question_2.question: In which scenarios can the RAN send ANBR recommending UE transmission at an uplink bitrate R1 greater than the current rate R0?
question_2.ground_truth: The RAN can send ANBR recommending UE transmission at an uplink bitrate R1 greater than the current rate R0 in the case of GBR bearer/GFBR flow and assuming GBR/GFBR < recommended bitrate < MBR/GFBR, or in the case of non-GBR bearer/non-GFBR flow.

question_3.question: What is the maximum number of diversions permitted for each communication in the CD service and Communication Forwarding (CF) services?
question_3.ground_truth: The maximum number of diversions permitted for each communication is a network provider option for the CD service and a service provider option for the CF services. The service provider or network provider defines the upper limit of diversions, and when counting the number of diversions, all types of diversion are included.

question_4.question: What is the purpose of the pre-established session between the MCPTT UE and the MCPTT server?
question_4.ground_truth: The pre-established session between the MCPTT UE and the MCPTT server is used to maintain the connection between the two, and it can be modified or removed by using the SIP procedures for session modification and terminating a SIP session.

question_6.question: Which attribute group is referenced in the ProSeUserEntryType complex type?

question_7.question: What is the focus of the Enhanced Performance Requirements Type A - Single-layer Spatial Multiplexing with TM9 interference model (User-Specific Reference Symbols) test?
question_7.ground_truth: The focus of this test is to verify closed loop rank one performance on one of the antenna ports 7 or 8 without a simultaneous transmission on the other antenna port in the serving cell when the PDSCH transmission in the serving cell is interfered by PDSCH of one dominant interfering cell applying transmission mode 9 interference model defined in clause B.5.4.

question_9.question: What is the purpose of the "Register" message in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
question_9.ground_truth: The "Register" message is used to assign a new transaction identifier for call independent supplementary service control and to request or acknowledge a supplementary service.

question_10.question: How does the NWDAF containing AnLF use the rate of untrusted AF data sources?
question_10.ground_truth: The NWDAF containing AnLF may use the rate of untrusted AF data sources as a criterion to calculate the confidence level of the respective analytics output.

question_11.question: What should the UE do if it is unable to report the requested GPS assistance data?
question_11.ground_truth: The UE may send a measurement report containing the "UE positioning error" and should not send another measurement report for at least 20s to request the same GPS assistance data.

question_12.question: What are the main functions of the RLC/MAC layer in the GPRS radio interface?
question_12.ground_truth: The RLC/MAC layer provides services for information transfer over the physical layer in the GPRS radio interface. It includes backward error correction procedures enabled by the selective retransmission of erroneous blocks and arbitrates access to the shared medium between multiple MSs and the Network.

question_13.question: What condition triggers the SS to terminate the dialogue in Option 3 of the test procedure?
question_13.ground_truth: The SS terminates the dialogue when the user ignores the location request by taking no action, allowing the verification process timer to time-out.

question_14.question: What action should the RNC take when it receives a RESET RESOURCE message from the CN, indicating that the CN is releasing resources and references associated with the Iu signalling connection identifiers in the received message?
question_14.ground_truth: The RNC should release locally the resources and references associated to the Iu signalling connection identifiers indicated in the received message, and should return a RESET RESOURCE ACKNOWLEDGE message to the CN after all Iu-related resources and references have been released.

question_16.question: When is a change of the set of S-NSSAIs associated with an established PDU Session, released by the network?
question_16.ground_truth: If the S-NSSAIs in the Allowed NSSAI of the PDU Session do not match any of the values in the mapping of the Requested NSSAI to S-NSSAIs, the network releases this PDU Session. The PDU Session(s) context is also released in the UE.

question_17.question: Who is responsible for monitoring accredited actors within the SECAM scheme?
question_17.ground_truth: The SECAM Accreditation Body is responsible for monitoring three types of accredited actors: vendors, security compliance testing laboratories, basic vulnerability testing laboratories, and enhanced vulnerability analysis laboratories within the SECAM scheme.

question_18.question: Who is the father of computer science?

question_20.question: What is the data type of the "allow-request-locally-initiated-ambient-viewing" element in the 3GPP specification?
question_20.ground_truth: The "allow-request-locally-initiated-ambient-viewing" element is a Boolean data type in the 3GPP specification.

question_21.question: What is the role of the SMF in the PDU session modification when a new DNAI is received?
question_21.ground_truth: When a new DNAI is received, the SMF inserts the new ULCL and new L-PSA, which is better serves the new EAS.

question_22.question: What are the general requirements specified for the Service Enabler Architecture Layer (SEAL)?
question_22.ground_truth: The general requirements for SEAL specified in the Technical Specification include: supporting applications from one or more verticals, offering SEAL services as APIs to vertical applications, supporting notification mechanisms, and ensuring the API interactions between the vertical application server(s) and SEAL server(s) will conform to CAPIF.

question_23.question: Which R1 31-1 option provides guard symbol reception in the documentation?
question_23.ground_truth: The enumerated value "supported" in guardSymbolReportReception-IAB-r17 provides guard symbol reception in the documentation.

question_25.question: What is the function of the 3GPP System with regards to establishing and controlling communication from a UE to its private group?

question_27.question: What is the role of the LMA in the PMIPv6-based network?
question_27.ground_truth: The LMA (Local Mobility Anchor) is a key component of a PMIPv6-based network that manages the Local Mobility Anchor functionality, handling IPv4 and IPv6 traffic, and assigning GRE keys, LMA addresses, and UE Interface Identifiers.

question_28.question: What is the purpose of the limits on spurious emissions in the document, and when do they become mandatory?
question_28.ground_truth: The limits on spurious emissions in the document are used for the protection of systems operating in frequency ranges other than the BS downlink operating band. They become mandatory when set by local or regional regulation for an operating band or specific systems.

question_30.question: What is the role of the Information Model in the Network Resource Model (NRM)?
question_30.ground_truth: The Information Model in the Network Resource Model (NRM) defines the semantics and behavior of information object class attributes and relations in a protocol and technology neutral way.

question_31.question: What is the responsibility of the NSP OSS SML in this possible solution?
question_31.ground_truth: The NSP OSS SML receives the service order request from the NSP BSS, analyzes the NSC requirements for network slice management capabilities exposure, captures them in the form of NSC-specific access control data, and sends a service order response to the BSS.

question_33.question: How is a deliveryMethod element related to a Session Description fragment in MBMS?
question_33.ground_truth: Each deliveryMethod instance in an instance of the userServiceDescription element must refer to one Session Description fragment.

question_34.question: What happens if no packets were detected for the duration of the Summary Timer in the EPS bearer packet flow?
question_34.ground_truth: The Packet Data Summary Report shall not be sent.

question_36.question: How does specifying the last class instance in a Netconf request uniquely identify the exact instance?
question_36.ground_truth: When retrieving data using a self-contained class, only the last class instance needs to be specified in the request as it uniquely identifies the exact instance.

question_37.question: What are the guidelines for constructing the profile schema in 3GPP GUP?
question_37.ground_truth: The guidelines emphasize on modularity, extensibility, readability, easy support for versioning, and isolation of the schema components.

question_38.question: What is the purpose of "Index of selected SCCPCH" in 3GPP TS 25.321?
question_38.ground_truth: The "Index of selected SCCPCH" identifies the selected SCCPCH with the PCH and the uniquely associated PICH to be used by the UE in 3GPP TS 25.321. It is selected based on "Initial UE Identity" as follows: "Index of selected SCCPCH" = "Initial UE Identity" mod K.

question_40.question: What is the purpose of the candidate 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay discovery procedure?
question_40.ground_truth: The candidate 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay discovery procedure supports the target 5G ProSe end UE to discover the candidate 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE when it needs to reselect the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay for negotiated 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-UE relay reselection.

question_42.question: What should be the value of the "may include <report-suspension> element" in the MCVideo function?
question_42.ground_truth: The "may include <report-suspension>" element can be set to "true" or "false" in the MCVideo function.

question_43.question: What message is sent by the MS after receiving the RRLP Measure Position Request in Option 1 with a delay of 8 seconds?
question_43.ground_truth: The MS sends the RRLP Measure Position Response to SS with the measurement data after finishing the measurement.

question_44.question: What is one of the potential new requirements for 5G system to support secure clock signals to devices and application servers in a reliable manner?
question_44.ground_truth: The 5G system shall support a mechanism to verify authorization of a 3rd party application server to use a 5G timing resiliency service is one of the potential new requirements for 5G system to support secure clock signals to devices and application servers in a reliable manner.

question_45.question: Which TS in the 3GPP technical specification series defines the procedures used for Short Message Control (SMC) and Short Message Relay (SM-RL) functions across various mobile radio interfaces (A/Gb mode, GPRS, EPS, and 5GS)?

question_46.question: Which PUCCH format does the NACK to ACK detection requirement apply to, in terms of the number of UCI bits?
question_46.ground_truth: The NACK to ACK detection requirement only applies to the PUCCH format 1 with 2 UCI bits.

question_47.question: What is the meaning of "5G ProSe Direct Discovery" in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
question_47.ground_truth: In 3GPP technical specifications, "5G ProSe Direct Discovery" refers to a function employed by a 5G ProSe-enabled UE to discover other 5G ProSe-enabled UEs in its vicinity based on direct radio transmissions between the two UEs with NR technology.

question_48.question: What is the difference between the first digit's values in the version number of the 3GPP documents?
question_48.ground_truth: The first digit's value represents the stage of the document in the 3GPP standardization process. A version number with 'x' as the first digit is presented to the TSG for information, 'y' as the first digit is presented to the TSG for approval, and 'z' as the first digit is a TSG approved document under change control.

question_49.question: What is the impact of new channel bandwidths on UEs that do not support the new solution?
question_49.ground_truth: UEs that do not support the new solution should be able to use the next lower supported channel bandwidth in both uplink and downlink without any implications.

question_50.question: What is the purpose of Concurrent Features Activation with Bi-control (CFA-BC) in B-ISDN?
question_50.ground_truth: CFA-BC enables a call to be influenced by some features at two different points concurrently, with a pre-defined set of features controlled by its context with bi-control relationship.

question_51.question: What is the message definition of the ProSe UE to UE relay update accept?
question_51.ground_truth: This message is sent by the target end UE to 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-UE relay UE to complete the relay update procedure.

question_52.question: What is the conductive test tolerance for the mandatory spurious emissions requirements for OTA transmitter and receiver?
question_52.ground_truth: The conductive test tolerance for the mandatory spurious emissions requirements for OTA transmitter and receiver is zero.

question_53.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) and what is the purpose of its Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects?
question_53.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) is an international organization that develops technical specifications for 3G systems. The Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects is responsible for defining the telecommunication management of 3G systems, including the interface between the managing system and the managed system.

question_57.question: What must the MME include in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message when it modifies the current EPS security context or takes a non-current native EPS security context into use?
question_57.ground_truth: The eKSI of the EPS security context to be modified and a new set of selected NAS security algorithms

question_58.question: What is the default priority assigned to a location service request if the LCS Priority parameter is absent in a BSSMAP-LE Perform Location request?
question_58.ground_truth: If the LCS Priority parameter is absent in a BSSMAP-LE Perform Location request, the lowest priority shall be assumed.

question_59.question: What is the purpose of the Hosted SEPP providers using their own unique credentials for authentication?
question_59.ground_truth: The Hosted SEPP providers must use their own unique credentials for authentication to enable operators that receive signaling from a Hosted SEPP provider to verify that the Hosted SEPP provider has been authorized by the roaming partner. This helps to ensure the security and integrity of communication between different PLMNs.

question_60.question: What is the focus of the enhanced FR2 HST requirements in 3GPP TS 38.854 v0.4.0?
question_60.ground_truth: The enhanced FR2 HST requirements in 3GPP TS 38.854 v0.4.0 focus on cell re-selection, RRC connection mobility control, gradual timing adjustment, SSB based radio link monitoring and beam failure detection, intra-frequency measurement, and L1-RSRP/SINR measurement for specific scenarios. Additionally, it specifies the new requirements of one shot large UL timing adjustment and TCI state switch delay for FR2 HST scenarios.

question_61.question: What is the responsibility of the MBMS subchannel control in MBMS subchannel control messages?
question_61.ground_truth: The MBMS subchannel control in MBMS subchannel control messages is responsible for the control of media and floor control broadcast over a MBMS subchannel.

question_62.question: What is the purpose of the test procedure outlined in 9.3.1C.4.2?
question_62.ground_truth: The purpose of the test procedure outlined in 9.3.1C.4.2 is to verify that the reporting accuracy of the channel quality indicator (CQI) under AWGN (additive white Gaussian noise) propagation conditions with periodically varying radio conditions is within the specified limits.

question_63.question: What reference points for group management are supported by the SEAL-C of the MSGin5G Service?
question_63.ground_truth: The SEAL-C of the MSGin5G Service supports the GM-C reference point for group management.

question_65.question: What are the four requirements specified for the flexible layer one in the context of IMS services?
question_65.ground_truth: The four requirements specified for the flexible layer one in the context of IMS services are: (1) to fulfill most of the IMS requirements in terms of radio bearer service attributes, (2) to support the multiplexing of parallel flows onto a basic physical subchannel, (3) to provide an optimisation of spectral efficiency through the support of different interleaving depths, unequal error protection/detection, reduced channel coding rate granularity, and support of 8PSK and GMSK modulations, and (4) to provide an efficient support of real-time IMS services.

question_66.question: What should the receiving side of an AM RLC entity do if it receives an AMD PDU with a sequence number (SN) outside of the receiving window?
question_66.ground_truth: The receiving side should discard the received AMD PDU.

question_67.question: In which subclause of clause 12 of the document does the value part of the information element get described?
question_67.ground_truth: The name of the type of the information element generally refers to the subclause describing the value part of the information element in clause 12 of the document.

question_70.question: What should the SME do in the case where all automatic attempts fail in sending an SMS-SUBMIT?
question_70.ground_truth: If all automatic attempts fail, the user shall be informed and the failed message should be stored in the mobile in such a way that the user can request a retransmission using the same TP-MR value, without the need to re-enter any information.

question_71.question: What are the two types of security requirements in SECAM?
question_71.ground_truth: The two types of security requirements in SECAM are functional requirements and hardening requirements. Functional requirements describe the features of the network product related to security, while hardening requirements focus on making the software/hardware of a network product robust against unauthorized remote or physical access.

question_72.question: What is the purpose of the propagation condition "Case 2" in the UTRA simulations?
question_72.ground_truth: The purpose of the propagation condition "Case 2" in the UTRA simulations is to test the receiver under high delay spread conditions, ensuring efficient support of repeaters and not exceeding reasonable complexity or performance impact on the receiver.

question_73.question: What is the issue with having a token lifetime that is too short or too long?
question_73.ground_truth: If the token lifetime is too short, it may result in overloaded storage resources in the UE and eNB, while if it is too long, it may also overload the storage resources due to no reason.

question_74.question: What is the channel coding for the RATSCCH mechanism defined in 3GPP TS 28.062?
question_74.ground_truth: The channel coding for the RATSCCH mechanism is defined in 3GPP TS 45.003.

question_76.question: What is the purpose of Common access class control in the network?
question_76.ground_truth: Common access class control allows the network to restrict access for certain groups of mobile stations, also known as access classes, for access to both domains or to one domain only.

question_77.question: What is an Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the context of 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects?
question_77.ground_truth: An IRP is a reference point that defines the interface between two functional entities in the 3GPP network, allowing them to interact and exchange information based on a common information model.

question_80.question: Under what circumstances should the UE insert a public GRUU value in the Contact header field?
question_80.ground_truth: The UE should insert the public GRUU value in the Contact header field if a public GRUU value has been saved associated with the public user identity from the P-Called-Party-ID header field, and the UE does not indicate privacy of the P-Asserted-Identity.

question_81.question: In what mode does the mobile station continue data transfer when it enters CCN mode after sending a PACKET CELL CHANGE NOTIFICATION message?
question_81.ground_truth: The mobile station continues data transfer in CCN mode, but does not perform the cell change.

question_83.question: In the context of an MCPTT emergency group call, what indication should the MCPTT client display if the <emergency-ind> element is set to "true" in the SIP INVITE request?
question_83.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should display an indication that this is an MCPTT emergency group call, the MCPTT ID of the originator, the MCPTT group identity, and if the <alert-ind> element is set to "true", an MCPTT emergency alert and associated information.

question_84.question: What is the objective of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's LTE 450 MHz in Brazil work item?
question_84.ground_truth: The objective is to specify technical requirements for deploying LTE operation in the 450 MHz band in Brazil.

question_86.question: How can the media key be retrieved for lawful interception purposes?
question_86.ground_truth: The media key can be retrieved from the KMS based on the identities of calling parties. If the terminal is roaming, the KMS in the visited network or the home network can be contacted to retrieve the media key.

question_87.question: What does the abortMultipleCalls() method indicate to the application?
question_87.ground_truth: It indicates that a number of ongoing call sessions have aborted or terminated abnormally.

question_89.question: What should the MAC entity do if it is a BL UE or UE in enhanced coverage and Random Access Preamble group B does not exist?
question_89.ground_truth: The MAC entity should select the Random Access Preambles group corresponding to the selected enhanced coverage level.

question_90.question: How many pilot symbols are inserted for every data symbol in Class-1 modulation and Class-2 modulation respectively?
question_90.ground_truth: In Class-1 modulation, 4 pilot symbols are inserted for every 11 data symbols, while in Class-2 modulation, 2 pilot symbols are inserted for every 8 data symbols.

question_91.question: In what ways can Handover Optimization based on UE Load benefit the target eNB?
question_91.ground_truth: Handover Optimization based on UE Load can benefit the target eNB by providing knowledge about the projected UE load, including additional radio and virtual resources. This information can help the target eNB manage its resources more efficiently and handle handover requests more effectively, leading to improved network performance.

question_92.question: What does the measurement "DL total available PRB" represent in the context of 5G?
question_92.ground_truth: The "DL total available PRB" measurement provides the total number of physical resource blocks (PRBs) available for downlink transmission in 5G.

question_93.question: What happens in service flow 1 during a loss of connection between eNB and EPC in the local fall back at eNB individual call use case?
question_93.ground_truth: A fault develops in the link between eNB and EPC, disconnecting the eNB from the EPC, halting the information flow between Mick and Ned, and the information flow between Oscar and Peter. All participants under the coverage of the affected eNB receive an indication that the eNB has been disconnected from the network.

question_94.question: What is the procedure to off-load ECM-CONNECTED mode UEs using the S1 Release procedure?
question_94.ground_truth: The MME initiates the S1 Release procedure with release cause "load balancing TAU required", and the S1 and RRC connections are released. The UE initiates a TAU but provides neither the S-TMSI nor the GUMMEI to eNodeB in the RRC establishment.

question_95.question: When the MS receives a downlink message to initiate uplink GPRS user data transfer while the GA-PSR TC activation procedure is in progress, what should it do?
question_95.ground_truth: The MS should process the request as if the transport channel was active and not initiate uplink GPRS user data transfer until the GA-PSR TC activation procedure is successfully completed.

question_96.question: What are the three conformance testing functions that can be activated (and deactivated) in the UE, as specified in the document?
question_96.ground_truth: UE test loop function, UE radio bearer test mode, and Electrical Man Machine Interface (EMMI).

question_97.question: In a FDD system, when will the Node B activate the inner loop DL power control for all RLs?
question_97.ground_truth: The Node B shall activate the inner loop DL power control for all RLs, if the received Inner Loop DL PC Status IE is set to "Active" in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message.

question_98.question: When should the UE populate the P-Access-Network-Info header field within a dialog?
question_98.ground_truth: During the dialog, the UE should populate the P-Access-Network-Info header field in any request or response within a dialog with the current point of attachment to the IP-CAN (e.g. the current cell information).

question_99.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 8.6.1.2.3?
question_99.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in 8.6.1.2.3 is to verify that the UE meets the minimum requirements.

question_100.question: What is the purpose of 3GPP analyzing the content of the default overload algorithm?
question_100.ground_truth: 3GPP is trying to agree on the use of this default algorithm for its own usage and indicate generic points needed for 3GPP applications. They are also investigating specific 3GPP client and application behavior to provide their own overload specific algorithms.

question_101.question: What should the UE do if the PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message is received over a specific access type in an SNPN, and the timer T3585 is running for all the equivalent SNPNs and that access type?
question_101.ground_truth: The UE should apply the timer T3585 for all the equivalent SNPNs and that access type.

question_103.question: What is the maximum length of the HNB Address?
question_103.ground_truth: The maximum length of HNB Address shall be 48 bytes.

question_104.question: What is the effect of the Implicit De-registration timer expiring before the UE contacts the network?
question_104.ground_truth: If the Implicit De-registration timer expires before the UE contacts the network, the AMF implicitly de-registers the UE.

question_105.question: What is the minimum number of uplink slots the SS commands the EGPRS MS to transmit for the output RF spectrum measurements as defined in 3GPP TS 44.014 subclause 5.4?
question_105.ground_truth: The SS commands the EGPRS MS to transmit with its maximum number of uplink slots, with 16-QAM modulation in hopping mode for the output RF spectrum measurements.

question_106.question: What changes are required for aligned RF carriers on the transmitter side for combined UE CBW in one cell?
question_106.ground_truth: Two RF carriers phase-aligned on the Tx side are required to ensure phase continuity on the Rx side. Also, the irregular bandwidth is split into two sets of PRBs and filtered through the next smaller bandwidth after which the signal is combined at the receiver's baseband as a single carrier. UE may benefit from supporting intra-band non-contiguous CA for such processing.

question_108.question: What is continuously transmitted by SS and ensured by SS for duration of 200 ms?
question_108.ground_truth: The SS continuously transmits on PSCell and ensures inactivity timer is expired on the UE for LTE PCell.

question_111.question: What should the MCX Service do if there is an imminent peril group communication?
question_111.ground_truth: The MCX Service shall be capable of requesting increased priority for all Participants of an Imminent Peril group communication, maintain knowledge of the Affiliated MCX Service Group Member(s) that initiated the Imminent Peril group communication, and maintain an In-progress Imminent Peril condition from the time the initial Imminent Peril group communication was requested until the In-progress Imminent Peril condition is cancelled.

question_112.question: What is the aim of the present document (Technical Report in 3GPP's 3rd Generation Partnership Project) in supporting maritime communication services?
question_112.ground_truth: The present document aims to support maritime communication services between users ashore and at sea or between vessels at sea over the 3GPP system, targeting improved maritime safety, protection of the maritime environment, and promotion of shipping efficiency. Ultimately, it aims to narrow the information gap between mobile users on land and shipboard users on vessels at sea by enabling mobile broadband services.

question_114.question: What is the role of the IRI-POI function in the 3GPP system?
question_114.ground_truth: The IRI-POI function is responsible for providing intercept capabilities in the 3GPP system.

question_115.question: What must be submitted with metrics reports by the Media Session Handler?
question_115.ground_truth: Metrics reports shall be submitted by the Media Session Handler in a format specified by the metrics reporting scheme in question.

question_116.question: What type of message is sent when the MS performs a combined GPRS attach and no valid TMSI is available?
question_116.ground_truth: The TMSI status information element (9.4.1.3) is included in the ATTACH REQUEST message when the MS performs a combined GPRS attach and no valid TMSI is available.

question_117.question: What is the purpose of hardening requirements in the described security problem definition?
question_117.ground_truth: Hardening requirements aim to reduce the attack surface and security vulnerability of the network product, ensuring that security functions cannot be bypassed and unneeded or insecure functionality is removed.

question_118.question: What mode must the MS be in for the negotiation procedure to be initiated?
question_118.ground_truth: The MS initiates the negotiation procedure after the CONNECKT ACKNOWLEDGE message in ADM or ABM mode.

question_119.question: How is the high frequency band signal generated in the source-filter model for the high-band?
question_119.ground_truth: The high frequency band signal is generated using a source-filter model where the filter is an LP filter derived from the LP filter in the low-band. The LP filter in the high-band is preliminarily equalized to match the levels of the two LP filters at a given frequency point of 6000 Hz.

question_120.question: What should the PGW-C do when it receives a GTP error indication from a SGW-U for the default bearer?
question_120.ground_truth: The PGW-C shall delete all the Bearer contexts associated with the PDN connection with a delete session message to SGW-C and may notify the Operation and Maintenance network element.

question_121.question: What command is sent by the MRFC to start an announcement?
question_121.ground_truth: The MRFC sends an ADD or MODIFY command to start an announcement.

question_122.question: When intra-frequency SMTC is partially overlapping with measurement gaps, what is the formula for Kp?
question_122.ground_truth: Kp = 1 / (1 - (SMTC period / MGRP)), where SMTC period < MGRP

question_123.question: What are the potential security requirements related to "Security aspects of Data Channel usage in IMS network"?
question_123.ground_truth: The potential security requirements are: (1) communication over IMS data channel shall be confidentiality, integrity and replay protected, (2) the peers over IMS data channel shall be mutually authenticated, and (3) the path between IMS-AGW and external data server shall be confidentiality, integrity and replay protected.

question_124.question: What is the purpose of the "Spare extension" field in the error handling procedure?
question_124.ground_truth: The "Spare extension" field is included in the error handling procedure to allow for the addition of new fields or information in later versions of the document, without being interpreted by the receiver in the current version of the document.

question_125.question: What are the exceptions to the default system information messages specified in clause 6.1.0b?
question_125.ground_truth: The exceptions include the contents of System information block type 1, 3, 4, and 5 (FDD) for both FDD and TDD.

question_127.question: In what circumstances should the UE abort the registration procedure for initial registration and re-initiate it immediately when changing into a new tracking area?
question_127.ground_truth: When the UE changes into a new tracking area before receiving the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

question_128.question: What is the format of the Operator Identifier based N3IWF FQDN?

question_129.question: What is the role of the RUA in the I1-ps approach with CS voice bearers in the IMS multimedia telephony service?
question_129.ground_truth: The RUA is responsible for inserting the IMS session toward the CSCF on behalf of the UE, combining the Bearer Control Signalling and Session Control Signalling stimuli at the RUA for presentation of the IMS session.

question_131.question: What happens if a mobile FRMCS User is already active in an ongoing Railway Emergency Alert and a new one is triggered?
question_131.ground_truth: The new Railway Emergency Alert is sent to the end user device of the mobile FRMCS User, and any ongoing non-emergency-voice communications are put in the queue.

question_132.question: What does this solution introduce to reuse CAPIF for Edge application architecture?
question_132.ground_truth: This solution introduces the serving area to the service API information and query information in the service API publish and discover procedures in CAPIF.

question_133.question: How are minimum requirements determined for the purposes of testing?
question_133.ground_truth: The minimum requirements given in this specification make no allowance for measurement uncertainty. The test specifications define test tolerances, which are used to relax the minimum requirements in this specification to create test requirements.

question_139.question: In what mode should the network operation be the same in each cell of a routing area for proper operation?
question_139.ground_truth: The network operation should be the same in mode I or II in each cell of a routing area for proper operation.

question_140.question: What should the SMF do if it determines that the DL NAS TRANSPORT message carrying the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message was not forwarded by the 5G access network due to a cause other than handover procedure in progress?
question_140.ground_truth: The SMF shall reject the UE-requested PDU session modification procedure with an appropriate 5GSM cause value in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message.

question_141.question: What interference model is applied in 8.3.1.1E?
question_141.ground_truth: The PDSCH transmission in the serving cell is interfered by PDSCH of two interfering cells applying transmission mode 3 interference model defined in clause B.6.2 in 8.3.1.1E.

question_142.question: What band is allocated to the mobile service on a primary basis in the 5850-5925 MHz frequency band in all regions?
question_142.ground_truth: The 5850-5925 MHz frequency band is allocated to the mobile service on a primary basis in all regions.

question_143.question: Which LBT scheme based on the Wi-Fi medium access protocol with slot size, contention windows and exponential backoff showed a majority of sources that evaluated it to be able to operate without impacting Wi-Fi more than another Wi-Fi network?
question_143.ground_truth: Category 4 LBT scheme with Wi-Fi preamble detection

question_144.question: What is the role of the "source BSS" in the PS handover preparation phase?
question_144.ground_truth: The source BSS is responsible for requesting a PS handover for an MS with one or more PFCs subject to handover, and signalling radio resources and system information to the MS before it moves to the target cell. The source BSS also ensures that the target BSS/GANC reserves necessary resources for the active PFCs in the target network nodes.

question_145.question: What is the role of "Adjusted Segment Availability Start Time" (ASAST) for a Segment?
question_145.ground_truth: ASAST is used to determine the exact availability time of a Segment for a Representation, which can be derived from the MPD using the Segment availability start time minus the Segment duration announced in the MPD. The ASAST is used to calculate the start time of each Segment within a Represention, considering any offsets provided in the MPD.

question_146.question: What is the requirement for the UE to send ACK/NACK throughout the test?
question_146.ground_truth: The UE shall send continuous ACK/NACK throughout the test, and from the start of T2 until Event A3 is reported, at least 85% ACK/NACK shall be detected.

question_147.question: Which ID has a criticality value of "ignore" and a presence indicator of "mandatory" in the MBMSSessionStartResponse-IEs?
question_147.ground_truth: id-MME-MBMS-M3AP-ID has a criticality value of "ignore" and a presence indicator of "mandatory" in the MBMSSessionStartResponse-IEs.

question_150.question: What audio-related information should be included in the SDP payload when the ICS UE proposes an audio stream over a circuit-switched bearer?
question_150.ground_truth: The ICS UE should include a "c=" line with the nettype portion set to "PSTN", a CS media "m=" line with the media portion set to "audio", and a=setup attribute set to "active". Additionally, it should add an a=cs-correlation attribute with the MSISDN of the ICS UE in the CS domain, in international E.164 number format.

question_151.question: What is the Intermediate Rate field of the ISDN Bearer Capability information element value when the User Rate is 19.2 kbit/s?
question_151.ground_truth: The Intermediate Rate field of the ISDN Bearer Capability information element value is 32 kbit/s when the User Rate is 19.2 kbit/s.

question_154.question: What are the requirements for a 300 (Multiple Choices) response in a roaming II-NNI during a collaborative session?
question_154.ground_truth: A Content-Type header field containing the MIME type "application/vnd.3gpp.iut+xml" and an "application/vnd.3gpp.iut+xml" MIME body shall be supported.

question_155.question: What action is taken by the UAE Server in response to a positive C2 mode switching confirmation response from the UAS application specific server?
question_155.ground_truth: The UAE Server sends to the involved UAE Clients, a C2 operation mode switching message which provides an instruction to the UAV and UAV-C to switch between the networks, to network-assisted mode or to direct mode or to UTM-Navigated.

question_156.question: Which UICC application's AIDs can be included in "Provisioning.xml" for the Contact Manager Server to be associated with?
question_156.ground_truth: One or several UICC applications' AIDs can be included in "Provisioning.xml" for the Contact Manager Server to be associated with.

question_157.question: In Intermodulation response rejection testing, what measure is used to test the receiver's capability to receive a wanted signal on its assigned channel frequency in the presence of two or more interfering signals?
question_157.ground_truth: Intermodulation response rejection is a measure of the capability of a receiver to receive a desired signal on the assigned channel frequency in the presence of two or more interfering signals that have a specific frequency relationship to the wanted signal.

question_158.question: What algorithm is used to generate the 16 bits hash for authentication in the C-MAC algorithm?
question_158.ground_truth: A proprietary implementation of the well-known C-MAC algorithm is used to generate the 16 bits hash for authentication in the MAC-PDUs.

question_159.question: What procedure does the Access Server (AS) use to determine the UE capabilities (e.g. video) when providing announcements during a communication session?
question_159.ground_truth: The AS takes the media feature tags into account to determine the UE capabilities when providing announcements.

question_160.question: What is the bandwidth of the square filter for measuring the mean power spectral density inNR tests?
question_160.ground_truth: The bandwidth of the square filter is equal to the RF bandwidth of the TAB connector, centred on the central frequency of the RF bandwidth.

question_161.question: How does a functional entity indicate support of a specific CAMEL phase 4 CSI?
question_161.ground_truth: To indicate support of a specific CAMEL phase 4 CSI, a functional entity shall have the ability to trigger on any initial service event possible for that CSI. For example, if a functional entity supports the CAMEL phase 4 O-CSI, it shall indicate this in its registration request to the HLR.

question_162.question: How does EU-ALERT support international roaming for warning notifications?
question_162.ground_truth: EU-ALERT supports international roaming for warning notifications by using the same Message Identifier for warning notifications in the local language, and using the same Message Identifier for warning notifications broadcast in other languages besides the local language.

question_164.question: What does the 3GPP Technical Specification Group produce in terms of mobile networks?
question_164.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group produces technical specifications for 3GPP (Third Generation Partnership Project) systems, including UTRAN, E-UTRAN, and Iu mode GERAN.

question_166.question: What is the Content-Format value that should be set in the MSGin5G procedure for indicating application/json format in the CoAP payload?
question_166.ground_truth: The Content-Format value that should be set in the MSGin5G procedure for indicating application/json format in the CoAP payload is 50.

question_168.question: What is the role of the Broadcast Service Function (BSF) in the multi-modal QoS flow solution?
question_168.ground_truth: The BSF stores and updates the information of multi-modal data flows group, including the corresponding PCF IP address, UE IP address, etc. It also discovers other PCFs that are responsible for generating the QoS policy for multi-modal data flows belonging to the same multi-modal data flows group.

question_169.question: What action should the participating MCVideo function take if the public user identity and an MCVideo ID binding has expired?
question_169.ground_truth: If the participating MCVideo function cannot find a binding between the public user identity and an MCVideo ID or if the validity period of an existing binding has expired, then the participating MCVideo function shall reject the SIP REFER request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response with a specific warning text.

question_170.question: What are the two domains that the user authentication mechanism in this solution covers?
question_170.ground_truth: The two domains that the user authentication mechanism in this solution covers are the trust domain between the UE and the Identity Manager, and the trust domain between the UE, the URR, and the application servers.

question_172.question: What is the data structure used to encode the properties of a new MBS Distribution Session when adding it to an MBS User Data Ingest Session?
question_172.ground_truth: The data structure used to encode the properties of a new MBS Distribution Session when adding it to an MBS User Data Ingest Session is the MBSDistributionSessionInfo data structure.

question_173.question: What is the attribute number 4 used for in RADIUS attributes but not for DIAMETER?
question_173.ground_truth: Attribute number 4 is unassigned and not used for DIAMETER but in RADIUS attributes.

question_174.question: What should the UE include in the Contact header when sending a REGISTER request?
question_174.ground_truth: The UE should include SIP URI(s) that contain the IP address of the UE or FQDN, the instance ID of the UE in the +sip.instance parameter if the UE supports GRUU, all supported ICSI values, and IARI values for the IMS communication services and IMS applications it intends to use in a sip.app-subtype feature tag.

question_175.question: What is the purpose of providing Usage Monitoring control related information per access in the PDU Session related policy control information?
question_175.ground_truth: The purpose of providing Usage Monitoring control related information per access in the PDU Session related policy control information is to enable the PCF control of PDU Session level Usage Monitoring based on the access type used to carry the traffic.

question_177.question: What should the UE do if the service request procedure is rejected with the EMM cause with the same value and the UE is operating in single-registration mode?
question_177.ground_truth: If the message was received via 3GPP access and the UE is operating in single-registration mode, the UE shall handle the EMM parameters EMM state, EPS update status, 4G-GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list and eKSI as specified in 3GPP TS 24.301 for this case.

question_180.question: What information does the SMF provide to the UPF (PSA) in a N4 Session Modification Request message?
question_180.ground_truth: The SMF provides the DL CN Tunnel Info of the I-UPF or the target NG-RAN Tunnel Info to the UPF (PSA) in a N4 Session Modification Request message.

question_181.question: What are the two reporting levels for Credit-Control in SCUR?
question_181.ground_truth: The two reporting levels for Credit-Control in SCUR are per rating group, and per combination of the rating group and service id.

question_183.question: What is the focus of Solution 1, which proposes to use IPsec between the RN and DeNB to protect both the user plane and control plane signalling?
question_183.ground_truth: The focus of this solution is to prevent attacks by using IPsec to protect S1-AP/X2-AP interface between the RN and DeNB, and to use IPsec for both control plane and user plane to protect the S1-U and X2-U interfaces.

question_185.question: Under what conditions should FEC be used to provide robustness against packet loss?
question_185.ground_truth: FEC should be used to provide robustness against moderate packet loss rates at high delay scenario, especially in environments with high packet loss rates and/or high delay (RTT). However, it may not be appropriate when packet losses are caused by insufficient throughput since it introduces bit rate overhead.

question_186.question: What is the maximum spurious emission level in the analysis of co-existence with Band 5?
question_186.ground_truth: The spurious emission level used in the analysis for co-existence with Band 5 is -49 dBm/MHz.

question_187.question: In the context of NR SL inter-band concurrent operating bands, what does the term "NR Uu carrier and NR Sidelink carrier" represent?
question_187.ground_truth: NR Uu carrier refers to the user equipment (UE) radio transmission in the uplink operating band, while NR Sidelink carrier refers to the UE radio transmission in the sidelink operating band.

question_188.question: In the context of the in-band blocking requirement, what is the definition of interfering signal offset when using a multi-band TAB connector?
question_188.ground_truth: When using a multi-band TAB connector, the interfering signal offset is defined relative to the lower / upper Base Station RF Bandwidth edges inside the Inter RF Bandwidth gap and is equal to -2.4 MHz/+2.4 MHz.

question_189.question: What is the parameter used by the PDCP entity to determine the ciphering or deciphering algorithm and key for DAPS bearers?
question_189.ground_truth: The parameter used by the PDCP entity to determine the ciphering or deciphering algorithm and key for DAPS bearers is based on the cell from/to which the PDCP SDU is transmitted/received.

question_190.question: What is the role of MME and eNB in case the calling party UE is not under coverage?
question_190.ground_truth: MME and eNB of the called party (if different from those of the calling party) would be in charge of requesting authorization when the calling party UE is not under coverage.

question_191.question: What protocols can be used for N6 PtP tunnelling mechanisms in delivering unstructured PDU type data to AS?
question_191.ground_truth: PMIPv6/GRE, L2TP, etc. are some of the N6 PtP tunnelling mechanisms that can be used to deliver unstructured PDU type data to AS.

question_192.question: How does the analysis assume the adjustment of PTRS parameters in OFDM when the number of symbols in each OFDM symbol becomes comparable to the PTRS symbol product?
question_192.ground_truth: The analysis assumes that PTRS parameters must be adjusted in a way that the PTRS symbol product is comparable to the total number of symbols available in each OFDM symbol.

question_193.question: What is the network capacity gain for MDSR compared to EGPRS with MRC for different 10th percentile session bit rate requirements in the 4/12 re-use scenario?
question_193.ground_truth: Network capacity gain is 200~% to 270 % for 100 kbps requirement and 340 % to 550 % for the 144 kbps connection average bit rate requirement.

question_195.question: What is the worst-case effective TCP payload and UDP payload, considering IPv4 and IPv6 packet sizes and their respective header sizes?
question_195.ground_truth: The worst-case effective TCP payload is 1436 octets for IPv6 and 1452 octets for IPv4, while the worst-case effective UDP payload is 1452 octets for IPv6 and 1468 octets for IPv4.

question_196.question: What is the primary role of the 5GSM sublayer in 5GS session management?
question_196.ground_truth: The main function of the 5GSM sublayer in 5GS session management is to support the PDU session handling in the UE and in the SMF, which is transferred via the AMF.

question_197.question: When does the old AMF determine whether the new AMF supports ATSSS or not?
question_197.ground_truth: The old AMF determines whether the new AMF supports ATSSS based on the supported features provided by the new AMF during step 4 of the registration.

question_198.question: What is the difference between a user channel and a control channel?
question_198.ground_truth: User channels are intended to carry user information, while control channels are used to provide signalling information for connection management, mobility management, and radio resource management.

question_199.question: What must the MCData client include in the SDS OFF-NETWORK MESSAGE message when sending a one-to-one SDS message in step 9.3.2.3.1 of the TS 24.282 clause?
question_199.ground_truth: The MCData client sends the SDS OFF-NETWORK MESSAGE message as specified in clause~9.3.1.1, which includes the SDS disposition request type IE, Sender MCData user ID IE, Recipient MCData user ID IE, Conversation ID IE, SDS message ID IE, Date and time IE, and optionally the Application ID IE or Extended application ID IE.

question_200.question: What is the purpose of the Missed ACK test in clause 10.2.2.2.1A.3?
question_200.ground_truth: The purpose of the Missed ACK test in clause 10.2.2.2.1A.3 is to verify that during an inter-cell soft handover for cell 1, the average probability for missed ACK, when E-HICH is transmitted using 12 consecutive slots, does not exceed specified values.

question_202.question: What is the mandatory requirement for the MCData client to download a file from the MCData content server over network resources with required QoS?

question_203.question: What is the purpose of the dispatcher capabilities in the MCVideo service?
question_203.ground_truth: Dispatchers need advanced capabilities for managing MCVideo services for MCVideo Users and fixed cameras under their control, such as requesting a monitoring camera to transmit a video to the dispatcher, terminating the video transmission from the monitoring camera, and distributing a video to MCVideo Group Members.

question_204.question: Which specification defines the symbols and abbreviations used in the 3GPP TS 36.521-2 technical specification?
question_204.ground_truth: The definitions, symbols, and abbreviations in the 3GPP TS 36.521-2 technical specification are based on the terms and abbreviations given in TR 21.905, TR 36.509, TR 36.508, ISO/IEC 9646-1, and ISO/IEC 9646-7.

question_205.question: In the scenario where LCLS becomes impossible after a handover, what should the MS do if LCLS was established before the handover attempt?
question_205.ground_truth: The MS should continue the call in the source BSS if possible and if LCLS was established before the handover attempt, the source BSS should keep LCLS established if possible.

question_206.question: How is the number of PCOMP values determined in protocol control information compression?
question_206.ground_truth: The number of PCOMP values is determined dynamically based on the negotiation of the XID parameters for protocol control information compression. Each assigned PCOMP value denotes one compressed frame type of that compression algorithm.

question_207.question: What should the initiating UE do upon receiving a DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION REQUEST to add a QoS flow to be used on an added unicast SL-DRB?
question_207.ground_truth: The initiating UE should be able to communicate using the newly added QoS flow on added SL-DRB.

question_208.question: What does the SCEF do after it receives the NIDD Authorisation Update Request message from the HSS to update a user's NIDD authorisation?
question_208.ground_truth: The SCEF initiates the SCEF Initiated T6a/T6b Connection Release Procedure and sends an NIDD Authorisation Update Response message to the HSS to acknowledge the authorisation update.

question_211.question: What message does the UE NAS layer build and send when the Deactivate EPS Bearer Context Request message from the MME indicated reactivation requested?
question_211.ground_truth: The UE NAS layer builds a Deactivate EPS Bearer Context Accept message and sends a Direct Transfer (Deactivate EPS Bearer Context Accept) message to the eNodeB.

question_212.question: What action should the UE take upon receiving a UEInformationRequest message with the idleModeMeasurementReq?
question_212.ground_truth: If the UE has stored VarMeasIdleReport that contains measurement information concerning cells other than the PCell, the UE should set the measResultIdleEUTRA and measResultIdleNR in the UEInformationResponse message to the value of measReportIdleEUTRA and measReportIdleNR in the VarMeasIdleReport.

question_214.question: What is the relation between ARP and BCM in the context of EPS?
question_214.ground_truth: The value of the ARP (Allocation and Retention Priority) of an EPS bearer is identical to the value of the ARP of the SDF(s) mapped to that EPS bearer, but SDFs associated with different QCIs or with the same service-level QCI but different ARP shall not be mapped to the same EPS bearer.

question_216.question: What should the MME do if it does not receive UE EPS security capabilities from the SGSN during a handover?
question_216.ground_truth: The MME shall assume that the default set of EPS security algorithms is supported by the UE.

question_217.question: Which message is sent by the ProSe Function in the described group priority update procedure?
question_217.ground_truth: The ProSe Function sends a Group Priority Notification (IMSI, L2 Group ID, Group Prio) message to the HSS to indicate the updated Group Prio to the eNB.

question_218.question: What should the Home eNodeB L-GW support for IP forwarding between a network accessed by LIPA and a UE?
question_218.ground_truth: The Home eNodeB L-GW should support IP forwarding of packets to multicast groups between the UE and the network accessed by LIPA.

question_219.question: What does the "Rule identifier" refer to in the context of PCC rule construction?
question_219.ground_truth: The "Rule identifier" is a unique value assigned to a PCC (Policy and Charging Control) rule within a PDU (Packet Data Unit) Session.

question_221.question: What is the maximum number of intra frequency TDD cells that a UE is required to be able to monitor?
question_221.ground_truth: A UE is required to be able to monitor up to 32 intra frequency TDD cells (including serving cell).

question_222.question: What is the purpose of the "Wait Time" between consecutive windows of time in the registration procedure?
question_222.ground_truth: The "Wait Time" is used to determine the start and end time of each consecutive window of time. It ensures that UEs only attempt registration during specific windows of time, allowing for a more staggered and manageable registration process.

question_225.question: What does the UE do when the 5GMM cause IE is set to the 5GMM cause #79 "UAS services not allowed"?
question_225.ground_truth: The UE indicates that the 5GSM message was not forwarded because it is not permitted to request UAS services.

question_226.question: In what scenario is the WLAN offload indication information element not taken into account for the Access stratum indication via untrusted WLAN?
question_226.ground_truth: When the move-traffic-to-WLAN indication is received from the access stratum layer of the 3GPP access, and the local operating environment information in the UE does not contain non-radio-related conditions that prohibit the use of WLAN access.

question_228.question: What is the objective of the measurements from all cells as identified in section 7.1.1?
question_228.ground_truth: The objective of the measurements from all cells as identified in section 7.1.1 is to obtain useful information from its surrounding cells for purposes such as interference management.

question_229.question: What is the purpose of locking down the virtualisation layer in a 3GPP network?
question_229.ground_truth: The purpose of locking down the virtualisation layer in a 3GPP network is to prevent unnecessary attack vectors, make it easier to monitor network behavior, and allow for maintenance and patching of the virtualisation layer and underlying hardware without impacting core services.

question_231.question: What should the MCVideo client set as the Request-URI of the SIP INVITE request when establishing an MCVideo private call?
question_231.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should set the Request-URI of the SIP INVITE request to a public service identity of the participating MCVideo function serving the MCVideo user.

question_232.question: What are the options for the applicable clause for lower power SRS relaxation due to TxD?
question_232.ground_truth: The options for the applicable clause for lower power SRS relaxation due to TxD are Option 1: Same as general, 6.2.4 (Ericsson, Oppo, Huawei), and Option 2: TxD suffix G (Samsung, ZTE, Qualcomm).

question_234.question: What is the difference between user-plane (UP) and controlled-plane (CP) based solutions for UE-to-Network Relay authorization and security?
question_234.ground_truth: UP based solutions use a UP connection to a PKMF while CP based solutions use the primary authentication for PC5 keys establishment.

question_235.question: What is the purpose of the "Promiscuous" approach in MBMS download?
question_235.ground_truth: Instructs FLUTE to receive all files available in the session.

question_236.question: What should the UE do upon reception of a DL NAS TRANSPORT message with the Payload container type IE set to "N1 SM information" and the 5GMM cause IE set to the 5GMM cause #78 "PLMN not allowed to operate at the present UE location"?
question_236.ground_truth: The UE should pass to the 5GSM sublayer an indication that the 5GSM message was not forwarded because the UE is registered to a PLMN via a satellite NG-RAN cell that is not allowed to operate at the present UE location along with the 5GSM message from the Payload container IE of the DL NAS TRANSPORT message.

question_237.question: Which reference point is used for the AAA-based charging solution in case of supporting the 3GPP offline charging system located in the HPLMN (non-roaming scenario) for fixed devices in the 3GPP and BBF network convergence architecture?
question_237.ground_truth: The Gza reference point is used for the AAA-based charging solution in case of supporting the 3GPP offline charging system located in the HPLMN (non-roaming scenario) for fixed devices in the 3GPP and BBF network convergence architecture.

question_238.question: What is the role of the SMF in selecting a UPF as the anchor for a PDU Session?
question_238.ground_truth: The SMF selects a UPF as the anchor for a PDU Session when the DNN in the "NEF Identity for NIDD" is not used in the "PDU Session Type" of the "Existing PDU Session".

question_240.question: What happens if all checks are successful and the new 3G-SGSN decides to construct MM and PDP contexts for the MS?
question_240.ground_truth: The new 3G-SGSN responds to the MS with a Routeing Area Update Accept (P-TMSI, P-TMSI signature, IMS voice over PS Session Supported Indication, Emergency Service Support) message.

question_241.question: Which entities are affected by the new solution for NTN coverage analysis?
question_241.ground_truth: The NWDAF, AMF, and UE are affected by the new solution for NTN coverage analysis.

question_242.question: What action has no impact on the control procedures and the operation of the service?

question_243.question: How are CCNR requests and CCBS requests from different users handled if they are directed towards the same terminating party?
question_243.ground_truth: CCNR requests and CCBS requests from different users are queued in the same queue.

question_244.question: In what mode and state does an SMC entity enter after completion of the NAS signalling connection establishment and receiving confirmation from the lower layer?
question_244.ground_truth: After completion of the NAS signalling connection establishment, the SMC entity forwards the CP-DATA message to the lower layer, sets the timer TC1* and enters the Wait for CP-ACK state.

question_245.question: In 7.25.1.3, RAN4 was advised to consider specific holding frequency bands for which two types of analysis involving Band 21?

question_248.question: What should the Mobile Station do when the network rejects a routing area updating procedure with the cause 'location area not allowed'?
question_248.ground_truth: The Mobile Station should not perform GPRS attach when in the same location area, delete the stored RAI, GPRS-CKSN, P-TMSI and P-TMSI signature, and store the LA in the 'forbidden location areas for regional provision of service'.

question_254.question: What should a receiving node do when it receives an initiating message that does not have a message to report unsuccessful outcome and contains one or more IEs/IE groups marked as "Reject IE" that it does not comprehend?
question_254.ground_truth: The receiving node should initiate the Error Indication procedure to report that one or more IEs/IE groups have been rejected.

question_256.question: What is the purpose of the silence descriptor (SID) frame in GSM mobile communications?
question_256.ground_truth: The SID frame conveys information on the acoustic background noise and initiates the comfort noise generation on the receive side.

question_257.question: What is the advantage of adding new SDP attributes over solution D in terms of SDP processing load?
question_257.ground_truth: The new attribute appears only one time for each media line (and not potentially multiple times in the SDP offer) in the SDP answer, making the SDP processing load smaller compared to solution D.

question_258.question: What is the test procedure in test 34.2.8?
question_258.ground_truth: The test procedure involves delivering a short message, displaying the message, submitting the reply message, and repeating the process with different message contents and recipient addresses.

question_259.question: What should be contained in the POST request in the Release service operation if an UL CL/BP was inserted in the data path of the PDU session and traffic usage measurements need to be reported to the SMF?
question_259.ground_truth: The POST request should contain N4 information related with traffic usage reporting (i.e. PFCP Session Report Request), and the DNAI related to the N4 information if the latter relates to a local PSA.

question_261.question: How does Solution #15 obtain the location of the MBSR?
question_261.ground_truth: Solution #15 proposes several options to avoid sending privacy check signaling towards MBSR nodes, and to optimize network operations. One of the options is to request the location and velocity of the MBSR by using a modified NRPPa procedure.

question_263.question: What is the purpose of the "ManifestUri" parameter in the e Media Streaming Services?
question_263.ground_truth: The "ManifestUri" parameter provides an HTTP URL where the Manifest for the Media Streaming Application Service is hosted and available for Media Clients access.

question_265.question: What are the steps involved in the general procedure for uplink data transfer?
question_265.ground_truth: A mobile station in idle mode wishing to transfer data on the uplink follows a general procedure that involves synchronizing with the network, sending a channel request, monitoring the PDCCH for a response from the network, and transmitting data blocks on the assigned resources once a response is received.

question_266.question: What does the "carrier" parameter in the ConnectArgExtension sequence represent?
question_266.ground_truth: The "carrier" parameter in the ConnectArgExtension sequence represents the carrier used for the call.

question_268.question: What status code would the NEF send to indicate that a TMGI allocation request has failed?
question_268.ground_truth: The NEF would respond with an HTTP "400 Bad Request" status code if the TMGI allocation request has failed.

question_269.question: What is the definition of the sum MgroupA,i,j?
question_269.ground_truth: MgroupA,i,j is the sum of the number of FR1 intra-frequency measurement objects Mintra-FR1,i,j and the number of FR2 intra-frequency measurement objects Mintra-FR2,i,j, including both SSB and CSI-RS based, which are candidates to be measured in gap j where the measurement object i is also a candidate.

question_270.question: What is the first step in transitioning from a controlling MCPTT function mode to a non-controlling MCPTT function mode?
question_270.ground_truth: The first step is for the controlling MCPTT function to prepare for acting as a non-controlling MCPTT function. The floor control server generates a random temporary identifier for each MCPTT client and stores associations, capabilities, and initiates the 'floor participant interface state transition' state machine.

question_272.question: Which document provides a system-wide view of the operation of DRX in the GSM system?
question_272.ground_truth: The present document, 3GPP Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network; Discontinuous Reception (DRX) in the GSM system (Release 17), provides a system-wide view of the operation of DRX in the GSM system.

question_273.question: What does "Reject paging request from the network" do in the defined values for the +CREJPAG command?
question_273.ground_truth: It indicates that the paging request from the network is set to be rejected.

question_274.question: What is the role of the SMF in providing updated ATSSS rules to the V-SMF?
question_274.ground_truth: The SMF (SMF-4G) provides updated ATSSS rules to the V-SMF (SMF-5G) as part of the N1 SM container in the PDU Session Modification Command, when the H-SMF has provided these rules.

question_275.question: Which PDU types are contained in the RP-ERROR PDU?
question_275.ground_truth: SMS-DELIVER-REPORT and SMS-SUBMIT-REPORT can be carried as a RP-User-Data element within an RP-ERROR PDU.

question_276.question: What is the fading characteristic of the wanted and the interfering signal in the FACCH/H co-channel rejection test?
question_276.ground_truth: The fading characteristic of the wanted and the interfering signal is TUlow in the FACCH/H co-channel rejection test.

question_277.question: Which optional feature is supported over S2a and S2b interfaces via GTPv2 control plane protocol for overload control in the context of eHRPD and TWAN or ePDG?
question_277.ground_truth: GTP-C Overload Control feature is the optional feature that is supported over S2a and S2b interfaces via GTPv2 control plane protocol for overload control in the context of eHRPD and TWAN or ePDG.

question_278.question: What is the cause for the "No radio resource available" mapping in RANAP Relocation Failure to BSSMAP Handover Failure?
question_278.ground_truth: This mapping indicates that there is no radio resource available for the handover.

question_280.question: What is the role of the HTTP proxy in a MCPTT network?
question_280.ground_truth: The HTTP proxy acts as a proxy for hypertext transactions between the HTTP client and one or more HTTP servers. It terminates a TLS session on HTTP-1 with the HTTP client of the MCPTT UE and allows the HTTP client to establish a single TLS session for hypertext transactions with multiple HTTP servers that are reachable by the HTTP proxy.

question_281.question: Under what conditions are serving cell symbols restricted during SS-RSRQ measurement on an FR2 inter-frequency cell with NCSG?
question_281.ground_truth: Serving cell symbols are restricted when they overlap with SSB symbols to be measured, RSSI measurement symbols, or the SMTC window for MOs.

question_282.question: What concepts were introduced by GSMA OPG (Operator Platform Group) in the 5G architecture?
question_282.ground_truth: GSMA OPG introduced the concept of Federation of Operator Platforms which allows Application Providers to reach a wider geographical area and user base.

question_283.question: In what circumstances does the AMF send Enhanced Coverage Restricted information to the UE in the Registration Accept message?
question_283.ground_truth: The AMF sends Enhanced Coverage Restricted information to the UE in the Registration Accept message if the UE included support for restriction of use of Enhanced Coverage in step~1.

question_284.question: How many new multislot classes need to be supported by the chipset and the software?
question_284.ground_truth: New multislot classes numbering up to 12 need to be supported by the chipset and the software.

question_287.question: What happens when the AMF receives a registration request with a "Non-3GPP path switch" indication?
question_287.ground_truth: The AMF initiates the establishment of user-plane resources for the MA PDU Session over the new non-3GPP access path, and updates its registration with the UDM for non-3GPP access while initiating deregistration over the old non-3GPP access.

question_289.question: How can the target UE be addressed in LCS?
question_289.ground_truth: The target UE can be addressed using MSISDN, SIP-URI, IP address, or a pseudonym based on IMSI or MSISDN.

question_290.question: What is the mean and 5% UL Average-UPT gain for operator 2 (SBFD operator) when using SBFD Alt 2 and large packet size at low load level?
question_290.ground_truth: The mean and 5% UL Average-UPT gain for operator 2 (SBFD operator) when using SBFD Alt 2 and large packet size at low load level are 6.76% and 24.88%, respectively.

question_291.question: What should be reused as the base station output power requirements for NB-IoT in both in-band and guard band operation?
question_291.ground_truth: The base station output power requirements for LTE should be reused as the base station output power requirements for NB-IoT in both in-band and guard band operation.

question_292.question: What are the data transmitted for coding rate 1/2?
question_292.ground_truth: For coding rate 1/2, d0(k) and d1(k) for any k are transmitted; d2(k) for any k are not transmitted.

question_293.question: What is the purpose of the iE-Extensions field in the GERAN-Iumode-RAB-Failed-RABAssgntResponse-Item?
question_293.ground_truth: The iE-Extensions field is used to include additional information as a ProtocolExtensionContainer in the form of GERAN-Iumode-RAB-Failed-RABAssgntResponse-Item-ExtIEs.

question_294.question: What is the key benefit of Solution 2 in dealing with MME partial failure without sending Delete PDN Connection Set Request to PGW?
question_294.ground_truth: Solution 2 has a significant advantage that it enables the MME to restore EPS service after a partial failure by allowing the UE to reattach to the EPS.

question_295.question: Which RRC message is received at the UE to indicate a successful outgoing inter-RAT handover in the context of circuit switched traffic?
question_295.ground_truth: Transmission of a RRC-message HANDOVER FROM UTRAN COMMAND indicating a successful outgoing inter-RAT handover.

question_296.question: What is an approach to determining the presence of victim UEs in the vicinity of a HeNB based on reported UE measurements?
question_296.ground_truth: The macro or HeNB could share the information of reported UE measurements in a standardized or non-standardized interface to determine if there are victim UEs in the vicinity of a HeNB.

question_297.question: In the "shall replace the list of the MCVideo group information entries stored in the served MCVideo client information entry with the candidate list of the MCVideo group information entries" step, what is the purpose of this action?
question_297.ground_truth: The purpose of this step is to update the list of MCVideo group information entries stored in the served MCVideo client information entry with the new set of candidate MCVideo group information entries received.

question_298.question: What should a UE do if the barred cell meets the same frequency and reselection criteria?
question_298.ground_truth: The UE should exclude the barred cell as a candidate for cell selection/reselection for 300 seconds.

question_299.question: In which broadcast channels, in a potential Rel-18 UE with BW1 complexity reduction option, is a coverage degradation observed compared to the Rel-17 RedCap UE, and what is the maximum degradation observed in the Urban scenario (30 kHz SCS) and Rural scenario (15 kHz SCS)?
question_299.ground_truth: SIB1, PDCCH CSS (48 RBs), and PBCH. The maximum degradation observed is 11.24 dB for SIB1 in Urban scenario (30 kHz SCS) and 6.8 dB for PBCH in Urban scenario at 2.6GHz.

question_300.question: What is the purpose of the UICC platform in the context of the 5G system?
question_300.ground_truth: The UICC platform, defined by ETSI SCP in TS 102 221, has been adopted by 3GPP to host the 3GPP applications, including the USIM and the ISIM, for many years. It remains a valid and appropriate solution to host 3GPP applications in a UE capable of registering on a 5G system.

question_302.question: What conditions are necessary for PDCP entity re-establishment during handover?
question_302.ground_truth: PDCP entity re-establishment during handover is supported for DRBs using RLC AM mode with a security key change, for DRBs using RLC AM mode with a data recovery procedure without a key change, for DRBs using RLC UM mode with a security key change, and for SRBs with a security key change or remaining as it is without a key change.

question_303.question: What are the prerequisites for the solution where originating IMS network invokes the signing on behalf of 3rd party?
question_303.ground_truth: The two prerequisites for this solution are that the 3rd Party specific user identities and corresponding rich call data are associated with the corresponding IMS identities in a Database, and that the originating IMS network has a secure channel to the Database with Rich Call Data information.

question_305.question: What are the rules to prevent routing issues and complexity when performing group regrouping signalling using temporary groups on the MC system?
question_305.ground_truth: The IWF must prevent the regroup signalling from propagating to the LMR system, handle the translation between temporary group identities on the MC system and the original interworking group identity used on the LMR system, and ensure that regrouping can only take place within a system under specific conditions.

question_306.question: What are the two items returned by the MME to the eNB during the initial access, to establish a UE-specific cookie and a KeNB?
question_306.ground_truth: A UE-specific cookie, uniquely associated with the permanent UE Identity, and KeNB, used to recognize the potential duplicate cached context for the same UE.

question_307.question: In the scenario with FR2, Dense Urban, DL, single stream traffic model, 30Mbps, 60FPS, 400MHz bandwidth, PDB increase from 10ms to 15ms, what is the increase in mean capacity performance for a mean capacity performance of 34 UEs per cell to 36 UEs per cell?
question_307.ground_truth: The mean capacity performance is increased by about 5.9%.

question_308.question: How does the Load Prediction (LP) and Generation Prediction (GP) service help Distribution System Operators (DSOs)?
question_308.ground_truth: The Load Prediction and Generation Prediction service helps Distribution System Operators (DSOs) in various ways. It forecasts the future values of power consumption and injection to give DSOs awareness of how grid operating conditions are expected to evolve. This enables DSOs to predict possible contingencies, apply preventive control schemes, and make informed decisions regarding planning and grid management.

question_309.question: In which logical channel is the RRC CONNECTION REQUEST sent when using clause 6.11.6.4.7.1.4?
question_309.ground_truth: The RRC CONNECTION REQUEST is sent using the TM-RLC SAP on the CCCH logical channel when using clause 6.11.6.4.7.1.4.

question_310.question: What are the major components involved in Multicast Distribution Setup procedure?
question_310.ground_truth: The major components involved in Multicast Distribution Setup procedure are MulticastDistributionSetupRequest, MulticastDistributionSetupResponse, and MulticastF1UContextDescriptor. The first two are used to initialize the setup process and the third one contains the necessary data to set up the multicast distribution.

question_313.question: How does the MNO decide which broadcast group to form for content delivery?
question_313.ground_truth: The MNO forms broadcast groups based on the number of UEs accessing the same content, location information, content information, and association information among end-users, device information, and media content information.

question_314.question: What is the difference between a root CA and a sub-CA in the context of network slicing?
