question_1314.ground_truth: A UE does not expect to monitor PDCCH when the UE performs RRM measurements over a bandwidth that is not within the active DL BWP for the UE.

question_1315.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe direct discovery service authorization from the ProSe Function of the HPLMN?
question_1315.ground_truth: The ProSe direct discovery service authorization from the ProSe Function of the HPLMN includes parameters related to ProSe UE-to-network relaying, group member discovery, and ProSe direct communication service authorization.

question_1316.question: What is the maximum allowed Tmargin for inter-frequency handover for a cell being identified or measured?
question_1316.ground_truth: The maximum allowed Tmargin for inter-frequency handover for a cell being identified or measured is 2 ms.

question_1318.question: How is a Class 2 EP considered in F1AP?
question_1318.ground_truth: A Class 2 EP is always considered successful in F1AP.

question_1320.question: What is the technique to mitigate the effect of the residual differential delay in NTN for PRACH procedure when the NTN differential delay is less than or equal to the Max currently specified NR PRACH CP duration?
question_1320.ground_truth: No change is required to the specified NR RACH procedure.

question_1322.question: What action does the SMF take if two UEs are served by the same DNAI via GEO UPF?
question_1322.ground_truth: The SMF determines the traffic steering rules for the two UEs based on the target IP, and enables satellite edge computing or local data switching via on-board UPF acting as UL CL/BP and local PSA.

question_1323.question: In the context of TS 38.331, clause 5.7.10.3, when rlf-ReportReq is set to true and the UE has radio link failure or handover failure information available in VarRLF-Report, what should be set as the rlf-Report in the UEInformationResponse message?
question_1323.ground_truth: The value of rlf-Report in VarRLF-Report.

question_1324.question: What message is sent by BSS-A to MSC-A to initiate the handover procedure?

question_1325.question: What is the keying model used in GBA Push?
question_1325.ground_truth: The Disposable-Ks model is the keying model used in GBA Push. In this model, a Ks is only used once to derive a single set of NAF-keys and other keying material, after which the Ks is erased or its further use is denied.

question_1327.question: What is the role of the Source UPF in the initial establishment of an Ethernet PDU Session?
question_1327.ground_truth: The Source UPF acts as the PSA (PDU Session Anchor) and maintains Ethernet context, which includes MAC address and VLAN tag learned from the UE side.

question_1328.question: What should a UE do upon receiving 5GMM cause #79 over 3GPP access in single registration mode?
question_1328.ground_truth: The UE shall abort the initial registration procedure, set the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED, enter state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION or 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH, reset the registration attempt counter, and not include the service-level device ID set to the CAA-level UAV ID in the Service-level-AA container IE of REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

question_1329.question: In the context of Network Slice as a Service (NSaaS) model, what is the KI addressing in terms of security features for NSaaS?
question_1329.ground_truth: The KI is addressing which security features can be offered as a service to be exposed and managed, and how to expose and manage the security features and specify the related network functions for NSaaS.

question_1331.question: What is the role of the SCEF in obtaining location information of a group of UEs via PCRF?
question_1331.ground_truth: The SCEF can request the location information of a group of UEs via PCRF, and the PCRF reports it to the SCEF for applicable IP-CAN types and RAT types.

question_1332.question: What are the TLS protection protocol used in Service Based Interfaces (SBI)?
question_1332.ground_truth: The TLS protection protocol used in Service Based Interfaces (SBI) is mutually authenticated TLS and HTTPS. NFs shall support both server-side and client-side certificates with TLS client and server certificates compliant with the SBA certificate profile specified in clause 6.1.3c of TS 33.310. The TLS profile follows the profile given in clause 6.2 of TS 33.210 with the restriction that it shall be compliant with the profile given by HTTP/2 as defined in RFC 9113. TLS shall be used for transport protection within a PLMN unless network security is provided by other means.

question_1333.question: What is a requirement for enabling local break-out for DNNs in the home PLMN of a partner MC system for MC service provisioning for migrating MC service users?
question_1333.ground_truth: The home PLMN of the partner MC system needs to enable local break-out for DNNs that identify the DNs of the partner MC system for MC service provisioning for migrating MC service users.

question_1334.question: What is the minimum requirement for single RAT E-UTRA operation?
question_1334.ground_truth: There is no spectrum emission mask requirement for a single RAT E-UTRA AAS BS.

question_1337.question: What is the role of the floor control interface towards the MCPTT client in the controlling MCPTT function?
question_1337.ground_truth: The floor control interface towards the MCPTT client in the controlling MCPTT function is responsible for receiving and transmitting floor control messages from and to the MCPTT client via the participating MCPTT function or non-controlling MCPTT function.

question_1338.question: What is the minimum length of the "PEIPS assistance information" information element?
question_1338.ground_truth: The PEIPS assistance information information element has a minimum length of 3 octets.

question_1339.question: What is the process of spreading for the 3.84 Mcps MBSFN IMB option?
question_1339.ground_truth: The spreading operation includes a modulation mapper stage, a channelisation stage, an IQ combining stage, and a scrambling stage. For all physical channels, the I and Q branches are spread to the chip rate by the same real-valued channelisation code. The sequence of complex-valued chips output from the spreading stage is then scrambled (complex chip-wise multiplication) by a complex-valued scrambling code.

question_1340.question: What is the purpose of assigning a new 'eNB-UE-Id' to the UE at each RRC connection release?
question_1340.ground_truth: The purpose of assigning a new 'eNB-UE-Id' to the UE at each RRC connection release is to ensure proper identification and tracking of the user equipment (UE) at the eNB node.

question_1341.question: What is the procedure when the UE is not registered in IMS and the delivery of the Instant Message will not be allowed?
question_1341.ground_truth: In this case, either the message is sent over CS/PS, or an error indication is sent back to the SM-SC. In that case, when the IM user registers at a later time, this information is sent to the SM-SC and the delivery is attempted at that time.

question_1343.question: What is the purpose of the "modes of use" of the terms "shall" and "shall not" in the document?
question_1343.ground_truth: The purpose of the "modes of use" of the terms "shall" and "shall not" is to indicate a mandatory requirement or prohibition in the normative provisions of the document.

question_1344.question: In which CSS set and when is the UE expected to receive the PDSCH that corresponds to the PDCCH that UE monitors for RMSI scheduling for multiplexing patterns 2?
question_1344.ground_truth: The UE is expected to receive PDSCH that corresponds to the PDCCH that UE monitors in the Type0-PDCCH CSS set, on SSB symbols to be measured for RLM, for the SSB for RLM and CORESET for RMSI scheduling multiplexing patterns 2.

question_1345.question: Which country is the reference location request for with AdditionalGPSAssistDataRequired?
question_1345.ground_truth: It depends on the context of the application. The reference location request could be for any country, depending on the location of the device or user requesting assistance.

question_1346.question: What steps should the H-SMF take when releasing resources in 3GPP access during the PDU Session Establishment procedure from 3GPP to untrusted non-3GPP access?
question_1346.ground_truth: The H-SMF should perform steps 3b, 4, 6, and 7a as specified in clause 4.3.4.2 to release the resources over the source 3GPP access, but not execute step 11 and send the N1 SM container.

question_1347.question: What is the purpose of Step 4 in the remotely initiated MCPTT call request procedure?
question_1347.ground_truth: Step 4 in the remotely initiated MCPTT call request procedure is where the MCPTT server sends the corresponding remotely initiated MCPTT call request towards the MCPTT client 2 after checking the authorization of the MCPTT user at MCPTT client 1.

question_1349.question: How many External Identifiers can be associated with one IMSI?
question_1349.ground_truth: One IMSI can have one or several External Identifiers, with at least one designated as the default External Identifier and one or more additional External Identifiers.

question_1350.question: What is the purpose of the "CRITICALITY" field in the "protocolIE" sequence of the mentioned messages?
question_1350.ground_truth: The "CRITICALITY" field in the "protocolIE" sequence indicates the criticality of the information contained in the message. It can have one of three values: "ignore", "ignore" with a "protocol level criticality" of "negociated", or "reject". The "ignore" value indicates that the information is not critical, but is included for additional information or future use. The "ignore" value with a "protocol level criticality" of "negociated" indicates that the information is not critical, but is included for additional information and that the receiver should treat it as critical if prescribed in the negotiated protocol. The "reject" value indicates that the absence or occurrence of the information is critical, and if this is not satisfied, the receiver should reject the message.

question_1351.question: What media is reused after Access Transfer in PS to CS direction within 3GPP access networks?
question_1351.ground_truth: The media established upon the transfer of the currently active session is reused for the held session.

question_1352.question: What should be done by the floor participant upon receiving a Floor Deny message and the <User ID> value in the User ID field matches its own MCPTT ID and there is no stored SSRC of the current arbitrator?
question_1352.ground_truth: The floor participant shall stop the timer T201 (Floor Request), set the stored SSRC of the current arbitrator to the SSRC of the floor control server as received in the Floor Deny message, restart the timer T203 (End of RTP media), provide floor deny notification to the user, may display the floor deny reason to the user using information in the Reject Cause field, and enter 'O: has no permission' state.

question_1353.question: What is the measurement type that provides the number of attempted relocation resource allocations with UE involved for PS domain?

question_1354.question: How does the network resource allocation between legacy TTI and shorter TTI affect legacy UEs' throughput?
question_1354.ground_truth: Reserving more PRBs for shorter TTI would lead to less resource for legacy TTI, which would bring bad impact on the throughput on legacy UEs.

question_1355.question: Which function is responsible for the control of connection element set-up and release in the E-UTRAN?

question_1356.question: What should the data link layer entity do if it has not received the correct response after N200 attempts to recover and timer T200 has expired?
question_1356.ground_truth: The data link layer entity should enter the idle state and inform the layer~3 entity using the primitive DL-RELEASE-CONFIRM and MDL-ERROR-IND with cause "Timer T200 expired (N200+1) times: perform abnormal release".

question_1357.question: What is the purpose of the CONF service?
question_1357.ground_truth: The CONF service enables a user to participate in and control a simultaneous communication involving multiple users. It allows users to join, leave and remotely add or remove other users from a conference.

question_1358.question: What should the floor control server interface do when receiving a Floor Deny message sent from the controlling MCPTT function?
question_1358.ground_truth: It should forward the Floor Deny message to the identified floor participant interface and remove the floor request from the passive floor request queue if needed.

question_1360.question: What HTTP status code is returned if the EES authorizes the delete request?
question_1360.ground_truth: The EES responds with an HTTP "204 No Content" status code upon success.

question_1362.question: Which network entities store data related to MSP in 3GPP network?
question_1362.ground_truth: In a 3GPP network, the HLR (Home Location Register) and the VLR (Visitor Location Register) are the network entities that store data related to MSP.

question_1363.question: What is the role of the TDF in the procedures described in 6.3?
question_1363.ground_truth: The TDF is responsible for provisioning QoS Rules for the IP-CAN session for the UE local address and performing policy control in the BBF domain based on these QoS Rules. The TDF translates the QoS rules as received on the S9a interface into access-specific QoS parameters applicable in the BBF domain.

question_1364.question: How should server-initiated communication be described in OpenAPI specification files?
question_1364.ground_truth: Server-initiated communication, such as notifications, should be described as "callbacks" in OpenAPI specification files.

question_1365.question: What does the Home enhanced Node B Subsystem (HeNS) Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP) cover in terms of requirements and information service?
question_1365.ground_truth: The Home enhanced Node B Subsystem (HeNS) Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP) covers the requirements in 3GPP TS 32.781 and the information service in 3GPP TS 32.782.

question_1366.question: In case spatial HARQ-ACK bundling is not applied, what does K represent in the number of transport blocks received or the SPS release PDCCH/EPDCCH received in subframe(s) in serving cell, where K is the number of elements in set M?
question_1366.ground_truth: K represents the number of transport blocks or SPS release PDCCH/EPDCCH received in subframe(s) in serving cell.

question_1368.question: In what circumstances can a UE initiate the MBS Interest Indication procedure?
question_1368.ground_truth: A UE can initiate the MBS Interest Indication procedure in several cases, including upon successful connection establishment/resume, entering or leaving the broadcast service area, MBS broadcast session start or stop, change of interest or priority, changing to a PCell providing SIB21 or nonServingCellMII in SIB1, receiving SIB20 of an SCell via dedicated signalling, handover, RRC connection re-establishment, changing to a PCell providing nonServingCellMII in SIB1, starting or stopping reception of MBS broadcast service on a non-serving cell, and change of CFR information or subcarrier spacing for MBS broadcast reception on a non-serving cell.

question_1369.question: What should the P-CSCF do when it detects that signalling bearer is no longer available?
question_1369.ground_truth: If the P-CSCF receives an indication that the signalling bearer is no longer available, it shall send out a CANCEL request to cancel the dialog and include a Reason header field containing a 503 (Service Unavailable) status code.

question_1370.question: Which events are applicable when an IoT UE attaches for NIDD using SCEF in a CSP network?
question_1370.ground_truth: The events applicable when an IoT UE attaches for NIDD using SCEF in a CSP network are IoT UE Attach for NIDD using SCEF, MME originated connection request, and SGSN originated connection request.

question_1372.question: What does each message indicating a failed external parameter deletion increments in the relevant subcounter per failure cause by 1 in the NEF?
question_1372.ground_truth: The subcounter per failure cause of the number of failed external parameter deletions in the NEF.

question_1373.question: What action will the P-CSCF take if the SDP offer contains a "RTP/AVPF" transport offering a "UDP/TLS/RTP/SAVP" or "UDP/TLS/RTP/SAVPF" transport protocol?
question_1373.ground_truth: If the SDP offer contains an end-to-end security mechanism for RTP media using DTLS-SRTP and certificate fingerprints, the P-CSCF will invoke IMS-ALG procedures, act as defined in the specification, and handle SDP and RTP accordingly.

question_1374.question: What is the purpose of the "gapTreatment" parameter in the CallGap procedure?
question_1374.ground_truth: The "gapTreatment" parameter specifies how calls that were stopped by the call gapping mechanism shall be treated, such as sending an announcement, repeating a message, or releasing the call with a specific cause value.

question_1375.question: What action does a UE take when its signalling connections to all other UEs have been released or broken?
question_1375.ground_truth: The UE enters the DCM-IDLE state from the DCM-CONNECTED state.

question_1376.question: What is the format of the ggsn parameter and dslcid parameter?
question_1376.ground_truth: The ggsn parameter and dslcid parameter are transferred from the GGSN and the BRAS respectively, to the P-CSCF via the Rx and Gx interfaces. They are transferred in binary format, and on receipt of this header field, a node receiving a ggsn or dslcid shall decode from hexadecimal into binary format.

question_1377.question: What is the goal of a spoofing attack in the context of GNSS?
question_1377.ground_truth: The goal of a spoofing attack is for the attacker to threaten the integrity and confidentiality of a GNSS transmission by broadcasting false signals, making the receiver misinterpret them as authentic, and compute a false position and time.

question_1378.question: What is the procedure used in LTE Rel-15 to establish a UE context at the secondary eNB (SeNB) to provide radio resources from the SeNB to the UE, as part of DC mobility scenario?

question_1379.question: What is Key issue #1 related to the location of PCEF functionality in non-roaming cases with non-3GPP accesses?
question_1379.ground_truth: Key issue #1 related to the location of PCEF functionality in non-roaming cases with non-3GPP accesses is that the PCEF functionality encompasses service data flow detection, policy enforcement, and flow-based charging functionalities. It is logical to have the PCEF functionality within the P-GW, which terminates the SGi interface towards the PDN. Therefore, in the EPC architecture for non-roaming cases with non-3GPP accesses, the PCEF functionality shall reside in the P-GW.

question_1381.question: How is the XML content protected in the MCPTT environment?
question_1381.ground_truth: The XML content in the MCPTT environment is protected using optional confidentiality protection and integrity protection mechanisms defined in 3GPP TS 33.210 using XML encryption and XML signatures, respectively.

question_1382.question: What is the condition for success in Test 1 and Test 3 for UE supporting other power class?
question_1382.ground_truth: The overall delay measured from the beginning of time period T2 should be less than 7682 ms.

question_1384.question: What is the DL reference channel for the minimum information throughput requirements of 4C-HSDPA with 16QAM and HS-DSCH categories 31 or 32 in section 6.3G?
question_1384.ground_truth: The DL reference channel for the minimum information throughput requirements of 4C-HSDPA with 16QAM and HS-DSCH categories 31 or 32 in section 6.3G is H-Set 1C.

question_1386.question: What are the examples of retransmission schemes used in 3GPP network?
question_1386.ground_truth: Some examples of retransmission schemes used in 3GPP network are CoAP/UDP/IP, which repeats each transmitted packet a maximum of 4 times, MQTT-SN/UDP/IP, which repeats each transmitted packet a maximum of 2-3 times, and TCP, which repeats the initial SYN packet 3 times.

question_1387.question: What is the purpose of the "SV Global Health" information that may accompany the almanac information?
question_1387.ground_truth: The purpose of "SV Global Health" information is to provide additional information about the current status and health of each satellite in the GPS constellation.

question_1388.question: What mechanisms have been studied for efficient discovery of small cells in small cell deployment scenarios?
question_1388.ground_truth: Some mechanisms that have been studied for efficient discovery of small cells in small cell deployment scenarios include the performance evaluation of the legacy cell search mechanism, evaluating PSS/SSS interference canceller-based cell discovery mechanisms, investigating new cell discovery mechanisms based on existing RS, and investigating new cell discovery mechanisms based on modified SS/RS or new discovery signals. Other mechanisms include evaluating opportunistic activation and deactivation of small cells based on UL signals and increasing the maximum number of measurement carriers without significant increase of UE power consumption and/or measurement delay.

question_1389.question: What does the MCData group standalone data request contain in its response to the target recipients?
question_1389.ground_truth: The MCData group standalone data request contains conversation identifier for message thread indication and may include additional implementation-specific information in the application metadata container.

question_1390.question: What is required to protect management and control systems (MnS) and corresponding managed resources from unauthorized access in the 3GPP management system?
question_1390.ground_truth: Access control, including identification, authentication, authorization and auditing, is required to protect MnSs and corresponding managed resources from unauthorized reading and writing.

question_1391.question: What function allows the CN to operate the mode in which the UTRAN reports the location of the UE?

question_1392.question: What message is sent from the floor participant to the floor control server to control reception of unicast media flow of the designated communication?
question_1392.ground_truth: The Unicast Media Flow Control message

question_1393.question: How does the MRFP select which video streams to send to a conference participant?
question_1393.ground_truth: The MRFP selects the video streams to be sent to a conference participant from among the videos received from the other conference participants in such a way that from each other conference participant at most one main video is sent to this conference participant, and at most one screenshare video stream is sent to this conference participant.

question_1395.question: What is the name of the measurement that provides the mean number of QoS flows of UPF, and is expressed as a single integer value?
question_1395.ground_truth: This measurement is called "Mean number of QoS flows".

question_1396.question: What is one security requirement for mitigating the risk of container breakout?
question_1396.ground_truth: The virtualization platform should provide capabilities to limit the impact on co-hosted containers caused by a rogue container escaping its isolation.

question_1401.question: What HTTP method is used for Data Change Notifications in the described mechanism?
question_1401.ground_truth: The POST method is used for Data Change Notifications.

question_1403.question: What is the accuracy requirement for the BS output power in Range 1 for NR?
question_1403.ground_truth: The same output power accuracy values as in existing specifications (TS 36.104 and TS 37.105) can be used in NR for Range 1, which are +/- 2.0dB for conducted and +/- 2.2 dB for over-the-air (OTA).

question_1406.question: What is the use of an alternative S-NSSAI in Solution #5?
question_1406.ground_truth: An alternative S-NSSAI is used in Solution #5 as another S-NSSAI from the network slice selection criteria within the URSP rules in the UE, which is included by the UE in the PDU Session Establishment Request and is stored in the UE context within the AMF for PDU Session handover to this alternative S-NSSAI if the current S-NSSAI is not supported or overloaded in the target CN.

question_1409.question: When does the NG-RAN prefer to use specific radio resources for data radio bearer(s) in 5G system?
question_1409.ground_truth: The NG-RAN may prefer to use specific radio resources per data radio bearer(s), e.g. depending on the Network Slices associated to the data radio bearer used by the UE, when UP resources are activated for the UE in the network.

question_1410.question: What does the MS send when it chooses to send a SREJ frame with N(R)=Nss+1 in the test?
question_1410.ground_truth: The MS sends a SREJ frame containing N(R)=Nss+1

question_1411.question: What is the recommended UE transmission power limit for the LTE 450 band to meet the target emission limit for UE emissions while preserving the required isolation from the TV broadcast tower?
question_1411.ground_truth: The recommended UE transmission power limit for the LTE 450 band is -18 dBm/6 MHz, scaled from the -36 dBm/100 kHz limit in accordance with the ITU-R recommendation for a 5 MHz channel bandwidth. The UE duplexing filter must provide at least 12 dB rejection at this offset to comply with the target emission limit of -30 dBm/6 MHz.

question_1412.question: Which ITU-T draft Recommendation studies influencing factors on quality of experience (QoE) for virtual reality services?
question_1412.ground_truth: Draft ITU-T G.QoE-VR provides a study on influencing factors on quality of experience (QoE) for virtual reality services.

question_1413.question: What is the advantage of using radio-interface based synchronization mechanisms for small cells?
question_1413.ground_truth: A radio-interface based synchronization mechanism can be beneficial for small cell deployments where GNSS or backhaul network synchronization are unavailable, especially for indoor deployments and hotspots with high buildings around.

question_1414.question: What is required for the inclusion of the "GANSS TOD msec" information element in a measurement report?
question_1414.ground_truth: The "GANSS TOD msec" information element should be included in a measurement report if the UE supports the capability to provide the GANSS timing of the cell frames measurement and the IE "GANSS timing of Cell wanted" is not included or set to zero, and any of the GANSS signals are measured.

question_1416.question: What is the purpose of Home Link Detection in DSMIPv6?
question_1416.ground_truth: The UE needs to perform Home Link Detection before it initiates registration with the HA, in order to detect if it is attached to the home link from a DSMIPv6 perspective.

question_1417.question: What is the time duration for checking the BSIC value on carrier 2?

question_1418.question: What information is provided by UPF for the MP-DCCP-LL functionality?
question_1418.ground_truth: UPF provides two "UE link-specific MP-DCCP-LL" IP addresses, "MP-DCCP Address Information" which contains the "UPF link-specific MP-DCCP-LL" IP address for the UPF, and one UPF port number per MP-DCCP connection.

question_1419.question: What should the SS look for in subframes (m+5), (m+9), and (m+13) and (m+18) up to the end of T2 for intra-band CA UE in step 8a?

question_1420.question: What actions should the UE take if it receives a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST with certain cause values and the de-registration type indicates "re-registration not required"?
question_1420.ground_truth: The UE shall delete the TAI list, last visited registered TAI, list of equivalent PLMNs or SNPNs, set the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED, start timer T3502, and delete 5G-GUTI and ngKSI if it is not registering or has not registered to the same PLMN over both 3GPP access and non-3GPP access.

question_1422.question: What should the ADRF include in the Location HTTP header field when responding with "201 Created" after successfully processing an HTTP POST request?
question_1422.ground_truth: The ADRF should include the URI of the created record in the Location HTTP header field.

question_1424.question: What is the role of padding in HSCSD?
question_1424.ground_truth: Padding refers to the fill bits needed to adapt the maximum possible AIUR supported by a given number of TCH/F with a given channel coding to a FNUR that is lower than the maximum possible AIUR.

question_1426.question: What is the purpose of storing collected data and analytics in the Analytics Data and ML Model Repository (ADRF) as specified in clause 6.2B.1?
question_1426.ground_truth: The data and analytics may be stored in the ADRF for future use or analysis, or they may be deleted when they are no longer needed.

question_1429.question: When is the UE that supports simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology able to perform CSI-RS measurement without restrictions for FR1 in active BWP with different SCS than the CSI-RS for L1-RSRP measurement?
question_1429.ground_truth: The UE is able to perform CSI-RS measurement without restrictions in this case.

question_1432.question: What should the SeNB do if it receives an SENB MODIFICATION REQUEST message containing a E-RAB Level QoS Parameters IE which contains a QCI IE indicating a GBR bearer but does not contain the GBR QoS Information IE?
question_1432.ground_truth: The SeNB should not admit the corresponding E-RAB.

question_1433.question: What action does the SGW take when it receives a Change Notification Request with an unknown IMSI/IMEI?
question_1433.ground_truth: The SGW may silently discard the Change Notification Request message and the MME/SGSN may initiate PDN disconnection for all of these PDN Connections.

question_1434.question: What is the purpose of the EDGE-9 reference point between the Edge Enabler Servers (EES)?
question_1434.ground_truth: The EDGE-9 reference point enables interactions between the EES, supporting discovery of T-EAS information to support Application Context Relocation (ACR), EEC context relocation procedures, and transparent transfer of the application context during Edge Enabler layer Managed ACR.

question_1435.question: What is used to verify the establishment of the TLS session in the corresponding media stream to belong to the served user?
question_1435.ground_truth: The certificate fingerprint is used to verify the establishment of the TLS session in the corresponding media stream to belong to the served user.

question_1436.question: What should the SS answer after receiving a SABM (C=1,P=1) or a DISC (C=1) frame from the MS?
question_1436.ground_truth: The SS should answer with an UA (R=0) frame with F bit set to P bit received in SABM or DISC frame.

question_1437.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for E-UTRAN RSRQ absolute accuracy for 2Rx RedCap UE in section 16.7.6.0.1?
question_1437.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement for E-UTRAN RSRQ absolute accuracy for 2Rx RedCap UE in section 16.7.6.0.1 is given in clause 6.7.6.0.1 of the reference document.

question_1438.question: What requirements must the L1-RSRP reports from the UE meet for the test to pass in terms of successful reported values ratio and confidence level?
question_1438.ground_truth: At least 90% for each requirement (R1 to R4) with a confidence level of 95%.

question_1439.question: What does the V field indicate in the Enhanced Multiple Entry PHR MAC CE?
question_1439.ground_truth: The V field indicates if the PH value is based on a real transmission or a reference format. For Type 1 PH, the V field set to 0 indicates real transmission on PUSCH and the V field set to 1 indicates that a PUSCH reference format is used.

question_1440.question: How can multi-vendor scenarios influence standardized interfaces for 5G network management?
question_1440.ground_truth: In a multi-vendor scenario, higher autonomous network levels may require simpler standardized interfaces (i.e. MnS) to reduce interoperability complexity and improve network operating efficiency and automation performance.

question_1441.question: What is the purpose of the interpolating filter in the fractional pitch search in the AMR-WB codec?
question_1441.ground_truth: The interpolating filter in the fractional pitch search has a low pass frequency response and is used to update the target signal by removing the adaptive codebook contribution.

question_1442.question: What are the parameters that must be met in the shielding effectiveness of the chamber for being able to measure sensitivity for the mobile equipment?
question_1442.ground_truth: The measured level of external signals at the frequency of interest(UMTS frequency band) has to be 10dB below sensitivity level of the mobile equipment.

question_1446.question: What is the need for inter-RAT idle mode mobility in the context of NB-IoT?
question_1446.ground_truth: Inter-RAT idle mode mobility is needed to prevent devices from being forced to detach and re-attach when moving between RATs, which can result in signaling and power consumption costs, and incorrect "current RAT Type information" within the network.

question_1447.question: What should the UE do if it does not receive a random access response after sending the first 4 preambles in Test 2?
question_1447.ground_truth: The UE shall consider the random access response reception not successful then re-select a preamble and transmit with the calculated PRACH transmission power when the backoff time expires if no random access response is received within the RA Response window of 10 sub-frames.

question_1449.question: What should the UE do when it receives the Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming" or "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service" IE in an ATTACH REJECT message?
question_1449.ground_truth: The UE stores the TAI(s) for the current PLMN in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming" or "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service" and ignores the TAI(s) that do not belong to the serving PLMN. If a certain EMM cause value is received in the ATTACH REJECT message, the UE takes additional actions such as setting the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED and deleting certain information.

question_1450.question: What is the purpose of the open loop diversity performance test described in sections 9.2.2A to 9.2.2D?
question_1450.ground_truth: The purpose of the open loop diversity performance test described in sections 9.2.2A to 9.2.2D is to verify the ability of the receiver to receive a predefined test signal, representing a multi-path fading channel with information bit throughput R not falling below a specified value. The test stresses the multi-code reception and channel decoding with incremental redundancy.

question_1451.question: What action should the UE take if a matching criterion is found and the value of Tsor-cm timer in the new SOR-CMCI is smaller than the current value of the running Tsor-cm timer for the associated PDU session or service?
question_1451.ground_truth: The Tsor-cm timer value for the associated PDU session or service shall be replaced with the value in the new SOR-CMCI without stopping and restarting the timer.

question_1452.question: What is the significance of the three digits in the version numbering system used in the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals?
question_1452.ground_truth: The first digit of the version number indicates the stage of development of the specification, with "0" indicating that it is presented to the TSG for information, "1" for approval, and "3" or higher for TSG approved documents under change control. The second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, such as technical enhancements, corrections, and updates. The third digit is incremented when only editorial changes have been made.

question_1453.question: What is the role of the management service discovery (MnS) in an operator's management system?
question_1453.ground_truth: The MnS discovery service enables MnS consumer to discover management capabilities of MnS producer(s), making MnS instances discoverable to the operator's management system when they become operative.

question_1456.question: In the context of case m2), what should the AMF set the Payload container IE to?
question_1456.ground_truth: The AMF should set the Payload container IE to the UPP-CMI container received from the LMF in the context of case m2).

question_1457.question: What is the first protocol data unit specified in the DirectTransferIEs?
question_1457.ground_truth: The first protocol data unit specified in the DirectTransferIEs is id-NAS-PDU, which is a NAS PDU used for transferring signaling messages.

question_1458.question: What is the role of the IMS-ALG (IP Multimedia Subsystem - Access Link Gateway) while interworking SIP messages?
question_1458.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG behaves as a SIP B2BUA (Back-to-Back User Agent) when interworking SIP messages. It modifies SDP based on specific rules and forwards SIP messages transparently with respect to all methods, result codes, headers, and attachments.

question_1459.question: What is the detection level (a) that u and Weinzierl assumed to reach "plausibility" in a simulation, defined as agreement with the listener's expectation towards an equivalent real acoustic event?

question_1460.question: What is the role of the CPCN in charging for a PDN connection and NIDD submissions?
question_1460.ground_truth: The CPCN is responsible for collecting charging information per user per PDN connection and per NIDD submission in both originating and terminating directions for each data network with associated volume counts.

question_1464.question: What is the procedure for creating a new DSCP marking rule in the UE when receiving an IP packet?
question_1464.ground_truth: When receiving an IP packet, the UE creates a new DSCP marking rule by setting the source IP address, destination IP address, source port number, destination port number, protocol type, DSCP marking value and timestamp based on the received IP packet. No matching entry is required to create a new entry.

question_1465.question: What is the role of the AMF during the Registration procedure in terms of non-3GPP access?
question_1465.ground_truth: The AMF updates the UDM registration for non-3GPP access after the user-plane resources over the new non-3GPP access are established and indicates to the SMF that the AMF and the UE support non-3GPP path switch during the MA PDU Session Establishment.

question_1467.question: When is a UE required to send an empty report in logged MDT procedures?
question_1467.ground_truth: A UE is required to send an empty report in logged MDT procedures when retrieval is attempted and the RPLMN is not in the MDT PLMN list.

question_1468.question: What type of geometric description is used to model the arrival and departure angles in the channel generation process?
question_1468.ground_truth: The geometric description covers arrival angles from the last bounce scatterers and respective departure angles to the first scatterers interacted from the transmitting side.

question_1469.question: As per requirement R-5.1.4.2-004 and R-5.1.4.2-005, what functionality does the MCVideo service provide in terms of recording, capturing, and activating multiple video cameras?
question_1469.ground_truth: The MCVideo service can record video content for video processing, capture video content using coordinated multiple video cameras, determine if presented video content was captured with multiple cameras simultaneously, and provide simultaneous activation and control of multiple video cameras.

question_1470.question: What type of activity does the SGSN report to the MSC/VLR when the MS is both IMSI- and GPRS-attached and it does not lead to any procedure towards the MSC/VLR?
question_1470.ground_truth: The SGSN sends an MS Activity Indication (IMSI) message towards the MSC/VLR when the MS is both IMSI- and GPRS-attached and it does not lead to any procedure towards the MSC/VLR.

question_1471.question: What is the overall gain in call throughput for users using the Type 2i and Type 3i receivers, considering all users?
question_1471.ground_truth: The overall gain is 3 % with Type 2i and 6 % with Type 3i.

question_1472.question: What action does the SGSN take if it cannot activate a PDN connection from the determined dedicated CN?
question_1472.ground_truth: The SGSN initiates Detach with "reattach requested", which causes another Attach Request that the RNC routes directly to the determined dedicated CN based on the Null-NRI.

question_1474.question: What is the function of the RRC Transfer procedure in the 3GPP 5G system?
question_1474.ground_truth: The RRC Transfer procedure is used to deliver an RRC message, encapsulated in a PDCP PDU between the MN and the SN, so that it may be forwarded to/from the UE using split SRB.

question_1475.question: What is the test applicability requirement for the E-UTRAN FDD - FDD Intra-band Inter-frequency async DAPS handover test?
question_1475.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE release 16 and forward. Applicability requires support for Inter-frequency async DAPS handover and FGI bits 5, 13 and 25.

question_1477.question: What must both the UE and MME continue to use for communication, until the MME initiates a security mode control procedure?

question_1478.question: What should the MBMS GW do when it receives an MBMS Session Update from the BM-SC during an Sm path failure modifying the MBMS Service Area?
question_1478.ground_truth: The MBMS GW will encode the original MBMS Service Area in the MBMS Session Start Request sent to the alternative MME and subsequently send an MBMS Session Update Request with the modified MBMS Service Area to the new MME controlling the MBMS session.

question_1479.question: What changes are suggested for the dynamic range measurement in the new specification?
question_1479.ground_truth: Similar to the reference sensitivity, the dynamic range can be measured for each component carrier separately, applying the same wanted signal power and SNR operating point as in Rel-8.

question_1480.question: What must the UE do to keep the uplink time alignment during time duration T1?
question_1480.ground_truth: The UE must be provided with a new Timing Advance Command MAC control element at least once every 500ms to restart the Time Alignment Timer.

question_1484.question: What is done with received BSSMAP messages at the non-anchor 3G MSC?
question_1484.ground_truth: The received BSSMAP messages are mapped into the corresponding RANAP messages to be sent to the RNS, and the received RANAP messages are mapped into the corresponding BSSMAP messages to be sent over the E-interface to the anchor MSC.

question_1485.question: What is the name of the data type "EntryType" which contains a sequence of uri-entry, display-name, and anyExt, with the attribute "entry-info" of type "EntryInfoTypeList"?
question_1485.ground_truth: The data type is "EntryType" with an attribute of type "EntryInfoTypeList".

question_1487.question: What happens if the SMF sends an N4 Session Modification Request to UPF (PSA) with different CN Tunnel Info?
question_1487.ground_truth: If the SMF selects a new UPF to act as intermediate UPF for the PDU Session and the different CN Tunnel Info need be used, the SMF sends N4 Session Modification Request message to UPF (PSA).

question_1488.question: What was the decision made in the 3GPP CT4#50 Working Group regarding call leg correlation?
question_1488.ground_truth: The decision made in the 3GPP CT4#50 Working Group was to define and conclude on a single solution within the Technical Report based on Solution 3 defined in Section 9.2.2. Therefore, Solution 1 and Solution 2 in Section 9.7 and Section 9.8 are void.

question_1491.question: What is the role of the MC service server in creating MBS sessions for MC service media transmission?
question_1491.ground_truth: The MC service server is responsible for creating MBS sessions for MC service media transmission by interacting with the 5GC to determine the necessary information related to the requested session, such as MBS session mode and the required QoS profile.

question_1493.question: What step does the S-CSCF take to avoid a loop when it receives an INVITE request with a Route header field from the home network of the calling user?
question_1493.ground_truth: The S-CSCF checks a local policy based on bilateral agreement whether the homeB supports indicating the II-NNI traversal scenario or not, and removes the topmost Route header field with URI identifying itself if the local policy is supported.

question_1494.question: What is the role of the EES (Edge Enabler Server) in policy authorization and update in the 3GPP network?
question_1494.ground_truth: The EES can act as an AF and is a peer of the PCF if they share an N5 interface. It can trigger the Policy Modification procedure if needed, and authorize policy authorization and update for the Edge Application Servers.

question_1495.question: What components in the network perform the SGW restoration procedure in the same PLMN?
question_1495.ground_truth: The MME/S4-SGSN and PGW components in the same PLMN perform the SGW restoration procedure.

question_1496.question: What are the required factors for CHF selection by the NF consumer or in the SCP?
question_1496.ground_truth: The required factors are CHF Group ID of the UE's SUPI or SUPI, or both.

question_1497.question: How does the AS layer determine the mapping of multiple PC5 QoS Flows to the same radio bearer?
question_1497.ground_truth: The AS layer determines the mapping based on the information provided by the destination Layer-2 ID and the PC5 QoS Flows.

question_1499.question: What action does the MS take when it receives an Attach Accept message that includes the IMS voice over PS session supported Indication?
question_1499.ground_truth: The MS activates IMS voice over PS session if the Indication is set.

question_1500.question: What is required for an MCPTT client to join an ongoing MCPTT group call?
question_1500.ground_truth: The MCPTT client sends a group call setup announcement message with the on-going group call ID to initiate the process of joining the ongoing MCPTT group call. Upon receiving the group call setup announcement, the MCPTT client as a participant of the on-going MCPTT group call sends parameters for media transfer to the newly entered MCPTT client to join the call.

question_1501.question: What is the reduction in transaction time for downloading 100 email message headers when the TTI is reduced from 20 ms to 10 ms?
question_1501.ground_truth: The transaction time is reduced from 8 seconds to 6 seconds, a reduction of 25%.

question_1502.question: How does the 5G system enable 'access to local services' for mobile metaverse services?
question_1502.ground_truth: The 5G system enables 'access to local services' for mobile metaverse services by providing spatially defined access to localized services, which have spatially defined access and associated service information available to the mobile network operator. This is used to provide customers with relevant information and services based on their location.

question_1503.question: What are the two ways for a UE-A to indicate resources in coordination information?
question_1503.ground_truth: UE-A can indicate resources preferred to be included in unicast and resources preferred to be excluded in unicast, groupcast, or broadcast.

question_1505.question: What is the MAIO hopping scheme used for VAMOS second sub-channel users in the 3GPP 45.002 sequence generation?
question_1505.ground_truth: The MAIO hopping scheme is applied to all VAMOS second sub-channel users for 20% of the frames, and it activates on the last frame within each five frames.

question_1507.question: How can the MCPTT UE identify the purpose of a key?
question_1507.ground_truth: The 'purpose tag' within the key identifier (e.g. GMK-ID) shall be used to indicate the use of the key.

question_1508.question: What should the UE do when the received measObject includes the cellsToRemoveList in the 5.5.2.5 procedure?
question_1508.ground_truth: The UE should remove the entry with the matching physCellId from the cellsToAddModList for each physCellId included in the cellsToRemoveList.

question_1512.question: What should be done if any of the received VAL group IDs is a temporary group when creating a group in the SGM-S?
question_1512.ground_truth: The SGM-S shall not create the group and respond with a CoAP 4.03 (Forbidden) response to the CoAP POST request.

question_1513.question: What is the role of an assistant UE in the Ranging/Sidelink positioning procedure?
question_1513.ground_truth: An assistant UE provides assistance in the Ranging/Sidelink positioning procedure by acting as a relay or a reference point, but may not obtain the final ranging result between UE1 and UE2.

question_1515.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Report on the study of enhancement of network slicing?
question_1515.ground_truth: The purpose of the report is to identify, prioritize, and study the practical non-roaming and roaming deployment scenarios and system impacts when the 5G system (5GS) cannot support all possible combinations of S-NSSAIs for user equipment (UE). The report also covers the mutually exclusive access to network slices and interworking with EPC for connected and idle modes.

question_1517.question: What is the 5G DDNMF of the UE-to-UE Relay supposed to check when authorizing a Monitor Request from the 5G DDNMF of the Source UE/Target UE?
question_1517.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF of the UE-to-UE Relay is supposed to check whether the Source UE/Target UE and the UE-to-UE Relay are authorized to perform the U2U discovery under the specific U2U relay service.

question_1518.question: What is the impact on existing nodes and functionality in UMTS when performing an early Service Request procedure with a new RRCConnectionRequest message?
question_1518.ground_truth: The impacts on UE include support for early Service Request procedure with a new RRCConnectionRequest message, support for RRC combining in RRCConnectionSetup and RRCConnectionSetupComplete, and support of fallback to the legacy RRC connection setup procedure. For eNodeB, the impacts include support of new RRC messages in RRCConnectionSetup, support of NAS triggered RRC connection setup procedure, and support of fallback to the legacy RRC connection setup procedure.

question_1519.question: Which series of specifications, TS 24.08x and 24.09x, deal with the procedures used at the radio interface for the operation, registration, erasure, activation, deactivation, invocation, and interrogation of supplementary services?
question_1519.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 24.08x and 24.09x-series specify the procedures used at the radio interface for normal operation, registration, erasure, activation, deactivation, invocation, and interrogation of supplementary services.

question_1521.question: What is the condition for the UE to detect no uplink signal?
question_1521.ground_truth: UE output power equal to or less than Transmit OFF power -48.5 dBm.

question_1523.question: What is the purpose of Burst Arrival Time in the context of Key Issue 6 solutions?
question_1523.ground_truth: The purpose of Burst Arrival Time (BAT) is to enable low latency communication in 5G by giving the AF the ability to conform to the latency requirements.

question_1524.question: What is the difference between Solution #6 and Solution #21 for PC5 communication?
question_1524.ground_truth: In Solution #6, the Remote UE calculates a message authentication code (MAC~REAR) and includes it in the Direct Communication Request to the UE-to-network relay, while in Solution #21, this is not the case. Additionally, in Solution #6, the Remote UE and UE-to-network relay belong to the same HPLMN, whereas in Solution #21, they belong to different HPLMNs.

question_1526.question: What are the potential types of measurements for direct AI/ML positioning, considering performance impact and associated signalling overhead?
question_1526.ground_truth: The potential types of measurements are: Potential new measurement: CIR/PDP, Existing measurement: e.g., RSRP/RSRPP/RSTD, and Note: Details of potential new measurement and/or potential enhancement to existing measurement is to be studied.

question_1527.question: What information does the Role management and presence application provide for the FRMCS System?
question_1527.ground_truth: The identities of the Drivers and Controller, and the location of the Drivers.

question_1528.question: What problem was found with using FOA signals with two instances of eAAC+ encoding at low bit-rates?
question_1528.ground_truth: The occurrence of out-of-phase components between each of the channel pairs was the issue found.

question_1532.question: What function controls the signaling reference points and the corresponding media for MCData server?
question_1532.ground_truth: The MCData server controls the signaling reference points and the corresponding media for MCData server.

question_1536.question: Which capability IE should the Node B include in the RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message if the Local Cell is F-DPCH-capable when it becomes Existing?
question_1536.ground_truth: The Node B shall include the F-DPCH Capability IE set to "F-DPCH Capable" for the Local Cell.

question_1538.question: What is the role of the MCData Service in robot control communication within a 3GPP system?
question_1538.ground_truth: The MCData Service provides the necessary mechanisms to enable and control robot communication within a 3GPP system, ensuring smooth integration of various robots and provision of a common transmission framework.

question_1541.question: What does the "ROHC Parameters" IE carry?
question_1541.ground_truth: The ROCH parameters for header compressions.

question_1542.question: What message does the MAG function of the Trusted Non-3GPP IP Access or ePDG send to the Serving GW to initiate a handover of PDN connections to non-3GPP access?
question_1542.ground_truth: A Proxy Binding Update (MN-NAI, Lifetime, Access Technology Type, Handover Indicator, APN, GRE key for downlink traffic, PDN GW address, Additional Parameters) message.

question_1543.question: What is required for service continuity in a 5G system?
question_1543.ground_truth: The system should minimize service disruption when changing the communication path from one PIN element to another, including licensed and unlicensed spectrum as well as 3GPP and non-3GPP access.

question_1545.question: What is the target confidence level that the total number of successful tests must be more than in the test to pass?

question_1546.question: What is the improvement in average user throughput for TX-diversity users in the PA3 channel when the inter-site distance is 2.8 km?
question_1546.ground_truth: There is some gain in average user throughput for TX-diversity users in the PA3 channel when the inter-site distance is 2.8 km.

question_1547.question: What should the IMS-ALG do if an indication that the allocation of a primary local MR is not required has been stored?
question_1547.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG should compare the realm instances and MRs that can be bypassed, and use local policy to select whether to allocate a primary local MR.

question_1548.question: What procedure does the SGSN initiate when a PDP context using streaming or conversational traffic class is deactivated in architecture variants using S4 based interaction with S-GW and P-GW?
question_1548.ground_truth: The SGSN initiates the SGSN-initiated PDP Context Deactivation procedure to deactivate the PDP context.

question_1550.question: When is a UE allowed to initiate a PDU session establishment procedure?
question_1550.ground_truth: The UE is allowed to initiate a PDU session establishment procedure if the procedure is for emergency services and the back-off timer is running or the timer is deactivated.

question_1552.question: What action does the SS take after sending the MEASUREMENT INFORMATION message to the MS?
question_1552.ground_truth: The SS verifies that the MS includes the UTRAN cell in the MEASUREMENT REPORT.

question_1553.question: What is the function of the Non-IP Packet Data Header Information event in the SCEF related events?
question_1553.ground_truth: The Non-IP Packet Data Header Information event is used to provide packet header reports on a per packet basis for a target.

question_1554.question: What is the value of the general result for the successfully performed "SEND DATA" command?

question_1557.question: How are the noise estimates obtained in DTX-off mode in the CNA?
question_1557.ground_truth: By applying the FD-CNG noise estimation algorithm at the output of the core decoder during speech pauses

question_1558.question: What is the minimum percentage of successful channelOccupancy reports required for the FS3 channel occupancy test to pass, with a confidence level of 95%?
question_1558.ground_truth: The minimum percentage of successful channelOccupancy reports required for the FS3 channel occupancy test to pass, with a confidence level of 95%, is more than 90%.

question_1560.question: What should the UE do when it has changed to S1 mode or E-UTRA connected to 5GCN?
question_1560.ground_truth: The UE should treat the indication from the lower layers as successful completion of the procedure and stop timer T3517.

question_1561.question: What is the instruction given by the CSE if the attach request is rejected in the attach procedure?
question_1561.ground_truth: If the CSE rejects the attachment request, the VPLMN shall reject the attachment request and continue.

question_1562.question: What information should be included in the drx-Preference in the UEAssistanceInformation message?
question_1562.ground_truth: If the UE has a preference on DRX parameters for the cell group, the preferredDRX-LongCycle, preferredDRX-InactivityTimer, preferredDRX-ShortCycle or preferredDRX-ShortCycleTimer should be included in the DRX-PreferenceIE with the preferred value.

question_1563.question: What messages need to be sent via the DRA in order to restore a failed PCRF session?
question_1563.ground_truth: The "Restore Request" and "Restore Confirm" messages need to be sent via the DRA to restore a failed PCRF session.

question_1564.question: What is the difference between common RF hardware and parallel RF hardware in the context of equivalent beams?
question_1564.ground_truth: Common RF hardware uses half the power of each transceiver unit for each equivalent beam, while parallel RF hardware uses each transceiver unit at full power for each equivalent beam.

question_1566.question: What should the UE do when barring for an Access Category is considered being alleviated and the Access Category is '8'?
question_1566.ground_truth: The UE shall perform actions specified in 5.3.13.8 if barring is alleviated for Access Category '8'. These actions may include triggering uplink transmission if needed.

question_1568.question: What is expected from the MS for displaying information?
question_1568.ground_truth: It is expected that the MS will display the most up-to-date information transferred to it.

question_1570.question: What must the USAT application do when the UICC/ME interface transport level is present in a command?
question_1570.ground_truth: The USAT application must provide the requested transport layer protocols under the channel and use the object containing a set of parameters required to make the transport connection.

question_1572.question: What is the purpose of the Comprehension Required mechanism in GTPv2?
question_1572.ground_truth: The Comprehension Required mechanism in GTPv2 allows a sender to force the receiver to support comprehension of specific IEs (Information Elements) as a precondition to process a backward incompatible message.

question_1575.question: What procedure does the Trusted Non-3GPP Access follow for PMIPv6 PDN Connection Creation in PMIPv6 mode?
question_1575.ground_truth: In PMIPv6 mode, the Trusted Non-3GPP Access follows the MAG procedure for the PMIPv6 PDN Connection Creation as outlined in subclause 5.1.2.

question_1576.question: What should the LMISF do upon receiving a notification of an IMS Signalling Bearer creation due to S-GW relocation?
question_1576.ground_truth: The LMISF should examine whether the IMS Signalling Bearer is associated with an intercepted IMS session, and if so, whether the intercepted IMS session requires CC interception. If it does, the LMISF should inform the S-GW/BBIFF with the IMS Signalling Bearer information and an instruction to deliver (to LMISF) the packets from the Media Bearer associated with the IMS Signalling Bearer.

question_1577.question: What was the average interference power over the burst length used in the asynchronous scenario to match the synchronous case?
question_1577.ground_truth: Two consecutive bursts with independent fast fading were generated to provide the same average interference power over the burst length as in the synchronous case.

question_1579.question: What is the role of the recovery message in the SMF set in case of UE IP address/prefix release?
question_1579.ground_truth: The SMF broadcasts the available UE IP address(es)/prefix(es) message towards all other SMFs in the SMF set if the released UE IP address(es)/prefix(es) does not belong to its individual UE IP address/prefix list.

question_1580.question: Which HTTP method is used for deregistration notifications, and what URI format is used in this method as provided during the registration procedure?
question_1580.ground_truth: The POST method is used for deregistration notifications, and the URI is defined as "<callbackReference>" as provided during the registration procedure.

question_1581.question: When should the target end UE layer-2 ID set to the layer-2 ID of the target 5G ProSe end UE be included in the PROSE DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION REQUEST message?
question_1581.ground_truth: This should be included if the UE acts as a source 5G ProSe end UE and the 5G ProSe direct link is between the source 5G ProSe end UE and the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE.

question_1582.question: What is the role of the jamming graph in the distributed FFR algorithm for HeNB network interference?
question_1582.ground_truth: The jamming graph in the distributed FFR algorithm for HeNB network interference is used to convert the planning problem into a graph coloring problem, which can be solved in a distributed manner at low complexity.

question_1584.question: What is the primary function of the MTC-IWF in reusing the MT SMS functionality for MTC device triggering?
question_1584.ground_truth: The MTC-IWF reuses the existing SMS infrastructure and protocols and hides the details of the triggering mechanism in the operator's domain for MTC device triggering.

question_1585.question: What does the ProtectedStreaming attribute indicate?
question_1585.ground_truth: It indicates whether the device supports streamed protected PSS as defined by Annex R.

question_1588.question: What action does the UE take when the TTL corresponding to a Discovery Filter expires?
question_1588.ground_truth: When the TTL corresponding to a Discovery Filter expires, the ProSe Function in the UE removes the entry related to that Discovery Filter from the UE context.

question_1589.question: What message types may be included in the first message received for a specific TNL association, if it is not an X2 SETUP REQUEST, X2 SETUP RESPONSE, or X2 SETUP FAILURE message?
question_1589.ground_truth: Any other ongoing procedure (except another Reset procedure) on the same X2 interface.

question_1590.question: What is required for an MC service user to affiliate to a group that is defined in a partner MC system in a different trust domain?
question_1590.ground_truth: The home MC system of the MC service group needs to authorize the MC service user to affiliate to the requested MC service group, and the primary MC system of the MC service user may also need to authorize the user to take part in MC service group calls in a different trust domain.

question_1592.question: What is the relationship between the Slot Number variable and the SpatialDirectionInformation variable in NR?
question_1592.ground_truth: The Slot Number variable represents the number of the slot within the radio frame for the NR network, while the SpatialDirectionInformation variable represents the spatial direction information of a beam in the NR network. The Slot Number variable is an integer that ranges from 0 to 79, while the SpatialDirectionInformation variable is a sequence that contains information about the NR-PCI and the Scrambling Sequence.

question_1595.question: What request does the UE-1 send towards the SCC AS to setup the collaborative session?
question_1595.ground_truth: The UE-1 sends a SIP INVITE request towards the SCC AS to setup the collaborative session.

question_1596.question: What is the purpose of the UE providing reason for registration to S-NSSAI in Solution #36 and what are the three possible reasons for registration explained in the solution?
question_1596.ground_truth: The purpose of the UE providing reason for registration to S-NSSAI in Solution #36 is to assist the network in assuring proper utilization of the network slices. The three possible reasons for registration include: "immediate use", "default applications", and "proactive registration". "Immediate use" denotes the UE needs the slice registration for immediate usage, "default applications" refers to S-NSSAIs correlated with default applications (e.g. IMS voice for a voice-centric UE), and "proactive registration" indicates the UE wants to register to an S-NSSAI in advance for future usage.

question_1597.question: What is the function of the PCF in the 5G System?
question_1597.ground_truth: The PCF (Policy Control Function) is responsible for authorizing requests and creating PCC (Packet Caching Context) rules in the 5G System.

question_1598.question: What are the functions of the EAS in relation to the EES?
question_1598.ground_truth: The EAS is responsible for providing server functions for an application, and it can consume 3GPP Core Network capabilities through the EES.

question_1599.question: How are MBMS User Services defined in the present document?
question_1599.ground_truth: MBMS User Services are defined as an end-user service for which all associated resources are delivered through an MBMS User Service via broadcast and/or unicast bearers and which is accessible through the MBMS-API.

question_1600.question: What are the actions taken by the CAPIF core function when the onboarding request is successfully validated?
question_1600.ground_truth: When the onboarding request is successfully validated, the CAPIF core function creates an API invoker Profile, a new resource as defined in clause~8.4.3, and sends the API invoker Profile, API List of APIs the API invoker is allowed to access and the CAPIF Resource URI in the response message to the API invoker.

question_1601.question: Who provides the SVSP to the UE in 5G network?
question_1601.ground_truth: The Home PLMN (HPLMN) may provide the SVSP to the UE in 5G network to indicate in which condition the UE is allowed to trigger VPLMN selection to find a network that supports slices the UE wants to use.

question_1603.question: What is the purpose of "omr-s-cksum" and "omr-m-cksum" in the initial SDP offer when sending an initial SDP offer in IMS-ALG?
question_1603.ground_truth: To ensure the integrity of the media line and session level lines in the SDP offer.

question_1604.question: What action does the target RNC/BSS take when it receives downlink packets from the 3G/2G SGSN?
question_1604.ground_truth: The target RNC/BSS may start blind transmission of downlink user data towards the MS over the allocated radio channels.

question_1606.question: What happens when the SCS/AS sends a Group Message Request using xMB to the SCEF with a ServiceId through application level interaction?
question_1606.ground_truth: When the SCS/AS sends a Group Message Request using xMB to the SCEF with a ServiceId through application level interaction, the application in the UE can activate reception using MBMS APIs.

question_1607.question: What is a Name space in the context of the present document?
question_1607.ground_truth: A name space is a collection of names with a hierarchical containment structure, including its simplest form - the one-level, flat name space. In the context of the present document, all Managed Objects in a MIB are included in the corresponding name space and the MIB/name space shall only support a strict hierarchical containment structure with one root object.

question_1608.question: What should a mobile station do if it receives an LLC PDU with a lower throughput class during an uplink transfer?
question_1608.ground_truth: The mobile station should first complete the sending of the current LLC PDU, then perform a resource reallocation for uplink for any remaining LLC PDU(s) by sending a PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message on the PACCH.

question_1609.question: What is the role of the NWDAF in the MDAS system?
question_1609.ground_truth: The NWDAF may consume the MDAS for identified scenarios and provide analytics service for 5GC NF for control purpose.

question_1610.question: What type of E-UTRA TDD UE does the 9.2.33.2 test apply to?
question_1610.ground_truth: All types of E-UTRA TDD UE release 12 and forward

question_1611.question: What is the role of STI-AS in the process where originating IMS network invokes the signing on behalf of 3rd party?
question_1611.ground_truth: STI-AS signs the SIP identity header based on the STIR/SHAKEN framework and draft-ietf-stir-passport-rcd-18 in the process where originating IMS network invokes the signing on behalf of 3rd party.

question_1612.question: What is the purpose of Ga reference point in the 3GPP offline charging architecture?
question_1612.ground_truth: The Ga reference point in the 3GPP offline charging architecture is intended for the transport of Charging Data Records (CDRs) between the Charging Data Function (CDF) and Charging Gateway Function (CGF).

question_1614.question: What is the requirement for the PDSCH BLER in high power subframes using the transport format indicated by the wideband CQI median if it is less than or equal to 0.1?
question_1614.ground_truth: If the PDSCH BLER in the high power subframes using the transport format indicated by the wideband CQI median is less than or equal to 0.1, the BLER in high power subframes using the transport format indicated by (wideband CQI median + 1) shall be greater than 0.1.

question_1615.question: What is a potential benefit of using multiple machine learning models in Key Issue #10?
question_1615.ground_truth: Potential benefits include enabling the selection of an ML model based on specific context, such as UE location or time of day, leading to improved analytics correctness for a given Analytics ID.

question_1616.question: What is required to ensure a seamless processing of originating requests from registered users despite loss of user data in the HSS during HSS failure?
question_1616.ground_truth: A new S-CSCF assignment is required for an authenticated re-registration, which is stored in the HSS for SIP request handling.

question_1618.question: What is sent from one MCVideo client to another MCVideo client for a private communication request?
question_1618.ground_truth: A private communication request is sent from one MCVideo client to another, containing information such as the identities of the requesting and requested users, and an SDP offer for establishing the session.

question_1619.question: What is the recommended solution for AVP filtering in inter-PLMN Diameter Gy?
question_1619.ground_truth: The recommended solution is to reuse GSMA DEA, as there is no need to introduce a new dedicated OCS proxy for this purpose.

question_1620.question: What message is used to report detected errors in one incoming message when an appropriate failure message cannot be used?
question_1620.ground_truth: The Error Indication procedure is initiated by an ERROR INDICATION message, sent from the receiving node.

question_1621.question: What is the significance of the sequence number in SLPP messages?
question_1621.ground_truth: The sequence number in SLPP messages is used to match acknowledgements with the correct message and to indicate the order in which messages should be sent and received.

question_1623.question: What should a GPRS MS do if the GPRS detach and GPRS attach procedure collide and the detach type indicates "re-attach required"?
question_1623.ground_truth: The network should ignore the ATTACH REQUEST message and progress the detach procedure if the detach type is "re-attach required". If "re-attach not required" or "IMSI detach" is specified, the network should progress both procedures or abort the GPRS detach procedure and progress the GPRS attach procedure.

question_1625.question: What is the effect of CFU on the served user's ability to originate communication?
question_1625.ground_truth: The CFU supplementary service does not affect the served user's ability to originate communications.

question_1626.question: What should the UE do with a first PUCCH transmission of smaller priority index that is not dropped and its UCI is not multiplexed in a second PUCCH transmission of larger priority index in an overlapping slot?
question_1626.ground_truth: The first PUCCH transmission is associated with the next overlapping slot with subslotLengthForPUCCH symbols for PUCCH transmissions with the larger priority index.

question_1627.question: When an NF Service Consumer creates a session context for callback, what is shared by all NF (Service) instances pertaining to the same NF (Service) set?
question_1627.ground_truth: The session context data is shared by all NF (Service) instances pertaining to the same NF (Service) set.

question_1628.question: What is the objective of the link level evaluation in sub-clause 4.4.2?
question_1628.ground_truth: The objective of the link level evaluation in sub-clause 4.4.2 is to analyze the PDSCH performance in a scenario with inter-user interference for MU-MIMO and to compare differing receiver structures in combination with differing sources of interference parameters.

question_1629.question: How is the removal of a single value from a multivalue attribute reported?
question_1629.ground_truth: The operation used is "remove" and no value is present.

question_1631.question: What is the number of codec modes in Example 2, and does it include SCR?
question_1631.ground_truth: There is only one codec mode in Example 2, and yes, it includes SCR.

question_1632.question: What action is taken by the NAS if the lower layers indicate that the access attempt is allowed and the event which triggered the access attempt was an MO-MMTEL-voice-call-started indication or an MO-MMTEL-video-call-started indication?
question_1632.ground_truth: If the UE is operating in the single-registration mode and the UE's usage setting is "voice centric", the UE will attempt to select an E-UTRA cell connected to EPC and then proceed with the appropriate EMM specific procedures and, if necessary, ESM procedures to make a PDN connection providing access to IMS available. If the UE is operating in the dual-registration mode, the UE will proceed in S1 mode with the appropriate EMM specific procedures and ESM procedures to make a PDN connection providing access to IMS available.

question_1635.question: What are the benefits of the solution where the BSS detects the tone/announcement coming from the CN and sends that data, muting the local user data?
question_1635.ground_truth: The benefits are that there is no dedicated signalling from the MSC-S to inform the BSS about the announcement and that the BSS can easily distinguish speech, e.g. announcements and tones, from SID frames/silence codewords.

question_1636.question: What is the impact on the valid policy decision and/or condition data when the SMF reports PCC and/or session rule errors for all the provisioned PCC rules and/or session rules?
question_1636.ground_truth: The valid policy decision and/or condition data provided in the corresponding update response can remain valid in the SMF until the PCF removes them.

question_1637.question: What is the definition of "Standalone Transaction" in the context of the document?
question_1637.ground_truth: A Standalone Transaction in the document refers to a SIP transaction that is not part of an existing dialog and does not initiate the creation of a new dialog.

question_1638.question: How does the 5GC system in 5G handle 5GC individual MBS traffic delivery for multicast?
question_1638.ground_truth: In 5GC individual MBS traffic delivery for multicast, 5GC receives a single copy of multicast packets and delivers separate copies of those multicast packets to individual UEs via per-UE PDU sessions, with a PDU session required for each UE.

question_1641.question: What is the minimum output power defined for each carrier in 5.4.3A.2 for the test to apply?
question_1641.ground_truth: The minimum output power in each carrier shall be less than -50 dBm, when both carriers are set to minimum output power.

question_1642.question: How does 3GPP management system manage network functions not specified by 3GPP SDOs?
question_1642.ground_truth: 3GPP management system may provide link requirements (e.g. topology, QOS parameters) to the TN management system to ensure proper functionality.

question_1643.question: What is the LoS-NLoSInformation ::= CHOICE sequence used for?
question_1643.ground_truth: The LoS-NLoSInformation ::= CHOICE sequence is used to indicate the line-of-sight (LoS) or non-line-of-sight (NLoS) status of a measured location. It can specify the LoS-NLoSIndicatorSoft (soft LoS-NLoS) or LoS-NLoSIndicatorHard (hard LoS-NLoS) parameters, as well as any additional information (iE-Extensions).

question_1644.question: What is the size of the sequence number modulo used for standard L3 messages in the MM+CC+SS (via CS domain) message flow when the RR connection starts with a core network of Release 98 or earlier?

question_1646.question: What is the purpose of the Application Level Container in the Discovery Request message when using restricted Direct Discovery with application-controlled extension?
question_1646.ground_truth: The Application Level Container contains the request and any relevant information for the ProSe Application Server to assign a (set of) ProSe Restricted Code Suffixes.

question_1647.question: What action should the P-CSCF take if the list of Route headers in the received request does not match the stored list of Record-Route headers for the same dialog?
