question_1647.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should either return a 400 (Bad Request) response or replace the Route header value in the request with the stored list of Record-Route headers for the same dialog.

question_1648.question: What is the result of the TERMINAL RESPONSE after the second CLOSE CHANNEL command in the second sequence?

question_1651.question: What is a requirement for UP security policy handling in section 6.1 of the document for redundant data transmission?
question_1651.ground_truth: A requirement for UP security policy handling in section 6.1 of the document is that the SMF should determine and provide the UP security policy for a PDU session to the gNB connected to 5GC during the PDU session establishment procedure for redundant data transmission.

question_1652.question: What spreading factor is used for the E-AGCH?
question_1652.ground_truth: The E-AGCH uses a spreading factor of SF = 16.

question_1653.question: How many dB of adjacent channel suppression are required for the first adjacent channel to be excluded in the same cell?

question_1654.question: What should the NF service consumer do if the "PartialPull" feature is supported and the PFDF requests the NF service consumer to retrieve the PFDs with the "pfdOp" attribute set to "FULLPULL"?
question_1654.ground_truth: If the "PartialPull" feature is supported and if the PFDF requests the NF service consumer to retrieve the PFDs with the "pfdOp" attribute set to the value "FULLPULL", the NF service consumer shall invoke the full pull procedure defined in clause~4.2.2.2.

question_1655.question: What information can be exchanged in real-time conversational XR communication on the 5G system, as per R-5.2.2-002 and R-5.2.2-003?
question_1655.ground_truth: Multimedia conversational communications, including real-time avatar media and audio media, and the option to change media types between video and avatar media for parties in the conversation.

question_1656.question: Who is the test applicable to?
question_1656.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA UE on or after release 16, supporting EN-DC, RRM measurements, UL with a shared spectrum NR carrier, BWP adaptation of at least 2BWPs, DCI and timer-based active BWP switching delay Type1 or Type2 and 2DL CA on shared channel access.

question_1658.question: How many times will an SLPP message be retransmitted if not acknowledged?
question_1658.ground_truth: An SLPP message will be retransmitted up to three times if it is not acknowledged before the timeout period expires.

question_1659.question: Which API is utilized to monitor the time period in the network slice optimization process?
question_1659.ground_truth: The NSCE server sets up a timer to monitor the time period.

question_1660.question: What is the impact of DPCCH bursts on transmissions scheduled at medium and higher data-rates?
question_1660.ground_truth: The interference created by DPCCH bursts is important when transmissions are scheduled at medium and higher data-rates. An impact on performance is observed when the DPCCH bursts are interfered by data transmissions, and this impact increases with the number of DPCCH bursts between data transmissions.

question_1661.question: What is a feature of the MILENAGE algorithm that is carried over to the Tuak algorithm?
question_1661.ground_truth: Operator customization, which allows for the customization of the Tuak algorithm by each mobile operator.

question_1663.question: How is the measurement window, T, determined in this process?
question_1663.ground_truth: The measurement window, T, shall be identical to the test signal period, T, with the measurement window synchronized to the PN-sequence of the test signal.

question_1664.question: What is the benefit of reusing the existing provisioning MnS operations and notifications with extensions of the NRM for ML inference emulation?
question_1664.ground_truth: Reusing the existing provisioning MnS operations and notifications with extensions of the NRM for ML inference emulation provides flexibility and allows any function that can execute n ML entity to be the MnS producer for ML inference emulation, for example an inference function or a generic sandbox function. It also enables requests for inference emulation for a given ML entity to be instantiated using provisioning management service implemented via CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations on the request objects.

question_1665.question: What is the purpose of setting the number of peaks to 0 if either of the last two frames has the flag set?
question_1665.ground_truth: This is done to avoid quality degrading tonal sounds due to too strong periodicity and is useful both in case of transients and burst frame loss.

question_1666.question: What actions does the old I-SMF take when releasing the resource of old I-SMF and old I-UPF when the PDU session moves to a new I-SMF?
question_1666.ground_truth: The old I-SMF provides forwarding tunnel info to the old I-UPF for the data forwarding tunnel, which is released by the old I-SMF after the timer for indirect forwarding tunnel expires. After receiving forwarding tunnel information, the old I-UPF sets up the forwarding tunnel endpoint for the buffered DL data received from the old I-UPF.

question_1667.question: What is one of the benefits of using switched antenna transmit diversity in the studied channels, PedA 3 km/h and VehA 30 km/h, when assuming uncorrelated and balanced antennae?
question_1667.ground_truth: The benefit of using switched antenna transmit diversity in the studied channels when assuming uncorrelated and balanced antennae is a reduction of up to 1.42 dB in UE uplink transmit power in PedA 3 km/h channel and UE transmit powers ranging from 0.15 dB loss to 0.2 dB gain in VehA 30 km/h channel.

question_1669.question: What type of operation is supported on the UE-contexts resource?
question_1669.ground_truth: There is no standard operation supported on this resource.

question_1671.question: What does the NRF network product class refer to in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_1671.ground_truth: The NRF network product class refers to a specific set of security requirements and test cases related to the Network Repository Function in the 3GPP 5G System.

question_1676.question: What is an operator controlled Rx service?
question_1676.ground_truth: An operator controlled Rx service is a service for which the PCEF receives from the PCRF service specific uplink/downlink packet filters and service specific QoS parameters, where the QoS parameters have been derived from information received over the Rx interface from an AF.

question_1678.question: What should the MS do when it receives a GA-PSR-DEACTIVATE-UTC-ACK message while the GA-PSR is in the GA-PSR-ACTIVE state?
question_1678.ground_truth: The MS should stop TU4001 timer, release the GA-PSR TC, and transition to GA-PSR-STANDBY state when it receives a GA-PSR-DEACTIVATE-UTC-ACK message while the GA-PSR is in the GA-PSR-ACTIVE state.

question_1679.question: What are the specification-level requirements for the Policy Management Service Producer in network policy management?
question_1679.ground_truth: The Policy Management Service Producer should provide the capabilities to create, delete, update, query, activate, and deactivate network policies. Additionally, it should notify the Policy Management Service Consumer of any network policy conflicts and support the execution and verification of activated network policies.

question_1680.question: What must the MRFC include in the SDP offer within the SIP signalling if it determines to offer CVO?
question_1680.ground_truth: The MRFC must include the CVO related "a=extmap" attribute in the SDP offer it sends within the SIP signalling if it determines to offer CVO.

question_1682.question: What is one security threat and one potential security requirement related to the "Management Exposure Interface" in the context of 5G network slicing management?
question_1682.ground_truth: One security threat related to the "Management Exposure Interface" is an attacker gaining access to this interface and creating network slice instances in an unauthorized way. One potential security requirement is to ensure that the management capabilities that a communication service customer is allowed to use are defined by the HPLMN and that it is possible to integrity protect the slice management interface messages.

question_1683.question: What is one issue with using independent and dynamic gain value signalling for some physical channels in 3GPP networks?
question_1683.ground_truth: This issue is that for some physical channels all involved nodes (NodeBs and UEs) need to have a consistent view on what gain values are used.

question_1685.question: What is the purpose of using the private message mechanism for non-standard use in the SLmAP protocol?
question_1685.ground_truth: The private message mechanism for non-standard use may be used for special operator and/or vendor specific features that are not part of the basic functionality, or by vendors for research purposes. It shall not be used for basic functionality that is required for a complete and high-quality specification for multivendor inter-operability.

question_1686.question: What are the three different sequences used in the subjective tests described in section 9.2.1?
question_1686.ground_truth: The three different sequences used in the subjective tests are: the Football sequence with significant movements, the Interview sequence with almost static content, and the Cartoon sequence, an animated movie with simplified textures.

question_1687.question: What is the typical bandwidth of human sensitivity of touch for tactile sensing?
question_1687.ground_truth: The typical bandwidth of human sensitivity of touch for tactile sensing is around 400 Hz.

question_1688.question: What should a UE attached for access to RLOS do when it receives a paging indication from the network?
question_1688.ground_truth: It should ignore the paging indication from the network.

question_1690.question: What were the two methods for evaluation of echo control characteristics introduced in Release 11 of TS~26.132 that lack corresponding requirements in TS~26.131?
question_1690.ground_truth: In Release 11 of TS~26.132, new methods for evaluation of echo control characteristics were introduced in Clauses 7.11 and 8.11, but corresponding requirements were not defined in TS~26.131.

question_1693.question: Which command is used to open a new logical channel and select the application identified by the <dfname> received with the command in the currently selected UICC?
question_1693.ground_truth: The Open logical channel +CCHO command is used to open a new logical channel and select the application identified by the <dfname> received with the command in the currently selected UICC.

question_1694.question: What is the meaning of the measurement family names used in the present document?
question_1694.ground_truth: The measurement family names (e.g. UR.AttInitReg, SC.AttOrigSession) identify all measurements which relate to a given functionality and it may be used for measurement administration.

question_1695.question: What are the two assignment models for the Network Identifier (NID) in Stand-alone Non-Public Networks?
question_1695.ground_truth: The two assignment models for the Network Identifier (NID) in Stand-alone Non-Public Networks are Self-assignment, where NIDs are chosen individually by SNPNs at deployment time and use a different numbering space than coordinated assignment NIDs, and Coordinated assignment, where NIDs are assigned such that they are globally unique independent of the PLMN ID used or the combination of NID and PLMN ID is globally unique.

question_1696.question: What is the role of the "Service data flow template" in a PCC rule?
question_1696.ground_truth: The "Service data flow template" contains information for matching user plane packets, instructing the UPF to identify packets belonging to a particular service data flow. It may include any number of service data flow filters or an application identifier.

question_1697.question: What action should the CBC take if it receives the same RESTART-INDICATION-E-UTRAN message twice?
question_1697.ground_truth: If the same RESTART-INDICATION-E-UTRAN message is received twice, the CBC shall consider the message as a duplicate and ignore it.

question_1698.question: What information does the V-SMF send in the PDU Session Create Request to the H-SMF when creating a HR breakout session?
question_1698.ground_truth: The V-SMF sends the VPLMN-provided policy information for the HR breakout session in the PDU Session Create Request to the H-SMF.

question_1699.question: What is the timing advance adjustment value in the second time period of the test procedure in the E-UTRAN FDD Timing Advance Adjustment Accuracy Test for CE UE in CEModeA?
question_1699.ground_truth: The timing advance adjustment value in the second time period is NTA = 128.

question_1700.question: Who is responsible for verifying the authorization of the DAA support information request before sending it to the UAE client?
question_1700.ground_truth: The UAE server is responsible for verifying that the DAA support information request from the application specific server is authorized before sending the DAA support information to the UAE client.

question_1701.question: When at least one different numerology/slot pattern is used in aggregated cells, what requirement must be applied for intra-band SL CA operation?
question_1701.ground_truth: The same requirement as specified in clause 6.2E.4.3 in TS38.101-1 must be applied.

question_1702.question: What is the behavior of an AS handling a service during 3GPP PS data off, if the service is not a 3GPP PS data off exempt service and the 3GPP PS data off status is "active"?
question_1702.ground_truth: The AS prevents downlink IP packets of the service from reaching the UE over certain IP-CANs and includes two indications for 3GPP IMS services as 3GPP PS Data Off exempt services, one for non-roaming users and one for users roaming in certain VPLMNs.

question_1703.question: What is the impact of NR PC5 DRX for pedestrian UEs with multiple PC5 communication sessions?
question_1703.ground_truth: If not coordinated properly, different V2X services with multiple PC5 communication sessions may have conflicts in QoS requirements and power efficiency, which may affect the reliability of V2X applications due to missing V2X messages.

question_1704.question: What is the minimum requirement for single RAT UTRA operation for UTRA BS in the context of in-channel selectivity?
question_1704.ground_truth: This requirement is not applicable for UTRA BS.

question_1706.question: What is Proposal 2 regarding intermodulation requirements for non-contiguous intra-band CA?
question_1706.ground_truth: Proposal 2 suggests that the interference CW signal level should be set to -40dBc relative to the sum of the filtered mean powers centered on the assigned channel frequencies, and the intermodulation product levels for the first and second tests should be -29dBc and -35dBc, respectively.

question_1707.question: How does the MRFC request the MRFP to play a sequence of announcements?
question_1707.ground_truth: The MRFC requests the MRFP to play all the announcements with one request.

question_1709.question: What is required for a pre-arranged group session to be initiated in the MCPTT system?
question_1709.ground_truth: The pre-arranged sessions must be already active and the use of pre-established sessions must be required for the pre-arranged group session to be initiated.

question_1710.question: What is the difference between UE-initiated NBIFOM and Network-initiated NBIFOM?
question_1710.ground_truth: UE-initiated NBIFOM is a mode where only the UE determines the routing rules and provides them to the PDN GW, while Network-initiated NBIFOM is a mode where the network determines the routing rules and provides them to the UE.

question_1711.question: How can the IMS domain ensure the appropriate 5GC network slice is used for each IMS service and prevent inappropriate services from different 5GC network slice in 5GC network slicing?
question_1711.ground_truth: The IMS domain can ensure the appropriate 5GC network slice is used for each IMS service and prevent inappropriate services from different 5GC network slice by implementing network slicing capabilities and managing the association of IMS services to their appropriate slices. This can be achieved through the use of a shared or separate IMS network, depending on the specific requirements of the network.

question_1713.question: What are the two functional entities of the call control procedures in MSC-A?
question_1713.ground_truth: The two functional entities of the call control procedures in MSC-A are: (1) the call control procedure as part of the normal interworking between the PSTN/ISDN and the PLMN, for an MS originating call MSC-A is the originating exchange, for an MS terminating call MSC-A is the destination exchange; and (2) the call control procedure for the connection between MSC-A and MSC-B in case of a handover from MSC-A to MSC-B.

question_1714.question: What should the PCF do if the AF requests the PCF to report on the Out of credit event for associated service data flow(s)?
question_1714.ground_truth: The PCF must inform the AF that credit is no longer available for the service data flow(s) related to the AF session together with the applied termination action.

question_1715.question: What is required for supporting larger files or V2X messages in unicast and multicast scenarios?
question_1715.ground_truth: A V2X application server should provide a partitioning step to separate the file or message into multiple IP packet payloads. A V2X UE should provide larger files or V2X messages for uplink distribution.

question_1716.question: What mandatory data elements are included in the FDT Instance schema for FLUTE in MBMS?
question_1716.ground_truth: The mandatory data elements that are included in the FDT Instance schema for FLUTE in MBMS are Content-Location (URI of a file), TOI (Transport Object Identifier of a file instance), and Expires (expiry data for the FDT Instance).

question_1717.question: What is expected when the SS detects certain uplink power levels during subtest b) in the test procedure?
question_1717.ground_truth: When the SS on Cell2 detects uplink power equal to or higher than -39 dBm in the On-duration part of every DRX cycle during the period from time point A to time point B and does not detect any uplink power higher than -48.5 dBm between time point C and T3 expiration, the SS must increase the number of successful tests by one. Otherwise, the number of failed tests is incremented.

question_1718.question: What message is sent to a device in response to an access request on the RACH on TS0 using Access Burst (AB) or Normal Burst (NB), and includes the uplink resources consisting of a fixed uplink allocation?
question_1718.ground_truth: The AGCH Fixed Uplink Allocation Assignment message

question_1719.question: What entity sends a PIN services de-registration response containing the status of the de-registration request?

question_1720.question: What is the condition for a UE to consider an NB-IoT neighbour cell in cell reselection?
question_1720.ground_truth: The UE shall not consider a NB-IoT neighbour cell in cell reselection, if it is indicated as not allowed in the measurement control system information of the serving NB-IoT cell.

question_1721.question: What is the video pull service in the MCVideo system?
question_1721.ground_truth: The video pull service in the MCVideo system is a service that allows users to request another user to transmit a video stored or directly taken from the camera. This is initiated by an MCVideo user, who can be a dispatcher, and can be transmitted to the requester, another authorized party, or both.

question_1722.question: What is the purpose of duplicating and sending the Application Context from the S-EAS to the T-EAS in service continuity planning?
question_1722.ground_truth: The purpose is to synchronize the Application Contexts in S-EAS and T-EAS when the Application Context is updated until the AC connects to the T-EAS.

question_1723.question: What is the recommended approach for testing the terminal in the testing setup described?
question_1723.ground_truth: The recommended way for testing is to connect the terminal to the system simulator with exact defined settings and access points. The test sequences are fed in either electrically using a reference codec, using the direct signal processing approach, or acoustically using ITU-T specified devices.

question_1724.question: How does the primary PCF update the policy counter when a UE is deregistered?
question_1724.ground_truth: During the AM policy association termination procedure, for each S-NSSAI the PCF instance of the deregistered UE decreases the policy counter value of a given S-NSSAI by one.

question_1727.question: What is the primary objective of the characterization process between AV1 and H.264/AVC?
question_1727.ground_truth: The characterization process aims to provide a substantive overlap of rate distortion curves for AV1 and H.264/AVC, which would enable accurate estimation of BD rate gain for codec comparison.

question_1728.question: How are the RTP retransmission payload format multiplexing schemes used in PSS servers?
question_1728.ground_truth: PSS servers shall use SSRC-multiplexing and shall not use session-multiplexing.

question_1729.question: What action must the UE take upon receipt of a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message with the 5GSM cause value #39 "reactivation requested" and the PDU session is being transferred from EPS to 5GS and established with the request type set to "existing PDU session"?
question_1729.ground_truth: The UE should re-initiate the UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure for the PDU session type associated with the transferred PDU session, the SSC mode associated with the transferred PDU session, the DNN associated with the transferred PDU session, and the S-NSSAI associated with (if available in roaming scenarios) a mapped S-NSSAI if provided in the UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure of the transferred PDU session.

question_1730.question: How does time-dilated UMTS affect on-time percentage during idle time?
question_1730.ground_truth: During idle time, time-dilated UMTS sees an increase in on-time percentage compared to legacy UMTS.

question_1731.question: What bits of the E-UTRAN <M-TMSI> are mapped into bit 29 and down to bit 24 of the GERAN/UTRAN <P-TMSI> when mapping the GUTI in the UE?
question_1731.ground_truth: 6 bits of the E-UTRAN <M-TMSI> starting at bit 29 and down to bit 24 are mapped into bit 29 and down to bit 24 of the GERAN/UTRAN <P-TMSI> when mapping the GUTI in the UE.

question_1733.question: What information is included in a Routing Filter?
question_1733.ground_truth: A Routing Filter includes IP header parameter values or ranges used to identify one or more IP flows.

question_1736.question: What is the mean power saving gain provided by the R17 PDCCH monitoring adaptation scheme in the FR2 UL only evaluation, InH, AR UL 1 stream, and high load scenario?
question_1736.ground_truth: The mean power saving gain provided is 46.21%.

question_1737.question: What is the action taken by the BTS for timing advance estimation when an access burst transmission is detected on RACH, PRACH, or one or a sequence of access burst(s) on EC-RACH?
question_1737.ground_truth: The BTS measures the delay of the signal relative to the expected signal from an MS at zero distance under static channel conditions, rounds it to the nearest normal symbol period, and includes it in its response.

question_1738.question: What should be stored as the default public user identity upon receiving a 200 (OK) response to a REGISTER request?
question_1738.ground_truth: The first URI on the list of URIs present in the P-Associated-URI header field should be stored as the default public user identity and bound to the respective contact address of the UE and the associated set of security associations or TLS session.

question_1739.question: When should a UE replace any stored pending NSSAI with the pending NSSAI received in the registered PLMN?
question_1739.ground_truth: A UE should replace any stored pending NSSAI with the pending NSSAI received in the registered PLMN when the registration area contains TAIs belonging to different PLMNs, which are equivalent PLMNs, for each of the equivalent PLMNs.

question_1741.question: What is the purpose of sending the PMK key to the Trusted WLAN Access Point?
question_1741.ground_truth: The PMK key is used to secure the WLAN air-interface communication between the Trusted WLAN Access Point and the TWIF.

question_1743.question: In which step does the SAS request the OTDOA positioning method and may also request the UE Rx-Tx timing difference or UE timing advance?
question_1743.ground_truth: The SAS requests the OTDOA positioning method and may also request the UE Rx-Tx timing difference (FDD only) or UE timing advance (1.28 Mcps TDD) in step 3.

question_1744.question: What form does the Small Data Rate Control information take?
question_1744.ground_truth: The Small Data Rate Control information is in the form of an integer 'number of packets per time unit' and an integer 'number of additional allowed exception report packets per time unit' for both uplink and downlink.

question_1745.question: What is Reflective QoS in the context of 5G?
question_1745.ground_truth: Reflective QoS is a feature that enables the UE to map uplink user plane traffic to QoS Flows without SMF provided QoS rules, by creating UE derived QoS rules in the UE based on the received downlink traffic.

question_1747.question: What should the UE do if barring is alleviated for Access Category 8 or 2?
question_1747.ground_truth: The UE should perform the actions specified in clause 5.3.13.8.

question_1748.question: Which method is used to send an LCS event notify to the NF Service Consumer in the 6.4.5.2.3 section?
question_1748.ground_truth: The "POST" method is used to send an LCS event notify to the NF Service Consumer in the 6.4.5.2.3 section.

question_1749.question: What is the role of the OMA "XML Document Management Architecture" in the TS?
question_1749.ground_truth: The OMA "XML Document Management Architecture" is used in conjunction with the TS to provide the specifications for the stage 2 of the XML document management capability for NGNs.

question_1750.question: What is the role of the Data Session Manager in the OSA API Mapping?
question_1750.ground_truth: The Data Session Manager provides management functions to the data session service capability features in the OSA API Mapping. It allows the application programmer to enable or disable data session-related event notifications.

question_1751.question: What will the IWF do if the in-progress emergency group call timer (TNG2) expires for an MCPTT group?
question_1751.ground_truth: The IWF will set the in-progress emergency state of the group to "false", generate a SIP re-INVITE request or SIP MESSAGE request for each participating and affiliated but non-participating member of the group, and include the public service identity and ICSI value in the SIP MESSAGE request sent towards the MCPTT client.

question_1752.question: What is the duration defined as Dhandover in the context of inter-RAT handover from UTRAN FDD to E-UTRAN FDD?
question_1752.ground_truth: Dhandover equals the maximum RRC procedure delay defined plus the interruption time stated in section 5.4a.2.2.

question_1753.question: What should the TPC command error ratio level be at when the UE is detecting a loss of signal on Layer 1?
question_1753.ground_truth: The threshold Qout should correspond to a level of DPCCH quality where no reliable detection of the TPC commands transmitted on the downlink DPCCH can be made, which can be at a TPC command error ratio level of e.g. 30%.

question_1754.question: How is the estimated energy consumption of a VNF instance calculated?
question_1754.ground_truth: The estimated energy consumption of a VNF instance is equal to the estimated energy consumption of the virtual compute resource on which it runs.

question_1755.question: What must the user or application do if they accept the FD request and the FD signalling payload message contains an existing Conversation ID, and it contains an InReplyTo message ID?
question_1755.ground_truth: They must associate the message to an existing message in the conversation thread as identified by the InReplyTo message ID in the FD signalling payload, and use the Message ID in the FD signalling payload to identify the new message.

question_1757.question: What is the minimum requirement for the transmitter OFF power spectral density for BS type 1-C?
question_1757.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for the transmitter OFF power spectral density for BS type 1-C is less than -85 dBm/MHz per antenna connector.

question_1758.question: What is the condition that needs to be satisfied before the partner MCPTT server stores the new affiliation status of the target MCPTT user for the MCPTT group(s)?
question_1758.ground_truth: The target MCPTT user must be authorized to affiliate or de-affiliate to the MCPTT group(s) and the requested affiliation status must be different to the current affiliation status.

question_1759.question: What is the difference between UE-controlled mode and NW-controlled mode in IP flow mobility?
question_1759.ground_truth: UE-controlled mode allows only the UE to initiate IP flow mobility while NW-controlled mode allows only the network to initiate IP flow mobility.

question_1760.question: What are the potential post-conditions for stopping Assured Voice Communication (AVC)?
question_1760.ground_truth: The post-conditions are that the FRMCS User is no longer part of a voice communication with one or more FRMCS Users (automatic stopping) or the FRMCS User is still part of a voice communication with one or more FRMCS Users (manual stopping).

question_1761.question: What security feature is considered in Solution 4 for the RN platform to protect from unauthorized parties?
question_1761.ground_truth: Solution 4 requires platform integrity and device authentication as part of the start-up procedure.

question_1762.question: What is the responsibility of the Hosting RAN in sharing PWS messages?
question_1762.ground_truth: The Hosting RAN shall be able to broadcast PWS messages originated from the core networks of all Participating Operators.

question_1764.question: What is one solution for group discovery/management to support on demand-based group communication for commercial services?
question_1764.ground_truth: Solution #4, #22, #37, and #39 describe ways to carry out group discovery/formation/management for on demand-based group communication for commercial services in the Application Layer.

question_1765.question: What information can be indicated through Quasi-Colocation (QCL) in UE-side beamforming/receiving procedure for data reception?
question_1765.ground_truth: Information related to the User Equipment (UE) beamforming/receiving procedure used for data reception can be indicated through QCL to UE.

question_1766.question: What message does the UE transmit after receiving a MEASUREMENT CONTROL message in step 7?
question_1766.ground_truth: The UE transmits a MEASUREMENT REPORT message containing the IE "UE positioning GPS measured results" and/or "UE positioning GANSS measured results".

question_1767.question: Where can NWDAF instance(s) be collocated?
question_1767.ground_truth: NWDAF instance(s) can be collocated with a 5GS NF.

question_1770.question: What are the two mandatory elements the GGSN must collect for A interface related charging information for MSs and/or individual PDP contexts in a GPRS network?
question_1770.ground_truth: The two mandatory elements the GGSN must collect for A interface related charging information are destination and source (with a level of accuracy as defined by the GPRS operator) and usage of the packet data networks (amount of data sent and received to and from the packet data network).

question_1771.question: What is the message that the MCVideo client in the UE sends to the MCVideo server, over SIP, if the user is authorized for full MCVideo services?
question_1771.ground_truth: The MCVideo server sends an acknowledgement back to the MCVideo client after validating the access token.

question_1773.question: What is the expected behavior of the UE during the period from time point A to time point D?
question_1773.ground_truth: The UE is expected to decode the uplink grant and switch to uplink to complete the corresponding uplink transmission during this period.

question_1774.question: What is the function of the TSCTSF in the notification procedures for burst timing preference signalling?
question_1774.ground_truth: The TSCTSF derives exact BAT from the BAW, includes BAT to the NEF, and provides the updated BAT value as part of TSC Assistance container to the SMF.

question_1776.question: What is the impact of the use of a too short timer for the more preferred PLMN search on the network?
question_1776.ground_truth: A too short timer for the more preferred PLMN search can prevent the failed network from recovering and can impose more load on the local competing networks.

question_1777.question: What is the target for the NB M2M solution in terms of battery life?
question_1777.ground_truth: The target is to achieve good energy efficiency while being compatible with the battery technologies appropriate for low cost IoT products.

question_1779.question: What is the level of the interfering signals sent during the test, relative to the level of the PDTCH?
question_1779.ground_truth: The interfering signals are sent at a level 20.5 dB below the level of the PDTCH.

question_1781.question: What does the FRMCS System do if a mobile FRMCS User is already active in another railway emergency alert and a new one is initiated?
question_1781.ground_truth: The FRMCS System does not forward new alerts to this particular FRMCS User. A waiting alert is sent as soon as the FRMCS User is no longer involved in an ongoing railway emergency alert.

question_1782.question: What is the measurement reporting delay defined as in the context of a user equipment (UE) transmitting measurement reports in an LTE system?
question_1782.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between the point when UE receives an ECID-RequestLocationInformation message and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface, excluding certain delays such as those caused by other RRC signaling, no UL resources, RRC connection release, or signaling connection with the MME.

question_1783.question: What message does the source gNB send to the target gNB upon reception of the PATH SWITCH REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message from the AMF to inform the success of the handover?
question_1783.ground_truth: The source gNB sends a UE CONTEXT RELEASE message to the target gNB to inform the success of the handover upon reception of the PATH SWITCH REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message from the AMF.

question_1784.question: In the scenario where a FRMCS User is receiving an invitation to a voice communication, what must be true about the invited FRMCS User in terms of their vocal communication status?
question_1784.ground_truth: The invited FRMCS User may or may not be involved in voice communication.

question_1785.question: Which Diameter application provides a Diameter application to support the transport of EAP over Diameter?

question_1787.question: How many unique Bradian Room Impulse Responses (BRIRs) were measured in total?
question_1787.ground_truth: 28 unique BRIRs were measured in total.

question_1788.question: Which functional entities are grouped in the GERAN LCS that use the various LCS components to provide the target MS Location Information to the internal LCS client?
question_1788.ground_truth: The GERAN LCS functional entities can be grouped into the Internal Client group, the GERAN System Handling group, and the Positioning group.

question_1790.question: What is the purpose of step 6 in procedure 5.5.1.7, regarding PDN GW initiated Resource Allocation Deactivation?
question_1790.ground_truth: Step 6 in procedure 5.5.1.7 is for informing the AAA Server/HSS to remove the PDN GW identity information and APN corresponding to the UE's PDN Connection, if the resources corresponding to the PDN connection are released in PDN GW.

question_1791.question: What is the influence of Carrier leakage in the transmit modulation quality requirements for inter-band CA?
question_1791.ground_truth: In case the parameter 3300 or 3301 is reported from UE via txDirectCurrentLocation IE, the carrier leakage measurement requirement in clause 6.4F.2.2 and 6.4F.2.3 shall be waived, and the RF correction with regard to the carrier leakage and IQ image shall be omitted during the calculation of transmit modulation quality.

question_1793.question: What is the purpose of application data in the context of interactive sequences?
question_1793.ground_truth: Application data pertains to the description of scene information for an interactive sequence and may include display icons, layout information, or overlaid text on interactivity media.

question_1794.question: How does a client NWDAF participate in Horizontal Federated Learning?
question_1794.ground_truth: A client NWDAF participates in Horizontal Federated Learning by locally training the local ML model with its own data and sharing it to the coordinator NWDAF. The coordinator NWDAF aggregates the local ML models into a global or optimal ML model or ML model parameters and sends them back to the client NWDAF.

question_1795.question: Which subclause of the IOC applies to the data types "NsacfCapability", "NwdafInfo", "NwdafCapability", "MlAnalyticsInfo", "PlmnIdNid", "SeppInfo", "UdsfInfo", "SmsfInfo", and "PlmnRange" in the context described in the document?

question_1797.question: What must the H-GMLC do when a smaller number of reports was requested in a location request and periodic reporting from the RAN was completed?
question_1797.ground_truth: The target UE would be responsible for reissuing further MO-LR requests, after periodic reporting from the RAN was completed, until the overall number of reports was attained.

question_1800.question: What is the reference power for relative measurements in the non-multicarrier BTS class?
question_1800.ground_truth: The reference power for relative measurements in the non-multicarrier BTS class is the power measured in a bandwidth of at least 300 kHz for the TRX under test.

question_1801.question: What should be provisioned to UEs supporting both EPC NAS and 5GC NAS for V2X communications?
question_1801.ground_truth: Radio parameters for PC5 communication and service parameters for V2X services that could differ depending on whether they are accessed via EPS or 5GS should be provisioned to the UEs supporting both EPC NAS and 5GC NAS for V2X communications.

question_1802.question: Which 3GPP RAN1 specification sections are impacted by the CZ-UMTS time dilation solution?
question_1802.ground_truth: The sections of TS 25.201, TS 25.213, and TS 25.214 are impacted by the CZ-UMTS time dilation solution.

question_1803.question: What is the purpose of the pending requests method in ACM procedures, as specified in section 10.17.3.1?
question_1803.ground_truth: The pending requests method provides a means to manage and respond to incoming requests manually, enabling the ACM server to forward incoming requests to authorized users.

question_1804.question: What is the purpose of the "start of interception with active bearer" event?
question_1804.ground_truth: The "start of interception with active bearer" event is used to send interception events for active bearers of a targeted user.

question_1805.question: What is the scope of the TR on evaluation of path-loss technologies for 3GPP Location Services (LCS)?
question_1805.ground_truth: The scope of the TR is to evaluate individual technology groups, such as RF pattern matching, RSSI Trilateration technologies, and Enhanced Cell-ID technologies, independently as Annexes to the TR.

question_1807.question: Which AVPs are not applicable for the S9 reference point?
question_1807.ground_truth: 3GPP-RAT-Type AVP, QoS-Rule-Base-Name AVP and TDF-Information AVP are not applicable for the S9 reference point.

question_1809.question: What does the Notification IRP: CORBA SS define in relation to the FileTransferIRP?
question_1809.ground_truth: The Notification IRP: CORBA SS defines the notifications' semantics and syntax, as well as the mapping of notifications to OMG CORBA structured event equivalents.

question_1810.question: What action does the PGW-C include in the "Network Requested Secondary PDP Context Activation Procedure" when sending a request to the PGW-U?
question_1810.ground_truth: The PGW-C includes the F-TEIDu of the activated bearer received from the SGW in the "Network Requested Secondary PDP Context Activation Procedure" when sending a request to the PGW-U.

question_1811.question: What should the UE not do when timer T3585 is running and it is in the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state?
question_1811.ground_truth: The UE should not send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message or PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message until the timer T3585 expires or it is stopped.

question_1812.question: What is the difference between Transcoder Free Operation (TrFO) and Tandem Free Operation (TFO)?
question_1812.ground_truth: Transcoder Free Operation (TrFO) transports speech signals in the coded domain from one user equipment (UE) to the other user equipment through the radio access network (RAN) and core network (CN), possibly through a transit network (TN), while TFO enables similar advantages, but is based on pure inband signalling after call setup.

question_1815.question: In the world of mobile communications, what does "MAC" often refer to?

question_1816.question: What message is sent by the source GANC to the SGSN during the execution phase of a PS handover within the same SGSN?
question_1816.ground_truth: The PS Handover Required Acknowledge message is sent by the SGSN to the source GANC during the execution phase of a PS handover within the same SGSN, containing the Old TLLI, List of Set Up PFCs, and Target BSS to Source BSS Transparent Container (RN part).

question_1817.question: What is the role of VAS AS in the signalling procedure for originating VAS?
question_1817.ground_truth: The VAS AS indicates to the SMS Node A whether the originating VAS is active and performs originating VAS for the original user by generating a new short message if necessary.

question_1819.question: What is the length of the PLMN List information element content?
question_1819.ground_truth: The PLMN List information element content is a type 4 information element with a minimum length of 5 octets and a maximum length of 47 octets.

question_1821.question: What security issue does KI#3 in TR 23.786 address for eV2X groupcast communications?
question_1821.ground_truth: KI#3 in TR 23.786 addresses the support of groupcast for sensor sharing over PC5 and preventing privacy issues related to long duration groupcast session, e.g. source L2 ID tracking.

question_1822.question: What is the function of the IWF performing the participating role in generating an SDS message?
question_1822.ground_truth: The IWF performing the participating role is responsible for generating an SDS SIGNALLING PAYLOAD message and a DATA PAYLOAD message, including them in specific MIME bodies in a SIP request.

question_1824.question: How is an EP triggered in the 3GPP TS 36.468 specification?
question_1824.ground_truth: An EP is triggered by the transmission of a message from one unit (HNB or HNB-GW) to the other.

question_1825.question: What changes are required over the S11 and X2 interfaces to support user plane relocation during the handover procedures?
question_1825.ground_truth: The changes include providing new S1-U and S5-U identities of the Serving GW user plane to the MME, PGW, and eNB during the X2-based and S1-based handover procedures, with and without Serving GW control plane relocation.

question_1827.question: What is the role of the "Default bearer" RG in Solution 4?
question_1827.ground_truth: The "Default bearer" RG in Solution 4 is applicable to all services using the default bearer, and it is one of the well-known RG values defined by GSMA. It is used for services determined as authorized for using the default bearer.

question_1829.question: What is one of the requirements during the test described in 6.6.2.12.4.2?
question_1829.ground_truth: During the test, the UE shall not have any timing information of NR cell 2 during time duration T1.

question_1830.question: What message is used by the MS to send the location measurements or estimate to the SMLC?
question_1830.ground_truth: The Measure Position Response component is used by the MS to send the location measurements or estimate to the SMLC.

question_1831.question: What is the role of the 2G/3G MME/UPE in the 3GPP access system?
question_1831.ground_truth: The 2G/3G MME/UPE is responsible for selecting a SAE MME/UPE serving the Evolved RAN nodes that the UE will be using in the target Evolved RAN.

question_1832.question: In the LBO roaming scenarios, who does the V-PCF for the PDU Session contact first in step 1?
question_1832.ground_truth: The V-PCF for the PDU Session contacts the V-PCF for the UE first in step 1.

question_1833.question: When do early pass/fail decisions become obsolete while testing the adjacent channel interference performance?
question_1833.ground_truth: Early pass/fail decisions are obsolete when the minimum test time due to multipath conditions exceeds the target test time during testing under multipath and interference conditions.

question_1834.question: What is the minimum test time due to multipath conditions that needs to be considered before limit checking is valid?
question_1834.ground_truth: The minimum test time due to multipath conditions that needs to be considered before limit checking is valid is the time required to cross 990 wavelengths with the speed given in the fading profile.

question_1835.question: What condition should be met to test the Directed Retry procedure in a mobile originated call?
question_1835.ground_truth: The MS should correctly apply the Directed Retry procedure from SDCCH/8 or SDCCH/4 to TCH/F or TCH/H with or without frequency hopping in the non-synchronized case during call establishment.

question_1836.question: In which specification is the usage of the Enhanced Coverage Restricted parameter at the AS layer defined?
question_1836.ground_truth: The usage of the Enhanced Coverage Restricted parameter at the AS layer is defined in the RAN specification.

question_1837.question: What should a Sidelink process do when the Sidelink HARQ Entity requests a new transmission for sidelink communication?
question_1837.ground_truth: When the Sidelink HARQ Entity requests a new transmission, the Sidelink process should store the MAC PDU in the associated HARQ buffer, store the sidelink grant received from the Sidelink HARQ Entity, and generate a transmission as described.

question_1838.question: What is the definition of "absolute accuracy of RSRP" in the context of 3GPP TS 36.133?
question_1838.ground_truth: The "absolute accuracy of RSRP" is the RSRP measured from a cell that has different carrier frequency from the serving cell.

question_1839.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon receiving a request to release an MCVideo emergency group call with the state set to "MVEGC 2: emergency-call-requested"?
question_1839.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should set the MCVideo emergency group call state to "MVEGC 1: emergency-gc-capable", if the MCVideo client emergency group state of the group is "MVEG 3: confirm-pending", it should set the MCVideo client emergency group state of the group to "MVEG 1: no-emergency", and if the MCVideo emergency alert state is set to "MVEA 2: emergency-alert-confirm-pending", it should set the MCVideo emergency alert state to "MVEA 1: no-alert".

question_1841.question: In which network topology cases should the HSS provide IRI-POI functions?
question_1841.ground_truth: The HSS should provide IRI-POI functions in the non-roaming case and in the roaming case when the UE is in the home PLMN.

question_1843.question: What is the input to the Hash function during the signature verification process?
question_1843.ground_truth: The input to the Hash function during the signature verification process is the concatenation of MAC and M.

question_1844.question: What is the role of the PGW/GGSN in the roaming scenarios when either the VPLMN or the HPLMN does not support the HSS based P-CSCF restoration mechanism?
question_1844.ground_truth: The PGW/GGSN, depending on operator policy, may apply no P-CSCF restoration mechanism, or another existing mechanism like the "Update PDP context/bearer at P-CSCF failure" mechanism.

question_1845.question: What should be the relationship between the resolution bandwidth and measurement bandwidth in a measurement setting for accurate results?
question_1845.ground_truth: To improve accuracy, sensitivity, and efficiency, the resolution bandwidth should be smaller than the measurement bandwidth, with the result integrated over the measurement bandwidth to obtain the equivalent noise bandwidth.

question_1846.question: What is the maximum delay recommended by ITU-T Recommendation G.114 for a circuit delay in ideal conditions?

question_1848.question: When does a UE have to renew its ProSe Identity before the expiration time is reached in the described solution?
question_1848.ground_truth: A UE is required to send a renew request message with the permanent identity in the application layer to the authorized network node as long as the UE is active in ProSe services before the expiration time assigned to the currently valid ProSe Identity is reached.

question_1850.question: What is the purpose of the measurement "Wideband CQI distribution"?
question_1850.ground_truth: This measurement provides the distribution of Wideband CQI (Channel Quality Indicator) reported by UEs in the cell. This measurement is obtained by incrementing the appropriate measurement bin when a wideband CQI value is reported by a UE in the cell.

question_1853.question: What should a UE do when all target TCI states in the active TCI state list are unknown?
question_1853.ground_truth: When all target TCI states in the active TCI state list are unknown, the requirements specified in this clause are not applicable.

question_1855.question: What is the format of the Reason Code field in the MCPTT pre-session messaging?
question_1855.ground_truth: The Reason Code field in the MCPTT pre-session messaging is a 16-bit binary value indicating the reason for accepting, rejecting, or disconnecting from a pre-established MCPTT call.

question_1856.question: What is the requirement for the test in terms of total successful tests and confidence level for it to pass?
question_1856.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests shall be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

question_1858.question: What is one advantage of using GBA-Push over TS 33.220 for public key distribution?
question_1858.ground_truth: One advantage of using GBA-Push over TS 33.220 for public key distribution is that it reduces the amount of traffic over the access network as the GBA procedures are sent only in the core network.

question_1859.question: What is the significance of entering the UE into loopback test mode?
question_1859.ground_truth: Entering the UE into loopback test mode allows for the testing and measurement of the UE's internal operations and performance.

question_1861.question: What is the maximum allowed delay for the first report in event triggered periodic measurement reporting as specified in clause~8.6.3.1.2.1.1.3?
question_1861.ground_truth: The UE shall not send any event triggered measurement reports, as long as no reporting criteria are fulfilled. The first report in event triggered periodic measurement reporting shall meet the requirements specified in clause~8.6.3.1.2.1.1.3.

question_1862.question: What does the 9.2.2.131a IE define in the context of GANSS?
question_1862.ground_truth: This IE defines multiple signals within a particular GANSS.

question_1865.question: What is the default behavior of the floor control server when receiving the first unconfirmed indication from the invited participating MCPTT function?
question_1865.ground_truth: The floor control server optionally gives an early indication to send RTP media packets to the inviting MCPTT client and buffers RTP media packets received from the MCPTT client at least until the first invited MCPTT client accepts the invitation.

question_1866.question: What potential threats do flexible and low-cost security monitoring agents pose in a virtualized environment, and how can they be mitigated?
question_1866.ground_truth: Without appropriate protection, an attacker may be able to identify multiple logical locations within NFVI, correlate signaling, and take action based on this information, potentially exposing user privacy. To mitigate these threats, solutions should increase assurance that virtualized 3GPP NFs are protected from distributed monitoring attacks and dynamically assign VNF resources to prevent long-term data leakage and exposure.

question_1867.question: What should the P-CSCF do when no signalling plane security mechanism is selected from the Security-Client header field?
question_1867.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall continue with the procedures described in the remainder of the subclause, including the GPRS-IMS-Bundled authentication procedures, performing NASS-IMS bundled authentication (if the P-CSCF supports both SIP digest and NASS-IMS bundled authentication), following the SIP digest without TLS procedures, or following the IMS-AKA procedures for eP-CSCF (if the REGISTER request is received by eP-CSCF over TLS and contains an Authorization header field with an "algorithm" header field parameter set to "AKAv2-SHA-256").

question_1868.question: What action should the MCData client take after determining that the payload contained in the FD SIGNALLING PAYLOAD message is not for user consumption?
question_1868.ground_truth: The MCData client shall determine that the payload contained in the Payload IE in the FD SIGNALLING PAYLOAD message is not for user consumption and notify the application of the incoming FD request if the Application ID value is known.

question_1870.question: What is the difference between an sNB and a gNB?
question_1870.ground_truth: Although some functions may be common between an sNB and a gNB, an sNB is not the same as a gNB. A gNB might be enhanced to also act as an sNB.

question_1871.question: What is the purpose of the 3D video created from post-processed videos received from UEs?
question_1871.ground_truth: The 3D video can be used for analysis in various scenarios, such as sharing the video with end-users in a car race, or evaluation of possible accidents by law enforcement.

question_1873.question: In the Session Breakout scenario, what is the simple solution to keep EC traffic to 3GPP access for UL-CL that is reachable only through that access?
question_1873.ground_truth: One solution is to set the Access Type Preference to "3GPP" in the corresponding URSP rule for this PDU Session and use WIFI offload for other non-EC traffic.

question_1876.question: What is the expected HTTP status code when the UAE Server is not able to delete an existing USS Change Policy?
question_1876.ground_truth: The expected HTTP status code when the UAE Server is not able to delete an existing USS Change Policy is an appropriate HTTP status code indicating the error in the HTTP DELETE response body.

question_1877.question: What is the transport protocol used for EPC-level ProSe discovery messages over the PC3 interface?
question_1877.ground_truth: The UE and the ProSe Function use HTTP~1.1 as the transport protocol.

question_1879.question: What information is included in the NG-RAN's shared delivery establishment response for a location dependent MBS session?
question_1879.ground_truth: The NG-RAN's shared delivery establishment response includes MBS service areas and Area Session IDs associated with the same MBS session.

question_1880.question: What should a TWAN do when it receives a GTP error indication for a non-default bearer from a PGW?
question_1880.ground_truth: The TWAN should delete its bearer context and may notify the Operation and Maintenance network element.

question_1881.question: What is the method used by the UE to signal the Routing Rules to the PDN GW to update the routing rules via NAS and GTPv2 procedures in 3GPP access?
question_1881.ground_truth: The UE sends a Request Bearer Resource Modification message, which includes the Routing Rules requested by the UE to the MME in 3GPP access.

question_1882.question: How does the UE retrieve the list of Emergency Call Numbers from a WLAN AP?
question_1882.ground_truth: The UE may retrieve from a WLAN AP the list of Emergency Call Numbers that are used in the geographic location of the AP via ANQP procedures prior or after association with the AP.

question_1884.question: What is the protocol used for the Rx reference point interface?
question_1884.ground_truth: The Rx reference point interface is based on RESTful HTTP and XML.

question_1886.question: How are the UMTS cipher/integrity keys CK and IK derived in case of a handover from a GSM BSS to UTRAN with a GSM security context?
question_1886.ground_truth: The UMTS cipher/integrity keys CK and IK are derived from the 64-bit GSM cipher key Kc using the conversion functions c4 and c5.

question_1887.question: What are the possible categories of a UE for E-DPDCH in the "Physical Layer category" section for the stand-alone E-DCH and HS-DSCH with QPSK and 16QAM and the stand-alone HS-DSCH with QPSK and 16QAM?
question_1887.ground_truth: The possible categories of a UE for E-DPDCH in the "Physical Layer category" section for the stand-alone E-DCH and HS-DSCH with QPSK and 16QAM and the stand-alone HS-DSCH with QPSK and 16QAM are categories 5, 6, 7, 8, and 9.

question_1888.question: What protocols can be used for in-band call control in certain scenarios in media production workflows?
question_1888.ground_truth: The use of SIP or NMOS may be convenient for in-band call control in certain scenarios, such as remote production contribution links.

question_1889.question: What happens in step 7 of the forward relocation procedure towards the source eNodeB during the data forwarding execution phase?
question_1889.ground_truth: The source MME sends the message Handover Command to the Source eNodeB, and the Source eNodeB initiates data forwarding for the bearers specified in the "Bearers Subject to Data Forwarding List" to the target SGSN or via the Serving GW based on the source MME and/or target SGSN's decision.

question_1892.question: Which cleartext IEs should be included in the initial NAS message when sending a REGISTRATION REQUEST message?
question_1892.ground_truth: The cleartext IEs include Extended protocol discriminator, Security header type, Spare half octet, Registration request message identity, 5GS registration type, ngKSI, 5GS mobile identity, UE security capability, Additional GUTI, UE status, and EPS NAS message container.

question_1893.question: What should the Node B do if the Delayed Activation Update IE is included in the RADIO LINK ACTIVATION COMMAND message and indicates "Activate", and the First RLS Indicator IE is not included?
question_1893.ground_truth: The Node B should initiate the Error Indication procedure.

question_1894.question: What is the function of the BCAST Service Distribution/Adaptation logical entity in OMA's BCAST architecture?
question_1894.ground_truth: The BCAST Service Distribution/Adaptation logical entity is responsible for the aggregation and delivery of BCAST Services, and performs the adaptation of the BCAST Enabler to underlying Broadcast Distribution Systems. It provides the functionality of File and Stream Distribution, Service Aggregation, Service Protection, Service Guide generation and delivery, Notification Delivery, and the adaptation to the underlying BDS.

question_1895.question: What does the NSSMF do in the post-condition of Network Slice Subnet Instance performance management?
question_1895.ground_truth: The NSSMF creates a performance management job for the constituent parts of the NSSI to enable collection of the performance data for an NSSI, collecting and providing the performance data to the NSMF.

question_1896.question: What type of functions are the 5GMSu AF and 5GMSu AS in the context of 5G uplink media streaming?
question_1896.ground_truth: The 5GMSu AF is an Application Function dedicated to 5G uplink media streaming, while the 5GMSu AS is an Application Server dedicated to 5G uplink media streaming.

question_1897.question: When can Core Network type restriction be applied for a UE?
question_1897.ground_truth: The Core Network type restriction can be applied for a UE to connect to 5GC only, EPC only, or both 5GC and EPC for a PLMN. This applies to both 3GPP and non-3GPP Access Types.

question_1898.question: What is the role of the MTSI MGW in packet size considerations?
question_1898.ground_truth: The MTSI MGW is responsible for indicating the maximum SDU size of the application data that can be transmitted without segmentation, and for determining the specific maximum SDU size limit through the maximumAl2SDUSize and maximumAl3SDUSize fields of the H223Capability member in H.245 TerminalCapabilitySet message.

question_1899.question: What should the UE do if the access attempt is considered as barred and timer T302 is not running?
question_1899.ground_truth: The UE shall inform upper layers that the access attempt for the Access Category is barred.

question_1901.question: What is the purpose of the "Retrieve" operation in AKMA API?
question_1901.ground_truth: The purpose of the "Retrieve" operation in AKMA API is to allow a service consumer to retrieve AKMA application key information via the NEF.

question_1902.question: Which attribute is used to describe the maximum number of terminals that can use the network slice simultaneously?
question_1902.ground_truth: The "Number of terminals" attribute describes the maximum number of terminals that can use the network slice simultaneously.

question_1903.question: What happens if the UE receives a response indicating that the MO-LR request for periodic location transfer to a third party cannot be supported?
question_1903.ground_truth: The UE may periodically initiate the MO-LR request until it is accepted, or follow other instructions in the response.

question_1904.question: What is the mobile communication infrastructure requirement for bulk transfer of CCTV archives from train to ground in 7.2.2.2?
question_1904.ground_truth: The mobile communication infrastructure should enable transfer of CCTV archives from train to the ground system while the train stops at the stations.

question_1905.question: In the 'G: Initialising' state, what must the floor control arbitration logic do upon receiving a floor request (R: mcptt-floor-request) from a constituent MCPTT group?
question_1905.ground_truth: The floor control arbitration logic must cache the mcptt-floor-request and remain in the 'G: Initialising' state.

question_1906.question: In the context of the measurement reporting procedure, what should be done if the trigger type is set to event and the event's entry condition is fulfilled for one or more applicable cells not included in the cellsTriggeredList for all measurements after layer 3 filtering?
question_1906.ground_truth: Set the numberOfReportsSent to 0, include the concerned cells in the cellsTriggeredList within the VarMeasReportList for this measId, and initiate the measurement reporting procedure as specified in 5.5.5.

question_1908.question: What does the "OK~" indicate after the AT+CDU command is executed?

question_1912.question: What is the role of the S-CSCF in the initial filter criteria of a 3GPP network?
question_1912.ground_truth: The S-CSCF interacts with the associated application server based on the initial filter criteria, starting from the filter criteria with the highest priority.

question_1913.question: What is one of the responsibilities of the 5G system with regard to C2 communication?
question_1913.ground_truth: The 5G system is responsible for provisioning required QoS, priority, and ensuring reliability for one or more C2 communication sessions between the UAV and UAV controller.

question_1914.question: What is the condition for a UE to complete the DL and UL TCI state switch as specified in clause 8.21.5?
question_1914.ground_truth: A UE is expected to complete the DL and UL TCI state switch before receiving on DL based on the target TCI state.

question_1916.question: What aspects should be considered in alignment with 3GPP TS 23.247 when including solutions that reflect the life cycle of broadcast and multicast MBS sessions?
question_1916.ground_truth: The aspects to be considered include broadcast and multicast MBS sessions being identified via MBS session ID, utilizing the MBS session mode information element, providing common procedures for broadcast and multicast MBS sessions, and including procedures for established multicast MBS sessions with state transitions.

question_1917.question: What is the procedure for the case when the UE registers with a VPLMN AMF?
question_1917.ground_truth: The UE initiates registration by sending a REGISTRATION REQUEST message to the VPLMN AMF, and the VPLMN AMF initiates the authentication procedure. The HPLMN UDM sends the list of preferred PLMN/access technology combinations to the HPLMN AUSF, which sends the protected list to the VPLMN AMF. The VPLMN AMF transparently sends the list to the UE in the NAS AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message. If the UE successfully authenticates the network, it checks the indication to determine whether the list of preferred PLMN/access technology combinations was provided, performs a security check on the received list, and proceeds accordingly.

question_1919.question: What is an example of a DN in string representation?
question_1919.ground_truth: An example of a DN in string representation is "DC=com,DC=CompanyXYZ,DC=marketing,IRPAgent=ATMPVCBilling, Log=19990101131000,AccountingRecord=100098".

question_1921.question: What is the action taken by the AF upon successful reception of an updated DNAI Mapping information notification request from the NEF?
question_1921.ground_truth: The AF acknowledges its successful reception by sending a HTTP POST response message with an HTTP "204 No Content" status code.

question_1923.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe Function in the NW to authorize ProSe discovery?
question_1923.ground_truth: The ProSe Function in the NW authorizes the usage of ProSe functionality by the application, and it may store the discoverability preferences of a user per application.

question_1925.question: What is the process used by the UE to determine the preferred PLMN to use for S-NSSAI registration?
question_1925.ground_truth: The UE selects the PLMN ID associated with the S-NSSAI that maximizes the number of S-NSSAIs that the UE can use, or if all S-NSSAIs can be used in a set of PLMNs, the UE selects the common PLMN ID across all the Network-Slice-Aware PLMN list which ranks higher on average.

question_1927.question: What action should a UE take when it receives a DL assignment for its stored G-CS-RNTI in the same slot as the current slot for receiving DL MAC PDU for PTM transmission, with NDI set as 0 and PDCCH content indicates activation?
question_1927.ground_truth: The UE should continue receiving DL MAC PDU in the same slot as the assignment is for the same slot and NDI indicates a new transmission.

question_1928.question: What is the difference between sensitivity in downlink without sub channel specific power control and sensitivity in downlink with subchannel specific power control?
question_1928.ground_truth: Sensitivity in downlink without sub channel specific power control refers to the case where equal power is assigned to the sub channels, while sensitivity in downlink with subchannel specific power control refers to the case where unequal power is assigned to the sub channels for enhancing the signal to noise ratio.

question_1929.question: What is non-contiguous spectrum?
question_1929.ground_truth: Non-contiguous spectrum is a type of spectrum that consists of two or more sub-blocks separated by sub-block gap(s).

question_1930.question: What is a method used to reduce interference in the UL sub-bands in FR1 Wide Area BS?
question_1930.ground_truth: Digital IC is used to reduce interference in the UL sub-bands in FR1 Wide Area BS. It involves capturing and sampling the interference signals in the digital domain, then subtracting the interference at the receiver.

question_1932.question: What is the mandatory and optional CDR format on the Bm interface in MMS?
question_1932.ground_truth: The support of FQPCs is mandatory, the support of RPCs is optional on the Bm interface in MMS.

question_1934.question: What should the UE do if it has not been granted user-plane resources for PDU sessions and receives a request from the upper layers to perform emergency services fallback or establish an emergency PDU session?
question_1934.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3540 and locally release the N1 NAS signalling connection, before proceeding as specified in subclause 5.5.1.

question_1935.question: What is the purpose of modifying the ACL list when X2-Proxy is used in the network?
question_1935.ground_truth: The purpose of modifying the ACL list is to allow the eNBs and HeNBs to properly establish X2 connections with the X2-Proxy, which manages the communication between them.

question_1936.question: What is the method used by the human brain to perceive depth in images using stereoscopy?
question_1936.ground_truth: The human brain perceives depth in images using stereoscopy by interpreting the difference in the angle of a scene that is seen by each eye.

question_1937.question: Which devices are not applicable to the ANDSP policy, V2X Policy, and ProSe Policy in the 3GPP 5G system?
question_1937.ground_truth: 5G-RG, FN-RG, and AUN3 devices are not applicable to the ANDSP policy, V2X Policy, and ProSe Policy in the 3GPP 5G system.

question_1938.question: What is the requirement for the server implementing the bootstrapping function in 3GPP AKA infrastructure?
question_1938.ground_truth: The server implementing the bootstrapping function needs to be trusted by the home operator to handle authentication vectors.

question_1939.question: What must the SeNB do when the SENB ADDITION REQUEST message contains the Correlation ID IE for the concerned E-RAB?
question_1939.ground_truth: The SeNB must use this information for LIPA operation for the concerned E-RAB.

question_1941.question: What is the format of the "protocolIEs" in the "UEContextModificationRefuse" sequence?
question_1941.ground_truth: The "protocolIEs" in the "UEContextModificationRefuse" sequence is a container for "UEContextModificationRefuseIEs" which is a sequence of protocol IEs.

question_1942.question: What is the maximum number of emergency numbers that the user equipment shall be able to store in the Local emergency numbers list and in the Extended local emergency numbers list?
question_1942.ground_truth: The user equipment shall be able to store up to ten entries in the Local emergency numbers list and up to twenty entries in the Extended local emergency numbers list.

question_1943.question: What is the maximum test time for MS in the GSM900 frequency range for the reference sensitivity test?
question_1943.ground_truth: The maximum test time for MS in the GSM900 frequency range for the reference sensitivity test is 23 minutes.

question_1944.question: What should the 5GS do when verifying whether the triggering conditions for the notification about potential change in QoS are met during phase 3?
question_1944.ground_truth: The 5GS verifies whether the triggering conditions for the notification about potential change in QoS are met and sends one or more notifications about potential change in QoS to the AF if so.

question_1946.question: What is the frequency relationship between the unwanted signals and the wanted signal in the intermodulation rejection test?
question_1946.ground_truth: The unwanted signals have a specific frequency relationship to the wanted signal frequency.

question_1949.question: When should the UE seek to update the schedule instance?
question_1949.ground_truth: The UE should seek to update the schedule instance after UTC February 1st at time 00 hour 00 min 00 sec, as indicated by the scheduleUpdate attribute.

question_1950.question: What should the UE first read to determine the modulation order and target code rate for the physical uplink shared channel?
question_1950.ground_truth: The UE should read the 5-bit modulation and coding scheme field in the DCI to determine the modulation order and target code rate based on the procedure defined in Subclause 6.1.4.1.

question_1951.question: What must the controlling MCVideo function do if the in-progress emergency state of the group is set to a value of "true" and this MCVideo user is indicating a new emergency indication?
question_1951.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function shall cache the MCVideo ID of the MCVideo user that has initiated an MCVideo emergency call, check if an alert indication is set to "true" and send a SIP MESSAGE request notification of the MCVideo user's emergency indication to the other affiliated members of the group.

question_1952.question: What signaling flows does the TDF use for session establishment and activation of service detection and policy rules?
question_1952.ground_truth: The TDF uses session establishment and activation of service detection and policy rules described in clause 1.4.3.2.2 of the specified document.

question_1953.question: What is the format of the "scope" information that the front-end stores in its NFProfile?
question_1953.ground_truth: The "scope" information in the NFProfile consists of impacted resource names, partialLastReplicationTime, and partialRecoveryTime.

question_1955.question: What action should the UE take if the received PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-network relay discovery solicitation meets the specified criteria?
question_1955.ground_truth: If the received message is valid, the UE shall generate a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-network relay discovery response. The UE sets the necessary parameters such as Discoveree info, relay service code, resource status indicator, UTC-based counter, and MIC field in the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-network relay discovery response.

question_1956.question: What information is included in the PDU Session Resource Modify Response Transfer IE if any QoS flows have failed to be setup or modified during the PDU Session Resource Modify procedure?
question_1956.ground_truth: The list of QoS flows which have failed to be setup or modified is included in the QoS Flow Failed to Add or Modify List IE of the PDU Session Resource Modify Response Transfer IE.

question_1957.question: What is the function of the MapGroupToSessionStream in the 5G MBS service?
question_1957.ground_truth: The MapGroupToSessionStream is sent from the MC service server to MC service clients to provide specific required information to receive the media related to a group communication within an MBS session. The MC service can either be MCPTT, MCVideo or MCData services.

question_1958.question: When the UE sends any request using a given contact address or to the registration flow in IMS, what information should be included in the Contact header field if the UE indicates privacy of the P-Asserted-Identity?
question_1958.ground_truth: If the UE indicates privacy of the P-Asserted-Identity, then the UE should insert the temporary GRUU ("temp-gruu" header field parameter) value as specified in RFC 5627 in the Contact header field if a temporary GRUU value has been saved associated with the public user identity to be used for this request, or insert a SIP URI containing the contact address of the UE in the Contact header field, otherwise.

question_1959.question: What is one example of a projection method to map a spherical coordinate system into a cylindrical coordinate system?
question_1959.ground_truth: Equirectangular Projection (ERP) is an example of projection methods to map a spherical coordinate system into a cylindrical coordinate system.

question_1960.question: Under what conditions is the reporting accuracy of CQI under fading environments determined in 9.3.6.1?
question_1960.ground_truth: The reporting accuracy of the channel quality indicator (CQI) under fading environments in subclause 9.3.6.1 is determined by the BLER performance using the transport format indicated by the reported CQI median.

question_1962.question: What should a UE do if it has not successfully received MsgB, and the Random Access Response Reception is not considered successful within the MsgB Response Window?
question_1962.ground_truth: The UE shall again perform the Random Access Resource selection procedure and transmit MsgA with the calculated MsgA PRACH and MsgA PUSCH transmission power.

question_1964.question: What is the mode of operation that E-UTRA would allow for point to multipoint transmission within a cluster of asynchronous cells?
question_1964.ground_truth: E-UTRA would still allow point to multipoint transmission within a cluster of asynchronous cells.

question_1965.question: In the authentication procedure for EAP-AKA' with AKMA additions, what does the UDM/ARPF generate first?
question_1965.ground_truth: The UDM/ARPF generates an authentication vector with Authentication Management Field (AMF) separation bit = 1 first in the authentication procedure for EAP-AKA' with AKMA additions.

question_1966.question: What should the UE do if it has random access related information available and the RPLMN is included in the plmn-IdentityList stored in VarRA-Report?
question_1966.ground_truth: The UE should set the ra-ReportList in the UEInformationResponse message to the value of ra-ReportList in VarRA-Report and discard the ra-ReportList from VarRA-Report upon successful delivery of the UEInformationResponse message confirmed by lower layers.

question_1967.question: What is the purpose of the "Test" command for the +CDIS command?
question_1967.ground_truth: The "Test" command for the +CDIS command returns the maximum length of each display element.

question_1968.question: What is the role of the group management server in this process?
question_1968.ground_truth: The MCPTT server resolves the MCPTT group ID to determine the members of that MCPTT group and their affiliation status, based on the information from the group management server.
