question_1969.question: In section 5.1.4, what conclusions are drawn about the feasibility of the described cell switching procedures for conserving energy?
question_1969.ground_truth: In section 5.1.4, it is concluded that both OAM-based approach and signalling-based approach are feasible, applicable and backward compatible for improving energy efficiency in inter-RAT scenario. Additionally, enhancement solutions on how to exit dormant mode efficiently are also concluded to be feasible, applicable and backward compatible.

question_1970.question: What is the purpose of the fileMD5 attribute in the fileSchedule element?
question_1970.ground_truth: The fileMD5 attribute is the MD5 hash value of the file, and its purpose is to enable a UE to determine if a file has changed since a prior reception without having to download the file.

question_1971.question: What is the expiration time used in the SIP PUBLISH request when the targeted MCPTT user indicates interest in at least one MCPTT group at the targeted MCPTT client?
question_1971.ground_truth: The expiration time is set to 4294967295.

question_1973.question: What is the maximum number of transmitting Sidelink processes associated with each Sidelink HARQ Entity for V2X sidelink communication?
question_1973.ground_truth: The maximum number of transmitting Sidelink processes associated with each Sidelink HARQ Entity for V2X sidelink communication is 8.

question_1974.question: How many times shall the mobile station reinitiate the packet access procedure when there is a TLLI mismatch in the contention resolution procedure?
question_1974.ground_truth: The mobile station shall reinitiate the packet access procedure up to 4 times in case of TLLI mismatch in the contention resolution procedure.

question_1975.question: What must the MME/SGSN do when it receives an answer message from the IWF/HSS for the same user in the network?
question_1975.ground_truth: The MME/SGSN should store the identity of the IWF/HSS for each IMSI for future reference to be able to send messages for the same IMSI.

question_1976.question: How were the TSC vectors evaluated for DAS-10b/11b/12b v2 and DBS-10b/11b/12b v2 in the evaluation method?
question_1976.ground_truth: The Data and Header BLER performance for each TSC positing vector TSC(T,cn,sp) was evaluated for DAS-10b/11b/12b v2 and DBS-10b/11b/12b v2 in sensitivity limited, co-channel interference limited, and adjacent channel interference limited scenarios.

question_1977.question: What is the purpose of the Ga reference point in 3GPP networks?
question_1977.ground_truth: The Ga reference point in 3GPP networks is used for CDR transfer between a CDF and the CGF.

question_1978.question: How many bits are used for the "New data indicator" field in the DCI, when the DCI is not for a random access procedure?

question_1983.question: What post-condition has to be met to establish connectivity for the emergency stop service?
question_1983.ground_truth: The post-condition for establishing connectivity for the emergency stop service is that connectivity between the mobile operation panel and the production line/mobile robot has been established, and the communication service between UEs has been maintained on the 5G network with encryption and secured data transfer.

question_1984.question: What combinations of system information blocks (NR-X) are used in multi band multi cell carrier aggregation scenarios?
question_1984.ground_truth: Combinations NR-3, NR-4, NR-5, NR-10, NR-11, NR-19, and NR-22 are used in multi band multi cell carrier aggregation scenarios.

question_1985.question: What is the result of sending the MC service emergency alert request when an emergency alert is initiated by an MC service user?
question_1985.ground_truth: The MC service emergency alert request message is sent to the MC service clients of each of the affiliated MC service group members, in order to notify them of the emergency.

question_1986.question: What message does the SS send to the MS to initiate a Non-synchronized PS Handover containing a handover reference?
question_1986.ground_truth: The SS sends a PS HANDOVER COMMAND message to the MS to initiate a Non-synchronized PS Handover containing a handover reference.

question_1987.question: What is the impact on OTA conformance testing for FR2 that the available test equipment such as cables and connectors get expensive and unreliable as frequency increases?
question_1987.ground_truth: The upper frequency limit for OTA out-of-band blocking conformance testing in FR2 is set to 60 GHz because of the high cost and unreliability of test equipment at higher frequencies.

question_1989.question: Which mode of network independent clocking is not provided between the ISDN and the PLMN?
question_1989.ground_truth: Network independent Clocking (NIC) interworking is not provided between the ISDN and the PLMN.

question_1991.question: What is a data unit that is identified by a label at layer 3 of the OSI reference model, also known as a NPDU?

question_1992.question: What is the main requirement for test efficiency optimization to be applicable?
question_1992.ground_truth: The manufacturer needs to declare the use of the same RF hardware for both IAB-MT and IAB-DU, and a set of declarations must be the same for both.

question_1993.question: What are the two currently valid classes of operating condition in the UICC specification for 3GPP?
question_1993.ground_truth: The two valid classes of operating condition are class B (3.0V) and class C (1.8V).

question_1994.question: When is the third digit incremented in the version numbering system?
question_1994.ground_truth: The third digit is incremented when editorial only changes have been incorporated in the document.

question_1997.question: What action should the UE take upon receiving a PDN MODIFICATION REQUEST message from the TWAG in the UE-initiated IP flow mobility over trusted WLAN using MCM?
question_1997.ground_truth: The UE should respond with a PDN MODIFICATION ACCEPT message and apply the requested routing rules.

question_1998.question: What should the SS do if 1800 or more of the cell specific CQI values are in the range (cell specific Median CQI - 2) <= (cell specific Median CQI) <= (cell specific Median CQI + 2) for each cell?
question_1998.ground_truth: If 1800 or more of the cell specific CQI values are in the range (cell specific Median CQI - 2) <= (cell specific Median CQI) <= (cell specific Median CQI + 2) for each cell, then the SS should continue with step 6).

question_2000.question: What is specified in the more specific requirement for the NRM?
question_2000.ground_truth: The more specific requirement for the NRM states that the Network Resource Model should contain IMS specific IOCs and related definitions, supporting IMS entities in the current 3GPP Release.

question_2001.question: What is the purpose of the Entity Released IF?
question_2001.ground_truth: It is used to inform the gsmSCF about the release of a logical entity (CS or BCSM) caused by exception or errors.

question_2002.question: Which element appears in both "UNR-discovery-security-parameters-request-type" and "UNR-discovery-security-parameters-accept-type" complex types?
question_2002.ground_truth: The element "relay-service-code" appears in both complex types.

question_2003.question: What is the requirement for the UE not to consider a E-UTRA neighbour cell in cell reselection?
question_2003.ground_truth: If it is indicated as not allowed in the measurement control system information of the serving cell, the UE shall not consider a E-UTRA neighbour cell in cell reselection.

question_2005.question: What happens when eNB1 initiates the X2AP Message Transfer procedure by sending the X2AP MESSAGE TRANSFER message to eNB2?
question_2005.ground_truth: Upon receiving the X2 MESSAGE TRANSFER message, eNB2 may retrieve the X2AP message included in the X2AP Message IE and consider the target eNB ID contained in the Target eNB ID IE as the destination for the X2AP message.

question_2006.question: What is the function of the SimpleReference structure in the charging information structure?
question_2006.ground_truth: The SimpleReference structure in the charging information structure contains the information required to create the endpoint information for those services that require a reference to a Web Service.

question_2008.question: What should be included in MeasurementReport message, as per clause 5.5.5, as the first element in measResultNeighCells list, when the reportType is eventTriggered or periodical?
question_2008.ground_truth: The first element in measResultNeighCells list, when the reportType is eventTriggered or periodical, should be the best neighboring cell with the highest score, which is determined based on the sorting quantity. The sorting quantity is determined as specified in 5.5.5.3, i.e., the best cell is included first.

question_2009.question: What should a ME capable of UMTS AKA with a USIM active and attached to a GSM BSS do regarding GSM AKA participation?
question_2009.ground_truth: It may participate in GSM AKA and is required to allow registration in a R98- VLR/SGSN.

question_2012.question: What is the difference between registered relation types and extension relation types for 3GPP Service Based Interface APIs?
question_2012.ground_truth: Registered relation types are identified by a token, such as "self," and can be reused by other applications. They are preferred when expressing the link relation between two resources. Extension relation types, on the other hand, are used when no registered relation exists to express the relation between two resources. They may be defined as a string token or as a URI.

question_2013.question: What is the format of the first DL message in the SRNS relocation without UE involvement?
question_2013.ground_truth: The first DL message in the SRNS relocation without UE involvement is a target RNC(*) sending to ME+, which should be integrity protected and ciphered, while it is carrying target RNC(*)'s security capability.

question_2015.question: What is UESliceMaximumBitRateList?
question_2015.ground_truth: UESliceMaximumBitRateList is a sequence of UESliceMaximumBitRateItem with size constraint between 1 and maxnoofAllowedS-NSSAIs.

question_2016.question: What information is required for AMF selection, if applicable, in an NF profile?
question_2016.ground_truth: NF instance ID, NF type, PLMN ID or PLMN ID + NID, Network Slice related Identifiers such as S-NSSAI or NSI ID, FQDN or IP address of NF, NF capacity information, and NF priority information.

question_2017.question: What procedure is called by the new SGSN when there are active PDP contexts for the MS, and ISR is activated?
question_2017.ground_truth: The new SGSN calls the Delete Session Request (Cause, Operation Indication) procedure to delete bearer resources on the other old CN node.

question_2018.question: How much TX filtering rejection at RX band would be needed for dual carrier transmitters meeting certain IM and spurious requirements?
question_2018.ground_truth: It would be ~37 dB for TX filters with 27 dBm output.

question_2019.question: What is the function of the VISITED NETWORK BEST INDICATION container in the BEST service?
question_2019.ground_truth: The VISITED NETWORK BEST INDICATION container in the BEST service is added to the PCO provided by the UE in the PDN_CONNECTIVITY_REQUEST to indicate regulatory requirements in certain countries such as Lawful Interception or where encryption is prohibited.

question_2020.question: What is the method used to multiplex data on multiple carriers in EGPRS?
question_2020.ground_truth: The method used to multiplex data on multiple carriers in EGPRS is either simultaneous transmission over multiple carriers or time-divided transmission over multiple carriers.

question_2021.question: What must the UE do when all PDN connections are allowed to be handed over to WLAN access and a valid IARP rule from HPLMN is present?
question_2021.ground_truth: The UE shall apply the internal IARP for APN rules and ignore their RAN validity conditions if present.

question_2028.question: What is one of the required features for the 5G system to support eMBB users while providing UAV communication?
question_2028.ground_truth: The 5G system shall optimize the resource use of the control plane and/or user plane for transfer of continuous uplink data that requires both high data rate and very low end-to-end latency.

question_2030.question: What custom operation is used to enable a service consumer to request SEALDD Data Storage delivery to the SEALDD Server?
question_2030.ground_truth: DataDeliveryRequest is the custom operation used for this purpose.

question_2032.question: What should the UE consider as the sorting quantity when determining the reporting order for eventA3, eventA3H1, eventA3H2, and eventA6 in a 5G NR cell?
question_2032.ground_truth: The quantity used in the aN-Offset.

question_2033.question: What must a UE do to identify and report a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell, when no explicit neighbor list is provided and the purpose is 'reportCGI'?
question_2033.ground_truth: The UE shall identify and report the CGI when requested by the network for the purpose 'reportCGI'. The UE may make autonomous gaps in downlink reception and uplink transmission for receiving MIB and SIB1-BR message.

question_2034.question: What should the UE (MCDATA Client) do when it receives an MSRP SEND message during a one-to-one SDS session?
question_2034.ground_truth: The UE (MCDATA Client) should respond with an MSRP 200 (OK) message and render the contents of the Payload IE to the MCDATA User if the MSRP SEND message is not blank, and send a MSRP SEND message with a disposition notification of "DELIVERED".

question_2036.question: What parameters are decoded to aid in the error concealment procedure in subclause 6.6?
question_2036.ground_truth: The parameters that are decoded include the signal classification parameter, energy information, phase control information, pitch lag information, and spectral envelope diffuser.

question_2037.question: What is the difference between automatic and manual commencement mode in the MCVideo private call request process?
question_2037.ground_truth: Automatic commencement mode allows the call to be established automatically once accepted, while manual commencement mode requires explicit user action to start the call. The MCVideo server checks if the calling user is authorized to initiate a manual commencement mode call.

question_2038.question: What method is used by the framework to indicate an error fulfilling the request to provide fault statistics?
question_2038.ground_truth: The generateFaultStatisticsRecordErr() method is used by the framework to indicate an error fulfilling the request to provide fault statistics.

question_2039.question: What attack is most relevant to KDFs used in EPS?
question_2039.ground_truth: Attacks on the "one-way" property, such as first-preimage or second-preimage attacks, are more relevant to KDFs used in EPS, as these attacks would allow an attacker to find a message that results in a desired hash value, while collisions are less of a concern.

question_2040.question: What is the main factor considered by the SMF to determine the UE port pair for 5G VN Group information?
question_2040.ground_truth: The SMF determines the UE port pair based on 5G VN Group information.

question_2041.question: What is the type of the id-BCH-Information field in the BCH-Information-ResourceStatusInd container?
question_2041.ground_truth: The type of the id-BCH-Information field in the BCH-Information-ResourceStatusInd container is Common-TransportChannel-Status-Information.

question_2042.question: What is the role of the TP-Message-Reference field in a Short Message Status Report (SMS-STATUS-REPORT)?
question_2042.ground_truth: The TP-Message-Reference field in a Short Message Status Report contains the same value as the TP-Message-Reference generated by the MS in the earlier SMS-SUBMIT or SMS-COMMAND to which the status report relates.

question_2043.question: What is the BS transmission power assumed in the first scenario for semi-static SBFD at low load level?
question_2043.ground_truth: The BS transmission power assumed in the first scenario for semi-static SBFD at low load level is 49dBm.

question_2044.question: When must a UE immediately acquire SIB6, SIB7, or SIB8 if it is ETWS or CMAS capable and received a Short Message with the specified conditions met?
question_2044.ground_truth: The UE must immediately acquire SIB6, SIB7, or SIB8 as specified in clause 5.2.2.3.2 if it is ETWS or CMAS capable and received a Short Message with the specified conditions met.

question_2045.question: What are the two types of failures in Diameter based on the error scenarios?
question_2045.ground_truth: The two types of failures in Diameter are Permanent Failures and Transient Failures. Permanent Failures indicate that a request failed and should not be attempted again, while Transient Failures indicate that a request could not be satisfied at the time it was received but may be satisfied in the future.

question_2046.question: Which resolution and bitrate ranges are recommended for the test cases?
question_2046.ground_truth: The recommended spatial resolutions for the test cases are 240p, 480p, 720p, and 1080p, and the target bitrates range from about a hundred kbit/s up to 8 MBit/s.

question_2048.question: What is the impact on the own Rx of Band 19 when the system operates with Band n78 and with Band 19?
question_2048.ground_truth: 3rd and 4th order IMD generated by dual uplink of Band 21 + Band n78 may fall into own Rx of band 19

question_2050.question: What is the measure of the receiver's ability to receive a wanted signal on its assigned channel frequency in the spurious response test specified?
question_2050.ground_truth: Spurious response is a measure of the receiver's ability to receive a wanted signal on its assigned channel frequency without exceeding a given degradation due to the presence of an unwanted CW interfering signal at any other frequency.

question_2051.question: What happens when two users press to transmit at the same time in MCPTT?
question_2051.ground_truth: A race condition/collision may occur, and both setups may fail. If one device sees RECEIVING for more than one user in the group, a COLLIDE message can be sent, causing both setups to fail. Any other device seeing a COLLIDE message can't start a new communication for a random time.

question_2053.question: Which clause specifies the RF conditions and the required success rate for the SDR test for EN-DC within FR1 in Clause 9.4B.1.1.1?
question_2053.ground_truth: The RF conditions and the required success rate for the SDR test for EN-DC within FR1 in Clause 9.4B.1.1.1 are specified in the clause itself.

question_2054.question: What is the role of the Core Network (CN) and Access Network (AN) in the PLMN?
question_2054.ground_truth: The PLMN infrastructure is logically divided into a Core Network (CN) and an Access Network (AN) infrastructures. The CN is logically divided into a CS domain, a PS domain, and an IM subsystem, while the AN includes GERAN, UTRAN, and E-UTRAN, which are the access networks.

question_2055.question: What is the meaning of the ENUMERATED value in ResetAll, which represents the different types of reset that can be performed?
question_2055.ground_truth: The ENUMERATED value in ResetAll are: reset-all.

question_2056.question: What are the IM-SSF preconditions for the normal procedure of responding to the ActivityTest procedure in CAMEL Phase 4 for IP Multimedia call sessions?
question_2056.ground_truth: The IM-SSF preconditions for the normal procedure of responding to the ActivityTest procedure in CAMEL Phase 4 for IP Multimedia call sessions are: (1) A relationship exists between the gsmSCF and the IM-SSF, and (2) The SSME-FSM is in the state "Idle Management" or "Non-call Associated Treatment".

question_2059.question: What are the two parts of a standard L3 message header for the MM, GMM, CC and SM protocols defined in 3GPP TS 24.008?
question_2059.ground_truth: The two parts of a standard L3 message header for the MM, GMM, CC and SM protocols defined in 3GPP TS 24.008 are the protocol discriminator (1/2 octet) and a message type octet.

question_2060.question: What is the role of the "ModifiedBy" attribute in the "groupStatusType" complex type in the context of constructing an application/simple-filter+xml MIME body indicating per-group dynamic data restrictions of presence event package notification information?
question_2060.ground_truth: The "ModifiedBy" attribute is used to specify the URI that modified the group status. It is an optional attribute in the "groupStatusType" complex type.

question_2061.question: What value of the "entry-info" attribute in the <entry> element within the <MCDataGroupInitiation> element for an on-network group emergency alert indicates the use of the currently selected MCData group as the destination address?

question_2062.question: What is the total number of FeatureSets (size of the pool) for NR DL?

question_2063.question: What are the advantages of allowing simultaneous usage of the APN back-off timer mechanism and the overload control mechanism for performing congestion control at APN level?
question_2063.ground_truth: The advantages of this alternative are that it allows a sender to achieve the use case of blocking Create Session Request messages while throttling other messages at the same time for a given APN, offering flexibility to the sender.

question_2064.question: What is the purpose of the Resource Status Indicator bit of the status indicator parameter in the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message?
question_2064.ground_truth: The Resource Status Indicator bit is set to indicate whether or not the UE has resources available to provide a connectivity service for additional ProSe-enabled UEs.

question_2065.question: What is the rule for a UE roaming in a VPLMN and not having an ongoing IMS session, in terms of transferring the PDN connection providing access to IMS between EPC via non-3GPP access and 5GCN via NG-RAN?
question_2065.ground_truth: If the UE is roaming in a VPLMN and does not have an ongoing IMS session, it is allowed to transfer the PDN connection providing access to IMS between EPC via non-3GPP access and 5GCN via NG-RAN.

question_2066.question: What is the definition of Automatic Train Protection (ATP) in FRMCS?
question_2066.ground_truth: Automatic Train Protection (ATP) in FRMCS refers to applications responsible for giving Movement Authority to a train based on its current speed, braking capability, and the distance it can travel before it must stop.

question_2069.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 14.2.19.3 of the 3GPP TS 44.014 standard?
question_2069.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the MS (Mobile Station) does not exceed conformance requirement 1 under TUhigh propagation conditions with an allowance for the statistical significance of the test.

question_2071.question: What is the benchmark used for comparing the AI/ML based CSI compression?
question_2071.ground_truth: The benchmark used for comparing the AI/ML based CSI compression is Rel-16 Type II codebook.

question_2073.question: What shall be measured in step 3) of the procedure section in a bandwidth of at least (1+ times the chip rate of the radio access mode?
question_2073.ground_truth: The mean power of the User Equipment (UE)

question_2074.question: What is the purpose of the NR intra-frequency RRC re-establishment test in FR2 without serving cell timing?
question_2074.ground_truth: The purpose is to verify that the RRC re-establishment delay is within the specified limits and to verify the requirements in TS 38.133 clause 6.2.1.

question_2075.question: What is the identifier necessary to uniquely identify a target for interception in the circuit-switch domain?
question_2075.ground_truth: Specific identifiers, such as the Lawful Interception IDentifier (LIID), are used to uniquely identify a target for interception in the circuit-switch domain.

question_2076.question: When is a cardinality of "M..N" allowed for data types "array(<type>)" and "map(<type>)"?
question_2076.ground_truth: A cardinality of "M..N" is only allowed for data types "array(<type>)" and "map(<type>)" if the values of M and N are greater than 0 and M is less than or equal to N.

question_2077.question: What conditions must be met for the initiation or cease of SLSS transmission with V2X sidelink communication for eNB as Timing Reference?
question_2077.ground_truth: The test purposes to verify that the V2X UE meets the requirements related to the maximum evaluation time allowed to initiate and cease SLSS transmissions defined in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 13.3.1.1, when the downlink timing of the serving cell or PCell on a non-V2X sidelink carrier is used as the timing reference.

question_2078.question: What are the advantages of IN services?
question_2078.ground_truth: The advantages of IN services include the ability to provide services network-wide without building them into every network node, and the ease of introducing new services into the network.

question_2079.question: What is the difference between Tracking Area in E-UTRAN and NG-RAN?
question_2079.ground_truth: Both in E-UTRAN and NG-RAN, a warning message with the same Message Code and Update Number may or may not be "new" in the next cell, depending on whether the next cell is in the same Tracking Area as the current cell.

question_2080.question: What are the three approaches to inter-cell interference mitigation?
question_2080.ground_truth: The three approaches to inter-cell interference mitigation are inter-cell-interference randomization, inter-cell-interference cancellation, and inter-cell-interference co-ordination/avoidance.

question_2082.question: What speech codec is mandatory for the 3GPP?
question_2082.ground_truth: The Adaptive Multi-Rate (AMR) speech codec is mandatory for the 3GPP.

question_2084.question: What is the final step in the procedure described in subclause 6.12.1, after the MC service group affiliation request is sent from MC service server C to MC service server B?
question_2084.ground_truth: MC service server B sends an MC service group affiliation response to MC service server C indicating the success of the affiliation process.

question_2085.question: What should the RNC do if the Pre-emption Capability IE is set to "shall not trigger pre-emption" in an allocation request?
question_2085.ground_truth: The RNC should not trigger the pre-emption procedure.

question_2088.question: Which mechanism must the PGW support to indicate its support for P-CSCF restoration for WLAN to the 3GPP AAA Server?
question_2088.ground_truth: The PGW must support the basic mechanism to indicate its support for P-CSCF restoration for WLAN to the 3GPP AAA Server.

question_2089.question: What should the pre-test condition be for the UE in this test?
question_2089.ground_truth: The UE should be authorized to perform NR sidelink communication and synchronized on GNSS.

question_2090.question: When would an MCVideo emergency call cancellation request be considered authorized?
question_2090.ground_truth: An MCVideo emergency call cancellation request would be considered authorized if the <allow-cancel-imminent-peril> element of the <ruleset> element within the MCVideo user profile document identified by the MCVideo ID of the calling user is set to "true".

question_2091.question: What steps does the initiating UE take after receiving the PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE ACCEPT message?
question_2091.ground_truth: The initiating UE saves its new IP address/prefix if received on the PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE ACCEPT message, updates the associated 5G ProSe direct link context with the new identifiers, uses the new layer-2 IDs to transmit the PC5 signalling message and PC5 user plane data, and continues to receive traffic with the old layer-2 IDs from the target UE until it receives traffic with the new layer-2 IDs from the target UE.

question_2093.question: What is required in the SIP INVITE request when requesting automatic commencement mode at the invited MCVideo client?
question_2093.ground_truth: The SIP INVITE request should include an Answer-Mode header field with the value "Auto".

question_2095.question: What is the expected sequence of messages in the test in 18.2a.4?
question_2095.ground_truth: The expected sequence of messages in the test in 18.2a.4 includes SIP MESSAGE requests, 200 OK responses, and 202 ACCEPTED responses.

question_2096.question: What must SGM-C include in the "GroupMember" object when sending a CoAP PUT request for group registration?
question_2096.ground_truth: MembershipState set to "registered" as true, and optionally, messageFilter attribute and other attributes unchanged.

question_2098.question: What is the definition of the nominal power step due to transmission of Ack/Nack or CQI in HS-DPCCH?
question_2098.ground_truth: The nominal power step due to transmission of Ack/Nack or CQI in HS-DPDCH is defined as the difference between the nominal mean powers of two power evaluation periods on either side of an HS-DPCCH boundary.

question_2101.question: What is the indication that the target SGSN sends in the RANAP Common ID message to the source SGSN during PS Handover procedures for SRVCC?

question_2102.question: What is the definition of a CSI-RS based inter-frequency measurement in the context of 9.10D.3.1?
question_2102.ground_truth: A CSI-RS based inter-frequency measurement is a measurement that is not considered an intra-frequency measurement, and is performed on identified inter-frequency cells with the help of CSI-RS-Resource-Mobility and associatedSSB parameters.

question_2103.question: What resource can be queried by the TSCTSF for the SUPI(s) that belong to the provided External or Internal Group Identifier?
question_2103.ground_truth: The Group Identifiers resource (6.1.3.20) can be queried by the TSCTSF to get the SUPI(s) that belong to the provided External or Internal Group Identifier.

question_2105.question: What is the minimum requirement for the test case regarding the delay of system information blocks in a UTRAN cell?
question_2105.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for the test case is 240ms.

question_2107.question: What is the outcome of a successful UE Radio Capability Match procedure?
question_2107.ground_truth: The SGSN initiates the procedure by sending a UE RADIO CAPABILITY MATCH REQUEST message and the RNC shall, if supported, respond with a UE RADIO CAPABILITY MATCH RESPONSE message.

question_2109.question: What is one of the conditions that must be met for an AS to remove the Contact header field or modify a 3xx response to an appropriate non 2xx response code before sending the response towards the UE?
question_2109.ground_truth: If the response contains a Contact header field and the AS protects against attacks using 3xx responses.

question_2110.question: What is the role of a PIN Element with Gateway Capability in a PIN?
question_2110.ground_truth: A PIN Element with Gateway Capability is a PIN Element that has the ability to provide connectivity to and from the 5G network for other PIN Elements.

question_2111.question: What is the name of the method defined in clause 6.3.3.2 that an MAA calls to register with the MBMS client?
question_2111.ground_truth: The name of the method is registerStreamingApp().

question_2112.question: What is a PCC rule in 5G architecture?
question_2112.ground_truth: A PCC rule is a set of information elements enabling the detection of a service data flow and providing parameters for policy control and/or charging control. It can be dynamically provisioned by the PCF to the SMF or predefined in the SMF.

question_2113.question: What is the required signal strength level in relation to the system noise floor during the test procedure?
question_2113.ground_truth: The receiving signal should be at least 30dB higher than the system noise floor during the test procedure to avoid disruption from the noise floor of the measurement receiver.

question_2114.question: What is the action of the MS in A/Gb mode if there is no available UMTS security context, and the MS has indicated support for integrity protection in MS network capability IE to the network but the network does not activate integrity protection?
question_2114.ground_truth: If the network does not activate integrity protection by indicating a GPRS GSM integrity algorithm or does not include a message authentication code to the MS in the AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING REQUEST message, then the MS ignores the AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING REQUEST message.

question_2115.question: What is the content type used for HTTP bodies in the MSGin5G APIs?
question_2115.ground_truth: JSON (IETF RFC 8259) is used for HTTP bodies in the MSGin5G APIs.

question_2116.question: What technology is used to determine the position of a container in an enhanced positioning area?
question_2116.ground_truth: The position of a container in an enhanced positioning area is determined using the 3GPP system, which can include 3GPP RAT-dependent positioning technologies for coverage or non-3GPP positioning technologies such as GNSS when outside the coverage of 3GPP RAT-dependent positioning technologies.

question_2117.question: What information is carried between the MS and the network to support Periodic Location features during a MO-LR operation?
question_2117.ground_truth: The LCS-MOLR Invoke and the LCS-MOLR Return Result components carry the periodic location information between the MS and the network to support Periodic Location features during a MO-LR operation.

question_2118.question: Which E-DCH Transport Bearer Mode is defined by the Multicell E-DCH Transport Bearer Mode in the context of TS 25.214?
question_2118.ground_truth: The Multicell E-DCH Transport Bearer Mode indicates the Multicell E-DCH Transport Bearer Mode, which can be either "Separate Iub Transport Bearer Mode" or "UL Flow Multiplexing Mode" in the context of TS 25.214.

question_2120.question: When should the rlf-InfoAvailable flag be included in the RRCConnectionResumeComplete message, for NB-IoT?
question_2120.ground_truth: The rlf-InfoAvailable flag should be included in the RRCConnectionResumeComplete message if the UE has radio link failure information available in VarRLF-Report-NB and if the RPLMN is included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarRLF-Report-NB.

question_2124.question: What is the purpose of defining "shall" and "shall not" constructions in Technical Specifications produced by the 3GPP?
question_2124.ground_truth: The purpose is to indicate a mandatory requirement to do something and an interdiction (prohibition) to do something, respectively, within the context of normative provisions.

question_2125.question: What is the role of the BSS in Local Switching?
question_2125.ground_truth: The BSS establishes Local Switching by internal means if it has received permission from the MSC-S(s), and can break an established Local Switch if it receives signalling that it is not possible or no longer possible for one radio leg.

question_2126.question: What is the function of the USIM Simulator in this test procedure?
question_2126.ground_truth: The USIM Simulator is used to test the communication between the Mobile Equipment (ME) and the USS.

question_2128.question: What is the function of the Network Slice Admission Control Function (NSACF) in 5G networks?
question_2128.ground_truth: The NSACF monitors and controls the number of registered UEs and PDU Sessions per network slice in 5G networks.

question_2129.question: In the described HVQ mode, what method is used to reconstruct harmonic characteristics of the higher frequency band signal?
question_2129.ground_truth: In the HVQ mode, the widths of the bands are larger than in the non-harmonic mode to reconstruct harmonic characteristics of the higher frequency band signal.

question_2130.question: In the 3GPP TS 51.010-1 GSM system, what is the maximum number of cells that can be contained in the Intra-frequency measurement system information for cell No.31 in the UTRAN test scenario with cells belonging to three different frequencies?
question_2130.ground_truth: Cell No.31 in the UTRAN test scenario with cells belonging to three different frequencies contains two cells in the Intra-frequency measurement system information.

question_2134.question: What is the 3GPP system that the Enhanced aacPlus general audio codec is described within?

question_2135.question: What parameters are used in the Group Member Discovery Solicitation message (Model B)?
question_2135.ground_truth: The parameters used in the Group Member Discovery Solicitation message (Model B) are Discoverer info (which provides information about the discoverer user) and Target Info (which provides information about the targeted discoverees).

question_2136.question: What is the purpose of the long-term post-filter in NB decoding at 9.6 kbit/s?
question_2136.ground_truth: The long-term post-filter in NB decoding at 9.6 kbit/s is used to improve the quality of the reconstructed signal for clean speech when the background noise level is less than 20 dB. It is active only in this specific case and for certain modes, and its parameters are computed from the residual signal obtained by filtering through the numerator of the short-term post-filter.

question_2138.question: What measurements should PSCC intra-frequency and SCC intra-frequency measurements meet as per the document?
question_2138.ground_truth: PSCC intra-frequency and SCC intra-frequency measurements should meet all applicable requirements in clauses 8.1.2.2 and 8.3.3, respectively.

question_2140.question: What are the primary responsibilities of the RLC layer in the MBMS UTRAN and E-UTRAN Bearer services?
question_2140.ground_truth: The RLC layer provides functions such as segmentation and reassembly, concatenation, padding, sequence numbering, reordering, and duplication detection.

question_2142.question: Which two types of capability exchange are required for Trusted N3GPP solutions?
question_2142.ground_truth: The two types of capability exchange required for Trusted N3GPP solutions are 5G Session Management (5GSM) and 5G Mobility Management (5GMM) to ensure smooth communication and connectivity in the network.

question_2143.question: When will the MS start a timer not shorter than 60 minutes after adding an SNPN to the list of "temporarily forbidden SNPNs"?
question_2143.ground_truth: The MS will start a timer not shorter than 60 minutes after adding an SNPN to the list of "temporarily forbidden SNPNs", if the message received is integrity-protected or if the value of the SNPN-specific attempt counter for that SNPN is equal to the MS implementation specific maximum value.

question_2144.question: What is a potential application for industrial control in a cellular network?
question_2144.ground_truth: A high-reliability low-latency wireless connection with high uplink bandwidth for industrial control applications.

question_2147.question: What are the drawbacks of the HTTP/2 Server Push mechanism?
question_2147.ground_truth: The HTTP/2 Server Push mechanism has several drawbacks such as: (1) it is not guaranteed to work in the presence of intermediaries, (2) it requires the server to generate and send a promised request for every push response, and (3) it requires keeping the stream of the original request of the client to the "open" or "half-closed (remote)" state with respect to the server.

question_2148.question: What message is sent by the gNB to the AMF to trigger a 5G Core (5GC) switch for the downlink data path towards a target gNB and to establish an NG-C interface instance towards that target gNB?

question_2149.question: What is the purpose of the FRMCS System with regards to interrogating functional identities?
question_2149.ground_truth: The FRMCS System allows for the interrogation of functional identities to recognize the own functional identity(ies) or the functional identity of other FRMCS Users or FRMCS-equipment.

question_2153.question: What is the wrong decision probability (D) for MS in the reference sensitivity test?
question_2153.ground_truth: The wrong decision probability (D) for MS in the reference sensitivity test is 0.0085.

question_2156.question: What is the role of N3IWF in enabling service continuity between PLMN and NPN networks?
question_2156.ground_truth: N3IWF (Non-3GPP Interworking Function Wireless) serves as a gateway for enabling service continuity between PLMN and NPN networks. It allows UEs to discover and establish connectivity with remote networks, maintains security contexts for user equipment, and tunnels communication between networks as needed.

question_2157.question: What should the UE do upon reception of a NOTIFICATION message, if it decides not to initiate a service request procedure over 3GPP access?
question_2157.ground_truth: The UE shall respond with a NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message indicating failure to re-activate the user plane radio resources of PDU sessions.

question_2158.question: What is the action taken by the UE when it receives a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-UE relay discovery solicitation?
question_2158.ground_truth: When the UE receives a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-UE relay discovery solicitation, it uses the associated DUSK, DUCK, and UTC-based counter to unscramble, decrypt, and verify the MIC field in the message.

question_2159.question: Which event indicates handover from GSM or UMTS to EPS in a "Forward Relocation Request" message from SGSN?
question_2159.ground_truth: The BSSGP Cause or RANAP Cause IE (IE type: F-Cause) indicates handover from GSM or UMTS to EPS respectively.

question_2160.question: Which measurement type provides the number of successful radio link deletions to the E-DCH active set (UE side) in FDD mode?

question_2161.question: What provides the number of successful executions of outgoing handovers to the cells outside the RN per handover cause?

question_2163.question: What factor determines whether the UE can request eDRX cycle during a registration procedure?
question_2163.ground_truth: Whether the UE can request eDRX cycle during a registration procedure depends on whether the UE is registered for emergency services.

question_2164.question: How does the ITU-T define Quality of Experience (QoE)?
question_2164.ground_truth: QoE is the degree of delight or annoyance of the user of an application or service, including the complete end-to-end system effects (client, terminal, network, services infrastructure, etc.) and influenced by user expectations and context.

question_2165.question: What is the difference between alternatives 6a and 6b for restoring energy distribution?
question_2165.ground_truth: Alternative 6a is when there is no UPS capacity remaining in the infrastructure that serves the distribution substations, and manual intervention is required to restore energy distribution. Alternative 6b is when prior arrangement is made so that UPS capacity remains in the infrastructure at the time it is needed to restore energy distribution service, and the DSO employs smart energy services to restore service to customers rapidly.

question_2166.question: What is the definition of MTC UE authentication in the 3GPP technical specification group?
question_2166.ground_truth: MTC UE authentication is the authentication of a MTC Device using GSM AKA, UMTS AKA, EPS AKA, EAP-AKA, or EAP-AKA' as defined in TSs 43.020, 33.102, 33.401, 33.234, or 33.402.

question_2169.question: What is not in the scope of the present document?
question_2169.ground_truth: The specification of transmission delay requirements and O&M requirements are not in the scope of the present document.

question_2170.question: What measures can be taken to prevent man-in-the-middle attacks during H(e)NB's first network access?
question_2170.ground_truth: Measures that can help prevent man-in-the-middle attacks during H(e)NB's first network access include ensuring that H(e)NB has authentication credentials already during the very first contact with the network, and performing mutual authentication between the H(e)NB and the first contact node.

question_2172.question: What should the system do if the Resource-Priority header field is not included in the INVITE request for an MCVideo emergency group call?
question_2172.ground_truth: If the Resource-Priority header field is not included in the INVITE request for an MCVideo emergency group call, the system should perform the actions specified in clause 6.3.3.1.8, send an UPDATE request towards the initiator of the SIP INVITE request, and wait for a 200(OK) response before proceeding with the rest of the steps.

question_2173.question: What is the objective of spatial correlation validation measurement in OTA testing for MIMO systems?
question_2173.ground_truth: The objective of spatial correlation validation measurement is to check whether the measured correlation curve follows the theoretical curve. This is used to ensure that the spatial correlation of the channel is as per the defined channel model.

question_2174.question: What network is required for the underlying "transport bearer" over which the SS and the UE communicate in basic E-UTRA Single cell network scenarios?
question_2174.ground_truth: The E-UTRAN (Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access Network) network is required for the underlying "transport bearer" over which the SS and the UE communicate in basic E-UTRA Single cell network scenarios.

question_2175.question: How does the eNB ensure that the X2 SETUP RESPONSE is mapped correctly by the concentrator?
question_2175.ground_truth: The eNB sends the response over the same stream number as the received X2 SETUP REQUEST to allow mapping by the concentrator.

question_2177.question: In the "T1: in-progress emergency group call" state, what should the MCVideo client do when it receives a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message with the MCVideo group ID IE matching the call stored for other state machines, and the Confirm mode indication is present in the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message?
question_2177.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should establish a media session based on the stored SDP body of the call, start transmission control as a terminating transmission participant, generate a GROUP CALL ACCEPT message, set the necessary IEs in the GROUP CALL ACCEPT message, send the GROUP CALL ACCEPT message, start timer TFG6, start timer TFG2, and enter the "S3: part of ongoing call" state.

question_2178.question: What action does the MS take when timer TU5002 expires in the MS?
question_2178.ground_truth: When timer TU5002 expires in the MS, the MS shall release the associated transport channel(s).

question_2179.question: What feature allows HD-FDD Cat. M1 UEs to use up to 14 HARQ processes in CE Mode A with an additional PDSCH scheduling delay in Rel-17?
question_2179.ground_truth: Additional PDSCH scheduling delay for 14-HARQ processes in DL for LTE-MTC

question_2180.question: What is the mean power saving gain provided by the R17 PDCCH monitoring adaptation scheme in the FR2 UL only evaluation, InH, AR UL 1 stream, and low load scenario?
question_2180.ground_truth: The mean power saving gain provided is 52.35%.

question_2181.question: What is the impact of allowing group regrouping within a system on the MCPTT server?
question_2181.ground_truth: The solution provides a means of allowing group regrouping within a system and still providing communication between systems, subject to limitations.

question_2182.question: Which modulation symbols can be used by an HS-PDSCH?
question_2182.ground_truth: An HS-PDSCH may use QPSK, 16QAM, or 64QAM modulation symbols.

question_2183.question: What is the significance of the reset parameter in the getNextNotification() method?
question_2183.ground_truth: The reset parameter in the getNextNotification() method specifies whether the application intends to obtain the set of notifications starting at the beginning (TRUE) or requests the next set of notifications that have not (yet) been obtained since the last call to this method with this parameter set to TRUE (FALSE).

question_2184.question: What does the "0" value represent in the defined values of the parameter "<n>", which enables or disables reporting of changes in the MT's IMS capabilities?
question_2184.ground_truth: The "0" value in the defined values of the parameter "<n>" represents disabling the reporting of changes in the MT's IMS capabilities.

question_2185.question: What is the versioning scheme used in the 3GPP TS-family of documents?
question_2185.ground_truth: The versioning scheme of 3GPP TS-family documents consists of three digits: the first digit representing the status of the document within the TSG (information, approval, or change control), the second digit incremented for all changes of substance, and the third digit incremented for editorial only changes.

question_2186.question: What should be provided as input to the QoS sustainability analytics to derive the analytics in a finer granularity area of interest?
question_2186.ground_truth: The necessary granularity of the area of interest should be indicated and provided as input to the QoS sustainability analytics to derive the analytics in a finer granularity area of interest.

question_2187.question: What is the radio interface in the GSM Cordless Telephony System between the CTS-MS and CTS-FP?
question_2187.ground_truth: The radio interface between the CTS-FP and the CTS-MS is a modified GSM interface, where the carrier frequencies used are the same as assigned for cellular service, and these carrier frequencies can be part of a license-exempt band or a licensed band.

question_2188.question: When the GA-RRC sub-layer entity in the MS receives the GA-RRC RELEASE message, what should it do?
question_2188.ground_truth: When the GA-RRC sub-layer entity in the MS receives the GA-RRC RELEASE message, it should send a GA-RRC RELEASE COMPLETE message to the GANC, release the GA-RRC connection and any user plane resources for the indicated domain, stop relevant timers if running, and enter the GA-RRC-IDLE state for the domain.

question_2189.question: What should the IWF performing the participating role determine if the user homed in the IWF is not affiliated to the targeted MCData group?
question_2189.ground_truth: The IWF performing the participating role should determine that the user homed in the IWF is not affiliated to the targeted MCData group if the applicable MCData group information entry was not found or the affiliation status of the MCData group information entry is "deaffiliating" or "deaffiliated."

question_2190.question: In what scenarios can a pre-established session be used for a private MCPTT call?
question_2190.ground_truth: A pre-established session can be used for a private MCPTT call if the offered media streams in the INVITE request are the same or subset of those in the existing pre-established session, and if the media parameters of each offered media stream are compliant with the media parameters of the media stream of the same media type in the existing pre-established session.

question_2191.question: What should the UE include in a SIP request when it wants to indicate the privacy of the P-Asserted-Identity that will be generated by the P-CSCF?
question_2191.ground_truth: The UE can indicate privacy of the P-Asserted-Identity by inserting a P-Access-Network-Info header field into any request for a dialog, any subsequent request (except CANCEL requests) or response (except CANCEL responses) within a dialog or any request for a standalone method. This is defined in subclause 7.2A.4 of the IMS communication service.

question_2194.question: What is the purpose of the AC field in the BFD-RS set of the Serving Cell?
question_2194.ground_truth: The AC field in the BFD-RS set of the Serving Cell indicates the presence of the Candidate RS ID field in this octet. It is set to 1 if at least one of the SSBs with SS-RSRP above rsrp-ThresholdBFR amongst the SSBs in list of candidate beams is available.

question_2195.question: Which O&M functions should be foreseen for the interface towards the management plane?
question_2195.ground_truth: The O&M functions that should be foreseen for the interface towards the management plane are performance monitoring functions, alarm status reporting functions, and synchronization source management.

question_2196.question: What are the two categories of solutions in Key Issue #7 for enhancing QoS Sustainability analytics?
question_2196.ground_truth: The two categories are enhancing the QoS Sustainability analytics with a finer granularity area (e.g. below Cell level) and enhancing the QoS Sustainability analytics with additional input data.

question_2197.question: What is the registration authority for the 3GPP file format called?
question_2197.ground_truth: The registration authority for the 3GPP file format is called (for historical reasons) MP4 REG.

question_2198.question: When does UE2 start using UE1's new IP address/prefix?
question_2198.ground_truth: UE2 starts using UE1's new IP address/prefix only after receiving an IP packet using UE1's new IP address/prefix from UE1.

question_2199.question: What kind of authentication vectors can be distributed between R99+ VLRs/SGSNs?
question_2199.ground_truth: UMTS and GSM authentication vectors can be distributed between R99+ VLRs/SGSNs.

question_2200.question: What is the reference point for the measurement result after layer 1 filtering in the E-UTRA measurement model?
question_2200.ground_truth: The reference point for the measurement result after layer 1 filtering in the E-UTRA measurement model is point B.

question_2201.question: What is the expected impact of PT1 and PT2 on data rate in the relaxed UE processing timeline?
question_2201.ground_truth: No impact on instantaneous peak data rate is expected from PT1 and PT2.

question_2202.question: How does a ticket help with the key management signalling and what does it contain?
question_2202.ground_truth: A ticket is a reference to a key held by the key management system or it could hold the key itself. It is forwarded with the signalling associated with the media set-up. The ticket helps by having the key information associated with the media transported in it. It includes the key itself or a reference to the key held by the key management system. It can also include other information such as the identity of the media, the sender, and the receiver.

question_2204.question: What frequencies are allowed for RLANs in Brazil?
question_2204.ground_truth: The allowed frequencies for RLANs in Brazil are 5250-5350 MHz, 5470-5650 MHz, 5650-5725 MHz, and 5725-5850 MHz.

question_2205.question: What is the maximum allowed measurement reporting delay for Event A3 triggered measurement report in Test 1?
question_2205.ground_truth: The maximum allowed measurement reporting delay for Event A3 triggered measurement report in Test 1 is less than 6.4 seconds from the beginning of time period T2.

question_2207.question: What does Key Issue #2 study in terms of non-public networks?
question_2207.ground_truth: Key Issue #2 studies network identification for non-public networks, addressing aspects like information elements, uniqueness of the network identification, and the relationship between network and UE identification.

question_2208.question: What is a possible service level that a hybrid cell may provide to non-member UEs?
question_2208.ground_truth: A hybrid cell may provide a paging service, where a non-member UE can access the cell to receive pages. This provides similar functionality as a CSG cell without incurring CSG-hybrid switching penalty.

question_2210.question: What is the default S0 value for TCP/IP header compression?
question_2210.ground_truth: The default S0 value for TCP/IP header compression is 16.

question_2211.question: What should a late joining UE do if it only receives RECEIVING and not the original stream of the communication?
question_2211.ground_truth: It may investigate a relay opportunity and announce itself to the relay.

question_2214.question: What should be the contents of the "IE UE positioning GPS measured results" in a MEASUREMENT REPORT message during a location request?
question_2214.ground_truth: The contents of "IE UE positioning GPS measured results" in a MEASUREMENT REPORT message depend on the capabilities of the UE and the measurement type. If the UE supports the capability to provide the GPS timing of the cell frames measurement, the UE should include the "Primary CPICH Info" and "GPS timing of cell frames" measurements. If the UE does not support this capability, the UE should include the "GPS TOW msec" measurement.

question_2215.question: What are the minimum required methods for the IpConfCallControlManager interface?
question_2215.ground_truth: The minimum required methods for the IpConfCallControlManager interface are the createConference() method, or the reserveResources() and freeResources() methods, along with the methods inherited from the IpMultiPartyCallControlManager interface.

question_2216.question: What are the required delivery methods for DASH-formatted contents and generic application services in MBMS?
question_2216.ground_truth: At least one of the delivery methods shall be the download delivery method for both DASH-formatted contents and generic application services.

question_2218.question: What essential information is derived from the GTP-U header for user plane traffic by the NG-RAN?
question_2218.ground_truth: The NG-RAN derives the boundaries of the PDU Set (e.g. an XR frame) and the dependencies of PDU Sets.

question_2219.question: What is a key challenge in enabling the State Estimation service?
question_2219.ground_truth: A key challenge is the availability of measurement devices with real-time communication capabilities, as the instrumentation penetration at the distribution level is usually poor.

question_2220.question: What is the behavior of the UE when there is more than one criterion applicable for a PDU session?
question_2220.ground_truth: The UE shall apply the Tsor-cm timer with the highest value.

question_2222.question: What is the purpose of the private message mechanism for non-standard use?
question_2222.ground_truth: The private message mechanism for non-standard use may be used for special operator- (and/or vendor) specific features considered not to be part of the basic functionality, and by vendors for research purposes.

question_2224.question: What is the purpose of using a separate MP-DCCP connection for each QoS flow?
question_2224.ground_truth: The purpose of using a separate MP-DCCP connection for each QoS flow is to ensure that PDUs belonging to different QoS flows, which may require different QoS treatment, are not multiplexed in the same MP-DCCP connection, without the need for QoS-aware scheduling in each MP-DCCP connection.

question_2225.question: Which three techniques can be used to reduce the peak rate relative to the Category 1 UE, thus providing a cost reduction?
question_2225.ground_truth: The three techniques to reduce the peak rate relative to the Category 1 UE are: reduction of maximum transport block sizes for DL and UL, restricting the number of PRBs in an assignment/grant, and restricting the maximum modulation order.

question_2226.question: How is the CS Data used in IMS Core for establishing a connection?
question_2226.ground_truth: The CS Data is used similarly to a voice call in IMS Core. A data terminal equipment (modem) establishes a connection to another terminal using available codecs, and the connection setup is controlled by the IMS Core.

question_2227.question: In the case of a non-LCLS inter-BSS handover, what does the BSS-2 do after receiving the Handover Command message in Step 15?
question_2227.ground_truth: The BSS-2 bicasts the user plane data in the same way as the Access MGW-1 would be doing

question_2228.question: What are the main components of the Speech Recognition Framework (SRF) for automated voice services in 3GPP?
question_2228.ground_truth: The main components of the SRF for automated voice services in 3GPP is the distributed audio sub-system and the speech services, which use an error-protected data channel to transport encoded speech from the client audio sub-system (terminal client) to remote speech engines (on server) for processing, and enable downlink data streaming of voice and recorded audio prompt generated by server to the terminal client audio subsystem.

question_2229.question: What interfaces are used for the provisioning of UE policies between the PCF in the HPLMN and PCF in the VPLMN?

question_2230.question: What is the TB success rate supposed to be sustained during at least?

question_2232.question: When will the S-CSCF-hA1 update the SDP if it receives the INVITE request containing the "+g.3gpp.trf" header field parameter in a Feature-Caps header field?
question_2232.ground_truth: The S-CSCF-hA1 will update the SDP if it receives the INVITE request containing the "+g.3gpp.trf" header field parameter in a Feature-Caps header field.

question_2233.question: What is the calculation method for the feature representing the closeness/variation compared to the current background noise estimate in equation (129) compared to equation (128) for the same sub-band during initialization and normal operation?
question_2233.ground_truth: During initialization, the comparison is made using a constant, which is the initialization value for the sub-band energies, while during normal operation, the calculation is made using the current background noise estimate of the respective sub-band.

question_2235.question: What information element is included in every I1-Error response message and contains a binary encoded SIP failure response?

question_2236.question: What should the Node B do if the RESET REQUEST message is received and the Reset Indicator IE is set to "Communication Context"?
question_2236.ground_truth: The Node B shall remove all the indicated Node B Communication Contexts and all the radio resources allocated for these Node B Communication Contexts. The Node B shall also initiate release of the user plane transport bearers that were involved in these Contexts.

question_2237.question: What information is exchanged between the RAN and MME/AMF at N2 and S1 Setup in Solution #14?
question_2237.ground_truth: They exchange information on whether they support the "new Rel-16 mechanism" for backward compatibility solutions.

question_2238.question: What are the potentially more stringent requirements when applying higher order modulation to DL only?
question_2238.ground_truth: The potentially more stringent requirements are on PA and synthesizer for keeping EVM approximately constant for all modulations.

question_2239.question: What is the purpose of the URSP rules with Non-Seamless Offload indication when performing Non-Seamless Offload of data traffic to a WLAN access network?
question_2239.ground_truth: It is used to send the traffic outside the IPSec tunnel encapsulation.

question_2242.question: What is the purpose of the OTA UTRA inner loop power control in the downlink test?
question_2242.ground_truth: The purpose of the OTA UTRA inner loop power control in the downlink test is to verify that it is within the limits specified by the minimum requirement.

question_2244.question: In the context of the document, what does ME+ stand for?
question_2244.ground_truth: ME+ stands for Mobile Equipment that supports the UTRAN key hierarchy (UTRAN KH).

question_2246.question: What are the requirements for end-to-end protection between the RN and the core network if necessary?
question_2246.ground_truth: The same solution as for backhaul protection should be considered if end-to-end protection between the RN and the core network is needed. Integrity protection and confidentiality protection for the S1 control plane traffic shall be mandatory. The S1 control plane traffic between RN and MME-UE shall be integrity protected between the DeNB and the MME-UE with the same strength as in the current EPS architecture. Only hop by hop protection between RN and MME-UE shall be considered as the DeNB acts as an S1-proxy in the solution selected by RAN. The S1 control plane traffic between DeNB and MME-RN shall be integrity protected with the same strength as in the current EPS architecture.

question_2247.question: Why does the SGSN need to buffer paging messages for a long time when an extended DRX cycle is used for CIoT MS?
question_2247.ground_truth: The SGSN does not know the exact time of paging occasions in every cell for a CIoT MS, so the paging message arrives at each base station an undetermined amount of time ahead of the paging occasion, causing the base station to buffer the paging message for a long time.

question_2248.question: When must the UE include a "phone-context" tel URI parameter in the Request-URI when using non-international formats of E.164 addresses?
question_2248.ground_truth: The UE must include a "phone-context" tel URI parameter in the Request-URI when using non-international formats of E.164 addresses, including geo-local numbers, home-local numbers, and other local numbers, in the Request-URI.

question_2249.question: What is the impact of inter access system handover between 3GPP access systems on the mobility and anchoring?
question_2249.ground_truth: Inter access system handover between 3GPP access systems (UTRAN/Evolved HSPA/GERAN and SAE/LTE) maintains the UE's established IP packet bearer service during mobility, and is performed below the User IP layer or in another term, below UMTS Gi level. This implies the usage of a common 2G/3G/LTE mobility anchor and mechanisms that control and perform mobility between the user plane tunnels (Gn-UP) of existing 2G/3G accesses (GERAN and UTRAN) and the user plane tunnels of the Evolved Packet Core. In addition, S3 is GTP based.

question_2251.question: What should an MTSI client do when it receives an SDP offer with multiple codecs and an offer for ECN, but ECN-triggered adaptation is only supported for some of the codecs?
question_2251.ground_truth: An MTSI client should first select which codec to accept and then accept or reject the offer for ECN depending on whether ECN-triggered adaptation is supported for that codec or not. If ECN is accepted for a codec where ECN-triggered adaptation is not supported, the MTSI client should re-negotiate the session to disable ECN.

question_2253.question: What is a key consideration for the reuse of legacy infrastructure in AIPN?
question_2253.ground_truth: AIPN should still be capable of handling access systems based on CS and the necessary interworking with CS domains.

question_2254.question: What message type should be used to transmit a supplementary service code in step 4 of the test procedure?

question_2255.question: What is the typical data rate for passenger internet access compared to MTTC (Multi-purpose Train-Track Communication) service?
question_2255.ground_truth: Passenger internet access requires around 100 Mbit/s, while MTTC only consumes some hundred kbit/s.

question_2257.question: What is the main purpose of the Serving Evolved Packet System report event in the HSS?
question_2257.ground_truth: The Serving Evolved Packet System report event is generated at the HSS when the HSS has detected that the target has roamed. Such events could be mainly triggered by Diameter messages such as: Server-Assignment-Request in case of command of 3GPP AAA to HSS.

question_2259.question: What is the role of ADAES in the VAL server performance analytics procedure?
question_2259.ground_truth: ADAES is responsible for performing the VAL server performance analytics based on data collected from the ongoing VAL sessions as well as data from the DN (VAL server, DN database or networking stack at DN).

question_2262.question: What are the pre-conditions that the initiating UE must meet before initiating the path switching procedure from the direct communication path over PC5 to the direct communication path over Uu?
question_2262.ground_truth: The initiating UE and the target UE must be communicating with each other via the 5G ProSe direct link over PC5 reference point, and the communication mode of the 5G ProSe direct link must be set to unicast mode.

question_2263.question: What should a Mobile Station (MS) do when it receives a message with out of sequence information elements, in the context of 3GPP TS 04.68 or 04.69?
question_2263.ground_truth: The MS should ignore the message if the information elements are not encoded as "comprehension required". If they are encoded as "comprehension required", the MS should return a STATUS message with cause "invalid mandatory information" and include, if possible, as diagnostics the complete message received.

question_2264.question: What procedure is recommended before the actual test for MTSI-based speech with LTE, NR, or WLAN access for the convergence of the jitter buffer management of the UE?
question_2264.ground_truth: Applying a conditioning sequence consisting of the British-English single talk sequence described in ITU-T Recommendation P.501 with a level of -16 dBm0.

question_2265.question: What must be met for an RTCP SDES packet in the Basic SDES Test?
question_2265.ground_truth: The source count (SC) header field must match the number of SDES item chunks, each SDES item with a length field corresponding to the content length, and each SDES item with non-zero content must have a non-zero terminating octet.

question_2266.question: What does the Precedence for TFT packet filter allocation parameter determine in PCC rules?
question_2266.ground_truth: The Precedence for TFT packet filter allocation parameter determines the order in which TFT (Traffic Flow Template) packet filters are allocated for PCC rules. The PCF may include this parameter if there is a possibility to run into a restriction regarding the number of TFT packet filters that can be allocated for the PDU Session when interworking with EPS (Evolved Packet System) with N26 deployment is supported.

question_2267.question: What entities and interfaces are impacted by the solution, including the support of L2 relay functionality for forwarding the signalling and user data between the Remote UE and RAN?
question_2267.ground_truth: The entities impacted by the solution include the AMF, RAN, and UE-to-Network Relay UE. The RAN needs to support L2 relay functionality for forwarding the signalling and user data between the Remote UE and RAN. The UE-to-Network Relay UE also needs to support L2 relay functionality for forwarding the signalling and user data between the Remote UE and RAN.

question_2268.question: What components may be needed to meet the isolation requirements between transmitters?
question_2268.ground_truth: The options being considered include using isolators at the transmitter output, which can provide typically around 10 dB to 12 dB of isolation and may introduce an insertion loss of approximately 0.8 dB.

question_2269.question: What mechanism is used by the AMF to protect itself from signalling overload caused by massive CIoT UEs?
question_2269.ground_truth: The AMF uses a blacklist of misbehaving UEs and triggers the PDU session release procedure for UEs in the blacklist.

question_2272.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 7.3.38.4?
question_2272.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in 7.3.38.4 is to verify the behavior of the UE during different time durations (T1, T2, and T3) in DRX mode with two cells, Cell1 as PCell and Cell2 as PSCell.

question_2273.question: How can a user access a speech or multimodal/multi-device service in a 3GPP system?
question_2273.ground_truth: The user can interact with the service using spoken and keypad inputs, and the server-based application can provide visual information in addition to audio playback.

question_2274.question: What is the purpose of the id-ExtendedRNC-ID extension in the Direct Information Transfer sequence?
question_2274.ground_truth: The id-ExtendedRNC-ID extension in the Direct Information Transfer sequence is used to indicate an extended RNC-ID.

question_2275.question: What is indicated by the "MBMS CN De-Registration" in the MBMS Service Area IE?
question_2275.ground_truth: This IE indicates whether the MBMS Session Stop procedure is a normal Session Stop or a total de-registration for a given MBMS Bearer Service.

question_2276.question: How long does a UE have to wait for the next measurement period, if it is not able to acquire the required number of samples per GSM carrier during one measurement period?
question_2276.ground_truth: The GSM carriers that were not measured during that measurement period shall be measured in the following measurement periods.

question_2277.question: What is the purpose of the circular buffer in the UL-SCH transport channel processing?
question_2277.ground_truth: The purpose of the circular buffer in the UL-SCH transport channel processing is to collect and concatenate the rate matching outputs for the different code blocks.

question_2278.question: What are the two types of LCS architecture specified in the 3GPP network?
question_2278.ground_truth: The two types of LCS (Location Services) architecture specified in the 3GPP network are non-roaming LCS architecture and roaming LCS architecture.

question_2279.question: What is a condition for block beginning to provide benefits in application layer FEC?
question_2279.ground_truth: Application layer FEC block beginning can provide benefits if the protection period exceeds at least 5 times the coherence time.

question_2281.question: What information does the eNodeB include in the S1 UE Context Release Complete message if Dual Connectivity was activated?
question_2281.ground_truth: The last known PSCell ID and the time elapsed since the Dual Connectivity was released.

question_2282.question: In the context of UxNB, what is the first new requirement needed to support the use case?
question_2282.ground_truth: The 5G system shall be able to supply wireless backhaul with the required quality to enable a UxNB (P.R.5.2-001).

question_2283.question: What is the purpose of the frequency correction channel (FCCH) in a radio sub-system?
question_2283.ground_truth: The FCCH carries information for frequency correction of the mobile station.

question_2284.question: What is the goal of the patient location use case outside hospitals?
question_2284.ground_truth: The goal is to locate patients in real-time to avoid runaway patients, locate patients who leave the hospital without authorization, and localize ambulatory patients with potentially critical conditions in case their condition gets critical.

question_2285.question: What is the role of TFO-Negotiation in the voice path of SIP/SDP offer/answer procedures in the IMS?
question_2285.ground_truth: The OoBTC procedures in the BICN interoperate with the SIP/SDP offer/answer procedures in the IMS to remove unnecessary transcoding and provide optimal voice quality and high bandwidth efficiency on all portions of the speech path.

question_2286.question: In which radio block period should the mobile station transmit uplink data blocks when it receives an assigned USF in the first reduced radio block period of a given basic radio block period, and the downlink control block is encoded using MCS-0 and occurs in the last two TDMA frames of a given basic radio block period?
question_2286.ground_truth: The mobile station should transmit uplink data blocks in the corresponding reduced uplink data blocks of the next basic radio block period.

question_2287.question: How many instances of paging groups will occur for the highest coverage class in EC-PCH?
question_2287.ground_truth: For the highest coverage class, the lower number of paging instances will occur, with at minimum two instances for the higher coverage classes.

question_2288.question: What are the general concepts in the architecture and functionality for control and user plane separation of SGW, PGW, and TDF?
question_2288.ground_truth: The general concepts include roaming scenarios, interworking with networks without control and user plane separation, split network entities interworking with non-split entities, no requirement for updating UE and Radio Access Network, selection functions for control plane and user plane separation, and independent scalability of control plane and user plane functions.

question_2289.question: What elements make up the IFPEI?
question_2289.ground_truth: The IFPEI is composed of the Type Approval Code (TAC), Final Assembly Code (FAC), Serial Number (SNR), and Software Version Number (SVN).

question_2290.question: What action does the UE take upon expiry of the timer T3583 associated with a derived QoS rule?
question_2290.ground_truth: Upon expiry of timer T3583 associated with a derived QoS rule, the UE shall remove the derived QoS rule.

question_2292.question: What state does the UE's EMM change to when the Active Timer expires?
question_2292.ground_truth: EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE, which may be considered as some "EMM-REGISTERED.power-saving"

question_2295.question: What should a Mobile Station do if it fails to complete an IMSI attach procedure and the broadcast LAI is equal to the stored LAI?
question_2295.ground_truth: When the Mobile Station's attempt counter reaches the value 4, it should send a Location Updating Request message with the Mobile Identity IE set to its IMSI, CKSN IE set to "no key is available" and the Location Updating type set to "normal" after T3212 expiry.

question_2296.question: What is the requirement for a L2 U2N Remote UE to monitor paging occasions for SI modifications and/or PWS notifications?
question_2296.ground_truth: A L2 U2N Remote UE is not required to monitor paging occasion for SI modifications and/or PWS notifications.

question_2297.question: What event triggers the UE to initiate the registration procedure for initial registration when moving from GERAN to NG-RAN coverage or from UTRAN to NG-RAN coverage?
question_2297.ground_truth: The UE initiates the registration procedure for initial registration when it moves from GERAN to NG-RAN coverage or from UTRAN to NG-RAN coverage, and the UE did not perform a successful EPS attach or tracking area updating procedure in S1 mode or registration procedure in N1 mode after the GPRS attach or routing area updating procedure while in A/Gb mode or Iu mode.

question_2300.question: What function does the 3GPP portal perform when a CR is successfully reserved?
question_2300.ground_truth: The 3GPP portal pushes the completed CR cover page to the user, eliminating transcription errors.

question_2301.question: What percentage of attempts was not successful after the maximum attempts in the simulated cases of 100% 23 dBm MS penetration?
question_2301.ground_truth: Failed attempts were shown to be below 0.1% in all scenarios.

question_2302.question: What is a KMS certificate and how does it differ from X.509 certificates in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_2302.ground_truth: A KMS certificate is a certificate required to communicate with a security domain to support identity-based cryptography, which differs from X.509 certificates used for traditional PKI.
