question_2303.question: What are the specific conditions that the time domain measurement resource restriction pattern for the measured cell needs to meet in order to be valid for performing RSRP measurements?
question_2303.ground_truth: The time domain measurement resource restriction pattern for the measured cell needs to indicate at least one subframe per radio frame for performing the RSRP measurement, and four symbols containing CRS have to be available in all subframes indicated by the pattern.

question_2304.question: What is the basis for selecting the best shape in the glottal-shape codebook search?
question_2304.ground_truth: The best shape is selected by minimizing the mean-squared error between the target signal and the contribution signal for all candidate glottal-shape codevectors.

question_2305.question: What is the difference between MR-VoD and SVC-VoD in terms of video encoding?
question_2305.ground_truth: MR-VoD encodes multiple representations of a video using AVC, while SVC-VoD encodes multiple representations of a video using SVC.

question_2306.question: What should be used by the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay and 5G ProSe Remote UE during 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay Discovery and PC5 link establishment for emergency service?
question_2306.ground_truth: The dedicated RSC(s) for emergency service should be used by the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay and 5G ProSe Remote UE during 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay Discovery and PC5 link establishment for emergency service.

question_2307.question: What is the expected final state of MS in test 34.2.8?
question_2307.ground_truth: The expected final state of MS is idle, updated.

question_2309.question: What is the purpose of the version numbering system in the document's title?
question_2309.ground_truth: The version numbering system indicates the level of TSG approval and the type of changes made to the document. For example, a version number of x.y.z indicates that the first digit denotes the level of TSG approval, the second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, and the third digit is incremented when only editorial changes have been made.

question_2310.question: What protocol must the 5G system support processing and transmitting to support third-party applications using this protocol?

question_2311.question: What should an ePDG do when it receives a GTP error indication for the default bearer from a PGW?
question_2311.ground_truth: The ePDG should delete all the bearer contexts associated with the PDN connection and initiate the release of the corresponding SWu instance. The ePDG may also notify the Operation and Maintenance network element.

question_2312.question: In Solution #7, what is the role of N3IWF in the authentication and authorization process between non-3GPP UE and MSGin5G server?
question_2312.ground_truth: N3IWF acts as the key management server in the authentication and authorization process between non-3GPP UE and MSGin5G server.

question_2315.question: What is the term used to describe the action of a mobile station reselecting from GERAN/UTRAN to GAN in idle mode?

question_2318.question: When will the AMF consider the UE as unreachable?
question_2318.ground_truth: When the Start of unavailability period starts, the AMF shall consider the UE as unreachable until the UE registers for normal service again.

question_2319.question: How are changes to the present document communicated?
question_2319.ground_truth: Changes to the present document are communicated through the 3GPP Technical Specification Group, with a new version number and release date assigned following a formal TSG approval.

question_2321.question: What is the maximum EIRP for out of band emission in Korea?
question_2321.ground_truth: The maximum EIRP for out of band emission in Korea is < -27 dBm/MHz.

question_2324.question: What TPC command should the SS transmit on the MPDCCH DCI format 6-0A for the scheduling of the PUSCH in sub-test 1.2 and 2.2?
question_2324.ground_truth: The SS should transmit a +1dB TPC command for sub-test 1.2 and a -1dB TPC command for sub-test 2.2.

question_2325.question: What should the MCPTT client do when it receives a PRIVATE CALL RELEASE ACK to the PRIVATE CALL RELEASE message in the "P3: waiting for release response" state, as specified in TS 24.379, clause 11.2.2.4.5.5?
question_2325.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should stop timer TFP3, terminate the media session, start timer TFP7, release the call type control state machine, and enter the "P1: ignoring same call id" state.

question_2326.question: How many frames per second do many available consumer cameras typically capture?
question_2326.ground_truth: Many available consumer cameras typically capture frames at 30 frames per second.

question_2327.question: What potential requirement does the 3GPP management system have for authorization based on operator's policies, SLA, and security context for an external MnS consumer?

question_2328.question: Which message type contains the SRES or the first 4 octets of the RES, depending on the type of authentication challenge, and should be sent from the network to the MS after an authentication and ciphering request?

question_2330.question: When should the PCRF generate QoS rules for an IP-CAN session where both Gx and associated Gxx interfaces exist?
question_2330.ground_truth: The PCRF should generate QoS rules for all the authorized PCC rules in this step to ensure consistency between the QoS rules and PCC rules authorized for the same service data flow.

question_2331.question: In the context of positioning frequency layers in a cellular network, what does Case 1 refer to in terms of PRS resources?
question_2331.ground_truth: In Case 1, only the PRS resources that are unmuted and fully or partially overlap with the first T2 ms of PPW are considered.

question_2332.question: What is sent at attach/tunnel activation on interfaces s2b and s2c, detach/tunnel deactivation, session modification, start of interception with active tunnel, in case of GTPv2 based s2b?

question_2333.question: What happens when an identity is activated or deactivated on a UE?
question_2333.ground_truth: When an identity is activated or deactivated, all UEs that can use that identity to originate or terminate a session will receive a notification of the change of status.

question_2334.question: What happens when the IWK-SCEF receives a request indicating deletion of a Monitoring Event Request?
question_2334.ground_truth: The IWK-SCEF performs final operations necessary, deletes any stored parameters, and sends an acknowledgement to the MME/SGSN.

question_2335.question: What are the two types of bandwidth information indicated by the Rx-Request-Type AVP?
question_2335.ground_truth: The two types of bandwidth information indicated by the Rx-Request-Type AVP are RTCP receiver reports (RR-Bandwidth AVP) and RTCP sender reports (RS-Bandwidth AVP).

question_2336.question: Which protocols are used for the CEMAF's communication in the CEMAF Enrolment and MAnagement Framework solution?
question_2336.ground_truth: The CEMAF's communication is HTTP-based and can be secured using TLS, OCSP, or CMPv2 protocols.

question_2338.question: What are the modulation schemes used for downlink modulation?
question_2338.ground_truth: BPSK, QPSK, and 16QAM with grey-mapping are used for downlink modulation.

question_2339.question: What is the purpose of an IMS Network-Independent Public User Identity (INIPUI) Host?
question_2339.ground_truth: The IMS Network-Independent Public User Identity (INIPUI) Host is the entity that hosts and manages the INIPUIs.

question_2340.question: What should be the TA value used by an MS for accessing a new BTS in a GSM network?
question_2340.ground_truth: The MS should use a TA value of 0 for the Random Access burst, Extended Synchronisation Access Burst, and Extended Dual Slot Access Burst for accessing a new BTS in a GSM network.

question_2342.question: What action should the UE take if timer T5086 expires during the 5G ProSe direct link keep-alive procedure?
question_2342.ground_truth: The UE should either initiate a 5G ProSe direct link keep-alive procedure to check the link or initiate the 5G ProSe direct link release procedure, depending on its implementation.

question_2345.question: What percentage of the total LTE reference modem cost can be saved by implementing HD-FDD mode?
question_2345.ground_truth: HD-FDD mode provides an overall cost saving based on the reference LTE modem of 4-8%.

question_2347.question: In potential solution #1 for energy saving in 5G NR based on service related information, what kinds of information can be included in the service related information?
question_2347.ground_truth: The service related information may include service characteristic information or tenant information, which can include service type information, service name information, service priority information, tenant type, tenant name, and tenant priority information.

question_2348.question: What must the S-EES receive from the EEC as part of the ACR launching procedure in step 4a?
question_2348.ground_truth: The S-EES receives a request from the EEC, along with the ACR initiation data, indicating ACR initiation.

question_2349.question: What is the difference between Service Continuity and Session Continuity?
question_2349.ground_truth: Service Continuity is the uninterrupted user experience of a service, including changes in IP address and anchoring point, while Session Continuity refers to the continuity of a PDU session and the preservation of the IP address for the lifetime of the PDU session.

question_2350.question: What is the purpose of the PDC Measurement Initiation procedure?
question_2350.ground_truth: The purpose of the PDC Measurement Initiation procedure is to enable the gNB-CU to request the gNB-DU to report measurements used for propagation delay compensation at the gNB-CU or UE.

question_2352.question: What should the initiating UE do if there is an existing PC5 unicast link for the pair of peer application layer IDs but the network layer protocol or security policy is not compatible with the V2X service requirements?
question_2352.ground_truth: The initiating UE should establish a new PC5 unicast link with a compatible network layer protocol and security policy if there is an existing PC5 unicast link for the pair of peer application layer IDs, and the network layer protocol or security policy of the existing PC5 unicast link is not compatible with the V2X service requirements.

question_2355.question: What are the common characteristics that enable trained ML model sharing between different vendors, as listed in Key Issue #5?
question_2355.ground_truth: The common characteristics that enable trained ML model sharing between different vendors include the interoperability indicator, interoperable token, and ML model filter information such as ML model file format and supported AI framework.

question_2356.question: What is the role of the 3GPP AAA Proxy in the handover procedure?
question_2356.ground_truth: In non-roaming cases, the 3GPP AAA Proxy is not involved in the handover procedure, except for the authentication and authorization step in home routed roaming cases.

question_2357.question: What does the MS need to initiate the secondary PDP context activation procedure with the same PDP address and APN as an already active PDP context?
question_2357.ground_truth: The MS should send an ACTIVATE SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message to the network, containing the selected NSAPI, QoS profile, requested LLC SAPI, Linked TI and TFT.

question_2358.question: What method is used to read the existing application AM context for a given AF and a given application AM context Id?
question_2358.ground_truth: The GET method, as specified in clause 5.17.1.3.3.2 of the document, is used to read the existing application AM context for a given AF and a given application AM context Id.

question_2360.question: What is the aim of the minimum conformance requirements in 6.6.4.5.3?
question_2360.ground_truth: The aim of the minimum conformance requirements in 6.6.4.5.3 is to ensure that the UE meets the required measurement performance within predefined measurement conditions.

question_2362.question: Which requirement for the performance of DCH is not required for a Home BS?
question_2362.ground_truth: The performance requirement of DCH in moving propagation conditions is not required to be met for a Home BS.

question_2363.question: What additional trigger conditions does ATG support for conditional handover?
question_2363.ground_truth: The RRM measurement-based event A4 and a location-based trigger condition.

question_2364.question: What information is used to determine the N6 traffic routing in the case of Ethernet PDU Session Type?
question_2364.ground_truth: The N6 traffic routing information can be, for example, a VLAN ID or the identifier of a VPN or a tunnel identifier at the UPF.

question_2365.question: How many satellites can be considered for the current GPS assistance request when NSAT is set to 16 in the binary representation of bits 5 to 8 in octet 8?

question_2367.question: What information is verified by the CAPIF core function during the onboarding process?
question_2367.ground_truth: The CAPIF core function verifies whether all the necessary information has been provided to onboard the API invoker.

question_2368.question: What is the test requirement for maximum RRC procedure delay in the E-UTRAN TDD-TDD Inter Frequency Handover test?
question_2368.ground_truth: The maximum RRC procedure delay is 15 ms.

question_2369.question: What entity includes the Survival Time in the TSN AF QoS Container to be passed to the PCF?
question_2369.ground_truth: The Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF) or an application function (AF) supporting Key Issue #3 may provide Survival Time to the Packet Control Function (PCF) directly or via the Non-3GPP Interworking Function (NEF).

question_2371.question: What is the role of the Verifier in the attestation process of VNFs?
question_2371.ground_truth: The Verifier, in the attestation process of VNFs, validates the measurements reported by the virtualization layer software for the virtual instance and VNF software.

question_2374.question: What should the P-CSCF do when it receives a request without a Security-Client header field or with only media plane security mechanisms and the Require and Proxy-Require header fields do not contain "sec-agree"?
question_2374.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall continue with the procedures described in the remainder of the subclause and either follow GPRS-IMS-Bundled authentication procedures, perform NASS-IMS bundled authentication (if the P-CSCF supports both SIP digest and NASS-IMS bundled authentication), follow the SIP digest without TLS procedures, or follow the IMS-AKA procedures for eP-CSCF (if the REGISTER request is received by eP-CSCF over TLS and contains an Authorization header field with an "algorithm" header field parameter set to "AKAv2-SHA-256").

question_2375.question: What is the test signal used for measuring the sending sensitivity of a desktop hands-free UE?
question_2375.ground_truth: The test signal used for measuring the sending sensitivity of a desktop hands-free UE is the British-English single talk sequence described in ITU-T Recommendation P.501.

question_2376.question: What is the transmitter OFF power spectral density minimum requirement for an E-UTRA frequency error?
question_2376.ground_truth: The transmitter OFF power spectral density minimum requirement for an E-UTRA frequency error is the same as defined in subclause 6.5.2.2 and subclause 6.5.2.4.

question_2377.question: What is the minimum number of radio blocks required to be tested for each test sample in the statistical test method for a MS not on the limit?
question_2377.ground_truth: The minimum number of radio blocks required to be tested for each test sample in the statistical test method for a MS not on the limit is 150.

question_2379.question: What HTTP method is used to destroy a Server Certificate resource in a 5GMS system?
question_2379.ground_truth: The HTTP DELETE method is used to destroy a Server Certificate resource in a 5GMS system.

question_2380.question: What is the use of the RLC-UM-DATA-Req primitive?
question_2380.ground_truth: The RLC-UM-DATA-Req primitive is used by upper layers to request transmission of an RLC SDU in unacknowledged mode.

question_2381.question: What trigger condition is used for S-BMSC-CDR closure when a new MBMS UE context is activated due to inter-system change?
question_2381.ground_truth: The S-BMSC-CDR shall be closed using the last partial CDR closed trigger condition when a new MBMS UE context is activated due to an inter-system (RAT) change.

question_2382.question: How are the payload sizes of EVS Primary and EVS AMR-WB IO in CS Networks specified?
question_2382.ground_truth: The payload sizes of EVS Primary rates for the application in CS Networks are always integer multiples of 8 bits (excluding the 7-bit EVS-CMR). The payload sizes of EVS AMR-WB IO rates for the application in CS Networks are not always integer multiples of 8 bits (excluding the 7-bit EVS-CMR).

question_2383.question: What is the FDD reference test frequency for Operating Band VII in DC-HSDPA mode?

question_2384.question: How does live content streaming cause issues for network operators?
question_2384.ground_truth: It creates a surge in the number of streams trying to flow through the network, especially in the air interface, as bandwidth is a scarce resource, and is usually delivered in the form of multiple streams of unicast traffic.

question_2385.question: What are the two keys used for message encryption and integrity protection in the 3GPP Sidelink Positioning broadcast?
question_2385.ground_truth: PEK (Positioning Encryption Key) and PIK (Positioning Integrity Key)

question_2386.question: When should the network include the interface identifier for the UE's link local address in the PDN address information?
question_2386.ground_truth: The network should include the interface identifier when the PDN type is set to IPv6 or IPv4v6.

question_2387.question: When must a UE not activate PSM?
question_2387.ground_truth: A UE must not activate PSM if it is attached for emergency bearer services or has a PDN connection for emergency bearer services or if it is attached for access to RLOS.

question_2388.question: What interfaces are carried over the forwarding plane based on the PDU-session type in Architecture 2a?
question_2388.ground_truth: All IP-based interfaces such as NG, Xn, F1, N4, etc. are carried over the forwarding plane based on the PDU-session type in Architecture 2a.

question_2389.question: What should the participating MCVideo function perform, if the procedures of clause 8.2.2.2.12 for implicit affiliation were performed in the current procedure?
question_2389.ground_truth: If the procedures of clause 8.2.2.2.12 for implicit affiliation were performed in the current procedure, the participating MCVideo function should complete the implicit affiliation by performing the procedures of clause 8.2.2.2.13.

question_2390.question: What is the benefit of aligning full header packets with the MSP in the context of the AMR WB voice codec and MBSFN?
question_2390.ground_truth: With alignment, there is no additional delay for the late entry KPI.

question_2391.question: What is the purpose of throttling messages based on session parameters in message throttling?
question_2391.ground_truth: Throttling messages based on session parameters allows for the prioritization of messages based on factors such as APN, QCI, ARP, and LAPI, resulting in better handling of messages and procedures related to higher priority sessions.

question_2392.question: How is the updated coverage class signaled to the base station when the MS detects a change in coverage class while in Connected Mode?
question_2392.ground_truth: The updated coverage class is signaled to the base station via the DCIs and system information, with the base station determining the MS's coverage class based on the physical RACH resource allocation used by the MS.

question_2394.question: What is the requirement for the X2 control plane traffic integrity protection between RN and eNB/RN in the new architecture?
question_2394.ground_truth: The X2 control plane traffic between RN and eNB/RN should be integrity protected between the DeNB and the eNB/RN with at least the same strength as in the current EPS architecture.

question_2395.question: What is the role of the Network Repository Function (NRF) in the network?
question_2395.ground_truth: The NRF is not responsible for storing individual IPv4 addresses or IPv6 prefixes of User Equipments (UEs).

question_2396.question: What must the manufacturer declare regarding the rated output power for the base station?
question_2396.ground_truth: The manufacturer must declare for the base station under test the rated output power for each supported transmit channel bandwidth.

question_2397.question: What is the difference between a bi-directional navigable association and a bi-directional non-navigable association?
question_2397.ground_truth: In a bi-directional navigable association, each model element has a pointer to the other, while in a bi-directional non-navigable association, each model element does not have a pointer to the other.

question_2398.question: What is the purpose of a pre-established MRB in the context of group communication?
question_2398.ground_truth: A pre-established MRB is used for the delivery of media to the receiving group members. Its setup time is included in the calculation shown in clause 5.1.1.1, even when it is already pre-established.

question_2399.question: What should the MME do if the EPS update result IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message indicates "TA updated" but not "combined TA/LA updated"?
question_2399.ground_truth: The MME should return a TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message to the network if the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message contains a GUTI or a TMSI or both.

question_2400.question: What is the role of the Network Repository Function (NRF) in the consumer PLMN in the roaming scenario?
question_2400.ground_truth: The NRF in the consumer PLMN authenticates the NF Service Consumer, verifies the input parameters in the access token request, and forwards the request to the NRF in the producer PLMN if verification is successful.

question_2401.question: What is the abbreviation for Global Synchronization Channel Number in the 3GPP technical report?

question_2402.question: What action does OCS take when it receives a Reserve Unit Request message from the 3GPP AAA server to update the reserved quota?
question_2402.ground_truth: OCS performs credit control (updates the account/returns back unused quota) and replies with a Reserve Unit Response message as acknowledgement.

question_2403.question: What are the different states a Media Player can have and what does each state indicate?
question_2403.ground_truth: The Media Player can be in the INITIALIZED state, the READY state, the PRELOADED state, the PAUSED state, and the PLAYING state, each indicating a different state of readiness and/or playback. The INITIALIZED state indicates that the Media Player has been created, the READY state indicates that the Media Player is ready for use, the PRELOADED state indicates that the Media Player has preloaded media, the PAUSED state indicates that the playback has been paused, and the PLAYING state indicates that the playback has been initiated.

question_2406.question: What is the concept of GNSS Integrity in 5G network positioning?
question_2406.ground_truth: GNSS Integrity in 5G network positioning refers to the trust in the accuracy of position-related data and the ability to provide alerts. UE-based GNSS integrity is supported in Rel-17, allowing the UE to determine and report the integrity results of the calculated location based on the integrity requirements and assistance data.

question_2407.question: What is the implication of using the RAN specified L2 relay functionality for forwarding signalling and user data in Solution #29?
question_2407.ground_truth: The NG-RAN, Remote UE, and AMF/SMF entities are not impacted by this solution.

question_2409.question: What is the impact on IMS when using different IP addresses for SIP signaling and media?
question_2409.ground_truth: Rel-7 IMS supports the usage of different IP addresses for SIP signaling and for the bearer traffic, so there is no IMS impact from that perspective.

question_2410.question: What information do all Sidelink BSRs transmitted in a TTI reflect regarding the buffer status?
question_2410.ground_truth: All Sidelink BSRs transmitted in a TTI always reflect the buffer status after all MAC PDUs have been built for this TTI.

question_2411.question: What should the AMF do for each PDU session indicated in the PDU Session ID IE upon receiving the HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message?
question_2411.ground_truth: The AMF should transfer transparently the Handover Request Acknowledge Transfer IE or Handover Resource Allocation Unsuccessful Transfer IE to the SMF associated with the concerned PDU session.

question_2413.question: What information is included in the Available Access Networks Info of the Access Network Info Response message?
question_2413.ground_truth: The Available Access Networks Info contains a list of access networks that are available in the vicinity of UE. If the UE included one or more access technology types in the Access Network Info Request, then information about neighbor access network with the requested access technology types is included.

question_2414.question: What should the MAC entity do if it receives a Serving Cell Set based SRS Spatial Relation Indication MAC CE on a Serving Cell?
question_2414.ground_truth: The MAC entity should indicate to lower layers the information regarding the Serving Cell set based SRS Spatial Relation Indication MAC CE.

question_2415.question: What is the requirement for testing ancillary RF amplifiers, as per section 4.5.6 of the document?
question_2415.ground_truth: When testing the repeater with an ancillary RF amplifier, you must use the connecting network declared by the manufacturer and choose the attenuation value as one of the extreme values. This must be done for each test with the amplifier fitted and, if optional, without the amplifier.

question_2416.question: What should the UE (MCDATA Client) do when it receives a SIP re-INVITE message to initiate a one-to-one SDS session using the media plane and a pre-established session?
question_2416.ground_truth: The UE (MCDATA Client) should respond by sending a SIP 200 (OK) message.

question_2418.question: What is the pre-condition for obtaining authorization to access a service API?
question_2418.ground_truth: The API invoker is onboarded, has received an API invoker identity, and is authenticated by the CAPIF core functions and CAPIF core functions validates the API invoker using authentication information.

question_2419.question: What is the role of the CAPIF core function/authorization function in the authentication of the API invoker?
question_2419.ground_truth: The CAPIF core function/authorization function is responsible for authenticating the identity of the API invoker using the certificate or shared key related to the AKMA/GBA/API invoker onboarding procedure.

question_2421.question: What is the purpose of step 7 in the procedure for Solution #4?
question_2421.ground_truth: The purpose of step 7 in the procedure for Solution #4 is for the UDM to invoke the SIDF to map the SUCI to the SUPI and select an authentication method based on the SUPI.

question_2422.question: What is the expected behavior of the MS when the SS sends corrupted data on four successive paging blocks in step 20.16.4.2?
question_2422.ground_truth: The DSC counter shall decrease by 4, which may cause a cell reselection.

question_2424.question: At low load level, what is the mean UL Average-UPT gain in case of using SBFD Alt 2 and large packet size?
question_2424.ground_truth: The mean UL Average-UPT gain with SBFD Alt 2 and large packet size at low load level is 103.52%.

question_2425.question: What is a critical service that the 3GPP system should prioritize when resources are limited?
question_2425.ground_truth: An example of a critical service is e-health.

question_2426.question: What is the impact of enabling UP function to construct End Marker in 5G networks?
question_2426.ground_truth: The UP function is required to support constructing End Marker in the UP function as mandatory.

question_2427.question: How should the MS treat the CONNECT message when the MS receives an RR message with semantic errors?
question_2427.ground_truth: The MS should follow the reactions specified in the procedural part of 3GPP TS 24.008 clauses 3, 4, 5, and 6, and if required, return a status message (STATUS or MM STATUS) with cause value #101 "mandatory information element(s) missing" or cause value #104 "conditional information element(s) missing".

question_2428.question: What are the key components of the BEST service in an EPS network?
question_2428.ground_truth: The BEST service in an EPS network requires a Home Security Endpoint (HSE) and optionally an End to Middle Key Server (EMKS) to perform functions such as terminating the control plane for BEST and routing user plane traffic for BEST.

question_2429.question: What information does the SMF request from the NRF?
question_2429.ground_truth: The SMF requests data analytics for network slice attributes, such as the number of UEs or PDU Sessions for S-NSSAIx, from the NWDAF.

question_2430.question: What must the UE include in its Via header field set when sending a request using UDP?
question_2430.ground_truth: The UE must include the sent-by field containing its IP address or FQDN and the port number, and a "rport" header field parameter with no value in the Via header field. If the UE supports sending keep-alives, it must also include a "keep" header field parameter with no value in the Via header field.

question_2431.question: In what scenario would a UE request a new 5G-GUTI assignment due to a change in the timing of paging occasions?
question_2431.ground_truth: When the MUSIM UE supporting the paging timing collision control needs to request a new 5G-GUTI assignment and is not registered for emergency services.

question_2432.question: What is the objective of Task Group 5/1 under WRC-19 Agenda item 1.13 for the future development of IMT?
question_2432.ground_truth: The objective of Task Group 5/1 under WRC-19 Agenda item 1.13 is to consider, conduct and complete in time for WRC-19 studies on spectrum needs, technical and operational characteristics, including protection criteria, and deployment scenarios for the terrestrial component of IMT, as well as propagation models, technical characteristics including protection criteria for existing services allocated in, or adjacent to, the bands identified in Resolution 238 (WRC-15).

question_2434.question: What is the expected DL throughput for the test case with a single cell when the Nominal Avg. Information Bit Rate is set to 534 kbps and the receiving UE is in a fading condition?
question_2434.ground_truth: The expected DL throughput for the test case with a single cell when the Nominal Avg. Information Bit Rate is set to 534 kbps and the receiving UE is in a fading condition is less than for the single cell case due to interference from Cell 2.

question_2436.question: What is the expected impact of time-dilated solution on RLC and MAC layers in terms of timing?
question_2436.ground_truth: The timing impacts are expected to be less on RLC as compared to MAC in terms of time-dilated solution.

question_2438.question: What happens when an AF is not considered trusted?
question_2438.ground_truth: If the AF is not considered trusted, it interacts with the NEF instead of the AF. If the AF provides explicit QoS parameters, then the AF (or NEF in case the AF is not trusted) interacts with PCF.

question_2439.question: Which 5G entity detects the available mean bitrate of the non-GBR QoS Flow?
question_2439.ground_truth: The RAN (Radio Access Network) detects the available mean bitrate of the non-GBR QoS Flow.

question_2440.question: What is the purpose of the "fields" query parameter when retrieving a subset of a resource?
question_2440.ground_truth: The "fields" query parameter is used to carry the identities of the attributes to be retrieved from a resource that has multiple attributes. This parameter is particularly useful when the NF only needs to retrieve specific attributes or individual members of a map in a large resource.

question_2441.question: What approach is used on PRACH for the persistence of mobile stations?
question_2441.ground_truth: A 2-step approach involving long-term and short-term estimation of the persistence

question_2443.question: What is an elementary stream in H.265 (HEVC)?
question_2443.ground_truth: An elementary stream in H.265 (HEVC) consists of a sequence of one or more bitstreams, where an elementary stream that consists of two or more bitstreams is formed by splicing together two or more bitstreams or parts thereof.

question_2444.question: What is the maximum number of services that the service supplier is willing to accept as a match?
question_2444.ground_truth: The "max" parameter states the maximum number of services that are to be returned in the "serviceList" result.

question_2446.question: What measure does the 5G network function take to ensure that it operates within its nominal capacity?
question_2446.ground_truth: It supports various measures such as load (re-)balancing, overload control, and NAS level congestion control.

question_2448.question: In what scenario may a UE have to register over 3GPP access and check for Emergency Services support?
question_2448.ground_truth: When the UE initiates a session to ePDG over untrusted WLAN and 3GPP access becomes available.

question_2449.question: What aspects are recommended to be addressed to support and optimize the deployment of unicast live TV services in 5G Systems?
question_2449.ground_truth: The recommended aspects include integrating into TS 26.501 (Stage 2) with specific updates to reference points, defining capability mechanisms, provisioning support for operation points and policy templates, creating necessary extensions for DASH and HLS chunked CMAF low-latency modes, providing protocols for time synchronization, extending QoE metrics schemes, providing informative guidelines on using different Operation Points, and studying even lower-latency streaming technologies.

question_2451.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the NR SA FR2 cell re-selection test case?
question_2451.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement is specified in clause 7.1.1.0.1 of TS 38.133.

question_2452.question: What is a multi-access PDU session in the context of un-trusted access?
question_2452.ground_truth: A multi-access PDU session in the context of un-trusted access refers to PDU sessions that may simultaneously use a 3GPP and a non-3GPP access, and is being studied in Key Issue #5 to understand its characteristics and how it can be supported in the 5G system.

question_2456.question: What action should the UE take upon receiving a SECURITY MODE COMMAND message or an indication from the lower layers that the user plane radio bearers are set up successfully, in clause 5.6.1.1, cases a, b, and c?
question_2456.ground_truth: The UE should start timer T3449 upon receipt of the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message or the user plane radio bearers set up indication, and wait for a SERVICE ACCEPT message to arrive.

question_2457.question: What is the name of the weighting factor that is used in the calculation of the smoothed decision in the speech/music classifier?
question_2457.ground_truth: The weighting factor used in the calculation of the smoothed decision is denoted as the filtering factor, which is adaptively set on a frame-by-frame basis in the speech/music classifier.

question_2459.question: What should the MCVideo client include in a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message?
question_2459.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include the Call identifier, Call type, Refresh interval, SDP, Originating MCVideo user ID, MCVideo group ID, Call start time, Last call type change time, Last user to change call type, and Confirm mode indication in a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message.

question_2462.question: What should the UE do when the validity timer of a ProSe Query Code expires?
question_2462.ground_truth: The ProSe Function removes the entry related to that ProSe Query Code from the UE context.

question_2465.question: What is the action taken by the MCPTT server when the receiving user accepts the private call with manual commencement mode in MCPTT?
question_2465.ground_truth: The MCPTT server sends an OK to the MCPTT client of the calling user, indicating that the receiving user has accepted the call and including the accepted media parameters.

question_2468.question: What is one of the priority services that the 5G system should support means to prevent from monopolizing all available network resources?

question_2469.question: How does a UE determine the resource allocation granularity and precoding granularity in terms of PRB pairs in the frequency domain for a PDSCH transmission in a cell?
question_2469.ground_truth: The UE assumes the resource allocation granularity and precoding granularity in terms of PRB pairs in the frequency domain to be N, where N is given by the higher layer parameter resAllocGranularity-r12 associated with the cell, for any PDSCH transmission scheduled by a cell with a given physical cell identity and transmission mode.

question_2471.question: What conditions does the network need to provide via RRC indication for activating/deactivating Pre-MG pattern through the network-controlled activation/deactivation mechanism?
question_2471.ground_truth: The network should provide the activation/deactivation status via RRC indication preConfGapStatus for all the DL BWPs of all the activated CCs, and for all the deactivated SCCs.

question_2472.question: What is the role of swap and a parameters in puncturing and interleaver design for DAS-10b/11b/12b v2 and DBS-10b/11b/12b v2?
question_2472.ground_truth: The swap and a parameters are used in puncturing and interleaver design for DAS-10b/11b/12b v2 and DBS-10b/11b/12b v2 to achieve throughput gains at high SINR levels.

question_2473.question: What is the format of the SCCP data field on the Lp interface for the BSSAP-LE message?
question_2473.ground_truth: The SCCP data field contains a discrimination indicator in bit 1 of octet one, which indicates the type of the BSSAP-LE message, and a length indicator which is the binary representation of the number of octets of the subsequent BSSMAP-LE message content.

question_2474.question: What are the two approaches discussed for self-interference leakage evaluation in the gNB RX subband in FR2-1?
question_2474.ground_truth: The two approaches for self-interference leakage evaluation in the gNB RX subband in FR2-1 are IM3 analysis and direct leakage mitigation techniques.

question_2475.question: What is the minimum requirement for in-channel selectivity for E-UTRA in the context of MSR operation?
question_2475.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for in-channel selectivity for E-UTRA in the context of MSR operation is specified in subclause 10.9.4.

question_2476.question: What is the mechanism that allows the UE to discontinuously transmit the uplink DPCCH based on the E-DCH and HS-DPCCH activity?

question_2477.question: What is the term used to describe the time between the last TTI the UE monitors the FACH channel and the time the UE starts transmit a RACH in the target cell, in the context of FDD-GSM cell reselection?

question_2479.question: What should the UE do when the neighbor NR cell becomes offset better than the serving NR PSCell, as per 8.2.3.6.1a.1?
question_2479.ground_truth: The UE must send the MeasurementReport with the correct measId for event A3.

question_2480.question: What should the RNC do when it receives the IU RELEASE COMPLETE message for only one of the simultaneous Iu signalling connections for both CS and PS domains?
question_2480.ground_truth: The RNC should not close the trace session if it was activated by both domains and stop the trace session if it was activated by only one domain and the Iu connection for this domain is successfully released.

question_2481.question: What are the two different IP@s that the P-CSCF needs to support for the UE's IMS registration?
question_2481.ground_truth: The P-CSCF needs to support one IP@ for UEs whose IMS PDN connections are anchored at PGW, and another IP@ for UEs whose IMS PDU sessions are anchored at the SMF+UPF.

question_2483.question: What is the requirement for the interruption time in intra-frequency or inter-frequency handover from NR FR1 cell to NR FR1 cell, as specified in clause 6.1.1.2.1?
question_2483.ground_truth: The requirement for the interruption time in intra-frequency or inter-frequency handover from NR FR1 cell to NR FR1 cell, as specified in clause 6.1.1.2.1, is that the UE shall start transmission of the new PRACH within Dhandover milliseconds from the end of the last TTI containing the RRC command, where Dhandover is the applicable RRC procedure delay plus the interruption time.

question_2484.question: What action should the destination host take upon receiving an initial request application message over Sy interface?
question_2484.ground_truth: The destination host shall include the features supported by the PCRF within Supported-Features AVP(s) with the 'M' bit cleared.

question_2485.question: When should a UE initiate the UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure for the S-NSSAI in a partially allowed NSSAI?
question_2485.ground_truth: If the current TAI is in the list of TAs for which the S-NSSAI is allowed, the UE can initiate the UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure for the S-NSSAI.

question_2489.question: What is the purpose of the "Use cases" subclause in the Management service template?
question_2489.ground_truth: The "Use cases" subclause describes the motivation for requirements and the benefits of the management capability. Each use case is labelled and should describe what the capability is good for, rather than how to use a certain feature.

question_2490.question: What is the role of the alias SUPIs in the solution?
question_2490.ground_truth: The alias SUPIs are used to authenticate the UE if a slice requires secondary authentication, for the purpose of slice switching between isolated sets, and reuse the existing Registration procedure but with a new registration type.

question_2491.question: What should the AMF set the Paging restriction bit to, if the network decides to accept the paging restriction and the UE has set the Follow-on request indicator to "Follow-on request pending" in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message?
question_2491.ground_truth: The AMF should set the paging restriction bit to "paging restriction supported" in the 5GS network feature support IE of the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message if the network decides to accept the paging restriction, and the UE has set the Follow-on request indicator to "Follow-on request pending" in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

question_2493.question: What should the AMF do when it receives a REGISTRATION REQUEST message with 5GS registration type IE set to "mobility registration updating" or "periodic registration updating" before the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message, if the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message is expected?
question_2493.ground_truth: The AMF should stop T3550 and start the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update.

question_2494.question: What is the P-CSCF restoration extension for TWAN access, and under what conditions can it be used?
question_2494.ground_truth: The P-CSCF restoration extension for TWAN access is used to avoid the need to deactivate and reactivate the IMS PDN connection. This extension can be used if the UE is accessing the EPC via TWAN in multi-connection mode, the UE indicated support for this extension, and TWAN indicated support for the WLCP PDN connection modification procedure.

question_2495.question: In which direction does the network provide the MSISDN if available?
question_2495.ground_truth: In the network to MS direction

question_2497.question: What is the role of the system simulator (SS) in the test procedure for RRC re-establishment?
question_2497.ground_truth: The system simulator (SS) is used as a trigger for the completion of the test and it receives the PRACH for the completion of the test.

question_2498.question: What message is displayed when the command to dial a URI is executed successfully?

question_2499.question: What is the purpose of the detailed call flow in 6.37.3.1-1 for (re)locating the same EAS to a collection of UEs?
question_2499.ground_truth: The purpose of the detailed call flow is to ensure that the same EAS IP address is applied to all the UEs in the group, allowing for changes in DNAI due to UE mobility or AF influence.

question_2500.question: What is the mean and 5% UL Average-UPT gain for operator 2 when using SBFD Alt 4 and large packet size at low load level?
question_2500.ground_truth: The mean and 5% UL Average-UPT gain for operator 2 when using SBFD Alt 4 and large packet size at low load level are 154.62% and 24.88%, respectively.

question_2501.question: What is a delta set used for in the context of UE Radio Capabilities?
question_2501.ground_truth: A delta set is used to represent the difference between a UE's actual set of UE Radio Capabilities and the set of UE Radio Capabilities represented by a UE Capability ID. It allows for more efficient signalling than sending the full set of UE Radio Capabilities.

question_2504.question: What is the expected sequence for the PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP EVENT LIST in the test scenario described?

question_2505.question: What is the purpose of MCCH in 5G network?
question_2505.ground_truth: MCCH is a PTM downlink channel used for transmitting MBS broadcast or MBS multicast control information associated with one or several MTCH from the network to the UE.

question_2507.question: What are the two main methods for NOMA bit-level scrambling?
question_2507.ground_truth: The two main methods for NOMA bit-level scrambling are UE-specific bit-level scrambling and UE-specific bit-level interleaving. The former uses randomization techniques (scrambling or interleaving) for MA signature generation, while the latter uses bit-level interleaving based on a UE-specific pattern.

question_2508.question: What are the pre-requisites for PDU session setup procedure in a non-roaming environment, supporting the co-location of UPF with FAGF-U?
question_2508.ground_truth: Registering UPF information and establishing NAS transport.

question_2510.question: What is one potential security threat to IMS Emergency Sessions during SRVCC from 5G to 3G?
question_2510.ground_truth: One potential security threat to IMS Emergency Sessions during SRVCC from 5G to 3G is the continuous authentication process, which may exhaust UE and network resources if the serving network policy does not allow unauthenticated IMS Emergency Sessions.

question_2511.question: What action is taken by the source eNB upon reception of the HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message, if the procedure was initiated for an immediate handover?
question_2511.ground_truth: The source eNB shall start the timer TX2RELOCoverall and defines a Prepared Handover for that X2 UE-associated signalling.

question_2512.question: What is the action taken by the MGW when the "Reserve Bearer Characteristics" or "Confirm Bearer Characteristics" procedures contain a codec not currently in use and framing protocol is used in support mode?
question_2512.ground_truth: The MGW shall be prepared to handle a framing protocol initialisation.

question_2514.question: What is the term used to describe a type of data transported over the radio interface in LTE, characterized by the type of information transferred?

question_2515.question: What is one of the main requirements for the Remote Driving use case group?
question_2515.ground_truth: High reliability and short low latency.

question_2516.question: Why should bidding down of encryption algorithms be prevented in IoT systems?
question_2516.ground_truth: Bidding down of encryption algorithms can result in the selection of a weaker encryption algorithm, making the system more vulnerable to attacks.

question_2517.question: What is the split AI/ML operation in the image recognition task based on?
question_2517.ground_truth: The split AI/ML operation in the image recognition task is based on the legacy model during the development or invocation of the model.

question_2518.question: What are the functions of a radio distribution network in NR?
question_2518.ground_truth: A radio distribution network distributes radio signals from the active transceiver unit array to the antenna array, and distributes radio signals collected by the antenna array to the active transceiver unit array. In the case where the active transceiver units are integrated with the array elements of the antenna array, the RDN is a one-to-one mapping between the transceiver units and the antenna elements.

question_2519.question: What is the significance of the document's version number and its components?
question_2519.ground_truth: The document's version number consists of three digits, indicating the status of the document within the TSG (first digit), changes of substance (second digit), and editorial changes (third digit). The first digit indicates if the document is presented for information, approval, or is approved and under change control.

question_2520.question: What is the fundamental building block of the Service Based Management Architecture (SBMA)?
question_2520.ground_truth: The fundamental building block of the SBMA is the Management Service (MnS).

question_2521.question: What is the effect of PDU session management functionality on PEGC?
question_2521.ground_truth: PDU session management functionality can be used by the PEGC to map PIN or PIN packets to an existing PDU session or establish a new PDU session when new packets (PIN signalling or PIN traffic or creation of PIN) are detected from a device in the PIN.

question_2522.question: What is the Lgd interface used for in the network location procedures?
question_2522.ground_truth: It is used by the GMLC to convey a location request to the SGSN currently serving a particular target UE whose location was requested and by the SGSN to return location results to the GMLC.

question_2523.question: What is the highest bandwidth that the codec can support at a bitrate of 9.6 kbps?
question_2523.ground_truth: The codec can support coding up to SWB (Specific Acoustic Bandwidth) at a bitrate of 9.6 kbps.

question_2524.question: What happens when a UE establishes multiple PDU sessions?
question_2524.ground_truth: A UE can establish multiple PDU sessions to the same or different data networks, via 3GPP or non-3GPP access networks. The UE can have different SMFs serving these PDU sessions and activate or deactivate the UP connection for each PDU session independently.

question_2527.question: What is the difference between MBMS and CC support in 3GPP networks?
question_2527.ground_truth: MBMS (Multimedia Broadcast and Multicast Service) is a point-to-multipoint communication used to broadcast content to multiple users, while CC (Circuit-Switched Connection) is a point-to-point communication used to provide a dedicated communication path between two users. 3GPP networks provide CC interception functionality at the GSNs (Gateway Service Nodes) for GPRS, but MBMS CC interception is not specifically provided by the 3GPP specification. However, MBMS CC decryption key provision is a future study area.

question_2528.question: Under what conditions will the +CGPIAF command affect the format of the IPv6 address returned by +CGPADDR?
question_2528.ground_truth: The format of the IPv6 address returned by +CGPADDR is influenced by the +CGPIAF command only when it is supported.

question_2529.question: What are the two documents that describe the basis of the DCS1800 RF requirements?
question_2529.ground_truth: The two documents are "DCS1800 System scenarios" and "Justifications for the DCS1800 05.05".

question_2530.question: When should the Relocation Preparation procedure be initiated simultaneously on all Iu signalling connections in a UTRAN to UTRAN relocation?
question_2530.ground_truth: The Relocation Preparation procedure should be initiated simultaneously on all Iu signalling connections existing for the UE in a UTRAN to UTRAN relocation.

question_2531.question: What should the AMF do when it has initiated a NGAP UE Context Modification procedure in order to take a new KgNB into use and receives a request for an inter-AMF handover from the serving gNB/ng-eNB?
question_2531.ground_truth: The AMF should wait for the (successful or unsuccessful) completion of the UE Context Modification procedure before initiating an inter-AMF handover.

question_2532.question: What is the responsibility of the PCRF when it provisionally adds new PCC rules to the PCEF due to the report of a resumed UE?
question_2532.ground_truth: The PCRF may initiate an IP-CAN session modification procedure

question_2533.question: What is the role of UPF in handling PDU sets based on their dependency?
question_2533.ground_truth: UPF buffers the PDU set for a period, determines the importance of a PDU set based on backward dependency, and retransmits or drops the PDU set accordingly. If a PDU set is not transmitted successfully, the UPF may drop all dependent PDU sets to save RAN and N3 resources.

question_2535.question: What is the size of the Format field in the MAC header for SL-SCH?
question_2535.ground_truth: The size of the Format field in the MAC header for SL-SCH is 1 bit.

question_2536.question: What should the transmission participant do if the first bit in the subtype of the Receive media response message is set to '1' (Acknowledgment is required)?
question_2536.ground_truth: The transmission participant should send a Transmission control Ack message that includes the Message Type field set to '7' (Receive media response) and the Source field set to '0' (the transmission participant is the source).

question_2537.question: What conditions must be met for the requirements in clause 9.9.6 to apply to UE PRS-RSRPP measurements?
question_2537.ground_truth: The requirements in clause 9.9.6 apply for periodic and triggered PRS-RSRPP measurements, provided PRS-RSRPP related side conditions given in clause 10.1.38 are met for a corresponding Band.

question_2538.question: What is the role of the UAS application specific server in the DAA client event information acknowledge procedure?
question_2538.ground_truth: The UAS application specific server consolidates information from the UAS application specific server and sends the DAA client event information acknowledge to the UAS client.

question_2541.question: What is the definition of ON power, as specified in clause 6.3E.3.2?
question_2541.ground_truth: The ON power is defined as the mean power over the duration of at least one slot excluding any transient period and non-transmitted symbols.

question_2542.question: What should the UE do before sending a REGISTER request for deregistration?
question_2542.ground_truth: The UE must release all dialogs related to the public user identity that is going to be deregistered, extract or derive the public user identity, the private user identity, and the domain name, and then populate the header fields with the required information.

question_2543.question: What should the UE do if it is in the 5GMM-DEREGERSTERED.NO-SUPI state and it needs to register for emergency services?
question_2543.ground_truth: The UE initiates the Registration procedure by indicating that the registration is to receive Emergency Services, i.e. with a Request Type indicating "Emergency Request".

question_2544.question: In which case should the UE notify the user that emergency session cannot be established?
question_2544.ground_truth: The UE should notify the user that emergency session cannot be established if the DNS response does not contain any record, or if the DNS response contains one or more records but the UE fails to select a PLMN that supports emergency services in non-3GPP access, or if the Emergency Registration procedure has failed for all PLMNs supporting emergency services in non-3GPP access.

question_2545.question: What is the minimum E-UTRA BS ACLR required to ensure a 5% UTRA capacity loss?
question_2545.ground_truth: An E-UTRA BS ACLR of at least 33dB is required for a 5% UTRA capacity loss.

question_2548.question: What is the parameter used to retrieve the LO position from the parameter txDirectCurrentLocation in UplinkTxDirectCurrent IE?
question_2548.ground_truth: The parameter used to retrieve the LO position from the parameter txDirectCurrentLocation in UplinkTxDirectCurrent IE is the LO position.

question_2549.question: What should the UE do when the receive window has been moved?
question_2549.ground_truth: The UE should continue accepting AMD PDUs within the updated window range.

question_2551.question: What should be met in order for antenna sharing to be allowed between the Band (2+2+5) BS transmitter and Band 5 or 26 BS receiver?
question_2551.ground_truth: The antenna path should meet very stringent 3rd order PIM specification.

question_2552.question: What is the maximum data rate supported by PTP Transmission for MBS multicast data delivery?
question_2552.ground_truth: PTP Transmission for MBS multicast data delivery supports a lossless transmission at the maximum data rate supported by the channel.

question_2554.question: What is the purpose of the algebraic codebook in the GSM enhanced full rate codec?
question_2554.ground_truth: The algebraic codebook is used to populate the excitation vectors (innovation vectors) with a small number of nonzero pulses with predefined interlaced sets of positions in the fixed codebook for the speech synthesis filters.

question_2555.question: What is the purpose of the MBMS Session Start procedure?
question_2555.ground_truth: The purpose of the MBMS Session Start procedure is to request the MCE to determine whether an MBMS E-RAB for an upcoming MBMS Session for a given MBMS Bearer Service can be accommodated by the E-UTRAN and to establish an MBMS service associated logical M3 connection.

question_2556.question: What is the difference between intra-band contiguous and non-contiguous carrier aggregation?
question_2556.ground_truth: In intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation, contiguous carriers are aggregated in the same operating band. In contrast, intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation involves aggregation of non-contiguous carriers in the same operating band.

question_2557.question: What action should the IRI-POI in the AMF take when it detects that the UE policies forwarded to a target UE have been accepted by the UE?
question_2557.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the AMF should generate an xIRI containing an AMFUEPolicyTransfer record when it detects this event.

question_2558.question: What must the source NG-RAN do before a handover when handling MBS traffic?
question_2558.ground_truth: The source NG-RAN must provide the target gNB with MBS Session Resource information, including the MBS Session ID and multicast QoS flow information, and include a mapping of unicast QoS Flows associated with the multicast QoS flow(s) of the MBS Session Resource in the UE Context information.

question_2559.question: What is the process for the "User plane / per flow" solution for transferring IP flows between accesses?
question_2559.ground_truth: The "User plane / per flow" solution (clause~7.6.1) works by sending a "redirection" packet (a packet of this IP flow with a TTL=1) from the requesting entity (resp. UE, PGW) to the other entity (resp. PGW, UE), which is acknowledged using an ICMP Time-Exceeded packet. This process effectively transfers the IP flow from one access to another.

question_2560.question: When should the regular discontinuous reception as defined in clause~5.13 be used rather than the extended idle mode DRX?
question_2560.ground_truth: The regular discontinuous reception should be used if the UE has bearers for emergency bearer services or if the UE is attached for RLOS services.

question_2561.question: What is the XML namespace that should be used when the interface is extended to allow KMS/client providers to add further information in the XML?
question_2561.ground_truth: A different XML namespace should be used when the interface is extended to allow KMS/client providers to add further information in the XML.

question_2562.question: What timing requirement must be supported for the transmission of IRI data record?
question_2562.ground_truth: Each IRI data record must be sent by the delivery function to the LEMF over the HI2 within seconds of the detection of the triggering event by the IAP at least 95% of the time.

question_2563.question: What are the primary processes involved in the conversion from 8 kHz input sampling rate to 12.8 kHz in the encoder?
question_2563.ground_truth: The primary processes involved in the conversion from 8 kHz input sampling rate to 12.8 kHz include up-sampling to 192 kHz, low-pass filtering to 6.4 kHz in the up-sampled domain, down-sampling to 12.8 kHz, high-pass filtering using a linear prediction (LP) filter, and decimation by 15. In the 8 kHz to 12.8 kHz conversion, the final filtering delay is aligned with that of the other sampling rates, i.e. 12 samples at 12.8 kHz sampling frequency, which corresponds to 0.9375 ms.

question_2564.question: What is the purpose of the Paging Cause Indication for Voice Service feature in IAB operation?
question_2564.ground_truth: The Paging Cause Indication for Voice Service feature in IAB operation is used to indicate Voice Service in the S1AP paging message only if the UE indicates support for the feature, allowing the UE to determine whether the Paging Cause Indication for Voice Service feature is supported in the current Tracking Area.

question_2565.question: What is the main focus of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals' study on Diameter overload control mechanisms (Release 12)?
question_2565.ground_truth: The main focus of this study is to investigate possible enhancements of the Diameter base protocol and existing Diameter applications to support overload control mechanisms in 3GPP core networks.

question_2566.question: What is the role of the Iur interface in the UMTS Terrestrial Radio Access Network (UTRAN)?
question_2566.ground_truth: The Iur interface is a logical interface for the interconnection of two Radio Network Controller (RNC) components of the UTRAN for the UMTS system.

question_2567.question: What was reported by multiple sources on the use of new PTRS patterns with ICI compensation compared to the existing Rel-15 NR distributed PTRS structure?
question_2567.ground_truth: The reports from different sources are not aligned, with some sources reporting that new PTRS patterns perform better, while others report no significant difference or worse performance.

question_2568.question: What should the NF Service Consumer do if the SMF indicated in the request that the SM context resource is updated with the anType IE in the Send MO Data service operation?
question_2568.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should change the access type of the PDU session with the value of anType IE.

question_2569.question: What aspects are essential in an AIPN to achieve its vision of enabling the convergence of access systems and services onto a common network?
question_2569.ground_truth: Essential aspects of an AIPN include IP-based network control, IP transport, communication quality, interworking with IP networks and legacy networks, and functionality at the edge of the network to support different access systems, legacy equipment, and advanced mobility management.

question_2570.question: What is the role of the NEF in caching application status information?
question_2570.ground_truth: The NEF caches application status information, UE ID, UE IP address when AF provides, and sends application status information to AF. It also receives early and late notification from SMF to retrieve application status from specific AF.

question_2571.question: How many sub-SAD modules does the SAD algorithm in the Enhanced Voice Services codec consist of?
question_2571.ground_truth: The SAD algorithm in the Enhanced Voice Services codec consists of three sub-SAD modules: SAD1, SAD2 and SAD3.

question_2572.question: What is the behavior of the TDF for solicited application reporting if the start/stop of application traffic detection Event Trigger is not muted for the ADC rule?
question_2572.ground_truth: The TDF shall provide application information to the PCRF, including the application identifier, start or stop of application traffic detection event trigger, and service data flow descriptions.

question_2573.question: What should the HSS do to request the identity and location information of the access network where the UE is currently attached?
question_2573.ground_truth: The HSS shall set the Access-Network-Info-Request bit in the PPR-Flags AVP bit to request the identity and location information of the access network where the UE is currently attached. In this case, the HSS shall only invoke this procedure if the 3GPP AAA Server has indicated support for the corresponding feature.

question_2574.question: What is one of the benefits of performing the procedure between CRNC and Node Bs for RNC-Node B Synchronisation?
question_2574.ground_truth: The ability to use a high priority transport bearer.

question_2577.question: What does an RFCS represent in the context of communication services?
question_2577.ground_truth: An RFCS represents a communication service instance for a specific customer and uses resources or resource services.

question_2579.question: What should the user equipment (UE) include in the measurement reporting procedure for a measurement identity (measId) in 3GPP TS 38.331, clause 5.5.5.1?
question_2579.ground_truth: For the measId, the UE should set the measId in the MeasurementReport message, include the measResultServingCell within measResultServingMOList, and set the servCellId within measResultServingMOList, if applicable.

question_2580.question: What should be done when the UE supports single xDD mode and UEScapabilityInformation includes the field fdd-Add-UE-EUTRA-Capabilities and tdd-Add-UE-EUTRA-Capabilities?
question_2580.ground_truth: The fields of UECapabilityInformation, except fdd-Add-UE-EUTRA-Capabilities and tdd-Add-UE-EUTRA-Capabilities, should be set to include the values applicable for the xDD mode supported by the UE.

question_2581.question: What is the purpose of the RFSP Index in the 5G Cellular Network?
question_2581.ground_truth: The RFSP Index is used by the Access Network to apply specific radio resource management strategies for a UE, based on accumulated usage, load level information per network slice instance, and an RFSP Index received from the AMF.

question_2582.question: What must a UE do when it is indicated to transmit a PUCCH over slots using a PUCCH resource with pucch-RepetitionNrofSlots?
question_2582.ground_truth: The UE must repeat the PUCCH transmission with the UCI over slots indicated by pucch-RepetitionNrofSlots.

question_2583.question: When is the SDP answer recorded in case of a successful session setup during the first negotiation?
question_2583.ground_truth: It is recorded in case of successful session setup.

question_2584.question: What requirement should an SNRM-S follow when handling a CoAP DELETE request from a SNRM-C?
question_2584.ground_truth: The SNRM-S should follow the procedures specified in IETF RFC 7252 when handling a CoAP DELETE request from a SNRM-C, and it should respond with a CoAP 4.03 (Forbidden) response if the request is not valid.

question_2585.question: What is the method for determining the UE's in-sync or out-of-sync status in the test specified in clause 10.3.1?
question_2585.ground_truth: The UE's in-sync or out-of-sync status is determined based on the uplink signal, which is verified based on the UE output power. If the UE output power is higher than Transmit OFF power -50 dBm, it is considered an uplink signal, and if it is equal to or less than Transmit OFF power -50 dBm, it is considered no uplink signal.

question_2586.question: What is the minimum total number of carrier frequency layers that a UE indicating support for increased UE carrier monitoring E-UTRA or increased UE carrier monitoring UTRA must be capable of monitoring?
question_2586.ground_truth: A minimum of 12 carrier frequency layers, consisting of any combination of E-UTRA FDD, E-UTRA TDD, UTRA FDD, UTRA TDD, GSM, cdma2000 1x, HRPD layers.

question_2587.question: What is the primary goal of the SMPTE ST 2110 transportation protocol?
question_2587.ground_truth: The primary goal of the SMPTE ST 2110 transportation protocol is to provide a replacement for the Serial Digital Interface (SDI) in professional media production environments using commodity networking infrastructure and interconnects, while being format-agnostic and handling various video formats.

question_2588.question: What does the UDM provide to the AUSF if the Default Credentials Server (DCS) provides the UDM with the information of a Provisioning Server (PVS FQDN(s) and/or IP address(es))?
question_2588.ground_truth: The UDM provides the PVS info to the AUSF.

question_2589.question: What is the purpose of the media distribution release request in this process?
question_2589.ground_truth: The media distribution release request is sent by the MC service server 1 to the MC service server 2 (MBS session control role) to release the capacity that was reserved in step 5 when the group call is terminated.

question_2590.question: In section 11e, how many ways are there for the SS to observe DTX in order to meet the condition for the event "Deactivation" to be considered a failure?
question_2590.ground_truth: There are 7 ways for the SS to observe DTX in order to meet the condition for the event "Deactivation" to be considered a failure.

question_2591.question: What should be the final state of the MS after the test procedure is completed?
question_2591.ground_truth: The MS should be in MM-state "idle, updated" with valid TMSI and CKSN.

question_2593.question: What is the role of the user plane function (UPF) in the 5GC assisted procedure?
question_2593.ground_truth: The UPF is responsible for sending the flow state to the session management function (SMF) for each flow and installing the flow state in the new UPF during handover to facilitate forwarding to the same server instance.

question_2594.question: What is the role of the Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF) in the EPS interworking procedures?
question_2594.ground_truth: The Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF) plays a vital role in the EPS interworking procedures. It is responsible for initiating the release of the 3GPP access resources for the MA PDU session which is not expected to be transferred to EPC, and for requesting the release of the MA PDU session which has resources established for 3GPP access, but not expected to be transferred to EPC. These actions play a crucial role in ensuring a smooth transition between 5GS and EPS.

question_2597.question: What is the aim of the "infrequent small data" optimization for Small Data Transmission in E-UTRAN?
question_2597.ground_truth: The aim of this optimization is to transfer small amounts of IP data efficiently in LTE with minimal network impact (e.g. signalling overhead, network resources, delay for reallocation) using pre-established NAS security context.

question_2598.question: What is the type of the attribute "VideoPreDecoderBufferSize"?

question_2599.question: What is the formula used to calculate APN-Relative-available-load?
question_2599.ground_truth: APN-Relative-available-load is calculated as the ratio of TNode-APN-effective-available-load of a target node to the sum of APN-effective-available-load of all the nodes in the TNodeList, multiplied by 100.

question_2600.question: What are the security requirements for mutually authenticating the UE and the anchor function in AKMA?
question_2600.ground_truth: The security requirements for mutually authenticating the UE and the anchor function in AKMA include the ability to mutually authenticate based on 5G credentials using the 5G authentication framework.

question_2602.question: What is the formula to calculate the cell selection criterion Srxlev?

question_2605.question: What is the expected behavior of the MS and the network when there is a collision between an MS initiated and a network initiated context deactivation, as per 45.4.3.2.1?
question_2605.ground_truth: The MS and the network shall each reply with the message DEACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT ACCEPT and shall stop timer T3390 and T3395, respectively, when there is a collision between an MS initiated and a network initiated context deactivation.

question_2608.question: What is the use of MLContext attribute on MLEntity?
question_2608.ground_truth: The MLContext attribute on MLEntity is a notifiable datatype that provides the ability to monitor changes in the ML context based on statistical properties of data.

question_2609.question: What is the measurement that provides the number of successful PUCCH allocations in the PCell for SCell scheduling in Carrier Aggregation, split into subcounters for PUCCH format 3 and PUCCH format 1bwcs?

question_2610.question: What is the purpose of the id-LMF-UE-Measurement-ID in E-CIDMeasurementInitiationFailure message?
question_2610.ground_truth: The id-LMF-UE-Measurement-ID in E-CIDMeasurementInitiationFailure message represents the unique measurement identifier that is used to identify the measurement.

question_2612.question: What must be established and provided for the reporting of Trace data under all Trace Recording Sessions of the same Trace Session reported by the same data producer?
question_2612.ground_truth: A connection from the data producer to the data consumer and information about Trace Session.

question_2613.question: What is the function of the "non-IP" service for CIoT devices in terms of addressing different Application Servers?
question_2613.ground_truth: Since a CIoT UE using "non-IP" has no means to address different Application Servers, a point-to-point tunnel between the UE and the Application Server is established. The destination IP address of the Application Server is defined in the APN.

question_2616.question: What is the purpose of ProSe Direct Discovery in Solution #37?
question_2616.ground_truth: ProSe Direct Discovery in Solution #37 is used for group member UE discovery at the PC5 reference point for groupcast mode communication in both commercial and public safety services.

question_2617.question: What is the difference between the "time slot start" and "transaction start" in the context of data analytics?
question_2617.ground_truth: "Time slot start" refers to the beginning of a time period for which data analytics are requested, while "transaction start" refers to the start of a specific transaction with respect to data analytics.

question_2618.question: What is required before initiating the 5G ProSe direct link establishment procedure by the initiating UE?
question_2618.ground_truth: The initiating UE must receive a request to transmit a packet, be authorized for 5G ProSe direct communication, have an available link layer identifier, know the link layer identifier of the target UE, be in unicast mode, and the 5G ProSe direct link for the pair of peer application layer IDs must not already exist or must meet certain conditions.

question_2619.question: What is the purpose of provisioning security materials in solution #15?
question_2619.ground_truth: The purpose of provisioning security materials in solution #15 is to protect the information exchanged between UEs using group communication for a Ranging/SL Positioning service. The mechanism proposes to provision security materials to the UEs which belong to a particular group for a SL positioning service. By using the provisioned security materials, a UE in the group can send confidentiality and integrity protected messages that include information related to the SL positioning service, and other UEs in the same group can undo the protection of the received messages.

question_2620.question: Which quality of service is associated with the result of interception in a telecommunication system?
question_2620.ground_truth: The quality of service associated with the result of interception should be at least equal to the quality of service of the original content of communication.

question_2621.question: What information does a UE need in order to determine which cells it can access in the Geographical Zones approach?
question_2621.ground_truth: A UE needs information on the geographical definition of the set of geographical zones that it is authorized to access within the satellite beam, which may already be available at logon or may be provided by the PLMN. The UE also needs to determine its own location and the set of cells that are available within the satellite radio coverage, based on the broadcast of SIB on the cells.

question_2622.question: What is the BER requirement for a UTRA carrier when the wanted signal is at the assigned channel frequency and two interfering signals are coupled to the Base Station antenna input?
question_2622.ground_truth: The BER for a UTRA carrier shall not exceed 0.001.

question_2624.question: What must a transmitting participant do to indicate that they no longer want to transmit in the MCData Service?
question_2624.ground_truth: A transmitting participant can indicate to the MCData Service that they no longer want to transmit by using the functionality provided by the service to terminate their communication.

question_2625.question: What is the information included in the positioning message sent by the UE?
question_2625.ground_truth: The positioning message includes the routing identifier for the LMF received in step~19, the UE ID or one of the UE IDs received in step~19, an authentication code to authenticate the UE ID, priority indication received at step~19, a positioning protocol (e.g. LPP) message, and ciphering information received at step~19.

question_2626.question: In what situation would the network re-associate a DRB with a different key?
question_2626.ground_truth: To re-associate a DRB with a different key, the network provides the drb-Identity value in the (target) drb-ToAddModList and sets the reestablishPDCP flag. The network does not list the drb-Identity in the (source) drb-ToReleaseList.

question_2627.question: What is the purpose of an Isolated E-UTRAN in the context of public safety communications?
