question_3321.question: What is the action that the controlling MCVideo function shall perform when receiving a SIP INVITE request for controlling MCVideo function of an ambient viewing call, if the public service identity is not allocated?
question_3321.ground_truth: Perform the actions specified in clause~6.3.7.1 and return a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response with the warning text as specified in "Warning header field".

question_3322.question: What is the modulation scheme applied to the shared data channel in E-UTRAN downlink?
question_3322.ground_truth: Link adaptation (AMC: adaptive modulation and coding) with various modulation schemes and channel coding rates is applied to the shared data channel in E-UTRAN downlink.

question_3323.question: What is the meaning of an error distance of 2 in an Iu UP-Status indication?
question_3323.ground_truth: The error report relates to an error at the other side reported by the upper layers.

question_3324.question: What is the state of the MCPTT Client when the preamble stage ends, as specified in the test procedure?
question_3324.ground_truth: At the end of the preamble stage, the MCPTT Client is in E-UTRA Registered, Idle Mode state, and the MCPTT Client Application has been activated with the User registered-in as the MCPTT User with the Server as active user at the Client.

question_3325.question: What is content preparation in the context of 5G Media Streaming?
question_3325.ground_truth: Content preparation in 5G Media Streaming refers to the process of preparing and/or modifying content, which can be applied in uplink and downlink streaming scenarios. Content preparation can involve uplink ingest content formats, content preparation instructions, and the use of existing formats such as MPEG-2 Transport Stream, CMAF content, and RIST.

question_3326.question: What are the two sub-elements that can be included in the "requested-identity" element?
question_3326.ground_truth: The "requested-identity" element can include either a "VAL-user-id" element or a "VAL-group-id" element.

question_3327.question: What message does UE-1 send to initiate a one-to-one ProSe Direct Communication with UE-2?
question_3327.ground_truth: UE-1 sends a Direct Communication Request message to UE-2.

question_3328.question: What should the IWF performing the controlling role do upon receiving a SIP INVITE request towards an MCPTT group session that has reached its maximum participant count and an existing user in the group session is deemed to have a lower priority?
question_3328.ground_truth: The IWF performing the controlling role should not admit the new user and return a SIP 486 (Busy Here) response with the warning text set to "122 too many participants" to the originating network.

question_3329.question: What information is transmitted by the SS during the connection setup phase?
question_3329.ground_truth: During the connection setup, the SS transmits a Paging message (including PagingRecord with UE-Identity) in Cell 1 and sends a UEInformationRequest message, requesting UE to report idle mode CA/DC measurements.

question_3330.question: Which function is allowed by the Presence interworking between GSM-R and FRMCS Users use case?
question_3330.ground_truth: This use case allows FRMCS User(s) to see the status of GSM-R user(s), and vice versa, by presenting the changed status of GSM-R User B in FRMCS User A, and the changed status of FRMCS User A in GSM-R User B.

question_3332.question: What is the measurement obtained by accumulating the time interval for every successful registration procedure per S-NSSAI per registration type between the receipt by the AMF from the UE of a "REGISTRATION REQUEST" and the sending of a "REGISTRATION ACCEPT" message during a granularity period using DER?
question_3332.ground_truth: The arithmetic mean of the time taken for successful registration procedures.

question_3333.question: What operation is performed to generate the decoder output signal in the AMR-WB codec?
question_3333.ground_truth: The decoder output signal(s) are generated by combining the low and high band signal to produce full band signals, which is the inverse of the encoder band-splitting operation.

question_3334.question: How many bits does the truncated modulation and coding scheme field have in the random access response grant for CEmodeA and B?
question_3334.ground_truth: The truncated modulation and coding scheme field has 4 bits for both CEmodeA and B in the random access response grant.

question_3336.question: What attribute is defined as a restriction of the "xs:string" base type?
question_3336.ground_truth: The "IPAddress-type" is defined as a restriction of the "xs:string" base type.

question_3337.question: What is the procedure for the UE to discover the V2X application server address for downlink transport, as specified in the first step?
question_3337.ground_truth: If the V2X service of the V2X message is identified by a V2X service identifier, and this V2X service identifier is associated with a V2X application server IP address and a TCP port for bidirectional transport in the list of V2X services authorized for V2X communication over LTE-Uu for the serving PLMN and the geographical area in which the UE is located, the UE shall use this IP address and the TCP port for V2X communication over LTE-Uu.

question_3338.question: What information is required by a national regulation for interception based on the HLR using the DF2?
question_3338.ground_truth: National regulations require interception based on the HLR using the DF2 with a delivery through the HI2 interface.

question_3339.question: What are the two main ways to realize the mobile station for the facsimile teleservice within the PLMN?
question_3339.ground_truth: The two main ways to realize the mobile station are by using a separate "Fax Adaptor" device for existing Group 3 facsimile apparatus or by combining a standard group 3 facsimile machine and the Fax Adaptor into a specially developed "PLMN facsimile machine".

question_3340.question: In what scenario should the IBCF set the Through-Connection information element to "sendrecv"?
question_3340.ground_truth: The IBCF should set the Through-Connection information element to "sendrecv" if the received em-param(s) in the P-Early-Media header field is set to "sendrecv".

question_3341.question: What is the DCI format used to schedule uplink data on E-UTRA subframe n-1 for Carrier 2, with a subcarrier spacing of 15 kHz?

question_3342.question: What shall the MS do on receipt of the GA-RRC MODIFY CHANNEL message indicating the CS domain?
question_3342.ground_truth: The MS shall process the specified CTC modifications on receipt of the GA-RRC MODIFY CHANNEL message indicating the CS domain.

question_3344.question: What is the standard command code range allocated by IANA for 3GPP?
question_3344.ground_truth: The standard command code range allocated by IANA for 3GPP is 300-313.

question_3345.question: What is the name of the message flow for satellite backhaul charging in clause 5.2.2.20.2.1?

question_3346.question: How is the main challenge for gNB-side SBFD operation in FR2-1, despite having similar leakage ratio as existing FR2-1 out-of-channel requirements?
question_3346.ground_truth: The main challenge is that PA characteristics need to be carried through a feedback link from the output of the PA, which is more difficult in mmWave for FR2-1 due to signal attenuation, making it significantly more challenging to exploit DPD as in FR1.

question_3349.question: What is the initial condition for message contents in 9.2.33.4.1?
question_3349.ground_truth: The message contents are defined in clause 9.2.33.4.3.

question_3350.question: What is the minimum rate of correct events required during repeated tests?
question_3350.ground_truth: The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests must be at least 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_3351.question: What is the functionality provided by the MCVideo service for controlling camera functions not specifically related to the video stream?
question_3351.ground_truth: The MCVideo service provides the ability for authorized MCVideo Users to control pan, tilt, and zoom (PTZ) functions of cameras, including placing a capable camera in and out of an automatic detection, activation, and tracking mode.

question_3352.question: What is the procedure for an MCData user to trigger remotely the tear down of a point-to-point IP connectivity connection?
question_3352.ground_truth: The MCData user sends an MCData remote IPcon point-to-point tear down request towards the MCData server, which contains the MCData IDs of MCData client 2 and MCData client 3. The MCData server then checks the authorization of the MCData user and the asked MCData client 2 to tear down an IP connectivity point-to-point session.

question_3353.question: What is the function of the Charging function in a GERAN?
question_3353.ground_truth: The Charging function formats and transfers information related to a chargeable event in order to determine usage for which the charged party may be billed.

question_3354.question: How does the UE handle a new 5G-GUTI upon receipt?
question_3354.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a 5GMM message containing a new 5G-GUTI, the UE considers the new 5G-GUTI as valid and the old 5G-GUTI as invalid, stops timer T3519 if running, and deletes any stored SUCI.

question_3356.question: What can happen if the MTSI client in a terminal cannot maintain the required bit rate, frame rate, or quantization parameter in video streaming?
question_3356.ground_truth: If the MTSI client in a terminal cannot maintain the required bit rate, frame rate, or quantization parameter, the video stream might be put on hold, dropped, or the session might be ended.

question_3357.question: What is the purpose of the "createServiceContract" method?
question_3357.ground_truth: The "createServiceContract" method creates a new service contract for an enterprise operator. The enterprise operator provides the service contract description.

question_3358.question: What is the maximum duration of consecutive DTX that can be observed by the SS for the event "DTX" to be counted as a success?
question_3358.ground_truth: No longer than 8 consecutive DTX is observed by the SS.

question_3359.question: What is the maximum achievable time synchronization accuracy between a gNB and a UE without propagation delay compensation for Rel-15 NR with 15kHz SCS?

question_3360.question: What information is included in the access token generated by the hNRF for the NF Service Consumer?
question_3360.ground_truth: The access token includes the NF Instance Id of the NRF (issuer), NF Instance Id of the NF Service Consumer (subject), NF type of the NF Service Producer (audience), expected services name(s), expiration time, and optionally "additional scope" information.

question_3362.question: In what scenarios is the measurement assistance information used by the UE to send access availability/unavailability to the UPF?
question_3362.ground_truth: When the UE is only capable of supporting MPTCP functionality with any steering mode and the ATSSS-LL functionality with only the active-standby steering mode, the MPQUIC functionality with any steering mode and the ATSSS-LL functionality with only the active-standby steering mode, or both of them with any steering mode and the ATSSS-LL functionality with only the active-standby steering mode.

question_3363.question: What is the definition of Tactile Internet in the context of 3GPP Technical Reports?
question_3363.ground_truth: Tactile Internet is a network or network of networks for remotely accessing, perceiving, manipulating, or controlling real or virtual objects or processes in perceived real time by humans or machines.

question_3364.question: What action must the SN take if the MN requests the SN to allocate radio resources for split SRB operation?
question_3364.ground_truth: The SN must store the information provided by the MN and use it when establishing SN terminated bearers.

question_3367.question: What should the UE do when it performs a TAU procedure caused by a RAT change?
question_3367.ground_truth: The UE should transmit a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST with N1 mode capability set to 'N1 mode not supported'.

question_3368.question: What limitations does option 2b have in defining default and deviating namespace and version information?
question_3368.ground_truth: Option 2b cannot define "versions deviating from the default" for MOs that are not derived from ManagedFunction and may not be defined once per SubNetwork instance.

question_3369.question: What are the key pre-conditions for setting up an ad-hoc event based video content broadcasting using 3GPP systems?
question_3369.ground_truth: The source broadcasting mobile must have an internet connection over the 3GPP system and video camera/codec capabilities on their phone. The recipient broadcast receiving mobiles must have the ability to connect to an Ad-Hoc MBMS group.

question_3370.question: What network can the MC service UE switch from, leading to inter-system switching handled by the MC service server?

question_3371.question: What should a node do if the operator agreements require a check for enabling II-NNI traversal scenario type in a SIP request?
question_3371.ground_truth: The node should check its local policy based on the operator agreements before including the II-NNI traversal type in a SIP request to avoid issues with legacy implementations. This helps to prevent forwarding the II-NNI traversal scenario type indication unnecessarily.

question_3372.question: When should a floor participant send the Floor Queue Position Info message?
question_3372.ground_truth: A floor participant should send the Floor Queue Position Info message when the pending request queue is not full and the floor request is received in a session with queuing support.

question_3374.question: What should the Node B do when the DEDICATED MEASUREMENT OBJECT TYPE is indicated as "RL" in the DEDICATED MEASUREMENT INITIATION REQUEST message?
question_3374.ground_truth: The Node B shall measure and report results for all indicated Radio Links if the DEDICATED MEASUREMENT OBJECT TYPE is "RL".

question_3375.question: What is the purpose of charging data records (CDR) in the 3GPP charging architecture?
question_3375.ground_truth: Charging data records (CDR) are a formatted collection of information about a chargeable event for use in billing and accounting. For each party to be charged for parts of or all charges of a chargeable event, a separate CDR shall be generated, i.e. more than one CDR may be generated for a single chargeable event. This allows for the proper and accurate tracking of resource and service usage and charges for billing purposes.

question_3376.question: When sending a SIP BYE request, what should the controlling MCVideo function do when the last MCVideo client is removed from the session?
question_3376.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should stop timer TNG3 (group call timer) if it has not expired.

question_3377.question: What is the format of the Request-URI in the HTTP POST message when the SCF sends a register deregister request to the BM-SC?
question_3377.ground_truth: The Request-URI in the HTTP POST message takes the form of "keymanagement?requesttype= sip-based-deregister".

question_3378.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in relation to Proximity Services (ProSe)?
question_3378.ground_truth: The 3GPP is a partnership that specifies the Stage 2 of the Proximity Services (ProSe) features in EPS. ProSe features consist of ProSe discovery and ProSe Direct Communication.

question_3379.question: What parameter can indicate if the format is alphanumeric or numeric in the SIM/USIM preferred operator list selection?

question_3380.question: What is the function of the MCPTT key management server (KMS) in MCPTT network?
question_3380.ground_truth: The MCPTT key management server (KMS) manages the security domain, and for any endpoint to use or access end-to-end secure communications, it needs to be provisioned with keying material associated with its identity by the KMS.

question_3381.question: Who is able to install or remove third party root public keys on an MExE device?
question_3381.ground_truth: The user is able to securely install or remove third party root public keys at any time using a system administrative tool. The Manufacturer, Operator, and Administrator may also install certificates containing Third Party root public key(s) on behalf of the user, such as at the time of manufacture by the Manufacturer.

question_3382.question: What shall the MRFP do when the maximum record time has elapsed in a multimedia recording?
question_3382.ground_truth: The MRFP shall stop the multimedia recording and save the recorded content to the specified URI if the multimedia recording is successful. If not, the MRFP shall discard the recorded content.

question_3383.question: What are the differences between Collaboration Scenario 4 and Collaboration Scenario 5?
question_3383.ground_truth: In Collaboration Scenario 5, the 5GMSu AS and 5GMSu AF reside in the trusted DN/domain, and the external 5GMSu Application Provider uses the M2u API for content egest. Meanwhile, Collaboration Scenario 4 has the 5GMSu AS and 5GMSu AF in the external DN/domain and follow 3GPP specifications.

question_3384.question: What is the sidelink power control applied for the transmission of Relay discovery messages?
question_3384.ground_truth: The sidelink power control applied for the transmission of Relay discovery messages is the same as for NR sidelink communication.

question_3385.question: What steps are replaced in the tracking area update procedure with Serving GW change in TS 23.401?
question_3385.ground_truth: Step 9a in the tracking area update procedure with Serving GW change in TS 23.401 is replaced by SM Policy Association Modification.

question_3387.question: What is the initial BSIC identification in the context of GSM cells?
question_3387.ground_truth: Initial BSIC identification is the process of searching for and decoding the BSIC of a GSM cell for the first time, when there is no prior knowledge about the relative timing between the E-UTRAN FDD and GSM cells.

question_3388.question: What is the purpose of including a PLMN as part of RANAP signaling in the RAU Request sent to SGSN during a PS handover?
question_3388.ground_truth: The purpose of including a PLMN as part of RANAP signaling in the RAU Request sent to SGSN during a PS handover is for the RNC to select a PLMN.

question_3389.question: What should the non-controlling MCVideo function of an MCVideo group do if the partner MCVideo system does not have a mutual aid relationship with the primary MCVideo system identified by the contents of the P-Asserted-Identity?
question_3389.ground_truth: The non-controlling MCVideo function should reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and set the warning text to "128 isfocus already assigned" in a Warning header field.

question_3390.question: When would the IRI-POI in the PTC server generate an xIRI containing a PTCSessionEnd record?
question_3390.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the PTC server generates the xIRI containing a PTCSessionEnd record when the IRI-POI present in the PTC server detects that the PTC session is released for any reason (i.e. normal or abnormal release) and voice communications ends.

question_3391.question: What is the procedure for selecting a PLMN/access technology combination when the MS supports CAG and is provisioned with a "CAG information list"?
question_3391.ground_truth: The MS first considers the HPLMN or the highest priority EHPLMN if the EHPLMN list is present. If registration fails, the MS then considers PLMN/access technology combinations in the "User Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology" and "Operator Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology" data files, and finally any available PLMN/access technology combinations with high signal quality.

question_3393.question: What requirement must be fulfilled by the SGSN for sending the Update CSG Location Procedure with CSS?
question_3393.ground_truth: The UE initiates the RAU procedure in a VPLMN supporting Autonomous CSG Roaming, and the HPLMN has enabled Autonomous CSG Roaming in the VPLMN via Service Level Agreement.

question_3395.question: What is the minimum required change for the second digit in the document versioning used by 3GPP?
question_3395.ground_truth: Substance changes, such as technical enhancements, corrections, or updates

question_3398.question: In which database(s) is the UE Reachability Request Parameter (URRP) conditionally stored?
question_3398.ground_truth: URRP is conditionally stored in the MME, SGSN, and HSS.

question_3399.question: What is the pre-condition for delivering popular video content using the multicast / broadcast function of the 3GPP system?
question_3399.ground_truth: The pre-condition for delivering popular video content using the multicast / broadcast function of the 3GPP system is that wireless operator A has deployed a 3GPP system and that three types of broadcast content caching entities, X, Y and Z have been deployed within the network. Entity X is co-located with the integrated terminal/set-top box, Entity Y is co-located with the radio site M, and Entity Z is located at a local aggregation point.

question_3400.question: How does the slice enabler layer support the translation of requirements from different verticals?
question_3400.ground_truth: The slice enabler layer acts as a mediator between the vertical customer and the 5GS to decompose and translate the requirements of different verticals. It decomposes vertical requirements into specific network parameters and translates them into 5GS network requirements. The service provided by the slice enabler layer can be from the control plane, management plane, or SA6 slice enabler layer itself.

question_3403.question: What message does the target I-SMF send to the target I-UPF to release all resources allocated for the N4 session?
question_3403.ground_truth: Target I-SMF to Target I-UPF: N4 Session Release Request

question_3404.question: What is the Global eNB ID IE used for in the Write-Replace Warning Request message?
question_3404.ground_truth: The Global eNB ID IE is used to identify the eNodeB in the Write-Replace Warning Request message.

question_3409.question: What is a requirement for the use of a third-party specific user identity in the solution described in section 6.2.2.1?
question_3409.ground_truth: The requirement is that the third-party Authorization Server must be authorized by the serving IMS network to provide the third-party specific user identity for a specific group of UEs.

question_3410.question: What is the sublayer of L2 that is responsible for adapting broadcast and multicast services on the radio interface in 3GPP networks?

question_3411.question: What must the UE check when receiving the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message in order to determine if it can be accepted?
question_3411.ground_truth: When the UE receives the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message, it must check the integrity of the message and ensure that the Replayed UE security capabilities IE has not been altered compared to the latest values it sent to the network.

question_3412.question: If an end-to-end security context needs to be established, what must the MCData client do when generating a PCK to protect one-to-one communications?
question_3412.ground_truth: The MCData client must encrypt the PCK to a UID associated to the MCData client using the MCData ID of the invited user and a time-related parameter.

question_3414.question: What are the two transparent containers defined for the PS handover in GERAN A/Gb mode and GAN mode?
question_3414.ground_truth: The two transparent containers defined for the PS handover in GERAN A/Gb mode and GAN mode are Source BSS to Target BSS Transparent Container and Target BSS to Source BSS Transparent Container.

question_3415.question: What should be the first step taken in the procedure for management of PFDs where there is any change to the PFD (s) due to pull mode or push mode procedure?
question_3415.ground_truth: PGW-C/TDF-C sends PFD management request to the PGW-U/TDF-U to provision/update/remove the PFD (s) when there is any change to the PFD (s) due to pull mode or push mode procedure.

question_3418.question: In the context of 3GPP, what does the term "E-DCH" refer to?

question_3419.question: What is the basic approach used for amplitude quantization in PPP coding?
question_3419.ground_truth: The DFS amplitude is first normalized by two scaling factors at the encoder, one for the low band and one for the high band. These scaling factors are vector-quantized in the logarithmic domain and transmitted to the decoder. The normalized spectrum is non-uniformly-downsampled/averaged to transform a variable dimension vector to a fixed dimension vector. The downsampled spectrum is then split into a low band and high band spectra, each of which is separately quantized.

question_3420.question: What is the difference between power control for inter-band and intra-band concurrent NR V2X transmissions?
question_3420.ground_truth: For inter-band concurrent NR V2X transmissions, the requirements specified in clause 6.3.4 shall apply for the uplink in licensed band, while for intra-band concurrent NR V2X transmissions, the same clause 6.3.4 applies for both the uplink and sidelink in the licensed band.

question_3422.question: What is the role of the NAF Key Center in the key establishment process using a shared-key based mutual authentication between the Terminal and the NAF Key Center?
question_3422.ground_truth: The NAF Key Center is responsible for establishing a secure tunnel with the Terminal for the key establishment process. This secure tunnel can be based on a shared-key based mutual authentication between the Terminal and the NAF Key Center using PSK TLS.

question_3423.question: What was the quality rating for r1, r2, and r3 in Test 2 HIQ?
question_3423.ground_truth: r1, r2, and r3 scored "Good" in Test 2 HIQ.

question_3425.question: What attribute must the MCVideo server include in the <affiliation> element in the MIME body indicating per-group dynamic data?

question_3426.question: In what form are the floor control messages and application layer paging messages transmitted along with the MC media over the same MBS session?
question_3426.ground_truth: The application layer signalling such as the floor control messages, application layer paging messages are transmitted along with the MC media over the same MBS session however with different QoS requirements.

question_3427.question: How are "modal verbs" used in the document?
question_3427.ground_truth: Modal verbs, like "shall" and "shall not," indicate mandatory requirements, interdictions, recommendations, permissions, possibility, or impossibility in the normative elements of the document.

question_3428.question: What response message does the PCF send upon successful deletion of an Individual MBS Policy?
question_3428.ground_truth: The PCF responds with an HTTP "204 No Content" status code.

question_3429.question: What procedure is specified in 3GPP TS 23.402 subclause 7.11..1 for bearer modification that requires the notification of SA2?
question_3429.ground_truth: The Sting PDN GW Initiated Bearer Modification procedure.

question_3430.question: What is the function of the Group Host Function within the MCPTT AS in the IMS architecture?
question_3430.ground_truth: The Group Host Function within the MCPTT AS is responsible for hosting the MCPTT Group call, which is equivalent to the Controlling Function (CF) in OMA PCPS Architecture Document.

question_3431.question: What is the purpose of the paging procedure in the network?
question_3431.ground_truth: The paging procedure is used by the network to cause the MS to establish either an RR connection for circuit switched services or a downlink TBF for EGPRS packet transfer.

question_3432.question: What action does the SS (Signaling Server) take if it receives a CANCEL request to terminate the pending INVITE transaction?
question_3432.ground_truth: SS sends ACK to the UE, expects and receives 200 OK for CANCEL from the UE, and expects and receives 487 Request Terminated for INVITE from the UE.

question_3433.question: What is the impact on the message waiting indication (MWI) service when identities are shared?
question_3433.ground_truth: The MWI is not supported for the identities, which are shared.

question_3435.question: How many gain states are considered for a full-power PA and half-power PA in Method 1 of the analysis?
question_3435.ground_truth: For a full-power PA, three gain states are considered, and for a half-power PA, three gain states are also considered.

question_3436.question: What is the purpose of Ambient Listening in MCPTT?
question_3436.ground_truth: The purpose of Ambient Listening in MCPTT is to allow an authorized MCPTT User, typically a dispatcher, to initiate a call resulting in no indication on the MCPTT UE that it is transmitting. Ambient listening can be initiated by an authorized MCPTT User who wants to be listened to by another remote authorized MCPTT User or by a remote authorized MCPTT User who wants to listen to another MCPTT User. This feature is used for stolen MCPTT UEs, monitoring officers, officer safety and particular operations, where it is important that the MCPTT UE does not indicate what is happening.

question_3437.question: What is a requirement for the NWDAF containing AnLF to access multiple ML models in Key Issue #10?
question_3437.ground_truth: Each ML model needs to have a unique identifier within the PLMN, and an NWDAF containing AnLF should be able to get all available ML models for a specific Analytics ID from an NWDAF containing MTLF.

question_3438.question: What is the basic design requirement for NR-U SS/PBCH transmission?
question_3438.ground_truth: NR-U should have a signal that contains at least SS/PBCH block burst set transmission.

question_3439.question: What type of audio/video DASH Media Presentation does the first User Service carry?
question_3439.ground_truth: The first User Service carries an English audio track audio/video DASH Media Presentation.

question_3441.question: When is it necessary to start mac-ContentionResolutionTimer and restart at each HARQ retransmission of the bundle in the subframe containing the last repetition of the corresponding PUSCH transmission?
question_3441.ground_truth: This will occur when, for EDT, edt-SmallTBS-Enabled is not set to TRUE for the corresponding PRACH resource.

question_3443.question: What is the purpose of down-sampling or up-sampling in the content re-targeting operation?
question_3443.ground_truth: The purpose of down-sampling or up-sampling is to match the depth information (disparity map) to the new viewing distance, screen resolution, and pixel density.

question_3444.question: What is the input power level that the Home BS receiver must meet the requirements for, as specified at the Home BS antenna connector?
question_3444.ground_truth: The input power level is specified at 0 dBi for Home BSs without measurement capability.

question_3446.question: What is the primary objective of the test in 8.1.8.1 and which time domain measurement resource restriction pattern is applied in this test?
question_3446.ground_truth: The primary objective of the test in 8.1.8.1 is to verify that the UE correctly detects and reports Event A3 under a time domain measurement resource restriction pattern. A time domain measurement resource restriction pattern is applied in this test.

question_3447.question: How does Solution #37 propose to handle UE inactivity with a given S-NSSAI?
question_3447.ground_truth: Solution #37 proposes to deregister the slice once slice inactivity is detected by AMF, and release the PDU session once the slice inactivity is detected at UE end. The UE PDU session status and Allowed NSSAI will be always synchronized with the network later. Solution #37 also supports passing the control of handling UE inactivity to the UE, relieving a serving AMF or SMF load.

question_3448.question: What functionalities are required to be supported by the MC service server and the MC service clients for 5G MBS session group communications?
question_3448.ground_truth: The MC service server and the MC service clients are required to support the different functionalities related to the 5G MBS session in order to support the MC service group communications over 5G MBS sessions.

question_3449.question: What is the probability threshold that the probability of re-selection from Cell 1 to Cell 2 during T2 observed during testing should meet or exceed?

question_3450.question: What information is provided by the Type 2 power headroom in Power Headroom Reporting?
question_3450.ground_truth: The Type 2 power headroom provides the difference between the nominal UE maximum transmit power and the estimated power for UL-SCH and PUCCH transmission on SpCell of the other MAC entity (i.e. E-UTRA MAC entity in EN-DC, NE-DC, and NGEN-DC cases).

question_3452.question: What is the role of the group management server in the process of group regrouping in the MC system?
question_3452.ground_truth: The group management server is responsible for checking if the group regroup operation is authorized, creating and storing the information of the temporary group, notifying the IWF and the MC service server of the group regroup operation, and providing a group regroup response to the group management client.

question_3453.question: What is the mandatory mode of operation for NR UEs supporting MBS?
question_3453.ground_truth: UE test loop mode C is mandatory for NR UEs supporting MBS.

question_3454.question: What is the test object specified in 27.22.4.11.4.2.4.2 for the ME to operate on?
question_3454.ground_truth: The test object is Expected Sequence 4.2A or 4.2B, which are SEND SS commands with specific parameters and attributes to test the ME's operation.

question_3455.question: What is the CRITICALITY of the informationExchangeInitiation PCAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?
question_3455.ground_truth: The CRITICALITY of the informationExchangeInitiation PCAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE is reject.

question_3456.question: What command controls whether or not an extended format of incoming call indication is used in GPRS?

question_3457.question: What happens to the UE's discontinuous coverage wait timer upon returning to coverage after being out of coverage due to discontinuous coverage?
question_3457.ground_truth: The UE shall stop the discontinuous coverage wait timer and initiate NAS signalling if the UE receives paging message, has pending emergency services or when UE enters a TAI outside the registration area.

question_3458.question: What must the transmission participant do upon receiving a granted response for Receive media request message?
question_3458.ground_truth: Provide receive media success notification to the user and enter the 'U: has permission to receive' state.

question_3459.question: What are the possible target identifier formats in the ETSI TS 103 221-1 messages for provisioning the MDF2?
question_3459.ground_truth: The possible target identifier formats in the ETSI TS 103 221-1 messages for provisioning the MDF2 are SUPIIMSI, SUPINAI, GPSIMSISDN, GPSINAI, IMSI, and MSISDN.

question_3460.question: What is the role of the PDN GW in the proxy binding acknowledgement step?
question_3460.ground_truth: The PDN GW processes the proxy binding update and allocates IP address(es) for the UE. It then sends a Proxy Binding Acknowledgement message to the Serving GW, containing the MN NAI, Lifetime, UE Address Info, GRE key for uplink traffic, Charging ID, and Additional Parameters.

question_3462.question: How is the policy for H(e)NB validation divided?
question_3462.ground_truth: The policy is divided into two parts: locally stored policy in HeNB, and network stored policy.

question_3463.question: Which device is specified as the source device in the "PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP MENU 1.2.1"?
question_3463.ground_truth: The source device is specified as "SIM".

question_3465.question: What is the maximum number of retransmissions allowed for an HS-DSCH transport block when using CRC attachment method 2 and HS-SCCH type 2?
question_3465.ground_truth: The maximum number of retransmissions allowed for an HS-DSCH transport block when using CRC attachment method 2 and HS-SCCH type 2 is two.

question_3467.question: What does the Serving GW do after receiving the Delete Bearer Command message?
question_3467.ground_truth: The Serving GW sends the Delete Bearer Command (EPS Bearer Identity) message to the PDN GW.

question_3468.question: How does Group 2 propose to change paging strategies to avoid PF/PO collision for multi-USIM devices?
question_3468.ground_truth: Solutions in Group 2, like #18 and partial #17, suggest changing paging strategies to avoid PF/PO collision, such as paging on consecutive POs or using UE assistant info to influence paging strategy. However, these changes may increase paging resource usage, delay, and affect RAN paging implementation.

question_3471.question: What is used for transferring substream numbering information in the parallel data substreams between Split/Combine-functions?
question_3471.ground_truth: The status bits S1, S3, and the X-bit between data bits D12 and D13 are used for transferring substream numbering information in the parallel data substreams between Split/Combine-functions.

question_3472.question: Who initiates the Paging procedure in the specified context?
question_3472.ground_truth: The AMF initiates the Paging procedure by sending the PAGING message to the NG-RAN node.

question_3473.question: Which nodes must obtain trusted network provided NPLI and why is this important?
question_3473.ground_truth: IMS nodes may require the network to provide the NPLI of the UE upon the following events, and the network shall not provide it to non-trusted entities. This is important for security and privacy reasons, as well as for legal obligations and operational needs.

question_3474.question: What happens to the radio bearer and E-RAB after a period of inactivity?
question_3474.ground_truth: The radio bearer and E-RAB are released after a period of inactivity.

question_3476.question: What type is used for the qos-flow-id attribute in the QoSFlow-info complex type and what is its data type?

question_3477.question: What is the impact of ProSe discovery on existing entities and interfaces?
question_3477.ground_truth: ProSe discovery requires changes to the application and procedures for allocation of expressions from the ProSe Manager, broadcasting expressions on the air interface, and authorization and provisioning from DPF for using ProSe discovery in the UE. The RAN also needs to signal the resources used for ProSe discovery.

question_3479.question: What should the transmission participant do upon receiving a SIP INVITE message for an On-demand Pre-arranged Imminent Peril Group Call and the MCVideo User answers the call?
question_3479.ground_truth: The MCVideo Client should respond to the SS (MCVideo Server) with a SIP 200 (OK) message.

question_3481.question: What is the process of PDU Session release by the AMF during network slice termination?
question_3481.ground_truth: The AMF releases inactive PDU Sessions first and then checks whether the active PDU Sessions are for emergency, critical, or priority services. If they are not, the AMF releases the active PDU Sessions after a predefined period of time. If they are, the AMF keeps the PDU Sessions for an operator's predefined period of time before releasing them.

question_3482.question: What is the purpose of the GPRS timer 3 information element?
question_3482.ground_truth: The purpose of the GPRS timer 3 information element is to specify GPRS specific timer values, e.g. for the timer T3396.

question_3485.question: Which type of invoker, residing outside the PLMN trust domain, can access service APIs from 3rd party API providers via CAPIF-2e interactions after onboarding to the PLMN operator's CAPIF?
question_3485.ground_truth: An API invoker residing outside the PLMN trust domain can access service APIs from 3rd party API providers via CAPIF-2e interactions after onboarding to the PLMN operator's CAPIF.

question_3488.question: What is the role of the line spectral pairs (LSPs) in speech processing?
question_3488.ground_truth: The line spectral pairs (LSPs) are a set of parameters that represent the spectral envelope of the speech signal in the cosine domain, which are used to quantize and code the LPC coefficients in speech processing applications.

question_3489.question: In the XML syntax for a reception report request, what does the "fileURI" element represent?
question_3489.ground_truth: The "fileURI" element in the XML syntax for a reception report request represents a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) for a file.

question_3491.question: What should the UE do when the timer T3585 is running upon entering state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED and remains the same when the UE switches on again, if the UE is not capable of determining the time elapsed between switch off and switch on?
question_3491.ground_truth: The UE shall restart the timer T3585 with the value t1, where t1 is the time remaining for T3585 timeout at switch off.

question_3492.question: What potential security requirement aims to minimize the impact of a compromised MCX UE on other MCX UEs?

question_3494.question: What is the scope of the test procedure for IMS MO call establishment in 5GC?
question_3494.ground_truth: The purpose of this procedure is to establish an IMS MO speech call in 5GC.

question_3495.question: What tolerance should be assumed for frame boundary alignment when deriveSSB-IndexFromCell is enabled in a UE?
question_3495.ground_truth: The tolerance for frame boundary alignment when deriveSSB-IndexFromCell is enabled in a UE is min(2 SSB symbols, 1 PDSCH symbol) for sub-carrier spacing of SSB and PDSCH up-to 240 kHz, and min (3 SSB symbols, NPDSCH PDSCH symbols) for sub-carrier spacing of 480 kHz and 960kHz of either SSB or PDSCH.

question_3496.question: What is the role of the Viterbi algorithm (VA) in a rate-1/2 convolutional code?
question_3496.ground_truth: The Viterbi algorithm (VA) is used to find the minimum distortion path in a rate-1/2 convolutional code.

question_3497.question: What are the network's responsibilities in handling alternate speech/facsimile group 3 service calls in 3GPP TS 27 series?
question_3497.ground_truth: The network should provide a rapid and reliable changeover of capability upon request from the mobile user during the alternate speech/facsimile group 3 service calls and initiate the changeover on the receipt of the "MODIFY" message from the UE.

question_3498.question: What conditions must be met for the test in 8.22.8 to pass?
question_3498.ground_truth: The total number of successful tests must be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

question_3499.question: What format could be used to send the device trigger from the network to the UE in option A?
question_3499.ground_truth: The device trigger could be sent in NAS format but using NAS as a transport in SMS format.

question_3501.question: How many times is the test sequence executed in the test for invalid frequency parameters?
question_3501.ground_truth: The test sequence is executed five times in the test for invalid frequency parameters.

question_3503.question: What is the purpose of Charging Gateway Functionality (CGF)?
question_3503.ground_truth: The Charging Gateway Functionality (CGF) is a function of the Offline Charging System (OFCS), which is used for offline charging.

question_3504.question: What is the role of the position estimate computation in UE positioning methods?
question_3504.ground_truth: The position estimate computation may be made by the UE or by the LMF in UE positioning methods.

question_3506.question: What is the role of the IpAppUIAdminManager in the application generic user interaction administration service package?
question_3506.ground_truth: The IpAppUIAdminManager is an interface that handles callbacks in the application generic user interaction administration service package.

question_3510.question: What is the NGAP UE-TNLA-binding in the context of 5G AN?
question_3510.ground_truth: NGAP UE-TNLA-binding refers to the association of a UE with a specific TNL in the 5G AN node. This binding is updated by the AMF at any time while the UE is in CM-CONNECTED state, such as when changing TNL associations for the UE, or releasing the NGAP UE-TNLA-binding for a UE while maintaining N3 (user-plane connectivity) for the UE.

question_3511.question: What entity is responsible for generating alternative QoS Parameter Sets based on the RT latency requirement?

question_3512.question: When must the UE check for the presence of the "outbound" option tag in the Require header field if the REGISTER request contains certain parameters?
question_3512.ground_truth: The UE must check for the presence of the "outbound" option tag in the Require header field if the REGISTER request contains the "reg-id" and "+sip.instance" Contact header field parameter and the "outbound" option tag in a Supported header field.

question_3513.question: How is the median CQI value determined for each stream?
question_3513.ground_truth: The median CQI value is determined by setting up a relative frequency distribution for the reported CQI values for each stream and calculating the median value (Median CQI is the CQI that is at or crosses 50% distribution from the lower CQI side). This CQI-value is declared as the Median CQI value for that stream.

question_3514.question: What action should the network take if the MS has indicated support of PS inter-RAT handover from GERAN to UTRAN Iu mode in the ROUTING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message and the network accepts it?
question_3514.ground_truth: Include a request to provide the Inter RAT information container in the ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message.

question_3515.question: What is the difference between the states "Gs-NULL" and "Gs-ASSOCIATED" at the VLR in the 3GPP system?
question_3515.ground_truth: In "Gs-NULL" state, the VLR considers that the MS is IMSI detached for GPRS services, and sends no BSSAP+-MS-INFORMATION-REQUEST or BSSAP+-MM-INFORMATION-REQUEST messages to the SGSN. In "Gs-ASSOCIATED" state, the VLR considers that the MS is attached to both GPRS and non-GPRS services, and sends BSSAP+-PAGING-REQUEST messages to MSs in class-A and class-B mode of operation via only the Gs interface.

question_3516.question: What is the name of the message flow for Edge Computing charging with satellite backhaul in clause 5.2.2.20.2.2?
question_3516.ground_truth: Edge Computing charging with satellite backhaul

question_3517.question: What element specifies the interval for periodic reports to be sent to the VAE-C?
question_3517.ground_truth: The "periodic-report" element specifies the interval for periodic reports to be sent to the VAE-C.

question_3519.question: In EGPRS, what are the conditions under which a mobile station can choose an alternate MCS for the initial transmission of the last RLC data blocks of a TBF?
question_3519.ground_truth: The alternate MCS must be more robust than the commanded MCS, it must have already been commanded by the network during the TBF or must have been available for selection by the MS during the TBF, and the TBF must require no more radio blocks for initial transmission of the RLC data blocks using the alternate MCS than it would with the commanded MCS.

question_3520.question: What should the mobile station do if it has transmitted the maximum number of RLC data blocks without receiving a PACKET~UPLINK~ACK/NACK message in SBPSCH?
question_3520.ground_truth: The mobile station should start timer T3182 and upon its expiration, perform an abnormal release with access retry.

question_3521.question: How does the UE determine the downlink transmit energy per resource element?
question_3521.ground_truth: The UE determines the downlink transmit energy per resource element based on the information received from the eNodeB. For the purpose of RSRP and RSRQ measurements, the UE may assume that downlink cell-specific RS EPRE is constant across the downlink system bandwidth and subframes with discovery signal transmissions until different cell-specific RS power information is received. For a cell that is not a LAA SCell, the UE may assume that downlink cell-specific RS EPRE is constant across the downlink system bandwidth and subframes with or without discovery signal transmissions.

question_3524.question: What is the requirement for the Block Error Ratio for USF/MCS-1 to 4 when using GMSK modulation and TUhigh faded wanted signal with TUhigh adjacent channel interferer under adjacent channel interference conditions with interfering signals at 200 kHz above and below the wanted signal frequency and at the adjacent interference ratio (C/Ia2) exceeding C/Ic - 50dB?
question_3524.ground_truth: The Block Error Ratio for USF/MCS-1 to 4 when using GMSK modulation and TUhigh faded wanted signal with TUhigh adjacent channel interferer under adjacent channel interference conditions with interfering signals at 200 kHz above and below the wanted signal frequency and at the adjacent interference ratio (C/Ia2) exceeding C/Ic - 50dB should not exceed 1%.

question_3525.question: What is the purpose of the "ProtocolIEs" field in the "RadioLinkAdditionResponseFDD" sequence in NBAP?
question_3525.ground_truth: The "ProtocolIEs" field in the "RadioLinkAdditionResponseFDD" sequence specifies the protocol IEs used in NBAP for FDD. It includes a mandatory "c-ID" element, while the other elements are optional.

question_3526.question: What condition triggers the MS to activate a PDP context?
question_3526.ground_truth: The MS activates a PDP context when the ACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message is over the threshold for main DCCH use, forcing the MS not to use the main DCCH for this signalling message.

question_3527.question: What should be included in the Transmission Indicator field if the receive media request is a broadcast group call, system call, emergency call or an imminent peril call?
question_3527.ground_truth: The relevant call types should be indicated in the Transmission Indicator field.

question_3528.question: What must the NAF indicate to the BSF to request key material for a specific Ua security protocol?
question_3528.ground_truth: The NAF shall be able to indicate to the BSF the protocol identifier of the Ua security protocol for which it requires the key material.

question_3529.question: What is the one-way end-to-end maximum latency target when performed by the cellular network?
question_3529.ground_truth: The one-way end-to-end maximum latency targets are 10 seconds for longer latency and 1 second for shorter latency.

question_3531.question: What does the "MBSMeasurementList-Element" sequence contain?
question_3531.ground_truth: The "MBSMeasurementList-Element" sequence contains information about the measurement of the MBS system, including the transmitterID, codephase, codephaseRMS, and iE-Extensions.

question_3532.question: What is required for the user plane function in handling partial failure on the control plane node?
question_3532.ground_truth: The user plane function (e.g. SGW-U or PGW-U) is required to store the FQ-CSID allocated by the control plane node to handle the possible partial failure on the control plane.

question_3533.question: What shall be the "unspecified connection address" for IPv4 implementations?
question_3533.ground_truth: The "unspecified connection address" shall be defined by the IPv4 unspecified address (c= IN IP4 0.0.0.0) for IPv4 implementations.

question_3534.question: What is the term used to describe a measurement that is not defined as an intra-frequency measurement?

question_3536.question: What should the UE do if the UE receives a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message with the 5GSM cause value #69 and the ABO bit is not set, and no Back-off timer value is received?
question_3536.ground_truth: The UE may send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message or PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message for the same S-NSSAI.

question_3539.question: What should the initiating client do if the terminating client determines that the security domains used by the initiating client are not permitted?
question_3539.ground_truth: The terminating client may send a KRR message containing permitted security domains back to the initiating client. The initiating client may then perform a procedure to select a new KMS URI and repeat the communication process.

question_3541.question: What are the four scenarios described in section 5.1?
question_3541.ground_truth: The four scenarios described in section 5.1 are: GERAN GWCN, non-DTM, combined procedures; UTRAN/GERAN MOCN, no combined procedures (Pool Centric and Operator Centric); UTRAN/GERAN MOCN, combined procedures; and UTRAN/GERAN GWCN, no combined procedures.

question_3542.question: What is the purpose of the monitoring UE procedure for UE-to-UE relay discovery?
question_3542.ground_truth: The purpose of the monitoring UE procedure for UE-to-UE relay discovery is to enable a ProSe-enabled UE to become aware of proximity of a connectivity service provided by a 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE, upon a request from upper layers, or to enable a ProSe-enabled UE to perform measurements of signal strength of PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY messages from 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE(s) for UE-to-UE relay selection/reselection.

question_3543.question: What is the condition that a CSCS is not empty in OACS determination?
question_3543.ground_truth: A CSCS is not empty in OACS determination if both radio legs support ACS change and there is a common set of supported codec modes.

question_3544.question: What is the role of the RUA in the ICCF during registration procedures?
question_3544.ground_truth: During registration procedures, the RUA in the ICCF performs a trusted registration on behalf of the UE, allowing the ICCF to register a CS UE based on the fact that it can be verified that the UE has been authenticated in the CS domain. This registration allows the I-CSCF and S-CSCF to derive the IMPI based on the T-IMPU.

question_3545.question: What is the threshold for the SNR value in time duration T1 during subtest 1 and subtest 2?
question_3545.ground_truth: The SNR value in time duration T1 during subtest 1 is -22.0 dB and in subtest 2 is -14.4 dB.

question_3546.question: Why is custom H.263 integration required for devices other than those using the OS?
question_3546.ground_truth: This is because not all devices use this OS, like watches for example, and hence would require custom integration for H.263.

question_3547.question: What should an MCPTT floor participant do upon receiving a Floor Granted message, given that the User ID field in the message matches its own MCPTT ID and the SSRC of the floor participant sending the message matches the stored SSRC of the current arbitrator?
question_3547.ground_truth: The MCPTT floor participant should request the MCPTT client to stop rendering received RTP media packets, set its own SSRC as the stored SSRC of the current floor arbitrator, stop timer T203 and T201 if they are running, provide a floor granted notification to the MCPTT user, and enter 'O: has permission' state.

question_3548.question: What should the system simulator set as the PCell, PSCell on FR2, and inter-frequency neighbor cell on FR2, for the pre-test conditions in 8.2.3.11.2.3.1?
question_3548.ground_truth: E-UTRA Cell 1 is PCell, NR Cell 1 is PSCell on FR2 and NR Cell 3 is inter-frequency neighbor Cell on FR2.

question_3549.question: What should the IWF do when processing a SIP re-INVITE request for an in-progress emergency call cancellation and the <emergency-ind> element is set to "false", and the request is an authorized request but the in-progress emergency state is "true"?
question_3549.ground_truth: The IWF should validate that the SIP re-INVITE request includes a Resource-Priority header field is populated correctly. If not, the IWF should perform the actions specified in clause~6.6.3.1.5 and, upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP UPDATE request sent in clause~6.6.3.1.5, proceed with the rest of the steps. After validation, set the in-progress emergency group state of the group to "false" and clear the cache of the MCPTT ID of the MCPTT user identified as having an outstanding MCPTT emergency group call.

question_3553.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 5.3.2.2.3.4.1?
question_3553.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the behavior of the random access procedure and that the MsgA PRACH and MsgA PUSCH power settings and timing are within specified limits.

question_3554.question: How is the constrained regional probability calculated in the 'OR combining' method?
question_3554.ground_truth: In the 'OR combining' method, the constrained regional probability for each point is considered '1' if that point is successful in at least one of the AoA pairs it participates in.

question_3555.question: What transmission mode should the AAS BS be set to in step 1 of the UTRA FDD Procedure (6.6.3.4.2.2) for single carrier tests?

question_3556.question: What is the condition for counting a success for the event "ACK/NACK" during the test?
question_3556.ground_truth: More than 99.5% of uplink transmissions are received by SS.

question_3557.question: What is the attribute name of the media level type that is not subject to the charset attribute and allows bypassing of a border gateway in networks with OMR procedures?

question_3560.question: When is the Network-based IP flow mobility information used?
question_3560.ground_truth: The NBIFOM container is used to transfer information associated with network-based IP flow mobility.

question_3561.question: What is the purpose of the UE identifying whether PO collisions can occur in Solution #19?
question_3561.ground_truth: The UE identifies whether PO collisions can occur to minimize the impact of page loss due to collisions.

question_3562.question: What are the contents of the SIP INVITE message when the MCVideo user requests the establishment of an On-demand Pre-arranged Imminent Peril Group Call?
question_3562.ground_truth: The UE (MCVideo Client) sends a SIP INVITE message to setup the Imminent Peril Group Call.

question_3564.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification (TS) in the document presented?
question_3564.ground_truth: The purpose of the 3GPP TS in the document presented is to describe and define the measurements for FDD done at the UE and network in order to support operation in idle mode and connected mode.

question_3565.question: What message does the LMF send to the gNB to request Multi-RTT measurement information?
question_3565.ground_truth: The LMF sends a NRPPa message to the selected gNB to request Multi-RTT measurement information.

question_3566.question: What is required for the PCEF to identify lost Diameter sessions and find related network elements with the PCRF?
question_3566.ground_truth: An AVP or AVPs are required for transferring the Diameter session ID and network entity address information between the PCRF and PCEF/BBERF.

question_3567.question: What is the maximum number of FDD inter-frequencies that a UE is required to be capable of performing RSRP and RSRQ measurements for?
question_3567.ground_truth: The UE is required to be capable of performing RSRP and RSRQ measurements for up to 2 FDD inter-frequencies.

question_3569.question: What is the behavior of a RLOS attached UE when it is not authenticated?
question_3569.ground_truth: For an RLOS attached UE, i.e. for UEs that have only RLOS EPS bearers established, there is no AS security context information included in the S1 control messages and there is no NAS level security when the UE has not been authenticated.

question_3571.question: In which mode is the FD-CNG noise levels used for estimating the noise spectrum in the CNA?
question_3571.ground_truth: DTX-on mode and provided that FD-CNG is triggered

question_3572.question: When a 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay needs to establish RRC Connection for emergency service while a 5G ProSe Remote UE has requested emergency service over the PC5 link, which RRC establishment cause should be used by the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay?
question_3572.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay should use RRC establishment cause "emergency" when it needs to establish an RRC Connection for emergency service while a 5G ProSe Remote UE has requested emergency service over the PC5 link.

question_3573.question: In which messages is the Management Based MDT PLMN List IE included to communicate user consent in the case of EN-DC and NR-DC?
question_3573.ground_truth: In the case of EN-DC, the Management Based MDT PLMN List IE is included in the INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message and, optionally, in the SGNB ADDITION REQUEST message sent to the gNB-CU-CP. In the case of NR-DC, the Management Based MDT PLMN List IE is included in the INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message sent to the MN and in the S-NODE ADDITION REQUEST message sent to the SgNB-CU-CP.

question_3575.question: What message is sent by the NEF in response to the HTTP PATCH request sent by the (H-) PCF to the "Individual PDTQ Policy" resource?
question_3575.ground_truth: The NEF sends an HTTP PATCH response message to the AF.

question_3576.question: In order to ensure start time of data delivery using MBMS, what must the system consider for alignment with the UE availability in a group?
question_3576.ground_truth: The system needs to confirm that the UEs are not in "deep sleep mode" (such as PSM or eDRX) and can receive the multicast/broadcast message at the desired time. This is important for minimizing latency and delivering multicast/broadcast data efficiently.

question_3581.question: What are the two optional features introduced for RedCap UEs in RRC idle/inactive states?
question_3581.ground_truth: The two optional features introduced for RedCap UEs in RRC idle/inactive states are Extended DRX cycles and RRM measurement relaxation for neighbor cells.

question_3582.question: What is the data type for the "radioFrequency" element in the schema?
question_3582.ground_truth: The data type for the "radioFrequency" element is "xs:unsignedInt".

question_3583.question: What AVP should be populated with the value received within the imsi parameter of PurgeMS-Arg while constructing a PUR command in step 8.4.3?
question_3583.ground_truth: The User-Name AVP should be populated with the value received within the imsi parameter of PurgeMS-Arg while constructing a PUR command in step 8.4.3.

question_3585.question: What are the two separate warning types in ETWS?
question_3585.ground_truth: The two separate warning types in ETWS are the ETWS Primary Notification and the ETWS Secondary Notification, with different delivery requirements.

question_3587.question: What is the procedure called for re-establishing the user plane for one or more PDU Sessions associated with non-3GPP access for a N5CW device in the CM-CONNECTED state over a trusted WLAN access point (TWAP)?
question_3587.ground_truth: The Service Request procedure for N5CW devices as specified in clause~4.12a.4.1.

question_3588.question: How is Graceful Degradation applied to MBMS services when entering bad reception conditions and traffic congestion in the 9th release?
question_3588.ground_truth: Graceful Degradation is applied to MBMS services by allowing differentiation transmission robustness for different parts of the video stream and by reducing bandwidth of the streams with graceful quality degradation using IVS, allowing service quality to be recovered as congestion state of the cell is relieved.

question_3589.question: What is the role of the NSCE client in the solution for key issue #12?
question_3589.ground_truth: If the NSCE client needs to be remapped to a different NSCE server due to the expected change of UE location, the NSCE client establishes a new connection with T-NSCE and terminates the one with S-NSCE.

question_3590.question: What is the first message sent by the network during a mobile terminating call establishment?

question_3592.question: What information is contained in the CONNECT message sent by the MCPTT server performing participating MCPTT function to the MCPTT UE-B if the invited MCPTT user has selected manual answer mode and has not been overridden?
question_3592.ground_truth: The CONNECT message contains the address of the participant at the MCPTT UE initiating the invitation, the nickname of the participant at the MCPTT UE initiating the invitation, and the MCPTT call identity.

question_3593.question: What is the role of the signal range parameters (center azimuth, center elevation, azimuth range, elevation range, and tilt angle) in describing a 360 video with restricted coverage?
question_3593.ground_truth: These parameters specify the center point, the range of angles, and the amount of tilt in the sphere region covered by the signal.

question_3594.question: In what situations should the MME include the EMM cause value #40 "no EPS bearer context activated" in the SERVICE REJECT message?
question_3594.ground_truth: The MME should include the EMM cause value #40 "no EPS bearer context activated" in the SERVICE REJECT message when the service request received is due to CS fallback or 1xCS fallback.

question_3598.question: What is the action taken by the H-PCRF if it does not differentiate between primary and non-primary BBERFs in IP flow mobility routing rules?
question_3598.ground_truth: The H-PCRF derives PCC rules for the PCEF and QoS rules for the BBERF(s), based on the BCM mode of the GW control session.

question_3599.question: What is appended to all the packets of a PDU set to identify it uniquely?
question_3599.ground_truth: A sequence number known as "PDU sequence mark" (PSM) is appended to all the packets of a PDU set.

question_3600.question: What does MBSFN transmission enable in LTE?
question_3600.ground_truth: MBSFN transmission enables highly efficient MBMS in LTE, allowing for over-the-air combining of multi-cell transmissions in the UE, by utilizing the cyclic prefix to cover the difference in the propagation delays.

question_3601.question: When does the MO-SMC entity transition to the MO-Wait for CP-ACK state?
question_3601.ground_truth: The MO-SMC entity transitions to the MO-Wait for CP-ACK state after initiating the transfer of a CP-DATA message.

question_3602.question: What should the MB-SMF do if it decides not to interact with the PCF in step 5?
question_3602.ground_truth: The MB-SMF should continue with step 11.

question_3606.question: What are the key benefits of enabling overload control for managing trigger loads?
question_3606.ground_truth: The benefits include regulating trigger loads by overload control to reduce the trigger loads generated by one or more SCSs, effectively protecting network nodes from network overload due to massive simultaneous trigger requests from SCSs, and avoiding massive individual failure report messages responding from an MTC-IWF to the SCS or from a congested network node to the MTC-IWF.

question_3607.question: What is the purpose of the UE Beamlock test function?
question_3607.ground_truth: The UE Beamlock test function is used to lock the antenna pattern of all active intra-band component carriers and all MIMO layers affected by the test function, in preparation for subsequent test procedures.

question_3608.question: What is the impact of activating the Originating Identification Presentation (OIP) for the FA Pilot Identity on incoming calls to the FA Pilot Identity?
question_3608.ground_truth: If the FA Pilot Identity has OIP activated, incoming calls to the FA Pilot Identity apply OIP to the members of the FA group.

question_3609.question: Which setup is used for the AoA in this test?
question_3609.ground_truth: The AoA setup for this test is Setup 3 as defined in clause A.9.

question_3610.question: When does the MM non-DRX mode period end for the MS in GPRS attach and routeing area update procedures?
question_3610.ground_truth: The MM non-DRX mode period ends when the MS receives any of the messages GPRS ATTACH ACCEPT, GPRS ATTACH REJECT, ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT, or ROUTING AREA UPDATE REJECT, or when it times out while waiting for these messages.

question_3612.question: What should the GA-CSR RELEASE message include?
question_3612.ground_truth: The GA-CSR RELEASE message includes an RR cause indication.

question_3613.question: In the normal paging process, what is the requirement for a mobile station to respond to PAGING REQUEST TYPE 1 messages when the page mode is set to normal paging?
question_3613.ground_truth: A mobile station is required to respond correctly to various PAGING REQUEST TYPE 1 messages, when the page mode is set to normal paging, in the following cases: (1) The MS is addressed with its IMSI in the first Mobile Identity field, (2) The MS is addressed with its TMSI in the first Mobile Identity field, (3) The first Mobile Identity field specifies a TMSI different from that of the MS but the optional Mobile Identity field addresses the MS by its IMSI, (4) The first Mobile Identity field specifies a TMSI different from that of the MS and the optional Mobile Identity field contains the correct TMSI of the MS.

question_3616.question: What is the purpose of the P-Charging-Vector header field that is added to a REGISTER request in the visited network?
question_3616.ground_truth: The P-Charging-Vector header field is added to the REGISTER request to provide an ICID value and to identify the visited network for charging purposes.

question_3617.question: What information does the "RNC Trace Session Information" field provide?
question_3617.ground_truth: The "RNC Trace Session Information" field indicates the information on a Trace Session activated by Management in the RNC.

question_3618.question: What are the two common charging modes for non-public networks?
question_3618.ground_truth: The two common charging modes for non-public networks are End user charging and Inter-provider charging. End user charging refers to the charges for using non-public network services by end-users, and Inter-provider charging refers to the charges between NPN service providers for utilizing their networks and related network services.

question_3619.question: How many bits are required for the initial state in a BC-TCVQ structure that allows N initial trellis states and exactly M terminal trellis states for each allowed initial trellis state?
question_3619.ground_truth: k bits are required for the initial state in a BC-TCVQ structure that allows N initial trellis states and exactly M terminal trellis states for each allowed initial trellis state.

question_3621.question: What should a 3V technology ME do if it detects a 3V technology SIM during the SIM type recognition procedure?
question_3621.ground_truth: A 3V technology ME may either switch to 5V operation or stay in 3V operation if it detects a 3V technology SIM during the SIM type recognition procedure.

question_3622.question: What is the most significant bit of the Home eNodeB ID?
question_3622.ground_truth: Bit 4 of Octet 9 is the most significant bit of the Home eNodeB ID.

question_3623.question: What should a UE include in the Geolocation-Routing header field if it includes a Geolocation header field in the INVITE request when initiating an emergency call?
question_3623.ground_truth: The UE shall include a Geolocation-Routing header field with a "yes" header field value, which indicates that the location of the UE can be used by other entities to make routing decisions.

question_3625.question: What are the recommended actions to prevent receiver desensitization for BS transmitter with Band 42?
question_3625.ground_truth: It is recommended that Band 41 and 42 BS transmitters should not share the same antenna with bands 1, 3, 5, 8, 9, 11, 18, 19, 21, 27, 28, 39, 43 or 44 receiver unless the antenna path meets very stringent 3rd order PIM specification.

question_3626.question: What is the role of Performance threshold management in E-OSF?
question_3626.ground_truth: Performance threshold management can automatically compare current performance indicators or calculation results with pre-defined thresholds. When the value is above the threshold, it generates a relevant performance alarm. When the value returns to normal, the alarm is deleted automatically.

question_3629.question: During RLM/BFD relaxation, what is the condition for the UE to perform RLM and/or BFD relaxation based on low mobility and good serving cell quality?
question_3629.ground_truth: The UE is allowed to perform RLM and/or BFD relaxation based on low mobility if (SS-RSRPRef - SS-RSRP) < SSearchDeltaP-Connected.

question_3631.question: What procedures are used for Dedicated Bearer Establishment and Modification for vSRVCC?
question_3631.ground_truth: The procedures involve the PCRF in the serving PLMN interacting with the P-GW or S-GW, and the inclusion of a "vSRVCC indicator" in Create Bearer Request or Update Bearer Request messages to indicate that the bearer has been allocated for video media.

question_3632.question: What message does the LMF send to the serving gNB to request deactivation of UL-SRS resource sets?
question_3632.ground_truth: The LMF sends the NRPPa Positioning Deactivation message to the serving gNB to request deactivation of UL-SRS resource sets.

question_3634.question: When defining a Basic Generic Procedure for setting up a call in UTRAN, what is the default transport channel parameters for E-DCH in the uplink direction?
question_3634.ground_truth: MAC-d flow parameters for E-DCH in the uplink direction, when using Streaming or interactive or background for UL and PS RAB, are described in clause 6.11.6.4.7.1.1.1.1.

question_3636.question: What message is used to forward the packet page for PS services to the MS?

question_3638.question: What is the benefit of the Interactive Personal Broadcast Services to the operator in section 5.2.2?
question_3638.ground_truth: The Interactive Personal Broadcast Services offer the benefit of generating upstream data through service interaction, which improves operator revenue. It also offers a new revenue creating service through multi-party conversation using interactive PBS.

question_3640.question: What is the benefit of using a reduction in percentage rather than an absolute amount for throttling?
question_3640.ground_truth: By using a reduction in percentage, the algorithm achieves better useful throughput and balances the traffic between source nodes, ensuring the protection of the overloaded node.

question_3643.question: What is the requirement for the 3GPP system to support non-real time services for a device, regardless of the connection mode?

question_3644.question: What measurements are included in E-CID measurements for E-UTRA?
question_3644.ground_truth: E-UTRA E-CID measurements include RSRP, RSRQ, UE E-UTRA Rx - Tx time difference, GERAN RSSI, UTRAN CPICH RSCP, UTRAN CPICH Ec/Io, and WLAN RSSI, WLAN RSSI, SS Reference signal received power (SS-RSRP), and SS Reference Signal Received Quality (SS-RSRQ).

question_3645.question: What is the objective of the RLS not containing the Serving E-DCH cell test?
question_3645.ground_truth: The objective of the RLS not containing the Serving E-DCH cell test is to verify that the receive characteristics of the E-DCH HARQ ACK Indicator Channel (E-HICH) can detect E-HICH signaling from different cells belonging to different RLS not containing the Serving E-DCH cell during an inter-cell soft handover.

question_3646.question: What is the motivation for extending 5GMS principles in the integration of AR services and experiences into 5G Networks?
question_3646.ground_truth: The motivation is that it allows for support of any type of media services including real-time communication, split rendering and spatial computing, and is not specific or limited to XR and AR experiences.

question_3647.question: What is included in the Policy/parameters for 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay Discovery for a 5G ProSe Remote UE?
question_3647.ground_truth: It includes 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay Discovery parameters, default destination Layer-2 IDs, PDU session parameters, ProSe application Traffic Descriptor, and security related content.

question_3648.question: Under what conditions will the AMF abort the procedure when the Payload container type is set to "SMS"?
question_3648.ground_truth: The AMF will abort the procedure if it does not have an SMSF address associated with the UE, if it cannot forward the content of the Payload container to the SMSF associated with the available SMSF address, or if the UE has registered to a PLMN via a satellite NG-RAN cell that is not allowed to operate at the present UE location.

question_3649.question: What should the UE set the APMQF bit to in the 5GSM capability IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message if it can perform access performance measurements using the QoS flow of the non-default QoS rule?
question_3649.ground_truth: The UE should set the APMQF bit to "Access performance measurements per QoS flow supported" in the 5GSM capability IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message if it can perform access performance measurements using the QoS flow of the non-default QoS rule.

question_3650.question: Which carrier belongs to a single TAG in SUL operation?
question_3650.ground_truth: The SUL carrier belongs to a single TAG.

question_3651.question: What is the purpose of a pre-established session in MCPTT calls?
question_3651.ground_truth: A pre-established session is used for exchanging necessary media parameters before initiating MCPTT calls. This allows MCPTT UEs to activate media bearers immediately or when the actual SIP signalling for the MCPTT call is initiated.

question_3652.question: What is the basis of Solution #3 for addressing the issue?
question_3652.ground_truth: The basis of Solution #3 for addressing the issue is that a NF sending a request to SCP implicitly authorizes the SCP to process the request, by sending a CCA.

question_3653.question: What information is included in an ADC rule for application detection and control?
question_3653.ground_truth: An ADC rule includes information to identify the rule, detect the start and stop of traffic for a certain application, apply enforcement actions and charging for the application traffic, and the application identifier that is used for matching service data flows.

question_3655.question: What should the SS do as per step 5a if the UE is a Release 16 or forward 5G NR UE?
question_3655.ground_truth: The SS is required to apply a backoff on the PCell power by activating the UE Power Limit Function (UPLF), and the UE shall transmit ACTIVATE POWER LIMIT RESPONSE to SS.

question_3656.question: What bit is used for determining the position of a frame in a substream modulo 31 using the PN-sequence?
