question_3656.ground_truth: The S4-bit is used for determining the position of a frame in a substream modulo 31 using the PN-sequence 0000 1001 0110 0111 1100 0110 1110 101.

question_3657.question: What is the responsibility of the IpUIManager interface in the generic user interaction service package?
question_3657.ground_truth: The IpUIManager interface is the 'service manager' interface for the Generic User Interaction Service in the generic user interaction service package. It provides the management functions to the Generic User Interaction Service.

question_3659.question: What message does the new SGSN send to the RNC to establish a radio access bearer?
question_3659.ground_truth: The new SGSN sends a RAB Assignment Request message to the RNC to establish a radio access bearer.

question_3660.question: What should the MCData client do if acting as an "active" endpoint, when the "a=setup" attribute in the received SDP answer is set to "active"?
question_3660.ground_truth: If acting as an "active" endpoint, the MCData client shall send an empty MSRP SEND request to bind the MSRP connection to the MSRP session from the perspective of the passive endpoint, when the "a=setup" attribute in the received SDP answer is set to "active".

question_3661.question: What is the purpose of the MDA process in the MDAS system?
question_3661.ground_truth: The MDA process is used to train the ML model, analyze management data, and provide analytics reports to the consumer for validation and feedback, which is used to optimize the ML model.

question_3663.question: Which method provides the result of a completed list message body parts request?

question_3664.question: What is the main difference between Z1 and GAN in terms of functionality?
question_3664.ground_truth: Z1 reference point is similar to GAN but with reduced functionality. Specifically, Z1 does not require IPSec for user plane and RRC type measurement result transfers to the IWF.

question_3665.question: What is the typical data rate required for HD video feeds in newsgathering?
question_3665.ground_truth: For HD video feeds, 5-10 Mbit/s are needed as minimum.

question_3666.question: What are the two types of mobility that are taken into account when considering small cell enhancement for indoor and outdoor deployments?
question_3666.ground_truth: The two types of mobility are low UE speed (up to 3 km/h) for indoor and low to high UE speed (up to 30 km/h and potentially higher) for outdoor.

question_3667.question: When does the network transmit the compressed reported bitmap in downlink TBFs?
question_3667.ground_truth: The network transmits the compressed reported bitmap in downlink TBFs if it covers more RLC data blocks than the uncompressed reported bitmap.

question_3668.question: What state should the UE enter if it is in 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE and the current TAI is in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"?
question_3668.ground_truth: The UE should enter the state 5GMM-DEREGESTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE and not attempt to perform registration if it re-selects a cell belonging to the TAI where it was rejected.

question_3670.question: What is the test requirement for maximum input level for CA (3DL CA) described in clause 7.4A.2.5?
question_3670.ground_truth: The test requirement is the same as in clause 7.4A.1.5: the throughput measurement derived in the test procedure shall be greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channels as specified in Annex A.

question_3673.question: What protocol does the MCPTT-3 reference point use for transport and routing of signalling if a pair of MCPTT servers or an MCPTT server and an MC gateway server are served by different SIP cores?
question_3673.ground_truth: The MCPTT-3 reference point uses the SIP-3 reference point for transport and routing of signalling in this case.

question_3674.question: What should the MS do when it receives a CHANNEL MODE MODIFY message when in TCH/F mode?
question_3674.ground_truth: The MS with a TCH/F allocated should acknowledge a CHANNEL MODE MODIFY message by sending a CHANNEL MODE MODIFY ACKNOWLEDGE message specifying the new mode and by switching to this mode.

question_3675.question: What is the purpose of the correlation reinforcement with pitch lag multiples?
question_3675.ground_truth: The correlation reinforcement with pitch lag multiples is used to avoid selecting pitch multiples within each pitch delay range, and emphasize the weighted normalized correlation in a lower pitch delay section if one of its multiples is in the neighborhood of the pitch lag in a higher section.

question_3677.question: When is the UE required to include the IMSI in the EPS mobile identity IE in the ATTACH REQUEST message when attaching for emergency bearer services?
question_3677.ground_truth: If the UE is attaching for emergency bearer services and does not hold a valid GUTI, P-TMSI, or IMSI, the IMEI shall be included in the EPS mobile identity IE.

question_3678.question: What is the shape of the adaptive window used for signal windowing in stereo signal low-band encoding?
question_3678.ground_truth: The shape of the adaptive window used for signal windowing is similar to that described in section 5.3.5.4.

question_3679.question: What type of service is allocated resources preferentially in a congested cell during a disaster situation?
question_3679.ground_truth: The Disaster Message Board (DMB) service is allocated resources preferentially in a congested cell during a disaster situation.

question_3680.question: How many coverage classes are allocated to the Physical Downlink Control Channel (PDCCH) resource?
question_3680.ground_truth: The frequency resource allocated to the PDCCH is divided into a number of coverage classes for different coupling losses.

question_3681.question: What is the difference between the V-to-H XPD and H-to-V XPD in the context of cross-polarized antennas?
question_3681.ground_truth: The V-to-H XPD and H-to-V XPD are the coupled power of waves that go from vertical to horizontal and horizontal to vertical, respectively. These draws are independent of each other.

question_3683.question: What is the effect of the tightened emission limits in an AAS BS, compared to a non-AAS BS, to ensure equivalent performance in the presence of a larger number of transceiver units and associated TAB connectors?
question_3683.ground_truth: The total unwanted emissions from the AAS BS should not exceed the unwanted emissions from a non-AAS BS conforming to the Rel-13 specifications with either the same number of transmitter units or a maximum of 8 transmitter units. This ensures that AAS BS performance is maintained despite an increased number of transceiver units.

question_3686.question: What is an SEI message related to decoder rendering metadata for omnidirectional media in the SDP?
question_3686.ground_truth: It is a SEI message that describes bitstream characteristics for omnidirectional media in the Session Description Protocol (SDP) using the 'sprop-sei' parameter, allowing a decoder to rely on the bitstream characteristics for the entire duration of the session.

question_3688.question: What is the purpose of the sendMessageReq() method in the IpMultiMediaMessaging interface?
question_3688.ground_truth: The sendMessageReq() method in the IpMultiMediaMessaging interface is used to send a message with the specified parameters, such as the session ID, source and destination addresses, message type, message, and additional headers.

question_3689.question: What is the purpose of the "Mean interruption time interval for 5QI 1 QoS Flow released due to double NG (double UE context)" measurement?
question_3689.ground_truth: The "Mean interruption time interval for 5QI 1 QoS Flow released due to double NG (double UE context)" measurement provides the average interruption time interval for 5QI 1 QoS Flow released due to double NG (double UE context).

question_3691.question: What is one of the options provided by Solution #17 for the AMF to determine the service area restriction?
question_3691.ground_truth: Solution #17 enables the AMF to use the service area list in the case when the registration area contains TAIs that are more than the TAIs of the area that is considered to correspond to the area of the disaster condition.

question_3692.question: What does the List of APNs IE indicate in the Overload Control Information?
question_3692.ground_truth: The List of APNs IE indicates one or more APNs for which the Overload Control Information is applicable. It determines the scope of the overload control information, whether it is applicable to the list of indicated APNs or the entire GTP-C entity.

question_3693.question: How is the bit width of the PTRS-DMRS association field determined for the case with transform precoder enabled and disabled?
question_3693.ground_truth: If the Transform precoder indicator field is present, the bit width of the PTRS-DMRS association field for the case with transform precoder enabled and disabled should be the same.

question_3694.question: When the mobile station responds to a paging request for RR connection establishment, what procedure should it follow?
question_3694.ground_truth: It shall follow the paging response procedures as specified in 3GPP TS 04.18.

question_3695.question: What is the effect of fine-tuning dataset size on positioning error when changing the network synchronization error from 0 ns to 50 ns?
question_3695.ground_truth: The positioning error varies, with a smaller fine-tuning dataset size resulting in a larger positioning error.

question_3696.question: What is the role of the floating-point ANSI-C code in the TS?
question_3696.ground_truth: The floating-point ANSI-C code is the only standard conforming non-bit-exact implementation for the Adaptive Multi-Rate speech transcoder, Voice Activity Detection, comfort noise generation, and source controlled rate operation. It also contains example solutions for substituting and muting of lost frames.

question_3697.question: Which architectures and signalling procedures are re-used in the established 3GPP architectures for local breakout of uplink traffic?
question_3697.ground_truth: The paging and mobility signalling procedures of GPRS and EPS are re-used.

question_3698.question: What entity identifies the UE when the SCS/AS sends a downlink small data SDT-PDU?
question_3698.ground_truth: The UE is identified by its External Identifier in the SCS/AS.

question_3699.question: How are the version handling capabilities of Interface IRPs and NRM IRPs managed?
question_3699.ground_truth: The version handling for Interface IRPs and NRM IRPs is managed with different operations and parameters. However, version handling for Data Definition IRPs does not exist.

question_3700.question: What is the spurious emission limit for NR BS inFR1, as defined by 3GPP TS 37.104/TS 37.105, for frequencies from 30 MHz to 1 GHz?

question_3701.question: What is the impact of increased straight-line distance on mortality for Red 1 calls?
question_3701.ground_truth: Increased straight-line distance correlates with increased risk of death; e.g., a 1% absolute increase in mortality is associated with each 10 km increase in straight-line distance, especially for Red 1 calls, which cover cardiac arrests and patients who are not breathing anymore.

question_3702.question: What is the power step size specified for the UE transmitter output power in the inner loop power control in UL OLTD?
question_3702.ground_truth: The UE transmitter shall have the capability of changing the output power with a step size of 1 dB, 2 dB and 3 dB.

question_3703.question: What is the "S-NSSAIs per TAI mapping" event that the AMF exposes?
question_3703.ground_truth: The "S-NSSAIs per TAI mapping" event provides, per TAI, the related access type and list of supported S-NSSAIs, including indication of S-NSSAIs restricted by AMF.

question_3704.question: What interworking procedures are included in clause 4.11 for interworking between EPS and 5GS?
question_3704.ground_truth: Procedures for interworking with EPS based on N26 interface, interworking without N26 interface, handover procedures between EPS and 5GC-N3IWF, handover procedures between EPS and 5GC-TNGF, and handover procedures between EPC/ePDG and 5GS are included in clause 4.11.

question_3707.question: What cell is used as the target for CSI-RS based CMR and dedicated IMR L1-SINR measurements in the test environment?
question_3707.ground_truth: Cell 2, also known as the PSCell, is used as the target for CSI-RS based CMR and dedicated IMR L1-SINR measurements in the test environment.

question_3708.question: What is the role of the SMF in allocating/releasing IP addresses in 5G network?
question_3708.ground_truth: The SMF shall process the UE IP address management related messages, maintain the corresponding state information and provide the response messages to the UE, furthermore, the SMF shall inform the PCF about an allocated IPv4 address, and shall act as the DHCP server towards the UE for IP address allocation, and act as the DHCP client towards the external DHCP server for IP address allocation.

question_3709.question: What should the MCPTT client include in the Contact header field of the SIP INVITE request for an MCPTT group call?
question_3709.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should include the g.3gpp.mcptt media feature tag and the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag with the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt" in the Contact header field of the SIP INVITE request for an MCPTT group call.

question_3710.question: How does the UE determine the sorting quantity when the report type is set to eventTriggered?
question_3710.ground_truth: When the report type is set to eventTriggered, the UE considers the trigger quantity as the sorting quantity if available. If not, it uses RSRP, RSRQ, or SINR as the sorting quantity, in that order.

question_3711.question: What is the role of the 5G system in supporting the Smart Grid applications?
question_3711.ground_truth: The 5G system supports the Smart Grid applications by providing different isolation modes, with dedicated core network elements and radio resources for the physical isolation requirements, while offering shared network resources for logical isolation requirements.

question_3712.question: What happens to a DOWNLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message if it is not delivered for any reason?
question_3712.ground_truth: The MME may discard the message.

question_3713.question: What is the purpose of defining "KVP", "NF", "UDSF", and "UDR" in the present document?
question_3713.ground_truth: These abbreviations are used to define key terms specific to the document and may have different meanings or not be defined in 3GPP TR~21.905.

question_3717.question: What should a mobile station do if a downlink assignment message has incorrect uplink and/or downlink PDCH information?
question_3717.ground_truth: The mobile station should perform an abnormal release of the downlink TBF(s) with erroneous assignments, and act upon the valid assignments.

question_3718.question: What is the significance of the radix in the test data provided for the 3GPP authentication and key generation functions?
question_3718.ground_truth: The radix refers to the base of the number system used in the test data, which is hexadecimal in this case. It is specified to ensure accurate interpretation and implementation of the test data.

question_3719.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the SIP REFER request for establishing a remote initiated ambient viewing call within a pre-established session?
question_3719.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include the request-URI, Refer-Sub header field, Supported header field with specific option tag, optional P-Preferred-Identity header field, P-Preferred-Service header field, Refer-To header field, and specific elements in the application/resource-lists+xml MIME body (including a single entry element and a proper uri attribute value).

question_3720.question: What must the R-GMLC do if the V-GMLC address is different from its own?
question_3720.ground_truth: The R-GMLC sends the location request to the V-GMLC if the V-GMLC address is different from its own.

question_3721.question: What is the expected result for the SEND SHORT MESSAGE command in Expected Sequence 3.1 and 3.2?
question_3721.ground_truth: In Expected Sequence 3.1, the expected result is "Command performed successfully" and in Expected Sequence 3.2, the expected result is "Command performed successfully, but requested icon could not be displayed".

question_3724.question: What is the SECAM Accreditation Body process for dispute resolution for inconsistencies in evaluation results?
question_3724.ground_truth: The SECAM Accreditation Body provides a process for dispute resolution, which includes a supplementary audit on vendor or third-party laboratory premises and updates their accreditation records.

question_3725.question: When should a receiving node report a missing IE/IE group with specified criticality "Reject IE" or "Ignore IE and Notify Sender" using the Error Indication procedure?
question_3725.ground_truth: The receiving node should report a missing IE/IE group with specified criticality "Reject IE" or "Ignore IE and Notify Sender" using the Error Indication procedure when the information received in the initiating message was insufficient to determine a value for all IEs that are required to be present in the response message.

question_3726.question: In what scenario would the MCPTT private call transfer be cancelled and an MCPTT private call transfer response with result "fail" be sent back to the MCPTT client?
question_3726.ground_truth: The MCPTT private call transfer is cancelled, and the MCPTT server 2 sends an MCPTT private call transfer response with result "fail" back to MCPTT client 3, if the check fails, or the target of the transfer is a functional alias that is not active or simultaneously active by multiple users and the outcome of the selection is a rejection.

question_3728.question: What is the measurement "DL PDCP SDU Data Volume" used for in the 5G network?
question_3728.ground_truth: This measurement is used to measure the data volume delivered to the PDCP layer in the downlink in the 5G network, and it is used for performance assurance within integrity area (user plane connection quality) and in the energy efficency (EE) area.

question_3729.question: What is the role of the DTF in this communication process?
question_3729.ground_truth: The DTF is responsible for anchoring the source access leg in PS access and managing the signaling and media connection between the ICCF and the remote end.

question_3731.question: What are the two modes of signalling message transfer provided by the radio bearers?
question_3731.ground_truth: The two modes of signalling message transfer provided by the radio bearers are through an unacknowledged mode RLC entity and through an acknowledged mode RLC entity.

question_3733.question: What information does the Warning Status Query Response procedure allow the CBC to determine about cells in the Warning Area?
question_3733.ground_truth: The Warning Status Query Response procedure allows the CBC to determine if cells in the Warning Area are capable of broadcasting warning messages and the status of those cells by containing a cause value indicating if the cell is available for PWS or not.

question_3734.question: What must the UE do upon successful reception of TMGI and other information when MBS decision is set to "MBS join is accepted"?
question_3734.ground_truth: The UE must consider that it has successfully joined the multicast MBS session, store the received TMGI and MBS service area, and provide the TMGI to lower layers.

question_3735.question: When should the media feature tags be included in the SIP response other than the 100 (Trying) response to the SIP INVITE request?
question_3735.ground_truth: The media feature tags should be included in the SIP response other than the 100 (Trying) response to the SIP INVITE request, for all supported streaming media types in the UE.

question_3736.question: What request is used by the originating side to confirm the successful resource reservation at the terminating UE?
question_3736.ground_truth: An SIP UPDATE request is used by the originating side to confirm the successful resource reservation at the terminating UE.

question_3739.question: What kind of data is expected to be provided in the request body when using the "GET" method for the NWDAF Analytics resource?
question_3739.ground_truth: The "GET" method for the NWDAF Analytics resource does not require a request body.

question_3741.question: In what scenario will the gNB-CU consider that the backhaul link between the gNB-DU and the node is congested, when receiving the GNB-DU STATUS INDICATION message with the IAB Congestion Indication IE?
question_3741.ground_truth: If the IAB Congestion Indication IE includes the Child Node Identifier IE but not the BH RLC CH ID IE.

question_3743.question: What is the recommended option for aggregate report format between the two options mentioned, to avoid the report server having to look into the header portion of each component XML file to determine the composition of the aggregated report?
question_3743.ground_truth: Option 1 is recommended as the aggregate report format since it avoids the report server having to look into the header portion of each component XML file to determine the composition of the aggregated report.

question_3745.question: What triggers the AMF to assign a Registration Area List to the UE with associated validity times in the Registration Accept?
question_3745.ground_truth: The indication received from the RAN informing the AMF of satellite access.

question_3746.question: What information can be used to determine the roaming status of a UE in 3GPP nodes?
question_3746.ground_truth: The serving network's PLMN-ID (MCC+MNC) can deterministically be used to derive whether UE is in HPLMN or VPLMN.

question_3747.question: How does a device join a PIN?
question_3747.ground_truth: A device sends the Join PIN request to the PEMC via the established connection between the device and PEMC, including PIN ID, Device ID, PINE type, capability, Service, name, etc. PEMC determines to accept the request and allocates the PINE ID for the device. PEMC sends the Join PIN response to the device, including the result (accept or reject), PIN Info, and PINE Info.

question_3748.question: What are the supported Subcarrier Spacings and Cyclic Prefixes for SL transmissions in FR1 and FR2?
question_3748.ground_truth: In FR1, 15 kHz, 30 kHz, and 60 kHz Subcarrier Spacings (SCS) are supported with normal CP, and 60 kHz SCS with extended CP. In FR2, 60 kHz and 120 kHz SCS are supported with normal CP, and 60 kHz SCS with extended CP.

question_3749.question: What is the potential new requirement for the 5G system with satellite access to support user data path efficiency?
question_3749.ground_truth: An explicit discussion on efficient user data path when all UEs connect to the 5G network via the same satellite in different network connection modes is needed.

question_3750.question: What should the P-Charging-Vector header field parameter be populated with in the dialog request?
question_3750.ground_truth: The P-Charging-Vector header field parameter should be populated with the "icid-value" and a type 1 "orig-ioi" header field parameter in the dialog request.

question_3751.question: What action should a receiving entity take when it encounters a reserved value within the content of an Information Element?
question_3751.ground_truth: The receiving entity should ignore that part of the Information Element if it encounters a reserved value within the content of an Information Element.

question_3752.question: What is the purpose of softwar separation of VNFs in a 3GPP network?
question_3752.ground_truth: The purpose of software separation of VNFs in a 3GPP network is to limit both incoming and outgoing traffic in an efficient and scalable way using software defined traffic rules applied directly to each virtual function.

question_3754.question: What is the minimum number of cells that the UE should be able to detect and measure inter-frequency RSTD for, as specified in UE Category 1bis?
question_3754.ground_truth: The UE should be able to detect and measure inter-frequency RSTD for at least 16 cells, including the reference cell.

question_3755.question: What is the purpose of the enhanced bandwidth negotiation mechanism in Hanism as defined in 3GPP-TS-26.114?
question_3755.ground_truth: The enhanced bandwidth negotiation mechanism in Hanism is used to negotiate additional bandwidth properties end-to-end based on the "a=bw-info" SDP attribute.

question_3756.question: What should be included in the SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP INVITE request for an MCPTT emergency call, unless the procedures of clause~6.6.3.1.5 were performed?
question_3756.ground_truth: The SIP 200 (OK) response should include an SDP answer, the Session-Expires header field with a recommendation, the "timer" option tag in a Require header field, and the required information in a Contact header field.

question_3757.question: What additional parameters may the AF provide if it is able to adjust the transmission time and periodicity?
question_3757.ground_truth: If the AF is able to adjust the transmission time and periodicity, it may provide a BAT Window, the capability for BAT adaptation, or the Periodicity Range to the TSCTSF.

question_3758.question: Which frame rates are valid for a Bitstream conforming to the H.265/HEVC Full HD HDR HLG Operation Point?
question_3758.ground_truth: A Bitstream conforming to the H.265/HEVC Full HD HDR HLG Operation Point shall have one of the following frame rates: 24; 25; 30; 50; 60; 24/1.001; 30/1.001; 60/1.001 Hz.

question_3759.question: In which situations should the UE submit the FailureInformation message via SRB1 for transmission?
question_3759.ground_truth: If the procedure was triggered to provide RLC failure information for an MCG RLC bearer or DAPS failure information.

question_3761.question: What is the role of the SMF in policy enforcement for authorized QoS per service data flow?
question_3761.ground_truth: The SMF performs a QoS flow binding based on the QoS information provided for the service data flow and assigns the QFI. It also derives the QoS flow information required towards the Access Network and the QoS rule required towards the UE.

question_3762.question: What self-optimization features does LTE-Advanced use to ensure good mobility performance across the cellular network?
question_3762.ground_truth: LTE-Advanced uses self-optimization features such as coverage and capacity optimization, mobility robustness optimization, mobility load balancing, and RACH optimization. These features are used to reduce radio link failures, balance the trade-off between coverage and capacity, and minimize access delays.

question_3764.question: What is the charging method that can be assigned to a PDU session to indicate a charging method applicable at the PDU session level, and can only be used at the offline phase?
question_3764.ground_truth: A PDU session charging method indicating "offline only"

question_3766.question: What action should the UE take if it receives the Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming" in the SERVICE ACCEPT message, and the TAI(s) included in the IE which are belonging to the serving PLMN or equivalent PLMN(s) is not part of the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"?
question_3766.ground_truth: The UE should store the TAI(s) included in the IE into the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming" and ignore the TAI(s) which do not belong to the serving PLMN or equivalent PLMN(s).

question_3768.question: How much additional improvement was observed when adding UMTS inter-RAT measurements in an urban 10 MHz scenario with LTE measurements made during IPDL periods?
question_3768.ground_truth: The performance improvement was 3% for UMTS inter-RAT measurements in an urban 10 MHz scenario.

question_3769.question: What is the initial role of the user specified in the SIP message?
question_3769.ground_truth: The initial role of the user specified in the SIP message is a controller.

question_3770.question: What is the purpose of the default midamble allocation by layer 1 in the 3.84 Mcps TDD?
question_3770.ground_truth: The default midamble allocation by layer 1 is used to assign associations between midambles and channelisation codes, as given in Annex AA.2.

question_3771.question: What should the IWF do upon receiving a SIP re-INVITE request with an imminent peril indication and if the group's in-progress imminent peril state is true and the MCPTT user is indicating a new imminent peril indication?
question_3771.ground_truth: The IWF should generate a SIP MESSAGE request notification of the MCPTT user's imminent peril indication to each of the other affiliated members of the group.

question_3772.question: When is the downlink TCI state known, based on the given conditions?
question_3772.ground_truth: The downlink TCI state is known if the given conditions are met during the period from the last transmission of the RS resource used for the L1-RSRP measurement reporting for the target downlink TCI state to the completion of active downlink TCI state switch.

question_3774.question: What is the assigned value for "initial request" in the request type set for the UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure?
question_3774.ground_truth: The assigned value for "initial request" in the request type set is 1, 2, or 3, depending on whether it is used for establishing a new non-emergency PDU session, handover of a PDU session, or initial emergency request, respectively.

question_3775.question: What action does the VLR take when it receives a CCBS Recall signal and the response to the CCBS Recall is received?
question_3775.ground_truth: The VLR shall subsequently send a CCBS Call Report when the relevant processing for the outgoing CCBS call to the destination network is completed.

question_3777.question: What are the recommendations for Bands 28 and 40 BS transmitters sharing the same antenna with Bands 5, 8, and 28 receivers?
question_3777.ground_truth: The recommendation is to meet very stringent 2nd and 3rd order PIM specification so that PIM will not cause Band 5, 8, and 28 BS receivers desensitization. Note that antenna sharing may be allowed as the state-of-the-art continues to evolve in the future.

question_3779.question: What should the SAS do if it receives an Abort message while in the RNC centric mode?
question_3779.ground_truth: The SAS should cease positioning attempts and return a POSITION CALCULATION RESPONSE message to the SRNC carrying any location estimate already obtained or a POSITION CALCULATION FAILURE message if no location estimate was obtained. After sending an Abort message, the SRNC should cease positioning activity, if any.

question_3780.question: What range of frequencies does the E850 band cover in the upper sub-band?
question_3780.ground_truth: The E850 band covers the range of frequencies from 860 MHz to 895 MHz in the upper sub-band.

question_3781.question: What L2 connection is established between the 5G-RG and the 5G-AGF in Solution #2?
question_3781.ground_truth: A layer-2 (L2) connection is established between the 5G-RG and the 5G-AGF using PPP/PPPoE procedures.

question_3782.question: Which clause in TS 31.111 does the SEND SHORT MESSAGE facility refer to?
question_3782.ground_truth: The SEND SHORT MESSAGE facility refers to clauses 6.1, 6.4.10, 6.6.9, 8.1, 8.2, 8.6, 8.7, 8.13, 8.31, 8.67, and 5.2 in TS 31.111.

question_3783.question: What should a client do if the new content stream consists of more media components than the ongoing content stream?
question_3783.ground_truth: The client is recommended to switch to the new content with the already established resources and add further components afterwards using the "3gpp-pipelined" feature if supported.

question_3786.question: What is the primary OTDOA measurement used to calculate an estimate of the position and optionally the velocity of the UE in 3G UMTS network?
question_3786.ground_truth: The primary OTDOA measurement used to calculate an estimate of the position and optionally the velocity of the UE in 3G UMTS network is the "SFN-SFN observed time difference" observed at the UE.

question_3787.question: What is the RSTD measurement reporting delay defined as in 8.16.2.3.1.1?
question_3787.ground_truth: The RSTD measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between the point when UE receives both the OTDOA-RequestLocationInformation message and the OTDOA assistance data in the OTDOA-ProvideAssistanceData message, and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface.

question_3788.question: How does the distributed ES function make a decision for the NR capacity booster cell to enter the energySaving state in the distributed energy saving solution?
question_3788.ground_truth: The distributed ES function makes a decision for the NR capacity booster cell to enter the energySaving state based on the cell traffic load information.

question_3789.question: What is the requirement for inter-band carrier aggregation with uplink assigned to two NR bands in terms of NR adjacent channel leakage power ratio?
question_3789.ground_truth: The NR adjacent channel leakage power ratio is defined per component carrier while both component carriers are active and the requirement is specified in clause 6.5.2.4.1.

question_3790.question: What is the type of modulation used by the second interfering signal?
question_3790.ground_truth: The second interfering signal is GMSK modulated by random data.

question_3791.question: How do PLMN-1 and PLMN-2 handle paging notifications when they are the same PLMN?
question_3791.ground_truth: If PLMN-1 and PLMN-2 are the same PLMN, there is no difference in behavior as the handle identifies a specific UE-PLMN pair rather than just a PLMN. The notifications and security associations will still function as expected.

question_3792.question: What is the purpose of the key set identifier (KSI) in 3GPP authentication and key agreement functions?
question_3792.ground_truth: The key set identifier (KSI) is used to identify the cipher key CK and integrity key IK stored in the mobile station, allowing for re-use in subsequent connection set-ups.

question_3793.question: Which component carrier is used for connection setup in the test described in clause 7.1.6.4.2?
question_3793.ground_truth: PCell is used for connection setup in the test described in clause 7.1.6.4.2.

question_3794.question: What are the different types of MBS sessions and how are they initiated?
question_3794.ground_truth: Multicast MBS sessions are initiated by the NRM client via a UE session join request towards the 5GC, while broadcast MBS sessions are established as part of the session creation procedures if the NRM client is accessing over 5G. In the case of broadcast, network resources are reserved in 5GC and NG-RAN.

question_3797.question: What is the name of the complex type with an "xs:any" wildcard allowing other elements, with the "lax" processContents, and a maximum occurrence of unbounded?

question_3798.question: What is required in the Solicitation message in the Ranging/Sidelink Positioning procedure?
question_3798.ground_truth: The Solicitation message may include Type of Discovery Message, Ranging/Sidelink Positioning service Code, Reference UE info, Target UE info, Role indication (Reference UE) and Reference UE capability.

question_3799.question: Which frequency bands, when used for carrier aggregation in LTE Advanced, may result in intermodulation products falling within the receive band of Bands 12, 17, 22, 42, and 43?

question_3800.question: What actions does the SEALDD server take when it decides to remove a connection?
question_3800.ground_truth: The SEALDD server sends a deletion notification to the VAL server, requests regular data transmission connection deletion to the SEALDD client, further notifies the VAL client about the SEALDD connection being removed, and removes the SEALDD connection context.

question_3801.question: Which message includes the DRB-CountInfoListExt-r15 sequence?

question_3803.question: What information does the N3IWF include in the GRE header to enable reflective QoS?
question_3803.ground_truth: The N3IWF includes a Reflective QoS Indicator (RQI) in the GRE header to enable reflective QoS.

question_3804.question: What state is the UE in at the end of the preamble?
question_3804.ground_truth: The UE is in E-UTRA Registered, Idle Mode state. The MCData Client Application has been activated and the User has registered-in as the MCDATA User with the Server as active user at the Client.

question_3807.question: What is one of the benefits of the LI-solution using bicasting in the context of local call local switching (LCLS)?
question_3807.ground_truth: One benefit of the LI-solution using bicasting is that it allows for LCLS even when the user plane data is necessary in the core network, without affecting end-to-end speech delay compared to local calls.

question_3808.question: What should the RNC do if SIPTO at Iu-PS functionality is supported by the UTRAN, and the MSISDN IE is present in the RAB ASSIGNMENT REQUEST message?
question_3808.ground_truth: The UTRAN may offload the RABs where the Offload RAB Parameters IE is present in the RABs To Be Setup Or Modified Item IEs IE. The Access Point Name IE and the Charging Characteristics IE within the Offload RAB Parameters IE and the MSISDN IE may only be used for the SIPTO at Iu-PS function.

question_3809.question: What security mechanisms are used in Solution #9 for securing eV2X unicast messages over PC5?
question_3809.ground_truth: Solution #9 uses the "Elliptic Curve-based Certificateless Signatures for Identity-based Encryption" (ECCSI) signature scheme, and Sakai-Kasahara Key Encryption (SAKKE) to generate a shared secret that is used as a KD session ID (root key) for establishing a secure connection between the two UEs.

question_3810.question: What are the issues that need to be resolved for stateless UE-to-UE Relay forwarding?
question_3810.ground_truth: The issues that need to be resolved for stateless UE-to-UE Relay forwarding include limiting the forwarding of packets by ProSe UE-to-UE Relays, employing neighbour discovery protocols, determining whether all UEs must be UE-to-UE Relay capable and authorized, and assessing the impact on power consumption and radio resource due to flooding by multiple Stateless ProSe UE-to-UE Relays.

question_3811.question: What are the three scenarios where problems can occur in E-UTRAN with different frequencies?
question_3811.ground_truth: The three scenarios described are: 1) Coverage holes without any other radio coverage, 2) Coverage holes with isolated island cell coverage, and 3) E-UTRAN cells with too large coverage.

question_3812.question: Which field in the "ResourceStatusUpdateIEs" F1AP-PROTOCOL-IES has a CRITICALITY value of "ignore" and allows for the inclusion of the "HardwareLoadIndicator" type?

question_3813.question: What action should the BSS take if it receives unknown fields within a known Access Technology Type in the MS Radio Access Capability field?
question_3813.ground_truth: The BSS should ignore the unknown fields when it receives unknown fields within a known Access Technology Type in the MS Radio Access Capability field.

question_3814.question: What specification defines the AKMA TLS protocol profiles for providing secure TLS connections between the UE and an Application Function (AF) in the 5G system?

question_3815.question: What is the maximum interruption uncertainty defined in 8.3.5.1.2?
question_3815.ground_truth: The interruption uncertainty T_IU can be up to one frame (10 ms) in 8.3.5.1.2.

question_3816.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network in developing enhanced Over-the-Air (OTA) test methods for NR FR1 Total Radiated Power (TRP) and Total Radiated Sensitivity (TRS)?
question_3816.ground_truth: The purpose of 3GPP is to develop a full set of OTA test methods to cover different UE features for TRP and TRS measurement in NR standalone (SA) and NR non-standalone (NSA) operation mode.

question_3817.question: What are the two types of spatial information feedback supported in NR for CSI measurement and reporting?
question_3817.ground_truth: Type I feedback: codebook-based PMI feedback with normal spatial resolution, and Type II feedback: explicit feedback and/or codebook-based feedback with higher spatial resolution.

question_3818.question: What is the purpose of sending an activity status request message with search criteria in the MCVideo system?
question_3818.ground_truth: The purpose is to request MCVideo clients with certain characteristics to share their activity status.

question_3819.question: What is required for an LLE to enter the ABM state after receiving a SABM command?
question_3819.ground_truth: The LLE must inform layer 3 using the LL-ESTABLISH-IND primitive and respond with a UA response with the F bit set to the same binary value as the P bit in the received SABM command. It must also reset timer T200 if active, set V(S), V(R), V(A), and B to 0, and clear any existing exception conditions and busy conditions.

question_3820.question: What is the difference between "shall" and "should" in a 3GPP TS?
question_3820.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, while "should" indicates a recommendation to do something.

question_3821.question: Which message does the gNB-CU-UP send to the gNB-CU-CP to initiate the Bearer Context Release (gNB-CU-CP initiated) procedure?
question_3821.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP sends the BEARER CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND message to the gNB-CU-CP to initiate the Bearer Context Release (gNB-CU-CP initiated) procedure.

question_3822.question: How is the low access priority indicator used in charging records and EPS Bearer contexts?
question_3822.ground_truth: The low access priority indicator may be included in charging records by the visited and home networks and stored in the MME EPS Bearer contexts. It is passed as part of these contexts to other network nodes in mobility management procedures for the purpose of including it in charging records.

question_3823.question: Which interface is defined as the interface between 2G-SGSN and BSS?

question_3826.question: How can the furnish charging information capability be useful in solving the issue of IMS charging correlation?
question_3826.ground_truth: The furnish charging information capability can reduce and possibly remove the need for aggregation of charging data, allowing an operator to delegate IMS charging to a single node for generation of charging data. It also introduces a mechanism for nodes to send data to the Billing Domain in a flexible way without a CTF necessarily being aware of the content.

question_3827.question: What does the UE do when the Direct Communication Request is received and reporting criteria are met in ProSe Unicast Direct Communication over PC5?
question_3827.ground_truth: The UE sends the usage information report to the CTF(ADF) after successful completion of the authentication procedure.

question_3828.question: What should be done by the UE in the RAU/LAU/TAU procedure?
question_3828.ground_truth: The UE performs the RAU/LAU/TAU procedure as defined in TS 23.060 or TS 23.401, and stores the rSRVCC allowed indication in NB/eNB upon receiving it as part of the "UE Radio Access Capability".

question_3830.question: In the 6.4.2.2 test procedure, what operation is done on the returned bytes from CatGetTimer()?
question_3830.ground_truth: The returned bytes from CatGetTimer() are typecasted to (BYTE) and used to free a timer in CatFreeTimer().

question_3831.question: What information does the source H(e)NB try to select a target H(e)NB in Rel-11?
question_3831.ground_truth: The source H(e)NB tries to select a target H(e)NB in Rel-11 to ensure session continuity for LIPA with mobility of a UE between H(e)NBs. The source H(e)NB includes the L-GW@CN address of the L-GW which the H(e)NB could connect with in every INITIAL UE MESSAGE and every UPLINK NAS TRANSPORT control messages.

question_3833.question: What does the 'num-levels-priority-hierarchy' element specify for the 'off-network' element?
question_3833.ground_truth: The 'num-levels-priority-hierarchy' element specifies the number of priority levels in the hierarchy for the 'off-network' element.

question_3835.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 7.3.53 of the document?
question_3835.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that the HD-FDD CE UE properly detects the in-sync state for monitoring downlink radio link quality of the serving cell.

question_3836.question: For occupied bandwidth OTA conformance requirement, what should be identified?
question_3836.ground_truth: For occupied bandwidth OTA conformance requirement, a beam should be identified which fulfills the core conditions.

question_3838.question: What should the MS do if the PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST has been transmitted four times during uplink resource reallocation on expiry of timer T3168?
question_3838.ground_truth: The MS should return to idle mode after the PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST has been transmitted four times.

question_3839.question: What should the S-CSCF do if there is an original dialog identifier present in the topmost Route header field of the incoming request?
question_3839.ground_truth: If there is an original dialog identifier present in the topmost Route header field of the incoming request, the S-CSCF should store the value of the "orig-ioi" header field parameter received in the P-Charging-Vector header field, if present, remove the received "orig-ioi" header field parameter if next hop is not an AS, include a type 1 "orig-ioi" header field parameter if next hop is not an AS, based on local policy, add an "fe-addr" element of the "fe-identifier" header field parameter to the P-Charging-Vector header field with its own address or if not already available, and remove any received Relayed-Charge header field if next hop is not an AS.

question_3841.question: How should the bodies of HTTP PATCH requests be described in OpenAPI specification files?
question_3841.ground_truth: The bodies of HTTP PATCH requests can be described using either "JSON Merge Patch" encoding as defined in IETF RFC 7396, or "JSON Patch" encoding as defined in IETF RFC 6902.

question_3842.question: What is the purpose of the method "rateErr()" in the charging system?
question_3842.ground_truth: The method "rateErr()" indicates that the corresponding request for a rate has failed.

question_3843.question: In what state does the floor control interface send a Floor Idle message to the associated floor participant when in the 'general floor control operation' state machine and the state is 'G: Idle'?
question_3843.ground_truth: The floor control interface shall send a Floor Idle message to the associated floor participant, including the Floor Indicator field with appropriate indications if the group call is a broadcast group call, a system call, an emergency call, an imminent peril call, or a temporary group session.

question_3844.question: What steps occur over PC5 in ProSe Direct Communication for Model A?
question_3844.ground_truth: Steps 11 to 16 in ProSe Direct Communication for Model A occur over PC5.

question_3845.question: What is the benefit of using the IHR mechanism for improving call drop ratio in the HSPA enhancements?
question_3845.ground_truth: The IHR mechanism can improve call drop ratio in case the radio condition worsens quickly, and it reduces HARQ transmission time because retransmission can be early in the IHR mechanism.

question_3846.question: Who is the authorized FRMCS User in the use case for merging of Railway Staff Emergency Alerts?
question_3846.ground_truth: The authorized FRMCS User in the use case for merging of Railway Staff Emergency Alerts is an operator, which is not an FRMCS Operator.

question_3850.question: Which mobility management procedures are specified for 3GPP accesses and WiMAX to minimize the service interruption during handover and support bidirectional service continuity?
question_3850.ground_truth: The mobility management procedures specified in 4.1.2 of the specification

question_3854.question: What length and fields does the identifier field contain in the MAC-PDU header?
question_3854.ground_truth: The identifier field is 40 bits long and contains the unique identifier of the device, which is set during personalization of the device.

question_3855.question: What are the performance requirements for PUSCH for high speed train only applicable to?
question_3855.ground_truth: Wide Area Base Stations and Medium Range Base Stations

question_3856.question: What types of custom operations without associated resources are defined for the 5GLANParameterProvision API in this specification release?
question_3856.ground_truth: No custom operations without associated resources are defined for the 5GLANParameterProvision API in this specification release.

question_3857.question: What should the UE do when there is no reference signal received for the CSI measurement over the minimum requirements?
question_3857.ground_truth: If there is no reference signal received for the CSI measurement over the minimum requirements, the UE shall report corresponding valid CSI for the activated SCell on the next available uplink reporting resource after receiving the reference signal.

question_3858.question: What is the role of the third-party key in the AKMA solution?
question_3858.ground_truth: The third-party key in the AKMA solution is a secret key shared by the application server and the UE for application level communication. It protects data from leakage to untrusted parties, and the application providers can control over the key material specifically.

question_3860.question: What should be the value of the `emergency-ind` element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body when sending a SIP MESSAGE request notification of an MCVideo user's emergency indication?
question_3860.ground_truth: The value should be set to "true".

question_3861.question: What is the purpose of the "eventReportList" attribute in the MbsSessionEventReportList data structure?
question_3861.ground_truth: The "eventReportList" attribute in the MbsSessionEventReportList data structure contains one or several individual MBS session event reports, with each one of them encoded within the MbsSessionEventReport data structure.

question_3862.question: What is the size of the Cipher Mode Command message for GSM/GPRS network, and how many public keys can it carry at maximum?
question_3862.ground_truth: The size of the Cipher Mode Command message for GSM/GPRS network is 3 bytes, and it can carry 2304 bytes of public keys, which means it can carry 2*3*384=2304 public keys.

question_3863.question: What should be used in the local network with a collocated SGW and LGW for the selection of the SGW in SIPTO service?
question_3863.ground_truth: The Local (H)(e)NB Network ID provided by the (H)(e)NB in the S1-AP/RANAP message should be used to discover the SGW via the DNS.

question_3866.question: What actions are taken to resume suspended bearers after a CS voice call is terminated and the UE returns to E-UTRAN?
question_3866.ground_truth: The UE sends a TAU to the MME, which then informs S-GW and P-GW to resume the suspended bearers using Modify Bearer Request message if triggered by the procedure in operation, or using Resume Notification message in other cases.

question_3867.question: In the OCNG test model, what conditions must be satisfied when OCNG is activated in a non-PCell?
question_3867.ground_truth: While activating OCNG on a non-PCell, TTCN needs to consider the timing information such that the SFN and subframe number correspond to the PCell SFN modulo x = 0, where x is the size of the subframePattern bit string divided by 10 and the subframe number of Pcell equals 0.

question_3868.question: When sending a group session SDS message, what is the required disposition value if the MCData user requests to send a group SDS session message with a disposition of "DELIVERY AND READ"?
question_3868.ground_truth: The MCData client should send the group session SDS message via a MSRP SEND message with a disposition of "DELIVERY AND READ" if the MCData user requests to send a group SDS session message with a disposition of "DELIVERY AND READ".

question_3869.question: What should the system do if the in-progress imminent peril state of the group is set to false and an MCVideo user has initiated an imminent peril call?
question_3869.ground_truth: If the in-progress imminent peril state of the group is set to false and an MCVideo user has initiated an imminent peril call, the system should set the value of the in-progress imminent peril state of the group to true, generate SIP re-INVITE requests for the MCVideo imminent peril group call to the other affiliated and joined participants of the chat MCVideo group, generate SIP INVITE requests for the MCVideo imminent peril call to the affiliated but not joined members of the chat MCVideo group, send the SIP INVITE request towards the MCVideo client, and cache the information that this MCVideo user has initiated an MCVideo imminent peril call.

question_3870.question: What should the IWU do if it receives an initial SIP INVITE request with the UPDATE method in the ALLOW header from the external SIP-I network?
question_3870.ground_truth: The IWU shall advertise its support for the UPDATE method to the succeeding 3GPP node by listing the UPDATE method in the ALLOW header field.

question_3872.question: Which LBT category included the schemes tested for both the DL and UL?
question_3872.ground_truth: Category 3 schemes were tested for both the DL and UL.

question_3873.question: What is the purpose of acquiring the requested SI message(s) corresponding to the requested SIB(s) in clause 5.2.2.3.2?
question_3873.ground_truth: The purpose of acquiring the requested SI message(s) corresponding to the requested SIB(s) in clause 5.2.2.3.2 is to allow the UE to receive the required system information for the cell.

question_3875.question: How does the UE access the localized service in this solution?
question_3875.ground_truth: The UE registers to the hosting network and authenticates using credentials provisioned in step 2. After registration, the UE has access to the localized service.

question_3876.question: What occurs if the timer for the temporarily stored data waiting to be delivered to a receiving user expires?
question_3876.ground_truth: The MCData server may purge the temporarily stored data and inform the recipient MCData user in MCData indication with "Data expired and not available to download anymore" in the Deferred data list.

question_3877.question: In what circumstances should the target UE derive a new KNRP by performing one or more 5G ProSe direct link authentication procedures?
question_3877.ground_truth: When the target UE does not have an existing KNRP for the KNRP ID included in the PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message or when the target UE wishes to derive a new KNRP.

question_3878.question: Which entity in the 5G Uplink Media Streaming architecture obtains feedback from the 5GMSu AF for 5G Media Streaming system provisioning?
question_3878.ground_truth: The 5GMSu Application Provider, via the M1u (5GMSu Provisioning API) interface.

question_3879.question: What should the UE do upon receiving ue-TimersAndConstants in SIB1 for a target cell group?
question_3879.ground_truth: The UE should use the values for timers T311 and constants N310, N311 for the target cell group, as included in ue-TimersAndConstants received in SIB1.

question_3880.question: What attribute in the policy request contains the list of Internal Group Identifiers?
question_3880.ground_truth: The attribute that contains the list of Internal Group Identifiers is "groupIds".

question_3882.question: Which message does the SMF send to initiate the establishment of user-plane resources over the trusted non-3GPP access for the MA PDU Session?
question_3882.ground_truth: The SMF sends an Update SM Context Request to SMF containing a Non-3GPP path switch indication, which indicates that the requested update is for switching the data traffic of an MA PDU Session to the trusted non-3GPP access.

question_3884.question: What is one of the impacts to the MME in the CN relaying alternative for eNB handovers?
question_3884.ground_truth: The MME needs to store RAN assistance information received from the last eNB during the release of the last RRC signalling connection.

question_3885.question: What is the definition of CIoT RAT as per the document?
question_3885.ground_truth: The definition of CIoT RAT as per the document is a 3GPP Radio Access Technology for Cellular IoT supporting the traffic models defined in the document and ultra-low complexity, power constrained, and low data-rate 'Internet of Things' devices.

question_3886.question: When do the two trains switch their connection from the 3GPP network to the PC5 interface?
question_3886.ground_truth: When the following train further approaches the leading train and requires a connection with a very short end-to-end latency for delicate train control.

question_3887.question: Which two types of cells can be the source cell in 4.3.32 NRCellRelation?
question_3887.ground_truth: The two types of cells that can be the source cell in 4.3.32 NRCellRelation are NRCellCU instance and EUtranGenericCell.

question_3888.question: What security parameters are introduced in the solution for protecting the direct discovery set and U2U discovery set?
question_3888.ground_truth: Two sets of security parameters are introduced in the solution: one for protecting the direct discovery set and the other for protecting U2U discovery set.

question_3889.question: What is the difference between "shall" and "should" in a 3GPP technical specification or report?
question_3889.ground_truth: In a 3GPP technical specification or report, "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement while "should" indicates a recommendation.

question_3890.question: What should a UE do when switching from a normal mode to a low mobility scenario, stationary scenario, or stationary and not-at-cell-edge scenario during cell-reselection period?
question_3890.ground_truth: The UE should fulfill the requirements corresponding to normal mode over the measurement period (Tnormal) and thereafter switch to requirements corresponding to the low mobility scenario, stationary scenario, or stationary and not-at-cell edge scenario.

question_3892.question: If the S-CSCF determines that loopback routeing is applicable for an incoming request, what information should it save for subsequent processing?
question_3892.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should save any URI representing the TRF address preference received from the visited network, and the ICID received in the request.

question_3893.question: When was the key valid from?

question_3895.question: In Scenario #2, what message does End UE#1 send to End UE#2 after End UE#1 decides to perform U2U Relay reselection with coordinated release of the initial connection?
question_3895.ground_truth: End UE#1 sends a Link Modification Request message which includes an indication to request a coordinated release of the initial connection via Relay#1 and other reselection related parameters.

question_3898.question: What d es the MS being tested for in the negotiation between TS 61 and TS 62: Mobile Originated call?
question_3898.ground_truth: The MS being tested for in the negotiation between TS 61 and TS 62: Mobile Originated call is its ability to accept a negotiation from TS 61 to TS 62.

question_3900.question: What is the minimum uplink rate for the combination described in 7.4.8.1?

question_3902.question: What should an MCVideo client do when it receives a request from an MCVideo user to release a private call session established using on-demand session signalling?
question_3902.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should follow the procedures as specified in clause 6.2.5.1 for on-demand session or clause 6.2.6 for terminating session.

question_3903.question: What is the effect of using the AT+CHCCS command with the parameter "5"?
question_3903.ground_truth: It terminates the connection with the call that has the identification number "5".

question_3904.question: What action does the target gNB/ng-eNB take when it receives a UE's RRCResumeRequest message?
question_3904.ground_truth: The target gNB/ng-eNB extracts the I-RNTI from the message and contacts the source gNB/ng-eNB for UE validation and context retrieval, and it prepares an Xn-AP Retrieve UE Context Request message to send to the source gNB/ng-eNB.

question_3905.question: How does the network set a priority for PLMNs in the disaster roaming scenario?
question_3905.ground_truth: The disaster roaming assistance information can consist of a prioritized list of PLMNs, a weighted list of PLMNs, or an indication of the capacity of PLMNs without Disaster to accept Disaster Inbound Roamers.

question_3906.question: What are the two main drawbacks of adhering to Level 3 of the Richardson maturity model?
question_3906.ground_truth: The two main drawbacks of adhering to Level 3 of the Richardson maturity model are increased message size and computational effort, and increased standardization effort.

question_3911.question: What action does the PCEF take to enforce the authorized QoS of the identified QoS rules?
question_3911.ground_truth: The PCEF installs, modifies or removes the identified QoS Rules, and enforces the authorized QoS of the corresponding QoS Rules.

question_3912.question: What should be the throughput for each component carrier as a percentage of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channels?
question_3912.ground_truth: The throughput for each component carrier should be at least 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channels as specified in Annex A.2 and A.3.

question_3913.question: What is the purpose of measuring the frequency responses in the silence condition?
question_3913.ground_truth: The purpose of measuring the frequency responses in the silence condition is to describe the differences between the devices by single values.

question_3915.question: What are the common characteristics between the child PDU sessions of a multi-access PDU session?
question_3915.ground_truth: The child PDU sessions of a multi-access PDU session share the following characteristics: a common DNN, a common UPF anchor, a common PDU type (e.g. IPv6), common IP address(es), a common SSC mode, and a common S-NSSAI.

question_3916.question: What command type was used in the REFRESH 1.3.1B response?

question_3917.question: When must the MCData client send a delivered notification to the originating client?
question_3917.ground_truth: When the SDS disposition request type IE in the received SDS SIGNALLING PAYLOAD message is set to "DELIVERY".

question_3919.question: What should the MCS UE do upon receiving the identity of the partner MC system selected by the user in manual partner MC system selection mode?
question_3919.ground_truth: The MCS UE shall select the partner MC system identified by the identity of a partner MC system selected by the user.

question_3920.question: What is the purpose of the requirements in clause 8.16.3 for the MAC-CE based uplink TCI state switch delay?
question_3920.ground_truth: The purpose of the requirements in clause 8.16.3 is to specify the delay for the MAC-CE based uplink TCI state switch, which applies for both separate UL TCI state switch and joint TCI state switch. The requirements ensure that the source RS in UL TCI state or joint TCI state is associated with a PCI different from that of the serving cell, and that the cell with a different PCI satisfies the known cell condition. If the known cell condition is not met, a longer delay may be expected. The requirements also specify that the UE is not expected to transmit on uplink based on the target TCI state before completing the downlink and uplink TCI state switch.

question_3921.question: What is the duplication factor in the context of network traffic duplication solutions, and how is it defined?
question_3921.ground_truth: The duplication factor is a percentage between 0% and 100% that determines the amount of traffic duplicated on a secondary access. It can be used to limit the number of duplicated packets to the ones seen as important for the user equipment (UE) and the user plane function (UPF).

question_3922.question: What privilege does an MCPTT client gain when initiating an imminent peril group call?
question_3922.ground_truth: The MCPTT client gains elevated access privilege for the MCPTT client if it is not already in that state. The access privilege for other applications is not affected.

question_3923.question: What is the difference between the spectral filling for transient mode and normal HQ mode?
question_3923.ground_truth: The spectral filling in transient mode does not include bandwidth extension, while in normal HQ mode it does.

question_3924.question: What steps does the PCF need to follow when modifying an existing session rule with conditional data?
question_3924.ground_truth: The PCF shall provision a session rule as defined in clause~4.2.6.3.1 and include within its "refCondData" attribute the corresponding ConditionData's "condId" attribute value. The PCF shall also ensure that the referenced ConditionData instance is included in the "conds" map within the SmPolicyDecision data structure following the procedures defined in clause~4.2.6.1. When modifying the attribute(s) within a session rule, the PCF shall include the modified attribute(s) with the new value(s) within the SessionRule data instance. If the PCF only needs to modify the content of referenced policy decision data, it shall include the corresponding policy decision data within the corresponding map attributes within the SmPolicyDecision data structure.

question_3925.question: What is the role of the GCS AS in the group communication process?
question_3925.ground_truth: The GCS AS uses the information provided by the MCE to determine the delivery method (MBMS or unicast) for each UE in the group communication.

question_3926.question: Which parameter in the Sbi-Binding-Header header indicates the name of a service?

question_3927.question: What procedure is used for NF/NF service discovery across PLMNs in TS~23.502?
question_3927.ground_truth: The NF/NF service discovery procedure across PLMNs is specified in clause~4.17.5 of TS~23.502. The NRF in the local PLMN interacts with the NRF in the remote PLMN to retrieve the NF profile(s) of the NF instance(s) in the remote PLMN that matches the discovery criteria.

question_3929.question: What does the "ESM-Info" NAS-PDU indicate in the context of 5GC?
question_3929.ground_truth: The "ESM-Info" NAS-PDU contains a 5GC-UE or UE-5GC message in 5GS, which is transferred without interpretation in the NG-RAN node.

question_3930.question: In the case of an abnormal situation between application entities in the TC environment, what procedure is used to report the rejection of a TC component by the TC-user?
question_3930.ground_truth: The TC-user uses the TC-U-REJECT request primitive to report the rejection of a TC component, indicating an abnormal situation in the communication between two application entities.

question_3934.question: What is the maximum length of the ProSe application code when using application-controlled extension in a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message?
question_3934.ground_truth: The ProSe application code is encoded as a 184 bitstring when using application-controlled extension in a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message.

question_3935.question: Who provides an ambient listening call release response to the MCPTT server in the case of a first-to-answer call with floor control?
question_3935.ground_truth: The user at MCPTT client 1, if they accept the call

question_3936.question: In what frequency bands do the requirements for power class 1 not apply for inter-band carrier aggregation with one uplink component carrier assigned to one E-UTRA band, as specified in subclause 6.2.2?
question_3936.ground_truth: The requirements for power class 1 do not apply for inter-band carrier aggregation with one uplink component carrier assigned to one E-UTRA band in E-UTRA bands 3, 20, 28, or 31, as specified in subclause 6.2.2.

question_3937.question: How are RSRP and RSRQ measured in relation to actual user plane transmissions?
question_3937.ground_truth: RSRP and RSRQ are measured separately from actual user plane transmissions.

question_3938.question: When can the dialogue be terminated by TC-END request primitive with basic end?
question_3938.ground_truth: The dialogue can be terminated by TC-END request primitive with basic end in case of ending from the gsmSCF when the gsmSSF has sent the last EventReportBCSM, ApplyChargingReport or CallInformationReport.

question_3939.question: What is the implication of using the normal Service Request procedure in the 3GPP TS 24.301 standard?
question_3939.ground_truth: Using the normal Service Request procedure in the 3GPP TS 24.301 standard can result in radio resource savings as it ensures a secure context between the UE and eNB.

question_3941.question: What are the key issues related to online charging in terms of CDRs generation?
question_3941.ground_truth: The key issues related to online charging are: 1) Investigating how to support CDRs generation when online charging is activated, 2) Supporting Offline charging (CDRs generation) only (i.e. no online charging).

question_3942.question: What is Key Issue #5 about in the context of Short Message Service?
question_3942.ground_truth: Key Issue #5 is about studying protocol selection mechanisms in the SMSF, SMS-GMSC, and UDM/HSS/HLR for the right protocol selection for Short Message Service.

question_3944.question: What is the concern addressed in Key Issue #8-3 regarding floor request timing in interworked systems?
question_3944.ground_truth: The concern addressed in Key Issue #8-3 is the potential for floor request transmissions sent from either an LMR device on an LMR system, or an MCPTT UE on an MCPTT system to take different times to arrive at the controlling floor control server, leading to an inherent bias in the chance of a floor request being accepted.

question_3947.question: What should 5GMM do if it receives a request to modify an existing PDU session and barring is still in effect for the associated access category?
question_3947.ground_truth: 5GMM shall not initiate the NAS transport procedure to send the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message.

question_3948.question: What is the disadvantage of option 1 in the solution detail subclause of TS 33.501?
question_3948.ground_truth: The disadvantage of option 1 is that the AUSF has to store a key identifier in addition to storing KAUSF, and this solution requires additional storage in the AUSF and the UE if the AUSF stores multiple pairs of key identifier and KAUSF for each UE.

question_3950.question: What is one of the requirements for coexistence between NR and LTE-MTC in-band operation using FDM?
question_3950.ground_truth: One of the requirements for coexistence between NR and LTE-MTC in-band operation using FDM is to avoid overlap between static SSB signals and the center 6 PRBs of the LTE-MTC Narrowband (NB) carrying LTE PSS and NSS as well as PBCH channel.

question_3952.question: What system is responsible for the significant interference in the MCBTS downlink, the MCBTS emissions or the UMTS UE interference?
question_3952.ground_truth: The unwanted emissions from MCBTS are orders of magnitude lower than the interference generated in the UMTS UE, which is the same for both MCBTS and SCBTS, meaning the interference is primarily caused by the UMTS UE.

question_3954.question: What is the action taken by a UE when it receives a 5GMM cause value of #10 while acting as a 5G-RG on behalf of the AUN3 device over a wireline access network?
question_3954.ground_truth: The UE should abort the initial registration procedure that was initiated on behalf of the AUN3 device. The 5G-RG should set its 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED and delete its 5G-GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list, ngKSI, and registration attempt counter. It should then enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.

question_3955.question: What is the purpose of the IMS NRM IRP: IS in 3GPP TS 28.704?
question_3955.ground_truth: The IMS NRM IRP: IS in 3GPP TS 28.704 specifies the requirements for the IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS) Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP), including the definition of a protocol neutral Information Service (IS).

question_3956.question: When should the first attempt be made by the MS in the fast first higher priority PLMN search?
question_3956.ground_truth: The first attempt by the MS should be made after a period of at least 2 minutes and at most T minutes, either after switch on if the fast first higher priority PLMN search is disabled, or after switch on or upon selecting a VPLMN if the fast first higher priority PLMN search is enabled.

question_3957.question: What is the test purpose of 15.11.3?
question_3957.ground_truth: The test purpose of 15.11.3 is to verify that the invoking UE puts the call on hold and resumes the call with a correct exchange of SIP/SDP protocol signalling messages.

question_3958.question: What are the initial conditions for the procedure described in 4.9.41.2?
question_3958.ground_truth: In the procedure described in 4.9.41.2, the initial conditions include a single NR cell connected to 5GC with default parameters, 1 NR-SS-UE, 1 GNSS simulator, and a user equipment that is in state 3N-A.

question_3959.question: What is the objective of the procedures described in clause 5.13.2.1?
question_3959.ground_truth: The objective of these procedures is to establish a Gxd IP CAN session after the IP Edge becomes aware of an IPv4 address and/or IPv6 prefix assignment to the fixed device and/or 3GPP UE.

question_3960.question: Which components are involved in the HSS/AAA-initiated detach procedure with GTP on S2b in the non-roaming, home routed roaming and local breakout case?
question_3960.ground_truth: The HSS, AAA, ePDG, and PDN GW are involved in this procedure.

question_3961.question: What is the purpose of limiting the maximum number of instances of the Load Control Info IE?
question_3961.ground_truth: The purpose of limiting the number of Load Control Info IE instances is to reduce the size of messages and prevent potential overloading of receivers by a misbehaving sender.

question_3964.question: What is the unique PDU Session ID creation method in the SMF+PGW-C during establishment of non-emergency PDN connection and emergency PDN connection for a UE that does not support 5GC NAS?
question_3964.ground_truth: The SMF+PGW-C creates a unique PDU Session ID for each PDN connection of the UE based on the EPS Bearer IDs assigned by the MME for the PDN Connections associated with the UE and not be in the range of PDU Session ID values that can be created by a 5GC NAS capable UE. If handover between EPS and EPC/ePDG is required, the SMF+PGW-C may perform additional steps to ensure the uniqueness of PDU Session ID.

question_3966.question: What keys can be used for storing in the AKRS in this solution?
question_3966.ground_truth: The AKRS can store either KAUSF or KSEAF.

question_3967.question: What should the UE include in the Contact header field of the UPDATE request if it has a public GRUU value associated with the public user identity?
question_3967.ground_truth: The UE should insert the public GRUU ("pub-gruu" header field parameter) value in the Contact header field of the UPDATE request as specified in RFC 5627.

question_3968.question: What is the state of the UE in the initial conditions of the test execution?
question_3968.ground_truth: The UE is in state Registered, Inactive mode (state 2N-A) on NR Cell 1.

question_3969.question: What happens when the inviting MCPTT UE-A receives the right-to-speak indication in a floor control message from the MCPTT server performing the MCPTT controlling function when the number of invited MCPTT users that accept the invitation meets the commencement mode conditions?
question_3969.ground_truth: The inviting MCPTT UE-A is now able to start sending media.

question_3970.question: What is the E-URTA ACLR requirement for power class 2 UE in Band 40 operating in Band 40?
question_3970.ground_truth: The E-URTA ACLR requirement for power class 2 UE in Band 40 operating in Band 40 is 31dB.

question_3971.question: What is the purpose of the Delay Value field in the BVC Measurement information element?
question_3971.ground_truth: The Delay Value field describes average queuing delay for a BVC in the network, in units of centi-seconds.

question_3973.question: What is the role of Part 5 in the 3GPP TS 34.229 conformance specification series?
question_3973.ground_truth: Part 5 of the 3GPP TS 34.229 series is responsible for the protocol conformance specification using 5G System (5GS) in the Internet Protocol (IP) multimedia call control protocol based on Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) and Session Description Protocol (SDP).

question_3974.question: What are the maximum luma samples, picture size, and frames per second for HEVC-FullHD-Enc as defined in 3GPP services?
question_3974.ground_truth: The HEVC-FullHD-Enc is capable of encoding a video signal with up to 133,693,440 luma samples per second, up to a luma picture size of 2,228,224 samples, and up to 240 frames per second, with chroma format 4:2:0 and bit depth of 8 or 10 bit.

question_3975.question: What is the purpose of the Communication Surveillance Integration Reference Point (CSIRP) in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_3975.ground_truth: The CSIRP is defined as a capability to ensure the availability and reliability of the communication between the managing system (manager) and the managed system (agent) by automatically surveying their communication. It is part of the 3GPP's technical specifications for telecommunication management in 3G systems.

question_3976.question: What is the DL peak data rate in NR satellite access, as defined in Report ITU-R M.2514?
question_3976.ground_truth: The DL peak data rate in NR satellite access is calculated as the product of the channel bandwidth and the peak spectral efficiency for DL, as defined in equation 4.2-1 of Report ITU-R M.2514.

question_3979.question: What action does the MSC-1 server take after receiving the Handover Required message from the serving BSS?
question_3979.ground_truth: The MSC-1 server requests the MGW to provide a binding reference and a bearer address using the Prepare Bearer procedure and uses the Change Flow Direction procedure to set the Handover Device to the initial state.
