question_3983.question: What is the procedure outlined in Note 2 in 4.4.2 Scenario 3.2 and 4.5.2 Scenario 4.2 for notifications for discreet listening in MCVideo pulls and pushes?
question_3983.ground_truth: Authorized MC user A may receive separate notifications when the MCVideo pull or push is initiated, and when the MCVideo media is provided.

question_3984.question: What message does the UE send to the PDN GW to de-register its DSMIPv6 binding in the scenario where a UE uses a trusted or untrusted non-3GPP access system?
question_3984.ground_truth: The UE sends a BU (lifetime) to the PDN GW to de-register its DSMIPv6 binding.

question_3986.question: What is the formula for the measured CDP ratio in the communication system?
question_3986.ground_truth: The measured CDP ratio is calculated using the formula: 10*log((Measured code power) / (Measured total power of all active codes)).

question_3987.question: What action does the mobile station take when it receives an implicit reject for the CS domain or PS domain?
question_3987.ground_truth: The mobile station starts timer T3234 or T3236, respectively, and returns to idle mode, prohibiting further mobile-originated access attempts until the timer expires or is stopped.

question_3988.question: What is the difference between short-term denial and long-term denial in CCBS service?
question_3988.ground_truth: Short-term denial is a temporary inability of the network to accept user A's request to activate the CC service, while long-term denial is a situation where the network cannot accept user A's request to activate the CC service, and a later attempt to activate the CC service for the same destination B will also be rejected.

question_3989.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP TS 22.011 standard?
question_3989.ground_truth: The 3GPP TS 22.011 standard defines a new service to provide Restricted Local Operator Services (RLOS) for unauthenticated UEs.

question_3990.question: What is the procedure for sending a SEALDD Transmission Request?
question_3990.ground_truth: To send a SEALDD Transmission Request, the service consumer sends an HTTP POST request to the SEALDD Server with the request body including the TransReq data structure, specifying the type of transmission requested ("regular" or "urllc"). Upon success, the SEALDD Server responds with an HTTP "200 OK" status code, and on failure, it returns an appropriate error status code and additional information.

question_3992.question: What information is provided by the "LTE-M Indication" IE in the 3GPP NG RAN protocol?
question_3992.ground_truth: The "LTE-M Indication" IE is provided by the NG-RAN node to inform that the UE indicates category M1 or M2 in its UE Radio Capability.

question_3994.question: When should the participating MCVideo function reject the "SIP INVITE request for originating participating MCVideo function" with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response, if the <allow-private-call> element of the <ruleset> element is not present or is present with the value "false" in the MCVideo user profile document?
question_3994.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function should reject the "SIP INVITE request for originating participating MCVideo function" with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response, with warning text set to "107 user not authorized to make private calls" in a Warning header field as specified in subclause~4.4, and shall not continue with the rest of the steps.

question_3999.question: What status code is used by the PFDF to indicate "too short allowed delay" when the provisioning is rejected?
question_3999.ground_truth: If the provisioning is rejected due to "too short allowed delay", the PFDF shall indicate the reason using an HTTP status code 412 Precondition Failed.

question_4000.question: What is the purpose of the Require header field in the message sent by the UE-A?
question_4000.ground_truth: The Require header field in the message sent by the UE-A contains the option-tag "100rel" and "precondition" which indicates reliable sending of the 183 (Session Progress) response and usage of the precondition mechanism.

question_4001.question: When shall the mobile station (MS) ignore a SETUP, EMERGENCY SETUP, or START CC message received with octet 1 part of the TI value coded as "111"?
question_4001.ground_truth: When TI EXT bit =1 or no extension is used

question_4002.question: What information is required by NWDAF to reallocate traffic from some UPF instances to other UPF instances?
question_4002.ground_truth: NWDAF requires information on how UEs are characterized as low or high priority, where to get information on UE priority, whether UE priority is relative to within a given network slice or across network slices, if UE priority or time of day is the main criteria for reallocating traffic, knowledge of the network slices associated with UPF instances, knowledge of which UPF instances can receive traffic from other UPF instances, and information about isolation requirements and server locations.

question_4003.question: What QoS parameters should be set up for the Sync frame delivery when limiting bridge residence time to 10 ms, as specified in step 3?
question_4003.ground_truth: PDB1, which is the UL PDB for the QoS flow of PDU session for UE1, should be less than 10ms

question_4004.question: What is the purpose of the S-CCPCH-InformationListExt-AuditRsp field?
question_4004.ground_truth: The S-CCPCH-InformationListExt-AuditRsp field contains information about the status and availability of an S-CCPCH resource on a LTE network.

question_4005.question: What is the impact on the positioning accuracy improvement for Redcap UEs in FR1 UMi scenario when phase offset between hops is considered and frequency hopping with partial overlap for phase offset compensation is used?
question_4005.ground_truth: The positioning accuracy improvement is observed for UL TDOA, DL TDOA, and Multi-RTT when the phase offset between hops is considered, and frequency hopping with partial overlap for phase offset compensation is used in FR1 UMi scenario.

question_4006.question: What kind of sensors are typically used in AR systems for real-time localization?
question_4006.ground_truth: Most AR systems use vision sensors such as cameras, an inertial measurement unit, and a GPS.

question_4008.question: What is the effect of receiving a deassign() method for a call leg?
question_4008.ground_truth: The leg is released and the call leg object is destroyed, but no further reports are sent to the application. Additionally, the callLegEnded() method is not invoked in this case.

question_4012.question: In EMM-IDLE mode, what action does a UE, with a valid USIM, take when not attached to the EPS and when entering a tracking area not in the list of assigned tracking areas?
question_4012.ground_truth: In EMM-IDLE mode, a UE, with a valid USIM, will perform tracking area updating when entering a tracking area not in the list of assigned tracking areas, in order to maintain the registration and enable the MME to keep track of the UE.

question_4013.question: How does the IOPS packet distribution function resolve the IP address destination for IP packets related to the call setup request?
question_4013.ground_truth: The IOPS packet distribution function resolves that the IP address destination is a unicast IP address of another MC UE within the IOPS system.

question_4014.question: What is the obligation for the terminating network if the TIR service is invoked?
question_4014.ground_truth: If the TIR service is invoked, the terminating network shall automatically enable the TIR service for every incoming request, ensuring that the terminating user's identity information is restricted.

question_4015.question: What is the set of general parameters required to describe the mapping of any logical channel onto one or more physical channel(s)?
question_4015.ground_truth: The set of general parameters required to describe the mapping of any logical channel onto one or more physical channel(s) includes: i) the set of radio frequency channels used in the cell together with the identification of the BCCH carrier and ii) the TDMA frame number (FN), which can be derived from the reduced TDMA frame number (RFN).

question_4018.question: What is the 3GPP and what is its role in the development of the X2 interface for E-UTRAN?
question_4018.ground_truth: The 3GPP is a partnership between several telecommunications standardization bodies, including organizations from several countries. They produce technical specifications, such as those defining the X2 interface for E-UTRAN, which allow for the interconnection and interoperability of different network components.

question_4019.question: What are the conditions that a UE (MCPTT Client) must satisfy to initiate MCPTT user authentication?
question_4019.ground_truth: The MCPTT UE must activate an MCPTT application and request MCPTT initialization.

question_4020.question: Which bands may be affected by 3rd order IMD products when Bands 28 and 41 are used for CA with 1 UL and maximum bandwidth is considered?
question_4020.ground_truth: Bands 1, 8, 18, 26, 28, 38, 41, and 44 may be affected by 3rd order IMD products when Bands 28 and 41 are used for CA with 1 UL and maximum bandwidth is considered.

question_4021.question: What information does the "ECGI" attribute provide in the <transmission> and <reception> elements?
question_4021.ground_truth: The "ECGI" attribute in the <transmission> and <reception> elements contains the parameter defined in subclause~12.4.2.5, indicating E-UTRAN Cell Global Identification of the E-UTRAN cell where the UE was camping on or which the UE used in the EMM-CONNECTED mode when transmitting or receiving the data.

question_4022.question: What happens when the NG-RAN node(s) joins the delivery of the broadcast MBS session if multicast transport is used over N3mb?
question_4022.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node(s) responds with the N2 MBS Session Setup Response message including a MBS Session Setup or Modification Transfer IE if a Shared NG-U Unicast TNL Information needs to be allocated for unicast transport over N3mb interface.

question_4024.question: What happens when an SAE-capable UE in IDLE mode is attached in 2G/3G and then selects an LTE cell?
question_4024.ground_truth: The UE initiates a Tracking Area Update and the 2G/3G MME treats this as an inter-SGSN routing area update.

question_4025.question: What is the Code for the CAG human-readable network name broadcasted in the network parameters for Cell 1 in sequence 1.30?
question_4025.ground_truth: There is no CAG human-readable network name broadcasted for Cell 1 in sequence 1.30.

question_4028.question: What is the method of testing the procedure of an MS camping on the BCCH carrier of the cell whose channel has just been released?
question_4028.ground_truth: The method of testing involves the SS transmitting a paging request to the MS after releasing the TCH or SDCCH and monitoring the MS's response to verify if it camps on the BCCH carrier quickly.

question_4029.question: What is the function of the Central Binding Server (CBS) in common EAS selection?
question_4029.ground_truth: The function of the Central Binding Server (CBS) in common EAS selection is to decide whether to proceed with the currently selected EAS or instruct to use another EAS for the UE group. The CBS maintains the binding information for the UE group and uses EDN id to identify EDN (Edge Network Domain) to ensure the correct mapping of UEs to the corresponding EAS.

question_4030.question: What should the UE do when performing the handover procedure and the physical frequency remains unchanged but the band is changed?
question_4030.ground_truth: E-UTRAN releases the measObject corresponding to the source frequency and adds a measObject corresponding to the target frequency.

question_4031.question: Which record does the IRI-POI in the PTC server generate when the IRI-POI detects that the PTC target initiates an on-demand session or receives an invitation to join an on-demand session?
question_4031.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the PTC server generates an xIRI containing a PTCSessionInitiation record when it detects that the PTC target initiates an on-demand session or receives an invitation to join an on-demand session.

question_4032.question: What is the minimum output power required for a Relay backhaul link with multiple transmit antenna connectors?
question_4032.ground_truth: For a relay backhaul link with multiple transmit antenna connectors, the minimum output power level is defined with respect to the sum of the mean power at each relay node backhaul antenna connector in one sub-frame (1 ms). The sum of these mean powers will be subject to the -50 dBm minimum output power requirement.

question_4033.question: What is the difference between the "Required" and "Supported" header fields in RTSP?
question_4033.ground_truth: The "Supported" header field is used to enumerate all the extensions supported by the sender, while the "Required" header field is used to ensure that a certain feature is supported by the recipient, causing the request to fail if the required feature is not supported.

question_4034.question: What is the required target packet delivery reliability rate for the 3GPP system in Phase I, as specified in PR.5.5-002?

question_4035.question: In the DNS Server registration procedure, what is the role of the MTC Device in providing the device identifier, APN, and IP address to the DNS Server via the AAA Server?
question_4035.ground_truth: The MTC Device provides the device identifier, APN, and IP address to the DNS Server via the AAA Server during the PDP context activation procedure.

question_4036.question: What information should be included in the jitter analysis report provided by the MDAS producer?
question_4036.ground_truth: The jitter analysis report should contain details such as the identifier of the jitter issue, type, start and end times, location, root cause, affected objects, severity level, jitter values, and recommended actions to solve the issue.

question_4037.question: What should the MBSF do upon success when updating an MBS User Service?
question_4037.ground_truth: The MBSF should update the concerned "Individual MBS User Service" resource and respond to the NF service consumer with either an HTTP "200 OK" status code containing the updated representation of the resource within the MBSUserService data structure or an HTTP "204 No Content" status code.

question_4038.question: What is the role of the Relay Entity within the L2R?
question_4038.ground_truth: The Relay Entity within the L2R provides the mapping between the NTP Entity and the L2R Entity. It may also contain the data compression function and negotiate parameters with the remote Relay Entity.

question_4040.question: What is the requirement for the measured BLER in this test scenario?
question_4040.ground_truth: The measured BLER shall not exceed 0.1 on each individual cell.

question_4042.question: What is the 3GPP technical specification group that deals with the technical aspects and services of 3GPP systems related to eCall?
question_4042.ground_truth: Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects

question_4045.question: What is one condition that would lead the UE to initiate the monitor request procedure?
question_4045.ground_truth: When the UE is triggered by an upper layer application to perform restricted ProSe direct discovery model A monitoring corresponding to at least one RPAUID, and the UE has no valid Restricted Discovery Filters corresponding to the requested RPAUID for that upper layer application.

question_4046.question: What is the role of the test equipment in this test, as specified in clause 6.4.1.1.4.2?
question_4046.ground_truth: The test equipment is used to monitor all SRS transmissions and verify that the UE transmit timing offset stays within a specified range.

question_4047.question: Which element in the XML schema has the complex type name "tSessionOrientedServiceInfoType"?
question_4047.ground_truth: The element with the name "v2x-service-id" has the complex type name "tSessionOrientedServiceInfoType".

question_4049.question: What is the interface used for transferring changes between the CS copy and the transparent data file in the HSS/HLR?
question_4049.ground_truth: The Sh interface is used for transferring changes between the CS copy and the transparent data file in the HSS/HLR.

question_4051.question: What message does the MS send to the SS after receiving the location estimate from the SS?
question_4051.ground_truth: The MS terminates the dialogue by sending a RELEASE COMPLETE message.

question_4052.question: What is the MS required to do upon the initiation of an outgoing basic call by the user?
question_4052.ground_truth: The MS is required to initiate establishment of an MM connection using a CM SERVICE REQUEST message with a CM service type of "Mobile originating call establishment or packet mode connection establishment" as the first MM message.

question_4053.question: How is a transmission in the MBMS Streaming Delivery Method initiated?
question_4053.ground_truth: Mobile terminals retrieve transmission details like Multicast IP Address, TMGI and the used ports before the MBMS UEs can activate the reception. Upon interaction of the user and when all parameters are known, the UE "tunes in" the transmission and stays until the user decides to leave the transmission, which can happen before the transmission ends.

question_4057.question: What is the purpose of Test Case 14 (TC14)?
question_4057.ground_truth: The purpose of TC14 is to test UTRA, E-UTRA, and NB-IoT standalone multi-carrier aspects.

question_4058.question: What subframe should the SS receive the first CSI report for intra-band CA UE in step 6b?

question_4061.question: What is the role of the SL Positioning Client UE in the Ranging/SL positioning operation when the SL Positioning Client UE consumes the Ranging/SL positioning service?
question_4061.ground_truth: The SL Positioning Client UE triggers the Ranging/SL positioning, and then requests the network to perform the Ranging/SL positioning between the UE1 and UE2. It includes the Ranging/SL positioning requirement in the MO-LR Request toward the AMF3.

question_4062.question: What generic term is used to describe the process of providing NR sidelink synchronization information for NR sidelink communication/discovery and SLSS/PSBCH transmission?
question_4062.ground_truth: The term is "Sidelink synchronization information transmission procedure for NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning."

question_4064.question: What privacy issue is addressed in Key Issue #4 regarding UE-to-UE relay?
question_4064.ground_truth: The main privacy issue addressed is protecting the privacy of identities exchanged in communications between peer UEs over a UE-to-UE relay.

question_4065.question: What is the main purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group in the "MBMS Extensions for Provisioning and Content Ingestion" document?
question_4065.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group is responsible for identifying key functionality of an interface from external application service/content providers to the BM-SC for provisioning and content ingestion in order to leverage all delivery methods and procedures through the interface.

question_4066.question: When should the controlling MCVideo function start timer TNG2 (in-progress emergency group call timer) as specified in subclause~6.3.3.1.16?
question_4066.ground_truth: When the in-progress emergency state of the group is set to a value of "true".

question_4068.question: What is the advantage of validating the CSG ID and access control mode of the target cell in the handover procedure?
question_4068.ground_truth: This advantage of this approach is that it mitigates the risk for the UE to hand off to a CSG cell for which the UE is not allowed.

question_4069.question: What is the first step in creating a PDU session with "5G VN internal" switching in the local PSA UPF(s)?
question_4069.ground_truth: The first step is to associate the UL traffic on the access side of the PDU Session with "5G VN internal" switching in the local PSA UPF(s).

question_4070.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon receiving a PRIVATE CALL ACCEPT ACK message or RTP media from the originating user, when in the "P5: pending" state of a private video pull call?
question_4070.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should follow the procedure as defined in clause~10.3.2.4.3.4 with the clarification to not start transmission control as the terminating MCVideo client.

question_4071.question: What is a UE not required to do if it operates an IDLE eDRX cycle longer than the modification period and the systemInfoModification-eDRX bit of a Short Message is set?
question_4071.ground_truth: Apply the SI acquisition procedure as defined in clause 5.2.2.3 from the start of the next eDRX acquisition period boundary.

question_4073.question: What entities are responsible for collecting charging information in case of interworking between 5GS and EPC?
question_4073.ground_truth: The dedicated PGW-C + SMF collects charging information using the same mechanisms as the SMF.

question_4075.question: What is the definition of end-to-end media flow routing in the context of MCPTT?
question_4075.ground_truth: End-to-end media flow routing in MCPTT means the routing of media flow from the transmitting UE to the receiver UE, except for the PTT control function, which may not be end-to-end.

question_4077.question: Which keys and associated key identifiers are used for protecting the media sent and received by MCData clients in an on-network MCData communication for an MCData group?
question_4077.ground_truth: The GMK and the GMK-ID of the MCData group are used for protecting the media sent and received by MCData clients in an on-network MCData communication for an MCData group.

question_4080.question: What should the UE do if it receives a request from upper layers to establish an eCall over IMS while in the EMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE substate?
question_4080.ground_truth: The UE should enter the EMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH substate and use the relevant EMM and ESM procedures to establish the eCall over IMS at the earliest opportunity.

question_4081.question: What is the term defined in the document that refers to the time period available to repair the primary timing source when it is lost?

question_4082.question: What is required for the PCF to include MA PDU Session control information within the PCC rule for ATSSS support?
question_4082.ground_truth: The SMF and the PCF should both support the "ATSSS" feature as defined in clause 5.8 and there should be detected service data flow within the PCC rule.

question_4085.question: What is the purpose of the SIP REFER request in step 4?
question_4085.ground_truth: The SIP REFER request in step 4 is used by the SCC AS to send a request to UE-1 to initiate a new REFER request to the SCC AS.

question_4086.question: What should the IWF do if it receives a SIP re-INVITE request with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body with an <emergency-ind> element set to a value of "true" and is an authorized request to initiate an MCPTT emergency group call?
question_4086.ground_truth: The IWF should cache the MCPTT ID of the MCPTT user that has initiated an MCPTT emergency call.

question_4088.question: What existing features can support the functionality of the eRG in ensuring the required QoS for AR/VR gaming in a 5G context?
question_4088.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 22.220 and TS 22.261 specify requirements and features for indoor base stations and 5GLAN networks that can be used to provide the same 5G LAN-type service to AR/VR devices in a 5G network.

question_4089.question: What should the target UE do if it receives a new PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE REQUEST message from the same layer-2 ID while the ongoing 5G ProSe direct link identifier update procedure is still in progress?
question_4089.ground_truth: The target UE should stop the timer T5083 and abort the ongoing 5G ProSe direct link identifier update procedure.

question_4090.question: What is the format of the Name leaf in the IMS conferencing management object?
question_4090.ground_truth: The Name leaf is a character string used as a name for the conferencing settings.

question_4091.question: What is the standard Schmidt-Normalized Ambisonics (FOA) signal format referred to as?
question_4091.ground_truth: This format is also known as AmbiX format.

question_4092.question: What should the NSACF do if it receives a request to mute events from the NWDAF or DCCF, and the "notifFlag" attribute is set to "DEACTIVATE"?
question_4092.ground_truth: The NSACF should mute the event notification and store the available events.

question_4093.question: What should the UE do if the maximum number of retransmissions for an AM SL DRB is reached in the sidelink connection with the peer UE?
question_4093.ground_truth: The UE should release the PC5-RRC connection, indicate the release to the upper layer, and send a SidelinkUEInformationNR message to indicate SL RLF (Sidelink Radio Link Failure).

question_4094.question: What are the issues raised by network slicing scenarios where one or more network slice constituents are provided by a second operator?
question_4094.ground_truth: The issues include terminology, modelling, APIs, abstraction level, and security.

question_4095.question: What is the HTTP request header used for conveying the client credentials assertion when sending messages over the N32 interface in 3GPP networks?

question_4096.question: What is the procedure for group affiliation to an interworking group defined in the LMR system via the IWF?
question_4096.ground_truth: The procedure involves sending a MC service group affiliation request from the MC service client to the MC service server, which then sends an IWF group affiliation request to the IWF. The IWF performs the necessary translations and protocol conversions and sends an IWF group affiliation response back to the MC service server, which then stores the group affiliation status of the MC service client for the requested interworking group.

question_4098.question: How does the NRF perform authorization for ML model retrieval in this solution?
question_4098.ground_truth: The NRF performs service authorization of ML model retrieval using token-based authorization at the NRF.

question_4099.question: What is the definition of a MTC Device in the context of the present document?
question_4099.ground_truth: A MTC Device is a UE equipped for Machine Type Communication, which communicates through a PLMN with MTC Server(s) and/or other MTC Device(s). It might also communicate locally with other entities which provide the MTC Device "raw data" for processing and communication to the MTC Server(s) and/or other MTC Device(s).

question_4100.question: What action should the MS take if timer T3396 is running when the MS is switched off and then on again with the same SIM/USIM?
question_4100.ground_truth: If t1 is greater than t, then the timer shall be restarted with the value t1 - t. If t1 is equal to or less than t, then the timer need not be restarted.

question_4101.question: What should the UE do when it receives a PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message for a PDU session that is in the state PDU SESSION INACTIVE in the UE?
question_4101.ground_truth: The UE should include the 5GSM cause #43 "Invalid PDU session identity" in the 5GSM STATUS message and set the PDU session ID to the received PDU session ID in the UL NAS TRANSPORT message.

question_4102.question: What is the role of the OCS in the message flow of a UE originating RCS File Transfer in scenario B?
question_4102.ground_truth: The OCS is responsible for authorizing the RCS File Transfer service with SDP offer description and granting pre-liminary time quota. It also sends CCA to the MMTel AS with granted quota, and sends a new granted time quota once the RCS File Transfer service is authorized.

question_4104.question: What is the effect of invoking Priority Service if a radio channel is not available and the queue for the cell is full, and the user's priority is higher than one or more Priority Service calls already in the queue?
question_4104.ground_truth: The lowest, most recent call in the queue is dropped from the queue, and the user's call is placed in the queue in accordance with the user's priority level and call initiation time.

question_4105.question: What are the maximum frame rates for the PD Media Profile in the DECE specification on Common File Format & Media Formats?
question_4105.ground_truth: The maximum frame rate for the PD Media Profile is 30 Hz, and it supports 23.97, 24, 29.97, and 30 Hz for 24 and 30 Hz contents, and 25 Hz for 25 Hz contents.

question_4106.question: What are the factors that can impact the achievable time synchronization accuracy for network listening based synchronization?
question_4106.ground_truth: Factors that can impact the achievable time synchronization accuracy include channel condition of received network listening RS, propagation delay between source cell and target cell, number of hops in small cell clusters, time drift between network listening slots, synchronization status of original synchronization sources, and source cell selection mechanism.

question_4107.question: What is the primary technique for self-interference suppression for a LA BS with a smaller array size in the Ericsson study?

question_4108.question: Under what conditions is the UE-initiated Detach procedure used to disconnect the last PDN connection?
question_4108.ground_truth: The UE uses the UE-initiated Detach procedure in clause~5.3.8.2 to disconnect the last PDN connection if "Attach without PDN Connectivity is supported" and the UE requires the last PDN connection to be disconnected.

question_4109.question: What is the effect of the PCF returning "200 OK" response message during an SM policy association update?
question_4109.ground_truth: A successful SM policy association update is added to the relevant subcounter per S-NSSAI.

question_4110.question: In what scenarios can other PGW-C/SMFs from the same PGW-C/SMF set take over the control of PDN connections served by an unavailable PGW-C/SMF?
question_4110.ground_truth: This can occur when a PGW-C/SMF becomes no longer available due to failure (without restart or with a scale-in operation) or when a change in the PGW-C/SMF of a PDN connection is required, causing a PGW-C/SMF to be de-instantiated from the PGW-C/SMF set.

question_4113.question: In this use case, what is the requirement for managing synchronization between clients (e.g., different AR glasses) in the mobile metaverse service?
question_4113.ground_truth: The mobile metaverse server manages synchronization between the clients, which includes managing video, avatar, speech, and text communications.

question_4114.question: What should the MCPTT server do if multiple MCPTT user profiles are stored for the user or are downloaded from the MCPTT user database?
question_4114.ground_truth: The MCPTT server must determine the pre-selected MCPTT user profile by identifying the one that contains the `<Pre-selected-indication>` element.

question_4116.question: What are the conditions for PUSCH with DM-RS bundling performance tests to apply to different antenna connectors in a BS of type 1-C?
question_4116.ground_truth: The PUSCH with DM-RS bundling performance tests with low MIMO correlation level apply only for the highest number of supported connectors in a BS of type 1-C, using the specific connectors declared by the manufacturer.

question_4117.question: How many resource block groups are present in a resource allocation field for uplink resource allocation type 1?
question_4117.ground_truth: A resource allocation field for uplink resource allocation type 1 includes two sets of resource blocks with each set including one or more consecutive resource block groups of size P.

question_4119.question: What should be assigned in sl-RemoteUE-L2Identity for L2 U2U Remote UE if a local ID pair is to be assigned or modified for an end-to-end PC5 connection?
question_4119.ground_truth: The new local UE ID should be set in sl-RemoteUE-LocalIdentity and the source L2 ID of the L2 U2U Remote UE should be set in sl-RemoteUE-L2Identity, if needed.

question_4121.question: What action should the S-CSCF take regarding the Relayed-Charge header field when it is not the next hop?
question_4121.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should remove the Relayed-Charge header field when it is not the next hop.

question_4123.question: How many subcarrier spacings for UL does the UE support on one carrier of one band entry in a band combination?

question_4124.question: What is the purpose of using long-term or permanent identifiers to intercept communications?
question_4124.ground_truth: The purpose of using long-term or permanent identifiers is to specify the target of interception. These identifiers, such as IMEI or IMSI, are used even if the network uses other derived or temporary identifiers to identify the correct traffic.

question_4125.question: What does the term "UE" refer to in the context of the document?

question_4127.question: In the context of UE DL Category M1, under AWGN (Additive White Gaussian Noise) conditions, what is the requirement for the PDSCH BLER using the transport format indicated by the median CQI in a TDD system?
question_4127.ground_truth: If the PDSCH BLER using the transport format indicated by the median CQI is greater than 0.1, the BLER using transport format indicated by (median CQI - 1) shall be less than or equal to 0.1.

question_4130.question: What information is required for the change in RAN node in 5G systems?
question_4130.ground_truth: The change in RAN node in 5G systems requires N4 signaling towards its immediate next hop UPF.

question_4132.question: What is the purpose of the 'Request Number' in the Charging SCF interfaces?
question_4132.ground_truth: The 'Request Number' is used to make retries possible after application, service, or communication errors, and to ensure that there is only one outstanding request per Charging Session. The charging SCF guarantees that Request Numbers are unique in a timespan where delayed responses can arrive.

question_4133.question: What is the role of the NSSAAF in the NSS-AAA initiated revocation of network slice authorization?
question_4133.ground_truth: The NSSAAF is responsible for releasing the corresponding resources and interacting with its succeeding Network Function (AMF) to revoke network slice authorization.

question_4134.question: What message does a UE receive from the ProSe Function in HPLMN when it sends a Discovery Request message to inform the ProSe Function that it wants to stop announcing a ProSe Application Code before the associated validity timer expires?
question_4134.ground_truth: The UE receives a Discovery Response (Discovery Entry ID) message containing only the Discovery Entry ID.

question_4135.question: What should the User Equipment (UE) indicate to support access performance measurements per QoS Flow?
question_4135.ground_truth: The UE should indicate its support for access performance measurements per QoS Flow in its Access Traffic Steering, Switching and Splitting (ATSSS) capabilities.

question_4137.question: What is the test setup for EN-DC including FR1 and FR2 carriers in terms of the PCell?
question_4137.ground_truth: The test setup for EN-DC including FR1 and FR2 carriers in terms of the PCell is specified in Clause 9.1.2.

question_4138.question: What is the purpose of the re-selection delay in the test?
question_4138.ground_truth: The re-selection delay is used to define the time it takes for the UE to re-select a lower priority cell, which is used as a test requirement in the test case.

question_4139.question: What action does the EM take in step 4.2.4.1.5 after receiving the VNF instance termination notification from the VNFM?
question_4139.ground_truth: The EM sends a DeleteVnfIdentifierRequest to VNFM to delete the VNF instance identifier.

question_4140.question: What should be placed if neither NB-IoT guard-band nor NB-IoT in-band operation is supported but NR and E-UTRA operations are supported?
question_4140.ground_truth: An E-UTRA carrier should be placed if neither NB-IoT guard-band nor NB-IoT in-band operation is supported, but NR and E-UTRA operations are supported.

question_4143.question: What information corresponds to the actual individual presence reporting area when the UE enters or leaves one or more presence reporting areas related to a PRA set?
question_4143.ground_truth: The additional presence reporting area information

question_4144.question: What should the floor control server do upon receiving a Floor Release message for which a Floor Revoke message has been sent in multi-talker floor control?
question_4144.ground_truth: The floor control server should request the media distributor to stop forwarding RTP media packets, stop timer T1 (End of RTP media) and T3 (Stop talking grace), remove the participant from the list of currently granted talkers, and send a Floor Release Multi Talker message. If the active floor request queue is not empty, the floor control server should enter the 'G: Idle' state. If both the active floor request queue and the list of currently granted talkers are empty, the floor control server should also enter the 'G: Idle' state. If the active floor request queue is empty but the list of currently granted talkers is not, the floor control server should enter the 'G: Floor Taken' state.

question_4145.question: What does the DS-TT port number in the device refer to when the DS-TT functionality is supported?
question_4145.ground_truth: The DS-TT port number represents the PDU Session's DS-TT port number in the device.

question_4146.question: What is the main function of the MME in network-based IP flow mobility?
question_4146.ground_truth: The main function of the MME in network-based IP flow mobility is to transport routing rules received from UE via NAS to the S-GW.

question_4148.question: What is the purpose of the Self-healing functionality within the SON framework?
question_4148.ground_truth: The purpose of the Self-healing functionality within the SON framework is to automatically solve or mitigate faults that can be addressed automatically by triggering appropriate recovery actions.

question_4150.question: What attribute should be provided if a list of top applications is to be requested based on the maximum number of traffic contribution in uplink and/or downlink directions in the User Data Congestion feature?
question_4150.ground_truth: The "maxTopAppUlNbr" attribute for uplink direction traffic and/or the "maxTopAppDlNbr" attribute for downlink direction traffic should be provided to request a list of top applications.

question_4152.question: What is beam correspondence in the context of 3GPP beam management procedures?
question_4152.ground_truth: Beam correspondence is the ability of a user equipment (UE) to determine its uplink transmit beam based on downlink measurements on one or more receive beams.

question_4154.question: What is the purpose of the Mission Critical Push To Talk (MCPTT) service?
question_4154.ground_truth: The MCPTT service provides an enhanced Push To Talk communication method for mission critical scenarios, leveraging 3GPP system services. It supports group calls with an arbitrated permission to talk, and private calls between pairs of users.

question_4155.question: What is the minimum link budget difference between NR and PUSCH in an Urban scenario at 4 GHz with a DL PSD of 33 dBm/MHz and maximum 11-PRB UE bandwidth?

question_4157.question: What action does the new SGSN take if the security functions authenticate the MS correctly during a SGSN Context Request?
question_4157.ground_truth: The new SGSN sends an SGSN Context Request (old RAI, TLLI, MS Validated, New SGSN Address) message to the old SGSN, indicating that it has authenticated the MS.

question_4159.question: What should the AMF do if the DNN selected by the network is a LADN DNN after a successful SMF selection?
question_4159.ground_truth: The AMF should determine the UE presence in LADN service area.

question_4161.question: What is the purpose of the Alternative RAB Parameter Values IE?
question_4161.ground_truth: It is used to indicate that RAB QoS negotiation is allowed for certain RAB parameters, and in some cases, to indicate also which alternative values to be used in the negotiation.

question_4162.question: What is the procedure after a channel change in the MS?
question_4162.ground_truth: After a channel change, the MS initiates a request for multiple frame operation by transmitting the SABM command. All existing exception conditions are cleared, the retransmission counter is reset, and all outstanding DL-DATA-REQUEST primitives and layer~3 message units are saved. The send buffer is cleared, and a layer~3 message is put into the send buffer for transmission in acknowledged mode.

question_4163.question: What should be contained in the message body for a 4xx/5xx response in step 2b of the policy update procedures with an I-SMF?
question_4163.ground_truth: A VsmfUpdateError structure, including N4 response information if available (e.g. PFCP Session Establishment Response with a rejection cause).

question_4164.question: What must be defined for Frequency repetitions 2 and on in 1.28Mcps TDD?
question_4164.ground_truth: The E-DCH Resource Information for Frequency repetitions 2 and on in 1.28Mcps TDD should be defined in the MultipleFreq-E-DCH-Resources-Information-List-ResourceStatusInd field.

question_4166.question: What is the maximum allowed time for an event triggered measurement report to be sent after the beginning of time period T2?
question_4166.ground_truth: The maximum allowed time for an event triggered measurement report to be sent after the beginning of time period T2 is 802 ms, including a TTI insertion uncertainty of 2 ms.

question_4168.question: What data type is used for the `accessGroupId` attribute in the schema?
question_4168.ground_truth: The `accessGroupId` attribute is of the data type `accessGroupIdType`, which is a restriction of the `nonNegativeInteger` type.

question_4169.question: What can be used for classification of the PDU sessions for communication of a certain 5G VN group?
question_4169.ground_truth: The DNN/S-NSSAI can be used for classification of the PDU sessions for communication of a certain 5G VN group.

question_4170.question: What should the UE do upon the expiry of timer T3247?
question_4170.ground_truth: Upon the expiry of timer T3247, the UE should remove all tracking areas from the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service" and "forbidden tracking areas for roaming", set the USIM to valid for EPS services and non-EPS services if certain conditions are met, and remove PLMNs from the list of forbidden PLMNs for each PLMN-specific attempt counter that meets certain conditions.

question_4172.question: What is the method used to determine the coded media in an SRTP (unencrypted header, encrypted payload) packet, as the RTP header is part of the encrypted payload and doesn't provide meta-information on the media carried?
question_4172.ground_truth: The application supplements by conveying different desired QoS handling priority by using different IPv6 flow labels, DSCP, sender ports.

question_4174.question: What is the benefit of Ethernet Header Compression (EHC) in NR and EUTRA PDCP?
question_4174.ground_truth: EHC increases the efficiency of Ethernet frames transmission over the NR air interface by avoiding transmission of Ethernet header fields, allowing for better support of TSC traffic over the 5G network.

question_4176.question: What is the main priority for supporting legacy terminals in the new Mobile Station (MS)?
question_4176.ground_truth: The first priority is given to the support of legacy DARP phase 1 capable terminals, while the second priority is given to supporting legacy GMSK terminals without DARP phase 1 capability.

question_4180.question: What is required in the initiation of a conversation using MBMS bearer procedures?
question_4180.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function sends a Map Group To Bearer message over the MCPTT-9 reference point to indicate the association information between the group identity of the call and the TMGI of the MBMS bearer, as well as additional necessary parameters.

question_4181.question: Which RAB management procedures as defined in TS 25.413 are of interest for measuring RAB establishment, modification, and release?
question_4181.ground_truth: The procedures of interest are RAB Assignment, RAB Release Request, RAB ASSIGNMENT REQUEST, RAB ASSIGNMENT RESPONSE, and RAB RELEASE REQUEST.

question_4182.question: What is Quality of Experience (QoE) information collection?
question_4182.ground_truth: Quality of Experience (QoE) information collection is the process of gathering detailed information at the call level on a number of user equipments (UEs) to evaluate the user experience.

question_4183.question: What is the requirement for an MS to use the extended idle mode DRX cycle in a network?
question_4183.ground_truth: The network must have provided the extended DRX parameters IE during the last ROUTING AREA UPDATE procedure.

question_4184.question: In the Sender, what is the initial value of the VT(A) state variable, which contains the "Sequence Number" of the last in-sequence acknowledged AMD PDU?
question_4184.ground_truth: The initial value of this variable is 0.

question_4186.question: What should the MS do when it receives a PACKET PDCH RELEASE message releasing the second PDCH during Extended Dynamic Allocation with Shifted USF operation?
question_4186.ground_truth: The MS should stop transmitting on the first and second PDCH within the required reaction time and continue data transfer using normal USF operation with Extended Dynamic Allocation and using the remaining available timeslots.

question_4187.question: What are the 5GS CIoT features for rate control of user data in 5GS?
question_4187.ground_truth: The two 5GS CIoT features for rate control of user data in 5GS are Serving PLMN Rate control and Small Data Rate Control.

question_4188.question: What should be the maximum time within which the UE shall be able to activate the deactivated LAA SCell?
question_4188.ground_truth: The delay within which the UE shall be able to activate the deactivated SCell depends upon the specified conditions, as given in 8.26.1.3.

question_4189.question: What is the requirement for the TB success rate during the SDR test for EN-DC including FR2 NR carrier in Clause 9.4B.1.2.1?
question_4189.ground_truth: The TB success rate should be higher than 85% for EN-DC including FR2 NR carrier in Clause 9.4B.1.2.1.

question_4190.question: How does the receiver handle an Abstract Syntax Error in the HNBAP protocol?
question_4190.ground_truth: When a receiver encounters an Abstract Syntax Error, it means that the received IEs or IE groups cannot be understood, or the logical range of received IEs is violated. The receiver then initiates the Error Indication procedure with the appropriate cause value for the Abstract Syntax protocol error.

question_4194.question: What are some factors that can reduce the probability of interference between the SARC system and the LTE network?
question_4194.ground_truth: Some factors that can reduce the probability of interference between the SARC system and the LTE network include the temporary and localized nature of SARC system usage, the possible usage of the system at reduced power levels, and the fact that ENG mobile transmitters are generally mounted on vans with telescoping antennas, which are aimed at distant receivers. Furthermore, the network may be able to handoff UE to another frequency band when available or accept the risk of outage for a subset of UE's in adverse radio conditions.

question_4195.question: What does the LCS-to-GCS-Translation::= SEQUENCE sequence translate to?
question_4195.ground_truth: LCS-to-GCS-Translation sequence translates to a 360-degree spherical coordinate system used for seamless indoor and outdoor navigation. It contains alpha, beta, and gamma values and is used for providing coordinates to the GCS (Global Coordinate System). The iE-Extensions represent additional information that can be added to this sequence.

question_4196.question: What is the function of the Reduced frame number per quarter hyperframe (RFNQH) in EC-SCH?
question_4196.ground_truth: RFNQH is used to identify the Reduced TDMA frame number per quarter hyperframe.

question_4198.question: What are the potential new requirements needed to support the use case of securing and storing digital assets for a user?
question_4198.ground_truth: The potential new requirements needed to support the use case of securing and storing digital assets for a user include securing registering, storing, and updating the digital assets for a user, supporting real-time transmission of body movement information between a UE and the network, and collecting charging information per UE or per application for managing the digital assets for an end user or a third party.

question_4199.question: What must the manufacturer declare for each supported channel bandwidth regarding NB-IoT operation?
question_4199.ground_truth: The manufacturer must declare whether the base station supports NB-IoT in-band and/or guard band operation and the number of supported NB-IoT PRBs (physical resource blocks) for each supported channel bandwidth.

question_4201.question: What are the mandatory measurement gap patterns introduced in Rel-16?
question_4201.ground_truth: In Rel-16, GP#17, GP#18, and GP#19 were introduced as additional mandatory measurement gap patterns, and GP#2, GP#3, and GP#11 were introduced as additional mandatory measurement gap patterns for NR only measurements.

question_4202.question: What is the procedure for IPv4 address allocation for a UE after successful PDU session establishment procedure?
question_4202.ground_truth: IPv4 address allocation via DHCPv4 procedure after successful PDU session establishment procedure.

question_4204.question: What identifies the cause of failure in a Charging Data Request STOP towards the CDF in a session termination?

question_4205.question: Who is responsible for creating the NRM root resource?

question_4207.question: What is the purpose of the test in section 22.3.3 of the document?
question_4207.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the UE correctly exchanges SIP protocol signalling messages for the Session Timer extension, sets the Session Expires Interval and becomes the refresher when the remote end does not indicate Session Timer Support, generates periodic session refreshes and is able to keep the session active until released, and does not change the role of refresher during session refreshes.

question_4209.question: What YANG parameter can be used to identify a host towards a DetNet controller in a 5GS node?
question_4209.ground_truth: The YANG parameter of host type as defined in RFC 6021 can be used to identify a host towards a DetNet controller in a 5GS node, which can be either an IP address or a domain name.

question_4212.question: What is the maximum throughput performance required for E-UTRA bands to pass the test procedure?
question_4212.ground_truth: The maximum throughput must be 95% or more of the reference measurement channel's maximum throughput.

question_4214.question: What is the purpose of the ACME vending machine company limiting the combined data volume of their vending machines to 500M per month?
question_4214.ground_truth: The purpose of this limit is to ensure that the ACME vending machines only require a limited amount of network capacity.

question_4216.question: What action should the P-CSCF take when receiving an unrecognized method request for a new dialog, if a security association exists and the Via header requires a value change?
question_4216.ground_truth: The P-CSCF adds its own address to the top of the received list of Via headers and save the list, and rewrite the IP address and the port number of its own Record-Route entry to the IP address and the port number where it awaits subsequent requests from the calling party and remove the comp parameter if present before forwarding the request.

question_4221.question: What information is transmitted by means of the HS-SCCH type 4 physical channels?
question_4221.ground_truth: The following information is transmitted by means of the HS-SCCH type 4 physical channels: type flag 1, channelisation-code-set information, type flag 2, time slot information, modulation scheme information, transport-block size information, hybrid-ARQ process information, redundancy version information, HS-SCCH cyclic sequence number, midamble allocation scheme flag, and UE identity.

question_4222.question: What action does the PCF take when the NWDAF determines that the network performance goes below the threshold?
question_4222.ground_truth: When the NWDAF determines that the network performance goes below the threshold, the NWDAF notifies the PCF with the network performance analytics in the area of interest and time window. The PCF may try to re-negotiate the affected BDT policies with AFs that accepted BDT policy re-negotiation.

question_4223.question: What are the two reasons why the use of the Filter Description fragment is favored over the use of the FLUTE FDT extension attribute groupID for conveying URL-based filter data?
question_4223.ground_truth: The two reasons are: 1. The Filter Description fragment is designed for extensibility in carrying general-purpose filtering information for targeted/personalized reception of different contents by the MBMS receiver, with location-based filtering initially defined in Rel-11 TS 26.346. 2. Content filtering at the FDT level means that the MBMS receiver has to be powered on at the start of each broadcast ad, and can only be powered off after having determined the absence of a match between the remote Period URL and the filter data.

question_4224.question: What sampling rate is used for super-wideband telephony testing in the LTE terminal, as defined in the 3GPP TS 26 series of specifications?

question_4225.question: What should the UE do when switched on or returning to coverage in automatic network selection mode, with RPLMN, HPLMN, UPLMN, and OPLMN NR cells available and a USIM indicating RPLMN should be selected?
question_4225.ground_truth: The UE should select a cell of the RPLMN and attempt registration on the selected cell.

question_4226.question: What is the difference between frame-packed stereoscopic 3D video and multiview stereoscopic 3D video in the document?
question_4226.ground_truth: Frame-packed stereoscopic 3D video consists of two views packed into a single stream before compression, while multiview stereoscopic 3D video consists of two views packed into a single stream during compression.

question_4227.question: What type of call is established between party A and pre-arranged party B defined as a hot-line address in the hotline service scenario?
question_4227.ground_truth: The call between party A and pre-arranged party B is a direct and pre-defined call without any user input in the hotline service scenario.

question_4228.question: How are initial reference picture lists constructed for RpsIL0 and RpsIL1, respectively?
question_4228.ground_truth: For initial reference picture list 0 (RefPicListTemp0), pictures in RpsIL0 are inserted immediately after pictures in RefPicSetStCurrBefore, and pictures in RpsIL1 are inserted last, after pictures in RefPicSetLtCurr. For initial reference picture list 1 (RefPicListTemp1), pictures in RpsIL1 are inserted immediately after pictures in RefPicSetStCurrAfter, and pictures in RpsIL0 are inserted last, after pictures in RefPicSetLtCurr.

question_4229.question: What protocol is used by the P-GW to deliver an IPv6 prefix to the S-GW in the case of using PMIP-based S5/S8?
question_4229.ground_truth: The prefix is delivered from the P-GW to the S-GW in the IPv6 Home Network Prefix Option IE of a Proxy Binding Ackowledgement message.

question_4233.question: What is the HTTP status code that the UDM responds with when the resource exists and the requesting SMSF is not the one currently registered for the UE?

question_4234.question: What are the two different values provided by the timing adjustment for IAB operation and when are they used?
question_4234.ground_truth: The two different values provided by the timing adjustment for IAB operation are Tdelta, which is used to determine the IAB-DU DL Tx timing adjustment for the Case-1 timing mode and the IAB-DU DL Tx and IAB-MT UL Tx timing adjustment for the Case-6 timing mode, and Toffset,2, which is used to determine the IAB-MT UL Tx timing adjustment for the Case-7 timing mode. These timing adjustments are provided to an IAB node by its parent node for time-domain synchronization across multiple backhaul hops.

question_4235.question: What are the four modifications to the Service Request procedure specified in clause~4.12a.4.1 for the trusted non-3GPP access when applied to a trusted WLAN access point (TWAP)?
question_4235.ground_truth: The four modifications are: (1) the trusted non-3GPP access is substituted by a TWAP, (2) the TNGF is substituted by the TWIF, (3) the TWIF sends and receives NAS messages on behalf of the N5CW device, and (4) the user plane between the N5CW device and TWIF is established using Yt' connection instead of IKEv2 signalling.

question_4236.question: What is the requirement for the SS to not exceed the block error ratio in the different propagation conditions and under the different propagation conditions?
question_4236.ground_truth: The block error ratio, as calculated by the SS for different channels and under the different propagation conditions, under any combination of normal and extreme test voltages and ambient temperatures, shall not exceed the conformance requirement.

question_4238.question: What is the expected sequence of events in the authentication rejected procedure?
question_4238.ground_truth: After reception of an Authentication Reject message, the MS does not perform normal location updating, does not perform periodic location updating, does not respond to paging with TMSI, rejects any request from CM entities except for emergency calls, and does not perform IMSI detach if deactivated. Additionally, the MS accepts a request for an emergency call by sending a CHANNEL REQUEST message with the establishment cause set to "emergency call" and includes an IMEI as mobile identity in the CM SERVICE REQUEST message.

question_4240.question: What is the condition for a successful EEC registration update with the EES?
question_4240.ground_truth: Upon successful validation of the request, the EES sends a successful registration update response to the EEC.

question_4241.question: In what scenario will a UE store the TAI(s) belonging to the current registration area in the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming" when receiving a REGISTRATION REJECT message with integrity protection?
question_4241.ground_truth: When the UE is not operating in SNPN access operation mode and the REGISTRATION REJECT message is received from one of the TAI(s) in the current registration area.

question_4242.question: What is the purpose of the rerouting procedure in shared networks?
question_4242.ground_truth: The rerouting procedure is used as part of the assignment of a CN operator in shared networks when a MS not supporting network sharing performs initial attach/registration.

question_4243.question: What is the 5G network's role when the AI/ML server is not allowed to access the user's location information?
question_4243.ground_truth: The 5G network can still interact with the AI/ML model server for prediction of need of certain AI/ML model without breaking user privacy policies. Two possible solutions include prediction based on monitoring function of the 5G network and prediction based on NWDAF analytics function of the 5G network.

question_4244.question: What entity allocates resources for the M2u protocol and format in the 5GMSu system?
question_4244.ground_truth: The 5GMSu AS (Application Server) interacts with the 5GMSu AS at reference point M3u to allocate resources for the M2u protocol and format.

question_4245.question: What are the two options for offering 2D and 3D content in the context of common provisioning?
question_4245.ground_truth: The two options are (a) encoding different content items into separate videos for 2D and 3D, and (b) encoding source files into one common provisioning format for offering 2D and 3D content to UEs.

question_4246.question: In which access mode, for the scenario where HeNBs are on a shared carrier with eNBs, the interference management considerations are different between closed and hybrid access modes?
question_4246.ground_truth: For the scenario where HeNBs are on a shared carrier with eNBs, the interference management considerations are different between closed and hybrid access modes.

question_4247.question: Which two B-ISDN point-to-multipoint connection service features can be used by B-ISDN Multi-Casting (BI-MCAST)?

question_4249.question: What happens to all new downlink N-PDUs received after completion of the PS handover preparation phase for a PDP context using LLC ADM?
question_4249.ground_truth: They are relayed to the target RNC and encapsulated in a GTP-PDU when transmitted to the target RNC/BSS.

question_4252.question: What are the minimum conformance requirements for the accuracy of RSRP of a non-overlapping carrier in the test described?
question_4252.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements for the accuracy of RSRP of a non-overlapping carrier include the use of different carrier frequency from the serving cell and the fulfillment of certain conditions such as the transmission of cell specific reference signals, the fulfillment of 3GPP TS 36.101 clause 7.3 for reference sensitivity, and a specific range of RSRP.

question_4253.question: What is the initial mode of the MS at the beginning of the test?
question_4253.ground_truth: The MS is in Packet Idle mode at the beginning of the test.

question_4254.question: What is the maximum number of interferers MDSR may have to cope with?
question_4254.ground_truth: MDSR may have to cope with a higher number of interferers, distributed over at least 2 GSM channels.

question_4256.question: What is the purpose of the transmitter test for the single-band or multi-band connector under test?
question_4256.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the ability of the transmitter units associated with the single-band connectors or multi-band connectors to restrict the generation of intermodulation products in its nonlinear elements caused by the presence of the wanted signal and an interfering signal reaching the transmitter via the antenna to below specified levels.

question_4258.question: When are there restrictions on the scheduling availability for intra-frequency measurements in TDD bands?
question_4258.ground_truth: There are restrictions on the scheduling availability for intra-frequency measurements in TDD bands when the UE performs SS-RSRP or SS-SINR measurement or SS-RSRQ measurement.

question_4259.question: What is the action taken when the MTLF0 with FL Client lacks data over the requested Area of Interest?
question_4259.ground_truth: When the MTLF0 with FL Client lacks data over the requested Area of Interest, it determines that training based on Horizontal Federated Learning is needed.

question_4260.question: How does the UE receive a local IP address in the BBF local policies?
question_4260.ground_truth: The UE receives a local IP address from the BBF Access Network. The details of this process are not defined in 3GPP scope.

question_4263.question: What should the SMF do if there are no PDU sessions to transmit the multicast MBS session data in the UPF and unicast transport is used over N19mb?
question_4263.ground_truth: The SMF should release the DL N19mb tunnel endpoint and inform the SMF.

question_4265.question: What is the difference in total degradation between CP-OFDM and DFT-spread-OFDM in satellite communication?
question_4265.ground_truth: The difference between CP-OFDM and DFT-spread-OFDM in satellite communication is about 1.6-2 dB in total degradation, with DFT-spread-OFDM having a lower total degradation.

question_4267.question: What does the UE transmit on the uplink reference measurement channel when it has no payload data to send?
question_4267.ground_truth: When the UE has no payload data to send, it transmits uplink MAC padding bits on the uplink reference measurement channel.

question_4269.question: What is the role of the group-level N4 Session in enabling broadcast traffic forwarding of a 5G VN group in a UPF?
question_4269.ground_truth: The group-level N4 Session provides the PDR that detects the broadcast packet sent via the "internal interface" and instructs the UPF on how to perform processing (using associated FAR, URR, QER) on the copy instead of the original packet. It also matches the broadcast packet against all PDRs installed at the "internal interface".

question_4271.question: What should the P-CSCF do if it receives a request on a dialog for which it initiated session release?
question_4271.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall terminate this received request and answer it with a 481 (Call/Transaction Does Not Exist) response.

question_4272.question: Which 3GPP technologies can solution #5 be used for?
question_4272.ground_truth: Solution #5 can be used for all 3GPP technologies, as long as the USIM hardware supports the profile of the corresponding 3GPP technology.

question_4273.question: What is the purpose of Fault Management (FM) in network management?
question_4273.ground_truth: The purpose of FM is to detect failures as soon as they occur and to limit their effects on the network Quality of Service (QOS) as far as possible.

question_4276.question: What action should the MAC entity take if it receives a UL grant indicating a SUL switch while a Random Access procedure is ongoing?

question_4277.question: What is the purpose of the MC service server sending an MBS session leave request to the MC service client and what are the conditions for this request?
question_4277.ground_truth: The MC service server sends an MBS session leave request to the MC service client when it decides that one or several MC service clients should leave a certain multicast MBS session. This can be triggered for example once no further MC media is needed to be delivered to the targeted MC service group, the multicast MBS session is no longer associated to the MC group, or a certain MC service client is no longer authorized to receive data to the associated MC service group. The MC service client then initiates an MBS session leave procedure to release the respective network resources.

question_4278.question: What proposal is made for the assessment of the 2nd layer attributes for 3GPP's LiQuImAS Audio Coding and Transmission listening tests?
question_4278.ground_truth: The proposal is for adopting the following attributes for the 2nd layer: Signal Related Artifacts, Noise Related Artifacts (optional), and Spatial Audio Quality.

question_4279.question: What is the EAS Service KPI used for in TS 23.222?
question_4279.ground_truth: The EAS Service KPI is used as a new IE in Service APIs provided by EAS as API Provider, to convey information about service characteristics provided by the Service API. It can be mapped to EAS Service KPIs in EAS Profile of the EAS providing the Service API.

question_4280.question: What kind of operations can the 5G system support for AI/ML operations over the 5G system?
question_4280.ground_truth: The 5G system can support AI/ML operation splitting, AI/ML model distribution and sharing, and distributed/federated learning over the 5G system.

question_4282.question: What is the main function of FL server NWDAF and FL client NWDAF in Federated Learning among multiple NWDAFs containing MTLF?
question_4282.ground_truth: FL server NWDAF discovers and selects FL client NWDAFs to participant in an FL procedure, requests FL client NWDAFs to do local model training and to report local model information. FL client NWDAF locally trains ML model that tasked by the FL server NWDAF with the available local data set, reports the trained local ML model information to the FL server NWDAF, and receives the global ML model feedback from FL server NWDAF and repeats training iteration if needed.

question_4283.question: What is the role of the PEMC in the PIN Management PINE join into PIN request process?
question_4283.ground_truth: The PEMC determines whether to forward the request to the PEMC or PIN server for authorization and responds accordingly.

question_4284.question: When is the drx-ShortCycleTimer stopped?
question_4284.ground_truth: The drx-ShortCycleTimer is stopped when a Long DRX Command MAC CE is received or if the drx-InactivityTimer expires.

question_4285.question: What is the process for codec negotiation in an outgoing call with support for 100rel but no support for preconditions?
question_4285.ground_truth: In an outgoing call with support for 100rel but no support for preconditions, the IWU selects one of the received codecs and makes a second SDP offer to the external node in the PRACK to lock the codec.

question_4286.question: What are the device capabilities and/or user preferences called, that contains a number of capability attributes, as defined in the present document?
question_4286.ground_truth: A device capability description or device capability profile.

question_4288.question: What is the purpose of the "Repetition-Period NG-RAN" parameter in the Warning Message Content NG-RAN?
question_4288.ground_truth: The Repetition-Period NG-RAN parameter in the Warning Message Content NG-RAN indicates the periodicity in seconds of the warning message to be broadcast, with a value between 0 and 217-1.

question_4291.question: What happens if the ULCL detects a DNS query based on detection information provided by SMF in IPv6 multi-homing?
question_4291.ground_truth: The ULCL forwards the DNS query to the local PSA2 or the PSA1 if it receives a DNS query whose destination address is the address of the centralized DNS server from the ULCL.

question_4292.question: How can utilizing the full uplink bandwidth not be critical for HeNBs, unlike macro-eNBs?
question_4292.ground_truth: HeNBs typically serve fewer users at a time, so PUCCH resources can be "pulled" inward, allowing the macro-eNB to use edge RBs for PUCCH transmissions for its UEs.

question_4293.question: What event is generated at the HSS during the IMS registration process when a target has roamed?
question_4293.ground_truth: The Serving System event is generated at the HSS during the IMS registration process, when the HSS has detected that the target has roamed.

question_4294.question: What is the effect of receiving a RELEASE COMPLETE message while in the U19 state?
question_4294.ground_truth: The MS releases the MM-connection and enters the U0 "Null" state.

question_4295.question: What action should the intermediate node take if LCLS is not permitted?
question_4295.ground_truth: The intermediate node should set the LCLS-Negotiation Request IE to value "LCLS not allowed" and forward it to the succeeding node.

question_4296.question: In which situation is the drx-InactivityTimer stopped for a DRX group?
question_4296.ground_truth: The drx-InactivityTimer is stopped for a DRX group when the MAC entity receives a new transmission (DL or UL) on a Serving Cell in that DRX group.

question_4299.question: What is a 'geographical area' in the context of UMTS mobility handling?
question_4299.ground_truth: A 'geographical area' is a cell-structure independent way to identify a specific area used in the UMTS system for mobility handling, typically implemented through 'Location Area identities'.

question_4300.question: How does Solution #33 propose to remove the slice from the allowed list when inactivity is detected?
question_4300.ground_truth: Solution #33 proposes that both UE and AMF can remove the slice from the allowed list when inactivity is detected in case of no PDU session. However, for PDU session with no data transfer, only releasing the PDU session is not sufficient. The UE can remove the slice from the allowed list, but SMF needs to indicate AMF so that AMF will remove the slice as well.

question_4301.question: What is the purpose of the test in 51.3.6.5?
question_4301.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the mobile station switches to the new assigned channels and continues sending PACKET DUMMY CONTROL BLOCKs in the uplink when it receives a PACKET UPLINK ASSIGNMENT message while the Uplink TBF is extended.

question_4302.question: What is the role of the SS in this test?
question_4302.ground_truth: The role of the SS in this test is to transmit the Standard Test Signal C1 on the traffic channel (wanted signal), as well as the independent, uncorrelated interfering signal (unwanted signal). The SS also compares the modulation of the signal that it sends to the MS with the signal which is looped back from the receiver after demodulation and decoding, and checks the frame erasure indication.

question_4303.question: What type of message is used to request the de-registration of PIN services by a PIN entity?
question_4303.ground_truth: The PIN services de-registration request is sent by a PIN Element to the PEMC to request the de-registration of PIN services.

question_4304.question: How can the network indicate its preferred READY timer value to the MS?
question_4304.ground_truth: The network can include a timer value for the READY timer in the ATTACH ACCEPT or ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT messages, respectively.

question_4305.question: What is the maximum interval between two successive indications from Layer 1?
question_4305.ground_truth: Two successive indications from Layer 1 shall be separated by at least max(10ms, rmax*G) in the out-of-sync and in-sync evaluations of the PCell.

question_4306.question: What is a requirement for NR-PSS/SSS design related to initial frequency offset?
question_4306.ground_truth: A requirement for NR-PSS/SSS design related to initial frequency offset is robustness against offsets up to 5 ppm, with 10 ppm as an optional requirement.

question_4307.question: What is the function of the Recommended bit rate MAC CE in the RAN?
question_4307.ground_truth: The Recommended bit rate MAC CE in the RAN informs the UE about the recommended bitrate for the associated logical channel on the uplink radio bearer.

question_4311.question: Which elements are used in the uplink direction to apply marking of packets sent to the PCEF in case of DSCP based marking?
question_4311.ground_truth: The DSCP bit in the IP packet header or the tunnel which carries the DSCP marking implemented in the inner IP packet header.

question_4312.question: How does the DRA select a PCRF if the DRA is not peer of the PCRFs?
question_4312.ground_truth: The DRA selects a PCRF based on the load information it has received from the peer PCRFs. However, if the DRA is not a peer of all the PCRFs, it would require additional load control information from the non-peer PCRFs to make the selection.

question_4314.question: What is the purpose of the repetition counter "I" in the synchronization process?
question_4314.ground_truth: The repetition counter "I" is used to count the number of repetitions within the cycle period. It helps in determining the synchronization frames within the synchronization period.

question_4315.question: What security requirement must M2M security solutions meet when applied to 3GPP terminals?
question_4315.ground_truth: The M2M security solutions shall not lower the 3GPP security when applied to 3GPP terminals.

question_4316.question: What is the data type used to represent the training data samples?
question_4316.ground_truth: Training data samples are not quantized, i.e., Float32 is used/represented.

question_4317.question: What are the two possible values of the RequestStatus attribute in the MLInferenceEmulationRequest, and what do they indicate?
question_4317.ground_truth: The two possible values of the RequestStatus attribute in the MLInferenceEmulationRequest are "Pending" and "Triggered". "Pending" indicates that no action has been taken for the request, while "Triggered" indicates that an MLInferenceEmulationProcess has been instantiated.

question_4318.question: What is the role of 5G system in authorizing the use of a user's digital representation in this use case?
question_4318.ground_truth: The 5G system is responsible for authorizing the use of a user's digital representation, such as their avatar, by a trusted third party, subject to user consent and operator policy.

question_4321.question: Which type of data is the "SS-Notification" in the NotifySS-Arg sequence?
question_4321.ground_truth: The "SS-Notification" in the NotifySS-Arg sequence is an octet string used to indicate various notifications related to a supplementary service.

question_4322.question: What is the role of the IWF in determining authorization of a user to initiate MCData communications in section 11.1?
question_4322.ground_truth: The IWF's method of determining authorization of a user to initiate MCData communications is not specified in section 11.1.

question_4324.question: What is the purpose of the UE being scheduled on PCell continuously throughout the test?
question_4324.ground_truth: The purpose of the UE being scheduled on PCell continuously throughout the test is to ensure that the UE sends one Event A6 triggered measurement report, with a measurement reporting delay less than 25602 ms from the beginning of time period T2, and to ensure that at least 99.5% of all expected ACK/NACKs are transmitted by the UE from the start of T1 until the measurement report is received during T2.

question_4325.question: What should the SC UE include in the Contact header field when establishing a session which can be replicated and has a playback state?
question_4325.ground_truth: The SC UE shall include the g.3gpp.iut.replicator media feature tag in the Contact header field of sent SIP requests and SIP responses establishing the session. The UE shall set the value of the g.3gpp.iut.replicator to the dialog identifier of the session being established.

question_4327.question: What is the procedure to control the back-off timer upon reaching the maximum number of UEs for some S-NSSAI(s)?
question_4327.ground_truth: The AMF provides the UE with a response message including a back-off timer and Pending NSSAI including the related S-NSSAI(s) when the quota on the maximum number of UEs for some S-NSSAI(s) has been reached. The UE associates the received back-off time with the S-NSSAI(s) and applies the timer. The UE is not allowed to initiate the registration request for the associated S-NSSAI(s) in this PLMN when the timer is running.

question_4328.question: What is the requirement for TBF suspension in the test method described in 14.18.1c.4?
