question_4657.ground_truth: A key size of 256 bits is recommended for SAE/LTE for future-proofing and compatibility reasons with 3GPP UMTS UEA/UIA security algorithms. The penalty for supporting 256-bit keys is considered small compared to the "future proofness" it provides.

question_4658.question: What is the "Cause" choice used for in the PCAP protocol?
question_4658.ground_truth: The "Cause" choice is used in the PCAP protocol to define the reason for a location measurement failure. It includes the "CauseRadioNetwork" enumerated type to define the cause of the failure, such as invalid reference information, information temporarily not available, and information provision not supported for the object.

question_4660.question: Which two user roles are defined in GCSE for a specific group, in terms of receiving and transmitting Group Communications?
question_4660.ground_truth: Receiver Group Member and Transmitter Group Member.

question_4661.question: What should a GTPv2 entity do when it receives a message with an unknown GTP version?
question_4661.ground_truth: If a GTPv2 entity receives a message with a GTP version that is unsupported or higher than GTPv2, it should return a Version Not Supported Indication message and silently discard the received message.

question_4662.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 5.5.5.2?
question_4662.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in 5.5.5.2 is to verify that the UE properly detects SSB-based beam failure in the set q0 and performs correct SSB-based link recovery based on beam candidate set q1, and to test the downlink monitoring for beam failure detection within the UEs active DL BWP of the PSCell during the evaluation period, and link recovery when DRX is used.

question_4663.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 04.08 subclause 5.2.1.1, for what purpose is the 112 number used in the test case, when the MS is not inserted with a SIM card?
question_4663.ground_truth: To verify that the MS in the "idle, no IMSI" state, when made to call the number 112, sends a CHANNEL REQUEST message with establishment cause "emergency call".

question_4664.question: What is the handover delay requirement for the test to pass?
question_4664.ground_truth: The handover delay Dhandover shall be less than Dhandover, where Dhandover equals the maximum RRC procedure delay plus the interruption time.

question_4665.question: What is the procedure if the target cell belongs to the same routing area as the source cell during an Iu mode to GERAN A/Gb mode PS HO?
question_4665.ground_truth: The MS sends a Routing Area Update Request message to the 3G/2G SGSN even if the target cell belongs to the same routing area as the source cell. However, the 3G/2G SGSN knows that a handover has been performed for this MS and can therefore exclude the SGSN context procedures which normally are used within the RA Update procedure.

question_4666.question: What message does the TAF send first to initiate the RLP link establishment after receiving frames on all allocated traffic channels for the call in A/Gb and GERAN Iu mode?

question_4667.question: Which two specific IMD products generated in the BS are a concern when operating Bands 20 and 31 simultaneously, and which receive bands can they fall into?
question_4667.ground_truth: Two-tone 3rd order IMD products may fall into the BS receive band of Bands 3, 4, 9, and 10, and three-tone IMD products may fall into the BS receive band of Bands 5, 13, 14, 18, 26, 27, 31, and 44.

question_4668.question: What is the implication of a compromised TLS server certificate?
question_4668.ground_truth: A compromised TLS server certificate can lead to a security risk where the attacker can impersonate the user and even obtain valuable information disclosed to the genuine NAF.

question_4669.question: What are the four levels of detail defined in 3GPP trace high-level architecture?
question_4669.ground_truth: The four levels of detail defined in 3GPP trace high-level architecture are Maximum, Medium, Minimum, and MaximumWithoutVendorSpecificExtension. These levels of detail allow for retrieval of signalling interface messages in encoded format, decoded subset of IEs contained in the signalling interface messages, and radio measurement IEs.

question_4670.question: What is an IOC (Information Object Class) in the context of 3GPP TS 32.150?
question_4670.ground_truth: An IOC (Information Object Class) is information that can be passed/used in management interfaces, modeled using the stereotype "Class" in the UML meta-model. An IOC has a formal definition of structure and specification, as defined in 3GPP TS 32.157.

question_4672.question: What is the role of the NSACF in the 5GS only slices solution?
question_4672.ground_truth: The NSACF is responsible for performing the PLMN global counting for the entire PLMN in the 5GS only slices solution.

question_4673.question: What is the role of the eNB-UP in E-UTRAN?
question_4673.ground_truth: The eNB-UP in E-UTRAN hosts the user plane part of the PDCP protocol.

question_4675.question: What is the significance of the Iur interface between HNB-GW and macro RNC?
question_4675.ground_truth: The Iur interface between HNB-GW and macro RNC is significant for supporting RNSAP signaling required for SHO, and for serving as a concentrator for Iur access.

question_4679.question: What supplementary service requires interworking between 3GPP TS 24.008, MAP (3GPP TS 29.002), and the fixed network protocol in the MSC?

question_4681.question: What must the AMF include in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message if the UE is a 5G-RG acting on behalf of an AUN3 device, and the AUN3 device supports 5G key hierarchy?
question_4681.ground_truth: If the UE is a 5G-RG acting on behalf of an AUN3 device, and the AUN3 device supports 5G key hierarchy, the AMF must include the AUN3 device security key IE in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message with its value set to the KWAGF key.

question_4683.question: What is the service provided by the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals, as specified in Release 18, and what is its purpose?
question_4683.ground_truth: The service provided by the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals, as specified in Release 18, is the Spending Limit Control Service of the 5G System. This service enables the NF service consumer to retrieve policy counter status information.

question_4684.question: What message does the MS transmit to indicate the completion of the PTC modification?
question_4684.ground_truth: After modifying the PTC(s), the MS sends a GA-RRC MODIFY CHANNEL ACK message, which includes the IE "CN Domain Identity" and the IE "PTC Modification Ack List".

question_4685.question: What are the three radio parameters for PC5 communication when a UE is not served by E-UTRA or NR?
question_4685.ground_truth: The three radio parameters are LTE PC5, NR PC5, and Geographical Area(s).

question_4686.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP system acting as an identity provider?
question_4686.ground_truth: The 3GPP system can act as an identity provider to authenticate users for accessing operator and non-operator deployed services. This allows for auto-log-in and single-sign-on to these services.

question_4687.question: What is the MU (in dB) for absolute ACLR in the frequency range 24.25 < f < 29.5 GHz and 37 < f < 43.5 GHz in a CATR?
question_4687.ground_truth: The MU for absolute ACLR is 2.7 dB in the frequency range 24.25 < f < 29.5 GHz and 2.7 dB in the frequency range 37 < f < 43.5 GHz in a CATR.

question_4688.question: In what situations is the <PrivateCallKMSURI> element present in the 3GPP TS 24.483 specification?
question_4688.ground_truth: When the URI of the KMS for the associated MCPTT ID is different from the KMS URI in the <uri-entry> element.

question_4689.question: What is the maximum time allowed for the MS to access on carrier 2 at test step e) in 20.16.5?
question_4689.ground_truth: The MS shall access on carrier 2 within 15 s.

question_4690.question: What is the procedure called when a user equipment (UE) requests its own location periodically in the UMTS CS domain?
question_4690.ground_truth: The MO-LR Request for Periodic Self Location in the UMTS CS domain is the procedure called when a user equipment (UE) requests its own location periodically in the UMTS CS domain.

question_4691.question: What is the formula for calculating round trip packet delay of N3 interface (TRTT-N3)?

question_4692.question: What is the role of gNB in the NG-RAN architecture?
question_4692.ground_truth: A gNB is a set of base station nodes connected to the 5GC through the NG interface and supports FDD mode, TDD mode or dual mode operation. It can have one or more gNB-DUs connected to one gNB-CU.

question_4693.question: What should a NF as HTTP client do if it receives a 5xx (Server Error) response status code that is not defined in the API specification?
question_4693.ground_truth: The NF should stop processing and go to an error handling process.

question_4694.question: What will the MME do if it receives an EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message containing a Request type of "NAS signalling connection release" or "Rejection of paging" in the UE request type IE in the EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message and if the UE requests restriction of paging by including the Paging restriction IE?
question_4694.ground_truth: The MME may accept the paging restriction and include the EPS additional request result IE in the SERVICE ACCEPT message and set the Paging restriction decision to "paging restriction is accepted" and store the paging restriction of the UE and enforce these restrictions in the paging procedure; or the MME may reject the paging restriction and include the EPS additional request result IE in the SERVICE ACCEPT message and set the Paging restriction decision to "paging restriction is rejected", and shall discard the received paging restriction. The MME shall delete any stored paging restriction for the UE and stop restricting paging; and the MME shall initiate the release of the NAS signalling connection after the completion of the service request procedure.

question_4695.question: What is one of the main advantages of having a standard communication flow between the DSO and MNO for energy recovery use case?
question_4695.ground_truth: A standard communication flow between the DSO and MNO for energy recovery use case enables both parties to adapt their processes to the existing constraints and efficiently manage resources to ensure high availability of remote access to DA assets during a power outage.

question_4696.question: What is the function of RAN Congestion Awareness Function (RCAF)?
question_4696.ground_truth: The RCAF provides RAN User Plane Congestion Information (RUCI) to the PCRF to enable it to consider the RAN user plane congestion status for policy decisions.

question_4698.question: What are the main features of the "Page in eUTRAN, Call in GSM/WCDMA" proposal in the context of mobility management?
question_4698.ground_truth: The "Page in eUTRAN, Call in GSM/WCDMA" proposal uses EPS mobility management for the entailing EPS attach procedure, integrating or combining mobility management with EPS mobility management. Moreover, paging requests for terminating voice calls are delivered to the terminal via EPS. CS voice calls are established using 2G or 3G radio access for call handling and paging responses.

question_4700.question: What is the purpose of the Srat1 - Sratk thresholds in the inter-RAT measurement rules?
question_4700.ground_truth: The Srat1 - Sratk thresholds are used to specify the RAT-specific threshold in the serving cell for the inter-RAT measurement rules.

question_4701.question: What action does the createVPrP() method return when a new virtual provisioned pipe is successfully granted?
question_4701.ground_truth: The status flag of the VPrP is set to Active.

question_4702.question: What is the requirement for clock synchronization in 5G-based Ethernet links and other ethernet transports such as wired and optical for infrastructure dedicated to high performance Ethernet applications?
question_4702.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall support clock synchronization defined by IEEE 802.1AS across 5G-based Ethernet links and other ethernet transports such as wired and optical.

question_4704.question: How is the magnitude of a 2-tuple coded when it is lower or equal to 3?
question_4704.ground_truth: The magnitude is coded directly by the MSB coding when the magnitude of the two spectral coefficients is lower or equal to 3.

question_4706.question: What is the aim of the "Rel-18 downlink interruption for NR and EN-DC band combinations at dynamic Tx Switching in Uplink" Work Item?
question_4706.ground_truth: The objective of this Work Item is to discuss and specify inter-band uplink CA and EN-DC combinations for which DL interruption is not allowed during dynamic switching between two uplink carriers.

question_4708.question: What should the UE do with the timer T3585 if the UE receives an indication that the 5GSM message was not forwarded due to S-NSSAI only based congestion control along with a Back-off timer value?
question_4708.ground_truth: The UE shall ignore the Re-attempt indicator IE provided by the network, if any, and take different actions depending on the timer value received for timer T3585 in the Back-off timer value IE or depending on the Back-off timer value received from the 5GMM sublayer.

question_4709.question: What is one of the performance requirements for high-availability machine type communication in the 5G system?
question_4709.ground_truth: One of the performance requirements is that the 5G system shall support a mechanism to determine the UE's velocity with a positioning service availability of 99%, an accuracy better than 0,5 m/s for the speed, and an accuracy better than 5 degree for the 3-Dimension direction of travel.

question_4710.question: What is the difference between "Incorrect computation of the GNSS Assistance Data" and "External feared event impacting the GNSS Assistance Data" in the context of positioning integrity?
question_4710.ground_truth: "Incorrect computation of the GNSS Assistance Data" is mainly due to wrong implementation of algorithms or corrupted data, while "External feared event impacting the GNSS Assistance Data" comprises situations affecting the estimation process that happens at the GNSS correction provider, such as erroneous data inputs used to compute the corrections.

question_4711.question: How should the 5G system optimize mobility management support for mobile originated communications?
question_4711.ground_truth: The 5G system should optimize mobility management support for a UE or group of UEs that use only mobile originated communications.

question_4712.question: What is the condition for a UE to indicate a capability for dynamic power sharing between E-UTRA and NR for EN-DC in the context of FR1?
question_4712.ground_truth: A UE indicates a capability for dynamic power sharing between E-UTRA and NR for EN-DC in the context of FR1 if its transmission(s) in subframe of the MCG overlap in time with UE transmission(s) in slot of the SCG in FR1.

question_4714.question: What action does the relay perform when the NSSAA procedure fails, if it has not already released the PC5 link?
question_4714.ground_truth: The relay sends a PC5 reject message indicating the failure cause.

question_4716.question: How many authorized QoS rules can the UE find in case 7 to avoid diagnosing an error in processing the request, assuming case 7a was also detected?
question_4716.ground_truth: The UE can find at least one other valid QoS rule in the 5GSM cause #83 "semantic error in the QoS operation" in the Authorized QoS rules IE.

question_4717.question: What action should the SM-over-IP receiver take when it receives a short message for an MSISDN less operation?
question_4717.ground_truth: The SM-over-IP receiver should check if the received short message contains a TP-OA field set to the dummy MSISDN value, and if the received SIP MESSAGE contains a Feature-Caps header field with a "+g.3gpp.smsip-msisdn-less" header field parameter. If both conditions are met, the SM-over-IP receiver should create a delivery report for the received short message.

question_4719.question: What is the purpose of the Diameter Accounting messages during primary and secondary PDP context activation procedures?
question_4719.ground_truth: The Diameter Accounting messages are used during both primary and secondary PDP context activation for non-EPC based packet domain (both the default bearer and dedicated bearer for the EPC based packet domain) and deactivation procedures respectively.

question_4720.question: When does a UE need to own a DUIHC for source authentication in the procedures?
question_4720.ground_truth: Each sending UE, such as an announcing UE, needs to own a DUIHC for source authentication in the procedures.

question_4721.question: How are User Defined Simple Data Types defined in XML Schema?
question_4721.ground_truth: User Defined Simple Data Types are defined in XML Schema as simpleType elements with a name attribute and a restriction to the base XML Schema type. Simple data types do not extend other simple data types.

question_4722.question: What scheduling restrictions are applied to UEs which do not support simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology when performing beam failure detection with a different subcarrier spacing than PDSCH/PDCCH on FR1?
question_4722.ground_truth: The UE is not expected to transmit PUCCH, PUSCH or SRS or receive PDCCH, PDSCH or CSI-RS for tracking or CSI-RS for CQI on SSB symbols to be measured for beam failure detection.

question_4723.question: What is the expected behavior of a Mobile Station (MS) when it receives a GA-RRC PAGING REQUEST message in the CS domain and the mobile identity in the message matches any of the valid identities of the MS?
question_4723.ground_truth: If the MS is in the GA-RRC-IDLE state for the CS domain and the mobile identity in the GA-RRC PAGING REQUEST message matches any of the valid identities of the MS, the MS should indicate reception of paging to upper layers and forward the IE "CN Domain Identity", the IE "Mobile Identity" and the IE "Paging Cause" (if received) to the upper layers. However, if timer TU5908 is active for the domain, the MS should ignore the GA-RRC PAGING REQUEST message and continue with the ongoing procedure as if the GA-RRC PAGING REQUEST was not received.

question_4724.question: What should be the pm-dsg value for the UE to pass the test in the first part?
question_4724.ground_truth: If the pm-dsg is less than or equal to 1%, the UE passes the first part of the test.

question_4725.question: What is the main challenge addressed in the first key issue related to XR/media services in 5GS?
question_4725.ground_truth: The main challenge addressed is meeting the very low Round-Trip latency requirement with the variable and unbalanced uplink/downlink latency overhead.

question_4726.question: What event triggers the reporting of a PTC Registration Record, regardless of its success or failure?
question_4726.ground_truth: The target registers, re-registers, or deregisters for a PTC service.

question_4727.question: What is the purpose of the "TriggerId" Information Element in a trace record?
question_4727.ground_truth: The "TriggerId" Information Element indicates the entity which triggered the trace.

question_4729.question: What should the MCVideo client do when it receives a Receive Media Response message after sending a Receive Media Request message during an On-demand Pre-arranged Emergency Group Call with implicit Transmission Control?
question_4729.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should provide receive media success notification to the MCVideo User.

question_4730.question: What message does the source RNS/BSS send to the source SGSN in the process of SRVCC handover from UTRAN or GERAN with PS handover support to E-UTRAN?
question_4730.ground_truth: Relocation Required (Source to Target Transparent Container) message

question_4731.question: In the context of clause~4.23.7.2.1, what is the procedure when both I-SMF and SMF are available for a PDU Session and no I-SMF change or removal is needed during inter NG-RAN node N2 handover procedure?
question_4731.ground_truth: The procedure defined in clause~4.9.1.3.2 and 4.9.1.3.3 are used with some differences.

question_4733.question: How does the SGSN modify PDP contexts after receiving an Update PDP Context Request without an actual modification of the PDP context?
question_4733.ground_truth: If the SGSN receives an Update PDP Context Request without an actual modification of the PDP context, it will still send an Update PDP Context Response message with the updated parameters to the GGSN or MS.

question_4737.question: What is the main threat in tracking a user's equipment (UE) based on packet sequence numbers in the LTE network?
question_4737.ground_truth: It can lead to a breach of user privacy and security.

question_4738.question: What should the UE do if it receives a PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message with the same PDU session ID as the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message it sent to the network?
question_4738.ground_truth: The UE should proceed with the network-requested PDU session release procedure and abort the UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure. However, if the UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure was for a handover of an existing PDU session between 3GPP access and non-3GPP access, the UE shall abort the PDU session establishment procedure and proceed with the network-requested PDU session release procedure.

question_4739.question: Which requirements aim to improve device power efficiency and network coverage?
question_4739.ground_truth: PR.5.3.3.2-004 and PR.5.3.3.2-005 aim to support significantly increased device power efficiency and significant coverage enhancement over what is supported by EPS.

question_4742.question: What is the vendor identifier assigned by IANA to 3GPP for the Diameter application?
question_4742.ground_truth: The vendor identifier assigned by IANA to 3GPP for the Diameter application is 10415.

question_4744.question: When can an IAB-node provide information via MAC-CE to a parent node?
question_4744.ground_truth: An IAB-node can provide information via MAC-CE to a parent node to facilitate enhanced scheduling at the IAB-node and/or at the parent node, specifically when it supports enhanced multiplexing capabilities. This includes recommended IAB-MT Tx/Rx beams, desired IAB-MT Tx PSD range, desired parent node's IAB-DU Tx power adjustment, and required IAB-MT's uplink transmission timing mode.

question_4745.question: What is the function of the "Maximum time offset" information element?
question_4745.ground_truth: The "Maximum time offset" information element is used to provide the UE with a maximum time offset after returning from discontinuous coverage.

question_4746.question: When is the PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTITY RESPONSE message sent in the 5G ProSe direct link identification procedure?
question_4746.ground_truth: The PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTITY RESPONSE message is sent by the target UE upon receipt of the PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTITY REQUEST message.

question_4747.question: What is the role of Step 4 in the procedure of NWDAF registering to NRF with its FL related information?
question_4747.ground_truth: In Step 4, the NWDAF registers its permitted-server-NWDAF list for each Analytics ID when it serves as a client NWDAF.

question_4748.question: Who is allowed to transmit media on a broadcast group call?
question_4748.ground_truth: Only the call originating MCVideo user is allowed to transmit media on a broadcast group call.

question_4751.question: What kind of measurement is being performed on neighbor cells in this test?

question_4752.question: What is wireless self-backhauling and how can it help in the deployment and management of access nodes in a mobile network?
question_4752.ground_truth: Wireless self-backhauling is the use of wireless backhaul for access nodes, which can help address some of the challenges in deployment and management. It can enable simpler deployment and incremental rollout, reduce reliance on wired backhaul availability, and enable incremental growth planning by adapting deployment of managed backhaul capacity to the increase of traffic demand.

question_4755.question: What are the components needed in the field for the SE service?
question_4755.ground_truth: The needed components in the field for the SE service are sensors and meters.

question_4756.question: What is one of the functions of the SCC AS in the IMS network for reverse SRVCC?
question_4756.ground_truth: The SCC AS is responsible for providing the STN-rSR received in a third-party register to the HSS for reverse SRVCC.

question_4757.question: What should the dedicatedPosSysInfoDelivery perform upon reception of the contained posSIB(s)?
question_4757.ground_truth: The dedicatedPosSysInfoDelivery should perform the action specified in clause 5.2.2.4.16 upon reception of the contained posSIB(s).

question_4758.question: What are two main responsibilities of the data storage management component in a centralized data base?
question_4758.ground_truth: The data storage management component hides storage complexity from the application and manages I/O generation and caching.

question_4760.question: What type of message is received by the RANAP process in the target RNC when an ENHANCED RELOCATION INFORMATION REQUEST message has been transparently transferred from the source RNC?

question_4763.question: What is the purpose of AMR Mode Control signaling and procedure in the context of mobile communication?
question_4763.ground_truth: The AMR Mode Control signaling and procedure was designed to cope with multiple bottlenecks in the voice path for mobile communication.

question_4764.question: Which element in the XML schema has a complex type with a "Sequence" and an "Extension"?
question_4764.ground_truth: The "NotifySwMProcessCreation" element in the XML schema has a complex type with a "Sequence" and an "Extension".

question_4766.question: What DL TEID address is provided by the MN in the NG-U interface for the new tunnel?
question_4766.ground_truth: The MN provides a DL TEID address to be applied as the additional DL tunnel address on the NG-U interface and the QoS flows associated with that tunnel.

question_4767.question: In what situation does the SN provide Xn-U DL TNL address information in the Xn-U Address Indication message?
question_4767.ground_truth: This occurs when the MN requests the SN to allocate resources for SN terminated bearers using MCG resources.

question_4768.question: What type of information element is the redirecting party BCD number?
question_4768.ground_truth: The redirecting party BCD number is a type 4 information element with a minimum length of 3 octets and a maximum length of 19 octets.

question_4769.question: What is the maximum number of activated TCI states for the DL TCI state in the Enhanced Unified TCI States Activation/Deactivation MAC CE for Separate TCI States?
question_4769.ground_truth: The maximum number of activated TCI states for the DL TCI state in the Enhanced Unified TCI States Activation/Deactivation MAC CE for Separate TCI States is 32.

question_4770.question: How is the maximum interference signal level declared in the AAS BS, and what considerations are taken into account for determining the leakage power?
question_4770.ground_truth: The maximum interference signal level for testing is declared as either the maximum intra-array leakage power for each TAB connector in the transceiver array boundary for each operating band, or the leakage power of the TAB connector with the most leakage power. The maximum leakage power at each TAB connector is estimated with consideration for co-channel leakage power coupled through the combined RDN and antenna array from all other TAB connectors.

question_4771.question: What protocol is required to carry the AKMA Key Identifier (A-KID) in the Ua* reference point?

question_4774.question: What is the purpose of NTC3 in the context of testing UTRA and E-UTRA multi RAT non-contiguous aspects?
question_4774.ground_truth: The purpose of NTC3 is to test UTRA and E-UTRA multi RAT non-contiguous aspects.

question_4775.question: What should the MAC entity determine for the MSGA payload in the selected PUSCH occasion if the Random Access Preamble was not selected among the contention-based Random Access Preamble(s)?
question_4775.ground_truth: The MAC entity should determine the UL grant and the associated HARQ information for the MSGA payload in the selected PUSCH occasion.

question_4776.question: What is the purpose of end-to-end flow control in the multi-hop backhaul?
question_4776.ground_truth: End-to-end flow control helps address packet discard at intermediate IAB-nodes due to downlink data congestion by providing a downlink delivery status from the UE's access IAB-node DU in hop-by-hop ARQ to the IAB-donor CU. It does not provide information to pinpoint the exact link or node where congestion is occurring, so hop-by-hop flow control may also be required.

question_4777.question: In the 41.5.1.2.1.1 test procedure, what message is used by the network to initiate the packet downlink assignment procedure for downlink TBF establishment in the ready state?
question_4777.ground_truth: The DTM ASSIGNMENT COMMAND message or a PACKET ASSIGNMENT message.

question_4778.question: What is the role of the AKMA Anchor Function (AAnF) in the 5G System?
question_4778.ground_truth: The AKMA Anchor Function (AAnF) stores the AKMA Anchor Key and generates key material between the UE and the Application Function (AF) in the 5G System.

question_4779.question: What should be used as the "Initial UE Identity" in the formula for calculating the index of selected SCCPCH if the UE-Id type is "TMSI and LAI (GSM-MAP)" or "P-TMSI and RAI (GSM-MAP)" in 3GPP TS 25.321?
question_4779.ground_truth: Only the TMSI or P-TMSI parts given as Bitstring(32) should be used. It shall be interpreted as a binary representation of an integer number, where the first bit in the Bitstring represents the highest order bit.

question_4783.question: What is the procedure for a Multi-USIM UE to be released to ECM-IDLE state for a USIM due to activity on another USIM?
question_4783.ground_truth: The Multi-USIM UE initiates the Service Request procedure or a Tracking Area Update procedure by including a Release Request indication and Paging Restriction Information, if supported by the UE and network.

question_4784.question: What was the uplink simulation frequency and environment used for the Asymmetric coexistence simulations between 20 MHz and 5 MHz E-UTRA?
question_4784.ground_truth: The uplink simulation frequency was 2000 MHz and the environment was Macro Cell, Urban Area, uncoordinated deployment for the Asymmetric coexistence simulations between 20 MHz and 5 MHz E-UTRA.

question_4785.question: Which band can up to 3rd order IMD products of 2UL inter-band DC UE operating with other systems fall into?

question_4786.question: Who is responsible for conducting the SCAS instantiation evaluation?
question_4786.ground_truth: The accredited evaluator, either the vendor or a third-party evaluator, is responsible for conducting the SCAS instantiation evaluation before it is used to evaluate the network product.

question_4787.question: What makes the External Group Identifier globally unique?
question_4787.ground_truth: The combination of Local Identifier and Domain Identifier makes the External Group Identifier globally unique.

question_4788.question: What should the NWDAF service consumer do if it needs to discover an NWDAF containing AnLF that is serving or holds data for a UE?
question_4788.ground_truth: The NWDAF service consumer can query UDM with the target SUPI and the Analytics ID. If the response from UDM indicates multiple candidate NWDAFs, the NWDAF service consumer may determine an appropriate instance based on registration time and query the NRF for their capabilities.

question_4789.question: How should the CA tests be executed for FDD CA tests specified in 8.2.1.1.1, 8.2.1.4.3, 8.7.1, 8.13.1.1.1, and 8.13.1.2.1?
question_4789.ground_truth: If corresponding CA tests with the largest number of CCs supported by the UE are tested, the test coverage can be considered fulfilled without executing the CA tests with less than the largest number of CCs supported by the UE.

question_4792.question: What is the function of the TrGW when forwarding media streams between IM CN subsystem networks?
question_4792.ground_truth: The TrGW provides functions like network address/port translation and IPv4/IPv6 protocol translation. NAT-PT binds addresses in IPv6 network with addresses in IPv4 network and vice versa to provide transparent routing between the two IP domains without requiring any changes to end points.

question_4793.question: What should the GANC do if there are no available resources for GA-PSR TC activation?
question_4793.ground_truth: The GANC shall send a GA-PSR-ACTIVATE-UTC-ACK message to the MS with the failure cause code "No available resources" and shall not include GANC IP address and UDP port number.

question_4794.question: What happens when the entry condition for an event is fulfilled while reporting on a per-event basis?
question_4794.ground_truth: If the entry condition for an event is satisfied, a measurement reporting entry is included within the VarMeasReportList for the measurement, and the numberOfReportsSent is set to 0. The concerned cell(s) is also included in the cellsTriggeredList defined within the VarMeasReportList for the measurement.

question_4795.question: What is the role of the 5G Media Streaming Architecture (5GMSA) in User Equipment (UE) and Media Application Server (AS)?
question_4795.ground_truth: The 5G Media Streaming Architecture (5GMSA) provides the framework for media streaming services in User Equipment (UE) and Media Application Server (AS). The codecs and formats recommended for 5G Media Streaming apply to the components in UE and the Media Application Server.

question_4796.question: What is the network architecture required to support the NR SL and the protocol stack for user plane and control plane in the PC5 interface?
question_4796.ground_truth: The network architecture includes unicast, groupcast, and broadcast SL transmission for in-coverage, out-of-coverage, and partial-coverage scenarios. Protocol stacks for the PC5 interface consist of RRC, PDCP, RLC, and MAC sublayers, SDAP, HARQ process ID, and physical layers.

question_4798.question: What should be the principle when applying tests for a Base Station capable of multi-band operation with three or more bands?
question_4798.ground_truth: The supported multi-band combination covering the widest radio bandwidth should be tested first, followed by those with larger rated total output power, larger total number of supported carriers, or larger Maximum Base Station RF Bandwidth.

question_4799.question: What level of the Richardson maturity model is suggested for 5G APIs?
question_4799.ground_truth: It is suggested that 5G APIs do not need to support Level 3 of the Richardson maturity model.

question_4801.question: What action is taken when the GA-RRC REQUEST REJECT message is received and timer TU5908 is inactive, how will the GA-RRC sub-layer entity in the MS behave?
question_4801.ground_truth: The GA-RRC sub-layer entity in the MS will remain in the GA-RRC-IDLE state and indicate to upper layers that GA-RRC was not able to enter the connected state for the domain.

question_4802.question: Which transport mechanism should be used to send IRI to DF2 in order to perform its functionality?
question_4802.ground_truth: The IRI should be sent to DF2 using a reliable transport mechanism.

question_4803.question: What is the format for a V2X service identifier to PC5 QoS parameters mapping rule in 3GPP TS 23.287?
question_4803.ground_truth: Each mapping rule contains one or more V2X service identifiers and the PC5 QoS parameters specified in clause~5.4.2.

question_4804.question: Which message triggers the accumulation of the call set-up time in the CS network originated calls?
question_4804.ground_truth: The accumulation of the call set-up time in the CS network originated calls is triggered by the receipt of the "IAM" message by the MGCF.

question_4805.question: What is the purpose of the "informationToSend" parameter in the PlayAnnouncement procedure?
question_4805.ground_truth: The "informationToSend" parameter is used to specify the inband information to be sent to the end-user, such as an announcement or a tone, with specific details about the content and duration.

question_4806.question: How many NSCE servers can be located in a PLMN per Network Slice Provider as per the architecture?
question_4806.ground_truth: One or more NSCE servers can be located in a PLMN per Network Slice Provider.

question_4807.question: What happens to all outstanding reports and open CDR in the old SGSN when a PDP Context Disconnection is reported in the old SGSN?
question_4807.ground_truth: All outstanding reports in the old SGSN are sent to the gsmSCF and the open CDR is closed.

question_4810.question: What interfaces are used for the S-CSCF to provide presence related information to the Presence Server?
question_4810.ground_truth: The ISC interface is used for the S-CSCF to provide presence related information to the Presence Server.

question_4811.question: What are the list of band-specific issues for the WCS band?
question_4811.ground_truth: The list of band-specific issues for the WCS band includes general issues such as the FCC out-of-band emissions frequency limits, operating bands, carrier frequency and EARFCN, and E-UTRA specific issues related to UE and BS emission masks, UE output power, network signaling and A-MPR, UE REFSENS, UE in-band blocking, and BS emission masks.

question_4812.question: What is the role of the floor participant in off-network MCPTT operations?
question_4812.ground_truth: A floor participant is a user or user equipment (UE) in an off-network group call that can request the floor and transmit voice media once granted the right to speak.

question_4814.question: What is the input used to calculate the ShortResumeMAC-I in the RRC Resume Request message?
question_4814.ground_truth: The inputs used to calculate the ShortResumeMAC-I in the RRC Resume Request message are the integrity algorithm (EIA) in the stored AS security context, the current KRRCint, and the VarShortResumeMAC-Input as defined in TS 36.331 with the following inputs: source C-RNTI, source PCI, resume constant, and target Cell-ID.

question_4815.question: What should be the SSB measurement period for the SCell activation delay to be equal to TFirstATRS + 5ms in the FR1 band?
question_4815.ground_truth: The SSB measurement period should be equal to or smaller than 2400ms.

question_4816.question: What colorimetry is required for a Bitstream conforming to the 3GPP VR Basic H.264/AVC Operation Point?
question_4816.ground_truth: The 3GPP VR Basic H.264/AVC Operation Point Bitstream shall use ITU-R BT.709 colorimetry.

question_4820.question: What is the mean and 5% DL Average-UPT loss for operator 1 when using SBFD Alt 4 and large packet size at medium load level?
question_4820.ground_truth: The mean and 5% DL Average-UPT loss for operator 1 when using SBFD Alt 4 and large packet size at medium load level are -24.42% and 0%, respectively.

question_4821.question: What should the non-controlling MCVideo function of an MCVideo group do if it has not established a mutual aid relationship with the primary MCVideo system identified in the P-Asserted-Identity header field and receives a SIP INVITE request for a non-controlling MCVideo function of an MCVideo group?
question_4821.ground_truth: The non-controlling MCVideo function of an MCVideo group should reject the request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and not process the remaining steps.

question_4822.question: What is the minimum rejection required over the receive frequencies for pairing option 1 with ceramic resonators in BS RF TX filtering?
question_4822.ground_truth: The minimum rejection required over the receive frequencies for pairing option 1 with ceramic resonators in BS RF TX filtering is 103 dB.

question_4823.question: What is the condition that allows for the lower step size requirement not to apply during step E?
question_4823.ground_truth: The lower step size requirement does not apply during the power step adjacent to the Min or Max power threshold for test in step E.

question_4824.question: What is the consequence of not having the knowledge of the IMS selected codec in some cases during Codec Negotiation in IMS?
question_4824.ground_truth: The local ATCF may not be able to assemble the remote IMS preferred codec list correctly, leading to issues in codec selection and negotiation in IMS.

question_4828.question: What is the expected QoS for UE1 as it moves to another floor while maintaining its service with UE2 through an indirect communication path?
question_4828.ground_truth: UE1 is expected to maintain the same QoS with UE2 through the indirect communication path as it was through the original direct communication path.

question_4829.question: What factors contribute to the threshold parameter (Thresh) in the measurement criteria for event A4?
question_4829.ground_truth: Thresh is expressed in the same unit as Mn (which is dBm for RSRP, or dB for RSRQ and RS-SINR) and represents the threshold that must be met for event A4 to be triggered.

question_4830.question: What is the GCS AS Heartbeat procedure used for?
question_4830.ground_truth: The GCS AS Heartbeat procedure is used to detect a path failure or outage of a peer BM-SC and confirm that it is still operational.

question_4832.question: What is the procedure for automatic commencement private communications?
question_4832.ground_truth: The MCVideo client A sends a private communication request to the MCVideo client associated with MCVideo user B, which automatically accepts the request if it is the designated MCVideo client for off-network MCVideo private communications.

question_4833.question: What does the 9.2.33 DRB-Identity IE uniquely identify in the XwAP protocol?
question_4833.ground_truth: The 9.2.33 DRB-Identity IE uniquely identifies the DRB for a UE.

question_4834.question: What is the role of the UE (User Equipment) in the URSP rule matching process?
question_4834.ground_truth: The UE matches applications against PvD (Policy and Charging Control) descriptors provided in the URSP rule and provides the relevant PvD ID during the Application Level Service Request. The UE also establishes a new PDU (Packet Data Unit) session to enable User Plane communication with the DN (Data Network) where the DNS Server or the Edge Application Server resides, based on URSP rule matching.

question_4835.question: In the "End-to-end and intermediate node" approach, what is the advantage in terms of protecting nodes from overload?
question_4835.ground_truth: It ensures the overload protection of the Target as well as Intermediate nodes.

question_4837.question: What should the UDM consider if the list of preferred PLMN/access technology combinations is not included in the secured packet received from the SOR-AF?
question_4837.ground_truth: The UDM considers this as an indication that the UE is not expected to perform SOR based on the associated steering of roaming information sent to the UE.

question_4838.question: What is the format of the ENVELOPE (ProSe Report) command parameter when sending a ProSe Report to the UICC?
question_4838.ground_truth: The ENVELOPE (ProSe Report) command parameters include device identities, with the source set to ME and the destination set to UICC. The ProSe Report Data data object contains the ProSe Report. The Last Envelope TLV is included to indicate the last information concerning the ProSe Report has been sent.

question_4839.question: What is the role of the ALCAP protocol in the establishment and release of the Iub Data Transport Bearer?
question_4839.ground_truth: The ALCAP protocol is used by the SRNC to initiate the setup or release of the Iub Data Transport Bearer in the establishment or release of a radio access bearer.

question_4842.question: What is a key consideration for energy efficiency in the 5G system?
question_4842.ground_truth: The 5G system needs to consider energy efficiency throughout all components, including resource-efficient data origination and energy saving modes.

question_4843.question: What should the protocol selected for a virtualized environment support?
question_4843.ground_truth: The protocol selected should allow seamless reconnection to the NFs in case of movement and support security.

question_4844.question: What is the requirement for secure connection between the SKM-C and the SKM-S in the SEAL key provisioning procedure?
question_4844.ground_truth: A secure connection must be established between the SKM-C and the SKM-S prior to any associated key provisioning requests in the SEAL key provisioning procedure.

question_4845.question: What mobile specific requirements does the MS indicate to the network during a mobile terminating call?
question_4845.ground_truth: Connection element, structure, synchronous/asynchronous, rate adaptation/other rate adaptation, user information layer 2 protocol, intermediate rate, modem type, user rate, compression, fixed network user rate, other modem type, and user initiated modification indication.

question_4846.question: What is the S1AP protocol value that corresponds to the radio network layer?

question_4848.question: Who was the first man to walk on the moon?

question_4849.question: What can cause a difference in radiation pattern between the V-pol and H-pol of an antenna module in practical UE design?
question_4849.ground_truth: In practical UE design, the difference between the V-pol and H-pol of an antenna module can be caused by severe blockage, which can lead to reflection and polarization mismatch. This difference may still exist even if the metal frame near the antenna module is replaced by other materials to avoid blockage.

question_4850.question: What is the primary purpose of the NAS SMC procedure in 5G System (5GS)?
question_4850.ground_truth: The primary purpose of the NAS SMC procedure is to securely establish a NAS security context between the UE and MME, protecting the establishment of the NAS security against a man-in-the-middle attack.

question_4851.question: What is the role of the S-EAS, S-EES, and CES during the ACR scenarios?
question_4851.ground_truth: The S-EAS is responsible for initiating the ACR procedures, the S-EES is responsible for executing the ACR procedures, and the CES is responsible for managing ACR in the cloud and acting as an intermediate between the EAS and CAS.

question_4852.question: What can the NSCE server do if the policy is in conflict with the MNO policies or NSPP in the VAL server policy provisioning procedure?
question_4852.ground_truth: The NSCE server can reject the request, check the validity of the policy, or harmonize the policy as per clause 9.5.2.1.4.

question_4853.question: What should the MSGin5G Server do if it receives an MSGin5G delivery status report for multiple messages?
question_4853.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server may aggregate the individual delivery status reports into one single message, and check whether the reports can be aggregated as specified in clause~6.4.1.2.7.

question_4854.question: What should the SCC AS do when it receives a SIP INVITE request with a Request-URI containing a valid SCC AS PSI DN encoded as a SIP URI with the "user" SIP URI parameter set to "phone"?
question_4854.ground_truth: The SCC AS shall proceed as defined in subclause 10.4.4.

question_4855.question: What is the RRC procedure delay in this test case?
question_4855.ground_truth: The RRC procedure delay is 50 ms.

question_4856.question: What are the possible handover mechanisms considered in the MDAS solution for optimal handover?
question_4856.ground_truth: The MDAS solution considers Dual Active Protocol Stack (DAPS), Conditional Handover (CHO), RACH-less handover, and SON MRO scenarios for optimal handover mechanisms based on radio conditions, cell load, service requirements, handover successful rate, history performance data around handover, and UE RF fingerprints.

question_4857.question: What is the state of Cell 3 during the initial connection setup?
question_4857.ground_truth: Cell 3 is switched off during the initial connection setup.

question_4858.question: Upon receipt of a SECURITY MODE REJECT message, what action does the AMF take regarding the ongoing procedure?
question_4858.ground_truth: Upon receipt of the SECURITY MODE REJECT message, the AMF stops timer T3560 and aborts the ongoing procedure that triggered the initiation of the NAS security mode control procedure.

question_4859.question: What should the 5GMSd Application Provider include in the Policy Template when provisioning a Background Data Transfer policy?
question_4859.ground_truth: The Policy Template provisioned by the 5GMSd Application Provider should include network QoS parameters and either reference an existing Background Data Transfer policy that embodies the Service Level Agreement or directly specify Background Data Transfer parameters in line with the aforementioned Service Level Agreement.

question_4860.question: What is the objective of the method used for measuring TRS in a reverberation chamber?
question_4860.ground_truth: The objective of the method used for measuring TRS in a reverberation chamber is to obtain a large number of independent samples of the received signal power at the UE/MS from a full 3-dimensional isotropic environment with uniform elevation and azimuth field distribution, in order to estimate the TRS value with sufficient accuracy.

question_4861.question: What should the NF service consumer do if it successfully processes and accepts an HTTP DELETE request for deleting a specific stored record?
question_4861.ground_truth: The NF service consumer should remove the corresponding stored record and respond with HTTP "204 No Content" status code.

question_4863.question: When should the MAC entity consider a set of Random Access resources with MSG3 repetition indication as not available for the Random Access procedure?
question_4863.ground_truth: The MAC entity should consider the set of Random Access resources as not available for the Random Access procedure if MSG3 repetition is not applicable.

question_4865.question: What should the SS do when checking MEASUREMENT REPORT messages transmitted by UE until statistical significance is achieved?
question_4865.ground_truth: The SS should compare the calculated SFN-CFN observed time difference value to the actual SFN-CFN observed time difference value for each MEASUREMENT REPORT message.

question_4866.question: What are the co-location emission requirements specified for a base station?
question_4866.ground_truth: The co-location emission requirements are specified as the power sum of the supported polarization(s) at the conducted output(s) of the Common Local Antenna System (CLTA).

question_4867.question: How much was the capacity performance increased for FR1, Dense Urban, DL, for CG, with single stream traffic model, DDDUU/DDDSU TDD format, with MU-MIMO, 30Mbps, 15ms PDB, 60 FPS, when using cooperative MIMO/precoding compared to zero-forcing precoding?
question_4867.ground_truth: The capacity performance was increased by 60.2%.

question_4868.question: What should the AMF include in the PDU session ID IE when it sends a single uplink CIoT user data container which is not forwarded due to routing failure?
question_4868.ground_truth: The AMF should include the PDU session ID in the PDU session ID IE when it sends a single uplink CIoT user data container which is not forwarded due to routing failure.

question_4869.question: What action does the MS take if the T3346 value in the ROUTING AREA UPDATE REJECT message is not zero or deactivated?
question_4869.ground_truth: The MS aborts the routing area updating procedure, resets the routing area updating attempt counter, and starts timer T3346 with the provided value if the message is integrity protected, or with a random value from the default range if not.

question_4870.question: What is the difference between a user plane message and a signalling message in a GTP-U PDU?
question_4870.ground_truth: User plane messages are used to carry user data packets between GTP-U entities, while signalling messages are sent between network nodes for path management and tunnel management.

question_4872.question: What is the purpose of the Procedure Transaction Id (PTI) parameter in the Update Bearer Request message?
question_4872.ground_truth: The Procedure Transaction Id (PTI) parameter is used to identify the procedure initiated by a UE Requested Bearer Resource Modification Procedure.

question_4874.question: In the context of the present document, what does the abbreviation "UE" stand for?

question_4875.question: What is the state of the mobile station at the beginning of the test procedure?
question_4875.ground_truth: The mobile station is in the state "idle, GMM-registered" at the beginning of the test procedure.

question_4877.question: What is the height of the two transmit points (TPs) in the test system used to measure the outdoor coverage in kholm, Sweden?
question_4877.ground_truth: The height of TP1 is 8.5 m and TP2 is 12 m.

question_4879.question: What is the procedure outlined in Note 5 in 4.6 Scenario 5 and 4.7 Scenario 6 for discreet listening in MCData SDS and file distribution?
question_4879.ground_truth: In 4.6 Scenario 5, when authorized MC user A receives MC service from a different MCData server to that of MC user B, the serving MCData server of MC user A communicates with the serving MCData server of MC user B to provide the discreet listening service. In 4.7 Scenario 6, the scenario is similar to that described in subclause 4.3 for MCPTT and MCVideo group call.

question_4881.question: What is the procedure if the deviation does not disappear in the offset cases?
question_4881.ground_truth: If the deviation does not disappear, it may be due to the fact that the offset has made the frequency of the unwanted signal correspond to the frequency of another narrow band response. In such a case, the procedure is repeated with the increase and decrease of the frequency of the unwanted signal set to 1.25 times the offset frequency.

question_4883.question: What does the abbreviation CA stand for in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?

question_4886.question: What is the definition of Voiced Service R99 in the context of 3GPP UMTS?
question_4886.ground_truth: Voiced Service R99 refers to a voice call service that meets the requirements of Release 99 (R99) of the 3GPP UMTS standard. These requirements include, but are not limited to, QoS parameters, call setup times, and voice call error rates.

question_4887.question: Which two faults are referenced in each operation that has referenced faults?
question_4887.ground_truth: The "ServiceException" (SVC0001) and "PolicyException" (POL0001) faults are referenced in each operation that has referenced faults.

question_4888.question: What error is indicated when a parameter value is out of range in a CAP Operation?

question_4889.question: What are the impacts on the QoS of a 5GS when introducing a satellite access?
question_4889.ground_truth: This is a point expected to be studied within Key Issue 6.

question_4890.question: What should the Node B do in FDD if the Timing IE is included in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message?
question_4890.ground_truth: The Node B shall use this information to decide whether Multiflow cells follow a different HS-DPCCH timing with an offset indicated by this IE.

question_4891.question: What is the required state of the User Equipment (UE) during the test described in step 6.3B.4.1.4.2?
question_4891.ground_truth: The UE is required to be in State 2A-NB with CP CIoT Optimisation during the test described in step 6.3B.4.1.4.2.

question_4892.question: When must the UE meet the requirements for transmission on both assigned component carriers for the relative power tolerance, as defined in 6.3A.4.1.2.1?
question_4892.ground_truth: The UE must meet the requirements when the power of the target and reference sub-frames on each component carrier exceed the minimum output power and the total power is limited by PUMAX. Additionally, the average transmit power per PRB must be aligned across both assigned carriers when transitioning between PUSCH, PUCCH, and SRS.

question_4893.question: What is the session key generation procedure when the UE initiates key refreshing?
question_4893.ground_truth: The UE initiates key refreshing by sending a Refresh Request to the application server, which contains the GUTI. The application server forwards the Refresh Request to the SCEF, which sends a Bootstrapping Renegotiation Request to MME. MME then re-authenticates the UE by initiating a 3GPP-AKA procedure.

question_4898.question: Which logical channel is used by the UE to send a CELL UPDATE message to the UTRAN?
question_4898.ground_truth: The CELL UPDATE message is sent on the CCCH logical channel by the UE to the UTRAN.

question_4900.question: In EN-DC operation, what is the minimum number of effective carrier frequency layers (excluding NR serving carriers) that the UE must be capable of monitoring for CSI-RS based L3 measurement?
question_4900.ground_truth: The UE must be capable of monitoring at least 1 effective carrier frequency layer for CSI-RS based L3 measurement in EN-DC operation (i.e. NCSI = 1).

question_4901.question: What is the role of the SMF in the process of anchor relocation in a PDU session?
question_4901.ground_truth: The SMF is responsible for establishing a new N4 session with the new UPF, obtaining the MAC addresses of packets sent via the old path from the old UPF, requesting the new UPF to issue a gratuitous ARP for the MAC addresses of the UE, and sending a DN Update Request to the new UPF containing the UE MAC addresses.

question_4902.question: What should the floor control server do upon receiving an implicit floor request in an emergency group call or an imminent peril call?
question_4902.ground_truth: If there is only one MCPTT client in the MCPTT call, the floor control server should reject the request. If the floor request is granted, the floor control server shall stop timer T4 (Inactivity), shall stop timer T7 (Floor Idle), and shall enter the 'G: Floor Taken' state.

question_4903.question: What is one of the responsibilities of the LAF?
question_4903.ground_truth: The LAF is responsible for processing the location requests received from the LEA during the location acquisition procedure.

question_4906.question: What is the format of the Decorated NAI for EAP AKA and EAP SIM authentication in 3GPP System to WLAN Interworking?
question_4906.ground_truth: The Decorated NAI takes the form wlan.mnc<homeMNC>.mcc<homeMCC>.3gppnetwork.org !0<IMSI> for EAP AKA authentication and wlan.mnc<homeMNC>.mcc<homeMCC>.3gppnetwork.org !1<IMSI> for EAP SIM authentication. Both the homeMNC, homeMCC and visitedMNC, visitedMCC are PLMN ID of the HPLMN and Selected PLMN respectively.

question_4908.question: What is the sampling frequency and FIR filter order used for resampling the past synthesis signal to 8 kHz?
question_4908.ground_truth: The FIR filter order used for resampling to 8 kHz is 20, 40, or 60, depending on the sampling frequency of the input signal, which can be 16, 32, or 48 kHz.

question_4909.question: What is the effect of EAP re-authentication on the UE and EPC network when it is supported?
question_4909.ground_truth: EAP re-authentication can provide enhanced performance and optimize the user experience by enabling Fast Initial Link Setup and minimalizing the link-setup delay between the UE and the non-3GPP access network. UEs can connect to EPC via non-3GPP access and utilize EPC services with enhanced performance.

question_4910.question: What should the UE do when it receives a 423 (Interval Too Brief) response to the REGISTER request?
question_4910.ground_truth: The UE should send another REGISTER request with an expiration timer of at least the value received in the Min-Expires header of the 423 (Interval Too Brief) response.

question_4911.question: How many sources achieved the target requirement of 6~12 months for battery life with extended DRX cycle and ultra-deep sleep state?

question_4912.question: What type of data is provided by the measurement "Number of incoming IP data packets on the S1-MME interface from eNodeB to MME"?
question_4912.ground_truth: The number of incoming IP data packets on the S1-MME interface from eNodeB to MME.

question_4913.question: What are the four physical blocks of TMN implementations based on LLA?
question_4913.ground_truth: The four physical blocks of TMN implementations based on LLA are Business-Operations Systems (B-OS), Service-Operations Systems (S-OS), Network-Operations Systems (N-OS), and Element-Operations Systems (E-OS).

question_4916.question: What are the decision parameters used to confirm whether the pitch related to the base pitch frequency is accurate in the frequency domain?
question_4916.ground_truth: The decision parameters include energy spectrum difference, average energy spectrum, and the ratio of energy spectrum difference and average energy spectrum.

question_4917.question: What information does each record in this clause consist of in ProSe UE-to-NW Relay?
question_4917.ground_truth: Each record in this clause consists of a set of parameters, which can be either mandatory (required for the record), conditional (required in situations where a condition is met), or optional (provided at the discretion of the implementation) in ProSe UE-to-NW Relay.

question_4919.question: What is the procedure for combining different physical downlink channels within one timeslot?
question_4919.ground_truth: Each spread channel is separately weighted by a weight factor G_i, and then all downlink physical channels are combined using complex addition.

question_4921.question: Which remote party wants to hold a call?

question_4922.question: What is the reference point between the PINE and the PEGC in Personal IoT Networks in 5GS?
question_4922.ground_truth: This reference point is based on the direct user plane path to 5GS, relay path via the PEGC, or other communication path via Internet.

question_4923.question: What action does the UE take when it has user data pending due to no user-plane resources established for PDU session(s) used for user data transport in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode over 3GPP access?
question_4923.ground_truth: The UE sends a SERVICE REQUEST message.

question_4924.question: What is the impact of the selected protection policy information on subsequent message transfers over N32-f in the parameter exchange procedure for protection policy exchange?
question_4924.ground_truth: The selected protection policy information contains the IEs allowed to be modified by an IPX on the side of the responding SEPP. The SEPPs shall store the modification policy and the encryption policy, which is applicable for both the directions of communication between the SEPPs. The SEPP receiving the subsequent message transfers over N32-f shall check whether the modifications performed by the IPXs were permitted by the respective modification policy.

question_4925.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe EPC-level Discovery Proximity Request Procedure?
question_4925.ground_truth: The ProSe EPC-level Discovery Proximity Request Procedure allows a ProSe-enabled UE A to request the network to assist it in detecting if UE B is in proximity.

question_4926.question: What is the action taken by the receiving side of an AM RLC entity when an AMD PDU is received with a SN gap?
question_4926.ground_truth: When an AMD PDU is received with a SN gap, the receiving side of an AM RLC entity sends a STATUS PDU to request retransmissions of PDUs in the SN gap.

question_4927.question: What should the UE do if the EMM cause value received is #11 or #35, and the UE is not in its HPLMN or EHPLMN?
question_4927.ground_truth: If the EMM cause value received is #11 or #35, and the UE is not in its HPLMN or EHPLMN, the UE should increment the PLMN-specific attempt counter of the PLMN that sent the reject message and handle 5GMM parameters for rejected registration request or service request procedures over 3GPP access.

question_4929.question: What action should the mobile station take when a PACKET CELL CHANGE ORDER message is received in extended uplink TBF mode?
question_4929.ground_truth: The mobile station should stop timer T3208, leave CCN mode and follow the procedures as specified for the Packet Cell Change Order and in sub-clause 8.8.1.

question_4930.question: What should be the action taken by a GTP entity if it receives an information element with a reserved value?
question_4930.ground_truth: The GTP entity should treat the information element as invalid, log the error, and send a response with Cause set to "Mandatory IE incorrect" if the invalid IE is mandatory or verifiable conditional.

question_4932.question: What is the purpose of using a callSessionIdentifier in the PlayMedia interface?
question_4932.ground_truth: The purpose of using a callSessionIdentifier in the PlayMedia interface is to indicate the ongoing call session to which the request applies. It allows the system to manage the media messages provided to the call participants in the specified call session.

question_4933.question: What kind of signalling does the Xw Setup procedure in the XwAP protocol use?
question_4933.ground_truth: The Xw Setup procedure in the XwAP protocol uses non-UE-associated signalling.

question_4934.question: What is the format of the MulticastMRBs-ToBeSetupMod-List in the MulticastContextModificationRequest?
question_4934.ground_truth: The MulticastMRBs-ToBeSetupMod-List in the MulticastContextModificationRequest is a SEQUENCE of ProtocolIE-SingleContainer, containing MulticastMRBs-ToBeSetupMod-ItemIEs.

question_4935.question: What RFC specifies the mechanisms for error recovery and packet reordering in the header compression supported by PDCP?

question_4936.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) and what does the abbreviation "TSG" stand for in the document?
question_4936.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) is a collaboration between groups of telecommunications standards associations. "TSG" stands for Technical Specification Group in the document.

question_4937.question: What is the size of the "TCI State ID" field in the Aperiodic CSI Trigger State Subselection MAC CE?
question_4937.ground_truth: The size of the "TCI State ID" field in the Aperiodic CSI Trigger State Subselection MAC CE is 7 bits.

question_4938.question: What is the purpose of having two different notifications for distributing emergency information in ETWS?
question_4938.ground_truth: The primary notification provides the most urgent information, such as warning type, and is send before the secondary notification which contains more detailed textual information, such as seismic intensity and epicentre.

question_4939.question: What are the potential benefits of using the UE WLAN MAC address as the Xw UE ID?
question_4939.ground_truth: Using the UE WLAN MAC address as the Xw UE ID has the added benefit of reusing already available information from the WLAN, and does not require changes in the WLAN air interface. This may also help to limit WT complexity.

question_4941.question: What is the role of a "resource owner" as defined in the document?
question_4941.ground_truth: A resource owner is an entity capable of granting access to a protected resource.

question_4942.question: When does the counter for "MM.HoExeInterSucc" in 5G mobility management get incremented?
question_4942.ground_truth: The counter is incremented by 1 when a successful handover is indicated by the receipt of UE CONTEXT RELEASE at the source gNB from the target gNB or AMF following a successful inter gNB handover or legacy handover.

question_4943.question: What terms and documentation were identified as E-UTRAN/EPS specific in the Mission Critical specifications?
question_4943.ground_truth: Terms such as UE-R, UE-to-network relay, EPC-level roaming, GCSE_LTE, MBMS, BM-SC, MB2-U, MB2-C, GC1, TMGI, MBSFN, ECGI, SAI, TS 23.246, TS 23.468, TS-29.468, PC5, ProSe, TS 23.303, APN, PAP, CHAP, QCI, LTE, EPS, EPC, E-UTRAN, S1, TS 23.331, GSMA PRD IR.88, and HSS were identified as E-UTRAN/EPS (Evolved Packet Core) specific in the Mission Critical specifications.

question_4944.question: What changes are needed in the mobile station to support new training sequence codes?
question_4944.ground_truth: New training sequence codes need to be defined in the mobile station (MS) and must be signalled to the network. Additionally, the mobile station's receiver algorithms should be optimized to cope with inter-sub-channel interference.

question_4945.question: What does the ResourceIsolationRule IOC represent in the IOC?
question_4945.ground_truth: The ResourceIsolationRule IOC represents a set of isolation requirements for managed resources, specifying a list of rules for the isolation of managed resources using the resourceIsolationRuleList attribute.

question_4946.question: What is the total number of tested position combinations in the search algorithm for the 12.65 kbit/s mode?
question_4946.ground_truth: The total number of tested position combinations in the search algorithm for the 12.65 kbit/s mode is 320 + 1280 = 1600 after four iterations with each having 320 combinations.

question_4948.question: How many interfering signals does the SS produce in addition to the wanted signal in scenario VDTS-2?
question_4948.ground_truth: The SS produces four interfering signals in addition to the wanted signal in scenario VDTS-2.

question_4949.question: What is the implication of eCall based on Circuit Switched calls?
question_4949.ground_truth: ETSI MSG requires eCall to be based on Circuit Switched calls so that the system is compatible with a PSAP that has not yet implemented the eCall functionality.

question_4950.question: What main functions does the physical layer perform in the UMTS system?
question_4950.ground_truth: The physical layer performs several main functions, including FEC encoding/decoding of transport channels, measurements and indication to higher layers, error detection on transport channels, multiplexing of transport channels and demultiplexing of coded composite transport channels, rate matching, mapping of coded composite transport channels on physical channels, modulation and spreading/demodulation and despreading of physical channels, frequency and time synchronization, closed-loop power control, power weighting and combining of physical channels, RF processing, and support for uplink synchronization (in TDD only).

question_4952.question: What is required in 3GPP TS 26.114 for defining RTP payload types for codecs?
question_4952.ground_truth: Codecs in 3GPP TS 26.114 can have static or dynamic RTP payload types. For dynamic payload types, the codecs must be signaled in the "a=rtpmap"-line of the SDP, with selected options expressed in the "a=fmtp"-line. For static payload types, the codecs can be signaled in the "a=rtpmap"-line when the selected options are expressed in the "a=fmtp"-line. Otherwise, the codec type is implied by the RTP payload type.

question_4954.question: What should the mobile station (MS) do if both the network and the MS support the Cell Notification and a new READY timer value is negotiated?
question_4954.ground_truth: The MS should use any LLC frame except the LLC NULL frame for the initial cell update.

question_4955.question: What is the allowed range for the bound parameter in the AccessPointName parameter?
question_4955.ground_truth: The bound parameter in the AccessPointName parameter must be in the range of minAccessPointNameLength to maxAccessPointNameLength.

question_4956.question: What should be included in the SDP offer when establishing an MCVideo group session?
question_4956.ground_truth: The SDP offer in the SIP INVITE request should be based on the negotiations during the call establishment and indicate whether an implicit Transmission request is negotiated.

question_4958.question: What condition will evaluate to true when the Outgoing Communication Barring service provides the rule that contains the matching condition that the specific outgoing communication it to be barred?
question_4958.ground_truth: When the request URI of the outgoing SIP request corresponds to a telephone number and does not point to a destination served by a network within the country where the originating user is located when initiating the communication.

question_4959.question: What is the purpose of the Test Management IRP in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_4959.ground_truth: The Test Management IRP is a part of the TM-family that specifies the Test management Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the 3GPP Technical Specification. It defines the interface between the managing system and the managed system for test management.

question_4960.question: In which direction does the Control Plane CIoT 5GS Optimisation exchange user data between the UE and the SMF?
question_4960.ground_truth: The Control Plane CIoT 5GS Optimisation exchanges user data between the UE and the SMF in both uplink and downlink directions.

question_4961.question: What is the response when the user does not accept the proactive command?
question_4961.ground_truth: The response is "User did not accept the proactive command".

question_4962.question: What should the SS do if the MS recommends to use the 8.85 kbit/s or a higher codec mode in the downlink after the carrier to interference has been altered in step 3o?
question_4962.ground_truth: The SS should increment the successful C/I increase event counter.

question_4963.question: How many subframes are allowed for intra-band Carrier Aggregation in the 3GPP TS 36.133 standard for interruption of Primary Cell?
question_4963.ground_truth: The intra-band CA allows a maximum of 5 subframes for interruption of the Primary Cell.

question_4964.question: What is the requirement for the NTP timestamp field in the stop condition of the time stamp test?
question_4964.ground_truth: The NTP timestamp field in the last RTCP packet sent from the SUT should be less than the NTP timestamp field in the first RTCP packet sent from the SUT.

question_4965.question: What should the MS do if the number 112 is entered in an emergency call?
question_4965.ground_truth: If the number 112 is entered in an emergency call, the MS shall send a CHANNEL REQUEST message with the correct establishment cause ("emergency call"). After assignment of a dedicated channel, the first layer message sent by the MS on the assigned dedicated channel shall be a CM SERVICE REQUEST message specifying the correct IMEI and a non-available CKSN, with CM Service Type "emergency call establishment". After cipher mode setting acceptance by the network, the MS shall send an EMERGENCY SETUP message, and the emergency call shall be correctly established.

question_4966.question: What is the total maximum allowed time for cell re-selection delay expressed in seconds?
question_4966.ground_truth: The total maximum allowed time for cell re-selection delay is 34 seconds.

question_4969.question: What information is included in the Modify Bearer Request message that is sent to the Serving GW to prompt the PDN GW to tunnel packets from non-3GPP IP access to 3GPP access system?

question_4970.question: What is the purpose of the P-Visited-Network-ID header field that is added to a REGISTER request in the visited network?
question_4970.ground_truth: The P-Visited-Network-ID header field is added to the REGISTER request to contain the identifier of the P-CSCF network and to inform the home network of the visited network that the user is roaming.

question_4971.question: What does the UE do in response to the Counter Check message?
question_4971.ground_truth: The UE compares the COUNT values received in the Counter Check message with the values of its radio bearers and sends a Counter Check Response message accordingly.

question_4972.question: What information is transmitted during an intersystem handover from UTRAN to GSM BSS?
question_4972.ground_truth: Necessary information such as Kc, supported/allowed GSM ciphering algorithms, and selected GSM ciphering mode are transmitted during an intersystem handover from UTRAN to GSM BSS.

question_4973.question: What is the PCF's role in determining the alternative S-NSSAI for the network?
question_4973.ground_truth: The PCF determines the alternative S-NSSAI for the network; however, since it is not specified in solution #40 how the PCF knows whether the alternative S-NSSAI is supported in the current TA and associated RAN node, further clarification is required to ensure proper functionality.

question_4975.question: How does the service interworking and service continuation for Public train emergency communication differ from Railway emergency communication with GSM-R?
question_4975.ground_truth: For Public train emergency communication, there is no interworking in the direction from GSM-R Railway emergency call to FRMCS Public train emergency communication required. This is because a GSM-R Railway emergency call already initiates a FRMCS Railway Emergency Communication. Additionally, the service flows for interworking for a Mobile FRMCS User attached to FRMCS and the service flows for service continuation are similar to Railway emergency communication, except that they are applicable to Public train emergency communication.

question_4979.question: In what situations can the P-CSCF select a new exit point when forwarding a REGISTER request?
question_4979.ground_truth: The P-CSCF can select a new exit point if the currently selected exit point does not respond to the REGISTER request and its retransmissions, or if it sends back a 3xx response or 480 (Temporarily Unavailable) response.

question_4980.question: What is one of the interaction types supported by the U2-AE reference point for UAS application layer?
question_4980.ground_truth: The interactions related to UAS application layer support functions between UAE clients are supported by the U2-AE reference point.

question_4982.question: What is the function of the PGW in NIDD using a PtP SGi tunnel, and how is the user plane different from NIDD using SCEF?
question_4982.ground_truth: The PGW provides an IRI-POI and a CC-POI for NIDD using a PtP SGi tunnel, and it terminates the PtP SGi tunnel with the SCS/AS, which has the same capabilities as SCEF for NIDD. The user plane for NIDD using a PtP SGi tunnel flows through MME and SGW, unlike in NIDD using SCEF where the user traffic is exchanged with DoNAS between UE and MME, over T6a interface between MME and SCEF, and finally over T8 interface between SCEF and SCS/AS.

question_4983.question: Which IE is an IP address used for the user plane transport in the M3AP protocol?
