question_5329.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-CP initiates the procedure by sending a GNB-CU-CP E1 SETUP REQUEST message.

question_5330.question: Over which interface is security mechanisms provided for the control plane and user plane traffic between the MS and the GANC in the Iu mode of GAN?
question_5330.ground_truth: Security mechanisms are provided over the Up interface in the Iu mode of GAN for control plane and user plane traffic between the MS and the GANC.

question_5331.question: What must a UE do if it has detected CDMA2000 HRPD cells that have met cell reselection criterion and Treselection timer has a non-zero value?
question_5331.ground_truth: Evaluate this CDMA2000 HRPD cell for the Treselection time and reselect that cell if the reselection criteria are met within this duration.

question_5333.question: What does the term "resource block" signify in the context of E-UTRA?
question_5333.ground_truth: A resource block is a unit of measurement for the frequency and time resources in the E-UTRA system, expressed as a number of subcarriers and symbols.

question_5334.question: When is the 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay UE required to perform the remote UE report procedure?
question_5334.ground_truth: After the completion of a successful 5G ProSe layer-3 remote UE establishment procedure and if there is a PDU session established for relaying traffic for the 5G ProSe remote UE, the 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay UE must perform the remote UE report procedure.

question_5335.question: When should a client modify the target protection time in media playback session?
question_5335.ground_truth: The client should only modify the target protection time in circumstances where it has a more accurate understanding of network and transmission jitter and the efficiency of its ability to process the network buffer.

question_5336.question: What is the purpose of introducing the IOC for AI/ML performance abstraction?
question_5336.ground_truth: The purpose of introducing the IOC for AI/ML performance abstraction is to serve as the entity that produces the abstraction of ML performance and supports all the related services for request and delivery of qualified ML performance abstraction.

question_5337.question: What is the reason for the P-CSCF to send a Cancel message to the SCC AS in the fallback procedure for originating sessions?
question_5337.ground_truth: The P-CSCF sends a Cancel message to the SCC AS to release the mobile originating session when the multimedia PS bearer setup fails in the pre-alerting phase.

question_5338.question: What should be assumed when two operating bands have overlapping frequency ranges and are deployed in the same geographical area?
question_5338.ground_truth: Special co-existence requirements may apply that are not covered by the 3GPP specifications.

question_5339.question: What should a UE do when it can no longer use the current radio parameters for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay discovery without causing interference to other cells?
question_5339.ground_truth: The UE should check with lower layers whether the selected radio parameters can be used in the current location without causing interference to other cells. If the lower layers indicate that the usage would not cause any interference, the UE should initiate 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay discovery.

question_5340.question: What is the purpose of the supplementary service version indicator in the mobile station classmark 2?
question_5340.ground_truth: The purpose of the supplementary service version indicator is to allow the network to select the correct version of a protocol for a specific supplementary service.

question_5341.question: What is the communication performance requirement for the 5G system to support energy efficient communication mechanisms for Ambient IoT devices?
question_5341.ground_truth: The 5G system should minimize the device communication power consumption while meeting the communication performance requirements.

question_5342.question: Which method is used to obtain a list of messages in a mailbox folder, based on specific criteria?

question_5343.question: What should the IWF do if the received SIP MESSAGE request does not contain an <originated-by> element?
question_5343.ground_truth: The IWF should clear the cache of the MCPTT ID of the sender of the SIP MESSAGE request as having an outstanding MCPTT emergency alert.

question_5347.question: What are the allowed value ranges for the "short", "medium", and "long" operation timers in CAP?
question_5347.ground_truth: The value ranges for the "short" timer is 1 to 20 seconds, for the "medium" timer is 1 to 60 seconds, and for the "long" timer is 1 second to 30 minutes.

question_5348.question: What is the relationship between a PICS, a PICS proforma, and a supplier in the 3GPP TS 51.010 specification?
question_5348.ground_truth: In the 3GPP TS 51.010 specification, a PICS is an ICS for an implementation or system claimed to conform to a given protocol specification. The PICS proforma is a document in the form of a questionnaire that, when completed for an implementation or system, becomes a PICS. The PICS proforma and PICS must be technically equivalent to and preserve the numbering/naming, ordering, and instructions for completion given in the annex A of the specification.

question_5349.question: What should the SGM-C send in the CoAP DELETE request when deleting a group?
question_5349.ground_truth: The SGM-C shall send a CoAP DELETE request to the SGM-S and set the CoAP URI identifying the individual VAL group document to be deleted. The request should be protected with the relevant ACE profile (OSCORE profile or DTLS profile).

question_5350.question: What is the procedure for handling IDC problems in the device?
question_5350.ground_truth: When the UE identifies IDC type problems, it first tries to solve them internally. If it can't, it indicates to the eNB that it experiences IDC problems, which it cannot solve itself.

question_5351.question: How does TMF define technology independent and technology specific concepts in network management?
question_5351.ground_truth: TMF defines technology independent concepts as a Technology Neutral Architecture (TNA) and technology specific concepts as Technology Specific Architectures (TSA).

question_5352.question: What state is considered as having an unspecified number of transmissions during an MCPTT Group Call?
question_5352.ground_truth: An MCPTT Emergency Group Call or an Imminent Peril group call can be seen as having an unspecified number of transmissions during a group call.

question_5353.question: What options does the network operator have if the diverting party has both CAT service and CDIV active, and the diverted-to party does not have an active service?
question_5353.ground_truth: The network operator can choose to not apply any CAT service to the session when CDIV is invoked, or to apply the CAT service of the diverting party to the session without applying the CAT service for the diverted-to party.

question_5354.question: What functionality does the PC5 Signalling Protocol enable?
question_5354.ground_truth: The PC5 Signalling Protocol enables functions such as Direct Communication Request, TMGI advertisement and eMBMS traffic relay, and Cell ID announcement procedure.

question_5355.question: What information does the MS include in the Measurement Report message to the GERAN to indicate preference for the GAN cell in the GERAN to GAN handover scenario?
question_5355.ground_truth: The MS includes GAN cell information in the Measurement Report message to the GERAN, reporting the highest signal level for the GAN cell, which is an artificial value (i.e. RxLev = 63).

question_5356.question: Which sections outline the requirements for periodic reporting of RSRP, RSRQ, and RS-SINR measurements?
question_5356.ground_truth: Reported RSRP, RSRQ, and RS-SINR measurements contained in periodically triggered measurement reports shall meet the requirements in sections 9.1.3.1, 9.1.3.2, 9.1.6.1, 9.1.6.2, 9.1.17.3.1 and 9.1.17.3.2, respectively.

question_5357.question: What is the significance of the Connect Acknowledge message type?
question_5357.ground_truth: The Connect Acknowledge message type has local significance, indicating that the network or mobile station has been awarded the call.

question_5358.question: How is the qop value determined in the WWW-Authenticate header in the HTTP 401 Unauthorized response?
question_5358.ground_truth: The qop value is set to "auth" in the WWW-Authenticate header in the HTTP 401 Unauthorized response.

question_5360.question: What action should the network take on the fifth expiry of timer T3395 related to the MBMS context deactivation initiated by the network?
question_5360.ground_truth: On the fifth expiry of timer T3395, the network should erase the MBMS context related data for that MS, as the MS did not respond to the DEACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message.

question_5361.question: What is the structure of the requestedCellGrouping-r16 in the UE-CapabilityRequestFilterCommon?
question_5361.ground_truth: The requestedCellGrouping-r16 in the UE-CapabilityRequestFilterCommon is a sequence that contains a list of CellGrouping-r16, which specify the list of FreqBandIndicatorNR, mode-r16, and mcg-r16 for NR-DC. It is included in the capability container request list if the NRDC condition is met.

question_5362.question: What action should an SNRM-C take upon determining that the MBMS bearer quality has reached a certain threshold?
question_5362.ground_truth: The SNRM-C should report the MBMS listening status by generating an application/vnd.3gpp.seal-mbms-usage-info+xml MIME body with an <mbms-listening-status-report> element in the <mbms-info> root element, and then sending this information in a CoAP DELETE request to the SNRM server.

question_5363.question: What is the benefit of the overload information data without requiring specificities for securing the Diameter based network in 3GPP?
question_5363.ground_truth: The overload information is sensitive as some other Diameter data, and securing the transfer of Diameter data is considered as useful for 3GPP but is not required for Release 12.

question_5364.question: Which custom operation allows deleting EAS Deployment Information based on given attributes?
question_5364.ground_truth: The custom operation "remove-edis" allows deleting EAS Deployment Information based on given attributes.

question_5365.question: What is the minimum performance requirement for the IBE requirements for the UE parameters that RAN4 has decided to use?
question_5365.ground_truth: The IBE requirements for the UE parameters from TS 38.101-2 clause 6.4.2.3.4 (power class 3 UE) are the minimum performance requirements for the UE parameters that RAN4 has decided to use.

question_5367.question: What are the three types of accounting data used for successful sessions in offline charging?

question_5371.question: How are temporary variables used in the SAT Interpreter?
question_5371.ground_truth: Temporary variables are used during the execution of the current page in the SAT Interpreter. They may be shared between the current page and the following page. The current page shall define, which variables are to be kept for access of the following page. To ensure, that only a dedicated following page can access the variables defined to be sharable, the current page may protect them with a One Time Password (OTP). The following page shall present a Page Unlock TLV to get access to the shared variables. This TLV contains the OTP of the preceding page.

question_5373.question: What is the required action of a mobile station if it receives an IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT REJECT, a PACKET ASSIGNMENT REJECT, or an RRC CONNECTION REJECT message while in the process of network controlled cell reselection?
question_5373.ground_truth: The mobile station shall determine that the network controlled cell reselection procedure has failed, start timer T3176, send a PACKET CELL CHANGE FAILURE message with the appropriate cause value to the network in the old cell, and stop timer T3176.

question_5374.question: How is the start of the TeDRX timer synchronized between the UE and the CN?
question_5374.ground_truth: There are two options for synchronizing the start of the TeDRX timer between the UE and the CN, described in clauses 5.2.1.1a.2 and 5.2.1.1a.3.

question_5375.question: What events shall be reported by the ICE to the DF for separate delivery of MMS?
question_5375.ground_truth: The events that shall be reported by the ICE to the DF for separate delivery of MMS include MMS Send, MMS Notification & Confirmation, MMS Retrieval Confirmation & Acknowledgement, MMS Forwarding, MMS Store Requests, MMS Viewing Requests & Responses, MMS Deletion Requests, MMS Cancel Requests, MMS Delivery Reports, and MMS Read Report.

question_5376.question: When does the NAS message from the UE need to include the Old PDU Session ID in 5G network?
question_5376.ground_truth: The UE needs to include the Old PDU Session ID in the NAS message only when the procedure is triggered for SSC mode 3 operation.

question_5377.question: What is the purpose of the test procedure defined in 7.6B.3.4.2?
question_5377.ground_truth: The purpose is to measure the UE's ability to meet the required average throughput when an interfering signal is present.

question_5380.question: What action should the RNC take if it receives a GTP error indication from the SGSN for a default bearer when S4-U is used?
question_5380.ground_truth: The RNC should initiate the RAB Release procedure with the error cause "GTP Resources Unavailable", release the RAB immediately, delete the related PDP context, and send a Deactivate PDP Context Request message to the MS with cause "re-activation required".

question_5382.question: What is the difference between CN controlled subgrouping and UE ID based subgrouping?
question_5382.ground_truth: CN controlled subgrouping is assigned by the AMF and is homogeneous within an RNA, with a maximum of 8 subgroups. In contrast, UE ID based subgrouping is determined by the UE based on the UE ID and the total number of subgroups in the cell, with the total number of subgroups decided by the gNB for each cell.

question_5383.question: How does the network process entries in the CCBS queue during IDLE conditions of the destination?
question_5383.ground_truth: During idle periods of destination B, the network processes the entries in the destination B CCBS queue in the order received, starting with the first non-suspended request. If an entry fails to initiate a call, the following entries are processed until the queue processing is complete.

question_5385.question: What action should the UE take when sending a SDS OFF-NETWORK MESSAGE message with a disposition request type of DELIVERY AND READ?
question_5385.ground_truth: The UE should send a SDS OFF-NETWORK MESSAGE message and initiate counter CFS1 (SDS retransmission) to 1 and start timer TFS1 (SDS retransmission) when the MCDATA User requests to send a standalone one-to-one SDS message with a disposition request type of DELIVERY AND READ.

question_5387.question: How many successful tests must be achieved for the test to pass, with what confidence level?
question_5387.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests must be more than 90% of the cases, with a confidence level of 95%.

question_5388.question: What is the expected value in the SubjectAltName extension of the GANC-SEGW certificate as per 3GPP TS 33.402?
question_5388.ground_truth: The SubjectAltName extension of the GANC-SEGW certificate shall contain an IPaddress SubjectAltName that matches the IP address of the GANC-SEGW, a DNSname SubjectAltName that matches the FQDN of the GANC-SEGW, or both.

question_5389.question: What is the purpose of the grouping and consolidation of common requirements in the MCX Service?
question_5389.ground_truth: The grouping and consolidation of common requirements in the MCX Service are not meant to dictate architectural design or impact entities and interfaces. Instead, it provides downstream working groups with flexibility, allowing them to determine the best approach for reusing generic MCX Service functionality, extending or customizing common MCX Services, or defining separate support for specialized Mission Critical Applications.

question_5390.question: What is the final step taken by the GMLC if the UE does not grant authorization in its current location?
question_5390.ground_truth: If one of the UEs does not grant authorization in its current location, the GMLC responds to the application server/AF with a failure cause, and the rest of the Ranging service procedure is not performed.

question_5392.question: What are the four functions of 5G Proximity-based Services (ProSe) in the 3GPP system?
question_5392.ground_truth: The four functions of 5G Proximity-based Services (ProSe) in the 3GPP system are 5G ProSe direct discovery, 5G ProSe direct communication, 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay, and 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay.

question_5393.question: How does the UE send the UE Capability ID in NAS (initial registration procedure) in Solution #5?
question_5393.ground_truth: In Solution #5, the UE sends the UE Capability ID in NAS (initial registration procedure) in ciphered form, providing protection against unauthorized access.

question_5394.question: What should a UE do if it does not support non-IP PDN type in EPS but supports Ethernet or Unstructured PDU Session type in 5GS?
question_5394.ground_truth: The UE should locally delete any EBI(s) corresponding to the Ethernet/Unstructured PDU Session(s) to avoid transferring them to EPS.

question_5395.question: In the example flow, what is the significance of the visited-realm attribute in the received SDP answer?
question_5395.ground_truth: The visited-realm attribute in the received SDP answer indicates whether the IP realm on the original media path has a matching IP realm along the alternate media path.

question_5396.question: What condition should be met by the first CSI report for SCell1 to indicate a successful activation during T2?
question_5396.ground_truth: The first CSI report for SCell1 should be received in a subframe (m+8) or (m+10) during T2, with a non-zero CQI index in the earliest available uplink resource after (m+8) or (m+10).

question_5397.question: What mode is the "This measurement is valid only for FDD mode" statement referring to?
question_5397.ground_truth: FDD mode stands for Frequency Division Duplex, which is a method of wireless communication.

question_5398.question: What is the process for MME re-direction in Solution 4b?
question_5398.ground_truth: Solution 4b involves the Source MME sending a Forward Relocation Request message to the Target MME over the S10 interface with the UE's context. The Target MME assigns a GUTI for the UE and sends a NAS message towards the UE using a new S1-AP MME RELOCATION REQUEST message. The T-MME ignores the transparent container sent by S-MME, the eNodeB retrieves the UE context and forwards the NAS message to UE, and UE takes note of the newly assigned GUTI and responds with a GUTI REALLOCATION COMPLETE message.

question_5399.question: What is the frequency range that must be considered for voice communication in the FRMCS system?
question_5399.ground_truth: For voice communication in the FRMCS system, the minimum encoding of speech must encompass the range of 200-7000 Hz.

question_5401.question: In the second example User Service Description, what percentage of UEs should complete the registration procedure before consuming the MBMS User Service?
question_5401.ground_truth: 50% of UEs should complete the registration procedure before consuming the MBMS User Service in the second example User Service Description.

question_5402.question: What is the primary function in the real-time video transmission use cases in section 7.1?
question_5402.ground_truth: The primary function in the real-time video transmission use cases in section 7.1 is to transmit video in real time.

question_5403.question: Which control is under the node B's power control, the E-AGCH or the E-RGCH or both, and how may the node B power control the E-AGCH when the E-AGCH message is targeted to one UE for decoding and to another UE for detection?
question_5403.ground_truth: The E-AGCH and E-RGCH power control are under the control of the node B. The node B may power control the E-AGCH appropriately to satisfy the reception performance requirements for the two UEs, for example, by minimally increasing the transmit power of the E-AGCH message targeted to the UE with poorer channel conditions and reducing the transmit power of the E-AGCH message targeted to the UE with better channel conditions.

question_5406.question: What must the UE do before reinitialising PDCP header compression entities when preparing for seamless SRNS relocation?
question_5406.ground_truth: The UE needs to (re-)establish the AM RLC entity for SRB#2 and its HFN values, and compare the next uplink receive PDCP sequence number with the next uplink send PDCP sequence number to ensure successful transfer of PDCP SDUs before the start of relocation. Any confirmed PDCP SDUs that are already received at the source RNC must be discarded by the UE.

question_5407.question: How does a UE determine the PUCCH resource to use when transmitting HARQ-ACK, SR, and CSI reports in a single PUCCH?
question_5407.ground_truth: A UE determines the PUCCH resource to use by using the PUCCH resource indicator field in a last DCI format associated with HARQ-ACK feedback, and selecting the minimum number of PRBs based on the number of UCI bits, code rate, modulation scheme, and the number of subcarriers per resource block and PUCCH symbols for the format.

question_5408.question: What is the role of the GAA client in the GBA flow for accessing a service in a terminal?
question_5408.ground_truth: The GAA client in the terminal sends a request to the NAF to access a service and uses GBA-based keys to secure the Ua application protocol upon the NAF's indication.

question_5409.question: What is the maximum measurement reporting delay allowed in this test case?

question_5410.question: What is the recommended resolution bandwidth of the measuring equipment for obtaining the equivalent noise bandwidth of the measurement bandwidth?
question_5410.ground_truth: The recommended resolution bandwidth of the measuring equipment is equal to the measurement bandwidth. However, to improve measurement accuracy, sensitivity, and efficiency, the resolution bandwidth may be smaller than the measurement bandwidth.

question_5411.question: What is the common method used to avoid the SAR issue and improve UL coverage in TDD systems?
question_5411.ground_truth: Restricting duty-cycle is a commonly used method to avoid the SAR issue in TDD systems.

question_5412.question: How does the E-RABs-ToBeModified-SgNBModReqd-Item sequence in the E-RABs-ToBeModified-SgNBModReqd-List field in the SgNBModificationRequired message differ from the E-RABs-ToBeModified-SgNBModReqd-Item sequence in the E-RABs-ToBeModified-SgNBModReqd-List field in the SgNBModificationModReqd message?
question_5412.ground_truth: The E-RABs-ToBeModified-SgNBModReqd-Item sequence in the E-RABs-ToBeModified-SgNBModReqd-List field of the SgNBModificationRequired message contains an SN-Status field, while the E-RABs-ToBeModified-SgNBModReqd-Item sequence in the E-RABs-ToBeModified-SgNBModReqd-List field of the SgNBModificationModReqd message does not.

question_5413.question: What is the main difference between Solution 1 and Solution 2 in terms of deployment scenario?
question_5413.ground_truth: Solution 1 deals with the deployment of multiple PCRF with DRA, while Solution 2 focuses on the failure of a single PCRF.

question_5414.question: What should the SMF do when it successfully completes the execution of the handover of a PDU session?
question_5414.ground_truth: The SMF should switch the PDU session towards the downlink termination point for the user data received from the target 5G-AN, and set the hoState to NONE, deleting any stored targetServingNfId.

question_5415.question: What is the role of the SNDCP entity in the establishment, re-establishment, and release of acknowledged peer-to-peer LLC operation?
question_5415.ground_truth: The SNDCP entity is responsible for the establishment, re-establishment, and release of acknowledged peer-to-peer LLC operation. This is in addition to the mapping of SN-DATA primitives onto LL-DATA primitives, multiplexing of N-PDUs from one or several network layer entities onto the appropriate LLC connection, and management of delivery sequence for each NSAPI, independently.

question_5416.question: What action does the SS take to initiate the establishment of concurrent downlink multi carrier in BTTI mode?
question_5416.ground_truth: The SS initiates the establishment of concurrent downlink multi carrier in BTTI mode by sending a PACKET UPLINK ASSIGNMENT message to the mobile station.

question_5417.question: What is the relationship between MMS and SMS in terms of their functionality?
question_5417.ground_truth: MMS is an extension of SMS to support multimedia content, i.e. SMS is a subset of MMS with only text support.

question_5418.question: What is the primary motivation for defining a new UE power class with a higher Tx power for TDD LTE Band 41 operations?
question_5418.ground_truth: The primary motivation is to improve UE and network performance, as maintaining the same power class UE definition would ensure backward compatibility with prior technologies and comply with national regulatory rulings. However, since TDD LTE band 41 does not have any 3GPP legacy technologies associated with it and is less susceptible to SAR levels, a new UE power class with higher Tx power would not compromise 3GPP foundational work.

question_5419.question: What is the role of GTP-U in the F1 interface between gNB-DU and gNB-CU?
question_5419.ground_truth: The GTP-U is used to transport data over the F1 interface between gNB-DU and gNB-CU.

question_5421.question: What has to be sent to the UE as part of the test procedure in 8.6.1.2.4.1?
question_5421.ground_truth: SS (Test System) shall transmit the initial MEASUREMENT CONTROL message indicating to the UE that event-triggered reporting with Event 1A, 1C and 1B shall be used.

question_5422.question: What is the maximum allowed PCell interruption duration due to measurements when an SCell is deactivated in inter-band EN-DC or synchronous intra-band EN-DC?
question_5422.ground_truth: Each interruption is not allowed to exceed 2 subframes for synchronous inter-band EN-DC or 1 subframe for synchronous intra-band EN-DC, and assumes that the cell specific reference signals from both cells are available in the same slot.

question_5423.question: What should the UE do if a PUCCH resource overlaps in time with a PUSCH transmission and the UE multiplexes only CSI reports?
question_5423.ground_truth: The UE should transmit the PUSCH using the PUCCH resource if the PUCCH resource does not overlap in time with a PUSCH transmission after multiplexing UCI following the procedures described in clauses 9, 9.2.5.1, 9.2.5.2, 9.2.5.3, and 18.

question_5426.question: What is the test parameter relaxation defined for this test?
question_5426.ground_truth: The test parameter relaxation for this test is defined in clause A5.5.2 and the explanation of how the Conformance requirement has been relaxed by the Test Parameter Relaxation is given in clause A5.5.4.

question_5427.question: What should the ME do if it receives a GPRS Kc computed by the USIM?
question_5427.ground_truth: The ME should ignore such GPRS Kc and not store it on the USIM or in the ME.

question_5428.question: What is the responsibility of the receiving SEPP in verifying the integrity and authenticity of the received message?
question_5428.ground_truth: The receiving SEPP decrypts the JWE ciphertext using the shared session key, checks the integrity and authenticity of the clearTextEncapsulatedMessage and the encrypted text, and applies the patches in the Operations field.

question_5429.question: What does HS-DSCH stand for in the HSDPA system?

question_5430.question: What is the mobile country code and mobile network code for the system simulator in the first scenario?
question_5430.ground_truth: The mobile country code is 001 and the mobile network code is 01.

question_5433.question: What actions occur when the PCRF sends an Intermediate Charging Status Request to the OCS?
question_5433.ground_truth: The OCS acknowledges the request and provides the Policy-Counter-Status per Policy-Counter-Id provided by the PCRF. The PCRF then makes updated policy decisions based on the received report from the OCS. If the procedure was triggered by an IP-CAN Session Modification procedure, the PCRF concludes this procedure as defined in the TS~23.203.

question_5434.question: What header field shall the MCPTT client include with the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt" in the SIP INVITE request?
question_5434.ground_truth: The MCPTT client shall include a P-Preferred-Service header field with the value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt" in the SIP INVITE request.

question_5435.question: What is the purpose of the Alarm Integration Reference Point (Alarm IRP) in 3GPP TS 32.111-5?
question_5435.ground_truth: The Alarm Integration Reference Point (Alarm IRP) in 3GPP TS 32.111-5 is responsible for specifying the XML definitions related to Alarm IRP notifications in conjunction with Notification Log IRP XML Definitions. These definitions are used for the Alarm IRP SOAP Solution Set and in Notification Log IRP XML Data File.

question_5437.question: What should the UE do upon receipt of the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message with the Connectivity type IE indicating "the PDN connection is considered a LIPA PDN connection"?
question_5437.ground_truth: The UE provides an indication to the upper layers that the connectivity is provided by a LIPA PDN connection.

question_5438.question: In which states does the gNB power consumption model characterize the power consumption of gNB in NR?
question_5438.ground_truth: The gNB power consumption model characterizes the power consumption of gNB in NR in four states: Full Activity, Sleep Mode 1 (SM1), Sleep Mode 2 (SM2), and Sleep Mode 3 (SM3).

question_5439.question: What is the specific message content for the SYSTEM INFORMATION TYPE 21 broadcast in the cell for this test?
question_5439.ground_truth: The SYSTEM INFORMATION TYPE 21 broadcast in the cell includes EAB Authorization Mask set to ''xxxxxxxxx1'' and EAB Subcategory set to ''00''.

question_5440.question: What is the impact of keeping a UE in connected mode for an extended duration on UE power consumption and handovers?
question_5440.ground_truth: It increases control plane signalling in RAN and CN and results in higher UE power consumption due to more extensive control plane signalling required for handovers.

question_5441.question: In what scenario should a UE include an onboarding SUCI in the 5GS mobile identity IE when initiating the initial registration for onboarding services in SNPN?
question_5441.ground_truth: A UE should include an onboarding SUCI in the 5GS mobile identity IE when it is initiating the initial registration for onboarding services in SNPN.

question_5442.question: What is a key requirement for reduced TPC frequency in the context of downlink enhancements for UMTS?
question_5442.ground_truth: All radio links used by UE during soft handover should have the same TPC frequency.

question_5443.question: What are the cons of solution #3.1 for UE PDU session charging procedure?
question_5443.ground_truth: The cons of solution #3.1 are high level signalling between NS tenant CHFs interfacing many UE CHFs, and the need for the NS tenant CCS to maintain the actual NS total volume usage.

question_5444.question: What is a function that the TrGW is required to support related to IP packets routing?

question_5445.question: What does the UpIntegrity enumeration represent in regards to a PDU session?
question_5445.ground_truth: Whether UP integrity protection is required, preferred or not needed for all the traffic on the PDU Session.

question_5446.question: When can the 5G-RG or the W-AGF send multiple DHCPv6 requests with different DHCPv6 Identity association for non-temporary addresses options?
question_5446.ground_truth: When the 5G-RG or the W-AGF acts as a DHCP relay for devices behind the 5G-RG or the W-AGF.

question_5447.question: What does the mobile station do in state MM IDLE and service state ATTEMPTING TO UPDATE when timer T3211 expires, and the location area of the current cell is the same as the stored location area?
question_5447.ground_truth: The mobile station performs the normal location updating procedure, if the location updating procedure is successful, then the request for MM connection is accepted.

question_5448.question: Which RFC defines the Diameter protocol as used for Network Access Server (NAS) AAA services?

question_5450.question: How long after physical channel establishment, in seconds, does the UE have to independently control its transmitter on each activated uplink frequency in the above passage?

question_5451.question: What should the main level of the CDR structure be changed to address key issue 1.12?
question_5451.ground_truth: Solution 1.13 suggests changing the main level of the CDR structure.

question_5452.question: What are the two key benefits of using wireless communications based on high-performance 5G systems in primary frequency control?
question_5452.ground_truth: (1) Reduced installation costs and maintenance effort due to wireless connectivity (2) Easy device connection and disconnection from the communications network, allowing for novel and swift setups

question_5453.question: What should the MCPTT client do upon expiration of Timer TFG5 in the "S6: ignoring incoming call announcements" state, as per TS 24.379?
question_5453.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should release several stored parameters related to the call and destroy the call type control state machine before entering the "S1: start-stop" state.

question_5454.question: What should the IMS-ALG do if it has allocated a secondary MR for a media line in the outgoing SDP offer and the media line includes OMR related attributes that are not allowed to be sent to the outgoing IP realm?
question_5454.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG should delete all OMR related attributes from the modified SDP offer before forwarding it.

question_5456.question: What is used to protect all communication between the USIM-RN, after the secure channel is established?
question_5456.ground_truth: The Secure Channel protects all communication between the USIM-RN, after the secure channel is established.

question_5457.question: What happens in step 4-5 when releasing bearer context initiated by the gNB-CU-UP?
question_5457.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP sends a BEARER CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST message to request the release of the bearer context in the gNB-CU-UP. This message may contain the PDCP status. If the PDCP status needs to be preserved, the E1 Bearer Context Modification and the F1 UE Context Modification procedures are performed, and then the gNB-CU-CP sends a BEARER CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND message to release the bearer context in the gNB-CU-UP. The F1 UE context release procedure may be performed to release the UE context in the gNB-DU.

question_5458.question: How many steps are there in the flow for releasing the NG-RAN connection with the UE and what are they?
question_5458.ground_truth: There are three steps in releasing the NG-RAN connection with the UE if the (R)AN connection is not already released. The first option is for the (R)AN to request the UE to release the (R)AN connection and delete the UE's context after receiving confirmation from the UE. The second option is for the (R)AN to locally release the RRC connection if the Cause in the N2 UE Context Release Command indicates that the UE has already locally released the connection.

question_5459.question: What is the primary requirement for the standalone non-public networks to operate in licensed-exempt spectrum?
question_5459.ground_truth: The primary requirement is that the network can guarantee the necessary Quality of Service (QoS) levels, which is not feasible in licensed-exempt spectrum due to coexistence problems.

question_5462.question: What is the role of the UE home address and HO indication in the Attach Request when adding a 3GPP access for the PDN connection?
question_5462.ground_truth: The UE sends the routing rule and UE home address (and/or HO indication) in the Attach Request when adding a 3GPP access for the PDN connection.

question_5463.question: What is the role of the NSCE server in the MnS discovery support solution?
question_5463.ground_truth: The NSCE server is responsible for translating the expected exposure capability type into MnS exposure requirement, coordinating with the 5GS to discover related network services, and sending the service/management data to the VAL server.

question_5464.question: What is the effect of omitting the "dnns" attribute in an entry of the "candidates" map?
question_5464.ground_truth: When the "dnns" attribute is omitted, the AMF will invoke a procedure for any UE request that matches the S-NSSAI value in the "snssai" attribute.

question_5465.question: What is the purpose of the RNSAP Common Transport Channel Resources Initialisation Request message?
question_5465.ground_truth: The RNSAP Common Transport Channel Resources Initialisation Request message is used to initialize the UE context in the target RNC when the SRNS Enhanced Relocation procedure is completed. The message includes the D-RNTI, cell identity, and a request for transport layer address and binding identity.

question_5467.question: What is the primary function of the channel emulator in the RTS test method?
question_5467.ground_truth: The channel emulator sends downlink signals to the probe antennas and implements the specified channel models.

question_5468.question: What is the rate of the encoder for the DBC-450 code with a swap value of 0 and without puncturing?
question_5468.ground_truth: 1/450 (the encoder is a rate 1/450 encoder, which implies a specific encoder structure and a specific number of input bits)

question_5469.question: Which conformance requirement is specified for the MS with a TCH/F allocated in 26.12.1.1?
question_5469.ground_truth: The MS with a TCH/F allocated shall acknowledge a CHANNEL MODE MODIFY message by sending a CHANNEL MODE MODIFY ACKNOWLEDGE message specifying the new mode and switching to this mode when this one is set to speech full rate or half rate version 1, speech full rate or half rate version 2, or any other mode declared supported by the mobile.

question_5471.question: What is the impact of DSRC V2V aggressor transmissions on LTE V2V victim transmissions for Case 4, V2V adjacent channel co-existence, in terms of average PRR loss at 60 kph and a target ACIR of 30 dB?
question_5471.ground_truth: The average PRR loss is less than 5% for vehicular velocities of 60 kph and a target ACIR of 30 dB.

question_5472.question: How many transport channel parameters are specified in 6.10.3.4.1.35?
question_5472.ground_truth: Six (6) transport channel parameters are specified in 6.10.3.4.1.35.

question_5473.question: What is the purpose of the MBS session update procedure for MC group communication?
question_5473.ground_truth: The procedure is used to modify the current service requirements and/or the service area of the ongoing MBS session, or further media and session related information for both broadcast and multicast sessions.

question_5474.question: What is the purpose of defining XML terms and abbreviations in the 3GPP Technical Specifications for telecommunication management?
question_5474.ground_truth: The purpose of defining XML terms and abbreviations in the 3GPP Technical Specifications for telecommunication management is to ensure a common understanding and consistent usage of these terms throughout the document, thus facilitating communication and collaboration among stakeholders involved in the development, deployment, and management of 3GPP networks.

question_5476.question: What is a possible approach to the ticket design and what are some considerations that may influence its statefulness?
question_5476.ground_truth: A possible approach to the ticket design is to make it generic and transport it using a signalling plane solution for ticket transport. This yields the simplest and most general systems solution. However, different options in the ticket design and selected features may influence the statefulness of the KMS. It is also important to consider the security of the ticket and ensure that it remains protected during transport.

question_5477.question: How many different LADNs can be included in a single 5GS registration area?
question_5477.ground_truth: A single 5GS registration area can contain a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 8 different LADNs, with each LADN consisting of a DNN, an S-NSSAI, and a 5GS tracking area identity list.

question_5478.question: What is the role of the OCS and PCRF in the Diameter protocol over the Sy interface?
question_5478.ground_truth: The OCS acts as a Diameter server, and the PCRF acts as the Diameter client.

question_5479.question: What is the purpose of the UE Context Release Request procedure as initiated by the gNB-DU?
question_5479.ground_truth: The UE Context Release Request procedure is used by the gNB-DU to request the gNB-CU to release the UE-associated logical F1-connection or candidate cells in conditional handover or conditional PSCell addition or conditional PSCell change or LTM or subsequent CPAC, using UE-associated signaling.

question_5480.question: What is the effect of timer T3182 expiration on the mobile station's behavior in the unacknowledged mode of RLC data transmission?
question_5480.ground_truth: If timer T3182 expires, the mobile station shall release the TBF as if a PACKET UPLINK ACK/NACK message was received, indicating the end of the TBF.

question_5482.question: What is the test scenario for the test cases 6.5A.3.2.x and 6.5A.3.3.x?
question_5482.ground_truth: The test scenarios for the test cases are in co-existence with protected bands in terms of transmitter spurious emissions.

question_5484.question: What is the difference between PS-PS session continuity and PS-CS continuity in the context of multimedia sessions?
question_5484.ground_truth: PS-CS continuity deals with a multimedia session with media on both the CS (Circuit-Switched) domain and the PS domain being transferred to an access network supporting only packet-switched communications or vice versa.

question_5485.question: What should the MUSIM UE do if it supports the NAS signalling connection release?
question_5485.ground_truth: The MUSIM UE should set the NAS signalling connection release bit to "NAS signalling connection release supported" in the UE network capability IE of the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message. If the network supports the NAS signalling connection release and the MUSIM UE requests the network to release the NAS signalling connection, the UE should set Request type to "NAS signalling con" in the message.

question_5486.question: What is the requirement for the Mobile Station in relation to the timer T3212 when the first MM message is received in the case of MM-connection establishment and ciphering mode is not set?
question_5486.ground_truth: The Mobile Station shall stop and reset the timer T3212 of the periodic location updating procedure when the first MM message is received.

question_5487.question: What does the PDR precedence value in DL PDR represent?
question_5487.ground_truth: The PDR precedence value in DL PDR represents the precedence value of the PCC rule associated with the QoS Flow.

question_5489.question: What message does the LMF send to request activation and deactivation of UL-SRS transmission of the target UE in the Positioning Activation/Deactivation Procedure?
question_5489.ground_truth: NRPPa Positioning Activation Request message and NRPPa Positioning Deactivation message.

question_5490.question: How many independent laboratories were involved in testing the fixed-point EVS codec?
question_5490.ground_truth: The tests were conducted in independent (non-codec proponent) laboratories to guarantee a transparent process.

question_5491.question: How does EEC discover EAS in step 4?
question_5491.ground_truth: EEC sends an EAS discovery request to EES (OP-B) over EDGE-1 reference point and includes the endpoint of EES (OP-A) in the request, which is transferred transparently between the ECS (OP-B) and the EES (OP-B).

question_5492.question: What is included in the Registration Accept message sent from the New AMF to the UE?
question_5492.ground_truth: The Registration Accept message sent from the New AMF to the UE includes a list of parameters such as 5G-GUTI, Registration Area, Mobility restrictions, PDU Session status, Allowed NSSAI, Rejected S-NSSAIs, Pending NSSAI, Periodic Registration Update timer, Active Time, LADN Information, and others.

question_5493.question: Which resource represents the UE's Location Information for UE's identity and is modeled with the Document resource archetype?

question_5494.question: What is the purpose of the location-based group creation request?
question_5494.ground_truth: The location-based group creation request is sent from the group management client or VAL server to the group management server to create a group based on a specific location.

question_5495.question: What standard defines the procedures for user plane location (UPL) in OMA?
question_5495.ground_truth: OMA AD SUPL: "Secure User Plane Location Architecture" and OMA TS UPL: "User Plane Location Protocol"

question_5496.question: What should the MCVideo client display if a SIP MESSAGE request for emergency notification is received with an `<alert-ind>` element set to "true" and contains the required information in the MIME body?
question_5496.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should display an indication of the MCVideo emergency alert and associated information, including the MCVideo group identity, originator of the MCVideo emergency alert, and mission critical organization of the MCVideo emergency alert originator.

question_5497.question: What is the purpose of the permit/deny communication use case in the FRMCS System?
question_5497.ground_truth: The purpose of the permit/deny communication use case in the FRMCS System is to allow the network operator to control and regulate communications in order to avoid disruption/distraction to the users and prevent unauthorized communication and minimize network load.

question_5498.question: What is the function of the serving AMF in the 5GC MO-LR procedure?
question_5498.ground_truth: The serving AMF is responsible for selecting an LMF in the VPLMN and transferring the MO-LR request to the LMF in the 5GC MO-LR procedure.

question_5499.question: What is the function of the "Segmentation Bit" in the Segmentation Information encoding?
question_5499.ground_truth: The "Segmentation Bit" in the Segmentation Information encoding indicates whether the current segment is the final segment of a segmented message or not.

question_5500.question: What is the interface used for offline Charging Event reporting?

question_5504.question: What is the ACRR of the repeater in dB based on the gain set in the repeater A?
question_5504.ground_truth: The ACRR of the repeater is 37 dB based on the gain set in the repeater A as 90 dB.

question_5505.question: What is the goal of the test in section 8.8.3?
question_5505.ground_truth: The goal of the test in section 8.8.3 is to verify the receiver's ability to receive the test signal under static propagation conditions with a BLER not exceeding a specified limit.

question_5506.question: Which field in the "ResourceStatusResponseIEs" F1AP-PROTOCOL-IES has a CRITICALITY value of "ignore" and allows for the inclusion of the "CriticalityDiagnostics" type?

question_5507.question: What is the difference between a broadband repeater and a channelized repeater?
question_5507.ground_truth: A broadband repeater is designed to operate on any combination of ARFCNs, while a channelized repeater is designed to operate on a specified subset of ARFCNs within the operating band of the repeater, which may be determined during manufacture or programmable.

question_5509.question: In the Serving Cell Set based SRS TCI State Indication MAC CE, what field indicates the identity of the Serving Cell associated with all TCI States indicated by the TCI State IDi fields?

question_5512.question: When will the MS consider a PLMN indicated by an NG-RAN cell if the MS is provisioned with a non-empty "CAG information list"?
question_5512.ground_truth: The MS will consider a PLMN indicated by an NG-RAN cell if the cell is a CAG cell with a CAG-ID for the PLMN in the "Allowed CAG list", or if the cell is not a CAG cell and there is no entry with the PLMN ID of the PLMN in the "CAG information list" or the entry does not have the "indication that the MS is only allowed to access 5GS via CAG cells".

question_5513.question: What information is maintained by the UE and SMF when a UE moves from 5GS to EPS and the PDN type is set to "non-IP"?
question_5513.ground_truth: The UE and SMF maintain information about the PDU Session type used in 5GS, i.e. information indicating that the PDN Connection with "non-IP" PDN type corresponds to PDU Session type Ethernet or Unstructured respectively.

question_5514.question: What are the two types of LPC inverse quantization in the MDCT based TCX coder for LVXX mode?
question_5514.ground_truth: The two types of LPC inverse quantization in the MDCT based TCX coder are the low-rate LPC for 6.4 kbps and 9.6 kbps; and the mid-rate LPC for bitrates from 13.2 kbps to 32 kbps, which relies on smoothed LPC spectral envelope.

question_5516.question: What message does the DRNC send when it has no MBMS context for a specific MBMS service?
question_5516.ground_truth: The DRNC sends a RNSAP Information Exchange Initiation Request message to the SRNC to request the IP Multicast address and APN for the service.

question_5517.question: What is the role of the NRF in PCF discovery and selection in the AMF?
question_5517.ground_truth: The NRF in the AMF is used by the AMF to discover candidate PCF instance(s) and based on operator policies, it selects a PCF instance, or two in the roaming case, to be used for AM policy association and UE policy association.

question_5518.question: What is the purpose of the FD-FDD intra frequency absolute RSRQ measurement accuracy test in 9.2.42.1.1?
question_5518.ground_truth: To verify the FD-FDD intra frequency absolute RSRQ measurement accuracy is within the specified limit for all bands.

question_5519.question: What are the three user privacy considerations in an AIPN?
question_5519.ground_truth: The three user privacy considerations in an AIPN are user location privacy, communication confidentiality, and non-disclosure of identity.

question_5520.question: What action does the SMS-SC take if the SMS Delivery from SMS-SC for Device Triggering is unsuccessful?
question_5520.ground_truth: If the SMS Delivery from SMS-SC for Device Triggering is unsuccessful, the SMS-SC triggers a Debit Units Request (Refund Account) message to the OCS to receive a Debit Units Response (Refund Account) message.

question_5521.question: Which type of protocol is compatible with the OMA Device Management protocol specifications and is used for the MTSI network preference MO?
question_5521.ground_truth: The MO is compatible with OMA Device Management protocol specifications, version 1.2 and upwards.

question_5526.question: Which interface is used for the CSC-1 reference point that exists between the identity management client and the identity management server?
question_5526.ground_truth: The MB2-U interface, as defined in 3GPP~TS~23.468, is used for the CSC-1 reference point.

question_5528.question: To which types of NR UE release 16 and forward does the test case applicability specified in 6.3A.4.2.2.2 apply?
question_5528.ground_truth: NR UE release 16 and forward with FR2 3UL CA support

question_5529.question: What mechanism is used to provide dedicated (re)location information for a collection of UEs within the same dynamic group or associated with the same service information?
question_5529.ground_truth: The UE sends a request to the Core network for the specific application with dedicated relocation information, targeting a collection of UEs.

question_5532.question: What is the criticality level of "id-Registration-Request" in this protocol?
question_5532.ground_truth: The criticality level of "id-Registration-Request" is "CRITICALITY reject".

question_5534.question: What should the floor control interface do when it receives a queued floor request from the associated floor participant in the 'U: not permitted and Floor Idle' state?
question_5534.ground_truth: It should remove the queued floor request from the queue and remain in the same state.

question_5535.question: What is the format of the CauseLevel-SyncAdjustmntFailureTDD choice?
question_5535.ground_truth: The CauseLevel-SyncAdjustmntFailureTDD choice consists of the GeneralCauseList-SyncAdjustmntFailureTDD and CellSpecificCauseList-SyncAdjustmntFailureTDD choices.

question_5536.question: What is the requirement for the transmitter power turn-off timing as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 section 5.3.11?
question_5536.ground_truth: The transmitter power shall be turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 counter as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 section 5.3.11.

question_5538.question: What is the significance of the third digit in the version numbering system used by the 3GPP Technical Specification (TSG)?
question_5538.ground_truth: The third digit is incremented when only editorial changes have been incorporated in the document, indicating that the technical content remains unchanged.

question_5539.question: What is the requirement for the average measured total radiated power (TRP) of low, mid and high channel for handheld UE defined in section 6.2.1.1.1.2.1.3?
question_5539.ground_truth: The average measured total radiated power (TRP) of low, mid and high channel for handheld UE shall be higher than the average TRP requirement specified in subclauses 6.2.1.1 and 6.2.1.2. The averaging shall be done in linear scale for the TRP results of both right and left side of the phantom head in case of beside the head and hand phantom positions. For the hand phantom browsing mode position the averaging shall be done in linear scale for the TRP results of both right and left hand phantom measurements.

question_5540.question: What is the procedure used to register the MS in the network, with which the network informs the MS about the MS's additional SoLSA capability?
question_5540.ground_truth: The procedure is called "LOCATION UPDATING REQUEST" and it is used to register the MS in the network. The network informs the MS about the MS's additional SoLSA capability by sending a CLASSMARK CHANGE message as soon as possible during a normal location update procedure.

question_5541.question: What should the BSS do when it receives a DELETE-BSS-PFC PDU for a PS Handover procedure that is ongoing?
question_5541.ground_truth: If a DELETE-BSS-PFC PDU is received for an MS for which the PS Handover Required procedure is ongoing, the BSS shall initiate the PS Handover Cancel procedure and continue the Delete BSS PFC procedure for the corresponding MS.

question_5542.question: What is the purpose of the new MSC-PCL Information Element?
question_5542.ground_truth: The new MSC-PCL Information Element is defined to transport Codec information to the BSS and replace the existing information coded within Channel Type IE octets 5, 5a, 5b. It is a prioritized list of all Codecs offered to BSS for channel assignment.

question_5543.question: What is the procedure for MCVideo CO session establishment/modification?
question_5543.ground_truth: The procedure for MCVideo CO session establishment/modification includes initial conditions as specified in the test case, the use of E-UTRA default system information messages, and specific message contents as specified in clause 5.5 and in the test case.

question_5544.question: What is the mandatory requirement in the 3GPP technical specification indicated by the term "shall" in the context of normative provisions?
question_5544.ground_truth: Shall indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

question_5546.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 43.1.1.5?
question_5546.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the correct response of the mobile station to an invalid negative acknowledgement.

question_5547.question: What should the system do if the SIP INVITE request contains an imminent peril indication and the in-progress imminent peril state of the group is true?
question_5547.ground_truth: If the SIP INVITE request contains an imminent peril indication and the in-progress imminent peril state of the group is true, the system should validate that the SIP INVITE request includes a Resource-Priority header field populated with the values for an MCVideo imminent peril group call, perform the actions specified in clause 6.3.3.1.8 if not, send the UPDATE request generated in clause 6.3.3.1.8 towards the initiator of the SIP INVITE request, and proceed with the rest of the steps if a 200(OK) response is received.

question_5548.question: For the use case of haptic feedback for a personal exclusion zone in dangerous remote environments, what is required beforehand for multi-modal UEs with sensor, haptic, and audio/visual capabilities to be interconnected?
question_5548.ground_truth: Beforehand, a 5G network needs to be provided by the MNO, both locally and remotely, and service data flows for multi-modal information delivered over one common session to different UEs need to be provided by the MNO.

question_5550.question: What actions are taken by the gprsSSF when it receives a Release GPRS information flow for the PDP Context in the GSM SCF to gprsSSF information flows?
question_5550.ground_truth: The gprsSSF removes the 'Waiting-for-AC' markers for the PDP Context.

question_5553.question: What is an LRF in the context of emergency session requests in IMS networks?
question_5553.ground_truth: LRF stands for Location Retrieval Function, which is responsible for querying a national database to determine the proper PSAP (Public Safety Answering Point) destination for emergency sessions.

question_5554.question: In the solution set based on CORBA, what specification defines the interoperability protocol?
question_5554.ground_truth: The General Inter-ORB Protocol (GIOP) defines the interoperability protocol in the solution set based on CORBA.

question_5556.question: What is the condition for the UE to use the radio parameters provided for V2X communications over PC5 reference point when it is not served by E-UTRA or NR?
question_5556.ground_truth: The UE can use the radio parameters to perform V2X communications over PC5 reference point when "not served by E-UTRA" and "not served by NR" only if it can reliably locate itself in the corresponding Geographical Area.

question_5557.question: When can the SMF delete the QoS flow in the 5G Core network?
question_5557.ground_truth: The SMF may delete the QoS flow if the Accounting Answer is not received from the DN-AAA server within a certain time frame.

question_5558.question: What are the conditions under which the intra-frequency cell is considered for cell re-selection in this test?
question_5558.ground_truth: The UE shall be able to identify new intra-frequency cells and perform RSRP measurements of identified intra-frequency cells without an explicit intra-frequency neighbor list containing physical layer cell identities. The UE shall not cause any interruption to the paging reception and acquisition of SI while performing measurement on serving or any neighbor cells.

question_5559.question: What should SMF do if the EAS IP/DNAI has not been determined or SMF cannot ensure the selected EAS IP/DNAI is the one stored in UDR?
question_5559.ground_truth: SMF will synchronize with UDR and receive EAS IP or DNAI for the UE collection, as defined in clause~6.16.2.2.

question_5560.question: What information does the BMC-Error-IND primitive provide to the upper layer (Transport Layer) regarding the source of the error?
question_5560.ground_truth: The BMC-Error-IND primitive provides the Error Type to the upper layer (Transport Layer) regarding the source of the error.

question_5561.question: What are the necessary procedures performed by the network when the UE moves one or more IP flows by providing a Routing Rule with access type 3GPP to update the routing rules via NAS and GTPv2 procedures?
question_5561.ground_truth: Appropriate S2a/S2b resource release/modification procedures are executed for the resources (bearers) associated with the Routing Rules that were removed from 3GPP access.

question_5562.question: In which direction(s) does the power of any spurious emission need to be below a certain limit when UTRA-TDD and/or E-UTRA TDD are co-located with a UTRA-FDD Repeater?
question_5562.ground_truth: In the down-link and up-link directions of the Repeater.

question_5564.question: Which node sends the values of the downlink counters and their corresponding downlink counter-ids in the Delete Bearer Command in this solution?
question_5564.ground_truth: At MME Initiated Dedicated Bearer Deactivation, the values of the downlink counters and their corresponding downlink counter-ids are included in the Delete Bearer Command messages from MME to SGW and from SGW to PDN GW.

question_5565.question: What is the purpose of the "extraCerts" field within the PKIMessage carrying the initialization response?
question_5565.ground_truth: The "extraCerts" field within the PKIMessage carrying the initialization response is mandatory and contains the operator root certificate (or 'full chain') and the RA/CA certificate (or certificates if separate private keys are used for signing of certificates and CMP messages). This is necessary for the RA/CA to use different private keys to sign certificates and CMP messages.

question_5567.question: What is the role of the MSC-Server in activating bi-casting for user plane bicasting during LCLS?
question_5567.ground_truth: The MSC-Server can activate bi-casting for a LCLS call by requesting the oMSC-Server or tMSC-Server controlling the BSS to provide user plane bicasting to the core network.

question_5569.question: What are the interfering cases considered for cross-link interference mitigation techniques?
question_5569.ground_truth: The interfering cases considered are: Case 1: Victim IAB-node is receiving in DL via its MT, interfering IAB-node is transmitting in UL via its MT, Case 2: Victim IAB-node is receiving in DL via its MT, interfering IAB-node is transmitting in DL via its DU, Case 3: Victim IAB-node is receiving in UL via its DU, interfering IAB-node is transmitting in UL via its MT, Case 4: Victim IAB-node is receiving in UL via its DU, interfering IAB-node is transmitting in DL via its DU.

question_5570.question: What is the purpose of the "a=bw-info" SDP attribute in the described procedure?
question_5570.ground_truth: The "a=bw-info" SDP attribute is used to indicate the available bandwidth range for rate adaptation when transcoding media streams.

question_5571.question: What is the general rule for the resolution bandwidth of the measuring equipment in relation to the measurement bandwidth?
question_5571.ground_truth: The general rule is that the resolution bandwidth should be equal to the measurement bandwidth.

question_5572.question: What is the maximum time the MS is allowed to be "ready to transmit" the HANDOVER COMPLETE message after the end of the HANDOVER COMMAND message?
question_5572.ground_truth: The MS shall be ready to transmit the HANDOVER COMPLETE message before "x" ms after the end of the HANDOVER COMMAND message, where "x" is specified in the specific message contents section.

question_5573.question: What should a UE do with a trigger type 2 SRS transmission that overlaps with PRACH in the same subframe and same serving cell?
question_5573.ground_truth: A UE should not transmit trigger type 2 SRS when it overlaps with PRACH in the same subframe and same serving cell.

question_5574.question: Who is responsible for initiating the Multicast Service Deactivation process in the BM-SC?
question_5574.ground_truth: The Multicast Service Deactivation process in the BM-SC is initiated by step 3), which involves the BM-SC Membership function receiving a Leave Indication and sending a UE Removal Request to the GGSN that originated the Leave Indication.

question_5575.question: Which method can be used to reserve an amount of money for a user?
question_5575.ground_truth: The method named 'reserveAmountReq()' can be used to reserve an amount of money for a user. It is also possible to enlarge an existing amount reservation using this method.

question_5578.question: What are the potential advantages and disadvantages of standardized versus vendor-specific UC scoring algorithms?
question_5578.ground_truth: Standardized UC scoring algorithms can lead to consistent scoring results but may have difficulty adapting to new UC scenarios, while vendor-specific UC scoring algorithms can lead to differing scoring results and potential difficulties in determining the meaning of scores.

question_5579.question: How is the index encoded if a given lattice point is in the base codebook C?
question_5579.ground_truth: If a given lattice point y is in the base codebook C, the index used to encode y is the codebook number plus the index Ik of codevector in C. The codebook number is encoded as a unary code, and the index Ik indicates the rank of y in the codebook.

question_5580.question: What message type is used to confirm the modification of the WT resources for a specific UE and is sent from WT to eNB?

question_5581.question: What is the role of the UDR in the 5G system?
question_5581.ground_truth: The UDR harmonizes the contexts for optimization between different PCF instances.

question_5582.question: What are the two architectural scenarios for AF (Access Function) in non-seamless WLAN offload, one of which is in the 3GPP operator's network and the other is in the BBF domain?
question_5582.ground_truth: Architecture scenario A: AF in 3GPP operator's network and Architecture scenario B: AF ("BBF AF") in BBF domain

question_5583.question: What is the procedure for determining the number of residual bit error events in this test?
question_5583.ground_truth: The procedure involves examining sequences of at least the minimum number of samples of consecutive bits of class Ib, and counting the number of bit errors in those sequences that are not signalled as erased.

question_5584.question: What should a UE do when it receives an initial INVITE request without an SDP offer?
question_5584.ground_truth: The UE should accept the request and include an SDP offer in the first non-failure reliable response.

question_5585.question: How does the UE create a new derived QoS rule in the reflective QoS?
question_5585.ground_truth: The UE shall create a new derived QoS rule if it does not have a derived QoS rule with the same packet filter for UL direction as the packet filter for UL direction derived from the DL user data packet, the DL user data packet belongs to a PDU session of IPv4, IPv6, or Ethernet PDU session type, and the received QFI is different from the QFI stored for the derived QoS rule.

question_5586.question: What is the requirement for frequency offsets higher than or equal to 1.8 MHz when the number of active carriers (N) increases in the described measurement?
question_5586.ground_truth: The value of the spectrum due to modulation and wideband noise must not increase by more than 10.log (N) dB.

question_5587.question: What action would the SMF initiate upon reception of PDU Session Resource Notify Transfer IE?
question_5587.ground_truth: The SMF normally initiates the appropriate release or modify procedure for the PDU session(s) or QoS flow(s) identified as not fulfilled anymore.

question_5589.question: How long is the cell reselection delay to an already detected cell for NR SA cell reselection for 2 Rx UE?
question_5589.ground_truth: The cell reselection delay to an already detected cell for NR SA cell reselection shall be less than 27 seconds.

question_5591.question: What should a CC entity of the MS in CC-state U7, "Call received", do upon receiving a RELEASE COMPLETE message with a valid cause value?

question_5593.question: What is the main difference between Alternative 1 and Alternative 2 for SMS delivery to MSISDN-less IMS UE?
question_5593.ground_truth: In Alternative 1, the IP-SM-GW is used for SMS delivery, while in Alternative 2, a specific Server for the service is used with a known MSISDN.

question_5594.question: What determines the radio priority levels to be used for Mobile-originated SMS transmission?
question_5594.ground_truth: The radio priority levels to be used for Mobile-originated SMS transmission are determined by the SGSN and delivered to the MS in the Attach Accept message.

question_5595.question: What is the challenge for determining if a TWAN supports emergency services?
question_5595.ground_truth: The challenge is to define how the UE knows whether the TWAN it is connected to supports emergency services in Phase-2.

question_5596.question: What HTTP method should be used to send new UCMF dictionary entries?
question_5596.ground_truth: An HTTP PUT or PATCH request should be used to send new UCMF dictionary entries.

question_5597.question: What should be the TPC command transmitted on the MPDCCH in sub-test 3.2?
question_5597.ground_truth: The TPC command transmitted on the MPDCCH in sub-test 3.2 is 0dB.

question_5598.question: What is the measurement result in the entering condition (A3-1) for this event, expressed in the same unit as Ms?
question_5598.ground_truth: Mn + Ofn + Ocn > Mp + Ofp + Ocp + Off + Hys

question_5600.question: What should be the test format for each test in the following clauses, as defined in clause 5?
question_5600.ground_truth: Each test has a standard format, including X~Title, X.1 Definition and applicability, X.2 Minimum Requirement, X.3 Test purpose, X.4 Method of test (X.4.1 Initial conditions, X.4.2 Procedure), and X.5 Test Requirement.

question_5601.question: What is the maximum average MSD transmission time allowed for the specified full campaign in GSM-HR codec mode for the set of channel conditions comprising a C/I of 10, 7, and 4 dB as well as the error-free case in the FoM metric?
question_5601.ground_truth: The maximum average MSD transmission time allowed for the specified full campaign in GSM-HR codec mode for the set of channel conditions comprising a C/I of 10, 7, and 4 dB as well as the error-free case in the FoM metric is 18.00 seconds.

question_5602.question: What is the definition of a plug&play in the context of the present document?
question_5602.ground_truth: In the context of the present document, plug&play refers to easy integration of hardware/software (HW/SW).

question_5603.question: Which enhancement provides power saving gains with minimized gaps between PRS/SRS/paging/reporting/synchronization?
question_5603.ground_truth: Minimizing gaps between PRS/SRS/paging/reporting/synchronization provides power saving gains.

question_5604.question: What is the use of "Correlation ID" in the delivery of SMS from SMSC-A to a IP-SM-GW at the terminating network?
question_5604.ground_truth: The Correlation ID is used for mapping incoming SMS to both the sender and receiver's identity. This points to an IP-SM-GW that can handle the forwardSMS operation by SMSC-A. This is required for storing and forwarding with SMSC-A.

question_5606.question: What is the procedure when a source gNB-CU-CP sends a HANDOVER REQUEST message to a target gNB-CU-CP in an inter-gNB-CU mobility procedure between MBS supporting nodes?
question_5606.ground_truth: The source gNB-CU-CP sends the HANDOVER REQUEST message to the target gNB-CU-CP with the last delivered MRB progress for the multicast sessions the UE has joined.

question_5607.question: What are the four layers of the WAVE ITS station reference architecture specified in IEEE 1609.0?
question_5607.ground_truth: The four layers of the WAVE ITS station reference architecture specified in IEEE 1609.0 are the Access layer, Networking and transport layer, Message layer or Facilities layer, and Applications layer.

question_5609.question: Which RAN interface does solution 4b correspond to, from a RAN interfaces point of view?
question_5609.ground_truth: Solution 4b corresponds to the legacy solution to move from idle to connected and back, from a RAN interfaces point of view.

question_5611.question: What is the role of the PGW in the IP-CAN Session Modification procedure?
question_5611.ground_truth: The PGW is responsible for instructing the UE to apply the new routing rules in the IP-CAN Session Modification procedure.

question_5612.question: What are the two types of RNTIs used for PTM transmission in 5G network?
question_5612.ground_truth: The two types of RNTIs used for PTM transmission in 5G network are G-RNTIs and G-CS-RNTIs.

question_5614.question: What is the action to be taken by the IWF if the initial processing result in clause 6.3.5.2 was that authorization of the MCPTT ID at a non-controlling MCPTT function of an MCPTT group is required?
question_5614.ground_truth: Perform the actions in clause 6.6.3.1.8.7 and do not continue with the rest of the steps specified in this clause.

question_5616.question: What should the floor participant do when the Receive RTP media message is received while in the "O: queued" state with a matching SSRC?
question_5616.ground_truth: The floor participant should request the MCPTT client to render the RTP media packets and restart timer T203 (End of RTP media).

question_5617.question: What does the "MS connection established" signal input in Sheet 3 indicate?
question_5617.ground_truth: The "MS connection established" signal input in Sheet 3 indicates that the MS has responded to paging, or sent a CM service request for anything other than a circuit-switched call, or completed the location registration procedure.

question_5618.question: What is the role of MCData server B when a user meets the criteria for the ongoing ad hoc group data session?
question_5618.ground_truth: MCData server B sends an ad hoc group data session add user notification message towards MCData server A when a user is detected to meet the ongoing ad hoc group data session criteria.

question_5619.question: What is the purpose of CBR in the context of sidelink congestion control in V2X communication?
question_5619.ground_truth: CBR is a physical measurement of the congestion present recently in the resource pool, used to manage reliability in V2X sidelink communication. When a UE finds its CR exceeds the CR-limit for the CBR range it currently measures, it must reduce its CR to not exceed the limit, helping to reduce congestion in the resource pool and improve the overall efficiency of the communication.

question_5620.question: What shall the SS transmit after setting up the RF parameters and before switching the power settings from T1 to T2?

question_5621.question: What is the requirement for the minimum conformance for EN-DC FR1 CSI-RS based beam failure detection and link recovery in DRX?
question_5621.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements for EN-DC FR1 CSI-RS based beam failure detection and link recovery in DRX are specified in clause 4.5.5.0.2 and the normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 clause A.4.5.5.4.

question_5622.question: What is the maximum allowed timing offset between the reference measurement timing and the target CSI-RS in one layer for intra-frequency measurements?
question_5622.ground_truth: The maximum allowed timing offset between the reference measurement timing and the target CSI-RS in one layer for intra-frequency measurements is CP (cyclic prefix).

question_5623.question: What is the role of a SL Positioning Server UE in Solution #32 for positioning a Target UE by multiple Reference UEs?
question_5623.ground_truth: A SL Positioning Server UE is responsible for result calculation when the target UE is out of coverage or when there is no UE in coverage. The control signalling is exchanged between the Target UE and LMF, and between Reference UEs and the LMF, for providing measurement data and computing services.

question_5625.question: What type of measurement is "Maximum Power" a reference to in the context of 5G Network Architecture?
question_5625.ground_truth: "Maximum Power" refers to the maximum power consumed during the measurement period in the context of 5G Network Architecture.

question_5627.question: Which 5G feature should be used to ensure NAS messages including small data can be sent integrity protected and ciphered?

question_5628.question: In what situation may the AMF send back to the UE the 5GSM message which was not forwarded?
question_5628.ground_truth: If the AMF does not have a PDU session routing context for the PDU session ID and the UE, and the Request type IE of the UL NAS TRANSPORT message is not "initial request", "existing PDU session", "initial emergency request", "existing emergency PDU session", or "MA PDU request".

question_5629.question: What is the role of the User Plane Function (UPF) in the communication path between a Remote UE and a UE-to-Network Relay?
question_5629.ground_truth: The UPF is a network function that can be used as a part of the communication path between a Remote UE and a UE-to-Network Relay. It can be used in two different ways: (1) as a part of the path when the Remote UE accesses the service via a UE-to-Network Relay's UPF or (2) as a part of the path when the Remote UE accesses the service via its own UPF.

question_5630.question: What is the condition for increasing the number of successful tests?
question_5630.ground_truth: The number of successful tests is increased by one if the UE transmits the random access burst on RACH of the target GERAN Cell 2 less than 3020 ms from the beginning of time period T2.

question_5632.question: What event is triggered when the ME (Mobile Equipment) detects a change in the CSG (Closed Subset Group) or Hybrid cell selection status?
question_5632.ground_truth: The CSG Cell Selection event is triggered.

question_5633.question: What is the first step for the MCVideo client when receiving a PRIVATE REMOTE VIDEO PUSH REQUEST message?
question_5633.ground_truth: The MCVideo client must store "PRIVATE REMOTE VIDEO PUSH REQUEST" as the current message type and generate and store the call identifier as a random number.

question_5634.question: In the described GNSS test scenario, what should be done with the 2D position error in step 4?
question_5634.ground_truth: Compare the 2D position error against a specified value, and record one Good Result or Bad Result as appropriate.
