question_5635.question: What actions does a transmission participant take when it receives a Transmission rejected message with the acknowledgment bit set to 1?
question_5635.ground_truth: The transmission participant sends a Transmission control Ack message, provides Transmission rejected notification to the user, may display the Transmission rejected reason to the user using information in the Reject Cause field, stops timer T100 (Transmission Request), and enters the 'U: has no permission to transmit' state.

question_5636.question: What status code is returned by the UDM on success when updating the AmfNon3GppAccessRegistration resource with received information?
question_5636.ground_truth: The UDM responds with "200 OK" or "204 No Content" on success.

question_5637.question: What is the method used for upsampling and downsampling the input audio signal?
question_5637.ground_truth: The input audio signal is upsampled by a factor K, filtered by a low pass filter, and then downsampled by a factor 180. This operation is efficiently implemented using a polyphase filter implementation.

question_5639.question: What is the minimum time required for a UE to complete search preparation (including RF tuning) in an LTE network for a synchronous system?
question_5639.ground_truth: For a synchronized system, if the UE can complete search preparation (including RF tuning) less than 0.5ms or within the first 5 OFDM symbols (normal CP) or first 4 OFDM symbols (extended CP) in the PSS/SSS subframe, a search window or measurement gap as short as 1ms may be feasible.

question_5641.question: What should the UE do if it is in EMM-CONNECTED mode and changes the radio capability for E-UTRAN or for NG-RAN?
question_5641.ground_truth: The UE may locally release the established NAS signalling connection and enter the EMM-IDLE mode. Then, the UE shall initiate the combined tracking area updating procedure including a UE radio capability information update needed IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

question_5642.question: What should the NF producer include in the notification request if it does not perform reselection?
question_5642.ground_truth: The NF producer should include the 3gpp-Sbi-Discovery-notification-type header, the 3gpp-Sbi-Discovery-n1-msg-class or 3gpp-Sbi-Discovery-n2-info-class header, and the 3gpp-Sbi-Routing-Binding header for the default notification based on the Binding Indication value in the NF profile of the NF Service Consumer if available.

question_5643.question: In the provided list, what does "LLC" likely stand for?

question_5644.question: What is the main advantage of using a certificate-based solution for key management in the secure channel method?
question_5644.ground_truth: A certificate-based solution seems to require relatively little extra effort, and it does not add considerable complexity to the EPS architecture as a pre-shared-key-based solution using GBA would do.

question_5645.question: Which carriers are verified during the PDSCH performance test for NR in Clause 9.2B.1.3?
question_5645.ground_truth: During the PDSCH performance test for NR in Clause 9.2B.1.3, only the PDSCH performance on the NR cell(s) on FR2 carriers shall be verified.

question_5646.question: What situations do GSM PLMN connection types apply to?
question_5646.ground_truth: GSM PLMN connection types apply to the following situations: (i) between two GSM PLMN user access points, (ii) between a PLMN user access point and a network-to-network interface, (iii) between a PLMN user access point and an interface to a specialized resource within the GSM PLMN, and (iv) between a PLMN user access point and an interface to a specialized resource outside the GSM PLMN.

question_5647.question: What are the two different types of midambles that can be included in a burst for the physical channel?
question_5647.ground_truth: A short one of length 256 chips, or a long one of 512 chips.

question_5648.question: What is the pattern used for notifications in a Web Service?
question_5648.ground_truth: The message pattern for notifications in a Web Service is a peer-to-peer or producer-consumer relationship, instead of a requestor-provider relationship.

question_5649.question: In which transmission modes are the reported CQI values calculated conditioned on the reported RI?

question_5650.question: What is the difference between the second and third digit in the version number of 3GPP documents?
question_5650.ground_truth: The second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, i.e. technical enhancements, corrections, updates, etc. while the third digit is incremented when editorial only changes have been incorporated in the document.

question_5651.question: In the 3GPP Technical Specification, what does the abbreviation MBS stand for and what does it refer to?
question_5651.ground_truth: In the 3GPP Technical Specification, MBS stands for Multicast/Broadcast Service. It refers to a point-to-multipoint service in which data is transmitted from a single source entity to multiple recipients, either to all users in a Broadcast service area, or to users in a multicast group.

question_5654.question: When will the UE delete the old set of security associations and related keys it may have with the P-CSCF?
question_5654.ground_truth: The UE should delete the old set of security associations and related keys after all SIP transactions that use the old set of security associations are completed, or when the first request or response protected with the newly established set of security associations is received from the P-CSCF.

question_5655.question: What is the minimum requirement for the RE power control dynamic range for UTRA FDD and UTRA TDD 1,28 Mcps option operation?
question_5655.ground_truth: There is no RE Power control dynamic range requirement for UTRA FDD or UTRA TDD 1,28 Mcps option operation.

question_5656.question: When is it necessary to repeat tests with and without the duplexer fitted?
question_5656.ground_truth: Sufficient tests should be repeated with and without the duplexer fitted if it is supplied as an option by the manufacturer, to verify that the BS meets the requirements of the present document in both cases.

question_5657.question: What is the abbreviation for Equivalent Isotropic Radiated Power?

question_5658.question: Which type of connection is maintained by IP connections for MTC services, and where is it maintained?
question_5658.ground_truth: IP connections for MTC services are maintained between the MTC device and the server, supported by the network access hardware or specialized hardware in the network or mobile device.

question_5660.question: What should the UE include in the Request-URI when sending a REGISTER request?
question_5660.ground_truth: The UE should include the SIP URI of the domain name of the home network in the Request-URI.

question_5663.question: What bands may experience interference when LTE Advanced Carrier Aggregation of Band 1 and Band 28 with uplink in one E-UTRA band is performed?
question_5663.ground_truth: The 3rd harmonics of BS transmitting in Bands 28 may fall into the BS receive band of Bands 30 and 40, while the 3rd IMD products supporting CA of Band 1 and Band 28 may fall into the BS receive band of Bands 5, 6, 12, 13, 14, 17, 18, 19, 20, 22, 26, 27, 28, 42, 43 and 44.

question_5665.question: What is the PEAQ-ODG deviation threshold required to establish compliance in modes other than the AMR-WB operation with DTX enabled?
question_5665.ground_truth: The PEAQ-ODG deviation threshold for compliance in the other modes is not greater than -0.2.

question_5666.question: What is the significance of the GPI length field in a GPL message?
question_5666.ground_truth: The GPI length field in a GPL message indicates the length of the GPI message in number of octets.

question_5667.question: What should be the RTSP response message sent by the PSS Adapter when no session matches the received RTSP message?
question_5667.ground_truth: When no session matches the received RTSP message, the PSS Adapter should respond with a RTSP error code 454 (Session Not Found).

question_5668.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects?
question_5668.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects is responsible for the development and maintenance of technical specifications and reports related to 3GPP services and systems.

question_5669.question: What does the LCGi field in a Long BSR format indicate?
question_5669.ground_truth: The LCGi field set to "1" indicates that the Buffer Size field for the logical channel group i is reported. The LCGi field set to "0" indicates that the Buffer Size field for the logical channel group i is not reported.

question_5670.question: What should the Mobile Station do after the expiry of T3213 and the completion of the cell reselection procedure if channel requests are not answered by the network during the RR connection establishment phase of a location updating procedure?
question_5670.ground_truth: After the expiry of T3213 and the completion of the cell reselection procedure, the Mobile Station shall perform a normal location updating procedure as it is still necessary and not repeat the complete procedure if the original cause of the location updating procedure has disappeared.

question_5672.question: What is the maximum absolute measurement error when the angular step size is equal to the HPBW?
question_5672.ground_truth: The maximum absolute measurement error can be as large as 3 dB when the angular step size is equal to the HPBW.

question_5673.question: What is the purpose of 3GPP TS 24.010, 24.080, and 24.007/008 in relation to the 3GPP system?
question_5673.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 24.010 outlines the general aspects of supplementary services at the layer 3 radio interface; 3GPP TS 24.080 specifies the formats and coding for the supplementary services; 3GPP TS 24.007 and 24.008 define the procedures for Call Control, Mobility Management, and Radio Resource management.

question_5674.question: What is the method of testing the MS's behavior if the network rejects the location updating with the cause "Location Area not allowed"?
question_5674.ground_truth: The testing involves the use of two cells belonging to different location areas, with the MS initially "idle updated" on cell A. The SS rejects a normal location updating with the cause value "Location Area not allowed" and the SS checks that the MS behaves as specified in the conformance requirements.

question_5675.question: What is the role of filtering in network slice management capabilities exposure?
question_5675.ground_truth: Filtering is an important function for network slice management capabilities exposure governance. It provides the ability to provision segregated yet tailored permissions to authorized MnS consumers, ensuring that these permissions do not conflict or get used by unauthorized MnS consumers.

question_5676.question: What is the role of the Mobility Management Entity (MME) in the 3GPP system?
question_5676.ground_truth: The Mobility Management Entity (MME) is a key component in the 3GPP system, responsible for managing the mobility of user equipment (UE) and handling the signaling related to the user's connection to the network. The MME is also responsible for authenticating and authorizing the user, and managing the bearer setup and release.

question_5677.question: What is the purpose of the Trusted WLAN Interworking Function (TWIF) as specified in clause 4.2.8.5.3?
question_5677.ground_truth: The functionality of TWIF is to specify the interworking between trusted WLAN and Evolved Packet System (EPS) networks.

question_5678.question: What should the SMF do to provide access network information to the PCF if the NetLoc feature is supported and the SMF receives a request for user location information?
question_5678.ground_truth: The SMF should provide the user location information within the "userLocationInfo" attribute and the time when it was last known within "userLocationInfoTime" attribute, if available.

question_5679.question: What is stored in the temporary buffer in the TCX10 frame case, in the IGF processing?
question_5679.ground_truth: The decoded sideinfo for the individual sub-frames is stored in the temporary buffer, so that the sideinfo for the current sub-frame under IGF processing can be accessed via the temporary buffer.

question_5681.question: When would the UE initiate the tracking area updating procedure while in S1 mode and use the current EPS NAS integrity key to integrity protect the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message?
question_5681.ground_truth: When initiating a tracking area updating procedure while in S1 mode, the UE shall use the current EPS NAS integrity key to integrity protect the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message, unless the UE is performing inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode.

question_5682.question: What is the purpose of the eLCS (enhanced location services) in the 5G System?
question_5682.ground_truth: The eLCS in the 5G System provides enhanced location services and brings new security issues such as authorization and privacy protection.

question_5684.question: What is the time span for a UE to detect, measure, and evaluate neighbour cells before the serving cell stops serving the area?
question_5684.ground_truth: The time span for a UE to detect, measure, and evaluate neighbour cells before the serving cell stops serving the area is less than Ttrigger.

question_5686.question: What should be the value of the "time resource assignment field" and the "resource ID indication field" when setting up N resources for a PSCCH transmission in sidelink resource allocation mode 2?
question_5686.ground_truth: The values of the "time resource assignment field" and the "resource ID indication field" should indicate N resources from a set of resources selected by higher layers, with N being the smallest slot indices of the selected resources.

question_5687.question: What kind of impulse response measurement was used for the headphone compensation filter generation process?
question_5687.ground_truth: A custom MATLAB script for the acquisition of acoustic impulse responses was used to measure the two Sennheiser HD 800TM headphone drivers with the internal microphones of a Neumann KU100 HATS.

question_5688.question: Which INTEGER value in the GPS-Transmission-TOW range (0..604799) represents the year 2000?

question_5689.question: What are the compatibility problems reconsidered in section 11.6.3?
question_5689.ground_truth: Compatibility problems reconsidered in section 11.6.3 include coexistence with current frequency planning, multiplexing loss with legacy EGPRS in uplink, no need for hardware change in BTS as turbo decoding can be implemented by software upgrade, applicability of DTM, applicability for the A/Gb mode interface, and impact to the mobile station.

question_5691.question: In what circumstances should the MS operate in the extended page mode?
question_5691.ground_truth: The MS should operate in the extended page mode when this is ordered by the network in a PAGING REQUEST TYPE 1, 2, or 3 message or in an IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT or IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT EXTENDED message.

question_5692.question: What is one method used to notify mobile stations in group receive or group transmit mode of group calls with priority level equal or higher than an operator specific setting?
question_5692.ground_truth: Periodical notification is sent on FACCH to all ongoing voice broadcast and group calls in the cell, except on the FACCH of the group call which has initiated this periodical notification.

question_5693.question: What type of command is used in the context of providing local information in the sequence 1.4, 1.5, and 1.6?
question_5693.ground_truth: The type of command used in the context of providing local information in the sequence 1.4, 1.5, and 1.6 is PROVIDE LOCAL INFORMATION.

question_5694.question: What is the channel status reported in the ENVELOPE (EVENT DOWNLOAD - Data available) message?
question_5694.ground_truth: The channel status reported is Channel 1 open and link established.

question_5695.question: What should the UE do if it has received all segments of SIB12?
question_5695.ground_truth: The UE should assemble SIB12-IEs from the received segments and perform CBR measurement and synchronization for NR sidelink communication/discovery transmission.

question_5696.question: What is the role of the Transient information refinement block in the transient detection algorithm?
question_5696.ground_truth: The Transient information refinement block performs an additional verification to prevent transient determination errors. It checks whether the current frame, which has been determined as a transient frame, is truly a transient frame by calculating the ratio of the average of the short-term energy in the region H to the average of the short-term energy in the region L.

question_5697.question: What happens when the SGSN receives a (non-combined) RA update from an MS for which an association exists?
question_5697.ground_truth: The SGSN removes the association without notifying the MSC/VLR.

question_5698.question: What are the two UE reachability procedures necessary for any service related entity that would need to be notified by the reachability of the UE?
question_5698.ground_truth: The two UE reachability procedures are UE Reachability Notification Request procedure and UE Activity Notification procedure.

question_5699.question: What type of information is contained in the CTSAGCH and CTSPCH messages?
question_5699.ground_truth: The CTSAGCH message directs the CTS-MS to a channel on which the RR connection can be continued, while the CTSPCH contains 23 octets of information, forming the following possible messages: a message used for the paging procedure or alive check procedure in the GSM-CTS system.

question_5703.question: What is the purpose of the GUTI reallocation procedure in the EMM-REGISTERED state?
question_5703.ground_truth: The purpose of the GUTI reallocation procedure is to allocate a GUTI and optionally to provide a new TAI list to a particular UE.

question_5704.question: What should the MME/S4-SGSN do when it receives a PGW Downlink Triggering Notification message, and what message does it send back to the PGW?
question_5704.ground_truth: If the MME/S4-SGSN can find UE context corresponding to the IMSI, it shall perform S-TMSI/P-TMSI paging as per step 3 and sends PGW Downlink Triggering Notification Acknowledge message back to the SGW with an acceptance cause code. Otherwise, it sends a PGW Downlink Triggering Notification Acknowledge message only with rejection cause code, e.g. Context Not Found, to the SGW.

question_5705.question: What procedure is used by the TSCTSF to activate or modify the 5G access stratum time distribution for UEs in the indicated PTP (Precision Time Protocol) instance?
question_5705.ground_truth: The TSCTSF uses the procedure in clause~5.5.11.4, steps 5-9, to activate or modify the 5G access stratum time distribution.

question_5706.question: What are the left over issues from Rel-16 NR V2X that need to be further studied and specified into related RF requirements in this TR?
question_5706.ground_truth: The left over issues from Rel-16 NR V2X that need to be further studied and specified into related RF requirements in this TR include TxD for NR V2X, PC2 HPUE for NR V2X, Intra-band V2X operation for TDD band (e.g. band n79), and Intra-band con-current V2X operation for TDD band (e.g. band n79).

question_5707.question: What is the meaning of "shall" and "shall not" in the present document?
question_5707.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, while "shall not" indicates an interdiction (prohibition) to do something. These constructions are used only in the context of normative provisions.

question_5708.question: What is the process of MCPTT user log on and getting the user profile?
question_5708.ground_truth: The MCPTT user logs on using a username and password, or other credentials. After successful log on, the user gets a public user identity and a security token that can be used for various applications. Then, the MCPTT user gets the user profile on the associated UE from Group Management and/or MCPTT user database by using the public user identity.

question_5710.question: What represents functions grouped around the anchor point for handovers between 3GPP and non-3GPP access systems in the context of mobility protocols and mechanisms?
question_5710.ground_truth: The SAE Anchor represents these functions in the context of mobility protocols and mechanisms.

question_5712.question: What should the UE do if it fails to transmit the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message or SECURITY MODE REJECT message during the security mode control procedure triggered by a tracking area updating procedure in the 5G system?
question_5712.ground_truth: The UE should abort the security mode control procedure and re-initiate the tracking area updating procedure.

question_5713.question: What algorithms should UEs and eNBs implement for RRC signalling integrity protection?
question_5713.ground_truth: UEs and eNBs should implement 128-EIA1 and 128-EIA2 for RRC signalling integrity protection.

question_5716.question: What are the two models for ProSe Direct Discovery?
question_5716.ground_truth: Model A ("I am here") and Model B ("who is there?" / "are you there?")

question_5717.question: What is the meaning of the term "GERAN" as used in the 3GPP technical specifications?
question_5717.ground_truth: GERAN stands for GSM EDGE Radio Access Network. It refers to the radio access network of the GSM and EDGE-based 3GPP system.

question_5718.question: What is the interaction between the PINMF and PCF for sending Relay Assistance Info, which contains PINE-related information, e.g. transferred IPv6 address of PINE, transferred IPv4 address, and IP port range of PINE?
question_5718.ground_truth: The interaction between the PINMF and PCF may be via NEF.

question_5719.question: What is the purpose of the "PDSCH PRB Usage per cell for MIMO" measurement in 5G?
question_5719.ground_truth: The "PDSCH PRB Usage per cell for MIMO" measurement in 5G provides the total usage (in percentage) of physical resource blocks (PRBs) per cell for MIMO with time domain averaged maximum scheduled layer number as spatial factor in the downlink.

question_5720.question: What is the SCTP Destination Port number value assigned by IANA to be used for NGAP?

question_5721.question: What is the maximum RRC procedure delay, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.331 clause 11.2?
question_5721.ground_truth: The maximum RRC procedure delay, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.331 clause 11.2, is 15 ms.

question_5724.question: What is the main modification introduced in the new channel solution for FET ACK indication?
question_5724.ground_truth: The main modification is to transmit TPC bits every alternate slots and use the freed TPC fields every alternate slot for ACK signaling.

question_5725.question: What does the new S4 SGSN indicate in the Context Request message if it has authenticated the UE?

question_5726.question: What is the role of the input function in the originator-to-dispatcher information in a voice group call?
question_5726.ground_truth: The input function is responsible for ensuring that the originator-to-dispatcher information has a correct format, including its length.

question_5730.question: Which release of E-UTRA UE TDD does the test apply to, when supporting Intra-band contiguous CA, Inter-band CA or Intra-band non-contiguous CA with FGI bit 111?
question_5730.ground_truth: The test applies to all types of E-UTRA UE TDD release 10 and forward.

question_5732.question: What action does the MME/SGSN take when it does not support the Additional-MSISDN feature and receives a request to use it?
question_5732.ground_truth: The MME/SGSN will use the MSISDN from the MSISDN AVP as C-MSISDN when it does not support the Additional-MSISDN feature.

question_5734.question: What message does the SRNC send to the SAS when it is unable to continue positioning activity due to cell reselection, loss of contact with the UE, or any other reason?
question_5734.ground_truth: The PCAP Abort message is sent to the SAS on the Iupc interface.

question_5735.question: How does the Multicall supplementary service interact with the Call Waiting supplementary service in 3GPP technical specifications?
question_5735.ground_truth: If the maximum number of bearers (Nbr) has been reached and the user has the Call Waiting supplementary service active, the user will be informed of an additional terminating call attempt.

question_5736.question: Which functionality does WLCP provide for managing PDN connectivity over a Trusted WLAN Access Network?
question_5736.ground_truth: WLCP provides session management functionality, including establishment of PDN connections, bearers, and handover; IP address assignment; and request/notification for PDN connection release.

question_5739.question: What is the communication model used for 3GPP telecommunication services that support the DSO in the described use case?
question_5739.ground_truth: The communication model used for 3GPP telecommunication services that support the DSO in the described use case is a 5GLAN service.

question_5741.question: What information is provided in the "Information attribute definitions" section?
question_5741.ground_truth: This section defines the semantics of attributes used in IOCs.

question_5743.question: What is a DNS Inspector in the context of this solution?
question_5743.ground_truth: A DNS Inspector is a new function that receives and stores the original DNS Request from UL CL/BP UPF, modifies source and destination IP addresses, and modifies the source and destination IP addresses of the L-DNS responded DNS Response if the EAS IP address is included and sends the DNS Response to UL CL/BP UPF.

question_5744.question: When do the single-band requirements apply for the spectrum emission mask for a multi-band BS?
question_5744.ground_truth: The single-band requirements apply for the spectrum emission mask for a multi-band BS when multiple bands are mapped on separate antenna connectors.

question_5746.question: What characters, when preceded by an element in ABNF, indicate the element's repetition?
question_5746.ground_truth: The star character ("*") preceding an element in ABNF indicates the element's repetition.

question_5747.question: Which service is not impacted by IUT in section 4.8.4 to 4.8.13?
question_5747.ground_truth: Terminating Identification Presentation, Terminating Identification Restriction, Communication Diversion, and Communication Hold are not impacted by IUT.

question_5749.question: What does the MSB of each attribute byte indicate in the context of SAT Interpreter?
question_5749.ground_truth: The MSB of each attribute byte indicates if another attribute byte follows or not.

question_5750.question: When does the LIPF request for storing LI state records?
question_5750.ground_truth: The LIPF requests for storing LI state records when the parent SMF stores session state for the relevant PDU session in the UDSF and when the parent SMF sends session state for the relevant PDU session to another SMF.

question_5751.question: What happens in the fourth scenario when the user's credit balance is not sufficient during reservation control?
question_5751.ground_truth: The corresponding reservation cannot be made (Reservation Control is skipped).

question_5752.question: What policy management aspect does the S9a interface focus on in the 3GPP-BBF interworking?
question_5752.ground_truth: The policy management aspects of the 3GPP-BBF interworking.

question_5753.question: What is the procedure for user-to-clients binding in the soft recovery procedure?
question_5753.ground_truth: The user-to-clients binding in the soft recovery procedure involves the restarted PCRF being informed of the network entities related to the to-be-rebuilt Diameter sessions and the relevant Diameter session bindings. This can be accomplished through the exchange of identities with recovery/rebuild messages or other alternatives.

question_5754.question: What information does the AMF include in the SM Request message to SMF in step 2 when sending a Multi-Access parameter?
question_5754.ground_truth: The AMF includes a Multi-Access parameter to indicate to SMF that the UE is connected both to 3GPP access and to non-3GPP access, along with a MA-PDU Capability flag to indicate that the UE and the AMF can both support MA-PDU session procedures.

question_5755.question: What adjustment does the AMF need to make when there is a Handover resulting in an ongoing positioning procedure in EPS?
question_5755.ground_truth: The AMF needs to indicate the MME to preform the Location Procedure in EPS and return the result via the N26 interface.

question_5756.question: Which frequency range is being extended for NR operation in the work item 11.19.2?
question_5756.ground_truth: The frequency range being extended for NR operation in the work item 11.19.2 is up to 71 GHz with the introduction of new unlicensed band n263.

question_5758.question: In what scenarios should a UE indicate to the user available SNPNs?
question_5758.ground_truth: The UE should indicate to the user available SNPNs if an SNPN is available and broadcasts the indication that access using credentials from a credentials holder is supported.

question_5759.question: Which limit for spurious emissions shall not be exceeded for BS operating in Band n48 in certain regions?
question_5759.ground_truth: The power of any spurious emission shall not exceed: -32 dBm/MHz for BS operating in Band n48, in the frequency range from 10 MHz below the lowest frequency of the BS downlink operating band up to 10 MHz above the highest frequency of the BS downlink operating band.

question_5760.question: What is the definition of "5GC" in the context of the present document?
question_5760.ground_truth: "5GC" stands for "5G Core," which refers to the core network of the 5G system that provides data connectivity and services using techniques such as Network Function Virtualization and Software Defined Networking.

question_5761.question: What is the definition of the interruption time Tinterrupt in this test case?
question_5761.ground_truth: Tinterrupt is defined as the time between the end of the last TTI containing the RRC command on the old PDSCH and the moment the UE has transmitted all repetitions of PRACH in the target cell, excluding the RRC procedure delay.

question_5762.question: What is the con of Solution 1 for PGW failure without restart?
question_5762.ground_truth: The con of Solution 1 for PGW failure without restart is the possibility of RAN overload, caused by the MME/S4-SGSN performing cleanup of external resources, including at eNodeB/RNC and UE.

question_5763.question: What is the purpose of validating the H(e)NB platform in the HV system?
question_5763.ground_truth: The purpose of validating the H(e)NB platform is to ensure the integrity and security of the hardware and software components before device authentication. This process involves secure start-up, integrity checking, and authentication procedures.

question_5765.question: What are the initial conditions specified in 27.22.7.2.2.4.1 required for the test method?
question_5765.ground_truth: The ME should be connected to the USIM Simulator and USS. Additionally, the ME should be powered on and perform the PROFILE DOWNLOAD procedure after being booted up.

question_5766.question: What is the relative cost of uplink transmission compared to downlink transmission, as assumed in the analysis in section 7.2.1.6.2?
question_5766.ground_truth: The relative cost of uplink transmission is 2.375 times that of downlink transmission.

question_5767.question: What is the device identity of the source when a proactive command is sent to deactivate timer with the identifier 4?

question_5769.question: What is the definition of receiver exclusion band?
question_5769.ground_truth: Receiver exclusion band is the band of frequencies over which no tests of radiated immunity of a receiver are made. It is expressed relative to the base station receive band.

question_5770.question: What is the procedure initiated by the GANC for the transfer of a NAS message to the MS after the establishment of the GA-RRC connection for the domain?
question_5770.ground_truth: The GANC includes the "CN Domain Identity" and the contents of the NAS message in the IE "L3 Message" when initiating the downlink direct transfer procedure.

question_5771.question: What are the twocast types for SLPP signaling?
question_5771.ground_truth: The two cast types for SLPP signaling are unicast and groupcast.

question_5774.question: What should be the minimum time that an RTP packet should be kept available for retransmission in the sender's buffer?
question_5774.ground_truth: The minimum time the sender should keep an original RTP packet in its buffers available for retransmission, i.e. "rtx-time" value, should be RTT.

question_5775.question: What measures does R-UE take to ensure the integrity and authenticity of the groupcast message?
question_5775.ground_truth: R-UE verifies the message by checking the MAC of the received message using the groupcast key, and decrypts the encrypted SLPP payload using the groupcast key.

question_5777.question: What is the role of the AMF in initiating the 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure?
question_5777.ground_truth: The AMF initiates the 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure by sending an AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message to the UE and starting the timer T3560. The AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains the parameters necessary to calculate the authentication response.

question_5778.question: What should the sender do to ensure that the total number of different instances sent across various messages does not exceed the maximum number of instances limit at the node level?
question_5778.ground_truth: The sender must manage the identifier for each scope separately and ensure that the number of different instances sent in various messages does not exceed the maximum number of instances limit at the node level.

question_5780.question: What is the definition of front-to-back ratio in an antenna?
question_5780.ground_truth: Front-to-back ratio is the ratio of maximum directivity of an antenna to its directivity in a specified rearward direction.

question_5781.question: Which function in the NF consumers is used to discover and select an SMSF instance for managing SMS?
question_5781.ground_truth: The SMSF selection function in NF consumers is used to discover and select an SMSF instance for managing SMS.

question_5787.question: In Solution #24, what is the priority order for considering PLMNs in the list of "PLMNs to be used while in Disaster condition"?
question_5787.ground_truth: In Solution #24, the forbidden PLMNs shall be considered in the same order in which they are present in the "List of PLMNs to be used while in Disaster condition."

question_5788.question: What is the difference between on-network and off-network video push in the MCVideo service?
question_5788.ground_truth: On-network video push is supported between MCVideo clients, or between a MCVideo client and a MCVideo server, while off-network MCVideo push is supported between MCVideo clients only.

question_5789.question: What should be used instead of APN-Aggregate-Max-Bitrate-UL/DL AVPs when establishing an S9 session and the V-PCRF supports the Extended-BW-NR feature?

question_5790.question: What is the purpose of the MCPTT-2 reference point between MCPTT server and MCPTT user database?
question_5790.ground_truth: To provide MCPTT server with information about a specific user

question_5792.question: What is the requirement for the Contact header field in the initial registration after step 3 in 12.12.1?
question_5792.ground_truth: The UE shall perform an initial registration after step 3.

question_5794.question: What is the method for defining Redundant Steering Mode (RSM) in the normative phase?
question_5794.ground_truth: RSM shall be defined in the normative phase, supporting features such as the PCF deciding SDFs for RSM application, duplication criteria, and basic operating methods including UE/UPF handling in primary and secondary access for RSM operating modes.

question_5795.question: What measure should be taken by an NF to handle N1 and/or N2 requests with an indication that the request has been temporarily rejected due to handover procedure in progress?
question_5795.ground_truth: The NF should hold any signalling messages targeted towards AMF for a given UE during the handover preparation phase and re-attempt when the handover is completed or has failed using message reception or at expiry of the guard timer.

question_5796.question: What information must the Serving GW include in the Create Session Response in the case of Control Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation?
question_5796.ground_truth: If Control Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation applies and the MME does not include Control Plane Only PDN Connection Indicator in the Create Session Request, the Serving GW must include specific IP addresses and TEIDs in the Create Session Response, depending on whether separation of S11-U from S1-U is required or not.

question_5798.question: What is the mode of operation for FLO when used on a given DBPSCH?
question_5798.ground_truth: FLO used on a given DBPSCH operates in such a way that it does not use the same RTI value at the same time for two separate RLC/MAC control messages.

question_5799.question: When is an emergency call attempt made using access technology specific procedures?
question_5799.ground_truth: When the CS domain is selected and the UE is capable of performing an emergency call setup using appropriate access technology specific procedures.

question_5800.question: What should the UE do when receiving 5GMM cause #81 or #82 from a network?
question_5800.ground_truth: The UE aborts the registration procedure, sets the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED, resets the registration attempt counter, and may use the provided information in a consecutive registration attempt.

question_5801.question: Which type of group call can be established by the MCPTT User within a pre-established session?
question_5801.ground_truth: A Chat Group Call can be established by the MCPTT User within a pre-established session.

question_5804.question: What should the IWF including in the Contact header field of an outgoing SIP INVITE request for an MCPTT session?
question_5804.ground_truth: The IWF should include an MCPTT session identity for the MCPTT session with the g.3gpp.mcptt media feature tag, the isfocus media feature tag and the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag with the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt".

question_5805.question: What is the net SACCH/T FER limit before signal failure in this test, as noted in the first note?
question_5805.ground_truth: The net SACCH/T FER limit before signal failure is approximately 67%.

question_5806.question: What is one of the capabilities that IMS should support for continuous service experience when adding or deleting media components across different UEs?
question_5806.ground_truth: The capability for an IMS user to control media components of a session between different UEs.

question_5807.question: What is the procedure for charging the invocation of service APIs?
question_5807.ground_truth: The procedure for charging the invocation of service APIs involves the AEF triggering an API invocation charging request towards the CAPIF core function upon invocation of service API(s) from one or more API invokers. The charging request includes API invoker information and service API information. The CAPIF core function performs a charging procedure, which includes storing the information for access by authorized API management. The AEF receives the API invocation charging response from the CAPIF core function.

question_5808.question: What is the difference between the UL boundary and the DL boundary in a heterogeneous network?
question_5808.ground_truth: The UL boundary is the area where the received signal from the LPN is equal in path loss to the received signal from the Macro cell, while the DL boundary is the area where the downlink received power from the LPN is equal to the downlink received power from the Macro cell.

question_5809.question: How are TNS filter coefficients quantized?
question_5809.ground_truth: TNS parcor coefficients are quantized with a resolution of 4 bits, and the filter order is reduced such that the last PARCOR coefficient is non-zero.

question_5810.question: What is an essential design constraint for the device battery life in AR glasses?
question_5810.ground_truth: Minimizing the power consumption per thermal island as well as minimizing the overall power consumption is essential for the device battery life in AR glasses.

question_5811.question: What is the problem with the current UE registration process when an S-NSSAI is not available in the RA?
question_5811.ground_truth: The current UE registration process does not allow the UE to register the S-NSSAI again in any of the TAs of the RA, even if some of the TAs in the RA do support the S-NSSAI.

question_5812.question: Who stops transmitting media to MCPTT client 1 in the case of a remotely initiated ambient listening call release?

question_5813.question: Which two bands, when connected in dual uplink, can generate intermodulation products that may interfere with the own Rx of band 2 and 46?

question_5814.question: What should be the initial state of the MS in a test that involves a MS being capable of GAN Iu mode (only) and no GAN Mode Indicator IE in the GA-RC REGISTER ACCEPT message?
question_5814.ground_truth: The MS should be in state GA-RC DEREGISTERED.

question_5819.question: What is the procedure described in section 7.2.4.1.3?
question_5819.ground_truth: The Session Set-up procedure is to be performed under Ideal radio conditions as defined in clause 5.

question_5821.question: What is the target for CSI-RS-based L1-SINR measurements in the test setup?
question_5821.ground_truth: Cell 2, the NR FR1 cell (PSCell), is the target for CSI-RS-based L1-SINR measurements.

question_5822.question: When is the "downlink-Compressed-Mode-Method" field required to be present?
question_5822.ground_truth: The "downlink-Compressed-Mode-Method" field is required to be present if the UL/DL mode is set to "DL only" or "UL/DL".

question_5823.question: Which type of exception is returned if the sum of percentage allocations is invalid in a charge split volume message?
question_5823.ground_truth: A PolicyException with the code POL0271 is returned if the sum of percentage allocations is invalid in a charge split volume message.

question_5824.question: What should the UE do for L1-RSRP measurement in the PRBs that overlap with an SSB for FR1 in active BWP with different SCS than the CSI-RS for L1-RSRP measurement?
question_5824.ground_truth: The UE is required to measure one of the CSI-RS for L1-RSRP measurement and SSB, with restrictions, and no requirements are defined for longer measurement periods.

question_5825.question: What is the difference between infrequent and frequent small data in Solution #13?
question_5825.ground_truth: Infrequent small data is transmitted in NAS, while frequent small data is transferred over the user plane and the UE returns to RRC-INACTIVE/RRC-SUSPEND after transmission.

question_5827.question: How is the RAN UE NGAP ID used in NG interface?
question_5827.ground_truth: A RAN UE NGAP ID is used in NG interface to uniquely identify the UE over the NG interface within an gNB. The AMF receives the RAN UE NGAP ID from the gNB and stores it for the duration of the UE-associated logical NG-connection for that UE.

question_5828.question: What should the GANC do when it receives a GA-CSR UPLINK DIRECT TRANSFER message for the first time after GA-CSR Connection establishment?
question_5828.ground_truth: The GANC should trigger the normal A-interface procedures towards the Core network to establish a signalling connection and transfer the contents of the IE "L3 Message" to the CN.

question_5830.question: What should a UE meet during the transition time interval between the first state and the second state?
question_5830.ground_truth: After the transition time interval, the UE shall meet the requirement corresponding to the second state.

question_5831.question: What did the ME need to do in 27.22.4.20.2.3?
question_5831.ground_truth: The ME needed to close a session with the additional card identified in the GET CARD READER STATUS proactive SIM command and return the result in the TERMINAL RESPONSE command sent to the SIM.

question_5832.question: Which reference points are used by the CSC-7 application plane reference point when the group management servers are connected by multiple SIP cores?
question_5832.ground_truth: The CSC-7 application plane reference point makes use of the SIP-2 and SIP-3 reference points when the group management servers are connected by multiple SIP cores.

question_5834.question: What should the AF do if it wants to request access network information in the session termination request?
question_5834.ground_truth: The AF can request access network information within the STR by adding a Required-Access-Info AVP.

question_5835.question: What are the two sets of Oldauout used for in the described method?
question_5835.ground_truth: The two sets of Oldauout are saved at the phase matching for erased frame block and the phase matching for burst erasures block. The 1st Oldauout is generated from a copied signal by a phase matching process, and the 2nd Oldauout is generated by the time domain signal resulting from the IMDCT.

question_5836.question: What must be determined in order to implicitly affiliate a user to an MCPTT group based on the triggers in clause 9.1?
question_5836.ground_truth: The IWF must determine the served MCPTT client ID, the MCPTT group ID to affiliate, the served MCPTT ID, and construct a candidate list of the MCPTT group information entries.

question_5837.question: What is the purpose of the OTA REFSENS RoAoA in the OTA sensitivity requirement?
question_5837.ground_truth: The OTA REFSENS RoAoA is the declared range of angle of arrival of signal and is used to calculate a minimum antenna gain and hence a minimum sensitivity for the OTA sensitivity requirement.

question_5838.question: What is the role of the SECAM Accreditation Body in the evaluation of network products?
question_5838.ground_truth: The SECAM Accreditation Body is responsible for accrediting security-relevant parts of the vendor network product development and network product lifecycle management processes, as well as test laboratories, in order to ensure trustworthiness and credibility of the evaluation results.

question_5840.question: Under what circumstances does the TSN AF divide the TSN stream into multiple streams?
question_5840.ground_truth: The TSN AF divides the TSN stream into one uplink stream and one or more downlink streams if it determines that the TSN stream is for UE-UE communication and the ingress and egress ports are in DS-TTs.

question_5842.question: What is the expected message content for step 6 in the eCall over IMS test procedure?
question_5842.ground_truth: The expected message content for step 6 is specified in annex C.47, which is referring to A.2.1 default message content of INVITE with condition A20 or A21.

question_5843.question: What function is responsible for initiating de-registration procedures in the S-CSCF and PCSCF?

question_5845.question: What are the minimum performance requirements for a JBM in MTSI client terminals?
question_5845.ground_truth: The minimum performance requirements for a JBM in MTSI client terminals include objective criteria for delay, jitter-induced concealment operations, and jitter buffering time management. The JBM must meet these criteria for all supported channels to pass the performance requirements.

question_5846.question: What is the disadvantage of Alternative 1 for indicating to another UE that it is requested to become a controller of the collaborative session using SIP REFER with method= REFER?
question_5846.ground_truth: The disadvantage is that it is based on special semantics for REFER.

question_5847.question: What must the manufacturer declare for each supported E-UTRA channel bandwidth in standalone NB-IoT operating mode?
question_5847.ground_truth: The manufacturer must declare if the base station supports NB-IoT in-band and/or guard band operation and the number of supported NB-IoT PRBs for each supported E-UTRA channel bandwidth in standalone NB-IoT operating mode.

question_5849.question: What action shall the S-CSCF take if it received a display name from the HSS for a public user identity?
question_5849.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall populate the P-Associated-URI header field entry for that public identity with the associated display name.

question_5850.question: What indicates the requirement to communicate Cell or TAI to the PDN GW with this EPS bearer Context and is temporary data stored in MME and S4-SGSN?

question_5853.question: What is the purpose of a 5G LAN-type service providing a mechanism to identify an authorized UE?
question_5853.ground_truth: This is to ensure that only authorized devices can access the 5G PVN and company files and databases.

question_5854.question: How does the SMF enforce QoS enforcement in 5G networks?
question_5854.ground_truth: The SMF controls the QoS that is provided to a combined set of service data flows. The policy enforcement function ensures that the resources which can be used by an authorized set of service data flows are within the "authorized resources" specified by the PCF. The authorized QoS provides an upper bound on the resources that can be reserved (GFBR) or allocated (MFBR) for the QoS Flow.

question_5855.question: What is the action taken by the MS when it receives a GA-RRC DOWNLINK DIRECT TRANSFER message and is not in the GA-RRC-CONNECTED state for the indicated domain?
question_5855.ground_truth: The MS ignores the message, sets the "GA-RRC Cause" to "Message type not compatible with protocol state", and includes the received message contents in the "IE PDU in Error".

question_5857.question: In what format should the HLR send the registration parameter "forwarded-to number" when passing CFNRy information to a VLR that supports CAMEL?
question_5857.ground_truth: The HLR should send the registration parameter "forwarded-to number" in international format.

question_5858.question: What media feature tags must the MCVideo client include in the Contact header field of the SIP INVITE request?
question_5858.ground_truth: The g.3gpp.mcvideo and g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tags, with specific header field parameters.

question_5860.question: What carriers are selected for the downlink multi carrier TBF with frequency hopping enabled?
question_5860.ground_truth: The carriers are selected using the DLMC Bandwidth, CA in SI1, and system information 13. The carriers that are selected is determined in each radio block period by the carrier selection method which is independent on the number of PDCHs assigned to any given carrier.

question_5861.question: In which type of operation is the continuous timing advance update procedure and the PTCCH not used?
question_5861.ground_truth: In EC operation, the continuous timing advance update procedure and the PTCCH are not used. Instead, the EC-PACCH can be used by the network to send timing advance information.

question_5862.question: What action does the NGCN site take when it requires privacy for the calling party identity?
question_5862.ground_truth: The NGCN site includes a Privacy:id header field in the request to the NGN and the calling party puts an anonymous SIP URI into the From header field.

question_5863.question: What is the action taken by the source Cell after the PDCP Count is transferred to the target Cell in the NR-DC inter-cell PSCell change sequence?
question_5863.ground_truth: The source Cell releases SRB3 (if necessary) and DRBs after the successful PSCell change.

question_5865.question: What are the two main methods of energy saving envisioned in ITU-T recommendations for fixed network fiber access that could be applied to wireless networks?
question_5865.ground_truth: The two main methods are dynamic link rate adaptation to fit the actual traffic load and shutdown of parallel resources when parallel resources are used.

question_5866.question: What is the total SDU size for repair packets?
question_5866.ground_truth: The total SDU size for repair packets is 498 bytes if one PDU is used per SDU, and 996 bytes if two PDUs are used per SDU.

question_5869.question: What does PCEF functionality encompass in the evolved 3GPP system architecture?
question_5869.ground_truth: PCEF functionality encompasses service data flow detection, policy enforcement and flow based charging functionalities in the evolved 3GPP system architecture.

question_5870.question: How can an active CFU be deactivated?
question_5870.ground_truth: An active CFU can be deactivated in two ways: (1) by the user through an appropriate control procedure, and (2) as a result of Erasure, either by the user or administratively.

question_5871.question: What message does the UE send to the network when a user requests an emergency call establishment?
question_5871.ground_truth: The UE sends a CM SERVICE REQUEST message to the network with a CM service type information element indicating emergency call establishment.

question_5873.question: Which two network entities are involved in the exchange and analysis of desired service requirements for the FF application when not using TSN in the 5GS?
question_5873.ground_truth: The FAE client and the FAE server (acting as an AS)

question_5874.question: In the described "GPRS attach / rejected" test, what is the expected behavior of the Mobile Station (MS) if the network rejects the GPRS attach procedure with the cause 'Illegal MS'?
question_5874.ground_truth: If the network rejects the GPRS attach procedure with the cause 'Illegal MS', the MS shall consider the SIM invalid for GPRS services, delete the stored RAI, GPRS-CKSN, P-TMSI, and P-TMSI signature, and delete the LAI.

question_5877.question: How many successive time periods are there in the cell re-selection delay test procedure for UTRA FDD UE that support E-UTRA FDD?
question_5877.ground_truth: There are three successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2, and T3.

question_5878.question: What is the purpose of Radio Network Controller in a UTRAN network?
question_5878.ground_truth: The Radio Network Controller controls the use and integrity of radio resources in a UTRAN network.

question_5879.question: What can cause high signalling load within the network in the scenario where a massive number of users attempt to initiate mobile terminating services simultaneously for specific users?
question_5879.ground_truth: The HLR/HSS can get overloaded due to a massive number of queries for profile/routing information, which are required to process the service request.

question_5880.question: What is the minimum uplink bit rate for conversational speech in release 6?

question_5881.question: How is the M5 request URL formed for Service Access Information in the Media Session Handler?
question_5881.ground_truth: The M5 request URL for Service Access Information is formed based on the information supplied in the 5GMS Service URL.

question_5882.question: What is the purpose of the read command in the +CGDCONT command?
question_5882.ground_truth: The read command returns the current settings for each defined context.

question_5883.question: What actions are performed in Step 6 that are common to cases A, B, and C?
question_5883.ground_truth: Downlink TBF establishment, PDP Context Activation, and PDP Context Deactivation are performed.

question_5884.question: What is the purpose of the "reqExpTime" property in the MSGin5G Registration Request schema?
question_5884.ground_truth: The "reqExpTime" property in the MSGin5G Registration Request schema represents the allowed maximum processing time in seconds.

question_5885.question: What is the purpose of AuC/HSS in the context of 3GPP TS 33.102 and 3GPP TS 33.401?
question_5885.ground_truth: AuC and HSS are secure 3GPP elements that securely store information used for authentication and create authentication vectors used for 3GPP authentication. They store K, OP, and TOP as specified by the home network operator.

question_5886.question: Which study concluded the feasibility of supporting advanced V2X services using technical solutions on NR?
question_5886.ground_truth: The feasibility of supporting advanced V2X services using technical solutions on NR was concluded in TR 38.885.

question_5887.question: What two protocols can be used over the Wd reference point?
question_5887.ground_truth: RADIUS or Diameter based protocols can be used over the Wd reference point.

question_5888.question: What feature does the enterprise want to have with the 5G PVN regarding UE access?
question_5888.ground_truth: The enterprise wants to enable or disable a UE from accessing the 5G PVN, allowing only specified equipment to have access and blocking access from non-company equipment.

question_5889.question: What is the role of the Controllee UE in a Collaborative Session?
question_5889.ground_truth: The Controllee UE can initiate the modification or release of a media flow that terminates on it. It can also accept or refuse media additions and modifications initiated by the remote party or the Controller UE.

question_5890.question: What is the change in the uplink timing in this test procedure for the first transmission timing offset in the repetition period (R>1) for NPUSCH if it's not the first transmission in the repetition period?
question_5890.ground_truth: If it's not the first transmission timing offset in the repetition period, the SS verifies that the UE transmit timing offset doesn't change.

question_5892.question: What are the functional entities that the MCPTT application service is composed of in the on-network architectural model?
question_5892.ground_truth: The MCPTT application service is composed of an MCPTT server, floor control server, and a media distribution function in the on-network architectural model.

question_5894.question: What is the role of the S13-interface in the Evolved Packet Core?
question_5894.ground_truth: The S13-interface is used between MME and EIR to exchange data, in order that the EIR can verify the status of the IMEI retrieved from the Mobile Station.

question_5895.question: What are the characteristics of the MBMS Common Control Channels in 3GPP TS 44.003?
question_5895.ground_truth: The MBMS Common Control Channels in 3GPP TS 44.003 are used for packet switched operation. They include the Packet Paging channel (PPCH), Packet Random access channel (PRACH), and Packet Access grant channel (PAGCH).

question_5896.question: What type of frames are used for carrying information in a particular DLC if I-bit is set to 1 in that DLC?
question_5896.ground_truth: If I-bit is set to 1 in a particular DLC, I frames are used for carrying information in that DLC.

question_5897.question: What is the difference between an Application Layer connection-less group and an Application Layer managed group in the context of V2X services?
question_5897.ground_truth: An Application Layer connection-less group does not have group formation in the V2X application layer, while an Application Layer managed group has group formation and management in the V2X application layer.

question_5900.question: What is the recommended practice for UE co-existence issues for single UL non-simultaneous in TS 36.101?
question_5900.ground_truth: For single UL non-simultaneous UE, the 2nd and 3rd harmonic analysis for certain bands is done in the 2DL/1UL TR 36.851. For UE co-existence, the single UL is already considered in TS 36.101.

question_5901.question: What is the condition for the successful completion of the test in the 4.5.2.1.4.2 test procedure?
question_5901.ground_truth: If the UE responds on cell 2 during time duration T2 within 21 seconds from the beginning of time period T2 then the number of successful tests is increased by one. The test is considered successful if the number of successful tests is more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

question_5902.question: What action does the P-CSCF take when the state attribute within the contact subelement is set to "terminated" and the event attribute is set to "deactivated", "expired", "probation", "unregistered", or "rejected"?
question_5902.ground_truth: The P-CSCF considers the binding between the indicated public user identity and the contact address and its related information as deregistered for this user, and shall release all stored information associated with the deregistered contact address and related information associated with this contact address.

question_5903.question: What happens when the receiver's alternative address is encapsulated in the use data body?
question_5903.ground_truth: This has been commonly used in practice for encapsulating email address in use data body for email and SM exchanges at Email GW.

question_5904.question: In which frequency bands should the interfering signal be during the preliminary test, if the BTS is a GSM 700 normal BSS, BS capable of co-location with systems in other frequency bands?
question_5904.ground_truth: The interfering signal will be +22 dBm, +14 dBm, and 0 dBm for Wide Area, Medium Range, and Local Area multicarrier BTS, respectively.

question_5905.question: What procedure is initiated by the MME when all the bearers belonging to a UE are released due to a handover from 3GPP to non-3GPP?
question_5905.ground_truth: The MME initiates the deactivation of ISR and, if ISR is activated, the SGSN locally deactivates ISR as well.

question_5907.question: What is the TCAP Message type in the intermediate unprotected representation?
question_5907.ground_truth: The TCAP Message type in the intermediate unprotected representation is the same as OriginalTCAP-MessageType in the intermediate protected representation.

question_5908.question: What is the purpose of the "Discard port number '9'" in the media description?
question_5908.ground_truth: The "Discard port number '9'" is a placeholder that indicates that a media line is to be replicated. It was the convention used in older versions of Inter-UE Transfer for replicating media components, but it might not be the best choice for all cases, as pointed out by the editor's note.

question_5911.question: What is the purpose of the State Management IRP in 3G networks?
question_5911.ground_truth: The State Management IRP is defined to specify and standardize the generic attributes for modelling and managing the resources of 3G networks at the Itf-N. It is used to control the management state of various managed objects and network resources in a standardized way.

question_5912.question: What is the purpose of the frequency management in GSM-CTS?
question_5912.ground_truth: The purpose of the frequency management in GSM-CTS is to avoid the use of the same frequencies by multiple parties and prevent high interference levels.

question_5913.question: What is the method for providing keys to a new MME during idle mode mobility within one SAE/LTE network, that does not require a new run of AKA?
question_5913.ground_truth: The new MME can be provided with keys by deriving a new KASME from CK, IK with help of PLMN-ID and RAT type as input, without requiring a new run of AKA and additional state about each UE in the HSS.

question_5914.question: What is the default Test PDP context used in test cases where no particular Test PDP contexts are specified?

question_5916.question: When is the "PDU session status" IE included in the 3GPP specification?
question_5916.ground_truth: The "PDU session status" IE is included when the network needs to indicate the PDU sessions that are associated with the access type that the message is sent over, and that are active within the network.

question_5917.question: What is the maximum test time allowed for the statistical error limit tests?
question_5917.ground_truth: The maximum test time allowed for the statistical error limit tests is 6 hours 40 minutes.

question_5918.question: What is the purpose of the SMS-STATUS-REPORT TPDU that the SS sends to the MS in step 6 in the 34.4.3.4 method of test?
question_5918.ground_truth: The SMS-STATUS-REPORT TPDU is sent to the MS in step 6 in the 34.4.3.4 method of test to verify that the MS is able to accept a SMS-STATUS-REPORT TPDU.

question_5920.question: What is required of a supporting UE?
question_5920.ground_truth: A supporting UE is able to select a core network operator as the serving operator within a shared network and has the capability to handle network sharing.

question_5921.question: What is the value of CAMEL Capability Handling for MO-SMS-CSI?
question_5921.ground_truth: The CAMEL Capability Handling for MO-SMS-CSI shall have the value CAMEL phase 3.

question_5922.question: What should the UE do when it receives a new Allowed NSSAI for a PLMN over an Access Type?
question_5922.ground_truth: The UE should replace any stored (old) Allowed NSSAI for the PLMN and Access Type with the new Allowed NSSAI and store the associated mapping of the new Allowed NSSAI to HPLMN S-NSSAIs.

question_5923.question: In Use Case 7, why was ACB bypassed for Alice's UE while sending DMB, but not for Bob's UE?
question_5923.ground_truth: ACB was bypassed for Alice's UE because the network prioritized DMB for ACDC-capable UEs and to avoid treating DMB initiation in the same or lesser preference compared to video uploading from UEs without ACDC. Bob's UE did not receive the ACDC control messages, and hence ACB was not bypassed.

question_5924.question: How is the MTK generated and distributed in the solution?
question_5924.ground_truth: The MTK is generated by MBSF and distributed securely to the MBSTF and UEs through the control plane. It is different for each multicast session and consists of a Key Domain ID and a MTK ID.

question_5925.question: What is a concern regarding the implementation complexity of IR-HARQ for Polar codes?
question_5925.ground_truth: One company has concerns about the complexity of implementing IR-HARQ for Polar codes.

question_5926.question: What is the impact of a strong mismatch zone without UL-DL mismatch compensation in a heterogeneous network?
question_5926.ground_truth: The size of the strong mismatch zone could be significant, especially without UL-DL mismatch compensation. A strong mismatch zone is the area where the UE is seen by the LPN but the LPN has not yet been added to the active set of the UE.

question_5927.question: What is the purpose of the "wTInitiatedWTRelease" procedure, and what is its criticality level?
question_5927.ground_truth: The "wTInitiatedWTRelease" procedure is used to release wireless network resources, and its criticality level is "reject", which means that the failure to execute this procedure has a critical impact on the system.

question_5928.question: What should the IWF include in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body in the SIP MESSAGE request for emergency alert cancellation?
question_5928.ground_truth: The IWF should include an <alert-ind> element set to a value of "true", an <alert-ind-rcvd> element set to a value of "true", and the <mcptt-client-id> element with the MCPTT client ID that was included in the incoming SIP MESSAGE request.

question_5929.question: What is the procedure when AS acting as a terminating UA generates any 1xx or 2xx response to a request received from the originating UA?
question_5929.ground_truth: The AS shall store the value of the "term-ioi" header field parameter received in the P-Charging-Vector header field.

question_5930.question: What information elements can be present in an XML document when carrying USSD related information?
question_5930.ground_truth: USSD language, USSD string, USSD error code, Alerting pattern, and optional extension elements.

question_5932.question: What is the purpose of the present document in the context of USSD over IP Multimedia Core Network Subsystem (IMS)?
question_5932.ground_truth: The present document describes the procedures for using USSD operations for mobile initiated MMI mode over IMS and for network initiated MMI mode over IMS. It specifies the 3GPP technical specification that defines the procedures for transporting USSD messages over the IP Multimedia Core Network Subsystem (IMS) using the SIP protocol.

question_5933.question: What recommendation describes stage 2 of the method for characterisation of telecommunication services in 3GPP?
question_5933.ground_truth: ITU-T Recommendation Q.65 is the one that defines stage 2 of the method for characterisation of telecommunication services in 3GPP.

question_5934.question: What action will the UDM take when it receives a request from the NF Service Consumer to translate an External Group Identifier to an Internal Group Identifier and/or list of UE identifiers?
question_5934.ground_truth: The UDM will respond with "200 OK" and the message body containing the corresponding Internal Group Identifier and/or the list of UE identifiers belonging to the provided External Group Identifier.

question_5936.question: What is the TS 26.267 standard used for in relation to eCall?
question_5936.ground_truth: TS 26.267 provides a general description of the eCall in-band modem, along with C-code references as provided in 3GPP TS 26.268, and deals with the conformance testing for eCall modem implementations.

question_5938.question: What element is the root element of this XML schema, defining the structure of a PrivateEmergencyAlert message?
question_5938.ground_truth: The root element is PrivateEmergencyAlert, of type EmergencyAlertType.

question_5939.question: When should the UE stop timer T3585 if the PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message with Back-off timer value IE is received from the network for the same S-NSSAI?
question_5939.ground_truth: The UE shall stop timer T3585 associated with the corresponding S-NSSAI, if it is running, upon the reception of the PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message with Back-off timer value IE for the same S-NSSAI.

question_5940.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 5.6.2.6.4.2?
question_5940.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in section 5.6.2.6.4.2 is to verify the UE's ability to make correct reporting of an event in DRX within inter-frequency cell search requirements.

question_5941.question: What should the MAC entity do if the number of consecutive DTX events reaches a predefined limit for all carriers applied for HARQ-based Sidelink RLF detection?
question_5941.ground_truth: The MAC entity should indicate HARQ-based Sidelink RLF detection to RRC.

question_5942.question: What is the decision that the network makes regarding the assignment of a traffic channel during the "CC-establishment confirmed" state when establishing a network initiated mobile originating call?
question_5942.ground_truth: The assignment of a traffic channel during the "CC-establishment confirmed" state is a network dependent decision when establishing a network initiated mobile originating call.

question_5943.question: How are error rates determined in the receiver tests for circuit switched channels in 3GPP TS 05.05?
question_5943.ground_truth: The error rates are determined in the receiver tests for circuit switched channels in 3GPP TS 05.05 by defining test error rates in 3GPP TS 05.05 that are not worse than the specification by 1 dB, and performing tests at the sensitivity and interference levels defined in 3GPP TS 05.05. The error rates are defined based on the fixed sensitivity or interference level for circuit switched channels, and a 1 dB offset is used in the receive level and the interference level for packet switched channels.

question_5945.question: What measures shall the participating MCVideo function take if it receives a SIP BYE request from the controlling MCVideo function and if the MCVideo session id refers to an MCVideo user that has a pre-established session with the participating MCVideo function?
question_5945.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function shall follow the procedures as specified in clause~6.3.2.2.8.2.

question_5946.question: What should the UE do if it supports MPQUIC functionality with any steering mode and ATSSS-LL functionality with any steering mode allowed for ATSSS-LL functionality?
question_5946.ground_truth: The UE should set the ATSSS-ST bits to "MPQUIC functionality with any steering mode and ATSSS-LL functionality with any steering mode allowed for ATSSS-LL supported" in the 5GSM capability IE of the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message.

question_5949.question: What is the action taken by the MCPTT server when all the preconditions are met in clause 10.19.3.2.3?
question_5949.ground_truth: The MCPTT server determines the list of participants from the primary MC system and determines the partner MC system to be involved in the ad hoc group call based on the information present in the information element Criteria for determining the participants.

question_5950.question: What is the maximum relative velocity that the E-UTRAN can support for V2X messages in the 3GPP standard?
question_5950.ground_truth: The E-UTRAN can support a maximum relative velocity of 280 km/h.

question_5952.question: What is the focus of Key Issue #1 in unlicensed spectrum offloading system enhancements?
question_5952.ground_truth: Key Issue #1 focuses on studying the unlicensed spectrum identification to be known in core network elements and analyzing if and how the core network elements can identify the use of unlicensed spectrum and with which granularity this identification would be reported.

question_5954.question: What are the pre-conditions for the 5GMSG service when using mobile originated-mobile terminated messaging?
question_5954.ground_truth: The pre-conditions for the 5GMSG service when using mobile originated-mobile terminated messaging is the availability of a user cell phone with this capability and an IoT device attached to the user's possession with the location request function.

question_5956.question: When does the RAN send an ANBR message in the uplink assistance based on ANBR and ANBRQ messaging?
question_5956.ground_truth: The RAN sends an ANBR message whenever it finds reasonable or useful to notify the UE about a change in the recommended bitrate and when the UE queries for updated recommended bitrate.

question_5957.question: How many RadioLinkMonitoringRS can be used for radio link monitoring depending on Lmax and up to two can be used for link recovery procedures?
question_5957.ground_truth: From the NLR-RLM RadioLinkMonitoringRS, up to NLRM RadioLinkMonitoringRS can be used for radio link monitoring depending on Lmax, and up to two RadioLinkMonitoringRS can be used for link recovery procedures.

question_5958.question: What is the function of the WS-IWF in solution 2?
question_5958.ground_truth: The WS-IWF in solution 2 interfaces with the WebRTC client and provides third-party services, such as called party number transformation, call diversion, and simultaneous ringing within a call center, without handling user plane handling.

question_5959.question: Under what conditions should the radio link counter S be re-initialized and the algorithm started?
question_5959.ground_truth: The radio link counter S should be re-initialized and the algorithm started whenever the MS switches to a new channel, at the latest when the main signalling link has been established.

question_5963.question: In which mode are the tests for the UE's combination of Bluetooth transmission and EVS codec conducted?
question_5963.ground_truth: The tests for this combination are conducted in wideband mode (Clause 8) instead of super-wideband mode.

question_5964.question: What is the unit used for encoding the UL/DL MBR and GBR fields in the Flow QoS IE?
question_5964.ground_truth: The UL/DL MBR and GBR fields in the Flow QoS IE are encoded in kilobits per second (kbps).

question_5965.question: What is the purpose of the AMF including the nonce~AMF and nonce~UE when creating a mapped 5GS security context during inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode in 5GMM-IDLE mode?
question_5965.ground_truth: The nonce~AMF and nonce~UE are included to ensure secure context transition during inter-system change.

question_5966.question: What action does the S-CSCF take if the user needs to be reauthenticated?
question_5966.ground_truth: If the user needs to be reauthenticated, the S-CSCF shall proceed with the procedures as described for the unprotected initial REGISTER in subclause~5.4.1.2.1, beginning with step 3.

question_5967.question: In what mode is the HS-SCCH subframe transmitted if a DPCH associated with an HS-SCCH subframe uses open or closed loop transmit diversity on the radio link transmitted from the HS-DSCH serving cell?
question_5967.ground_truth: The HS-SCCH subframe is transmitted using STTD.

question_5969.question: Who has the responsibility for modifying the PDB signalled to the NG-RAN in the QoS Profile for the QoS Flows of the Remote UE's traffic?
question_5969.ground_truth: The SMF has the responsibility for modifying the PDB signalled to the NG-RAN in the QoS Profile for the QoS Flows of the Remote UE's traffic.

question_5970.question: What is required of a UE (MCPTT Client) upon initiating a private call in manual commencement mode towards the requesting MCPTT client, if the requesting MCPTT user wanted to make a private call call-back using the MCPTT ID of the requesting MCPTT user as found in the "PCCB target client entry" stored on the UE?
question_5970.ground_truth: Upon receiving a SIP 2xx response to the SIP INVITE request for establishment of the private call, the UE (MCPTT Client) shall set the private call call-back target client state to "PCCB-R1: no-call-back" and shall delete the "PCCB target client entry" associated with the requesting MCPTT user.

question_5971.question: What is the format of the version number used in the GIA4 specification?
question_5971.ground_truth: The version number is in the format x.y.z, where x indicates the level of TSG approval, y indicates changes of substance, and z indicates editorial changes.

question_5972.question: What is used to determine the long-term throughput between the LLC and RLC/MAC layers?
question_5972.ground_truth: The long-term throughput is determined on the basis of the amount of successfully delivered LLC data, specifically the amount of data bits in acknowledged RLC data blocks in the correct order without gaps representing LLC or higher layer data.

question_5973.question: What is the purpose of the srs-SwitchingTimesListNR in the supportedBandCombinationList?
question_5973.ground_truth: The srs-SwitchingTimesListNR is used in the supportedBandCombinationList to indicate the SRS carrier switching times for each band combination.
