question_5974.question: What is the mean capacity performance of FR1, Indoor Hotspot, DL, with 100MHz bandwidth for VR/AR single-stream traffic model, 60Mbps, with MU-MIMO, for a single video stream 30Mbps + data/audio stream 1.12Mbps?
question_5974.ground_truth: 2 UEs per cell in a range of 0 to 4 UEs per cell.

question_5975.question: What is the procedure specified in 12.12.1 for MO MTSI Voice Call Successful with preconditions at both originating UE and terminating UE?
question_5975.ground_truth: The UE shall correctly perform IMS mobile originated voice call setup and release when using IMS Multimedia Telephony with preconditions.

question_5978.question: What is the length and content of the <LHN-name> in the Local Home Network-ID FQDN?
question_5978.ground_truth: The length and content of the <LHN-name> in the Local Home Network-ID FQDN is an operator choice, following the rules specified in clause 19.4.2.1.

question_5979.question: When would the UE need to set the Multiple DRB support bit to "Multiple DRB supported" in the UE network capability IE of the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message?
question_5979.ground_truth: If the UE supports S1-U data transfer and multiple user plane radio bearers in NB-S1 mode, then the UE shall set the Multiple DRB support bit to "Multiple DRB supported" in the UE network capability IE of the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

question_5980.question: What determines the actions to be taken when a quota is reached in the solution #9?
question_5980.ground_truth: The AF determines the actions to be taken when a quota is reached in the solution #9. The AF can determine an "action" (e.g. limitation) to be applied in the 5GS upon exceeding a particular quota.

question_5981.question: What shall the MCVideo client do if it receives a SIP re-INVITE request containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the <mcvideoinfo> element containing the <mcvideo-Params> element having the <imminentperil-ind> element set to a value of "true"?
question_5981.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should display to the MCVideo user the MCVideo ID of the originator of the MCVideo imminent peril group call and an indication that this is an MCVideo imminent peril group call.

question_5982.question: What information must be sent from the source MME to the target MME/SGSN when performing X2-based handover for SRVCC?
question_5982.ground_truth: The source MME must send MS Classmark 2, MS Classmark 3, STN-SR, C-MSISDN, ICS Indicator and the Supported Codec IE to the target MME/SGSN if available.

question_5985.question: What is a session rule in 5G architecture?
question_5985.ground_truth: A session rule consists of policy information elements associated with PDU session and is dynamically provisioned by the PCF to the SMF.

question_5986.question: What is the lower end of the range of Top-1 DL Tx beam prediction accuracy achieved by AI/ML in the third evaluation scenario?
question_5986.ground_truth: The lower end of the range of Top-1 DL Tx beam prediction accuracy achieved by AI/ML in the third evaluation scenario is 55%.

question_5988.question: How is the MS test sample placed during the initial conditions for equipment with an integral antenna?
question_5988.ground_truth: The MS is placed in the anechoic shielded chamber or on the outdoor test site, on an isolated support, in the position for normal use, at a distance of at least 3 meters from a test antenna, connected to the SS.

question_5989.question: What is the purpose of Global Text Telephony ( GTT ) in 3GPP networks?
question_5989.ground_truth: Global Text Telephony in 3GPP networks enables real-time, character by character, text conversation to be included in any conversational service, and supports human input and reading in the languages users communicate in.

question_5990.question: What is the purpose of the VAS AS in the VAS SMS services provisioning?
question_5990.ground_truth: The VAS AS is the main functional entity involved in the VAS SMS services provisioning. It handles the necessary service logic for VAS SMS messages, informs the SMS Node about the outcome of its short message handling, and may receive the delivery report of the VAS4SMS messages generated by it from the SMS Node.

question_5992.question: What is the goal of cross-checking in the context of anchor reconstruction verification?
question_5992.ground_truth: The goal of cross-checking in the context of anchor reconstruction verification is to ensure that the same md5 for the anchor sequence is obtained using a verified anchor bitstream in two different implementations of a reference decoder, indicating successful reconstruction of the anchor.

question_5993.question: What is the role of the PSA UPF in measuring packet delay between NG-RAN and itself?
question_5993.ground_truth: The PSA UPF is responsible for creating and sending monitoring packets to the NG-RAN in a measurement frequency, taking the QoS monitoring reporting frequency received from the SMF into account. It encapsulates the monitoring packets in the GTP-U header with QFI and QoS Monitoring Packet (QMP) indicator, and includes local time information for calculations.

question_5994.question: What is the format of the UEContextResumeFailure message in NGAP protocol?
question_5994.ground_truth: The UEContextResumeFailure message is a sequence consisting of protocolIEs, which is a ProtocolIE-Container object.

question_5995.question: What does the expression "(n)" represent in EN-DC CA notation and how it is different from NE-DC CA notation?
question_5995.ground_truth: In EN-DC, "(n)" indicates the LTE part of the combination, while in NE-DC, "X(n)" indicates the NR part of the combination. This difference emphasizes whether the NR carriers or LTE carriers are involved in the intra-band contiguous CA.

question_5996.question: When is the Application Context synchronization accomplished in the case of EELManagedACR?
question_5996.ground_truth: The Application Context synchronization is accomplished using the same mechanism as when transferring the context from the S-EES to the T-EES in the case of EELManagedACR.

question_5997.question: Which message type is sent by the MS to the network to set-up a group call immediately with compressed originator-to-dispatcher information?

question_5998.question: What action does the MGCF take when the waiting timer expires in the autonomous release process at the MGCF?
question_5998.ground_truth: The MGCF initiates call clearing towards the succeeding SIP-I based circuit-switched network by sending an ISUP REL message included in a SIP BYE request. It also sends a final response for the SIP INVITE request towards the preceding IMS node indicating the error that happened.

question_5999.question: What should the UE do if the provided measurement gaps for RSTD measurements are insufficient?
question_5999.ground_truth: If the provided measurement gaps are insufficient, the UE is allowed to repeat the procedure to indicate start of inter-frequency RSTD measurements in the same PCell once per frequency.

question_6001.question: What is the type of data connection for the event where data connection status is successful?
question_6001.ground_truth: The type of data connection is PDN connection.

question_6002.question: What information about the mobility protocol tunnelling header does the PCRF receive from the PDN GW?
question_6002.ground_truth: The PDN GW provides the PCRF with information about the mobility protocol tunnelling header.

question_6003.question: What are the two fundamental options for the start of TLS security session establishment?
question_6003.ground_truth: The two fundamental options for the start of TLS security session establishment are (1) initiating it immediately by the TLS client side as soon as the underlying IP transport connection is successfully established, and (2) decoupling the start of TLS security session establishment from the underlying TCP connection establishment.

question_6004.question: What is the functional responsibility of the Network Exposure Function (NEF)?
question_6004.ground_truth: The NEF provides a means to securely expose the services and capabilities provided by 3GPP network functions and to receive information from other network functions.

question_6006.question: What is an issue with aligning the service sets between IMS and CS domains?
question_6006.ground_truth: The issue is that there are services in IMS which cannot be mapped to existing CS supplementary services and vice versa, so the service set in IMS has to be limited to the CS telephony supplementary service set in order to align the service sets.

question_6007.question: For AI/ML assisted positioning with timing information and clutter parameter B, what is the range of the positioning error when fine-tuning dataset size is 2.0% to 2.5% of the full training dataset size?
question_6007.ground_truth: The positioning error is (1.47-5.88) x E0,B.

question_6010.question: What is the role of the SLPBK-ID in determining whether the sending UE-1 and receiving UE-x are with the same HPLMN in the key retrieval phase?
question_6010.ground_truth: The SLPBK-ID contains UE-1's HPLMN ID, enabling the serving SLPKMF of UE-x to determine if they are with the same HPLMN by analyzing the SLPBK-ID in the key retrieval phase.

question_6011.question: What is the method used for the calculation of signal non-stationarity in the first stage of the speech/music classifier?
question_6011.ground_truth: Signal non-stationarity is calculated as the product of ratios between power spectrum and the difference spectrum in the first stage of the speech/music classifier.

question_6012.question: How can the Target UE determine its position in the in-coverage scenario?
question_6012.ground_truth: The Target UE can determine its position by performing a ranging discovery procedure with discovered Reference UEs and initiating a ranging session with a Reference UE by transmitting a Direct Connection Request. The Target UE or Reference UE can report information about the ranging session to the LMF.

question_6013.question: What is the procedure followed when the MCVideo client receives an MBS session announcement from the participating MCVideo function with a specific MIME body and mcvideo-request-uri element containing an MCVideo ID?
question_6013.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function shall send a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response.

question_6014.question: What is the polynomial used to define the u(k) intended for the coded bit c(2k) via the specific convolutional encoding used in the discussed transmission system?

question_6016.question: How is the time to first SSB transmission determined when TCI state switching involves QCL-TypeD for SSB-based L1-RSRP measurement?
question_6016.ground_truth: The time to first SSB transmission is determined as the time to first SSB transmission after the L1-RSRP measurement for QCL-TypeD, or the time to first SSB transmission after the MAC CE command is decoded by the UE for other QCL types.

question_6017.question: What is the role of the NEF in the multi-member AF session with required QoS, in terms of AI/ML-based services?
question_6017.ground_truth: The NEF in the multi-member AF session with required QoS is responsible for member UE selection assistance functionality for application operation, handling Planned Data Transfer with QoS (PDTQ) requirements, and managing Multi-member AF session with required QoS.

question_6019.question: What is the priority level order for MCData communication types in 5GS?
question_6019.ground_truth: The priority level order for MCData communication types in 5GS is as follows: MCData emergency communication > MCData imminent peril communication > other MCData communication types.

question_6022.question: Which entity determines the mapping of uplink traffic flows to the S2a bearer when a new dedicated bearer is created for the UE in the trusted WLAN access network?
question_6022.ground_truth: The TWAN uses the uplink packet filter (UL TFT) to determine the mapping of uplink traffic flows to the S2a bearer.

question_6023.question: What should the network do if it does not receive a SETUP message in the "recall-present" state before the expiry of timer T334?
question_6023.ground_truth: The network should send a RELEASE COMPLETE message to the mobile using cause #102 "recovery on timer expiry", release the MM connection, enter the "null" state and inform all appropriate entities within the network.

question_6024.question: What data type is used for an implementation specific result in integrity management?

question_6025.question: What is used for encrypting the RAND value that is sent to the UE during the AKA protocol in IMEI(SV) validation?
question_6025.ground_truth: A symmetric common secret, KME, between the UE and the 3GPP HSS.

question_6026.question: How does the 3GPP TS numbering system indicate the status of a specification document?
question_6026.ground_truth: The 3GPP TS numbering system provides information on the specification document's status in the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals (TSG CT). A document with a first digit of "1" is presented to TSG for information, while a first digit of "2" indicates a TSG approved document under change control. A first digit of "3" or higher indicates that the document has been approved as part of a specific 3GPP release.

question_6028.question: What does the UE Contention Resolution Identity field contain when included in response to an uplink CCCH transmission?
question_6028.ground_truth: If the uplink CCCH SDU is 48 bits long, the UE Contention Resolution Identity field contains the uplink CCCH SDU. If the CCCH SDU is longer than 48 bits, this field contains the first 48 bits of the uplink CCCH SDU.

question_6030.question: In the context of FDD, what should the Node B do with the DL Power Balancing Information IE and/or the Minimum Reduced E-DPDCH Gain Factor IE in the Multicell E-DCH Information IE in the Additional E-DCH FDD Setup Information IE?
question_6030.ground_truth: The Node B should use the information in the same way as on the Primary uplink frequency.

question_6031.question: What is the procedure for switching from MBMS bearer to unicast bearer in the MCVideo service?
question_6031.ground_truth: The procedure for switching from MBMS bearer to unicast bearer in the MCVideo service is specified in 3GPP TS 23.280 with the MCVideo service using the MCVideo-1, MCVideo-4, MCVideo-7, MCVideo-8 and MCVideo-9 reference points for this procedure.

question_6032.question: What is the function of the "3gpp-switch-stream" feature tag value?
question_6032.ground_truth: The "3gpp-switch-stream" feature tag value indicates support for switching media to an alternative representation of the media within an active session.

question_6033.question: What is the measurement reporting delay requirement excluding a delay uncertainty, as specified in Section 8.1.2.6.1.1?
question_6033.ground_truth: This requirement assumes that the measurement report is not delayed by other LPP signaling on the DCCH. This measurement reporting delay excludes a delay uncertainty resulted when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH. The delay uncertainty is: 2 x TTIDCCH where TTIDCCH is the duration of subframe or slot or subslot when the measurement report is transmitted on the PUSCH with subframe or slot or subslot duration. This measurement reporting delay excludes any delay caused by no UL resources for UE to send the measurement report.

question_6034.question: What is the procedure for determining the subframes and resource blocks for transmitting SCI format 1 in sidelink transmission mode 3?
question_6034.ground_truth: The subframes and resource blocks for transmitting SCI format 1 in sidelink transmission mode 3 are determined by the UE using the procedure described in Clause 14.2.1.2, where SCI format 1 is transmitted in two physical resource blocks per slot in each subframe where the corresponding PSSCH is transmitted.

question_6035.question: What is the significance of using SEAL in the 3GPP system connectivity for communicating FF application service requirements?
question_6035.ground_truth: SEAL can be used to enhance NRM server functionality and translate FF application service requirements to 3GPP network requirements.

question_6036.question: What action does the UE take after receiving a file through HTTP GET message and successfully downloading it?
question_6036.ground_truth: The UE notifies the MCDATA User that the file has successfully downloaded and generates an FD NOTIFICATION indicating the successful download of the file.

question_6037.question: Which PCF function maintains the information of 5G ProSe Layer-3 Remote UEs handled by a 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay in the 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay's SM context for the PDU Session associated with the relay?
question_6037.ground_truth: The SMF function supports receiving the 5G ProSe Layer-3 Remote UE report and retains the information of 5G ProSe Layer-3 Remote UEs handled by a 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay in the 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay's SM context for PDU Sessions associated with the relay.

question_6042.question: What are the differences between normal and enhanced N2 based handover procedures?
question_6042.ground_truth: The enhanced N2 based handover procedure reuses the existing N2 based handover with the following differences: 1) The SN mapping relation between PDCP and GTP-U is used for redundancy elimination. 2) During session modification, if the secondary tunnel is established, the UPF begins to duplicate the downlink data simultaneously and sends it to both source and target RAN nodes. An indication is included in the GTP-U header of the first duplicated packet to the source RAN to indicate the start of duplicated transmission. 3) Before the target DRBs are established, the target RAN node caches the downlink data from the UPF. As soon as the target DRBs are established, the UL and DL data transmission can take place. 4) The UL and DL data transmission is performed via target RAN node before the handover procedure is totally finished using dual radio based handover. UE performs redundancy elimination of DL data from the source and/or target RAN node using the DL PDCP SN for URLLC QoS flow. UPF performs redundancy elimination of UL data from the RAN node using the GTP-U SN for URLLC QoS flow.

question_6043.question: What is a typical application for a sensor network with high traffic demands?
question_6043.ground_truth: A typical application for a sensor network with high traffic demands is audio monitoring, where audio sensors produce a continuous data stream per device of tens of kilobits per second, depending on the audio encoding and targeted frequency range.

question_6045.question: What is the role of the LIPF in communication between the LICF and other entities?
question_6045.ground_truth: With the exception of communication with the LEA, all other communication between the LICF and any other entities shall be proxied by the LIPF.

question_6046.question: After sending a SIP MESSAGE request, what must the MCPTT client receive before indicating to the user that the request has been delivered to an MCPTT client of the target MCPTT user?
question_6046.ground_truth: A SIP 2xx response to the SIP MESSAGE request.

question_6047.question: What digital asset container does Alice access to select the list of information for the successful provision of the service?
question_6047.ground_truth: Alice accesses her digital asset container to select the list of information such as her local resident status, payment information, ID, and other associated information.

question_6049.question: What is the format of the HTTP PATCH request that the NF service consumer sends to inform the PCF about selected PDTQ policy?
question_6049.ground_truth: The NF service consumer sends an HTTP PATCH request targeting the URI of the corresponding "Individual PDTQ policy" resource and includes in the body a PdtqPolicyPatchData data type which contains the identifier of the selected PDTQ policy in the "selPdtqPolicyId" attribute.

question_6050.question: What information does the "Frequency Layer Convergence Flag" field indicate to the RNC?
question_6050.ground_truth: The "Frequency Layer Convergence Flag" field indicates to the RNC the requirement to not apply Frequency Layer Convergence for a given MBMS Bearer Service.

question_6051.question: How is a single S9a diameter session used by the PCRF/H(e)NB PF for all UEs requesting services via the same 3GPP H(e)NB device?
question_6051.ground_truth: A single S9a diameter session is used by the PCRF/H(e)NB PF for all UEs requesting services via the same 3GPP H(e)NB device. This applies to architecture alternative 1 and 2 for H(e)NB solutions.

question_6053.question: What information should be included in the request body for invoking the custom operation for N2 message transfer in the 5G system?
question_6053.ground_truth: The request body for invoking the custom operation for N2 message transfer should carry the MbsN2MessageTransferReqData data structure, which includes N2 MBS Session Management information such as MBS Session ID, Area Session ID, notification URI for failure, and notification correlation ID.

question_6054.question: What is the purpose of the Assistance Data Transfer procedure in Assisted-GNSS positioning?
question_6054.ground_truth: The Assistance Data Transfer procedure in Assisted-GNSS positioning is used to enable the LMF to provide assistance data to the UE and the UE to request assistance data from the LMF. This can include information such as GNSS satellite orbit and clock corrections.

question_6055.question: What is the test purpose for the receiver's ability to receive the test signal under slow multipath fading propagation conditions in 8.12.3 and 8.12A.3?
question_6055.ground_truth: The purpose is to verify that the receiver can receive the test signal with a throughput not below a specified limit under slow multipath fading propagation conditions.

question_6056.question: When is the Activate Secondary PDP context reject message used in the 3GPP TS 24.008 standard?
question_6056.ground_truth: The Activate Secondary PDP context reject message is used by the network to reject activation of an additional PDP context associated with the same PDP address and APN as an already active PDP context.

question_6057.question: Who is Hinkle in Once Upon a Time in Wonderland?

question_6059.question: What is the expected behavior of the UE during T4 in the HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync without DRX for UE Category NB1 in Enhanced Coverage?
question_6059.ground_truth: The UE is expected not to decode the UL grant and conduct any UL transmission during T4.

question_6061.question: What is the standard method supported by the Individual PCF for a UE Binding, as specified in section 5.3.8.3?
question_6061.ground_truth: The Individual PCF for a UE Binding supports the standard methods DELETE and PATCH, as specified in section 5.3.8.3.

question_6062.question: What type of NR UEs does the test case in clause 7.4A.1.2 apply to?
question_6062.ground_truth: All types of NR UEs release 15 and forward that support FR2 2DL CA.

question_6064.question: How does the BM-SC construct source blocks for FLUTE in the download delivery service of MBMS?
question_6064.ground_truth: The BM-SC constructs source blocks for FLUTE by breaking the file into contiguous portions of approximately equal size. Each source block is broken into source symbols, and one or more encoding symbols are carried as the payload of a FLUTE packet.

question_6065.question: What information is included in the Network Slice Selection Policies of the VPLMN specific URSP Rules?
question_6065.ground_truth: The Network Slice Selection Policies of the VPLMN specific URSP Rules contain values that are associated with the HPLMN.

question_6067.question: What is the role of the 5G ProSe Layer-2 UE-to-Network Relay in the connection between the 5G ProSe Layer-2 Remote UE and NG-RAN?
question_6067.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe Layer-2 UE-to-Network Relay relays the PDUs over the signalling radio bear without any modifications using the functionality of the adaptation layer as specified in TS~38.300.

question_6068.question: What is the purpose of adding an additional suppression of the second order intermodulation interference bands provided by the filter in the post-filter receiver?
question_6068.ground_truth: To ensure that the post-filter receiver's IIP2 value is sufficient for all examined TX power levels

question_6069.question: How many spectral coefficients are there in each band for the spectrum envelope in transient mode frames?
question_6069.ground_truth: Each band for the spectrum envelope in transient mode frames contains 34 spectral coefficients.

question_6070.question: What is the frequency range in which a TDD AAS BS operating in BC3 without synchronization shall not exceed -52 dBm/MHz in each supported downlink operating band, except for a specific frequency range?
question_6070.ground_truth: Emissions shall not exceed -52 dBm/MHz in each supported downlink operating band, except for the frequency range from 10 MHz below the lower Base Station RF Bandwidth edge to the frequency 10 MHz above the upper Base Station RF Bandwidth edge of each supported band.

question_6071.question: What physical channels does the PPCH and CPPCH use for mapping?
question_6071.ground_truth: The PPCH and CPPCH are mapped on one or several physical channels. The exact mapping on each physical channel follows a predefined rule, as it is done for the PCH.

question_6072.question: What is the purpose of the Channel Mode Modify procedure in the testing process for the reference sensitivity?
question_6072.ground_truth: The Channel Mode Modify procedure is used to change the active codec set to different bit rates (8.85 kbit/s, 12.65 kbit/s) in the testing process for the reference sensitivity. This allows for testing of the MS performance under different codec rates.

question_6073.question: What are the criteria for steering/splitting/switching the traffic towards a specific backhaul link and where is the decision taken?
question_6073.ground_truth: The criteria for steering/splitting/switching the traffic towards a specific backhaul link include the available capacities, the traffic load, and the link quality. The decision can be taken at the 5GS or at the NG-RAN based on the satisfaction of certain criteria.

question_6074.question: What message does the source I-SMF send to the source I-UPF to delete all resources allocated for indirect forwarding tunnel?
question_6074.ground_truth: Source I-SMF to Source I-UPF: N4 Session Modification Request (if Conditional 22a is true).

question_6075.question: What is used as a frequency reference point for both transmitter and receiver requirements in TDD?
question_6075.ground_truth: The upper edge of one sub-block, also called the upper sub-block edge

question_6076.question: What is the procedure for resource efficiency in RAN sharing with multiple cell-ID broadcast?
question_6076.ground_truth: In case of RAN sharing with multiple cell-ID broadcast, the gNB-DUs sharing the same physical cell resources receive and identify broadcast MBS sessions with identical content. They then resolve different QoS requirements in an implementation-specific way, establish F1-U resources towards either all involved gNB-CUs or some of them, and trigger the gNB-CU to establish F1-U resources if needed.

question_6077.question: What message should the UAE-C include in the Content-Type header field when sending an HTTP POST request for registration to the UAE-S?

question_6080.question: What message is sent by the source gNB-CU to the target gNB-DU during the process of switching the U2N Remote UE from direct to indirect path with gNB-CU change?
question_6080.ground_truth: The source gNB-CU sends the UE CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message for the U2N Remote UE to the target gNB-DU.

question_6083.question: What is the function of the Application Service Management client in the Application Service Management SEAL service?
question_6083.ground_truth: The Application Service Management client acts as a SEAL client for application service monitoring and traffic control functions in the Application Service Management SEAL service.

question_6084.question: What are the messages exchanged in the standard IMS origination procedure described in steps 1-5?
question_6084.ground_truth: The messages exchanged are CS SETUP, INVITE, SDP offer, SIP INVITE, and 200Ok.

question_6086.question: What should the TWAN do upon receiving a DEA command marked with a success code and with the MPS-Priority AVP with the MPS-EPS-Priority bit set?
question_6086.ground_truth: The TWAN shall treat the UE with priority, e.g., as defined in Annex~B, Annex~C and Annex~D.

question_6087.question: What is the role of the MCPTT server in an MCPTT emergency group call?
question_6087.ground_truth: The MCPTT server adjusts the priority of the underlying bearer for all participants in the MCPTT group and sends the MCPTT emergency group call request towards the MCPTT clients of each of those affiliated MCPTT group members.

question_6089.question: What is the size of the "Highest Successfully delivered retransmitted NR PDCP Sequence Number" field?
question_6089.ground_truth: The size of the "Highest Successfully delivered retransmitted NR PDCP Sequence Number" field is 3 octets.

question_6090.question: What is the significance of the version numbering system in this 3GPP specification?
question_6090.ground_truth: The version numbering system indicates the level of approval and the type of changes made to the document. The first digit indicates the level of TSG approval, the second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, and the third digit is incremented for editorial only changes.

question_6091.question: What are the factors that influence the performance of the VAD algorithm?
question_6091.ground_truth: The performance of the VAD algorithm is characterized by the amount of audible speech clipping it introduces and the percentage activity it indicates. These characteristics are established by extensive testing under a wide range of operating conditions, such as varying speech/noise ratios, vehicle noise, tone detectors, and frequency domain stationarity.

question_6092.question: What are the limitations on the number of downlink and uplink component carriers for carrier aggregation in CA capable UEs?
question_6092.ground_truth: For carrier aggregation, CA capable UEs can have up to four downlink component carriers intra-band contiguous and up to three downlink component carriers inter-band and one uplink component carrier, or up to three downlink component carriers intra-band contiguous and up to four downlink component carriers inter-band and one uplink component carrier, or up to four downlink and up to two uplink component carriers for inter-band carrier aggregation, or up to five downlink component carriers and up to two uplink component carriers for intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation, or up to four downlink and one uplink component carrier for inter-band carrier aggregation, or up to two downlink/uplink component carriers intra-band contiguous and one downlink/uplink inter-band carrier aggregation, or up to two downlink component carriers intra-band contiguous and up to three downlink inter-bands and up to two uplink component carriers for inter-band carrier aggregation, or up to two downlink component carriers intra-band non-contiguous and up to three downlink inter-bands and up to two uplink component carriers for inter-band carrier aggregation, or up to three downlink component carriers intra-band contiguous and one downlink intra-band non-contiguous and up to two uplink component carriers intra-band contiguous for carrier aggregation, or two sub-blocks intra-band non-contiguous with two downlink component carriers intra-band contiguous per sub-blocks and up to two uplink component carriers intra-band contiguous for carrier aggregation, or two sub-blocks intra-band non-contiguous with two downlink component carriers intra-band contiguous and three downlink component carriers intra-band contiguous per sub-block and up to two uplink component carriers intra-band contiguous for carrier aggregation, or up to two downlink and one uplink component carriers for intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation, or up to two downlink and two uplink component carriers for inter-band carrier aggregation, or up to two downlink component carriers intra-band contiguous and one downlink inter-band and one uplink component carriers for carrier aggregation, or up to two downlink component carriers intra-band non-contiguous and one downlink inter-band and one uplink component carriers for carrier aggregation, or up to two downlink component carriers and one uplink component carriers for intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation.

question_6093.question: What does the "SEAL" in the document title represent?
question_6093.ground_truth: Service Enabler Architecture Layer for Verticals

question_6094.question: What information does the Edge Enabler Server retrieve and send to the Edge Enabler Client in an Edge Application Server discovery response?
question_6094.ground_truth: The Edge Enabler Server retrieves a list of FQDN(s) along with IP address mappings of the Edge Application Servers running on the Edge Hosting Platforms in the Edge Data Network. This information is then filtered based on discovery policies or filters and sent to the Edge Enabler Client in an Edge Application Server discovery response.

question_6095.question: What is NB-IoT in-band operation?
question_6095.ground_truth: NB-IoT in-band operation refers to the use of resource blocks within a normal E-UTRA carrier for NB-IoT operations.

question_6096.question: What is the difference between Datagram mode 1 and Datagram mode 2 in the context of MPQUIC functionality?
question_6096.ground_truth: Datagram mode 2, as defined in RFC 9298, encapsulates UDP packets within QUIC Datagram frames and provides unreliable transport with no sequence numbering and no packet reordering/deduplication. In contrast, Datagram mode 1, an extension of mode 2, encapsulates UDP packets within QUIC Datagram frames and provides unreliable transport but with sequence numbering and packet reordering/deduplication. Datagram mode 1 is applicable for any UDP flow, and its details are further specified in stage-3 specifications.

question_6097.question: What is one way a PSS server can adapt the total transmission rate for RTP sessions, including retransmissions?
question_6097.ground_truth: A PSS server can skip retransmissions or use the transmission rate adaptation described in clause 10.2.2 of the present document.

question_6099.question: What is the role of the IWF in determining affiliation status for a user homed in the IWF?
question_6099.ground_truth: The IWF determines whether the affiliation status should change for a user homed in the IWF and takes actions to determine the served MCPTT ID, served MCPTT client ID, and candidate expiration interval. The IWF then sets the affiliation status of the user based on these values.

question_6100.question: What is the role of the CAPIF-1e reference point?
question_6100.ground_truth: The CAPIF-1e reference point is used for an API invoker outside the PLMN trust domain to discover service APIs, authenticate and get authorization. It supports the same functions as the CAPIF-1 reference point.

question_6101.question: What should the measResult include in the reportQuantityUTRA-FDD in decreasing order of the sorting quantity?
question_6101.ground_truth: The measResult should include the quantity(ies) indicated in the reportQuantityUTRA-FDD in decreasing order of the sorting quantity.

question_6103.question: What is the purpose of the Initial Network Connectivity Service in the provisioning and management of MCIMs?
question_6103.ground_truth: The Initial Network Connectivity Service sets up the initial network connectivity for the M2ME to access an IP network before the operational MCIMs have been downloaded and activated. This service establishes bootstrapping functions for initial network connectivity and uses pre-provisioned preliminary credentials or user-provided credentials to access a network.

question_6105.question: What is the purpose of the test requirement in 4.5.6.1.2?
question_6105.ground_truth: The purpose of the test requirement in 4.5.6.1.2 is to verify the DL BWP switch delay requirement defined in TS 38.133, and interruption requirements for NR and E-UTRA victim cells.

question_6106.question: In Solution 4.5, what is the role of the SCC AS in forwarding the SIP request to the S-CSCF with 3GPP PS Data Off status for mobile terminating scenarios?
question_6106.ground_truth: The SCC AS forwards the SIP request to the S-CSCF with 3GPP PS Data Off status and the S-CSCF checks the status and determines whether to send the SIP request to the UE based on the 3GPP PS Data Off Exempt Services.

question_6107.question: What should a UE assume about the PUCCH resource value for all PDCCH assignments in the primary cell and in each secondary cell that are used to determine the PUCCH resource value within the subframe(s) when the DAI value equal to '1' is not the first PDCCH/EPDCCH transmission in the subframe(s)?
question_6107.ground_truth: A UE should assume that the same HARQ-ACK PUCCH resource value is transmitted on all PDCCH assignments in the primary cell and in each secondary cell that are used to determine the PUCCH resource value within the subframe(s).

question_6109.question: What happens when an eP-CSCF fails in this solution and how is user information restored?
question_6109.ground_truth: When an eP-CSCF is detected as failed, another eP-CSCF is selected by the WIC. The S-CSCF stores its restoration data on the WUDB, and when a new S-CSCF is elected, it retrieves its restoration data from the WUDB.

question_6110.question: What IE is used for the establishment or modification of Common E-DCH MAC-d flows?
question_6110.ground_truth: 9.2.2.105 Common E-DCH MAC-d Flow Specific Information

question_6111.question: What is the registration expiration interval value that the UE shall include as the value desired for the duration of the registration?
question_6111.ground_truth: The registration expiration interval value that the UE shall include is 600~000 seconds.

question_6112.question: What type of request is sent to the NEF by the AF to create a new AM policy association?
question_6112.ground_truth: The AF sends an HTTP POST request to the "Application AM Contexts" resource to create a new AM policy association.

question_6113.question: What is the meaning of collaboration level x in the CSI prediction for the AI/ML model?
question_6113.ground_truth: Collaboration level x represents a performance benchmark for CSI prediction using the AI/ML model.

question_6114.question: What is the purpose of the (U)SIM API for Java Card released by 3GPP?
question_6114.ground_truth: The purpose of the (U)SIM API for Java Card is to define an extension of the "UICC API for Java Card" to develop a (U)SAT application running together with a (U)SIM application and using 3GPP network features.

question_6115.question: Which message should the UE send to delete the erroneous mapped EPS bearer contexts and the erroneous QoS rules?

question_6116.question: What is the purpose of the S/P field in the downlink RLC block?
question_6116.ground_truth: The S/P field in the downlink RLC block is set by the network to request the FPB or NPB segment for the bitmap period.

question_6117.question: Which network behavior should be included in a Preferred Network Behaviour indication if the UE wants to indicate that User Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation is preferred, as per 3GPP specifications?
question_6117.ground_truth: If the UE wants to indicate that User Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation is preferred, it should include the information elements for User Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation and S1-U data transfer in the Preferred Network Behaviour indication.

question_6118.question: What information is used by the eNB/RNC to select the SGW/SGSN and the TEID for sending uplink traffic when it receives a Connection ID?
question_6118.ground_truth: The eNB/RNC only needs the Connection ID information to select the SGW/SGSN and the TEID for sending uplink traffic.

question_6119.question: What is the meaning of "business communication" in the context of the present document?
question_6119.ground_truth: Business communication refers to any communication that is either originated in an NGCN, terminated in an NGCN, originated in the NGN on behalf of an enterprise, or terminated in the NGN on behalf of an enterprise and is subject to special arrangements between the NGN operator and the enterprise.

question_6121.question: What is an advantage of using AR devices for industrial maintenance?
question_6121.ground_truth: AR devices can provide ad-hoc support from a remote expert, allow for a maximum degree of ergonomics, flexibility, and mobility, and enable access to context information if executed in the network.

question_6123.question: What type is used for the "protected" attribute in the "tLocationType" complex type, which can take the values "Normal" or "Encrypted"?

question_6124.question: What is the purpose of the "Revalidation time limit" attribute provided by the PCF upon every interaction with the SMF?
question_6124.ground_truth: The "Revalidation time limit" defines the time period within which the SMF shall trigger a request for PCC rules for an established PDU Session.

question_6125.question: What is the requirement for NCR-Fwd type 1-C operating band unwanted emissions in Japan for Band n41 and n90?
question_6125.ground_truth: The operating band unwanted emissions limits shall be applied to the sum of the emission power over all antenna connectors for NCR-Fwd type 1-C.

question_6127.question: How many SEG CA certificate key usage bits should be set mandatory and critically in the X.509 certificate?
question_6127.ground_truth: Only the digitalSignature key usage bit should be set mandatory and critically in the X.509 certificate.

question_6128.question: In what mode should the mobile station be for the NC2 non-DRX mode period to be ordered by a PACKET CELL CHANGE ORDER message?
question_6128.ground_truth: The NC2 non-DRX mode period can be ordered by a PACKET CELL CHANGE ORDER message when the mobile station is in packet idle mode and operating in NC2 mode.

question_6130.question: Which types of E-UTRA UE does test case 8.16.88 apply to?
question_6130.ground_truth: Test case 8.16.88 applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE release 11 and forward, all types of E-UTRA TDD UE release 11 and forward, and all types of E-UTRA UE release 12 and forward that support 4DL CA.

question_6131.question: What is a pre-condition for establishing a group-broadcast group call in the LMR system?
question_6131.ground_truth: A pre-condition for establishing a group-broadcast group call in the LMR system is that the group-broadcast group and its subordinate groups are defined in the same group management server and served by the same MCPTT server.

question_6132.question: What should the PCF do if it detects that the P-CSCF released all the MCS session and the IMS priority service has been deactivated for the PDU session?
question_6132.ground_truth: The PCF shall delete the PCC Rules corresponding to the IMS Mission Critical Service and set the ARP and 5QI of the default QoS flow as appropriate for the IMS Mission Critical set to inactive.

question_6136.question: What should the target eNB do with the Handover Restriction List IE when it is contained in the HANDOVER REQUEST message?
question_6136.ground_truth: The target eNB should store the information received in the Handover Restriction List IE in the UE context and use it to determine a target for the UE during subsequent mobility actions and to select a proper SCG during dual connectivity operation, except when one of the E-RABs has a particular ARP value.

question_6137.question: What should the `ng-user-id>` element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body display if the `alert-ind` element is set to "true"?
question_6137.ground_truth: It should display to the MCVideo user an indication of the MCVideo emergency alert and associated information.

question_6138.question: What is the difference between L3 and Layer 2 UE-to-UE relays?
question_6138.ground_truth: L3 UE-to-UE relays set up communication links based on L3 connectivity, while Layer 2 UE-to-UE relays set up an end-to-end PC5 link based on L2 connectivity. The former may use link-local IP addresses, while the latter transfers messages based on the identity information of UE-1/UE-2 in the Adaptation Layer.

question_6140.question: What are the two main players in MCData Client testing?
question_6140.ground_truth: The two main players in MCData Client testing are the MCdata Server and the MCData Clients.

question_6143.question: What is the action taken by the mobile station during contention resolution when it receives a PACKET POWER CONTROL/TIMING ADVANCE address with TFI for a R97 and R98 device?
question_6143.ground_truth: The mobile station may accept the PACKET POWER CONTROL/TIMING ADVANCE message addressed with TFI during contention resolution for a R97 and R98 device.

question_6144.question: What are the actions taken if indirect forwarding tunnel is setup during handover preparation phase and cancellation of handover is triggered?
question_6144.ground_truth: If indirect forwarding tunnel is setup during handover preparation phase then cancellation of handover triggers the source CN node to release the temporary resources used for indirect forwarding and the target CN node to release the temporary resources used for indirect forwarding.

question_6145.question: When does the Media Session Handler activate the consumption reporting procedure?
question_6145.ground_truth: The Media Session Handler activates the consumption reporting procedure when the samplePercentage is less than or equal to a randomly generated number between 0 and 100.

question_6146.question: What is the impact of increasing frequency error from 0.05ppm to 0.25ppm on HeNB 64QAM?
question_6146.ground_truth: Increasing frequency error from 0.05ppm to 0.25ppm results in almost no performance degradation for HeNB 64QAM.

question_6147.question: What is the maximum number of data blocks that can be transmitted in a single transmission using MCS-9?

question_6148.question: What is the responsibility of the ResolveRemoteUserId service in the 5G System?
question_6148.ground_truth: The ResolveRemoteUserId service enables an NF service consumer (i.e. SMF) to request the PAnF to resolve the Remote User ID.

question_6150.question: What is the variable Hys defined as in Event D1, in terms of how it is used in the inequalities?
question_6150.ground_truth: Hys is the hysteresis parameter for Event D1, and is used in the inequalities to adjust the threshold values up or down, depending on whether the entering or leaving condition is being considered.

question_6153.question: What is the overall delays measured requirement for the test to pass?
question_6153.ground_truth: The overall delays measured shall be less than a total of 4802 ms for the test to pass.

question_6155.question: What is the function of the "charging function" as defined in the document?
question_6155.ground_truth: The "charging function" is an entity inside the core network domain, subsystem, or service that is involved in charging for that domain, subsystem, or service.

question_6156.question: What is the test purpose for the Additional Spectrum Emission Mask for category M1?
question_6156.ground_truth: The Additional Spectrum Emission Mask is not applicable for category M1.

question_6160.question: How does the potential solution #2 aim to improve energy efficiency in the network?
question_6160.ground_truth: The potential solution #2 aims to improve energy efficiency by focusing on area-based energy saving, considering the energy efficiency values of cells running under common or similar conditions to be comparable.

question_6161.question: What is the TRP threshold for the OTA AAS BS TX OFF requirement?
question_6161.ground_truth: The Very low TRP for the OTA AAS BS TX OFF requirement cannot be measured accurately, hence the co-location method is used.

question_6163.question: How does Intent driven management differ from Policy driven management?
question_6163.ground_truth: Intent defines the desired state, while policy specifies the actions to be taken when specific conditions occur. Intent driven management is more focused on "What" the system should achieve, while policy driven management is more focused on "How" to achieve it.

question_6164.question: What is the main purpose of DASH Events in the context of interactivity notifications in the MPEG DASH standard?
question_6164.ground_truth: DASH Events can convey the necessary data related to the interactivity event and application, including retiming of the occurrence of the interactivity event, validity interval, and Event identifier. This mechanism can be used for both interactivity-enabled web applications and native applications.

question_6165.question: What is the error code in the "TERMINAL RESPONSE: LAUNCH BROWSER 2.3.2" command?
question_6165.ground_truth: The error code in the "TERMINAL RESPONSE: LAUNCH BROWSER 2.3.2" command is "Launch browser generic error code".

question_6166.question: What physical channels transmitted by the macro node, other than HS-PDSCH, can be cancelled easily?
question_6166.ground_truth: Physical channels like P-CPICH and SCH can be cancelled relatively easily.

question_6167.question: What is the action taken by the PIN server or PEMC after deciding to modify the PIN with changing PEGC?
question_6167.ground_truth: The PIN server or PEMC sends a successful response to the original PEGC, which includes a stop of access control information in PEGC.

question_6168.question: What is the subject of the present document, as defined in its scope section?
question_6168.ground_truth: The present document defines the requirements for the Common RAT Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP) for equipment that may be shared between BSS in GSM, UTRAN and E-UTRAN.

question_6169.question: What is the confidence level that is expected to be achieved for the rate of correct events observed during repeated tests?
question_6169.ground_truth: The expected confidence level for the rate of correct events observed during repeated tests is 95%.

question_6171.question: What is the expected action by the UE after generating the response message?
question_6171.ground_truth: After generating the response message, the UE applies the security mechanism(s) and sets the destination layer-2 ID to the source layer-2 ID from the discoverer UE used in the transportation of the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-network relay discovery solicitation, and self-assigns a source layer-2 ID for sending the UE-to-network relay discovery response message. Finally, the UE passes the resulting PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-network relay discovery response along with the source layer-2 ID, destination layer-2 ID and an indication that the message is for 5G ProSe direct discovery to the lower layers for transmission over the PC5 interface.

question_6172.question: When is the Packet Physical information message not sent in the target cell?
question_6172.ground_truth: The Packet Physical information message is not sent in the target cell in the case of pre-synchronised or synchronised handover.

question_6173.question: For what purpose is the second test procedure conducted in section 44.2.1.1.6.3?
question_6173.ground_truth: The second test procedure is conducted to test the behavior of the MS in case of access class control when the cell is changed.

question_6175.question: What parameter in the Warning Security Information needs to be updated to include fields for PKID, NSUC, and potentially, identifiers for the hash and signature algorithm?
question_6175.ground_truth: The Warning Security Information parameter itself needs to be updated to include these fields.

question_6176.question: What must the PCEF include in the Diameter CCR when the UE initiates a resource modification request procedure?
question_6176.ground_truth: The P packet-Filter-Information AVP, Packet-Filter-Operation AVP, and QoS-Information AVP, if applicable.

question_6177.question: What is the result of the MC service server A sending ad hoc group emergency alert modify request?
question_6177.ground_truth: The result of the MC service server A sending ad hoc group emergency alert modify request is that MC service server B detects participants that meet the criteria for the emergency alert, and sends ad hoc group emergency add user notification messages to MC service server A, which sends emergency alert requests to the detected participants.

question_6178.question: What does the 3GPP technical specification mean by the term "AAA-S" in the context of NSSAA?
question_6178.ground_truth: The term "AAA-S" stands for Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting Server, and it is an entity responsible for providing authentication and authorization services in the 3GPP telecom network.

question_6179.question: What should the UE do when there is no network preference?
question_6179.ground_truth: The UE determines the ProSe applications to be switched with the consideration of other criteria, such as availability of direct communication paths and requirements of the application.

question_6181.question: What is the meaning of an "IOC" in the context of 3GPP 32.762?
question_6181.ground_truth: In the context of 3GPP 32.762, an "IOC" refers to an Information Object Class.

question_6184.question: What is the effect of the Ready timer length on the use of iDRX mode in packet idle mode?
question_6184.ground_truth: A device uses iDRX mode for the duration of its Ready timer after entering packet idle mode upon completing the transmission of an LLC PDU.

question_6185.question: Which diversity scheme is used for transmissions with two antenna ports in uplink control channels with Rel-8 PUCCH format 1/1a/1b?

question_6186.question: Upon receiving a SIP REFER request due to session replication, what should the SCC AS do if it is not authorized?
question_6186.ground_truth: If not authorized, the SCC AS shall reject the SIP request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and do not process the remaining steps.

question_6187.question: What action should the UE take upon receiving a valid EAP-success message from the network?
question_6187.ground_truth: The UE should delete any valid K~AUSF and K~SEAF that it has, generate a new K~AUSF and K~SEAF using the provided parameters, create a partial native 5G NAS security context, store the K~AMF in the created security context, and consider the new K~AUSF and K~SEAF as valid.

question_6188.question: What does the Edge Enabler Server check upon receiving the discovery request from the Edge Enabler Client?
question_6188.ground_truth: The Edge Enabler Server checks if the Edge Enabler Client is authorized to discover the requested Edge Application Server(s) and if it is able to provide access to servers that meet the desired level of access permissions, features, and location availability.

question_6189.question: What is the definition of the measurement reporting delay in the test case?
question_6189.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between an event that will trigger a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface, excluding the delay uncertainty resulted from inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH.

question_6190.question: What should the transmitting PDCP entity do when successful delivery of a PDCP Data PDU is confirmed by one of the associated AM RLC entities?
question_6190.ground_truth: Indicate to the other AM RLC entities to discard the duplicated PDCP Data PDU.

question_6191.question: What is the role of the MSGin5G Client in the MSGin5G system architecture?
question_6191.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Client provides client-side functionality for UE Application Clients with the sending and receiving of messages via the MSGin5G Service to/from Application Servers and/or other MSGin5G Service endpoints.

question_6192.question: What kind of primitive is used by the radio resource management entity in the mobile station to perform a local end release and save the state of the transmit and receive counters and layer~3 data units?

question_6193.question: What is the importance of the Interface specification part in the OSA API?
question_6193.ground_truth: The Interface specification part of the OSA API describes in detail each of the interfaces shown within the Class diagram part and plays a crucial role in understanding how each interface functions and relates to other interfaces within the SCF.

question_6194.question: What is the expected sequence for launching a browser using the SIM command with default URL unavailable?

question_6196.question: What should the MCPTT client do when it receives a PRIVATE CALL ACCEPT message accepting the establishment of a private call while in the off-network environment, as specified in TS 24.379, clause 11.2.1.1.1?
question_6196.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should treat the UDP messages received as PRIVATE CALL ACCEPT messages and send a PRIVATE CALL ACCEPT ACK message in response.

question_6198.question: What is the name of the first EAP (Request) Command for STa?
question_6198.ground_truth: The name of the EAP (Request) Command is Diameter-EAP-Request (DER).

question_6199.question: What is the type of the "id-CriticalityDiagnostics" extension in the RelocationRequestAcknowledgeIEs RANAP-PROTOCOL-IES and RelocationFailureIEs RANAP-PROTOCOL-IES?
question_6199.ground_truth: The type of the "id-CriticalityDiagnostics" extension is "CriticalityDiagnostics".

question_6202.question: What is the requirement for L1-SINR measurement if CSI-RS as CMR and CSI-IM as IMR?
question_6202.ground_truth: The requirement for L1-SINR measurement applies only if the number of CSI-RS resources in the CMR resource set and the number of CSI-IM resources in the IMR resource set are the same.

question_6203.question: What is the effect of including an "any" element in the XML schema?
question_6203.ground_truth: Including an "any" element in the XML schema allows for flexibility in the XML document by allowing any or specific XML elements or attributes from other namespaces to be included in the XML document.

question_6204.question: What is the purpose of the display orientation SEI message in H.265 (HEVC)?
question_6204.ground_truth: The display orientation SEI message in H.265 (HEVC) signals the recommended anticlockwise rotation of the decoded picture prior to display.

question_6205.question: What conditions may trigger the unicast call release procedure (terminating)?
question_6205.ground_truth: The conditions for release may be the MCPTT release request by an authorized MCPTT client or some conditions determined by the MCPTT server such as call duration, available coverage, or the number of participants.

question_6206.question: What is the use of the "ngKSI" in the 5G NAS security context?
question_6206.ground_truth: The ngKSI is used to indicate the current 5G NAS security context when establishing a secure exchange of NAS messages in a new N1 NAS signalling connection or when the AMF initiates a security mode control procedure. It is also used to indicate whether the 5G NAS security context is native or mapped.

question_6208.question: What is the definition of "event" as used in the context of the present document?
question_6208.ground_truth: An "event" is defined as a timed notification to UE software or to an application, indicating that some action is to be taken.

question_6209.question: What shall a UE include in the user agent request-header field when communicating over Ub with a BSF?
question_6209.ground_truth: A UE shall always include the product token "3gpp-gba-tmpi" in the user agent request-header field when communicating over Ub with a BSF.

question_6212.question: What should the user equipment (UE) do upon T304 expiry in case of a handover failure to E-UTRA?
question_6212.ground_truth: If the source RAT is E-UTRA, the UE should perform the actions specified in section 5.3.5.6 of the document. If not, the UE should reset the MAC and perform the actions defined for this failure case in the specifications for the other RAT.

question_6213.question: What is the name of the function that reports broadcasted TAC(s) of the selected Public Land Mobile Network to the Access and Mobility Management Function as part of UE Location Information?

question_6214.question: What is the difference between CP CIoT 5GS Optimisation and UP CIoT 5GS Optimisation in the context of 5G system?
question_6214.ground_truth: CP CIoT 5GS Optimisation and UP CIoT 5GS Optimisation are features used in the 5G system to optimize data transport for Cellular IoT (CIoT) devices. CP CIoT 5GS Optimisation is used for control plane data transfer, while UP CIoT 5GS Optimisation is used for user plane data transfer.

question_6215.question: How does the NWDAF check the user-plane-data-access-control list in Step 7 of Solution #19.3?
question_6215.ground_truth: The NWDAF checks the user-plane-data-access-control list and decides what information needs to be collected. Information that matches the user-plane-data-access-control list will not be collected.

question_6217.question: What is the role of the HGMLC in Solution 24 of the positioning access selection for LCS service?
question_6217.ground_truth: The HGMLC receives a location request from an LCS client and selects the access type to transmit the positioning message based on the information received from the UDM.

question_6218.question: What is the recommended solution for IP-PBX support without provisioning of IP-PBX data?
question_6218.ground_truth: The recommended solution for IP-PBX support without provisioning of IP-PBX data is based on the use of a TLS connection for authentication and the dynamic acquisition of IMS identities and the contact address through the TLS handshake. This solution eliminates the need for provisioning IP-PBX data in the P-CSCF and reduces the impact on the S-CSCF.

question_6219.question: What tunneling capability does GTP-U allow for Multicast?
question_6219.ground_truth: GTP-U allows Point-to-Multipoint (P2MP) tunneling capability for Multicast, enabling one tunnel endpoint node to send out a G-PDU to be received at multiple tunnel endpoints using the IP multicast capability of underlay IP networks.

question_6222.question: What is the function of the BCS response procedures?
question_6222.ground_truth: The BCS response procedures are used to store BCS responses, check the sequence of IFP packets, transmit stored complete BCS responses towards the associated facsimile terminal, and autonomously repeat BCS commands towards the accepting facsimile terminal if necessary. The BCS response procedures also include reading and reverse transcoding of the buffered facsimile coded data to be transmitted to the associated facsimile terminal.

question_6223.question: What is the difference between a CC Intercept Function and a CC Interception Triggering Function?
question_6223.ground_truth: A CC Intercept Function is a network function that has access to the voice media of an intercepted call, while a CC Interception Triggering Function is a network function that provides a trigger to intercept the CC (call control signal).

question_6224.question: In which condition does the E-CSCF not provide the IRI-POI functions in the default deployment option for session-based IMS communications?
question_6224.ground_truth: The E-CSCF does not provide the IRI-POI functions in the default deployment option for session-based IMS communications when the S-CSCF provides the IRI-POI for emergency services.

question_6225.question: What should the UE do if it has received 5GMM cause #75 from a cell belonging to an SNPN with a non-globally-unique SNPN identity?
question_6225.ground_truth: This is considered an abnormal case, and the UE should follow the behavior specified in subclause 5.5.2.3.4.

question_6226.question: How are Announcer Info, Discoverer Info, and Discoveree Info used in Public Safety Discovery messages?
question_6226.ground_truth: Announcer Info, Discoverer Info, and Discoveree Info refer to the same parameter that takes on a different name depending on the Public Safety Discovery message and is provided to the UE during provisioning time.

question_6228.question: What action shall the target UE take upon receipt of a PROSE DIRECT LINK SECURITY ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message?
question_6228.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a PROSE DIRECT LINK SECURITY ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message, the target UE shall verify the MIC field and decrypt the relay service code and UP-PRUK ID or CP-PRUK ID, if received, using the DUCK or DUSK.

question_6231.question: What should the old SGSN mark in its context after receiving a Context Acknowledge message from the new SGSN during a RAU between two S4-SGSNs?
question_6231.ground_truth: The old SGSN marks the MSC/VLR association and the information in the S-GW and the HLR as invalid in its context.

question_6232.question: How many bits is the Timing Advance Command field in the MAC RAR in Random Access Response for NB-IoT UEs using Preamble Format 2?
question_6232.ground_truth: The Timing Advance Command field in the MAC RAR is 11 bits for NB-IoT UEs using Preamble Format 2.

question_6236.question: Why would new technical requirements be necessary when some disturbance exists (e.g., due to regulatory or technical causes)?
question_6236.ground_truth: To minimize the impact on transfer caused by such disturbances, new technical requirements may be needed, such as scheduling and information necessary for the 3GPP entity to perform "good scheduling."

question_6237.question: What information should be included in measResultNeighCells for each applicable neighbouring cell?
question_6237.ground_truth: For each applicable neighbouring cell included in measResultNeighCells, the physCellId should be included. In addition, if the triggerType is set to event, or the purpose is set to reportStrongestCells or reportStrongestCellsForSON, the layer 3 filtered measured results should be included.

question_6238.question: In the scenario where the NF Service Consumer and the NRF are connected over a mutually authenticated TLS connection, when is the NF Service Consumer authorized to invoke the services of the NF Service Producer?
question_6238.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer is authorized to invoke the services of the NF Service Producer after mutual authentication between the NF Service Consumer and the NRF at the transport layer and after the "Access token request before service access" procedure is completed.

question_6239.question: What is the procedure followed by the MCVideo client when a Transmission Granted message is received during an On-demand Pre-arranged Imminent Peril Group Call?
question_6239.ground_truth: The UE (MCVideo Client) responds with a Transmission Control Ack message and provides Transmission granted notification to the MCVideo User, respecting Transmission Control (Transmission Granted, Transmission Control ACK, Transmission End Request, Transmission Control Response).

question_6241.question: What is the role of the SEAL Group Management server in creating or modifying the external group identifiers for 5G LAN groups?
question_6241.ground_truth: The SEAL Group Management server uses dynamic 5G VN group management procedures exposed by NEF via the N33 reference point to create or modify the external group identifiers for 5G LAN groups.

question_6242.question: What is the role of the SBI-DIAMETER interworking functionality in the 5G authentication procedure?
question_6242.ground_truth: The SBI-DIAMETER interworking functionality is collocated with the AUSF and is responsible for receiving the MSK from the AAA-Server.

question_6243.question: What action does the TSCTSF take if a UE moves within any of the TAs from the time synchronization coverage area?
question_6243.ground_truth: The TSCTSF enables access stratum time distribution for the UE.

question_6244.question: In the case of an N2 based handover, what determines the availability of direct forwarding path between source and target NG-RANs?
question_6244.ground_truth: A direct forwarding path is available if security associations and IP connectivity are in place between the source and target NG-RANs.

question_6247.question: What is the purpose of SNDCP XID parameter negotiation in 3GPP?
question_6247.ground_truth: The purpose of SNDCP XID parameter negotiation is to ensure optimal information transfer between peer SNDCP entities by negotiating parameters called SNDCP exchange identity (XID) parameters.

question_6248.question: What encoding type should the SM-over-IP sender use for the encoding of the SM in the body of the SIP MESSAGE request?
question_6248.ground_truth: The SM-over-IP sender will use content transfer encoding of type "binary" for the encoding of the SM in the body of the SIP MESSAGE request.

question_6250.question: What should the MS do if the authentication response is not valid in GPRS services?
question_6250.ground_truth: If the authentication response is not valid, the MS should set the GPRS update status to GU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED and delete the P-TMSI, P-TMSI signature, RAI, and GPRS ciphering key sequence number stored. The MS shall also consider the SIM/USIM as invalid for GPRS services.

question_6251.question: How is paging reliability improved in this solution?
question_6251.ground_truth: Paging reliability is improved by introducing a Paging Transmission Window Time (PTW) during which the UE monitors the network for paging when the extended I-DRX cycle based on the extended I-DRX value expires.

question_6254.question: How is the timing of the CB messages defined in this specification?
question_6254.ground_truth: The timing of the messages is defined in 3GPP TS 45.002.

question_6255.question: What are the conditions under which the UE should apply Single Tx Switched UL for LTE-NR inter-band combinations?
question_6255.ground_truth: If the 2nd~order IMD of the simultaneous UL bands fall into its own Rx band, the UE should use Single Tx Switched UL for LTE-NR inter-band combinations. For non-difficult band combinations, simultaneous UL transmission is mandatory.

question_6257.question: In which state(s) will the MCVideo client send a GROUP EMERGENCY ALERT CANCEL message and stop timer TFE2 (emergency alert retransmission)?
question_6257.ground_truth: The MCVideo client will send a GROUP EMERGENCY ALERT CANCEL message and stop timer TFE2 (emergency alert retransmission) when the MCVideo user cancels the Emergency Alert while in state "E1: Not in emergency state" or in "E2: Emergency state".

question_6259.question: How is the excitation of the high frequency band signal predicted in the bandwidth extension algorithm?
question_6259.ground_truth: The excitation of the high frequency band signal is adaptively predicted from the decoded low frequency band excitation signal, which is the sum of adaptive codebook contribution and algebraic codebook contribution, based on LSF and bitrates.

question_6260.question: What message is sent by the network to the MS to initiate a Deferred MT-LR Periodic Location Event?
question_6260.ground_truth: A REGISTER message containing an LCS Periodic Location invoke component is sent by the network to the MS to initiate a Deferred MT-LR Periodic Location Event.

question_6261.question: What should the UE do with the paging restriction bit in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if it supports reject paging request, N1 NAS signalling connection release, or both, and supports paging restriction?
question_6261.ground_truth: If the UE supports reject paging request, N1 NAS signalling connection release, or both, and also supports paging restriction, the UE should set the paging restriction bit to "paging restriction supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

question_6262.question: What is the role of the MC replay function in this solution?
question_6262.ground_truth: The MC replay function receives the necessary security information needed to replay logged communications by CSC-8. A user of the replay function, or an automatic function of the replay function, will perform the necessary authorizations to retrieve logged communications, and CSC-1 will be used to verify the authenticity and authorization of the user or function.

question_6263.question: What is the lower limit of the spurious range specified for FR1 in OTA transceiver measurements?
question_6263.ground_truth: The lower limit of the spurious range specified for FR1 in OTA transceiver measurements is from 30~MHz.

question_6267.question: Who is responsible for releasing the floor control and media plane resources associated with the group call that is released?
question_6267.ground_truth: The MCPTT client 1, client 2 and the IWF are responsible for releasing the floor control and media plane resources associated with the group call that is released.

question_6269.question: What are some consequences of adding MACs to each user plane packet to ensure integrity protection?
question_6269.ground_truth: Adding MACs to each user plane packet reduces the available bandwidth and can increase the packet size significantly, depending on the length of the MAC value. This could cause issues in networks with low bandwidth or small packet sizes.

question_6270.question: What should be the new value for Cell 2 physical cell identity in the next iteration of the test procedure loop?
question_6270.ground_truth: The new value for Cell 2 physical cell identity in the next iteration of the test procedure loop is ((current cell 2 physical cell identity + 1) mod 14 + 2).

question_6271.question: When should the Node B send the INFORMATION EXCHANGE INITIATION FAILURE message over the Node B control port if the requested information provision cannot be initiated?
question_6271.ground_truth: When the requested information provision cannot be initiated, the Node B shall send the INFORMATION EXCHANGE INITIATION FAILURE message over the Node B control port with the Cause IE set to "Information temporarily not available" or "Information Provision not supported for the object".

question_6272.question: What is the main difference between solutions #1.3 and #1.9 from an interconnect perspective?
question_6272.ground_truth: The main difference is that solutions #1.3 requires a V-SMF to H-CHF interaction while solution #1.1 does not.

question_6273.question: What are the benefits of having dual carrier capabilities on the uplink for MBMS and CS?
question_6273.ground_truth: The benefits of having dual carrier capabilities on the uplink for MBMS and CS include the ability for users to receive MBMS and CS calls simultaneously, and allowing up to 2 mobiles per non-MBMS carrier in the cell to have a parallel CS call while receiving the MBMS session.

question_6274.question: What is the determining factor in the selection of the SSN and PBSN values in the downlink RLC block?
question_6274.ground_truth: The values of SSN and PBSN are determined based on the PBSN, V(Q), and the S/P field set by the network in the downlink RLC block.

question_6275.question: What is one of the responsibilities of the 5GMSd Application Provider when initiating the 5G Media Streaming Service in step 4?
question_6275.ground_truth: The 5GMSd Application Provider is responsible for provising the 5G Media Streaming System, including content hosting.

question_6276.question: What message does the PDN GW send to the Serving GW in step A1 to prompt the tunneling of packets from non-3GPP IP access to 3GPP access system?

question_6277.question: What is the role of the Network Slice System Provider (NSSP) in the 5G management systems?
question_6277.ground_truth: The NSSP is part of the Management Services provided by the 5G management systems. It is responsible for providing network slice instance (NSI) provisioning and exposure services.

question_6278.question: What does the "App-ID" node specify in the ISRP rules?
question_6278.ground_truth: The "App-ID" node specifies the flow description for a particular flow distribution rule based on an application identifier.

question_6279.question: What is the first action the gsmSSF performs when it receives an EstablishTemporaryConnection operation?
question_6279.ground_truth: The gsmSSF routes the call to the assisting gsmSSF or gsmSRF using the "assistingSSPIPRoutingAddress".

question_6280.question: What is the forgetting factor set for increasing updates in a moving average filter used in noise fluctuation calculation?
question_6280.ground_truth: The forgetting factor is set to 0.99 for increasing updates in the moving average filter used in noise fluctuation calculation.

question_6281.question: What is the pre-condition for Tom to access devices on his in-home LAN from his 5G mobile devices?
question_6281.ground_truth: Tom needs to include his eRG into his 5G-LAN VN, so his mobile devices on the 5G-LAN can connect to the devices on his in-home LAN.

question_6282.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the SIP MESSAGE request when changing the selected group of a targeted MCVideo user to a specific group?
question_6282.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include the ICSI value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcvideo" in a P-Preferred-Service header field, an Accept-Contact header field with the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag, a MIME body with the <mcvideoinfo> element containing the mcvideo-request-uri element set to the new MCVideo group identity, and a request-type element set to "group-selection-change-request".

question_6283.question: What is the focus of the feasibility study in terms of network scenarios?
question_6283.ground_truth: The focus of the feasibility study is to establish the feasibility for supporting generic access in the home network case, while also identifying issues with extending the solution to the roaming scenarios.

question_6284.question: Which positioning method could not meet the regulatory requirements for FR1 or FR2 in Scenario 2?
question_6284.ground_truth: The AoD+ZoD positioning method could not meet the regulatory requirements for FR1 or FR2 in Scenario 2.

question_6285.question: When should the "Payload container" information element be included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message in 5GS?
