question_6285.ground_truth: The "Payload container" information element should be included within a PLMN if the UE has one or more stored UE policy sections identified by a UPSI with the PLMN ID part indicating the HPLMN or the selected PLMN for the registration procedure, or if the UE does not have any stored UE policy section identified by a UPSI with the PLMN ID part indicating the HPLMN or the selected PLMN for the registration procedure and the UE needs to send a UE policy container to the network. Within an SNPN, this IE should be included if the UE has one or more stored UE policy sections for the selected SNPN for the registration procedure for initial registration, or if the UE does not have any UE policy section for the selected SNPN for the registration procedure for initial registration and the UE needs to send a UE policy container to the network.

question_6286.question: What is the main difference between on-demand session with automatic answer and on-demand session with manual answer in SIP?
question_6286.ground_truth: In on-demand session with automatic answer, the call is automatically answered by the receiving UE, whereas in on-demand session with manual answer, the call is manually answered by the receiving UE.

question_6287.question: What is the maximum allowed interruption duration if both E-UTRA PCell and PSCell are in DRX?
question_6287.ground_truth: No interruption is allowed if both E-UTRA PCell and PSCell are in DRX.

question_6288.question: What are the advantages and disadvantages of the two cell shape definitions?
question_6288.ground_truth: The grid point approach has the advantage of consuming minimal data and signaling because of the regularity of the arrays, but it is less flexible when it comes to aligning with natural or artificial boundaries. On the other hand, the polygon approach is more flexible and can align precisely with borders such as that of a country, but it requires more data and signaling.

question_6289.question: What is the goal of the potential new requirement PR 5.7.6-003?
question_6289.ground_truth: The goal of the potential new requirement PR 5.7.6-003 is to apply different access control for different access networks of Shared NGRANs based on the Hosting and Participating Operator's agreement and policies.

question_6290.question: What is the role of the location management server in providing the location information of the current talking user?
question_6290.ground_truth: The location management server provides the location information of the current talking user to the MCPTT server, which then provides it to other MCPTT users on the call.

question_6291.question: What measure should MTSI clients take when transitioning from a full-duplex session to a unidirectional flow in a hold procedure?
question_6291.ground_truth: MTSI clients should take measures to ensure minimal impact on the media quality during the transition.

question_6293.question: How should the manufacturer declare the channel bandwidths supported by the BS?
question_6293.ground_truth: The manufacturer should declare the E-UTRA channel bandwidths supported by the BS and, for each E-UTRA channel bandwidth, the NB-IoT operating mode(s) supported by the BS.

question_6294.question: What is the procedure for executing a Gateway Control and QoS Rules Provisioning in a roaming scenario for the hPCRF?
question_6294.ground_truth: The hPCRF initiates the procedure over S9 towards the vPCRF and the vPCRF in turns initiates the procedure over S9a towards the BPCF.

question_6296.question: What is one of the main objectives for supporting IoT UEs in a 5G system?
question_6296.ground_truth: One of the main objectives for supporting IoT UEs is to minimize resource usage in an IoT UE for each location determination for the UE, including power consumption, signaling and available bandwidth, processing, and memory usage.

question_6297.question: What kind of arrangements can a VAL service provider have in relation to SEALDD providers?
question_6297.ground_truth: A VAL service provider can have SEALDD provider arrangements with multiple SEALDD providers, and a SEALDD provider can have SEALDD provider arrangements with multiple VAL service providers.

question_6298.question: In the context of "Non-contiguous spectrum", what is the definition of a "Sub-block"?
question_6298.ground_truth: A sub-block is one contiguous allocated block of spectrum for transmission and reception by the same UE. There may be multiple instances of sub-blocks within an RF bandwidth.

question_6299.question: What is the method of test specified in section 7.8.3B of the document?
question_6299.ground_truth: The test is conducted in three stages, with the downlink power limited during stage two and the downlink power ratio measured during stage three. The test is repeated 328 times and the requirement is met if the downlink power ratio is below the specified values more than 90% of the time.

question_6300.question: What is the procedure that the HPLMN ProSe Function follows to request ProSe Direct Discovery announcing authorization for a roaming UE in the VPLMN or a Local PLMN?
question_6300.ground_truth: The HPLMN ProSe Function makes use of a specific procedure that includes the Discovery Entry ID, Discovery Type, ProSe Application ID, ProSe Application Code or ProSe Application Code Prefix/Suffix(es), and the UE identity (IMSI or MSISDN) in the request. This information allows the VPLMN or Local PLMN to perform charging.

question_6301.question: In which 3GPP specification can information on E-UTRA cells and procedures to connect to a PDN in single-registration and dual-registration modes be found?
question_6301.ground_truth: Such information can be found in 3GPP TS 24.301.

question_6302.question: What is the impact of a radio handover on an ongoing emergency call in the local break-out architecture?
question_6302.ground_truth: A radio handover triggering a domain change has no impact on an ongoing emergency call in the local break-out architecture.

question_6303.question: What must the Serving GW do if it receives the Control Plane Only PDN Connection Indicator in step~12?
question_6303.ground_truth: The Serving GW must inform the PDN GW about this information in the Create Session Request and indicate the use of CP only on their CDRs.

question_6304.question: What is the main idea behind Power Cap Method in smart power control?
question_6304.ground_truth: Power Cap Method restricts the maximum transmission power density of the HUE based on the interference rise at the MeNB, providing adequate protection for macro UEs and minimizing interference from HeNB UEs to macro UEs.

question_6305.question: What is the initial state of the MS in the test procedure?
question_6305.ground_truth: The MS is in MM-state "idle, updated" with valid TMSI and CKSN.

question_6306.question: When the network sends a rejected NSSAI with the rejection cause "S-NSSAI not available due to maximum number of UEs reached", what should the UE do with the rejected S-NSSAIs for the maximum number of UEs reached?
question_6306.ground_truth: The UE should not remove the rejected S-NSSAIs for the maximum number of UEs reached.

question_6307.question: What is the class of the message content specified in clause 6.2B.2.2.4.3 and 6.5B.2.2.3.4.3?
question_6307.ground_truth: The class of the message content specified in clause 6.2B.2.2.4.3 and 6.5B.2.2.3.4.3 is the same.

question_6308.question: What should a UE do if it cannot identify a CDMA2000 1xRTT cell for SON ANR?
question_6308.ground_truth: The UE may stop searching CDMA2000 1xRTT cells for SON ANR after a period of time determined by the UE implementation.

question_6310.question: What is the use of UE-to-UE relay in enhancing QoS for services?
question_6310.ground_truth: UE-to-UE relay supports the E2E QoS parameters splitting between the two PC5 interfaces, and it performs necessary adaptations in the AS layers of the two PC5 interfaces for QoS enforcement. The data is transferred based on the adaptation in the AS layer.

question_6312.question: What is the definition of "architecture" in the context of the present document?
question_6312.ground_truth: In the context of the present document, architecture refers to the organizational structure of a system or component, their relationships, and the principles and guidelines governing their design and evolution over time.

question_6313.question: What metric is used to decide the blocker level for Rx intermodulation in Range 2?
question_6313.ground_truth: The metric used to decide the blocker level for Rx intermodulation in Range 2 is the worst case scenario of saturation of the receiver, where beam peak is used as a metric for the both blockers from the same direction of wanted signal.

question_6314.question: What is the role of IMS Application Servers in the IMS infrastructure?
question_6314.ground_truth: IMS Application Servers host and execute interfaces with the S-CSCF, allowing third-party providers easy integration and deployment of their value-added services to the IMS infrastructure. Examples of such services include Caller Line Identity Presentation and Restriction, Call Hold and Retrieve, Call Forwarding, Call Blocking, Call Interception, Announcement Services, and Messaging Services.

question_6316.question: What signal is used as the reference signal for the test measurements in this process?
question_6316.ground_truth: The reference signal is the original signal (test signal) in accordance with ITU-T Recommendation P.501.

question_6317.question: Which reference point supports the control plane interactions between the network resource management server and the BM-SC?
question_6317.ground_truth: The reference point MB2-C supports the control plane interactions between the network resource management server and the BM-SC and is specified in 3GPP TS 29.468.

question_6318.question: What is the role of the MRF in session replication by the SCC AS?
question_6318.ground_truth: The MRF is responsible for allocating the media resource for the media to be replicated and communicating media with the UE for replicated media flows in SIP INVITE requests.

question_6319.question: What determines the validity of a flow distribution rule?
question_6319.ground_truth: The validity of a flow distribution rule takes into account ValidityArea, ValidityAreaRef, TimeOfDay, TimeOfDayRef, RANValidityCondition, and RANValidityConditionRef. Each existing non-empty node must match in order to make the rule valid.

question_6320.question: What is the frequency offset of the measurement filter center frequency for UTRA FDD?
question_6320.ground_truth: The frequency offset of the measurement filter center frequency for UTRA FDD is 2.5 MHz.

question_6321.question: What is the name of the solution that uses a PAKE for UE-to-UE relay security and authorization?

question_6322.question: What action should an MCPTT client take upon receiving a request from the MCPTT user to establish a locally initiated ambient listening call, and if the "allow-request-locally-initiated-ambient-listening" element in the MCPTT user profile document is not present or set to a value of "false"?
question_6322.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should inform the MCPTT user and exit the procedure.

question_6325.question: What is one of the security and privacy requirements for the 5G wireless sensing service?
question_6325.ground_truth: One security and privacy requirement for the 5G wireless sensing service is to support encryption and integrity protection of the 3GPP sensing data, non-3GPP sensing data and sensing results to protect the data inside the 5G system.

question_6326.question: What is the recommended action for ensuring audio level alignment when inter-working with different networks or terminals that use codecs with different overload points?
question_6326.ground_truth: It is recommended that the MTSI MGW doing transcoding ensure proper audio level alignment by maintaining the nominal level (0 dBm0 shall be maintained to 0 dBm0) and adjusting the dynamic range control to prevent saturation or clipping.

question_6327.question: What command is used when the ME needs to receive data from the UICC?

question_6330.question: What should the UE do when barring for an Access Category is considered being alleviated?
question_6330.ground_truth: If the Access Category was informed to upper layers as barred, the UE should inform upper layers about barring alleviation for that Access Category.

question_6332.question: What are the three files that make up each DTX test sequence?
question_6332.ground_truth: The three files in each DTX test sequence are files for input to the speech encoder (*.INP), files for comparison with the encoder output and input to the speech decoder (*.COD), and files for comparison with the decoder output (*.OUT).

question_6334.question: For what purpose is the PCC rule authorization function used in the binding mechanism?
question_6334.ground_truth: The PCC rule authorization function determines whether the user can access the requested service and grants or denies the PCC rules accordingly.

question_6335.question: What is the minimum spectrum that must be allocated in the AWS-Extension band to be compliant with the FCC mandate?
question_6335.ground_truth: The minimum spectrum to allocate in the band plan and be compliant with the FCC mandate is 70+70 MHz (1710 - 1780 MHz / 2110 - 2180 MHz).

question_6338.question: What type of signalling and transport are carried over the Nb interface?
question_6338.ground_truth: Bearer control signalling and transport are carried over the Nb interface.

question_6342.question: What action does the UE take when it receives a PLMN not allowed message and is operating in single-registration mode?
question_6342.ground_truth: The UE handles the 5GMM parameters as specified in 3GPP TS 24.501 for the case when a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST is received over 3GPP access with the 5GMM cause with the same value, with de-registration type set to "re-registration not required" and with access type set to "3GPP access".

question_6343.question: What is the purpose of the "sv" or "schemaversion" parameter in the "application/3gpp-ims+xml" media type?
question_6343.ground_truth: The purpose of the "sv" or "schemaversion" parameter is to indicate the versions of the 3GPP IM CN Subsystem XML schema supported or accepted in the 3GPP IM CN subsystem XML body.

question_6344.question: What is the purpose of the SDT protocol in the small data solution?
question_6344.ground_truth: The SDT protocol is introduced to carry small data units of various users of the small data service. It is a protocol that spans between service access points in the UE and the SCS/AS, allowing efficient transfer of small data through the MTC-IWF.

question_6345.question: What should the UE do when it receives an ESM message with a reserved PTI value or an assigned value that does not match any PTI in use?
question_6345.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the message in this case.

question_6346.question: What should the floor control interface do when it receives a Floor Release message from the associated floor participant in the 'U: permitted' state, and an indication that the participant is overriding without revoke is stored?
question_6346.ground_truth: The floor control interface should forward the Floor Release message to the 'dual floor control operation' state machine of the floor control arbitration logic in the MCPTT server with the first bit in the subtype of the Floor Release message set to '0' (Acknowledgment is not required), remove the indication that the participant is overriding without revoke, and enter the 'U: not permitted and Floor Taken' state as specified in the clause~6.3.5.4.2.

question_6347.question: What is the mode of operation for the NodeB receiver when it is unaware that the UE is in open loop beamforming transmit diversity mode?
question_6347.ground_truth: The NodeB receiver does not make any changes to its processing, i.e. synchronization, channel estimation, demodulation, and decoding.

question_6349.question: What is the purpose of the 6.6.2 solution?
question_6349.ground_truth: The 6.6.2 solution implements a new interface on CN NFs for data collection, specifically for collecting data with spatial (in specific regions of the network slice) and temporal aspects from NFs.

question_6350.question: What is the UDP destination port used for GTP-U encapsulation?
question_6350.ground_truth: The UDP destination port used for GTP-U encapsulation is 2152.

question_6351.question: What capabilities should an ECSP management system have regarding EDN sharing?
question_6351.ground_truth: The ECSP management system should be able to enable and disable sharing of available EDN with other ECSP management systems (REQ-FUN-NBI-1).

question_6353.question: How many reserved bits are there adjacent to the midamble for burst types 1 and 2 in the MICH?
question_6353.ground_truth: There are 4 reserved bits adjacent to the midamble for burst types 1 and 2 in the MICH.

question_6354.question: Under what circumstances would the 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-UE relay UE send a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message containing PC5 signalling protocol cause value #xx "MAC address not unique"?
question_6354.ground_truth: If the 5G ProSe direct link establishment procedure is for 5G ProSe direct communication between the source 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE and the 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-UE relay UE for Ethernet traffic, and the target UE detects that the MAC address of the 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE is not unique.

question_6355.question: What is the threat category for the threat "Over-Privileged Processes/Services"?

question_6358.question: How many sources evaluate the link level performance gain from compact DCI in Rel-15 NR?
question_6358.ground_truth: 12 sources evaluate the link level performance gain from compact DCI in Rel-15 NR.

question_6360.question: What enumeration represents the different global navigation satellite systems?

question_6361.question: Which method is used to retrieve the User State information in CS domain as retrieved from the MSC/VLR in the Nhss-ims-sdm API?
question_6361.ground_truth: The GET method is used to retrieve the User State information in CS domain as retrieved from the MSC/VLR in the Nhss-ims-sdm API.

question_6362.question: What must the UE do with the received PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-UE relay discovery solicitation when the relay service code parameter of the message is the same as the relay service code parameter of the UE-to-UE relay discovery response received from the discoveree end UE?
question_6362.ground_truth: The UE must generate a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-UE relay discovery response and apply the DUIK, DUSK, or DUCK with the associated encrypted bitmask for the relay service code for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay discovery, along with the UTC-based counter to the message.

question_6363.question: What is the element included in the CALL CONFIRMED message sent to the network in clause 1.1, and what is its purpose?
question_6363.ground_truth: The Cause information element is included in the CALL CONFIRMED message sent to the network in clause 1.1 with cause #17 "user busy". Its purpose is to indicate that the call is waiting.

question_6366.question: What is the role of the MC service server in the MC service emergency alert procedure?
question_6366.ground_truth: The MC service server sends the MC service emergency alert request towards the designated target and sends the MC service emergency alert response to confirm the request.

question_6367.question: How does the IMS provide services when the CS bearer is used for the media of the IMS session?
question_6367.ground_truth: IMS services are provided to the ICS UE with the IUA of the SCC AS combining the service control signalling with the description of the CS bearer for execution of service control over the Remote Leg.

question_6369.question: What is the role of the IRPManager in the energy saving function?
question_6369.ground_truth: The IRPManager is responsible for monitoring the network and user service quality, monitoring the performance of the energy saving function, monitoring energy consumption information, initiating energy saving compensation, enabling and disabling energy saving for a selected part of the network, and defining traffic thresholds and time durations for energy saving purposes.

question_6371.question: When is the UE required to discard a stored extended local emergency numbers list received via non-3GPP access?
question_6371.ground_truth: The UE is required to discard a stored extended local emergency numbers list received via non-3GPP access if it can determine the current country and the UE has successfully registered to a PLMN in a country different from that of the PLMN that sent the stored list, or if the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message is received from a PLMN different from which the stored list was received, and the stored indication in the EENLV field within the Extended emergency number list IE indicates "Extended Local Emergency Numbers List is valid only in the PLMN from which this IE is received".

question_6372.question: What is the procedure that a Mobile Station (MS) should follow after a Location Updating (LU) reject on carrier 1?
question_6372.ground_truth: The MS should initiate the Network Selection Procedure and access onto Carrier 2 as part of cell selection within 33 seconds from returning to idle mode after the LU reject.

question_6376.question: What is the purpose of the "Source RNC to target RNC transparent Information (UMTS)" information element in 3GPP TS 24.008?
question_6376.ground_truth: The "Source RNC to target RNC transparent Information (UMTS)" information element is used to convey RNC specific information transparently through the core network from BSS to RNC, as defined in RANAP specification TS 25.413, excluding RANAP tag.

question_6377.question: What is one of the main factors that affects the average SE gains from MUST?
question_6377.ground_truth: The average SE gains from MUST largely depend on the trade-off between the potential SE improvement in the target coverage area for the added enhancement layer and the potential SE loss in the original coverage area for the basic layer.

question_6378.question: What is the objective of the 3GPP study on user centric identifiers and authentication?
question_6378.ground_truth: The objective is to introduce an optional, user-centric authentication layer that supports various authentication mechanisms and interacts with external authentication systems while maintaining the security and privacy of user data.

question_6379.question: What event triggers the generation of an xIRI containing a FiveGMSAFUnsuccessfulProcedure record in the 5GMS AF?
question_6379.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the 5GMS AF detects an unsuccessful procedure or error condition for a target UE.

question_6381.question: What action should the mobile station take if the Facility IE is included in the RECALL message?
question_6381.ground_truth: The mobile station should include the Facility IE in the SETUP message when indicating acceptance of a recall.

question_6382.question: What is the pre-condition for the MNO to offload an IP connection between two devices to ProSe direct communication?
question_6382.ground_truth: The MNO must be aware that the two devices have established an IP connection between them using eICBD.

question_6384.question: What does RAB.RelReqCS.Cause measurement represent in UMTS?
question_6384.ground_truth: This measurement provides the number of RABs requested to release by UTRAN for CS domain split into subcounters per cause.

question_6385.question: What message is sent from the network to the MS if the routing area updating request has been accepted by the network?
question_6385.ground_truth: A ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message

question_6386.question: What is the role of the BSF in Solution #31?
question_6386.ground_truth: In Solution #31, the BSF maintains the mapping relationship between the IP address and SUPI of the UE and is used to verify the EEC provided IP address.

question_6388.question: What message does the MS send the GANC to indicate a list of target GERAN cells for handover?
question_6388.ground_truth: The MS sends the GA-RRC HANDOVER INFORMATION message to the GANC, indicating the Channel Mode and a list of target GERAN cells, identified by CGI, in order of preference for handover, and the received signal strength for each identified GERAN cell.

question_6389.question: What is the requirement for a MS when the MS supports eDRX and requests the use of eDRX?
question_6389.ground_truth: The MS shall include the extended DRX parameters IE in the Routing Area Update Request message and use the extended idle mode DRX cycle only if the network has provided the extended DRX parameters IE during the last Routing Area Update procedure.

question_6390.question: What is the pre-condition for vehicles in 5.12.1.2 to obtain predictive information for platooning maneuver?
question_6390.ground_truth: Each vehicle shares its detected objects and/or coarse driving intention with other vehicles, and each vehicle obtains the information of surrounding objects and driving intention of other vehicles in the same and different platoon group in proximity.

question_6391.question: What is the requirement for a UE when performing CSI-RS measurements for BFD and SSB measurement in the same OFDM symbol for FR1?
question_6391.ground_truth: The UE is not required to receive CSI-RS for BFD measurement in the PRBs that overlap with an SSB when the CSI-RS for BFD measurement and SSB measurement are in the same OFDM symbol for FR1.

question_6392.question: What information is transmitted by means of the 1st-stage SCI format 1-B?
question_6392.ground_truth: The 1st-stage SCI format 1-B is used for scheduling SL PRS for a dedicated SL PRS resource pool, and it transmits priority, source ID, destination ID, cast type indicator, resource reservation period, time resource assignment, resource ID indication, SL PRS request, and reserved bits.

question_6393.question: What are the channel bandwidths per operating band for LTE-A carrier aggregation with 7.28.1.1?
question_6393.ground_truth: The channel bandwidths per operating band for LTE-A carrier aggregation with 7.28.1.1 are specified in the document.

question_6394.question: Which clause of the document defines the requirements for FDD intra-frequency handovers and FDD inter-frequency handovers for a Cat-M1 HD-FDD UE in CEModeA?
question_6394.ground_truth: Clause 5.5.2.2 applies to FDD intra-frequency handovers and FDD inter-frequency handovers for a Cat-M1 HD-FDD UE in CEModeA.

question_6399.question: What should be included in the ProSeUserID-entry element?
question_6399.ground_truth: The ProSeUserID-entry element should contain a DiscoveryGroupID element, a User-Info-ID element, and have an "index" attribute.

question_6400.question: What must the controlling MCVideo function do if it receives a SIP re-INVITE request that is an imminent peril call cancellation but the in-progress imminent peril group state of the group is still set to "true"?
question_6400.ground_truth: It must validate that the SIP re-INVITE request includes a Resource-Priority header field with the namespace set to the MCVideo-specific namespace and the priority set to the priority designated for imminent peril calls.

question_6401.question: What is the requirement for the BS tester used for the 3.84 Mcps TDD option in 6.4.3.4.1.1?
question_6401.ground_truth: The BS tester used for the 3.84 Mcps TDD option in 6.4.3.4.1.1 must have the ability to analyze the output signal of the BS under test with respect to code domain power and to simulate a UE with respect to the generation of TPC commands embedded in a valid UE signal.

question_6402.question: What is the purpose of the preamble in the CTM burst structure?
question_6402.ground_truth: The preamble in the CTM burst structure is used for synchronization of the deinterleaver and error correction at the receiving side. It simplifies the initial synchronization of the demodulator at the receiving side and does not introduce any additional delay.

question_6403.question: What percentage of measured locations with C/I > 0 dB in urban areas have a delay spread that exceeds that of the TU?

question_6404.question: What should the IP-SM-GW do if the UE in step 1 requests a Disposition Notification for a read notification?

question_6406.question: What exception is thrown if the dstBuffer is null in the copyValue method?

question_6407.question: What is the procedure for initiating a new QoS flow or modifying existing QoS flows for a source 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE?
question_6407.ground_truth: The source 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE provides the PC5 QoS flow context and PC5 QoS rules (if new or modified flows are added) to the 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-UE relay UE via the 5G ProSe direct link security mode control or modification procedure.

question_6409.question: What is the main difference between the On-Demand Session and the Pre-established Session in SIP?
question_6409.ground_truth: In an On-Demand Session, all media parameters are negotiated at the same time the PoC session is set up. In contrast, in a Pre-established Session, media parameters are negotiated before establishing the PoC session, allowing the PoC Client to activate media bearer whenever needed.

question_6410.question: What information needs to be provisioned by Farmer X for on-demand private data communication using UE-A?
question_6410.ground_truth: Farmer X needs to provision UE-A to be part of the private group and indicate how to obtain authorization for data communication.

question_6411.question: What is the minimum number of PRS subframes per cell measurement, as specified in Section 9.1.21.17?
question_6411.ground_truth: is the minimum number of PRS subframes per cell measurement.

question_6412.question: What message does the CN send to the source RNC upon reception of a RELOCATION CANCEL message indicating a successful cancellation of the relocation of SRNS?
question_6412.ground_truth: The CN sends a RELOCATION CANCEL ACKNOWLEDGE message to the source RNC after receiving a RELOCATION CANCEL message indicating a successful cancellation of the relocation of SRNS.

question_6413.question: What are the two options for securing downlink data communication in Group Communications, considering re-using EPS security or MBMS security mechanisms?
question_6413.ground_truth: The two options are: Option 1) GCS AS relies on EPS security (confidentiality and integrity) for the Unicast downlink and relies on MBMS security for the Multicast/Broadcast downlink; and Option 2) GCS AS relies on MBMS security protection mechanism for both, Unicast and Multicast/Broadcast downlink, where the BM-SC processes the data for Multicast/Broadcast and sends the encrypted data back to the AS for Unicast distribution.

question_6414.question: What is the role of the Terminal Adaptation Functions (TAF) in the 3GPP system?
question_6414.ground_truth: The Terminal Adaptation Functions (TAF) in the 3GPP system provides facilities to allow manual or automatic call control functions associated with circuit switched data services, in case of ITU-T V series interfaces. The TAF includes functions such as conversion of electrical, mechanical, functional and procedural characteristics, bit rate adaptation, mapping of ITU-T V.25 bis procedures to PLMN Layer 3 signalling, synchronization procedure, filtering of channel control information, compatibility checking, flow control and in-call modification function.

question_6415.question: What is the purpose of PIN-1 reference point?
question_6415.ground_truth: PIN-1 reference point is used for interactions related to enabling PINAPP between the Application client and the PIN client.

question_6416.question: What entity is responsible for enforcing the allowed combinations of RN and USIM-RN in the process of establishing a secure channel between them?
question_6416.ground_truth: The RN itself, as it is the only one capable of establishing a secure channel with a USIM-RN, which in turn is a prerequisite for a successful RN attachment to the network.

question_6419.question: What is one advantage of the solution for charging based on Network Slice performance using a Network Slice Charging Trigger Function?
question_6419.ground_truth: One advantage is that the solution allows for different customers to have flexible and personalized network slice instance charging, and the CHF can directly influence the provided service by granting or denying service access.

question_6420.question: In the 6.2A procedure, what is the purpose of precautionary de-registering the un-registered user when termination of all ongoing sessions is detected?
question_6420.ground_truth: To avoid loss of service for un-registered users and increase de-registration traffic and registration traffic.

question_6422.question: What is the purpose of the "IMSI" and "IMSPrivateUserIdentity" information elements?
question_6422.ground_truth: The "IMSI" information element contains the IMSI that is associated with the IMS Public User Identity present in the request, while the "IMSPrivateUserIdentity" information element contains all IMS Private User Identities associated with the IMS Public User Identity present in the request. These information elements are used to identify the user's public and private user identities in the request.

question_6424.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function include in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body in the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request when sending a notification of the cancellation of an emergency alert?
question_6424.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should include the <mcvideo-client-id> element with the MCVideo client ID that was included in the incoming SIP MESSAGE request, and set the <emergency-ind> element to a value of "false".

question_6428.question: How can vendor-specific data be added to JSON objects in 3GPP 5GC APIs?
question_6428.ground_truth: Vendor-specific data can be added to JSON objects in 3GPP 5GC APIs by using the naming scheme "vendorSpecific-nnnnnn" for vendor-specific member names, where "nnnnnn" is a 6-digit string associated with a given vendor using the IANA-assigned "SMI Network Management Private Enterprise Codes". The content and usage of those vendor-specific member elements is not defined by any of the 3GPP Technical Specifications, and they can be of any type (objects, arrays, or simple types) allowed in the JSON specification.

question_6429.question: What should be the ratio of successful reported values for the test to pass in the context of SS-RSRQ measurement accuracy?
question_6429.ground_truth: The ratio of successful reported values should be more than 90%.

question_6430.question: What do the abbreviations "B1A35", "B1B35", and "B1F" stand for?
question_6430.ground_truth: "B1A35" stands for the lower duplexer of the option B1 with the split duplexers with a 35 MHz spacing, "B1B35" stands for the upper duplexer of the option B1 with the split duplexers with a 35 MHz spacing, and "B1F" stands for option B1 with full band duplexer.

question_6431.question: What is Open Service Access (OSA) and its significance in 3GPP networks?
question_6431.ground_truth: Open Service Access (OSA) is an architecture that enables application developers to make use of network functionality through an open standardized interface, i.e. the OSA APIs. It allows developers to create applications that utilize the capabilities of 3GPP networks in a standard way.

question_6432.question: What information does the enabling data contain for each MDA capability?
question_6432.ground_truth: The enabling data contains the necessary inputs for implementing each MDA capability, but it is not restrictive or mandatory to use the analytics inputs exactly the same as the provided enabling data for implementation. Other (additional or different) data are also allowed to facilitate the production of analytics outputs.

question_6433.question: What should a UE do upon receiving an IDENTITY REQUEST message with the identity type IE set to "SUCI" while in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode and with timer T3519 not running?
question_6433.ground_truth: The UE should generate a fresh SUCI, send an IDENTITY RESPONSE message containing the SUCI, start timer T3519, and store the value of the SUCI sent in the IDENTITY RESPONSE message.

question_6435.question: What information is provided by the eNB/C-BS to the MME/C-SGN in the S1 UE context release complete message for the static paging CE level?
question_6435.ground_truth: The information provided by the eNB/C-BS to the MME/C-SGN in the S1 UE context release complete message for the static paging CE level includes device type (e.g. low cost), the paging CE level and an indication that the paging CE level is static.

question_6436.question: What is the difference between the CD service and Communication Forwarding services?
question_6436.ground_truth: The CD service enables the served user to respond to an incoming communication by requesting redirection of that communication to another user before the connection is established, while Communication Forwarding services, such as CFNRc, enable a user to have the network redirect all incoming communications when the user is not reachable to another user.

question_6437.question: Which DIP values were not changed for 0 dB, resulting in little change in the prior results?
question_6437.ground_truth: The DIP values for 0 dB were not changed, leading to little change in the prior results compared to those of 8.10 and 8.11 at 0 dB.

question_6438.question: When is the IP-CAN Session Modification procedure performed instead of the IP-CAN Session Establishment procedure?
question_6438.ground_truth: The IP-CAN Session Modification procedure is performed instead of the IP-CAN Session Establishment procedure when adding a new access to an existing PDN connection in single-connection mode.

question_6440.question: What does TNSCN define in the context of 3GPP TS 23.003?
question_6440.ground_truth: TNSCN defines the couple of timeslot number circular series to be used to form the timeslot shifting sequence.

question_6441.question: What does the WLAN Usage IE indicate in the WLAN Information IE of the Xw Setup procedure in the XwAP protocol?
question_6441.ground_truth: If the WLAN Usage IE is included in the WLAN Information IE of the Xw Setup procedure in the XwAP protocol, the eNB shall consider that the relevant WLAN identifier(s) may be used for both LWA and LWIP, or for LWIP only.

question_6443.question: What are the functions of the SIP core in the communication system?
question_6443.ground_truth: The SIP core contains a number of sub-entities responsible for registration, service selection, and routing in the signalling control plane. It can be compliant with 3GPP~TS~23.228 or internally non-compliant with 3GPP~TS~23.228 but compliant with 3GPP~TS~23.002 reference points.

question_6445.question: What command is sent from a trusted non-3GPP access network to a 3GPP AAA Server to initiate SWa authentication and authorization procedures?

question_6446.question: What is one of the objectives of the "Provisioning of inter-system operator's policies for seamless WLAN offload with IP flow mobility" work item?
question_6446.ground_truth: One of the objectives is to enable the routing of media traffic via an optimal path between networks without including unnecessary parts of the path that the signalling flow needs to take.

question_6447.question: What is the general definition of output intermodulation in 6.8.1.1 for repeaters?
question_6447.ground_truth: Output intermodulation requirement is a measure of the capability of the repeater to inhibit the generation of signals in its non-linear elements caused by the presence of the wanted signal and an interfering signal reaching the repeater via the output port.

question_6450.question: What happens when D-CPICH(s) are not activated for data demodulation by Node B?
question_6450.ground_truth: For CQI reporting, the UE shall assume a total transmit power of HS-PDSCH as specified, with the total transmit power evenly distributed among the HS-PDSCH codes corresponding to the reported CQI value.

question_6451.question: What is the role of SMF when a UE is anchored to a UPF and the address is not allocated from the local pool of the UPF?
question_6451.ground_truth: When a UE is anchored to a UPF and the address is not allocated from the local pool of the UPF, the UPF advertises a host route for the address into the DN.

question_6453.question: What is one possible additional header size used by the MP-DCCP-LL solution to encapsulate and transport PDUs over the user-plane?
question_6453.ground_truth: 61/65 Bytes, including generic header, MP-SEQ, MP-RTT, IP, UDP, and payload.

question_6454.question: What is one difference between using PC5 direct communication and PC5 direct discovery for Application layer discovery messages exchanged between UEs?
question_6454.ground_truth: Using PC5 direct discovery with a transparent container for Application layer discovery messages might be more appropriate if the protocol stack for PC5 direct discovery is to be defined without the SDAP layer similar to that for PC5-S.

question_6455.question: What is the purpose of the "mbms-service-area-id" sub-element within the "location-information" element?
question_6455.ground_truth: The "mbms-service-area-id" sub-element within the "location-information" element specifies the MBMS service area id that the SLM-C is using.

question_6457.question: What should the UE do when either the validity timer of the ProSe application code or ProSe application code prefix expires in case of open 5G ProSe direct discovery or when the validity timer of the ProSe restricted code or ProSe restricted code prefix expires in case of restricted 5G ProSe direct discovery?
question_6457.ground_truth: The UE may instruct the lower layers to stop announcing UE procedure for 5G ProSe direct discovery, and if in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode, the UE shall trigger the corresponding procedure in lower layers as specified in 3GPP TS 38.331.

question_6459.question: What is the purpose of the authorization request in the 5G ProSe restricted discovery?
question_6459.ground_truth: The authorization request is sent by the M-DDNMF to the ProSe Application Server to get an authorization response for the Discovery Request message if it is authorized. The response is then transmitted to the Monitoring/Discoverer UE.

question_6460.question: Which DCD metadata are supported if SFR server extends the feed metadata with DCD metadata?
question_6460.ground_truth: If SFR server extends the feed metadata with DCD metadata, then DCD Channel-name, DCD Updated, DCD channel-description, DCD genre, and DCD channel-icon may be supported.

question_6461.question: What is the purpose of the secondary authentication between the UE and the DCS?
question_6461.ground_truth: The secondary authentication between the UE and the DCS is performed to ensure the UE during PDU Session establishment.

question_6464.question: What are the additional requirements for the UE and the MME when applying Solution 1 for small data transfer in NAS PDU?
question_6464.ground_truth: The additional requirements for the UE are setting a new value for "Security header type" IE and partially ciphering the initial L3 message, and for the MME, identifying whether the initial L3 message is ciphered and partially deciphering it.

question_6465.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 15.10?
question_6465.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the UE's ability to activate and deactivate Communication Forwarding during times when the user is not logged into the IMS service.

question_6466.question: What is the effect of the DHCPv4 Address Allocation Procedure Indication message in the PMIP-based S5/S8 architecture?
question_6466.ground_truth: The DHCPv4 Address Allocation Procedure Indication message in the PMIP-based S5/S8 architecture is used to indicate that the UE has requested deferred IPv4 address allocation. In this case, the UE initiates the IPv4 address allocation using DHCPv4 after the default bearer establishment procedure is completed. If the IPv4 address lease expires or the UE releases the IPv4 address using DHCPv4, the PDN GW initiates the "PDN-GW initiated PDN-disconnection" procedure to delete the IPv4 address from the PDN connection and bearer contexts. The same IPv4 address shall not be allocated to another UE immediately.

question_6467.question: What should an eP-CSCF do with received media level attributes that do not correspond to a data channel in the SDP offer it forwards to the WIC?
question_6467.ground_truth: The eP-CSCF should encapsulate all received media level attributes, except for "fingerprint" and "tls-id" attributes, into an "tra-att" attribute and add this attribute as a media level attribute for the media line.

question_6468.question: What should a UE do when it receives the ATTACH REJECT message including EMM cause #5 "IMEI not accepted" in a 3GPP network?
question_6468.ground_truth: Upon receiving the ATTACH REJECT message including EMM cause #5, the UE should enter the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-IMSI.

question_6469.question: What is the role of the MS upon receiving a GA-PSR-UFC-REQUEST message?
question_6469.ground_truth: The MS adjusts the uplink data rate accordingly when it receives the GA-PSR-UFC-REQUEST message from the GANC.

question_6470.question: How does the SGSN/MME handle extended C-DRX values in Connected mode?
question_6470.ground_truth: The SGSN/MME is aware of the extended C-DRX value and provides a NAS retransmission timer adjustment by C-DRX. This solution proposes to follow a similar behavior as for idle mode, i.e., when the eNB indicates to the MME that a UE is in long extended C-DRX, the MME enters a substate of ECM connected mode "Temporarily Unavailable".

question_6471.question: What network elements communicate location information between different GMLCs?
question_6471.ground_truth: The communication between different GMLCs occurs via the specified GMLC to GMLC interface.

question_6472.question: What is the purpose of the MCVideo server in providing a progress indication in the call setup process?
question_6472.ground_truth: The purpose of the MCVideo server in providing a progress indication in the call setup process is to inform MCVideo client 1 about the status and progress of the call setup with MCVideo client 2.

question_6474.question: When is it necessary to include exclusive access cells in the "Cell Identifier List (preferred)" in the HANDOVER REQUIRED message?
question_6474.ground_truth: Exclusive access cells should be included if at least one LSA identity in the exclusive access cell corresponds to any LSA identity received in the HANDOVER REQUEST or the latest LSA INFORMATION message, or if the connection is an emergency call.

question_6477.question: What is the maximum aggregate adjustment rate for a UE when the transmission timing error exceeds Te?
question_6477.ground_truth: The maximum aggregate adjustment rate for a UE is Tq per 200 ms for UL signals smaller or equal to 120 kHz, and 100 ms for UL signals larger or equal to 480 kHz.

question_6478.question: In case c) in subclause~5.4.5.2.1, what shall the UE set the Payload container type IE to if it needs to deliver a SLPP message payload?
question_6478.ground_truth: The UE shall set the Payload container type IE to "SLPP message container" in case c) in subclause~5.4.5.2.1.

question_6479.question: What entity selects the LMF for Ranging/SL positioning based on the service request and new factors?

question_6480.question: What should the NG-RAN node do if it receives the RRC Inactive Transition Report Request IE in the INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message and sets it to "subsequent state transition report"?
question_6480.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node should send the RRC INACTIVE TRANSITION REPORT message to the AMF to report the RRC state of the UE when the UE enters or leaves RRC_INACTIVE state.

question_6481.question: What is the purpose of Spatial Anchors in XR and AR experiences?
question_6481.ground_truth: Spatial anchors establish the position of a 3D object in a shared XR or AR experience and are accurate within a limited space, allowing users to explore virtual content while maintaining the localization of the XR Viewer Pose.

question_6484.question: When is the DE-REGISTRATION REQUEST message (UE originating de-registration) sent with integrity protection but without ciphering?
question_6484.ground_truth: The DE-REGISTRATION REQUEST message (UE originating de-registration) is sent with integrity protection but without ciphering when it is sent as an initial NAS message.

question_6485.question: How much is the turbo decoder speed requirement reduced in the time-dilated UMTS system when compared to the UMTS system?
question_6485.ground_truth: The turbo decoder speed requirement is reduced to 1/N in the time-dilated UMTS system when compared to the UMTS system, where N is the time dilation factor.

question_6486.question: What is the difference between Layer-2 and Layer-3 communication via the stateful UE-to-UE Relay?
question_6486.ground_truth: Layer-2 communication involves the use of a "Relay Layer-2 ID" field and a "Direction" field in the Layer-2 frame header, whereas Layer-3 communication involves using the simplified Layer-2 format for ProSe 5G communication. Layer-3 communication is performed at layer-3, and the stateful UE-to-UE Relay acts as an IP router.

question_6487.question: What is the maximum allowed wsegSNR degradation, for TCX-512 mode compliance to be concluded?
question_6487.ground_truth: A wsegSNR degradation of more than 1% is not allowed for TCX-512 mode compliance.

question_6489.question: What message does the MS send to terminate the dialogue after sending a RRLP PROTOCOL ERROR message?
question_6489.ground_truth: The MS sends a RELEASE COMPLETE message to terminate the dialogue after sending a RRLP PROTOCOL ERROR message.

question_6496.question: What error code does the MS send in the RRLP PROTOCOL ERROR message if the RRLP MEASURE POSITION REQUEST is incomplete?
question_6496.ground_truth: The MS sends a specific error code in the RRLP PROTOCOL ERROR message if the RRLP MEASURE POSITION REQUEST is incomplete.

question_6497.question: In the context of the document, what does the term "conducted test methods and conformance requirements" refer to?
question_6497.ground_truth: The term "conducted test methods and conformance requirements" refers to the specific methods and requirements outlined in the document for evaluating the performance of an AAS BS in a controlled laboratory or shielded environment.

question_6499.question: How are security policies determined for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay direct communication?
question_6499.ground_truth: Security policies for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay direct communication include the signalling integrity protection policy, signalling ciphering policy, user plane integrity protection policy, and user plane ciphering policy.

question_6500.question: What is the expected result of a test in the context of network product evaluation?
question_6500.ground_truth: The expected result of a test in network product evaluation should show that the network product is acting as expected and cannot describe the behavior of other network entities or personnel in the environment of the network product.

question_6501.question: For AI/ML assisted positioning with timing information and drop parameters, what is the range of the positioning error when fine-tuning dataset size is 2.0% to 10.0% of the full training dataset size?
question_6501.ground_truth: The positioning error is (1.27-7.68) x E0,B.

question_6502.question: In case a) in subclause~5.4.5.2.3, what should the AMF do if it has received a PDU session routing context for the UE and the PDU session ID, and the Request type IE is not included or is included but set to other value than "initial request", "existing PDU session", "initial emergency request", "existing emergency PDU session", or "MA PDU request"?
question_6502.ground_truth: In case a) in subclause~5.4.5.2.3, the AMF shall send the 5GSM message, and the PDU session ID IE towards the SMF identified by the SMF ID of the PDU session routing context.

question_6504.question: When must the UE send aperiodic L1-SINR measurement reports?
question_6504.ground_truth: The UE should sends aperiodic L1-SINR measurement reports only if a DCI for triggering report has been received.

question_6505.question: What is the purpose of the Positioning Assistance Information Feedback procedure?
question_6505.ground_truth: The purpose of the Positioning Assistance Information Feedback procedure is to allow the gNB-DU to give feedback to the gNB-CU on positioning assistance information broadcasting. It uses non-UE-associated signaling.

question_6506.question: What should a participating MCVideo function do if it receives a SIP INVITE request for a terminating MCVideo client containing an emergency indication or imminent peril indication?
question_6506.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function should check for the presence of a Resource-Priority header field and perform further actions accordingly, generate an outgoing SIP re-INVITE request, include an SDP offer based on the SDP offer in the received SIP re-INVITE request, and send the SIP re-INVITE request towards the MCVideo client.

question_6508.question: What is the size of the RNC-ID and corresponding RNC-ID in the context of 3GPP TS 25.413?
question_6508.ground_truth: The RNC-ID or the Corresponding RNC-ID are 12-bit numbers, ranging from 0 to 4095, in the context of 3GPP TS 25.413.

question_6510.question: How can the Network Functions indicate the purpose of the certificate being requested in the CSR (Certificate Signing Request) to the operator CA?
question_6510.ground_truth: The Network Functions should be able to indicate the purpose of the certificate being requested in the CSR (Certificate Signing Request) to the operator CA by explicitly stating it in the CSR.

question_6511.question: Which function in the TNAP-TNGF architecture is responsible for terminating N2 and N3 interfaces and behaves as an authenticator during UE registration?
question_6511.ground_truth: The Trusted Non-3GPP Gateway Function (TNGF) is responsible for terminating N2 and N3 interfaces and behaves as an authenticator during UE registration in the TNAP-TNGF architecture.

question_6512.question: What should the UE do when it receives a UEInformationRequest message with ra-ReportReq set to true and the UE has random access related information available in VarRA-Report and the RPLMN is included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarRA-Report?
question_6512.ground_truth: The UE sets the ra-ReportList in the UEInformationResponse message to the value of ra-ReportList in VarRA-Report and discards the ra-ReportList from VarRA-Report upon successful delivery of the UEInformationResponse message confirmed by lower layers.

question_6514.question: What is the definition of relative CSI-RSRP accuracy in an inter-frequency case?
question_6514.ground_truth: It is the difference in CSI-RSRP measured from one cell on a frequency in FR2 compared to the CSI-RSRP measured from another cell on another frequency in FR2.

question_6515.question: What is the procedure when a first cell triggers the event in eventTriggered reporting type with no numberOfTriggeringCells and the entry condition is fulfilled for at least one applicable cell?
question_6515.ground_truth: Include a measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportList for this measId, set the numberOfReportsSent to 0, and include the concerned cell(s) in the cellsTriggeredList defined within the VarMeasReportList for this measId, as well as initiate the measurement reporting procedure, as specified in 5.5.5.

question_6516.question: What should be supported by the ME for SMS-PP Data Download to SIM?
question_6516.ground_truth: The ME should support the Proactive SIM: SMS-PP Data Download facility as defined in TS11.14 clause 4.3, 5, 7.1, 12.1, 12.7, and 12.13.

question_6517.question: What is the use of the Redundancy Sequence Number (RSN) in the solution?
question_6517.ground_truth: The Redundancy Sequence Number (RSN) in the solution is used as an indication by the UE in the PDU Session Establishment Request message to indicate whether the first or second PDU session is being established for redundancy.

question_6518.question: What is the significance of the CORBA solution set in the 3GPP specifications?
question_6518.ground_truth: The CORBA solution set is significant because it specifies the mapping of the IRP information model to the protocol specific details necessary for implementation in a CORBA/IDL environment. CORBA (Common Object Request Broker Architecture) is a standard for creating and managing distributed objects, widely used in telecommunications and other industries. By providing a CORBA solution set, 3GPP enables efficient integration of E-UTRAN NRM information into CORBA-based systems.

question_6520.question: What should the mobile station do when timer T3210 expires after sending a PACKET CELL CHANGE NOTIFICATION message with no response from the network?
question_6520.ground_truth: The mobile station should retransmit the PACKET CELL CHANGE NOTIFICATION message at the first possible opportunity.

question_6521.question: What is defined as in-band blocking characteristics in clause 6.19?
question_6521.ground_truth: It is a measure of the receiver's ability to receive a wanted signal at its assigned channel at the TAB connector for NCR-MT type 1-C and NCR-MT type 1-H in the presence of an unwanted interferer, which is an NR signal for general blocking or an NR signal with one resource block for narrowband blocking.

question_6522.question: What is the goal of the gap analysis performed in the feasibility study?
question_6522.ground_truth: The goal of the gap analysis is to assess the ability of existing 3GPP specifications to meet the high-level Multimedia Priority Service requirements.

question_6523.question: What information is used in the GPS Based HeNB Maximum Output Adjustment?
question_6523.ground_truth: The GPS receiver in the HeNB is used to set the maximum output power of the HeNB based on the number of detected satellites and the reception quality of the detected satellites.

question_6524.question: What is the entire delay through the different elements of a GSM system for a full-rate speech channel transmission, as specified in 3GPP TS 03.50?
question_6524.ground_truth: The total delay for a full-rate speech channel transmission within the GSM system should be less than 143.9 ms.

question_6525.question: Which requirements in section 9 of the specification apply to intra-frequency RSRP, RSRQ, and RS-SINR measurements accuracy for PSCell and SCell?
question_6525.ground_truth: The requirements for intra-frequency RSRP, RSRQ, and RS-SINR measurements accuracy for PSCell and SCell are specified in section 9 of the specification.

question_6526.question: What happens if the UE has not re-selected Cell 1 or Cell 2 by the time T2 or T3 expires, respectively, in the area update procedure?
question_6526.ground_truth: If the UE has not re-selected Cell 1 or Cell 2 by the time T2 or T3 expires, then the procedure continues with the next step.

question_6527.question: What is the role of the UE when the PGKs are provided to it?
question_6527.ground_truth: When the PGKs are provided to the UE, they shall be provided with an Expiry Time. The UE uses the PGK that has not expired and with the earliest expiration time to derive the PTK, which is then used to derive the needed ProSe Encryption Key (PEK) to encrypt the data. A receiving UE would need to derive the PTK using the information in the bearer header and then the PEK used to decrypt the data. PGKs that have expired should be deleted from the UE.

question_6528.question: What is the purpose of calibrating the test equipment in a Compact Antenna Test Range (CATR)?
question_6528.ground_truth: The purpose of calibrating the test equipment in a Compact Antenna Test Range (CATR) is to ensure that the measurement errors are within the allowable contribution limit and do not affect the final measurement accuracy.

question_6530.question: What is the role of the application services layer in the MCPTT system?
question_6530.ground_truth: The application services layer includes MCPTT application and any required supporting functions grouped into common services function.

question_6531.question: Which type of E-UTRA UE does the test applicability specified in 4.3.2.2.1.2 apply to?
question_6531.ground_truth: The test applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 15 and forward, supporting EN-DC.

question_6532.question: What is the role of the P-CSCF in case the multimedia PS bearer setup fails, and the terminating call is to be delivered on the CS domain?
question_6532.ground_truth: The P-CSCF sends a response to the S-CSCF indicating the failure of the delivery of the terminating call on the PS domain, and the S-CSCF forwards the response to the SCC AS that attempts to deliver the terminating call on the CS domain.

question_6533.question: What is the requirement for a non-3GPP access network when the UE is onboarding via Trusted non-3GPP access?
question_6533.ground_truth: The non-3GPP access network should advertise an Onboarding enabled indication.

question_6534.question: What action should the NG-RAN node take for each QoS flow in the QoS Flow Add or Modify Request List IE when the QoS Flow Add or Modify Request Item IE is included for an existing QoS Flow Identifier IE?
question_6534.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node should overwrite the content of the full QoS Flow Add or Modify Request Item IE for the existing QoS flow identified by the QoS Flow Identifier IE.

question_6535.question: Which network component is needed for Solutions #46 and #49 to communicate with EAS?
question_6535.ground_truth: The UPF needs to support to communicate with EAS via a local NEF for Solutions #46 and #49.

question_6539.question: What is the issue addressed in Use Case 13 (NRM object instance versions)?
question_6539.ground_truth: The issue addressed in Use Case 13 is the lack of a standardized way to know which IRPVersion a particular managed object (MO) instance belongs to, causing an information gap in the NRM.

question_6541.question: What functions does the MC service server have to support in order to enable the support of MC service group communications over MBS sessions?
question_6541.ground_truth: The MC service server is required to support the different 5G MBS service functionalities to enable the support of MC service group communications over MBS sessions.

question_6542.question: What is the role of the PSER in 5G network services and how is it related to the PSDB?
question_6542.ground_truth: PSER defines an upper bound for non-congestion-related packet losses. In uncongested scenarios, PDU-Sets should not experience a delay exceeding the 5QI's PSDB. For GBR QoS Flows with Delay-critical GBR resource type, a PDU-Set delayed more than PSDB is counted as lost, and included in the PSER unless the QoS Flow is exceeding the GFBR.

question_6543.question: What action should a receiving node take when it receives IEs/IE groups with the "Reject IE" marking that it does not understand?
question_6543.ground_truth: The receiving node should include the Information Element Criticality Diagnostics IE in the Criticality Diagnostics IE for each reported IE/IE group and report it using the Error Indication procedure.

question_6544.question: What is the effect of the Barring of all outgoing calls supplementary service on the Call Forwarding supplementary services?
question_6544.ground_truth: If the Barring of all outgoing calls supplementary service is active, it will prevent the registration or activation of Call Forwarding on Busy, No Reply, or Not Reachable.

question_6545.question: What aspects should be considered in order to facilitate also > 20 MHz CA with a RF performance per CC aligned with that of a Rel-8 LTE 20 MHz CC?
question_6545.ground_truth: In order to facilitate also > 20 MHz CA with a RF performance per CC aligned with that of a Rel-8 LTE 20 MHz CC, the specifications should consider performance degradations, reduced output power per CC compared to 20 MHz Rel-8 LTE, the combining of CCs going through separate PAs based on "air-combining", and lossy wideband combiners as diplexers are not feasible for contiguous CCs. The specifications should also support CA with a PA BW <= 20 MHz.

question_6546.question: What is required of the PLMN operator regarding service announcements in the multicast mode?
question_6546.ground_truth: The PLMN operator shall be able to provide service announcements for a multicast service within and outside of the multicast area defined for the service.

question_6547.question: What mode does the user terminals follow in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication, except for the specified conditions?
question_6547.ground_truth: The user terminals follow the behavior in 5GMM-CONNECTED over 3GPP access.

question_6550.question: What is the procedure that involves searching for the BSIC and decoding the BSIC for the first time when there is no knowledge about the relative timing between the E-UTRAN FDD and GSM cells?

question_6551.question: What is the test purpose for verifying the round-trip delay of a speech channel for a MS in 3GPP TS 03.50?
question_6551.ground_truth: The test aims to verify that the round-trip delay of a speech channel for a MS, which consists of the sum of downlink, DAI output to ERP, MRP to DAI output, and DAI to uplink RF output delays, meets the requirements when using the predefined test sequences SEQ01.COD, SEQ03.COD, SEQ04.COD, and SEQ05.COD.

question_6552.question: What happens to the timer T3396 if an emergency PDN connection is requested while it is already running or deactivated?
question_6552.ground_truth: It does not affect the ability of the UE to request an emergency PDN connection.

question_6553.question: What is the role of the MEAG ID in the Registration procedure?
question_6553.ground_truth: The MEAG ID is used to ensure that the UE requests access to network slices that can share a common AMF. The RAN selects AMF based on the MEAG ID and if it is not able to find an AMF that can support all S-NSSAIs in the Requested NSSAI, it forwards the message to an AMF belonging to the requested MEAG ID. The AMF or NSSF may verify whether all S-NSSAIs in the Requested NSSAI are correctly associated with the same MEAG ID.

question_6555.question: What should the SM entity do when it receives the DEACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message from the network in the GSM case?
question_6555.ground_truth: The SM entity should locally release the related LLC links and acknowledge the network with the DEACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT ACCEPT message.

question_6557.question: What information must the MN provide in step 1 of the Conditional SN Addition procedure when requesting resources for SN terminated bearers?
question_6557.ground_truth: The MN must provide a list of available DRB IDs for SN terminated bearers and Xn-U TNL address information for the respective DRB.

question_6558.question: What is the cell level throughput values for EGPRS and DSR, respectively?
question_6558.ground_truth: DSR achieves 1.7 times higher data capacity compared to EGPRS at the cell level throughput.

question_6559.question: What is the role of the DRA in ensuring Diameter sessions reach the same PCRF?
question_6559.ground_truth: The DRA uses Diameter Realm-Based Routing to ensure all Diameter sessions for Gx, S9, Gxa/c, and Rx reach the same PCRF for a certain UE or IP-CAN session.

question_6561.question: What address does the UE use to discover the UDP port of the PMF in the UPF when establishing an MA PDU session of IPv4 or IPv4v6 PDU session type?
question_6561.ground_truth: The UE discovers the UDP port of the PMF in the UPF using the source port field of an UDP/IPv4 packet, received via the MA PDU session, with the destination port field set to the UDP port of the PMF in the UPF and the destination address field set to the IPv4 address of the PMF in the UPF.

question_6562.question: What is the difference between the Certificate-based and Identity-based approaches in the UE-to-UE relay hop-by-hop security establishment procedure?
question_6562.ground_truth: In the Certificate-based approach, the security materials include the UE's certificate and the root CA certificate(s), which allows the UE to verify the certificates of other UEs. In contrast, the Identity-based approach includes the UE's identity, secret signing key (SSK), public validation token (PVT), and KMS public authentication key(s) (KPAK), which allows the UE to verify the signatures of other UEs in the hop-by-hop security establishment procedure.

question_6565.question: What is the effect of daylight saving time on the Time Zone code in the TP-SCTS?
question_6565.ground_truth: When the sending entity switches from regular (winter) time to daylight saving (summer) time, the Time Zone code in the TP-SCTS changes, such as in the UK where the winter setting is 00000000 and the summer setting is 01000000.

question_6566.question: What is the function of the Non-IP Type header in the Non-IP PDCP SDU?
question_6566.ground_truth: The Non-IP Type header in the Non-IP PDCP SDU indicates the V2X message family used by the application layer.

question_6568.question: Which field in the ReferenceTime-r16 IEs contains the refDays-r16?

question_6569.question: Which component of the F1-C signalling transport deployment is used for the Initial Registration with separate per-PLMN signalling?
question_6569.ground_truth: Each F1-C interface instance uses a separate signalling transport or shares signalling transport with other F1-C interface instances.

question_6570.question: What is the minimum mean power that should be applied to the single antenna port for UE category NB1 and NB2 to meet the reference sensitivity power level requirement?
question_6570.ground_truth: The minimum mean power that should be applied to the single antenna port for UE category NB1 and NB2 to meet the reference sensitivity power level requirement is the minimum power at which the throughput of the UE meets or exceeds the requirements for the specified reference measurement channel.

question_6572.question: What are the functions provided by the Edge Application Server for user plane management event notifications?
question_6572.ground_truth: The Edge Application Server provides the API exposing function, API publishing function, and API management function for user plane management event notifications. The API exposing function allows the invocation of service APIs exposed from the Edge Application Servers and supports charging of API invocations. The API publishing function allows the publishing of service APIs of the Edge Applications to the CAPIF core function of the Edge Enabler Server. The API management function allows the management of service APIs of the Edge Application Servers to the CAPIF core function of the Edge Enabler Server.

question_6573.question: What is a disadvantage of using Fully Qualified Domain Names (FQDNs) to address MTC devices?
question_6573.ground_truth: Using FQDNs requires modifications to most existing billing systems and places a huge burden on DNS servers due to the need for mapping every FQDN to an IP address.

question_6575.question: What is the purpose of using the PDU Set ID in the GTP-U header?
question_6575.ground_truth: The PDU Set ID in the GTP-U header is used to identify a PDU set and indicate its transmission status between UPF and RAN.

question_6577.question: What is the main focus of clause 5 in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_6577.ground_truth: The main focus of clause 5 in the 3GPP technical specification is the key security issues which impact the mission critical service.

question_6579.question: What is the role of the NEF in the 5G Core network?
question_6579.ground_truth: The Network Exposure Function (NEF) is responsible for validating application requests and storing them, as well as interaction with the Unified Data Management (UDR) for storing application requests.

question_6580.question: What is the role of the AF in providing assistance information for power savings in NG-RAN?
question_6580.ground_truth: The AF is responsible for providing the set of periodicities and the associated jitter ranges associated with a specific AF session, which would assist NG-RAN in determining the appropriate power saving scheme for XR applications.

question_6581.question: What action does the PGW take when it receives the UE's latest 3GPP PS Data Off status, with dynamic PCC deployed?
question_6581.ground_truth: When dynamic PCC is deployed, PGW needs to enforce the enhanced PCC rule with an indication of 3GPP PS Data Off Exempt Service received from PCRF and set the Gate status to "closed" in all PCC rules for non 3GPP PS Data Off Exempt Services, if the received UE's 3GPP PS Data Off status is activated.

question_6582.question: What are the limits of the maximum gain for different frequency bands and bitrates in the weighting mask?
question_6582.ground_truth: The maximum gain for the first 1 kHz is 1, for the band between 1 and 2 kHz the maximum gain is 1.5 for bitrates below 12650 bits per second (b/s) and 1 otherwise, for the band between 2 to 4 kHz the maximum gain is 2 for bitrates below 12650 b/s, 1.25 for bitrates equal to or higher than 12650 b/s and lower than 15850 b/s, and 1 for bitrates higher than 15850 b/s. For the band between 4 to 6.4 kHz, the maximum gain is 2 for bitrates below 15850 b/s and 1.25 otherwise. The minimum gain is fixed to 0.5 only if the bitrate is higher than 15850 b/s for the band between 2 to 4 kHz and between 4 to 6.4 kHz.

question_6583.question: What function sends data to an open channel using the proactive command SEND DATA?

question_6584.question: What is one of the functions of the Session Stop indicator in the Accounting-Request STOP message in avoiding race conditions?
question_6584.ground_truth: The Session Stop indicator indicates that the PDU session is terminated and the IPv4 address and/or IPv6 prefix and GTP tunnel can be released. The DN-AAA server shall not assume the PDU session terminated until an Accounting-Request STOP with the Session Stop indicator is received.

question_6585.question: Which bands may have 3rd order IM products falling into the BS receive bands when B39 and B42 are used together?
question_6585.ground_truth: The 3rd order IMD products may fall into BS receive Bands of 1, 2, 22, 25, 33, 35, 36, 37, 39, 42, 43, 48, and 65 when considering the maximum bandwidth impact.

question_6586.question: What are the main decoding steps performed in the internal decoder after MDCT based TCX encoding in order to update the filter memories for CELP coding?
question_6586.ground_truth: The main decoding steps performed in the internal decoder after MDCT based TCX encoding to update the filter memories for CELP coding are adaptive low frequency deemphasis, global gain decoding, residual dequantizer, formant enhancement, noise filling, application of global gain and LPC shaping in MDCT domain, inverse window grouping, and temporal noise shaping.

question_6587.question: What is the function of the Restricted Security parameter in ProSe Direct Discovery?
question_6587.ground_truth: The Restricted Security parameter contains security information elements for ProSe Direct Discovery communication between UEs.

question_6588.question: In which cases shall the UE start the timer T3540?
question_6588.ground_truth: The UE shall start the timer T3540 if it receives the 5GMM cause values #11, #12, or #13, if it receives a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message with certain conditions, if it receives a REGISTRATION REJECT message with the 5GMM cause value #10, or if it receives a SERVICE REJECT message with the 5GMM cause value #10.

question_6589.question: What is the key motivation for partitioning the channel into subcarriers in NB-CIoT physical layer design?
question_6589.ground_truth: The key motivation for partitioning the channel into subcarriers is to enable communications with MSs that have lower peak transmit power but have the worst case coverage defined by the coverage extension objective.

question_6590.question: What happens to upper layer messages when a channel change is required in dedicated channels?
question_6590.ground_truth: In case of a channel change, the RR sublayer will request the data link layer to suspend multiple frame operation before the mobile station leaves the old channel. When the channel change has been completed, layer 3 will request the data link layer to resume multiple frame operation again.

question_6591.question: What measures are mandatory for UE with FDD mode capability?
question_6591.ground_truth: The measures that are mandatory for UE with FDD mode capability are: 9.2.3 CPICH Ec/N0, 9.2.5 CPICH RSCP, 9.2.13 UE transmitted power, 9.2.14 UE Rx-Tx time difference, 9.2.16 UE GPS Timing of Cell Frames for UE positioning, and 9.2.21 UE transmission power headroom.

question_6594.question: How can a specific attribute be updated in the resource representation sent to the MnS Producer?
question_6594.ground_truth: To update only "attrA", the received resource representation needs to contain "attrA" with the new value and "attrB" with the old value. Similarly, to update only "attrB", the received resource representation needs to contain "attrA" with the old value and "attrB" with the new value.

question_6596.question: In the case of object-based audio representation, what are the audio elements represented as and how do they differ from single-point audio capture?
question_6596.ground_truth: Object-based audio representations use a collection of single audio elements, each comprising an audio waveform and a set of associated parameters or metadata. Object-based audio elements offer more spatial accuracy and artistic intent flexibility than single-point audio capture. Object-based audio provides a more immersive and accurate audio experience compared to single-point audio capture.

question_6597.question: What is the 3GPP Technical Specification that provides the principles for interface specifications in the 3GPP TS 48.0xx series?
question_6597.ground_truth: The present document, 3GPP TS 48.0xx, gives the principles on which the detailed interface specifications in the rest of the 3GPP TS 48.0xx series of Technical Specifications are based.

question_6599.question: What is the typical business relationship in CAPIF regarding the API invoker and API provider?
question_6599.ground_truth: The API invoker is typically provided by a third-party application provider who has a service agreement with a CAPIF provider. The API provider hosts one or more service APIs and has a service API arrangement with the CAPIF provider to offer the service APIs to the API invoker. The CAPIF provider and API provider can be part of the same organization or different organizations.

question_6600.question: What is the maximum throughput that can be indicated by peak throughput class 9?
