question_6926.ground_truth: The UE must set the From header field of the INVITE request to "Anonymous" and include a service URN in the Request-URI of the initial INVITE request, a To header field with the same emergency service URN as in the Request-URI, a Contact header field set to include SIP URI that contains in the hostport parameter the IP address of the UE and an unprotected port where the UE will receive incoming requests belonging to this dialog, and a P-Access-Network-Info header field in any request for a dialog, and the location identifier such as the cell id, the line id or the identity of the WLAN access node, which is relevant for routeing the emergency call.

question_6927.question: What is the Failure State in the TFO Protocol caused by?
question_6927.ground_truth: The Failure State is entered when the distant partner shows an incorrect behavior, and the TC then sends pure PCM samples and waits for the failure to disappear without sending TFO Frames or TFO Messages.

question_6928.question: What is the purpose of the MonitoredEntity class in the document?
question_6928.ground_truth: The MonitoredEntity class represents classes that can have an alarmed state. It is used in the AlarmInformation class to identify the instance that is in alarmed state and to identify a back up network resource for the instance that is in alarmed state.

question_6930.question: What message does the target gNB send to the source gNB to indicate the successful switch of the data path to the indirect path via the target L2 U2N Relay UE?

question_6933.question: In the context of the requirements for handover testing, what is the cell identification requirement for a cell to be known?
question_6933.ground_truth: For a cell to be known in the context of handover testing, it must have been meeting the relevant cell identification requirement during the last 5 seconds.

question_6934.question: In the context of inter-frequency handover from NR FR2 to NR FR1, what is the maximum allowed interruption time (Tinterrupt) for UE processing and margin?
question_6934.ground_truth: Tinterrupt = Tprocessing + Tmargin ms, where Tprocessing can be up to 40ms, and Tmargin can be up to 2ms.

question_6935.question: Who is the source device and destination device for the Timer Management commands in the first passage?
question_6935.ground_truth: In the first passage, the source device is ME and the destination device is SIM.

question_6937.question: What does the Mobile-Station-Memory-Capacity-Exceeded-Flag (MCEF) indicate?
question_6937.ground_truth: The Mobile-Station-Memory-Capacity-Exceeded-Flag (MCEF) within the HLR is a Boolean parameter with the value TRUE if an attempt to deliver a short message to an MS has failed with a cause of MS Memory Capacity Exceeded, and with the value FALSE otherwise.

question_6938.question: What should the S-CSCF do if the user requires re-authentication and the REGISTER request did not include an Authorization header field with a digest response?
question_6938.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall proceed with the authentication procedures as described for the initial REGISTER in subclauses 5.4.1.2.1 and 5.4.1.2.1B.

question_6939.question: Which two new messages for the ATSSS rules have been introduced for traffic duplication suspension?
question_6939.ground_truth: The two new messages are for suspending duplication and reactivating duplication.

question_6940.question: At L3, when is a Type 3 receiver expected to have a higher throughput at the LPN?
question_6940.ground_truth: A Type 3 receiver is expected to have a higher throughput at the LPN when the available resource at the Macro is less than about 25% of that at the LPN.

question_6941.question: What is the purpose of the GANC in the network initiated PTC re-activation scenario?
question_6941.ground_truth: The GANC is responsible for establishing the GA-RRC Packet Transport Channel (PTC) and deactivating it during the network initiated PTC re-activation scenario.

question_6942.question: What information does the VAE Server send in a 201 Created message when a new Individual File Distribution resource is created?
question_6942.ground_truth: The VAE Server sends a Location header field containing the URI for the created resource.

question_6946.question: Which clause of the document specifies the minimum conformance requirements for UE specific channel bandwidth (CBW) change?

question_6947.question: What message does the SS send to terminate the downlink TBF?
question_6947.ground_truth: The SS sends a PACKET TBF RELEASE message to terminate the downlink TBF.

question_6949.question: What is the base data type for the "tRadioParametersType" complex type?
question_6949.ground_truth: The base data type for the "tRadioParametersType" complex type is "xs:string" which represents a string value.

question_6950.question: What is the maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell, as assumed in this test case?
question_6950.ground_truth: The maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell, as assumed in this test case, is 1280 ms.

question_6952.question: When does the UE provide the list of stored PSIs during initial registration in 5G?
question_6952.ground_truth: The UE provides the list of stored PSIs during initial registration or when the UE moves from EPS to 5GS to request synchronization.

question_6953.question: What is the maximum allowed time for the UE to identify a new FDD inter-frequency cell in the test procedure?
question_6953.ground_truth: The maximum allowed time for the UE to identify a new FDD inter-frequency cell is defined as TBasic_Identify_Inter, which is 480 ms.

question_6955.question: When does an HLR supporting the "mobile terminating roaming retry" feature sends a MAP Cancel Location message to the old VLR?
question_6955.ground_truth: An HLR supporting the "mobile terminating roaming retry" feature sends a MAP Cancel Location message to the old VLR upon receipt of the MAP Update Location from the new VLR.

question_6959.question: What should be measured for the first preamble?
question_6959.ground_truth: The power and timing of the first preamble, which should not exceed the values specified in 7.3.2.2.2.5.

question_6961.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 5.2.4.3?
question_6961.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in section 5.2.4.3 is to verify that the TRP of the UE is not below specified values by measuring a sufficient number of independent samples in a reverberation chamber and using the equations from chapter 5.2.1 to calculate the TRP.

question_6962.question: What is the gain provided by the semi-static SBFD in the UL when using SBFD Alt 3 and a large packet size at a high load level?
question_6962.ground_truth: The semi-static SBFD provides a mean and 5% UL Average-UPT gain of 1.08%.

question_6963.question: What is the specific procedure for service specific parameter provisioning from the AF to the VPLMN?
question_6963.ground_truth: The procedure for service specific parameter provisioning by the AF to the VPLMN involves the AF sending a request to the NEF, the NEF authorizing the request, and the NEF storing the AF request information in the UDR as the "Application Data". The NEF also sends the Service Parameters to the targeted UE through the PCF when the UE is reachable.

question_6965.question: What is the purpose of the Receivers eNB TNL identity IE introduced in the X2 Setup Request message?
question_6965.ground_truth: The Receivers eNB TNL identity IE allows the X2 Routing Proxy to determine where to send the X2 message to i.e. HeNB#2.

question_6967.question: What is the meaning of the "access-type" parameter in the P-Access-Network-Info header field?
question_6967.ground_truth: The "access-type" parameter in the P-Access-Network-Info header field indicates the type of IP-CAN based on the access technology.

question_6968.question: What information must be included in each xIRI?
question_6968.ground_truth: Each xIRI must include the target identity, time stamp, correlation information, location information, and session related information.

question_6970.question: In the A/V production use cases relying on PLMN infrastructure, which scenario allows the A/V production business to choose from any of the three business relationship models?
question_6970.ground_truth: Both deployment scenarios, fixed and nomadic installations.

question_6971.question: What feature does the mobile station indicate support for in the MS Radio Access Capabilities IE?
question_6971.ground_truth: The mobile station indicates support for Downlink Multi Carrier in the MS Radio Access Capabilities IE.

question_6972.question: What is the role of the IM CSCF in the domain transfer procedure from CS to IMS?
question_6972.ground_truth: The IM CSCF forwards the SIP INVITE message from the UE to the E-CSCF.

question_6974.question: What is the first condition that the new cell must meet for reselection by the UE?
question_6974.ground_truth: The new cell must be better ranked than the serving cell during a time interval TreselectionRAT.

question_6975.question: In the context of sponsored data connectivity, how are sponsored IP flows handled in relation to user's volume cap?
question_6975.ground_truth: Sponsored IP flows are excluded from monitoring for the user's volume cap to prevent charging based on data usage.

question_6976.question: What is the power control tolerance for UE supporting Transmit Diversity, in case of UE with two transmit antenna connectors in Transmit Diversity scheme?
question_6976.ground_truth: The power control tolerance applies to the sum of output power at each transmit antenna connector, and the power control requirements specified for single carrier apply to UE with two transmit antenna connectors in Transmit Diversity scheme.

question_6977.question: When is a UE not required to decode a PDSCH on the primary cell, even when a PDCCH with CRC scrambled by the C-RNTI or SPS C-RNTI is detected in the same subframe?
question_6977.ground_truth: A UE is not required to decode a PDSCH on the primary cell, even when a PDCCH with CRC scrambled by the C-RNTI or SPS C-RNTI is detected in the same subframe, when RA-RNTI and either C-RNTI or SPS C-RNTI are assigned in the same subframe.

question_6978.question: What is the requirement for discovering SSBs in FR2 inter-frequency measurements with CCA?
question_6978.ground_truth: UE shall be able to identify new inter-frequency cells in carrier frequencies with CCA and perform SS-RSRP, SS-RSRQ, and SS-SINR measurements even if no explicit neighbor list is provided.

question_6980.question: What is the power overhead for F-DPCH when using dual antenna UE?
question_6980.ground_truth: For dual antenna UE, the power overhead for F-DPCH is below 15% for CIO up to 9dB.

question_6982.question: What is the role of the MCData server in releasing an ongoing ad-hoc group data communication?
question_6982.ground_truth: The MCData server identifies the participants, generates a release request, sends it to each participant, and removes the ad-hoc group information after receiving acknowledgments.

question_6984.question: What does the P-Charging-Vector header field parameter value "icid-value" identify in step 9?
question_6984.ground_truth: It identifies the home network of the remote user

question_6985.question: When must the UE indicate support for Reflective QoS in a PDU Session that has been transferred from EPS with N26 interface?
question_6985.ground_truth: The UE indicates Reflective QoS support using the PDU Session Modification procedure after the first inter-system change from EPS to 5GS.

question_6986.question: How is the support of the new overload control feature advertised?
question_6986.ground_truth: The support of the new feature related to overload control is advertised with the Supported-Features AVP.

question_6988.question: What is the role of UxNB in the 3GPP system?
question_6988.ground_truth: UxNB is a radio access node on-board UAV that provides connectivity to UEs (User Equipments) carried in the air by an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV). It can also connect with 3GPP core network like a normal ground Base Station.

question_6989.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for this test as specified in 6.5.7C.1.3?
question_6989.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 6.5.7C.0.

question_6991.question: Which 3GPP TS 23.107 standard defined parameter specifies the type of application for which the UMTS bearer service is optimized in the 3G Quality of Service profile?

question_6992.question: What is the difference between ACS and ACLR in the context of mobile communication?
question_6992.ground_truth: ACS (Adjacent Channel Selectivity) is a measure of a receiver's ability to receive a signal at its assigned channel frequency in the presence of an adjacent channel signal at a given frequency offset. ACLR (Adjacent Channel Leakage Ratio) is the ratio of the transmitter's power in an adjacent channel to the transmitter's power in the desired channel.

question_6993.question: What is the purpose of the "UE to UE ToD session-oriented service termination over PC5" procedure?
question_6993.ground_truth: This procedure allows the termination of a tele-operated driving session between two V2X UE devices over the PC5 reference point.

question_6995.question: What is the purpose of the transferring Collaborative Session Control from one UE to another?
question_6995.ground_truth: The purpose of transferring Collaborative Session Control is to change the role of each UE, such as from Controller UE to Controllee UE, or to transfer media flow to another UE.

question_6996.question: What format is the "SSID" and "HESSID" in ANDSF/WLANSP/<X>/SelectionCriteria/<X>/PreferredSSIDList/<X> represented as?
question_6996.ground_truth: The "SSID" and "HESSID" in ANDSF/WLANSP/<X>/SelectionCriteria/<X>/PreferredSSIDList/<X> are represented as chr format.

question_6997.question: What information about the NF Service Consumer does the NRF validate for service request authorization?
question_6997.ground_truth: The NRF validates the NF Type, NF Instance ID, PLMN-ID, and FQDN of the NF Service Consumer.

question_6998.question: What is the requirement for determining authorization for cancelling an MCPTT emergency alert?
question_6998.ground_truth: The IWF may authorize the MCPTT emergency alert cancellation if it has received a SIP request with the <alert-ind> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body set to a value of "false".

question_7000.question: What is the role of a protection relay in power distribution?
question_7000.ground_truth: A protection relay measures the local current, receives the sampled current values from the remote protection relay, and time-aligns the two current samples to calculate the differential current. If the differential current exceeds the threshold, it sends a trip command to the circuit breaker to protect the power line.

question_7002.question: How does the SMF intercept a copy of the packets for all DNs the subject is connected to, in the in-bound roaming case for home-routed roaming?
question_7002.ground_truth: The SMF intercepts a copy of the packets sent and received on the N6 interface side of the PDU Anchor UPF for all DNs the subject is connected to, in the in-bound roaming case for home-routed roaming. In this case, the CSP shall deliver a copy of the packets sent and received on the N9 side of the PDU Anchor UPF towards the serving network.

question_7003.question: What is the procedure followed in Solution #20 when the target UE is out of coverage?
question_7003.ground_truth: In Solution #20, when the target UE is out of coverage, the GMLC determines to use Network assisted sidelink positioning to locate the target UE and selects a Located UE based on the target area. The LMF then triggers the LCS procedure of the Located UE to get the location of the Target UE.

question_7006.question: What triggers the start of T2 in the intra-band PCell TDD case?
question_7006.ground_truth: T2 starts in subframe m for the intra-band PCell TDD case if the first CSI report for SCell1 is received by the SS in a specific subframe, which depends on whether certain subframes were subject to interruption and an intra-band SCell is activated.

question_7007.question: What is the role of the SIP core in the 5GS signalling control plane model?
question_7007.ground_truth: In the 5GS signalling control plane model, the SIP core may interact directly with 5GS via the N5 or Rx reference point to control QoS on a per communication flow.

question_7009.question: What should the UE (MCPTT Client) do when the MCPTT User requests to terminate the ongoing MCPTT Group Call in step (3) under 5.6.1?
question_7009.ground_truth: In step (3) under 5.6.1, the UE (MCPTT Client) should send a SIP BYE message and leave the MCPTT session when the MCPTT User requests to terminate the ongoing MCPTT Group Call.

question_7012.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe Relay User Key (PRUK) in the process of establishing a secure communication between a Remote UE and a UE-to-network relay?
question_7012.ground_truth: The PRUK is used to generate KD for any of the relays under a particular PKMF. Once calculated, KD serves to derive session keys between the Remote UE and the UE-to-network relay.

question_7013.question: How often does the UE need to receive a new Timing Advance Command MAC control element?
question_7013.ground_truth: The UE needs to be provided at least once every 1280ms with new Timing Advance Command MAC control element to restart the Time alignment timer.

question_7015.question: What type of E-UTRA HD-FDD UE with support for intra-frequency SI acquisition for HO is this test applicable to, starting from release 12?

question_7017.question: What is the frequency range covered by the 3GPP technical report on the 7.125 - 24.250 GHz range for the Next Generation access technologies?
question_7017.ground_truth: The frequency range covered by the 3GPP technical report on the 7.125 - 24.250 GHz range for the Next Generation access technologies is 7.125 - 24.250 GHz.

question_7019.question: What message does the BSS send to the MS to initiate the handover?
question_7019.ground_truth: The BSS sends the "PS Handover Command (RN part)" message to the MS to initiate the handover.

question_7020.question: What HTTP method is supported for the "Resource: Individual File Distribution" to support the request data structures?
question_7020.ground_truth: The HTTP method "POST" is supported for the "Resource: Individual File Distribution" to support the request data structures.

question_7023.question: What is the specification impact to support enhancements to inter-UE CLI measurement resources and reporting?
question_7023.ground_truth: The specification impact to support enhancements to inter-UE CLI measurement resources and reporting includes: For L1/L2 UE-to-UE CLI reporting, periodic and/or semi-persistent and/or aperiodic reporting, and for L1/L2 UE-to-UE CLI measurement, periodic and/or semi-persistent and/or aperiodic measurement resource.

question_7024.question: How many MS can be multiplexed on the same physical resource in case overlaid CDMA is used?
question_7024.ground_truth: Up to four MS can be multiplexed on the same physical resource using overlaid CDMA.

question_7025.question: What determines the measurement duration for the last PRS RSTD sample in positioning frequency layer i?
question_7025.ground_truth: The measurement duration for the last PRS RSTD sample in positioning frequency layer i is derived from the duration of PRS-ProcessingSymbolsInEveryTms and the least common multiple between the duration of PRS-ProcessingSymbolsInEveryTms and the DRX cycle length.

question_7026.question: What additional KPIs can be reported by companies in addition to the required KPIs for system performance evaluation?
question_7026.ground_truth: Other KPIs that can be reported by companies include UCI report overhead (e.g., number of UCI reports and UCI payload size) and/or UCI overhead reduction for inference of the AI/ML model, latency reduction, and power consumption reduction.

question_7027.question: Regarding the impact of Band 8 UE transmitter on Band 7 UE receiver in 7.6.1.3, what frequency range does the interference fall into?
question_7027.ground_truth: The 3rd harmonics of band 8 UE transmitter may fall to band 7 UE receiver band, specifically 2640-2690 MHz (only last 50 MHz).

question_7029.question: What action should the en-gNB take if the Integrity Protection Indication IE is set to "required" and it does not support integrity protection for a certain E-RAB in the SGNB ADDITION REQUEST message?
question_7029.ground_truth: The en-gNB should reject the addition of the concerned E-RAB with an appropriate cause value.

question_7030.question: What should the IBCF do if it receives an initial request for a dialog and the network uses the Resource-Priority header field to control the priority of emergency calls?
question_7030.ground_truth: If the request includes a Resource-Priority header field and the network uses the Resource-Priority header field to control the priority of emergency calls, the IBCF should include a topmost Route header field set to the URI associated with an E-CSCF.

question_7031.question: What is the purpose of DBI signaling when used between an MSMTSI client and MSMTSI MRF in multiparty conferencing?
question_7031.ground_truth: DBI signaling is used to improve end-to-end delay and quality performance of the RTP streams exchanged between the clients and conferencing server in multiparty conferencing. It allows negotiation of available additional delay budget for the RTP streams received and sent by the clients and the MRF.

question_7035.question: What are the conditions for a CSI-RS based RLM for FR1 and FR2-1 regarding measuring or receiving restrictions?
question_7035.ground_truth: For both FR1 and FR2-1, the NCR-MT is not required to receive CSI-RS for RLM in the PRBs that overlap with an SSB, and it must consider restrictions while performing CSI-RS measurements based on its capabilities. For FR1, if SSB is present within the active BWP and has a different SCS than CSI-RS for RLM, NCR-MT can have no restrictions or required to measure only one of CSI-RS or SSB, if NCR-MT does not support simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology. For FR1, if CSI-RS for RLM is in the same OFDM symbol as another CSI-RS for RLM, BFD, CBD, or L1-RSRP measurement, it can measure the CSI-RS for RLM without any restrictions. For FR2-1, if CSI-RS for RLM measurement on one CC is in the same OFDM symbol as CSI-RS for RLM, BFD, CBD, or L1-RSRP measurement on the same CC or different CCs in the same band, NCR-MT is required to measure one of but not both CSI-RS for RLM and CSI-RS. Longer measurement periods for SSB based RLM are expected, and no requirements are defined.

question_7036.question: In Solution #24, when must the UE consider forbidden PLMNs for PLMN selection?
question_7036.ground_truth: In Solution #24, if the UE detects a "Disaster Condition" based on the solution for Key Issue #1, then the UE shall perform a PLMN selection and consider the list of "PLMNs to be used while in Disaster condition" in the PLMN selection. If the UE finds a forbidden PLMN that is present in the list of PLMNs to be used while in Disaster condition, then the UE shall consider the forbidden PLMN for PLMN selection.

question_7040.question: What actions should the floor participant take when it receives a Floor Deny message and the <User ID> value in the User ID field matches its own MCPTT ID and the SSRC of the floor participant sending the Floor Deny message matches the stored SSRC of the candidate arbitrator?
question_7040.ground_truth: The floor participant shall stop the timer T201 (Floor Request), provide a floor deny notification to the user, reset the timer T203 (End of RTP media), display the floor deny reason to the user, and enter the 'O: has no permission' state.

question_7041.question: What is the first step in the location reporting procedure when a UE is served by an MBSR (Mobile Base Station Relay)?
question_7041.ground_truth: The AMF serving UE is triggered to initiate the location reporting procedure for UE as specified in TS~23.273.

question_7042.question: What is the role of an authorized 3rd party in the S&F Satellite operation?
question_7042.ground_truth: An authorized 3rd party can apply, on a per UE and/or satellite basis, an S&F data retention period and a data storage quota.

question_7043.question: What must be taken into account when the AMF triggers paging for a UE in CM-IDLE state?
question_7043.ground_truth: The AMF takes into account the MBS service area information when triggering paging for a UE in CM-IDLE state. Only the NG-RAN nodes within the MBS service area are required to trigger paging.

question_7044.question: What action does the old I-SMF take if the old I-UPF receives end marker packets and there is no associated tunnel to forward these packets in the case of I-SMF change?
question_7044.ground_truth: The old I-UPF discards the received end marker packets and does not send any Data Notification to SMF.

question_7045.question: What is the role of the CSI AS in supplementary services?
question_7045.ground_truth: The CSI AS determines the application of Call Forwarding and Call Barring to terminating CUA, and performs corresponding session modification toward the originating UE if the terminating CUA applies call hold or call retrieval.

question_7046.question: What channel coding scheme is used for transport blocks in the NR physical layer?
question_7046.ground_truth: The channel coding scheme for transport blocks in the NR physical layer uses quasi-cyclic low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes with 2 base graphs and 8 sets of parity check matrices for each base graph. The channel coding scheme for PBCH and control information is Polar coding based on nested sequences.

question_7048.question: What are some possible elements in the management loop constituted for the MDA process?
question_7048.ground_truth: Observation, Analytics, Decision, and Execution are some possible elements in the management loop for the MDA process.

question_7050.question: What is the action taken by SCC AS-1 when the Inter UE Transfer is completed and UE-1 keeps the Collaborative Session control?
question_7050.ground_truth: SCC AS-1 activates media-B at UE-2 and releases media-B UE-3 when the Inter UE Transfer is completed, and UE-1 keeps the Collaborative Session control.

question_7052.question: How does the 3GPP define personal data in the context of this study?
question_7052.ground_truth: Personal data is defined as any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person, including physical, physiological, mental, economic, cultural, or social factors specific to that person.

question_7053.question: What is the function of Solutions 1a, 1b, and 1c in relation to the membership verification in the CN?
question_7053.ground_truth: Solutions 1a, 1b, and 1c are different possible ways to perform membership verification (MV) in the CN, either by triggering MV before initiating handover, after handover, or during handover.

question_7054.question: What is the MIME type of the MIME body inserted in the SIP MESSAGE request for a group standalone SDS message?
question_7054.ground_truth: The MIME type of the MIME body inserted in the SIP MESSAGE request for a group standalone SDS message is application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml.

question_7056.question: What is the requirement for the total number of successful tests for the NR SA FR2 event-triggered reporting with gap in DRX test case in order for the test to pass?
question_7056.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests shall be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

question_7057.question: What is the requirement for reporting RSRP and RSRQ measurements in event triggered measurement reports?
question_7057.ground_truth: The reported RSRP and RSRQ measurement contained in event triggered measurement reports shall meet the requirements in 3GPP TS 36.133 in clauses 9.1.21.9, 9.1.21.10, 9.1.21.13 and 9.1.21.14.

question_7058.question: What kind of location service is provided to Bob when he is out of Airport H?
question_7058.ground_truth: When Bob is out of Airport H, he can only access the basic location service provided by operator A.

question_7059.question: What is the purpose of the "Response time" measurement parameter in A-GPS test conditions?
question_7059.ground_truth: The "Response time" measurement parameter in A-GPS test conditions is defined as the time starting from the moment that the MS has received the final RRLP MEASURE POSITION REQUEST, and ending when the MS starts sending the MEASURE POSITION RESPONSE containing the Location Information or the GPS Measurement Information on the Air interface.

question_7061.question: What does the bandwidth efficient mode of RFC 4867 offer in the context of AMR?
question_7061.ground_truth: The bandwidth efficient mode of RFC 4867, when used in the context of AMR, allows for a more efficient use of available bandwidth for conversational speech telephony services. This mode does not apply CRC and robust sorting.

question_7062.question: What does the acronym "LEMF" stand for in the context of telecommunications?

question_7063.question: Under what circumstances is the indicator "Location Information Confirmed in HLR" set to "Not Confirmed"?
question_7063.ground_truth: When the VLR receives a "Reset" message from the HLR with which the MS is registered, or when the VLR in a Super-Charged network receives a Cancel Location message that indicates an "updateProcedure".

question_7064.question: What is the purpose of the Gateway Control Session Establishment Procedure in step A.1?
question_7064.ground_truth: The purpose of the Gateway Control Session Establishment Procedure in step A.1 is for the Serving GW to obtain the rules required for the Serving GW to perform the bearer binding for all the active sessions the UE may establish as a result of the handover procedure.

question_7066.question: What actions does the new 3G-SGSN take if it receives a Downlink Data Notification message or any other downlink signalling message while the MS is still connected?
question_7066.ground_truth: The new 3G-SGSN may prolong the PS signalling connection with the MS.

question_7067.question: What is the term used in the 3GPP technical specification to refer to the frequency ranges in which NR can operate in the range of 24250 MHz - 52600 MHz?

question_7068.question: In the document, what is the difference between A/Gb mode and Iu mode?
question_7068.ground_truth: A/Gb mode refers to the MS operating in GERAN A/Gb mode, while Iu mode refers to the MS operating in UTRAN or GERAN Iu mode.

question_7069.question: What is the main function of the Discontinuous Transmission (DTX) in the GSM system?
question_7069.ground_truth: The Discontinuous Transmission (DTX) in the GSM system is a mode of operation in which the transmitters are switched on only for those frames which contain useful information, with the purpose of prolonging battery life, reducing RF spectrum and improving the measurement of the radio link quality.

question_7070.question: When determining a SR transmission occasion in a PUCCH, if the number of symbols available for the PUCCH transmission in a slot is smaller than the value provided by nrofSymbols, what does the UE not do in the slot?
question_7070.ground_truth: The UE does not transmit the PUCCH in the slot.

question_7071.question: What is the action taken by a UE capable of NR sidelink U2N Remote UE operation when the RSRP measurement of the PCell or the cell on which the UE camps is above threshHighRemote?
question_7071.ground_truth: The UE will consider the threshold conditions not to be met, which is referred to as leaving.

question_7072.question: What happens to the gNB when the UE sends a wake-up signal with Technique A-3-2?
question_7072.ground_truth: When the UE sends a wake-up signal, the gNB can transit to become active for transmitting or receiving a channel/signal as the gNB may be inactive before the receiving the uplink signal from the UE.

question_7073.question: What needs to be investigated by CT1 for the use of SCTP in 10.14.1.2?
question_7073.ground_truth: CT1 needs to investigate how much can be reused from other work in CT4 for the use of SCTP in 10.14.1.2.

question_7075.question: How does the MSGin5G Service enable communication between an Application Server and a UE?
question_7075.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Service enables communication between an Application Server and a UE by providing a service based architecture with functional entities such as M5S, L3G, N3G, and BMG, and reference points between these functional entities for messaging. The M5S function is responsible for managing the distribution of messages, while the AS, L3G/N3G, and BMG functions provide services for sending MSGin5G messages towards Legacy 3GPP UE, Non-3GPP UE, or the broadcast delivery mechanism.

question_7076.question: What is the typical range of the wall penetration loss?
question_7076.ground_truth: The typical wall penetration loss ranges between 10 and 30dB.

question_7077.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG RAN) on the study item "Further enhancements to LTE Time Division Duplex (TDD) for Downlink-Uplink (DL-UL) interference management and traffic adaptation (Release 11)"?
question_7077.ground_truth: The purpose is to provide further enhancements to LTE TDD for DL-UL interference management and traffic adaptation, aiming to improve the network performance and efficiency.

question_7080.question: What are the performance requirements defined for media production over 5G NPN?
question_7080.ground_truth: Performance requirements for media production over 5G NPN are defined in TR 26.805, and focus on identifying how media production can beneficially use 5G systems for media production.

question_7081.question: What is the role of the Security Gateway (SeGW) in this architecture?
question_7081.ground_truth: The SeGW is a mandatory logical function that secures communication from/to the HeNB, and may be implemented as a separate physical entity or co-located with an existing entity.

question_7082.question: What key issue does the solution in 3GPP TS 23.558 clause 7.27.3 address?
question_7082.ground_truth: The solution in 3GPP TS 23.558 clause 7.27.3 addresses Key Issue #17, discovery of a common EAS.

question_7083.question: What is the main advantage of Solution 1a?
question_7083.ground_truth: The main advantage of Solution 1a is that it does not require any new functionality in the UE and keeps the existing macro behavior for source RAN node detection.

question_7087.question: What should the EF and the PCRF include in the Auth-Application-Id AVP and Vendor-Id AVP of the Vendor-Specific-Application-Id AVP when advertising support for an Nt specific application?
question_7087.ground_truth: The value of the application identifier in the Auth-Application-Id AVP and the value of the 3GPP (10415) in the Vendor-Id AVP.

question_7088.question: What type of address is used as the target destination in the Redirect parameter?
question_7088.ground_truth: The Redirect Destination parameter specifies the target redirect address in case the uplink part of the service data flow should be redirected to a controlled address.

question_7092.question: What does MCL represent in the context of network coverage?
question_7092.ground_truth: MCL is the Maximum Coupling Loss (MCL) in uplink and downlink between a device and the Base Station site (antenna connector(s)) for a specific data rate target.

question_7094.question: How does the number of possible antenna positions for vehicular UEs affect their performance compared to handheld use cases?
question_7094.ground_truth: The number of possible antenna positions is much more limited in vehicular UEs than in handheld use cases, making the implementation less arbitrary and more consistent in terms of performance.

question_7095.question: How does human UC identification by the callee happen in the terminating network?
question_7095.ground_truth: Human UC identification by the callee happens in the terminating network as the caller is the only instance who can identify UC. This caller-based UC identification can then be used as input to an IMR-based PUCI AS to prevent UC.

question_7097.question: After how many milliseconds should the MeasurementReport message be transmitted after the beginning of time period T2, as per the requirement in test 1 and 2?
question_7097.ground_truth: Less than 1080 ms for Test 1 and less than 10240 ms for Test 2.

question_7098.question: When shall the UE include in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message the MS determined PLMN with disaster condition IE indicating the MS determined PLMN with disaster condition?
question_7098.ground_truth: The UE shall include the MS determined PLMN with disaster condition IE indicating the MS determined PLMN with disaster condition in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message when it initiates the registration procedure for disaster roaming services.

question_7101.question: What is the initial message content in the case of Expected Sequence 1.1?

question_7102.question: What is the purpose of the media distribution request in this process?
question_7102.ground_truth: The media distribution request is sent by the MC service server 1 or 3 to the MC service server 2 (MBS session control role) to indicate that the media distribution request is used for a specific group call and to request the use of the MBS session for media distribution.

question_7105.question: What is a potential issue when using Diffie-Hellman keying technique with forking to multiple endpoints in a signaling protocol?
question_7105.ground_truth: Performing a Diffie-Hellman operation with each party can be a difficult task for some devices, as it involves calculating multiple Diffie-Hellman secrets and validating signatures.

question_7108.question: What happens if there is a difference between LTE Used Codec and IMS Selected Codec, and transcoding is required in the ATGW?
question_7108.ground_truth: This would be irrelevant after eSRVCC since the LTE Used Codec will discontinue.

question_7110.question: Which system calculate the packet delay between NG-RAN and PSA UPF?
question_7110.ground_truth: The UPF (User Plane Function) calculates the packet delay between NG-RAN and PSA UPF and reports the packet delay value(s) between NG-RAN and PSA UPF, RAN part delay value(s) to SMF.

question_7111.question: What is the purpose of the IP discovery authorization required indication in the PC5 Link Establishment procedure between UE1 and the UE-to-UE Relay?
question_7111.ground_truth: The IP discovery authorization required indication is used to indicate that UE1 requires authorization before its IP address can be discovered by UE2. This provides an additional layer of security to ensure that UE2 is authorized to receive IP address/prefix information of UE1.

question_7112.question: In 5.4.10.3 and 5.4.11.3, what is the procedure for ProSe direct one-to-many communication out of E-UTRA coverage in announcing/discovering and monitoring/discoverer group members?
question_7112.ground_truth: The specific procedure is not outlined in 5.4.10.3 and 5.4.11.3, but it is stated that it should be defined in the test case.

question_7114.question: What are the three attributes of user location information?
question_7114.ground_truth: The three attributes of user location information are location, accuracy, and age of location information.

question_7116.question: What message does the SS send to the MS when it requests for Assistance Data?
question_7116.ground_truth: The SS sends RRLP ASSISTANCE DATA components and the MS sends acknowledgement of RRLP ASSISTANCE DATA ACK for each component.

question_7117.question: What is the service procedure that the provided document measures for the Call Barring service, which results in a 603 (Decline) response being sent to the calling user?
question_7117.ground_truth: Number of Outgoing Communication Barring (OCB) procedure

question_7120.question: What is the serviceability of a network and what are its performance criteria?
question_7120.ground_truth: Serviceability of a network is the delivery of network dependability of service to the end-users. The performance criteria of serviceability are service accessibility, service retainability, service integrity, and disengagement.

question_7121.question: What is the consequence if neither the Assistance Information IE nor the Broadcast IE are included in the ASSISTANCE INFORMATION CONTROL message?
question_7121.ground_truth: If neither the Assistance Information IE nor the Broadcast IE are included in the ASSISTANCE INFORMATION CONTROL message, the NG-RAN Node will consider the procedure as failed.

question_7122.question: What is the purpose of the Additional RRM Policy Index (ARPI) parameter in the Radio Resource Management functions in 3GPP specifications?
question_7122.ground_truth: The Additional RRM Policy Index (ARPI) parameter is used in the Radio Resource Management functions to prioritize the allocation of RAN resources to a set of UEs with the same ARPI. The ARPI parameter can also be used to carry information that is independent of the Reference SPID values.

question_7123.question: How many offset positions are there for the phi-axis and theta-axis ripple tests in the quiet zone ripple test?
question_7123.ground_truth: There are three offset positions for the phi-axis ripple test and eight offset positions for the theta-axis ripple test in the quiet zone ripple test.

question_7127.question: In the scenario where there is no mutual authentication between the NF Service Consumer and the NRF at the transport layer, which network element authenticates the NF Service Consumer when the NF Service Consumer requests an access token from the SCP?
question_7127.ground_truth: The NRF authenticates the NF Service Consumer when the NF Service Consumer requests an access token from the SCP.

question_7128.question: What protocol is used by the UE to determine which SNPNs in the visited country support emergency services in untrusted non-3GPP access via N3IWF?
question_7128.ground_truth: DNS (Domain Name System) is used by the UE to determine which SNPNs in the visited country support emergency services in untrusted non-3GPP access via N3IWF.

question_7129.question: What is required for hosting models identified in clause~5.1 to be supported in this solution?
question_7129.ground_truth: Private edge hosted resources may be secured via zero trust models with per application session authorization, or with VPNs and may have no direct access to central DN.

question_7130.question: What action does the UE take after receiving the Discovery Response message from the ProSe Function in HPLMN when stopping the announcement of a ProSe Application Code before the associated validity timer expires?
question_7130.ground_truth: The UE removes and stops announcing the ProSe App Code corresponding to the Discovery Entry ID, and informs the lower layers to take any appropriate action.

question_7131.question: What is the purpose of "SRBs-Required-ToBeReleased-List" and "DRBs-Required-ToBeReleased-List"?
question_7131.ground_truth: Both "SRBs-Required-ToBeReleased-List" and "DRBs-Required-ToBeReleased-List" are used to specify the list of SRBs and DRBs, respectively, that are required to be released during the UE context modification.

question_7132.question: What is the role of the NEF in AF requests for QoS resources for the AI/ML operation?
question_7132.ground_truth: The NEF provides QoS resources for the AF's AI/ML operation, and when successful, allocates QoS resources for the UEs and initiates QoS monitoring.

question_7133.question: What event is triggered for the PCF to request NW conditions from the NWDAF?
question_7133.ground_truth: The event is triggered when the PCF determines that the network conditions may impact the UEs of the ASP, leading to a re-negotiation of the BDT policy.

question_7134.question: What happens in step 3b and 3c in the procedure described in clause 6c.2.3.1?
question_7134.ground_truth: If there is a match with any transferable session, the EATF proceeds with the Access Transfer and sends a 200 OK response to the I-CSCF.

question_7135.question: What information does the PGW trigger the PGW send the updated list of available P-CSCFs towards the UE via the ePDG if the UE indicates support for the P-CSCF restoration extension for the untrusted WLAN access in the IMS PDN connection establishment?
question_7135.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a P-CSCF restoration indication from the 3GPP AAA Server, the PGW may invoke this P-CSCF restoration extension procedure if the UE and the ePDG support this extension for the untrusted WLAN access. This triggers the PGW to send the updated list of available P-CSCFs towards the UE via the ePDG.

question_7136.question: Which sub-element does "session-oriented-change-info" contain to indicate the reliability requirement of the V2X application?

question_7138.question: What is the intended purpose of the Advanced Alarm Management IRP?
question_7138.ground_truth: The Advanced Alarm Management IRP intends to provide methods to improve the situation when an IRPManager receives a high volume of alarms that inhibits the operator's ability to quickly identify and locate the responsible network faults.

question_7140.question: What is the goal of Solution #35 in the context of edge relocation with user plane latency requirements?
question_7140.ground_truth: The goal of Solution #35 is to provide a solution for enabling an edge computing relocation with considering user plane low latency, when required by the edge application server (EAS) and/or the edge enabler server (EES).

question_7141.question: Under what conditions should an MME send a Notify Request (Homogeneous Support of IMS Voice over PS Sessions) message to the HSS?
question_7141.ground_truth: The MME should send this message if it has evaluated the support of IMS Voice over PS Sessions and if it determines that it needs to update the Homogeneous Support of IMS Voice over PS Sessions.

question_7142.question: What message triggers the test procedure for verifying that the MS correctly considers the TBF starting time during downlink assignment?

question_7143.question: What is the purpose of the video pull to self procedure in MCVideo off-network communication?
question_7143.ground_truth: The video pull to self procedure is used when a MCVideo user requests another MCVideo user to deliver a video from its MCVideo client. It is initiated by a MCVideo user A at MCVideo client A with another MCVideo client B, to pull a video to MCVideo client A.

question_7144.question: What are the two additional rules for Huffman codes in the "deflate" format?
question_7144.ground_truth: The two additional rules for Huffman codes in the "deflate" format are: 1) All codes of a given bit-length have lexicographically consecutive values, in the same order as the symbols they represent; 2) Shorter codes lexicographically precede longer codes.

question_7145.question: What action should the UE take when receiving a 403 (Forbidden) response to a REGISTER request, and SIP digest is being used with TLS?
question_7145.ground_truth: The UE should send a new initial REGISTER request if the UE considers the TLS session to be no longer active at the P-CSCF.

question_7146.question: What value is added to the Record-Route header field when sending the SIP INVITE request in the initial step of charging-Vector?
question_7146.ground_truth: The IBCF-vA1 and IC are added to the Record-Route header field when sending the SIP INVITE request in the initial step of charging-Vector.

question_7147.question: Under what circumstances would an xIRI containing a PTCSessionAbandon record be created in a PTC server?
question_7147.ground_truth: The xIRI containing a PTCSessionAbandon record is created in a PTC server when the IRI-POI present in the PTC server detects that the PTC Session is not established and the request is abandoned before the PTC session starts.

question_7149.question: What entity is responsible for selecting the Sidelink Positioning Broadcast Key (SLPBK) and generating a key identifier (SLPBK-ID) for the sending UE-1 in the broadcast key request phase?

question_7150.question: What action should the receiver take when it receives a LPP message carrying the same sequence number as that last received for the associated location session?
question_7150.ground_truth: The receiver should discard the LPP message.

question_7152.question: What is a key consideration for Model A procedure of ProSe Direct discovery?
question_7152.ground_truth: A key consideration for Model A procedure of ProSe Direct discovery is that it requires the announcing UE to periodically broadcast the direct discovery message, which may consume more announcing UE power.

question_7153.question: What should the floor participant include in the Floor Queue Position Info message when responding to a Floor Queue Position Request message?
question_7153.ground_truth: The floor participant should include the floor participant's own MCPTT ID in the User ID field, the queue position and floor priority in the Queue Info field, the SSRC of floor participant requesting floor queue status info in the SSRC of queued floor participant field, and the value of the User ID field from the received Floor Queue Position Request message in the Queued User ID field.

question_7154.question: Which type of orbit does a geostationary satellite occupy?
question_7154.ground_truth: A geostationary satellite occupies a geosynchronous orbit that lies in the plane of the Earth's equator.

question_7155.question: What is the purpose of Customized Alerting Tones (CAT) in the 3GPP TS 24.182 standard?
question_7155.ground_truth: CAT is a feature that matches the corresponding CS supplementary service in 3GPP TS 24.182 and specifies the binary description of service data for a subset of MMTEL services.

question_7157.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network's Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access (E-UTRA) and Evolved Packet Core (EPC) user equipment (UE) conformance specification, part 3: test suites (Release 18)?
question_7157.ground_truth: The purpose of the specification is to provide the protocol and signaling conformance testing in TTCN-3 for the 3GPP UE at the UE-E-UTRAN radio interface.

question_7159.question: How is the fourth packet in a TCX1024 frame calculated if the third packet is lost?
question_7159.ground_truth: If the third packet is lost in a TCX1024 frame, "index1" is replaced by the logical XOR combination of "parity" and "index0". That is, "Bit 3" is generated from the logical XOR of "Parity Bit 2" and "Bit 6", "Bit 2" is generated from the logical XOR of "Parity Bit 1" and "Bit 5", and "Bit 1" is generated from the logical XOR of "Parity Bit 0" and "Bit 4".

question_7160.question: What is the impact of the GERAN enhancements on the existing network architecture and core network?
question_7160.ground_truth: The GERAN enhancements are expected to have minimal impact on the existing network architecture and should be based on the existing network architecture. The enhancements should also be applicable for Dual Transfer Mode and A/Gb mode interface.

question_7161.question: What is the purpose of the V-EASDF in the process described?
question_7161.ground_truth: The V-EASDF is used for DNS query handling, EC service selection, and EAS discovery. It assists and validates the L-PSA selected by the V-SMF based on H-EASDF trigger.

question_7163.question: What is the maximum length of the short message within the TP-UD field in the case of 16 bit uncompressed USC2 data?
question_7163.ground_truth: The maximum length is 66 ((140-7)/2) characters. A UCS2 character shall not be split in the middle.

question_7168.question: What are the benefits of ICN/CCN to the 3GPP system users?
question_7168.ground_truth: The benefits of ICN/CCN to the 3GPP system users include latency reduction, bandwidth savings on backhaul and core transport links, flexible caching, and security.

question_7170.question: What is the expression of sensitivity in dB in clause 7.4.4?
question_7170.ground_truth: The expression of sensitivity in dB in clause 7.4.4 is dBPa/V.

question_7171.question: What is the difference between radio-related measurements and information for QoE?
question_7171.ground_truth: Radio-related measurements for QoE are collected for all types of supported services, and they include MDT-like measurements and, potentially, additional measurements related to the radio interface. They are reported for assisting application-related QoE measurements. Radio-related information, on the other hand, may be reported even when radio-related measurements are not triggered over the radio.

question_7172.question: Which network entity is responsible for buffering data and notifying the AF about UE reachability in the event of coverage loss?
question_7172.ground_truth: HLCOM (High Layer Connection Management) can be applied while the UE is in PSM/MICO mode to buffer data in the network and notify the AF about UE reachability.

question_7174.question: What should the AMF do if it receives a CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message with the Data type field indicates "control plane user data" and the PDU session ID is not in the AMF's routing context?
question_7174.ground_truth: The AMF may send back to the UE the CIoT user data container or control plane user data which was not forwarded as specified in subclause 5.4.5.3.1 case l1) or case l2).

question_7175.question: What is the purpose of the Paging restriction information element?
question_7175.ground_truth: The Paging restriction information element is used to request the network to restrict paging.

question_7176.question: What is the main defining characteristic of OMR in relation to IBCF and TrGW for interconnect?
question_7176.ground_truth: OMR is used when IBCF and TrGW are used for interconnect, and it aims to establish an optimal media path based on the Home operator's policy, system constraints, and information within SIP signalling.

question_7177.question: How is the PLMN level NRF FQDN constructed when the PLMN level NRF addresses and FDQN are not provisioned into the NF?
question_7177.ground_truth: If the PLMN level NRF addresses and FDQN are not provisioned into the NF, the NF self-constructs the PLMN level NRF FQDN as specified in clause~28.3.2.3.2. The PLMN level NRF FQDN for an NRF in an operator's PLMN shall be constructed by prefixing the Home Network Domain Name of the PLMN, located in which the NRF is located with the label "nrf."

question_7178.question: What happens to the broadcasts scheduled for the period when the eNodeB is unavailable due to a complete breakdown without recovery?
question_7178.ground_truth: The broadcasts scheduled for the period the eNodeB is unavailable do not occur, and even if the broadcast is restored, the CBC cannot report the correct number of broadcasts performed as it does not know the time when the eNodeB stopped broadcasting.

question_7181.question: Which network entity is responsible for collecting charging information related to PS domain resources usage for IP-CAN bearers?
question_7181.ground_truth: The PCNs shall collect charging information on usage of the PS domain network resources for IP-CAN bearers.

question_7182.question: What does the SS do when the value of a parameter in an uplink message is not specified in a test?
question_7182.ground_truth: The SS does not check the parameter unless stated otherwise.

question_7183.question: Which scenario measured the spectral efficiency results of CoMP CS/CB and JP schemes versus single-cell schemes in the FDD Downlink with closely-spaced ULA deployment and non-full buffer traffic model for the 3GPP case 1 channel model?

question_7185.question: What are the procedures in which the "transfer" custom operation is used in the 5G system?
question_7185.ground_truth: The "transfer" custom operation is used in the MBS (Multicast-Broadcast Service) session activation procedure, MBS session deactivation procedure, and multicast session update procedure.

question_7186.question: What is the format of the RAB-SubflowCombinationBitRate in the 3GPP TS 25.427 standard?
question_7186.ground_truth: The RAB-SubflowCombinationBitRate is an integer value ranging from 0 to 16000000, indicating the maximum bit rate for an RAB subflow.

question_7189.question: What is the role of the MME in the 3GPP TS 24.301 standard if the UE exceeds limits for small data transfer?
question_7189.ground_truth: The MME may disallow the UE to continue transferring IP packets via NAS, initiate the S1 release, and perform the normal paging procedure when limits for small data transfer are exceeded.

question_7190.question: What is the effect of setting the expiration time of a new MCVideo group information entry to the current time increased with the candidate expiration interval?
question_7190.ground_truth: This means that the expiration time of the new MCVideo group information entry is set to the current time plus the candidate expiration interval, which keeps the entry valid for a certain period.

question_7191.question: What happens when the SMF decides to insert an UL Classifier (UL CL) in the data path of a PDU Session?
question_7191.ground_truth: When the SMF decides to insert an UL Classifier (UL CL) in the data path of a PDU Session, it enables the forwarding of UL traffic towards different PDU Session Anchors and the merge of DL traffic to the UE. This is based on traffic detection and forwarding rules provided by the SMF.

question_7194.question: What are the non-exhaustive key issues for tenant management that the document aims to address?
question_7194.ground_truth: The non-exhaustive key issues for tenant management include studying tenancy, tenant, and tenant management key concepts, different exposure of network management capabilities for different tenants, and the relation of tenant management, communication service management, and network management, including network slicing management.

question_7196.question: In the context of 5GSM, what is the procedure when a UE or the network initiates a transaction related procedure?
question_7196.ground_truth: When the UE or the network initiates a transaction related procedure, it shall include a valid PTI value in the message header of the request message or of the command message.

question_7197.question: What headers should not be modified by the IBCF when involved in the registration procedure?

question_7199.question: What is the purpose of the overload control mechanisms in the IMS?
question_7199.ground_truth: The overload control mechanisms in the IMS are used to manage traffic and prevent network congestion. They include a feedback-based mechanism that utilizes the Via header field of signalling messages, and an event package for distributing load filters. These mechanisms can be used to address expected overload situations and prioritize certain types of traffic, such as priority and emergency calls.

question_7200.question: What action does MSC-2 take when it receives the Handover Complete message indicating a locally switched call?
question_7200.ground_truth: MSC-2 notifies other CN nodes that LCLS is connected and updates the MGW that LCLS is connected and CN UP can be de-activated.

question_7201.question: What is the difference between registering a functional identity to an FRMCS Equipment as opposed to a FRMCS User?
question_7201.ground_truth: Registering a functional identity to an FRMCS Equipment is required for Equipment that can be registered to a functional identity, but doesn't allow for FRMCS User login. A FRMCS User, on the other hand, can log in to the FRMCS System and register to functional identities related to the user.

question_7204.question: What is the action taken by the PCRF when path-switch occurs and the PCEF informs the PCRF of a new IP-CAN type for UE initiated resource reservation through the non-primary BBERF?
question_7204.ground_truth: The PCRF shall reject the request if a non-primary BBERF request results in a change of the QoS rules active in the primary-BBERF.

question_7206.question: What is the purpose of the spectral envelope concealment in synthesizing the decoded speech?
question_7206.ground_truth: The spectral envelope is moved to an estimated reference envelope to synthesize the decoded speech. The estimated LSF vector is converted to an LSP vector and interpolated with the last frame's LSP vector for 4 or 5 subframes.

question_7207.question: What are the four categories of control channels defined in the document and what are their intended use?
question_7207.ground_truth: The four categories of control channels defined in the document are broadcast, common, dedicated and CTS control channels. They are intended to carry signalling or synchronization data.

question_7208.question: What should the MS do after activating the new channel during handover in the non-synchronized case?
question_7208.ground_truth: After activating the new channel, the MS shall transmit the HANDOVER COMPLETE message without undue delay, and correctly retransmit Layer 3 MM or CC messages, that were not acknowledged by Layer 2 before the Handover, after completion of the Handover.

question_7210.question: Which type of MAC control element consists of a single field containing the C-RNTI of a MAC entity?

question_7211.question: What should the VAE-C include in the Request-URI field of the HTTP POST request?
question_7211.ground_truth: The URI corresponding to the identity of the other VAE-C.

question_7213.question: In what scenarios might a UE proactively inform the RAN of updates/changes to its supported models or functionalities?
question_7213.ground_truth: When there is a need for AI/ML model or functionality updates, or when a UE moves to a new cell or changes its capabilities.

question_7214.question: What should the MCData client do upon receipt of a HTTP 201 Created containing a Location header field with a URL identifying the location of the resource where the file has been stored on the media storage function?
question_7214.ground_truth: The MCData client should store this information.

question_7215.question: In LTE-A, what should be considered for the transmitter characteristic for adjacent channel leakage ratio (ACLR)?
question_7215.ground_truth: The investigation can be defined for intra band contiguous component carrier (CC) aggregation, intra band non-contiguous (CC) aggregation, and inter band contiguous (CC) aggregation.

question_7217.question: What is checked in step 6 of the test procedure outlined in section 10.5.3.2.4.2?
question_7217.ground_truth: In step 6 of the test procedure outlined in section 10.5.3.2.4.2, the SS-SINR value of Cell 3 reported by the UE is compared to the expected SS-SINR.

question_7218.question: What must the gNB ensure while deactivating a PUCCH SCell?
question_7218.ground_truth: NG-RAN ensures that SCells mapped to PUCCH SCell are deactivated before the PUCCH SCell is changed or removed.

question_7219.question: What criteria must be met for a PRS resource to be considered fully overlapped with PPW?
question_7219.ground_truth: All instances of the PRS resource are overlapped with a PPW occasion.

question_7220.question: What is the main issue addressed in the "Solution - Directly Reporting to MTC Server from CN entity" solution?
question_7220.ground_truth: The main issue addressed in this solution is that the MTC Event Reporting entity (e.g. SGSN/MME or GGSN/PGW or PCRF) is not aware of the MTC Server identity. Thus, it cannot send the MTC Event Report to the MTC Server.

question_7221.question: What is the provision for NF certificates in clause 6.1.3c.3 in addition to clause 6.1.1 and the provisions of RFC 5280?
question_7221.ground_truth: The provision for NF certificates in clause 6.1.3c.3 is to use subjectAltName entries (DNS-ID, SRV-ID, URI-ID) over the use of the subject field (CN-ID) where available, and to follow the CA-browser forum requirement on the CN-ID if present.

question_7222.question: What is the data type of the "expectationFulfilmentResult" property in the "IntentFulfilmentReport" data type?
question_7222.ground_truth: The data type of the "expectationFulfilmentResult" property is an array of "ExpectationFulfilmentResult" objects.

question_7223.question: When does a Network Element transmit ACR Interims during a session in offline charging?
question_7223.ground_truth: A Network Element may transmit multiple ACR Interims during a session based on the progression of the session or when charging conditions change.

question_7224.question: What happens if the functional alias is not currently active when the request is targeted at a functional alias in the partner MC system?
question_7224.ground_truth: The ACM server stores the request and will send it to the ACM client of the partner MC system when the functional alias becomes active.

question_7225.question: What is the purpose of the "Knrp" element in the 3GPP 5G Pro Se PC3ach interface?
question_7225.ground_truth: The "Knrp" element contains the "KNRP" parameter, which is used to indicate the "Known NG-RAN Node Response" in the 5G network.

question_7226.question: What is the purpose of using multiple instances of KDF in the EYSET equation?
question_7226.ground_truth: If e2mKEYSET includes more than 256 bits of key material, then multiple instances of KDF are used with different key type strings (key type A, key type B, etc.).

question_7228.question: What is the purpose of the "stereo-to-mono downmix tool" in the Enhanced aacPlus decoder?
question_7228.ground_truth: The "stereo-to-mono downmix tool" in the Enhanced aacPlus decoder enables a decoder only capable of mono output to downmix a stereo bitstream.

question_7229.question: In the process of rejoining an ongoing MCPTT group call, what action does the MCPTT client 1 initiate?
question_7229.ground_truth: The MCPTT client 1 initiates a group call rejoin request, which includes the ongoing group call information.

question_7234.question: What happens to time measurement for a Monitoring key when time based usage monitoring is disabled before the Inactivity Detection Time is reached?

question_7235.question: How long does the UE have to finish BWP switching as per 3GPP TS 38.133 Clause 8.6.2?
question_7235.ground_truth: The UE is allowed to have an interruption of up to X slots to other active serving cells during BWP switching delay TBWPswitchDelay as defined in TS 38.133 Clause 8.6.2.

question_7238.question: In what sub-state of the GMM-REGISTERED state can user data and signalling information be sent and received?

question_7239.question: What should a UE do upon receiving the TAU Accept message with ISR Activated indication and a GUTI TIN?
question_7239.ground_truth: The UE should set its TIN to "GUTI" in this situation.

question_7240.question: What is the length of the FSN/DRT Reset field in bits?
question_7240.ground_truth: The length of the FSN/DRT Reset field is 1 bit.

question_7241.question: What action will the UE take if the validity conditions of a WLANSP rule are not met?
question_7241.ground_truth: The UE will consider the rule as invalid.

question_7242.question: What are the three procedures the network can use to request a dispatcher to join a voice group call channel as a talker, besides the channel assignment procedure?
question_7242.ground_truth: A handover procedure, a channel mode modify procedure, or a channel release procedure can be used to request a dispatcher to join a voice group call channel as a talker.

question_7243.question: What is the expected sequence for the SEND USSD procedure with 7-bit default coding and text attribute?

question_7244.question: When should a UE set the media streams to inactive in the SDP offer during session establishment?
question_7244.ground_truth: If the desired QoS resources for one or more media streams have not been reserved at the UE when constructing the SDP offer, the UE should set the related media streams to inactive, by including an "a=inactive" line, unless the UE knows that the precondition mechanism is supported by the remote UE.

question_7246.question: What is the value that identifies the application to be invoked by the terminating UE in IMS?

question_7247.question: What are the additional spurious emissions requirements for inter-band EN-DC with Tx Diversity within FR1?
question_7247.ground_truth: The additional spurious emissions requirements specified for E-UTRA in clause 6.6.3.3 of TS 36.101 and for NR Tx Diversity specified in clause 6.5G.3 of TS 38.101-1 apply for each component carrier.

question_7248.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in producing the "User Equipment (UE) conformance specification; Part 3: Abstract Test Suite (ATS)" technical specification?
question_7248.ground_truth: The 3GPP produced this specification to provide a detailed TTCN test design framework and the specific test specifications in TTCN for UE at the Uu interface.

question_7249.question: What does the new SGSN do after receiving the Forward SRNS Context message from the source RNC?
question_7249.ground_truth: The new SGSN sends a Forward SRNS Context Acknowledge message to the old SGSN to confirm the receipt.

question_7250.question: In A/Gb and Iu mode, what happens to the PDP contexts and MBMS contexts when the GPRS detach procedure is performed?
question_7250.ground_truth: In both A/Gb and Iu mode, if the GPRS detach procedure is performed, the PDP contexts and MBMS contexts are deactivated locally without peer-to-peer signaling between the SM and LLC entities in the MS and the network.

question_7251.question: What is the result if the network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure fails for a certain S-NSSAI?
question_7251.ground_truth: If the network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure fails for a certain S-NSSAI, the AMF may initiate the PDU Session Release procedure to release the PDU sessions associated with that S-NSSAI.

question_7252.question: What message does the SS send to alter the downlink radio environment in Step 2b and Step 3d?
question_7252.ground_truth: The SS sends a command to alter the downlink radio environment so that the carrier to interference ratio is set to 4 dB above the highest of the upwards thresholds Thr1u in Step 2b and Step 3d.

question_7253.question: How does a UE know to remove stored Disaster Condition information after receiving a de-registration request?
question_7253.ground_truth: Upon receiving a registration reject, service reject, or de-registration request with 5GMM cause #11 (PLMN not allowed), the UE removes the stored information on Disaster Condition from its storage.

question_7254.question: What is the uplink-downlink separation for the ECC plan in Europe?
question_7254.ground_truth: The uplink-downlink separation for the ECC plan in Europe is 100 MHz.

question_7255.question: How is an IMSI-Group Identifier composed?
question_7255.ground_truth: An IMSI-Group Identifier is composed of four parts: Group Service Identifier, Mobile Country Code (MCC), Mobile Network Code (MNC), and Local Group Id.

question_7256.question: What is solution 1 for changing the user plane session identity in load balancing scenarios?
question_7256.ground_truth: Solution 1 involves the control plane of the functional entity changing the user plane session identity from one user plane function to another, informing the new identity to the peer entities.

question_7257.question: In the 3GPP Technical Specification, what does the symbol "A" represent in the context of network energy savings for NR (Release 18)?
question_7257.ground_truth: The symbol "A" represents the ratio between the dynamic power consumption of the antenna part and the dynamic DL power consumption of a base station in an active state.

question_7259.question: What is the effect of the MCData request for extension and response for extension?
question_7259.ground_truth: The MCData request for extension is sent from the MCData client to the MCData server and from MCData server to authorized MCData user to request for an extension of MCData communication, and the MCData response for extension is sent from the authorized MCData user to the MCData server and MCData client to the MCData server and from MCData server to MCData client to grant or deny the extension of MCData communication.

question_7260.question: What action must the network take during the temporary inactive periods in the uplink direction for the mobile station?
question_7260.ground_truth: The network continues allocating the mobile station uplink radio blocks during the inactivity period, using the procedures defined in sub-clause 8.1.1 for each medium access mode.

question_7261.question: For NB-IoT in NR, what is the minimum requirement for in-band and guard band operation?
question_7261.ground_truth: The E-UTRA minimum requirement specified in clause 6.6.4.1 should apply.

question_7262.question: How frequently should the UE filter RSRP or RSRQ measurements of inter-frequency cells?
question_7262.ground_truth: The UE should filter RSRP or RSRQ measurements of each measured higher, lower, and equal priority inter-frequency cell using at least 2 measurements, with at least two measurements spaced by at least Tmeasure,EUTRAN_Inter/2 within the set of measurements used for the filtering.

question_7263.question: What is the duration of each measurement for power control levels 7 and 11 in step i)?
question_7263.ground_truth: The duration of each measurement for power control levels 7 and 11 in step i) is such as to cover at least 10 burst transmissions at FT.

question_7264.question: What is the feature addressed in 4.8 of the NSCE server's predictive slice modification in edge-based deployments?
question_7264.ground_truth: The feature addresses the scenario where the NSCE server is deployed at the edge and the migration to a different Data Network requires ongoing slice support at the target area to meet application session requirements.

question_7265.question: What action does the IMS-AGW take after receiving a TCP SYN from the core network to establish a TCP connection?
question_7265.ground_truth: The IMS-AGW sends a TCP SYN towards the core network to establish a TCP connection and completes the TCP connection establishment after the remote peer answers with a TCP SYN ACK and the IMS-AGW replies with a TCP ACK.

question_7270.question: What interface does NR-SS-UE 1 use for sidelink communication?

question_7271.question: What is the pre-condition for establishing a session-oriented service update in Solution #6?
question_7271.ground_truth: The pre-condition for establishing a session-oriented service update is that the VAE client (remote controller) has established a session-oriented service with a VAE client (remote vehicle) via the VAE server.

question_7272.question: What should the MS respond with when receiving an XID command with an unrecognized type field?
question_7272.ground_truth: The MS should ignore the SABM or XID command and respond with the same unrecognized type field in the XID response.

question_7274.question: In which aspects may PT1 increase the complexity for the scheduling, in the context of relaxed UE processing timeline?
question_7274.ground_truth: PT1 may increase the complexity for the scheduling in scenarios where Rel-18 RedCap UEs coexist with legacy UEs, may have an impact on scheduling flexibility as several timing requirements are related to N1/N2 values, and may cause potential coexistence issues with legacy UEs if early identification of Rel-18 RedCap UEs prior to Msg2 scheduling is not supported.

question_7276.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the NR SA FR1 event-triggered reporting tests for FR1 with NCSG for inter-frequency measurement?
question_7276.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 6.6.19.0.

question_7277.question: What does the GCS AS do when it detects a restart in the BM-SC?
question_7277.ground_truth: When the GCS AS detects a restart in the BM-SC, it assumes that all the TMGIs that had been assigned by the restarted BM-SC have been de-allocated and all the related MBMS bearers have been deactivated. The GCS AS may restore the MBMS delivery using the MB2-C procedures.

question_7278.question: What is the role of the VGMLC in the 5GC-MT-LR procedure?
question_7278.ground_truth: The VGMLC, or visiting GMLC, receives information from the LMF and forwards it to the HGMLC, or home GMLC.

question_7280.question: What is the size of the "Transport blocks in a bundle" field when the DCI Field "HARQ-ACK bundling flag" is set to 1?
question_7280.ground_truth: 2 bits, which can indicate from 1 to 4 transport blocks in a bundle.

question_7281.question: What must the AMF do if the UE received a Service Request message with a Release Request indication or a Reject Paging Indication over 3GPP access?
question_7281.ground_truth: The AMF removes any stored Paging Restriction Information from the UE context and triggers the AN Release procedure.

question_7284.question: What is an MBSFN cluster in the UTRAN network?
question_7284.ground_truth: An MBSFN cluster is a set of cells operating in MBSFN mode, providing only MBMS service in PtM mode, and appearing as a single cell to a UE in terms of radio frequency.

question_7285.question: What is the role of the Authorization Function in the local user authentication architecture?
question_7285.ground_truth: The Authorization Function acts as a proxy to the multi-factor authentication server (e.g., OP/NAF) and carries out authentication on behalf of the server. It confirms assertions generated from user credentials and provides authorization to use the GBA authentication.

question_7287.question: When can the Sidelink Positioning and Ranging services be performed without network involvement?
question_7287.ground_truth: The Sidelink Positioning and Ranging services can be performed without the network involvement when UE C and UE D are out of coverage or with partial network coverage.

question_7288.question: What should a UE do if the conditions for using the "mediasec" header field parameter for media plane security mechanisms are met?
question_7288.ground_truth: The UE may initiate the media security mechanism on a media level when it initiates new media in an existing session.

question_7289.question: Which type of E-UTRA UE does 6.5B.2.3.3.1.2 apply to?
question_7289.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 15 and forward, supporting inter-band EN-DC within FR1 with 1 NR UL.

question_7290.question: What is the purpose of the Floor Priority field in the floor control messages?
