question_7290.ground_truth: The Floor Priority field in the floor control messages describes the level of priority requested in a Floor Request message or granted in a Floor Granted message, with the maximum priority level negotiated between the MCPTT client and the controlling MCPTT function.

question_7291.question: What should the SCF do upon receipt of a SIP BYE message in PSS streaming session teardown?
question_7291.ground_truth: The SCF shall forward it to the PSS adapter and send a SIP BYE message to the IM CN Subsystem, and then to the UE.

question_7292.question: What element in a X.509 certificate contains the subject's public key information?

question_7294.question: Which service announcement mode has been added in TS26.346 to indicate that the service announcement metadata for a service is delivered in-band with the data?
question_7294.ground_truth: A new service announcement mode named "self-contained" mode.

question_7295.question: What is the maximum frequency error allowed for the MS carrier frequency in subclause 13.1a.2 under both normal and extreme conditions?
question_7295.ground_truth: The maximum frequency error allowed for the MS carrier frequency in subclause 13.1a.2 under both normal and extreme conditions is 0.1 ppm (0.2 ppm for GSM 400 MS).

question_7297.question: What is the aim of the "Successful sessions forwarded to IBCF" measurement?
question_7297.ground_truth: The aim of the "Successful sessions forwarded to IBCF" measurement is to provide the number of successful sessions forwarded to the IBCF in the selected network for sessions routing to another IMS network or other SIP-based multimedia networks, if local policy requires IBCF capabilities towards another network.

question_7298.question: When would an ECS need to de-register with the ECS-ER?
question_7298.ground_truth: An ECS needs to de-register with the ECS-ER when it no longer wishes to provide edge services. The ECS sends an ECS de-registration request to the ECS-ER, which then verifies the security credentials and de-registers the ECS.

question_7299.question: What should the SGW do when DL data arrives and the UE has moved out of coverage for the small data fast path?
question_7299.ground_truth: Return GTP-U Error Indication to the SGW and include the undelivered small data in the GTP-U Extension Header

question_7300.question: What is the allowed handover delay in the E-UTRAN FDD - cdma2000 1xRTT handover test?
question_7300.ground_truth: The allowed handover delay is less than 130 ms (maximum RRC procedure delay) + Tinterrupt in the E-UTRAN FDD - cdma2000 1xRTT handover test.

question_7301.question: What information is included in the MBMS NOTIFICATION UPDATE COMMAND message?
question_7301.ground_truth: The MBMS NOTIFICATION UPDATE COMMAND message includes the NI Information IE, Modification Period IE, and MICH CFN IE.

question_7303.question: What should be the PLMN-BC parameter Information Transfer Capability when interworking with an indirectly connected restricted 64 kbit/s network is required?
question_7303.ground_truth: The PLMN-BC parameter Information Transfer Capability should be set to "Other ITC" and Other ITC parameter is set to "restricted digital" when interworking with an indirectly connected restricted 64 kbit/s network is required.

question_7305.question: What is the command used for downloading a USAT profile onto the UICC automatically upon start-up?
question_7305.ground_truth: The command is +CUSATD, which can determine if and optionally which profile should be downloaded to the UICC automatically upon start-up.

question_7306.question: What frame rates are allowed for H.264/AVC Full HD Operation Point?
question_7306.ground_truth: A Bitstream conforming to the H.264/AVC Full HD Operation Point shall have one of the following frame rates: 24, 25, 30, 50, 60, 24/1.001, 30/1.001, 60/1.001 Hz.

question_7307.question: What are the SIP header fields applicable on a roaming II-NNI?
question_7307.ground_truth: The SIP header fields applicable on a roaming II-NNI are Authentication-Info, Authorization, P-Associated-URI, P-Called-Party-ID, P-Preferred-Service, P-Profile-Key, P-Served-User, P-Visited-Network-ID, Path, Priority-Share, Proxy-Authenticate, Proxy-Authorization, Resource-Share, Restoration-Info, Service-Route, and WWW-Authenticate.

question_7308.question: What is the main goal of a spatial mapping service in the 5G system?
question_7308.ground_truth: The main goal of a spatial mapping service in the 5G system is to create a spatial map for a location, which makes it possible to localize users in that location and assign spatial anchors there.

question_7309.question: What is the structure of the XML schema for the EPIRP Notification in 3GPP TS 32.365?
question_7309.ground_truth: The XML schema for the EPIRP Notification in 3GPP TS 32.365 includes a root element named "ePIRPNotif.xsd", which defines a complex type named "NotifyIRPInfoChanges" that contains a sequence of elements including "body", which further contains the elements "IRPDN", "ChangeMode", and "AdditionalText".

question_7311.question: What type of signal can a blocking signal be in this test scenario, and what frequency range can it be located in?
question_7311.ground_truth: A blocking signal can be a continuous, static sine wave signal or a static signal modulated with 5 MHz W-CDMA. It can be located within or outside the in-band frequency range and the out-of-band frequency range.

question_7312.question: Who sends the location reporting trigger in the client-triggered location reporting procedure?
question_7312.ground_truth: Location management client 2 (authorized MC service user) sends a location reporting trigger to the location management server.

question_7313.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network in the context of the Extended-Band 12 new E-UTRA Band?
question_7313.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network is responsible for the development of the technical specification for the Extended-Band 12 new E-UTRA Band.

question_7314.question: What action should the User Agent (UA) take to invoke Communication Deflection?
question_7314.ground_truth: The UA should send a 302 (Moved Temporarily) response to the initial INVITE request, including a Contact header field with the address where the communication is diverted to.

question_7315.question: What should the mobile station do when timer T3208 expires after not receiving any PACKET NEIGHBOUR CELL DATA, PACKET CELL CHANGE CONTINUE, PACKET MEASURMENT ORDER, or PACKET CELL CHANGE ORDER messages in CCN mode?
question_7315.ground_truth: The mobile station should leave CCN mode and continue cell reselection in NC0/NC1 mode.

question_7316.question: What network elements support the indirect and hybrid models of MTC in addition to IMS network elements?
question_7316.ground_truth: The network elements that support the indirect and hybrid models of MTC are MTC-IWF, HLR/HSS, GGSN/PGW, and SGSN/MME.

question_7317.question: If the MS supports CAG, what information does the MS present to the user for each PLMN/access technology combination for NG-RAN access technology?
question_7317.ground_truth: The MS presents the PLMN/access technology combination, a list of CAG-IDs, and the PLMN/access technology combination without a list of CAG-IDs, if there is an available NG-RAN cell which is not a CAG cell for the PLMN.

question_7318.question: In Example 1, when the NAI decoration is not used, what is the format of the Fast Re-authentication NAI?
question_7318.ground_truth: The Fast Re-authentication NAI takes the form of "username@domain", where the username is the fast re-authentication identity returned by the 3GPP AAA Server (458405627015 in this example) and the domain is the domain name corresponding to the HPLMN (wlan.mnc015.mcc234.3gppnetwork.org in this example).

question_7321.question: What should the EPS bearer identity be set to, in the mapped EPS bearer context or the association between QoS flow and mapped EPS bearer in the PDU session?
question_7321.ground_truth: The EPS bearer identity should be set to the EPS bearer identity received in the mapped EPS bearer context, or the EPS bearer identity associated with the QoS flow.

question_7322.question: What is the purpose of the SIP INFO request in sending the URL of the file where the MCVideo media stream will be recorded?
question_7322.ground_truth: The purpose of the SIP INFO request is to send additional information about the video call, specifically the URL of the file where the media stream will be recorded.

question_7323.question: What should the UE do with the mapped 5G security context if the handover is not completed successfully?
question_7323.ground_truth: The UE should delete the mapped 5G security context.

question_7325.question: In which direction does the BSSGP perform flow control between the SGSN and the BSS?

question_7327.question: What happens to the SMS over IP usage when the network operator's preference for selection of the domain to not invoke the SMS service over IP networks?
question_7327.ground_truth: The policy on usage of SMS over IP has no effect.

question_7328.question: What reference points are used in the EDGEAPP architecture for federation functionalities?
question_7328.ground_truth: EDGE-9 and EDGE-10 are used in the EDGEAPP architecture to support federation functionalities, such as EAS discovery, ECS registration, and service provisioning information retrieval. These reference points enable sharing of edges nodes and facilitate roaming, federation, and edge node sharing.

question_7329.question: What is the subcounter in MM.HoOutExe5gsToEpsReq that provides the number of failed executions at the source gNB for handovers from 5GS to EPS, split into subcounters per failure cause?

question_7333.question: What does the SIP REFER request sent from UE-3 in step 1-2 of the ECT call flow initiate the transfer of a session?

question_7335.question: In what order should the contacts of the SIM/ME interface be deactivated when the ME is soft powered down and the clock is running?
question_7335.ground_truth: The contacts of the SIM/ME interface should be deactivated in the following order when the ME is soft powered down and the clock is running: RST at low level, Clock stopped at low level, I/O at status A, and Vcc inactive.

question_7337.question: What is the function of the Automatic Neighbour Relation (ANR) in UTRAN?
question_7337.ground_truth: The Automatic Neighbour Relation (ANR) in UTRAN is responsible for detecting and managing the neighbour cells of a serving cell in order to improve the handover performance and network stability.

question_7339.question: What network entities does the Rf interface utilize the Diameter Accounting Application for the Offline Charging System (OFCS)?
question_7339.ground_truth: The Rf interface utilizes the Diameter Accounting Application for the Offline Charging System (OFCS) to connect network elements such as P-GW, MME, S-GW, ePDG, SGSN, WLAN, S-CSCF, MGCF, BGCF, IBCF, P-CSCF, I-CSCF, MRFC, SIP AS, Service-NE, and CS-NE.

question_7340.question: What is composed of the functional entities in the SIP core?
question_7340.ground_truth: The SIP core is composed of the following functional entities: for signalling control, a local inbound / outbound proxy, a registrar finder and a registrar / application service selection entity.

question_7341.question: What is the procedure for a 5GMS Client to request a bit rate recommendation using a Network Assistance Session identifier?
question_7341.ground_truth: The 5GMS Client may use the Network Assistance Session identifier to explicitly request a bit rate recommendation by invoking a remote procedure call provided for this purpose by the 5GMS~AF. This procedure is further specified in clause~11.6.4.3.

question_7343.question: What information does the NRM server send to NRM clients in the MBS session announcement for an established multicast MBS session?
question_7343.ground_truth: The NRM server sends the NRM clients of the VAL service group X the information related to the created MBS session via the MBS session announcement, which includes information such as the MBS session ID, MBS session mode (multicast or broadcast service type), and SDP information related to the MBS session under consideration.

question_7344.question: What actions take place after the NRM server creates the MBS session and provides the NRM client with the related information?
question_7344.ground_truth: After the NRM server creates the MBS session, it provides the NRM client with the session ID, session mode, and SDP information via an MBS session announcement. Optionally, it may include information elements related to the established eMBMS bearer if needed.

question_7347.question: What should be indicated for QoS parameters in the QoS Sustainability analytics output?
question_7347.ground_truth: The Crossed Reporting Thresholds for QoS parameters, such as Throughput, Delay, and Packet loss, should be indicated in the QoS Sustainability analytics output.

question_7348.question: What is the purpose of the queryAppLoadStatsErr() method in the IpAppLoadManager interface?
question_7348.ground_truth: This method is used by the client application to return an error response to the framework that requested the application's load statistics information, when the application is unsuccessful in obtaining any load statistic records.

question_7351.question: In the Change of SSC mode 3 PDU Session Anchor procedure, when does the SMF determine that the serving UPF or the SMF needs to be changed?
question_7351.ground_truth: The SMF determines that the serving UPF or the SMF needs to be changed if the "Indication of application relocation possibility" attributes in the PCC rule indicate no DNAI change takes place once selected for this application.

question_7352.question: What should the system do after extracting the MSCCK from the payload during the MIKEY-SAKKE authentication?
question_7352.ground_truth: The system should extract the MSCCK-ID from the payload.

question_7353.question: What message is used by IAB-MT to request the network to allocate IP addresses for the collocated IAB-DU or inform the network about IP addresses allocated to the collocated IAB-DU?

question_7354.question: What happens to the UE when it receives a request from upper layers to establish an eCall over IMS in the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE substate?
question_7354.ground_truth: The UE enters the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION and uses the relevant 5GMM and 5GSM procedures to establish the eCall over IMS at the earliest opportunity.

question_7355.question: What is the first byte in the UE operation mode coding in EFAd?
question_7355.ground_truth: The first byte in the UE operation mode coding in EFAd has the following possible values: '00' for normal operation, '80' for type approval operations, '01' for normal operation + specific facilities, '81' for type approval operations + specific facilities, and '02' for maintenance (off line).

question_7356.question: What is the function of FCS1-3 flow control signals in RTR Flow Control?
question_7356.ground_truth: The flow control signals FCS1-3 are combined with the RTR signal from the opposite 27.010 instance to create the local RTR input signal that signals flow control to the local application.

question_7358.question: Which information element is used to indicate the caused of a Position Periodic Termination?

question_7360.question: What actions should the UE take after successfully receiving a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message containing a 5G-GUTI and a network assistance required indicator of "true" during a mobility and periodic registration procedure on an NGC cell?
question_7360.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3519 if it is running and delete any stored SUCI.

question_7363.question: In what state will the UE be after successfully receiving a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message containing a 5G-GUTI and sending a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF?
question_7363.ground_truth: The UE will be in the state 5GMM-REGISTERED and the 5GS update status will be set to 5U1 UPDATED.

question_7364.question: What happens when the P-CSCF has restarted and lost all bindings for a particular user, leading to the rejection of incoming requests with a 404 (Not Found) response?
question_7364.ground_truth: The P-CSCF initiates the restoration procedure by sending an indication to the HSS if UDM/HSS or HSS based P-CSCF restoration is applied, or includes the IMSI in a Restoration-Header field included in an initial INVITE request if PCF or PCRF based restoration is used.

question_7365.question: Which FCC order expanded the ESMR band in the Southeastern United States to accommodate iDEN networks?

question_7367.question: What happens if the PROSE DIRECT LINK AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message cannot be accepted by the target UE during the 5G ProSe direct link authentication procedure?
question_7367.ground_truth: The target UE creates a PROSE DIRECT LINK AUTHENTICATION REJECT message, indicating one of the cause values: lack of resources for 5G ProSe direct link or authentication failure.

question_7369.question: What action does the UE take when creating a global IPv6 address after receiving a prefix from the network?
question_7369.ground_truth: The UE may use any interface identifier when creating a global IPv6 address, as the prefixes are uniquely allocated to the UE. The PDN GW guarantees that the prefixes in the Router Advertisements are unique, so the UE does not need to perform the Duplicate Address Detection procedure.

question_7370.question: How does Fred provision the 24/7 wearable monitoring device?
question_7370.ground_truth: Fred unpacks the device and scans the QR code using his 5G enabled UE, which initiates a sequence of events that includes the provisioning of credentials onto the 24/7 wearable monitoring device, enabling it to set up an identifiable connection to an application server through the 5G core network.

question_7371.question: What are the two implementations of IST described in the technical specification?
question_7371.ground_truth: The two implementations are based on CAMEL and a new MAP message.

question_7372.question: What is the difference between N5 reference point and N33 reference point in requesting resources from the MC service server?
question_7372.ground_truth: N5 reference point is used for direct interaction between the MC service server and 5GS, while N33 reference point is used for indirect interaction between the MC service server and 5GS NEF.

question_7374.question: What shall the UE do if it receives 5GMM cause #76 from a CAG cell and the CAG information list includes the serving VPLMN?
question_7374.ground_truth: The UE shall replace the serving VPLMN's entry of the "CAG information list" stored in the UE with the serving VPLMN's entry of the received CAG information list.

question_7376.question: What is the requirement for TLS transparent forwarding in e2e security for TCP-based media using TLS?
question_7376.ground_truth: A pre-requisite for support of e2e security is that the TLS message is passed transparently by any node present in the media path (i.e. TLS transparent forwarding).

question_7377.question: What is the role of MAC reset after receiving an LTM cell switch command MAC CE?
question_7377.ground_truth: After receiving an LTM cell switch command MAC CE, the UE performs MAC reset to clear the data in the MAC layer before switching to the target cell.

question_7381.question: What is the requirement for the UE to report RSTD measurements, as specified in the sub-clause 8.1.2.6.4?
question_7381.ground_truth: The UE physical layer shall be capable of reporting RSTD for the reference cell and all the neighbor cells i out of at least (n-1) neighbor cells within, provided that certain conditions are met.

question_7383.question: What is the purpose of Mobility Restrictions functionality?
question_7383.ground_truth: Mobility Restrictions functionality is provided by the UE, the radio access network, and the core network to restrict mobility handling of a UE in E-UTRAN access. Mobility Restriction functionality in ECM-IDLE is executed in UE based on information received from the core network, while in ECM-CONNECTED, it is executed in the radio network and the core network.

question_7384.question: What should a CC-entity of the MS in CC-state U4, "Call Delivered", do upon receipt of the CONNECT message?
question_7384.ground_truth: It should return a CONNECT ACKNOWLEDGE to its peer entity and enter the CC-state U10, "Active".

question_7385.question: How does the OCS specify the behavior on consumption of the final granted units when terminating an ABC Credit-Control session?
question_7385.ground_truth: The OCS may specify the behavior on consumption of the final granted units when terminating an ABC Credit-Control session through the use of a termination action. The required termination action is indicated with Final Unit Action, which can be either TERMINATE or REDIRECT. This is used to instruct the TDF on handling the application traffic once the granted quota is exhausted.

question_7386.question: What message is sent by the new SGSN if the security functions do not authenticate the MS correctly during a routeing area update?
question_7386.ground_truth: The old SGSN shall continue as if the Context Request was never received if the security functions do not authenticate the MS correctly.

question_7387.question: How can the MPS Service User invoke MPS for all participants on an MMTEL video conference call?
question_7387.ground_truth: The MPS Service User can invoke MPS for all participants using a customized feature of the video conference service that indicates a request for priority to the MPS capable 3GPP system.

question_7388.question: What does the HSCSD automatic user initiated upgrading +CHSU command control in non-transparent HSCSD calls?
question_7388.ground_truth: The HSCSD automatic user initiated upgrading +CHSU command controls whether or not automatic user initiated service level upgrading is used for non-transparent HSCSD calls based on the UP bit in the received RLP frames.

question_7390.question: What information does a CIoT device provide within a RACH access request?
question_7390.ground_truth: A CIoT device provides its full set of capabilities within the MS Radio Access Capability IE, which is included within the RAU Request message.

question_7391.question: What action should the MCVideo client take if the media-level section for the offered MCVideo video media stream and the media-level section of the offered media-transmission control entity are not the same as what was negotiated in the existing pre-established session, when sending a SIP re-INVITE request within a pre-established session?
question_7391.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should indicate this as specified in clause~6.4, and shall not include an SDP offer with the media parameters that differ from the existing pre-established session.

question_7393.question: What should the source RNC include in the Relocation Required message for a handover to a hybrid cell?
question_7393.ground_truth: The source RNC should include the CSG access mode in the Relocation Required message when the target cell is a hybrid cell.

question_7394.question: In the context of the present document, what is the definition of the term "communication"?
question_7394.ground_truth: In the present document, "communication" refers to an interaction between at least two entities that takes place using at least one protocol. It may consist of a series of messages.

question_7396.question: What is the meaning of "might" in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
question_7396.ground_truth: In the context of 3GPP technical specifications, "might" indicates a likelihood that something will happen as a result of action taken by some agency the behavior of which is outside the scope of the present document.

question_7397.question: What will the 5G network expose to service providers regarding the location and network delay of specific terminals or a group of terminals?
question_7397.ground_truth: The 5G network will expose the physical location and network delay of specific terminals or a group of terminals to service providers, including the delay inside the 5G system (UE to PSA UPF) and the latency information between PSA UPF and some potential servers.

question_7398.question: What is the difference between the Continue procedure and the ContinueWithArgument procedure in the IM-SSF?
question_7398.ground_truth: The Continue procedure does not provide additional service-related information to the user, while the ContinueWithArgument procedure does.

question_7399.question: What action does the mobile station (MS) take when it encounters an abnormal release with random access?
question_7399.ground_truth: The mobile station aborts all TBFs in progress and its associated resources, returns to the CCCH or PCCCH, and initiates establishment of a new uplink TBF.

question_7401.question: What is the maximum repetition period of the relevant system information blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell?
question_7401.ground_truth: The maximum repetition period of the relevant system information blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell is 1420ms.

question_7402.question: What is the main objective of Solution #61 in the context of improving the correctness of NWDAF analytics?
question_7402.ground_truth: The main objective of Solution #61 is to use a historical ML model with different model information as Priori Knowledge and train it upon new datasets, aiming to achieve higher accuracy than retraining a new ML model.

question_7403.question: What should the ME do upon receiving an OPEN CHANNEL command related to (I-)WLAN bearer, if the user stops the (I-)WLAN service activation attempt before a result is received from the network?
question_7403.ground_truth: The ME informs the UICC using TERMINAL RESPONSE (user cleared down call before connection or network release)

question_7404.question: What will be the BSF response if the "PCF for a UE Bindings" resource does not exist in 4.2.4.3?
question_7404.ground_truth: The BSF shall respond with a "404 Not Found" HTTP error code.

question_7407.question: What is the maximum number of reporting criteria that a UE should support in total for Intra-frequency, Inter frequency, and Inter-RAT measurements in the 8.3, 8.3A, and 8.3B sections?
question_7407.ground_truth: The UE should not support more than 14 reporting criteria in total for Intra-frequency, Inter frequency, and Inter-RAT measurements in the 8.3, 8.3A, and 8.3B sections.

question_7410.question: What does the TRS performance for handheld UE in FR1 apply to?
question_7410.ground_truth: The TRS performance for handheld UE in FR1 applies to both NR SA and EN-DC.

question_7411.question: What is the purpose of the procedures in 5.7.1.2 for preliminary setup of unicast media IP connectivity?
question_7411.ground_truth: The purpose of these procedures is to exchange address and port information for routing (S)RTP packets between the endpoints of the related call segment.

question_7413.question: Which clause in 3GPP TS 36.133 defines Nfreq?
question_7413.ground_truth: Nfreq is defined in clause 8.1.2.1.1 of 3GPP TS 36.133.

question_7414.question: What is the threat name for the potential disclosure of sensitive information about the GNP and its operation?

question_7415.question: What is the format and occurrence of the PriorityLevel leaf for V2X communication over the NR-PC5?
question_7415.ground_truth: The format is int and it occurs zero or one time.

question_7416.question: In the context of testing MT-LR Location Notification for mobiles supporting MS-Based GPS, what message does the MS send to terminate the dialogue after receiving a REGISTER message containing a LCS Location Notification Invoke component set to notifyLocationAllowed?
question_7416.ground_truth: The MS sends a RELEASE COMPLETE message containing a LocationNotification return result with verificationResponse set to permissionGranted.

question_7417.question: Which command is used to activate or deactivate the UAE layer support in the MT?
question_7417.ground_truth: The +CUAEACT command is used to activate or deactivate the UAE layer support in the MT.

question_7418.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in relation to the technical report produced on the measurement of user equipment (UE) over-the-air (OTA) performance for NR FR1?
question_7418.ground_truth: The 3GPP is responsible for producing the technical report in question, which outlines the test methodology for Total Radiated Power (TRP) and Total Radiated Sensitivity (TRS) for NR FR1 in both standalone (SA) and non-standalone (NSA) operation modes.

question_7419.question: What is the role of the Announcing UE in the 5G ProSe restricted discovery?
question_7419.ground_truth: The Announcing UE is responsible for sending a Discovery Request message containing the ProSe Application ID to the DDNMF in its HPLMN to get permission to announce on its serving PLMN.

question_7422.question: What are the conditions for an SMTC occasion and a measurement gap occasion to be considered colliding?
question_7422.ground_truth: The SMTC occasion and the measurement gap occasion are considered colliding if they are fully or partially overlapping in time domain or if the magnitude of the distance between them in time domain is less than or equal to 4ms.

question_7423.question: What should the UE do if it receives the 5GMM cause value #13 (Roaming not allowed in this tracking area) in a REGISTRATION REJECT message and the TAI of the current cell is in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"?
question_7423.ground_truth: The UE should not attempt to registration.

question_7424.question: What should the MS do every 480 ms to enable uplink quality measurements in the GANC?
question_7424.ground_truth: The MS should send at least one RTP frame.

question_7426.question: What is the maximum payload size supported by the SDS capability for message types?
question_7426.ground_truth: The SDS capability supports messages with a maximum payload of at least 1000 bytes.

question_7427.question: How are the extra symbols obtained in timeslot aggregation?
question_7427.ground_truth: After the removal of guard period and tail bits between the two bursts, and the training sequence of one burst, 40.25 extra symbols will be retrieved from each aggregated fat burst, resulting in 80 or 240 extra bits for each block using MCS1-4 or MCS5-9 respectively.

question_7428.question: What is the sum of all supported per cause measurements for "Attempted outgoing intra-eNB/RN handovers per handover cause" measurement?
question_7428.ground_truth: The sum of all supported per cause measurements shall equal the total number of outgoing intra-eNB/RN handover events.

question_7431.question: What is the DTMF string sent to the network in expected sequence 1.1 and 1.2?
question_7431.ground_truth: The DTMF string sent to the network in expected sequence 1.1 is "1" pause "2", and in expected sequence 1.2 is "1234567890".

question_7432.question: What are the main aspects to consider in the reference signal design for DL CoMP?
question_7432.ground_truth: The main aspects to consider in the reference signal design for DL CoMP are the use of non-zero-power and zero-power CSI-RS for CSI measurement, the reference signals for interference measurements, enhancement of existing DMRS, and performance requirements on CSI-RS and DM-RS.

question_7433.question: What is the procedure followed by the I-CSCF upon receiving an initial request with more than one Route header field?
question_7433.ground_truth: The I-CSCF removes its own SIP URI from the topmost Route header field and forwards the request based on the topmost Route header field.

question_7436.question: What must the UE (MCVideo Client) do when it receives a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP PUBLISH request?
question_7436.ground_truth: Upon receiving the SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP PUBLISH request, the MCVideo client may indicate to the MCVideo User the successful communication of the MCVideo service settings to the MCVideo server.

question_7437.question: Which BS transmitters should not share the same antenna with Band 22, 41, or 42 BS receivers to prevent receiver desensitization?

question_7438.question: In what situation would a participating MCVideo function reject a SIP REFER request for a pre-established session with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response?
question_7438.ground_truth: If the participating MCVideo function is unable to identify the controlling MCVideo function for the private call service associated with the originating user's MCVideo ID.

question_7439.question: What is the function of KSEAF in the key hierarchy in the EAP-AKA' authentication method?
question_7439.ground_truth: KSEAF is the anchor key in the key hierarchy and is used to derive the KAMF using the ABBA parameter and the SUPI.

question_7442.question: What is the purpose of the MDAS producer in relation to network slice throughput?
question_7442.ground_truth: The MDAS producer assists the consumer in analyzing network slice throughput issues and identifying root causes to ensure throughput assurance. It can work at both the domain-specific and cross-domain levels for optimum throughput performance.

question_7443.question: Who is responsible for the analysis and validation of noise suppression solutions for the AMR speech encoder in SMG11?
question_7443.ground_truth: SMG11 is responsible for analyzing and validating any AMR noise suppression solution which is voluntarily brought to their attention, using the requirements set out in this specification.

question_7444.question: Under what circumstances will UE-1 not signal additional delay availability to UE-2?
question_7444.ground_truth: UE-1 will not signal additional delay availability to UE-2 if it's already close to its JBM constraint and cannot tolerate any additional delay or jitter, as it would lead to more packets being dropped.

question_7445.question: Which abbreviations are used in this particular technical specification?
question_7445.ground_truth: The following abbreviations are used: 5GS, 5GVN, CAPIF, CNC, CRUDN, EPC, GPSI, LWP, NEF, NR, PCC, SCEF, SEAL, SEAL-UU, TSC, TSN, VAL, NOP, NSaaS.

question_7446.question: What is the time duration of T1 and T2 in sub-test 1 and sub-test 2?
question_7446.ground_truth: T1 is 200 ms and T2 is 1000 ms in both sub-tests.

question_7447.question: When should the UE resend the BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message and reset timer T3481 upon the first expiry of timer T3481?
question_7447.ground_truth: The UE should resend the BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message and reset timer T3481 upon the first expiry of timer T3481.

question_7448.question: What happens to the timer T3526 associated with the removed S-NSSAI(s) when the timer expires due to the maximum number of UEs reached being rejected?
question_7448.ground_truth: The timer T3526 associated with the removed S-NSSAI(s) shall be stopped, if running.

question_7449.question: In Solution #5, what access token method is utilized for authentication and authorization purpose of the UE to obtain the MSGin5G service from MSGin5G server?
question_7449.ground_truth: Access token is used for authentication and authorization purpose of the UE to obtain the MSGin5G service from MSGin5G server. This authorization method (OAuth2.0) is already being utilized in Mission Critical Services and Service-Based procedures.

question_7450.question: What should the UE do when the timer T3526 expires for the rejected NSSAI with the rejection cause of "S-NSSAI not available due to maximum number of UEs reached"?
question_7450.ground_truth: The UE shall remove the S-NSSAI in the rejected NSSAI and initiate a registration procedure.

question_7451.question: What is the term for a group of MF tones indicated by the eNB for single tone transmission in SC-FDMA?
question_7451.ground_truth: A group of MF tones indicated by the eNB for single tone transmission in SC-FDMA is called an M-PUSCH.

question_7452.question: What is required for outgoing international communications to be true?
question_7452.ground_truth: Outgoing international communications is true when the request URI of the outgoing SIP request corresponds to a telephone number, and does not point to a destination served by a network within the country where the originating user is located.

question_7453.question: What is the significance of the <n> parameter in the definition of the <stat> value in the +CREG command?
question_7453.ground_truth: The <n> parameter in the definition of the <stat> value in the +CREG command indicates the circuit mode registration status.

question_7454.question: What should the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure be instructed to generate and transmit when the Single Entry PHR MAC CE is used, as defined in subclause 6.1.3.8?
question_7454.ground_truth: The Multiplexing and Assembly procedure should be instructed to generate and transmit the Single Entry PHR MAC CE based on the values reported by the physical layer.

question_7455.question: What is the sequence and individual importance of the parameters in the encoded speech output in the AMR wideband speech codec?
question_7455.ground_truth: The encoder will produce the output information in a unique sequence and format, and the individual parameters of the encoded speech have unequal importance with respect to subjective quality. The output and input frame formats for the AMR wideband speech codec are reordered to optimize the speech quality.

question_7456.question: What information must the MSC/SGSN send when initiating the periodic location cancellation request to the UE?
question_7456.ground_truth: The MSC/SGSN must include the LDR reference number and H-GMLC address when initiating the periodic location cancellation request to the UE.

question_7457.question: What protocol is used between the P-GW and a Diameter server or proxy for applications to deliver information related to the user session?

question_7458.question: What is the maximum number of "restricted-discovery-filter" elements that can be present in the "RestrictedMonitorRsp-info" complex type?
question_7458.ground_truth: The maximum number of "restricted-discovery-filter" elements that can be present in the "RestrictedMonitorRsp-info" complex type is unbounded, meaning there is no limit on the number of occurrences.

question_7460.question: When is the II-NNI traversal scenario used between home A and an IMS transit network providing application services?
question_7460.ground_truth: The II-NNI traversal scenario is used when the home network A wants to use application services in an IMS transit network.

question_7461.question: What message does the HSS send to the ProSe Server to indicate that the location reporting cancellation has been made for UE-B in step 10b?
question_7461.ground_truth: A Location Notification message containing the most current location information for UE-B is sent by the HSS to the ProSe Server in step 10b to indicate that the location reporting cancellation has been made for UE-B.

question_7462.question: What information is used for location handling during inter-system switching if the MC service UE is not within the service area?
question_7462.ground_truth: Location reports provided by the MC service client and network notifications related to 5GS supporting EPS interworking

question_7465.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement specified in section 17.3.2.2.4.3?
question_7465.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 17.3.2.2.0.2.

question_7466.question: Who controls model/functionality in the network-side model inference in a network?
question_7466.ground_truth: The gNB controls the model/functionality in the network-side model inference, where inference is performed and input data is generated at the UE.

question_7468.question: What is the function of user identity privacy, and when should it be enabled?
question_7468.ground_truth: User identity privacy is used to send encrypted temporary identity(ies) to the WLAN UE in every EAP authentication procedure. It should be enabled in the 3GPP AAA server to ensure user identity protection.

question_7469.question: What is the objective of T1 in the test?
question_7469.ground_truth: During T1, the test checks if the UE's channel occupancy ratio is higher than 1% when the sidelink UEs transmit with a low CBR.

question_7471.question: What is the operation used to instruct the gsmSSF on the charging information to send?

question_7472.question: In case 1, what error will the network report for the TFT operation "Delete packet filters from existing TFT"?
question_7472.ground_truth: The network will reject the modification request with ESM cause #41 "semantic error in the TFT operation".

question_7473.question: What should the AMF do if there are PDU sessions that failed to handover due to timeout of SMF responses in any step of the handover preparation phase?
question_7473.ground_truth: The AMF should consider that the PDU session will be released by the MME and remove the PDU session context from the UE context. For a Home Routed PDU session or a PDU session with I-SMF, the AMF should also release the SM Context in the V-SMF or the I-SMF only.

question_7475.question: What is the definition of the term ``Interference bandwidth'' in the document?
question_7475.ground_truth: The term ``Interference bandwidth'' refers to the absolute value of a multiplied by CBW1 plus the absolute value of b multiplied by CBW2, where CBW1 and CBW2 are UL channels and a and b are integers with the sum of 2 (or 3).

question_7476.question: What is the role of MME in the S-GW initiated Gateway Control and QoS rules Request procedure?
question_7476.ground_truth: MME provides NPLI to the S-GW, which is then forwarded to the PCRF.

question_7477.question: What is the function of the 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay Communication?
question_7477.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay provides the functionality to support connectivity between 5G ProSe Layer-3 End UEs. A 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay and 5G ProSe Layer-3 End UEs can be located within NG-RAN coverage or outside of NG-RAN coverage. The 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay is responsible for relaying any IP, Ethernet or Unstructured traffic for 5G ProSe applications.

question_7478.question: What action is recommended for video encoders when transitioning from a held full-duplex session to a full-duplex session in the HOLD supplementary service?
question_7478.ground_truth: The recommended action for video encoders is to start the updated session with a full infra refresh.

question_7479.question: What is the role of the IBCF in relation to the OIR service when interworking with untrusted networks?
question_7479.ground_truth: The IBCF is responsible for stripping the P-Asserted-Identity from the SIP header when interworking with untrusted networks.

question_7480.question: What type of changes are considered minor in CAP protocol?
question_7480.ground_truth: A minor change is a change of a functionality which is not essential for the requested IN service. It can be a modification of an existing function or additional functionality that is not executed at all, and the peer Application Entity (AE) need not know about the effects of the change.

question_7483.question: What is the maximum number of CSI-RS resources that can be specified in the "supportedCSI-RS-ResourceList-r18" parameter?
question_7483.ground_truth: The maximum number of CSI-RS resources that can be specified in the "supportedCSI-RS-ResourceList-r18" parameter is "maxNrofCSI-RS-ResourcesExt-r16".

question_7484.question: What is the RSU responsible for in road safety services?
question_7484.ground_truth: The RSU is responsible for receiving V2X messages transmitted from UEs supporting V2I Service and transmitting the received V2X messages to UEs within a local area.

question_7487.question: What is the role of PDU Set Error Rate (PSER) parameter in 5G networks?
question_7487.ground_truth: The PDU Set Error Rate (PSER) parameter, when indicated, overrides the PER (Packet Error Rate) of the corresponding 5QI in the control plane of 5G networks.

question_7488.question: What is the general rule for processing piggybacked initial messages?
question_7488.ground_truth: The triggered response message carrying the piggybacked message is processed first, followed by the independent processing of the piggybacked initial message. If the processing of a dedicated bearer activation message results in an error, this should not affect the default bearer establishment. If the default bearer establishment fails, the dedicated bearer activation related message is discarded.

question_7489.question: What is the variable that represents the carrier specific scaling factor for PRS-RSRP measurements, in the equation for the scaling factor for a positioning frequency layer within the associated measurement gap pattern?
question_7489.ground_truth: is the carrier specific scaling factor for PRS-RSRP measurements.

question_7490.question: What actions does the Serving GW take after receiving Modify Bearer Response in step B?
question_7490.ground_truth: Sends buffered downlink packets, sends Update Location Request if necessary, sends Modify Bearer Response to the SGSN to confirm completion of the handover process.

question_7492.question: What should the SMF do when it receives a PDU SESSION RELEASE COMPLETE message from the UE?
question_7492.ground_truth: The SMF shall stop timer T3592 and consider the PDU session as released.

question_7493.question: What are two examples of applications that can survive an IP address change?
question_7493.ground_truth: SIP (Session Initiation Protocol) based applications and DASH (Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP) based applications, which can send a "SIP reINVITE" message or use globally unique transport-independent labels (URLs) for future user plane traffic.

question_7495.question: What are the parameters for the findAndCompareValue method?
question_7495.ground_truth: The method has 6 parameters: tag, occurence, valueOffset, compareBuffer, compareOffset, and compareLength.

question_7496.question: What message should the MS send in response to a DISCONNECT message from the SS, containing the transaction identifier of Call A-B?
question_7496.ground_truth: The MS should send a RELEASE message in response to the DISCONNECT message.

question_7498.question: What operation can be performed in the MCData message store to create a copy of a folder, including all its contents, to a different location?
question_7498.ground_truth: A folder copy operation can be performed to create a copy of a folder, including all its contents, to a different location in the MCData message store.

question_7499.question: What happens in step 6 of the Edge Enabler Client triggered application context relocation solution if the application context relocation is rejected?
question_7499.ground_truth: If the application context relocation is rejected, the application context relocation response indicates that the relocation request is rejected, and the following steps 7 to 11 are not conducted.

question_7500.question: What does the NWDAF provide as output for DN Performance Analytics?
question_7500.ground_truth: The NWDAF provides analytics for user plane performance in the form of statistics or predictions to a service consumer for a specific Edge Computing application or a specific UE, group of UEs, or any UE over a specific serving anchor UPF, DNAI, or Edge Application Server Instance.

question_7501.question: Which protocol element is conditional to be included in the "MeasurementRequest-IEs" sequence?
question_7501.ground_truth: The "ID id-MeasurementPeriodicityExtended" element is conditional in the "MeasurementRequest-IEs" sequence, only when the MeasurementPeriodicity IE is set to the value "extended".

question_7502.question: What must the ME (Mobile Equipment) send after receiving an IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message during the SIM/ME initialization procedure?
question_7502.ground_truth: The ME must send a PAGING RESPONSE containing the correct IMSI stored in the SIM.

question_7503.question: What is the purpose of having a Weight Factor per DCN in a network with the same PLMN and MMEGI value?
question_7503.ground_truth: The Weight Factor per DCN is used to achieve load balancing across MMEs of the same MME pool area supporting the same DCN, based on the capacity of an MME node for a specific DCN relative to other MME nodes' capacity for that DCN.

question_7506.question: What should the system do when affiliating a remote MCPTT user to a targeted MCPTT group, if the procedures of clause 9.2.1.2 were not successful?
question_7506.ground_truth: The system should indicate to the requesting MCPTT user that the requesting MCPTT user is not authorized to initiate a remotely initiated group call request to the remote MCPTT user and skip the rest of the steps.

question_7507.question: What is the impact of the Target MGW on the uplink speech break in real networks?
question_7507.ground_truth: Following the current eSRVCC stage 2 specification, the Target MGW blocks the uplink path, increasing the uplink speech break even more in real networks.

question_7509.question: What is responsible for carrying the tunnelling function for exchanging cdma2000 HRPD messages over the E-UTRAN access and the S101 reference point?
question_7509.ground_truth: The tunnelling function that carries the signalling occurs below the NAS level and is the responsibility of RAN2 (for RRC) and RAN3 (for S1AP), from a 3GPP perspective.

question_7510.question: What should the UE include in the initial INVITE request if it wishes to receive early media authorization indications?
question_7510.ground_truth: The UE should add the P-Early-Media header field with the "supported" parameter to the initial INVITE request.

question_7512.question: What is the role of the "MulticastSessionDeactivationRequest" structure in the NGAP-PROTOCOL-IES for 5G mobile communication networks?
question_7512.ground_truth: The "MulticastSessionDeactivationRequest" structure is a message in the NGAP-PROTOCOL-IES used in 5G mobile communication networks to request the deactivation of a multicast session from the network. The message contains various fields that are used to specify the session and the reason for deactivating it.

question_7513.question: What is the purpose of the Re-attempt indicator information element?
question_7513.ground_truth: The purpose of the Re-attempt indicator information element is to indicate a condition under which the MS is allowed to re-attempt an EPS session management procedure.

question_7514.question: In the context of NG-U TNL information and associated list of QoS flows, what information does the "QoS Flow per TNL Information" IE indicate?
question_7514.ground_truth: The "QoS Flow per TNL Information" IE indicates the NG-U transport layer information and associated list of QoS flows for a UE's communication.

question_7515.question: Under which circumstances should a SIP re-INVITE request be used to cancel the in-progress imminent peril group state of the group?
question_7515.ground_truth: This occurs when a member of the MCVideo group wishes to cancel the in-progress imminent peril state of the group.

question_7516.question: What signaling protocol is used between the P-GW and the PDN, when initial IPv4 address is not available for the UE?

question_7517.question: What H.265/HEVC video resolution is required to be supported by a 5GMSd Client that supports the Television (TV) profile?
question_7517.ground_truth: A 5GMSd Client that supports the Television (TV) profile should support the H.265/HEVC 720p HD, Full HD, UHD, Full HD HDR, and UHD HDR Operation Point Receiver requirements.

question_7518.question: In which operating bands is the minimum requirement for the transmitter transient period applicable in the case of a multi-band TAB connector?
question_7518.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for the transmitter transient period is applicable during the transmitter OFF period in all supported operating bands for a multi-band TAB connector.

question_7519.question: What does the PDN GW indicate in the Create Session Response if it supports NBIFOM?
question_7519.ground_truth: If the PDN GW supports NBIFOM, it indicates the network support of NBIFOM in the PCO in the Create Session Response.

question_7520.question: What are the possible MS operation modes for mobile stations supporting General Packet Radio Service (GPRS)?
question_7520.ground_truth: Mobile stations supporting GPRS may operate in one of the following modes: MS operation mode A, MS operation mode B, or MS operation mode C.

question_7521.question: What are the two main types of requirements that need to be considered for spurious emissions of time-dilated UMTS?

question_7522.question: What are the two methods for sending an announcement during the establishment of a communication session as defined in 3GPP TS 24.628?
question_7522.ground_truth: The two methods are sending an announcement as early media and sending an Alert-Info header field in the 180 (Ringing) response to the INVITE request.

question_7523.question: What is the purpose of the hop-by-hop security establishment procedure in the UE-to-UE relay solution?
question_7523.ground_truth: The hop-by-hop security establishment procedure in the UE-to-UE relay solution aims to secure the communication between the Source UE, Target UE, and the UE-to-UE Relay, both within and outside the network coverage.

question_7524.question: What should the "Length-of-Information-Element" fields include in their count value and what should they not include?
question_7524.ground_truth: The "Length-of-Information-Element" fields should include the number of octets within its associated "Information-Element-Data" field that follows, and should not include the "Length-of-Information-Element" field itself in its count value. Also, it should not include any fill bits which may be present.

question_7525.question: What is the flatness measure of the temporal envelope of the signal in the high band target frame?
question_7525.ground_truth: The flatness measure is calculated as the ratio of the mean of the high frequency band signal to the product of the variance and a constant.

question_7526.question: What actions does the receiving side of an AM RLC entity perform when it receives AMD PDUs?
question_7526.ground_truth: The receiving side of an AM RLC entity detects duplicated AMD PDUs and discards them, detects the loss of AMD PDUs and requests retransmissions, and reassembles RLC SDUs from received AMD PDUs.

question_7527.question: What is the primary focus of Key Issue 1 in the 3GPP Technical Specification Group study on system enablers for Multi-USIM devices?
question_7527.ground_truth: Key Issue 1 focuses on handling Mobile Terminated service with Multi-USIM devices, specifically on how to handle the MT service for a Multi-USIM device with the aim of avoiding any unnecessary interruptions of the service in the current system and saving system resources.

question_7528.question: When the BS only transmits up to 10 MHz and 60 MHz DL in Band 5 and Band 46 respectively, which 3rd IMD products may still fall into the BS receive band?
question_7528.ground_truth: The 3rd IMD products caused by BS supporting carrier aggregation of Band 5 and Band 46 may still fall into the BS receive bands of Bands 5, 6, 8, 11, 12, 13, 14, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 24, 26, 27, 28, 31, 42, 43, and 44 when the BS only transmits up to 10 MHz and 60 MHz DL in Band 5 and Band 46 respectively.

question_7529.question: In scenario 1, for which type of users are the gains from higher order modulation and turbo coding the most significant?
question_7529.ground_truth: The users with lower radio quality (10th and 50th percentiles) experience significantly higher gains.

question_7530.question: What is the role of the EIR in checking the mobile equipment identity?
question_7530.ground_truth: The EIR identifies the mobile equipment based on the first 14 digits of the IMEI AVP and may also use the Software-Version AVP to check against prohibited and tracking lists.

question_7531.question: What is the difference between the first and second digits in the version number of a TS document in this family of specifications?
question_7531.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number of a TS document indicates the level of approval by the TSG, while the second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, such as technical enhancements, corrections, and updates.

question_7532.question: What is the process for creating a meet-me conference in 3GPP networks?
question_7532.ground_truth: To create a meet-me conference in 3GPP networks, an application first reserves resources for a specified time period. The application then receives notifications of participants joining and leaving the conference, and decides whether to accept or reject the participants.

question_7533.question: What is the requirement for the FR1 band channel bandwidth for IAB specification?
question_7533.ground_truth: The channel bandwidth per operating band for FR1 should incorporate only the bands and associated channel bandwidth to be supported for IAB in the IAB specification.

question_7534.question: What is the procedure for deriving the battery life in approach 1?
question_7534.ground_truth: The battery life in approach 1 is derived by considering the average number of retransmissions, which is approximated as the initial message BLER. In this case, the residual BLER after the first retransmission is approximated as 0%.

question_7535.question: What is the functional model for location management based on?
question_7535.ground_truth: The functional model for location management is based on the generic functional model specified in clause 6 and is organized into functional entities to describe a functional architecture for location management aspects for vertical applications.

question_7536.question: What are the types of traffic routing policies of 5GLAN communication for the centralized user plane architecture?
question_7536.ground_truth: The types of traffic routing policies of 5GLAN communication for the centralized user plane architecture are N6-based, where all the UL/DL traffic for the 5GLAN communication is routed to/from the DN and Nx-based, where all the UL/DL traffic for the 5GLAN communication is routed between PSA UPFs of different PDU sessions.

question_7537.question: What is the second byte used for in EF~IST?
question_7537.ground_truth: The second byte in EF~IST is used for coding optional services that are available.

question_7538.question: What is the purpose of the Local IP Access (LIPA) function in the HeNB system?
question_7538.ground_truth: The LIPA function enables a UE connected via a HeNB to access other entities in the same residential/enterprise network without the user plane traversing the mobile operator's network except the HeNB subsystem.

question_7539.question: When must the UE not respond to a paging message, even if it receives one?
question_7539.ground_truth: The UE must not respond to the paging message if the paging identity is TMGI and it matches with a multicast MBS session that the UE has joined.

question_7541.question: What is the standard for MP-DCCP-LL solution to create an MP-DCCP connection to carry the traffic that matches a derived QoS rule?
question_7541.ground_truth: The MP-DCCP-LL solution does not specify how an MP-DCCP connection can be created to carry the traffic that matches a derived QoS rule.

question_7542.question: What is the role of the NSQ (Network Slice Quota) entity in the solution for limiting the number of UEs per network slice?
question_7542.ground_truth: The NSQ entity monitors, counts, and enforces the number of registered UEs per S-NSSAI quota. It interacts with the AMF for quota management.

question_7543.question: What is the type of id-MaximumTransmissionPower in the CellSetupRequestFDD NBAP-PROTOCOL-IEs?
question_7543.ground_truth: The id-MaximumTransmissionPower in CellSetupRequestFDD NBAP-PROTOCOL-IEs is defined as MaximumTransmissionPower, indicating the maximum DL power for the Cell Setup Request (this field is mandatory)".

question_7544.question: What is the requirement for the TRP in talk mode with head and hand phantom defined in section 6.2.1.2.1.1?
question_7544.ground_truth: The requirement for the TRP in talk mode with head and hand phantom defined in section 6.2.1.2.1.1 is to verify that the total radiated power (TRP) of a 5G NR FR1 UE in talk mode with head and hand phantom does not exceed the range prescribed by the specified nominal maximum output power and tolerance. An excess maximum output power has the possibility to interfere to other channels or other systems. A small maximum output power decreases the coverage area.

question_7545.question: What is the approach of the tiled stream approach in 360 video delivery?
question_7545.ground_truth: The full 360 video is projected into a frame, mapped, and encoded into several tiles at different resolutions, allowing for emphasizing the current user viewport.

question_7546.question: What events can trigger the REPORT record to be generated?
question_7546.ground_truth: The REPORT record is triggered when the target's WLAN UE performs a successful or unsuccessful I-WLAN access initiation procedure, re-authentication, I-WLAN access termination detach procedure, or is unsuccessful at performing a I-WLAN tunnel establishment procedure. Additionally, the REPORT record is triggered when intercepting a target's communications, and during packet data header reporting or packet data summary reporting.

question_7548.question: What is the measurement period requirement for the UE, as specified in clause 4.5.5.5?
question_7548.ground_truth: The UE should be able to measure multiple DL RSTD and DL RSCPD measurements during the measurement period as specified in the clause, which depends on various factors such as the number of positioning frequency layers, the periodicity of the PRS RSTD measurement in each positioning frequency layer, and the UE Rx beam sweeping factor.

question_7549.question: What is the role of the relay UE in the PWS notification use case?
question_7549.ground_truth: The relay UE is placed at the top of the fishing boat, receives PWS messages from the 3GPP network, and forwards them to UEs of the shipmaster and crews aboard the fishing boat.

question_7550.question: What is the initial condition of the mobile station in this test procedure?
question_7550.ground_truth: The mobile station is in group transmit mode.

question_7551.question: Who has the responsibility of deregistering functional identities in the FRMCS System - the user or the system?
question_7551.ground_truth: Both the user and the system have the ability to deregister functional identities in the FRMCS System. The user can choose which functional identities to deregister, while the system can deregister functional identities based on certain criteria such as timer, location, operational schedules, or another user taking over the functional identity.

question_7552.question: What is the purpose of the "any PLMN" entry in the ePDG selection information?
question_7552.ground_truth: The "any PLMN" entry in the ePDG selection information matches any PLMN the UE is attached to except the HPLMN, and indicates that emergency bearer services are not supported in a different country to avoid selecting a PLMN for emergency bearer services.

question_7553.question: What should the MRFP do if the SDP offer includes the RTCP Codec Control Commands and Indications?
question_7553.ground_truth: If the MRFP supports the RTCP Codec Control Commands and Indications, it shall assign resources for the requested RTCP control flow and send the RTCP feedback messages as requested by the MRFC.

question_7554.question: In Urban scenario at 2.6 GHz with DL PSD of 33 dBm/MHz, what is the characteristic of the representative values of the coverage margins for the potential Rel-18 UE with maximum 12-PRB bandwidth for all channels with 3-dB UE antenna efficiency loss?
question_7554.ground_truth: The representative values of the coverage margins for the potential Rel-18 UE with maximum 12-PRB bandwidth for all channels with 3-dB UE antenna efficiency loss are positive, indicating better coverage than the bottleneck channel of the reference NR UE.

question_7557.question: What is the solution for service continuity from on-network to UE-to-network relay in 5.8.1?
question_7557.ground_truth: The solution uses application-level mechanisms for service continuity from on-network to UE-to-network relay. The procedure involves UE-1 losing connection to the network, discovering a UE-to-network relay, establishing a PC5 connection, and transferring the MCPTT session to the UE-to-network relay.

question_7558.question: What does the information flow IWF floor granted indicate in interworking floor control?
question_7558.ground_truth: The information flow IWF floor granted is used to indicate that a request for floor is granted and media transfer is possible, from the IWF to the MCPTT floor control server and from the MCPTT floor control server to the IWF.

question_7559.question: What is the main function of the "Uplink Message Delivery" notification?
question_7559.ground_truth: The "Uplink Message Delivery" notification is used by the VAE Server to deliver an uplink message to the update the policy.

question_7560.question: In the third-party REGISTER request, what should the S-CSCF include in the message body if there is only one message body to be included?
question_7560.ground_truth: The S-CSCF sets the Content-Type header field to the content type specified for the body.

question_7561.question: How many paging indicators can be transmitted in a single PICH frame, given that Np can be equal to 18, 36, 72, or 144?
question_7561.ground_truth: Np can be any integer multiple of 3 between 18 and 144.

question_7562.question: What is the name of the operating band for DC in section 7.89.2, 7.90.2, and 7.91.2?
question_7562.ground_truth: The operating band for DC is n77 in section 7.89.2, n78 in section 7.90.2, and n79 in section 7.91.2.

question_7564.question: What is required for MSC-B to send the appropriate signals to the MS when the Signalling System no. 7 ISDN User Part is not used?
question_7564.ground_truth: MSC-B can send the appropriate signals to the MS when it receives a clear-forward signal from MSC-A, and may send a clear-back signal to MSC-A in fault situations.

question_7566.question: What does the "might" construction indicate in the context of the document?
question_7566.ground_truth: The "might" construction indicates a likelihood that something will happen as a result of action taken by some agency the behavior of which is outside the scope of the present document.

question_7568.question: What should the MCPTT client include in the Contact header field of the SIP 200 (OK) response, when performing the automatic commencement mode procedures?
question_7568.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should include the g.3gpp.mcptt media feature tag in the Contact header field of the SIP 200 (OK) response.

question_7569.question: How does the activation of DMB affect data traffic in a congested cell?
question_7569.ground_truth: The activation of DMB reduces the bandwidth available to users uploading video files to their blogs, allowing users to reach their relatives without difficulty.

question_7570.question: What action does the TSCTSF take when it receives information from the PCF for device side ports but does not have a corresponding AF session?
question_7570.ground_truth: The TSCTSF creates an AF session with the PCF when it does not have a corresponding AF session upon reception of the information from the PCF for device side ports.

question_7571.question: What data type is specified for the "transaction-ID" element in the "RestrictedDiscReq-info" complex type?
question_7571.ground_truth: The "transaction-ID" element in the "RestrictedDiscReq-info" complex type is specified as an "xs:integer" data type.

question_7576.question: What capability must the MCPTT client include in an Accept-Contact header field containing the g.3gpp.mcptt media feature tag in the initial SIP INVITE request during MCPTT on-network/broadcast group call with temporary group/client-originated?
question_7576.ground_truth: The "require" and "explicit" header field parameters are included with the g.3gpp.mcptt media feature tag in the Accept-Contact header field.

question_7580.question: In the context of conditional handover, if the source radio link failure is detected while T304 is running, what should be set as timeConnSourceDAPS-Failure?
question_7580.ground_truth: The time between the initiation of the DAPS handover execution and the radio link failure detected in the source PCell while T304 was running.

question_7581.question: What should the reporting periodicity be for CSI in this test?
question_7581.ground_truth: The reporting periodicity for CSI should be 5 ms in this test.

question_7582.question: What is the effective TTI for N-PACCH transmission in downlink in extreme coverage using concatenated block transmission with 3 blind repetitions?

question_7583.question: What is the implication of the update flag parameter from the AMF indicating decrease?
question_7583.ground_truth: The NSACF removes the entry associated with the NF ID upon reception of a request having update flag indicating decrease.

question_7585.question: What is the term used in the document to describe additional information provided by the calling or called party during a call?

question_7586.question: What is the role of the PCRF in providing static QoS policies for non-3GPP access in case of non-support of Gxa/b or S9 interface?
question_7586.ground_truth: The PCRF can provide the static QoS policies for non-3GPP access to the PDN GW through the Gx interface if present and supported.

question_7588.question: In the procedure of Ranging/SL positioning, what kind of UEs are involved in the result calculation if a higher location accuracy is required?
question_7588.ground_truth: Both UE and LMF will be involved for result calculation

question_7589.question: In the NF Service Consumer's POST request for CancelLocation service operation, what does the "CancelLocInfo" data structure indicate?
question_7589.ground_truth: The "CancelLocInfo" data structure in the POST request for CancelLocation service operation indicates the desired cancellation of reporting periodic or events triggered location of the UE.

question_7590.question: What is the purpose of the uplink NAS COUNT associated with the most recent NAS Security Mode Complete in non-3GPP access?
question_7590.ground_truth: It is used as the parameter in the derivation of the KN3IWF in non-3GPP access.

question_7593.question: What are the issues and inconsistencies identified in the current set of SA5 specifications regarding version handling?
question_7593.ground_truth: Two issues have been identified, including an information gap on Itf-N for the IRPManager to know which IRPVersion a particular Managed Object (MO) instance belongs to, and different operations required for IRPManager to obtain IRPVersion(s) of an IRPAgent's supported Interface IRPs and supported NRM IRPs.

question_7594.question: What should the succeeding node do if the connection address for the MGW is not specified in the external network?
question_7594.ground_truth: The succeeding node will select a MGW accordingly and may return the MGW Identifier to the IWU.

question_7596.question: What is the format of the ENVELOPE: SMS-PP DOWNLOAD message 1.1.1 in the test defined in 27.22.14.1.4?
question_7596.ground_truth: The format of the ENVELOPE: SMS-PP DOWNLOAD message 1.1.1 includes the SMS-PP Download with the source device as Network and the destination device as UICC, and the SMS TPDU with the contents of the Secured Packet from DL NAS TRANSPORT message 1.1.1.

question_7597.question: What information does the sendMessageReq() method require to process a multimedia message in multimedia messaging?
question_7597.ground_truth: The session ID of the multimedia messaging session and the actual message received, which contains the entire message (headers and body) in unstructured format.

question_7599.question: Which protocol is used for the 3GP-DASH quality reporting protocol for reporting QoE metrics?
question_7599.ground_truth: The 3GP-DASH quality reporting protocol is used for the 3GP-DASH quality reporting scheme, which specifies the XML-based report format and the reporting protocol to report QoE metrics.

question_7601.question: What is the interference ratio at which the performance requirement shall be met for 8-PSK modulated wanted signals, 16-QAM, 32-QAM and QPSK modulated wanted signals for Local Area multicarrier BTS and their associated control channels in VAMOS Mode?
question_7601.ground_truth: The interference ratio for this requirement is 4 dB above the interference ratio specified above in sub-clause 6.3 for GMSK modulated wanted signals, and 6 dB above the interference ratio specified above in sub-clause 6.3 for Local Area multicarrier BTS and speech channels in VAMOS Mode and their associated control channels.

question_7603.question: What are the characteristics of User Status Data in the UDC?
question_7603.ground_truth: User Status Data contains call-related or session-related dynamic data that are typically stored in VLR or SGSN and are only used transitorily by their owner services. These dynamic data are not typically shared with other services in the short term.

question_7604.question: What is the main goal of integrating the 3GPP anchor function and SAE Anchor into a single entity or coordinating between them?
question_7604.ground_truth: The main goal is to minimize introduced overhead (signaling and user plane transport overhead) and performance penalties (delays etc.), especially for 3GPP accesses.

question_7605.question: How many classes of acoustical interface are considered in the document?
question_7605.ground_truth: Five classes of acoustical interface are considered in the document: handset UE, softphone UE used as a handset, headset UE, softphone UE used with headset, desktop-mounted hands-free UE, softphone UE with external loudspeaker(s) in hands-free mode, hand-held hands-free UE, and softphone UE with internal loudspeaker(s) in hands-free mode.

question_7609.question: What is a characteristic of the input CMAF track that can be described by a DASH MPD manifest in order to correctly initialize the media transcoder?
question_7609.ground_truth: Maximum segment duration, video width, height, and frame rate

question_7610.question: What is the number of quantization levels for the Gaussian codevector gain in dB when it is uniformly quantized between -30 dB and 90dB with a step size of 1.9dB?

question_7611.question: What are the possible values for the Presence information for individual IEs/IE groups in RANAP messages?
question_7611.ground_truth: The Presence information for individual IEs/IE groups in RANAP messages can have three possible values: "Optional," "Conditional," or "Mandatory." Based on these values and the conditions specified in the version of the specification used by the receiver, actions can be taken when an abstract syntax error occurs due to a missing or false presence of these IEs or IE groups.

question_7612.question: What is the value of the TC3252 timer?
question_7612.ground_truth: The value of the TC3252 timer is the value in deciminutes (6 seconds) of the timer TC3252.

question_7613.question: Which device is the source and which is the destination for the SMS-PP Download?
question_7613.ground_truth: The source device is the network and the destination device is the SIM in the SMS-PP Download.

question_7614.question: What is the role of the I-SMF in alternative #2?
question_7614.ground_truth: In alternative #2, the I-SMF gets the quota information from the charging system CHF and sends resource usage directly for a CK to the CHF. It also manages two associations for charging of that PDU Session.

question_7616.question: What must the MCVideo client do if the <affiliation-required> element is present and the affiliation is successful or if the <affiliation-required> element is not present in the received SIP MESSAGE request?
question_7616.ground_truth: The MCVideo client must change its selected group to the MCVideo group identified by the <mcvideo-calling-group-id> in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body and determine the success or failure of the change of selected group action.

question_7617.question: What is user-plane resources in 3GPP TS 23.501?
question_7617.ground_truth: User-plane resources in 3GPP TS 23.501 are resources established between the UE and the UPF, which consist of one or more of the following: user plane radio bearers via the Uu reference point, a tunnel via the N3 reference point and a tunnel via the N9 reference point (if any) for 3GPP access; IPsec tunnels via the NWu reference point, a tunnel via the N3 reference point and a tunnel via the N9 reference point (if any) for untrusted non-3GPP access; IPsec tunnels via the NWt reference point, a tunnel via the N3 reference point and a tunnel via the N9 reference point (if any) for trusted non-3GPP access; a layer-2 connection via the Yt reference point, a layer-2 or layer-3 connection via the Yw reference point, a tunnel via the N3 reference point and a tunnel via the N9 reference point (if any) for trusted non-3GPP access used by the UE; W-UP resources via Y4 reference point, a tunnel via the N3 reference point and a tunnel via the N9 reference point (if any) for wireline access used by the 5G-RG; and L-W-UP resources via Y5 reference point, a tunnel via the N3 reference point and a tunnel via the N9 reference point (if any) for wireline access used by the FN-RG.

question_7621.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 8.16.21?
question_7621.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in section 8.16.21 is to verify the UE's ability to make correct reportings of Event A2 under deactivated SCell in non-DRX for 20MHz+10MHz bandwidth.

question_7622.question: Under what conditions can an MS trigger PS handover from GAN A/Gb mode?
question_7622.ground_truth: The MS can trigger PS handover from GAN A/Gb mode based on local measurements of GAN coverage signal quality, user-initiated change of operational mode to GERAN/UTRAN preferred or GERAN/UTRAN only, or based on reception of a GA-PSR UPLINK QUALITY INDICATION message from the GANC indicating problems with the uplink quality.

question_7623.question: After successfully passing the integrity check, which indicators must the UE store from the received SOR transparent container IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
