question_7938.ground_truth: The validity of certificates received from the peer end entity is verified by CRLs or OCSP responses retrieved via the mechanisms specified in section 6.1.1, based on the CRL Distribution Point or Authority Information Access extensions in the certificates.

question_7939.question: In which order should the UE build the Route header field value for new dialogs?
question_7939.ground_truth: The UE shall build a Route header field value containing only the P-CSCF URI (containing the unprotected port number and the IP address or the FQDN learnt through the P-CSCF discovery procedures).

question_7940.question: What is the mobility interruption time achieved for the PCell mobility scenario in LTE Rel-15 using Make-Before-Break and RACH-less handover for a dual RX UE in the scenario where there is no or negligible UE TA difference between the source and the target cell?

question_7941.question: What is one of the capabilities of the SMF (Session Management Function) related to satellite backhaul?
question_7941.ground_truth: The SMF is capable of triggering GTP-U path monitoring when satellite backhaul is used.

question_7942.question: How many "o-bcsm-camel-TDP-data" elements can occur within "o-bcsm-camel-TDP-data-list" definition?
question_7942.ground_truth: Up to 10 "o-bcsm-camel-TDP-data" elements can occur within the "o-bcsm-camel-TDP-data-list-type" definition.

question_7944.question: What is the purpose of the CAMEL Application Part (CAP) specification in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Rel-5?
question_7944.ground_truth: The CAMEL Application Part (CAP) specification in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Rel-5 supports the fourth phase of the network feature Customized Applications for Mobile network Enhanced Logic.

question_7945.question: What message is sent from the old SGSN to the new SGSN over the S16 interface to forward RNC contexts to the target system?
question_7945.ground_truth: A Forward Access Context Notification message is sent.

question_7946.question: What is the purpose of the TDD absolute RSRP accuracy test?
question_7946.ground_truth: The purpose of the TDD absolute RSRP accuracy test is to verify that TDD absolute RSRP measurement accuracy in carrier aggregation is within the specified limits under AWGN propagation conditions.

question_7947.question: What are the initial conditions for the mobile station in the 52.8.1.7 test case?
question_7947.ground_truth: The mobile station is GPRS attached and in packet idle mode, with PDP context 2 established.

question_7948.question: What is an MCPTT Private Call with Floor control?
question_7948.ground_truth: An MCPTT Private Call with Floor control is a type of call in the MCPTT (Mission Critical Push-to-Talk) service that enables guaranteed voice communications between two or more users. The "with Floor control" feature allows an MCPTT User to restrict providing the reason why an MCPTT Private Call setup has failed to the calling MCPTT User.

question_7949.question: What is the test procedure for the "processToolkit" method in the ToolkitInterface interface?
question_7949.ground_truth: The test procedure involves checking if the method is implemented by a Toolkit applet, which extends the javacard.framework.Applet class, and implementing the processToolkit shared method so that specific events can be notified.

question_7950.question: What is the role of the FRMCS System in initiating railway emergency voice communication?
question_7950.ground_truth: The FRMCS System automatically initiates voice communication upon activation of the railway emergency alert and establishes it within a setup time specified as IMMEDIATE.

question_7951.question: What is the time duration for MS to wait before resending the MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message during T3381 Expiry?
question_7951.ground_truth: The MS shall wait T3381 seconds before resending the MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message during T3381 Expiry.

question_7952.question: What should the UE do upon receiving N310 consecutive "out-of-sync" indications for the SpCell from lower layers while neither T300, T301, T304, T311 nor T319 are running?
question_7952.ground_truth: The UE should start timer T310 for the corresponding SpCell.

question_7955.question: What are the different types of Random Access Points in DIMS?
question_7955.ground_truth: There are two types of Random Access Points in DIMS: normal random access points and redundant random access points. Normal random access points are processed by terminals in all states, while redundant random access points should only be processed by terminals when performing random access, tune-in, or error recovery.

question_7958.question: What does the MBMS User Service provision phase, "MBMS User Service activation / deactivation" entail?
question_7958.ground_truth: The phase "MBMS User Service activation / deactivation" is generally triggered by a user action. It is an individual phase and is independent from the session start/stop and data transfer phases.

question_7959.question: When shall the UE consider the current frequency to be the lowest priority frequency?
question_7959.ground_truth: When the UE in camped normally state has only dedicated priorities other than for the current frequency, it shall consider the current frequency to be the lowest priority frequency.

question_7960.question: What does GTPv2-C stand for in the context of the 3GPP Evolved Packet System?
question_7960.ground_truth: GTPv2-C refers to the GPRS Tunnelling Protocol, Version 2, Control plane.

question_7961.question: What must the originating UE do in subsequent requests with an SDP body, if the response with an SDP body received does not include the "precondition" option-tag in the Require header field and did not include it in the Supported header field?
question_7961.ground_truth: The originating UE must not include a Require or Supported header field with the "precondition" option-tag in the same dialog in subsequent requests with an SDP body.

question_7962.question: What are the two main HTTP methods that REST is based on?
question_7962.ground_truth: REST is based on the strict usage of POST, PUT, GET, and DELETE HTTP methods.

question_7963.question: Upon inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode in EMM-IDLE mode, what does the UE do when the default EPS bearer context has a corresponding PDU session identity for interworking to 5GS?
question_7963.ground_truth: The UE shall create a corresponding PDU session context with the same PDU session type, PDN address, DNN, and QoS rules as the default EPS bearer context.

question_7964.question: What actions does the Edge Application Server perform upon receiving a De-Registration Notification?
question_7964.ground_truth: The Edge Application Server performs Edge Data Network discovery and registration after receiving a De-Registration Notification.

question_7966.question: What protocol is used to negotiate the specific media capabilities in an IMS-based telepresence call?

question_7968.question: What is the purpose of the network broadcasting assistance information for discontinuous coverage in the NTN?
question_7968.ground_truth: The network broadcasts assistance information for discontinuous coverage to enable UEs to predict upcoming satellites fly-over periods and save power during periods of no coverage. The broadcast assistance information includes SGP4 ephemeris elements based on the TLE industry standard and other optional information such as coverage footprint parameters and cell radius.

question_7970.question: What is the objective of this 3GPP technical specification?
question_7970.ground_truth: The objective of this specification is to define a set of Solution Profiles (SPs) for Interface IRPs, which identifies the necessary and sufficient subset of 3GPP IRP defined solutions (operations) required for the network management of a specific operating environment or domain.

question_7971.question: What technology is required for the audio distribution NPN described in the use case?
question_7971.ground_truth: The audio distribution NPN described in the use case needs to operate logically independently from other co-located radio networks, support authentication of users, and connect users located in the venue of the event. It should also allow audience owned UEs to connect to the audio distribution service offered by the NPN while still connected to their home RAN PLMN.

question_7972.question: What is the impact of the IP preserving PSA relocation solution on the 5GC Control Functions?
question_7972.ground_truth: The IP preserving PSA relocation solution impacts the SMF, NEF, and PCF in the 5G Control Plane. The SMF supports the same IP address allocation with different PSA-UPFs based on the PCC rules or AF request. The NEF supports more information elements for AF influenced traffic steering requests. The PCF supports upper layer context preserving information elements. The UE supports upper layer context preservation if indicated by the SMF, and needs to identify IP preservation and exchange the upper layer network context control information.

question_7973.question: What is the default number for the IMSI in 3GPP TS 25.321 if the UE has no IMSI?
question_7973.ground_truth: If the UE has no IMSI, for instance when making an emergency call without USIM, the UE shall use as default number IMSI = 0 in 3GPP TS 25.321.

question_7974.question: What are the main steps of the local ML model training procedure within the federated learning framework?
question_7974.ground_truth: The main steps of the local ML model training are as follows: (1) receiving a request from the central MTLF to train a local ML model, (2) collecting data required to train the local ML model, (3) locally training the ML model, (4) exchanging ML model parameters with the central MTLF to allow aggregation of gradients and loss factors, and (5) updating the central trained model using the aggregated model parameters.

question_7975.question: What is one difference between Layer 2 UE-to-UE Relay and Layer 3 UE-to-UE Relay?
question_7975.ground_truth: The difference lies in the QoS flow, in the Layer 3 UE-to-UE Relay case, two QoS flows are setup, one between Source UE and UE-to-UE Relay UE, and another between UE-to-UE Relay UE and the Target UE. In the Layer 2 UE-to-UE Relay case, the end-to-end QoS flow is setup between the Source UE and the Target UE.

question_7976.question: What is the impact of introducing a new shared DCH for enhanced R99?
question_7976.ground_truth: The introduction of a new shared DCH for enhanced R99 frees the enhanced R99 DPCH from the need to carry SRB data, omitting the need for in-band signalling for the presence of the DCCH, and enabling consistent FET application.

question_7978.question: What is the function of the ProSe Response Code and ProSe Response Discovery Filter in Model B discovery?
question_7978.ground_truth: The ProSe Response Code and ProSe Response Discovery Filter are used by the Discoveree UE to determine if a received ProSe Query Code over the air should trigger sending of the ProSe Response Code.

question_7979.question: What action does the UE take when the current available UE EPTI value is 7FFFH after initiating a PMFP procedure?
question_7979.ground_truth: The UE sets the current available UE EPTI value to 0000H.

question_7982.question: What is the difference between server-driven and agent-driven negotiation in content negotiation?
question_7982.ground_truth: In server-driven negotiation, the server decides the best representation of an entity, while in agent-driven negotiation, the client application makes the decision.

question_7984.question: What should a 3V only ME do if it cannot complete the SIM type recognition procedure with a SIM card?
question_7984.ground_truth: A 3V only ME should deactivate the SIM/ME interface and reject the SIM immediately without issuing any further commands if it cannot complete the SIM type recognition procedure.

question_7985.question: What is the purpose of assigning a SSRC identifier in MCVideo communication?
question_7985.ground_truth: The SSRC identifier is used to identify the source of RTP media packets in MCVideo communication, ensuring packet order and preventing duplicate packets from being processed.

question_7986.question: What is the benefit of Multiflow (SF-DC) operation in a medium to lightly loaded system?
question_7986.ground_truth: The benefit of Multiflow (SF-DC) operation in a medium to lightly loaded system comes from the load balancing, allowing a cell with available resources to serve nearby UEs that do not have this cell as the serving cell.

question_7987.question: What type of area can be specified in the "geographical-area-change" element?
question_7987.ground_truth: The "geographical-area-change" element can specify any geographical area change, or a specific geographical area that the VAE-S will send monitoring reports to the VAE-C when entered or exited.

question_7989.question: What is the role of the Network Slice Capability Enablement (NSCE) client in the network slice architecture?
question_7989.ground_truth: The NSCE client acts as the application client for slice enablement and interacts with the NSCE server to trigger network slice related operations, such as mapping or migrating vertical applications to network slices, and dynamic network slice lifecycle management.

question_7990.question: What are the four "levels" of security that may be worth including when introducing a key hierarchy in UTRAN?
question_7990.ground_truth: Binding the AVs to use in a particular network, separating CN and RAN keys by vertical key derivation, separating RAN keys by horizontal key derivation at intra-UTRAN handovers, and making key derivations depend on the algorithm identifiers.

question_7991.question: What is required for a UE-to-network relay to broadcast which MC service group(s) it is authorized to connect to the network?
question_7991.ground_truth: The UE-to-network relay includes the related relay service code(s) in the UE-to-Network Relay Discovery Announcement message.

question_7992.question: What is the definition of a "message element" in the context of MMS?
question_7992.ground_truth: A message element is a part of a MM consisting of only one media type.

question_7993.question: What is the definition of "Non-seamless WLAN offload" presented in the document?
question_7993.ground_truth: Non-seamless WLAN offload is a capability of a UE supporting routing specific IP flows over the WLAN access without traversing the EPC.

question_7994.question: Which node provides in textual format the QoE metrics that need to be reported, the measurement frequency, the reporting interval and the reporting range?
question_7994.ground_truth: The Metrics node is the one that provides the QoE metrics in textual format, and its format is "chr".

question_7995.question: What should be the form of the temporarily not available indication when the service authorization for acting as a 5G ProSe Remote UE or as a 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay is revoked?
question_7995.ground_truth: The form of the temporarily not available indication will be determined by stage 3.

question_7996.question: What determines the PDCCH monitoring occasions for MCCH message reception in the MCCH transmission window when searchspaceMCCH is set to zero?
question_7996.ground_truth: The PDCCH monitoring occasions for MCCH message reception in the MCCH transmission window are the same as PDCCH monitoring occasions for SIB1 where the mapping between PDCCH monitoring occasions and SSBs is specified in TS 38.213.

question_7997.question: What should a test system fulfil for 5G NR throughput tests as per 3GPP?
question_7997.ground_truth: A test system should fulfil the 3GPP test system uncertainty values for 5G NR throughput tests specified in Annex F of TS 38.521-4.

question_7998.question: What does the floor control interface do if the MCPTT client negotiated support of queueing of floor requests as specified in clause~14, the effective priority level is not pre-emptive and the maximum queue length has not been reached?
question_7998.ground_truth: The floor control interface inserts the MCPTT client into the active floor request queue, updates the position of the MCPTT client in the active floor request queue, sends a Floor Queue Position Info message to the floor participant and remains in the 'U: not permitted and Floor Taken' state.

question_7999.question: What is the priority order for reselecting frequency when it supports at least one NSAG provided by NAS?
question_7999.ground_truth: The frequencies are prioritized in the order of the NAS-provided priority for the NSAG with highest priority supported on the frequency.

question_8000.question: Who is the work item rapporteur for the 3GPP work item with UID 440065?

question_8001.question: What is the minimum number of PRS RSTD samples that must be taken for positioning measurements?
question_8001.ground_truth: The minimum number of PRS RSTD samples that must be taken for positioning measurements is 1, which occurs when the UE supports supportedDL-PRS-ProcessingSamples-RRC-Inactive and the LMF requests the UE to perform positioning measurements with reduced number of samples. In this case, the UE must take 1 PRS RSTD sample for positioning measurements.

question_8003.question: In the context of an MCPTT session, when the MCPTT client receives an initial SDP offer, what should it process and compose?
question_8003.ground_truth: The MCPTT client shall process the SDP offer and compose an SDP answer. It shall accept the MCPTT speech media stream in the SDP offer and set the IP address of the MCPTT client for the accepted MCPTT speech media stream. It shall also include an "m=audio" media-level section for the accepted MCPTT speech media stream and the media-level section of the offered media-floor control entity if included in the SDP offer.

question_8004.question: What does codebookTypeRequest-r16 contain in the UE-CapabilityRequestFilterCommon?
question_8004.ground_truth: The codebookTypeRequest-r16 in the UE-CapabilityRequestFilterCommon is a sequence that contains the different codebook types and their respective selections. It is included in the capability container request list.

question_8005.question: Which protocol is used to provide end-to-end security for the Remote UE when the UE-to-Network Relay is not a trusted entity?
question_8005.ground_truth: Solution #23 is agreed to be used to provide end-to-end security for the Remote UE.

question_8006.question: What happens when floor participant A sends a floor request message with a higher priority than floor participant B in an MCPTT session?
question_8006.ground_truth: The floor control server determines whether to accept the floor request from floor participant A based on arbitration result, and if accepted, floor participant A starts sending voice media while floor participant B continues transmitting (overridden).

question_8007.question: What is the expected sequence for the specific message contents in step 12.2a?
question_8007.ground_truth: The expected sequence for the specific message contents in step 12.2a includes the default message "504 Server Time-out" in Annex A.4.6.

question_8010.question: What is the role of the FRMCS System in initiating the Automatic Train Operation data communication?
question_8010.ground_truth: The FRMCS System determines the drivers, based on location information of the train provided by the locations services application, and/or functional identities, to which the communication will be initiated.

question_8012.question: What is the value of the MCVideo ID that should be set for the <mcvideo-request-uri> element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body?
question_8012.ground_truth: The value of the MCVideo ID of the targeted MCVideo user.

question_8013.question: What is the requirement for Test Requirements in clause 6.2.4.5, 6.2.5.5 and 6.3.5 for NB-IoT operation in E-UTRA in-band or guard band?
question_8013.ground_truth: The test requirement is specified in TS~36.141 clause~6.3.3.5.

question_8014.question: When does a busy condition no longer exist for a data station?
question_8014.ground_truth: The busy condition no longer exists when the station sends an RR, REJ, SABM, or UA frame with or without the P/F bit set to 1, or when it sends a new I frame with the F bit set to 1 to indicate that it is ready to receive further I frames.

question_8016.question: What should the CCU do when it receives a TRAU frame indicating an Uplink Frame Error in channel a or channel b with no errors on the synchronization pattern and the control bits?
question_8016.ground_truth: The CCU starts a timer TsyncU.

question_8019.question: What does the "stat" parameter indicate when the EPSFB status reporting is enabled?
question_8019.ground_truth: The "stat" parameter indicates the EPS fallback status when a MO/MT call is initiated in 5GS, such as 5GS to EPS fallback started, successful, or failure.

question_8020.question: What is the meaning of a Relying Party in the context of attestation?
question_8020.ground_truth: A Relying Party depends on the Attestation Results to apply specific actions, such as deciding the extent to which it will interact with the attested system.

question_8023.question: What is the impact of ISR on CS fallback and SMS over SGs for the UE in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_8023.ground_truth: If ISR is active, the UE can change between all registered areas and RATs without performing update signaling, and the UE listens for paging on the RAT it is currently camped on. The UE deactivates ISR at reception of LAU accept or at reception of combined RAU/LAU accept response with no ISR indication.

question_8025.question: What is the condition for the test to pass?
question_8025.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests must be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

question_8026.question: What type of element is the "manual-deactivation-not-allowed-if-location-criteria-met" under the "anyExt" element of the "entry" element in the "FunctionalAliasList" list element of the "anyExt" element of the "OnNetwork" element, and what 3GPP specification does it correspond to?
question_8026.ground_truth: The "manual-deactivation-not-allowed-if-location-criteria-met" element is of type "Boolean" and corresponds to the "ManualDeactivationNotAllowedIfLocationCriteriaMet" element of clause 5.2.48W6C in 3GPP TS 24.483.

question_8028.question: What action is taken by the UE-1 when the reporting criteria are met but the UE is out of E-UTRAN coverage?
question_8028.ground_truth: The UE-1 stores the usage information, when the UE-1 is out of E-UTRAN coverage and has no connection to the HPLMN ProSe Function. When the UE-1 comes back to E-UTRAN coverage, it will trigger the reporting of the usage information.

question_8029.question: What is the main goal of the network allowing OTT TV application to schedule their background traffic transfers via providing one or more time windows of expected content delivery?
question_8029.ground_truth: The main goal is optimization for streaming content delivery, allowing the network to provide high-resolution streaming content with a lower charging rate and improving QoE, while mitigating the load of the OTT provider.

question_8031.question: What new information element is required for a message from AMF to SMSF in Solution 4.1 for restoration?
question_8031.ground_truth: A new information element is required in a message from AMF to SMSF for triggering restoration during registration or after detection of any activity.

question_8032.question: What is a Solution Set (SS) in the context of the 3GPP Technical Specification on Advanced Alarm Management?
question_8032.ground_truth: A Solution Set (SS) is a set of definitions specified in the AAM IRP Information Service that provides methods to improve network fault identification and location in the face of a high volume of alarms. This Solution Set specification is related to TS 32.122 v14.0.X.

question_8033.question: What is the procedure for authenticating a UE behind a 5G-RG or FN-RG?
question_8033.ground_truth: A UE connected to a 5G-RG or FN-RG can access the 5GC via N3IWF. When using untrusted non-3GPP access, the authentication is as specified in clause 7.2.1. When using trusted non-3GPP access, the authentication is as specified in clause 7A.2.1.

question_8034.question: What are the two main requirements for enhanced warning status reporting?
question_8034.ground_truth: The two main requirements for enhanced warning status reporting are: (1) the ability for the CBC to report the number of broadcasts performed for each cell in the warning area, and (2) the ability for the CBC to report whether the cells in a warning area are available or not available for PWS.

question_8035.question: What is the minimum modulation scheme supported for the control channel in NR?
question_8035.ground_truth: At least QPSK is supported for the modulation of the NR-PDCCH.

question_8036.question: What should the MCPTT client do upon receiving a SIP 4xx, 5xx or 6xx response to the SIP MESSAGE request?
question_8036.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should indicate to the MCPTT user the failure of the sent group selection change request and not continue with the rest of the steps.

question_8039.question: What is a pre-requisite for affiliation and group call to be possible where group members have migrated to partner MC systems and where logging is required in the primary MC system of the group members?
question_8039.ground_truth: Interconnection between MC systems is a pre-requisite for affiliation and group call to be possible where group members have migrated to partner MC systems and where logging is required in the primary MC system of the group members.

question_8040.question: What identity does the ePDG use as the UE identifier when the IMSI cannot be authenticated or the UE has not provided it during the IKE tunnel establishment procedure?
question_8040.ground_truth: The ePDG uses the IMEI as the UE identifier when the IMSI cannot be authenticated or the UE has not provided it during the IKE tunnel establishment procedure.

question_8041.question: What method should the NF Service Consumer use to send a request to transfer a UE context?
question_8041.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should send an HTTP POST request to invoke the "transfer" custom method on the URI of the "Individual ueContext" resource.

question_8042.question: Which custom operation is used by the NF service consumer (AUSF) to request ProSe authentication vector(s) for the 5G ProSe Remote UE or for the 5G ProSe End UE from the UDM, if the SUPI is provided and EAP-AKA' is selected in the ProSeSecurityInformation resource?
question_8042.ground_truth: The "generate-av" custom operation is used by the NF service consumer (AUSF) to request ProSe authentication vector(s) for the 5G ProSe Remote UE or for the 5G ProSe End UE from the UDM, if the SUPI is provided and EAP-AKA' is selected in the ProSeSecurityInformation resource.

question_8043.question: What shall the LMISF-IRI that receives the xIRI do with the information received in the xIRI?
question_8043.ground_truth: The LMISF-IRI that receives the xIRI shall store or update the record with the information received in the xIRI (e.g. UE location) as applicable, for future handling.

question_8044.question: What is the purpose of the HS-DSCH physical layer category field in FDD?
question_8044.ground_truth: The HS-DSCH physical layer category field in FDD identifies the HS-DSCH physical layer category number of the UE, which is not applicable to the case that the H-RNTI IE sets to the same value as the BCCH Specific HS-DSCH RNTI IE.

question_8045.question: What is the role of the channel coding step in the coding/multiplexing process in Flexible Layer One?
question_8045.ground_truth: The main function of the channel coding step is to encode the code blocks that are provided by the channel coding block to ensure that the total bit rate after TrCH multiplexing is identical to the total channel bit rate of the allocated dedicated basic physical subchannel.

question_8047.question: What is the expected behave of the PSSCH transmissions by UE #65-84 during T2?
question_8047.ground_truth: The rate of PSSCH transmissions on the resources by UE #65-84 should be more than 90%.

question_8049.question: What is the difference between "may" and "need not"?
question_8049.ground_truth: "May" indicates permission to do something, and "need not" indicates permission not to do something.

question_8050.question: How are the scrambling codes generated and allocated?
question_8050.ground_truth: A total of 262,143 scrambling codes can be generated, but not all are used. The scrambling codes are divided into 512 sets, each containing a primary scrambling code and 15 secondary scrambling codes. The primary scrambling codes consist of scrambling codes n=16*i where i=0...511, and the i-th set of secondary scrambling codes consists of scrambling codes 16*i+k, where k=1...15. There is a one-to-one mapping between each primary scrambling code and 15 secondary scrambling codes in a set.

question_8051.question: In the context of UM downlink, when is the value "111 1111 1111 1100" used for the "Length Indicator" and what does it indicate?
question_8051.ground_truth: The value "111 1111 1111 1100" is used for the "Length Indicator" when the RLC SDU starts at the beginning of the RLC PDU, ends exactly at the end of the RLC PDU, and is not segmented, concatenated, or padded. It also indicates that the last octet of the PDU is the last octet of the RLC SDU.

question_8052.question: What is required for the ME and HSS to validate a UE's use of a specific UICC in the IMEI-IMEISV binding method?
question_8052.ground_truth: This approach binds IMSI with IMEI using a shared secret (KME) between ME and HSS that is not based on IMEI value. In this method, the IMEI value is not used for validating whether the UE can make use of a specific UICC.

question_8053.question: In which cases must the UE include the Paging restriction IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message, and when must the UE not include it?
question_8053.ground_truth: The UE must include the Paging restriction IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message when the UE is in 5GMM-IDLE mode and the network supports the N1 NAS signalling connection release, and must not include it when the paging restriction is already indicated in the current stored registration area and the UE is requesting NAS signalling connection release during mobility and periodic registration update.

question_8054.question: What should an MS do after receiving a Frequency Redefinition message?
question_8054.ground_truth: After receiving a Frequency Redefinition message, an MS should start using the new frequencies and hopping sequence at the time indicated in the message when the MS is allocated a dedicated channel.

question_8055.question: What protocol does the PMF operate on top of in an MA PDU Session with type Ethernet, over 3GPP access?
question_8055.ground_truth: The PMF operates on top of Ethernet in an MA PDU Session with type Ethernet, over 3GPP access.

question_8056.question: What are the main aspects of 5G Location Services specified in TS~23.273?
question_8056.ground_truth: The main aspects of 5G Location Services specified in TS~23.273 include service based 5G location architecture, general concepts, high level features, location service procedures, and network function services.

question_8057.question: In the 3GPP technical specification, which service does SAPI 7 identify within the LLC layer for GPRS?

question_8059.question: What is the requirement for the 5G system to support a harmonized QoS and policy framework applicable to multiple accesses?
question_8059.ground_truth: The 5G system should support a harmonized QoS and policy framework applicable to multiple accesses.

question_8060.question: What mode will the MS use for transmitting data if it is capable of both Mode (a) and Mode (b)?
question_8060.ground_truth: The MS will use Mode (a), which is transmitting pseudo-random data sequence in RLC data blocks.

question_8061.question: What methods does NR support for RRM measurement in DL concerning cell-level and multi-beam based operations?
question_8061.ground_truth: NR supports cell-level mobility based on DL cell-level measurement, such as RSRP for each cell, in IDLE mode UE. It also supports CSI-RS, in addition to IDLE mode RS, for CONNECTED mode RRM measurement for L3 mobility.

question_8063.question: What is the difference between the "serviceID" and "serviceToken" in the framework?
question_8063.ground_truth: The "serviceID" is a unique identifier for a service, while the "serviceToken" is a free format text token returned by the framework, which can be used as part of a service agreement to signify a client application's intention to use the service.

question_8064.question: What happens if the back-off timer is started or deactivated for a specific SM procedure and PLMN/APN combination and the MS changes to a new PLMN or inter-system mode?
question_8064.ground_truth: The back-off timer remains active or deactivated, and the MS can still be prevented from sending another ACTIVATE SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message in the PLMN for the same APN.

question_8065.question: What is the purpose of the Radio Link Addition (Branch Addition) procedure in a soft handover?
question_8065.ground_truth: The Radio Link Addition (Branch Addition) procedure in a soft handover is used to establish a radio link via a new cell controlled by another RNC.

question_8066.question: What is the purpose of Step 5 during the LTE only NAS Security Mode Command procedure?
question_8066.ground_truth: The IMEI request/response can take place in this procedure in an integrity protected way.

question_8067.question: What is the cost associated with the first Radio Link (RL) when adding a Radio Link to a Radio Link Set?
question_8067.ground_truth: The cost for the first Radio Link is the sum of the costs for each DPCH (cost 1) and the cost for a DPCH (cost 2).

question_8068.question: What message is sent by the gNB-CU to initiate PDC measurements?

question_8070.question: What is the maximum length of the "Called party BCD number" information element sent by the network, excluding PCS1900?
question_8070.ground_truth: The maximum length of the "Called party BCD number" information element sent by the network, excluding PCS1900, is 13 octets.

question_8071.question: In the 3GPP technical specification, what is the purpose of a test loop function in UE special conformance test functions?
question_8071.ground_truth: A test loop function is designed to establish a loop between the UE and the System Simulator (SS) to allow downlink (DL) data packets sent by the SS to be looped back uplink (UL) by the UE.

question_8072.question: What are the two reference loads defined for MSCs in the Technical Report 3GPP TS 12.22?
question_8072.ground_truth: Reference load A and Reference load B, which represent normal and increased activity levels respectively.

question_8073.question: When should a UE start receiving DL MAC PDU in the slots assigned for PTM transmission, after receiving a DL assignment with NDI set as 0 and PDCCH content indicates activation, if the slot is not the current slot?
question_8073.ground_truth: The UE should start receiving DL MAC PDU in the slots assigned, using the semi-persistent scheduling interval, after receiving the DL assignment.

question_8074.question: What is the function of the Bearer Binding Function (BBF) in the context of IP-CAN bearer binding?
question_8074.ground_truth: The Bearer Binding Function (BBF) is responsible for associating the PCC rule and the QoS rule (if applicable) to an IP-CAN bearer within an IP-CAN session.

question_8075.question: What is the role of the S-CSCF in terminating sessions that use only PS media flow(s)?
question_8075.ground_truth: The S-CSCF receives the request for session setup following normal IMS session setup procedures and forwards the request to the SCC AS for anchoring the session.

question_8077.question: What is the ratio of encoded bits to input bits in 5.3a.7.3?

question_8081.question: What action does the V-PCF take if the AMF informs it that the UE is accessing over a satellite backhaul?
question_8081.ground_truth: The V-PCF includes the Satellite Backhaul Category in the information it sends to the H-PCF.

question_8083.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the SIP INVITE request for a private call with transmission control?
question_8083.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include an application/resource-lists+xml MIME body with the MCVideo ID of the invited MCVideo user in a "uri" attribute of an "<entry>" element of a "<list>" element of the "<resource-lists>" element in the application/resource-lists+xml MIME body.

question_8084.question: What is the definition of "Deferred Location Request" in the context of LCS?
question_8084.ground_truth: A Deferred Location Request is a request for location contingent on some current or future events where the response from the LCS Server to the LCS Client may occur some time after the request was sent.

question_8085.question: What is the difference between sidelink communication and sidelink discovery?
question_8085.ground_truth: Sidelink communication refers to ProSe Direct Communication between nearby UEs using E-UTRA technology but not traversing any network node, while sidelink discovery is the AS functionality enabling ProSe Direct Discovery between nearby UEs, also using E-UTRA technology and not traversing any network node.

question_8088.question: What should UE do if it has geographical location information available and appropriate URI, then what should UE include in the INVITE request?
question_8088.ground_truth: UE should include a Geolocation header field in the INVITE request with the location information in a PIDF location object, in accordance with RFC 4119, include the location object in a message body with the content type application/pidf+xml, and include a Content ID URL, referring to the message body, as the Geolocation header field value.

question_8089.question: What should be the number of successful tests compared to the number of failure tests for the test to pass?
question_8089.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the number of successful tests should be more than 90% of the total number of tests performed.

question_8090.question: What is the requirement for the IWF performing the participating role in an on-demand chat group call?
question_8090.ground_truth: The IWF performing the participating role shall include the "norefersub" option tag in a Supported header field and the "tdialog" option tag in a Supported header field.

question_8091.question: What is the role of the CSI prediction part in the CSI prediction use case?
question_8091.ground_truth: The CSI prediction part is used to predict future CSI values based on past and current CSI measurements. This information can be used for various purposes, such as for precoding in multi-antenna systems.

question_8092.question: What is the role of the external location services client in the V-GMLC procedure?
question_8092.ground_truth: The external location services client sends a request to the GMLC for a location for the target UE, and indicates the required QoS, supported GAD shapes and client type.

question_8093.question: How does the UE set up a temporary set of security associations for a new registration after receiving a valid 401 (Unauthorized) response in the IMS network?
question_8093.ground_truth: The UE sets up the temporary set of security associations using the most preferred mechanism and algorithm returned by the P-CSCF and supported by the UE, and using IK and CK (only if encryption is enabled) as the shared key. The UE sets a temporary SIP level lifetime for the temporary set of security associations to the value of the reg-await-auth timer.

question_8094.question: What is the impact of this procedure on the eNB, MME, and SGW?
question_8094.ground_truth: This is an optional optimization that the eNB, MME, and SGW can support. It reduces MME/SGW signalling on Service Request and S1 Release, and optionally also at S1 HO without SGW change and X2 HO without SGW change. However, it primarily applies for UEs that have single bearer and single PDN connection.

question_8096.question: What network entities can interfere with the end-to-end codec negotiation in an IMS network?
question_8096.ground_truth: The IBCF, the MRFC, or other IMS network entities can interfere with the end-to-end codec negotiation.

question_8098.question: Which channel does the ROHC feedback refer to?
question_8098.ground_truth: Feedback received on one ROHC channel for this PDCP entity shall always refer to the ROHC channel in the opposite direction for this same PDCP entity.

question_8099.question: In the scenario where the UE (MCVideo Client) has upgraded to an Emergency Group Call, what should the UE (MCVideo Client) do when the MCVideo User continues communication with the invited MCVideo User(s)?
question_8099.ground_truth: The UE (MCVideo Client) should respect the Transmission Control imposed by the SS (MCVideo Server).

question_8100.question: What does the solution #6 propose for sponsored data connectivity?
question_8100.ground_truth: Solution #6 proposes the usage of a sponsoring context identifier, allowing a third party to define sponsored data flows with higher layer information, reducing the overloading of Rx and Gx interfaces, providing flexibility for third-party capability to change the list of sponsored flows, and controlling operator impacts with existing PCC functionality.

question_8101.question: What triggers the handover from GAN to GERAN in a CS call?
question_8101.ground_truth: The handover from GAN to GERAN is triggered by the MS, which can be due to the MS being in GERAN/UTRAN-preferred mode, or when the MS begins to leave GAN coverage based on local measurements, received RTCP reports, or uplink quality indications from the GANC.

question_8102.question: How is the 5G-GUTI constructed for paging purposes?
question_8102.ground_truth: The 5G-S-TMSI is constructed from the AMF Set ID, the AMF Pointer, and the 5G-TMSI for paging purposes in the 5G System.

question_8103.question: What is the objective for narrowband services in terms of call quality?
question_8103.ground_truth: The objective is to reach a quality as close as possible to ITU-T standards for PSTN circuits. However, due to technical and economic factors, there cannot be full compliance with the general characteristics of international telephone connections and circuits recommended by the ITU-T.

question_8105.question: What is the difference between sidelink resource allocation mode 3 and 4?
question_8105.ground_truth: Mode 3 is for resource allocation scheduled by eNB while mode 4 is for UE autonomous resource selection.

question_8107.question: What is the purpose of the S-DPCCH in UL CLTD?
question_8107.ground_truth: The S-DPCCH in UL CLTD is used for channel sounding of the secondary stream to enable selection of the best possible precoding vector for future transmissions. It may also assist in data demodulation.

question_8108.question: What is the purpose of the users-network (MS-BSS) protocols for the MS-BSS interface in the GSM PLMN?
question_8108.ground_truth: The user-network (MS-BSS) protocols for the MS-BSS interface in the GSM PLMN define the functional and procedural aspects of the interface, including the rules for the transfer of information between the mobile station and the base station subsystem.

question_8109.question: When is the requirement for the BS type 1-H and BS type 1-O to be met for the radiated receiver characteristics?
question_8109.ground_truth: The requirement for the BS type 1-H and BS type 1-O to be met for the radiated receiver characteristics is during the base station (BS) receive period and with any transmitter setting. The requirements for FDD operation should be met with the transmitter unit(s) ON. The throughput requirements for the radiated receiver characteristics do not assume HARQ retransmissions.

question_8110.question: What is the role of fractional bit allocation in the Generic mode bit allocation process?
question_8110.ground_truth: The fractional bit allocation in the Generic mode bit allocation process allows the allocation of bits with three bits fractional parts, which enables more precise allocation of bits to each band.

question_8113.question: What is the purpose of the GTP-U sender determining round trip time (RTT) periodically in the 3GPP domain?
question_8113.ground_truth: The GTP-U sender determines RTT periodically to detect changes in transport delays. This helps in monitoring QoS for a QoS Flow.

question_8114.question: When should the UE not stop timer T3584, even upon a PLMN change, SNPN change, or inter-system change?
question_8114.ground_truth: When the timer value is deactivated but has not expired yet.

question_8116.question: What is the additional requirement for UE with two active transmit antenna connectors in UL OLTD operation regarding the minimum requirements in sub-clause 6.5.4.1?
question_8116.ground_truth: The minimum requirements specified in sub-clause 6.5.4.1 apply at each UE antenna connector.

question_8117.question: What is the role of the Zh and Zn interfaces based on the Diameter protocol in GAA?
question_8117.ground_truth: The Zh interface is used for bootstrapping HSS resolution in GAA, while the Zn interface is used for bootstrapping GAA application. Both interfaces are based on the Diameter protocol and are defined in stage 3 of the GAA specification.

question_8118.question: When should the NG-RAN send an N2 MBS Session request message?
question_8118.ground_truth: The NG-RAN sends an N2 MBS Session request message when it decides to establish shared delivery for a multicast MBS session, or when handing over to a target RAN node that does not have a shared delivery tunnel established for the multicast MBS session.

question_8119.question: What is the purpose of the 'service request verification' payload in the CCA?
question_8119.ground_truth: The 'service request verification' payload is used to ensure the integrity of the service request and protect against unauthorized modifications during indirect communication. It includes the service request message or a hash of it, as well as a protected header list of custom headers that shall be integrity protected.

question_8121.question: What happens after the SNPN credentials are provisioned to the UE?
question_8121.ground_truth: Once the provisioning of SNPN credentials is completed, the UE de-registers from the ON and uses the provisioned SNPN credentials to register to the SNPN.

question_8122.question: What is the purpose of modifying clause 8.4.2.2.2, EEC registration, in the 3GPP TS 23.558 changes?
question_8122.ground_truth: The purpose of modifying clause 8.4.2.2.2, EEC registration, is to provide the EES with information about the EEC's expected use of the EES' services and the EAS selection request indicator, to enable EAS selection and synchronization of the information about selected EAS(s) between the EEC and EES.

question_8123.question: What is the purpose of the "Listener detection" procedure used by the BTS during a voice group call?
question_8123.ground_truth: The "Listener detection" procedure is used by the BTS during a voice group call to detect an uplink access with the value reserved for replying to an uplink access request and to measure the delay of the access burst.

question_8124.question: When should the 5G ProSe end UE consider the candidate 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE as discovered?
question_8124.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe end UE shall consider the candidate 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE as discovered if the relay service code parameter, direct discover set parameter, and UE-to-UE relay UE info parameter of the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-UE relay discovery response satisfy specific conditions.

question_8125.question: What is the purpose of step 4-6 in the procedure described in the document?
question_8125.ground_truth: Step 4-6 in the procedure describes the process of populating the UE context in the eNB-m. This may involve CN (Core Network) assistance for enhanced RRC-CONNECTED timer selection and context retention decisions.

question_8126.question: Which service does the BM-SAP provide to upper layers in the user plane on the radio interface for common user data in unacknowledged mode?

question_8127.question: What is the term that defines Emission on a frequency or frequencies immediately outside the necessary bandwidth which results from the modulation process, but excluding spurious emissions in 3GPP BS specifications?
question_8127.ground_truth: The term Out-of-band (OOB) emissions in 3GPP BS specifications defines Emission on a frequency or frequencies immediately outside the necessary bandwidth which results from the modulation process, but excluding spurious emissions.

question_8129.question: What is required during the registration procedure for UAS services to authorize direct C2 communication?
question_8129.ground_truth: To authorize direct C2 communication during the registration procedure for UAS services, a UE (unmanned aerial system) should provide the CAA-level~UAV~ID and C2 authorization payload.

question_8130.question: What type of E-UTRA UE does this test apply to?
question_8130.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 15 onwards, supporting EN-DC, BWP adaptation of at least 2BWPs, DCI and timer-based active BWP switching delay Type1 or Type2 and 2DL CA.

question_8131.question: How many identified cells and SSBs must the UE be capable of performing SS-RSRP, SS-RSRQ, and SS-SINR measurements for during each layer 1 measurement period for FR1?
question_8131.ground_truth: For each intra-frequency layer during each layer 1 measurement period, the UE shall be capable of performing SS-RSRP, SS-RSRQ, and SS-SINR measurements for at least 8 identified cells and 8 SSBs with different SSB index and/or PCI on the intra-frequency layer. Additionally, the UE must meet the requirements for the number of SSBs in GEO and NGSO deployments.

question_8132.question: What types of services are addressed in this 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_8132.ground_truth: The services addressed in this specification include session establishment, service continuity, single radio voice call continuity, access domain selection, and IMS control of services where the media is transported via the CS network.

question_8133.question: What should the network inform the UE about the support of specific features, such as IMS voice over PS session, location services (5G-LCS), emergency services, emergency services fallback, ATSSS and non-3GPP access path switching in the 5GS network feature support information element?
question_8133.ground_truth: The network informs the UE about the support of specific features, such as IMS voice over PS session, location services (5G-LCS), emergency services, emergency services fallback, ATSSS and non-3GPP access path switching in the 5GS network feature support information element. In a UE with IMS voice over PS session capability, the IMS voice over PS session indicator, the Emergency services support indicator, and the Emergency services fallback indicator shall be provided to the upper layers. The upper layers take the IMS voice over PS session indicator into account when selecting the access domain for voice sessions or calls. In a UE with LCS capability, location services indicator (5G-LCS) shall be provided to the upper layers. When initiating an emergency call, the upper layers also take the IMS voice over PS session indicator, the Emergency services support indicator, and the Emergency services fallback indicator into account for the access domain selection. In a UE with the capability for ATSSS, the network support for ATSSS shall be provided to the upper layers. If the UE receives the 5GS network feature support IE with the ATSSS support indicator set to "ATSSS not supported", the UE shall perform a local release of the MA PDU session, if any. In a UE that supports non-3GPP access path switching, the network support for non-3GPP access path switching shall be provided to the upper layers. If the UE receives the 5GS network feature support IE with the non-3GPP access path switching bit set to "non-3GPP access path switching not supported", the UE shall not perform the registration procedure for mobility registration update for non-3GPP access path switching.

question_8134.question: What represents the hOReportInformation in the SONInformation-ExtIEs NGAP-PROTOCOL-IES context?
question_8134.ground_truth: It is a report containing information about a handover procedure completed with a PLMN identity as origin and a target SNPN ID as destination, plus a set of extension information related the SNPN-CellBasedMDT context.

question_8136.question: What message does the SMF create to initiate the PDU EAP message reliable transport procedure?
question_8136.ground_truth: The SMF creates a PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message to initiate the PDU EAP message reliable transport procedure.

question_8137.question: What should the SCC AS do when it receives a SIP re-INVITE request with an SDP offer, indicating the addition of a CS bearer on an existing session?
question_8137.ground_truth: The SCC AS shall send a SIP 183 (Session Progress) response towards the originating ICS UE with the SDP answer, indicating local preconditions not met for the media over CS bearer, if the SDP offer meets the specified conditions.

question_8138.question: What is the action taken by the IP-SM-GW when there is an unsuccessful SMS-MT delivery?
question_8138.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW sets a "Not Reachable" flag, and a re-registration or other messages received from the terminal will trigger the standard retry mechanisms.

question_8140.question: What is the definition of average spectral efficiency in Report ITU-R M.2514?
question_8140.ground_truth: Average spectral efficiency is the aggregate throughput of all users divided by the channel bandwidth of a specific band divided by the number of TRxPs, and measured in bit/s/Hz/TRxP.

question_8141.question: What is the purpose of the Source-Controlled Variable Bit Rate operational mode (SC-VBR) in the Enhanced Voice Services codec?
question_8141.ground_truth: The Source-Controlled Variable Bit Rate operational mode (SC-VBR) reduces the operational bit rate still further for NB and WB speech services, providing a more efficient transmission with decreased load and increased capacity.

question_8143.question: What is the required placement of the initial UTRA FDD carrier in relation to the Base Station RF Bandwidth?
question_8143.ground_truth: The UTRA FDD carrier should be placed in the middle of the Base Station RF Bandwidth.

question_8145.question: What is the difference between an "abstract IOC provided for sub-classing only" and a regular class?
question_8145.ground_truth: An abstract IOC provided for sub-classing only is a class that cannot be instantiated on its own, and it is meant to be a base class for other classes. It provides common attributes and constraints that are shared among its sub-classes. A regular class, on the other hand, can be instantiated and used on its own.

question_8148.question: What is the effect on composite emission requirement when the sub-block gap size is varied in non-contiguous intra-band CA?
question_8148.ground_truth: The composite emission requirement varies based on the sub-block gap size, following specific rules when the sub-block gap bandwidth is equal to, greater than, or less than the sum of the out-of-band domain bandwidths, and also considering cases where OOB regions extend over different CC bandwidths.

question_8150.question: What action does the UE take when it receives the "UE positioning GANSS reference time" IE in a setup message?
question_8150.ground_truth: The UE stores the "GANSS Day" or "GANSS TOD" in the "UE positioning GANSS reference time" variable and uses it as the current GANSS day or an estimate of the GANSS Time-of-Day, depending on the included IEs.

question_8151.question: What happens when FRMCS User A and GSM-R User B and C accept the invitation and join the group communication in the FRMCS System?
question_8151.ground_truth: FRMCS User A, GSM-R User B and C can communicate among each other in a group call.

question_8152.question: How many maximum octets of free format data can be sent per leg?
question_8152.ground_truth: The maximum number of free format data that can be sent per leg is 160 octets.

question_8154.question: What is the position of the interfering signal in the first set of steps for each supported NR channel bandwidth?
question_8154.ground_truth: The interfering signal is adjusted at the opposite side of the Fc and adjacent to the wanted signal.

question_8155.question: How many frequency offsets are studied for intra-slot frequency hopping when the bandwidth is less than 50 PRBs?
question_8155.ground_truth: Four frequency offsets are studied for intra-slot frequency hopping when the bandwidth is less than 50 PRBs.

question_8157.question: What is the method of test for the "LAUNCH BROWSER" proactive command?
question_8157.ground_truth: The method of test for the "LAUNCH BROWSER" proactive command involves the execution of 3 sequences, each with a different URL and alpha identifier, with the expected result being a successful performance of the proactive command and Wap session.

question_8158.question: What is the effect of pseudo-flexible RM on the flexibility of the bit positions in the DCCH?
question_8158.ground_truth: With pseudo-flexible RM, the bit positions reserved for DCCH can be re-used by DTCH when DCCH does not carry a transport block, which makes more DPDCH bits available to the voice packets and allows increased repetition for improved performance of FET.

question_8160.question: What is the reference point between MME and 3GPP2 1xCS IWS for relaying 3GPP2 1xCS signalling messages?

question_8163.question: What triggers the immediate sending of a group call announcement in an ongoing MCPTT group call when a new entrant is detected?
question_8163.ground_truth: The MCPTT client that is the current talker (floor arbitrator) sends the group call announcement immediately when a new entrant, such as MCPTT client 4, is detected.

question_8164.question: What should the measurement reporting delay be, excluding certain factors such as delay uncertainty and no UL resources?
question_8164.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay excludes a delay uncertainty resulted when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH, and a delay which causes by no UL resources for UE to send the measurement report.

question_8165.question: What is the purpose of Step 4 in Test 31.2.1.2.1's MMI sequence for registration rejected?
question_8165.ground_truth: Step 4 is for the MS to register with the SS, but with a non-compatible mobile station, the mobile station shall send the "normalized" INDEFINITE form of the message.

question_8168.question: What information does the old 3G-SGSN include in the SGSN Context Response (MM Context, PDP Contexts, Negotiated Evolved ARP) message for each PDP context?
question_8168.ground_truth: The GTP sequence number for the next uplink GTP PDU to be tunnelled to the GGSN and the next downlink GTP sequence number for the next in-sequence N-PDU to be sent to the MS. Each PDP Context also includes the SNDCP Send N-PDU Number (the value is 0) for the next in-sequence downlink N-PDU to be sent in SNDCP acknowledged mode to the MS and the SNDCP Receive N-PDU Number (= converted PDCP-SNU) for the next in-sequence uplink N-PDU to be received in SNDCP acknowledged mode from the MS.

question_8169.question: What is the maximum transmission power that requires coordination with the RAS?
question_8169.ground_truth: Any operator with a high power station (i.e. more than 2 kW EIRP) within 185 km radius of RAS facilities is obligated to coordinate with the National Science Foundation (NSF) before operating.

question_8170.question: What mode is the MS brought into after being packet idle?
question_8170.ground_truth: The MS is brought into packet idle mode.

question_8173.question: What is the purpose of the procedure specified in TS 38.331, clause 5.5.5.1?
question_8173.ground_truth: The purpose of the procedure specified in TS 38.331, clause 5.5.5.1 is to transfer measurement results from the UE to the network after successful AS security activation.

question_8174.question: What is the type of emergency call if the UE recognizes that a call request is an emergency call and core network supports emergency bearers?
question_8174.ground_truth: UE should use EPS bearer contexts for both signalling and media for emergency calls made using the IM CN subsystem.

question_8175.question: What action is taken if there is no change in ciphering status and no new keys?
question_8175.ground_truth: CipheringModeCommand is set to NULL and no new keys are used.

question_8177.question: What is the objective of using a pre-established session in MCPTT?
question_8177.ground_truth: The objective is to have a pre-established session between MCPTT UE-A and MCPTT server A, which can be used to either initiate a fast MCPTT call establishment or modify the pre-established session to match between the invitation request and the existing pre-established session.

question_8178.question: How many sources observed a negative performance gain in the evaluation of Type 2 training between 1 NW part model and M>1 separate UE part models?

question_8179.question: What is the action taken by the SMF when not all the PCC Rules bound to a QoS flow are removed from a PDU session restricted to Emergency Services?
question_8179.ground_truth: The SMF initiates a QoS flow modification procedure.

question_8180.question: What are the three different communication interfaces in AKMA?
question_8180.ground_truth: The three different communication interfaces in AKMA are (1) the communication between UE and 3GPP network, (2) between UE and application server, and (3) between 3GPP network and application server.

question_8182.question: What is the purpose of the tests in 8.2.2.4.1B, 8.2.2.4.1D, and 8.2.2.4.2A?
question_8182.ground_truth: The purpose of the tests in 8.2.2.4.1B and 8.2.2.4.1D is to verify the closed loop rank-one performance with wideband precoding, while the purpose of the tests in 8.2.2.4.2A is to verify the closed loop rank-two performance with wideband precoding.

question_8183.question: What is the role of the Innovative codevector in the AMR-WB codec?
question_8183.ground_truth: The innovative codevector is used in the fixed algebraic codebook search to find the optimum innovation for the new target signal x2(n), which is obtained by removing the adaptive codebook contribution from the original target signal x(n).

question_8187.question: What message does ProSe Server-A send to ProSe Server-B when authorizing UE-A's ProSe Discovery request?
question_8187.ground_truth: ProSe Server-A sends a ProSe Permission Check Request message to ProSe Server-B to check if UE-A is permitted to discover UE-B.

question_8188.question: In the procedure for private call setup from a migrated user, what is the significance of MC service server A responding with a private call response in step 6?
question_8188.ground_truth: MC service server A responds with a private call response to indicate whether it accepts or rejects the call for media logging purposes. If it accepts the call, media will flow between MC service client 1 and MC service server A; otherwise, only MC service client 1 and MC service server C will be in the media path.

question_8189.question: What is the purpose of SSR URA?
question_8189.ground_truth: SSR URA provides the receiver with information about the estimated accuracy of the corrections for each satellite.

question_8191.question: What is the difference between inter-RAT and intra-RAT energy saving in terms of the selection of candidate cells?
question_8191.ground_truth: In inter-RAT energy saving, the candidate cells are eNB, while in intra-RAT energy saving, the candidate cells are gNB.

question_8194.question: What should the SS send after sending pseudo random characters for approximately 5 seconds following TCH synchronization at the SS side?
question_8194.ground_truth: After sending pseudo random characters for approximately 5 seconds following TCH synchronization at the SS side, the SS shall send the following bit sequence in the 3GPP~TS~04.21 frames: 2M+3 bits of start polarity, and 2M bits of stop polarity.

question_8195.question: What should a MS do when attempting to send an exception report and determines that the Exception Report Status field sent in EC-SI2 is not authorized?
question_8195.ground_truth: The EC-EGPRS preliminary access barring check prohibits the MS from sending an exception report if the Exception Report Status field is not authorized.

question_8196.question: Who receives the media when the MCPTT server sends the media "over the associated MBS session"?

question_8198.question: What does it mean when the test procedure states that the UE "responds" to a cell?
question_8198.ground_truth: The UE starts transmitting a preamble on PRACH to perform a Registration procedure for mobility when it re-selects to a specific cell.

question_8200.question: What is the on-demand solution for the End UE in Scenario #2?
question_8200.ground_truth: The on-demand solution for Scenario #2 is a U2U Relay secured PC5 message request and response for a protected direct discovery set.

question_8201.question: What triggers the network to start APN based congestion control?
question_8201.ground_truth: The network may start APN based congestion control when one or more APN congestion criteria, as specified in 3GPP TS 23.060, are met.

question_8203.question: How are AP IDs used in NG interface or Xn interface or F1 interface or E1 interface?
question_8203.ground_truth: AP IDs are used in NG interface or Xn interface or F1 interface or E1 interface to uniquely identify a logical connection associated to a UE over the NG interface or Xn interface or F1 interface or E1 interface within a node or over the F1 interface or over the E1 interface or over the W1 interface.

question_8204.question: What information must the 3GPP network be able to securely receive from an authorized 3rd party via encrypted connection for the use case functionality?
question_8204.ground_truth: Expected communication behavior of UE(s), including allowed applications, allowed geographic area, and the expected network's actions when detecting unexpected communication behavior.

question_8205.question: What SMF action initiates application client to switch to the New EAS after EAS relocation is completed?
question_8205.ground_truth: The SMF sends event exposure to AF (late notification) about the new UP path after Target BP/ULCL and Target UPF (PSA3) have been activated, indicating that context migration between old and new EAS is completed and the application client is instructed for when and how to switch to the New EAS, using Application Layer procedures.

question_8206.question: What information is included in the Path header field of the SIP REGISTER request message?
question_8206.ground_truth: The Path header field of the SIP REGISTER request message includes the address of the P-CSCF-vA1 and is included to inform the S-CSCF where to route terminating requests.

question_8207.question: What does the abbreviation "GEO" stand for in the context of non-terrestrial networks?

question_8209.question: Which functional element is responsible for generating the values for RFSP Index, UE-AMBR, UE-Slice-MBR, Service Area Restriction, SMF selection management and Network Slice Replacement in the VPLMN for access and mobility related policy control?
question_8209.ground_truth: The V-PCF is responsible for generating these values in the VPLMN.

question_8210.question: How are additional TSN traffic patterns distributed to RAN via SMF and AMF?
question_8210.ground_truth: The additional TSN traffic patterns and associated QFI references are sent from SMF to RAN via N2 information using existing PDU session establishment/modification procedures. The QFI reference is used by gNB to link the additional TSN traffic patterns to a specific TSN flow.

question_8211.question: What is the starting point for SA3 to use when identifying security requirements and test cases for a network product class?
question_8211.ground_truth: SA3 uses the CC part 2 document as a reference catalogue of security requirements and security requirement categories.

question_8212.question: What is the role of a PINAPP in the PIN ecosystem?
question_8212.ground_truth: A PINAPP can maintain a registry of ASs available to a PIN and provide information about available ASs to other PINAPPs. It also allows application clients to query for information about an AS.

question_8213.question: What is the traditional SRB data rate and TTI over DCH?
question_8213.ground_truth: The traditional SRB data rate over DCH is 3.4 kbps and the TTI is 40 ms.

question_8216.question: What is the role of the 5GPRUK in the UE-to-network relay security flow?
question_8216.ground_truth: The 5GPRUK is a relay key generated by the 5GPKMF of the relay service for the Remote UE, used for establishing a secure connection between the Remote UE and the UE-to-network Relay UE. The 5GPRUK is generated based on an AV of the Remote UE or derived from the SUCI if the Remote UE does not already have a 5GPRUK.

question_8217.question: What is the disadvantage of using compression/decompression algorithms at the HSS as per Option B?
question_8217.ground_truth: The disadvantage of using compression/decompression algorithms at the HSS as per Option B is that it is independent of the nature of data exchanged over the Sh interface, and the compression/decompression algorithm could operate on data received at the HSS over the Sh. However, this would require the App Server and HSS to be coordinated, requiring a standardization/definition exercise for each application server or application server data increment.

question_8218.question: What should a UE do after releasing an emergency PDU session if it did not receive WUS assistance information during the last registration procedure?
question_8218.ground_truth: The UE should initiate a registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update to request WUS assistance information.

question_8219.question: What is the procedure for the SMF to send the content of the DN Request Container information (authentication message) to the DN-AAA Server via the UPF?
question_8219.ground_truth: In step 3f, after receiving the N1 NAS message containing DN Request Container information from the UE, the AMF informs the SMF. The SMF then sends the content of the DN Request Container information to the DN-AAA Server via the UPF, which relays it to the DN-AAA Server. This process continues until the DN-AAA Server confirms the successful authentication/authorization of the PDU Session.

question_8220.question: In the CMPv2 based certificate management, what is the significance of the NF generating a new private-public key pair to obtain the operator signed end entity certificate?
question_8220.ground_truth: Generating a new private-public key pair in CMPv2 based certificate management allows for a more secure process while obtaining the operator signed end-entity certificate, as it ensures the key hasn't been compromised earlier, offering better protection for the NF.

question_8221.question: What is the value of Subsession-Operation AVP in the V-PCRF when an existing S9 session for the roaming user is already established and if no Gateway Control Session for the same PDN ID exists?
question_8221.ground_truth: The value of Subsession-Operation AVP in the V-PCRF is "ESTABLISHMENT".

question_8222.question: What is the role of gNB-DU in RAN visible QoE measurement in split gNB architecture?
question_8222.ground_truth: In split gNB architecture, upon receiving RAN visible QoE measurement reports from UE, the gNB-CU may forward the corresponding QoE information to the gNB-DU, which may deactivate the transfer of RAN visible QoE measurement results from the gNB-CU by initiating QoE Information Transfer Control procedure towards the gNB-CU.

question_8223.question: Which wireless communication technology showed better metrics for the non-replaced Wi-Fi operator in the outdoor scenario with one shared unlicensed carrier and FTP traffic, when both technologies used the same CCA-ED threshold?
question_8223.ground_truth: NR-U network had better metrics for the non-replaced Wi-Fi operator compared to the Wi-Fi network when both technologies used the same CCA-ED threshold in an outdoor scenario with one shared unlicensed carrier and FTP traffic.

question_8224.question: What does the source and target gNBs maintain during the handover execution period to process uplink data from the UE?
question_8224.ground_truth: The source and target gNBs maintain their own security and ROHC header decompressor contexts to process UL data received from the UE during the handover execution period.

question_8225.question: What is the effect of activating/deactivating charging for any AMF functionality by CHF?
question_8225.ground_truth: The set of triggers enabled/disabled via charging activation/deactivation by CHF are independent from the invoked AMF functionality. The triggers activation/deactivation take effect at the next AMF functionality invoking the CHF.

question_8227.question: What is the problem that is solved by rejecting connection requests by the SGSN/MME in the Evolved Packet Core (EPC)?
question_8227.ground_truth: This solution helps with congestion and overload control for the SGSN/MME in the EPC, specifically in managing the limited network resources.

question_8228.question: What should the S-CCF do when it receives an initial request for a dialog or a request for a standalone transaction from an unregistered user?
question_8228.ground_truth: The S-CCF should execute a series of procedures, which includes removing certain headers and saving specific information from the request. If the S-CCF does not have the user profile, it will initiate the S-CCF Registration/deregistration notification to download the relevant user profile and inform the HSS that the user is unregistered.

question_8229.question: What measures should be taken in the "non-transparent case" regarding data and status lines in the RLP?
question_8229.ground_truth: In the "non-transparent case," the RLP satisfies the requirement for both data and status lines.

question_8230.question: How does the NM-RMS collect PEE parameters in the 3GPP network?
question_8230.ground_truth: The NM-RMS collects PEE parameters from part or whole of the radio access network and may control PEE-related parameters through DM(s) and/or XCU/DGU(s) and/or VS-RMS(s).

question_8231.question: What does "User Connectivity" refer to in the context of networks?
question_8231.ground_truth: User Connectivity refers to the capability to establish and maintain data transfer between networks and terminals.

question_8232.question: In the LTE download tab, what does the "Kt" column represent?
question_8232.ground_truth: The total number of source symbols for the test cases for the RFC 5053 code.

question_8233.question: What is the technique used to ensure all symbols are transmitted at least once after 3 transmissions of a block?
question_8233.ground_truth: Modification to the scheme includes the transmission of all symbols at least once after 3 transmissions of a block to improve throughput performance.

question_8234.question: What is the event listed in the "EVENT DOWNLOAD - IMS Registration 7.1.1" log?

question_8237.question: What is the responsible entity for intercepting MMS messages at the GSN?
question_8237.ground_truth: The GSN is not responsible for recovering individual MMS messages from the user PDP context IP stream.

question_8239.question: What is the function of the DHCP relay agent in the GGSN in the context of DHCP?
question_8239.ground_truth: The DHCP relay agent relays the requests from the DHCP client to the DHCP server(s) and replies from the server(s) to the corresponding client, allowing for the correct delivery of replies as the logical connection from the MT terminates in the GGSN.

question_8240.question: What is the purpose of user plane tunnelling in EGAN handovers and LA/RA Update signalling?
question_8240.ground_truth: The purpose of user plane tunnelling is to identify the flow inside the IPsec for EGAN handovers and LA/RA Update signalling.

question_8242.question: What IF is used by the gsmSSF to report to the gsmSCF the information requested in the Apply Charging IF?

question_8244.question: What is the role of the IWF in interworking between an MCPTT or MCData system and an LMR system?
question_8244.ground_truth: The IWF provides centralized support for interworking between an MCPTT or MCData system and an LMR system. It maps the identities of LMR users and groups to corresponding identities in an MCPTT or MCData system.

question_8245.question: What is the effect of the activation and deactivation of the discontinuous downlink reception operation?
question_8245.ground_truth: The activation and deactivation of the discontinuous downlink reception operation is applied by the UE 12 slots after the ending of the HS-SCCH subframe delivering the order.

question_8246.question: What regulatory requirements determine the need for support of emergency calls in the IM CN subsystem?

question_8247.question: What is the function of the Terminate EMSDP session request for E2E command?
question_8247.ground_truth: The Terminate EMSDP session request for E2E command is used by either the UE or the HSE to terminate an existing EMSDP session with E2E keys. This message is exchanged between the UE and the HSE on a control session to terminate the E2E session between the UE and the EnSE.

question_8249.question: What action should be taken to the contents of the body if the Content-Type of the SIP message is "text" or any of its subtypes?
question_8249.ground_truth: The contents of the body must be overwritten with spaces such that the length of the body remains unchanged.

question_8250.question: What is the maximum number of timers that can be allocated for all applets?

question_8251.question: What does the UAE layer define in relation to 3GPP TS 23.255?
question_8251.ground_truth: The UAE layer defines the procedures for UAS application communication between the UE and the UAE server, and among UEs over the U1-AE interface. It also defines the usage and interactions of the UAE layer with SEAL services, as well as the message format, message contents, error handling, and system parameters applied by the protocols for the UAE layer.

question_8253.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function create when sending a SIP MESSAGE request to remove a regroup?
