question_8253.ground_truth: An application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-regroup+xml MIME body including an <mcvideo-regroup-uri> element set to the identity of the regroup and a <regroup-action> element set to "remove".

question_8254.question: Where are the privacy profile data stored for EPS?
question_8254.ground_truth: The privacy profile data for EPS are stored in H-GMLC/PPR.

question_8256.question: Which command type is used to set up idle mode text, and what is its command qualifier?
question_8256.ground_truth: The command type used to set up idle mode text is "SET UP IDLE MODE TEXT," and its command qualifier is "RFU."

question_8258.question: What is the role of the ProSe Server in the network architecture?
question_8258.ground_truth: The ProSe Server is a new logical network entity in the EPC on the 3GPP control plane that implements the functionality of the ProSe Function entity.

question_8261.question: What is the maximum frequency error allowed in 13.17.1b.5.1?
question_8261.ground_truth: The maximum frequency error allowed is less than 10E-7.

question_8263.question: What is the requirement for a UE supporting ca-IdleModeMeasurements when performing idle mode CA measurements on overlapping carriers?
question_8263.ground_truth: A UE supporting ca-IdleModeMeasurements must perform idle mode CA measurements on serving cell and overlapping carriers, as defined in the section.

question_8264.question: What is the purpose of sending multiple IEs in the PFCP Session Establishment Response message from UP Function to CP Function?
question_8264.ground_truth: The order of the IEs in the message indicates the priority of the DNS or NBNS server addresses, with the first IE containing the primary address and the second IE containing the secondary address.

question_8266.question: What is the default value of the Mobile Country Code (MCC) in the E-UTRAN parameters of the system simulator?
question_8266.ground_truth: The default value of the Mobile Country Code (MCC) in the E-UTRAN parameters of the system simulator is 001.

question_8269.question: What is one of the pre-conditions to trigger the network slice optimization in the VAL server policy provisioning?
question_8269.ground_truth: The NSCE server is authorized to get network slice management data notification from OAM, and/or NWDAF via NEF.

question_8270.question: What message does the NEF send to the AF when the establishment or update of transmission resources occurs?
question_8270.ground_truth: The NEF sends a Nnef_AFsessionWithQoS_Notify message to the AF, which includes the information about the resource allocation status for every UE address in the list.

question_8271.question: What is the EVM budget approved for MPR evaluation by RAN4?
question_8271.ground_truth: The EVM budget approved for MPR evaluation by RAN4 is 3.5%.

question_8272.question: Which network entities does CAMEL support for IP multimedia sessions?
question_8272.ground_truth: CAMEL supports IP multimedia sessions addressed by either E.164 numbers or SIP URLs.

question_8273.question: What protocol is used as a global mobility protocol for handovers between 3GPP and non-3GPP access systems in this solution?

question_8276.question: Under what conditions should the UE initiate an IMS emergency registration?
question_8276.ground_truth: The UE should initiate an IMS emergency registration if it is not already IMS registered, roaming outside its home network, has sufficient credentials to authenticate with the IMS network, and is able to detect emergency sessions. The UE should also initiate IMS emergency registration if it receives an "IMS emergency registration required" response.

question_8277.question: What is the TERMINAL RESPONSE COMMAND when the PROACTIVE COMMAND: OPEN CHANNEL 8.2.1 is sent and received successfully?
question_8277.ground_truth: TERMINAL RESPONSE (Command performed successfully) with Channel status CHANNEL STATUS: Channel identifier 1 and link established.

question_8278.question: What is the responsibilities of the Control Plane Charging Nodes (CPCN) in the 3GPP charging architecture?
question_8278.ground_truth: The CPCN records Control Plane data transfer and generates charging information, which can be used for Offline Charging.

question_8279.question: Who were involved in the development of this OSA specifications?
question_8279.ground_truth: The OSA specifications were jointly developed by 3GPP TSG CT WG5, ETSI TISPAN and the Parlay Group, in cooperation with a number of JAIN Community member companies.

question_8281.question: What information is signalled from the UE to the LMF in UE-based mode?
question_8281.ground_truth: The UE in UE-based or standalone mode reports the latitude, longitude, and possibly altitude with an estimate of location uncertainty, velocity, and an indication of which GNSSs and possibly other location methods have been used to calculate a fix.

question_8282.question: What should the Mobile Station do when it receives an IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT EXTENDED message that references an earlier CHANNEL REQUEST message?
question_8282.ground_truth: The Mobile Station should ignore the IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT EXTENDED message and continue to send CHANNEL REQUEST messages until the Max-Retrans value has been reached.

question_8283.question: What is the role of IKEv2 in negotiating the IPsec security association?
question_8283.ground_truth: The UE supports the IKEv2 protocol for negotiating the IPsec security association to secure DSMIPv6 signalling, and uses EAP over IKEv2 for authentication with an AAA server. The UE supports IPsec ESP and multiple authentication exchanges in the IKEv2 protocol to support authentication with an external AAA server, and the redirect mechanism is also supported.

question_8286.question: What is the purpose of Solution #3.2 in the converged charging architecture?
question_8286.ground_truth: Solution #3.2 relies on CHF/5G Converged Charging System for 5G VN group unicast communication charging, and addresses the Key Issue #3.1 with the different that UPF1 reports the usage volume per PDU session per UE to SMF.

question_8288.question: What does the State attributes IE specify in the STATUS message?
question_8288.ground_truth: The State attributes IE specifies information about the state of a call or the connection.

question_8289.question: What is the definition of Total Radiated Power (TRP) in the context of a wireless device?
question_8289.ground_truth: TRP is a measure of how much power the device actually radiates, calculated as the integral of the power transmitted in different directions over the entire radiation sphere.

question_8290.question: What is the target for the quality of the secondary stream in a MIMO scheme using two transport blocks?
question_8290.ground_truth: The target is to achieve the same block error rate (BLER) level as the primary stream.

question_8294.question: When can the MS send an ACTIVATE SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message after a PLMN change, if the back-off timer is not running or deactivated?
question_8294.ground_truth: The MS can send an ACTIVATE SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message after a PLMN change if the back-off timer is not running or deactivated for the secondary PDP context activation procedure and the combination of new PLMN and APN.

question_8295.question: What is the importance of Network Assisted Interference Cancellation (NAIC) in heterogeneous deployments?
question_8295.ground_truth: NAIC is crucial in heterogeneous deployments as it helps mitigate the performance loss experienced by a UE connected to an LPN due to strong Macro interference.

question_8296.question: What type of channel is the Dedicated Traffic Channel (DTCH) in LTE?
question_8296.ground_truth: The Dedicated Traffic Channel (DTCH) is a point-to-point bi-directional channel dedicated to one UE for the transfer of user information in LTE.

question_8297.question: What information is used by NWDAF to expose slice load level analytics?
question_8297.ground_truth: The NWDAF services as defined in clause~7.2 and clause~7.3 are used to expose slice load level analytics from the NWDAF to the consumer NF.

question_8298.question: What does the UEReachabilityInfoNotify service operation do and how is it triggered?
question_8298.ground_truth: The UEReachabilityInfoNotify service operation is used to send a notification towards the notification URI for the UE(s) which are reachable or do not respond to paging. It is triggered by the AMF after the EnableGroupReachability service operation is invoked. The AMF uses the HTTP method POST, using the notification URI received in the EnableGroupReachability request, to send a notification.

question_8299.question: What is the minimum value of "PacketLossRate" parameter defined as?

question_8300.question: How is the parameter Ns calculated?
question_8300.ground_truth: Ns is calculated as 64 divided by the DCI interval for the corresponding Coverage Class.

question_8302.question: What should a UE do with GRUUs if it indicated support for GRUU in the Supported header field of the REGISTER request and used the procedures specified in RFC 6140?
question_8302.ground_truth: The UE should store the value of the "pub-gruu" header field parameter for use for generating public GRUUs for registering UAs and the value of the "temp-gruu-cookie" header field parameter for use for generating temporary GRUUs for registering UAs.

question_8303.question: What is the purpose of the MBMS Key Management function?
question_8303.ground_truth: The MBMS Key Management function is used to distribute MBMS keys to authorized UEs for securing MBMS user services data.

question_8305.question: What is the purpose of the test for constraining the access to a single number as defined by 3GPP~TS~02.07 Category 3?
question_8305.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure the correct behavior of the MS to 3GPP~TS~02.07 Category 3.

question_8306.question: What are the IRI events generated by the IRI-POI in the SCEF for NIDD using SCEF?
question_8306.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the SCEF generates xIRI events when it detects the following specific events or information: PDN connection establishment, PDN connection update, PDN connection release, start of interception with established PDN connection, unsuccessful procedure, and PDN connection establishment failure.

question_8307.question: How many subframes after subframe (n) can DTX not be observed for the event "Deactivation" to be considered a success in the intra-band PCell TDD case?
question_8307.ground_truth: DTX should not be observed in subframes (n+5) to (n+9) and (n+13), subframes (n+6) to (n+10) and (n+13) to (n+14), or subframes (n+7) to (n+11) and (n+13) to (n+14) and (n+18) for the event "Deactivation" to be considered a success in the intra-band PCell TDD case.

question_8308.question: What field does the HS-DSCH data frame header include to which the RNC can include the received measurement results on RACH?
question_8308.ground_truth: The HS-DSCH data frame header includes a "RACH Measurement Result" field.

question_8310.question: Which bands, besides Band 31, may have interference issues with Bands 1 + 3 + 28 DL carriers when used for BS transmitter and Band 31 for BS receiver?
question_8310.ground_truth: Band 3, Band 7, Band 28, and Band 31 (when antenna sharing is allowed) may have interference issues.

question_8311.question: What is the issue addressed in Solution #12?
question_8311.ground_truth: The solution addresses the key issue #4, which is signaling overload due to malicious applications on the User Equipment (UE).

question_8312.question: What is the purpose of the test defined in 8.7.8.1.3 and 8.7.8.1.4?
question_8312.ground_truth: The purpose of the test defined in 8.7.8.1.3 and 8.7.8.1.4 is to verify that the P-CCPCH RSCP absolute measurement accuracy is within the specified limits.

question_8313.question: What are the two options for spectrum that the 5G system should support for PRAS as per PR 5.18.6-002?

question_8314.question: What is the function of the serviceArea element within the availabilityInfo element of an MBMS User Service Description?
question_8314.ground_truth: The serviceArea element within the availabilityInfo element indicates the one or more service areas over which this MBMS User Service is provided, and is designated by the MBMS Service Area Identity.

question_8315.question: What should a UE do when it wants to make a new communication, but another UE's ID is in the RELEASE message's list of seconds and not first?
question_8315.ground_truth: It will wait time D for each ID in the list above its own ID to see if a higher priority UE takes the floor. If the xD time expires, the UE sends its ORIGINATE and begins its communication.

question_8316.question: What information does the USS include in the re-authentication request message?
question_8316.ground_truth: The USS includes the GPSI, CAA-Level UAV ID, and an Authentication message in the re-authentication request message. It may contain the PDU Session IP address if available.

question_8317.question: What is the purpose of the ABIM object classes for authentication methods?
question_8317.ground_truth: The purpose of the ABIM object classes for authentication methods is to represent data that is required to perform Authentication and Key Agreement (AKA) for different types of services, such as GPRS, EPS, CS, IMS, and others. Each object class represents the data that is required to perform AKA for a specific type of service.

question_8318.question: Who is responsible for handling the mapping between the UE location and DNAI(s) associated with UPF and applications in the selection of the UPF(s) for PDU sessions?

question_8319.question: Upon receiving the SystemInformationBlockType1 message, what should a category 0 UE do if the cellAccessRelatedInfoList-5GC doesn't contain an entry with the plmn-Identity of the selected PLMN?
question_8319.ground_truth: If a category 0 UE receives the SystemInformationBlockType1 message and the cellAccessRelatedInfoList-5GC doesn't contain an entry with the plmn-Identity of the selected PLMN, it should consider the cell as barred.

question_8320.question: In what transmission modes is the UE required to report a type 2b report on each respective successive reporting opportunity?
question_8320.ground_truth: Transmission modes 9 and 10 with certain conditions.

question_8321.question: What is a solution for enabling the 5GS to know the PDU set handling capability of the RAN node?
question_8321.ground_truth: The solution includes enhancements such as adding a "PSH-support" indicator in the N2 SM information during PDU session establishment, and including the indicator in the Path Switch Request (Xn handover) or Handover Request Acknowledge message (NG handover) to inform the SMF and UPF about the PDU set handling capability.

question_8322.question: What is the significance of not encrypting the RTP extension header?
question_8322.ground_truth: Not encrypting the RTP extension header allows UPF to inspect the header, reducing packet inspection complexity.

question_8323.question: What is the amount of link-efficiency gain provided by Solution 1 over R99 for the AMR 12.2kbps codec, in most cases?

question_8324.question: What information must be provided by the SMF during initial registration for enabling P-CSCF restoration in 5G networks?
question_8324.ground_truth: The SMF must provide sufficient information, including DNN for IMS and callback URI for P-CSCF restoration, to the UDM during initial registration to trigger P-CSCF restoration.

question_8325.question: What is one of the features in IMS-based 3D Avatar Call Support use case?
question_8325.ground_truth: One of the features in IMS-based 3D Avatar Call Support use case is the possibility to enable authorized third party to synchronize the metaverse traffic which is routed or steered over available 5G access networks.

question_8326.question: What does the "+CGEREP" command do in the context of sending unsolicited result codes?
question_8326.ground_truth: The "+CGEREP" command enables or disables sending of unsolicited result codes in the case of certain events occurring in the Packet Domain MT or the network, with "<mode>" controlling the processing of unsolicited codes.

question_8328.question: What is the maximum allowed peak code domain error for spreading factor 256?
question_8328.ground_truth: The peak code domain error shall not exceed -35 dB at spreading factor 256.

question_8331.question: In what scenarios is the vPCRF involved in the handover procedure?
question_8331.ground_truth: The vPCRF is involved in the handover procedure for roaming cases, except for the authentication and authorization step, and in non-roaming cases where there is a need for authentication and authorization.

question_8332.question: What is the condition for inter-frequency relative SS-RSRP measurement accuracy?
question_8332.ground_truth: The condition for inter-frequency relative SS-RSRP measurement accuracy is that the absolute difference between the channel 1 and channel 2 reference signals is at least 20 dB.

question_8333.question: When should the UE include the 3GPP PS Data Off Support Indication in the PCO when sending the Request Bearer Resource Modification message to the MME?
question_8333.ground_truth: The UE should include the 3GPP PS Data Off Support Indication in the PCO when sending the Request Bearer Resource Modification message to the MME if the PDN GW indicated support for the 3GPP PS data off feature during PDN connection setup and the 3GPP PS Data Off feature status has changed.

question_8335.question: What is the primary goal of Solutions #11 and #12 in addressing CAG ID privacy?
question_8335.ground_truth: The goal of Solutions #11 and #12 is to provide a method for protection of the CAG IDs transmitted during broadcast/CAG cell selection and in UL AS signalling during access control procedure, and to protect against passive and False Base Station attacks on CAG ID confidentiality and privacy over unicast or broadcast messages during the CAG access control procedure.

question_8336.question: What is the purpose of Option 1 in sharing the same MnS for tenancy?
question_8336.ground_truth: Option 1 allows for multiple tenants to consume the same management service from a single MnS Producer instance, with tenancy related management data isolation not provided by the 3GPP management system.

question_8337.question: What is actualUESliceAMBR defined as in this solution?
question_8337.ground_truth: In this solution, actualUESliceAMBR is defined as the accumulated session AMBR across all the active PDU sessions associated with the same network slice per UE in UL and DL + accumulated MFBR across all active GBR flows associated with the same network slice per UE in UL and DL.

question_8338.question: What is the purpose of Ranging/Sidelink positioning with the assistance of assistant UE?
question_8338.ground_truth: The purpose is to determine the Ranging/Sidelink positioning result or Ranging/Sidelink positioning measurement data for a SL Positioning Client UE in network coverage or partial network coverage.

question_8339.question: What is the requirement for the target network for PLMN selection at handover from E-UTRAN to UTRAN to make a difference based on UE capability?
question_8339.ground_truth: The target network should support broadcasting of multiple PLMN list.

question_8340.question: What is the initial step for the process of service provision in section 4.2.4.2?
question_8340.ground_truth: The initial step for the process of service provision in section 4.2.4.2 is the UE proceeding to Initial Attach towards the VPLMN PGW allocated for the selected APN.

question_8341.question: What should the MCPTT client do upon receiving a SIP re-INVITE request for an existing private call with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body and an <emergency-ind> element set to "false"?
question_8341.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should display to the MCPTT user an indication that this is a SIP re-INVITE request to downgrade this emergency private call to a normal priority private call, display the MCPTT ID of the sender of the SIP re-INVITE request, set the MCPTT emergency private priority state to "MEPP 1: no-emergency" for this private call, and if the MCPTT emergency private call state of the call is set to "MEPC 3: emergency-call-granted", shall set the MCPTT emergency private call state of the call to "MEPC 1: emergency-pc-capable".

question_8344.question: What promising technology is mentioned to support online gaming in power- and resource-constrained devices?
question_8344.ground_truth: Split rendering is a promising technology to support online gaming in power- and resource-constrained devices.

question_8345.question: What is the role of the GUP Component Language (GCL) in 3GPP GUP?
question_8345.ground_truth: The GCL is used for referencing components in 3GPP GUP. It is a subset of the XPath 1.0 language and is used to define the language syntax for GUP.

question_8346.question: In the context of a URSP rule, what does a DNN Selection component do in a Route Selection Descriptor?
question_8346.ground_truth: It indicates that the traffic of the matching application/PIN shall be routed via a PDU Session supporting any of the included DNNs. If a DNN Selection component is provided in the Route Selection Descriptor, the UE shall use any of the DNNs of the DNN Selection component, instead of the DNN requested by the application for the PDU Session that is used to route the traffic of the matching application.

question_8347.question: What is the action taken by the UE if an access attempt is barred?
question_8347.ground_truth: If the access attempt is barred, the NAS shall not initiate the procedure to send the initial NAS message for the access attempt.

question_8348.question: What is the consequence of the absence of the OSId leaf in ANDSF/IARP/<X>/ForNonSeamlessOffload/<X>/IPFlow/<X>/App-ID?
question_8348.ground_truth: The absence of the OSId leaf in ANDSF/IARP/<X>/ForNonSeamlessOffload/<X>/IPFlow/<X>/App-ID indicates that the operating system identifier is not examined when matching packets against the IP flow description of the rule.

question_8349.question: What are the requirements for the Deterministic Delay QoS class in order to support the Bridge Model?
question_8349.ground_truth: The Deterministic Delay QoS class should give deterministic air delay and backhaul delay for Bridge Model. For symmetric air delay, DL and UL scheduling should coordinate with each other, and DL/UL congestion should not happen. If packets are scheduled with an increased (higher) priority, the UPF and gNB are expected to achieve the target backhaul delay without failur".

question_8350.question: What is the purpose of user authorization and authentication in the primary MC system?
question_8350.ground_truth: The purpose of user authorization and authentication in the primary MC system is to realize the MC service user authentication and authorization requirements as defined in 3GPP TS 22.280.

question_8352.question: Which type is the attribute that has legal values "NPT" or "UTC" and follows the append resolution rule?

question_8353.question: What information does the "request-retransmitted" parameter provide in the 3gpp-Sbi-Response-Info header?
question_8353.ground_truth: The "request-retransmitted" parameter in the 3gpp-Sbi-Response-Info header indicates, in an error response, whether the SCP attempted to retransmit the request to alternative HTTP server instances. When present, it shall be set to "true" if so, and to "false" otherwise.

question_8355.question: Which release of the NR UE does this test apply to?
question_8355.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16, supporting NE-DC and idleInactiveEUTRA-MeasReport-r16.

question_8356.question: What is the duration of the legacy measurement gap versus the new 2ms measurement gap in an LTE network?
question_8356.ground_truth: The legacy measurement gap is 6ms, while the new 2ms measurement gap is much shorter than the current 6ms measurement gap.

question_8360.question: What are the evaluation criteria for co-existence performance of NR V2X as agreed by RAN4?
question_8360.ground_truth: The evaluation criteria for co-existence performance of NR V2X are the Packet Reception Ratio (PRR) and the CDF of PRR.

question_8361.question: Under what conditions would a new MME/AMF send the Context Request message during TAU/RAU/Idle mode Mobility procedures?
question_8361.ground_truth: A new MME/AMF sends the Context Request message to the old MME/SGSN during a TAU/RAU procedure or idle mode mobility procedure to get the MM and EPS bearer contexts for the UE.

question_8362.question: What are the measurements related to CSCF defined in the present document?
question_8362.ground_truth: The measurements defined in clause 4.1 are related to the functionality aspect performance, and the detailed measurements for CSCF are defined in subclauses 4.1.1, 4.1.2, and 4.1.3.

question_8363.question: Which IOC uses the "N6Protection" data type in GSMA NG.116?
question_8363.ground_truth: The "N6Protection" data type in GSMA NG.116 is used in the 6.5 subclause of the IOC, which represents the N6 interface protection information in ServiceProfile and CNSliceSubnetProfile for CN.

question_8365.question: What should the UE do upon the expiry of a periodical reporting timer for a measId?
question_8365.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the measurement reporting procedure as specified in 5.5.5.

question_8366.question: What are the two main sub-frequency ranges in FR2?
question_8366.ground_truth: FR2 has been divided into two sub-frequency ranges: FR2-1 which covers the original range of 24.25-52.6 GHz, and FR2-2 which extends NR operation from 52.6 to 71 GHz.

question_8368.question: When should the `associated-group-id` element be set in the `xtless}mcvideo-Params` element?
question_8368.ground_truth: The `associated-group-id` element should be set if the group identity can be determined to be a TGI and if the MCVideo client can associate the TGI with a MCVideo group ID.

question_8370.question: What is the purpose of indicating the II-NNI traversal scenario type in SIP requests?
question_8370.ground_truth: The indication of the II-NNI traversal scenario type can be used to identify interoperability related errors, reject communication if no corresponding interoperability agreement with a peer operator exists, collect new statistics, determine if the screening of SIP signalling shall be applied, if the transcoding control shall be applied, and the media anchoring point.

question_8372.question: Under what conditions should the UE delete the stored Rejected NSSAI and attempt to use the rejected NSSAI in the current PLMN?
question_8372.ground_truth: The UE should delete the stored Rejected NSSAI and attempt to use the rejected NSSAI in the current PLMN if the UE has been switched off, then switched on, after receiving a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message with rejected NSSAI with the reject cause "S-NSSAI not available in the current PLMN".

question_8373.question: What is the message that initializes the NRPPA-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE for measurementUpdate?

question_8374.question: What is the purpose of the MnS data for exposed MnS in the described procedure?
question_8374.ground_truth: The MnS data for exposed MnS allows the NSC to identify the proper MnS producer for consuming the exposed MnS.

question_8375.question: What happens when an MCVideo group call is upgraded to an MCVideo emergency group call?
question_8375.ground_truth: When an authorized MCVideo user upgrades an MCVideo group call to an MCVideo emergency group call, the MCVideo server adjusts the priority of the underlying bearer for all participants in the MCVideo group, sends the MCVideo emergency group call request towards the MCVideo clients of each of those affiliated MCVideo group members, and the MCVideo users are notified of the in-progress emergency state of the MCVideo group.

question_8376.question: What should the UE (MCPTT Client) do when it receives a request to establish an MCPTT On-demand Pre-arranged Group Call using the group regroup?
question_8376.ground_truth: The UE (MCPTT Client) should send a SIP INVITE message using the group regroup to establish an MCPTT On-demand Pre-arranged Group Call.

question_8377.question: What information does the address mapping information for traffic routing between on-board UPFs include?
question_8377.ground_truth: The address mapping information includes the UE IP address range and next UPF information corresponding to the address range.

question_8378.question: What types of information are defined in Annex B of the 3GPP Technical Specification for Trace Management?
question_8378.ground_truth: Annex B of the 3GPP Technical Specification for Trace Management provides the XML definitions. It includes definitions for XML schemas, XML complex types, XML element types, XML namespaces, and other XML related terms.

question_8379.question: What is the purpose of the test specified in 9.2.4H.4.1?
question_8379.ground_truth: The purpose of the test specified in 9.2.4H.4.1 is to verify the ability of the receiver to receive a predefined test signal representing a multi-path fading channel with information bit throughput R not falling below a specified value.

question_8380.question: When should the UE delete the old set of security associations and related keys it has with the P-CSCF?
question_8380.ground_truth: The UE should delete the old set of security associations and related keys it has with the P-CSCF when the first request or response protected with the newly established set of security associations is received from the P-CSCF or when the lifetime of the old set of security associations expires.

question_8381.question: In what type of scenarios does the V-PCRF proxy the Gateway Control Session Termination or the Gateway Control and QoS Rules Provision between the BBERF in the VPLMN and the H-PCRF when home routed access is used or case 2a applies for Local Breakout?

question_8382.question: What is the format of RLC data PDUs used by a TM, UM, and AM RLC entity to transfer upper layer PDUs?
question_8382.ground_truth: The format of RLC data PDUs used by a TM RLC entity is TMD PDU, by an UM RLC entity is UMD PDU, and by an AM RLC entity is AMD PDU.

question_8383.question: What should the UE do if it has not registered in N1 mode over non-3GPP access yet and has at least one active PDN connection which it intends to transfer to TNGF or N3IWF connected to 5GCN?
question_8383.ground_truth: The UE should initiate an initial registration procedure over non-3GPP access. After successful completion of the 5GS initial registration in N1 mode over non-3GPP access, the UE should initiate a UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure with a request type to transfer each of the PDN connections which the UE intends to transfer to TNGF or N3IWF connected to 5GCN, if any.

question_8384.question: How does the hierarchical relationship between SubNetwork instances affect the value of the "parents" and "containedChildren" references in the example?
question_8384.ground_truth: The value of the "parents" reference for a SubNetwork instance includes a reference to allcontaining SubNetwork instances from the root down to the immediate parent. The value of the "containedChildren" reference for a SubNetwork instance includes a reference to all directly contained SubNetwork instances.

question_8386.question: What is the definition of DSCH in the UTRAN?
question_8386.ground_truth: DSCH is a shared downlink channel for which resource allocation is performed by RRC in Controlling RNC, it exists in downlink only, it has impact on the physical and transport channel levels, it supports code multiplexing, and it is transmitted in a single cell only.

question_8388.question: What happens when a roaming 3GPP UE connects to a H(e)NB in the BBF network with GTP Home Routed Traffic?
question_8388.ground_truth: The hPCRF sends the IP tunnel information (including H(e)NB local IP address) and/or FQDN of BBF access network to the vPCRF over the S9 interface.

question_8390.question: When a UE should consider an MBSFN cluster as a candidate during the MBSFN cluster selection and MBSFN cluster re-selection procedures?
question_8390.ground_truth: A UE should consider an MBSFN cluster as a candidate during the MBSFN cluster selection and MBSFN cluster re-selection procedures if the UE is assigned to access class 11 or 15 and the MBSFN cluster belongs to the home PLMN or to any EHPLMN.

question_8391.question: What is the role of the discovery procedure(s) in ProSe direct discovery?
question_8391.ground_truth: The discovery procedure(s) in ProSe direct discovery are used to establish communication between devices and enable the exchange of information, enabling proximity services and other functionalities.

question_8392.question: What should the UE include in the INVITE request when initiating an emergency call as an unregistered user?
question_8392.ground_truth: The UE should include a To header field with the same emergency service URN as in the Request-, a service URN in the Request- of the initial INVITE request, a P-Access-Network-Info header field in any request for a dialog, the UE's IP address and an unprotected port in the Contact header field, the IP address of the UE in the Via header field, and if the UE has its location information available, a Geolocation header field in the INVITE request.

question_8393.question: What happens when a UE would simultaneously transmit on the UL and receive on the SL in the same carrier, or in two respective carriers, and it is not capable of simultaneous transmissions on the UL and reception on the SL in the two respective carriers?
question_8393.ground_truth: The UE transmits only on the link, UL or SL, with the higher priority.

question_8394.question: What should be the position of a 10 MHz E-UTRA carrier in relation to the Base Station RF Bandwidth edge when placing multiple carriers for transmitter tests?
question_8394.ground_truth: The carriers should be placed adjacent to each other starting from the high Base Station RF Bandwidth edge.

question_8395.question: What is the maximum UL switching time as defined in 6.3B.5?
question_8395.ground_truth: The maximum UL switching time is 120 us.

question_8396.question: What should the MCVideo client set the stored current call type to when downgrading an "IMMINENT PERIL GROUP CALL" to a basic group call?
question_8396.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should set the stored current call type to "BASIC GROUP CALL" when downgrading an "IMMINENT PERIL GROUP CALL" to a basic group call.

question_8397.question: What is the maximum allowed overall delays measured in the intra-frequency event triggered reporting test under fading propagation conditions in asynchronous cells?
question_8397.ground_truth: The maximum allowed overall delays measured in the intra-frequency event triggered reporting test under fading propagation conditions in asynchronous cells is 1002 ms.

question_8398.question: What is the effect of N1 on the maximum frame size in the case of a Type 2 convergence layer being used?
question_8398.ground_truth: The maximum frame size should be chosen carefully to ensure that it can contain a complete protocol frame.

question_8400.question: What action will the UE take if it does not receive a REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message when expected?
question_8400.ground_truth: On the first expiry of timer T3586, the UE shall resend the REMOTE UE REPORT message and shall reset and restart timer T3586. This retransmission is repeated two times, i.e. on the third expiry of timer T3586, the UE shall abort the procedure and release any resources for this procedure.

question_8402.question: What is the name of the mechanism in 6.5.3 that allows an NG-RAN node to request a neighbouring NG-RAN node to switch on certain SSB beams?

question_8403.question: What should the P-CSCF do when it receives a 200 (OK) response to a REGISTER request with an Expires header field or Expires parameter in the Contact header set to a value different than zero?
question_8403.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should save the list of Service-Route headers preserving the order, associate the Service-Route header list with the registered public user identity, store an association between the IP source address and port of the initial REGISTER request and the public user identities and wildcarded public user identities, store an association between the IP source address and port of the initial REGISTER request with the default public user identity for use with procedures for the P-Asserted-Identity header, and store the values received in the P-Charging-Function-Addresses header.

question_8407.question: What is the purpose of the single APN approach in the NAT solution?
question_8407.ground_truth: The single APN approach in the NAT solution supports all types of PDNs and enables interoperation between different address types and ranges, and in case of access to multiple private PDNs at the same time.

question_8408.question: What is the peak data rate increase that can be achieved by combining HOMTC including 32QAM and a 5 timeslot allocation as compared to EGPRS?
question_8408.ground_truth: The peak data rate increase can exceed 100%.

question_8409.question: What is the purpose of the Heartbeat Mechanism in 3GPP Proximity-Based MIPv6 path management?
question_8409.ground_truth: The Heartbeat Mechanism in 3GPP Proximity-Based MIPv6 path management is used for Failure Detection and Restart Detection between a LMA or MAG. It is defined in IETF RFC 5847 and sends Heartbeat Request messages periodically (no more often than every 60 seconds) to detect path failures.

question_8410.question: What is the threatened asset for the threat "Insecure Network Services"?

question_8411.question: Which organization is responsible for producing the 3GPP technical specifications, including the NR radio interface and the physical layer specifications?

question_8412.question: What information does the MS include in the GAN-RR HANDOVER REQUIRED message to the GANC during the handover process?
question_8412.ground_truth: The MS includes the Channel Mode and a list of GERAN cells, identified by CGI, in order of preference for handover.

question_8413.question: What should the 5G system support for traffic and services in one network slice to have no impact on traffic and services in other network slices?
question_8413.ground_truth: The 5G system should support means to differentiate policy control, functionality, and performance provided in different network slices.

question_8414.question: What happens to the DRA (proxy) binding when all the Diameter sessions of an IP-CAN session or a UE are terminated?
question_8414.ground_truth: The DRA (proxy) removes the DRA binding when all the Diameter sessions of an IP-CAN session or a UE are terminated.

question_8415.question: What action does the A-SMF take when the local anchor can be released because the UE has moved out of the service area of the UL-CL/BP UPF in the same region as the A-SMF?
question_8415.ground_truth: The A-SMF releases the UL-CL/BP via the local SMF, updates the PSA with the DL CN tunnel information of the new I-UPF, and sends a SM N2 request to the 5G AN via the AMF to update the AN with the new I-UPF tunnel information if UP is to be activated.

question_8416.question: What does the Iur interface provide capability for in regard to data streams?
question_8416.ground_truth: The Iur interface provides the means for transport of uplink and downlink Iub/Iur DCH data streams.

question_8419.question: What information is carried in the MMS CC PDU to be sent to the LEMF when CC is reported?
question_8419.ground_truth: The MMS CC PDU to be sent to the LEMF when CC is reported contains information such as the time of the MMS, the source and destination addresses, and the message size.

question_8421.question: What happens if the ad-hoc group call is not authorized?
question_8421.ground_truth: The MCPTT server and MCPTT client shall not proceed with the rest of the steps if the ad-hoc group call request is not authorized.

question_8422.question: What is required for a group-broadcast group call to be released when the group-broadcast group is defined in the MCPTT system?
question_8422.ground_truth: Once the user of MCPTT client 1 completes transmitting, the group-broadcast group call is released. This is done by sending a group-broadcast group call release request to the MCPTT server, which then sends a group-broadcast group call release response to the initiator indicating that the call is now ended.

question_8423.question: What is the method used for rendering the ESD format in Test 1?
question_8423.ground_truth: The method used for rendering the ESD format in Test 1 is R-ESD (Rendering to ESD).

question_8424.question: What is the maximum number of successive data blocks in one RTP packet for CSData?
question_8424.ground_truth: The maximum number of successive data blocks in one RTP packet for CSData is 3, known as redundancy level 3.

question_8427.question: What is the significance of the KNASint and KNASenc keys in 5G technology?
question_8427.ground_truth: The KNASint and KNASenc keys are derived based on a KAMF after a successful Network Access and Security Management Procedure (NAS SMC) and are used to protect NAS signaling messages between the UE and the 5G Core network over non-3GPP access.

question_8428.question: In a GSM authentication challenge, what is the purpose of the Ciphering Key Sequence Number information element?
question_8428.ground_truth: In a GSM authentication challenge, the Ciphering Key Sequence Number information element is used to identify the ciphering key Kc stored in the mobile station without invoking the authentication procedure.

question_8429.question: What are two conditions that would indicate a potential signalling overload due to malicious UE behavior in the network?
question_8429.ground_truth: A high load on the NF or an abnormally large number of UEs requesting NAS resources at the same time.

question_8433.question: What should the MCData client do when it receives an SDS message?
question_8433.ground_truth: Upon receiving an SDS message, the MCData client should follow the procedure defined in the specified subclause to decode the contents of the MIME body and instantiate or associate a conversation with the message. It should also identify the number of payload IEs in the DATA PAYLOAD message and render the contents of the Payload IE(s) to the MCData user or deliver the contents to the identified application.

question_8434.question: What is the issue with using direct path switch messages from target eNB to the SAE GW in LTE system, from a security perspective?
question_8434.ground_truth: The issue is that in case of eNB compromise, an attacker could send false path switch messages towards SAE GWs, causing high risk of synchronization loss between MME and SAE GW, and difficulty in detecting if messages are sent due to UE movement or eNB compromise.

question_8435.question: What is the concept of Hypermedia Controls (level 3) in the context of the IRP REST Solution Set compliance?
question_8435.ground_truth: At level 3, the resource is completely described in the hypermedia documents transported over the interface (HATEOAS). This creates a dynamic interface that is self-documenting and discoverable without a centralized, pre-defined specification, and requires no pre-defined knowledge of server capabilities at the client side.

question_8436.question: What happens when there is a change in a FRMCS User's talker status during an ongoing group voice communication?
question_8436.ground_truth: The FRMCS System may trigger a change of communication privileges for all FRMCS Users affiliated to that group.

question_8437.question: What should the UE do if it receives the Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming" IE in the SERVICE ACCEPT message and the TAI(s) included in the IE is not part of the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming"?
question_8437.ground_truth: The UE shall store the TAI(s) belonging to the serving PLMN or equivalent PLMN(s) and ignore the TAI(s) which do not belong to the serving PLMN or equivalent PLMN(s) included in the IE into the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming" and remove the TAI(s) from the stored TAI list if present.

question_8438.question: What does the mobile station do when the GERAN receives an MBMS SESSION STOP REQUEST message from the SGSN, indicating that the MBMS session can be released?
question_8438.ground_truth: The mobile station ignores this message, as it is only relevant for the network.

question_8440.question: What measures are taken in solution 12 to prevent a Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) attack on the Un interface between RN and DeNB?
question_8440.ground_truth: In solution 12, the UICC checks whether the secure channel with a real RN has been set up successfully before engaging in AKA-related communication. This prevents the insertion of the UICC into a MitM node that does not have a successful secure channel with the RN.

question_8441.question: Who is responsible for sending event reports in this network management system?
question_8441.ground_truth: The Event Receiving NF is responsible for sending event reports in this network management system.

question_8442.question: What is the purpose of the ISC gateway function in the 3GPP network architecture, and where does it functions as an entry point and as an exit point?
question_8442.ground_truth: The ISC gateway function acts as an entry point for the 3GPP network when it processes a SIP request received from another network, and as an exit point when it processes a SIP request sent to other networks.

question_8443.question: Under what conditions will the interruption on PCell and/or active SCell not occur before subframe n+2 and not occur after subframe n+6 if the activation command is transmitted on the PDSCH with dl-STTI-Length-r15=subslot and proc-Timeline-r15= nplus4set1, proc-Timeline-r15= nplus6set1 or proc-Timeline-r15= nplus6set2?
question_8443.ground_truth: The activated SCell and the SCell being activated belong to E-UTRA FDD and the PCell belongs to E-UTRA TDD.

question_8444.question: What is the state of the MS expected to be after the successful execution of this test?
question_8444.ground_truth: The MS is expected to be in the CC-state U0, "Null".

question_8445.question: What is the status code included in the HTTP response when the PCF successfully fulfills the received HTTP POST request for BDT policies?
question_8445.ground_truth: The PCF includes a "201 Created" status code in the HTTP response when it successfully fulfills the received HTTP POST request for BDT policies.

question_8446.question: What should a UE in NB-NI mode do when there is downlink user data pending for a PDU session associated with non-3GPP access, and the number of PDU sessions with user-plane resources established equals the UE's maximum number of supported user-plane resources?
question_8446.ground_truth: The AMF notifies the SMF that reactivation of user plane resources cannot be performed.

question_8447.question: What action is taken if the CLI measurement resource is removed from the cli-TriggeredList in the VarMeasReportList for a specific measId?
question_8447.ground_truth: The concerned CLI measurement resource(s) are removed from the cli-TriggeredList in the VarMeasReportList for that measId.

question_8448.question: How does the adaptive bit-allocation scheme work in allocating bits to bands?
question_8448.ground_truth: The adaptive bit-allocation scheme uses the quantized band energies to allocate the available bits in a frame among the bands. It adaptively groups the band energies into a number of groups and allocates variable number of bits to each group based on characteristics between the groups. Then, it allocates bits to bands within groups based on the available bit budget to the groups. The energy difference between maximum energy of a subvector in a group and average subvector energy of the rest of the groups is calculated to determine the energy difference between groups.

question_8450.question: What should the floor participant do upon receiving a Floor Deny message from the floor control server in the 'U: pending Request' state?
question_8450.ground_truth: The floor participant should provide floor deny notification to the user and stop timer T101 (Floor Request), then enter the 'U: has no permission' state.

question_8451.question: When do PIN Elements forward service access requests to the PIN Element?
question_8451.ground_truth: The PIN Element with gateway Capability forwards the service access request to the PIN Element only if the user authentication is successful. Otherwise, it rejects the request for service access.

question_8452.question: What is the purpose of the "AuthorizationResult" enumeration?
question_8452.ground_truth: The enumeration AuthorizationResult represents the NEF notify the AF about the service parameters authorization updates result, e.g. to revoke an authorization.

question_8453.question: What is the base station output power as defined by the given text?
question_8453.ground_truth: The base station output power (Pout) is the mean power of one carrier delivered to a load with resistance equal to the nominal load impedance of the transmitter.

question_8454.question: Which two network entities are involved in the HPLMN and IPLMN when an MS is being called in another PLMN?
question_8454.ground_truth: HPLMN contains HLRB and IPLMN contains GMSCB.

question_8457.question: What is the impact of the update from IETF RFC 3588 to IETF RFC 6733 on the Diameter base protocol?
question_8457.ground_truth: The IETF RFC 6733 modifies the design and use of the Diameter base protocol, which may impact 3GPP diameter applications, such as affecting the security model.

question_8458.question: What is a Mobile Termination (MT) in the context of the 3GPP system?
question_8458.ground_truth: A Mobile Termination (MT) in the 3GPP system is a functional entity that contains the Terminal Adaptation Functions (TAF) which enables the use of synchronous bearer services in the PLMN and the attachment of Synchronous Terminals to an MT.

question_8459.question: What is the difference between autonomous mode and coordinated mode in RAN delay budget reporting?
question_8459.ground_truth: In autonomous mode, MTSI sender and MTSI receiver independently use RAN delay budget reporting mechanisms toward adjusting air interface delay in their respective RANs without coordination. In contrast, in coordinated mode, MTSI sender and MTSI receiver trigger and use RAN delay budget reporting mechanisms in a coordinated fashion, and exchange delay budget information with each other.

question_8460.question: What information can the H-SMF indicate to the UE for a PDU Session's use of the EDC functionality?
question_8460.ground_truth: The H-SMF may indicate to the UE that for the PDU Session the use of the EDC functionality is either allowed or required.

question_8461.question: What is the purpose of a User Agent in ATSC 3.0 standard?
question_8461.ground_truth: A User Agent is a W3C-compliant execution environment for broadcaster applications in ATSC 3.0. It enables a broadcaster application to run and may employ graphical capabilities of the ATSC 3.0 receiver to render the user interface.

question_8462.question: What message does the MCVideo Client send to the MCVideo Server to establish a call in automatic commencement mode?
question_8462.ground_truth: The MCVideo Client sends a SIP INVITE message to the MCVideo Server to establish a call in automatic commencement mode.

question_8465.question: What shall a secondary device do if it receives a message which addressed device subunit does not exist?
question_8465.ground_truth: If a secondary device receives a procedure message which addressed device subunit does not exist, it shall respond with "FormatError".

question_8468.question: In the context of the CORBA SS, what is mapped to attributes when the cardinality for an association allows more than one referred MO?
question_8468.ground_truth: The reference attribute is mapped to MOReferenceSet, which contains a sequence of MO references.

question_8470.question: What will the BSS do upon reception of an MBMS-SESSION-UPDATE-REQUEST PDU with new MBMS Service Area(s)?
question_8470.ground_truth: The BSS may send assignments for the ongoing MBMS broadcast service session to the mobile stations in the new MBMS Service Area(s) and repeat notifications to the mobile stations in the old MBMS Service Area(s).

question_8471.question: What is the purpose of the "send data without mandatory download" procedure?
question_8471.ground_truth: The "send data without mandatory download" procedure allows the receiving MCData client to accept download, defer download, or refuse (e.g. by the user deleting the notification item) the data sent from the sending MCData client.

question_8472.question: What is the content distribution approach using satellite backhaul and traditional caching policies?
question_8472.ground_truth: The content distribution approach using satellite backhaul and traditional caching policies involves storing popular content in the edge and streaming it from a location closer to end-users. Satellite backhaul provides large bandwidth and multicast capabilities, which can lead to a more efficient content distribution process.

question_8473.question: What is the message type of the Interworking Security Data (InterSD) message?
question_8473.ground_truth: The message type of the Interworking Security Data (InterSD) message is InterSD-MESSAGE.

question_8474.question: What is the role of the BM-SC in the eMBMS service availability notification?
question_8474.ground_truth: The BM-SC provides a User Service Description (USD) including information that the eMBMS service is available over both Unicast (UC) and Broadcast (BC). The USD may include BC and UC related information, or BC information only.

question_8475.question: What should the UE do if it receives a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message and the de-registration procedure was performed due to disabling of 5GS services?
question_8475.ground_truth: The UE should enter the 5GMM-NULL state for 3GPP access if the de-registration procedure was performed due to disabling of 5GS services, and enter the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state for non-3GPP access if the de-registration procedure was not due to disabling of 5GS services.

question_8476.question: Which element is used to indicate the version of the Associated Delivery Procedures schema being used?

question_8477.question: What is the mechanism provided by Solution #1 Alternative 1 in TR 23.700-33?
question_8477.ground_truth: The mechanism provided is for PC5 security setup procedure between a source UE or target UE and a L3 UE-to-UE relay when the L3 UE-to-UE relay is in 3GPP coverage.

question_8479.question: What is one method for a device to retrieve a software update it missed due to being in use or powered off?
question_8479.ground_truth: A device can make a unicast request for the most recently transmittedDatacasting content from a file repair server, using file repair request based solely on Schedule Description fragment information.

question_8480.question: What type of paging information is used in a PAGING REQUEST message on CCCH for packet paging?
question_8480.ground_truth: In a PAGING REQUEST message for packet paging, the MS is identified by the P-TMSI (GPRS TMSI) or its IMSI. If the MS is identified by the P-TMSI, it shall proceed as specified in 3GPP TS 04.18, subclause 3.5.1.2.

question_8481.question: What needs to be added to the ONAP VES JSON API header fields to enable the DCAE R3 VES JSON Collector to consume 3GPP Rel-15 PM data?
question_8481.ground_truth: New types of fields, such as 3GPPNGRANMeasurementFields, 3GPP5GCMeasurementFields, 3GPPNSMeasurementFields, and 3GPPE2EMeasurementFields, would have to be added to the existing ones at the root level of the common event format of ONAP VES JSON API.

question_8482.question: What is the duration of the first session in the session schedule?
question_8482.ground_truth: The first session in the session schedule lasts for 30 minutes, starting from UTC March 1st 2012 23:00:00 and ending at UTC March 1st 2012 23:30:00.

question_8483.question: How many octets long can the Field length of Spare Extension IE be in the HS-DSCH DATA FRAME TYPE 1?
question_8483.ground_truth: The Field length of Spare Extension IE in HS-DSCH DATA FRAME TYPE 1 is 0-25 octets.

question_8484.question: What are the two layer 1 options for implementing the Iuant interface in UTRA, E-UTRA, and NR?
question_8484.ground_truth: The two layer 1 options are the RS485 option, which uses a screened multicore cable, and the Modem option, which uses a connection to a RET and/or TMA control unit by way of a coaxial cable.

question_8485.question: What does the AF use to construct the HTTP request URL to the protocol converter?
question_8485.ground_truth: The AF may use parameters such as the UE IP address, PDN information, user identity, and domain Identity to construct the HTTP request URL to the protocol converter.

question_8486.question: What is the maximum possible equal frequency spacing (Deq) in the declared maximum Base Station RF bandwidth (RF-BWmax) for test case b)?
question_8486.ground_truth: Deq is a multiple of 200 kHz within RF-BWmax.

question_8488.question: Which subclause of TS 24.380 specifies the actions that the MCPTT client should perform when receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP INVITE request?

question_8490.question: How does the PCF handle the Maximum Group Data Rate compared to the Maximum Slice Data Rate?
question_8490.ground_truth: The PCF handles the Maximum Group Data Rate per 5G VN group, while it handles the Maximum Slice Data Rate per S-NSSAI. Instead of deducting the value of the authorized Session-AMBR and the MBR of every GBR SDF for every PDU Session of the slice, the PCF deducts such value for every PDU Session accessing to the 5G VN group.

question_8491.question: What limits the aggregated bit rate across all Non-GBR QoS Flows of a UE in a 5G network?
question_8491.ground_truth: The UE-AMBR limits the aggregated bit rate across all Non-GBR QoS Flows of a UE in a 5G network.

question_8492.question: What fields does the UE need to set in the ra-InformationCommon while setting the contents in it?
question_8492.ground_truth: The UE needs to set the absoluteFrequencyPointA, locationAndBandwidth, subcarrierSpacing, msg1-FrequencyStart, msg1-FDM, msg1-SubcarrierSpacing, msg1-FrequencyStartCFRA, msg1-FDMCFRA and msg1-SubcarrierSpacingCFRA in the ra-InformationCommon while setting the contents in it.

question_8493.question: What is the procedure for establishing security during the PC5 link setup between the source UE and U2U relay?
question_8493.ground_truth: During the PC5 link setup procedure between the source UE and U2U relay, if the security policy of either the source UE or U2U relay requires hop-by-hop security protection, the source UE indicates this to the U2U relay by a Direct Communication Request followed by a Direct Authorization and Key procedure. If the security policies of both the source UE and U2U relay are the same, the PC5 link setup includes security establishment, and hop-by-hop security is intended. Otherwise, the source UE and U2U relay only set up the PC5 without security protection.

question_8494.question: What procedure is initiated by the network when a GMM context has been established, and used for GPRS identification?

question_8495.question: What is the definition of the RRH switching point for unidirectional RRH deployment, Scenario-2 in the HST tunnel?
question_8495.ground_truth: The RRH switching point is where the UE switches from the source RRH beam to the target RRH beam based on maximizing SNR among detected beams.

question_8496.question: What occurs when the Target UE receives the Relay Announcement message?
question_8496.ground_truth: After receiving the Relay Announcement message, if the Target UE wants to be discovered by other UEs, it will send a Response message and use Code-Sending Security Parameters to protect it.

question_8497.question: Which attribute of the complex type "UeRegReq-info" is defined as a hexBinary type in the XML schema?

question_8498.question: What is the main difference between the reference picture management in H.264 (AVC) and H.265 (HEVC)?
question_8498.ground_truth: H.264 (AVC) uses a sliding window plus adaptive memory management control operation (MMCO) based reference picture marking mechanism, while H.265 (HEVC) specifies a reference picture set (RPS) based reference picture management and marking mechanism.

question_8499.question: What is the mandatory parameter when using EAP terminated in UICC?

question_8500.question: What is the maximum allowed RRC re-establishment delay to an unknown NB-IoT FDD inter frequency cell, as given in the requirement section?
question_8500.ground_truth: The maximum allowed RRC re-establishment delay to an unknown NB-IoT FDD inter frequency cell is 12 seconds.

question_8502.question: What sub-element within the <EnterSpecificArea> element indicates the geographical area which, when entered, triggers the functional alias activation?
question_8502.ground_truth: The <PolygonArea> or <EllipsoidArcArea> elements indicate the area.

question_8504.question: What is the Far scatterer cluster model used for in the context of urban macro-cells?
question_8504.ground_truth: The Far scatterer cluster model is used to represent the bad-urban case in urban macro-cells where additional clusters are seen in the environment. This model is used to represent the primary and far scattering cluster (FSC) in the environment.

question_8505.question: When does the GMM entity in the network provide the lower layer with a list of CSG IDs?
question_8505.ground_truth: When there is no PDN connection for emergency bearer services and the network has accepted eDRX for the MS.

question_8506.question: What is the constraint used in the balanced SNR criterion for modifying the training symbol placement?
question_8506.ground_truth: The constraint used is that the training symbols are placed symmetrically over the part consisting of payload and training symbols, consecutively placed in the center of the burst, and evenly placed in other parts of the burst.

question_8507.question: In which bands can V2X operation be performed concurrently?
question_8507.ground_truth: V2X operation can be performed concurrently in band 47, Uu FDD bands 3, 5, 7, 8, 20, 28, 71; Uu TDD bands 34, 39, 41; and NR Uu bands n1, n3, n5, n8, n34, n39, n40, n71, n78, n79.

question_8509.question: What information does the "Max offset" parameter in the 3GPP 5G DDNMF provide?
question_8509.ground_truth: The "Max offset" parameter indicates the maximum time difference between the time on the UE's ProSe clock and the UTC-based counter associated with the discovery slot.

question_8510.question: What is the IMS-AGW's role in TLS-based e2ae scenarios for BFCP-based media?
question_8510.ground_truth: The IMS-AGW shall support application-agnostic interworking for TLS-based e2ae scenarios, i.e. transparent forwarding of application (i.e. BFCP) data.

question_8511.question: What are the user plane path and control plane path in Solution 25 of the positioning signalling transfer?
question_8511.ground_truth: The user plane path and control plane path are the two possible transfer paths for positioning signalling between the UE and AMF, with the first being determined by the serving AMF load and the second by the NEF for local LMF.

question_8512.question: What should PLMN operators do to enable the reuse of the MCPTT architecture for non-public safety customers?
question_8512.ground_truth: PLMN operators can reuse the MCPTT architecture for non-public safety customers by integrating many components of the MCPTT solution with their existing network architecture and functionally decomposing MCPTT into a small number of distinct logical functions.

question_8513.question: What are the transport layer requirements for SLPP as specified in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_8513.ground_truth: SLPP requires reliable, in-sequence delivery of SLPP messages from the underlying transport layers. SLPP reliable transport includes duplicate detection, acknowledgement, and retransmission. SLPP message sequence numbers shall be distinct for different SLPP messages sent by the same endpoint for the same endpoint in the same location session. A sender shall include a sequence number in all SLPP messages, and a receiver shall record the most recent received sequence number. If a message is received carrying the same sequence number as that last received for the associated location session, it shall be discarded.

question_8516.question: What is the difference between a Radio Bearer and a Radio Access Bearer in a telecommunications network?
question_8516.ground_truth: A Radio Access Bearer is the service that the access stratum provides to the non-access stratum for transfer of user data between User Equipment and CN, while a Radio Bearer is the service provided by the Layer 2 for transfer of user data between User Equipment and UTRAN.

question_8517.question: What should the UE do after the SS receives the MeasurementReport message in step 11) or when T4 expires?
question_8517.ground_truth: After the SS receives the MeasurementReport message in step 11) or when T4 expires, the SS shall transmit RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources.

question_8518.question: What must the MS check for the correct sense of negotiation when responding to an XID frame?
question_8518.ground_truth: The MS must check if the parameters sent in the XID frame are different from those chosen by the SS.

question_8519.question: What is the purpose of the "timer" option tag in the Supported header field during SIP INVITE request?
question_8519.ground_truth: The "timer" option tag is included in the Supported header field to specify the ability to handle SIP timers, and its inclusion is recommended.

question_8520.question: What are the two possible reporting intervals that can be set for the UE in some systems?
question_8520.ground_truth: The two possible reporting intervals are every 1h when the UE becomes in-coverage, or a longer interval if there is no requirement of timely report.

question_8522.question: What are the four essential control plane functionalities supported in Architecture 1a?
question_8522.ground_truth: The four essential control plane functionalities supported in Architecture 1a are reliable transport (via RLC over the wireless backhaul), in-order delivery (via PDCP), security (via PDCP), and F1-AP traffic protection over the wireless backhaul.

question_8523.question: What should be done by the MSGin5G Client in the Constrained UE when it receives a CoAP POST request for registration response?
question_8523.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Client in the Constrained UE should generate a CoAP 2.04 (Change) response including the CoAP "Message ID" element and the "Token" element with the same values with those in the CoAP POST request for registration response.

question_8524.question: What should a UE registered over both 3GPP and non-3GPP access in different PLMNs do to initiate a UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure?
question_8524.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the procedure over 3GPP access and non-3GPP access sequentially and consider the MA PDU session established once it receives the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message over one access. The UE should then initiate the procedure over the other access to establish user plane resources on both 3GPP and non-3GPP access.

question_8527.question: In which state can the procedure for CS handover from GAN A/Gb mode be initiated?
question_8527.ground_truth: The procedure for CS handover from GAN A/Gb mode can be initiated in the GA-CSR-DEDICATED state.

question_8528.question: In what situation would a group-broadcast group call not affect the behavior of ongoing group calls on its subordinate groups?
question_8528.ground_truth: If the group-broadcast group call is established and the call originator (user of MCPTT client 3) is not a member of any other subordinate group of the group-broadcast group, other than group A, and group A currently has an on-going MCPTT emergency group call, the group-broadcast group call request is sent to the MCPTT clients of the MCPTT users who are affiliated members of any other subordinate groups of the group-broadcast group being set up and resources are made available for the transmission.

question_8529.question: How many received signal level measurement samples are required per RSSI value for a UE not requiring measurement occasions?
question_8529.ground_truth: At least 3 received signal level measurement samples are required per RSSI value for a UE not requiring measurement occasions.

question_8530.question: What is the function of the P-Charging-Vector header field in step 29 in the SIP flow?
question_8530.ground_truth: The P-Charging-Vector header field in step 29 includes a type-2 IOI value that identifies the home network of the terminating user and other relevant ioI values.

question_8531.question: What is the role of the ThreshBeaconRSSIWLANHighRAN threshold condition in the context of UTRAN?
question_8531.ground_truth: The ThreshBeaconRSSIWLANHighRAN threshold condition is evaluated to determine if a high threshold value of beacon RSSI threshold provided by E-UTRAN/UTRAN is being taken into account when evaluating the validity of a rule. If the threshold value has not been received from E-UTRAN/UTRAN, the UE considers this node as not matching.

question_8533.question: What is an ICS proforma and how is it related to UE conformance testing?
question_8533.ground_truth: An ICS (Implementation Conformance Statement) proforma is a questionnaire that, when completed, outlines which capabilities from a given specification have been implemented in an implementation or system. In the context of UE conformance testing, completing the ICS proforma can help determine the test cases relevant to the specific UE implementation.

question_8535.question: What is the function of the IP Edge Node for Ethernet and Fiber accesses in the context of the access-network-charging-info parameter?
question_8535.ground_truth: The IP Edge Node is responsible for tracking the IP Edge Node address (ip-edge parameter) for Ethernet and Fiber accesses in the context of the access-network-charging-info parameter.

question_8536.question: What is the default behavior of the UE when the R value of multiple cells is within the rangeToBestCell of the highest-ranked cell during the reselection procedure?
question_8536.ground_truth: The UE will perform cell reselection to the highest ranked cell among them.

question_8538.question: What is the test purpose for handover to UTRAN while in DTM with a downlink TBF?
question_8538.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify that the mobile station aborts packet resources while in DTM and proceeds with the handover to UTRAN, upon reception of an INTER SYSTEM TO UTRAN HANDOVER COMMAND message.

question_8544.question: What is the definition of LC, LR and LSA in this telecommunication management context?
question_8544.ground_truth: LC stands for LSA Controller which is a part of the NMLS (Network Management Layer Service). LR stands for LSA Repository, a repository containing LSA information. LSA stands for Licensed Shared Access which refers to a system allowing access for mobile/fixed communication networks (MFCNs) in the 2 300 MHz - 2 400 MHz band under licensed shared access (LSA) conditions.

question_8547.question: What information is added to the complete layer 3 information message for an exclusive access cell during location updating?
question_8547.ground_truth: The LSA ID(s) of the current cell is added to the complete layer 3 information message for the exclusive access cell during location updating.

question_8548.question: What should the MCPTT client do when receiving a SIP INFO request where the Request-URI contains an MCPTT session ID identifying an ongoing group session?
question_8548.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should follow the actions specified in subclause~6.2.8.1.13 when receiving such a SIP INFO request.

question_8549.question: What happens if a matching entry is not found when checking for a target ID in either the "List of MCPTT users" or the "List of functional aliases" for call transfer authorization?
question_8549.ground_truth: If no matching entry is found, the authorization check has failed, and the procedure continues with step 10.

question_8550.question: In the context of the first paragraph, what is the user rate when the user information layer 1 protocol is V.110, I.460/X.30 and the BC retrieved from the VLR indicates FTM?

question_8552.question: What is the purpose of the SCS/AS sending a Monitoring Indication Response message in the monitoring process?
question_8552.ground_truth: The SCS/AS sends a Monitoring Indication Response message with a Cause value to acknowledge the receipt of a Monitoring Indication message.

question_8554.question: What is the purpose of the MBMS User Service Consumption Reporting functionality?
question_8554.ground_truth: The MBMS User Service Consumption Reporting functionality enables the MBMS service operator to make dynamic decisions on whether to establish or tear down service delivery over an MBMS bearer based on real-time demand. This helps the MBMS service operator to better utilize overall network resources in supporting unicast and/or MBMS services delivery.

question_8556.question: What is one use of interactivity usage information in the use cases?
question_8556.ground_truth: Interactivity usage information is used to derive statistics on the amount of viewing of interactive advertisements.

question_8557.question: If a UE is provided with two TCI-State or TCI-UL-State for a Type 1 power headroom report, when does the UE use the first p0AlphaSetforPUSCH and pathlossReferenceRS-Id-r17 values versus the second p0AlphaSetforPUSCH and pathlossReferenceRS-Id-r17 values?
question_8557.ground_truth: If the reference PUSCH transmission is associated with the first TCI-State or TCI-UL-State, the UE uses the first p0AlphaSetforPUSCH and pathlossReferenceRS-Id-r17 values. If the reference PUSCH transmission is associated with the second TCI-State or TCI-UL-State, the UE uses the second p0AlphaSetforPUSCH and pathlossReferenceRS-Id-r17 values.

question_8558.question: Which clients are used for discreet listening of MCData content server transactions in the solution?
question_8558.ground_truth: The authorized user can use at least one of the sourcing MCData client 1 or the target MCData users or groups for discreet listening where an MCData content server is in use.

question_8561.question: What should the UE do if the serving NB-IoT cell does not meet criterion S in N consecutive DRX cycles within a single PTW?
question_8561.ground_truth: The UE should initiate measurements of all neighbor cells indicated by the serving NB-IoT cell, regardless of the current measurement rules.

question_8563.question: What is the purpose of the initiating UE generating a new L2 identifier and a new MSB of the Kd session ID in this procedure?
question_8563.ground_truth: The initiating UE generates a new L2 identifier and a new MSB of the Kd session ID to update its identifiers and avoid L2 ID tracking in the PC5 unicast communication, mitigating trackability and linkability attacks.

question_8564.question: What is the condition that needs to be satisfied for a code to be used in a timeslot in the code tree method?
question_8564.ground_truth: A code can be used in a timeslot if and only if no other code on the path from the specific code to the root of the tree or in the sub-tree below the specific code is used in this timeslot.

question_8566.question: What charging models does the 5G system need to support as per the technical report?
question_8566.ground_truth: The 5G system needs to support volume, time, combined volume and time, and event-based charging models; session-based charging; application-based charging model; usage real-time control; capability for billing system support; capability for inter-operator charging; and capability for network operator to third-party providers charging.

question_8567.question: What should the participating MCVideo function do when it receives RTP media packets from the controlling MCVideo function or non-controlling MCVideo function and the MCVideo client has reported "listening" status in the latest received MBMS bearer listening status report?
question_8567.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function should perform actions as specified in subclause 10.2. This may include sending the RTP media packets to the MCVideo client.

question_8568.question: What should a receiving entity do when receiving a message with a syntactically incorrect mandatory information element?
question_8568.ground_truth: The receiver should ignore the message and return a corresponding response message with the cause IE set to "Mandatory IE incorrect", together with the type of the offending mandatory IE.

question_8569.question: What is the difference between Filter Criteria and Transit Invocation Criteria in IMS communication service?
question_8569.ground_truth: The set of Filter Criteria is user specific, while the set of Transit Invocation Criteria is not user specific, but instead is based on the originating and terminating networks. The purpose and handling of Transit Invocation Criteria is identical to the handling of Filter Criteria. However, the procedures in subclause 5.2.2 associated with the handling of SIP REGISTER request do not apply to the handling of Transit Invocation Criteria.

question_8570.question: What is the role of AF1 in the initial PDU Session establishment procedure?
question_8570.ground_truth: AF1 is involved in the initial PDU Session establishment procedure with SMF/5GC.

question_8571.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network's document on Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access (E-UTRA) and Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access Network (E-UTRAN) in relation to deriving test tolerances for Radio Resource Management (RRM) conformance tests?
question_8571.ground_truth: The purpose is to specify a general method for deriving Test Tolerances for RRM tests and to establish a system for relating the Test Tolerances to the measurement uncertainties of the Test System.

question_8573.question: What ciphering algorithms should ProSe enabled Public Safety UEs implement for ciphering one-to-many traffic?
question_8573.ground_truth: ProSe enabled Public Safety UEs should implement EEA0, 128-EEA1, 128-EEA2, and may implement 128-EEA3.

question_8574.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for this test case?
question_8574.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 7.1.1.2.4 of the document.
