question_9949.ground_truth: In the STAR architecture, immersive media including 2D media is considered as the input media for the architecture. In contrast, in the EDGAR architecture, 2D media and additional information generated from immersive media renderer are considered as the input media for basic AR functions.

question_9950.question: What is the HTTP status code that the MnS producer sends to the MnS consumer in case of failure when sending notifications?
question_9950.ground_truth: The MnS producer sends a HTTP status code of an appropriate error code in case of failure when sending notifications.

question_9952.question: What are the procedures for NPN relevant mobility support for Rel-16 and later NPN-capable UEs?
question_9952.ground_truth: NPN relevant mobility procedures for Rel-16 and later NPN-capable UEs include the SNPN ID in the RRCSetupComplete and Initial UE Message message for SNPN, provision of the Allowed CAG list by the AMF to the gNB for PNI-NPN, and a single cause "NPN access denied" when accessing NPN cells. If the SNPN ID or UE allowed CAG ID list does not match any of the target cell supported lists, the handover fails.

question_9954.question: What parameters are used to form the input S for deriving the P-TID from KAUSF?
question_9954.ground_truth: FC, P0 (with the value of SUPI), L0 (length of SUPI), P1 (with the value of "P-TID"), and L1 (length of "P-TID").

question_9957.question: What is the format of the IMSI-based Emergency NAI?
question_9957.ground_truth: The IMSI-based Emergency NAI takes the form "0<IMSI>@sos.nai.epc.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.3gppnetwork.org" or "6<IMSI>@sos.nai.epc.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.3gppnetwork.org".

question_9958.question: What is the expected response from the MCData Client when it receives a disposition response via a MSRP SEND message in step 4 of the procedure sequence?
question_9958.ground_truth: The MCData Client is expected to respond to the MSRP SEND message by sending a MSRP 200 (OK) message and deliver the notification to the MCDATA User.

question_9959.question: What is the test description for maximum input level for category NB1 and NB2?
question_9959.ground_truth: The test case applies to all types of NB-IoT HD-FDD UE release 17 and forward of category NB1 and NB2 that support satellite access operation. This test case aims to test the UE's ability to receive data with a given average throughput for a specified reference measurement channel, under conditions of high signal level, ideal propagation, and no added noise. A UE unable to meet the throughput requirement under these conditions will decrease the coverage area near to an e-NodeB.

question_9960.question: What should the UE do if there are not enough subframes for SI message transmission in the provided radio frames?
question_9960.ground_truth: The UE should continue to receive the SI message transmission in the following radio frames as provided in the si-RepetitionPattern.

question_9961.question: What is the role of the UE (User Equipment) in the 5GLAN LAN-type service for IP communication?
question_9961.ground_truth: In the 5GLAN LAN-type service for IP communication, the UE acts as a part of the network, providing information for access to the 5GLAN service, such as DNS server address, P-CSCF address (in case of enhanced services such as IMS), authorized QoS, and time of service activation.

question_9962.question: How do UE and AMF negotiate the support of MO SMS in Rel-15?
question_9962.ground_truth: In Rel-15, the UE and AMF negotiate the support of MO SMS by the UE including "SMS over NAS supported" in Registration Request to the AMF and an AMF supporting this feature responding back to the UE by including "SMS over NAS allowed" in Registration Accept.

question_9965.question: What does TrCH number represent in the context of L1 in the 3GPP TS?
question_9965.ground_truth: The transport channel number (TrCH number) identifies a transport channel (TrCH) in the context of L1, with the L3 transport channel identity (TrCH ID) mapping onto the L1 transport channel number.

question_9966.question: Who creates and processes the Source BSS to Target BSS Transparent Container in PS handover from GERAN A/Gb mode to GAN mode?
question_9966.ground_truth: The Source BSS to Target BSS Transparent Container in PS handover from GERAN A/Gb mode to GAN mode is created by the source BSS or GANC and processed by the target BSS for PS handover from a source GANC.

question_9967.question: What type of UE does the test case 6.4B.2.4.5 apply to?
question_9967.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 15 and forward, supporting inter-band EN-DC including FR2 with 1 NR UL CC.

question_9968.question: When should the AMF not release the NAS signalling connection after the completion of the Registration procedure for a UE with PC5 capable V2X communication over PC5 reference point with PC5 authorization?
question_9968.ground_truth: The AMF should not release the NAS signalling connection after the completion of the Registration procedure if the UE has PC5 capable V2X communication with PC5 authorization, and relying on the decision of NG-RAN.

question_9971.question: How does the SGSN deal with PDP Context Activation request when there is a Maximum APN restriction stored and the value indicates the most restrictive type?
question_9971.ground_truth: The SGSN shall reject any Activate PDP Context requests to a different APN.

question_9972.question: What is the purpose of indicating a priority level in the signalling message for a mobile originating (MO) call?
question_9972.ground_truth: The purpose is to prioritize the MO call establishment, as specified in 3GPP~TS 04.67 subclause 4.1.1.

question_9973.question: What must the HSS include in the V2X-Notify-Flags to indicate revocation of authorization for V2X service on one PLMN?
question_9973.ground_truth: The HSS must set the "Revocation of Authorization for V2X Service" bit in the V2X-Notify-Flags to indicate that the V2X service authorization is being revoked for one PLMN.

question_9975.question: What is the minimum requirement for the cell re-selection delay for UEs supporting both FDD and TDD in clause 8.2.4.2?
question_9975.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for the cell re-selection delay is less than 8 seconds with a DRX cycle length of 1,280 ms. This should be verified in more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

question_9977.question: What is the purpose of specifying SMF-specific security functional adaptations and related test cases in the present document?
question_9977.ground_truth: The purpose of specifying SMF-specific security functional adaptations and related test cases in the present document is to address SMF-specific security threats and ensure the security of the SMF network product class.

question_9978.question: What is the rule used to determine the two flags hu(B) and hl(B) in the discussed data transmission system?
question_9978.ground_truth: hu(B) = 1 for the first 4 bursts (even numbered bits are stolen) and hl(B) = 1 for the last 4 bursts (odd numbered bits are stolen) for FACCH/F, and hu(B) = 1 for the first 2 bursts (even numbered bits are stolen) and hl(B) = 1 for the last 2 bursts (odd numbered bits are stolen) for FACCH/H.

question_9980.question: What is the purpose of the nonce in the RP authentication process?
question_9980.ground_truth: The nonce in the RP authentication process is a proof of freshness which is used to sign the nonce. After decrypting the nonce based on the negotiated DH-key, the RP signs the nonce with Kr,o, before adding it as an additional parameter to the redirect message. The OP can then authenticate the RP by using the shared key Kr,o to authenticate the signed nonce.

question_9981.question: What is the role of the PBSN in the calculation of the Next Partial Bitmap (NPB) segment?
question_9981.ground_truth: The PBSN is a Partial Bitmap Sequence Number variable stored at the receiver that is used to calculate the starting sequence number for the NPB segment.

question_9985.question: What is the relation between TRP and Total Radiated Power Gain (TRPG)?
question_9985.ground_truth: TRP is the total power radiated by the DUT, while TRPG is the total radiation efficiency of the DUT normalized to the transmitted power. TRPG is also known as the total radiation gain of the DUT.

question_9986.question: What is one of the cons of using the Call-leg IDs and/or radio access network IDs between BSSes for correlation of call legs?
question_9986.ground_truth: One of the cons of using the Call-leg IDs and/or radio access network IDs between BSSes for correlation of call legs is that standardization effort is necessary to extend the existing call-leg IDs to globally unique call-leg IDs.

question_9987.question: When can a UE indicate its capability to support NR paging subgrouping during the registration procedure?
question_9987.ground_truth: A UE can indicate its capability to support NR paging subgrouping during the registration procedure if it has 5GS registration type IE not set to "emergency registration" and does not have an active emergency PDU session.

question_9988.question: What is the role of the HS-SICH type 2 information field mapping in the coding and multiplexing flow?
question_9988.ground_truth: The HS-SICH type 2 information field mapping is the first step in the coding and multiplexing flow for HS-SICH type 2. It defines how the RMF, RTBS, and ACK/NACK information bits for each stream are mapped.

question_9990.question: What factors influence the selection of Client NWDAFs in Federated Learning?
question_9990.ground_truth: The capability, interoperability, and availability of NWDAFs are factors that influence the selection of Client NWDAFs in Federated Learning.

question_9991.question: In what type of network would the GCSE AS be, when it is part of the operator's network?
question_9991.ground_truth: The GCSE AS would be in the operator's network, when it is part of the operator's network.

question_9992.question: What is the nominal reported channelOccupancy value for the FS3 channel occupancy test?
question_9992.ground_truth: The nominal reported channelOccupancy value is 33 for the FS3 channel occupancy test.

question_9993.question: What are the two entities with enhanced functionality in the Iu mode GAN architecture?
question_9993.ground_truth: The two entities with enhanced functionality in the Iu mode GAN architecture are the Mobile Station (MS) and the Generic Access Network Controller (GANC).

question_9994.question: How does a user initiate service from a CTS-MS (Cordless Terminal System Multi-System) on a CTS-FP (Cordless Terminal System Fixed Part)?
question_9994.ground_truth: To have service granted, a CTS-MS needs to attach at the CTS-FP by being enrolled with the CTS-FP, brought in range of the CTS-FP, and the appropriate operation mode selected.

question_9997.question: What is a solution to minimize the risk of preparing a handover to a non-existing cell?
question_9997.ground_truth: To minimize the risk of preparing a handover to a non-existing cell and guarantee the success of consequent RRC reestablishment, the neighbour eNBs of the eNB controlling the cell to be split/merged can be notified about the planned deployment change in advance.

question_9998.question: Which HTTP method allows a service consumer to request the creation of a Monitoring Job at the NSCE Server?
question_9998.ground_truth: The HTTP POST method allows a service consumer to request the creation of a Monitoring Job at the NSCE Server.

question_9999.question: What is the function of the Physical Downlink Control Channel (PDCCH) in NB-CIoT?
question_9999.ground_truth: The Physical Downlink Control Channel (PDCCH) is used by the base station in NB-CIoT to schedule uplink and downlink transmission allocations, including normal data transmission, RACH Response, paging messages, and other control messages.

question_10000.question: What is the significance of the <on-network-max-participant-count> element in the MCVideo group?
question_10000.ground_truth: The <on-network-max-participant-count> element in the MCVideo group indicates the maximum number of participants allowed in the group session.

question_10003.question: What value should the "ton" parameter be set to when it has no relevant information?
question_10003.ground_truth: The "ton" parameter is set to zero when it has no relevant information.

question_10004.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 41.2.6.2.2?
question_10004.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the MS returns to packet idle updated if RLC/MAC blocks are sent after T3190 s, and that the MS correctly receives RLC/MAC blocks if they are sent before T3190 s.

question_10006.question: What does the 3GPP AAA server send to the OCS when the WLAN session ends?
question_10006.ground_truth: The 3GPP AAA server sends an ACR (stop) to the OCS with information from the ACR.

question_10007.question: What is the effect of an extended soft combining window on the DL interference perspective?
question_10007.ground_truth: From a DL interference perspective, there is little difference between synchronized DL SHO links and links that are delayed by a considerable amount, because the repetitive decoding attempts will succeed as soon as enough energy has been gathered by the UE. The extended SHO window can result in a 50% reduction of the DRX cycle for about 25% of UEs, but the alternative is imposing a DRX cycle of 100% for some users in case of code shortage.

question_10009.question: What is the state of the multi-party conversation after the release is confirmed?
question_10009.ground_truth: There is no longer a held multi-party conversation

question_10011.question: What is the purpose of the remote UE information request procedure?
question_10011.ground_truth: The purpose of the remote UE information request procedure is for the serving ProSe UE-to-network relay UE to obtain the information from the remote UE served by the relay.

question_10012.question: What should the SS do if the CMR indicates that the MS recommends to use the same or a lower codec mode in the downlink, after the carrier to interference ratio has been altered?
question_10012.ground_truth: The SS should increment the unsuccessful C/I increase event counter.

question_10013.question: What is the definition of "AoS" and "Apps" as used in the document?
question_10013.ground_truth: "AoS" stands for Always Online Service, while "Apps" refers to applications.

question_10014.question: What happens if the MCPTT user is not authorized to establish a private call in automatic commencement mode?
question_10014.ground_truth: If the MCPTT user is not authorized to establish a private call in automatic commencement mode, the MCPTT private call request will be denied.

question_10015.question: What information must the NF Service Consumer include in the POST request during SMF Context Transfer procedure with LBO or no Roaming, no I-SMF?
question_10015.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer must include the SMF transfer indication, old SMF ID, and the identifier of the SM Context resource in old SMF in the POST request.

question_10016.question: What is the role of the users in this functional model of the IOPS MC system?
question_10016.ground_truth: Users may be transferred to the IOPS MC system and actively use the MC service server's participating function, which takes place prior to the IOPS mode being triggered by backhaul failure. When the backhaul transmission works, users and the MC service client in the IOPS MC system are connected to the common services core in the primary MC system.

question_10017.question: What must the RCAF send to the PCRF in the ARA command for aggregated RUCI report?
question_10017.ground_truth: The RCAF must send related info and respond with an ARA command, including the PCRF id within the Destination-Host AVP, Aggregated-RUCI-Report AVP(s) with a congestion level set id and a list of aggregated congestion information in an ARR command for aggregated RUCI report.

question_10019.question: What method is used in 6.2.5.3.3.1 to notify a service consumer about Network slice LCM recommendation?
question_10019.ground_truth: The POST method is used in 6.2.5.3.3.1 to notify a service consumer about Network slice LCM recommendation.

question_10020.question: What happens to the sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer when it expires and the corresponding Sidelink process was not successfully decoded?
question_10020.ground_truth: The sl-drx-RetransmissionTimer/sl-DRX-GC-RetransmissionTimer for the corresponding Sidelink process is started in the first slot after the expiry of sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer.

question_10021.question: What actions does the network take when controlling network slices simultaneous usage incompatibility?
question_10021.ground_truth: The network checks for network slice simultaneous usage incompatibility between the new network slice and the network slices on which there are already established PDU sessions. If there is simultaneous usage incompatibility, the PDU Session Establishment Request on the new network slice is rejected.

question_10024.question: What condition is required for the MS to change from single carrier concurrent TBF to a DLMC TBF with the uplink reallocated to carrier 2?
question_10024.ground_truth: The network and mobile station must both support Downlink Multi Carrier for this change to occur.

question_10026.question: In the context of cell selection, what does it mean for a UE to treat a cell as if the cell status is "barred"?
question_10026.ground_truth: It means that the UE is not permitted to select/reselect this cell, not even for emergency calls, and shall exclude the barred cell as a candidate for cell selection/reselection for up to 300 seconds. The UE shall also exclude the barred cell and the cells on the same frequency as a candidate for cell selection/reselection for 300 seconds.

question_10027.question: What procedure should the MCVideo server perform if the functional alias does not exist in the server?
question_10027.ground_truth: If the functional alias does not exist in the MCVideo server, it should reject the SIP PUBLISH request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response.

question_10028.question: What should the UE do when it receives a REGISTRATION REJECT message with 5GMM cause value #9 from the AMF during a mobility and periodic registration procedure on an NGC cell?
question_10028.ground_truth: The UE should delete any 5G-GUTI, last visited registered TAI and ngKSI, enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED 5U2 NOT UPDATED, and subsequently automatically initiate the initial registration procedure.

question_10029.question: What is the key difference between "Solution A: New Band introduction for sub-band" and "Solution B: New Band Number"?
question_10029.ground_truth: Solution A introduces a new band with separate band combinations and RF requirements, while Solution B introduces a new band number that adheres to the same RF and performance requirements of the original band but differentiates which part of the spectrum a UE is certified to operate in a region.

question_10031.question: What is the difference between the PSDB and NPSDB in the per-PDU Set QoS framework?
question_10031.ground_truth: The PSDB is an upper bound for the time that a PS may be delayed between the UE and the N6 termination point at the UPF, while the NPSDB is the same concept of the PSDB but applied to the Nominal Arrival Time of PDU Set for periodic DL traffic.

question_10032.question: What is the purpose of the broadcast message service in a smart building's security system?
question_10032.ground_truth: The purpose of the broadcast message service in a smart building's security system is to quickly notify all smart devices of an intrusion event, so that they can respond accordingly within milliseconds.

question_10033.question: What limit is not met for offsets smaller than 300 kHz from the block edge for the 5 PRB allocation in the 100 kHz resolution bandwidth?
question_10033.ground_truth: The limit -13 dBm/100 kHz is not met for offsets smaller than 300 kHz from the block edge for the 5 PRB allocation.

question_10035.question: Which type of E-UTRA UE does the test case 6.3B.8.2.4.2 apply to?
question_10035.ground_truth: The test case 6.3B.8.2.4.2 applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 15 and forward, supporting inter-band EN-DC including FR2 with 1 NR UL CC.

question_10036.question: What is the difference between an Elementary Procedure with response and without response, in the context of the PCAP protocol?
question_10036.ground_truth: Class 1 Elementary Procedures are those with a response (whether successful or unsuccessful), while Class 2 Elementary Procedures are those without a response. Class 2 EPs are considered always successful. The types of responses for Class 1 EPs include successful (explicitly indicating that the elementary procedure was successfully completed) and unsuccessful (explicitly indicating that the EP failed).

question_10037.question: In which bands could the 2nd harmonics of BS transmitting in Band 3 and Band 5 fall, considering LTE Advanced Carrier Aggregation of Band 3 and Band 5 (1 UL)?
question_10037.ground_truth: The 2nd harmonics of BS transmitting in Band 3 and Band 5 may fall into the Band 3, 4, 9, 10, and 43 BS receive bands.

question_10038.question: What should the UE include in the Authorization header field when using SIP Digest without TLS as a security mechanism in a REGISTER request?
question_10038.ground_truth: The UE must add an Authorization header field following the requirements of RFCs 7616 and 8760, and include the unprotected port value for mid-dialog requests, as well as the Via header field with the unprotected port for response reception.

question_10039.question: What is the scaling factor considering PRS resource muting in the formula for the repetition periodicity of the PRS measurement in positioning frequency layer i?
question_10039.ground_truth: The scaling factor, , is calculated by multiplying the muting repetition factor, DL-PRS-MutingBitRepetitionFactor, given by the higher-layer parameter, and the size of the bitmap.

question_10045.question: What is necessary to consider for network preferences for the domain in which an emergency call is established and what are the trigger conditions for a transition?
question_10045.ground_truth: It is necessary to consider how network preferences relate to the decision to transition from one access to the next and to specify what the likely trigger conditions are for a transition, as this is a safety-critical service and needs to be error-free. The type of handover is different in VCC since it is UE-triggered, but the transition still requires detailed consideration, such as signal strength hysteresis regimes.

question_10046.question: What operation does the PDN GW provide to the PCRF when deleting packet filters from an existing TFT?
question_10046.ground_truth: The PDN GW provides to the PCRF the Gx operation "delete filters" when the TFT operation is "Delete packet filters from existing TFT".

question_10048.question: What was the mean power saving gain provided by making random traffic arrival offset in FR1, DL evaluation, DU, VR30Mbps-60Fps?
question_10048.ground_truth: The mean power saving gain provided by making random traffic arrival offset in FR1, DL evaluation, DU, VR30Mbps-60Fps was 5.96%.

question_10049.question: What is the principle used in the File Repair Procedure to protect network resources?
question_10049.ground_truth: The principle used in the File Repair Procedure to protect network resources is to spread the file repair request load in time and across multiple servers.

question_10051.question: What function is responsible for associating AF session information with one and only one PDU session?
question_10051.ground_truth: The Session binding function is responsible for this action.

question_10053.question: What are the considerations when enabling on-demand SSB or SIB1 from a specification and legacy UE perspective?
question_10053.ground_truth: Specification impact may include channel/signal design and behavior, and procedures of on-demand SSBs/SIB1 and related signaling. Random access related enhancements, mobility support or paging for the cell without SSB/SIB1, and new signal/channel design may also be required. If enabled, it should only be done when legacy UEs are not using the carrier.

question_10054.question: What is the procedure for the PCEF/TDF to retrieve PFDs for an Application Identifier from the PFDF?
question_10054.ground_truth: The PCEF/TDF sends a Fetch PFD Request to the PFDF, which responds with the list of Application Identifier and all associated PFDs in the Fetch PFD Response message. The PCEF/TDF then binds the PFDs received from the PFDF to the respective Application Identifier.

question_10056.question: What is Key Issue #4 in the 3GPP Technical Report about?
question_10056.ground_truth: Key Issue #4 covers the security aspect of TNAP mobility without full authentication when UE switches from one TNAP to another TNAP within the same TNGF.

question_10058.question: What is the reporting range of RSRQ in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.6.2?
question_10058.ground_truth: The reporting range of RSRQ is defined from -34 dB to 2.5 dB with 0.5 dB resolution in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.6.2.

question_10059.question: Which parameter is used to indicate the length of digits in Generic Number and Generic Digits?
question_10059.ground_truth: The length of the timeAndTimeZone parameter

question_10060.question: Which DRBs are considered active in the context of "5.1.1.10.3 Number of released active DRBs"?
question_10060.ground_truth: DRBs with bursty flow are considered active if there is user data in the PDCP queue or if data has been transferred during the last 100 ms. DRBs with continuous flow are seen as active as long as the UE is in RRC connected state.

question_10064.question: What is an elementary procedure (EP) in the context of F1AP?
question_10064.ground_truth: An elementary procedure (EP) in F1AP is a unit of interaction between gNB-CU and gNB-DU. It is used to build up complete sequences in a flexible manner.

question_10065.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon expiry of timer TFE2 (emergency alert retransmission) when in the "E2: Emergency state"?
question_10065.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should generate a GROUP EMERGENCY ALERT message, send the message, start the timer TFE2 (emergency alert retransmission), and remain in the current state.

question_10066.question: What IP address and port number should the UE insert into the Contact header field and the Via header field, and sent all IP packets to the P-CSCF?
question_10066.ground_truth: The UE shall insert the same IP address and port number into the Contact header field and the Via header field, and sends all IP packets to the P-CSCF from this IP address and port number.

question_10067.question: What is ProSe discovery in the context of EPS?
question_10067.ground_truth: ProSe discovery is a procedure that identifies that ProSe-enabled UEs are in proximity, using E-UTRAN (with or without E-UTRAN), WLAN technology or EPC.

question_10068.question: What is the state of the UE in relation to IMS services at the beginning of the test?
question_10068.ground_truth: The UE is not registered to IMS services at the beginning of the test.

question_10069.question: What is the function of the combining network in this process?
question_10069.ground_truth: The combining network is used for diversity reception from the two Base Station (BS) antenna connectors.

question_10070.question: What action can a UE capable of NR sidelink discovery take to be assigned resources for transmission or reception?
question_10070.ground_truth: The UE can initiate the procedure to request assignment of dedicated resources for NR sidelink discovery transmission or reception.

question_10072.question: What is a Management Service (MnS) component type B also known as?
question_10072.ground_truth: A Management Service (MnS) component type B is also called Network Resource Model (NRM).

question_10073.question: What is the definition and function of the ManagedFunction IOC?
question_10073.ground_truth: The ManagedFunction IOC is provided for sub-classing only and represents attributes common to functional IOCs. It can represent a telecommunication function realized by software running on dedicated hardware or realized by software running on NFVI. Each ManagedFunction instance communicates with a manager (directly or indirectly) over one or more management interfaces exposed via its containing ME instance.

question_10075.question: What is the minimum requirement for single RAT E-UTRA operation for co-location?
question_10075.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for single RAT E-UTRA operation for co-location is the same as the general minimum requirement for single RAT E-UTRA operation, and applies when E-UTRA BS, NR BS, UTRA BS, CDMA BS, or GSM/EDGE BS operating in a different frequency band are co-located with an AAS BS. The interferer power levels are specified at the co-location reference antenna conducted input and valid over minSENS RoAoA.

question_10076.question: How does the BSS handle existing location related procedures for a target MS if the SCCP connection to the SMLC is released?
question_10076.ground_truth: The BSS shall abort all existing location related procedures for the target MS without notifying the MS, and attempt to notify the SMLC using a BSSAP-LE Perform Location Abort if no BSSLAP procedure is active.

question_10077.question: In what scenario is authentication and NAS security setup mandatory for the UE in the new MME if the UE supports RACS?
question_10077.ground_truth: If the UE supports RACS, as indicated in the UE Core Network Capability IE, and if the UE indicated that it has UE Radio Capability ID assigned for use in the selected PLMN in step~1, then authentication and NAS security setup to activate integrity protection and NAS ciphering are mandatory.

question_10079.question: What does the EVS Codec generic frame format in CS Networks consist of?
question_10079.ground_truth: The EVS Codec generic frame format in CS Networks consists of the "generic frame format" of the EVS Codec in 3G CS networks for the Speech and SID frames of the primary modes of operation and the Speech and SID frames of the EVS AMR-WB IO mode of operation.

question_10080.question: How does a UE's Preferred Network Behaviour influence policy decisions for rerouting the Registration Request?
question_10080.ground_truth: The UE's Preferred Network Behaviour may be used to influence policy decisions that can cause rerouting of the Registration Request from one AMF to another.

question_10082.question: What should a GPRS MS do if the network accepts the routing area updating procedure from the MS without reallocation of the old P-TMSI?
question_10082.ground_truth: The MS should continue communication with the old P-TMSI.

question_10084.question: What is the purpose of the Initial UE Message procedure?
question_10084.ground_truth: The Initial UE Message procedure establishes an Iu signalling connection between a CN domain and the RNC, and transfers the initial NAS-PDU to the CN node as determined by the NAS Node Selection Function.

question_10085.question: What is the role of the MCVideo server in the MCVideo private call request process?
question_10085.ground_truth: The MCVideo server checks if the users are authorized to initiate and receive the private call, verifies the provided functional alias, resolves functional aliases to corresponding MCVideo IDs, and sets up a security association if end-to-end encryption is used.

question_10087.question: What is the expected result for Test case 1?
question_10087.ground_truth: The expected result for Test case 1 is that the I-CSCF under test encrypts the hiding information elements when forwarding the SIP message to the network element outside the hiding network's domain.

question_10088.question: What is the role of the SS in the NR/5GC Layer 3 normal mode for SRB0 in the uplink and downlink port?
question_10088.ground_truth: In the NR/5GC Layer 3 normal mode, for SRB0, the uplink port is above RLC and the downlink port is above RLC in the SS.

question_10089.question: In order to support NBIFOM, what is one of the capabilities of the PDN GW?
question_10089.ground_truth: It needs to be capable of Receiving UE request on a default access for NBIFOM in UE-initiated NBIFOM mode.

question_10090.question: In what scenarios is radio link monitoring required in section 7.6.2.4, independent of the evaluation periods defined in sections 7.6.2.1-7.6.2.3?
question_10090.ground_truth: For E-UTRAN FDD-UTRAN FDD measurements with autonomous gaps, for identification of the CGI of a UTRA FDD cell, the UE shall also perform radio link monitoring. The same applies to E-UTRAN TDD-UTRAN FDD measurements with autonomous gaps, E-UTRAN FDD-NR measurements with autonomous gaps, and E-UTRAN TDD-NR measurements with autonomous gaps.

question_10091.question: What is the purpose of the HSDPA connection setting up in 9.5.1.4.2?
question_10091.ground_truth: Once the HSDPA connection is set up, the test starts transmitting HSDPA data, and the SS counts the number of NACK, ACK, and statDTX on the UL HS-DPCCH during the test interval.

question_10093.question: What does error code 103 indicate in the context of CS, GPRS, UMTS, and 5GS-related errors?
question_10093.ground_truth: Error code 103 indicates that an MS or UE is illegal for CS, GPRS, UMTS, and 5GS.

question_10094.question: What is the expected sequence when the mobile station receives a PACKET TBF RELEASE message with a "Abnormal release" cause value during an uplink TBF in acknowledged mode?
question_10094.ground_truth: The mobile station stops transmitting immediately and follows the abnormal release with a random access procedure.

question_10096.question: What conditions must be met for the number of successful tests to be increased by one in the described procedure?
question_10096.ground_truth: The number of successful tests is increased by one if the SS detects uplink power on NR carrier equal to or higher than the minimum output power, does not detect a preamble on a beam associated with the candidate beam set q1 before time point B, and detects a preamble on a beam associated with the candidate beam set q1 before time point F (D1 after the start of T5).

question_10098.question: What is the impact of the solution on the NWDAF service consumer?
question_10098.ground_truth: The NWDAF service consumer receives notifications when the accuracy in use or MAE in use has decreased, and stops using the analytics provided by the NWDAF(AnLF) as a result.

question_10099.question: What is the role of the PCF in relation to the NG-RAN in the context of k quality detail level and clock quality acceptance criteria parameters?
question_10099.ground_truth: The PCF provides these parameters to the NG-RAN.

question_10100.question: When does the inclusion of ECGI/eNodeB ID/TAI trigger a Modify Bearer Request message from the S-GW to the PDN GW?
question_10100.ground_truth: The inclusion of ECGI/eNodeB ID/TAI in the MS Info Change Reporting support indication will trigger a Modify Bearer Request message from the S-GW to the PDN GW when the level of support changes during a mobility management procedure.

question_10101.question: What is the purpose of the CEMAF framework in Solution #1 for key issue #1 in 5G SBA certificate management?
question_10101.ground_truth: The CEMAF framework in Solution #1 proposes to group the certificate management procedures in three blocks, corresponding to the initial trust establishment, the enrolment of the certificate, and the management procedures during the lifecycle of the certificate. This framework will facilitate interoperability and reduce the implementation complexity for 5G SBA with capabilities such as enrolment, renewal, updates, revocation, status notification, etc. for the entire lifecycle of the certificates.

question_10103.question: What message should the MS receive to initiate the release of both calls, after a successful explicit call transfer?
question_10103.ground_truth: The MS should receive a RELEASE COMPLETE message for each call to enter state U0 "Null".

question_10104.question: What is the main objective of the 3GPP and TM Forum joint working group?
question_10104.ground_truth: The main objective of the 3GPP and TM Forum joint working group is to achieve model and realisation structure alignment across 3GPP and TM Forum for a specific aspect of the problem concerning Fixed Mobile Convergence (FMC) network management compliance.

question_10105.question: What is the monotonic sequence requirement for the supported maximum output power for each number of uplink timeslots, from R99 onwards?
question_10105.ground_truth: The supported maximum output power for each number of uplink timeslots shall form a monotonic sequence. The maximum reduction of maximum output power from an allocation of n uplink timeslots to an allocation of n+1 uplink timeslots shall be equal to the difference of maximum permissible nominal reduction of maximum output power for the corresponding number of timeslots.

question_10107.question: What is a PIN in the context of the 5G system?
question_10107.ground_truth: A PIN (also referred to as a PLMN) is a Public Land Mobile Network, which can include a CPN (non-3GPP access), a PRAS (Premises Radio Access Station), an eRG (enhanced Radio Gateway), and a PIN Element with Gateway Capability.

question_10108.question: What is the objective of the test in subclause 3.4.3 of GPP~TS~44.018?
question_10108.ground_truth: The objective is to verify that the MS, in CC-state U4, "Call Delivered", through-connects the speech channel to make in-band announcements available when it receives a DISCONNECT with a progress indicator indicating in-band information and the TCH is in speech mode.

question_10109.question: What should the UE do when timer T3582 expires in the UE-requested PDU session release procedure?
question_10109.ground_truth: The UE shall abort the procedure, release the allocated PTI, and perform the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update with a REGISTRATION REQUEST message including the PDU session status IE.

question_10110.question: What are the new features introduced in TR 23.501 related to the QoS aspects of satellite backhauling in 5GC?
question_10110.ground_truth: Reporting of satellite backhaul category to the 5G Core Network, and new 5G QoS Indicator (5QI) defined for satellite backhaul and satellite access.

question_10111.question: What is the role of the PIN AS in managing PIN at the network side over the application layer?
question_10111.ground_truth: The PIN AS is responsible for managing PIN at the network side over the application layer. It stores and updates the PIN information in UDR via NEF.

question_10112.question: What should the UE do if the UE encounters SOR security check not successful on the received steering of roaming information and a matching criterion "SOR security check not successful" is included in the SOR-CMCI stored in the non-volatile memory of the ME?
question_10112.ground_truth: If the timer value is not zero, the UE shall start an associated Tsor-cm timer with the value included in the SOR-CMCI, stop all other running Tsor-cm timers, and not start any new Tsor-cm timer while Tsor-cm timer associated with "SOR security check not successful" criterion is running.

question_10113.question: What is the format of the routing rules provided to the UE and how do they apply to access types?
question_10113.ground_truth: The routing rules provided to the UE have a specific format, and they dictate which flows identified by the rules can be sent over specific access types. 3GPP is the preferred access type for the first routing rule, while WLAN is the preferred access type for the second routing rule. The third routing rule prohibits sending flows over WLAN.

question_10114.question: In what scenarios is the PDU Session Modification procedure used?
question_10114.ground_truth: The PDU Session Modification procedure is used when the UE or network requested traffic steering in 3GPP or non-3GPP access, traffic switching from 3GPP to non-3GPP access and vice versa, or traffic splitting in 3GPP and non-3GPP access.

question_10116.question: What does the "PDU Set QoS Parameters" IE define in a 5G network?
question_10116.ground_truth: This IE defines PDU Set QoS parameters to be applied to a QoS flow.

question_10117.question: What is the method to compute the message authentication code for data integrity (MAC-I) using the integrity algorithm f9?
question_10117.ground_truth: The MAC-I is computed by taking the input parameters such as the Integrity Key (IK), the integrity sequence number (COUNT-I), a random value generated by the network side (FRESH), the direction bit (DIRECTION) and the signalling data (MESSAGE) and processing them through the integrity algorithm f9.

question_10118.question: What is the purpose of the Downlink Power Control procedure?
question_10118.ground_truth: The Downlink Power Control procedure is used to change the power in DL transmission based on the report of the quality measure.

question_10119.question: What should the PGW do upon receiving downlink data for a PDN connection associated with a failed SGW that has not been restored yet, and what message does it send over GTPv2-based S5?
question_10119.ground_truth: The PGW should select a new SGW that supports this solution and sends a PGW Downlink Triggering Notification message, including IMSI and an MME/S4-SGSN identifier when available, if the PDN connection receiving downlink data or signalling is eligible for PGW initiated Downlink triggering based on operator's policies.

question_10121.question: What is the method described to minimize uplink traffic when only a few symbols are lost?
question_10121.ground_truth: Only the initial symbol ESI and the amount of requested consecutive symbols are sent.

question_10122.question: What action does the UE take if the SS/PBCH block-based measurement quantities are available?
question_10122.ground_truth: If the SS/PBCH block-based measurement quantities are available, the UE sets the rsIndexResults in measResultLastServCell to include all the available measurement quantities of the source PCell or PCell, ordered such that the highest SS/PBCH block RSRP is listed first if SS/PBCH block RSRP measurement results are available.

question_10123.question: What information is collected in a PGW-CDR when IP-CAN session charging is active?
question_10123.ground_truth: Two types of data can be collected: traffic volumes used for IP-CAN bearer charging and service data used for FBC.

question_10125.question: What is studied in section 7.167.2 regarding DC?
question_10125.ground_truth: Channel bandwidths per operating band for DC

question_10126.question: What causes the abortion of the dialogue in MSC-B' during a handover scenario?
question_10126.ground_truth: The abortion of the dialogue in MSC-B' is triggered by the failure of the handover, which can occur due to various reasons, including poor radio quality, resource optimization, better cell, directed retry, etc.

question_10127.question: When must the transmission participant send a Transmission control Ack message upon receiving a media transmission notification?
question_10127.ground_truth: When the first bit in the subtype of the media transmission notification message is set to '1' (Acknowledgment is required).

question_10132.question: What should the UE do, if the AUTHENTICATION REJECT message is received without integrity protection and timer T3516 or T3520 is running, and it is not registered for onboarding services in SNPN or performing initial registration for onboarding services in SNPN?
question_10132.ground_truth: The UE should start timer T3247 with a random value uniformly drawn from the range between 30 minutes and 60 minutes, if the timer is not running.

question_10133.question: What is the role of the UE in this test?
question_10133.ground_truth: The UE is the MCData client in this test, and it is required to be registered and authorized for MCDATA Service.

question_10136.question: What entity initiates the Ranging/SL positioning service request from the SL Positioning Client UE to the LMF?
question_10136.ground_truth: The AMF initiates the Ranging/SL positioning service request from the SL Positioning Client UE to the LMF.

question_10137.question: What should the gNB trigger for key refresh to occur before DRB ID reuse?
question_10137.ground_truth: Before DRB ID reuse, the gNB should take a new KgNB into use by triggering an intra-cell handover or triggering a transition from RRC_CONNECTED to RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE and then back to RRC_CONNECTED.

question_10138.question: What message type is sent by the mobile station to the network in response to an IDENTITY REQUEST message, providing the requested identity?

question_10139.question: What information is included in the ADMF message to the Delivery Function 2 for deactivation?
question_10139.ground_truth: The ADMF sends the DF2 activation id, which uniquely identifies the activation to be deactivated for DF2, when deactivating the delivery of the IRI.

question_10141.question: How can PUCCH resources be allocated in a HeNB to reduce interference with macro-eNB UEs?
question_10141.ground_truth: By not allocating PUCCH resources on edge RBs and pulling the PUCCH resources inward so they do not overlap with the macro-eNB UE region.

question_10142.question: What does the SOAP 1.2 HTTP binding provide support for?
question_10142.ground_truth: The SOAP 1.2 HTTP binding provides support for both HTTP GET and POST operations.

question_10143.question: What is the role of CC-POI and CC-TF in IMS?
question_10143.ground_truth: CC-POI functions handle the media in IMS, while CC-TF functions handle the SIP messages in IMS and manage the IMS Media Functions.

question_10144.question: In what situations can the initiating UE initiate the 5G ProSe direct link modification procedure for adding a new ProSe application to the existing 5G ProSe direct link?
question_10144.ground_truth: The initiating UE shall initiate this procedure if there is a 5G ProSe direct link between the initiating UE and the target UE, the pair of application layer IDs and the network layer protocol of this 5G ProSe direct link are identical to those required by the application layer in the initiating UE for this ProSe application, the security policy corresponding to the ProSe identifier is aligned with the security policy of the existing 5G ProSe direct link, the timer T5091 is not running, and the initiating UE is not performing the 5G ProSe direct link re-keying procedure initiated by the target UE.

question_10146.question: What is used to indicate authorization for a UE to use a L2 or L3 UE-to-Network Relay in NG-RAN?
question_10146.ground_truth: Authorization IEs are introduced in NG-RAN to indicate whether the UE is authorized to use a 5G ProSe Layer-3 and/or Layer-2 UE-to-Network Relay and 5G ProSe Layer-2 UE-to-Network Remote UE.

question_10147.question: Which UE categories support the combination described in 7.4.8?

question_10148.question: What are the two options for allocating new IP prefix in the procedure of changing PDU Session Anchor in SSC mode 3?
question_10148.ground_truth: The two options are: (a) allocating a new IP prefix within the same PDU Session, using IPv6 multi-homing, (b) allocating a new IP address and/or IP prefix within a new PDU Session that the UE is triggered to establish.

question_10149.question: What are the general architecture aspects of the Gb based architecture compared to the S1 based architecture in terms of cost and software licences?
question_10149.ground_truth: The Gb based architecture of the cellular system for supporting ultra low complexity and low throughput Internet of Things (Cellular IoT) is capable of avoiding costs (e.g. software licences) associated with maintaining permanently-open PDP contexts, and, may simplify the (re)allocation of an APN to a new device when the device only supports one PDP context. On the other hand, the S1 based architecture requires the activation of a default bearer which incurs costs associated with maintaining permanently-open PDP contexts.

question_10150.question: What is the function of the passenger information system (PIS) at a smart station?
question_10150.ground_truth: The PIS at a smart station displays information about the trains, including which platform they will stop at and whether they will be at the front or back of the platform.

question_10152.question: When must a UE stop timer T3396 upon a PLMN change or inter-system change?
question_10152.ground_truth: A UE must not stop timer T3396 upon a PLMN change or inter-system change.

question_10154.question: What is the implication of a "shall" requirement in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
question_10154.ground_truth: The implication of a "shall" requirement in the context of 3GPP technical specifications is a mandatory requirement to do something.

question_10155.question: What message is sent by the RNC to inform the CN that an enhanced relocation is completed?

question_10156.question: How does the MAC entity determine the number of parallel UL HARQ processes?
question_10156.ground_truth: The number of parallel UL HARQ processes per HARQ entity is specified in TS 38.214.

question_10157.question: What effect does the hysteresis parameter for this event have on event triggered measurements?
question_10157.ground_truth: The hysteresis parameter for this event is used as a hysteresis when determining if the entering or leaving conditions for event triggered measurements have been satisfied. The event will not be triggered if the measured value is close to the threshold, but the value of the hysteresis parameter determines how close the measured value must be to the threshold for the event to be triggered.

question_10159.question: What action should the MS take if it receives an unexpected GA-PSR-ACTIVATE-UTC-REQ message while waiting for the GA-PSR-DEACTIVATE-UTC-ACK message response during the GA-PSR deactivation procedure?
question_10159.ground_truth: The MS should ignore the request and continue waiting for the GA-PSR-DEACTIVATE-UTC-ACK response.

question_10160.question: What should the SMF do if the network-requested PDU session modification is triggered by a UE-requested PDU session modification and the 5GSM capability IE is included in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message with the RQoS bit set to "Reflective QoS not supported"?
question_10160.ground_truth: The SMF should consider that the UE does not support reflective QoS for this PDU session.

question_10161.question: What is the specific exception to clause 9 for the ACTIVE SET UPDATE (Step 8) and (Step 7) in procedure P9b and P10, respectively?
question_10161.ground_truth: The ACTIVE SET UPDATE (Step 8) and (Step 7) should be referred to in clause 9 for procedure P9b and P10, respectively.

question_10163.question: What are the conditions of the <cp:rule> element inside <cp:ruleset> in the simservs document provided in the test procedure of 15.14a.3?
question_10163.ground_truth: The <cp:conditions> element must contain a <roaming> element and not contain a <rule-deactivated> element.

question_10165.question: In what circumstances should the SGSN locally deactivate all PDP contexts associated with a SIPTO at the local network PDN connection if the PDN connection is a SIPTO at the local network PDN connection with collocated L-GW?
question_10165.ground_truth: If a SIPTO L-GW Transport Layer Address is not provided by the lower layer together with the ROUTING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message, or the provided SIPTO L-GW Transport Layer Address is different from the GGSN address associated with the PDP context of the SIPTO at the local network PDN connection.

question_10167.question: How does SHVC inter-layer motion prediction work in the enhancement layer (EL) decoder?
question_10167.ground_truth: In SHVC inter-layer motion prediction, the base layer's motion information is mapped to the EL's resolution, and a scaling operation is applied to the base layer motion vectors to account for the upsampling ratio. The scaled base layer motion information is then used as a reference to predict the EL's motion information.

question_10168.question: What is the function of the Proxy Binding Update message in the PMIP S5/S8 architecture?
question_10168.ground_truth: The Proxy Binding Update message is used by the Serving GW to request the new IPv4 address and update the current registration in the PMIP S5/S8 architecture. It is sent to the PDN GW and contains the MN NAI (Mobile Node Network Access Identifier), APN (Access Point Name), and UE Address Info.

question_10170.question: How does the UE protect the CAG ID during the initial registration process?
question_10170.ground_truth: The UE protects the CAG ID by concealing it with the Home Network Public Key and a protection scheme, creating a concealed CAG ID. This concealment is performed every time a SUCI is required, such as when sending a Registration Request message or responding to an Identity Response message.

question_10171.question: What action does the old Serving GW take when the UE cannot access the RA due to regional or access restrictions?
question_10171.ground_truth: The old Serving GW discards any packets buffered for the UE.

question_10172.question: What is the format of the BroadcastMRBs-SetupMod-Item in the BroadcastMRBs-SetupMod-ItemIEs F1AP-PROTOCOL-IES?
question_10172.ground_truth: The BroadcastMRBs-SetupMod-Item in the BroadcastMRBs-SetupMod-ItemIEs F1AP-PROTOCOL-IES is a sequence of one or more BroadcastMRBs-SetupMod-Item elements, each containing zero or more ProtocolIE-SingleItem elements.

question_10173.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the congestion control measurement test for V2X UE?
question_10173.ground_truth: The UE shall be capable of estimating the channel busy ratio for one or more transmission pools based on S-RSSI measurements provided by the physical layer.

question_10174.question: What function does the X2-Proxy offer in the event of failure for non-UE-dedicated X2 procedures?
question_10174.ground_truth: The X2-Proxy terminates the procedure and triggers the associated non-UE-dedicated X2-AP procedure(s) to other side.

question_10175.question: What action should the UE take if the initial eCall request fails due to the emerg-request timer expiring?
question_10175.ground_truth: The UE should consider the emergency service request as failed and perform the procedures defined in 3GPP TS 23.167 subclause 7.3.

question_10176.question: What is the purpose of the Load Control Sequence number parameter in the GTP-C protocol?
question_10176.ground_truth: The Load Control Sequence number parameter is used to differentiate two Load Control Information IEs generated at two different instants by the same GTP-C entity and to sequence the load control information received from a GTP-C entity.

question_10177.question: What should the MSGin5G Gateway Client do when it receives a CoAP POST request for bulk registration from the MSGin5G Server?
question_10177.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Gateway Client shall split the content of the "List of individual MSGin5G UE registration response" element into multiple individual registration responses, and generate one or more CoAP POST requests as registration responses to constrained UE(s) separately based on the cached CoAP POST requests associated with the UE Service ID included in the individual registration responses.

question_10179.question: What action does the SRNC take when it receives a RANAP MBMS Session Update message after a RA filtering option has been used in the network?
question_10179.ground_truth: The SRNC updates the MCCH using RRC MBMS Modified Services Info message on MCCH in all the cells indicated to request UE to establish PMM connection. This is done by the SRNC as CRNC after it has received a RANAP MBMS Session Update message from the CN and updated the RA list containing UEs.

question_10182.question: What is the role of the NWDAF in providing URSP rules experience analytics?
question_10182.ground_truth: The NWDAF is responsible for providing URSP rules experience analytics to a service consumer, such as the PCF, in the form of statistics or predictions. It collects QoS related data from the SMF, including parameters like S-NSSAI, DNN, and SSC mode, and uses them to calculate the analytics.

question_10184.question: What should the UE do when it receives a 5GSM message including an unassigned or reserved PDU session identity value?
question_10184.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the message if it receives a 5GSM message which includes an unassigned or reserved PDU session identity value.

question_10186.question: What is recommended for migrated MC service users to utilize in terms of SIP core / IMS when accessing MC services in a partner MC system?
question_10186.ground_truth: Migrated MC service users should utilize the SIP core / IMS of the partner MC system to access MC services in the partner MC system, in order to ensure the security policy of the partner MC system is not compromised and to consistently meet service-level delay requirements.

question_10187.question: What is the maximum power reduction (MPR) for the range of A from 0.2 to 0.6 for intra-band contiguous multi-carrier operation bandwidth class B?
question_10187.ground_truth: The MPR for the range of A from 0.2 to 0.6 for intra-band contiguous multi-carrier operation bandwidth class B is 5.75 - 3.75A.

question_10189.question: What is the main focus of solution #10 regarding EAS relocation scenarios involving the SEALDD server?
question_10189.ground_truth: Solution #10 introduces the SEALDD server relocation proposal for EDN and non-EDN scenarios, and the SEALDD context transfer procedure for non-IP replacement and IP replacement.

question_10191.question: What information does the UE identify in an intra-frequency measurement?
question_10191.ground_truth: The UE identifies new intra-frequency cells and performs SS-RSRP, SS-RSRQ, and SS-SINR measurements of identified intra-frequency cells in an intra-frequency measurement.

question_10192.question: What should the SS do to evaluate the MeasurementReport messages transmitted by the UE?
question_10192.ground_truth: The SS should compare the reported RSRQ values for Cell 1, Cell 2, Cell 3, Cell 4, and Cell 5 to the actual RSRQ values.

question_10194.question: When does the session start and stop for the Video Clip Distribution Service in the provided metadata fragment?
question_10194.ground_truth: The session start for the Video Clip Distribution Service in the provided metadata fragment is the 5th of August 2005, 00:00:00 (in NTP format 3332188800) and the session stop is the 18th of December 2005, 00:00:00 (in NTP format 3343766400).

question_10195.question: What is the information required in a session setup request in the media replication process from UE-2 to SCC AS-1?
question_10195.ground_truth: The session setup request from UE-2 to SCC AS-1 includes information to identify the session that contains the media flow to be replicated, the media flow to be replicated, the source of the media flow to be replicated, and the target of the replicated media flow.

question_10197.question: What is the use of NM centralized Coverage and Capacity Optimization?
question_10197.ground_truth: The NM centralized Coverage and Capacity Optimization is used to identify and optimize coverage and capacity problems in a network, such as cell coverage adapting to traffic demand, coverage and accessibility, LTE coverage holes with underlaid UTRAN/GERAN, LTE connection failure, and radio link quality.

question_10199.question: Which timers are requested for getting the current value from the Timer in the first passage?
question_10199.ground_truth: Timer with identifier 2 is requested for getting the current value from the Timer in the first passage.

question_10201.question: What is the purpose of the near field to far field transformation in the NFTR testing procedure?
question_10201.ground_truth: The near field to far field transformation is a mathematical computation that is applied to the near field measured radiation pattern to compute the far field radiation pattern.

question_10203.question: What are the privacy concerns associated with transferring a UE's location information in a network operator's systems?
question_10203.ground_truth: Many aspects of a UE's location need to be transferred to and sometimes stored in a network operator's systems. However, it is regulatory required that the privacy of a user's location is protected by network operators. Therefore, any solution that transfers or stores location information will need to do so in a manner that protects the user from misuse or abuse of that location information.

question_10204.question: What should the MS do if it fails to decode the "Sample Size" parameter in a GA-RRC ACTIVATE CHANNEL message?
question_10204.ground_truth: The MS is required to fail the establishment of the CS traffic channel if it cannot decode a valid "Sample Size" parameter.

question_10206.question: What are the applicable deployment scenarios for NR Radio Access operating with shared spectrum channel access in the unlicensed spectrum?
question_10206.ground_truth: The applicable deployment scenarios are Carrier aggregation between NR in licensed spectrum (PCell) and NR in shared spectrum (SCell), dual connectivity between LTE in licensed spectrum and NR in shared spectrum (PSCell), NR in shared spectrum (PCell), NR cell in shared spectrum and uplink in licensed spectrum, and dual connectivity between NR in licensed spectrum (PCell) and NR in shared spectrum (PSCell).

question_10208.question: What are the key features of the third variant of the distributed approach for UC identification and scoring?
question_10208.ground_truth: In this third variant, UC functionality is available in several networks, but UC entities in different networks do not communicate scores to each other, allowing each operator to react independently to locally determined scores.

question_10209.question: What is the minimum requirement for UE transmitter power when turned on?
question_10209.ground_truth: The UE transmitter is considered to be on if the UE transmitted power is higher than minimum output power.

question_10211.question: What is the range of Message Identifiers that can be used for Public Warning System in 3GPP~TS~22.268?
question_10211.ground_truth: The range of Message Identifiers that can be used for Public Warning System in 3GPP~TS~22.268 is from 4352 to 6399 (1100 hex to 18FF hex).

question_10212.question: What information does the N2 SM information carry to the (R)AN from the AMF regarding the PDU Session?
question_10212.ground_truth: The CN Tunnel Info, QoS profiles, PDU Session ID, S-NSSAI, User Plane Security Enforcement information, and other related information.

question_10213.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a MobilityFromEUTRACommand message with the purpose set to handover?
question_10213.ground_truth: The UE should consider inter-RAT mobility as initiated towards the RAT indicated by the targetRAT-Type in the MobilityFromEUTRACommand message, forward the nas-SecurityParamFromEUTRA to the upper layers, and access the target cell in accordance with the specifications of the target RAT.

question_10214.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP TS 51.010 series of documents?
question_10214.ground_truth: The 3GPP TS 51.010 series of documents cover the Mobile Station (MS) conformance specification for digital cellular telecommunications systems, including GSM Phase 2, Phase 2+, and 3GPP releases 4 to 12. The series consists of five parts: Part 1 (conformance specification), Part 2 (PICS proforma specification), Part 3 (Layer 3 Abstract Test Suite), Part 4 (SIM Application Toolkit conformance specification), and Part 5 (Inter-RAT Abstract Test Suite for GERAN to UTRAN).

question_10215.question: Which protocol layer is responsible for management of transport network resources in UMTS?
question_10215.ground_truth: Management of transport network resources belongs to the Transport Layer in UMTS.

question_10216.question: What is the difference between Single User Busy and Multiple User Busy in Flexible Alerting?
question_10216.ground_truth: Single User Busy returns a busy indication if any group member indicates busy before the call is answered, while Multiple User Busy returns a busy indication if all accessible members indicate busy in that FA group.

question_10217.question: What is the role of the AMF in the 3GPP network, and what does it store in the UE context?
question_10217.ground_truth: The Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF) is a 3GPP network entity responsible for managing the user equipment (UE) context, which includes storing data such as IP addresses, security keys, and handles. These handles are used to identify specific UE-PLMN pairs and secure the communication between UEs and the network.

question_10218.question: What are the symbols and abbreviations used in the document?
question_10218.ground_truth: The symbols and abbreviations used in the document include API, BA, DDP, FMW, IA, IIS, IRP, MTOSI, NRA, NRM, RTM, TIP, and TMF.

question_10219.question: What is the length of a recording interval in terms of the granularity period?
question_10219.ground_truth: The length of a recording interval is a multiple of the granularity period.

question_10221.question: What is the role of the "hysteresis" parameter in the defined events, and in what unit is it expressed?
question_10221.ground_truth: The hysteresis parameter is a value that is added to the measurement result of the serving cell or the neighboring cell in the defined inequalities to avoid rapid and frequent switching between the serving and neighboring cells. The hysteresis parameter is expressed in decibels (dB).

question_10222.question: In what scenario should the AMF set the Payload container type IE to "N1 SM information" when sending a single uplink 5GSM message which is not forwarded due to congestion control?
question_10222.ground_truth: The AMF should set the Payload container type IE to " NIoT user data container" when it sends a single uplink CIoT user data container which is not forwarded due to congestion control.

question_10223.question: What message does the MS send to the SS in option 2, after requesting additional assistance data and receiving it in zero, one or more RRLP Assistance Data delivery messages?
question_10223.ground_truth: The MS sends RRLP MEASURE POSITION RESPONSE to the SS after finishing the measurement.

question_10224.question: How is the number of active transmitter units calculated for BS type 1-H output power requirements?
question_10224.ground_truth: The number of active transmitter units that are considered when calculating the emissions limit (NTXU, counted) for BS type 1-H is calculated as the minimum of NTXU,active and 8 multiplied by Ncells.

question_10226.question: Which reference signals are supported in SL, and what are their functions?
question_10226.ground_truth: DM-RS associated with PSSCH are transmitted in one of several possible patterns in the time domain. In FR2, a PT-RS for PSSCH is also supported. CSI-RS, SRS, and AGC training signal are candidate reference signals. Their functions include carrying Channel State Information (CSI) and aiding cell search, mobility measurement, and beam management.

question_10227.question: How is the UE location calculated for GNSS scenario #4B?
question_10227.ground_truth: The UE location is calculated as a random offset from the reference location using the method described in subclause 6.2.1.2.6. The reference location for GNSS scenario #4B is given by the latitude of 3 degrees 56 minutes 31.668 seconds north and longitude of 73 degrees 29 minutes 26.0376 seconds east, with a height of 50m.

question_10228.question: What is a non-GBR bearer in the context of EPS services?
question_10228.ground_truth: A non-GBR bearer is an EPS bearer that uses network resources that are not related to a guaranteed bit rate value.

question_10229.question: What is the purpose of the test in clause 6.5.7A.2.1?
question_10229.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in clause 6.5.7A.2.1 is to verify the DL interruption requirements during UE dynamic switching between two uplink carriers.

question_10230.question: What is the required reporting delay for the UE to send the MeasurementReport message triggered by Event B2?
question_10230.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay should be less than 4.8s from the start of period T2.

question_10231.question: What is the initial condition for the test procedure for no response to paging?
question_10231.ground_truth: The initial conditions are specified in the test case, which calls the procedure in its entirety or refers to parts of it.

question_10232.question: What type of payload is used to send an SDS notification over MSRP?
question_10232.ground_truth: An SDS notification is sent over MSRP using an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body.

question_10233.question: What is the concept being introduced to reduce the jitter in the delay with which the complete PDU Set is delivered to the recipient's application?
question_10233.ground_truth: The concept of "PDU Set Delay Budget" and providing the PDU's PDU Set sequence number to the gNB is introduced.

question_10235.question: What is the requirement for the CSI report with non-zero CQI index in step 8b and 8c?
question_10235.ground_truth: The CSI report with non-zero CQI index should be received by the SS earlier than or equal to subframe (m+59) or the next available uplink resource if there are no uplink resources for reporting the valid CSI in a subframe (m+59).

question_10236.question: What is the role of the Media Server in the Media Player's content selection process?
question_10236.ground_truth: The Media Server provides content to the Media Player, which is then processed and evaluated by the Media Player to determine if it is available from different data networks, including the Media Server and the 5GMSd~AS.

question_10239.question: What is the major concern of operators with the USIM application being integrated into the M2M equipment rather than the UICC?
question_10239.ground_truth: One of the major concerns is that integrated USIM applications might not meet the required levels of security.

question_10241.question: What happens when the UE loses coverage of the registered PLMN?
question_10241.ground_truth: If the UE loses coverage of the registered PLMN, either a new PLMN is selected automatically (automatic mode) or an indication of available PLMNs is given to the user so that a manual selection can be performed (manual mode).

question_10242.question: What factors does a UE consider when deriving reselection priorities for slice-based cell reselection?
question_10242.ground_truth: A UE derives reselection priorities for slice-based cell reselection using NSAGs and their priorities provided by NAS, sliceInfoList and sliceInfoListDedicated per frequency with nsag-CellReselectionPriority per NSAG, and cellReselectionPriority per frequency provided in system information and/or dedicated signalling.

question_10245.question: What is the definition of Tactile Internet as given in the document?
question_10245.ground_truth: Tactile Internet is a network (or network of networks) for remotely accessing, perceiving, manipulating, or controlling real or virtual objects or processes in perceived real time by humans or machines.

question_10246.question: When using the File Repair Using the FileSchedule procedure, what element in the Schedule Description metadata fragment is used to request the file of interest?
question_10246.ground_truth: The fileURI element in the fileSchedule is used to request the file of interest in the File Repair Using the FileSchedule procedure.

question_10247.question: What is the beam correspondence requirement for PC3 UEs?
question_10247.ground_truth: The beam correspondence requirement for PC3 UEs consists of three components: UE minimum peak EIRP, UE spherical coverage, and beam correspondence tolerance. The UE shall meet the beam correspondence requirement with its autonomously chosen UL beams without uplink beam sweeping if beamCorrespondenceWithoutUL-BeamSweeping is present, and with uplink beam sweeping and support uplink beam management if it is not present.

question_10248.question: What action is taken by the IBCF-hA1 and the IC-A1 when releasing resources for a call?
question_10248.ground_truth: The IBCF-hA1 and the IC-A1 release resources reserved in the media gateway for the call.

question_10250.question: What is the HTTP method and custom operation used to request USS change?
question_10250.ground_truth: An HTTP POST request (custom operation: "RequestUssChange") should be used to request USS change.

question_10251.question: What is the function of the AKMA Authentication Function (AAuF) in the AKMA architecture?
question_10251.ground_truth: The AKMA Authentication Function (AAuF) interacts with the UE via the AKMA Protocol Transfer Gateway (APTG) over Service-Based interfaces for AKMA application specific keys.

question_10252.question: What information should the IMS P2P CDS UE send to the Tracker AS when terminating the existing P2P session?
question_10252.ground_truth: The IMS P2P CDS UE should notify the Tracker AS to remove itself from all related Peer lists after releasing all the current P2P media connections and terminating the existing P2P session through SIP Bye message.

question_10253.question: In what scenario would the target NG-RAN node send a HANDOVER NOTIFY message to the AMF?
question_10253.ground_truth: The target NG-RAN node sends the HANDOVER NOTIFY message to the AMF when the UE has been identified in the target cell and the NG-based handover has been successfully completed.

question_10254.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP INVITE request?
question_10254.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should interact with the media plane, perform the actions specified in subclause~6.2.8.3.4 if the MCVideo emergency private call state is set to "MVEPC 2: emergency-pc-requested" or "MVEPC 3: emergency-pc-granted", and notify the user that the call has been successfully established.

question_10255.question: What are the actions taken by the IMS Messaging Service when the recipient is unavailable in scenario 6.2.9, IMS Messaging Selects Appropriate Delivery Methods?
question_10255.ground_truth: The IMS Messaging Service automatically stores the message, waiting for Sally to be available, and then delivers the message to Sally when she turns on her phone.

question_10256.question: When is the UE allowed to initiate a PDU session establishment procedure for emergency services?
question_10256.ground_truth: When the timer T3584 is running or the timer is deactivated, the UE is allowed to initiate a PDU session establishment procedure for emergency services.

question_10257.question: How many fallback options can be chosen for a session?
question_10257.ground_truth: There can only be one fallback option for a session.

question_10260.question: Which reference point is used to provide information about a PCRF-controlled bearer for types of IP-CAN where the H-PCRF can be in control of IP-CAN Bearers, such as GPRS?
question_10260.ground_truth: For types of IP-CAN where the H-PCRF can be in control of IP-CAN Bearers, e.g., GPRS, the PCEF provides a new bearer identifier and information about the requested bearer, such as QoS, in step 3 of IP-CAN Session Establishment for H-PCRF.

question_10261.question: What is the name of the enumerated type in the SDAP-Parameters to indicate whether as-ReflectiveQoS is true or not?

question_10262.question: What is the assumed BS transmission power for all results?
question_10262.ground_truth: The assumed BS transmission power is 23dBm.

question_10263.question: Which harmonic frequencies, caused by Band 1 or Band 40, may fall into the BS receive bands of Bands 1, 7, 38, 39, 40, and 41, when carrier aggregation is supported?
question_10263.ground_truth: The 3rd order IMD products caused by BS supporting carrier aggregation of Band 1 and Band 40 may fall into the BS receive bands of Bands 1, 7, 38, 39, 40, and 41.

question_10264.question: What is the format of Procedure Code in E1AP-ELEMENTARY PROCEDURE?
question_10264.ground_truth: Procedure Code in E1AP-ELEMENTARY PROCEDURE is a string of the format id-<ProcedureName>.

question_10266.question: What is the allowable length of USSD strings for Follow Me (FM) registration?
question_10266.ground_truth: The USSD strings for Follow Me (FM) registration should not exceed 30 characters.

question_10267.question: In which operation must at least one valid packet filter be included?
question_10267.ground_truth: When creating a new TFT or modifying an existing TFT, at least one valid packet filter must be included in the procedure. If not, the procedure should fail, and an error code should be returned.

question_10268.question: When must the MS use regular discontinuous reception instead of extended idle mode DRX, even if negotiated earlier?
question_10268.ground_truth: The MS must use regular discontinuous reception when it has PDP context for emergency bearer services, and must not use extended idle mode DRX at any time when PDP context for emergency bearer services is active.

question_10270.question: What is the role of the MCPTT-1 reference point in a MCPTT network?
question_10270.ground_truth: The MCPTT-1 reference point provides MCPTT application signalling for establishing a session in support of MCPTT and uses the SIP-1 and SIP-2 reference points for transport and routing of SIP signalling. It may also use the HTTP-1 and HTTP-2 reference points, and provides location information with respect to multicast service availability for the MCPTT client.

question_10271.question: In the test procedure for "Call Re-establishment/call present, re-establishment not allowed", what state should the mobile station's call control entity be in, after the initial part of procedure 26.9.2 is used?
question_10271.ground_truth: The call control entity of the mobile station is brought to state U4, "call delivered".

question_10273.question: What is the role of the S5/S8 interface between initial DeNB and target DeNB in the mobile relay handover procedure?
question_10273.ground_truth: The S5/S8 interface of the mobile relay is between the initial DeNB and the target DeNB, and it is responsible for the control plane protocol stack between the two networks.

question_10274.question: What should be sent to the MS in step 2 to obtain a fix in the described GNSS test scenario?
question_10274.ground_truth: A RESET MS POSITIONING STORED INFORMATION message followed by RRLP Assistance Data and RRLP Measure Position Request messages containing appropriate assistance data.

question_10275.question: What is the color that represents the parts that are new for the enhanced GAN in the MA-SM terminal architecture for the PS domain?
