question_10594.question: What is the difference between the NEF-edge and NEF-central in the 5G network?
question_10594.ground_truth: The NEF-edge is deployed close to the edge network, while the NEF-central is deployed in the core network. The NEF-edge communicates with the MnS producer to support low latency exposure to the edge network, while the NEF-central handles non-RAN related event exposure.

question_10595.question: What message is sent from the GANC to the MS in GERAN A/Gb mode to GAN mode PS handover to provide it with PS service related information as perceived by the GANC which may result in the MS triggering the PS handover procedure?
question_10595.ground_truth: The GA-PSR UPLINK QUALITY INDICATION message is sent from the GANC to the MS in GERAN A/Gb mode to GAN mode PS handover to provide it with PS service related information as perceived by the GANC which may result in the MS triggering the PS handover procedure.

question_10596.question: What procedure is used to update URSP rules dynamically for EC traffic while some EC traffic is ongoing on a PDU Session?
question_10596.ground_truth: The updated rules might not be enforced by the UE immediately for the ongoing traffic, but they will be applied for any application traffic that will start later. Updating the URSP rules requires SMF notification towards the UE PCF.

question_10597.question: What kind of data is defined in clause 6.1.6.4.4?
question_10597.ground_truth: User data for SMS is defined in clause 6.1.6.4.4.

question_10599.question: What is one potential requirement for the 5G system to support location-based advertising push?
question_10599.ground_truth: One potential requirement for the 5G system to support location-based advertising push is to provide the UE's location information with 3m horizontal position accuracy, 3m vertical position accuracy, over 90% availability, and less than 1min latency.

question_10601.question: What are the two optional transmission systems for the A-Interface User Plane, as defined in 3GPP TS 48.0xx?
question_10601.ground_truth: The two optional transmission systems for the A-Interface User Plane are TDM (using 1 or more 2 048 kbit/s digital transmission system interfaces) and IP (supporting User Plane and/or Control Plane using SIGTRAN).

question_10602.question: What is the role of the NRF in the network?
question_10602.ground_truth: The NRF provides a set of discovered SMF instances or endpoint addresses of SMF service instances in the network in response to a query from the AMF. It also provides an NSI ID for the selected Network Slice instance corresponding to the S-NSSAI for subsequent NRF queries.

question_10603.question: What should a UE do if it is implicitly detached in CS/PS mode 1 or CS/PS mode 2?
question_10603.ground_truth: If a UE is operating in CS/PS mode 1 or CS/PS mode 2 and has been implicitly detached, the UE shall enter the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE. The UE shall delete any mapped EPS security context or partial native EPS security context. If the rejected request was not for initiating a PDN connection for emergency bearer services, the UE shall then perform a new attach procedure.

question_10604.question: Which documents describe the technical realization of supplementary services at the radio interface?
question_10604.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 23.011 and GSM 23.08x and 23.09x-series describe the technical realization of supplementary services at the radio interface.

question_10606.question: What does the UE do to trigger a new initial emergency registration if it obtains a different IP address than the one used for the current emergency registration?
question_10606.ground_truth: The UE triggers a new initial emergency registration by sending an unprotected REGISTER request for new initial emergency registration over the EPS emergency bearers, receiving a 401 response, and sending another REGISTER request to complete the re-authentication and receiving the 200 OK for renewed registration.

question_10607.question: In what scenario would the Chargeable Duration (CDUR) be suspended for an MS originated call?
question_10607.ground_truth: The Chargeable Duration (CDUR) shall be suspended when the MS detects a radio link failure and shall resume when an MM connection has been successfully completed and a TCH has been successfully seized in the appropriate mode, in the case of an MS originated call.

question_10608.question: What is an identifier used to indicate which public/private key pair is used for SUPI protection and de-concealment of the SUCI in 5G systems?

question_10609.question: What are the applicability requirements for UE capable of network-based CRS interference mitigation?
question_10609.ground_truth: The applicability requirements for UE capable of network-based CRS interference mitigation are detailed in section 3.6.1.1 of the specification. They specify the conditions under which UE capable of network-based CRS interference mitigation can assume CRS is transmitted in specific time periods and bandwidths.

question_10611.question: How can the PCF update the RFSP index at the MME in Solution #9?
question_10611.ground_truth: The PCF notifies the updated RFSP index to the UDM/HSS, which sends it to the MME serving the UE in the Location Update Response message during the TAU or attach procedure, which is initiated by the UE after accessing to 4G. Based on the updated RFSP index received from HSS, the MME sets the RFSP index in use for the UE. The RFSP index in use is sent to eNB, which will guide the UE to move from 4G to 5G.

question_10613.question: In the HQ coder, what are the supported modes per bitrate and bandwidth, and how are they transmitted to the decoder?
question_10613.ground_truth: The supported modes per bitrate and bandwidth in the HQ coder are Transient, Normal, and Harmonic. These modes are transmitted to the decoder using one bit for Transient/non-Transient, and one bit for Normal/Harmonic.

question_10614.question: What is the decrease in maximum output power observed from GSM850 to EGSM900?
question_10614.ground_truth: The maximum output power decreases by approximately 1 dB from GSM850 to EGSM900.

question_10615.question: What is the difference between Call Connection Elapsed time limitation (CCEL) and the Mobility Call Origination (MCO) feature in IN CS-3?
question_10615.ground_truth: CCEL allows a calling party to make calls and communicate with one or more parties within a predefined duration time, while MCO covers mobile call origination and UPT call termination, providing a provision of customized authentication of terminal/user for call origination.

question_10616.question: What message is used by the network to pass the result of the location procedure to the MS?
question_10616.ground_truth: A FACILITY message containing a LCS-MOLR return result component is used by the network to pass the result of the location procedure to the MS.

question_10617.question: What should the SL Server UE perform if steps 11 or 12 (and 14 or 15) were performed?
question_10617.ground_truth: The SL Server UE performs the ranging/SL positioning results calculation and sends a SL Positioning/Ranging Service Response to UE1 including the results requested in step 5.

question_10618.question: What is the role of the NAS-SecurityParamFromEUTRA in the mobility from E-UTRA procedure?
question_10618.ground_truth: The NAS-SecurityParamFromEUTRA is a parameter included in the MobilityFromEUTRACommand message and is used to establish security for the NAS in the target RAT.

question_10619.question: What message does the network send to the UE in response to a UE initiated detach procedure, indicating that the UE no longer has access to the EPS?

question_10620.question: What is the meaning of the "a=rtpmap:98" line in the SIP message?
question_10620.ground_truth: The "a=rtpmap:98" line in the SIP message indicates that the RTP media is being transmitted using the H263 codec.

question_10621.question: What is the initial state of the 27.010 entity in terms of data flow?
question_10621.ground_truth: The initial state of the 27.010 entity is with data flow enabled.

question_10625.question: What should the IWU do if it receives a SIP INVITE from the external SIP-I network without the "100Rel" tag?
question_10625.ground_truth: As an option, the IWU may consider the INVITE request as erroneous and reject it with a 421 "Extension Required" response.

question_10626.question: What is one advantage of using MSISDN-less IMS UE addresses when sending SMS?
question_10626.ground_truth: MSISDN-less IMS UE addresses can be used for billing and aligns with current usages of encapsulating sender or receiver's address.

question_10627.question: What addressing mechanism is preferred for future-proof and scalable MTC deployments?
question_10627.ground_truth: IPv6 based addressing for both UEs used for MTC and MTC Servers is considered the primary addressing solution and is preferred.

question_10628.question: In what scenario will the network reply with a MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message with a cause code indicating "activation rejected by GGSN, Serving GW or PDN GW" for a MS initiated PDP context modification procedure for a PDN connection established for emergency bearer services?
question_10628.ground_truth: This would happen when the network receives a MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message from the MS for a PDN connection established for emergency bearer services.

question_10629.question: What should the Node B do when the "Frequency Acquisition" is indicated within the Synchronisation Report Type IE and the frequency locking is performed successfully?
question_10629.ground_truth: The Node B shall start transmitting the indicated cell synchronisation bursts if the frequency locking is performed successfully and "Frequency Acquisition completed" is reported to the RNC.

question_10630.question: What is the impact of user settings on disabling MMI functions in the user equipment (UE)?
question_10630.ground_truth: Users may set the ME to disable some or all of the MMI functions defined in the present document. However, this setting shall only apply when the same SIM/USIM is in use. Otherwise, the ME shall enable the standard MMI.

question_10631.question: What is the range for the CDIV Indication Timer value?
question_10631.ground_truth: The CDIV Indication Timer value ranges from 60 seconds to 0 seconds.

question_10632.question: What is the purpose of the PDN GW in the EMSDP protocol when the UE selects the non-IP PDU data type?
question_10632.ground_truth: The PDN GW encapsulates the non-IP EMSDP payload in PtP (IP and UDP) for the communication with the HSE.

question_10633.question: When does the MC service server send an MBS session announcement?
question_10633.ground_truth: The MC service server may send an MBS session announcement at an earlier step during the MBS session creation procedure towards the MC service clients once the MC group associated to the MBS session is known.

question_10634.question: What are the categories of chargeable events in converged charging?
question_10634.ground_truth: The two categories of chargeable events are immediate report, where current counts are closed and sent to the CHF as soon as the event occurs, and deferred report, where current counts are closed and stored together with charging data to be sent to the CHF in the next Charging Data Request.

question_10635.question: In what scenarios is the SOR-CMCI feature applicable?
question_10635.ground_truth: The SOR-CMCI feature is applicable only when the UE is in automatic network selection mode.

question_10637.question: What is the purpose of the "Timing advance group (TAG)" introduced in Rel-11 for multiple timing advances in LTE?
question_10637.ground_truth: The Timing advance group (TAG) is introduced in Rel-11 for supporting multiple timing advances for some carrier aggregation scenarios. A TAG includes one or more serving cells with the same UL timing advance and the same DL timing reference cell. It is used for supporting up to 2 component carriers for Rel-11, and the initial UL time alignment of sTAG is obtained by an eNB initiated random access procedure similar to pTAG.

question_10638.question: What unit is used for the measurements of "Number of octets of DL LWIPEP PDUs" and "Number of octets of UL LWIPEP PDUs"?

question_10641.question: Which message flow or SIP signalling is not required for the solution #8?
question_10641.ground_truth: No extension on message flow or SIP signalling is required for the solution #8.

question_10642.question: What is the definition of the "management state" in the context of the present document?
question_10642.ground_truth: The management state of a managed object represents the instantaneous condition of availability and operability of the associated resource from the point of view of management. It is expected to be common to a large number of resources and expresses key aspects of their usability at any given time, controlling the general availability of a resource and making visible information about that general availability.

question_10643.question: What parameter should match the "qop" Authorization header field parameter sent by the UE in a "Protected REGISTER" with SIP digest and TLS?

question_10644.question: What is the service flow for unified remote control of intelligent terminals using 5GMSG?
question_10644.ground_truth: Terminal A sends power on/off instructions to other terminals (B, C, D) through a MSG proxy/gateway in the 5G network, which converts different popular device access technologies and protocols into unified MSG service on the northbound side.

question_10645.question: How is the signal classification parameter determined for FEC?
question_10645.ground_truth: The signal classification parameter is determined based on the classification for FEC, using five classes to classify speech signals: UNVOICED, UNVOICED TRANSITION, VOICED TRANSITION, ONSET, and VOICED.

question_10646.question: What action does the MCPTT Server take upon receiving the INVITE message?
question_10646.ground_truth: The MCPTT Server checks whether the user of MCPTT UE1 is authorized for joining the group call identified by Group ID. If successful, an acknowledgement is sent by the hosting MCPTT Server towards MCPTT UE-1.

question_10647.question: What HTTP status code does the UAE-S send to the UAE-C to indicate successful processing of the UAS UE registration update?
question_10647.ground_truth: In the HTTP 200 (OK) response, the UAE-S includes a <result> element set to the value "success" indicating success of the UAS UE registration update.

question_10649.question: How does the 5GMSd AS handle a purge request for media resources?
question_10649.ground_truth: The 5GMSd AS invalidates all media resources in the 5GMSd AS cache matching the regular expression by declaring them as stale. For Push-based ingest, M4d requests for purged content shall be responded to with a 404 (Not Found) HTTP response.

question_10651.question: What is the difference between static and dynamic user plane congestion mitigation policies?
question_10651.ground_truth: Static user plane congestion mitigation policies are provisioned in advance, while dynamic policies can be de/activated dynamically by the PCRF.

question_10652.question: What is the role of the BM-SC in the Gmb interface?
question_10652.ground_truth: The BM-SC functions for different MBMS bearer services may be provided by different physical network elements. To allow this distribution of BM-SC functions, the Gmb protocol must support the use of proxies to correctly route the different signalling interactions in a manner which is transparent to the GGSN.

question_10654.question: What event rate should be achieved in the test for the UE's repeated tests?
question_10654.ground_truth: The rate of correct events observed (UE transmitting uplink signals) during repeated tests must be at least 90%. This ensures the UE adheres to the test requirements consistently.

question_10655.question: What message is sent from the eNB1 to the eNB2 to initiate the Reset procedure?

question_10656.question: What is the purpose of the second part of the administrator determination mechanism in clause~6.13.3.2?
question_10656.ground_truth: The second part of the administrator determination mechanism deals with the case where the MExE-(U)SIM supports third-party certificates and is used to determine whether the user or a third-party is the administrator.

question_10657.question: What is the value of TRRCprocessingDelay in milliseconds?

question_10658.question: What are the initial conditions for the test procedure to verify UE relative code domain power accuracy in clause 5.2C.4.1?
question_10658.ground_truth: The initial conditions for the test procedure include a normal test environment, mid-range frequencies to be tested, connecting the SS (node B emulator) to the UE antenna connector, setting up HSDPA call parameters, and entering the UE into loopback test mode 1 in the presence of HSDPA.

question_10660.question: What should the Node B do if the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message includes the Maximum MAC-d PDU Size Ext IE for a E-DCH Logical Channel in the E-DCH MAC-d Flows Information TDD IE in the E-DCH Information IE?
question_10660.ground_truth: The Node B should ignore the MAC-d PDU Size IE in the MAC-d PDU Size List IE and use Maximum MAC-d PDU Size Ext IE to optimise capacity allocation for the related E-DCH Logical Channel and use the indicated format in user plane frame structure for E-DCH channels and MAC.

question_10662.question: What message does the MME send to the eNodeB during the CS-MT-LR procedure while the UE is in an IMS VoIP session and has provided location update information using the SGs interface?
question_10662.ground_truth: The MME sends an S1-AP Request message to eNodeB that includes the UE Radio Capabilities and a CS Fallback Indicator.

question_10665.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 16.1.2.4?
question_10665.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in 16.1.2.4 is to verify the requirement for the NR - E-UTRA inter-RAT cell reselection to lower priority E-UTRA cell for 2RX RedCap UEs.

question_10668.question: What HTTP method is used by the MnS consumer to acknowledge a single alarm?
question_10668.ground_truth: The MnS consumer uses a HTTP PATCH request to acknowledge a single alarm.

question_10669.question: For a CSI-RS based L1-SINR measurement in FR2, when is a longer measurement period expected and no requirements are defined for UE?
question_10669.ground_truth: When the CSI-RS for L1-SINR measurement is in the same OFDM symbol as another CSI-RS for RLM, BFD, CBD, L1-RSRP or L1-SINR measurement on the same CC or different CCs in the same band.

question_10670.question: What is the role of the Group Call Register (GCR) in the VBS?
question_10670.ground_truth: The Group Call Register (GCR) is a functionality in the network that contains the broadcast call attributes, such as group call area and dispatcher identities.

question_10671.question: What are the actions taken by the MnS producer when the new intent is prioritized over the existing intent?
question_10671.ground_truth: The MnS producer can either terminate or suspend the existing intent and send a notification to the MnS consumer or notify the conflict and ask for approval of termination or suspension.

question_10672.question: What is the format of the discovery group ID, and what will the XDMS return if it is not in the correct format?
question_10672.ground_truth: The discovery group ID shall be 3 octets expressed in hexadecimal format. If not, the XDMS shall return an HTTP "409 Conflict" response, including the <constraint-failure> error element with the "phrase" attribute set to "Invalid Discovery Group ID".

question_10675.question: What should be the duration of the measurement period if the time span of the PRS resource instance is greater than the UE reported capability N?
question_10675.ground_truth: The measurement period can be longer in this case.

question_10676.question: How can the EDGEAPP layer align with the ADAES for allowing the edge services to utilize the ADAES?
question_10676.ground_truth: The EDGEAPP layer needs to align with the ADAES to trigger pro-active analytics for optimizing the edge services operation.

question_10679.question: When should an AF send a Nnef_MBSUserDataIngestSession_Delete request message using the HTTP DELETE method?
question_10679.ground_truth: An AF should send a Nnef_MBSUserDataIngestSession_Delete request message using the HTTP DELETE method when they want to request the deletion of an existing MBS User Data Ingest Session.

question_10681.question: What is the effect of DSR on voice quality with different data loads, based on the simulation results?
question_10681.ground_truth: The simulation results indicate that DSR has a similar impact to voice quality as EDGE at lower data loads, but a smaller impact than EDGE with higher data loads.

question_10682.question: What should the UE do if the whole SDU fits into the remaining resources of the associated MAC entity?
question_10682.ground_truth: The UE should not segment an RLC SDU (or partially transmitted SDU or retransmitted RLC PDU) if the whole SDU fits into the remaining resources of the associated MAC entity.

question_10683.question: What is the reason why serving network authentication was not introduced in UMTS?
question_10683.ground_truth: The main reason is that serving network authentication would have provided limited protection against attacks due to practical difficulties with serving network authorization.

question_10684.question: When is the Extended Quality of Service information element included in the message?
question_10684.ground_truth: The Extended Quality of Service information element is included in the message only if the UE wishes to transmit maximum and guaranteed bit rate values to the network and at least one of the values exceeds the maximum value specified in the EPS quality of service information element.

question_10687.question: What is the function of the "E-TTI" parameter in the UTDOA positioning method?
question_10687.ground_truth: The "E-TTI" parameter in the UTDOA positioning method indicates the Transmission Time Interval for E-DPCH operation.

question_10689.question: What is the role of the AMF in the Area of Interest (AoI) procedure?
question_10689.ground_truth: The AMF reports whether the UE is inside or outside the AoI.

question_10690.question: What is the purpose of the "Not Reachable for NIDD Flag" and where is it conditionally stored?
question_10690.ground_truth: The Not Reachable for NIDD Flag indicates that Non-IP Data has been attempted to be delivered by one or more SCEF(s) to a UE that is temporarily not reachable and that the corresponding SCEF(s) need to be notified when the UE is reachable or about to become reachable. The Not Reachable for NIDD Flag (together with the list of SCEF(s)) is temporary data conditionally stored in the MME.

question_10692.question: What is the purpose of Service Point Triggers (SPTs) in IMS communication service?
question_10692.ground_truth: Service Point Triggers (SPTs) are those points in the SIP signalling on which Filter Criteria can be set. They define specific conditions in the SIP message that can trigger a service or a request to be sent to a specific application server.

question_10693.question: What is the purpose of the Content field in ProSe discovery messages?
question_10693.ground_truth: The Content field in ProSe discovery messages can indicate the ProSe UE Identity or ProSe Group Identity when the Type field is set to 1, the ProSe Application Identity when the Type field is set to 2, or both the ProSe Application Identity and ProSe UE Identity when the Type field is set to 3.

question_10694.question: What is the performance of the speech users when mapped to the different strength bits in the modulation constellation?
question_10694.ground_truth: By simple mapping, it is possible to support speech users in conditions that are only 6 dB worse than legacy speech channels, as it is possible to support 3 and 4 users in such conditions with minor modifications.

question_10696.question: What condition must be met for the network to include the T3447 value IE in its message?
question_10696.ground_truth: The UE has indicated support for service gap control in the ATTACH REQUEST message, and the EMM context contains a service gap time value.

question_10697.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals?
question_10697.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals specifies the technical details for the core network and terminals used in 3GPP mobile networks.

question_10698.question: What is the benefit of EMSE and EMKS in the PLMN security solution being functional entities that can be implemented stand-alone or combined with other entities?
question_10698.ground_truth: This allows for flexibility in implementation, reducing the need for operators to upgrade their core networks in order to support PLMN security.

question_10699.question: What should the BBF do during PCC/QoS rules enforcement if packet filters are provided to the UE?
question_10699.ground_truth: The BBF should provide packet filters with the same content as that in the SDF template filters received over the Gx/Gxx interface from the PCRF within the Flow-Description or the Flow-Information AVP.

question_10701.question: What is the role of the SEALDD server in handling application traffic from the VAL client?
question_10701.ground_truth: The SEALDD server maps the SEALDD traffic to the application traffic and sends it to the address provided by the VAL server via an established connection.

question_10702.question: What is the correct HTTP method to update the whole data record?
question_10702.ground_truth: HTTP PUT method shall be used to replace a complete data record.

question_10703.question: What is required to effectively control the signalling traffic to prevent severe overload and potential breakdown of the GTP-C node?
question_10703.ground_truth: Node level overload control, which involves advertising of the overload information at a node level, and applying the mitigation policies towards the target node, can be used to effectively control the signalling traffic.

question_10705.question: What are the two options for the SMF to restore the Multicast MBS session after an NG-RAN failure?
question_10705.ground_truth: The two options are: (8a) waiting for UEs to trigger a Service Request procedure to re-establish the user plane resource and then restore the Multicast MBS session in NG-RAN, or (8b) deriving UEs who have joined the MBS session(s) affected by the NG-RAN failure and initiate the restoration procedure for each Multicast MBS session.

question_10706.question: What should an HTTP client do if it receives an error response with the 3gpp-Sbi-Response-Info header including the "no-retry" parameter set to "true"?
question_10706.ground_truth: The HTTP client should consider that the request cannot be served anywhere and should not retry the request at the original HTTP server instance or at any other alternative HTTP server instance.

question_10710.question: In the "tEmergencyEventType" complex type, what is the maximum occurrence of the "GroupCallEmergency" element?
question_10710.ground_truth: There is no maximum occurrence specified, so it can appear any number of times, including zero times (minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded").

question_10711.question: When can the South Koreancarrier's spectrum be used for PC5?
question_10711.ground_truth: The South Korean carriers' licensed spectrum can be used for PC5 in V2X service.

question_10714.question: What is the difference between P.NATS Modes 0, 1, and 3?
question_10714.ground_truth: P.NATS Mode 0 estimates quality based on audio and video codecs and bitrates, requiring very low processing power. Mode 1 adds GOP structure and frame sizes, providing better video quality estimation over Mode 0, and also requiring low processing power. Mode 3 takes the bitstream itself into account, providing a more significant estimation of video coding quality, but requiring more processing power and an unencrypted bitstream.

question_10716.question: What is the approach to multiplexing RLC services in the testing architecture?
question_10716.ground_truth: For the RRC and NAS testing, the TTCN RRC test steps and emulators share the same service access point (AM SAP) and provide separate message queues for the TTCN RRC test steps and the RRC emulator for the TTCN NAS test cases.

question_10719.question: What is the purpose of step 4 in the procedure for DSMIPV6 on S2c when accessing a trusted Fixed Broadband Access for EPC-routed Traffic?
question_10719.ground_truth: In step 4, the PCEF acknowledges the provisioning of PCC Rules in the PCEF.

question_10720.question: In which RFC is the SigComp state memory size requirement of at least 4096 bytes specified?
question_10720.ground_truth: The required SigComp state memory size of at least 4096 bytes is specified in RFC 5049.

question_10722.question: What features for machine type communication should be supported for maritime communication services?
question_10722.ground_truth: Features for machine type communication include eMTC and NB-IoT features as specified in 3GPP specifications including 5G from Release 13 onwards.

question_10723.question: When does the SS activate the secondary cell (SCC) by sending the activation MAC-CE, as specified in step 5?
question_10723.ground_truth: The SS activates the SCC by sending the activation MAC-CE in a subframe # denoted m, where m is 4 or 9.

question_10725.question: What is the data type for the "ExpectationTarget" specializations?
question_10725.ground_truth: The data type for the "ExpectationTarget" specializations is an object that contains the properties "targetName", "targetCondition", "targetValueRange", and "targetContexts".

question_10726.question: What is the role of the ID and criticality fields in the protocol's mechanism for forwards and backwards compatibility?
question_10726.ground_truth: The ID and criticality fields are used to ensure that all current and future messages, IEs, or groups of related IEs can always be decoded, regardless of the standard version.

question_10727.question: What is the condition for the UE to send aperiodic L1-RSRP measurement reports?
question_10727.ground_truth: The UE will only send aperiodic L1-RSRP measurement reports if a DCI trigger has been received.

question_10728.question: What is the format of maxCallPeriodDuration in the CAMEL-AChBillingChargingCharacteristics choice?
question_10728.ground_truth: It is an integer with a range of 1 to 864000, measured in 100 millisecond units.

question_10729.question: What is the function of the SGSN in providing the MS radio access capability to the BSS?
question_10729.ground_truth: The SGSN provides the MS radio access capability as an information element on the Gb interface and is responsible for providing the BSS with the most recent MS radio access capability received from the MS.

question_10732.question: What is the entering condition for Event A2, indicating that the serving cell becomes worse than a certain threshold?
question_10732.ground_truth: The entering condition for Event A2 is defined by the inequality Ms + Hys < Thresh, where Ms is the measurement result of the serving cell, Hys is the hysteresis parameter, and Thresh is the threshold parameter.

question_10733.question: What are the requirements of the edge enabling application architecture, related to the Edge Enabler Client registration?
question_10733.ground_truth: The requirements of the edge enabling application architecture related to the Edge Enabler Client registration are mechanisms for a UE to register and de-register from the Edge Enabler Server, mechanisms for the Edge Enabler Server to detect an abnormal termination of a UE registration, and mechanisms to notify a UE about relevant changes in availability of the Edge Application Servers.

question_10734.question: What is the purpose of the SS commanding the MS into Radio Block Loopback Sub-mode: ON in this procedure?
question_10734.ground_truth: The purpose is to raise the level of the unwanted signal until the BER of the looped back data is between 8.3% and 12%.

question_10735.question: What does the acronym UE in UEContextSetupResponse refers to?

question_10736.question: What is the minimum number of consecutive active frames required for the hangover logic to start adding the hangover in the final decision for WB signals?
question_10736.ground_truth: The hangover logic starts adding the hangover after at least three consecutive active frames for WB signals.

question_10737.question: What is the role of grid points in the virtual cell approach for the 5G satellite network?
question_10737.ground_truth: In the virtual cell approach, the coverage area is divided into virtual cells with well-defined geographic boundaries, defined by an array of grid points. A serving cell for any UE is defined by the cell associated with the grid point which is closest to the current UE location.

question_10738.question: What is the effect of the "UNLOCKED" and "LOCKED" administrative state on a PerfMetricJob instance?
question_10738.ground_truth: When the administrative state is set to "UNLOCKED" after the creation of a PerfMetricJob, the first granularity period starts. When it is set to "LOCKED" or the operational state to "DISABLED," the ongoing reporting period is aborted, and a new reporting period starts in case of streaming after the administrative state is set back to "UNLOCKED" or the operational state to "ENABLED."

question_10739.question: In the document, what does the acronym FDD stand for?

question_10740.question: What is the conformance requirement specified in 12.12.2 for MO MTSI Voice Call Successful with preconditions at both originating UE and terminating UE?
question_10740.ground_truth: The UE shall follow the procedures in TS 24.229, clause 5.1.2A.1, for sending requests using a given contact address and including security mechanism-specific information.

question_10741.question: What is the purpose of the coastal and local warning service described in the use case?
question_10741.ground_truth: The purpose is to provide navigational warning, meteorological information and other urgent safety-related information to vessels, which they can automatically monitor and display for safe navigation.

question_10742.question: What should the network do when it receives an ACTIVATE SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message specifying a transaction identifier which is not recognized as relating to a PDP context that is in the process of activation and with a transaction identifier flag set to "1"?
question_10742.ground_truth: The network should ignore the message.

question_10743.question: What are the four network scenarios considered in the analysis?
question_10743.ground_truth: The four network scenarios considered are: Scenario A - 4/12 BCCH from WIDER-1, Scenario B - 1/1 TCH from WIDER-1, Scenario C - 3/9 TCH from WIDER-2, and Scenario D - 4/12 BCCH+3/9 TCH from WIDER-3.

question_10745.question: What are the units for the parameters fz,n and fp,m in the multi-pole/zero model (Eq. 4.2.3.2-1) for phase noise profile parameterization?
question_10745.ground_truth: The parameters fz,n and fp,m are in the unit of frequency offset (f0) in Eq. 4.2.3.2-1.

question_10746.question: What should the MS do if it receives the ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message from a PLMN that is not in the list of "equivalent PLMNs"?
question_10746.ground_truth: Remove any PLMN code that is already in the "forbidden PLMN" list, and add to the stored list the PLMN code of the registered PLMN that sent the list.

question_10747.question: What does the term "UE" stand for in the document title?

question_10748.question: What is the purpose of the group call announcement message in the MCPTT system?
question_10748.ground_truth: The group call announcement message includes parameters for media delivery and indicates the start of a group call. It is used to convey information about the group call, such as the MCPTT group ID, group call originator identity, media type, and the port number for media and floor control protocol.

question_10749.question: What is the purpose of the Asserted-Identity header field in the context of subclause 6.2.1.1.3?
question_10749.ground_truth: The Asserted-Identity header field can be used by the NGCN site to provide a P-Asserted-Identity or P-Preferred-Identity. The NGN will use a provided PAI or PPI if it matches one of the registered public user identities.

question_10754.question: Which band has a 1MHz overlap with band 71 Tx in case where the lowest edge of band 71 paired with simultaneous downlink in the uppermost edge of band 2 is utilized?

question_10755.question: What should a UE do if it detects a change of BSIC for a GSM BCCH carrier?
question_10755.ground_truth: The GSM BCCH carrier shall be treated as a new GSM neighbour cell.

question_10756.question: Which element in the "ShapeType" complex type contains a list of "Polygon" or "CircularArea"?
question_10756.ground_truth: The element "PolygonList" or "CircularAreaList" contains a list of "Polygon" or "CircularArea" respectively.

question_10757.question: What should the Node B do if the TSN-Length IE is included in the HS-DSCH TDD Information IE in a 1.28Mcps TDD system?
question_10757.ground_truth: The Node B should use the TSN bits applied to the MAC-hs PDU frame as indicated by the TSN-Length IE.

question_10759.question: What are some of the potential issues that can arise with regulatory requirements for PWS in extraterritorial areas, such as maritime or aeronautical regions?
question_10759.ground_truth: Some potential issues include uncertainty about which regulatory requirements apply, such as whether PWS should be supported and which regional versions of PWS must be supported. There may also be issues with coordinating Warning Notifications in these areas, as there may not be a clear organization responsible for this task.

question_10760.question: What is the method of measuring the BLER (Block Error Rate) for HS-PDSCH received from the UE at the SS?
question_10760.ground_truth: The BLER of HS-PDSCH is measured by counting the number of NACK, ACK, and statDTX on the UL HS-DPCCH, where BLER = (NACK + statDTX)/(NACK + statDTX + ACK).

question_10764.question: What are the different MS operation modes for mobile stations supporting General Packet Radio Service in GSM (A/Gb mode only)?
question_10764.ground_truth: The different MS operation modes are MS operation mode A, MS operation mode B, and MS operation mode C.

question_10765.question: What should the SMF do if seamless Edge relocation is needed and a dedicated QoS Flow needs to be bound to the application flow?
question_10765.ground_truth: The SMF should bind the application flow to a dedicated QoS Flow and make sure to include the 'seamless Edge relocation' indication in the PCC rule.

question_10766.question: What is the purpose of the PRUK (ProSe Remote User Key) Request message and Key Request message in Solution #18?
question_10766.ground_truth: The PRUK Request message is sent by the remote UE to the PKMF of the UE-to-network relay to receive UE-to-network relay service and the key request message is sent by the UE-to-network relay to the PKMF to request KNRP freshness parameter 2 and the encrypted key for the secure communication with the remote UE.

question_10767.question: What is the purpose of the authenticated payloads in SDS messages?
question_10767.ground_truth: The authenticated payloads are used to ensure the integrity and authenticity of the MCData payload in SDS messages.

question_10770.question: What should the UE do if the authentication verification fails during an AKA run while a PDN connection for emergency bearer services exists?
question_10770.ground_truth: Upon authentication verification failure in the UE, the UE shall send an Authentication Failure message to the MME. The UE shall continue using the current EPS security context. If the UE receives a NAS security mode command selecting NULL integrity and ciphering algorithms, the UE shall accept this as long as the IMS Emergency session progresses.

question_10772.question: What is the maximum measurement reporting delay for a UE to report Event A3 for cells 2, 3, and 4?
question_10772.ground_truth: The maximum measurement reporting delay for a UE to report Event A3 for cells 2, 3, and 4 is 153.6s.

question_10773.question: Which entity transfers MAC-c PDU to the peer MAC-c entity in the UE using the services of the FACH Frame Protocol (FACH FP) entity?
question_10773.ground_truth: The Common MAC (MAC-c/sh/m) entity in the RNC

question_10776.question: What does the OIR service restrict for the originating user?
question_10776.ground_truth: The OIR service restricts presentation of the originating user's identity information to the terminating user.

question_10777.question: How are the Measurement types and families in UMTS and LTE networks administered?
question_10777.ground_truth: In UMTS and LTE networks, Measurement types and families may be administered per individual measurement type or per measurement family, which comprises a collection of related measurement types. The measurement types and families for UMTS and combined GSM/UMTS networks are specified in TS 32.405, TS 32.406, TS 32.407, TS 32.408 and TS 32.409, for IMS in TS 32.409, for E-UTRAN in TS 32.425, for EPC in TS 32.426, for Home Node B (HNB) Subsystem (HNS) in TS 32.452, and for Home enhanced Node B (HeNB) Subsystem (HeNS) in TS.32.453.

question_10779.question: When is the UE allowed to perform SRS carrier based switching if the above conditions cannot be met?
question_10779.ground_truth: The UE is not allowed to perform SRS carrier based switching if the above conditions cannot be met.

question_10780.question: What is the purpose of the BBF AAA proxy in the 3GPP UE support?
question_10780.ground_truth: The BBF AAA proxy is deployed as part of the BBF network to provide support for 3GPP UE. If the BBF AAA proxy is not present, the SWa reference point is terminated on the BNG.

question_10782.question: When would the target UE send a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message containing PC5 signalling protocol cause value #111 "protocol error, unspecified"?
question_10782.ground_truth: If the 5G ProSe direct link establishment request is for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relaying, and the PDU session for relaying the service is an LADN PDU session, and the target UE is outside the LADN service area.

question_10783.question: What is the difference between inviting a user to a conference by sending a REFER request to the user or to the conference focus?
question_10783.ground_truth: Inviting a user to a conference by sending a REFER request to the user is done through a direct request, while inviting a user to a conference by sending a REFER request to the conference focus is done through a third party, with the conference focus acting as an intermediary.

question_10784.question: What is a possible approach to synthesizing multiple interfering signals in real-time for SAIC terminal assessment?
question_10784.ground_truth: A possible approach involves using a general-purpose streaming signal source to generate multiple interfering signals that are agile in terms of embedded training sequence, delay, and frequency offset.

question_10786.question: What is the role of the ASP interface in the SS through a PCO in type of SatS PCO?
question_10786.ground_truth: The ASP interface in the SS through a PCO in type of SatS PCO is used to load a pre-defined test scenario into the satellite simulator, start or stop generating and broadcasting satellite signals from the satellite simulator, and retrieve the GPS assistance data from an assistance data source.

question_10787.question: What must the MCVideo client include in the Supported header field as specified in step 22.2.2.2.1?
question_10787.ground_truth: The MCVideo client shall include the option tag "multiple-refer" in the Supported header field.

question_10789.question: What should the LMA do when it receives a PBU message during the Initial MAG Initiated PDN Connection Deletion procedure as per the PMIPv6 and IPv4 support specifications?
question_10789.ground_truth: The LMA should initiate the "Binding De-Registration" procedure while parameters in the PBA are set as specified by the PBA parameters section for this procedure.

question_10790.question: What is the action required of the UE when High-mobility state is detected, as per TS 38.304, clause 5.2.4.3.1?
question_10790.ground_truth: If High-mobility state is detected, the UE needs to add the sf-High of "Speed dependent ScalingFactor for Qhyst" to Qhyst and multiply TreselectionNR by the sf-High of "Speed dependent ScalingFactor for TreselectionNR" if broadcasted in system information.

question_10791.question: What shall the AMF do if the UE initiates the registration procedure for disaster roaming services and the AMF determines that it does not support providing disaster roaming services for the determined PLMN with disaster condition?
question_10791.ground_truth: The AMF shall send a REGISTRATION REJECT message with 5GMM cause #80 "Disaster roaming for the determined PLMN with disaster condition not allowed" if the UE initiates the registration procedure for disaster roaming services and the AMF determines that it does not support providing disaster roaming services for the determined PLMN with disaster condition.

question_10792.question: What should the network do if an ATTACH REQUEST message contains the Old GUTI type IE and the EPS mobile identity IE with type of identity indicating "GUTI"?
question_10792.ground_truth: If the network receives an ATTACH REQUEST message containing the Old GUTI type IE and the EPS mobile identity IE with type of identity indicating "GUTI", the network must use the Old GUTI type IE to determine whether the mobile identity included in the EPS mobile identity IE is a native GUTI or a mapped GUTI.

question_10793.question: How often might the technical specification be updated or revised?
question_10793.ground_truth: The specification may be updated or revised with an increment of the second or third digit depending on the nature of the changes (technical or editorial).

question_10794.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 14.2.10a.3?
question_10794.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the MS meets the reference sensitivity performance for TCH AFS/FER and TCH/AFS class Ib RBER under specific propagation conditions.

question_10796.question: What is the definition of "credit control" in the context of 3GPP TSs?
question_10796.ground_truth: Credit control is a mechanism that interacts with a user's account and controls or monitors the charges related to the service usage. It involves checking if credit is available, reserving credit, deducting credit from the user's account when service is completed, and refunding reserved credit not used.

question_10797.question: What is one of the potential performance degradations caused by reducing supported downlink transmission modes for MTC UEs?
question_10797.ground_truth: There may be some downlink performance degradation due to the lack of precoding gain.

question_10800.question: What is the problem identified with CELL_FACH mobility support for CSG-capable UEs?
question_10800.ground_truth: The problem identified is that in CELL_FACH, a CSG-capable UE may not be able to detect CSG cells outside of the Neighbour Cell List (NCL) or apply appropriate search criteria for reselection.

question_10802.question: What is the function of the integrity algorithm when used for authentication and integrity protection of messages?
question_10802.ground_truth: The integrity algorithm computes a message authentication code (MAC) for the sender, which is appended to the message when sent. The receiver computes the expected message authentication code (XMAC) and verifies the data integrity by comparing it to the received message authentication code.

question_10805.question: How can a TP UE start presentations during an ongoing IM session supporting telepresence?
question_10805.ground_truth: To start presentations during an ongoing IM session supporting telepresence, a TP UE constructs media captures for presentation in a CLUE message and proceeds the exchange. Optionally, floor control can be achieved using BFCP (Binary Floor Control Protocol) to offer control of shared presentation resources. The TP UE and MRFP (Multimedia Resource Function Processor) shall support the roles for floor control and their general operations as specified in 3GPP TS 24.147.

question_10806.question: What is the function of the Local IP Access and SIPTO at the Local Network with L-GW function collocated with the HeNB?
question_10806.ground_truth: The Local IP Access and SIPTO at the Local Network with L-GW function collocated with the HeNB is achieved using a Local GW (L-GW) collocated with the HeNB to provide local IP access and SIPTO at the Local Network for the HeNB subsystem. The L-GW has a S5 interface with the S-GW to support this function.

question_10807.question: What are the EVM Equalizer Spectrum Flatness requirements per layer in a closed-loop spatial multiplexing scheme with two or four transmit antenna connectors?
question_10807.ground_truth: The EVM Equalizer Spectrum Flatness requirements specified in clause 6.4.2.4 apply per layer.

question_10808.question: What is the test signal level for the British-English single talk sequence described in ITU-T Recommendation P.501?
question_10808.ground_truth: The test signal level is -16 dBm0.

question_10811.question: What must the UE do when receiving a RRC message implying conditional handover in NR?
question_10811.ground_truth: The UE must be ready to start the transmission of the new uplink PRACH channel within Dhandover seconds from the end of the last TTI containing the RRC command.

question_10813.question: What message is sent by the WT to indicate that the requested measurement is successfully initiated?

question_10814.question: What is the unit of measurement for the "Mean processor usage" in the equipment-related measurements?
question_10814.ground_truth: The unit of measurement for the "Mean processor usage" in the equipment-related measurements is %.

question_10815.question: What information is required to be shared between co-located NodeBs for mitigating the CQI mismatch issue?
question_10815.ground_truth: The proposal requires communication between co-located NodeBs for sharing scheduling information regarding the interference type of the interferer, which may be required per TTI due to the dynamic nature of the interferer.

question_10816.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project Technical Specification Group's work on Lawful Interception (LI) architecture and functions in Release 18?
question_10816.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group produced the present document to standardize Lawful Interception of telecommunications and specify the architecture and functions required to support LI in 3GPP networks, in accordance with applicable national or regional laws and technical regulations.

question_10817.question: What procedures need to be followed when adding a second access to a PDN connection?
question_10817.ground_truth: The UE sends a PDN connection request message to the network which includes a requested APN and an NBIFOM indication, and then the UE and PGW negotiate an IFOM operating mode during the IFMP session setup.

question_10818.question: In what situation should a UE delete 5G-GUTI, TAI list, list of equivalent PLMNs, ngKSI, and set 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED after a de-registration request?
question_10818.ground_truth: If the de-registration type is "re-registration not required" and the 5GMM cause indicators abnormal cases or no 5GMM cause IE is included.

question_10821.question: What is the difference between the test requirement principle between MSR single-RAT and multi-RAT requirements?
question_10821.ground_truth: The principle used to define the test requirement for MSR single-RAT requirements remains from the existing specifications, while the minimum requirements developed in the present Technical Report for MSR multi-RAT requirements make no allowance for measurement uncertainty. The measurement results are compared against the Test Requirements as defined by the shared risk principle for both MSR single-RAT and multi-RAT requirements.

question_10822.question: What is the maximum C/I ratio at which the AMR codec outperforms the GSM FR codec in all conditions?
question_10822.ground_truth: The AMR codec outperforms the GSM FR codec down to 13 dB C/I in error-free conditions and down to 7 dB C/I in other cases.

question_10823.question: What procedure does the Trusted Non-3GPP Access follow for PMIPv6 MAG Initiated PDN Connection Deletion in each PDN connection of the UE?
question_10823.ground_truth: In PMIPv6 mode, the Trusted Non-3GPP Access follows the MAG procedure for the PMIPv6 MAG Initiated PDN Connection Deletion as outlined in subclause 5.4.2 for each PDN connection of the UE.

question_10828.question: What is the capacity performance for FR2, Indoor Hotspot DL, with 400MHz bandwidth for VR/AR single-stream traffic model, SU-MIMO, 10ms PDB, 60 FPS, 45Mbps, Option 1 UE Antenna parameters: (M, N, P) = (1, 4, 2), 3 panels (left, right, top)?
question_10828.ground_truth: The capacity performance is 27 UEs per cell.

question_10829.question: What is the purpose of the Network Instance attribute in the 5G VN group in the PLMN when more than one 5G VN group is supported?
question_10829.ground_truth: The Network Instance attribute is used to keep the traffic of different 5G VN groups separate from each other during the packet detection and forwarding process, enabling isolation of the 5G VN group communication.

question_10830.question: What is the memory type used to store a list of "Cells-to-be-Activated-List-ItemIEs" in the "GNB-DU-Served-Cells-List" field?
question_10830.ground_truth: It is a SEQUENCE (SIZE(1.. maxCellingNBDU)) OF ProtocolIE-SingleContainer, which is used to store a list of "Cells-to-be-Activated-List-ItemIEs" for each cell of the GNB-DU served cell list.

question_10831.question: What information must be registered in the network for CFNRy?
question_10831.ground_truth: The ForwardedToNumber, which may be accompanied by a ForwardedToSubAddress, information as to whether all calls or all calls of a specific basic service should be forwarded, and the duration of the no reply condition timer.

question_10832.question: When can the 3gpp-Sbi-Target-apiRoot header be used in a request between SEPPs?

question_10834.question: What is the length of the Macro eNodeB ID in bits?
question_10834.ground_truth: The Macro eNodeB ID consists of 20 bits.

question_10835.question: What should the UE do if it receives the ESM cause value #50 or #51 and the selected PDN type is different from the one allowed by the network?
question_10835.ground_truth: The UE should not send another PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message to the same APN (or no APN) to obtain a PDN type different from the one allowed by the network until the UE is registered to a new PLMN, switched off, or the USIM is removed.

question_10836.question: What is Z in the calculation of TdormantBWPswitchDelay, and how is it determined?
question_10836.ground_truth: Z is the length of one slot, corresponding to the SCS of the serving cell where UE receives dormancy indication. It is determined by the SCS of the serving cell at the time the UE receives the dormancy indication.

question_10837.question: What is the function of the local quota in the primary PCF?
question_10837.ground_truth: The primary PCF provides local slice SLA information including local quotas of the maximum number of allowed UEs per S-NSSAI to its secondary PCF instances, keeps a shared quota of the maximum number of allowed UEs per S-NSSAI, and decides the acceptance or rejection of the UE registration request for a specific S-NSSAI based on the sum of the local quotas to the associated secondary PCF instances of S-NSSAI, which shall be less or equal to the network slice related global quota of the maximum number of UEs per S-NSSAI.

question_10838.question: What is the transmission power of a PRACH transmission in Dual Connectivity Mode 2?
question_10838.ground_truth: If a UE has a PRACH transmission for CG1 overlapping with subframe i of CG1, the transmission power of that PRACH transmission is denoted by PPRACH, cg1, i. Otherwise, the transmission power is zero. Similarly, for CG2, the transmission power of the PRACH is denoted by PPRACH, cg2, i if there is a PRACH transmission for CG2 in subframe i of CG2, and zero otherwise.

question_10839.question: What is the function of the "Call waiting" supplementary service?
question_10839.ground_truth: The "Call waiting" supplementary service is a feature that allows a user to be notified of a second incoming call while they are already engaged in a call.

question_10841.question: What is the format of the technical report?
question_10841.ground_truth: The technical report is divided into several clauses, annexes, and a foreword. It provides information on the scope and abbreviations, a general overview of the project, history and selection process of the codec, performance requirements, and the results of the subjective listening tests and verification phase of testing. Additionally, the annexes contain detailed information about the AMR-WB selection phase and floating-point verification phase.

question_10843.question: What is the maximum end-to-end latency allowed for a 5G system providing service with GEO based satellite access?

question_10844.question: What is the role of MCEG in controlling access for 3GPP management system components?
question_10844.ground_truth: MCEG provides exposure governance on MnS components A, B, C in the 3GPP management system.

question_10845.question: Which message is used in the Handover Required Indication procedure to request the handover for a particular MS by the BSS?

question_10846.question: When will the UE remove an SNPN identity from the list of equivalent SNPNs?
question_10846.ground_truth: The UE will remove an SNPN identity from the list of equivalent SNPNs if it is present in the "permanently forbidden SNPNs" list or the "temporarily forbidden SNPNs" list, or if there is no emergency PDU session established and the UE is not registered for onboarding services in SNPN.

question_10847.question: What is the purpose of feature negotiation in the context of these APIs, as specified in clause 6.8?
question_10847.ground_truth: Feature negotiation is used to determine which optional features are supported by the API and should be used during API invocations.

question_10848.question: What should be the Request-URI set to in the HTTP POST request, when the VAE-S wants to obtain the consent from a user to update group information?
question_10848.ground_truth: The Request-URI should be set to the URI corresponding to the identity of the VAE-C.

question_10849.question: What is the main purpose of the test in 26.6.5.2.2?
question_10849.ground_truth: The main purpose of the test in 26.6.5.2.2 is to test that when the MS is ordered to make a non-synchronized handover, it continuously sends access bursts on the main DCCH (and optionally the SACCH) until it receives a PHYSICAL INFORMATION message from the SS.

question_10850.question: What is the expected action by the MS when it receives the EAP Success message from the EAP-SIM authentication procedure?
question_10850.ground_truth: After the MS receives the EAP Success message from the EAP-SIM authentication procedure, the MS and GANC-SEGW complete the setup of the SA.

question_10851.question: What are the conformance requirements for an MS in MM state "idle, updated" and in RR idle mode, when made to initiate a call for a selected teleservice that is supported by the MS?
question_10851.ground_truth: The MS shall provide a human interface and display the dialled number. It shall also start to initiate the immediate assignment procedure by sending a CHANNEL REQUEST message with correct establishment cause and send a CLASSMARK CHANGE message in the uplink block followed directly after the Layer 2 UA message sent from the network. The CLASSMARK CHANGE message shall contain information elements Mobile Station Classmark 2 and Mobile Station Classmark 3. Subsequently, after establishment of an MM connection, the MS shall send a SETUP message with correct parameters. Upon the receipt of a CONNECT message, the MS shall attach the user connection to the radio path and return a CONNECT ACKNOWLEDGE message. Upon the network initiating call clearing by sending a DISCONNECT message, the MS shall proceed to release the call. On receipt of a CHANNEL RELEASE message, the MS shall disconnect the main signalling link.

question_10852.question: What is the data type of the 3GPP-IPv6-DNS-Servers sub-attribute?
question_10852.ground_truth: The 3GPP-IPv6-DNS-Servers sub-attribute is of Octet String type.

question_10853.question: In the context of 6a.9.2.1, what happens after UE-2 sends a request to UE-1 to transfer Media-B from UE-1 to UE-2?
question_10853.ground_truth: A Collaborative Session is established, in which UE-1 is Controller UE and UE-2 is Controllee UE.

question_10854.question: What is the (E/5G)SM cause for the data connection drop event?

question_10855.question: What is the potential service requirement in the 3GPP system to support timely, efficient, reliable, and secure transmission of information to multiple UEs?
question_10855.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall support a timely, efficient, reliable and secure mechanism to transmit the same information to multiple UEs which only support 3GPP device-to-device communication.

question_10856.question: How does the performance of AMR-WB compare to AMR 12.2 kbit/s mode for narrowband speech at a bit-rate of 12.65 kbit/s or higher?
question_10856.ground_truth: AMR-WB offers similar performance as AMR 12.2 kbit/s mode for narrowband speech when the bit-rate of the AMR-WB is 12.65 kbit/s or higher.

question_10859.question: What does the UE do upon expiry of the periodical reporting timer for a measId?
question_10859.ground_truth: The UE initiates the measurement reporting procedure, as specified in 5.5.5.

question_10860.question: What is the purpose of the KME_Check parameter in the network authentication and key agreement process?
question_10860.ground_truth: The KME_Check parameter is used in the authentication process to verify the integrity of the KME stored in the UE by the HSS/HLR. This ensures that both the UE and the HSS/HLR have the same KME stored in their systems.

question_10861.question: What is the primary feature of the architecture for ProSe one-to-many communications in Ad-Hoc mode?
question_10861.ground_truth: The primary feature of the architecture for ProSe one-to-many communications in Ad-Hoc mode is that it is entirely distributed with no single point of failure.

question_10863.question: What is the purpose of using a similar quantization range for TBE gain frame in Unvoiced coding mode as that of the primary frame?
question_10863.ground_truth: The purpose is to preserve the dynamic range of the amplitude (TBE gain frame) in Unvoiced coding mode.

question_10864.question: What are the interface protocols that need to be tested for interoperability in a 3GPP TMN system?
question_10864.ground_truth: Interoperability testing in a 3GPP TMN system includes testing of the interface protocols, the shared/exposed information over those interfaces, and the interface functionality of the system to ensure that different implementations can interwork.

question_10865.question: In the IETF model for Presence Information, what is the term for the server that stores and distributes presence information?
question_10865.ground_truth: The term for the server that stores and distributes presence information is the Presence Service.

question_10866.question: What type of information is included in the ENC service that is accessible to the pilotage service?
question_10866.ground_truth: The ENC service includes the latest information about a port or sea area, such as the depth of water, buoys, navigational route, and berth information, which is useful for shipboard users such as pilots and shipmasters when maneuvering vessels through pilotage areas.

question_10867.question: What is the purpose of the "id-TransactionID" field in the IAB-Donor-CU-UPPSKInfo sequence?
question_10867.ground_truth: The "id-TransactionID" field in the IAB-Donor-CU-UPPSKInfo sequence is used to identify a specific transaction.

question_10868.question: What is the name of the data container that holds the info about the UE's context in UEContextSetupResponse?

question_10869.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function do upon receiving a SIP BYE request containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body?
question_10869.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should copy the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body into the outgoing SIP BYE request, perform the procedures as specified in the clause 6.3.3.1.4, and stop timer TNG1 (acknowledged call setup timer) if the local counter of the number of SIP 200 (OK) responses received from invited members is greater than or equal to the value of the <on-network-minimum-number-to-start> element of the group document.

question_10870.question: What is one of the capabilities of the 5GMSG Gateway model?
question_10870.ground_truth: It can convert 5G messages and interoperate with terminals using different protocols in the M2M network.

question_10871.question: What is the format of the MIB-SB-SIB-InformationItem-SystemInfoUpdateRqst in the MIB-SB-SIB-InformationList-SystemInfoUpdateRqst?
question_10871.ground_truth: The MIB-SB-SIB-InformationItem-SystemInfoUpdateRqst is a sequence that contains several parameters including iB-Type, iB-OC-ID, deletionIndicator, iE-Extensions (optional), and a few other optional parameters.

question_10872.question: What is the short message compression algorithm described in 3GPP TS 23.042?
question_10872.ground_truth: The algorithm describes a method for compressing short message data for transmission over the radio interface. Compression applies only to the TP-User-Data part of the TPDU and excludes any TP-User-Data-Header, and theCompression Header must commence at the first octet of the TP-User-Data field immediately following any TP-User-Data-Header field which may be present.

question_10874.question: What is one specific aspect to be considered for XR and Cloud Gaming?
question_10874.ground_truth: One specific aspect to be considered is the role of Edge Computing as a network architecture to enable XR and Cloud Gaming.

question_10878.question: What is the difference between Tethered Standalone AR Glasses and Display AR Glasses?
question_10878.ground_truth: Tethered Standalone AR Glasses run an XR application that uses the capabilities of the Glasses to create a service and are tethered to a 5G device, while Display AR Glasses are tethered to a 5G device that includes the application and the XR functions and run the AR/MR experience. The XR runtime API is exposed to the 5G device/phone in Display AR Glasses.

question_10880.question: What is the condition for the path loss criterion C1 for current serving cell falling below zero for a period of 5 seconds in 3GPP TS 05.08 subclause 6.6.2?
question_10880.ground_truth: The path loss to the cell has become too high if the path loss criterion C1 for current serving cell falls below zero for a period of 5 seconds.

question_10882.question: What does the "LADN information +CLADN" unsolicited result code indicate in the 5G Network?
question_10882.ground_truth: The "LADN information +CLADN" unsolicited result code in the 5G Network indicates that there has been a change in the LADN information stored at the MT and it contains the current values of LADN information if available.

question_10883.question: Which 5GS entity sends the overall jitter range and local jitter range to the RAN during PDU Session Establishment/Modification procedure?

question_10888.question: When can a base station choose constellation rotation to minimize PAR?
question_10888.ground_truth: A base station can choose constellation rotation to minimize PAR when two alpha-QPSK MUROS mobiles are paired together on orthogonal sub-channels, and if there is no legacy mobile in at least one of the sub-channels.

question_10889.question: What is the function of the SMF in the handover preparation phase during Xn handover?
question_10889.ground_truth: The SMF is responsible for invoking the N4 Session Modification procedure with the UPF (PSA) only for unicast PDU Sessions and determining the delivery method (i.e., 5GC Shared MBS traffic delivery or 5GC Individual MBS traffic delivery) for MBS data transferring based on whether the target NG-RAN supports MBS.

question_10890.question: What is one possible method for prioritizing NOVES over non-emergency services?
question_10890.ground_truth: NOVES should generally be prioritized higher than the equivalent non-emergency service.

question_10891.question: What is the set of security features that enable applications in the user and in the provider domain to securely exchange messages?

question_10892.question: What is the role of UPF1 (PSA UPF) in the SMF based solution-CTF for session based charging?
question_10892.ground_truth: UPF1 (PSA UPF) determines how to adapt unicast communication based on the destination and traffic forwarding way, and reports the usage reporting of the traffic forwarding to SMF and the identifier of the traffic forwarding way.

question_10893.question: What is the maximum bit rate offered to the user for a given time period for the transfer of a bursty signal?

question_10894.question: What is the primary mission of Maritime Assistance Service (MAS)?
question_10894.ground_truth: The primary mission of MAS is to handle communication between the coastal state, ship's officers requiring assistance and other players in maritime community. They are on 24-hour alert to deploy rapid assistance and professional support for ships in connection with combating pollution, fire and explosions on board, collision, grounding, maritime security, terror mitigation, etc.

question_10895.question: How is the number of segments (parts) computed in the PVQ decoding process?
question_10895.ground_truth: The number of segments (parts) is computed using the formula in subclause 5.3.4.2.7.2.1, with a small adjustment to the formula based on the band bit rate and the flag read from the bit stream.

question_10896.question: What action should be taken if the Accept-Contact header field does not include the g.3gpp.mcvideo media feature tag or the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag containing the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcvideo"?
question_10896.ground_truth: The SIP request should be rejected with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and not processed further.

question_10897.question: Which type of RLC with short SN is indicated as supported in RLC-Parameters?

question_10898.question: When should the Receiver assemble an MRW SUFI?
question_10898.ground_truth: The Receiver should assemble an MRW SUFI if the STATUS PDU includes negatively acknowledged AMD PDUs or the DISCARD SUFI, and take the corresponding actions specified in subclauses 11.6.3, 11.6.4, or 11.6.5.

question_10899.question: What action should an SGSN take when it receives a PS-HANDOVER-CANCEL PDU for an unknown MS/UE?
question_10899.ground_truth: The SGSN shall ignore such a PDU.

question_10900.question: What is the role of the MME in ProSe communication setup procedure?
question_10900.ground_truth: The MME initiates the ProSe communication setup procedure if it receives a positive response for ProSe direct communication from the eNB. It sends a Bearer Setup Request message to the eNB for each UE to establish a dedicated EPS bearer as a direct bearer between two UEs.

question_10901.question: What are some of the typical deployment scenarios for the Programme Making and Special Events (PMSE) industry in the context of 5G systems?
question_10901.ground_truth: The typical deployment scenarios for the PMSE industry include short-term and long-term deployments, within a local geographical area, with stringent requirements in terms of end-to-end latency, communication service availability, communication service reliability, jitter, audio/video quality, number of wireless links per site, and synchronicity.

question_10903.question: What must the UE indicate when requesting SCM for an emergency service?
question_10903.ground_truth: The UE indicates the requested parameters for the session, including an indicator of an emergency service, the PDN Type (no APN is provided in the case of an access for emergency services), the PDN type (IPv4 or IPv6), Initial Attach/Handover indication and/or PCO.

question_10904.question: What indication does the SGSN give to the UE if it can obtain SMS services via PS domain NAS from the SGSN?
question_10904.ground_truth: The SGSN signals to the UE "SMS-Supported" in every Attach/RAU procedures to inform the UE that it can obtain SMS services via PS domain NAS from the SGSN.

question_10905.question: What are the considered options for Ethernet header compression in terms of protocol layer?
question_10905.ground_truth: The considered options for Ethernet header compression are anchoring it on PDCP and on UPF, where the Ethernet PDU session is terminated.

question_10906.question: What is the impact of the solution on services, entities, and interfaces?
question_10906.ground_truth: The entities impacted by this solution are the UPF at the XR Server and any gNB that supports this functionality. If a new QoS attribute is added for the PDU Set delay budget, there would be some impacts on the PCF and SMF. The AMF and any UPFs in between the gNB and the UPF at the XR Server are not impacted.

question_10907.question: What is the purpose of the provisioning step in the PFD call flow?
question_10907.ground_truth: The provisioning step in the PFD call flow is the process of provisioning one or more PFDs for the traffic identification of a single application.

question_10908.question: What action should the gNB-DU take if the Notification Control IE is included in the DRB to Be Setup List IE and set to active?
question_10908.ground_truth: The gNB-DU should monitor the QoS of the DRB and notify the gNB-CU if the QoS cannot be fulfilled any longer or if the QoS can be fulfilled again. This pertains only to GBR bearers.

question_10909.question: How are the E-AGCH, E-ROCH, E-RGCH, E-HICH, and F-TPICH transmitted if a UE is receiving a DPCH on which transmit diversity is used from a cell?
question_10909.ground_truth: The E-AGCH, E-ROCH, E-RGCH, E-HICH, and F-TPICH from the same cell are transmitted using STTD.

question_10910.question: What is the purpose of Step 6 in the relay service code setup process?
question_10910.ground_truth: In Step 6, the UE-to-Network relay's AMF adds the necessary information to the NAS Relay Authorization Response/Key Response message, which includes the decrypted Relay Service Code, encrypted and integrity protected new Relay Service Code and User Info ID, and a fresh 5G-GUTI if received from the Remote UE's AMF.

question_10913.question: What should the transmission participant do if the first bit in the subtype of the Transmission Granted message is set to '1' (Acknowledgment is required)?
question_10913.ground_truth: The transmission participant should send a Transmission control Ack message with the Message Type field set to '0' (Transmission Granted) and the Source field set to '0' (the transmission participant is the source).

question_10914.question: What is the process of H(e)NB initial authentication?
question_10914.ground_truth: During H(e)NB initial authentication, the H(e)NB identity and TrE identity authentication, the integrity verification, the H(e)NB device identity and TrE identity binding relationship authentication, and some H(e)NB related authentication/verification (such as HPM authentication, H(e)NB Location verification and UE authentication) are executed.

question_10916.question: What should the AMF do if all the NG-RANs serving the Broadcast MBS session requested the AMF to release the Broadcast MBS session?
question_10916.ground_truth: The AMF shall release the Broadcast MBS session context and send a notification with the releaseInd attribute set to true to report to the MB-SMF that the Broadcast MBS session (context) is released at the AMF and NG-RANs.

question_10917.question: What is the term used to describe a devastating event where a large number of packets are lost during a limited period?

question_10918.question: What is the purpose of the back-off timer in the context of network slice quota management?
question_10918.ground_truth: The back-off timer is used to suppress further signalling load for a subsequent request of the same S-NSSAI when a network slice quota is overflown.

question_10920.question: What happens after the MCVideo server sends an MBS session stop request towards the 5GS?
question_10920.ground_truth: The 5GS removes the MCVideo UEs from the corresponding MBS session, and resources in both NG-RAN and 5GC are released.

question_10921.question: What is the maximum duration of the test for transferring data and receiving PACKET UPLINK ACK/NACK in 41.2.3.4?
question_10921.ground_truth: The maximum duration of the test is 5 minutes.

question_10922.question: What should the NAS do if the event which triggered the access attempt was a request from upper layers to establish a new PDU session, and the NAS did not initiate the NAS transport procedure?
question_10922.ground_truth: Upon receiving an indication from the lower layers that the barring is alleviated for the access category, the NAS may initiate the NAS transport procedure as specified in subclause~5.4.5 to send the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message.

question_10923.question: What is the difference between step 5a and step 6a when generating and sending CDR information in the SMS-SC?
question_10923.ground_truth: Both steps include the SCS Identifier and the SMS Application port ID which is included in the SM User Data Header in the CDR information. However, step 5a is sent to the MTC-IWF with a cause value indicating success, while step 6a is sent to the MTC-IWF as a Trigger Delivery Report for the original trigger message indicating that this message has been recalled, and it is not sent with a cause value.

question_10924.question: Which LTE-based 5G terrestrial broadcast feature was introduced to support high mobility scenarios?
question_10924.ground_truth: The feature is a new numerology for PMCH with 100us cyclic prefix and 2.5kHz subcarrier spacing, which supports high mobility scenarios of up to 250km/h.
