question_11583.ground_truth: In an LTE system, if there is a collision between a periodic CSI report and a HARQ-ACK in the same subframe without PUSCH and the parameter simultaneousAckNackAndCQI, provided by higher layers is set TRUE or if the parameter simultaneousAckNackAndCQI-Format3-r11 provided by higher layers is set TRUE or if the parameter simultaneousAckNackAndCQI-Format4-Format5-r13 provided by higher layers is set TRUE, the periodic CSI report is multiplexed with HARQ-ACK or dropped. Otherwise, the CSI is dropped.

question_11585.question: What must the PCF use to determine the selected PCF address for an AF using Rx, such as P-CSCF?
question_11585.ground_truth: The BSF determines the selected PCF address based on the information carried by the incoming Rx requests.

question_11586.question: What operation is not impacted by the compressed mode in the radio frames that do not overlap an uplink compressed mode transmission gap?

question_11587.question: What is the role of the HTTP proxy in MCPTT?
question_11587.ground_truth: The HTTP proxy in MCPTT is responsible for handling HTTP communications between the MCPTT UE and other components in the network, such as the HTTP server and the SIP database.

question_11588.question: What should the UE include in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if it supports 5G ProSe direct discovery, direct communication, and acting as a UE-to-network relay UE?
question_11588.ground_truth: The UE should set the 5G ProSe-dd bit to "5G ProSe direct discovery supported", 5G ProSe-dc bit to "5G ProSe direct communication supported", 5G ProSe-l2relay bit to "Acting as a 5G ProSe layer-2 UE-to-network relay UE supported", and 5G ProSe-l3relay bit to "Acting as a 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay UE supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

question_11589.question: What is the role of a QFI in the high-level charging procedure for QoS based charging?
question_11589.ground_truth: QFI is used to identify a QoS flow in the 5G system and is part of the reporting level in the high-level charging procedure for QoS based charging. When step 7 occurs in the charging procedure, the charging information for the combination of Rating Group and QoS flow identifier is reported to the charging system.

question_11590.question: What is the FDD reference test frequency for Operating Band VIII in DC-HSUPA mode?

question_11591.question: What is the maximum accepted test system uncertainty for OTA co-location spurious emissions measurements in General Chamber under normal test conditions (FR1)?
question_11591.ground_truth: The maximum accepted test system uncertainty for OTA co-location spurious emissions measurements in General Chamber under normal test conditions (FR1) is derived based on test system specific values in clause~13.3.2.

question_11592.question: What is the requirement for triggering a QoS downgrade indication from the NRM client in a single pair of UEs communication?
question_11592.ground_truth: The requirement is based on the packet delay or packet loss for the Uu link, which is greater than a threshold value provided by the NRM server.

question_11594.question: How is a Management Information Base (MIB) defined in the present document?
question_11594.ground_truth: A MIB is an instance of an NRM and has some values on the defined attributes and associations specific for that instance. It includes a Name Space, a number of Managed Objects with their attributes, and a number of Associations between these MOs.

question_11595.question: How does the NF determine which profiles need synchronization when it receives a "UDR recovery message"?
question_11595.ground_truth: The NF identifies profiles requiring synchronization by checking if the impacted resource names in the scope match a profile and if the last synchronization time of the profile falls within the period between partialLastReplicationTime and partialRecoveryTime.

question_11596.question: What is the purpose of the Relay UE initiating a re-key procedure over the PC5 link with the Remote UE?
question_11596.ground_truth: The Relay UE initiates a re-key procedure over the PC5 link with the Remote UE to generate fresh new Krelay-session, Krelay-enc, Krelay-int after a successful re-authentication/authorization of the Remote UE.

question_11597.question: What should the P-CSCF do before forwarding the request to the I-CSCF based on the topmost Route header field?
question_11597.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should check for the presence of a 3xx response or 480 (Temporarily Unavailable) response and repeat the actions with a different I-CSCF if none of the retransmissions receive a response.

question_11599.question: When should the UE monitor the link for recovery using the evaluation period and Layer 1 indication interval corresponding to the non-DRX mode?
question_11599.ground_truth: Upon start of T310 timer as specified in section 5.3.11 in 3GPP TS 36.331.

question_11600.question: What is the format of a PathSwitchRequestAcknowledge message in NGAP protocol?
question_11600.ground_truth: A PathSwitchRequestAcknowledge message is a sequence containing protocolIEs.

question_11601.question: What action shall the NEF take upon the deletion of an existing MBS Session?
question_11601.ground_truth: The NEF shall interact with the MB-SMF to request the deletion of the corresponding MBS Session.

question_11604.question: What is the purpose of the DayOfWeek leaf in an ISMP rule?
question_11604.ground_truth: The DayOfWeek leaf in an ISMP rule indicates the day(s) of the week for which the corresponding rule is valid. The value of this leaf is an 8-bit integer formatted as a bit map representing days of the week. If the bit corresponding to a day of the week is set, the rule is valid on that day.

question_11605.question: How does the Disaster Roaming PLMN AMF handle notifying Disaster Inbound Roamers that the Disaster Condition is no longer applicable?
question_11605.ground_truth: When the Disaster Roaming PLMN AMF is notified that the Disaster Condition is no longer applicable for Disaster Inbound Roamers, it initiates a network-initiated de-registration procedure to minimize service interruption.

question_11606.question: What action should the Node B take upon receiving a DEDICATED MEASUREMENT INITIATION REQUEST message with a specific Node B Communication Context ID IE set to "All NBCC"?
question_11606.ground_truth: The Node B shall apply the measurement request to all current and future Node B Communication Contexts controlled via the Communication Control Port on which the DEDICATED MEASUREMENT INITIATION REQUEST message was received.

question_11607.question: What is the main function of the coverage class in the 3GPP TS 36.304 specification for E-UTRAN?
question_11607.ground_truth: The main function of the coverage class is to adapt to different path and penetration losses experienced by different MSs, allowing MSs with better than worst case coupling loss to benefit from improved battery life and lower latency, and also benefiting the network in terms of improved capacity.

question_11610.question: What is the purpose of the transmit media request from the transmission control participant to the transmission control server?
question_11610.ground_truth: The transmit media request is used by the transmission control participant to request the transmit media from the transmission control server. This information flow is sent in unicast to the transmission control server.

question_11613.question: What type of speech sentence pair is recommended for consistency in comparing P.863 scores across different laboratories?
question_11613.ground_truth: A fullband speech sentence pair from ITU-T Recommendation P.501 Annex D, with American English samples, is recommended.

question_11614.question: What is the purpose of the 'U: pending Release' state in the MCPTT context?
question_11614.ground_truth: The 'U: pending Release' state is used when the floor participant is waiting for a response to a Floor Release message. In this state, the floor participant can receive floor control messages and RTP media packets while timer T100 (Floor Release) is running.

question_11615.question: Which two Solution Sets are defined in the 3GPP TS 28.673 V14.0.x specification?
question_11615.ground_truth: The two Solution Sets defined in the 3GPP TS 28.673 V14.0.x specification are the 3GPP HNS NRM IRP CORBA SS and the 3GPP HNS NRM IRP XML Definitions.

question_11617.question: What are the parameters that are typically traded-off in determining state of the art filter performance?
question_11617.ground_truth: The parameters that are typically traded-off in determining state of the art filter performance include Rx pass band attenuation, Tx pass band attenuation, Tx/Rx pass band ripple, Tx/Rx out of band attenuation, filter return loss and Tx/Rx filter temperature performance.

question_11619.question: What is the purpose of the systemDateTimeQuery method in the IpFwOAM interface?
question_11619.ground_truth: The systemDateTimeQuery method in the IpFwOAM interface is used to query the system date and time of the framework.

question_11620.question: In 4.5.2.3, what should a UE capable of ProSe Direct Discovery and SLSS transmission and reception measure within Tevaluate,SLSS if the conditions for SLSS transmissions are met?
question_11620.ground_truth: The RSRP of the cell used to transmit ProSe Direct Discovery announcements.

question_11621.question: What is the significance of Id and criticality fields in the context of the PCAP protocol?
question_11621.ground_truth: The Id and criticality fields ensure forwards and backwards compatibility of the protocol. These fields are coded in a standard format that will not be changed in the future, and can always be decoded regardless of the standard version.

question_11622.question: What is the limitation on the length of the signature and related security parameters in ETWS Primary Notifications if ETWS Primary Notifications over GERAN are supported?
question_11622.ground_truth: If ETWS Primary Notifications over GERAN are supported, the total length of the signature and related security parameters cannot exceed 75 bytes.

question_11623.question: Who is responsible for providing communication services and who provides network services?
question_11623.ground_truth: Communication Service Providers (CSPs) are responsible for providing communication services, while Network Operators (NOPs) provide network services.

question_11624.question: What does the term "NF" stand for in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_11624.ground_truth: "NF" stands for Network Function in the 3GPP Technical Specification.

question_11625.question: What information is included in the E2E derivation information container?
question_11625.ground_truth: The E2E derivation information container includes provided information for the key E2E derivation for the UE, as provided by the EnSE. It may contain an identifier for a private key to be used and optionally other values for key derivation.

question_11627.question: What is the role of the Implementation eXtra Information for Testing (IXIT) proforma in the document?
question_11627.ground_truth: The Implementation eXtra Information for Testing (IXIT) proforma is a document in the form of a questionnaire that, when completed for a User Equipment (UE), becomes an IXIT. It contains all the information related to the UE and its testing environment required to run an appropriate test suite against the UE.

question_11628.question: How should each beam be set for EIRP accuracy requirements?
question_11628.ground_truth: For EIRP accuracy requirements, each beam should be set to maximum EIRP for the tested beam direction pair.

question_11629.question: What is the objective of the 3GPP work item for LTE Advanced Carrier Aggregation in Band 38?
question_11629.ground_truth: The objective of the work item is to determine the appropriate deployment scenarios, specify core RF requirements for the base station (BS) and user equipment (UE) supporting contiguous carrier aggregation in Band 38, address band-specific RRM requirements, add signaling support in RAN2 specifications if needed, and specify the performance requirements for BS and UE.

question_11630.question: What are the two required Coordination of Video Orientation (CVO) bits granularity support requirements for the UE and the IMS core network entities in the GSMA NG.114 V1.0 specification?
question_11630.ground_truth: The UE and the entities in the IMS core network which terminate the user plane must support Coordination of Video Orientation (CVO) with two bits granularity.

question_11631.question: What is the purpose of the initial test setup described in section 9.2.1HD.4.1?
question_11631.ground_truth: The purpose of the initial test setup described in section 9.2.1HD.4.1 is to define the test conditions for the HSDPA connection and fading simulations.

question_11632.question: When is there no need for rekeying procedure during handover in mobility usecase?
question_11632.ground_truth: When the SMF distributes the same rekeying token to all RANs, there is no need for rekeying procedure during handover in mobility usecase.

question_11633.question: What is the role of the DeliveredAlternatives SAND message in a DASH-based streaming system?
question_11633.ground_truth: The DeliveredAlternatives SAND message is used as a response to an AcceptedAlternatives message sent by a DASH client, where a DANE may deliver an alternative segment rather than the requested segment.

question_11635.question: What is the first step a UE takes before requesting to join a multicast group in a MBS session?
question_11635.ground_truth: The UE registers in the PLMN or SNPN and may have established a PDU session that can be associated with multicast session(s).

question_11637.question: What should be inserted into the list of the MCData user information entries of the served MCData group information entry if the MCData user information entry does not exist?
question_11637.ground_truth: An MCData user information entry with the MCData ID set to the handled MCData ID.

question_11638.question: What information does the user plane function report during the Sx reporting procedure?
question_11638.ground_truth: The user plane function reports events related to the node level and/or individual user plane sessions, including the load/overload status of the node, measurement reports, and detection of specific user plane traffic.

question_11640.question: What is the first step in the process of a PINE joining a PIN?
question_11640.ground_truth: The PINE discovers the PIN from the PEMC/PIN server first.

question_11643.question: What should be transmitted by the SS when T2 expires?
question_11643.ground_truth: When T2 expires, the SS shall transmit either an RRCRelease message to release the RRC connection or switch the UE off, followed by transmitting a Paging message including matched ng-5G-S-TMSI for the UE if an RRCRelease has been sent, or switching on the UE if it was switched off.

question_11644.question: What is the role of the MCPTT server in a private call or group call?
question_11644.ground_truth: The MCPTT server can perform both the controlling role and the participating role in a private call or group call. The controlling role is responsible for call control, interfacing with the group management server, managing floor control, and managing media handling. The participating role is responsible for call control, group affiliation support, relaying call control and floor control messages, and media handling for its MCPTT users.

question_11645.question: What functionality should the MBMS client support to provide a valid HLS Media Presentation?
question_11645.ground_truth: If the MBMS client supports the HLS Server functionalities, the MBMS client shall support sufficient functionalities to provide a valid HLS Media Presentation. This may include rewriting the Master Playlist and the Media Playlist to provide a valid service based on the data received.

question_11647.question: What message does the SS send to the MS to initiate ciphering?
question_11647.ground_truth: The SS sends a CIPHERING MODE COMMAND message to the MS, ordering it to start ciphering with a supported algorithm.

question_11649.question: What is the smallest threshold for the number of allocated bits for each of the 3 sub-band groups?
question_11649.ground_truth: The smallest threshold for the number of allocated bits for each of the 3 sub-band groups are 5, 6, and 7.

question_11650.question: What is the maximum number of SRSPosResourceSets that can be aggregated across CH-ID carriers for CH-ID sidelink positioning resource pool is FFS?
question_11650.ground_truth: The value is defined by 3GPP and is not specified in this text.

question_11651.question: What action does the PGW-C request from the PGW-U in the "GGSN Initiated PDP Context Deactivation Procedure"?
question_11651.ground_truth: In the "GGSN Initiated PDP Context Deactivation Procedure", the PGW-C requests the PGW-U to stop counting and stop forwarding packets for the affected bearers.

question_11653.question: How does glottal pulse resynchronization correct the difference between the target transmitted position of the last glottal pulse and its actual position in the concealed adaptive codebook excitation signal?
question_11653.ground_truth: By searching for the pulse closest to the actual pulse, finding the error in pulse position, and performing glottal pulse resynchronization by inserting or removing samples around a determined position based on the error in pulse position. The resynchronization is performed only if and, where is the absolute difference between the decoded pulse position and the pitch lag of the first subframe in the future frame. The samples to be added or deleted are distributed across the different pitch cycles in the frame, with the minimum energy regions being determined by computing the energy using a sliding 5-sample window. The minimum energy position is set at the middle of the window at which the energy is at a minimum. The search performed between two pitch pulses is restricted between and, where and are the pitch pulses in the frame. The samples to be added or deleted are distributed based on the number of pulses to be removed/added and the number of minimum energy regions. Removing samples is straightforward, while adding samples is performed by copying the last samples after dividing by 20 and inverting the sign. Using this procedure, the last maximum pulse in the concealed adaptive codebook excitation is forced to be aligned with the actual maximum pulse position at the end of the adaptive codebook frame which is transmitted in the current frame.

question_11655.question: What is the main reason for the preference of using statistical models over traces for RAN simulations?
question_11655.ground_truth: The main reason is that RAN1 needs to simulate multiple cells at the same time, for example 63, for interference considerations.

question_11656.question: What is the difference between "NF" and "AF" in the document?
question_11656.ground_truth: "NF" stands for Network Function, while "AF" stands for Application Function.

question_11657.question: What kind of network can support the ATSSS feature?
question_11657.ground_truth: The ATSSS feature can be supported over a network where an MA PDU session can be established, including NG-RAN, untrusted non-3GPP access network, trusted non-3GPP access network, wireline access network, 3GPP access network connected to EPC, and non-3GPP access network connected to 5GCN.

question_11658.question: What is the result of maintaining transcoder resources in the BSS when TrFO operation is not possible/desirable?
question_11658.ground_truth: It does not allow exploiting a 3G-like architecture.

question_11659.question: What should the MCPTT client store in the "callee ID" field when in the "P0: start-stop" or "P1: ignoring same call id" state upon an indication from MCPTT User to initiate a private call?
question_11659.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should store the MCPTT user ID of the callee in the "callee ID" field when in the "P0: start-stop" or "P1: ignoring same call id" state upon an indication from MCPTT User to initiate a private call.

question_11660.question: What should the UE do if the EMM cause #31 is received and the UE has not indicated support for CIoT optimizations?
question_11660.ground_truth: The UE should reset the service request attempt counter and enter the state EMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE, and enable N1 mode capability for 3GPP access if it was disabled and disable the E-UTRA capability.

question_11663.question: What entity plays the central role during the observation phase, the analytics phase, and the decision phase in Potential Solution #1?
question_11663.ground_truth: The 3GPP management system, in particular the MDAF.

question_11665.question: What is the purpose of the NetworkSliceSubnetProviderCapabilities IOC in network slicing?
question_11665.ground_truth: The NetworkSliceSubnetProviderCapabilities IOC stores the capabilities of the network slice subnet provider in terms of network slice subnets it can manage/provide. The attributes of this IOC can be queried to know the capabilities of the provider.

question_11666.question: What does the test defined in 9.4.4C.2 assume?
question_11666.ground_truth: The test defined in 9.4.4C.2 assumes STTD is disabled on HS-SCCH and DPCH, HS-SCCH Type 3 coding associated with single stream transmission on HS-DSCH and MIMO only with single-stream restriction feature is used. This test is target for R10 and later UEs for all types of UTRA for FDD UE's that support optional MIMO only with single-stream restriction feature and optional enhanced performance requirements type1.

question_11667.question: What is the effect of an old SGSN storing New SGSN Address in its context during a combined RA/LA update?
question_11667.ground_truth: It allows the old SGSN to forward data packets to the new SGSN when the old MM context is cancelled.

question_11669.question: What is the primary cause of the challenges associated with the expiry of MAC timers in NR NTN and IoT NTN?
question_11669.ground_truth: The high Round Trip Time (RTT) in NTN is the primary cause of these challenges.

question_11672.question: When should the UE start or restart timer T317 with the duration ul-SyncValidityDuration from the subframe indicated by epochTime?

question_11673.question: When is access to the CTS-FP allowed for any enrolled CTS-MS?
question_11673.ground_truth: Access to the CTS-FP is allowed for any enrolled CTS-MS when the CTSBCH status field indicates idle.

question_11674.question: What is the function of the energy accurate fee control of the smart meter?
question_11674.ground_truth: The energy accurate fee control function allows for the remote troubleshooting of energy problems for the user, and the regular provision of detailed energy consumption analysis reports to guide users to use electricity scientifically and rationally.

question_11675.question: How does the Self-healing functionality determine when to trigger recovery actions?
question_11675.ground_truth: The Self-healing functionality monitors the alarms, gathers necessary correlated information, performs deep analysis and diagnosis, and based on the results, triggers appropriate recovery actions to solve the fault automatically.

question_11680.question: What is the main benefit of using a composite output with multiple PLLs and PAs in terms of EVM and emission requirements?
question_11680.ground_truth: The noise and emissions performance is improved up to 10log(M) where M is the number of non-correlated signals, making it beneficial for lowering the EVM and emissions performance on transmitters per antenna connector.

question_11681.question: What does the `Max-Simul-Data-Receptions-Nc4` element represent in the context of MCData UE for on-network or off-network group data transmissions?
question_11681.ground_truth: It indicates the maximum number of simultaneous data receptions allowed for an MCData UE for on-network or off-network group data transmissions.

question_11682.question: What is the downside if inter-BSS handover is not successful and the MS reverts back to the serving BSS with LCLS being broken in the user plane?
question_11682.ground_truth: In this case, the LCLS may need to be re-established.

question_11683.question: What are the two sub-classes of immediate messaging?
question_11683.ground_truth: The two sub-classes of immediate messaging are sessions where the user can both send and receive messages without any prior actions, and sessions where the user may be required to join a messaging session before the message exchange can take place.

question_11685.question: What is the purpose of the test in 14.20.7.3 for FACCH/H?
question_11685.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the MS does not exceed the conformance requirements for FACCH/H under propagation condition TUhigh with an allowance for the statistical significance of the test.

question_11686.question: What action should the UE take if the 5GSM cause value is different from the specified list but the Back-off timer value IE is not included?
question_11686.ground_truth: If the Back-off timer value IE is not included, then the UE shall ignore the Re-attempt indicator IE provided by the network in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message, if any.

question_11687.question: When does interception of IMS conference services begin if the target of interception has requested a conference to be created?
question_11687.ground_truth: Interception of IMS conference services begins regardless of whether the target of interception has joined the conference if the target has provisioned or requested a conference to be created.

question_11688.question: What is the interface for providing access category selection assistance information between the Access Stratum (AS) layer and the Non-Access Stratum (NAS) layer in 5G systems?
question_11688.ground_truth: The AS-NAS interface is used for this purpose.

question_11689.question: What kind of measurements are provided in subclause 4.9 of the TS 25.423 and TS 25.433?
question_11689.ground_truth: The following measurements are provided in subclause 4.9 of the TS 25.423 and TS 25.433: Radio Link Setup (NBAP), Radio Link Addition (NBAP), Radio Link Deletion (NBAP), Radio Link Setup (RNSAP), Radio Link Addition (RNSAP), and Radio Link Deletion (RNSAP).

question_11690.question: What is the procedure followed for removing QoS Flows or resources in an existing W-UP?
question_11690.ground_truth: The W-AGF may decide to delete an existing W-UP resource when there is no QoS Flow mapped to this W-UP resource. This is covered in step 4c.

question_11691.question: What should the MS do upon receiving the CONNECT message in a mobile terminated call?
question_11691.ground_truth: The MS should indicate acceptance of a MT call by sending CONNECT, except if there is no compatible radio resource available at this time, in which case the attachment should be delayed until such a resource becomes available. For Data Calls, the mobile station attaches the user connection when receiving the CONNECT ACKNOWLEDGE message from the network.

question_11693.question: What is the role of the Application Layer Group ID in ProSe Direct Communication?
question_11693.ground_truth: The Application Layer Group ID identifies an application layer group that the UE belongs to and is used in ProSe Direct Communication to enable one-to-one, one-to-many, or ProSe UE-to-Network Relaying communication. This ID is one of the parameters that need to be provisioned to the UE for ProSe Direct Communication.

question_11694.question: What is the E-UTRAN and NB-IoT tracking area code (TAC) and NG-SS cell identity for cell 1 and cell 2?
question_11694.ground_truth: For cell 1, TAC for E-UTRAN is 0001, NB-IoT TAC is 0001, and NG-SS cell ID is 0001 (36 bits). For cell 2, TAC for E-UTRAN is 0002 and NB-IoT TAC is also 0002. NG-SS cell ID for cell 1 is 0001 (36 bits) and for cell 2 is 0002 (36 bits).

question_11695.question: What is the maximum duration of the test procedure for the COLP presentation mode "temporary (presentation allowed)"?
question_11695.ground_truth: The maximum duration of the test procedure for the COLP presentation mode "temporary (presentation allowed)" is 30 seconds.

question_11697.question: What is the procedure for PCRF-initiated gateway control session establishment over S9a?
question_11697.ground_truth: The procedure for PCRF-initiated gateway control session establishment over S9a is triggered by PCRF to establish a gateway control session with BPCF to provision policy decisions for EPC routed traffic. The PCRF initiates Gateway Control Session establishment request over S9a with the BPCF, and the BPCF may interact with the BNG as defined by Fixed Broadband Access Policy Framework specifications.

question_11698.question: What is the coupling loss between a Repeater and a UTRA TDD BS receiver that the 73 dB coupling loss requirement is based on?

question_11699.question: What is the purpose of the Time Zone information element in the 3GPP TS 24.008 protocol?
question_11699.ground_truth: The Time Zone information element in the 3GPP TS 24.008 protocol encodes the offset between universal time and local time in steps of 15 minutes and the universal time at which this information element may have been sent by the network.

question_11701.question: What is required for the MC service clients to determine to join the multicast MBS session with the received MBS session ID?
question_11701.ground_truth: The MC service clients determine to join the multicast MBS session with the received MBS session ID based on the multicast MBS service announcement from the MC service server.

question_11702.question: What action does the 5GC take when it receives a Path Switch Request message from the target NG-RAN node during handover, and the source NG-RAN node supports MBS?
question_11702.ground_truth: The 5GC infers the delivery method (i.e. shared or individual MBS traffic delivery) for MBS data transferring based on the information received in the N2 SM information from the SMF.

question_11703.question: What should be the CQI reporting periodicity during the NR SA FR2 SSB-based beam failure detection and link recovery in non-DRX test setup?
question_11703.ground_truth: The CQI reporting periodicity should be 5ms during the NR SA FR2 SSB-based beam failure detection and link recovery in non-DRX test setup.

question_11705.question: When might an IWF be deployed as a security gateway in an MC system?
question_11705.ground_truth: An IWF can be deployed as a security gateway between the MCPTT system and the LMR system in cases where encryption of voice media is required in the MC system and the MCPTT user(s) and the LMR user(s) use different codecs.

question_11706.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 38.412, what is the role of the Controlling RNC?
question_11706.ground_truth: The Controlling RNC is an RNC that controls the use and integrity of the radio resources for a specific set of Node B's, with only one Controlling RNC for any Node B.

question_11707.question: What does the MAC entity do when it receives a retransmission and the data has not been successfully decoded?
question_11707.ground_truth: The MAC entity combines the received data with the data currently in the soft buffer for this TB and attempts to decode the combined data.

question_11708.question: What is the role of the NEF in relation to the deletion of AF requirements in the UDR?
question_11708.ground_truth: The NEF deletes the AF requirements in the UDR and responds to the AF.

question_11709.question: What is the maximum performance improvement observed when combining reduction of LTE measurements interference and GSM and UMTS inter-RAT measurements in an urban 10 MHz condition?
question_11709.ground_truth: A 54% reduction in the 67th percentile error was observed in the suburban 10 MHz case.

question_11710.question: What should be the destination address for a Downlink Data Notification Failure Indication message in the event of network triggered service restoration?
question_11710.ground_truth: The destination address for this message should be the SGW IP address signalled via the Sender F-TEID for Control Plane IE in the Downlink Data Notification message, or the source IP address of the Downlink Data Notification message received earlier if the Sender F-TEID is not present in the message.

question_11711.question: When must a UE disable the N1 mode capability for 3GPP access and set the N1mode bit to "N1 mode for 3GPP access not supported" in the UE network capability IE?
question_11711.ground_truth: When the UE supporting both N1 mode and S1 mode needs to stay in an E-UTRA cell connected to EPC in order to prevent unintentional handover or cell reselection from E-UTRA connected to EPC to NG-RAN connected to 5GCN.

question_11715.question: What should the PCF do if the S-NSSAI is subject to network slice data rate limitation and the Remaining Maximum Slice Data Rate reaches a certain operator defined threshold?
question_11715.ground_truth: The PCF may apply a policy decision to strengthen the traffic restrictions for individual PDU Sessions or PCC rules and interact with the SMF accordingly.

question_11716.question: What is the difference between "High-CL Relay" and "Low-CL Relay" in 3GPP E-UTRA?
question_11716.ground_truth: "High-CL Relay" is characterized by requirements derived from outdoor relay scenarios with a minimum coupling loss of 59 dB, while "Low-CL Relay" is characterized by requirements derived from indoor relay scenarios with a minimum coupling loss of 45 dB.

question_11718.question: What is the procedure for disassociating the association of the collection of UEs when a game is over?
question_11718.ground_truth: The procedure is similar to the create procedure, except that it deletes related information and modifies the SM policy for the application within the PDU Session accordingly.

question_11720.question: What should the MSGin5G UE-2 do if it receives responses from multiple MSGin5G Gateway UEs with different Allowed packet size values?
question_11720.ground_truth: The MSGin5G UE-2 should select the Gateway UE with an Allowed packet size equal to or greater than its Required packet size; if no such Gateway UE is found, it should select the one with the maximum Allowed packet size.

question_11721.question: What is the difference between the two MT-LR Privacy Options cases?
question_11721.ground_truth: In the first MT-LR Privacy Options case (70.4.2.1), the default response is location allowed if no response is received, while in the second case (70.4.2.2), the default response is location not allowed if no response is received.

question_11722.question: What is one of the advantages of an OFDM/SC-FDMA based system like E-UTRAN?
question_11722.ground_truth: One of the advantages is that it allows for implementation of a lower complexity receiver at wider bandwidths.

question_11724.question: What command is used in this test to verify that the ME uses the FETCH command to obtain the proactive UICC command?
question_11724.ground_truth: The MORE TIME proactive command is used in this test.

question_11725.question: What is the purpose of the totalBroadcasts parameter?
question_11725.ground_truth: The totalBroadcasts parameter specifies how many times the message should be broadcasted to each of the designated area(s).

question_11726.question: What is the purpose of the test in 14.18.9.1.3?
question_11726.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in 14.18.9.1.3 is to verify that the MS does not exceed the conformance requirement for different coding schemes under the propagation condition TU50/noFH with an allowance for the statistical significance of the test.

question_11727.question: What should a P-CSCF operating in a network that supports calling number attestation and signing do for an emergency session?
question_11727.ground_truth: A P-CSCF operating in a network that supports calling number attestation and signing may insert attestation information related to the asserted calling identity associated with an emergency session, based on operator policy.

question_11729.question: What is the primary purpose of the Download Delivery Method in MBMS?
question_11729.ground_truth: The MBMS Download Delivery Method allows the error-free transmission of files via unidirectional MBMS Bearer Services. The files are downloaded and stored in the local files-system of the user equipment.

question_11730.question: What actions can trigger the UE to invoke the de-registration procedure with appropriate de-registration type?
question_11730.ground_truth: The UE can trigger the de-registration procedure with appropriate de-registration type if it is switched off, as part of the eCall inactivity procedure, or as part of USIM removal.

question_11731.question: What is the data type defined in clause 8.8.4.2.2 of the CAPIF Auditing API service?
question_11731.ground_truth: Type: InvocationLogs is defined in clause 8.8.4.2.2 of the CAPIF Auditing API service.

question_11734.question: What information is required to receive data from an MBMS bearer using Android APIs?
question_11734.ground_truth: tmgi (Temporary Multicast Group Identifier of the MBMS Bearer)

question_11736.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 23.501, what is a NF service?
question_11736.ground_truth: A NF service is one type of capability exposed by a NF (NF Service Producer) to other authorized NF (NF Service Consumer) through a service based interface. A NF service may support one or more NF service operation(s).

question_11737.question: What should a Mobile Station (MS) do when it receives a GA-RRC PAGING REQUEST message and the mobile identity included in the message matches any of the valid identities of the MS, and timer TU5908 is not active for the CS domain?
question_11737.ground_truth: The MS should indicate reception of paging to upper layers, forward the IE "CN Domain Identity", the IE "Mobile Identity" and the IE "Paging Cause" (if received) to the upper layers, and continue with the ongoing procedure as if the GA-RRC PAGING REQUEST was not received. The MS should also implicitly establish a GA-RRC connection and transmit a paging response in the initial NAS message (resulting in the GA-RRC CONNECTED state for the CS domain).

question_11738.question: What should the NAS do when the UE is in 5GMM-IDLE mode, has received a request from the upper layers for an access attempt, and has been informed by the lower layers that the access attempt is allowed?
question_11738.ground_truth: The NAS shall initiate the procedure to send the initial NAS message for the access attempt if allowed.

question_11739.question: What is the role of the MCVideo group ID in the basic call control state machine?
question_11739.ground_truth: The stored MCVideo group ID of the call is one of the pieces of information associated with the basic call control state machine.

question_11740.question: What is the exception to mandatory integrity protected signalling in Iu mode, in regards to emergency calls?
question_11740.ground_truth: The exception is for emergency calls, where integrity protected signalling is not mandatory.

question_11743.question: What should the network do if a low layer failure occurs before the message ATTACH COMPLETE has been received from the MS and a new P-TMSI or a new P-TMSI together with a new P-TMSI signature has been allocated?
question_11743.ground_truth: The network shall consider both the old and new P-TMSI each with its corresponding P-TMSI-signature as valid until the old P-TMSI can be considered as invalid by the network or the GMM context which has been marked as detached in the network is released, and shall not resent the message ATTACH ACCEPT.

question_11745.question: Under what conditions should the "Allowed PDU session status" IE be included in a message?
question_11745.ground_truth: The "Allowed PDU session status" IE must be included in a message if the CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message is sent as a response to paging with the access type indicating non-3GPP access or notification via 3GPP access for PDU session(s) associated with non-3GPP access.

question_11746.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects in the context of Telecommunication management and the Transport Network (TN) interface?
question_11746.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects is responsible for creating technical specifications related to Telecommunication management and the Transport Network interface, including the Network Resource Model (NRM) and Integration Reference Point (IRP) components.

question_11747.question: What is the name of the interference signal that is simulated in the measurement setup using a separate signal generator?
question_11747.ground_truth: The interference signal is generated using a separate signal generator to simulate the interference signal from the other antenna.

question_11750.question: What is the expectation for the Message Identifier for Warning Notifications in the local language in countries adopting EU-ALERT?
question_11750.ground_truth: Countries adopting EU-ALERT are expected to use the same Message Identifier for Warning Notifications in the local language.

question_11751.question: What is the purpose of the PCF querying other AMFs within the AMF set?
question_11751.ground_truth: The PCF queries other AMFs within the AMF set to obtain the GUAMI and possibly a service name.

question_11752.question: What is the meaning of the "Information Transfer Mode" attribute in the minimal set of attributes for Bearer Services?
question_11752.ground_truth: The "Information Transfer Mode" attribute in the minimal set of attributes for Bearer Services has the value "Circuit", indicating that the information transfer is circuit-switched.

question_11754.question: What are the factors to be considered when designing the role of the application(s) and the interworking mechanisms with EPS in the ProSe system architecture?
question_11754.ground_truth: The role of the application(s) and the interworking mechanisms with EPS in the ProSe system architecture should consider factors such as reference points and interfaces to the 3rd party applications layer functions in the UE and network/EPC, the new entities and their required functionality, the handling of ProSe identities, security-related functionality, policy-related functionality, and charging.

question_11755.question: What is the role of the IMSI hash in the CS/PS coordination process in RAN?
question_11755.ground_truth: The IMSI hash is used by RAN to base the CS/PS coordination process in the operator-centric approach. This is an alternative solution to the issue of uncoordinated CS/PS NRIs.

question_11757.question: What are the potential requirements for the 5G System to support location-based services in hospitals?
question_11757.ground_truth: The 5G System shall be able to provide positioning service with better than 3 m horizontal positioning accuracy, 2 m vertical positioning accuracy, and an availability of over 99%. The system shall be able to handle additional location information from other external sources and provide positioning service with a latency lower than 1 minute. The system shall also support positioning of UEs using very little energy consumption on the UE, taking into account the limitations of the UE's form factor, CPU power, peak power, and radio access technology support.

question_11758.question: Which message type is used for the PMFP PLR report response?
question_11758.ground_truth: The message type for the PMFP PLR report response is "PMFP PLR REPORT RESPONSE".

question_11759.question: What is the NF service-based interface exhibited by the Policy Control Function (PCF) and what is the UE Policy Control Service (Npcf_UEPolicyControl) part of?
question_11759.ground_truth: The UE Policy Control Service (Npcf_UEPolicyControl) is part of the Npcf service-based interface exhibited by the Policy Control Function (PCF).

question_11760.question: What is the purpose of the Generic Network Product model in the 3GPP network?
question_11760.ground_truth: The Generic Network Product model is a description of the functions that cannot be found in 3GPP specifications but are necessary for the GNP. It serves as a reference for the GNP SCAS and provides a comprehensive view of the network product.

question_11762.question: How many ACK/NACK shall be sent during and after identifying the cell global identifier of cell 2?
question_11762.ground_truth: At least 42 ACK/NACK shall be sent during and after identifying the cell global identifier of cell 2.

question_11763.question: What factor determines the new transmitter output power in 22.1.5a?
question_11763.ground_truth: The new transmitter output power shall change by one power step towards the new level signalled for each measured burst, until the MS is operating at the closest supported power control level.

question_11765.question: What should the SMF include in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message if it decides to establish a single access PDU session for a MA PDU session with the network upgrade allowed?
question_11765.ground_truth: The SMF shall not include the ATSSS container IE in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message in this case.

question_11767.question: What should be included in the Queued User ID field in the Floor Granted message for a floor participant in the queue?
question_11767.ground_truth: The MCPTT ID of the floor participant should be included in the Queued User ID field in the Floor Granted message for a floor participant in the queue.

question_11768.question: What is the purpose of the createNotification() method in the IpEventNotification interface?
question_11768.ground_truth: This method is used to enable generic notifications so that events can be sent to the application. It returns the ID assigned by the framework for this newly installed notification.

question_11770.question: What is the DAC (Digital-to-Analog Converter) requirement for implementing DSR (Dual Symbol Rate) in a mobile station?
question_11770.ground_truth: The DAC would have to run at a higher sampling rate which would require a wider filter after the DAC, thus increasing the Tx noise power.

question_11772.question: What response will an MCVideo server return if an "on-network-invite-members" element is set to "false" and the SIP INVITE request contains a specific MIME body with a session-type value not set to "chat"?
question_11772.ground_truth: The MCVideo server will return a SIP 404 (Not Found) response with the warning text set to "118 the group identity indicated in the request is a chat group".

question_11774.question: What information shall the BM-SC send to the GCS AS in case of an expiring TMGI at timer expiry?
question_11774.ground_truth: The BM-SC shall notify the GCS AS by sending a GCS-Notification-Request (GNR) command including one TMGI-Expiry AVP in case of an expiring TMGI at timer expiry. If there are active MBMS bearer(s) related to an expiring TMGI, the BM-SC shall terminate those bearer(s) and shall notify the GCS AS about the bearer termination by including MBMS-Bearer-Event-Notification AVP(s) in the GNR in accordance with the MBMS Bearer Status Indication Procedure in clause 5.3.5.

question_11775.question: What is the purpose of the tonality flag in the described concealment method?
question_11775.ground_truth: The tonality flag is used to indicate the type of the current frame and to determine the concealment method to be used in the decoder.

question_11778.question: What is the minimum performance requirement for the UE co-channel Tx model's granularity?

question_11779.question: What should the MS do when receiving an unknown or unforeseen transaction identifier with COMM=T?
question_11779.ground_truth: The MS should answer with a STATUS message with same TI value, cause "invalid transaction identifier value", and including, if possible, as diagnostics the complete message received.

question_11780.question: Which UE types does the test case 6.3A.4.4.3.2 apply to?
question_11780.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward that supports FR2 4UL CA.

question_11782.question: What is the purpose of the "PDP-Identifier" field in the "PDPContext" definition?
question_11782.ground_truth: The "PDP-Identifier" field in the "PDPContext" definition is used to identify a specific PDP Context within a control relationship between gprsSSF and gsmSCF.

question_11784.question: What is the role of S-NSSAI in UE registration procedure?
question_11784.ground_truth: S-NSSAI is used for AMF and SMF selection during UE registration procedure in 5GC.

question_11786.question: What is the effect of a floor taken message in the MCPTT group call?
question_11786.ground_truth: A floor taken message is sent to all other floor participants when the floor grant is successful, informing them that they can no longer transmit audio.

question_11789.question: What is the expected sequence if the network rejects a GPRS attach procedure with the cause 'roaming not allowed in this location area' and the MS is switched off or the SIM is removed?
question_11789.ground_truth: The MS resets the list of 'Forbidden location areas for roaming' when switched off or the SIM is removed.

question_11790.question: What should the SCC AS do upon sending a SIP re-INVITE request toward the CS domain and receiving a SDP offer from the CS domain in response?
question_11790.ground_truth: The SCC AS should send an initial SIP INVITE request toward the remote UE, including the information from the SDP offer received from the CS domain.

question_11791.question: What is the purpose of the EEC using the EAS information in service continuity planning?
question_11791.ground_truth: The EEC can use the EAS information in service continuity planning, for example, when ultra-low latency Access Candidates with ACR are required.

question_11795.question: What is the role of the SMF in charging for PDU sessions and service data flows within PDU sessions?
question_11795.ground_truth: The SMF is responsible for performing converged charging for charging data related to PDU sessions and service data flows within PDU sessions.

question_11796.question: What is the recommend power level offset when performing the EIS procedure for each component carrier other than the one being tested?
question_11796.ground_truth: The power level of each component carrier other than the one being tested should be increased by a fixed offset of 5 dB compared to the current power level of the component carrier under test.

question_11797.question: What is the system that establishes voice or video communication to drivers, with a setup time of NORMAL?

question_11798.question: What action does the UE take after it sends a Detach Accept message and receives a Detach Acknowledge message from the SGSN?
question_11798.ground_truth: If the Detach Type did not request the UE to make a new attach, then the 3G SGSN releases the PS signalling connection.

question_11799.question: What is the objective of the document when it comes to the usage of GBA in web browsers?
question_11799.ground_truth: The document aims to have cryptographic separation between different applications using GBA in web browsers, protect the authentication token for GBA in web browsers from man-in-the-middle attacks, and ensure that the GBA based authentication token is bound to the existing GBA web session between the browser and the web server.

question_11801.question: What are the main drawbacks of using the Inter-Frequency Handover (IFHO) procedure?
question_11801.ground_truth: The main drawbacks of using the Inter-Frequency Handover (IFHO) procedure are continuous re-allocation of system resources, increased RRC signalling (with associated delays), and inefficiency in case of MRAB.

question_11802.question: In what state does the floor control interface send a Floor Taken message to the associated floor participant when in the 'general floor control operation' state machine and the state is 'G: Taken'?
question_11802.ground_truth: The floor control interface shall send a Floor Taken message to the associated floor participant, including the granted MCPTT user's MCPTT ID in the Granted Party's Identity field and the generated audio SSRC to be used by the granted MCPTT participant into the Audio SSRC of Granted Participant field.

question_11804.question: What is the purpose of the Notification IRP in this specification?
question_11804.ground_truth: The Notification IRP in this specification is used as a standard general-purpose mechanism for the management of logs containing selected notifications from the network. It enables historical analysis on faults and conditions that occurred in the network.

question_11805.question: What should an AIPN provide to support multi-access within the same coverage area?
question_11805.ground_truth: Support for appropriate handover between access systems, reachability over multiple access systems, access system-aware services, and optionally simultaneous multi-access.

question_11806.question: What is the recommended architecture for network slice ordering, provisioning and assurance in clause 8.1.2?
question_11806.ground_truth: It is recommended that the architecture depicted in clause 8.1.1 is included in the normative phase as the reference architecture for network slice ordering, provisioning and assurance.

question_11808.question: When should the UE use the stored small data rate control parameters value as the maximum allowed limit of uplink user data?
question_11808.ground_truth: The UE should use the stored small data rate control parameters value as the maximum allowed limit of uplink user data for the corresponding PDU session that becomes transferred after inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode.

question_11809.question: How many bands can a UE that signals support of any bandwidth combination set for carrier aggregation have 2UL simultaneous UL CA UE impact while operating with other systems such as Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and GNSS systems?
question_11809.ground_truth: 2ULs inter-band CA UE can have impacts on up to 32 bands.

question_11810.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 19.4.6?
question_11810.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that after receiving a 403 (Forbidden) response to a registration request, the UE initiates an IMS emergency call without emergency registration.

question_11811.question: What are some factors that influence network sharing arrangements in 3GPP?
question_11811.ground_truth: Factors that influence network sharing arrangements in 3GPP include business, technical, network deployment, and regulatory conditions.

question_11814.question: What is the Rel-13 OTA sensitivity requirement based on in the far field region over the declared OSDD?
question_11814.ground_truth: Meeting a declared EIS value over a declared RoAoA.

question_11815.question: What subclauses describe the default contents of GSM 710 and T-GSM~810 layer 3 messages for RR tests in subclause 26.6?
question_11815.ground_truth: Subclause 26.6.21 and 26.6.22 describe the default contents of GSM 710 and T-GSM~810 layer 3 messages for RR tests, respectively, in subclause 26.6.

question_11816.question: What is the role of the midamble allocation scheme flag in the HS-SCCH type 4 information field mapping?
question_11816.ground_truth: The midamble allocation scheme flag decides the mapping of the channelisation code set information in HS-SCCH type 4 information field mapping.

question_11817.question: What message does the USS send in step 5 of the UUAA procedure?
question_11817.ground_truth: The USS sends an Authentication Response message in step 5 of the UUAA procedure, which includes the GPSI, the UUAA result (success/failure), the authorized CAA-level UAV ID, and a UUAA Authorization Payload that contains UAS security information if the USS has such information to send.

question_11818.question: What should be considered when evaluating the reaction time of the eNB to requests from the UE in terms of processing time?
question_11818.ground_truth: A minimum of 100ms processing time should be considered, along with possible pre-emption by more critical eNB processing such as handovers.

question_11819.question: What is the role of the SMF in event based charging for network slice related usage type?
question_11819.ground_truth: The SMF is responsible for reporting the usage information of network slice for event based charging per PDU session.

question_11821.question: What is the minimum number of Rx antenna ports required for Local Area NCR-MT in all operating bands, except for certain specific bands?
question_11821.ground_truth: A minimum of two Rx antenna ports.

question_11822.question: What are the pre-conditions for a client to transition out of the MBMS MC receive-only mode?
question_11822.ground_truth: The MC service server and the MC service client must have a bidirectional unicast bearer, and the MC service server should use MBMS service for media and media control distribution.

question_11824.question: What is the purpose of the list of entry points in the context of IBCF?
question_11824.ground_truth: The list of entry points is used by the P-CSCF to determine the entry point of the home network when the P-CSCF is located in the visited network and local policy does not require the application of IBCF capabilities towards the home network. The list can be obtained as specified in RFC~3263 or provisioned in the P-CSCF.

question_11825.question: When the UE is located in the home country and the Non-3GPP Access Node Selection Information for the HPLMN is not available, what should the UE attempt first when selecting an N3IWF?
question_11825.ground_truth: The UE should attempt to select an N3IWF following the procedure defined in clause~6.3.6.2.

question_11826.question: What must the UE do before sending an initial INVITE request when there are multiple domains for initiating a call/session?
question_11826.ground_truth: The UE must perform access domain selection in accordance with the appropriate specification for the IP-CAN in use.

question_11827.question: How many frames does it take before pnup reaches 0, signaling the subsequent logic that background noise energy can be updated, if it is not incremented in any of the conditions from the above diagram?
question_11827.ground_truth: It takes at least 6 frames before pnup reaches 0.

question_11829.question: What is the only time an NB-IoT UE is not required to monitor NPDCCH candidates of a Type2A-NPDCCH common search space during the scheduling gap or processing gap?
question_11829.ground_truth: During any scheduling gap or processing gap.

question_11830.question: What is the requirement specified in TS 33.203 clause 7.4.0 for an S-CSCF when receiving an unprotected REGISTER message from the UE?
question_11830.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall authenticate the user by means of the AKA protocol.

question_11831.question: What is one of the main advantages of solution 4 for SRNS relocation with SGSN+ during the preparation phase?
question_11831.ground_truth: The advantage of solution 4 for SRNS relocation with SGSN+ during the preparation phase is that even if the target RNC is breached by an attacker, they cannot determine the keys used by the source RNC+ due to the different key materials used. This ensures one-hop backward security.

question_11833.question: What is the TEST REQUIREMENT for Method of Test 10.2 in the USIM Application Toolkit?
question_11833.ground_truth: The TEST REQUIREMENT for Method of Test 10.2 in the USIM Application Toolkit is that the ME shall operate in the manner defined in Expected Sequence 10.1, which involves DISPLAY TEXT for UCS2-coded Katakana characters of Max length.

question_11834.question: What is the purpose of the test specified in 30.18.3 in relation to sending distortion?
question_11834.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the ratio of signal to total distortion power in the sending direction measured with psophometric noise weighting is as specified in 3GPP TS 26.131.

question_11835.question: What are the two communication paths mentioned for the VR based interactive service?
question_11835.ground_truth: The two communication paths mentioned for the VR based interactive service are the ProSe Communication path (direct) and the 5GC path.

question_11837.question: What level of horizontal positioning accuracy is achieved by Rel.16 in the UMa scenario without modeling synchronization and gNB/UE TX/RX timing errors?
question_11837.ground_truth: A 10 m level @ 90% of horizontal positioning accuracy is achieved by Rel.16 in the UMa scenario without modeling synchronization and gNB/UE TX/RX timing errors.

question_11840.question: What is the purpose of using the Extended Estimation Window (EEW) in E-RUCCH?
question_11840.ground_truth: The EEW is used to prevent the UE from sending unnecessary E-RUCCH by estimating whether there is a valid Grant before sending Scheduling Information. This is particularly useful in determining if there is a Non-scheduled Grant available in the near future.

question_11841.question: What is the role of the NRF in the authorization process?
question_11841.ground_truth: The NRF (Network Repository Function) verifies the CCA and authorizes the NF Service Consumer based on the information contained in the CCA. It also authorizes the SCP to act on behalf of the NF Service Consumer.

question_11842.question: What is the output of the discoverService method in the third step of service discovery?
question_11842.ground_truth: The output of the discoverService method is a list of duplets, each containing a serviceID and a service property list, which provides a list of SCFs matching the requirements from the Application.

question_11843.question: What is the criteria for determining if the first CSI report for SCell is received in a timely matter?
question_11843.ground_truth: The first CSI report for SCell is received in a timely matter if it is received by the SS no later than slot (m+k) (where k is defined in section 7.5.3.4.4.2) or if the slot was subject to interruption, or if the SS is able to monitor CSI reports for SCell sent from the UE before the end of T2.

question_11844.question: What message is used to indicate handover to the same routeing area while in dedicated mode and MM Ready state, and what is its expected content?
question_11844.ground_truth: The message used to indicate handover to the same routeing area while in dedicated mode and MM Ready state is the GTPP Information message, which contains the TLLI of the MS and the LLC PDU.

question_11845.question: What is the maximum allowed Time Alignment Error (TAE) for V2X UE with two transmit antenna connectors in Transmit Diversity scheme?
question_11845.ground_truth: The Time Alignment Error (TAE) shall not exceed 260 ns.

question_11846.question: How does the UE determine the start of the SI-window for the concerned SI message?
question_11846.ground_truth: The UE determines the start of the SI-window for the concerned SI message based on the order of entry in the schedulingInfoList, schedulingInfoListExt, posSchedulingInfoList, and the si-WindowLength, si-Periodicity, or posSI-Periodicity of the concerned SI message.

question_11847.question: What is the typical size range of a XR Viewer Pose associated to time, delivered over the network with latency requirements in the range of 10-20ms?
question_11847.ground_truth: The typical size of a XR Viewer Pose associated to time, delivered over the network with latency requirements in the range of 10-20ms, is several hundred kbit/s and results in packets of size in the range of 30-100 bytes.

question_11849.question: Which element in the MCData function contains the credentials for secondary authentication and authorization method?

question_11850.question: What does the first digit of the version number in 3GPP Technical Specifications and Reports represent?
question_11850.ground_truth: The first digit of the version number in 3GPP Technical Specifications and Reports represents the status of the document in the TSG approval process.

question_11851.question: What are the two ways a floor control server can resolve a request for permission to talk during an ongoing talk burst?
question_11851.ground_truth: If the request has higher priority than the ongoing talk burst, the floor control server can revoke the current talk burst and send a Floor Revoke message to the current talker, and if the request does not have higher priority, the floor control server can reject this request by sending a Floor Deny message to the requester.

question_11852.question: Which parameter does the method "reserveUnitRes()" use to specify the volume of application usage reserved?
question_11852.ground_truth: The method "reserveUnitRes()" uses the parameter "reservedUnits" of the type "TpVolumeSet" to specify the volume of application usage reserved.

question_11853.question: What should the UE do if the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message includes the horizontal derivation parameter indicating "KAMF derivation is required"?
question_11853.ground_truth: The UE shall derive a new K'AMF as specified in 3GPP TS 33.501 and set both uplink and downlink NAS COUNTs to zero.

question_11856.question: When is the UE behavior in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication different from 5GMM-CONNECTED mode over 3GPP access?
question_11856.ground_truth: The UE behavior in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication is different from 5GMM-CONNECTED mode over 3GPP access when the UE has to apply mobility restrictions and perform PLMN selection procedures as in 5GMM-IDLE mode over 3GPP access.

question_11857.question: What should the UE send as part of the L1-SINR report in this test?
question_11857.ground_truth: The UE should send the L1-SINR report for both CSI-RS #0 as CMR + CSI-IM #0 as IMR and CSI-RS #1 as CMR + CSI-IM #1 as IMR, at slot 26 from the reception of the DCI trigger.

question_11858.question: What is the purpose of the provider specified and operator specified tags in the IpQoSTemplate interface?
question_11858.ground_truth: The provider specified tag indicates that the value cannot be modified by the operator and the operator specified tag indicates that the operator can change the default value set by the provider. The unspecified tag indicates that the parameter is not used for this template and cannot be changed by the Enterprise operator.

question_11860.question: What is the effect of a PDP context deactivation on SNDCP XID negotiation in 3GPP?
question_11860.ground_truth: A PDP context deactivation triggers an SNDCP XID negotiation to remove the NSAPI from the Applicable NSAPIs of the compression entity.

question_11861.question: In what state does a UE consider the current frequency to be the lowest priority, if it only has dedicated priorities other than for the current frequency while in the camped normally state?
question_11861.ground_truth: The current frequency is considered to be the lowest priority frequency for a UE, if it only has dedicated priorities other than for the current frequency while in the camped normally state.

question_11862.question: What happens to the session if the in-progress emergency private priority state cancel request is rejected?
question_11862.ground_truth: The state of the session does not change, i.e. continues with MCVideo emergency private call level priority.

question_11863.question: What is the minimum number of occurrences of the "restricted-discovery-filter" element in the "RestrictedMonitorRsp-info" complex type?
question_11863.ground_truth: The "restricted-discovery-filter" element in the "RestrictedMonitorRsp-info" complex type has a minimum occurrence of 0, which means it can occur zero or more times.

question_11864.question: What is the definition of IMS Centralized Services (ICS) as provided in the document?
question_11864.ground_truth: ICS is the provision of communication services wherein services and service control are based on IMS mechanisms and enablers, and support is provided for a diversity of access networks (including circuit switched and IP based, wireless and wireline), and for service continuity between access networks.

question_11866.question: What is the purpose of the Allocation Retention Priority (ARP) parameter in the 5G System?
question_11866.ground_truth: The ARP parameter contains information about the priority level, pre-emption capability, and pre-emption vulnerability. It is used to decide whether a bearer/flow establishment or modification request can be accepted or needs to be rejected in case of resource limitations.

question_11867.question: What is responsible forprotecting the group message in the SCEF?
question_11867.ground_truth: The SCEF protects the group message using the group security credentials.

question_11869.question: What is the CSG Mobility List used for in cellular networks?
question_11869.ground_truth: The CSG Mobility List is a list of TAs of CSG cells provided to the UE where the UE can access those TAs without performing any EMM procedure (e.g. tracking area updating procedure).

question_11870.question: What is the purpose of the architecture of 5GC that allows virtualized deployment of NF services?
question_11870.ground_truth: The purpose is to avoid and/or mitigate overload situations by scaling the virtualized instances of the NF service in some deployments.

question_11871.question: When is the base layer bitstream obtained via external means in the SHVC architecture?
question_11871.ground_truth: The base layer bitstream is obtained via external means when it is coded using a non-HEVC single-layer codec, or through other system-level multiplexing methods. This is referred to as hybrid codec scalability and allows SHVC to support non-HEVC coded base layer bitstreams.

question_11873.question: What type of data does the <user-max-simultaneous-authorizations> element indicate in the <anyExt> element contained in the <OnNetwork> element?
question_11873.ground_truth: The <user-max-simultaneous-authorizations> element indicates the maximum allowed number of simultaneous service authorizations for the MCVideo user.

question_11874.question: What is the role of the UE in establishing a TCP connection with the IMS-AGW?
question_11874.ground_truth: The UE is responsible for completing the TCP connection establishment with the IMS-AGW by answering the TCP SYN sent by the IMS-AGW.

question_11875.question: In which scenario will the UE consider the ThreshBackhRateULWLANLowRAN node as not matching?
question_11875.ground_truth: The UE will consider the ThreshBackhRateULWLANLowRAN node as not matching if the ThreshBackhRateULWLANLowRAN leaf is present and the ThreshBackhRateULWLANLow threshold value has not been received from E-UTRAN/UTRAN.

question_11876.question: What is the effect of supporting mission critical services for MCPTT over the II-NNI?
question_11876.ground_truth: The "g.3gpp.mcptt" media feature tag in the Contact header field, the Content-Type header field with the value "multipart/mixed", and the "application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml" MIME body shall be supported at the II-NNI. The Warning header field with the warn-code set to "399" and with the warn-text set to a quoted-string shall also be supported.

question_11877.question: What must the ME do when the MS originates a Multi-party call and receives Facility IEs containing CAI elements for each chargeable call?
question_11877.ground_truth: The ME must record the sum of all the charges for the services currently being used and insert the correct charge in the ACM field of the SIM.

question_11878.question: What are the two possible outcomes if a measurement job is not completed and an indication of validity of the result value(s) is required?
question_11878.ground_truth: The two possible outcomes are: the result value(s) are valid or the result value(s) are invalid and an indication of the reason is provided.

question_11879.question: What is the command type used in the "TERMINAL RESPONSE" command with sequence 1.4.1B?
question_11879.ground_truth: The command type used in the "TERMINAL RESPONSE" command with sequence 1.4.1B is "SEND SS".

question_11880.question: What does the MS do after the fifth expiry of the timer T3380?
question_11880.ground_truth: The MS releases all resources possibly allocated for this invocation and aborts the procedure; no automatic secondary PDP context activation re-attempt is performed.

question_11881.question: What is the purpose of the V2X authorization procedure?
question_11881.ground_truth: The V2X authorization procedure enables the UE to retrieve V2X communication parameters from the V2X control function.

question_11883.question: What are the two main architectural scenarios covered in the 3GPP Technical Report on NR-based access to unlicensed spectrum?
question_11883.ground_truth: The two main architectural scenarios covered in the report are (1) an NR-based LAA cell connects with an LTE or NR anchor cell operating in licensed spectrum, with the linking techniques assumed following the NR WI, and (2) an NR-based cell operating standalone in unlicensed spectrum, connected to a 5G-CN network, for private network deployments.

question_11884.question: What network element enforces the APN-AMBR?

question_11885.question: What is the significance of the version numbering system used in the 3GPP TS?
question_11885.ground_truth: The version numbering system used in the 3GPP TS indicates the status of the document and any changes made to it. The first digit indicates whether the document is presented for information, approval, or under change control. The second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, and the third digit is incremented when editorial changes are made.

question_11886.question: What are the aspects that need to be addressed for extending the current single and dual cluster allocation to allow multi-cluster in LAA UL transmissions?
question_11886.ground_truth: The aspects that need to be addressed for extending the current single and dual cluster allocation to allow multi-cluster in LAA UL transmissions are the number of clusters needed, the size of each cluster, and the spacing between clusters or subcarriers.

question_11887.question: What action does MSISDN-less IMS UE 2 take when it successfully parses the SMS payload?
question_11887.ground_truth: MSISDN-less IMS UE 2 returns a RP-ACK encapsulated in a SIP MESSAGE to S-CSCF, including MSISDN-less terminating code and MSISDN-less IMS UE 1 (originator) and MSISDN-less IMS UE 2 (recipient) addresses in the user data body.

question_11888.question: What is used to calculate the spectral sparseness of a frame in this process?
question_11888.ground_truth: The sum of the log energy spectrum is calculated to determine the spectral sparseness of a frame.

question_11889.question: What procedures should the MRFP follow when the MRFC sends an initial SDP offer for BFCP media?
question_11889.ground_truth: If the MRFC sends an initial SDP offer towards the served UE for BFCP media, the MRFP should act as a TLS client.

question_11890.question: What should the UE do if there is a transmission failure during a security mode control procedure triggered by a registration or service request?
question_11890.ground_truth: If there is a transmission failure during a security mode control procedure triggered by a registration or service request, the UE should abort the procedure and re-initiate the registration procedure if the current TAI is not in the TAI list, or re-run the ongoing procedure that triggered the security mode control procedure if the current TAI is still part of the TAI list.

question_11891.question: What is the condition for the AMF to perform a network triggered Service Request procedure when the UE is in CM-IDLE and RM-REGISTERED state?
question_11891.ground_truth: The AMF performs a network triggered Service Request procedure when it has signalling or mobile-terminated data to be sent to this UE, by sending a Paging Request to this UE, if a UE is not prevented from responding e.g. due to MICO mode or Mobility Restrictions.

question_11892.question: When will the UE initiate a first measurement report when the purpose is set to 'reportStrongestCellsForSON'?
question_11892.ground_truth: The UE initiates a first measurement report when it has determined the strongest cells on the associated frequency.

question_11893.question: What is the mandatory payload format parameter for AMR and AMR-WB encoded media that the MTSI MGW should support?
question_11893.ground_truth: The MTSI MGW shall support octet-align, mode-set, mode-change-period, mode-change-capability, mode-change-neighbor, maxptime, ptime, channels and max-red.

question_11894.question: What are the two performance requirements specified in the Stage-1 requirements for the evaluation of E-UTRA procedures for group communication?
question_11894.ground_truth: The two performance requirements specified in the Stage-1 requirements for the evaluation of E-UTRA procedures for group communication are: (1) end-to-end setup time for group communication should be less than or equal to 300ms, (2) time to join an ongoing group communication should be less than or equal to 300ms.

question_11895.question: What action does the gsmSSF take if there is no gap interval active for call gapping?
question_11895.ground_truth: An "InitialDP" operation may be sent including the "cGEncountered" parameter in accordance with the specified controlType. A new gap interval shall be initiated as indicated by "gapInterval".

question_11896.question: What is the main Phase 2 change request that combined GSM900 and DCS1800 specifications?
question_11896.ground_truth: CR 05.01-04 "Combination of GSM900 and DCS1800 specifications" is the main Phase 2 change request that combined GSM900 and DCS1800 specifications.

question_11898.question: What is the channel bandwidth (in MHz) for category NB1 and NB2?

question_11899.question: What information is transferred via the UPF during the authentication procedure between the SMF and the DN-AAA?
question_11899.ground_truth: The UPF transparently relays messages related to the authentication procedure between the SMF and the DN-AAA Server.

question_11901.question: What protocol is used to transport files in MBMS download?

question_11903.question: What is the definition of "far apart" areas for reusing eNB IDs in Solution 3?
question_11903.ground_truth: "Far apart" areas are defined as areas where the probability of a UE in Area A detecting an eNB in Area B is not significant, the interference by an Area A eNB in Area B is not significant, and the two areas have no need for an eNB to detect each other based on UE measurements or interfere with each other.

question_11904.question: Which protocol sends timing deviation measurements from Node B to SRNC?
question_11904.ground_truth: Rx Timing Deviation Frame Protocol sends timing deviation measurements from Node B to SRNC.
