question_12546.ground_truth: The procedure described in clause~4.23.4.2 is used when both I-SMF and SMF are available for a PDU session and no I-SMF change or removal is needed during the service request procedure.

question_12547.question: What is the procedure when a GMM common message is received by the MS while waiting for a DETACH ACCEPT message with a detach cause different from "power off"?
question_12547.ground_truth: The MS shall ignore the GMM common message.

question_12548.question: What action should the network take when it receives a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message with an unassigned or reserved PTI value?
question_12548.ground_truth: The network should respond with a PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message including ESM cause #81 "invalid PTI value".

question_12549.question: How is a unique identifier generated for a PDN connection in the SCEF?
question_12549.ground_truth: The SCEF generates a unique identifier when creating a PDN connection, which is forwarded to the MME to allow correlation of MME PDN connection CDRs with SCEF CDRs in the BD.

question_12550.question: What is the difference between Client-side and Server-side Request Interceptor?
question_12550.ground_truth: Client-side Request Interceptor is between the client application layer and CORBA ORB layer, while Server-side Request Interceptor is between the server application layer and CORBA ORB layer. The Client-side Interceptor intercepts the request information exchanged between the client and server, while the Server-side Interceptor intercepts the resulting information.

question_12554.question: When should a UE report a truncated BSR?
question_12554.ground_truth: A UE should report a truncated BSR if more than one logical channel group (LCG) has data available for transmission in the TTI where the BSR is transmitted, and the number of padding bits is equal to or larger than the size of the short BSR plus its subheader but smaller than the size of the long BSR plus its subheader.

question_12555.question: What should the mobile station do when it receives an uplink assignment message but does not have an existing uplink TBF?
question_12555.ground_truth: The mobile station should perform an abnormal release with access retry.

question_12556.question: In which situations should a UE ignore an RRC message?
question_12556.ground_truth: A UE should ignore an RRC message when receiving it on the BCCH, CCCH, PCCH, or MCCH, and the abstract syntax is invalid.

question_12557.question: What is the difference between a generic and roaming partner specific data-type encryption policy?
question_12557.ground_truth: A generic data-type encryption policy applies to all roaming partners, while a roaming partner specific data-type encryption policy applies only to a specific roaming partner and takes precedence over a generic data-type encryption policy if present.

question_12558.question: In the context of FRMCS User relocating towards a Visited (FRMCS) Network, what is one requirement for the Visited (FRMCS) Network in order to support this use case?
question_12558.ground_truth: The Visited (FRMCS) Network must be capable of retrieving FRMCS Users information from the applicable Home FRMCS network.

question_12559.question: How should the weighting values for non-deployed scenarios be treated in the context of global system deployment?
question_12559.ground_truth: The weighting values for non-deployed scenarios should be set to zero, as they are not contributing to the energy efficiency of the system.

question_12560.question: What are the requirements for an NR SCell to cause interruption to active serving cells in MCG during dormancy switching, if the UE is capable of per-FR gap and the switching does not involve SCS changing?
question_12560.ground_truth: The NR SCell on which the dormancy switching occurs must belong to FR1.

question_12562.question: What is the mobility solution that NR mobility enhancements specify for reducing interruption time during HO?
question_12562.ground_truth: The NR mobility enhancements specify Dual Active Protocol Stack (DAPS) handover to reduce interruption time during HO.

question_12563.question: What is the function of the Sharing-Key-DL AVP, and how should it be used for media components across AF sessions for the same user?
question_12563.ground_truth: The Sharing-Key-DL AVP is used to identify what media components may share resources in the downlink direction. If resource sharing applies between media components across AF sessions for the same user, the same value of the Sharing-Key-DL AVP should be used.

question_12564.question: What is the difference in consequences between HNB and HeNB regarding UP encryption?
question_12564.ground_truth: In HNB there are two UMTS cases for UP encryption, while in HeNB there is only one LTE case. The main difference is that in HNB UP encryption can terminate within the HNB, while in HeNB it cannot.

question_12566.question: What actions should the source EES take after a successful EEC Context Relocation procedure at EEC (re-)registration to a target EES?
question_12566.ground_truth: The source EES determines the corresponding EEC Context to be stale and the EEC to be de-registered.

question_12568.question: Which reference point, as defined in section 4.3.6, is used for the S-CSCF to provide IMS-specific presence information?
question_12568.ground_truth: The Pi reference point, as defined in section 4.3.6, is used for the S-CSCF to provide IMS-specific presence information.

question_12569.question: What is the "transport bearer" used for in the simulated cell 1 scenario?
question_12569.ground_truth: The "transport bearer" used for in the simulated cell 1 scenario is the default parameters for the basic E-UTRA Single cell network scenarios, as defined in TS 36.508.

question_12570.question: What is the result of a successful 5G authentication process?
question_12570.ground_truth: An EMSK is established from the keying materials obtained in step 16, the AUSF derives the KAUSF from the EMSK, and an EAP-Success message is sent to the UE.

question_12571.question: What is the minimum mean power received at the UE antenna port for the HS-PDSCH in DC-HSDPA, where the BLER on each individual cell should not exceed 0.1?
question_12571.ground_truth: The reference sensitivity level <REFSENS> for DC-HSDPA.

question_12573.question: What is the name of the function on the UE for establishing, controlling and supporting the delivery of a media session in 5G Media delivery?

question_12574.question: Which criteria are important for determining whether User Peer functionality can be enabled or disabled on PC/Laptop type of UEs vs mobile handsets type of UEs?
question_12574.ground_truth: The key factor for enabling User Peer functionality on PC/Laptop type of UEs is the upload/download bandwidth, while for mobile handsets type of UEs, the crucial factors are storage space, computing capability, and battery, which are usually limited.

question_12575.question: What is the recommended action for the network and UE to support the Network Identity part of the Network Identity and Time Zone (NITZ) feature?
question_12575.ground_truth: It is recommended for the network and the UE to support the Network Identity part of the Network Identity and Time Zone (NITZ) feature to provide the UE with the name of the serving PLMN operator.

question_12578.question: What is the purpose of the tunnel management procedures described in subclause 7.3.3?
question_12578.ground_truth: The purpose of the tunnel management procedures described in subclause 7.3.3 is to define the procedures for establishment or disconnection of an end-to-end tunnel between the UE and the ePDG.

question_12579.question: What is the mean DL Average-UPT gain for operator 2 when using SBFD Alt 2 and large packet size at low load level?
question_12579.ground_truth: The mean DL Average-UPT gain for operator 2 when using SBFD Alt 2 and large packet size at low load level is 5.22%.

question_12580.question: What should the MS do when it receives a REQUEST PDP CONTEXT ACTIVATION message, MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message, DEACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message, REQUEST SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT ACTIVATION message or REQUEST MBMS CONTEXT ACTIVATION message?
question_12580.ground_truth: The MS shall stop timer T3340 and may send uplink signalling via the existing PS signalling connection.

question_12581.question: What is the channel identifier used in SC Mode 1?
question_12581.ground_truth: The channel identifier used in SC Mode 1 is 1 as an example.

question_12584.question: In the context of RF-ParametersMRDC, what does the term "NEDC" in "supportedBandCombinationListNEDC-Only" and "supportedBandCombinationListNEDC-Only-v15a0" stand for?
question_12584.ground_truth: Non-Evolved Darfon Combination for New Radio

question_12586.question: What is the name of the interfering signal with the lowest signal level in the test scenario?

question_12588.question: How many E-UTRA TDD carriers and cells are specified in the test?
question_12588.ground_truth: There are two E-UTRA TDD carriers and two cells specified in the test.

question_12589.question: What type is used for the source-IP-address attribute in the Transmitter-info complex type and what is its data type?

question_12594.question: What deployment scenario requires a vertical 3rd party to deploy the full network infrastructure for a standalone non-public network at the desired location?
question_12594.ground_truth: The first deployment scenario, where neither 5GC nor NG-RAN infrastructure is available at the desired location.

question_12595.question: What is the recommended bitrate value R2 in the described uplink bitrate boost scenario?
question_12595.ground_truth: The recommended bitrate value R2 is higher than R0 but lower than R1.

question_12596.question: What must be supported by each implementation concerning measurement result transfer to an external OS?
question_12596.ground_truth: Each implementation must support a file transfer facility to an external OS, such as an NM, implemented using FTAM ISO 8571, (T)FTP protocol, or FTIRP, located either in the NEs or the EM.

question_12599.question: What is the default behavior when the samplePercentage attribute is not present in a delivery session?
question_12599.ground_truth: The default behavior is that each UE which entered the associated session shall send a reception report.

question_12600.question: What is the purpose of the service information in the present document?
question_12600.ground_truth: Service information is out of scope for standardization, but it can contain any information, such as a URL or media access information, used by an application to access a service.

question_12602.question: What system information messages are defined in 5.4.7.2 or 5.4.8.2 for use in out-of-coverage communication?
question_12602.ground_truth: No system information messages are defined in 5.4.7.2 or 5.4.8.2 for use in out-of-coverage communication as it is not applicable.

question_12603.question: Which term is used to indicate a mandatory requirement to do something in the context of the present document?
question_12603.ground_truth: The term "shall" is used to indicate a mandatory requirement to do something in the context of the present document.

question_12604.question: How does the NG-RAN determine or adjust the BAT offsets for UL and DL directions in the solution?
question_12604.ground_truth: The NG-RAN determines the BAT offset for UL direction based on the BAT in UL direction received from the SMF in TSCAI and the upstream scheduling in Uu reference point. The NG-RAN may adjust the offset value based on the upstream scheduling in Uu reference point. Similarly, the NG-RAN can determine a BAT offset for DL direction based on the BAT in DL direction received from the SMF in TSCAI and the downstream scheduling in Uu reference point.

question_12605.question: What is the measurement method for the OTA REFSENS requirement?
question_12605.ground_truth: The measurement methods for the OTA REFSENS requirement are the same as those for the OTA sensitivity requirement, except that the required level is EISREFSENS in the measurement procedure.

question_12606.question: What is one of the general architecture principles used when developing solutions for LBO and OMR in single PLMN and roaming scenarios?
question_12606.ground_truth: Backward compatibility shall be maintained, with UE battery consumption and cost as considerations. UE shall not use the same IP address simultaneously across multiple accesses.

question_12608.question: In the 5G ProSe direct link modification procedure, what operation code is used to remove a 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE from the existing 5G ProSe direct link?
question_12608.ground_truth: The operation code set to "Remove 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE from the existing 5G ProSe direct link".

question_12609.question: What should the P-GW do with the user plane data that has the "reporting indication" encapsulated in the header?
question_12609.ground_truth: After the P-GW extract the data usage reporting from the user plane data with the "reporting indication", P-GW can obsolete the user plane data.

question_12612.question: Which element does the <QoS-management-provision-response> include in XML schema?
question_12612.ground_truth: The <QoS-management-provision-response> includes a <server-id> element and a <requested-QoS-parameters> element in XML schema.

question_12613.question: In step 4.12.1, how should a single carrier be chosen for the RF channels B, M and T?
question_12613.ground_truth: The tests should be performed with a single carrier at each of the RF channels B, M and T.

question_12614.question: What is the test applicability for spurious emissions in inter-band CA between NR FR1 and FR2 in clause 6.5A.3.1.2?
question_12614.ground_truth: The requirements for spurious emission and UE co-existence are tested for each component carrier in NR FR1 and FR2.

question_12615.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG RAN) study on latency reduction techniques for LTE in Release 14?
question_12615.ground_truth: The purpose of this study is to capture the findings from TSG RAN WG2 and WG1, and to draw a conclusion on the way forward for reducing latency in LTE systems. This activity involves the Radio Access work area of the 3GPP studies and has potential impacts on the Mobile Equipment and Access Network of the 3GPP systems.

question_12616.question: When is ML Model Filter Information parameter required when requesting an ML model?
question_12616.ground_truth: ML Model Filter Information parameter is used to enable NWDAF containing MTLF to select which ML model for the analytics is requested, e.g. S-NSSAI, Area of Interest. It is required when requesting an ML model if the user wants to select a specific ML model for the analytics.

question_12618.question: Which requirement supports resource-efficient discovery mechanisms for devices?
question_12618.ground_truth: PR.5.3.3.5-001 states that the 3GPP system shall efficiently support service discovery mechanisms where devices can discover status, capabilities, and services of other devices.

question_12619.question: What is the UP Function required to indicate in the UP function feature IE during PFCP Association Setup procedure for L2TP support?
question_12619.ground_truth: The UP Function is required to indicate its support of L2TP in the UP function feature IE during PFCP Association Setup procedure.

question_12620.question: What should a Mobile Station (MS) do when it receives a message and diagnoses a "missing mandatory IE" error?
question_12620.ground_truth: If the message is a DISCONNECT message, a RELEASE message should be returned with cause value # 96 "invalid mandatory information" and normal call clearing applies.

question_12621.question: What message is used to report the uplink and downlink data volumes of used NR resources to the EPC on a per EPS bearer basis in EN-DC?
question_12621.ground_truth: The Secondary RAT Data Usage Report message is used to report the uplink and downlink data volumes of used NR resources to the EPC on a per EPS bearer basis in EN-DC.

question_12622.question: What must the DS-TT support for receiving network timing synchronization status information?
question_12622.ground_truth: The DS-TT must support receiving network timing synchronization status information for receiving PTP messages.

question_12623.question: What should the gNB-CU consider if the C-RNTI IE is included in the UE CONTEXT SETUP RESPONSE message?
question_12623.ground_truth: The gNB-CU should consider that the C-RNTI has been allocated by the gNB-DU for this UE context.

question_12624.question: What is the test purpose for expected sequence 3.1?
question_12624.ground_truth: The test purpose for expected sequence 3.1 is to verify that the ME can handle a GET INKEY command with a UCS2-coded text string and return the result.

question_12626.question: What is the maximum duration of test for GSM700, GSM850, and GSM900?
question_12626.ground_truth: The maximum duration of test for GSM700, GSM850, and GSM900 is 15 minutes.

question_12627.question: Who are the NFs that can provide input to the PCF for PCC decision-making?
question_12627.ground_truth: The NFs that can provide input to the PCF for PCC decision-making are the SMF, the AMF, the CHF, the NWDAF if present, the UDR, and the AF if the AF is involved.

question_12628.question: How many instances of Subsequent Authorized Session-AMBR and Subsequent Authorized default 5QI/ARP can be provided by the PCF with Time Condition parameter?
question_12628.ground_truth: Up to four instances with different values of the Time Condition parameter can be provided by the PCF.

question_12629.question: What are the scheduling restrictions when a UE is measuring SS-RSRP or SS-SINR on an FR2 intra-frequency cell and deriveSSB-IndexFromCell is not enabled?
question_12629.ground_truth: If deriveSSB-IndexFromCell is not enabled, the UE is not expected to transmit PUCCH/PUSCH/SRS or receive PDCCH/PDSCH/TRS/CSI-RS for CQI on all symbols within the SMTC window duration.

question_12631.question: Which component is mandatory in the "DSCH-InformationResponseList-RL-AdditionRspTDD-RL-AdditionRspTDD" sequence?

question_12632.question: For which codecs the MTSI clients in terminal using fixed access shall support encapsulating up to 4 non-redundant speech frames into the RTP packets and 12 speech frames in total if redundancy is used in the RTP packet?
question_12632.ground_truth: The MTSI clients in terminal using fixed access shall support encapsulating up to 4 non-redundant speech frames into the RTP packets and 12 speech frames in total if redundancy is used for AMR, AMR-WB, EVS, G.711, G.722, G.729, EVRC and EVRC-B.

question_12633.question: What action does the PCF take if the request is authorized and the required QoS is allowed?
question_12633.ground_truth: The PCF derives the required QoS parameters based on the received MBS Service Information and determines whether this QoS is allowed. If the required QoS is allowed, the PCF generates the policy information for the MBS session and stores it together with the MBS Session ID.

question_12634.question: What is the role of the GAA Server in 3GPP TS 33.234?
question_12634.ground_truth: The GAA Server is responsible for communicating with the SIM/USIM/ISIM application in the UICC, and with external entities for possible key generation processes. It also functions as a public API towards the GAA Clients in the terminal.

question_12636.question: In spatial audio setups, what are the three primary signal types that can describe 3-dimensional audio as necessary for an immersive VR experience?
question_12636.ground_truth: Channel, Object and Scene-based audio representations.

question_12637.question: How many unique base layer ratios were used for encoding the SVC streams?
question_12637.ground_truth: Two unique base layer ratios, roughly 30% and 50%, were used for encoding the SVC streams.

question_12638.question: What does the cancelMessageRes() method indicate after its execution?
question_12638.ground_truth: The cancelMessageRes() method indicates a successful execution of a cancelMessageReq() method by the SCS.

question_12640.question: What action does the PGW-C take when initiating the procedures with handover from 3GPP access?
question_12640.ground_truth: The PGW-C allocates F-TEIDu for each and every bearer, and sends an Sx Session Establishment Request to the selected PGW-U for modifying the Sx session for the UE.

question_12641.question: What should the UE do to request policy provisioning from the PCF after registration?
question_12641.ground_truth: The UE includes a "UE POLICY PROVISIONING REQUEST" message defined in clause~X.X.XX of 3GPP~TS~XX.XXX during the NAS transport procedure.

question_12642.question: What action does the NSACF take when the update flag is set to "UPDATE" for a Single-Access PDU session?
question_12642.ground_truth: If the update flag is set to "UPDATE" for a Single-Access PDU session, the NSACF shall locate the existing entry in the PDU registration list and update the access type associated to the PDU session to which indicated in the request message.

question_12645.question: What is the structure of the PDUSessionResourceFailedToSetupItemCxtRes data type, which is a sequence of PDUSessionResourceFailedToSetupItemCxtRes?
question_12645.ground_truth: Each instance of PDUSessionResourceFailedToSetupItemCxtRes contains a PDUSessionID, a PDUSessionResourceSetupUnsuccessfulTransfer, and an optional ProtocolExtensionContainer.

question_12646.question: What determines the priority level, pre-emption capability, and pre-emption vulnerability of a QoS flow in 3GPP~TS~23.501?
question_12646.ground_truth: The QoS parameter Allocation Retentions Priority (ARP) determines the priority level, pre-emption capability, and pre-emption vulnerability of each QoS flow in 3GPP~TS~23.501.

question_12647.question: Which metric indicates the waiting time that the user experiences for media start-up, and is only logged at the time point when the media start-up happens?

question_12649.question: What should the UE do upon detection of a connection resume failure in NR?
question_12649.ground_truth: The UE should store the connection resume failure information in VarConnEstFailReport and clear VarConnEstFailReport upon successful establishment of RRC connection.

question_12650.question: What is the purpose of the "iE-Extensions" field in the "Cells-to-be-Deactivated-List-Item"?
question_12650.ground_truth: The "iE-Extensions" field in the "Cells-to-be-Deactivated-List-Item" is a ProtocolExtensionContainer containing a list of Cells-to-be-Deactivated-ExtIEs that extends the IE.

question_12652.question: What is the format of Initiating Message in E1AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?
question_12652.ground_truth: Initiating Message in E1AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE is a SEQUENCE of three elements: procedureCode, criticality, and value.

question_12655.question: What is the minimum number of successful tests required for the test to pass in clause 8.2.3.2.5?
question_12655.ground_truth: The total number of successful tests should be at least 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

question_12656.question: What is required in the `<trigger-id>` element when it is included in the `<geometry-area>` element?
question_12656.ground_truth: A `<geographical-area>` element should be included, and it should include either a `<polygon-area>` or `<ellipsoid-arc-area>` element.

question_12657.question: What are the MBMS notifications specific fields that define the Application Paging message?
question_12657.ground_truth: The SSRC field, the MCPTT Group ID field, and the MBMS subchannel field

question_12659.question: What component is the enforcement point for user consent in the described NTN-RAN use case?
question_12659.ground_truth: The NTN-RAN is the enforcement point for user consent in the described NTN-RAN use case.

question_12660.question: Which parameter is being used in "cap-InformationObjects" for "CAP-operationcodes" and "CAP-IMS-classes"?
question_12660.ground_truth: The parameter being used in "cap-InformationObjects" for "CAP-operationcodes" and "CAP-IMS-classes" is "opcode-activityTest, opcode-applyCharging, opcode-applyChargingReport, ...".

question_12661.question: What are the user plane modes supported for the Full MBMS service mode in the IP-based mode of the pass-through system?
question_12661.ground_truth: The user plane modes supported for the Full MBMS service mode are DASH Streaming Services using the appropriate 3GPP profile, RTP Streaming service using the appropriate 3GPP profile, and File-delivery services for which the content complies with the appropriate 3GPP profile.

question_12662.question: What message does the network include in the LOCATION UPDATING ACCEPT message?
question_12662.ground_truth: The network includes the new TMSI in the LOCATION UPDATING ACCEPT message.

question_12664.question: What is the role of the MTC-IWF in the 3GPP MTC architecture?
question_12664.ground_truth: The MTC-IWF is responsible for connecting to the 3GPP network to communicate with UEs used for MTC and nodes in the PLMN. It supports the indirect and hybrid models of MTC.

question_12665.question: What are the two types of cell coverage that NGSO satellites can provide?
question_12665.ground_truth: NGSO satellites can provide either quasi-Earth-fixed cell coverage or Earth-moving cell coverage.

question_12666.question: What does the Proxy Function in a Domestic Service Provider (DSP) specify?
question_12666.ground_truth: The Proxy Function in a DSP specifies the architecture and functions of the Proxy Function logical components, which derives the functionality of the Proxy Function interfaces.

question_12667.question: What is the difference between direct and indirect interaction models in the 5G Service Based Architecture?
question_12667.ground_truth: Direct interaction models involve direct communication between NFs or NF services while indirect interaction models involve intermediaries, such as a Service Communication Proxy (SCP) for routing requests from NF service consumers to NF service producers. The direct interaction models can be more efficient but may not provide as much flexibility in terms of load management and service discovery. Indirect interaction models provide more flexibility in these areas but come at the cost of increased complexity.

question_12668.question: What is the responsibility of the PLMN level NRF while supporting location services for UEs accessing via a mobile IAB node?
question_12668.ground_truth: The PLMN level NRF stores the association of IAB-UE ID, the identifier of AMF serving IAB-UE, and Cell ID of IAB node. It also supports finding an IAB-UE ID and the identifier of AMF serving IAB-UE based on the Cell ID.

question_12669.question: What does the term "concurrent operation" refer to in the context of the present document?
question_12669.ground_truth: Concurrent operation refers to the simultaneous transmission and reception of sidelink and Uu interfaces, irrespective of TDM mode and FDM mode, while operation is agnostic of the service used on each interface.

question_12671.question: How should the NF service consumer discover API version(s) supported by an NF service producer?
question_12671.ground_truth: The NF service consumer can use NRF query or NF status change notifications to discover the API version(s) supported by an NF service producer.

question_12672.question: What is the expected response of the UE in step 2 of the test procedure?
question_12672.ground_truth: In step 2 of the test procedure, the UE should send a second Registration message indicating that the received 401 Unauthorized message was invalid.

question_12673.question: What should the network do, if the AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message is received with 5GMM cause #20 "MAC failure"?
question_12673.ground_truth: If the network receives an AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message with 5GMM cause #20 "MAC failure", the network should abort the 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure and any ongoing 5GMM specific procedure and release the N1 NAS signalling connection.

question_12674.question: What should the UE do when there are multiple applicable Tsor-cm timers for different ongoing PDU sessions or services?
question_12674.ground_truth: If there are multiple applicable Tsor-cm timers for different ongoing PDU sessions or services, the UE should start all the applicable Tsor-cm timers and follow the further handling described in clause~C.4.2.

question_12676.question: What should be the network's response if the IMS service is denied to end-users due to service termination?
question_12676.ground_truth: The network should provide UEs with an indication of the reason the service has been released or rejected.

question_12678.question: What action is taken by the SGSN when it cannot deliver the SM to the MS in a mobile-terminated SMS transfer?
question_12678.ground_truth: The SGSN sets the Mobile station Not Reachable for GPRS flag (MNRG), and returns a failure report to the SMS-GMSC.

question_12680.question: What is the purpose of generating re-synchronisation token in the USIM?
question_12680.ground_truth: The re-synchronisation token is generated in the USIM upon the assertion of a synchronisation failure, it is used to provide data origin authentication for the synchronisation failure information sent by the USIM to the AuC and to provide user identity confidentiality during re-synchronisation.

question_12683.question: What is the total delay measured when DRX cycle length is 1280 ms, as defined in the inter-frequency identification requirements?

question_12684.question: What is the role of the authorization function in the API exposed by GPSI?
question_12684.ground_truth: The authorization function in the API exposed by GPSI receives the resource owner information during the resource owner registration and retrieves the resource owner information when the service API invocation indicates the resource owner client.

question_12686.question: Who can initiate a Ranging/SL positioning service request in this solution?
question_12686.ground_truth: A Ranging/SL positioning service request can be initiated by a UE that is one of the two UEs subject to Ranging/SL positioning (i.e. UE1 and UE2) or by a SL Positioning Client UE.

question_12687.question: What is the formula used by the PSA UPF to calculate the UL packet delay or round trip time if NG-RAN and PSA UPF are not time synchronized?
question_12687.ground_truth: The formula used by the PSA UPF to calculate the UL/DL packet delay between NG-RAN and anchor PSA UPF if not time synchronized is (T2-T1+T4-T3)/2.

question_12688.question: What are the conditions under which the E-CSCF adds the PSAP URI to the topmost Route header field?
question_12688.ground_truth: The E-CSCF adds the PSAP URI to the topmost Route header field if operator policy determines that the E-CSCF selects the PSAP and if, based on the location information contained in the INVITE request, the E-CSCF fails to select the PSAP.

question_12689.question: What is the value range for a tThreeByteType?
question_12689.ground_truth: The value range for a tThreeByteType is from 0 to 16777215.

question_12691.question: Under what circumstances is the CTSPCH indicator flag set to "CTSPCH~to~decode"?
question_12691.ground_truth: The CTSPCH indicator flag is set to "CTSPCH~to~decode" when the CTS-FP initiates the alive check or hunting procedure.

question_12693.question: What is the maximum number of subframes indicated by the Number of Subframes field for FDD and 1.28Mcps TDD?
question_12693.ground_truth: The maximum number of subframes indicated is 16.

question_12695.question: What type of authentication is used for trusted non-3GPP access?
question_12695.ground_truth: For trusted non-3GPP access, the UE uses 3GPP-based authentication for connecting to the non-3GPP access.

question_12696.question: What are the two options for the anchor key (KAKMA) lifetimes in the solution?
question_12696.ground_truth: The two options for the anchor key (KAKMA) lifetimes are implicit lifetime and explicit lifetime.

question_12697.question: What is the maximum criticality level that can be assigned to a ProtocolIE-Container in the EUTRAN-BearerContextModificationRequest choice?
question_12697.ground_truth: The maximum criticality level that can be assigned to a ProtocolIE-Container in the EUTRAN-BearerContextModificationRequest choice is reject.

question_12699.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 6.4A.1.1.4?
question_12699.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in 6.4A.1.1.4 is to verify the ability of both the receiver and the transmitter to process frequency correctly.

question_12701.question: What is the format of the From header in the SIP MESSAGE request?
question_12701.ground_truth: The From header shall contain a public user identity of the SM-over-IP receiver.

question_12703.question: What is the unit and type of the RAB Establishment Success Rate KPI?
question_12703.ground_truth: The unit of this KPI is percentage and its type is RATIO.

question_12704.question: What should the UE do when editing Mobility Registration Update if it is aware of its location?
question_12704.ground_truth: The UE should limit its PLMN selection to only PLMNs of the country of the present UE location to ensure proper network registration.

question_12705.question: What is the procedure in step 14.4.8a.4.2c)?
question_12705.ground_truth: The SS compares the modulation of the signal that it sends to the MS with the signal which is looped back from the receiver after demodulation and decoding, and checks the frame erasure indication.

question_12708.question: What is the required ratio of successful reported values in each RSRQ FDD - FDD inter frequency relative accuracy test?
question_12708.ground_truth: For the RSRQ FDD - FDD inter frequency relative accuracy test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values in each test must be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_12711.question: Who is responsible for provisioning the LTF associated with a POI or MDF2 with the LALS triggered location service parameters?
question_12711.ground_truth: The LIPF is responsible for provisioning the LTF associated with a POI or MDF2 with the LALS triggered location service parameters, which can be provided in the warrant or using a default set of parameters.

question_12713.question: In the "prose-epc-level-ue-registration-request" and "prose-epc-level-ue-registration-response" complex types, what is the purpose of the "anyExt" element?
question_12713.ground_truth: The "anyExt" element in these complex types appears to be a placeholder for additional extensions or information that may not have been explicitly defined at this point.

question_12714.question: What is the impact of the transmission occurrences in the traffic channel on the channel control information?
question_12714.ground_truth: The alignment of channel control information for remote control of the DTE/DCE control interchange-circuits between the UE and the MSC/IWF requires taking into account the transmission occurrences in the traffic channel within the PLMN.

question_12715.question: What is the purpose of the NAS security mode command set-up procedure in the high-level message signalling flow?
question_12715.ground_truth: The NAS security mode command set-up procedure in the high-level message signalling flow is for providing NAS signalling security, including integrity/replay protection and enciphering/deciphering of NAS signalling messages.

question_12716.question: What should the UE and the TWAN do when the UE determines that the 3GPP access is not usable anymore for carrying the IP flows?
question_12716.ground_truth: The UE should report this event to the network via WLAN access by sending the WLCP Request Bearer Resource Modification message including a 3GPP unusable indication. The TWAN also sends the indication to the PGW within a Bearer Resource Command.

question_12718.question: What information must the Participating Operator obtain and retain related to privacy for MDT data?
question_12718.ground_truth: The Participating Operator must obtain and retain any required user consent related to privacy for MDT data.

question_12719.question: What message does the source gNB-DU send to the gNB-CU after receiving the UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message indicating to stop data transmission for the UE?
question_12719.ground_truth: The source gNB-DU sends a Downlink Data Delivery Status frame to inform the gNB-CU about the unsuccessfully transmitted downlink data to the UE.

question_12723.question: What information is included in the "INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST" message?
question_12723.ground_truth: The "INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST" message includes each QoS flow requested to setup during initial UE context setup.

question_12724.question: What is the purpose of back-off time for MTC devices in the solution?
question_12724.ground_truth: The mechanism of back-off time to the MTC Device is used to resolve congestion caused by MTC devices in the network.

question_12725.question: What should the MS send after it has received an I+S frame numbered NSS+KIM+1 mod(62) during the verification of KIM and after it has sent a REJ frame to the SS?
question_12725.ground_truth: The MS should send one RR (R=0, F=0) frame containing N(R)=NMS mod (62) at T1 expiry, after having sent KMI+4 RR frames. After N2 retransmissions of the same RR frame (C=1, P=1), The MS shall reset or disconnect the RLP link by sending a SABM (C=1,P=1) or a DISC (C=1) frame. The SS answers with an UA (R=0) frame with F bit set to P bit received in SABM or DISC frame.

question_12729.question: What is the center point in a 3DOF FLUS source system?
question_12729.ground_truth: The center point in a 3DOF FLUS source system is a physical location that may be moving, and is defined by a set of three coordinates (x, y, z) in a 3D space.

question_12730.question: What is the purpose of the MBMS Bearer Status Indication Procedure?
question_12730.ground_truth: The MBMS Bearer Status Indication Procedure is used by the BM-SC to notify the GCS AS of conditions affecting the delivery of services that use MBMS Delivery, such as MBMS bearer activation failure due to no established MBMS-GW, MBMS-GW transient error or SGmb path failure.

question_12731.question: What procedure is used when hierarchical NSACF architecture is deployed, and the NSACF may delegate the request to the primary NSACF for further processing?
question_12731.ground_truth: When hierarchical NSACF architecture is deployed, the NF Service Consumer (e.g. SMF, combined SMF+PGW-C) shall invoke the NumOfPDUsUpdate service operation to request the NSACF to perform network slice admission control procedure related to the number of PDU sessions. In this procedure, the NSACF may delegate the request to the primary NSACF for further processing.

question_12732.question: What is the state of the mobile station after the test procedure is completed?

question_12735.question: What does a UE include in the PDU Session Modification Request when it has an existing PDU session for the multicast MBS session?
question_12735.ground_truth: The UE includes one or several MBS Session ID(s) and join request in the PDU Session Modification Request.

question_12737.question: What information can be requested from the FRMCS System related to location services?
question_12737.ground_truth: The location information of an FRMCS Equipment consisting of geographic location, velocity, infra location, and quality of service information can be requested.

question_12739.question: What is the procedure for providing port and node information during the PDU Session Establishment procedure for the device side ports of the 5GS node?
question_12739.ground_truth: The UPF provides a port number that identifies the given port corresponding to the PDU Session in the logical 5GS node, and provides a user-plane node ID. The SMF requests this information from the UPF during the N4 Session Establishment Request, and the information is reported to the TSCTSF through the SMF initiated SM Policy Association Modification procedure.

question_12740.question: What was assumed for the performance evaluation in Evaluation Setup 1?
question_12740.ground_truth: In Evaluation Setup 1, a 5x compression of the TCP/IP headers was assumed for the evaluation of header compression schemes.

question_12742.question: What is the minimum BS site separation distance under the tight requirement in Scenario 1 (pico-Macro)?
question_12742.ground_truth: The minimum BS site separation distance under the tight requirement in Scenario 1 (pico-Macro) is about 275 meters in NLOS and 1500 meters in LOS.

question_12743.question: How many times is the EC-RACH repeated for the worse coverage class device?
question_12743.ground_truth: The EC-RACH is repeated up to 32 times, allowing for up to around 6 accesses per second for the worse coverage class device.

question_12744.question: What does the "RANValidityCondition" node represent in the context of flow distribution rules?
question_12744.ground_truth: The "RANValidityCondition" node acts as a placeholder for RAN validity condition for a particular flow distribution rule. This node and its descendants are used to define the RAN validity condition for the network selection.

question_12746.question: What is sent to the MCData server from MCData client 1 when the user at MCData client 1 initiates an ad hoc group data communication?
question_12746.ground_truth: The MCData client 1 sends an ad hoc group data session request containing the criteria for determining the participants list, end-to-end encryption details, SDP offer with media parameters, and functional alias if selected, to the MCData server.

question_12747.question: What is the data type of the parameter "yvalue" in the structure "RelativeCartesianLocation"?
question_12747.ground_truth: The data type of the parameter "yvalue" in the structure "RelativeCartesianLocation" is integer.

question_12748.question: What is the purpose of enabling connectivity through 5G satellite RAT(s) for mission critical services in a 5G system?
question_12748.ground_truth: The purpose is to support connectivity in remote areas where terrestrial networks may not be available or sufficient, ensuring that mission critical services have access to a reliable and capable network.

question_12749.question: What are the five CoRs defined in TS~22.186 to support eV2X scenarios?
question_12749.ground_truth: The five CoRs defined in TS~22.186 to support eV2X scenarios are General Aspects, Vehicle Platooning, Advanced Driving, Extended Sensors, and Remote Driving.

question_12751.question: What is the BCM used for by the SGSN in the GGSN's Create PDP Context Response message?
question_12751.ground_truth: The BCM is used by the SGSN to handle unexpected session management signalling.

question_12753.question: What is the NWDAF responsible for in clause 6.26.2.3?
question_12753.ground_truth: The NWDAF determines a list of cell IDs and related TAIs that support the path and assesses the availability of resources that may be based on a centralized view of the status of the RAN along the path.

question_12754.question: When can an abstract syntax error occur due to a missing IE/IE group in RANAP messages?
question_12754.ground_truth: An abstract syntax error occurs due to a missing IE/IE group when the receiver expects a specific IE or IE group as per the procedure, but it is not present in the received message. This subtle difference can result in an abstract syntax error, which depends on the specified presence and conditions of the concerning object.

question_12756.question: What entity is responsible for binding the two radio legs together in Local Switching?
question_12756.ground_truth: The MSC-S(s) is responsible for binding the two radio legs together in Local Switching.

question_12757.question: Which method in the NEF allows an AF to request to retrieve all the MBS Parameters Provisionings resources managed by the NEF?
question_12757.ground_truth: The GET method in the NEF allows an AF to request to retrieve all the MBS Parameters Provisionings resources managed by the NEF.

question_12761.question: How can the ADAES support the application layer automatic network slice lifecycle management by sending out management recommendations?
question_12761.ground_truth: The ADAES can provide analysis-based slice management suggestions such as slice scale in and scale out, which can be exposed to VAL or provided to NSCE as a service.

question_12762.question: What attribute is used in the schema to specify that the XML document can contain any namespace with lax processing?
question_12762.ground_truth: The 'namespace' attribute with a value of "#any" and 'processContents' attribute with a value of "lax" is used to allow any namespace with lax processing in the XML document.

question_12763.question: What measures should be taken while transferring the control of UEs from one hovering RAN to another?
question_12763.ground_truth: Interference between the hovering RANs should be minimized, handover procedure should be quick and minimized, and information exchange among the hovering RANs should be quick and minimized during the transfer.

question_12764.question: What should the TSCTSF provide to the AMF to adjust the Area of Interest (AoI) based on the User Equipment's (UE) Registration Area (RA)?
question_12764.ground_truth: The TSCTSF may provide an indication to the AMF with Parameter Type = "Adjust AoI based on RA" for the AMF to adjust the received AoI depending on UE's RA.

question_12765.question: What is the duration of the OTA transmitter transient period as defined in clause 6.5.3.1 of the document?
question_12765.ground_truth: The OTA transmitter transient period is the time period during which the transmitter unit is changing from the OFF period to the ON period or vice versa.

question_12766.question: What does the document not specify in the context of USIM Application Toolkit?
question_12766.ground_truth: The document does not specify any aspects related to the administrative management phase, any internal technical realization of either the UICC or the ME, or any of the security algorithms which may be used in the context of USIM Application Toolkit.

question_12767.question: What should the MAC entity do if at least one SSB with SS-RSRP above rsrp-ThresholdSSB is available during contention-based Random Access preamble selection?
question_12767.ground_truth: The MAC entity should select an SSB with SS-RSRP above rsrp-ThresholdSSB.

question_12768.question: What does the AF do with the UE identify information and the AF transaction internal identifier when receiving notifications about UP path management events?
question_12768.ground_truth: The AF maps the UE identify information, such as SUPI, to the GPSI and the AF transaction internal identifier to the AF transaction identifier before sending the notifications to the AF.

question_12769.question: What kind of paging co-ordination is provided if the network supports DTM?
question_12769.ground_truth: This kind of paging co-ordination shall be provided if the network supports DTM.

question_12772.question: In what scenarios does the "ThreshBackhRateDLWLANHighAndSF" threshold condition need to be evaluated?
question_12772.ground_truth: The "ThreshBackhRateDLWLANHigh" threshold condition needs to be evaluated if the UE is using WLAN for traffic steering and the available downlink bandwidth is higher than the threshold value.

question_12775.question: What is the desired target for the UE battery life for mMTC?
question_12775.ground_truth: The desired target for the UE battery life for mMTC is 15 years.

question_12776.question: What frequency band shall be reported by the mobile station, in case it does not support any frequency band requested by the network?
question_12776.ground_truth: In that case, the mobile station shall report its radio access capabilities for the BCCH frequency band.

question_12778.question: What is the role of PLMN A and PLMN D in Solution #7?
question_12778.ground_truth: PLMN A is a PLMN without Disaster Condition, and PLMN D is another PLMN in the same country as PLMN A.

question_12779.question: What should the P-CSCF verify when it receives a 1xx or 2xx response to the target refresh request for a dialog?
question_12779.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should verify that the list of Via header fields in the response matches the saved list of Via header fields received in the request corresponding to the same dialog, including the P-CSCF Via header field value.

question_12782.question: What is the role of CN (Circuit Network) in the handover process?
question_12782.ground_truth: The CN selects a target GERAN cell and requests it to allocate the necessary resources, using Handover Request.

question_12783.question: What is the MIME type used to carry ProSe discovery operation information in the format of an XML document?

question_12784.question: What is the minimum measurement period for intra-frequency measurements for UE category 0 in the intra-frequency event triggered reporting test?
question_12784.ground_truth: The minimum measurement period for intra-frequency measurements for UE category 0 in the intra-frequency event triggered reporting test is 400 ms.

question_12786.question: What are the factors affecting the overall service latency in 5G systems with very low latency and high communications service availability?
question_12786.ground_truth: The factors affecting overall service latency include the delay on the radio interface, transmission within the 5G system, transmission to a server that can be outside the 5G system, and data processing.

question_12787.question: What acronym identifies the target quality of service class in the measurement name DRB.TotalPdcpSDUPacketDl.QOS and DRB.TotalRlcSDUPacketDl.QOS?
question_12787.ground_truth: QOS identifies the target quality of service class in these measurement names.

question_12788.question: What is the purpose of the delegation request from a PCF instance to its primary PCF?
question_12788.ground_truth: The PCF instance may send a delegation request of quota enforcement for the indicated S-NSSAI to its primary PCF when the local quota is to be consumed by the PCF instance, as an alternative to rejecting the UE request for PDU session establishment.

question_12789.question: How does the IRPAgent resolve concurrency problems in the Bulk CM IRPAgent state machine?
question_12789.ground_truth: The IRPAgent resolves concurrency problems on a "first come - first serve" basis, meaning that the first request will be progressed to completion and subsequent requests will be rejected.

question_12790.question: What should the SMF+PGW-C do if seamless session continuity from EPS to 5GS is not supported for a specific PDU Session?
question_12790.ground_truth: The SMF+PGW-C does not provide SM information for the corresponding PDU Session and includes an appropriate cause code for rejecting the PDU Session transfer within the N2 SM Information. It then locally releases the PDN connection(s) not further transferred to 5GC.

question_12791.question: What are the impacts of introducing SBI-based MT SM transfer with SMS Router/IP-SM-GW deployed?
question_12791.ground_truth: The introduction of SBI-based MT SM transfer will change steps 2, 4, and 6 of the current procedure, while steps 1, 3, and 5 will remain the same.

question_12792.question: What is the disadvantage of LCLS negotiation within CN solution for signalling effort on Nc?
question_12792.ground_truth: The disadvantage of LCLS negotiation within CN solution for signalling effort on Nc is that it requires more signalling messages to be exchanged between oMSC-Server and tMSC-Server, resulting in increased signalling traffic on the Nc interface.

question_12793.question: What is the significance of the if-Index used to generate an interface identifier?
question_12793.ground_truth: The if-Index can be used to generate an interface identifier for the DetNet controller that is unique within the 5GS node. Based on the if-Index, an interface name can be generated for better managing IP nodes.

question_12794.question: What information does the UE(USIM) provide to the network to assist with MT service delivery in Section 6.5.2?
question_12794.ground_truth: The UE(USIM) may provide MUSIM Release assistance Information (MUSIM-RAI) to the network to assist with MT service delivery in Section 6.5.2.

question_12795.question: What must the UE do when it sends the URL of the file location to the recipient and receives a FD notification via a SIP MESSAGE message?
question_12795.ground_truth: The UE shall respond to the SIP MESSAGE message with a SIP 200 (OK) message and deliver the notification to the MCDATA User.

question_12796.question: What is the strategy for transferring ME capabilities from the source RNC to the target RNC during SRNS relocation?
question_12796.ground_truth: The normal strategy is to include these in the source to target transparent container. However, since the current specs do not guarantee that a legacy source RNC includes an IE that it does not understand to the target RNC, the ME must be the entity to supply the target RNC with information about whether it is updated or not.

question_12798.question: What properties does the "ExpectationFulfilmentResult" data type contain?
question_12798.ground_truth: The "ExpectationFulfilmentResult" data type contains the "expectaitonId", "expectationFulfilmentInfo", and "targetFulfilmentResult" properties.

question_12799.question: What is one use case in AV production that involves the transfer of file-based AV content?
question_12799.ground_truth: Transferring file-based AV content between the broadcasting facility and an event location.

question_12800.question: What must be invoked separately for interception of multi-media service in order to intercept the content of communications?
question_12800.ground_truth: Activation and invocation of lawful interception for multi-media service only at the CSCF(s) does not produce interception of content of communications. A separate activation and invocation of lawful interception shall occur at a node that has access to the CC.

question_12801.question: What should the UE do if it receives a SERVICE REJECT message with cause #10 (Implicitly de-registered) via a 3GPP access in single-registration mode?
question_12801.ground_truth: The UE should enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE and delete any mapped 5G NAS security context or partial native 5G NAS security context.

question_12802.question: What is allowed for a UE with an ongoing IMS session, when roaming in a VPLMN, in terms of transferring the PDN connection providing access to IMS between EPC via non-3GPP access and 5GCN via NG-RAN?
question_12802.ground_truth: The UE is allowed to transfer the PDN connection providing access to IMS between EPC via non-3GPP access and 5GCN via NG-RAN.

question_12804.question: What action is taken if the sidelink grant cannot be associated with any Sidelink process?
question_12804.ground_truth: If the HARQ Process ID corresponding to the sidelink grant received on PDCCH is not associated to any Sidelink process, then the grant is ignored.

question_12805.question: What is the principle behind Solution #2 for handling CS/PS mis-matched cases?
question_12805.ground_truth: When the CN is performing Update Location Request to HLR, HLR will indicate if the current registering PLMN is mis-matched with the other registered domain and return back to the CN the PLMN ID of the other registered domain, which can then be used by RAN to find the correct domain.

question_12808.question: How many cells are involved in this test scenario?
question_12808.ground_truth: There are two cells involved in this test scenario, cell 1 being the E-UTRAN PCell and cell 2 being the PSCell.

question_12810.question: What is the function of RAN user plane congestion management in the RAN and CN?
question_12810.ground_truth: The function of RAN user plane congestion management is to effectively mitigate RAN user plane congestation in order to reduce the negative impact on the perceived service quality, and it can be performed in the RAN or CN, or in a combined way both in the RAN and in the CN.

question_12811.question: What message is sent by the eNB to the MME to initiate a handover to the 2G CS domain?
question_12811.ground_truth: A "Handover Required" message is sent by the eNB to the MME to initiate a handover to the 2G CS domain.

question_12812.question: What is the purpose of the 5G PKMF address request procedure?
question_12812.ground_truth: The 5G PKMF address request procedure allows a UE to obtain a 5G PKMF address from the 5G DDNMF in HPLMN over the PC3a interface for the security procedure over user plane.

question_12814.question: What has been added to RK Resources to improve the management of Target geographical area semantics for mission critical services?
question_12814.ground_truth: The Target geographical management of RK Resources has been aligned with the MB2-C AVP for mission critical services.

question_12815.question: What is the purpose of the "mit parameter" in the UTDOA positioning method?
question_12815.ground_truth: The "mit parameter" in the UTDOA positioning method is used to minimize the number of dedicated physical channels by indicating the limit in the amount of puncturing that can be applied.

question_12817.question: How is performance data collected in a shared NSSI?
question_12817.ground_truth: In a shared NSSI, performance data is segregated per NSI and can be collected for different QoS levels, service instances, or slice instance levels based on NMF requests.

question_12821.question: What is the role of 'homerealm' in the Decorated NAI?
question_12821.ground_truth: 'Homerealm' is the realm as specified in clause 19.2 using the HPLMN ID ('homeMCC' + 'homeMNC').

question_12822.question: What message does the Serving GW send to the PDN GW in the VPLMN or HPLMN in step 14 of the procedure?
question_12822.ground_truth: The Serving GW sends a Modify Bearer Request message to the PDN GW in the VPLMN or HPLMN in step 14 of the procedure.

question_12823.question: Which combinaison MSD (Multi Spectral Duplexer) analysis is related to an example calculation with UL RB (Resource Block) allocations wider than in respective single band RFESENS, which has significant CF (Carrier Frequency) impact but not included in the MSD?
question_12823.ground_truth: The combinaison MSD (Multi Spectral Duplexer) analysis related to this example calculation is the case of IMD2 and IMD3 from B3+B8 both hitting on top of B7 DL but not overlapping.

question_12826.question: In what format are the UE policies for V2X encoded in the document?
question_12826.ground_truth: The UE policies for V2X are encoded as a V2X policy (V2XP) UE policy part using the UE policy delivery service as specified in 3GPP TS 24.501, annex D.

question_12827.question: Which error code is related to the 'establish temporary connection' in the CAP-operationcodes module?

question_12829.question: What is the initial physical cell identity for Cell 2 upon the beginning of T3?
question_12829.ground_truth: Set Cell 2 physical cell identity = ((current cell 2 physical cell identity + 1) mod 14 + 2)

question_12831.question: What is the solution for System-level considerations for MCPTT service continuity?
question_12831.ground_truth: The solution for System-level considerations for MCPTT service continuity has no specification impact on existing RAN entities and existing EPC entities.

question_12832.question: Over what frequency range is the power capability of a single PA not sufficient?
question_12832.ground_truth: Over the frequency range of 7 to 24 GHz, the power capability of a single PA is not sufficient.

question_12833.question: How can the intent-driven MnS consumer test intent-driven capabilities provided by an MnS producer?
question_12833.ground_truth: The intent-driven MnS consumer should be able to test intent-driven MnS by specifying the expected outcome from executing an intent, sending a detailed report to the MnS consumer containing information related to the outcome of the intent execution, and checking if the expectations are fulfilled using the present document.

question_12834.question: What is the role of the network in the authorization process for the UE in the Ranging and Sidelink Positioning services?
question_12834.ground_truth: The network is responsible for providing the authorization token to the UE and verifying the UE's authorization during the discovery and PC5 link establishment procedures.

question_12835.question: What is the condition for intra-frequency SSB based measurements without measurement gaps?
question_12835.ground_truth: Intra-frequency SSB based measurements can be performed without measurement gaps if the SSB is completely contained in the active BWP of the UE, or if the active downlink BWP is initial BWP.

question_12837.question: Which new MAC entities are added in the UE for supporting Enhanced Uplink?
question_12837.ground_truth: New MAC entities (MAC-es/MAC-e and MAC-is/i) are added in the UE for handling HARQ retransmissions, scheduling, and MAC-e/i multiplexing, E-DCH TFC selection.

question_12838.question: What happens during a Voice group call when a new talker starts to speak in the 1 channel model?
question_12838.ground_truth: The talker's speech is transferred to the MGW on the termination of the traffic channel serving the cell and is transferred to the conference function where the summarized conference signal is calculated. The resulting stream is then transferred to all conference terminations.

question_12839.question: What is the purpose of establishing a secure connection with the Sidelink Positioning Key Management Function (SLPKMF) in solution #15?
question_12839.ground_truth: Establishing a secure connection with the SLPKMF is the first step for a UE to derive the Sidelink Positioning Traffic Key (SLPTK) and Sidelink Positioning Encryption Key (SLPEK) and Sidelink Positioning Integrity Key (SLPIK) from the Sidelink Positioning Group Key (SLPGK) in solution #15.

question_12840.question: What is the goal of the energy control during frame erasure concealment?
question_12840.ground_truth: The goal of the energy control is to minimize energy discontinuities by scaling the synthesized signal to render the energy of the signal at the beginning of the recovery frame to be similar to the energy of the synthesized signal at the end of the last frame erased during the frame erasure.

question_12841.question: What type of discovery message is used in the procedure for 5G ProSe Direct Discovery with Model A?
question_12841.ground_truth: The procedure for 5G ProSe Direct Discovery with Model A uses a single discovery protocol message (Announcement).

question_12844.question: When autonomous gaps are used by a 1Rx RedCap UE for identifying the CGI of an E-UTRA cell with the purpose of 'reportCGI', what is the maximum allowed time for the UE to identify a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell, provided that the E-UTRA cell has been already identified by the UE?
question_12844.ground_truth: The maximum allowed time for the UE to identify a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell is 190 ms.

question_12845.question: What is the purpose of a request to transmit in MCX Services?
question_12845.ground_truth: A request to transmit in MCX Services is a mechanism for a user to request the permission to transmit (transmit voice/audio) and provides a deterministic mechanism to arbitrate between requests that are in contention.

question_12846.question: What should the UE do if the security check of the steering of roaming information is not successful and it is in automatic network selection mode?
question_12846.ground_truth: If the security check is not successful, the UE shall wait until it moves to idle mode or 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication before attempting to obtain service on a higher priority PLMN or SNPN.

question_12847.question: Which command number and type should the ME send if it responds with 'MORE TIME' command in sequence 1.3 of the test procedure?
question_12847.ground_truth: The command number should be '1' and the command type should be 'MORE TIME'.

question_12848.question: What is the role of 5G-RG in the registration procedure as depicted in TS~23.502?
question_12848.ground_truth: 5G-RG can act as the UE in the registration procedure and initiates the PDU session establishment procedure dedicated to IPTV service.

question_12849.question: What value shall the Reachability-Type AVP take on the S6a/S6d interface to indicate reachability for data?
question_12849.ground_truth: The Reachability-Type AVP shall take the value 1 (bit 1 set) on the S6a/S6d interface to indicate reachability for data.

question_12850.question: What is the minimum performance requirement for LEE TRS for E-UTRA FDD, as specified in section 7.3.4?
question_12850.ground_truth: The LEE TRS minimum performance requirements for E-UTRA FDD in data transfer position mode for throughput greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channels are specified in section 7.3.4.

question_12852.question: What is the format of the complex query expression used to express a query condition in the "complex-query" query parameter?
question_12852.ground_truth: The complex query expression used to express a query condition in the "complex-query" query parameter can be in either Conjunctive Normal Form (CNF) or Disjunctive Normal Form (DNF).

question_12857.question: What information should the SMF forward to the PCF when receiving an application detection report from the UPF?
question_12857.ground_truth: The SMF should forward the application identifier, start/stop indication, and when service data flow descriptions were deduced, the application instance identifier(s) and service data flow description(s) to the PCF.

question_12858.question: When does the eNB decide to move to another RAT in the case of mobility to CDMA2000 while the target RAT determines to which cell the UE shall move?
question_12858.ground_truth: This occurs during connected mode mobility for handover to CDMA2000, where the eNB decides when to move to the other RAT while the target RAT determines to which cell the UE shall move.

question_12859.question: What is the GPRS service described in the document?
question_12859.ground_truth: The GPRS is a packet bearer service and a main part of the packet domain in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) technical specification.

question_12860.question: What is hosted by the Hosting Party Module (HPM) in the H(e)NB?
question_12860.ground_truth: The Hosting Party Module (HPM) hosts the credentials used to authenticate the Hosting Party in the respective H(e)NB.

question_12861.question: What should the mobile station obey when the timers related to measurement reporting expire while the reselection procedure has not yet been completed?
question_12861.ground_truth: The mobile station shall restart these timers so that the mobile station resumes the measurement reporting procedures once camped on the new cell.

question_12863.question: What is the requirement for UE when performing L1-SINR measurements on FR1 or FR2 in case of FR1-FR2 inter-band CA?
question_12863.ground_truth: There are no scheduling restrictions on FR1 serving cell(s) due to L1-SINR measurement performed on FR2 serving cell(s), and there are no scheduling restrictions on FR2 serving cell(s) due to L1-SINR measurement performed on FR1 serving cell(s).

question_12864.question: What is the PAR (Peak to Average Power Ratio) for a single 8-PSK carrier?
question_12864.ground_truth: The PAR of a single 8-PSK carrier is approximately 3.2~dB.

question_12865.question: What HTTP method is used by the Media Session Handler to request a delivery boost from the 5GMS AF?
question_12865.ground_truth: The POST HTTP method is used by the Media Session Handler to request a delivery boost from the 5GMS AF.

question_12866.question: What type of positioning method makes use of different sensors such as accelerometers, gyros, and magnetometers to calculate the displacement of UE?

question_12869.question: What is the difference between CSMT flag and CSMO flag in the 3GPP Technical Specification document?
question_12869.ground_truth: CSMT flag is used in CS fallback for MT call to avoid missing paging in roaming retry, while CSMO flag is used in CS fallback for MO calls in the CM Service Request and LA Update request message.

question_12870.question: What is the effect of the notification delivery report in the MCData data disposition for delivery?
question_12870.ground_truth: The IWF initiates an MCData data disposition notification delivery report if the MCData data disposition for delivery was requested by MCData~client 1 and if the LMR system provided data disposition. The MCData data disposition notification from the IWF can be stored by the MCData server for disposition history interrogation from authorized MCData users.

question_12871.question: What is the purpose of the "parents" leaf-list reference in the "SubNetwork" class?
question_12871.ground_truth: The "parents" leaf-list is used to reference all containing SubNetwork instances in a strict order from the root subnetwork down to the immediate parent subnetwork. This forms a containment hierarchy and allows for the modeling of relationships between subnetworks.

question_12872.question: What is the reporting range of differential PRS-RSRP when nr-DL-AoD-RequestLocationInformation message is received?
question_12872.ground_truth: The reporting range of differential PRS-RSRP is defined from -30 dB to 0 dB with 1~dB resolution when nr-DL-AoD-RequestLocationInformation message is received.

question_12874.question: What is the role of the ProSe Server in the ProSe discovery using Presence Service architecture?
question_12874.ground_truth: The ProSe Server is an IMS application server that communicates with UE's and other network entities through the IMS Service Control Interface. It also acts as a Presence Network Agent/LCS client for getting the location information.

question_12875.question: What is a Client in the context of the Streaming Service?
question_12875.ground_truth: In the context of the PSS, the client is a device or service that receives media objects and/or multimedia composition instructions from a server.

question_12876.question: What type of exception is returned to the application if the requested tracking accuracy is not supported in the StartGeographicalNotificationRequest operation?

question_12877.question: What is the purpose of the MBS Policy Authorization Service?
question_12877.ground_truth: The MBS Policy Authorization Service enables the Policy Control Function (PCF) to authorize the MBS Service Information provided by an NF service consumer (e.g. AF, NEF, MBSF) and derive the related MBS policies, including enabling an NF service consumer to request the creation, update or removal of an MBS Application Session Context based on the provisioning of MBS Service Information.

question_12878.question: What is the difference between real-time and non-real-time messaging services in the 3GPP context?
question_12878.ground_truth: Real-time messaging services refer to services where messages are delivered in what is perceived as real-time by the user, while non-real-time services are designed to store messages for later delivery or collection. In 3GPP, SMS is typically considered a non-real-time service, while instant messaging is a real-time service.

question_12879.question: What is the procedure for V-ANDSF discovery by the UE during DNS lookup resolution?
question_12879.ground_truth: The UE obtains the V-ANDSF IP address by performing a DNS lookup by name as specified in RFC 1035. The QNAME is set to the ANDSF-SN FQDN and included in the DNS Request. The UE then selects the IP address of the V-ANDSF included in the DNS response message.

question_12880.question: Under which conditions should the transmitter output power be measured for "extreme test conditions"?
question_12880.ground_truth: The radiated power should be measured by comparing the power levels under extreme test conditions with those under normal test conditions for each burst type, power control level, and frequency used.

question_12882.question: What is the default combination of system information blocks (Combination NR-1) used in test cases?
question_12882.ground_truth: Combination NR-1 is used in NR FDD single cell scenario, NR TDD single cell scenario, NR FDD inter-band DC component carriers cell scenario, NR TDD inter-band DC component carriers cell scenario, and NR FDD and NR TDD inter-band DC component carriers cell scenario.

question_12884.question: What is the concept referred to as "Single Point of Control (SPC)" in IN terminology?
question_12884.ground_truth: In IN terminology, Single Point of Control (SPC) refers to the principle where only one application is allowed to influence a call or session at the same point in time during call or session processing.

question_12886.question: What are the steps involved in MBSR mobility during a handover procedure in the IAB network?
question_12886.ground_truth: The steps include the MBSR moving towards the IAB Donor 2 coverage, the IAB UE sending a measurement report, IAB Donor-1 initiating HO preparation with the target IAB Donor-2, standard HO procedure, and F1 continuation with the m-CU using the new IAB Donor 2.

question_12888.question: What should a UE do when it is in EMM-IDLE mode without suspend indication and has an uplink user data to be sent to the network using control plane CIoT EPS optimization upon receiving a paging indication?
question_12888.ground_truth: The UE can piggyback the uplink user data during the service request procedure initiated to respond to the paging as specified in clause 5.6.1.2.2.

question_12890.question: Who manages the queue of users for the CCBS, CCNR, and CCNL services?
question_12890.ground_truth: The application servers manage the queue of users for these services.

question_12891.question: What is the purpose of the "GammaQ" function?
question_12891.ground_truth: The "GammaQ" function is used to compute gamma values for BCJR algorithm and takes in Int16 k (bit position), Int16 l (state), const IntLLR* parity (received parity bits) and const IntLLR* extrinsic (sum of extrinsic and systematic bits).

question_12892.question: What input parameters are required for the 128-EIA algorithms to integrity-protect the user plane data?
question_12892.ground_truth: A 128-bit integrity key, a 5-bit bearer identity, the direction of transmission, and a bearer specific, time and direction dependent 32-bit input COUNT.

question_12893.question: What should the MS do after receiving a notification message for the current group or broadcast call in the cell change procedure?
question_12893.ground_truth: The MS should change to the group channel and stay in group receive mode if the notification message contains the related channel position and the channel is found. If the notification message does not contain information on the related channel position, the MS should leave group receive mode, enter idle mode, and establish a dedicated connection with the network to become informed on the related channel position.

question_12895.question: What is the delay uncertainty that is excluded from the measurement reporting delay?
question_12895.ground_truth: The delay uncertainty is the delay that results from inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH.

question_12896.question: What is the test environment for the hard handover delay test in clause 8.3.3?
question_12896.ground_truth: The test environment is normal, as specified in clauses G.2.1 and G.2.2.

question_12897.question: What should the UE do when it wants to initiate a UE-requested PDU session modification procedure to request a network upgrade to an MA PDU session, as specified in clause 6.4.2.2 of 3GPP TS 24.501?
question_12897.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the UE-requested PDU session modification procedure by sending the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message including the 5GSM capability IE over the specific access, as specified in clause 6.4.2.2 of 3GPP TS 24.501. The UE may set the Request type IE to "modification request" and include the MA PDU session information IE set to "MA PDU session network upgrade is allowed".

question_12898.question: What is the action taken by the PCRF when a certain threshold is reached in the OCS?
question_12898.ground_truth: The PCRF applies operator-defined actions such as downgrading QoS for affected IP-CAN sessions and provides policy decisions to the PCEF and BBERF (if applicable) based on the new counter status from the OCS.

question_12901.question: What should the Node B include in the RL Information IE for Serving E-DCH RL in FDD UL MIMO DL Control Channel Information IE?
question_12901.ground_truth: The Node B should include the Secondary Transport Block E-HICH Signature Sequence IE or the Secondary Transport Block E-HICH Release Indicator IE for every RL indicated by the E-DCH RL Indication IE, set to "E-DCH", in the RL Information IE in FDD UL MIMO DL Control Channel Information IE.

question_12902.question: What are the available signaling options for picture resolution in DASH?
question_12902.ground_truth: The available signaling options for picture resolution in DASH include Adaptation Set Parameters @maxWidth and @maxHeight, Common Adaptation Set or Representation Parameters @width and @height, and Width and height in track header box of the ISO BMFF.

question_12904.question: In TS 36.331, clause 5.6.13.2, what should the UE perform upon initiating the procedure to report EUTRA SCG failures when neither NR MCG nor EUTRA SCG transmission is suspended?
question_12904.ground_truth: Upon initiating the procedure, the UE should include the failureType within failureReportSCG-EUTRA and set it to indicate the SCG failure in accordance with TS 36.331 clause 5.6.13.4; and submit the SCGFailureInformationEUTRA message to lower layers for transmission.

question_12906.question: What is the role of the IQF in relation to the ICF and the LEA?
question_12906.ground_truth: The IQF is responsible for receiving and responding to LEA requests, validating the request and sending an association search request to the ICF if the request is valid and within the ICF cache period. Following receipt of an association search request response from the ICF, the IQF shall forward any matching identifier association(s) to the LEA.

question_12910.question: What is the purpose of the Location Related Data procedure in the 3GPP network?
question_12910.ground_truth: The Location Related Data procedure allows the CN to handle additional location-related requests over the Iu interface, such as retrieving deciphering keys for broadcast assistance data or requesting the RNC to deliver dedicated assistance data to the UE.

question_12911.question: What is the interface between the Node B and RNC (Radio Network Controller) components of the UMTS Terrestrial Radio Access Network (UTRAN) in UMTS system?
