question_12911.ground_truth: The Iub interface is the logical interface for the interconnection of Node B and RNC components of the UTRAN for the UMTS system.

question_12912.question: What is the difference in energy consumption between the short and long sync procedures?
question_12912.ground_truth: The long sync procedure consumes approximately 600 times more energy than the short sync procedure.

question_12915.question: What are the equivalent reference points for CAPIF-3, CAPIF-4, and CAPIF-5 for supporting interactions with 3rd party service providers' APIs?

question_12916.question: What are the two main types of ML models and model processing considered in the AI/ML based automotive networked systems use-case?
question_12916.ground_truth: The two main types of ML models and model processing considered are large ML models updates using non-real time training and partial transfer and exchange of AI-ML model data.

question_12919.question: What state will the gsmSSF FSM transit to if there are no pending reports or armed EDPs and the call has been released but not due to call duration limit being reached?
question_12919.ground_truth: The gsmSSF FSM will transit to the "Idle" state in this case.

question_12920.question: What are the procedures for WebRTC IMS session management?
question_12920.ground_truth: Session management related procedures for a class of users, such as origination and termination, and session release, follow standard IMS procedures. However, routing of all messages between the WIC and S-CSCF traverses the eP-CSCF, and parameters of Iq+ procedures take into account the WebRTC-specific extensions used by the WIC to send and receive media.

question_12921.question: If a UE supports MPTCP functionality with any steering mode and ATSSS-LL functionality with only active-standby steering mode, what should be the ATSSS-ST bits set in the 5GSM capability IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message?
question_12921.ground_truth: The ATSSS-ST bits should be set to "MPTCP functionality with any steering mode and ATSSS-LL functionality with only active-standby steering mode supported".

question_12922.question: When should the 3gpp-Sbi-Target-apiRoot header be included in the HTTP request when communicating with a remote PLMN?
question_12922.ground_truth: The 3gpp-Sbi-Target-apiRoot header should be included in the HTTP request when the request targets a URI with an authority from a remote PLMN.

question_12924.question: What is the parameter that determines the aggregation level for an EPDCCH candidate in EPDCCH UE-specific search spaces?
question_12924.ground_truth: The aggregation level for an EPDCCH candidate in EPDCCH UE-specific search spaces is determined by the number of EPDCCH candidates at each aggregation level in EPDCCH-PRB-set.

question_12925.question: What information is transferred from the CC-POI to the MDF3 while performing interception in the PTC Server?
question_12925.ground_truth: In addition to the intercepted content of communications, the following information is transferred from the CC-POI to the MDF3 in the PTC Server to allow the MDF3 to perform its functionality: Target identity, Correlation information, Time stamp, and Identity of source of media (communications content) for group call.

question_12927.question: What is one advantage of using HTTP/2 over HTTP/1.1?
question_12927.ground_truth: HTTP/2 provides on average a 5% to 15% performance improvement on page load times over HTTP/1.1.

question_12928.question: What is the required number of successful tests for the test in 4.6.1.1.4.2 to pass?
question_12928.ground_truth: For the test in 4.6.1.1.4.2 to pass, the total number of successful tests shall be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

question_12929.question: What is the purpose of the Redirect BSF in the 5G Core network?
question_12929.ground_truth: The Redirect BSF redirects the received Diameter request message by carrying out the procedures defined in clause~6.1.7 of IETF~RFC~6733, allowing the BSF to redirect Diameter messages to the appropriate PCF.

question_12930.question: What kind of data is the RPT exposing for read access by the NM?
question_12930.ground_truth: The RPT exposes Planned Data, which includes site and antenna data, for read access by the NM.

question_12931.question: What is the requirement for antenna connector termination when testing a multi-band capable BS with separate antenna connector for both involved bands and single band tests?
question_12931.ground_truth: For multi-band capable BS with separate antenna connector, the antenna connector not being under test shall be terminated.

question_12932.question: What is the definition of AllocationOrRetentionPriority in the protocolIEs of UeRegistrationQueryResponse?
question_12932.ground_truth: AllocationOrRetentionPriority is a SEQUENCE containing priorityLevel, pre-emptionCapability, pre-emptionVulnerability, queuingAllowed, and iE-Extensions, where the latter is a ProtocolExtensionContainer with AllocationOrRetentionPriority-ExtIEs.

question_12934.question: What is the approach for acquiring an SI message from an MBMS-dedicated cell?
question_12934.ground_truth: Determine the start of the SI-window and receive DL-SCH using SI-RNTI with value in accordance with 36.321 from the start of the SI-window and continue until the end of the SI-window or until the SI message is received, excluding the specified subframes.

question_12935.question: What is the purpose of using a lag candidate representation in low-frequency spectrum offsets?
question_12935.ground_truth: The purpose of using a lag candidate representation in low-frequency spectrum offsets is to enable a wide search range for actual lag information even with a small bit budget, while ensuring that at least one non-zero spectrum is generated.

question_12937.question: What are some countermeasures for network threats such as flooding the RAN, the core network, or performing a replay attack?
question_12937.ground_truth: Authentication, monitoring, and logging are appropriate countermeasures for these threats.

question_12938.question: What is the message sent by the AMF-UE to the source NG-RAN when a UE moves with the MBSR and is in CM-CONNECTED state?

question_12940.question: In what state is the floor participant interface when it is first initiated?
question_12940.ground_truth: When a new instance of the 'Floor participant interface state transition' state machine is first initiated, it is in the 'Start-stop' state.

question_12942.question: What is the purpose of modeling the eNB as an implementation-specific issue?
question_12942.ground_truth: The purpose of modeling the eNB is to demonstrate that end-to-end delay budget adjustments can deliver performance enhancements for a wide range of eNB behaviors based on its processing capabilities and corresponding delays.

question_12943.question: What is the purpose of utilizing the reporting mechanism by time period in minimizing the impact on the performance of the collection equipment?
question_12943.ground_truth: By defining data collection periods, it meets the data collection requirements while minimizing the impact on the performance of the collection equipment and fully utilizing the resource capacity of the idle time.

question_12944.question: What is the requirement for the protocol used from the MTC Server for submitting device trigger requests?
question_12944.ground_truth: The protocol should support an option where the UE can be identified without the use of an E.164-MSISDN.

question_12945.question: What should the UE do if it needs to deliver a port management information container in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMPLETE message?
question_12945.ground_truth: The UE should include a Port management information container IE in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMPLETE message and handle the contents of the Port management information container IE as specified in 3GPP TS 23.501 and 23.502.

question_12946.question: What is the definition of the presentation indicator (PI) in the 3GPP system?
question_12946.ground_truth: The presentation indicator (PI) can have three values: "presentation allowed," "presentation restricted," and "number not available." It indicates whether the calling line identity is presented to the terminating party or not.

question_12948.question: How does a Light Detection And Ranging (LiDAR) system measure distances?
question_12948.ground_truth: LiDAR measures distances by illuminating the target with a light and then measuring the reflection with an optical sensor. It operates in the ultraviolet, visible, or infrared spectrum.

question_12950.question: What is the role of the source SRNC after it receives the Forward Relocation Response message in the SRNS relocation procedure?
question_12950.ground_truth: The source SRNC begins forwarding downlink data for the RABs subject to data forwarding through the Iu interface and performs data forwarding for downlink user data only. The data forwarded is duplicated and routed at the IP layer towards the target RNC.

question_12951.question: What are the three concepts used to achieve the requirement of low generated interference in the CTS radio interface?
question_12951.ground_truth: The three concepts used to achieve the requirement of low generated interference in the CTS radio interface are the beacon concept, Adaptive Frequency Allocation (AFA) concept, and Total Frequency Hopping (TFH) concept.

question_12952.question: What is the purpose of the bandwidth switching detector employed before bandwidth switching post-processing?
question_12952.ground_truth: The bandwidth switching detector is employed to detect if there is bandwidth switching or not, and to calculate the counters of bandwidth switching from WB to SWB and from SWB to WB.

question_12953.question: When are the GNSS-AcquisitionAssistance and GNSS-AcquisitionAssistElement fields used for GLONASS in the satellite system?
question_12953.ground_truth: The GNSS-AcquisitionAssistance and GNSS-AcquisitionAssistElement fields are used for GLONASS when the satellite system is supported by the UE.

question_12957.question: What action should the MS take when the Back-off timer value IE is not included, and the SM cause value is different from #26 "insufficient resources"?
question_12957.ground_truth: The MS may send another ACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST, ACTIVATE SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST, or MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message for the same APN.

question_12958.question: In what scenarios would the "srcservinst" parameter be present in the header?
question_12958.ground_truth: The "srcservinst" parameter would be present in the header when the Source NF Service Instance ID is included, and if it is present, "srcinst" must also be present.

question_12960.question: Under what circumstances can an E-UTRA neighbor cell not be considered in cell reselection by the user equipment (UE)?
question_12960.ground_truth: If it is indicated as not allowed in the measurement control system information of the serving cell.

question_12962.question: What is the main feature of the video glasses when used for a simulated large screen viewing experience?
question_12962.ground_truth: The main feature of the video glasses is their ability to display the left view on the left eye and the right view on the right eye, creating a depth effect for the user.

question_12963.question: What is the definition of the BBF network elements?
question_12963.ground_truth: The BBF network elements include BRAS, BNG, RG, BBF AAA proxy, and BPCF. These elements are defined in BBF TR-058, BBF TR-101, BBF~TR-145, and BBF TR-134. The BBF device represents any devices defined by Broadband Forum or supported by Fixed Broadband Access.

question_12964.question: In which state does the AMF-UE sends a Paging request towards the NG-RAN when the UE moves with the MBSR?
question_12964.ground_truth: The UE is in CM-IDLE state

question_12965.question: When can the UE perform an initial registration procedure using the 5G NAS security algorithms "0" and 5G-IA0 for integrity protection and 5G-EA0 for ciphering?
question_12965.ground_truth: The UE can perform an initial registration procedure using these algorithms when registering for emergency services, performing initial registration for emergency services, or establishing an emergency PDU session.

question_12966.question: What functional entities utilize SEAL Client and SEAL Server for the group management service in the MSGin5G Service?

question_12967.question: What response parameters/data are included in an ENVELOPE command for a Data Connection Status Change event?
question_12967.ground_truth: None. No response parameters/data are included in this type of ENVELOPE command.

question_12968.question: What is the responsibility of the Non-3GPP Message Gateway in the message delivery process?
question_12968.ground_truth: The Non-3GPP Message Gateway translates the MSGin5G message to a Non-3GPP message and sends it to the Non-3GPP Message Client.

question_12969.question: What protocol is used by the MPQUIC solution to indicate the QoS flow associated with an MPQUIC connection?
question_12969.ground_truth: The QoS flow associated with an MPQUIC connection is indicated during the connection setup as a new transport parameter.

question_12970.question: How can the AF control the DNS resolver used by the UE in a negotiated DNN/S-NSSAI?
question_12970.ground_truth: The AF can control the DNS resolver used by the UE in a negotiated DNN/S-NSSAI by providing information about the IP address of the DNS server and corresponding security related information to the 5GC.

question_12971.question: What action does the VAL server take upon receiving a status request from the ASM server?
question_12971.ground_truth: The VAL server responds immediately to the ASM server with a report containing status information as requested.

question_12974.question: What is the range of values for the guaranteed bit rate for downlink when the value of the binary coded value in 8 bits is 00111101?
question_12974.ground_truth: The range of values for the guaranteed bit rate for downlink is from 500 Mbps to 510 Mbps.

question_12975.question: What is the frequency offset for the unwanted signal when tested at 400 kHz below the nominal frequency of the wanted signal?
question_12975.ground_truth: The frequency offset for the unwanted signal when tested at 400 kHz below the nominal frequency of the wanted signal is 400 kHz.

question_12976.question: What can cause very long delays in receiving a paging message for some CIoT MSs?
question_12976.ground_truth: A CIoT MS may experience a long delay in receiving a paging message if it moves out of the coverage of a cell before the paging occasion, and the next paging message is sent when the MS is in an unsynchronized new cell.

question_12978.question: What new functionalities in the 5GS are needed to support network slice-related quota on the maximum number of UEs?
question_12978.ground_truth: The new functionalities required include storing network slice-related quota information, managing and updating the network slice quota, enforcing the network slice quota, and a new NF to support the storing and access control of network slice information.

question_12979.question: What is the goal of the open systems approach in a 3GPP system?
question_12979.ground_truth: The goal of the open systems approach in a 3GPP system is to choose commercially supported specifications and standards for selected system interfaces and build systems based on modular hardware and software design.

question_12980.question: What must be established before the UPF can report PMIC/UMIC information towards the TSN AF or TSCTSF?
question_12980.ground_truth: At least one established PDU session for DS-TT port.

question_12981.question: What is the purpose of NAS security?
question_12981.ground_truth: NAS security provides services to the NAS protocols, such as integrity protection and ciphering of NAS signalling messages.

question_12982.question: What is the solution for the case when a group with call activity in LMR system cannot be added to a group regroup?
question_12982.ground_truth: The proposal includes a 'group has call in progress' result code for a group regroup request, allowing the user to omit the LMR group from the group regroup or wait and try again. Alternatively, the IWF can check whether an MC service group has call activity using the check group status request and response and omit the MC service group from the group regroup if necessary.

question_12983.question: What is the function that enables the transfer of NAS messages within the Access Stratum in the RRC protocol and S1AP?

question_12985.question: What action does the BCC entity in the MS take when it receives a TERMINATION message in any state?
question_12985.ground_truth: When the BCC entity in the MS receives a TERMINATION message in any state, it informs higher layers, asks lower sub-layers to release the broadcast call, clears the context related to the broadcast call, and returns to state U0, NULL.

question_12986.question: What is the requirement for UE when the SSB for CBD measurement is in the same OFDM symbol as CSI-RS for CBD measurement on a different CC in FR2?
question_12986.ground_truth: The UE is required to measure one of but not both SSB and CSI-RS for CBD measurement. A longer measurement period for SSB based CBD measurement is expected, and no requirements are defined.

question_12987.question: What is the action taken by the UE (MCPTT Client) when it accepts a private emergency call in on-demand Automatic Commencement Mode without offering a media-level section for a media-floor control entity?
question_12987.ground_truth: The UE (MCPTT Client) sends a SIP 200 (OK) message accepting the private emergency call in on-demand Automatic Commencement Mode without offering a media-level section for a media-floor control entity.

question_12988.question: What message does the SCEF send to the SCS/AS to confirm the reception of a Device triggering request with a specific MSISDN or External Identifier?
question_12988.ground_truth: SCEF sends a Device triggering response to the SCS/AS to acknowledge the reception of a Device triggering request with MSISDN or External Identifier matching the target identifier.

question_12989.question: What is the action taken by the UE if it has 5G-EA0 as a selected 5G NAS security algorithm and selects a PLMN other than Registered PLMN and EPLMN over one access?
question_12989.ground_truth: The UE sends an initial NAS message including cleartext IEs only via the access type associated with the newly selected PLMN if it does not have a valid 5G NAS security context.

question_12990.question: Under which circumstances does the target RNC reject the handover if the target cell is a CSG cell, or accept the emergency bearers if the target cell is in hybrid mode and the CSG Membership Indication is "non-member"?
question_12990.ground_truth: The target RNC rejects the handover with an appropriate cause if the target cell is a CSG cell and the provided CSG ID does not match the CSG ID for the target cell. If the target cell is in hybrid mode, the target RNC accepts the emergency bearers if the CSG Membership Indication is "non-member".

question_12991.question: What is the "PC8-control-protocol-cause-value" element used for in the 3GPP 5G Pro Se PC3ach interface?
question_12991.ground_truth: The "PC8-control-protocol-cause-value" element contains the cause value that indicates the reason for the rejection of a specific transaction in the 5G network.

question_12993.question: In what scenario would an RMD-CDR be produced in the Recipient MMS R/S?
question_12993.ground_truth: An RMD-CDR would be produced in the Recipient MMS R/S when the system decides to abandon processing of an MM, deletes an MM due to expiry of storage time, or deletes an MM prior to the expiry of storage time as per a request from the recipient MMS User Agent.

question_12994.question: In which conditions should the UE wait before attempting to obtain service on a higher priority PLMN or SNPN?
question_12994.ground_truth: If the UE fails the security check of the SOR information and is in automatic network selection mode, it shall wait until it moves to idle mode or 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication before attempting to obtain service on a higher priority PLMN or SNPN.

question_12996.question: What is the purpose of the Entry Point (EP) Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_12996.ground_truth: The Entry Point (EP) Integration Reference Point (IRP) is a special Integration Reference Point (IRP) that provides a convenient mechanism for the network manager (NM) to discover the managed systems and their related Integration Reference Points (IRPs) in the environment, which can be difficult due to the presence of several managed systems and multiple IRPs related to each managed system.

question_12998.question: When should the UE set the contents of the IE "UE positioning Error" to 'Not Enough GANSS Satellites'?
question_12998.ground_truth: The UE should set the contents of the IE "UE positioning Error" to 'Not Enough GANSS Satellites' when it does not receive enough satellite signals to compute a position.

question_12999.question: What are the three types of data exchange between the DED and DESMP in the general service flow?
question_12999.ground_truth: The three types of data exchange between the DED and DESMP in the general service flow are command delivering, data reporting, and other data.

question_13000.question: What is the procedure that needs to be followed if a service-related entity wants to be notified when a UE becomes reachable at NAS level?
question_13000.ground_truth: The UE Reachability Notification Request procedure is followed, where the service-related entity requests the HSS to provide an indication regarding UE reachability and the HSS sends a UE-REACHABILITY-NOTIFICATION-REQUEST to the SGSN if the value of URRP-SGSN parameter has changed to "set".

question_13001.question: What should the overall delays measured from the beginning of time period T2 be for the number of successful tests for event "T2 A6" to increase by one?
question_13001.ground_truth: The overall delays measured from the beginning of time period T2 should be less than 12802 ms for the number of successful tests for event "T2 A6" to increase by one.

question_13002.question: What shall a transmission participant do upon receiving a Transmission Rejected message where the User ID in the User ID field matches its own MCVideo ID and there is a stored current transmission arbitrator?
question_13002.ground_truth: The transmission participant shall stop the timer T201, provide transmission deny notification to the user, display the transmission deny reason to the user using information in the Reject Cause field if desired, and enter the 'O: has no permission' state.

question_13003.question: What should the PDSCH BLER using the transport format indicated by the median CQI0 + 1 and median CQI1 + 1 be greater than or equal to?
question_13003.ground_truth: The PDSCH BLER using the transport format indicated by the median CQI0 + 1 and median CQI1 + 1 should be greater than or equal to 0.1.

question_13004.question: What is the initiating message for the PDCMeasurementTerminationCommand procedure?

question_13005.question: What is the maximum duration of the test in 20.22.32.1.4?
question_13005.ground_truth: The maximum duration of the test in 20.22.32.1.4 is 10 minutes.

question_13006.question: Which two network elements are involved in generating an access token for accessing services of a specific NF Service Producer instance after a successful verification of input parameters in the access token request?
question_13006.ground_truth: The NRF in the visited PLMN and the NRF in the home PLMN are involved in generating an access token for accessing services of a specific NF Service Producer instance after a successful verification of input parameters in the access token request.

question_13008.question: What is the significance of the "Call control result" field?
question_13008.ground_truth: The "Call control result" field specify the outcome of the call control operation as allowed, not allowed or allowed with modifications.

question_13010.question: What is the function of the EMSDP Session Request message in initiating a BEST session?
question_13010.ground_truth: The EMSDP Session Request message in the BEST service includes the UE Identity, BEST capabilities of the UE, details of the enterprise service, and the Enterprise server Id that the BEST service is being used for. This message is used to initiate a BEST session after the establishment of the PDN connection or PDU Session.

question_13012.question: What is the function of the UTRAN-GPSReferenceTimeResult in Extension-ReferenceTimeChoice-IE?
question_13012.ground_truth: The UTRAN-GPSReferenceTimeResult in Extension-ReferenceTimeChoice-IE represents the UTC time of the frame when the UE is reporting the position.

question_13015.question: What actions should the network perform if the TFT operation is "Delete existing TFT" or "Delete packet filters from existing TFT" and this operation would render the TFT empty?
question_13015.ground_truth: The network should further process the new request and, if no error was detected, consider the TFT as successfully deleted.

question_13019.question: What is the purpose of the Local Call Local Switch (LCLS) feature in 3GPP networks?
question_13019.ground_truth: The LCLS feature allows for the user plane to be locally switched for calls generated and terminated by users served by the same BSS, resulting in saving on transmission resources.

question_13021.question: For which of the additional requirements for DC-HSUPA, UL OLTD, UL CLTD and UL MIMO are specified the parameters in clause 6 at the UL E-DCH reference measurement channel?
question_13021.ground_truth: The parameters for the additional requirements for DC-HSUPA, UL OLTD, UL CLTD and UL MIMO are specified in clause 6 at the UL E-DCH reference measurement channel, specified in subclause A.2.6, as per the given text.

question_13024.question: What does the "EL" bit in the length indicator field indicate?
question_13024.ground_truth: The "EL" bit in the length indicator field indicates the final octet of the field.

question_13025.question: What action does the SCC AS take when it receives an INVITE from the S-CSCF?
question_13025.ground_truth: The SCC AS invokes a B2BUA, terminating the UE A Leg and originating the Remote Leg for presentation of an IMS session towards the B-party on behalf of UE A.

question_13026.question: What action should the UE take if it ignores the P-CSCF address received in step 2 of the procedure?
question_13026.ground_truth: The UE will send a DHCP query in step 3.

question_13028.question: What should the MAC entity do if a set of Random Access resources is not associated with any feature indication?
question_13028.ground_truth: The MAC entity should consider the set of Random Access resources to not be associated with any feature indication.

question_13029.question: What should be the value of b=AS for EVS Primary mode at IPv4 if br is 7.2-24.4, the packetization is header-full payload format, ptime is 20, and no extra bandwidth is allocated for redundancy?
question_13029.ground_truth: The value should be set to 42.

question_13032.question: What event is used to report the result of the protocol negotiation in UMTS Circuit Switched Data package?

question_13033.question: What is the PRACH's NTA defined as (in Tc units) for other channels?
question_13033.ground_truth: The PRACH's NTA is defined as 0 (in Tc units) for other channels.

question_13035.question: What is the purpose of the MCVideo private emergency alert (MVPEA) state in the MCVideo client?
question_13035.ground_truth: The MVPEA state is used in conjunction with the MVEPC state to manage the MCVideo emergency state and related actions.

question_13036.question: What is the measure of a receiver's capability to receive a wanted modulated signal without exceeding a given degradation due to the presence of an unwanted signal in the adjacent channel?

question_13039.question: What will be discussed for a possible additional allocation to the mobile services on a primary basis during WRC-23 in the 7-24 GHz range?
question_13039.ground_truth: The frequency range 10.0 - 10.5 GHz in Region 2.

question_13040.question: What information does the RAB.SuccRelCS.Cause measurement provide?
question_13040.ground_truth: The RAB.SuccRelCS.Cause measurement provides the number of successfully released RABs for CS domain, split into subcounters per release cause.

question_13041.question: What is the 3GPP Technical Specification group that focuses on the Common IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS)?
question_13041.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specifications and Technical Reports relating to the Common IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS) is the 3GPP Technical Specifications Group that focuses on IMS.

question_13043.question: What is the meaning of the "UE-associatedLogicalNG-connectionList" field in the NGResetAcknowledgeIEs sequence in the JSON format?
question_13043.ground_truth: The "UE-associatedLogicalNG-connectionList" field is a list of logical connections between the user equipment (UE) and the next generation radio access network (NG-RAN). This information is included in an NG reset acknowledge message to inform the network about the state of the logical connections that were reset.

question_13047.question: What is the result of indicating support for redirect instructions in a request?
question_13047.ground_truth: If the application indicates support for redirect instructions, the GUP server may decide to return redirect instructions based on policies, allowing the application to receive and process these redirections accordingly.

question_13048.question: What should a UE do when it receives a PMF-Suspend Duplication Request message from the UPF without a specified type of traffic?
question_13048.ground_truth: The UE should stop duplicating all traffic for which traffic duplication is being performed.

question_13049.question: What should be included in the application/sdp MIME body if the session parameters of the pre-established session require modification or if implicit floor control is required?
question_13049.ground_truth: An application/sdp MIME body containing an SDP offer should be included in the <body> element if the session parameters require modification, or if implicit floor control is required.

question_13050.question: What information does a DCCF include in the notification endpoint information when notifying MFAF-2 or DCCF-2?
question_13050.ground_truth: The DCCF includes the endpoint information necessary for MFAF-2 or DCCF-2 to send notifications, such as the address or address and port number of MFAF-2 or DCCF-2.

question_13051.question: What is the role of the tilt compensation filter in speech processing?
question_13051.ground_truth: The tilt compensation filter is used to compensate for the frequency response tilt of the speech production mechanism in speech processing applications.

question_13052.question: How many measurements are taken during the second set of tests in steps e) to j)?
question_13052.ground_truth: The number of measurements taken during the second set of tests in steps e) to j) is 20.

question_13053.question: What security mechanism is used to protect offline floor and media control signalling and how is the information conveyed?
question_13053.ground_truth: The security mechanism for protecting offline floor and media control signalling is provided within each SRTCP Packet, where the transmitting UEs send SRTCP packets using the format described in IETF RFC 3711. The terminating UE uses the contents of the MKI to look up the appropriate Master Key and Salt and generate the appropriate SRTCP session key and salt if it satisfies the key derivation rate criteria as specified in IETF RFC 3711.

question_13054.question: What does a UE indicate by UTO-UCI a value of '1' for a CG-PUSCH TO, and what is the effect of this indication for subsequent CG-PUSCH transmissions?
question_13054.ground_truth: The UE indicates by UTO-UCI a value of '1' for a CG-PUSCH TO to indicate that it will not transmit CG-PUSCH in the CG-PUSCH TO. The UE continues to indicate the value of '1' for the CG-PUSCH TO in subsequent CG-PUSCH transmissions.

question_13055.question: In which frequency range do IMT and DTV coexistence require additional consideration on a per-country basis in Region 3?
question_13055.ground_truth: Digital television (DTV) and IMT coexistence may require additional consideration on a per-country basis in the 470-694 MHz frequency range in Region 3, potentially leading to the need for a guard band.

question_13056.question: How can shared data be obtained by the NRF if it's not available in the NRF?
question_13056.ground_truth: If the shared data corresponding to the shared-data ID is not available in the NRF, the NRF can obtain it by invoking a separate function to retrieve the shared data from a granted NF or a shared data repository.

question_13057.question: What is the name of the new type of DL quality reporting introduced in Rel-16, which reflects MPDCCH quality rather than PDSCH quality?
question_13057.ground_truth: The report represents the required number of MPDCCH subframe repetitions for reliable MPDCCH reception.

question_13060.question: What type of AVP is the Monitoring-UE-VPLMN-Identifier, and what information does it contain?
question_13060.ground_truth: The Monitoring-UE-VPLMN-Identifier AVP is of type UTF8String and contains the identifier of the monitoring UE's VPLMN.

question_13061.question: What are the symbols used in the present document for charging system components and interfaces?
question_13061.ground_truth: The symbols used in the present document for charging system components and interfaces include Bd for the CDR file transfer from the 5G Data connectivity CGF to the BD, Ga for CDR transfer between a CDF and the CGF, Nchf for the service based interface exhibited by CHF, and N40 for the reference point between SMF and the CHF.

question_13063.question: What is excluded from the scope of the present document?
question_13063.ground_truth: The specification of transmission delay requirements and O&M requirements are not included in the scope of the present document.

question_13064.question: What information does the group charging event collection/reporting and CDRs generation/reporting include?

question_13066.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP TS 25.41x series of Technical Specifications?
question_13066.ground_truth: The 3GPP TS 25.41x series of Technical Specifications defines the Iu interface for the interconnection of Radio Network Controller (RNC) component of the UMTS Terrestrial Radio Access Network (UTRAN) to the Core Network of the UMTS system.

question_13068.question: What is the condition for the IWF to revert the MCPTT emergency alert state to its value prior to entering the current procedure?
question_13068.ground_truth: If the IWF receiving a SIP 4xx response, SIP 5xx response or SIP 6xx response to the SIP re-INVITE request did not contain an <originated-by> element and did not contain an <originated-by> element, the IWF shall revert the MCPTT emergency alert (MEA) state to its value prior to entering the current procedure.

question_13069.question: What parameter should be used to map the retransmission payload type to the associated original payload type in RTP?

question_13071.question: What must a UE do to verify that the stored MCCH information remains valid during an MCCH modification period, when it is not currently receiving an MBMS service via MRB and is potentially interested in receiving other services from a carrier with a different DL-bandwidth?
question_13071.ground_truth: The UE must attempt to find the MCCH information change notification at least notificationRepetitionCoeff times during the modification period of the applicable MCCH(s), if no MCCH information change notification is received.

question_13073.question: What is one of the benefits of SON (Self-Organizing Network) for AAS (Active Antenna Systems) ?
question_13073.ground_truth: SON mechanism with OAM (Operation, Administration, and Maintenance) support can optimize the inter-operability of AAS operations for cell splitting, cell merging, and cell shaping.

question_13074.question: In what circumstances does the UE send a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message to request de-registration from the network?
question_13074.ground_truth: A UE sends a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message to the network when it wants to initiate a UE or network-terminated de-registration.

question_13076.question: What HTTP method can be used to request the creation of a new Slice Parameters Provisioning in the SliceParamProvision API?
question_13076.ground_truth: The HTTP method that can be used to request the creation of a new Slice Parameters Provisioning in the SliceParamProvision API is POST.

question_13077.question: What are the PDU Set QoS Parameters specified in TS 23.501 for enabling PDU Set based QoS handling in 5G?
question_13077.ground_truth: PDU Set Delay Budget (PSDB) and PDU Set Error Rate (PSER)

question_13080.question: What should an NF Service Consumer do if it receives LCI for the same target scope from different NF service producers?
question_13080.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should consider the LCIs received from different NF service producers as independent from each other when handling LCIs for the same target scope.

question_13082.question: What is the main difference between the synchronization procedure for 1.28 Mcps TDD and 3.84 Mcps TDD?
question_13082.ground_truth: The main difference is the use of the DwPCH for synchronization burst transmission and reception instead of the PRACH in the 1.28 Mcps TDD.

question_13084.question: What subframe is regarded as the subframe occurring immediately before the measurement gap for SCG in GP2 and GP3 asynchronous dual connectivity with a measurement gap length of 3?
question_13084.ground_truth: Subframe j is regarded as the subframe occurring immediately before the measurement gap for SCG in GP2 and GP3 asynchronous dual connectivity with a measurement gap length of 3.

question_13085.question: What are the two energy saving states that can be identified for a network element?
question_13085.ground_truth: The two energy saving states are notParticipatingInEnergySaving state and energySaving state.

question_13087.question: What happens if two colliding measurement gaps are not fully overlapping in NR serving cells?
question_13087.ground_truth: The UE will perform measurements in the occasion of the measurement gap with higher priority, and the occasion with lower priority is considered dropped.

question_13088.question: What is the currently defined 5GMSd Application Function (AF) based network assistance solution exclusively triggered by?

question_13089.question: What should the UE do upon receipt of a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message for an existing PDU session that is not subject to network slice admission control?
question_13089.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message for an existing PDU session that is not subject to network slice admission control, the UE shall stop timer T3580, release the allocated PTI value, and consider that the PDU session was established.

question_13091.question: What is the Test Procedure for CatPollingOff in 6.8.3.2?
question_13091.ground_truth: The Test Procedure for CatPollingOff in 6.8.3.2 is to set the test to CatPollingOff and execute the test case mentioned for turning polling off.

question_13092.question: What is the purpose of the document "3rd Generation Partnership Project; Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects; Study on generic group management, exposure and communication enhancements (Release 18)"?
question_13092.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to study potential enhancements on generic group management, exposure and communication in the 3GPP system.

question_13093.question: In the scenario described in section 5.3.4.2.2, what is the role of the SMF when adding a new PDU session anchor and enabling Branching Point or UL CL functionalities?
question_13093.ground_truth: The SMF selects a UPF and establishes the Branching Point or UL CL functionalities in the data path, indicating what traffic should be forwarded towards the existing and new UPFs. The SMF also decides this UPF as the single point of measurement for charging.

question_13094.question: What is the role of the AS data collection client (5GMS~AS) in the 5GMS architecture with respect to UE data collection and reporting?
question_13094.ground_truth: The 5GMS~AS plays the role of the AS data collection client in the 5GMS architecture. It may be deployed as a trusted AS within the 5G System or deployed externally. The 5GMS~AS is responsible for reporting downlink media streaming access activity to the Data Collection AF instantiated in the 5GMSd~AF via reference point R4.

question_13095.question: What response does hA1 send to S-CSCF when a PRACK request is received and precondition mechanism is used?
question_13095.ground_truth: hA1 sends a 200 (OK) response to the PRACK request.

question_13096.question: What is the objective of the attacker in stealing service under the described circumstances?
question_13096.ground_truth: The attacker can make calls, send SMSes, and send/receive data without being charged for it by breaking into a collapsed RNC/NodeB or by breaking the ciphering/integrity algorithms and injecting data over the air interface.

question_13097.question: What is the percentage increase in mean capacity performance when bandwidth is increased from 100MHz to 400MHz for FR2, Dense Urban, UL, for CG (8 Mbps, 15ms PDB, 60FPS), DDDSU TDD format based on Source 16?
question_13097.ground_truth: The mean capacity performance is increased by more than 100%.

question_13102.question: When restoring a floor participant's privileges after overriding without revoke, what state will the floor control interface enter?
question_13102.ground_truth: The floor control interface will enter the 'U: permitted' state.

question_13103.question: What should the UE do if it has not obtained location information, and SIB19 has not broadcasted distanceThresh and referenceLocation?
question_13103.ground_truth: In this case, the UE may not perform intra-frequency measurements.

question_13104.question: What is the minimum persistence time per frame for low persistence in VR displays?
question_13104.ground_truth: Low persistence in VR displays means having the screen lit for only a small fraction of the frame, typically 2 - 3 ms.

question_13105.question: What should the AS do if the number of diversions exceeds the given limit when receiving an initial INVITE request?
question_13105.ground_truth: Based on operator policy, the AS shall send one of the 486, 480, 408, 503, 404, or 487 responses to the originating user with a Warning header field indicating that the communication is released due to the extension of diversion hops.

question_13106.question: What should the floor control server do upon receiving an initial SIP INVITE request or SIP REFER request to establish an MCPTT chat group call or to rejoin an ongoing MCPTT call?
question_13106.ground_truth: The floor control server should not handle the initial SIP INVITE request or SIP REFER request as an implicit floor control request message, except if explicitly stated in the SIP INVITE request or in the SIP REFER request.

question_13108.question: On what QoS Flow shall the User Plane Function (UPF) perform access performance measurements when it receives a list of QoS Flows from the Session Management Function (SMF)?
question_13108.ground_truth: The UPF shall perform access performance measurements per QoS Flow only when this is explicitly indicated in the Measurement Assistance Information, i.e. only when the UPF receives the list of QoS Flows over which access performance measurements may be performed. Otherwise, the UPF shall perform access performance measurements based on the QoS Flow associated with the default QoS rule.

question_13110.question: When is the frequency error for DC-HSUPA tested?
question_13110.ground_truth: The frequency error for DC-HSUPA is tested with the UE receiver at the reference sensitivity, where the UE transmitter is set to maximum output power, and the frequency error is measured at each assigned channel frequency using the Global In-Channel-Tx-test.

question_13111.question: What is the format of the End-Marker Control PDU, as specified in TS 37.324 clause 6.2.3?
question_13111.ground_truth: The End-Marker Control PDU consists of a Start Flag, a QoS Flow ID, a Length, a Next Extension, and an Extension field.

question_13113.question: What should be the final state of the MS upon completion of the registration procedure for call restriction services?
question_13113.ground_truth: The MS remains unaffected and remains in the same call control state as before the registration procedure.

question_13114.question: What should an MCPTT floor participant do upon receiving a Floor Request message and if the User ID field in the message matches its own MCPTT ID, but there is no stored SSRC of the current arbitrator?
question_13114.ground_truth: The MCPTT floor participant should set its own SSRC as the stored SSRC of the current arbitrator, stop timer T203 and T201 if they are running, provide a floor granted notification to the MCPTT user, and enter 'O: has permission' state.

question_13115.question: What is the adjustment to be made to the reference sensitivity performance for DCS 1800 class 1 and class 2 MS for normal conditions?
question_13115.ground_truth: A correction offset of +2dB shall apply for the reference sensitivity performance.

question_13116.question: What is the requirement for master station (BTS) and mobile station in terms of channel spacing?

question_13117.question: What is the meaning of "shall" in the context of 3GPP Technical Specifications?
question_13117.ground_truth: "Shall" in the context of 3GPP Technical Specifications indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

question_13118.question: What should the UE do if it receives a payload, payload type, and the CAA-level UAV ID from the UAS-NF in the Service-level-AA container IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message for a UE registered for disaster roaming services and for a PDU session which is not a PDU session for emergency services?
question_13118.ground_truth: The UE should include the service-level-AA response, the service-level device ID set to the CAA-level UAV ID, the service-level-AA payload with the value set to the payload, and the service-level-AA payload type with the values set to the associated payload type in the Service-level-AA container IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message.

question_13119.question: What does the scaling factor equals when Srxlev > SnonIntraSearchP and Squal > SnonIntraSearchQ?
question_13119.ground_truth: The scaling factor equals to the sum of Nlayer in 4.2.2.7 and one positioning layer.

question_13120.question: What should the MCPTT client do if the MCPTT user does not answer the call within a certain time?
question_13120.ground_truth: If the MCPTT user does not answer the call within the specified time, the MCPTT client should send a SIP 480 (Temporarily Unavailable) response to the SIP INVITE request and not continue with any further steps.

question_13121.question: What procedures may occur during the establishment of a TFCP tunnel for non-3GPP access in step 1a, b, and c?
question_13121.ground_truth: In step 1a, the TFCP tunnel is requested by UE. In step 1b, the TFCP indication with the binding QoS flow Info or Packet Filter is included in the PDU session Modification Command message to indicate the successful establishment of the TFCP tunnel. In step 1c, the UE acknowledges the QoS rule and the TFCP tunnel in the NAS message PDU Session ID, N1 SM container (PDU Session Modification Command Ack).

question_13122.question: What interface is used for communication between UDM and HSS FE in the 5G system?
question_13122.ground_truth: The Sh interface, as defined in clause~6.2.2.1, is used for communication between UDM and HSS FE in the 5G system.

question_13123.question: What is one of the benefits of the Generalized Unavailability Period solution?
question_13123.ground_truth: The solution can avoid a large number of UEs re-accessing a serving PLMN at the same time after a coverage gap has ended.

question_13124.question: Which messaging services are not included in IMS MES?
question_13124.ground_truth: IMS MES does not include support for legacy store and forward messaging such as the Short Messaging Service (SMS).

question_13126.question: Which image file format is part of the media types supported by IMS terminals, typically represented by the "image/jpeg" MIME type?

question_13127.question: Which security mechanism is applied for the MB2-C interface, as specified in the GCSE?
question_13127.ground_truth: The security mechanisms for the MB2-C interface include TLS, DTLS, or IKE/IPsec as mandatory for implementation, and mutual authentication between nodes in the security domains. The signaling messages on MB2-C and user plane messages on MB2-U should be integrity and confidentiality protected and replay protected. The BM-SC and GCS AS may apply access control on messages initiated by each other.

question_13128.question: What is the purpose of sending a Floor Queue Position Info message to the MCPTT clients in the active floor request queue?
question_13128.ground_truth: The purpose of sending a Floor Queue Position Info message to the MCPTT clients in the active floor request queue is to provide the updated status on their queue position and the status of other MCPTT clients in the queue.

question_13129.question: What is the maximum allowed time for the UE to identify a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell?
question_13129.ground_truth: The maximum allowed time for the UE to identify a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell is 190 ms.

question_13130.question: What should the RBW be set to for a 1.28Mcps TDD UE?
question_13130.ground_truth: The RBW should be set to 3MHz.

question_13131.question: What is the target data rate and latency requirement for the 5G system to optimize for transfer of continuous uplink data in cloud robotics applications?
question_13131.ground_truth: The target data rate is 10 Mbps and the latency is 1-10 ms.

question_13132.question: What message is sent by the mobile station after receiving a PAGING REQUEST message to initiate the immediate assignment procedure?

question_13133.question: In what scenarios does the SGSN/MSC/VLR perform access control for CSG cells?
question_13133.ground_truth: The access control is performed for HNB during attach, detach, service request, RAU, and location update procedures, but only if the SGSN/MSC/VLR receives a NAS request message from the HNB GW together with an indication that the request is from a release 8 UE.

question_13134.question: Which cause numbers are used to indicate a problem with the user's authentication?
question_13134.ground_truth: Cause number 29 and cause number 33 are used to indicate a problem with the user's authentication.

question_13136.question: What is the primary purpose of MPS for Voice?
question_13136.ground_truth: The primary purpose of MPS for Voice is to provide the Service User with priority voice communication sessions in periods of severe network congestion during which normal commercial voice service is degraded.

question_13137.question: What action does the Proxy-Gn take when it receives a Delete PDP Context towards the GGSN from the serving GA-SM entity?
question_13137.ground_truth: The Proxy-Gn forwards Delete PDP Context to the GGSN and the EGAN Access Termination enters the INACTIVE state.

question_13138.question: What is the function of the BM-SC in the TMGI Allocation Procedure?
question_13138.ground_truth: The BM-SC determines whether the GCS AS is authorized to receive the TMGIs, allocates a set of TMGIs, and determines an expiration time for the TMGIs.

question_13140.question: In the context of resource authorization procedures, what does the term "AF" refer to?
question_13140.ground_truth: In the context of resource authorization procedures, "AF" refers to the Application Function, which is a functional entity responsible for enforcing policy rules on the PDN connection.

question_13142.question: What are the two frequency offsets that determine the different parts of the PN model's domination in TR 38.803?
question_13142.ground_truth: When the frequency offset is less than LoopBW, the PN is dominated by ref noise and Loop components. When the frequency offset is greater than LoopBW, the PN model is dominated by VCO.

question_13144.question: What message is sent by the target UE when it cannot accept the PROSE DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION REQUEST?
question_13144.ground_truth: PROSE DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION REJECT message

question_13147.question: What is the procedure for IP-CAN session termination for offloaded traffic in the case when dynamic policy provisioning is not deployed in trusted Fixed Broadband Access network?
question_13147.ground_truth: If dynamic policy provisioning is not deployed, the Fixed Broadband Access network employs local policies for IP-CAN session termination. The PCRF does not execute a Gateway Control and QoS Rules Provision procedure or a PCRF-Initiated Gateway Control Session Termination Procedure with the BPCF over S9a.

question_13149.question: What is the maximum number of times the MS is allowed to transmit in step n) for both GMSK modulation and 8-PSK modulation?
question_13149.ground_truth: The MS is allowed to transmit no more than 25 times in step n) for both GMSK modulation and 8-PSK modulation.

question_13150.question: What should a UE do with an EPS bearer identity (EBI) contained in the parameters list field of one or more authorized QoS flow descriptions in a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message, in S1 mode?
question_13150.ground_truth: The UE should locally remove the EPS bearer identity (EBI) from the parameters list field of such one or more authorized QoS flow descriptions.

question_13152.question: What is required for the H(e)NB to check the revocation status of certificates?
question_13152.ground_truth: The H(e)NB may check the revocation status of certificates using either CRLs or OCSP.

question_13153.question: Where can 'RAPID only' and 'MAC subPDU(s) with RAPID and MAC RAR' be placed within a MAC PDU?
question_13153.ground_truth: They can be placed anywhere between a MAC subPDU with Backoff Indicator only (if any) and padding (if any).

question_13154.question: What is the function of the Unstructured Data Storage Function (UDSF) in storing and retrieving data?
question_13154.ground_truth: The UDSF function enables the storage and retrieval of data with basic operations, including creating, reading, updating, and deleting data. It also supports transaction integrity and pessimistic locking.

question_13155.question: What is the property described in the Technical Report that an eNB is unable to calculate AS keys for UEs after a series of subsequent handovers?

question_13156.question: How is the measurement of the mean number of the radio link established by other UTRAN cells obtained?
question_13156.ground_truth: This measurement is obtained by RNC sampling at a pre-defined interval the number of the radio link established by other UTRAN cell that is other than the best UTRAN cell of active set (UE side), and then taking the arithmetic mean.

question_13157.question: What is the objective of requiring a new AKA run upon idle mode mobility between different SAE/LTE networks?
question_13157.ground_truth: The objective is to provide MME with new keys that depend on the identity of the new PLMN, and the RAT type, and to avoid new AKA runs on frequent network changes by using a key caching mechanism.

question_13159.question: What is Option 4's target for the test decoder in the context of defining interoperability?
question_13159.ground_truth: Option 4's target is that a single decoder implemented by each TE vendor will be enough for at least a single test for any DUTs, with the TE vendor able to implement the test decoder without any involvement from another party.

question_13160.question: When should the UE include measurement results for neighboring cells in the logMeasInfoList?
question_13160.ground_truth: The UE should include measurement results for at most 6 neighboring cells on the NR serving frequency and for at most 3 cells per NR neighboring frequency and for the NR neighboring frequencies that are included in both interFreqTargetInfo and SIB4.

question_13162.question: What is the main difference between the Small Data Fast Path solution (Solution 3a) and Connectionless Data Transmission solution (Solution 3b) for reducing signalling?
question_13162.ground_truth: The main difference is the handling of security. In the Small Data Fast Path solution (Solution 3a), security is performed between the UE and SGW. In contrast, in the Connectionless Data Transmission solution (Solution 3b), the eNB performs the encryption function.

question_13163.question: How does the H-SMF select V-SMF?
question_13163.ground_truth: The H-SMF selects V-SMF based on the target DNAI sent by the H-AMF after the target DNAI is determined.

question_13164.question: What UE performance is required for E-UTRA measurements in clause 10.2A?
question_13164.ground_truth: The UE performance required for E-UTRA measurements in clause 10.2A is specified for RedCap UE in SA operation mode.

question_13165.question: What should a UE do when receiving an RRC message with an abstract syntax that is invalid?
question_13165.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the message.

question_13166.question: Under what conditions should a UE not report type-0-triggered SRS in the current subframe n?
question_13166.ground_truth: A UE should not report type-0-triggered SRS in the current subframe n if the MAC entity would not be in Active Time considering grants/assignments/DRX Command MAC control elements/Long DRX Command MAC control elements received and Scheduling Request sent until and including subframe n-5 when evaluating all DRX Active Time conditions as specified in this clause.

question_13167.question: What are the pre-conditions for registering to a functional identity in the FRMCS system?
question_13167.ground_truth: The equipment type is identified, and functional registration of the user, the user is logged in into the FRMCS System.

question_13169.question: What must the AMF do when preparing a mapped EPS security context for the target MME during inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode?
question_13169.ground_truth: The AMF must derive a K~ASME using the K~AMF key and the downlink NAS COUNT of the current 5G NAS security context, include the corresponding NAS sequence number in the N1 mode to S1 mode NAS transparent container IE, and then increment its stored downlink NAS COUNT value by one.

question_13170.question: What is the expected sequence of tests for testing the SIM/ME interface in clause 27?
question_13170.ground_truth: The expected sequence of tests includes the correct interpretation of data read from the SIM by the ME, the correct writing of data to the SIM by the ME, the initiation of appropriate procedures by the ME, low-level protocols, electrical characteristics, and physical characteristics.

question_13171.question: What is the main focus of closed-loop automation mechanisms in Intent-driven MnS Producer?
question_13171.ground_truth: Closed-loop automation mechanisms in Intent-driven MnS Producer focus on continuously monitoring the intent fulfillment status, analyzing service and network information, and automatically meeting the intent requirements.

question_13172.question: What procedure is used in LAPDm protocol to pass unacknowledged information from Layer 3 to Layer 1 for transmission?
question_13172.ground_truth: Unacknowledged information is passed to the data link layer by layer 3 using the primitive DL-UNIT DATA-REQUEST. The layer 3 message unit is then transmitted in a UI command frame using the primitive PH-DATA-REQ.

question_13173.question: What is the procedure for the DeNB to change the EPS bearer allocation for the RN?
question_13173.ground_truth: The DeNB-initiated bearer activation/modification procedure is used to change the EPS bearer allocation for the RN, with the S-GW/P-GW functionality performed by the DeNB.

question_13174.question: How many PRBs are in the uplink NB-LTE carrier?
question_13174.ground_truth: The uplink NB-LTE carrier comprises of 6 PRBs in frequency domain.

question_13175.question: What are the two different connectivity models supported in a PDU Session for accessing an EHE in VPLMN and Home DN in HPLMN simultaneously?
question_13175.ground_truth: The two different connectivity models are LBO PDU Session and HR PDU Session.

question_13176.question: What is the first action the UE performs when it receives the RRCReject message from the network?
question_13176.ground_truth: The UE stops timer T300, if it is running.

question_13177.question: What should have higher priority when AS RAI has been triggered, if data from any Logical Channel, except data from UL-CCCH, does not require segmenting RLC SDU?
question_13177.ground_truth: DCQR and AS RAI MAC control element should have higher priority than data from any Logical Channel, except data from UL-CCCH.

question_13178.question: When must the mobile station send the PACKET DOWNLINK ACK/NACK message with the Final Ack Indicator bit set to '1'?
question_13178.ground_truth: Whenever the mobile station receives an RLC data block with a valid RRBP and has received all RLC data blocks of the TBF.

question_13179.question: What is the optional parameter of the CID that is used to uniquely identify the relevant network element carrying out the LI operations?
question_13179.ground_truth: The Communication Identity Number (CIN) is the optional parameter of the CID that is used to uniquely identify the relevant network element carrying out the LI operations.

question_13180.question: What is the purpose of the speech decoder performing a plausibility analysis of the received frame parameters and of the output signal in case of unreliable frames?
question_13180.ground_truth: The purpose is to detect and conceal erroneous frames which are not marked with the Bad Frame Indication (BFI) flag.

question_13181.question: What should the ICS UE follow when it wants to establish a new I1 session using an existing CS bearer leg?
question_13181.ground_truth: The ICS UE should send an I1 Invite message toward the SCC AS, and populate the I1 Invite message as specified in subclause~6.2.1.2.1 with the following additions: set the Reason in the I1 Invite message to value hex "003" to indicate to the SCC AS that the existing CS bearer leg will be used for this call, and ignore the SCC AS PSI DN, if included in the I1 Progress message with Progress reason set to Call progressing received from the SCC AS, i.e. the ICS UE shall not initiate a call toward the CS domain.

question_13182.question: What are the three different schemes being simulated to analyze the performance impact of latency reduction enhancements?
question_13182.ground_truth: The three different schemes being simulated are Shorter TTI (7 symbols or 2 symbols), Fast UL grant (i.e. pre-scheduling), and UL scheduling based on SR.

question_13183.question: What is the definition of co-location requirement in section 9.7.5.2.3?
question_13183.ground_truth: In section 9.7.5.2.3, co-location requirement refers to a measure to prevent the receivers of own or a different BS of the same band from being desensitized by emissions from a type 1-O BS. The power levels are specified at the co-location reference antenna output.

question_13186.question: What type of measurements are included in Enhanced Cell ID methods?
question_13186.ground_truth: Enhanced Cell ID methods include measurements such as UE Rx-Tx Time Difference (FDD), pathloss, CPICH RSCP (FDD), CPICH Ec/No (FDD), Timing Advance (TDD), RTT (FDD), Rx Timing Deviation (TDD), and Angle of Arrival (1.28 Mcps TDD) to estimate the location of the target UE.

question_13187.question: What is the role of an ICS in the 3GPP specification?
question_13187.ground_truth: In the 3GPP specification, an ICS (Implementation Conformance Statement) is a statement made by the supplier of an implementation or system, stating the capabilities that have been implemented in compliance with the given specification. The ICS can take several forms, including protocol ICS, profile ICS, profile specific ICS, and information object ICS.

question_13189.question: What are some examples of the 5G Access Network options supported within the NG RAN?
question_13189.ground_truth: Some examples of the 5G Access Network options supported within the NG RAN include standalone NR, NR is the anchor with E-UTRA extensions, standalone E-UTRA, E-UTRA is the anchor with NR extensions, and untrusted non-3GPP access, trusted non-3GPP access, and fixed access.

question_13190.question: What is one disadvantage of using a new XML body for session and media flow replication?
question_13190.ground_truth: One disadvantage is that no protocol solution is currently available to evaluate for this option.

question_13193.question: What is the main requirement for NR SA FR2 radio link monitoring UE scheduling restrictions?
question_13193.ground_truth: The main requirement for NR SA FR2 radio link monitoring UE scheduling restrictions is that the UE is not expected to transmit PUCCH, PUSCH, or SRS, or receive PDCCH, PDSCH, or CSI-RS for tracking or CQI on RLM-RS symbols to be measured for radio link monitoring.

question_13196.question: What does TLV-E format of the information element indicate?
question_13196.ground_truth: TLV-E format of the information element indicates that the information element has type-length-value format with an extension.

question_13198.question: What is the requirement for CSFB with PS handover to ensure correct CS/PS coordination?
question_13198.ground_truth: The source network should select the same operator for the PS domain as is already selected for CS via the SGs registration during CSFB with PS handover.

question_13199.question: What is the effect of the NAS procedure called "idle suspend" on the UE?
question_13199.ground_truth: The UE will enter 5GMM-IDLE mode with suspend indication and shall not consider the N1 NAS signalling connection released.

question_13200.question: What is the advantage of providing a range and having the UE draw a random value within that range, compared to providing only a "wait timer" or a "minimum wait time"?
question_13200.ground_truth: Providing a range and having the UE draw a random value within that range offers an upper bound for the wait time, providing more flexibility and limiting service interruption.

question_13202.question: What instance number should the IMS-ALG supply when no visited-realm instances are present in the SDP offer?
question_13202.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG should supply the instance number 2 when no visited-realm instances are present in the SDP offer.

question_13203.question: What is the maximum RRC procedure delay defined in 3GPP TS 36.331, clause 11.2?
question_13203.ground_truth: The maximum RRC procedure delay is 15 ms.

question_13204.question: What are the main aspects for SMS usage charging in the visited MNO's network?
question_13204.ground_truth: The main aspects for SMS usage charging in the visited MNO's network are RAT type and Location.

question_13205.question: When does the UE update stored UE policy information in 5G?
question_13205.ground_truth: The UE updates stored UE policy information with the one provided by the PCF when it has no policies with the same PSI, replaces the stored policy section with the received information, or removes the stored policy section if the received information contains only the PSI.

question_13206.question: In a heterogeneous network, what is the advantage of using Solution 2 for evaluating the importance of a node or cell?
question_13206.ground_truth: Solution 2 allows for dynamic adjustments in cell importance evaluation to reduce bottleneck handling in a heterogeneous network, with the IRPAgent serving as a better decision point due to its proximity to network elements.

question_13207.question: What is required for UEs accessing the Shared NG-RAN to successfully attach?
question_13207.ground_truth: For UEs accessing the Shared NG-RAN, the hosting network needs to know which participating operator a UE is registered to and what type of network sharing is in place for that participating operator.

question_13209.question: What is the size of the output returned by the KDF in the process of deriving CKSRVCC and IKSRVCC from KASME and the NAS downlink COUNT?

question_13211.question: What does HEVC Main-10 Tier Main Profile level 5.1 support in terms of resolution?

question_13212.question: How does IAB support mobility in NR Uu access traffic relaying?
question_13212.ground_truth: IAB supports mobility through wireless in-band and out-of-band relaying of NR Uu access traffic via NR Uu backhaul links.

question_13213.question: What is the role of the NWDAF (Network Exposure and Control) in the deterministic communication solution?
question_13213.ground_truth: The NWDAF provides network analytics on Observed Service Experience to the PCF, which can decide if QoS parameters fulfill the QoS requirements for a target UE or application.

question_13214.question: What is the purpose of the Session Management Congestion Control Experience for PDU Session event in the 5G system?
question_13214.ground_truth: The Session Management Congestion Control Experience for PDU Session event is used to collect data for Session Management Congestion Control Experience analytics in the 5G system.

question_13216.question: What is required for a consumer to perform a data storage query to the SEALDD server?
question_13216.ground_truth: The consumer needs to have the identifier of the stored data, and pre-conditions are that the VAL client/server has stored data in SEALDD server and the consumer has obtained the identifier of the stored data.

question_13218.question: What is required for a UE supporting UAS services to establish a PDU session for USS communication?
question_13218.ground_truth: The UE needs to provide CAA-level~UAV~ID to the network when requesting to establish a PDU session for USS communication.

question_13220.question: In Solution #13, what is the recommended encryption algorithm and method for the handling of encryption/decryption key(s) for storing the TUAK TOPc in the UDR?
question_13220.ground_truth: This solution recommends the use of NIST approved algorithms and reminds that the selection of encryption algorithm and encryption/decryption key(s) is operator dependent.

question_13221.question: What requirement should be met to support confidentiality of MCX Service User IDs from all entities outside the Mission Critical Service?
question_13221.ground_truth: The Mission Critical Service should provide a means to support confidentiality of MCX Service User IDs from all entities outside the Mission Critical Service as per MCSEC-1.5-1.

question_13222.question: What is the procedure for AS discovery by an application client in a PIN?
question_13222.ground_truth: The procedure involves the application client querying the PINAPP registry for information about an AS, either directly or by forwarding the query to another PINAPP if it cannot be resolved. If the query is successful, the PINAPP responds with the details of the AS, such as the URL. If the query cannot be resolved by the PINAPP, the query is forwarded to the PIN server, which responds to the application client with the details of the AS.

question_13223.question: What is the mechanism for power saving enhancements in EPS?
question_13223.ground_truth: The MME may update the power saving parameters to the UE in EPS, such as through the GUTI Reallocation procedure. The power saving parameters can include periodic registration timer, active time for PSM, and eDRX parameters.

question_13225.question: What is the role of the TRF in the loopback II-NNI traversal scenario in the 3GPP network?
question_13225.ground_truth: The TRF is responsible for returning an INVITE request to the visited network where the UE is registered. The TRF's address is included in the g.3gpp.trf feature-capability indicator in a Feature-Caps header field.

question_13230.question: What are the two options for a UE in EMM-CONNECTED mode if the above conditions are met?
question_13230.ground_truth: The two options for a UE in EMM-CONNECTED mode are a) performing a detach procedure as specified in 3GPP TS 24.301 and then performing PLMN selection triggered by V2X communication over PC5 as specified in 3GPP TS 23.122, or b) not initiating V2X communication over PC5.

question_13231.question: What is the condition for a first UE to determine a second UE for providing the conflict information to in a PSFCH transmission?
question_13231.ground_truth: The first UE determines to transmit to the second UE the PSFCH with the conflict information if the first UE is an intended receiver of the second UE for a reserved resource of a PSSCH transmission, does not expect to perform reception on the sidelink due to half-duplex operation in the slot, detects certain flags and SCI format 1-A from the second UE, has certain priority values and RSRP measurements, and determines to transmit to the second UE the PSFCH with the conflict information before certain deadlines.

question_13233.question: What is the function of the NSACF system in terms of network slice instance selection?
question_13233.ground_truth: The NSACF system allows forNetwork Slice instance reselection for a given S-NSSAI, which helps alleviate current load status of selected Network Slice instance and supports Network Slice service continuity.

question_13235.question: What type of interactivity experience can be provided by the service signaling mechanism without requiring unicast transactions between the interactivity application and a network server?
question_13235.ground_truth: Customized or personalized interactivity experiences can be provided among users in a pure broadcast service/content delivery context.

question_13237.question: What are the responsibilities of the MTLF with FL Client and MTLF with FL Server when acting as part of the network architecture for 5G?
question_13237.ground_truth: The MTLF with FL Client is responsible for registering the "FL capability, Serving Area, Supported Time Period for FL" in NF profile to NRF, supporting local ML training based on instruction from the MTLF acting as coordinator, reporting the trained interim ML model to NWDAF(MTLF) acting as coordinator, and supporting MTLF with FL Server discovery procedure. The MTLF with FL Server is responsible for registering the "FL capability, Serving Area, Supported Time Period for FL" in NF profile to NRF, supporting MTLF with FL client discovery procedure, sending FL request to MTLF with FL client, and aggregating the interim ML model from MTLF with FL client.

question_13238.question: How are the number of frame erasure events determined for the minimum number of samples?
question_13238.ground_truth: The number of frame erasure events is determined during at least the minimum number of samples. If a failure is indicated, it is noted and counted towards the allowed exemption total.

question_13239.question: What is the scope of NOTE 2 in clause 5.7.1 concerning query types?
question_13239.ground_truth: The scope of NOTE 2 is that the single query and response followed by triggered real-time reporting of any subsequent changes is only applicable to queries based on a permanent identifier and the changes reported are new temporary identifiers associated with that permanent identifier.

question_13240.question: What is required to prevent trackability and linkability attacks on peer UEs during communications over a UE-to-UE relay?
question_13240.ground_truth: The 5G system should provide means for mitigating trackability and linkability attacks including during the UE-to-UE relay path switch.

question_13242.question: What does a custom operation allow in the context of RPC-style interaction?
question_13242.ground_truth: A custom operation allows for RPC-style interaction on a resource, with the custom operation URI and HTTP method specified, as well as data structures supported by the request and response bodies.

question_13243.question: What is the maximum repetition period of the relevant system information blocks that need to be received by the UE to camp on a cell in clause 8.2.4.4.1.2?
question_13243.ground_truth: The maximum repetition period of the relevant system information blocks that need to be received by the UE to camp on a cell is 1,280 ms in clause 8.2.4.4.1.2.

question_13244.question: What is the purpose of pre-established sessions in MCPTT?
question_13244.ground_truth: Pre-established sessions in MCPTT allow for the setup of group calls, private calls, and emergency calls, both on-network and off-network, and help in managing floor control and media plane signaling for efficient communication.

question_13245.question: What happens to the QoS Flows that do not have EPS bearer IDs assigned when a handover is performed in 5G systems?
question_13245.ground_truth: If the QoS Flow associated with the default QoS rule in the PDU Session does not have an EPS bearer ID assigned, the UE locally deletes the PDU Session. If it has an EPS bearer ID assigned, the UE keeps the PDU Session and notifies the impacted applications that the dedicated QoS resource has been released.

question_13246.question: What actions does the V2X UE take if the network resource adjustment for the LoA was successful?
question_13246.ground_truth: The V2X UE performs the application layer adaptation corresponding to the resource modification for the LoA in coordination with other affected V2X UEs with the support of the V2X application specific server.

question_13248.question: Which nodes are responsible for reporting events in the solution where the HLR/HSS is responsible for detecting?
question_13248.ground_truth: The HLR/HSS is responsible for reporting events when it is responsible for detecting in the solution where the HLR/HSS is responsible for detecting.

question_13249.question: What is the purpose of the OCI header and when is it sent?
question_13249.ground_truth: The OCI header conveys overload control information and is sent when an NF Service Producer/Consumer/SCP/SEPP detects overload conditions. It is sent in the 3gpp-Sbi-Oci HTTP header and may be conveyed periodically or in response to changes.

question_13250.question: What is the conclusion on the maximum channel bandwidth accountability for regulatory rules in NR operation in the 52.6 - 71 GHz frequency range?
question_13250.ground_truth: The maximum channel bandwidth should account for the regulatory rules with agreed band plan and may be revised accordingly.
