The UE also maintains one or more PC5 QoS Rule(s), each containing PFI, a PC5 Packet Filter Set, and a precedence value to determine the order in which the PC5 QoS Rules are evaluated.

question_13914.question: What action does the HSS take when there is redirection to another HSS (service) instance?
question_13914.ground_truth: In the case of redirection, the HSS returns a 3xx status code which contains a Location header with an URI pointing to the endpoint of another HSS (service) instance.

question_13915.question: What is the definition of the absolute accuracy of P-CCPCH RSCP in the context of 3GPP TS 25.133?
question_13915.ground_truth: The absolute accuracy of P-CCPCH RSCP is defined as the P-CCPCH RSCP measured in a UTRA TDD cell on one frequency compared to the actual P-CCPCH RSCP power of that cell on the same frequency.

question_13916.question: Which type of data is used for Operator Determined Barring and where is it stored conditionally?
question_13916.ground_truth: Operator Determined Barring uses permanent data that is stored conditionally in the HLR, SGSN, MME, VLR, and HSS.

question_13917.question: Which types of NR UE does the test in section 7.7.6.2.2 apply to?
question_13917.ground_truth: The test in section 7.7.6.2.2 applies to all types of NR UE from Release 16 onwards, as long as they support L1-SINR measurements.

question_13919.question: How does the RAN select the appropriate CN node supporting the slice ID presented by the UE?
question_13919.ground_truth: The RAN can select the appropriate CN node by exchanging information on supported slice IDs at the RAN-CN interface setup.

question_13920.question: What is a home environment requirement for multicast services?
question_13920.ground_truth: The PLMN operator shall be able to provision one or more multicast services, with individual multicast service areas that may overlap and cover parts of one or more PLMNs.

question_13922.question: What is the purpose of the Client Information API in the solution described?
question_13922.ground_truth: The Client Information API is used to enable Edge Application Servers to use the services of an Edge Enabler Server, such that it can be provided with information about capabilities of Edge Enabler Clients and Application Clients, as well as facilitate communication with the Application Clients. The API is based on the existing EEC (Edge Enabled Client) registration procedure defined in Solution #8.

question_13924.question: What action does the UE take if 5GMM cause #76 is received from a non-CAG cell?
question_13924.ground_truth: The UE shall replace the CAG information list stored in the UE with the received information list when received in the HPLMN or EHPLMN, and replace the serving VPLMN's entry of the CAG information list stored in the UE with the serving VPLMN's entry of the received CAG information list when received in a serving PLMN other than the HPLMN or EHPLMN.

question_13927.question: In base 10, 16 different polynomials are used in division. What is the relationship of the Reed Solomon code polynomial with these polynomials?
question_13927.ground_truth: The Reed Solomon common polynomials, which have a wide variety of applications, are used in Galois field division in conjunction with these polynomials.

question_13928.question: What factors determine the EIRP level for the repeater?
question_13928.ground_truth: The EIRP level is calculated using the Repeater unwanted emission level at the antenna connector, Repeater antenna gain, and feeder loss.

question_13929.question: What is the total noise power result obtained from the measurements?
question_13929.ground_truth: The total noise powers obtained from the measurements are averaged and expressed as 10 * log10 of this average in dB.

question_13930.question: What are the RRM requirements defined for IAB-MT nodes?
question_13930.ground_truth: The RRM requirements defined for IAB-MT nodes include RRC Connected State mobility, transmitted timing and transmitting power requirements. The random access requirements of IAB-MTs are the same as those of UEs. The RRC re-establishment and RRC release with redirection requirements of IAB-MTs are modified from those of UEs to accommodate higher periodicity of SMTC windows in IAB nodes.

question_13931.question: When can the ProSe UE-to-network relay start announcing Relay Discovery Additional Information?
question_13931.ground_truth: The ProSe UE-to-network relay can start announcing Relay Discovery Additional Information if it is currently authorized to perform ProSe direct discovery Model A announcing in the serving PLMN, has detected the corresponding TMGI in the serving cell, and the timer T4105 or T4107 has not expired (depending on the information being announced).

question_13932.question: Which element is used in the "c2-operation-mode-switching" to indicate the operation mode switching requirement for UAV?
question_13932.ground_truth: The "C2-operation-mode-switching-requirement" element is used in the "c2-operation-mode-switching" to indicate the operation mode switching requirement for UAV.

question_13933.question: In what state does the mobile station enter the state PLMN SEARCH in case of losing coverage while continuously activated and then returning to coverage?

question_13935.question: In the "tPlmnChangeType" complex type, what is the data type of the "mcc" and "mnc" elements of the "tPlmnIdent" type?
question_13935.ground_truth: The "mcc" and "mnc" elements of the "tPlmnIdent" type are defined as strings, and can have a maximum length of 3 and 2 digits respectively, followed by an optional 1- or 2-digit extension.

question_13936.question: What is the operation used by the NF Service consumer to obtain the information about the indicated discovery code from the 5G DDNMF?
question_13936.ground_truth: The MatchReport service operation is used to obtain the information about the indicated discovery code from the 5G DDNMF.

question_13938.question: What is the code power of the last transmitted PRACH preamble plus the power offset between the power of the last transmitted preamble and the initial DPCCH transmission power in the equation for initial E-TFC restriction for UE in CELL_FACH state and Idle mode?
question_13938.ground_truth: An estimate of PDPCCH, target = Ppreamble + PP-e

question_13942.question: What is the quality measure reported by the UE to the NAS if the high-quality criterion is met?
question_13942.ground_truth: The quality measure reported by the UE to the NAS is the same for each PLMN found in one cell if the high-quality criterion is met.

question_13944.question: What is the recommended audio mixing gain in the WI on ITT4RT for enhanced user experience in immersive teleconferencing and telepresence?
question_13944.ground_truth: The recommended audio mixing gain in the WI on ITT4RT for enhanced user experience in immersive teleconferencing and telepresence is 6dB.

question_13945.question: In what circumstances can the H-GMLC initiate the cancellation procedure for an outstanding Deferred Location Request?
question_13945.ground_truth: The H-GMLC may initiate the cancellation procedure if the UE's privacy profile stored in the H-GMLC or in the PPR was changed, or if the expiry of the validity timer specified by the start time and stop time, or if the expiry of an implementation dependent timer specified by the Operator as a default value in the R-GMLC when the stop time is undefined or exceeds the maximum allowed value.

question_13948.question: What is the service type in this case in the 3GPP TS 24.008?
question_13948.ground_truth: The service type is set to 'mobile terminating call'.

question_13949.question: When would a PTC Instant Personal Alert Report Record be sent from the MF/DF to the LEMF?
question_13949.ground_truth: When an Instant Personal Alert (IPA) is initiated or sent to the PTC target, the PTC Instant Personal Alert Report Record is sent.

question_13951.question: What are the entities involved in the AF provided QoS requirement procedure for the PINE communication?
question_13951.ground_truth: The AF (or the PEMC acting as AF), the 5GC, the SMF, and the DN (Data Network) are the entities involved in the AF provided QoS requirement procedure for the PINE communication.

question_13952.question: What should the SMF do if it receives a POST request with the upSecurity IE from the AMF for Xn Handover with I-SMF Insertion?
question_13952.ground_truth: The SMF shall verify that the upSecurity IE included in the received upSecurityInfo IE is the same as the security policy for integrity protection and encryption that the SMF has locally stored.

question_13953.question: What are the two ways of realizing Timed Graphics in 3GPP?
question_13953.ground_truth: The two ways of realizing Timed Graphics in 3GPP are SVG-based timed graphics, where the layout and timing are controlled by the SVG scene, and simple timed graphics mode, where a binary representation format is defined to enable simple embedding of graphics elements.

question_13955.question: What should be the value of the Expires header field when sending a de-affiliation request in the SIP PUBLISH request?
question_13955.ground_truth: The Expires header field should be set to zero when sending a de-affiliation request in the SIP PUBLISH request.

question_13956.question: What is 3GPP and what is its role in the development of the NRPPa?
question_13956.ground_truth: 3GPP (Third Generation Partnership Project) is a collaboration between telecommunications standard development organizations. They produced the NRPPa (NR Positioning Protocol A) as part of their Technical Specification for the 5G wireless communication standard.

question_13958.question: What is the purpose of registering the IMS UE's media security capabilities during the registration process?
question_13958.ground_truth: The purpose of registering the IMS UE's media security capabilities during the registration process is to have simple operational procedures, good usability, and to enable the network to make informed decisions based on the IMS UE's capabilities.

question_13960.question: What is the order in which resources are allocated to logical channels?
question_13960.ground_truth: Resources are allocated to logical channels in a decreasing priority order based on the Bj value. If the PBR of a logical channel is set to infinity, the MAC entity shall allocate resources for all the data that is available for transmission on the logical channel before meeting the PBR of the lower priority logical channel(s). If any resources remain, all the logical channels are served in a strict decreasing priority order until either the data for that logical channel or the UL grant is exhausted.

question_13961.question: Which procedure is used by the network to detach the IMSI in the network for GPRS services and/or non-GPRS services and to release a GMM context?

question_13963.question: What should an eNodeB do when it receives an MBMS Session Start Request with a different transport network IP multicast distribution address and/or a different IP multicast source address?
question_13963.ground_truth: The eNodeB involved in the broadcast of the MBMS session shall leave the former M1 transport network IP multicast address and join the new M1 transport network IP multicast address (including the IP address of the multicast source) if the MBMS Session Start Request contains a different transport network IP multicast distribution address and/or a different IP multicast source address; the eNodeB should also use the C-TEID received in the MBMS Session Start Request.

question_13964.question: What should the UE consider to satisfy the entering condition for a specific event in the measurement reporting procedure?
question_13964.ground_truth: The UE should consider the entering condition for a specific event to be satisfied when the inequality A2-1 is fulfilled. This inequality specifies that Ms + Hys < Thresh, where Ms is the measurement result of the serving cell (taking into account any offsets), Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event, and Thresh is the threshold parameter for this event.

question_13965.question: What is the frequency range over which the measurements are made for GSM 700 and GSM 850?
question_13965.ground_truth: The measurements are made over the band 728 MHz to 746 MHz for GSM 700 and over the band 869 MHz to 894 MHz for GSM 850 at 200 kHz intervals.

question_13966.question: What is the effect of Control and User Plane Separation (CUPS) on the session management related measurements in the PGW-C?
question_13966.ground_truth: The session management related measurements in the PGW-C include PDN-GW initiated dedicated bearer creation, PDN-GW initiated dedicated bearer deletion, PDN-GW initiated dedicated bearer modification with QoS update, PDN-GW initiated dedicated bearer modification without QoS update, Active EPS bearers related measurements, UE requested bearer resource modification related measurements, PDN connections related measurements, and Number of EPS bearer.

question_13967.question: What does the "MM.ChoPrepInterSuccUes" counter measure in the "5.1.1.6.6.14 Number of UEs for which conditional handover preparations were successful" metric?
question_13967.ground_truth: The number of UEs for which successful conditional handover preparations were received by the source NR cell CU.

question_13968.question: What is the difference between physical network products and 3GPP virtualized network products in terms of SECAM Accreditation Body?
question_13968.ground_truth: The SECAM Accreditation Body is applicable to both physical network products and 3GPP virtualized network products. The actors performing security compliance testing and basic vulnerability testing for both types of network products should be accredited by the SECAM Accreditation Body.

question_13970.question: What action does the MS take when the LOCATION UPDATING ACCEPT message contains an IMSI while performing a location updating in cell B after selecting it the second time?
question_13970.ground_truth: The MS deletes its TMSI and responds to paging with IMSI.

question_13971.question: What happens when T1 expires in the test procedure loop?
question_13971.ground_truth: The SS switches the power setting from T1 to T2, and the UE sends a MeasurementReport message if the overall delays measured from the beginning of time period T2 is less than 5122 ms.

question_13974.question: What is the main purpose of network slicing in the 5GS as specified in 3GPP TS 23.501 clause 5.15?
question_13974.ground_truth: The main purpose of network slicing is to support network service differentiation and meet the diversified requirements from tenants like vertical industries.

question_13975.question: What is the requirement for an eNodeB to support RACS in inter-PLMN handover to a CSG cell in a PLMN which is not an equivalent PLMN for the UE?
question_13975.ground_truth: The eNodeB in the source PLMN should support RACS and send some (or all) of the UE's Radio Capability to the eNodeB in the target PLMN for the inter-PLMN handover to a CSG cell in a PLMN which is not an equivalent PLMN for the UE.

question_13976.question: What should the gNB do if it is not marking packets directly in the PDU IP header for uplink congestion detection and ECN marking?
question_13976.ground_truth: The gNB needs guarantees that another function will mark packets directly in the PDU IP header before intermediate header information is discarded and before the PDU IP packet is processed by the end system.

question_13977.question: What action does the MS take if it receives two RRLP Measure Position Requests with the same Reference Number?
question_13977.ground_truth: The MS ignores the later Request and continues with the current measurement.

question_13978.question: What is the method used to calculate the inter-site distance of the aggressor system in Note 1?
question_13978.ground_truth: The inter-site distance of the aggressor system is calculated as 1.2 times the inter-site distance of the victim system in urban and suburban environments, and 1.22 times in rural environments.

question_13980.question: What does the source SN send to the source MN in step 9a, along with the data volumes delivered to and received from the UE to the source SN in the Secondary RAT Data Usage Report message?
question_13980.ground_truth: The order in which the SN sends the Secondary RAT Data Usage Report message and performs data forwarding with MN is not defined. The SN may send the report when the transmission of the related bearer is stopped.

question_13981.question: What is the purpose of the TMGI Deallocation Procedure?
question_13981.ground_truth: The TMGI Deallocation Procedure is used by the GCS AS to immediately release a set of TMGIs, irrespective of their expiration times.

question_13982.question: When is the session management based network slice admission control not applicable for a PDU session?
question_13982.ground_truth: The session management based network slice admission control is not applicable for PDU sessions for emergency services, priority services, or onboarding services in SNPN.

question_13983.question: What is the message size mentioned as a potential requirement for transferring V2X messages?
question_13983.ground_truth: The E-UTRA(N) should support a message size of 50-400 Bytes to transfer V2X messages.

question_13985.question: What are the potential device features that could impact the user experience of VR services?
question_13985.ground_truth: A typical VR device may include features such as screen size, resolution, pixel size, field of view, refresh rate, head-tracking/eye-tracking latency, degree of freedom, weight, and audio bandwidth. All of these features could potentially impact the user experience.

question_13986.question: What metric can be used by the MC service client to estimate the MBMS bearer quality, when no data is transmitted on the MBMS bearer?
question_13986.ground_truth: The quality of the bearer can be estimated, for example, as an equivalent BLER (Block Error Rate), based on the modulation and coding scheme (MCS) and measurements from the reference signals from the eNB(s).

question_13987.question: What application manages the arbitration in the transfer of an incoming voice communication?
question_13987.ground_truth: The arbitration is managed by the arbitration application.

question_13988.question: What is the purpose of the network-requested PDU session release procedure?
question_13988.ground_truth: The purpose of the network-requested PDU session release procedure is to enable the network to release a PDU session or the user-plane resources on a single access of an MA PDU session.

question_13990.question: What is the duration of an Extended symbol in terms of samples and microseconds?
question_13990.ground_truth: An Extended symbol consists of 146 samples, which is equivalent to 456.25 microseconds.

question_13992.question: What is one of the potential requirements for the 3GPP system regarding security over fixed broadband access link?
question_13992.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall support the option for Operators to provide the same level of security over fixed broadband access link as is provided over the Next Generation Radio access link.

question_13993.question: What is the purpose of the Automatic Device Detection (ADD) feature in HSS?
question_13993.ground_truth: The Automatic Device Detection (ADD) feature in HSS is used to detect unauthorized combinations of IMSI and IMEI(SV) and to secure the registration of authorized combinations of USIMs and MEs. It can also request the IMEI(SV) from the UE and verify if the IMSI-IMEI(SV) pair is authorized in the HSS.

question_13994.question: When shall the actions related to CSI reporting on a serving cell that is not active apply if a UE receives an activation command for a secondary cell in subframe n?
question_13994.ground_truth: The actions related to CSI reporting on a serving cell that is not active shall apply in the earliest subframe after n+8 in which the serving cell is active.

question_13995.question: What should the MCPTT client do when it receives a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message with a matching MCPTT group ID in the "S7: Waiting for call announcement after call release" state?
question_13995.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should store the SDP body, call identifier, originating MCPTT user ID, refresh interval, and call start time of the GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message and stop the TFG1 timer.

question_13997.question: What is the relaying mechanism used for the duplicate paths to deliver redundant traffic end-to-end?
question_13997.ground_truth: The relaying mechanism for the duplicate paths is not specified by 3GPP. It is up to the network operator to use upper layer protocols, such as IEEE 802.1 TSN FRER, to manage the replication and elimination of redundant packets/frames over the duplicate paths, which can span both 3GPP segments and fixed network segments.

question_13998.question: What is the use of the IpAppEventNotification interface in the Event Notification Framework?
question_13998.ground_truth: This interface is used by the framework to inform the application of a generic service-related event. The Event Notification Framework will invoke methods on the Event Notification Application Interface that is specified when the Event Notification interface is obtained.

question_13999.question: What is the impact of Solution #52 on the N2 protocol interface?
question_13999.ground_truth: Solution #52 does not introduce any new impacts on the N2 protocol interface.

question_14001.question: What must the S-CSCF do if it receives an initial request for a dialog destined for an unregistered user?
question_14001.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall return an appropriate unsuccessful SIP response, which may be a 480 (Temporarily unavailable) and terminate these procedures if no AS needs to be contacted.

question_14003.question: What should a Mobile Station (MS) do if the network rejects a combined GPRS attach procedure with the cause 'GPRS services and non-GPRS services not allowed'?
question_14003.ground_truth: The MS should consider the SIM invalid for GPRS and non-GPRS services, delete stored TMSI, LAI, CSKN, RAI, GPRS-CKSN, P-TMSI, and P-TMSI signature, and not perform GPRS attach in the same or another PLMN.

question_14005.question: What is the purpose of the "Interference profile" clause in TR36.829?
question_14005.ground_truth: The "Interference profile" clause in TR36.829 presents the interference characterization results and develops the interference profile for link level performance and system level performance characterization.

question_14006.question: What must the network do in order to provide the UE with the mapped EPS bearer context for a PDU session when interworking with EPS is supported for a PDU session before attempting to transfer it from N1 mode to S1 mode?
question_14006.ground_truth: The SMF must provide the UE with the mapped EPS bearer context for a PDU session.

question_14008.question: What is the role of the NF service consumer in enforcing overload control during overload situations, as specified in Solution #8?
question_14008.ground_truth: During overload situations, the NF service consumer shall reduce the number of messages it would normally generate towards the NF service producer, in accordance with the overload reduction percentage requested by the NF service producer in the OCI IE. This mechanism is called message throttling and is applied by the NF service consumer. SCPs can help mitigate overload as specified in solution #4 in clause~11.6.

question_14010.question: What are the target scenarios for the UMTS NAICS study in the 3GPP report?
question_14010.ground_truth: The target scenarios are intra-NodeB scenario, HetNet scenario, and inter-NodeB scenario.

question_14011.question: What is the purpose of the enableNotifications() method?
question_14011.ground_truth: It is used to enable the application to receive notifications provisioned from within the network.

question_14012.question: How many frame erasure events are required for an early fail decision in the described test method?
question_14012.ground_truth: For an early fail decision, ne (number of error events) is equal to or greater than 7.

question_14014.question: What means does the 3GPP system support for MPS activation when data service is congested?
question_14014.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall support a means for MPS for DTS activation when data service is congested at the request of the MPS Service User or IoT device and a means for MPS for DTS activation when data service is congested at the request of a roaming MPS Service User.

question_14016.question: In the context of HS-DSCH and E-DCH, what is the size of a transport block set?
question_14016.ground_truth: The transport block set consists of one transport block only in the case of HS-DSCH and E-DCH.

question_14020.question: Which specification is used for the WSDL structure in the SOAP Solution Set?
question_14020.ground_truth: The WSDL structure in the SOAP Solution Set is based on the Web Service Description Language (WSDL) 1.1 specification.

question_14021.question: What is the maximum RMS EVM over the useful part of any burst of the 16QAM modulated signal under extreme conditions?
question_14021.ground_truth: The RMS EVM must not exceed 8.0%.

question_14025.question: What is the maximum rated output power per 10 MHz bandwidth for band n41 and n90 operation in Japan for BS type 1-H?
question_14025.ground_truth: The rated output power, Prated,c.sys for BS type 1-H or sum of Prated,c,AC over all antenna connectors for BS type 1-C declared by the manufacturer shall be equal to or less than 20 W per 10 MHz bandwidth.

question_14026.question: What must the PCRF be provisioned with, in order to accomplish network enforcement of downlink packets for non-SIP based services that are not 3GPP PS Data Off exempt?
question_14026.ground_truth: The PCRF must be provisioned with the necessary IP addresses for non-SIP based services that are Data Off exempt ifdynamic rules are used. If static rules are to be used, the PGW must be provisioned with the necessary IP addresses for that purpose.

question_14027.question: What is the timeslot arrangement for Cells A and B in the context of the timebase?
question_14027.ground_truth: The edges of their timeslots are not coincident at the antenna connector.

question_14030.question: What is a "Registration Area" as defined in the document?
question_14030.ground_truth: A "Registration Area" is an area in which the UE may roam without a need to perform location registration, which is a NAS procedure.

question_14031.question: What is the condition for Layer 1 of the UE to send in-sync indications in the 3GPP TS 36.331 standard?
question_14031.ground_truth: Layer 1 of the UE sends in-sync indications to the higher layers within the TEvaluate_Qin_DRX evaluation period when the downlink radio link quality estimated over the last TEvaluate_Qin_DRX period becomes better than the threshold Qin.

question_14033.question: What is the length and encoding of the Vehicle UE Authorized and Pedestrian UE Authorized fields in 3GPP TS 29.272?
question_14033.ground_truth: The Vehicle UE Authorized field and Pedestrian UE Authorized field are each encoded as a one octet long enumeration. They currently specify two enumeration values: 0 means "authorized" and 1 means "not authorized".

question_14034.question: What is the maximum length of a compressed short message within the TP-UD field?
question_14034.ground_truth: The maximum length of a compressed short message within the TP-UD field is 134 (140-6) octets including the Compression Header and Compression Footer.

question_14036.question: What is the expression for the measurement result of the inter-RAT neighbor cell in dBm or in dB, depending on the measurement quantity of the inter-RAT neighbor cell?

question_14037.question: What is one of the functions that the eMBMS service layer should support for TV application support?
question_14037.ground_truth: Encryption, security, and conditional access functions typically supported by TV Content Providers.

question_14038.question: When is the UE allowed a longer measurement period to measure the UE Rx-Tx time difference on PCell?
question_14038.ground_truth: The UE is allowed longer measurement period to measure UE Rx-Tx time difference on PCell if TRS resources overlap with Type 1A/1B/2 PPW.

question_14039.question: Which procedures are specified in Clause 4 of the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_14039.ground_truth: Clause 4 specifies elementary procedures for Mobility Management, including mobility management common procedures, mobility management specific procedures, and connection management sublayer service provision. It also specifies GPRS specific mobility management procedures.

question_14042.question: What should the UE do if timer T3346 is running and none of the specified conditions are met?
question_14042.ground_truth: The UE should not send an UPLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message until timer T3346 expires or is stopped.

question_14043.question: What should the MAC entity do if the ra-ResponseWindowBFR expires and the PDCCH addressed to the C-RNTI has not been received?
question_14043.ground_truth: If the ra-ResponseWindowBFR expires and the PDCCH addressed to the C-RNTI has not been received, the UE should retransmit the PRACH Preamble.

question_14044.question: Which are the two main entities involved in the interworking with external DN with DHCP service in a 5G system?
question_14044.ground_truth: The SMF (Session Management Function) and the UPF (User Plane Function)

question_14045.question: When does a UE determine that transmission(s) in subframe i of CG1 cannot overlap in time with transmission(s) in subframe i of CG2 in Dual Connectivity Mode 2?
question_14045.ground_truth: A UE determines that transmission(s) in subframe i of CG1 cannot overlap in time with transmission(s) in subframe i of CG2 based on higher layer signalling.

question_14047.question: What request does the SCC AS forward upon receipt of the SIP INVITE request from UE-1 to setup the collaborative session?
question_14047.ground_truth: The SCC AS forwards the SIP INVITE request to conferencing AS.

question_14048.question: What is the main difference between a RLOS call and an unauthenticated emergency call in the second solution?
question_14048.ground_truth: The main difference is that the UE initiates a RLOS call using an appropriate user interface, rather than an emergency call in the NAS signalling to the network, and the network connects the UE to the RLOS server rather than making a connection to the emergency service infrastructure.

question_14049.question: What action does the IWF perform when a user is no longer affiliated to an MCPTT group in the second scenario?
question_14049.ground_truth: The IWF shall determine that the user homed in the IWF is not affiliated to the MCPTT group at the determined client and skip the rest of the steps.

question_14050.question: What is the maximum time period for which a UE should be able to determine SFTD for an NR carrier in FR2 without measurement gaps and without additional SS-RSRP reporting?
question_14050.ground_truth: For an NR carrier in FR2, the UE should be able to determine SFTD within 112 SMTC periods.

question_14051.question: What is the effect of receiving a MAC PDU on MCH containing reserved values or on DL-SCH containing reserved values for G-RNTI or SC-RNTI, or on SL-SCH?
question_14051.ground_truth: The MAC entity shall ignore the MAC PDU subheaders containing reserved values and the corresponding MAC SDUs, and in the MAC control elements, ignore the fields containing reserved values and the fields associated with the fields containing reserved values.

question_14052.question: What action results in implicit continuation of call processing in the release() and deassignCall() methods?
question_14052.ground_truth: These operations continue processing of the call implicitly.

question_14053.question: What is the purpose of the FFS (Forrest-Fenn-Silver) service in the MC system for LMR user homed in the IWF?
question_14053.ground_truth: The FFS service in the MC system is responsible for authorizing actions of users homed in the IWF in the LMR network.

question_14054.question: What is the expected sequence for the test described in 52.10.3.2?
question_14054.ground_truth: After initiating an uplink data transfer of RLC data blocks with acknowledged mode, if the IPA is supported in GPRS cell options, then the SS verifies that the MS correctly sets the Access Type to 'Two Phase Access Request by IPA capable MS'.

question_14056.question: What information is included in the Control Plane CIoT 5GS Optimisation during PDU session establishment?
question_14056.ground_truth: The indication of Control Plane CIoT 5GS Optimisation is included in the Control Plane CIoT 5GS Optimisation.

question_14058.question: What is the purpose of the authorization and authentication procedure in the tunnel establishment process?
question_14058.ground_truth: The authorization and authentication procedure is used to ensure mutual authentication of the user and the EPC upon attachment to the EPC via untrusted non-3GPP IP access.

question_14059.question: What is the difference between BTS output power on frames containing PBCCH or PPCH and on other PDCH radio blocks?
question_14059.ground_truth: The BTS shall use constant power on those PDCH radio blocks which contain PBCCH or PPCH. This power may be lower than the output power used on BCCH. On the other PDCH radio blocks, downlink power control may be used. Thus, a procedure may be implemented in the network to control the power of the downlink transmission based on the Channel Quality Reports.

question_14061.question: What properties does the "TargetFulfilmentResult" data type contain?
question_14061.ground_truth: The "TargetFulfilmentResult" data type contains the "targetName", "targetFulfilmentInfo", and "targetAchievedValue" properties.

question_14062.question: What should the MS do when the SM cause value is #26 "insufficient resources" and the Back-off timer value IE is included?
question_14062.ground_truth: The MS should stop timer T3396 associated with the corresponding APN, if it is running. If the request type was different from "emergency" and no APN was included in the ACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message, the MS should stop timer T3396 associated with no APN, if it is running. After that, the MS should not send another ACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message until timer T3396 expires or is stopped.

question_14064.question: What function is used to filter paging messages for a CSG cell?

question_14066.question: What is the out-of-sync block error rate (BLERout) defined as in the context of RLM-RS resource monitoring?
question_14066.ground_truth: The out-of-sync block error rate (BLERout) is defined as the level at which the downlink radio link cannot be reliably received, corresponding to the block error rate at the out-of-sync threshold.

question_14067.question: What is the encapsulation format required for 5GMS downlink and uplink streaming in 3GPP services?
question_14067.ground_truth: Common Media Application Format (CMAF) encapsulation as defined in ISO/IEC 23000-19.

question_14069.question: What is the purpose of the system simulator (SS) in the beam peak direction search and spherical coverage test procedure?
question_14069.ground_truth: The system simulator (SS) is responsible for providing downlink reference signals, maintaining the type D quasi co-location (QCL) between SSB and CSI-RS, and measuring the mean power and EIRP of the modulated signal arriving at the power measurement equipment.

question_14070.question: What does the endorsement of 3GPP TS 24.247 by ETSI TISPAN NGN mean?
question_14070.ground_truth: The endorsement of 3GPP TS 24.247 by ETSI TISPAN NGN means that the specifications for the stage 3 of the messaging service for NGN are provided in conjunction with 3GPP TS 24.247, with certain modifications.

question_14071.question: What is the "current MM system information" for a UE in RRC idle mode?
question_14071.ground_truth: The "current MM system information" for a UE in RRC idle mode is the broadcasted MM system information of the chosen cell, which is determined by the UE idle mode cell selection/re-selection process.

question_14072.question: What is the packet switched domain in the context of GSM/UMTS?
question_14072.ground_truth: The packet switched domain is a domain within GSM/UMTS where data is transferred in packet switched mode, and it corresponds to the term "GPRS".

question_14073.question: What are two features of HSDPA that affect the handling of multimedia telephony?
question_14073.ground_truth: The two features of HSDPA that affect the handling of multimedia telephony are fast H-ARQ re-transmissions on the radio layer, which makes packet losses due to bad radio conditions infrequent, and the scheduler that needs to prioritize between different users and services, inducing varying transport delay to the user equipment (UE).

question_14074.question: Under what condition can the PCEF derive traffic mapping information based on implementation specific logic?
question_14074.ground_truth: If PCC rule(s) with application identifier(s) are the only PCC rule(s) that are bound to a bearer which requires traffic mapping information, the PCEF can derive traffic mapping information based on implementation specific logic.

question_14075.question: What is the purpose of the minimum requirement for TDD PCell in 8.2.3.2.2?
question_14075.ground_truth: The purpose of the minimum requirement for TDD PCell in 8.2.3.2.2 is to verify the performance of large delay CDD with 2 transmitter antennas for TDD FDD CA with TDD PCell and different number of DL CCs.

question_14076.question: How many logical states does the call waiting service have?
question_14076.ground_truth: The call waiting service has 3 logical states: (Not Provisioned, Not Applicable, Not Active), (Provisioned, Not Applicable, Not Active), and (Provisioned, Not Applicable, Active and Operative).

question_14078.question: What is the use of the HS-DSCH Semi-Persistent scheduling Information to modify LCR?
question_14078.ground_truth: This IE is used for the modification of HS-DSCH Semi-Persistent scheduling information for 1.28 Mcps TDD.

question_14079.question: What is a "native application" in the context of the present document?
question_14079.ground_truth: A "native application" is an application developed specifically for a particular mobile device/operating system and is installed directly onto that device.

question_14080.question: How does the UE determine which frequency to reselect first when more than one cell meets the cell reselection criteria?
question_14080.ground_truth: The UE selects the highest-priority frequency first and then the highest ranked cell among the cells on that frequency meeting the criteria.

question_14082.question: What function does the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay provide in enabling connectivity to the network for 5G ProSe Remote UEs?
question_14082.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay provides the relaying functionality to support connectivity to the network for 5G ProSe Remote UEs, enabling discovery, unicast traffic relaying, and access to the 5GS as a UE with enhancements as specified in clauses 6.2 and 6.6 in the document.

question_14083.question: What should the MS do when it receives the GA-RC REGISTER ACCEPT message?
question_14083.ground_truth: The MS should start the Keep Alive mechanism using the received TU3906 Timer IE.

question_14084.question: What is the purpose of the Code-Receiving Security Parameters in the ProSe Function?
question_14084.ground_truth: The Code-Receiving Security Parameters in the ProSe Function indicate whether a Match Report will be used for MIC checking and provide the information needed by a UE to undo the protection applied to the ProSe Query Code and ProSe Response Code by the other UE.

question_14087.question: What should the MME/S4-SGSN prioritize when restoring PDN connections in the event of an SGW failure?
question_14087.ground_truth: The MME/S4-SGSN should prioritize the SGW relocation for UEs engaged in a Service Request, Connection Resume, RAU/TAU procedures, or having GBR bearers over UEs which are not engaged in any mobility procedure and do not have a signalling connection to the MME/S4-SGSN nor GBR bearers. The MME/S4-SGSN should also prioritize the SGW relocation for UEs with an emergency PDN connection.

question_14088.question: How is charging and policy-control handled in the EPS and GPRS architectures for non-SIPTO traffic and for SIPTO/LIPA traffic if the UE moves away from the eNB with the anchoring L-GW?
question_14088.ground_truth: It is handled by the P-GW in EPS and GGSN in GPRS as usual for non-SIPTO traffic, and for SIPTO/LIPA traffic if the UE moves away from the eNB with the anchoring L-GW.

question_14089.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the Contact header field of the SIP INVITE request when establishing an MCVideo prearranged group session?
question_14089.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include the g.3gpp.mcvideo media feature tag and the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag with the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcvideo" in the Contact header field of the SIP INVITE request.

question_14090.question: What action should the MCData client perform when it wants to release a MCData communication over the media plane?
question_14090.ground_truth: The MCData client should generate a SIP BYE request, set the Request-URI to the MCData session identity to be released, and send the SIP BYE request towards the MCData server.

question_14093.question: What organization is working on a new version of the Diameter Base Protocol for improved application design?
question_14093.ground_truth: IETF DIME WG (Diameter Maintenance and Extensions)

question_14094.question: What is the impact of receiving a limit on the number of PDU sessions from the network?
question_14094.ground_truth: Receiving a limit on the number of PDU sessions from the network cannot be used by the UE to perform PLMN reselection.

question_14095.question: What is the range of TADV (Timing Advance) reporting?
question_14095.ground_truth: The range of TADV reporting is from 0 to 3150848 Tc with 128 Tc resolution for timing advance less than 262144 Tc, and 512 Tc for timing advance greater than or equal to 262144 Tc.

question_14096.question: What happens if user B's UE receives a CANCEL request or BYE request from user C during a CW condition?
question_14096.ground_truth: User B's UE shall stop the timer T~UE-CW (if necessary), stop providing the CW indication to user B, and apply the terminating UE procedures upon receipt of CANCEL or BYE request.

question_14097.question: What message can be used to transport the access token to the MCPTT server during initial SIP registration if an access token is not available?
question_14097.ground_truth: The SIP REGISTER message can be used to transport the access token to the MCPTT server during initial SIP registration even if an access token is not available. If an access token is not available, SIP registration shall proceed without the inclusion of the access token.

question_14099.question: What event triggers the MBMS Registration procedure?
question_14099.ground_truth: The MBMS Registration procedure is initiated when a downstream node informs an upstream node that it would like to receive session attributes and data for a particular MBMS bearer service in order to distribute it further downstream.

question_14100.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe Service Notification message?
question_14100.ground_truth: The ProSe Service Notification message is used to send the updated ProSe Discovery UE ID to the UE immediately or to notify the updated authorization for ProSe Direct Discovery or ProSe Direct Communication to the UE.

question_14101.question: What is an Elementary Procedure (EP) in the context of 3GPP TS 36.468?
question_14101.ground_truth: An Elementary Procedure (EP) is a unit of interaction between the HNB and HNB-GW in the 3GPP SA WG5 protocol.

question_14102.question: What should the floor control interface do upon receiving an MCPTT call release step~1 request from the application and signalling plane?
question_14102.ground_truth: The floor control interface should stop sending floor control messages to the associated floor participant, request the network media interface to stop sending RTP media packets towards the associated MCPTT client, ignore any floor control messages received from the associated floor participant, request the network media interface to stop forwarding RTP media packets from the associated MCPTT client to the media distributor in the MCPTT server, indicate to the floor control server arbitration logic in the MCPTT server that the MCPTT client has started to disconnect from the MCPTT call, and enter the 'Releasing' state.

question_14104.question: What device initializes the Scene Manager in the call flow described in subclause 4.3.1 of TR 26.998?
question_14104.ground_truth: The application initializes the Scene Manager in the call flow described in subclause 4.3.1 of TR 26.998.

question_14105.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's technical report on E-UTRA NR Dual Connectivity in Release 15?
question_14105.ground_truth: The purpose is to gather relevant background information and studies to address Dual connectivity band combinations of LTE 1DL/1UL + inter-/intra-band NR 2DL/2UL bands (FR1+FR2) in Rel-15.

question_14106.question: What type of network node does the UDM request the addressing information for in the Send Routing Info for SM procedure?

question_14108.question: What should the UE do when it receives a "HOLD" (i.e. DTX) from the Serving E-DCH RLS while applying a Delta to calculate its new SG?

question_14109.question: What is the post-condition for the Train Integrity monitoring data communication use case?
question_14109.ground_truth: The post-condition is that the FRMCS System will be used to exchange train integrity information, ensuring the continuous verification of the train completeness for the time of mission.

question_14113.question: What is the purpose of the "Channel Mode" information element in GAN?
question_14113.ground_truth: The Channel Mode information element gives information of the mode on coding/decoding and transcoding in GAN.

question_14115.question: What should the SMF do when Authorized QoS parameters are received from the PCF?
question_14115.ground_truth: The SMF shall perform mapping from the Authorized QoS parameters received from PCF to the access specific QoS parameters.

question_14116.question: Which regulatory requirement does the MCX Service support with regard to lawful interception?
question_14116.ground_truth: The MCX Service supports lawful interception, meaning that it can be used to intercept and monitor communications in accordance with legal requirements, such as those imposed by law enforcement agencies.

question_14120.question: Which types of NR UE does the test in 7.5.3.13.2 apply to?
question_14120.ground_truth: The test applies to all types of NR UE from Release 17 onwards and supporting 2DL CA and fast SCell activation.

question_14122.question: When can a UE initiate IP flow mapping over GERAN or UTRAN?
question_14122.ground_truth: A UE can initiate IP flow mapping over GERAN or UTRAN if it is operating in A/Gb mode or Iu mode, and the PDN connection applies to NBIFOM, and the network-initiated NBIFOM mode is selected.

question_14123.question: What is the purpose of the LSA controller (LC) Integration Reference Point (IRP) management operations and notifications as specified in the present document?
question_14123.ground_truth: The purpose of the LSA controller (LC) Integration Reference Point (IRP) management operations and notifications as specified in the present document is to enable communication of management information between an IRPAgent and one or several IRPManagers in a protocol and technology neutral way.

question_14125.question: What is one of the main differences between 2D video streaming and VR video streaming from a user's perspective?
question_14125.ground_truth: The main difference is the notion of a viewport. In VR video streaming, the user only sees a cropped part of the video (the viewport) depending on the direction of the device, while in 2D video streaming, the user always sees the complete video.

question_14126.question: What is the effect of an allow list in the context of the communication barring service?
question_14126.ground_truth: An allow list is used to specify a list of identities towards which outgoing communications are always allowed.

question_14128.question: What happens when the available capacity is less than the resource demand of traffic flows in the RAN?
question_14128.ground_truth: The RAN performs allocation of resources as described by the QCI characteristics and the RCHDs of the flows, with QCI based differentiation applied first and then the RCHDs of the flows at the lowest congestion level within the bounds of the QCI characteristics.

question_14129.question: What is the function of H-CHF in Solution #2.2?
question_14129.ground_truth: H-CHF rates the charging home request, updates the user's account balance, creates a CDR related to the service, and informs V-CHF on the result of the charging home request.

question_14130.question: What information does the EES provide to the CAAR during an update in option (ii)?
question_14130.ground_truth: The EES provides the following information to the CAAR during an update in option (ii): EES ID, list of association IDs of the associations being served, and registrar ECS information including list of EDNs.

question_14131.question: What events can trigger the clearing of Radio Resources on the A-Interface in 3GPP TS 29.010?
question_14131.ground_truth: The clearing of Radio Resources on the A-Interface can be triggered by a positive empty result in MSC-B, a circuit connection abortion or dialogue abortion in MSC-B, or the clearing of the SCCP connection between MSC-B and BSS-B.

question_14132.question: What action should the MS take if there is a change in the MS's capabilities while having an active RR connection?
question_14132.ground_truth: The MS should send a CLASSMARK CHANGE message to the network not later than 1 second after the change in capabilities.

question_14133.question: What is a disadvantage of delayed deletion for PDN connections not eligible for restoration?
question_14133.ground_truth: A disadvantage of delayed deletion is that PDN connections not eligible for restoration will only get deleted after the SGW timer expires, which may cause delays in removing ineligible connections.

question_14134.question: What is responsible for provisioning security materials for direct discovery and U2U relay discovery in a 5G network?
question_14134.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF or 5G U2U Relay PKMF is responsible for provisioning security materials for direct discovery and U2U relay discovery.

question_14135.question: What information is required in a Filter Criteria of IMS communication service?
question_14135.ground_truth: A Filter Criteria contains the address of the Application Server to be contacted, priority of the Filter Criteria, Trigger Point composed by 1 to n instances of the Service Point Triggers (SPTs), default handling, optional Service Information that shall be added to the message body before it is sent to the Application Server.

question_14136.question: What message is transmitted in Cell 1 by the SS to ensure the UE is in State 3A during the paging procedure?
question_14136.ground_truth: A Paging message (including PagingRecord with UE-Identity) for the UE is transmitted in Cell 1 by the SS during the paging procedure.

question_14137.question: What is the role of "Stage 2 requirements for NF Service discovery" in 5GC Service Based Architecture?
question_14137.ground_truth: The "Stage 2 requirements for NF Service discovery" specify the capabilities and functionalities required for a network function to discover the network repository function and the supported services.

question_14138.question: What happens during time-shifted viewing in the 5GMS content delivery scenario?
question_14138.ground_truth: During time-shifted viewing, the Media Player selects media content from the 5GMSd~AS if the user switches to time-shift viewing mode or if the streaming service becomes unavailable via MBS. Once the service becomes available again via MBS, the Media Player switches back to accessing the media content from the local proxy Media Server.

question_14140.question: How does the MME/SGSN determine if it should include Information for Enhanced Coverage in the Paging message for all eNBs selected by the MME/SGSN for paging?
question_14140.ground_truth: The MME/SGSN includes Information for Enhanced Coverage in the Paging message for all eNBs selected by the MME/SGSN for paging only if it has Information for Enhanced Coverage stored, and Enhanced Coverage Allowed parameter is set (i.e. value indicate enhanced coverage is authorized or enabled). Otherwise, it does not include this information in the Paging message.

question_14142.question: What should be the measurement reporting delay for a MEASUREMENT REPORT message for Cell 3 triggered by event 1A during time period T4?
question_14142.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay for a MEASUREMENT REPORT message for Cell 3 triggered by event 1A during time period T4 should be less than 280 ms.

question_14143.question: What must the 3GPP AAA server indicate to the UE when selecting the mobility protocol based on UE indication, access network capabilities, and network policies?
question_14143.ground_truth: The 3GPP AAA server indicates the selected protocol to the UE by using the AT_IPMS_RES attribute.

question_14144.question: What is required for Time Synchronization in the downlink direction from NW-TT port in Follower state?
question_14144.ground_truth: It requires ingress timestamping, calculation of link delay, cumulative rateRatio replacement, and modification of gPTP message payload.

question_14146.question: What information is contained in the RRLP Measure Position Response message sent by the MS?
question_14146.ground_truth: The RRLP Measure Position Response message sent by the MS contains the results of the location measurements performed and the mobile's location estimate.

question_14147.question: What is one possible approach to provide improved support for SIP based call features, such as forking/retargeting, early media, and multicast communication in an SDES based solution?
question_14147.ground_truth: One possible approach to provide improved support for SIP based call features in an SDES based solution is to interpret the <key-info> of SDES in the SDP offer not as the key, but as a nonce used to derive the key, and to use the <key-info> of SDES in the SDP answer directly as the key to protect traffic from the answerer to the offerer. This approach can efficiently support multicast communication by the answerer using a common key for a stream that is sent to multiple receivers.

question_14148.question: What is the purpose of the time window for sending duplicate application layer messages?
question_14148.ground_truth: The time window for sending duplicate application layer messages allows UE1 to send each application layer message twice, using both the old and new L2 ID (and old and new IP address in case of IP-based communication) as the source address. This ensures that the peer UE receives the application layer message containing either the old or the new L2 ID (or IP address) as the source ID, depending on the timing with respect to the message exchange in the L2 ID update procedure.

question_14149.question: What type of session is created by the MCData server for file distribution when making use of the xMB interface?
question_14149.ground_truth: The MCData server creates an MBMS session over xMB-C with the type set to "Files" for file distribution.

question_14150.question: What should the UE do when it detects physical layer problems?
question_14150.ground_truth: The UE should start timer T310 and not initiate any RRC connection re-establishment procedure before expiring of timer T310.

question_14151.question: What defines the observation period between sounding reference symbol (SRS) and an adjacent PUCCH/PUSCH symbol and subsequent sub-frame in all types of frame structures?

question_14152.question: What is the purpose of primary authentication and key agreement?
question_14152.ground_truth: The purpose of primary authentication and key agreement is to enable mutual authentication between the UE and the network and provide keying material that can be used in subsequent security procedures.

question_14153.question: What is the name of the information flow where the MCPTT server sends a group call cancel response to the MCPTT client?

question_14154.question: What additional functionality is suggested for detection of video calling capability during a voice call in the 3GPP Technical Report?
question_14154.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Report suggests that it would be useful for mobiles to indicate whether they support 64 kbit/s video in their current location when using UTRAN, and whether UMTS coverage is available and can support 64 kbit/s video when using GERAN.

question_14155.question: How does the SCC AS identify the session to be transferred?
question_14155.ground_truth: The SCC AS identifies the session to be transferred using the STI (Session Transfer Identity) and the media flow(s).

question_14156.question: What should the participating MCVideo function do when it receives a SIP BYE request from the controlling MCVideo function during a one-to-one video pull call?
question_14156.ground_truth: Upon receiving a SIP BYE request from the controlling MCVideo function, the participating MCVideo function shall follow the procedures as specified in clause 10.2.5.

question_14157.question: What needs to happen for MCPTT client 1 to successfully establish media plane communication with MCPTT client 2?
question_14157.ground_truth: Both MCPTT clients need to successfully establish media plane for communication, and the floor participant at MCPTT client 1 needs to be granted the floor by the floor control server at MCPTT service provider 1, giving it permission to transmit.

question_14158.question: What information does the Handover Complete message contain regarding the LCLS status of the call?
question_14158.ground_truth: The Handover Complete message includes the LCLS-BSS-Status that indicates whether the call is locally switched or not after the internal handover.

question_14160.question: What is the role of the SMF in session management in 5G networks?
question_14160.ground_truth: The Session Management Function (SMF) performs various functions in session management, including session establishment, modification, and release, tunnel maintenance, IP address management, DHCP functions, interface termination for policy control functions, and more.

question_14161.question: What are the two main X2AP procedure modules?
question_14161.ground_truth: The two X2AP procedure modules are the X2AP Basic Mobility Procedures and the X2AP Global Procedures. The former contains procedures used to handle the UE mobility within E-UTRAN, and the latter includes procedures that are not related to a specific UE, involving two peer eNBs, and are not related to a specific user equipment (UE).

question_14162.question: What channels are used in NB LTE for downlink functions based on LTE?
question_14162.ground_truth: M-PBCH, M-PDSCH, M-PDCCH, and M-PSCH are used in NB LTE for downlink functions based on LTE.

question_14163.question: What is the use of the "Number of failed handover executions per beam pair" measurement?
question_14163.ground_truth: The "Number of failed handover executions per beam pair" measurement is used for performance assurance in detecting handover failures between gNBs and providing information about the failure causes.

question_14165.question: What is the purpose of the location service deregistration request message in the 9.3.2.38 information flow?
question_14165.ground_truth: The location service deregistration request message is used by the location management client to inform the location management server that it wants to unregister the location service.

question_14166.question: What is the limit for the number of simultaneous MCX Users for a functional alias?
question_14166.ground_truth: If the upper limit of number of simultaneous MCX Users is reached, the MCX Service will reject the MCX User's request to activate a functional alias.

question_14167.question: What is the effect of using the DELETE method on the "Individual EAS Deployment Information" resource?
question_14167.ground_truth: The DELETE method deletes an existing Individual EAS Deployment Information resource.

question_14169.question: What does the 3GPP Technical Report 22.886 specify in terms of V2X use cases?
question_14169.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Report 22.886 specifies the following V2X use cases: remote driving, information sharing for high/full automated driving, advanced driver assistance systems, and road management, traffic, and network management.

question_14170.question: What is the most widely consumed cereal grain crop in the world?

question_14171.question: What should an MTSI client offer when offering AVPF and AVP together using SDPCapNeg for video?
question_14171.ground_truth: The MTSI client shall offer AVP on the media (m=) line and shall offer AVPF using SDPCapNeg mechanisms.

question_14173.question: What is the state of the USIM for SMS services after receiving an ATTACH REJECT message with EMM cause #8 or #15?
question_14173.ground_truth: The USIM is considered as invalid for SMS services until switching off or the UICC containing the USIM is removed or the timer T3245 expires.

question_14174.question: What is the requirement if a repeater is intended for combination with additional apparatus connected to a repeater port?
question_14174.ground_truth: The combination of repeater together with the additional apparatus shall also fulfill the repeater requirements.

question_14175.question: What is the role of the "originating side eP-CSCF" in the process of WebRTC media transport?
question_14175.ground_truth: The "originating side eP-CSCF" is responsible for sending media information to the eIMS-AGW and creating a translated offer (SDP2) based on the original caller SDP1. It also includes both SDP1 and SDP2 in the SIP request message.

question_14177.question: What is the leaving condition for event A4 in the measurement reporting procedure?
question_14177.ground_truth: The leaving condition for event A4 is defined in Inequality A4-2, which outlines the specific requirements that must be met for the event A4 to no longer be satisfied.

question_14180.question: What is the relationship between the modulo of the "GANSS Code Phase Ambiguity" and the length of the C/A code period in forming pseudo-ranges?
question_14180.ground_truth: The pseudo-ranges are formed by determining the integer number of milliseconds to be added to each code-phase measurement, where 1 ms corresponds to a travelled distance of 300 km.

question_14182.question: What should a UE do when it wants to establish a PDN connection as a user-plane resource associated with an existing MA PDU session of Ethernet PDU session type, but does not support Ethernet PDN type or if the Ethernet PDN type is not supported in EPC?
question_14182.ground_truth: The UE can establish a PDN connection of non-IP PDN type as the user plane resource associated with an existing MA PDU session of Ethernet PDU session type.

question_14184.question: What needs to be achieved in order to have a controlled return of UEs during the winding down phase in 6.47.1.1?
question_14184.ground_truth: The time period for which PLMN A keeps the broadcast indication active and the time period for which it accepts registration requests by inbound roamers need to be different.

question_14185.question: What information is included in the Set-up message sent from VMSCB to MSB?
question_14185.ground_truth: The Set-up message may include bearer capability information for the call.

question_14186.question: What is the maximum number of allowed occurrences for spurious response frequencies in the in-band frequency range (a) and the out-of-band frequency range (b)?
question_14186.ground_truth: In the in-band frequency range, the maximum number of allowed occurrences for spurious response frequencies is one for GSM 850 MS and GSM 900 MS and two for DCS 1800 MS and PCS 1900 MS in band. In the out-of-band frequency range, the maximum number of allowed occurrences for spurious response frequencies is 24, which if grouped, shall not exceed three contiguous occurrences per group.

question_14187.question: What exception is thrown in 6.2.7.22.1.2 if value2 is null?

question_14188.question: When can the multimedia recording be completed as per 3GPP TS 26.244?
question_14188.ground_truth: The multimedia recording can be completed when the maximum time period of multimedia recording has elapsed, a DTMF digit that represents to finish or cancel the multimedia recording is detected by the MRFP, the MRFC requests the MRFP to stop the audio recording, or the multimedia recording is not successful.

question_14189.question: What is the role of the PCEF in step 4 of the procedure for terminating an IP-CAN session when the AF is located in the HPLMN?
question_14189.ground_truth: The PCEF sends a RAA to acknowledge the RAR and request for the termination of the IP-CAN session.

question_14190.question: What is the difference between maritime areas and aeronautical areas in terms of regulatory regimes?
question_14190.ground_truth: Maritime areas may have different regulatory regimes depending on the type of communication services considered, while aeronautical areas have two scenarios with different regulations: Sovereign Airspace and International Airspace.

question_14192.question: What action results in the SGSN sending an MBMS UE Context Deactivation Request to the GGSN?
question_14192.ground_truth: The SGSN sends an MBMS UE Context Deactivation Request to the GGSN upon receiving a UE Removal Request or for other reasons, such as a change in the roaming restrictions for the user.

question_14193.question: What should the UE do when it receives a PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND indicating access type IE as "3GPP access" while in PDU SESSION ACTIVE state and the MA PDU session has user-plane resources established only on 3GPP access?
question_14193.ground_truth: The UE should transmit PDU SESSION RELEASE COMPLETE message and the whole MA PDU session should be released.

question_14194.question: What indicator is included in the Downlink Data Notification Ack message if the UE is in a power saving state?
question_14194.ground_truth: The MME includes a Downlink Buffering Requested indicator in the Downlink Data Notification Ack message if the UE is in a power saving state.

question_14195.question: In the 3GPP system, what is the expected end-to-end latency for cooperative maneuver planning in emergency trajectory alignment messages?
question_14195.ground_truth: Less than 3 milliseconds is expected for cooperative maneuver planning within the application time limit.

question_14196.question: What parameters does the HGMLC query from an external LCS client for a periodic and triggered location request for a target UE?
question_14196.ground_truth: The HGMLC queries the type of location reporting being requested and associated parameters, such as time interval between successive location reports and the total number of reports for periodic reporting, details of the target area, trigger event, and event reporting (whether it includes UE location estimates) for triggered reporting on area event, linear distance threshold and UE location estimates for triggered reporting on motion event, and no additional parameters for UE available trigger event.

question_14199.question: What should the mobile station do, after releasing the last active traffic channel, if it receives a SETUP message with Signaling IE indicating Call Waiting?
question_14199.ground_truth: The mobile station should not request a new SI value before releasing any other call that leads to release any other bearers than the retained bearer.

question_14203.question: What is the purpose of the user-plane-data-access-control list in Solution #19?
question_14203.ground_truth: The user-plane-data-access-control list is used to define the data and data type that should not be provided to NWDAF for an application. It ensures that certain user data is not collected during NWDAF-assisted application detection.

question_14204.question: What is the procedure when a device boots up in the SLM-C?
question_14204.ground_truth: Upon device boot up, the SLM-C in the UE sends an HTTP POST message to SLM-S containing the callback URI in a JSON structure.

question_14205.question: What technology can achieve a higher minimum NF than SiGe HBT BiCMOS within the 7 - 24 GHz frequency range?

question_14206.question: What should be added to the MPD for expressing Early Terminated Periods in DASH?
question_14206.ground_truth: Both Period@start and Period@duration should be added to Early Terminated Periods in DASH.

question_14207.question: What conditions must be met for the IRI-POI in the P-CSCF to identify an IMS-based communication as to be intercepted in the default deployment option?
question_14207.ground_truth: In the default deployment option, the P-CSCF provides the IRI-POI functions when the target is an inbound roaming IMS user not registered for emergency services, or when an inbound roaming IMS user is in communication with a target non-local ID.

question_14208.question: What emergency priority does an MCPTT system provide for an emergency private call during interworking with LMR systems that do not support emergency private calls?
question_14208.ground_truth: For the portion of the call transported in the MCPTT system and LTE EPS, the emergency private call will have priority. However, on the LMR system, there will be no priority for the emergency private call.

question_14209.question: What information does the UE send in a DSMIPv6 Binding Update when activating or modifying a routeing rule to move a traffic flow from one access to another?
question_14209.ground_truth: The UE sends a Binding Update (HoA, BID, FID) that includes the updated routing rules and the mapping between the routing addresses and SDFs.

question_14210.question: What is the channel bandwidth to be tested for RSRP and RSRQ measurement accuracy in the 3GPP TS 36.133 standard?
question_14210.ground_truth: The channel bandwidth to be tested is 10 MHz.

question_14212.question: In what scenario is the UE required to perform PLMN selection triggered by V2X communications over PC5 reference point?
question_14212.ground_truth: If the UE finds a cell that belongs to a PLMN authorized for V2X communications over PC5 reference point and provides radio resources for V2X service but not in the registered PLMN or a PLMN equivalent to the registered PLMN.

question_14213.question: What happens if the absolute switch-over time given in the tariff indication has already passed at the start of charging?
question_14213.ground_truth: If the absolute switch-over time given in the tariff indication has already passed, then the communication charge of the next tariff instead of the current tariff shall immediately be applied.

question_14214.question: What information is used to set the Route Selection Descriptor Precedence in the Route Selection Descriptor?
question_14214.ground_truth: The DN priority that results from the DNAI applicability evaluation is used to set the Route Selection Descriptor Precedence in the Route Selection Descriptor.

question_14215.question: What should the mobile station do if a TBF starting time information element is present and one or more uplink TBFs are already in progress, upon receiving a TBF assignment?
question_14215.ground_truth: The mobile station should continue to use the assigned parameters of the ongoing uplink TBFs until the TDMA frame number indicated by the TBF starting time occurs, at which time it should immediately begin to use the newly assigned uplink TBF parameters.

question_14216.question: What does the 'state' field represent in the response of the +CCSTATEREQ command for PDP context activation?
question_14216.ground_truth: The 'state' field in the response of the +CCSTATEREQ command for PDP context activation indicates the state of PDP context activation, with possible values including deactivated or activated.

question_14217.question: What should the Serving GW do for the PMIPv6 LMA Initiated PDN Connection Deletion on the S8 interface as per clause 11.8.3?
question_14217.ground_truth: Follow the MAG procedure for the PMIPv6 LMA Initiated PDN Connection Deletion on the S8 interface

question_14218.question: What is the recommended way to request a metadata fragment and its associated envelope in a single MBMS download session?
question_14218.ground_truth: It is recommended that only the metadata fragment (fileURI) be requested from the download client, which will result in both fragment and envelope being received using the grouping mechanism.

question_14220.question: What action should the UE take if it has not requested any IP address during the default bearer activation procedure and does not have any information about the capability supported by the IP stack?
question_14220.ground_truth: In this case, the PDN address allocation IE will not contain any information. It is FFS whether the UE shall send an (empty) PDN address allocation IE anyway.

question_14221.question: What should the PGW do if it receives a PGW Downlink Triggering Notification message for which it cannot find a UE context during the SGW restoration procedure?
question_14221.ground_truth: The PGW should send a PGW Downlink Triggering Acknowledge message with the rejection cause code "Context Not Found" to the SGW.

question_14223.question: What is a "secondary resource" in the context of HTTP?
question_14223.ground_truth: A secondary resource is a subset or portion of a primary resource that is identifiable and can be accessed using a URI that is a specific portion of the URI of the primary resource.

question_14226.question: What parameter is sent to the MS in the Facility information element in the FACILITY or CALL PROCEEDING message towards MSa when the network indicates that a CUG has been invoked for the outgoing call?
question_14226.ground_truth: The cug-Index parameter is sent to the MS in the Facility information element.

question_14227.question: What is the purpose of including the Desired-Max-Latency AVP and/or Desired-Max-Loss AVP within the Media-Component-Description AVP when the QoSHint feature is supported by the AF?
question_14227.ground_truth: To indicate to the PCRF that the related application media has specific latency and/or loss demands.

question_14228.question: What is the role of the 5G-RG in the registration procedure of Solution #3?
question_14228.ground_truth: The 5G-RG uses the unified authentication framework to do NAS based authentication in the registration procedure of Solution #3.

question_14229.question: What is one of the threat scenarios that the early IMS security solution is intended to address?
question_14229.ground_truth: One of the threat scenarios that the early IMS security solution is intended to address is impersonation on IMS level using the identity of an innocent user.

question_14230.question: What is the potential new requirement for 5G system with satellite access to support the use case on user differentiation for UEs?
question_14230.ground_truth: The 5G system with satellite access should be able to provide services to an authorized UE independently of the UE's GNSS capability.

question_14231.question: In what order are Bluetooth measurement results reported, if available, in the logMeasResultListBT field?
question_14231.ground_truth: The Bluetooth measurement results are reported in order of decreasing RSSI for Bluetooth beacons, if available, in the logMeasResultListBT field.

question_14232.question: What must be included in the SIP re-INVITE request when sending an MCPTT emergency private call?
question_14232.ground_truth: The SIP re-INVITE request must include a Resource-Priority header field populated with the values for an MCPTT emergency private call as specified in clause 6.6.3.1.12.

question_14233.question: What is one challenge faced by using UE-based proximity detection for small cell discovery and identification?
question_14233.ground_truth: One challenge faced is maintaining feasible fingerprint information, as there is no "CSG whitelist" for small cells, and they are open and deployed in public places.

question_14236.question: What is the required RMS90 error measurement for an E-OTD capable MS receiving a co-channel 8PSK neighbor with a co-channel interference ratio of 0 dB, as specified by the conformance requirement?
question_14236.ground_truth: The RMS90 measurement error of an E-OTD capable MS receiving a co-channel 8PSK neighbor with a co-channel interference ratio of 0 dB shall not exceed 300 nanoseconds.

question_14237.question: What is the difference between centralized quota check and distributed quota check in the context of network slice quota enforcement?
question_14237.ground_truth: In centralized quota check, the NW Slice quota enforcement functionality checks every new PDU Session request against the global S-NSSAI quota at one centralized quota enforcement point. In distributed quota check, the local quota is distributed to one or more NW Slice quota enforcement functionalities and every new PDU Session request is checked against local quota of one or more distributed quota enforcement points before checking against the global quota.

question_14239.question: What are the delivery methods available between the NG-RAN and UE for the transmission of MBS data packets over the radio interface?
question_14239.ground_truth: The two delivery methods are Point-to-Point (PTP) delivery method and Point-to-Multipoint (PTM) delivery method. The NG-RAN can use a combination of PTP/PTM to deliver an MBS data packets to UEs.

question_14241.question: What is the purpose of MMEGI and NRI coordination in the 3GPP network?
question_14241.ground_truth: The purpose of MMEGI and NRI coordination is to keep the UE on the same dedicated network if available, by allowing for coordination between neighbour pools or even the entire PLMN. If the UE is routed to a MME/SGSN not belonging to the dedicated core network, re-routing/re-direction to a dedicated MME/SGSN is needed during the TAU/RAU procedure.

question_14242.question: In the context of PEE performance data file reporting (REQ-PEEFRS-FUN-010 and 011), what is the role of the management service producer?
