question_14242.ground_truth: The management service producer for PEE performance data file reporting is responsible for notifying authorized consumers when PEE performance data (of NF(s)) files are ready and allowing them to fetch the files.

question_14243.question: What is the maximum accepted test system uncertainty for the frequency range up to 4.2 GHz?
question_14243.ground_truth: The maximum accepted test system uncertainty for the frequency range up to 4.2 GHz is the same as for E-UTRA.

question_14244.question: What clause specifies the accuracy requirements for E-UTRAN carrier frequencies measurements?

question_14245.question: What should be the range of the HS-PDSCH BLER using the transport format indicated by the stream and cell-specific CQI median, as per the requirement for UE HS-DSCH categories 19-20?
question_14245.ground_truth: If the HS-PDSCH BLER using the transport format indicated by the stream and cell-specific CQI median is less than or equal to 0.1, the BLER using the transport format indicated by (stream and cell-specific CQI median + 2) must be greater than 0.1. If the HS-PDSCH BLER using the transport format indicated by the stream and cell-specific CQI median is greater than 0.1, the BLER using transport format indicated by (stream and cell-specific CQI median -1) must be less than or equal to 0.1.

question_14250.question: What is the reference point between the SCEF and the HSS/HLR for general access to the capabilities and data of the HSS from the SCEF?

question_14252.question: What technique can be used to accelerate delivery of segmented content in a CDN?
question_14252.ground_truth: One way to do this is to have the proxy server pre-fetch the next segment from the origin at the same time as it retrieves the current segment, so that the segment is ready and waiting when the next request arrives from the client.

question_14253.question: What should the UE do when the fifth expiry of timer T3521 occurs during the de-registration procedure in the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED state?
question_14253.ground_truth: The deregistration procedure shall be aborted and the UE performs local detach.

question_14255.question: What is the role of the Content Handler Function (CHF) in the MBMS system?
question_14255.ground_truth: The CHF handles the separation of unicast and MBMS bearer content and makes the content available in operators CDN for unicast access.

question_14256.question: When is a UE not expected to receive the 16-bit bitmap ZeroPowerCSI-RS with certain LSB bits set to 1 for the normal or extended CP case in a frame structure type 1 or 2 serving cell?
question_14256.ground_truth: The UE is not expected to receive the 16-bit bitmap ZeroPowerCSI-RS with any one of the 6 LSB bits set to 1 for the normal CP case, or with any one of the 8 LSB bits set to 1 for the extended CP case in a frame structure type 1 or 2 serving cell.

question_14257.question: What is the minimum Ethernet frame size that requires padding?
question_14257.ground_truth: The minimum Ethernet frame size that requires padding is 64 bytes.

question_14258.question: What is the effect of calling the getVersion() request function as per clause 6.2.3.21.1?
question_14258.ground_truth: The getVersion() request function returns the version of the implemented APIs of the MBMS client.

question_14260.question: What information does the mobile station get from the packet resource assignments for sending access bursts on the PTCCH?
question_14260.ground_truth: The mobile station gets the Timing Advance Index (TAI) from the packet resource assignments for sending access bursts on the PTCCH.

question_14264.question: What is the effect of an empty "text" field when using the "Read" command for the +CDIS command?
question_14264.ground_truth: If the "text" field is empty when using the "Read" command for the +CDIS command, the corresponding display element cannot be read by the TA.

question_14268.question: What is the function of the MBMS session duration value in the MBMS SESSION STOP REQUEST message?
question_14268.ground_truth: The MBMS session duration value in the MBMS SESSION STOP REQUEST message indicates the remaining duration of the MBMS session.

question_14269.question: What is required for the integrity of the H(e)NB to be validated before establishing a connection to the H(e)NB-GW or the core network?
question_14269.ground_truth: The H(e)NB's integrity is validated by using algorithms of adequate cryptographic strength to authenticate and protect confidentiality and integrity.

question_14270.question: What is the value of the constant MIN(a,b)?
question_14270.ground_truth: The smaller of a and b

question_14272.question: What action does the target gNB-CU-CP take if the multicast session the UE has joined was not established in the target cell?
question_14272.ground_truth: The target gNB-CU-CP triggers the Multicast MBS Session Context Establishment procedure as defined in section 8.15.1.2.

question_14273.question: What transport mechanism is used to send the supplementary services EventReport message in NG-RAN LCS?
question_14273.ground_truth: UL NAS TRANSPORT message defined in 3GPP TS 24.501.

question_14276.question: What is the purpose of the 'Transaction ID' parameter in 5G ProSe security messages over PC8?
question_14276.ground_truth: The Transaction ID parameter is used to uniquely identify a PC8 control protocol for 5G ProSe security transaction when it is combined with other PC8 control protocol for 5G ProSe security transactions in the same transport message.

question_14277.question: Which requirements for NGEN-DC operation are applicable to EN-DC operation as well?
question_14277.ground_truth: All the requirements in this specification applicable for EN-DC are also applicable for NGEN-DC.

question_14278.question: What does the EASDF do when it receives a DNS Response with a FQDN that matches the DNS message detection template provided by the SMF?
question_14278.ground_truth: The EASDF handles the DNS Query message received from the UE as follows: If the FQDN in the DNS Response matches the requested FQDN in the DNS Query, the EASDF may add/replace the EDNS Client Subnet option into the DNS Query message and sends it to the C-DNS server.

question_14279.question: What should the Node B do upon receiving a DL NODE SYNCHRONISATION control frame?
question_14279.ground_truth: The Node B should respond with a UL NODE SYNCHRONISATION control frame, indicating the T1 and T2 parameters from the received DL NODE SYNCHRONISATION control frame.

question_14280.question: What message does the MME send to the MSC/VLR in step 5 if the cause indicates "IMSI Detach only" in a UE-initiated Detach procedure for GERAN/UTRAN with ISR activated?
question_14280.ground_truth: The MME sends an IMSI Detach Indication (IMSI) message to the MSC/VLR.

question_14281.question: What is the role of the responding 5G ProSe End UE when multiple UEs are specified in the Link Modification Request message?
question_14281.ground_truth: The responding 5G ProSe End UE selects a new 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay and sends a PC5 Link Modification Request to each of the specified 5G ProSe End UEs.

question_14282.question: What is replaced with "MCData" in the pre-test conditions of this TLS profile test case?

question_14283.question: What triggers service continuation between FRMCS and GSM-R systems for multi-train voice communication?
question_14283.ground_truth: Service continuation between FRMCS and GSM-R systems for multi-train voice communication is triggered when the Driver or Ground FRMCS User moves from one system to another.

question_14284.question: What is the role of the S-CSCF in SIP Digest when used in the SSO subsystem?
question_14284.ground_truth: The S-CSCF is not involved when SIP digest credentials are re-used in the SSO subsystem, even if it is involved when SIP Digest is performed in IMS.

question_14285.question: How many symbols does the data field of burst type 4 have, when the spreading factor is 16?
question_14285.ground_truth: When the spreading factor is 16, the data fields of burst type 4 have 132 symbols.

question_14287.question: What is the test purpose in clause 6.4B.2.4.2D.1 and 6.4B.2.4.2_1.1.1?
question_14287.ground_truth: The test purpose is not explicitly stated in these clauses. However, it can be inferred that the test purpose is to evaluate the performance of the NR carrier under certain conditions.

question_14288.question: What determines the geographical location of a MC service user for the purpose of migrating to a partner MC system: MNC, MCC, or GPS coordinates?
question_14288.ground_truth: The geographical location of a MC service user can be based on the MNC and MCC of their UE's RPLMN, or something more accurate like GPS coordinates.

question_14291.question: What UE behavior is specified in clause 5.2.4.2 if the UE is camping on a NTN cell and supports skipping TN measurement with UE location information and tn-AreaIdList?
question_14291.ground_truth: The UE may not perform measurements of a TN frequency when UE is not in the coverage of that frequency provided via tn-AreaIdList, regardless of the frequency priority.

question_14292.question: What are the potential KPI requirements to support the use case for media quality enhancement in video streaming upgrade?
question_14292.ground_truth: The potential KPI requirements for media quality enhancement in video streaming upgrade include uplink streaming latency not higher than 100-200 ms and a user experienced UL data rate of 100-1500 kbit/s for the uplink, as well as downlink streaming latency not higher than 100-500 ms and a user experienced DL data rate of 32-150 Mbit/s for the downlink.

question_14295.question: If the user homed in the IWF declines the MCPTT session invitation when performing the manual commencement mode procedures, what should the IWF performing the participating role do?
question_14295.ground_truth: The IWF should send a SIP 480 (Temporarily Unavailable) response towards the MCPTT controlling function with the warning text set to: "110 user declined the call invitation".

question_14298.question: What is the difference between the first digit values in the version number of the 3GPP technical specification?
question_14298.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number of the 3GPP technical specification represents the stage of approval. A value of 1 indicates that the document has been presented to the TSG for information, a value of 2 means that it has been presented to the TSG for approval, and a value of 3 or greater indicates that it is a TSG approved document under change control.

question_14299.question: What state does a mobile station enter after releasing all SBPSCHs and DBPSCHs when in MAC-DTM state?

question_14300.question: What procedures are used for UE mobility between mobile base station relays or between mobile base station relay and macro base station?
question_14300.ground_truth: The legacy procedure of Inter-gNB-DU Mobility as defined in TS~38.401 or the legacy handover procedure using the Xn or N2 reference points as defined in the TS~23.502 are used for UE mobility between mobile base station relays or between mobile base station relay and macro base station.

question_14301.question: What types of procedures does the specification distinguish for different types of cells?
question_14301.ground_truth: The measurement procedures distinguish the following types of cells for measurement: the NR serving cell(s), listed cells, and detected cells.

question_14302.question: What are the different categories of faults that can occur in a 3GPP system?
question_14302.ground_truth: The different categories of faults that can occur in a 3GPP system are hardware failures, software problems, functional faults, faults due to overload situations, and communication failures.

question_14303.question: How does the IWF handle group affiliation in an MCPTT system?
question_14303.ground_truth: The IWF can handle group affiliation in an MCPTT system by informing the LMR system (via the IWF) of group affiliations. It can do this in two ways: by sending an affiliation for every LMR group affiliation, or by sending an affiliation for a group's LMR users when the first user affiliates and a de-affiliation when the last user de-affiliates.

question_14304.question: What action does the UE take when it receives a message with a UE contention resolution identity that does not match the CCCH SDU transmitted in msg3 uplink message?
question_14304.ground_truth: The UE considers the contention resolution not successful then re-selects a preamble and transmits with the calculated PRACH transmission power when the backoff time expires.

question_14305.question: What is the role of the BAP in the IAB architecture?
question_14305.ground_truth: The Backhaul Adaptation Protocol (BAP) is a L2 sub-layer in the IAB architecture that carries the IP layer for the F1 interface and enables routing over multiple hops. It supports fine-granular QoS by allowing multiple BH RLC channels on each BH link, with each channel having an extended logical channel ID (eLCID).

question_14306.question: Who does the test described in section 17.5.1.2.1 apply to?
question_14306.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE from Release 17 onwards.

question_14307.question: What information must the UE include in the LCS PS-MO-LR Location Services invoke message when requesting its own location or that its own location be sent to an external LCS client?
question_14307.ground_truth: The LCS requested QoS information, the requested maximum age of location, and the requested type of location. If the UE is requesting that its location be sent to an external LCS client, the message shall also include the identity of the LCS client and may include the address of the GMLC.

question_14309.question: What are the expected sequences defined for the ME to operate in the manner defined for test requirement 27.22.6.1.5?
question_14309.ground_truth: Expected sequences 1.1 to 1.14 for test requirement 27.22.6.1.5

question_14310.question: What is the main purpose of test case 27.4.3?
question_14310.ground_truth: The purpose of test case 27.4.3 is to verify various aspects of the ME's behavior related to using the IMSI stored in the SIM, updating the cipher key sequence number and TMSI, and handling the paging response.

question_14311.question: What does the Num Sat field represent in the TOD GANSS Signals message?
question_14311.ground_truth: The Num Sat field contains a binary representation of the number of GANSS satellites for which the Data Bit Assistance is requested. It may contain a value between 0 and 15, representing the number of satellites for which Data Bit Assistance is requested or no GANSS satellite ID is specified. When the Num Sat field is 0, there are no GANSS satellite IDs present.

question_14312.question: What is the purpose of the Recommended Cells for Paging IE in the NGAP UE Context Release Complete, UE Context Suspend Request and UE Context Resume Request messages?
question_14312.ground_truth: The Recommended Cells for Paging IE is provided to the AMF to restriction the use of UE paging on a specific cell when in idle mode.

question_14314.question: When does the procedure for initiating the measurement reporting procedure start?
question_14314.ground_truth: The measurement reporting procedure is initiated when a measurement reporting entry is included within the VarMeasReportList for a measId, or when a first measurement report is triggered for the 'reportStrongestCells' or 'reportStrongestCellsForSON' purpose. The procedure can also be initiated upon expiry of the periodical reporting timer for a measId, or upon expiry of T321 for a measId.

question_14316.question: What is the role of the WT in the Xw UP protocol for LWA option?
question_14316.ground_truth: The WT provides information in the Xw UP protocol for LWA option, such as successful transmission towards or sequence delivery to the UE, indication of transferred LWA PDUs, and desired buffer sizes for the eNB and the UE.

question_14317.question: What is the significance of the envelope of the current frame at 13.2kbps in the context of bit-rate switching?
question_14317.ground_truth: The envelope of the current frame at 13.2kbps is preserved for the envelope estimation for 7.2kbps and 8kbps when bit-rate switching from 13.2kbps to 7.2 or 8kbps.

question_14318.question: What is the role of the SCP in the authorization process of an NF Service Consumer?
question_14318.ground_truth: The SCP acts as an intermediary between the NF Service Consumer and the NF Service Producer, and is responsible for requesting access tokens and services on behalf of the consumer.

question_14319.question: What information elements should the Application Client residing in a different UE include in a message sending request?
question_14319.ground_truth: The Application Client residing in a different UE should include the following information elements in a message sending request: Message Type IE, Message ID IE, Target Address IE, Target Type IE (optional), Application ID IE (optional), Payload IE, and Delivery Status Required IE (optional).

question_14321.question: What is the main difference between a remotely initiated MCPTT call and a normal MCPTT call?
question_14321.ground_truth: A remotely initiated MCPTT call is requested by an MCPTT user on MCPTT client 1 to the MCPTT user of MCPTT client 2 without the user of MCPTT client 2 explicitly initiating the call. A normal MCPTT call, on the other hand, is initiated by the user of MCPTT client 2 explicitly and not by a request from another MCPTT client.

question_14322.question: For the AUN3 device served by a 5G-RG, what is the result when steps 1a, 1b, and 2b are executed for PDU Session Establishment?
question_14322.ground_truth: A distinct PDU session is established for each AUN3 device.

question_14323.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon receiving a SIP 183(Session Progress) response with a specific alert-info header field value?
question_14323.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should not give any indication of the progress of the call setup to the user.

question_14324.question: What is the difference in decibels (dB) between the interferer level and IM2 product in the setup used to investigate the impact of IM2?
question_14324.ground_truth: The IM2 product was found at -69 dBm at an interferer level of 10 dBm, and has disappeared in the noise floor at -80 dBm at an interferer level of -13 dBm, indicating a difference of 11 dB.

question_14325.question: What is the type of codec used in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group's AMR-WB speech codec?
question_14325.ground_truth: Algebraic Code Excited Linear Prediction Coder (ACELP)

question_14327.question: What is the implication of a low U-value in the context of building efficiency?
question_14327.ground_truth: A low U-value indicates high thermal efficiency in the context of building efficiency.

question_14330.question: What is one solution to the large difference in interference when there is or is not data activity on the Lean carrier?
question_14330.ground_truth: The DPCCH is only transmitted with E-DCH or as a preamble during several TTIs/slots before E-DCH transmission.

question_14331.question: What is the system that provides MC service to an MC user, which can be a primary or a partner MC system to which the MC service user has migrated?

question_14333.question: Who manages the floor control in step 6 of the subclause 10.3.3.4?
question_14333.ground_truth: The LMR system where the interworking group is defined and manages the floor control.

question_14334.question: What is the pre-condition for the MC service user at the MC service client 1 to initiate an MC service individual emergency alert?
question_14334.ground_truth: The MC service user at the MC service client 1 must set the MC service emergency state.

question_14335.question: What is the purpose of MBMS bearer event notifications in the MC service?
question_14335.ground_truth: The purpose of MBMS bearer event notifications is to keep the MC service server informed of the MBMS bearer's status, such as network's ability to deliver the service, MBMS bearer start result, cells' allocation of MBMS resources, and overload scenarios.

question_14336.question: In the scenario given, what should the UE do if it is in 5GMM-REGISTERED state and a SERVICE ACCEPT message with a T3448 value IE is received, and the timer is running?
question_14336.ground_truth: The UE shall stop timer T3448, treat the indication from the lower layers as successful completion of the procedure, and enter the state 5GMM-REGISTERED.

question_14337.question: What is the procedure followed when a MS uses an unknown TMSI in a location area managed by the same VLR?
question_14337.ground_truth: This procedure, called "Local TMSI unknown", involves the network performing a variant of the procedures described in subclauses 2.3.1 and 2.3.2, and occurs when a data loss has occurred in a VLR and when the MS uses an unknown TMSI for a communication or location updating request.

question_14338.question: In the "tThreeByteType" simple type, what is the maximum possible value for its restriction base?

question_14339.question: What is the typical minimum requirement for EVM (Error Vector Magnitude) in other cellular systems?
question_14339.ground_truth: The typical minimum requirement for EVM in other cellular systems is 12.5%.

question_14340.question: Which leaf in the document is used as a placeholder for location conditions for a particular flow distribution rule?
question_14340.ground_truth: The ValidityArea node acts as a placeholder for location conditions for a particular flow distribution rule, and it is defined in the "ANDSF/IARP/<X>/ForInterAPNRouting/<X>/RoutingCriteria/<X>/ValidityArea" leaf.

question_14343.question: What is the definition of "Availability" as used in the document?
question_14343.ground_truth: Availability is the percentage value of the amount of time the 3GPP system is delivering services divided by the amount of time it is expected to deliver services in a specific area.

question_14344.question: How does the NEF determine the HPLMN of the UE when the IP address of the UE is a public IP address that belongs to a range not owned by the PLMN of the NEF?
question_14344.ground_truth: The NEF contacts the NEF of the HPLMN in order to retrieve the UE IP address of the PDU Session from the PSA UPF in the HPLMN.

question_14345.question: What are the principles followed in the complexity comparison methodology?
question_14345.ground_truth: The principles followed in the complexity comparison methodology include standalone analysis, system description in terms of functional blocks, specification of functional and technical characteristics, and measurement of complexity using silicon area estimate, gate density, relative area of RF and baseband functions, list of external components, and DSP cycles/second.

question_14346.question: What is the field name for "Mandatory for 1.28Mcps TDD. Not Applicable to 3.84Mcps TDD."?

question_14348.question: What should the P-CSCF add in the SIP message if SIP digest without TLS is used and the SIP message is received outside of the registration and authentication procedures?
question_14348.ground_truth: If SIP digest without TLS is used and the SIP message is received outside of the registration and authentication procedures, the P-CSCF shall discard the SIP message if the message does not map to an existing IP association as defined in subclause~5.2.3.

question_14349.question: What is the requirement for the MS when the last received steering of roaming information contains a list of preferred PLMN/access technology combinations?
question_14349.ground_truth: The MS shall use the "Operator Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology" stored in the ME when following the procedure for selecting a PLMN/access technology combination, if the last received steering of roaming information contains a list of preferred PLMN/access technology combinations.

question_14351.question: What is the role of the RRLP Flags information element in the 3GPP TS 44.064 standard?
question_14351.ground_truth: The RRLP Flags information element carries control information for RRLP in the 3GPP TS 44.064 standard.

question_14353.question: What charging information does the AMF collect as part of the 5G connection and mobility charging requirements?
question_14353.ground_truth: The AMF collects charging information per UE registration to the 5GS, per UE N2 connection between the 5G-AN and the AMF, per UE location reporting, and may collect charging information including CAG Identifier(s) per UE registration to the 5GS.

question_14355.question: What is the function of 5QI in QoS data?
question_14355.ground_truth: 5QI (Five Quality Class Identifiers) in QoS data defines the QoS parameters (e.g. bitrates) associated with a rule.

question_14356.question: What is the TFCP layer used for in this solution?
question_14356.ground_truth: The TFCP layer is used for tunneling traffic between the UE and the UPF.

question_14358.question: What should the MCVideo emergency group state be set to if an emergency condition is contained in the `mcvideo-calling-group-id` element?
question_14358.ground_truth: It should set the MCVideo emergency group state to "MVEG 2: in-progress".

question_14359.question: What operation can be performed in the MCData message store to delete a folder and all its contents?
question_14359.ground_truth: A folder delete operation can be performed to delete a folder and all its contents in the MCData message store.

question_14360.question: What is the effect of setting the TFO Activity Control property to "On"?
question_14360.ground_truth: Setting the TFO Activity Control property to "On" means that TFO is enabled and the TFO protocol is supported.

question_14361.question: What are the requirements for the selectivity of GSM carrier RSSI measurements?
question_14361.ground_truth: The selectivity requirements for GSM carrier RSSI measurements are 16 dB for adjacent 200 kHz channel, 48 dB for adjacent 400 kHz channel, and 56 dB for adjacent 600 kHz channel. These requirements must be met using random, continuous, GSM-modulated signals with the wanted signal at 20 dB above the reference sensitivity level.

question_14362.question: What method is used in PSS for requesting the retransmission of RTP packets?
question_14362.ground_truth: PSS clients shall use the NACK feedback message format as defined in the "Extended RTP Profile for RTCP-based Feedback (RTP/AVPF)" for requesting the retransmission of RTP packets.

question_14363.question: What kind of information might be needed by the RAN from the CN and/or the UE to enhance power management (i.e. CDRX) in the eighth key issue?
question_14363.ground_truth: Information such as XR/media traffic characteristics, traffic pattern and statistics might be needed.

question_14364.question: What is the role of the Mobile Station Classmark 2 and 3 information elements in the GA-RRC RELOCATION REQUEST message?
question_14364.ground_truth: The Mobile Station Classmark 2 and 3 information elements are included in the GA-RRC RELOCATION REQUEST message to provide information about the MS's capabilities and to ensure compatibility with the target network.

question_14365.question: When is it up to UE implementation whether to perform UL transmission in NOTE 4, NOTE 5, and NOTE 6?
question_14365.ground_truth: It is up to UE implementation whether to perform UL transmission when there are more than one UL transmission which the MAC entity is not able to perform simultaneously among the transmissions where the MAC entity is able to perform all transmissions of V2X sidelink communication prioritized simultaneously, among the UL transmissions that the MAC entity is able to perform simultaneously with the transmission of NR sidelink communication prioritized, and among the UL transmissions where the MAC entity is able to perform all transmissions of V2X sidelink communication prioritized simultaneously with the transmission of NR sidelink communication prioritized, respectively.

question_14366.question: When should the UE initiate the match report procedure in restricted 5G ProSe direct discovery model B discoverer operation?
question_14366.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the match report procedure in restricted 5G ProSe direct discovery model B discoverer operation when there is a match event when applying one of the discovery response filters to one of the ProSe response codes received from the lower layers and the UE does not have a corresponding RPAUID already locally stored, among other conditions.

question_14367.question: What is the responsibility of the CAS after receiving the selected CAS declaration message from the S-EAS for ACR execution?
question_14367.ground_truth: The CAS informs the UE with the S-EES endpoint information by selected EES declaration request.

question_14368.question: Who are the parties involved in the mutual authentication and establishment of new cipher and integrity keys between the VLR/SGSN and the MS?
question_14368.ground_truth: The parties involved are the AuC of the user's HE (HE/AuC) and the USIM in the user's mobile station.

question_14369.question: What is the highest target value for RTT for satellite systems involving user equipment in the case of GEO satellite systems?
question_14369.ground_truth: The highest target value for RTT for satellite systems involving user equipment in the case of GEO satellite systems is 600ms.

question_14370.question: What happens when the "forbidden PLMNs for attach in S101 mode" list is full and a new PLMN identity has to be inserted?
question_14370.ground_truth: When the list is full and a new PLMN identity has to be inserted, the UE shall delete the oldest PLMN identity.

question_14371.question: What is the purpose of multi-connectivity or route redundancy in DAG for back-up purposes?
question_14371.ground_truth: Multi-connectivity or route redundancy in DAG can be used for back-up purposes, and can also be used concurrently to achieve load balancing, reliability, etc.

question_14372.question: What is the responsibility of the eIMS-AGW in the described solution?
question_14372.ground_truth: The eIMS-AGW is responsible for media plane interworking between the IP network and IMS network. It supports media plane interworking extensions, including conversion between SRTP and RTP, and termination of ICE procedure.

question_14375.question: What should the target UE do when Timer T5005 expires?
question_14375.ground_truth: The target UE should either initiate a PC5 unicast link keep-alive procedure to check the link or initiate the PC5 unicast link release procedure.

question_14377.question: What does the scenario described in section 5.1.5 involve in the context of intent driven MnS?
question_14377.ground_truth: The scenario described in section 5.1.5 involves the MnS consumer expressing an intent to the MnS producer containing an expectation on radio network performance to be assured, which may include RAN UE throughput performance and radio network capacity performance.

question_14378.question: Which entity notifies the SMF when a UE moves out of the 5G VN group service area?
question_14378.ground_truth: The AMF notifies the SMF when a UE moves out of the 5G VN group service area.

question_14382.question: If the field F0 is set to 00, what resource is used as a spatial relation for the i-th Positioning SRS resource?
question_14382.ground_truth: NZP CSI-RS resource index is used.

question_14383.question: How should the message type IE be used for messages transmitted via the PS domain?
question_14383.ground_truth: No sequence number should be used for messages transmitted via the PS domain. Bits 7 and 8 should be coded with a "0". If a sequence number is received on the network side, it should be ignored.

question_14385.question: What channels require coverage compensation in Urban 4 GHz O2I scenario with ISD 500m for FR1?
question_14385.ground_truth: PUSCH eMBB, PUSCH VoIP, Msg3, PRACH B4, PUCCH Format 1 with 2 bits, PUCCH Format 3 with 11 bits and PUCCH Format 3 with 22 bits

question_14387.question: What information should the NG-RAN node store in the UE context and use if the Time Synchronisation Assistance Information IE is included in the PATH SWITCH REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message?
question_14387.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node should store the Time Synchronisation Assistance Information in the UE context and use it as defined in TS 23.501.

question_14388.question: In what mode will the MS send a Service Request message if it has any signalling messages to be sent to the network in PMM-IDLE mode, and what should the Service Type be set to in this case?
question_14388.ground_truth: The MS will send a Service Request message in PMM-IDLE mode and set the Service Type to "signalling".

question_14389.question: What are the three densities used to describe the possible deployment scenarios?
question_14389.ground_truth: Coverage, traffic density, and connection density.

question_14391.question: What should the UE compute the scaling factor for an uplink transmission on a LAA SCell as if the PUSCH transmission is performed on the LAA SCell in subframe i, when determining the UL transmission power for the LAA SCell?
question_14391.ground_truth: The UE should compute the scaling factor for an uplink transmission on a LAA SCell as if the PUSCH transmission is performed on the LAA SCell in subframe i, irrespective of whether the UE can access the LAA SCell for the PUSCH transmission in subframe i.

question_14392.question: What are the four components of a 3GPP system?
question_14392.ground_truth: The four components of a 3GPP system are: (1) one or more Access Networks, (2) one or more Core Networks, (3) one or more Intelligent Node Networks, service logic and mobility management, and (4) one or more transmission networks.

question_14393.question: What should be done for the CBC to take cell barring/unbarring into consideration for PWS reporting?
question_14393.ground_truth: The CBC could take such events into consideration for PWS reporting if OAM barring/unbarring of cells is coordinated in the CBC.

question_14396.question: What is the DL reference channel for the minimum information throughput requirements of DB-DC-HSDPA?
question_14396.ground_truth: The DL reference channel for the minimum information throughput requirements of DB-DC-HSDPA is H-Set 8A.

question_14397.question: What is the main function of dial plans in IP-PBX systems?
question_14397.ground_truth: The main function of dial plans is to allow shortcut dialing and map enterprise-specific dial strings to E.164 numbers.

question_14399.question: Which IMD product falls into the 3rd own Rx band 7 in section 6.46.1.2?
question_14399.ground_truth: The 4th IMD falls into the 3rd own Rx band 7 in section 6.46.1.2.

question_14400.question: What is the main difference between CZ-UMTS and normal UMTS in terms of modulation and spreading?
question_14400.ground_truth: CZ-UMTS has different pulse shaping and alternate chip zero out procedures as well as a different number of allowed spreading codes compared to normal UMTS.

question_14401.question: How can the SCAS writing process ensure that no area of the network product class is missed?
question_14401.ground_truth: The SCAS writing process can use the classes and grouping provided by CC part 2 as guidance, to avoid missing any critical areas of the network product class.

question_14402.question: In the 3GPP technical specification, which procedures in TS~23.060 use off-path signalling for the PDN GW released resources to support PMIP-based S5/S8 deployments in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_14402.ground_truth: The PDN GW-Initiated PDP Context Deactivation Procedure using S4 and S5/S8 deployments in clause 9.2.4.3A and 9.2.4.3B in the 3GPP technical specification.

question_14403.question: When should the UE set the Follow-on request indicator to "Follow-on request pending" in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message?
question_14403.ground_truth: The UE should set the Follow-on request indicator to "Follow-on request pending" if it initiates an initial registration for onboarding services in SNPN, needs to prolong the established NAS signalling connection after the completion of the initial registration procedure, or requests resources for V2X communication over PC5 reference point, ProSe direct discovery over PC5, ProSe direct communication over PC5 or A2X communication over PC5 reference point.

question_14404.question: What is the primary use of Grant Allocation Type 5?
question_14404.ground_truth: Grant Allocation Type 5 is primarily used when the UE is establishing or re-establishing an RRC connection, during handover, or when the UE is not PUCCH synchronized.

question_14405.question: What is the purpose of the RPAUID in the ProSe query procedure?
question_14405.ground_truth: The RPAUID is used to identify the application that triggered the ProSe query procedure and to indicate what the UE is interested to announce.

question_14407.question: What are some key performance indicators (KPIs) for communication services in wind power plant communication networks?
question_14407.ground_truth: The KPIs of communication services in a wind power plant communication network include reliability, latency, data rate, and availability, among others.

question_14408.question: What is the expected HTTP status code when a service consumer pulls a DD Context from the SEALDD Server and the request fails?
question_14408.ground_truth: The appropriate HTTP status code indicating the error shall be returned, along with appropriate additional error information in the HTTP GET response body.

question_14411.question: What is the purpose of the procedure in this solution?
question_14411.ground_truth: The purpose of the procedure in this solution is to allow an NRM client to report the broadcast reception quality to the NRM server so that it can make decisions about using unicast delivery for VAL UEs with poor broadcast reception quality.

question_14414.question: What is the function of the "Cell Identifier List" information element in GAN?
question_14414.ground_truth: The "Cell Identifier List" information element is used to transfer multiple Cell Global Identifications in GAN.

question_14416.question: What message does the TWAN send to the UE when there are multiple WLCP bearers per PDN connection and a new bearer needs to be created?
question_14416.ground_truth: The TWAN sends a WLCP message, Bearer Creation Request, to the UE containing necessary information for the new bearer.

question_14418.question: What should an EES do if it receives an EAS information provisioning request including an EASID that corresponds to an instantiable but not yet instantiated EAS?
question_14418.ground_truth: The EES should include the selected EASID in the request without the endpoint, and instantiate the EAS when necessary.

question_14419.question: Which parameter allows specification of the uplink transmission direction for packet filters in the +CGTFTRDP command?
question_14419.ground_truth: The <direction< parameter allows specification of the uplink transmission direction for packet filters in the +CGTFTRDP command.

question_14421.question: What is the role of the NSQ-NF in the 5GS network?
question_14421.ground_truth: The NSQ-NF is responsible for providing network slice quota event notifications to the AF in the 5GS network.

question_14422.question: What should a UE do if it detects a cell in a higher priority search that is indicated as not allowed for that carrier in the measurement control system information?
question_14422.ground_truth: The UE is not required to perform measurements on that cell.

question_14423.question: In section 7.23.1.7, which interference component is stated to be no longer an issue after RAN4 considers specific holding frequency bands?
question_14423.ground_truth: The 2nd IMD problem that falls into the own Rx band 21 when RAN4 studies the IMD analysis for the related CA band combinations including Band 21.

question_14424.question: What is a disadvantage of using JPEG and PNG image compression formats for GPU textures?
question_14424.ground_truth: They need to be decompressed and passed to the GPU in a format that it supports.

question_14425.question: What is the unit of measurement used in event A3 in the 3GPP specification?
question_14425.ground_truth: The variables Mn, Mp, Ofn, Ofp, Ocn, and Ocp are expressed in dBm in case of RSRP, or in dB in case of RSRQ and RS-SINR. The variables Hys, Off, and the hysteresis are expressed in dB.

question_14427.question: What is the function of the Bearers layer in MBMS-based services?
question_14427.ground_truth: The Bearers layer provides the mechanism for transporting IP data in an efficient one-to-many manner, using MBMS bearers as defined in 3GPP TS 23.246 and 3GPP TS 22.146.

question_14428.question: What is the objective of the present document in the 3GPP study on security aspects of support for advanced V2X services?
question_14428.ground_truth: The objective is to provide security and privacy analysis of eV2X system architecture, derive potential security and privacy requirements, and evaluate security and privacy solutions for protection of it.

question_14429.question: What do the padlock icons in the list of Technical Specifications and Technical Reports signify?
question_14429.ground_truth: The padlock icons in the list of Technical Specifications and Technical Reports indicate whether the documents are intended for adoption by partner Standards Development Organizations or if they are internal working documents of the 3GPP TSGs.

question_14430.question: What is the purpose of the proximity alert procedure?
question_14430.ground_truth: The proximity alert procedure informs the UE (UE~A) that it has been determined to be in proximity with the targeted UE (UE~B) and, if UE~A has indicated it wishes to engage in WLAN direct discovery and communication with UE~B, provides Assistance Information that expedites the WLAN direct discovery and communication to both UE~A and UE~B.

question_14431.question: How does the IP-SM-GW deliver the SMS from MSISDN-less IMS UE to Traditional UE in alternative 1?
question_14431.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW receives the SIP MESSAGE from the MSISDN-less IMS UE, recognizes the message as originating from a MSISDN-less UE, and executes special handling which includes including a special code in the RP-OA, and the TP-UD contains the MSISDN-less UE's SIP URI. The IP-SM-GW forwards the SM to SC, which sends the SM to the traditional UE.

question_14432.question: What is the task of a MUSHRA test subject when evaluating the audio conditions?
question_14432.ground_truth: The subject is required to listen to the OR, then to each of the test conditions, the Hidden Reference (HR), and two or more degraded Anchor conditions. The subject's task is to identify the HR condition and give it a rating of 100, then rate the remaining conditions relative to the HR condition.

question_14434.question: What is the role of Minimum Requirement in this specification?
question_14434.ground_truth: In this specification, the Minimum Requirement is a value determined relative to a nominal value specified by the manufacturer for a parameter, for tests that measure a parameter relative to a value that is not fully specified in the E-UTRA specifications.

question_14436.question: What is the definition of the VAMOS reference test scenarios in the context of 3GPP TS 45.005?
question_14436.ground_truth: The VAMOS reference test scenarios define a set of interfering signals and corresponding performance limits for the VAMOS receiver to receive a wanted modulated signal without exceeding a given degradation due to the presence of specific unwanted modulated signals.

question_14437.question: What is the recommended naming convention for a private user identity in TS 23.003 subclause 13.3 for 3GPP systems with ISIM application?
question_14437.ground_truth: The private user identity is derived from the IMSI.

question_14439.question: Where should the maximum limit to the number of UEs with granted access to a given CSG cell be controlled?
question_14439.ground_truth: The maximum limit to the number of UEs with granted access to a given CSG cell should be controlled in the MME/SGSN/MSC, as the HeNB GW is an optional entity and cannot perform the number limit control for CSG.

question_14440.question: What is the purpose of the requestReportGPRSEvent operation in the eZone?
question_14440.ground_truth: The requestReportGPRSEvent operation is used to request the gprsSSF to monitor for an event, then send a notification back to the gsmSCF when the event is detected.

question_14441.question: How does a GGSN handle a GTP error indication message for a PDP context with the DTI flag set (i.e. from an RNC)?
question_14441.ground_truth: The GGSN should not delete the associated PDP context but mark it as invalid. Any subsequent packets arriving for an invalid PDP context should be discarded. The GGSN shall inform the SGSN that the GGSN received a GTP error indication from RNC and the SGSN shall re-establish the tunnel between the SGSN and GGSN as specified in 3GPP TS~29.060.

question_14443.question: What is the purpose of the 4.9B procedure in the withdrawal of specifications and functionality in 3GPP?
question_14443.ground_truth: The 4.9B procedure outlines the steps required for withdrawing specifications and functionality, including diligent assessment, explicit identification of the withdrawal, documentation in a work item, and changes to affected specifications.

question_14444.question: What are the pre-conditions for an MCData user to initiate a one-to-one conversation on MCData client 1 and 2?
question_14444.ground_truth: The pre-conditions are that MCData user(s) on MCData client 1 and 2 are registered for receiving MCData service.

question_14446.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon receiving a request to release an MCVideo ambient viewing call?
question_14446.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should perform the actions specified in clause~6.2.5.2 and clear the cache of stored data related to the ambient viewing call if the procedures of clause~6.2.5.2 were successful.

question_14448.question: What is a possible method to supply an E-RUA DN (Emergency-RUA Dialable Number) to the UE when establishing an emergency session using a logical signalling control channel over the PS domain?
question_14448.ground_truth: A possible method to supply an E-RUA DN to the UE is through an USSD (Unstructured Supplementary Service Data) exchange between the UE and the network.

question_14450.question: Which RF and BB bandwidths are considered for the UL and DL in option BW1?
question_14450.ground_truth: Both RF and BB bandwidths are 5 MHz for UL and DL in option BW1.

question_14451.question: What is the minimum distance along the ground between a repeater and a UE (User Equipment) for Local Area scenarios?
question_14451.ground_truth: The minimum distance along the ground between a repeater and a UE for Local Area scenarios is 2 m.

question_14452.question: Which reference point is used between the TDF and the PCRF for online charging based on the Diameter credit control application?
question_14452.ground_truth: The Gyn Reference Point is used for the online charging based on the Diameter credit control application between the Online Charging System (OCS) and the TDF.

question_14453.question: What scenarios does the 3GPP study item cover in relation to IMS calls?
question_14453.ground_truth: The 3GPP study item covers IMS calls where the service invocation is done in the originating and/or terminating home network, concatenation of applications, an application server hosting several applications, call leg manipulation, and correlation of charging relevant information created by application servers.

question_14456.question: What is the carrier frequency information that the UE should be able to identify for the inter-frequency cells in the test case?
question_14456.ground_truth: The DRX cycle length used to evaluate the inter-frequency cell re-selection criteria is 1.28 seconds.

question_14458.question: What is the response of the MCPTT server to MCPTT client 1 after it has resolved the MCPTT group ID?
question_14458.ground_truth: The MCPTT server sends the MCPTT emergency state cancel response to MCPTT client 1 to confirm the MCPTT emergency state cancel request, and MCPTT client 1 resets its emergency state.

question_14462.question: What are the pre-conditions for the MC service client to cancel an ad-hoc group emergency alert?
question_14462.ground_truth: The MC service client must be authorized to cancel the emergency alert and be a participant of the associated ad-hoc group.

question_14463.question: What is the minimal bitrate of incoming traffic that requires the generation of an RCI signalling message?
question_14463.ground_truth: An operator may decide not to apply a congestion mitigation measure for EPS bearer/PDP context that carries little amount of traffic, and thus no RCI signalling for such EPS bearer/PDP context.

question_14464.question: What is the role of the CDF in the ProSe Direct Communication?
question_14464.ground_truth: The CDF generates the charging data records (CDR), sends the Charging Data Response corresponding to the received Charging Data Request, and opens, updates, and closes the PF-DC-CDR for the UE in the ProSe Direct Communication.

question_14466.question: What message is used by the application to enable notifications on new call events in the call barring service?
question_14466.ground_truth: The enableNotifications message is used by the application to enable notifications on new call events in the call barring service.

question_14467.question: What is the purpose of the IAM message that the MGCF sends to the VMSC?
question_14467.ground_truth: The IAM message is used by the MGCF to set up the signalling connection, after which the setup message is sent to the UE-B.

question_14469.question: What should a Mobile Station do when it receives a message not consistent with the protocol state?
question_14469.ground_truth: The Mobile Station should ignore the message and return a CP-ERROR message with cause #98 "Message type not compatible with the short message protocol state" if an appropriate connection exists.

question_14470.question: What action does the MS take after receiving a CONNECT ACKNOWLEDGE message for an emergency call?
question_14470.ground_truth: After receiving a CONNECT ACKNOWLEDGE message for an emergency call, the MS indicates that the traffic channel is through connected in both directions.

question_14471.question: What is the information included in the EVENT DOWNLOAD - LOCATION STATUS 1.1.2B?
question_14471.ground_truth: EVENT DOWNLOAD - LOCATION STATUS 1.1.2B includes the following information: MCC & MNC (001110), LAC (0002), and Cell ID (0002).

question_14472.question: What is the value of M for PCCCH when there are 25 uplink and 25 downlink channels in the cell?
question_14472.ground_truth: M = 12*64 = 768 when there are 25 uplink and 25 downlink channels in the cell.

question_14473.question: How is the physical cell identity of Cell 7 updated in each iteration of the test procedure loop?
question_14473.ground_truth: The physical cell identity of Cell 7 is updated by adding 1 to its current value, then taking the module of the sum and adding 2, for next iteration of the test procedure loop. If the new value is equal to the physical cell identity of Cell 3 then it should be skipped for next iteration.

question_14474.question: What action does the ICCF take after receiving an incoming SIP INVITE to the actual target ICS UE of the call?
question_14474.ground_truth: The ICCF initiates an ICS Incoming Call Request USSD to the MSC-S where the ICS UE is, pages the ICS UE, and fetches a number (MSRN) for a media connection if not already established.

question_14477.question: What is the message that the location management client-1 sends as an acknowledgement after receiving the off network location report message from the location management client-2?
question_14477.ground_truth: The location management client-1 sends the off-network location management ack message if requested in the received message.

question_14478.question: What is the significance of the ToS field in the context of traffic identification and separation?
question_14478.ground_truth: The ToS (Type of Service) field is used to map an application data flow to a specific PCC rule for traffic identification and separation.

question_14479.question: What technology is required for the pre-condition of the container positioning system?
question_14479.ground_truth: The containers are equipped with 5G communication modules, smart lock as well as a 5G positioning module.

question_14480.question: What is a broadcast group call in the MCPTT system?
question_14480.ground_truth: A broadcast group call is a special group call where the initiating MCPTT user expects no response from the other MCPTT users, so that when his transmission is complete, so is the call.

question_14482.question: What shall the UE do if it receives EMM cause #31 and doesn't support CIoT optimizations or N1 mode?
question_14482.ground_truth: The UE shall set the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, reset the tracking area updating attempt counter, and enter the state EMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE. The UE shall also enable N1 mode capability for 3GPP access and disable the E-UTRA capability.

question_14484.question: When does the UE suspend the transmission of 5GSM messages during 5GMM procedures?
question_14484.ground_truth: The UE and the AMF shall suspend the transmission of 5GSM messages during 5GMM procedures, except for 5GMM procedures piggybacking 5GSM messages.

question_14485.question: What types of data are transmitted in real-time in a 5G connected ambulance?
question_14485.ground_truth: In a 5G connected ambulance, high-definition video and audio streams, as well as physiological data from medical equipment, are transmitted in real-time. An example of physiological data includes ECG data, vital signs monitoring, and CT scan images. All data streams are synchronized to enable recording and offline synchronized playback of medical interventions.

question_14488.question: What should be the position of the UE in the initial conditions of the test described in section 8.26.2, in terms of connected cells?
question_14488.ground_truth: The UE is connected to Cell1 on radio channel 1 (PCC) but is not aware of Cell 2 on radio channel 2.

question_14489.question: What is specified in the 3GPP STN NRM IRP XML Definitions?
question_14489.ground_truth: The 3GPP STN NRM IRP XML Definitions specify the XML schema, XML namespace, XML complex type, and XML element type for the STN NRM IRP IRPAgent and IRPManager.

question_14491.question: What should the UDM do if the NF service consumer sends a DELETE request to delete a 5G-VN-Group and MTC Provider or AF are not allowed to perform this operation for the UE?
question_14491.ground_truth: The UDM should return HTTP status code "403 Forbidden" including additional error information in the response body.

question_14492.question: In the location updating procedure, what is the maximum duration of the test?
question_14492.ground_truth: The maximum duration of the test is 30 minutes.

question_14496.question: How are Information Elements classified for Short Messages?
question_14496.ground_truth: Information Elements are classified into 3 categories: SMS Control, EMS Control, and EMS Content.

question_14497.question: What is the role of r in the alternative channel generation method?
question_14497.ground_truth: r is a proportionality factor used to scale the values of DS, ASD, ASA, ZSD, and ZSA. It is set to 1.5.

question_14499.question: What is the purpose of the procedure for releasing a chat group call on an interworking group defined in the LMR system?
question_14499.ground_truth: This procedure describes the case where the LMR system releases an ongoing MCPTT chat group call for all the participants of that group call.

question_14500.question: What are the responsibilities of an AIPN operator in regard to controlling user access to the public network and managing the prime commercial relationship with the user?
question_14500.ground_truth: The AIPN operator controls access of the user to the public network and has the prime commercial relationship with the user.

question_14501.question: Which XML schema namespace is used as the target namespace in the example XML schema?
question_14501.ground_truth: The target namespace used in the example XML schema is "urn:3gpp:ns:mcvideoPresInfoFA:1.0".

question_14502.question: What potential issue might arise when using signalling to indicate start and stop of mid-call announcement or tone?
question_14502.ground_truth: One potential issue is that providing information to start and stop an announcement or tone might cause delays due to signalling flow and variations in network load, leading to queuing of the messages involved. This, in turn, may impact the precision and alignment of the message timings in delivering mid-call announcements and tones.

question_14504.question: What action does the MCPTT server take when it receives an MCPTT imminent peril group call request?
question_14504.ground_truth: The MCPTT server adjusts the priority of the underlying bearer for all participants in the MCPTT group.

question_14506.question: What should the UE do if it is using EPS services with control plane CIoT EPS optimization, and the T3448 value in the SERVICE ACCEPT message is zero or deactivated?
question_14506.ground_truth: The UE should treat this case as an abnormal case and proceed as if the T3448 value is not present.

question_14507.question: What is the required confidence level for the rate of correct events observed during repeated tests for the UE behavior in each test during time durations T1, T2 and T3?
question_14507.ground_truth: The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_14508.question: What must the new 3G-SGSN do if it receives only emergency services from the old S4-SGSN and the UE is UICCless, making it impossible to include the IMSI in the MM and PDP contexts in SGSN Context Response message?
question_14508.ground_truth: The new 3G-SGSN shall mark the IMSI as unauthenticated if it cannot be authenticated for emergency attached UEs.

question_14509.question: What is the function of the Extended HS-SCCH ID IE in 1.28Mcps TDD?
question_14509.ground_truth: The Extended HS-SCCH ID LCR identifies unambiguously a HS-SCCH and its paired HS-SICH within the set of HS-SCCHs in a cell for 1.28Mcps TDD.

question_14510.question: What is the difference between push and pull ingest modes for file delivery in the MCData system?
question_14510.ground_truth: In push ingest mode, the MCData server pushes the file to the URL indicated by the BM-SC, while in pull ingest mode, the BM-SC pulls the file from the provided file URL.

question_14511.question: What are the conditions to pass the overall outcome of the test for event-triggered reporting with Event 1A and Event 1F?
question_14511.ground_truth: For the overall outcome of the test to be considered a pass, the counters for Event 1A shall independently indicate a pass result.

question_14512.question: What is the first step to remove the oldest entry in visitedPSCellInfoListReport in the visitedCellInfoList of the variable VarMobilityHistoryReport?
question_14512.ground_truth: The first step is to identify the oldest PCell entry in visitedCellInfoList including visitedPSCellInfoListReport.

question_14513.question: What is the goal of informing the network about the maximum latency requirement in the scenario described in section 4.2.2?
question_14513.ground_truth: The goal of informing the network about the maximum latency requirement is to minimize total power consumption in the device.

question_14514.question: What is the role of the 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay UE in the PDU session modification procedure for IPsec traffic between the 5G ProSe layer-3 remote UE and the N3IWF?
question_14514.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay UE is responsible for sending the packet filter provided in the PC5 QoS rules IE by the 5G ProSe layer-3 remote UE to the SMF when initiating the PDU session modification procedure.

question_14516.question: When do the power settings switch from T2 to T3 in the test procedure?
question_14516.ground_truth: The power settings switch from T2 to T3 at the start of T3, which is the instant when the last TTI containing the RRC message implying handover is sent to the UE.

question_14517.question: What action does the UE perform if it receives a UEInformationRequestSidelink message that includes the sl-E2E-QoS-ConnectionListPC5?
question_14517.ground_truth: If the UE receives a UEInformationRequestSidelink message that includes the sl-E2E-QoS-ConnectionListPC5, it performs QoS split based on the sl-QoS-InfoList for each QoS flow to decide the split PDB value for each PC5 hop and then sets the contents of the UEInformationResponseSidelink message accordingly.

question_14519.question: What should the UE do if the first CSI report for SCell is received by the SS in a subframe (m+8) and CSI report with non-zero CQI index is received earlier than or equal to subframe (m+24) for intra-band CA UE during SCell activation?
question_14519.ground_truth: If the first CSI report for SCell is received by the SS in a subframe (m+8) and CSI report with non-zero CQI index is received earlier than or equal to subframe (m+24) for intra-band CA UE during SCell activation, then the UE should send the next available uplink resource if there are no uplink resources for reporting the valid CSI in a subframe (m+24).

question_14521.question: How does the UPF distribute a broadcast packet when received from a UE via PDU Session associated with a 5G VN group?
question_14521.ground_truth: The UPF distributes the broadcast packet to all 5G VN group members (except the source UE) connected to this UPF via local switch and to all 5G VN group members connected to other UPFs via N19-based forwarding or N6-based forwarding, and the devices on the DN via N6-based forwarding.

question_14524.question: How are the inter-site distances defined for uncoordinated macro cellular deployment - B?
question_14524.ground_truth: In uncoordinated macro cellular deployment - B, different cell sizes are assumed for victim and aggressor systems, with the aggressor system having a bigger cell size than the victim system.

question_14526.question: What must the UE do when it receives CAG information for the Serving PLMN while roaming?
question_14526.ground_truth: The UE must update only the CAG information provided for the Serving PLMN and not update the stored CAG information for other PLMNs.

question_14528.question: Who is referred to as the Master Operator (MOP) in the context of network sharing?
question_14528.ground_truth: In the context of network sharing, the Master Operator (MOP) is the single actor responsible for the deployment and daily operation of shared network elements. They provide network and OAM&P services to other operators, called Participating Operators (POPs).

question_14530.question: What is the high-level user authentication and authorization procedure for VAL services?
question_14530.ground_truth: The user authentication process for VAL services involves the VAL user supplying user credentials for verification with the identity management server, the signalling user agent establishing a secure connection to the SIP core for SIP level authentication and registration, and the signalling user agent completing the SIP level registration with the SIP core.

question_14532.question: What is the expected number of TBs per TTI in case of downlink spatial multiplexing?
question_14532.ground_truth: One or two TBs are expected per TTI in case of downlink spatial multiplexing.

question_14533.question: Which standard method is defined in 6.3.3.3.3.2 to request the update of an existing "Individual Policy" resource at the NSCE Server?
question_14533.ground_truth: The HTTP PUT method is defined in 6.3.3.3.3.2 to request the update of an existing "Individual Policy" resource at the NSCE Server.

question_14535.question: What should a Mobile Station do if it fails to complete a periodic location updating procedure and the broadcast LAI is equal to the stored LAI?
question_14535.ground_truth: When the Mobile Station's attempt counter reaches the value 4, it should send a Location Updating Request message with the Mobile Identity IE set to its IMSI, CKSN IE set to "no key is available" and the Location Updating type set to "normal" after T3212 expiry.

question_14537.question: Which HTTP method allows to read all active LPI Parameters Provisionings for a given AF?
question_14537.ground_truth: The GET method allows to read all active LPI Parameters Provisioning resources for a given AF in the LpiParameterProvision API.

question_14538.question: What should the SS do if the UE has not re-selected Cell 1 within T3?

question_14540.question: What is the difference between On-network only communication, Off-network only communication, and Combined On-network and Off-network communication in the FRMCS environment?
question_14540.ground_truth: On-network only communication uses the bearer services that are provided by the FRMCS land mobile network, while Off-network only communication uses a dedicated radio bearer service for proximity communication. Combined On-network and Off-network communication encompasses the parallel use of the FRMCS land mobile network and the radio bearer service for proximity communication.

question_14544.question: What is the minimum performance requirement for the transmission of radio signals in the frequency band above 2 GHz?
question_14544.ground_truth: The minimum performance requirement for the transmission of radio signals in the frequency band above 2 GHz is 40 dB above the GSM 850/900 sensitivity level.

question_14545.question: What is the issue being addressed in Solution #25 regarding EEC authentication by the ECS/EES in 3GPP TS 33.558?
question_14545.ground_truth: The issue being addressed in Solution #25 is the lack of a common mutual authentication method supported by the UE, HN, SN, and ECS/EES for providing EDGE service to the UE.

question_14546.question: What is the benefit of applying a power offset to the F-DPCH transmitted by the non-serving LPN in HetNet deployments?
question_14546.ground_truth: The benefit of applying a power offset to the F-DPCH transmitted by the non-serving LPN in HetNet deployments is that it ensures reliable reception and improves the UL performance of HetNet.

question_14547.question: What is the number of tail bits used in the convolutional coding for the DBC-450 code with a swap value of 0?

question_14548.question: What should the MME do before the NAS uplink or downlink COUNT wraps around with the current security context?
question_14548.ground_truth: The MME should activate fresh NAS keys from an EPS AKA run or activate a native security context with sufficiently low NAS COUNT values.

question_14549.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) responsible for?
question_14549.ground_truth: The 3GPP is responsible for producing technical specifications for telecommunications, including the 3GPP charging functionality and charging management for GSM/UMTS networks.

question_14550.question: How long can a UE store a valid version of a SIB?
question_14550.ground_truth: A UE shall delete any stored version of a SIB after 3 hours from the moment it was successfully confirmed as valid.

question_14551.question: What should the S4-SGSN do when a Sn path failure is detected and the Sn path remains down for a duration longer than the maximum path failure duration?
question_14551.ground_truth: The S4-SGSN should behave as specified for the case of an MBMS GW restart, which enables to free corresponding radio resources in UTRAN for MBMS services if the MBMS GW has failed without restart.

question_14552.question: What animals in a game reserve are tagged or injected with sensors for monitoring?

question_14554.question: When is the application notified during the process of a call release?
question_14554.ground_truth: The application is notified when the release event has been requested to be reported in Notify mode.

question_14556.question: What is the limitation of Solution #2 for addressing the issue?
question_14556.ground_truth: The limitation of Solution #2 is that the CCA can be stolen or misused, and without the NFc requesting a service, the NRF could still provide access, or NFp could unknowingly provide a service to SCP.

question_14557.question: What should the user equipment (UE) do if the System Information (SI) request is based on the RRCSystemInfoRequest message and the RACH procedure fails?
question_14557.ground_truth: It is up to the UE implementation when to retry the SI request after a RACH failure.

question_14560.question: What should the mobile station do if the re-segment bit is not set, and it is time for retransmission?
question_14560.ground_truth: The mobile station shall use an MCS within the same family as the initial MCS without splitting the payload for retransmission.

question_14561.question: What is the purpose of temporary groups in the MC system?
question_14561.ground_truth: Temporary groups are created during the group regroup operation to combine at least two existing groups into one. The group management server creates and stores the information of the temporary group, including the temporary MC service group ID, off-network information, and the MC service IDs of the groups being combined, the priority level of the temporary group, and the security level of the temporary group.

question_14562.question: What needs to be enhanced to achieve the target MPL calculated from 1732m ISD in the Rural 700MHz FDD NLOS O2I scenario?
question_14562.ground_truth: PUSCH with SIP invite and PRACH format B4

question_14564.question: What is the role of the UE-to-UE Relay in the PC5 link security establishment procedure over Control Plane?
question_14564.ground_truth: The UE-to-UE Relay performs the same authorization and key establishment procedure over Control Plane as 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay and derives the PC5 session key (Krelay-SESS), confidentiality key (Krelay-enc) and integrity key (Krelay-int) based on PC5 policies. The UE-to-UE Relay sends a Direct Security mode command message to the source UE and stores the 5GPRUK ID in the security context associated to the PC5 link with the source UE after the successful verification of the Direct Security Mode complete message.

question_14565.question: What is the purpose of the Channel-Guide List in SFR?
question_14565.ground_truth: The Channel-Guide List in SFR is an initial list of syndicated feeds received with the ApplicationRegistrationResponse message.

question_14566.question: What should the UE do when the entering condition for Event A3 is satisfied?
question_14566.ground_truth: The UE should consider the SpCell for Mp, Ofp and Ocp and use the SpCell for the measurement, measurement object specific offset, and cell specific offset.

question_14567.question: What is the function of a Network Application Function (NAF) in the bootstrapping approach?
question_14567.ground_truth: After the bootstrapping is completed, the UE and a NAF can run an application-specific protocol, where the authentication of messages will be based on the session keys generated during the mutual authentication between UE and BSF.

question_14568.question: What is the effect of increasing the modulation order to 32QAM or 64QAM on receiver complexity?
question_14568.ground_truth: Increasing the modulation order to 32QAM or 64QAM is likely to result in an increase in receiver complexity, requiring new hardware for both base stations and mobile stations.

question_14570.question: What is the purpose of the BEGIN record in the HI2 protocol?
question_14570.ground_truth: The BEGIN record in the HI2 protocol is used to convey the first event of packet-data communication interception.

question_14571.question: How can channel spacing be adjusted in an LTE-Advanced deployment scenario?
question_14571.ground_truth: The channel spacing can be adjusted to optimize performance in a particular deployment scenario. This includes the possibility to reduce the channel spacing in order to support specific spectrum assignments.

question_14572.question: What is the purpose of the AI-ML systems in the emergency response to a disabled vehicle use-case?
question_14572.ground_truth: The AI-ML systems in this use-case are used to diagnose a mechanical failure in a vehicle, notify surrounding networks of the severity of the failure, and refine prediction and prevention models using the gathered failure training data.

question_14573.question: What should a mobile station report to the network if it does not support any frequency band requested by the network?
question_14573.ground_truth: The mobile station should report its radio access capabilities for the BCCH frequency band.

question_14575.question: What element in the 'forward-to' action specifies the address of the forwarding rule?
question_14575.ground_truth: The 'target' element specifies the address of the forwarding rule.

question_14576.question: What should an MS do when it receives a ROUTING AREA UPDATE REJECT with cause "PLMN not allowed" in 3GPP TS 24.008?
question_14576.ground_truth: The MS shall store the PLMN identity in the "forbidden PLMN list" when it receives a ROUTING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with the cause "PLMN not allowed".

question_14579.question: What is the requirement for the number of times the MS can transmit no more than in step n)?
question_14579.ground_truth: The MS shall transmit no more than 25 times in step n) for both GMSK modulation and 8-PSK modulation.

question_14581.question: What type of interface is specified in Release 17 of the 3GPP Technical Specification for the interconnection of Node B and RNC components in UTRAN?
question_14581.ground_truth: The Iub interface is a logical interface

question_14583.question: What is the initial state of the UE before the test procedure sequence?
question_14583.ground_truth: The UE is in Automatic PLMN selection mode, registered to NR Cell 1, and then Switched OFF (State 0N-B).

question_14585.question: What is the role of BSF in the authentication process between EEC hosted in a roaming UE and EES?
question_14585.ground_truth: BSF derives the K~EEs based on the B-TID, NAF ID of the EES, and key indicator, and sends it to the Zn-Proxy or directly to the EES if connected to the home network of UE/ECS.

question_14587.question: What records should be reported from DF2 to the LEMF when SMS is used in conjunction with GPRS or UMTS for separate delivery?
question_14587.ground_truth: SMS MO and SMS MT Communication REPORT Records, HLR Related REPORT Records (Serving System REPORT Record, Cancel location REPORT Record, Register location REPORT Record, and Location information request REPORT Record) should be reported from DF2 to the LEMF when SMS is used in conjunction with GPRS or UMTS for separate delivery.

question_14588.question: What information does the application client in the UE provide to the ProSe Application Server when requesting its own PDUID?
question_14588.ground_truth: The application client in the UE provides its own PDUID to the ProSe Application Server when requesting an RPAUID.

question_14589.question: What are the three main organizations involved in sub-use case 2 for network slice exposure?
question_14589.ground_truth: The three main organizations involved are Company-V (Network Slice Customer), Company-A (Network Slice Provider and Network Operator), and Company-X and Company-Y (Communication Service Providers).

question_14590.question: What does the ME do when it receives a secured packet from the network with the integrity check successful?
question_14590.ground_truth: The ME passes the packet transparently to the UICC using the ENVELOPE (SMS-PP DOWNLOAD) command.

question_14591.question: What triggers the release of all PDU sessions associated with an S-NSSAI in the current Allowed NSSAI?
question_14591.ground_truth: The revocation of authorization for an S-NSSAI in the current Allowed NSSAI triggers the release of all PDU sessions associated with that S-NSSAI for the Access Type.

question_14592.question: What should the MCPTT client do upon receipt of an initial SIP INVITE request for an MCPTT emergency group call?
question_14592.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should display to the MCPTT user an indication that this is a SIP INVITE request for an MCPTT emergency group call and display the relevant information. The MCPTT client should also set the MCPTT emergency group state to "MEG 2: in-progress".

question_14593.question: What must the TF in the SMF use to retrieve LI state information from the LISSF?
question_14593.ground_truth: The TF in the SMF must use the LISSF to retrieve LI state information when it is provisioned with a specific XID and access to an LISSF function.

question_14594.question: How is the wanted signal and interferer power level specified for FR2 in the NR BS for the EMC purposes?
question_14594.ground_truth: The wanted signal and interferer power level for FR2 are specified based on the declared sensitivity EISREFSENS50M, which is based on a 50 MHz channel bandwidth. The values are calculated by taking into account the bandwidth and signal-to-noise ratio of the signal, and the interference margin for the interferer.

question_14595.question: What exception procedures should the originating AS follow when it receives a 480 (Temporarily Unavailable) response or a 403 (Forbidden) response to an outstanding CC request?
question_14595.ground_truth: The originating AS should stop the CC request timer CC-T2 and confirm to the caller that the invocation was not successful using announcement procedures.

question_14596.question: What message is sent by the UE or by the network at any time to report certain error conditions?

question_14597.question: What message does the Source gNB (SN) send to the Master gNB (MN) when a secondary RAT data usage report is required for released E-RABs?
question_14597.ground_truth: The Secondary RAT Data Usage Report message

question_14598.question: What action should the UE take after receiving a REGISTER message containing a Facility IE with a LCS Location Notification Invoke message set to notifyAndVerify-LocationAllowedIfNoResponse?
question_14598.ground_truth: The UE should notify the user of the request and indicate that the default response is location allowed if no response and provide the opportunity to accept or deny the request. The UE should then send a RELEASE COMPLETE message containing a LocationNotification return result with verificationResponse set to permissionDenied or permissionGranted as appropriate.

question_14601.question: What action does the NSCE Server take upon a successful Policy(ies) deletion?
