question_15990.ground_truth: The client can use the information to optimize its own quality, and act fairly by only requesting higher bit rates when the content is more complex.

question_15991.question: What is the use of the "Ending Suffix Code" parameter in relation to the "ProSe Application Code Suffix Range"?
question_15991.ground_truth: The "Ending Suffix Code" parameter has the same length as the "Beginning Suffix Code" parameter in the "ProSe Application Code Suffix Range". If there is only one ProSe Application Code Suffix, then the "Beginning Suffix Code" represents that single suffix and the "Ending Suffix Code" is omitted.

question_15992.question: Under what circumstances is the provision of MCVideo media to authorized MC user A real-time or on-demand in 4.4.2 Scenario 3.2 and 4.5.2 Scenario 4.2 for discreet listening in MCVideo pulls and pushes?
question_15992.ground_truth: The provision of MCVideo media to authorized MC user A may be in real-time or on-demand with intermediate storage in the MCVideo server.

question_15993.question: When must the UE send a NAS Security Mode Complete message?
question_15993.ground_truth: The UE shall send the NAS Security Mode Complete message to the network in response to a NAS Security Mode Command message. The NAS Security Mode Complete message shall include the complete initial NAS message in a NAS Container if either requested by the AMF or the UE sent the initial NAS message unprotected.

question_15994.question: What must be done when sending a REFER request to remove a conference participant from a conference as a removing conference participant?
question_15994.ground_truth: The removing conference participant must set the request URI of the REFER request to the conference URI of the conference from which the conference participant shall be removed and set the Refer-To header of the REFER request to the address of the conference participant who should be removed from the conference.

question_15995.question: What is the purpose of the repeater out of band gain document?
question_15995.ground_truth: The repeater out of band gain document derives the requirements for the repeater out of band gain and provides planning guidelines when a repeater is in close proximity to other communication systems.

question_15996.question: What should the AMF do to support session binding based on MAC address and VLAN ID in the 5G system?
question_15996.ground_truth: The AMF must forward the relevant indications between RAN and SMF to support session binding based on MAC address and VLAN ID.

question_15998.question: What is the purpose of sending an XID response with an N201-I value out of range?
question_15998.ground_truth: The purpose is to test the MS response to an XID response with the N201-I value out of range and verify if it ignores the response and retransmits the SABM with the XID command.

question_15999.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 7.1.3.3?
question_15999.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in section 7.1.3.3 is to ensure that TRSavrage and TRSmax of the UE is above specified limit. The lack of the reception sensitivity decreases the coverage area at the far side from Node B.

question_16001.question: What message are the network and MS expected to exchange after the MS sends the CLASSMARK CHANGE message?
question_16001.ground_truth: The MS shall acknowledge the SETUP message with a CALL CONFIRMED message, if compatibility checking was successful, the MS is not busy, and the user does not refuse the call.

question_16004.question: What is the required message that the MCPTT client sends to accept the establishment of the media plane for setting up a private call?
question_16004.ground_truth: A media plane control Acknowledgement message accepting the establishment of the media plane.

question_16005.question: What is the role of S1-U in the CIoT-RAN?
question_16005.ground_truth: S1-U is not needed in the CIoT-RAN as user plane data is carried in S1-AP.

question_16006.question: What is the new Application Id for the STa application when using the MAG to AAA interface defined in IETF RFC 5779 and the NAS to AAA interface defined in IETF RFC 5447?

question_16007.question: What is the condition for triggering 5G-RG to establish the PDU session for IPTV service?
question_16007.ground_truth: The condition to trigger the 5G-RG to establish the PDU Session for IPTV service is implementation specific, such as when the STB is switched on.

question_16008.question: What is the overall algorithmic round-trip delay for the AMR-WB codec in application B?
question_16008.ground_truth: The overall algorithmic round-trip delay is lower for application B than for application A.

question_16010.question: What is the percentage increase in capacity performance for FR1, Dense Urban, DL, with 100MHz bandwidth for VR/AR single-stream traffic model, 45Mbps, 10ms PDB, 60 FPS, with SU-MIMO and 64TxRU, when the offset across UEs is changed from zero to random?
question_16010.ground_truth: There is a 31.11% increase in capacity performance.

question_16011.question: What message does the AMF send to the NG-RAN node to request the start or stop of reporting RAN timing synchronization status information?

question_16012.question: What happens to gaps with lower priority when there is a collision between two gaps with different priorities?
question_16012.ground_truth: The gaps with lower priority will be dropped.

question_16013.question: What is the formula for estimating communication service availability?
question_16013.ground_truth: Communication service availability can be estimated as the MTBF, or Mean Time Between Failures, divided by the sum of the MTBF and the MTTR, or Mean Time To Repair.

question_16015.question: What should the MSGin5G Server include in the CoAP payload as it sends a message response in a new CoAP POST request to the originating entity?
question_16015.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server shall include the originating MSGin5G Client's address, the "MSGin5G service identifier", the "Originating UE Service ID", "Message ID", "Delivery Status", "Failure Cause" (if applicable), and a "Message Type" set to "MSGRESP" in the CoAP payload.

question_16017.question: What interfaces are used for the MCVideo-6 reference point between the MCVideo server and the EPS?
question_16017.ground_truth: The MB2-C interface, as defined in 3GPP~TS~29.468, is used for the MCVideo-6 reference point between the MCVideo server and the EPS.

question_16018.question: What is the distribution of vehicle types in Option A of the highway scenario?
question_16018.ground_truth: The distribution of vehicle types in Option A of the highway scenario is 100% vehicle type 2.

question_16021.question: What information is provided in the getFullMessageRes() method?
question_16021.ground_truth: The getFullMessageRes() method delivers the entire message, including headers and body, in unstructured format.

question_16022.question: What is the purpose of service authorization information in scheduled resource allocation mode for Ranging/SL Positioning?
question_16022.ground_truth: The purpose of service authorization information in scheduled resource allocation mode for Ranging/SL Positioning is to be provisioned to NG-RAN for the support of Ranging/SL Positioning.

question_16023.question: What Technical Specifications are included in the analysis for resource control in the 5GS context?

question_16024.question: What are the cells' roles in section 11.6.1.1.4.1?
question_16024.ground_truth: In section 11.6.1.1.4.1, Cell 1 is the PCell, and Cell 2 is the target cell.

question_16027.question: What should a mobile station do if it has not sent the first block within the time equal to the timer T3164?
question_16027.ground_truth: The mobile station shall reinitiate the packet access procedure, and this procedure shall at most be reinitiated 3 times.

question_16028.question: What is the minimum time difference between the first measurement and the last measurement used for filtering in the 1.28 Mcps TDD option of the cell re-selection procedure?
question_16028.ground_truth: The UE shall filter the PCCPCH RSCP level of the serving cell using at least 2 measurements, which are taken so that the time difference between the first measurement and the last measurement used for filtering is at least TmeasureNTDD/2.

question_16029.question: What is the maximum Doppler shift rates during the field test for LEO at the altitude of 600 km in NR network?
question_16029.ground_truth: The maximum Doppler variation rates during the field tests appeared in the scenarios of LEO at the altitude of 600 km are -544 Hz/s with carrier frequency of 2 GHz, -5.44 kHz/s with carrier frequency of 20 GHz and -8.16 kHz/s with carrier frequency of 30 GHz.

question_16030.question: What is the OTA RX spurious emissions requirement for RX only multi-band RIB in each supported operating band?
question_16030.ground_truth: The OTA RX spurious emissions requirements for RX only multi-band RIB in each supported operating band are subject to exclusion zones.

question_16031.question: When does data forwarding from the last serving SN take place in the SN Modification procedure?
question_16031.ground_truth: Data forwarding from the last serving SN takes place as early as the last serving SN receives the early data forwarding address in step 17.

question_16032.question: What action does the system simulator SS-UE1 perform as a ProSe Direct Communication transmitting and receiving device?
question_16032.ground_truth: The system simulator SS-UE1 performs as a ProSe Direct Communication transmitting and receiving device, for the underlying "transport bearer" over which the SS and the UE will communicate, as defined in TS 36.508.

question_16033.question: What does the Interface specification clause of each of the Call Control SCFs describe?
question_16033.ground_truth: The Interface specification clause of each of the Call Control SCFs describes in detail each of the interfaces shown within the Class diagram part, including their properties, methods, and the interactions between them.

question_16035.question: Who is the test applicability in 6.2E.1.1.2 and 6.2E.1.3.1.2?
question_16035.ground_truth: The test applicability in 6.2E.1.1.2 is for NR V2X operation or E-UTRA V2X operation, and the test applicability in 6.2E.1.3.1.2 is for all types of E-UTRA UE release 16 and forward supporting concurrent operation between E-UTRA Uu and NR sidelink.

question_16038.question: What does the ' reporting' parameter represent in the 10.1.80 DNS server address reporting command?
question_16038.ground_truth: The ' reporting' parameter in the 10.1.80 DNS server address reporting command enables or disables reporting of DNS server addresses received from the network.

question_16040.question: What procedure is used by the MME to establish a NAS security association between the UE and MME in order to protect further NAS signalling messages or make changes in the security association?
question_16040.ground_truth: The NAS Security Mode Command (SMC) procedure.

question_16041.question: What does the phrase "TSG Approved Document under change control" in the first digit of version number refer to?
question_16041.ground_truth: It refers to a document that has been approved by the Technical Specification Group (TSG) and is now under change control, meaning any modifications must follow a formal process.

question_16042.question: What is the definition of "Inter-band Carrier Aggregation" given in the document?
question_16042.ground_truth: Inter-band Carrier Aggregation is defined as the Carrier Aggregation of component carriers in different operating bands.

question_16043.question: What message does the network use to initiate downlink data transfer to an MS in the Ready state?
question_16043.ground_truth: The network uses a packet downlink assignment message to initiate downlink data transfer to an MS in the Ready state.

question_16045.question: What are the two parts of the input codevector decomposition in the indexing of codevector in base codebook?
question_16045.ground_truth: The two parts are the sign vector (s0) and the absolute vector (y0).

question_16046.question: What should be the minimum number of successful tests for the RRC connection release with redirection to GERAN to pass the test?
question_16046.ground_truth: The minimum number of successful tests for the RRC connection release with redirection to GERAN to pass the test is more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

question_16048.question: What is the effect on access attempt if barring is indicated for a specific access category by the NAS?
question_16048.ground_truth: The NAS shall not initiate the procedure to send the initial NAS message for the access attempt, and if the UE is operating in the single-registration mode, it may attempt to select an E-UTRA cell connected to EPC.

question_16049.question: What is the role of the PEGC in Personal IoT Networks in 5GS?
question_16049.ground_truth: The PEGC supports the relay path between PINE and 5GS, the traffic relay between PINEs, PIN discovery and status report, access control and traffic enforcement, triggering the activation of communication path with the PINE for DL traffic, and traffic routing for non-PIN capable devices.

question_16050.question: What is the role of ICCF when the ICS UE has no ISIM but USIM and performs registration via PS access?
question_16050.ground_truth: ICCF provides SIP UA behavior on behalf of the UE towards IMS and controls all subsequent session setup and mid-call services. During mid-call service Hold, RTCP packets should be sent continuously as "remote end-point aliveness information" to the held remote end. Meanwhile, if UE originates a new session towards another remote end, a new media path would be needed from the UE to the new remote end.

question_16051.question: In Solution #23, what must a UE do if it determines that Disaster Condition applies for PLMN D and PLMN A can accept Disaster Inbound Roamers from PLMN D?
question_16051.ground_truth: In Solution #23, if a UE determines that Disaster Condition applies for PLMN D and PLMN A can accept Disaster Inbound Roamers from PLMN D, then the UE shall consider PLMN A as an allowable PLMN in automatic PLMN selection with the lowest priority, if PLMN D is UE's HPLMN or is not in UE's list of forbidden PLMNs, and if PLMN A is in UE's list of forbidden PLMNs.

question_16052.question: What is the role of the SCEF in the negotiation for future background data transfer procedure?
question_16052.ground_truth: Based on the SCS/AS request, the SCEF sends the BTR command to the PCRF including the required information, and once the PCRF receives the BTR command, the PCRF retrieves all existing transfer policies and determines one or more transfer policies based on the information received from the SCEF and other available information, and responds with a BTA command including the possible transfer policies.

question_16053.question: What is the responsibility of the Core Functions in the Media Session Handler of a UE in the 5G System?
question_16053.ground_truth: The Core Functions are responsible for realizing a "session" concept for media communications, optionally spanning multiple stateless sessions. It may also interact with network-based 5GMSd AFs.

question_16055.question: What does the K value of 15 mean in the GANSS Data Bit Interval field?
question_16055.ground_truth: The time interval is not specified.

question_16057.question: What is the output of the FFT that provides the real and the imaginary parts of the spectrum denoted as, and, respectively, in the spectral analysis process?
question_16057.ground_truth: The output of the FFT that provides the real and the imaginary parts of the spectrum denoted as, and, respectively, corresponds to the spectrum at 0 Hz (DC) and corresponds to the spectrum at 6400 Hz.

question_16059.question: What is the purpose of a "blind" transmission in the PS handover execution phase?
question_16059.ground_truth: The "blind" transmission is used for lossy type of services where unacknowledged LLC and RLC protocol modes are used. It is used for forwarding packets on the DL, but no acknowledgment is required for these packets.

question_16060.question: What does the value 1 mean in the field "S/U" in the contention-free Random Access Resources?
question_16060.ground_truth: If the value of the field "S/U" is set to 1, it means that SUL (Secondary Universal) is used for PRACH (Physical Random Access Channel) transmission.

question_16061.question: What is the broadcast delivery status reported via the "broadcastDelStatus" attribute in the MbsSessionEventReport data structure?
question_16061.ground_truth: The broadcast delivery status, encoded via the "broadcastDelStatus" attribute in the MbsSessionEventReport data structure, indicates whether the MBS session is STARTED or TERMINATED.

question_16062.question: What is the procedure for providing RAN additional information about all QoS flows to be considered for joint admission?
question_16062.ground_truth: AF requests all service flows from the 5GS together in a single request or a batch of correlated requests with a batch correlation ID, and 5GS handles and admits them one by one.

question_16063.question: What is the role of a V2X UE in Solution #13 for V2X group communication over ProSe?
question_16063.ground_truth: An authorized V2X UE broadcasts the available ProSe Layer-2 Group ID(s) being used for platooning and the related destination information via PC5. The vehicles who are authorized to use the V2X platooning service can interpret the message and determine the appropriate ProSe Layer2 Group ID based upon the platooning information broadcasted.

question_16064.question: What is the percentage of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channel that the throughput measured shall be greater than or equal to, for high speed train in clause 8.2.5.5?
question_16064.ground_truth: The throughput measured shall be greater than or equal to 70% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channel.

question_16065.question: What action does the MME take after receiving a Reject Paging Indication from the UE?
question_16065.ground_truth: The MME uses the Downlink Data Notification Failure Indication message to notify the Serving GW that the UE rejected the page and no user plane radio bearers will be established.

question_16066.question: What actions should the network take in case of a de-registration procedure collision?
question_16066.ground_truth: If the network receives a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST with "switch off" indication, the network shall consider both procedures completed if the access types are the same, or re-initiate the de-registration procedure for the access type not indicated if they are different. If the network receives a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message without "switch off" indication, the network shall send a DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT message to the UE.

question_16068.question: What potential threats face virtualized 3GPP NFs in a MANO system, and what security requirements could address these threats?
question_16068.ground_truth: Without appropriate protection, virtualized 3GPP NFs could be compromised, data within virtualized 3GPP NFs could be eavesdropped or tampered, and incorrect management information could be supplied by a compromised MANO system. Increasing assurance that virtualized 3GPP NFs are protected from being attacked via a compromised MANO system, providing isolation and redundancy, and conducting internal health checks are requirements to address these threats.

question_16071.question: What does the qoe-Streaming-MeasReport-r17 ENUMERATED indicate in the AppLayerMeasParameters-r17 SEQUENCE?
question_16071.ground_truth: The qoe-Streaming-MeasReport-r17 ENUMERATED indicates whether a UE is capable of supporting Streaming measurement report-r17 in RAN.

question_16073.question: What is the role of the M3 interface in E-UTRAN?
question_16073.ground_truth: The M3 interface is a logical interface between the MCE and the MME in E-UTRAN, used for transporting M3-AP signalling messages.

question_16074.question: What is a new requirement needed to support the use case described in PR. 5.3.6-002?
question_16074.ground_truth: The 5G system shall be able to indicate to the evolved residential gateway that a specific UE connected to it either via 3GPP RAT or non-3GPP (R)AT needs specific QoS and what the required QoS characteristics are.

question_16075.question: What entity is responsible for enforcing traffic in the PDN GW when the PCRF does not apply?
question_16075.ground_truth: The PDN GW enforces the traffic per the Packet Filtering Information, if any, when the PCRF does not apply.

question_16077.question: When is the network sending AoC information to the end-user in the call sequence described?
question_16077.ground_truth: The network sends AoC information to the end-user at the tariff switch time.

question_16078.question: When is the measurement time for a single PRS positioning occasion in E-UTRAN FDD intra-frequency RSTD measurements?
question_16078.ground_truth: It is ms, where the PRS measurement time for a single PRS positioning occasion includes the sampling time and the processing time.

question_16079.question: What MIME body format should the MCVideo client include in the SIP MESSAGE request when sending a MCVideo affiliation command?
question_16079.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-affiliation-command+xml MIME body as specified in Annex F.4.

question_16080.question: What is the responsibility of the PCEF when the UE modifies or releases resources that were originally allocated based on UE-initiated resource allocation after handover?
question_16080.ground_truth: The UE's determination of QoS resources in the target access allocated to pre-existing IP flows is facilitated by the access system providing packet filters with the same content as that in the SDF template filters received over the Gx/Gxx interface.

question_16082.question: Which entity is informed by the NEF upon receiving an indication from the Slice-AAA for revoking a slice authorization?
question_16082.ground_truth: The SMF(s) serving the slice, and the PDU session(s) corresponding to that slice.

question_16084.question: What event triggers the mobile terminated speech call in this test?
question_16084.ground_truth: The MS is paged on Cell A and responds to the PAGING REQUEST message.

question_16085.question: What is the purpose of the Inhibition Of Call Waiting Indication (IOCWI) mechanism in an SCF-SCF relationship?
question_16085.ground_truth: The Inhibition Of Call Waiting Indication (IOCWI) mechanism in an SCF-SCF relationship allows a service logic to prevent the activation of the switch-based call waiting service.

question_16086.question: What is the ABC feature in the context of MBMS?
question_16086.ground_truth: The ABC feature, "Alternative-Broadcast-Content", is a term used for a specific operation in Demand feature that allows certain content to be turned into an MBMS User Service for efficient network resource usage.

question_16087.question: Which ASN.1 module is being imported into the F1AP-PDU-Descriptions module?
question_16087.ground_truth: F1AP-CommonDataTypes, F1AP-PDU-Contents, and F1AP-Constants modules are being imported into the F1AP-PDU-Descriptions module as they contain important parameter types, messages, and constants required for defining and using procedures.

question_16088.question: What does the "associationThreshold" attribute determine in the "GeoAreaToCellMapping" data type?
question_16088.ground_truth: The "associationThreshold" attribute determines the lower boundary of the coverage ratio for mapping a geographical area to cells.

question_16089.question: What information is included in the measurements of Logged MDT?
question_16089.ground_truth: The measurements of Logged MDT include multiple events and measurements taken over time, linked to available location information and/or other information or measurements that can be used to derive location information, and linked to a time stamp.

question_16090.question: What is the primary method for the UE to communicate with the GO (Group Administrator's device) in the ProSe Group Communication?
question_16090.ground_truth: In ProSe Group Communication, the UE shall attempt to communicate with the GO first, using the ProSe Group Communication, regardless of network coverage.

question_16091.question: What should the MAC entity do if the sPBR of a logical channel is set to infinity?
question_16091.ground_truth: If the sPBR of a logical channel is set to infinity, the MAC entity should allocate resources for all the data that is available for transmission on the logical channel before meeting the sPBR of the lower priority logical channel(s).

question_16092.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon receiving a SIP INFO request containing a release-reason?
question_16092.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should not provide any indication that an ambient viewing call is being terminated if the cached ambient viewing client role is equal to "viewed-to MCVideo user". If the cached ambient viewing client role is equal to "viewing MCVideo user", it should provide an indication to the MCVideo user that an ambient viewing call is being terminated. It should also generate and send a SIP 200 OK response to the SIP INFO request and comply with the procedures of clause~15.2.2.5.

question_16093.question: What is the requirement for the 3GPP system to support efficient and secure information gathering for V2X applications to adjust their service offering?

question_16095.question: What is the step size for the synchronization raster in the frequency range between 39.5-43.5 GHz?
question_16095.ground_truth: The step size for the synchronization raster in the frequency range between 39.5-43.5 GHz is 17.28 MHz.

question_16097.question: What keys and key identifiers are associated with the on-network group call and are used to derive SRTP-MK, SRTP-MS, and SRTP-MKI for encrypting and decrypting media in SRTP?

question_16098.question: What should the UE do if the maximum number of preamble transmission counter has been reached for the random access procedure on PCell or PSCell?
question_16098.ground_truth: The UE should indicate a random access problem to upper layers if the maximum number of preamble transmission counter has been reached for the random access procedure on PCell or PSCell.

question_16100.question: What should the UE do upon the expiry of the periodical reporting timer for a measId with reportType set to reportSFTD?
question_16100.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the measurement reporting procedure for this measId as specified in 5.5.5.

question_16102.question: What should the UE read to determine the redundancy version for the physical uplink shared channel?
question_16102.ground_truth: The UE should read the redundancy version field (rv) in the DCI to determine the redundancy version for the physical uplink shared channel.

question_16103.question: What is the required BS ACLRadj-1 for NB-CIoT when the downlink %5-ile throughput reduction is around 40 dB?
question_16103.ground_truth: The minimum required BS ACLR adj-1 for NB-CIoT at less than 5% (i.e. around 4.9%) downlink %5-ile throughput reduction is around 40 dB.

question_16104.question: What is one of the 5G system's capabilities regarding user privacy?
question_16104.ground_truth: The 5G system can maintain privacy of a user against the hosting network while the UE does not make use of the hosting network. For example, to prevent tracking of UEs by hosting networks.

question_16106.question: What is the correct format for addressing URIs for Parlay X Web Services, and how are aliases supported?
question_16106.ground_truth: URIs for Parlay X Web Services should conform to the URI definition provided in RFC 3966 for 'tel:' addresses or RFC 3261 for 'sip:' addresses. Shortcodes are differentiated by using the 'short:' URI scheme. Aliases in addresses are supported by use of the URI RFC 3986, allowing arbitrary data to be submitted to the Parlay X Service interface. An example of this could be 'uri scheme<generic syntax>', where an alias is a relatively short character string that holds a scrambled address.

question_16108.question: Who is the intended device for the applicability of the test described in section 9.1.42.1.2 of the document?
question_16108.ground_truth: The applicability of the test described in section 9.1.42.1.2 of the document is for all types of E-UTRA HD-FDD operation Category 0 UE from release 12 and forward.

question_16112.question: How much time does the MS have to transmit the CIPHERING MODE COMPLETE message after the last timeslot of the message block containing the CIPHERING MODE COMMAND message occurs?
question_16112.ground_truth: The MS should transmit the CIPHERING MODE COMPLETE message before T+500 ms.

question_16113.question: What is the role of the network and access networks in LCS?
question_16113.ground_truth: The network sends location requests to the access network, which then sends the corresponding responses back to the core network. Communication between access and core networks is accomplished through Iu interface in UMTS, A, Gb and Iu interfaces in GSM, and S1 interface in E-UTRAN.

question_16115.question: What is the physical cell identity setting during time period T2, within the loop of the test procedure?
question_16115.ground_truth: The physical cell identity of Cell 2 is changed to ensure Cell 2 is not detected by the UE.

question_16116.question: What is the name of the protocol used in interception at the ePDG and PDN-GW when based on IMSI in case of GTPv2 based protocol?

question_16119.question: How does the choice of options in Option 1-1 for the DB-DC HSDPA scenario impact code allocation and capacity?
question_16119.ground_truth: Option 1-1 leads to different code allocation and capacity impacts depending on the implementation choice for improving the reliability of high frequency carrier HS-SCCHs.

question_16122.question: What is the procedure when a radio link failure is detected by the MS in group transmit mode?
question_16122.ground_truth: The MS shall return to idle mode and, when possible, to group receive mode.

question_16124.question: What does MCPTT client 2 need to initiate a private call with MCPTT client 3, if end-to-end encryption is required?
question_16124.ground_truth: MCPTT client 2 needs the necessary security information to initiate a private call with MCPTT client 3 if end-to-end encryption is required.

question_16126.question: What should be performed when there is a user alerting with no answer for the connection demand (C-B)?
question_16126.ground_truth: The demand should be disconnected after the timer expires.

question_16127.question: What will be provided by the NWDAF to the 5GC for supporting customizing mobility management based on NWDAF output?
question_16127.ground_truth: NWDAF shall provide UE mobility related analytical report based on analysis on historical UE location, UE mobility behaviors, and other necessary information. The 5GC can customize mobility management for UEs using the NWDAF analytical results by using areas such as registration area allocation, paging handling, mobility restriction area handling, NAS signalling connection management, periodic registration timer handling, handover decisions, overload avoidance, and RFSP index change.

question_16129.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification in the document?
question_16129.ground_truth: The purpose of the 3GPP in the document is to define procedures to limit the effects of failure of a location register and to restore the location register data automatically in mobile communication networks.

question_16130.question: What is the expected sequence number for the SEND SHORT MESSAGE test with foreground and background color text attribute?

question_16131.question: What is the purpose of the IWF performing the broadcast group call procedure as specified in subclause~10.3.4?
question_16131.ground_truth: The IWF performs the broadcast group call procedure to initiate a group call involving multiple parties.

question_16132.question: What functionalities does the Watcher Presence Proxy provide?
question_16132.ground_truth: The Watcher Presence Proxy provides functionality for address resolution and identification of target networks, authentication of watchers, interworking between presence protocols for watcher requests, and generation of accounting information for watcher requests.

question_16133.question: What is one impact on MME in Solution 1 to Idle Mode DRX Open Issue #3?
question_16133.ground_truth: One impact on MME in Solution 1 to Idle Mode DRX Open Issue #3 is identifying that UE is using a long DRX value and deciding to declare UE unreachable towards SMS infrastructure, even when proceeding with paging procedure.

question_16134.question: What attribute must be set to a unique string in the "d" element?
question_16134.ground_truth: The "id" attribute of the "d" element must be set to a unique string.

question_16135.question: What must the SMF provide within the "servingNetwork" attribute when requested by the PCF?
question_16135.ground_truth: The SMF shall provide the serving PLMN Identifier or the SNPN Identifier (the PLMN Identifier and the NID) within the "servingNetwork" attribute.

question_16136.question: What must the NF service consumer include in the service request when using indirect communication with delegated discovery?
question_16136.ground_truth: The NF service consumer must include discovery and selection parameters necessary to discover and select a NF service producer.

question_16139.question: What is the purpose of the tests in 9.2.1GA and 9.2.1GB?
question_16139.ground_truth: The purpose of the tests in 9.2.1GA and 9.2.1GB is to verify the ability of the receiver to receive a predefined test signal, representing a multi-path fading channel with information bit throughput R not falling below a specified value.

question_16140.question: What are some of the issues that may arise with emergency calls in extraterritorial areas, such as at sea or in international waters?
question_16140.ground_truth: One issue is routing emergency calls to the correct Public Safety Answering Point (PSAP), which may be difficult if it is not clear which legal jurisdiction the UE is located in. Another issue is determining which emergency call numbers should be supported in extraterritorial areas, as different countries and regions may use different numbers for similar types of emergency calls. Satellite operators may need to take the location of the UE into account to determine which emergency call numbers apply in a given situation.

question_16143.question: What is the function of the one step interleaving architecture in 3GPP TS 45.005?
question_16143.ground_truth: The one step interleaving architecture in 3GPP TS 45.005 ensures that all TrCHs on one basic physical subchannel have the same interleaving depth.

question_16145.question: What are the conditions for the entering and leaving of event B1-1 and B1-2 as specified in clause 5.5.4.7 of the document?
question_16145.ground_truth: The entering condition for event B1-1 is satisfied when B1-1 inequality is fulfilled, and the leaving condition for event B1-2 is satisfied when B1-2 inequality is fulfilled.

question_16146.question: What network component stops the running Service Gap timer when a UE moves from EPC to 5GC?
question_16146.ground_truth: The MME stops the running Service Gap timer when a UE moves from EPC to 5GC.

question_16147.question: What actions can the CSE instruct the VPLMN/IPLMN network to perform in the called party connection procedure?
question_16147.ground_truth: The CSE can instruct the VPLMN/IPLMN network to perform charging activities, activate subsequent control service events for the call, or order in-band user interaction in the called party connection procedure.

question_16148.question: What is the LTMCells-ToBeReleased-Item::= SEQUENCE sequence used for?
question_16148.ground_truth: The LTMCells-ToBeReleased-Item::= SEQUENCE sequence is used to release an LTE cell from the LTE network. It specifies the NRCGI (Network Cell Global Identifier) of the cell to be released and any additional information (iE-Extensions) that may be required.

question_16149.question: What does the "Slice Support List" IE indicate?
question_16149.ground_truth: The "Slice Support List" IE indicates the list of supported slices.

question_16150.question: What is the identified risk in section 5.2.7.1 for incorrect CS/PS coordination due to operators being selected independently in source RAN and target BSS/RNC?
question_16150.ground_truth: In section 5.2.7.1, there is a risk for incorrect CS/PS coordination as operators are selected independently in source RAN in step 1a and target BSS in step 3b. However, there are no identified risks for incorrect CS/PS coordination in section 5.2.8.2 and 5.2.9.2, as no such risks are mentioned for these use cases.

question_16151.question: How much should the input levels be corrected for DCS 1800 class 1 or 2 MS?
question_16151.ground_truth: The input levels should be corrected by +2/+4 dB for DCS 1800 class 1 or 2 MS.

question_16152.question: What is the core keystream generator function used for in these algorithms?
question_16152.ground_truth: The core keystream generator function KGCORE is used to define each of the three algorithms in terms of this core function.

question_16153.question: What should the 2G+3G-SGSN do when it receives a Routeing Area Update Request message with an Update Type indicating a combined RA / LA update with IMSI attach requested?
question_16153.ground_truth: The 2G+3G-SGSN sends a Location Update Request message to the VLR with a Location Update Type of IMSI attach indicated.

question_16155.question: In the context of a TAB connector, what does the basic limit P<sub>EM,N</sub> refer to in clause 6.6.5.5.4.3?
question_16155.ground_truth: The basic limit P<sub>EM,N</sub> refers to the level of emissions in the band 470-790 MHz, measured in an 8~MHz filter bandwidth on center frequencies F<sub>filter</sub> for a TAB connector operating in Band~20/n20.

question_16156.question: In the macrocell environment, how are the AoDs and powers associated?
question_16156.ground_truth: In the macrocell environment, the AoDs and powers are associated such that the AoD with the largest power is assigned to the first path, the AoD with the second largest power is assigned to the second path, and so on. When the LOS model is used, the AoD for the direct component is set equal to the line-of-sight path direction.

question_16164.question: What is the emergency call code for sequence 1.9 in the USIM Application Toolkit default?
question_16164.ground_truth: The emergency call code is "1020" for sequence 1.9.

question_16165.question: What should the MCVideo server do for a functional alias ID which has an entry in the served list of functional alias information entries, but the expiration time has already expired?
question_16165.ground_truth: The MCVideo server should add a new functional alias information entry in the candidate list of the functional alias information list for the functional alias ID, and set the functional alias status to the "activating" state.

question_16166.question: What is the test described in section 4.3.4.4.4 for, in regards to increased UE carrier monitoring?
question_16166.ground_truth: The test described in section 4.3.4.4.4 is to verify the requirement for E-UTRA TDD to UTRA TDD inter-RAT cell reselection for increased UE carrier monitoring, where UTRA TDD cells are of lower priority than E-UTRA serving cell.

question_16167.question: What action does the MCData server take if the corresponding file is not available in the MCData content server?
question_16167.ground_truth: The MCData server provides a response to the MCData client indicating that the file distribution request cannot proceed due to the unavailability of the file in the MCData content server.

question_16168.question: What should the IWF do upon receiving an authorised request for an MCPTT emergency alert cancellation?
question_16168.ground_truth: The IWF should clear the cache of the MCPTT ID of the MCPTT user identified by the <originated-by> element as having an outstanding MCPTT emergency alert.

question_16169.question: What are the three EAP authentication methods that the AMF can choose to authenticate UE?
question_16169.ground_truth: 5G AKA, EAP-AKA', or any other key-generating EAP authentication method.

question_16172.question: What is the significance of service level interworking with respect to the architecture of the IMS, SMS, and SIP based messaging service?
question_16172.ground_truth: The service level interworking shall be transparent to the end user, minimize the impact on the IMS architecture, not impact existing functionality of the SMS service, and use existing security mechanisms for both the SIMPLE IM service and the SMS service. Additionally, existing security mechanisms for SIP based messaging service shall be reused.

question_16173.question: What should be the value of time alignment timers during the test?
question_16173.ground_truth: Time alignment timers should be set to "infinity" during the test to maintain UL timing alignment.

question_16174.question: What would be the impact of supporting H.263 and MPEG-4 Visual codecs on 5G devices?
question_16174.ground_truth: It would reduce the available space for other, newer, codecs and technologies.

question_16176.question: What message is sent from the MS to the target GANC in GERAN A/Gb mode to GAN mode PS handover to indicate handover completion?
question_16176.ground_truth: The GA-PSR HANDOVER COMPLETE message is sent from the MS to the target GANC in GERAN A/Gb mode to GAN mode PS handover to indicate handover completion.

question_16177.question: What is the purpose of using the BSN in the fast Ack/Nack reporting structure?
question_16177.ground_truth: The BSN is used to indicate the Block Start Number of the first incorrectly received block, allowing for efficient error reporting.

question_16178.question: What is key issue 3 related to and what is its assumed solution?
question_16178.ground_truth: Key issue 3 is related to key issue 1 and assumes that a solution to key issue 1 has been provided. It addresses the uncertainty of when it would be beneficial to move offloaded IP traffic back to the original 3GPP RAT during or after 3GPP RAT mobility.

question_16180.question: In what situation can an operator modify an existing NSI that is composed of both shared and non-shared CN network functions and a shared AN?
question_16180.ground_truth: When the operator wants to modify an existing NSI and determine whether the shared or non-shared CN network functions of the NSI need modification.

question_16182.question: What is the quality rating for r4 in Test 2 HIQ?

question_16183.question: In what scenario would the 3GPP network calculate the MBMS broadcasting area?
question_16183.ground_truth: This would occur in the broadcasting/multicasting case when the MTC Server issues a broadcast request to the 3GPP network, indicating the data to be broadcasted and the geographic area in which broadcast/multicast should occur.

question_16184.question: What is the total measurement period for aggregated measurements, as defined in clause 5.6.2.6?
question_16184.ground_truth: The total measurement period for aggregated measurements is defined as the maximum of either the total measurement period for non-aggregated measurements or the sum of the total measurement period for non-aggregated measurements and a scaling factor when certain conditions are met.

question_16186.question: What information does the NRM client store to enable monitoring of the 5G MBS session by the VAL UE?
question_16186.ground_truth: The NRM client stores the information associated with the MBS session ID and other 5G MBS session related information.

question_16187.question: What is the minimum UE class supporting the combination of DL: 32 kbps with a stand-alone signalling RB for PCCH in 9.4.1 classes?
question_16187.ground_truth: The minimum UE class supporting this combination is DL: 32 kbps.

question_16188.question: What should the NF service consumer respond with when the data change notification is received successfully?
question_16188.ground_truth: The NF service consumer should respond with "204 No Content" on success for data change notification or UE parameters update data delivery via a notification.

question_16191.question: What is the purpose and type of the A&C reference number information element?
question_16191.ground_truth: The A&C reference number information element is a type 1 information element and its purpose is to indicate to the network in the AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING RESPONSE message which AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING REQUEST message the MS is replying to.

question_16193.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Northbound Interfaces and APIs in TS 22.261?
question_16193.ground_truth: The 3GPP Northbound Interfaces and APIs are designed to enable external entities and third-party Application Servers/Functions to securely and controlledly access a set of exposed 3GPP network services and capabilities. They ensure the efficient use and deployment of various applications/services (e.g. V2X, UAS, EDGE) via an optimized application layer framework.

question_16194.question: What technology was used in a live lung surgery training program for more than 200 thoracic surgeons in May 2021?

question_16195.question: What is the purpose of the satellite simulator in the context of GNSS testing?
question_16195.ground_truth: The satellite simulator generates all UE supported GNSS satellite signals and provides assistance data based on UE capabilities. It is used to test the signalling of the satellite system.

question_16197.question: What should the SS do in step 2 of the test procedure when a manually initiated eCall over IMS is initiated at the UE?
question_16197.ground_truth: The SS sends a 600 (Busy Everywhere) message.

question_16199.question: What type of constellation is used in the downlink concept of the Basic OSC for modulating bits?
question_16199.ground_truth: The downlink concept of the Basic OSC uses a QPSK type of constellation for modulating bits in the downlink.

question_16200.question: What is the role of the inter-PLMN discovery request in the process of selecting the target PLMN?
question_16200.ground_truth: The inter-PLMN discovery request is used by the target PLMN to determine the interface to be used.

question_16202.question: What must the ICS UE do when it detects a request for the establishment of an emergency session in the CS media?
question_16202.ground_truth: The ICS UE shall attempt to initiate a CS emergency call if it detects the request for the establishment of an emergency session, or forwards an IMS session establishment request if it could not detect an emergency call.

question_16204.question: What action does the SCP take if none of the associated AMF service instances are available due to AMF failure?
question_16204.ground_truth: The SCP selects an AMF service instance from the backup AMF used for failure.

question_16208.question: If the UE is not able to perform registration update and is operating in single-registration mode, what should the UE handle in addition for the abnormal cases?
question_16208.ground_truth: Handle the EPS update status as specified in 3GPP TS 24.301 for LTE access

question_16209.question: What is the communication protocol used for HeNB management?
question_16209.ground_truth: The communication protocol used for HeNB management is the TR-069 protocol.

question_16210.question: What should the VAE-C include in the HTTP 200(OK) response message indicating acceptance or rejection of a dynamic group information update request?
question_16210.ground_truth: The VAE-C should include a <dynamic-group-update-consent-info> element with a <result> child element set to "accept" or "reject" in the <VAE-info> root element.

question_16212.question: What is the measurement that provides the mean setup time of successful IMS initial registrations at P-CSCF, given as an integer value in milliseconds?

question_16213.question: What is the purpose of the 'Sequence number' parameter in messages transmitted over the PC3ach interface?
question_16213.ground_truth: The Sequence number parameter is used to indicate the sequence number of the usage information report. It increases by 1 whenever a new usage information report is created.

question_16215.question: What is the root element of the NetworkQoSManagementInfo document in XML schema?
question_16215.ground_truth: The root element of the NetworkQoSManagementInfo document in XML schema is <network-QoS-management-info>.

question_16216.question: What is the meaning of "SHALL" and "SHALL NOT" in the Network Resource Model (NRM)?
question_16216.ground_truth: "SHALL" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, and "SHALL NOT" indicates a prohibition to do something in the context of normative provisions.

question_16217.question: How does IMS handle call forwarding compared to CS-domain call forwarding?
question_16217.ground_truth: IMS does not have any standard call forwarding service, but it provides the ability to build applications that can redirect sessions on the user's behalf based on many different types of criteria. CS-domain call forwarding provides a standard mechanism to allow users to set forwarding parameters, while IMS servers allow users to change their personal agent's criteria using non-service specific technology.

question_16220.question: Why does the source AMF send the uplink NAS COUNT value of 232-1 for deriving KeNB in a handover procedure from 5GS to EPS?
question_16220.ground_truth: This value is used to avoid any possibility that the same KeNB may be derived again, which can ensure security and prevent replay attacks in the handover process.

question_16221.question: What shall the service type be set to if the MS receives a paging request using P-TMSI for PS domain from the network in PMM-IDLE mode?
question_16221.ground_truth: The service type shall be set to "paging response".

question_16222.question: What is defined as an inter-frequency RSSI measurement?
question_16222.ground_truth: An RSSI measurement is defined as an inter-frequency measurement if the RSSI measurement bandwidth is not contained within the current carrier bandwidth of the UE.

question_16223.question: What must the transmission participant send upon receiving an indication from the user to request permission to receive media?
question_16223.ground_truth: The Receive Media Request message towards the transmission control server.

question_16225.question: What shall the floor participant do when it has no permission for a chat group call and the SIP INVITE request is not an implicit floor request?
question_16225.ground_truth: The floor participant shall enter the 'U: has no permission' state when it has no permission for a chat group call and the SIP INVITE request is not an implicit floor request.

question_16226.question: Which part of the NAS downlink COUNT value is included in the HO Command to the UE when performing SRVCC from E-UTRAN to Circuit Switched UTRAN/GERAN?
question_16226.ground_truth: The 4 least significant bits of the NAS downlink COUNT value are included in the HO Command to the UE when performing SRVCC from E-UTRAN to Circuit Switched UTRAN/GERAN.

question_16227.question: What purpose does the Positioning Capability Transfer procedure serve?
question_16227.ground_truth: The Positioning Capability Transfer procedure enables the SMLC to obtain the positioning capabilities of the MS, the types of assistance supported and the types of assistance data that may be needed from the SMLC.

question_16228.question: What is the entering condition for event A2 in clause 5.5.4.3 of TS 38.331?
question_16228.ground_truth: The entering condition for event A2 is fulfilled when inequality A2-1 is satisfied, i.e. Ms + Hys < Thresh.

question_16231.question: What does the UL Maximum Packet Loss Rate and DL Maximum Packet Loss Rate indicate?
question_16231.ground_truth: The UL Maximum Packet Loss Rate and DL Maximum Packet Loss Rate indicate the maximum rate for lost packets that can be tolerated in the uplink and downlink directions, respectively.

question_16232.question: What is the procedure followed by the Reference UE to obtain the Ranging measurement of UE#1 and UE#2 in the Ranging service exposure?
question_16232.ground_truth: The Reference UE performs the authentication procedure to determine whether the SL Positioning Client UE is authorized to invoke the Ranging service, performs the Ranging and positioning procedure with UE#1 and UE#2 based on the solutions of KI#4, obtains the Ranging measurement of UE#1 and UE#2, and calculates the Ranging result between UE#1 and UE#2.

question_16233.question: When a UE accesses EPC via S2a using trusted non-3GPP IP access and establishes connections to additional PDNs, what should the UE include in the trigger for additional PDN connectivity?
question_16233.ground_truth: The UE should include an APN in this trigger to connect to the desired PDN and indicate the Attach Type to the trusted non-3GPP access during additional PDN connectivity, distinguishing between Initial Attach and Handover Attach.

question_16234.question: What type of intra-frequency SSB-based measurement is applied to a measurement object i when there is no measurement gap and none of the SMTC occasions are overlapped by the measurement gap?
question_16234.ground_truth: SSB-based intra-frequency measurement with no measurement gap in clause 9.2D.5, when none of the SMTC occasions of this intra-frequency measurement object are overlapped by the measurement gap.

question_16236.question: What should the NAS do when the barring is alleviated for the access category associated with the access attempt and an uplink user data packet is to be sent for a PDU session with suspended user-plane resources?
question_16236.ground_truth: The NAS should consider that the uplink user data packet is not allowed to be sent and should initiate the service request procedure as specified in subclause~5.6.1, if still needed, when the barring is alleviated for the access category.

question_16237.question: What is the maximum aggregate adjustment rate?
question_16237.ground_truth: The maximum aggregate adjustment rate is Tq per 200ms.

question_16238.question: How does the CORBA SS handle reference attributes for the E-UTRAN NRM?
question_16238.ground_truth: In the CORBA SS, reference attributes for the E-UTRAN NRM are mapped to attributes in the MOC. When the cardinality for an association is 0..1 or 1..1, the datatype for the reference attribute is defined as an MOReference, containing the distinguished name of the associated MO. When more than one referred MO is allowed, the reference attribute will be of type MOReferenceSet, which contains a sequence of MO references.

question_16239.question: What is the condition for the SS to switch the power setting from T1 to T2?
question_16239.ground_truth: The SS switches the power setting from T1 to T2 after the UE re-selects Cell 1 within T1, or when T1 expires.

question_16240.question: What is the purpose of MCData message store in the context of MCData communication?
question_16240.ground_truth: MCData message store is used to store MCData communication for a MCData user who has requested it.

question_16242.question: What is the trigger for starting the time in the calculation of the RSTD measurement accuracy?
question_16242.ground_truth: The time starts from the first subframe of the PRS positioning occasion closest in time after both the OTDOA-RequestLocationInformation message and the OTDOA assistance data in the OTDOA-ProvideAssistanceData message via LPP are delivered to the physical layer of the UE.

question_16244.question: In what format should the P-CSCF build the Via header field entry when adding its own address to the top of the received list, if a security association or TLS session exists?
question_16244.ground_truth: The P-CSCF builds the Via header field entry in a format that contains the protected server port number of the security association or TLS session established from the UE to the P-CSCF and either the P-CSCF FQDN or IP address of the security association or TLS session established from the UE to the P-CSCF.

question_16246.question: What network provides the location-reference when establishing a logical control channel over the PS domain using SIP?
question_16246.ground_truth: The location-reference is provided by a location server in the PS network rather than the CS network when establishing a logical control channel over the PS domain using SIP.

question_16248.question: In what situation is the "RAN timing synchronization" information element included?
question_16248.ground_truth: The "RAN timing synchronization" information element is included to provide information related to the RAN timing synchronization to a UE that has set the Reconnection to the network due to RAN timing synchronization status change bit to "Reconnection to the network due to RAN timing synchronization status change supported".

question_16249.question: Who is responsible for establishing, re-establishing, and releasing the acknowledged peer-to-peer LLC operation in the 3GPP TS~24.008 standard?
question_16249.ground_truth: The SNDCP layer is responsible for establishing, re-establishing, and releasing the acknowledged peer-to-peer LLC operation in the 3GPP TS~24.008 standard.

question_16250.question: What procedure is triggered by the PDN Connectivity procedure if the UE already has active PDN connections?
question_16250.ground_truth: The PDN Connectivity procedure may trigger one or multiple Dedicated Bearer Establishment procedures to establish dedicated EPS bearer(s) for that UE.

question_16251.question: What is the maximum number of reporting criteria that a UE should support for Traffic volume and Quality measurements in the 8.3, 8.3A, and 8.3B sections?
question_16251.ground_truth: The UE should not support more than 16 reporting criteria in total for Traffic volume and Quality measurements in the 8.3, 8.3A, and 8.3B sections.

question_16254.question: What is the role of the IRPManager and IRPAgent in version handling?
question_16254.ground_truth: The IRPManager is responsible for finding out which Interface IRP SS versions are supported by an IRPAgent, while the IRPAgent responds with a set of supported IRP SS version(s). For NRM IRPs, the IRPAgent responds with a list of supported NRM IRP versions, but it does not indicate which NRM versions are supported in each of the instantiated managed objects of the MIB.

question_16255.question: What should the AMF do upon receipt of the SECURITY MODE REJECT message from the UE?
question_16255.ground_truth: Upon receipt of the SECURITY MODE REJECT message, the AMF should stop timer T3560 and abort the ongoing procedure that triggered the initiation of the NAS security mode control procedure.

question_16256.question: Under what circumstances is a non-3GPP IP access network identified as an untrusted non-3GPP access network?
question_16256.ground_truth: When one or more of the security feature groups provided by the non-3GPP access network are considered not sufficiently secure by the home operator, the non-3GPP access may be identified as an untrusted non-3GPP access.

question_16258.question: What should the network do to indicate desired DL TX power adjustment to an IAB-node?
question_16258.ground_truth: The network may indicate to its parent node recommendations for DL TX power adjustment using the DL TX Power Adjustment MAC CE.

question_16259.question: What are the conditions for activation and deactivation of the SCell in the test procedure?
question_16259.ground_truth: Activation of the SCell occurs in subframe m, which is an even number, when the SS receives ACK for the MAC-CE sent by the UE. Deactivation of the SCell occurs in subframe n, when the SS sends the deactivation MAC-CE and receives ACK from the UE.

question_16260.question: When should the MTSI client re-negotiate the RTCP bandwidth with SDP bandwidth modifiers values greater than zero, and send RTCP packets to the other end, during a call hold?
question_16260.ground_truth: The MTSI client should re-negotiate the RTCP bandwidth with SDP bandwidth modifiers values greater than zero, and send RTCP packets to the other end, during a call hold to enable the remote end to detect link aliveness during hold.

question_16261.question: What is the purpose of Step 3 in the process of service continuity with MCPTT?
question_16261.ground_truth: In Step 3, UE-1 registers with the MCPTT server over the UE-to-network relay leg using the SIP REGISTER method.

question_16263.question: What is the main difference between the Normal mode and Harmonic mode in the high-level decoder structure?
question_16263.ground_truth: The main difference is in the detailed structure of the PFSC block.

question_16264.question: What issue can arise from the introduction of high comfort noise levels in other voice-operated devices?
question_16264.ground_truth: The high comfort noise level may be interpreted as a voice signal, or if detected as noise, another source of comfort noise at a different level may be introduced downstream, thus increasing the noise contrast.

question_16265.question: What measurement is used to provide the number of successful MBMS session start?

question_16266.question: What are the two main types of transport channels specified in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_16266.ground_truth: The two main types of transport channels specified are Dedicated Channels and Common Channels.

question_16267.question: In which clause is the overall procedure for ProSe Direct Discovery via E-UTRAN detailed?
question_16267.ground_truth: The overall procedure for ProSe Direct Discovery via E-UTRAN is detailed in clauses 5.3.2 and 5.3.2A.

question_16268.question: What happens when the VAE server receives a session-oriented service termination request from the V2X application-specific server or from the VAE itself?
question_16268.ground_truth: The VAE server indicates to terminate the session-oriented service with the VAE client upon the request from the V2X application-specific server or the VAE client.

question_16270.question: What is required for the MC service client to send a location report and MBMS listening report to the MC service server?
question_16270.ground_truth: A unicast bearer is needed for the MC service client to send the location report and the MBMS listening report to the MC service server.

question_16271.question: What is the role of the "Implicit Reject" functionality in GERAN?
question_16271.ground_truth: The "Implicit Reject" functionality in GERAN inhibits Random Access Channel signalling, which helps in managing large numbers of MSs.

question_16272.question: What two scenarios are mentioned for MSD (Maximum Simultaneous Uplink and Downlink) in section 6.3.1.3 of the document?
question_16272.ground_truth: The two scenarios mentioned for MSD are when the uplink is band 8, and when the uplink is in band 1.

question_16273.question: Which types of media can be subject to discreet listening in Scenario 1.1 described in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_16273.ground_truth: In Scenario 1.1, the media that can be subject to discreet listening includes the communication between MC user B and MC user C, which can be MCPTT or MCVideo private calls.

question_16274.question: What parameters should be signalled for a video Adaptation Set in a 3GPP media stream?
question_16274.ground_truth: The Adaptation Set should signal the maximum required capability to decode any Representation in the Adaptation Set by signalling the @codes parameter, the width and height by @width and @height, chroma format by an Essential or Supplemental Descriptor, color primaries and transfer function by an Essential or Supplemental Descriptor, and frame rate by @frameRate. Random Access Points should be signalled by @startsWithSAP.

question_16275.question: What extra information does N4 need to support in order to transfer information to local SMF for UL-CL offloading?
question_16275.ground_truth: N4 needs to support the transfer of extra information, such as DNAI and UE location information for UL-CL support, indication of UL-CL or Multi-homing, and allocated IP address for BP support.

question_16276.question: What is the purpose of the concurrent RTTI TBF establishment in the enhanced DTM CS establishment procedure?
question_16276.ground_truth: The purpose is to verify that the MS can decode correctly the Packet downlink Assignment that assigns dual downlink carrier and is able to correctly receive data simultaneously on both the carriers assigned.

question_16279.question: What is the effect of system load and L1 data rate loss on the UPT gain provided by one symbol length TTI for FTP file size 0.5Mbytes?
question_16279.ground_truth: Higher system load and larger L1 data rate loss lead to smaller UPT gain provided by one symbol length TTI for FTP file size 0.5Mbytes.

question_16280.question: What happens if the number of talker permissions is reduced in the FRMCS System?
question_16280.ground_truth: If the number of talker permissions is reduced, the active talkers lose their permission to talk as soon as they stop talking until the new maximum allowed number of talkers is met.

question_16281.question: What is the expected sequence 4.1 in SC Mode 1?
question_16281.ground_truth: The expected sequence 4.1 in SC Mode 1 is SEND DATA, NG-RAN, bearer type '03' - Default PDU Session, immediate mode.

question_16282.question: What is the role of the 3GPP management system in providing the connection information of the NEF to the edge computing management system?
question_16282.ground_truth: The 3GPP management system receives a request from an authorized consumer (e.g. edge computing management system) and provides the connection information (e.g. IP address) of the NEF to the authorized consumer.

question_16283.question: What impact does network sharing have on LTE architecture?
question_16283.ground_truth: Network sharing is an inherent part of the LTE architecture, and all UEs support network sharing from the beginning. The LTE UE decodes the broadcast system information to determine available operators, and takes them into account when selecting a network. Based on the broadcast system information, the UE selects and connects to a specific operator (MME/UPE) and stores related information for future reattachment.

question_16286.question: What message is sent by the gNB-CU-CP during bearer context modification to setup the DL TNL address information for F1-U or Xn-U?
question_16286.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-CP sends a BEARER CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message containing the DL TNL address information for F1-U or Xn-U, and PDCP status.

question_16287.question: What should a UE include in the SDP offer when initiating a user-originated USSD session?
question_16287.ground_truth: A UE should include an SDP offer with one media description, but with a zero port number value in order to inform network entities that media resources are not requested for the session.

question_16288.question: In subtest 1, what is the maximum duration that the UE shall stop transmitting uplink signal after T3 in both subtest 1 and subtest 2?
question_16288.ground_truth: In subtest 1, the UE shall stop transmitting uplink signal no later than 900 ms after the start of T3 in both subtest 1 and subtest 2.

question_16289.question: When is the relay service code parameter set to the specific value for emergency service?
question_16289.ground_truth: The relay service code parameter is set to the specific value for emergency service when the UE is triggered by an upper layer application to announce availability of an emergency connectivity service and certain conditions are met.

question_16291.question: What type of AVP is the Time-Stamps AVP, and what information does it contain?
question_16291.ground_truth: The Time-Stamps AVP is of type Grouped and contains the time stamp of the SIP REQUEST and the time stamp of the response to the SIP REQUEST.

question_16294.question: What are the types of measurement results that may be included in a CEF report for NR?
question_16294.ground_truth: The CEF report for NR may include UL/DL CEF reports, RRC connection establishment/resume failure information, and UL/DL packet delay, packet delay variation, and packet loss information.

question_16295.question: How many test cases are considered in Scenario 3 for RRM requirement with two Angle of Arrivals (2 AoAs)?
question_16295.ground_truth: There are two test cases (Case 1 and Case 2) considered in Scenario 3. Case 1 is with TDM transmissions from 2 probes, and Case 2 is with simultaneous transmission of signals from 2 probes.

question_16296.question: What is the role of the Destination Port Number value in 3GPP TS 36.423?
question_16296.ground_truth: The Destination Port Number value 36422 is assigned by IANA to be used for X2AP in 3GPP TS 36.423, and it should also be used in Source Port Number by all eNBs and en-gNBs within a network.

question_16297.question: What action does a UE take if it recognizes an emergency call request and the core network supports emergency bearers?
question_16297.ground_truth: The UE uses EPS bearer contexts for both signalling and media for emergency calls made using the IM CN subsystem.

question_16299.question: What is the purpose of parameter negotiation in session setup and termination?
question_16299.ground_truth: The purpose of parameter negotiation in session setup and termination is to address various combinations of private call parameters and capabilities in LMR systems, and to ensure compatibility in commencement mode.

question_16300.question: What happens to stored PDCP SDUs when the PDCP entity is re-established for SRBs?
question_16300.ground_truth: When the PDCP entity is re-established for SRBs, all stored PDCP SDUs and PDCP PDUs are discarded, in-order delivery is stopped, and reordering information is reset.

question_16303.question: In the case that the intersystem change from N1 mode to S1 mode occurs while in EMM-IDLE mode and there is no active PDU session context for interworking to EPS, what is the resulting state in 5GMM and EMM for the UE?
question_16303.ground_truth: The resulting state is FFS (editor's note indicates that the behavior is not specified).

question_16305.question: What is the purpose of the solution for KI#1 in 6.29, on improving correctness of NWDAF analytics?
question_16305.ground_truth: The purpose of the solution is to enhance ML model provisioning to improve the correctness of NWDAF Analytics and study mechanisms to detect ML model degradation and trigger appropriate actions.

question_16306.question: What should the MME do upon receiving a TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message and a new TMSI in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message?
question_16306.ground_truth: The MME should send an SGsAP-TMSI-REALLOCATION-COMPLETE message.

question_16307.question: What security requirement does 5G System need to provide for mitigating linkability attacks on L2 identities during eV2X broadcast communications?
question_16307.ground_truth: The 5G System shall provide means for mitigating linkability attacks on L2 identities and trackability attacks on L2 identities during eV2X broadcast communications.

question_16309.question: When must the UE apply the timer T3584 for all the PLMNs or all the equivalent SNPNs?
question_16309.ground_truth: If the 5GSM congestion re-attempt indicator IE with the ABO bit set to "The back-off timer is applied in all PLMNs or all equivalent SNPNs" is included in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message with the 5GSM cause value #67 "insufficient resources for specific slice and DNN", then the UE shall apply the timer T3584 for all the PLMNs or all the equivalent SNPNs.

question_16311.question: What should a mobile station (MS) do if it receives the cause codes #22, #95, #96, #97, #99, and #111 and considers them as abnormal cases?
question_16311.ground_truth: The MS should set the location update attempt counter to 4 and wait for the release of the RR connection as specified in subclause~4.4.4.8.

question_16312.question: What is one of the functions of the 5GMSG Service in a 5G system?
question_16312.ground_truth: It allows a server in the network to trigger a User Equipment (UE) to perform an action.

question_16313.question: What are some examples of policies for a SCP trust domain in the SCP trust domain solution?
question_16313.ground_truth: Examples of policies for a SCP trust domain include restricting communication between trust domains, allowing specific domains to communicate, granting access tokens for all NFs within the domain, providing a service only for NFs of a distinct NF Type, and requiring the NF Service Consumer to be part of the same SCP trust domain.

question_16314.question: What is one of the requirements for IMS P2P CDS?
question_16314.ground_truth: The system shall support a mechanism to provide address information for accessing an IMS based P2P content distribution service for an IMS P2P CDS UE.

question_16315.question: What is the purpose of the new alternative S-NSSAI parameter in the PDU Session Establishment Request message?
question_16315.ground_truth: The new alternative S-NSSAI parameter in the PDU Session Establishment Request message allows the UE to include an alternative S-NSSAI, if available, in the PDU Session establishment procedure. The S-AMF may use this information for PDU Session handover to the alternative S-NSSAI if the current S-NSSAI is not supported or overloaded in the target network.

question_16316.question: What is the definition of measurement reporting delay for the E-UTRAN HD-FDD inter-frequency OTDOA measurements provided the conditions for reporting are met?
question_16316.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between the point when UE receives both the OTDOA-RequestLocationInformation message and the OTDOA assistance data in the OTDOA-ProvideAssistanceData message, and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface. This delay excludes a delay uncertainty and a delay that may be caused by no UL resources for UE to send the measurement report.

question_16317.question: What is the significance of TpMessageDeliveryType in multimedia messaging?
question_16317.ground_truth: TpMessageDeliveryType is a string of characters that identify the names of the modes of delivery for a message in multimedia messaging. These values can be used to specify the delivery method when sending a message.

question_16318.question: How does the network determine the unavailability period for a UE?
question_16318.ground_truth: In this solution, the unavailability period is requested by the UE from the 5GC. The network may accept the unavailability duration indicated by the UE or indicate a different value. If necessary, the network may delay the unavailability period with a backoff timer.

question_16319.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 9.2.1IA.3, as applied to a mobile device?
question_16319.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the ability of the mobile device's receiver to receive a predefined test signal, which represents a multi-path fading channel with a certain minimum information bit throughput. The test is designed to stress the multicode reception and channel decoding with incremental redundancy.

question_16320.question: What is the main function of the 5GS mobility management (5GMM) sublayer?
question_16320.ground_truth: The main function of the 5GS mobility management (5GMM) sublayer is to support the identification, security, mobility of a UE as well as generic message transport and provide connection management services to other sublayers.

question_16321.question: What information does the network provide to support coordination between the contexts maintained by ESM and SM in a UE that supports both E-UTRAN and UTRAN/GERAN?
question_16321.ground_truth: The network provides GERAN/UTRAN specific information to support coordination between the contexts maintained by ESM and SM in a UE that supports both E-UTRAN and UTRAN/GERAN.

question_16322.question: What is the LAI value for cell A in the initial conditions for 480/900 MS?

question_16323.question: What is the difference between NTC4a, NTC4b, and NTC4c in terms of the number of carriers and supported RATs?
question_16323.ground_truth: NTC4a is applicable for a BS that supports UTRA and GSM and allows up to 4 carriers, NTC4b is applicable for a BS that supports E-UTRA and GSM and also allows up to 4 carriers, and NTC4c is applicable for a BS that supports UTRA, E-UTRA, and GSM and also allows up to 4 carriers.

question_16324.question: What is the required support for FGI bit 25 for the applicability of the FDD-TDD inter-frequency absolute accuracy test?
question_16324.ground_truth: Support for FGI bit 25 is required for the applicability of the FDD-TDD inter-frequency absolute accuracy test.

question_16325.question: What is the maximum peak-to-peak ripple of the equalizer coefficients (dB) across the allocated uplink block variation for the EVM equalizer spectrum flatness requirement to be met?
question_16325.ground_truth: The maximum peak-to-peak ripple of the equalizer coefficients for the EVM equalizer spectrum flatness requirement to be met is defined by the EVM measurement process in dB.

question_16326.question: Why is it necessary to study authenticate and authorization between two EESes?
question_16326.ground_truth: It is necessary to study authenticate and authorization between two EESes due to the lack of clear definition of how EESes authenticate and authorize each other on interfaces EDGE-3/6/9, which support confidentiality, integrity, and replay protection.

question_16327.question: What should the UE do if the uac-BarringForCommon is applicable or the uac-AC-BarringListType indicates that uac-ExplicitAC-BarringList is used and the uac-AC-BarringList does not contain a UAC-BarringPerCat entry corresponding to the Access Category?
question_16327.ground_truth: The UE should consider the access attempt as allowed.

question_16328.question: What new functionality is added to the wind turbine controllers in the first scenario?
question_16328.ground_truth: The new functionality is data analytic functionality for predictive maintenance.

question_16329.question: What procedure is used for a UE returning to coverage in either 5GS or EPS?
question_16329.ground_truth: If 5GS is used, the Registration procedure is reused and if EPS is used, the Tracking Area Update procedure is used as defined in TS~23.401.

question_16330.question: Under what conditions should the UE start the Tw2 timer and not try again until the backoff timer expires?
