question_17673.ground_truth: When the network scales and automates, it may cause congestion in one network function, requiring the 3GPP network to have policies for load migration to minimize service impact. There is also a need to enhance the network function selection mechanism to treat traffic effectively.

question_17674.question: What should be the length of the group ID when more than one call attempt is made to the same group ID?
question_17674.ground_truth: If more than one call attempt is made to a group ID with a length of 8 decimal digits, the network should reject all but one of the call attempts.

question_17675.question: What type of addresses does the F1 interface support for data transport over the IP based Transport layer?
question_17675.ground_truth: The F1 interface supports both IPv4 and IPv6 for data transport over the IP based Transport layer.

question_17676.question: What is the main threat to RRC when integrity protection is not provided by IPsec?
question_17676.ground_truth: The main threat is that an attacker may modify bearers on the Un interface, which seems possible when the attacker knows the RRC integrity key.

question_17677.question: What should the infrastructure do to enable operation of the affected MSs that are unable to handle the LOCATION UPDATING ACCEPT, ATTACH ACCEPT and ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT messages when the EPLMN Lists IE is included?
question_17677.ground_truth: The infrastructure may adapt the contents of the LOCATION UPDATING ACCEPT, ATTACH ACCEPT and ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message it sends to an MS by excluding the EPLMN List IE added in the R99 version of the specifications. This can be done based on the MS Revision Level Indicator.

question_17678.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe Application Layer Group ID in ProSe Direct Discovery?
question_17678.ground_truth: The ProSe Application Layer Group ID is used to identify an application layer group that the UE belongs to in ProSe Direct Discovery.

question_17679.question: What are some common types of failures during the PS handover preparation phase?
question_17679.ground_truth: During the PS handover preparation phase, failures can occur due to no resource reservation or allocation, insufficient resource allocation by the target system, the target CSG cell not being allowed for the MS, or loss of signaling messages or incorrect information elements in the signaling messages.

question_17680.question: In the implementation of Solution #8, what is the purpose of the Integrity Mode (IM) bit?
question_17680.ground_truth: The Integrity Mode (IM) bit indicates whether the message is discarded or delivered to the upper layer if the MAC verification fails.

question_17681.question: What are the types of filters that a watcher can define for filtering presence information?
question_17681.ground_truth: The types of filters that a watcher can define for filtering presence information include filters for selecting specific tuples, attributes, and triggers for sending notifications.

question_17682.question: What is the minimum bandwidth required for the measurement of maximum input level for NR V2X?
question_17682.ground_truth: The parameters of the reference measurement channel are defined for 10MHz, 20MHz, 30MHz and 40MHz channel bandwidths.

question_17687.question: What are the possible drawbacks of triggering a Codec change from the Core Network to the BSS using a new Assignment procedure on the same SCCP connection?
question_17687.ground_truth: The drawbacks include replacing the UDP/IP termination at the BSS and at the MGW without having the old and new terminations in place during the Codec change, and the Core Network not being aware of the current BSS capabilities when initiating the new Assignment procedure.

question_17689.question: What information is provided by the "HS-DSCH FDD Update Information" IE?
question_17689.ground_truth: The "HS-DSCH FDD Update Information" IE provides information for HS-DSCH to be updated, with at least one IE being required.

question_17692.question: What is the UE spurious emissions limit for PS projection based on the different offsets?
question_17692.ground_truth: The UE spurious emissions limit is defined as -42dBm/6.25kHz for public safety/narrow-band protection, and is currently under consideration for a possible relaxation to up to -35 dBm/6.25kHz, which would remove the need for operator-specific coexistence solutions and facilitate global deployment of the upper 850.

question_17693.question: What is required to be included in the Contact header field of the SIP INVITE request when initiating an MCPTT prearranged group call and the MCPTT emergency state is already set?
question_17693.ground_truth: The g.3gpp.mcptt media feature tag and the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag with the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt" need to be included in the Contact header field of the SIP INVITE request.

question_17694.question: In the described test setup, what is the duration of the reporting period used for averaging the received signal quality?
question_17694.ground_truth: The length of one SACCH multiframe

question_17695.question: What is the maximum number of valid WLANSP rules that can be active at the same time?
question_17695.ground_truth: At any point in time, there shall be at most one active WLANSP rule.

question_17696.question: How is the channel bandwidth and allocated resource blocks determined in the intra-band contiguous EN-DC power imbalance tests in FR1?
question_17696.ground_truth: The channel bandwidth and allocated resource blocks are determined by first selecting the CBW combinations with the same BWs between E-UTRA MCG carrier(s) and NR SCG carrier. Next, the CBW combinations with the smallest CBW difference between NR SCG carrier and E-UTRA MCG carrier(s) are selected. If there is no such CBW combination, the EN-DC combinations with smallest CBW difference between the NR SCG carrier and E-UTRA MCG carrier(s) are selected. Among the CBW combinations selected in Step 1, the EN-DC combination with the largest aggregated CBW is then selected. The allocation of test resource blocks depends on the bandwidth of the NR SCG carrier in relation to the E-UTRA MCG carrier(s).

question_17697.question: How many time periods are there in test 1 and 2?
question_17697.ground_truth: There are three time periods in both test 1 and 2.

question_17698.question: What is an Equivalent PLMN list (EHPLMN list) in the context of TS 23.122?
question_17698.ground_truth: The EHPLMN list is a list stored on the USIM that contains PLMN codes, including the HPLMN code derived from the IMSI, for PLMN selection purposes. If the HPLMN code derived from the IMSI is not present in the EHPLMN list, it is treated as a Visited PLMN for PLMN selection purposes.

question_17699.question: What is the condition for the missed up down test to be decided pass?
question_17699.ground_truth: The missed up down test is decided pass, if the last counter reaches pass and all the counters have reached the pass criterion.

question_17700.question: What should the UE do when the cell re-selection criteria are met for the cell on a different frequency?
question_17700.ground_truth: The UE reselects the new cell.

question_17701.question: When should the UE include the "Release assistance indication" IE in the UL NAS TRANSPORT message?
question_17701.ground_truth: The UE may include the "Release assistance indication" IE in the UL NAS TRANSPORT message to inform the network whether no further uplink and no further downlink data transmission is expected or only a single downlink data transmission and no further uplink data transmission subsequent to the uplink data transmission is expected.

question_17702.question: What action should the V-PCRF indicate to the H-PCRF when receiving an indication of an IP-CAN Session Termination from the PCEF and the last S9 subsession for the roaming user is removed?
question_17702.ground_truth: The V-PCRF should indicate to the H-PCRF that the S9 session needs to be terminated.

question_17703.question: What is the responsibility of the 5G DDNMF/PKMF of the UE in the authorization process in Model A?
question_17703.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF/PKMF of the UE sends an Authorization Request to the Ranging Server or the UDM of the UE for announcing or monitoring authorization. It generates Discovery Security Material only if the authorization is successful and includes the authorized Role(s) of the UE in the Discovery Response.

question_17704.question: What should be the maximum power for intermodulation components, measured in 100 kHz bandwidth, as defined in ITU-R Recommendation SM.329?
question_17704.ground_truth: The intermodulation products shall never exceed -16 dBm, measured in 100 kHz bandwidth, as defined in ITU-R Recommendation SM.329, sub-clause 4.3 and Annex 7.

question_17705.question: What is the pre-condition for the group announcement and join procedure in the group management system?
question_17705.ground_truth: The VAL server must be aware of the users' identities and authorized to form a VAL group, and the group management client, group management server, VAL server, and VAL clients must belong to the same VAL system.

question_17706.question: What is the motivation for studying unlicensed spectrum offloading system enhancements in the 3GPP system?
question_17706.ground_truth: The motivation is to enable the 3GPP system to differentiate traffic transported over unlicensed access in non-roaming and roaming cases, and to ensure the granularity of data collected for data usage over unlicensed access is as required for particular operating purposes.

question_17708.question: What is the limit for BER for each measured carrier in the test?
question_17708.ground_truth: The BER should not exceed 0.001 for each measured carrier in the test.

question_17710.question: What is the purpose of RAN-assisted codec adaptation feature in Rel-14?
question_17710.ground_truth: The RAN-assisted codec adaptation feature was developed in Rel-14 to address the limitations of ECN-based solutions for rate adaptation, which are difficult to guarantee that intermediate routers in the core network and along the transmission path would not drop ECN-marked packets, and the lack of explicit indication of supported rate during congestion. The RAN-assisted codec adaptation provides an explicit indication of the uplink and downlink rate supported.

question_17711.question: What is an SFC in the 5GC network?
question_17711.ground_truth: An SFC (Service Function Chain) is a logical representation of an ordered set of Service Functions that need to successively handle traffic in the 5GC network.

question_17712.question: What are the scaling factors used for in the process of quantizing and de-quantizing a signal in the described 3rd SVQ?
question_17712.ground_truth: The scaling factors are used to minimize computational complexity in the 3rd SVQ. They are used to divide the input signal before quantization and to obtain the quantized signal of the 3rd SVQ by multiplying the quantized output with the scaling factor.

question_17713.question: What is the value of "x" specified in subclause 26.6.5.1.3 for MSs supporting Speech at Step 6, and what does it represent in the sequence of events?
question_17713.ground_truth: The value of "x" is 500 at Step 6, representing the number of milliseconds the MS and SS are expected to wait before the MS transmits the HANDOVER COMPLETE message.

question_17714.question: What is the purpose of the GAA server showing a dialog window to the user when an application attempts to gain access to GAA functionality?
question_17714.ground_truth: The purpose of the dialog window is to allow the user to grant or deny access to the GAA credentials for a specific NAF, and remember the decision for the next time the same application requests the same NAF specific GAA credentials.

question_17715.question: What kind of traffic is CBS and what is its communication direction?
question_17715.ground_truth: CBS traffic is asymmetric in nature, and communication flow is only from the CBC to the UE.

question_17716.question: What is the implication when the User ID field is included in the Floor Taken message?
question_17716.ground_truth: The User ID field is used in the off-network mode to carry the MCPTT user ID of the floor participant sending the Floor Taken message.

question_17717.question: When would the MCPTT Service terminate Ambient Listening?
question_17717.ground_truth: The MCPTT Service shall terminate Ambient Listening if the MCPTT User being listened to starts to transmit in an MCPTT Private Call or an MCPTT Group Call.

question_17718.question: Which type of information element is used to indicate the trackin Area Code List in the ASN.1 definition?
question_17718.ground_truth: The type of information element used to indicate the tracking Area Code List in the ASN.1 definition is TrackingAreaCodeList-r10.

question_17719.question: What information elements are available for normal UE assisted testing?
question_17719.ground_truth: The available information elements for normal UE assisted testing include GPS Reference Time, GANSS Reference Time, GANSS Time Model (for multi-GNSS tests), GANSS Reference UE Position, GPS Navigation Model, GANSS Navigation Model, GANSS Acquisition Assistance, GANSS Auxiliary Information, GPS Acquisition Assistance, GANSS Reference Measurement Information, GPS UTC Model, and GPS Almanac.

question_17720.question: What is the role of the AMF in revoking EBI for allocating to a new SMF request?
question_17720.ground_truth: In order to serve a new SMF request of EBI for the same UE, the AMF may revoke an EBI that was assigned to QoS flow(s). The AMF then takes the ARP pre-emption vulnerability and the ARP priority level into consideration and revokes EBIs with a higher value of the ARP priority level first. The AMF then releases the mapped EPS QoS parameters corresponding to the EBI to be revoked and communicates the change to the related SMF, AN, and UE.

question_17721.question: What is the ability of the UE to set its output power to a specific value for each subframe called in the context of E-UTRA uplink transmission?

question_17723.question: What is the purpose of the MCData synchronization notification in the message store communication?
question_17723.ground_truth: The MCData synchronization notification is used to keep the message store client and the MCData message store in sync.

question_17724.question: What should the GGSNs update their PDP context fields with when they receive an Update PDP Context Request from a new SGSN?
question_17724.ground_truth: The GGSNs update their PDP context fields with new TEID, Prohibit Payload Compression, APN Restriction, MS Info Change Reporting Action, CSG Information Reporting Action, BCM, and Negotiated Evolved ARP.

question_17729.question: What does the SCAS compliance tester assess during security testing?
question_17729.ground_truth: The compliance tester evaluates whether the SCAS instantiation contains enough information to install a representative test bed, define test vectors, execute test cases, and determine if the tests completely and accurately cover the SCAS.

question_17731.question: What is the required periodic measurement reporting accuracy for RSRP and RSRQ measurements in the absence of DRX or scheduled measurement gaps?
question_17731.ground_truth: The required accuracy for RSRP and RSRQ measurements is specified in sub-clauses 9.1.14.2 and 9.1.14.4, respectively.

question_17732.question: What are the two methods of roaming specified in TS 23.280?
question_17732.ground_truth: The two methods of roaming specified in TS 23.280 are EPC-level roaming as defined in 3GPP TS 23.401 and IMS-level roaming as defined in 3GPP TS 23.228.

question_17733.question: Which 3GPP TS document outlines the procedures for handling mobile calls in the imcnSSF?

question_17734.question: What is the role of the MC service server (controlling role) in distributing media to other MC service systems?
question_17734.ground_truth: The MC service server (controlling role) requests that other MC service systems, owning the discovered bearer(s), distribute the media.

question_17736.question: What types of data communication are supported by 5G LAN-VNs?
question_17736.ground_truth: Multiple types of data communication are supported by 5G LAN-VNs, at least IP and Ethernet.

question_17737.question: What does the term "interception" mean in this specification?
question_17737.ground_truth: In this specification, "interception" is the action (based on the law) performed by a network operator / access provider / service provider of making available certain information and providing that information to a law enforcement monitoring facility.

question_17738.question: Which organization is responsible for maintaining the OSA specifications in 3GPP Rel-8 and new OSA Stage 1, 2 and 3 work beyond Rel-9?

question_17741.question: What action should a UE take if it receives a USSD operation while already processing another USSD transaction in IMS?
question_17741.ground_truth: The UE should inform the network that it is unable to process the USSD request and set the <error-code> element to "USSD-busy".

question_17743.question: What can be used as an identifier to correlate a target's various SIP messages in a communication session?
question_17743.ground_truth: LIID (Local Identification Industry Dealing) or an implementation dependent number (such as Call-id) can be used to correlate a target's various SIP messages in a communication session.

question_17744.question: What does the <Source Statistics Descriptor> parameter specify for a PDP context?
question_17744.ground_truth: The <Source Statistics Descriptor> parameter specifies characteristics of the source of the submitted SDUs for a PDP context.

question_17745.question: What is the maximum duration of the simulator test?
question_17745.ground_truth: The maximum duration of the test is 10 minutes.

question_17746.question: What is the procedure for verifying the current serving cell during the short sync interval?
question_17746.ground_truth: The device confirms the current serving cell by checking if the TSC value is the same as when it last performed the short sync procedure, either by reading the TSC indicated by a Normal Burst (NB) or by decoding a SCH burst and examining the BSIC value carried therein.

question_17747.question: What is the formula for calculating the Cumulative Adjacent Channel Leakage power Ratio (CACLR) for repeater type 1-C for DL and UL for NR carriers?
question_17747.ground_truth: The CACLR is the ratio of the sum of the filtered mean power centered on the assigned channel frequencies for the two carriers adjacent to each side of the gap between passband or the inter-passband gap, and the filtered mean power centered on a frequency channel adjacent to one of the respective repeater type 1-C passband edges.

question_17748.question: What is the formula used for calculating the entropy of a spectral line in the envelope scaling section?
question_17748.ground_truth: The formula used for calculating the entropy of a spectral line is, which is an approximation of the entropy formula that assumes the sign of the spectral line is encoded even if it is quantized to zero.

question_17749.question: What is the recommended minimum key size for providing data confidentiality and/or integrity in the cellular IoT traffic model?
question_17749.ground_truth: The minimum key size for providing data confidentiality and/or integrity should be 128 bits.

question_17750.question: What is the purpose of the ProtocolIE-Single-Container in the Extension-InformationExchangeObjectType-InfEx-Rqst information element?
question_17750.ground_truth: The ProtocolIE-Single-Container in the Extension-InformationExchangeObjectType-InfEx-Rqst information element is used to define a single protocol information element container for the extension information exchange object type request.

question_17751.question: What does Solution #7 propose to protect in relation to Network Slice specific access authentication and authorization?
question_17751.ground_truth: Solution #7 proposes to protect any message exchange after the primary authentication by making it confidentiality protected after successful activation of AS and NAS security.

question_17752.question: What should the network do if the UE paging probability information for the UE value is changed or deleted?
question_17752.ground_truth: The network should assign a new GUTI and consider the old UE paging probability information as invalid if the UE responds to the paging with the new GUTI.

question_17753.question: What does the tBSS do if the GCR correlation has identified the call as an intra BSS call and LCLS is allowed in the BSS?
question_17753.ground_truth: The tBSS returns the ASSIGNMENT COMPLETE message with the LCLS-BSS-Status IE indicating "Call not yet locally switched".

question_17756.question: What should a UE do if the registration request is rejected with the rejection cause "S-NSSAI not available due to maximum number of UEs reached"?
question_17756.ground_truth: Unless the back-off timer value received along with the S-NSSAI is zero, the UE should add the rejected S-NSSAI(s) in the rejected NSSAI for the maximum number of UEs reached and not attempt to use this S-NSSAI in the current PLMN or SNPN over the current access until switching off the UE, removing the rejected S-NSSAI(s), or when timer T3526 expires.

question_17757.question: What action does the gprsSSF take when there are no 'Waiting-for-AC' markers remaining in the GPRS_SSF process?
question_17757.ground_truth: The gprsSSF stops the TC guard timer.

question_17758.question: What is the egress TT for synchronizing TSN end stations behind other UE(s) with the TSN GM in the network attached to the device side via 5G System?
question_17758.ground_truth: The egress TT is DS-TT of the other UE.

question_17760.question: What is the purpose of testing ACS based on the OTA REFSENS?
question_17760.ground_truth: Testing ACS based on the OTA REFSENS is not necessary as the blocking requirements evaluate the receiver's ability to manage absolute signal levels.

question_17761.question: In which scenario does a session continuity situation occur?
question_17761.ground_truth: A session continuity situation occurs when the service is made available via both 5GMS and eMBMS delivery networks, with only one Representation of each Adaptation Set provided via eMBMS.

question_17762.question: What is the maximum variability allowed in the UE sending delay obtained from different calls for MTSI-based speech with LTE, NR, or WLAN access?
question_17762.ground_truth: A variability of up to 20ms may be expected between different calls due to the synchronization between the speech frame processing in the sending UE and the bits of the speech frames at the UE antenna.

question_17764.question: Which entities receive the Survival Time in the Survival Time for Deterministic Applications solution?
question_17764.ground_truth: SMF (Session Management Function) and NG-RAN (Next Generation Radio Access Network) receive the Survival Time when it is provided with the TSCAI (TS Control Channel Augmentation Information).

question_17765.question: What is the significance of the "Traffic Control Data" in policy decision types?
question_17765.ground_truth: The "Traffic Control Data" in policy decision types defines how traffic data flows associated with a rule are treated, such as blocked or redirected.

question_17768.question: How does the SMF determine the TSCAI for the QoS Flow based on the TSC Assistance Container?
question_17768.ground_truth: The SMF determines the TSCAI for the QoS Flow based on the TSC Assistance Container by correcting the Burst Arrival Time, Periodicity, and Survival Time, and setting other parameters as specified.

question_17769.question: What are the stop conditions used in the Self-healing procedure?
question_17769.ground_truth: The stop conditions used in the Self-healing procedure are thresholds that determine whether to stop the procedure if the related fault is still not resolved after several iterations or a long time.

question_17770.question: What should the Node B do in a 1.28Mcps TDD system if the TSTD Indicator IE is included in PDSCH To Add Information LCR IE and is set to "active"?
question_17770.ground_truth: The Node B shall activate TSTD diversity for PDSCH transmissions using the specified PDSCH Set that are not beacon channels if the TSTD Indicator IE is set to "active". If the TSTD Indicator IE is set to "not active" or not included, the Node B shall not activate TSTD diversity for the PDSCH Set.

question_17771.question: Upon successful completion of an attach or routing area update procedure, when does the MS start using the new UMTS security context and the indicated integrity algorithm and encryption algorithm in the LLC layer?
question_17771.ground_truth: The MS shall take the new UMTS security context and the indicated integrity algorithm and encryption algorithm received in the AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING REQUEST message into use in the LLC layer after sending the AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING RESPONSE message.

question_17772.question: What are the radiated performance requirements specified for in relation to the fixed reference channels in Annex A and the propagation conditions in Annex G for the BS?
question_17772.ground_truth: The radiated performance requirements for the BS are specified for the fixed reference channels defined in Annex A and the propagation conditions in Annex G.

question_17774.question: What procedure does the P-CSCF follow when it receives an SDP answer and there are no ICE specific procedures since it did not include candidate attributes for TCP based streams in the SDP offer?
question_17774.ground_truth: It simply discards the candidate attributes for TCP based streams in the SDP answer.

question_17775.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a PDN CONNECTIVITY ACCEPT message with the NBIFOM container IE set to "Accepted" in the context of a PDN connection with NBIFOM support over untrusted WLAN?
question_17775.ground_truth: The UE should consider that NBIFOM applies to the PDN connection and consider the received NBIFOM mode parameter as the selected NBIFOM mode.

question_17776.question: What message does the IAB-donor-CU send to the source parent node IAB-DU to release the migrating IAB-MT's context?
question_17776.ground_truth: The IAB-donor-CU sends a UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND message to the source parent node IAB-DU to release the migrating IAB-MT's context.

question_17777.question: Which are the access technology types associated to the "Operator controlled signal threshold per access technology" parameter?
question_17777.ground_truth: The access technology types associated with the parameter are E-UTRAN - NB-IoT (NB-S1 mode), EC-GSM-IoT (A/Gb mode), E-UTRAN - Category M1 (NB-S1 mode), and E-UTRAN - Category M2 (WB-S1 mode).

question_17778.question: At which period does the transmitter intermodulation requirement apply in a base station?
question_17778.ground_truth: The transmitter intermodulation requirement applies during the transmitter ON period and the transmitter transient period in a base station.

question_17779.question: How many seconds long is the source material used for the test, a Maximum Length Sequence (MLS) burst of order 15?
question_17779.ground_truth: The source material was approximately 0.7 seconds long.

question_17781.question: What is the event package that shall be used to obtain the status of participants in group sessions, as defined by IETF RFC 4575?

question_17783.question: What are the impacts of Solution #16 on UPF?
question_17783.ground_truth: Solution #16 enforces UL/DL bitrate quota across all GBR and Non-GBR QoS Flows of the PDU Sessions with the S-NSSAI at the UPF. The UPF ensures that the traffics of GBR QoS Flows do not exceed the sum of GFBR value of the respective QoS Flows and shapes the traffic of non-GBR QoS Flows and/or drops packets exceeding the GFBR from GBR QoS Flows with MFBR > GFBR.

question_17784.question: What protocol is used for transporting control plane messages between the donor CU and IAB DUs over the IAB backhaul network?
question_17784.ground_truth: The protocol used is RRC or F1-AP, while IAB specific enhancements are not precluded.

question_17785.question: How is data transmitted and delivered in Non-IP Data Delivery (NIDD) between the User Equipment and an Application Function in 5G system?
question_17785.ground_truth: In Non-IP Data Delivery (NIDD), data is transmitted between the User Equipment and an Application Function using an unstructured PDU session and a Non-IP Data Delivery (NIDD) API on the N33/Nnef reference point for data delivery from/to the Application Function. Alternatively, data can be delivered using an unstructured PDU session between the UE and UPF and a Point-to-Point N6 tunnel between the UPF and the AF.

question_17786.question: What action should the MT take when the targeted application on the UICC does not support the requested EAP method and the MT does support this method?
question_17786.ground_truth: The MT should handle the EAP method, run the authentication algorithm on the SIM or USIM, and allocate an EAPsessionid to identify the EAP session and its corresponding keys and parameters.

question_17787.question: What is the purpose of the control part of the MBMS-APIs?
question_17787.ground_truth: The control part of the MBMS-APIs is used for service discovery, registration, notifications, state changes, and other control messages between the MAA and the MBMS client.

question_17788.question: What is the procedure if the mobile station supports only Transparent mode or responds with a CALL CONFIRMED message in the context of 2 of BS 41 in the context of PAD Access Asynchronous?
question_17788.ground_truth: The procedure involves sending a BC GSM message starting with 04 0X X1 X8 8C 21 X1 XX X0 (CX).

question_17789.question: What must the MME do if an APN Restriction is received in the Create Session Request?
question_17789.ground_truth: The MME must store the APN Restriction value for the Bearer Context, check it with the stored value for the Maximum APN Restriction to ensure there are no conflicts, and determine a new value for the Maximum APN Restriction if the Bearer Context is accepted.

question_17790.question: When should the "LTE-M" RAT-Type be set by the MME for a UE accessing E-UTRAN with satellite access and indicating Category M from the eNB?
question_17790.ground_truth: The "LTE-M" RAT-Type should be set by the MME for a UE accessing E-UTRAN with satellite access and indicating Category M from the eNB.

question_17793.question: In the context of 5G networks, what is the difference between primary and secondary authentication?
question_17793.ground_truth: Primary authentication is used for mutual authentication between the UE and the network, while secondary authentication is used for a DN to authenticate and/or authorize a UE to access the DN with EAP framework based authentication between the UE and the DN-AAA server in the DN. The ARPF is only involved in primary authentication, not secondary authentication.

question_17797.question: When Enhanced Flexible Timeslot Assignment, EFTA, is used, and the applicable conditions for pre-emptive retransmission are true, what is the requirement for the mobile station regarding uplink radio block transmission and reading downlink radio blocks?
question_17797.ground_truth: The mobile station shall not prioritize uplink radio block transmission over attempting to read downlink radio blocks.

question_17798.question: Under what condition should the MAC entity consider a set of Random Access resources with NSAG indication as not available for the Random Access procedure?
question_17798.ground_truth: The MAC entity should consider the set of Random Access resources as not available for the Random Access procedure unless it is triggered for the corresponding NSAG indication.

question_17799.question: What is the role of CA (Certificate Authority) in PWS (Public Warning System) security?
question_17799.ground_truth: A CA (Certificate Authority) is responsible for certifying the authenticity of public keys used to verify signed warning messages in PWS security.

question_17801.question: What information does the NetworkSliceController IOC provide in a 5G network?
question_17801.ground_truth: The NetworkSliceController IOC represents the network slice controller in a 5G network that controls the lifecycle of the NetworkSlice MOI. It includes attributes such as serviceProfileId, operationalState, availabilityStatus, and administrativeState. The serviceProfileId defines the service profile identifier provided by the MnS producer for uniquely identifying the network slice related requirements received from the MnS consumer.

question_17802.question: What factor can negatively affect the gain on DRT brought by a shorter TTI in the context of FTP download application?
question_17802.ground_truth: The size of the download file and the provided Uu throughput can negatively affect the gain on DRT brought by a shorter TTI in the context of FTP download application.

question_17803.question: What is the purpose of the Survival Time parameter in TSC AI?
question_17803.ground_truth: The Survival Time parameter in TSC AI refers to the time that an application consuming a communication service may continue without an anticipated message.

question_17805.question: What does the MSC-A server use to requests MGW-A to set the Handover Device to initial state when the MSC-A server receives the MAP Prepare Subsequent Handover request containing a Relocation Request message?

question_17806.question: What action does the S-CSCF take when it receives a 2xx response for a BYE request matching an existing dialog?
question_17806.ground_truth: The S-CSCF deletes all the stored information related to the dialog.

question_17807.question: What protocol is used as the basic session control protocol to create an IMS session supporting telepresence, alongside SIP?
question_17807.ground_truth: The Session Initiation Protocol (SIP), as defined in IETF RFC 3261, is used as the basic session control protocol to create an IMS session supporting telepresence.

question_17808.question: What is the maximum number of cells for QMC?

question_17811.question: In sidelink transmission mode 4, what is the parameter PSSCH-RSRP used for in the UE's procedure for determining the subset of resources to be reported to higher layers in PSSCH resource selection?
question_17811.ground_truth: PSSCH-RSRP is used as a threshold for the UE to exclude certain candidate single-subframe resources from the set of resources to be reported to higher layers.

question_17813.question: What is the purpose of a "Link Object" in the context of the JSON Hypertext Application Language (HAL)?
question_17813.ground_truth: A "Link Object" in the context of the JSON Hypertext Application Language (HAL) represents a hyperlink from the containing resource to another resource identified by the URI and it has several properties describing the target resource.

question_17814.question: How does the solution for service continuity planning differ from the procedure specified in 3GPP TS 23.558 clause 8.8.2.5?
question_17814.ground_truth: The solution for service continuity planning differs from the procedure specified in 3GPP TS 23.558 clause 8.8.2.5 in the following ways: (1) The detection entities (EEC, S-EAS, S-EES) detect the ACR may be required and identify the ACID and related ACR type (normal ACR or service continuity planning). (2) If the EEC or S-EAS detect the ACR event, the EEC or S-EAS should inform S-EES with ACID, ACR type and predicted/expected UE location or EAS service area in the ACR launching procedure. (3) When S-EAS detects application context transmission is complete, the S-EAS sends ACR status update request message to the S-EES with ACID. (4) Once S-EES detects the UE has moved to the predicted/expected UE location or EAS service area, then the S-EES sends ACR complete notify message to the EEC indicating that UE has moved to the predicted location.

question_17816.question: What information should be contained in the request body when sending an HTTP PUT request to the MonitorKey custom operation?
question_17816.ground_truth: The RSC and PC5 UE security capability.

question_17817.question: What is the procedure for initiating a private call between two MCPTT users using ProSe-enabled UEs by ProSe in off-network mode with solicited discovery?
question_17817.ground_truth: The MCPTT user requires the MCPTT UE IP address of the target MCPTT user, then initiates the private call set up procedure. A discovery request containing the target MCPTT user's identity is sent, followed by a call setup request message. The MCPTT UE2 accepts the private call, and media plane resources are established.

question_17819.question: What is the purpose of the id-Cause field in the MCBearerContextSetupFailureIEs E1AP-PROTOCOL-IES sequence?
question_17819.ground_truth: The id-Cause field in the MCBearerContextSetupFailureIEs E1AP-PROTOCOL-IES sequence is used to indicate the cause of the MC bearer context setup failure.

question_17820.question: What bitmap graphics decoders should be supported by an MBMS client?
question_17820.ground_truth: The following bitmap graphics decoders should be supported by an MBMS client: GIF87a, GIF89a, and PNG.

question_17821.question: What is the Service-Specific-Data AVP used for in the 3GPP charging system?
question_17821.ground_truth: The Service-Specific-Data AVP is used to hold the value of the Service-Specific-Data. It is of type UTF8String.

question_17822.question: In subclause 11.1, how many pilot signals does the UE transmit for uplink MIMO?
question_17822.ground_truth: The UE transmits two orthogonal pilot signals on DPCCH and S-DPCCH.

question_17823.question: How is the SMF Set FQDN constructed, and what information does it include?
question_17823.ground_truth: The SMF Set FQDN is constructed using the NF Set ID, MNC, and MCC, with a subdomain name derived from the Home Network Realm/Domain. It is used to identify an SMF Set within an operator's network.

question_17824.question: What should the 3GPP management system allow an authorized MnS consumer to define, in order to instruct the AI/ML MnS producer on how to perform the AI/ML capability activation?
question_17824.ground_truth: The policies for activation of AI/ML capabilities, such as when and where to activate which AI/ML capabilities.

question_17825.question: What happens when a UE moves between multiple Service Areas in 5GS-EPS interworking with EPS counting active?
question_17825.ground_truth: The NSACF NF handling the shared 5GS-EPS count simply updates the UE stored information, regardless of whether the NSACF is shared or dedicated for 5GS-EPS interworking.

question_17826.question: What is the solution to avoid sensitive information leakage involving S-NSSAI in the 5G system?
question_17826.ground_truth: In order to avoid sensitive information leakage involving S-NSSAI, S-NSSAI is not sent to or made available to a third party AF. Instead, NEF keeps a mapping between S-NSSAI and ENSI (External Network Slice Information) and ENSI (instead of S-NSSAI) is available at the third party AF.

question_17827.question: What are the three different modes of operation for NB-IoT?
question_17827.ground_truth: The three different modes of operation for NB-IoT are Stand-alone operation, utilizing GERAN spectrum; Guard band operation, utilizing unused resource blocks within an LTE carrier's guard-band; and In-band operation, utilizing resource blocks within a normal LTE carrier.

question_17829.question: In section 6.2A.2.0.3, what does the MPR for power class 2 for FR2 4UL CA refer to, as indicated in sub-clause 6.2A.2.0.4?
question_17829.ground_truth: The MPR for power class 2 is specified in sub-clause 6.2A.2.0.4 for FR2 4UL CA. The details of the MPR for power class 2 are not provided in this section.

question_17830.question: What happens during an Inter-RNS URA Update without SRNS relocation?
question_17830.ground_truth: The target RNC allocates new C-RNTI and D-RNTI for the UE, the UE is not registered in the target RNC, so the target RNC allocates new C-RNTI and D-RNTI for the UE, and the URA Update Confirm is forwarded from the target RNC to the UE via CCCH with new RNTIs.

question_17831.question: What message does the UE send to the TWAN to request a specific mapping of IP flow to TWAN access?
question_17831.ground_truth: The UE sends a WLCP NBIFOM Request message to the TWAN, which includes the Routing Rules requested by the UE to request a specific mapping of IP flow to TWAN access.

question_17832.question: What should the MME do upon receipt of an SGs paging request including the CS restoration indicator?
question_17832.ground_truth: If the IMSI is unknown or if the IMSI is known and the UE is marked as EMM-DEREGISTERED, the MME shall send the paging request with the location information provided by the VLR. If no such location information is provided, the MME may page the UE in all the tracking areas corresponding to that MME.

question_17833.question: What is the barring condition that this test case checks for when the served user is registered from an access network other than the served user's home network?

question_17835.question: Which message is sent by the gNB-CU-UP to provide information about the DL data arrival or inactivity of the MC Bearer Context to the gNB-CU-CP in the 9.2.5.2.12 message?

question_17836.question: What is the default frame size and FCS in the SS RLP codec for handling RLP frames exchanges in SS?
question_17836.ground_truth: The default frame size in the SS RLP codec is 576 bits and the FCS value is calculated and inserted in the FCS fields in each DL RLP frames. The FCS values in the UL frames are irrelevant in the TTCN.

question_17839.question: What is the maximum QoS profile data length for SMF in the UTF-8 encoded QoS Profile field for non-GBR 5QIs in the RADIUS attribute as specified in subclause 16.4.7.2?
question_17839.ground_truth: The UTF-8 encoded QoS Profile field for non-GBR 5QIs in the RADIUS attribute is not specified in the present specification.

question_17841.question: What is the time difference between the best case and worst case scenario for reading the Primary System Information message (PSI)?
question_17841.ground_truth: The best case scenario is 11.925 ms, and the worst case scenario is 886.925 ms.

question_17842.question: What information is included in the "realm" field of the Authorization header in a REGISTER request?
question_17842.ground_truth: The "realm" field of the Authorization header in a REGISTER request contains a globally unique name of the S-CCF.

question_17843.question: What does QoS stand for in the context of telecommunications?

question_17844.question: What is the precondition mechanism referred to in the test procedure?
question_17844.ground_truth: The precondition mechanism is a procedure defining how to establish and use resources during a session in IMS mobile terminated speech calls.

question_17845.question: What must the MCPTT client include in the SIP INVITE request when the MCPTT user has requested the origination of an MCPTT emergency group call?
question_17845.ground_truth: The MCPTT client must include an SDP offer, indicate whether an implicit floor request is required, and send the SIP INVITE request towards the MCPTT server.

question_17846.question: What parameter in BSSMAP-LE PERFORM LOCATION REQUEST message gives the information about the LCS capabilities of the target MS?
question_17846.ground_truth: The LCS Capability parameter provides information about the LCS capabilities of the target MS in the BSSMAP-LE PERFORM LOCATION REQUEST message.

question_17848.question: What is the minimum size of the temporary identity part of the ProSe Application Code Prefix?
question_17848.ground_truth: The minimum size of the temporary identity part of the ProSe Application Code Prefix is 8 bits.

question_17849.question: What should the SCC AS do to maintain IMS registration when the UE is involved in a CS session?
question_17849.ground_truth: The SCC AS shall forward the TRegistration to the UE via a 3rd party registration procedure and forward the TRegistration to the UE, e.g. by including the TRegistration in the response to the SIP REGISTER request.

question_17850.question: What does the "5.3.126.1 Definition" section specify about the data type "NsacfCapability"?
question_17850.ground_truth: It represents the NSACF service capability.

question_17851.question: What message is transmitted by the SS in Cell 1 after the RRC connection release in the test procedure loop?
question_17851.ground_truth: A Paging message with a PagingRecord containing UE-Identity is transmitted by the SS in Cell 1 after the RRC connection release in the test procedure loop.

question_17854.question: What is the purpose of the Cell Identity in NTN and how is it used for handover messages?
question_17854.ground_truth: The Cell Identity in NTN is a fixed geographical area identified by a Mapped Cell ID. It is used to identify the correct target cell in handover messages. For a BL UE or a UE in enhanced coverage, the Cell Identity included within the target identification of the handover messages allows identifying the correct target cell.

question_17855.question: What are the drawbacks of Alternative 4 for including Load Control Information?
question_17855.ground_truth: The drawbacks are that the sender has to remember when it has sent the information the last time to decide when to send it again, potentially redundant information being included in multiple messages, and extra processing at the receiver to compare and discard the new information if it is the same as the old information received from the same node.

question_17856.question: In which substate is the UE not allowed to initiate any 5GMM procedure except for cell and PLMN reselection?

question_17857.question: What action does the SMS-SC take after receiving a "Device Trigger Request" in the IEC operation model for Device Triggering?
question_17857.ground_truth: The SMS-SC triggers a Debit Units Request message to the OCS after receiving a "Device Trigger Request" in the IEC operation model for Device Triggering.

question_17860.question: What is the impact of handover on the control procedures and the operation of the service in the 3GPP system?
question_17860.ground_truth: Handover will have no impact on the control procedures and the operation of the service.

question_17861.question: Which bandwidth classes are used only for FR2-2 operating bands in NR?
question_17861.ground_truth: Classes V and W in 5.3A.4-1 in 38.101-2

question_17862.question: In which message is the T3346 value IE included?
question_17862.ground_truth: The T3346 value IE may be included in the ATTACH REJECT message by the MME when the NAS level mobility management congestion control is active.

question_17863.question: What is the value of "x" in the specific message contents for M = 3?

question_17864.question: What should be indicated to the user about the SNPN that does not support emergency calls while the MS is in limited service state and the registration request for emergency services is rejected by the network?
question_17864.ground_truth: The MS should indicate to the user that a different SNPN is available and it will automatically select the SNPN in this case.

question_17865.question: Which service is supported by the 5G system to collect charging information for using Ambient IoT services on a per Ambient IoT device basis?
question_17865.ground_truth: PR 5.3.6-004 - The 5G system shall be able to collect charging information for using Ambient IoT services on per Ambient IoT device basis (e.g., total number of communications per charging period).

question_17867.question: What is required to initiate the 5G ProSe direct link security mode control procedure?
question_17867.ground_truth: The initiating UE must ensure that the target UE has initiated a 5G ProSe direct link establishment procedure or a 5G ProSe direct link re-keying procedure and that security protection is not explicitly declined.

question_17870.question: What protocol type over S5/S8 interface does the target MME indicate to the target Serving GW for each PDN connection?
question_17870.ground_truth: The Protocol Type over S5/S8 is provided to Serving GW which protocol should be used over S5/S8 interface.

question_17871.question: What is the post-condition for Critical advisory messaging services in the FRMCS system?
question_17871.ground_truth: Safety related - Critical advisory messages can be exchanged among FRMCS Users.

question_17873.question: What is the frequency separation distance recommended for uncoordinated GSM and UMTS systems to avoid significant interference?
question_17873.ground_truth: The recommended minimum frequency separation distance between GSM carriers and UMTS center frequency for uncoordinated case is 2.8 MHz.

question_17874.question: What is the potential of using the 3GPP EVS codec for FOA-based VR audio services?
question_17874.ground_truth: The 3GPP EVS codec can be used to encode super-wideband FOA B-format representations with good to excellent quality for conversational and streaming use cases. It shows the potential of using the 3GPP EVS codec for FOA-based VR audio services.

question_17877.question: What action is taken by the MRFP during the SCTP association establishment phase to prevent later usage for a closure procedure?
question_17877.ground_truth: The MRFP denies during the SCTP association establishment phase the negotiation of SCTP extensions (such as the SCTP stream reset capability) in order to prevent their later usage for a closure procedure.

question_17878.question: What is the maximum number of CP-DATA message retransmissions allowed in the Wait for CP-ACK state, if the timer TC1* expires and message is not acknowledged?
question_17878.ground_truth: The maximum number of CP-DATA message retransmissions allowed is 1, 2 or 3.

question_17879.question: What-to-Ec/Ior values are considered for F-DPCH in the evaluation?
question_17879.ground_truth: The Ec/Ior values considered for F-DPCH are 4% and the highest value set by the network in the evaluation.

question_17880.question: What is used for the initialization of the scrambler and RE-mappers as defined in TS36.211 using a specific value of p?
question_17880.ground_truth: p = 0, even if the signal is transmitted on a physical port other than port 0.

question_17881.question: What is the purpose of the document with respect to 3GPP TR 21.905?
question_17881.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to gather background information and studies to address the requirements for 2 bands DL/2 band UL Inter-band Carrier Aggregation for Rel-16 band combinations in 3GPP TR 21.905.

question_17882.question: What is the goal of edge enabler layer support for EAS synchronization?
question_17882.ground_truth: The goal is to enable seamless communication across different EDNs for specific communication sessions, such as multi-user game sessions.

question_17883.question: What should the 3GPP AAA Proxy do to indicate to the 3GPP AAA Server that the WLAN AN is RADIUS based?
question_17883.ground_truth: The 3GPP AAA Proxy should include one or more of the following Diameter AVPs in the resultant Diameter command that is sent to the 3GPP AAA Server to indicate that the WLAN AN is RADIUS based: NAS-IP-Address AVP, NAS-IPv6-Address AVP, State AVP, or Termination-Cause AVP.

question_17885.question: What is the impact of the timer expiry at source MME during indirect forwarding?
question_17885.ground_truth: The expiry of the timer at source MME triggers the source MME to send a Delete Indirect Data Forwarding Tunnel Request message to the S-GW to release the temporary resources used for indirect forwarding.

question_17886.question: What is the maximum length of the transparent container for backward compatibility when sending the Source to Target Transparent Container IE or the Target to Source Transparent Container IE?

question_17887.question: What are the number of bits used for WB TBE LSF quantization at 9.6 kbps and at 13.2 kbps, respectively?
question_17887.ground_truth: A single stage vector quantizer that utilizes 2 bits and 8 bits for LSF quantization, respectively, at 9.6 kbps and at 13.2 kbps.

question_17889.question: What should a MS do when it receives a CC message containing an IE unknown in the message, but encoded as "comprehension required"?
question_17889.ground_truth: When the message is not one of the messages listed in 3GPP~TS 04.08 / 3GPP~TS~24.008 subclauses 8.5.1, 8.5.2 and 8.5.3, the MS shall ignore the message except for the fact that, if an RR-connection exists, it returns a STATUS message with cause value #96 "invalid mandatory information".

question_17890.question: What type of equipment is considered as "telecommunication port"?
question_17890.ground_truth: Ports which are intended to be connected to telecommunication networks (e.g. public switched telecommunication networks, integrated services digital networks), local area networks (e.g. Ethernet, Token Ring) and similar networks are considered as telecommunication ports.

question_17891.question: What should the UE do if it receives a NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message after sending a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message with the same access type in the UE?
question_17891.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message and proceed with the de-registration procedure.

question_17892.question: What should the application do after invoking the fileListAvailable() notification with the given parameters?
question_17892.ground_truth: The application may then ask the client on the status of the file list using the getFdDownloadStateList() method defined in clause 6.2.3.16.

question_17893.question: How does a group call using pre-established MBMS bearer start?
question_17893.ground_truth: To start a group call using pre-established MBMS bearer, the MBMS bearer(s) must be pre-established with BM-SC, and the information of pre-established MBMS bearer must be announced to the MCPTT clients.

question_17894.question: What is the default value for the "<integrity-protection>" element of the "<signalling-protection>" element?
question_17894.ground_truth: The default value for the "<integrity-protection>" element of the "<signalling-protection>" element is "true" indicating that integrity protection is enabled.

question_17897.question: How is a new CCNF selected in the event of policy changes?
question_17897.ground_truth: If the current CCNF is not compatible with the new MDD due to policy changes, a new CCNF that is compatible with the new MDD will be selected, and a new Temp ID associated with the new CCNF will be sent back to the UE.

question_17900.question: What is the initial condition for testing the UE's spatial coverage?
question_17900.ground_truth: The UE is set in the Tx beam peak direction found with a 3D EIRP scan as performed in Annex K.1.1.

question_17901.question: What HTTP status code indicates that the NEF has successfully updated the concerned "Individual Data Reporting Session" resource?
question_17901.ground_truth: The NEF responds with an HTTP "200 OK" status code when it has successfully updated the resource.

question_17902.question: When does the "Packer Flow Identifier" information element need to be included in the network's message?
question_17902.ground_truth: The network shall include the "Packet Flow Identifier" information element if the network wants to indicate the Packet Flow Identifier associated with the PDP context, and the MS has indicated PFC procedure support in the PFC feature mode field of the MS Network Capability IE.

question_17903.question: In the context of 3GPP specifications, what does the "3rd digit" indicate in the version number x.y.z?
question_17903.ground_truth: The "3rd digit" is incremented when editorial only changes have been incorporated in the document, indicating minor modifications or revisions.

question_17908.question: When is it possible for a UE to move individual service data flows from one (source) to another (target) access link in a seamless manner?
question_17908.ground_truth: It is possible for a UE to move individual service data flows from one (source) to another (target) access link in a seamless manner when policies determine that these flows should be moved and the target access link is available for the UE.

question_17909.question: What is the role of the SMF in 5G networks?
question_17909.ground_truth: The SMF processes the session setup request based on the per-slice information and reports the per-slice session status information to the NRF.

question_17910.question: What is the primary function of the Peripheral Super-Block in the EC-GSM SoC?
question_17910.ground_truth: The Peripheral Super-Block groups together peripherals such as interfaces for external sensors and input/output ports, the SIM block, the Clock Generation Unit, the System Power Control Unit, the System Control Unit, the System Timer Unit, and the Trace block.

question_17911.question: What action should the gNB-CU-UP take if it receives a BEARER CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message containing a E-UTRAN QoS IE in the DRB To Setup List IE for a GBR QoS DRB but where the GBR QoS Information IE is not present?
question_17911.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP should report the establishment of the corresponding DRB as failed in the DRB Failed List IE of the BEARER CONTEXT SETUP RESPONSE message with an appropriate cause value.

question_17913.question: What entity takes the role of "ProSe Function" in the monitoring UE and discoverer UE procedures?
question_17913.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF takes the role of "ProSe Function" in the monitoring UE and discoverer UE procedures.

question_17914.question: What is the status code that the Control Sink sends to the Control Source if a partial modification update cannot be fulfilled?
question_17914.ground_truth: The Control Sink sends a 403 message to the Control Source if the partial modification update cannot be fulfilled.

question_17915.question: Which procedures apply for emergency PDN connections for the untrusted WLAN case?
question_17915.ground_truth: The procedures defined in clauses 7.4.3, 7.6, 7.9.2, 7.10, 7.11.1, and 8 apply to emergency PDN connections for the untrusted WLAN case.

question_17917.question: What should the UE do when the "UE Manufacturer Assigned operation requested list" contains PLMN assigned UE Radio Capability IDs that were added to the list in the MMEs?
question_17917.ground_truth: The UE shall not re-use the PLMN assigned UE Radio Capability IDs that were added to the "UE Manufacturer Assigned operation requested list" in the MMEs.

question_17921.question: What is the definition of a correct event in the FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for UE Category 1bis?
question_17921.ground_truth: A correct event is defined as a successful detection of the uplink signal or a correct determination of the absence of the uplink signal, where the rate of correct events should be at least 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_17922.question: What information element is used to indicate the inability to perform the requested retrieve function?
question_17922.ground_truth: The "RETRIEVE REJECT" message is used to indicate the inability to perform the requested retrieve function.

question_17924.question: What is the minimum UE category that supports HS-PDSCH and E-DPDCH in the described combinations?

question_17925.question: What is the purpose of the COMPACT synchronization channel (CSCH) in a radio sub-system?
question_17925.ground_truth: The CSCH contains two encoded parameters: Base transceiver station identity code (BSIC) and Reduced TDMA frame number (RFN) for synchronization purposes.

question_17926.question: What should the MS (Mobile Station) do when it receives an ACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REJECT message with a request type of "emergency"?
question_17926.ground_truth: The MS may inform the upper layers of the failure to establish the emergency bearer, which can result in the upper layers attempting to establish a CS emergency call or initiating other implementation-specific mechanisms.

question_17927.question: What is the impact of introducing the gateway MCPTT server on existing nodes and functionality?
question_17927.ground_truth: The introduction of the gateway MCPTT server should prevent any change to the MCPTT server entity or reference point MCPTT-3. The new complexity will be confined to the new MCPTT-3' reference point and the equivalent MCVideo and MCData reference points between those MC systems.

question_17928.question: What are the criteria used by the MTC-IWF to perform load control?
question_17928.ground_truth: The MTC-IWF performs load control based on criteria such as ingress/service rate of triggers from a specific MTC server, aggregate ingress/service rates from all MTC servers, the maximum number of queuing trigger requests for further processing, congestion indication from MME/SGSNs, or network management settings.

question_17929.question: What is the purpose of the OSA API specification in the 3GPP telecommunications network?
question_17929.ground_truth: The OSA API specification defines an architecture that enables application developers to make use of network functionality through an open standardized interface. It allows for the creation of applications that can interact with the 3GPP telecommunications network in a standardized way.

question_17930.question: What should the UE do after receiving a NOTIFY message for the Message Waiting Indication in step 15.15.3?
question_17930.ground_truth: The UE should provide the appropriate user indication for the message waiting indication, if it has a UI with the capability to notify the user of a Message Waiting Indication.

question_17931.question: What is the purpose of the first step in the GMM-REGISTERED with 1 MBMS Service Activated procedure for MBMS broadcast test cases?
question_17931.ground_truth: The first step in the GMM-REGISTERED with 1 MBMS Service Activated procedure for MBMS broadcast test cases is for the SS to request the UE to active the requested MBMS broadcast service.

question_17933.question: What are the four binary flags used in the LCLS-Negotiation to identify whether User Plane access is necessary by at least one node in the path?
question_17933.ground_truth: The four binary flags are: Read-Forward, Read-Backward, Write-Forward, Write-Backward.

question_17934.question: What type of number is the CSRN used for in the IM CN subsystem?
question_17934.ground_truth: The CSRN is used as a number that is used to route a call from the IM CN subsystem to the user in the CS domain.

question_17935.question: What is the function of DMRS in the context of NR cell search?
question_17935.ground_truth: DMRS, or Demodulation Reference Sigal, is used for NR cell search in conjunction with primary and secondary synchronization signals, and PBCH DMRS, which are all located on the synchronization raster.

question_17936.question: What is the role of an in-band modem solution in the eCall transmission, as examined in 3GPP TR 22.967?
question_17936.ground_truth: The in-band modem solution is the preferred option for transmitting emergency call data from a vehicle to a PSAP, as identified in 3GPP TR 22.967.

question_17937.question: What is the recommended separation between a mounted antenna with 8 dBi gain and an in-band blocking case 1 requirement of -56 dBm for interference mitigation?

question_17940.question: What value should be present in the "mcdata-allow-transmit-data-in-this-group" element for an MCData client to send a group SDS message?
question_17940.ground_truth: The value of the "mcdata-allow-transmit-data-in-this-group" element should be "true" for an MCData client to send a group SDS message.

question_17941.question: What happens to the PIN elements of a PIN when a PIN is deleted by the PEMC locally?
question_17941.ground_truth: The PEMC deletes the PIN and the related information stored in the PIN profile, and the PIN elements can't access the 5GS anymore.

question_17943.question: What is the initial condition required for testing the ME's text attribute support?
question_17943.ground_truth: The ME is connected to the USIM Simulator, and the TA-TE interface is set to 8-bit operation.

question_17944.question: What is the requirement for the edge of the carrier transmitted at the highest carrier frequency in BS supporting CA for operating band unwanted emissions?
question_17944.ground_truth: The higher edge of the carrier transmitted at the highest carrier frequency shall be the start point of UEM.

question_17947.question: What mandatory action shall the UE take in subclause 5.2.3.2.3.d) if the new cell is not in the forbidden PLMN list?
question_17947.ground_truth: The UE shall initiate a registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update when the current TAI has changed.

question_17948.question: What measures are being taken to protect user location information from active attacks in the 3GPP system?
question_17948.ground_truth: PR 5.8.2-005 states that the 3GPP system shall be able to protect user location information from active attacks.

question_17949.question: What is the structure of the GERAN-Iumode-RAB-Failed-RABAssgntResponse-Item in the provided ASN.1 definition?
question_17949.ground_truth: The GERAN-Iumode-RAB-Failed-RABAssgntResponse-Item is a SEQUENCE that consists of rAB-ID, cause, gERAN-Classmark, and iE-Extensions.

question_17950.question: What are the two Doppler frequency options for the PDSCH requirement in the bi-directional deployment scenario?
question_17950.ground_truth: The two options are 9722Hz targeting 350km/h at 30GHz and 7000Hz with the smallest range of frequency offset estimation.

question_17951.question: How many interruptions are allowed during SCell activation for an unknown SCell in intra-band CA?
question_17951.ground_truth: When the SCell being activated is unknown, up to 1+L3,1 interruptions are allowed during SCell activation in intra-band CA.

question_17952.question: What must the SGM-S do upon receiving a CoAP GET request with a valid VAL group document resource URI?
question_17952.ground_truth: The SGM-S must determine the sender's authorization and return all VAL group documents matching the given query parameters in a 2.05 (Content) response if the sender is authorized.

question_17953.question: What is the action taken by the SMR entity when the RP-SMMA message is not acknowledged by the receiving entity?
question_17953.ground_truth: If the RP-SMMA message is not acknowledged by the receiving entity, the SMR entity in the MS will retransmit the message if the RETRANS flag is not set, or terminate the transmission and reset the RETRANS flag if the maximum number of retransmissions has been reached.

question_17954.question: What is the role of the transmitting part of the SRAP entity on the Uu interface of U2N Relay UE in transmitting SRAP data packets?
question_17954.ground_truth: The transmitting part of the SRAP entity on the Uu interface of U2N Relay UE receives SRAP data packets from the receiving part of the SRAP entity on the PC5 interface of the same U2N Relay UE, constructs SRAP Data PDUs as needed, determines the egress RLC channel, and submits the SRAP Data PDU to the determined egress RLC channel for transmission.

question_17955.question: What is the role of IP Layer in the Xn-C signalling bearer in the NG-RAN?
question_17955.ground_truth: The IP Layer in the Xn-C signalling bearer supports point-to-point transmission for delivering XnAP messages, and supports IPv6 and/or IPv4 for the NG-RAN node. The NG-RAN node supports Diffserv Code Point marking for QoS and traffic management purposes.

question_17958.question: What should the NSACF in Serving PLMN do when the requested UE admission quota or UE admission threshold cannot be satisfied?
question_17958.ground_truth: The NSACF in Serving PLMN shall send a POST request to the resource representing the network slice admission control related to the number of UEs in the NSACF in HPLMN.

question_17959.question: What action should the remote UE take if it receives a lower layers indication that using radio resources for relay communication is not allowed?
question_17959.ground_truth: The remote UE should abort any ongoing procedures involving a relay, start a timer, and release all direct links used for communication with relay(s) after the timer expires.

question_17960.question: What is the priority of service flows in Railway emergency communication compared to Service flows in 6.25.5.2?
question_17960.ground_truth: The priority of service flows in Railway emergency communication is higher than in 6.25.5.2.

question_17962.question: What should NM request NFVO to do as the pre-condition for adding a VNFFG to a NS that contains VLs for virtualized and non-virtualized parts of gNB?
question_17962.ground_truth: NM should request NFVO to use the NS update operation to add a VNFFG to a NS that contains VLs connecting the virtualized parts and non-virtualized parts of the gNB.

question_17965.question: What actions does the UPF take when a N4 Session is released?
question_17965.ground_truth: When a N4 Session is released, the UPF automatically considers the corresponding UE IP addresses as released and removes the PDI or PFCP session that induced the N6 IP address allocation.

question_17966.question: What is the purpose of the SEALDD traffic descriptor for redundant transmission?
question_17966.ground_truth: The SEALDD traffic descriptor for redundant transmission contains the addresses or ports for the redundant transmission paths, which are used for the transmission of SEALDD traffic.

question_17967.question: What is the role of the 5G core network in case of Indirect Network Sharing for inbound roaming users?
question_17967.ground_truth: The 5G core network is responsible for supporting collection of charging information associated with a UE (User Equipment) accessing a Shared NG-RAN (Next-Generation Radio Access Network) using Indirect Network Sharing, which refers to the resource usage of the hosting operator's core network.

question_17968.question: When would the UE store the SNPN identity in the "temporarily forbidden SNPNs" list for non-3GPP access, if the SNPN is selected using credentials from a credentials holder?
question_17968.ground_truth: If the UE is operating in SNPN access operation mode and the service request procedure is rejected with 5GMM cause #74, the UE should store the SNPN identity in the "temporarily forbidden SNPNs" list for the specific access type (non-3GPP access) for which the message was received.

question_17970.question: What is the subject of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification in Release 17?
question_17970.ground_truth: The technical specification outlines the standards for implementing Layer 1 on the X2 interface in the Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access Network (E-UTRAN).

question_17971.question: What is the difference between the minimum requirements and the test requirement in terms of inner loop power control?
question_17971.ground_truth: The minimum requirements refer to the general capability of the UE transmitter to change its output power in response to TPC commands, while the test requirement refers to the specific requirement for the UE transmitter to change its output power within a prescribed range in response to TPC commands during a specific test scenario.

question_17972.question: What is the goal of the LMF initiated Assistance Data Delivery in clause 8.4.3.2.1?
question_17972.ground_truth: The goal of the LMF initiated Assistance Data Delivery in clause 8.4.3.2.1 is to provide assistance data to the UE for the network-assisted barometric pressure sensor method when initiated by the LMF.

question_17974.question: When should the UE send a Binding Update message with a lifetime of 0 to its home address?
question_17974.ground_truth: The UE shall send a Binding Update message with a lifetime of 0 to the HA when it is on the home link and wants to remove the binding at the HA.

question_17975.question: How many assessors participated in the FOA and HIQ tests after post-screening?
question_17975.ground_truth: 10 assessors participated in both the FOA and HIQ tests after post-screening.

question_17977.question: How does the system information on the broadcast channel identify a PLMN?
question_17977.ground_truth: The system information on the broadcast channel can identify a PLMN by either a 'PLMN identity' (GSM-MAP) or a 'SID' (System Identification), or both.

question_17978.question: What information should the SLM-C include in the "location-capability" object when sending a CoAP POST request to the SLM-S for registering location services?
question_17978.ground_truth: The SLM-C may include the "location-access-type" or "positioning-method" in the "location-capability" object.

question_17979.question: What information is checked while sending the assigned USF on the lowest PACCH for the assigned PDCH-pairs?
question_17979.ground_truth: While sending the assigned USF on the lowest PACCH for the assigned PDCH-pairs, it is checked that the MS sends RLC/MAC data in correct reduced radio block on all assigned PDCH-pairs with USF GRANULARITY set to 1 block.

question_17980.question: What is the problem with using the same IPSec Security Association (SA) for different classes of traffic differentiated by DSCP bits when anti-replay feature is implemented?
question_17980.ground_truth: It could result in inappropriate discarding of lower priority packets due to the windowing mechanism used by this feature.

question_17981.question: What is the purpose of the floor control message in off-network group calls?
question_17981.ground_truth: The floor control message is used to indicate a request for the floor and can be monitored by all members within the MCPTT group.

question_17983.question: What is the purpose of the "3GPP-specified MooD header field" in the MooD redirect response?
question_17983.ground_truth: The MooD header field triggers the activation of the MBMS receiver in the UE, indicating an MCBC (MBMS Consumed By Content) to the BM-SC, and providing entry point information to the USD.

question_17984.question: What should be the behavior of the network when deregistering or deactivating active UEs?
question_17984.ground_truth: Deregistration or deactivation of active UEs should not always require the involvement of the UE affected by the setting. However, the network should only process deactivation and deregistration requests from UEs belonging to the same PN. A UE performing activations should have the capability to perform the deactivations for these settings.

question_17985.question: Which of the following best represents a subframe in this AMR-WB+ codec discussion: 1.25 ms, 5 ms, or 40 ms?
question_17985.ground_truth: 5 milliseconds (ms) at a 12.8 kHz sampling rate.

question_17986.question: What is the aim of SEALDD data distribution mechanisms?
question_17986.ground_truth: To provide interactions between the SEALDD client and SEALDD server for data transmission, control and manage the SEALDD data distribution between the VAL client and VAL server, and manage the bitrate of different users dynamically.

question_17987.question: What positioning requirements does the 5G system need to meet in order to support a UE outdoors?
question_17987.ground_truth: The 5G system needs to provide a positioning service with 2m horizontal position accuracy, 90% availability, and less than 1s latency for the UE outdoors.

question_17988.question: What is the name of the procedure used to establish necessary resources in an eNB for an incoming handover?

question_17989.question: What does the "Preemption Capability indicator" bit mean in the VGCS/VBS Assignment procedure?
question_17989.ground_truth: If the "Preemption Capability indicator" bit is set to 1 in the VGCS/VBS Assignment procedure, then this allocation request can trigger the running of the preemption procedure and if set to 0, it cannot trigger the preemption procedure.

question_17990.question: When does the MS use the new timing advance?
question_17990.ground_truth: The MS uses the new timing advance at the first TDMA frame belonging to the next reporting period after the SACCH frame containing the new TA value.

question_17991.question: What must the IWF identify in the SIP request to determine the served MCPTT group ID for MCPTT user eligibility?
question_17991.ground_truth: The served MCPTT group ID is identified in the `<mcptt-request-uri>` element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body of the SIP request.

question_17992.question: What is the initial state of the UE before the start of time duration T1?
question_17992.ground_truth: At the start of the test, the UE does not have any timing information of cell 2.

question_17993.question: What should be the target for user throughput per MHz at the 5% point of the C.D.F. in the downlink, compared to Release 6 HSDPA?
question_17993.ground_truth: The target for user throughput per MHz at the 5% point of the C.DF. in the downlink should be 2 to 3 times that of Release 6 HSDPA.

question_17994.question: What is the reduction in battery life for eMTC/NB-IoT at 164 dB MCL and 144 dB MCL, respectively, for a UE using an integrated GNSS module and IoT module, as observed by Ericsson?
question_17994.ground_truth: The reduction in battery life for eMTC/NB-IoT at 164 dB MCL is up to around 6%, and at 144 dB MCL is up to around 17%, for a UE using an integrated GNSS module and IoT module, as observed by Ericsson.

question_17995.question: How does the AF request selecting the same EAS for a collection of UEs?
question_17995.ground_truth: The AF requests selecting the same EAS for a collection of UEs by including a Dynamic External Group ID per DNAI or per External Application ID in the AF request. The PCF then determines the affected UEs and creates PCC rules with the application ID and the Dynamic External Group ID, along with a DNAI correlation indication and/or EAS correlation indication.

question_17996.question: What should be the MS behavior on the uplink when the radio link counter S is decreased?
question_17996.ground_truth: The MS shall continue transmitting as normal on the uplink until the radio link counter S reaches 0.

question_17997.question: What message is sent by the UE when the Access Stratum indicates move-traffic-to-WLAN in multi-connection mode?
question_17997.ground_truth: The UE sends the WLCP PDN Modification Command message including a move-to-WLAN indication.

question_17998.question: What is the activation mechanism of the Go Back byte code?
question_17998.ground_truth: The Go Back byte code forces branching to the last anchor pushed on the history list, but it has no impact on the history list itself.

question_18001.question: In the scenario where the session starts in 3GPP access, what is performed in step 5 for each PDN connection that is being transferred from 3GPP access during the handover?
