question_18001.ground_truth: If not performed in 3GPP access prior to the handover, Step 5 is repeated for each PDN connection that is being transferred from 3GPP access to initiate the PDN GW Initiated PDN Disconnection procedure in 3GPP access or the PDN GW Initiated Bearer Deactivation procedure as defined in TS23.401 clause5.4.4.1.

question_18002.question: How can the MMSE-based receiver help in interference limited cases in a UE with modules on the same face?
question_18002.ground_truth: The MMSE-based receiver performs better than the RAN4 SINR calculation estimate for narrow AoA offsets where interference limited cases become more dominant in a UE with modules on the same face.

question_18003.question: In which storage location is the KAUSF stored if the USIM supports 5G parameters storage?
question_18003.ground_truth: If the USIM supports 5G parameters storage, the KAUSF is stored in the USIM.

question_18004.question: What is the meaning of the term "multimedia messaging body part (MMBP)" in the context of the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_18004.ground_truth: The term "multimedia messaging body part (MMBP)" refers to the definition of parts of message body that carry multimedia content in the 3GPP Technical Specification.

question_18005.question: What is the impact of the solution on the existing nodes and functionality in terms of the MME/SGSN?
question_18005.ground_truth: The MME/SGSN will have new connectionless data procedures, connectionless paging support, and will indicate the network support of the connectionless mode in Attach/TAU accept message.

question_18006.question: In which ways can Rel-14 LTE provide simultaneous support for broadcast/multicast and unicast?
question_18006.ground_truth: Rel-14 LTE can provide simultaneous support for broadcast/multicast and unicast in the following ways: a) time-multiplexing MBSFN and non-MBSFN subframes on the same carrier, b) using SC-PTM for multicast/broadcast on the same carrier, and c) on separate carriers, using a dedicated MBMS carrier for multicast services. This enables coexistence of both multicast/broadcast and unicast transmissions within the LTE network.

question_18007.question: What is the test signal that should be used for the measurements in the electrical interface UE sending section?
question_18007.ground_truth: The British-English single talk sequence described in ITU-T Recommendation P.501.

question_18008.question: What is the task of designers of specific managed object classes in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_18008.ground_truth: The task of designers of specific managed object classes in the 3GPP Technical Specification is to model the state conditions of the associated network resources using the generic attributes provided in the State Management Data Definition IRP.

question_18009.question: What is the purpose of using EAP-AKA for device authentication in this solution?
question_18009.ground_truth: The H(e)NB (Home eNodeB) is authenticated by the SeGW (Security Gateway) using EAP-AKA for device authentication during the set-up of IPsec security associations between the SeGW and the H(e)NB.

question_18010.question: What is the purpose of the EAP Identifier in the NSSAA procedure?
question_18010.ground_truth: The EAP Identifier is used during the NSSAA procedure to identify the slice authentication for the corresponding NSSAA application. It is stored at the NSSAA application level and can be retrieved and used by the ME.

question_18011.question: What is the procedure when a UE moves a PDU Session from 3GPP access to non-3GPP access and an I-SMF had been inserted?
question_18011.ground_truth: An I-SMF may need to be removed during PDU Session mobility from 3GPP to non-3GPP access. Similarly, an I-SMF may need to be inserted during PDU Session mobility from non-3GPP to 3GPP access if the TA associated with the UE location requires the AMF to insert an I-SMF.

question_18012.question: What modulation is used for each HS-PDSCH in the test models?

question_18013.question: What should the MCData client include in the application/resource-lists MIME body of the SIP REFER request when initiating a group SDS session within a pre-established session?
question_18013.ground_truth: The MCData client should include a single <entry> element containing a "uri" attribute set to the MCData group identity, extended with the specified parameters in the headers portion of the SIP URI.

question_18014.question: What is the significance of the Target Info parameter in UE discovery?
question_18014.ground_truth: The Target Info parameter is not provisioned in the UE. It is provided by the application layer in the UE (e.g. manually selected by the user from a contacts list).

question_18015.question: What is the role of the H-PCRF in case 2b during IP-CAN session establishment when session linking is not deferred?
question_18015.ground_truth: The H-PCRF selects or generates PCC rules and derives QoS rules from them, taking into account the user's MPS EPS Priority, MPS Priority Level, and IMS Signalling Priority.

question_18016.question: What is the intention behind the introduction of new per-band capability signaling for FR1 UEs supporting transparent TxD in Rel-16?
question_18016.ground_truth: The intention is to enable release independent support of this new capability from Rel-15 for PC2, if possible. RAN4 also respectfully asked RAN2 to define the corresponding signaling in Rel-16 and discuss release independence to Rel-15.

question_18019.question: What action does the PGW-C take when initiating the bearer deactivation procedure based on IP-CAN modifications encountered by the PCRF?
question_18019.ground_truth: The PGW-C sends an Sx Session Modification Request to the existing PGW-U for deactivating the dedicated bearer for the UE.

question_18021.question: What is the name of the 3GPP specification, 20.907, that defines script and CSS and various APIs to support media synchronization, SVG animation, scene updates, etc., for use by web app-based interactive apps?

question_18022.question: What is the purpose of the "Inter-working CAT" feature in the CAT system?
question_18022.ground_truth: The purpose of "Inter-working CAT" is to ensure a consistent CAT experience for users, regardless of whether they or the other party are roaming.

question_18024.question: What is the recommended approach when defining a new performance measurement that is similar to a measurement already defined in another standard?
question_18024.ground_truth: The recommendation is to reference the other standard and only define the missing properties that differentiate the new measurement from the existing one.

question_18025.question: In which order should the UE include resultsSSB-Cell in the measResultNeighCells?
question_18025.ground_truth: The UE should include the resultsSSB-Cell in the measResultNeighCells in decreasing order of the sorting quantity, determined as specified in 5.5.5.3, i.e. the best cell is included first.

question_18026.question: What functional entity is introduced in the UDC architecture in "Solution 2"?
question_18026.ground_truth: A new functional entity, a central server, is introduced in the UDC architecture in "Solution 2".

question_18027.question: Which tests require the UE to report SSB time index?
question_18027.ground_truth: Tests 1 and 2 require the UE to report SSB time index.

question_18029.question: What is the maximum allowed timing difference between any two TRXs in a BSS as per step f)?
question_18029.ground_truth: The maximum allowed timing difference between any two TRXs is 1/4 symbol, measured at the BSS antenna connector.

question_18030.question: What is the unit of QoS differentiation in the MA PDU Session?
question_18030.ground_truth: The QoS Flow is the finest granularity of QoS differentiation in the MA PDU Session.

question_18033.question: Under what conditions the MS shall use a TA value of 0 for the Random Access burst sent?
question_18033.ground_truth: Under normal conditions, the MS shall use a TA value of 0 for the Random Access burst sent.

question_18034.question: What should the NF Service Consumer include in the POST request if the AMF determines that the RAT type is NB-IoT and the UE has already 2 PDU Sessions with user plane resources activated?
question_18034.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should include the cpCiotEnabled IE or cpOnlyInd IE with the value "True" in the POST request, indicating that the UE is able to support Control Plane CIoT 5GS Optimisation for the PDU session.

question_18035.question: What is the criticality of the "id-gNB-DU-UE-F1AP-ID" in the "UEContextSetupRequestIEs F1AP-PROTOCOL-IES" sequence?
question_18035.ground_truth: The criticality of "id-gNB-DU-UE-F1AP-ID" is "ignore" in the "UEContextSetupRequestIEs F1AP-PROTOCOL-IES" sequence.

question_18037.question: What is the role of the PLMN and the PSTN in service interworking?
question_18037.ground_truth: Service interworking is required when the teleservices at the calling and called terminals are different. However, no service interworking, except for facsimile group 3, has been identified as a requirement of the PLMN system for PSTN/ISDN network-based services.

question_18038.question: What is the most significant octet in the type Integer in the RADIUS attribute as specified in subclause 16.4.7.2?
question_18038.ground_truth: The most significant octet is the first one in the type Integer.

question_18040.question: What is the role of the Non-3GPP Message Gateway in the Non-3GPP UE to Application Server message delivery procedure?
question_18040.ground_truth: The Non-3GPP Message Gateway translates the Non-3GPP Message into an MSGin5G message and sends it to the MSGin5G Server as specified in clause 8.3.2.

question_18041.question: What actions should be performed if the network initiates the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update?
question_18041.ground_truth: The UE in 5GMM-REGISTERED state should initiate the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update by sending a REGISTRATION REQUEST message to the AMF.

question_18042.question: What should a UE do after finding a ProSe Application Code(s) that matches the Discovery Filters, if there are no corresponding ProSe Application ID(s) stored?
question_18042.ground_truth: The UE should re-establish a secure connection with the ProSe Function in HPLMN and send a Match Report message.

question_18043.question: What is used to avoid reuse of the COUNT with the same RB identity and with the same KeNB?
question_18043.ground_truth: The eNB may use different RB identities for successive RB establishments, trigger an intra cell handover or by triggering a transition from RRC_CONNECTED to RRC_IDLE or RRC_INACTIVE and then back to RRC_CONNECTED.

question_18044.question: What information should the CHF send in the Charging Data Response message when changing the non-blocking mode?
question_18044.ground_truth: The CHF sends the Charging Data Response with the Non-Blocking mode change and the non-blocking mode set by CHF in the Charging Data Response message.

question_18045.question: What HTTP response would the server return if the document URI in the Request-URI has an incorrect application id?
question_18045.ground_truth: The server would return an HTTP 409 (Conflict) response including the XCAP error element <constraint-failure>.

question_18046.question: When does a Change of Position (Session) service event get reported within a GPRS Session relationship?
question_18046.ground_truth: A Change of Position (Session) service event gets reported within a GPRS Session relationship when it is the first subsequent event to be reported for a PDP Context within a GPRS Session relationship and the PDP Context Establishment event for this PDP Context was not reported.

question_18047.question: What type of interference may occur when BS supporting CA of Band 1 and Band 18 are used in specific frequency ranges?

question_18048.question: What is the purpose of the PRIVATE CALL SETUP REQUEST message in the context of MCVideo?
question_18048.ground_truth: The PRIVATE CALL SETUP REQUEST message is used to initiate a private call in the context of MCVideo. It is generated when the MCVideo user requests the establishment of a private call, and is transmitted by the MCVideo client to the MCVideo server.

question_18049.question: What takes precedence when selecting an SGSN based on both low access priority and UE Usage Type parameter?
question_18049.ground_truth: Selection based on the UE Usage type parameter overrides selection based on the low access priority indication.

question_18050.question: What is the purpose of the T8 Long Term Transaction Reference ID in the 3GPP specification?
question_18050.ground_truth: The T8 Long Term Transaction Reference ID (TLTRI) in the 3GPP specification is a parameter that refers to long term transactions between the SCEF and the SCS/AS when using the T8 interface. TLTRI is assigned by the SCEF and is unique through the duration of the transaction. It is stored on both the SCEF and the SCS/AS for the duration of the transaction.

question_18052.question: What is the functionality of the IAB-node in the 5G RAN architecture?
question_18052.ground_truth: The IAB-node in the 5G RAN architecture is a relaying node that supports access and backhauling via NR. It terminates the NR access interface to UEs and next-hop IAB-nodes, and terminates the F1 protocol to the gNB-CU functionality on the IAB-donor.

question_18054.question: What is the purpose of the +CMUX command, and what is its default setting?
question_18054.ground_truth: The +CMUX command is used to enable/disable the 3GPP TS 27.010 multiplexing protocol control channel. The default setting for port speed in the +CMUX command is implementation-specific.

question_18056.question: What is the action taken if the UE does not move to the predicted location in service continuity planning?
question_18056.ground_truth: If the UE does not move to the predicted location, then the EEC does not connect to the T-EES, and the AC does not connect to the T-EAS.

question_18057.question: What is the purpose of the "Create Component" procedure in the Rp interface?
question_18057.ground_truth: The "Create Component" procedure is used by the application to add a new profile component in the contacted repository.

question_18059.question: In the static variables defined in the C-code, what is the purpose of the variable 'chLLRbuffer'?
question_18059.ground_truth: The variable 'chLLRbuffer' is a soft bit buffer of the turbo decoder used in the C-code.

question_18060.question: What message is used to confirm the arrival of the MS in the target cell during a handover from a GAN A/Gb mode cell?
question_18060.ground_truth: The MS confirms its arrival in the target cell by sending a message indicating that it has arrived in the target cell.

question_18061.question: How is the disparity of timed graphics handled when accompanying stereo video?
question_18061.ground_truth: The disparity of timed graphics is signalled when accompanying stereo video, in order for it to be displayed at an appropriate depth, avoiding any perceptual depth conflicts with the video. It is measured in the same units as the track dimensions, with positive values moving the timed graphics away from the viewer and negative values moving it towards the viewer.

question_18063.question: Under what conditions do the PUCCH with DM-RS bundling requirement tests apply for TDD with different subcarrier spacings?
question_18063.ground_truth: The PUCCH with DM-RS bundling requirement tests apply for each subcarrier spacing declared to be supported in TDD with different subcarrier spacings.

question_18064.question: What should an MTSI client do if it receives an SDP bandwidth modifier for RTCP equal to zero from the originating MTSI client in a point-to-point speech only session?
question_18064.ground_truth: If an MTSI client receives SDP bandwidth modifiers for RTCP equal to zero from the originating MTSI client in a point-to-point speech only session, it should reply by setting its RTCP bandwidth using SDP bandwidth modifiers with values equal to zero.

question_18065.question: What is the information provided by the CN to RAN to optimize gNB radio resource scheduling for XR traffic?
question_18065.ground_truth: The information provided by the CN to RAN to optimize gNB radio resource scheduling for XR traffic includes the periodicity for UL and DL traffic of the QoS Flow, DL traffic jitter information, PDU Set QoS parameters, and PDU Set Information and Identification.

question_18067.question: What is the role of the common E-RNTI in the E-RNTI collision resolution phase?
question_18067.ground_truth: The common E-RNTI is used as a UE ID in the E-RUCCH and is provided to the Node B to identify the UE. The Node B sends an E-AGCH with the common E-RNTI within the common E-RNTI scheduling window when it receives a random access request from the common E-RNTI. The UE considers the collision resolution phase to be over when it receives an E-AGCH with its common E-RNTI in the common E-RNTI scheduling window.

question_18068.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 45.005 subclause 6.2, what is the test purpose for verifying the AM suppression performance of a mobile station (MS)?
question_18068.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify that the AM suppression performance of the MS meets the conformance requirements with an allowance for the statistical significance of the test.

question_18069.question: What should the SGSN do if it receives a paging request while the Mobility Management back-off timer is running and the MS's TIN indicates "GUTI"?
question_18069.ground_truth: The SGSN should detect that it is an intra-SGSN routeing area update, and no need to inform the GGSNs or the HLR about the new MS location.

question_18071.question: What happens when MC service client 1 is granted transmission permission in the MC service group?
question_18071.ground_truth: MC service client 1 transmits a media stream to the group host MC service server, which sends a single media stream to the serving MC service server of MC service clients 2, 3 and n in the partner MC system of the MC service group for media replication and distribution to MC service clients 2, 3 and n.

question_18072.question: How does the network handle the request for different supplementary service procedures within a single message, and what ensures the correlation of supplementary service operations and their responses?
question_18072.ground_truth: The request for different supplementary service procedures within a single message is identified by the Invoke identifier present within the Facility information element itself. The correlation of supplementary service operations and their responses is facilitated by the combination of the transaction identifier of the messages containing the Facility information element and the Invoke identifier present within the Facility information element itself. This ensures proper tracking and response communication.

question_18073.question: What information does the SMS-SC store when it fails to deliver a trigger message?
question_18073.ground_truth: The SMS-SC stores the trigger payload, without routing information, if the message delivery fails and is attempted to be delivered again.

question_18074.question: What is the latency target for exception reporting in the NB M2M solution?
question_18074.ground_truth: The latency target for exception reporting in the NB M2M solution is 10 seconds.

question_18075.question: What parameter should be used by an MTSI client in terminal setting up asymmetric video streams with H.265 (HEVC)?

question_18076.question: What should the UE do when the T390 timer is running in the 5G System?
question_18076.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T390 for all access categories and perform the actions as specified in 5.3.14.4.

question_18077.question: When the SS-UE receives the MIB-SL over the sidelink system control port, how is the DirectFrameNumber set?
question_18077.ground_truth: A dummy value is provided by TTCN, and the SS-UE should set the DirectFrameNumber and DirectSubframeNumber in the MIB-SL.

question_18078.question: What should the source eNB do if the timer TRLOCprep expires before receiving any response from the target eNB after sending a Handover Request message?
question_18078.ground_truth: The source eNB should cancel the Handover Preparation procedure towards the target eNB by initiating the Handover Cancel procedure with the appropriate value for the Cause IE and remove any reference and release any resources related to the concerned X2 UE-associated signalling.

question_18079.question: Which extension is defined for the WWW-Authenticate header field in the SIP core network for UE authentication procedure in 3GPP TS 24.229?
question_18079.ground_truth: This extension defines a new authentication parameter (auth-param) for the WWW-Authenticate header field used in a 401 (Unauthorized) response to the REGISTER request. The S-CSCF appends the integrity-key and cipher-key parameters (directive) to the WWW-Authenticate header field in a 401 (Unauthorized) response and the P-CSCF stores the integrity-key and cipher-key value respectively. The P-CSCF removes the integrity-key and cipher-key parameter from the header field prior to forwarding the response to the UE.

question_18080.question: What does the T3 parameter represent in the hopping sequence generation algorithm?
question_18080.ground_truth: The T3 parameter is a time parameter defined in the hopping sequence generation algorithm, and it is used in the calculation of M'. Along with T1 and T2, the value of T3 is used to calculate M, serving as an input in the creation of the hopping sequence.

question_18081.question: How does the key download procedure reduce signalling, data, and key processing in the MCX system?
question_18081.ground_truth: By allowing multiple entities to share the same key, the key download procedure reduces the number of group key distribution messages and key processing required. Additionally, it allows keys to be updated without making a new bearer announcement message, further reducing the number of required messages and processing.

question_18082.question: What is the duration for which the specific conditions for GPRS only devices are kept for GSM~900, DCS~1~800, and PCS 1 900?
question_18082.ground_truth: The conditions are kept for 30 seconds for all three frequency bands.

question_18083.question: When retrieving a group document for a non-controlling MCVideo function to initiate a temporary group session, what does the requested group identity refer to in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body of the SIP INVITE request?
question_18083.ground_truth: The requested group identity refers to the group identity of the constituent group contained in the <associated-group-id> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body of the SIP INVITE request.

question_18084.question: What are the implications of considering COMM = T as inconsistent with certain states and sub-states in the context of Group Call Control?
question_18084.ground_truth: COMM = T is inconsistent with states U0, U3, U4, and with sub-states U2nc and U2r of state U2. This means that the communication should not be established in those states or sub-states.

question_18086.question: What is the main challenge in providing network assistance for enhancing QoE in V2X applications?
question_18086.ground_truth: The main challenge is that the quality experienced by a V2X UE changes dynamically during an ongoing session due to mobility, channel quality, and content variability, requiring adaptation by the V2X application server.

question_18087.question: What is the role of a Network Management (NM) system in a 3G telecommunication network?
question_18087.ground_truth: A NM system provides fault management services and functions required by the 3G operator on top of the element management layer. It connects to either Element Mangers (EMs) or Network Elements (NEs) by means of Integration Reference Points (IRPs).

question_18088.question: What action should the MS take if it receives a supervisory RNR frame from the SS indicating a busy condition?
question_18088.ground_truth: The MS should stop sending I+S frames, start the retransmission timer T201, and retransmit the unacknowledged frame after T201 seconds.

question_18089.question: What field is set to the From header field value as received in the initial INVITE request in the To header field when a SIP dialog is established?
question_18089.ground_truth: The To header field is set to the From header field value as received in the initial INVITE request.

question_18090.question: What functions can the NEF perform regarding the usage of AF specific UE identifier?
question_18090.ground_truth: The NEF can enforce restriction on the usage of AF specific UE identifier, such as rejection of a service request from AF not authorized to use the UE identifier.

question_18092.question: What does the first octet of the URCMP header represent?
question_18092.ground_truth: The first octet of the URCMP header represents the message version and should be set to decimal 1 ("001").

question_18094.question: How many documents are used to define an interface in Parlay X?
question_18094.ground_truth: There are three documents used to define an interface in Parlay X: Types Definitions Document, Shared Faults Document (if needed), and Service Interface Document.

question_18096.question: What is the frequency range affected by the IMDs generated within the band 3 receiver?
question_18096.ground_truth: The IMDs generated within the band 3 receiver should be well below the receiver noise floor, eliminating the possibility of receiver desensitization.

question_18098.question: When is the MBMS UE's termination procedure started immediately, regardless of the protection period?
question_18098.ground_truth: The MBMS UE's termination procedure is started immediately if it is triggered before the session end time or after the protection period end time.

question_18100.question: What must be enhanced in the MAP message for use on the FE-FE interface in questingNodeType of "s-cscf"?
question_18100.ground_truth: The MAP message is slightly enhanced for use on the FE-FE interface in questingNodeType of "s-cscf".

question_18101.question: What is the goal of solution #6 - End-to-end security establishment for Layer-2 UE-to-UE relay?
question_18101.ground_truth: The goal of solution #6 is to address security requirement for providing confidentiality, integrity protection of end-to-end information exchanged between the peer UEs over the L2 UE-to-UE Relay in key issue #2 by performing service authorization and policy provisioning for the Source UE, Target UE and UE-to-UE Relay, security establishment for PC5 link between the source UE and UE-to-UE relay and between the target UE and UE-to-UE relay, and End-to-End PC5 link establishment between the source UE and target UE.

question_18102.question: What type of information is carried in a PDU-Set in the context of 5GS and real-time media?
question_18102.ground_truth: A PDU-Set is composed of one or more PDUs carrying the payload of one unit of information generated at the application level, such as a frame or video slice for XRM Services.

question_18103.question: What is one method used by operators to improve network coverage when customers complain about poor coverage or throughput?
question_18103.ground_truth: Operators perform drive tests in the relevant area to observe the coverage quality and take actions such as deploying new cells or adjusting antenna tilting of existing cells.

question_18104.question: In what situation should an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-location-info+xml MIME body be included in a 3GPP MCPTT floor-request message?
question_18104.ground_truth: This MIME body should be included in the message if the user or participant with permission to send media is either an MCPTT client with location information available, or a participant homed in the IWF with location information available, and that information has either not been sent before or has changed since it was last sent.

question_18105.question: What is the role of the compositor in the tethered display AR Glasses context?
question_18105.ground_truth: The compositor is responsible for taking all the received layers, performing any necessary corrections such as pose correction and lens distortion, compositing them, and then sending the final frame to the display.

question_18108.question: What is the method used by SEALDD server 2, when it has no transportation layer service continuity support, to notify the SEALDD client of a SEALDD Connection info update?
question_18108.ground_truth: SEALDD server 2 sends a SEALDD Connection info update notification to the SEALDD client with updated allocated IP address and port for SEALDD-Uu user plane communication.

question_18109.question: What should be used as the WX UE ID if the WLAN air interface cannot be changed?
question_18109.ground_truth: The UE WLAN MAC address could be used as the WX UE ID in this case.

question_18110.question: What is the default value of the TMSI field in bytes 1 to 4 for the LOCI file?
question_18110.ground_truth: Bytes 1 to 4 in the LOCI file are FFFF to represent the TMSI. This stands for "FF FF FF FF" in hexadecimal.

question_18111.question: When will the MS start using the extended idle mode DRX cycle?
question_18111.ground_truth: The MS will use the extended idle mode DRX cycle only if the network has provided the extended DRX parameters IE during the last attach procedure.

question_18112.question: What is the method used to estimate Timing Advance (TA) values in the 9.6.2 procedure for the PS domain in A/Gb-mode?
question_18112.ground_truth: The 9.6.2 procedure uses three different methods to estimate TA values: the RLC data block method, the extended access burst method, and the access burst method.

question_18113.question: What is the purpose of the sub-block interleaver used with the three output streams?
question_18113.ground_truth: The sub-block interleaver is used to interleave the three output streams, which are then sent to rate matching for bit collection and selection.

question_18114.question: What is the minimum set of video resolutions and frame rates that the MCVideo service shall support for rendering of video information?
question_18114.ground_truth: The MCVideo service shall support video resolution at least from 320 x 240 at 10 frames per second up to and beyond 1280 x 720 at 30 frames per second.

question_18116.question: In subclause 5.6.1.1 a), what should the UE set in the Control plane service type of the CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message when it has pending user data to be sent via the user plane?
question_18116.ground_truth: The UE should set the Control plane service type to "mobile terminating request".

question_18117.question: What action does the SS take in step 1.13B if the MS does not send a "location updating request" on either carrier 1 or 2 within 30 minutes after step 1.11 is completed?
question_18117.ground_truth: The SS checks that the MS sends a "location updating request" on channel 1 between 30 and 60 minutes after step 1.11 is completed.

question_18118.question: What should the participating MCVideo function do if it does not receive a 200 (OK) message from a specific MCVideo client upon sending a MuSiK download message?
question_18118.ground_truth: If the participating MCVideo function does not receive a 200 (OK) message from a specific MCVideo client, it shall use unicast signalling for transmission control towards that MCVideo client for the groups for which the MuSiK was intended.

question_18119.question: What are the potential impacts on HS-SCCH format due to cross carrier scheduling?
question_18119.ground_truth: If cross carrier scheduling is specified, there is some chance that the HS-SCCH format could be impacted, depending on the eventual solution.

question_18121.question: What is the role of the default V-SMF during a handover procedure in 5G roaming scenarios?
question_18121.ground_truth: The default V-SMF handles the Data Forwarding Tunnel Info in the case of home routed roaming and indicates the mapping between the TEID where the UPF receives data forwarded by the source SGW and the QFI(s) and N3 Tunnel Info for data forwarding where the UPF is selected to forward such data.

question_18122.question: In what situation will the MS send a RELEASE COMPLETE message containing a LocationNotification return result with verificationResponse set to permissionDenied?
question_18122.ground_truth: When the user denies the location request.

question_18123.question: What is a drawback of Alternative 2 for overload control information propagation?
question_18123.ground_truth: A drawback of Alternative 2 is that it may result in redundant information being included in multiple messages, and extra processing may be required at the receiver to compare and discard new information if it is the same as old information received from the same node.

question_18125.question: What is the document titled that provides specifications for the 3GPP IMS Management Object?
question_18125.ground_truth: The title of the document is "3rd Generation Partnership Project; Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terms; 3GPP IMS Management Object (MO); Stage 3 (Release 18)".

question_18126.question: What is a solution set in the context of the 3GPP GERAN NRM IRP?
question_18126.ground_truth: A solution set is a specification that defines the communication protocol, data model, and information exchange mechanisms for the 3GPPTM GERAN NRM integration. It provides an interface for management of GERAN resources.

question_18127.question: What should the MSGin5G Gateway UE do upon reception of a CoAP 2.04 (Change) response for the bulk de-registration request from the MSGin5G Server?
question_18127.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Gateway UE should split the content of the "List of individual MSGin5G UE de-registration response" element into multiple individual de-registration responses and generate one or more CoAP POST requests as de-registration responses to constrained UEs separately.

question_18129.question: What is the scope of this study?
question_18129.ground_truth: The study aims to identify key issues and solutions in order to address the security aspects of employing AI/ML techniques in RAN.

question_18130.question: What is the recommended solution for routing IPv6 packets encapsulated in IPv4 over an IPv4 transport network?
question_18130.ground_truth: An efficient solution for IPv6 encapsulated packets is to be routed based on the destination IPv6 address as standardized in IETF~RFC~5969.

question_18131.question: What is the main idea of dynamic PUCCH repetition factor indication?
question_18131.ground_truth: The feature allows network to adjust PUCCH repetition factor in a flexible fashion based on channel conditions and traffic load. Network can use existing PRI in DCI to point to a PUCCH resource where the associated repetition factor will be applied to the PUCCH transmission.

question_18132.question: What is the difference between OpenID Provider driven identifier selection and a user entering their own Identifier in the OpenID field?
question_18132.ground_truth: OpenID Provider driven identifier selection allows a user to enter the URL of their OpenID Provider into an OpenID field, rather than their personal OpenID URL. This allows the web site (RP) to start the OpenID authentication flow and send the user over to the correct OpenID provider. While entering their own OpenID URL will simply authenticate the user with that specific URL.

question_18133.question: What is the difference between "Basic" and "Bilateral" in the context of Called Party Number transfer in the VPLMN or HPLMN?
question_18133.ground_truth: "Basic" refers to the transfer of the full Called Party Number received in VPLMN or HPLMN on its own in the AssistRequestInstructions operation CorrelationID parameter. "Bilateral" refers to the extraction of CorrelationID from Called Party Number in HPLMN or VPLMN and transferring it on its own in AssistRequestInstructions CorrelationID field to a gsmSCF in HPLMN.

question_18134.question: What is the role of the ProSe Key Management Function (PKMF) in the process of establishing a shared key KD between a Remote UE and a UE-to-network relay?
question_18134.ground_truth: The PKMF is responsible for authorizing the Remote UE to receive UE-to-network Relay service, generating a fresh PRUK ID, and generating the KD Freshness Parameter. It then sends the Remote UE Identity, KD, KD Freshness Parameter, and GPI (if used to calculate a fresh PRUK) to the UE-to-network relay.

question_18135.question: Which combinations of system information blocks (NR-X) are used in sidelink communication test cases?
question_18135.ground_truth: Combinations NR-14, NR-15, NR-16, and NR-17 are used in sidelink communication test cases.

question_18136.question: What are the reporting requirements for RSTD measurements in NPRS occasions?
question_18136.ground_truth: The UE physical layer shall be capable of reporting RSTD for the reference cell and all the neighbor cells i out of at least (n-1) neighbor cells, where n is the number of cells including the reference cell, all with a minimum NPRS subframes per cell measurement, and with a maximum NPRP in a corresponding band.

question_18137.question: What is the role of the Short Message Relay Layer (SM-RL) in the SMS protocol?
question_18137.ground_truth: The SM-RL is a service provided to the Short Message Transfer Layer (SM-TL) that enables it to send and receive Transfer Protocol Data Units (TPDUs) to its peer entity and receive reports about earlier requests for TPDUs to be transferred.

question_18138.question: What is the priority level of the positioning accuracy requirement for the 3GPP system?
question_18138.ground_truth: The priority level of the positioning accuracy requirement for the 3GPP system is PPP (Priority, Precedence, Preemption) as failure to transmit communications in a reliable and timely manner could result in loss of property or life.

question_18139.question: What indication does the MN include in the SN Addition procedure to request the target SN to allocate resources for the UE in the SN initiated SN change procedure?
question_18139.ground_truth: The MN requests the target SN to allocate resources for the UE by means of the SN Addition procedure, including the measurement results related to the target SN received from the source SN.

question_18140.question: What are the possible subsequent service events that the CSE can activate when the PDP deactivation event occurs within a GPRS session relationship?
question_18140.ground_truth: The CSE can activate instructions for PDP deactivation, changes of position (PDP context and session), and detach procedure.

question_18141.question: In what situation will the UE take a non-current native 5G NAS security context into use and delete the mapped 5G NAS security context?
question_18141.ground_truth: When the security context flag included in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message is set to "native security context", the ngKSI matches a valid non-current native 5G NAS security context held in the UE, and the UE has a mapped 5G NAS security context as the current 5G NAS security context.

question_18142.question: What will happen if an emergency indicator is present in the received MCData group data request and the MCData group is not in in-progress emergency state?
question_18142.ground_truth: The MCData group will be considered to be in the in-progress emergency state until cancelled.

question_18143.question: What are the two pre-conditions for using Real-time Speech to Speech translation?
question_18143.ground_truth: The two pre-conditions are that the FRMCS System is aware of the native language of the FRMCS User and that both users have selected their roles for point-to-point communication.

question_18144.question: What is the function of the "b=AS:0" line in the SDP offer in the INVITE request in Alternative 4?
question_18144.ground_truth: The "b=AS:0" line in the SDP offer in the INVITE request in Alternative 4 indicates to reserve a non-GBR voice media bearer for the RTP media and releases the radio resource of the non-GBR voice media bearer.

question_18145.question: In NOMA link level simulations, how many cases were defined in Template 1 for detailed description of link performance?
question_18145.ground_truth: A total of 35 cases were defined in Template 1.

question_18146.question: What action must the UE take upon receiving a TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message?
question_18146.ground_truth: The UE must stop timer T3430, reset the service request attempt counter, and set the EPS update status to EU1 UPDATED.

question_18148.question: When the SMF receives a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST during a network-requested PDU session release procedure, what should the SMF do if the indicated PDU session is the same?
question_18148.ground_truth: The SMF shall ignore the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message and proceed with the PDU session release procedure.

question_18149.question: What should the MRFC do if the SRGS script is larger than the transport capability of the Mp interface in the ASR procedure?
question_18149.ground_truth: The MRFC should terminate the ASR procedure and return an error.

question_18152.question: What is the effect of the "On Modification" Report Characteristics IE when the SFN IE is provided?
question_18152.ground_truth: If the Report Characteristics IE is set to "On Modification" and the SFN IE is provided, the Node B shall initiate the Common Measurement Reporting procedure using the measurement value reported by the layer 3 filter at the specified SFN.

question_18154.question: What is the purpose of the Link Identifier Update procedure in the relay service code setup process?
question_18154.ground_truth: The purpose of the Link Identifier Update procedure is to change the L2 identifiers of the UEs involved in the PC5 unicast link regularly to mitigate privacy issues in key issue #16. This procedure helps to prevent tracing of the Remote UE during discovery and connection setup.

question_18156.question: What is the procedure for selecting the S11 interface of the SGW from the SGW's canonical node record?
question_18156.ground_truth: If it is not obtained from the TAI/eNodeB-ID records, the MME selects the S11 interface of the SGW from the SGW's canonical node record.

question_18157.question: What is the format of the UPPCH-LCR-Parameters-CTCH-ReconfRqstTDD sequence?
question_18157.ground_truth: The UPPCH-LCR-Parameters-CTCH-ReconfRqstTDD sequence is a SEQUENCE that consists of uPPCHPositionLCR, uARFCN, and iE-Extensions.

question_18158.question: What is the purpose of the Minimum Supported Bandwidth in the context of TS 26.114?
question_18158.ground_truth: The Minimum Supported Bandwidth is the lowest bandwidth that can be maintained for a session in TS 26.114. If this bandwidth cannot be maintained, the session may be terminated.

question_18160.question: What is the length of the old PDU session identity information element?
question_18160.ground_truth: The old PDU session identity information element is a type 3 information element with a length of 2 octet.

question_18161.question: When does the additional BC3 blocking requirement apply?
question_18161.ground_truth: The additional BC3 blocking requirement applies when a BS is operating in the same geographical area as UTRA TDD.

question_18162.question: What should a UE do upon receiving 5GMM cause #80 in a non-satellite NG-RAN cell?
question_18162.ground_truth: The UE shall set the 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, delete certain information, reset the registration attempt counter, store the PLMN identity in the list of PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location, and start a corresponding timer.

question_18163.question: What is the use of a UE to network sidelink relay in 3GPP 5G?
question_18163.ground_truth: The specification covers the use of UE to network sidelink relays by specifying the additional requirements that apply for a sidelink relay UE and a sidelink remote UE, i.e. for such UEs the regular sidelink UE requirements equally apply unless explicitly stated otherwise.

question_18165.question: What should the UE do when lower layers indicate an integrity check failure while T319 is running or SDT procedure is ongoing?

question_18167.question: What does the <xs:any namespace="##other" processContents="lax" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded"/> particle in the XML Schema do?
question_18167.ground_truth: This particle allows any element to be present in the XML document with a namespace other than the target namespace and with a lax validation process.

question_18168.question: What actions should the NF Service Consumer take if the delivery of the N1 message fails while moving a non-3GPP PDU session to 3GPP access?
question_18168.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should delete any stored representation of the N1N2MessageTransfer request resource URI upon receiving this notification.

question_18171.question: When should the MME initiate a key change on the fly procedure for the entire EPS key hierarchy?
question_18171.ground_truth: The MME shall initiate a key change on the fly procedure for the entire EPS key hierarchy when the UE has cryptographically protected radio bearers established and the MME wants to activate a non-current native EPS security context.

question_18172.question: What are the estimation error modelling methodologies for LMMSE-IRC and E-LMMSE-IRC channel estimation errors?
question_18172.ground_truth: The estimation errors of the channels can be modelled assuming complex normal distributed signals, and the equivalent channel estimate may be expressed as a complex normal distribution with a mean equal to the true channel matrix and variance equal to the covariance of the channel estimate. Similarly, for the E-LMMSE-IRC the equivalent channel estimate for H0 and H1 can be expressed as a function of the channel estimation error covariance.

question_18173.question: What is the role of the Connection Management sublayer in the 3GPP TS?
question_18173.ground_truth: The Connection Management sublayer in the 3GPP TS is responsible for the functions of the Control, Provision, and Support of services offered by the network. This includes functions such as establishing, maintaining, and terminating circuit-switched connections, supporting supplementary services, supporting short message services, and supporting location services for certain types of MS.

question_18174.question: What is the role of OCSP in certificate validation for RNs?
question_18174.ground_truth: OCSP is used for certificate validation in the following way: the UICC sends a nonce as part of the TLS client hello, the RN acting as the OCSP client forms an OCSP request including the nonce, the OCSP responder signs the response including the nonce, and the UICC checks the CertStatus and expiry time of the RN certificate in the signed response. This ensures the UICC that the RN certificate was valid at the time the UICC started the TLS handshake.

question_18175.question: What should the AMF node name be if the operator wants to use the 3GPP defined AMF instance FQDN for provisioning?
question_18175.ground_truth: The AMF node name should be the 3GPP defined AMF instance FQDN or an alias of the AMF's canonical node name.

question_18176.question: What are the postconditions for the gsmSRF when the "DisconnectFromIPForbidden" parameter is FALSE in the "Invoking entity (gsmSRF)" section?
question_18176.ground_truth: The gsmSRF initiates a bearer channel disconnect sequence to the gsmSSF using the applicable bearer channel signalling system after sending the "SpecializedResourceReport" operation to the gsmSCF and transits to the state "Idle".

question_18178.question: What action shall the UE take if no CAG-ID is authorized based on the "allowed CAG list" for the current PLMN?
question_18178.ground_truth: The UE shall enter the state 5GMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH and shall apply the PLMN selection process defined in 3GPP TS 23.122 with the updated "CAG information list".

question_18180.question: What is the effect of phase noise on wireless communications?
question_18180.ground_truth: Phase noise in the receiver can lead to interference, particularly when it is high and the downlink signal is received at very high power, resulting in reciprocal mixing on a high-power signal in the downlink sub-band, causing interference in the uplink sub-band.

question_18181.question: What network element is responsible for establishing the I1-cs reference point through the CS domain network using CS Access Signalling?
question_18181.ground_truth: The ICS UE, when connected to a standard VMSC, establishes the I1-cs reference point through the CS domain network using CS Access Signalling.

question_18185.question: What should the CN do if it receives the DIRECT TRANSFER message from the RNC without the SAPI IE?
question_18185.ground_truth: The CN shall continue with the Direct Transfer procedure.

question_18186.question: What is the purpose of the S9 interface in the scenario described in section 6.2?
question_18186.ground_truth: The S9 interface provides PCC rules to the vPCRF function in the visited network, which then distributes the PCC information towards PDN GW2 via S7. In addition, S9 is used for conveyance of QoS rules to the Serving GW or the trusted non-3GPP access via S7c and S7a, respectively.

question_18187.question: How is the input speech signal processed in the AMR-WB encoder before it undergoes LP analysis and quantization?
question_18187.ground_truth: The input speech signal is processed by decimating it from 16 kHz to 12.8 kHz, followed by high-pass filtering and pre-emphasizing (down-scaling) to enhance higher frequencies and reduce the possibility of overflows during fixed-point implementation.

question_18189.question: What is necessary for the W-5GAN to support QoS flows for a 5GC-capable UE using 5G-RG/FN-RG access?
question_18189.ground_truth: The W-5GAN can receive and coordinate requests for PDU Session QoS resources over multiple N2 connections to different logical functions (FAGF-C and IWF), perform admission control and coordination of the QoS requests associated to the 5G-RG as well as 5GC-capable UEs behind the RG.

question_18190.question: What information is required for the transfer of media from CS to PS direction for access transfers within 3GPP access networks as specified in TS 23.216?
question_18190.ground_truth: The required information includes the user being active or inactive in a CS originating or terminating speech session, procedures and capabilities specified in TS 23.216, and an active IMS registration prior to the transfer.

question_18191.question: What is the Sidelink interface used for in 3GPP networks?
question_18191.ground_truth: The Sidelink interface is used for direct communication between UEs over the PC5 interface, enabling features like ProSe Direct Communication and sidelink discovery.

question_18192.question: What should be done if a UE supports the UPLF test mode in release 16 or later?
question_18192.ground_truth: The SS should apply a backoff on the PCell power by activating the UE Power Limit Function (UPLF).

question_18193.question: What measures should be taken to ensure confidentiality and integrity of the application plane from the SIP signalling plane?
question_18193.ground_truth: When required by the MCX Service provider, MCX Service identities and other MCX Service sensitive information should be contained within the application plane and should provide a means to support confidentiality and integrity of the application plane from the SIP signalling plane as per MCSEC-1.6-2.

question_18194.question: What do the terms "modal verbs" in the document refer to?
question_18194.ground_truth: Modal verbs are verbs that express modality, i.e. they indicate obligation, possibility, or ability.

question_18196.question: What type of data transfer policy is valid for packet switched traffic in a 5GS network?

question_18199.question: What is the purpose of the document "3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects; Enhancement for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles; Stage 1 (Release 17)"?
question_18199.ground_truth: The document provides use cases and analysis of UAV capabilities that may require enhanced 3GPP support, focusing on the use of low altitude UAVs in various commercial and government sectors.

question_18201.question: What is the requirement for AMR-WB mode compliance with DTX enabled and how does the decoder implementation ensure compliance with the test vectors given in Annex B?
question_18201.ground_truth: The AMR-WB modes of AMR-WB+ are required to behave bit-exactly to the FIP reference code, and the decoder implementation shall comply with the test vectors given in Annex B to ensure AMR-WB mode compliance with DTX enabled.

question_18202.question: What action should the SCF take if the SDP parameters are not successfully examined and the MBMS download service is not available to the UE?
question_18202.ground_truth: The SCF shall answer to the UE with a SIP 403 error message indicating that the UE is not authorized to join the multicast session.

question_18203.question: In the measurement restriction for CSI-RS based candidate beam detection, which restriction is applied when CSI-RS for CBD measurement is in the same OFDM symbol as SSB for L1-RSRP measurement?
question_18203.ground_truth: UE is not required to receive CSI-RS for CBD measurement in the PRBs that overlap with the SSB from a candidate LTM neighbor cell for L1-RSRP measurement on the same or adjacent OFDM symbol for both FR1 and FR2.

question_18204.question: What is the main function of the punctuation processor in the Huffman coding algorithm?
question_18204.ground_truth: The punctuation processor removes leading and trailing spaces from the input stream, replaces repeated spaces within the stream with a single space, removes and inserts spaces following certain punctuation characters, decapitalizes and capitalizes the first character of the stream under certain conditions, and removes or inserts a full stop if it is the last character of the stream.

question_18206.question: What is the purpose of the test in subclause 7.5.3, for the 1.28 Mcps TDD option?
question_18206.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in subclause 7.5.3, for the 1.28 Mcps TDD option, is to stress the ability of the BS receiver to withstand high-level interference from unwanted signals at frequency offsets of 3.2 MHz or more, without undue degradation of its sensitivity.

question_18207.question: What is a ProSe Layer-2 Group ID used for in the context of Proximity-based Services (ProSe)?
question_18207.ground_truth: A ProSe Layer-2 Group ID is used to address a set of users at the 3GPP lower layers for ProSe Direct Communication.

question_18208.question: What protocol is used by the PDN GW to initiate an authorization procedure for establishing a new PDN connection via a non-3GPP access network?
question_18208.ground_truth: The PDN GW uses the Diameter protocol to initiate an authorization procedure for establishing a new PDN connection via a non-3GPP access network.

question_18210.question: What is a condition for the UE to perform IMS registration procedure towards the HPLMN IMS?
question_18210.ground_truth: The UE has obtained a P-CSCF address for the IMS registration procedure.

question_18212.question: What is the effect of the UE receiving a list of preferred PLMN/access technology combinations from the HPLMN and the security check is successful?
question_18212.ground_truth: The UE shall replace the highest priority entries in the "Operator Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology" list with the received list of preferred PLMN/access technology combinations.

question_18213.question: What is the minimum length of a mini-slot, at least above 6 GHz?
question_18213.ground_truth: The minimum length of a mini-slot, at least above 6 GHz, is 1 OFDM symbol.

question_18217.question: What is the principle of solution #14 for unique CN Tunnel Info allocation?
question_18217.ground_truth: The principle of solution #14 is to divide the whole TEID resource within one UPF pool to different TEID ranges for each SMF and UPF pair.

question_18218.question: Which model of 3GPP TR~25.942 is applied for UEs assigned to micro cells, as defined in paragraph 5.1.4.3?
question_18218.ground_truth: The model of 3GPP TR~25.942 as defined in paragraph 5.1.4.3 applies for UEs assigned to micro cells.

question_18219.question: What capability should the SEALDD server provide to support the data storage service?
question_18219.ground_truth: The SEALDD server should provide capabilities such as data storage, cache services, and support for data retrieval directly from the server to reduce processing time and transferring resources cost on interacting with the 3GPP network or application server.

question_18220.question: What should the UE do if it is capable of MBMS Service Continuity and is receiving an MBMS service, but the reselected cell is not broadcasting SIB13?
question_18220.ground_truth: The UE cannot consider that frequency to be the highest priority.

question_18221.question: What is the measurement that provides the number of successful outgoing inter-frequency handovers when measurement gaps are not used?

question_18222.question: What is the priority of filter criteria in IMS?
question_18222.ground_truth: The priority of filter criteria determines the order in which the S-CSCF assesses and contacts the application servers when evaluating incoming SIP requests.

question_18224.question: What should be added in the "UE positioning reporting quantity" if a 3-dimensional position estimate is required with GPS TOD and GPS TOW information?
question_18224.ground_truth: The "GPS timing of Cell wanted" should be set to FALSE and the "GPS TOW msec" should be set to the GPS TOD when the position estimate was valid.

question_18225.question: When does a Reference/Target UE authorize the SL Positioning Client UE based on the information of the involved UEs during direct communication establishment?
question_18225.ground_truth: During the establishment of direct communication, the Reference/Target UE should authorize the SL Positioning Client UE based on the information of the involved UEs sent by the SL Positioning Client UE in the Direct Communication Request.

question_18228.question: Which 3GPP specification defines the Enhanced Power Control (EPC) concept used in E-UTRAN networks?

question_18229.question: What should the server include in the response if the first byte range is lost and the FDT Instance contains an 'mbms2015:IndependentUnitPositions' attribute with value "0 60000 80000 110000"?
question_18229.ground_truth: The server should include 3gpp-access-position in the response with the value of the position in the 'mbms2015:IndependentUnitPositions' attribute of the corresponding range.

question_18230.question: How does the UE ensure that the ProSe Key Management Function is aware of its correct IP address for PGK deliveries?
question_18230.ground_truth: If the UE detects that a PDN connection, which is used for receiving PGKs is released by the network, the UE should try to send a new Key Request to inform the ProSe Key Management Function of its new IP address. This ensures that the ProSe Key Management Function becomes aware of the new UE IP address for the purpose of performing PGK deliveries.

question_18232.question: What is the name of the measurement and reporting for inter-cell UE-to-UE cross link interference (CLI) on NR cells specified for CLI handling?

question_18233.question: What is the difference between scenario 2.1 and scenario 2.2 in the described EAS re-discovery procedure?
question_18233.ground_truth: In scenario 2.1, the H-SMF has knowledge of EAS deployment information in VPLMN and sends an EAS rediscovery indication and impact field to the UE. In scenario 2.2, the H-SMF does not have this knowledge and only sends an EAS rediscovery indication to the UE.

question_18234.question: What is the lowest quality of service (QoS) traffic class in a GERAN?
question_18234.ground_truth: Best effort QoS is the lowest of all QoS traffic classes. If the guaranteed QoS cannot be delivered, the bearer network delivers the QoS which can also be called best effort QoS.

question_18235.question: What is the maximum measurement reporting delay required for the UE in this test case?
question_18235.ground_truth: The maximum measurement reporting delay required for the UE in this test case is 30.72 seconds for Test 1 and 30722 ms for Test 2.

question_18236.question: What is the purpose of the Uplink (UL) Reference Measurement channels set for E-UTRA CG and NR CG?
question_18236.ground_truth: The UL Reference Measurement channels are set for E-UTRA CG and NR CG to ensure proper downlink and uplink signaling for testing.

question_18237.question: What is the formula used for calculating the IP Latency in DL on E-RAB level?
question_18237.ground_truth: The IP Latency in DL on E-RAB level is calculated using the formula: LatTime/LatSample

question_18238.question: What is the maximum allowed residual class Ib BER and residual class II BER for speech channels in 3GPP TS 24.008?
question_18238.ground_truth: The residual class Ib BER should not exceed 2%, and the residual class II BER should not exceed 0.08% for speech channels in 3GPP TS 24.008.

question_18240.question: What is the indication flag in the CTS PAGING REQUEST message for initiating the alive check procedure?

question_18242.question: What is the purpose of the LowerMSDRequest-r18 in the UE-CapabilityRequestFilterCommon?
question_18242.ground_truth: The LowerMSDRequest-r18 in the UE-CapabilityRequestFilterCommon is used to request UE capabilities for low MSD support in NR. It is included in the capability container request list.

question_18245.question: How can the macro-eNB signal offsets to all HeNBs within its coverage area?
question_18245.ground_truth: By signalling over the backhaul to avoid uplink interference from UEs connected to HeNBs with the macro-eNB receiver.

question_18248.question: What does the term "shall" indicate in a 3GPP TSG Technical Specification or Technical Report?
question_18248.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

question_18249.question: What entities can the Cancel operation be sent to, and for what purposes?
question_18249.ground_truth: The Cancel operation can be sent to the gsmSRF to cancel the "PlayAnnouncement" or "PromptAndCollectUserInformation" operation. It can also be sent to the gsmSSF to disarm all armed EDPs and cancel all pending reports, allowing the gsmSSF FSM to transit to the "Idle" state.

question_18251.question: What is the transport protocol used to open the channel in the first sequence?

question_18252.question: Why should "leaf-lists" for "SubNetwork" be defined directly under the class definition in the YANG model, instead of in the "SubNetworkGrp" grouping?
question_18252.ground_truth: This is because the "path" statements for the "leaf-lists" are specific to each class and should not be inherited by child classes.

question_18253.question: How does the UE determine the range of ESIs for requesting repair symbols?
question_18253.ground_truth: The UE uses one of the algorithms defined in clause 6.1.3 to determine a range of ESIs that will result in successful reception.

question_18254.question: What should a mobile station (MS) do if it receives the "Extended wait time" for CS domain from the lower layers when no location updating or CM service request procedure is ongoing?
question_18254.ground_truth: The MS shall ignore the "Extended wait time".

question_18256.question: What is the action taken when T2 expires during the test?
question_18256.ground_truth: The SS deactivates SCell1 by sending the deactivation MAC-CE, and if an ACK is received, T3 starts. If not, the test moves to step 12. After T2 expires, the SS deactivates SCell2 as well.

question_18258.question: What should the UE do when located in the geographical area and requested by a service to transmit a V2X packet after receiving V2XP over PC5 from SS and initiating a UE-requested V2X policy provisioning procedure?
question_18258.ground_truth: The UE should initiate a V2X communication on the frequency associated with the service.

question_18259.question: What is the result when an MCPTT user is requested to leave a group call due to de-affiliation?
question_18259.ground_truth: The MCPTT user will be notified and removed from the ongoing group call, and the MCPTT client will send a group call leave response to the MCPTT server, leaving the group call.

question_18260.question: What is the approach to Adjacent Channel Selectivity and narrow-band blocking measurement in the new specification?
question_18260.ground_truth: Adjacent Channel Selectivity and narrow-band blocking can be measured for each component carrier separately, as suggested in the new specification. The wanted signal power and SNR operating point should be the same as in Rel-8.

question_18262.question: What is the significance of the version numbering system used in the document?
question_18262.ground_truth: The version numbering system used in the document indicates the stage of approval and the extent of changes made to the document. A version number with a higher first digit indicates a TSG approved document under change control.

question_18263.question: What should the 3GPP system be able to provide in relation to QoS?
question_18263.ground_truth: The 3GPP system should be able to provide the required QoS (e.g., reliability, latency, bandwidth) for an application and support prioritization of resources when necessary for that application.

question_18265.question: Which clause in 7.3A.3.3.3 specifies the minimum conformance requirements for 7.3A.3.3.1?

question_18266.question: What is required for end-to-access-edge media security for BFCP using TLS and certificate fingerprints in IMS-ALG?
question_18266.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG is required to support bfcp-tls-name = "bfcp-tls" to indicate a header field that applies to the media plane in the Security-Client, Security-Server, or Security-Verify header fields.

question_18267.question: How does the BM-SC fetch the file when the MCData server defines a pull ingest mode?
question_18267.ground_truth: The MCData server can provide the resource location in the MCData content server (i.e. the file URL) to the BM-SC, which directly fetches the file from the MCData content server.

question_18268.question: How many sets of 51 52-multiframes are there in the timeslot shifting sequence for a given set of parameters in the context of 3GPP TS 23.003?
question_18268.ground_truth: There are 8 sets of 51 52-multiframes in the timeslot shifting sequence for a given set of parameters in the context of 3GPP TS 23.003.

question_18269.question: Which parameter represents the ResourceCoordinationTransferContainer type in the F1AP protocol?

question_18270.question: What is the difference between direct and indirect data collection methods for UE data?
question_18270.ground_truth: Direct data collection refers to the collection of UE data by the 5GMS AF from the 5GMS Client over the M5 interface. Indirect data collection refers to the collection of UE data by the 5GMS AF from the Application Service Provider (ASP) through the M8 application layer interface. Indirect data collection is not specified in TS 26.501 and TS 26.512 and may be supported by defining a separate interface between the ASP and the 5GMS AF.

question_18271.question: What is the role of the LIPF in the 5GC network?
question_18271.ground_truth: The LIPF, present in the ADMF, provisions the IRI-POI in the AMF and the MDF2. It may interact with the SIRF to discover AMFs in the network and receives the warrant from an LEA, deriving the intercept information from the warrant and providing the same to the LICF.

question_18273.question: What action does the UE take when it receives the "UE positioning GANSS reference UE position" IE in a setup message?
question_18273.ground_truth: The UE stores the information in "UE positioning GANSS reference UE position" and uses it as a priori knowledge of the approximate location of the UE.

question_18275.question: What is the role of the AUSF in the 5G authentication process?
question_18275.ground_truth: The AUSF is responsible for checking with the UDM within the SNPN for the authentication method to be executed for the UE and for running EAP-TTLS phase 1 towards the UE.

question_18277.question: What should be considered when using Bands 7 and 28 in a geographical area where Band 25 and 39 might be used?
question_18277.ground_truth: Second and third-order IMD products may fall into bands 1, 2, 33, and 42, but bands 25 and 39 are not intended for use in the same geographical area as bands 7 and 28.

question_18278.question: What cumulative basic limit is applied to the sub block gap in a single-band connector operating in non-contiguous spectrum?
question_18278.ground_truth: A combined basic limit is applied to the sub block gap, which is the cumulative sum of the basic limits specified for the adjacent sub blocks on each side of the sub block gap.

question_18279.question: Which procedure allows the MS and GGSN to modify any TFT while in 'MS/NW' mode?

question_18280.question: What happens when the Call Control Manager is in the Notification terminated state?
question_18280.ground_truth: When the Call Control Manager is in the Notification terminated state, events requested with enableCallNotification() will not be forwarded to the application. There can be multiple reasons for this, for instance it might be that the application receives more notifications from the network than defined in the Service Level Agreement, or that the Service has detected it receives no notifications from the network due to a link failure.

question_18283.question: What is the function of the ENUM response in the process of selecting the target PLMN based on MSISDN belonging to a different PLMN without NP?
question_18283.ground_truth: The ENUM response indicates to the local NRF that the MSISDN belongs to a different PLMN including a URI pointing to the NRF in the target PLMN.

question_18285.question: What is the format of the Content-Type header field when submitting an SM over IP with a SIP URI as the destination?
question_18285.ground_truth: The Content-Type header field shall contain "multipart/mixed".

question_18287.question: What should the network do upon reception of a NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message over non-3GPP access, indicating the UE's inability to initiate a service request procedure or registration procedure over 3GPP access?
question_18287.ground_truth: The network should stop timer T3565 and notify the SMF that the UE is unreachable. If the NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message includes the PDU session status information element, the network should release all those PDU sessions which are not in the 5GSM state PDU SESSION INACTIVE in the UE, and request the SMF to perform a local release of all those PDU sessions associated with the 3GPP access.

question_18289.question: What is the purpose of the ThreshBeaconRSSIWLANHigh node leaf in the context of UTRAN?
question_18289.ground_truth: The ThreshBeaconRSSIWLANHigh node leaf acts as a placeholder for high threshold value of beacon RSSI thresholds provisioned by ANDSF and/or by RAN in the context of UTRAN. It is used to determine if a node is a match for traffic steering to WLAN.

question_18290.question: What message is sent by the source NG-RAN node to request the cancellation of an ongoing handover?

question_18291.question: What type of burst is used for the CTSBCH-FB and CTSBCH-SB in the CTSBCH format?
question_18291.ground_truth: Frequency Correction Burst (FB) is used for the CTSBCH-FB, and Synchronisation Burst (SB) is used for the CTSBCH-SB.

question_18292.question: What information could the target V-SMF include in the content of the POST response if it supports the HR-SBO feature and the request is to retrieve the complete SM context for a HR-SBO session?
question_18292.ground_truth: The HR-SBO related information, such as hrsboAuthResult, hDnsAddr, hPlmnAddr, vplmnOffloadingInfoList, could be included in the content of the POST response message by the target V-SMF.

question_18293.question: What is the purpose of the 'Frequency hopping flag' field in non-PUSCH hopping with resource allocation type 1?
question_18293.ground_truth: The 'Frequency hopping flag' field is a 1-bit indicator that triggers frequency hopping for resource allocation, as detailed in TS 38.214.

question_18294.question: What should the User Equipment (UE) include in the Accept-Contact header field when sending a request if the ICSI for the IMS communication service is known?
question_18294.ground_truth: The UE may include an ICSI value (coded as specified in subclause 7.2A.8.2) that is related to the request in a g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag.

question_18295.question: What should the initiating UE do to form the new KNRP ID for a PC5 unicast link after a direct link release procedure?
question_18295.ground_truth: The initiating UE should form the new KNRP ID by combining the Most Significant Bits (MSB) of the KNRP ID included in the DIRECT LINK RELEASE REQUEST message and the Least Significant Bits (LSB) of the KNRP ID received in the DIRECT LINK RELEASE ACCEPT message.

question_18296.question: What should a UE do if the de-registration type indicates "re-registration required"?
question_18296.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the 5GMM cause IE if received.

question_18297.question: How does the UE indicate its capability for Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization?
question_18297.ground_truth: The UE includes a Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization indicator in the 'UE security capabilities' in the registration request message.

question_18298.question: In what type of UTRAN mode is the success of outgoing inter-RNC hard handovers via Iur measured?

question_18300.question: What event triggers the AMF to interact with the PCF and generate RFSP index associated with the Target NSSAI?
question_18300.ground_truth: A Generation of a Target NSSAI trigger

question_18301.question: What shall the MCPTT client include in the Request-URI of the SIP INVITE request when establishing an MCPTT prearranged group session?
question_18301.ground_truth: The MCPTT client shall set the Request-URI of the SIP INVITE request to the public service identity identifying the participating MCPTT function serving the MCPTT user.

question_18303.question: What is required for the application of Alternative 1 between networks?
question_18303.ground_truth: The application of Alternative 1 between networks requires interconnect agreements that allow the transit of SDP extensions needed for Alternative 1 and for transit of SIP signalling with or without associated media. Every ALG in a supporting network must also support the algorithm.

question_18304.question: What is the relationship between the Minimum Requirements and Test Requirements in the 3GPP specification?
question_18304.ground_truth: The Minimum Requirements in the 3GPP specification make no allowance for measurement uncertainty, while the Test Requirements are created by relaxing the Minimum Requirements using Test Tolerances defined in the specification. The test results are then compared against the Test Requirements.

question_18305.question: What information does the MNO create in the MOI for UPS related information of the MNO site?
question_18305.ground_truth: The MNO creates information about whether the MNO site has UPS installed, the total UPS backup capacity, the status of the remaining UPS backup capacity, the identity of the DSO energy supply meter present in the MNO site, and the identity of the base station present in the MNO site.

question_18306.question: What is required for an MCX Service to provide a mechanism for an MCX Service Administrator to create and define the membership of MCX Service Groups?
question_18306.ground_truth: The MCX Service must have a mechanism for an MCX Service Administrator to create and define the membership of MCX Service Groups.

question_18307.question: What is the purpose of the IP-SM-GW-SBI-Support-Indicator AVP in 5.3.3.39?
question_18307.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW-SBI-Support-Indicator AVP in 5.3.3.39 is used to indicate whether the IP-SM-GW supports service-based-interface or not.

question_18308.question: What condition must be met in step 7 in order to increase the number of successful tests?
question_18308.ground_truth: The UE must start to report valid ACK/NACK for the PSCell from the first UL slot that occurs after the beginning of DL slot (i+ ) in step 7.

question_18309.question: What does error code 111 indicate in the context of CS, GPRS, UMTS, and EPS-related errors?
question_18309.ground_truth: Error code 111 indicates that a PLMN is not allowed for CS, GPRS, UMTS, and EPS.

question_18310.question: What is the role of the CSC-X reference point in the MBMS system?
question_18310.ground_truth: The CSC-X reference point is used for the MC service server to request MBMS bearer for a given group and for the MBMS management server to provide MBMS bearer information.

question_18312.question: How does the network indicate to the UE that it has accepted the request to use eDRX?
question_18312.ground_truth: The network provides the Negotiated extended DRX parameters IE when accepting the registration procedure to indicate that the UE can use eDRX.

question_18313.question: Which information element in PathSwitchRequestFailure message is mandatory and indicates the released list of PDU session resource?

question_18314.question: What entities interact with the ProSe AS to get the authorization for restricted discovery in the ProSe Direct Discovery procedure?
question_18314.ground_truth: In the ProSe Direct Discovery procedure, the 5G DDNMF may interact with the ProSe AS to get the authorization for restricted discovery and retrieve the PDUID corresponding to the RPAUID before it generates the ProSe Discovery Code (ProSe Restricted Code for Model A and ProSe Query Code and ProSe Response Code for Model B) corresponding to PDUID.

question_18315.question: What is the function of the NEF B in the EES A and EAS A interaction described in TS 23.558 7.55.2-2?
question_18315.ground_truth: The NEF B is responsible for authenticating the requested edge entity and UE by checking the UEID and PLMN ID in the message sent by EES A. It may also send UE location information in the notification.

question_18316.question: What is the maximum number of ongoing E1AP procedures related to a certain UE or MBS session at any instance in time?
question_18316.ground_truth: Unless explicitly indicated in the procedure specification, at any instance in time one protocol endpoint shall have a maximum of one ongoing E1AP procedure related to a certain UE or MBS session.

question_18319.question: What is the purpose of the initial allocation of TrGWs in the context of IMS-ALGs?
