question_18657.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure synchronization between the client and the user equipment. This measurement does not need to be repeated and can be obtained from the setup procedure.

question_18658.question: In the 12.21.3 use case, what is one reason for using FRMCS Functional Identities in FRMCS Roaming situations?
question_18658.ground_truth: FRMCS Functional Identities enable an FRMCS User or FRMCS Equipment to make use of FRMCS Functional Identities, such as when moving beyond the coverage of its Home FRMCS Network and using a Visited (FRMCS) Network.

question_18659.question: What is the condition for deciding pass or fail in level settings of the HS-SCCH Type 3 Performance test in section 9.4.3B?
question_18659.ground_truth: The condition for deciding pass or fail in level settings of the HS-SCCH Type 3 Performance test in section 9.4.3B is based on the count of NACK, ACK, and statDTX on the UL HS-DPCCH during the test interval. NACK and ACK are counted as a pass, and statDTX is counted as a failure.

question_18660.question: When fine-tuning for clutter parameter B, if the full training accuracy (using F1-score) for clutter parameter B is E0,B, what is the range of LOS/NLOS indicator accuracy (using F1-score) when the fine-tuning dataset size is x% = 10.0% of the full training dataset size?
question_18660.ground_truth: The LOS/NLOS indicator accuracy (using F1-score) is in the range of (0.56~0.974) x E0,B.

question_18661.question: What is the aim of the joint workshop with Khronos and MPEG on "Streamed Media in Immersive Scene Descriptions"?
question_18661.ground_truth: The aim of the joint workshop with Khronos and MPEG on "Streamed Media in Immersive Scene Descriptions" is to identify common and complementary aspects on defining networked media, and to find areas where collaboration would be beneficial.

question_18662.question: What should the MAC entity do if more than one set of Random Access resources is identified, based on the highest priority feature applicable to the current Random Access procedure?
question_18662.ground_truth: The MAC entity should repeat the procedure taking as input the identified sets of Random Access resources and the feature applicable to the current Random Access procedure with the highest priority assigned.

question_18663.question: What is the API name and version that should be used for the resource URI structure when communicating with the MSGin5G Server?
question_18663.ground_truth: The API name should be "msgs-msgdelivery" and the version should be "v1".

question_18665.question: What command is sent by the AMF to the (R)AN to initiate the AN Release Procedure in 5GS?
question_18665.ground_truth: The AMF sends an N2 UE Context Release Command to the (R)AN to initiate the AN Release Procedure in 5GS.

question_18667.question: What mechanism is used to replicate data for different multicast groups with different QoS policies?
question_18667.ground_truth: The UE application replicates multiple copies of the data for different multicast groups with different QoS treatments based on the Ethernet PDU Session.

question_18668.question: What is a PDN connection established between the UE and the Service Capability Exposure Function (SCEF) for transmitting the UE's non-IP data related to a specific application?

question_18669.question: How does E-TFC selection work for different frequencies when the UE has more than one Activated Uplink Frequency in FDD?
question_18669.ground_truth: If E-TFC selection is invoked on only one frequency, the E-TFC selection behavior is performed as if only one uplink frequency is activated.

question_18670.question: What is the default authentication method used by EEC and EES in solution #10?
question_18670.ground_truth: TLS with certificates is adopted as the default authentication for EEC and EES.

question_18672.question: Which element can appear an unbounded number of times in Group-info complex type with the processContents set to "lax"?

question_18675.question: What is the definition of the relative accuracy of RSRP inter-frequency measurement in 3GPP TS 36.133?
question_18675.ground_truth: The relative accuracy of RSRP inter-frequency measurement is defined as the RSRP measured from one cell compared to the RSRP measured from another cell on a different frequency.

question_18677.question: In what mode(s) does the MME store the mapped EPS NAS security context with associated NAS COUNT counters during an inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode?
question_18677.ground_truth: The MME stores the mapped EPS NAS security context with associated NAS COUNT counters during an inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode in both 5GMM-CONNECTED mode and EMM-IDLE mode for a UE operating in single-registration mode in a network supporting N26 interface.

question_18679.question: What is the maximum EIRP allowed for general purpose SRD devices in the band 5725-5875 MHz in Europe?
question_18679.ground_truth: The maximum EIRP for general purpose SRD devices in the band 5725-5875 MHz in Europe is 25 mW.

question_18680.question: In what scenarios should the IBCF not perform the through-connect control of early media?
question_18680.ground_truth: The IBCF may decide not to perform the through-connect control of early media if the P-Early-Media header field includes the "gated" parameter and the IBCF does not decide to perform the through-connection control.

question_18681.question: What is the role of VAL server in step 9.16.4.2.2 and 9.16.4.2.3?
question_18681.ground_truth: The VAL server consumes the network slice requirements verification and alignment service in step 9.16.4.2.2, and gets notified with the updated network slice requirements information in step 9.16.4.2.3.

question_18683.question: What is tested in the test case described in section 10.5.3.3.4?
question_18683.ground_truth: Absolute accuracy of SS-SINR intra-frequency measurements is tested in the test case described in section 10.5.3.3.4.

question_18684.question: What is the definition of an Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the context of 3GPP's telecommunications management?
question_18684.ground_truth: An IRP is a logical interface that specifies the information flow between two functional entities responsible for telecommunications management.

question_18685.question: What is the maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell, in 4G LTE?

question_18686.question: What is the name of the header field used by the S-CSCF to inform an alternative P-CSCF about the failure in a 408 (Request Timeout) response for INVITE requests or a 504 (Server Time-out) response for non-INVITE requests?

question_18689.question: What is one of the functional requirements related to management regarding different types of managed devices in the 3GPP system?
question_18689.ground_truth: One of the functional requirements is having the capability to provide a single point of access allowing IRPManager to manage HNBs, HeNBs, and other types of managed entities such as macro eNBs.

question_18691.question: What is the function of a Dataset in the binary option of MMTEL services?
question_18691.ground_truth: A Dataset is a binary description of the service data of a subset of MMTEL services. It contains parameters associated with MMTEL services, such as AOC, FA pilot, and FA member datasets, and defines the rules for extendibility, backward compatibility, and compactness.

question_18693.question: What is the expected mode for the sequence 1.3 command 1.3.1 in the PROACTIVE COMMAND?

question_18695.question: How are the most significant bits padded with value 0 when the bit width of the Second Precoding information field for the case with transform precoder enabled is not equal to that for the case with transform precoder disabled?
question_18695.ground_truth: A number of most significant bits with value set to '0' are inserted to the Second Precoding information field for the case with smaller bit width until the bit width of the Second Precoding information field for the two cases are the same.

question_18696.question: In what situation would the AMF forward the SM message, the PDU session ID, the S-NSSAI (if received), the DNN (if received) and the request type of the UL SM MESSAGE TRANSPORT message towards the SMF ID of the PDU session routing context?
question_18696.ground_truth: This would occur when the AMF has a PDU session routing context for the PDU session ID of the UL SM MESSAGE TRANSPORT message and the UE, the request type IE of the UL SM MESSAGE TRANSPORT message is set to "initial request" and the AMF has not received a reallocation requested indication.

question_18698.question: What message type should an MME include when it sends a Modify Access Bearers Request message to an SGW as part of certain procedures, given that all specified conditions are met?
question_18698.ground_truth: The Modify Access Bearers Request message should include all bearer contexts of all the PDN connections of the UE.

question_18701.question: What is the media feature tag that should be included in the Accept-Contact header field for an Interworking Security Data message?

question_18702.question: What is the purpose of the B-TID in the GBA procedures?
question_18702.ground_truth: The B-TID is used by the UE to supply to the NAF to allow the NAF to retrieve the corresponding keys from the BSF. It uniquely identifies a key in the BSF.

question_18703.question: What is the main function of the mediation function in the Iuant interface protocol structure?
question_18703.ground_truth: The mediation function provides a protocol that uses the implementation specific O&M bearer on one side and the Iuant protocol on the other, allowing the two different interfaces to communicate with each other.

question_18704.question: What is the purpose of the End Marker message(s) in GTP-U tunnels in 3GPP EPS?
question_18704.ground_truth: The End Marker message(s) indicate the end of data transmission on a GTP-U tunnel and are sent after the last G-PDU has been transmitted or after receiving an End Marker Indication.

question_18705.question: How many sublayers does the layer 3 of the 3GPP TS contain, and what are they?
question_18705.ground_truth: The layer 3 of the 3GPP TS is composed of three sublayers for non-GPRS services (Radio Resource Management, Mobility Management, and Connection Management) and four sublayers for GPRS services (Radio Resource Management, Mobility Management, Logical Link Control, and Connection Management). The Connection Management sublayer of the GPRS services is further composed of functional blocks for various call control, short message service support, session management, and location services support functions.

question_18706.question: Which XML schema defines the XML schemas for application/vnd.3gpp.seal-info+xml, application/vnd.3gpp.seal-unicast-info+xml and application/vnd.3gpp.seal-mbms-usage-info+xml?
question_18706.ground_truth: The XML schema that defines the XML schemas for application/vnd.3gpp.seal-info+xml, application/vnd.3gpp.seal-unicast-info+xml and application/vnd.3gpp.seal-mbms-usage-info+xml is 7.4.

question_18707.question: What should the UE do if it cannot accept the security mode command in the 5G system?
question_18707.ground_truth: The UE should send a SECURITY MODE REJECT message with an EMM cause value of #23 (UE security capabilities mismatch) or #24 (security mode rejected, unspecified).

question_18708.question: What is the scope of the BEST service?
question_18708.ground_truth: The BEST service provides security using battery efficient key agreement and secure transport services for low throughput data on battery constrained devices.

question_18710.question: What provides the number of dictionary entry deletions at the NEF, including the number of failed ones?
question_18710.ground_truth: Number of failed UCMF dictionary entry deletions

question_18712.question: What is the effect of unsynchronization between the UE and network while in the ECM-IDLE state?
question_18712.ground_truth: When the UE and the network are unsynchronized, the UE and network have different sets of established EPS bearers, indicating a lack of consistent connectivity.

question_18713.question: What happens if the Reservation-Priority AVP is not specified for IP flow?
question_18713.ground_truth: If the Reservation-Priority AVP is not specified for IP flow, the requested priority is DEFAULT (0).

question_18714.question: What is the specification notations for procedures, messages, and control/data frames in the present document?
question_18714.ground_truth: A procedure is referred to as "Procedure Name" in upper case characters followed by the word "procedure". A message is referred to as "MESSAGE NAME" in all upper case characters followed by the word "message". A control/data frame is referred to as "CONTROL/DATA FRAME NAME" in all upper case characters followed by the words "control/data frame".

question_18716.question: What is the rule for mapping the bits to a PhCH with an odd number?
question_18716.ground_truth: The bits are mapped to a PhCH with an odd number in forward order.

question_18719.question: Which mode of operation has a fixed frame period based channel access in NR-U?
question_18719.ground_truth: FBE mode of operation in NR-U has a fixed frame period based channel access.

question_18720.question: What should the P-CSCF do when rewriting the address and port number of its own Record Route entry in a 1xx or 2xx response?
question_18720.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should rewrite the address and port number of its own Record Route entry to the same value as the response to the initial request for the dialog.

question_18721.question: What should the UE do if it receives a 504 (Server Time-out) response containing a P-Asserted-Identity header field and Content-Type header field set in a registration flow?
question_18721.ground_truth: If the 504 (Server Time-out) response includes an IM CN subsystem XML body indicating restoration and initial registration, the UE should initiate S-CSCF restoration procedures and may provide an indication to the user based on the reason for the alternative service.

question_18723.question: What should the MCVideo client do when attempting to cancel an in-progress imminent peril group state and it is not authorized to do so?
question_18723.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should skip the remaining steps of the current subclause and indicate to the MCVideo user that they are not authorized to cancel the in-progress imminent peril group state.

question_18726.question: When can a BH RLF detection indication be transmitted from an IAB-DU?
question_18726.ground_truth: A BH RLF detection indication can be transmitted from an IAB-DU when the collocated IAB-MT initiates RRC re-establishment, when the collocated IAB-MT is dual-connected and detects BH RLF on a BH link and cannot perform UL re-routing for any traffic, or when the collocated IAB-MT has received a BH RLF detection indication from a parent node and there is no remaining backhaul link affected.

question_18728.question: What is a key feature of an AIPN mobility solution?
question_18728.ground_truth: An AIPN mobility solution must support UTRAN and GERAN based systems as possible access systems besides supporting alternative existing accesses such as WLAN and other emerging new technologies.

question_18729.question: What message is sent by the SMLC to the BSS to initiate U-TDOA location determination on the Lb interface?
question_18729.ground_truth: The SMLC sends a BSSMAP-LE Connection Oriented Information message to the BSS that contains the embedded BSSLAP U-TDOA Request message.

question_18730.question: What are the three key states of a CIoT mobile station?
question_18730.ground_truth: The three key states of a CIoT mobile station are macro sleep, idle, and active.

question_18731.question: What is the format of the CellAdjustmentInfoItemIE-SyncAdjustmntRqstTDD sequence?
question_18731.ground_truth: The CellAdjustmentInfoItemIE-SyncAdjustmntRqstTDD sequence is a sequence containing fields such as c-ID, frameAdjustmentValue, timingAdjustmentValue, and iE-Extensions.

question_18732.question: What interfaces does the SWd interface support HSS initiated detach procedures for trusted non-3GPP access?

question_18733.question: What is the limitation of the correlatedNotification attribute in its current definition?
question_18733.ground_truth: The limitation is that it captures notification ID, not alarm ID, but it can still serve as a useful piece of information for higher layer correlation processes.

question_18734.question: What are the two different architectures that have been identified for supporting relays in LTE?
question_18734.ground_truth: The two different architectures that have been identified for supporting relays in LTE are Architecture A and Architecture B.

question_18735.question: What are the two options for the target RNC when the target CN provides the serving PLMN in the RAU procedure without knowing the UE's network sharing capability, in the context of CS and PS handover from UTRAN/GERAN to UTRAN?
question_18735.ground_truth: The two options are (1) using the Common PLMN, or (2) using the Dedicated PLMN of the serving PS domain. The first option may result in an incorrect CS/PS coordination, while the second option may result in a change of serving operator when the UE enters Idle mode in both CS and PS domain.

question_18736.question: What should be the frequency ranges of the downlink and uplink protection requirements for the protection of DCS1800, UTRA Band III, E-UTRA Band 3 or NR Band n3 in China?
question_18736.ground_truth: The frequency ranges of the downlink and uplink protection requirements for the protection of DCS1800, UTRA Band III, E-UTRA Band 3 or NR Band n3 in China are 1805 - 1850 MHz and 1710 - 1755 MHz respectively.

question_18739.question: How are rare or frequent codes treated in the DEFLATE format for data compression?
question_18739.ground_truth: Rare codes have longer representations, and frequent codes have shorter representations to replace them.

question_18740.question: In what way can the rate of user data sent to and from a UE using CIoT EPS Optimization be controlled?
question_18740.ground_truth: The rate of user data sent to and from a UE using CIoT EPS Optimization can be controlled in two different ways: Serving PLMN Rate Control and APN Rate Control. Serving PLMN Rate Control is used to protect the MME and the Signalling Radio Bearers in the E-UTRAN from the load generated by NAS Data PDUs, while APN Rate Control is used by HPLMN operators to offer customer services such as a maximum of Y messages per day.

question_18741.question: Which system entities are impacted by Solution #38?
question_18741.ground_truth: PCF and UE are impacted by Solution #38. PCF gains the ability to identify ProSe Connection Capabilities and related Route Selection Descriptor in URSP rule. UE gains the ability to identify the Route Selection Descriptor for 5G ProSe Layer 3 UE-to-Network Relay PDU Session establishment.

question_18742.question: What is the role of the Access and Mobility Management function (AMF) in the context of 5G networks?
question_18742.ground_truth: The Access and Mobility Management function (AMF) performs functions such as registration management, connection management, reachability management, mobility management, forwarding of UE Policy towards the served UE, reporting of the UE state to the (V-)PCF, forwarding of the UE policy enforcement result received from the UE to the (V-)PCF, forwarding of the N2 PC5 policy for V2X communications and/or A2X communications and/or 5G ProSe and/or Ranging/SL towards the NG-RAN, and reporting the UE policy enforcement result towards the (V-)PCF.

question_18743.question: What type of information is specified in the present document?
question_18743.ground_truth: The present document specifies the coding, multiplexing and mapping to physical channels for 5G NR.

question_18744.question: What actions do MC service clients take for multicast MBS sessions?
question_18744.ground_truth: For multicast MBS sessions, MC service clients initiate a UE session join request towards the 5GC using the information provided via the MBS session announcement. Upon the first successful UE session join request, the multicast is then established, and the radio resources are reserved, if the session is in an active state.

question_18746.question: What interfaces are impacted by the provision of PDU Set related parameters to the NG-RAN in DL and UL?
question_18746.ground_truth: N6 and NG-UP (between SMF and NG-RAN)

question_18747.question: What message does the MS send if it receives a DISCONNECT message while in state U9 during a mobile terminating call?
question_18747.ground_truth: The MS returns a RELEASE message and enters the CC-state U19, "Release Request".

question_18749.question: What attribute is used to specify the maximum number of times an element from another namespace can appear in the "WLANAssistance-info" complex type?
question_18749.ground_truth: The "processContents" attribute is used to specify how to process content from another namespace and can be set to "lax" to allow any content but only validate if it's valid. The "maxOccurs" attribute is used to specify the maximum number of times an element can appear, in this case, it is set to "unbounded" meaning it can appear an indefinite number of times.

question_18752.question: What is the requirement for UE when inter-RAT NR measurements are indicated to be measured in this specification?
question_18752.ground_truth: The UE shall measure SS-RSRP and SS-RSRQ of detected NR cells in the neighbor frequency list at the minimum measurement rate specified in this clause.

question_18753.question: What state(s) should the MS be in for the GANC not to send the GA-RC REGISTER REJECT message?

question_18754.question: What is the meaning of "shall" in the 3GPP technical specifications?
question_18754.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

question_18755.question: Which service is considered in a worst-case scenario in the L-band frequency arrangement?
question_18755.ground_truth: In the worst-case scenario, the L-band frequency arrangement considers coexistence with the Fixed Service (FS), which operates in an uncoordinated manner.

question_18756.question: What is used to deliver mobile terminated short messages?

question_18757.question: What information is sent by the application in the Heartbeat Management: Start/perform/end heartbeat supervision of the application sequence diagram?
question_18757.ground_truth: The application sends its heartbeat at the specified interval, and reports its load condition to the framework load manager.

question_18758.question: What should the UE not consider as candidate cells for cell reselection if it is exclude-listed?
question_18758.ground_truth: The UE should not consider any exclude-listed cells as candidate for cell reselection.

question_18761.question: Which message is sent by a UE to another peer UE to indicate that the link identifier update request is accepted?
question_18761.ground_truth: PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE ACCEPT

question_18763.question: How does the AMF obtain the 5G-GUTI of the IAB-node when a UE accesses the network via a mobile IAB-node?
question_18763.ground_truth: The AMF obtains the 5G-GUTI of the IAB-node from the NGAP Initial UE message provided by the NG-RAN when a UE accesses the network via a mobile IAB-node.

question_18764.question: What is the initial condition for the Procedure step 7.5.4.2.2?
question_18764.ground_truth: The initial condition for Procedure step 7.5.4.2.2 is the Normal test environment, and the RF channels or Base Station RF Bandwidth positions to be tested depend on the number of carriers and the type of TAB connector involved.

question_18765.question: What performance measurements for SMF, UPF, and NEF are meaningful to be provided by 3GPP management system for a 5G VN group communication?
question_18765.ground_truth: Performance measurement for SMF: Number of successful PDU session creations, for UPF: Number of incoming GTP data packets on the N3 interface, from (R)AN to UPF, for NEF: Number of application trigger requests accepted for delivery.

question_18766.question: Which mode of operation builds on the existing functionality described in clause 9.2.2 and is limited to the SNPN(s) identified within the mobility restrictions received in the UE context in inactive mode?
question_18766.ground_truth: A UE in inactive mode operates in the SNPN(s) identified within the mobility restrictions received in the UE context.

question_18767.question: What information is used to provision a network slice instance in a 5G network?
question_18767.ground_truth: An SLS will contain service requirements that are conveyed to the CSP by the CSC and may be used to provision a network slice instance.

question_18768.question: Which 3GPP network elements are required to have the capability to temporarily stop QoE measurement reporting at RAN overload?
question_18768.ground_truth: The RAN, with the exception of UTRAN and E-UTRAN, shall have the capability to temporarily stop QoE measurement reporting at RAN overload.

question_18769.question: When can the target BSS choose to terminate the PS Handover Request procedure and send a PS-HANDOVER-REQUEST-NACK PDU?
question_18769.ground_truth: The target BSS can terminate the PS Handover Request procedure if a BSS Context could not be allocated for the MS, none of the PFCs in the PFCs To Be Set-up List IE of the PS-HANDOVER-REQUEST PDU could be granted the requested QoS, or no uplink TBF could be allocated for the MS in the BVCI.

question_18770.question: What is the maximum transmission timing error for sidelink transmissions in V2V Sidelink Communication?
question_18770.ground_truth: The transmission timing error for sidelink transmissions in V2V Sidelink Communication shall be less than or equal to Te where the timing error limit value Te is specified as 12*Ts and Ts is the basic timing unit defined in TS 36.211.

question_18771.question: What UE capability is used to determine the BWP switching delay on a single CC (TBWPswitchDelay)?

question_18772.question: What is the role of the 5G system in enabling self-healing in the Smart Energy?
question_18772.ground_truth: The 5G system is expected to provide communication services with ultra-low latency, ultra-high reliability and availability, and high data rate at both uplink and downlink to enable fast and precise detection of grid disturbances in the Smart Energy.

question_18773.question: How many bearers are cumulated to the counter when the "Failed number of PDN-GW initiated Dedicated Bearer Modification without QoS update" is received by the PDN-GW in EPS packet switching, for each cause?
question_18773.ground_truth: Each bearer that is part of the "Update Bearer Response" message with the same EPS Bearer ID, when the "Cause" IE identifies a failed bearer handling with "Rejection Response" from the "Cause" IE, is cumulated to the counter.

question_18774.question: What parameters does an operator-defined access category consist of?
question_18774.ground_truth: An operator-defined access category consists of a precedence value, an access category number in the 32-63 range, and one or more access category criteria type and associated access category criteria type values. The access category criteria type can be set to one of the following: DNN name, 5QI, OS Id + OS App Id of application triggering the access attempt, or S-NSSAI.

question_18775.question: What is the role of DRA (proxy) in the Diameter protocol when the PA2 option is implemented and a Client needs to send subsequent Diameter messages directly to the target PCRF?
question_18775.ground_truth: DRA (proxy) provides the Origin-Host AVP value to the Client, which is the identity of the target PCRF. The Client then populates the Destination-Host AVP with this address and sends any subsequent Diameter messages directly to this PCRF bypassing the DRA.

question_18776.question: What is the role of the SSO server in the SSO subsystem?
question_18776.ground_truth: The SSO server is a part of the SSO subsystem which could be leveraged to enable application servers and on the user side to establish shared keys and provide SSO service to application servers based on SIP Digest. The SSO server communicates securely with the HSS and the UE and the RP, performs authentication based on SIP digest based credentials, generates shared keys and session keys with a UE, manages the Identity-related security keys and credentials and sends session keys to the RP, encrypted by a key that is pre-shared by the IdP and the RP, inside a message to the UE.

question_18777.question: What type of service is supported by the 5G system in high-speed scenarios via the ProSe Communication path (direct)?
question_18777.ground_truth: Interactive services like VR and interactive conversations.

question_18779.question: In what circumstances shall the 3GPP AAA Server send the trust relationship to the PDN GW as specified in clause~9.1.2.5?
question_18779.ground_truth: If the 3GPP AAA Server detects that an S6b session already exists for this UE and the S6b session was established as a result of an authentication request for DSMIPv6, the 3GPP AAA Server shall send the trust relationship to the PDN GW as specified in clause~9.1.2.5.

question_18781.question: What should be the value of the "service type" IE in the SERVICE REQUEST message for case a) in subclause 5.6.1.1, if the paging request includes an indication for non-3GPP access type and the UE has PDU session(s) associated with non-3GPP access for which the associated S-NSSAI(s) are included in the allowed NSSAI for 3GPP access?
question_18781.ground_truth: The "service type" IE should be set to "mobile terminated services".

question_18782.question: What is the behavior of MCVideo client 2 when the ambient viewing call is released by the "viewed to" user?
question_18782.ground_truth: MCVideo client 2 does not provide any indication of the ambient viewing call release to its user when the ambient viewing call is released by the "viewed to" user.

question_18785.question: What protocol is recommended for establishing secure connections between NDS/IP entities on the Zb interface?
question_18785.ground_truth: The procedure for establishing secure connections using NDS/IP on the Zb interface is specified in detail in clause 5.2.2.

question_18787.question: In JavaScript, what is the relationship between the "call," "apply," and "bind" methods of a function?
question_18787.ground_truth: "Call" and "apply" allow you to invoke a function immediately with a specified context (also called "this") and arguments, while "bind" returns a new function that, when called, will have the context and part of the arguments pre-defined.

question_18788.question: What is the function of the MTC Device priority in determining when Low-Priority-Access is barred by the network?
question_18788.ground_truth: The MTC Device priority determines when Low-Priority-Access is barred by the network for the MTC Device.

question_18790.question: What is the role of the NG-RAN in the MBS session creation process without PCC?
question_18790.ground_truth: The NG-RAN is responsible for allocating radio resources for the established broadcast MBS sessions, regardless of the number of N3mb tunnels established to deliver the MBS packets in the MBS session creation process without PCC.

question_18791.question: What is a UPF in the context of 5G System architecture?
question_18791.ground_truth: A UPF (User Plane Function) in the context of 5G System architecture is a network function responsible for processing and forwarding user data packets. It can support Inter PLMN UP Security (IPUPS) functionality to protect the network from invalid inter PLMN N9 traffic in home routed roaming scenarios.

question_18794.question: What must the target I-SMF do if the user equipment (UE) moves from source I-SMF service area to A-SMF service area during the preparation phase for a handover?
question_18794.ground_truth: The target I-SMF must send a N4 Session Modification Request indicating DL AN Tunnel Info of T-RAN to the Target I-UPF and indicate DL AN Tunnel Info of T-RAN to the A-UPF if the target I-UPF is not selected during the preparation phase.

question_18796.question: What message is sent if there is a change in the channel allocation during group call re-establishment by the BSS without A-interface link sharing?
question_18796.ground_truth: The "VGCS/VBS ASSIGNMENT STATUS message" is sent if there is a change in the channel allocation during group call re-establishment by the BSS without A-interface link sharing.

question_18797.question: What are the main procedures performed by the UE for DSMIPv6 initial attach?
question_18797.ground_truth: The UE first discovers the Home Agent IPv6 address via DNS, PCO, or IKEv2. Then, the UE establishes IPsec security associations and assigns an IPv6 home network prefix. Afterward, if needed, the UE performs home link detection and initial binding registration. The UE may also discover the IPv4 address of the Home Agent.

question_18799.question: What is the purpose of the HeNB GW in the architecture?
question_18799.ground_truth: The HeNB GW serves as a concentrator for the C-Plane and may optionally terminate the user plane towards the HeNB and towards the S-GW.

question_18801.question: What is required for the redirection of traffic in the event of a TDF-U failure without a restart?
question_18801.ground_truth: The redirection of traffic is to be implemented specifically by the TDF-C.

question_18802.question: What is the role of WebRTC Third Party Function (WTPF) as defined in the document?
question_18802.ground_truth: WTPF is a function in WebRTC that enables interaction with third-party services or systems.

question_18803.question: What is the purpose of importing OPERATION and other identifiers from various modules?
question_18803.ground_truth: Importing the OPERATION and other identifiers from different modules allows for their usage and definition in the current module, ensuring consistency and standardization in the language used to describe various operations and their associated parameters.

question_18804.question: What is the definition of a "Managed network slice" as given in the document?
question_18804.ground_truth: A Managed network slice is defined in 3GPP TS 28.530 as a set of network functions and resources organized so as to provide specific network capabilities and behavior.

question_18805.question: What information does the PDN GW inform the PCRF about when dynamic PCC applies and NBIFOM is supported?
question_18805.ground_truth: The PDN GW informs the PCRF about the UE and network support of NBIFOM capability, about the requested NBIFOM mode, and about the IP-CAN type and RAT type when dynamic PCC applies and NBIFOM is supported.

question_18806.question: What is the pre-test condition for test case 8.1.6.3.3.2.3?
question_18806.ground_truth: The pre-test condition for test case 8.1.6.3.3.2.3 includes NR Cell 1, NR Cell 2, WLAN AP 1 (Cell 27), and WLAN AP 2 (Cell 27b).

question_18807.question: What parameter determines the time duration for each test iteration?
question_18807.ground_truth: The time duration for each test iteration is determined by the parameters T1, T2, and T3.

question_18810.question: What is the historical character T6 for the ANSWER TO RESET command in the initial conditions?

question_18812.question: What is the purpose of the MBMS Session Stop procedure?
question_18812.ground_truth: The purpose of the MBMS Session Stop procedure is to request the UTRAN to notify UEs about the end of a given MBMS Session and to release the corresponding MBMS RAB and MBMS Iu signalling connection for this MBMS Session.

question_18813.question: In which sub-message is the Home Network Identifier provided by the AGF when sending a SUCI to the AMF for FN-RG?
question_18813.ground_truth: The Home Network Identifier is provided in the SUCI made up to include a Line Id (together with an operator Id of the operator administrating the Line ID value) from the AGF to the AMF.

question_18814.question: What must the MCVideo client do when it receives a PRIVATE CALL SETUP REQUEST message with Commencement mode set to "MANUAL COMMENCEMENT MODE" and the call type set to "PRIVATE VIDEO PUSH CALL"?
question_18814.ground_truth: The MCVideo client must set the stored current call type to "PRIVATE VIDEO PUSH CALL" and perform the procedures of clause 10.3.2.4.4.

question_18816.question: What should the AMF include in the DL NAS TRANSPORT message when sending a single uplink 5GSM message which was not forwarded because the UE is registered to a PLMN via a satellite NG-RAN cell that is not allowed to operate at the present UE location?
question_18816.ground_truth: The AMF should include the PDU session ID in the PDU session ID IE, set the Payload container type IE to "N1 SM information", set the Payload container IE to the 5GSM message which was not forwarded, and set the 5GMM cause IE to the 5GMM cause #78 "PLMN not allowed to operate at the present UE location".

question_18819.question: What will be the effect of using larger TTI sizes in adaptive chase combining on the overall computational load in the N-GSM using less complex channel equalizer and subsequent FFT detector?
question_18819.ground_truth: It will not increase the overall computational load.

question_18821.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the LTE anchor agnostic approach?
question_18821.ground_truth: The LTE anchor agnostic approach means that the NR or E-UTRA does not have any specific requirements for the LTE anchor.

question_18822.question: What is the purpose of AF triggered EAS migration in 5GC?
question_18822.ground_truth: AF triggered EAS migration in 5GC is used to move some UE(s) from the source EAS to the target EAS for load balancing purposes or to move all UEs being served by the source EAS to a target EAS for abnormal conditions. The AF influence content information that needs to be included in the AF triggered EAS migration includes a list of UE IP addresses and port numbers, source EAS IP address for the impacted DNAI, and target EAS IP address for the impacted DNAI.

question_18823.question: How many URLLC users per cell were assumed in the evaluation for urban macro, which resulted in a UE satisfaction percentage lower than 95% for uplink transmission with a resource utilization of 7.3% or 16.2%, assuming realistic channel estimation, and up to 4 Tx/4 Rx at gNB size and 2 Tx/4 Rx at the UE side?

question_18825.question: What is the expected behavior of the UE during time duration T4?
question_18825.ground_truth: During T4, the UE is not expected to decode the UL grant and conduct any UL transmission, since the UE is expected to declare RLF during T3.

question_18826.question: What is the purpose of the test in 22.13.3a)?
question_18826.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that power level changes using EPC are implemented by the MS in accordance with conformance requirements 1, 5 and 7.

question_18827.question: What should the UE not conduct during T4 in this test scenario?
question_18827.ground_truth: The UE should not conduct any NPUSCH transmission during T4 in this test scenario.

question_18828.question: How does the Media Service Application request content from the Media Service Provider?
question_18828.ground_truth: The Media Service Application requests content from the Media Service Provider by using the URL for the media service, typically through Android app links or the APIs defined by the Media Service Application.

question_18830.question: What action should the MME employ if the current location service attempt is permanently impeded?
question_18830.ground_truth: The MME should abort the current location service attempt and the associated signalling dialogue with the E-SMLC.

question_18831.question: What is the use of the 3GPP Vendor-Specific attribute in the Accounting-Request START messages?
question_18831.ground_truth: The 3GPP Vendor-Specific attribute is present for a 5G-BRG accessing the 5GC via wireline access network and is used to provide details such as the HFC Node Identifier, Global Line Identifier, type of the wireline, Network ID, and the S-NSSAI in the Accounting-Request START messages.

question_18832.question: What action does the UE (MCPTT Client) take when the ongoing MCPTT emergency private call has been cancelled by the remote client?
question_18832.ground_truth: The UE (MCPTT Client) accepts the request and after sending a SIP 200 (OK) response leaves the MCPTT session.

question_18833.question: What are the expected conditions for the central MTLF to apply federated learning?
question_18833.ground_truth: Federated learning is applied when data required for training an ML model cannot be collected directly from an NF, or when federated learning is required for a DNAI or a specific service area.

question_18834.question: What is the impact of Band 5 and Band 46 harmonics on the BS and UE receive bands in the context of UL and DL?
question_18834.ground_truth: There is no issue of harmonic interference between Band 5 and Band 46 harmonics in the BS and UE receive bands of interest.

question_18835.question: What is the system that allows a train driver from Country A to communicate with a traffic controller from Country B in their native languages?
question_18835.ground_truth: The system is called Real-Time Text to Text (T2T) translation, which is part of the FRMCS (Future Railway Mobile Communication System).

question_18837.question: What is the action taken by the transmission control server when ending a media transmission initiated by a remote user?
question_18837.ground_truth: The transmission control server checks whether the user at the UE of the transmission control participant that initiated the media transmission is authorized to end the ongoing media transmission. If authorized, the transmission control server ends the media transmission and sends transmit media end notify messages to the transmission control participants receiving the media transmission.

question_18838.question: What are the two available mechanisms for an application to receive multimedia messages in Part 5 of the OSA specifications?
question_18838.ground_truth: The two available mechanisms for an application to receive multimedia messages in Part 5 of the OSA specifications are a polling mechanism and an asynchronous notification mechanism.

question_18839.question: How is mobility management between 3GPP and non-3GPP accesses handled in the enhanced EPS architecture?
question_18839.ground_truth: The mobility support function of handover towards non-3GPP accesses is handled by the PDN GW when the UE leaves the eNB.

question_18840.question: What component carrier requirements apply for E-UTRA UL transmission in inter-band V2X concurrent operation?
question_18840.ground_truth: The output dynamic requirements specified in clause 6.3 of TS 36.101 apply for E-UTRA UL transmission.

question_18841.question: What protocol is used to transfer data between the SGSN and the HLR in the Gr-interface?
question_18841.ground_truth: The Mobile Application Part (MAP), which in turn uses the services of Transaction Capabilities (TCAP), is used to transfer data between the SGSN and the HLR in the Gr-interface.

question_18842.question: What is the Timing Advance Command value set during time duration T1?
question_18842.ground_truth: The Timing Advance Command value set during time duration T1 is 31, which results in zero adjustment of the Timing Advance.

question_18843.question: What is the purpose of system selection or PLMN selection in a multi system terminal?
question_18843.ground_truth: The purpose of system selection or PLMN selection in a multi system terminal is to ensure 3GPP compliance and protection of 3GPP networks in cases where operators operate more than one system, either through choice or company merger/acquisition.

question_18844.question: What is the purpose of step 6 of the solution provided by Solution #6?
question_18844.ground_truth: In step 6 of the solution provided by Solution #6, the AAnF generates the KMBS and sends it to MBSF/MSF-C, while the MBSTF computes the MAC-I using KMBS and checks if it is the same with the received MAC-I from UE to authenticate and authorize the UE.

question_18845.question: What should the UE do when the counter for "the entry for the current SNPN considered invalid for 3GPP access" events reaches its maximum value?
question_18845.ground_truth: The UE should delete the list of equivalent SNPNs, if any, and enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE. Additionally, it should delete 5G-GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list, and ngKSI for 3GPP access.

question_18846.question: How does solution 12 ensure the security of the RN-core network connection?
question_18846.ground_truth: Solution 12 ensures end-to-end protection between the RN and the core network by providing integrity protection for the S1 and X2 control plane traffic over the Un. Integrity protection is also applied to the S1 control plane traffic between RN and MME-UE and to the X2 control plane traffic between RN and eNB/RN. Mutual authentication between RN and the network is provided by EPS AKA, and relay device authentication is fulfilled by implicit platform authentication.

question_18847.question: What information may be lost at Xn handover or UE context retrieval due to old NG-RAN nodes?
question_18847.ground_truth: Information provided by the 5GC within the NGAP Mobility Restriction List may be lost at Xn handover or UE context retrieval due to old NG-RAN nodes not being able to recognize the entire content.

question_18850.question: What is the effect on F-DPCH power consumption when a constant power offset is applied to the LPN power controlled F-DPCH Ec/Ior?
question_18850.ground_truth: With a constant power offset, the power consumption of F-DPCH increases compared to the case when the UE DL TPC tracks the LPN F-DPCH.

question_18851.question: What is the typical delay for the UE processing time, including RF/baseband retuning and security update in the interruption time?
question_18851.ground_truth: The typical delay for the UE processing time, including RF/baseband retuning and security update in the interruption time is 20 ms.

question_18854.question: What is a primary function of Performance Management (PM) in E-OSF?
question_18854.ground_truth: Performance Management (PM) in E-OSF is an essential function of network management that defines measurement tasks for NE performance, collects, saves, and displays performance data, and provides network service quality recommendations, resource allocation, and optimization.

question_18855.question: What message should a participating MCPTT function send to the MCPTT client upon receiving a failed call setup indication from the controlling MCPTT function?
question_18855.ground_truth: A Disconnect message should be sent to the MCPTT client.

question_18858.question: What should the RCAF send to the MME to request the list of IMSIs and APNs for multiple eNodeBs or E-UTRAN Cell Ids?
question_18858.ground_truth: The RCAF should send an NqAP-IMSI-APN-INFORMATION-REQUEST message with multiple instances of the RAN Entity Identifier IE.

question_18862.question: When should the P-CSCF remove the Geolocation header field's loc-src parameter?
question_18862.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall remove the loc-src parameter from the Geolocation header field if the P-CSCF receives a Geolocation header field with a loc-src parameter from the UE.

question_18863.question: What are the two possible events that can trigger a change in the user's terminal status from attached to detached?
question_18863.ground_truth: The two possible events are when the user's terminal is switched off or when the network initiates detach upon location update failure.

question_18865.question: In what situations must a UE include the "User security key ID" IE when establishing a 5G ProSe direct link?
question_18865.ground_truth: The UE must include the "User security key ID" IE when the 5G ProSe direct link establishment procedure is for direct communication between the 5G ProSe remote UE and the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE or for direct communication between the 5G ProSe end UE and the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE, and the security procedure over user plane or control plane for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay or UE-to-UE relay is used.

question_18866.question: What action should a non-controlling MCVideo function take if an Accept-Contact header field does not include the g.3gpp.mcvideo media feature tag in a SIP INVITE request for non-controlling MCVideo function of an MCVideo group?
question_18866.ground_truth: The non-controlling MCVideo function should reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and not process the remaining steps.

question_18867.question: What is the appropriate signalling protocol for the eP-CSCF when it uses Gm towards the WIC?
question_18867.ground_truth: The appropriate signalling protocol for the eP-CSCF when it uses Gm towards the WIC is defined in 3GPP TS 24.229.

question_18868.question: What is the test purpose in sections 7.3A.3.3.1 and 7.3A.3.3.4?
question_18868.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify the UE's conformance to specific 3GPP protocols.

question_18869.question: What triggers the removal of the CAT-B to UE-A in the CAT-B server during a video call?
question_18869.ground_truth: The removal of the CAT-B to UE-A in the CAT-B server during a video call can be triggered either when the CAT-B server receives the call forwarding indication or when a CAT-B server receives indication that a CAT-C is connected.

question_18871.question: What happens when the CS/PS coordination process directs the user equipment (UE) to operator B in a MOCN network?
question_18871.ground_truth: The call setup will fail in most networks since core networks in MOCN are usually not connected to each other.

question_18873.question: What are the procedures for Information Provisioning to a 5G ProSe Remote UE/UE-to-UE Relay?
question_18873.ground_truth: The Registration procedures, UE Policy Association Establishment procedure, and UE Policy Association Modification procedure of TS~23.502 apply with additions to authorize UE as a 5G ProSe Remote UE/UE-to-UE Relay, and to determine and provide 5G ProSe Remote UE/UE-to-UE Relay Information to the UE.

question_18874.question: What is the function of the DF2 delivery function in the PTC architecture?
question_18874.ground_truth: The DF2 delivery function is used to convert the information on the X2-interface to the corresponding information on the HI2 interface and to distribute the intercept-related information to the relevant LEAs. It is also responsible for extracting intercepted SIP signalling information related to encryption and sending a request to the KMS to derive the encryption keys.

question_18876.question: What is the scenario described in 4.5.1, where authorized MC user A requests discreet listening for MC user B who is within the authority of authorized MC user A and where authorized MC user A receives MCVideo pushes initiated or received by MC user B?
question_18876.ground_truth: This scenario is the same as those described in subclause 4.2.1 for MCVideo private call within a single MC service server, and in subclause 4.2.2 where authorized MC user and target MC user are receiving service from different MC service servers.

question_18878.question: What is the test requirement for the in-sync test in 7.3.2?
question_18878.ground_truth: The test requirement for the in-sync test in 7.3.2 is that the UE must transmit uplink signals during specified time durations, with the uplink signal being a power level of at least -39 dBm.

question_18881.question: What is the NF Service Consumer required to do when invoking the EnableUEReachability service operation?
question_18881.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer is required to send a PUT request to the resource representing the ueReachInd resource of the AMF, with the content of the PUT request containing an "EnableUeReachabilityReqData" object.

question_18882.question: What is the purpose of the Security Association Database (SAD) in 3GPP TS 34.229-4?
question_18882.ground_truth: The Security Association Database (SAD) in 3GPP TS 34.229-4 contains sets of parameters corresponding to each security association, which are negotiated through SIP message exchanges between the UE and SS during registration/authentication. A number of ASPs are defined to convey these parameters from TTCN-3 codes to SAD and perform necessary operations on these parameters.

question_18883.question: What should the UE do upon receiving an EAP-request/AKA'-challenge message within AUTHENTICATION REQUEST with ngKSI is already in use for the third time?
question_18883.ground_truth: The UE should locally release the RRC connection and treat the active cell as barred.

question_18884.question: When must an MME/SGSN ignore a message in SCTP associations?
question_18884.ground_truth: An MME/SGSN must ignore a message in SCTP associations if the message is too short, unknown or unforeseen, sent in the wrong direction, or contains missing mandatory information elements.

question_18885.question: What should the MS do if the network accepts the GPRS attach procedure for GPRS and non-GPRS services?
question_18885.ground_truth: The MS should acknowledge the P-TMSI or the new P-TMSI, and continue communication with the P-TMSI or the new P-TMSI. For CS calls, the MS should continue communication with the IMSI or the new TMSI.

question_18886.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body when canceling an in-progress emergency condition and an MCVideo emergency alert originated by the MCVideo user?
question_18886.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body populated as specified in clause~6.2.8.1.3.

question_18887.question: What type of analytics information can the NWDAF provide to a consumer NF regarding UE proximity?
question_18887.ground_truth: The NWDAF can provide relative proximity analytics, which includes statistics or predictions about the relative proximity of UEs.

question_18893.question: What is the resulting action after the UE derives the KAUSF from MSK in the described passage?
question_18893.ground_truth: The UE derives the KAUSF from MSK instead of EMSK, either based on an indicator received from AMF or by interpretation of the realm part of the NAI that might indicate the use of external CdP.

question_18895.question: How should the UE request the GPS or GANSS almanac in A-GNSS test cases?
question_18895.ground_truth: The UE should request the GPS or GANSS almanac by setting the appropriate information element in the MO-LR request for assistance data.

question_18897.question: What should the UE provide in step 1 of clause 4.11.2.4.1 if it operates in single-registration mode and is moving from EPC?
question_18897.ground_truth: The UE should provide a Registration type set to "mobility registration update", a mapped 5G-GUTI from the 4G-GUTI, and a native 5G-GUTI if available.

question_18898.question: When is a NR carrier cell not considered in cell reselection?
question_18898.ground_truth: A NR carrier cell is not considered for cell reselection if it is indicated as not allowed in the measurement control system information of the serving cell.

question_18899.question: What is the requirement for determining authorization for cancelling an MCPTT imminent peril call?
question_18899.ground_truth: If the IWF receives a SIP request with the <imminentperil-ind> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body set to a value of "false", the IWF may authorize the MCPTT imminent peril call cancellation request.

question_18900.question: What is the name of the famous clock tower in London?

question_18901.question: What is the purpose of the BVC-RESET procedure in the GPRS network?
question_18901.ground_truth: The BVC-RESET procedure synchronises the initialisation of GPRS BVC related contexts at a BSS and SGSN, enabling them to begin communication in known states by requiring that after the completion of the BVC-Reset procedure, the BSS initiates the block procedure for all affected BVCs that are marked as blocked at the BSS.

question_18902.question: What information must be provided to the AS layer for PC5 data transmission?
question_18902.ground_truth: The PC5 Link Identifier, PFI, PC5 unicast link-related information including Layer-2 ID information (i.e. source and destination Layer-2 IDs), and ProSe data must be provided to the AS layer for PC5 data transmission.

question_18903.question: What is the minimum measurement filtering requirements that the UE must still meet before it makes any determination that it may stop measuring the cell if the UE detects on a E-UTRA carrier a cell whose physical identity is indicated as not allowed for that carrier in the measurement control system information of the serving cell?
question_18903.ground_truth: The minimum measurement filtering requirements that the UE must still meet before it makes any determination that it may stop measuring the cell if the UE detects on a E-UTRA carrier a cell whose physical identity is indicated as not allowed for that carrier in the measurement control system information of the serving cell are specified later in this section.

question_18906.question: What is the name of the feature where the MS uses two receive antennas to improve performance under non-interfering and interfering scenarios?
question_18906.ground_truth: DARP Phase II, also referred as Mobile Station Receiver Diversity

question_18907.question: What should an MTSI client indicate in an attribute (a=) line to indicate support for AVPF using SDPCapNeg mechanisms?
question_18907.ground_truth: The transport capability attribute 'tcap' should be used in an attribute (a=) line to indicate support for AVPF using SDPCapNeg mechanisms.

question_18908.question: What is the transport protocol used in the Proxy mode of the Transparent delivery method?
question_18908.ground_truth: The transport protocol used in the Proxy mode of the Transparent delivery method is UDP/IP.

question_18911.question: What is the role of a small cell range expansion technique in a heterogeneous network deployment?
question_18911.ground_truth: Range expansion is a desirable technique to expand the service area of a small cell and achieve load balancing between Macro and small cells, but it can introduce new DL interference problems.

question_18912.question: How long can the possible interruption period be for SCell activation/hibernation?
question_18912.ground_truth: The possible interruption period for SCell activation/hibernation is 1 subframe, which occurs in the range of subframe m+5 to m+9.

question_18913.question: What should a receiving node do when it receives a message with a Procedure Code IE marked with "Ignore IE and Notify Sender" that it does not comprehend?
question_18913.ground_truth: The receiving node should ignore the procedure and initiate the Error Indication procedure.

question_18914.question: What is the impact of clearing errors using the RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message?
question_18914.ground_truth: When the RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message is used to clear errors, only all errors for one object can be cleared per message, and it is not possible to clear one out of several errors for one object.

question_18915.question: What is the significance of "common data" in the 3GPP technical specifications?
question_18915.ground_truth: Common data refers to sets of permanent data where the values are common to a large number of users. This data is stored in the UDR and is used by various functional entities in the 3GPP system.

question_18916.question: What is one of the approaches described for the design of a complete data model of an end-user?
question_18916.ground_truth: Approach 1 exposes the complete model to all network functions and uses Adaptation Layer Functionality to guarantee the integrity of semantically identical data entities for all involved network functions.

question_18917.question: What issue is indicated when the signal being received cannot be identified or understood by the receiver?

question_18918.question: What is the action taken by the MS when it receives the GA-RRC RELEASE message with GA-RRC Cause value #83?
question_18918.ground_truth: When the GA-RRC sublayer entity in the MS receives the GA-RRC RELEASE message with GA-RRC Cause value #83, it shall send a GA-RRC RELEASE COMPLETE message to the GANC, release the GA-RRC connection and any user plane resources for the indicated domain, stop timer TU5002 for the domain (if running), stop timer TU5909 for the domain (if running), and enter the GA-RRC-IDLE state for the domain.

question_18920.question: What message is sent by a UE to another peer UE when a 5G ProSe direct link re-keying procedure is initiated?

question_18921.question: What is the impact of the extended idle mode DRX on mobile terminated data and specifically on SMS?
question_18921.ground_truth: The extended idle mode DRX may impact the delay tolerance of mobile terminated data, SMS, and device triggers. A network side application must be aware that extended idle mode DRX may be in place and ensure that any mobile terminated CS services or SMS are able to handle the extended idle mode DRX.

question_18924.question: What must the UE include in the response to a RequestCapabilities message?
question_18924.ground_truth: The UE must include the capabilities of the device for each supported positioning method in the response message.

question_18925.question: What is the purpose of a g.3gpp.iut-xyz media feature tag in a SIP REFER request?
question_18925.ground_truth: The g.3gpp.iut-xyz media feature tag is used to explicitly identify the media capability of a user equipment (UE) in the IMS (IP Multimedia Subsystem) network, allowing for more accurate selection and allocation of media resources.

question_18929.question: What should the Node B do if the E-DCH Decoupling Indication IE is included in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message?
question_18929.ground_truth: The Node B should use this indication for E-DCH decoupling operation if supported.

question_18930.question: What are the services provided by the RLC function to the upper layers?
question_18930.ground_truth: The RLC function provides the following services to the upper layers: Transparent data transfer, Acknowledged data transfer, Unacknowledged data transfer, Notification of unrecoverable errors, Notification of discard, Suspend, Resume, Stop, Continue, and Re-establishment.

question_18932.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 6.7.4.1.1.4?
question_18932.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the SSB based L1-RSRP absolute measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for all bands.

question_18933.question: How is the transaction identifier coded in case of Data Connection Status Change event?
question_18933.ground_truth: The transaction identifier is coded as an identifier generated by the terminal to uniquely identify the PDP or PDN or PDU data connection, regardless of the bearer of the connection, and the TI flag is always 0 in this data connection transaction identifier.

question_18935.question: What is the difference between the two described test procedures (clause 6.3.6 and 6.3.7) in terms of the initial conditions?
question_18935.ground_truth: The main difference is that in clause 6.3.7, a single E-UTRA TDD serving cell and one UTRA TDD cell are specified, while in clause 6.3.6, two cells (Cell 1 and Cell 2) are specified, with Cell 1 being the active cell for both clauses. The propagation conditions, message contents, and power level settings are also set differently between the two test procedures.

question_18937.question: What is a MnS producer described by?
question_18937.ground_truth: A MnS producer is described by a set of meta data called MnS producer profile.

question_18938.question: What is the largest part of RTT (Round Trip Time) error in non-collocated serving cells in CoMP or CA scenarios for E-CID positioning?
question_18938.ground_truth: The largest part of RTT error comes from the wrong judgement of anchor point for RTT estimation.

question_18939.question: What is the procedure for forwarding URSP rule enforcement information in the 5G Core network?
question_18939.ground_truth: The procedure for forwarding URSP rule enforcement information in the 5G Core network involves the UE sending reporting of URSP rule enforcement to the SMF, which then forwards the information to the PCF serving the PDU session. The PCF then forwards this information to the PCF serving the UE.

question_18941.question: What message format should be included in the HTTP POST request when updating group information in the VAE server?

question_18942.question: What is the requirement for CRS based measurements of cells on the primary component carrier in E-UTRA carrier aggregation?
question_18942.ground_truth: CRS based measurements of cells on the primary component carrier shall meet all applicable requirements (FDD or TDD) in clause~8.6.2.1.

question_18943.question: What is the 5GMM cause sent to the UE if the network does not accept an initial registration procedure for emergency services using a PEI?

question_18945.question: What should a controlling MCVideo function do if the terminating participating MCVideo function is in an interconnected MCVideo system in a different trust domain?
question_18945.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should set the Request-URI to the public service identity of the terminating participating MCVideo function associated to the MCVideo user, and route the SIP request through an MCVideo gateway server that acts as an exit point from the local MCVideo system to the interconnected MCVideo system.

question_18946.question: What radio parameters are provisioned in the UE in support of the UE assuming the role of a 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay when the UE is not "served by NG-RAN"?
question_18946.ground_truth: The radio parameters include NR PC5 with Geographical Area(s) and an indication of whether they are "operator managed" or "non-operator managed". The UE uses the radio parameters to perform 5G ProSe Direct Discovery over PC5 reference point when "not served by NG-RAN" only if the UE can reliably locate itself in the corresponding Geographical Area.

question_18948.question: What is the importance of sub-test 5 in 3GPP 36.508 for LCS sub-test cases?
question_18948.ground_truth: The values for sub-test 5 are used for the default message content in subclause 5.4 of 3GPP 36.508, for LCS sub-test cases.

question_18949.question: What is the definition of "5G NAS security context" in the present document?
question_18949.ground_truth: 5G NAS security context refers to the initial security context exchanged between the UE and the network, it includes the security algorithms, keys and key identifiers, and other security-related information.

question_18950.question: What is the relationship between user profile and capability negotiation in MExE?
question_18950.ground_truth: The user profile contains the user's preferences, and the capability negotiation contains the preferences that the MExE device is able to support, allowing the MSE to serve the MExE device with the lowest common denominator of the user's preferences, device capabilities, and service characteristics.

question_18951.question: What event triggers the generation of the "deregistration xIRI" by the IRI-POI in the RCS Server or IMS signalling function?
question_18951.ground_truth: The "deregistration xIRI" is generated by the IRI-POI in an RCS Server or IMS Signalling Function when it detects that a target UE has been deregistered from RCS services.

question_18952.question: What is the purpose of the "Number of successful handover executions per beam pair" measurement?
question_18952.ground_truth: The purpose of the measurement is to provide the number of successful handover executions received by the source gNB per beam pair, i.e. beam in the source and beam in the target cell.

question_18953.question: What is the main focus of the modifications to the Inner Receiver (IRX) in the DSP super-block for EC-GSM?
question_18953.ground_truth: The main focus is on modifications for FCCH, EC-SCH, and EC-PDTCH, with EC-PDTCH decoding being the critical scenario to satisfy real-time requirements.

question_18954.question: What is the purpose of caching information in the partner MC system for continued operation during failure conditions?
question_18954.ground_truth: Caching information would enable continued operation during failure conditions in links between the primary MC system and partner MC system. However, the application of this must be considered against any potential consequences of synchronisation errors.

question_18955.question: When is a cell considered as a "detected cell" by the UE?
question_18955.ground_truth: A cell is considered as a "detected cell" by the UE when it is not included in the measurement object(s) but is detected on the carrier frequency(ies) indicated by the measurement object(s).

question_18956.question: What is the purpose of the Plug and Connect (PnC) procedure described in the document?
question_18956.ground_truth: The PnC procedure describes the steps for a Network Element (NE) to connect to its management system and obtain basic connectivity information after being powered up.

question_18957.question: What is the handover delay requirement for the E-UTRAN FDD-FDD intra frequency handover test case?
question_18957.ground_truth: The handover delay shall be less than a total of 50 ms, which includes 15 ms for maximum RRC procedure delay and 35 ms for Tinterrupt.

question_18958.question: What is the difference between a GCSE Group and a ProSe Group?
question_18958.ground_truth: A GCSE Group includes all group members that take part in a common group communication, regardless of their network access method. A ProSe Group is a local concept designating a collection of UEs capable of communicating with each other or with the network and belonging to the same local IP subnet. UEs connected to the same ProSe Group may actually be unaffiliated and may belong to different GCSE Groups.

question_18959.question: What were the conditions evaluated in the test for spatial audio localization?
question_18959.ground_truth: In addition to the Ambisonics of orders 1, 2 and 3, three additional conditions were evaluated in the test to span the quality scale better.

question_18961.question: What must the MS do during call establishment if a Layer 3 message is not Layer 2 acknowledged before the channel change caused by the HANDOVER COMMAND message?
question_18961.ground_truth: The MS shall send the Layer 3 message to the new cell, using the same value in the N(SD) field, after the handover procedure.

question_18962.question: What is the attribute used for providing WLAN performance analytics requirements in the "wlanReqs" attribute?
question_18962.ground_truth: The "wlanReqs" attribute may include network area, SSID(s), BSSID(s), preferred order of results for the list of WLAN performance information, and accuracy per analytics subset for providing WLAN performance analytics requirements in the "wlanReqs" attribute.

question_18963.question: What is a recommended requirement for the 3GPP network regarding managed streaming service?
question_18963.ground_truth: The 3GPP network needs to be able to allow the operator to collect QoE metrics of any managed streaming service.

question_18964.question: When must the UE include the Port management information container IE in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message?
question_18964.ground_truth: The UE must include the Port management information container IE in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message if a port management information container needs to be delivered.

question_18966.question: What is the maximum length of the control frame payload in the Common Control Channel control frames?
question_18966.ground_truth: The maximum length of the control frame payload in the Common Control Channel control frames is 239 octets.

question_18967.question: What subclause of TS 37.571-2 defines the MBS performance test cases for which scenario data is defined in Subclause 8.2?
question_18967.ground_truth: Subclause 8.1 of TS 37.571-2 refers to the MBS performance test cases for which scenario data is defined in Subclause 8.2.

question_18968.question: How do UE and LMF transfer assistance data for OTDOA positioning measurements?
question_18968.ground_truth: The UE sends a Request Assistance Data message to the LMF with an indication of which specific OTDOA assistance data are requested. The LMF provides the requested assistance data in a Provide Assistance Data message if available.

question_18969.question: What is the role of the SS in the Extended Dynamic Allocation MAC mode procedure?
question_18969.ground_truth: The SS sends RLC/MAC control blocks to the mobile station, interprets messages from the mobile station, assigns USF values, and monitors the mobile station's compliance with the procedure.

question_18970.question: What should the "Polling bit" in the AMD PDU header be set to if a poll has been triggered but polling is not prohibited?
question_18970.ground_truth: The "Polling bit" in the AMD PDU header should be set to "1" if a poll has been triggered and polling is not prohibited.

question_18971.question: What is the purpose of using two different asymmetric windows for LP analysis in this process?
question_18971.ground_truth: The purpose of using two different asymmetric windows for LP analysis is to perform LP analysis twice per frame using two different window sets. The first window has its weight concentrated at the second subframe, while the second window has its weight concentrated at the fourth subframe. This is done to ensure that the windows are applied to 80 samples from past speech frames in addition to the 160 samples of the present speech frame, without using any samples from future frames.

question_18972.question: What should the network do if the requested TFT is not available for modification in the MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message?
question_18972.ground_truth: The network shall reply with a MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REJECT message with an appropriate cause code.

question_18973.question: What event is triggered when the management data files have been prepared ready in the IRPAgent in the context of File Transfer?
question_18973.ground_truth: The notifyFileReady event is triggered when the management data files have been prepared ready in the IRPAgent in the context of File Transfer.

question_18974.question: What size is the first RBG for a downlink carrier bandwidth part i of size PRBs in downlink resource allocation of type 0?
question_18974.ground_truth: The size of the first RBG is P, where P is the size of the carrier bandwidth part in PRBs.

question_18975.question: What is the property of a transaction in which it is only committed if all database operations have been carried out successfully?

question_18977.question: What is required for the "Combination of CS and IMS services" to be applicable to GERAN access?
question_18977.ground_truth: A CSI capable UE requires DTM capability (Dual Transfer Mode) for the "Combination of CS and IMS services" to be applicable to GERAN access.

question_18978.question: What is the error protection scheme that is applied to the transport formats in the static part?
question_18978.ground_truth: The error protection scheme applied to the transport formats in the static part is turbo coding with a coding rate of 1/3 and a size of CRC of 24 bits.

question_18979.question: Which protocolIEs are mandatory in the MBMSCNDe-RegistrationResponse message?
question_18979.ground_truth: The mandatory protocolIEs in the MBMSCNDe-RegistrationResponse message are "id-TMGI" and "id-GlobalRNC-ID".

question_18980.question: What is the purpose of the "Non-3GPP access path switching while using old AN resources" indication provided by the UE?
question_18980.ground_truth: It indicates that the UP connection(s) via the old non-3GPP access can still be used for the MA PDU Session(s) during the Registration procedure, allowing a smooth transition between the old and new access paths.

question_18981.question: What is the purpose of the identifier association xIRI in the MME?
question_18981.ground_truth: The identifier association xIRI in the MME is used to report the association change between a UE's temporary identifier and a permanent identifier such as IMSI or IMEI.

question_18982.question: What is the condition for a failure in the event "Cell 1 A2"?
question_18982.ground_truth: If the UE sends event-triggered measurement reports before the beginning of time period T3 or fails to report the event within the overall delays measured requirement, then the number of failures for the event "Cell 1 A2" is increased by one.

question_18983.question: What is the purpose of sending a PDU Set Descriptor in advance of sending the PDUs in this solution?
question_18983.ground_truth: The advantage of sending a PDU Set Descriptor in advance of sending the PDUs is that the headers of the individual PDUs will not need to be marked with as much information, and the PDU Set Descriptor can be structured so that it is extensible in future releases, and the addition of new header fields in lower layer protocols can be avoided.

question_18984.question: What message flow is used in ProSe Direct Discovery for charging data collection in TS 23.303?
question_18984.ground_truth: ProSe operation flows are based on the procedures defined in TS 23.303, including ProSe Direct Discovery Announce Request, ProSe Direct Discovery Announce Response, and ProSe Direct Discovery Monitor Request.

question_18985.question: What message type is sent by the network at any time to ask the MS for setting of parameters and consequential actions?

question_18986.question: What must the MCVideo client do if it receives a SIP MESSAGE request for a group selection change and the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body of the request contains an <affiliation-required> element set to "true"?
question_18986.ground_truth: The MCVideo client must invoke the procedures of clause 8.2.1.2 to affiliate to the MCVideo group identified by the <mcvideo-calling-group-id> in the MIME body, invoke the procedures of clause 8.2.1.3 if it hasn't already, and determine the success of the affiliation procedure when it receives a SIP NOTIFY request with a matching <p-id> value.

question_18987.question: How does the UE perform the 4-way handshake for secure connection establishment with the WLAN AN?
question_18987.ground_truth: The AUN3 device performs a 4-way handshake to establish a secure connection with the WLAN AN after the establishment of a WLAN connection between the AUN3 device and the WLAN Access Network (AN) and deriving the WLAN keys from the PMK (Pairwise Master Key).
