question_20306.ground_truth: The AMF receives from the OAM the information on availability of a network slice when the granularity is smaller than TA, i.e. if the NS-AoS includes TAs where the network slice is not available in some cells of the TA.

question_20307.question: What event does the IRI-POI in the SCEF detect when it generates an xIRI containing a SCEFDeviceTrigger record?
question_20307.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the SCEF generates an xIRI containing a SCEFDeviceTrigger record when the IRI-POI present in the SCEF detects that an SCS/AS has sent a Device triggering request to a target UE matching one of the target identifiers.

question_20309.question: What is the role of the HSS in the location reporting process for UE-B?
question_20309.ground_truth: The HSS is responsible for starting location reporting related to UE-B by sending a Location Reporting Request message to the MME in step 6b. The HSS also responds with Location Notification Ack messages to the MME and the ProSe Server in steps 11b and 12b.

question_20312.question: Which access technology is recognized from Rel-6 onwards as an alternative access system to access services of the mobile core network?
question_20312.ground_truth: WLAN (Wireless Local Area Network) is recognized from Rel-6 onwards.

question_20315.question: What is the function of the Notification control in the context of management service producers?
question_20315.ground_truth: Notification control refers to the forwarding of notifications to the consumer as soon as they are available.

question_20316.question: What is the purpose of the mirroring pattern in uplink frequency hopping with channel bonding size of 8?
question_20316.ground_truth: The mirroring pattern is inserted periodically during a frequency hopping cycle to preserve the single carrier property with channel bonding size of 8, preventing the set of bonded channels from being segmented within the allocated uplink channel in the base station sector.

question_20317.question: What is the data type of the "longitude" and "latitude" elements defined in the "tPointCoordinate" complexType?
question_20317.ground_truth: The "longitude" and "latitude" elements defined in the "tPointCoordinate" complexType are of type "vaeinfo:tCoordinateType".

question_20318.question: Which reference point is used by the WAG in the non-roaming case?
question_20318.ground_truth: The Wa reference point is used by the WAG in the non-roaming case.

question_20319.question: In the context of 4G and 5G mobile networks, what is the purpose of custom operations in the NF service architecture?
question_20319.ground_truth: Custom operations in the NF (Network Function) service architecture provide procedures for a service consumer to interact with an NF service producer in ways other than what is supported by the CRUD (Create, Retrieve, Update, Delete) methods. They can be related to a resource or to an entire service, and are identified by a verb as a name for the custom operation at the end of the resource or service URI.

question_20320.question: What is the method in OSA API mapping for the occurrence of fault in user interaction?
question_20320.ground_truth: userInteractionFaultDetected is the method in OSA API mapping for the occurrence of fault in user interaction.

question_20321.question: What is returned as the value of the Hop counter in a single SCCP XUDT message if the message is not segmented?

question_20323.question: What is the required total number of successful tests for the test to pass with a confidence level of 95%?
question_20323.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests shall be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

question_20325.question: What are the pre-conditions for enabling the MCS to announce a new MBMS bearer, as defined in subclause 6.4.2?
question_20325.ground_truth: The pre-conditions for enabling the MCS to announce a new MBMS bearer are: (1) an MBMS bearer used for MCS application signalling messages must have been pre-established and announced to the MCS client, and (2) additional MBMS bearer information may have already been announced to the client.

question_20329.question: What is the name of the SIP request that is used in clause 6.3.1.2 and 6.3.1.3 and is sent from the IWF to the MCData client?

question_20331.question: How long should the uplink DPCCH transmission wait before starting on the activated uplink frequency if an activation time has been given?
question_20331.ground_truth: The uplink DPCCH transmission should not start on the activated uplink frequency before the downlink physical channel has been established and the activation time has been reached.

question_20332.question: What is the format of thesecondaryCPICH-InformationList-Cell-SetupRqstFDD field?
question_20332.ground_truth: It is a sequence (SIZE (1..maxSCPICHCell)) OF ProtocolIE-Single-Container that contains SecondaryCPICH-InformationItem-Cell-SetupRqstFDD.

question_20333.question: In scenario~2.1 with HPLMN monitoring, what information does H-SMF provide if V-SMF does not have EDI and decision is mainly based on UE location?
question_20333.ground_truth: If V-SMF does not have EDI in scenario~2.1, the decision is mainly based on UE location, and H-SMF also provides the address of the selected H-EASDF.

question_20335.question: What is a purpose of the Slice-specific Policy and Charging Control in the 5G System?
question_20335.ground_truth: The purpose of the Slice-specific Policy and Charging Control in the 5G System is to define policies and manage charging for a specific Network Slice instance.

question_20336.question: What is a requirement for the 5G system to support clock synchronization in integrated 5G/non-3GPP TSN networks when the sync master and sync devices are served by different UEs?
question_20336.ground_truth: The 5G system should be able to support the flow of clock synchronization messages in either uplink and downlink direction.

question_20338.question: What is the difference between 6.17.3.2 and 6.17.4?
question_20338.ground_truth: 6.17.3.2 deals with paging, while 6.17.4 discusses the impacts on services, entities, and interfaces regarding the support of MUSIM Assistance Information and procedures.

question_20339.question: What are the steps involved in the pre-identify method in clause 7.3.5.2 for pre-identifying an IP realm in SDP offer forwarding phase?
question_20339.ground_truth: The pre-identify method involves the following steps: (a) checking the IP realms in the received IP realm list from the end, (b) finding an IP realm containing a behaviour indication with value of Category A or B, (c) identifying the IP realm if a controlled TrGW has a direct connection to an IP realm in the IP realm list, and (d) replacing the connection information of the forwarded SDP offer with that of the identified IP realm when forwarding an SDP offer.

question_20340.question: How do the Ambient IoT devices in the pig barns gain connectivity to the 5G network?
question_20340.ground_truth: Each pig barn is equipped with base stations that provide random access and data transmission over the radio interface to the Ambient IoT devices, which communicate by harvesting ambient energy (e.g., solar power).

question_20341.question: What is subclause 6.10.2.4.1.52.2.1 specifying?
question_20341.ground_truth: Subclause 6.10.2.4.1.52.2.1 specifies the transport channel parameters for Interactive or background / DL:128 kbps / PS RAB in the document.

question_20342.question: What is the definition of the threshold Qtpi in test case 5.4.5.2?
question_20342.ground_truth: The threshold Qtpi is a level of F-TPICH quality below which no reliable detection of the TPI bits transmitted on the downlink DPCCH can be made.

question_20343.question: What is the difference between L3/L4 level NAT traversal and L4+ level NAT traversal?
question_20343.ground_truth: L3/L4 level NAT traversal is NAT traversal support limited to protocol layers L3 and L4 (network and transport layer), while L4+ level NAT traversal is NAT traversal support above the IP transport layer.

question_20345.question: What does the "IP-SM-GW" abbreviation stand for in the context of 3GPP 5G System?

question_20346.question: What frequency range is used for the uplink band in the US 600 MHz eco-system development?
question_20346.ground_truth: The uplink band is in the upper 35 MHz from 663 to 698 MHz.

question_20348.question: When is the administrative state attribute manipulated in a PerfMetricJob instance?
question_20348.ground_truth: The administrative state attribute can be manipulated to temporarily suspend or resume performance metric production, or to set the operational state attribute for overload situations indicated by the MnS producer.

question_20350.question: What percentage of the total output power is used as the limit in the 1.28 Mcps TDD option?
question_20350.ground_truth: 0.5% of the total output power is used as the limit in the 1.28 Mcps TDD option.

question_20351.question: What is one difference between approach 1 and approach 2 in triggering an activation of PDP contexts with dynamic IP addresses?
question_20351.ground_truth: Approach 2 allows presence servers in both VPLMN and HPLMN to be informed by the SGSN while approach 1 would need a mechanism to indicate the global user name to the VPLMN to a Push Initiators in the VPLMN to send Push Data that are not requested by the user.

question_20352.question: What information may the IMS core request from the LRF when determining the location of a UE?
question_20352.ground_truth: The information requested may include the IP-CAN, the UE, means to access the UE (e.g. UE's IP address), and any location information provided by the UE. Additionally, the request may include information concerning the location solutions and position methods supported by the UE.

question_20354.question: What should be the "o=" field value in the session-level section of the SDP body generated for a private call in an off-network MCPTT session?
question_20354.ground_truth: The "o=" field should have the <username> portion set to a dash in the session-level section of the SDP body generated for a private call in an off-network MCPTT session.

question_20355.question: What is the common criticality value in rAB-ReleaseRequest RANAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?

question_20356.question: What is the charging mechanism where charging information does not affect, in real-time, the service rendered?

question_20358.question: How are the keys KAUSF, KAKMA, and KAF derived in the AKMA key hierarchy?
question_20358.ground_truth: KAUSF is generated by the AUSF, KAKMA is derived by the Mobile Equipment (ME) and the AUSF from KAUSF, and KAF is derived by the ME and the AKMA Anchor Function (AAnF) from KAKMA.

question_20359.question: What is the purpose of the RAB ID List information element?
question_20359.ground_truth: The RAB ID List information element is used by the GANC to identify a set of circuit transport channel(s) or packet transport channel(s).

question_20361.question: What is the purpose of the Subsession-Enforcement-Info AVP in a CCR message from the V-PCRF to the H-PCRF in a roaming scenario?
question_20361.ground_truth: The Subsession-Enforcement-Info AVP is used to establish a new S9 subsession identifier assigned by the V-PCRF to this Gateway Control Session within the Subsession-Id AVP and the Subsession-Operation AVP set to the value ESTABLISHMENT or MODIFICATION.

question_20362.question: Which field in the TMGI list in the Bearer Announcement message is mandatory after the TMGI field?
question_20362.ground_truth: The Alternative TMGI fields in the Bearer Announcement message are mandatory after the TMGI field.

question_20363.question: What is one limitation of the currently standardized access control related security mechanisms?
question_20363.ground_truth: One limitation of the currently standardized access control related security mechanisms is that they do not consider security monitoring related information, such as threat assessments or security posture, which could be used to identify and prevent access from NFs with malicious behaviors.

question_20364.question: What is the role of MBSF in the solution described?
question_20364.ground_truth: MBSF is responsible for generating a MTK (MBS Traffic Key) and securely distributing it to the MBSTF (Multicast Broadcast Single-Frequency Network Terminating Function) and UEs (User Equipments) for protecting MBS traffic.

question_20365.question: In the PUCCH spatial relation Activation/Deactivation MAC CE, what field indicates the activation status of a PUCCH Spatial Relation Info?

question_20366.question: In the OpenID-GBA interworking solution, what is used to bind the first and second factor of authentication when receiving the username/password and OpenID token in the same TLS tunnel/HTTP session?
question_20366.ground_truth: The TLS tunnel/HTTP session is used to bind the first and second factor of authentication when receiving the username/password and OpenID token.

question_20368.question: What are the two main cases for mapping operations of the Basic CM IRP to HTTP methods?
question_20368.ground_truth: Case 1: The operations relate to one and only one managed object instance (resource), and Case 2: The operations relate to a scope with more than one managed object instance (resource).

question_20369.question: What action does the UPF take if the UE does not accept the restart of counting procedure?
question_20369.ground_truth: The UPF shall abort the restart of PMFP PLR measurement procedure.

question_20370.question: What procedure should be used for relaying DTMF in the user plane when RTP Telephony Event is selected for the internal 3GPP CS CN connection and inband DTMF is selected for the BICC network?
question_20370.ground_truth: The MGW should filter out (delete) the DTMF from the default PCM codec when relaying the DTMF via the RTP Telephony Event to prevent potential double signalling of the same digit.

question_20371.question: Which IEs are to be included in the MinSchedulingOffsetPreference IE if the UE has a preference for the value of K0 for cross-slot scheduling with 15 kHz SCS?

question_20372.question: What is the function of the Service Capability Exposure Function (SCEF) in 3GPP network architecture?
question_20372.ground_truth: The Service Capability Exposure Function (SCEF) provides northbound APIs in 3GPP network architecture.

question_20373.question: What is Dual Tone Multi Frequency (DTMF) and in which states is its support permitted?
question_20373.ground_truth: DTMF is an inband one out of four plus one out of four signalling system primarily used from terminal instruments in telecommunication networks. Its support is only permitted when a bearer capability for speech is in use or during the speech phase of alternate speech/data and alternate speech/facsimile teleservices.

question_20374.question: What is the length of the Random Reference for Two Phase packet access?
question_20374.ground_truth: The length of the Random Reference for Two Phase packet access is 3 bits.

question_20375.question: Who can initiate the cancellation of an in-progress emergency in the described MCData system?
question_20375.ground_truth: An MCData user authorized to cancel in-progress emergencies on the MCData group can initiate the cancellation.

question_20376.question: What is the interruption time (Tinterrupt1) for asynchronous intra-frequency DAPS handover when the bandwidth of the target cell is larger than the bandwidth of the source cell?

question_20377.question: What is the function of an MCVideo UE, described in the document?
question_20377.ground_truth: An MCVideo UE is a device that provides video acquisition (e.g., has a camera), video rendering (has a display), and normally also has encoding/decoding, communication, and storage capabilities.

question_20379.question: What will the MAC entity do with the drx-InactivityTimerPTM when it receives a PDCCH indication of a new multicast transmission for the corresponding G-RNTI or G-CS-RNTI?
question_20379.ground_truth: The MAC entity will restart the drx-InactivityTimerPTM in the first symbol after the end of the PDCCH reception when it indicates a new multicast transmission for the corresponding G-RNTI or G-CS-RNTI.

question_20380.question: In case of a location request from a VAL user, what should the SLM-C send as part of the Off-network location management message?
question_20380.ground_truth: The SLM-C should send an Off-network location management message with a MIME body containing the requested location information.

question_20382.question: What was the resolution of the testing used for the EVS codec?
question_20382.ground_truth: The listeners only used a scale from 1 to 5 to rank the different codecs.

question_20383.question: What MIME body should the participating MCVideo function include in the outgoing SIP re-INVITE request, if it receives a SIP re-INVITE request with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body when using a pre-established session?
question_20383.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function shall copy the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body from the received SIP re-INVITE request into the outgoing SIP re-INVITE request.

question_20384.question: What is the required throughput for high-speed trains in the UL timing adjustment scenario Y, expressed as a percentage of the maximum throughput for the reference measurement channel?
question_20384.ground_truth: The required throughput for high-speed trains in the UL timing adjustment scenario Y is 70% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channel.

question_20386.question: What value does the NSQ update to 0 when a UE or network initiated de-registration procedure is done?

question_20387.question: What is the maximum allowed RRC procedure delay for the "MOBILITY FROM E-UTRA" command?

question_20388.question: What is the purpose of the Multicall supplementary service?
question_20388.ground_truth: The Multicall supplementary service allows multiple simultaneous calls to be made or received by a single user on a 3GPP network.

question_20389.question: What are the four speech decoder input sequences provided for testing the GSM half rate speech decoder?

question_20391.question: What is the main objective of the Mobile IPv4 initial attach procedure?
question_20391.ground_truth: The main objective of the Mobile IPv4 initial attach procedure is to establish a Mobile IPv4 connection with the home agent by discovering the home agent address and the foreign agent care-of address, assigning an IPv4 address to the UE as home address in FA mode, and establishing a security association between the UE and the home agent for securing the Mobile IPv4 signaling.

question_20392.question: Which combination of LTE bands and NR bands in 2DL/2UL and 3DL/2UL has fallback modes captured in TR 37.864-41-21?
question_20392.ground_truth: LTE bands and NR bands in 2DL/2UL and 3DL/2UL are captured in TR 37.864-41-21.

question_20393.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in relation to the 5G system?
question_20393.ground_truth: The 3GPP is a collaborative project between multiple telecommunications standard development organizations that specifies the technical details of the 5G system, including Policy and Charging Control (PCC) over various service-based interfaces and their relationship with the flow level signalling.

question_20395.question: What should the UE do when timer T106 expires for the first time in the case of expiry of timer T106 in 5.4.8.4?
question_20395.ground_truth: The UE should retransmit the PMFP UAD PROVISIONING message and reset and start timer T106.

question_20397.question: What is one of the features of the rendering system for Scene-Based Audio in VR applications?
question_20397.ground_truth: In VR applications, the sound-field can be rotated relative to head-movement through a multiplication of a matrix F to the SBA signals.

question_20400.question: What does the VAL client need to transmit application traffic mapping to the redundant SEALDD traffic, and what does the SEALDD server do after receiving this request?
question_20400.ground_truth: The VAL client needs to transmit the application traffic descriptors (UE addresses and ports) for redundant transmission of the SEALDD client side. Upon receiving this request, the SEALDD server establishes a connection with the VAL server to transmit the application traffic mapping to the redundant SEALDD traffic. The SEALDD server then sends a response to the SEALDD client with the required information.

question_20401.question: What message does the GANC send to redirect the MS to a different Serving GANC?

question_20402.question: What are the RAT-dependent positioning techniques specified in TS~37.355 for NR positioning?
question_20402.ground_truth: The RAT-dependent positioning techniques specified in TS~37.355 for NR positioning are DL TDOA, DL AoD, UL TDOA, UL AoA, Multi-RTT, and NR E-CID.

question_20404.question: What is the difference between Scenario 1 and Scenario 2 in the Network Sharing Scenarios section of the document?
question_20404.ground_truth: In Scenario 1, operators share the RAN elements but not the radio frequencies, and connect directly to their own dedicated carrier layer in the shared RNC in the shared RAN. In Scenario 2, operators with individual 3G licenses cover different parts of a country and provide coverage of the entire country together. This scenario can be divided into two cases: national roaming for users and multiple core networks connected to both radio access networks throughout the coverage area.

question_20405.question: What should the P-CSCF do upon detecting that the radio/bearer resources are no longer available for a session?
question_20405.ground_truth: If the P-CSCF detects that the radio/bearer resources are no longer available for a session, it shall release the respective dialog by generating a BYE request destined for the called user, including a Reason header field with an appropriate protocol value and cause code.

question_20407.question: What is a Period in the context of 3GP-DASH media presentation?
question_20407.ground_truth: A Period is a part of a Media Presentation that contains one or more Adaptation Sets, each with alternate Representations. It is defined by the Period element in the MPD element and allows for splicing of content, synchronization of segments, and adding or removing content.

question_20408.question: What message should the UE include in the REGISTRATION REQUEST when it wants to use SMS over NAS?
question_20408.ground_truth: The UE should include the 5GS update type IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message with the SMS requested bit set to "SMS over NAS supported".

question_20409.question: How does the distribution of users as a function of speed affect the performance of MCS9 and MCS9-T4-16QAM in the TU channel?
question_20409.ground_truth: Many operators prefer EGPRS on the non-hopping layer for superior throughput performance for MCS7, MCS8, and MCS9 schemes, so MCS9 performance on the non-hopping channel is used for a fair comparison with MCS9-T4-16QAM.

question_20410.question: What is the recommended PSS attribute for representing the number of bits of colour or greyscale information per pixel in the context of HardwarePlatform?

question_20411.question: What should the new AMF do if it is aware that another AMF is serving the UE?
question_20411.ground_truth: The new AMF should forward the uplink N2 signaling of the UE to that AMF directly if necessary or reject the transaction from the peer CP NFs with a cause to indicate that a new AMF has been selected.

question_20412.question: Which sublayer of CTS services provides services to the MM sublayer and uses the services of signalling layer~2?

question_20413.question: What action should the RNC take when it de-registers from an MBMS bearer service and there is no corresponding MBMS UE Context?
question_20413.ground_truth: The RNC requests de-registration from the MBMS bearer service to its parent SGSN and disables reception from the IP backbone of the particular MBMS bearer service if it is using IP multicast distribution.

question_20415.question: What is one example of a parameter that can be optimized for coverage and capacity in a network?
question_20415.ground_truth: Sub-tones (sub-tone sets planned for cell borders)

question_20416.question: What does the TIP service do in relation to the originating UE in 4.5.2.1?
question_20416.ground_truth: The TIP service allows the UE to receive the network-provided identity information of the terminating user in SIP responses containing one or more P-Asserted-Identity headers.

question_20417.question: What is the main disadvantage of using a UE-controlled timer for delaying public key updates in GSM/GPRS networks?
question_20417.ground_truth: UEs without a valid old public key will reject genuine warning messages received while a timer for a key update is running.

question_20419.question: What are the two possible planes of the A-Interface, as defined by 3GPP TS 48.0xx?
question_20419.ground_truth: The two planes of the A-Interface are the Control Plane (signalling) and the User Plane (traffic).

question_20420.question: What is the purpose of the multi-path scenario required in 70.11.8?
question_20420.ground_truth: The purpose of the multi-path scenario in 70.11.8 is to measure the accuracy and response time of the MS's A-GPS position estimate in a specific GPS signal multi-path environment.

question_20421.question: What should the IWF, performing the participating role, do upon receipt of a SIP 4xx, 5xx or 6xx response to the SIP re-INVITE request?
question_20421.ground_truth: The IWF, performing the participating role, should perform the procedures of clause~9.2.1.2.10, which includes releasing the SIP resources associated with the MCPTT session.

question_20422.question: What is the state of Cell C at the start of the test?
question_20422.ground_truth: Cell C is not active at the start of the test.

question_20423.question: How should the MAC entity determine the Msg1 repetition number for SI request?
question_20423.ground_truth: The MAC entity should determine the Msg1 repetition number based on the rsrp-ThresholdMsg1-RepetitionNum2, rsrp-ThresholdMsg1-RepetitionNum4, and rsrp-ThresholdMsg1-RepetitionNum8, and the RSRP of the downlink pathloss reference.

question_20424.question: What LLc PDU is used by the MS to perform a cell update procedure?
question_20424.ground_truth: A cell update is any correctly received and valid LLC PDU carried inside a BSSGP PDU containing a new identifier of the cell.

question_20425.question: What are some of the existing features in the 5G system that can support the use case functionality for M2M services in utility applications?
question_20425.ground_truth: The 5G system can provide high availability IoT traffic performance requirements, periodic performance reporting, network slicing for differentiated policy control, and real-time E2E QoS monitoring. It also offers logging and monitoring interfaces for authorized entities and statistical information of service parameters and error types.

question_20426.question: What message type is used for the PMFP UAD PROVISIONING message?
question_20426.ground_truth: The message type for the PMFP UAD PROVISIONING message is "PMFP UAD PROVISIONING".

question_20428.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 6.7.9.1.2?
question_20428.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the L1-SINR relative measurement accuracy is within the specified limits.

question_20430.question: How does the registration management procedure work in the Hierarchical NSACF Architecture?
question_20430.ground_truth: The registration management procedure involves NSACF performing NSAC for the indicated S-NSSAI. If the local maximum number is reached, the NSACF interacts with the Primary NSACF to check if there is more allowance for the specific S-NSSAI. The Primary NSACF performs NSAC for the indicated S-NSSAI and allocates the local maximum number of UEs accordingly. If the Primary NSACF has allocated the complete range of the global maximum number, then the UE cannot be granted admission.

question_20431.question: What action should a participating MCVideo function take if the call is a private call and there are more than one <entry> elements in the application/resource-lists MIME body of the incoming SIP INVITE request?
question_20431.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function should reject the "SIP INVITE request for originating participating MCVideo function" with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response including warning text set to "145 unable to determine called party" in a Warning header field as specified in subclause~4.4, and shall not continue with the rest of the steps.

question_20434.question: What should the SMF do after it has successfully installed PCC rules and enforced a UP path change in case of 3a?
question_20434.ground_truth: The SMF should indicate to the UE to refresh the cached EAS information if the "EASDiscovery" feature is supported.

question_20435.question: What does the SscMode enumeration represent?
question_20435.ground_truth: The service and session continuity mode.

question_20436.question: In M=14, initially the MS and SS are using a full-rate TCH with speech full rate version 1 and non-hopping mode on cell B. After the handover command, what are they using?
question_20436.ground_truth: After the handover command, they are using a half-rate TCH with speech half rate version 3 and non-hopping mode on cell A.

question_20437.question: What are the required contents of the REGISTER request message sent from the UE to the SS?
question_20437.ground_truth: The REGISTER request message sent from the UE to the SS must include the SIP URI in the Contact header field, the From header field set to the SIP URI that contains the public user identity to be registered, the To header field set to the SIP URI that contains the public user identity to be registered, and the Via header field with the sent-by field containing the IP address or FQDN of the UE.

question_20441.question: What is an approach to determining the presence of victim UEs in the vicinity of a HeNB based on detected uplink transmissions?
question_20441.ground_truth: The HeNB can detect uplink transmissions from victim UEs, such as data and control information on the uplink, and use it to determine the presence of victim UEs.

question_20442.question: What options are available for the deployment location of the BSF?
question_20442.ground_truth: The BSF may be deployed standalone or collocated with other network functions such as the PCF, UDR, NRF, and SMF.

question_20443.question: What is the purpose of the Quota management trigger in the message flows?
question_20443.ground_truth: The purpose of the quota management trigger in the message flows is to perform unit determination and request more units from the H-CHF as needed for the service to continue.

question_20444.question: What is returned by the ProSe Application Server to the application client in the UE in step 0?
question_20444.ground_truth: The ProSe Application Server returns the RPAUID (Restricted ProSe Application User ID) to the application client in the UE in step 0.

question_20449.question: What is the procedure if the mobile station supports only Transparent mode or responds with a CALL CONFIRMED message in the context of BS 41 to 46 - PAD Access Asynchronous?
question_20449.ground_truth: The procedure involves sending a BC GSM message starting with 04 0X X1 X8 8C 21 X1 XX X0 (CX) if the mobile station supports both Transparent and Non Transparent modes. If the mobile station supports only Transparent mode or responds with a CALL CONFIRMED message, the BC GSM message starts with 04 0X X1 X8 8C 21 X1 XX X0 (CX).

question_20450.question: What is the difference between Routing Policy Cancellation Procedure and WAG initiated Routing Policy Cancellation Procedure?
question_20450.ground_truth: Routing Policy Cancellation Procedure is invoked by the 3GPP AAA Server while WAG initiated Routing Policy Cancellation Procedure is invoked by the WAG in the case where session specific routing policy has been removed without preceding instruction from the 3GPP AAA Server.

question_20451.question: Following which BC parameters in the SETUP message should be set to "32 kbit/s" and "transparent (for multimedia)" or "bothNT or bothT (If IWF supports PIAFS, UTRAN Iu mode only)", respectively?
question_20451.ground_truth: The Fixed network user rate and Connection element parameters in the SETUP message should be set to "32 kbit/s" and "transparent (for multimedia)" or "bothNT or bothT (If IWF supports PIAFS, UTRAN Iu mode only)", respectively.

question_20452.question: What information must the Content Provider AS include in the TV Service Content Addition Request message?
question_20452.ground_truth: The Content Provider AS must include the TV service identifier and content information (such as content URL, formats etc.) in the TV Service Content Addition Request message.

question_20453.question: In what scenarios does switched transmit antenna diversity result in increased UE power consumption compared to the reference case without transmit diversity?
question_20453.ground_truth: Switched transmit antenna diversity results in increased UE power consumption when the insertion loss exceeds 0.2~dB compared to the reference case without transmit diversity.

question_20455.question: What is the expected sequence for the test performed for both channel modes of the multi-rate codec, i.e. full rate and half rate?
question_20455.ground_truth: The test is repeated for M = 1, 2, 3, 4 and K = 1, 2 (if the MS supports half rate version 3).

question_20456.question: What happens when an error situation arises in the incoming message using MBMS-service-associated signalling?
question_20456.ground_truth: The Error Indication procedure uses MBMS-service-associated signalling and should contain at least either the Cause IE or the Criticality Diagnostics IE. In case the error indication procedure is triggered by utilising MBMS-service-associated signalling, the MCE MBMS M3AP ID IE and the MME MBMS M3AP IE shall be included in the ERROR INDICATION message.

question_20457.question: What information must the manufacturer declare for a base station that supports Band 20 and operates in certain geographic areas?
question_20457.ground_truth: The manufacturer must declare the PEM,N for channel N and P10MHz for the maximum output power in 10 MHz, and demonstrate conformance with the declared emission level PEM,N for a base station that supports Band 20 and operates in geographic areas within the CEPT in which frequencies are allocated to broadcasting (DTT) service.

question_20458.question: What is the function of the PWS Restart Indication procedure?
question_20458.ground_truth: The purpose of PWS Restart Indication procedure is to inform the gNB-CU that PWS information for some or all cells of the gNB-DU are available for reloading from the CBC if needed. The procedure uses non UE-associated signalling.

question_20459.question: Who needs to be granted temporary, restricted access to local sensor, monitoring, and surveillance data in a wind power plant?
question_20459.ground_truth: External stakeholders such as the helicopter company may need to be granted temporary, restricted access to local sensor, monitoring, and surveillance data in a wind power plant.

question_20460.question: Who can control the security policy of an Evolved Residential Gateway?
question_20460.ground_truth: The network operator associated with an Evolved Residential Gateway can control its security policy as per PR 5.5.6-005.

question_20461.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Report on the study of Operations, Administration and Maintenance (OAM) support for the assessment of energy efficiency in mobile access networks?
question_20461.ground_truth: The purpose of the report is to provide a gap analysis between ETSI ES 203 228 and 3GPP OAM Technical Specifications, and provide recommendations towards ETSI ES 203 228 compliance, including suggestions for further 3GPP specification enhancements. It also studies potential solutions for interfaces that are in the scope of 3GPP.

question_20462.question: What is the event that causes the increment of the counter for the measurement of the number of successful Intra-NRCell SSB Beam switch executions?
question_20462.ground_truth: Reception of HARQ ACK in MAC CE from the UE to the target SSB Beam indicating a successful intra-NRCell SSB Beam switch

question_20463.question: What is the use of the RAN-INFORMATION PDU in the MBMS data channel RIM application when the RIM Application Identity IE is set to "MBMS data channel"?
question_20463.ground_truth: The RAN-INFORMATION PDU is used by a serving BSS to send the information about the MBMS data channels established in a single reporting cell, to a controlling BSS in the MBMS data channel RIM application.

question_20466.question: What type of network interface is "X2" in the document?
question_20466.ground_truth: The X2 interface is a logical interface between two eNBs (E-UTRAN Node B).

question_20467.question: What should the PLMN BC parameter Information Transfer Capability be set to when interworking with an indirectly connected restricted 64 kbit/s network?
question_20467.ground_truth: The PLMN BC parameter Information Transfer Capability should be set to "Other ITC" and the Other ITC parameter should be set to "restricted digital" when interworking with an indirectly connected restricted 64 kbit/s network.

question_20468.question: What is the purpose of modifying the existing procedures and call flows between the MCPTT server and a partner MCPTT system and between the MCPTT server and MCPTT clients in 6.4.1.2?
question_20468.ground_truth: The modification is to support various LMR modes of operation for MCPTT clients.

question_20469.question: What procedure does a NRM client follow when it detects an MBMS suspension indication from RAN?
question_20469.ground_truth: A NRM client detects the MBMS suspension indication, sends an MBMS suspension report to the NRM server, which in turn determines whether to switch to a new bearer (unicast or MBMS) based on the MBMS suspension report.

question_20470.question: How many bits are used for the transport block size in E-UCCH for the 1.28 Mcps TDD option?
question_20470.ground_truth: The transport block size in E-UCCH for the 1.28 Mcps TDD option is specified by 6 bits.

question_20471.question: What information should the initiating UE include in a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for the target UE's application layer ID?
question_20471.ground_truth: The initiating UE should include the target user info set to the target UE's application layer ID in the PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message.

question_20473.question: What is the purpose of using neighboring MBMS bearers information sent from NRM server?
question_20473.ground_truth: The purpose is for the NRM client to have information about other MBMS bearers which can be used for switching the bearer to preserve the service continuity.

question_20475.question: What must the IPA Downlink Assignment struct sent in the IMMEDIATE PACKET ASSIGNMENT message contain when assigning packet downlink resources for multiple mobile stations?
question_20475.ground_truth: The IPA Downlink Assignment struct sent in the IMMEDIATE PACKET ASSIGNMENT message must contain parameters specific to different mobile stations, such as TLLI, temporary flow identity, power control parameters, and optionally, the timing advance value.

question_20477.question: What action is taken by a NF that detects the failure or restart of a peer NF or NF service using the NRF?
question_20477.ground_truth: The NF may trigger appropriate restoration or clean-up actions if it cannot communicate with the failed or restarted NF or NF service.

question_20478.question: What is the procedure that the mobile station follows upon receipt of the HANDOVER COMMAND message when VAMOS is used?
question_20478.ground_truth: Upon receipt of the HANDOVER COMMAND message, the mobile station is instructed to release link layer connections, disconnect the physical channels (including packet resources, if in Class A mode of operation), command the switching to the assigned channels, and establish lower layer connections (including activation of the channels, their connection, and the establishment of data links).

question_20479.question: What is the functionality of Terminating Identification Presentation (TIP) in a communication?
question_20479.ground_truth: TIP has no impact on the operation of other services, i.e., neither service will affect the operation of the other.

question_20482.question: What action does the ProSe Application Server take when User A revokes discovery permissions related to some other users in the ProSe Application Server?
question_20482.ground_truth: The ProSe Application Server pushes an Authorization Update message to the ProSe Function serving user A, containing the details of the banned users and their corresponding UEs.

question_20483.question: What message status code is returned by the UDM when the UE's location information is successfully retrieved?

question_20484.question: What is the role of the "urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:pidf" namespace in the context of constructing an application/simple-filter+xml MIME body indicating per-group dynamic data restrictions of presence event package notification information?
question_20484.ground_truth: The "urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:pidf" namespace contains the "presence" element, which is used to define the presence information for a particular group.

question_20486.question: What two options are feasible for dealing with security to media data in Unicast Delivery mode?
question_20486.ground_truth: Option A is to use hop-by-hop security protection, such as NDS/IP in network domain and LTE access security mechanism in air interface. Option B is to use end-to-end security protection in application layer between GCS AS and GCS UE.

question_20487.question: What is the N-SCH synchronization time at the target MCL conditions and for MCL=154 dB condition for the 95% percentile?
question_20487.ground_truth: At target MCL conditions, the N-SCH synchronization time corresponding to 95% percentile is 923 ms. For MCL=154 dB condition, the N-SCH synchronization time reduces to 350 ms.

question_20488.question: When will the MME not accept a service request from a UE with a SIPTO at the local network PDN connection?
question_20488.ground_truth: The MME will not accept a service request from a UE with a SIPTO at the local network PDN connection if all the remaining PDN connections are SIPTO at the local network PDN connections, and if a PDN connection remains that is not SIPTO at the local network PDN connection and the network decides to set up the S1 and radio bearers, the MME shall upon completion of the setup of the S1 bearers initiate an EPS bearer context deactivation procedure with ESM cause #39 "reactivation requested" for the default EPS bearer context of each SIPTO at the local network PDN connection.

question_20489.question: What is the basic concept of the LZ77 compression algorithm used in the DEFLATE format?
question_20489.ground_truth: LZ77 compression works by finding sequences of data that are repeated and replacing them with a short string pair (length, distance), representing how far back into the window the sequence starts and the number of characters for which the sequence is identical.

question_20490.question: What is the mandatory interception for ProSe Function and ProSe Key Management Function?
question_20490.ground_truth: Interception of the following events is mandatory for ProSe Function and ProSe Key Management Function: ProSe Function sends authorisation to perform one-to-many communications to the target UE, ProSe Key Management Function sends keys to use in one-to-many communications to the target UE, and ProSe Function receives a one-to-many communications usage information report from the target UE.

question_20491.question: What must the IUT (MCPTT Server) do when the SS (MCPTT Client) initiates a pre-arranged group call with automatic commencement mode?
question_20491.ground_truth: The IUT (MCPTT Server) must accept the call from the initiator and establish the call with all registered users of the group.

question_20492.question: In clause 7.4.2.1.2, what should the UE include in the request to the upper layers to send data unit(s) of a ProSe application identified by a ProSe identifier using 5G ProSe communication over PC5 in groupcast mode?
question_20492.ground_truth: The UE should include the application layer group ID, group size and member IDs, range requirement, and the communication mode which is set to groupcast mode.

question_20493.question: Which codec is used by the system simulator for narrowband telephony testing, and what is its source coding bit-rate?
question_20493.ground_truth: The AMR speech codec is used by the system simulator for narrowband telephony testing, with a source coding bit-rate of 12.2 kbit/s.

question_20496.question: What should the UE do when it is not performing initial registration for onboarding services in SNPN and receives a 5GMM cause value of #7 in a REGISTRATION REJECT message?
question_20496.ground_truth: The UE should set the 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED and delete any 5G-GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list, and ngKSI. If the UE is not performing initial registration for onboarding services in SNPN, it should enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-SUPI. If the message has been successfully integrity checked by the NAS, then the UE should set the corresponding counter to a UE implementation-specific maximum value.

question_20499.question: What should the I-CSCF do if it is able to resolve the Request-URI into the IP address of the AS hosting the PSI?
question_20499.ground_truth: The I-CSCF should store the value of the "icid-value" header field parameter received in the P-Charging-Vector header field, insert a type 3 "orig-ioi" header field parameter into the P-Charging-Vector header field, and forward the request directly to the AS hosting the PSI.

question_20500.question: What is the requirement for the number of ACK/NACK transmissions on PCell during the time the UE identifies the new CGI of an E-UTRA cell?
question_20500.ground_truth: At least 92 ACK/NACKs should be transmitted on PCell provided that certain conditions are met.

question_20501.question: What does the scaling factor equals if the UE supports parallelPRS-MeasRRC-Inactive-r17?
question_20501.ground_truth: If the UE supports parallelPRS-MeasRRC-Inactive-r17, the scaling factor equals to 1.

question_20502.question: What is the main difference between open-loop control and closed-loop control?
question_20502.ground_truth: Open-loop control lacks output control and assumes that the output of the influenced process is predetermined, while closed-loop control manipulates processes even with environmental influences by sensing the process output and feeding measurements back into a controller.

question_20503.question: What function of the NWDAF is responsible for detecting whether there is a need for improvement of an analytics ID?
question_20503.ground_truth: The NWDAF's tracing function is responsible for detecting whether there is a need for improvement of an analytics ID.

question_20504.question: What system does Solution #0-1 in the report introduce to support protocol translation, identity mapping, transcode, and routing between an MCPTT system and an LMR system?
question_20504.ground_truth: An IWF entity which acts as an MCPTT server.

question_20505.question: What is the purpose of timer G in the "confirmed" state, if an unreliable transport-layer connection is used between the UE and the SCC AS?
question_20505.ground_truth: Timer G indicates that the ICS UE has received the I1 Success message and the ICS UE has stopped the retransmission of the I1 Invite message.

question_20506.question: What are the two potential scenarios described where undesired bearer handling can occur?
question_20506.ground_truth: The two scenarios described are: 1) Loss of bearers during inter-RAT 3GPP PS handover, leading to interrupted services or decreased QoS, and 2) Undesirable inter-RAT 3GPP PS handover, where the UE moves certain IP traffic to WLAN based on policies, resulting in potential loss, degradation, or suspension of bearers.

question_20508.question: What issue prevents dual carrier implementation in uplink using a wideband transmitter in an MRP network?
question_20508.ground_truth: The wideband transmitter cannot include dual carriers in uplink due to the large separation (greater than 1 MHz) between carriers in an MRP network, which includes the BCCH frequency in the hopping set.

question_20509.question: What is the subject of 3GPP Technical Specification document TS 28.709:17?
question_20509.ground_truth: The subject of the document is Evolved Packet Core (EPC) Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP) and its Solution Set (SS) definitions.

question_20510.question: When using the Object Distribution Indicator, what should be done if no specific indicator is present for a given information element?
question_20510.ground_truth: If no Object Distribution Indicator is present in an information element, the object may be freely distributed.

question_20516.question: In the alternative A of Scenario I, what condition must be met for roaming charging in the visited network?
question_20516.ground_truth: In alternative A of Scenario I, the VPLMN and HPLMN must agree on the RG value for Internet-based services (e.g., Peer to Peer) and the OCS address for the UE.

question_20518.question: What attribute should be provided if the user data congestion requirements are to be specified in the User Data Congestion feature?
question_20518.ground_truth: The "userDataConReqs" attribute should be provided if the user data congestion requirements are to be specified in the User Data Congestion feature.

question_20519.question: What is the purpose of the re-try interval information sent by the PCRF to the AF in case of temporary inability to provide the requested service delivery?
question_20519.ground_truth: The re-try interval indicates when service delivery may be retried by the AF over Rx, informing the AF of when it can retry the service delivery request in case of temporary inability of the PCRF to provide the requested service delivery.

question_20520.question: What is the result of receiving the 'Queued' indication?
question_20520.ground_truth: Call leg processing is suspended and the event is reported.

question_20523.question: What type of transform is used in H.265 (HEVC) instead of Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) for 4x4 intra transform blocks?
question_20523.ground_truth: Discrete Sine Transform (DST) is used in H.265 (HEVC) instead of Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) for 4x4 intra transform blocks.

question_20525.question: What is the requirement for data transmission in the described use case for time-critical applications?
question_20525.ground_truth: For time-critical applications, data is directly mapped to the Ethernet data link layer as GOOSE messages or SVs transmission using connectionless multicast addressing of frames.

question_20526.question: What is the purpose of service announcement in the context of MBMS multicast service?
question_20526.ground_truth: The purpose of service announcement in the context of MBMS multicast service is to distribute to users information about the service, parameters required for service activation, and possibly other service-related parameters. This mechanism allows users to discover MBMS user services, including operator-specific MBMS user services and services from content providers outside of the PLMN.

question_20527.question: What is the purpose of monitoring the DPCCH quality in the UE in clause 5.4.4B.1?
question_20527.ground_truth: The purpose of monitoring the DPCCH quality in the UE is to detect a loss of the signal on Layer 1 and specify the thresholds Qout and Qin.

question_20528.question: What are the two types of handover defined in the Enhancement of Handover Optimization Work Item?
question_20528.ground_truth: Conditional Handover (CHO) and Dual Active Protocol Stack (DAPS) handover

question_20530.question: In which case should a MS execute the Gs attachment procedure when moving to a new RA in A/Gb mode?
question_20530.ground_truth: If the MS is in operation mode A or B and the old RA supports Gs services, the MS shall execute the Gs attachment procedure when moving to a new RA.

question_20533.question: In which scenario does a UE access EHE in VPLMN via a LBO PDU Session?
question_20533.ground_truth: The scenario where the UE accesses EHE in VPLMN via a LBO PDU Session is addressed in Solution 27 of the KI#1 description.

question_20534.question: When the G-bit in the Floor Indicator is set to '0', what should the floor control interface do with the Floor Release message received from the floor control server arbitration logic?
question_20534.ground_truth: The floor control interface shall forward the Floor Release message to the floor control server arbitration logic and remain in the state 'U: pending Floor Revoke'.

question_20535.question: What does the "gsmSCF-gsmSRF" in the module name "CAP-gsmSCF-gsmSRF-ops-args" stand for?
question_20535.ground_truth: "gsmSCF" stands for "gsm Service Control Function," and "gsmSRF" stands for "gsm Service Response Function." Together, they refer to two functional components within the gsm network architecture that cooperate and communicate via a well-defined interface.

question_20537.question: What is the purpose of the PDU session authentication and authorization procedure in the test scenario?
question_20537.ground_truth: The purpose of the procedure is to enable the DN to authenticate and authorize the upper layers of the UE when establishing the PDU session.

question_20538.question: What is the name of the message used to respond to a CounterCheck message?

question_20540.question: What happens if both the originator and the responder do not include a specific parameter in the negotiation?
question_20540.ground_truth: The value of the parameter remains unchanged.

question_20541.question: What are the two methods for UE1 and UE2 to discover assistant UEs for KI#3?
question_20541.ground_truth: The two methods are Model A, where assistant UEs announce their availability, and Model B, where UE1 and UE2 solicit and respond to each other's availability.

question_20542.question: What resource is used by the service consumer (e.g. IP-SM-GW) to create, retrieve, update or delete the SMS registration information in the Nhss-ims-sdm API?
question_20542.ground_truth: The "SMSRegistrationInfo" resource is used by the service consumer (e.g. IP-SM-GW) to create, retrieve, update or delete the SMS registration information in the Nhss-ims-sdm API.

question_20544.question: What is the purpose of the "cp:validity" condition in the communication barring service?
question_20544.ground_truth: The "cp:validity" condition specifies a period and evaluates to true when the current time is within the validity period expressed by the value of this condition.

question_20547.question: What is the reporting range for SS-RSRP and CSI-RSRP for L1 reporting?
question_20547.ground_truth: The reporting range for SS-RSRP and CSI-RSRP for L1 reporting is defined from -140 to -44~dBm with 1~dB resolution.

question_20548.question: What are the responsibilities of the Controllee UE?
question_20548.ground_truth: The Controllee UE provides media flows for a Collaborative Session, and is subordinate to the Controller UE for session control. It uses a Media Control Signalling Path to manage its IMS session established to provide media flow(s) for a Collaborative Session.

question_20549.question: What specific solutions may be required for BS operating in Band 28/n28 to fulfill the spurious emissions limits for co-existence with Band 27 UL operating band?
question_20549.ground_truth: Specific solutions may be required for BS operating in Band 28/n28 to fulfill the spurious emissions limits for co-existence with Band 27 UL operating band.

question_20550.question: In the provided scenario, what is the method used by SEALDD server 1 to send AF traffic influence to SEALDD server 2?
question_20550.ground_truth: SEALDD server 1 includes SEALDD IP replacement information in the AF traffic influence to SEALDD server 2 or sends AF traffic influence with target DNAI of SEALDD server 2 and simultaneous connectivity indicator to request 5GC to maintain the simultaneous connectivity.

question_20553.question: What is the role of NWDAF1 containing MTLF in deciding whether an update of the trained ML model is needed?
question_20553.ground_truth: NWDAF1 containing MTLF decides whether an update of the trained ML model is needed based on the notifications received in step~3a-3b. It may use the ML model performance data in the notifications as input data to perform analytics on the trained ML model performance.

question_20554.question: What is the purpose of deriving a MCData Payload Cipher Key and its associated identifier in the MCData Payload Protection Key?
question_20554.ground_truth: The purpose is to protect and authenticate media or media plane control information in the MCData function.

question_20556.question: Under which conditions should the MME send a Downlink Data Notification Ack message with an indication that the Downlink Data Notification message has been temporarily rejected?
question_20556.ground_truth: The MME should send a Downlink Data Notification Ack message with an indication that the Downlink Data Notification message has been temporarily rejected if it holds stored Paging Restriction Information for the UE that restricts the Downlink Data from causing paging.

question_20557.question: What are the network options available for location dependent interception?
question_20557.ground_truth: The network options available for location dependent interception are target location versus Interception Areas (IAs) check in the 3G~ICEs and Delivery Functions (DFs), target location versus IAs check in the DFs, and location dependent interception not applicable to CSCF.

question_20558.question: What should the UE do if the value for Tsor-cm timer equals "infinity"?
question_20558.ground_truth: If the value for Tsor-cm timer equals "infinity", the UE shall wait until the PDU session is released or the service is stopped. The Tsor-cm timer is applicable only if the UE is in automatic network selection mode. Upon switching to manual network selection mode, the UE shall stop any Tsor-cm timer, if running. In this case, the UE is not required to enter idle mode and perform the de-registration procedure.

question_20559.question: What is the minimum number of GSM carrier RSSI measurement samples that a UE supporting GSM measurements shall measure per measurement gap?
question_20559.ground_truth: 10 GSM carrier RSSI measurement samples (NGSM carrier RSSI)

question_20560.question: What occurs in the pre-condition of the intent-driven NSI performance assurance scenario?
question_20560.ground_truth: The NSI consumer wants the NSI Producer to assure the performance of the provided NSI based on its intent, such as the type of services that need performance assurance and the granularity of performance assurance report notifications.

question_20561.question: What is the unit of the measurements 5.1.3.10.2 and 5.1.3.10.3?
question_20561.ground_truth: Each measurement is an integer value.

question_20562.question: What information is included in the an-APDU parameter of the HANDOVER REQUEST ACK message in a MAP PREPARE HANDOVER response?
question_20562.ground_truth: The an-APDU parameter of the HANDOVER REQUEST ACK message in a MAP PREPARE HANDOVER response includes a BSSMAP HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE.

question_20564.question: What is the cause code used by the MME to reject the Service Request when a UE has attached to other MMEs and is not yet attached to the original MME?
question_20564.ground_truth: The MME uses cause code #10 (Implicitly detached) to reject the Service Request when a UE has attached to other MMEs and is not yet attached to the original MME.

question_20565.question: How do 5G CP NFs handle NF service discovery in terms of protocol?
question_20565.ground_truth: 5G CP NFs use the same protocol (e.g. HTTP/2) for NF service discovery as other 5G service-based interfaces.

question_20566.question: What is one potential issue with the MAC-PHY split option (Option 6) in terms of fronthaul latency?
question_20566.ground_truth: The split may require subframe-level timing interactions between MAC layer in CU and PHY layers in DUs, and round trip fronthaul delay may affect HARQ timing and scheduling.

question_20567.question: What SIP URI parameter is used to identify the II-NNI traversal scenario in Dialog creating SIP requests and standalone requests?
question_20567.ground_truth: The "iotl" SIP URI parameter is used to identify the II-NNI traversal scenario in Dialog creating SIP requests and standalone requests. It can be included in the Request-URI or in a Route header field of a SIP message and is appended to the URI that represents the destination in CDRs.

question_20568.question: Which resource is described in section 7.6.1.2.2 of the document?
question_20568.ground_truth: The Key Records resource is described in section 7.6.1.2.2 of the document.

question_20572.question: What should the MCVideo client do when it receives a PRIVATE CALL RELEASE message while in the "P4: part of ongoing call" state?
question_20572.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should generate a PRIVATE CALL RELEASE ACK message with the stored call identifier and MCVideo user IDs, send the PRIVATE CALL RELEASE ACK message in response to the request message, terminate the media session for the private call, and enter the "P1: ignoring same call id" state.

question_20578.question: What should the UE do with the stored rejected NSAAI for the current PLMN when it has been switched off and then switched on?
question_20578.ground_truth: The UE should delete the stored rejected NSAAI for the current PLMN when it has been switched off and then switched on.

question_20579.question: What information is included in the Service Access Information for uplink media streaming?
question_20579.ground_truth: The Service Access Information for uplink media streaming includes parameters and addresses that are needed by the 5GMSu Client to activate and control the uplink streaming session. It may be provided as a 3GPP-defined Service URL that provides a unique resolvable identifier to the 5GMSu media session and that may also include a reference to the Media Entry Point.

question_20580.question: What is the clock synchronicity budget requirement for the 5G system?
question_20580.ground_truth: The potential requirement PR.5.19-001 states that the 5G system shall support a clock synchronicity budget requirement in a range between 1000 ns and 250 ns.

question_20581.question: What is the purpose of the high-pass filter used in this process?
question_20581.ground_truth: The high-pass filter serves as a precaution against low frequency components adversely affecting the processing.

question_20582.question: What is the initial condition of the mobile station in the test procedure?
question_20582.ground_truth: The MS is in CC state U10.

question_20583.question: What shall the target device do when it receives a ProvideAssistanceData message as specified in TS 36.355, clause 5.2.4?
question_20583.ground_truth: The target device delivers the related assistance data to upper layers for each positioning method contained in the ProvideAssistanceData message.

question_20584.question: What action should the SMF take when triggered by the 5G-AN requested PDU session resource release?
question_20584.ground_truth: The SMF may decide to keep the PDU Session with user plane connection deactivated or release the PDU Session. If the SMF decides to release the PDU Session, it shall return "200 OK" including n1SmInfoToUe binary data containing the Message Type "PDU Session Release Command" and possibly PCO and cause information.

question_20585.question: In what circumstances should the UE include interferenceDirection in the affectedCarrierFreqList for IDC assistance information?
question_20585.ground_truth: The UE should include interferenceDirection in the affectedCarrierFreqList for IDC assistance information if there is at least one carrier frequency included in candidateServingFreqListNR, the UE is experiencing IDC problems that it cannot solve by itself, and the affected carrier frequency is included in candidateServingFreqListNR.

question_20586.question: What can prevent certain services from being considered for interworking in the Uu unicast based V2X communication between EPS and 5GS?
question_20586.ground_truth: Those services may not be supported in 5GS due to QoS requirements.

question_20588.question: Who will provide the 5G system and operational data for City A's emergency drill?
question_20588.ground_truth: Mobile operator B will provide the 5G system and operational and maintenance data for the emergency drill in the metaverse environment.

question_20589.question: What does the first digit in the version number of a 3GPP TS document indicate?
question_20589.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number of a 3GPP TS document indicates whether the document is presented to TSG for information, presented to TSG for approval, or is TSG approved and under change control.

question_20590.question: What is the method used by the SMF to forward packets to the AF for notifications on the DNS response?
question_20590.ground_truth: The SMF can create a PDI (packet detection information) in a PDR (data radio bearer) with a filter that matches e.g. with dst IP address = DNS resolver address and src IP address = L-DNS server address. The UPF (user plane function) forwards the matching packets to the tunnel towards SMF.

question_20591.question: What is the purpose of highlighting some elements and messages in MCPTT private call transfer related information flows between MCPTT servers?
question_20591.ground_truth: The purpose is to cover necessary elements and messages between MCPTT servers to support MCPTT private call transfer for users in different MCPTT systems.

question_20593.question: What is the purpose of the band-specific combination part in the technical report?
question_20593.ground_truth: The band-specific combination part contains the actual requirements for each specific band combination, which are added to the corresponding technical specifications.

question_20595.question: What triggers the Remote UE authentication procedure in the UE-to-network relay process?
question_20595.ground_truth: The Relay UE triggers the Remote UE authentication procedure.

question_20596.question: What happens if the E-UTRAN Service Handover IE is not included in the RAB setup and modification process?
question_20596.ground_truth: If the E-UTRAN Service Handover IE is not included, the decision to perform an inter-system mobility to E-UTRAN is an internal UTRAN matter.

question_20597.question: What HARQ procedure is followed for unicast transmission in SL, and which RLC Mode triggers RLF declaration?
question_20597.ground_truth: HARQ-ACK feedback for a PSSCH is carried in SFCI format(s) via PSFCH in resource allocation Modes 1 and 2. For CBG operation, the receiver UE generates HARQ-ACK if it successfully decodes the corresponding TB. It generates HARQ-NACK if it does not successfully decode the corresponding TB after decoding the associated PSCCH targeted to the receiver UE. For unicast RLC AM in SL, RLF declaration is triggered by indication from RLC that the maximum number of retransmissions has been reached.

question_20599.question: What should the ADRF do if the NF service consumer requests to remove a stored ML model based on the unique ML model identifier?
question_20599.ground_truth: The ADRF shall remove any stored ML model(s) that match the unique ML model identifier received in the HTTP POST request and respond with HTTP "204 No Content" or HTTP "200 OK" with the message body containing the MLModelDelResult data structure, depending on the success of the deletion.

question_20601.question: When is the MCData server required to initiate the group standalone data request towards each MCData client?
question_20601.ground_truth: The MCData server initiates the group standalone data request towards each MCData client after successfully resolving the MCData group ID and determining the members and their affiliation status.

question_20602.question: In bullet d) 1a), what will the UE do if the selected the PDU session parameters for 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay UE do not have an associated DNN?
question_20602.ground_truth: The UE will not provide any DNN in a PDU session establishment procedure.

question_20603.question: What is PDN GW initiated Resource Allocation Deactivation in 3GPP network, and how is it triggered?
question_20603.ground_truth: PDN GW initiated Resource Allocation Deactivation is a procedure to release all the resources associated with the PDN address. It can be triggered due to IP-CAN session modification requests from the PCRF, handover from Non-3GPP to 3GPP, or release of resources independently of deactivation from the PDN GW.

question_20604.question: What is the purpose of introducing DelayMin and DelayMax parameters in the QoS model?
question_20604.ground_truth: The purpose of introducing DelayMin and DelayMax parameters in the QoS model is to expose the time duration within which the packet is guaranteed to be available at the egress port of the 3GPP bridge. This value can be used by the CNC to derive the maximum E2E (talker to listener) delay that can occur during the transmission of a packet.

question_20605.question: What is the primary role of Solution 7 in terms of other solutions?
question_20605.ground_truth: Solution 7 proposes means for bulk signaling to be used in other solutions (e.g. solutions 4 and 5).

question_20606.question: What is the re-selection delay requirement for a lower priority E-UTRAN cell?
question_20606.ground_truth: The re-selection delay to a lower priority E-UTRAN cell with UE fulfilling not-at-cell edge criterion shall be less than 17 seconds.

question_20607.question: Which type of network connection is mapped to access category 9 while a MO IMS registration related signalling is ongoing?
question_20607.ground_truth: Any service request procedure related to the PDU session established for DNN = "IMS" and for the DNN used for SMSoIP is mapped to access category 9.

question_20608.question: What is the relationship between the distribution of DL total PRB usage and the distribution of UL total PRB usage?
question_20608.ground_truth: Both measurements provide the distribution of samples with total usage (in percentage) of physical resource blocks (PRBs) on the downlink and uplink respectively in different ranges. They are useful measures of whether a cell is under high loads or not in the scenario where a cell may experience high load in certain short times and recover to normal quickly.

question_20611.question: What should the UE do if it needs to indicate a change of 3GPP PS data off UE status for a PDU session and timer T3396, T3584, T3585 or the back-off timer is running or is deactivated?
question_20611.ground_truth: The UE should still initiate the UE-requested PDU session modification procedure to indicate the change of 3GPP PS data off UE status for a PDU session even if timer T3396, T3584, T3585 or the back-off timer is running or is deactivated.

question_20612.question: When are test for a specific channel bandwidth applicable in the OTA test setup?
question_20612.ground_truth: A test for a specific channel bandwidth is only applicable if the BS supports it. For a BS supporting multiple channel bandwidths only the tests for the lowest and the highest channel bandwidths supported by the BS are applicable.

question_20613.question: What shall the MCVideo client do when it receives a SIP 4xx, 5xx, or 6xx response to the SIP INVITE request or re-INVITE request?
question_20613.ground_truth: The MCVideo client shall set the MCVideo emergency group state or emergency alert state based on the response, and if the response contains certain elements, it shall set the MCVideo emergency alert state to "emergency-alert-initiated" or revert it to its value prior to entering the current procedure.

question_20614.question: What needs to be protected in the H(e)NB to ensure secure location authentication?
question_20614.ground_truth: The location authentication functions of the H(e)NB fall into the category of security-sensitive functions and have to be protected from malicious manipulation. The TrE should protect certain information required for location authentication, such as authentication credentials used for location authentication, if such information needs to be stored within the H(e)NB.

question_20615.question: What should be done if T3 expires and the UE has not yet re-selected Cell 4?
question_20615.ground_truth: The SS should skip to step 20.

question_20616.question: What is the minimum gap length defined between two aperiodic CSI-RS bursts, at least for certain subcarrier spacings?
question_20616.ground_truth: At least 2 slots for 15kHz and 30kHz, and at least 3 slots for 60kHz.

question_20617.question: What shall the SS do after transmitting the RRCConnectionRelease message in the UE Transmit Timing Accuracy test?
question_20617.ground_truth: After transmitting the RRCConnectionRelease message, the SS shall release the RRC connection, which includes the release of established radio bearers as well as all radio resources.

question_20622.question: What is the impact of MTC access barring on core network consumption and signalling?
question_20622.ground_truth: RAN and core network resource consumption can be avoided during congestion situation and there will be no further AS and NAS signalling initiated from the targeted, access barred MTC Devices.

question_20623.question: What should the S-CSCF do if the request is a UE-terminating request, the served user is not registered and no more of the initial filter criteria apply?
question_20623.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should reject the request.

question_20624.question: How many bits does the "Second PTRS-DMRS association" field have when it is present?
question_20624.ground_truth: The "Second PTRS-DMRS association" field has 2 bits when it is present.

question_20626.question: In the code construction for code groups 0 to 15, what is used to provide code group and frame position information for Case 1 and what is used to provide slot timing, frame position information, and code group information for Case 2?
question_20626.ground_truth: In Case 1, the secondary codes in the code set are used to provide code group and frame position information. In Case 2, the comma free property of the code word and the modulation of some of the secondary codes in the code set are used to provide slot timing, frame position information, and code group information.

question_20628.question: What is the condition for counting a success in the test?
question_20628.ground_truth: A success in the test is counted if the UE starts to report valid ACK/NACK for PSCell and SCell from the first UL slot that occurs after the beginning of the DL slot.

question_20629.question: What is the terminology used to describe the TTI in 4.6J?
question_20629.ground_truth: TTI stands for Time Division Duplex which refers to a method of time division multiplexing used by UMTS.

question_20630.question: What is the P-value when the RLM-RS resource is not overlapped with measurement gap and partially overlapped with SMTC occasion?

question_20631.question: What is the maximum number of inter-frequency E-UTRAN cells that an UE supporting nr-IdleInactiveMeasFR1-r16 or nr-IdleInactiveMeasFR2-r16 should be able to measure simultaneously while in Idle mode?
question_20631.ground_truth: An UE supporting nr-IdleInactiveMeasFR1-r16 or nr-IdleInactiveMeasFR2-r16 should be able to measure at least 2 inter-frequency E-UTRAN cells simultaneously while in Idle mode.

question_20632.question: What happens if the TAU/Registration Complete message is lost in the paging procedure of a 5G network?
question_20632.ground_truth: In case of lost TAU/Registration Complete message, normal stage 3 procedures are applied. This means that the MME/AMF pages with both old and new S-TMSIs using the old and new "offset value", respectively.

question_20633.question: What should be connected to the UE antenna connector for UEs that support receive diversity?
question_20633.ground_truth: The SS (node B emulator), fader, and AWGN noise source should be connected to the UE antenna connector for UEs that support receive diversity.

question_20635.question: What is the range of RSRP reporting and the resolution of the measurement?
question_20635.ground_truth: The reporting range of RSRP is defined from -140 dBm to -44 dBm with a 1 dB resolution.

question_20636.question: What action is taken if the PDU Session modification to setup QoS flow for IMS voice is rejected by NG-RAN?
question_20636.ground_truth: The PGW-C+SMF maintains the PCC rule(s) associated with the QoS Flow(s).

question_20637.question: What is the main idea behind the CRS-TM deployment in the RRH deployment with DOAP?
question_20637.ground_truth: In the CRS-TM deployment, SFN RRHs use CRS-based PDSCH transmission modes, and different subsets of RRHs transmit reference signals of different CRS APs in SFN, which are orthogonal.

question_20638.question: What is one of the features introduced in Rel.15 to reduce the number of MAC CEs needed for activating/deactivating PUCCH spatial relation?
question_20638.ground_truth: Resource grouping based PUCCH spatial relation activation/deactivation.

question_20639.question: What two groups of equipment are not supported in the UMTS PLMN environment?
question_20639.ground_truth: Group 1 and group 2 equipments are not supported in the UMTS PLMN environment.

question_20640.question: What is one requirement for the MIME body of a SIP INFO request for USSD operations in IMS?
question_20640.ground_truth: The MIME body must include a g.3gpp.ussd USSD+xml message.

question_20641.question: In the context of 3GPP network architecture, what is the role of the Edge Repository (ER)?
question_20641.ground_truth: The Edge Repository (ER) functions as a storage repository for the Edge Enabler Layer (SEAL). The ER stores the Service APIs and Edge Application definitions required by various network functions and services.

question_20644.question: What is the test point measurement for UE data throughput performance?
question_20644.ground_truth: The point of measurement on the UE side will be either in a connected PC for terminals that support tethered mode only, or inside the UE in case of a terminal that does not support tethered mode, or in both places for UEs that support both modes.
