question_20645.question: What is the difference between online charging and offline charging?
question_20645.ground_truth: Online charging requires charging to occur during the active connection, while offline charging allows for charging to occur after the fact.

question_20646.question: What is the primary objective of the 3GPP system in providing means to support UxNB?
question_20646.ground_truth: The primary objective is to provide continuous connectivity service to UEs within the rescue area, minimize power consumption of the UxNB, optimize signalling when a serving UxNB changes, and minimize interference among UxNBs in close proximity.

question_20647.question: What measures should the UE (MCPTT Client) respect when the MCPTT User engages in communication in an off-network MCPTT Pre-arranged Group Call?
question_20647.ground_truth: The UE (MCPTT Client) should respect the floor control imposed by the floor control entity/arbitrator, including floor request, granting/release, idle, deny, taken/revoked, request queued and queue handling.

question_20650.question: What is the recommendation for Bands 1 and 38 BS transmitters in terms of harmonics and intermodulation products?
question_20650.ground_truth: It is recommended that Bands 1 and 38 BS transmitters do not share the same antenna with Bands 3, 7, 9, 31 and 41 BS receivers so that the antenna PIM will not cause desensitization of Bands 3, 7, 9, 31 and 41 BS receivers.

question_20651.question: What are two properties of security that the Security Management concept and requirements aim to provide?

question_20652.question: What is the role of the ValidityArea node in the ForServiceBased node?
question_20652.ground_truth: The ValidityArea node acts as a placeholder for location conditions for a particular flow distribution rule. This node and its descendants are the same as defined in ANDSF/Policy/<X>/ValidityArea.

question_20653.question: When does the MS leave CCN mode and continue cell reselection in NC0 mode if T3206 expires in the GPRS attach procedure?
question_20653.ground_truth: When T3206 expires, the MS leaves CCN mode and continues cell reselection in NC0 mode during the GPRS attach procedure.

question_20654.question: What is the gain presented for test case A in subsection 8.2.2.1?
question_20654.ground_truth: The gain presented for test case A is approximately 14.2%.

question_20655.question: What is the function of the MC service server in the MBMS system?
question_20655.ground_truth: The MC service server is responsible for determining the activation of one or more pre-established MBMS bearers, passing the MBMS bearer information to the MC service client, and sending MBMS bearer delivery notification message to all users that will receive the transmission over MBMS bearer.

question_20656.question: What are the common security procedures described in clause 5 of the present document?
question_20656.ground_truth: The common security procedures described in clause 5 of the present document include the security for interfaces between network entities, security requirements for the transmission of data between ProSe network entities, and security procedures for UE to ProSe Function interface.

question_20657.question: What happens when a multi-access PDN connection becomes unusable, as per TS 23.203?
question_20657.ground_truth: The Termination of service data flow chargeable event applies for all the service data flows carried under the IP-CAN bearer of the unusable access.

question_20658.question: What is the impact of time-dilated UMTS on in-band blocking requirements?
question_20658.ground_truth: The in-band blocking requirement will need to be redefined for a time-dilated UMTS modulated interferer, as its characteristics may differ from a W-CDMA modulated interferer. The out of band blocking requirement will also need to be updated for standalone time-dilated UMTS and multi-carrier scenarios.

question_20659.question: What is the scenario selected to derive ACIR values for NR stations interfering with NR-NTN in a rural environment?
question_20659.ground_truth: The scenario of NR DL interfering with NR-NTN LEO-600 UL in a rural environment was selected.

question_20660.question: What should a CS and IM CN subsystem capable UE do to select the domain for an emergency call attempt?
question_20660.ground_truth: The UE should follow the conventions and rules in 3GPP~TS 22.101 and 3GPP~TS 23.167 to select the domain for the emergency call attempt, and use appropriate access technology specific procedures.

question_20661.question: If the SMF has received an "Estimated Maximum Wait time" from the AMF and Extended Buffering in SMF applies, what will the SMF store?
question_20661.ground_truth: The SMF will store the DL Data for the Extended Buffering time.

question_20663.question: What are the pre-conditions for initiating a public emergency call in the FRMCS system?
question_20663.ground_truth: The pre-conditions for initiating a public emergency call in the FRMCS system are that the underlying transport of the FRMCS System supports emergency calls and the FRMCS System allows FRMCS Users to make use of emergency calls.

question_20664.question: What is the primary objective of controlling traffic in the 3GPP network when a third-party server encounters difficulties?
question_20664.ground_truth: The primary objective is to reduce or avoid unproductive traffic in the 3GPP network by blocking excessive traffic and preventing network congestion.

question_20665.question: What is the purpose of the "sos" SIP URI parameter as defined in 7.2A.13?
question_20665.ground_truth: The "sos" SIP URI parameter is intended to indicate to the S-CSCF that a REGISTER request is for emergency registration purposes, to prevent barring of the public user identity being registered, and to not apply initial filter criteria to requests destined for an emergency registered contact.

question_20666.question: What is the role of the RRBP field in the redefined header of EGPRS DL data blocks?
question_20666.ground_truth: The RRBP field, when split, defines only two possible values for reaction time (20 ms and 40 ms) and is part of a new interpretation for the RRBP, RS, and ES/P fields.

question_20671.question: What is the purpose of the SCAS technical specification for the NSSAAF network product class?
question_20671.ground_truth: The SCAS technical specification for the NSSAAF network product class contains requirements and test cases that are specific to this network product class. It makes adaptions to the Catalogue of General Security Assurance Requirements and specifies requirements and test cases unique to the NSSAAF network product class.

question_20672.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 8.16.99 of the document?
question_20672.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the UE's (User Equipment) ability to make correct reportings of certain events (A1, A2, A6) related to cell measurement in a specific scenario (deactivated SCells in non-DRX with generic duplex modes) under the requirements in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.3.3.2.1.

question_20673.question: What is the amplitude range for the current of the first set of random spikes?
question_20673.ground_truth: The current amplitude for the first set of random spikes is 60 mA.

question_20676.question: What should a NF Service Consumer do if it uses a query parameter that might not be supported by a NF Service Producer?
question_20676.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer shall be prepared to receive a successful response that may not match all the query parameters sent in the request, and to determine the features (and thus query parameters) not supported by the NF Service Producer using the attribute of the SupportedFeatures data type returned by the NF Service Producer in the HTTP GET response.

question_20677.question: What is the purpose of the Service Based Interface (Nsmsf) provided by the SMSF in the 5G system architecture?
question_20677.ground_truth: The Service-based interface (Nsmsf) provided by the SMSF is used to support SMS over NAS in the 5G system architecture.

question_20678.question: What are the fields in the User Data Header?
question_20678.ground_truth: The User Data Header comprises the following fields: Length of User Data Header, Information-Element-Identifier, Length of Information-Element, and Information-Element Data.

question_20679.question: What does the 'Random Access Preamble index' field represent and how many bits does it have?
question_20679.ground_truth: The 'Random Access Preamble index' field is a 6-bit field that represents the random access preamble index in the random access procedure initiated by a PDCCH order.

question_20680.question: What happens when a CUG call is received with an interlock code but not an indication of OA allowed, and there is a match with the called user's CUGs and incoming calls are not barred within this CUG?
question_20680.ground_truth: The call is offered as a CUG call.

question_20681.question: What should be included in the XML document in the HTTP response payload after the BSF concludes that the UE has been authenticated?
question_20681.ground_truth: The XML document should include the bootstrapping transaction identifier (B-TID), the key lifetime, and may include additional server-specific data.

question_20683.question: What protocol is used between the PoC XDM Server and the SIP/IP Core for communication?
question_20683.ground_truth: The POC-6 reference point uses the SIP protocol for communication between the PoC XDM Server and the SIP/IP Core.

question_20684.question: What are the three pieces of information that should be contained in the information provided from AF to 5GS for group QoS coordination?
question_20684.ground_truth: The three pieces of information that should be contained in the information provided from AF to 5GS for group QoS coordination are: (1) a group of Flow description, (2) a group of QoS requirement associated to the group of Flow Description, and (3) a group of Necessity Indication.

question_20686.question: What are the main contributors to complexity reduction for Option PT1 in relaxed UE processing timeline?
question_20686.ground_truth: The main contributors to complexity reduction for Option PT1 in relaxed UE processing timeline are the baseband: receiver processing block, baseband: LDPC decoding, baseband: DL control processing & decoder, and baseband: UL processing block.

question_20687.question: What event triggers the UE to use the counter for "the entry for the current SNPN considered invalid for non-3GPP access" events?
question_20687.ground_truth: When the UE accesses to SNPN services via a PLMN and the current SNPN is considered invalid for non-3GPP access.

question_20688.question: What is the A-TRAU' frame format in transparent mode?
question_20688.ground_truth: An A-TRAU' frame consists of two consecutive A-TRAU frames, each with a length of 320 bit. In transparent mode, the number of data bits in an A-TRAU' frame depend on the user rate only, each user rate corresponds to a fixed number of data bits.

question_20689.question: What is the main function of the Network Data Analytics Function (NWDAF) in the 5G system?
question_20689.ground_truth: The Network Data Analytics Function (NWDAF) in the 5G system is responsible for collecting network data and providing analytics to consumers, such as the data collected from any network function and the analytics exposure procedures.

question_20693.question: Which network entity is responsible for PWS key delivery in GERAN networks?
question_20693.ground_truth: MSC/SGSN can be used to deliver PWS keys to UEs in GERAN networks.

question_20694.question: What is the purpose of the 5GLAN Group creation and the Group Management Function?
question_20694.ground_truth: The 5GLAN Group creation is handled by a Group Management Function, where the group administrator can choose or specify a P-DNN for the 5GLAN group in creation, which interacts with the group administrator to handle the group creation and other group management functions.

question_20696.question: When should the UE include the MICO indication IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message?
question_20696.ground_truth: If the UE supports MICO mode and requests the use of MICO mode, then the UE shall include the MICO indication IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

question_20697.question: What does the "B8 02 81 00" coding represent in the "GET STATUS" response?
question_20697.ground_truth: This indicates that Channel 1 is open, and the link is established or the PDP context is activated.

question_20699.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 9.2.1LA.3 and 9.2.1LB.3?
question_20699.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the ability of the receiver to receive a predefined test signal, representing a multi-path fading channel with information bit throughput R not falling below a specified value.

question_20700.question: What action is taken to refresh the root key of the 5G AS security context associated with the SN Counter and reset the SN Counter to 0?
question_20700.ground_truth: An intra-cell handover is triggered as part of the root key refresh process.

question_20701.question: How are minimum performance requirements calculated for TRP in browsing mode with a hand phantom?
question_20701.ground_truth: The TRP performance requirements are calculated using the arithmetic mean of the linear-scale TRP results from the right and left hand phantom measurements, as defined in the equation for TRPaverage. Additionally, the minimum TRP for each measured channel in hand phantom browsing mode must also exceed the minimum performance requirements.

question_20702.question: What is the purpose of the local breakout roaming policy framework architecture in 5G?
question_20702.ground_truth: The local breakout roaming policy framework architecture in 5G enables communication between a PCF in the VPLMN and the AF for generating PCC Rules for services delivered via the VPLMN.

question_20703.question: What is the purpose of the eRG in ensuring prioritization of AR/VR game data flows over downloading of the game in the 5G core network?
question_20703.ground_truth: To ensure that the AR/VR game is playable with no additional lag or unplayable settings for frames per second and resolution due to the download.

question_20704.question: What is the HTTP status code that the USS shall respond with if the HTTP request message from the NF service consumer is accepted?
question_20704.ground_truth: If the HTTP request message from the NF service consumer is accepted, the USS shall respond with "200 OK" status code.

question_20707.question: What is the role of the NRCellCU IOC in the management of inter-cell mobility and neighbor relations for an NR cell?
question_20707.ground_truth: The NRCellCU IOC is responsible for managing inter-cell mobility and neighbor relations for an NR cell via ANR (Autonomous Neighbor Relations).

question_20708.question: Under what conditions are the steps of subclause 13.16.2.4.1.2 repeated for extreme test conditions?
question_20708.ground_truth: The steps of subclause 13.16.2.4.1.2 are repeated for extreme test conditions except that the repeats at step d) are only performed for power control level 10 and the minimum nominal output power level supported by the MS.

question_20709.question: What should the MCData client include in a SIP MESSAGE request when sending SDS messages?
question_20709.ground_truth: The MCData client should include an Accept-Contact header field containing the g.3gpp.mcdata.sds media feature tag with the "require" and "explicit" header field parameters, along with the ICSI value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.sds" in a P-Preferred-Service header field.

question_20710.question: What is the difference between the two NSAC admission options for a network slice subject to EPS interworking, and what is the corresponding NSAC strategy for each option?
question_20710.ground_truth: The two NSAC options for a network slice subject to EPS interworking are: (1) maximum number of registered UEs and/or maximum number of PDU Sessions, and (2) maximum number of UEs with at least one PDU Session/PDN Connection and/or maximum number of PDU Sessions. The NSAC for the first option is performed at the time of UE attachment, while the NSAC for the second option is performed at the time of PDN connection establishment in case of EPC interworking.

question_20711.question: When should a UE perform cell reselection to a higher priority E-UTRAN frequency or inter-RAT frequency than the serving frequency?
question_20711.ground_truth: If more than 1 second has elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell, and a cell of a higher priority EUTRAN, NR or UTRAN FDD RAT/frequency fulfills Squal > ThreshX, HighQ during a time interval TreselectionRAT or a cell of a higher priority UTRAN TDD, GERAN or CDMA2000 RAT/frequency fulfills Srxlev > ThreshX, HighP during a time interval TreselectionRAT.

question_20713.question: What action does the L2R function take when the "BREAK" condition is received from the MS?
question_20713.ground_truth: The L2R function generates a "BREAK" condition towards the fixed network on receipt of a break indication from the MS.

question_20714.question: What is the syntax of the device-address value in the MMS addressing model?
question_20714.ground_truth: The device-address value in the MMS addressing model can be a global phone number, an IPv4 address, an IPv6 address, or an escaped value of an address type.

question_20715.question: What does PDUsetQoSParameters contain in the definition provided?
question_20715.ground_truth: PDUsetQoSParameters contains a set of QoS Parameters related to the PDUset or PDUset-based QoS handling, including the pduSetDelayBudget, pduSetErrorRate, pduSetIntegratedHandlingInformation, and iE-Extensions.

question_20718.question: What is the function of the PCF in relation to non-session management?
question_20718.ground_truth: The PCF provides non-session management related functionality, which includes access and mobility related policy control, UE policy information control, negotiation for future BDT, and negotiation for planned data transfer with QoS requirements.

question_20719.question: What are the channel bandwidths supported by E-UTRA for D2D operations?
question_20719.ground_truth: E-UTRA supports flexible bandwidths of 1.4~MHz, 3~MHz, 5~MHz, 10~MHz, 15~MHz, and 20~MHz for D2D operations.

question_20720.question: What procedure is used for IPv4 home address allocation after a successful attach in untrusted non-3GPP IP access on S2c?

question_20722.question: What is the name of the service signaling in ATSC that contains basic information for users to perform service selection?

question_20723.question: What is the requirement for MTSI clients when offering speech media streams?
question_20723.ground_truth: An MTSI client must offer at least AVP for speech media streams and should also offer AVPF for speech media streams.

question_20724.question: What is the requirement for TAE in UTRA and E-UTRA for TX diversity, MIMO, and carrier aggregation?
question_20724.ground_truth: In UTRA and E-UTRA, TAE requirement was defined for TX diversity, MIMO transmission, carrier aggregation, and their combinations.

question_20725.question: What is the purpose of using the "omr-s-att" and "omr-s-bw" attributes in the SDP offer?
question_20725.ground_truth: These attributes are used to encapsulate session-level information within an "omr-s-att" attribute and add it as a media level attribute for every media line.

question_20726.question: In Iu mode, when is integrity protected signalling mandatory and what is its responsibility?
question_20726.ground_truth: In Iu mode, integrity protected signalling is mandatory for all protocols, and it is responsible for protecting the integrity of all SM signalling messages.

question_20728.question: Which message is transmitted in the CHANNEL RELEASE message when the MS performed GPRS suspension procedure prior to the CS session?

question_20730.question: What should the UE do if it receives a network initiated EPS Session Management Request message for the congested APN while the Session Management back-off timer is running?
question_20730.ground_truth: The UE should stop the Session Management back-off timer associated with the congested APN and respond to the MME if it receives a network initiated EPS Session Management Request message for the congested APN while the back-off timer is currently running.

question_20732.question: What is the requirement for the measurement reporting delay for Event W1 and Event W3 in E-UTRAN FDD-WLAN Event Triggered Reporting in non-DRX under AWGN?
question_20732.ground_truth: The UE shall send one Event W1 triggered measurement report, with a measurement reporting delay less than 30 seconds from the beginning of time period T2. The UE shall send one Event W3 triggered measurement report, with a measurement reporting delay less than 500 ms from the beginning of time period T3.

question_20733.question: What radio access technologies can be indicated by the Radio Access Technology identifier (RAT) associated with each entry in the "User controlled PLMN selector with Access Technology", "Operator controlled PLMN selector with Access Technology" and "HPLMN selector with Access Technology" data files?
question_20733.ground_truth: The Radio Access Technology identifier (RAT) associated with each entry in the "User controlled PLMN selector with Access Technology", "Operator controlled PLMN selector with Access Technology" and "HPLMN selector with Access Technology" data files can indicate any combination of the values: GSM, GSM COMPACT, UTRAN, E-UTRAN, cdma2000 1xRTT and cdma2000 HRPD access technologies.

question_20735.question: What message is transmitted by the eNB to trigger the measurement of "Number of octets of DL LWIPEP PDUs"?
question_20735.ground_truth: The DL LWIPEP PDUs by the eNB.

question_20736.question: In 5G systems, for NAS signalling security, what is the role of the NAS security function in both the UE and the AMF?
question_20736.ground_truth: The NAS security function in both the UE and the AMF performs integrity/replay protection and enciphering/deciphering of NAS signalling messages to provide NAS signalling security for 5GS.

question_20737.question: What is the difference between solutions 1 and 2 in terms of handling state transitions?
question_20737.ground_truth: In solution 1, the UE indicates its readiness to perform a state transition to the Node B via MAC Control Element after the expiration of the inactivity timer. Upon receiving HARQ ACK, the UE can perform the state transition. On the other hand, solution 2 involves an additional HS-SCCH order sent from the network as a go-ahead for the state transition.

question_20738.question: What is the requirement for the multicarrier receiver in a multicarrier BTS?
question_20738.ground_truth: The manufacturer shall declare if the multicarrier BTS is equipped with multicarrier receiver and if any multicarrier receiver paths are equivalent in terms of radio performance. The Medium Range and Local Area classes may not be declared without multicarrier receiver.

question_20739.question: What is the security requirement for multimedia on demand services in SIP traffic?
question_20739.ground_truth: The security requirement for multimedia on demand services in SIP traffic is to study whether an IMS media security solution can be used to protect the confidentiality and authentication of media on demand during transit.

question_20742.question: What should the UE and eNB do if UP integrity protection is not activated for DRBs?
question_20742.ground_truth: The eNB and the UE shall not integrity protect the traffic of such DRB and shall not put MAC-I into PDCP packet.

question_20743.question: What shall the originating transmission participant do upon receipt of encoded media from the user, as per TS 24.581 clause 7.2.3.5.5?
question_20743.ground_truth: The originating transmission participant shall start timer T206, request the MCVideo client to start sending RTP media packets, and remain in the 'O: transmission arbitration' state.

question_20744.question: What does the SMF receive from the PCF if dynamic PCC is used for the MA PDU Session?
question_20744.ground_truth: The SMF receives PCC rules with MA PDU Session Control information from the PCF if dynamic PCC is used for the MA PDU Session.

question_20746.question: What new functionalities will have to be introduced for overload control in the existing Diameter application?
question_20746.ground_truth: New functionalities related to overload control will have to be introduced as a new feature of the existing application.

question_20747.question: What is the result of using the TFO codes for tandem-free operation?
question_20747.ground_truth: The use of TFO codes for tandem-free operation does not result in any change in frame timing.

question_20748.question: What does the term "UICC" refer to in the context of 3GPP applications?
question_20748.ground_truth: The UICC is a platform used for 3GPP applications, such as USIM, ISIM, and HPSIM.

question_20749.question: What should the manufacturer declare if the BS supports NB-IoT?
question_20749.ground_truth: The manufacturer should declare the supported NB-IoT sub-carrier spacing (15 kHz or 3.75 kHz or both) for NPUSCH.

question_20750.question: What is the role of the MTC Security GW within the MTC-IWF in the 3GPP network?
question_20750.ground_truth: The MTC Security GW within the MTC-IWF is responsible for performing access control functionality of the MTCsp interface to prevent unauthorized MTC servers from accessing the core network and authenticating with the MTC server on behalf of the 3GPP network.

question_20751.question: Which standard specifies the procedures for the MCPTT client to generate a SIP MESSAGE request for a remotely initiated private call?

question_20755.question: Which downlink power control mode is used during the test?
question_20755.ground_truth: Downlink power control mode (DPC_MODE) 0 is used during the test.

question_20756.question: What are the functionalities of the W1 interface that are supported over W1-C and W1-U?
question_20756.ground_truth: The functionalities of the W1 interface that are supported over W1-C include Interface management, system information management, Paging function, UE context management function, RRC message transfer function, and Warning message information transfer function. The W1-U functionalities that are supported include Transfer of user data.

question_20758.question: What is the first digit in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Specification document and what does it indicate?
question_20758.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Specification document indicates the status of the document. A value of 1 presented to TSG for information, 2 presented to TSG for approval, or greater than 2 indicates TSG approved document under change control.

question_20759.question: What message does the UE send to the network in order to start data transmission after receiving a Service Accept message?
question_20759.ground_truth: The UE may start data transmission on default resources after receiving a Service Accept message.

question_20762.question: What is the role of the UPF/NW-TT in the 5GS with respect to TSN network?
question_20762.ground_truth: The UPF/NW-TT realizes Ethernet forwarding functionality and makes use of the static forwarding rules to any port as provided by the CNC. The PDU Sessions serving TSC or non-TSC traffic correspond to 5GS bridge ports.

question_20766.question: In Solution #3, how does the system handle a UE reaching the quota limit in a Network Slice?
question_20766.ground_truth: When the quota is overflown in Solution #3, the NSSF returns either the UE is allowed to use the S-NSSAI but with an indication that the quota is overflown, or, if it is the policy, that the S-NSSAI is not allowed with cause "quota overflown". An optional back-off timer may also be provided.

question_20767.question: How many entries shall the MS be capable of storing in the list of "Forbidden location areas for roaming" as per 3GPP TS 04.08 / 3GPP TS 24.008?
question_20767.ground_truth: The MS shall be capable of storing at least 6 entries in the list of "Forbidden location areas for roaming".

question_20768.question: Which device is the source device when the SIM simulator is setting up a call to the network?
question_20768.ground_truth: The SIM simulator is the source device when setting up a call to the network.

question_20769.question: Which two options are available for CHF selection to be used by the MMS Node for converged online and offline charging scenarios?
question_20769.ground_truth: The two options for CHF selection are: (1) discovered via NRF, and (2) locally provisioned based on Operator's policies.

question_20770.question: What is the maximum allowed magnitude of the error vector for QPSK, AQPSK, 8-PSK, 16-QAM, and 32-QAM modulated signals?
question_20770.ground_truth: The magnitude of the error vector shall be less than 17.5% (measured in percentages of the nominal constellation point amplitude) for all the mentioned modulation types.

question_20772.question: What is the role of the Transport Format Selection function in LTE MAC layer?
question_20772.ground_truth: The Transport Format Selection function in LTE MAC layer is responsible for selecting the appropriate transport format for each active transport channel depending on source rate, which maximizes the utilization of transport channels.

question_20773.question: What is one potential disadvantage of dynamic SBFD compared to semi-static SBFD?
question_20773.ground_truth: Dynamic SBFD may increase gNB implementation complexity due to dynamic antenna/panels switching and filters/RF tuning, may incur loss of resources due to transition time, may increase inter-gNB CLI, and can result in additional specification impact on top of semi-static SBFD.

question_20774.question: What is the default value of the voice mode and when is it manufacturer specific?
question_20774.ground_truth: The default value of the voice mode is manufacturer specific, this value applies when no other value is set and the UE supports this feature.

question_20776.question: What media format and protocols are used to define an instantiation of AR conversational services in WebRTC?
question_20776.ground_truth: A subset of WebRTC, limited to a protocol stack and implementation excluding codecs and other media processing functions defined in W3C and/or IETF, is used to define an instantiation of AR conversational services in WebRTC.

question_20777.question: What type of messages are used for sending call connect and disconnect information over non-SIP media plane signaling using MCPTT-4 in a pre-established session?
question_20777.ground_truth: Call connect and disconnect information is sent over non-SIP media plane signaling using MCPTT-4 for including or releasing an MCPTT client in the call using a pre-established session.

question_20778.question: What is the predetermined bit-rate value used in HQ MDCT coding bit-rate, if the CELP core is at 12.8 kHz?

question_20780.question: What is the behavior required by the source eNB upon handover, regardless of the handover procedures used within the network?
question_20780.ground_truth: The source eNB should maintain a context to enable the UE to return in case of handover failure and should enable the UE to resume the RRC connection either in the source PCell or in another cell using the RRC re-establishment procedure.

question_20781.question: What steps are followed in the N9HR LI process for voice media interception?
question_20781.ground_truth: The N9HR LI process involves the creation, modification, or deletion of PDU sessions for inbound roaming UEs with N9HR DNN, and notifying the LMISF-IRI to instruct the BBIFF-C present in the SMF to deliver the relevant user plane packets to LMISF-CC for interception.

question_20782.question: What information must the PCRF include in an NRA command for reporting restrictions for a specific user id and PDN ID?
question_20782.ground_truth: The PCRF must include one or more Congestion-Level-Definition AVP(s) indicating the specific congestion level set and corresponding congestion levels in an NRA command to provide reporting restrictions for a specific user id and PDN ID.

question_20783.question: What should a MCVideo client include in the SIP INVITE request when pulling a video from another MCVideo client?
question_20783.ground_truth: A MCVideo client should include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the <mcvideoinfo> element containing the <mcvideo-Params> element with the <session-type> element set to a value of "one-to-one video pull" when pulling a video from another MCVideo client.

question_20784.question: What is the Inner loop power control in the downlink requirement for E-UTRA or NR operation?
question_20784.ground_truth: There is no Inner loop power control requirement for E-UTRA or NR operation.

question_20786.question: What is the difference between "native" and "mapped" operators in a shared network?
question_20786.ground_truth: In a shared network, an operator can be "native" (i.e. no RAT change) or "mapped" (i.e. RAT change) - meaning that the network uses a different radio access technology (RAT) for the operator compared to the one used for the same operator in a different network.

question_20787.question: Which PDU is used by an SME to determine which data formats within the Extended Object IE are supported by a specific terminal when using the SC?
question_20787.ground_truth: An SME uses the SMS-DELIVER PDU to determine which data formats within the Extended Object IE are supported by a specific terminal when using the SC.

question_20788.question: What is the pre-requisite for a message store client to initiate a synchronization request with the MCData message store?
question_20788.ground_truth: A successful authentication and authorization between the message store client and the MCData message store.

question_20789.question: What should the Node B do regarding Transmission Gap Pattern Sequences when it receives a COMPRESSED MODE COMMAND message from the CRNC, with the Affected HS-DSCH serving cell List IE in the Active Pattern Sequence Information IE, and the Transmission Gap Pattern Sequence for affected HS-DSCH Serving Cells is activated on the HS-DSCH Primary Serving Cell but not for all the other serving cells?
question_20789.ground_truth: The Node B shall reject the procedure using the RADIO LINK FAILURE message with the cause value ``Invalid CM settings''.

question_20790.question: What is a potential requirement for the 3GPP system to support the autonomous operation of a network slice in the case of lost connectivity?
question_20790.ground_truth: PR 5.9.2-1, For autonomous operation in case connectivity inside the network slice is lost, the 3GPP system shall be able to continue operation in unaffected parts of the network slice.

question_20791.question: What is the value of the "ProtocolType" leaf in the IP flow description?
question_20791.ground_truth: The value of the "ProtocolType" leaf in the IP flow description is a value among the internet protocol numbers as defined in IANA Assigned Internet Protocol Numbers.

question_20795.question: How long should the interruption time be for intra-frequency and inter-frequency cell re-selection?
question_20795.ground_truth: The interruption time shall not exceed TSI-NB1-EC + 100 ms.

question_20799.question: What is included in a Direct Communication Accept message for V2X service oriented Layer-2 link establishment?
question_20799.ground_truth: The Direct Communication Accept message includes the Source User Info (Application Layer ID of the UE sending the message) and QoS Info (information about PC5 QoS Flows requested for V2X service).

question_20800.question: What is the duration of DL PRS symbols in ms that the user equipment (UE) processes every Tagg ms in a given maximum bandwidth supported by UE?

question_20801.question: What is the purpose of the LocationNotificationUri in the ProvideLocation service operation?
question_20801.ground_truth: The LocationNotificationUri is used to specify the callback URI where the NEF or other NF can receive a notification about the UE location information update.

question_20802.question: What must the UE include in the 5GSM capability IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message if the UE supports transfer of port management information containers?
question_20802.ground_truth: The UE must set the TPMIC bit to "Transfer of port management information containers supported" in the 5GSM capability IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message and include the DS-TT Ethernet port MAC address IE and the UE-DS-TT residence time IE if requested.

question_20803.question: What is the role of the IWF/CN in source coding?
question_20803.ground_truth: Source coding is dependent on the IWF/CN and is a NAS functionality, while radio channel coding is supported by URAN to optimize the usage of radio resources.

question_20804.question: What is the purpose of the MCPTT imminent peril group call cancel request?
question_20804.ground_truth: It is used to cancel the MCPTT group's in-progress imminent peril state.

question_20805.question: What should the BM-SC do if the SGmb path failure remains transient for the MBMS GW?
question_20805.ground_truth: The BM-SC shall consider that the MBMS session is still controlled by the related MBMS GW and proceed as if there had been no SGmb path failure.

question_20807.question: What is the purpose of the "MDAS" service in the 3GPP system?
question_20807.ground_truth: The "MDAS" service is a "Management Domain Analytics Service" that is used to provide data analytics at the OAM level in the 3GPP system.

question_20809.question: What should the AS replace the Refer-To header field with when sending the REFER request to the transferee?
question_20809.ground_truth: The AS replaces the Refer-To header field with the ECT Session Identifier URI.

question_20811.question: What is the parameter p in equation (7.6-46) used for?
question_20811.ground_truth: The parameter p in equation (7.6-46) is used to determine the proportion of mobile scatterers in the channel.

question_20813.question: What is the effect of RAN paging failure on user plane data and UE CM state in the AMF?
question_20813.ground_truth: If the RAN paging procedure is not successful in establishing contact with the UE, the network initiates the AN Release procedure to move the UE CM state in the AMF to CM-IDLE state and indicates to the AMF the NAS non-delivery.

question_20815.question: What is the frequency domain resource allocation method used in the DL scheduling scheme?
question_20815.ground_truth: The frequency domain resource allocation method used in the DL scheduling scheme is exclusively using resource allocation type 1 with non-interleaved VRB-to-PRB mapping.

question_20816.question: What is the recommended approach for short downloading latency for AI/ML model downloading in the 5G system for image recognition?
question_20816.ground_truth: For short downloading latency, it is recommended to pre-install a sub-optimal model that can be temporarily employed while downloading the optimal model in case of 1-second or less, and then replace the pre-installed model.

question_20820.question: What is the key feature of a MA PDU Session?
question_20820.ground_truth: A MA PDU Session is a PDU session that provides a PDU connectivity service, which can use one access network at a time, or simultaneously one 3GPP access network and one non-3GPP access network.

question_20821.question: What is the purpose of the Service category information element in the context of GERAN and UTRAN?
question_20821.ground_truth: The Service category information element is used to provide the network with information about services invoked by the user equipment in the context of GERAN and UTRAN.

question_20822.question: What is the meaning of "shall" in the context of the document?
question_20822.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something in the context of normative provisions for the document.

question_20824.question: What should an MTSI client support for TMMBR in ECN and video sessions?
question_20824.ground_truth: If an MTSI client offers to use ECN for video in RTP streams, it should indicate support of TMMBR by including the "ccm tmmbr" value within an "rtcp-fb" SDP attribute. When an MTSI client receives an offer for ECN for video with an indication of support of TMMBR, it should accept the offer if it supports ECN and TMMBR.

question_20827.question: What method indicates the successful copying of a message from one folder to another?

question_20829.question: Which command can be used to print IPv6 address parameters of other AT commands?
question_20829.ground_truth: The 8.62 +CGPIAF command can be used to print IPv6 address parameters of other AT commands.

question_20830.question: What is the requirement for supporting long forwarded-to numbers in the 3GPP system?
question_20830.ground_truth: It should be possible to register a long forwarded-to number for call forwarding supplementary services in the 3GPP system, and an additional clause defines the requirements when one or more network entities and/or the mobile station does not support Long Forwarded-to Numbers.

question_20831.question: What is the order of services provisioning in the centralized service brokering functions?
question_20831.ground_truth: In centralized service brokering functions, the S-CSCF interfaces with only one SB, the SB interfaces with multiple ASs.

question_20832.question: What type of information is indicated in the node named "DefaultBroadcastDestinationLayer2ID"?
question_20832.ground_truth: It acts as a placeholder to indicate the default destination layer-2 ID for broadcast used for V2X broadcast mode communication over the NR-PC5.

question_20833.question: What action does the UE take when it receives a SECURITY MODE COMMAND message that can be accepted and includes the "null integrity protection algorithm" 5G-IA0 as the selected NAS integrity algorithm, but is not received during a specific scenario?
question_20833.ground_truth: The UE should not accept such a message, except when the UE is registered for emergency services, performing initial registration for emergency services or establishing an emergency PDU session.

question_20834.question: What was agreed for OTA ACS requirement in frequency range 2 (FR2) for the ACS requirements and the allowed REFSEN degradation for the different BS channel bandwidths?
question_20834.ground_truth: The ACS requirement for BS channel bandwidths of 50~MHz in FR2 is agreed as 24~dB in 24.25 ~ 33.4~GHz and 23~dB in 37 ~ 52.6~GHz. The allowed REFSEN degradation is 6~dB.

question_20835.question: What is the purpose of the EN-DC FR2 CSI-RS based L1-RSRP measurement accuracy test?
question_20835.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that the CSI-RS based L1-RSRP absolute measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for all bands.

question_20836.question: What is the purpose of the gsmSSF, gsmSCF, assisting gsmSSF and gsmSRF in the CAP protocol?
question_20836.ground_truth: The gsmSSF, gsmSCF, assisting gsmSSF and gsmSRF follow the normal error handling procedures when receiving an operation that is not part of the CAP or contains parameters that are not part of the CAP.

question_20837.question: What SAND messages must 3GP-DASH clients support in the 'Proxy Caching' mode?
question_20837.ground_truth: 3GP-DASH clients supporting SAND functionality in the 'Proxy Caching' mode must support the following SAND messages: ClientCapabilities, DaneCapabilities, AnticipatedRequests, AcceptedAlternatives, DeliveredAlternative, ResourceStatus, MPDValidityEndTime.

question_20838.question: What is the IP mobility mode selection procedure purpose?
question_20838.ground_truth: The purpose is to select the mobility protocol, namely DSMIPv6 or PMIPv6, when the UE moves from 3GPP system to non-3GPP system.

question_20839.question: What is the requirement for the out-of-order PDSCH-to-HARQ-ACK flow in a given serving cell when applicable?
question_20839.ground_truth: The UE only expects a maximum of one out-of-order PDSCH-to-HARQ-ACK flow on the active BWP of a given serving cell when applicable.

question_20842.question: What happens when the receiving MC service client 2 accepts the private call in an ongoing private communication between two MC service clients?
question_20842.ground_truth: When the receiving MC service client 2 accepts the private call in an ongoing private communication, an acknowledgement is sent to the MC service server 2, and the MC service server 2 forwards the private call response message to the MC service server 1.

question_20843.question: What is the length of the TAC and 5GS TAC in the en-gNB ID?
question_20843.ground_truth: The length of the TAC is 2 octets and the 5GS TAC is 3 octets.

question_20844.question: What must the UE comply with in order to pass the test in 8.16.88?
question_20844.ground_truth: The UE must make a correct reporting of event A6 on deactivated SCell with PCell and SCell interruptions in non-DRX, fulfill the requirements on interruption rate, and comply with the minimum conformance requirements in clause 8.16.84.3.

question_20846.question: When can the MCPTT server send an MCPTT call request towards MCPTT client 3 during MCPTT call transfer?
question_20846.ground_truth: The MCPTT server sends an MCPTT call request to MCPTT client 3 after MCPTT client 1 sends an MCPTT private call request with a call transfer indication.

question_20847.question: What must the UE do with the announcement of the media plane security mechanisms the P-CSCF (IMS-ALG) supports, received in the Security-Server header field and labelled with the "mediasec" header field parameter in the 401 (Unauthorized) response during the registration process in a 5G system?
question_20847.ground_truth: The UE must store the announcement of the media plane security mechanisms the P-CSCF (IMS-ALG) supports, received in the Security-Server header field and labelled with the "mediasec" header field parameter, if any.

question_20848.question: What is the data type of the "Current-Time" element in the "prose-direct-discovery-response" complexType?
question_20848.ground_truth: The data type of the "Current-Time" element is "xs:dateTime".

question_20849.question: How does the Serving GW act as the signaling endpoint for each interface when either of the S2a or S2b interfaces is chained with a PMIP-based S8 interface?
question_20849.ground_truth: When a procedure is initiated by its peer on a given interface for a given PDN connection, the Serving GW shall trigger an equivalent procedure over the chained interface for the designated PDN connection.

question_20850.question: How many sources show SNR gain for joint channel estimation over multiple slots for eMBB?
question_20850.ground_truth: Eleven sources show SNR gain for joint channel estimation over multiple slots for eMBB.

question_20852.question: What is the role of the UE-to-Network relay in this process?
question_20852.ground_truth: The UE-to-Network relay is used to discover the remote UE and establish a secure PC5 unicast link.

question_20854.question: What condition must be met for a test to be considered successful?
question_20854.ground_truth: Both the event detection and the percentage of transmitted ACK/NACKs must be fulfilled simultaneously for a test to be considered successful.

question_20857.question: What actions should the Serving GW take when informed about the change of RAT type by the SGSN in the procedure Modify Bearer Request for a PMIP-based S5/S8?
question_20857.ground_truth: The Serving GW should inform the P-GW(s) about the change of RAT type and update its context field. MSISDN is included if available in the stored UE context.

question_20858.question: What can be done to improve measurement accuracy, sensitivity, and efficiency when the resolution bandwidth is smaller than the measurement bandwidth?
question_20858.ground_truth: When the resolution bandwidth is smaller than the measurement bandwidth, the result should be integrated over the measurement bandwidth in order to obtain the equivalent noise bandwidth of the measurement bandwidth.

question_20859.question: What is the main functionality of Enhancement Solution 1?
question_20859.ground_truth: Enhancement Solution 1 estimates the distance between the Announcing and Monitoring UE based on their relative location, determined using existing LBS techniques. The location of the announcing UE is conveyed to the monitoring UE directly in the discovery message over PC5.

question_20860.question: What is the purpose of enhancing the User Plane Redundant Session Path (URSP) in Rel-17 of 3GPP with Redundant Transmission Experience related analytics?
question_20860.ground_truth: The purpose is to assist the SMF in deciding on Redundant Transmission on N3/N9 interface, providing UL/DL packet delay, and packet drop rate for the end-to-end Redundant transmission.

question_20862.question: How much improvement was observed when including GSM RSSI measurements for the urban 10 MHz case and suburban 10 MHz case?
question_20862.ground_truth: In the urban 10 MHz case, there is a 11% reduction in the 67th percentile error, and in the suburban 10 MHz case, there is a 23% reduction in the 67th percentile error.

question_20865.question: What is the purpose of "SMF support for P-CSCF restoration procedure" as defined in TS23.380?
question_20865.ground_truth: It is for the support of P-CSCF restoration, which is a functionality located in the IMS.

question_20866.question: What is the state where the network has sent a request for a new mode but has not yet received a response from the mobile station?

question_20867.question: What is the role of the Service Capability Feature Servers in the OSA environment?
question_20867.ground_truth: Service Capability Feature Servers provide network services to applications through the Framework. They register their features to the Framework for discovery and management.

question_20868.question: What does the GW (BBERF) do after receiving the response for the IP-CAN specific bearer removal procedure in the PCRF-Initiated Gateway Control Session Termination procedure?
question_20868.ground_truth: The GW (BBERF) replies to the PCRF with an PCRF-Initiated Gateway Control Session Termination acknowledgement.

question_20869.question: What is the purpose of the test in 9.1.70.1 as per the 3GPP TS 36.508 standard?
question_20869.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that RSRP absolute and relative measurement accuracy in carrier aggregation are within the specified limits under AWGN propagation conditions.

question_20871.question: What is the role of the MCData server and MCData clients in establishing media plane resources for data communication?
question_20871.ground_truth: The MCData server sends an ad-hoc group data session request, while MCData clients receive it, further notify their corresponding MCData users, and establish media plane resources for data communication upon acceptance of the request.

question_20872.question: What is the main challenge in the key issue of MNO exposing network performance monitoring?
question_20872.ground_truth: The main challenge is that DSO has to be an MNO trusted entity to access MnSes provided by the 3GPP Management System.

question_20875.question: Which 3GPP organization is responsible for defining "3GPP defined radio access networks supporting non-Terrestrial Networks" (NRAN)?
question_20875.ground_truth: RAN (RAN1, RAN2, RAN3, RAN4) is responsible for defining radio access networks supporting non-Terrestrial Networks (NRAN) in Release 17.

question_20876.question: What will fail if there are subsequent requests towards the P-CSCF but they do not traverse the S-CSCF?
question_20876.ground_truth: All subsequent requests towards the P-CSCF will fail if the P-CSCF does not resume operation.

question_20877.question: What is the difference between a SIM and a USIM in terms of the network they can support?
question_20877.ground_truth: A SIM supports a 2G network, while a USIM only accepts 3G commands and is not compatible with a 2G ME.

question_20878.question: What is the single carrier requirement for Additional Maximum Output Power that applies to UE additional maximum output power reduction for inter-band NR CA between FR 1 and FR 2 without EN-DC?
question_20878.ground_truth: The single carrier requirements for Additional Maximum Output Power apply as part of clause~6.2.3 in TS~38.521-1 for NR FR1 carrier and clause~6.2.3 in TS~38.521-2 for NR FR2 carrier.

question_20879.question: What is the value of D when turbo coding with rate 1/3 is used?
question_20879.ground_truth: The value of D is K + 4 when turbo coding with rate 1/3 is used.

question_20880.question: What is the problem solved/gains provided by the solution of using a FQDN Identifier with dynamic DNS Update?
question_20880.ground_truth: This solution addresses some aspects of IP addressing related to MT communications initiated by the MTC server and proposes to use dynamic DNS updates initiated by the UE instead of a network entity. This overcomes the problem of the network ignoring the global IPv6 address used by the MTC device, and allows for the association between FQDN and the current IP address to be kept up to date, even in case of stateless IPv6 addressing or frequent changes to the UE's IP address.

question_20881.question: What is the purpose of the NAS Registration Accept message in the 5G network?
question_20881.ground_truth: The NAS Registration Accept message is used to inform the UE that it can use the TNAN to transfer non-seamless offload traffic and to establish PDU Sessions.

question_20882.question: What is the function of Timing Advance (TA) in UMTS system?
question_20882.ground_truth: Timing Advance (TA) is the amount of time, expressed in number of chips, by which the transmission of an uplink burst is anticipated by the UE in order to be received by the cell inside the corresponding time slot.

question_20883.question: What is the purpose of sending a supervisory frame from the SS with the first byte of the S frame control field set to 1110 0000?
question_20883.ground_truth: The purpose is to verify whether the MS sends an FRMR when it receives a supervisory frame with incorrect length.

question_20884.question: What is the purpose of the Block Check Sequence (BCS) in the channel coding process?
question_20884.ground_truth: The Block Check Sequence (BCS) is used for error detection in the channel coding process.

question_20885.question: What is the EU measurement capability requirement in the RRC_IDLE state, as specified in clause 4.5.5.3?
question_20885.ground_truth: The UE PRS RSTD measurement capability in the RRC_IDLE state is indicated by the UE in NR-DL-TDOA-ProvideCapabilities as per TS 37.355.

question_20886.question: What network function is used to determine the AMF and SMF instances serving a UE or group of UEs?

question_20887.question: What message does the UE send to terminate the dialogue after the last location request operation?
question_20887.ground_truth: The UE sends a RELEASE COMPLETE message.

question_20888.question: What steps must the MCData client follow upon receiving a SIP MESSAGE request for absolute URI discovery response?
question_20888.ground_truth: The MCData client must store the absolute URI found in the <mcdata-controller-psi> element, generate a SIP 200 (OK) response, and send the SIP 200 (OK) response towards the MCData server.

question_20890.question: What is the role of the Key Server Function (KSF) in the 5G system as defined in TS 33.535?
question_20890.ground_truth: The KSF is responsible for obtaining a derived anchor key from the basic network layer authentication service and deriving one or more service specific keys from this anchor key. It is typically located in the home CSP and has a connection to the AAA infrastructure.

question_20891.question: What should the MS do upon receiving a downlink message while the GA-PSR TC activation procedure is in progress in the GPRS network?
question_20891.ground_truth: The MS shall process the request as if the transport channel was active. The MS shall not initiate uplink GPRS user data transfer until the GA-PSR TC activation procedure is successfully completed as specified in the subclause 8.2. Also, the MS shall use the IP address and UDP port number received in the GA-PSR ACTIVATE UTC ACK message for sending uplink GPRS user data packets to the GANC on that transport channel.

question_20892.question: What should the UE do if the initial registration request cannot be accepted by the network and the 5GMM cause value is set to #22 "congestion"?
question_20892.ground_truth: The UE shall take the following actions: abort the initial registration procedure, set the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED, enter state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION, stop timer T3346, and stay in the current serving cell while applying the normal cell reselection process.

question_20894.question: What is the role of the "Mobile Intelligent Assistant" in the context of the "Railway Smart Station"?
question_20894.ground_truth: The "Mobile Intelligent Assistant" is a 5G-enabled robot with autonomous movements and artificial intelligence, which is used to support passengers in the "Railway Smart Station".

question_20895.question: How is the "List of Traffic Data Volumes" attribute of the ePDG-CDR populated?
question_20895.ground_truth: The "List of Traffic Data Volumes" attribute of the ePDG-CDR consists of a set of containers that are added when specific trigger conditions are met. These conditions identify the volume count per Qos, separated for uplink and downlink traffic, on encountering that trigger condition.

question_20896.question: What is the FER performance for full rate speech channels in VAMOS mode?
question_20896.ground_truth: The FER performance for full rate speech channels in VAMOS mode is less than or equal to 1.

question_20898.question: What should the AMF and UE do after a successful second NAS SMC procedure when the NAS key re-keying occurred over access A?
question_20898.ground_truth: Both the UE and the AMF shall delete the old NAS security context after a successful second NAS SMC procedure over the other access (access B).

question_20899.question: What restrictions does a QoS unaware client face in adapting the bitrate in response to congestion?
question_20899.ground_truth: A QoS unaware client may have to adapt down to virtually 0 kbps, causing poor video quality due to lack of information about GBR.

question_20901.question: What is a "Non-Local Identity" in the context of LI?
question_20901.ground_truth: A "Non-Local Identity" is an identity that is not connected to the operator network. It is based on a match between this target identity and identity type (e.g. IMPU) with the detected party fields. This type of interception is based on national regulations.

question_20902.question: What is the handover delay Dhandover1 for target cell addition need to be verified during T3?

question_20903.question: What should the user equipment (UE) do with stored deprioritization requests when requested to perform a manual PLMN selection?
question_20903.ground_truth: The UE should delete the stored deprioritization requests and proceed with the PLMN selection.

question_20904.question: When does the Replaces information element indicate that the I1 session being established will replace the existing SIP dialog?
question_20904.ground_truth: The Replaces information element indicates that the I1 session being established will replace the existing SIP dialog identified by the Replaces information element.

question_20905.question: What is one of the functions of the Controller UE in a Collaborative Session?
question_20905.ground_truth: The Controller UE can initiate the addition, modification, or release of a media flow in a Collaborative Session.

question_20906.question: What is the maximum mean power received at the UE antenna port for category M1, at which the specified relative throughput shall meet or exceed the minimum requirements for the specified reference measurement channel?
question_20906.ground_truth: The maximum mean power received at the UE antenna port for category M1, at which the specified relative throughput shall meet or exceed the minimum requirements for the specified reference measurement channel is -40 dBm.

question_20907.question: What is the factor by which the processing complexity increases for DSR compared to EDGE?
question_20907.ground_truth: The total processing complexity of DSR is in the order of 2-3 times higher than for EDGE, i.e. up to 50 % higher per bit.

question_20908.question: What formats are recommended for encapsulating AR media in real-time transport protocol (RTP) and ISO Base Media File Format (ISOBMFF)/Common Media Application Format (CMAF)?
question_20908.ground_truth: The report suggests encapsulating AR media into RTP and ISOBMFF/CMAF, but it does not specify which formats to use.

question_20909.question: Which RTP payload types should be used for G.711, G.729 and G.722 in an MTSI client in terminal using fixed access?
question_20909.ground_truth: The following payload types should be used for G.711, G.729 and G.722: 0 for G.711 ulaw, 8 for G.711 alaw, 96 for G.729, 97 for G.729 Annex A, and 98 for G.729, 99 for G.722.

question_20911.question: What entity is responsible for initiating the PDU Session modification procedure in the described 5G network architecture?

question_20914.question: What should the UE (MCVideo Client) do upon receipt of an initial SIP INVITE request during an MCVideo emergency or imminent peril call when the MCVideo client is affiliated but not joined to the chat group?
question_20914.ground_truth: The UE (MCVideo Client) may reject the SIP INVITE request if the client does not have enough resources to handle the call. If the SIP INVITE request is rejected, the MCVideo client should respond with an appropriate reject code and warning texts. If the MCVideo client does not have enough resources to handle the call, the MCVideo client can choose to accept the request by means outside the scope of the specification.

question_20915.question: When is the UE Usage Type information obtained during the handover procedure when transitioning from a service area where DCN is not used to a service area where DCN is supported?
question_20915.ground_truth: The target MME or SGSN obtains the UE Usage Type information from the HSS during the subsequent TAU or RAU procedure if the handover occurs from a service area where DCN is not used to a service area where DCN is supported and the MME or SGSN changes.

question_20916.question: What is the application of the EAS IP replacement procedure in the 5GC?
question_20916.ground_truth: The EAS IP replacement procedure allows the replacement of the source/old Target EAS IP address and port number with the target/new target EAS IP address and port number in the 5GC to support Edge Relocation.

question_20917.question: What is the conclusion of the evaluation on PDCCH resource utilization in Rel-15 NR for URLLC UEs with a single PDCCH transmission?
question_20917.ground_truth: Compact DCI targeting a reduction of 16 bits compared to Rel-15 DCI can save 14% ~ 20% PDCCH resource used for URLLC UEs with a single PDCCH transmission.

question_20918.question: What is the maximum number of packet filters supported by the UE for the PDU session?
question_20918.ground_truth: The Maximum number of packet filters supported by the UE for the PDU session is 16, unless specified differently in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message.

question_20919.question: What is the purpose of supporting identifiers in the 5G system for a non-public network (NPN)?
question_20919.ground_truth: The purpose of supporting identifiers in the 5G system for a non-public network is to uniquely identify a non-public network.

question_20922.question: Which methods (in the list provided) apply only to notifications created using createNotification()?
question_20922.ground_truth: The methods changeNotification(), getNotification(), and destroyNotification() do not apply to notifications provisioned in the network and enabled using enableNotifications().

question_20923.question: What do the RAN and the CN do when using the TMSI ranges for CIoT?
question_20923.ground_truth: The RAN routes Signalling messages to the appropriate Core Network and the CN node allocates a TMSI from the correct range to the device.

question_20924.question: What are the potential issues with using existed protocols in AKMA?
question_20924.ground_truth: The potential issues with using existed protocols in AKMA include the need for a specific transport layer protocol and the limited resource of some UEs, especially those used in IoT, which may not be able to implement other protocols required for communication.

question_20925.question: What is the primary advantage of Solution #3.6 compared to Solution #3.5?
question_20925.ground_truth: The primary advantage of Solution #3.6 compared to Solution #3.5 is that pseudonyms could be randomly changed in each session, and even within the same session, different pseudonyms could be used depending on how many participating functions are involved.

question_20926.question: What is the main motivation for the evolution of mobile networks?
question_20926.ground_truth: The main motivation for the evolution of mobile networks is to improve the user experience.

question_20927.question: What is the purpose of the "Length-of-Information-Element" fields in the Short Message?
question_20927.ground_truth: The "Length-of-Information-Element" fields represent the integer representation of the number of octets within its associated "Information-Element-Data" field which follows and shall not include itself in its count value.

question_20929.question: What is the difference between implicit and explicit deregistration procedures?
question_20929.ground_truth: An implicit deregistration procedure is triggered automatically by the network, such as when the implicit deregistration timer expires, while an explicit deregistration procedure is initiated by the network or UDM for specific reasons, such as when providing a reject cause value indicating that the PLMN is not allowed to operate in the present UE location.

question_20930.question: What is the maximum allowable disconnection time for the UAV when switching between C2 communication modes in the 5G system?
question_20930.ground_truth: The maximum allowable disconnection time for the UAV when switching between C2 communication modes in the 5G system is below 10 ms.

question_20931.question: In accordance with TS 23.122, clause 4.4.3.1.1, what order should the MS attempt registration on other PLMN/access technology combinations when selecting a PLMN?
question_20931.ground_truth: The MS attempts registration on other PLMN/access technology combinations in the following order: HPLMN, EHPLMN list, data files in the SIM, PLMN/access technology combinations stored in the ME, PLMNs with received high quality signal, and PLMNs in order of decreasing signal quality. If the MS is in eCall only mode, it shall not consider PLMNs which do not advertise support for eCall over IMS, unless such PLMNs are available in GERAN or UTRAN.

question_20935.question: What events trigger a normal cell reselection for the SoLSA MS when camped on a cell of the selected PLMN?
question_20935.ground_truth: The cell camped on has become barred, there is a better cell in terms of the path loss criterion, or the SoLSA MS needs to select a different cell to fulfill the process goal.

question_20936.question: What is the purpose of the ISCP measurement in the HNB and HUE?
question_20936.ground_truth: The ISCP measurement in the HNB and HUE is used to estimate the interference from neighboring cells in both uplink and downlink. If the ISCP measurement value is larger than a predefined threshold, the HNB can shift to work in another carrier to avoid the strong uplink interference or communicate with the interfering cell to coordinate the interference.

question_20937.question: What message is sent by the relay to the Remote UE upon completion of the NSSAA procedure, indicating success and including the authorized S-NSSAI?
question_20937.ground_truth: A PC5 message (e.g., a PC5 Link Modification Request) that includes a successful NSSAA indication and the authorized S-NSSAI.

question_20938.question: When can the "rTLatencyInd" attribute be included in the provided information?
question_20938.ground_truth: The "rTLatencyInd" attribute can be included in the provided information if the service data flow needs to meet the Round-Trip (RT) latency requirement.

question_20939.question: Which release of the 3GPP specifications first supported broadcast TV services and in what way?
question_20939.ground_truth: Broadcast TV services were first supported by the Rel-9 LTE specification and were further enhanced in Rel-14. They have been supported since Release 9 through the use of enhancements to the Point-to-Multipoint Service (SC-PTM) transmission scheme and Multicast/Broadcast Single Frequency Network (MBSFN) transmission.

question_20941.question: What are the two options for the template in 3GPP Telecommunication management requirements?
question_20941.ground_truth: The two options for the template in 3GPP Telecommunication management requirements are Option 1, which is for all high-level Requirements TSs, and Option 2, which is for Integration Reference Point (IRP) specific Requirements TSs.

question_20943.question: What should the UE do with the derived cell measurement results for applicable cells after performing idle/inactive measurements?
question_20943.ground_truth: The UE should store the derived cell measurement results as indicated by reportQuantities for cells applicable for idle/inactive measurement reporting within measResultsPerCarrierListIdleNR in the measReportIdleNR in VarMeasIdleReport in decreasing order of the cell sorting quantity.

question_20945.question: What is the role of the gPTP compliancy with preserving origin timestamp in 5G?
question_20945.ground_truth: The gPTP compliancy with preserving origin timestamp is significant in conveying the origin time stamp with synchronized time through Uu, allowing the gNB to determine the time in the scale of NR time base when TSN GM time has been equal to the time indicated in the origin timestamp.

question_20946.question: What signalling radio bearers be used for services delivered by both CS and PS service domains, and how are these ciphered?
question_20946.ground_truth: Signalling radio bearers used for services delivered by both CS and PS service domains are ciphered by the CK of the service domain for which the most recent security mode negotiation took place.

question_20947.question: What is the action taken by the MS if the READY timer length is set to zero?
question_20947.ground_truth: If the READY timer length is set to zero, the MS shall immediately be forced into STANDBY state and shall not perform a cell update.

question_20949.question: What is the maximum power allowed for a GSM~900, GSM 400 or T-GSM 810 BSS in the band 1 805 - 1 880 MHz?
question_20949.ground_truth: The maximum power allowed for a GSM~900, GSM 400 or T-GSM 810 BSS in the band 1 805 - 1 880 MHz is -57 dBm.

question_20951.question: What should the MAC entity do if the random access preamble transmission was unsuccessful and the associated PRACH occasions are not available in the next si-RequestPeriod?
question_20951.ground_truth: If the associated PRACH occasions are not available in the next si-RequestPeriod, the MAC entity should determine the next available PRACH occasion from the PRACH occasions corresponding to the selected SSB in the association period given by ra-AssociationPeriodIndex in the next si-RequestPeriod, permitted by the restrictions given by the ra-ssb-OccasionMaskIndex.

question_20952.question: What message does the NSSAAF send if the network slice specific authentication is not required?
question_20952.ground_truth: The NSSAAF sends a Diameter STR message.

question_20953.question: Which functions in UMTS radio access sub network are responsible for managing the allocation and deallocation of Radio Bearers?
question_20953.ground_truth: The function responsible for translating the connection element set-up (or release) requests into physical radio channel allocation (or deallocation) accordingly to the QoS of the Radio Access Bearer is called Allocation and Deallocation of Radio Bearers. This function is located in the CRNC and SRNC. It may be activated during the call since e.g. the user service request may vary, or macro diversity may be used.

question_20954.question: What should the UE do when it receives a 200 (OK) response for the INVITE request for the first final response in one of the early dialogues?
question_20954.ground_truth: The UE should proceed to set up the SIP session using the required radio/bearer resources, and release any unneeded radio/bearer resources.

question_20955.question: What higher layer parameter determines the CFI for non-MBSFN subframes for receiving physical downlink shared channel with slot/subslot duration?
question_20955.ground_truth: The higher layer parameter cfi-SlotSubslotNonMBSFN determines the CFI for non-MBSFN subframes for receiving physical downlink shared channel with slot/subslot duration.

question_20957.question: How can sNBs determine its TA?
question_20957.ground_truth: sNBs would broadcast the TA(s) currently supported by that radio cell in a SIB for each supported radio cell. This would assist a UE in determining its current TA as well as indicating to a UE whether a registration is needed for a change of TA.

question_20958.question: What message does the NG-RAN send to the AMF if the RRCEarlyDataRequest message was received in step~1?
question_20958.ground_truth: The NG-RAN includes "EDT Session" indication in the N2 Initial UE message.

question_20959.question: What are the impacts of using Direct Tunnel on charging in the 3GPP system?
question_20959.ground_truth: When Direct Tunnel is active, volume-based charging can no longer operate using SGSN charging information alone. An inconsistency in data volumes captured by the SGSN and GGSN will arise, and flow-based charging will still work as before.

question_20960.question: What are the frequencies used to determine the level of the unwanted signal for GSM 450, GSM 480, and GSM 900 MS?
question_20960.ground_truth: For GSM 450 MS, the level of the unwanted signal in the band 905 MHz to < 915 MHz is relaxed to 108 dBuVemf( ). For GSM 900 MS, the level of the unwanted signal in the band 905 MHz to < 915 MHz is relaxed to 108 dBuVemf( ). For GSM 450 small MS, the level of the unwanted signal in the band 450,4 MHz to < 457,6 MHz is relaxed to 108 dBuVemf( ). For GSM 480 small MS, the level of the unwanted signal in the band 478,8 MHz to < 486 MHz is relaxed to 108 dBuVemf( ).

question_20964.question: What is the significance of the Hop-by-hop Security Indicator in the UE-to-UE relay security policy/parameters?
question_20964.ground_truth: The Hop-by-hop Security Indicator in the UE-to-UE relay security policy/parameters indicates whether the Source/Target UE requires the hop-by-hop security establishment with the UE-to-UE Relay, or not. It determines the signalling integrity, signalling confidentiality, user plane integrity, and user plane confidentiality in the UE-to-UE relay communication.

question_20965.question: What is the abbreviation for the term MSD in section 7.35?
question_20965.ground_truth: No additional MSD requirement is needed

question_20966.question: What restrictions are ignored during handover evaluation for an active PDU Session associated with emergency service?
question_20966.ground_truth: The source NG-RAN and source AMF ignore any UE related restrictions during handover evaluation for an active PDU Session associated with emergency service.

question_20968.question: What is the definition of an "Information Object Class (IOC)" in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_20968.ground_truth: An Information Object Class (IOC) in the 3GPP Technical Specification is a class of managed object that expresses and controls aspects of the operation of their associated resource.

question_20969.question: How many CDPs can be present in a service usage?
question_20969.ground_truth: There can be one or more CDPs per service usage.

question_20970.question: What is the purpose of the WTAI libraries in creating web services for mobile phones with telephony capabilities?
question_20970.ground_truth: The WTAI libraries are used to access and manipulate the telephony features of mobile phones, such as call control, phonebook access, and network text messaging.

question_20972.question: How many MHz is the channel bandwidth to be tested for each test?

question_20973.question: How does the initiating UE select security algorithms?
question_20973.ground_truth: The initiating UE selects security algorithms in accordance with its UE 5G ProSe direct signalling security policy and the target UE's 5G ProSe direct signalling security policy.

question_20974.question: What should a UE include in a Contact header for an initial registration if the UE supports GRUU and the REGISTER request is integrity protected?
question_20974.ground_truth: The UE shall include the public IP address or FQDN and protected server port value in the hostport parameter and the instance ID of the UE in the +sip.instance parameter. The UE shall also include all supported ICSI values and IARI values in the g.3gpp.icsi-ref and g.3gpp.iari-ref feature tags, respectively.

question_20976.question: What happens when the NSACF receives a request to increase the current number of PDU Session/PDN Connection for a network slice that has reached the maximum number of UEs?
question_20976.ground_truth: Unless operator policy implements a different action, the SMF+PGW-C rejects the PDU Session/PDN connection indicating the cause being the number of UEs in the network slice has been exceeded.

question_20977.question: What is an action that a transmission participant may take upon receiving an indication from the user to request permission to receive media?
question_20977.ground_truth: The transmission participant may display the details of the incoming media to the user.

question_20978.question: What is the purpose of using STI during session establishment in the domain transfer request for the other end C?
question_20978.ground_truth: The purpose of using STI during session establishment in the domain transfer request for the other end C is to identify ME1's public user id relationship when ME1 and ME2 use the same public user id.

question_20979.question: What is the conformance requirement for the MS to establish the timing advance when the Timing Advance IE is included in the HANDOVER COMMAND message?
question_20979.ground_truth: The MS shall access the new cell with the timing advance included in the Timing Advance IE.
