question_21646.ground_truth: The purpose of RTP header compression is to achieve even better bandwidth savings, as the RTP header includes many static fields that remain unchanged during an RTP session, making it possible to compress the header and reduce bandwidth usage.

question_21647.question: What is the maximum allowed measurement reporting delay for UE category 0 in the intra-frequency event triggered reporting test?
question_21647.ground_truth: The maximum allowed measurement reporting delay for UE category 0 in the intra-frequency event triggered reporting test is 1000 ms.

question_21648.question: What is the role of the MC gateway UE server in the GW-local reference point?
question_21648.ground_truth: The MC gateway UE server, in the GW-local reference point, is responsible for authorizing the use of the MC gateway UE, managing forwarding of signalling and media, and notifying about the connection status.

question_21649.question: Which service is responsible for exposing messaging-related capabilities of MSGin5G Service as APIs for the Application Servers?
question_21649.ground_truth: CAPIF (Common API Framework for northbound APIs)

question_21650.question: What is the requirement for LTM cell switch delay for inter-frequency switch?
question_21650.ground_truth: LTM cell switch delay is the delay from the end of the last TTI containing the MAC-CE command for cell switch until the time the UE transmits the first UL message on the target cell. This value is measured in milliseconds.

question_21651.question: What should the UE do if it supports idle/inactive measurements and there are more frequencies to measure or report than it can handle?
question_21651.ground_truth: The UE can prioritize which frequencies to measure or report based on its own implementation.

question_21655.question: What entity is responsible for creating and storing a new registration when an NF service consumer registers the use and monitoring capability of the analytics accuracy of an ML Model in the NWDAF?

question_21658.question: How can user plane data from a user in the IOPS network be protected from interception within the eNB?
question_21658.ground_truth: The eavesdropping of user plane data from a user in the IOPS network can be prevented by controlling signalling and data at the air interface, making sure it is confidentiality protected and integrity protected.

question_21661.question: What is the value of SFN in the gapOffset formula, when gapFR1 is set to setup?
question_21661.ground_truth: The value of SFN in the gapOffset formula is the SFN that meets the condition SFN mod T = FLOOR(gapOffset/10)

question_21662.question: What should the IWF do with the MIP6-Agent-Info AVP within a NOR command if pdn-gw-Identity was not received within the pdn-gw-update parameter within eps-info within UpdateGprsLocationArg?
question_21662.ground_truth: The IWF should not include the MIP6-Agent-Info AVP within a NOR command if pdn-gw-Identity was not received within the pdn-gw-update parameter within eps-info within UpdateGprsLocationArg.

question_21663.question: What is the role of the Immersive Renderer in the 3GPP MPEG-H Audio Operation Point?
question_21663.ground_truth: The Immersive Renderer is optional in the 3GPP MPEG-H Audio Operation Point.

question_21664.question: What is the role of an IWF in the context of MCData?
question_21664.ground_truth: An IWF in MCData can perform the controlling role for the short data service (SDS), implementing procedures such as 3rd party call control, generating SDP offer and SDP answer, registration and service authorization, affiliation, short data service functionality, transmission and reception control functionality, disposition notification functionality, and communication release functionality.

question_21665.question: What are the two separate PC5 links that are necessary for the full security of a UE-to-UE PC5 link in the 5G ProSe network?
question_21665.ground_truth: The two separate PC5 links are the link between the Source UE and UE-to-UE Relay and the link between UE-to-UE Relay and Target UE.

question_21666.question: How many separate PDU Sessions can IAB-node MTs setup for transporting traffic of different types in architecture group 2?
question_21666.ground_truth: IAB-node MTs can setup multiple separate PDU Sessions for transporting traffic of different types in architecture group 2.

question_21667.question: What is the maximum length of the pseudo-random noise (pn) part of the CSS used in the test measurements?
question_21667.ground_truth: It is recommended to use a pn sequence of 32 k samples with a 48 kHz sampling rate.

question_21669.question: What is the function of a Unicast Link Profile in PC5 unicast link establishment?
question_21669.ground_truth: A Unicast Link Profile includes the Application Layer IDs and Layer-2 IDs of both UEs, the network layer protocol used on the PC5 unicast link, and information about PC5 QoS Flow(s). It helps identify the PC5 unicast link and can be updated during secure layer-2 link establishment or modification.

question_21670.question: What is the agreed performance metric used for evaluating the co-existence of V2X UE with higher power and DSRC system with LTE ACLR requirement?
question_21670.ground_truth: Average PRR at 50m for 15 km/h and average PRR at 150m for 60 km/h are used as the agreed performance metric.

question_21671.question: What is the procedure for an immersive AR conversational with two parties using EDGAR UEs including an EDGAR-DCMTSI client in the context of the IMS-AGW/MRF with a support of immersive media processing?
question_21671.ground_truth: The procedure involves establishing a call between the two EDGAR UEs, negotiating the required resources, establishing additional data channels for AR application, and processing the AR immersive media for transmitting and rendering.

question_21675.question: What information is sent to the RNC in the Radio Access Bearer Assignment Request message?
question_21675.ground_truth: The Radio Access Bearer Assignment Request message includes NSAPI, TEID, QoS Profile, SGSN IP Address, UE-AMBR, CSG Membership Indication, MSISDN, APN, Charging characteristics, Correlation ID, and SIPTO Correlation ID.

question_21676.question: What is required by the 5G System to protect SL positioning signaling in groupcast?
question_21676.ground_truth: The 5G System is required to provide confidentiality, integrity, and replay protection of SL positioning signaling in groupcast.

question_21677.question: What is the function of the CES (Cloud-based Edge Support) in the ACR between CAS (Cloud Application Server) and EAS (Edge Application Server)?
question_21677.ground_truth: The CES supports ACR feature parity between CAS and EAS utilizing all EDGEAPP developed features such as AS discovery, AS registration.

question_21679.question: What is a potential security requirement to address the issue of trust domains in 3GPP network functions?
question_21679.ground_truth: Solutions should be implemented to manage (e.g. define, enforce) the security policies for each trust domain independently.

question_21680.question: What does the Distinguished Name (DN) uniquely identify in the context of 3GPP network models?
question_21680.ground_truth: The Distinguished Name (DN) uniquely identifies a managed object instance within a specific name space in 3GPP network models.

question_21681.question: What information does the AF provide in the AFsessionWithQoS request?
question_21681.ground_truth: The AF provides a group of flow descriptions, QoS references, and UE addresses, as well as the multi-modal service provider ID and multi-modal data flows group ID in the AFrequest message.

question_21684.question: What is the length of the coded in-band signalling bit sequence (NcINBAND)?
question_21684.ground_truth: The length of the coded in-band signalling bit sequence is equal to the size of the coded uplink TFCI.

question_21685.question: What is the effect when the CN includes the RABs To Be Released List IE in the ENHANCED RELOCATION COMPLETE RESPONSE message?
question_21685.ground_truth: The RNC shall release the resource for the RABs and consider the RABs indicated in the RABs To Be Released List IE as being fully released.

question_21686.question: What message should the UE send when it is sending a registration request after an inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode in 5GMM-IDLE mode and has a valid 5G NAS security context and needs to send non-cleartext IEs?
question_21686.ground_truth: The UE should include the NAS message container IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

question_21687.question: What action does the ECS take if the service consumer is not authorized to retrieve the target Enabler Server information in the provided scenario?
question_21687.ground_truth: The ECS will take proper error handling actions, as specified in clause 9.2.6, and respond to the service consumer with an appropriate error status code.

question_21688.question: What is the primary purpose of Network Slice Information delivery in 9.17?
question_21688.ground_truth: The Network Slice Information delivery is used for the VAL server to manage the network slice for their service such as preparation, creation, activation and termination (tear-down) of network slice.

question_21690.question: What is required for off-network video capability information sharing?
question_21690.ground_truth: Off-network video capability information sharing is based on ProSe capabilities, and each MCVideo client within a MCVideo group needs to share its video capabilities with other members of the MCVideo group by sending information periodically or on request, and the receiving MCVideo clients need to store and update the video capability information from the sharing MCVideo client.

question_21691.question: In which conditions is a User Equipment (UE) required to leverage the corresponding credentials for S-NSSAIs subject to Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization (NSSAA) in 5G System?
question_21691.ground_truth: A UE is required to use the corresponding credentials in the Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization if the UE supports this feature and requests S-NSSAIs that are subject to Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization.

question_21692.question: What is one of the methods used for coding short TFCIs in the 3.84 Mcps TDD option?
question_21692.ground_truth: One of the methods used for coding short TFCIs in the 3.84 Mcps TDD option is using bi-orthogonal codes, where the TFCI is encoded using a (16, 5) bi-orthogonal (or first order Reed-Muller) code. If the TFCI consists of less than 5 bits, it is padded with zeros to 5 bits, by setting the most significant bits to zero. The code words of the (16,5) bi-orthogonal code are linear combinations of 5 basis sequences.

question_21693.question: When an LPP message requesting at least one location method not supported is received by a UE, what should the UE provide in its response?
question_21693.ground_truth: The UE should provide location information for the supported methods in its response.

question_21696.question: What should the MCData client 2 do if the payload is for MCData user consumption?
question_21696.ground_truth: The MCData user of MCData client 2 may be notified if the payload is for MCData user consumption. Otherwise, if the payload is not for MCData user consumption, then the MCData user of MCData client 2 shall not be notified.

question_21697.question: Which component is responsible for the provisioning of data collection and reporting features in the 5G Media Streaming architecture?
question_21697.ground_truth: M1, or provisioning of data collection and reporting features in the Data Collection AF, is responsible for this.

question_21698.question: What action does the MME take when it receives a request for CS paging from an MSC/VLR for an IMSI unknown by the MME?
question_21698.ground_truth: If the "MME-Reset" indicator is set to "true", the MME sends the paging request with the location information provided by the VLR. If the indicator is set to "false" and the IMSI is unknown or the UE is marked as EMM-DEREGISTERED, the paging request is rejected.

question_21701.question: When the MCPTT client receives a SIP MESSAGE request with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-affiliation-command+xml MIME body and a list of MCPTT groups for affiliation and de-affiliation, what must it send in response if the user accepts the request?
question_21701.ground_truth: A 200 (OK) response to the SIP MESSAGE request, along with confirmation of the accepted list of MCPTT groups for affiliation and de-affiliation.

question_21706.question: Who sends the SCCP CONNECTION CONFIRM message in a successful SCCP connection establishment?
question_21706.ground_truth: The RNC sends the SCCP CONNECTION CONFIRM message in a successful SCCP connection establishment.

question_21707.question: What does the pre-established broadcast MBS session enable the MC service user to do?
question_21707.ground_truth: The pre-established broadcast MBS session enables the MC service user to transfer downlink data.

question_21708.question: What is the conformance requirement for the Receiving Loudness Rating (RLR)?
question_21708.ground_truth: The Receiving Loudness Rating (RLR) shall be within the limits specified in 3GPP TS 26.131, subclause 5.2.2.

question_21709.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message with 5GSM cause value #69 "insufficient resources for specific slice" and Back-off timer value set to zero, for a UE-requested PDU session with a specific S-NSSAI?
question_21709.ground_truth: The UE could send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for the same S-NSSAI.

question_21710.question: How should an AIPN address the evolution of next-generation radio access systems and the progress of broadband wireless IP-based networks?
question_21710.ground_truth: An AIPN should consider the capability of next-generation radio access systems to provide significantly higher data rates to the user and allow for multiple radio access systems optimized for specific user requirements, as well as easing inter-working with various broadband wireless IP-based networks.

question_21711.question: What parameter does the BM-SC use to signal the duration of an interval for randomly deferring initiation procedures?
question_21711.ground_truth: The `randomTimePeriod` parameter is used by the BM-SC to signal the duration of an interval for randomly deferring initiation procedures.

question_21712.question: What is the purpose of storing Classmark information by MSC-B?
question_21712.ground_truth: The purpose of storing Classmark information by MSC-B is to use the information at internal handover in MSC-B.

question_21713.question: What is the purpose of the Maximum Time Offset in the overload control procedure?
question_21713.ground_truth: The Maximum Time Offset is used to avoid a large number of UEs causing excessive signalling load on the network when leaving or re-gaining coverage.

question_21715.question: Which standard specifies the NAS protocol for Evolved Packet System (EPS) in 3GPP Release 14?

question_21716.question: What exception is thrown if dataOffset is less than 0 in CRRP4?

question_21718.question: What should the transmitting PDCP entity do when it generates an EHC feedback packet?
question_21718.ground_truth: It should submit to lower layers the corresponding PDCP Control PDU without associating a PDCP SN or performing ciphering.

question_21719.question: What is the procedure to initiate an IPv4 address Delete Procedure in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_21719.ground_truth: The PDN GW initiates the Gateway Control Session Modification Procedure with the PCRF, with the PDN GW providing information to enable the PCRF to uniquely identify the IP CAN session.

question_21720.question: What type of document is the 3GPP Technical Specification for E-UTRAN M1 data transport (Release 17) in terms of 3GPP's internal document versioning system?
question_21720.ground_truth: A TSG approved document under change control (greater than or equal to 3.x.z)

question_21721.question: What is the test procedure to confirm that the MS reports appropriate results when given information about neighboring cells?
question_21721.ground_truth: In a test with a call in progress, the SS sends SYSTEM INFORMATION TYPE 5 and 6 (with additional SYSTEM INFORMATION TYPE 5bis on the second iteration). The SS then indicates all 8 BCCHs "on air" in the BA, and the MS shall send MEASUREMENT REPORTs back with measurement results for the 6 strongest carriers within 20 seconds.

question_21722.question: What is the role of the MExE QoS manager in relation to the network specific QoS control?
question_21722.ground_truth: The MExE QoS manager can access the network specific QoS control through the network control API, and it can also perform some QoS control even if it is not provided in the network control.

question_21723.question: What is the special value that the UE shall set the Request-URI to if the upper layers request establishment of an IMS emergency call of the automatically initiated eCall type of emergency service or of the manually initiated eCall type of emergency service?
question_21723.ground_truth: The UE shall set the Request-URI to "urn:service:sos.ecall.automatic" or "urn:service:sos.ecall.manual"

question_21725.question: What is the type of the "id-Source-To-Target-TransparentContainer" IE?
question_21725.ground_truth: The type of the "id-Source-To-Target-TransparentContainer" IE is Source-To-Target-TransparentContainer.

question_21727.question: What is the role of PSS with fast content switching (Release 7) in improving user experience?
question_21727.ground_truth: PSS with fast content switching (Release 7) improves user experience by reducing the client/server interactions to a minimum, allowing faster start up and switching of content for both on-demand and live applications.

question_21729.question: What is a Managed Object (MO) in the context of 3GPP Telecommunication Management?
question_21729.ground_truth: A Managed Object (MO) is an abstract entity that represents a Network Resource (NR) in a 3GPP network for the purpose of management. It is an instance of a Managed Object Class (MOC) as defined in a Management Information Model (MIM).

question_21730.question: What is the difference between automatic release and retention of PDU sessions based on timing information?
question_21730.ground_truth: Automatic release of PDU sessions occurs when the respective network slices have an end of life timing information, while retention and restoration occur when the network slices have periodic timing information.

question_21731.question: What is the procedure for T-ADS for IMS voice in the 5G system?
question_21731.ground_truth: The SCC AS initiates T-ADS query towards UDM via Sh interface. The UDM queries T-ADS information towards HSS FE to get T-ADS information related to EPS and UMTS. After receiving response of T-ADS query from HSS FE, UDM responds T-ADS query to SCC AS based on the T-ADS information received from HSS FE and T-ADS information in UDM.

question_21732.question: Which technology is becoming available but is more expensive and has an example of filter traces at ambient temperature given in the 5.2.3.2 clause?
question_21732.ground_truth: FBAR/BAW (Film Bulk Acoustic Wave/Thickness Extensional Mode Acoustic Wave) technology.

question_21733.question: What are the three interfaces that the Generic User Interaction SCF consists of?
question_21733.ground_truth: The Generic User Interaction SCF consists of three interfaces: the User Interaction Manager, the Generic User Interaction, and the Call User Interaction interfaces.

question_21734.question: What must the Access Server (AS) include in a re-INVITE request when initiating third-party call control procedures?
question_21734.ground_truth: The AS must include a P-Asserted-ID header field with a valid identity of the REFER target and a Referred-by header field matching the P-Asserted-Identity of the REFER request in the re-INVITE request when initiating third-party call control procedures. The AS must also include a P-Served-User header field including a valid identity of the referor and Privacy header fields if the P-Asserted-Identity is included in the re-INVITE request.

question_21736.question: What does the TSCTSF do after successful authorization to create a time synchronization service for a UE in an Area of Interest?
question_21736.ground_truth: The TSCTSF creates a PTP port in a DS-TT and assigns it into the PTP instance and adds the DS-TT PTP port to the PTP instance again if the UE moves into an Area of Interest.

question_21737.question: What is returned after the findAndCopyValue method is successful and copies the value into the destination buffer?
question_21737.ground_truth: dstOffset + length of the copied value

question_21738.question: What are the responsibilities of the "c-ID" element in the "RadioLinkAdditionResponseFDD" sequence in NBAP?
question_21738.ground_truth: The "c-ID" element in the "RadioLinkAdditionResponseFDD" sequence identifies the communication context of the CRNC.

question_21739.question: Which function transports charging information for online charging?

question_21740.question: What are the three limits used to calculate the minimum range length for NR FR1 RTS MIMO systems with a 20cm test zone size?
question_21740.ground_truth: The three limits used to calculate the minimum range length for NR FR1 RTS MIMO systems with a 20cm test zone size are the phase uncertainty limit, the amplitude uncertainty limit, and the reactive Near-Field limit.

question_21741.question: What message does the RNC send to the CN when it decides to perform a direct retry in handover from UMTS to GSM?
question_21741.ground_truth: RANAP message Relocation Required with cause value "Directed Retry"

question_21742.question: How does a UE determine the referenceSignal value in PUCCH-PathlossReferenceRS when only one set of power control parameters is provided?
question_21742.ground_truth: The UE obtains the referenceSignal value in PUCCH-PathlossReferenceRS from the pucch-PathlossReferenceRS-Id with index 0.

question_21743.question: What happens if a called endpoint recognizes the new field but does not support the mode specified in the new field?
question_21743.ground_truth: If a called endpoint recognizes the new field but does not support the mode specified in the new field, it will ignore it and will not return it, resulting in the usage of regular SDES.

question_21744.question: What condition must be met in order for a UE to decrease the coverage area when two or more interfering signals exist which have a specific frequency relationship to the wanted signal?
question_21744.ground_truth: The UE must be unable to meet the throughput requirement under ideal propagation conditions.

question_21746.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) and what is the purpose of its Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects (TSG-SS)?
question_21746.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) is an international organization responsible for the development of technical specifications for mobile communication systems. The Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects (TSG-SS) is a part of 3GPP responsible for defining the telecommunication management and network resource models for 3GPP systems.

question_21747.question: What is the optional parameter being referred to in NOTE 1?
question_21747.ground_truth: The optional parameter being referred to in NOTE 1 is the support and inclusion of the parameters within Load Control Information, specific to APN level load control feature.

question_21749.question: In the context of Rel-17 eType-II port selection codebook, what is the aspect that is shifted toward the gNB to reduce UE computational burden by exploiting angle-delay reciprocity?
question_21749.ground_truth: Spatial domain and frequency domain compression operation are shifted toward the gNB to reduce UE computational burden by exploiting angle-delay reciprocity in DL and UL which is applicable for both TDD and FDD.

question_21750.question: What is the procedure for defining new performance measurements and their addition to the present document?
question_21750.ground_truth: New performance measurements can be defined through the methodology discussed in Annex B of TS 32.404, and submitted for potential adoption and inclusion in the document based on the end-user's needs and potential suitability for multi-vendor network compatibility.

question_21751.question: What is measured to determine the pass or fail decision for throughput tests?
question_21751.ground_truth: The number of NACK, ACK, and statDTX on the UL HS-DPCCH during the test interval are counted to decide pass or fail for the throughput tests.

question_21752.question: What are the advantages of using the Ambient IoT device with the wireless sensors in the pig farm for daily monitoring?
question_21752.ground_truth: The thin and lightweight tags result in increased livestock welfare and reduced asset damage, and the temperature data analysis helps to identify early signs of ailment, increasing pig farm production. The efficient 5G-enabled Ambient IoT communication allows for daily monitoring every 15 minutes without energy drain leading to replacement or manual recharging.

question_21753.question: What happens when the number of information bits in format 6-0A mapped onto a given search space is less than the payload size of format 0 mapped onto the same search space?
question_21753.ground_truth: Zeros are appended to format 6-0A until the payload size equals that of format 0 including any padding bits appended to format 0. If format 6-0A is scrambled by PUR-RNTI and Resource block assignment is set to all ones, additional fields are present, otherwise, additional fields are set to zero.

question_21755.question: What is one consequence of a non-ideal fronthaul in the context of the CU-DU split?
question_21755.ground_truth: It might impact performances in case of non-ideal fronthaul and short TTI due to scheduling decision delays between CU and DU.

question_21756.question: What is the purpose of sending the IWF emergency alert cancel request with an indication to cancel the in-progress emergency state on the group?
question_21756.ground_truth: The purpose of sending the IWF emergency alert cancel request with an indication to cancel the in-progress emergency state on the group is to request the cancellation of the ongoing emergency condition.

question_21759.question: What is one high-level principle that guides the evolution of the Evolved 3GPP System's architecture?
question_21759.ground_truth: The architecture should provide scalable system architecture and solutions without compromising system capacity, by separating the control plane and the transport plane.

question_21761.question: What is the definition of intermodulation rejection in the context of this test?
question_21761.ground_truth: Intermodulation rejection is a measure of the capability of the receiver to receive a wanted modulated signal without exceeding a given degradation due to the presence of two or more unwanted signals with a specific frequency relationship to the wanted signal frequency.

question_21762.question: What is the primary focus of the report regarding Virtual Reality in the context of 3GPP?
question_21762.ground_truth: The primary focus of the report is on 360 degrees video and associated audio, which support three degrees of freedom (3DOF).

question_21764.question: What elements are required in a `<session-oriented-service-trigger-info>` element?
question_21764.ground_truth: A `<session-oriented-service-trigger-info>` element must include `<V2X-UE-id>`, `<V2X-service-id>`, `<V2X-application-specific-server-id-info>`, `<session-id>`, `<V2X-application-QoS-requirements>`, and `<acknowledgement>` elements.

question_21765.question: What does the TimeOfDay node in an ISMP rule specify?
question_21765.ground_truth: The TimeOfDay node in an ISMP rule specifies the time of day condition for the rule. The validity condition of TimeOfDay is considered fulfilled when the time of day in the current time zone, as indicated by the UE, matches at least one time interval indicated in the TimeOfDay node.

question_21766.question: What is the abbreviation "UTRAN" an acronym for in the context of 3GPP?
question_21766.ground_truth: UTRAN stands for Universal Terrestrial Radio Access Network.

question_21768.question: What is the test applicability for this test case?
question_21768.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR UE release 15 onwards.

question_21769.question: What is the main difference between Solution #6 "MPQUIC-LL Steering Functionality" and Solution #6.2.1 "Support non-3GPP access leg of MA-PDU Session with PDN connection in EPC" in TR~23.700-93?
question_21769.ground_truth: The main difference is that Solution #6 uses MP-QUIC, while Solution #6.2.1 uses non-3GPP access leg of a PDN connection in EPC.

question_21770.question: What are the cleartext IEs in a REGISTRATION REQUEST message?
question_21770.ground_truth: The cleartext IEs in a REGISTRATION REQUEST message are Extended protocol discriminator, Security header type, Spare half octet, Registration request message identity, 5GS registration type, ngKSI, 5GS mobile identity, UE security capability, Additional GUTI, UE status, EPS NAS message container, NID, and PLMN with disaster condition.

question_21771.question: What action does the DS-TT take if it is capable of acting as a (g)PTP GM?
question_21771.ground_truth: If the DS-TT is capable of acting as a (g)PTP GM and has received the appropriate parameters and instructions from the NEF or TSN AF through PMIC, it will generate (g)PTP Sync, Follow_Up, and Announce messages to devices attached to the UE. If the DS-TT is already active as a grandmaster, it will generate Announce messages to the Master port in the DS-TT and forward the Announce messages to the NW-TT for BMCA execution. If a better Announce message is received or a Sync or Announce receipt timeout is detected, the TSN AF may activate or deactivate the GM in DS-TT(s).

question_21772.question: What provides the SMF with the DL Tunnel Info of the new UL CL/Branching Point for the downlink traffic?
question_21772.ground_truth: The DL Tunnel Info of the new UL CL/Branching Point is provided to the SMF from the PSA0.

question_21775.question: What additional requirements does SAV address, besides the ones addressed by AuV?
question_21775.ground_truth: SAV addresses requirement 23, which involves local management interface access and authentication for the H(e)NB owner.

question_21777.question: How long does TTI insertion uncertainty last?
question_21777.ground_truth: TTI insertion uncertainty lasts for 2 ms.

question_21779.question: What is the state transition model for CFU?
question_21779.ground_truth: The state transition model for CFU shows the successful cases of transition between the applicable logical states of CFU, which are caused by actions of the service provider, the mobile user, or the network.

question_21780.question: How does the Hosting SCC AS determine whether to relay or execute service requests for the Collaborative Session?
question_21780.ground_truth: The Hosting SCC AS includes a piece of service interaction information in the SIP signalling messages sent to other SCC-ASs, indicating that the Service Feature "Collaborative Session" has been performed. When an SCC AS receives a SIP message containing such indication, it shall relay all service requests associated with the Collaborative Session towards the Hosting SCC AS.

question_21781.question: What is used by the NG-RAN node during handover to determine the target cell based on the list of CAG IDs supported by neighbor CAG cells?
question_21781.ground_truth: The source NG-RAN node determines a target cell among the candidates which is compatible with the received PNI-NPN restrictions.

question_21782.question: What is the unit of the "CLBSB-Rep" value in the calculations?
question_21782.ground_truth: The unit of the "CLBSB-Rep" value in the calculations is decibels (dB).

question_21783.question: Who is responsible for providing the security materials for the UE-to-UE PC5 link in the 5G ProSe network?
question_21783.ground_truth: The security materials for the UE-to-UE PC5 link in the 5G ProSe network are provided by the network after passing the authorization check.

question_21786.question: What is the purpose of the Random Access procedure in 3GPP 5G technology?
question_21786.ground_truth: The random access procedure is used in 3GPP 5G technology to establish uplink time synchronization, convey a UE's request for Other SI, or recover from beam failure.

question_21787.question: What are the two methods for registering a callback reference in setting the callback reference?
question_21787.ground_truth: The two methods for registering a callback reference are using the `enableCallNotification()` method with an explicit immediate registration, or explicitly with a separate `setCallback()` method.

question_21789.question: What event does the ME need to inform the UICC about, as defined in the 3GPP TS 31.111 clause 4.7 and 5.2?

question_21790.question: What should the SGSN do after releasing the Iu when the MS has no active PDP context?
question_21790.ground_truth: The SGSN should take the responsibility to release the Iu interface either immediately or after some timeout.

question_21791.question: What is the recommended action to prevent BS receiver desensitization when Band (1 + 3 + 8) BS transmitter and Band 28 or 44 BS receiver share the same antenna?
question_21791.ground_truth: Band (1 + 3 + 8) BS transmitter should not share the same antenna with Band 28 or 44 BS receiver to prevent BS receiver desensitization, unless the antenna path meets very stringent 3rd order PIM specification.

question_21792.question: What is the name of the message that the MME/SGSN sends to the RAN nodes, indicating a type or group of MTC access to be barred, in case of an overload situation?

question_21793.question: What is the purpose of the test defined in clause 5.9AA.3?
question_21793.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the power of UE emission for UL OLTD does not exceed the prescribed limits even in the presence of the HS-DPCCH.

question_21794.question: Which standard provides the requirements for AT command set for User Equipment (UE) in 3GPP?

question_21795.question: What is the role of the KDF in the solution described in clause 6.32.2?
question_21795.ground_truth: The KDF is used to generate verification information by taking the IP address and the SUPI as inputs in the solution described in clause 6.32.2.

question_21796.question: What system entity is capable of determining the dynamical satellite backhaul in use and sending the satellite backhaul indication to the SMF?
question_21796.ground_truth: The AMF (Access and Mobility Management Function) has this capability.

question_21797.question: What is the maximum overall delay for a UE supporting power class 1 in the test, and when does the UE need to report the event within that delay?
question_21797.ground_truth: The maximum overall delay for a UE supporting power class 1 is 51202 ms. The UE needs to report the event within that delay from the beginning of time period T2.

question_21799.question: What is a U2N Relay UE in the context of the 5G System?
question_21799.ground_truth: A U2N Relay UE is a UE that provides functionality to support connectivity to the network for U2N Remote UEs.

question_21801.question: How is the sleep ratio per slot basis and per symbol basis calculated for NR satellite access network?
question_21801.ground_truth: The sleep ratio per slot basis is given by equation (4.8.2.2-1) in the document, while the sleep ratio per symbol basis is given by equation (4.8.2.2-2) in the document.

question_21802.question: What is the format of the eKSI parameter and what does it contain?
question_21802.ground_truth: The eKSI parameter contains a format which allows a recipient of such a parameter to distinguish whether the parameter is of type 'KSIASME' or of type 'KSIGSN', and a value field. The value fields of KSIASME and KSIGSN are three bits each, with seven values used to identify the key set.

question_21803.question: What is the role of the NAS signalling in IP address allocation for PDU sessions in 5GCN?
question_21803.ground_truth: The NAS signalling is used by the UE to request IP connectivity and set the PDU session type, based on its IP stack capabilities.

question_21804.question: What information flow is shared from the MC gateway UE to the MC client on a non-3GPP device for the MC GW MBMS listening status report?
question_21804.ground_truth: MC GW MBMS listening status report

question_21805.question: What information is retrieved by the NRM server for each member in a group identified by the VAL group ID for end-to-end QoS management?
question_21805.ground_truth: The NRM server retrieves VAL-UE associated information for each member in the group, which includes information from the 5GC (e.g. NEF Monitoring Events, QoS sustainability analytics) or SEAL LMS (on-demand location reporting).

question_21807.question: What should a UE do upon returning in coverage after being out of coverage due to discontinuous coverage?
question_21807.ground_truth: The UE sets the discontinuous coverage maximum time offset value to a random value up to and including the stored discontinuous coverage maximum time offset for this PLMN and satellite E-UTRAN access and starts this timer. The UE shall not initiate any NAS signalling on that satellite E-UTRAN access and PLMN combination while the discontinuous coverage maximum time offset timer is running.

question_21808.question: What should the originator of an HTTP error response include in the HTTP error response to enable an HTTP client to determine the originator of the error?
question_21808.ground_truth: The originator of an error should include a Server header in the HTTP error response with the type and identity of the NF or network entity generating the error, such as "SCP", "SEPP", or "SMF", and the FQDN of the SCP or SEPP, or the NF Instance ID of the HTTP server.

question_21809.question: What is one of the potential service requirements for Mobility on Demand in the 3GPP system?
question_21809.ground_truth: One potential service requirement for Mobility on Demand is the 3GPP system shall enable operators to define different levels of mobility support for different UEs, which includes minimizing packet loss during inter- and/or intra-RAT cell changes, maintaining the same IP address assigned to a UE across different cells, and minimizing interruption time.

question_21810.question: In the context of traffic flow simulation and situation awareness, what do virtual objects interact with?
question_21810.ground_truth: Virtual objects can interact with each other within the virtual world and also interact with physical objects via the 5G system. This includes delivering real-time status data to digital twin objects (physical to virtual) and sending alerts or other information to physical objects (virtual to physical).

question_21811.question: What is the synchronization mechanism used by the A/R application to ensure correct recombination of images from the laparoscope and the ultra-sound probe?
question_21811.ground_truth: Medical images are synchronized together thanks to local clocks stabilized on the grand master clock with a very tight accuracy to ensure correct recombination of the two data streams in a single and accurate A/R image by the A/R application.

question_21814.question: What is the main goal of the XR conference system?
question_21814.ground_truth: The main goal of the XR conference system is to provide an immersive telepresence experience for physically co-located and remote participants using XR technology in a shared conference space.

question_21816.question: Under what conditions will the 5G PKMF accept the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay discovery security material request procedure?
question_21816.ground_truth: The 5G PKMF will accept the procedure if the UE requests the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay discovery security material for 5G ProSe end UE over a TLS tunnel established by a UE authorized to act as a 5G ProSe end UE, or if the UE requests the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay discovery security material for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE over a TLS tunnel established by a UE authorized to act as a 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE, or if the UE requests the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay discovery security material for both 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE and 5G ProSe end UE over a TLS tunnel established by a UE authorized to act as a 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE and a 5G ProSe end UE.

question_21817.question: What are the minimum test time requirements given in subclause 14.11.2.2.5 for a single error rate test?
question_21817.ground_truth: Wrong decision probability per test step, D = 0.000085, bad DUT factor, M = 1.5, number of (error) events, ne, and the number of samples, ns, are parameters for limit lines. The minimum test time due to fading should be considered before limit checking is valid.

question_21818.question: What procedure is used to deactivate all the dedicated channels in use for an RR connection?
question_21818.ground_truth: The channel release procedure is used to deactivate all the dedicated channels in use for an RR connection.

question_21819.question: What is the purpose of the Recommended rate in the context of network assistance for DASH clients?
question_21819.ground_truth: The Recommended rate is a suggested video payload rate that the network provides to the client to assist in making better adaptation decisions, based on estimates of both radio link and transport link rates, radio quality, and network policies.

question_21820.question: What is the abbreviation for "Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP" in the context of the present document?

question_21821.question: What is the role of Element Management Layer (EML) in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_21821.ground_truth: The EML manages each Network Element on an individual or group basis and supports an abstraction of the functions provided by the Network Element Layer (NEL). It interacts with other OSFs in the same or other layers within the same TMN through a q reference point and in other TMNs through an x reference point.

question_21823.question: What is the formula for computing the "Tracking Area Update Success Rate" KPI?
question_21823.ground_truth: The "Tracking Area Update Success Rate" KPI is calculated by taking the ratio of the number of successfully performed tracking area update procedures to the number of attempted tracking area update procedures. It is obtained by successful tracking area update procedures divided by attempted tracking area update procedures.

question_21824.question: What is the maximum allowed Tprocessing value when source and target cells are in different FRs?
question_21824.ground_truth: The maximum allowed Tprocessing value is 40 ms when source and target cells are in different FRs.

question_21826.question: What provides information of a given IP interface of a UPF?

question_21827.question: What is the main difference between Solution 6 and Solution 7 in terms of sending user privacy setting?
question_21827.ground_truth: In Solution 6, the user privacy setting is sent via AMF, while in Solution 7, it is sent via LMF using a protocol called "UE-LMF."

question_21828.question: What is the purpose of synchronizing operations in CAP protocol?
question_21828.ground_truth: The purpose of synchronizing operations is to avoid complicated fall-back procedures when introducing major functional changes in the protocol. This synchronization takes place before the new function is invoked in either application entity.

question_21829.question: What is the function of the Network Instance in enabling multiple network slice sharing in 5G networks?
question_21829.ground_truth: The Network Instance is used for traffic detection and routing as required by network slice.

question_21830.question: What is the purpose of identity keying in MCPTT?
question_21830.ground_truth: Identity keying is used to support key distribution for application signalling, floor control, and media. It verifies user identities and removes users that are no longer part of the MCPTT domain.

question_21831.question: What is the criticality level of "id-securityinformation" in the "BearerContextSetupRequest"?
question_21831.ground_truth: The criticality level of "id-securityinformation" in the "BearerContextSetupRequest" is "reject".

question_21833.question: What is one of the main features of the delivery protocol that provides efficient and reliable support for object flows with timing real-time properties?
question_21833.ground_truth: The delivery of static information a priori in a reliable information, bundling of dynamic information with the media object, and enabling the support of timing information to the delivery.

question_21834.question: What is the assumed data rate for each mobile in all scenarios provided in the illustration?
question_21834.ground_truth: Both mobiles are assumed to be sending variable rate encoded video data at 15 frames per second (60 ms rate) in all scenarios.

question_21836.question: What is the minimum channel raster for NR?
question_21836.ground_truth: The minimum channel raster for NR is specified in Clause 5.4.2 of TS 38.104.

question_21838.question: Which protocol extension is used to indicate the assisted GANSS data required in a Position Periodic Report?

question_21839.question: What state does the MSC-1 Server instruct MGW-1 to set the Handover Device after releasing the A-interface line towards BSS-1?
question_21839.ground_truth: The MSC-1 Server instructs MGW-1 to set the Handover Device to its final state by removing the bearer termination towards the BSS-1.

question_21840.question: What message does the SS send to the MS to establish single carrier operation on the uplink side, specifically on carrier 1?
question_21840.ground_truth: A PACKET UPLINK ASSIGNMENT message with assignment type single carrier assignment is sent to the MS to establish single carrier operation on the uplink side, specifically on carrier 1.

question_21841.question: What is the main difference between the direct network connection and indirect network connection described in section 5.1.5?
question_21841.ground_truth: The main difference is that the direct network connection allows the UE to connect to the network directly, while the indirect network connection connects using another UE as a relay UE. Additionally, the 5G system should maintain service continuity of indirect network connection when the communication path to the network changes.

question_21843.question: What are the two possible solutions provided for the performance indicator selection for ML model training?
question_21843.ground_truth: The two possible solutions are: (1) using the IOC (Information Object Class) named MLTrainingCapability, which contains the inference type and supported performance metrics, and (2) using the IOC MLTrainingRequest with the existing performanceRequirements attribute extended to indicate the MnS consumer selected performance indicator/metric.

question_21844.question: What should the UE do if the AMF indicates the need for the UE to perform a Registration procedure immediately?
question_21844.ground_truth: The UE initiates a Registration procedure with the registration type Mobility Registration Update after the UE enters CM-IDLE state, including the Requested NSSAI and the UE's received rejected S-NSSAIs in the Registration Request message.

question_21845.question: What is the role of the NEF in releasing resources for the MBS session?
question_21845.ground_truth: The NEF requests the MB-SMF to delete resources for the MBS session, and then the MB-SMF requests the MB-UPF to release user plane resources. The NEF responds to the AF once these steps are completed.

question_21847.question: Which two frequency ranges are specified for the minimum requirements of the 20 MHz bandwidth for Band 71?
question_21847.ground_truth: The two frequency ranges are 673-678 MHz and 683-688 MHz.

question_21848.question: Which message is used to inform the network about a failure detected by the UE?

question_21849.question: What is the frequency range supported by the channel models in the scenarios described?
question_21849.ground_truth: The channel models support a frequency range from 0.5 GHz up to 100 GHz, with a focus on the frequency bands below 6 GHz and the Ka bands.

question_21851.question: In the urban microcell environment, how are the multipath delays randomly associated with AoDs?
question_21851.ground_truth: In the urban microcell environment, the multipath delays are randomly associated with AoDs using a random process. This association is done so that the phases defined for each sub-path are maintained.

question_21853.question: What is the role of the N3IWF in the 5G system?
question_21853.ground_truth: The N3IWF (Non-3GPP Interface Wrapper Function) is responsible for the communication between the AMF and the non-3GPP access networks.

question_21854.question: What are the pre-conditions for the mobile metaverse use case?
question_21854.ground_truth: The pre-conditions for the mobile metaverse use case are that the necessary computing resources, such as game development libraries and rendering tools, are provided on the cloud or edge server. Additionally, 5GS must be capable of transporting uplink/downlink service data and the VR/AR/MR/Cloud Gaming mobile devices must be connected to the cloud or edge server.

question_21855.question: When does the SS activate SCC during SCell activation?
question_21855.ground_truth: The SS activates SCC by sending the activation MAC-CE in a subframe (m+5) during SCell activation.

question_21856.question: What should be done with all L3-enabled processes when they are deactivated?
question_21856.ground_truth: They become inactive, regardless of whether they were active or inactive before deactivation.

question_21857.question: What should the MME do if it needs to reject incoming PRA requests from PCRFs or OCS?
question_21857.ground_truth: The MME should respond back with an indication for each accepted PRA ID and an indication per PRA ID for the ones that were rejected.

question_21859.question: In step 2a of the Routing Area Update procedure, what information about the old P-TMSI does the UE indicate in the RAU Request message?
question_21859.ground_truth: The UE indicates the old P-TMSI, the corresponding RAI, and the related KSI in the RAU Request message.

question_21861.question: What should the LLE do if timer T200 expires before receiving a UA or DM response in the test procedure?
question_21861.ground_truth: The LLE should retransmit the SABM command, set timer T200, and increment the retransmission counter.

question_21862.question: How does the SMLC determine the MS location using the information received from the BSS?
question_21862.ground_truth: The SMLC collects and validates all Multilateration Timing Advance, BTS Reception Accuracy Level, MS Sync Accuracy, and Cell Identifier information associated with a given MS for up to the length of the Multilateration Positioning Method timer after triggering the Multilateration Timing Advance procedure, using the provided Random ID or Short ID value. The SMLC then determines the MS location using validated information.

question_21863.question: What is the condition for the test defined in section 9.1.32.5 to pass?
question_21863.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values in each test must be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_21866.question: How does the use of A-MPR differ in intra-band contiguous CA between single carrier and multi-cluster transmission?
question_21866.ground_truth: For single carrier, A-MPR is used alone for intra-band contiguous CA if NS value is signaled, while for multi-cluster transmission in intra-band contiguous CA, further discussion is needed to define MPR formula for all modulation schemes.

question_21869.question: What is the purpose of the PositioningMeasurementUpdate message?
question_21869.ground_truth: The PositioningMeasurementUpdate message is used to update the positioning information of a specific measurement. It contains a ProtocolIE-Container, which includes a set of ProtocolIE-SingleContainer elements, each with a specific ID, Criticality, Type, Presence, and optional Additional Information.

question_21870.question: What is the main drawback of the network based SMS payload filtering solution?
question_21870.ground_truth: The main drawback of the network based SMS payload filtering solution is that the network node has to inspect all received SMSs based on TP Protocol ID, which will increase network processing load.

question_21872.question: What action should an IWF take if the MCPTT group for a served MCPTT group ID does not exist?
question_21872.ground_truth: The IWF should reject the SIP PUBLISH request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response.

question_21875.question: What does the MSGin5G Server do upon receiving a group message request from the Application Server?
question_21875.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server resolves the group ID to determine the members of the group based on the information from the group management server.

question_21876.question: Which type is specified for the "RPAUID" element in the "RestrictedDiscReq-info" complex type?
question_21876.ground_truth: The "RPAUID" element in the "RestrictedDiscReq-info" complex type is specified as an "xs:string" data type.

question_21877.question: When should the requirements defined in clause 8.19 apply?
question_21877.ground_truth: The requirements defined in clause 8.19 apply when the UE is operating in NE-DC mode.

question_21878.question: What is a Circle of Trust in IdM?
question_21878.ground_truth: A Circle of Trust is a notion in IdM that means there is a potential trusted link between every End User and every Service Provider in the Circle of Trust, allowing for seamless and efficient SSO services.

question_21882.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification in the context of NR Repeater type 2-O?
question_21882.ground_truth: The purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification is to specify the Radio Frequency (RF) test methods and conformance requirements for NR Repeater type 2-O.

question_21884.question: What should the NG-RAN node do if the Location Reporting Request Type IE in the received LOCATION REPORTING CONTROL message contains the Event Type IE set to neither "UE presence in the area of interest" nor "change of serving cell and UE presence in the Area of Interest", but the Area of Interest List IE is present?
question_21884.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node should ignore the Area of Interest List IE and proceed with the Location Reporting Procedure.

question_21885.question: What are the three levels of energy efficiency granularity in SON?
question_21885.ground_truth: The three levels of energy efficiency granularity in SON are network level, site level and equipment level.

question_21888.question: What is the role of Application Layer User ID and Application Layer Group ID in ProSe features?
question_21888.ground_truth: Application Layer User ID is an identity identifying a user within the context of a specific application, while Application Layer Group ID is an identity uniquely identifying a group of users within the context of a specific application.

question_21889.question: What is the difference between version x.y.z presented as a TSG approved document under change control and version x.y.z presented to TSG for approval in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
question_21889.ground_truth: The difference is that version x.y.z presented as a TSG approved document under change control is a TSG approved document under change control, while version x.y.z presented to TSG for approval is not yet a TSG approved document under change control.

question_21890.question: How many failures are allowed for the DCS 1 800 frequency band 1 785 MHz to 1 920 MHz?
question_21890.ground_truth: A maximum of twelve failures are allowed for the DCS 1 800 frequency band 1 785 MHz to 1 920 MHz, with a restriction that if grouped, it should not exceed three 200 kHz channels per group.

question_21891.question: How is an UE PDN connection uniquely identified in the case where multiple PDN connections to the same APN are supported by both MAG and LMA?
question_21891.ground_truth: An UE PDN connection can be uniquely identified by a (MN-Id, APN, PDN connection ID) tuple.

question_21892.question: What is the responsibility of the OCS in handling the IP-CAN session for a roaming user?
question_21892.ground_truth: The OCS is responsible for authorizing the IP-CAN session, allocating appropriate quota for RGs, and sending CCA with granted quota to the PGW.

question_21894.question: What is the main objective of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's technical specification group for the radio access network's work item on LTE TDD Home eNodeB RF requirements?
question_21894.ground_truth: The main objective is to first identify relevant scenarios and then write an RF requirements specification that is applicable to LTE TDD Home eNodeB.

question_21895.question: What is one of the potential new requirements needed to support the "Multiple Trains' Stops at the Same Platform" use case?
question_21895.ground_truth: One of the potential new requirements needed to support this use case is the ability for the 5G system to support the connection of a massive number of devices in a specific area in the station, which is defined to monitor and/or control.

question_21897.question: What are the two scenarios described to support service continuity?
question_21897.ground_truth: The two scenarios described to support service continuity are: Scenario 1 - Slice resource shortage in case of Intra-RA mobility and Inter-RA mobility, and Scenario 2 - Non-supported slice in case of Inter-RA mobility.

question_21898.question: What is a target identity and how is it used in the context of telecommunications?
question_21898.ground_truth: A target identity is a technical identity that uniquely identifies a target for interception. It is used in lawful authorization for telecommunications interception, and may be associated with one or more target services.

question_21899.question: What is the type used for query request in LA Data Service Template?

question_21900.question: What is the time interval before the second UPLINK ACCESS message is transmitted following the first one?
question_21900.ground_truth: The second UPLINK ACCESS message is repeated after a further period of 100 ms plus a random delay between 0 and 20 ms.

question_21901.question: What information can the XRM service stream include when provided to the PCF via the NEF?
question_21901.ground_truth: The XRM service stream information can include IP packet filters, GBR and/or MBR, RTP payload type for media type, synchronization source identifier, and special label information.

question_21902.question: What is the purpose of the Facility information element in a Connect scenario?
question_21902.ground_truth: The Facility information element in a Connect scenario may be used for functional operation of supplementary services.

question_21904.question: What is the level of the signal of the artificial mouth that shall be measured at the MRP?
question_21904.ground_truth: The level of the signal of the artificial mouth shall be - 4.7dBPa measured at the MRP for handset and headset modes. For handsfree modes, the downlink delay is defined from the system simulator input to the acoustic output from the UE loudspeaker.

question_21905.question: What should be the priority for a MME/SGSN when selecting a target SGSN?
question_21905.ground_truth: When a MME/SGSN supporting DCNs selects a target SGSN, the selected target SGSN should be restricted to SGSNs that belong to the same CN.

question_21906.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) and what is the purpose of the Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG-RAN) within it?
question_21906.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) is a collaboration between multiple standards organizations to create specifications for mobile telecommunications. The Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG-RAN) is a subgroup of 3GPP that focuses on the radio access network aspects of mobile telecommunications, including Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access (E-UTRA) and Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access Network (E-UTRAN).

question_21907.question: What is the measurement called that provides the fraction of PDCP SDU packets lost at the gNB-DU for packet switched traffic in 5GS?

question_21908.question: When would the UE diagnose a semantic error in packet filters in the context of two or more packet filters with identical packet filter identifiers?
question_21908.ground_truth: When two or more packet filters with identical packet filter identifiers are contained in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message.

question_21909.question: What additional actions does the MB-SMF take during the PFCP session establishment when restoring MBS sessions affected by an MB-UPF failure without restart?
question_21909.ground_truth: The MB-SMF requests alternative MB-UPF to join multicast tree towards SSM address, allocate new N6mb and/or Nmb9 ingress tunnel address, allocate new N3mb and/or N19mb LL SSM address and C-TEID, and send data towards the N3mb and/or N19mb endpoint's DL F-TEID. Then, for each MBS session, the alternativeMB-UPF assigns a new N3mb and/or N19mb LL SSM address and C-TEID, and/or a new N6mb and/or Nmb9 ingress tunnel address.

question_21911.question: What is the function of the MBS QoS flow binding in MBS deployments?
question_21911.ground_truth: The MBS QoS flow binding function resides at the MB-SMF and is used to associate the MBS PCC rule to an MBS QoS flow within an MBS session. This binding is performed using specific binding parameters.

question_21912.question: What is the effect of the AMF providing a different extended idle mode DRX cycle length value than what was requested by the UE?
question_21912.ground_truth: The AMF providing a different extended idle mode DRX cycle length value than what was requested by the UE can adversely impact reachability requirements of applications running on the UE.

question_21913.question: What functions does the Edge Application Server of an Edge Data Network provide for Edge Application Server's service APIs publish and discovery?
question_21913.ground_truth: The Edge Application Server of an Edge Data Network provides the API exposing function, the API publishing function, and the API management function for Edge Application Server's service APIs publish and discovery. These functions enable invocation of service APIs exposed from the Edge Application Server, publishing of service APIs of edge applications to the CAPIF core function of the Edge Enabler Server, and managing service APIs of the Edge Application Server to the CAPIF core function of the Edge Enabler Server, respectively.

question_21914.question: What is the objective of the initial conditions specified in 6.6.18.3.4.1.1?
question_21914.ground_truth: The objective of the initial conditions specified in 6.6.18.3.4.1.1 is to ensure a consistent and controlled testing environment for this test case.

question_21915.question: What is one of the potential standardization needs for the network rendering of XR services to meet immersive limits and low-complexity and low-latency bitrates?
question_21915.ground_truth: One of the potential standardization needs for the network rendering of XR services to meet immersive limits and low-complexity and low-latency bitrates is efficient content delivery and 5G network support.

question_21917.question: What is the procedure when the MCDATA User requests to send a group standalone SDS message with a disposition of only Delivery?
question_21917.ground_truth: When the MCDATA User requests to send a group standalone SDS message with a disposition of only Delivery, the UE (MCDATA Client) sends a group standalone SDS message with a disposition of only Delivery via a SIP MESSAGE message.

question_21918.question: What is the pass criteria for the RTCP Report Count Test?
question_21918.ground_truth: The pass criteria for this test are that all RTCP packets sent from the SUT fulfil the following: 1) The report count (RC) field is consistent with the number of report blocks observed to be included in the packet, regardless if the RTCP packet is a Sender Report or Receiver Report, and 2) The length field has a value that is the number of 32-bit words minus one occupied by that RTCP packet, including the RTCP packet header and any padding.

question_21919.question: What type of procedures are used for invoking and revoking of the call-completion services?
question_21919.ground_truth: Out-of-band stimulus procedures, such as ETSI TR 183 057, and inband interaction procedures can be used.

question_21921.question: Which TS 33.501 clause does solution #19 reuse for primary authentication between the UE and the AAA server in SNPN?
question_21921.ground_truth: Solution #19 reuses clause I.2.2.2 of TS 33.501 for primary authentication between the UE and the AAA server in SNPN.

question_21922.question: What is the role of Transcoder B' in the speech path when TFO-Negotiation is not successful?
question_21922.ground_truth: When TFO-Negotiation is not successful, Transcoder B' performs the necessary transcoding to PCM to carry compressed speech with high bandwidth efficiency on the Nb and Iu interfaces.

question_21927.question: What is an L-GW, and how does it relate to LIPA and SIPTO?
question_21927.ground_truth: An L-GW (Local Gateway) is a key element in the LIPA infrastructure, providing IP connectivity for the LIPA PDN. It is the anchor point for LIPA connectivity to the local IP network and also supports SIPTO features. An L-GW is typically included in a Local HeNB Network, a set of H(e)NB (Home eNodeB) with IP connectivity for LIPA to local PDN(s) via one or more L-GWs.

question_21928.question: What is the purpose of the procedure specified in clause 5.5.5 of TS 38.331?
question_21928.ground_truth: The purpose of this procedure is to transfer measurement results from the UE to the network.

question_21929.question: Which organization is responsible for the management of 5G SA and NSA scenarios?

question_21931.question: What is the difference between Class 1 and Class 2 Elementary Procedures in the NGAP?
question_21931.ground_truth: Class 1 EPs in the NGAP are Elementary Procedures with response, while Class 2 EPs are Elementary Procedures without response. For Class 1 EPs, the response can be successful, unsuccessful, or both, while Class 2 EPs are considered always successful.

question_21932.question: What type of reference signals are used for CSI estimation in the LTE-Advanced system?
question_21932.ground_truth: Reference signals used for CSI estimation in the LTE-Advanced system are cell-specific, sparse in frequency and time, and punctured into the data region of normal/MBSFN subframes.

question_21933.question: What is the requirement for BS capable of multi-band operation for each supported operating band in clause 4.12?
question_21933.ground_truth: The RF requirements in clause~6 and 7 apply for each supported operating band unless otherwise stated in clause 4.12.

question_21934.question: What functions are supported by the RLC sub layer?
question_21934.ground_truth: The functions supported by the RLC sub layer include transfer of upper layer PDUs, error correction through ARQ (only for AM data transfer), segmentation and reassembly of RLC SDUs, duplicate detection (only for AM data transfer), and RLC re-establishment.

question_21935.question: What are the two DSR Front-ends developed by the ETSI STQ-Aurora working group?
question_21935.ground_truth: The two DSR Front-ends are ES 201 108 and ES 202 050.

question_21936.question: What is the role of the dynamic/Static flag in the UDC solution?
question_21936.ground_truth: The dynamic/Static flag in the UDC solution indicates whether static Huffman or dynamic Huffman is used for compression. The possible values are: 00- No compression, 01 - Compressed with fixed Huffman codes, 10 - Compressed with dynamic Huffman codes, and 11 - Reserved (error).

question_21937.question: When can a UE expect to receive a 401 (Unauthorized) response to the REGISTER request in GPRS-IMS-Bundled authentication?
question_21937.ground_truth: A UE can expect to receive a 401 (Unauthorized) response to the REGISTER request in GPRS-IMS-Bundled authentication when the network requires authentication or re-authentication of the UE.

question_21938.question: When is an IPsec tunnel used to terminate interfaces in the W-AGF function?
question_21938.ground_truth: An IPsec tunnel is used to terminate the N2 interface between the W-5GAN and the AMF and the N3 interface between the W-5GAN and the UPF on the W-AGF side.

question_21940.question: What shall the SGW do if it detects a partial failure and has one or more corresponding CSID(s) assigned?
question_21940.ground_truth: The SGW shall clean up any residual state associated with the CSID(s), send the GTPv2 Delete PDN Connection Set Request message containing the SGW CSIDs to the MME peers supporting the feature, and delete all the retrieved PDN connections and the associated resources.

question_21941.question: What is the function of the Transit function in forwarding the request to the required Application Servers?
question_21941.ground_truth: The Transit function forwards the request to the required Application Servers, each of which may identify the PBX the user belongs to and perform any enterprise specific actions for the user if required.

question_21942.question: What is the main difference between the two scenarios, 8.1 and 8.2, described in section 4.9?
question_21942.ground_truth: In scenario 8.1, authorized MC user A requests discreet listening for communications involving MC user B, while in scenario 8.2, authorized MC user A requests discreet listening for a set of users being part of group communications involving MC user B to MC user D.

question_21943.question: What is the purpose of the Relocation of application context solution?
question_21943.ground_truth: The Relocation of application context solution allows the Edge Application Server to determine whether the application context for a UE is to be relocated, it prepares the required UE application context to be relocated and transfers it to the target Edge Application Server, with this solution the UE will not be aware of the application context of the UE being relocated and preserves the service continuity.

question_21945.question: How does the X2-proxy handle UE-dedicated procedures?
question_21945.ground_truth: The X2-proxy processes and forwards all X2 messages between the HeNB and other eNBs for all UE-dedicated procedures. The processing of X2-AP messages includes modifying X2-AP UE IDs, but leaves other parts of the message unchanged. Upon reception of the X2 Handover Request message, the X2-proxy forwards the message to the target node based on the target cell ID.

question_21947.question: What is the role of UE-B in the WLAN Direct group formation?
question_21947.ground_truth: UE-B accepts the group setup request and responds with a ProSe Group Setup Response message, then associates and authenticates with UE-A (the GO) and establishes direct IP communication with UE-A.

question_21948.question: What command is sent from a 3GPP AAA Server to a trusted non-3GPP access network NAS to complete SWa authentication and authorization procedures?

question_21949.question: What is an Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the context of 3GPP TM?
question_21949.ground_truth: An Integration Reference Point (IRP) in 3GPP TM is a specification that defines the information in the agent that is visible for the manager, the operations that the manager may perform on this information, and the notifications that are sent from the agent to the manager.

question_21950.question: What should the "3GPP-Adaptation" header be sent in the response and what does its presence indicate?
question_21950.ground_truth: The "3GPP-Adaptation" header should be sent in responses to requests containing this header, and its presence indicates to the client that the server acknowledges the request.

question_21953.question: What action should the SMF consider when it receives the Current QoS Parameters Set Index IE for a QoS flow in the QoS Flow Setup Response List IE in the Handover Request Acknowledge Transfer IE in the HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message?
question_21953.ground_truth: The SMF should consider it as the currently fulfilled QoS parameters set among the alternative QoS parameters for the involved QoS flow.

question_21954.question: When should the PLMN BC parameters be set to "transparent" and "non-transparent", respectively, if an LLC is received and indicates UIL1P=X.31?
question_21954.ground_truth: The PLMN BC parameters should be set to "transparent" if the ISDN-BC received consists of octets 1 to 4 only, and to "non-transparent" if the ISDN-BC received consists of octets 1 to 5 only and indicates UIL1P=X.31.

question_21955.question: What requirements does 3GPP TS 22.011 introduce for roaming in shared networks?
question_21955.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 22.011 introduces requirements for roaming in shared networks, including the ability for a user to register with a core network operator in the shared network, even if the operator is not operating a radio access network in that area.

question_21956.question: What measures should a UE take if a GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND, an EMM STATUS or an EMM INFORMATION message is received before the detach procedure is completed?
question_21956.ground_truth: For detach procedures with detach type other than "IMSI detach", the UE should ignore the message. For detach procedures with detach type "IMSI detach", the UE should continue both detach and EMM procedures.

question_21957.question: What action does the MRFP take when it receives an RTP header extension for Predefined ROI and does not apply video transcoding?
question_21957.ground_truth: The MRFP passes any received RTP header extension for Predefined ROI to succeeding RTP streams.

question_21958.question: What are the steps taken by the AMF during the Verified N26 Handover with Serving GW Change procedure?
question_21958.ground_truth: Steps include validation of the TAU request message, requesting SM Context, providing mapped EBS context, and sending a Context Response message carrying mapped MM context.

question_21959.question: What is the purpose of the mappingQoS field in the LCS-PeriodicTriggeredInvokeArg sequence?
question_21959.ground_truth: The mappingQoS field in the LCS-PeriodicTriggeredInvokeArg sequence indicates the mapped QoS which appliable to EPS to be sent by the UE for EPS to UE service continuity when UE has moved from 5GS to EPS and detected an event to report to MME.

question_21960.question: When measuring spurious emissions for intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation in co-existence with protected bands, what should be the lowest and highest frequency of the measurement position in each frequency range?
question_21960.ground_truth: The lowest frequency of the measurement position in each frequency range should be set at the lowest boundary of the frequency range plus MBW/2, and the highest frequency of the measurement position in each frequency range should be set at the highest boundary of the frequency range minus MBW/2.

question_21961.question: What is the Survival Time used for in 3GPP network functions?
question_21961.ground_truth: Survival Time is an optional parameter in the TSC Assistance container, used to indicate the amount of time a network slice instance can remain alive without requiring additional signaling with the user equipment (UE).

question_21962.question: What should the UE do if more than one cell meets the reselection criteria and the highest-priority cell is from a different RAT?
question_21962.ground_truth: The UE shall reselect the highest ranked cell among the cells on the highest priority frequency(ies) meeting the criteria of that RAT.

question_21963.question: What should the SS attempt to do if the UE fails to add the FR2 SCell in the UE behavior testing process?
question_21963.ground_truth: The SS shall first attempt to release and add the FR2 SCell.

question_21965.question: When does the UE initiate a registration procedure for initial registration after waiting in 5GMM-IDLE mode?
question_21965.ground_truth: This occurs when the UE is registered over non-3GPP access and has an emergency service ongoing, and the UE parameters update data set does not include a UE parameters update data set with UE parameters update data set type indicating "Routing indicator update data".

question_21967.question: What is the definition of "Outgoing Access (OA)" in the context of the CUG Supplementary Service?
question_21967.ground_truth: Outgoing Access (OA) is an arrangement that allows a member of a CUG to place calls outside the CUG.

question_21968.question: What is the function of the IMS Network Functions when performing interception without the control channel (CC) in a roaming case for voice over IP (VoIP) users?
question_21968.ground_truth: The IMS Network Functions report to the Lower Layer Media Function (LLMF) that the CC is unavailable due to the target's roaming situation when performing interception without the CC for roaming targets.

question_21969.question: What information does the MME include in the S1AP Paging message?
question_21969.ground_truth: The MME may include the paging attempt count information, WUS Assistance Information, Information for Enhanced Coverage, and CE mode B Restricted parameter, based on specific conditions.

question_21970.question: If a UE chooses the high resolution representation with HEVC simulcast solution, how many layers of resolution will the UE receive?
question_21970.ground_truth: The UE will receive a single layer of 1080p resolution.

question_21971.question: What is the third primitive type used for the communication between the BMC sublayer and other entities?

question_21974.question: What is the purpose of the frame substitution and muting procedure defined in the document?
question_21974.ground_truth: The purpose of the frame substitution and muting procedure is to be used by the Receive (RX) Discontinuous Transmission (DTX) handler for the half rate speech traffic channels within the digital cellular telecommunications system, in case of lost or unreliable speech or SIdence Descriptor (SID) frames received from the Radio Sub System (RSS).

question_21975.question: What is the meaning of the absence of the QoS flow Identifier in the Diameter ASR message received by the SMF?
