question_21975.ground_truth: The absence of the QoS flow Identifier in the Diameter ASR message indicates that all QoS flows for the specific user and sharing the same user session should be deleted.

question_21976.question: What is the name of the parameter that is made up of the following: Original SCCP Calling party address, Original SCCP Message type, Original SCCP Protocol class in the intermediate unprotected representation?

question_21977.question: What information does the "Supported" header field in the initial INVITE request contain?
question_21977.ground_truth: The "Supported" header field in the initial INVITE request contains the option-tags "100rel" and "precondition".

question_21978.question: What is the purpose of the FEC Evaluation Procedure?
question_21978.ground_truth: The FEC Evaluation Procedure is defined for the evaluation and selection of FEC code performance. It includes procedures to measure theoretical FEC code performance, FEC performance in 3GPP services, as well as high-level and detailed decoder performance.

question_21979.question: In the hop-by-hop approach, what is the advantage in terms of information required for each node?
question_21979.ground_truth: Each node only needs to know the overload condition of its next-hop peer.

question_21982.question: What is the required throughput measurement for NR bands with DL and UL frequencies below 2700 MHz?
question_21982.ground_truth: The throughput measurement must be 95% or more of the reference measurement channel's maximum throughput.

question_21983.question: What happens when the 5GMS Client requests a Background Data Transfer during one of the advertised time windows?
question_21983.ground_truth: If the 5GMS network services grant the request for the Background Data Transfer, it applies the appropriate Quality of Service policy to the media streaming session. The 5GMS network services will indicate the estimate of the time period for which Background Data Transfer is available and the maximum data volume that it is permitted to transfer.

question_21985.question: What is the procedure for the transmission of unsolicited location information in section 5.3.3?
question_21985.ground_truth: The Location Information Delivery procedure in section 5.3.3 describes how Endpoint A can provide unsolicited location information to Endpoint B through the use of ProvideLocationInformation messages.

question_21987.question: How does the SGSN handle an AKA procedure if both the SGSN and UE support the enhanced security context?
question_21987.ground_truth: If both the SGSN and UE support the enhanced security context, the SGSN includes an indication in the Authentication and Ciphering Request message, signalling the ME to create an enhanced security context from this AKA run. Both the ME and SGSN then calculate CKS and IKS using the new KASMEU and COUNT = 0 for any subsequent security mode procedures or inter-RAT handovers.

question_21988.question: What is the responsibility of the MN or SN node in mapping QoS flows to DRBs in MR-DC with 5GC?
question_21988.ground_truth: The MN or SN node that hosts the SDAP entity for a given QoS flow decides how to map the QoS flow to DRBs in MR-DC with 5GC.

question_21989.question: What internal event exposures does the 5GC NFs consider when providing mobility related events to NF consumers?
question_21989.ground_truth: The 5GC NFs consider events independent of the ongoing system procedure, such as during registration, inter-NG-RAN node handover, location reporting, and N2 Notification and AN release procedures.

question_21990.question: What is the role of the Service Enabler Architecture Layer (SEAL) in the 3GPP system?
question_21990.ground_truth: The SEAL is a platform architecture that enables the distribution and delivery of application content/data for vertical applications in the 3GPP system.

question_21991.question: What is the purpose of the eP-CSCF verifying the web-page establishing the signalling connection at the Trusted Node?
question_21991.ground_truth: To ensure that the web-page comes from a trusted domain and to protect against unauthorized access.

question_21995.question: What is the purpose of the post-screening rules used in Test 1?
question_21995.ground_truth: The post-screening rules ensure that none of the hidden references are rated below 90 and none of the midrange anchors are rated lower than low anchors. This helps maintain the quality standards during the test.

question_21996.question: What are some potential RACH resource enhancements that have been identified for NR-U beyond Rel-15 flexibility?
question_21996.ground_truth: Some potential RACH resource enhancements that have been identified for NR-U beyond Rel-15 flexibility include frequency-domain enhancements, time-domain enhancements, and additional new RACH resources used immediately following detection of DRS transmission.

question_21998.question: What is the time duration for each step in subclause 7.7.4.2.1 for the 3,84 Mcps TDD option?
question_21998.ground_truth: The time duration of each step should be sufficiently long to capture one even (transmit) time slot.

question_21999.question: What restriction applies to the distribution of IMSI and authentication data between MMEs belonging to different serving network domains?
question_21999.ground_truth: Unused EPS authentication vectors, or non-current EPS security contexts, shall not be distributed between MMEs belonging to different serving domains (PLMNs).

question_22000.question: What is the equation used to convert the average high band signal energy to the domain, before quantizing it in the SWB SID frame?
question_22000.ground_truth: The equation used is (1357) which is the average high band signal energy in domain.

question_22001.question: What information is provided to the CSE when the VPLMN/IPLMN network makes contact with it?
question_22001.ground_truth: The VPLMN/IPLMN network provides the CSE with the following information: event met, type of monitoring, cause for unsuccessful call establishment (if applicable), event specific data (such as received DTMF digits), the party in the call for which the event is detected and reported (calling or called party), and the type of monitoring (control or notification).

question_22002.question: What is the expected output for the memcmp function in Test Case 1 under the "Test Procedure" section for CatEndSelectItem?
question_22002.ground_truth: The expected output is that the two buffers contain the same data.

question_22004.question: How does the S-NAPTR procedure logically output a list of host names?
question_22004.ground_truth: The S-NAPTR procedure outputs a list of host names each with a service, protocol, port and a list of IPv4 and IPvv6 addresses, which can be obtained one host name at a time or in a complete ordered list of all nodes.

question_22005.question: When can a leg be moved from one call segment to another call segment?
question_22005.ground_truth: A leg can be moved from one call segment to another call segment as a result of a Move Leg or Split Leg information flow.

question_22006.question: How is the bootstrapping information transferred in GAA?
question_22006.ground_truth: NAF specific bootstrapping information is transferred from a BSF to a NAF and contains NAF and its service specific parts from bootstrapped data and needed key information derived from the bootstrapped data.

question_22007.question: What are the conditions for an MME or SGSN to trigger extended buffering for a UE?
question_22007.ground_truth: An MME or SGSN should trigger extended buffering when the UE is in a power saving state or intermittently in coverage, excluding cases with a "Availability after DDN Failure" monitoring event or a "UE Reachability" monitoring event. The MME/SGSN indicates DL Buffering Requested in the Downlink Data Notification Ack message and includes a DL Buffering Duration time and optionally a DL Buffering Suggested Packet Count. The DL Data Buffer Expiration Time is used to indicate that there are buffered data in the Serving GW and that the user plane setup procedure is needed when the UE makes signalling with the network.

question_22008.question: What is the abbreviation for Group Call Control in 3GPP TS?

question_22009.question: What is the purpose of using multiple PLMN IDs in Solution 2?
question_22009.ground_truth: The purpose of using multiple PLMN IDs in Solution 2 is to allow more eNBs in an operator network, specifically to support more than 1.04 million eNBs in their network.

question_22010.question: What is the purpose of identity mapping in the IWF?
question_22010.ground_truth: The purpose of identity mapping in the IWF is to derive the corresponding identities of LMR users and groups in an MCPTT or MCData system. This is done by providing an MCPTT ID for LMR users and an MCPTT group ID for LMR groups.

question_22011.question: What information does the UE send to the network via the user plane when it receives Measurement Assistance Information?
question_22011.ground_truth: The UE sends the dynamically allocated UDP port and, if IPv6 is used for PMF messages, the IPv6 address to the network via the user plane when it receives Measurement Assistance Information.

question_22012.question: What is the process of enhancing SSC mode 3 PDU Session anchor change with multiple PDU sessions?
question_22012.ground_truth: The SMF determines to select a new target UPF as the new PSA based on the UE location or DNAIs, sends a notification indicating PSA change to the AF, releases the old PDU session after the new PDU session is established and a positive response is received from the AF.

question_22013.question: What kind of standard is 3GPP?
question_22013.ground_truth: 3GPP (Third Generation Partnership Project) is a standardization project with the goal of developing specifications for mobile telecommunications. It is a collaboration of telecommunications standards bodies in seven countries, including ARIB, ATIS, CCSA, ETSI, TTA, TTC, and GSMA. These organizations work together to develop global technical specifications for 3G, 4G, and 5G mobile networks and services.

question_22014.question: What is the function of the Session Management Function (SMF) in 5G networks?
question_22014.ground_truth: The SMF is responsible for the enforcement of policy decisions related to service data flow detection, authorized QoS, charging, gating, traffic usage reporting, packet routing and forwarding, and traffic steering.

question_22015.question: What are some of the risks associated with transporting LTK during provisioning in Key Issue 3?
question_22015.ground_truth: The risks include a security compromise of the communication channel during transportation, a compromise of the mobile operators' equipment or software, and an insider attack on the key store at a network operator or SIM vendor.

question_22016.question: What is one of the allowed CCTrCH combinations for one UE on the uplink?
question_22016.ground_truth: One of the allowed CCTrCH combinations for one UE on the uplink is several CCTrCH of dedicated type.

question_22017.question: What must the SS Version Indicator value be when the UE invokes a MO-LR by sending a REGISTER message?
question_22017.ground_truth: The SS Version Indicator value must be 1 or above.

question_22018.question: How does the RN establish IP connectivity in the second method described?
question_22018.ground_truth: The RN attaches to an eNB like a normal UE using a USIM, called USIM-INI, which is different from the one used in the RN attach procedure to the DeNB, called USIM-RN. A secure channel between RN and USIM-INI is not required.

question_22019.question: What is the main principle of Enhancement Solution 3?
question_22019.ground_truth: Enhancement Solution 3 uses a coarse proximity estimation based on path loss by retrieving the actual transmit power used and mapping it into a transmit power category, which is then encoded in the discovery message. The monitoring UE calculates the path loss and estimates the proximity to the announcing UE.

question_22020.question: How much bit rate reduction, on average, does H.265 (HEVC) provide over H264 for the MTSI service in the medium bitrate range?
question_22020.ground_truth: The bit rate of H.265 (HEVC) is approximately 60% of that of H264 for the MTSI service in the medium bitrate range.

question_22021.question: What are the desired characteristics for the signal path in the described use case?
question_22021.ground_truth: The signal path should be resilient, with guaranteed bandwidth and QoS. Precision Time Protocol (IEEE 1588-2008) support and open standard-based broadcast workflows are also necessary for this application.

question_22022.question: What network architectures does the system need to support for optimized handovers between mobile WiMAX and 3GPP accesses?
question_22022.ground_truth: The system needs to support an architecture that uses the EPC network elements and reference points, introducing a new logical function (FAF) and a new reference point (X200) in the EPC architecture, and using the existing protocols in the EPC architecture.

question_22023.question: What is the procedure for secure MO small data transmission when UE is idle?
question_22023.ground_truth: UE sends small data in Service Request to MME, MME retrieves the routing for UE, finds out to which MTC-IWF the small data should be sent, and MTC-IWF performs integrity check, UE authorization, and delivers the small data to SCS if the verifications are successful.

question_22024.question: What is the purpose of the Software Management function in the 3G network?
question_22024.ground_truth: The Software Management function in the 3G network provides the operator with the ability to manage effectively the software entities residing in the network. It is especially useful for managing a large number of software widely distributed geographically, with a focus on managing new software releases and correction patches.

question_22025.question: What is the viable running time to maintain specified HDOP values for GPS scenario #2?
question_22025.ground_truth: The viable running time to maintain specified HDOP values for GPS scenario #2 is 19 minutes.

question_22026.question: What is the Granularity of applying the RCI value when it is transferred to the TDF/AF without PCRF involvement?
question_22026.ground_truth: The granularity of applying the RCI value is per application.

question_22027.question: What action should the UE take when it receives 5GMM cause #77 over a wireline access network?
question_22027.ground_truth: The UE sets the 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes specific information, resets the registration attempt counter, and enters the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.

question_22028.question: What is the expected behavior when storing an Abbreviated Dialling Number with a unique 32-character alpha identifier on the default SIM?
question_22028.ground_truth: The ME should store the data and allow it to be retrieved as instructed.

question_22032.question: What is the purpose of the measurement DBU.NbrPubUserIdentities with SIP URI format?
question_22032.ground_truth: This measurement provides the number of Public Service Identities with SIP URI format stored in a HSS.

question_22034.question: Which procedure is used to notify the sending endpoint by the receiving endpoint that the receiving SLPP message is erroneous or unexpected?
question_22034.ground_truth: The procedure is called Error handling in SLPP.

question_22036.question: What information should the UE include in the UECapabilityInformation message if it does not support FDD and TDD?
question_22036.ground_truth: If the UE does not support FDD and TDD, it should not set the fields fdd-Add-UE-EUTRA-Capabilities and tdd-Add-UE-EUTRA-Capabilities (including their sub-fields) in the UE-EUTRA-Capability within the ue-CapabilityRAT-Container, and should set the other fields to include the values applicable for its supported mode.

question_22037.question: What is the length of the Zadoff-Chu sequence used in the NB-LTE M-PRACH preamble design?
question_22037.ground_truth: The length of the Zadoff-Chu sequence used in the NB-LTE M-PRACH preamble design is 491.

question_22038.question: What is the role of the RAA message in the session start procedure for MBMS bearer service?
question_22038.ground_truth: The RAA message is used by the GGSN to indicate to the BM-SC that it has successfully started the session for the MBMS bearer service.

question_22039.question: What is the condition that must be met for the requirements for Relative Code Domain Error in DC-HSUPA mode to be applicable?
question_22039.ground_truth: The requirements for Relative Code Domain Error in DC-HSUPA mode are applicable when the total power in each of the assigned carriers is equal to each other.

question_22042.question: What bands' receivers have a potential issue with 3rd order IMD products caused by BS supporting carrier aggregation of Band 3 and Band 46?
question_22042.ground_truth: The BS receivers of Bands 1, 2, 3, 4, 9, 10, 11, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 30, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 38, 39, 40, and 41 have a potential issue with 3rd order IMD products caused by BS supporting carrier aggregation of Band 3 and Band 46.

question_22044.question: What should the SCC AS including in the SIP re-INVITE request when indicating the media streams to be transferred to the target UE?
question_22044.ground_truth: The SCC AS sets the SDP information for the media streams to be transferred to the target UE as inactive.

question_22045.question: When is it necessary for the AS to send an INFO request including an Identification Request MIME body?
question_22045.ground_truth: The AS sends an INFO request including an Identification Request MIME body when the INVITE request does not contain the information of the originating party.

question_22046.question: How does the IBCF perform encryption for network topology hiding purposes?
question_22046.ground_truth: When the IBCF receives an outgoing request/response from the hiding network, it performs encryption by using the whole header values which were added by one or more specific entities of the hiding network as input, and forms one valid entry for the specific header out of the resulting NAI. If the IBCF encrypted an entry in the Route header, then it also inserts its own URI before the topmost encrypted entry.

question_22047.question: What is the purpose of an MCPTT client sending a group join request when participating in a group communication for a group?
question_22047.ground_truth: The purpose of an MCPTT client sending a group join request is to indicate to the MCPTT server that the MCPTT user associated with the given MCPTT client wishes to participate in the group communication and begin to receive or send media from or to the group.

question_22048.question: What is the main purpose of Security risk assessment in the context of 5G network?
question_22048.ground_truth: The main purpose is to detect anomalies in managed objects, identify potential security risks, and propose countermeasures to mitigate them in order to ensure the security and stability of the network.

question_22050.question: What is the primary goal of the Frequency of inclusion requirements subclause?
question_22050.ground_truth: The primary goal of the Frequency of inclusion requirements subclause is to define how often/frequently the "Load Control Information" should be transferred, while ensuring that the transfer of the load information doesn't add significant additional load to each peer node and the calculation of load information doesn't severely impact the resource utilization of the node.

question_22051.question: What should the SGSN provide for the downlink MBMS-UNITDATA procedure?
question_22051.ground_truth: The SGSN provides the BSSGP with a current TMGI, MBMS Session Identity, PDU Lifetime, and identifies the MBMS Service Context for the downlink MBMS-UNITDATA procedure.

question_22052.question: What is the purpose of the test defined in section 9.1.32.1?
question_22052.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that the CSI-RSRP absolute and relative measurement accuracies in CSI-RS based discovery signal are within the specified limits.

question_22053.question: What are some technical features that can be used to overcome the challenges in mmWAVE spectrum for televison production requirements?
question_22053.ground_truth: Some technical features used to overcome the challenges in mmWAVE spectrum for televison production requirements include advanced beam management and multi-carrier operation. Also, to operate scenario at a few hundred megabits per second, content delivery protocols and codecs are needed to compensate for mmWAVE channel characteristics, achieve high reliability and high bit rate.

question_22054.question: What actions are taken by the PGW to trigger the reporting of counters values?
question_22054.ground_truth: The PGW indicates the events for reporting, which may be implicit or explicit triggers, and sends the counters in the control plane.

question_22055.question: What is the target identity associated with the IRI-POI present in the EES?
question_22055.ground_truth: The LIPF present in the ADMF provisions the intercept information associated with the GPSI and EECID target identities to the IRI-POI present in the EES.

question_22056.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project responsible for?
question_22056.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project is responsible for producing technical specifications for the radio access network, including the conformance testing of user equipment that supports Assisted Global Navigation Satellite Systems.

question_22057.question: What is the test requirement for 6.5.3.10.5?
question_22057.ground_truth: The test requires the UE to send the first CSI report for SCell in the first available uplink resource and start sending CSI reports with non-zero CQI index at a certain slot. Also, interruption on any activated serving cell should not exceed certain limits during T2.

question_22059.question: What information is needed when the AF request is for influencing SMF routing decisions?
question_22059.ground_truth: The information is used to identify UE(s) whose traffic is to be routed.

question_22060.question: What is the requirement for the measurement reporting delay in the test?
question_22060.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay shall be less than 25.6 seconds in the test.

question_22061.question: What should the UE do if the T3448 value IE is present in the received ATTACH ACCEPT message and the UE is using EPS services with control plane CIoT EPS optimization, and the value indicates that this timer is zero or deactivated?
question_22061.ground_truth: The UE shall consider this case as an abnormal case and proceed as if the T3448 value IE is not present.

question_22062.question: What is one of the potential requirements under the separation architecture of SMF and UPF for the 5G system?
question_22062.ground_truth: One of the potential requirements under the separation architecture of SMF and UPF for the 5G system is online and offline charging. This means that charging can be done in real-time (online) or after the service has been used (offline).

question_22063.question: What is the difference in interference leakage between 23dBm interfering LTE UE and 31dBm interfering HPUE in NB-IoT UE and LTE UE transmissions?
question_22063.ground_truth: The interference leaked from LTE UL to NB-IoT UL with 31dBm interfering HPUE is 1.5dB, 0.6dB, 0.3dB, and 0.3dB higher (at 5%, 50%, 95%, and 99% CDF points, respectively) than that with 23dBm interfering LTE UE.

question_22066.question: What message does the BSS send to the SGSN to initiate an intra-BSS PS handover?
question_22066.ground_truth: The BSS sends a "PS Handover Required" message to the SGSN to initiate an intra-BSS PS handover.

question_22067.question: What type of data is the Service-ID AVP expected to contain?
question_22067.ground_truth: The Service-ID AVP is expected to contain a UTF8String that identifies the service the MRFC is hosting or AoC service.

question_22069.question: From ITU-T SG16, what telepresence system feature is considered an advanced feature and recommended for SA4 to consider?
question_22069.ground_truth: Actual size high definition imaging of videoconferencing participants at the remote end is an advanced feature recommended for SA4 to consider.

question_22070.question: Which clause describes the more specific details about the test procedure?
question_22070.ground_truth: X.4.2y specifies the initial conditions and procedures for the test method, including details such as domain, range, weighting, and algorithms.

question_22074.question: What is the role of the SCEF in setting up a transfer policy and who is responsible for deriving the PCC rules for the background data transfer?
question_22074.ground_truth: The SCEF, acting as an AF, transfers the request to set up a transfer policy to the PCRF via the Rx interface. The PCRF retrieves the corresponding transfer policy from the SPR and derives the PCC rules for the background data transfer.

question_22075.question: What are the two functions of the RUA in the 3GPP 3rd Generation Partnership Project?
question_22075.ground_truth: The RUA has two main functions: transparently transferring RANAP messages and handling errors. The error handling function enables the reporting of general error situations for which function-specific error messages have not been defined.

question_22077.question: What HTTP method is used to send notifications in ACR Information Notification as specified in 6.4.4.2.2?
question_22077.ground_truth: The POST method is used to send notifications in ACR Information Notification as specified in 6.4.4.2.2.

question_22078.question: What is a defining characteristic of a local regrouping within a system in the context of MCPTT and LMR?
question_22078.ground_truth: Group regrouping is only possible within each system locally, and one or more regrouped groups on one system are connected to the other system via the IWF, without the other system necessarily being aware that the regrouping has taken place.

question_22081.question: What procedure does the SCF (Service Capability Feature) follow when PSS to MBMS switching is available in 8.4.4.1.3?
question_22081.ground_truth: When PSS to MBMS switching is available for the UE, the SCF terminates the SIP session between it and the PSS Adapter by sending a SIP BYE message to the PSS Adapter in 8.4.4.1.3.

question_22083.question: What information must the AF request the PCRF to report if an IP-CAN bearer establishment mode is to be negotiated for non-3GPP IP-CANs using Gxx?
question_22083.ground_truth: Negotiation of bearer establishment mode takes place via Gxx for non-3GPP IP-CANs using GTP, the PCRF must negotiate via Gxx for the rest of the cases.

question_22084.question: Upon receiving the indication for GNSS measurements, what should the UE perform?
question_22084.ground_truth: Upon receiving the indication for GNSS measurements, the UE should perform GNSS measurement using the measurement gap with a gap length indicated by lower layers.

question_22085.question: What is the purpose of the source Edge Enabler Server and Context ID in the registration process?
question_22085.ground_truth: If the Edge Enabler Client is moving from the purview of a source Edge Enabler Server to the new Edge Enabler Server, the request from the Edge Enabler Client may include the identity of the source Edge Enabler Server and an Edge Enabler Client Registration Context ID that was provided by the source Edge Enabler Server.

question_22086.question: What is the role of the CDF when it comes to Monitoring Event reports sent by the MECN?
question_22086.ground_truth: The CDF, based on operator implementation, generates a single ME-RE-CDR when a burst of Monitoring Event reports is reported by the CTF or may generate an individual ME-RE-CDR for each Monitoring Event report when a burst is reported by the CTF. The CDF, in the context of Monitoring Event reporting, is responsible for collecting charging information related to a single Monitoring Event report or a burst of Monitoring Event reports in a short time interval.

question_22087.question: What should the UE do upon receiving N314 consecutive "in-sync" indications for the PCell from lower layers while T313 is running?
question_22087.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T313.

question_22088.question: What is the role of KO in the establishment of a new security context in an intra-eNB handover?
question_22088.ground_truth: KO is used as an input to the KDF (Key Derivation Function) in the establishment of a new security context in an intra-eNB handover.

question_22089.question: In what situation does the UE need to initiate a UE-initiated modification procedure for a multi-access PDN connection over 3GPP accesses and untrusted WLAN?
question_22089.ground_truth: When the network-initiated NBIFOM mode is selected, the RAN rules control the WLAN access selection and traffic routing, the RAN rules handling parameter is set, and the local operating environment information in the UE does not contain non-radio-related conditions that prohibit the use of WLAN access.

question_22091.question: Which service enables a user to establish a simultaneous communication involving several users?
question_22091.ground_truth: The 3PTY service enables a user to establish and control a simultaneous communication involving several users. This service is invoked by the served user involved in at least two communication sessions (one active communication and at least one held communication), which can be either incoming or outgoing.

question_22092.question: In what way does PR 5.8.6.001 affect a 5G system with satellite access?
question_22092.ground_truth: PR 5.8.6.001 requires a 5G system with satellite access to support Relay UE's with 5G satellite access.

question_22093.question: What is the GSM/EDGE carrier spacing?

question_22094.question: What is the goal of alternative service flow 1 in sub clause 5.2.4.1 for the local fall back at eNB individual call use case?
question_22094.ground_truth: The goal is to maintain calls already in progress between users under the coverage of the isolated system, in this case, by carrying the call locally by the eNB and received by Peter.

question_22095.question: When must the MCVideo client set the <emergency-ind> element to a value of "false" in the <mcvideoinfo> element containing the <mcvideo-Params> element?
question_22095.ground_truth: When the MCVideo user has additionally requested the cancellation of the in-progress emergency state of the MCVideo group and this is an authorized request for an in-progress emergency group state cancellation.

question_22096.question: What is the minimum number of resource blocks that the AllowedMeasBandwidth IE can indicate?
question_22096.ground_truth: The minimum number of resource blocks that the AllowedMeasBandwidth IE can indicate is mbw6, which indicates 6 resource blocks.

question_22098.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon expiration of timer TFG2 (call announcement) while in the "S3: part of ongoing call" state?
question_22098.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should generate a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message and send it to the network, and start timer TFG2 again.

question_22099.question: Which new paired bands are defined in the RF specifications as n91, n92, n93 and n94?
question_22099.ground_truth: These are the new variable duplex FDD bands defined in the work item.

question_22100.question: What is the difference between single-band scenarios and multiband scenarios in terms of the PIM study?
question_22100.ground_truth: Single-band scenarios focus on the operation of MSR BS in Non-Contiguous spectrum (MSR-NC), considering the frequency domain relations for the generation of passive intermodulation (IM) products. Multiband scenarios involve dual band HSDPA, LTE inter-band CA, and MB-MSR, where PIM interference may cause receiver sensitivity degradation of another co-located BS or own BS.

question_22101.question: How does the Parent UE respond to a parental control request from the SCF?
question_22101.ground_truth: The Parent UE sends a SIP MESSAGE message back to the SCF with the XML document unchanged to accept the request, or with the ProgramID deleted to refuse the request.

question_22104.question: How does the Target UE or the Reference UE request Ranging capability and Ranging assistant data?
question_22104.ground_truth: The Ranging capability request and Ranging assistant data request are transferred via the PC5-S message.

question_22105.question: What should be considered when selecting parameters for the parameterized array antenna model in order to produce accurate and physical gain response?
question_22105.ground_truth: When selecting parameters for the parameterized array antenna model, the coverage range requirement, array antenna steering capability, single element gain, and half power beamwidth should be considered and checked with Eq. 7.2.4-1, Eq. 7.2.4-2, and Eq. 7.2.4-4.

question_22106.question: What should be the source IP address observed in incoming DNS query packets as client subnet option in 5GC?
question_22106.ground_truth: The source IP address observed in incoming DNS query packets as client subnet option should be added when forwarding a DNS query in 5GC.

question_22108.question: What function does a switch serve in half duplex FDD MTC UEs?
question_22108.ground_truth: In half duplex FDD MTC UEs, a switch is used instead of a duplexer to allow for simplified RF implementation.

question_22111.question: What should an MRFC do when it recognizes that the MRFP is available again?
question_22111.ground_truth: After an MRFP becomes available again, the MRFC can use the MRFP after receiving an MRFP Communication Up message or an MRFP Restoration message. The MRFC can also initiate the MRFC Ordered Re-register procedure if none of the three conditions (1, 2, or 3) occur.

question_22112.question: What are the two main categories of logical channels supported by the radio subsystem as defined in the document?
question_22112.ground_truth: The two main categories of logical channels supported by the radio subsystem as defined in the document are the traffic channels (TCH's) and the control channels.

question_22113.question: Which access scheme is used for mapping MAC layer logical channels onto the physical channels in NB M2M?
question_22113.ground_truth: A combination of FDMA and TDMA.

question_22114.question: Which KPI is obtained by the sum of the number of successful session establishments and the number of failed session establishment due to user behavior factors divided by the number of attempted session establishments for originating side and terminating side respectively for IMS?

question_22115.question: What is the behavior of the network upon expiry of the mobile reachable timer when the UE is not registered for emergency services?
question_22115.ground_truth: The network stops sending paging messages to the UE on the first expiry and may take other appropriate actions. If the UE is registered for emergency services, the AMF sets the mobile reachable timer with a value equal to timer T3512 and locally de-registers the UE when the mobile reachable timer expires.

question_22117.question: What determines the size of the sensing window in the mode 2 sensing procedure of NR V2X?
question_22117.ground_truth: The sensing window in the mode 2 sensing procedure of NR V2X starts shortly after the trigger for (re-)selection of resources and cannot be longer than the remaining latency budget of the packet due to be transmitted.

question_22118.question: What is the agreed IM value for REFSENS and ICS in the RF parts and the BB, not including the antenna mismatch?
question_22118.ground_truth: The agreed IM value for REFSENS and ICS in the RF parts and the BB, not including the antenna mismatch is 2~dB.

question_22119.question: What is the procedure when the validity timer associated with a ProSe Response Code expires?
question_22119.ground_truth: When the validity timer associated with a ProSe Response Code expires, the ProSe Function removes the entry related to that ProSe Response Code from the UE context.

question_22120.question: What is the role of the PGW in the 7.7.3.1.4.4 UE-initiated IP Flow Mobility process?
question_22120.ground_truth: The PGW receives a Routing Rule request from the UE and forwards the requested IP flow mapping to an Access Type to the PCRF. It also creates/modifies/updates bearers on S5/S8 and/or S2a/S2b as needed.

question_22121.question: What is the difference in the QoS model between 4G EPS and 5GS?
question_22121.ground_truth: 4G EPS follows a rigid approach, with all traffic mapped to the same EPS bearer with the same packet forwarding treatment. 5GS uses a more flexible approach, with multiple different QoS flows within a PDU session.

question_22122.question: What is the role of the MBSR IAB-UE in determining the location of the TRP?
question_22122.ground_truth: The MBSR IAB-UE initiates a 5GC-MO-LR procedure to get its location information. The MBSR IAB-DU uses the MBSR IAB-UE's location info to determine the updated location for its TRP. The updated location of MBSR's TRP is then reported to the Donor-CU and further forwarded to LMF which uses the updated location of MBSR's TRP for calculation of the UE's position.

question_22123.question: What is the main goal of the Factories of the Future with the implementation of modular production systems?
question_22123.ground_truth: The main goal is to increase production flexibility and versatility, and to have powerful wireless communication and localization services for increasingly mobile production assets.

question_22125.question: What functionalities should the 3GPP network have while adapting the amount of resources allocated to unicast and broadcast in a flexible manner for LTE based TV service?
question_22125.ground_truth: The 3GPP network should allow the MNO to specify the amount of user plane radio resources dedicated to LTE based TV service, limit how much of these resources are used for broadcast and unicast, pre-define the maximum percentage to be used for unicast and broadcast at a time-resolution of one minute over a period of 24 hours, and automatically convert network unicast capacity to network broadcast capacity and vice versa.

question_22126.question: What should the value of s be for each cell which belongs to the serving E-DCH radio link set, in the case where the E-DCH control data is received in the E-RGCH frame associated with SFN i?
question_22126.ground_truth: The value of s should be 1, in the case where the E-DCH control data is received in the E-RGCH frame associated with SFN i.

question_22127.question: What is the procedure for restoration of profiles related to UDR in 6.7.2-1?
question_22127.ground_truth: The procedure for restoration of profiles related to UDR involves defining callbackUri for data restoration in the NF profile registered in NRF, storing temporary data in UDR, detecting corruption, loss, or inconsistency in temporary data, querying NRF based on the identity, discovering callbackUri for data restoration in UDR consumers' NF profiles, and forwarding notifications to UDM consumers.

question_22128.question: What should an MCVideo client do to act as the user agent for all MCVideo application transactions?
question_22128.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should initiate and manage group calls, as well as handle the MCVideo client ID as specified in clause 4.10.

question_22131.question: When does the MBMS client provide persistent storage for received files?
question_22131.ground_truth: The MBMS client only provides persistent storage for received files to ensure they are made available to the requesting application. Once files are moved to the application space, the application is responsible for managing them.

question_22132.question: What action does the source SN take when it receives the SN Release Request message from the MN in the MN initiated SN change procedure?
question_22132.ground_truth: The source SN stops providing user data to the UE and, if applicable, starts data forwarding.

question_22133.question: What should the UE (MCVideo Client) do when having an incoming On-demand Pre-arranged Group Call and implicit Transmission Control?
question_22133.ground_truth: The UE (MCVideo Client) receives a Media Transmission Notification message from the SS (MCVideo Server) and sends a Receive Media Request message to the SS (MCVideo Server) and respects the Reception Control imposed by the SS (MCVideo Server).

question_22134.question: What are the two options for the NWDAF to collect only valid UE location data within the exact target area?
question_22134.ground_truth: Option A: LCS scheme, where the LCS architecture provides valid UE location data when the UE is in the exact target area. Option B: NWDAF scheme, where the NWDAF makes the judgment and counts the valid UE location data.

question_22135.question: What is the difference between the "Adjacent Channel Leakage Ratio" (ACLR) and the "Out-of-band emission" (OOBE) in 3GPP technical specifications?
question_22135.ground_truth: Adjacent Channel Leakage Ratio (ACLR) is a measure of the unwanted signal emitted in the adjacent frequency band to the desired one and Out-of-band emission (OOBE) is a measure of the unwanted signal emitted in other than the desired frequency band.

question_22136.question: How many pairs of security associations are created and used during the IMS signalling handling in IPsec for IMS?
question_22136.ground_truth: During the IMS signalling handling two pairs of SAs consisting of four unidirectional SAs will be used, one pair of SAs between the server port of UE and the client port of the SS, and another pair of SAs between the client port of UE and the server port of the SS.

question_22138.question: What is the purpose of scrambling the output bits from FEC/interleaving in the downlink?
question_22138.ground_truth: The purpose of scrambling the output bits from FEC/interleaving is to randomize the inter-cell interference and reduce the potential impact of long sequences of identical bits.

question_22139.question: How much degradation in beam prediction accuracy is caused by the existing quantization granularity of L1-RSRP in BM-Case1 for inference of DL Tx beam with L1-RSRPs of all beams in Set B?
question_22139.ground_truth: The existing quantization granularity of L1-RSRP causes less than 5% beam prediction accuracy degradation in terms of Top-1 beam prediction accuracy in BM-Case1 for inference of DL Tx beam with L1-RSRPs of all beams in Set B.

question_22140.question: In what scenario is a single octet Ci bitmap used for the Truncated Enhanced BFR MAC CE, instead of a four octets Ci bitmap?
question_22140.ground_truth: A single octet Ci bitmap is used when the highest ServCellIndex of the MAC entity's SCell for which beam failure is detected, and the evaluation of the candidate beams has been completed is less than 8.

question_22143.question: What is the result of Step 3 in the remotely initiated MCPTT call request procedure if the MCPTT client 2 is not already affiliated to the MCPTT group?
question_22143.ground_truth: The MCPTT server implicitly affliates the MCPTT user 2 on MCPTT client 2 to the MCPTT group if the MCPTT client 2 is not already affiliated and notifies the MCPTT client 2 of this affiliation change.

question_22145.question: What is the system-dependent delay for Tsps?
question_22145.ground_truth: The system-dependent delay for Tsps is the delay of the speech encoder after reception of the last PCM sample until availability of the first encoded bit.

question_22146.question: What is the purpose of the NLe reference point in the SUPL location platform architecture?
question_22146.ground_truth: The NLe reference point is the interface between a SLP and an LMF in the SUPL location platform architecture.

question_22147.question: What reference points does MCPTT-6 use when the MCPTT service provider interacts with MBSF directly?
question_22147.ground_truth: MCPTT-6, utilizing Nmb10/MB2-C reference points, is used when the MCPTT service provider interacts with MBSF directly, either for interworking with LTE through MBSF/MBSTF or in full-service mode.

question_22148.question: What should the UE do if it receives the rejection cause "S-NSSAI not available due to maximum number of UEs reached" in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
question_22148.ground_truth: The UE should stop the timer T3526 associated with the S-NSSAI, if running, start a new timer T3526, and remove the S-NSSAI from the rejected NSSAI for the maximum number of UEs reached when the timer T3526 associated with the S-NSSAI expires.

question_22149.question: What should the UE do if it receives a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message with a corresponding Authorized QoS flow descriptions IE but no mapped EPS bearer context with a matching EPS bearer identity?
question_22149.ground_truth: The UE should send a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message including a Mapped EPS bearer contexts IE to delete the mapped EPS bearer context.

question_22150.question: What does the "rules" header field parameter in the "Resource-Share" header field parameter carry?
question_22150.ground_truth: The "rules" header field parameter in the "Resource-Share" header field parameter carries one or more rules for resource sharing. Each rule is included in the same order as the corresponding m-line in the SDP offer/answer and consists of a "new-sharing-key" that identifies a media stream in an existing ongoing session or is a new sharing key value when the UE is not already involved in a session subject for resource sharing. An optional "existing-sharing-key-list" is included if there are UEs already involved in sessions where the media-stream can be shared, and a "directionality" that indicates in which direction resource sharing applies.

question_22151.question: In the initial conditions section of the test procedure, what does "M" stand for in RF channels to be tested?
question_22151.ground_truth: "M" in RF channels to be tested stands for all the RF channels as defined in the 3GPP document.

question_22152.question: What must the UE use to respond to a valid NOTIFY for the registration event package?
question_22152.ground_truth: The UE must respond to a valid NOTIFY for the registration event package with 200 OK.

question_22153.question: What is denoted by S in the bit scrambling process?
question_22153.ground_truth: S is the number of bits input to the bit scrambling block, which is equal to the total number of bits on the CCTrCH.

question_22156.question: Which element of the XML schema allows specifying the duration of no-answer timeout for call forwarding when it is triggered by a condition?
question_22156.ground_truth: The "call-forwarding-no-answer-timeout" element specifies the duration of no-answer timeout for call forwarding when it is triggered by a condition.

question_22159.question: What defines a cell in GAN for the purpose of location services and billing?
question_22159.ground_truth: A cell in GAN for the purpose of location services and billing is defined by a Cell Global Identity (CGI), which is the concatenation of a Location Area Identity (LAI) and Cell Identity (CI).

question_22160.question: What is the difference between Terminating Identification Presentation (TIP) and Terminating Identification Restriction (TIR)?
question_22160.ground_truth: Both TIP and TIR are similar but TIR has an additional information element, the mode, which can be set to permanent or temporary with a default of presentation restricted or not restricted.

question_22161.question: What is the number of occasions used to estimate the Round-Trip Single-Path Delay (RSTD) measurement performance in section 6.3.1?
question_22161.ground_truth: One or two occasions are used to estimate the RSTD between cell1 and cell2 in section 6.3.1.

question_22162.question: What is the Resource Management function of the CRNC in FDD?
question_22162.ground_truth: The CRNC in FDD controls cell coverage by sending a maximum total RTWP value to the Node B, which reflects the total interference including contributions from all uplink traffic and external interferers. The scheduling should be such that the maximum total RTWP value is not exceeded. The CRNC may also send to the Node B the Reference Received Total Wideband Power (RTWP) and the target value of Non-serving E-DCH to total E-DCH power ratio per cell. The Node-B should not send down the E-DCH Reporting area if both of the criteria of the Target RTWP and the Non-serving E-DCH to total E-DCH power ratio are not met.

question_22164.question: What is the test purpose for Single Link Performance - QPSK/16QAM, Fixed Reference Channel (FRC) H-Set 1/2/3?
question_22164.ground_truth: The purpose of the Single Link Performance tests for H-Set 1/2/3 is to verify the ability of the receiver to receive a predefined test signal, representing a multi-path fading channel with information bit throughput R, while stressing the multicode reception and channel decoding with incremental redundancy.

question_22165.question: What is the P-value for SSB resources for an ATG UE with antenna array, if there are no gaps and SMTC occasions overlap some SSB resources?
question_22165.ground_truth: The P-value for SSB resources will be 1 if there are no GAPs or SMTC occasions that overlap any SSB resources.

question_22166.question: What is the subset of functionality that MCPTT UEs using non-3GPP access can support, compared to the full set of functionality supported by MCPTT UEs using 3GPP access?
question_22166.ground_truth: A subset of the full set of functionality

question_22169.question: What is the minimum requirement for the average downlink DPCH/Ior value in test 7.6.3.2?
question_22169.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for the average downlink DPCH/Ior value in test 7.6.3.2 is the same as those specified in clause E.3.3, regardless of Node Bs and the test cases.

question_22172.question: What is the role of the MS-BSS interface in the GSM PLMN?
question_22172.ground_truth: The MS-BSS interface in the GSM PLMN is the connection between the mobile station and the base station system, and it is specified to allow separate evolution of mobile stations and network equipment technologies.

question_22173.question: What is the purpose of the Service-level-AA container information element in the 5GMM-Connected mode?
question_22173.ground_truth: The Service-level-AA container information element is used to transfer upper layer information for authentication and authorization between the UE and the network.

question_22175.question: Where is the Default APN for Trusted WLAN and the list of Access Information for Trusted WLAN permanently stored?
question_22175.ground_truth: The Default APN for Trusted WLAN and the list of Access Information for Trusted WLAN are both permanently stored in the HSS and 3GPP AAA Server.

question_22176.question: What conditions should be met for the preferred primary precoding vector selection in the UE?
question_22176.ground_truth: The preferred primary precoding vector shall be applied to the secondary transport block if the UE indicates a preference for two transport blocks and the preferred primary precoding vector does not correspond to the highest reported CQI value.

question_22178.question: What is the action taken by an ME+ when it receives an indication to continue using the enhanced security context in a RAU Accept message from a serving network?
question_22178.ground_truth: The ME+ continues to use the enhanced security context.

question_22180.question: What is the role of the "serviceInteractionIndicatorsTwo" parameter in the "ConnectToResource" procedure?
question_22180.ground_truth: The "serviceInteractionIndicatorsTwo" parameter is used to control the through connection to the Calling Party in the "ConnectToResource" procedure.

question_22181.question: Which phase noise modelling approach is agreed upon by RAN4 for PUSCH requirements?
question_22181.ground_truth: RAN4 agreed that there should be no explicit phase noise modelling in the alignment results, and phase noise impact can be included in the impairment results, but it is left up to companies.

question_22182.question: What is the quantity replaced with in Clauses 8.1.1, 8.1.1, and 8.4 for sidelink transmission mode 1?
question_22182.ground_truth: The quantity 12/ is replaced with for sidelink transmission mode 1.

question_22183.question: What information is required to indicate the object(s) for which an ML model is requested?
question_22183.ground_truth: Target of ML Model Reporting parameter is used to indicate the object(s) for which an ML model is requested. It can include information about specific UEs, a group of UE(s), or any UE (i.e. all UEs). This information is optional when requesting an ML model.

question_22184.question: What network deployment scenarios should be taken into account for maritime communication in 3GPP?
question_22184.ground_truth: Network deployment scenarios for maritime communication should consider moving networks, isolated networks, or satellite access networks, as fixed mobile network deployments are used for most terrestrial mobile services.

question_22185.question: Who provides the EACI by using the parameter provisioning procedure to UDM for the LBO case?
question_22185.ground_truth: The AF in the visited PLMN provides the EACI by using the parameter provisioning procedure to UDM for the LBO case.

question_22186.question: What mode of operation is used for unacknowledged data transfer in LLC procedures?
question_22186.ground_truth: Unacknowledged mode of operation is used for unacknowledged data transfer in LLC procedures.

question_22188.question: What is the difference in average BD-rate reduction between H.265 (HEVC) and H.264 (AVC) for the low-to-medium bit-rate ranges in the set of tests?
question_22188.ground_truth: The difference in average BD-rate reduction was in the range of 27.4 - 45.3%.

question_22189.question: What identifies a swMProcess instance uniquely?
question_22189.ground_truth: The identifier of the swMProcess, which is identical to the identifier of the NE.

question_22190.question: What is the requirement for the CSI-RSRP measurement accuracy for all measured TPs as specified in sub-clauses 9.1.14.3?
question_22190.ground_truth: The CSI-RSRP measurement accuracy for all measured TPs shall be as specified in the sub-clauses 9.1.14.3.

question_22192.question: What action should the P-CSCF take when adding its own address to the Via header field?
question_22192.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should add its own address in a format that includes the port number, and either its FQDN or IP address.

question_22196.question: Which bands does the RAN4 requirements currently include for the PCell in FDD band for inter-band CA combination of Band 1, Band 41 and Band 41?
question_22196.ground_truth: The RAN4 requirements currently include the PCell in FDD band, i.e. band 1, for inter-band CA combination of Band 1, Band 41 and Band 41.

question_22197.question: What are the key features of the AR Enabled Immersive Experience use case?
question_22197.ground_truth: The key features of the AR Enabled Immersive Experience use case are a reliable transmission of uplink and downlink data, a way for users to synchronize their experience and interact together, continuity of data transmission in mobility scenarios, and a low demand on the environment and space of the user's location.

question_22198.question: What is the purpose of the signer's private key dA in the signature generation process?
question_22198.ground_truth: The signer's private key dA is used to calculate the value of s, which is one of the components of the signed message.

question_22199.question: What should the S-CSCF do if the "integrity-protected" header field parameter in the Authorization header field is set to "auth-done" in subclause 5.4.1.2.2E?
question_22199.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall only proceed with the following steps if the "integrity-protected" header field parameter is set to "auth-done".

question_22200.question: What is the impact of maintaining a diameter session for each PDN-Connection on the 3GPP AAA Servers?
question_22200.ground_truth: It can impose a big traffic load on some 3GPP AAA Servers over the S6b interface and potentially result in overloading and unavailability of the network entity.

question_22201.question: What are the two main abbreviations defined in the present document?
question_22201.ground_truth: The two abbreviations defined in the present document are "TSN" which stands for Time-Sensitive Networking and "TSC" which stands for Time Service Correction.

question_22202.question: What is the target for averaged user throughput per MHz in the downlink, compared to Release 6 HSDPA?
question_22202.ground_truth: The target for averaged user throughput per MHz in the downlink should be 3 to 4 times that of Release 6 HSDPA.

question_22203.question: What is the role of the NG-RAN in evaluating whether the UE is allowed to access the CAG cell?
question_22203.ground_truth: The NG-RAN checks that the UE provided hashed CAG ID matches one of the hashed supported CAG IDs, and may forward the decrypted CAG-ID to the AMF for further processing.

question_22205.question: What is the purpose of the MbsPpData data structure in the MBS Parameters Provisioning procedure for multicast MBS Session Authorization information provisioning?
question_22205.ground_truth: The MbsPpData data structure in the MBS Parameters Provisioning procedure for multicast MBS Session Authorization information provisioning contains the MBS Session Authorization information to be provisioned, encoded via the MbsSessAuthData data structure.

question_22206.question: What action should the NEF take if the UDR responds with an error message when the NEF sends a request to delete EAS Deployment Information?
question_22206.ground_truth: If the NEF receives an error message from the UDR when sending a request to delete EAS Deployment Information, the NEF should take proper error handling actions and respond to the AF with a proper error status code.

question_22207.question: What is the purpose of the BSSGP flow control model?
question_22207.ground_truth: The purpose of the BSSGP flow control model is to decide which LLC-PDUs are conforming to the flow to the PFC of an MS, to an MS or in a BSSGP virtual connection (BVC) over the Gb interface. It regulates the transmission of data by controlling the size of the bucket, the rate at which data is passed, and the time that data is delayed if the bucket limit is exceeded.

question_22208.question: What are the types of PDU sessions supported for 5G LAN-type services by the 5G network?
question_22208.ground_truth: The 5G network supports PDU sessions of IP PDU Session type or Ethernet PDU Session type for 5G LAN-type services.

question_22209.question: What should the MCPTT client store when initiating a private call?
question_22209.ground_truth: The MCPTT user ID of the callee as callee ID, the value of /<x>/<x>/Common/PrivateCall/Authorised or /<x>/<x>/Common/PrivateCall/ManualCommence as commencement mode, and a call type control state machine.

question_22210.question: How does the NG-RAN node determine the cell(s) in which the warning message is to be broadcast in the warning message delivery procedure?
question_22210.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node uses the Warning Area List NG-RAN information to determine the cell(s) in which the message is to be broadcast.

question_22211.question: What should the terminating UE do during session initiation if local resource reservation is required and the precondition mechanism is supported and enabled in the received INVITE request?
question_22211.ground_truth: The terminating UE should use the precondition mechanism and include a Require header field with the "precondition" option-tag in the responses that include an SDP body.

question_22212.question: How does a UE determine the schema version required to parse an instantiation of the Schedule Description?
question_22212.ground_truth: The UE uses the schema that has the highest schema version attribute value that is equal to or less than the value in the received schemaVersion element.

question_22213.question: How many satellites are required to be visible for BDS (including GEO, IGSO, and MEO) in Assisted GNSS minimum performance testing?
question_22213.ground_truth: In Assisted GNSS minimum performance testing, for BDS constellation, 5 GEO, 3 IGSO and 27 MEO Satellites of BDS should be visible, in total 35 satellites. But, we test using signals for only 6 satellites or 7 if SBAS is included.

question_22214.question: What is the minimum number of static power control steps required for each supported modulation?
question_22214.ground_truth: The minimum number of static power control steps required for each supported modulation is Nmax with respect to the declared output power of the manufacturer. For the modulation with the highest output power, Nmax shall be at least 6.

question_22216.question: What is the purpose of the "MTA Signature" option in the RLC data block method?
question_22216.ground_truth: The "MTA Signature" option in the RLC data block method is used to verify the integrity of the location estimated from the MTA positioning method.

question_22217.question: What is the purpose of generating a quintet in the HLR/AuC?
question_22217.ground_truth: In the HLR/AuC, a quintet is generated for the purpose of authentication and key derivation, consisting of RAND, XRES, CK, IK, and AUTN. If the sequence number is to be concealed, an additional anonymity key AK is generated and used to compute the concealed sequence number.

question_22218.question: What is the purpose of the receiptRequest optional parameter?
question_22218.ground_truth: The receiptRequest optional parameter is specified when the application requires to receive notification of the status of the broadcast message delivery.

question_22220.question: What information does the SFN Offset IE contain?
question_22220.ground_truth: The SFN Offset IE contains the time offset between an absolute time reference and the SFN0 start in an X2AP message.

question_22221.question: What is the time duration of available PRS resources in the positioning frequency layer i, to be measured during, and is calculated in the same way as PRS duration K defined in clause 5.1.6.5 of TS 38.214?
question_22221.ground_truth: TPRS,i is the time duration of available PRS resources in the positioning frequency layer i, to be measured during, and is calculated in the same way as PRS duration K defined in clause 5.1.6.5 of TS 38.214, for calculation of, only the PRS resources unmuted and fully or partially overlapped with MG are considered.

question_22222.question: What is the procedure for UE-to-UE Relay discovery Model B?
question_22222.ground_truth: The procedure for UE-to-UE Relay discovery Model B involves UE-1 performing the Group Member Discovery procedure and discovering its neighbours. UE-1 then realizes that the group member of interest is not within direct range and solicits potential UE-to-UE Relays by transmitting the Solicitation message. UE-R, in the role of Discoveree, realizes that it can act as a UE-to-UE Relay and replies with a Response message. UE-1 then establishes a one-to-one communication link with UE-R and engages in communication with UE-2 via UE-R.

question_22223.question: What should the MS do when it receives a message with an unrecognized transaction identifier?
question_22223.ground_truth: The MS should ignore messages with the transaction identifier value set to "111". If the transaction identifier value is not "111", it should follow different procedures depending on the type of message received.

question_22224.question: What is the difference between an MCX Service Emergency Group Communication and an MCX Service Imminent Peril Group Communication?
question_22224.ground_truth: An MCX Service Emergency Group Communication provides the user elevated priority towards obtaining resources of the MCX Service system for a personal, life-threatening situation, while an MCX Service Imminent Peril Group Communication is initiated by an MCX User to assist other MCX Users or persons of the general public who are in trouble and may soon need assistance.

question_22225.question: What action is taken if a UE sends an ORIGINATE message but receives no RECEIVING messages in response?
question_22225.ground_truth: If a UE sends an ORIGINATE message but receives no RECEIVING messages, it can either wait for an opportunity to communicate or if pre-emption is supported, attempt to pre-empt an existing communication.

question_22226.question: What does the PIN Management Client send if the processing of the request was successful in indicating service continuity response?
question_22226.ground_truth: The PIN Management Client sends a PIN Management PEGC Service Continuity response indicating that the request processing was successful.

question_22227.question: What is the minimum number of times the element "v2x-service-id" can appear in the "tV2vCommunicationAssistanceInfoType" complex type?
question_22227.ground_truth: The element "v2x-service-id" can appear only zero or one time in the "tV2vCommunicationAssistanceInfoType" complex type.

question_22228.question: What is the Key Performance Indicator (KPI) used for evaluating the capacity of NR systems for XR applications?
question_22228.ground_truth: System capacity, identified as the maximum number of users per cell with at least Y % of UEs being satisfied, is used as the KPI for capacity evaluations.

question_22229.question: In what circumstances can the MS postpone periodic attempts during idle mode?
question_22229.ground_truth: Periodic attempts may be postponed by the MS while in power saving mode (PSM) or while receiving eMBMS transport service in idle mode.

question_22231.question: Under what circumstances should the MS consider SIM invalid for non-GPRS services?
question_22231.ground_truth: If the network accepts the GPRS attach procedure, but GMM cause code 'IMSI unknown in HLR' is sent to the MS, the MS should delete the stored TMSI, LAI, and CKSN.

question_22232.question: What is considered a "verified" BSIC for a GSM cell?
question_22232.ground_truth: The BSIC of a GSM cell is considered "verified" if the UE has decoded the SCH of the BCCH carrier and identified the BSIC for a GSM cell at least one time. Once a GSM cell has been identified, the BSIC shall be re-confirmed at least once every 30 seconds. Otherwise, the BSIC of the GSM cell is considered "non-verified."

question_22234.question: What is the result if the UE does not support the P-CSCF restoration extension for TWAN or the TWAN does not support the new WLCP PDN connection modification procedure?
question_22234.ground_truth: The P-GW will release the IMS PDN disconnection and proceed with the basic P-CSCF restoration mechanism.

question_22235.question: What shall the UE do when the MS determined PLMN with disaster condition cannot be determined and the UE includes the Additional GUTI IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message?
question_22235.ground_truth: The UE shall not include the MS determined PLMN with disaster condition IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and shall include the Additional GUTI IE as specified in subclauses 5.5.1.2.2 when the MS determined PLMN with disaster condition cannot be determined and the UE includes the Additional GUTI IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

question_22236.question: What is the measurement that provides the number of RLC blocks sent by the RNC including retransmitted blocks called?
question_22236.ground_truth: The measurement is named RLC.NbrBlocksSent and has different suffixes for each Mode: TM, UM, and AM.

question_22237.question: What is the role of the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay in transmitting MC service media to the remote MC service client?
question_22237.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay is responsible for transmitting the MC service media to the remote MC service client using unicast delivery.

question_22238.question: What should the network do if it receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message with a protocol error?
question_22238.ground_truth: The network should return a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with one of the EMM cause values: invalid mandatory information element error, information element non-existent or not implemented, conditional IE error, or protocol error, unspecified.

question_22239.question: What is the difference between OCS and Ro in 3GPP networks?
question_22239.ground_truth: OCS is a 3GPP Diameter application that is used for Northbound Application Program Interfaces (API) offline and online charging, while Ro is a reference point between the SCEF and the CDF that covers all online charging functionality required for SCEF.

question_22241.question: What is the maximum file size that can be transmitted using the MCData-FD-1 reference point?
question_22241.ground_truth: The file size that can be transmitted using the MCData-FD-1 reference point depends on the capabilities provided by MCData-FD-1, such as payload or transmission limits.

question_22242.question: In the context of 5G system, what is the role of the KMSKeyProv request in the procedure for provisioning identity-specific key material?
question_22242.ground_truth: The KMSKeyProv request is used to obtain new key material from the KMS and may contain details of a specific identity, such as an MCPTT ID, and a specific time for which the key material is required.

question_22243.question: In the context of uci-MuxWithDiffPrio, what is the priority index of UCI when HARQ-ACK and CG-UCI/UTO-UCI have the same priority index and are jointly encoded and transmitted on a PUSCH?
question_22243.ground_truth: The priority index of UCI is the same as that of CG-UCI or UTO-UCI when HARQ-ACK and CG-UCI/UTO-UCI have the same priority index and are jointly encoded and transmitted on a PUSCH.

question_22245.question: How many TTI pointers can a new HS-SCCH format contain for HS-DSCH semi-persistent scheduling transmission?
question_22245.ground_truth: A new HS-SCCH format for HS-DSCH semi-persistent scheduling transmission contains one TTI pointer.

question_22246.question: Which resource URI variables are supported by the Nssai resource?
question_22246.ground_truth: The Nssai resource supports the resource URI variables <apiRoot>, <apiVersion>, and <supi>.

question_22249.question: What procedure is used for seamless session continuity for single registration mode UEs?
question_22249.ground_truth: N26 interface is used to provide seamless session continuity for single registration mode UE, with IP address preservation by assuming SSC mode 1.

question_22252.question: What is the purpose of the "anonymous" element in the simservs document?
question_22252.ground_truth: The "anonymous" element in the simservs document evaluates to true only when the conditions as set out in clause 4.5.2.6.2 for asserted originating public user identity apply.

question_22254.question: What is the significance of small data packets in the context of 3GPP access?
question_22254.ground_truth: Small data packets, when transmitted over 3GPP access, can result in suboptimal delivery due to the addition of ROHC and other overheads. This trend is expected to continue as mobile data apps generate more small packets over time.

question_22255.question: What is the requirement for the last CSI report during SCell deactivation?
question_22255.ground_truth: The last CSI report should be received by the SS earlier than or equal to subframe (n+8) during SCell deactivation, and there are different criteria for intra-band and inter-band CA UE.

question_22256.question: What MIME body should be included in the SIP INVITE request when establishing an MCVideo session?
question_22256.ground_truth: The SIP INVITE request should contain an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the <mcvideoinfo> element containing the <mcvideo-Params> element with the <session-type> element set to a value of "private".

question_22257.question: What nodes need to be modified to support the "Notify on UE Reachability after DDN Failure" option?
question_22257.ground_truth: The HSS must be modified to support the "Notify on UE Reachability after DDN Failure" option, and the MME/SGSN must also be modified to receive, store, check, and notify based on this option.

question_22258.question: In what conditions will the AMF provide a List of equivalent PLMNs to the UE?
question_22258.ground_truth: The AMF will provide a List of equivalent PLMNs to the UE if the UE is registered in a PLMN and the AMF has the information available.

question_22259.question: What is the format of the E-CIDMeasurementInitiationFailure message, which is used when there is a failure to initiate a measurement?
question_22259.ground_truth: The E-CIDMeasurementInitiationFailure message is a sequence consisting of protocolIEs, which is a ProtocolIE-Container for E-CIDMeasurementInitiationFailure-IEs.

question_22260.question: What is the abbreviation for IMS based P2P Content Distribution Services?

question_22262.question: What does the USCH transport channel support in the context of UMTS?
question_22262.ground_truth: The USCH transport channel supports USCH data streams in UMTS.

question_22264.question: What should the M-HC do if it is operating in U mode and a context relocation of RFC3095 header compression protocol is to be applied?
question_22264.ground_truth: The M-HC should transit to FO state and send IR-DYN to re-synchronise the dynamic part of the uplink context.

question_22265.question: What should the MS do if the back-off timer is not provided in the REQUEST MBMS CONTEXT ACTIVATION message?
question_22265.ground_truth: If the back-off timer is not provided, then the MS shall ignore the Re-attempt indicator IE provided by the network and may send an Activate MBMS Context Request message for the same APN in the new PLMN if the back-off timer is not running and not deactivated for the MBMS context activation procedure.

question_22266.question: What is the purpose of the MBS session deactivation procedure?
question_22266.ground_truth: The MBS session deactivation procedure is used for deactivating the resources for MBS data at the NG-RAN node, and it can be triggered by the MB-SMF when there is no downlink data to be transmitted for a certain duration, or when it receives a request directly from the AF or NEF.

question_22267.question: What does the V-PCF do after it receives the updated policy information from the H-PCF in step 4?
question_22267.ground_truth: The V-PCF makes the policy decision considering the updated Policy Control Request Trigger(s) and/or updated UE Policy, if applicable. If the "FeatureRenegotiation" feature is supported, the V-PCF re-evaluates the negotiated features.

question_22268.question: What is the purpose of the procedure described in 6.10.1.1.5, MCData user to LMR user SDS request?
question_22268.ground_truth: The procedure describes the case where an MCData user initiates a one-to-one MCData data communication for sending a standalone SDS data to an LMR user over the signalling plane with or without a disposition request.

question_22269.question: When will the UE consider the ThreshBackhRateDLWLANLow node as matching when the ThreshBackhRateDLWLANLowRAN node is present?
question_22269.ground_truth: If the ThreshBackhRateDLWLANLowRAN node is present and the ThreshBackhRateDLWLANLow threshold value has been received from E-UTRAN/UTRAN, the UE shall consider this node as matching if the measurement value of backhaul available downlink bandwidth is smaller than the ThreshBackhRateDLWLANLow threshold value.

question_22273.question: What is the purpose of the Non-3GPP Message Gateway translating the MSGin5G message to a Non-3GPP message?
question_22273.ground_truth: The purpose of the Non-3GPP Message Gateway translating the MSGin5G message to a Non-3GPP message is that the procedure to translate an MSGin5G message to a Non-3GPP message is out of scope for 3GPP.

question_22274.question: When is it required for the UE to respond by performing a detach procedure, if the EPS bearer indicated in the DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message is the default EPS bearer of the last PDN connection that the UE has?
question_22274.ground_truth: If EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is not supported by the UE or the MME, the UE shall respond by performing a detach procedure. Additionally, the UE should perform an attach procedure.

question_22276.question: What does the PCEF do when the AF requests to report on IP-CAN bearer level events?
question_22276.ground_truth: The PCEF shall report the IP-CAN bearer level events as requested by the AF and cancel the request when the AF ceases handling the user.

question_22277.question: Who is the parent company of the SeaQueen?

question_22278.question: What is the purpose of the "ID" node in the video adaptation parameters?
question_22278.ground_truth: The "ID" node in the video adaptation parameters is a leaf node that represents the identification number of a set of parameters related to video adaptation. It is recommended to have at least a node, for example, ID, TAG, or implementation-specific ones, for the identification purpose such that each set of parameters can be distinguished and accessed.

question_22280.question: What is the purpose of the DSO-MS reading information from the SiteOp-MS exposed 3GPP management system MnS Producer's exposed interfaces on a regular basis?
question_22280.ground_truth: The DSO-MS is aware of which base stations each of the DSO's UE camps on and which base stations rely on which Distribution Substation. By reading information regularly, it is informed about the status of the base stations, the UEs, and the distribution substations.

question_22281.question: What is the counter for in the measurement type "HSUPA.AttEdchAddUESide"?
question_22281.ground_truth: The number of attempted radio link additions to the E-DCH active set (UE side).

question_22282.question: When should the UE use PUCCH format 4 and PUCCCH resource with more than 22 HARQ-ACK bits?
question_22282.ground_truth: The UE should use PUCCH format 4 when the total number of HARQ-ACK bits, scheduling request bit (if any), and periodic CSI bits (if any) is more than 22.

question_22283.question: What is the basic requirement for different DRBs in the IP test model?
question_22283.ground_truth: Different DRBs should not use the same sockets in the IP test model.

question_22284.question: What happens when the SUPI authorization is revoked in 5G networks?
question_22284.ground_truth: When the SUPI authorization is revoked, the Network Slice-Specific authorization is also revoked.

question_22285.question: What is the role of the MME in the "Obtaining Non-UE Associated Network Assistance Data" procedure?
question_22285.ground_truth: The MME in this procedure acts as a mediator between the E-SMLC and eNodeB. It receives the Network Positioning Information message from the E-SMLC and forwards it to the eNodeB in a S1-AP Transport Message.
