question_22624.ground_truth: In off-network, floor control is performed using floor control messages among the MCPTT clients without a centralized floor arbitrator. The MCPTT client currently speaking serves as the temporary floor arbitrator. All other MCPTT clients in the call play the role of floor participant. When the floor arbitrator grants the floor to another MCPTT client, that new MCPTT client, with a media session active, becomes the new floor arbitrator and the former becomes a floor participant.

question_22625.question: What action does the CBC take upon reception of the Stop Warning Confirm messages from the MMEs in the warning message cancel procedure?
question_22625.ground_truth: The CBC may confirm to the CBE that it has initiated the Warning message cancel procedure.

question_22627.question: What is one solution to the issue of PSC confusion in HetNets?
question_22627.ground_truth: One solution is to extend the size of the Neighbour Cell List (NCL) to include all small cells in the area, allowing the user equipment (UE) to report each detected small cell to the network side.

question_22629.question: What should the UDM do after checking the parameters in step 4 if the check fails?
question_22629.ground_truth: The UDM should provide a cause value indicating the reason for failure condition to the NEF in step 4 if the check fails.

question_22630.question: What is one of the functions of the TDF in the IP-CAN Session Modification procedure?
question_22630.ground_truth: The TDF provides all new ADC decisions to the TDF in step 11, which may include ADC Rules activation, deactivation, and modification for traffic steering control over Sd.

question_22631.question: How can the MME/SGSN use Load Control Information during PDN GW or Serving GW selection?
question_22631.ground_truth: The MME/SGSN supporting GTP-C Load Control feature uses Load Control Information during PDN GW or Serving GW selection by considering the Load Control Information as a parameter for PDN GW Selection and Serving GW Selection.

question_22632.question: What is the minimum downlink rate on DPCH for the combination described in 7.4.6.2?

question_22633.question: What is the data type and corresponding 3GPP clause for the "allow-create-delete-user-alias" element?
question_22633.ground_truth: The data type for the "allow-create-delete-user-alias" element is Boolean, and it corresponds to the "AuthorisedAlias" element in clause 10.2.14 in 3GPP TS 24.483.

question_22634.question: What is required in the SIP INVITE request when the inviting MCPTT client requests automatic commencement mode at the invited MCPTT client and the MCPTT user has not requested it?
question_22634.ground_truth: The SIP INVITE request should include an Answer-Mode header field with the value "Auto".

question_22635.question: What is the recommended mechanism for IRPManager and IRPAgent to recover from alarm loss?
question_22635.ground_truth: The recommended mechanism for IRPManager and IRPAgent to recover from alarm loss is the use of the getAlarmList operation, which is not specified in detail in the document.

question_22637.question: What is the general approach used by the group control system to resolve and arbitrate floor control requests between MCPTT and LMR systems?
question_22637.ground_truth: The group control system manages floor control requests from group members between two systems and determines the action, e.g., receiving, granting, denying requests, and revoking floor. The controlling system of the group communication manages the floor control requests from group members between MCPTT and LMR systems and determines the action.

question_22638.question: What functionalities are required for charging in WLAN access?
question_22638.ground_truth: The WLAN Access Network should be able to report the WLAN access usage to the appropriate 3GPP system, control a specific ongoing WLAN access session for online charging purposes, maintain a single prepaid account for WLAN, PS, CS, and IMS for a user, process the WLAN access resource usage information, convert it into the format used in 3GPP networks, correlate charging and accounting records generated in WLAN Access related nodes and records generated in 3GPP nodes, and apply offline charging and online charging mechanisms for WLAN interworking with 3GPP network.

question_22639.question: Which parameters are required for E-UTRAN access for periodic or triggered event reporting?
question_22639.ground_truth: For E-UTRAN access, the required parameters are locationEstimate, velocityEstimate, and locationInfo.

question_22640.question: What is the role of the TSCTSF in the 5G System with respect to time synchronization?
question_22640.ground_truth: The TSCTSF controls the DS-TT(s) and NW-TT for the (g)PTP based time synchronization service and supports TSC assistance container related functionalities.

question_22641.question: What does the old MME/old SGSN do if it receives a Context Acknowledge message from the new MME with ISR Activated indicated?
question_22641.ground_truth: If ISR Activated is indicated, the old S4 SGSN maintains its UE context including authentication quintets and stops the timer started in step 4. Additionally, it restarts the Implicit Detach timer with a slightly larger value than the UE's GERAN/UTRAN Deactivate ISR timer, if it is running.

question_22642.question: What should the ICS UE consider as terminated when it receives an I1 Success message from the SCC AS during a service control transfer while retaining the existing CS bearer and associated media intact?
question_22642.ground_truth: The ICS UE should consider the SIP dialog on the Source Access Leg that was originally set using the Gm reference point and all remaining PS media associated with this SIP dialog as terminated.

question_22643.question: When should the UE perform the Random Access Resource selection procedure again?
question_22643.ground_truth: The UE should perform the Random Access Resource selection procedure again if all received Random Access Responses contain Random Access Preamble identifiers that do not match the transmitted Random Access Preamble, or if no Random Access Response is received within the RA Response window.

question_22644.question: What should the UE do if the security check is not successful in step 5 and it is in automatic network selection mode?
question_22644.ground_truth: If the UE has a SOR-CMCI stored in the non-volatile memory of the ME, it shall apply the actions in clause~C.4.2, otherwise, it shall wait until it moves to idle mode or 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication before attempting to obtain service on a higher priority PLMN or SNPN.

question_22645.question: What is the requirement for the ME's response to an AT Command contained within a RUN AT COMMAND with bold text attribute?
question_22645.ground_truth: The ME shall respond as though the command were initiated by an attached TE, and return an AT Response within a TERMINAL RESPONSE to the UICC.

question_22646.question: What is the purpose of the PS Handover Procedure?
question_22646.ground_truth: The PS Handover Procedure is used to handover an MS with one or more packet flows from a source cell to a target cell, when at least one of the cells is a GERAN cell. It is used to allocate radio resources in the target cell and signal system information to the MS, as well as to perform the RAU procedure even if the RAI has not changed.

question_22647.question: What is the purpose of the FREQUENCY REDEFINITION message in this test?
question_22647.ground_truth: The purpose of the FREQUENCY REDEFINITION message is to verify that the MS correctly starts using the new frequencies and hopping sequence when some E-GSM or R-GSM or ER-GSM frequencies are used.

question_22648.question: Under what condition(s) can an MBMS capable mobile station receive one or more broadcast/multicast sessions on up to 5 contiguous timeslots within a TDMA frame, and at the same time listen to the (P)BCCH and (P)CCCH?
question_22648.ground_truth: The PDCH where PBCCH/PCCCH is mapped on must be adjacent to the other PDCHs assigned for the MBMS radio bearer(s), and the same frequency parameters must apply over the 5 PDCHs.

question_22652.question: What is the minimum requirement for the transmitter intermodulation level in a single-band BS?
question_22652.ground_truth: The transmitter intermodulation level is the power of the intermodulation products when an interfering signal reaches the transmitter via the antenna.

question_22655.question: What is the role of the DRA in the routing of Diameter messages in a PLMN?
question_22655.ground_truth: The DRA is used for routing Diameter messages towards the right Diameter realm in a PLMN, based on standard Diameter realm-based routing. The UE's IP address or PDN information is used to assist routing PCC messages to the appropriate Diameter realm.

question_22656.question: What is the meaning of the '0' value of the Queued Floor Requests Purpose field?
question_22656.ground_truth: The '0' value of the Queued Floor Requests Purpose field indicates a Cancel Request.

question_22657.question: What is the role of the EIR in the IMEI check process?
question_22657.ground_truth: The EIR is responsible for performing the IMEI check in the IMEI check process. It receives the request from the 3GPP AAA server and sends the ME Identity Check Ack (Result) back to it.

question_22658.question: What is the associated service type of an sos-URN in the 3GPP system?
question_22658.ground_truth: An sos-URN in the 3GPP system is associated with the top level service type of "sos" as specified in IETF RFC 5031.

question_22659.question: What is an MCVideo user in the context of MCVideo group?
question_22659.ground_truth: An MCVideo user is a user who is affiliated to an MCVideo group.

question_22661.question: For protocol testing in FDD and TDD intra- and inter-frequency cell environment, which cells are used?

question_22662.question: What is the maximum possible size in bits of the uncompressed reported bitmap in the acknowledgement message when no compressed bitmap is included?

question_22663.question: What is the maximum time allowed for the UE to start to transmit the CQI to cell 2 after receiving a RRC message implying HS-DSCH cell change?
question_22663.ground_truth: The UE shall start to transmit the CQI to cell 2 based on the quality of cell 2 less than 74 ms from the beginning of time period T4.

question_22666.question: What is the abbreviation used for Occupied Band Width?

question_22668.question: What conformance requirement should the Mobile Station meet if the network rejects a GPRS attach procedure with the cause 'PLMN not allowed'?
question_22668.ground_truth: The Mobile Station shall not perform GPRS attach when switched on in the same routing area or location area, delete the stored RAI, GPRS-CKSN, P-TMSI, and P-TMSI signature, and store the PLMN in the 'forbidden PLMN' list.

question_22670.question: In which scenarios is indirect data forwarding applied during handover?
question_22670.ground_truth: Indirect data forwarding is applied during handover in roaming and Home-routed cases.

question_22672.question: When is a PLMN ID reported and what does it provide?
question_22672.ground_truth: PLMN ID is reported when the target UE is roaming. It provides the vPLMN ID when the target UE is roaming.

question_22673.question: What happens when the Transit Function receives an initial or standalone request?
question_22673.ground_truth: The Transit Function sets up the list of Transit Invocation Criteria for the request, parses the received request to find Service Point Triggers, checks if the trigger points of the Transit Invocation Criteria are matched by the SPTs of the request, adds an Original Dialog Identifier (ODI) to the request, and forwards the request via the ISC interface to the Application Server.

question_22674.question: What is the maximum number of bits that can be punctured to minimize the number of physical channels, as signaled from higher layers, known as?

question_22676.question: What are the units of Power Spectral Density (PSD) and what do they represent?
question_22676.ground_truth: The units of PSD are extensively used in the document and they represent the mean power in a given bandwidth. When normalised to the chip-rate, it represents the mean energy per chip.

question_22679.question: What is required for a MnS producer to register its management capabilities in the 3GPP management system?
question_22679.ground_truth: A MnS producer is required to register its management capabilities (including the endpoint address) at the MnS discovery service producer for use by MnS consumers wishing to interact with these MnS producers.

question_22680.question: What is the difference between the Downlink Shared Channel (DL-SCH) and the Uplink Shared Channel (UL-SCH) in terms of features?
question_22680.ground_truth: The DL-SCH is characterized by support for HARQ, dynamic link adaptation, broadcast in the entire cell, beamforming, dynamic and semi-static resource allocation, and UE discontinuous reception, while the UL-SCH is characterized by support for beamforming, dynamic link adaptation, HARQ, and dynamic and semi-static resource allocation.

question_22681.question: What should the UE do if the transmission failure of TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message indication is received from lower layers?
question_22681.ground_truth: The UE should abort the tracking area updating procedure and re-initiate it immediately. The UE should also set the EPS update status to EU2 NOT UPDATED.

question_22683.question: What information is required to activate media interception at the CC-POI?
question_22683.ground_truth: To activate media interception at the CC-POI, the CC-TF sends an ActivateTask message over the LI_T3 interface that includes the IP address and UDP port number of the media stream, as well as additional identifiers such as the H248ContextID and TriggerScope.

question_22684.question: What functions do SMF/UPF need to support in DHCP procedures as per RFC 3315?
question_22684.ground_truth: SMF/UPF need to support DHCPV6 NA and PD.

question_22685.question: What does aggregationLevel8-r16 ENUMERATED in the Search DCI-GroupType-r16 sequence signify?
question_22685.ground_truth: The search space element refers to the list of IDs of the cells or SCGs to search for in aggregated format 8 for the dependency size 1 RNTI.

question_22686.question: What is the purpose of the System Time fragment in ATSC 3.0 Low Level Signaling?
question_22686.ground_truth: The System Time fragment carries auxiliary, time-related information with respect to the system time delivered in the ATSC 3.0 PHY layer, including time offsets, leap second information, and Daylight Savings Time status.

question_22687.question: What is the main design target for an LAA system regarding coexistence with Wi-Fi?
question_22687.ground_truth: The LAA design should target fair coexistence with existing Wi-Fi networks to not impact Wi-Fi services more than an additional Wi-Fi network on the same carrier, with respect to throughput and latency.

question_22688.question: What does the term "360-degree video" mean in the context of this specification?
question_22688.ground_truth: The term "360-degree video" refers to a real-world visual scene captured by a set of cameras or a camera device with multiple lenses and sensors covering the sphere in all directions around the center point of the camera set or camera device. This specification also uses the term to include limited 360-degree video, which covers only a part of the sphere around the center point.

question_22692.question: What does the "NRCellCU" in the measurement names stand for?
question_22692.ground_truth: "NRCellCU" in the measurement names stands for NR Cell Congestion Userplane. It represents the NR cell congestion in userplane.

question_22693.question: What are the key functionalities introduced in the NR SON and MDT support work item?
question_22693.ground_truth: The key functionalities introduced in the NR SON and MDT support work item include MRO, MLB, RACH optimization, MDT, and L2 measurements. It also includes the specification of new specification TS~38.314: L2 measurements for NR.

question_22696.question: What should be the measurement reporting delay for a successful test for Test 1 and Test 2?
question_22696.ground_truth: For Test 1, the measurement reporting delay should be less than 6.4 s, and for Test 2, it should be less than 51.2 s.

question_22697.question: What is the purpose of the notation "Note 1" in Solution #8?
question_22697.ground_truth: The notation "Note 1" in Solution #8 indicates that the implementation details of encoding the required information in the OAuth access token are not specified in the solution and will be addressed in stage 3.

question_22698.question: Under which conditions do the intra-frequency absolute CSI-RSRP measurement accuracy requirements apply?
question_22698.ground_truth: These requirements apply under the following conditions: CSI reference signals in discovery signal occasions are transmitted on one antenna port only from each TP, conditions defined in 36.101 Clause 7.3 for reference sensitivity are fulfilled, CSI-RSRP is as specified in Annex B.3.21.3 for a corresponding Band, the discovery signal occasion does not contain any MBSFN subframe and contains at least two CSI REs per resource block within the measured bandwidth in two adjacent slots of the same or different subframes.

question_22699.question: What is the encoding mechanism used in the short message?

question_22700.question: What does end-to-middle security (e2m security) represent in the context of 3GPP's security architecture(s)?
question_22700.ground_truth: End-to-middle security (e2m security) refers to security between an UE and a server that is not the communication endpoint, and it can reside in the HPLMN or a third-party network.

question_22701.question: What functionality should the 3GPP system support regarding authentication and network access?
question_22701.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall support an authentication process that can handle alternative authentication methods with different types of credentials to allow for different deployment scenarios such as industrial factory automation. The 3GPP system shall also be able to provide means to verify whether a UE is authorized to use prioritized access for transport of data for critical service.

question_22702.question: When is a Routeing Area Update performed in an attached MS?
question_22702.ground_truth: A Routeing Area Update is performed when an attached MS detects that it has entered a new RA, the periodic RA update timer has expired, RRC connection is released with cause "Directed Signalling connection re-establishment", the MS has to indicate changed access capabilities or new DRX parameters to the network, the MS reselects GERAN/UTRAN with the TIN indicating "GUTI", or the RRC layer in an E-UTRAN capable UE informs the UE's NAS layer that an RRC connection failure occurred in E-UTRAN and this led the MS to select a GERAN/UTRAN cell.

question_22703.question: What are the conformance requirements referred to in this test description?
question_22703.ground_truth: The conformance requirements are specified in TS 36.331, clause 5.3.5.3, TS 38.331, clauses 5.3.5.3, 5.3.5.5.7, 5.3.5.6.4 and 5.3.5.6.5. These are Rel-15 requirements.

question_22704.question: What are the two signaling methods described in section 6.1.2 for supporting irregular channels in the DL?
question_22704.ground_truth: The two methods described are using a larger channel bandwidth, broadcast in SIB1, and using a smaller channel bandwidth during initial access, and then switching to a larger bandwidth once the RRC connection is established.

question_22705.question: What type of multimedia messaging service is supported in 3GPP networks?
question_22705.ground_truth: The following types of multimedia messaging services are supported in 3GPP networks: store-and-forward multimedia messaging service with mobile and non-mobile users, and MMS capable of supporting integration of different types of messaging in a consistent manner.

question_22706.question: What is the requirement for the 5G system regarding proximity-based work task offloading?
question_22706.ground_truth: The 5G system should collect charging information and support service continuity for proximity-based work task offloading.

question_22707.question: What is the conformance requirement related to the transmission of RLC data blocks in the RLC unacknowledged mode in 3GPP TS 04.60?
question_22707.ground_truth: The conformance requirement is that the transfer of RLC data blocks in the RLC unacknowledged mode does not include any retransmissions, except during the release of an uplink TBF where the last transmitted uplink block may be retransmitted.

question_22708.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP technical report on SUL and LTE-NR DC with SUL in Rel-15 time frame?
question_22708.ground_truth: The purpose is to gather relevant background information and studies in order to address SUL and LTE-NR DC with SUL for the Rel-15 bands/band combinations.

question_22710.question: What is the procedure for E-UTRAN Initial Attach in H(e)NB Interworking Architecture Alternative 2?
question_22710.ground_truth: The procedure for E-UTRAN Initial Attach in H(e)NB Interworking Architecture Alternative 2 includes the HeNB sending the outer IP address of the IPSec tunnel and the FQDN of the BPCF in UE associated S1 signalling. The MME also includes HeNB Tunnel-Info and FQDN of BPCF in the Create Session Request sent to the Serving GW, and the PDN GW includes it when the HeNB connects to the BBF access network.

question_22711.question: What is the benefit of the solution for protecting RAN from signalling overload caused by misbehaving UEs?
question_22711.ground_truth: The RAN can protect itself from draining resource caused by massive malicious CIoT UEs without any UE change, ensuring RAN usability and mitigating unnecessary complaint caused by misinformation.

question_22712.question: What is the name of the sub-element within the <RulesForAffiliation> element that specifies the location-related criteria of a rule?

question_22713.question: What are the types of keys used for protecting MCData signalling payloads?
question_22713.ground_truth: Unicast MCData signalling payloads between client and server are protected using the CSK, multicast MCData signalling payloads from server to client are protected using a MuSiK, MCData signalling payloads between servers are protected using the SPK, MCData signalling payloads between two offline clients are protected using a PCK, and MCData signalling payloads between a group of offline clients are protected using a GMK.

question_22714.question: How does the SRNC obtain the IP Multicast address and APN for a specific MBMS service?
question_22714.ground_truth: The SRNC requests these from the SGSN using the connectionless RANAP Uplink Information Exchange Request message.

question_22716.question: What is the purpose of the Remaining Minimum Periodic Location Reporting Time in 3GPP TS 29.336?
question_22716.ground_truth: The Remaining Minimum Periodic Location Reporting Time indicates the current value of the timer for minimum periodic location reporting. The target MME/SGSN shall use this value to detect location changes and restart the timer if it expires.

question_22717.question: What should the server indicate to the client for the window mechanism to work properly?
question_22717.ground_truth: The server should indicate to the client that a higher window limit applies as soon as the overload condition disappears.

question_22720.question: What is the format of GUAMI and what does it consist of?
question_22720.ground_truth: GUAMI is the global unique identifier of an AMF, and it is defined in TS 29.571. It consists of <MCC><MNC><AMF Region ID><AMF Set ID><AMF Pointer>.

question_22721.question: How often is the UE required to perform BSIC verification in accordance with TS~45.005?
question_22721.ground_truth: The UE is required to perform BSIC verification at levels down to the reference sensitivity level or reference interference levels as specified in TS~45.005.

question_22723.question: What are the minimum requirements for UE in cases with two active transmit antenna connectors in UL OLTD in clause 5.4.4B.2?
question_22723.ground_truth: The minimum requirements for UE in cases with two active transmit antenna connectors in UL OLTD include specific shut off and turn on times based on the DPCCH quality estimates.

question_22724.question: What components are required in the field for the PC service in the Smart Grid?
question_22724.ground_truth: Inverters, sensors, and meters are required in the field for the PC service in the Smart Grid.

question_22725.question: Which communication modes are supported by V2X communication over NR based PC5 reference point in the 3GPP study?
question_22725.ground_truth: V2X communication over NR based PC5 reference point supports broadcast mode, groupcast, and unicast mode.

question_22728.question: What should the UE and UPF do with the SDF traffic in the REDUNDANT steering mode when a threshold value is not provided?
question_22728.ground_truth: The UE and UPF send all data packets of the SDF on both accesses if both are available. If a primary access is provided, the UE and UPF send all data packets of the SDF on the primary access and may duplicate data packets of the SDF on the other access. If a primary access is not provided to the UE and UPF, the UE and UPF send all data packets of the SDF on both accesses.

question_22730.question: What is one method for spatial domain coordination in gNB-to-gNB co-channel CLI handling?

question_22731.question: What actions should the MAC entity take when it receives a Recommended bit rate query for a logical channel and direction?
question_22731.ground_truth: If the MAC entity is requested by upper layers to query the gNB for the recommended bit rate for a logical channel and direction, it should trigger a Recommended bit rate query for this logical channel, direction, and desired bit rate. If the MAC entity has UL resources allocated for new transmission, it should instruct the Multiplexing and Assembly procedure to generate the Recommended bit rate MAC CE for the logical channel and direction of this Recommended bit rate query, start the bitRateQueryProhibitTimer for the logical channel and direction of this Recommended bit rate query, and cancel this Recommended bit rate query.

question_22734.question: What is the difference between Approach 1 and Approach 2 in resolving the issue regarding to which entity (SCC AS or controller UE) the target UE requests to pull the existed media flow?
question_22734.ground_truth: In Approach 1, the target UE sends the request to SCC AS, which then authorizes and executes the request. In Approach 2, the target UE sends the referred REFER request to the controller UE, which then authorizes the request and sends the REFER request to SCC AS for media transfer.

question_22736.question: What is the purpose of adding a fixed jitter value to cater for jitter induced by the transport network?
question_22736.ground_truth: The purpose of adding a fixed jitter value is to ensure a short traffic delay for the RAN and to allow the UE to save power by sleeping as long as possible outside the jitter range.

question_22737.question: What is an E-UTRA-NR dual connectivity where E-UTRA is the master referred to as?

question_22740.question: What are the two possible interpretations for SGW Service Area when the Serving GW is separated into CP and UP functions?
question_22740.ground_truth: The first interpretation is that SGW Service Area refers to the SGW CP function Service Area, and the second interpretation is that it refers to the SGW UP function Service Area.

question_22742.question: What information is included in the PDN Connections IE when the target SGSN uses S4 based interaction with S-GW and P-GW?
question_22742.ground_truth: Bearer information for all bearers except the QCI=1 and vSRVCC marked PS bearers

question_22743.question: What does the CS to PS SRVCC Indication information element indicate in a 3GPP network?
question_22743.ground_truth: The CS to PS SRVCC Indication information element indicates a CS to PS SRVCC to E-UTRAN or to UTRAN (HSPA) is required in a 3GPP network.

question_22745.question: What is the MIME body format for the SLM-S to obtain location information of a VAL user?

question_22746.question: What should the MAC entity select if there are multiple sets of Random Access resources available and one of them can indicate all features triggering the Random Access procedure?
question_22746.ground_truth: The MAC entity should select the available set of Random Access resources that can indicate all features triggering the Random Access procedure.

question_22747.question: When is ECN-triggered adaptation undefined for EVS?
question_22747.ground_truth: ECN-triggered adaptation is currently undefined for EVS, but it does not prevent it from being negotiated and used for AMR or AMR-WB.

question_22748.question: What message does the MS send when it receives a RR MANAGEMENT command during the measurement procedure?
question_22748.ground_truth: The MS sends RR MANAGEMENT RESPONSE message upon completion.

question_22749.question: What is the typical size difference between the ks sample entry type equal to 'hvc2' and the one using @dependencyId when initializing a segment?
question_22749.ground_truth: The ks sample entry type equal to 'hvc2' is typically smaller than when using @dependencyId.

question_22750.question: What should the IP-SM-GW do when determining service-level interworking between Short Messages and CPM Messages in IMS?
question_22750.ground_truth: When the IP-SM-GW performs service-level interworking between Short Messages and CPM Messages in IMS, it performs additional functions such as translating chat session invitations, answering chat session invitations on behalf of the SMS user, informing SMS user about the changes of group chat session parameters, translating a chat session teardown request to a short message, and translating the SMS user's request to leave a chat session to a proper CPM request.

question_22751.question: What should the UE do when it receives a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message including 5GMM cause value #62 and a rejected NSSAI with rejection cause "S-NSSAI not available due to maximum number of UEs reached" in the 5GMM-REGISTERED state?
question_22751.ground_truth: The UE shall store the rejected NSSAI and start the timer T3526.

question_22752.question: What message is used by the IM-SSF to activate or modify or remove a call gap mechanism in the IM-SSF?

question_22753.question: What is one of the main purpose of the control information in the IRI records?
question_22753.ground_truth: The main purpose of the control information in the IRI records is the unique identification of records related to a target identity, including their unique mapping to the links carrying the Content of Communication.

question_22754.question: What are the three parameters in the compressed data format for APDC?
question_22754.ground_truth: The three parameters in the compressed data format for APDC are "srcaddr" (Lookback Length), "destaddr" (Distance to pointer), and "length" (size).

question_22755.question: What is one option for avoiding perceptual artifacts in 3D video encoding?
question_22755.ground_truth: One option is to use different robustness for different parts of the video stream, which can improve the subjective quality of the reconstructed video under severe network conditions.

question_22757.question: What does the H-GMLC do with the MO-LR Location Information message if the identity of the LCS Client is not available?
question_22757.ground_truth: The H-GMLC skips sending the MO-LR Location Information message to the external LCS Client and skips steps 10 to 14 if the identity of the LCS Client is not available.

question_22758.question: What are the responsibilities of the T-AMF in the network slice selection process?
question_22758.ground_truth: The T-AMF compares the correspondence relationship between the Secondary NSSAI and the Allowed NSSAI sent by the S-AMF during the T-AMF selection process. If the relationship is consistent, the T-AMF continues the rest of the handover procedure. If the relationship is inconsistent, the T-AMF can either perform a service continuity process or query NSSF in the registration procedure to obtain the latest Secondary NSSAI and Allowed NSSAI related information at UE's current location area.

question_22759.question: What information may be forwarded by the AMF to SMF instances during PDU Session Establishment procedure for SMF to use the same PCF?
question_22759.ground_truth: AMF may forward the selected PCF ID, PCF Set ID, and if PCF Set ID is not available, the PCF Group ID (if available) to SMF during the PDU Session Establishment procedure.

question_22761.question: What is the maximum supported temporal resolution for the HEVC/H.265 HDR UHD60 mode?
question_22761.ground_truth: The maximum supported temporal resolution for the HEVC/H.265 HDR UHD60 mode is that the frame rate exceeds 30fps.

question_22762.question: What does the term "Short Processing Time" signify in the context of 3GPP networks?
question_22762.ground_truth: Short Processing Time refers to the operation with short processing time in UL data transmission and DL data reception, specifically for 1 ms TTI length.

question_22763.question: What is the minimum uplink rate for the combination described in 7.4.6.1?
question_22763.ground_truth: 128 kbps plus support for 'Maximum total number of transport blocks transmitted within TTIs that start at the same time' = 16.

question_22765.question: What is the effect of entering "<mode>=1" or "<mode>=2" in the MT result code buffer settings?
question_22765.ground_truth: Entering "<mode>=1" or "<mode>=2" will result in the buffer unsolicited result codes defined within this command being forwarded directly to the TE when the MT-TE link is reserved, and flushed to the TE when the MT-TE link becomes available for "<mode>=2".

question_22766.question: How many modulation and coding schemes are defined for EGPRS2-A Radio Blocks carrying RLC data blocks on the downlink?
question_22766.ground_truth: There are 12 modulation and coding schemes defined for EGPRS2-A Radio Blocks carrying RLC data blocks on the downlink.

question_22768.question: What should be the setting of the interface circuit bits in the 3GPP~TS~04.21 frame after TCH synchronization has been completed at the SS side?
question_22768.ground_truth: The interface circuit bits in the 3GPP~TS~04.21 frame should be set to ON after TCH synchronization has been completed at the SS side.

question_22769.question: What method does the framework use to send load statistic records back to the application that requested the information?

question_22770.question: What is the role of BLER threshold in TRS calculation in a 3D isotropic environment?
question_22770.ground_truth: The BLER threshold is used to determine the power received by the UE at each discrete field combination that provides a BLER which is better than the specified target BLER level. The power received is averaged with other measurements using different field combinations to obtain an absolute value of the TRS.

question_22771.question: What are the two potential improvements suggested for HNB-GW to mitigate the CBC message size impact?
question_22771.ground_truth: The two potential improvements suggested are (a) introducing a method to signal to a HNB-GW to broadcast a Warning message to all HNBs that it serves, (b) introducing a method that allows grouping of HNBs in the WARNING REPLACE message addressing.

question_22773.question: What features does the Provision of Access to Restricted Local Operator Services by Unauthenticated UEs work item include?
question_22773.ground_truth: The Provision of Access to Restricted Local Operator Services by Unauthenticated UEs work item adds requirements to enhance the 3GPP PS Domain to provide an optional capability to allow unauthenticated UE's to access restricted local operator services based on operator policy and regional regulatory requirements. The requirements address identifying when restricted local operator services are available and enabling a UE to attach to a network for the purpose of accessing a restricted local operator service even if the UE is not able to be authenticated by the network.

question_22774.question: What is the method for GMLC to select a serving node among multiple returned by the HSS?
question_22774.ground_truth: The GMLC selects the serving node based on local policy (e.g. the top of the return list) when multiple serving nodes' addresses are returned by the HSS.

question_22775.question: In the context of E-UTRAN, what is one of the potential service requirements for interworking with legacy systems?
question_22775.ground_truth: The 5G system shall support interworking with 5G systems and legacy systems, enabling roaming, visited network provided data connectivity, and seamless handover and inter-system mobility.

question_22776.question: What are the two abbreviations introduced in the present document, and what do they stand for?
question_22776.ground_truth: The two abbreviations introduced in the present document are "NR" which stands for New Radio, and "RAN" which stands for Radio Access Network.

question_22777.question: What is the purpose of "recommendedBitRate" in MAC-Parameters?
question_22777.ground_truth: The parameter "recommendedBitRate" indicates the recommended bit rate that should be used by the UE during transmission.

question_22778.question: When is the first UPLINK ACCESS message transmitted after a request to talk is made?
question_22778.ground_truth: The first UPLINK ACCESS message is transmitted by the mobile station with a random delay between 0 and 20 ms.

question_22780.question: What is the frequency range for which the received power should be measured?
question_22780.ground_truth: The received power should be measured over the frequency range 30 MHz to 12.75 GHz, excluding certain frequencies.

question_22782.question: In Solution 3.5.1, what is the total number of steps taken when the charging system granted quota is shared by UPFs?
question_22782.ground_truth: The total number of steps taken is 8.

question_22784.question: What is the purpose of using unlinkable SA identifiers in the uplink of reference point Ua?
question_22784.ground_truth: The purpose of using unlinkable SA identifiers in the uplink of reference point Ua is to maintain privacy and security in communication.

question_22785.question: How does the MME behave when APN and group specific NAS level congestion control for Session Management signalling is activated for a UE?
question_22785.ground_truth: When APN and group specific NAS level congestion control for Session Management signalling is activated for a UE belonging to a particular group and initiating signalling to a particular APN, the MME may reject ESM requests from the UEs belonging to this particular group and attaching to this particular APN with a Session Management back-off timer, and may deactivate PDN connections of the UEs belonging to this particular group and attaching to this particular APN.

question_22787.question: What is required of the MS in step 1.1) of the requirements for procedure 1?
question_22787.ground_truth: The MS shall make a response as indicated in steps 1.4, 1.7, 1.10, 1.13A, 1.13B, 1.14A, 1.14B, 1.15C, 1.18, 1.23 in response to a "location updating request" or other specified events. The MS shall respond within 30 seconds in certain steps.

question_22790.question: What is the purpose of the Metadata information element in 5G ProSe direct discovery messages?
question_22790.ground_truth: To provide application layer metadata information or the application layer discovery message.

question_22791.question: What is the function that transfers MDT measurements collected by the UE?

question_22792.question: What should a P-CSCF do if it receives a Resource-Share header field with the value "no-media-sharing" for a media stream where resource sharing is already applied?
question_22792.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should stop media sharing as specified in 3GPP TS 29.214 Annex A.

question_22796.question: In the solution 5.3.4.3.2, when is the charging session updated, and what usage does the SMF report to the charging domain in this update?
question_22796.ground_truth: The charging session is updated after step 8, and the SMF reports the usage collected from UPF BP/UL CL for traffic to/from UPF1 and traffic to/from UPF2.

question_22797.question: What are the two key issues addressed for improving fast and efficient network exposure of UE traffic related information to Edge Application Server via Local UPF/NEF?
question_22797.ground_truth: The two key issues are: 5.2.1 Fast and efficient network exposure improvements and 5.3.1 Policies for finer granular sets of UEs.

question_22798.question: What field in the Desired IAB-MT PSD range MAC CE indicates the desired PSD range a node sends to its parent node to help with the sending node's MT UL TX power control?

question_22799.question: What is the role of 5QI in handling congestion-related packet drops in 5G networks?
question_22799.ground_truth: The 5QI (QoS Flow with particular QoS characteristics) determines whether a service is prepared to experience congestion-related packet drops or not.

question_22800.question: What is a TCoSH in the context of Self-healing SON?
question_22800.ground_truth: A TCoSH (Trigger Condition of Self-Healing) is the condition used to judge whether a Self-healing Process needs to be started. This condition could be an alarm or the detection of a fault.

question_22801.question: What protocol stack does the SS E-UTRAN part of the E-UTRAN-GERAN Inter RAT test model consist of?
question_22801.ground_truth: The SS E-UTRAN part of the E-UTRAN-GERAN Inter RAT test model consists of the same model defined in clause 4.2.2 for RRC testing.

question_22802.question: How is a delegated PDU Session uniquely identified in the 5G PLMN?
question_22802.ground_truth: A delegated PDU Session is uniquely identified by the NAI of the "Non-5G-capable over WLAN" UE, which is used in the NAS message sent by TWIF.

question_22803.question: What action does the BSS take when it receives a NOTIFICATION DATA message?
question_22803.ground_truth: The BSS broadcasts the notification data to all listeners and the talker by initiating the transmission of the data on the radio interface in each cell in which the group call is active. Optionally, the BSS may distribute the application-specific data immediately, upon receiving the application data from the MS, without waiting for a NOTIFICATION DATA message from the MSC.

question_22805.question: What should the UE do after changing from S1 mode to N1 mode in 5GMM-IDLE mode if it intends to transfer a PDN connection from S1 mode to N1 mode?
question_22805.ground_truth: If the UE has received an "interworking without N26 interface supported" indication from the network, it shall attempt to transfer the PDN connection(s) by initiating the PDU session establishment procedure with the request type set to "existing PDU session." Otherwise, it shall establish PDU session(s) by initiating the PDU session establishment procedure with a request type set to "initial request."

question_22807.question: What should the MAA assume about the Packet Session when it receives the sdpURI from the getPacketServices() call?
question_22807.ground_truth: The MAA should assume that the Packet Session can be consumed by the Packet client without any further interaction with the MAA.

question_22808.question: Which bearer LCID is used to carry signalling messages that are confidentiality and integrity protected?
question_22808.ground_truth: Bearer LCID = 30 is used for Direct Security Mode Command and Direct Security Mode Complete, and for other signalling messages that are confidentiality and integrity protected.

question_22809.question: What should the security level of the SSO system be controlled by in 3GPP SSO deployments?
question_22809.ground_truth: The operator should be able to control the security level of the SSO system, either by operating the SSO system themselves or by contractual agreements with trusted partners.

question_22810.question: What should the MCVideo client store as the call identifier in a GROUP REMOTE VIDEO PUSH REQEST message?
question_22810.ground_truth: The call identifier should be a random number uniformly distributed between (0, 65536).

question_22811.question: In step 6 of the test procedure, which event triggers the MeasurementReport that the SS receives?
question_22811.ground_truth: In step 6, the MeasurementReport is triggered by Event A3, which is specified in the measurement control information.

question_22812.question: What is the principle behind the coordinated channel allocation proposal for VAMOS?
question_22812.ground_truth: The coordinated channel allocation proposal for VAMOS takes into account the modulation types of the interferers and their strengths, and uses frequency hopping in radio resource allocation.

question_22815.question: How are UEs informed about proximity information?
question_22815.ground_truth: UEs are informed about proximity information via the application server.

question_22816.question: What is the message type for 5G ProSe direct discovery messages sent over the PC5 interface?

question_22817.question: How many floor control messages can be stored and processed in the "Floor participant state transition diagram for basic operation" during the call initiation phase?
question_22817.ground_truth: Only one floor control message can be stored and processed in the "Floor participant state transition diagram for basic operation" during the call initiation phase.

question_22820.question: Which user interface (UI) functionality is unavailable if the terminal indicates "NK" in the context of UICC capabilities?
question_22820.ground_truth: The "NK" UI functionality indicator indicates that no keypad is available.

question_22821.question: What is the maximum time allowed for the interruption time (Tinterrupt) when the field sameSFN-Indication and mib-RepetitionStatus are included in the handover command for intra-frequency or inter-frequency conditional handover?
question_22821.ground_truth: Tinterrupt = Tsearch + TIU + 20 ms, where TIU is the time required to complete the transmission of PRACH in the target cell and Tsearch is the time required to search the target cell.

question_22822.question: Which API function allows the Mission Critical applications to obtain the MBMS SAI or cell information of the UE and its relevant updates?
question_22822.ground_truth: Obtain the MBMS SAI or cell information of the UE and the relevant updates

question_22823.question: Who is responsible for making the final decision when using the NWDAF Recommendations service?
question_22823.ground_truth: The NF consumers of the NWDAF Recommendations service are fully in charge of all decisions concerning their own tuning.

question_22824.question: What is the frequency response of the output signal when the AMR-WB+ codec is used with mono output at a bit rate of 14 kbps?
question_22824.ground_truth: The output is band limited to 11 kHz and slightly attenuated in the frequency range 6 kHz to 11 kHz.

question_22827.question: When is the UE considered registered to a list of tracking areas?
question_22827.ground_truth: The UE considers itself registered to a list of tracking areas and does not need to trigger tracking area update other than periodic tracking area update as long as it stays in one of the tracking areas of the list of tracking areas received from the MME.

question_22828.question: In 4.3.3.2, what is the purpose of Alignment Tool A in determining the DUT bottom location on the spacer?
question_22828.ground_truth: The Alignment Tool A is used to determine the DUT bottom location on the spacer by providing an interior corner to ensure that the ring fingertip lands in the desired position at the bottom of the DUT. The tool also has ruled markings on a conformal palm spacer to ensure consistent positioning.

question_22829.question: What is the function of the 5GC Action IE in the MT COMMUNICATION HANDLING REQUEST message?
question_22829.ground_truth: The 5GC Action IE in the MT COMMUNICATION HANDLING REQUEST message is used to activate or deactivate the CN based MT Communication handling for a UE in RRC_INACTIVE state with extended DRX beyond 10.24 seconds.

question_22830.question: What are the parameters that determine the uplink power control window size for E-UTRA CC?
question_22830.ground_truth: The uplink power control window size for E-UTRA CC is determined by the sum of the UE power step size, UE power step tolerance, and the test system relative power measurement uncertainty.

question_22831.question: What is the purpose of transforming the state vector from Cartesian coordinates to geodetic latitude, longitude, and altitude on the WGS84 reference ellipsoid?
question_22831.ground_truth: The purpose is to extract the user position information from the ECEF coordinates.

question_22832.question: What happens when the PCF receives a request for requested Alternative QoS Parameter Sets from the AF?
question_22832.ground_truth: The PCF may reject any of the Requested Alternative QoS Parameter Sets it has received based on operator policy or impossibility to support the requested values of the individual parameters.

question_22833.question: What should the mobile station do with regards to user connection for speech calls in acceptance to a SETUP message indicating speech before the call is established?
question_22833.ground_truth: For speech calls, the mobile station shall attach the user connection at latest when sending the CONNECT message, except if there is no compatible radio resource at this time.

question_22834.question: What is used in SRv6 solution to represent segments in the N4 interface protocol?
question_22834.ground_truth: SRv6 leverages IPv6 addresses to represent segments in the N4 interface protocol.

question_22835.question: What actions does the Event Producer NF take when an exception occurs?
question_22835.ground_truth: The Event Producer NF executes exception instructions and notifies the Event Consumer NF when an exception, such as lack of storage space, occurs.

question_22837.question: What is the significance of the "id" value in the Privacy header field when received in a request from the NGCN site?
question_22837.ground_truth: The P-CSCF retains the header field when passing on the request, meaning that the privacy of the identity specified in the header field will be protected.

question_22838.question: What is the purpose of the FEC request in the 5G MBS session?
question_22838.ground_truth: The FEC request in the 5G MBS session is used to protect several sets of media transported within the same session using forward error correction (FEC).

question_22839.question: What is the UE's maximum allowed time to complete RSRP1 measurement?
question_22839.ground_truth: The UE's maximum allowed time to complete RSRP1 measurement is from T1' until T2.

question_22840.question: Which AMR codec modes perform well under background noise conditions in half rate channel down to 16 dB C/I?
question_22840.ground_truth: The highest AMR modes (12.2, 10.2, and 7.95) perform well under background noise conditions in half rate channel down to 16 dB C/I.

question_22841.question: What is the basic measurement interval for the EVM equalizer spectrum flatness in 6.5.2.4?
question_22841.ground_truth: The basic measurement interval for the EVM equalizer spectrum flatness in 6.5.2.4 is the same as for EVM.

question_22843.question: What is the primary difference between the two use-cases described in the document, regarding nation-wide TV channels?
question_22843.ground_truth: The main difference is that in the second use-case, the system also provides unicast access of the content in areas where no MBMS broadcast is offered, and the Content Provider does not control the precise delivery option. The operator selects the mode of transmission based on current popularity or predictions from past events.

question_22844.question: What action shall the 3GPP AAA Server take if it receives an Authentication and Authorization Request with the Emergency-Indication bit not set and no APN was requested?
question_22844.ground_truth: The 3GPP AAA Server shall select the default APN of the user to be used during the actual authentication and authorization procedure.

question_22845.question: How does the introduction of AIPN have the potential to impact the development and provisioning of mobile services?
question_22845.ground_truth: The introduction of AIPN has the potential to bring the model for the development and provisioning of services one step further, allowing for quicker responses to changing market trends and enabling an extremely wide variety of mobile services.

question_22846.question: What type of information does the "CellGlobalIdOrServiceAreaIdFixedLength" indicate in the "LegA-Identity" definition?
question_22846.ground_truth: The "CellGlobalIdOrServiceAreaIdFixedLength" in the "LegA-Identity" definition indicates the value part of the "CellGlobalIdOrServiceAreaIdFixedLength" type or the "LAIFixedLength" type, excluding tags and lengths.

question_22847.question: What is the purpose of the HTTP payload in the HTTP POST message sent from the SCF to the BM-SC?
question_22847.ground_truth: The HTTP payload in the HTTP POST message sent from the SCF to the BM-SC contains an XML document including a list of userServiceIds of MBMS User Services, IP address of the UE, MBMS user key (MUK), lifetime of MUK, NAF FQDN and B-TID.

question_22850.question: What element within the 'response-announce' contains the discovery-key?

question_22851.question: What is transmitted for successful MO SMS message in 5.2.7.2.2?
question_22851.ground_truth: The AMF transmits an NAS message that contains the "submit report" indicating the MO SMS message has been successfully delivered.

question_22853.question: What action types can the SCS/AS include in the Trigger Modify Request message for recalling or replacing a trigger?
question_22853.ground_truth: The SCS/AS can include "Trigger Recall Request" or "Trigger Replace Request" as action types in the Trigger Modify Request message.

question_22855.question: What is the purpose of Media Stream Access Points (SAPs) in 3GPP-DASH?
question_22855.ground_truth: Media Stream Access Points (SAPs) are used to access a Representation, which contains the media streams in 3GPP-DASH.

question_22856.question: How many charging requirements are associated with use case #2.1 in the NOP model of network slice provisioning?
question_22856.ground_truth: There are six charging requirements (REQ-CH-NSIMNG-01, REQ-CH-NSIMNG-02, REQ-CH-NSIMNG-03, REQ-CH-NSIMNG-04, REQ-CH-NSIMNG-05, and REQ-CH-NSIMNG-06) associated with use case #2.1 in the NOP model.

question_22858.question: What constraints are considered in the optimization of the multimedia telephony service for IMS?
question_22858.ground_truth: The optimization should maintain backward compatibility to ensure seamless inter-working with existing services available in the CS domain, such as CS voice telephony and 3G-324M, as well as with terminals of earlier 3GPP releases. It should be based on default codecs specified in 3GPP TS 26.235 and 3GPP TS 26.141.

question_22859.question: What is the maximum number of LEO satellites that the UE can measure in parallel within one SMTC (Scheduling Modification TimeCorpus)?
question_22859.ground_truth: The maximum number of LEO satellites that the UE can measure in parallel within one SMTC is NumOfLEOSatToBeMeasured.

question_22861.question: What is the key issue addressed in "Key issue #4 'QoS with satellite access'" in the context of 5G systems?
question_22861.ground_truth: The key issue is the larger latency introduced by satellite access in 5G systems, and its impact on QoS.

question_22862.question: What should the Node B include in the COMMON MEASUREMENT INITIATION RESPONSE message for all available measurement results if the Common Measurement Type IE is set to "HS-DSCH Provided Bit Rate" and the Report Characteristics IE is set to "On Demand" in FDD systems?
question_22862.ground_truth: The Node B should include all the available measurement results for each cell portion in the COMMON MEASUREMENT INITIATION RESPONSE message.

question_22863.question: What security measure is necessary for the initial L3 message in SA2's solutions for MO IP packet delivery in LTE?
question_22863.ground_truth: The initial L3 message should be integrity protected but not ciphered.

question_22865.question: What is one of the potential security threats for the unauthorized network becoming a man in the middle to any service that is being offered?
question_22865.ground_truth: The man in the middle could take advantage of the user's lack of awareness of the PARLOS based service security implications and gain access to the complete communication when the user is required to obtain user consent for the use of PARLOS based services.

question_22866.question: Which service does the SRAP sublayer provide to upper layers, regarding data transfer?
question_22866.ground_truth: The SRAP sublayer provides a data transfer service to upper layers.

question_22867.question: What is the purpose of this solution in addressing Key Issue #1?
question_22867.ground_truth: This solution addresses the management of elements in a PIN, including adding and removing elements from a PIN, as well as the authorization required for these actions.

question_22869.question: What is the role of a relay node in the 3GPP network?
question_22869.ground_truth: A relay node is part of the radio access network and behaves like an eNB for UEs, while communicating with a donor eNB through a separate physical layer entity that corresponds to UE functionality.

question_22870.question: Which clause defines the measurement reporting delay for OTDOA Inter-Frequency RSTD Measurements for UE category NB1 for enhanced coverage?

question_22871.question: What is the estimated worst-case beam switching time, and how does it affect the downlink performance in different channels?
question_22871.ground_truth: The estimated worst-case beam switching time is less than 100 ns, based on an analogue implementation. Simulation results show little to no impact on overall link performance if the beam switch delay falls within this CP length. However, there may be a degradation in throughput and Blank Error Rate (BLER) if the CP loss is 80% or higher due to beam switching speed delay.

question_22873.question: What should be the resolution of the frame buffers for raster-based split rendering in online gaming?
question_22873.ground_truth: The resolution of the frame buffers for raster-based split rendering in online gaming is 2k by 2k per eye, potentially even higher.

question_22874.question: What is the effect of not specifying the codec mode in the ASSIGNMENT COMMAND message?
question_22874.ground_truth: When the ASSIGNMENT COMMAND message does not specify which of the codec modes the MS should use, the handset selects the default codec mode.

question_22875.question: How is the total energy efficiency (EEglobal) calculated for the whole system?
question_22875.ground_truth: EEglobal is calculated as the sum of the EEscenario per each deployment scenario multiplied by the corresponding weight, bi, for each deployment scenario.

question_22876.question: What information is delivered by the Serving Gateway-C to the Serving Gateway-U when interception is required at the Serving Gateway?
question_22876.ground_truth: The packet detection rules, forwarding action rules, indication to perform packet duplication, and the intercepted packet identification rules are delivered by the Serving Gateway-C to the Serving Gateway-U when interception is required at the Serving Gateway.

question_22878.question: What is the role of IP-SM-GW when sending a SIP MESSAGE in a MT scenario?
question_22878.ground_truth: IP-SM-GW includes MSISDN-less IMS UE 1 (originator) and MSISDN-less IMS UE 2 (recipient) addresses in the user data body of the SIP MESSAGE.

question_22880.question: What are the two scenarios where the live immersive media production service can be deployed?
question_22880.ground_truth: The two scenarios are a private slice in a PLMN shared among MNOs and 3rd parties, and a non-public network with infrastructure deployed by a 3rd party using leased spectrum.

question_22881.question: What interfaces are specified in the present document for the bearer-independent circuit-switched core network?
question_22881.ground_truth: The interfaces specified in the present document are the Iu, Mc, Nb, and Nc interfaces.

question_22882.question: What is the role of the "HARQ process number" field in the DCI formats 2A, 2B, and 2C?
question_22882.ground_truth: The HARQ process number field specifies the number of bits used for denoting the HARQ process number in DCI formats 2A, 2B, and 2C.

question_22883.question: What is the purpose of the policy for H(e)NB validation?
question_22883.ground_truth: It is a mechanism that utilizes trusted and secure start-up, maintaining operator policy consideration.

question_22884.question: What is the requirement for the UE to apply relaxed radio link monitoring if at least one of the following conditions is met: (i) the UE sends out of sync indications to the higher layers, (ii) the timer T310 is running, or (iii) no DRX is used or DRX cycle is longer than 80ms?
question_22884.ground_truth: The UE is no longer allowed to relax RLM measurements and apply the relaxed radio link monitoring under these conditions.

question_22885.question: How can an In-progress Emergency be cancelled in MCX Service Group Communication?
question_22885.ground_truth: An In-progress Emergency can be cancelled by an authorized MCX User for an MCX Service Group, when criteria established by the MCX Service Administrator are met (e.g., timeout), or by the MCX Service Emergency Group Communication initiator. The MCX Service shall then notify Affiliated MCX Service Group Members of the cancellation of the In-progress Emergency and the identity of the cancelling MCX User.

question_22888.question: What is a potential solution for a business to ensure the privacy of its internal communications within a network slice, while also being resource efficient?
question_22888.ground_truth: A potential solution is to use a 3GPP-supported manner for the 3rd party to provide its own encryption algorithm for intra-slice communications.

question_22889.question: What is solution #22 in the 5G context described, and what is its primary usage?
question_22889.ground_truth: Solution #22 is a method of handing over PDU sessions from 3GPP-based RATs to W-5GCAN-based access with the goal of maintaining the same QoE. The primary usage of this solution is for PDU sessions with GBR, but it may also be applied to non-GBR sessions based on operator policy.

question_22890.question: What is one of the ways to request multiple layers for each segment in case of a VoD service with multiple available representations based on layers of SVC?
question_22890.ground_truth: One way is within one single TCP connection, requesting each layer after the other.

question_22892.question: What is the main focus of the 3GPP technical report on enhancing data collection for NR and EN-DC in Release 17?
question_22892.ground_truth: The main focus of the report is to provide descriptions of principles for RAN intelligence enabled by AI, the functional framework for AI-enabled optimization, and use cases and solutions for AI-enabled RAN.

question_22893.question: Under what circumstances is the UE allowed to send a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for the same S-NSSAI after receiving a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message?
question_22893.ground_truth: If T3585 is running for the current access type, or if T3585 is running for the same S-NSSAI and the new PLMN or SNPN.

question_22894.question: What should a UE do if it receives ESM cause value #66 and the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message was sent together with an ATTACH REQUEST, the ATTACH REJECT message is integrity protected, and the Back-off timer value IE is included and the timer value indicates neither zero nor deactivated?
question_22894.ground_truth: The UE should start the back-off timer with the value provided in the Back-off timer value IE for the PDN connectivity procedure and PLMN and APN combination and shall not initiate a new attach procedure or send another PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message in the current PLMN in S1 mode with the same APN that was sent by the UE, until the back-off timer expires, the UE is switched off or the USIM is removed.

question_22895.question: What is the role of the UAS application specific server in sending a DAA server event information to the UAE server?
question_22895.ground_truth: The UAS application specific server determines the information of the UAVs which may be in the proximity of the UAV and sends this information to the UAE server.

question_22896.question: In the context of inter-system handover, what information should the RNC include in the RELOCATION REQUIRED message when performing SRVCC to the GSM CS domain?
question_22896.ground_truth: The RNC should include the SRVCC HO Indication IE in the RELOCATION REQUIRED message, with the value set to "CS only".

question_22898.question: What is the difference between Model A and Model B discovery in selecting a SL Positioning Server UE?
question_22898.ground_truth: In Model A, a SL Positioning Server UE announces itself as an SL Positioning Server UE, and Target UEs monitor such announcements. In Model B, a Target UE issues requests to discover a SL Positioning Server UE.

question_22899.question: What should the SS (node B emulator) send continuously throughout the test?
question_22899.ground_truth: The SS should send PDCCH indicating a new transmission on the PCell continuously throughout the test to ensure that the UE sends ACK/NACKs.

question_22901.question: What does the procedure described in subclause 10.11.5.1 aim to achieve in terms of the behavior of the MC service server related to priority sharing and pre-conditions?
question_22901.ground_truth: The procedure aims to modify the unicast bearer parameters for an ongoing MC service call with pre-conditions like an existing MC service call or session, and the MC service server deciding to modify the unicast bearer parameters.

question_22902.question: What is the difference between the 3,1 kHz Audio, Transparent and 3,1 kHz Audio, Non Transparent services in BS 21 to 26?
question_22902.ground_truth: The 3,1 kHz Audio, Transparent service in BS 21 to 26 is a speech service with no flow control, while the 3,1 kHz Audio, Non Transparent service in the same range has the octet 7 present depending on the flow control supported by the TE. When the TE supports no flow control, it means outband flow control, and when the TE supports Inband or No flow control, the octet 7 is present with different values indicating the type of flow control.

question_22903.question: What happens when a Delivery Status IE is received in the split SRB IE in the MeNB?
question_22903.ground_truth: The MeNB shall consider RRC messages up to the indicated NR PDCP SN as having been successfully delivered to the UE by the en-gNB.

question_22904.question: What is the purpose of CUG authorization functions?
question_22904.ground_truth: CUG authorization functions perform checks to ensure the integrity of a CUG related call. They reject CUG calls if the calls do not meet the criteria of these checks.

question_22905.question: What is the difference between the processing of the ACELP technology and the MDCT-based technology in the described encoding process?
question_22905.ground_truth: The MDCT-based coding mode uses a sine-based window for windowing the LTP-filtered signal and the ACELP coding mode uses a different window definition in the LTP filtered signal processing. Additionally, the two technologies have different SNR estimation methods for the segmental SNR estimation.

question_22906.question: What should the mobile station do when it receives a PACKET ACCESS REJECT message and the packet request reference in the Reject structure corresponds to one of its 3 last PACKET CHANNEL REQUEST or EGPRS PACKET CHANNEL REQUEST messages?
question_22906.ground_truth: The mobile station should follow the procedures defined in sub-clause 7.2.3.2.1.6, including stopping T3170, starting T3172, and listening to the downlink PCCCH until T3170 expires or a PACKET UPLINK ASSIGNMENT or PACKET DBPSCH ASSIGNMENT message is received. If no PACKET UPLINK ASSIGNMENT or PACKET DBPSCH ASSIGNMENT message is received before the expiration of T3170, the mobile station should indicate a packet access failure to the upper layer and return to the MAC-Idle state.

question_22907.question: What does the "Content-Type" header specify in the HTTP response to a symbol-based repair request?
question_22907.ground_truth: The "Content-Type" header specifies that the message body is a simple container of encoding symbols as described below.

question_22910.question: In the on-network element, what element contains a boolean indicating whether confidentiality protection of MCVideo signalling is enabled or disabled between the MCVideo client and MCVideo server?

question_22911.question: What is the HTTP status code that the NF service consumer shall send in response to a successfully processed and accepted HTTP POST request towards the NWDAF?

question_22912.question: What is the maximum downlink power level that can be allocated with simultaneous transmission of 24 RBs for a NR FR1 cell?
question_22912.ground_truth: The maximum downlink power level that can be allocated with simultaneous transmission of 24 RBs for a NR FR1 cell is -78dBm/SCS.

question_22914.question: What factor must be considered when modeling the channel of dual antenna mobiles?
question_22914.ground_truth: Antenna correlation and gain differences must be considered when modeling the channel of dual antenna mobiles, influencing how signals received at two antennas are combined as one link.

question_22915.question: What will the MCPTT client do when timer TFG5 expires in the "S6: ignoring incoming call announcements" state?
question_22915.ground_truth: The MCPTT client will release the stored SDP body, call identifier, originating MCPTT user ID, refresh interval, MCPTT group ID, and call start time; destroy the call type control state machine; and enter the "S1: start-stop" state.

question_22916.question: What type of information can be provided as an optional query parameter when the NF service consumer requests the UE's Private Identities?
question_22916.ground_truth: The type of information that can be provided as an optional query parameter when the NF service consumer requests the UE's Private Identities is the supported-features and/or impi.

question_22918.question: Which network element is responsible for sending the "Info req" message to the HLRb for the call forwarding request?
question_22918.ground_truth: The MSCb sends the "Info req" message to the HLRb.

question_22919.question: What is involved in the pre-condition of the Area Load Balance scenario?
question_22919.ground_truth: The operator wants the selected area to be balanced and ensure sufficient traffic capacity for new UE(s) to access.

question_22921.question: What are the requirements for intra-band V2X operation in clause 6.3E.0.2?
question_22921.ground_truth: The requirements for intra-band V2X operation in clause 6.3E.0.2 include the SL switching time masks for NR SL and LTE SL (if NR SL and LTE SL have different priorities). The UE implementation determines when NR SL and LTE SL have the same priority.

question_22923.question: What are the potential gains for pre-decoding IC UE by solving the CQI mismatch issue for Rel-7 MIMO interference?
question_22923.ground_truth: The gains for L3 and L4 in HetNet scenario are 24.13% and 15.93% respectively, and the gains for L1 and L2 in HetNet scenario are 53.68% and 36.07% respectively. In HomoNet scenario, the gains are smaller, with the largest gains, from 13% to 20%, obtained when the UE is in L7 or L8 position.

question_22925.question: What should the AMF do when it receives the 5G ProSe Capability from a UE during the registration process?
question_22925.ground_truth: The AMF reports the 5G ProSe Capability of the UE to the PCF within the "proSeCapab" attribute, as per the procedures defined in clause~4.2.2.1.

question_22926.question: When should the MCVideo client indicate to the requesting user that they are not authorized to change the selected MCVideo group of the targeted MCVideo user?
question_22926.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should indicate this when the <RemoteGroupSelectionURIList> element does not exist in the MCVideo user profile document or when the MCVideo ID of the targeted MCVideo user does not match with one of the <entry> elements of the <RemoteGroupSelectionURIList> element in the MCVideo user profile document.

question_22927.question: What happens if a LLC-PDU arrives at the SGSN when the current bucket level (CBL) is in use and the SGSN does not receive a Flow Control PDU?
question_22927.ground_truth: The SGSN continues computing the bucket counter (B) as defined above without interruption when the CBL feature is negotiated and SGSN does not receive a Flow Control PDU.

question_22928.question: Where can the MCPTT user database be deployed in relation to the HSS?
question_22928.ground_truth: The MCPTT user database can be deployed in the same network as the HSS or in a different network.

question_22929.question: What are the MC services that are supported during the IOPS mode of operation in Release 17?
question_22929.ground_truth: During the IOPS mode of operation in Release 17, the IOPS MC system supports MCPTT services like group call, emergency group call, private call, and emergency private call. Additionally, it supports short data service for MCData services. MCVideo services are not supported in Release 17.

question_22930.question: What are the two advantages of using standard test antennas in conformance testing?
question_22930.ground_truth: Standard test antennas are easily available and easier to specify, and repeatability between different conformance testing runs will be greater.

question_22931.question: How does a client calculate the reduction in traffic when taking additional actions?
question_22931.ground_truth: The client simply rejects (i.e. does not send to the server) every tenth request message it becomes aware of.

question_22932.question: What are the initial conditions for the test in section 9.3.7H.4.1?
question_22932.ground_truth: The initial conditions for the test in section 9.3.7H.4.1 include a normal test environment, as specified in clauses G.2.1 and G.2.2, and mid-range frequencies, as specified in clause G.2.4.

question_22937.question: What must the UE include in the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for direct discovery announcement?
question_22937.ground_truth: In the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for direct discovery announcement, the UE must set the ProSe direct discovery PC5 message type parameter, include either ProSe application code or ProSe restricted code, include the MIC field, and set the UTC-based counter LSB parameter to the 4 least significant bits of the UTC-based counter.

question_22938.question: What is the parameter dataSessionSet used for in the abortMultipleDataSessions() method?
question_22938.ground_truth: The dataSessionSet parameter is used to specify the set of sessionIDs of data sessions that have aborted or terminated abnormally. An empty set of sessionIDs indicates that all data sessions have aborted.

question_22939.question: What parameter should be specified in the send operation to initiate message delivery at a non-peak time?

question_22940.question: What is the maximum number of transport blocks that can arrive to the coding unit per TTI for the sidelink discovery channel?

question_22941.question: What kind of parameter does the fwAvailStatusInd() method take to indicate the reason for the framework becoming unavailable?
question_22941.ground_truth: The fwAvailStatusInd() method takes a reason parameter of the type TpFwAvailStatusReason, which is used to inform the application of the reason for the framework's unavailability.

question_22942.question: What action is taken with the AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING RESPONSE message in the network if the check and verification of the message authentication code fails?
question_22942.ground_truth: The network ignores the GMM message if the check and verification of the message authentication code fails.

question_22945.question: What is the test purpose for E-UTRAN HD-FDD intra-frequency event triggered reporting under fading propagation conditions in asynchronous cells for UE category 0?
question_22945.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify the UE makes correct reporting of an event, and it will partly verify the FDD intra-frequency cell search requirements.

question_22946.question: What should the UE do after taking a new 5G NAS security context into use if the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message does not indicate the "null integrity protection algorithm" 5G-EA0 as the selected NAS integrity algorithm?
question_22946.ground_truth: The UE shall set the downlink NAS COUNT of this new 5G NAS security context to the downlink NAS COUNT that has been used for the successful integrity checking of the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.

question_22947.question: What should the UE do upon receiving N310 consecutive "out-of-sync" indications for the SpCell from lower layers?
question_22947.ground_truth: The UE should start timer T310 for the corresponding SpCell.

question_22948.question: What information should be included in the <mcptt-request-uri> element when sending a SIP INVITE request for an MCPTT private call?
question_22948.ground_truth: The <mcptt-request-uri> element should be set to the group identity in the SIP INVITE request for an MCPTT private call.

question_22949.question: How is the distribution of delay DL air-interface measurement represented?
question_22949.ground_truth: The distribution of delay DL air-interface measurement is represented as an integer, indicating the number of RLC SDU packets measured with the delay within the range of the bin. The measurement is calculated per PLMN ID, mapped 5QI or QCI in NR option 3, and per supported S-NSSAI.

question_22950.question: How does the IP-SM-GW handle an incoming Short Message from an SMS user in the originating network, if the operator policy indicates that the session is accepted without SMS user interaction?
question_22950.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW will acknowledge the session invitation if the answer is positive, and will tear down the associated resources if the answer is negative.

question_22952.question: What are the two performance classes in 5G systems for real-time communication between PMUs?
