question_22952.ground_truth: P class, primarily for protection and control, and M class, mainly for measurements in the presence of out-of-band signals.

question_22953.question: Which messages are applicable to the Lb interface for signaling to a Type A LMU using a TCH?
question_22953.ground_truth: Call Confirmed (LMU to SMLC), Connect (LMU to SMLC), Connect Acknowledge (SMLC to LMU), Setup (SMLC to LMU), Disconnect (two way), Release (two way), Release Complete (two way).

question_22955.question: What should the UE do if it receives a network-initiated Session Management message, other than PDU Session Release Command, for a congested S-NSSAI while the back-off timer is running?
question_22955.ground_truth: The UE shall stop the back-off timer and respond to the 5GC.

question_22956.question: What should the eNB do if the NR V2X Services Authorized IE is contained in the RETRIEVE UE CONTEXT RESPONSE message and it contains one or more IEs set to "authorized"?
question_22956.ground_truth: The eNB should, if supported, consider that the UE is authorized for the relevant service(s).

question_22957.question: What action should be taken by the UE when IE "Error reason" is set to "Assistance Data Missing" in the IE "UE positioning Error"?
question_22957.ground_truth: When the UE receives a MEASUREMENT CONTROL from the SS containing the requested assistance data and instructs the UE not to repeat the request for assistance data, the UE shall perform positioning measurements and respond with a MEASUREMENT REPORT message containing a valid position estimate in the UE Positioning Position Estimate Info.

question_22958.question: What message is sent by the BSS to the SGSN when it wishes to delete a BSS packet flow context due to memory restrictions or user inactivity?
question_22958.ground_truth: Delete BSS Packet Flow Context Request

question_22960.question: What measures shall the participating MCVideo function take if it receives a SIP INVITE request containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the <session-type> element set to a value of "adhoc" from a SIP REFER request for a pre-established session?
question_22960.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function shall follow the procedures specified in clause~22.3.2.2.1 with the clarification in step~13) of clause~22.3.2.2.1 that the Request-URI of the SIP INVITE request shall contain a URI of the MCVideo session identity which mapped to the MCVideo session identity provided in the Refer-To header field of the "SIP REFER request for a pre-established session".

question_22963.question: What is the versioning system used by the 3GPP Technical Specifications and Technical Reports relating to the Common IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS)?
question_22963.ground_truth: The version number consists of three digits, where the first digit indicates the stage of approval within the TSG, the second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, and the third digit is incremented when only editorial changes have been made.

question_22966.question: What is the procedure when the GA-RRC sub-layer entity in the MS initiates the uplink direct transfer procedure in the GA-RRC-CONNECTED state for a subsequent NAS message?
question_22966.ground_truth: The MS includes the "CN Domain Identity" and the contents of the received NAS message in the IE "L3 Message" and sends it to the GANC.

question_22967.question: When reporting missing IEs/IE groups with specified criticality "Reject IE" or "Ignore IE and Notify Sender" using a response message, what should be included in the Criticality Diagnostics IE?
question_22967.ground_truth: In the Information Element Criticality Diagnostics IE, the Repetition Number IE and, if the missing IE/IE group is not at message hierarchy level 1, the Message Structure IE should be included.

question_22968.question: What is the procedure for ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT (step 9b4)?
question_22968.ground_truth: The default message with specific contents is used to update the routing area.

question_22970.question: How shall the total noise powers obtained from repeats be expressed in clauses 7.3.1 and 7.3.2?
question_22970.ground_truth: The total noise powers obtained from repeats shall be expressed as 10*log10 of the average in dB in clauses 7.3.1 and 7.3.2.

question_22972.question: What kind of environment is specified for the test in 9.2.1FD.4.1?
question_22972.ground_truth: The test environment is normal, as specified in clauses G.2.1 and G.2.2, and the frequencies to be tested are in the mid-range, as specified in clause G.2.4.

question_22975.question: In which bands is the narrowband blocking requirement defined for UMTS?
question_22975.ground_truth: The narrowband blocking requirement is defined for Bands II, IV, V, X, XXV, XXVI, III, VIII, XII, XIII, and XIV in UMTS.

question_22978.question: When does the service authorization procedure for ProSe Direct Discovery or ProSe Direct Communication get executed?
question_22978.ground_truth: The service authorization procedure for ProSe Direct Discovery or ProSe Direct Communication gets executed before starting the setup of ProSe Direct Discovery or ProSe Direct Communication if the UE has no valid authorization information or when the UE already engaged in a ProSe Direct Discovery or ProSe Direct Communication changes its registered PLMN and has no valid authorization information for the new registered PLMN or when the service authorization expires.

question_22980.question: What is the function of the Vision Engine in the ETSI AR functional architecture?
question_22980.ground_truth: The Vision Engine is responsible for localizing the AR device relative to the real world, detecting and tracking real objects, and reconstructing a 3D representation of the real world.

question_22981.question: What message does the SN-CU sends to the SN-DU to indicate the request of SCG activation or deactivation in the MN initiated SN modification procedure with SCG Activation or Deactivation?
question_22981.ground_truth: The SN-CU sends the UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message to the SN-DU to indicate the request of SCG activation or deactivation in the MN initiated SN modification procedure with SCG Activation or Deactivation.

question_22982.question: What happens to the AMF in LBO and home-routed roaming scenarios for data rate limitation?
question_22982.ground_truth: In LBO roaming and home-routed roaming, the AMF selects the same SMF and UPF for all PDU sessions, or divides the slice MBR into visited and home networks for individual enforcement, depending on the roaming agreement. If home-routed PDU sessions are established before LBO, the existing V-SMF and V-UPF will be reselected for the new LBO PDU sessions.

question_22984.question: What is one of the facilities relevant to USAT that are stated in the ME's profile?
question_22984.ground_truth: The list of USAT facilities that are supported by the ME is one of the contents stated in the profile.

question_22985.question: What action does the UE take if the user-plane resources over one access of the MA PDU Session have been established but are currently inactive?
question_22985.ground_truth: The UE may re-activate the user-plane resources over this access by initiating the Registration or UE Triggered Service Request procedure over this access.

question_22986.question: What is the generation method for ATCR6b?
question_22986.ground_truth: The generation method for ATCR6b involves placing a 5 MHz E-UTRA carrier at the RF channel to be tested. If 5 MHz carriers are not supported, the narrowest supported channel BW shall be selected instead.

question_22987.question: What measurement supports the UTRAN Cell Availability KPI, and provides the length of time the cell has been unavailable for each cause?

question_22988.question: What is the function of Service Exposure Function in the 5G system?
question_22988.ground_truth: The Service Exposure Function allows the UE to interact with the application layer, or the AF and external client if the network supports the Sidelink Positioning and Ranging.

question_22990.question: What kinds of situations are considered in the case of an emergency on an LMR group in the context of a group regroup?
question_22990.ground_truth: There are two cases considered: (1) if the LMR system does not support emergencies on group regroups, the IWF will indicate that in the group regroup response and omit the group from the regroup; (2) if the LMR system supports emergencies on group regroups, the IWF informs the MC service server of the emergency on the group regrouped group and includes the identity of the constituent group in emergency.

question_22991.question: What are some of the design considerations for Diameter overload control in 3GPP networks?
question_22991.ground_truth: Some of the design considerations for Diameter overload control in 3GPP networks include addressing the traffic overload associated to a given Diameter application, distinction between overload information and the way a node handles traffic reduction for a given application, and minimizing the impacts on the delivered service and so improve user experience. Additionally, when a server is overloaded, its Diameter identity may be given back to clients and Diameter agents in the path, so that traffic may be reduced for this server and not for others.

question_22992.question: What is the goal of Ranging/SL Positioning services and how does it relate to UE location information?
question_22992.ground_truth: The goal of Ranging/SL Positioning services is to support the authorization of the UE as a target UE, reference UE, assistant UE, or located UE in Ranging/Sidelink Positioning services. These services request UE location information, which is privacy sensitive. By perform authorization on the UE level, privacy is ensured as the location information of the UEs involved in a service is protected.

question_22993.question: What is the standardized value of the averaging window used for the UE's enforcement of the UL rate limitation indicated by the session-AMBR in 3GPP TS 23.501 5.7.4-1?
question_22993.ground_truth: The standardized value of the averaging window used for the UE's enforcement of the UL rate limitation indicated by the session-AMBR in 3GPP TS 23.501 5.7.4-1 is two seconds.

question_22995.question: What should an old Gn/Gp SGSN do when forwarding data to a new SGSN?
question_22995.ground_truth: An old Gn/Gp SGSN duplicates the buffered N-PDUs and starts tunnelling them to the new SGSN. Additional N-PDUs received from the GGSN before the timer described in step~2 expires are also duplicated and tunnelled to the new SGSN.

question_22996.question: How is the Consumption Reporting Description related to the Associated Delivery Procedure Description in MBMS?
question_22996.ground_truth: The Consumption Reporting Description is a separate Associated Delivery Procedure Description instance, referenced by the consumptionReporting element in a userServiceDescription instance.

question_22997.question: What is the consequence if the network fails to prevent the old TMSI from being allocated again when a new TMSI is allocated to an MS?
question_22997.ground_truth: The network will not be able to prevent the old TMSI from being allocated again until the MS has acknowledged the allocation of the new TMSI.

question_22998.question: What is the requirement regarding the interaction between ACDC and EAB?

question_22999.question: What is the delay uncertainty when inserting the ECGI measurement report to the uplink DCCH?
question_22999.ground_truth: The delay uncertainty is twice the TTI (Transmission Time Interval) of the uplink DCCH.

question_23000.question: What is the measurement reporting delay defined as in the context of 7DL CA Event Triggered Reporting under Deactivated SCells in Non-DRX with generic duplex modes tests?
question_23000.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between an event that will trigger a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface.

question_23001.question: What is the suggested recommendation for DRX cycle extension to meet the battery life requirement for LPHAP from RAN1's perspective?
question_23001.ground_truth: The suggested recommendation is to extend DRX cycle beyond 10.24s for LPHAP to meet the battery life requirement from RAN1's perspective.

question_23002.question: What is the objective of the solution described in section 7.23 of the document?
question_23002.ground_truth: The objective of the solution described in section 7.23 of the document is to provide a deployment option for the FF application in the Edge deployment architecture, specifically addressing KI#9 for "How to support FFAPP communications over Edge deployments."

question_23004.question: What is the maximum number of preambles that the UE is allowed to transmit before indicating a Random Access problem to upper layers?
question_23004.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement for this does not specify a maximum number of preambles transmission counter.

question_23005.question: What are the conditions under which an MS searches for all access technologies in i, ii, iii, iv, and v?
question_23005.ground_truth: An MS shall search for all access technologies in i, ii, iii, iv, and v when using a SIM without access technology information storage or when the HPLMN Selector with Access Technology file is not present, and it is a GSM voice capable MS or a packet only MS supporting GSM COMPACT.

question_23006.question: What does the maximum number of APNs for advertising the Overload Control Information mean?
question_23006.ground_truth: The maximum number of APNs that the PGW may advertise the Overload Control Information is 10. It means that if the PGW supports more than 10 APNs, it shall advertise the overload control for at most 10 of the most important APNs. In future, if needed, this limit may be increased.

question_23007.question: What should the S-CSCF do if the Contact URI in the Contact header field of a REGISTER request contains a "bnc" URI parameter?
question_23007.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should bind each non-barred registered public user identity to a contact address as specified in RFC 6140.

question_23008.question: What is the function of the threshold in the described algorithm?
question_23008.ground_truth: The threshold is used in the signal activity detection logic to identify the signal as active or inactive.

question_23010.question: Which information objects are specified as mandatory in the RANAP-RelocationInformationIEs for the Relocation Information procedure?
question_23010.ground_truth: The RANAP-RelocationInformationIEs can contain the id-DirectTransferInformationList-RANAP-RelocInf, id-RAB-ContextList-RANAP-RelocInf, among others as optional.

question_23011.question: What is the delay requirement for fast SCell activation when one SCell is in EN-DC, standalone NR carrier aggregation, or NE-DC, and when one SCell is being activated?
question_23011.ground_truth: When one SCell is being activated, the UE shall be able to activate the deactivated SCell no later than a specified delay which is dependent upon various conditions, such as the measurement period of the SCell, the numerology used, and the presence of aperiodic CSI-RS resources for SCell activation.

question_23014.question: Why was Solution 3 chosen as the preferred solution for the heartbeat mechanism in the 5GC?
question_23014.ground_truth: Solution 3 was chosen as the preferred solution because it allows a NF Service Consumer or Producer to check the aliveness of the peer NF service, including through any intermediate HTTP proxies. While it is not a safe method and requires modeling an extra "status" resource, it is flexible enough to send additional data and allows for a wider range of use cases.

question_23015.question: What is the purpose of the "SEND DTMF" facility in the DTMF protocol?
question_23015.ground_truth: The "SEND DTMF" facility in the DTMF protocol is used to send DTMF tones over a communication channel.

question_23016.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 6.1.5.3 of 3GPP TS 37.144?
question_23016.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the minimum TRP and TRP average of the UE is not below specified values, as a lower value can decrease the coverage area.

question_23018.question: How can an NF Service Producer mitigate a potential overload situation?
question_23018.ground_truth: An NF Service Producer can mitigate a potential overload status by sending specific HTTP status codes (503, 429, or 307) to the NF Service Consumer, signalling the server's inability to handle the current or potential traffic rate, allowing the NF Service Consumer to divert or throttle a portion of the traffic to an alternative, non-overloaded resource.

question_23019.question: What are the two methods for Trace Session activation?
question_23019.ground_truth: The two methods for Trace Session activation are Management activation and Signalling activation.

question_23020.question: What methods can be used to minimize overhead in the architecture using U-plane location services?
question_23020.ground_truth: The ProSe Function can request UEs only send location updates when they cross into a border area, and then request the UE only send a location update if/when it leaves the border area. The ProSe Function can update the border area whenever necessary.

question_23021.question: What information must the NG-RAN node report in the PDU SESSION RESOURCE SETUP RESPONSE message if the PDU Set based Handling Indicator IE is included in the PDU SESSION RESOURCE SETUP REQUEST message?
question_23021.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node must report the PDU Set based Handling Indicator IE in the PDU Session Resource Setup Response Transfer IE of the PDU SESSION RESOURCE SETUP RESPONSE message.

question_23023.question: What is the interpretation of the "TON" field and the "NPI" field in the "Address" of the "EVENT DOWNLOAD" for MT call and Call Connected events?
question_23023.ground_truth: The "TON" (Type of Number) field is "Unknown" and the "NPI" (Numbering Plan Indicator) field is "ISDN / telephone numbering plan" in the "Address" of the "EVENT DOWNLOAD" for MT call and Call Connected events.

question_23024.question: What is a transport channel, as defined in the context of the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_23024.ground_truth: A transport channel is a service offered by the physical layer to the higher layers, defining how and with what characteristics data is transferred over the air interface.

question_23025.question: What should the system do upon receiving a SIP NOTIFY request, indicating the per-user affiliation information of a remote MCPTT user relative to the targeted MCPTT group?
question_23025.ground_truth: If the per-user affiliation information in the received SIP NOTIFY request indicates that the remote MCPTT user is not affiliated to the targeted MCPTT group, the system should indicate to the requesting MCPTT user that the remote MCPTT user cannot be affiliated to the targeted MCPTT group.

question_23026.question: What should the UE do when it has at least one active PDU session and has not registered in S1 mode yet but needs to transfer an active PDU session from N1 mode to S1 mode?
question_23026.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the EPS attach procedure with request type set to "handover" in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message. After successfully attached in S1 mode, the UE may transfer other active PDU sessions from N1 mode to S1 mode by initiating the PDN connectivity procedure with request type set to "handover" in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message.

question_23027.question: What should be known for an UE to initiate Inter-UE Transfer procedures towards an UE not IMS registered?
question_23027.ground_truth: The UE initiating Inter-UE Transfer procedures towards an UE not IMS registered should know the E.164 number of the device in order to address the transfer request.

question_23029.question: In what state are the bearer contexts when the UE sends the Forward Relocation Request message in PMM-CONNECTED state?
question_23029.ground_truth: The bearer contexts are sent already in the Forward Relocation Request message.

question_23030.question: What is the purpose of MCSEC-6.2-1, ensuring that all mission critical users are authenticated with their home identity management service before authentication or authorization with a partner domain?
question_23030.ground_truth: The purpose is to prevent an adversary from accessing and overloading mission critical resources, thereby denying them to other mission critical users.

question_23032.question: What is the goal of the energy control in frame erasure concealment?
question_23032.ground_truth: The goal is to minimize energy discontinuities by scaling the synthesized signal to render the energy of the signal at the beginning of the recovery frame similar to the energy of the synthesized signal at the end of the last frame erased during the frame erasure.

question_23033.question: What should the MFAF send as the response status code if an error occurs when processing an HTTP POST request?
question_23033.ground_truth: The MFAF should send an HTTP error response as specified in clause 5.1.7 if an error occurs when processing an HTTP POST request.

question_23034.question: Which UE categories have the requirement for normal coverage in idle mode, assuming radio condition that SCH Es/IoT -6 dB and CRS Es/IoT -6 dB?
question_23034.ground_truth: UE category M2 has the requirement for normal coverage in idle mode, assuming radio condition that SCH Es/IoT -6 dB and CRS Es/IoT -6 dB.

question_23035.question: What is the role of the AZF in Solution 2?
question_23035.ground_truth: The AZF acts as the authorization function in Solution 2, which is separate from the OpenID provider.

question_23036.question: What must the MS (Mobile Station) do to complete the Routing Area Updating procedure after receiving the ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message?
question_23036.ground_truth: The MS initiates the establishment of an uplink TBF and transmits a ROUTING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message accepting the new P-TMSI.

question_23037.question: How many bits are used to quantize the TNS parcor coefficients for long and short blocks?
question_23037.ground_truth: 4 bits are used to quantize the TNS parcor coefficients for long blocks, and 3 bits for short blocks.

question_23039.question: What is MCover5GS, as specified in Rel-17, for the use by Mission Critical Services (MCS)?
question_23039.ground_truth: MCover5GS aims to enable 5GS for the use by on-network and off-network MCS and adapts the general MC Communication functional model to be applicable under 5GS conditions. It also enables isolation of MC services and their traffic using network slicing, and provides a minimum amount of bandwidth for handling MC services, e.g. when using public networks.

question_23040.question: What is the expected final state of the MS during the test?
question_23040.ground_truth: The MS is in Transfer mode on carrier 2, or in RR dedicated mode.

question_23042.question: What measurements can the Bluetooth beacons provide to support Bluetooth AoA positioning in 3GPP system?
question_23042.ground_truth: The Bluetooth beacons can provide measurements such as Received Signal Strength (RSSI) and estimated Angle of Departure (AoD) in azimuth and zenith angles to support Bluetooth AoA positioning in 3GPP system.

question_23045.question: In the context of ICE procedures, what is the purpose of the P-CSCF requesting the IMS-ALG to reserve media- and STUN resources towards a peer?
question_23045.ground_truth: The P-CSCF requests the IMS-ALG to reserve media- and STUN resources towards a peer in order to perform the necessary connectivity checks per the ICE procedures.

question_23046.question: What technology does the tent provider use to deliver video over the MNO's network?
question_23046.ground_truth: The tent provider uses adaptive bitrate technology to deliver video over the MNO's network.

question_23047.question: How does FLO differ from the current approach in GERAN Release 5 in terms of mapping logical channels to basic physical channels?
question_23047.ground_truth: FLO takes a different approach from GERAN Release 5 in that it offers one or more transport channels to the MAC sublayer, similar to UTRAN, instead of providing logical channels. This allows for a more flexible and efficient handling of data flows with different QoS requirements.

question_23050.question: In what situations must the UE deactivate ISR locally?
question_23050.ground_truth: The UE must deactivate ISR locally in situations such as modification of any EPS bearer context or PDP context, moving between E-UTRAN, GERAN, and UTRAN, updating either MME or SGSN about the change of UE specific DRX parameters or UE Core Network Capabilities, and for UEs that are IMS registered for voice and move between Tracking Area Lists that support and do not support IMS voice over PS sessions, among others.

question_23051.question: What is the difference between controlled power down UE and uncontrolled power down UE scenarios?
question_23051.ground_truth: In the controlled power down UE scenario, the user or FRMCS User initiates power-down of the UE, and the FRMCS Equipment de-registers from the FRMCS System before the UE is switched off. In the uncontrolled power down UE scenario, the UE loses power probably without being able to notify the FRMCS System, and the FRMCS System deregisters all identities associated with the FRMCS Equipment.

question_23052.question: Who is authorized to cancel an MCPTT group's in-progress emergency state?
question_23052.ground_truth: An authorized user, such as a dispatcher or supervisor, can cancel the in-progress emergency state of the group. However, only the initiator of an MCPTT emergency alert can cancel their local MCPTT emergency state.

question_23053.question: What action is taken by the invalidate method in normal execution?
question_23053.ground_truth: In normal execution, the currently selected EF of the calling applet is invalidated, i.e. the flag in the EF file status is changed accordingly.

question_23054.question: What must the UE-1 do in order to discover members associated with a specific ProSe Application ID in proximity?
question_23054.ground_truth: UE-1 groupcasts a Targeted Discovery Request message, including the ProSe Application ID and the Application Layer User ID or ProSe UE ID of the discoverer.

question_23055.question: What is the purpose of using avatar rendering in this use case?
question_23055.ground_truth: The purpose of using avatar rendering in this use case is to provide an immersive shopping experience equivalent to a face-to-face purchase in a crowded market.

question_23056.question: What are some Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS) that can provide global coverage?
question_23056.ground_truth: Some Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS) that can provide global coverage include GPS, Galileo, GLONASS, and BeiDou Navigation Satellite System.

question_23058.question: What must the UE do when there is no DRB for the Always On Control QoS Flow?
question_23058.ground_truth: The UE rejects any UL packet and does not initiate Service Request for the Always On Control QoS Flow with no DRB.

question_23059.question: Which message does the HSS send to the UE to acknowledge the deactivation of 3GPP PS Data Off?
question_23059.ground_truth: The HSS sends back an acknowledgement message after marking 3GPP PS Data Off as being deactivated for the IMSI received.

question_23060.question: What is the definition of a GBR SAE bearer?
question_23060.ground_truth: A GBR SAE bearer is an SAE bearer that has dedicated network resources related to a Guaranteed Bit Rate (GBR) value associated with it, which are permanently allocated at SAE bearer establishment/modification.

question_23061.question: What is the function of the ANDSF in the context of non-3GPP technology selection?
question_23061.ground_truth: The Access Network Discovery and Selection Function (ANDSF) is responsible for providing information and rules that help the UE in selecting the most appropriate access network and radio interface based on operator policies and roaming agreements.

question_23063.question: What information does the P-CSCF use to select the appropriate interface/protocol when it supports both Rx and N5 interfaces toward the policy function?
question_23063.ground_truth: The P-CSCF can use the trunk identity in incoming trunk identifiers, such as a physical port, VPN, or source MAC address, to determine the appropriate protocol/interface to use when interfacing with a combined node or a non-combined node.

question_23067.question: What is the purpose of Handover Optimization in the context of network virtualization?
question_23067.ground_truth: The purpose of Handover Optimization is to reduce or avoid Handover (HO) rejections in virtualized environments, where HO may be rejected due to inadequate available virtual resources such as processor and memory in the target gNB. This helps reduce wastage of UE and network resources and decreases service disruptions due to increased latency and Radio Link Failures (RLFs).

question_23070.question: What condition must be met for an HD-FDD UE to perform a PRACH transmission in a cell?
question_23070.ground_truth: An HD-FDD UE must have received at least one SSB associated with the PRACH resource in the last Tp period (160 ms) before the PRACH transmission.

question_23071.question: What request does the SCC AS send in response to the SIP REFER request sent by UE-3 to initiate the transfer of UE-1 to the conferencing AS?
question_23071.ground_truth: The SCC AS sends a SIP 202 (Accepted) response to UE-3 as a response to the SIP REFER request sent by UE-3 to initiate the transfer of UE-1 to the conferencing AS.

question_23072.question: In the GTP Tunnel Endpoint IE, what does the Transport Layer Address contain?
question_23072.ground_truth: The Transport Layer Address in the GTP Tunnel Endpoint IE contains an IP address to be used for the X2 user plane transport or for the S1 user plane transport.

question_23074.question: What is the overhead incurred by the MBSFN subframe based method for deriving synchronization in a TDD system?
question_23074.ground_truth: The overhead incurred by this scheme depends on the number of hops and would be equal to the number of hops times one subframe in every 320 subframes.

question_23075.question: In the case of BM-Case1 when Set B is a subset of Set A and for DL Tx beam prediction, how does the performance of AI/ML compare with a random Rx beam (s) and the best Rx beam as inputs for the AI/ML model for beam prediction?
question_23075.ground_truth: Evaluation results from multiple sources have shown a degradation of 20%~50% with random Rx beam(s) compared with the best Rx beam in terms of Top-1 prediction accuracy.

question_23077.question: How does the solution work for the case where the PCSCF FQDN/IP@ is provided using DHCP/DNS?
question_23077.ground_truth: The solution works for this case, but it has a limitation that the type of anchor (PGW or SMF) does not change between UE reboots. If the type of anchor changes, the lifetime of the FQDN of PCSCF may still point to the wrong interface of P-CSCF, which would not work.

question_23078.question: What is the purpose of the PACKET DOWNLINK ASSIGNMENT message in step 4 in the test procedure?
question_23078.ground_truth: The purpose of the PACKET DOWNLINK ASSIGNMENT message in step 4 in the test procedure is to assign a downlink TBF (temporary block flow) on the same timeslot as the uplink TBF.

question_23079.question: How many orders of intermodulation products, ranging from 2 to 5, are generated by dual uplink of bands 2 and n77 in the context of UE coexistence studies?

question_23080.question: What is the concept of OTA REFSENS over the RoAoA, which define a contour equivalent to the 3dB beam width of a non-AAS passive antenna covering the same RoAoA, in the context of OTA sensitivity?
question_23080.ground_truth: The concept allows for simple estimation of equivalent directivity by use of standard formula and helps to demonstrate the minimum sensitivity of the OTA AAS BS receiver.

question_23081.question: When should the UE include reducedMaxBW-FR1 and reducedBW-FR2 in the MaxBW-Preference IE?
question_23081.ground_truth: The UE should include reducedMaxBW-FR1 and reducedMaxBW-FR2 in the MaxBW-Preference IE, if the UE prefers to reduce the maximum aggregated bandwidth for FR1 or FR2.

question_23082.question: What is one of the requirements for capability exposure in the 3GPP network?
question_23082.ground_truth: The 3GPP network shall enable an MNO to inform a 3rd party of the result of delivering a TV service to a user.

question_23086.question: What should the SS send to the MS after the MS sends a DTM REQUEST message to the SS to request uplink data transfer in the context of mobile originating CS release?
question_23086.ground_truth: The SS sends a DTM ASSIGNMENT COMMAND message to the MS, and the MS returns an ASSIGNMENT COMPLETE message on the new signalling link and continues transmitting on the uplink TBF.

question_23088.question: Which architecture does the present document apply to, with regard to the MCVideo service?
question_23088.ground_truth: The present document applies to the mission critical video service that uses the EPC architecture defined in 3GPP TS 23.401 and the 5G System architecture defined in 3GPP TS 23.501.

question_23090.question: What type of header field is required in a SIP INFO request for USSD operations in IMS?
question_23090.ground_truth: The Info-Package header field containing the g.3gpp.ussd info-package name.

question_23091.question: What shall the MCVideo client do upon an indication from a user to initiate a group call for an MCVideo group ID, as per TS 24.281 clause 9.3.2.4.2.1?
question_23091.ground_truth: The MCVideo client shall store the MCVideo group ID, create a call type control state machine, generate a GROUP CALL PROBE message, send the message, start timers TFG3 and TFG1, and enter the "S2: waiting for call announcement" state.

question_23092.question: What message is used by the system simulator to indicate the return result of the DeactivateSS operation in the test procedure?
question_23092.ground_truth: RELEASE COMPLETE message with Facility information element

question_23097.question: What is the issue described in the scenario where multiple and different slices can be supported on different frequencies or on the same frequency in different regions?
question_23097.ground_truth: The issue is that the user equipment (UE) is unaware of the slices supported on different cells or frequencies, which may prevent it from reselecting to the cell or frequency supporting the intended slice.

question_23098.question: What action does the MME take if the PDN type has been changed in the attach procedure?
question_23098.ground_truth: The MME will return an appropriate reason cause to the UE if the PDN type has been changed.

question_23099.question: What is the role of the Discovery and Registration Function (DRF) in M2M communication?
question_23099.ground_truth: The Discovery and Registration Function (DRF) helps the M2ME to discover and register with the Selected Home Operator (SHO), and includes address resolution.

question_23101.question: What are the three steps used to accelerate the matching between visual and spatial features in AR?
question_23101.ground_truth: The three steps to accelerate matching are: (1) retrieving the closest keyframe to the current frame, (2) matching the visual features between the current frame and the retrieved keyframe, and (3) matching the visual features between the current frame and the spatial feature cloud using known matches between visual features of the keyframes and spatial features of the spatial map.

question_23102.question: What should the UE do if the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message includes the 5GS registration result IE with the "NSSAA to be performed" indicator set to "Network slice-specific authentication and authorization is to be performed" and the message contains a pending NSSAI?
question_23102.ground_truth: In this case, the UE should delete any stored allowed NSSAI as specified in subclause~4.6.2.2.

question_23105.question: What action must the UE take if it is not transmitting PUSCH for the serving cell and receives TPC command for PUSCH with DCI format 3/3A?
question_23105.ground_truth: The UE shall assume that the UE transmit power for the PUSCH transmission in subframe i for the serving cell is computed as given in Clause 5.1.2.1 of the specification.

question_23106.question: How many TCI states can be mapped to a TCI codepoint in the Enhanced TCI States Activation/Deactivation for UE-specific PDSCH MAC CE?
question_23106.ground_truth: The maximum number of TCI states mapped to a TCI codepoint is 2.

question_23110.question: What action does the mobile station take when it receives a change in the Channel Coding Command in a PACKET UPLINK ACK/NACK message during the countdown procedure in the unacknowledged mode of RLC data transmission?
question_23110.ground_truth: The mobile station shall act upon the new Channel Coding Command and recalculate the CV values for any untransmitted RLC data blocks using the new RLC data block size.

question_23111.question: Which input signal should be applied while testing EC-channels with Overlaid CDMA using a Multipath Fading Simulator?
question_23111.ground_truth: When testing EC-channels with Overlaid CDMA, two input wanted signals corresponding to Overlaid CDMA sub-channels should be applied. In case Overlaid CDMA is not applied, connect the input signal to each of the two RX antenna connectors via Multipath Fading Simulators.

question_23113.question: What is the MBMS-User-Data-Mode-Indication AVP used for in the RAA command?
question_23113.ground_truth: The MBMS-User-Data-Mode-Indication AVP is used to indicate the mode of user data in the RAA command.

question_23114.question: What does the abbreviation "CA" stand for in the context of the document?
question_23114.ground_truth: In the context of the document, "CA" stands for Carrier Aggregation.

question_23115.question: What is the purpose of using the "additionalProperties: false" keyword in an OpenAPI specification?
question_23115.ground_truth: The "additionalProperties: false" keyword enables the OpenAPI tooling to check that only allowed modifications are done. However, it is not appropriate to use this keyword if new optional attributes are expected to be introduced without a corresponding supported feature or if PATCH can be used as the first operation in an API.

question_23116.question: What occurs during step 8a of the private call procedure?
question_23116.ground_truth: The MCPTT user is alerted, and the MCPTT client 2 sends an MCPTT ringing to the MCPTT server.

question_23117.question: Which measurement provides the number of successful EPS detach procedures initiated by UE within this MME area, not including retransmissions?

question_23118.question: What is the role of feedback information in Intent-driven MnS?
question_23118.ground_truth: Feedback information is provided by the service after the intent is received and implemented, indicating whether the intent is successfully executed or not, and possibly the reasons for not successful executions.

question_23119.question: What is the maximum length of the latency requirement of the traffic that determines the upper bound of the resource selection window?
question_23119.ground_truth: The maximum length of the latency requirement of the traffic is 100 ms.

question_23120.question: What should the SS (node B emulator) transmit after the SS has received 5 preambles from the UE in Test 1 or Test 2?
question_23120.ground_truth: The SS shall transmit a random access response containing a random access preamble identifier corresponding to the transmitted random access after 5 preambles have been received by the SS.

question_23121.question: What information does the VLR store about CFU?
question_23121.ground_truth: The VLR stores the service state information received from the HLR for all relevant elementary basic service groups.

question_23122.question: What are the parameters that may require different levels of processing in a DASH-based model?
question_23122.ground_truth: The parameters that may require different levels of processing in a DASH-based model include parameters required in the DASH client, ISO BMFF parser, video decoder, and display.

question_23123.question: What is one of the mobility support levels that the 3GPP system can enable for different UEs?
question_23123.ground_truth: Minimizing packet loss during inter- and/or intra-RAT cell changes.

question_23124.question: What is the purpose of the MO-LR Invoke message sent by the UE in step 14?
question_23124.ground_truth: The MO-LR Invoke message sent by the UE in step 14 indicates an event report for a deferred periodic and triggered location request, providing the type of event trigger being reported, the LDR reference number, H-GMLC address and whether a location estimate is required.

question_23125.question: In what scenario will the Node B reject the procedure using the RADIO LINK ADDITION FAILURE message, if the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message contains a MIMO Activation Indicator IE and a Single Stream MIMO Activation Indicator IE in the HS-DSCH FDD Information IE in the HS-DSCH Serving Cell Change Information IE or in the HS-DSCH FDD Secondary Serving Information IE in the Additional HS Cell Information RL Addition IE?
question_23125.ground_truth: The Node B will reject the procedure if the above conditions are met, as it is not possible to have both a MIMO Activation Indicator and a Single Stream MIMO Activation Indicator in the same message.

question_23126.question: What does CRS media consist of in the CRS service?
question_23126.ground_truth: CRS media consists of music, voice, text, video, or other customized ringing signals.

question_23128.question: What happens after an emergency service or service b) to h) successfully passes access control?
question_23128.ground_truth: Certain access attempts are allowed to proceed without further access control checking to avoid double barring as long as the service is ongoing.

question_23129.question: In which conditions does the IBCF provide the IRI-POI functions in the alternate deployment option for session-dependent IMS communications?
question_23129.ground_truth: In the alternate deployment option, the IBCF provides the IRI-POI functions for session-dependent IMS communications when the target involved is an outbound roaming (with LBO) IMS user, the IMS session to a target is redirected to a user in the IP domain, the IMS session to a target is redirected to an outbound roaming (with LBO) IMS user, and the inbound roaming (with LBO) IMS user is in communication with a target non-local ID on an IMS session that employs home-routed media.

question_23130.question: What is the duplex gap that needs to be considered in the design of the duplexer for the 1670-1680 MHz band?

question_23131.question: What step is necessary to determine the order in which an emergency session is attempted over the available networks?
question_23131.ground_truth: The UE shall select an access network for initiating emergency sessions by using the "access selection for emergency sessions" information and by considering other applicable conditions such as the signal strength of WLAN and 3GPP accesses.

question_23132.question: What are the initial values of the variables and in the absolute vector indexing process?
question_23132.ground_truth: is initialized to zero before the first step at the beginning of the procedure, and is initialized to zero before the first step at the beginning of the procedure for each new absolute vector.

question_23134.question: What are the use cases for a coherent approach to version handling in SA5 OAM specifications?
question_23134.ground_truth: Some use cases for version handling include requesting a list of supported interface IRPs, IRP versions, operations, notifications, packages, and parameters for operations and notifications. Others include handling versions of network resource model objects and supported PM file formats.

question_23135.question: In which section of the document does the requirement for PRACH detection probability apply?

question_23136.question: What happens if a call to a controlled called number matches several active basic gap criteria of the same type?
question_23136.ground_truth: Only the gap criteria associated with the longest called party number is used, and the corresponding control is applied.

question_23137.question: How are the legal values of the nsVersionInfo attribute determined in the proposal?
question_23137.ground_truth: The legal values of the nsVersionInfo attribute are defined as strings representing a specification authority, a specification number, and a version number. Examples include "3GPP, 32.766 V9.1" and "MEF, 7.1."

question_23140.question: What is the procedure for codec negotiation when the external network provides a single codec for an outgoing call with support for preconditions?
question_23140.ground_truth: When the external network provides a single codec, no second SDP offer/answer is needed for codec negotiation in an outgoing call with support for preconditions.

question_23141.question: What are the two modes of idle periods used for location services in a wireless network?
question_23141.ground_truth: The two modes are continuous mode, where idle periods are active all the time, and burst mode, where idle periods are arranged in bursts with breaks in between.

question_23142.question: What is the variation in 10th percentile user throughput for non-TX-diversity users in a VehA 30 kmph channel when the inter-site distance is 2.8 km?
question_23142.ground_truth: The variation in 10th percentile user throughput for non-TX-diversity users in a VehA 30 kmph channel when the inter-site distance is 2.8 km is from 0 % to 20 %, which is inconsistent among companies.

question_23143.question: What is the method used in the Generic Service Interface to specify the reference address of the callback interface that a service uses to invoke methods on the application?
question_23143.ground_truth: The method used in the Generic Service Interface to specify the reference address of the callback interface that a service uses to invoke methods on the application is setCallback().

question_23145.question: What is the importance of 3D geo-localization in the storage area C of the asset management system?
question_23145.ground_truth: High accuracy 3D geo-localization is needed in the storage area C to distinguish containers on stacks during handling, which is essential for traceability and regulatory compliance.

question_23146.question: What can result in inefficient node selection algorithm at the source node if not taken into account during the session selection process?
question_23146.ground_truth: The overload information of the Access Point Name (APN) for the given PDN Gateway (PGW).

question_23148.question: What is the advantage of deploying user plane network entities closer to the RAN in the pooled deployment of MMEs scenario?
question_23148.ground_truth: Deploying user plane network entities closer to the RAN in the pooled deployment of MMEs can optimise the routing, reduce the required transmission resources, and result in less MME changes compared to a single MME deployment.

question_23150.question: What is the primary function of the Real Time Counter (RTC) in the EC-GSM SoC?
question_23150.ground_truth: The RTC has its own dedicated power island, which is always kept powered on, and functions as a wakeup source for the platform. It also generates all EC-GSM scheduling related timing information for the controller, DSP, and RF transceiver.

question_23152.question: What is a potential requirement for the integration of type-b networks with the 5G system?
question_23152.ground_truth: One potential requirement is to avoid bottlenecks in PLMN ID allocation due to the scalability of local type-b networks.

question_23155.question: Who provides VPLMN specific URSP Rules to the UE for routing traffic to the VPLMN?
question_23155.ground_truth: The H-PCF (Home PCF) provides VPLMN specific URSP Rules to the UE.

question_23158.question: What should the participating MCVideo function do if the <allow-request-locally-initiated-ambient-viewing> element is not present or set to 'false' in the MCVideo user profile document?
question_23158.ground_truth: If the <allow-request-locally-initiated-ambient-viewing> element is not present or set to 'false' in the MCVideo user profile document, the participating MCVideo function should reject the SIP INVITE request for originating participating MCVideo function with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response. This indicates that the MCVideo user is not authorized to make an ambient viewing call in this case.

question_23160.question: What is the purpose of the SSRC identifier in media floor control messages and quality feedback messages in the MCPTT call?
question_23160.ground_truth: The SSRC identifier is used to identify the source of media streams and quality feedback messages in the MCPTT call.

question_23161.question: What happens to the policy decision and/or condition data when the PCF decides to remove them and they have been silently removed by the SMF before that?
question_23161.ground_truth: The SMF accepts the removal indication.

question_23162.question: What are the main functionalities of an X2-proxy in the discussed solution?
question_23162.ground_truth: The X2 proxy functionality includes passing UE-dedicated X2 signaling messages between X2-connected eNBs and HeNBs, supporting the establishment of X2-connectivity between eNBs and HeNBs, and terminating non-UE-dedicated signaling with both the HeNB and the eNB.

question_23163.question: What is the use of the UL Classifier functionality in a PDU Session?
question_23163.ground_truth: The UL Classifier functionality is used in a PDU Session to divert traffic matching traffic filters provided by the SMF, allowing for traffic routing after the PDU Session Establishment.

question_23164.question: What issue does Solution #8 aim to address in the 5G network architecture with support of satellite access?
question_23164.ground_truth: The key issue that Solution #8 aims to address is mobility management with moving satellite coverage areas.

question_23166.question: What protocol does the TE use to initially negotiate for CHAP and if unsuccessful, for PAP?

question_23168.question: What is the purpose of using frequency hopping in the OSC solution?
question_23168.ground_truth: The purpose of using frequency hopping in the OSC solution is to improve interference diversity and fairness among mobile stations in the cell, making the channel robust to a certain amount of interference.

question_23169.question: What is the purpose of the Advice Of Charge (AOC) service in the TISPAN NGN Release 2 network?
question_23169.ground_truth: The AOC service allows the served user to be informed of IP Multimedia session related charging information in the TISPAN NGN Release 2 network.

question_23171.question: What should the mobile station do during T3122 timer running after receiving an encapsulated IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT REJECT message in response to non-emergency call establishment?
question_23171.ground_truth: The mobile station should not attempt to originate a further non-emergency call whilst T3122 is running after receiving an encapsulated IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT REJECT message in response to non-emergency call establishment.

question_23173.question: What is the purpose of the TU5908 timer in the GA-RRC connection establishment procedure?
question_23173.ground_truth: The TU5908 timer is used to measure the time taken for the GA-RRC connection establishment procedure. If it expires, then the GA-RRC sub-layer entity in the MS shall remain in the GA-RRC-IDLE state and indicate to upper layers that GA-RRC was not able to enter the connected state for the domain.

question_23174.question: What is the role of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in the development of the technical specification for 5G system architecture enhancements to support Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) services?
question_23174.ground_truth: The 3GPP is responsible for producing the technical specification for the 5G system architecture enhancements to support V2X services.

question_23175.question: What is the purpose of the "a=rid" attribute in MMCMH?
question_23175.ground_truth: The "a=rid" attribute in MMCMH is used to identify simulcast formats and shall be unique within a media clause ("m=" line). SDP simulcast negotiation decides which simulcast formats, if any, are sent between the conference participant and the MRFP.

question_23176.question: What principles should be adhered to in terms of the quality of intercepted data?
question_23176.ground_truth: Intercepted data should be delivered as soon as possible following the triggering event, contain a timestamp, and maintain the same quality of service as the original content of communication. The QoS used for interception may be agreed upon by operators and law enforcement.

question_23177.question: What kind of measurement is provided in subclause 4.9.3.1 for attempted radio link setups on Iur?
question_23177.ground_truth: This measurement provides the number of attempted radio link setups on Iur for each cell. This measurement shall be increased for each attempted radio link setup on Iur. This measurement is valid only for FDD mode.

question_23179.question: What should the UE do if it has received a mapping of the S-NSSAI to an Alternative S-NSSAI in the Allowed NSSAI during a new PDU Session establishment procedure?
question_23179.ground_truth: If the UE has received a mapping of the S-NSSAI to an Alternative S-NSSAI, the UE shall provide both the Alternative S-NSSAI and the S-NSSAI in the PDU Session Establishment message.

question_23180.question: What action should the SLM-S take when the TLM-2 timer expires?
question_23180.ground_truth: The SLM-S should check if any notification is pending to send or not, and if any pending notifications are present, follow the procedure described in clause 6.2.7.2 to send notification.

question_23181.question: What limitations are there on advertising overload control information based on DNNs?
question_23181.ground_truth: The number of DNNs for which overload control advertisement can be necessary is limited due to processing and storage requirements at the overloaded SMF entity and its receiver, interoperability between NFs of different vendors, and to ensure reasonable use of resources.

question_23182.question: In what scenarios does Service Gap Control not apply in the context of UE requests?
question_23182.ground_truth: Service Gap Control does not apply to exception reporting for NB-IoT or to accessing the network for regulatory prioritized services like Emergency services when a Service Gap timer is running.

question_23183.question: What is the frequency range for the unwanted emission limits related to the protection of Earth Exploration Satellite Service in section 9.7.4.3.4.1?
question_23183.ground_truth: The frequency range for the unwanted emission limits related to the protection of Earth Exploration Satellite Service in section 9.7.4.3.4.1 is 24.25 GHz to 27.5 GHz.

question_23184.question: In the UL, what are the modifications introduced to assist with FET?
question_23184.ground_truth: The modifications introduced to assist with FET in the UL include changes to the UL DPCCH slot format to maintain ILPC timeline, changes to TPC rate to accommodate ACK signalling, and compression/repetition in UL.

question_23185.question: What should the RNC perform when it receives the Multicast Service list in the Information Requested IE in the UPLINK INFORMATION EXCHANGE RESPONSE message?
question_23185.ground_truth: When the RNC receives the Multicast Service list in the Information Requested IE in the UPLINK INFORMATION EXCHANGE RESPONSE message, it should perform the corresponding UE linking for each TMGI received.

question_23186.question: Who is responsible for avoiding duplicate provisioning for a specific attribute in the solution for Key Issue #1?
question_23186.ground_truth: OAM is responsible for avoiding duplicate provisioning for a specific attribute in both NF profile registered by the NF Producer and the shared data for the NF Set.

question_23187.question: What are the types of roaming offered by the CTS-FP operator?
question_23187.ground_truth: The types of roaming offered by the CTS-FP operator are uncontrolled roaming, no roaming, and control roaming.

question_23190.question: What is the required information for establishing an on-demand private data communication connection with multiple types of data communication using 3GPP System?
question_23190.ground_truth: At least IP and Ethernet should be supported as multiple types of data communication.

question_23191.question: In Coverage Evaluation Method 1 for FR1, UMa, DL, VR/AR30, #UE/cell=Capacity(1), which source observed a mean DL coverage of -72dB?
question_23191.ground_truth: Source 15 observed a mean DL coverage of -72dB in Coverage Evaluation Method 1 for FR1, UMa, DL, VR/AR30, #UE/cell=Capacity(1) with the AR30 option.

question_23193.question: What is a telepresence system defined as in the context of 3GPP services?
question_23193.ground_truth: A telepresence system is defined as a set of functions, devices and network elements which are able to capture, deliver, manage and render multiple high quality interactive audio and video signals in a telepresence conference.

question_23194.question: When GPRS-IMS-Bundled authentication is in use and a 401 (Unauthorized) response is not expected to be received after the REGISTER request, what should the UE do if it receives a 420 (Bad Extension) response containing the Unsupported header field with the value "sec-agree"?
question_23194.ground_truth: If GPRS-IMS-Bundled authentication is in use, the UE should initiate a new authentication attempt with the GPRS-IMS-Bundled authentication procedures as specified in subclause 5.1.1.2.6, if it receives a 420 (Bad Extension) response containing the Unsupported header field with the value "sec-agree".

question_23195.question: What is the RS/measurement overhead reduction achieved with measurements from 5 time instances with measurement periodicity of 160ms?
question_23195.ground_truth: A 1/2 or 3/5 RS/measurement overhead reduction can be achieved with measurements from 5 time instances with measurement periodicity of 160ms.

question_23196.question: What is one of the criteria used for network broadcast geographic area coverage management in the 3GPP network?
question_23196.ground_truth: The available network unicast/broadcast capacity of the 3GPP network.

question_23197.question: What action should be taken when the timeAlignmentTimer associated with a TAG is not running, and a timing advance command is received?
question_23197.ground_truth: Apply the timing advance command for the TAG and start or restart the timeAlignmentTimer associated with it.

question_23198.question: What is the significance of the P-Charging-Vector header field parameter in a SIP INVITE request due to ATU-STI?
question_23198.ground_truth: The P-Charging-Vector header field parameter in a SIP INVITE request due to ATU-STI identifies the transit network from which the SIP INVITE request is received, i.e. the interconnect network A.

question_23199.question: How many components are permuted during the second stage of the LP-CNG synthesis filter computation, and how are they chosen?
question_23199.ground_truth: During the second stage of the LP-CNG synthesis filter computation, two components are permuted. The first index of the permutation is chosen from the first half of the codevector, and the second index is chosen from the second half or subvector of the codevector.

question_23201.question: What is the total allowed time for the cell re-selection delay to lower priority in the test case?
question_23201.ground_truth: The total allowed time for the cell re-selection delay to lower priority in the test case is 8 seconds.

question_23202.question: What action is taken regarding registration states, when transitioning from RM-REGISTERED to RM-DEREGISTERED, in case of different reasons?
question_23202.ground_truth: There are specific actions taken depending on the reason for the transition, such as switching off or de-registration. The actions range from removing all remaining security parameters to keeping some or all of them.

question_23203.question: What is the expected action of an MME upon receiving End Marker packets over an S11-U tunnel?
question_23203.ground_truth: The MME should discard the End Marker packets and may initiate the release of the corresponding S11-U resources, but this is implementation dependent.

question_23205.question: What does the Translation Type field represent in the Global Title Indicator (GT) and what is the meaning of having it set as 0000 0000?
question_23205.ground_truth: The Translation Type field in the GT is not used, and setting it as 0000 0000 indicates that it is not being utilized.

question_23206.question: What is the purpose of the Cell Identity information element in 3GPP TS 24.008?
question_23206.ground_truth: The Cell Identity information element is used to identify a cell within a location area in 3GPP TS 24.008.

question_23207.question: What is the purpose of recording and filtering ACK, NACK, and statDTX responses for any HSDPA block transmitted by the SS?
question_23207.ground_truth: The purpose is to measure the statistical selectivity based on 1000 samples, to distinguish between BLER less than 0.1 and greater than 0.1, and to test the UE's ability to transmit and receive data using HSDPA.

question_23208.question: What kind of UE implementation-based solution does Group 4 propose for multi-USIM devices?
question_23208.ground_truth: Solution #19 in Group 4 is a UE implementation-based solution not limited by 3GPP. Further discussion and feedback are required from RAN WGs to determine if this solution is 'good enough' for handling multi-USIM devices.

question_23209.question: What is used for the routing capabilities of the MC gateway UE?
question_23209.ground_truth: Framed routing in accordance with IETF RFC 2865, IETF RFC 3162, and 3GPP TS 23.501 is used for the routing capabilities of the MC gateway UE.

question_23210.question: What does the BSS do with the page requests it receives in DRX of GSM system?
question_23210.ground_truth: The BSS receives page requests, analyzes the IMSI to derive the page group of the MS involved and constructs an air interface page request which is transmitted in the appropriate TDMA burst.

question_23211.question: What is required for the network to transfer an IP flow from a source access to a target access without exchanging routing rules in the 7.6.1.1.1 solution?
question_23211.ground_truth: The PGW can transmit uplink traffic for these IP flows to the target access if the UE autonomously transfers at least one IP flow to a target access. The PGW will not transmit any more traffic to the source access in this case.

question_23212.question: What must the transmission participant do upon receiving an indication from the user to end the RTP media reception?
question_23212.ground_truth: Send a Media reception end request message towards the transmission control server and enter the 'U: pending reception release' state.

question_23213.question: What does the acronym "3GPP" in the document stand for?

question_23214.question: What is the effect of including the IMSI in the Mobile identity IE in the ATTACH REQUEST message?
question_23214.ground_truth: When the IMSI is included in the Mobile identity IE in the ATTACH REQUEST message, it indicates that the MS does not support S1 mode, or the selected PLMN is neither the registered PLMN nor in the list of equivalent PLMNs.

question_23215.question: What information should the UE include in the INVITE request if available and defined for the access type as specified in subclause~7.2A.4?
question_23215.ground_truth: If available to the UE, and if defined for the access type as specified in subclause~7.2A.4, the UE should include a location identifier such as the cell id, line id or the identity of the WLAN access node in the P-Access-Network-Info header field of the INVITE request, which is relevant for routeing the IMS emergency call.

question_23216.question: What is the responsibility of the PIN Element Management Capability Function (PEMCF) in the PIN architecture?
question_23216.ground_truth: The PIN Element Management Capability Function (PEMCF) is responsible for providing the capability to manage the PIN in 5GC, such as processing the request of creating PIN, choosing a UE to be a PEMC and distribute a PIN ID to identify a PIN, etc.

question_23217.question: What is the expected format of the location estimate in the uplink SLPP message as per 3GPP TS 24.501 and 23.273?
question_23217.ground_truth: The UE includes a Routing identifier received in the Additional Information IE of the DL NAS TRANSPORT message in the Additional Information IE of the UL NAS TRANSPORT message when sending uplink SLPP messages. This association of the Routing Identifier is provided at the LPP level, with the UL NAS TRANSPORT message carrying an LPP message that is a response to or instigated by the LPP message in the DL NAS TRANSPORT message.

question_23218.question: In the payload description of the ASN.1 module, what format is used to identify the media format and media attributes when the payload is in RTP (Real-time Transport Protocol) form?
question_23218.ground_truth: The media format and media attributes in RTP form are identified using the Session Description Protocol (SDP) as defined in RFC 4566.

question_23219.question: What is the expected outcome of the System Simulator when receiving a call set up request while the user is busy on another call?
question_23219.ground_truth: The System Simulator will reject the call set up request with the cause "User Busy".

question_23220.question: What is the action taken by the AMF when the S-NSSAI based congestion control is activated and the UE indicates that the NAS SM message is exempted from NAS congestion control?
question_23220.ground_truth: The AMF shall not apply S-NSSAI based congestion control on the UL NAS Transport message and shall forward the NAS SM message to the corresponding SMF with an indication that the message was received with exemption indication.

question_23221.question: What is the required percentage of successful reported values for the FDD RSRQ absolute accuracy for carrier aggregation test to pass?
question_23221.ground_truth: The required percentage of successful reported values for the FDD RSRQ absolute accuracy for carrier aggregation test to pass is more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_23223.question: What is the role of the IpAppDataSession interface in handling data session request responses and state reports?
question_23223.ground_truth: The IpAppDataSession interface is used on the application side to handle data session request responses and state reports.

question_23225.question: What limitations were imposed on system level simulations regarding TSC assignment?
question_23225.ground_truth: For paired users, a TSC pair was defined as (TSC x from TSC Set 1, TSC x from TSC Set 2). For non-paired users, a TSC chosen from TSC Set 1 was always assumed. When leaving a VAMOS pair, a user who was formerly allocated TSC x from TSC Set 2 had to change the TSC to TSC x from TSC Set 1.

question_23226.question: What is the pass criterion for each requirement in this test?
question_23226.ground_truth: The ratio of successful reported values for each requirement must be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_23227.question: What is the requirement for the UICC in this solution for delivering a GPL protected message to the targeted UICC application?
question_23227.ground_truth: The UICC needs to be GPL capable when delivering a GPL protected message to the targeted UICC application in this solution.

question_23228.question: What should the UE do when barring for an Access Category is considered being alleviated and the Access Category was informed to upper layers as barred?
question_23228.ground_truth: The UE should inform upper layers about barring alleviation for the Access Category.

question_23230.question: What is the format of the HTTP POST request that the SLM-S expects when receiving a request to share location information?
question_23230.ground_truth: The HTTP POST request should contain an "Accept" header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.seal-location-info+xml", a "Content-Type" header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.seal-location-info+xml", and an application/vnd.3gpp.seal-location-info+xml MIME body with the <location-info> root element which contains an <identities-list> element.

question_23231.question: Which TS (Technical Specifications) are referenced in this test case for conformance requirements?
question_23231.ground_truth: The conformance requirements are covered in TS 23.122, clause 4.4.3.1.1 and TS 23.167, Annex H.6.

question_23232.question: What should the UE do if it receives CRS media from the network?
question_23232.ground_truth: The UE should play it as ringing tone.

question_23233.question: What information does the Serving GW include in the Create Session Response message if Control Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation applies and if the MME does not include Control Plane Only PDN Connection Indicator in the Create Session Request?
question_23233.ground_truth: If Control Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation applies and if the MME does not include Control Plane Only PDN Connection Indicator in the Create Session Request, the Serving GW includes the Serving GW IP address and TEID for S11-U and additionally the Serving GW IP address and TEID for S1-U in the Create Session Response.

question_23234.question: What are the additional requirements for the 3PTY supplementary service?
question_23234.ground_truth: In addition to the requirements for CONF, if a REFER request is supported at the II-NNI, a Replaces header field in the header portion of the SIP URI of the Refer-to header field of the REFER request shall also be supported at II-NNI.

question_23237.question: In a non-roaming scenario, what message triggers the SMF to generate an xIRI containing an SMFMAPDUSessionRelease record?
question_23237.ground_truth: The N1 NAS message PDU SESSION RELEASE COMPLETE received from the UE and the 5GSM state within the SMF is changed to PDU SESSION INACTIVE for a PDU session that is either MA-Confirmed or MA-Upgrade-Allowed.

question_23238.question: What is the significance of the bitrate range in SDP for a QoS aware client?
question_23238.ground_truth: The bitrate range used for adaptation in SDP should align with the MBR and GBR values to ensure QoS.

question_23241.question: What is the time-dilated UMTS solution for scalable UMTS?
question_23241.ground_truth: The time-dilated UMTS solution for scalable UMTS involves increasing the UMTS chip period by a time dilation factor N, where N is equal to 2 or 4, resulting in a reduced chip rate and spectrum bandwidth.

question_23244.question: What HTTP status code is returned when the CancelLocation service operation is successful?

question_23245.question: What is the purpose of the SSRC field in the Floor Queue Request message?
question_23245.ground_truth: The SSRC field in the Floor Queue Request message carries the SSRC of the floor participant who is requesting cancellation of a queued floor request, or the SSRC of the floor control server/arbitrator when notifying or responding to the cancellation of a queued floor request.

question_23246.question: In the context of 6.2H.1.2, what does MPRc refer to?
question_23246.ground_truth: The Maximum Power Reduction for the maximum output power

question_23250.question: What is the role of NSI in the DL scheduling scheme?
question_23250.ground_truth: NSI is the number of RBs reserved for system information in the DL scheduling scheme.

question_23251.question: What is the requirement for the rate of correct events observed during repeated tests for UE measurements?
question_23251.ground_truth: The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests for UE measurements shall be at least 90% with a confidence level of 95% for each of the events.

question_23252.question: What RFCs cover the signalling of parameters with FDT instances in FLUTE?

question_23253.question: What is the subject of the "E1 Signalling Transport" section?
question_23253.ground_truth: The "E1 Signalling Transport" section specifies the technical details of E1 signalling transport in the NG-RAN.

question_23256.question: What is the maximum duration of test for verifying that the MS releases the CTC when the TU5002 timer (CS domain) expires?
question_23256.ground_truth: The maximum duration of test for this is 1 min.

question_23257.question: What is the suggested approach for new channel bandwidths in the 5G network?
question_23257.ground_truth: The suggested approach is to aim for generic solutions, prioritize approaches that avoid the introduction of new channel bandwidths on the UE side, and prefer spectrally efficient methods with fine channel bandwidth granularity, low guard band width, and signaling overhead. Any impact on RAN1, RAN2, and RAN4 requirements should be identified and minimized.

question_23258.question: What is the criterion for a successful test in step 6 of the test procedure described in section 8.4.9.4.2?
question_23258.ground_truth: A test is considered successful if the measurement reporting delay from the beginning of time period T2 is less than 13.2s for cell 2 and 153.6s for cells 3 and 4.

question_23259.question: What technology provides the backhaul part of the industrial communication network in the global time domain?

question_23260.question: What is the format of the Distinguished Name (DN) for a InventoryUnit in the IM NRM?
question_23260.ground_truth: The Distinguished Name (DN) for a InventoryUnit in the IM NRM is a unique identifier that expresses its containment hierarchy. An example of the DN for a InventoryUnit could have a format like: SubNetwork=Sweden,meContext=MEC-Gbg-1,ManagedElement=RNC-Gbg-1,InventoryUnit=Inv-1.

question_23262.question: Under what conditions can a GCS AS activate an MBMS bearer?
question_23262.ground_truth: A GCS AS can activate an MBMS bearer if it sends an Activate MBMS Bearer Request message, including the TMGI, QoS, MBMS broadcast area, and start time, with a valid TMGI for the MBMS bearer to be started, and appropriate QoS parameters, MBMS broadcast area, and start time.

question_23263.question: What is the main function of the Detection Function (DF) in Solution #12?
question_23263.ground_truth: The DF collects UE and network activities to detect abnormal UEs and their behavior, and then sends reports to the Security Function (SF).

question_23266.question: What should the pSEPP return as a response to the N32-f Error Reporting from the Roaming Intermediary?
question_23266.ground_truth: The pSEPP should return the status code "204 No Content" as the response to the N32-f Error Reporting.

question_23267.question: When is a UE allowed to attempt accessing a PLMN from the list of "PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location"?
question_23267.ground_truth: A UE can try to access a PLMN from the list if either the current UE location is not in the geographical area specified for that PLMN entry, or access is for emergency services.

question_23270.question: What do Qout and Qin signify in the context of 17.5.1.0.1?
question_23270.ground_truth: Qout is the level at which the downlink radio link cannot be reliably received, and Qin is the level at which the downlink radio link can be significantly more reliably received than at Qout.

question_23271.question: Which type of icon is displayed in the Expected Sequence 5.3A, when the icon is not self-explanatory?
question_23271.ground_truth: A basic icon is displayed in the Expected Sequence 5.3A, when the icon is not self-explanatory.

question_23272.question: What is the objective of the 3GPP project on studying AI/ML for NR air interface?
question_23272.ground_truth: The central objective of this project is to study the 3GPP framework for AI/ML for air-interface corresponding to each target use case regarding aspects such as performance, complexity, and potential specification impact.

question_23273.question: When do the uplink DPCCH preamble and postamble need to be transmitted in all slots in the radio frame in the presence of an uplink compressed mode transmission gap?
question_23273.ground_truth: When an uplink DPCCH transmission or preamble/postamble overlaps an uplink compressed mode transmission gap.

question_23277.question: What determines the selection of a UPF for N4 session establishment if there is no existing N4 session for DN-related messages?
question_23277.ground_truth: The SMF selects a UPF and triggers N4 session establishment for DN-related messages.

question_23278.question: What is the definition of "Sponsored data related rule" as per the 3GPP technical specification?
question_23278.ground_truth: "Sponsored data related rule" is a term that includes 1) PFD information identifying sponsored data packets, 2) correlation identifier, and 3) charging key.

question_23280.question: What is the maximum allowed overall delay measured in Test 1 and Test 2?
question_23280.ground_truth: In Test 1, the maximum allowed overall delay measured is 1482 ms, and in Test 2, the maximum allowed overall delay measured is 26882 ms.

question_23281.question: How many types of grants are there for 1.28Mcps TDD?
question_23281.ground_truth: There are two types of grants for 1.28Mcps TDD: Absolute Grants and Relative Grants.

question_23282.question: Which frequency bands are relevant for evaluating NB-IoT coexistence with CDMA systems?
question_23282.ground_truth: The frequency bands relevant for evaluating NB-IoT coexistence with CDMA systems are around 800MHz, specifically those used by CDMA devices for providing voice and data services. The most important frequency band for CDMA networks is 800M, which is widely used for providing coverage.

question_23283.question: What are the requirements for the 3GPP Management system to support Alternate 1 of the operational testing feature?
question_23283.ground_truth: The 3GPP Management system should have the ability to indicate test entities meant for testing, assign and select UEs based on specific criteria, select deployment locations for upgraded software, and provide information on the network nodes and UEs selected for testing.

question_23284.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Timed text format?
question_23284.ground_truth: The 3GPP Timed text format is used to define the format of timed text in downloaded files in the 3GPP packet switched streaming service (PSS).
