question_23285.question: What information must the SMF handle upon inclusion of the Secondary RAT Usage Information IE in the PDU Session Resource Notify Transfer IE or the PDU Session Resource Notify Released Transfer IE?
question_23285.ground_truth: The SMF must handle this information as specified in TS~23.502.

question_23286.question: What should the IBCF do if policing the ICSI value contained in the P-Asserted-Service header field?
question_23286.ground_truth: The IBCF may police the ICSI value contained in the P-Asserted-Service header field if receiving a SIP request from another entity within the same trust domain.

question_23287.question: What will be responsible for privacy protection and other security aspects in the R18 architecture?
question_23287.ground_truth: SA3 will be responsible for privacy protection and other security aspects in the R18 architecture.

question_23288.question: What is the purpose of the application-triggered slice re-mapping solution for V2X applications in 3GPP TS 23.501?
question_23288.ground_truth: The solution enables the VAE-S to translate the adaptation of the service requirements / profile, as triggered by the VASS or VASC, to a network slice re-mapping.

question_23290.question: What is the size of the LBT failure MAC CE when the highest ServCellIndex of the MAC entity's Serving Cell is less than 8?
question_23290.ground_truth: A single octet format is used, which is 1 octet in size.

question_23291.question: What is the purpose of the Handover Command message in the Handover Complete procedure?
question_23291.ground_truth: The Handover Command message in the Handover Complete procedure releases the A-interface line towards the serving BSS and requests the MGW to set the Handover Device to its final state.

question_23293.question: What is the purpose of the STA command for the Gmb interface?
question_23293.ground_truth: The STA command is sent in response to an STR~command and confirms the session termination. It indicates the result of the termination request and includes any error messages, if applicable.

question_23294.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 52.3.2.2.2.2?
question_23294.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the MS aborts the downlink TBF establishment and continues the normal operation of the uplink TBF when the PACKET DOWNLINK ASSIGNMENT fails.

question_23295.question: What is the registration area in the 5GS and how does the UE handle it?
question_23295.ground_truth: A registration area in the 5GS is a set of tracking areas and each of these tracking areas consists of one or more cells that cover a geographical area. The UE considers itself registered to a list of tracking areas and does not need to trigger the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update as long as it stays in one of the tracking areas of the list of tracking areas received from the AMF. The UE includes the last visited registered TAI, if available, to the AMF. The last visited registered TAI is stored in a non-volatile memory in the USIM or ME.

question_23296.question: What is required for the UE to obtain code security parameters for PC5 direct discovery and communication procedure?
question_23296.ground_truth: The UE needs to send a Discovery Request message containing necessary information to the 5G DDNMF/PKMF in order to get the associated security material and code security parameters for PC5 direct discovery and communication procedure.

question_23297.question: What is the expected behavior of the P-CSCF when it supports indicating the traffic leg associated with a URI?
question_23297.ground_truth: If the P-CSCF supports indicating the traffic leg associated with a URI, is not in the home network, required by local policy, the UE is roaming and the P-CSCF detects that the UE is behind a NAT, the P-CSCF may append an "iotl" SIP URI parameter with a value set to "homeB-visitedB" to the SIP URI of the Path header field.

question_23298.question: What is the purpose of the PIN PEGC role takeover request and response?
question_23298.ground_truth: The PIN PEGC role takeover request is used to assign the PEGC role to another PIN element and the PIN PEGC role takeover response is used to confirm the success or failure of the request.

question_23299.question: What is the role of the IWF in relation to an MCData user?
question_23299.ground_truth: The IWF acts on behalf of all users homed in the IWF, providing procedures for registration, service authorization, affiliation, SDS, transmission and reception control, dispositions and notifications, communication release, and enhanced status.

question_23301.question: What is the purpose of the 14.2.25.3 test in 3GPP TS 45.005 subclause 14.2.25?
question_23301.ground_truth: The purpose of the 14.2.25.3 test is to verify that the MS does not exceed the conformance requirement under TUhigh propagation condition with an allowance for the statistical significance of the test.

question_23302.question: In what scenario does the NEF not contact the PCF of the PDU Session when the target PDU Session is working in HR-SBO mode?
question_23302.ground_truth: If the NEF has determined that the AF request targets a PDU Session that is already working in HR-SBO mode, the NEF stores the AF request in the UDR instead of contacting the PCF of the PDU Session.

question_23303.question: What is the format of the Alt-RAB-Parameter-MaxBitrateInf?
question_23303.ground_truth: It is a SEQUENCE (SIZE (1..maxNrOfAltValues)) OF Alt-RAB-Parameter-MaxBitrateList.

question_23304.question: What is the maximum sensitivity degradation (MSD) for Band 4 when Band 17 uplink is operated simultaneously with Band 4 downlink?
question_23304.ground_truth: The MSD is specified as 10.2 dB for the 5 MHz channel bandwidth case, and 7.6 dB for the 10 MHz channel bandwidth case, as per TS 36.101.

question_23305.question: What is the concept of the bulk operation of LCS service request for multiple UEs?
question_23305.ground_truth: The bulk operation of LCS service request for multiple UEs involves initiating the LCS service for multiple UEs in a single message, rather than sending separate messages for each UE. This improves efficiency and saves resources.

question_23306.question: What state is the remote party "B" in, after holding the conversation and waiting for confirmation?
question_23306.ground_truth: In the process of holding the multi-party conversation and waiting for confirmation.

question_23307.question: What should be the value of the "session-type" element in the `xtless}mcvideo-Params` element for a prearranged session?

question_23308.question: In what circumstances does the SGSN include the Enhanced Coverage Restriction (RestrictEC) information in the PAGING-PS PDU?
question_23308.ground_truth: The SGSN includes the Enhanced Coverage Restriction information in the PAGING-PS PDU when the network supports restricted use of enhanced coverage and the MS is camping on a cell supporting EC-GSM-IoT.

question_23309.question: What are the necessary requirements for 5G communication to be used in Uu-based communication for significantly lower latency and high bitrate?
question_23309.ground_truth: The necessary requirements for 5G communication to be used in Uu-based communication for significantly lower latency (less than 10ms) and high bitrate (0.1 - 1 Gbps) are 5G Infrastructure and QoS (Quality of Service).

question_23310.question: What is the TP-DCS "Message class" value in SEND SHORT MESSAGE command of USS?

question_23311.question: What is the decoded decimal representation of an IMSI-S part of an octet string in DS-41 in 3GPP TS 25.321?
question_23311.ground_truth: The decoded decimal representation of an IMSI-S part of an octet string in DS-41 is used in the formulae above for calculating the index of selected SCCPCH in 3GPP TS 25.321.

question_23313.question: What should a UE supporting dynamic mobility management selection do when multiple connections are established?
question_23313.ground_truth: A UE supporting dynamic mobility management selection should use the same mobility protocol when multiple connections are established.

question_23314.question: What are the procedures for a mechanism to request a particular MCVideo client in proximity, for its capabilities?
question_23314.ground_truth: MCVideo client 1 sends a Capability request message towards MCVideo client 2, upon receiving the Capability request message, MCVideo client 2 responds with a Capability announcement message, which contains its capability information with other relevant information, MCVideo client 1 then caches MCVideo client 2's presence and capability information along with other relevant information.

question_23315.question: What event can cause a transition to the Releasing state in any state?

question_23316.question: When is an IE/IE group considered not comprehended (not implemented) by a receiving entity?
question_23316.ground_truth: An IE or IE group is considered not comprehended (not implemented) by a receiving entity when a new or modified IE or IE group is implemented for one EP from a standard version, and other new or modified IEs or IE groups specified for that EP in that standard version are not supported. An EP that is not supported may also be considered not comprehended, even if another EP from the same standard version is comprehended.

question_23317.question: What should the MCPTT client do if it accepts a pre-established session within a call session?
question_23317.ground_truth: The MCPTT client shall create an instance of the 'Floor participant state transition diagram for basic operation' and enter the 'U: Pre-established session in use' state.

question_23318.question: What does AM DRB stand for in the context of 3GPP NR?
question_23318.ground_truth: AM DRB stands for a data radio bearer which utilizes RLC AM.

question_23319.question: What is a "native code" as defined in the present document?
question_23319.ground_truth: "Native code" is a processor-dependent representation of a basic computer operation such as "increment by one" that is executed by the hardware circuitry of a computer's central processing unit.

question_23320.question: What is a condition for the channel-based alignment method used in time synchronization of protection relays?
question_23320.ground_truth: The condition is that the communication channel should have near equal latency in transmission and reception directions between two protection relays.

question_23322.question: What is the role of the CMR in this process?
question_23322.ground_truth: The CMR is used to indicate the MS's recommended codec mode for the downlink after the carrier to interference has been altered.

question_23323.question: What determines the order in which a QoS rule or a PDR is evaluated?
question_23323.ground_truth: The order is determined by the precedence value, with evaluation taking place in increasing order of their precedence value.

question_23325.question: What action is taken by the PSAP upon receiving a false eCall?
question_23325.ground_truth: The PSAP handles the false eCall by disconnecting the call after communicating with the driver and determining that there is no actual emergency.

question_23326.question: When is a MS allowed to use GA service in a VPLMN?
question_23326.ground_truth: A MS is allowed to use GA service in a VPLMN only if the HPLMN supports and authorizes GA.

question_23327.question: What is the minimum number of cellular UEs inside a vehicle in Option A of the highway scenario?
question_23327.ground_truth: The number of cellular UEs inside a vehicle in Option A of the highway scenario is uniformly random in the range between 1 and 4.

question_23328.question: What action should the mobile station take when V(S) = V(A) and there is no RLC data block with BSN = V(S) available in the context of stopping the transmission of RLC data blocks?
question_23328.ground_truth: The mobile station should stop sending RLC data blocks and continue sending them when a RLC data block with BSN = V(S) is available.

question_23329.question: What is the duration of Tpre-empt in the testing process?

question_23331.question: What is the function of the power control mechanisms in the transmission process?
question_23331.ground_truth: The power control mechanisms adjust the output level of the mobile station to ensure the required quality with the least possible radiated power.

question_23333.question: What should the Node B do if the Single Stream MIMO Activation Indicator IE is included in the HS-DSCH FDD Secondary Serving Information IE?
question_23333.ground_truth: The Node B should activate the Single Stream MIMO mode for the secondary serving HS-DSCH Radio Link.

question_23334.question: What happens to all secondary RLC entities associated with a DRB when duplication is deactivated for that DRB?
question_23334.ground_truth: They are all deactivated and their HARQ buffers are not flushed.

question_23335.question: What action should a BSS take if the position supervision timer times out in BSS before the RRLP response from the target MS is received?
question_23335.ground_truth: The BSS shall send a BSSLAP Abort to the SMLC. The location service attempt may then be restarted from the LCS Client, VMSC, or SGSN.

question_23336.question: What is the purpose of the UE Policy Association establishment procedure?
question_23336.ground_truth: The UE Policy Association establishment procedure is triggered by the PCF for the PDU Session to support the delivery of URSP rule in EPS for a UE.

question_23338.question: What does the CAMEL Capability Handling indicate in the context of MT-SMS-CSI?
question_23338.ground_truth: The CAMEL Capability Handling for MT-SMS-CSI indicates the CAMEL Phase that is required for the MT SMS service. For MT-SMS-CSI, the CAMEL Capability Handling shall have the value CAMEL phase 4.

question_23342.question: What signalling path is re-established between the UE-A and the other end C as a result of the Re-INVITE processing at the other end C in the example flow for Domain Transfer to CS?
question_23342.ground_truth: A CS bearer path is re-established between the UE-A and the other end C as a result of the Re-INVITE processing at the other end C in the example flow for Domain Transfer to CS.

question_23343.question: What feature in 3GPP TS 24.501 allows optimization of transmitting UE radio capability over the radio interface?

question_23344.question: How are the timestamps carried in the piggybacking approach using RTP header extensions?
question_23344.ground_truth: The timestamps are carried in the RTP packet payload, rather than the RTP header, in order to accurately capture processing delay and other delays experienced by the media.

question_23345.question: Which organization produced the present document?
question_23345.ground_truth: The present document was produced by the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP).

question_23346.question: What are Shared iFC Set Identifiers and where are they stored?
question_23346.ground_truth: Shared iFC Set Identifiers identify sets of Initial Filter Criteria and are permanent data stored in the HSS and the S-CSCF.

question_23347.question: What should the MSGin5G Server include in the aggregated message when sending it to the recipient?
question_23347.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server should include a "Number of individual messages" element in the aggregated message to indicate the total number of messages aggregated into it.

question_23350.question: What does Candidate Solution #7 add in terms of requirements for the user equipment (UE) and Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF)?
question_23350.ground_truth: Candidate Solution #7 adds the requirement for the UE and AMF to use a sequenced List of Registration Areas instead of just a single Registration Area.

question_23351.question: Under what conditions should a 5GMM message piggybacking a 5GSM message for a PDU session be delivered via the access associated with the PDU session?
question_23351.ground_truth: A 5GMM message piggybacking a 5GSM message for a PDU session should be delivered via the access associated with the PDU session if it is being sent from the AMF to the UE for a network-requested 5GSM procedure, or if the UE is sending a response message to the 5GSM message via 3GPP access or non-3GPP access when in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode over non-3GPP access.

question_23353.question: What is verified during the NR FR2 PDSCH SDR tests?
question_23353.ground_truth: During the NR FR2 PDSCH SDR tests, only the PDSCH performance on the NR cell(s) on FR2 carriers is verified.

question_23354.question: What is the requirement for the volume control at the digital electrical interface UE regarding signal processing?
question_23354.ground_truth: The volume control at the digital electrical interface UE should not have a direct effect on the signal in the receive direction.

question_23356.question: What is the recipient's option when a video private communication is initiated?
question_23356.ground_truth: The recipient of a video private communication has the option of accepting or rejecting the communication.

question_23357.question: What should the UE do upon initiation of the access barring check procedure if timer T302 is running and the Access Category is neither '2' nor '0'?
question_23357.ground_truth: The UE should consider the access attempt as barred.

question_23359.question: What happens to the media flow(s) of an ongoing Collaborative Session after they are deleted?
question_23359.ground_truth: After deleting media flow(s) from an ongoing Collaborative Session, the Collaborative Session is no longer in effect if the deleted media flow was the only one remaining in the session.

question_23361.question: Which element within the 'response-announce' contains the validity timer T4000?

question_23362.question: What should the network do upon receiving a CM SERVICE REQUEST message?
question_23362.ground_truth: The network should analyze the content of the message and start any of the MM common procedures and RR procedures, depending on the type of request and the current status of the RR connection.

question_23363.question: What is one potential requirement for the 5G system to support a change of host of a non-public network without changing the network selection information stored in the UEs?
question_23363.ground_truth: PR 5.11.2-1, The 5G system shall support a change of host of a non-public network from one PLMN to another PLMN without changing the network selection information stored in the UEs of the non-public network.

question_23365.question: What is the required Content-Type for the message body of a NPVR request from the UE?
question_23365.ground_truth: The Content-Type of the message body for a NPVR request from the UE should be set to "application/3gpp-ims-pss-mbms-npvr+xml".

question_23367.question: How does the PSA UPF record the time stamps for QoS monitoring in DL GTP packet delay?
question_23367.ground_truth: The PSA UPF records T1 in the GTP-U header of the monitoring response packet and T2 in the GTP-U header of the monitoring response packet, which indicate the local time that the DL GTP PDU was sent by the PSA UPF and received by the NG-RAN, respectively.

question_23368.question: What is the purpose of including the "MS identity" information element in a combined GPRS attach procedure?
question_23368.ground_truth: The purpose of including the "MS identity" information element in a combined GPRS attach procedure is to assign or unassign a TMSI to an MS.

question_23369.question: What procedure is the PDU Session Modification Procedure via Wireline Access Network based on?
question_23369.ground_truth: The UE or Network Requested PDU Session Modification procedure in solution 3 clause~6.3.4.

question_23370.question: What can the PCRF do if the PCRF uses the Called-Station-Id AVP to assist the association?
question_23370.ground_truth: The PCRF shall apply the procedures in Annex I to match APN information.

question_23372.question: What is the difference in throughput between deployments with and without DPS in bi-directional cases?
question_23372.ground_truth: The throughputs in DPS deployment are higher than without DPS in all bi-directional cases.

question_23373.question: What does the L2R function do in the PLMN connection?
question_23373.ground_truth: The L2R function performs protocol conversion between the user data structure and a structure more adapted to the radio link protocol. It also includes the data compression function.

question_23374.question: How are satellite cells mapped for 5G satellite access with large or moving radio coverage?
question_23374.ground_truth: The satellite coverage is mapped with satellite cells as close as technologically feasible to the national borders of countries. There are two approaches for mapping the satellite radio coverage: virtual cells with regular mapping, possibly with adjustments close to national borders; or geographical zones with irregular mapping, allowing for variable sizes of satellite cells.

question_23375.question: In which scenarios does Solution #1 not address all operator-centric scenarios with non-coordinated NRIs?
question_23375.ground_truth: Solution #1 does not address operator-centric scenarios where users are not CS/PS coordinated in the source network or when the UE is registered in one domain only.

question_23377.question: How is the IP-PBX registered in the IMS network in registration mode?
question_23377.ground_truth: In registration mode, the IP-PBX registers to and receives service from the IMS network as specified in ETSI.

question_23378.question: What should the 5G-RG or the W-AGF acting on behalf of the FN-RG do if there is no non-default matching URSP rule which has not yet been evaluated and all non-default matching URSP rules have been evaluated?
question_23378.ground_truth: The 5G-RG or the W-AGF acting on behalf of the FN-RG should inform the upper layers of the failure if there is no non-default matching URSP rule which has not yet been evaluated and all non-default matching URSP rules have been evaluated.

question_23379.question: What should the MS (Mobile Station) do if it fails to establish a layer 2 link on the new channel after receiving a HANDOVER COMMAND on a full or half rate TCH?
question_23379.ground_truth: The MS should transmit the HANDOVER FAILURE message on the old TCH before T+1,1 seconds.

question_23380.question: In what situations is the User-user information element included in a Connect scenario's progress indicator?
question_23380.ground_truth: The User-user information element may be included in a Connect scenario's progress indicator in order to pass information about the call in progress or to make the MS attach the user connection for speech.

question_23381.question: What is the requirement and applicability for the MIMO only with single-stream restriction test in section 9.4.4?
question_23381.ground_truth: The requirement is for the detection performance of the HS-SCCH for MIMO only with single-stream restriction, as determined by the probability of event Em. This test applies for Release 10 and later for all types of UTRA for the FDD UE that support the optional MIMO with the single-stream restriction.

question_23382.question: What does the ME generate a new KAUSF from if the UE operates in SNPN access operation mode and the credentials in the USIM contain an indication to use MSK for derivation of KAUSF after success of primary authentication and key agreement procedure?
question_23382.ground_truth: The ME generates a new KAUSF from the MSK.

question_23385.question: What is the principle that takes priority over load balancing procedures in UMTS?

question_23386.question: When shall the MCVideo emergency alert state be set to "MVEA 1: no-alert" in response to a SIP re-INVITE request?
question_23386.ground_truth: The MCVideo emergency alert state shall be set to "MVEA 1: no-alert" in response to a SIP re-INVITE request containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with an <originated-by> element having the value of the MCVideo ID of the receiving MCVideo user.

question_23387.question: What protocol is used for out-band flow control in the case of V.110 rate adaption?
question_23387.ground_truth: V.110 TA to TA "end-to-end flow control"

question_23388.question: What should the MS do if none of the preferred PLMNs are available while in the VPLMN?
question_23388.ground_truth: The MS should remain on the VPLMN if no higher priority PLMN is found.

question_23389.question: What is the impact of CSFB on UE behavior and how it affects offloading IP traffic to WLAN?
question_23389.ground_truth: CSFB may trigger a UE to fall back to GERAN or UTRAN for a CS service, while the UE has ANDSF policies that trigger the UE to offload some IP traffic to WLAN. If the CS service is short, the UE may still be in GERAN or UTRAN for a brief period of time before returning to the E-UTRAN, causing the offloaded IP traffic to move back to E-UTRAN, which might increase overall signaling.

question_23390.question: What is the structure of the Successful-RL-InformationRespItem-RL-SetupFailureFDD sequence?
question_23390.ground_truth: The Successful-RL-InformationRespItem-RL-SetupFailureFDD sequence consists of several fields, including rL-ID, rL-Set-ID, received-total-wide-band-power, diversityIndication, not-Used-dSCH-InformationResponseList, and not-Used-tFCI2-BearerInformationResponse.

question_23391.question: What state of the MCVideo group is managed by the controlling MCVideo function and provides elevated priority to all participants in group calls using this group?
question_23391.ground_truth: The In-progress imminent peril group (IPIG) state

question_23392.question: How is the Priority Level used in case of congestion?
question_23392.ground_truth: In the case of congestion, when all QoS requirements cannot be fulfilled for one or more QoS Flows, the Priority Level is used to select for which QoS Flows the QoS requirements are prioritized, with a lower Priority Level value taking precedence over higher values.

question_23398.question: What field in the Child IAB-DU Restricted Beam Indication MAC CE determines the type of information used as an indication of a set of child IAB-DU's restricted beams?

question_23399.question: In what scenarios can HPLMN analytics be leveraged by the AMF in the VPLMN?
question_23399.ground_truth: In home routed roaming scenarios, HPLMN analytics such as slice load level analytics and NF load analytics can be leveraged by the AMF in the VPLMN for Network Slice selection and SMF selection for PDU Session management.

question_23401.question: When does the NAS initiate the procedure to send the initial NAS message for the access attempt?
question_23401.ground_truth: The NAS initiates the procedure to send the initial NAS message for the access attempt if the lower layers indicate that the access attempt is allowed.

question_23402.question: What changes need to be made to the mobile station for the fast Ack/Nack reporting mechanism?
question_23402.ground_truth: The mobile station needs to be updated to schedule and send event-based ACK/NACK reports. It also needs to insert a short bitmap or Ack/Nack report in an UL RLC data block when polled accordingly and receive a short Ack/Nack report in a DL RLC data block.

question_23403.question: Which interface is used for the measurement that provides the number of UL PDCP SDU bits entering the GNB-CU-UP from external gNB-CU-UP, and from external eNB?

question_23404.question: What must the UE do when it moves from EPS to 5GS, after it is registered over the 3GPP, if it requires a MA PDU Session or there is no local restriction mandating a single access for the PDU Session?
question_23404.ground_truth: The UE triggers the PDU Session Modification procedure to provide the ATSSS Capability to SMF+PGW-C.

question_23406.question: What does the solution 1.5 require in order to support the USSD operation for the UE to communicate with the VPLMN (Visited Public Land Mobile Network)?
question_23406.ground_truth: The solution requires UTRAN or GERAN to be available.

question_23407.question: What are the advantages of the Mobility Management and Session Management message simplification in the 3GPP network solution?
question_23407.ground_truth: Simplification enables efficient handling of infrequent small data transmissions for CIoT devices by reducing the overhead in MM and SM messages, including S1 and Gb cases. This improvement may guide further optimizations in the 3GPP network.

question_23408.question: What is required to enable ECN marking for L4S in NG-RAN?
question_23408.ground_truth: Dedicated QoS Flows are used for carrying L4S enabled IP traffic and an indication for ECN marking for L4S is provided for a corresponding QoS Flow in UL and/or DL directions.

question_23409.question: What should the initiating UE do if it receives a PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE REJECT message with the cause value of "#3"?
question_23409.ground_truth: The initiating UE should stop timer T5082 and abort the 5G ProSe direct link identifier update procedure.

question_23410.question: What is the assumed end to end delay for media transport between transmitting and receiving group members in this communication system?
question_23410.ground_truth: The assumed end to end delay for media transport between transmitting and receiving group members is in the order of 40ms in this communication system.

question_23412.question: What information does the new I-SMF use to establish the forwarding tunnel when initiating a N4 session modification in the case of I-SMF change?
question_23412.ground_truth: The new I-SMF uses the SM Context ID received from AMF for this service operation.

question_23413.question: What must an AS ensure when generating an emergency request on behalf of a UE in the same network as the S-CSCF?
question_23413.ground_truth: The AS must ensure that the UE is not roaming.

question_23414.question: What triggering event causes the SS to send a message to the MS with message type not defined for the protocol discriminator?
question_23414.ground_truth: When the MS is made to initiate a call and the CC entity of the MS is brought to the U12 state.

question_23415.question: What type of functions and interfaces should be reused in the IAB architectures?
question_23415.ground_truth: Existing functions and interfaces defined for access, including Mobile-Termination (MT), gNB-DU, gNB-CU, UPF, AMF, and SMF as well as the corresponding interfaces NR Uu, F1, NG, X2, and N4.

question_23416.question: What is the minimum duration for this test?
question_23416.ground_truth: The minimum duration for this test is approximately 1 hour.

question_23417.question: What problem does using a separate security key for connectionless data transmission solve?
question_23417.ground_truth: A separate security key for connectionless data transmission solves the problem of HFN de-synchronization issues and complex PDCP COUNT handling in the UE and also in the eNB. Additionally, it minimizes the risk of key compromise and resource exhaustion attack on eNBs by a malicious UE.

question_23418.question: What are the main tasks of the AF in the Deferred Application layer-based Network triggered ranging device discovery procedure?
question_23418.ground_truth: The AF responds to UE1 based on the privacy checking results, performs the Deferred 5GC-MT-LR Procedure with UE1 and UE2, determines whether UE1 and UE2 are proximate, and notifies the UE1 and UE2 of performing the ranging device discovery procedure.

question_23419.question: What action does the SMF take if the UPF receives an Extended Buffering indication from the SMF?
question_23419.ground_truth: The UPF initiates Extended Buffering of the downlink data and starts an Extended Buffering timer. If the Extended Buffering timer expires, the UPF discards the buffered downlink data.

question_23420.question: What is the role of the 5G ProSe Layer-3 Remote UE when it receives Additional QoS Information from the N3IWF in the dynamic QoS signalling based mechanism?
question_23420.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe Layer-3 Remote UE determines whether it is necessary to request for QoS session modification for the dedicated QoS Flows toward the 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay and provides the N3IWF address, DSCP, and the SPI as the traffic filter to enable filtering and mapping of DL traffic within the 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay UE's 5GC.

question_23422.question: What is an XML document in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
question_23422.ground_truth: In the context of 3GPP technical specifications, an XML document is composed of the succession of an optional XML declaration followed by a root XML element, containing other XML elements and possibly XML attributes specifications within the XML content of the XML element between its XML start-tag and XML end-tag.

question_23424.question: What are some of the User Dynamic Attributes in the priority model?
question_23424.ground_truth: User Dynamic Attributes include operational status, location, incident involvement, and assigned role in incident resolution.

question_23425.question: What actions should a mobile station take if timer T3380 expires for the first time?
question_23425.ground_truth: The MS should resend the Activate MBMS Context Reject message and reset and restart timer T3380. This retransmission is repeated four times before the MS releases all resources possibly allocated for this invocation and aborts the procedure.

question_23426.question: What is the maximum allowed interruption duration on any active serving cell, when activating or deactivating an SCell in the same FR1 band pair or in a FR1+FR2 band pair?
question_23426.ground_truth: The UE is allowed an interruption of up to X2 slot on any active serving cell, when activating or deactivating an SCell in the same FR1 band pair or in a FR1+FR2 band pair.

question_23427.question: What message type should be used to request the registration of call forwarding on a mobile station (MS)?
question_23427.ground_truth: The MS should send a REGISTER message containing the invoke of the RegisterSS operation for registration of call forwarding.

question_23428.question: What is the approach and validity for the measurements in subclauses 5.1.4.1, 5.1.4.2, and 5.1.4.3 in the context of EPS packet switching?
question_23428.ground_truth: The "2 out of 3 approach" is followed for these measurements and they are applicable to PGW-C for EPC CUPS situations. They are valid for packet switching in EPS.

question_23430.question: What should be the final state of the MS upon the User releasing a call, while in CC-state U12, "Disconnect Indication" and in network initiated call release phase?
question_23430.ground_truth: The final state of the MS should be U19, "Release Request".

question_23431.question: What are the types of 5G-AN signalling connection requests that the AMF can restrict during an overload situation using the NGAP OVERLOAD START message?
question_23431.ground_truth: The AMF can restrict 5G-AN signalling connection requests for certain UEs that are not for emergency, not for exception reporting, not for high priority mobile originated services, or not for specific NAS procedures(e.g. uplink NAS signalling transmission to a specific AMF). Additionally, the AMF can restrict requests based on the network slices supported by the 5G-AN node.

question_23432.question: Which procedures in the 3GPP technical specification are related to the location change reporting with PMIP for the S5 and S8 interfaces?
question_23432.ground_truth: The procedures described in clause 5.9.2 and clause 5.12 in the 3GPP technical specification, with the vPCRF forwarding messages between the Serving GW and the hPCRF in the roaming case.

question_23434.question: What should be included in the Contact header field of the SIP 200 (OK) response when a SIP re-INVITE request is received within a pre-established session?
question_23434.ground_truth: The g.3gpp.mcptt media feature tag and the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag containing the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt".

question_23435.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function do if the received SIP re-INVITE request contains an imminent peril indication set to "true" for an MCVideo imminent peril group call and this is an unauthorised request?
question_23435.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function shall reject the SIP re-INVITE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response with the imminent peril indication set to "false" in the response.

question_23436.question: What message does the source eNodeB send to the source MME in the E-UTRAN to GERAN A/Gb mode Inter RAT handover preparation phase?
question_23436.ground_truth: The source eNodeB sends a Handover Required message to the source MME.

question_23438.question: What modifications were made to the training sequence length for the new N-GSM data?
question_23438.ground_truth: The training sequence length for normal bursts in N-GSM data is now 30 bits, which is an extension from the 26 bits in GPRS/EGPRS normal bursts. This modification is not expected to impact the hardware of the GSM/EDGE base station and can be introduced with software changes.

question_23440.question: Which UE categories should follow the requirements for 7DL CA under TDD-FDD CA with TDD PCell?
question_23440.ground_truth: UE Category 8 and Category 11 should follow the requirements for 7DL CA under TDD-FDD CA with TDD PCell.

question_23442.question: What message is sent by the mobile station when a session management message with an unrecognized transaction identifier is received, as per 45.5.1.1.1?
question_23442.ground_truth: The mobile station sends an SM-STATUS message with cause #81 "invalid transaction identifier value" using the received transaction identifier value and remains in the PDP-INACTIVE state.

question_23444.question: What is the action taken by the S-CSCF when the session timer expires and the S-CSCF has requested the session to be refreshed periodically, and the S-CSCF gets the indication that the session will be refreshed?
question_23444.ground_truth: The S-CSCF deletes all the stored information related to the dialog.

question_23446.question: What is the condition for the UE to switch to a higher priority PLMN in the test described in 6.3.1.10.3.1?
question_23446.ground_truth: The UE switches to a higher priority PLMN if there is a higher priority PLMN available and the UE is in automatic network selection mode.

question_23448.question: In what situations must the UE initiate the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay discovery security material request procedure?
question_23448.ground_truth: The UE must initiate the procedure if it is authorized to act as a 5G ProSe end UE and has no 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay discovery security material for 5G ProSe end UE and is in NG-RAN coverage, after expiration of timer T50cc, or when entering NG-RAN coverage. Alternatively, the UE must initiate the procedure if it is authorized to act as a 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE and has no 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay discovery security material for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE and is in NG-RAN coverage, or after expiration of timer T50yy when in NG-RAN coverage or when entering NG-RAN coverage.

question_23449.question: What is the function of the DNS Inspector in the case where it receives a DNS Response including the resolved IP address from the L-DNS?
question_23449.ground_truth: The DNS Inspector replaces the source and destination IP addresses of the DNS response with the stored C-DNS IP address and UE-IP respectively and forwards the response to the UL CL/BP UPF.

question_23450.question: What is the least common multiple calculated between in TS 37.355, when positioning frequency layer i is in Case 1?
question_23450.ground_truth: It is the same as TPRS,i in TS 37.355, which represents the least common multiple among the PRS resource periodicities among all DL PRS resources in positioning frequency layer i.

question_23451.question: What is the data type provided in the request body when sending the BDT warning notification?
question_23451.ground_truth: The "Notification" data type is provided in the request body when sending the BDT warning notification.

question_23453.question: What is the impact of packet size on the evaluation results in SBFD deployment case 1 (FR2-1)?
question_23453.ground_truth: The impact of packet size on the evaluation results in SBFD deployment case

question_23454.question: What are the key architectural features specific to the CORBA Solution Set in 3GPP TS 32.623?
question_23454.ground_truth: The key architectural features specific to the CORBA Solution Set in 3GPP TS 32.623 include the use of Notifications, specific syntax for Distinguished Names, and mappings of generic NRM Information Object Classes to MOCs. These features are defined to ensure interoperability between different 3GPP network elements using the CORBA Solution Set.

question_23455.question: Over what frames are the SI messages transmitted for NB-IoT's SystemInformationBlockType1?
question_23455.ground_truth: The SI messages are transmitted within periodically occurring time domain windows (SI-windows), using dynamic scheduling with the corresponding SI message transmitted a number of times in any subframe other than MBSFN subframes, uplink subframes in TDD, and subframe #5 of radio frames for which SFN mod 2 = 0 for NB-IoT's SystemInformationBlockType1.

question_23457.question: What must the UE do upon reception of the SIP 200 OK from the HTTP/SIP adapter?
question_23457.ground_truth: Once the UE receives the SIP 200 OK from the HTTP/SIP adapter, it sends an HTTP GET request to the URL obtained from the download session description. The HTTP "Connection" header should be set to "Keep-Alive" to indicate a persistent TCP connection.

question_23458.question: What is the impact of Alternative 2 on the SMF when a UE establishes a latency sensitive PDU session?
question_23458.ground_truth: The SMF needs to determine whether a PDU session is latency sensitive, and send the AMF of the UPF Service Area information to trigger the AMF to recalculate the RA.

question_23459.question: What is the role of MEC entities in the ETSI MEC architecture?
question_23459.ground_truth: The MEC entities in the ETSI MEC architecture include MEC Platform, MEC Application, MEC Platform Manager, MEC Orchestrator, MEC Federator, OSS, and CFS. These entities provide various network services and functionalities for edge computing.

question_23460.question: What happens to a mobile station that has enabled PEO with PSM when its active timer expires in packet idle mode?
question_23460.ground_truth: The mobile station enters the PSM based power saving state and will not be reachable until the next time it performs an uplink data transfer.

question_23461.question: What is the PRB scheduling restriction for the PRBs within a selected Narrow Band in MPDCCH DL DCI formats?
question_23461.ground_truth: The PRB scheduling is for the PRBs within a selected Narrow Band consisting of 6 resources. The selection is restricted to these 6 PRBs in the selected narrow band.

question_23462.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the measurement reporting delay in RRC_CONNECTED state?
question_23462.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement for the measurement reporting delay in RRC_CONNECTED state is less than Tidentify intra.

question_23463.question: What methods are used to retransmit unacknowledged RLC data blocks in the test procedure?
question_23463.ground_truth: The SS retransmits, after a delay that corresponds to a round trip time of 120ms, all unacknowledged RLC data blocks with PS2 starting from the oldest unacknowledged RLC blocks.

question_23464.question: In the context of 3GPP management system, what potential requirement is related to mutual authentication between a MnS producer and an external MnS consumer?

question_23465.question: What determines if a newly received instance of overload information can overwrite an existing instance in a peer node?
question_23465.ground_truth: The receiver uses the "Overload-Sequence-Number" to compare and decide if an existing instance can be overwritten.

question_23466.question: What type of information is provided by the CTSBCH logical channel in the GSM-CTS system?
question_23466.ground_truth: The CTSBCH logical channel provides frequency and synchronization information in the downlink direction in the GSM-CTS system.

question_23471.question: What service does the SMSF send a PATCH request to for updating the state of UE memory capacity for SMS in 3GPP access?
question_23471.ground_truth: The SMSF sends a PATCH request to the resource representing the UE's SMSF registration for 3GPP access.

question_23473.question: What does the "MSKID" represent in the "keyId" element?
question_23473.ground_truth: The "MSKID" in the "keyId" element identifies the key uniquely by specifying both the "keyDomainID" and "MSKID" as defined in sub-clause 6.3.2.1 of 3GPP TS 33.246.

question_23475.question: What is the objective of the Work Item related to the L-band?
question_23475.ground_truth: The objective of the Work Item is to specify the RF characteristics and channel bandwidths of the L-band for UTRA, E-UTRA, and MSR.

question_23476.question: What values can the <start-stop-indication> take?
question_23476.ground_truth: The <start-stop-indication> can take two integer values, indicating the start and stop of sending data respectively.

question_23479.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group in producing the "Study on security issues to support Group Communication System Enablers (GCSE) for LTE (Release 12)" document?
question_23479.ground_truth: The purpose is to study the security aspects of GCSE for LTE and provide an evaluation of possible technical security solutions. The document aims to define functional security requirements for all entities from a system perspective, with Stage 1 requirements defined in 3GPP TS 22.468.

question_23480.question: What is the focus of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project Technical Specification document TS 28.680?
question_23480.ground_truth: The focus of TS 28.680 is the concepts and requirements of Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN) management, specifically for WLAN performance monitoring and alarm notifications.

question_23481.question: What should the floor participant do upon receiving an indication from the MCPTT client to request the queue position information?
question_23481.ground_truth: The floor participant should send the Floor Queue Position Request message and include the SSRC of the sent Floor Request message in the SSRC of floor participant field, as well as the own MCPTT User ID in the User ID field. The floor participant should also initialize the counter C204 (Floor Queue Position request) with a value of 1 and start timer T204 (Floor Queue Position request).

question_23482.question: Which network element in the 3GPP technical specification manages concurrent IP multimedia sessions?

question_23483.question: What encryption scheme should a 5GMSd Client support for encrypted audio content when any of the speech and audio playback requirements are supported?
question_23483.ground_truth: The 5GMSd Client should support encrypted audio content using the 'cenc' AES-CTR subsample pattern encryption scheme or the 'cbc1' AES-CBC subsample pattern encryption scheme as specified in clause 8 of CTA-WAVE 5003, clause 8.12.

question_23487.question: What must the MSC/SGSN do if the UE cancels the periodic location procedure after a location estimate has been transferred to the LCS client?
question_23487.ground_truth: The MSC/SGSN shall notify the V-GMLC, H-GMLC, R-GMLC and LCS Client using the procedure in clause~9.1.12.4.

question_23488.question: In PLMN selection in shared network environment, what should an MS do when it has multiple PLMN identities on a shared cell, and one of them is the HPLMN (Home PLMN) but not the registered PLMN?
question_23488.ground_truth: The MS should attach to the HPLMN on the shared cell.

question_23490.question: What is the procedure for the TDD relative RSRQ accuracy in carrier aggregation for 20MHz test?
question_23490.ground_truth: The test consists of verifying that TDD relative RSRQ measurement accuracy in carrier aggregation for 20MHz is within the specified limits under AWGN propagation conditions, and verifying the TDD relative RSRQ accuracy requirements between the primary and secondary component carriers.

question_23491.question: What is the Bearer type in the "OPEN CHANNEL" command?
question_23491.ground_truth: The Bearer type used in the example was GPRS.

question_23492.question: What is the role of the vPCRF in the roaming and Local Breakout cases?
question_23492.ground_truth: The vPCRF forwards messages between the non-3GPP access and the hPCRF in the roaming and Local Breakout cases. In the Local Breakout case, it forwards messages between the PDN GW and the hPCRF. In the non-roaming case, it is not involved at all.

question_23493.question: In the context of 3GPP technical specification, what does "S1" refer to?
question_23493.ground_truth: S1 is a logical interface between an eNB within the E-UTRAN and an MME in the EPC.

question_23494.question: What is required for DMRS bundling across PUCCH repetitions to function properly?
question_23494.ground_truth: The restrictions for DMRS bundling across PUCCH repetitions include phase coherency across PUCCH repetitions, the same frequency resource allocation across PUCCH repetitions, and the same power across PUCCH repetitions.

question_23495.question: What is the requirement for UE when SSB symbols to be measured are completely contained in the active bandwidth part of the UE and inter-frequency measurements without measurement gaps are performed?
question_23495.ground_truth: UE is required to be capable of measuring without measurement gaps when the SSB is completely contained in the active bandwidth part of the UE and any of the conditions in clauses 9.3.9.3.1 to 9.3.9.3.3 are met. Otherwise, there is no scheduling restriction.

question_23496.question: What is the general principle that the E1 interface should be feasible even if there is no physical direct connection between the endpoints?
question_23496.ground_truth: The E1 interface is a point-to-point logical interface that should be feasible even in the absence of a physical direct connection between the endpoints.

question_23497.question: What is the prerequisite for the UIU compatibility category 7 and UL CLTD requirement?
question_23497.ground_truth: The requirements for UE relative CDP accuracy for HS-DPCCH and E-DCH with 16QAM for UL CLTD activation state 1 apply for Release 11 and later releases for all types of UTRA for the FDD UE that support E-DCH 16QAM UE capability category 7 and UL CLTD.

question_23498.question: What is the role of an X2-proxy in the discussed scalability solution for eNBs supporting X2 mobility towards/from HeNBs?
question_23498.ground_truth: An X2-proxy, if deployed, resides in the HeNB-GW and provides X2 proxy functionality between HeNBs connected to the HeNB-GW and the eNBs.

question_23501.question: What are the two different stages of SCI in 5G NR sidelink communication?
question_23501.ground_truth: The two different stages of SCI in 5G NR sidelink communication are 1st-stage SCI and 2nd-stage SCI.

question_23502.question: What must happen to the stored Local emergency numbers list in the user equipment when the UE moves to a new PLMN in a different country from where the currently stored Local emergency numbers list was received?
question_23502.ground_truth: The UE shall delete the stored Local emergency numbers list in the user equipment.

question_23504.question: What is the role of the UPF in handling Ethernet PDU Session type in 5G?
question_23504.ground_truth: When an UPF is acting as PSA for an Ethernet PDU Session Type, the SMF may instruct the UPF to route the traffic based on detected MAC addresses. The UPF learns the MAC address(es) connected via N6 based on the source MAC addresses of the DL traffic received on a N6 Network Instance. It also learns the MAC address(es) of UEs and devices connected behind, if any, based on the source MAC address contained within the UL traffic received on a PDU Session (N3/N9 interface).

question_23505.question: What should the SCP do if it receives a request from an NF service consumer and the NF service producer had included an access token in the service request that the SCP had cached or obtained from the NRF?
question_23505.ground_truth: The SCP shall not repeat the request with the access token that was used; instead, it may repeat the request with a new access token.

question_23506.question: In the context of RTP streams, what does the term "modal verb" refer to?
question_23506.ground_truth: In the context of RTP streams, "modal verbs" indicate mandatory requirements, recommendations, or permissions related to the RTP protocol.

question_23507.question: What message does the 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay send upon reception of the Disconnect Request message in the Layer-2 link release procedure?
question_23507.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay sends a Disconnect Response message in response to the Disconnect Request message.

question_23508.question: What are some of the terms and abbreviations used in the NR positioning report?
question_23508.ground_truth: Some of the terms and abbreviations used in the report include CID, CDP, ECID, GNSS, LCS, LPP, DL-TDOA, TBS, TTFF, and WLAN.

question_23509.question: When would a UE trigger the establishment of a new PC5 unicast link?
question_23509.ground_truth: A UE triggers the establishment of a new PC5 unicast link when it cannot reuse an existing one, such as when the pair of peer Application Layer IDs and the network layer protocol are not identical to those required by the application layer for the desired V2X service.

question_23510.question: Which requirement is applicable for the protection of NR repeater receivers when co-located with other systems, as specified in section 6.7?
question_23510.ground_truth: The additionally specified input intermodulation requirement is applicable for the protection of NR repeater receivers when GSM, CDMA, UTRA, E-UTRA, NR BS or repeater, operating in a different frequency band, are co-located with a NR repeater.

question_23512.question: What is the role of a DRM Agent in the OMA DRM architecture?
question_23512.ground_truth: A DRM Agent is a functional entity in the OMA DRM architecture that is responsible for enforcing permissions and constraints associated with DRM Content, controlling access to DRM Content, and so on.

question_23515.question: What is the impact of the negotiated maximum priority level on floor request pre-emption in the MCPTT call?
question_23515.ground_truth: The negotiated maximum priority level determines the priority level that is used for floor request pre-emption in the MCPTT call.

question_23516.question: What is protected in Solution #3 (Network Authorization in RLOS) against the lack of network authentication for RLOS connection?
question_23516.ground_truth: Solution #3 protects against the lack of network authentication for RLOS connection by implementing UE based mechanisms such as enforcing access control on applications that are authorized to trigger establishment of RLOS connection, requesting user confirmation before triggering RLOS connection, maintaining a white list of MCCs where RLOS is supported and verifying that the MCC of the network that advertises RLOS is present in the white list.

question_23517.question: Which IE is required to be included in the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message, if the UE supports A/Gb mode or Iu mode or both, and the network supports mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode or Iu mode or both?

question_23518.question: What is the purpose of initiating a group standalone short data service (SDS) in the procedure described in section 7.4.3.4.2?
question_23518.ground_truth: The purpose is to send SDS data to a MCData group, with or without a disposition request.

question_23519.question: What is the purpose of the MC service emergency alert cancel procedure?
question_23519.ground_truth: The MC service emergency alert cancel procedure is used to clear the emergency state of the MC service client.

question_23520.question: What is the purpose of the SEPP and SCP in the 5G architecture?
question_23520.ground_truth: The SEPP (Service Communication Proxy) and SCP (Service Capability Server) are components in the 5G architecture that provide inter-operator communication and service capability exposure, respectively. Both the SEPP and SCP are not Network Function instances but are deployed distributed, redundant, stateless, and scalable.

question_23521.question: What is the maximum number of seconds of validity of the provided assistance information, provided in the Assistance-Info AVP?

question_23522.question: What are the three caching directives defined in the caching functionality?
question_23522.ground_truth: The three caching directives defined in the caching functionality are "no-cache", "max-stale", and "Expires".

question_23524.question: In the roaming case, what is the role of the 3GPP AAA Proxy in the handover of PDN connections to untrusted non-3GPP access?
question_23524.ground_truth: In the roaming case, the 3GPP AAA Proxy mediates all interaction between the 3GPP AAA Server in the PLMN and entities in the VPLMN and non-3GPP access.

question_23526.question: What is the action taken if the user equipment does not support the fixed network user rate?
question_23526.ground_truth: The network may release the call for a transparent connection element.

question_23528.question: What protocol is used to secure the SDP message in SDES when used with Secure Real-time Transport Protocol (SRTP) unicast media streams?
question_23528.ground_truth: The SDP crypto attribute requires the services of a data security protocol to secure the SDP message. In the context of RFC 4568 and IMS, the SIP signalling security mechanisms are used to secure the SDP message.

question_23529.question: What is the conclusion regarding the support of positioning for RedCap UEs as part of the Rel-18 study item on expanded NR positioning enhancements?
question_23529.ground_truth: The support of positioning for RedCap UEs is one of the conclusions of the Rel-18 study item on expanded NR positioning enhancements, along with the identified scenarios for prioritized use-cases and related target requirements, bandwidth requirements for sidelink positioning, sidelink positioning solutions, and potential specification impacts.

question_23531.question: What should the network do if an eCall only mobile station has not successfully completed a location update procedure?
question_23531.ground_truth: A callback will not be possible due to the calling line identity being unavailable at the PSAP. An eCall only device uses the CS domain to originate an emergency services call when in A/Gb or Iu mode, even if the device is capable of eCall over IMS.

question_23532.question: What must the UE do before sending an event triggered measurement report?
question_23532.ground_truth: The UE must first fulfill the reporting criteria specified for the event triggered measurement report.

question_23533.question: What are the required SDP "proto" field values for H.248 terminations in the "application-agnostic packet processing" scenario?
question_23533.ground_truth: The required SDP "proto" field values for the two H.248 terminations in the "application-agnostic packet processing" are: "UDP/DTLS" and "udp". The effort to request an IANA registry entry for "UDP/DTLS" is still in progress (IETF draft-schwarz-mmusic-sdp-for-gw).

question_23534.question: What is the function of the 5G ProSe layer-2 UE-to-network relay UE in supporting PDU sessions for a 5G ProSe layer-2 remote UE?
question_23534.ground_truth: A single PC5 unicast link is established between the 5G ProSe layer-2 UE-to-network relay UE and the 5G ProSe layer-2 remote UE for supporting PDU sessions of the 5G ProSe layer-2 remote UE.

question_23536.question: What should the SLM-S include in the CoAP 2.05 (Content) response message when generating a series of responses for a CoAP FETCH request?
question_23536.ground_truth: The Content-Format option set to "application/vnd.3gpp.seal-location-info+cbor" and one or more "LocationReport" objects corresponding to the triggers that have been met.

question_23537.question: What functionality does the GMF provide during the temporary group creation?
question_23537.ground_truth: During the temporary group creation, the GMF creates and stores the information of the temporary group, including the temporary group identity, off-network information, and the identities of the groups being combined, priority of the temporary group, security level of the temporary group and so on.

question_23538.question: What should the UE do when it receives the NSAG information in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
question_23538.ground_truth: The UE should store the NSAG information as specified in subclause 4.6.2.2 of the 5GMM specification.

question_23540.question: What is the purpose of the HSS in the WebRTC IMS architecture?
question_23540.ground_truth: The HSS stores up-to-date registration information about WICs, indicating if an S-CSCF is assigned. It maintains correct registration states, allowing interworking with existing application services such as NetLoc or T-ADS.

question_23541.question: For a MBMS-dedicated cell, what determines the value of CFI in non-MBSFN subframes for a UE?
question_23541.ground_truth: The higher layer parameter semiStaticCFI-MBMS included in MasterInformationBlock-MBMS determines the value of CFI in non-MBSFN subframes for a UE in a MBMS-dedicated cell.

question_23543.question: What is the maximum limit for the rated carrier output power for Wide Area Base Station in NR?
question_23543.ground_truth: Similar to E-UTRA, there is no upper limit for the rated carrier output power of the Wide Area Base Station in NR.

question_23544.question: What should a GPRS MS include in the ROUTING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message as the TMSI status IE, if no valid TMSI is available?
question_23544.ground_truth: The TMSI status IE shall be included in the ROUTING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message if no valid TMSI is available.

question_23546.question: What is the entering condition for event B1 to be satisfied, assuming a positive hysteresis value (Hys) and threshold (Thresh)?
question_23546.ground_truth: The entering condition for event B1 to be satisfied is for the inequality Mn + Ofn + Ocn - Hys > Thresh to hold true.

question_23548.question: What information is included in the NAS (Non-Access Stratum) message when the UE informs the MME (Mobility Management Entity) about the 3GPP PS Data Off (de)activation in solution 1.5?
question_23548.ground_truth: The information includes downlink filters associated with the non-SIP data exempt services, and the uplink filters for the non-SIP data exempt services to be enforced by the UE.

question_23549.question: What is the 5G QoS parameter that can be used to differentiate the treatment of traffic aggregates with similar requirements?

question_23550.question: What happens to application developers who use the small data path?
question_23550.ground_truth: They are not required to use special handling of small data, but can optionally do so.

question_23553.question: What subcarrier spacing (SCS) should be standardized for 5G NR operating in the frequency range 1 (FR1)?
question_23553.ground_truth: Some companies noted that standardization effort for 240 kHz numerology could be relatively smaller compared to 480 kHz or 960 kHz numerologies.

question_23554.question: What is the procedure if the BSS grants the uplink of the group call channel for sending application-specific data?
question_23554.ground_truth: The MS sends a SABM (DATA INDICATION) message with its mobile identity and the application data to the network. The serving BSS responds with a UA (DATA INDICATION) message and releases the group call channel uplink. The MS then returns to group receive mode.

question_23555.question: What is required for the establishment of an IP flow mobility (IFMP) session between the UE and the P-GW during PDN connection establishment?
question_23555.ground_truth: The IP address of the P-GW is provided to the UE during PDN connection establishment for the establishment of the IFMP session.

question_23556.question: In the context of the 26.8.1.2.1.1.1 test, when is the mobile originated circuit switched basic service established?
question_23556.ground_truth: The mobile originated circuit switched basic service is established when the MS sends a CM SERVICE REQUEST message with a CM service type of "Mobile originating call establishment or packet mode connection establishment" upon the initiation of an outgoing basic call by the user.

question_23558.question: What should the MTSI client do if the remote party sends with lower modes within the negotiated mode-set than requested by the CMR in AMR and AMR-WB?
question_23558.ground_truth: The MTSI client should accept that the remote party sends with lower modes within the negotiated mode-set than requested by the CMR.

question_23564.question: What is the purpose of the test in X.4.2y.2 of the standard format for tests?
question_23564.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in X.4.2y.2 is to define the steps necessary to perform the test and provide further details including domain, range, weighting, and algorithms. The procedure may also include data processing of the measurement result before comparison with the test requirement.

question_23566.question: What is the effect of activating the 3GPP PS Data Off feature on the UE?
question_23566.ground_truth: The UE prevents the sending of uplink IP packets, Unstructured and Ethernet data except for those related to 3GPP PS Data Off Exempt Services

question_23567.question: What is the role of the playout delay in the NADU APP packet?
question_23567.ground_truth: The playout delay indicates the difference in milliseconds between the scheduled playout time of the next ADU and the current time, allowing the server to have a more precise value of the amount of time before the client will underflow.

question_23568.question: How does the RLC/MAC header need to be modified for 4 RLC blocks in EGPRS uplink?
question_23568.ground_truth: The RLC/MAC header in EGPRS uplink for 4 RLC blocks requires two additional octets to indicate block sequence numbers and 5 bits to enhance the Coding and Puncturing Scheme (CPS) indicator field.

question_23569.question: What is the role of MTP3-B, SCCP and SAAL-NNI in 5.2.2 for CS domain?
question_23569.ground_truth: MTP3-B provides message routing, discrimination and distribution, signalling link management, load sharing and changeover/back between link. SCCP provides connectionless service, Class 0, Class 2, connection oriented service and separation of the connections mobile by mobile basis. SAAL-NNI consists of sub-layers SSCF, SSCOP and AAL5. SSCF maps the requirements of the layer above to the requirements of SSCOP and provide SAAL connection management, link status, and remote processor status mechanisms. SSCOP provides mechanisms for the establishment and release of connections and the reliable exchange of signalling information between signalling entities.

question_23570.question: What is provisioning and what role does it play in Lawful Interception (LI) in a 3GPP network?
question_23570.ground_truth: Provisioning is the action taken by the CSP to provide its Lawful Interception functions information that identifies the target and the specific communication services of interest to the LEA, sourced from the LEA provided warrant. With provisioning, the CSP can identify the target and the specific communication services of interest to the LEA.

question_23572.question: What is the role of the CDR in the process of call completion?
question_23572.ground_truth: After the logical call record is completed, its free format data is moved to the corresponding CDR and the logical call record is deleted.

question_23573.question: What information is required to be sent to the MS in order to obtain a position fix for MS based testing of A-GPS positioning?
question_23573.ground_truth: A RESET MS POSITIONING STORED INFORMATION message followed by RRLP Assistance Data and RRLP Measure Position Request messages containing appropriate assistance data as specified in the standard.

question_23574.question: What is the expected result of the ME in the TERMINAL RESPONSE command of the SEND USSD process?
question_23574.ground_truth: The ME is expected to perform the SEND USSD operation successfully and return a successful result in the TERMINAL RESPONSE command.

question_23576.question: How many SCells can a UE capable of direct activation or hibernation support simultaneously?
question_23576.ground_truth: A UE capable of direct activation or hibernation can support up to 2 SCells simultaneously.

question_23577.question: What is the significance of a third digit increase in versioning in the 3GPP TS?
question_23577.ground_truth: A third digit increase in versioning of 3GPP TS indicates that only editorial changes have been incorporated in the document, not any technical enhancements or corrections.

question_23578.question: What is the test scenario composed of?
question_23578.ground_truth: The test scenario is composed of one E-UTRA PCell (Cell 1), one NR PSCell (Cell 2), and one NR SCell (Cell 3).

question_23580.question: What is the maximum size of a "UE-MulticastMRBs-To-BeSetup-List" in the "F1AP-PROTOCOL-IES" used in the "UEContextSetupRequest" message?
question_23580.ground_truth: It can contain up to "maxnoofMRBsforUE" ProtocolIE-SingleContainer elements as defined in the "UE-MulticastMBSSessionSetupList F1AP-PROTOCOL-IES" section of the 3GPP spec.

question_23581.question: How long can satellite ephemeris and clock corrections data be used for?
question_23581.ground_truth: Satellite ephemeris and clock corrections data can be used for up to six hours.

question_23582.question: What is the purpose of identifying the capabilities of existing ML entities?
question_23582.ground_truth: The purpose of identifying the capabilities of existing ML entities is for the consumer to determine how to use them for their needs, such as fulfilling intent targets or other automation targets.

question_23583.question: What are the different GNSS systems that can be used separately or in combination for network-assisted GNSS methods?
question_23583.ground_truth: The different GNSS systems that can be used are GPS, Modernized GPS, Galileo, GLONASS, Satellite Based Augmentation Systems (SBAS), Quasi Zenith Satellite System (QZSS), and BeiDou Navigation Satellite System (BDS).

question_23584.question: What condition must be fulfilled if the UE requires measurement gaps for intra-frequency measurements?
question_23584.ground_truth: The condition for the RSSI measurement duration and the measurement gap is that the entire RSSI measurement duration should be contained in the measurement gap.

question_23586.question: What action does an SMC entity take when it receives a release request from SM-RL while in the Wait for CP-ACK state?
question_23586.ground_truth: The request is stored until the next state (either MM Connection Established or Idle) is entered. If the Idle state is entered, the request is discarded; otherwise, an MM-connection release request is sent to the MM-sublayer and the SMC entity enters the Idle state.

question_23587.question: What is the minimum time available for intra-frequency measurements during the measurement period with an arbitrarily chosen timing?
question_23587.ground_truth: TIntra is the minimum time available for intra-frequency measurements during the measurement period with an arbitrarily chosen timing.

question_23588.question: What is the granularity at which redundant transmission is performed using the two N3/N9 tunnels?
question_23588.ground_truth: Redundant transmission is performed at QoS Flow granularity and shares the same QoS Flow ID.

question_23589.question: What is a possible reason for terminating a call when the UICC with the active USIM is removed from a mobile terminal?
question_23589.ground_truth: The active UICC is required to access the PLMN, so removing it would cause the call to be terminated.

question_23590.question: What is the role of the re-assembly function in the described communication system?
question_23590.ground_truth: The re-assembly function is responsible for reassembling upper layer PDUs in the proper order at the receiving end.

question_23591.question: What is the maximum number of inter-frequency TDD cells that the UE is required to be capable of performing P-CCPCH RSCP measurements for, with a measurement period of Tmeasurment inter, if idle intervals are used for TDD inter frequency measurements?
question_23591.ground_truth: The UE is required to be capable of performing P-CCPCH RSCP measurements for a maximum of 6 inter-frequency TDD cells, every Tmeasurement inter milliseconds, if idle intervals are used for TDD inter frequency measurements.

question_23592.question: In what substate does the UE initiate an initial registration procedure if timer T3346 is not running, in the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state?

question_23594.question: What are the conformance requirements specified in TS 38.331 for the test cases 8.1.6.3.1.2 and 8.1.6.3.1.3?
question_23594.ground_truth: The conformance requirements for the test cases 8.1.6.3.1.2 and 8.1.6.3.1.3 are the same as those specified in test case 8.1.6.3.1.1.

question_23596.question: What entities are involved in supporting a single VAL user?
question_23596.ground_truth: A VAL user, VAL service provider, home PLMN operator, visited PLMN operator, and SEAL provider are all involved in supporting a single VAL user.

question_23597.question: What is the range and accuracy requirement for temperature control and measurement for the temperature controllable environment and temperature measuring device respectively?
question_23597.ground_truth: The temperature controllable environment shall be able to control the temperature of a chamber large enough to enclose the UICC and the card reader with the range of temperature control being between -25 oC and +85 oC to an accuracy of 0,5 oC. The temperature measuring device shall be able to measure the temperature of the UICC to within 0,5 oC with the range of measurement being between -25 oC and +85 oC.

question_23598.question: What is the main objective of Scenario 5 in ensuring seamless services?
question_23598.ground_truth: The main objective of Scenario 5 is to minimize data loss and break time during the switch between access technologies such as 3GPP and WLAN, providing seamless service continuity for the services supported in Scenario 3.

question_23599.question: What should the DPCCH quality be when the UE can detect the TPC commands on the downlink DPCCH with significant reliability?
question_23599.ground_truth: The threshold Qin should correspond to a level of DPCCH quality where detection of the TPC commands transmitted on the downlink DPCCH is significantly more reliable than at Qout, which can be at a TPC command error ratio level of e.g. 20%.

question_23600.question: What determines the treatment of a priority level within a network, such as the selection of a target set-up time and pre-emption?
question_23600.ground_truth: The network operator can administer parameters that control the treatment of each priority level within its domain.

question_23601.question: What transmission protocol is used for the IP layer in 3GPP TS 36.423?
question_23601.ground_truth: The IP layer of X2 in 3GPP TS 36.423 supports point-to-point transmission for delivering X2-AP messages, and the eNB and en-gNB shall support IPv6 (IETF RFC 2460) and/or IPv4 (IETF RFC 791).

question_23602.question: What should the mobile station do if the Facility IE is encoded as "recall alignment not essential" and the decoding of the Facility IE is unsuccessful in the CC_ESTABLISHMENT message?
question_23602.ground_truth: The mobile station shall discard the SS Version IE and Facility IE and NOT copy them into the SETUP message.

question_23603.question: What should the UE do if it receives an EAP-success message?
question_23603.ground_truth: The UE should delete the valid KAUSF and valid KSEAF (if any), generate a new KAUSF and KSEAF from the received EMSK and the key agreement and authentication data, create a new partial native 5G NAS security context, and store the new KAUSF, KSEAF, and related data in the ME.

question_23606.question: What is the size and format of the Sidelink CSI Reporting MAC CE?
question_23606.ground_truth: The Sidelink CSI Reporting MAC CE is 3 octets in size and consists of 3 fields: RI, CQI, and R (Reserved bit). The RI and CQI fields indicate the derived value of the Rank Indicator and Channel Quality Indicator, respectively, for sidelink CSI reporting.

question_23607.question: What is the definition of a "chargeable event" in the context of charging in telecommunication networks?
question_23607.ground_truth: A chargeable event is an activity that utilizes telecommunication network resources and related services, which the network operator may want to charge for. This includes user-to-user communication, user-to-network communication, inter-network communication, and mobility. It characterizes the resource/service usage and indicates the identity of the involved end user(s).

question_23608.question: What is the basic scheduling unit in NB-LTE uplink?
question_23608.ground_truth: The basic scheduling unit is M-subframe of 6 ms in NB-LTE uplink.

question_23616.question: What is the reference point for specifying the SNR in Mode 1 for a DNF setup in UE demodulation and CSI reporting testing?
question_23616.ground_truth: The reference point for specifying the SNR in Mode 1 for a DNF setup is the intersection of the axes of rotation of the positioning system(s).

question_23617.question: What should the SMF include in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message if it determines to provide the N3QAI to the UE and it has authorized QoS flow descriptions for the SMF?
question_23617.ground_truth: In this case, the SMF should include the N3QAI in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message.

question_23618.question: What must the MCPTT client do upon receiving a 2xx response to the sent SIP REFER request, when the call is released, but the Pre-established Session is kept alive?
question_23618.ground_truth: The MCPTT client must enter the 'U: Pre-established session not in use' state and terminate the instance of the 'Floor participant state transition diagram for basic operation' state machine.

question_23619.question: What is the default procedure for reporting measurement results in the BTS?
question_23619.ground_truth: The default procedure is the basic measurement reporting procedure defined in sub-clause 4.5.1.

question_23621.question: What is the format of the PROSE PATH SWITCHING REQUEST message that the initiating UE generates to initiate the path switching procedure?
