question_24636.question: What should the MS do in idle updated mode when it receives a GET STATUS message from the network on the VGCS or VBS channel downlink?
question_24636.ground_truth: The MS shall send a STATUS message using the same Transaction Identifier (TI) received from the network.

question_24637.question: What type of window function is recommended for the spectral distribution analysis in clauses 7.3.1 and 7.3.2?
question_24637.ground_truth: A window function commonly known as a "flat top window" is recommended for the spectral distribution analysis in clauses 7.3.1 and 7.3.2.

question_24638.question: What does the term "SCP" signify in the context of ETSI?
question_24638.ground_truth: SCPI stands for Subcommittee on Communications Privacy and Integrity (SCP) in ETSI.

question_24639.question: What information should be included in the SIP MESSAGE request for sending a location report?
question_24639.ground_truth: The SIP MESSAGE request for sending a location report should include a Content-Type header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-location-info+xml", an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-location-info+xml MIME body, and should follow the format specified in TS 24.379 clause 13.3.4.2.

question_24640.question: What are the basic requirements for an audio CAPTCHA to meet a fairly sophisticated Turing Test level?
question_24640.ground_truth: The PIN should be encoded in such a way as to make it unintelligible to sophisticated voice recognition/interpretation systems, the riddle should not be too complicated discouraging the caller, and the method used should not discriminate against people because of their audio or visual impairments.

question_24641.question: What is the meaning of the "IM CN subsystem functional entity address" in the FE Identifier List?
question_24641.ground_truth: The "IM CN subsystem functional entity address" in the FE Identifier List is included in the SIP signaling when the IM CN subsystem functional entity creates charging information for the related CDR of this IM CN subsystem functional entity.

question_24642.question: What is the interface used by the SDS distribution function of the MCData server to send downlink multicast SDS data to the SDS function of the MCData client in the MCData-SDS-3 reference point?
question_24642.ground_truth: The MB2-U interface defined in 3GPP TS 23.468 is used in the MCData-SDS-3 reference point.

question_24644.question: What are some potential operational requirements for wireless self-backhauling in a mobile network?
question_24644.ground_truth: Some potential operational requirements for wireless self-backhauling include the need for 5G Radio Interface Technology (RIT) to provide a backhaul function, support for flexible partitioning of resources between access and backhaul functions, autonomous neighbour discovery and link setup, and dynamic adaptation to topology changes.

question_24645.question: In the context of cell selection, what does the term "higher priority PLMN" refer to?
question_24645.ground_truth: A PLMN with a higher priority level than the currently camped VPLMN.

question_24648.question: What conformance requirement for the Normalized Coherency Error should be met for the tests under a) and b)?
question_24648.ground_truth: The conformance requirement for the Normalized Coherency Error for the tests under a) and b) is that the Normalized Coherency Error should be less than or equal to the maximum limit specified in the test.

question_24649.question: What does step 2 involve in the service provisioning notification procedure between the ECS and the EEC?
question_24649.ground_truth: In step 2, the ECS identifies the EES(s) to be sent to the EEC based on the registered ECSP identifier in EES profile and the desired ECSP identifier(s) provided by the EEC, if any.

question_24650.question: What is an early indication to send RTP media packets in the context of MCVideo communication?
question_24650.ground_truth: An early indication to send RTP media packets is a signal that informs the inviting MCVideo client about the need to start sending media packets to the server.

question_24651.question: What is the purpose of the "cause" protocol data unit (PDU) in the ServedEUTRAcellsENDCX2ManagementList data type?
question_24651.ground_truth: The "cause" protocol data unit (PDU) in the ServedEUTRAcellsENDCX2ManagementList data type is used to indicate the cause of a certain event or condition related to the serving of cells in the context of X2AP (3GPP 5G X2 interface signalling).

question_24652.question: What is the purpose of providing 4G connectivity service from a visited PLMN to a UE in a disaster condition?
question_24652.ground_truth: The purpose is to enable connectivity service when a disaster condition applies and the UE is within the area of the visited PLMN that is providing disaster roaming service.

question_24654.question: What types of charging information can be included in the NS Tenant charging information used for individual UE charging?
question_24654.ground_truth: The NS Tenant charging information used for individual UE charging can include "Max nb of PDU sessions", "Nb of PDU sessions", "load level", "Max nb of registered UEs", "Nb of registered UEs".

question_24655.question: What is the difference between Normal Recognition Mode and Hotword Recognition Mode in the ASR procedure?
question_24655.ground_truth: In Normal Recognition Mode, the MRFP matches all speech against a recognition grammar, while in Hotword Recognition Mode, the MRFP looks for a match against specific speech grammar and ignores non-matching speech.

question_24656.question: What changes needs to be done to the timestamp field of the ETSI TS 102 232-1 PSHeader structure for IRI messages?
question_24656.ground_truth: The timestamp field of the ETSI TS 102 232-1 PSHeader structure in IRI messages shall be set to the time at which the NEF event was observed (i.e. the timestamp field of the xIRI).

question_24657.question: What should be adjusted in 8.12.4.2 and 8.12A.4.2 based on the BS class under test?
question_24657.ground_truth: In 8.12.4.2 and 8.12A.4.2, the AWGN generator should be adjusted at the BS input based on the BS class under test to achieve the required EC/N0.

question_24659.question: What should the MSGin5G Client include in the CoAP payload when sending an aggregated MSGin5G message?
question_24659.ground_truth: In addition to the information elements listed in step d) of clause~6.4.1.1.2, the MSGin5G Client should include a "Number of individual messages" element to indicate the total number of messages which are aggregated into this single message, and a "List of individual messages" element which contains information elements such as "Message ID", "Payload", and optional "Application ID", "Delivery status required", and "Priority type" elements. The MSGin5G Client should not include the "Message is segmented", "Segmentation set identifier", "Total number of message segments", "Message segment number" and "Last segment flag" elements.

question_24661.question: What should the MCData client do on receipt of a HTTP 200 OK response containing the requested file?
question_24661.ground_truth: The MCData client should notify the user or application that the file has been successfully downloaded on receipt of a HTTP 200 OK response containing the requested file.

question_24662.question: What information should the NF service consumer include in the Nnrf_NFDiscovery_Request message when it wants to discover the NF or NF service in the home PLMN?
question_24662.ground_truth: The NF service consumer should include the Expected Service Name, NF type of the expected NF, home PLMN ID, serving PLMN ID, NF type of the NF service consumer, and other service related parameters such as producer NF Set ID, NF Service Set ID, S-NSSAI, NSI ID if available.

question_24663.question: What message is sent by the SMF to the UPF (PSA) in step 13a?

question_24664.question: In the integrated TSN framework, how do individual nodes of the 5G system interact with TSN procedures?
question_24664.ground_truth: Individual nodes of the 5G system, such as UPF and gNB, interact with TSN procedures that are initiated by TSN end-points and TSN controllers. By doing so, the 5G system and associated infrastructure present themselves as multiple TSN-compatible end-points.

question_24665.question: What should the 5G System ensure for the positioning-related data in Road-User Charging (RUC) use case?
question_24665.ground_truth: The 5G System shall ensure the positioning-related data are secured, support mechanisms to protect positioning-related data against tampering and spoofing and detect tampering and spoofing attempts on the position-related data.

question_24666.question: Which bands may experience interference when the 2nd order IMD products of Band 5 and Band 40 are considered?
question_24666.ground_truth: The 2nd order IMD products may fall into the BS receive band of Band 11 and Band 21.

question_24668.question: Who checks the operator agreements before including the II-NNI traversal type in a SIP request to avoid the II-NNI traversal scenario type being forwarded by a legacy implementation?
question_24668.ground_truth: P-CSCF and S-CSCF are the functional entities responsible for checking the operator agreements before including the II-NNI traversal type in a SIP request to avoid it being forwarded by a legacy implementation.

question_24669.question: What should the MME/S4-SGSN do upon detecting an SGW failure when restoring PDN connections that are not supported or not applicable for SGW restoration procedure?
question_24669.ground_truth: The MME/S4-SGSN should attempt to restore the PDN connections eligible for restoration for all UEs affected by the SGW failure, following the procedures specified in clause 14.1A.1 and 17.1A.1.

question_24670.question: How does the UE decide which cell to reselect between the highest ranked cell and the lowest priority frequency if multiple cells meet the criteria?
question_24670.ground_truth: The UE will choose the highest ranked cell among the cells meeting the criteria if the highest-priority frequency is an NR frequency. If the highest-priority frequency is from another RAT, the UE selects the highest ranked cell among the cells meeting the criteria for that RAT.

question_24673.question: What features are provided by the MCPTT Service for group communications?
question_24673.ground_truth: The MCPTT Service provides users with the ability to request permission to talk, a deterministic mechanism for floor control, and means for higher-priority users to override the current talker. Additionally, it allows users to monitor multiple calls, switch focus between calls, and automatically adjusts talk time limits for fair communication.

question_24674.question: What is the 3GPP test case for testing the LTE carrier requirements for inter-band EN-DC including FR2 in TS 36.521-1?

question_24675.question: What are Service Capability Features in the context of OSA?
question_24675.ground_truth: Service Capability Features (SCFs) are functionalities offered by service capabilities that are accessible via the standardized OSA application interface for the support of services in 3GPP system.

question_24678.question: What does the mobile station do when timer T3192 expires and there is no ongoing uplink TBF?

question_24679.question: What are the roles of the Master Operator (MOP) and Participating Operators (POPs) in network sharing?
question_24679.ground_truth: The Master Operator (MOP) is responsible for managing the shared network and providing OAM&P services to Participating Operators (POPs). The POPs are service providers who share network facilities provided by the MOP and manage their own networks, while having the ability to use a portion of the shared network.

question_24680.question: How many resource allocation modes are there in 5G V2X with NR sidelink?
question_24680.ground_truth: There are two resource allocation modes, Mode 1 and Mode 2.

question_24682.question: What shall an SDP offerer include in the SDP media description for an MSRP session when creating a session mode messaging session?
question_24682.ground_truth: The SDP offerer shall include an SDP msrp-cema attribute, the supported MIME types, an SDP path attribute, and an SDP setup attribute in the SDP media description for an MSRP session.

question_24683.question: What are the minimum requirements for the PUSCH with transform precoding enabled for BS type 2-O in 2-step RA type procedure?
question_24683.ground_truth: The minimum requirements for the PUSCH with transform precoding enabled for BS type 2-O in 2-step RA type procedure is that the block error rate of MsgA shall be equal to or smaller than 1% at the given SNR. The performance requirements assume that the precedent preamble of MsgA is correctly detected in a 2-step RA type procedure and no HARQ retransmissions.

question_24684.question: What is the function of the "List of Functional Aliases" field and what does it contain?
question_24684.ground_truth: The "List of Functional Aliases" field indicates the list of Functional Aliases that have permission to send media in a multi-talker scenario. It contains the Functional Aliases in the same order as the corresponding user IDs in the List of Granted Users field.

question_24685.question: What is the definition of uplink synchronization accuracy for PRACH in the context of 3GPP TS 25.224?
question_24685.ground_truth: The uplink synchronization accuracy for PRACH is defined as the PRACH timing deviation between the received PRACH position and the desired PRACH position.

question_24687.question: What should be set if the purpose of the random access procedure is to request on-demand system information and the on-demand system information acquisition was successful?
question_24687.ground_truth: The onDemandSISuccess should be set to true.

question_24688.question: How much of a beam prediction accuracy increase was shown for AI/ML in terms of Top-1 beam prediction accuracy, when using measurements from 4 time instances with a measurement periodicity of 80ms?
question_24688.ground_truth: AI/ML can increase the beam prediction accuracy by 2.8%.

question_24689.question: What procedure is indicated by the transmission of a "DETACH REQUEST" message by the MME to the UE and not including repeats?
question_24689.ground_truth: An attempted EPS detach procedure initiated by MME

question_24690.question: What should the receiving device do if the Call type IE of the received GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message is set to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL"?
question_24690.ground_truth: The receiving device shall set the stored current call type to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL", set the stored current ProSe per-packet priority to the value corresponding to MCVideo off-network emergency group call, start timer TFG13 with the value as specified in clause~9.3.3.4.1.1, and enter the "T1: in-progress emergency group call" state.

question_24692.question: What are the two main QoS parameters that determine the quality of the transport system?
question_24692.ground_truth: The two main QoS parameters are latency of the user data and reliability of the communication.

question_24693.question: What are the key issues in defining the Energy Efficiency KPI in 3GPP standards?
question_24693.ground_truth: The key issues in defining the Energy Efficiency KPI in 3GPP standards include the fact that the measurement of energy efficiency applies to packet-switched networks only, the energy efficiency KPIs include measurements of both energy consumption and energy efficiency, and the energy efficiency should be evaluated in different environments, including coverage limited environments, capacity limited environments, and both capacity and coverage limited environments.

question_24694.question: What is the requirement for the S-CPICH power offset accuracy for BS supporting MIMO operation?
question_24694.ground_truth: The S-CPICH power is equal to the sum of the P-CPICH power and the power offset, which are signalled to the UE. The power offset for MIMO mode is signalled in the IE "Power Offset for S-CPICH for MIMO" defined in section 10.3.6.41b in TS 25.331.

question_24696.question: What role does the IWF play when setting the MCPTT emergency state, and which state and MIME body is required for a SIP request to originate MCPTT emergency private calls?
question_24696.ground_truth: The IWF is responsible for setting the MCPTT emergency state and should include an "<emergency-ind>" element set to "true" in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body to indicate an MCPTT emergency private call request. When an emergency alert is to be sent, the IWF also needs to include the "<alert-ind>" element set to "true" and include specific location information for the MCPTT emergency alert in the request.

question_24697.question: What is the required minimum throughput for any NR carrier as specified in clause 7.7.5.1.2?
question_24697.ground_truth: The throughput for any NR carrier should be greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channel.

question_24698.question: What are the two basic ways of performing Coronary Artery Bypass Graft (CABG) surgery and what are the differences between them?
question_24698.ground_truth: The two basic ways of performing CABG surgery are on-pump CABG and off-pump CABG. In on-pump CABG, the heart is temporarily stopped and blood flow is diverted using a heart-lung bypass machine. In off-pump CABG, the area around the blocked coronary artery is stabilized using pods while the surgeon grafts the blood vessel on the pumping heart. The off-pump procedure has been shown to reduce postoperative complications associated with using a heart-lung bypass machine.

question_24700.question: What information must be stored by the MME for providing SMS in MME service when the HSS provides SMS data in the ULA?
question_24700.ground_truth: The SMS data provided by the HSS and the indication that the MME is registered for SMS.

question_24701.question: Which authentication and ciphering message is sent from the network to the MS to request an update of its location file or an IMSI attach for non-GPRS services?

question_24702.question: What bearer does the MCPTT-4 reference point use for unicast floor control signalling between the floor control server in the MCPTT server and the floor participant in the MCPTT client?
question_24702.ground_truth: The MCPTT-4 reference point uses the SGi reference point for this purpose.

question_24704.question: What is the frame structure for Adaptive Multi-Rate Wideband Speech (AMR-WB) (16 kbit/s) in the 3GPP TS 48.051 standard?
question_24704.ground_truth: The frame format for AMR-WB (16 kbit/s) uses the frame format for AMR-NB with a single 16kbit/s frame.

question_24705.question: What programming language was used for developing the code, and why?
question_24705.ground_truth: ANSI-C was used as the programming language for developing the code because portability was a major requirement.

question_24706.question: What is the role of the DANE in the Network Assistance workflow?
question_24706.ground_truth: The DANE is responsible for recommending the media content version and providing delivery boosts for the upcoming media segment in the Network Assistance workflow.

question_24707.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) and what is its role in the development of the GSM/EDGE Link adaptation?
question_24707.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) is a collaboration between groups of telecommunications associations that creates technical specifications for the development of mobile networks and devices. The GSM/EDGE Link adaptation is a technical specification produced by 3GPP that outlines the requirements for the Adaptive Multi-Rate (AMR) speech service in GSM MSs and BSSs.

question_24708.question: What happens if a UE has more than one anchored active bi-directional speech session during PS to CS Dual Radio Access Transfer?
question_24708.ground_truth: The UE first requests transfer of one of the active bi-directional sessions, puts the remaining active sessions on hold, and then requests the transfer of one of the remaining inactive bi-directional sessions.

question_24709.question: When is an ERROR INDICATION message sent in the SLmAP protocol?
question_24709.ground_truth: The ERROR INDICATION message is sent by a node to report detected errors in an incoming message if they cannot be reported by an appropriate failure message.

question_24710.question: What message does the SCS/AS send to the SCEF to initiate the device triggering procedure?
question_24710.ground_truth: The SCS/AS sends the Trigger Submit Request message to the SCEF to initiate the device triggering procedure.

question_24711.question: When should the MS send the GA-CSR CLEAR REQUEST message to the GANC?
question_24711.ground_truth: The MS should send this message when it needs to release the GA-CSR connection and signaling connection to the core network.

question_24713.question: What is the role of the Authentication Proxy (AP) when a user wants to access services through the AP?
question_24713.ground_truth: The AP first determines the authentication mechanism to use, then authenticates the user and forwards the request to the appropriate AS if successful.

question_24714.question: What is required of the MCPTT client upon receiving a request from an MCPTT user to establish an MCPTT prearranged group session, as specified in TS 24.379, clause 10.1.1.2.1.1?
question_24714.ground_truth: The MCPTT client must generate an initial SIP INVITE request by following the UE originating session procedures specified in 3GPP~TS~24.229, with the specified clarifications such as including the g.3gpp.mcptt media feature tag, an Accept-Contact header field containing the g.3gpp.mcptt media feature tag, and complying with procedures in subclause~6.2.8.1.1 under certain conditions.

question_24715.question: What is the main tool used by an attacker to distribute false public keys in a GSM/GPRS network?

question_24717.question: What are the three key factors that impact the minimum test time for application layer throughput procedures in 5G NR?
question_24717.ground_truth: Doppler/fading, minimum number of samples, confidence level for pass/fail decision

question_24719.question: What is the procedure when a User Equipment (UE) initiates a Service Request in UMTS to send data?
question_24719.ground_truth: The UE sends a NAS Service Request message to the Mobility Management Entity (MME) in the RRCConnectionRequest message. Then, the MME sends the NAS Service Request message to the Serving GPRS Support Node (SGSN) to establish a Downlink Radio Bearer (DRB) of the MTC bearer. The SGSN sends RAB Assignment Request message to the MME to establish a Data Radio Bearer (DRB). The MME sends an RRCConnectionSetup message to the UE which includes SRB parameters, DRB parameters, security mode command, and measurement control information. The UE sends RRCConnectionSetup Complete message to the MME with security mode command response, DRB establishment, and measurement control information.

question_24720.question: Which 3GPP specification defines the security architecture and procedures for the 5G system?

question_24722.question: How many dB better ranked must an already detected intra-frequency cell be for the UE to evaluate it for re-selection within Treselection = 0?
question_24722.ground_truth: The already detected intra-frequency cell must be at least 3 dB better ranked for the UE to evaluate it for re-selection within Treselection = 0.

question_24724.question: What is the eligible QoS flow value specified for MCData media in the 5GS PDU session?
question_24724.ground_truth: The eligible QoS flow value specified for MCData media in the 5GS PDU session is 70, or operator defined 5QI values (128-254).

question_24725.question: What decoding matrix was used to decode the A-format signals to the FOA signal in the main test?
question_24725.ground_truth: The decoding matrix D, obtained as a pseudo-inverse from the spherical harmonic transform matrix Y, was used to decode the A-format signals to the FOA signal in the main test.

question_24726.question: What is the minimum number of (error) events required for an early fail decision in the limit checking section?
question_24726.ground_truth: For an early fail decision, the number of (error) events ne must be equal to or greater than 7.

question_24727.question: What should be the power allocation for all other requirements except for EIRP accuracy, in the ATCR2 power allocation section?
question_24727.ground_truth: The power of each carrier should be set to the same level so that the sum of the carrier powers equals to the Rated transmitter TRP per RIB.

question_24728.question: What is the role of 3GPP OAM specifications in the assessment of energy efficiency in radio access networks as defined by ETSI ES 203 228?
question_24728.ground_truth: 3GPP OAM specifications can provide support for the assessment of energy efficiency in radio access networks as defined by ETSI ES 203 228 by measuring both network performance and energy consumption.

question_24729.question: What is the impact of PC5-MO-LR and PC5-MT-LR procedures for Case I and/or Case II on the UE, entities, and interfaces?
question_24729.ground_truth: The impacts of the PC5-MO-LR and PC5-MT-LR procedures on the UE include support for SL Positioning Server UE selection, SL Positioning Client UE authorization, and location requests/responses pertaining to SL positioning/ranging. The SL Positioning Server UE is responsible for selecting a SL Positioning Server UE, verifying the SL Positioning Client UE authorization, and reporting the location information to the SL Positioning Client UE.

question_24730.question: What is the Anchor PDP context state in the ACTIVE state?
question_24730.ground_truth: The Anchor PDP context is active in the ACTIVE state, and it knows the IMSI/NSAPI identifier and an IP address has been allocated by the GGSN.

question_24731.question: What does the acronym HS-DSCH-FDD stand for in ID id-HSDSCH-FDD-Information?
question_24731.ground_truth: HS-DSCH-FDD stands for High Speed Downlink Shared Channel in ID id-HSDSCH-FDD-Information

question_24734.question: Which function in AR and MR applications is responsible for the delivery of media content components over the 5G system?
question_24734.ground_truth: Media Access Functions are provided that support the delivery of media content components over the 5G system in AR and MR applications.

question_24736.question: What is the requirement R1 evaluating in the test procedure?
question_24736.ground_truth: R1 evaluates the absolute accuracy of Cell 1 during T1.

question_24738.question: What is the requirement for spurious emission band in 6.5B.4.3.3?
question_24738.ground_truth: The requirement is for the UE to meet the spurious emission limits for frequency ranges that are more than a specified distance from the edge of the channel bandwidth.

question_24740.question: What is the parameter measured to assess the quality of the received signal in a GSM connection?
question_24740.ground_truth: The received signal quality is measured using a parameter called RXQUAL, which indicates the BER (bit error rate) of the received signal before channel decoding.

question_24741.question: What should the RNC include in the RELOCATION REQUIRED message when performing a Relocation to GERAN Iu-mode in a successful operation?
question_24741.ground_truth: The RNC should include the GERAN Classmark IE within the RELOCATION REQUIRED message if available, as defined in TS 43.051.

question_24743.question: What message is sent when the answerer accepts the implicit floor request from the offerer in an SDP answer?
question_24743.ground_truth: The answerer sends a "Floor Granted" message

question_24744.question: Which attribute is used to specify the URI for the user profile element in the XML schema?

question_24745.question: What must a UE do to store the system information when it acquires a SIB1 or an SI message in a serving cell?
question_24745.ground_truth: The UE must store the associated areaScope, the first PLMN-Identity in the PLMN-IdentityInfoList for non-NPN-only cells or the first NPN identity in the NPN-IdentityInfoList for NPN-only cells, the cellIdentity, the systemInformationAreaID, if present, and the valueTag, if present, as indicated in the si-SchedulingInfo for the SIB.

question_24746.question: What entity calculates the PDB (Policy Decision Buffer) for the application flows?

question_24747.question: What is the maximum EIRP limit for a UE using directive antennas for transmission?
question_24747.ground_truth: For UE using directive antennas for transmission, a class-dependent limit will be placed on the maximum EIRP (Equivalent Isotropic Radiated Power).

question_24749.question: What is the issue with the UE power class in standalone mode that Option 2 proposes to clarify in Rel-15 CR?
question_24749.ground_truth: The issue is that, in standalone mode, the UE may have different power classes for NR and EN-DC, and there was ambiguity regarding how to determine the UE's power class.

question_24753.question: What is the purpose of the "oneOf", "anyOf", and "allOf" keywords in the OpenAPI specification?
question_24753.ground_truth: The "oneOf", "anyOf", and "allOf" keywords are used to describe alternative or combined data types in the OpenAPI specification. OneOf indicates that an instance should match one and only one of the alternative data types, anyOf indicates that an instance should match one or more of the alternative data types, and allOf indicates that an instance should match all of the combined data types.

question_24754.question: What are the frequency ranges for the OTA out-of-band blocking requirement for BS type 2-O operating in FR2-1?
question_24754.ground_truth: The frequency ranges for the OTA out-of-band blocking requirement for BS type 2-O operating in FR2-1 are from 30 MHz to FUL,low - 1500 MHz and from FUL,high + 1500 MHz up to 2nd harmonic of the upper frequency edge of the operating band.

question_24755.question: What is the role of a group controller in Public Safety ProSe group communication?
question_24755.ground_truth: A group controller handles the communication for a group and functions as the UE-to-Network relay if it is in network coverage.

question_24756.question: What is the purpose of considering security at the application layer in the 5G system?
question_24756.ground_truth: The purpose is to provide security for multicast/broadcast services that may not have application level security, allowing them to leverage the security provided by the 5G system, such as MBS services for IoT devices.

question_24757.question: What happens in the Uplink Direct Transfer procedure after the SRNC receives the NAS message from the CN?
question_24757.ground_truth: The SRNC sends the RRC Uplink Direct Transfer Message to the UE with the NAS message as a parameter.

question_24758.question: What is the size of the security protected 5GS NAS message header?

question_24760.question: What kind of information about a UE is included in Trace Requirements when they are sent to a 5G-AN?
question_24760.ground_truth: Trace Requirements about a UE sent to a 5G-AN do not contain information on the SUPI or on the PEI of the UE.

question_24761.question: What action does the UE take after obtaining location measurements or a location estimate in a periodic or triggered location request?
question_24761.ground_truth: The UE performs a service request if in idle state and if the UE will report the location event using a NAS signalling connection.

question_24763.question: What is the purpose of the Sequence-ID in the I1 Failure and I1 Redirection messages generated in 6.3.2.5 CFNRc and 6.3.2.6 CD?
question_24763.ground_truth: The Sequence-ID is used to indicate the sequence of messages in the I1 session between the ICS UE and the SCC AS.

question_24764.question: What is the Location Information Transfer procedure in section 5.3.2?
question_24764.ground_truth: The Location Information Transfer procedure in section 5.3.2 outlines the steps for Endpoint B to request location information from Endpoint A and for Endpoint A to transfer the requested location information to Endpoint B in the form of RequestLocationInformation and ProvideLocationInformation messages.

question_24766.question: What is the role of the V-SMF in the V-EASDF (re)-discovery procedure?
question_24766.ground_truth: The V-SMF is responsible for requesting the Visited Session Breakout with the V-EASDF/DNS server address of VPLMN to the H-SMF, interacting with V-EASDF by reusing the interface between SMF and EASDF, and creating DNS message handling Rules using the received DNS server address.

question_24767.question: What message type is used in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMPLETE message, and what direction is it sent?
question_24767.ground_truth: The message type is PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMPLETE and it is sent from the UE to the network.

question_24768.question: What is the effect of the eCall inactivity procedure on the UE's registration status with the network?
question_24768.ground_truth: If the UE is currently registered to the network for 5GS services, the eCall inactivity procedure performs a de-registration procedure.

question_24770.question: What should the UE do with the stored GPS assistance data after a location request fails due to positioning method failure?
question_24770.ground_truth: The UE should clear the stored GPS assistance data after sending a MEASUREMENT REPORT message with the "UE positioning Error" information element reporting the failure.

question_24771.question: What is the ACSadj-x in the context of NB M2M?
question_24771.ground_truth: ACSadj-x represents the x-th adjacent channel selective which is defined over the 15 kHz downlink channels and 5 kHz uplink channels used in NB M2M.

question_24773.question: What is the purpose of the X3 interface in the document?
question_24773.ground_truth: The purpose of the X3 interface in the document is to transport CC from the point of interception to the MF/DF3.

question_24774.question: What is the objective of the data security regime in the document?
question_24774.ground_truth: The objective of the data security regime in the document is to secure the data stored in a location register, which can include replication of volatile storage units and periodic back-up of data to non-volatile storage.

question_24775.question: Does Local Switching involve transcoding between the radio legs?
question_24775.ground_truth: No, Local Switching does not involve transcoding between the radio legs.

question_24778.question: What is the role of the intent-driven management service producer in AI/ML capabilities usage?
question_24778.ground_truth: The intent-driven management service producer is responsible for informing the consumer of the set of ML Entities that together achieve their intent management requirements. It manages the inter-related execution of multiple ML Entities for complex intents.

question_24779.question: What is one of the possible solutions for ML entity loading using NRM-based approach?
question_24779.ground_truth: One of the possible solutions for ML entity loading using NRM-based approach involves using instances of IOCs (Information Object Classes) for interaction between ML loading MnS producer and consumer. This includes ML entity loading request, ML entity loading policy, ML entity loading process, and ML entity loaded in the inference function.

question_24780.question: What should the mobile station do if the information in the PACKET~UPLINK~ASSIGNMENT message does not properly specify an uplink PDCH or violates the mobile station's multislot capabilities?
question_24780.ground_truth: The mobile station should reinitiate the packet access procedure unless the packet access procedure has already been attempted four times. In that case, TBF failure has occurred.

question_24782.question: What are the two types of application categories that the FRMCS System shall consider in terms of user plane application categories?
question_24782.ground_truth: The two types of application categories are Voice, for user to user or multiuser communication, and Very Critical Data, with direct impact on safety-related critical train control and operation.

question_24783.question: How is transmission point location information provided for delay propagation compensation in synchronization procedures?
question_24783.ground_truth: Transmission point location information is provided by adding this information in the Time Synchronization Information IE signaled over the S1 interface as part of RIBS signaling procedures, in the form of location coordinates associated to a list of cells served by the corresponding transmission point. This allows the synchronization target to calculate the relative distance between transmission and reception points and compensate for the propagation delay.

question_24784.question: What does the "Paging Restriction Information" indicate?
question_24784.ground_truth: The Paging Restriction Information indicates one of the following: a) all paging is restricted; b) all paging is restricted, except for voice service (IMS voice); c) all paging is restricted, except for certain PDU Session(s); or d) all paging is restricted, except for voice service (IMS voice) and certain PDU session(s).

question_24788.question: What does the "Delivered Retransmitted NR PDCP SN Ind" parameter indicate?
question_24788.ground_truth: The "Delivered Retransmitted NR PDCP SN Ind" parameter indicates the presence of successfully delivered retransmitted PDCP Sequence Number.

question_24790.question: What is the purpose of the EPS network feature support information element and what type and length is it?
question_24790.ground_truth: The EPS network feature support information element indicates whether certain features are supported by the network. It is a type 4 information element with a minimum length of 3 octets and a maximum length of 5 octets.

question_24792.question: What is the difference between "intermediate rate" and "substream rate" in the context of the present document?
question_24792.ground_truth: The intermediate rate refers to the intermediate rate in the overall data stream, while the substream rate refers to the user rate including padding, if applicable, on one individual substream.

question_24793.question: Where can AI/ML Model Training and AI/ML Model Inference be located in the OAM and gNB for network energy saving?
question_24793.ground_truth: AI/ML Model Training can be located in the OAM and AI/ML Model Inference can be located in the gNB. Alternatively, both AI/ML Model Training and AI/ML Model Inference could be located in the gNB, with the option for the gNB to continue model training based on AI/ML models trained in the OAM.

question_24794.question: What are the two types of dispersion analytics provided by the NWDAF?
question_24794.ground_truth: The two types of dispersion analytics are Data Volume Dispersion and Transactions Dispersion, which identify the location or network slice where a UE or a group of UEs disperse most of their data volume and sessions transactions.

question_24795.question: What is the procedure for Measurement of normal burst transmitter output power as per the standard?
question_24795.ground_truth: The SS takes power measurement samples evenly distributed over the duration of one burst and identifies the centre of the useful 147 transmitted bits as the timing reference. The transmitter output power is then calculated as the average of the samples over the 147 useful bits, with a sampling rate of at least 2/T, where T is the bit duration.

question_24796.question: For Band 3, Band 41, and Band 41 3-carrier carrier aggregation, what are the base station (BS) receive bands that can have the 2nd or 3rd order intermodulation products during the maximum transmission bandwidth?
question_24796.ground_truth: The 2nd order intermodulation products may fall into BS receive Bands 5, 6, 8, 12, 13, 14, 17, 18, 19, 20, 26, 27, 28, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 39, 42, 43, and 44. The 3rd order intermodulation products may fall into the BS receive bands of 1, 2, 5, 6, 8, 12, 13, 14, 17, 18, 19, 20, 22, 23, 25, 26, 27, 28, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 39, 42, 43, and 44, but when considering the impact of maximum bandwidth, the 3rd order intermodulation products will not fall into the BS receive bands of 8, 12, 17, and 22.

question_24798.question: What is the use of the Filler IE in User Data Header?
question_24798.ground_truth: The Filler IE is used to replace certain IEs in the User Data Header while retaining the original TP-User-Data-Header-Length and TP-UDL values, and a receiving entity shall ignore its content.

question_24800.question: What action should the NG-RAN node initiate if the 5G ProSe UE PC5 Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate IE is included in the PATH SWITCH REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message and it includes one or more IEs set to "not authorized"?
question_24800.ground_truth: If the 5G ProSe UE PC5 Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate IE is included in the PATH SWITCH REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message and it includes one or more IEs set to "not authorized", the NG-RAN node should initiate actions to ensure that the UE is no longer accessing the relevant 5G ProSe services.

question_24801.question: What is the name given to a nomadic cell that may be deployed for Public Safety use?

question_24802.question: What should an MCVideo client do upon receiving a transmission request message and while waiting for a response to its own sent transmission request message?
question_24802.ground_truth: The MCVideo client compares its transmission priority with the transmission priority indicated in the received transmission request message.

question_24803.question: Should terminals support the bi-directional ordering codes (U+200E, U+200F, and U+202A through U+202E)?
question_24803.ground_truth: No, terminals are not required to support the bi-directional ordering codes (U+200E, U+200F, and U+202A through U+202E), as per the Unicode 3.0 specification.

question_24805.question: What is the main function of the RAN-level compression solution?
question_24805.ground_truth: The RAN-level compression solution compresses a SDU (Service Data Unit) received from upper layers (e.g. IP) to create a PDU (Protocol Data Unit) at the transmission entity, and performs the reverse function to re-create the original SDU from the PDU at the receiver entity.

question_24806.question: What information does the SMF include in the early notification to the AF for the target DNAI?
question_24806.ground_truth: The SMF includes an IP subnet in the early notification to the AF for the target DNAI, which is representative of the N6 interface of the target UPF (PSA3).

question_24807.question: What is the issue of continuously performing inter-frequency measurements for reducing UE battery consumption and data transmission interruption?
question_24807.ground_truth: Continuously performing inter-frequency measurements may cause significant UE battery consumption and potential data transmission interruption, especially for the unnecessary measurements in Idle mode.

question_24808.question: What is the difference between Solution #1h and Solution #1i for inter-provider charging for 5GS capabilities usage?
question_24808.ground_truth: Solution #1h involves aggregating UE usage reported by SMF by the CHF, while Solution #1i involves reporting per UE usage to the billing domain, which then aggregates the usage based on the received CDRs and edge application indication in these CDRs. The difference lies in the level of aggregation, with Solution #1h aggregating usage within the CHF and Solution #1i aggregating usage in the billing domain.

question_24809.question: What happens when the FRMCS Equipment relocates from GSM-R system to the FRMCS System?
question_24809.ground_truth: The applicable functional address(es) associated with the FRMCS User require(s) a conversion to the functional identity format applicable within the FRMCS System.

question_24810.question: Regarding the measurement reporting delay in the test, what is included in the total time reported?
question_24810.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay reported is the time between an event triggering a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the report over the air interface. It excludes the delay at the DCCH TTI and any EUTRAN L3 filtering/IDC autonomous denial related delays.

question_24811.question: What is the motivation for power balancing in the context of subchannel specific power control?
question_24811.ground_truth: The purpose of power balancing is to provide a higher resolution for balancing subchannel specific power between both subchannels using different patterns.

question_24812.question: What are the possible categories of a UE for E-DPDCH in the "Physical Layer category" section for the stand-alone E-DCH and HS-DSCH and HS-DSCH on E-DCH with QPSK and 16QAM?
question_24812.ground_truth: The possible categories of a UE for E-DPDCH in the "Physical Layer category" section for the stand-alone E-DCH and HS-DSCH and HS-DSCH with QPSK and 16QAM are categories 5, 6, 7, 8, and 9.

question_24813.question: What is used to secure the reference point Ua* in the 5G core network?
question_24813.ground_truth: The AKMA Application Key derived from the AKMA Anchor Key is used to secure the reference point Ua* in the 5G core network.

question_24814.question: What should the MRFC do after receiving a trigger to stop multimedia record as per 3GPP TS 26.244?
question_24814.ground_truth: The MRFC shall request the MRFP to stop the multimedia recording and if the multimedia recording termination is added, the MRFC shall request the MRFP to subtract it.

question_24816.question: What entity is responsible for making the decision to grant, release, or revoke a Floor Request in the context of media resource control?

question_24817.question: What is the maximum time that the CCBS request will be held within the network, as specified by the CCBS service duration timer (T7) in the 3GPP system?
question_24817.ground_truth: The maximum time that the CCBS request will be held within the network, as specified by the CCBS service duration timer (T7), is greater than 45 minutes.

question_24819.question: How many dB SNR gain was observed in source R1-2009647 when the actual PUSCH transmission could cross the slot boundary, cross-slot channel estimation was used, and the length of actual repetition could be larger than 14 symbols for VoIP at 2% rBLER for FR2 TDD, compared to Rel-16 PUSCH repetition type B without joint channel estimation?

question_24822.question: What should the participating MCVideo function include in the Contact header field when sending SIP provisional responses other than the SIP 100 (Trying) response?
question_24822.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function shall include the following in the Contact header field when sending SIP provisional responses: the g.3gpp.mcvideo media feature tag, the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag with the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcvideo", the isfocus media feature tag, and an MCVideo session identity mapped to the MCVideo session identity if provided in the Contact header field of the incoming provisional response.

question_24824.question: What is the architectural consideration for Monitoring Event offline charging?
question_24824.ground_truth: For offline charging, the MME, SGSN, and IWK-SCEF can function as Monitoring Event Charging Nodes to generate accounting metrics sets for Monitoring Event CDRs. The MECN may have an integrated CDF or CGF or both, or the MECN/CDF may forward the CDRs to the CGF across the Ga interface.

question_24825.question: What is required in subclause 6.2.3 regarding the registration of NGCN sites in the IMS?
question_24825.ground_truth: Subclause 6.2.3 states that there is no registration of NGCN sites in the IMS.

question_24827.question: What is the purpose of the Radio Network Layer in the UTRAN architecture?
question_24827.ground_truth: The Radio Network Layer in the UTRAN architecture defines the UTRAN logical nodes and interfaces between them, including the protocols for user plane transport, signalling transport, and implementation-specific O&M.

question_24828.question: What is one of the potential requirements for the 5G system to support on-demand multicast sessions over a 5G PVN?

question_24829.question: What should an SCP include in a request if the 3gpp-Sbi-Max-Forward-Hops header is not received in an incoming request?
question_24829.ground_truth: The SCP should include the 3gpp-Sbi-Max-Forward-Hops header with the node type "scp" and the maximum number of allowed intermediate SCPs to relay the message before reaching the target HTTP server.

question_24830.question: What is the type definition for the "tEmptyTypeAttribute" element, as defined in the provided XML schema?
question_24830.ground_truth: The "tEmptyTypeAttribute" element is an extension of the "tEmptyType" type, with an added "TriggerId" attribute of type "xs:string", as defined in the schema.

question_24832.question: Which solution is preferred for Sh interface and why?
question_24832.ground_truth: Solution C is preferred for Sh interface as it does not require any impact with the introduction of a Group ID for impacted user identification. This solution does not require any additional complexities or changes, making it the preferred option.

question_24833.question: What should the NF Service Consumer include in the POST request if the AMF determines that the PDU session establishment should be rejected?
question_24833.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should include the indication of PDU session establishment rejection together with the corresponding rejection cause in the POST request, indicating that the PDU session establishment should be rejected.

question_24834.question: What is the procedure for EAS discovery when application information is shared between two OPs having partnership?
question_24834.ground_truth: During service provisioning, if the application information is shared, the EEC obtains an EES (OP-B) from its OP (i.e. OP-B) and triggers EAS discovery towards the EES (OP-B), which further obtains EESs of a partner OP (OP-A) from its registered ECS (OP-B) and returns the discovered EASs to the EEC.

question_24835.question: What should the UE do when the UE receives a REGISTRATION REJECT or SERVICE REJECT message without integrity protection with specific 5GMM causes?
question_24835.ground_truth: The UE shall remove the registration failure data received in the REGISTRATION REJECT message or SERVICE REJECT message without integrity protection with specific 5GMM causes from its registration failure data storage.

question_24836.question: What is the value of AddressType discriminator in Recipient-SCCP-Address AVP?
question_24836.ground_truth: The value of AddressType discriminator in Recipient-SCCP-Address AVP is 8, E.164.

question_24837.question: What is performed after the receipt of a failed LOCATION RELATED DATA REQUEST at the non-anchor 3G MSC, if Assistance Data was requested?
question_24837.ground_truth: The Delivery of Assistance Data to the MS is performed after the failed LOCATION RELATED DATA REQUEST, with the corresponding RANAP and BSSMAP information elements.

question_24839.question: When should the MME or PWS-IWF forward the same WRITE-REPLACE-WARNING-INDICATION message to all CBCs?
question_24839.ground_truth: The MME or PWS-IWF should forward the same WRITE-REPLACE-WARNING-INDICATION message to all CBCs if it interfaces with multiple CBCs and has active SCTP associations established with them.

question_24842.question: In the calibration stage for the method using the one-dimensional probe in subclause 10.3.2.1.3.2, what is the first step in the procedure?
question_24842.ground_truth: The first step is to connect the feed system of the compact probe to the signal generator.

question_24843.question: What is the purpose of Slice Differentiator (SD) in the 3GPP 5G system?
question_24843.ground_truth: Slice Differentiator (SD) is optional information that complements the Slice/Service type(s) to allow further differentiation for selecting a Network Slice instance from potentially multiple Network Slice instances that all comply with the indicated Slice/Service type.

question_24844.question: What is the body that produces the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network documents?

question_24846.question: What is a potential security requirement to protect the integrity and confidentiality of information during path change in 5G System?
question_24846.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall provide means to protect security (i.e., the integrity, confidentiality, and replay protection) of user plane data and signaling information during UE-to-UE Relay path switch.

question_24847.question: Which method enables an AF to update an existing Individual MBS User Service resource at the NEF using the MBSUserService API?

question_24851.question: What is the purpose of the "Globalen-gNB-ID" protocol data unit (PDU) in the En-gNBServedCells-ExtIEs data type within the En-gNB-ENDCX2SetupReqIEs data type of X2AP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION?
question_24851.ground_truth: The "Globalen-gNB-ID" protocol data unit (PDU) in the En-gNBServedCells-ExtIEs data type of X2AP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION represents the global en-gNB-ID (Globally unique en-gNB-ID) used for identification purposes.

question_24852.question: What is the minimum requirement for BS type 1-O in terms of EIRP for the lowest and highest supported frequencies?
question_24852.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for BS type 1-O, as per 3GPP TR 37.842, specifies that the radiated transmit power requirements are the same as those for E-UTRA, with the radiated transmit power based on manufacturer's declarations for FR1.

question_24853.question: What is one of the functions of the S16 reference point?
question_24853.ground_truth: The S16 reference point is used to inform the H(e)NB policy function about the IPSec tunnel header information of specific H(e)NB.

question_24856.question: What is the function of the Preferred Frequency Band (PFB) in the 5G network?
question_24856.ground_truth: The Preferred Frequency Band (PFB) is a parameter that includes a list of target carrier frequencies containing one or more entries, and for each entry, a carrier frequency priority index is associated. It is used by the UE in Idle state to select the appropriate cell where to establish the RRC connection.

question_24858.question: What data type is used for the "ProSe-Application-Code" in the "AnnouncingUpdate-info" complex type?
question_24858.ground_truth: The "ProSe-Application-Code" in the "AnnouncingUpdate-info" complex type is of the "hexBinary" data type.

question_24859.question: What event triggers the UDR to send updated information to the NRF in this solution?
question_24859.ground_truth: The UDR sends updated information to the NRF when it detects that the corruption, loss, or inconsistency of data may occur because of certain scenarios, such as the UDR failing and restarting or migrating data from an old UDR to a new UDR.

question_24860.question: What is the role of the guard timer used by RAN for UE reachability management?
question_24860.ground_truth: The guard timer is used by RAN for UE reachability management to initiate the AN release procedure after the expiry of the RAN notification area update timer value provided to the UE.

question_24861.question: What are the potential benefits and cons of Option 3-2 in splitting NR functions between central and distributed units?
question_24861.ground_truth: Option 3-2 is insensitive to transmission network latency between CU and DU and uses the interface format inherited from legacy interfaces of PDCP-RLC and MAC-RLC. Benefits include flow control from the CU using a buffer in the CU, no additional transport delay of the PDCP/RLC reestablishment procedure, and no transport constraint induced. However, STATUS PDU of AM Rx RLC in AM Rx RLC may lead to additional time delay in the interface between CU and DU. Two buffers, a buffer in CU for flow control and a buffer in DU for packet buffering, are also required in this setup.

question_24862.question: What happens when a user transfers a voice call from an IP-PBX device to a 3GPP mobile device within the Enterprise premises?
question_24862.ground_truth: The SIP session in the Enterprise IP-PBX is converted to a CS voice call and transferred to the mobile operator's MSC, which is anchored in the mobile operator's IMS.

question_24863.question: What is the purpose of the validity time in the security context?
question_24863.ground_truth: The validity time in the security context indicates when the security keys and thus the storage in the ADRF expire. This ensures that the keys and the ML model information are up-to-date and secure.

question_24865.question: What is the difference between variant "a" and variant "b" in the basic mechanism for the HSS based solution?
question_24865.ground_truth: Variant "a" triggers the P-GW via S6b, while variant "b" triggers the ePDG over SWm or the TWAN over STa.

question_24866.question: What should an SGW do when it detects a S1-U user plane path failure?
question_24866.ground_truth: If the SGW decides to keep the bearer contexts associated with the failed path, it shall notify the MME of the S1-U path failure in subsequent signalling procedures. If the SGW decides to delete the bearer contexts, it shall include a cause code "S1-U path failure" in the Delete Bearer Request message.

question_24867.question: What is the coverage target for PUSCH?
question_24867.ground_truth: The coverage target for PUSCH can be met using repetition. The number of repetitions required varies depending on the scheme used, and could be around 200-1200 for a single PRB carrying 16-104 bits.

question_24868.question: What is the condition for the UE to send an Event A3 triggered measurement report in step 6.6.1.8.5?
question_24868.ground_truth: The UE shall send one Event A6 triggered measurement report, with a measurement reporting delay less than 5760 ms from the beginning of time period T2.

question_24870.question: What type of duplex method is considered for LAA operation in the 5GHz unlicensed band?
question_24870.ground_truth: The duplex method for 5GHz unlicensed band will be based on the physical layer design on L1 enhancements for LAA, considering both DL-only and/or DL+UL transmission scenarios.

question_24871.question: What is the role of the MRFP in user plane interworking when the user plane is not transported transparently through the IMS?
question_24871.ground_truth: The MRFP may provide transcoding of the user plane if a codec mismatch occurs.

question_24872.question: What is the interface used for 5GC-capable UE to access a 5G-RG via 5GC?
question_24872.ground_truth: The untrusted N3GPP interface, defined in 3GPP release 15, is used for the 5GC-capable UE to access a 5G-RG via 5GC.

question_24873.question: How does network synchronization error affect the positioning error when changing it from 0 ns to B ns?
question_24873.ground_truth: The positioning error varies, with a larger network synchronization error resulting in a larger positioning error.

question_24874.question: What happens when the SGM-S receives a CoAP PUT request to update a VAL group document and the sender is not authorized?
question_24874.ground_truth: The SGM-S responds with a CoAP 4.03 (Forbidden) response and does not update the VAL group document.

question_24875.question: What is the purpose of the test in section 6.3.9?
question_24875.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in section 6.3.9 is to verify that the UE makes correct performing the RRC connection release with redirection to the target UTRAN FDD cell without system information.

question_24877.question: How are packets prioritized in both intra-UE and inter-UE transmissions?
question_24877.ground_truth: Packets are served in priority order, with UE serving all packets associated with a specific priority before moving on to the next priority (where a lower number indicates a higher priority).

question_24878.question: When must a UE re-enable the N1 mode capability for 3GPP access after disabling it for 3GPP access?
question_24878.ground_truth: A UE must re-enable the N1 mode capability for 3GPP access when it performs PLMN selection, SNPN selection, SNPN selection for onboarding services over 3GPP access, changes its usage setting from "voice centric" to "data centric", or re-enables the N1 mode capability for 3GPP access when performing items c) or d).

question_24880.question: What is the purpose of the NAS transport procedures in the 5G protocol?
question_24880.ground_truth: The NAS transport procedures help to provide transport of payload between the UE to the AMF in the 5GMM message. They have two alternatives: a dedicated set of procedures for each of SM transport and non-SM transport, or a single set of procedures for both SM and non-SM transport. The SM transport procedures describe conditions for inclusion of the S-NSSAI, the DNN, and the request type.

question_24881.question: What is the requirement for the throughput of any measured E-UTRA carrier in the context of base station RF bandwidth or maximum radio bandwidth?
question_24881.ground_truth: The throughput should be greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channel as defined in clause 7.2.5.4.

question_24882.question: What should the participating MCVideo function do if it cannot find a binding between the public user identity and an MCVideo ID in the SIP MESSAGE request for binding a functional alias with the MCVideo group(s) for the MCVideo user?
question_24882.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function should reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response and warning text set to "141 user unknown to the participating function".

question_24883.question: What information is included in the channel status when it is open and a link has been established?
question_24883.ground_truth: Channel data length, with more than 255 bytes available.

question_24886.question: What procedure is used to dynamically re-anchor the PDU Session to a Distributed Anchor Point connectivity model?
question_24886.ground_truth: The EAS Discovery procedure with Dynamic PSA distribution for both SSC mode 2 and SSC mode 3 PDU Sessions using EASDF is used to dynamically re-anchor the PDU Session and transition to a Distributed Anchor Point connectivity model when needed.

question_24887.question: Which subclause of 3GPP TS 05.05 or 3GPP TS 45.005 is referenced in section 6.6.2.1.2 for the test purpose?

question_24888.question: What should be adjusted in order to obtain the specified level of interference signal at the BS (Base Station) input?
question_24888.ground_truth: ATT2 and ATT3 should be adjusted.

question_24889.question: What is one of the functions of the SN if the SN is kept?
question_24889.ground_truth: The SN keeps the UE context if the indication from the target MN is included in the SgNB Release Request message.

question_24891.question: What is the primary function of the Signalling Proxy within the Mission Critical System?
question_24891.ground_truth: The primary function of the Signalling Proxy is to perform key management of signalling keys, and encryption/decryption of application signalling transiting the edge of the mission critical domain.

question_24892.question: Which information element is used to indicate the reference cell info for OTDOA in a Position Periodic Report Extension?

question_24893.question: What is the role of the Contact Manager Server in this specification?
question_24893.ground_truth: The Contact Manager Server is an application on the UICC that enables Java CardTM platform-based applets to invoke and register to its services. The invocation of the Contact Manager Server services is done through methods corresponding to the Contact Manager Runtime Environment interface.

question_24894.question: In what state should the MS be at the beginning of the test?
question_24894.ground_truth: The MS should have a MultiParty call to two destinations (Call A-B and Call A-C) active, both in state U10 "Active" with auxiliary state "Call in MPTY".

question_24897.question: What is the role of security in the ETWS system?
question_24897.ground_truth: Security is provided by appending Digital Signatures and Timestamps to the Warning Information. In case of regulatory preference for speed of delivery time over security features, the UE only accepts "unsigned" warnings in that country, and the UE has to authenticate the network during its registration in that country. This requires the use of a USIM, rather than a SIM.

question_24898.question: What was the input level of the AMR-WB coder when the overload performance test was conducted in section 22?
question_24898.ground_truth: The input level of the AMR-WB coder was adjusted with 'sv56' algorithm provided in the ITU-T Recommendation G.191 software tool library (STL2000r3).

question_24899.question: How many applet instances are allowed for the maximum number of toolkit applets requirement?
question_24899.ground_truth: The maximum number of applets allowed is 8.

question_24900.question: What actions does the H-PCF take if the UE policy information size exceeds the predefined limit?
question_24900.ground_truth: The H-PCF splits the UE policy information into smaller logical independent fragments and sends them one at a time by initiating the PCF-initiated UE Policy Association Modification procedure.

question_24901.question: What information must a UE use after BWP switch when the UE does not have the required activated TCI-state(s) to receive PDCCH/ PDSCH and to transmit PUSCH/PUCCH/SRS in the new BWP?
question_24901.ground_truth: The UE must use old TCI-states before the BWP switch until a new MAC CE updating the required activated TCI-state(s) information is received after the BWP switch.

question_24902.question: What fields are used in the Primitive REPORT or REJECT for the WRITE-REPLACE and KILL primitives?
question_24902.ground_truth: The Serial-Number field will contain the old serial number if this primitive is sent in response to a KILL primitive, and the new serial number if the primitive is sent in response to a WRITE-REPLACE primitive.

question_24903.question: Which header compression protocols are supported for a PDCP entity associated with DRB in the 3GPP 5G system?
question_24903.ground_truth: The robust header compression protocol (ROHC) and the Ethernet header compression protocol (EHC) are supported for a PDCP entity associated with DRB in the 3GPP 5G system.

question_24904.question: How is the performance of HS-DSCH determined in multi-path propagation conditions?
question_24904.ground_truth: The performance of HS-DSCH in multi-path propagation conditions is determined by the throughput R measured on HS-DSCH.

question_24905.question: What is the purpose of the +CIRQE command in the reflective QoS for ESP feature?
question_24905.ground_truth: The +CIRQE command allows the TE to provide information about a downlink IPsec SA to TA/MT, along with other required information for an UL packet filter of a derived QoS rule for ESP.

question_24906.question: What EMM cause value should the network set when the service request is rejected due to service gap control?
question_24906.ground_truth: The network should set the EMM cause value to #22 "congestion" when the service request for mobile originated services is rejected due to service gap control as specified in clause~5.3.17.

question_24907.question: What function does the UE perform after receiving the LADN service area from the AMF during registration?
question_24907.ground_truth: After receiving the LADN service area from the AMF, the UE can request PDU session establishment for the LADN DNN, and the AMF and SMF handle the PDU session establishment request as a PDU session for the LADN DNN.

question_24909.question: What is the responsibility of the MCData client 1 when it receives a request for more information about the remaining data volume to transmit?
question_24909.ground_truth: MCData client 1 sends MCData more information response including the remaining amount of data to transmit.

question_24910.question: How are Transfer of N1/N2/N3 reference points between NG-RANs and 5CNs managed in the Geographical Zones approach?
question_24910.ground_truth: Transfer of N1/N2/N3 reference points between NG-RANs and 5CNs is managed based on the association of cells with TAs and RAs, with an Inter-satellite Link transport for 5CNs out of reach of NG-RANs.

question_24911.question: What technology is used for advanced V2X service such as platooning?

question_24912.question: What should a UE consider itself for NR sidelink communication if it cannot detect any cell meeting the S criterion on a specific frequency?
question_24912.ground_truth: The UE should consider itself out-of-coverage for NR sidelink communication on that frequency.

question_24913.question: What is the spreading factor used for E-UCCH part 2 in E-PUCH?
question_24913.ground_truth: E-UCCH part 2 is spread using the same spreading factor as the data payloads.

question_24915.question: What is a measurement object associated with for intra-frequency and inter-frequency measurements?
question_24915.ground_truth: A measurement object is a single E-UTRA carrier frequency for intra-frequency measurements and a single NR carrier frequency for inter-RAT measurements.

question_24918.question: What is the number of subframes used for NB and WB signals at 13.2 kbit/s in case of inactive signals?
question_24918.ground_truth: 1 subframe is used for NB and WB signals at 13.2 kbit/s in case of inactive signals.

question_24919.question: What is the value of the Ready timer in the ATTACH ACCEPT message in the initial state, keeping the MS always in Ready state?
question_24919.ground_truth: The value of the Ready timer in the ATTACH ACCEPT message is 111.

question_24920.question: What is needed to allow the UE to switch into the 3GPP2 1xRTT network and do radio measurements for event-triggered measurements?
question_24920.ground_truth: Measurement gaps, which are network-controlled, are needed to allow the UE to switch into the 3GPP2 1xRTT network and do radio measurements.

question_24922.question: How is the in-band emission measured for UL transmission?
question_24922.ground_truth: The in-band emission is defined as the average emission across 12 sub-carriers and as a function of the RB offset from the edge of the allocated UL transmission bandwidth. The in-band emission is measured as the ratio of the UE output power in a non-allocated RB to the UE output power in an allocated RB.

question_24924.question: Which data type is used in the "CallingPartysNumber" of "ConnectSMSArg" in the "CAP-SMS-ops-args" module?
question_24924.ground_truth: The "SMS-AddressString" data type is used in the "CallingPartysNumber" of "ConnectSMSArg" in the "CAP-SMS-ops-args" module.

question_24925.question: What is the average L1-RSRP difference of the Top-1 predicted beam pair when measured by three sources with a different set of beams?
question_24925.ground_truth: The average L1-RSRP difference of the Top-1 predicted beam pair can be 1dB~2dB, 2dB~3dB, more than 3dB, and about 6dB based on three different sources.

question_24926.question: What should the MS do when timer TU3904 expires in the MS during the registration process?
question_24926.ground_truth: The MS should release the TCP connection towards the GANC, release the secure connection towards the SEGW of the GANC, and start timer TU3905 if GAN registration can be re-attempted. If timer TU3905 expires in the MS, the MS shall restart the Registration procedure.

question_24927.question: What is the difference between Modes 0 and 3 in estimating audio-visual quality for HTTP Adaptive Streaming services?
question_24927.ground_truth: Mode 0 implements a simple and efficient quality estimation by inputting parameters from the metadata description of audio-visual streams (codecs and bitrate). Mode 3 derives coding quality from the unencrypted bitstream by parsing the bitstream, considering codec information, video resolution, framerate, bitrate, GOP structure, and quantization parameters for more accurate estimation of video coding quality. Mode 3 requires more processing power and is not typically deployed on user end devices, but can be applied by splitting the processing for the model between the server and client.

question_24928.question: What should the target AMF do if it receives a complete Registration Request in clear text and the indication of horizontal KAMF derivation (i.e. keyAmfHDerivationInd) from the initial AMF in registration with AMF reallocation via direct NAS reroute?
question_24928.ground_truth: The target AMF should initiate NAS SMC if the indication of horizontal KAMF derivation (i.e. keyAmfHDerivationInd) is received, otherwise it should use the received security context from initial AMF and send protected NAS message including protected authentication request message if authentication is needed. The target AMF decides whether to perform authentication based on local policy.

question_24929.question: What is the purpose of the UE requested PDN disconnection procedure?
question_24929.ground_truth: The UE requested PDN disconnection procedure allows a UE to request disconnection from one PDN, leading to the release of all EPS bearer contexts established towards that PDN, including the default EPS bearer context.

question_24930.question: What is the maximum allowed handover delay Dhandover for the test case to pass?
question_24930.ground_truth: The maximum allowed handover delay Dhandover is 120 ms.

question_24931.question: What type of data is the "MBMS Service Area" and where is it conditionally stored?
question_24931.ground_truth: The MBMS Service Area is permanent data conditionally stored in MBMS GW, MME, SGSN, and BM-SC.

question_24933.question: As per Note 2 of clause 7.5.5.3.2, what is the interfering signal step size for the additional blocking requirement for GSM, DCS, UTRA FDD, E-UTRA FDD, FDD unsynchronized UTRA TDD, and unsynchronized E-UTRA TDD BTS operating in a different frequency band?
question_24933.ground_truth: The interfering signal step size for the additional blocking requirement is 1 MHz.

question_24934.question: What must the AMF do if the UE's Enhanced Coverage Restriction information changes and the UE has established PDU sessions?
question_24934.ground_truth: The AMF must trigger a PDU session modification to the SMFs serving the UE's PDU sessions and include an extended NAS-SM indication only if use of CE mode B is now unrestricted in the Enhanced Coverage Restriction information in the UE context in the AMF.

question_24935.question: What is the role of the MTC Provider Information in the authorization process of service specific parameters?
question_24935.ground_truth: The MTC Provider Information is used by any type of Service Providers or Corporate or External Parties to distinguish their different customers.

question_24936.question: What is the role of the paging re-transmission timer in the MSC/SGSN/MME in E-UTRAN?
question_24936.ground_truth: The paging re-transmission timer in the MSC/SGSN/MME in E-UTRAN is adapted to fit the needs of the extended DRX cycle and normal DRX cycle.

question_24937.question: What is the primary purpose of wireless sensor networks (WSN) in the context of the Factory of the Future?
question_24937.ground_truth: The primary purpose of wireless sensor networks (WSN) in the context of the Factory of the Future is to monitor the state or behavior of a particular industrial environment and detect anomalies in the data using machine learning algorithms.

question_24938.question: What is the purpose of the announce request procedure for restricted 5G ProSe direct discovery model A?
question_24938.ground_truth: The purpose of the announce request procedure for restricted 5G ProSe direct discovery model A is for the UE to obtain a ProSe restricted code for the RPAUID to be announced over the PC5 interface, or to inform the 5G DDNMF that the UE wants to stop announcing a ProSe restricted code. Before initiating the announce request procedure, the UE must be authorized for restricted 5G ProSe direct discovery model A announcing in the registered PLMN or local PLMN.

question_24939.question: How long does the eCall capable MS remain registered on the network following completion of a test eCall?
question_24939.ground_truth: The eCall capable MS remains registered on the network for a duration of T3243 following completion of a test eCall.

question_24940.question: What is the main limitation of the bit-exact criteria used for the floating-point implementation in TS 26.443, and why is this a problem?
question_24940.ground_truth: The main limitation of the bit-exact criteria used for the floating-point implementation in TS 26.443 is that the output values of the codec change slightly due to factors like compiler, compile options, operating system, and platform, which causes the bit-exactness test to fail. This is a problem because it prevents the use of the EVS floating-point code for 3GPP voice services, as the test vectors were generated using a specific version of Microsoft Visual Studio.

question_24941.question: What is one condition for the FRMCS system to provide service continuation by setting up the communication via the GSM-R system?
question_24941.ground_truth: One condition for the FRMCS system to provide service continuation by setting up the communication via the GSM-R system is that the GSM-R system is unavailable.

question_24942.question: What is the frequency range at which measurements are made in the sidetone characteristics section?
question_24942.ground_truth: Measurements are made at 1/12-octave intervals for frequencies from 100 Hz to 4 kHz (inclusive) and from 100 Hz to 8 kHz (inclusive) in the sidetone characteristics section.

question_24945.question: What is a desired feature for farm machinery regarding mobile operator selection?
question_24945.ground_truth: Technologies that facilitate easy switch between mobile operators are desirable for farm machinery due to the long lifetimes and often leased nature of the equipment.

question_24946.question: What is the uplink resource allocation scheme supported when transform precoding is disabled?
question_24946.ground_truth: Uplink resource allocation scheme type 0 is supported for PUSCH only when transform precoding is disabled.

question_24947.question: Which type of UE is the applicability of the test described in 14.5.2.2.2 outlined for?
question_24947.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR UE release 17 and forward that support satellite access and long DRX cycle.

question_24949.question: What is the significance of the "3,1 kHz (External to the PLMN)" Bearer Service category?
question_24949.ground_truth: The "3,1 kHz (External to the PLMN)" Bearer Service category is used when interworking with the ISDN or PSTN "3,1 kHz audio" service and includes the capability to select a modem at the interworking function.
