The connection within the PLMN, user access point to the interworking function, is an unrestricted digital connection.

question_24950.question: What is the main function of the Floor Arbitrator (FA) in the off-network MCPTT service?
question_24950.ground_truth: The main function of the Floor Arbitrator (FA) in the off-network MCPTT service is to manage floor congestion among participants and control the floor of users.

question_24951.question: What mode is used in the ticket-based solution for media protection that exposes plaintext keys to all SIP proxies?
question_24951.ground_truth: The unprotected ticket mode is used in the ticket-based solution for media protection that exposes plaintext keys to all SIP proxies.

question_24953.question: What is the maximum power of any UE emission, in dBm, for frequencies up to 10 MHz offset from the assigned E-UTRA channel bandwidth in Band C?
question_24953.ground_truth: The power of any UE emission must not exceed -47 dBm for frequencies up to 10 MHz offset from the assigned E-UTRA channel bandwidth in Band C.

question_24954.question: What should the initiating UE ensure before initiating the 5G ProSe direct link identifier update procedure?
question_24954.ground_truth: The initiating UE should ensure that timer T5091 is not running and it is not performing the 5G ProSe direct link re-keying procedure initiated by the target UE.

question_24955.question: What should be avoided during T2 and T3 to ensure a correct SCell1 activation and deactivation delay?
question_24955.ground_truth: PCell interruption during SCells activation should not occur outside specific subframes in T2, and PCell interruption during SCells deactivation should not occur outside specific subframes in T3.

question_24957.question: What happens during the real time video streaming service flow if the requested quality cannot be reached?
question_24957.ground_truth: If the requested quality cannot be reached, the FRMCS Application or the FRMCS User can decide to stop the request or to continue the setup of video streaming with a lower video quality, depending on the application needs. If the delivered quality of the real time video data communication changes during the streaming, the FRMCS Application or the FRMCS User is informed about the change and may decide to change the quality of the real time video streaming, depending on the applications needs.

question_24958.question: What is the role of SoR information in delivering SVSP?
question_24958.ground_truth: SoR information can be used as an alternative mechanism to deliver SVSP in both roaming and non-roaming scenarios. In non-roaming cases, the V-PCF is not involved and the role of the H-PCF is performed by the PCF. In roaming scenarios, the V-PCF interacts with the AMF and the H-PCF interacts with the V-PCF.

question_24960.question: Which data type is used for the "LocationFilter" type's "cellID" element?
question_24960.ground_truth: The data type for the "cellID" element is "xs:unsignedLong".

question_24961.question: What message does the MS initiate while in GA-PSR-STANDBY state when receiving a GPRS uplink data transfer request from the LLC for specific SAPI values?
question_24961.ground_truth: The MS initiates the GA-PSR-ACTIVATE-UTC-REQ message and starts timer TU4002.

question_24962.question: What protocol is used to establish the IPsec tunnel between the UE and the ePDG?
question_24962.ground_truth: The IPsec tunnel is established between the UE and the ePDG via an IKEv2 protocol exchange.

question_24963.question: What happens when a UE initiates a de-registration for a S-NSSAI?
question_24963.ground_truth: When a UE triggers a de-registration request for a S-NSSAI, the AMF triggers the update of policy counter to the associated PCF during AM policy association termination procedure. Upon receiving a deregistration request from the AMF, the secondary PCF of the S-NSSAI increases the remaining local quota of the S-NSSAI by one. The response of the deregistration of the S-NSSAI is then sent to the UE by the serving AMF.

question_24964.question: Which logical entities are assumed to have no implicit trust in the secured AI/ML model sharing mechanism?
question_24964.ground_truth: The following logical entities are assumed to have no implicit trust: the producer of the AI/ML model (NWDAF MtFL), the storage platform (ADRF), and the AI/ML consumer (AnLF).

question_24965.question: What is the requirement for the event triggered measurement reporting delay on cells not belonging to monitored set, measured without L3 filtering?
question_24965.ground_truth: The event triggered measurement reporting delay on cells not belonging to monitored set, measured without L3 filtering, shall be less than the above defined Tidentify detected set. defined in Section 8.1A.2.2.1.

question_24967.question: What was the range of the mean power saving gain with a marginal loss in DL UE satisfied rate observed in FR1, DL evaluation, DU, VR30 for the enhanced PDCCH for jitter handling scheme?
question_24967.ground_truth: The range of the mean power saving gain was 37.83~47.38%.

question_24969.question: What is the purpose of the procedure described in 5.6.13.1?
question_24969.ground_truth: The purpose of the procedure described in 5.6.13.1 is to inform E-UTRAN about an SCG failure the UE has experienced, such as SCG radio link failure or SCG change failure.

question_24970.question: What information does Solution 46 provide to the UE through the CellReselectionPriorities in the RRC connection Release?
question_24970.ground_truth: Solution 46 provides more information on what slices are supported in which bands, allowing the UE to prefer certain bands for registering with band specific slices.

question_24971.question: What is the total cell re-selection delay to lower priority that is allowed?
question_24971.ground_truth: The total cell re-selection delay to lower priority that is allowed is 20.48 s.

question_24972.question: What should the UAE-S do upon receiving DAA client event information and links information from the UAS application specific server?
question_24972.ground_truth: Upon receiving DAA client event information and links information from the UAS application specific server, the UAE-S stores the information and forwards it to the UAS application specific server. Once it receives a DAA client event information acknowledgement, the UAE-S generates an HTTP 200 (OK) response message and sends it towards the UAE-C.

question_24973.question: What action does the MME take if there is a Service Gap timer running in the MME MM Context for the UE and the MME is not waiting for a MT paging response from the UE?
question_24973.ground_truth: The MME rejects the Service Request with an appropriate cause. In addition, MME may also provide a UE with a Mobility Management Back-off timer set to the remaining value of the Service Gap timer.

question_24974.question: What kind of limits are used for defining operating band unwanted emissions for BS type 1-C in Band n78?
question_24974.ground_truth: The operating band unwanted emissions limits for each antenna connector for BS type 1-C in Band n78 shall be defined based on basic limits, with no scaling and no antenna considered.

question_24975.question: What is the role of the local near-edge MEC in the traffic surveillance camera and MEC metro traffic safety system use-case?
question_24975.ground_truth: The local near-edge MEC in this use-case is responsible for processing accident information, suggesting immediate next course of action, predicting the position of the vehicle, and informing local Emergency Response Unit dispatch to send help.

question_24977.question: What is the main purpose of the main SA in the IPsec tunnel between the UE and the interworking function N3IWF in non-3GPP access?
question_24977.ground_truth: The main SA is used solely for the transport of NAS messages between the UE and the AMF/SMF in non-3GPP access.

question_24978.question: What information is exchanged between PCF and TSCTSF via the N84 reference point?
question_24978.ground_truth: The information exchanged between PCF and TSCTSF via the N84 reference point includes application level session information and Ethernet or IP port management information.

question_24980.question: What is the purpose of secure channel pairing between the UICC and the MTC ME?
question_24980.ground_truth: The secure channel pairing is used for one-to-one binding between a USIM and a Relay Node, and to restrict the use of a USIM to specific UEs.

question_24981.question: What is the purpose of the document "3rd Generation Partnership Project; Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network; Dual Connectivity (EN-DC) with 3 bands DL and 3 bands UL (Release 16)"?
question_24981.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to gather relevant background information and studies to address Dual Connectivity (EN-DC) with 3 bands DL and 3 bands UL for the Rel-16 band combinations.

question_24983.question: In the context of rvingCell and measResultServingMOList, what does RSRP refer to?
question_24983.ground_truth: RSRP stands for Reference Signal Received Power. It is a measurement of the power level received by the user equipment (UE) from a reference signal transmitted by a serving cell.

question_24984.question: What is the role of the multiplexing function in the uplink and downlink for TCH/F28.8 in the transparent case?
question_24984.ground_truth: In the uplink, the multiplexing function maps one 290-bit block from each substream into every 580-bit TCH/F28.8 radio interface data block. In the downlink, the multiplexing function demultiplexes the two substreams by extracting the two 290-bit blocks from the received 580-bit radio interface blocks.

question_24986.question: What should the "Requested PDP Address" field be for all MSs using Mobile IP?
question_24986.ground_truth: The "Requested PDP Address" field should be omitted for all MSs using Mobile IP.

question_24987.question: What is required to establish the secure channel between the USIM and the MTC ME?
question_24987.ground_truth: A mutual authentication is performed between the USIM and the MTC ME to establish the secure channel.

question_24990.question: What is the alpha identifier for the second SEND DATA command in the procedure?
question_24990.ground_truth: The alpha identifier for the second SEND DATA command is "Send Data 2".

question_24991.question: What is the condition for checking sending distortion in this process?
question_24991.ground_truth: The sending distortion is checked using a sine-wave signal with a frequency of 1020 Hz, and the RMS level of the signal is measured with psophometric noise weighting.

question_24992.question: How is the retrieval of authentication vectors and authorization of the ProSe UE performed if the ProSe Function does not have an unused authentication vector associated with the ProSe UE?
question_24992.ground_truth: The ProSe Function shall request one Authentication Vector from the HSS over the PC4a interface.

question_24993.question: What action does the mobile station take when it receives the first PACKET NEIGHBOUR CELL DATA message or PACKET CELL CHANGE CONTINUE message or PACKET CELL CHANGE ORDER message while in CCN mode?
question_24993.ground_truth: The mobile station stops timer T3210 when it receives any of these messages.

question_24994.question: What is the difference between Class 1 and Class 2 Elementary Procedures in NBAP?
question_24994.ground_truth: Class 1 EPs in NBAP have a response (success or failure), while Class 2 EPs do not have a response and are considered always successful.

question_24995.question: What Network determined not reachable condition should the HSS use when reporting the User State to other network entities if the e-rel-12 MME/SGSNs consider the UE as not reachable?
question_24995.ground_truth: The HSS should use the "Network determined not reachable" state.

question_24996.question: What is the type of the id-RetainabilityMeasurementsInfo field in the bearer context release complete message?
question_24996.ground_truth: The type of the id-RetainabilityMeasurementsInfo field in the bearer context release complete message is RetainabilityMeasurementsInfo.

question_24997.question: What should the UE do upon inter-system change to N1 mode over 3GPP access for PDN connections established via an ePDG connected to EPC?
question_24997.ground_truth: The UE may keep, release, or attempt to transfer the PDN connections to N1 mode over 3GPP access using the parameters associated with the PDU session identity.

question_24998.question: What is the PEI monitoring interval for the UE in the 9.1.14.1.3 test procedure?
question_24998.ground_truth: The UE monitors one PEI occasion (PEI-O) per DRX cycle, where a PEI occasion is a set of PDCCH monitoring occasions (MOs) and can consist of multiple time slots (e.g. subframes or OFDM symbols) where PEI can be sent.

question_24999.question: What should the MCPTT client do after it determines the success or failure of a sent remotely initiated private call request?
question_24999.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should indicate to the requesting MCPTT user the success or failure of the sent remotely initiated private call request.

question_25001.question: What is the solution selected for Assignment of dedicated MME/SGSN procedures and for HSS Initiated dedicated CN node reselection?
question_25001.ground_truth: Solution 1: Redirection after Update Location Procedure is selected.

question_25002.question: How should the network slice availability be maintained in solution #26 while maintaining uniform support of network slices within the TA?
question_25002.ground_truth: The availability of a network slice can be maintained by re-using existing OAM mechanisms and defining RRM policies such that the network slice uses shared resources outside the service area within the TA.

question_25004.question: What happens to the UE's back-off timer after it is used for a certain PLMN and APN combination in N1 mode?
question_25004.ground_truth: The back-off timer is stopped when the UE is switched off or the USIM is removed.

question_25005.question: What is the role of the MC service server in using UE's capabilities and service related information in creating and using MBS sessions?
question_25005.ground_truth: The MC service server uses UE's capabilities and service related information in a implementation-specific way to create and use MBS sessions.

question_25006.question: What is the measurement for the reference sensitivity performance of the MS?
question_25006.ground_truth: The reference sensitivity performance of the MS is measured by the number of residual bit error events for class Ib bits and frame erasure events. The error rate is determined by examining sequences of at least the minimum number of samples of consecutive bits or frames and assuming a frame is received successfully if it is not signalled as erased.

question_25007.question: In the 5G communication scenario, what information does the WAMPAC system utilize to detect and prevent the potential collapse of the distribution grid due to the presence of underfrequency conditions at several distributed generator sites?
question_25007.ground_truth: Based on data from multiple strategically chosen PMUs measuring synchrophasors, frequency, and ROCOF, the WAMPAC system identifies the distribution grid area affected by underfrequency conditions among several DERs. By tripping the generators in some of these critical sites, the WAMPAC system can help prevent system collapse due to severe imbalance.

question_25008.question: What is the definition of "idle mode" in the context of user equipment (UE)?
question_25008.ground_truth: Idle mode is the state of UE when switched on but with no Radio Resource Control (RRC) connection.

question_25010.question: What is the condition for passing the UE if the ratio (NACK / ACK + NACK) is greater than or equal to 0.1?
question_25010.ground_truth: The UE is passed if 1000 filtered ACK+NACK responses are gathered and the ratio (NACK / ACK + NACK) is greater than or equal to 0.1.

question_25011.question: What is the function of the signalling RB for MCCH with 80 ms TTI?
question_25011.ground_truth: The signaling RB for MCCH with 80 ms TTI is support in Release 6 by UEs with capability for MBMS. It is used to convey information during the initial phase of the Multimedia Broadcast System between the UEs and the network. The TTI is the time duration for which the UE and the network share the frequency resource.

question_25012.question: What is the purpose of including a ProSe Relay UE ID in the announcement message during UE-to-Network Relay Discovery?
question_25012.ground_truth: Including a ProSe Relay UE ID in the announcement message during UE-to-Network Relay Discovery does not imply that the ProSe UE-to-Network Relay has established the indicated connectivity to the network.

question_25013.question: When providing a Requested NSSAI, what S-NSSAIs can the UE include and use for a given PLMN?
question_25013.ground_truth: The UE in a given PLMN only includes and uses S-NSSAIs applying to this PLMN.

question_25014.question: What should a mobile station (MS) do upon completion of the location updating procedure if there is no follow-on CM application request pending and no follow-on proceed indication has been received?
question_25014.ground_truth: The MS shall set timer T3240 and enter the state WAIT FOR NETWORK COMMAND, expecting the release of the RR connection.

question_25017.question: What should a UE do when it receives a mandatory field that is missing or treated as absent in an RRC message on DCCH or CCCH?
question_25017.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the message.

question_25018.question: What is the purpose of the measurement reporting delay excluding a delay caused by no UL resources for UE to send the measurement report?
question_25018.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay excluding a delay caused by no UL resources for UE to send the measurement report ensures that the measurement reporting delay is not impacted by the availability of uplink resources for the UE.

question_25021.question: What indications are included in the Forward Relocation Request message for each PDN connection?
question_25021.ground_truth: The Forward Relocation Request message includes, for each PDN connection, the indication "Uplink Access Marking" if provided by the PGW, and is transferred to the eNB in the Handover Request.

question_25022.question: When is the NF service consumer required to report the presence area information to the PCF?
question_25022.ground_truth: The NF service consumer should report the presence area information to the PCF when it receives the information from the serving node, including the initial status at the time the request for reports is initiated.

question_25023.question: What state should the UE be in prior to the start of the time duration T1?
question_25023.ground_truth: Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE should be fully synchronized to cell 1.

question_25024.question: What method was used to minimize the dominance of noise in the investigation of far end background noise?
question_25024.ground_truth: The Degradation Category Rating method was selected to minimize the dominance of noise, and the investigation of the two different types of noise was placed in separate experiments.

question_25025.question: What is the core objective of the 3GPP work item related to the Introduction of upper 700MHz A block E-UTRA band for the US?
question_25025.ground_truth: The core objectives are to study the need for co-location and/or co-existence requirements, standardize a new FDD E-UTRA operating band, specify band numbering and RF characteristics, ensure the new band supports only NB-IoT operation, and update related 3GPP E-UTRA technical specifications.

question_25027.question: What is the purpose of the OperatorEdgeDataNetwork IOC in the Edge Federation?
question_25027.ground_truth: The OperatorEdgeDataNetwork IOC contains attributes to support an available edge data network shared with another operator.

question_25028.question: What is the role of the RR entity in the network?
question_25028.ground_truth: The RR entity in the network provides services to the Mobility Management (MM) and other entities for setting up control channel connections, establishing traffic channel connections, synchronization, ciphering mode indication, and control-data transfer.

question_25029.question: What is the network component that determines to de-register an AUN3 device and initiates the deregistration process targeting the AUN3 device and not the 5G-RG?

question_25030.question: What is the purpose of the pre-scan method described in 6.3.2.5.2?
question_25030.ground_truth: The pre-scan method is used to identify spurious frequencies with emission power levels above a threshold in a fast measurement over the entire spurious frequency range. It is not meant to provide an estimate of TRP.

question_25031.question: What is the recommended mechanism for the HSE to flush unused e2m key pairs in clause 6.1.2.1?
question_25031.ground_truth: The recommended mechanism is a time-based approach, where keys that remain unused for a specified period after they are generated are deleted.

question_25032.question: What FAST's standard does the IE SpeedStateScaleFactors belong to?

question_25034.question: In the context of handover cancellation during handover preparation phase in home-routed roaming, what actions does the SMF and V-SMF take after receiving the Relocation Cancel Indication from the AMF?
question_25034.ground_truth: The SMF(s) deletes the session resources established during the handover preparation phase in SMF(s) and UPF(s). The V-SMF releases the corresponding resource in the target V-UPF if it was allocated during the handover preparation.

question_25035.question: What is the general principle for achieving a consistent user experience across different access scenarios?
question_25035.ground_truth: The general principle is to strive for a consistent user experience across different access scenarios.

question_25036.question: What two events are dispatched based on the screen orientation?
question_25036.ground_truth: A portrait event is dispatched if the screen is taller than it is wide, and a landscape event is dispatched if the screen is wider than it is tall.

question_25041.question: When must the UE include the media feature tags defined in RFC 3840 and RFC 5688 in the initial INVITE request?
question_25041.ground_truth: The UE must include the media feature tags defined in RFC 3840 and RFC 5688 for all supported streaming media types in the initial INVITE request.

question_25042.question: In the Technical Report 3GPP TS 12.22, which entity handles processing phases that are included in the defined call phases for user signalling acknowledgement delay?
question_25042.ground_truth: The MSC/VLR handles the processing phases that are included in the defined call phases for user signalling acknowledgement delay.

question_25044.question: What action does the UE (MCPTT Client) take when it receives a Connect message with Automatic Commencement Mode in the pre-arranged group call?
question_25044.ground_truth: The UE (MCPTT Client) accepts the connection and sends an Acknowledgement message.

question_25046.question: What conditions are necessary for the formation of a wide area Isolated E-UTRAN?
question_25046.ground_truth: The formation of a wide area Isolated E-UTRAN requires an outage in the E-UTRAN and the presence of multiple isolated infrastructure eNBs that can interconnect, providing increased range.

question_25047.question: What is the purpose of Self-healing in the context of SON?
question_25047.ground_truth: The purpose of Self-healing in SON is to solve or mitigate faults that can be solved automatically by triggering appropriate recovery actions.

question_25049.question: When is the AMF necessary in authorizing a PINE for access to a PIN?
question_25049.ground_truth: The AMF is necessary if the Initial PINE ID is associated with a PLMN that is different than that of the AMF.

question_25050.question: What are the two polynomials used for CRC calculation in this protocol?
question_25050.ground_truth: The two polynomials used for CRC calculation are gCRC6(D) = D6 + D5 + D3 + D2 + D1 + 1 and gCRC10(D) = D10 + D9 + D5 + D4 + D1 + 1.

question_25051.question: What is the requirement for the UE when it receives an INFO request with specific header fields and body in an emergency session as per clause 5.1.6.11.3 of TS 24.229?
question_25051.ground_truth: The UE shall proceed to send an INFO request containing an "application/EmergencyCallData.eCall.MSD" MIME body part with the MSD not exceeding 140 bytes and encoded in binary ASN.1, if it is able to provide an updated MSD.

question_25054.question: What is the main issue addressed by solution #11?
question_25054.ground_truth: Solution #11 addresses resolving misalignments between VAL server policy (e.g., requirements provided when adding or changing slices) and the NSCE service provider policy.

question_25056.question: What is the purpose of the test in step 9.6.2.4.2?
question_25056.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in step 9.6.2.4.2 is to verify the ability of the receiver to receive a predefined test signal in cell FACH state, with SDU error ratio not falling below a specified value.

question_25058.question: Which message is sent by the RNC to transfer the radio interface initial layer 3 message to the CN?
question_25058.ground_truth: The 9.1.33 INITIAL UE MESSAGE is sent by the RNC to transfer the radio interface initial layer 3 message to the CN.

question_25059.question: What is the definition of "active" media information for audio in the context of average codec bitrate calculation?
question_25059.ground_truth: In the context of average codec bitrate calculation, "active" audio media information is defined as frames containing audio.

question_25061.question: What is the purpose of the HNB Registration Procedure in 3GPP TS 36.468?
question_25061.ground_truth: The purpose of the HNB Registration Procedure is to register the HNB with the HNB-GW to enable the HNB-GW to provide service and core network connectivity for the HNB.

question_25062.question: What are some examples of exclusion areas that UEs must take into account and comply with?
question_25062.ground_truth: Examples of exclusion areas include CBRS spectrum in the United States, international treaties in which spectrum that is used in one country can only be employed by a neighboring country if emissions are prevented in an exclusion zone extending several kilometers from the mutual border, and scientific and research exclusion areas used for astronomical research.

question_25063.question: What should the MCVideo client 2 do after receiving a transmission granted message while at least one participant is currently transmitting video in the group?
question_25063.ground_truth: MCVideo client 2 can transmit video to the MCVideo group after receiving a transmission granted message.

question_25066.question: How are the OTA sensitivity requirements defined for EIS declarations in Rel-13?
question_25066.ground_truth: In Rel-13, vendors declare the EIS values and provide information on how the EIS values are obtained (separately to the conformance specification).

question_25067.question: What is the expected HTTP status code when the NF service consumer sends a DELETE request to delete an existing MBS Application Session Context and the request is processed successfully?
question_25067.ground_truth: The PCF shall respond with an HTTP "204 No Content" status code.

question_25068.question: What is the purpose of the error concealment procedure in the AMR-WB speech codec within the 3GPP system?
question_25068.ground_truth: The purpose of the error concealment procedure is to conceal the effect of erroneous/lost AMR-WB speech frames and to mute the output in the case of several erroneous/lost frames to indicate the breakdown of the channel to the user and to avoid generating possible annoying sounds as a result from the error concealment procedure.

question_25069.question: What should the source AMF do if the smfChangeInfoList attribute is received in the POST request body after the UE context transfer was completed successfully?
question_25069.ground_truth: The source AMF shall release the SM context at the I-SMF or V-SMF only, for all the PDU sessions listed in the smfChangeInfoList attribute with the smfChangeIndication attribute set to "CHANGED" or "REMOVED".

question_25070.question: What does an MS need to perform in addition to the tasks in 6.5.6.1, if it is COMPACT-capable?
question_25070.ground_truth: If an MS is COMPACT-capable, it needs to perform the same tasks as in 6.5.6.1 for any CPBCCH, either transmitted in the serving cell or indicated in the BA-GPRS list.

question_25072.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project?
question_25072.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network is responsible for the technical specifications of the radio interface of 3GPP mobile systems, including MC services over LTE.

question_25073.question: For successful operation of the Path Switch Request procedure, what message should the NG-RAN node send to the AMF upon reception of the PATH SWITCH REQUEST message for each PDU session indicated in the PDU Session ID IE?
question_25073.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node initiates the procedure by sending the PATH SWITCH REQUEST message to the AMF.

question_25074.question: How many times can the MS retransmit the PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message after T3168 expires?
question_25074.ground_truth: The MS can retransmit the PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message three times after T3168 expires.

question_25075.question: Which network entity sends the 200 OK to the UE after a domain transfer is initiated?
question_25075.ground_truth: The P-CSCF (Proxy-Call Session Control Function) sends the 200 OK to the UE after a domain transfer is initiated.

question_25077.question: What is the procedure for assessing test site loss for scaling of received output power measurements?
question_25077.ground_truth: The MS is replaced by a half-wave dipole, resonating at the center frequency of the transmit band, connected to an RF generator. The frequency of the RF signal generator is set to the frequency of the ARFCN used for the measurements, the output power is adjusted to reproduce the received transmitter output power averages recorded in step a). The power, delivered by the generator to the half-wave dipole, is recorded for each channel number used, and then used to compute the actual transmitter output power averaged over the 8 measurement orientations.

question_25078.question: What is the purpose of the EPS bearer context status information element?
question_25078.ground_truth: The EPS bearer context status information element is used to indicate the state of each EPS bearer context that can be identified by an EPS bearer identity.

question_25080.question: What is the name of the custom operation that revokes authorization for some service APIs of an existing Individual security instance resource in the CAPIF core function?

question_25081.question: What is the periodic update message sent by PINE(s), PEGC(s), PEMC, and PIN servers in a PIN network to indicate their availability?
question_25081.ground_truth: PIN heartbeats are periodic update messages sent by PINE(s), PEGC(s), PEMC, and PIN servers in a PIN network to indicate their availability.

question_25083.question: What should the SCC AS do when it receives an initial SIP INVITE with a valid SCC AS PSI DN, a valid E.164 number in the SDP offer, and a P-Asserted-Identity header field containing the same E.164 number?
question_25083.ground_truth: The SCC AS shall use the SCC AS PSI DN that was allocated in the above step 1 to associate SCC-AS-PDN with the existing session and the E.164 number received in the SDP offer from the ICS UE.

question_25084.question: What is the HTTP method required to negotiate the applicable HTTP version for SEAL APIs?
question_25084.ground_truth: The HTTP upgrade mechanism should be used to negotiate the applicable HTTP version.

question_25085.question: What are the two directions in which downlink control channel (PDCCH) interference can occur in co-channel HeNB deployments?
question_25085.ground_truth: The two directions are HeNB (aggressor) to macro-UE (victim), and macro-eNB (aggressor) to HUE (victim) if the UE is connected to a weaker HeNB cell.

question_25086.question: What is the purpose of QoS estimation in V2X applications?
question_25086.ground_truth: QoS estimation helps V2X applications to get the communication system connection capability in advance, which allows them to compute and adjust in advance to the right working mode to guarantee safety and service availability.

question_25087.question: What is the main objective of security requirement 4.4 in terms of network slice negotiation?
question_25087.ground_truth: The main objective is to secure the negotiation procedure and standardize the security procedure for network slice negotiation.

question_25088.question: What is the drawback of Alternative 1 and Alternative 2 when following a given peer in this alternative?
question_25088.ground_truth: The drawbacks are the same as those listed in Alternative 1 and Alternative 2 when following a given peer.

question_25089.question: What should the P-CSCF do if the verification of the list of Route headers with the stored list of Record-Route headers fails?
question_25089.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should return a 400 (Bad Request) response or replace the preloaded Route header value in the request with the one received during the last registration in the Service-Route header of the 200 (OK) response.

question_25090.question: What is the high-level architectural option for online charging for the creation, activation, de-activation, modification and termination of a Network Slice?
question_25090.ground_truth: The CTF could be placed in the Network Slice Management Function (NSMF).

question_25091.question: What action should a UE take if uplink user data is pending for one or more PDU sessions when building a control plane service request message as an initial NAS message?
question_25091.ground_truth: The UE should indicate the respective PDU sessions, regardless of the access category, as specified in subclause 5.6.1.2.2 when building a control plane service request message as an initial NAS message.

question_25093.question: How is the "Call waiting" supplementary service activated?
question_25093.ground_truth: The "Call waiting" supplementary service is activated at the request of the user, through an activation request that specifies the basic services to which the activation refers.

question_25094.question: What should a Mobile Station (MS) do when it receives a FACILITY message containing AoCC information and is in the U10 call active state?
question_25094.ground_truth: The MS should ignore the AoCC information and not send any AoCC information acknowledgement.

question_25095.question: What are the potential consequences of a compromised mobile access gateway (MAG) in the PMIPv6 protocol?
question_25095.ground_truth: A compromised MAG could send PMIP messages on behalf of a Mobile Node, leading to Denial-of-Service attacks or a misuse of received key material.

question_25097.question: What is the role of the PDCF in the ProSe application registration process?
question_25097.ground_truth: The PDCF is responsible for checking whether an application is authorized to use ProSe service and for sending the ProSe Application Registration Request to the Application Server.

question_25098.question: What should the S-CSCF do if it receives any response to third-party REGISTER and the response contains a type 3 term-ioi parameter?
question_25098.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall store the value of the type 3 term-ioi parameter received in the P-Charging-Vector header, if present. The type 3 term-ioi identifies the service provider from which the response was sent.

question_25100.question: Which mode of operation is used for MCPTT over MBMS?
question_25100.ground_truth: The unidirectional mode of operation is used for MCPTT over MBMS.

question_25101.question: When must the peak code domain error requirements specified in sub-clause 6.8.3.1 apply at each active transmit antenna connector, as specified in sub-clause 6.8.3.1A, 6.8.3.1B and 6.8.3.1C?
question_25101.ground_truth: The requirements apply for UE with two active transmit antenna connectors in UL OLTD operation, UL CLTD activation state 1 and 2 or 3, and DB-DC-HSUPA operating simultaneously with CS.

question_25102.question: What should the MM sublayer do if an RR connection cannot be established or any of the MM common procedures or security mode control fail in Iu mode?
question_25102.ground_truth: The MM sublayer shall indicate this to the CM layer with an appropriate error cause.

question_25103.question: What should the AMF do when it receives an emergency registration request when the UE was not successfully authenticated?
question_25103.ground_truth: The AMF shall not register with the UDM for an emergency registration in which the UE was not successfully authenticated.

question_25104.question: Which two signalling protocols can be used for establishing the WebRTC media plane connection between WIC peers?
question_25104.ground_truth: The WIC application can implement any signalling protocol such as SIP or RESTful HTTP or JSON over WebSocket for establishing the WebRTC media plane connection between WIC peers.

question_25108.question: Under what conditions is the "Loss of connectivity" monitoring event triggered in the HSS?
question_25108.ground_truth: The "Loss of connectivity" monitoring event is triggered when it is no longer possible to establish signalling between the UE and the network, and reported by the serving MME/SGSN to the HSS.

question_25109.question: What is the purpose of solution #15 in the 5GC?
question_25109.ground_truth: The purpose of solution #15 is to address mutual authentication (key issue #3) by generating the AKMA anchor key at the time of primary authentication.

question_25110.question: What information is exchanged between the CP function and the SX3LIF over the X3c reference point in the defined LI architecture for CUPS?
question_25110.ground_truth: The CP function provides intercept-related information (IRI) to the SX3LIF over the X3c reference point.

question_25111.question: What is the reporting range for P-CCPCH RSCP?
question_25111.ground_truth: The reporting range for P-CCPCH RSCP is from -120 to -25 dBm.

question_25112.question: What is the role of the TP-Status-Report-Qualifier in the Short Message Peer-to-Peer (SMPP) protocol?
question_25112.ground_truth: The TP-Status-Report-Qualifier is a 1 bit field located within bit 5 of the first octet of SMS-STATUS-REPORT, which indicates whether the status report is the result of a SMS-SUBMIT or an SMS-COMMAND.

question_25114.question: What action does the NG-RAN node take upon receiving the UE RADIO CAPABILITY CHECK REQUEST message?
question_25114.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node establishes the UE-associated logical NG-connection by receiving the AMF UE NGAP ID IE in the UE RADIO CAPABILITY CHECK REQUEST message.

question_25116.question: What are the two main approaches for storing and placing network slice quota information and management in the 5GC network?
question_25116.ground_truth: The two main approaches are to put them into an existing 5GC network function or to introduce a new network function/new service operation to be deployed in the existing 5GC network function.

question_25117.question: What is required when the 5GC NF generates the request of an EE operator certificate to the operator CA/RA during the set up of initial trust?
question_25117.ground_truth: The request shall include the initial trust (initial OAM issued certificate, signature of NF profile parameters, or IAK) fetched in step 1 and the NF Instance Id in SubjectAltName field of the certTemplate. The NF shall sign the request with its private key and includes the digital signature in the request.

question_25118.question: What does the abbreviation "3GMS" stand for in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_25118.ground_truth: 3GMS stands for Third Generation Mobile Communications System.

question_25119.question: What are the adjusted EPS bearer priority and transmission control priority for MCVideo emergency calls?
question_25119.ground_truth: Adjusted EPS bearer priority and transmission control priority are given to MCVideo emergency calls over MCVideo users in MCVideo emergency group calls who themselves do not have their MCVideo emergency state set. The MCVideo emergency state is cancelled, and normal transmission control priority and EPS bearer priority is restored to call participants. MCVideo emergency state is managed by the MCVideo user, and is set when the MCVideo user is in a life-threatening situation.

question_25120.question: What manual mode is available for the MCVideo Client to establish an On-demand private call without Transmission Control?
question_25120.ground_truth: The MCVideo Client can establish an On-demand private call in Manual Commencement Mode without Transmission Control, which requires a manual request to establish a call without Transmission Control.

question_25122.question: What is the default value of T if the MS does not support EC-GSM-IoT, Category M1 or Category NB1?
question_25122.ground_truth: The default value of T is 60 minutes if the MS does not support any of the mentioned categories.

question_25123.question: When should the Serving GW inform the PDN GW that only Control Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation applies?
question_25123.ground_truth: The Serving GW must inform the PDN GW when the MME has determined that the PDN connection shall only use the Control Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation.

question_25124.question: How does an Edge Application Server de-register from the CAPIF core function?
question_25124.ground_truth: The Edge Application Server sends a registration update request to the CAPIF core function, indicating a de-registration to an existing registration. The CAPIF core function then validates the request and sends a registration update response message to the Edge Application Server.

question_25126.question: When can the 3GPP system automatically revoke a DTS session in the RPLMN?
question_25126.ground_truth: The 3GPP system in the RPLMN shall automatically revoke the DTS upon UE detachment/deregistration, or when the connections under control of the DTS session are released.

question_25127.question: What information does the BSF supply to the UE when it continues protocol Ub after receiving the authentication vector?
question_25127.ground_truth: The BSF supplies key material (Ks) to the UE, derived from the confidential key (CK) and integrity key (IK), as well as the Bootstrapping Transaction Identifier (B-TID) and key lifetime (expiry time) for further use in GAA/GBA applications.

question_25128.question: What is the purpose of monitoring the statistical properties of data in ML context?
question_25128.ground_truth: The purpose is to detect changes and anomalies in the ML context, which can lead to performance degradation of the ML entity.

question_25130.question: What is the suggested solution for the charging principle document structure in the solution #2?
question_25130.ground_truth: The suggested solution is to add a new chapter for the charging principle in the TS 32.240 and describe the high-level service description for charging, including 5G LAN Charging, Edge Computing Charging, and Network slice charging.

question_25131.question: Which operations have a timeout value of T(AoC) (1s to 40s)?

question_25132.question: What is the purpose of the DMR-1 relationship in the gaming domain model?
question_25132.ground_truth: The DMR-1 relationship represents the relationship between Application and ApplicationInstance, and is a one-to-many relationship.

question_25133.question: What is the purpose of deploying security functions, such as firewalls, at the CN edge in a network slice?
question_25133.ground_truth: Deploying security functions, such as firewalls, at the CN edge (e.g. N6 interface) in a network slice can protect the network slice from attacks from the internet.

question_25135.question: How should the HSS indicate unavailable Repository Data in a Sh-Pull Response?
question_25135.ground_truth: The HSS should include an empty Service Indication and Sequence Number but not contain a ServiceData element.

question_25136.question: In NR Rel-16, what are the aspects being studied for Enhanced Hybrid Automatic Repeat Request (HARQ) feedback?
question_25136.ground_truth: The aspects being studied for Enhanced HARQ feedback in NR Rel-16 include enabling more than one Physical Uplink Control Channel (PUCCH) for HARQ-ACK transmission within a slot and enabling enhanced reporting procedure/feedback for HARQ-ACK.

question_25138.question: What should be the number of rated output power declarations for a BS capable of 1024QAM DL operation?

question_25140.question: What should the call control entity of the MS indicate to the upper layers when it receives an indication of "MM connection establishment due to SRVCC handover" and is in the "null" state?
question_25140.ground_truth: The call control entity of the MS should indicate to the upper layers that call establishment is due to SRVCC handover.

question_25141.question: What condition does a set of subframes for PSSCH transmission need to meet in sidelink transmission mode 4?
question_25141.ground_truth: A set of subframes for PSSCH transmission in sidelink transmission mode 4 needs to meet the condition that it is a resource reservation interval provided by higher layers.

question_25142.question: What is the shortest SMTC period among all CCs in the same FR2 band, given the SMTC offset of all CCs in FR2 provided the same offset, denoted as TSMTCperiod?

question_25144.question: What is the purpose of the Proximity-based Services (ProSe) charging in 3GPP?
question_25144.ground_truth: The Proximity-based Services (ProSe) charging in 3GPP specifies the offline, online, and converged charging description for ProSe, based on the stage 2 description of ProSe. It includes the charging architecture and scenarios specific to the Prose, as well as the mapping of the common 3GPP charging architecture onto the Prose. It further specifies the structure and content of the CDRs for offline charging, and the charging events for online charging.

question_25145.question: What is the main purpose of the V2X application server discovery using MBMS procedure?
question_25145.ground_truth: The purpose of the V2X application server discovery using MBMS procedure is to allow the UE to receive the V2X application server information over MBMS bearers.

question_25146.question: What does E-DCH stand for in the context of UMTS and what is its definition?
question_25146.ground_truth: E-DCH stands for Enhanced Dedicated Channel in UMTS. It is a resource that exists in the uplink only and is not visible in the logical channels provided by MAC. It is a transport channel subject to Node-B scheduling and is defined as an extension to DCH transmission.

question_25148.question: What is the purpose of Test 1 in 8.2.6.2.4.1, ensuring that the UE successfully transmits an RRCResumeComplete message after receiving an RRCResume message and so on?
question_25148.ground_truth: The purpose of Test 1 in 8.2.6.2.4.1 is to ensure that the UE can properly transmit an RRCResumeComplete message after receiving an RRCResume message, waiting for 10ms, and receiving an UL grant.

question_25149.question: What is the uncertainty in the power accuracy of the OTA test chamber for the TAE measurement?
question_25149.ground_truth: The uncertainty in the power accuracy of the OTA test chamber will not affect the TAE measurement uncertainty.

question_25151.question: What is the role of the "CBC" in the architecture alternative 2 for supporting PWS in 5GS?
question_25151.ground_truth: The CBC is responsible for managing CBS messages and reusing the existing SBc protocol interface for warning message delivery between the AMF and CBC.

question_25152.question: What is the maximum value that the "Value" attribute of TimeUnc element can take?

question_25153.question: What does the UE store in step 8 of the UUAA procedure?
question_25153.ground_truth: If UUAA result is success, the UE stores the authorization information if received such as UAS Security information along with the CAA-level UAV ID in step 8 of the UUAA procedure.

question_25155.question: What are the pre-conditions for the automated healing of a Network Slice Instance (NSI)?
question_25155.ground_truth: The pre-conditions for the automated healing of an NSI are that the operator wants the NSI to be healed automatically, and that the NSI is activated.

question_25156.question: What action should the ePDG take if it receives an authorization response with the WLAN-Location-Info-Request bit set to 1 and no WLAN Location Information is included?
question_25156.ground_truth: The ePDG should delete any stored WLAN Location Information associated with the UE.

question_25157.question: What is the scope of the document "Application of Q.1900 series to bearer independent Circuit Switched (CS) core network architecture; Stage 3 (Release 17)"?
question_25157.ground_truth: The document describes the protocols used in a 3GPP bearer independent CS core network when ITU-T Q.1902 is used as the call control protocol, specifically for a 3rd generation PLMN (UMTS) that complies with Release 4 and later.

question_25158.question: What should the MS do when it receives a GA-CSR PAGING REQUEST message and the mobile identity does not match any of its valid identities?
question_25158.ground_truth: The MS should ignore the GA-CSR PAGING REQUEST message and continue with any ongoing procedure as if the GA-CSR PAGING REQUEST was not received.

question_25159.question: What measure is taken to avoid inconsistent addresses allocation throughout the network and enable the restoration of PFCP sessions after an MB-UPF restart?
question_25159.ground_truth: TheMB-UPF used before an MB-UPF restart does not reuse the IP addresses immediately after the restart. Instead, during or immediately after an MB-UPF restart, theMB-UPF places a local UPF Recovery Time Stamp value in all Heartbeat Request/Response messages.

question_25161.question: What is the purpose of the Completion of Communications on No Reply (CCNR) service?
question_25161.ground_truth: The CCNR service allows user A to have a communication completed with a destination B that did not answer, without having to manually initiate a new communication attempt when destination B becomes not busy after having initiated and completed a new communication.

question_25163.question: What is the effect of setting the Event header field to "deactivated" in the NOTIFY request by the S-CSCF?
question_25163.ground_truth: The S-CSCF expects the UE to reregister the public user identity with the associated set of implicitly registered public user identities and will only release sessions that currently include the user's contact address.

question_25164.question: What is the role of the UPF (PSA) in the forwarding of buffered DL data in the N4 Session Modification procedure?
question_25164.ground_truth: The UPF (PSA) sends DL CN Tunnel Info as requested by SMF in step~6b, and the SMF starts a timer to release the resource in the old intermediate UPF if it exists.

question_25165.question: What is the potential normative work that may be covered for the use case of Online XR Gaming?
question_25165.ground_truth: The potential normative work that may be covered for the use case of Online XR Gaming includes streaming protocols for online gaming, decoding, rendering and sensor APIs, architectures for computing support in the network, coded representation of audio/video formats for gaming, device-to-device communication support for XR gaming, format for storing and sharing location information, and network support for group discovery and authentication, shared persistence and spatial mapping.

question_25166.question: How does the ADR control algorithm fulfill its objective in the VBR mode?
question_25166.ground_truth: The ADR control algorithm fulfills its objective in the VBR mode by adjusting the threshold (Tcn), frame pattern (LHH), PPP bump up threshold (R ss1, R sl2, R sns1, R sns2), and the open loop voiced and unvoiced decisions to reduce the rate. Additionally, it utilizes a speech quality improvement strategy if the global rate is less than the target rate.

question_25168.question: What is the test purpose for the TDD - TDD inter frequency relative accuracy measurement of RSRQ in 9.2.4.2.2?
question_25168.ground_truth: To verify that the TDD - TDD inter frequency relative accuracy measurement of RSRQ is within the specified limit for all bands.

question_25169.question: Which SIP header fields can be used to identify the home network in Alternative 3?
question_25169.ground_truth: The Via, Route, and Record-Route header fields cannot be used to identify the home network in Alternative 3 as they include physical entities which may not apply to the home network.

question_25171.question: What are the potential benefits of using an AI/ML model split strategy in offloading?
question_25171.ground_truth: The split model strategy allows for optimizing energy consumption, reducing latency, and effectively managing multiple AI/ML models running in parallel on different devices.

question_25172.question: How does a PEGC join a PIN?
question_25172.ground_truth: A PEGC joins a PIN as a PIN element using one of the above methods and indicates in the PIN Join request that it is capable of functioning as a PIN Gateway.

question_25173.question: What should the target NG-RAN node do if the HANDOVER REQUEST message contains the Data Forwarding Not Possible IE associated with a given PDU session within the Handover Request Transfer IE set to "data forwarding not possible"?
question_25173.ground_truth: The target NG-RAN node may not include the DL Forwarding UP TNL Information IE and for intra-system handover the Data Forwarding Response DRB List IE within the Handover Request Acknowledge Transfer IE for that PDU session in the HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message.

question_25174.question: What algorithm is required for providing confidentiality and data authentication of SRTP packets in TF RFC 7714?
question_25174.ground_truth: The AEAD_AES_128_GCM algorithm is required for providing confidentiality and data authentication of SRTP packets in TF RFC 7714.

question_25175.question: What is the purpose of the Average Data Rate (ADR) control in the EVS VBR mode?
question_25175.ground_truth: The purpose of the ADR control in the EVS VBR mode is to ensure the compliance of ADR requirements under a variety of language and noise type mix. It achieves this by adjusting the thresholds and frame selection patterns.

question_25177.question: How is the partial redundancy technology implemented in the EVS channel aware mode?
question_25177.ground_truth: The partial redundancy technology in EVS channel aware mode transmits partial copies of the current frame along with a future frame, allowing for retrieval of the partial copy from the jitter buffer in the event of loss of the current frame.

question_25178.question: What is the window size from the MS to the IWF (SS) called in the test?

question_25179.question: What is the purpose of the <emergency-ind> element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body in the outgoing SIP INVITE request?
question_25179.ground_truth: The <emergency-ind> element is used to indicate whether the call is an emergency or not. It is set to a value of "true" if the call is an emergency, and to a value of "false" otherwise.

question_25180.question: What is the purpose of the Origination-Id header field in 3GPP TS 24.229?
question_25180.ground_truth: The Origination-Id header field in 3GPP TS 24.229 is used to identify the node that performed the identity attestation of an originating user or to identify the source of a request.

question_25183.question: In the CAMEL-CallResult choice, what is the meaning of legActive when its default value is TRUE?
question_25183.ground_truth: It indicates that the leg of the call is still active.

question_25185.question: What information is included in a TWAG-CDR when it is used to collect charging information related to the IP-CAN bearer data information?
question_25185.ground_truth: The TWAG-CDR includes details such as Record Type, Served IMSI, Sequence Number etc. and both the traffic data and FBC specific charging data.

question_25186.question: When ProSe Direct Discovery operation is on a non-serving carrier, in what circumstances is the UE allowed interruptions to serving cells?
question_25186.ground_truth: When ProSe Direct Discovery is on a non-serving carrier, and when no request for transmission and/or reception gaps is signalled by the UE, interruptions to serving cell(s) is allowed with up to probability of missed ACK/NACK. Furthermore, when ProSe Direct Discovery is on more than one non-serving carrier, and no request for transmission and/or reception gaps is signalled by the UE, the aggregate interruptions to serving cells(s) are allowed with up to probability of missed ACK/NACK with N non-serving carriers. The interruptions are for both uplink and downlink of PCell and any activated SCell. The interruptions may occur while switching a receiver chain ON/OFF for ProSe Direct Discovery if the UE has a dedicated receiver chain for discovery, and/or while switching a transmitter chain ON/OFF for ProSe Direct Discovery transmissions on a non-serving carrier, and if the UE has a dedicated transmitted chain for discovery.

question_25190.question: What should the P-GW do with packets received for a suspended UE?
question_25190.ground_truth: The P-GW should discard packets if received for the suspended UE.

question_25192.question: What are the two functions that the MCPTT application server interacts with in addition to clients on the UE?
question_25192.ground_truth: The two functions that the MCPTT application server interacts with in addition to clients on the UE are other MCPTT application servers and other entities, specifically Dispatch Console and legacy LMR systems.

question_25193.question: What is the main issue with using a JSON Merge Patch to replace resources with descendants?
question_25193.ground_truth: The main issue is that it goes against the principle of PATCH by requiring the inclusion of the representations of all descendant resources, leading to inefficiency.

question_25195.question: What should the UE do if the EMM cause value received is #12, #13, or #15 and the UE is in its HPLMN or EHPLMN?
question_25195.ground_truth: If the EMM cause value received is #12, #13, or #15 and the UE is in its HPLMN or EHPLMN, the UE should proceed as specified in clauses 5.5.1, 5.5.3, and 5.6.1 and delete any GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list, and eKSI. Additionally, the UE should reset the attach attempt counter, tracking area updating attempt counter, or service request attempt counter, if applicable.

question_25196.question: What is the 5% UL Average-UPT gain for semi-static SBFD at low load level with a small packet size, SBFD Alt 4, and 40dBm BS transmission power?

question_25197.question: Which security functions are shared between ISIM and USIM applications in the UE?
question_25197.ground_truth: Only the sequence number checking mechanism, the algorithm, or the algorithm and sequence number checking mechanism can be shared between ISIM and USIM applications.

question_25198.question: What actions can the PCF perform based on the "User Data Congestion" statistics or predictions?
question_25198.ground_truth: The PCF may perform SM Policy Association modifications to update policies in the SMF for the PDU sessions handling traffic from those applications. Alternatively, the PCF may update URSP on Network Slice Selection Policy for the associated UEs, based on the "Data Volume Dispersion" analytics.

question_25199.question: What is the impact of the new type of SUPI/SUCI on existing 5GC nodes?
question_25199.ground_truth: The new type of SUPI/SUCI needs to be supported in AMF, SMF, PCF, UDM, AUSF, UDR, NWDAF and CHF.

question_25201.question: What factors does the AUSF selection function in AUSF NF consumers or in SCP consider when available in the 5G Core network?
question_25201.ground_truth: When available, the AUSF selection function in AUSF NF consumers or in SCP considers the Home Network Identifier (e.g. MNC and MCC, realm) of SUCI/SUPI, the selected NID (provided by the NG-RAN), Routing Indicator, and optionally Home Network Public Key identifier for AUSF selection. This is applicable to both 3GPP access and non-3GPP access.

question_25203.question: What is the response from the Node B if it cannot perform the cell synchronization adjustment as requested in the CELL SYNCHRONISATION ADJUSTMENT REQUEST message due to hardware failure or other problems?
question_25203.ground_truth: CELL SYNCHRONISATION ADJUSTMENT FAILURE with a radio network layer cause of "Cell Synchronisation Adjustment not supported" or "Power level not supported" or miscellaneous cause of "O&M Intervention" or "HW failure."

question_25205.question: What is the role of the AS protocol stack for NR sidelink communication?
question_25205.ground_truth: The AS protocol stack for NR sidelink communication consists of SDAP, PDCP, RLC, MAC, and the physical layer for the user plane in the PC5 interface. For the control plane, there are separate stacks for SCCH for RRC, PC-S, and SBCCH in the PC5 interface.

question_25207.question: What is the payload type for CS Data service with no redundancy in 3GPP TS 48.103?
question_25207.ground_truth: The specific payload type value for CS Data service with no redundancy in 3GPP TS 48.103 is 120.

question_25209.question: What should be included in the media-level section for MCPTT speech in the SDP offer from the MCPTT client?
question_25209.ground_truth: The media-level section for MCPTT speech in the SDP offer from the MCPTT client should include the "m=" field with audio, port number for MCPTT speech of the MCPTT group, "proto" field set to "RTP/AVP" and "fmt" portion set indicating RTP payload type numbers, "i=" field with the session description portion set to "speech", and "a=rtpmap:" attribute indicating codec(s) and media parameters of the MCPTT speech.

question_25210.question: When should the expiration time be set in the served MCData user information entry?
question_25210.ground_truth: The expiration time should be set as determined by local policy in the served MCData user information entry.

question_25213.question: What are some of the capabilities of the GSM MS-BSS interface in addition to the multiservice capability?
question_25213.ground_truth: Some of the capabilities of the GSM MS-BSS interface in addition to the multiservice capability include support for multidrop and other multiple terminal arrangements, choice of information bit rate and switching mode, and capability for compatibility checking.

question_25214.question: What is the maximum message size that the E-UTRAN can support for V2X messages in the 3GPP standard?
question_25214.ground_truth: The E-UTRAN can support a message size of 50-300 Bytes, which can be up to 1200 Bytes.

question_25215.question: What is the consequence of failing to decode the BSIC of a GSM BCCH carrier within the specified time limit?
question_25215.ground_truth: If the UE fails to decode the BSIC of a GSM BCCH carrier within the time limit, it shall abort the BSIC identification attempts for that carrier and move on to the next carrier in signal strength order.

question_25216.question: Where does the information about the mapping of PRACH or CPRACH on the physical channel come from?
question_25216.ground_truth: A predefined fixed part of the multiframe structure for PDCH can be used as PRACH or CPRACH only, and the information about the mapping on the physical channel is broadcast on PBCCH or CPBCCH.

question_25218.question: What is the purpose of the Iu UP protocol in the UTRAN?
question_25218.ground_truth: The Iu UP protocol is used in the UTRAN to transfer user data for all Iu UP specific functions, except for initializing the RAB.

question_25219.question: What action should the controlling MCVideo function take if the MCVideo user identified by the MCVideo ID in the SIP INVITE request is not affiliated with the MCVideo group identified by the group identity in the SIP INVITE request?
question_25219.ground_truth: If the MCVideo user is not affiliated with the MCVideo group, the controlling MCVideo function should check if the user is eligible to be implicitly affiliated with the MCVideo chat group. If not, the function should reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response with the warning text set to "120 user is not affiliated to this group."

question_25220.question: What is the purpose of the 'N' bit in the PDCP header?
question_25220.ground_truth: The 'N' bit in the PDCP header is used to indicate whether the transmitted data is the 'first message' or not in the PDCP header. The value of 0 is set when the message is a 'first message', and the value of 1 is set when the message is a 'next message' i.e. not a 'first message'.

question_25221.question: What action does the UE take when it receives an ATTACH REJECT message from the network, if the UE is in the state EMM-REGISTERED?
question_25221.ground_truth: The UE stops timer T3410, enters state EMM-DEREGISTERED and takes corresponding actions based on the reject cause value received.

question_25222.question: What is the insertion loss in front of the LNA predominated by?
question_25222.ground_truth: The insertion loss in front of the LNA is predominated by the receive filter.

question_25225.question: What is the measurement reporting delay defined as?
question_25225.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between an event that will trigger a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface.

question_25226.question: In the context of TS 38.331, clause 5.5.5, what triggers the measurement reporting procedure, and what subsequent actions does the UE take after triggering the procedure?
question_25226.ground_truth: The measurement reporting procedure, as specified in TS 38.331, clause 5.5.5, is triggered for the measId for which the reporting event was met. The UE then sets the measResults within the MeasurementReport message, including the measurement identity that triggered the measurement report, the relevant serving cells, and, if applicable, neighboring cells. The UE then initiates the measurement reporting procedure, as specified in 5.5.5.

question_25227.question: What is the purpose of user-to-USIM authentication in user domain security?
question_25227.ground_truth: The purpose of user-to-USIM authentication in user domain security is to restrict access to the USIM to an authorized user.

question_25228.question: What is MIKEY used for in the context of ProSe Key Management Function and UE communication?
question_25228.ground_truth: MIKEY is used to transport the PSDKs from the ProSe Key Management Function to the UE and is used exactly as in subclause 6.2.3.3.2.3, except that the IDi payload is formed from the Key Type ID || PSDK ID @ FQDN of the ProSe Key Management Function at the PKMF, and an all-zero PSDK ID is used to trigger the UE to send a Key Request message.

question_25229.question: What is the aim of the solution described in section 7.18.1?
question_25229.ground_truth: The aim of the solution described in section 7.18.1 is to enable the management and provision of HD map dynamic information for the V2X application specific client on V2X UE. The solution consists of various mechanisms for tracking and managing UE location information.

question_25230.question: What is the potential data rate for current flow collection in the urban area scenario?
question_25230.ground_truth: The potential data rate for current flow collection in the urban area scenario is 640 Mbit/s.

question_25231.question: What does a transmission participant need to do after receiving a Transmission Granted message from the transmission control server?
question_25231.ground_truth: The transmission participant should store the SSRC of the granted transmission participant, provide Transmission granted notification to the user, stop timer T100 (Transmission Request), and enter the 'U: has permission to transmit' state.

question_25232.question: What is the field "cellReservedForFutureUse" indicated for in SIB1 message, and how is it applied across multiple PLMNs or NPNs?
question_25232.ground_truth: The field "cellReservedForFutureUse" is indicated in SIB1 message and is common for all PLMNs and NPNs in case of multiple PLMNs or NPNs indicated in SIB1.

question_25235.question: What is the value of FC used for in the KDF input S?
question_25235.ground_truth: FC is used as a constant value set to 0xYY in the input S for the KDF.

question_25236.question: What information should a UE provide in the InDeviceCoexIndication message if there is a supported UL CA combination affected by IDC problems?
question_25236.ground_truth: The UE should include the "victimSystemType" in "ul-CA-AssistanceInfo" and provide the affected carrier frequencies or combinations if the UE sets "victimSystemType" to "wlan" or "Bluetooth".

question_25237.question: What is the purpose of preparing a UE context including a mapped EPS security context in a handover procedure from 5GS to EPC?
question_25237.ground_truth: The purpose is to enable interworking between LTE and 5G networks, allowing the UE to access LTE services while maintaining its current 5G security context, which can be either a mapped or native security context.

question_25238.question: What is one of the pre-conditions for dynamic platoon formation in a transportation system?
question_25238.ground_truth: All the platoon members are within the communication range with its direct neighbor which also is the platoon member.

question_25239.question: What is the process known as when an FRMCS User logs into the system?
question_25239.ground_truth: The process involves the FRMCS User starting the FRMCS Application on their UE, which then logs in to the FRMCS System. The FRMCS Equipment is identified, and the FRMCS User becomes reachable via their FRMCS User Identity.

question_25240.question: What is the requirement for the UE to meet the in-band blocking requirements of E-UTRA?
question_25240.ground_truth: The UE shall meet the requirements specified in subclause 7.6.1.1 for each component carrier while all downlink carriers are active.

question_25241.question: What is the difference between the three versions of a document as per 3GPP?
question_25241.ground_truth: The three versions of a document as per 3GPP are version x.0.0, which represents a TSG-level document presented for information; version x.y.0, which represents a TSG-level document presented for approval; and version x.y.z, which represents a TSG-approved document under change control, with y indicating technical enhancements, corrections, or updates, and z indicating editorial-only changes.

question_25242.question: What is the impact of this solution on roaming scenarios?
question_25242.ground_truth: The solution allows for simultaneous access to network slices in roaming scenarios, but the serving PLMN must ensure there are no conflicts with the HPLMN and VPLMN constraints on simultaneous use of network slices.

question_25243.question: What should the Node B use as the maximum DL power for each timeslot within a DSCH type CCTrCH when the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message includes the CCTrCH Maximum DL Transmission Power IE?
question_25243.ground_truth: The Node B should use the CCTrCH Maximum DL Transmission Power IE as the maximum DL power for each timeslot within a DSCH type CCTrCH when the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message includes the CCTrCH Maximum DL Transmission Power IE.

question_25244.question: What are the parameters included in UNITDATA indication primitives for sending and receiving data?
question_25244.ground_truth: The parameters include the Called and Calling Addresses, Sequence Control, Return Option, and User Data, with addressing parameters always mandatory.

question_25245.question: What should the MCPTT client do in the "S4: pending user action without confirm indication" state when it receives an indication from the MCPTT user to accept the incoming group call?
question_25245.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should establish a media session based on the stored SDP body of the call, start floor control as a terminating floor participant, generate a GROUP CALL ACCEPT message as specified in subclause 15.1.4, start timer TFG6 with value as specified in subclause 10.2.2.4.1.2, start timer TFG2 with value as specified in subclause 10.2.2.4.1.1.1, and enter the "S3: part of ongoing call" state.

question_25246.question: What is the bottleneck channel for the reference NR UE in the Urban scenario at 4 GHz with a downlink power spectrum density (PSD) of 33 dBm/MHz?
question_25246.ground_truth: PUSCH is the bottleneck channel for the reference NR UE in the Urban scenario at 4 GHz with a downlink power spectrum density (PSD) of 33 dBm/MHz.

question_25247.question: What triggers LCS to provide enhanced geographic capabilities for UE locations?
question_25247.ground_truth: LCS provides enhanced geographic capabilities for UE locations when IA is provisioned.

question_25248.question: What are the potential requirements for the sidelink positioning measurement report?
question_25248.ground_truth: The potential requirements for the sidelink positioning measurement report include one or more sidelink positioning measurements, associated timestamps and quality metrics, and UE identification information. The time domain behavior can be one-shot, triggered, aperiodic, semi-persistent, or periodic.

question_25249.question: What is the procedure for the UE to start monitoring for PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message?
question_25249.ground_truth: When the UE is triggered by an upper layer application to monitor proximity of other UEs in a discovery group, and if the UE is authorized to perform the monitoring UE procedure for group member discovery, it shall instruct the lower layers to start monitoring for PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message. The UE uses the group identifier as the input to the SHA-256 hashing algorithm and uses the 24 least significant bits of the 256 bits of the output as the destination layer-2 ID.

question_25250.question: What is the primary condition to keep UE uplink time alignment?
question_25250.ground_truth: UE needs to be provided at least once every 500ms with new Timing Advance Command MAC control element to restart the Time alignment timer.

question_25252.question: What is the command line option to set Lmax in the loudness tool?

question_25253.question: What is the Media Type for identifying documents following the filter description schema?

question_25255.question: How does the NRM server collect 5GS TSN Bridge information?
question_25255.ground_truth: The NRM server collects 5GS TSN Bridge information by interacting with the 5GS via the N5 reference point and storing the binding relationship between 5GS Bridge ID, MAC address of the DS-TT Ethernet port, and 5GS bridge delay.

question_25256.question: What is the purpose of the "Foreword" section in the document?
question_25256.ground_truth: The "Foreword" section explains the version numbering system and the meanings of the modal verbs used in the document.

question_25258.question: What is the difference between unintentional and intentional RFI in the context of GNSS?
question_25258.ground_truth: Unintentional RFI is caused by nearby radio devices broadcasting at a frequency that impacts GNSS signals, while intentional RFI is the deliberate action of blocking GNSS signal reception by broadcasting a strong signal on GNSS frequencies.

question_25260.question: What is the composition of IMEI as per the 3GPP TS 23.003?
question_25260.ground_truth: The IMEI is composed in such a way that each individual mobile station equipment can be separately identified and it directly or indirectly contains all necessary information for the network operator to make relations through its administrative system to trace the equipment to its origin of production.

question_25261.question: What should the MCVideo client do if it receives a SIP 4xx, 5xx, or 6xx response to the SIP MESSAGE request for binding a functional alias with the MCVideo group(s) for the MCVideo user?
question_25261.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should inform the MCVideo user of the unsuccessful binding, possibly taking into account Warning header information for the failure reason.

question_25262.question: What optional attribute can be included in the PolicyAssociation data type response body for the H-PCF as service producer communicating with the V-PCF?
question_25262.ground_truth: UE policy, encoded as the "uePolicy" attribute.

question_25263.question: What SNR levels are needed for 256QAM to reach throughput saturation for MCS21 and MCS23 at 29GHz?
question_25263.ground_truth: An SNR level of 21dB is needed for MCS21, and an SNR level of 28dB is needed for MCS23.

question_25264.question: In what situation is the APDC header pushed to APDC header memory in this solution?
question_25264.ground_truth: The APDC header is pushed to APDC header memory if the APDC header length is less than or equal to APDCHeaderMemorySize.

question_25265.question: In the Proxy Binding Ack, what information does the PDN GW reply with when acknowledging the Proxy Binding Update message for the handover of PDN connections to non-3GPP access?
question_25265.ground_truth: The PDN GW replies with the same IP address and/or prefix that was assigned to the UE earlier in the Proxy Binding Ack.

question_25266.question: Which messages are relevant to the formats and codes listed in ITU-T Recommendation Q.704, clause 15?
question_25266.ground_truth: The formats and codes listed are relevant to the messages that are required, i.e. those not excluded in the rest of the recommendation.

question_25267.question: What should the MS do if the procedures tested in 26.9.6 are not correctly implemented, particularly for emergency calls?
question_25267.ground_truth: Establishment, maintenance, and clearing of connections might fail.

question_25269.question: In the context of the Key agreement TLV, what does a Length value of 1 signify?
question_25269.ground_truth: A Length value of 1 signifies that the current keyset agreed for the specified KEY ID should be used.

question_25272.question: What is Proposal-4 recommending for TS 33.210?
