question_25272.ground_truth: Proposal-4 recommends extending TS 33.210 to include protection of multicast traffic for particular interfaces/usages and adding a specific chapter(s) on the support of security solutions for protecting Multicast data.

question_25273.question: What is the expected message content when invoking the GetPassword operation for BAIC activation?
question_25273.ground_truth: The expected message content includes the invoke of the GetPassword operation requiring the current password for verification.

question_25275.question: What is the expected response from the conference focus to an REFER request received from a user requesting to invite another user to a conference?
question_25275.ground_truth: The conference focus shall send a final response in accordance with RFC 3515, generate an INVITE request to invite the referred user, and include a Referred-By header if one was included in the REFER request.

question_25276.question: What is the length of the 5GS tracking area identity information element?
question_25276.ground_truth: The 5GS tracking area identity information element has a length of 7 octets.

question_25277.question: What is an eNB that has the capability of IOPS mode operation called?

question_25280.question: What should the UE do if the security check is not successful and the UE is in automatic network selection mode?
question_25280.ground_truth: The UE shall wait until it moves to idle mode or 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication before attempting to obtain service on a higher priority PLMN.

question_25281.question: What happens to the P-Preferred-Identity header field if the identity is not part of the implicit registration set?
question_25281.ground_truth: The P-Preferred-Identity header field will be removed and the P-CSCF will provide a default identity in the P-Asserted-Identity header field.

question_25282.question: What is the P2 puncturing pattern for the DBC-450 code?
question_25282.ground_truth: The P2 puncturing pattern is determined by the CPS values in the DBC-450 code, with patterns defined in 3GPP TS 44.060.

question_25283.question: What should the UE do if it is in a non-allowed area and the uplink signalling pending is to indicate a change of 3GPP PS data off UE status for a PDU session?
question_25283.ground_truth: The UE should set the service type IE in the SERVICE REQUEST message to "elevated signalling" and not include the Uplink data status IE in the SERVICE REQUEST message even if it has active always-on PDU sessions associated with the access type over which the SERVICE REQUEST message is sent.

question_25284.question: What should a UE do if it receives ESM cause value #66 and the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message was sent standalone, the Back-off timer value IE is not included, and either the Re-attempt indicator IE is not included or it is included and indicates that re-attempt in an equivalent PLMN is allowed?
question_25284.ground_truth: The UE should not send another PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message for the same APN in the current PLMN in S1 mode until the UE is switched off or the USIM is removed.

question_25285.question: What should the UE do if it supports emergency service and the network only supports transparent single-connection mode?
question_25285.ground_truth: The UE should abort the authentication if it supports emergency service and the network only supports transparent single-connection mode.

question_25286.question: What is the significance of UL Outer Loop Power Control in the Uplink Power Control functions, and how is it related to E-DCH connections?
question_25286.ground_truth: UL Outer Loop Power Control plays a crucial role in Uplink Power Control functions by setting the target quality for UL Inner Loop Power Control, and it receives the number of HARQ retransmissions as input in the case of E-DCH connections.

question_25287.question: What should the Mobile Station do when it receives a PACKET PAGING REQUEST message?
question_25287.ground_truth: The MS returns to packet idle mode and initiates the establishment of a CS connection.

question_25288.question: What actions are taken when the UE returns to the LADN service area and has downlink CIoT user data pending after being moved out of the LADN service area?
question_25288.ground_truth: The SMF shall initiate the CIoT user data via the control plane transfer to the UE and re-establish the user-plane resources for the PDU session for LADN.

question_25289.question: What was the capacity performance of FR1, Dense Urban, DL, with VR/AR, 30Mbps, 60FPS, 10ms PDB, with MU-MIMO, when using Frame Level Integrated Transmission (FLIT) scheduler?
question_25289.ground_truth: The capacity performance was 14 UEs per cell.

question_25290.question: What should the CTS-FP do when it receives a message not compatible with the protocol state, and the message is not one of the messages listed in subclause 8.5.3 b), c), d), or e)?
question_25290.ground_truth: The CTS-FP should either try to treat the message or ignore the message and return a status message with cause #96.

question_25291.question: Which information does the AMF provide to the NRF when trying to discover SMF instances for managing the PDU session?

question_25293.question: What information is included in the FORWARD SRNS CONTEXT message for each RAB?
question_25293.ground_truth: For each RAB, the FORWARD SRNS CONTEXT message includes the RAB ID IE, the sequence number for the next downlink GTP-PDU to be sent to the UE (DL GTP-PDU Sequence Number IE), the sequence number for the next uplink GTP-PDU to be tunnelled to the GGSN (UL GTP-PDU Sequence Number IE), the radio interface sequence number (PDCP) of the next uplink N-PDU expected from the UE (UL N-PDU Sequence Number IE), and the radio interface sequence number (PDCP) of the next downlink N-PDU that would have been sent to the UE by a source system (DL N-PDU Sequence Number IE).

question_25299.question: What type of electromagnetic field disturbance is assessed in section 9.2 of the document?
question_25299.ground_truth: A radio frequency electromagnetic field disturbance at the enclosure.

question_25300.question: What does the abbreviation "5GC" in the document stand for?

question_25301.question: What action will the network take if the mobile station has indicated support of EMM combined procedures in MS network capability and the network supports CS Fallback?
question_25301.ground_truth: The network will indicate in the Update result IE in the ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message that ISR is not activated.

question_25302.question: What are the requirements for the overall availability of the communications network in this use case?
question_25302.ground_truth: The overall availability of the communications network must be at least five nines, and the total amount of planned and unplanned downtime should not be more than 5,26 minutes per year.

question_25305.question: What action does B take when an incoming call from C is received while connected to A?
question_25305.ground_truth: B rejects the incoming call from C.

question_25306.question: How are the 8 most significant bits of the 5GS <AMF Region ID> mapped to the E-UTRAN <MME Group ID>?
question_25306.ground_truth: The 8 most significant bits of the 5GS <AMF Region ID> are mapped to the bits 15 and down to bit 8 of the E-UTRAN <MME Group ID>.

question_25308.question: What action should the network take if the SM cause value is not #26 "insufficient resources" and the Back-off timer value IE is included?
question_25308.ground_truth: The network may include the Re-attempt indicator IE to indicate whether the MS is allowed to attempt a bearer resource modification procedure in the PLMN for the same APN in S1 mode, and whether another attempt in A/Gb and Iu mode or in S1 mode is allowed in an equivalent PLMN.

question_25309.question: What does the abbreviation DeNB stand for in the document?

question_25310.question: What are the requirements for Ranging-based services in the 5G system?
question_25310.ground_truth: The 5G system shall be able to support a UE to discover other UEs supporting ranging, authorize ranging, protect user privacy, authorize mutual ranging, provide energy efficient UE ranging operation, and securely identify other ranging capable UEs.

question_25311.question: How is the energy consumption of a virtual compute resource instance estimated in Release 17?
question_25311.ground_truth: The energy consumption of a virtual compute resource instance X is estimated as a proportion of the energy consumption of the NFVI node on which the virtual compute resource instance X runs, by dividing the vCPU mean usage of the virtual compute resource instance X, by the sum of the vCPU mean usage of all virtual compute resource instances running on the same NFVI Node as X, during the same observation period.

question_25313.question: How does the SMF control packet processing functions in each UPF?
question_25313.ground_truth: The SMF controls packet processing functions in each UPF by provisioning packet processing rules (PDR/FAR/QER/URR) to the UPF over N4 using the existing PFCP protocol.

question_25315.question: What should be done to activate multicast media bearers for eMBMS capable UEs?
question_25315.ground_truth: The MC service server should use the Activate MBMS Bearer procedure specified in 3GPP TS 23.468, with the MC service server performing the GCS AS function, to activate multicast media bearers for eMBMS capable UEs.

question_25316.question: What is the potential impact on base station related RRM measurement requirements if the duration of each measurement on time-dilated UMTS carrier is kept the same as the existing UMTS?
question_25316.ground_truth: A number of base station related RRM measurement requirements defined in TS 25.133 are expected to be affected, including received total wideband power, signal-to-interference ratio (SIR), transmitted carrier power, transmitted code power, and others.

question_25317.question: What key issues were identified for optimizing connectivity between MC systems?
question_25317.ground_truth: The key issues include studying and describing the existing mechanism of routing of media and signalling between MC systems and investigating optimizations to improve media and signalling routing between MC service systems.

question_25318.question: What is the minimum recommended timer value for the fallback to speech procedure in the call setup procedure?
question_25318.ground_truth: The recommended minimum timer value is 3 seconds for the fallback to speech procedure in the call setup procedure.

question_25322.question: What should the UE do when lwip-DL-Aggregation is set to TRUE for a DRB identity using lwip-WLAN-AC?
question_25322.ground_truth: The UE should indicate to higher layers to apply decoding of LWIPEP header with GRE sequence number for both LTE and WLAN DL reception for the DRB associated with the drb-Identity.

question_25323.question: What is the message sent by the AF to terminate the active Rx session?
question_25323.ground_truth: The AF sends a Diameter ASR requesting the termination of the Rx session to the BSF (proxy).

question_25326.question: What information should the MCData client include in the P-Preferred-Service header field when generating a SIP INVITE message?
question_25326.ground_truth: The MCData client should include the ICSI value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.sds" in the P-Preferred-Service header field when generating a SIP INVITE message.

question_25327.question: What is the effect of the HPLMN on forwarded-to numbers when TIF-CSI is provided?
question_25327.ground_truth: The HPLMN shall not check the forwarded-to number and only the category Barring of registration of any call forwarded-to number will take effect.

question_25328.question: What are the high level functions specified in 3GPP~TS~23.287 that have V2X application layer impact?
question_25328.ground_truth: The high level functions specified in 3GPP~TS~23.287 that have V2X application layer impact are authorization and provisioning for V2X communications over PC5 and Uu reference points, V2X message transmission/reception over PC5 or Uu reference points, V2X Application Server discovery, QoS handling for V2X communication over PC5 and Uu reference points, and interworking between EPS V2X and 5GS V2X.

question_25329.question: What is the main difference between on-network communication and off-network only communication?
question_25329.ground_truth: On-network communication uses bearer services provided by the FRMCS land mobile network, while off-network only communication relies on a dedicated radio bearer service for proximity communication.

question_25330.question: What is the purpose of the activation of an emergency group call by a user, in regards to the emergency state?
question_25330.ground_truth: Every transmission on this group by that user is an emergency group call transmission until the emergency state is cancelled at the radio/UE.

question_25332.question: When the priority of the response message needs to have a different value than the request, what action should a server take?
question_25332.ground_truth: A server should include a "3gpp-Sbi-Message-Priority" header in the response message which value is set to the response required priority level.

question_25334.question: What mechanism does the network need to provide in order to reduce load over the RAN in case of congestion?
question_25334.ground_truth: The network needs to provide traffic compression using common compression/transcoding mechanisms.

question_25335.question: What is the maximum number of LTE outlying subcarriers when the LTE carrier is located at subcarrier index 7 within a NR RB in the downlink direction when the NR subcarrier spacing is 15kHz?
question_25335.ground_truth: The maximum number of outlying subcarriers is 4.

question_25336.question: What should the MCS UE do if there are multiple partner MC systems that meet the required conditions for automatic partner MC system selection?
question_25336.ground_truth: The MCS UE will select a partner MC system among the available options in an implementation-specific way.

question_25337.question: In the 'O: has no permission' state, what should the floor participant do when it receives RTP media and there is no stored SSRC of the current floor arbitrator?
question_25337.ground_truth: The floor participant requests the MCPTT client to render the received RTP media packets, sets the stored SSRC of the current floor arbitrator to the SSRC of the RTP media packet, clears the stored SSRC of the candidate arbitrator, if any, restarts timer T203 (End of RTP media), and remains in the 'O: has no permission' state.

question_25338.question: What is the purpose of Solution 1 for SGW-U partial failure?
question_25338.ground_truth: The purpose of Solution 1 for SGW-U partial failure is to efficiently delete of the affected user plane resource if there is a partial failure on the other node (SGW-C) and to mark all the retrieved Sx Sessions to be restored.

question_25339.question: What information is used to forward the identities between the GSM-R system and the FRMCS system?
question_25339.ground_truth: The information from the Role management and presence application is used to forward the identities between the GSM-R system and the FRMCS system.

question_25341.question: What is the term "thin time" referred to in the context of 3GPP TS 36.133?
question_25341.ground_truth: In the context of 3GPP TS 36.133, "thin time" is a time period used in the evaluation of UTRA TDD cells for inter-RAT cell re-selection.

question_25342.question: What is able to do the PCF with events received from the SMF, the NEF, the AF, and the OCS?
question_25342.ground_truth: The PCF is able to evaluate operator policies that are triggered by events received from the SMF, the NEF, the AF, and the OCS.

question_25344.question: What is the procedure to switch on eNB/cell or resume the usage of corresponding physical resources in order to satisfy increasing service/QoS requests?

question_25345.question: What is the name of the matrix that contains N sequences,each with K complex coefficients, in the context of the sequence design problem?

question_25346.question: What performance metric is evaluated for RTP-based streaming delivery in UTRAN?
question_25346.ground_truth: Maximum supported Media Rate (kbit/s) for Mean Time Between FEC Block Loss of 1 hour

question_25347.question: What should the UE do when it stops discoveree operation and the lower layers indicate that a discovery indication is required to be sent to the eNodeB?
question_25347.ground_truth: The UE should trigger the corresponding procedure in lower layers as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331 if it stops discoveree operation and the lower layers indicate that a discovery indication is required to be sent to the eNodeB in case of E-UTRA-based restricted ProSe direct discovery model B discoveree operation and the UE is in EMM-CONNECTED mode.

question_25348.question: What is the maximum RRC procedure delay for handover interruption time?
question_25348.ground_truth: TRRC is the maximum RRC procedure delay defined in TS36.331, and represents the delay in receiving the handover command by the UE to start the transmission of the new uplink PRACH channel in the target cell.

question_25351.question: What should the UE do if it has no geographical location information available?
question_25351.ground_truth: The UE should not include any geographical location information in the INVITE request if it has no geographical location information available.

question_25353.question: What is the input to the KDF function during the signature generation process?
question_25353.ground_truth: The input to the KDF function during the signature generation process is a point Q.

question_25354.question: Which command type is utilized in the SEND SS facility tests in section 27.22.4.11.4.9?

question_25355.question: What is the purpose of the first text in the example sequence diagram for network initiated mobile originating call using the option assignment after A and B party alerting?
question_25355.ground_truth: The first text in the example sequence diagram for network initiated mobile originating call using the option assignment after A and B party alerting is a description of the case with backward bearer establishment being considered.

question_25356.question: Which enumeration defines the enumerated types of UUAA-MM status?
question_25356.ground_truth: UuaaMmStatus defines the enumerated types of UUAA-MM status.

question_25357.question: What is the purpose of the AI/ML support function in NG-RAN?
question_25357.ground_truth: The AI/ML support function in NG-RAN is used to support AI/ML, including the initiation of data collection and the reporting of collected data.

question_25358.question: What is the type of the "traceInformation" field in the RNSAPRelocationParameters sequence?
question_25358.ground_truth: The "traceInformation" field in the RNSAPRelocationParameters sequence is of the type TraceInformation which is optional.

question_25359.question: What is the recommended interval for running the PC service in the Smart Grid?
question_25359.ground_truth: It is recommended to run the PC service in the Smart Grid at intervals shorter than one minute and possibly close to a few seconds.

question_25360.question: What are the requirements for a CR (Change Request) to be approved by the TSG (Technical Specification Group)?
question_25360.ground_truth: A CR may be raised by any individual member and brought to the attention of the responsible Group. It shall relate to a specific version of a specification and a unique (for that specification) reference number shall be allocated. Once approved at TSG level, the Support Team person responsible for the specification shall edit the original specification to incorporate the changes of all CRs approved by the TSG. The new version of the specification shall then be made available on the 3GPP file server. The TSG should approve, reject or postpone a CR in its entirety. Where two or more CRs pertain to the same version of a specification, the responsible Group shall check for potential interaction amongst those CRs. The TSG Secretary shall record the TSG's decisions on each CR in the meeting report and those decisions shall be reflected in the CR database and on the 3GPP portal.

question_25361.question: When should the UE initiate the measurement reporting procedure for event A4?
question_25361.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the measurement reporting procedure for event A4 when the reportType is set to eventTriggered and the leaving condition for this event is fulfilled for one or more of the cells included in the cellsTriggeredList.

question_25362.question: Which types of NR RedCap UE does the test described in section 17.3.2.2.4.2 apply to?
question_25362.ground_truth: The test described in section 17.3.2.2.4.2 applies to all types of NR RedCap UE from Release 17 onwards and supporting 2-step RACH.

question_25363.question: What kind of counters should a UE maintain for access attempts via non-3GPP access?
question_25363.ground_truth: A UE should maintain a list of PLMN-specific attempt counters for non-3GPP access.

question_25365.question: What is the additional delay for the late entry KPI if the first packet of the call within the first received transport block cannot be decoded due to it not being a full header packet?

question_25366.question: What is one challenge for Interactive Cinematic VR in section 5.7.3?
question_25366.ground_truth: Directors lose control over framing and audio effects, as viewers can look anywhere and make story branching decisions.

question_25367.question: What is the role of DIMS in error resilience mechanisms?
question_25367.ground_truth: Among the error resilience mechanisms available in DIMS are priority, periodic random access points, and separation of static and dynamic data. By combining these methods, one can determine if a loss need repair or not, and increase the efficiency of Distributed Random Access Points.

question_25369.question: What are the minimum performance requirements for spurious emissions in the sub-band 807-824/852-869 MHz for Band 28?
question_25369.ground_truth: The minimum requirements for spurious emissions towards Band 28 in the sub-band 807-824/852-869 MHz are -32 dBm/MHz @790-803 MHz and -50 dBm/MHz @748-790 MHz.

question_25370.question: How is the reporting accuracy of CQI under MIMO single stream conditions determined?
question_25370.ground_truth: The reporting accuracy of CQI under MIMO single stream conditions is determined by the BLER performance when transmitting with a transport format indicated by the reported CQI median determined over all single transport block Type A CQI reports and all Type B CQI reports that were reported together with PCI reports matching the precoding vector embedded in the propagation channel.

question_25371.question: What are the four possible services or service preferences in 3GPP TS 24.008?
question_25371.ground_truth: The four possible services or service preferences are: Packet Domain, circuit switched, Packet Domain preferred (use circuit switched if GPRS not available), and circuit switched preferred (use Packet Domain if circuit switched not available).

question_25374.question: What action should an MS (Mobile Station) perform when it receives a paging request with IMSI as the identifier for PS (Packet Switched) services?
question_25374.ground_truth: The MS should perform a new GPRS attach and re-activate PDP contexts.

question_25375.question: How can digital wallets be used in the context of mobile metaverse services?
question_25375.ground_truth: Digital wallets can be used in mobile metaverse services as a type of digital asset container that securely stores digital credentials, such as payment information, loyalty cards, tickets, and other digital assets, allowing users to make electronic transactions conveniently and securely.

question_25377.question: What is the Maximum Data Burst Volume (MDBV) associated with in 5G?
question_25377.ground_truth: Each GBR QoS Flow with Delay-critical resource type shall be associated with a Maximum Data Burst Volume (MDBV), which denotes the largest amount of data that the 5G-AN is required to serve within a period of 5G-AN PDB.

question_25378.question: How does the SMF determine the UE belongs to a set of UEs accessing an EAS corresponding to a common DNAI in step 1 of 6.2.3.2.3-1?
question_25378.ground_truth: The SMF determines UE belongs to a set of UEs based on traffic correlation indication and Traffic correlation ID in the PCC rule.

question_25379.question: What message type must be sent as a response when a new password mismatch occurs during the registration of a password for all call restriction services?

question_25380.question: What additional information is provided in the form of a clause in the answer for Question 1?
question_25380.ground_truth: The clause number for the answer to

question_25381.question: What are the GNSS test parameters defined in clause B.4.1 used for in the test?
question_25381.ground_truth: They are used to define the test parameters for GNSS signals, which are emulated and sent to the test UE during the test.

question_25382.question: What are the constraints for multiview stereoscopic 3D video bitstreams in the 3GP-DASH Release 11 multiview stereoscopic 3D video profile?
question_25382.ground_truth: The constraints for multiview stereoscopic 3D video bitstreams include the use of the DASH multiple views scheme, the use of complementary and dependent representations, or the use of SubRepresentation elements for the representation, and specific requirements for the Level Assignment box and Subsegment Index box.

question_25383.question: What happens when FRMCS User A establishes a point to point communication to GSM-R User B in the FRMCS System?
question_25383.ground_truth: GSM-R User B accepts the communication and joins the communication.

question_25384.question: Given a block of N+8 bits, how does the first parity bit b(0) get calculated in the case when an eTFI field is included?
question_25384.ground_truth: It is calculated as that in the two preceding bits, b(-6) and b(-2), which are added after the N bits of the block, resulting in a block of N+8 bits.

question_25385.question: What is the evaluation framework that RAN4 used to define radio link monitoring, beam failure detection and candidate beam detection requirements for IAB-MTs?
question_25385.ground_truth: To define these requirements, RAN4 used the same requirements for Rel-15 UEs as a starting framework.

question_25386.question: What is the PDP type organization value for a default PDP connection activation in Expected Sequence 1.2?
question_25386.ground_truth: The PDP type organization value is as declared by the ME in Expected Sequence 1.2 and 1.3.

question_25387.question: What is the significance of the "visited realm" in the WebRTC IP realm SDP offer?
question_25387.ground_truth: The "visited realm" in the WebRTC IP realm SDP offer helps identify the WebRTC specific realm in the SDP offer. It is used to allocate connection information for the eIMS-AGW and to determine whether both ends are WebRTC users.

question_25391.question: What happens if the AMF rejects the Paging Restriction Information from the UE?
question_25391.ground_truth: The AMF removes any stored Paging Restriction Information from the UE context and discards the UE's requested Paging Restriction Information.

question_25392.question: What conditions must be met for a UE to attempt accessing a PLMN from the list of "PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location"?
question_25392.ground_truth: A UE is allowed to attempt to access a PLMN via satellite E-UTRAN access technology which is part of the list of "PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location" if the current UE location is known, the UE is at a distance from where EMM cause value #78 was received, or if the access is for emergency services.

question_25394.question: How does the target H(e)NB provide feedback to the source H(e)NB for LIPA bearer handling in Rel-11?
question_25394.ground_truth: The target H(e)NB may feed back its support or lack of connectivity to the L-GW to the source side to help the source H(e)NB identify whether the target H(e)NB is a legacy H(e)NB. If the target side is a legacy node, the L-GW@CN address and LIPA bearer information will be ignored, and the source H(e)NB can identify it by sending the L-GW@CN address and LIPA bearer information in Handover Request message as new parameters.

question_25396.question: What is the purpose of the Default SMS handling in the MT SMS TDP descriptions?
question_25396.ground_truth: The default SMS handling indicates whether the MT SMS delivery request shall be rejected or continued in the case of error in the dialogue between the gsmSSF and gsmSCF or between the gprsSSF and gsmSCF.

question_25397.question: What is the definition of the relative accuracy of SS-RSRQ in the inter-frequency case?
question_25397.ground_truth: The relative accuracy of SS-RSRQ in the inter-frequency case is defined as the RSRQ measured from one cell on a frequency compared to the RSRP measured from another cell on a different frequency, with at least one of the two frequencies being under CCA.

question_25400.question: What services does a PLMN offer when acting as the Onboarding Network for the provisioning of SNPN credentials?
question_25400.ground_truth: The PLMN acts as an Onboarding Network, allowing remote provisioning of UEs with SNPN credentials for primary authentication and other information to enable access to the desired SNPN via a PDU Session for DNN and S-NSSAI used for onboarding.

question_25401.question: What must the SS detect during T4 for successful test?
question_25401.ground_truth: For a successful test, the SS must not detect uplink power equal to or higher than -48.2dBm in the uplink subframes scheduled for NPUSCH transmission by the uplink grant during T4.

question_25402.question: What is the required range for Occupied Bandwidth as per test requirement 5.8A.5?
question_25402.ground_truth: The measured Occupied Bandwidth, derived in step 6, shall not exceed 10 MHz as per test requirement 5.8A.5

question_25403.question: What is the corresponding DTX timing on PUCCH by allowed interruption timing by SCell activation/hibernation?
question_25403.ground_truth: When there is an interruption by SCell1 activation causing a DTX reception period on SS, it occurs between subframe n+5 to n+9, with a corresponding DTX reporting on PUCCH (Physical Uplink Control Channel).

question_25405.question: What information is required to build the P-CSCF SIP URI in a format that contains the protected server port number of the security association established from the UE to the P-CSCF, when adding its own SIP URI to the top of the list of Record-Route headers and save the list?
question_25405.ground_truth: If a security association exists, the protected server port number, P-CSCF FQDN that resolves to the IP address of the security association established from the UE to the P-CSCF, and the P-CSCF IP address of the security association established from the UE to the P-CSCF can be used.

question_25406.question: How is the gain computed to shape the excitation in high-band?
question_25406.ground_truth: The gain in high-band is computed based on the signal voicing. If the sub-frame is classified as unvoiced, the gain is computed as in equation (2037). Otherwise, if the sub-frame is not classified as unvoiced, the gain is computed as in equation (2041).

question_25407.question: What is the action taken by the network if an invalid initial message or a CM SERVICE REQUEST message with invalid content is received by the network?
question_25407.ground_truth: A CM SERVICE REJECT message is returned with an appropriate Reject cause indication. The network may also start RR connection release if no other MM connections exist or if the abnormal condition affects the other MM connections.

question_25408.question: What type of traffic is the measurement valid for, in the 5.1.1.15.4 "Number of Idle-state RRC release messages" description?
question_25408.ground_truth: The measurement is valid for packet switched traffic.

question_25409.question: What type of service may only be supported by UEs belonging to a 5G VN group and located in a specific service area in this solution?

question_25411.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP TR 21.905 in the present document?
question_25411.ground_truth: The 3GPP TR 21.905 gives the abbreviations and acronyms used in the present document, providing a common terminology for reference in the document.

question_25412.question: What should the Target UE include in the Refer-To header field when sending a SIP REFER request to transfer a media component?
question_25412.ground_truth: The SIP URI of the Target UE and the SIP URI of the Inter UE Transfer SCC AS URI with the method parameter set to REFER.

question_25413.question: What is the recommended MUX-PDU size in the 3GPP TS 26.114 document?
question_25413.ground_truth: The recommended MUX-PDU size in the 3GPP TS 26.114 document is smaller than in typical GSTN use and is often in the range of 100-200 octets.

question_25415.question: What does the acronym "ALCAP" stand for in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_25415.ground_truth: ALCAP stands for a transport signalling protocol used to setup and tear down transport bearers.

question_25416.question: What is the listen-before-talk mechanism used in LAA systems to coexist fairly with Wi-Fi networks?
question_25416.ground_truth: The listen-before-talk (LBT) procedure in LAA is defined as a mechanism by which an equipment applies a clear channel assessment (CCA) check before using the channel, which determines if a channel is occupied or clear, and is considered to be a vital feature for fair and friendly operation in the unlicensed spectrum in a single global solution framework.

question_25419.question: In the context of the present specification, what does "Diameter race condition handling" mean?
question_25419.ground_truth: Diameter race condition handling refers to the management of simultaneous requests and/or answers between Gx-based applications (Gx, Gxx, Sd, and S9) that may result in mismatched or unexpected sessions.

question_25421.question: In the communication optimized approach 2, what is the role of the MSK?
question_25421.ground_truth: In the communication optimized approach 2, the MSK is a key shared by the N UEs in the multicast group and is used to protect the update of the GK over the multicast channel.

question_25422.question: In the context of the F1AP messages for UE, which type of protocol container contains the UuRLCChannelSetupList?

question_25423.question: What are the two options for the location of the AKRS in this solution?
question_25423.ground_truth: The AKRS can be present in the serving network or in the home network.

question_25424.question: What is the main coding technique used in the EVS primary mode?
question_25424.ground_truth: Linear predictive (LP) coding techniques based upon ACELP (Algebraic Code Excited Linear Prediction)

question_25425.question: What is the function of a Managed Object (MO) in the context of the present document?
question_25425.ground_truth: A Managed Object (MO) is a software object that encapsulates the manageable characteristics and behavior of a particular Network Resource. The MO is an instance of a class defined in a MIM/NRM, called Information Object Class (IOC), which has attributes that provide information and operations that represent behavior relevant for that class. An MO may support the emission of notifications that provide information about an event occurrence within a network resource.

question_25427.question: What should the diverting AS include in a 181 (Call Is Being Forwarded) response when providing the originating user with information about the diverted-to identity?
question_25427.ground_truth: The diverting AS should include a SIP or TEL URI of the diverted-to user into a History-Info header field in a 181 (Call Is Being Forwarded) response message.

question_25428.question: What is the difference between untrusted and trusted N3GPP access procedures?
question_25428.ground_truth: In untrusted N3GPP access, the TNGF/N3IWF cannot provide wireline location information (line ID) over N2, while in trusted N3GPP access, the TNGF/N3IWF can provide wireline location information (line ID) over N2.

question_25430.question: What information does the Analytics Area Type Properties Function (AATPF) store?
question_25430.ground_truth: The AATPF stores the mapping of AOI in sub-areas along with their Sub-Area type IDs, properties descriptions, and the AOI partitioning.

question_25431.question: What is the purpose of the MCVideo session identity in the Contact header field in a SIP provisional response to an initial SIP INVITE request?
question_25431.ground_truth: The MCVideo session identity in the Contact header field is used to identify the MCVideo session at the controlling MCVideo function in the SIP provisional response.

question_25432.question: What is the role of the 5GS/EPS capable MC service UE in inter-system mobility with MC service sessions?
question_25432.ground_truth: The 5GS/EPS capable MC service UE is a user equipment that can support both 5GS and EPS systems and can handle associated PDU sessions and PDN connections during inter-system change.

question_25433.question: What is the term used to describe the combination of channel bandwidths and operating bands for V2X Communication?
question_25433.ground_truth: E-UTRA V2X Communication channel bandwidths and operating band

question_25436.question: What action should an IMS Network Element take if a trigger occurs during session establishment and the session needs to be released?
question_25436.ground_truth: The IMS Network Element should initiate procedures to cancel the session establishment and close the credit-control session, indicating an appropriate cause code upon completion of the cancellation procedure.

question_25437.question: What should a network do if it receives two consecutive AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING FAILURE messages from the MS with the reject cause "synch failure"?
question_25437.ground_truth: The network may terminate the authentication procedure by sending an AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING REJECT message.

question_25439.question: What should the MS do upon successful activation of a dual address PDP type (IPv4v6)?
question_25439.ground_truth: The MS should wait for the Router Advertisement from the network with the IPv6 prefix information or it may send Router Solicitation if necessary.

question_25440.question: What information is sent in the response body when the HSS responds with "201 created" after updating the SMS registration information?
question_25440.ground_truth: Additional information about HSS, such as features supported by HSS.

question_25441.question: What is the expected final state of the Mobile Station in the test procedure described in subclause 26.5.5.1.2.2?
question_25441.ground_truth: The Mobile Station remains in the same state as in the initial conditions after the test procedure.

question_25442.question: What is the name of the state that the UE enters when an AN signalling connection is established between the UE and the AN?

question_25444.question: What should the UE NAS layer provide to the lower layers if the UE performs initial registration for onboarding services in SNPN or is registered for onboarding services in SNPN?
question_25444.ground_truth: The UE NAS layer shall provide the lower layers with an indication that the connection is for onboarding.

question_25446.question: What are the two scenarios considered for integrating unlicensed access in RAN (Rel-13) in the 3GPP system?
question_25446.ground_truth: The two scenarios are: eNB with LTE (primary) + LTE-LAA (secondary) access, and eNB with LTE (primary) + WLAN (secondary) access.

question_25448.question: What is the rationale behind the requirement that LTE AKA SHALL produce keys forming a basis for UP/CP protection?
question_25448.ground_truth: The rationale behind this requirement is that such "key separation" is being discussed as a countermeasure to GSM weaknesses discovered in the last few years.

question_25449.question: What is the behavior of V-PCF in the roaming scenario with VPLMN in 5G?
question_25449.ground_truth: The V-PCF forwards any UE provided PSIs associated with the home PLMN to the H-PCF in the roaming scenario, and provides PSIs and its content only if they correspond to the current UE location in 5G.

question_25450.question: What is the state of the MS (Mobile Station) after storing the FQDN to the serving GANC and its SEGW associated with the AP-ID?
question_25450.ground_truth: The MS is in the state GA-RC REGISTERED.

question_25453.question: What is the role of the PEGC in the 5GS network?
question_25453.ground_truth: The PEGC is responsible for managing the PINs and PINEs in the 5GS network. It establishes and maintains the PDU sessions for the PINs, and ensures the end-to-end QoS requirement for each PINE over PIN indirect communication and over PIN-DN communication.

question_25456.question: What is the difference between an "array element" and an "antenna array" as defined in the document?
question_25456.ground_truth: An "array element" is a subdivision of a passive antenna array, consisting of a single radiating element or a group of radiating elements, with a fixed radiation pattern. An "antenna array" is a group of radiating elements characterized by the geometry and the properties of the array elements.

question_25458.question: What may the transmission control participants do when they receive the transmission idle message?
question_25458.ground_truth: The transmission control participants may notify the MCVideo users about the transmission idle i.e., silent period. Optionally, they may also send an acknowledgement to the transmission control server.

question_25459.question: What should the SCC AS do when it receives a SIP BYE request on the Source Access Leg with the Reason header field containing a SIP 503 (Service Unavailable) response code?
question_25459.ground_truth: If the SCC AS receives an I1 Invite message within a time defined by the operator policy after the SIP BYE request reception, then the SCC AS shall not initiate release of the dialog toward the remote UE, and if the SCC AS does not receive a I1 Invite message within a time defined by the operator policy after the SIP BYE request reception then the SCC AS shall initiate release of the dialog toward the remote UE.

question_25463.question: What is the HTTP status code that indicates the successful registration of an EES?
question_25463.ground_truth: The ECS responds with an HTTP "201 Created" status code upon successful registration of the EES.

question_25464.question: When generating a SIP re-INVITE request, what should be included in the SDP offer with the media parameters as currently established with the terminating MCVideo client?
question_25464.ground_truth: An SDP offer with the media parameters as currently established with the terminating MCVideo client, as specified in 3GPP TS 24.229 with the clarifications specified in clause 6.3.3.1.1.

question_25465.question: Which function is responsible for validating access to packet switched resources within a 5GS network?

question_25466.question: How could a more general issue related to interworking with pre-Rel-8 HLR be addressed in terms of authentication vector requests?
question_25466.ground_truth: One way to address this issue is by explicitly indicating the type of authentication vector needed (E-UTRAN or UTRAN) in the Diameter-based authentication vector request. This will allow the HSS to distinguish authentication vector requests from the same SGSN/MME relating to E-UTRAN from those relating to UTRAN.

question_25469.question: What is the required field in the MCData Group message?
question_25469.ground_truth: The MCData Group ID field is mandatory in the MCData Group message.

question_25470.question: What is the PRS bandwidth that the UE must meet the RSTD measurement accuracy for during inter-frequency handover?
question_25470.ground_truth: The UE must meet the RSTD measurement accuracy for a PRS bandwidth which is not larger than the minimum channel bandwidth of all the PCells during the RSTD measurement period.

question_25471.question: What is the 3GPP encryption algorithm defined in the present document?

question_25472.question: What security information is contained in the header of the PDCP packet for user plane data?
question_25472.ground_truth: The 5 least significant bits of the PGK Identity, PTK Identity, and Counter are contained in the header of the PDCP packet for user plane data.

question_25474.question: What is the purpose of the AUSF in the UE-to-Network relaying procedure?
question_25474.ground_truth: The AUSF is responsible for authenticating the Remote UE via the AMF using the SUCI of the Remote UE, and for determining whether the Remote UE is authorized to use UE-to-Network relaying.

question_25475.question: What is the difference between "intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation" and "intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation"?
question_25475.ground_truth: Intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation refers to contiguous NR or E-UTRA carriers aggregated in the same operating band, while intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation refers to non-contiguous NR or E-UTRA carriers aggregated in the same operating band.

question_25476.question: What elements make up the TAI FQDN?
question_25476.ground_truth: The TAI FQDN is composed of "tac-lb<TAC-low-byte>.tac-hb<TAC-high-byte>.tac.epc.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.3gppnetwork.org".

question_25477.question: What is the difference in PRS resource utilization between FR1 and FR2 in the 20ms PRS periodicity scenario?
question_25477.ground_truth: The PRS resource utilization is 3.21% in FR1 and 51.42% in FR2.

question_25478.question: What is the technology used to reduce the transmission delay in a GERAN network?
question_25478.ground_truth: Reduced TTI radio blocks and a Fast Ack/Nack reporting scheme are used to reduce transmission delay in a GERAN network.

question_25479.question: What are the responsibilities of the MME in this solution?
question_25479.ground_truth: The MME receives a Downlink Data Notification, determines that the UE monitors the network for paging, sends an S1 Paging message to the relevant eNB including PTW information, and forwards the paging message towards relevant RAN when the TeDRX expires next time in a timely manner taking possible imperfections in the synchronization between the CN and the UE into account.

question_25480.question: When establishing a PDN connection as a user-plane resource of an MA PDU session over untrusted non-3GPP access, what protocol should the UE use to establish the IPsec tunnel?
question_25480.ground_truth: The UE should use the IKEv2 protocol to establish the IPsec tunnel.

question_25482.question: What does the MPTCP functionality communicate with in the UPF?
question_25482.ground_truth: The MPTCP functionality in the UE communicates with the MPTCP Proxy functionality in the UPF using the user plane of the 3GPP access, or the non-3GPP access, or both.

question_25483.question: What is the difference between the "wTInitiatedWTModification" and "eNBInitiatedWTModification" procedures?
question_25483.ground_truth: Both procedures are used to modify wireless network parameters, but the "wTInitiatedWTModification" procedure is initiated by the wireless terminal (wT), while the "eNBInitiatedWTModification" procedure is initiated by the eNB.

question_25484.question: What is the purpose of the ICS as specified in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_25484.ground_truth: The ICS provides the delivery of consistent IMS services to the user regardless of the attached access type, enables IM CN subsystem services when using CS access for the media bearer, and supports the use of CS media bearer for IM CN subsystem sessions.

question_25485.question: What is the CP-UP separation introduced in Rel-17 for the enhancement of robustness?
question_25485.ground_truth: The CP-UP separation introduced in Rel-17 for the enhancement of robustness is a feature that allows an IAB-node, which is dual-connected with an IAB-donor and a gNB, to exchange F1-C via the backhaul with the IAB-donor or the path containing the access link between IAB-node and gNB and the Xn connection between gNB and IAB-donor.

question_25486.question: What is the requirement for measuring the S-RSRP of the selected SyncRef UE when initiating/ceasing SLSS transmissions for the UE capable of ProSe Direct Communication and/or ProSe Direct Discovery?
question_25486.ground_truth: The UE shall be capable of measuring the S-RSRP of the selected SyncRef UE used to derive transmission timing for Prose Direct Communication and/or ProSe Direct Discovery and evaluate it to initiate/cease SLSS transmissions within Tevaluate,SLSS = 0.8 seconds as specified in clause 11.3.2.

question_25489.question: What is the role of the CAG ID in the solution for CAG ID privacy?
question_25489.ground_truth: The CAG ID refers to the Cell Access Group Identifier, which is used in the solution for CAG ID privacy to identify and protect the CAG cells for access control.

question_25490.question: What is the purpose of the "Floor Queue Position Request" message and what does it contain?
question_25490.ground_truth: The "Floor Queue Position Request" message is a request from a floor participant to get information about the floor participant's position in the floor request queue. It contains the SSRC of the floor participant that is requesting information about its position in the floor request queue.

question_25492.question: How much improvement does the cross scheduling system with N = 1 and N = 4 provide over the multi carrier system with the same parameters?
question_25492.ground_truth: The cross scheduling system with N = 1 and N = 4 provides about 4% improvement over the multi carrier system with the same parameters.

question_25495.question: What are the three AOC services defined in the document?
question_25495.ground_truth: The three AOC services defined in the document are AOC-S (Charging information at communication set-up time), AOC-D (Charging information during the communication), and AOC-E (Charging information at the end of the communication).

question_25497.question: What is the purpose of load reporting in the context of intra-RAT and intra-system inter-RAT load balancing?
question_25497.ground_truth: Load reporting is executed by exchanging load information over the Xn/X2/F1/E1 interfaces to distribute load evenly among cells or among areas of cells. The following load-related information is supported in load reporting: radio resource usage, TNL capacity indicator, cell capacity class value, capacity value, HW capacity indicator, RRC connections, number of active UEs, and NR-U channel load.

question_25499.question: What statuses does the MCPTT Service provide for an MCPTT Private Call with Floor control?
question_25499.ground_truth: The MCPTT Service provides the following statuses for an MCPTT Private Call with Floor control: ringing, accepted, rejected, active, and failed to set up.

question_25501.question: How does the AMF approach handle UE reported PC5 charging data?
question_25501.ground_truth: The AMF approach passes in a container the info received from the UE as is to the CHF, and the CHF can handle it using data type "string".

question_25502.question: What is the EBNF for a Distinguished Name (DN) in string representation?
question_25502.ground_truth: The EBNF for a DN is a set of rules defining the structure of a DN, such as NullDN, RegularDN, DNPrefixPlusRDNSeparator, DNPrefixWithDomainComponent, DNPrefixWithoutDomainComponent, LocalDN, RDNSeparator, DomainComponentRDN, RegularRDN, LocalDNAttributeTypeAndValue, DCAttributeTypeAndValue, DCAttributeType, DCAttributeValue, DCLabel, DCLabelSeparator, RegularAttributeType, LocalDNAttributeType, and RegularAttributeValue.

question_25503.question: What actions shall the transmission participant take upon an indication from the MCVideo user to release permission to send RTP media and there is no transmitter in transmitter list, as per TS 24.581 clause 7.2.3.5.5?
question_25503.ground_truth: The transmission participant shall stop timers T206 and T207, and remain in the 'O: transmission arbitration' state.

question_25504.question: What is the impact of propagation delay and pilot overhead on the achievable gains of the SFN mode for a UE?
question_25504.ground_truth: The impact due to propagation delay and pilot overhead is very small in the SFN mode for a UE, and there are some cases where the SFN mode will give gains, while in some cases there might be some losses due to propagation mismatch.

question_25506.question: What is the role of the "offset value" in the paging procedure of 5G networks?
question_25506.ground_truth: The "offset value" is used to calculate the Paging Occasion, which determines when a device is paged for incoming calls or messages. The MME/AMF adds the "offset value" to the value it would have otherwise sent in the UE Identity Index Value field in the S1-AP/NG-AP paging message.

question_25508.question: What is one of the steps the MCData server takes after passing control plane signalling the MBMS user service info to the MCData client if the MCData server does not make use of the xMB interface?
question_25508.ground_truth: The MCData server fragments the file, applies error correction, and sends the FLUTE packets over MB2-U.

question_25509.question: What should the Content-Type be set to when generating an MSRP SEND request containing only an SDS SIGNALLING PAYLOAD message?
question_25509.ground_truth: The Content-Type should be set to "application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling".

question_25511.question: What is the maximum duration for the transmitter power of the UE to be turned off after the expiry of T310 timer?

question_25512.question: What is the main feature of the Location Reporting API in the Edge Enabler Server?
question_25512.ground_truth: The Location Reporting API in the Edge Enabler Server supports tracking or checking the valid location of the UE for the Edge Application Server.

question_25516.question: What is the role of the Application Server (AS) when the Authentication Proxy (AP) asserts an identity?
question_25516.ground_truth: The AS provides authorization to access the requested resource when the AP asserts an identity.

question_25519.question: At what carrier frequency and with what SNR level does supporting UL 256 QAM provide significant performance gain over UL 64QAM for FR2-1?
question_25519.ground_truth: UL 256 QAM can provide a significant performance gain over UL 64QAM for FR2-1 at all simulated SNR levels for AWGN channel and TDL-A and TDL-D fading channels with 3.5% Tx EVM+3.5% Rx EVM, as long as the SNR level is greater than 19.5 dB, 22.5 dB, and 25.2 dB, respectively.

question_25520.question: What is the role of the "appInterface" parameter in the "reserveResources()" method?
question_25520.ground_truth: The "appInterface" parameter specifies the callback interface to be used when the conference is created in the network, allowing the application to receive the conferenceCreated message when a conference is created in the network.

question_25521.question: What are the existing procedures that can be reused with the enhancement for Notification Control of PDB and PER?
question_25521.ground_truth: The existing procedures that can be reused include the RAN notifying the unfulfillment/re-fulfilment of the QoS characteristics PDB and PER to the 5GC, which then notifies the Application Function.

question_25522.question: What indication does an L2 U2U Remote UE give to upper layers when receiving a PC5 RLF with L2 U2U Relay UE?
question_25522.ground_truth: The L2 U2U Remote UE indicates PC5 RLF received from L2 U2U Relay UE to the upper layers for the indicated L2 U2U Remote UE based on the received sl-DestinationIdentityRemoteUE.

question_25523.question: What type of mode cannot be used when a mobile station has enabled EC operation or PEO?
question_25523.ground_truth: Dual transfer mode cannot be used when a mobile station has enabled EC operation or PEO.

question_25524.question: What happens if call gapping is performed on a call for a particular service and triggering of this service is allowed, but no other gap criteria should be applied to the same service?
question_25524.ground_truth: Active gap criteria with assigned scfID will have higher priority than the others. In case an entry with scfID matching the current call exist, all other criteria without scfID are not evaluated.

question_25525.question: What is the role of the application function (AF) in the edge relocation sequence?
question_25525.ground_truth: The AF is responsible for handling the end-to-end application flows and determining whether a server relocation is necessary. The AF determines if there is a better LDN than the initially selected and initiates server relocation procedures if necessary. The AF also determines when the UE has handed over to a new (R)AN and UPF-PSA and initiates mechanisms to transfer UE context and related data.

question_25527.question: Who is responsible for rendering the digital representations, such as avatars, for the virtual shop assistants in this use case?
question_25527.ground_truth: GreenMobile provides rendering services for the digital representations, such as avatars, for the virtual shop assistants in this use case.

question_25529.question: What is the level of specification impact for a common framework in PHY layer aspects?
question_25529.ground_truth: The specification impact is assessed at the use case and collaboration level, including new signaling, means for training and validation data assistance, assistance information, measurement, and feedback.

question_25530.question: When deriving KASME, what other input is used in addition to CK and IK?
question_25530.ground_truth: KASME is derived by UE and HSS from CK, IK, and the type of radio access technology during an AKA run. If the RAT is LTE type, KASME also depends on the PLMN identity (MCC + MNC).

question_25532.question: What is the main focus of the solution described in section 6.9.2 to address the failure in the connection between the NF consumer and the NF producer?
question_25532.ground_truth: The main focus of the solution is to optimize the efficiency of certificate revocation status query by combining it with the service discovery procedure.

question_25534.question: What is the role of the "reference cells" in the 1.28 Mcps TDD solution?
question_25534.ground_truth: The role of the "reference cells" is to initialise their SFN counter and synchronise other cells in the network by being synchronised by an external reference such as a GPS receiver. These cells serve as a reference for the RNC to evaluate the absolute time and synchronise other cells in the network.

question_25535.question: What should the UE do if the received Random Access Responses contain Random Access Preamble identifiers that do not match the transmitted Random Access Preamble?
question_25535.ground_truth: The UE should perform the Random Access Resource selection procedure and transmit with the calculated PRACH transmission power.

question_25536.question: Why does the use of UUID as identifier limit the flexibility that a service mesh could offer in SBA?
question_25536.ground_truth: The use of UUID as identifier limits the flexibility that a service mesh could offer in SBA because it requires the operator RA/CA to keep track of the NF instance identifiers for verification, which can be challenging in a heterogeneous environment across different operator domains.

question_25537.question: What does the MSGin5G Server do when the API Request includes Delivery status required?
question_25537.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server sends the message delivery status report to the Application Server when the API Request includes Delivery status required.

question_25538.question: What is the role of an NTN-Gateway in non-terrestrial networks?
question_25538.ground_truth: An NTN-Gateway is an earth station or gateway located at the surface of Earth that provides sufficient RF power and RF sensitivity for accessing to the satellite or HAPS in non-terrestrial networks.

question_25539.question: How are the conformance requirements in different releases of the cores specifications handled?
question_25539.ground_truth: When differences between conformance requirements in different releases of the cores specifications have an impact on the Pre-test conditions, Test procedure sequence or/and the Specific message contents, the Conformance requirements related to different releases are specified separately with a clear indication of the Release of the spec from which they were copied.

question_25541.question: What should the ME operate in, as per the 27.22.4.2.6.5 test requirement?
question_25541.ground_truth: The ME should operate in the manner defined in expected sequences 6.1A to 6.4B.

question_25542.question: What is the purpose of step A4 in the RN attach procedure?
question_25542.ground_truth: In step A4, the DeNB sets up RN-specific AS security over Un, which differs from AS security over Uu in that integrity protection for PDCP frames carrying S1 /X2 messages is provided. The DeNB also rejects any attach requests by relay nodes for which no confirmation has been received from the MME-RN that the attachment is for relay nodes.

question_25544.question: What should the AS do when receiving 4xx, 5xx or 6xx response to the initial INVITE request from the terminating UE?
question_25544.ground_truth: The AS should instruct the MRF to stop the media for the CRS service and forward the final response to the originating UE.

question_25546.question: What should the UE do in step 6 when the SS sends a 600 (Busy Everywhere) message for a manual eCall over IMS?
question_25546.ground_truth: The UE performs domain selection to a cell supporting the CS domain (UTRAN/GERAN) and initiates a CS domain emergency call with MM registration if necessary.

question_25547.question: What is the type of the attribute "xml:lang" that appears in the "AliasEntryType" and "ListEntryType" complex types?
question_25547.ground_truth: The type of the attribute "xml:lang" in the "AliasEntryType" and "ListEntryType" complex types is xs:language.

question_25548.question: What should the Node B do with the Transport Format Set IE in the case of a unidirectional DCH?
question_25548.ground_truth: If the DCH Specific Info IE includes the Unidirectional DCH Indicator IE set to "Uplink DCH only", the Node B shall ignore the Transport Format Set IE for the downlink for this DCH. Similarly, for "Downlink DCH only", the Node B shall ignore the Transport Format Set IE for the uplink for this DCH.

question_25552.question: What does the "Change UCS2 Row" CH Extension Type indicate?
question_25552.ground_truth: The "Change UCS2 Row" CH Extension Type indicates that the initial UCS2 Row value should be overridden by the value specified in the CH Extension Value or subsequent CH octets of this type.

question_25553.question: What must the GCS AS send to indicate that it requests MBMS security services?
question_25553.ground_truth: The GCS AS sends an indication to the GCS AS if it requests using MBMS security services.

question_25555.question: What procedure is followed to migrate the F1-U tunnels from the first path to the second path for a subset of UE bearers?
question_25555.ground_truth: The IAB-donor-CU sends a UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message to the dual-connecting IAB-DU and the dual-connecting IAB-DU replies with a UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION RESPONSE message.

question_25556.question: What type of bearer does the MCPTT-9 reference point use for providing floor control signalling between the floor control server and the floor participant?
question_25556.ground_truth: The MCPTT-9 reference point uses a multicast bearer.

question_25557.question: What is the purpose of the additional PDU Session Anchor(s) in the same PDU Session?
question_25557.ground_truth: The additional PDU Session Anchors are assigned for selective traffic routing to the DN, and are independent of the SSC mode of the PDU Session.

question_25558.question: What should the UE do if it receives a measObject with a ssb-PositionQCL-CellsToRemoveList?
question_25558.ground_truth: The UE should remove the entry with the matching physCellId from the ssb-PositionQCL-CellsToAddModList for each physCellId included in the ssb-PositionQCL-CellsToRemoveList.

question_25559.question: What is a functional entity embedded in the Online Charging Function (OCF) within the Online Charging System (OCS) that performs online credit control functions?
question_25559.ground_truth: Service Data Flow Based Credit Control Function

question_25560.question: What does the Terminal Location Web Service specify in Part 9 of the OSA interface?
question_25560.ground_truth: The Terminal Location Web Service specifies the aspects of the interface, including name spaces, sequence diagrams, data definitions, interface specification, fault definitions, service policies, and WSDL Description of the interfaces.

question_25562.question: What is the role of the MSGin5G Server in sending a message from a MSGin5G UE to a Non-3GPP UE?
question_25562.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server forwards the MSGin5G message request to the Non-3GPP Message Gateway, which then sends the message to the Non-3GPP UE.

question_25563.question: What are the three receiver-assisted channel access schemes that will not be further investigated in Rel-17?
question_25563.ground_truth: Class B1) Intra-operator only, Class B2) Also including inter-operator signaling, Class C) Receiver provides assistance information (signaling) to other NR nodes and nodes from other RAT.

question_25566.question: When can a UE initiate a PDU session establishment procedure for emergency services, even if timer T3585 is running?
question_25566.ground_truth: Always, as the UE is allowed to initiate a PDU session establishment procedure for emergency services, regardless of the status of timer T3585.

question_25568.question: Where can the IRPAgent reside in relation to an NE and EM?
question_25568.ground_truth: The IRPAgent can reside in an Element Manager (EM) or a Network Element (NE). In the former case, the interface between the EM and the NEs is not the subject of the Interface IRPs for SuM NRM IRP.

question_25569.question: What message does the PDN GW send to the PCRF to indicate if the requested PCC decision was enforced or not?
question_25569.ground_truth: A Provision Ack message is sent by the PDN GW to the PCRF to indicate if the requested PCC decision was enforced or not.

question_25571.question: What is the role of the MC service server in the MBMS bearer suspension reporting procedure?
question_25571.ground_truth: The MC service server sends an MBMS suspension reporting instruction to the MC client residing on a non-3GPP device and may send an additional proposal for measurements after receiving the MBMS listening status report from the MC Client.

question_25572.question: Which antenna is identified as the primary antenna for UE containing multiple Tx antennas as per section 6.2.1.1.1.4.1.2?
question_25572.ground_truth: The antenna with better TRP is identified as the primary antenna, and the corresponding TRP result will be used to determine the pass/fail compliance.

question_25574.question: What is the expected result of the PROACTIVE COMMAND 1.5.1 for the TEST REQUIREMENT 27.22.4.31?
question_25574.ground_truth: General result: Bearer Independent Protocol error (3A), Additional result: Channel identifier not valid (03).

question_25575.question: What is the role of NFVI in the attestation process?
question_25575.ground_truth: The NFVI, in the attestation process, retrieves the virtual instance from network storage and attests the virtual instance and VNF. The virtualization layer software of NFVI measures the virtual instance and VNF software and reports the evidence to a Verifier.

question_25576.question: What information is provided by the UAE layer with respect to DAA applications?
question_25576.ground_truth: The UAE layer provides real-time location update about UAVs to UASS (UTM/USS) and provides dynamic information of UAVs in an application defined area to the host UAV and/or UASS (UTM/USS).

question_25578.question: What should the MAC entity do if it determines if there is an SSB with SS-RSRP above rsrp-ThresholdSSB or a CSI-RS with CSI-RSRP above rsrp-ThresholdCSI-RS?
question_25578.ground_truth: The MAC entity should use the latest unfiltered L1-RSRP measurement to determine if there is an SSB or CSI-RS with SS-RSRP or CSI-RSRP above the threshold.

question_25580.question: What is the significance of the three digits in the version number of the 3GPP technical specifications?
question_25580.ground_truth: The first digit indicates the stage of the document (information, approval, or change control), the second digit is incremented for changes of substance, and the third digit is incremented for editorial-only changes.

question_25583.question: What message does an MS send to the GANC when it wants to initiate a handover to a GERAN A/Gb mode cell?

question_25584.question: What must the NEF control when performing analytics exposure to AFs via NEF using analytics request to NWDAF?
question_25584.ground_truth: The NEF must control the analytics exposure mapping among the AF identifier with allowed Analytics ID(s) and associated inbound restrictions (applied to the Analytics ID requested by AF) and/or outbound restrictions (applied to the response of Analytics ID to AF).

question_25585.question: What is the consequence of choosing to selectively distribute specific target identifiers to specific POIs instead of distributing the full target list to all POIs?
question_25585.ground_truth: A race condition is introduced, where the POI must query the ADMF/LICF to find out if the user identifier is part of the target list.

question_25586.question: What is the 3GPP's role in the development of the technical specification for MBMS User Services?
question_25586.ground_truth: The 3GPP (3rd Generation Partnership Project) is the organization that produced the technical specification for MBMS User Services.

question_25587.question: What is the filter used to de-emphasize the signal in the initial step of the process?
question_25587.ground_truth: The filter de-emphasizes the high frequencies and enhances the low frequencies.

question_25588.question: What does the NWDAF do after receiving the allocated IPv4 address or IPv6 prefix from the SMF?
question_25588.ground_truth: The NWDAF correlates the UE data with the NWDAF request using the retrieved IPv4 address or IP v6 prefix.

question_25590.question: What is the definition of BSSAP-LE in 3GPP?
question_25590.ground_truth: BSSAP-LE is an extension to BSSAP that contains messages and parameters specific to the support of LCS.

question_25592.question: What is the U-TDOA method based on?
question_25592.ground_truth: The U-TDOA positioning method is based on network measurements of the Time Of Arrival (TOA) of a known signal sent from the UE and received at four or more LMUs.

question_25593.question: What will the Parlay X Web Service do if no call participant addresses are specified in the PlayAudioMessage operation?
question_25593.ground_truth: The Parlay X Web Service will play the message to all call participants associated with the CallSessionIdentifier.

question_25595.question: What is the requirement for the test with varying signal strength values?
question_25595.ground_truth: The requirement for the test is that the first response from the MS shall be on the weaker carrier (carrier 2) within 33 seconds.

question_25597.question: What is one of the requirements for AR/VR in the 5G system?
question_25597.ground_truth: One of the requirements is that the 5G system shall support low-delay speech coding for interactive conversational services with a one-way mouth-to-ear delay of 100 ms.

question_25599.question: How are the Target/Reference UEs authorized to obtain the key packet decryption keys and signature verification public keys in the solution described in 6.23?
question_25599.ground_truth: In the solution described in 6.23, the AMF-LMF/KMF checks whether the Target/Reference UE is authorized to receive key packet decryption key and key packet signature verification public key. If the UE is authorized, AMF-LMF/KMF returns a list of key packet decryption keys and a list of key packet signature verification public keys.

question_25600.question: When is the PDU session released after 5G-SRVCC from NG-RAN to UTRAN?
question_25600.ground_truth: After UE moves to UTRAN and AMF receives the forward relocation complete, AMF requests PDU session release for all the PDU session in 5G-SRVCC from NG-RAN to UTRAN.

question_25602.question: What RTCP bandwidth modifiers shall be negotiated for MTSI clients in terminals to enable proper video rate adaptation?
question_25602.ground_truth: The MTSI clients in terminals shall set the RR field in the SDP offer/answer to 5000 bps (at media level) and the RS field to 0 bps (at media level) to reserve an RTCP bandwidth that is no smaller than the bandwidth reserved by setting the RTCP bandwidth modifiers as specified above.

question_25604.question: What is the purpose of the PDCP SDU data volume measurements?
question_25604.ground_truth: The PDCP SDU data volume measurements are used for performance assurance within integrity area (user plane connection quality) and in the energy efficiency (EE) area.

question_25605.question: What is the role of the Network Header Compressor and Decompressor (N-HCD) in the 3GPP network?
question_25605.ground_truth: The N-HCD is responsible for compressing and decompressing network layer, transport layer or upper layer protocol headers in the 3GPP network. It is located in the RNC and performs header compression for downlink (i.e. N-HC) and header decompression for uplink (i.e. N-HD).

question_25607.question: What are the factors considered for NEF selection?
question_25607.ground_truth: S-NSSAI(s), Event ID(s) supported by an AF, AF Instance ID, Application Identifier, External Identifier, External Group Identifier, or domain name, request for local NEF selection, location, List of supported TAI, List of supported DNAI, Capability of NEF to support UAS NF functionality for UUAA procedures, Capability of NEF to support Multi-member AF session with required QoS for a set of UEs identified by a list of UE addresses, Capability of NEF to support member UE selection assistance functionality.

question_25608.question: What action does the UE take when it receives an S-NSSAI not available in the current PLMN?
question_25608.ground_truth: The UE adds the rejected S-NSSAI(s) in the rejected NSSAI for the current PLMN and does not attempt to use this S-NSSAI in the current PLMN until switching off the UE or removing the USIM.

question_25609.question: What is the threshold value for uplink power in the test procedure outlined in section 7.3.28.4.2?

question_25610.question: What is the priority category for the "Create Session Request" procedure in message throttling?
question_25610.ground_truth: The "Create Session Request" procedure has the highest priority in message throttling.

question_25612.question: What is the procedure for deriving NAS keys upon idle mode mobility from UTRAN to E-UTRAN?
question_25612.ground_truth: The new MME derives new KASME from IK, CK and uses the algorithm indicated in the TAU Request to derive KNASInt and verify the integrity protection of the TAU Request. The new MME then derives new NAS keys (KNASenc, KNASint) from KASME using the selected NAS algorithms and other key derivation parameters as input parameters for the KDF.

question_25613.question: What should the GANC do when it receives a request from the upper layers to transfer a non-access stratum message?
question_25613.ground_truth: The GANC should include the contents of the upper layer message in the IE "L3 Message" and initiate the Downlink Direct Transfer procedure to transfer the message to the MS.

question_25614.question: What is started in the first symbol after the end of the first repetition of a PUSCH transmission for a corresponding HARQ process?

question_25615.question: What operation is used to compare the threshold in quiet with the actual threshold to avoid pre-echos?
question_25615.ground_truth: A maximum operation is used to compare the threshold in quiet with the actual threshold.

question_25616.question: What is provided to the UE in step 6 when the SMF+PGW-C accepts to provide interworking of the PDN connection with 5GC?
question_25616.ground_truth: In step 6, if the SMF+PGW-C accepts to provide interworking of the PDN connection with 5GC, it shall allocate 5G QoS parameters corresponding to PDN connection, e.g. Session AMBR, QoS rules and QoS Flow level QoS parameters if needed for the QoS Flow(s) associated with the QoS rule(s), and include them in PCO. The SMF+PGW-C also determines the S-NSSAI associated with the PDN connection based on the operator policy and sends the S-NSSAI together with the PLMN ID to the UE in the PCO. If Small Data Rate Control is used, the SMF+PGW-C also provides the Small Data Rate Control parameters to the UE in the PCO.

question_25617.question: What is the identifier used by the Relay UE to ensure the correct Remote UE is identified when they have different N ID of their serving PLMN?
question_25617.ground_truth: The Relay UE uses the Remote UE's identifier, which can be SUCI or 5G-GUTI, to identify the correct Remote UE.

question_25618.question: What is the action taken when the UE fails to meet the conditions for BFD evaluation in clause 8.5.2.2?
question_25618.ground_truth: If the UE fails to meet the conditions for BFD evaluation in clause 8.5.2.2, the requirements in this clause may not be applicable, and the test may need to be repeated or modified to meet the necessary conditions.

question_25620.question: What information must the new BSS include in the handover message if it supports DTM and network sharing and the MS also supports it?
question_25620.ground_truth: The PLMN Index corresponding to the PLMN received in the Cell Identifier (Target) IE in the HANDOVER REQUEST message.

question_25621.question: How can the MME use the stored paging information from a failed MME in the external backup system?
question_25621.ground_truth: The MME can use the stored paging information from the failed MME in the external backup system to page UEs when it receives the Downlink Data Notification with IMSI.

question_25622.question: What type of AVP is the Node-Functionality AVP, and what information does it include?
question_25622.ground_truth: The Node-Functionality AVP is of type Enumerated and includes the functionality identifier of the node, which can be one of 19 different node identifiers.
