question_25623.question: What HTTP response message does the AF send back to the NEF to acknowledge the notification of service parameters?
question_25623.ground_truth: The AF sends back an HTTP response message to the NEF to acknowledge the notification.

question_25626.question: What data rate is required for cooperative perception in high/full automated platooning use case?

question_25628.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement in the context of wideband intermodulation for EN-DC within FR1 (5 CCs)?
question_25628.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement is that the throughput should be greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channels with the specified parameters and two interfering signals present.

question_25629.question: What shall the controlling MCVideo function do if it receives a SIP re-INVITE request for an on-demand prearranged MCVideo group session with an emergency indication set to "true" and it is unable to process the request?
question_25629.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function can choose to accept the request, even if it is unable to process it due to a lack of resources or a risk of congestion.

question_25630.question: Which custom operation is used to retrieve the discovery key from the 5G PKMF for monitoring in the PLMN?

question_25631.question: Which protocol is used as a basis for supporting multipath transport of UDP flows between the UE and UPF?
question_25631.ground_truth: The MPQUIC steering functionality using UDP proxying over HTTP will be specified during the normative phase to support multipath transport of UDP flows between the UE and UPF.

question_25633.question: In what situation will the S-CSCF perform the protected registration procedures with SIP digest?
question_25633.ground_truth: This will occur if the REGISTER request contains an Authorization header field with the "integrity-protected" header field parameter set to "tls-pending", "tls-yes", "ip-assoc-pending" or "ip-assoc-yes".

question_25634.question: What is the error procedure used to indicate that the cancellation of a specific CAP operation was not successful by the gsmSRF?
question_25634.ground_truth: The error procedure "CancelFailed" is used to indicate that the cancellation of a specific CAP operation was not successful by the gsmSRF.

question_25637.question: What should be the minimum aggregate adjustment rate for the uplink transmission?
question_25637.ground_truth: The minimum aggregate adjustment rate for the uplink transmission should be 7 x Ts per second.

question_25638.question: What should the UE include in the SidelinkUEInformation message if it wants to release sidelink communication reception resources?
question_25638.ground_truth: The UE should include commRxInterestedFreq and set it to an empty list if it no longer requires any sidelink communication reception resources.

question_25639.question: What is the minimum reporting interval for aperiodic CSI reporting of CQI, PMI, and RI?
question_25639.ground_truth: The minimum reporting interval for aperiodic CSI reporting of CQI, PMI, and RI is 1 subframe.

question_25640.question: In what situation would the SMF+PGW-C generate an SMFPDUSessionEstablishment record?
question_25640.ground_truth: When the SMF+PGW-C detects the creation of a new PDN Connection.

question_25642.question: What is the purpose of the "3gpp-Sbi-Source-NF-Client-Credentials" header in an NF service request sent from an NF Service Consumer to an NF Service Producer?
question_25642.ground_truth: The purpose of the "3gpp-Sbi-Source-NF-Client-Credentials" header is to enable the authorization of NF service consumers for data access via DCCF.

question_25643.question: Which 3GPP technical specification defines the requirements for the ePWS feature that enhances the Public Warning System?

question_25644.question: What is the process for splitting E2E QoS parameters in UE-to-UE relay?
question_25644.ground_truth: In UE-to-UE relay, the E2E QoS parameters for the connection are split into two parts, one for the PC5 interface between the source UE and the UE-to-UE relay, and the other part for the interface between the UE-to-UE relay and the target UE.

question_25648.question: What is the role of the User Equipment (UE) in determining traffic splitting percentages in the context of Load-Balancing steering mode?
question_25648.ground_truth: The UE is expected to determine its own percentages for traffic splitting by performing measurements across the two accesses.

question_25651.question: What is the initial state of MCVideo client 1 when initiating an emergency private call?
question_25651.ground_truth: While MCVideo client 1 is in the emergency state, all MCVideo group and private calls initiated by MCVideo client 1 are initiated as MCVideo emergency calls.

question_25653.question: What is the maximum time specified for the UE to shut its transmitter off after point B for the continuous transmission test case?
question_25653.ground_truth: The UE is required to shut its transmitter off before point C, which is Toff = 200 ms after point B for the continuous transmission test case.

question_25655.question: What should the MME/SGSN be able to handle in deployments satisfying all SA1 requirements?
question_25655.ground_truth: The MME/SGSN should be able to handle the PS Data Off UE status and the list of Exempted APNs and associated Packet Filtering Information sent by the HSS, and send it to the PGW.

question_25656.question: What happens to the "progressPercentage" attribute during the "RUNNING" state?
question_25656.ground_truth: During the "RUNNING" state, the "progressPercentage" attribute may be repeatedly updated, with further specialization in its exact semantic.

question_25658.question: What is the difference between a resource focused view and a service impact focused view in the context of managed alarms?
question_25658.ground_truth: A resource focused view, as carried by the NEs, is centered around the resources and their status. In contrast, a service impact focused view, as transformed within the NM domain, considers the impact of the network condition on the overall network service.

question_25659.question: When reducing the Isolation Offset, what happens to the number of scheduled UEs per TTI and cell in the same combined cell?
question_25659.ground_truth: As the Isolation Offset is decreased, the number of simultaneously scheduled users in the same combined cell increases, while the number of HARQ transmissions also increases.

question_25662.question: What should the UE do if it receives a TAU Reject message indicating that the selected PLMN is not allowed to operate at the present UE location?
question_25662.ground_truth: The UE shall attempt to select a PLMN as specified in TS~23.122.

question_25663.question: What are the two ways to achieve binding in case of EAP-AKA authentication?
question_25663.ground_truth: In case of EAP-AKA authentication, two ways for achieving the binding are known: logical binding of the TrE holding the AKA credentials to the H(e)NB, or physically binding the TrE holding the AKA credentials to the H(e)NB.

question_25664.question: Which reference point (6a.9.1) is between the 3GPP AAA server and the HLR up to and including Rel-4 and the HSS in Rel-5?
question_25664.ground_truth: The D'/Gr' reference point is between the 3GPP AAA server and the HLR up to and including Rel-4 and the HSS in Rel-5. The functionality of this reference point is similar to that of the Wx reference point.

question_25665.question: What is the role of the SMF+PGW-C in relation to network slice availability check and update during PDN connection establishment?
question_25665.ground_truth: The SMF+PGW-C is responsible for invoking the network slice availability check and update procedure during PDN connection establishment to ensure the number of PDU Sessions and UEs per network slice do not exceed the maximum limit.

question_25666.question: What should the SGSN or SGW do when forwarding the FPI in roaming scenarios?
question_25666.ground_truth: The SGSN or SGW should forward the FPI over Iu or S1 together with the HPLMN ID and additional information which indicates whether the FPI is assigned by a GGSN/PGW in the Home PLMN, Visited PLMN, or Operator Group GGSN.

question_25667.question: What information must be included in the RAR message for the MBMS Session Start procedure?
question_25667.ground_truth: The RAR message for the MBMS Session Start procedure must include either an IPv4 address included in 3GPP-SGSN-Address AVP or an IPv6 address included in 3GPP-SGSN-IPv6-Address AVP for each participating MBMS control plane nodes (MMEs, SGSNs), MBMS-Time-to-Data-Transfer AVP, MBMS-Service-Area AVP, and the Local-M1-Information AVP if determined to use local MBMS information.

question_25668.question: How many initial conditions are there for the test described in 9.2.59.4.1?
question_25668.ground_truth: There are two initial conditions: the test environment and the frequencies to be tested.

question_25669.question: What protocol should the SLM-S use to send a CoAP GET request to the SLM-C for reporting location information?

question_25671.question: What message does the MS send in response to the PACKET DOWNLINK ASSIGNMENT message?
question_25671.ground_truth: The MS sends a PACKET CONTROL ACKNOWLEDGEMENT message in response to the PACKET DOWNLINK ASSIGNMENT message.

question_25672.question: What should the 3GPP AAA server send if the EAP authentication is unsuccessful, prior to sending the EAP-Failure message?
question_25672.ground_truth: The 3GPP AAA server should send an EAP-Request/AKA-Notification or EAP-Request/SIM-Notification message containing a failure notification, which is MAC protected.

question_25673.question: What does the "ggsn" parameter represent in the "ggsn-charging-info" parameter in the P-Charging-Vector header field?
question_25673.ground_truth: The "ggsn" parameter is a string value representing a Gateway GPRS Support Node (GGSN).

question_25674.question: What is the measure of the difference between the reference waveform and the measured waveform called in the context of 5.13.1AB.1?

question_25676.question: What is the role of APtG in the described authentication process?
question_25676.ground_truth: APtG is responsible for sending a temporary identity (TID) and the key lifetime of KAApF to the user equipment (UE) in the described authentication process.

question_25677.question: What network function terminates the N1, N2, and N3 interfaces and implements the NAS protocol stack for the UE in the 5GC over non-3GPP access solution?

question_25678.question: What is the purpose of the "Service Level Agreement" in regards to service properties?
question_25678.ground_truth: The Service Level Agreement restricts the set of property values of the SCS and leads to a subset of the service property values.

question_25679.question: What is the action taken when the information has been acknowledged by the MS?

question_25683.question: What is the technique used for reducing initial latency during stream switching in eMBMS?
question_25683.ground_truth: The technique used for reducing initial latency during stream switching in eMBMS is to retrieve the base data of the requested TV stream from the buffered preview data and decode low quality video instantly, while receiving the enhancement data stream in the background.

question_25686.question: What is the minimum and maximum values for the "Radius" element in the "EllipsoidArcType" complex type?
question_25686.ground_truth: The "Radius" element in the "EllipsoidArcType" complex type can have a minimum value of 0 and a maximum value of 65535.

question_25687.question: What action should the MCPTT client take when it receives a GROUP CALL IMMINENT PERIL END message while in the "T3: in-progress imminent peril group call" state?
question_25687.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should set the stored last call type change time, stored last user to change call type, stored current call type, stored current ProSe per-packet priority, stop timer TFG14, and enter the "T2: in-progress basic group call" state.

question_25688.question: What should the UE do after changing the source Layer-2 ID and/or source IP address?
question_25688.ground_truth: The UE should provide an indication to upper layers that the source Layer-2 ID and/or the source IP address are changed.

question_25690.question: What is the maximum number of <entry> elements allowed in a SIP REFER request for pre-established session?
question_25690.ground_truth: If the received SIP REFER request contains an application/resource-lists+xml MIME body referenced by a "cid" URL in the Refer-To header field with more than one <entry> element in one or more <list> elements in the <resource-lists> element, then the participating MCVideo function shall reject the SIP REFER request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response.

question_25693.question: When must the downlink TCI switching to the indicated DL TCI state be completed?
question_25693.ground_truth: The downlink TCI switching to the indicated DL TCI state must be completed starting from the first slot that is at least BeamAppTime-r17 symbols after the last symbol of the PUCCH carrying HARQ-ACK in response to the DCI triggering TCI state activation.

question_25694.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 36.301, what does the acronym "A-GANSS" stand for?

question_25698.question: What should be the maximum BER for any measured UTRA TDD carrier in the General narrowband blocking test requirement?
question_25698.ground_truth: The BER for any measured UTRA TDD carrier in the General narrowband blocking test requirement should not exceed 0.001.

question_25699.question: What is the requirement for interfering signals in the test of a multi-carrier BS of equal or different E-UTRA channel bandwidths?
question_25699.ground_truth: There are no requirements for interfering signals between the wanted carriers in such cases.

question_25700.question: What must a Warning Notification's alerting indication do before it can be suppressed?
question_25700.ground_truth: A Warning Notification's alerting indication can only be suppressed by users' manual operation.

question_25701.question: What is the meaning of HATEOAS in the context of RESTful domain application protocols?
question_25701.ground_truth: HATEOAS stands for Hypermedia As The Engine Of Application State and means that the hypermedia models application state transitions and describes application protocols. It guides the interactions between NF Service Consumer and Producer to achieve a particular goal, and the application state transitions as it transits across intermediate states until the final state is reached.

question_25702.question: What does the MCPTT service support?
question_25702.ground_truth: It supports both public safety applications and general commercial applications, such as police, fire brigade, utility companies and railways.

question_25704.question: What type of error occurs when the receiver is unable to decode the received physical message due to issues with the transfer syntax?

question_25705.question: What should the SMF do if the installation/activation of one or more PCC rules fails?
question_25705.ground_truth: The SMF shall include the "ruleReports" attribute for the affected PCC rules to report the failure within the SmPolicyUpdateContextData data structure.

question_25706.question: How are the starting symbol and allocation length of PUSCH determined for a CSI report on PUSCH by a CSI request field on a DCI?
question_25706.ground_truth: The starting symbol S and the allocation length L for PUSCH is determined based on the start and length indicator SLIV of the indexed row.

question_25707.question: How much MSD is needed in the n3 FDD band if the noise level is increased by 1.5dB in the Rx band due to RFIC/PA operation?
question_25707.ground_truth: A 0.7 dB MSD is needed in the n3 FDD band if the noise level is increased by 1.5dB in the Rx band due to RFIC/PA operation.

question_25709.question: What is the mandatory mobility related requirement that an EC-GSM-IoT mobile station need not comply with?

question_25710.question: What is the purpose of using DAS-7 coding scheme in the test procedure?
question_25710.ground_truth: The DAS-7 coding scheme is used in the test procedure to send RLC data blocks, ensuring that the MS and SS can effectively communicate using the specified coding method.

question_25712.question: What is the message contained in the Uplink NAS transport message when creating a PDU Session Release Ack for the FN-RG?

question_25713.question: What feature in the SMF requires the SMF to request the UPF to perform duplicated notification?

question_25714.question: What action is taken by the UE and eNB when cryptographic protection is established for radio bearers?
question_25714.ground_truth: The UE generates RRC protection keys and UP protection keys, and the eNB sends an AS SMC to the UE to take the new NAS keys into use.

question_25715.question: What is the length of the Transport Layer Address signalled in F1AP messages?
question_25715.ground_truth: The Transport Layer Address can be a 32-bit string for an IPv4 address, a 128-bit string for an IPv6 address, or a 160-bit string for both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, with the IPv4 address contained in the first 32 bits.

question_25716.question: What is the definition of "Iuant interface" in the context of the "UTRAN Iuant interface: General aspects and principles (Release 17)" technical specification?
question_25716.ground_truth: The "Iuant interface" in the "UTRAN Iuant interface: General aspects and principles (Release 17)" technical specification refers to the interface between the UTRAN and the NA-NET between the RNC and the 3G-SGSN.

question_25717.question: What is the effect of selecting a general-purpose PDP Context in IM CN subsystem signalling and media?
question_25717.ground_truth: The general-purpose PDP Context can carry both IM CN subsystem signalling and media, provided that the media does not need authorization and the media stream is not mandated to be carried in a separate PDP Context.

question_25721.question: What does the FMSS study aim to achieve in use case 5.1.1?
question_25721.ground_truth: The FMSS study aims to achieve efficient and flexible mobile service steering by steering data traffic through several service enablers based on its application characteristics, such as application type and application protocol.

question_25722.question: What is the limitation of the antenna emissions for an AAS with a large number of transceiver units?
question_25722.ground_truth: The antenna emissions for an AAS are capped at the equivalent of 8 transceivers no matter how many transceiver units they have, to maintain the same levels of protection and performance as an equivalent non-AAS system with the same number of transceiver units.

question_25723.question: What should the floor control interface do when it receives a Floor Release Multi Talker message from the floor control arbitration logic in the MCPTT server?
question_25723.ground_truth: The floor control interface should forward the Floor Release Multi Talker message to the associated floor participant and remain in the 'U: not permitted but sends media' state.

question_25724.question: What is the minimum length of the LADN information information element?
question_25724.ground_truth: The minimum length of the LADN information information element is 3 octets.

question_25725.question: What should the UE do with RS resources for pathloss estimation for PUSCH/PUCCH/SRS transmissions in the above scenario?
question_25725.ground_truth: If the number of RS resources for pathloss estimation for PUSCH/PUCCH/SRS transmissions is larger than 4, the UE maintains the first four RS resources for pathloss estimation.

question_25727.question: What should the UE do during T4 regarding CSI reports for PSCell?
question_25727.ground_truth: The UE should send at least one CSI report for PSCell with a non-zero CQI index during T4. If this condition is met, it counts as a success for event "CSI", otherwise, it is a failure.

question_25731.question: What message does the TWIF create on behalf of the N5CW device when the TWIF selects an AMF in the visited PLMN/SNPN by using the 5G-GUTI in the NAI to send an N2 message to the AMF?
question_25731.ground_truth: The TWIF sends a Registration Request message to the AMF along with the User Location and AN Type.

question_25733.question: What should the receiver of a standard L3 message with unknown IE assume the length of the IE to be, if bit 8 of the IEI octet is set to "1" and bits 7 to 4 are set to "0" and bit 3 is set to "1"?
question_25733.ground_truth: The receiver of a standard L3 message should assume the length of the IE to be as specified in the following two octets (length octets), if bit 8 of the IEI octet is set to "0" and bits 7 to 4 are set to "1" and bit 3 is set to "1" for an unknown IE.

question_25735.question: How does the network handle an incoming IMS session when the user is busy?
question_25735.ground_truth: The network shall support the capability of a user to reject an incoming IMS session with an indication of "user busy", which may be used by the network as a trigger for certain services such as Call Forwarding on Busy.

question_25736.question: What is the spectral emission mask test purpose for intra-band non-contiguous EN-DC?
question_25736.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that the power of any UE emissions shall not exceed specified level for the specified channel bandwidth.

question_25737.question: What diameter AVP is used to indicate the supported mobile IP capabilities of a non-3GPP access network?

question_25738.question: How can an attribute within a structured data type be specified if its data type is "Any Type"?
question_25738.ground_truth: If the data type of an attribute is "Any Type", it can be any of "integer", "number", "string", "boolean", "array" or "object" as defined in the OpenAPI specification, or a data type defined in a 3GPP specification.

question_25739.question: What functionality in the RAN and UPF may support the Listener/Talker functionality?
question_25739.ground_truth: The RAN and UPF may support the functionality of Listener/Talker for hold and buffer functionality, stream transformation, and retrieving interface capabilities/end station interfaces from the Talker/Listener via Transparent Container.

question_25740.question: What is the significance of preserving all bits in the fixed section of release data when rewriting a database?
question_25740.ground_truth: Preserving all bits in the fixed section of release data when rewriting a database ensures backward compatibility, as these bits may be used in the future for extensions without the need for a new version.

question_25741.question: What is the overall delay measured for Test 1 and Test 2 in the NR SA FR1 Event triggered reporting tests with per-UE gaps under DRX for 2 Rx UE?
question_25741.ground_truth: The overall delay measured for Test 1 is less than 922 ms, and for Test 2 is less than 6402 ms.

question_25743.question: When should the Service Gap timer be started in AMF and UE when entering CM-IDLE state?
question_25743.ground_truth: The Service Gap timer should be started in AMF and UE when entering CM-IDLE state if there is no uplink data status and if the connection was not initiated after a paging of an MT event, or after a Registration procedure without Uplink data status or after a Registration procedure for regulatory prioritized services like Emergency services or exception reporting. This is applicable if Service Gap Control is applied for the UE.

question_25744.question: What is the duration of the test to verify the mobile station's ability to update the Timing Advance Index when received as part of PACKET POWER CONTROL /TIMING ADVANCE?
question_25744.ground_truth: The maximum duration of the test is 2 minutes.

question_25747.question: What is the name of the enumerated type in the RF-ParametersMRDC to indicate the power class of MSD-Information-r18?

question_25748.question: What does the MME do when it receives a RRC "HO to CS Request" message from the eNodeB?
question_25748.ground_truth: The MME generates S3 FWD RELOCATION REQUEST and sends it towards the SGSN, via the IWF which is in MME-SGSN S3 signalling path.

question_25749.question: What does the FSMnSProducer maintain and manage within the AlarmList?
question_25749.ground_truth: The FSMnSProducer maintains an AlarmList that contains currently active alarms and alarms that are cleared but not yet acknowledged.

question_25750.question: What aspects of complexity will be compared between system proposals?
question_25750.ground_truth: The following aspects of complexity will be compared between system proposals: silicon area in absolute value or relative to the reference, processor cycles/second, external components, number of components, and any special requirements that affect relative cost.

question_25752.question: What should the IWF do if an authorized MCPTT user cancels an interworking group's in-progress imminent peril state?
question_25752.ground_truth: The IWF should cancel the group's in-progress imminent peril state by sending IWF in-progress imminent peril group state cancel request(s) to the MCPTT server.

question_25753.question: What is the purpose of the EPS mobile identity information element, and what type and length is it?
question_25753.ground_truth: The EPS mobile identity information element provides the IMSI, GUTI, or IMEI. It is a type 4 information element with a minimum length of 3 octets and a maximum length of 13 octets.

question_25754.question: What is the starting point for accommodating the impact from the directionality of the AoA1-AoA2 DL orientation vectors?
question_25754.ground_truth: The starting point for accommodating the impact from the directionality of the AoA1-AoA2 DL orientation vectors is to test both +AoA offset and -AoA offset for each test point and ensure no testing bias is introduced.

question_25755.question: How do TLS entities verify the received certificate for inter-domain SBA connection?
question_25755.ground_truth: TLS entities use the interconnection CA certificate to verify the received certificate for inter-domain SBA connection.

question_25756.question: What is the requirement for the overall delay measured when DRX cycle length is 1280 ms?
question_25756.ground_truth: The overall delay measured when DRX cycle length is 1280 ms shall be less than a total of 7682 ms.

question_25757.question: What information does the MS receive to detect entering a new cell or a new RA?
question_25757.ground_truth: The MS detects entering a new cell by comparing the cell's identity with the cell identity stored in the MS. By comparing the RAI stored in the MS's MM context with the RAI received from the network, the MS detects that an RA update shall be performed.

question_25758.question: What must the PCF service consumer provide in the HTTP POST request when creating an "Individual PCF for a PDU Session Binding" resource and the BSF supports the "SamePcf" feature as defined in clause~5.8?
question_25758.ground_truth: The PCF service consumer must include the "paraCom" attribute in the HTTP POST message.

question_25759.question: What is the index of the positioning frequency layer in the measurement period requirements for NR-Multi-RTT-ProvideAssistanceData and NR-Multi-RTT-RequestLocationInformation messages in 3GPP 5G NR physical layer?

question_25760.question: What is CRRN1 in 6.2.8.1.1.1 for normal execution?
question_25760.ground_truth: The copyAdditionalInformation() method shall copy a part of the additional information field from Result TLV element in dstBuffer, using dstOffset and dstLength.

question_25762.question: What overload control mechanism does the MTC-IWF implement when the MME/SGSN is overloaded?
question_25762.ground_truth: The MTC-IWF implements overload control by suppressing trigger requests, such as stopping the forwarding of stored trigger requests, rejecting/dropping new arrival trigger requests, sending notification messages to the MTC server, or deleting stored trigger requests with reporting trigger failure to the MTC server.

question_25764.question: What is the coding scheme used by the EC-BCCH for CIoT devices?
question_25764.ground_truth: The EC-BCCH uses the same coding scheme as currently used by the BCCH, i.e. CS-1.

question_25765.question: How should the mobile station behave when the transmit window is stalled in EC-GSM-IoT?
question_25765.ground_truth: The mobile station should set the stall indicator to 1 in each RLC data block transmitted once the transmit window is stalled, retransmit blocks that are pending acknowledgement, and retransmit unacknowledged RLC data blocks in correct order while the transmit window is stalled.

question_25767.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's study on interconnection and migration aspects for railways?
question_25767.ground_truth: The study aims to identify gaps in existing mechanisms on interconnection and migration, and develop solutions for those gaps to support mission critical communications in railways.

question_25768.question: What is the purpose of network interworking in GPRS packet domain PLMN?
question_25768.ground_truth: Network interworking is required for execution of service requests involving packet domain PLMN and any other network. It takes place through the Gi or SGi reference point and the Gp or S8 interface.

question_25769.question: What is the purpose of the XnAP Retrieve UE Context procedure in the SDT procedure over RACH?
question_25769.ground_truth: The XnAP Retrieve UE Context procedure is used to retrieve the UE context from the last serving gNB when the UE initiates SDT over RACH and accesses a different gNB. This allows the receiving gNB to handle SDT data and signaling for the UE.

question_25771.question: What are some advantages of using the ACME protocol for certificate management in a 5G SBA?
question_25771.ground_truth: The ACME protocol, when used in a 5G SBA, simplifies deployment of TLS, automates cryptographic key material changes, reduces the chance of global outages, makes monitoring certificate lifecycles easier, leads to quicker responses to global outages, and removal of vendor lock-in for certificate issuance. It also improves network security by using certificates uniformly across the ecosystem, and supports both public trust anchors and private PKI.

question_25772.question: What does the local MCVideo system not specify in the process of routing the SIP request through an exit MCVideo gateway server?
question_25772.ground_truth: How the local MCVideo system routes the SIP request through an exit MCVideo gateway server is out of the scope of the present document.

question_25773.question: What is the principle of Solution #1 related to Key Issue #1 (How are the UE capabilities identified)?
question_25773.ground_truth: Solution #1 suggests using a UE manufacturer-specific UE capability ID, which is a short pointer with distinct UE Radio Capabilities for each UE manufacturer-specific UE capability ID.

question_25775.question: What element must be present in the "match-report" element when it is sent from the UE to the ProSe Function to report a matching of the direct discovery?
question_25775.ground_truth: A "ProSe-Application-Code" element must be present in the "match-report" element.

question_25776.question: What state does a UE enter if the PLMN selection fails in 3GPP access and the message is successfully integrity checked by the NAS, while the UE supports registration over other access to the same PLMN?
question_25776.ground_truth: The UE shall enter state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED and handle 5GMM parameters and 5GMM state for this access, as described for the specific 5GMM cause value.

question_25777.question: What information does the DRNC include in the NBAP message Radio Link Setup Request to the NodeB?
question_25777.ground_truth: The DRNC includes the cell id, UL DPDCH Indicator for E-DCH operation, E-DPCH Information, and E-DCH FDD Information in the NBAP message Radio Link Setup Request to the NodeB.

question_25778.question: What are the potential categorization of tasks in a workflow?
question_25778.ground_truth: The potential categorization of tasks in a workflow includes intent translation, awareness, analysis, decision, and execution.

question_25779.question: What is the difference between TSi and TSr in the 3GPP's GAN technical specification?
question_25779.ground_truth: TSi and TSr are Traffic Selectors used in the IPsec tunnel negotiation between the MS and GANC-SEGW. TSi is used by the MS to identify the traffic that it sends, while TSr is used by the GANC-SEGW to identify the traffic that it receives. The TSi and TSr values include the IP addresses and ports used in the communication between the MS and GANC-SEGW.

question_25780.question: What information is included in the N2 SM information in the List Of PDU Sessions to Hand-over?
question_25780.ground_truth: The N2 SM information in the List Of PDU Sessions to Hand-over contains per each PDU Session ID T-RAN N3 addressing information, including N3 UP address and Tunnel ID of T-RAN for the PDU Session.

question_25781.question: What is the purpose of encoding the GTP-U extension header type so that intermediate UPFs/GTP-U entities pass the header on to the final GTP-U endpoint even if they do not understand it?
question_25781.ground_truth: This is done to enable smooth operation with legacy RAN nodes.

question_25782.question: Which codecs should be supported by MTSI clients in terminals offering super-wideband or full band speech communication?
question_25782.ground_truth: EVS codec (TS 26.441, TS 26.444, TS 26.445, TS 26.447, TS 26.451, TS 26.442, TS 26.452, and TS 26.443) with functions for backwards compatibility with AMR-WB and discontinuous transmission.

question_25783.question: In what direction does the PCEF discard packets when there is no matching service data flow template?
question_25783.ground_truth: For the uplink direction, discarding packets due to no matching service data flow template is also referred to as uplink bearer binding verification.

question_25784.question: What is the difference between the three digits in the version number of the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_25784.ground_truth: The first digit indicates the stage of the TSG's approval process, the second digit is incremented for changes of substance, and the third digit is incremented for editorial changes.

question_25785.question: What should the UE do if it receives a 486, 600, or 603 response to the INVITE request containing a multipart/mixed body with an "application/EmergencyCallData.Control+xml" MIME body part and specific elements?
question_25785.ground_truth: The UE should consider the initial MSD transmission as successful and perform domain selection to re-attempt the eCall if it receives a 486, 600, or 603 response to the INVITE request containing a multipart/mixed body with an "application/EmergencyCallData.Control+xml" MIME body part and specific elements.

question_25786.question: What is the standard minimum distance from the ground for a HAPS BS?

question_25787.question: What is the purpose of the Forward Relocation Complete message in the PS Handover procedure?
question_25787.ground_truth: The Forward Relocation Complete message indicates that the PS Handover procedure has been successfully finished.

question_25788.question: How does the TA value affect the transmission of access bursts for packet switched channels in GSM network?
question_25788.ground_truth: The TA value for packet switched channels is used to derive the timing advance for the access bursts. The MS shall transmit access bursts with TA value=0 and receive the updated value of TA from the BTS on the downlink PTCCH, which it shall always use for the uplink transmission of normal bursts.

question_25789.question: What information does the SCEF store for MTC device trigger procedures involving T4?
question_25789.ground_truth: The information stored in SMS-SC for MTC device trigger procedures involving T4 includes the Trigger Payload (stored as user data in SMS-SC), Priority, Validity period, and SMS Application Port ID.

question_25790.question: What architecture enhancements does solution #1 propose for the SEALDD enabler layer?
question_25790.ground_truth: Solution #1 proposes functional architecture, reference points, and traffic flow architecture enhancements for the SEALDD enabler layer.

question_25791.question: What should the S-CSCF do if the SIP digest with TLS as a security mechanism does not match with the expected REGISTER request?
question_25791.ground_truth: If the S-CSCF receives a REGISTER request with the "integrity-protected" header field parameter in the Authorization header field set to "tls-yes", "ip-assoc-yes", "tls-pending", or "ip-assoc-pending", for which the public user identity received in the To header field and the private user identity received in the Authorization header field of the REGISTER request do not match to any registered or initial registration pending user at this S-CSCF, if the S-CSCF does not support S-CSCF restoration procedures, the S-CSCF shall respond with a 500 (Server Internal Error) response to the UE.

question_25792.question: What are the implications of using fast re-authentication and when is it recommended?
question_25792.ground_truth: Fast re-authentication saves power consumption and processing time for WLAN UE and 3GPP AAA server. It is recommended when the user is accessing high trusted I-WLANs but should be avoided in low trusted I-WLANs.

question_25793.question: What is the final condition that must be met in order for the test to pass in section 9.2.58.4.2?
question_25793.ground_truth: For the test to pass in section 9.2.58.4.2, all events must pass for each scenario.

question_25794.question: How does PCF determine the DN priorities for appDomains?
question_25794.ground_truth: PCF determines the DN priorities for appDomains by receiving policies from different AFs, building a unique map of relative priorities between (DNN, S-NSSAI) for a given domain, and considering local policies to resolve potential conflicts.

question_25795.question: What does CT6 consider for a potential need for a modification of the required support of a feature?
question_25795.ground_truth: CT6 considers a potential need for a modification of the required support of a feature when a common understanding is reached about the potential need for it.

question_25796.question: What should the MCVideo function do if the <allow-request-locally-initiated-ambient-viewing> element is set to "false" in the MCVideo user profile document?
question_25796.ground_truth: The MCVideo function shall reject the "SIP REFER request for a pre-established session" with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response, with warning text set to "154 The MCVideo user is not authorized to make an ambient viewing call" in a Warning header field as specified in clause~4.4.

question_25798.question: Which two network entities work together to determine the RFSP for the Target NSSAI and the Allowed NSSAI?
question_25798.ground_truth: The AMF and PCF work together to determine the RFSP for the Target NSSAI and the Allowed NSSAI, with the AMF applying the RFSP to the Target NSSAI and sending the corresponding indices to the NG-RAN, and the PCF selecting the RFSP for the Allowed NSSAI.

question_25799.question: What is the difference between stereo signal and video signal in the context of a FLUS system?
question_25799.ground_truth: A stereo signal is a type of signal that exists for each eye in a FLUS system, while a video signal typically consists of three color components: luminance (Y) and two chrominance components (U and V).

question_25800.question: What is the purpose of the r12:serviceArea element in the deliveryMethod element in clause 4.2.7.5.5?
question_25800.ground_truth: The r12:serviceArea element specifies the service area in which the NRT contents delivered on the FLUTE session associated with that instance of deliveryMethod.

question_25801.question: What is the role of the BBF BNG in the reference architecture?
question_25801.ground_truth: The BBF BNG may be enhanced to support new functionality such as provisioning of policies from the BPCF.

question_25802.question: Which operation is used to include a schema in another schema in the XML schema language?
question_25802.ground_truth: The "xs:include" element is used to include one schema in another schema in the XML schema language.

question_25803.question: What is the newly designed example algorithm set for the 3GPP Authentication and Key Generation Functions, referred to as Tuak, pronounced as "too-ack"?
question_25803.ground_truth: Tuak is a second trusted example set of (f1 - f5*) algorithms, serving as a fallback in case MILENAGE is ever compromised and providing choice and resilience against future cryptanalysis.

question_25804.question: What standard is TS~23.501 a part of?
question_25804.ground_truth: It is a part of the 5G System; Stage 2 standard.

question_25805.question: What technology does QTG use to provide a tour to Peng, Pan, and Adrian?
question_25805.ground_truth: QTG uses earbuds, microphone, earbuds, and display capabilities to provide a tour to Peng, Pan, and Adrian.

question_25806.question: What event triggers the AMF to interact with the PCF and update RFSP index related policy information in the AMF based on the S-NSSAI(s) rejected partially in the RA?
question_25806.ground_truth: A Change of the S-NSSAI(s) rejected partially in the RA trigger

question_25807.question: What is a partially cached Representation in the context of DASH-enabled proxy caching?
question_25807.ground_truth: A partially cached Representation is a Representation that has segment gaps, meaning that not all segments of the Representation are cached in the proxy cache.

question_25809.question: What should the operator ensure when selecting an S-CSCF based on the list of capabilities received from the HSS?
question_25809.ground_truth: The operator should ensure that there are S-CSCFs which have mandatory capabilities indicated by the HSS for any given user.

question_25811.question: Which type of threats involve the malicious modification of data?

question_25813.question: What is the expected behavior of the UE when the maximum RTT value or maximum packet loss rate value is exceeded in the load balancing steering mode for a MA PDU session?
question_25813.ground_truth: The UE and UPF reduce the amount of traffic sent over that access and send traffic over the other access. If both the maximum RTT value and the maximum packet loss rate value for both accesses do not exceed the provided threshold values, the UE and the UPF steer the SDF traffic across both the 3GPP access and non-3GPP access as indicated by the steering information of the ATSSS rule.

question_25816.question: What is the equation used to recombine the extracted tonal and ambiance components adaptively in the recombination process?
question_25816.ground_truth: The combined signal is obtained using the equation S(n) = |A(n)|*Amb(n) + |T(n)|*Ton(n)*sign(T(n)), where Amb(n) is the ambiance component, Ton(n) is the tonal component, A(n) and T(n) are the absolute values of Amb(n) and Ton(n) respectively, and sign(T(n)) is the sign of the tonal component.

question_25817.question: Which key is used for encrypting XML content and key material in 9.3.4.2 and 9.3.4.2 respectively?
question_25817.ground_truth: The Client-Server Key (CSK) is used for encrypting XML content, while the manually provisioned Signalling Protection Key (SPK) is used for encrypting XML key material.

question_25818.question: What does the spare half octet contain in every 5GMM message in 3GPP TS 24.007?
question_25818.ground_truth: The spare half octet in every 5GMM message in 3GPP TS 24.007 contains spare bits set to zero.

question_25820.question: What should be the alignment of the manufacturer declared coordinate system orientation of the AAS BS with the test system in step 2?
question_25820.ground_truth: The manufacturer declared coordinate system orientation of the AAS BS should be aligned with the test system in step 2.

question_25822.question: What does the term "Non-Public Network" mean in the context of 5G Systems?
question_25822.ground_truth: A Non-Public Network (NPN) is a 5G System that operates as a private network, separating its spectrum from that of a public network, providing connectivity within a limited geographical area and allowing the deployment and use of customized and dedicated services.

question_25826.question: What message does the MSC-1 server send to the target MSC-server when it receives the A-HO-DETECT/COMPLETE message?
question_25826.ground_truth: The MSC-1 server sends the ANSWER message to the target MSC-server when it receives the A-HO-DETECT/COMPLETE message.

question_25827.question: What is the role of the MC service server 2 (MBS session control role) in this process?
question_25827.ground_truth: The MC service server 2 (MBS session control role) responds to media distribution requests, sends media distribution responses, and distributes media to MC service clients with MBS capabilities via MBS session.

question_25828.question: What is the length of the BWP ID field in the Enhanced Unified TCI States Activation/Deactivation MAC CE for Separate TCI States?
question_25828.ground_truth: The length of the BWP ID field is 2 bits.

question_25829.question: In the context of radio link monitoring in TS 38.133, what is the scheduling restriction during RLM for an active Type-D CSI-RS with active TCI state for PDCCH or PDSCH in the CSI-RS that is not in a CSI-RS resource set with repetition ON?
question_25829.ground_truth: There are no scheduling restrictions due to radio link monitoring based on the CSI-RS.

question_25831.question: What is the definition of unidirectional RRH deployment for Scenario-2 in the HST tunnel?
question_25831.ground_truth: For Scenario-2 in the HST tunnel, unidirectional RRH deployment refers to one panel per RRH pointed to the same direction for all RRHs.

question_25832.question: What must the location management server check before it requests stored location information from location management client1?
question_25832.ground_truth: The location management server must check the authorization of the request before it requests stored location information from location management client1.

question_25834.question: What is the coding scheme used in the USSD string for the SEND USSD procedure with UCS2 coding?

question_25835.question: What are the initial conditions specified for testing the Proactive UICC: Set Up Call functionality?
question_25835.ground_truth: The ME is connected to both the USIM Simulator and the USS. The elementary files are coded as USIM Application Toolkit default. Prior to this test the ME shall have been powered on, performed the PROFILE DOWNLOAD procedure and in the updated idle mode on the USS.

question_25836.question: What is the main focus of Key Issue 1 in the 3GPP policy study, namely Policy enhancement for sponsored data connectivity?
question_25836.ground_truth: Key Issue 1 focuses on policy enhancement needed for sponsored data connectivity, which allows users to access services provided by sponsors or 3rd party service providers while compensating for connectivity costs.

question_25837.question: What is the role of the Initial UE Position Estimate IE in the Position Calculation procedure?
question_25837.ground_truth: The Initial UE Position Estimate IE is used by the SAS to calculate the UE Position Estimate when A-GPS or A-GANSS positioning methods are used.

question_25839.question: What should the UE do with the list of "PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location" when switching off?
question_25839.ground_truth: When switching off, the UE retains the list of "PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location" in non-volatile memory and deletes it if the USIM is removed. When switching on after a shutdown, the UE restarts or considers expired the timer associated with the entry in the list based on hysteresis principles.

question_25841.question: How is policy control for EPC-routed traffic provided?
question_25841.ground_truth: Policy control for EPC-routed traffic is provided when either 3GPP access authentication or tunnel-based authentication is performed.

question_25843.question: In the home routed roaming architecture where a UPF is inserted in the UP path for the IPUPS functionality, who controls the UPF supporting IPUPS functionality?
question_25843.ground_truth: In this architecture, the UPF supporting IPUPS functionality in VPLMN and HPLMN are controlled by the V-SMF and the H-SMF respectively.

question_25845.question: What is the objective of the "SDM PDSCH PRB Usage" measurement in 5G?
question_25845.ground_truth: The objective of the "SDM PDSCH PRB Usage" measurement is to measure the usage of cell DL capacity in MIMO scenario by providing the total usage (in percentage) of PDSCH physical resource blocks (PRBs) based on statistical MIMO layers in the DL per cell.

question_25847.question: Who derives the analytics for network slice throughput in Solution #14?
question_25847.ground_truth: The NWDAF derives the analytics for network slice throughput in Solution #14.

question_25848.question: What is the requirement for the test to pass in the E-UTRAN TDD TDD intra-frequency event triggered reporting under fading propagation conditions in synchronous cells for UE category 1bis test case?
question_25848.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests shall be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

question_25849.question: What action should the SMF take when it does not accept the request to release the PDU session in the UE-requested PDU session release procedure?
question_25849.ground_truth: The SMF shall create a PDU SESSION RELEASE REJECT message, set the 5GSM cause IE of the message to indicate the reason for rejecting the PDU session release, and send the message back to the UE.

question_25851.question: What should be done to each character of the field-value of the Subject header if its delivery is unauthorized in a SIP message?
question_25851.ground_truth: Each character of the field-value of the Subject header should be replaced with a space.

question_25852.question: What is not required to be reported in the test?
question_25852.ground_truth: The SSB time index is not required to be reported in the test.

question_25853.question: How are Public User Identities compared in the HSS?
question_25853.ground_truth: Public User Identities are compared in the HSS as defined in IETF~RFC~3966, clause~4.

question_25855.question: What is the format for representing the version number in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_25855.ground_truth: The version number in the 3GPP technical specification is represented as x.y.z, where x represents the level of approval, y represents changes of substance, and z represents editorial changes.

question_25857.question: What is the role of the UE local service activation phase in MBMS broadcast service provision?
question_25857.ground_truth: The UE local service activation phase is when the MBMS user service part in the UE initiates reception of the MBMS bearer service to receive an MBMS user service.

question_25858.question: What is the primary substate when the UE enters the state 5GMM-REGISTERED and the cell the UE selected is known to be in an allowed area?

question_25862.question: What is the response of the MCPTT client when it receives MBMS bearer announcements via SIP MESSAGE messages?
question_25862.ground_truth: The MCPTT client responds by sending a SIP 200 (OK) to the SIP MESSAGE message and sends an MBMS listening status message via SIP MESSAGE.

question_25865.question: What are the two extreme cases for array antenna transceivers in terms of local oscillator (LO) signal generation and distribution?
question_25865.ground_truth: The two extreme cases are centralized LO generation with a single PLL for all transceivers and distributed LO generation with one PLL per transceiver.

question_25866.question: What is the purpose of the 8.34 command in a mobile phone?
question_25866.ground_truth: The 8.34 command is used to set a specific ring melody and volume for the selected call type and profile in a mobile phone.

question_25867.question: What is reproducibility in the context of 3GPP security assurance methodology?
question_25867.ground_truth: Reproducibility is the ability of a 3GPP security assurance methodology to produce identical results when applied to the same target at a different time, place, or by a different actor.

question_25868.question: What must the UE do to discover the V2X control function IP address as per 3GPP TS 33.185?
question_25868.ground_truth: The UE first tries to use the V2X control function IP address specified in 3GPP TS 33.187, if it is provisioned and is an IP address. If not, the UE performs DNS lookup of the V2X control function FQDN as specified in IETF RFC 1035 and shall use the resulting IP address as the discovered V2X control function address.

question_25869.question: What should a mobile station do with a received DTR information when it's already in DTR mode?
question_25869.ground_truth: Ignore the DTR information received in the RLC data block.

question_25872.question: What information is carried in the Context ID IE to uniquely identify a particular UE in the HNB and HNB-GW?
question_25872.ground_truth: The Context ID IE uniquely identifies a particular UE in the HNB and HNB-GW.

question_25873.question: What is the total number of successful tests required for the test case of NR SA FR1 event-triggered reporting without gap under non-DRX to pass?
question_25873.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests should be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

question_25874.question: What should the TWAN use as the PLMN of the PDN GW if neither the Visited Network Identifier, the FQDN of the PDN GW, nor the PLMN where the 3GPP AAA Server is located are available for static PDN GW assignment?
question_25874.ground_truth: The TWAN should use the PLMN where the 3GPP AAA Server is located.

question_25875.question: What is the maximum number of retransmissions due to false or missed ACK detections in series?
question_25875.ground_truth: The maximum number of retransmissions is specified in Annex F.6.4.

question_25876.question: What is the effect of multiplexing four users with four repetitions in an overlaid CDMA system?
question_25876.ground_truth: There is a performance loss of 0.7 dB in the average SCPIR scenario and about 2.9 dB in the "worst case" SCPIR scenario.

question_25877.question: What is the criteria for the SGSN to determine if an SM procedure, such as SGSN-Initiated PDP Context Modification or PDP Context Deactivation, should be initiated when the SGSN fails to re-establish RAB(s) for the PDP context(s)?
question_25877.ground_truth: The appropriate action depends on the QoS profile of the PDP context and is an operator choice.

question_25878.question: What should the MAC entity do if a PRACH occasion is selected but the Random Access Preamble was not selected among the contention-based Random Access Preambles?
question_25878.ground_truth: The MAC entity should select a PUSCH occasion and deliver the UL grant and the associated HARQ information to the HARQ entity for the MSGA payload in the selected PUSCH occasion.

question_25879.question: What is the role of bearer services in determining the Quality of Service (QoS) in network communication?
question_25879.ground_truth: Bearer services are characterized by a set of end-to-end QoS characteristics with requirements on QoS. They are key in determining the QoS as perceived by the customer in network communication between two or more access points.

question_25880.question: What is the role of the Implementation Conformance Statement (ICS) in MC services over LTE?
question_25880.ground_truth: ICS in MC services over LTE is a document that shows the conformance of a specific implementation to the 3GPP MC service requirements. It provides information on the features and functions implemented by a specific UE and its compliance with the MC service requirements. It is used to ensure the interoperability between different UE's and network elements.

question_25881.question: When would the V-SMF indicate to the H-SMF whether the request for an always-on PDU Session is accepted or not?
question_25881.ground_truth: If the PDU Session being established was requested to be an always-on PDU Session, the H-SMF indicates to the V-SMF whether the request is accepted or not via the Always-on PDU Session Granted indication in the response message to V-SMF.

question_25884.question: What is the purpose of the NSUC parameter in the PWS architecture?
question_25884.ground_truth: The NSUC (Network Signature Validity Counter) parameter is used to prevent replay attacks by ensuring that the warning messages are distributing the latest public keys and signatures.

question_25885.question: What does the superviseDataSessionReq() method do in the IpDataSession interface?
question_25885.ground_truth: The superviseDataSessionReq() method is used by the application to supervise a data session and set a granted data volume for it. The measurement of time starts as soon as the data session is connected. The Data Session object persists after the data session has terminated.

question_25888.question: What is the impact on UL packet loss after enabling SPS PDSCH reception/Type-2 CG PUSCH transmission/SP-CSI reporting on PUSCH without reactivation after BWP switching?
question_25888.ground_truth: The UL packet loss can be by 28.4%~14.47% after enabling SPS PDSCH reception/Type-2 CG PUSCH transmission/SP-CSI reporting on PUSCH without reactivation after BWP switching.

question_25889.question: What should the MS do if it has a FQDN of the Provisioning SEGW?
question_25889.ground_truth: The MS should perform a public DNS query to retrieve the IP-address of the Provisioning SEGW and establish a secure connection towards the Provisioning SEGW.

question_25892.question: What should the UE ensure regarding the feature set IDs if the NR or E-UTRA network requests UE capabilities for nr, eutra-nr or eutra?
question_25892.ground_truth: The UE should ensure that the feature set IDs are consistent across feature sets, feature set combinations and band combinations in all three UE capability containers that the network queries with the same fields with the same values.

question_25893.question: How should a mobile station receive system information and paging messages if it's in broadcast/multicast receive mode?
question_25893.ground_truth: The mobile station shall, in parallel to the MBMS data, read system information for the serving cell from the broadcast control channel and CS and/or PS paging messages from its paging group on the paging channel(s) allocated in the cell. However, reading system information and paging messages takes precedence over listening to the MBMS session.

question_25894.question: What is the effect of the "Rf" reference point in the SMS offline charging architecture?
question_25894.ground_truth: The "Rf" reference point in the SMS offline charging architecture is the interface between a 3G network element and the CDF, which is used for offline charging.

question_25895.question: What is the main goal of the User Data Convergence (UDC) in the 3GPP system?
question_25895.ground_truth: The main goal of UDC is to simplify the overall network topology and interfaces, avoid data duplication and inconsistency, and facilitate the creation of new services by providing easy access to user data.

question_25896.question: What action should the UE take when the plmn-Identity in the VarConnEstFailReport is not equal to the RPLMN, and the VarConnEstFailReportList is not empty?
question_25896.ground_truth: The UE should clear the content included in VarConnEstFailReport except for the numberOfConnFail, and store the connection establishment failure information in the VarConnEstFailReport as specified.

question_25897.question: What is necessary prior to testing the ME's response to Proactive Commands in the USIM Application Toolkit?
question_25897.ground_truth: Prior to testing, the ME should have been powered on, performed the PROFILE DOWNLOAD procedure, and be in the updated idle mode on the USS.

question_25898.question: What action should the SMF take if it receives a request for retrieving the complete SM context and there are downlink data packets buffered at I-UPF?
question_25898.ground_truth: The SMF should include the "forwardingInd" attribute with value "true" in the response body to indicate the presence of buffered downlink data packets.

question_25899.question: What is the frequency range specified for out-of-band band blocking for NR V2X bands in clause 7.6E.3?
question_25899.ground_truth: The frequency range specified for out-of-band band blocking for NR V2X bands in clause 7.6E.3 is 30 MHz below or above the UE receive band.

question_25902.question: What type of data does the "<RelativePresentationPriority>" element contain and where is it used?
question_25902.ground_truth: The "<RelativePresentationPriority>" element contains an integer value between 0 and 255 and it is used to indicate the presentation priority of the on-network group relative to other on-network groups and on-network users or off-network groups and off-network users. It is used in the "<MCPTTGroupInfo>" element of the "<OnNetwork>" and "<OffNetwork>" elements.

question_25906.question: What should the P-CSCF do when it receives a target refresh request for a dialog with a Request-URI containing a GRUU?
question_25906.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should obtain the UE IP address and UE protected server port related to the GRUU contained in the Request-URI and rewrite the Request-URI with that UE IP address and UE protected server port. After that, it should perform the steps in subclause 5.2.6.4 for when the P-CSCF receives, destined for the UE, a target refresh request for a dialog.

question_25907.question: What procedures are followed by the NWDAF to provide UE mobility analytics with finer granularity than TA/cell?
question_25907.ground_truth: The NWDAF can interface with the GMLC/AMF to obtain location information for a UE using LCS procedures, or act as a GMLC client and obtain location information directly from the AMF.

question_25909.question: When do co-located, synchronized TDD base stations require special co-location requirements?
question_25909.ground_truth: Co-located, synchronized TDD base stations require special co-location requirements when they are unsynchronized.

question_25910.question: What is determined as the CN type when the UE is registered both in EPC and 5GC, or some members of a Group of UEs are registered in EPC while some members are registered in 5GC?

question_25912.question: How does the power allocation differ between case a) and case b) in 4.8.4a?
question_25912.ground_truth: In case a), each carrier is set to the same power such that the sum of the carrier powers equals the rated total output power. In case b), the power allocated per carrier for the RAT on which modulation quality is measured is the highest possible, while the power of the remaining carriers from other RAT(s) is set to the same level as in case a).

question_25914.question: What should be the T3212 time-out value in the NO CELL AVAILABLE, LIMITED SERVICE, PLMN SEARCH and PLMN SEARCH-NORMAL SERVICE states?
question_25914.ground_truth: The T3212 time-out value should not be changed in these states.

question_25915.question: In the context of GTP' transfer scenarios, what is the purpose of the networking layer and lower layers?
question_25915.ground_truth: The networking layer (IP) is responsible for transmitting the GTP' messages, while the L2 and L1 layers, which are not specified in the document, form the lower layers of the network.

question_25918.question: What is the required throughput for the PUSCH performance requirement, expressed as a fraction of the maximum throughput for the reference channels listed in Annex A?
question_25918.ground_truth: The required throughput is expressed as a fraction of maximum throughput for the FRCs listed in Annex A.

question_25919.question: What measure should the MCX Service take to minimize the impact of denial of service attacks on the network and on MCX users?

question_25922.question: What is the role of the USAT Interpreter in executing an USAT command?
question_25922.ground_truth: The USAT Interpreter issues a regular USAT command to the UE using the USAT protocol when executing an Execute USAT command byte code. The translation procedure occurs from the Execute USAT Command TLV to an USAT command.

question_25923.question: Under what circumstances should the UE in 5GMM-IDLE mode over 3GPP access include the Uplink data status IE in the SERVICE REQUEST message?
question_25923.ground_truth: The UE should include the Uplink data status IE in the SERVICE REQUEST message if it has uplink signalling or user data pending over 3GPP access.

question_25924.question: What is modified in the HARQ operation for satellite RAN supporting NR?
question_25924.ground_truth: The HARQ operation is disabled or modified in the 5G network's satellite RAN to accommodate the effects of satellite delay and associated RTT.

question_25925.question: When must the UE release the traffic flow aggregate description if it receives a MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message with a PTI value different than "no procedure transaction identity assigned" and "reserved"?
question_25925.ground_truth: The UE must release the traffic flow aggregate description when it receives a MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message containing a PTI value other than "no procedure transaction identity assigned" and "reserved" and when it is associated with a UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure or a UE requested bearer resource modification procedure.

question_25928.question: Which key characteristics of packet domain are found in 3GPP TS 23.060?
question_25928.ground_truth: The key characteristics of PLMN related to the packet domain are found in 3GPP TS 23.060.

question_25929.question: What should be the value of AMR-WB at IPv6 if the mode-set includes 6.60, 8.85, and 12.65, the packetization time is 20, and no extra bandwidth is allocated for redundancy?
question_25929.ground_truth: The value should be set to 38.

question_25932.question: What information included in the NAICS Information IE replaces corresponding NAICS information at the receiver?
question_25932.ground_truth: When the NAICS Information IE is set to "NAICS Inactive", the existing NAICS information at the receiver is considered invalid and replaced by the new information.

question_25933.question: When the SMF detects that a policy decision cannot be enforced, what action is taken if the SMF does not need to reject the request?
question_25933.ground_truth: The SMF includes one or more PartialSuccessReport data structure(s) in the response message with an HTTP "200 OK" status code to report the partial success of policy decision and/or condition data.

question_25935.question: What kind of information is included in the Measurement Assistance policy provided to the UE?
question_25935.ground_truth: The Measurement Assistance policy provided to the UE includes the address of a network function (PMF), the protocol to use for the measurements, the maximum duration and/or the maximum number of bytes to transmit during a measurement session, and how frequently the UE should initiate a measurement session on a specific access.

question_25937.question: In what situations can the network use the 5GMM cause value #7 (5GS services not allowed) when rejecting the initial registration request from a UE?
question_25937.ground_truth: If the network does not authorize the UE to use a certain CAG, or if the UE roams and is not allowed to use certain services or PLMNs.

question_25938.question: What is the role of the UE-to-UE Relay in the 5G DDNMF of the Target UE?
question_25938.ground_truth: The UE-to-UE Relay responds to the 5G DDNMF of the Target UE with a Discovery Response message including security parameters and the chosen PC5 ciphering algorithm. It also stores the Code-Sending Security Parameters, Code-Receiving Security Parameters, and the chosen PC5 ciphering algorithm together with the RSC.

question_25941.question: What is the role of a PEGC in the PIN architecture?
question_25941.ground_truth: A PEGC in the PIN architecture is responsible for terminating application sessions, maintaining synchronization among sub-flows, and obtaining QoS Rules for the new flow.

question_25942.question: What is the required HS-PDSCH category that the minimum UE classes should support in the described combinations?
question_25942.ground_truth: The required HS-PDSCH category that the minimum UE classes should support in the described combinations is category 11.

question_25944.question: What is the requirement for the SLSS transmission initiation delay in the cell selection state?
question_25944.ground_truth: The SLSS transmission initiation delay shall be less than 0.84 seconds.

question_25945.question: In the primary classifier decision at 24.4 kbps, what is Condition I?
question_25945.ground_truth: Condition I is the condition that the average energy of certain sub-bands in the speech signal is greater than the threshold and the peak-to-average ratio is greater than the threshold.

question_25946.question: What is the total time allowed for the UE to read the relevant system information blocks and the procedures?
question_25946.ground_truth: The total time allowed for the UE to read the relevant system information blocks and the procedures is 7.82s.

question_25947.question: What is the role of the DRA in a network that deploys multiple and separately addressable PCRFs in a Diameter realm?
question_25947.ground_truth: The DRA (Diameter Routing Agent) ensures that all Diameter sessions for Gx, S9, Gxa/c and Rx for a certain IP-CAN session reach the same PCRF in a network that deploys multiple and separately addressable PCRFs in a Diameter realm.

question_25948.question: What is the key difference between Solution #6 and Solution #7 in addressing KI#1 scenario 2?
question_25948.ground_truth: Solution #6 and Solution #7 can be paired and allow AF in VPLMN to provide H-PCF with information that can be used to build URSP rules with PLMN ID(s) in Location Criteria. However, Solution #7 includes the "Revaluation Suggested" indication while Solution #6 does not.

question_25951.question: What are the minimum and maximum values for the MbmsSaIdentityFormat and MbsfnAreaIdentityFormat simple types, and what data types do they restrict?
question_25951.ground_truth: The MbmsSaIdentityFormat simple type restricts the base type of xs:integer with a minimum inclusive value of 0 and a maximum inclusive value of 65535. The MbsfnAreaIdentityFormat simple type restricts the base type of xs:integer with a minimum inclusive value of 0 and a maximum inclusive value of 255.

question_25953.question: What is the type and length of the relay reselection indication information element?
question_25953.ground_truth: The relay reselection indication information element is a type 1 information element with a length of 1 octet.

question_25954.question: What is the maximum non-public network latency that a professional cameraman can tolerate between his wireless camera and the return video in his viewfinder?
question_25954.ground_truth: The maximum non-public network latency tolerated by a professional cameraman between his wireless camera and the return video in his viewfinder coming back from the mixing console is 40 ms.

question_25955.question: What is the priority of UCI type when a UE determines not to expect more than one PUCCH from the first PUCCH and the second PUCCHs to start at a same slot and include a UCI type with the same priority?
question_25955.ground_truth: The UE does not expect more than one PUCCH from the first PUCCH and the second PUCCHs to start at a same slot and include a UCI type with the same priority.

question_25956.question: What should the MS do if the timer TU3904 expires and GAN registration is unsuccessful after a number of attempts defined by the MS parameter "Up Register Max Retries"?
question_25956.ground_truth: The MS shall act as defined in sub-clause 6.2.4.5, which could include stopping all ongoing registration procedures, releasing the TCP connection and secure connection, and initiating registration towards the Default GANC as defined in sub-clause 6.2.1.

question_25958.question: What should be the state of the mobile in 27.22.4.26.1.4.1 Initial conditions?
question_25958.ground_truth: The mobile shall be in idle mode, and there should be no active PDP contexts established before fetching the proactive command.

question_25959.question: What is the rule for UE to measure one of the CSI-RS for RLM when it is in the same OFDM symbol as the SSB for BFD?
question_25959.ground_truth: UE is required to measure one of but not both CSI-RS for RLM and SSB when the CSI-RS for RLM is in the same OFDM symbol as the SSB for BFD or when UE detects beam failure. Longer measurement period for CSI-RS based RLM is expected, and no requirements are defined.

question_25962.question: What is the gain in terms of time for a specific number of users to receive data without errors with an event-based scheme compared to regular polling?
question_25962.ground_truth: The gain is substantial, with a larger number of users receiving an LLC packet within a certain time limit compared to regular polling (assumed set to 12).

question_25964.question: In the context of combined CELL/URA update and SRNS relocation, when the ME and the target RNC use the chained keys for communication, what message does the ME send to the target RNC to indicate that it is capable of the enhanced UTRAN KH?
question_25964.ground_truth: The ME informs the target about that it is capable of the enhanced UTRAN KH in the UTRAN Mobility Information Confirm (uplink message 10).

question_25965.question: Which subclauses in TS 36.101 need to be updated for the combined Rx implementation in 6.3.8.2.2?
question_25965.ground_truth: The subclauses that need to be updated for the combined Rx implementation in 6.3.8.2.2 are 8.2.1.7 and 8.2.1.8 in TS 36.101.

question_25966.question: What action should the MS take if it receives a page while it has not yet decoded the full BCCH data for the cell?
question_25966.ground_truth: The MS should store the page and respond once it has decoded the full BCCH data, provided that the cell is not barred and the MS's access class is allowed.

question_25967.question: What should the UE do after sending a CSI report with non-zero CQI index for PSCell in step 6?
question_25967.ground_truth: The UE should stop sending CSI reports for PSCell no later than 20ms from the start of T5.

question_25968.question: What actions should the PGW-C take when it detects a partial failure?
question_25968.ground_truth: The PGW-C sends Sx Session Set Deletion Request and Delete PDN Connection Set Request messages to the affected PGW-U and SGW-C, respectively, to delete the affected user plane resources and retrieve the usage report for each affected Sx session.

question_25970.question: What is the definition of Automatic Commencement mode in MCPTT service?
question_25970.ground_truth: Automatic Commencement mode is a mode in which the initiation of the private call does not require any action on the part of the receiving MCPTT user.

question_25972.question: What is the condition for the relative accuracy of RSRP inter-frequency measurement in 3GPP TS 36.133?
question_25972.ground_truth: The relative accuracy of RSRP inter-frequency measurement is valid under the condition that the cell specific reference signals are transmitted either from one, two, or four antenna ports, and the conditions defined in 3GPP TS 36.101 clause 7.3 for reference sensitivity are fulfilled.

question_25975.question: What is the maximum number of broadcast D2D transmitters allowed for public safety use case, assuming 4 blind HARQ transmissions per packet and max power transmissions?
question_25975.ground_truth: The maximum number of broadcast D2D transmitters allowed for public safety use case, assuming 4 blind HARQ transmissions per packet and max power transmissions, is 6/cell.

question_25977.question: What is the procedure for the SMF when it receives the DL Periodicity, if available, from the UPF and the "traffParaData" attribute includes the "reqTrafficParas" attribute?
question_25977.ground_truth: The SMF requests the UPF to monitor and report the measured Traffic Parameter(s) using the N4 Session Modification procedure, and at reception of the measured Traffic Parameter(s) from the UPF, the SMF includes the measured N6 Jitter Information associated with the DL Periodicity in the TSCAI and forwards it to the NG-RAN as specified in 3GPP~TS~29.502.

question_25978.question: What action is taken by the MS if it does not receive an acknowledgment for a MM- or CM message before the channel assignment procedure is initiated?
question_25978.ground_truth: The MS repeats the message after the new dedicated channel is established.

question_25981.question: What is the handover delay requirement for E-UTRAN FDD - GSM handover: unknown target cell test?
question_25981.ground_truth: The handover delay requirement for E-UTRAN FDD - GSM handover: unknown target cell test is less than 200 ms.

question_25982.question: What is the purpose of the single carrier fallback procedure in the context of EC-GSM-IoT?
question_25982.ground_truth: The single carrier fallback procedure is used to ensure reliable reception of signals in EC-GSM-IoT, particularly in cases where a mobile is located at the edge of a cell or in poor coverage conditions.

question_25983.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 26.14.9.2.2, as it pertains to a mobile station (MS) in group receive mode?
question_25983.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the behavior of the MS after location updating and receiving NOTIFICATION/NCH for the current group or broadcast call with or without information on the related channel position.

question_25987.question: What is the role of the MCVideo server in the ambient viewing call release process when initiated by the "viewing" user?
question_25987.ground_truth: The MCVideo server sends an ambient viewing call release notification to MCVideo client 1 together with a reason code when the call is released by the MCVideo server.

question_25988.question: What is the role of the H(e)NB owner in adding, removing, and viewing the list of CSG members?
question_25988.ground_truth: The H(e)NB owner is responsible for adding, removing, and viewing the list of CSG members under the supervision of the PLMN operator. However, the specific interfaces or entities used for this process may or may not be specified by 3GPP.
