question_25989.question: In which clause are the channel coefficient generation and the antenna specifications detailed in 7.6.2.1 and 7.6.3.1?
question_25989.ground_truth: The channel coefficient generation is detailed in Clause 7.5 and the antenna specifications in Clause 7.6.3.1.

question_25990.question: What is the general purpose of the M3 Setup procedure?
question_25990.ground_truth: The M3 Setup procedure is used to exchange application level data needed for the MCE and MME to interoperate on the M3 interface, erasing any existing application level data and re-initializing the E-UTRAN M3AP service-related contexts in both nodes.

question_25991.question: In which band(s) might the 3rd order IMD products fall into for 3DL inter-band CA with one component carrier in each band, and bands 2, 5 and 30 are used?
question_25991.ground_truth: The 3rd order IMD products might fall into Bands 22 and 42.

question_25992.question: Why may media routing need to be made via the media distribution functions of both MC systems for interconnection private calls?
question_25992.ground_truth: To allow logging of both MC service users to take place and to enable connectivity from an MC service user in one MC system to the media distribution function of the interconnected MC system.

question_25993.question: When should an MS perform a routing area updating procedure in Iu mode after an intersystem change from A/Gb mode?
question_25993.ground_truth: The MS shall perform a routing area updating procedure in Iu mode after an intersystem change from A/Gb mode if the MS is required to perform routing area updating for IMS voice termination as specified in annex~P.3.

question_25995.question: Where is the ACR scenario supported by the EAS available?
question_25995.ground_truth: The ACR scenario supported by the EAS is available in the EAS service continuity support of the EAS profile.

question_25996.question: How is the version of a 3GPP technical specification determined?
question_25996.ground_truth: The version of a 3GPP technical specification is determined by the first digit (representing the stage of approval), the second digit (representing changes of substance), and the third digit (representing editorial changes).

question_26002.question: What is the effect of the eSRVCC and subsequent CS-internal handover in the 6.11 scenario?
question_26002.ground_truth: The eSRVCC reduces the voice quality from FB to SWB and the CS-internal handover further reduces the quality to WB. However, this is the best quality possible under the given circumstances and is always transcoding free.

question_26005.question: What information does the NodeB include in the NBAP message Radio Link Setup Response to the RNC?
question_26005.ground_truth: The NodeB includes the E-DCH RL Set ID, E-DCH FDD DL Control Channel Information, and E-DCH FDD Information Response in the NBAP message Radio Link Setup Response to the RNC.

question_26006.question: What network functions can provide the IRI-POI and CC-TF functions in IMS?
question_26006.ground_truth: The network functions that can provide the IRI-POI and CC-TF functions in IMS include S-CSCF, E-CSCF, P-CSCF, IBCF, MGCF, Conference AS/MRFC, Telephony AS, and PTC server.

question_26010.question: What is the result of the MCPTT private call transfer if the authorization check fails or the target of the transfer is a functional alias that is not active?
question_26010.ground_truth: The MCPTT private call transfer is cancelled, and the MCPTT server sends an MCPTT private call transfer response with result "fail" back to MCPTT client 2.

question_26011.question: What are the minimum requirements for RSRP measurement accuracy for all measured cells?
question_26011.ground_truth: The RSRP measurement accuracy for all measured cells shall be as specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 clauses 9.1.13.1 and 9.1.13.2.

question_26012.question: What is the role of the Media Session Handler in the 5GMSd UE functions?
question_26012.ground_truth: The Media Session Handler is responsible for media session handling, control, reporting and assistance that also include appropriate security mechanisms, e.g. authorization and authentication between the Media Player and the Media Session Handler.

question_26013.question: In what state does the BCC entity in the MS initiate the termination procedure for a broadcast call in the U5 state?
question_26013.ground_truth: The BCC entity in the MS initiates the termination procedure for a broadcast call in the U5 state by sending a TERMINATION REQUEST message to its peer entity in the network and setting timer Tterm.

question_26014.question: What is the use case for S9a session establishment in the BBF local policies?
question_26014.ground_truth: S9a session establishment is used when the BPCF initiates it, after receiving the trigger in step A.1, and if policy interworking with fixed accesses is supported. The BPCF includes the IMSI, UE IP Address and IP-CAN type in the message to the PCRF.

question_26015.question: What is the capability offered by the Dynamic TriggerDetectionPoint loading (DTDPL) mechanism in an SCF-SSF relationship?
question_26015.ground_truth: The Dynamic TriggerDetectionPoint loading (DTDPL) mechanism in an SCF-SSF relationship allows for the creation of a new TDP in the SSF by downloading SSF triggering information associated with the newly created TDP.

question_26016.question: What requirement needs to be met by a 5G system supporting satellite access to optimize the delivery of content?
question_26016.ground_truth: The 5G system supporting satellite access shall be able to optimize the delivery of content when using the 5G satellite access network.

question_26017.question: What is the purpose of the IBCF - TrGW interface (6a.7.21) during session establishment?
question_26017.ground_truth: The IBCF - TrGW interface is used by the IBCF to control the TrGW, e.g. to request network address translation binding during session establishment.

question_26019.question: What action does the PGW-C request from the PGW-U during PDP connection establishment procedures?
question_26019.ground_truth: During PDP connection establishment procedures, the PGW-C requests the PGW-U to create the Sx session.

question_26022.question: What procedure is performed by the UE when it receives the HO from E-UTRAN Command message containing a Handover Command message?
question_26022.ground_truth: The UE associates its bearer IDs to the respective RABs based on the relation with the NSAPI and suspends the uplink transmission of the user plane data.

question_26024.question: What action should the network take if a UE supporting MINT is no longer in a disaster condition location?
question_26024.ground_truth: The network should set the 5GMM cause value to #11 "PLMN not allowed" in the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message.

question_26025.question: What is the primary use of the media feature tag "g-3gpp-registration-token" in 3GPP IP multimedia call control protocol based on Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) and Session Description Protocol (SDP)?
question_26025.ground_truth: The media feature tag "g-3gpp-registration-token" is primarily used to indicate support of using a token to identify the registration used for the current request or response among the set of registrations for the registered URI.

question_26026.question: What is the role of the Local PSA in the process of EAS relocation?
question_26026.ground_truth: The Local PSA is responsible for supporting the uplink data buffering and EAS IP address replacement in the case of option 1d.

question_26029.question: What is the procedure used for channel estimation for each modulation and symbol rate option in a BSS?
question_26029.ground_truth: The procedure involves using a linear model of the received signal, y=Xh+n, where h~ is obtained by using a least squares (LS) estimator for each channel, expressed as h~ = Py, where P = (XHGHGX)-1XHGHRH.

question_26030.question: What message does the BPCF send to the H(e)NB Policy Function after performing admission control and taking into account the information contained in the QoS rule and the available resources at the HeNB's access point?
question_26030.ground_truth: The BPCF sends an GW Control and QoS Rule Provision Ack message to the H(e)NB Policy Function after performing admission control and taking into account the information contained in the QoS rule and the available resources at the HeNB's access point.

question_26032.question: What two factors are balanced in determining appropriate EVM levels in NR FR2?
question_26032.ground_truth: To balance between reference signal overhead and throughput, a balance of DM-RS and PT-RS along with achievable EVM levels were studied in NR FR2.

question_26033.question: What is one of the potential requirements for 3GPP system to support maritime communication services at sea or in a vessel?
question_26033.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall be able to support requirements for machine type communication such as eMTC and NB-IoT features for maritime communication services at sea or in a vessel.

question_26034.question: Which types of E-UTRA TDD UE does the non-anchor carrier test apply to?
question_26034.ground_truth: The non-anchor carrier test applies to all types of E-UTRA TDD UE release 15 and forward of UE Category NB1 and NB2.

question_26035.question: Which information element should be included in the BSSAP+-MOBILE-STATUS message to indicate the cell global identity in A/Gb mode?

question_26039.question: In EGPRS TBF mode, when is the TLLI included in both RLC data blocks?
question_26039.ground_truth: The TLLI is included in both RLC data blocks when MCS-7, MCS-8, or MCS-9 is used for the transmission of the TLLI and contention resolution is not yet completed on the mobile station side.

question_26040.question: What is the role of the 5GMSu Provisioning API in the 5GMS system?
question_26040.ground_truth: The 5GMSu Provisioning API allows the selection of Media Session Handling (M5u) and Uplink Streaming (M4u) options, including the option to publish media content to trusted 5GMSu ASs (Application Servers).

question_26042.question: What is the meaning of the constructions "might" and "might not" in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
question_26042.ground_truth: The construction "might" indicates a likelihood that something will happen as a result of action taken by some agency the behavior of which is outside the scope of the present document, while the construction "might not" indicates a likelihood that something will not happen as a result of action taken by some agency the behavior of which is outside the scope of the present document.

question_26043.question: What should be done to support supplementary services in the fixed network for CTS calls?
question_26043.ground_truth: DTMF handling on the CTS Radio Interface should be handled in the same way as in GSM, and hook-flash signalling should be supported.

question_26044.question: What is the effect of E-UTRA-NR dual connectivity and NR SRS carrier-based switching on UTRA-FDD measurement requirements?
question_26044.ground_truth: The requirements in clause~8.17.5 apply when the UE is operating in E-UTRA-NR dual connectivity mode or when using NR SRS carrier-based switching and measurement gaps, as specified in section 8.17.6 and 8.17.7.

question_26045.question: What is the purpose of the information flow IWF floor request in interworking floor control?
question_26045.ground_truth: The information flow IWF floor request is used to request the floor for media transfer, from the IWF to the MCPTT floor control server and from the MCPTT floor control server to the IWF.

question_26047.question: What procedure is used to allocate a static IP address to the UE during access authentication and authorization process?
question_26047.ground_truth: A static IP address (i.e. a static IPv4 address and/or a static IPv6 prefix) can be received from HSS/AAA during access authentication and authorization procedure, then the non-3GPP access should forward the static IP address to the PDN GW.

question_26048.question: What is the role of the Access and Functions (AF) in the multi-modal communication solution?
question_26048.ground_truth: The AF is responsible for establishing the Quality of Service (QoS) for multi-modal data flows towards multiple User Equipments (UEs) in one AF request.

question_26049.question: What is the role of NAS SM signalling in the 5G core network?
question_26049.ground_truth: NAS SM signalling is used in the 5GC to establish, modify, and release PDU Sessions upon UE request, as well as to trigger a specific application in the UE upon request from an Application Server. It is exchanged over N1 between the UE and the SMF.

question_26051.question: What should the UE do when provided with a new EPS bearer identity, a new EPS QoS parameters, a new extended EPS QoS parameters, a new APN-AMBR or a new extended APN-AMBR in the Mapped EPS bearer context IE of the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message for a QoS flow?
question_26051.ground_truth: The UE should discard the corresponding association(s) and associate the new value(s) with the QoS flow.

question_26053.question: What type of PoC session has the role(s) related information of the PoC User specified?

question_26055.question: What is the term used in the document to refer to the average number of active UEs for each QCI?
question_26055.ground_truth: Average number of active UEs per QCI

question_26059.question: What is the mobile station required to do if it fails to successfully complete a packet access procedure in the test described in 3GPP TS 04.60 subclause 7.1.2.3?
question_26059.ground_truth: The mobile station is required to reinitiate the packet access procedure unless it has already been repeated 4 times.

question_26060.question: What is the fixed size of the message delivered to the encoder on the DL for EC-CCCH/D, EC-PACCH/D, and EC-PACCH/U?
question_26060.ground_truth: The fixed size of the message delivered to the encoder on the DL for EC-CCCH/D is 88 bits, for EC-PACCH/D is 80 bits, and for EC-PACCH/U is 64 bits.

question_26061.question: What is the main purpose of including the MME ID in the UE's MM Context?
question_26061.ground_truth: The purpose of including the MME ID in the UE's MM Context is to keep track of the serving MME for the UE for proper handling of PRAs during IP-CAN session establishment or modification.

question_26062.question: What must a UE do upon the reception of a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for group member discovery solicitation in 5G ProSe direct discovery?
question_26062.ground_truth: Upon the reception of a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for group member discovery solicitation, the UE must unscramble and decrypt/decrypt the received message using the DUSK, DUCK, and UTC-based counter obtained during the monitoring operation. The UE must then verify the MIC field in the unscrambled PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for group member discovery solicitation.

question_26063.question: What is the role of PCF in the 5G system architecture for ProSe Services?
question_26063.ground_truth: PCF provides the Authorization policy and parameters for 5G ProSe Direct Discovery and Communication, and Authorization policy and parameters for 5G UE-to-Network Relay Discovery and Communication.

question_26065.question: What action does the SS take if it observes more than 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes during SCell deactivation in the intra-band FDD case?
question_26065.ground_truth: The SS counts a fail for the event "Deactivation" in the intra-band FDD case if it observes more than 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes.

question_26067.question: Why does it appear undesirable for HSS to set the key in the AV to be KASMEU derived from (CK, IK)?
question_26067.ground_truth: It would require the HSS to be aware of whether the CNN is capable of the UTRAN key hierarchy and whether the ME is an ME or an ME+, and performing the KASMEU derivation in the HSS would require making the HSS aware of these factors. Moreover, it would defeat the security benefit of not exposing (CK, IK) outside the HSS.

question_26068.question: What should the MRFP do with the received RTP CVO header extension if it supports the CVO feature and does not apply video transcoding?
question_26068.ground_truth: If the MRFP supports the CVO feature and does not apply video transcoding, it shall pass any received RTP CVO header extension to succeeding RTP streams.

question_26071.question: What is the current issue with using a list of APNs in the Mobile Equipment (ME)?
question_26071.ground_truth: The current issue is the management overhead on the ME supplier or current Home Operator to keep the list up-to-date. For a truly global MTC Module, it would need to contain and maintain a list of over 1000 different APNs to satisfy all markets.

question_26073.question: What is the purpose of the "Paging restriction" information element?
question_26073.ground_truth: The Paging restriction information element is used to request the network to restrict paging.

question_26074.question: What are the architectural requirements for energy efficiency in 3GPP standards?
question_26074.ground_truth: The architectural requirements include supporting energy saving capabilities, three levels of energy saving (network, site, and equipment), coexistence of multi-radio access technologies, resource sharing and network collaborations, coordinated energy efficiency in network nodes/sub-systems, and energy efficient control based on radio network environment knowledge.

question_26075.question: In Alternative 1, What are the steps taken by the eNB upon receiving the NAS SMC message from MME during detached to active transitions?
question_26075.ground_truth: The eNB starts integrity protection, gets ready to receive encrypted RRC and UP traffic and sends the AS SMC to UE, including the NAS SMC message received from MME. The AS SMC message includes the selected RRC algorithms and the selected UP algorithm and is protected with AS integrity protection.

question_26076.question: What is the role of the Cell Global Identity in the LLC frame reception process?
question_26076.ground_truth: The Cell Global Identity, including the RAC and LAC of the cell, is added to the LLC frame by the BSS on reception. The SGSN then interprets the LLC frame as an implicit paging response message and stops the paging response timer.

question_26078.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project responsible for in terms of mobile communication?
question_26078.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project is responsible for producing technical specifications for the mobile communication system, including the interworking between Public Land Mobile Network (PLMN) and Integrated Services Digital Network (ISDN) or Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN).

question_26081.question: What kind of information is contained in the 'Descriptive Part' of the basic NGOSS contract description?
question_26081.ground_truth: The 'Descriptive Part' of the basic NGOSS contract description contains the goal of the contract, some search criteria, and other descriptive information.

question_26082.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function include in the SIP NOTIFY request for an individual participant in the MCVideo session?
question_26082.ground_truth: A single <endpoint> element that includes an "entity" attribute for each participant, indicating the status of the MCVideo session for that participant.

question_26083.question: What triggers the network to receive DASH streaming content over MBMS bearer in the described scenario?
question_26083.ground_truth: Congestion situation alerting operator attention prompts the network to receive the DASH streaming content over MBMS bearer.

question_26084.question: What should the system simulator set as the PCell, PSCell on FR1, and inter-frequency neighbor cell on FR1, for the pre-test conditions in 8.2.3.11.1.3.1?
question_26084.ground_truth: E-UTRA Cell 1 is PCell, NR Cell 1 is PSCell on FR1 and NR Cell 3 is inter-frequency neighbor Cell on FR1.

question_26085.question: What does the "2 out of 3 approach" refer to in the context of IP-CAN session modification measurements?
question_26085.ground_truth: The "2 out of 3 approach" refers to the requirement that at least two out of the three measurements (attempted IP-CAN session modification, successful IP-CAN session modification, and failed IP-CAN session modification) are supported by the implementation.

question_26088.question: What are the conditions for the delay uncertainty introduced when inserting the measurement report in the TTI of the uplink DCCH?
question_26088.ground_truth: The delay uncertainty introduced when inserting the measurement report in the TTI of the uplink DCCH is equal to 2 x TTIDCCH where TTIDCCH is the duration of subframe or slot or subslot when the measurement report is transmitted on the PUSCH with subframe or slot or subslot duration.

question_26089.question: Which element can contain information about an NG-RAN cell in the XML schema?
question_26089.ground_truth: The "location" element contains information about an NG-RAN cell in the XML schema.

question_26090.question: How does the 5GMSG Service handle messages when an IoT device is unavailable?
question_26090.ground_truth: It stores the message for future delivery once the IoT device becomes available.

question_26095.question: In the media flow transfer process from UE-2 to UE-1, what is the pre-requisite before the SCC AS sends a request to establish an Access Leg on UE-3?
question_26095.ground_truth: The SCC AS must have performed authorization as specified in clause~6a.12, and the media flow (Media Flow-A) must have been removed from UE-2.

question_26096.question: What is the RSSI measurement bandwidth assumed in defining the accuracy requirements in Section 9.1.18.5.2-1 and 9.1.18.5.3-1?
question_26096.ground_truth: The RSSI measurement bandwidth assumed in defining the accuracy requirements in Section 9.1.18.5.2-1 and 9.1.18.5.3-1 is 6 RB.

question_26098.question: How can eP-CSCFs ensure that a third party WWSF is authorized to assign IMS identities?
question_26098.ground_truth: There are three suggested countermeasures to enforce the authorization of a WWSF by the eP-CSCF: eP-CSCFs can maintain a list of trusted third-party authentication services, use the HSS to track the authorized third-party authentication services, or adopt a Web Access Firewall (WAF) in the operator domain to verify authorization.

question_26101.question: Which information elements are included in a Remote UE report message?
question_26101.ground_truth: The IE included in the message by the UE when sending a Remote UE report message are Remote UE Context Connected, Remote UE Context Disconnected, and ProSe Key Management Function Address.

question_26103.question: Which information does the final AMF use to select the final V-SMF?
question_26103.ground_truth: The final AMF selects the final V-SMF based on the VPLMN value of S-NSSAI associated with the established PDN connection(s).

question_26104.question: What condition triggers the reinitialization of the minimum statistics routine in the noise estimation process?
question_26104.ground_truth: If four or more frames with increasing noise energy are detected consecutively, and the sum of the last four of them is bigger than 5, the reset flag is set to 1, triggering the reinitialization of the minimum statistics routine.

question_26107.question: When is a UE required to initiate an announce request procedure in a new PLMN?
question_26107.ground_truth: A UE is required to initiate an announce request procedure in a new PLMN when it selects a new PLMN while announcing a ProSe restricted code and intends to announce in the new PLMN and the UE is authorized for restricted 5G ProSe direct discovery model A announcing in the new PLMN.

question_26108.question: What should the MCData client do when receiving an MSRP request in an MSRP session?
question_26108.ground_truth: The MCData client should follow the rules and procedures defined in IETF RFC 4975 and IETF RFC 6714, and handle the received content before delivering the content to the application.

question_26109.question: What exception is thrown if the 'eventList' parameter is null in the 'setEventList' method?

question_26111.question: What is the significance of the version number format in the technical specification?
question_26111.ground_truth: The version number format indicates the level of approval and changes made to the document. The first digit represents the level of approval, the second digit indicates changes of substance, and the third digit reflects editorial-only changes.

question_26112.question: What is the role of the NRF in SMF discovery and selection?
question_26112.ground_truth: The NRF provides NF profile(s) of SMF instance(s) and the SMF service area of SMF instance(s) to the AMF.

question_26113.question: What is the difference between a UE set to "Voice centric" and a UE set to "Data centric" during a voice call?
question_26113.ground_truth: A "Voice centric" UE will always try to ensure that Voice service is possible, while a "Data centric" UE does not disable the E-UTRAN capability if voice services cannot be obtained.

question_26116.question: What is the process when the UE with ongoing PDN connections moves from EPC to 5GC?
question_26116.ground_truth: The SMF+PGW-C triggers a request to decrease the number of the UE registration in NSACF, and the AMF triggers a request to increase the number of the UE registration in NSACF.

question_26117.question: Who is responsible for initiating the creation of a child security association pair in the DSMIPv6 tunnel, the UE or the HA?
question_26117.ground_truth: Both the UE and HA can independently decide to initiate the creation of a child security association pair. If both initiate it simultaneously, the procedure described in IETF-RFC-5996 applies.

question_26118.question: What is the purpose of the EN-DC FR1 SCell activation and deactivation test?
question_26118.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that the SCell activation and deactivation times are within the requirements, when the SCell in FR1 is known by the UE at the time of activation.

question_26120.question: How does Solution 4 improve the accuracy of RIBS?
question_26120.ground_truth: Solution 4 improves the accuracy of RIBS by providing a mechanism to calculate and compensate for propagation delays, leading to enhanced accuracy in scenarios with large synchronization errors.

question_26121.question: What should the network do when it decides to restrict CE mode B for a UE?
question_26121.ground_truth: If the use of CE mode B is restricted for a UE, the UE shall not use CE mode B in the registered PLMN and in any PLMN which is in the list of equivalent PLMNs.

question_26122.question: What is the purpose of the Account Management Service Capability Feature (SCF) in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification?
question_26122.ground_truth: The Account Management SCF specifies the aspects of the interface that allow an application developer to make use of network functionality through an open standardized interface, specifically for account management.

question_26123.question: Which command is used to send APDU commands to the UICC with a logical channel other than the default channel (channel "0")?
question_26123.ground_truth: The <sessionid> is used to send APDU commands to the UICC with a logical channel other than the default channel (channel "0"). It is an integer type identifier for the session used to send APDU commands to the UICC.

question_26127.question: What is the highest priority frequency considered for cell reselection if the highest-priority frequency is from another RAT?
question_26127.ground_truth: The highest ranked cell among the cells on the highest priority frequency(ies) meeting the criteria of that RAT will be considered.

question_26128.question: What is the phenomenon that allows signals to travel further than normal in TDD networks, potentially causing interference?
question_26128.ground_truth: The atmospheric ducting phenomenon, caused by lower densities at higher altitudes in the Earth's atmosphere, is the phenomenon that allows signals to travel further than normal in TDD networks.

question_26129.question: Under what conditions is an in-progress emergency group state cancel request considered to be an authorized request for a group?
question_26129.ground_truth: An in-progress emergency group state cancel request is considered to be an authorized request for a group if the "<allow-cancel-group-emergency>" element of the "ruleset" element of the MCVideo user profile document identified by the MCVideo ID of the calling MCVideo user is set to a value of "true". In all other cases, it is considered to be an unauthorized request for group emergency state cancellation.

question_26131.question: What triggers the IP Edge/PCEF to initiate the termination of an IP-CAN session in routed mode with NAT?
question_26131.ground_truth: The IP session being terminated from the RG, such as when the RG is switched off.

question_26132.question: What is the role of the QFI (QoS Flow Identifier) in boundary between UL and DL?
question_26132.ground_truth: The QFI (QoS Flow Identifier) is used by the UPF to convey the classification of the User Plane traffic belonging to a QoS Flow through an N3 (and N9) User Plane marking.

question_26133.question: What is used to control the maximum data rate of Non-GBR QoS Flows?

question_26134.question: What information does the "omr-codecs" attribute encapsulate in OMR procedures?
question_26134.ground_truth: The "omr-codecs" attribute encapsulates codec related SDP information, including the transport format and list of media formats, that are applicable if a particular border gateway is bypassed.

question_26135.question: What is the situation when the network ensures that the RLC receiver entities do not deliver old PDCP PDUs to the re-established PDCP entity?
question_26135.ground_truth: When setting the reestablishPDCP flag for a radio bearer, the network ensures that the RLC receiver entities do not deliver old PDCP PDUs to the re-established PDCP entity.

question_26136.question: What is the significance of the Highly Managed Alarm (HMA) class in network management?
question_26136.ground_truth: The HMA class represents the most critical alarms that are catastrophic from various points of view including operations, security, and business. These alarms require special treatment, such as high levels of administrative requirements, detailed documentation, and frequent testing, to ensure that they receive the highest attention and are never delayed or lost.

question_26137.question: In case of BS capable of multi-band operation, what parameters should be declared for each supported operating band in addition to the declared capability set, maximum Base Station RF Bandwidth, total number of supported carriers, rated carrier output power, and rated total output power?
question_26137.ground_truth: The manufacturer should declare supported operating band combinations of the BS, supported operating band(s) of each antenna connector, supported capability set in each supported operating band in multi-band operation, support of multi-band transmitter and/or multi-band receiver, total number of supported carriers for the declared band combinations of the BS, maximum number of supported carriers per band in multi-band operation, total RF Bandwidth of transmitter and receiver for the declared band combinations of the BS, maximum Base Station RF Bandwidth of each supported operating band in multi-band operation, maximum Radio Bandwidth in transmit and receive direction for the declared band combinations of the BS, any other limitations under simultaneous operation in the declared band combinations of the BS, rated total output power as a sum over all supported operating bands in the declared band combinations of the BS, maximum supported power difference between any two carriers in any two different supported operating bands, the rated carrier output power in multi-band operation, and rated total output power of each supported operating band in multi-band operation.

question_26138.question: What is the impact of test system uncertainties on application layer throughput results?
question_26138.ground_truth: The tighter the uncertainty requirements, the more reproducible and comparable the results will be.

question_26139.question: What is the source coding bit-rate used for narrowband telephony testing in the GSM, 3G, or LTE terminal, as defined in the 3GPP TS 26 series of specifications?

question_26140.question: What is the purpose of the registerService() method in the IpFwServiceRegistration interface?
question_26140.ground_truth: The registerService() method is used to register a service in the Framework, allowing it to be discovered by enterprise applications. It returns a service-ID, which is a unique handle that identifies the registered service.

question_26141.question: Which XDM related measurement is used to track the number of attempted HTTP PUT procedures in the XDMS?
question_26141.ground_truth: The name of the measurement is "Attempted HTTP PUT procedures".

question_26142.question: What is the purpose of the processMonitor attribute in the IOC?
question_26142.ground_truth: The processMonitor attribute represents the status of the implementation of network slice subnet related requirements by the NetworkSliceSubnetController, providing information for the MnS consumer to monitor progress and result.

question_26143.question: What are the three types of channel access defined in the LBT mode?
question_26143.ground_truth: Type 1 channel access can be performed by gNB or UE to initiate a channel occupancy and involves sensing the channel multiple times with a counter with maximum contention window size 3. Type 2 channel access requires a single sensing slot channel sensing and can be used to share a COT. Type 3 channel access does not require channel sensing and can be used to share a COT, or to initiate Discovery RS transmission when regulation allows.

question_26144.question: What is the significance of the version numbering system in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_26144.ground_truth: The version numbering system in 3GPP technical specification indicates the level of TSG approval, changes of substance, and editorial only changes.

question_26146.question: What is the AVP code for the Media-Component-Number AVP?

question_26148.question: Which ITU-T Recommendation is reserved for Digital Cellular in the command prefix for Mobile Termination (MT) functions and network services?

question_26149.question: What interfaces does the SCEF use to communicate with the MTC-IWF and serving MME/SGSN?
question_26149.ground_truth: The SCEF uses the Tsp interface to communicate with the MTC-IWF and the T6a/T6b interfaces to communicate with the serving MME/SGSN.

question_26151.question: What is the purpose of the ME Identity Check procedure?
question_26151.ground_truth: The ME Identity Check procedure is used to check the Mobile Equipment's identity, e.g. to check that it has not been stolen, or, to verify that it does not have faults.

question_26154.question: What message is sent by the source NG-RAN to the MBSR during handover, and what information does it include?
question_26154.ground_truth: The source NG-RAN sends Handover Command to the MBSR with MBSR info. This message includes a transparent container with UE info (MBSR info).

question_26157.question: What is the purpose of the Nq and Nq' interfaces in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_26157.ground_truth: The Nq and Nq' interfaces are used for the IMSI and APN information retrieval procedures between the RAN Congestion Awareness Function (RCAF) and the Mobility Management Entity (MME) or the Serving GPRS Support Node (SGSN).

question_26158.question: What is the difference between an XML complex type and an XML element type?
question_26158.ground_truth: An XML complex type is defined in an XML schema and cannot be directly used in an XML document, while an XML element type can be directly used in an XML document.

question_26159.question: In the context of MCPTT, what does it mean for the MCPTT client to "associate the TGI with a MCPTT group ID"?
question_26159.ground_truth: In the context of MCPTT, for the MCPTT client to "associate the TGI with a MCPTT group ID" means that the MCPTT client is able to determine that there is a constituent group of the temporary group that it is a member of.

question_26161.question: Which information element is mandatory in the "UERadioCapabilityIDMappingResponseIEs" sequence?
question_26161.ground_truth: The "ID id-UERadioCapabilityID" and "ID id-UERadioCapability" information elements are mandatory in the "UERadioCapabilityIDMappingResponseIEs" sequence.

question_26162.question: What protocol is used for negotiating session keys between the User Equipment (UE) and the IMS Application Gateway (IMS-AGW) for e2e media security protection?
question_26162.ground_truth: The TLS handshake protocol is used for negotiating session keys between the UE and the IMS-AGW for e2e media security protection.

question_26163.question: What is one possible network optimization that the AMF may implement based on UE communication pattern in Solution 22?
question_26163.ground_truth: If the UE communication pattern indicates that the UE has no communication in a time period, the AMF may advise the UE to adopt power saving methods like PSM or MICO.

question_26164.question: What information is specified by the 'setCallback()' method in the IpService interface?
question_26164.ground_truth: The 'setCallback()' method specifies the reference address of the callback interface that a service uses to invoke methods on the application. It is used to provide a mechanism for handling responses and reports.

question_26165.question: What is the condition for outgoing communication to evaluate to true?
question_26165.ground_truth: Outgoing communication evaluates to true for all outgoing communication.

question_26166.question: What must the ME do if the UICC responds with '02' in the MO Short Message control result?
question_26166.ground_truth: The ME must send a short message using the data supplied by the UICC.

question_26167.question: What information is included in the measResultListEUTRA field of the handover failure report, if measured for one or more EUTRA frequencies?
question_26167.ground_truth: The measResultListEUTRA field includes detailed measurement results for EUTRA frequencies.

question_26170.question: What capability is expected for the future 5G system to handle uplink and downlink radio transmissions simultaneously for multiple RAT connectivity?
question_26170.ground_truth: The UE shall have full dual radio capability, i.e. can handle both uplink and downlink radio transmissions on both the 5G New RATs and the E-UTRA RAT simultaneously. However, it is also expected that some UEs will target lower complexity segments where single radio capability is preferred.

question_26171.question: What feature-capability indicator should be included in the Feature-Caps header field of the REGISTER request to support IMS Centralized Services (ICS) at the roaming II-NNI?

question_26174.question: What is the use of the SN-XID.indication in the SNDCP entity?
question_26174.ground_truth: The SN-XID.indication is used by the SNDCP entity to deliver the list of requested XID parameters to the SNDCP user.

question_26175.question: What is a feature used in 5GC to direct media traffic to a local UPF for a specific media flow?
question_26175.ground_truth: The "AF influence of traffic routing" feature is used in 5GC to direct media traffic to a local UPF for a specific media flow.

question_26176.question: What should SMF do if it wants to trigger EAS rediscovery for a UE collection?
question_26176.ground_truth: SMF removes the common EAS/DNAI from AF traffic influence request information, UDR notifies PCF, and then PCF updates SMF with an updated PCC rule removing the common EAS/DNAI, and triggers other SMF for EAS rediscovery.

question_26177.question: What is the default behavior upon receiving a floor request during an off-network emergency call in progress?
question_26177.ground_truth: If an emergency call is in progress and a floor request is received, the current talker will be pre-empted, and the floor request will be granted. If the value of a specific leaf node indicates to queue the request, the floor request will be queued, and if not, the request will be denied.

question_26180.question: How many dB of height gain is achieved by doubling the BTS antenna height under Rayleigh fading conditions?

question_26181.question: What is the purpose of providing the UE with an indication of TWAN/ePDG support of emergency services?
question_26181.ground_truth: The purpose of providing the UE with an indication of TWAN/ePDG support of emergency services is to allow the UE to request emergency bearers and reach P-CSCF, E-CSCF, etc. that support emergency services.

question_26182.question: What should be done for each DRB that is not established in the CounterCheck message?
question_26182.ground_truth: For each DRB that is not established in the CounterCheck message, the UE should include the DRB in the drb-CountInfoList in the CounterCheckResponse message, and set the drb-Identity, the count-Uplink, and the count-Downlink with the most significant bits set identical to the corresponding values in the drb-CountMSB-InfoList and the least significant bits set to zero.

question_26183.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 33.501, what is the purpose of the consumer's IPX (cIPX) and producer's IPX (pIPX) in a roaming scenario?
question_26183.ground_truth: The cIPX and pIPX are the IP exchange services provided by the consumer's and producer's IPX providers, respectively.

question_26184.question: What action does the floor control server take when it receives a valid floor request message from a permitted floor participant during the 'G: Floor Idle' state?
question_26184.ground_truth: The floor control server grants permission if the conditions are met, stores the SSRC associated with the granted user, stops timer T4 (Inactivity), and enters the 'G: Floor Taken' state.

question_26185.question: What is the purpose of time duration T1 in the test environment?
question_26185.ground_truth: The purpose of time duration T1 is to start the test and ensure the UE is in State 2A-NB with CP CIoT Optimisation before changing the SNR.

question_26186.question: What information does the HGMLC use to identify the periodic and triggered location request received in step 1?
question_26186.ground_truth: The HGMLC uses the LDR reference number received in step 29 and verifies UE privacy requirements before reporting the event and any location to the external LCS client.

question_26187.question: What is the role of the Initial HeMS in Home eNodeB (HeNB) management?
question_26187.ground_truth: The Initial HeMS is used to perform identity and location verification of HeNB and assign appropriate Serving HMS, Security Gateway and MME to HeNB.

question_26188.question: What message does the SGSN send to the Serving GW to initiate the deactivation of an EPS bearer?
question_26188.ground_truth: The SGSN sends the Delete Bearer Command (EPS Bearer Identity) message to the Serving GW.

question_26191.question: What is the method used for obtaining the measurement of "Packet Success Rate" in the uplink?
question_26191.ground_truth: The measurement of "Packet Success Rate" in the uplink is obtained by counting the number of successfully received UL PDCP sequence numbers, representing packets that are successfully delivered to higher layers, of a data radio bearer, divided by Total number of UL PDCP sequence numbers of a bearer, starting from the sequence number of the first packet delivered by UE PDCP to gNB until the sequence number of the last packet.

question_26192.question: What is required for the UE to access the PSS and MBMS User Service using IMS?
question_26192.ground_truth: The UE must implement an IMS client that registers to the IM CN Subsystem, attach to a network, establish PS connectivity through a PDP context, and complete the P-CSCF discovery procedure. The UE must then perform the PSS and MBMS Service Provider Discovery to discover the list of IMS PSI of the SDF and relative Service Providers.

question_26193.question: In Step 3, how are the MCS values determined for each CC?
question_26193.ground_truth: In Step 3, the MCS values are determined for each CC in the chosen CA bandwidth combination based on the test parameters and the indicated UE capabilities.

question_26194.question: What should the UE do if the timer T3396 indicates zero upon receipt of a BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT message with ESM cause #26 "insufficient resources"?
question_26194.ground_truth: If the timer T3396 indicates zero, the UE may send another PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST, BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST or BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message for the same APN. If the UE did not provide an APN for the establishment of the PDN connection and the request type was different from "emergency" and from "handover of emergency bearer services", the UE shall stop timer T3396 associated with no APN, if running, and may send another PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message without an APN, or another BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST or BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message for a non-emergency PDN connection established without an APN provided by the UE.

question_26195.question: Under what conditions is an MCVideo emergency alert request considered to be an authorized request?
question_26195.ground_truth: An MCVideo emergency alert request is considered to be an authorized request if the "allow-activate-emergency-alert" element of the "actions" element of a "rule" element of the "ruleset" element of the MCVideo user profile document is set to "true", and if the "entry-info" attribute of the "<EmergencyAlert>" element is set to "DedicatedGroup" and the "<uri-entry>" element of the "<entry>" element contains the MCVideo group identity targeted by the calling MCVideo user, or if the "entry-info" attribute is set to "UseCurrentlySelectedGroup" and the "<MCVideo-allow-emergency-alert>" element of the "actions" element of a "rule" element of the "list-service" element of the group document identified by the MCVideo group identity is set to "true".

question_26198.question: What is a <ProxyClass> in object-oriented programming?
question_26198.ground_truth: A <ProxyClass> is a form or template representing attributes, links, methods, and interactions of a represented <InformationObjectClass>. It cannot define its own behavior but encapsulates the behavior of the represented <InformationObjectClass>.

question_26199.question: What is the meaning of "shall" in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
question_26199.ground_truth: In the context of 3GPP technical specifications, "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

question_26200.question: What is the result of an unsuccessful submitMetricsReport Request from the target UE in the 5GMS AF?
question_26200.ground_truth: The 5GMS AF returns a submitMetricsReport Response with 400 Bad Request or 415 Unsupported Media Type status code.

question_26201.question: Under what conditions can a directed retry procedure be initiated during the assignment phase?
question_26201.ground_truth: Directed retry can be triggered by radio conditions, congestion, or the inability to provide the requested bearer service due to radio conditions or congestion during the assignment phase.

question_26202.question: What are the equivalent NF Service Instances if they share the same MCC, MNC, NID, ServiceName, and Set ID?
question_26202.ground_truth: NF Service Instances are equivalent if they share the same MCC, MNC, NID (for SNPN), ServiceName and Set ID.

question_26203.question: What is the function of the TMSI based NRI container information element?
question_26203.ground_truth: The TMSI based NRI container information element allows the VLR to determine if the MS has performed inter or intra VLR mobility when the VLR holds a current registration of the UE that could exist at another VLR.

question_26204.question: During which time duration the SS shall detect uplink power and increase the number of successful tests in the test described in 6.5.1.3.4.2?
question_26204.ground_truth: From time point A to time point F (D1 second after the start of time duration T5)

question_26205.question: What procedure does the MRFC initiate to add a bearer termination to an existing context in the "Add Subsequent User to Conference; Dial-out" process?
question_26205.ground_truth: The MRFC initiates the "Reserve IMS Resources" procedure as specified in clause~8.21 to add a bearer termination to an existing context in the "Add Subsequent User to Conference; Dial-out" process.

question_26206.question: What is the problem when using Border Control Function in international communications and terminal roaming scenarios?
question_26206.ground_truth: The lack of SIP signalling in IP transit networks presents a problem for negotiating QoS between end-points, as current QoS reservation is based on the SIP pre-conditions model.

question_26207.question: What is the purpose of the RRC procedures in the S1-based architecture of this communication system?
question_26207.ground_truth: The RRC procedures in the S1-based architecture are responsible for the control of the RRC connection and the transport of the NAS signalling, as well as the establishment and release of the RRC connection, security activation, and the transfer of data.

question_26209.question: What should the IWF do for each affiliated but not joined member, when cancelling the MCPTT user's emergency call?
question_26209.ground_truth: The IWF should generate a SIP MESSAGE request notification of the cancellation of the MCPTT user's emergency call and include an <emergency-ind> element set to a value of "false" in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body.

question_26210.question: What is the main objective of the 3GPP Technical Report on network operation technology enablers?
question_26210.ground_truth: The main objective is to identify and document key families of use cases and their potential requirements to enable 3GPP network operators to support the needs of new scenarios and markets related to network operation.

question_26211.question: What is the effect of using a Wi-Fi 802.11a preamble for NR-U coexistence with a Wi-Fi network for an indoor scenario when NR-U and Wi-Fi have CCA-ED of -62dBm and CCA-PD of -82dBm for a stand-alone NR-U deployment on an unlicensed carrier?
question_26211.ground_truth: Two sources indicated fair coexistence with mostly improved performance for both Wi-Fi and NR-U when NR-U with CCA-ED of -62dBm and CCA-PD of -82dBm compared with NR-U with CCA-ED of -72dBm and no Wi-Fi 802.11a preamble.

question_26213.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function include in the SIP 403 response for an unauthorized request for an MCVideo emergency call?
question_26213.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the <mcvideoinfo> element containing the <mcvideo-Params> element, with the <emergency-ind> element set to "false" and the <alert-ind> element set to "false".

question_26215.question: What is the role of the NFp and NFc in Solution #10?
question_26215.ground_truth: The NFp represents the producer of the machine learning (ML) model, while the NFc represents the consumer of the ML model in Solution #10.

question_26216.question: What is the role of the BM-SC in a GGSN initiated MBMS broadcast session termination?
question_26216.ground_truth: The BM-SC removes the Diameter session and confirms the operation by sending an STA message to the GGSN.

question_26218.question: What is the purpose of the "Group Call Reference" element and how does the second octet indicate the length?
question_26218.ground_truth: The "Group Call Reference" element contains a recommendation of the BSS concerning application of queuing. The second octet is a binary indication of the length of the remainder of the element in octets.

question_26220.question: Which functional element is responsible for authorizing a gateway control session and sending corresponding QoS rules in the Gxa/c interface?
question_26220.ground_truth: The PCRF (Policy and Charging Rules Function) is responsible for authorizing a gateway control session and sending corresponding QoS rules in the Gxa/c interface.

question_26221.question: What does the solution for small data add to the existing network in order to address small data usage?
question_26221.ground_truth: An alternative data path for small data to the existing one

question_26224.question: What action does the SCEF take if the MME/SGSN is aware that the UE is temporarily unreachable and cannot deliver the non-IP data?
question_26224.ground_truth: The MME/SGSN may send a NIDD Submit Response towards the SCEF indicating that the non-IP data was not delivered and the UE is temporarily not reachable. The MME/SGSN sets the Not Reachable for NIDD flag and stores the SCEF address.

question_26227.question: Which entities interact for providing and consuming group management services in the network resource management?
question_26227.ground_truth: The network resource management server could provide service to VAL server and network resource management client through interface Snrm.

question_26228.question: When manufacturers perform tests, what is the requirement for scored RF bandwidths and output power if a Base Station supports multiple frequency bandwidths?
question_26228.ground_truth: Manufacturers must declare that the requirements for spurious emissions and output power are also met for all other supported Base Station RF Bandwidths that are not explicitly tested. This is based on the requirement that the equipment is tested with the maximum bandwidth, meeting the emission and output power limits for all other bandwidths as well.

question_26229.question: What is the co-channel rejection defined as, as per 14.18.2a.1?
question_26229.ground_truth: The co-channel rejection is a measure of the capability of the receiver to receive a wanted modulated signal without exceeding a given degradation due to the presence of an unwanted modulated signal, both signals being at the nominal frequency of the receiver.

question_26230.question: What keyword is used in the OpenAPI specification to describe a list of non-exclusive alternatives in the `exNestedArray` attribute?

question_26231.question: What is the purpose of the FLUS source capability discovery procedure?
question_26231.ground_truth: The FLUS source capability discovery procedure allows a FLUS source to discover capabilities of a FLUS sink, such as the supported input formats, codecs, transcoding capabilities, reformatting, media combination, input media streams, and media processing functions.

question_26232.question: What are the roles of the User Profile and Terminal Capabilities in IMS based Peer-to-Peer Content Distribution services?
question_26232.ground_truth: User Profile provides the P2P application service with the user's preferences, while Terminal Capabilities are used to decide whether or not the client is capable of receiving the requested content. Terminal Capabilities are stored in Peer-to-Peer application service when available.

question_26233.question: What happens to the Route header field parameter with the II-NNI traversal scenario indicator after it is removed by SIP procedures?
question_26233.ground_truth: After the Route header field parameter with the II-NNI traversal scenario indicator is removed by SIP procedures, the functional entity with a legacy implementation will also remove the II-NNI traversal scenario type.

question_26234.question: What is the purpose of the A-KID in the AKMA architecture?
question_26234.ground_truth: The A-KID is used to identify the AKMA Anchor Function serving the User Equipment (UE) in the AKMA architecture.

question_26237.question: What is the applicable RF channel for the transmission of a single carrier in 6.7.4.4.2?
question_26237.ground_truth: The applicable RF channel for the transmission of a single carrier in 6.7.4.4.2 is B, M and T.

question_26238.question: How are the measurements in the present document categorized, and what is the significance of these measurement families?
question_26238.ground_truth: The measurements are categorized into families, each represented by a prefix that indicates a related functionality for measurement administration. The measurement families help in understanding and managing UTRAN measurement parameters.

question_26241.question: What is the level of spatial isolation assumed for the LA SBFD in the Ericsson study?

question_26244.question: What is the relative performance degradation difference between VAMOS level II receiver without shifted SACCH and with shifted SACCH?
question_26244.ground_truth: The degradation is 0.6dB to 1.5dB without shifted SACCH and -0.7dB to 0dB with shifted SACCH.

question_26247.question: What is the maximum output power of the switchplexer in the EGSM900 band?
question_26247.ground_truth: The maximum output power of the switchplexer in the EGSM900 band is 26.2 dBm.

question_26249.question: What should the MRFC do when sending any request or response related to a dialog and the message contains a "logme" header field parameter in the SIP Session-ID header field?
question_26249.ground_truth: The MRFC should log the message if required by local policy.

question_26250.question: What is the requirement for the UE to keep precoding weights in test case 5.4.5.2?
question_26250.ground_truth: The requirement for the UE is to keep precoding weights with more than 50% of the time between point B and point C.

question_26251.question: In the context of interruption time for handover, what is the minimum Tsearch if signal quality is sufficient for successful cell detection on the first attempt?
question_26251.ground_truth: If signal quality is sufficient for successful cell detection on the first attempt, Tsearch is 80 ms.

question_26252.question: What does the PDG (Packet Data Gateway) do in interworking with IP networks via the Wi reference point?
question_26252.ground_truth: The PDG operates as the access point of the Packet Domain and interworks with IP networks via the Wi reference point, appearing as a normal IP router to the external network.

question_26254.question: What should the UE do if the PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message is received in a PLMN, and the timer T3585 is running for all the PLMNs and that access type?
question_26254.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3585 for all the PLMNs and that access type.

question_26255.question: What is the maximum tolerable interference level at an LTE BS Tx noise assuming 70 dB port to port isolation?
question_26255.ground_truth: The maximum tolerable interference level at an LTE BS Tx noise assuming 70 dB port to port isolation is -89 dBm/25 Hz.

question_26257.question: What is the role of the UCMF with regards to UE Radio Capability IDs?
question_26257.ground_truth: The UCMF is used for storage of dictionary entries corresponding to either PLMN-assigned or UE manufacturer-assigned UE Radio Capability IDs. The UCMF assigns the PLMN-assigned UE Radio Capability ID values and associates them with the IMEI/TAC of the UE model(s) they are related to.

question_26258.question: What does A/331, a specific specification of ATSC 3.0, define?
question_26258.ground_truth: A/331 defines, among other functionality, the media content format and application transport protocols of ATSC 3.0 services.

question_26260.question: What action should the Iu UP protocol layer take when it receives a badly formatted or corrupted RATE CONTROL control frame?
question_26260.ground_truth: The Iu UP protocol layer should ignore the RATE CONTROL control frame and send a RATE CONTROL NEGATIVE ACKNOWLEDGEMENT control frame back.

question_26261.question: What information does the addressPointName parameter contain?
question_26261.ground_truth: The addressPointName parameter contains the requested address that the MS wants to connect to.

question_26262.question: What should the IWF performing the controlling role do if the received SIP MESSAGE request for emergency notification is an authorized request and the sending MCPTT user is not affiliated with the MCPTT group?
question_26262.ground_truth: The IWF should check if the MCPTT user is eligible to be implicitly affiliated with the MCPTT group as determined by clause 9.2.1.3.6.

question_26264.question: What action is taken if the SS-RSRQ value of Cell 3 is outside the limits or if the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 3?
question_26264.ground_truth: The number of failed iterations is increased by one.

question_26265.question: What message does the ePDG send to the PDN GW when adding a WLAN access for the PDN connection?
question_26265.ground_truth: The ePDG sends a Create Session Request to the PDN GW when adding a WLAN access for the PDN connection.

question_26266.question: What should the UE do upon receipt of a BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT message with ESM cause #41, #42, or #44?
question_26266.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT message with ESM cause #41, #42, or #44, the UE shall reject the allocation request, enter the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE, and release the traffic flow aggregate description associated with the PTI value.

question_26267.question: What is the role of the Paging Server in the 5GC?
question_26267.ground_truth: The Paging Server maintains a secure connection with the UE via the Internet and is used for sending Paging Notifications.

question_26268.question: How are the five directions for conformance testing determined for an OSDD without receiver target redirection range?
question_26268.ground_truth: The five directions for conformance testing are determined based on the receiver target reference direction, maximum and minimum phi and theta values achievable inside the sensitivity RoAoA, while maintaining the receiver target reference direction theta and phi values.

question_26269.question: Which AVP (Attribute-Value Pair) is used to indicate the type of server update being performed in a Server-Assignment-Request operation?
question_26269.ground_truth: The Server-Assignment-Type AVP is used to indicate the type of server update in a Server-Assignment-Request operation.

question_26270.question: When can resource reservation be initiated in UE initiated resource reservation?
question_26270.ground_truth: Resource reservation can be initiated immediately after the sending or receiving of the initial SDP offer in UE initiated resource reservation.

question_26271.question: How long is the guard period for burst type 2, measured in chip periods?
question_26271.ground_truth: The guard period for burst type 2 is 192 chip periods long.

question_26272.question: How can a consumer determine the set of ML entities to achieve a certain outcome?
question_26272.ground_truth: The producer should be able to inform the consumer of the set of ML entities that together achieve the consumer's automation needs.

question_26273.question: What should the ME do upon receiving an OPEN CHANNEL command related to (I-)WLAN bearer, if immediate (I-)WLAN service activation is requested and the ME is unable to activate the I-WLAN service with the network using the exact parameters provided by the UICC?
question_26273.ground_truth: The ME informs the UICC using TERMINAL RESPONSE (Network currently unable to process command) and aborts the operation.

question_26275.question: What is the main desire of verticals regarding network slices in the 5G system?
question_26275.ground_truth: Verticals desire self-management of network slices, including the ability to create, modify, and delete them.

question_26277.question: What is the significance of Step 18 in Flow 2?
question_26277.ground_truth: Step 18 in Flow 2 is significant as the BM-SC sets up an MBMS bearer for the serviceId in the new Service Area Identifier (SAI), allowing the UE to receive the MBMS service in the new SAI.

question_26278.question: What is the recommended method for power control in UL MIMO?
question_26278.ground_truth: It is recommended that a single power control inner/outer loop is used for UL MIMO, as having two independent power control loops complicates the precoder selection, which will then require knowledge of the instantaneous relative power ratios on the two streams. Additionally, inverting the weak secondary stream will result in excessive transmit power overhead, and estimating the relative power ratios based on the history of power-control up/down commands transmitted on the two streams is subject to errors due to inaccuracies in the reception of the TPC commands transmitted on the F-DPCH.

question_26279.question: What type of network planning might be considered in a dense urban area with high volume and high capacity multi-media traffic?
question_26279.ground_truth: Precise network planning would be difficult due to deployment concerns. Random or semi-random network planning should be considered.

question_26281.question: What is the potential security requirement to protect the security of the User ID and corresponding credentials?
question_26281.ground_truth: The User ID shall be privacy protected as a potential security requirement.

question_26283.question: What type of communication channel is employed for execution counter M = 1 and M = 2?
question_26283.ground_truth: For M = 1, a combined CCH/SDCCH is used, while for M = 2, a non-combined SDCCH is used.

question_26284.question: What is the maximum number of times the "anyExt" can occur in the "ProSeApplicationCodeACE-info" complex type?
question_26284.ground_truth: The "anyExt" can occur a maximum of 1 time in the "ProSeApplicationCodeACE-info" complex type.

question_26286.question: What is the purpose of the Extended Cell Identity Value in the provided call control communication examples?
question_26286.ground_truth: The Extended Cell Identity Value is used in Rel-4 and onwards implementations. The values of the two bytes shall not be verified in this implementation.

question_26288.question: What is the AVP code for the Originator-Interface AVP?

question_26292.question: What triggers the start of time period T3 in the E-UTRAN FDD - HRPD handover test?
question_26292.ground_truth: The start of time period T3 is triggered by the last TTI containing the RRC message implying handover in the E-UTRAN FDD - HRPD handover test.

question_26296.question: Which SCCP format and codes should the calling and called party addresses include on the E1 Interface?
question_26296.ground_truth: ITU-T Recommendation Q.713, subclause 3.4 states that the called party address shall include the appropriate subsystem number, and all other aspects of SCCP addressing are network specific. ITU-T Recommendation Q.713, subclause 3.5 states that the calling party address shall include the appropriate subsystem number, and all other aspects of SCCP addressing are also network specific.

question_26297.question: What is the definition of the relative accuracy of SS-SINR in the inter-frequency case?
question_26297.ground_truth: The relative accuracy of SS-SINR in the inter-frequency case is defined as the SS-SINR measured from one cell on a frequency compared to the SS-SINR measured from another cell on a different frequency, with at least one of the two frequencies being under CCA.

question_26298.question: When is a UE required to initiate the tracking area updating procedure in EMM-IDLE mode?
question_26298.ground_truth: A UE initiating the tracking area updating procedure in EMM-IDLE mode may request the network to re-establish the radio and S1 bearers for all active EPS bearer contexts if control plane CIoT EPS optimization is not used. If control plane CIoT EPS optimization is used, the UE may request re-establishment of radio and S1 bearers for all active EPS bearer contexts associated with PDN connections established without control plane only indication.

question_26300.question: What is the role of the SMF in the 5GC?
question_26300.ground_truth: The SMF in the 5GC offers services to NF service consumers via the Nsmf service based interface, providing functionalities such as session management, handling of policy and charging rules, and interacting with the UPF for creating, modifying and releasing user plane sessions.

question_26304.question: What should the UE report out of range after receiving the SCell activation command and until the SCell activation completion at UE?
question_26304.ground_truth: After receiving the SCell activation command and until the SCell activation completion at UE, the UE shall report out of range if the UE has available uplink resources to report CQI for the SCell.

question_26305.question: What is the goal of the codec reconciliation solution in group call?
question_26305.ground_truth: The goal of the codec reconciliation solution in group call is to enable dynamic codec selection based on the current LMR participants in the group call. This solution helps maintain voice continuity and quality with large amounts of signalling when switching to the new codec. The codec reconciliation solution provides a means of restricting the codec used within an MCPTT group call to that used in an LMR system, allowing end-to-end encryption using LMR mechanisms to be used within the MCPTT group.

question_26306.question: What is the definition of Multi-Connectivity in the context of the NR system?
question_26306.ground_truth: Multi-Connectivity is a mode of operation in the NR system where a multiple Rx/Tx UE in the connected mode utilizes radio resources amongst E-UTRA and/or NR provided by multiple distinct schedulers connected via non-ideal backhaul.

question_26307.question: What is the maximum number of DL band combinations in Release 17?

question_26308.question: What is the common 3GPP charging architecture?
question_26308.ground_truth: The common 3GPP charging architecture is specified in TS 32.240 and provides an umbrella for other charging management specifications. It specifies the content of the CDRs per domain/subsystem/service, the content of real-time charging messages per domain/subsystem/service, the functionality of online and offline charging for those domains/subsystems/services, and the interfaces that are used in the charging framework to transfer the charging information (i.e. CDRs or charging events).

question_26309.question: What action does the en-gNB take if at least one of the requested modifications is admitted after receiving the SGNB MODIFICATION REQUEST message?
question_26309.ground_truth: The en-gNB shall modify the related part of the UE context accordingly and send the SGNB MODIFICATION REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message back to the MeNB.

question_26312.question: When more than one useful signal frequency is considered, what applies separately to each useful signal frequency for spurious response frequencies?
question_26312.ground_truth: The maximum number of allowed occurrences for the spurious response frequencies applies separately to each useful signal frequency.

question_26313.question: What is the maximum TIU allowed for NR to E-UTRAN handover?

question_26314.question: In the MSGin5G registration response to Constrained UE schema, what is the value of "msgType" property should be?

question_26315.question: What is the purpose of the CAPIF and MEC service API management?
question_26315.ground_truth: CAPIF is the Common API Framework for northbound APIs, used in 3GPP for the northbound API exposure of edge service APIs. MEC platforms support CAPIF in the form of MEC service management API. The CAPIF APIs are similar to the MEC service management APIs and are used for service API management.

question_26316.question: What is the possible impact on the DL due to a wider pulse shape in Network Planning (C5)?
question_26316.ground_truth: The impact on the DL due to a wider pulse shape is left for further examination.

question_26317.question: What happens when the DIAMETER timer value is smaller, leading to a premature failure detection?
question_26317.ground_truth: Smaller values of the timer may increase the probability of a premature failure detection, which could potentially cause unnecessary failover procedures.

question_26319.question: How many contiguous timeslots within a TDMA frame can an MBMS capable mobile station receive one or more broadcast/multicast sessions, excluding the timeslots for (P)BCCH and (P)CCCH?
question_26319.ground_truth: Up to 5 contiguous timeslots within a TDMA frame.

question_26320.question: What is the purpose of IMS-ALG bypassing its local GW during session establishment?
question_26320.ground_truth: The purpose is to establish a user plane connection without GW insertion for the media in the outgoing IP realm.

question_26321.question: What is required for an authorized user to successfully discretely listen to group communications without violating end-to-end encryption?
question_26321.ground_truth: The authorized user's MC service client needs access to the GMK for the group, and this must be done without the group members in the call being aware of the authorized user possessing the encryption key.

question_26324.question: What should the network do when it receives an ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message which includes an unassigned or reserved PTI value?
question_26324.ground_truth: The network should ignore the message if the PTI is an unassigned or reserved value. If the PTI is an assigned value that does not match the PTI in use for any ongoing transaction related procedure, the network should respond with an ESM STATUS message including ESM cause #81 "invalid PTI value".

question_26325.question: What is the main function of the cognitive immersive service in 6G?
question_26325.ground_truth: The main function of the cognitive immersive service in 6G is to process media and other interactions to create semantical perception.

question_26326.question: What information is provided to the SGW-U by the SGW-C when the DL Data Buffer Expiration Time expires?
question_26326.ground_truth: When the DL Data Buffer Expiration Time expires, the SGW-C requests the SGW-U to drop the buffered data packets and to start buffering the DL data packets with reporting of the arrival of the first DL data packet, via an Sx Session Modification.

question_26328.question: What should the UE do if an initial request contains an Accept-Contact header field with the g.3gpp.icsi-ref feature tag and the g.3gpp.iari-ref feature tag?
question_26328.ground_truth: The UE should invoke the IMS application that is the best match for the ICSI value or IARI value in the header field.

question_26330.question: How much higher is the decoding time for Solution 1 compared to Solution 3, for AMR 12.2kbps codec and active-set size of 2?
question_26330.ground_truth: The decoding time for Solution 1 is approximately double that of Solution 3 for AMR 12.2kbps codec and active-set size of 2.

question_26331.question: What is the role of the TFT in the PS voice bearer during the IMS session continuity procedure?
question_26331.ground_truth: The TFT (Traffic Flow Template) of the PS voice bearer is modified during the IMS session continuity procedure to take into account the transport address used by the ATGW or by the remote end.

question_26333.question: What is the maximum sensitivity for base stations and GSM mobiles in GSM 900?
question_26333.ground_truth: The maximum sensitivity for base stations and GSM mobiles in GSM 900 is approximately -104 dBm.

question_26334.question: What is the effect of the SMF updating the N4 rules during non-3GPP access path switching?
question_26334.ground_truth: The SMF updates the N4 rules by replacing the AN Tunnel Info of the old non-3GPP AN with that of the new non-3GPP AN, instructing the UPF to switch traffic from the old non-3GPP access path to the new non-3GPP access path.

question_26335.question: What information is included in a mapping for non-F1 traffic in the IAB-donor-CU?
question_26335.ground_truth: For non-F1 traffic, the mapping includes the appropriate BH RLC channel and next-hop BAP address and/or BAP routing ID.

question_26336.question: When does the Active Time of the MAC entity start for PUSCH transmission?
question_26336.ground_truth: The Active Time of the MAC entity starts in the first symbol after the end of the first repetition of the corresponding PUSCH transmission.

question_26337.question: What should a floor participant do upon receiving a Floor Granted message when the User ID in the message matches its own MCPTT ID and the SSRC of floor participant sending the message matches the stored SSRC of the current arbitrator?
question_26337.ground_truth: The floor participant should request the MCPTT client to stop rendering received RTP media packets, start the T233 (Pending user action) timer, notify the MCPTT user about the floor grant, and remain in the 'O: queued' state.

question_26341.question: What happens during T3 in the test procedure?
question_26341.ground_truth: During T3, the UE shall send periodic CSI reports in PCell. After receiving at least one such report, the test system shall send an RRC message instructing the UE to release the PCell, and the UE shall stop transmitting uplink signal in Cell 2 no later than time point C (D1 second after the start of the time duration T3).

question_26344.question: What is the purpose of post-processing in the decoder?
question_26344.ground_truth: The purpose of post-processing in the decoder is to adaptively filter and upscale the reconstructed speech. It consists of two functions: adaptive post-filtering and signal up-scaling.

question_26346.question: What kind of information does the data usage reporting include for LAA and LWA scenarios?
question_26346.ground_truth: The data usage reporting includes the "data volume" of data transmitted over unlicensed spectrum of each bearer, the unlicensed spectrum access network identity (for example "WLAN access", "unlicensed LTE access"), Bearer Identity of bearer transmitted over unlicensed spectrum and the time stamp.

question_26347.question: What is the purpose of sending continuously Up power control commands to the plug-in UE?
question_26347.ground_truth: The purpose of sending continuously Up power control commands to the plug-in UE is to ensure that the plug-in UE reaches maximum power. This is necessary for the measurement of the TRP.

question_26348.question: What is the purpose of secure provisioning protocol in M2ME?
question_26348.ground_truth: A secure provisioning protocol transports all components of MCIMs, including network-access credentials, from a DPF in the network to the M2ME securely. It allows mutual authentication of M2ME and DPF, provides data integrity, confidentiality, uniqueness, and assurance of freshness, and is adequately resistant to known attacks.

question_26349.question: When should a UE initiate deregistration from the ON-SNPN after remote provisioning of SO-SNPN credentials is completed?
