question_26349.ground_truth: Based on ON-SNPN policies, the AMF may start an implementation-specific timer once the UE has registered to the ON-SNPN for the purpose of onboarding. Expiry of this timer triggers the AMF to deregister the onboarding registered UE from the ON-SNPN.

question_26353.question: What are the two options available for QoS support in 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay UE's serving PLMN?
question_26353.ground_truth: The two options are a static QoS mapping mechanism and a dynamic QoS signalling based mechanism.

question_26354.question: Under what conditions does the UE consider access to the cell as barred when the establishmentCause is set to mo-ExceptionData?
question_26354.ground_truth: The UE considers access to the cell as barred if the UE has at least one valid Access Class and the corresponding bit in the ab-BarringForSpecialAC is set to one.

question_26355.question: In what state does the network send a TERMINATION message to the MS when aborting a group call?
question_26355.ground_truth: The network sends a TERMINATION message to the MS in any state when aborting a group call.

question_26356.question: What should the MAG function of the Trusted Non-3GPP IP Access or ePDG set in the Proxy Binding Update message to indicate handoff between two different interfaces of the UE in the handover of PDN connections to non-3GPP access?
question_26356.ground_truth: The MAG should set the Handover Indicator to indicate handoff between two different interfaces of the UE in the Proxy Binding Update message used in the handover of PDN connections to non-3GPP access.

question_26357.question: What is the purpose of the pre-standard described in the document in the testing procedure using the 3-D pattern measurement method?
question_26357.ground_truth: The purpose is to make the testing in different laboratories harmonized and to define the procedure in detail by specifying test channels and phantom setups. It's open for the use of alternative test methods that can meet the specified performance parameters and measurement uncertainty.

question_26358.question: What is the consequence of TC3102 expiring during the hunting procedure?
question_26358.ground_truth: The CTS-FP stops the hunting procedure when TC3102 expires.

question_26359.question: What is the purpose of the initial authorization process for a UAS to access UAS data services from a MNO?
question_26359.ground_truth: The purpose of the initial authorization process is for the MNO to establish the UAS's credentials to operate and transport the UAS data to the UTM for further authorization.

question_26363.question: What is the purpose of the Immediate Packet Assignment (IPA) Single Block Uplink Assignment struct in 3GPP TS 44.018 subclause 3.5.2.1.3.1 and 3.5.2.1.3.3?
question_26363.ground_truth: The IPA Single Block Uplink Assignment struct is used to assign one uplink block for multiple mobile stations, indicating the first frame number of the single block period granted for packet access and the relative TBF starting time specific to each mobile station.

question_26364.question: What is required for the UE to perform a handover from N3IWF/5GC to NR / UE in 5GMM-DEREGISTERED states?
question_26364.ground_truth: The UE needs to support N1 mode, support IP address preservation between N3IWF/5GC and NR, have at least one PDN Connections established between the UE and N3IWF/5GC via untrusted non-3GPP, and be in the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.

question_26366.question: What is one of the responsibilities of the AMF in the PWS architecture in 5GS?
question_26366.ground_truth: The AMF is responsible for interpreting commands from the CBC, storing messages from the CBC, routing warning message request to the appropriate NG-RAN entities, reporting warning message delivery success or failure to the CBCF, and forwarding PWS RESTART-INDICATION message and the PWS FAILURE-INDICATION message to all CBCFs that the AMF interfaces with.

question_26368.question: What is the assumed architecture for controlling UL and DL transmission in the 5G satellite network?
question_26368.ground_truth: The assumed architecture for controlling UL and DL transmission in the 5G satellite network involves a Satellite Node B (sNB) in the NG-RAN, which provides the N2 interface to one or more AMFs. An sNB can include either a single ground station or several ground stations which act as DUs using an sNB central unit (sNB-CU).

question_26370.question: What is the step 3 in the procedure of Discover T-EAS used by the CAS in TS 23.558 clause 8.8.3.2?
question_26370.ground_truth: The CES has to be part of the EEL to facilitate the discovery of the T-EAS by interacting with the ECS.

question_26371.question: What is the expected sequence when testing the behavior of the MS with respect to the retransmission counter for the GPRS detach procedure?
question_26371.ground_truth: The MS initiates a GPRS detach procedure and the SS does not respond with a DETACH ACCEPT message before T3321 timeout. This is repeated with the retransmission counter being incremented each time, up to four times, after which the MS deletes the logical link and performs a new GPRS attach procedure.

question_26373.question: What IEs should be present for normal MS based testing?
question_26373.ground_truth: The Reference Time IE, GPS Reference Time Extension IE, Reference Location IE, Navigation Model IE, and Ionospheric Model IE should be present for normal MS based testing.

question_26375.question: Which 3GPP system document defines the stage 1 requirements for the 3GPP system provided enablers for group communication services using EUTRAN access?

question_26376.question: What is the maximum allowed interruption for a UE with dormantSCellState capability when performing CQI measurements of dormant SCells?
question_26376.ground_truth: The maximum allowed interruption for a UE with dormantSCellState capability when performing CQI measurements of dormant SCells is 2 subframes if the PCell or activated SCell is in the same band as the dormant SCell, and 5 subframes otherwise.

question_26377.question: What is the maximum length of an uncompressed concatenated short message?
question_26377.ground_truth: The maximum length of an uncompressed concatenated short message is 39015 (255*153) default alphabet characters, 34170 (255*134) octets or 17085 (255*67) UCS2 characters.

question_26378.question: What should the mobile station do after receipt of the ASSIGNMENT COMMAND message specifying speech full rate version 1 or 2 or speech half rate version 1 (if supported) during a mobile terminating call establishment?
question_26378.ground_truth: The mobile station shall continue the call establishment by replying to the ASSIGNMENT COMMAND with an ASSIGNMENT COMPLETE message and by connecting TCH in both directions or sending an ALERTING message if it supports immediate connect.

question_26380.question: In the SLIC modelling, how is the residual error after data cancelation approximated in the equivalent received signal processing?
question_26380.ground_truth: The residual error after data cancelation is approximated by a scaled value of the signal being cancelled in the equivalent received signal processing.

question_26381.question: What should the UE do if a cell reselection occurs while T300, T302, T303, T305, T306, or T308 are running and the UE is connected to EPC?
question_26381.ground_truth: The UE stops timer T302, T303, T305, T306, and T308, whichever ones were running, and performs the actions as specified in 5.3.3.7.

question_26384.question: What should the UE do if the network requests capabilities for nr but indicates that no NR band combinations should be included in the UE-NR-Capability?
question_26384.ground_truth: The UE should remove all NR-only band combinations from the list of "candidate band combinations", as this will also avoid the inclusion of corresponding feature set combinations and feature sets.

question_26385.question: What should the SMF do when the TSC Assistance container of an existing PCC rule is changed?
question_26385.ground_truth: The binding of this PCC rule should not be re-evaluated.

question_26386.question: What action does the network take when it rejects the MS's request for Secondary PDP context activation?
question_26386.ground_truth: The network sends an ACTIVATE SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT REJECT message to the MS, and the MS enters the state PDP-INACTIVE.

question_26387.question: What is the procedure if the MME fails to authenticate the UE after receiving a request for EPS emergency bearer services that was integrity protected by the current EPS NAS security context?
question_26387.ground_truth: If the serving network policy does not allow unauthenticated IMS Emergency Sessions, the UE and MME shall proceed as for setting up normal EPS bearers. If the policy allows unauthenticated IMS Emergency Sessions, the UE and MME can continue to use the current EPS NAS security context if it's detected during an attach procedure for EPS emergency bearer services or a PDN connectivity request procedure.

question_26388.question: What is the pass criterion for the testing procedure described in 27.22.4.22.5.4.2 as Expected Sequence 5.1?
question_26388.ground_truth: The ME shall operate in the manner defined in Expected Sequence 5.1

question_26391.question: What are the primary components of the audio signal processing in the encoder?
question_26391.ground_truth: The primary components of audio signal processing in the encoder include high-pass filtering, complex low-delay filter bank analysis, sample rate conversion to 12.8 kHz, and common processing for discontinuous transmission (DTX) and AMR-WB interoperable option.

question_26392.question: What is the maximum latency that the E-UTRAN can support for V2X messages in the 3GPP standard?
question_26392.ground_truth: The E-UTRAN can support a maximum latency of 100ms.

question_26396.question: What should a UE do for at least one TB of the multiple TB in HARQ-ACK transmission if the HARQ-ACK information is disabled?
question_26396.ground_truth: The UE should generate an ACK for HARQ-ACK corresponding to the transport block associated with the HARQ process with disabled HARQ-ACK information.

question_26397.question: What event triggers the transmission of the ASR command in the Gi/Sgi interface?
question_26397.ground_truth: The ASR command is sent by the Diameter server to the GGSN/P-GW to request termination of a PDP Context or an IP-CAN session.

question_26398.question: What features does the 3GP-DASH Release 11 multiview stereoscopic 3D video profile include?
question_26398.ground_truth: The 3GP-DASH Release 11 multiview stereoscopic 3D video profile includes all features defined in clauses 7.3.7, 8, 9, and 10.

question_26399.question: What should a mobile station that does not support eMLPP do if it receives a CALL PROCEEDING message containing a priority level?
question_26399.ground_truth: The mobile station should ignore this information if provided in a CALL PROCEEDING message.

question_26400.question: What are the main services that RRC expects from lower layers in an NR network?
question_26400.ground_truth: The main services that RRC expects from lower layers in an NR network are integrity protection, ciphering, and loss-less in-sequence delivery of information without duplication, as well as broadcast of system information including NAS common information.

question_26403.question: What information should the UE try to acquire if the cell indicated by the cellForWhichToReportCGI is a UTRAN cell?
question_26403.ground_truth: The UE should try to acquire the LAC, the RAC and the list of additional PLMN Identities, if multiple PLMN identities are broadcast in the concerned cell; and try to acquire the CSG identity, if the CSG identity is broadcast in the concerned cell.

question_26404.question: What is the purpose of sending an EAP Request/Identity message to the UE during secondary authentication?
question_26404.ground_truth: The purpose of sending an EAP Request/Identity message to the UE during secondary authentication is to authenticate and authorize the UE.

question_26406.question: What value should the VAE-S set for the <result> child element in the HTTP 200 (OK) response message, if the service discovery is successful?

question_26407.question: What must the old MME (in a network supporting unauthenticated UEs) do if it cannot authenticate the UE with emergency bearers and cannot validate the Context Request?
question_26407.ground_truth: The old MME continues the procedure with sending a Context Response and starting the timer.

question_26410.question: What protocols are used for the mapping of cause codes in the context of handover between UMTS and GSM networks?
question_26410.ground_truth: The RANAP and BSSMAP protocols are used for the mapping of cause codes in the context of handover between UMTS and GSM networks.

question_26412.question: What happens to the resources associated with a MS when it receives a GA-RC DEREGISTER message with a Reject Cause of 'IMSI not allowed'?
question_26412.ground_truth: The GANC releases all resources associated with the MS, and the MS does not initiate a new Registration procedure until the next power-on.

question_26413.question: What is the purpose of the "Change to Report" flag in the message from the old MME to the new SGSN?
question_26413.ground_truth: The "Change to Report" flag in the message from the old MME to the new SGSN indicates if there was a deferred reporting of change of UE Time Zone, Serving Network, or both towards Serving GW / PDN GW.

question_26414.question: What is the purpose of the PACKET MEASUREMENT ORDER message in the test procedure?
question_26414.ground_truth: The PACKET MEASUREMENT ORDER message is used to measure the radio environment, such as the received signal strength, for the purpose of evaluating the network performance or for initiating a handover between cells.

question_26415.question: What is the reason for requiring isolated communication resources in different railway applications?
question_26415.ground_truth: Each railway application has unique transport services and functionalities, requiring separate and customized communication resources for efficient operation.

question_26416.question: What are some of the services provided by the Access Stratum in the document?
question_26416.ground_truth: Some of the services provided by the Access Stratum include call control, connection bearer control, radio access bearers, and resource management. The Access Stratum provides flexible radio access bearers characterized by parameters describing the type of information and QoS transported over the radio interface.

question_26417.question: What is the role of the NG interface in the NG-RAN architecture?
question_26417.ground_truth: The NG interface is a logical interface in the NG-RAN architecture that supports the exchange of signalling information between the NG-RAN and 5GC. It separates the Radio Network Layer and Transport Network Layer and is future-proof to support new services and functions.

question_26418.question: What is the purpose of the getVersion() function as defined in clause 6.4.3.13?
question_26418.ground_truth: The getVersion() function is used to determine the version of the MBMS clients API implementation.

question_26420.question: How do Supplementary Services determine if a call is identified as UC?
question_26420.ground_truth: Supplementary Services do not mark a particular call as UC, but rather mark a particular user as being a potential UC source (black list), or another user as certainly not being a UC source (white list). A further call is identified as UC, or definitely not UC, by comparing the call source identity with the lists.

question_26421.question: What should the ME (Mobile Equipment) do if the alpha identifier is not provided by the UICC when sending a USSD request message?
question_26421.ground_truth: The ME may give information to the user concerning what is happening.

question_26422.question: In the example flow for the active bypass option, when would an IMS-ALG send a SIP INVITE request to establish an alternate media path segment?
question_26422.ground_truth: An IMS-ALG would send a SIP INVITE request to establish an alternate media path segment if it determines that it may be able to establish a shorter media path segment, and the new path segment appears to be significantly better than the one determined by the base algorithm.

question_26424.question: What is the role of the 5GMSd AF in the media session handling?
question_26424.ground_truth: The 5GMSd AF is responsible for acquiring the whole Service Access Information, interacting with the PCF or NEF service for policy authorization, and enforcing the applied policy to the media session.

question_26426.question: What is the auxiliary state for Call A-B and Call A-C after the MS successfully sends a FACILITY message with the transaction identifier for Call A-B and invite component SplitMPTY?
question_26426.ground_truth: Call A-B shall enter the auxiliary state "split request" and call A-C shall remain in state "Call in MPTY".

question_26427.question: What are the efficiency requirements related to resource utilization for the 5G system?
question_26427.ground_truth: The 5G system should optimize control and user plane resource usage for data transfer from send only UEs, stationary UEs, and transfer of infrequent small data units. It should also optimize resource use for transfer of continuous uplink data and high density connections.

question_26428.question: What does the "FullFDT" attribute in the FLUTE FDT indicate?
question_26428.ground_truth: The "FullFDT" attribute in the FLUTE FDT indicates that the FDT instance contains the exact set of Transport Objects that are currently scheduled for transmission by the sender in the actual FLUTE session.

question_26429.question: What is the minimum and maximum length of the CTS mobile group list information element?
question_26429.ground_truth: The CTS mobile group list information element has a minimum length of 5 octets and a maximum length of 26 octets.

question_26430.question: What is the interruption time for the combination of make-before-break and RACH-less handover?
question_26430.ground_truth: The interruption time for the combination of make-before-break and RACH-less handover is Tinterrupt = 5 + TUL_grant ms.

question_26431.question: Which 3GPP specification defines the functionality for IP transport and IP fragmentation at a RAN node on the Iu interface or S12?
question_26431.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 25.414 defines the functionality for IP transport and IP fragmentation at a RAN node on the Iu interface or S12.

question_26432.question: What are the relative code domain error requirements for a UE with two active transmit antenna connectors in UL CLTD activation state 1?
question_26432.ground_truth: The relative code domain error requirements specified in sub-clause 6.8.3a.1.1 apply at each transmit antenna connector.

question_26434.question: What should the UE do if the random-access attempt is performed on the contention based random-access resource and contention resolution was not successful for the transmitted preamble?
question_26434.ground_truth: The UE should set the contentionDetected to true.

question_26435.question: What consequence can the new shared data update notification functionality have regarding timing limitations?
question_26435.ground_truth: The consequence can be increased timing limitations derived from the massive update due to the high amount of data retrievals requested by MME/SGSN, leading to potential massive signaling between MME/SGSN and HSS and high demanding processing needs for MME/SGSN.

question_26437.question: What is the required measurement restriction when the SSB for RLM is in the same OFDM symbol as CSI-RS for RLM with different SCS for FR1?
question_26437.ground_truth: The UE is required to measure one of but not both SSB for RLM and CSI-RS with a longer measurement period for SSB based RLM if the UE does not support simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology.

question_26438.question: What should the UE do in a PLMN if it receives a 5GSM cause value of #27 "missing or unknown DNN" and provided a DNN to the network during PDU session establishment?
question_26438.ground_truth: The UE shall not send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for the same DNN in the current PLMN until the back-off timer expires, the UE is switched off, or the USIM is removed.

question_26439.question: When should the network retransmit the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message during a security mode control procedure?
question_26439.ground_truth: The network should retransmit the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message initially, and then retransmit it four more times if the timer T3560 expires. On the fifth expiry of timer T3560, the network should consider the security mode control procedure to be aborted.

question_26441.question: What is the role of the ADRF in the VPLMN?
question_26441.ground_truth: The ADRF in the VPLMN stores the "VPLMN UE analytics profile" for future use when UE is served by the VPLMN again.

question_26443.question: What must the eNodeB do if the Number of Reports Requested IE is set to 1 in the Write-Replace Warning Request message?
question_26443.ground_truth: The eNodeB must send a Warning Status Report message to the CBC immediately after expiration or cancellation of the warning message.

question_26444.question: What happens when the TSSF reports the ADC rule error to the PCRF?
question_26444.ground_truth: The TSSF reports the ADC rules error by sending a Diameter TNR command to the PCRF and the PCRF acknowledges to the TSSF by sending a Diameter TNA command.

question_26447.question: What is the allowed spurious emissions limit for a BTS receiver, measured in the frequency band 9 kHz to 1 GHz and 1 GHz to 12.75 GHz?
question_26447.ground_truth: The allowed spurious emissions limit for a BTS receiver, measured in the frequency band 9 kHz to 1 GHz is 2 nW (-57 dBm) and 20 nW (-47 dBm) in the frequency band 1 GHz to 12.75 GHz.

question_26448.question: What is the role of the RAN node in determining the conditions for a UE to enter RRC_INACTIVE state?
question_26448.ground_truth: RRC_INACTIVE state applies to NG-RAN, and it is up to the RAN to determine the conditions to enter RRC_INACTIVE state. The 5GC network is not aware of the UE transitions between CM-CONNECTED with RRC_CONNECTED and CM-CONNECTED with RRC_INACTIVE state, unless the 5GC network is notified via N2 notification procedure.

question_26450.question: What message is sent by the en-gNB to inform the MeNB that one or more RA reports are available at the UE in the context of EN-DC?

question_26451.question: What does the AMF store when it receives the authorized RFSP Index from the PCF with the validity time in the described solution?
question_26451.ground_truth: The AMF stores the authorized RFSP Index, validity time, and the resulting RFSP index in use.

question_26452.question: What should the I-CSCF do with the P-Charging-Function-Addresses header field when forwarding a response to a request, if the next hop is outside of the current network?
question_26452.ground_truth: The I-CSCF should remove the P-Charging-Function-Addresses header field prior to forwarding the message.

question_26454.question: What is the effect of handover on the service continuity when using Gm reference point for IMS sessions?
question_26454.ground_truth: A change of access network due to handover may result in an inability to use the PS access for the Gm reference point, and the service continuity is maintained by switching the signalling transport over to the CS access. Standard Handover procedures are used for handover of the Service Control Signalling Path and the CS Bearer Control Signalling Path.

question_26455.question: What functional entity enables the interworking between eMBMS and MBS for mission critical operation at the control plane?
question_26455.ground_truth: The Joint BM-SC, MBSF and MBSTF functional entity enables the interworking between eMBMS and MBS for mission critical operation at the control plane.

question_26457.question: What are the primary content differences between a MEASUREMENT CONTROL message for Intra frequency measurement and a regular MEASUREMENT CONTROL message?
question_26457.ground_truth: The primary difference is the inclusion of specific parameters and values related to Intra frequency measurement accuracy testing.

question_26458.question: What are the basic mechanisms executed in the OSA Framework prior to offering and activating applications?
question_26458.ground_truth: Some of the basic mechanisms executed in the OSA Framework prior to offering and activating applications include: Authentication, Authorisation, Discovery of Framework and network SCFs, Establishment of service agreement and Access to network SCFs. These mechanisms ensure secure and controlled access to network functionality for applications.

question_26459.question: What is the purpose of the gNB-CU-UP MBS E1AP ID in the 3GPP 5G system?
question_26459.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP MBS E1AP ID is used to uniquely identify the MBS Session Context over the E1 interface within a gNB-CU-UP in the 3GPP 5G system.

question_26460.question: When must the SAS include the Accuracy Fulfilment Indicator IE with the value "requested accuracy fulfilled" in the POSITION PERIODIC RESULT message?
question_26460.ground_truth: If the calculated position estimate fulfils the requested accuracy in the POSITION INITIATION REQUEST message that initiated periodic position reporting.

question_26461.question: Which alternative is preferable for E-MBMS and why?
question_26461.ground_truth: Alternative 2 is preferable for E-MBMS because it allows for faster delivery of Primary notifications to the UE than Alternative 2-1. Additionally, the eMBMS alternative is applicable to EUTRAN access only.

question_26462.question: What should the MS do if it receives a page in a different mode (A/Gb mode or Iu mode) as when it last sent data or signalling?
question_26462.ground_truth: The MS should perform the RA update procedure and the SGSN should accept this RAU as a valid response.

question_26463.question: What is the interface used for external binaural room impulse responses (BRIRs) and head-related impulse responses (HRIRs) in MPEG-H 3DA?
question_26463.ground_truth: The interface specified in ISO/IEC 23008-3, clause 17.4 is used for external BRIRs and HRIRs in MPEG-H 3DA.

question_26464.question: What happens when the USS triggers revocation of UUAA at any time?
question_26464.ground_truth: The USS sends a UUAA revocation request to UAS-NF, targeting the specific AMF or SMF, and upon verification, the UAS NF revokes the authorization of the UE and deletes the UUAA context.

question_26465.question: What are the requirements for the issuer name in the vendor base station certificate?
question_26465.ground_truth: The issuer name in the vendor base station certificate is the name of the vendor CA signing the base station certificate.

question_26466.question: What is the procedure for MCPTT session modification?
question_26466.ground_truth: The procedure for MCPTT session modification includes initial conditions as specified in the test case, the use of E-UTRA default system information messages, and specific message contents as specified in clause 5.5 and in the test case.

question_26467.question: What entity determines the validity time for the "authorized RFSP index" in the described solution?

question_26468.question: What are the two domains specified for a MO voice call between networks?
question_26468.ground_truth: The two domains specified for a MO voice call between networks are CS and IMS.

question_26469.question: What should the NF Service Consumer do if the target RAN failed to establish resources for the PDU sessions during the N2 handover procedure?
question_26469.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should indicate the failure to setup the PDU session in the target RAN by sending a POST request, as specified in clause 5.2.2.3.1, with the Path Switch Request Setup Failed Transfer IE including the cause why the session could not be setup.

question_26470.question: What is the state of the user's session before the UE decides to move from PS to CS in step 2c and step 12d?
question_26470.ground_truth: The user is in a pre-alerting state or in the alerting phase before the UE decides to move from PS to CS in step 2c and step 12d.

question_26471.question: What is the initiating message for the "CellSynchronisationReportingTDD" procedure?

question_26472.question: What is the purpose of NF consumer information such as Vendor ID in the discovery request during the ML Model Filter Information registration?
question_26472.ground_truth: NF consumer information such as Vendor ID is used in the discovery request during the ML Model Filter Information registration to identify the NF consumer (i.e. an NWDAF containing AnLF) and to provide the S-NSSAI(s), Area(s) of Interest of the Trained ML Model required, ML Model Interoperability indicator and NF consumer information.

question_26473.question: What purpose does the "minNumberOfDigits" and "maxNumberOfDigits" fields serve in the "MinimumMessageContent" definition?
question_26473.ground_truth: The "minNumberOfDigits" and "maxNumberOfDigits" fields in the "MinimumMessageContent" definition specify the minimum and maximum number of digits that shall be collected for a message content.

question_26474.question: What is the procedure for sending packets in SRv6 enhanced mode over N9?
question_26474.ground_truth: In SRv6 enhanced mode over N9, UPFs process packets by setting the IPv6 destination address as the next hop UPF address with TEID arguments during FAR processing. They insert one or multiple SIDs in a SRH between the IPv6 header and the encapsulated T-PDU.

question_26475.question: What is the purpose of the 'visited-realm' attribute in an SDP offer/answer transaction in the context of IMS-ALGs?
question_26475.ground_truth: The 'visited-realm' attribute in an SDP offer/answer transaction is used to indicate the IP realms that have been visited during the session setup. This information is used by IMS-ALGs to determine whether TrGWs can be bypassed and to optimize the media path.

question_26476.question: What is the function of the "Availability Notification after DDN Failure" solution described in section 5.4?
question_26476.ground_truth: The "Availability Notification after DDN Failure" solution is designed to notify an application of the availability of a UE that may be a high latency UE, with minimized signalling load.

question_26478.question: What are the three tests that a floating-point implementation based on TS 26.443 should pass to be conformant?
question_26478.ground_truth: Decoder test based on Signal metrics, Encoder test, and MOS-LQO verification based on POLQA.

question_26479.question: What are the two primary types of mission critical services?
question_26479.ground_truth: Mission critical services can be divided into two categories: those requiring ultra-reliable communications and those involving speech, audio, and video in virtual and augmented reality scenarios.

question_26480.question: What message does the RNC send to the RAN node to indicate that the UE is attaching in the CS domain?
question_26480.ground_truth: The RNC sends a Direct Transfer message with the Reroute Command IE, indicating that the UE is attaching in the CS domain.

question_26481.question: What is the requirement for end-to-end latency for transport of messages between two UEs supporting V2V applications, that are part of a group of UEs supporting V2V applications, as specified in PR-5.5-003a?

question_26484.question: What information does the SGSN send to the GMLC if it returns the last known location of the target UE?
question_26484.ground_truth: If the SGSN returns the last known location of the target UE, it may record charging information and send the location information, its age, and obtained accuracy indication to the GMLC, if the privacy checks were successfully executed.

question_26485.question: What is the role of the Local MBMS Area?
question_26485.ground_truth: The Local MBMS Area is a defined area of a MBMS service, where the service content is the same. Different Local MBMS Areas can have different content for the same MBMS service.

question_26488.question: What is the first band selected for a second bit allocation if the average number of bits per bin of the first band is less than the second band?
question_26488.ground_truth: The first band will be selected as the second band for a second bit allocation.

question_26489.question: What is the action performed by a UE when it receives an INVITE request that includes a Replaces header?
question_26489.ground_truth: Upon receipt of an INVITE request that includes a Replaces header, the UE shall apply the procedures described in RFC 3891 to the INVITE request.

question_26490.question: What is the role of the NRF in federated learning group creation?
question_26490.ground_truth: The NRF supports new discovery parameters related to federated learning group creation.

question_26491.question: How can the significant generalization performance degradation for Tx-Rx beam pair prediction in the NW side model be improved?
question_26491.ground_truth: The significant generalization performance degradation for Tx-Rx beam pair prediction in the NW side model can be improved by using mixed data for model training, or relying on model switching based on applicable scenarios.

question_26492.question: What is the network procedure performed when the MS is in state U9 during a mobile terminating call?
question_26492.ground_truth: An assignment procedure is performed for traffic channel.

question_26493.question: What is the key information exchanged between adjacent Diameter peers in the MDOC solution?
question_26493.ground_truth: The key information exchanged between adjacent Diameter peers in the MDOC solution is the current server load as well as an indication of overload state and severity.

question_26495.question: When is the UE considered to be OFF during measurement gaps and transmission/reception gaps for ProSe?
question_26495.ground_truth: During measurement gaps and transmission/reception gaps for ProSe, the UE is not considered to be OFF.

question_26498.question: How should a PIN Element collect charging information when using operator managed spectrum for PIN direct connections?
question_26498.ground_truth: The 5G system should support mechanisms for the PIN to collect charging information, including timestamps for start and stop of communications, and amount of data sent/received.

question_26499.question: What is the format of the serving cell-ID(s) in the currentLocation field when the location type is CGI or ECGI?
question_26499.ground_truth: The serving cell-ID(s) in the currentLocation field follows the format defined in clause 8.4.2.8 when the location type is CGI or ECGI.

question_26500.question: What are the two types of rules defined in the document and what do they consist of?
question_26500.ground_truth: The two types of rules defined in the document are Inter-System Routing Policy (ISRP) rules and Inter-APN Routing Policy (IARP) rules. An ISRP rule consists of one or more flow distribution containers, and a flow distribution container consists of one or more flow distribution rules. Similarly, an IARP rule consists of one or more flow distribution containers, and a flow distribution container consists of one or more flow distribution rules.

question_26501.question: What is the method used by Solution #23 to manage AF-specific and temporary UE IDs at the Edge Enabler Layer?
question_26501.ground_truth: Solution #23 reuses a SA2-defined CN capability to translate the UE's private IP address to its UE ID, allowing the EES to convert the CN or EEC provided UE ID to an Edge UE ID.

question_26502.question: What is the name of the sequence used in the initial cell search procedure to estimate coarse CFO using PSS?

question_26504.question: What information does the SMF provide to the UPF regarding the PINE?
question_26504.ground_truth: Depending on what the PEGC provides, the SMF will provide the UPF with either the framed routing information or the IP address that the PEGC has allocated to the PINE.

question_26506.question: What is the requirement for the relative accuracy of RSRP in inter-frequency cases?
question_26506.ground_truth: The relative accuracy of RSRP in inter-frequency cases is defined as the RSRP measured from one cell compared to the RSRP measured from another cell on a different frequency, with a maximum allowable difference of 27 dB.

question_26507.question: What action should the NG-RAN take if there is no match to any Alternative QoS Profile during QoS Flow establishment or modification?
question_26507.ground_truth: The NG-RAN should reject the QoS Flow establishment or modification.

question_26509.question: What is the primary function of the Antenna Test Function (ATF) in the antenna pattern measurement of the first stage RTS test?
question_26509.ground_truth: The Antenna Test Function (ATF) measures the amplitude and relative phase of known signals incident at the DUT antennas using the SS Reference Signal Received Power per Branch (SS-RSRPB) and SS Reference Signal Antenna Relative Phase (SS-RSARP) measurements. This functionality is commonly referred to as the Antenna Test Function (ATF).

question_26510.question: What is the format of the MICH-768-Parameters-CTCH-ReconfRqstTDD sequence?
question_26510.ground_truth: The MICH-768-Parameters-CTCH-ReconfRqstTDD sequence is a SEQUENCE that consists of commonPhysicalChannelID768, mICH-Power, and iE-Extensions.

question_26511.question: How is a specific instance of VGCS or VBS identified in a given group call area?
question_26511.ground_truth: Through Voice Group Call References, which are unique combinations of Group ID and the Group Call Area Id.

question_26512.question: What steps does the SS take after receiving the MeasurementReport message from the UE during T2?
question_26512.ground_truth: After receiving the MeasurementReport message from the UE during T2, the SS shall transmit RRCRelease message to release the RRC connection and all radio resources or switch the UE off.

question_26513.question: What is the method for a UE to receive 5GS access stratum time or time-synchronized UPF/NW-TT for time synchronization services in 5G?
question_26513.ground_truth: The UE can receive 5GS access stratum time or time-synchronized UPF/NW-TT for time synchronization services in 5G through various sources of time/frequency like GNSS signal, Synchronous Ethernet (Sync E), PTP transport network, PPS input, etc. 5G GM may collocate with UPF or RAN, not limited with the deployment.

question_26514.question: What is a Key Issue regarding homing and affiliation in MCPTT and LMR systems?
question_26514.ground_truth: Key Issue #2-1: Group affiliation management. This key issue involves managing affiliation of users to a group, sending affiliations to the controlling system, and considering the system to be permanently implicitly affiliated.

question_26515.question: What message does a new SGSN send to GGSNs to update their MBMS UE Context fields during an Inter SGSN Routeing Area Update procedure?
question_26515.ground_truth: The new SGSN sends Update MBMS UE Context Request (Serving network identity, MS Time Zone, CGI/SAI, RAT Type, Additional MBMS Trace Info) to the GGSNs concerned.

question_26516.question: What should the UE do upon sending the PMFP UAD PROVISIONING message in step 5.4.8.2?
question_26516.ground_truth: The UE should start a timer T106.

question_26517.question: What message format is required for the CoAP POST request when registering to the gateway service in MSGin5G?
question_26517.ground_truth: The "Content-Format" element should be set to "50" to indicate the format of the CoAP payload is "application/json".

question_26518.question: What happens when an MCVideo server initiates termination of an ongoing MCVideo private call?
question_26518.ground_truth: When an MCVideo server initiates termination of an ongoing MCVideo private call, it sends an MCVideo call end request towards the MCVideo clients involved in the call, and the MCVideo clients release all the media plane resources used for the private call.

question_26519.question: How does the TSCTSF associate a UE address to a flow when the flow is UE-to-UE?
question_26519.ground_truth: If the flow is UE-to-UE, the TSCTSF breaks up the requirements to individual requirements for the PDU Sessions, as this type of flow affects two PDU Sessions.

question_26520.question: What is the criteria used by the UE to determine a higher priority PLMN for registration?
question_26520.ground_truth: The UE determines a higher priority PLMN based on the list of preferred PLMN/access technology combinations received in the steering of roaming information and its own determination of available and allowable PLMNs in the area.

question_26522.question: What should an ICS UE use as the B-Party number when establishing a CS Bearer Control Signalling Path after sending Service Control Signalling over I1 or Gm?
question_26522.ground_truth: The routing number provided by the network in response to the Service Control Signalling.

question_26523.question: In the 3GPP Technical Specification group, what do the constructions "shall" and "shall not" indicate in a normative context?
question_26523.ground_truth: In the 3GPP Technical Specification group, the constructions "shall" and "shall not" are used to indicate a mandatory requirement and an interdiction (prohibition) to do something, respectively. These constructions are confined to the context of normative provisions.

question_26524.question: What is the requirement for the number of SSB and CSI-RS layers that the UE must be capable of measuring in CSI-RS based L3 measurements in R16?
question_26524.ground_truth: For each serving cell, the UE must be able to measure at least 1 SSB intra-frequency layer and 1 CSI-RS intra-frequency layer. Additionally, the UE must be able to measure at least 8 NR inter-frequency layers including SSB and CSI-RS in total.

question_26525.question: What is the minimum number of occurrences for the "discovery-request" and "restricted-discovery-request" elements in the "prose-direct-discovery-request" complex type?
question_26525.ground_truth: The minimum number of occurrences for the "discovery-request" and "restricted-discovery-request" elements in the "prose-direct-discovery-request" complex type is 0.

question_26527.question: What is the procedure for PC5 assisted Network-based positioning?
question_26527.ground_truth: The procedure for PC5 assisted Network-based positioning includes sending the location request for UE1 to the LMF, which may first trigger the Uu-based positioning for UE1. Based on the requested LCS QoS, LMF determines to trigger discovery of a Located UE for positioning assistance and sends the Application ID to UE2 to trigger the UE2 discovering UE1 reusing the 5G ProSe Direct Discovery procedure. The LMF sends the Application ID to UE1 to trigger UE1 discovering UE2 for positioning assistance. UE1 and UE2 perform the 5G ProSe Direct Discovery procedure, and based on the discovery report, the LMF determines which UE as a Located UE.

question_26528.question: What happens when the target UE receives a PROSE AA MESSAGE TRANSPORT REQUEST message?
question_26528.ground_truth: The target UE passes the EAP message in the PROSE AA MESSAGE TRANSPORT REQUEST message to the upper layer for the external DN authentication and generates a PROSE AA MESSAGE TRANSPORT RESPONSE message including the EAP message IE set to the received EAP message from the upper layers.

question_26529.question: What does the Handover Device do when the MSC-1 Server requests it to set to the intermediate state?
question_26529.ground_truth: The Handover Device sets the Handover Device to the intermediate state, as requested by the MSC-1 Server.

question_26531.question: What is the maximum allowed performance degradation for the macrocell?
question_26531.ground_truth: The maximum allowed performance degradation for the macrocell is 3%.

question_26532.question: What should the UE do when it receives a request from upper layers to send NAS signalling not associated with establishing either a CS emergency call or a PDN connection for emergency bearer services in EMM-CONNECTED mode?
question_26532.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3440 in this case.

question_26533.question: What is the purpose of the SIP-Forking-Indication AVP?
question_26533.ground_truth: The SIP-Forking-Indication AVP describes if several SIP dialogues are related to one Diameter session.

question_26535.question: What should be done when the timeAlignmentTimer associated with the PTAG is not running, except for the Random Access Preamble transmission?
question_26535.ground_truth: No uplink transmission should be performed on any serving cell, except for the Random Access Preamble transmission on the SpCell.

question_26536.question: What is the expected final state of the MS in the test case "Outgoing call / U0.1 MM connection pending / CM service rejected"?
question_26536.ground_truth: The expected final state of the MS in this test case is U0, null.

question_26537.question: In what scenario is the Signalling integrity protection policy set to "Signalling integrity protection preferred" when the 5G ProSe direct link establishment procedure is for direct communication between the 5G ProSe remote UE and the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE?
question_26537.ground_truth: When the RSC is specific for emergency services, and the initiating UE has a valid USIM.

question_26538.question: What is the data type and corresponding 3GPP clause for the "PartnerMCDataSystemId" element?
question_26538.ground_truth: The data type for the "PartnerMCDataSystemId" element is "anyURI", and it corresponds to clause 10.2.97 in 3GPP TS 24.483.

question_26540.question: What should the value of bit 8 in Octet 7 be, if the PGW requests the MME/SGSN or TWAN/ePDG to provide the User Location Information?
question_26540.ground_truth: The value of bit 8 in Octet 7 should be set to 1, if the PGW requests the MME/SGSN or TWAN/ePDG to provide the User Location Information.

question_26541.question: What should the MS do when it receives a detach request with cause 'GPRS detach' or 'combined GPRS/IMSI detach' while waiting for a ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message during a routing area updating procedure?
question_26541.ground_truth: The MS should terminate the routing area updating procedure and continue with the GPRS detach procedure.

question_26542.question: What is one of the objectives for the UC protection framework in 7.5.1?
question_26542.ground_truth: To be scalable to a large number of interconnected domains, while not requiring extensive use of asymmetrical cryptography.

question_26543.question: What is the reported measurement result after layer 1 filtering in the E-UTRA measurement model?
question_26543.ground_truth: The reported measurement result after layer 1 filtering in the E-UTRA measurement model is an estimate of the average value of the measured quantity over the measurement period.

question_26544.question: In the context of restricted serving cell symbols due to measurement of MO i, what do the serving cell symbols fully or partially overlap with SMTC window for MO i and on 1 serving cell symbol before and after the SMTC window represent?
question_26544.ground_truth: These represent the serving cell symbols that overlap with the measurement occasion (MO) window for MO i and include one serving cell symbol before and after the MO window. The UE is not expected to transmit or receive specific signals during these symbols due to measurement restrictions.

question_26545.question: What is the significance of the "Ud" reference point in the 3GPP technical specifications?
question_26545.ground_truth: The "Ud" reference point is significant in the 3GPP technical specifications as it is used for the communication of user data between functional entities, such as application front ends and user data repositories.

question_26546.question: How should the MC service client or user receive MC service from a partner MC system during migration?
question_26546.ground_truth: UE A, the device of the MC service user, should be provisioned with necessary credentials and information for connecting to the partner MC system, which can be done automatically or by prompting the user.

question_26547.question: Which interface does a 3G ME not support for compatibility with 5V only SIMs?
question_26547.ground_truth: A 3G ME does not support a 5V ME/UICC or a 5V ME/SIM interface.

question_26548.question: What should the MS do when it receives a Facility IE in which certain e-parameters are set to zero?
question_26548.ground_truth: The total charge accumulated should be the same as that when the same e-parameters are completely omitted from the Facility IE.

question_26551.question: What is the TFCI transmit power when there is no data in any transport channel for a given TTI and a TFCI is defined for no transmission on all transport channels multiplexed on the S-CCPCH?
question_26551.ground_truth: The TFCI transmit power is unspecified and can be for example 0 or determined by the Node B relatively to Pref-nodata = Min (PCH Power, Max FACH1 Power, Max FACH2 Power,...., Max FACHn Power) where PCH, FACH1, FACH2,..., FACHn are the transport channels of the S-CCPCH.

question_26553.question: What is the purpose of Message 2 method in ProSe Communication path?
question_26553.ground_truth: The Message 2 method in ProSe Communication path is used to inform the SIP/IMS clients of the new media description for a subset of IP flows using IP@A2 and IP@B2. This allows UE A and UE B to start sending media packets on the ProSe Communication path upon reception of the Message 2 OK and Message 2 ACK, respectively.

question_26554.question: What could happen if an attacker performs a denial-of-service attack against a H(e)NB?
question_26554.ground_truth: It can result in an annoying service interruption for users and operators.

question_26555.question: What action is taken when the S-CSCF-hA1 receives the SIP INVITE request in step 25?
question_26555.ground_truth: The S-CSCF-hA1 decides not to loopback the SIP INVITE request and forwards the call to the terminating home network.

question_26556.question: What should the MCVideo client do when it receives a PRIVATE CALL ACCEPT message in the "P5: pending" state?
question_26556.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should send a PRIVATE CALL ACCEPT message in response, stop timer TFP4 if it is running, and enter the "P4: part of ongoing call" state.

question_26557.question: Which solution proposes to support message communication for FFAPP?

question_26558.question: What is the difference between clause 5.5.1.2 and 5.5.1.2a regarding Detach Procedure and UE-requested PDN Disconnection on S2b?
question_26558.ground_truth: The difference is in the tunnel type used, GTP is used in 5.5.1.2a instead of PMIPv6 used in 5.5.1.2.

question_26560.question: What information does the TNGF include in the IKEv2 Create Child SA Request message for a GBR flow with an IPsec child SA carrying a GBR flow?
question_26560.ground_truth: The TNGF includes QoS Characteristics and GBR QoS Flow Information in the IKEv2 Create Child SA Request message for a GBR flow with an IPsec child SA carrying a GBR flow.

question_26561.question: What does the "spatial mapping service" offer to the customers?
question_26561.ground_truth: The "spatial mapping service" gathers sensor data in order to create and maintain a Spatial Map that can be used to offer customers Spatial Localization Service.

question_26564.question: What action does the SMF take when a request is received to disable QoS monitoring for all requested QoS monitoring parameters?
question_26564.ground_truth: The SMF updates the PCC rule with the "refQosMon" attribute set to NULL and removes the corresponding QoS Monitoring Data instance(s) if no PCC rule is referring to it.

question_26565.question: What information must the BSS include in the handover request message in case of BSS external handover?
question_26565.ground_truth: The LSA information for the connection must be included in the handover request message in case of BSS external handover.

question_26566.question: What is the RSTD measurement accuracy for a PRS bandwidth that the UE must meet during an intra-frequency handover for all measured neighbor cells in TDD systems?
question_26566.ground_truth: The RSTD measurement accuracy for a PRS bandwidth which is not larger than the minimum channel bandwidth of all the PCells during the RSTD measurement period must be met for all measured neighbor cells by the UE during an intra-frequency handover in TDD systems.

question_26567.question: What are the possible values for the PC5-Radio-Technology AVP?
question_26567.ground_truth: The PC5-Radio-Technology AVP can take the values of EUTRA, WLAN, and Both EUTRA and WLAN.

question_26568.question: What type of measurements are related to the call release in IMS?
question_26568.ground_truth: The measurements related to the call release in IMS are divided into four categories: call release initiated by CS network, call release initiated by IM CN subsystem, call release initiated by MGCF, and call release initiated by MGW.

question_26569.question: What is the impact of the "Command Operator Selection +COPS" in the context of MT power levels?
question_26569.ground_truth: The "Command Operator Selection +COPS" command is used to force registration/deregistration in the network and is not affected by the MT power level command.

question_26570.question: What should the SGSN do when it receives an attach request indicating combined IMSI and GPRS attach while timer T6-1 is running and the new LAI is different but is in the same VLR as the outstanding request?
question_26570.ground_truth: The SGSN ignores any response from the VLR to the outstanding request, stops and resets Timer T6-1, and starts the location update for non-GPRS service procedure.

question_26571.question: What is the purpose of autocorrelation analysis in linear prediction?
question_26571.ground_truth: The purpose of autocorrelation analysis in linear prediction is to determine the coefficients of the synthesis filter of the CELP (Code-Excited Linear Prediction) model.

question_26573.question: What does it mean when a network provides NGN services to end-users regardless of the access technology in the NGN environment?
question_26573.ground_truth: It means that the network can deliver NGN services to users, such as voice and data, using various technologies for connecting to the network, such as Wi-Fi, 4G, or 5G, and the choice of technology does not affect the user's experience.

question_26574.question: Which two IP version values can be assigned to the "AddressType" leaf?
question_26574.ground_truth: The "AddressType" leaf can be assigned the values "IPv4" or "IPv6".

question_26575.question: What information does the UPF send in the notification when the granularity of the measurement is per data flow?
question_26575.ground_truth: When the granularity of the measurement is per data flow, the notification includes the packet filter set and the Applications Identifier if available.

question_26576.question: What should the MCPTT client do upon receiving a SIP INVITE request with an emergency indication in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body?
question_26576.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should display an indication for the Pre-arranged MCPTT emergency group call to the user and respond to the SS with correct SIP messages when it receives a SIP INVITE request with an emergency indication in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body.

question_26577.question: What is the purpose of testing that the MS aborts the packet access procedure when it receives a CHANNEL RELEASE message before the expiry of T3148?
question_26577.ground_truth: The purpose is to verify that the MS completes the release before re-attempting the establishment of the uplink TBF.

question_26578.question: What is the behavior of the USS when the HTTP POST request cannot be fulfilled?
question_26578.ground_truth: If the USS cannot successfully fulfil the received HTTP POST request due to an internal error or an error in the HTTP POST request, the USS shall send the HTTP error response as specified in clause~5.1.7.

question_26579.question: How does the 5GMS Client determine the delivery network for media content in hybrid services?
question_26579.ground_truth: The 5GMS Client, in collaboration with the Media Player and Media Session Handler, dynamically selects the delivery network based on reception conditions, user preferences, or other policies.

question_26580.question: What is the purpose of the User Info ID in the ProSe direct discovery service authorization for UE-to-network relaying?
question_26580.ground_truth: The User Info ID is used to identify the UE-to-network relay discovery in the ProSe direct discovery service authorization.

question_26582.question: What should be included in the Accept-Contact header field when sending a SIP INVITE request to establish a private MCPTT call?
question_26582.ground_truth: The Accept-Contact header field should include the media feature tag g.3gpp.icsi-ref with the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt" and the parameters "require" and "explicit".

question_26583.question: What action does the SGSN take when it receives a BVC-BLOCK PDU from the BSS?
question_26583.ground_truth: The SGSN marks the indicated BVC as blocked and stops transmitting traffic addressed to this BVC when it receives a BVC-BLOCK PDU from the BSS.

question_26585.question: What should the SS do if the UE has re-selected Cell 4 within T3?
question_26585.ground_truth: The SS should continue with step 16.

question_26586.question: What is the condition for a UE to start transmitting UL MAC PDU in a symbol with timeDomainOffset 15 and continue transmitting UL MAC PDU in a symbol with timeDomainOffset 5?
question_26586.ground_truth: When the UE receives another UL grant type 1 in an RRC message with timeDomainOffset 15.

question_26587.question: What message is transmitted by the GANC when it initiates the transport channel deactivation procedure?
question_26587.ground_truth: The GA-RRC DEACTIVATE CHANNEL message is transmitted by the GANC when it initiates the transport channel deactivation procedure.

question_26588.question: What is the PDU Session type used between the Relay UE and Relay UE UPF for the Remote UE traffic over PC5 UE-to-NW Relay path?
question_26588.ground_truth: The PDU Session type used between the Relay UE and Relay UE UPF for the Remote UE traffic over PC5 UE-to-NW Relay path is IP.

question_26589.question: What message does the MS receive during the packet access procedure in step 4 for k=1 and k=2 related to the mechanism of assuring a proper handover?
question_26589.ground_truth: In step 4 for k=1 and k=2, the MS receives the INTER SYSTEM TO UTRAN HANDOVER COMMAND message during the packet access procedure, which is sent by the network to instruct the MS to update its serving UMTS cell and establish lower layer connections for handover assurance.

question_26590.question: What is the purpose of using anycast DNS in discovering Edge Application Server (EAS)?
question_26590.ground_truth: The purpose is to create a unified anycast IP address for all DNS servers in the edge hosting environment and all central DNS servers, making UE agnostic to any change of DNS server as the IP address remains the same.

question_26591.question: What parameters can be used to customize the analytics provided by the NWDAF in the traffic flow statistics use case?
question_26591.ground_truth: The parameters include "temporal granularity size" and "spatial granularity size". The "temporal granularity size" parameter determines the time range of the data that should be included in the analytics, and the "spatial granularity size" parameter determines the geographical region that should be covered by the analytics.

question_26592.question: What is the measurement position for each frequency range in the context of spurious emissions?
question_26592.ground_truth: The measurement position for each frequency range should be set at the lowest boundary of the frequency range plus MBW/2 for the lower boundary, and at the highest boundary of the frequency range minus MBW/2 for the highest boundary.

question_26593.question: When shall the old MME include UE Radio Capability for Paging information to the new MME in the Context Response or Forward Relocation Request message?
question_26593.ground_truth: The old MME shall include UE Radio Capability for Paging information to the new MME in the Context Response or Forward Relocation Request message if it is available.

question_26596.question: What does the term "NSA" refer to in the 3GPP Technical Specification and what mode does it operate in?
question_26596.ground_truth: "NSA" stands for Non-Standalone. It is a mode of operation where the operation of one radio is assisted with another radio. It operates in EN-DC mode as per the TRP/TRS test procedures in this specification.

question_26597.question: What is the parameter specified by pdsch-AllocationList in the time domain resource allocation scheme?
question_26597.ground_truth: The entries of pdsch-AllocationList are referred to by DCI in the time domain resource allocation scheme.

question_26598.question: What message is returned by the EES to the EEC if the EEC selects an EAS which is instantiable but not yet instantiated?
question_26598.ground_truth: The EES sends an EAS information provisioning request for EAS selection indicating the selected EAS ID to the EEC.

question_26599.question: What should the gNB-CU do if it receives a F1 SETUP REQUEST message containing the RRC Terminating IAB-Donor gNB-ID IE and the BAP Address IE?
question_26599.ground_truth: The gNB-CU shall, if supported, consider the BAP address indicated by the BAP address IE is assigned by the gNB-CU of the RRC-terminating IAB-donor indicated by the RRC Terminating IAB-Donor gNB-ID IE and use this BAP address and gNB-ID for the subsequent IAB Transport Migration Management procedure towards the RRC-terminating IAB-donor of the mobile IAB-node.

question_26600.question: What should the network do if the T3422 timer expires while a network initiated detach procedure is in progress?
question_26600.ground_truth: The network should retransmit the DETACH REQUEST message and start timer T3422 to repeat the retransmission four times. If the detach type is "IMSI detach" or "re-attach not required" and the EMM cause value is #2 "IMSI unknown in HSS", the network should not change the current EMM state. Otherwise, the network should change to the EMM-DEREGISTERED state.

question_26602.question: What does the UE do when it updates ISIM parameters?
question_26602.ground_truth: After updating ISIM parameters, the UE shall use the new values when registering to IMS the next time, but it is not required to perform deregistration, it will wait for the network-initiated deregistration procedures to occur.

question_26603.question: What information is used for correlation between IRI and CC of an IMS VoIP session?
question_26603.ground_truth: A Correlation number and Correlation parameter may be used to provide further correlation between IRI and CC of an IMS VoIP session, and also between IRI messages of the same IMS VoIP session. Additionally, imsVoIP can be used to provide correlation when clause 12 is used.

question_26604.question: What should the CTS-MS do when it receives a message that is not compatible with the protocol state, and the message is not one of the messages listed in subclauses 8.5.1, 8.5.2, or 8.5.3?
question_26604.ground_truth: The CTS-MS should ignore the message, except for returning a status message with cause #96 if an RR connection exists.

question_26605.question: What is the role of the CAPIF core function/authorization function in Solution 13?
question_26605.ground_truth: The CAPIF core function/authorization function obtains resource owner related policies and authorizes the API invoker to request resources belonging to the owner in Solution 13.

question_26607.question: What is the meaning of "may" in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
question_26607.ground_truth: In 3GPP technical specifications, "may" indicates permission to do something.

question_26608.question: What step determines the members of an MCData group based on the information from the group management server?
question_26608.ground_truth: Step 3 determines the members of an MCData group based on the information from the group management server.

question_26610.question: What is the maximum allowed interruption duration on any active serving cell in MCG when one NR SCell is switched from dormancy to non-dormancy or vice versa?
question_26610.ground_truth: The interruption is allowed to active serving cell in MCG regardless of which parameters change between the dormant BWP and the non-dormant BWP.

question_26612.question: What is the purpose of the QoS leaf in the IP flow description?
question_26612.ground_truth: The QoS leaf indicates the DS or ToS values parameters in a flow description, with any value in the range from 0 up to and including 63 in a binary form.

question_26613.question: What is the format of the SIP-Auth-Data-Item AVP in diameter messages for 3GPP WLAN Wx reference point?
question_26613.ground_truth: The SIP-Auth-Data-Item AVP for 3GPP WLAN Wx reference point contains various information such as SIP-Item-Number, SIP-Authentication-Scheme, SIP-Authenticate, SIP-Authorization, SIP-Authentication-Context, Confidentiality-Key, Integrity-Key, Authentication-Method, and Authentication-Information-SIM/SIM.

question_26615.question: When should the UE send a Match Report (non-roaming) in the open discovery?
question_26615.ground_truth: If a UE finds a ProSe Application Code that matches the Discovery Filters and doesn't have the corresponding ProSe Application ID locally stored, it shall send a Match Report.

question_26616.question: What action shall the SMF take upon receipt of the PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message, if timer T3590 has expired?
question_26616.ground_truth: The SMF shall abort the procedure after retransmitting the PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message four times.

question_26617.question: What entity is responsible for triggering the S-GW to allocate a dedicated bearer in the PMIP-based S5/S8 procedure?

question_26618.question: What is the format of the Root NAI for network and mobile client when the UE attempts a MIPv4 registration while attached to the HPLMN?
question_26618.ground_truth: The Root NAI format is specified in 3GPP TS 23.003.

question_26619.question: What is the purpose of security mechanisms in CAPIF?
question_26619.ground_truth: To provide security for the service APIs, including hiding the topology of the service, authenticating and authorizing API invokers, controlling service API access and protecting the communication between the CAPIF and the API invoker.

question_26621.question: What is the command qualifier in "Excepted Sequence 1.9"?
question_26621.ground_truth: The command qualifier is "only if not currently busy on another call with redial".

question_26623.question: What is the key issue with the M-bit setting for AVPs in the Diameter protocol?
question_26623.ground_truth: The key issue is that the M-bit setting for AVPs needs to be application and command-specific, but for AVPs owned by other 3GPP Diameter Applications, the M-bit setting may not be appropriate.

question_26625.question: What should the UE do when the discard timer expires for a PDCP SDU?
question_26625.ground_truth: The UE should discard the PDCP SDU along with the corresponding PDCP PDU, and indicate to lower layers if the PDU has already been submitted for transmission.

question_26626.question: What is the relationship between the terms and definitions used in the document and those in other 3GPP documents, as defined in section 3.1?
question_26626.ground_truth: If a term is defined in the present document, it takes precedence over the definition of the same term in 3GPP TS 32.150, 3GPP TS 32.101, 3GPP TS 32.102, and 3GPP TR~21.905.

question_26627.question: How can the network ensure the grant handling for retransmission in TG scheduling?
question_26627.ground_truth: The network can either prioritize a retransmission by granting the new user one TTI at a time or delay a retransmission until the next occasion.

question_26629.question: When a UE creates a conference with an INVITE request, what should be the identity used by the UE in the communications now on HOLD?
question_26629.ground_truth: The UE shall use the same identity as the UE used in the communications now on HOLD. If the UE uses identity C or identity D for the established sessions, the UE shall add the Additional-Identity header field containing this identity.

question_26630.question: What are the fault supervision operations in the 3GPP management services not addressed by ONAP?
question_26630.ground_truth: The fault supervision operations specified in 3GPP fault supervision management services and not addressed by ONAP include acknowledgeAlarms (), unacknowledgeAlarms (), and clearAlarms ().

question_26631.question: What is the capability that the 3GPP management system provides with its management service?
question_26631.ground_truth: The capability is to find a communication service description based on a request or to assign/remove a communication service instance to/from a network slice instance.

question_26632.question: What is the expected advantage of having consistent and aligned PM and PM interfaces in 3GPP and TMF?
question_26632.ground_truth: The advantages include CAPEX reduction through less development and integration cost, and OPEX reduction through consistent handling of performance measurements collection.

question_26633.question: When is the UE required to send an ACK message in the random access procedure?
question_26633.ground_truth: The UE is required to send an ACK message if the Contention Resolution is successful.

question_26634.question: What should the E-UTRAN do when it determines a VoIP-incapable cell as a target cell for SRVCC handover for a specific UE with an established voice bearer?
question_26634.ground_truth: The establishment of the voice bearer will be rejected by the target access.

question_26635.question: What is the role of the PCF in initiating an SM Policy Association Modification procedure based on triggers from other peers?
question_26635.ground_truth: The PCF may initiate the SM Policy Association Modification procedure based on triggers from other peers such as AF, NWDAF, CHF, UDR and TSCTSF.

question_26637.question: What is the protocol used by the GGSN/P-GW for handling IP-Multicast traffic in the User Plane CIoT EPS Optimization and the Control Plane CIoT EPS Optimization?
question_26637.ground_truth: Multicast traffic is handled at the application level from a Packet Domain perspective and is sent over UDP/IP

question_26639.question: What is the role of exceptions in interface operations?
question_26639.ground_truth: Exceptions in interface operations are used to indicate when an operation fails due to an invalid input parameter, an unsupported optional input parameter, or an internal problem, and to provide a consistent way to handle and respond to such failures.

question_26640.question: What is SCEF Reference ID used for in the Monitoring Procedure?
question_26640.ground_truth: SCEF Reference ID is used to associate a Monitoring Event report or a deletion of a Monitoring Event to a specific Monitoring Request and the associated context information within the SCEF.

question_26641.question: What is the expected sequence for test 84.4.4.2.3?
question_26641.ground_truth: MS is made to initiate GA-RRC connection for PS domain, MS sends GA-RRC REQUEST message and activates timer TU5908, the SS initiates paging procedure by sending GA-RRC PAGING REQUEST message to the MS when TU5908 is active in MS, MS discards the received GA-RRC PAGING REQUEST message, after TU5908 expiry, the SS sends GA-RRC PAGING REQUEST to verify that MS is in GA-RRC-IDLE state, MS may answer by sending GA-RRC INITIAL DIRECT TRANSFER or re-establish the GA-RRC connection by re-sending GA-RRC REQUEST message.

question_26642.question: What is the probability threshold that the probability of re-selection from Cell 2 to Cell 1 during T3 observed during testing should be less than?

question_26643.question: What is the expected user experience in case of a handover between E-UTRAN and GSM/UMTS CS in the VPLMN?
question_26643.ground_truth: The user experience will be comparable to the one in the non-roaming case, as the handover will be performed solely in the VPLMN.

question_26644.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon expiry of timer TFB2 (broadcast retransmission) in the "B2: in-progress broadcast group call" state?
question_26644.ground_truth: Upon expiry of timer TFB2 (broadcast retransmission) in the "B2: in-progress broadcast group call" state, the MCVideo client should generate a new GROUP CALL BROADCAST message and send it, restart timer TFB2, and remain in the "B2: in-progress broadcast group call" state.

question_26645.question: Which IETF Working Group has discussed the use of TCP PEP to improve the performance of Internet protocols on network paths with specific characteristics?
question_26645.ground_truth: The Performance Implications of Link Characteristics Working Group (PILC) has discussed the use of TCP PEP to improve the performance of Internet protocols on network paths with specific characteristics.

question_26646.question: What is the purpose of N50 reference point in the 5GS PWS architecture?
question_26646.ground_truth: N50 is a reference point between the AMF and the CBCF or between the AMF and the PWS-IWF, which uses service-based interfaces.

question_26647.question: What happens if the UE cannot include all feature sets and feature set combinations due to message size or list size constraints?
question_26647.ground_truth: It is up to the UE implementation to prioritize which feature sets and feature set combinations to include.

question_26648.question: What condition will lead to PDN-GW initiated PDN Disconnection procedure?
question_26648.ground_truth: If UE is assigned only IPv4 HoA, then PDN-GW initiated PDN Disconnection procedure is initiated.

question_26649.question: Which interface in the TNGF-TNGF architecture enables UE mobility between different TNGFs?
question_26649.ground_truth: The Tn interface in the TNGF-TNGF architecture enables UE mobility between different TNGFs.

question_26652.question: What is the maximum number of HS-SCCHs that can be monitored by the UE across the serving HS-DSCH cell and the 6th secondary serving HS-DSCH cell?
question_26652.ground_truth: The maximum number of HS-SCCHs monitored by the UE across the serving and 6th secondary serving HS-DSCH cells is 21.

question_26653.question: What are the requirements for the architecture of E-UTRAN in terms of interoperability?
question_26653.ground_truth: The requirements for the architecture of E-UTRAN include minimizing the presence of "single points of failure", simplifying and minimizing the introduced number of interfaces, and supporting an end-to-end QoS.

question_26655.question: What requirements apply to both single band and multi-band Tab connectors concerning spurious emissions?
question_26655.ground_truth: The requirements apply for both single band and multi-band Tab connectors, except for frequencies at which exclusion bands or other multi-band provisions apply, and for all transmission modes foreseen by the manufacturer's specification.

question_26656.question: In the Random Access procedure, what should the MAC entity do if the Random Access Response is considered successful and the Random Access Response includes RAPID only?
question_26656.ground_truth: The MAC entity should consider the Random Access procedure successfully completed and indicate the reception of an acknowledgement for the SI request to upper layers.

question_26657.question: How does the PDG support QoS provisioning in uplink data streams?
question_26657.ground_truth: The PDG shall mark the DS field in the external IP header of a tunnel for uplink data stream with the corresponding DS codepoint (DSCP) codes following the GSMA specification GSMA~PRD~IR.34.

question_26658.question: How is the PC5 key used in the V2X unicast link establishment?
question_26658.ground_truth: The PC5 key is used to establish a different security context for each peer UE during the V2X unicast link establishment, providing confidentiality and integrity protection and preventing man-in-the-middle attacks.

question_26659.question: What should the UE store upon receiving the SIB1?
question_26659.ground_truth: The UE should store the acquired SIB1 upon receiving the SIB1.

question_26660.question: What response will be generated by the participating MCVideo function to a "SIP INVITE request for terminating participating MCVideo function" when lause~7.3.4 is set to "auto-answer"?
question_26660.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function will generate a SIP 183 (Session Progress) response as specified in clause~6.3.2.2.4.1 and set the P-Answer-State header field to "Unconfirmed" in the SIP 183 (Session Progress) response.

question_26662.question: What is the source of the contents of the "UTRAN Iuant interface: General aspects and principles (Release 17)" technical specification?
question_26662.ground_truth: The contents of the "UTRAN Iuant interface: General aspects and principles (Release 17)" technical specification are subject to continuing work within the TSG and may change following formal TSG approval.

question_26663.question: What should the Mobile Station include in the ROUTING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message to indicate activation of Power Save Mode?
question_26663.ground_truth: The Mobile Station should include the T3324 timer in the ROUTING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message, with a value set to 2 minutes.

question_26665.question: What happens if MCPTT user 2 has not accepted the incoming call in step 9 of the private call procedure?
question_26665.ground_truth: The MCPTT client 2 sends a call failure response to the MCPTT server without adding a reason for call failure.

question_26666.question: What should the S-CCF do if the request from the UE contains an invalid nonce with a valid challenge response for that nonce?
question_26666.ground_truth: If the request from the UE contains an invalid nonce with a valid challenge response for that nonce, the S-CCF should send a 401 (Unauthorized) response to initiate a further authentication attempt with a fresh nonce and the stale parameter set to true.

question_26667.question: What kind of user plane services does the GANC provide inter-working for, in addition to circuit switched bearers over the A-interface?
