question_27031.ground_truth: The IWU has the option to send a SIP INVITE request to a succeeding external SIP-I network including the tag "precondition" in the SUPPORTED header and encoding preconditions in the SDP offer, or it can wait until local preconditions are met and then send the INVITE request to the external network.

question_27033.question: What is the purpose of Roaming in system mobility policy?
question_27033.ground_truth: Roaming in system mobility policy indicates if the policy is also valid if the UE is roaming.

question_27035.question: What event triggers the main S-EES to detect the need for ACR in the first phase of the second scenario?
question_27035.ground_truth: The main S-EES detects the need for ACR based on the service area and DNAIs (Data Network Authentication and Authorization Information) of all bundle EASs in the first phase of the second scenario.

question_27036.question: When should the MCPTT client include the "status" attribute in the functionalalias element of an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body in a SIP PUBLISH request?
question_27036.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should not include the "status" attribute in the functionalalias element of an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body in a SIP PUBLISH request.

question_27037.question: How is the file access in the ISIM API specified?
question_27037.ground_truth: The ISIM file access API is specified through the package uicc.isim.access, which defines additional constants to those defined in the uicc.access package in ETSI TS 102 241. The access to the file system is specified to be the same as that defined in TS 31.103 via the UICC FileView Interface.

question_27041.question: Which message is sent by the RNC to request modification of one or more RABs for the same UE?
question_27041.ground_truth: The 9.1.46 RAB MODIFY REQUEST message is sent by the RNC to request modification of one or more RABs for the same UE.

question_27042.question: When does the deletion of the context of SM related policies occur?
question_27042.ground_truth: Deletion of the context of SM related policies can occur during PDU session termination or when the PCF requests to terminate a PDU session based on an external or internal trigger.

question_27043.question: What determines the conditions for adding information to a C-BMSC-CDR?
question_27043.ground_truth: The conditions for adding information to a C-BMSC-CDR are defined per charging characteristics profile by the operator through OAM&P means.

question_27044.question: What is the UMTS measurement that provides the maximum of the DPCH Received Signal Code Power, valid for both circuit switched and packet switched traffic?
question_27044.ground_truth: The name of the UMTS measurement is "CARR. MaxDPCHRx".

question_27045.question: What is the state of a CTS-RR connection in CTS-idle mode?
question_27045.ground_truth: In CTS-idle mode, no CTS-RR connection exists.

question_27046.question: What is the purpose and type of the PS LCS Capability element?
question_27046.ground_truth: The PS LCS Capability element is a type 4 information element with a length of 4 octets. Its purpose is to indicate the positioning methods and additional positioning capabilities supported by the MS for the provision of location services (LCS) via the PS domain in Gb-mode.

question_27047.question: What should the MCData client include in the SDS SIGNALLING PAYLOAD message when sending a standalone one-to-one SDS message over the media plane using a pre-established session?
question_27047.ground_truth: When sending a standalone one-to-one SDS message over the media plane using a pre-established session, the MCData client should include the SDS SIGNALLING PAYLOAD message in an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body and the SDS DATA PAYLOAD message in an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-payload MIME body.

question_27048.question: What is the name of the enumerated type for the RTT accuracy-r15 in the ASN.1 definition?
question_27048.ground_truth: The name of the enumerated type for the RTT accuracy-r15 in the ASN.1 definition is not explicitly defined, but it is used to indicate the accuracy of the RTT measurement.

question_27050.question: What is the effect of Application Data Unit (ADU) dropping for FR1, Dense Urban, DL, with VR/AR, single-stream traffic model, 30Mbps, 60FPS, 10ms PDB, with DDDSU, MU-MIMO on capacity performance?
question_27050.ground_truth: The capacity performance is increased from 11.2 UEs per cell without ADU dropping to 12.9 UEs per cell with ADU dropping, a 15.2% improvement.

question_27053.question: What is the role of AI technology in the centralized energy saving solution?
question_27053.ground_truth: AI technology allows the 3GPP management system to make more accurate energy saving decisions, cover more areas, and apply energy saving to more cells in a RAN domain area.

question_27054.question: Which threats/attacks can be countered by Semi-Autonomous Validation (SAV)?
question_27054.ground_truth: SAV can counter threats/attacks 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12, 14, 16, 17, 18, 19, 21, 23, and 28. In addition to detecting these threats, SAV includes mechanisms for informing the network of attacks, making access decisions, and remediating the network after an attack.

question_27059.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the SIP re-INVITE request when sending it within an on-demand session?
question_27059.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include an SDP offer in the SIP re-INVITE request, as specified in 3GPP TS 24.229, with the clarifications in subclause 6.2.1.

question_27060.question: What is the condition for UEFA-NR dual connectivity operation in the case of E-UTRA inter-RAT measurement object and NR serving carrier?
question_27060.ground_truth: In the case of E-UTRA-NR dual connectivity operation, when an E-UTRA inter-RAT measurement object and an NR serving carrier are overlapping, they shall be counted as one intra-frequency measurement object. This is the case when the SSB is completely contained in the active BWP of the UE and none or part of the SMTC occasions of this inter-RAT measurement object are overlapped by the measurement gap.

question_27061.question: What is the default periodicity for sending PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY messages for relay discovery additional information by the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE?
question_27061.ground_truth: The default periodicity for sending PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY messages for relay discovery additional information by the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE is implementation specific and is normally lower than the one related to the additional parameters announcement request refresh timer T5016.

question_27062.question: What requirement is related to the communication between devices for V2X Service when roaming?
question_27062.ground_truth: The 3GPP System shall support communication between devices for V2X Service which can be served by different PLMNs, including when roaming.

question_27063.question: What message does the GGSN send to the Diameter server to update necessary information related to a PDP context?

question_27064.question: In the context of the abbreviations list, what does "MOS" stand for?

question_27065.question: Where should the MCVideo client include the MCVideo ID of the originating MCVideo user for a session?
question_27065.ground_truth: The MCVideo ID of the originating MCVideo user is not included in the body, as this will be inserted into the body of the SIP INVITE request that is sent from the originating participating MCVideo function.

question_27067.question: What is the expected sequence of events in the test procedure?
question_27067.ground_truth: The expected sequence of events in the test procedure is as follows: The SS sends a DTM ASSIGNMENT COMMAND to the MS, which then releases the current link layer connections and disconnects the physical channels. After switching to the assigned channel, the MS initializes the establishment of lower layer connection, activation of the channel, and establishment of the main signalling link.

question_27068.question: What value corresponds to a 10240 milliseconds periodicity value in the reportingRequestType of the RRC container transfer schedule in 3GPP TS38.300 v16.1.0 (2018-july)?

question_27069.question: What is the length of the NAS security parameters to E-UTRA information element?
question_27069.ground_truth: The NAS security parameters to E-UTRA information element is a type 3 information element with a length of 7 octets.

question_27070.question: What is the name of the test described in clause 7.3.37.4?
question_27070.ground_truth: The name of the test is not explicitly mentioned, but it is a test for the E-UTRAN TDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for In-sync in DRX for UE Category 0.

question_27071.question: In the second and third solutions above, how is the Milenage OP value protected during its storage in the UDR?
question_27071.ground_truth: The Milenage OP value is stored in encrypted form in the UDR in the second and third solutions.

question_27072.question: When is an IMSI detach performed during the GPRS Attach procedure in mode~II?
question_27072.ground_truth: In mode~II, an IMSI detach via the non-GPRS common control channels is performed when an IMSI-attached MS does not desire CS operation after a GPRS attach procedure. Alternatively, the MS may be implicitly IMSI detached after a while without performing any explicit detach procedures.

question_27075.question: What is the role of indicators in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_27075.ground_truth: Indicators are fast low-level signalling entities used for transmitting information without using information blocks over transport channels. They convey specific meanings implicitly to their receivers, with examples including Paging Indicator (PI) and MBMS Notification Indicator (NI).

question_27076.question: What is one possible candidate option for the first PUSCH(s) transmitted in the UL transmission burst in NR-U design?
question_27076.ground_truth: Option 2, where multiple starting positions in one or multiple slot(s) are allowed for PUSCH(s) scheduled by a single UL grant.

question_27077.question: What is the recommended packetization scheme for the MTSI MGW when setting up a speech session and there is no ptime value in the SDP?
question_27077.ground_truth: The MTSI MGW should encapsulate 1 frame per packet or the packetization used by the end-point clients.

question_27079.question: What is the 7.6B.4.0.3's minimum conformance requirement definition's purpose?
question_27079.ground_truth: The 7.6B.4.0.3's minimum conformance requirement definition describes the necessary criteria to conform to the 3GPP standards.

question_27081.question: What should a UE supporting LPP reliable transport do when an LPP message requiring acknowledgement is sent and not acknowledged?
question_27081.ground_truth: The UE should resend the message following a timeout period up to three times. If still unacknowledged after that, the UE should abort all LPP activity for the associated session.

question_27082.question: Under what circumstance is the UE required to include a Geolocation header field in the INVITE request during emergency registration?
question_27082.ground_truth: If the UE has its location information available, or a URI that points to the location information.

question_27084.question: What does SMS stand for in the context of mobile networks?

question_27085.question: What is the limitation of the number of roaming partners in the cross-certification process?
question_27085.ground_truth: The number of roaming partners with which cross-certificates are exchanged would have to be limited to ensure manageability. It is believed that agreements with only a limited number of roaming partners would suffice to ensure that most users would be present in their home area or one of the partner areas most of their time.

question_27087.question: What is the basic multiple access scheme for NR in terms of downlink and uplink data transmissions?
question_27087.ground_truth: The basic multiple access scheme for NR is orthogonal, meaning time and frequency physical resources of different users do not overlap in both downlink and uplink data transmissions.

question_27088.question: What is the purpose of the UE beam peak direction measurement in this test procedure, as specified in step 2.1?
question_27088.ground_truth: The purpose of the UE beam peak direction measurement in this test procedure, as specified in step 2.1, is to ensure that the UE is in the Tx beam peak direction found with a 3D EIRP scan, allowing for accurate measurement of the uplink signal strength in the following steps of the test procedure.

question_27089.question: What message does NM send to NFVO for deleting an NS instance identifier?

question_27090.question: What does the id-PositionDataUEbased in UE-PositionEstimateInfo-ExtIEs represent?
question_27090.ground_truth: The id-PositionDataUEbased in UE-PositionEstimateInfo-ExtIEs represents a type of position data that is UE-based, implemented in the UE position estimate of the network, changing when there is a change in the network.

question_27091.question: What is the minimum aggregate adjustment rate for a UE in NR RedCap?
question_27091.ground_truth: The minimum aggregate adjustment rate is Tp per second.

question_27092.question: In the SMLC and LCS system, what does the SMLC application protocol supported in the BSSAP-LE layer provide for the other signalling endpoint?
question_27092.ground_truth: The SMLC application protocol supported in the BSSAP-LE layer provides support for specific LCS functions, such as positioning measurements and assistance measurements, and is independent of lower protocol layers.

question_27093.question: What does the "ValidityAreaRef" node represent in the context of flow distribution rules?
question_27093.ground_truth: The "ValidityAreaRef" node is a leaf that contains a reference to a ValidityArea interior node. It is used to define a location condition for a particular flow distribution rule.

question_27094.question: What is the pass criteria for the Delay Since Last SR Test?
question_27094.ground_truth: The pass criteria for the Delay Since Last SR Test is that the reception time and delay since last SR field in the receiver report from the SUT is consistent with observed reception time and NTP timestamp field of the corresponding RTCP sender report sender info from data injection.

question_27095.question: What does the "CS" parameter do in the Facility lock command?
question_27095.ground_truth: The "CS" parameter in the Facility lock command is used to lock the control surface of the MT, such as the phone keyboard.

question_27097.question: What parameter is used to indicate the slot format for a serving cell, in the context of slotFormatCombToAddModList and related parameters?

question_27099.question: When the UDM fails to retrieve the requested UE registration data sets, what message status code is returned in the GET request?
question_27099.ground_truth: On failure, the appropriate HTTP status code indicating the error shall be returned and appropriate additional error information should be returned in the GET response body.

question_27101.question: What are the functions of the GPRS MAC and RLC functions in the Medium Access Control and Radio Link Control Layer?
question_27101.ground_truth: The GPRS MAC function provides arbitration between multiple MSs attempting to transmit simultaneously, collision avoidance, detection and recovery procedures, and operates above the Physical Link layer. The GPRS RLC function defines procedures for the bitmap selective retransmission of unsuccessfully delivered RLC data blocks.

question_27102.question: What is the difference between a conventional codec and a DSR optimized codec in the context of the speech recognition framework?
question_27102.ground_truth: A conventional codec encodes the speech input waveform, while a DSR optimized codec takes speech input, extracts acoustic features and encodes them with a scheme optimized for speech recognition. The DSR optimized codec is similar to the conventional codec, such as AMR, but on the server-side, the uplink encoded stream can be directly consumed by speech engines without having to be converted to a waveform.

question_27103.question: What is the difference between end-to-end latency and communication service interface?
question_27103.ground_truth: End-to-end latency is the time taken to transfer a given piece of information from a source to a destination, while communication service interface is the interface between the application/function and the 5G system.

question_27104.question: What is the purpose of the "ussList" element in the BSF's response?
question_27104.ground_truth: The "ussList" element is used in the BSF's response to include the appropriate User Security Settings (if any) from stored GAA-UserSecSettings in Bootstrapping information.

question_27105.question: What action does the source UE take upon receiving an acknowledgement for the 5G ProSe direct link modification?
question_27105.ground_truth: The source UE starts to receive and/or transmit traffic via the newly selected 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE.

question_27107.question: What is the maximum number of counter instances that can be collected and reported for data volumes in DL/UL direction of a GBR bearer?
question_27107.ground_truth: There can be up to 200 counter instances for DL and 200 for UL.

question_27109.question: What is the purpose of the "loops" in the UE test loop mode functions?
question_27109.ground_truth: The loops in the UE test loop mode functions refer to the process of closing and opening the test loop for specific actions. For example, a closed loop could indicate that the UE is instructed to start counting the packets, while an open loop would indicate that the UE should stop counting the packets.

question_27110.question: What is the purpose of using the i-homed PDU Session in the service continuity case or the local access to DN case?
question_27110.ground_truth: The i-homed PDU Session is used to ensure service continuity in the service continuity case or to provide local access to a DN in a specific LADN service area in the local access to DN case.

question_27112.question: When an IPv6 prefix is obtained from an external PDN, what is the responsibility of the PDN GW regarding the allocation, renewal, and release of the IPv6 prefix?
question_27112.ground_truth: The PDN GW is responsible for obtaining the IPv6 prefix from the external PDN and for allocating, renewing, and releasing the IPv6 prefix.

question_27113.question: What risk increases if an attacker gains access to a software catalogue holding the images of virtualized 3GPP NFs?
question_27113.ground_truth: If an attacker is able to access the catalogue, they will be able directly gain a lot of information which can then be used to attack the running instances of the VNF. Where those VNFs contain cryptographic functions or sensitive information, this increases the risk even further.

question_27114.question: What is a throughput boost in the context of network assistance for DASH clients?
question_27114.ground_truth: A throughput boost is a short, temporary increase of throughput in the network, usually at the beginning of a video session or when the buffer level is low, to improve time-to-play latency and avoid video playout stalling. The network informs the client when throughput boost is performed, such that the client does not use a higher media rate than the available throughput.

question_27115.question: What is the criticality of the "id-SRBID" within the "ULRRCMessageTransferIEs" F1AP-PROTOCOL-IES?
question_27115.ground_truth: The criticality of the "id-SRBID" within the "ULRRCMessageTransferIEs" F1AP-PROTOCOL-IES is "reject".

question_27117.question: What is the counter used for failed QoS flow modification attempts in 5.8.2.X.3?
question_27117.ground_truth: QF.ModNbrUntrustNon3gppFail.cause, where cause identifies the cause.

question_27118.question: What should the RNC do if the CN node is not capable of processing the request or the transfer in the UPLINK INFORMATION EXCHANGE REQUEST message?
question_27118.ground_truth: If the CN node is not capable of processing the request or the transfer, the RNC should inform the CN by the UPLINK INFORMATION EXCHANGE FAILURE message, specifying the reason for unsuccessful operation with an appropriate cause value.

question_27119.question: What happens if the MCData data disposition for delivery is requested by the user at MCData client 1?
question_27119.ground_truth: The receiving MCData client initiates a MCData data disposition notification for delivery report, which may be stored by the MCData server for disposition history interrogation from authorized MCData users. MCData data disposition notification is then sent to the disposition requesting user at MCData client 1. The same process is followed if the MCData data disposition for read is requested by the user at MCData client 1.

question_27120.question: How does the swapping mechanism work when preserving the "sibling" property during weight increment in the tree update process?
question_27120.ground_truth: After incrementing the weight of a node, the list is scanned to find the node at position y with a weight greater than or equal to the new weight of the node at position x. Then, the nodes at x and y are swapped in terms of their position in the list and their parents while preserving all other attributes. The process is repeated for the parent of the node at position y until the root node is reached.

question_27121.question: What actions are taken when the MAC entity is in Active Time for a G-RNTI or G-CS-RNTI in the 5G NR system?
question_27121.ground_truth: The PDCCH is monitored for the G-RNTI or G-CS-RNTI, and if a DL multicast transmission is indicated, HARQ feedback is started, and drx-RetransmissionTimerDL-PTM is stopped for the corresponding HARQ process.

question_27123.question: What is the potential security requirement for protecting the SDS in MCX service?
question_27123.ground_truth: The Mission Critical Service shall provide a means to support end-to-end confidentiality and integrity protection for messaging transmitted between MCX UEs in both media and signalling streams.

question_27125.question: What does RB allocation refer to for PC1 UE supporting other bands than n14?
question_27125.ground_truth: RB allocation refers to the allocation of Resource Blocks in edge or inner region of the channel for PC1 UE supporting other bands than n14.

question_27126.question: What does the term "inter-band carrier aggregation" refer to in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
question_27126.ground_truth: Inter-band carrier aggregation refers to the aggregation of component carriers in different operating bands.

question_27127.question: What is the purpose of sending a MCData session data request in the procedure described in 7.4.2.4.2?
question_27127.ground_truth: The purpose of sending a MCData session data request is for an MCData user to initiate a data communication session request with another MCData user for exchanging at least one SDS data transaction between them, with or without a disposition request.

question_27128.question: What is one difference between the MBMS based method and the current MBMS security solution?
question_27128.ground_truth: The MBMS based method can provide shared key for data transferring, while the current MBMS security solution can't be applied for uplink data and individual communication between UEs and MTC application server/MTC SCS/network.

question_27129.question: What should be provided by the synchronization procedure for the alarm information?
question_27129.ground_truth: The synchronization procedure for the alarm information should provide the same (at least for the mandatory parameters) as the information already available in the alarm list.

question_27130.question: What event package name and MIME body should be included in the Event header field and NOTIFY request for roaming II-NNI?

question_27131.question: What type of charging is supported by IMS for VoLTE?
question_27131.ground_truth: IMS only supports duration-based charging for VoLTE.

question_27132.question: What is the minimum requirement for Time Alignment Error (TAE) in 6.7.3.5?
question_27132.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for Time Alignment Error (TAE) is 0.35 Tc for Tx diversity and MIMO transmission in the same frequency band, 0.6 Tc for transmission of multiple cells within a frequency band, and 5.1 Tc for transmission of multiple cells in different frequency bands.

question_27134.question: What are two features that the GGSN may provide for the MBMS bearer service that are not exclusive to MBMS?
question_27134.ground_truth: Two features that the GGSN may provide for the MBMS bearer service that are not exclusive to MBMS are Message Screening (not needed if the MBMS sources are internal in the PLMN) and Charging Data Collection.

question_27136.question: What is the process of binding a functional alias with a group in an MC system?
question_27136.ground_truth: The MC service client sends a functional alias to group binding request to the group controlling MC service server to bind functional aliases to groups. Once a functional alias is bound to a group, it remains bound till the functional alias is unbound from the group, even after an MC service log-off.

question_27137.question: Which simulated radio scenarios have been simulated for the timeslot mapping option?
question_27137.ground_truth: The simulated radio scenarios have been run in sensitivity (TU50iFH), co-channel interference with TU3iFH, and co-channel interference without frequency hopping (TU3noFH).

question_27138.question: What information does the MN provide in the SN Addition procedure to indicate that the request is for subsequent CPAC?
question_27138.ground_truth: The MN indicates that the request is for subsequent CPAC in the SN Addition procedure by requesting the candidate SN(s) to allocate resources for the UE.

question_27139.question: What is the purpose of enhancement in Rel-17 for the reduction of service interruption during intra-donor IAB-node migration?
question_27139.ground_truth: The purpose of the enhancement in Rel-17 is to enable concurrent traffic migration by descendent nodes and the migrating IAB-node during intra-donor IAB-node migration.

question_27142.question: What is the first action taken in step 4 of the method of test?
question_27142.ground_truth: The first action taken in step 4 of the method of test is step 4a, in which the SS uses a Channel Mode Modify procedure commanding the MS to use the AMR 10.2 kbit/s mode only. The SS waits for the MS to change the uplink codec to the 10.2 kbit/s mode.

question_27143.question: What is the mechanism used to protect H(e)MS traffic when it is accessible on the public Internet?
question_27143.ground_truth: A TLS tunnel established between H(e)NB and H(e)MS is used to protect H(e)MS traffic when it is accessible on the public Internet.

question_27144.question: Which 3GPP specification is used to define the support for active state of the call control protocol?
question_27144.ground_truth: U10 is used to define the support for active state of the call control protocol.

question_27145.question: What action does the MME take when the "UE Manufacturer Assigned operation requested list" contains PLMN assigned UE Radio Capability IDs?
question_27145.ground_truth: The MME avoids re-assigning PLMN assigned UE Radio Capability IDs that were added to the "UE Manufacturer Assigned operation requested list" in the MMEs to any UE.

question_27147.question: What action is taken by the NAS if the lower layers indicate that the access attempt is barred in relation to an MO-SMSoIP-attempt-started indication?
question_27147.ground_truth: If the UE is operating in the single-registration mode or dual-registration mode, and the UE receives an indication from the lower layers that the barring is alleviated for the access category with which the access attempt was associated, the NAS shall notify the upper layers that the barring is alleviated for the access category and may initiate the procedure to send the initial NAS message, if still needed.

question_27148.question: What is the maximum size of a Coding Tree Unit (CTU) in H.265 (HEVC) for video coding?
question_27148.ground_truth: The maximum size of a Coding Tree Unit (CTU) in H.265 (HEVC) for video coding is 64x64.

question_27149.question: What is the time available for intra-frequency measurements as per clause 8.1.2.8.3.1?
question_27149.ground_truth: TIntra is the minimum time available for intra-frequency measurements, during the measurement period with an arbitrarily chosen timing.

question_27150.question: What is the purpose of steps 10 to 14 in the described process?
question_27150.ground_truth: Steps 10 to 14 are only applied to the BP case and involve the SMF sending CN tunnel info of the new BP to the RAN node, establishing the CN tunnel between the RAN and the BP, and activating the UP path toward the new PSA.

question_27151.question: What is the reference point for the control plane protocol between NG-RAN and AMF?

question_27152.question: What is the main advantage of using decentralized averaging methods in Federated Learning (FL)?
question_27152.ground_truth: The main advantage is that each device only needs to transmit its local ML parameters to its neighboring devices, reducing the communication overhead of FL parameter transmission.

question_27153.question: What are the service flows for using satellite connectivity to aid in terrestrial network planning in sparsely populated areas?
question_27153.ground_truth: The service flows involve providing satellite access to UEs in sparsely populated areas, collecting traffic pattern and location-related information from the UEs, analyzing the information for the needs and capabilities of terrestrial deployment, and planning, designing, and executing the terrestrial deployment based on the analysis.

question_27155.question: What functions are performed during the logical link establishment function?
question_27155.ground_truth: The logical link establishment function is performed when the MS attaches to the PS services.

question_27156.question: What is the expected sequence of events when the T305 timer expires while the CC-entity is in state U11?
question_27156.ground_truth: The CC-entity sends the RELEASE message to its peer entity and enters the CC-state U19, "Release Request".

question_27157.question: What authentication method is specified in 6.5.2.3.2.2 for the 3GPP AAA server?
question_27157.ground_truth: EAP AKA based authentication as specified in IETF~RFC~4187.

question_27158.question: What is the role of the TSCTSF when the AF sends a request for QoS services via the TSCTSF?
question_27158.ground_truth: The TSCTSF determines a Requested PDB (5G System Procedure Delivery of PDU Sessions) based on the Requested 5GS Delay and the UE-DS-TT Residence Time.

question_27159.question: What message does the ICS UE send to the HSS when it wants to initiate a new call while engaged in an existing call?
question_27159.ground_truth: The ICS UE sends an ICS Hold Request on B party inside a USSD dialog to the HSS.

question_27160.question: What is the Mobile Station's response when it receives a message with a non-existent or not implemented message type and an RR-connection exists?
question_27160.ground_truth: The Mobile Station returns a status message (STATUS, RR STATUS or MM STATUS depending on the protocol discriminator) with cause value #97 "message type non-existent or not implemented".

question_27161.question: What should the SGW do if it receives a specific message while the timer is running during the network triggered service restoration procedure?
question_27161.ground_truth: The SGW shall stop the timer and delete the resources for the maintained restarted CN node if it receives a specific message while the timer is running.

question_27163.question: What is the function of an RLC entity in the NR radio interface?
question_27163.ground_truth: An RLC entity in the NR radio interface is responsible for controlling the radio link and handling data transmission and reception between the UE and NR radio interface.

question_27164.question: What action should an SGM-S take upon receiving a successful HTTP POST request from an SGM-C for creating a temporary group?
question_27164.ground_truth: The SGM-S should notify the VAL server regarding the temporary group creation with the received parameters and send an HTTP POST request to every SGM-C of the constituent VAL groups.

question_27166.question: What does the "+CSCON" command do in the context of signalling connection status?
question_27166.ground_truth: The "+CSCON" command controls the presentation of an unsolicited result code when the connection mode, state, access, or core network information of the MT changes.

question_27167.question: What are the services provided by AF to request authorization for Discovery Request?
question_27167.ground_truth: The services provided by AF enable the request of authorization for Discovery Request and can be updated by the AF to revoke the Restricted ProSe Direct Discovery permission.

question_27169.question: How does the UE determine if burstArrivalTime has changed for reporting relay UE information with non-3GPP connection(s)?
question_27169.ground_truth: The UE considers burstArrivalTime to have changed when it changes relative to the periodicity of the Data Burst arrival.

question_27170.question: What does the V-PCRF do when the H-PCRF provides new or modified QoS rules for the home routed case in a roaming scenario?
question_27170.ground_truth: The V-PCRF extracts QoS rules from the PCC rules, enforces visited operator policies regarding QoS authorization, and acknowledges the gateway control session establishment by sending a CCA to the BBERF with the selected BCM, applicable QoS rules, and event triggers.

question_27173.question: What should the MCVideo client set as the MCVideo emergency private priority state of the MCVideo private call on receiving a SIP 2xx response to the SIP re-INVITE request?
question_27173.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should set the MCVideo emergency private priority state of the MCVideo private call to "MVEPP 1: no-emergency" on receiving a SIP 2xx response to the SIP re-INVITE request.

question_27174.question: What must be used by the caller in a new field in the SIP header or session description to indicate which mode they want to use with SDES?
question_27174.ground_truth: A new field in the SIP header or session description must be used by the caller to indicate which mode they want to use with SDES.

question_27175.question: What does the measurement reporting delay assume in its definition?
question_27175.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay assumes that the measurement report is not delayed by other RRC signalling on the DCCH. It excludes a delay uncertainty resulted when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH and a delay which caused by no UL resources for the UE to send the measurement report.

question_27176.question: Which identities can the LIPF provision the intercept information to the IRI-POI present in the AMF?
question_27176.ground_truth: The LIPF can provision intercept information associated with the following target identities to the IRI-POI present in the AMF: SUPI, PEI, and GPSI.

question_27179.question: What is the format of the body of the HTTP POST message when the EES sends UE(s) location information events to the EAS?
question_27179.ground_truth: The body of the HTTP POST message shall include LocationNotification, which includes location information of each UE with accuracy and timestamp.

question_27180.question: What is the significance of the master media key in the IMS media plane security?
question_27180.ground_truth: The master media key is the keying material for the media encryption and decryption in the IMS media plane security. It needs to be securely generated, distributed, and stored to ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the media traffic.

question_27181.question: What is the difference between using GBA to derive MN-HA keys and to provision MN-AAA keys in the inter access mobility authentication?
question_27181.ground_truth: When using GBA to derive MN-HA keys, the HA is used as NAF, whereas when using GBA to provision MN-AAA keys, the HAAA is used as a NAF.

question_27182.question: What is the role of QoS Notification Control (QNC) in the solution?
question_27182.ground_truth: QoS Notification Control (QNC) is triggered by the PCF for monitoring the performance characteristics to be measured for each UE group member, such as maximum end-to-end latency and service bit rate.

question_27183.question: What procedure is performed in step 7, when the AMF-MBSR is in handover procedure and the AMF-MBSR does not select a new AMF-MBSR?
question_27183.ground_truth: The AMF-MBSR decreases the count for the Link ID, increases the count for the new Link ID, and associates the MBSR indicated by the Link ID with the new Link ID.

question_27184.question: What should the floor participant do upon receiving a Floor Release Multi Talker message?
question_27184.ground_truth: The floor participant should provide a notification to the user indicating that a participant has released the floor in a multi-talker group and remain in the 'U: queued' state.

question_27185.question: What should the Node B include in the Dual Band Capability Info IE when the Local Cell is HS-DSCH Dual Band Capable and can serve as a secondary serving HS-DSCH?
question_27185.ground_truth: The Node B should include the Possible Secondary Serving Cell List IE in the Dual Band Capability Info IE and list the possible secondary serving cells that can act as a secondary serving HS-DSCH for the Local Cell.

question_27186.question: What is the key difference between non-assisted rate adaptation and the use of NARA in terms of average re-buffering time?
question_27186.ground_truth: With increased load and non-assisted rate adaptation, the average re-buffering time increases linearly, while with the use of NARA, the average re-buffering time increases much more slowly.

question_27187.question: What should the SS do after T1 expires if a valid ACK/NACK has not been received?
question_27187.ground_truth: Transmit an RRCRelease message to release the RRC connection.

question_27189.question: What must the MS do during uplink TBF when it does not fully utilize total allocated resources?
question_27189.ground_truth: If the MS does not fully utilize the total allocated resources for uplink radio block transmission, it must immediately begin monitoring assigned downlink PDCHs or PDCH-pairs after transmitting its last available RLC/MAC block, taking into account the switching requirements of its multislot class.

question_27192.question: What is the message requested in the example specific interworking case?
question_27192.ground_truth: The message requested in the example specific interworking case is the MAP PROCESS-SIGNALLING message.

question_27193.question: What is the purpose of the message sent by the primary MC system in the procedure defined in Solution 7?
question_27193.ground_truth: The purpose of the message sent by the primary MC system in the procedure defined in Solution 7 is to notify MC service clients in proximity of the IOPS MC system of its existence. It may also include information that will improve the switching time when new MC UE's are moving into the MC IOPS system.

question_27194.question: In which conditions of a PDU Session the SMF sends a PDU Session Modification Command with EAS rediscovery indication to the UE?
question_27194.ground_truth: The SMF sends a PDU Session Modification Command with EAS rediscovery indication to the UE if an existing PDU Session is impacted by a new PCC rule for EAS discovery corresponding to Common DNAI and if the UE has indicated that it supports to refresh EAS information stored locally.

question_27195.question: Which stand-alone SRB for PCCH on SCCPCH is provided on SCCPCH?
question_27195.ground_truth: The stand-alone 12 kbps SRB for PCCH on SCCPCH is provided on SCCPCH.

question_27196.question: How is the BFI performance measured?
question_27196.ground_truth: The BFI performance is measured by counting the number of undetected bad frames while the input signal is a randomly modulated carrier on a speech TCH.

question_27198.question: What should the UE do when it receives a RRCConnectionSetup message in response to an RRCConnectionResumeRequest from a suspended RRC connection and resuming the RRC connection after early security reactivation?
question_27198.ground_truth: The UE should discard any current AS security context including the KRRCenc key, the KRRCint key, the KUPint key and the KUPenc key, release all radio resources, discard the stored UE AS context and resumeIdentity, and indicate to upper layers fallback of the RRC connection.

question_27199.question: What is the cause value for rejecting the requested update with "SIB origination in Node B not supported"?
question_27199.ground_truth: The Node B shall reject, with the cause value "SIB origination in Node B not supported", requests for Node B originated system information blocks that make use of a value tag.

question_27200.question: What does the term "clock skew" refer to in the context of the present document?
question_27200.ground_truth: Clock skew is defined as the difference between the clock of the device under test and the clock of the reference client.

question_27203.question: What information should the BSS send to the SGSN if all attempted CN operators have replied with a Redirection Indication IE?
question_27203.ground_truth: The BSS shall select the most appropriate Layer 3 Information received from the attempted CN operators based on the stored information as part of the Rerouting procedure and send it back to the MS.

question_27204.question: When the co-location of FAGF-U and UPF is enabled by 5GC signalling and node selection improvements, what is added to uplink NAS signalling messages received from the 5G-RG?
question_27204.ground_truth: The identity/identities of the FAGF-U(s) of FAGF Pool(s)

question_27205.question: What is the purpose of the Exclude-listing function in the 3GPP specified network measurement and reporting procedures?
question_27205.ground_truth: The Exclude-listing function in the 3GPP specified network measurement and reporting procedures is used to exclude certain neighboring cells from consideration in event evaluation or measurement reporting. This function is useful when the network needs to focus on specific cells or exclude cells that are not relevant to the measurement task at hand.

question_27206.question: How much is the total increase in transmit insertion loss when changing the SP6T switchplexer to an SP10T in the hybrid mobile transmitter path when operating in type 1 mode?
question_27206.ground_truth: The total increase in transmit insertion loss is 1.1 dB.

question_27207.question: What is the main objective of the 3GPP technical report on improved streaming Quality of Experience (QoE) reporting in 3GPP services and networks?
question_27207.ground_truth: The main objective is to ensure that customers remain satisfied with the 3GPP services, specifically for operator managed streaming service, 3rd party managed streaming service, and Over-The-Top (OTT) streaming service.

question_27208.question: What does FN represent in the formula used for TIMESLOT MAPPING AND ROTATION in 3GPP TS~45.008 standard?
question_27208.ground_truth: FN represents Frame numbers in the formula used for TIMESLOT MAPPING AND ROTATION in 3GPP TS~45.008 standard.

question_27209.question: What is the role of the EESE in the security solution between the enterprise and the UE?
question_27209.ground_truth: The EESE is responsible for triggering the generation of a new RAND and deriving the new e2eKEYSET when it receives a notification from the EMKS. It also transmits the RAND to the UE and lets the enterprise expire the keys immediately if needed.

question_27213.question: In step 21.2.2, how much attenuation is required for the received signal measurement for the adjacent (200 kHz) channel, adjacent (400 kHz) channel, and adjacent (600 kHz) channel respectively?
question_27213.ground_truth: The attenuation required for the received signal measurement for the adjacent (200 kHz) channel is at least 16 dB, for the adjacent (400 kHz) channel is at least 48 dB, and for the adjacent (600 kHz) channel is at least 56 dB.

question_27214.question: What is the purpose of defining 'building blocks' in IMS for supplementary services?
question_27214.ground_truth: The purpose is to construct supplementary services for a particular IMS service from these building blocks. Ideally, such a building block would be reusable for any IMS service.

question_27215.question: What is the purpose of the terminateServiceAgreement() method?
question_27215.ground_truth: The terminateServiceAgreement() method is used by the client application to terminate an agreement for the service.

question_27216.question: How do MC service clients establish a multicast MBS session?
question_27216.ground_truth: For multicast MBS sessions, if the MC service client is accessing over 5G, it initiates a UE session join request towards the 5GC using the information provided via the MBS service announcement. Once the first successful UE session join request is made, the multicast is established, and the radio resources are reserved.

question_27217.question: What should the BSS do upon reception of the downlink Redirection Completed IE?
question_27217.ground_truth: The BSS should send back the included LLC-PDU to the MS and terminate the Rerouting procedure.

question_27218.question: What action is taken when the "page MS" message is received?
question_27218.ground_truth: The network tries to contact the mobile station.

question_27219.question: What are the requirements for mobility management in this architecture?
question_27219.ground_truth: Handover to or from an open HeNB, and handover between different CSG cells and non-CSG cells are supported in this architecture.

question_27220.question: What should the UE do if the type of security context flag in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message is set to "native security context"?
question_27220.ground_truth: The UE should take the non-current native 5G NAS security context into use which then becomes the current native 5G NAS security context and delete the mapped 5G NAS security context.

question_27221.question: What is the name of the counter that is used to detect a restart in GTP-U messages and is associated with the GTP-U entity?

question_27222.question: What are the main types of user-related data managed by the 3GPP Generic User Profile?
question_27222.ground_truth: The GUP manages user-related data that affect the way users experience services. This includes user preferences, service customization settings, terminal capabilities, and address book information.

question_27224.question: How does the S-CSCF handle the P-Asserted-Identity header field when performing actions based on the service profile of the NGCN site?
question_27224.ground_truth: The S-CSCF finds a match between the P-Asserted-Identity header field and the public user identities as in the implicit registration set of the NGCN site's profile to perform actions based on the service profile of the NGCN site.

question_27225.question: What is the receiver combiner loss (CL) for an Rx?
question_27225.ground_truth: The CL for an Rx is 0.5 dB.

question_27227.question: What is the purpose of the Purge function in the SGSN?
question_27227.ground_truth: The Purge function is used to inform the HLR that the SGSN has deleted the MM and PDP contexts of a detached MS. The SGSN may delete these contexts immediately after the detach of the MS, or may keep them for some time so that they can be reused at a later GPRS attach without accessing the HLR.

question_27228.question: What is the range of the LOS directions with respect to the MS in step 2 of generating user parameters for urban macrocell and suburban macrocell environments?
question_27228.ground_truth: The LOS directions with respect to the MS in step 2 of generating user parameters for urban macrocell and suburban macrocell environments are drawn from a uniform 0 to 360 degree distribution.

question_27229.question: When does the MBMS client move to ACTIVE state?
question_27229.ground_truth: The MBMS client moves to ACTIVE state when the service with the serviceId parameter can be started and the MBMS client uses the Manifest file to offer a valid media presentation to the Media client.

question_27230.question: What information should the SLM-S store in the <location-QoS> element?
question_27230.ground_truth: The SLM-S should store the requested location QoS in the <location-QoS> element.

question_27231.question: What should the UE do upon request from upper layers if SystemInformationBlockType2 includes ac-BarringPerPLMN-List and a corresponding plmn-IdentityIndex is found?
question_27231.ground_truth: The UE should select the AC-BarringPerPLMN entry with the plmn-IdentityIndex corresponding to the PLMN selected by upper layers and use the selected AC-BarringPerPLMN entry (i.e. presence or absence of access barring parameters) in the remainder of the procedure, irrespective of the common access barring parameters included in SystemInformationBlockType2.

question_27232.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message with a PDU session ID?
question_27232.ground_truth: The UE passes the EAP message received in the EAP message IE of the PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message to the upper layers.

question_27233.question: What was the increase in capacity performance for FR1, Uma, DL, for VR/AR, with single stream traffic model, DDDUU/DDDSU TDD format, with SU-MIMO, 45Mbps, 10ms PDB, 60 FPS, when using cooperative MIMO/precoding compared to zero-forcing precoding?

question_27234.question: What is the meaning of "must" or "must not" in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_27234.ground_truth: The constructions "must" and "must not" are not used in the 3GPP technical specification to indicate normative requirements. They are only used in a direct citation from an external, referenced, non-3GPP document, or so as to maintain continuity of style when extending or modifying the provisions of such a referenced document.

question_27235.question: What is the purpose of the "3GPP-QoE-Metrics" attribute in SDP when used at session level?
question_27235.ground_truth: When present at session level, the "3GPP-QoE-Metrics" attribute in SDP shall only contain metrics that apply to the complete session.

question_27236.question: What should the UE do with the ESG information received from the SSF?
question_27236.ground_truth: The UE should use parameters received from the SSF for session initiation and store a part of the ESG information covering a certain period of time. It may also use the ESG information for other purposes than session initiation, such as presenting SSF information to the user.

question_27237.question: What is the purpose of UPF detecting PDU set information within a QoS flow?
question_27237.ground_truth: UPF identifies the PDUs belonging to a PDU Set and their information to enable intra-PDU Set handling (e.g. KI#4, PDU Set integrated handling) and inter-PDU Set handling (e.g. KI#5, PDU Set differentiated handling).

question_27238.question: What is the standard used for defining the mandatory requirements of spurious emission for LTE systems?

question_27239.question: What is an important factor in characterizing a rendering system for mobile devices?
question_27239.ground_truth: Computational complexity is an important factor in the characterization of a rendering system.

question_27240.question: What should be the restriction for CSI-RS measurements when the CSI-RS for BFD measurement is in the same OFDM symbol as another CSI-RS for RLM, BFD, CBD or L1-RSRP measurement for FR1?
question_27240.ground_truth: A UE should be able to measure the CSI-RS for BFD measurement without any restriction when the CSI-RS for BFD measurement is in the same OFDM symbol as another CSI-RS for RLM, BFD, CBD or L1-RSRP measurement for FR1.

question_27243.question: Which subclause specifies the default channel bandwidths for NR NTN signalling test?
question_27243.ground_truth: Subclause 6.2.3.8 specifies the default channel bandwidths for NR NTN signalling test.

question_27244.question: What aspects are considered when selecting an EPC network and routing traffic via the EPC network?
question_27244.ground_truth: The aspects considered include access network discovery and selection procedures, EPC network selection, and data traffic routing of IP flows.

question_27247.question: What information about network slice instance does the VAE server periodically receive for V2X services?
question_27247.ground_truth: Network and QoS monitoring information, including network slice analytics and performance monitoring (e.g. slice congestion, load).

question_27249.question: What shall the S-CSCF do if the public user identity is being registered to a contact address that already has a registered association with another user identity?
question_27249.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall consider the public user identity being registered to be bound either to the contact address of the UE or to the registration flow and the associated contact address for the duration indicated in the registration expiration interval value.

question_27251.question: What is the difference between management service components type A, B, and C in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_27251.ground_truth: Type A covers operations and notifications, type B covers network resource model, and type C covers alarm and performance information.

question_27252.question: What is the purpose of the resource selection window used by a sensing UE to select resources for its first transmission after sensing?
question_27252.ground_truth: The resource selection window begins less than or equal to 4 ms after the trigger for transmission, and is used by the sensing UE to identify resources for its transmissions based on the indicated periodicities and durations of reserved resources found during the sensing window.

question_27253.question: What is the interface between the E-SMLC and the LMU used for?
question_27253.ground_truth: It is used for the E-SMLC to exchange measurement information with the LMU for the purpose of UTDOA positioning.

question_27255.question: What's the maximum time alignment error permitted for intra-band UL contiguous CA with UL MIMO?
question_27255.ground_truth: For UE(s) with multiple transmit antenna connectors, the Time Alignment Error (TAE) shall not exceed 130 ns.

question_27256.question: What is the focus of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's technical report on the media handling aspects of 5G conversational services?
question_27256.ground_truth: The report studies the media handling aspects of 5G conversational services, including Multimedia Telephony Service over IMS and IMS-based Telepresence Service, and addresses various technical aspects such as speech codes, video codecs, media rate adaptation, virtual reality support, and new radio considerations.

question_27258.question: What is the maximum number of prefixes per PDP Context supported by GPRS?

question_27260.question: What is the purpose of the NAS SMC procedure in establishing NAS security context?
question_27260.ground_truth: The NAS SMC procedure is designed to protect the Registration Request against man-in-the-middle attacks where the attacker modifies the IEs containing the UE's security capabilities, and to ensure that no bidding down attack has occurred during the establishment of the NAS security context between the UE and the AMF.

question_27261.question: How does the positioning error change when the AI/ML model is trained and tested with different SNR/SINR values in direct AI/ML positioning?
question_27261.ground_truth: When the model is trained with S1 and tested with S2 (dB) where S1 is at least 15 dB higher than S2, the positioning error is more than 5.75 times that of the model trained and tested with data of S1 (dB). When the model is trained with S2 and tested with S1 where S1 is within 10 dB of S2, the generalization performance is better, with the positioning error being more than 2.97 times that of the model trained with data of S1 (dB) and tested with data of S2 (dB).

question_27263.question: What should the UE do if it receives a 401 (Unauthorized) response to a REGISTER request during the initial registration or reregistration process?
question_27263.ground_truth: The UE should extract the RAND and AUTN parameters, check the validity of the received authentication challenge, and calculate the RES parameter and derive the keys CK and IK from RAND. The UE should then set up a temporary set of security associations using the parameters received in the 401 (Unauthorized) response.

question_27265.question: What is the effect of reducing LPN transmit power on clustering radius in the LPN network?
question_27265.ground_truth: As LPN transmit power reduces, the clustering radius increases. Specifically, the clustering radius is chosen to be 20m, 35m, and 60m when the LPN power is 24dBm, 30dBm, and 37dBm, respectively.

question_27267.question: What is the function of the "StepsAndOfferedStopPointList" complex type in the XML schema?
question_27267.ground_truth: The "StepsAndOfferedStopPointList" complex type is used to define a list of steps and possible stop points in a process, including the name of each step and the sequence number in the process.

question_27268.question: What event can cause an interruption on PCell or on activated SCell(s) in the MCG when using multiple CCs simultaneously or over partially overlapping periods?
question_27268.ground_truth: BWP switch due to a change in specific parameters, uplink BWP switching triggered by consistent uplink LBT failures on the NR PSCell, or RRC-based downlink BWP and/or uplink BWP switching.

question_27270.question: What is the purpose of the test in step 1 of the procedure sequence?
question_27270.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in step 1 is to ensure that the MCData Client responds with a SIP 200 (OK) message when it receives a SIP INVITE to initiate a one-to-one SDS session using the media plane.

question_27271.question: What is the purpose of the Attendant feature in a VPN?
question_27271.ground_truth: The Attendant feature in a VPN allows VPN users to access an attendant position within the VPN for providing VPN service information, such as VPN numbers.

question_27272.question: Which mode of the EVS codec is bitstream interoperable with the AMR-WB codec?

question_27273.question: What is the purpose of using wildcards in CDI scoping levels?
question_27273.ground_truth: The use of wildcards in CDI scoping levels enables the discovery of new CDI tags, such as different values of DNNs (Data Network Names). It allows for specifying an empty wildcard meaning "all ID tags" or a constrained wildcard by denoting a range of ID tags.

question_27276.question: What is the role of the SHCCH in UMTS network?
question_27276.ground_truth: The SHCCH is a shared channel control channel that maps to RACH, USCH/FACH, and DSCH, and is used for signalling allocations of uplink capacity requested by UEs.

question_27278.question: What RRC state is added for returning from the power saving state in the cell selection procedure?

question_27280.question: What should the MCVideo client do if it receives a SIP 4xx, SIP 5xx response or SIP 6xx response to the SIP re-INVITE request and the SIP response contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with an <imminentperil-ind> element set to a value of "true"?
question_27280.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should set the MCVideo imminent peril group state as "MVIG 2: in-progress".

question_27281.question: What is the purpose of the asset tracker (UE) in the asset management system?
question_27281.ground_truth: The asset tracker (UE) in the asset management system is responsible for reporting relevant parameters related to the asset or freight container, such as freight temperature, pressure, and detection of shock.

question_27283.question: What should the AS do when a communication has been barred and activated the OIR service?
question_27283.ground_truth: Incoming communications of originating users that have activated the OIR service will be rejected as a consequence of the procedure in clause~4.5.2.6.2.

question_27285.question: What are the target horizontal position accuracy requirements for commercial use cases in Rel-17 of the 3GPP NR positioning enhancements?
question_27285.ground_truth: The target horizontal position accuracy requirement for commercial use cases in Rel-17 of the 3GPP NR positioning enhancements is less than 1 meter for 90% of UEs.

question_27287.question: How does the AS determine if the terminating network provides early media?
question_27287.ground_truth: The AS can determine whether the terminating network provides early media if the AS receives a P-Early-Media header field with a "sendrecv" value or a "sendonly" value in the initial SIP INVITE request.

question_27288.question: What mechanism does Solution #4 propose to allow a network to learn a new UE manufacturer-assigned ID directly from a UE?
question_27288.ground_truth: Solution #4 proposes a "self-learning" mechanism where an AMF receiving an unknown UE manufacturer-assigned ID provides this ID to the UDR via the NEF. This updates the ID in the UDR database and allows other AMFs in the network to be immediately updated with the ID, avoiding the need for allocation and management of operator-assigned IDs and initial registration capabilities reporting.

question_27290.question: What is the result of the MCPTT server sending an MCPTT emergency state cancel request towards the MCPTT clients of each of those affiliated MCPTT group members?
question_27290.ground_truth: MCPTT users are notified of the MCPTT emergency state cancellation of MCPTT client 1.

question_27291.question: What message does the SeNB send to initiate a successful operation in the procedure described in 8.6.6.2?

question_27292.question: What is the ID used to indicate Analytics ID related to Network Performance?
question_27292.ground_truth: The Analytics ID is set to "Network Performance" for Network Performance analytics.

question_27293.question: What is a SIP element that can handle a collection of User Agents and is independent of SIP rules?

question_27294.question: What is the role of the source I-SMF in the 3GPP network in relation to data forwarding?
question_27294.ground_truth: The source I-SMF provides the N3 forwarding tunnel information to S-AMF for data forwarding.

question_27295.question: What should be the Signalling integrity protection policy when the 5G ProSe direct link establishment procedure is for direct communication between the 5G ProSe remote UE and the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE and the RSC is not specific for emergency services?
question_27295.ground_truth: The Signalling integrity protection policy shall be set to "Signalling integrity protection required".

question_27297.question: What information is included in the corresponding Analytics API for VAL server performance analytics?
question_27297.ground_truth: The corresponding Analytics API for VAL server performance analytics includes inputs such as per VAL server performance measurements (application QoS measurements such as latency, channel losses, data rate, jitter), historical data/stats for VAL server performance, network/KPI monitoring from 5GS. The list of Data Sources includes VAL UE(s) having a session with VAL server(s), OAM for PM data, and other relevant data sources.

question_27298.question: What is the scope of section 5 of the document?
question_27298.ground_truth: Section 5 of the document focuses on specific band combinations for Intra-Band Contiguous Carrier Aggregation in FR1.

question_27299.question: What is used to find the time-domain TCX target signal from the quantized scaled spectrum X in the inverse transform step?
question_27299.ground_truth: An inverse FFT is used to find the time-domain TCX target signal from the quantized scaled spectrum X.

question_27300.question: What information is included in the LMF Request Location Information message in the LMF initiated Location Information Transfer Procedure?
question_27300.ground_truth: The LMF Request Location Information message includes positioning instructions such as the positioning mode, specific requested UE measurements if any, and quality of service parameters (accuracy, response time).

question_27301.question: What does the "TC-CONTINUE request primitive" represent in terms of the dialogue established between two application entities in the TC environment?
question_27301.ground_truth: The "TC-CONTINUE request primitive" is used to maintain a dialogue between two application entities, representing the ongoing communication of messages between them.

question_27303.question: What is the allowable deviation from the minimum requirement for the output power of a Home BS as given in Annex G?
question_27303.ground_truth: The allowable deviation from the minimum requirement for the output power of a Home BS is explained in Annex G, which provides the test tolerance and explains how the minimum requirement has been relaxed by the test tolerance.

question_27304.question: What attribute must the PCF include within the concerned PccRule data instance if UE IP address preservation is required?
question_27304.ground_truth: The "addrPreserInd" attribute must be set to true within the concerned PccRule data instance.

question_27305.question: What is one of the steps in the intra-CU topology adaptation procedure in SA?
question_27305.ground_truth: The IAB-donor-CU sends a UE CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message to the target parent node IAB-DU to create the UE context for the migrating IAB-MT and set up one or more bearers.

question_27308.question: What message does the UE send to the AMF in step 1 to request a single-access PDU session over 3GPP access?
question_27308.ground_truth: The UE sends a NAS message to AMF to request a single-access PDU session over 3GPP access and provides the PDU session identity (id) and other related information, such as the requested DNN and the requested slice type.

question_27311.question: What entity sets the URRP-SGSN or URRP-MME flag to notify about the UE's reachability status?

question_27312.question: What must the mobile station do if the Stream Identifier is included in the Setup Container?
question_27312.ground_truth: The mobile station can either re-assign a new Stream Identifier value and modify the Stream Identifier field, or remove the Stream Identifier field altogether.

question_27313.question: What is the condition for a UE to enter high-mobility state in non-HCS case?
question_27313.ground_truth: High-mobility state is entered if the number of cell reselections in a given time period exceeds a predefined value, or if the network has ordered the UE to consider itself in high-mobility state.

question_27314.question: What is the size of the Address leaf node defined in 5.24?
question_27314.ground_truth: The Address leaf node can store an FQDN, an IPv4 address, or an IPv6 address.

question_27315.question: What is the purpose of the UP Remote Provisioning of credentials for NSSAA or secondary authentication/authorization?
question_27315.ground_truth: The purpose of the UP Remote Provisioning of credentials for NSSAA or secondary authentication/authorization is to enable functionalities to provision or update the credentials used for NSSAA or credentials used for secondary authentication/authorization to the UE. The provisioning procedure is supported via User Plane.

question_27316.question: What propogation condition applies to the SS in section 8.6.1.4A.3?
question_27316.ground_truth: The propagation condition applied to the SS in section 8.6.1.4A.3 is fading propagation condition.

question_27317.question: When is the additional co-location minimum requirement in BC3 applicable for a BS co-located with a UTRA TDD BS?
question_27317.ground_truth: This additional requirement is applicable for a BS co-located with a UTRA TDD BS in subclause 6.7.2.3.

question_27318.question: What are the factors that define a physical channel?
question_27318.ground_truth: A physical channel is defined by frequency, timeslot, channelisation code, burst type and Radio Frame allocation.

question_27319.question: What information should the UE include in the transparent handover container when moving from EPS to 5GS?
question_27319.ground_truth: The UE should include an association of default EPS Bearer ID with S-NSSAI for each PDN connection established in 5GS in the transparent handover container.

question_27321.question: What information is used to route the received MAC-ehs SDUs or segments of MAC-ehs SDUs to correct reordering queues in MAC-ehs?

question_27324.question: What is the impact of the solution where SMF uses DN-AAA or DHCP servers for IP address assignment?
question_27324.ground_truth: The solution allows a central repository and management of UE IP addresses per UPF and eliminates IP pool fragmentation. However, the operator needs to deploy a DHCP or AAA server, and each IP address allocation requires an interaction with the DHCP/AAA server.

question_27325.question: What is the RRC re-establishment delay requirement for a known E-UTRA TDD intra frequency cell?
question_27325.ground_truth: The RRC re-establishment delay to a known E-UTRA TDD intra frequency cell shall be less than 7 seconds.

question_27326.question: What type of AVP is the Trunk-Group-ID (AVP code 851), as defined in 7.2.237, and what does it identify?
question_27326.ground_truth: The Trunk-Group-ID (AVP code 851) is of type Grouped and identifies the incoming and outgoing PSTN legs.

question_27327.question: When generating an FD SIGNALLING PAYLOAD message, what should an MCData client include in the SIP request?
question_27327.ground_truth: An MCData client should include the FD SIGNALLING PAYLOAD message in an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body as specified in subclause E.1.

question_27329.question: What should the receiver of a standard L3 message assume the format of an unknown IE to be, if bit 8 of the IEI octet is set to "1"?
question_27329.ground_truth: The receiver of a standard L3 message should assume the format of an unknown IE to be a TV formatted type 1 standard IE or a T formatted type 2 IE if bit 8 of the IEI octet is set to "1".

question_27331.question: What is the name of the HTTPS interface between the MCPTT IdM client in the UE and the IdMS for user authentication?

question_27332.question: What are the normal test conditions for equipment testing if not specified in the relevant product and basic standards?
question_27332.ground_truth: The manufacturers declared range of humidity, temperature and supply voltage should be used.

question_27333.question: What is the requirement for a MS to check the BSIC of non-serving cell BCCH carriers at least every 30 seconds?
question_27333.ground_truth: The MS shall attempt to check the BSIC for each of the 6 strongest non-serving cell BCCH carriers at least every 30 seconds, to confirm that it is monitoring the same cell.

question_27335.question: What is the role of the FRMCS System with regards to continuous supply of location information in the case of periodic location reporting?
question_27335.ground_truth: The FRMCS System supervises the continuous supply of the location information and initiates the re-establishment of the periodic location information data flow if it stops.

question_27336.question: What is the purpose of the "M" bit in the data link layer?
question_27336.ground_truth: The "M" bit in the data link layer indicates segmentation of layer 3 message units in data link layer frames and whether the information field of the frame contains only a segment or a complete layer 3 message unit.

question_27337.question: What is the first step in the Centralized Unit Determination and Centralized Rating scenario?
question_27337.ground_truth: The first step is the "Request for resource usage", where the UE-A requests the session establishment from the CTF.

question_27338.question: What is the difference between a DAPS bearer and an AM MRB?
question_27338.ground_truth: A DAPS bearer is a bearer whose radio protocols are located in both the source gNB and the target gNB during DAPS handover, whereas an AM MRB is an MRB associated with at least an AM RLC bearer for PTP transmission.

question_27339.question: What is the procedure if the UE has not re-selected Cell 2 within T3?
question_27339.ground_truth: If the UE has not re-selected Cell 2 within T3, then continue with step 12 of the procedure.

question_27340.question: What is a private slice as defined in the 3GPP Technical Report?
question_27340.ground_truth: A private slice is a dedicated network slice deployment for the sole use by a specific 3rd party.

question_27341.question: What information is stored in the "dialling number string", and how is it used in the "SET UP CALL" procedure?
question_27341.ground_truth: The "dialling number string" is a key component of the "SET UP CALL" procedure, containing the telephone number string that the ME will use to establish a connection with the Network. In this case, it consists of an USSD (Unstructured Supplementary Service Data) string combined with other characters (e.g., "TON", "NPI", "p" and "1" in the example), that is used for call setup purposes.separating the International dialing code from the actual phone number.

question_27342.question: What information does the first octet of the IED indicate in the case where the user data is coded using the GSM 7 bit default alphabet?
question_27342.ground_truth: The first octet of the IED indicates the number of septets within the IETF RFC 5322 E-Mail Header that is located at the beginning of the data part of the current SM segment.

question_27343.question: What does the Malicious Communication Identification (MCID) service do in 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_27343.ground_truth: The MCID service stores session-related information of incoming communications, independent of the service requested. It registers the destination party identity information, originating party identity information, and the local time and date of the invocation in the network serving the called user.

question_27344.question: What protocol does the PEMCF use to establish a transport layer connection with the PEGCF?

question_27345.question: What should a terminating participating MCData function do upon receiving a MSRP SEND request from the controlling MCData function and an indication to store the received file for later delivery?
question_27345.ground_truth: The terminating participating MCData function should receive and store the file, then indicate to the signalling plane that the file download is completed as specified in 3GPP TS 24.282 clause 10.2.5.3.4.

question_27346.question: How does the CSI AS initiate the first session with the voice component?
question_27346.ground_truth: The CSI AS initiates the first session with the voice component by sending an INVITE message to S-CSCF 1 containing a Tel URI corresponding to UE 1 and any additional information to terminate the session in the CS domain.

question_27348.question: What is the role of the HS-SCCH in HS-DSCH?
question_27348.ground_truth: The HS-SCCH is a DL physical channel that carries higher layer control information for HS-DSCH.

question_27349.question: What is an XML attribute specification, as defined by the present document?
question_27349.ground_truth: An XML attribute specification is a part of an XML element, it has a name and a value.

question_27351.question: What are the minimum conformance requirements for Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) for intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation?
question_27351.ground_truth: The EVM requirement for each component carrier is specified in section 6.4.2.1 of the document and applies with PRB allocation in one of the component carriers. Similar transmitter impairment removal procedures are applied for CA waveform before EVM calculation as is specified for non-CA waveform.

question_27352.question: What is the term for the number of successful credit re-authorization procedures in the context of 3GPP EPS?

question_27353.question: What is the update equation for the long term noise level estimate for the active speech level in the SAD module?
question_27353.ground_truth: The update equation for the long term noise level estimate for the active speech level in the SAD module is the total subband noise level after update for the current frame, only if and the speech music classifier flag is 0. Otherwise, the long term noise level estimate for the active speech level remains unchanged.

question_27355.question: What should the MBMS GW do when it detects a restart of the BM-SC with which it has at least one MBMS Bearer context?
question_27355.ground_truth: The MBMS GW shall deactivate all the related MBMS Bearer contexts locally and towards E-UTRAN/UTRAN in which the MBMS bearer service is active by sending MBMS Session Stop messages to their controlling MME/SGSNs.

question_27356.question: Which entity requests the PDN Gateway during PMIP on S2a and GTP on S2b?
question_27356.ground_truth: The ePDG requests the PDN Gateway during PMIP on S2a and GTP on S2b.

question_27357.question: What should the MeNB store in the E-RAB modifications for an MN-terminated bearer?
question_27357.ground_truth: The MeNB should store the UL PDCP SN Length IE and the DL PDCP SN Length IE for the concerned MN terminated bearer.

question_27358.question: What is the Layer-2 ID used for in unicast communication between two UEs in ProSe Direct Communication?
question_27358.ground_truth: The Layer-2 ID is assigned to the UE during provisioning time and can be used for multiple layer-2 links in one-to-one communication, as well as for the source Layer-2 ID of both one-to-one and one-to-many communication.

question_27359.question: What is required for the MCVideo clients to receive the corresponding MC data in multicast MBS sessions?
question_27359.ground_truth: The MCVideo UEs need to initiate a UE session join towards the 5GS to join the multicast MBS session.

question_27361.question: What are the two types of channels for packet switched mode that need to be tested with frequency offsets?

question_27362.question: When is a ProSe UE-to-network relay UE required to initiate the UE requested PDN connectivity procedure?
question_27362.ground_truth: When the target UE is not connected yet or more connections are needed for relaying associated with the ProSe Relay UE ID, the ProSe UE-to-network relay UE initiates the UE requested PDN connectivity procedure by sending the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message.
