question_28719.question: What is the purpose of the "MCVideo group ID" information element in the message format?
question_28719.ground_truth: The "MCVideo group ID" information element is used to indicate the destination MCVideo group identifier in the message.

question_28721.question: Which IRP specification is studied for aligning MTOSI FM implementations with MTNM specifications?
question_28721.ground_truth: The Alarm IRP (32.111-series) is studied for aligning MTOSI FM implementations with MTNM specifications.

question_28722.question: What is the challenge faced in model inference when using a fixed collection frequency mechanism for data collection?
question_28722.ground_truth: If the collection rate is too high, it will lead to excessive consumption of network resources. On the contrary, if the rate is too low, information loss and inaccurate measurement may be caused, and accurate analysis may not be possible in some key scenarios.

question_28725.question: What is the response sent by HLRb when it receives the "provide roaming number" request?

question_28726.question: Who is responsible for sending uplink power control "up" commands in the test described in 6.2D.2.4.2?
question_28726.ground_truth: The SS (test system) is responsible for sending uplink power control "up" commands in the test described in 6.2D.2.4.2.

question_28727.question: What is the principle of operation for a repeater in terms of performance assessment?
question_28727.ground_truth: The parameter used for assessment of performance of a repeater is the gain within the operating band.

question_28729.question: What is replaced when interworking with 5GS is supported and a "SMF+PGW-C" is selected for a PDN connection?
question_28729.ground_truth: IP-CAN Session Establishment procedure, IP-CAN Session Modification procedure, IP-CAN Session Termination procedure are replaced by equivalent procedures in SM Policy Association Establishment Procedure, SM Policy Association Modification procedure and SM Policy Association Termination procedure respectively.

question_28730.question: What is the measurement restriction for CSI-RS based L1-RSRP when the CSI-RS for L1-RSRP measurement is in the same OFDM symbol as another CSI-RS for L1-RSRP measurement?
question_28730.ground_truth: The UE is required to measure the CSI-RSRP for L1-RSRP without any restriction.

question_28731.question: What are the media types that may be supported during an IMS MES?
question_28731.ground_truth: Real-time video, session mode text-based instant messaging, file transfer, video clip sharing, picture sharing, audio clip sharing, voice, and Real-Time Text.

question_28732.question: What is the requirement for Transmit Diversity for inter-band Uplink Carrier Aggregation with Transmit Diversity in one of the two frequency bands for the receiver tests?
question_28732.ground_truth: Unless otherwise stated, the receiver requirements of inter-band UL CA are applicable to UE with one Tx antenna connector in each of the two bands, or UE with one Tx antenna connector in one band and two Tx antenna connectors in the other band.

question_28733.question: What are the two classes for communication session setup time in the FRMCS system?
question_28733.ground_truth: The two classes for communication session setup time in the FRMCS system are Immediate and Normal.

question_28736.question: When can GRUU processing be required by the S-CSCF?
question_28736.ground_truth: GRUU processing is required if the S-CSCF determines that an original dialog identifier is not present and the contact address contains a GRUU assigned by the S-CSCF or a temporary GRUU self-assigned by the UE.

question_28738.question: What is one condition that allows the UE to determine to use a NAS signalling connection instead of EDT for event reporting?
question_28738.ground_truth: One condition that allows the UE to determine to use a NAS signalling connection is when the UE is already in connected state or can only access a RAN node which does not support EDT.

question_28739.question: What is required for an emergency session to be anchored from CS to IMS?
question_28739.ground_truth: The UE needs to perform an IMS emergency registration (if not already registered) and initiate a request for session transfer from CS to IMS.

question_28741.question: What is compared to ensure that broadcast messages have power accuracy in AAS BS?
question_28741.ground_truth: In AAS BS, the signal power broadcast on the BCH is compared to the sum of the reference signal power summed over all the TAB connectors transmitting the signal, or the reference signal power broadcast on the BCH is multiplied by the fraction of power of that signal declared by the manufacturer on each TAB connector and compared with the power on the TAB connector individually.

question_28744.question: In what sequence do the message store client and the MCData message store communicate for uploading objects?
question_28744.ground_truth: First, the message store client sends an upload objects request to the MCData message store, then the MCData message store sends an upload objects response to the message store client.

question_28745.question: What must the V-GMLC do after receiving the cancellation acknowledgement from the MSC/SGSN?
question_28745.ground_truth: The V-GMLC must send the LCS Cancel Service Response to H-GMLC with the LDR reference number and the H-GMLC address.

question_28746.question: Which mobility procedure is used in the 6.4.1.3.1 call flows when a handover with SGW change occurs?
question_28746.ground_truth: The S1-based handover procedure with a normal flow is used in the 6.4.1.3.1 call flows when a handover with SGW change occurs.

question_28747.question: What attribute is used to specify the timestamp in the "Coverage-info" complex type?
question_28747.ground_truth: The "timestamp" attribute is used to specify the timestamp in the "Coverage-info" complex type.

question_28748.question: What must be created in Diameter nodes for the new Diameter application to contribute to overload management?
question_28748.ground_truth: A correlation between the specific Diameter application and the new Diameter application for transfer of load/overload information.

question_28749.question: What should the 3GPP system support in order to provide an appropriate and efficient authentication mechanism for groups of devices?

question_28750.question: What is the test purpose for the transmission quality of the first PRACH preamble in 5.13.4?
question_28750.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify that the transmission quality of the first PRACH preamble meets the minimum requirements for modulation quality, carrier frequency, access slot and signature as defined in 5.13.4.2.

question_28751.question: What does BAP PDUs stand for in IAB architecture?
question_28751.ground_truth: BAP PDUs stands for Backhaul Adaptation Protocol Protocol Data Units.

question_28752.question: What is the maximum number of timeslots that can be allocated to a Type I mobile for data transmission?
question_28752.ground_truth: 5 timeslots can be allocated to a Type I mobile for data transmission.

question_28753.question: What is the fading distribution of the first tap for TDL-D and TDL-E models?
question_28753.ground_truth: The fading distribution of the first tap for TDL-D and TDL-E models follows a Ricean distribution due to the presence of a LOS path.

question_28754.question: What happens if the source RAN (NG-RAN, E-UTRAN) decides to cancel the handover to the target system during the handover procedure?
question_28754.ground_truth: The source RAN initiates a handover cancel message to the source CN node (AMF or MME), which then sends a Relocation Cancel Request message to the target CN node. The target CN node triggers release of resources towards the target RAN node and sends a Relocation Cancel Response towards the source CN node, which in turn responds with a handover cancel ACK towards the source RAN.

question_28756.question: How does the measurement definition template describe measurements in this subclause?
question_28756.ground_truth: The measurement definition template describes the measurements using a descriptive name of the measurement type, collection method, condition, measurement result, measurement type, measurement object class, switching technology, and generation.

question_28758.question: When does a Tariff time change result in the start of new counts to be sent to the OCS?
question_28758.ground_truth: When a tariff time change is encountered, all current counts are captured and new counts are started and sent to the OCS in the next Debit/Reserve Units Request.

question_28759.question: What is the data type of the "hang-time" element in the "private-callType" complex type?
question_28759.ground_truth: The data type of the "hang-time" element in the "private-callType" complex type is xs:duration.

question_28760.question: In what scenario is device-to-device communication used for traffic offload in a factory?
question_28760.ground_truth: When there is not enough spectrum in one band to cover the whole network and there are high bandwidth and resource demands from multiple cyber-physical applications in the factory, some traffic is offloaded to ProSe communication instead of going through the eNB.

question_28761.question: What should the SRNC do if it receives a POSITION PARAMETER MODIFICATION message during a periodic UE positioning measurement reporting procedure that does not result in termination of the UE measurement reporting?
question_28761.ground_truth: The SRNC should continue to send POSITION PARAMETER MODIFICATION messages notifying the SAS of such RRC state changes until the periodic position measurement reporting has been completed or terminated.

question_28762.question: What is the role of the Transcoder and Rate Adaptor Unit (TRAU) in the 3GPP TS 48.051 standard?
question_28762.ground_truth: The TRAU is considered a part of the Base Station Subsystem (BSS) and the signaling between the BSS and the TRAU may be performed using BSS internal signals. The TRAU functions include Remote Transcoder and Rate Adaptor Control Function, Remote Speech Handler Function, Rate Adaptation functions, and the transcoder function, and optionally Tandem Free Operation functions.

question_28763.question: What is the reporting range for RS-SINR measurement accuracy requirements in 9.1.17.2 of the document?
question_28763.ground_truth: The reporting range for RS-SINR measurement accuracy requirements is the same as the guaranteed accuracy range in the document.

question_28764.question: What is the purpose of the N41 reference point in the 5G connection and mobility charging architecture?
question_28764.ground_truth: The N41 reference point is defined for the interactions between the AMF and H-CHF in the 5G connection and mobility charging architecture.

question_28765.question: What is the difference between the "AO", "OI", and "OX" parameters in the Facility lock command?
question_28765.ground_truth: The "AO" parameter is used to bar all outgoing calls, the "OI" parameter is used to bar outgoing international calls, and the "OX" parameter is used to bar outgoing international calls except to the home country.

question_28766.question: What is the difference between the contents of System Information Block type 11 for cell No.1, 2, 3, 7, 8 and cell No.4, 5, 6 in the UTRAN test scenario with cells on PLMN1 belonging to two different frequencies?
question_28766.ground_truth: The difference is in the Intra-frequency and Inter-frequency measurement system information. For cell No.1, 2, 3, 7, 8, the Intra-frequency measurement system information contains cell No.1, 2, 3, 7, 8, and Inter-frequency measurement system information contains cell No.4, 5, 6. For cell No.4, 5, 6, the Intra-frequency measurement system information contains cell No.4, 5, 6, and Inter-frequency measurement system information contains cell No. 1, 2, 3, 7, 8.

question_28767.question: What should the MAC entity do if there are remaining resources after serving the logical channel with the highest priority?
question_28767.ground_truth: The MAC entity should serve all the logical channels selected in clause 5.4.3.1.2 in a strict decreasing priority order until either the data for that logical channel or the UL grant is exhausted.

question_28768.question: What should the mobile station do if timer T3190 expires?
question_28768.ground_truth: If timer T3190 expires, the mobile station shall abort the procedure and return to packet idle mode.

question_28769.question: What is the role of the SGSN, when the MS accepts the PDP context modification requested by the network, in the SGSN-Initiated PDP Context Modification procedure?
question_28769.ground_truth: The SGSN receives a "Modify PDP Context Accept" message from the MS if the MS accepts the PDP context modification.

question_28770.question: How does the UE indicate a request for prioritised handling over the radio interface?
question_28770.ground_truth: The UE can indicate a request for prioritised handling over the radio interface by setting the Signalling Indication attribute within the QoS information element.

question_28771.question: What should the AMF do after completing the registration procedure if the UE has included the Non-3GPP path switching information IE with NSONR bit set in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and the AMF supports non-3GPP path switching while using old non-3GPP resources?
question_28771.ground_truth: The AMF shall not release the user plane resources of the old non-3GPP access of the PDU sessions supporting non-3GPP access path switching and whose PDU session IDs are included in the Uplink data status IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message until the user plane resources of the new non-3GPP access are established.

question_28772.question: What should be the state of the CC entity and call control timers when initiating the assignment phase during mobile terminating call establishment?
question_28772.ground_truth: Initiating the assignment phase does not directly change the state of a CC entity nor affect any call control timers.

question_28775.question: Which function is responsible for ciphering the radio interface upon request from the Core Network?
question_28775.ground_truth: The Radio Interface Ciphering function is responsible for ciphering the radio interface upon request from the Core Network. This ciphering applies to both signalling and user data, with the UTRAN responsible for ciphering within the network.

question_28776.question: What action should the SRNC take if it receives a POSITION PERIODIC TERMINATION message and has activated a periodic UE positioning measurement reporting in the UE?
question_28776.ground_truth: The SRNC should terminate the periodic UE positioning measurement reporting in the UE.

question_28777.question: What procedure is used for termination of the continuous reporting of network status?
question_28777.ground_truth: The removal procedure for continuous reporting of network status involves the SCEF detecting the end of the requested Duration for an ongoing continuous reporting, identifying the corresponding SCEF Reference ID, and sending a Cancel Network Status Response (Cause) message to the SCS/AS.

question_28778.question: What do functional entities need to verify about incoming SIP requests to determine whether the II-NNI URI parameter should be removed?
question_28778.ground_truth: Functional entities need to verify whether the request is received from a trust domain or not. If the request is received from outside of the trust domain, then the functional entity removes any "ii-nni" URI parameter of Route header field, if present.

question_28780.question: What is the role of modem performance in application layer data throughput performance in LTE?
question_28780.ground_truth: Modem performance plays a significant role in application layer data throughput performance in LTE, especially in noisy conditions under multipath fading scenarios.

question_28781.question: What is the precondition mechanism defined in RFC 3312 and updated by RFC 4032 used for in session establishment?
question_28781.ground_truth: The precondition mechanism is used to authorize media streams during session establishment by allowing the P-CSCF and S-CCF to inspect the SDP payloads. The UE should not encrypt the SDP payloads for this mechanism to work properly.

question_28782.question: What are the expected service lifetime and considerations for the communication infrastructure used in energy systems?
question_28782.ground_truth: The expected service lifetime of energy system communication services is decades, as they serve an extended period of time, similar to the energy system components' expected lifetime. Communication infrastructure components must consider interworking with legacy deployments due to the long service lifetime.

question_28784.question: When does the AMF include NONCE2 in the NAS Redirection message?
question_28784.ground_truth: The AMF includes NONCE2 in the NAS Redirection message when it wants to reject the UE and NAS security is not activated, to prove freshness from the network.

question_28785.question: What is the role of the non-controlling MCPTT function in an MCPTT group?
question_28785.ground_truth: The non-controlling MCPTT function of an MCPTT group receives and transmits floor control messages from and to the MCPTT client via the participating MCPTT function. It also distributes floor control messages to and from the floor control server in the controlling or non-controlling MCPTT function.

question_28786.question: What is the purpose of Scenario 1 in 5.7.2 for operators deploying femtocells over fixed broadband services?
question_28786.ground_truth: In Scenario 1, operators should be able to manage a unified set of identities for a single user to allow seamless access across fixed and cellular access networks.

question_28788.question: What should be the length of the MCPTT Group Identity value if it is not a multiple of 4 bytes?
question_28788.ground_truth: If the MCPTT Group Identity value is not a multiple of 4 bytes, it should be padded to the nearest multiple of 4 bytes, with the padding bytes set to zero.

question_28789.question: What is the objective of the CCO SON function?
question_28789.ground_truth: The objective of the CCO SON function is to meet the operator's requirement on coverage and capacity, and the prioritization between them.

question_28790.question: What happens when the S-CSCF initiates registration procedures affecting all the Public User Identities in the associated implicitly registered Public User Identity set?
question_28790.ground_truth: The Registration states of the Public User Identities in the associated implicitly registered Public User Identity set are affected in the same way as the targeted Public User Identity.

question_28792.question: What is the purpose of S&F (Store and Forward) Satellite operation in the 5G system?
question_28792.ground_truth: The purpose of S&F (Store and Forward) Satellite operation in the 5G system is to enable autonomous network services to UEs without the satellite always being connected to the ground station, which can extend the service availability for areas without the connectivity to ground station via feeder link or ISL. It also improves the ground segment affordability and allows more robust UE services with the satellite under intermittently/temporarily unavailable feeder link.

question_28793.question: What should the UE do if it cannot provide the requested identity in the IDENTITY RESPONSE message during the identification procedure in the 5G system?
question_28793.ground_truth: The UE should encode the identity type as "no identity" in the IDENTITY RESPONSE message.

question_28794.question: Who provides the service agreement that allows user B to participate in group M of MCPTT Y?
question_28794.ground_truth: MCPTT X provides the service agreement that allows user B to participate in group M of MCPTT Y.

question_28795.question: What is MLB, or Major League Baseball?
question_28795.ground_truth: The professional baseball league in the United States and Canada

question_28796.question: What is the condition that must be fulfilled for inter-frequency channel occupancy measurements when using a single measurement gap pattern for all concurrent inter-frequency measurements?
question_28796.ground_truth: The entire RSSI measurement duration used for channel occupancy measurement should be contained in the measurement gap.

question_28798.question: What should the CTS-FP do when it receives a message with semantically incorrect contents?
question_28798.ground_truth: If the CTS-FP receives a message with semantically incorrect contents, it should follow the reactions of the procedural part of GSM~04.56, or if no such reactions are specified, it should ignore the message and return a status message with cause #95 if an RR connection exists. The CTS-FP does not normally transmit a status message.

question_28799.question: What is the role of the augmented reality application in this use case?
question_28799.ground_truth: The augmented reality application in this use case handles the video streams generated by the laparoscope and the ultrasound probe to help the surgeon determine the location of the left anterior descending (LAD) coronary and visualize plaque and calcifications which may hamper coronary anastomosis suturing.

question_28800.question: When is immediate TFO establishment possible with two compatible AMR-NB codec types?
question_28800.ground_truth: Immediate TFO can be established between two compatible AMR-NB codec types if the CACS (Common Adaptive Multi-Rate Codec Set) is equal to the OACS (Optimal Adaptive Multi-Rate Codec Set), and the CACS fulfills the contiguity rule.

question_28801.question: What is the main difference between a broadcast group call and a normal MCPTT group call?
question_28801.ground_truth: In a broadcast group call, only the initiating MCPTT client is allowed to transmit media, while in a normal MCPTT group call, all participants can transmit media.

question_28802.question: What is a key feature of the STAR-based architecture for immersive interactive media distribution?
question_28802.ground_truth: The STAR-based architecture places most of the rendering on the user device, with some processing done on the server side.

question_28803.question: What action should the gNB-CU-UP take if it receives a BC BEARER CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message but cannot establish the requested resources?
question_28803.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP should respond with the BC BEARER CONTEXT SETUP FAILURE message and an appropriate cause value.

question_28804.question: In what scenario should the AS forward the INVITE request without providing CRS service?
question_28804.ground_truth: The AS should forward the INVITE request without providing CRS service if the CRS service provided by the AS serving the terminating UE has no priority and the CRS service provided by the AS serving the originating UE is not accepted.

question_28806.question: What is one of the procedures for reporting MME ID during attach procedure?
question_28806.ground_truth: During attach procedure, after completing steps 1 to 11 in clause 5.3.2.1 of TS 23.401, MME sends the MME ID to SGW in the Create Session Request message, which is forwarded to PGW and PCRF for further processing.

question_28808.question: What type of interfaces do network functions within the 5GC Control Plane use for their interactions?
question_28808.ground_truth: Network functions within the 5GC Control Plane only use service-based interfaces for their interactions.

question_28811.question: What should the UE do upon successfully delivering the UEInformationResponse message with connEstFailReport to upper layers?
question_28811.ground_truth: The UE should discard the connEstFailReport from VarConnEstFailReport and VarConnEstFailReportList.

question_28812.question: What should an eP-CSCF do when it receives an SDP answer over the Mw interface that includes "tra-m-line" media level SDP attributes?
question_28812.ground_truth: The eP-CSCF should use the media information received in "tra-m-line", "tra-att", and "tra-bw" SDP attributes when invoking IMS-ALG procedures, and de-encapsulate the "tra-m-line", "tra-att", "tra-SCTP-association", and "tra-bw" SDP attributes in the SDP answer towards the WIC.

question_28813.question: What is the condition for a UE to measure the CSI-IM without restriction for L1-SINR measurement in FR2?
question_28813.ground_truth: When both CSI-RSs are not in any CSI-RS resource set with repetition ON, the two CSI-RS resources and both PDSCHs are overlapped on the same OFDM symbol, one CSI-RS has the same QCL source as the active TCI state of one PDSCH, and the other CSI-RS has the same QCL source as the active TCI state of the other PDSCH, and the resources of the active TCI states for the two PDSCHs have been reported as a resource group in Rel-17 group-based RSRP report.

question_28814.question: How many carrier frequency layers, including one serving carrier frequency, should the UE be capable of monitoring in total?
question_28814.ground_truth: The UE should be capable of monitoring a total of at least 5 carrier frequency layers.

question_28815.question: Under which circumstances should a floor participant send a Floor Release message towards other floor participants if no queued requests exist?
question_28815.ground_truth: A floor participant should send a Floor Release message towards other floor participants if no queued requests exist when the MCPTT user releases permission to send RTP media, and if the session is not initiated as a broadcast group call with the B-bit set to '1' (Broadcast group call). The Floor Release message should include the MCPTT ID of the MCPTT user in the User ID field and a Floor Indicator field set to '0' (normal call).

question_28817.question: What is the purpose of the "Update Location Request" and "Update Location Response" messages exchanged between an SGSN and an HSS?
question_28817.ground_truth: These messages are used to inform the HSS of a mobile station's location for mobility with non-3GPP accesses.

question_28819.question: What is considered as missed (ACK) in the test?
question_28819.ground_truth: If the UE indicates on the E-DPCCH a retransmission and the ACK from cell 2 was received as NACK by the UE.

question_28820.question: What is the purpose of RFC5651 in the context of 3GPP?
question_28820.ground_truth: RFC5651 defines extension headers for the Real-time Applicability statement (RAS) for the use in 3GPP.

question_28821.question: What is the purpose of the conformance requirements in the intermodulation rejection test?
question_28821.ground_truth: The purpose of the conformance requirements is to ensure that the mobile station (MS) does not exceed the given degradation due to the presence of unwanted signals.

question_28822.question: What should the EES do if the UE location is outside the Geographical or Topological Service Area of an EAS?
question_28822.ground_truth: The EES shall not include this EAS in the EAS discovery notification.

question_28823.question: What are the limitations of glTF 2.0 in regards to immersive applications?
question_28823.ground_truth: glTF 2.0 has traditionally been focused on static scenes and assets, which makes it unfit to address the requirements and needs of dynamic and rich 3D scenes in immersive environments. It lacks support for timed media, audio, local and real-time media, and interactions with the scene.

question_28824.question: What message does the MS respond with after receiving a RRLP Positioning Capability Request message, indicating the GNSS(s) supported by the MS?
question_28824.ground_truth: The MS responds with an RR APPLICATION INFORMATION message containing an RRLP Positioning Capability Response message, indicating the GNSS(s) supported by the MS.

question_28826.question: Under what conditions does the network provide the 5GSM cause value #69 in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message?
question_28826.ground_truth: The network provides the 5GSM cause value #69 in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message when there are insufficient resources for a specific slice for non-emergency PDU sessions.

question_28828.question: What is the primary purpose of the TTI insertion uncertainty in the test requirement?
question_28828.ground_truth: TTI insertion uncertainty in the test requirement is the delay resulted when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH. It is added to the measurement reporting delays to ensure that the actual overall delays measured in the test match the requirements.

question_28829.question: What should the S-CSCF determine as the target URI to build in case no qvalue parameters were provided and the Request-Disposition header is not present in an INVITE request?
question_28829.ground_truth: The S-CSCF determines the contact address to be used to build the target URI as per its local policy if no qvalue parameters were provided and the Request-Disposition header is not present in an INVATE request.

question_28830.question: What is the total radiated power defined in for both the near-field and far-field regions?

question_28832.question: What are the basic functions supported over the E1 interface?
question_28832.ground_truth: The basic functions supported over the E1 interface include non-UE-associated E1 functions such as E1 interface management function, and UE-associated E1 functions such as Bearer management function.

question_28833.question: What is the function of the property "interface" and what are its possible values?
question_28833.ground_truth: The property "interface" indicates the type of interface on which the termination is used. The possible values it can take are "RAN" (for Iu interface) and "CN" (for Nb interface).

question_28834.question: In case of more than one UL-SCH transport block transmitted in a subframe of an UL cell, when is the AUL-UCI multiplexed with data on the UL-SCH transport block?
question_28834.ground_truth: The AUL-UCI is multiplexed with data on the UL-SCH transport block with the highest IMSCS value that is indicated by the AUL activation DCI.

question_28835.question: What is the condition for allowing the interruption during RRC-based BWP switching when it involves other parameter changes apart from SCS and the UE is not capable of per-UE measurement gap?
question_28835.ground_truth: Interruptions are not allowed during BWP switch involving other parameter change.

question_28836.question: What situation must be met in order to derive the NRPIK key during signalling confidentiality protection activation?
question_28836.ground_truth: NRPIK key is derived if and only if signalling integrity protection is activated for this connection.

question_28838.question: What is the purpose of sending rejected NSSAI to the UDM in 5G network?
question_28838.ground_truth: The purpose is to assist the UDM to steer the UE to the PLMN supporting rejected NSSAI. During the registration procedure in a VPLMN, if the AMF determines that a S-NSSAI is not allowed, the AMF sends the rejected NSSAI and requested NSSAI to the UDM. When the UDM receives the rejected NSSAI and the requested NSSAI, the UDM can determine which other VPLMN can support the rejected NSSAI.

question_28839.question: For RSTD measurement reporting, which subframes should be available in the measured and reference cells for the UE to comply with the requirement for satisfying the reporting delay?
question_28839.ground_truth: All positioning subframes indicated in the OTDOA assistance data and specified in Section 9.1.21.18 should be available for RSTD measurements in the measured and reference cells.

question_28843.question: What is the test purpose in the UCS2 facility for coding Katakana characters in the SEND SS proactive UICC command?
question_28843.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify that the ME displays the UCS2 text contained in the SEND SS proactive UICC command, and returns a successful result in the TERMINAL RESPONSE command sent to the UICC.

question_28844.question: What is the maximum increase in output power for A-MPR 6.3.3.1.2-1 and 6.3.3.1.2-2 for SL intra-band contiguous CA in section 6.3.3.1.2?
question_28844.ground_truth: The maximum increase in output power for A-MPR 6.3.3.1.2-1 is 4 dB, while for A-MPR 6.3.3.1.2-2 it is 6 dB.

question_28845.question: What entity is responsible for deriving the serving AMF which can serve a specific area in Network assisted Sidelink Positioning?

question_28846.question: What is the shortened form of the GUTI that enables more efficient radio signalling procedures in 5G System?

question_28847.question: What are the roles of gNB-CU and gNB-DU in the NG-RAN architecture, as per the definitions provided in the document?
question_28847.ground_truth: gNB-CU (Central Unit) hosts RRC, SDAP and PDCP protocols of the gNB or RRC and PDCP protocols of the en-gNB that controls the operation of one or more gNB-DUs. The gNB-DU (Distributed Unit) hosts RLC, MAC and PHY layers of the gNB or en-gNB, and its operation is partly controlled by gNB-CU. One gNB-DU supports one or multiple cells. One cell is supported by only one gNB-DU.

question_28848.question: What security mechanism is used for end-to-end security in UE-to-UE relay scenarios in Cellular-V2X networks?
question_28848.ground_truth: The Source UE and the Target UE may use unicast mode security mechanism defined in clause 5.3 of TS 33.536 to establish secure connections with the Relay UE. For the Layer-3 UE-to-UE relay scenario, establishing a secure connection between the Source UE and the Target UE is out of the scope of 3GPP.

question_28849.question: What should the EEC do if the status in step 12 indicates a successful ACT or in the EELManagedACR case?
question_28849.ground_truth: The EES sends the ACR information notification (ACR complete) message immediately to the EEC to confirm that the ACR has completed.

question_28851.question: Which ciphering algorithms should the AMF support for signaling data confidentiality?
question_28851.ground_truth: The AMF should support the following ciphering algorithms for signaling data confidentiality: NEA0, 128-NEA1, 128-NEA2, and optionally 128-NEA3.

question_28852.question: What is the condition under which the UE may choose not to perform intra-frequency measurements?
question_28852.ground_truth: The UE may choose not to perform intra-frequency measurements if the serving cell fulfills Srxlev > SIntraSearchP and Squal > SIntraSearchQ.

question_28854.question: What are the two possible types of routing based on MNP implementation?
question_28854.ground_truth: The two types of routing based on MNP implementation are direct routing and indirect routing.

question_28856.question: What is the minimum requirement for the cell re-selection delay in the test described in 8.2.5.3?
question_28856.ground_truth: The cell re-selection delay should be less than 21 seconds.

question_28858.question: What authentication procedure is performed when the MS indicated in the MS Network Capability it does not support BSS packet flow procedures, in the GGSN-Initiated PDP Context Modification procedure?
question_28858.ground_truth: The SGSN shall not include the Packet Flow Id if the MS indicated in the MS Network Capability it does not support BSS packet flow procedures, and it sends a "Modify PDP Context Request" message to the MS.

question_28859.question: In which clause is described the UE procedure for determining the subframes used for PSSCH in sidelink transmission mode 1?

question_28861.question: What is required for an end-point to use or access end-to-end secure communications in MCVideo?
question_28861.ground_truth: The end-point needs to be provisioned with keying material associated to its identity by the KMS.

question_28862.question: Which organization is responsible for the development of NR spectrum plans in the range between 24.25-29.5 GHz?
question_28862.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) and its Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG-RAN) are responsible for the development of NR spectrum plans in the range between 24.25-29.5 GHz.

question_28863.question: What is the UE measurement reporting requirement for event 1B during time period T4?
question_28863.ground_truth: UE shall transmit a MEASUREMENT REPORT message for Cell 3 triggered by event 1B during T4 with a measurement reporting delay less than 280 ms.

question_28864.question: What action does the new 3G-SGSN take after receiving an SGSN Context Response message without IMEISV and if the ADD function is supported?
question_28864.ground_truth: The new 3G-SGSN retrieves the IMEISV from the MS.

question_28865.question: What is the purpose of the "sCIBillingChargingCharacteristics" parameter in the SendChargingInformation operation?
question_28865.ground_truth: It contains a choice of two lists of charging information, one for when there is no active call leg or connection, and another for when there is.

question_28867.question: When multiple applications are involved in controlling a call or session, what principle is being referred to as the "cascaded chain principle"?
question_28867.ground_truth: The "cascaded chain principle" is a rule that ensures consistent processing of event notification detection requests in different call or session control instances, even when more than one controlling application is acting on the same call or session.

question_28868.question: In what scenario does the UE Rx-Tx time difference measurement period requirement apply for a cell that is the downlink reference cell for SRS transmission but not for a cell that is not the downlink reference cell for SRS transmission?
question_28868.ground_truth: When UE uplink transmission timing changes due to the UE autonomous timing adjustment.

question_28869.question: Which 5th order IMD is generated by dual uplink of Band 1 and n78?
question_28869.ground_truth: The 5th order IMD generated by dual uplink of Band 1 and n78 doesn't fall into own Rx.

question_28870.question: What kind of session is indicated by an 'm' line in the SDP media parameters for file repair?

question_28871.question: What is the role of the 5GMS AF in provisioning a Dynamic PCC rule?
question_28871.ground_truth: The 5GMS AF provisions the information for a Dynamic PCC rule with the PCF, possibly through NEF.

question_28872.question: In 6.7.2, what use cases are addressed by the Network based UE Sidelink Positioning solution?
question_28872.ground_truth: The Network based UE Sidelink Positioning solution addresses KI#5 for MT-LR cases, where uplink-based positioning is not feasible for a user equipment (UE) located within the network coverage. The solution involves the network initiating the location reporting procedure, and the UE performing positioning measurements and determining whether to use sidelink positioning.

question_28873.question: What is the function of the "Signalling Transport" in E1AP?
question_28873.ground_truth: The signalling transport in E1AP provides in-sequence delivery of E1AP messages and notifies E1AP if the signalling connection breaks.

question_28874.question: What type of sequence is UE Context Setup Response?

question_28875.question: What is the responsibility of the MCPTT server when a new MCPTT private call request is sent with new parameters?
question_28875.ground_truth: The MCPTT server can forward the MCPTT private call response with new parameters to the MCPTT client, which can then choose to end the call or continue with the new parameters. The MCPTT system initiating the call is responsible for managing the floor and issuing floor revoked indications.

question_28876.question: What is the goal of 3GPP in addressing the challenge of public numbering resources for MTC communications?
question_28876.ground_truth: The goal is to study and propose an alternative to using public numbering resources for MTC communications and alleviate the pressure on the current E.164 numbering resources.

question_28877.question: Which OPs are involved in the calculation of the viewport QR value in the evaluation of VR QoE?
question_28877.ground_truth: OP1, OP3, and OP4 in the VR QoE client reference model.

question_28879.question: What is the purpose of the "reactivation requested" cause value in the 3GPP TS 23.060 and 23.401 specifications?
question_28879.ground_truth: The "reactivation requested" cause value is used by the MME/S4-SGSN to deactivate and restore certain PDN connections based on operator policies such as QCI, ARP, and APN.

question_28880.question: What mode period should be used for a MS that has enabled EC operation in packet idle mode?
question_28880.ground_truth: A MS that has enabled EC operation in packet idle mode should use a non-DRX mode period of zero seconds.

question_28881.question: What should the UE do upon receiving an ACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT ACCEPT message with the NBIFOM status parameter set to "Accepted" in the context of adding GERAN or UTRAN access to an existing NBIFOM PDN connection?
question_28881.ground_truth: The UE should consider that the network has accepted that NBIFOM traffic for that PDN connection can be sent through GERAN or UTRAN and should consider the NBIFOM default access parameter of the NBIFOM container IE as the NBIFOM default access.

question_28885.question: What must the participating MCVideo function include in a SIP re-INVITE request towards the terminating MCVideo client?
question_28885.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function shall include the option tag "tdialog" in a Supported header field, may include a Resource-Share header field, shall perform procedures specified to copy any MIME bodies in the received SIP re-INVITE request to the outgoing SIP re-INVITE request, and if the received SIP re-INVITE request contains a Resource-Priority header field, shall include a Resource-Priority header field with the contents set as in the received header field.

question_28886.question: What is the maximum carrier output power per TAB connector in an AAS BS?

question_28887.question: What are the two parameters in the CSG Cell Selection event that are mandatory for the ME to set?
question_28887.ground_truth: The two parameters in the CSG Cell Selection event that are mandatory for the ME to set are: the Event list and Device identities.

question_28888.question: What is the format of the UEContextResumeResponse message in NGAP protocol?
question_28888.ground_truth: The UEContextResumeResponse message is a sequence consisting of protocolIEs, which is a ProtocolIE-Container object.

question_28891.question: What type is the attribute "ThreeGPAccept" and what is its legal value?
question_28891.ground_truth: The type of the attribute "ThreeGPAccept" is Literal (Bag) and its legal values are MIME types with parameters and the "Streaming-Media" identifier.

question_28892.question: What is the primary goal of step 3 in the test procedure?
question_28892.ground_truth: The primary goal of step 3 in the test procedure is for the UE to start sending L1-RSRP reports, which include results of both CSI-RS0 and CSI-RS1.

question_28893.question: What is the condition for supporting E-TFCj when the target E-DCH TTI for which E-TFC restriction is being considered does not belong to a compressed mode frame?
question_28893.ground_truth: If NRPMj is greater than or equal to the squared value of the quantized amplitude ratio of the E-DCH j, then E-TFCj can be supported.

question_28895.question: What is the purpose of the all-zero PGK Identity?
question_28895.ground_truth: The all-zero PGK Identity is used to signal special cases between the UE and ProSe Key Management Function and is never used to identify a PGK.

question_28896.question: How does a PLMN without Disaster Condition mitigate congestion due to the arrival of Disaster Inbound Roamers?
question_28896.ground_truth: Upon encountering congestion, a PLMN without Disaster Condition indicating that it can accommodate Disaster Inbound Roamers may perform one or more of the following: turn off the indication that the PLMN can accommodate Disaster Inbound Roamers, reject the Disaster Inbound Roamers' registration or service requests with a specific cause, or provide a list of PLMNs where disaster inbound roamers are not allowed. The UE shall not consider PLMNs where the 5GMM cause # YYY "disaster inbound roamers not allowed" was received as PLMN selection candidates.

question_28898.question: What is required for an SNPN to support QoS differentiation for UE-requested QoS when the 5QIs used by the PLMN are from the range of standardized 5QIs?
question_28898.ground_truth: The UE can request for an IPsec SA the same 5QI from the SNPN as the 5QI provided by the PLMN. The packet filters in the requested QoS rule can be based on the N3IWF IP address and the SPI associated with the IPsec SA.

question_28900.question: What is the role of TS 24.080 in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_28900.ground_truth: TS 24.080 specifies the formats and coding for the supplementary services in 3GPP.

question_28901.question: What should be the minimum number of PRS positioning occasions for the UE to report RSTD for the reference cell and all neighbor cells i, as specified in Section 8.1.2.6.1?
question_28901.ground_truth: The UE should be capable of reporting RSTD for the reference cell and all neighbor cells i out of at least (n-1) neighbor cells within at least PRS positioning occasions, as specified in Section 8.1.2.6.1.

question_28902.question: What is the condition for the test to pass in terms of the ratio of successful reported values and the confidence level?
question_28902.ground_truth: The ratio of successful reported values in each test should be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_28903.question: What is one requirement for one-to-many communication service in the IMS network?
question_28903.ground_truth: The IMS network shall provide a mechanism to support a single session with a large number of users (e.g. more than 10K) that can be in different communication modes, such as interactive or receive-only.

question_28904.question: Which functions are provided by the PHY-primitives exchanged between the physical layer and the data link layer?
question_28904.ground_truth: The PHY-primitives exchanged between the physical layer and the data link layer provide the transfer of transport blocks over the radio interface and indicate the status of the layer 1 to layer~2.

question_28907.question: What is the maximum number of MBSFN areas an MCPTT UE that uses MBSFN transmission should be able to support simultaneously on the same RF carrier?
question_28907.ground_truth: An MCPTT UE that uses MBSFN transmission should be able to support eight MBSFN areas simultaneously on the same RF carrier.

question_28910.question: What should the SGSN do if it receives an Information requested information element containing a 'not supported' value?
question_28910.ground_truth: The SGSN shall set the value part of the Mobile station state information element in the BSSAP+-MS-INFORMATION-RESPONSE message to 'Information requested not supported'.

question_28911.question: What is the focus of Solution #15 in 3GPP TR 23.758 Rel-17 for enabling the use of Service APIs in the Edge Enabler Layer?
question_28911.ground_truth: The focus of Solution #15 is to enable access to service APIs offered by Edge Application Servers (EASs) within and across the Edge Data Network, by providing CAPIF functions in a distributed or centralized manner.

question_28912.question: What is the recommended approach to prevent the UE from re-trying the process to re-establish connectivity via the WLAN access during a network overload condition?
question_28912.ground_truth: The recommendation is to use DDN throttling mechanisms to reduce the DDN traffic SGWs may originate towards an MME/S4-SGSN experiencing overload and also prioritize handover scenarios over the establishment of new PDN connections.

question_28913.question: What takes precedence in policy control, the PCC Rules installed in the SMF or the locally stored PCC Rules in the SMF?
question_28913.ground_truth: The installed PCC Rules in the SMF take precedence over the locally stored PCC Rules in the SMF.

question_28915.question: What action does the AF need to take to stop processing data related to UE(s) for which user consent has been revoked?
question_28915.ground_truth: At the reception of the user consent revocation notification from the NEF, the AF shall take the necessary actions to stop processing the data related to the UE(s) for which user consent was revoked.

question_28916.question: What information may be transferred from the Access System/Media Resource Function Controller (AS/MRFC) to the Diameter Freeway (DF2) in order to allow a DF2 to perform its functionality in IMS conference events?
question_28916.ground_truth: The target identity (IMPU, IMPI, Conference URI), events and associated parameters, correlation number, and bandwidth and media descriptions associated with the parties' bearer connection to the conference may be transferred from the AS/MRFC to the DF2.

question_28917.question: What is the specification that defines the encoding for the Flow Quality of Service (Flow QoS) in 3GPP networks?

question_28919.question: What information is included in the Reroute Command message sent by the new MME in step 4a, if dedicated core networks are supported and the new MME does not serve UEs of the UE Usage Type value contained in the Identification/Context Response message?
question_28919.ground_truth: The Reroute Command message sent by the new MME in step 4a includes the Attach/TAU Request message, MMEGI, GUTI, and GUMMEI.

question_28920.question: What is the function of the onboarding AUSF in the AMF/SEAF?
question_28920.ground_truth: The onboarding AUSF, selected by the AMF/SEAF, connects with the NSSAAF for onboarding based on the onboarding SUPI.

question_28921.question: What security mechanism is used to protect user plane traffic exchanged over the S2c tunnel in trusted non-3GPP accesses when enhanced security is activated?
question_28921.ground_truth: A child IPsec Security Association is used to provide integrity protection and/or confidentiality protection of user plane traffic exchanged over the S2c tunnel.

question_28922.question: What is the role of the RRC sublayer over the Uu interface in relation to NR and E-UTRA?
question_28922.ground_truth: The RRC sublayer over the Uu interface is responsible for providing services and functions related to AS and NAS, security, signalling and data bearers, mobility functions, QoS management, measurement reporting and control, radio link failure detection and recovery, and NAS message transfer between the UE and NG-RAN or 5GC.

question_28923.question: What is the maximum Base Station RF bandwidth that could be used in a smaller sub-block bandwidth as an exception for test case c)?
question_28923.ground_truth: The maximum possible equal frequency spacing (Deq) is the next lower multiple of 200 kHz in a smaller sub-block bandwidth.

question_28926.question: What information is carried in the port number and user plane node ID that is sent outside of the PMIC in the case of interfaces that correspond to network side interfaces of the UPF?
question_28926.ground_truth: The PMIC in this case includes the IP address, the subnet, and the neighbour information (list of neighbour IP addresses when available) in the port number and user plane node ID that is sent outside of the PMIC.

question_28928.question: What is the 3GPP system requirement for making authorized QoS modifications for an active MPS for DTS session?

question_28934.question: What action does the SGW take when it receives a GTPv2 Delete PDN Connection Set Request message from a PGW as the result of a partial failure in the PGW?
question_28934.ground_truth: The SGW shall retrieve all the PDN connections corresponding to each of the FQ-CSID(s) present in the message and shall delete all the retrieved PDN connections and the associated resources.

question_28937.question: What is the assumed NR-U operating bandwidth when the absence of Wi-Fi cannot be guaranteed in the band?
question_28937.ground_truth: The assumed NR-U operating bandwidth is an integer multiple of 20MHz when the absence of Wi-Fi cannot be guaranteed in the band.

question_28938.question: What steps should be taken by the SMF+PGW-C if the negotiation of support of URSP provisioning in EPS fails for the first PDN connection?
question_28938.ground_truth: The UE may retry the aforementioned procedure successively for the next PDN connectivity requests until it succeeds for one of them.

question_28939.question: What is the range of values for the "valueY-P-SP-CSI-RS-r18" parameter?
question_28939.ground_truth: The range of values for the "valueY-P-SP-CSI-RS-r18" parameter is from 1 to 3.

question_28940.question: What action must a functional entity take when forwarding a SIP request or response with a Resource-Priority header field outside the trust domain?
question_28940.ground_truth: If a functional entity forwards a SIP request or response with a Resource-Priority header field outside the trust domain, it must remove the header field.

question_28941.question: What is the maximum path loss difference between the lowest/highest frequencies per E-UTRA frequency band and corresponding simulation frequency in the E-UTRA system?
question_28941.ground_truth: The maximum path loss difference is less than 0.8 dB for the downlink and less than 1.5 dB for the uplink, except for bands 7, 11 and 38.

question_28942.question: What physical channel is used to carry higher layer control information and the Channel Quality Indicator (CQI) for HS-DSCH in the uplink direction?

question_28943.question: What should be coded in bits 5 to 8 of octet 6 if the MNC is 2 digits long, as specified in 3GPP TS 24.008 clause 10.5.1.4?
question_28943.ground_truth: Bits 5 to 8 of octet 6 should be coded as "1111" if the MNC is 2 digits long.

question_28946.question: What is the expected action of the MS if a DEACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message is received from the network while a MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message is still pending?
question_28946.ground_truth: The MS shall terminate internally the MS initiated PDP context modification procedure and proceed with the network initiated PDP context deactivation procedure by sending a DEACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT ACCEPT, entering the PDP-INACTIVE state.

question_28947.question: What is the long measurement period allowed for FR2 if certain conditions are met?
question_28947.ground_truth: A longer measurement period is allowed for FR2 when the aperiodic CSI-RS resource is measured for L1-RSRP measurement on any FR2 serving frequency in the same band, and the CSI-RS resource is outside the measurement gap and overlaps with specific symbols.

question_28951.question: What is the N4 Session Establishment procedure for T-UPF, if a new intermediate UPF (T-UPF) is selected by the SMF for the PDU Session?
question_28951.ground_truth: An N4 Session Establishment Request message is sent to the T-UPF, providing Packet detection, enforcement and reporting rules to be installed on the T-UPF. The CN Tunnel Info (on N9) of UPF (PSA) for this PDU Session is also provided to the T-UPF. Then, the T-UPF sends an N4 Session Establishment Response message to the SMF with DL CN Tunnel Info and UL CN Tunnel Info.

question_28955.question: How many PHICH are used per group in the NB-IoT test model?
question_28955.ground_truth: 2 PHICH are used per group in the NB-IoT test model.

question_28956.question: What is the purpose of the public key of the interconnection CA being securely stored in each SEG and TLS entity within the operator's domain?
question_28956.ground_truth: The public key of the interconnection CA is stored securely in each SEG and TLS entity within the operator's domain to allow the SEG and TLS entity to verify cross-certificates issued by its operator's Interconnection CA.

question_28957.question: How does centralized counting affect UE registration admission?
question_28957.ground_truth: With central count, admission is solely based on the central NSACF, even if local NFs are involved in the interaction. The central NSACF is able to determine when a UE with a stored state in it as being registered in one service area, has moved to a new service area, and does not perform an admission in this case.

question_28958.question: What is the applicability requirement for this test on E-UTRA UE releases 13 and onwards?
question_28958.ground_truth: Support for FDD, TDD, 2DL TDD-FDD CA with FDD as PCell and PUCCH transmission on SCell in CA, and FGI bit 25 is required.

question_28960.question: What should eNB1 do with the values in the Failure cell PCI IE, Re-establishment cell ECGI IE, C-RNTI IE and ShortMAC-I IE, if the RRC Conn Setup Indicator IE is present in the RLF INDICATION message?
question_28960.ground_truth: eNB1 should ignore the values in these IEs if the RRC Conn Setup Indicator IE is present in the RLF INDICATION message.

question_28961.question: When does the ProSe Function in HPLMN of the monitoring UE send a Match Report Info message to the ProSe Function in the PLMN indicated by the Monitored PLMN ID?
question_28961.ground_truth: The ProSe Function in HPLMN of the monitoring UE sends a Match Report Info message to the ProSe Function in the PLMN indicated by the Monitored PLMN ID if the Monitored PLMN ID is different from that of the Target PDUID, i.e. the "announcing UE" is roaming or performs inter-PLMN discovery transmission.

question_28962.question: What is the purpose of the evaluation period in DRX as defined in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 7.6.2 and A.7.3.7?
question_28962.ground_truth: The evaluation period in DRX is used for monitoring downlink radio link quality of the serving cell when DRX is used, as per 3GPP TS 36.133 section 7.6.

question_28964.question: What are the initial conditions for the method of test to verify phase E of the facsimile transmission?
question_28964.ground_truth: The initial conditions for the test are that the activity progress of the fax call is brought to the beginning of Phase E.

question_28965.question: What is the impact of an overloaded Offline Charging System (OFCS) on charging interfaces based on the Rf protocol?
question_28965.ground_truth: When the OFCS is overloaded, Diameter messages may be discarded, resulting in inaccurate data used for billing and loss of revenue for services delivered. Procedures should be defined to handle the overload condition.

question_28966.question: What should the MCPTT client do when it has established an MCPTT private call in off-network environment and the MCPTT User engages in communication with the inviting MCPTT User, as specified in TS 24.379, clause 11.2.2.4.3.5?
question_28966.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should respect the floor control procedures in off-network environment imposed by the Client having the floor.

question_28967.question: In what frequency range is the OBUE mask shape in the out-of-band domain based on the IMT characteristics submitted to the ITU-R during the initial work on NR, if the operations are above 24.25 GHz?
question_28967.ground_truth: The OBUE mask shape for frequencies above 24.25 GHz is based on the IMT characteristics submitted to the ITU-R during the initial work on NR, with an additional step defined in the Category B mask for emissions above 24.25 GHz.

question_28969.question: What is the purpose of defining specific terms, symbols, and abbreviations in the report?
question_28969.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure a consistent understanding of terms, symbols, and abbreviations used in the report.

question_28972.question: What are the benefits of the Customized Alerting Haptic Service when the called party has the priority?
question_28972.ground_truth: The called party can express their individual character by sending the haptic feedback to the calling party, and the calling party can notice the exact moment when the call connection is made to the called party.

question_28973.question: What should the UE do if it has at least one active PDU session associated with non-3GPP access and intends to transfer it to EPS?
question_28973.ground_truth: The UE should initiate an EPS attach procedure and include a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message with a request type in the ATTACH REQUEST message to activate a default EPS bearer context for the active PDU session which the UE intends to transfer to EPS.

question_28975.question: What is the maximum backoff time for the NCR-MT when receiving no Random Access Response?
question_28975.ground_truth: The NCR-MT shall transmit the msg3 if the Random Access Response is not received within the RA Response window, which is determined by the value of backoff time in clause 5.1.4 of TS 38.321.

question_28976.question: How does a NF obtain permission to consume services of a NF Service Producer?
question_28976.ground_truth: A NF Service Consumer sends an authorization request to the NRF (OAuth 2.0 authorization server), which will then supply access tokens to authorize the NF Service Consumer for gaining access to a service from a NF Service Producer.

question_28978.question: What is the role of the ROHC-Request AVP in the modification of an MBMS bearer?
question_28978.ground_truth: If the ROHC feature is supported, the GCS AS may include the ROHC-Request AVP together with the ROHC-Max-CID AVP when modifying an MBMS bearer.

question_28980.question: Which information should the 200 OK response include in step 4a of EPS to 5GS handover preparation for successful handover of EPS bearer contexts to 5GS?
question_28980.ground_truth: The 200 OK response should include the epsBearerSetup IE(s) with the list of EPS bearer contexts that were successfully handed over to 5GS, along with DL data forwarding information, which contains either CN tunnel information or NG-RAN F-TEID per E-RAB accepted for direct data forwarding.

question_28981.question: What should the UE do with the received list of service route values in the 200 (OK) response to the REGISTER request?
question_28981.ground_truth: The UE should store the list of service route values and bind it to the contact address or to the registration flow and the associated contact address.

question_28982.question: What would be the range of 'Xccs4, Xccs5, Xccs6, Xccs7' in the simplified HS-SCCH type 1?
question_28982.ground_truth: They would be set to a range of values from 0000-1110, indicating an offset range of 0 to 14 (15 usable code positions in total).

question_28983.question: What are the four cases in which an MRFC recognizes that an MRFP is unavailable?
question_28983.ground_truth: The four cases are: 1) the signalling connection is unavailable, 2) the MRFP indicates a failure condition to all connected MRFCs, 3) the MRFP is not functioning correctly, and 4) the MRFP indicates the maintenance locking condition to all concerned MRFCs.

question_28984.question: How many bits are used for frequency domain resource allocation if the subcarrier spacing for the active UL bandwidth part is 15 kHz?

question_28985.question: What does the "Transport Layer Address" IE represent in the F1 transport layer?
question_28985.ground_truth: The "Transport Layer Address" IE is an IP address used for the F1 user plane transport between gNB-CU and gNB-DU.

question_28986.question: What is the maximum accepted test system uncertainty for EIRP accuracy measurements in the frequency range up to 4.2 GHz?
question_28986.ground_truth: The maximum accepted test system uncertainty for EIRP accuracy measurements in the frequency range up to 4.2 GHz is 1.1 dB.

question_28987.question: What does the CC-POI in NEF stand for in 5.4.3.3.2.3?
question_28987.ground_truth: The CC-POI in NEF stands for the Control-Plane Connection Point in NEF in 5.4.3.3.2.3.

question_28988.question: What is the function of the permitted-server-NWDAF list in the authorization process?
question_28988.ground_truth: The permitted-server-NWDAF list is a list of authorized server NWDAFs that are allowed to serve as a client NWDAF for a specific Analytics ID. This list is registered to NRF by each NWDAF.

question_28990.question: What does "maxCellinengNB" represent in the "CellToReport-NR-ENDC-List"?
question_28990.ground_truth: "maxCellinengNB" represents the maximum number of cells in an EN-DC network.

question_28991.question: What is one of the service flows described in the changing UAV controller use case in the 3GPP system?
question_28991.ground_truth: When a UAV flies beyond the line of sight, the UAV controller requests a remote UAV controller to take over the UAV to continue the flight task, and the UTM authorizes the new UAV controller to control the UAV.

question_28992.question: What is the function of the IOC (Information Object Class) in TS 28.681 of the 3GPP 3rd Generation Partnership Project?
question_28992.ground_truth: The IOC (Information Object Class) in TS 28.681 of the 3GPP 3rd Generation Partnership Project outlines requirements for the Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN) Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP).

question_28995.question: What is the role of the User Equipment (UE) in the described solution?
question_28995.ground_truth: The User Equipment (UE) invokes an application running on an Edge Application Server (EAS) and provides addressing information to reach a UE, such as the IP address and N6 tunnelling information.

question_28996.question: Which protocol extension shall be present if the Target ID IE contains a RNC-ID IE or eNB-ID?
question_28996.ground_truth: The "id-Source-ToTarget-TransparentContainer" IE shall be present if the Target ID IE contains a RNC-ID IE or eNB-ID.

question_28997.question: What is the difference between "antenna gain" and "directivity"?
question_28997.ground_truth: "Antenna gain" is the ratio of the radiation intensity in a given direction to the radiation intensity that would be obtained if the power accepted by the antenna were radiated isotropically. On the other hand, "directivity" is the ratio of the radiation intensity in a given direction from the antenna to the radiation intensity averaged over all directions.

question_28998.question: What is an MC service group member in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_28998.ground_truth: An MC service group member is a user whose MC service ID is listed in a particular MC service group.

question_28999.question: How are frequency offsets considered in link evaluations for external interferers in the MUROS study?
question_28999.ground_truth: Normal distributions are used to model frequency offsets for low-band (850/900 MHz) and high-band (1800/1900 MHz) frequencies for external interferers on the downlink.

question_29000.question: What action does a GPRS-attached MS take when making an IMSI attach if it is in network operation mode~II and has a valid P-TMSI?
question_29000.ground_truth: The GPRS-attached MS identifies itself with a Foreign TLLI or a Random TLLI if a valid P-TMSI is not available.

question_29001.question: When a user originates a request for a VAL service group communication session in an area where pre-established MBMS bearers are to be used, what should the VAL server include in the HTTP POST request message?
question_29001.ground_truth: The VAL server should include a Request-URI set to the URI corresponding to the identity of the SNRM-S, a Content-Type header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.seal-mbms-usage-info+xml", and an application/vnd.3gpp.seal-mbms-usage-info+xml MIME body with a <request> element in the <mbms-info> root element.

question_29002.question: What are the conditions for which a UE can be provided one or more G-RNTIs or G-CS-RNTI per serving cell for scrambling the CRC of multicast DCI formats for scheduling PDSCH receptions?
question_29002.ground_truth: A UE can be provided one or more G-RNTIs or G-CS-RNTI per serving cell for scrambling the CRC of multicast DCI formats for scheduling PDSCH receptions in the presence of a C-RNTI, Temporary C-RNTI, CS-RNTI, G-CS-RNTI or G-RNTI for multicast MTCH. The UE can be provided one or more G-RNTIs or G-CS-RNTI per serving cell for scrambling the CRC of multicast DCI formats providing activation/release/scheduling retransmission for SPS PDSCH receptions.

question_29003.question: What procedure does the PCRF use to remove any active QoS rules referring to the Home Address in the BBERF when disconnecting from a PDN?
question_29003.ground_truth: The Gateway Control and QoS Rules Provision procedure is used, where the PCRF removes any active QoS rules referring to the Home Address in the BBERF.

question_29004.question: What is the procedure when an RNC receives an ANR report over Uu containing IRAT neighbour cells, and it is also the Base RNC?
question_29004.ground_truth: The RNC retrieves the necessary information for neighbour IRAT cells from O&M and/or the information of the ANR logs and determines if any of these IRAT neighbour cells are potential neighbour cells. In addition, the Base RNC may interact with O&M before the neighbour relation is stored in the NRT.

question_29006.question: What is the purpose of power backoff in E-TFC selection for uplink SI transmitted with data payload in E-DPDCH?
question_29006.ground_truth: The purpose of power backoff in E-TFC selection for uplink SI transmitted with data payload in E-DPDCH is to avoid boosting E-DPDCH power due to relatively high data rate, which would result in high overall transmit power.

question_29008.question: What are the functional requirements for energy efficiency in 3GPP standards?
question_29008.ground_truth: The functional requirements include minimizing the impact of energy efficiency control on system capacity and performance, distributed or centralized energy efficiency control operations, energy efficiency control based on operators' policy, network capability, spatial resolution, network load, traffic density, connection density, and services/applications types, and minimizing extra complexity and signalling.

question_29010.question: What is the response of a candidate WT to an Xw SETUP REQUEST message from an eNB in the XwAP protocol?
question_29010.ground_truth: The candidate WT responds to an Xw SETUP REQUEST message from an eNB in the XwAP protocol with the Xw SETUP RESPONSE message, and includes a list of relevant WLAN identifiers.

question_29011.question: What is the AVP code for Subsession-Decision-Info AVP and Subsession-Enforcement-Info AVP?
question_29011.ground_truth: Subsession-Decision-Info AVP has an AVP code 2204 and Subsession-Enforcement-Info AVP has an AVP code 2201.

question_29012.question: What is required to provide user identity confidentiality in 3GPP networks?
question_29012.ground_truth: A mechanism should be specified to provide user identity confidentiality by means of a temporary identity.

question_29013.question: In what state does the UE delete 5G-GUTI, TAI list, last visited registered TAI, list of equivalent PLMNs, ngKSI, and consider the USIM as invalid for 5GS services when receiving a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message with "re-registration not required" and 5GMM cause value set to #7?

question_29014.question: What is the role of the Internet Protocol (IP) multimedia call control protocol based on Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) and Session Description Protocol (SDP) in this specification?
question_29014.ground_truth: The Internet Protocol (IP) multimedia call control protocol based on Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) and Session Description Protocol (SDP) is the protocol used for multimedia communication in this specification.

question_29015.question: What is the role of Company-A SML in the use case?
question_29015.ground_truth: Company-A SML is responsible for managing the services that support the products offered by Company-A. It determines which services support the exposed MnS being requested by the NSC, and consumes exposed MnS from other companies directly via its SML.

question_29016.question: What is the bearer type for the channel established in TERMINAL RESPONSE: OPEN CHANNEL 6.2.1A?
question_29016.ground_truth: The bearer type is E-UTRAN / mapped UTRAN packet service.

question_29017.question: What is the issue that solution #53 aims to address?

question_29019.question: What message does the UE send to the Target HNB when it updates its cell?

question_29021.question: What is the principle for specifying the procedure logic in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_29021.ground_truth: The principle is to specify the functional behavior of the MCE exactly and completely, while leaving the EPC functional behavior unspecified.

question_29022.question: What is the purpose of the "Codec Type" field in the "Speech Codec List" Information Element?
question_29022.ground_truth: The "Codec Type" field in the "Speech Codec List" Information Element specifies the Codec Type for the radio interface. It may contain a certain 3GPP Speech Codec Type directly or it may contain the so-called "Codec Extension" for more than 16 different Codec Types in future.

question_29023.question: What should the UE do when it receives the rejected NSSAI in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message with the back-off timer value zero?
question_29023.ground_truth: The UE should not consider the S-NSSAI as the rejected S-NSSAI.

question_29026.question: What is the measurement name for the number of RRC connection re-establishment attempts?
question_29026.ground_truth: The measurement name has the form RRC.ReEstabAtt.

question_29027.question: What should the UE do if it receives a NOTIFICATION message with a reserved EPS bearer identity value or an assigned value that does not match an existing EPS bearer context?
question_29027.ground_truth: The UE should respond with an ESM STATUS message, including ESM cause #43 "invalid EPS bearer identity".

question_29028.question: What are the two types of UE-to-Network Relay Discovery supported in the PC5-D protocol stack for Public Safety use?
question_29028.ground_truth: Model A (using a single discovery protocol message - Announcement) and Model B (using two discovery protocol messages - Solicitation and Response).

question_29029.question: What are the exceptions in NAS over non-3GPP access in 5G systems?
question_29029.ground_truth: The exceptions in NAS over non-3GPP access in 5G systems include mobility management over non-3GPP access, user plane connections over non-3GPP access, and session management over non-3GPP access.

question_29030.question: What is the purpose of grouping service features into Transparent Data blobs in the HSS?
question_29030.ground_truth: The purpose is for simpler storage and retrieval. The blobs are identified by Service Indication names and can contain a complete service suite definition or a portion of it.

question_29031.question: What is the role of the MCPTT server when a group call is initiated by an LMR user over an interworking group defined in the MCPTT system?
question_29031.ground_truth: The MCPTT server is responsible for resolving the group ID, calling the group members from the MCPTT system, and managing the floor control if requested.

question_29032.question: On receiving a 200 (OK) response to a REGISTER request, what should the UE store the expiration time of the registration for the public user identities found in the To header field value?
question_29032.ground_truth: The UE should store the expiration time of the registration for the public user identities found in the To header field value and bind it to the respective contact address of the UE or to the registration flow and the associated contact address.

question_29033.question: In the backhaul RLF recovery procedure for an IAB-node in SA mode, what does the IAB-MT undergoing RLF recovery send to the new parent IAB-DU?
question_29033.ground_truth: The IAB-MT undergoing RLF recovery sends an RRCReestablishmentRequest message to the new parent IAB-DU in the backhaul RLF recovery procedure for an IAB-node in SA mode.

question_29034.question: What should a UE do if the network decides not to trigger fallback to EPS during a PDU session modification procedure?
question_29034.ground_truth: The UE should continue with the ongoing procedure in 5GS.

question_29035.question: What are the two interfaces of the Data Session Control SCF?
question_29035.ground_truth: The Data Session manager and the Data Session

question_29036.question: What should the SS do if it observes more than 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes during subframes (m+5) to (m+13) for inter-band CA UE during SCell hibernation?
question_29036.ground_truth: If the SS observes more than 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes during subframes (m+5) to (m+13) for inter-band CA UE during SCell hibernation, it counts a fail for the event "Hibernation1".

question_29037.question: What is the recommended action when a certain condition is met, based on the usage of "shall" in the document?
question_29037.ground_truth: When "shall" is used, it indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

question_29038.question: What is the difference between B-ISDN Point-to-Point Connection Service feature (BI-PPC) and B-ISDN Multi-Casting (BI-MCAST)?
question_29038.ground_truth: BI-PPC sets up a point-to-point connection between two parties, while BI-MCAST sets up multiple point-to-multipoint unidirectional connections among multiple parties.

question_29040.question: What is the consequence if two or more packet filters in a new request have identical packet filter identifiers in the same TFT?
question_29040.ground_truth: The network will reject the modification request with cause "syntactical errors in packet filter(s)".

question_29042.question: What is the role of the MME in the procedure when a warning message is sent?
question_29042.ground_truth: The MME aggregates the Warning Status Lists received from the eNodeBs and forwards them to the CBC.

question_29043.question: What is the purpose of ensuring that the UE authenticates itself using GBA or Digest when the UE activates Barring of Outgoing International Calls when roaming (OCB intl roam)?
question_29043.ground_truth: The purpose is to check if the UE can properly authenticate itself during the OCB intl roam activation process.

question_29045.question: What does the Event Type field identify in the context of Change-over operation?
question_29045.ground_truth: The Event Type field identifies the type of failure (communication, quality of service, processing, equipment, environment) in the context of Change-over operation.

question_29047.question: When is the total power dynamic range requirement derived in the 7 to 24 GHz sub-range?
question_29047.ground_truth: Once the set of supported channel bandwidths and the set of SCS is agreed for the 7 to 24 GHz sub-range, the derivation of the total power dynamic range requirement will be straightforward.

question_29048.question: What should the UE do if it receives a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message with the 5GSM cause value #69 and the ABO bit set to "The back-off timer is applied in all PLMNs or all SNPNs"?
question_29048.ground_truth: The UE should apply the timer T3585 for all the PLMNs or all the equivalent SNPNs.

question_29049.question: What are the drawbacks of alternative 2 in handling load information in 3GPP Release 12?
