question_29049.ground_truth: Alternative 2 has some implementation complexity for the sender, as the sender has to manage the identifier for each of the scope separately and ensure that the total number of different instances sent across various messages does not exceed the maximum number of instances limit at the node level.

question_29050.question: What is the lowest measurement limit for the level of output RF spectrum due to 8PSK modulation?
question_29050.ground_truth: The lowest measurement limit for the level of output RF spectrum due to 8PSK modulation is -36 dBm below 600 kHz offset from the carrier, -51 dBm for GSM 400, GSM 700, GSM 850 and GSM 900 or -56 dBm for DCS 1800 and PCS 1900 from 600 kHz out to less than 1800 kHz offset from the carrier, and -46 dBm for GSM 400, GSM 700, GSM 850 and GSM 900 or -51 dBm for DCS 1800 and PCS 1900 at and beyond 1800 kHz offset from the carrier.

question_29051.question: What is the level of the signaling tones used in the test of the AMR-WB codec's performance with signaling tones?
question_29051.ground_truth: The level of the signaling tones used in the test of the AMR-WB codec's performance with signaling tones was -10 dBm0.

question_29052.question: How does the "reference index" based SHVC architecture benefit the EL codec?
question_29052.ground_truth: The "reference index" based SHVC architecture allows the EL codec to maintain the same block level logics as a single-layer HEVC decoder, differing only at the high-level syntax level. This results in a more efficient inter-layer prediction process and reduces complexity.

question_29055.question: What is the purpose of the parametric stereo encoder in the 3GPP system's general audio service using the aacPlus general audio codec?
question_29055.ground_truth: The parametric stereo encoder is used to capture the stereo image into a limited number of parameters, enabling the regeneration of the stereo signal at the decoder side while requiring only a small overhead of a few kbit/s. This tool is used as a non-modifying analyzer prior to the aacPlus encoder.

question_29057.question: What is the condition for Bands 2 and 12 BS transmitters to share the same antenna with Band 22, 41, or 42 BS receivers?
question_29057.ground_truth: The antenna path meets very stringent 2nd and 3rd order PIM specification.

question_29058.question: What is the requirement for the DTX observation by the SS in the subframes (n+5) to (n+9) and (n+13) for intra-band PCell and SCells?
question_29058.ground_truth: DTX should not be observed by the SS outside these subframes for a successful "Deactivation" event.

question_29059.question: What should the expiration time be set to if the MCData group information entry is not deaffiliated, but its expiration time has expired yet?
question_29059.ground_truth: The expiration time should not be set to a value in the future if the MCData group information entry is already deaffiliated.

question_29061.question: What should the gNB-DU do if the Duplication Indication IE is contained in the SRB To Be Setup List IE and the value is set to be "true"?
question_29061.ground_truth: The gNB-DU should setup two RLC entities for the indicated SRB.

question_29062.question: What should be the corresponding RAT information for V2X operation authorization information during handover procedure?
question_29062.ground_truth: The corresponding RAT information for V2X operation authorization information should be part of the V2X operation authorization information and transferred from source eNB to target eNB in S1-AP/X2-AP Handover Request message during handover procedure and from MME to eNB in initial S1-AP message during Attach, TAU and Service Request procedures.

question_29063.question: Which radio solutions is RAN4 required to specify for NR to support advanced V2X services (except the remote driving use case)?
question_29063.ground_truth: RAN4 is required to specify NR sidelink solutions necessary to support sidelink unicast, sidelink groupcast, and sidelink broadcast for V2X services.

question_29064.question: What action does the H-PCF take if a UE Policy Container is received during initial registration?
question_29064.ground_truth: The H-PCF stores certain information from the UE Policy Container in the UDR.

question_29065.question: What is the purpose of verifying that the UE is able to use the IMS security procedures for the IMS emergency registration in clause 5.1.6.1 of TS 24.229?
question_29065.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure that the UE is capable of applying the security measures defined for IMS AKA and IPSec within 3GPP TS 24.229 during the IMS emergency registration process.

question_29066.question: What are the two methods of operation for V.44 data compression in SNDCP?
question_29066.ground_truth: The two methods of operation for V.44 data compression in SNDCP are Packet Method and Multi-Packet Method.

question_29068.question: In the context of TS 28.545, what does the term "MnS" stand for?
question_29068.ground_truth: In the context of TS 28.545, "MnS" stands for Management Service.

question_29069.question: What should the P-CSCF do when it receives a REGISTER request without a security association set up?
question_29069.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should be prepared to receive the initial REGISTER requests on the SIP default port values specified in RFC 3261 and on the port advertised to the UE during the P-CSCF discovery procedure.

question_29071.question: When is a UE not required to monitor a PDCCH candidate for a Type0-PDCCH CSS set?
question_29071.ground_truth: A UE is not required to monitor a PDCCH candidate for a Type0-PDCCH CSS set if it does not monitor PDCCH candidates in the Type0-PDCCH CSS set and at least one RE for a PDCCH candidate overlaps with at least one RE of a candidate SS/PBCH block corresponding to a SS/PBCH block index provided by NonCellDefiningSSB.

question_29073.question: What are the responsibilities of the control plane function in Solution 2 of F-TEID allocation?
question_29073.ground_truth: In Solution 2 of F-TEID allocation, the control plane function allocates a TEID and maintains blade level information, while the user plane function is notified by the CP function of the availability/unavailability of a blade.

question_29074.question: Which two packages of spectrum are assigned in Germany's 3400-3600 MHz band for broadband wireless access systems?

question_29075.question: What is the maximum BS power for NB-IoT when it is deployed in the lowest 1 MHz of the band 12 extended?
question_29075.ground_truth: When NB-IoT is deployed in the lowest 1 MHz paired spectrum, specifically 698-699 MHz uplink and 728-729 MHz downlink, the maximum BS power is 43 dBm shared among the NB-IoT carriers.

question_29076.question: What is the role of Parlay X in the present document?
question_29076.ground_truth: Parlay X is a joint effort between 3GPP TSG CT WG5, ETSI TISPAN and The Parlay Group to define the Message Broadcast Web Service for 3GPP OSA.

question_29077.question: What should a UE consider equal if it belongs to a forbidden tracking area for roaming or regional provision of service?
question_29077.ground_truth: The UE shall consider each of these TAIs equal if it belongs to a forbidden tracking area for roaming or regional provision of service.

question_29080.question: What is the objective of the feasibility study on Single Antenna Interference Cancellation (SAIC) for GSM networks, as defined in the 3GPP work item?
question_29080.ground_truth: The objective of the feasibility study is to determine the potential of SAIC in typical network layouts, including the feasibility of SAIC for GMSK and 8PSK scenarios under synchronized and non-synchronized network conditions, and the robustness against different training sequences.

question_29081.question: Which video coding method is used in the setup that reduces the overall required transmission cost of a service?
question_29081.ground_truth: Scalable Video Coding (SVC) and Single MCS AVC transmission are used.

question_29082.question: Which UE Context Setup Response IE has a mandatory presence and is in GNB-CU-UE-F1AP-ID criticality reject?

question_29086.question: When does the UE not verify the integrity protection of the NAS Redirection message?
question_29086.ground_truth: The UE does not verify the integrity protection of the NAS Redirection message when a specific 5GMM cause indicates that the NAS security is not activated and it is one of the abnormal cases, such as a roaming case with no roaming agreement.

question_29087.question: What mechanisms are provided for SGSN to handle overload in GERAN/UTRAN MSs that access the network with low access priority?
question_29087.ground_truth: SGSN can initiate rejection of RR(C) connection establishment in the GERAN/UTRAN MSs that access the network with low access priority. In addition, SGSN signalling or GERAN/UTRAN O&M can trigger GERAN/UTRAN to initiate Extended Access Barring in the GERAN /UTRAN.

question_29088.question: How does the FL Server NWDAF determine whether to reselect FL Client NWDAF(s) for the next round(s) of federated learning?
question_29088.ground_truth: The FL Server NWDAF checks the FL Client NWDAF(s) status based on the received information and determines whether reselection is needed based on factors like the difference between the updated status and initial criteria, the characteristics of local training and global validation datasets, the accuracy of the global and local models, and the load and response time of the FL Client NWDAF(s).

question_29089.question: What effect does the use of SFN frequency hopping have on the performance of lower coding rates such as MCS5 and MCS6?
question_29089.ground_truth: The use of SFN frequency hopping results in a loss of performance for lower coding rates such as MCS5 and MCS6.

question_29090.question: How does the NRF receive UPF information from a UPF instance?
question_29090.ground_truth: The NRF receives UPF information from a UPF instance through the Nnrf_NFManagement_NFRegister Request operation.

question_29092.question: What is the maximum number of transport blocks that can have not more than 1 transport block lost out of 3?

question_29093.question: What happens when the UE SDAP entity detects a PDR match for the UE in the 5G System?
question_29093.ground_truth: The UE SDAP entity encapsulates the downlink IP packet into an N3 packet and sets the QFI value in the N3 packet header, which is sent to the RAN and marked with the QFI value in the SDAP layer before sending to the UE.

question_29094.question: What should be the MS response be for an XID request from the SS when the MS does not support compression?
question_29094.ground_truth: The MS responds with applicable NSAPI field with 0 for an XID request from the SS with some compression entity.

question_29096.question: What should a UE do if the authentication fails during an Attach procedure while attempting to set up an IMS Emergency Session?
question_29096.ground_truth: The UE should retry by sending an Attach request for EPS emergency bearer services.

question_29097.question: What does the network congestion information include?
question_29097.ground_truth: The network congestion information includes QoS Notification Control information (for GBR QoS Flow) and network congestion level/indication (for non-GBR QoS Flow).

question_29098.question: What is the type of ID-SLDRBs-FailedToBeSetup-ItemIEs?

question_29099.question: What should the AAS BS maximum EIRP remain within when steering a beam within the maximum EIRP directions set?
question_29099.ground_truth: The AAS BS maximum EIRP should remain within +2.2 dB and -2.2 dB of the claimed value when steering a beam within the maximum EIRP directions set.

question_29100.question: What is the maximum time allowed for acquiring system information from an E-UTRAN cell?
question_29100.ground_truth: The maximum time allowed for acquiring system information from an E-UTRAN cell is 1280 milliseconds.

question_29101.question: What is the purpose of NR handover with PSCell?
question_29101.ground_truth: The purpose of NR handover with PSCell is to change the NR PCell to another NR cell or E-UTRA cell and add or change the PSCell along with PCell handover. This applies to specific handover scenarios such as handover with PSCell from NR SA to EN-DC, NR-DC to NR-DC, and NE-DC to NE-DC.

question_29102.question: What communication standard is used in the example to connect a device with a cellar module to a target server via cellular connectivity?
question_29102.ground_truth: The DLMS/COSEM standard from the IEC 62056-21 international standard is used in the example.

question_29103.question: What is the MIME type used for the session resource information that is sent in the content body of the HTTP POST message?
question_29103.ground_truth: The MIME type used for the session resource information that is sent in the content body of the HTTP POST message is JSON.

question_29105.question: In a private call without floor control, what procedures must be followed by the IWF performing the participating role when originating the call?
question_29105.ground_truth: The IWF performing the participating role must follow the procedures as specified in clause 11.1.2.1.1 for an on-demand session, but with an SDP offer not including a media-level section for media-floor control entity.

question_29106.question: What happens during a File System Call Unsuccessful error?
question_29106.ground_truth: The system is unable to complete a requested operation on the file system due to some errors.

question_29108.question: What is the purpose of introducing BCS4 and BCS5 in NR band combination for reducing workload in RAN4?
question_29108.ground_truth: The purpose is to reduce the workload in RAN4 when operators request new NR CA and SUL band combinations with new channel bandwidths added to existing bands in the band combinations. This allows operators to use new channel bandwidths in NR CA and SUL without having to create new Bandwidth Combinations Sets for existing band combinations.

question_29110.question: What action does the SRNC take when it receives a PCAP Position Activation Request message for periodic UE positioning measurement reporting and the UE or SRNC terminates the measurement reporting procedure?
question_29110.ground_truth: The SRNC sends a PCAP Position Periodic Termination message to the SAS indicating the cause of termination.

question_29111.question: What is the overall average of all measured transmission times in the eCall modem test?
question_29111.ground_truth: The overall average of all measured transmission times in the eCall modem test is 2.03 seconds.

question_29113.question: What is the main aspect studied in the first point of the Inter-PLMN Gy Reference Point study?
question_29113.ground_truth: The main aspect studied is determining the set of information needed to be available on both sides (HPLMN and VPLMN).

question_29114.question: How many times should the Mobile Station attempt to re-establish the TCP connection after receiving a TCP Reset?
question_29114.ground_truth: The MS shall attempt to re-establish TCP connection once.

question_29115.question: What is the post-condition for the end of a DTS session?
question_29115.ground_truth: Upon end of the DTS session, the enterprise network and UEs return to normal conditions (i.e., use of normal data service).

question_29116.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a 5GSM STATUS message with cause #43 invalid PDU session identity?
question_29116.ground_truth: The UE shall abort any ongoing 5GSM procedure related to the PTI or PDU session ID, stop any related timer and locally release the PDU session indicated in the 5GSM STATUS message if the SMF receives a 5GSM STATUS message with cause #43 invalid PDU session identity.

question_29117.question: How does an MCVideo server determine the affiliated group members to invite to a group session?
question_29117.ground_truth: The MCVideo server determines the affiliated members from the entries contained in the "list" element of the group document after the group session initiation rules have been satisfied.

question_29118.question: What is the requirement for the TDD Intra Frequency Absolute RSRQ Accuracy test to pass?
question_29118.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values in each test shall be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_29119.question: What information should be included in all xIRIs?
question_29119.ground_truth: All xIRIs should include the target identity and a time stamp.

question_29120.question: In what scenario should the MME include the TAIs in the Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming" IE?
question_29120.ground_truth: When all of the TAIs received from the satellite E-UTRAN are forbidden for roaming or for regional provision of service.

question_29121.question: What should be the level of the RF input signal when measuring the spurious emissions of a repeater?
question_29121.ground_truth: The RF input signal should be set to a level that will result in the maximum rated output power per channel when measured.

question_29122.question: What should the MS do if it receives a GA-PSR-DEACTIVATE-UTC-REQ message from the GANC to deactivate the GA-PSR TC channel and request to release the GA-PSR TC?
question_29122.ground_truth: The MS should stop TU4001 timer and release the GA-PSR TC, transitioning the MS GA-PSR to the GA-PSR-STANDBY state.

question_29123.question: When can the MC service server stop the unicast delivery for the established group communication?
question_29123.ground_truth: The MC service server can stop the unicast delivery towards the MC service clients when considering the UE session join notification or the MBS listening status report.

question_29124.question: What is the reason for the missing direct test frequency point for IMD3 MSD definition?
question_29124.ground_truth: There is no direct test frequency point for IMD3 MSD definition because of the range of IMD3 and the frequency band n26.

question_29126.question: What is the purpose of the new IE "UE radio access 7.68 Mcps TDD capability update requirement"?
question_29126.ground_truth: The purpose of this new IE is to indicate the UE's capability for 7.68 Mcps TDD mode in the radio access, and account for the differences in signalling between 7.68 Mcps TDD and 3.84 Mcps TDD.

question_29127.question: What information does the Node B include in the Semi-Persistent scheduling Capability LCR IE for semi-persistent scheduling capable local cells when operating at 1.28Mcps TDD?
question_29127.ground_truth: The Node B includes the Semi-Persistent scheduling Capability LCR IE set to "Semi-Persistent scheduling Capable" to indicate that the local cell is capable of supporting semi-persistent scheduling.

question_29128.question: What is the function of the AF in TS~23.502 in the context of this specification?
question_29128.ground_truth: The AF in TS~23.502 is considered as the ProSe Application Server in this specification.

question_29129.question: What are the main components of a bulk CM XML file format as defined in the present document?
question_29129.ground_truth: The main components of a bulk CM XML file format are XML, XML Schema, XML Namespace, XML complex type, and XML element type.

question_29130.question: What is the first step in the Gateway Control Session Termination initiated by the GW (BBERF)?
question_29130.ground_truth: The GW (BBERF) sends a Gateway Control Session Termination towards the H-PCRF or V-PCRF (if deployed in a visited network).

question_29131.question: What is the required TX-RX isolation for the duplexer to minimize TX out-of-band emissions (OOBE) into the receive chain and overload of the RX chain by the fundamental TX signals?
question_29131.ground_truth: The required TX-RX isolation is 50 dB for overload mitigation and 55 dB for OOBE mitigation.

question_29132.question: What is the minimum time interval between attempts to decode the BSIC of a GSM BCCH carrier during initial BSIC identification?
question_29132.ground_truth: The minimum time interval between attempts to decode the BSIC of a GSM BCCH carrier during initial BSIC identification is 1 ms.

question_29133.question: What is the purpose of sending the ciphering and integrity algorithms from the source cell to the target gNB/ng-eNB in the handover request message?
question_29133.ground_truth: It allows the target gNB/ng-eNB to decipher and verify the integrity of the RRC Reestablishment Complete message on SRB1 in the potential RRC Connection Re-establishment procedure, and to decide if it is necessary to include a new selection of security algorithms in the Handover Command message.

question_29134.question: What should the AMF indicate in the Rejected S-NSSAI information element to allow the use of the Rejected S-NSSAI in another TA?
question_29134.ground_truth: The AMF should provide an exception indication that the Rejected S-NSSAI is TA granularity so that it is allowed to use the Rejected S-NSSAI in another TA.

question_29135.question: What is the recommendation for the pn sequence used for the CSS signal in the delay calculation with the speech signal in the send direction?
question_29135.ground_truth: It is recommended to use a pn sequence of 32 k samples with a 48 kHz sampling rate.

question_29136.question: What is the purpose of the Uplink Acknowledgement message in the NB-CIoT solution?
question_29136.ground_truth: The Uplink Acknowledgement message is used in the NB-CIoT solution to indicate a positive or negative acknowledgment of the last transmitted data block, signaling whether the network will provide a new uplink allocation for the MS to retransmit the un-acknowledged data or enter RPR mode.

question_29138.question: Which MMS CDRs are specified for MMS VAS applications in the Originator MMS R/S?
question_29138.ground_truth: The specified MMS CDRs for MMS VAS applications in the Originator MMS R/S include the MM7 Submission, Deliver Request, Deliver Response, Cancel, Replace, Delivery Report Request, Delivery Report Response, Read Reply Report Request, Read Reply Report Response, Extended Cancel, and Extended Replace records.

question_29139.question: What does the setOriginatingAddress() method in the User Interaction Service Interface do and what parameters does it take?
question_29139.ground_truth: The setOriginatingAddress() method sets the originating address property on the user interaction session to be used when sending information to the user. It takes the user interaction session ID of the user interaction and the originating address as parameters.

question_29140.question: What are some of the benefits of using carrier aggregation in LTE networks?
question_29140.ground_truth: Carrier aggregation can provide benefits such as increased bandwidth for data transmission, improved network performance, increased capacity, and support for higher data rates and more users.

question_29141.question: What should the UE include in the MBMSInterestIndication message if the set of MBMS frequencies of interest is not empty?
question_29141.ground_truth: The UE should include mbms-FreqList and set it to include the MBMS frequencies of interest sorted by decreasing order of interest, using the EARFCN corresponding with freqBandIndicator included in SystemInformationBlockType1 if applicable, and the EARFCN(s) as included in SystemInformationBlockType15.

question_29142.question: What action should a Node B take if the Radio Link Addition Request message includes the Transport Layer Address IE or the Binding ID IE, but not both, for a transport bearer intended to be established in TDD mode?
question_29142.ground_truth: The Node B should reject the procedure using the RADIO LINK ADDITION FAILURE message.

question_29143.question: What percentage of the reports are delivered in less than 2 seconds for up to 240K users per sector?
question_29143.ground_truth: Around 98% of the reports are delivered in less than 2 seconds for up to 240K users per sector.

question_29145.question: What does the absence of the "StartSourceIPaddress" leaf indicate?
question_29145.ground_truth: The absence of the "StartSourceIPaddress" leaf indicates that the source address field of the IP header is not examined when matching packets against the IP flow description in the rule.

question_29147.question: What should the MAC entity do if the SCI indicates a new transmission where the cast type is set to groupcast and it has SL resources allocated for new transmission?
question_29147.ground_truth: Start or restart sl-DRX-GC-InactivityTimer for the corresponding Destination Layer-2 ID in the first slot after SCI transmission.

question_29149.question: What are the tight latency constraints for medical images that are real-time processed by applications to deliver results in medical procedures involving human beings?
question_29149.ground_truth: The tight latency constraints for medical images that are real-time processed by applications to deliver results in medical procedures involving human beings is the round trip delay, which is the sum of the Imaging System Latency and the Human Reaction Time.

question_29151.question: What is the role of the resource list server in the explicit case of the MCPTT group call procedure?
question_29151.ground_truth: The resource list server aggregates the notifications and sends a notification to the group MCPTT server including the affiliation status of all the group members.

question_29152.question: What is the initial value of accumulation for a BL/CE UE?
question_29152.ground_truth: For a BL/CE UE, the initial value of accumulation is 0.

question_29153.question: What is the purpose of Edge Application Server registration using CAPIF?
question_29153.ground_truth: The purpose of Edge Application Server registration using CAPIF is to allow functionality to API invokers after going through the registration process.

question_29154.question: What is the goal of the "Bearer Established" procedure?
question_29154.ground_truth: The "Bearer Established" procedure is used to notify the established bearer.

question_29155.question: What types of measurements does the UE and the network perform and report to higher layers in the NR system?
question_29155.ground_truth: The UE and the network measure and report to higher layers in the NR system, the following: measurements for intra- and inter-frequency handover, inter RAT handover, timing measurements, and measurements for radio resource management (RRM).

question_29156.question: In what situation is SMF responsible for initiating Change of PDU Session Anchor?
question_29156.ground_truth: SMF is responsible for initiating Change of PDU Session Anchor when there is a decision on re-anchoring, and such decision has been made based on SLA information or PCCs received from PCF for the PDU Session.

question_29158.question: What should the AMF include in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message if the UE has included the service-level device ID set to the CAA-level UAV ID in the Service-level-AA container IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and the UE is not allowed to request UAS services?
question_29158.ground_truth: The AMF should accept the registration update request and shall mark in the UE's 5GMM context that the UE is not allowed to request UAS services.

question_29159.question: What is the use of the Demodulation Common Pilot Channel (D-CPICH) in a UMTS network?
question_29159.ground_truth: A Demodulation Common Pilot Channel (D-CPICH) is a non-precoded downlink physical channel that carries a predefined bit sequence, transmitted from the third or fourth transmit antenna. It is used by the UE to assist with demodulation of the High Speed Downlink Shared Channel (HS-DSCH).

question_29160.question: What is the validity of the E-UTRAN Service Handover IE value in the RAB setup and modification process?
question_29160.ground_truth: The E-UTRAN Service Handover IE value is valid throughout the lifetime of the RAB or until changed by a RAB modification.

question_29162.question: What is the purpose of the Network Data Analytics Function (NWDAF) in the 5G System?
question_29162.ground_truth: The Network Data Analytics Function (NWDAF) provides analytics information for different analytics events to NF service consumers in the 5G System.

question_29163.question: What is the difference between Teleaction service and Telecommunication service?
question_29163.ground_truth: Teleaction service is a type of telecommunication service that uses short messages, requiring a low transmission rate, between the user and the network. Telecommunication service is what is offered by a PLMN operator or service provider to its customers in order to satisfy a specific telecommunication requirement, and can be divided into bearer services and teleservices.

question_29164.question: What procedures shall the MCData client follow upon receiving a successful file download indication with a file download completed update indication?
question_29164.ground_truth: The MCData client shall follow the procedures described in subclause 12.2.1.1.

question_29165.question: What should be the measurement reporting delay for both Cell 2 and Cell 3 in the measurement test?
question_29165.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay for both Cell 2 and Cell 3 in the measurement test should be less than 1280 ms.

question_29166.question: What is the purpose of the "redirection" packet in UE-initiated IP flow mobility with authorized transfer?
question_29166.ground_truth: The "redirection" packet is sent by the UE to the PGW via the target access as a request to transfer the IP flow to the target access. The PGW determines whether to accept or reject the redirection request based on procedures specified in clause~7.6.1.1.6 and clause~7.6.1.1.5.

question_29167.question: What is restricted regarding the use of WUS by the eNodeB and the UE?
question_29167.ground_truth: The use of WUS by the eNodeB and the UE is restricted to the last used cell, i.e. the cell in which the UE's RRC connection was last released, to avoid waking up UEs due to MME paging other UEs across multiple cells.

question_29168.question: What action should the P-CSCF take when it receives an INVITE request with an emergency service URN in the Request-URI?
question_29168.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall treat the request as an emergency call attempt by the UE and process it accordingly.

question_29169.question: Which network entity is responsible for collecting charging information for individual service data flows in the P-GW for flow based bearer charging?
question_29169.ground_truth: The P-GW may be capable of identifying data volumes, elapsed time or events for individual service data flows (Flow Based bearer Charging). One PCC rule identifies one service data flow.

question_29170.question: What is the maximum number of codewords in the compressor dictionary in the direction of MS-to-SGSN?
question_29170.ground_truth: P1 is used to indicate this value in the XID parameter negotiation

question_29171.question: What functional entity in the MCPTT system exists in the UE and provides support for combining multiple media streams into one media stream through the enforcement of media policy information?
question_29171.ground_truth: The Media mixer functional entity exists on the UE and provides support for combining multiple media streams into one media stream through the enforcement of media policy information.

question_29174.question: What is the purpose of combining the indices of two 3-pulse tracks together in the encoding process?
question_29174.ground_truth: The purpose is to reduce the number of bits used for pulse indexing.

question_29175.question: What action should the UE take if the entry condition for event B2 is fulfilled for one or more applicable cells for all measurements after layer 3 filtering taken during timeToTrigger, while the VarMeasReportList does not include a measurement reporting entry for this measId?
question_29175.ground_truth: The UE should include a measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportList for this measId, set the numberOfReportsSent for this measId to 0, include the concerned cell(s) in the cellsTriggeredList defined within the VarMeasReportList for this measId, and initiate the measurement reporting procedure, as specified in 5.5.5.

question_29176.question: Which operation service is used to update or terminate policies in NF service consumer (e.g. SMF)?
question_29176.ground_truth: The UpdateNotify service operation using the POST method is used for both update and terminate operations for the NF service consumer (e.g. SMF).

question_29177.question: What is the formula for calculating the measured maximum output power P'UMAX for serving cell c when at least one slot has a different transmission numerology or slot pattern?
question_29177.ground_truth: The formula for calculating the measured maximum output power P'UMAX for serving cell c when at least one slot has a different transmission numerology or slot pattern is given by the average measured maximum output power for serving cell c expressed in linear scale over TREF.

question_29180.question: What is the Action associated with BC GSM coded as 04 08 XXXX 20 20 30 24 when X.32 is used with SAP I.450 for X.21 allocating modems?
question_29180.ground_truth: When the BC GSM is coded as 04 08 XXXX 20 20 30 24 using X.32

question_29181.question: What is the relationship between the IRP and the Federated Network Information Model (FNIM) in 3GPP TS 28.651?
question_29181.ground_truth: The IRP defined in 3GPP TS 28.651 is a member of the Federated Network Information Model (FNIM) and its information is derived from the FNIM Umbrella Information Model (UIM).

question_29182.question: What should the MCData client do when it receives a disposition response via a SIP MESSAGE message from the SS (MCDATA Server) after sending a one-to-one standalone SDS message with a disposition of "DELIVERY"?
question_29182.ground_truth: The MCData client should respond to the SIP MESSAGE message by sending a SIP 200 (OK) message and deliver the notification to the MCDATA User.

question_29183.question: Who takes the decision for TTI switching, the Node B or the RNC?
question_29183.ground_truth: Either the Node B or the RNC takes the decision for TTI switching.

question_29184.question: What is the target scope of the Message Broadcast Web Service?
question_29184.ground_truth: The Message Broadcast Web Service is a part of the Stage 3 Parlay X Web Services specification for Open Service Access (OSA) and defines an architecture that enables application developers to make use of network functionality through an open standardized interface, i.e. the OSA APIs.

question_29185.question: Which types of E-UTRA UE are applicable for the spurious response test of EN-DC within FR1 with 4 DL CCs?
question_29185.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 15 and forward, supporting intra-band contiguous EN-DC in FR1 with 4 DL CCs.

question_29186.question: What is the test purpose for E-UTRAN HD - FDD Intra frequency case for CE UE in enhanced coverage?
question_29186.ground_truth: The purpose is to verify that the CE UE in enhanced coverage can search and measure cells to meet the respective HD-FDD intra-frequency cell re-selection requirements.

question_29187.question: What does the Update Number indicate in a CBS message?
question_29187.ground_truth: The Update Number indicates a change of the message content of the same CBS message, i.e. the CBS message with the same Message Identifier, Geographical Scope, and Message Code. It differentiates between older and newer versions of the same CBS message, within the indicated geographical area.

question_29188.question: In which two of the listed scenarios did both sources report improvement in all measured metrics for the non-replaced Wi-Fi operator when a category 2 or 3 or 4 LBT scheme was used?
question_29188.ground_truth: Two scenarios: 1) indoor deployment with one shared unlicensed carrier and FTP traffic, and 2) single carrier indoor scenario with FTP traffic and increased number of UEs per operator per carrier.

question_29190.question: What is an "Initial NAS message" in the 3GPP System Architecture Evolution (SAE)?
question_29190.ground_truth: An Initial NAS message is a NAS message that can trigger the establishment of a NAS signalling connection between UE and the network. For instance, the ATTACH REQUEST message is an initial NAS message.

question_29192.question: How does the Remote UE perform the measurement of the signal strength of PC5 unicast link with the ProSe 5G UE-to-Network Relay?
question_29192.ground_truth: After being connected to the ProSe 5G UE-to-Network Relay, the Remote UE keeps performing the measurement of the signal strength of PC5 unicast link with the ProSe 5G UE-to-Network Relay for relay reselection.

question_29193.question: Which clause in the technical specification defines the symbols and variables used in the Tuak algorithm set?
question_29193.ground_truth: Clause 3.2 of the technical specification defines the symbols and variables used in the Tuak algorithm set.

question_29194.question: What is the expected action if the GNSS validity duration reporting procedure has been triggered, but there are no UL resources allocated for new transmission for this TTI that can accommodate the GNSS Validity Duration Report MAC control element?

question_29195.question: What action should the AS take upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response from the terminating UE to the initial INVITE request?
question_29195.ground_truth: The AS should instruct the MRF to stop media for the CRS service and forward the SIP 200 (OK) response to the originating UE.

question_29196.question: What should the MS transmit before sending the first CP-DATA on a new MM connection?
question_29196.ground_truth: The MS shall transmit the CP-ACK for the old MM connection before sending the first CP-DATA on a new MM connection.

question_29199.question: What is the first step for establishing a PoC communication based on on-demand signalling with automatic answering in SIP?
question_29199.ground_truth: The first step for establishing a PoC communication based on on-demand signalling with automatic answering in SIP is that each UE is powered on and performs PS attach in order to register to the PS domain.

question_29201.question: What is the function of the Network Assistance (NA) feature in the 5GMS system?
question_29201.ground_truth: The Network Assistance (NA) feature enables a UE that is receiving an uplink media stream to improve the QoE of the media streaming session, by being able to make use of two distinct facilities: bit rate recommendation (throughput estimation) and delivery boost.

question_29203.question: Which UE is applicable for the NR SA FR1 SSB-based beam failure detection and link recovery in DRX mode for 1 Rx UE?
question_29203.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE with 1 RX from Release 17 onwards supporting link recovery and long DRX cycle.

question_29204.question: What is the target coupling loss value for achieving a 90th percentile time to successful detection of about 1.44s in the initial cell search procedure?

question_29207.question: What should the UE do if there exists one or more LADN DNNs which are included in the LADN indication IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and are not included in the LADN information IE of the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
question_29207.ground_truth: The UE considers such LADN DNNs as not available in the current registration area.

question_29210.question: What should the SMF do if traffic splitting is not supported for a GBR QoS Flow and the UPF determines that it cannot send GBR traffic over the current ongoing access?
question_29210.ground_truth: The UPF shall send an Access Availability report to the SMF, and the SMF shall try to move the GBR QoS Flow to the other access if the PCC rule allows it on both accesses and the other access is available.

question_29211.question: What network functions in the 5G system can potentially provide charging information in the control plane data transfer domain charging?
question_29211.ground_truth: The possible 5GC NFs as CPCN, which can potentially provide charging information in the control plane data transfer domain charging, include AMF, SMF, and NEF.

question_29212.question: In UE-initiated NBIFOM mode, what does the UE need to do when it indicates that an access has become "usable" or "unusable" in Network-initiated NBIFOM mode?
question_29212.ground_truth: The UE needs to notify the network that an access has become "usable" or "unusable".

question_29213.question: What are the conditions for two transport block transmission in terms of the reported preferred primary precoding vector and the CQI reported by the UE?
question_29213.ground_truth: If the CQI reported by the UE indicates a preference for two transport blocks and the preferred primary precoding vector corresponds to the highest reported CQI value, the preferred primary precoding vector is applied to the primary transport block. Otherwise, the preferred primary precoding vector is applied to the secondary transport block.

question_29214.question: Which protocol class should be used when multiple BSSMAP-LE messages are transferred containing segments of a single fragmented LLP or SMLCPP message on the Lb interface?
question_29214.ground_truth: SCCP protocol class 1 should be used in this case.

question_29216.question: What are the main enhancements considered for CSI feedback?
question_29216.ground_truth: The main enhancements considered for CSI feedback are Enhanced PMI feedback codebook for 4-tx, including cross-polarised antennas, Finer frequency-domain sub-band granularity for CSI feedback, CQI or CQI related feedback specifically for MU-MIMO, Rank-restriction or PMI selection, and PMI that causes least interference to the reporting UE.

question_29217.question: What should the MCVideo client do if it receives a SIP INFO request where the Request-URI contains an MCVideo session ID identifying an ongoing group session?
question_29217.ground_truth: When the MCVideo client receives a SIP INFO request where the Request-URI contains an MCVideo session ID identifying an ongoing group session, it follows the actions specified in subclause 6.2.8.1.13.

question_29220.question: When the user data header is mapped into the structure of a single message, what is the IEI value used?
question_29220.ground_truth: In the TS~23.040~ standard, the IEI value mapped into the User Data Header within a single message is '70'.

question_29221.question: What information is made available to the NWDAF for data analysis?
question_29221.ground_truth: Network information such as load, time and spatial data, service information, and UE mobility information could be made available to the NWDAF for data analysis.

question_29223.question: What is the responsibility of the MN in splitting the PDU session served by the MN into more than one NG-U tunnels (RAN initiated QoS flows offloading from MN to SN)?
question_29223.ground_truth: The MN sends the SN Addition/Modification Request message including UPF UL TEID address used at the MN.

question_29224.question: What gaps were identified in the analysis of 3GP-DASH and 3GPP File format up to Release 12 for DASH-based signalling?
question_29224.ground_truth: At least the following gaps were identified: Clarification of the interpretation of @maxWidth and @maxHeight, Clarification of the interpretation of @width, @height, and @sar, Clarification of the interpretation of width and height in track header box of the ISO BMFF, Addition of Picture Aspect Ratio to TS 26.247, Enable signaling of CICP parameters, Enable a frame rate signaling in DASH, Provide signaling for the defined parameters and options in the TV Profile Specification, and Define default parameters if certain signaling is not present.

question_29225.question: What is the purpose of Step 9b in the PDU Session Establishment Procedure for IPTV services?
question_29225.ground_truth: In Step 9b, the UPF binds the Line ID received in Step 9a with the CN Tunnel Info to identify the PDU Session that the DHCP Offer message belongs to.

question_29227.question: What are the pre-conditions for the EES registration operation?
question_29227.ground_truth: The pre-conditions for the EES registration operation are that the EES has the address (e.g. URI) of the ECS and both, the EES and ECS, have the necessary credentials to enable communications.

question_29228.question: What is the content type that indicates the JSON format in the 3GPP SBI interface?

question_29229.question: Which logical state of the call hold service corresponds to the HLR induction state "Not Induced"?
question_29229.ground_truth: The logical state of the call hold service which corresponds to the HLR induction state "Not Induced" is (Not Provisioned, Not Applicable, Not Active, Not Induced) or (Provisioned, Not Applicable, Active and Operative, Not Induced).

question_29232.question: What is included in the scope of the present document?
question_29232.ground_truth: The scope includes the radio related information transported in a transparent container between source eNB and target eNB upon inter eNB handover, and between a source or target eNB and another system upon inter RAT handover.

question_29233.question: What is the purpose of the Discovery Filter in the Discovery Response message in step 2?
question_29233.ground_truth: The Discovery Filter in the Discovery Response message in step 2 indicates the ProSe Restricted Code to be monitored and the TTL that indicates for how long the related ProSe Restricted Code in the Discovery Filter is valid after it is received.

question_29234.question: What functionality does the Support mode for predefined SDU size (SMpSDU) of the Iu UP protocol provide?
question_29234.ground_truth: The Support mode for predefined SDU size (SMpSDU) of the Iu UP protocol supports variations in RABs with predefined SDU sizes, and provides functions for transferring user data, initialization, rate control, time alignment, handling of error events, and frame quality classification.

question_29235.question: What approach is used to find the optimal TSC length for DAS-12b and DBS-12b in SBPCE2?
question_29235.ground_truth: An empirical method is used, which involves searching for a TSC vector TSC(T,cn,sp) with a specific number of symbols located in the center and the remaining symbols evenly distributed over the burst.

question_29236.question: What action does the NSACF take when the maximum number of UEs has already been reached for a network slice?
question_29236.ground_truth: The NSACF returns a response indicating that the maximum number with the network slice has been reached, and does not include the UE identity in the list of UE IDs.

question_29238.question: What information is included in a Paging record?
question_29238.ground_truth: Information in a Paging record includes ng-5G-S-TMSI, fullI-RNTI, ue-Identity, and Access Identity, as per TS 38.331 clause 5.3.2.3.

question_29240.question: What parameter determines the total number of samples taken for each fixed measurement antenna?

question_29242.question: What action should the MCVideo client perform when receiving a SIP 183(Session Progress) response to the SIP INVITE request?
question_29242.ground_truth: The MCVideo client may indicate the progress of the session establishment to the inviting MCVideo user.

question_29244.question: Which type of field in the "protocolIEs" container is mandatory to include in the "UEContextReleaseRequest" message?
question_29244.ground_truth: Both "AMF-UE-NGAP-ID" and "RAN-UE-NGAP-ID" are mandatory fields in the "UEContextReleaseRequest" message.

question_29245.question: In what mode does the PCEF initiate a TCP connection with the PFDF when sending pull requests?
question_29245.ground_truth: In pull mode, the PCEF initiates a TCP connection with the PFDF when sending pull requests.

question_29246.question: What is the functionality of the CICME (Correlation of Call Detail Record Information from Multiple Entities) feature in IN CS-3?
question_29246.ground_truth: CICME allows a network or service provider to collect and correlate CDR (Call Detail Record) information from different physical entities involved in the same call, enabling the information to be used in billing systems.

question_29247.question: In MCPTT Conformance testing, how many types of MCPTT Clients are involved in testing?
question_29247.ground_truth: Two types of MCPTT Clients are involved in testing, Client A installed on the implementation under test (IUT), and Client B simulated by the System Simulator (SS).

question_29248.question: What is the impact of the NWDAF on existing nodes and functionality in 5G networks?
question_29248.ground_truth: The NWDAF introduces extensions to support finer granularity area analytics, location and speed request from the GMLC/LMF, and UDM query for more accurate analytics.

question_29250.question: What is the responsibility of the SCF in the PSS download service?
question_29250.ground_truth: The SCF checks the user rights for the requested content, identifies the request as a progressive download request, selects and forwards the SIP request to the HTTP/SIP adapter, and receives the SDP answer from the HTTP/SIP adapter.

question_29251.question: What is the purpose of the network slice LCM operations in the procedure of multiple slices coordinated resource optimization?
question_29251.ground_truth: The network slice LCM operations are used to modify the network slice as per the decision made by the NSCE server to optimize resources between different slices.

question_29253.question: What happens when the NWDAF containing MTLF receives analytics feedback information from the analytics consumer for the provisioned ML model?
question_29253.ground_truth: When the NWDAF containing MTLF receives analytics feedback information and/or ML model accuracy information from the analytics consumer for the provisioned ML model, it may trigger a series of steps to enhance the ML model accuracy if necessary.

question_29256.question: What action does a MS take when attempting a location update to a PLMN in ROAMING NOT ALLOWED state?
question_29256.ground_truth: The MS shall not attempt a location update when the PLMN is in the ROAMING NOT ALLOWED state.

question_29257.question: What does NSQ do if the actual Slice AMBR is not within the maximum allowed Slice-AMBR limit?
question_29257.ground_truth: If the actual Slice AMBR is not within the maximum allowed Slice-AMBR limit, NSQ informs all SMF(s) which have active PDU session(s) associated with the same S-NSSAI to dynamically adjust data rates of the existing PDU sessions or may inform the SMF to reject the PDU session establishment request with an appropriate cause code.

question_29258.question: What is the role of the 5GMSG Proxy/Gateway in the 5GMSG Service?
question_29258.ground_truth: The 5GMSG Proxy/Gateway performs the interworking between the 5G MSG and the M2M system or provides access to 5G IoT devices.

question_29260.question: What does the Extended Object Type octet (Octet 5) in the Extended Object indicate?
question_29260.ground_truth: The Extended Object Type octet indicates the format of the Extended Object.

question_29261.question: How long should the SS wait before checking the reported RSRQ values in MeasurementReport messages for each event?
question_29261.ground_truth: After 10s wait from Step 6 in the test procedure.

question_29263.question: What indication does the UE provide in the UL NAS Transport message if there is no URSP rule or local restrictions mandating a single access for the PDU Session?
question_29263.ground_truth: The UE provides an "MA PDU Network-Upgrade Allowed" indication in UL NAS Transport message.

question_29264.question: What is the definition of "Multimedia Session Transfer" as provided in the document?
question_29264.ground_truth: Multimedia Session Transfer is the transfer at the IMS-level of one or more of the session signalling paths and associated media paths of an ongoing multimedia session while maintaining session continuity. It incorporates both Access Network Transfer and UE Transfer.

question_29265.question: What is the purpose of the QoE reception reporting procedure in the UE?
question_29265.ground_truth: The QoE reception reporting procedure in the UE occurs independently and separately from its reporting procedure as determined by parameters set in the Associated Delivery Procedures Description or the SDP description.

question_29266.question: What responsibility does the SMF remain responsible for in case of UE IP address transfer to the UE?
question_29266.ground_truth: The SMF remains responsible for sending the allocated UE IP address in CP signaling to the UE via NAS, to the PCF as part of SMF initiated SM Policy Association Modification, and to the CHF, LI, etc.

question_29267.question: What action must the UE take when it receives a PDN MODIFICATION REQUEST message with NBIFOM routing rules parameter over untrusted WLAN?
question_29267.ground_truth: If the UE accepts the requested routing rules, it shall send a PDN MODIFICATION ACCEPT message and apply the requested routing rules. If the UE rejects the requested routing rules, it shall send a PDN MODIFICATION REJECT message with a NBIFOM status parameter indicating the error.

question_29269.question: Who initiates the inter-SN subsequent CPAC by requesting the candidate SN(s) to allocate resources for the UE in the SN Addition procedure?

question_29270.question: What information is used in the UE to determine the source address for the PtP tunnel in the GGSN/P-GW and the AS for the Gi/SGi based Non-IP data delivery?
question_29270.ground_truth: UE IP address for the PDN connection or IPv6 prefix allocated for the PDN connection+suffix assigned for the PtP tunnel end point in the GGSN/P-GW

question_29271.question: What is the objective of the UE relative CDP accuracy for HS-DPCCH and E-DCH with 16QAM for UL OLTD activation state 1?
question_29271.ground_truth: The UE relative CDP accuracy for HS-DPCCH and E-DCH with 16QAM for UL OLTD activation state 1 is a measure of the ability of the UE to correctly set the level of individual code powers relative to the total power of all active codes.

question_29275.question: What happens when the MSGin5G Gateway Client finds that the conditions for sending a bulk de-registration request are met?
question_29275.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Gateway Client includes all cached/stored MSGin5G UE de-registration requests in an MSGin5G UE bulk de-registration request and sends it to the MSGin5G Server.

question_29276.question: What is the gap size requirement for Redcap UEs in FR1 InF-SH for meeting the horizontal accuracy requirement for DL-TDOA method for certain UE speeds and SL PRS bandwidth?
question_29276.ground_truth: The gap of 0.1ms for UE speed of up to 150km/h, the gap of 0.2ms for UE speed of up to 60km/h, the gap of 0.5ms for UE speed of up to 30km/h and the gap of 1ms, 2ms, 5ms for UE speed of up to 3km/h can be tolerated for meeting the horizontal accuracy requirement for DL-TDOA method in FR1 InF-SH for Redcap UEs.

question_29277.question: What message does the SRNC send to the CN when it decides to perform a handover towards GSM in service-based intersystem handover from UMTS to GSM?

question_29279.question: What is the definition of "in session" for E-RABs with continuous flow in "In-session activity time for E-RABs" measurement?
question_29279.ground_truth: E-RABs with continuous flow are always seen as being "in session" in the context of this measurement, and the session time is increased from the first data transmission on the E-RAB until 100 ms after the last data transmission on the E-RAB.

question_29280.question: What is the purpose of the pre-conditions stated in 6.2.3.21.3 for the MBMS client?
question_29280.ground_truth: The MBMS client may be in any state during the pre-conditions stated in 6.2.3.21.3 for the MBMS client.

question_29284.question: What should the manufacturer declare for NB-IoT sub-carrier spacing if the base station supports NB-IoT?
question_29284.ground_truth: The manufacturer should declare if the base station supports 15 kHz sub-carrier spacing, 3.75 kHz sub-carrier spacing, or both for NPUSCH if the base station supports NB-IoT.

question_29285.question: What is the positioning method based on network measurements of the Time Of Arrival (TOA) of a known signal sent from the mobile and received at three or more LMUs?
question_29285.ground_truth: Uplink Time Difference of Arrival (U-TDOA) positioning mechanism

question_29288.question: What actions are taken when CCBS request activation is accepted?
question_29288.ground_truth: When a CCBS request activation is accepted, the network registers the call information in the original call request, starts the CCBS service duration timers T3 and T7, and monitors destination B for becoming idle.

question_29290.question: Which variable is summed to determine the adaptive threshold in VAD?
question_29290.ground_truth: The variable rvad, which is the autocorrelation vector of the adaptive filter predictor values, is summed to determine the adaptive threshold in VAD. The adaptive threshold is then used to compare with the energy of a filtered version of the input signal to detect speech.

question_29291.question: What is the purpose of having the same group membership for ProSe Group Communication or GCSE Group Communication?
question_29291.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure seamless group communication between ProSe Group Communication or GCSE Group Communication when public safety users switch networks.

question_29294.question: What action does the GGSN take if it cannot negotiate an authentication protocol with the TE?
question_29294.ground_truth: If the GGSN cannot negotiate an authentication protocol with the TE, it may reject the PPP connection.

question_29296.question: What method returns the TPUDL offset in a SMS TPDU TLV?
question_29296.ground_truth: The method getTPUDLOffset() follows this definition.

question_29298.question: What is the power allocation strategy for the S-E-DPDCH channels in UL MIMO?
question_29298.ground_truth: The power allocation to the E-DPDCH and S-E-DPDCH channels in UL MIMO can be symmetric, where the amount of power allocated to both channels is the same, or asymmetric, where a different amount of power is allocated to each channel, potentially via waterfilling.

question_29300.question: What should the UE do if the timer T35ab is running and the UE enters state5GMM-DEREGISTERED while the USIM in the UE remains the same?
question_29300.ground_truth: The UE shall behave as follows: - let t1 be the time remaining for T35ab timeout at switch off and let t be the time elapsed between switch off and switch on. If t1 is greater than t, then the timer shall be restarted with the value t1 - t. If t1 is equal to t or t1 is less than t, then the timer T35ab is stopped.

question_29301.question: What is the S9 reference point used for in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_29301.ground_truth: The S9 reference point is used in roaming scenarios involving a HPLMN and a VPLMN for the installed PCC rules or QoS rules generated in the HPLMN to be transported to the VPLMN, and for events that may occur in the VPLMN to be transported to the HPLMN.

question_29302.question: What information does the loadStatisticsError parameter in queryLoadStatsErr() method provide?
question_29302.ground_truth: Specifies the error code associated with the failed attempt to retrieve the framework's load statistics.

question_29304.question: What should the UE do if it detects a cell with a physical identity not allowed on a particular E-UTRA carrier in the measurement control system information of the serving cell?
question_29304.ground_truth: The UE is not required to perform measurements on that cell.

question_29305.question: What technical specification is defined in the present document?
question_29305.ground_truth: A transport protocol for use in the IP multimedia (IM) Core Network (CN) subsystem based on the Diameter base protocol.

question_29306.question: In which case would the primary PCF delegate the request of policy counter update for the deregistration of the S-NSSAI to the primary PCF?
question_29306.ground_truth: If the PCF instance of the UE does not have local quota granted, the PCF instance delegates the request of policy counter update for the deregistration of the S-NSSAI to the primary PCF.

question_29309.question: What action does the SCF take if the minimum allowed age is higher than the child's age and the program is not in the list of allowed programs during PSS session initialization?
question_29309.ground_truth: The SCF responds the UE with a 403 error code.

question_29310.question: How can the network provide the set of mapped EPS bearer contexts for an MA PDU session in the 5G system?
question_29310.ground_truth: The network can provide the set of mapped EPS bearer contexts of the MA PDU session via either access of the MA PDU session.

question_29312.question: What information is specified by the <periodic-report> element in the XML schema?
question_29312.ground_truth: The <periodic-report> element specifies the reporting interval for periodic request for a location report.

question_29313.question: What are the minimum video resolutions that MCVideo clients should support for encoding and decoding?
question_29313.ground_truth: MCVideo clients should support video encoding and decoding of at least 240p.

question_29314.question: What is the meaning of the term "HDOP" as used in the document?
question_29314.ground_truth: HDOP stands for Horizontal Dilution Of Precision, a measure of position determination accuracy based on the geometrical layout of the satellites used for the fix.

question_29315.question: What is the minimum requirement for implementing the IpAccountManager interface?
question_29315.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for implementing the IpAccountManager interface is to implement the queryBalanceReq() method, or the retrieveTransactionHistoryReq() method, or both the createNotification() and destroyNotification methods, or both the enableNotifications and disableNotifications methods.

question_29316.question: How is the PICH designed for CZ-UMTS?
question_29316.ground_truth: The PICH in CZ-UMTS is a SF256 channel carrying a set of Paging Indicators, and the spreading is effectively reduced to SF128 for CZ-UMTS.

question_29317.question: What action is taken by the VAL server after creating an MBS session and announcing it to the UEs?
question_29317.ground_truth: The VAL server selects an MBS session ID for the VAL service group X and initiates the MBS session creation procedure via the NRM server. Upon successful creation, the NRM server announces the MBS session to the UEs.

question_29318.question: What does the OR1 stand for in the context of the message flow?

question_29319.question: What are two types of feared events that LMF is responsible for mitigating?
question_29319.ground_truth: LMF is responsible for mitigating hardware and software faults.

question_29320.question: What command is sent from a non-3GPP access network to a 3GPP AAA server to request session termination?

question_29321.question: What was the frequency re-use studied for the BCCH layer?
question_29321.ground_truth: Frequency re-use 4/12 was studied for the BCCH layer.

question_29322.question: What is one of the benefits of the solution for downlink small data transfer using RRC message?
question_29322.ground_truth: One of the benefits is the reduction in signalling required to transfer downlink small data from MME to UE, as it avoids the need for the Service Request procedure in certain cases.

question_29324.question: What are the required parameters for measurement in the context of 5G NR UE Application Layer Data Throughput?
question_29324.ground_truth: The required parameter for measurement is the 5G NR UE Application Layer Data Throughput, which can be measured in each direction (downlink and uplink).

question_29325.question: What is the role of the Energy Efficiency Control and Coordination function in the energy efficiency control framework?
question_29325.ground_truth: The Energy Efficiency Control and Coordination function is responsible for controlling and coordinating power saving operations across all relevant elements in the network, equipment, and site levels in the energy efficiency control framework.

question_29326.question: Which are the main families of use cases for network operation identified by the 3GPP Technical Report?
question_29326.ground_truth: The main families of use cases are System Flexibility, Scalability, Mobility Support, Efficient Content Delivery, Self-backhauling, Access, Migration and Interworking, and Security.

question_29327.question: What type of information is contained in the "v2x-usd-announcement" element?
question_29327.ground_truth: The "v2x-usd-announcement" element contains USD announcement type information.

question_29328.question: What information is included in the Queue Info field of the floor control messages?
question_29328.ground_truth: The Queue Info field of the floor control messages includes information about the position for one MCPTT client in the floor request queue and the priority of the floor request.

question_29329.question: What are the functions required for the default DTX mechanism in the EVS codec?
question_29329.ground_truth: The default DTX mechanism in the EVS codec requires a Signal Activity Detector (SAD) on the transmit (TX) side, evaluation of background acoustic noise on the TX side, and generation of comfort noise on the receive (RX) side during periods where the transmission is switched off.

question_29330.question: What action does the SGSN take if it receives a Deactivate PDP Context Request message upon completing the RAB modification procedure?
question_29330.ground_truth: The SGSN returns an Update PDP Context Response (TEID, QoS Negotiated, CGI/SAI) message to the GGSN upon completion of the RAB modification procedure or upon receipt of the Modify PDP Context Accept message.

question_29331.question: What is the problem with some MSs when using the HANDOVER COMMAND message with a channel mode change for directed retry handovers?
question_29331.ground_truth: Some MSs accept the handover command, make the required channel and mode change, but do not through connect the speech path.

question_29334.question: What information does the PC provide to the PCRF when initiating a gate-related procedure?
question_29334.ground_truth: The PC provides the service information to the PCRF, including instructions on when to enable or disable IP flows to pass through the IP-CAN.

question_29335.question: Are UE coexistence spurious emission requirements defined for NR SL-U in the bands n46, n96, and n102 when operating in a non-concurrent manner?
question_29335.ground_truth: No, they have not been defined.

question_29337.question: Which parameter is used in PDCP testing to check the use of certain PID values assigned to IP compressed header types?
question_29337.ground_truth: A given IP header packet (PIXIT) is used in PDCP testing to check the use of certain PID values assigned to IP compressed header types.

question_29338.question: What message is sent by the SCC AS to the UE upon receiving an I1 Invite message from the ICS UE while the session is in the "initiated" state?
question_29338.ground_truth: The SCC AS responds by sending an I1 Progress message with Progress reason set to Call progressing to the UE.

question_29339.question: What is the relationship between the Isotropic model's XPR and TRPG in terms of MEG?
question_29339.ground_truth: If the Isotropic model is applied, the MEG will always be 3 dB lower than the TRPG as the Isotropic model implies equal weighting of power versus direction in both polarizations with an XPR of 0 dB.

question_29340.question: Which modulation schemes are used for testing the transmitted signal quality in the FR1 test model 3.2?
question_29340.ground_truth: The transmitted signal quality is tested using 16QAM modulation in the FR1 test model 3.2.

question_29341.question: What is the NWDAF's role in accuracy monitoring?
question_29341.ground_truth: The NWDAF may have the accuracy checking capability for Analytics and/or ML Models, and it may provide accuracy information to consumers when requested or use it for its internal processes. The accuracy information is obtained by comparing the predictions using the current trained ML model and its corresponding ground truth data.

question_29342.question: What is the purpose of the first step in registering a new Service Capability Feature (SCF) in the Framework?
question_29342.ground_truth: The purpose of the first step is to agree on a name, called serviceID, for the newly installed SCF version within the network. It allows the OSA Framework and SCF in the same network to make an association between the new SCF version and its identifier, even if they come from different vendors.

question_29343.question: What is one reason why encryption mechanisms might not be activated in 5G systems, despite being important for information and communication integrity?
question_29343.ground_truth: One reason is to reduce the end-to-end latency of the system when additional over-the-top security is in place.

question_29345.question: What is the purpose of the "Supported-Features AVP" in the N6 reference point?
question_29345.ground_truth: The "Supported-Features AVP" is used during session establishment to inform the destination host about the required and optional features that the origin host supports.

question_29346.question: In the test procedure, what is the triggering event for the UE to transmit a MeasurementReport message containing the cell global identifier of cell 2?
question_29346.ground_truth: The UE is expected to transmit a MeasurementReport message containing the cell global identifier of cell 2 within 170 milliseconds from the start of T3.

question_29347.question: What is the procedure for network-initiated deregistration for IAB-UE?
question_29347.ground_truth: If the AMF detects that the MBSR authorization state of a MBSR IAB-UE has changed, it initiates the deregistration procedure for that UE.

question_29348.question: What is the purpose of sending a S9a GW Control and QoS rules request in H(e)NB policy function initiated bearer Deactivation?
question_29348.ground_truth: The purpose of sending a S9a GW Control and QoS rules request in H(e)NB policy function initiated bearer Deactivation is to modify the authorized resource for H(e)NB due to local reasons.

question_29349.question: What is a mobile virtual network operator (MVNO) and how does it operate in the wireless services market?
question_29349.ground_truth: An MVNO is a service provider that resells wireless services, typically under its own brand name, using the network of a host PLMN operator. It does not have its own radio access network.

question_29351.question: What is the procedure for outgoing calls when the external network does not support reliable provisional responses and no SDP precondition signaling can be performed with the UPDATE method?
question_29351.ground_truth: In outgoing calls with no support for reliable provisional responses and preconditions, the IWU makes a second offer to the external network with a re-INVITE request if the answer includes more than one codec.

question_29352.question: What should the NEF do if it receives an error response from the UDM while processing a request for a UE-specific identifier?
question_29352.ground_truth: The NEF should respond to the AF with an appropriate error status code if it receives an error response from the UDM.

question_29354.question: What is the Integration Reference Point (IRP) in 3GPP Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects?
question_29354.ground_truth: Integration Reference Point (IRP) is a concept in the 3GPP TS 32.531, which describes details about software management and requirements for the IRP Information Service.

question_29355.question: What is the output interface specified in MPEG-H 3DA for the delivery of un-rendered channels, objects, and HOA content and associated metadata?
question_29355.ground_truth: The output interface specified in ISO/IEC 23008-3, clause 17.10 is used for the delivery of un-rendered channels, objects, and HOA content and associated metadata in MPEG-H 3DA.

question_29356.question: What is the purpose of the test in 6.6.8.3 with exception 6.6.8.3.4.1?
question_29356.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the UE makes correct reporting of L1-SINR measurement in non-DRX within L1-SINR measurement requirements in TS 38.133 clause~9.8.4.3.

question_29359.question: What is the dependence of Medium Range and Local Area BS classes on power level?
question_29359.ground_truth: The dependence on power level could be similar between different BS classes, making it possible to use the same spectrum mask definition for different BS classes.

question_29360.question: What is the confidence level used in the stated measurement uncertainty tolerance interval?

question_29361.question: Which bands does the GSM co-existence requirement with other GSM bands apply to?
question_29361.ground_truth: The GSM co-existence requirement with other GSM bands applies to the bands below 1 GHz.

question_29362.question: What is the formula used to calculate the roundtrip delay between two base stations?
question_29362.ground_truth: The roundtrip delay between two base stations can be calculated as (T4-T1) - (T3-T2), where T1-T4 are the time stamps associated with the messages exchanged between the two base stations.

question_29365.question: When should the UE be able to receive PDSCH after a DCI-based active BWP switch, as defined in 16.5.3.1.0.1?
question_29365.ground_truth: UE shall be able to receive PDSCH on the new BWP right after a time duration of TBWPswitchDelay + Y starts from the beginning of DL slot n, where Y=0 if the serving cell where UE receives DCI for BWP switch request is the same as the serving cell on which BWP switch occurs, and Y equals to the length of 1 slot if the serving cell where UE receives DCI for BWP switch request is different from the serving cell on which BWP switch occurs. Additionally, TBWPswitchDelay + Y shall follow the smaller SCS of scheduling cell, scheduled cells before and scheduled cells after active BWP change.

question_29366.question: In the context of 3GPP technical specifications, what is the difference between the meanings of "shall" and "must"?
question_29366.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, while "must" is avoided in normative elements and is only used in direct citations from external documents.

question_29367.question: What type of information element is the GPRS timer with a length of 2 octets?
question_29367.ground_truth: It is a type 3 information element with a length of 2 octets.

question_29369.question: What is the purpose of MSD requirements in lower order combinations?
question_29369.ground_truth: MSD requirements are captured in lower order combinations to ensure compatibility and performance of the system.

question_29370.question: What steps are followed for obtaining location information in network assisted and network based positioning?
question_29370.ground_truth: The E-SMLC sends a Location Information message to the MME, which then sends a Network Positioning Information message to the serving eNodeB. The eNodeB obtains the location information for the UE and returns it to the MME, which then sends it to the E-SMLC.

question_29373.question: What should the gsmSSF do when it receives an Initiate Call Attempt IF from the gsmSCF?
question_29373.ground_truth: The gsmSSF shall functionally support all IEs which can be sent to it in the Initiate Call Attempt IF.

question_29374.question: What message does the network send to the mobile station when user alerting has been initiated at the called side?
question_29374.ground_truth: The network sends an ALERTING message to the mobile station when user alerting has been initiated at the called side.

question_29377.question: What is the effect on the LTE PCell during SRS carrier based switching between E-UTRA carriers when the UE is not capable of Per-FR gap?
question_29377.ground_truth: The LTE PCell may experience interruptions during SRS carrier based switching between E-UTRA carriers when the UE is not capable of Per-FR gap.

question_29378.question: Which message does the PDN GW use to send routing rules to the network when the UE initiates NBIFOM and both 3GPP and TWAN access are used in MCM?
question_29378.ground_truth: The UE sends routing rules via the access indicated by the Routing Access Type in the routing rule when both 3GPP and TWAN access are used in UE-initiated NBIFOM in MCM.

question_29380.question: What is one of the functions of a push proxy/device agent in reducing keep-alive data of applications?
question_29380.ground_truth: The function enables applications to send MT information to devices without a need for keep-alive signalling that keeps a NAT and or firewall open for MT communications.

question_29382.question: What action does the MSGin5G Server take when the aggregated message is larger than the recipient's maximum segment size?
question_29382.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server removes the last individual message in the aggregated message until it is smaller than the maximum segment size that can be transmitted over available transport.

question_29383.question: What should the UE do if timer T3584 is associated with the DNN and the USIM in the UE remains the same when the UE is switched on after being switched off?
question_29383.ground_truth: The UE should restart timer T3586 with the value t1 - t if t1 is greater than t, or not restart the timer if t1 is equal to or less than t.

question_29384.question: What should the partner MCVideo server do upon receiving a SIP REGISTER request containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body within a message/sip MIME body?
question_29384.ground_truth: The partner MCVideo server should determine if integrity protection has been applied, use the keying data to verify the integrity, and decrypt the access token, MCVideo ID, and selected user profile index if confidentiality protection has been applied.

question_29385.question: What should the AMF do if the UE did not include the requested NSSAI in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and none of the S-NSSAIs in the requested NSSAI in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message are allowed?
question_29385.ground_truth: The AMF shall put the allowed S-NSSAI(s) for the current PLMN or SNPN each of which corresponds to a default S-NSSAI and not subject to network slice-specific authentication and authorization in the allowed NSSAI of the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message and determine a registration area such that all S-NSSAIs of the allowed NSSAI are available in the registration area.
