question_31060.question: What is the purpose of the SS counting the number of USF/DAS-9 allocations and MS transmissions in step o)?
question_31060.ground_truth: The purpose of counting is to determine if the minimum number of blocks has been reached for calculating the Block Error Ratio.

question_31061.question: What is the possible values of the result parameter in the Protocol Negotiation Result event?

question_31062.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects in terms of fault management for mobile networks with virtualized network functions?
question_31062.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects is responsible for specifying the requirements applicable to fault management (FM) of mobile networks that include virtualized network functions.

question_31064.question: What is the role of non-3GPP sensors in 5G wireless sensing service?
question_31064.ground_truth: Non-3GPP sensors provide information to determine characteristics of objects and their environment, which can be used to improve sensing results or enhance the sensing service in 5G wireless communication and sensing network.

question_31066.question: What kind of list is the DRBs-FailedToBeModified-List?
question_31066.ground_truth: A list that contains information about DRBs which failed to be modified.

question_31067.question: What is the main function of the S- or T-NSCE server in the context of network slice capability exposure in edge data network?
question_31067.ground_truth: The S- or T-NSCE server can send trigger actions to the slice provisioning MnS based on the expected/predicted VAL UE or VAL group mobility.

question_31068.question: What is the maximum frame rate supported by the High Definition (HD) Media Profile and High Definition High bitrate (xHD) Media Profile?
question_31068.ground_truth: The maximum frame rate supported by both the High Definition (HD) Media Profile and High Definition High bitrate (xHD) Media Profile is 60 Hz.

question_31069.question: What element in the UAE document contains the unique identifier of a UAV which initiates the UAS UE de-registration procedure?

question_31071.question: What function does the "permanently forbidden SNPNs" list serve in an SNPN-enabled UE?
question_31071.ground_truth: The "permanently forbidden SNPNs" list stores a list of SNPNs that are permanently forbidden for access by a UE, and this list is maintained across activation and deactivation of SNPN access operation mode.

question_31074.question: What type of information element is the more data information element?
question_31074.ground_truth: The more data information element is a type 2 information element.

question_31075.question: In the LBO roaming scenarios, what component creates the UE policy container, and when is it provided?
question_31075.ground_truth: The (H-)PCF creates the UE policy container including UE policy information and provides it in step 3 when the UE Policy Association for the UE is established for a UE in EPS.

question_31076.question: What is the solution provided in 6.4.6 for partially applying Common IEs in the service charging specifications?
question_31076.ground_truth: In 6.4.6, the Common IEs are partially applied by showing and referring to the required layers, and not expanding or showing unnecessary sub-IEs.

question_31078.question: What is the initial state of the mobile station in this test procedure?
question_31078.ground_truth: The mobile station is in MM-state "idle, updated" with valid TMSI and CKSN.

question_31080.question: What is the difference between Target Delay and PDB in the context of Deterministic Delay QoS class?
question_31080.ground_truth: The target delay is the maximum allowed delay for a packet to be transmitted, while PDB (Packet Delay Budget) is the maximum allowed end-to-end delay for a packet to be transmitted, after which the packet is considered to be late and cannot be resent.

question_31082.question: In WLAN Direct IP Access online charging, what are the two methods for charging?
question_31082.ground_truth: The two methods for charging are based on Authentication-Authorization (AA) Requests and quota allocation mechanism, and the accounting requests used in offline charging.

question_31083.question: What information should be included with URSP rules for supporting LBO PDU Sessions?
question_31083.ground_truth: PLMN ID(s) should be sent with URSP rules.

question_31085.question: What is the maximum allowed interruption duration on any active serving cell, when activating or deactivating a SCell in the same FR1 band and UE is capable of independent beam management on this FR2 band pair?
question_31085.ground_truth: The UE is allowed an interruption of up to X2 slot on any active serving cell, when activating or deactivating a SCell in the same FR1 band and UE is capable of independent beam management on this FR2 band pair.

question_31087.question: What is the threshold number of HARQ-ACK bits for a UE to perform spatial HARQ-ACK bundling across multiple codewords within a downlink subframe or a special subframe for PUCCH format 3?
question_31087.ground_truth: Spatial HARQ-ACK bundling across multiple codewords within a downlink subframe or a special subframe is performed for each serving cell by a logical AND operation of all of the corresponding individual HARQ-ACKs, and PUCCH format 3 is used if the number of HARQ-ACK bits for multiple subframes in downlink and special subframes associated with a single UL subframe n is more than 21, where n is the index of the UL subframe.

question_31088.question: What are the conditions for a service data flow to pass through the UPF when both policy control and charging control are applicable in 5G networks?
question_31088.ground_truth: The SMF shall allow the service data flow to pass through the UPF if and only if the right conditions from both policy control and charging control are met, i.e. the corresponding gate is open and in the case of online charging the CHF has authorized credit for its charging key.

question_31089.question: What do HS-DSCH-FDD-Secondary-Serving-Information-Response, HS-DSCH-First-DRX-Cycle-FACH, HS-DSCH-First-Rx-burst-FACH, HS-DSCH-Paging-System-InformationFDD refer to?
question_31089.ground_truth: These terms are used in 3GPP TS 25.423, related to the High Speed Downlink Shared Channel in UTRAN

question_31091.question: When is the IRI-POI in IBCF provisioned with the parameter ReportDiversionPASSporTInfo?
question_31091.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in IBCF is provisioned with the parameter ReportDiversionPASSporTInfo when STIR/SHAKEN is required to be intercepted in the network.

question_31092.question: How many PDU sessions can have active user-plane resources for a UE in NB-N1 mode when the Multiple user-plane resources support bit is set to "Multiple user-plane resources supported"?
question_31092.ground_truth: There can be a maximum of two PDU sessions with active user-plane resources for a UE in NB-N1 mode when the Multiple user-plane resources support bit is set to "Multiple user-plane resources supported".

question_31094.question: What is the maximum length of a DN string?
question_31094.ground_truth: The maximum length of a DN string, including RDN separators and white spaces, shall not exceed 400 bytes (8-bit).

question_31095.question: What should be the condition of the interface circuit at the R-interface during step e) in the 29.2.2.5 test requirements?
question_31095.ground_truth: During step e), the interface circuit at the R-interface should not change.

question_31096.question: What should the UE do during T2 if there are no uplink resources for reporting the valid CSI in subframe (m+39)?
question_31096.ground_truth: The UE should use the next available uplink resource for reporting the corresponding valid CSI.

question_31097.question: What is the significance of organizational trust boundaries in the communication process?
question_31097.ground_truth: Organizational trust boundaries indicate that the communication may traverse through different organizations or between an organization and its subcontractors. This has implications on the responsibility of handling personal data correctly and should be taken into account during a privacy impact assessment.

question_31098.question: In the equation for calculating TRS, what does the variable EIS represent?
question_31098.ground_truth: EIS, or Effective Isotropic Sensitivity, is a measure of the reception sensitivity of the UE. It is used in the equation for calculating TRS to determine the overall sensitivity of the UE, taking into account the power transmitted from all directions.

question_31099.question: Which method allows an AF to retrieve all the active MBS User Data Ingest Sessions managed by the NEF using the MBSUserDataIngestSession API?

question_31100.question: Under what conditions does the SS continue transmitting new data after an MS sets the MS OUT OF MEMORY BIT to 0 in the EC Packet Downlink ACK/NACK message?
question_31100.ground_truth: After the MS sets the MS OUT OF MEMORY BIT to 0 in the EC Packet Downlink ACK/NACK message, the SS can continue transmitting new data with MCS-1.

question_31101.question: What is the role of the SMF in handling IP multicast traffic for a dedicated PDU Session?
question_31101.ground_truth: During the establishment of a dedicated PDU Session for IPTV service, the SMF indicates to the UPF acting as PSA for the PDU Session that the PDU Session is eligible for IP multicast traffic and provides the necessary information to carry out Access Control of Multicast Channels over N4.

question_31102.question: What action must the UE take upon receipt of a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message with the 5GSM cause value #86 "UAS services not allowed"?
question_31102.ground_truth: The UE must not send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for UAS services without including the CAA-level UAV ID in the service-level device ID of the Service-level-AA container IE, and upon receipt of the request from the upper layers to establish a PDU session for UAS services, the UE must initiate the UE-requested PDU session establishment procedure by including the service-level device ID in the Service-level-AA container IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message and set the value to the CAA-level UAV ID as specified in subclause 6.4.1.2.

question_31104.question: Which SSC mode is recommended for performing PDU session transfer from a source network slice to a target network slice?
question_31104.ground_truth: SSC mode 3 is recommended for performing PDU session transfer from a source network slice to a target network slice.

question_31105.question: What is the function of the observationPeriod attribute in the Intent IOC?
question_31105.ground_truth: The observationPeriod attribute in the Intent IOC indicates the time period for which the fulfilment process is observed. It determines when the fulfilmentInfo for corresponding ExpectationTargets, IntentExpectations and Intent is updated.

question_31106.question: What is the purpose of using Rx filtering in the gNB radio unit to prevent ADC saturation?
question_31106.ground_truth: The purpose of using Rx filtering in the gNB radio unit to prevent ADC saturation is to suppress the leakage from the Tx side interfering signal and provide protection against potential dynamic range and saturation issues for ADC or LNA when demodulating the UL subband in the Rx path of the gNB.

question_31108.question: What should be included in the parameter for user information in every case?
question_31108.ground_truth: An Object Identifier that identifies the user information and the entity that sent it should always be present.

question_31110.question: What is the main purpose of the classification of services in the CS CN domain?
question_31110.ground_truth: The purpose is to define the basic services, which include circuit teleservices and bearer services, capable of utilizing standardized supplementary services. The PS CN Domain provides IP bearer services, which are utilized by IP multimedia services, which are IP-based session-related services, including voice communications.

question_31111.question: What should a Mobile Station (MS) do if the network rejects a combined GPRS attach procedure with the cause 'location area not allowed'?
question_31111.ground_truth: The MS should not perform combined GPRS attach when in the same location area, delete stored LAI, CKSN, TMSI, RAI, GPRS-CKSN, P-TMSI and P-TMSI signature, store the LA in the 'forbidden location areas for regional provision of service' and perform GPRS attach when a new location area is entered.

question_31112.question: What is the function of the "Source to Target Transparent Container" IE?
question_31112.ground_truth: The "Source to Target Transparent Container" IE is used to transparently pass radio related information from the handover source to the handover target through the core network.

question_31114.question: What functions are included in the network fault localization function set in E-OSF?
question_31114.ground_truth: The network fault localization function set in E-OSF includes a verification of parameters and connectivity function set, network fault localization function set, and running of diagnostic function set. These functions help operators to diagnose and resolve network faults.

question_31115.question: What is the maximum transmission gap time for the absolute power tolerance requirements to apply?
question_31115.ground_truth: The maximum transmission gap time for the absolute power tolerance requirements to apply is 40 ms.

question_31117.question: What is an IOPS network composed of?
question_31117.ground_truth: An IOPS network consists of one or more eNBs operating in IOPS mode and connected to a Local EPC.

question_31118.question: What is the stability margin conformance requirement specified in 30.17.2.2?
question_31118.ground_truth: The stability margin shall be as specified in 3GPP TS 26.131.

question_31119.question: What is the purpose of the RIM Protocol Version Number IE in the RAN-INFORMATION-REQUEST/Single Report PDU?
question_31119.ground_truth: The RIM Protocol Version Number IE is set if necessary to indicate the version of the RIM protocol being used in the PDU.

question_31121.question: What does the 3GPP SMIL Language Profile include in addition to the SMIL Basic Profile?
question_31121.ground_truth: The 3GPP SMIL Language Profile includes the MediaAccessibility, MediaDescription, MediaClipping, MetaInformation, PrefetchControl, EventTiming, and BasicTransitions modules in addition to the SMIL Basic Profile.

question_31122.question: What is one difference between CB notifications for idle mode mobiles and connected mode mobiles in Alternative 4 with CBS over GERAN?
question_31122.ground_truth: For idle mode mobiles, the BTS sends the SMS BROADCAST REQ with an ETWS tag to all its BTSs within the impacted area, while for connected mode mobiles, the BTS copies the CB message content into a point-to-point short message structure, with the SMS indicating that the mobile shall deliver it to the (U)SIM.

question_31126.question: What are the objectives of the LTE-Advanced Intra-band Contiguous Carrier Aggregation in Band 42 work item?
question_31126.ground_truth: The objectives of this work item are to specify the RF requirements for Band 42 intra-band contiguous CA up to 2CC in uplink and downlink, define transmission bandwidth combinations for 5+20MHz, 10+20MHz, 15+20MHz, and 20+20MHz for supporting CA in contiguous spectrum block of 25MHz, 30MHz, 35MHz, and 40MHz, and add the performance requirements for this band in the relevant specifications.

question_31129.question: What should the new NF service consumer do if it cannot support handling notifications from the NF service producer after a change?
question_31129.ground_truth: The new NF service consumer should update the NF service producer with the new Notification URI.

question_31130.question: What is the function of a Redirect Diameter Agent (DA) when a client has to send a request to an unknown HSS?
question_31130.ground_truth: A Redirect Diameter Agent determines the identity of the HSS and returns it to the client, which then forwards the request to the HSS identified.

question_31132.question: What is the definition of a superseding-band?
question_31132.ground_truth: A superseding-band of an operating band includes the whole of the uplink and downlink frequency range of the operating band.

question_31133.question: What is the rationale for defining the OTA RX IM requirement based on the conducted RX IM requirement?
question_31133.ground_truth: The OTA RX IM requirement is defined based on the conducted RX IM requirement, with the conducted signal levels translated to OTA levels to account for various factors that mitigate the need for complex investigation.

question_31135.question: What is the condition for CT106 and CT109 in the modified V.110 frames received from the SS?
question_31135.ground_truth: CT106 and CT109 should be turned on when the X and SB bits are set in the modified V.110 frames received from the SS.

question_31136.question: What is the purpose of trace functionality in E-UTRAN/EPC?
question_31136.ground_truth: The purpose of trace functionality in E-UTRAN/EPC is to trace vendor specific data for troubleshooting, which requires allowing vendor specific data in the Equipment trace and the trace file for E-UTRAN.

question_31137.question: What is the result of a successful location service update procedure for the Location Management Client?
question_31137.ground_truth: After a successful location service update procedure, the Location Management Server will have updated the UE's location capabilities, allowing the system to better handle location requests for the UE.

question_31140.question: Which 3GPP TS provides a framework for Internet Protocol (IP) based streaming applications in 3G networks?
question_31140.ground_truth: The 3GPP PSS provides a framework for IP-based streaming applications in 3G networks.

question_31142.question: What are the parameters of the UPPCH-LCR-InformationItem-ResourceStatusInd in the UPPCH-LCR-InformationList-ResourceStatusInd?
question_31142.ground_truth: The UPPCH-LCR-InformationItem-ResourceStatusInd is a sequence that contains several parameters including uARFCN (optional), uPPCHPositionLCR, resourceOperationalState, availabilityStatus, iE-Extensions (optional), and a few other optional parameters.

question_31143.question: How can unsolicited communication (UC) distribution be countered in a phishing attack?
question_31143.ground_truth: UC distribution in a phishing attack can be countered by blocking other steps, such as through URL filtering against known phishing sites or by using heuristic approaches to look for specific techniques used by phishers.

question_31144.question: What is the role of the MCPTT server in the emergency private call transformation?
question_31144.ground_truth: The MCPTT server adjusts the priority of the underlying bearer for both participants, retaining the higher priority until the call ends.

question_31145.question: What are some of the differences between the use of Diameter messages in 17.2 and 17.6 for network slice specific authentication?
question_31145.ground_truth: Some of the differences include the replacement of SMF with NSSAAF or AAA-P, the exclusion of IP, Ethernet and PDU session descriptions and AVPs, and the exclusion of accounting function, ACR and ACA messages. Additionally, 3GPP-S-NSSAI is included in the DER command and the address of NSS-AAA server is included in the Origin-Host AVP in the ASR and RAR commands. The presence of 3GPP-S-NSSAI in the DER command is optional, but it is mandatory for the NSSAAF or AAA-P to include it for network slice specific authentication.

question_31146.question: In what way does solution #5 allow PINEs to join or leave a PIN without 5GC involvement?
question_31146.ground_truth: Solution #5 allows PINEs to join or leave a PIN without 5GC involvement by having the PIN AS authorize whether a PINE is allowed to join a PIN, and having the PEMC invite or expel a PINE from a PIN. A PINE can also request to join or leave a PIN.

question_31147.question: What does the term "freezing" of specifications in the context of 3GPP TS 21.900 indicate?
question_31147.ground_truth: "Freezing" of specifications in the context of 3GPP TS 21.900 refers to the last two columns of the 3GPP technical specifications and technical reports, which indicate the status of the specification and if it is available for public or restricted use.

question_31149.question: What is the primary reason Company A adopted Ambient IoT devices for their intralogistics process?
question_31149.ground_truth: After a comprehensive analysis, Company A adopted Ambient IoT devices for their intralogistics process due to its attractive wireless communication characteristics and suitability for their long-term business objectives.

question_31150.question: What is the N15 reference point used for and where is it located in non-roaming scenarios?
question_31150.ground_truth: The N15 reference point is used for the AMF to access the UE Policy Control Service at the PCF. In non-roaming scenarios, the N15 reference point is located between the PCF and the AMF.

question_31152.question: Which parameters must be set in the PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message in clause 7.7.2.2 if the initiating UE initiates this procedure?
question_31152.ground_truth: The ProSe identifiers and the target user info must be set in the PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message.

question_31154.question: Upon reception of SIB7, what should the UE do with the received warning message segments when it has all segments of a warning message and the complete warning message has not been assembled within a period of 3 hours?
question_31154.ground_truth: The UE should discard the stored warningMessageSegment and the current values of messageIdentifier and serialNumber for SIB7 if the complete warning message has not been assembled within the specified period.

question_31155.question: What action is taken by the source Node B after detecting a RL restoration?
question_31155.ground_truth: The source Node B sends a NBAP message Radio Link Restoration Indication to the source RNC.

question_31160.question: What are the PUCCH format 2 and CQI reporting periodicity used in this test case?
question_31160.ground_truth: The PUCCH format 2 is used for periodic CQI reporting with a reporting periodicity of 5 ms.

question_31161.question: What happens when a PTC session is initiated but has not been established, or when the PTC target has at least one PTC session active in progress, and a PTC Start of Interception Begin Record is generated?
question_31161.ground_truth: The first condition triggers the report when a PTC session is initiated but not yet established, and the second condition triggers the report when the PTC target already has at least one active PTC session in progress.

question_31162.question: What is the VAL service area, and how is it identified?
question_31162.ground_truth: The VAL service area refers to the geographical area(s) served by a VAL server. It is identified by the VAL service area identifier, which is a unique identifier assigned to the VAL service area by the location management server.

question_31163.question: What is the role of the Bootstrapping Server Function (BSF) in GBA Push?
question_31163.ground_truth: The BSF provides the keying material needed to establish a security association between a NAF and a UE using GBA Push.

question_31164.question: What should the SMF do if the requirements in clause 5.8.2.4 are fulfilled?
question_31164.ground_truth: The SMF should initiate the PDU Session Release with Reactivation procedure to the UE, to trigger the UE to re-establish IMS PDUS session.

question_31165.question: What is the document produced by in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project?
question_31165.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project produced the "Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects; Telecommunication management; Generic Integration Reference Point (IRP) management; Solution Set (SS) definitions" document.

question_31166.question: What network identifiers need to be exchanged by inter-operator agreements in advance for the support of certain SIP requests and responses in IMS networks?
question_31166.ground_truth: Operator network identifiers populated in the type 1 "orig-ioi" and type 1 "term-ioi" header field parameters; type 2 "orig-ioi" and type 2 "term-ioi" header field parameters; and the "transit-ioi" header field parameter.

question_31167.question: How can reporting of multiple Reception Acknowledgement (RAck) be aggregated in MBMS?
question_31167.ground_truth: Reception Acknowledgement reports can be aggregated by including multiple statisticalReport elements in a single reception report, each relating to a different serviceId, or by using multipart MIME to aggregate several reception report XML files.

question_31169.question: What is the role of the MBSF in the MBS session creation process without PCC?
question_31169.ground_truth: The MBSF is responsible for providing MBSF-related interactions and detailed interactions with the MBSTF in the MBS session creation process without PCC.

question_31170.question: What is the procedure between the CP and UP function during GTP based S2b for roaming, non-roaming and LBO where new PGW-C selects new PGW-U and creates an Sx session?
question_31170.ground_truth: The new PGW-C selects a new PGW-U and creates an Sx session with PGW-U during GTP based S2b for roaming, non-roaming and LBO, where new PGW-C sends an Sx Session Establishment Request to the selected PGW-U for creating Sx session for the UE.

question_31171.question: What specific requirements are defined for the Network Resource Model in the present document?
question_31171.ground_truth: The specific requirements for the Network Resource Model defined by this IRP include supporting EPC Network entities in the 3GPP Release, MME pool management specific IOCs and related definitions, E-MBMS specific IOCs and related definitions, management of communication between EPC and 3GPP access (including E-UTRAN and EN-DC), trusted non-3GPP access and untrusted non-3GPP access, and EPS/5GS interworking management in EPC side.

question_31172.question: In the "GPRS attach / accepted" test, what is the expected behavior of the MS if the network accepts the GPRS attach procedure and reallocates a new P-TMSI?
question_31172.ground_truth: If the network accepts the GPRS attach procedure and reallocates a new P-TMSI, the MS shall acknowledge the new P-TMSI and continue communication with the new P-TMSI.

question_31173.question: What is the main objective of Further Advancements for E-UTRA, as outlined in Release 17 of the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_31173.ground_truth: The main objective of Further Advancements for E-UTRA is to define a framework for further advancements of E-UTRA and E-UTRAN, while meeting ITU-R requirements and 3GPP operator requirements, as well as maintaining and progressing general enhancements for Release 8 E-UTRA and E-UTRAN.

question_31174.question: When generating a position estimate for a 3-dimensional position in GPS positioning, what action should the UE take if it has calculated a 3-dimensional position and the IE "Vertical Accuracy" is assigned to a value unequal to 0?
question_31174.ground_truth: The UE should include the IE "Ellipsoid point with altitude and uncertainty ellipsoid" as the position estimate.

question_31175.question: What should the UE consider as the cell sorting quantity when deciding which cells to include in measurement reporting?
question_31175.ground_truth: If the reportQuantities is set to rsrq, the UE should consider RSRQ as the cell sorting quantity. If not, the UE should consider RSRP as the cell sorting quantity.

question_31177.question: Who is responsible for selecting the delivery mode of the protected group message in the SCEF?
question_31177.ground_truth: The SCEF is responsible for the selection of the delivery mode based on business agreements.

question_31179.question: What is the function of the "Record-Route" header field in a SIP INVITE request?
question_31179.ground_truth: The "Record-Route" header field in a SIP INVITE request specifies the address that the ATCF-vA1 wants to receive subsequent in-dialog requests from the SCC AS-hA1.

question_31180.question: What information does the UE transmit to the LMF when requested to measure DL PRS and UL SRS?
question_31180.ground_truth: The UE transmits UL SRS if requested at step~7 and/or measures DL PRS from the MBSR (and other gNBs) if requested at step~9, including the time of measurements when measured.

question_31182.question: What is the purpose of reducing the E-TFCI information in the E-DPCCH?
question_31182.ground_truth: The purpose of reducing the E-TFCI information in the E-DPCCH is to optimize the E-TFCI overhead that can be significant in low data rate operations. This would reduce implementation complexity and enable blind detection of the E-DPCCH by the Node B.

question_31185.question: What kind of network is defined as "NPN" in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_31185.ground_truth: "NPN" in the 3GPP Technical Specification refers to a Non-Public Network, which is a network used for mission critical communications in a private or restricted environment.

question_31186.question: What is the length of the ALPHA identifier and BCD number in the first record of EF~ADN for the FDN SIM?
question_31186.ground_truth: The length of the ALPHA identifier is 32 characters, and the BCD number is "03" with a dialled number of 123.

question_31188.question: What features are desired for the EVS codec beyond the project objectives?
question_31188.ground_truth: It is further desirable that the codec fulfills needs for enhanced voice services in other 3GPP systems, such as Circuit Switched (CS) domain, and provides a set of new specifications including textual description of the coding algorithm and VAD/DTX/CNG scheme.

question_31189.question: What is a media profile in the context of 3GPP VR?
question_31189.ground_truth: A media profile in the context of 3GPP VR is a set of requirements and constraints for a specific media type in a 3GPP VR track.

question_31191.question: What is the essential component of the Downlink interference management based on mapping between PCIs and transmission patterns?
question_31191.ground_truth: A centralized coordinator that generates a number of transmission patterns and a function which maps transmission patterns to PCIs and sends the information to all cells.

question_31193.question: What is the primary advantage of using IP based A-interface for the user plane?
question_31193.ground_truth: The primary advantage of using IP based A-interface for the user plane is the much more flexible network design between the BSS and the CS core.

question_31194.question: How does the DSO modify or update information in the MOI?
question_31194.ground_truth: The DSO sends a modifyMOIAttributes request to the MNO in order to modify or update any information in the MOI. The DSO can create, read, update, or delete (CRUD) the information in the MOI by using provisioning MnS.

question_31195.question: What state shall a system remain in if it is not permitted and the floor has been taken?
question_31195.ground_truth: The system shall remain in the 'U: not permitted and Floor Taken' state

question_31196.question: What is the effect of sending '0' as the <sec> value in the CAPD command?
question_31196.ground_truth: Sending '0' as the <sec> value in the CAPD command dismisses a currently active alarm.

question_31197.question: Which resource allocation scheme is used for PDCCH/SPDCCH with uplink DCI format 7-0A/7-0B for allocating virtual resource block assignments?
question_31197.ground_truth: Resource allocation scheme Type 0 is used for PDCCH/SPDCCH with uplink DCI format 7-0A/7-0B for allocating virtual resource block assignments.

question_31198.question: What is the requirement for an MCX Service when an MCX User wants to cancel an In-progress Imminent Peril?
question_31198.ground_truth: The MCX Service shall support cancellation of an In-progress Imminent Peril by an authorized MCX User, an MCX Service Administrator, the Imminent Peril group communication initiator, or when criteria created by the MCX Service Administrator are met.

question_31199.question: What is the method described in section 5.3.2.1 for supporting UL MIMO operation using two HARQ processes and a single E-DCH transport channel?
question_31199.ground_truth: In this method, each HARQ process transmits a single transport block at the physical layer across two antennas using two precoding vectors in the same TTI.

question_31200.question: What is the default value of the <mode> parameter in the HSCSD parameters report +CHSR command?
question_31200.ground_truth: The default value of the <mode> parameter in the HSCSD parameters report +CHSR command is 0, which disables reporting.

question_31201.question: What is the reason for the re-INVITE request in step 84-88?
question_31201.ground_truth: The re-INVITE request in step 84-88 is to activate the video media component.

question_31205.question: How can the MBMS bearer quality be estimated when no data is sent?
question_31205.ground_truth: The MBMS bearer quality can be estimated using various methods, such as the modulation and coding scheme (MCS), measurements from reference signals from the eNB(s), and other metrics such as RTP packet loss.

question_31206.question: What is the role of the 5G U2U Relay PKMF in the U2U relay discovery process?
question_31206.ground_truth: The 5G U2U Relay PKMF is responsible for checking the authorization of the 5G ProSe UE, providing the discovery security materials related to U2U relay discovery, and specifying how the provided security material is used in the U2U relay discovery procedure.

question_31211.question: What is the test procedure to check the PLU timer behavior if the MS is out of coverage?
question_31211.ground_truth: The MS is deactivated and then activated and placed in automatic network selection mode. It performs IMSI attach and waits for 1 minute before cell A is switched off. Then, cell B is switched on 8 minutes after the IMSI attach procedure. The MS shall not location update on cell B before 11.75 minutes after the IMSI attach procedure, and the mobile shall perform a periodic location update on cell B between 11.75 minutes and 12.25 minutes after the IMSI attach procedure.

question_31212.question: What is the significance of an MCVideo in-progress emergency state cancel procedure?
question_31212.ground_truth: An MCVideo in-progress emergency state cancel procedure is used to explicitly cancel the emergency state of an MCVideo group, and can be initiated by an authorized user or through a specific emergency alert cancellation procedure.

question_31214.question: What is the role of 5G-XR AF in the UE and/or 5G-XR Application Provider?
question_31214.ground_truth: The 5G-XR AF provides control functions to the XR Session Handler on the UE and/or to the 5G-XR Application Provider. It may also interact with other network functions, relay or initiate requests for Policy or Charging Function (PCF) treatment.

question_31216.question: What is the effect of activating the Terminating Identification Restriction (TIR) for the FA Pilot Identity in terms of presenting the termination identification?
question_31216.ground_truth: The termination identification is not presented if the FA Pilot Identity has TIR activated.

question_31218.question: What is the impact of Rx beam orientation in the scenario where one boresight Tx beam is used at the RRH and one Rx beam is used at the UE?
question_31218.ground_truth: Rx beam orientation has a significant impact on performance. Wrong orientation of Rx beam results in significant loss of performance, while Rx beam oriented 10-15 degrees from the UE panel boresight towards the RRH provides the best performance in Scenario-B.

question_31219.question: What should the BSS do if it is unable to transfer the queued LLC-PDUs upon a transfer request from the SGSN?
question_31219.ground_truth: The BSS may indicate in the FLUSH-LL-ACK PDU that the LLC-PDUs were deleted, along with the number of octets actually deleted.

question_31221.question: What information is included in the PIN service switch notification sent by the PIN Server to the Application Server?
question_31221.ground_truth: The PIN service switch notification includes the PIN server identifier, PIN identifier, Application Client identifier, target PIN Client, application session identifier, and an IP 4 tuple that describes the traffic of the application session.

question_31222.question: What new elements are introduced in the File element of the FDT for providing the URL of the file on a content server or on a common dedicated server?
question_31222.ground_truth: Two optional elements are introduced in the File element of the FDT which can be used to provide the URL of the file on a content server or on a common dedicated server.

question_31228.question: What is the mandatory speech codec required to provide speech service in the 3GPP network?
question_31228.ground_truth: A default speech codec shall be specified to provide speech service.

question_31229.question: What should the FA transmit every 3 DATA frames in Phase D of the facsimile transmission in case of a 4th PPR for the same block?
question_31229.ground_truth: The FA should transmit 1 SYNC frame every 3 DATA frames in Phase D of the facsimile transmission in case of a 4th PPR for the same block.

question_31231.question: How is the 2D position error calculated in MS based testing?
question_31231.ground_truth: The 2D position error is calculated by comparing the reported Location Information in the Measure Position Response message against the simulated position of the MS used in step 1.

question_31232.question: What type of information can the NWDAF collect from other 5GC NFs for relative proximity analytics?
question_31232.ground_truth: The NWDAF collects a set of input data from other 5GC NFs such as DCAF and OAM for relative proximity analytics.

question_31233.question: What is the purpose of the solution described in section 6.9 of the document?
question_31233.ground_truth: The purpose of the solution described in section 6.9 of the document is to address Key Issue #4, which is "Securing initial access for UE onboarding between UE and SNPN".

question_31235.question: What is the purpose of the primary authentication procedure in the 5GS?
question_31235.ground_truth: The primary authentication procedure is started by the AMF/SEAF to authenticate the UE and establish a security context for the subsequent network procedures.

question_31236.question: What information does the AMF provide if a target AMF instance needs to be selected for intra-PLMN mobility?
question_31236.ground_truth: The AMF may provide AMF Set ID, AMF Region ID, target location information, S-NSSAI(s) of Allowed NSSAI, and optionally, the NRF to use.

question_31238.question: When must the MS abort the PS handover to GAN A/Gb mode?
question_31238.ground_truth: The MS must abort the PS handover to GAN A/Gb mode if connectivity has been lost on the GA-PSR Transport Channel before it has transmitted a GA-PSR HANDOVER COMPLETE message.

question_31239.question: What is the difference between the solution described in section 7.46.2.2 and section 7.47.2.2?
question_31239.ground_truth: The solution described in section 7.46.2.2 focuses on the EAS bundles scenario where bundled EAS(s) are associated with one EES or multiple EES(s), while the solution described in section 7.47.2.2 focuses on the EAS bundles scenario where bundled EAS(s) are associated with one AC and multiple EES(s).

question_31240.question: What is the mean UL Average-UPT gain for semi-static SBFD at low load level with SBFD Alt 4 and small packet size?
question_31240.ground_truth: The mean UL Average-UPT gain for semi-static SBFD at low load level with SBFD Alt 4 and small packet size is 104.37%.

question_31242.question: What is the purpose of testing that a Mobile Station (MS) discards the received GA-RRC PAGING REQUEST message (indicating CS domain page) if timer TU5908 is active for the CS domain?
question_31242.ground_truth: The purpose is to verify that the MS correctly discards the received GA-RRC PAGING REQUEST message and continues with the ongoing procedure when timer TU5908 is active for the CS domain, ensuring that the MS does not respond to outdated paging requests.

question_31244.question: What is the objective of 5.1.4 security features in 3GPP?
question_31244.ground_truth: The objective of 5.1.4 security features in 3GPP is to ensure that signalling data cannot be modified in an unauthorized way and to maintain the data origin of the signalling data.

question_31245.question: What is the significance of Services and protocol service names for the S-NAPTR procedure under 3GPP TS 23.003 clause 19.4.3?
question_31245.ground_truth: The Services and protocol service names for the S-NAPTR procedure under 3GPP TS 23.003 clause 19.4.3 are used in accordance with the 3GPP specifications to identify the service and protocols in the S-NAPTR procedure.

question_31246.question: What is the main difference between Approach 2-1 and Approach 2-2 in the "Number of CWs per TP" category?
question_31246.ground_truth: In Approach 2-1, up to two CWs per TP can be considered, while in Approach 2-2, only one CW per TP is allowed, with a change in DCI design.

question_31247.question: What function does the MC Security Gateway (SeGy) perform in relation to interworking with non-3GPP systems?
question_31247.ground_truth: The SeGy acts as a single MC client within the MC Domain to interwork with external systems that do not support mission critical security mechanisms, allowing for interconnection and interworking with non-3GPP systems.

question_31248.question: What is the purpose of the "E" parameter in the context of 5G ProSe direct discovery?
question_31248.ground_truth: The "E" parameter is used to scramble or unscramble the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message containing the ProSe restricted code in restricted 5G ProSe direct discovery.

question_31249.question: What is a registration area in the 5GS (5G System)?
question_31249.ground_truth: A registration area is a set of tracking areas, and each tracking area consists of one or more cells that cover a geographical area.

question_31250.question: Which requirement specifies the maximum output power for the uplink?
question_31250.ground_truth: The requirement for the maximum output power for the uplink is specified in clause 6.2.1 from 38.101-1.

question_31251.question: In which layer of RTP/RTCP signaling are ROI information parameters defined?
question_31251.ground_truth: ROI information parameters are defined in the application layer of RTP/RTCP signaling, independent of the negotiated video resolution for the encoded content.

question_31252.question: What are the network entities involved in the Content Management Web Service?
question_31252.ground_truth: The network entities involved in the Content Management Web Service are the service portal, Parlay X gateway, content server, streaming server, and end user. The end user uses the service portal to provide or consume content, while the content server functions as a content storage and management system in the network.

question_31253.question: What is one of the "Cons" or drawbacks of the solution based on existing CBS/PWS broadcast architecture for group triggering/messaging of MTC devices?
question_31253.ground_truth: One drawback is that the application needs to ensure that the UEs that need to receive the trigger have received the trigger, and if some in the group did not receive the trigger, the SCS/AS/MTC Server may have to individually trigger them.

question_31254.question: In which clause of the 3GPP TS 38.214 standard is the procedure for determining the TBS for DCI format 1C and DCI format 6-2 specified?
question_31254.ground_truth: The procedure for determining the TBS for DCI format 1C and DCI format 6-2 is specified in Clause 7.1.7.2.1.

question_31255.question: Which data type is used in the 3GPP Time Synchronization Exposure API to indicate the supported 5G clock quality (i.e. the source of time used by the 5GS)?
question_31255.ground_truth: The data type AsTimeResource is used in the 3GPP Time Synchronization Exposure API to indicate the supported 5G clock quality (i.e. the source of time used by the 5GS).

question_31261.question: On which reference points, as specified in this specification, should the Supported-Features AVP be used to identify features that have been defined by 3GPP?
question_31261.ground_truth: On all reference points as specified in this specification.

question_31262.question: What is the impact on clients of the PCRF, such as PCEF, BBERF, and AF, when the DRA is overloaded and running in PA1 mode?
question_31262.ground_truth: All messages between the clients of the PCRF and the PCRF go through the DRA, so when the DRA is overloaded, it can lead to timeout issues, session state mismatches, and improper charging, usage monitoring, or QoS management for the PCRF as well.

question_31263.question: What is required for the MCVideo server to initiate the termination of an ongoing ad-hoc group call?
question_31263.ground_truth: At least one of the termination conditions must be met, such as hang time expiry, last participant leaving, initiator leaving, or minimum number of affiliated MCVideo group members are not present.

question_31265.question: What is the resource partitioning approach used for the inband relay-eNodeB link?
question_31265.ground_truth: For the inband relay-eNodeB link, downlink and uplink transmissions for the eNB-RN and RN-UE links are time division multiplexed, with only one being active at any given time. Additionally, backhaul links may be multiplexed in FDD and TDD through the use of different frequency bands or subframes for uplink and downlink transmissions.

question_31266.question: What action does the gNB-DU take if the IAB TNL ADDRESS REQUEST message contains the IAB TNL Addresses To Remove List IE?
question_31266.ground_truth: The gNB-DU considers the listed TNL addresses and prefixes as no longer used by the IAB-node

question_31267.question: What is the priority of the alert termination within the FRMCS System?
question_31267.ground_truth: The termination of the alert has the priority which matches the application category of CRITICAL DATA within the FRMCS System.

question_31268.question: How is the time of arrival (TOA) for each ray in a cluster calculated in 7.6.2.1?
question_31268.ground_truth: The time of arrival (TOA) for each ray in a cluster is calculated by taking into account the delay of the ray within the cluster, and the delays due to the distance between the transmitter and receiver antennas in 7.6-4.

question_31269.question: How many dB of DPCH EcIor loss is experienced by the filtered UMTS in the downlink when the Geometry increases?
question_31269.ground_truth: The filtered UMTS experiences higher self-interference caused by the ICI, which results in a DPCH EcIor loss of around 3 dB as the Geometry increases.

question_31270.question: What should the value of Tselection timer be for the UE to start evaluating an inter-frequency FDD cell that is better ranked than the serving cell?
question_31270.ground_truth: If the value of Tselection timer is non-zero, the UE will start evaluating the inter-frequency FDD cell that is better ranked than the serving cell for the Treselection time.

question_31271.question: What is the first procedure a UE needs to perform for DSMIPv6 registration?
question_31271.ground_truth: The first procedure a UE needs to perform for DSMIPv6 registration is the discovery of the node acting as the home agent.

question_31273.question: What is the procedure followed by the IWF performing the participating role when determining a need to send a SIP BYE request?
question_31273.ground_truth: The IWF shall follow the procedures as specified in clause~6.6.2.1.3.

question_31276.question: What is indicated by the "RA List of Idle Mode UEs" in the MBMS Service Area IE?
question_31276.ground_truth: The RA List of Idle Mode UEs indicates the list of RAs where idle-mode UEs interested in a given Multicast Service are.

question_31279.question: When does the MC service server activate a functional alias for an MC service user?
question_31279.ground_truth: The MC service server activates a functional alias for an MC service user when a certain condition is met, there are no conflicts with current active functional aliases, and the limit of simultaneous MC service users is not reached.

question_31280.question: What is the OTA transmitter OFF TRP spectral density minimum requirement for NCR-Fwd type 2-O in NR repeater?
question_31280.ground_truth: The OTA transmitter OFF TRP spectral density for NCR-Fwd type 2-O in NR repeater shall be less than -36~dBm/MHz.

question_31283.question: What must be done to ensure that an IMS UE cannot modify key derivation?
question_31283.ground_truth: The IMS UE is not allowed to perform modifying key derivation by itself.

question_31285.question: What is the time to first SSB transmission after L1-RSRP measurement for TCI state switching involving QCL-TypeD?
question_31285.ground_truth: Tfirst-SSB is the time to first SSB transmission after L1-RSRP measurement for TCI state switching involving QCL-TypeD.

question_31286.question: What is the significance of ML entity performance indicators for the AI/ML inference?
question_31286.ground_truth: ML entity performance indicators are essential for performance evaluation during the inference phase.

question_31288.question: Which entity derives the challenge in UMTS/EPS AKA?
question_31288.ground_truth: The AuC/HSS in the Home Stratum.

question_31290.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function do if the in-progress emergency group state is "false" and the SIP re-INVITE request contains an imminent peril indication with a valid Resource-Priority header field?
question_31290.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should validate the SIP re-INVITE request and send a SIP UPDATE request towards the initiator of the SIP re-INVITE request if the request includes an improperly populated Resource-Priority header field. Upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP UPDATE request, the controlling MCVideo function should proceed with the rest of the steps.

question_31291.question: How many times can the "OSAppId" leaf occur in this interior node?
question_31291.ground_truth: The "OSAppId" leaf can occur one time in this interior node.

question_31292.question: What must be done if uplink PDCP delay results are available for reporting?
question_31292.ground_truth: The ul-PDCP-DelayResultList and ul-PDCP-DelayValueResultList must be set to include the uplink PDCP delay results available and the corresponding average uplink PDCP delay values, respectively.

question_31293.question: What are the potential implementation issues with 16QAM constellation?
question_31293.ground_truth: The potential implementation issues with 16QAM constellation include a higher peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR), which requires a larger backoff of the power amplifier at maximum output power and affects coverage areas in noise-limited environments. Additionally, the dynamic range of square 16QAM modulation reaches 40dB, which leads to wider linearity range requirements in the RF front end.

question_31294.question: What kind of message is transported in a MONP MCVIDEO MESSAGE CARRIER message in an off-network MCVideo group call?
question_31294.ground_truth: The MONP MCVIDEO MESSAGE CARRIER message is the entire payload of the UDP message.

question_31295.question: What should a UE do if it does not have the CFR information and subcarrier spacing for MBS broadcast reception on a non-serving cell at the time it sends the MBS Interest Indication?
question_31295.ground_truth: If the UE does not have the CFR information and subcarrier spacing for MBS broadcast reception on a non-serving cell at the time it sends the MBS Interest Indication, the UE shall send an MBS Interest Indication after it has acquired those information from the non-serving cell.

question_31296.question: When is an MS required to perform a combined routing area updating procedure with IMSI attach?
question_31296.ground_truth: When the MS is attached for GPRS services only and timer T3444 or T3445 is running.

question_31300.question: What are the two projection formats permitted by this operation point?

question_31301.question: In what mode is the transmit diversity used for HS-PDSCH if the P-CCPCH in the cell is not using transmit diversity?
question_31301.ground_truth: No transmit diversity is used for the HS-PDSCH subframe.

question_31302.question: What does it mean for an enumeration value to be applicable to only optional feature(s)?
question_31302.ground_truth: An enumeration value that is only applicable to optional feature(s) can only be used in JSON files if the corresponding feature has been negotiated and is supported.

question_31304.question: What is the purpose of the Generic Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP) as defined in 3GPP TS 28.621?
question_31304.ground_truth: The Generic Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP) provides a package of end-user functions for management of a set of closely related types of Network Elements (NEs) in the 3G network.

question_31305.question: What message does the SS send to the MS containing the location estimate in the test procedure?
question_31305.ground_truth: The SS returns location estimate to MS through DTAP LCS-MOLR Return Result.

question_31306.question: What are the two modes of network selection for WiMAX non-3GPP access network?
question_31306.ground_truth: The two modes of network selection for WiMAX non-3GPP access network are manual and automatic.

question_31307.question: What is the purpose of the RRC Connection Re-Establishment for the Control Plane for NB-IoT connected to 5GC solution?
question_31307.ground_truth: The solution addresses the key issue of security for RRC Connection Re-Establishment for the Control Plane for NB-IoT connected to 5GC.

question_31309.question: When does the UE send a WLCP PDN Modification Command message including a WLAN usable indication in multi-connection mode?
question_31309.ground_truth: The UE sends the WLCP PDN Modification Command message including a WLAN usable indication when it detects that the WLAN link is again usable for carrying IP flows and it is connected simultaneously to 3GPP and TWAN accesses.

question_31312.question: When a UE accesses the SNPN over NWu via a PLMN, what indication is sent towards the UE during the Registration procedure to indicate if an IMS voice over PS session is supported or not?
question_31312.ground_truth: The AMF in the SNPN sends the indication during the Registration procedure to indicate whether an IMS voice over PS session is supported or not.

question_31313.question: What is the requirement for successful mobility between two MBMS bearers (TMGI 1 and TMGI 2) without the need for area change reporting?
question_31313.ground_truth: The requirement is the presence of an application level signalling bearer TMGI 9 in the full area (TMGI 1 and TMGI 2) that can broadcast all application control messages for all VAL service communication in both areas.

question_31314.question: What analytics information can the PCF request from the NWDAF upon reception of a request from AF/NEF for negotiation for future background data transfer?

question_31317.question: When should the UE transmit a MeasurementReport message including the MeasResultCellSFTD IE in the test described in 8.2.3.17.3.1?
question_31317.ground_truth: The UE should transmit the measurement report when the sfn-OffsetResult and frameBoundaryOffsetResult results for the Serving E-UTRA PSCell become available.

question_31318.question: What is the role of ITU-T P.NATS phase 2 in the P.NATS project?
question_31318.ground_truth: ITU-T P.NATS phase 2 aims at extending the quality model for supporting 2K and 4K.

question_31319.question: When is a UE required to provide the NB-IoT UE radio capabilities to the network?
question_31319.ground_truth: A UE is required to provide NB-IoT UE radio capabilities to the network when it is camping on NB-IoT.

question_31320.question: What entity is responsible for transforming the service area information into Service Area Information expressed in a list of TAI or cell ID?
question_31320.ground_truth: The NEF (Non-3GPP Interworking Function) is responsible for this transformation.

question_31321.question: What is the minimum requirement for ACLR for single-carrier in normal test environment?
question_31321.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for ACLR for single-carrier in normal test environment is specified in TS~36.104 subclause 6.6.2.1.

question_31324.question: What is a potential requirement for extending Assured Voice Communication to a new user in FRMCS?
question_31324.ground_truth: The use of Assured Voice Communication should be activated for the ongoing voice communication.

question_31326.question: What color sub-sampling does the Chroma Format use?

question_31327.question: What must the data type be if the presence condition of a data structure in the response body is "C" or "O"?
question_31327.ground_truth: The data type can be "integer", "number", "string", or "boolean", or a data type defined in a 3GPP specification. If the presence condition is "C" or "O", the cardinality shall be set to "0..1".

question_31331.question: What action does End UE#1 perform before sending a Link Modification Request message in Scenario #1?
question_31331.ground_truth: End UE#1 decides to perform U2U Relay reselection with End UE#2 and to generate a new KNRP ID with End UE#2 based on this decision to maintain the current connection via Relay#1.

question_31333.question: What are the two network scenarios defined in this feasibility study?
question_31333.ground_truth: Two network scenarios have been defined in this feasibility study: one focusing on HSDPA-only traffic, and the second focusing on HSDPA + Release 99 voice traffic.

question_31334.question: How many UEA identifiers are defined and what does each of them represent?
question_31334.ground_truth: There are four UEA identifiers defined: UEA0 (no encryption), UEA1 (Kasumi), UEA2 (SNOW 3G), and one undefined.

question_31337.question: What entity is responsible for applying the received DL UE Slice MBR limit to the set of all bearers for which the SN hosts PDCP for the concerned Slice in MR-DC with 5GC?
question_31337.ground_truth: The PDCP entity at the SN

question_31339.question: What information is sent from the EES/UE/EEC to the EES in step 1 of the solution described in clause 6.31.2?
question_31339.ground_truth: The UE's IP address and the verification information (the random number in GBA scenarios or A-KID in AKMA scenarios) are sent from the EES/UE/EEC to the EES in step 1 of the solution described in clause 6.31.2.

question_31340.question: When does the SS use a Channel Mode Modify procedure in step 3b?
question_31340.ground_truth: In step 3b, the SS uses a Channel Mode Modify procedure to change the active codec set to the following set: With the Initial Codec Mode set to the 12.2 kbit/s mode and specific decision thresholds and hysteresis values.

question_31342.question: Which test case applies to all types of NR UE that support UL MIMO?
question_31342.ground_truth: The test case in 6.4D.3.2 applies to all types of NR UE that support UL MIMO.

question_31343.question: What action does the floor control arbitration logic take when it receives an implicit floor request due to an upgrade to an emergency group call or imminent peril call?
question_31343.ground_truth: The floor control arbitration logic stops timer T1 (End of RTP media) and T20 (Floor Granted), sets the Reject Cause field in the Floor Revoke message to #4 (Media Burst pre-empted), enters the 'G: pending Floor Revoke' state, inserts the floor participant into the active floor request queue to the position in front of all other queued requests, and sends a Floor Queue Position Info message to the requesting floor participant.

question_31347.question: In the context of network failure, what action does the MME take when dedicated bearers fail to be established?
question_31347.ground_truth: The MME indicates the failed bearers in the Path Switch Request Ack message and initiates the bearer release procedure to release the core network resources of the failed dedicated EPS bearers.

question_31350.question: What information is sent in the PACKET UPLINK ASSIGNMENT message sent during the subsequent two phase access procedure in the test procedure?
question_31350.ground_truth: In the PACKET UPLINK ASSIGNMENT message sent during the subsequent two phase access procedure in the test procedure, an RTTI mode TBF with 2 uplink PDCH pairs using RTTI USF mode with EXTENDED DYNAMIC ALLOCATION is allocated.

question_31351.question: What should the UE do before sending a correctly composed INVITE request for an emergency call when the UE has sent unprotected and then protected REGISTER request, as specified in TS 24.229 clause 5.1.6.3 in 3GPP TS 23.003?
question_31351.ground_truth: The UE shall send a correctly composed INVITE request without location information when the UE receives a valid 200 OK response for the REGISTER sent for authentication.

question_31353.question: What happens when the Edge Enabler Server is not able to fulfill or provide the services indicated by the Application Client Profile(s)?
question_31353.ground_truth: The Edge Enabler Server will indicate this in the Edge Enabler Client registration response, and the Edge Enabler Client must send a registration request with an Update Indication prior to the expiration to maintain the current registration.

question_31354.question: What information elements should be included in the GA-RRC RELOCATION REQUEST message if the handover involves both CS and PS domains?
question_31354.ground_truth: The CTC Activation List and PTC Activation List information elements should be included in the GA-RRC RELOCATION REQUEST message if the handover involves both CS and PS domains.

question_31355.question: What would cause an error sample in the calculation of the PAN error rate for GSM MS?
question_31355.ground_truth: An error sample is counted when the MS re-transmits one or more BSNs in any particular set after they have been acknowledged by a PAN field in the time-based format.

question_31356.question: What kind of LAI and TMSI should the MME allocate for a UE in "SMS in MME" attach procedure?
question_31356.ground_truth: The MME should allocate a non-broadcasted LAI (not associated with any VLR) and a reserved TMSI for a UE in the "SMS in MME" attach procedure.

question_31357.question: In what circumstances should the mobile station transmit an RLC/MAC control message other than a PACKET DOWNLINK ACK/NACK message?
question_31357.ground_truth: The mobile station should transmit an RLC/MAC control message other than a PACKET DOWNLINK ACK/NACK message if it is polled and it has another RLC/MAC control message to transmit, except when the PACKET DOWNLINK ACK/NACK message would contain a Final Ack Indicator or Channel Request Description IE.

question_31358.question: When is the UE required to transmit PRACH on PUCCH SCell and allowed to drop or cause interruption to SRS or PUCCH or PUSCH transmission on the SpCell or any activated SCell?
question_31358.ground_truth: The UE is required to transmit PRACH on PUCCH SCell and allowed to drop or cause interruption to SRS or PUCCH or PUSCH transmission on the SpCell or any activated SCell if the UE is not capable of parallelTxPRACH-SRS-PUCCH-PUSCH for inter-band CA, and PRACH on PUCCH SCell and PUCCH/PUSCH/SRS on other active serving cells are fully or partially overlapping in time.

question_31359.question: What is a service type in which data is sent from a single network termination to another network termination?

question_31360.question: What abbreviations are used in the document and what do they stand for?
question_31360.ground_truth: ACK stands for Acknowledgement, ANSI stands for American National Standards Institute, CRC stands for Cyclic Redundancy Check, FEC stands for Forward Error Correction, GSM stands for Global System for Mobile communications, HARQ stands for Hybrid Automatic Repeat-reQuest, I/O stands for Input/Output, IVS stands for In-Vehicle System, MSD stands for Minimum Set of Data, NACK stands for Negative Acknowledgement, PCM stands for Pulse Code Modulation, PSAP stands for Public Safety Answering Point, RAM stands for Random Access Memory, ROM stands for Read Only Memory, RX stands for Receive, and TX stands for Transmit.

question_31362.question: What is the recommended security measure for the OP and RP interface in the GBA Architecture?
question_31362.ground_truth: It is recommended to secure the RP OP interface properly for security reasons.

question_31363.question: What are the factors that affect the TCI state switching delay for a MAC-CE based switch if the TCI state is unknown?
question_31363.ground_truth: For a MAC-CE based TCI state switch with an unknown target TCI state, the delay is affected by the time for Rx beam refinement in FR2 for CSI-RS measurements, the number of resources in the resource set for aperiodic CSI-RS, and the value of TOuk based on whether the TCI state switching involves QCL-TypeD or other QCL types.

question_31365.question: Which method indicates that the attempt to delete a message was unsuccessful?

question_31366.question: What is the role of the "influence-id" in the PCC Rules of the SMF?
question_31366.ground_truth: The "influence-id" in the PCC Rules of the SMF is used to determine the lists of DNAIs in different PDU Sessions that are related to each other. It helps to assign the same traffic influence service data to multiple ad-hoc groups, where each group may have different traffic influence service data containing the same DNN/S-NSSAI.

question_31367.question: What is the role of the "originating UE" and "terminating UE" in the Direct connectivity phase on WLAN Direct?
question_31367.ground_truth: The originating UE and terminating UE initiate the connectivity procedure for WLAN Direct as currently defined. This process is out of scope for 3GPP.

question_31368.question: What should be set as the PDN type for the default EPS bearer context when creating the contents of a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message for a PDU session with PDU session type "IPv6"?
question_31368.ground_truth: The PDN type should be set to "IPv6".

question_31372.question: What is the benefit of the optimized SMS relay solution?
question_31372.ground_truth: The optimized SMS relay solution reduces signalling procedures on the radio interface and eliminates the need for resource reservation over the radio interface, ultimately conserving battery life and reducing costs.

question_31374.question: What is the purpose of the Delta Synchronization IRP?
question_31374.ground_truth: The Delta Synchronization IRP is designed to define an interface that allows an IRPManager to request only changed data (i.e., created, modified, or deleted) from a synchronization point onwards.

question_31375.question: In SL-TOA positioning method, what measurements do the peer UEs use to determine the location of the target UE?
question_31375.ground_truth: SL-RTOA (and optionally SL-PRS-RSRP and/or SL-PRS-RSRPP) measurements.

question_31376.question: What information does the 3G/2G SGSN use to determine the type of handover is inter-RAT/mode handover?
question_31376.ground_truth: The 3G/2G SGSN uses the Target Cell Identifier to determine that the type of handover is inter-RAT/mode handover.

question_31377.question: What is the difference between a call leg and an intra-BSS call in the context of 3GPP networks?
question_31377.ground_truth: A call leg refers to the access link between a mobile station and the Core Network, while an intra-BSS call is a mobile to mobile voice call involving two mobile stations connected to the same BSS.

question_31380.question: What action should the V-PCF take when it determines a received "MANAGE UE POLICY COMPLETE" or "MANAGE UE POLICY COMMAND REJECT" message is related to the result of a "MANAGE UE POLICY COMMAND" message?
question_31380.ground_truth: The V-PCF shall determine if the message is related to the result of a UE policy provided by the H-PCF and forward the corresponding "MANAGE UE POLICY COMPLETE" or "MANAGE UE POLICY COMMAND REJECT" message to the H-PCF.

question_31381.question: What is the minimum requirement for MSR UTRA FDD operation in terms of CPICH power requirement?
question_31381.ground_truth: There is no CPICH power requirement for MSR UTRA FDD operation.

question_31382.question: What are the three operations defined in clause 5.2.7 of TS~23.502 that the P-CSCF uses to register, update, and deregister the P-CSCF address in NRF services?

question_31383.question: What is the purpose of the token value exchanged between the RNC and UE during a full Service Request procedure?
question_31383.ground_truth: The token value serves as a reference to the UE context in the RNC and can also reference other UE context information. It allows for more efficient handling of security and token-based operation.

question_31384.question: What is the use of the defaultDestinationAddressList parameter in the openMultiMediaMessaging() method?
question_31384.ground_truth: The defaultDestinationAddressList parameter is used to identify the default set of users that a message is to be sent to when using the openMultiMediaMessaging() method.

question_31386.question: What radio carrier allows concurrent data sessions while receiving broadcast/multicast content in this use case?

question_31387.question: What are the implications of the HS-DSCH Credits IE in the HS-DSCH CAPACITY ALLOCATION Control Frame (TYPE 1 or TYPE 2)?
question_31387.ground_truth: The value of the HS-DSCH Credits IE in the HS-DSCH CAPACITY ALLOCATION Control Frame (TYPE 1 or TYPE 2) determines the capacity granted for the MAC-d flow. If HS-DSCH Credits IE = 0, the CRNC must immediately stop transmission of MAC-d PDUs, while HS-DSCH Credits IE = 2047 in the HS-DSCH CAPACITY ALLOCATION TYPE 1 Control Frame or 65535 in the HS-DSCH CAPACITY ALLOCATION TYPE 2 Control Frame allows the CRNC to transmit MAC-d PDUs with unlimited capacity.

question_31388.question: What is the capability required of the 3GPP system to support an Ethernet transport service?
question_31388.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall be able to support routing based on information extracted from Ethernet frame headers, routing based on information extracted from Virtual LAN (VLAN) ID, and sufficient QoS capabilities to meet the request in the Ethernet header information.

question_31389.question: What should the MME do if it receives an ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message as a result of a UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure or a UE requested bearer resource modification procedure?
question_31389.ground_truth: If the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message is received as a result of a UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure or a UE requested bearer resource modification procedure, the MME should include the procedure transaction identity (PTI) value received by the MME in the BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST or BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST respectively in the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.

question_31390.question: What must the AC include in an AC deregistration request for the EEC to successfully process it?
question_31390.ground_truth: The AC must include the registration ID and AC's security credentials in the deregistration request.

question_31391.question: What is the expected result for the S-CSCF under test in the Authenticated re-registration procedure?
question_31391.ground_truth: The S-CSCF under test authenticates the user by means of the AKA protocol.

question_31392.question: What is the relaxed version of the Minimum Requirement in 5.2BC.5?
question_31392.ground_truth: The relaxed version of the Minimum Requirement in 5.2BC.5 is defined in clause~F.2 and the explanation of how the Minimum Requirement has been relaxed by the Test Tolerance is given in clause~F.4.

question_31395.question: Which feature of CoAP allows it to make use of HTTP interaction enhancements and enable block-wise transfers without relying on IP fragmentation?
question_31395.ground_truth: CoAP has been enhanced further to support enhancements such as observation of resources (RFC7641) and is being enhanced further to support block-wise transfers, making it a versatile web transfer protocol for use with constrained nodes and constrained networks while allowing for flexible HTTP interaction.

question_31396.question: What is the maximum delay uncertainty allowed in the measurement reporting delay as defined in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 8.11.2.1.1.1?
question_31396.ground_truth: The delay uncertainty is 2 x TTI DCCH.

question_31397.question: What are the benefits of supporting both direct AI/ML and AI/ML assisted positioning approaches in indoor factory scenarios?
question_31397.ground_truth: They can significantly improve the positioning accuracy compared to existing RAT-dependent positioning methods in the evaluated indoor factory scenarios.

question_31398.question: What is a potential risk if NAF specific keys are used directly in JavaScript instead of NAF specific authentication tokens?
question_31398.ground_truth: The risk is that the direct usage of NAF specific keys in JavaScript introduces even greater security vulnerabilities.

question_31399.question: When can the network slice data rate limitation control be not applicable for the S-NSSAI(s)?
question_31399.ground_truth: Based on operator policy, the network slice data rate limitation control can be not applicable for the S-NSSAI(s) used for emergency services or priority services.

question_31400.question: Which protocol is used as the basis for the MPQUIC steering functionality in clause 6.11?
question_31400.ground_truth: The MPQUIC steering functionality is based on RFC~9298 "proxying UDP in HTTP" and the HTTP/3 protocol, which operates on top of the QUIC protocol.

question_31401.question: In the overall context, what is the main concern that the introduced solutions aim to address?
question_31401.ground_truth: The main concern that the introduced solutions aim to address is network function (NF) certification, lifecycle management, and security.

question_31404.question: What field in the Spatial Relation for Resource IDi indicates the type of a resource used as a spatial relation for the i-th Positioning SRS resource?

question_31405.question: What event triggers the IRI-POI in the EES to generate an xIRI containing an EESAppContextRelocation record in 7.14.2.6?
question_31405.ground_truth: The IRI-POI present in the EES detects that an EEC has requested ACR (Application Context Relocation) determination or initiation.

question_31406.question: Which reference point is used for QoS policy information transfer between PCRF and ePDG in specific scenarios?
question_31406.ground_truth: The Gxb* reference point is used for transporting access information from ePDG to PCRF/vPCRF for WLAN UEs such as the UE local IP address and the UDP port number in the interworking with Fixed Broadband Access network.

question_31407.question: What is the effect of receiving an I1 Progress message with Progress reason set to Ringing on the ICS UE's locally generated alerting procedure?
question_31407.ground_truth: The ICS UE may begin a locally generated alerting procedure if an I1 Progress message with Progress reason set to Ringing is received while the I1 session is in the "proceeding" state.

question_31409.question: What must the MT perform when the MT is not currently attached during the IP context activation procedure?
question_31409.ground_truth: The MT must perform the PS-attach procedure if the MT is not currently attached during the IP context activation procedure.

question_31411.question: What kind of RF components must be considered by RAN4 to support multiple component carriers in LTE and NR for DC band combinations?
question_31411.ground_truth: RAN4 considers specific RF components such as Diplexer, Triplexer, Quadplexer, and Hexaplexer to derive self-interference problems for DC band combinations in LTE and NR.

question_31412.question: What action does the gNB-CU-UP take if it does not receive a GNB-CU-CP E1 SETUP RESPONSE message or GNB-CU-CP E1 SETUP FAILURE message?
question_31412.ground_truth: If the gNB-CU-UP does not receive either of these messages, it may reinitiate the gNB-CU-CP E1 Setup procedure towards the same gNB-CU-CP.

question_31414.question: What should be included in the TOE description for a network product class?
question_31414.ground_truth: The TOE description should include all elements mandated by relevant SCAS requirements, all interfaces of the TSF, and all external communication interfaces of the TOE. If the TOE is not the entire product as packaged for evaluation, the interfaces between the TOE and the parts of the network product not in the TOE should also be described as external communication interfaces of the TOE.

question_31415.question: What HTTP status code is returned when a PATCH request to update the PSI activation state is successful?

question_31416.question: What message does the MN send to the source SN to indicate that CPC is prepared in step 5?
question_31416.ground_truth: The MN sends the SN Change Confirm message towards the source SN to indicate that CPC is prepared.

question_31417.question: What must the MRFC include in the SDP offer when requesting MSRP media handling?
question_31417.ground_truth: The MRFC shall include the value of the "MSRP URI Path" information element received from the MRFP in the "a=path" SDP attribute of the SDP offer it sends, and should include the "a=msrp-cema" SDP attribute in the SDP offer.

question_31418.question: Which parameter determines the power-ramping factor in case of a prioritized Random Access procedure?

question_31419.question: What are the RAT-independent positioning techniques supported in Rel-16 LPP for GNSS?
question_31419.ground_truth: The RAT-independent positioning techniques supported in Rel-16 LPP for GNSS are GNSS SSR (PPP-RTK support) and include the transmission of SSR Phase Bias, SSR STEC Corrections, SSR Gridded Correction, SSR URA, and SSR Correction Points.

question_31421.question: What should the initiating UE do after receiving the PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE ACCEPT message from the target UE?
