question_31421.ground_truth: The initiating UE should transmit the PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE ACK message with the old layer-2 IDs if it receives another PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE ACCEPT message from the target UE before it receives the traffic from the target UE with the new layer-2 IDs.

question_31422.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects?
question_31422.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group for Services and System Aspects is responsible for standardizing the technical specifications for the 3GPP's telecommunication network.

question_31424.question: What is the message sent by the source gNB to a candidate gNB to request CHO for one or more candidate cells belonging to the candidate gNBs?
question_31424.ground_truth: A CHO request message is sent for each candidate cell.

question_31426.question: What action does the multi-USIM device take when it receives a "reverse" Push Notification for lower or equal priority traffic while UE A is processing a paging in system A?
question_31426.ground_truth: The multi-USIM device sends a Push Notification NAK to stop the paging of UE B in system B as soon as possible.

question_31427.question: In 5G, when is the physical layer instructed to generate acknowledgement(s) of the data in a TB?
question_31427.ground_truth: The physical layer is instructed to generate acknowledgement(s) of the data in a TB if the HARQ process is associated with a successful transmission, if it is equal to the broadcast process, or if the timeAlignmentTimer is not stopped or expired.

question_31428.question: What percentage of PC2/PC3/PC5 UE can have a minimum SINR of 25 dB at the BS side in the indoor scenario?

question_31429.question: How many access types can be used with the "OSAppId" and "AddressType" leaves?
question_31429.ground_truth: Both the "OSAppId" and "AddressType" leaves support the access types "Get" and "Replace".

question_31431.question: What is the purpose of the test in 10.2.2.1.2.4?
question_31431.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in 10.2.2.1.2.4 is to verify that during an inter-cell soft handover for cell 2, the average probability for missed ACK and false ACK when E-HICH is transmitted using 3 consecutive slots does not exceed specified values.

question_31432.question: What should a UE do upon receiving an IDENTITY REQUEST message with the identity type IE set to "SUCI" while in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode and with timer T3519 already running?
question_31432.ground_truth: The UE should send an IDENTITY RESPONSE message containing the stored SUCI.

question_31433.question: What function should be used to append a single byte to the proactive command buffer?
question_31433.ground_truth: The CatPutByte function should be used to append a single byte to the proactive command buffer.

question_31434.question: What is required for ProSe communication between two UEs in close proximity even when they are not under network coverage?
question_31434.ground_truth: The 5G system shall be capable of supporting ProSe communication between two UEs in close proximity even when the UEs are not under network coverage (PR-5.10.6-001).

question_31435.question: In the context of activated uplink frequency and the two associated TTIs, when do we use Pallocated,x and Pallocated,y?
question_31435.ground_truth: Pallocated,x is used when the UE has more than one activated uplink frequency and one retransmission is required in one activated uplink frequency, and Pallocated,y is used when the UE has more than one activated uplink frequency and two retransmissions are required.

question_31437.question: What action should the MS take when the SS sends the GA-RRC DL DIRECT TRANSFER message (Deactivate PDP Context Request) during the test procedure?
question_31437.ground_truth: The MS will send GA-RRC RELEASE REQUEST to release the PS domain connection, as instructed by the GA-RRC DL DIRECT TRANSFER message.

question_31438.question: What is the purpose of the described test method?
question_31438.ground_truth: The purpose of the described test method is to verify that the MS does not exceed the first and second conformance requirements for FACCH/F under propagation condition TUhigh with an allowance for the statistical significance of the test.

question_31439.question: What is the basis of the solution for addressing Key Issue #2 requirement on authorization in the 3GPP network?
question_31439.ground_truth: The solution is based on ProSe direct discovery security mechanism, which needs to authorize whether the UE is allowed to use the service before provisioning discovery security materials to the UE.

question_31440.question: What should the target AMF include in the content when the UE context transfer cannot be supported between networks?
question_31440.ground_truth: If the continuity of the PDU Session(s) cannot be supported between networks, the target AMF shall include these PDU session(s) with release cause in the toReleaseSessionInfo attribute in the content.

question_31441.question: What is the procedure for conveying policy for EPS bearer level RCI signalling from the PCRF to the eNodeB?
question_31441.ground_truth: The procedures for conveying policy for EPS bearer level RCI signalling from the PCRF to the eNodeB include the procedure for E-UTRAN Initial Attach, procedure for dedicated bearer activation, procedure for PDN GW initiated bearer modification with bearer QoS update, and procedure for UE requested PDN connectivity.

question_31442.question: What is the purpose of the paging assistance information in 5G System?
question_31442.ground_truth: The paging assistance information contains UE radio related information that assists the RAN for efficient paging.

question_31443.question: Which clause in TS~23.304 specifies the N5g-ddnmf service?

question_31445.question: What is the purpose of the Overload Stop procedure in this 3GPP communication standard?
question_31445.ground_truth: The Overload Stop procedure is used to signal to an NG-RAN node that the overload situation at the AMF has ended and normal operation shall resume, utilizing non-UE associated signalling.

question_31446.question: What is the role of the IRPAgent in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_31446.ground_truth: The IRPAgent in the 3GPP Technical Specification is an agent responsible for managing the behavior of the system, it can be characterized by several different but related models, both exterior and interior. The current version of the specification focuses on the interior model aspects of IRPAgents.

question_31447.question: What is the expected behavior of the terminating UE, if local resource reservation is required and precondition mechanism is supported?
question_31447.ground_truth: The terminating UE must make use of the precondition mechanism and indicate a Require header with the "precondition" option-tag in any response or subsequent request it sends towards to the originating UE.

question_31448.question: What procedure is used when the UE tries to reestablish the RRC connection?
question_31448.ground_truth: The RRC connection reestablishment procedure is used, where the UE sends a preamble to the gNB-DU, which responds with RAR, and then the UE sends RRCReestablishmentRequest message, which contains old C-RNTI and old PCI.

question_31449.question: What is the purpose of the present document in 3GPP?
question_31449.ground_truth: The purpose of the present document is to specify the 3GPP confidentiality and integrity algorithms known as EEA3 and EIA3.

question_31450.question: What should the floor control interface do upon receiving the Floor Idle message from the floor control server arbitration logic in the MCPTT server when in the 'U: permitted' state and an indication that the participant is overridden without revoke is stored?
question_31450.ground_truth: The floor control interface should send Floor Idle message to the associated floor participant, remove the indication that a participant is overridden without revoke, and remain in 'U: permitted' state.

question_31451.question: What is the entering condition for event A4H2 to be satisfied?
question_31451.ground_truth: Both condition A4H2-1 and condition A4H2-2 must be fulfilled.

question_31452.question: What is used for the estimation of the LSF vector in ACELP concealment for rates 9.6, 16.4, and 24.4kbps?
question_31452.ground_truth: An estimated LSF vector used in ACELP concealment and the LSF representation of the CNG noise estimation on decoder side.

question_31453.question: What is the function of the BMMS GW in the MBMS architecture?
question_31453.ground_truth: The BMMS GW serves as an entry point for IP multicast traffic as MBMS data, establishes bearer plane for broadcast or multicast MBMS transmission and provides an interface for entities using MBMS bearers through the SGi-mb (user plane) and SGmb (control plane) reference points.

question_31456.question: What are the two main components of the solution described in Section 6.8 for L2TP tunnel and session setup by UP Function?
question_31456.ground_truth: The two main components of the solution described in Section 6.8 are L2TP Tunnel Setup and L2TP Session Setup.

question_31457.question: Which two medium access modes are mandatory for networks supporting EC-GSM-IoT?
question_31457.ground_truth: All networks that support EC-GSM-IoT must support Fixed Uplink Allocation on the uplink and Dynamic allocation on the downlink.

question_31458.question: What is the role of the Packet Flow Description Function (PFDF) in the 5G system?
question_31458.ground_truth: The PFDF provides the PFD Management Service to NF service consumers, such as the Session Management Function (SMF) and the Network Data Analytics Function (NWDAF), by managing Packet Flow Descriptions (PFDs).

question_31459.question: What is the length field in the RTCP Multiplexing packet header?
question_31459.ground_truth: The length field in the RTCP Multiplexing packet header specifies the length of the RTCP packet in 32-bit words minus one, including the header and any padding.

question_31460.question: What should the UE do when the conditions for RSRP measurement based on RSS are met?
question_31460.ground_truth: If the UE performs RSRP measurement based on RSS for a serving cell, it is not expected to perform RSRP measurement based on CRS for the same serving cell.

question_31465.question: What is the responsibilities of the Session Management Function (SMF) in the 5G system?
question_31465.ground_truth: The SMF is responsible for providing session management, including session establishment, modification, and release; UE IP address allocation and management; selection and control of user plane functions; termination of interfaces towards policy control functions; and control part of policy enforcement and QoS.

question_31466.question: What can an adversary do by sending false notifications?
question_31466.ground_truth: An adversary can cause panic by sending false primary notifications, and falsify information or instruct people to take hazardous actions with false secondary notifications.

question_31467.question: In how many test sessions were the EVS Codec (MAEC) tests conducted by Dolby?
question_31467.ground_truth: The EVS Codec (MAEC) tests conducted by Dolby were run in two sessions, A and B, each with 10 test items.

question_31468.question: What is the procedure for introducing the bundled EAS list in AC profile in the solution described in section 7.46.2.2?
question_31468.ground_truth: The bundled EAS list is introduced in AC profile to represent that the multiple EAS(s) are to serve the same AC.

question_31469.question: What information is required for the Core Network to select an L-GW if it depends on Non-Access-Stratum (NAS) information such as the APN?
question_31469.ground_truth: The H(e)NB needs to provide the Core Network with a LHN ID and necessary information such as the APN requested by the UE and the Local H(e)NB Network ID.

question_31471.question: What actions does the EES take if the EEC selects an EAS that is not currently instantiated?
question_31471.ground_truth: If the EEC selects an EAS that is not currently instantiated, the EES requests the MnS to perform EAS instantiation for the selected EAS.

question_31472.question: What is the purpose of the "VPLMNs with preferred WLAN Selection" rules in the HPLMN or VPLMN?
question_31472.ground_truth: The "VPLMNs with preferred WLAN Selection" rules in the HPLMN or VPLMN provide information to the UE for selecting a WLAN access network and a PLMN for 3GPP-based authentication over WLAN. These rules prioritize the selection of specific service providers when roaming.

question_31473.question: Which modes does the test applicability defined in 6.6.9.1.2 apply to?
question_31473.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16 onwards, supporting 2DL CA and idleInactiveNR-MeasReport-r16.

question_31475.question: What are the pre-conditions necessary for the 5G system to support the use case of pre-conditions for audio contribution in live programs?
question_31475.ground_truth: The pre-conditions necessary for the 5G system to support this use case include the presence of a 5G base station at the venue, its status being capable of being checked remotely before use, and access to the 5G solution being transparent to the reporter.

question_31476.question: What information element may be included in the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for relay discovery additional information?

question_31477.question: What is the use of the HS-DSCH RNTI in 3GPP TS 25.331?
question_31477.ground_truth: The HS-DSCH RNTI is used for the UE-specific CRC in HS-SCCH and HS-DSCH.

question_31478.question: What are the bandwidth scenarios considered in the RSTD measurement accuracy evaluation?
question_31478.ground_truth: The bandwidth scenarios considered in the RSTD measurement accuracy evaluation are larger bandwidths (15MHz, 20MHz) and smaller bandwidths (3MHz).

question_31479.question: What role does the AS-hA1 play in the final call state when precondition mechanism is used and an announcement is to be sent to the calling party?
question_31479.ground_truth: AS-hA1 acts as a B2BUA and creates two dialogs: one from UE-A to AS-hA1 and the other from AS-hA1 to the terminating UE.

question_31480.question: What is the function of IBCF on the Mr and Mr' interfaces in normal operation, and when is it critical?
question_31480.ground_truth: In normal operation, the communication between the application server and the MRF on Mr and Mr' interfaces forms the endpoint of the communication, and any information included in the signaling is essential. IBCF is used to support communication between the AS and MRB, AS and MRFC, S-CSCF and MRB, and between S-CSCF and MRFC when on the Mr and Mr' interfaces. It is not critical in normal operation, but when the network is supporting optimization of media paths on Mr and Mr' interfaces, IBCF can be used to support optimal media routing.

question_31481.question: What action should the MS take when it receives a class 0 message and its message store is not full?
question_31481.ground_truth: The MS shall display the message immediately and send an acknowledgement to the SC when the message has successfully reached the MS, and it shall be stored in the ME or SIM.

question_31482.question: What is the HTTP status code range for failures or redirections in the Notify SM Context Status service operation?
question_31482.ground_truth: The HTTP status code for failures or redirections in the Notify SM Context Status service operation is 4xx/5xx.

question_31483.question: Under what conditions does the target BSS request the INTER RAT HANDOVER INFO from the SGSN?
question_31483.ground_truth: The target BSS requests the INTER RAT HANDOVER INFO from the SGSN if the 'Reliable INTER RAT HANDOVER INFO' is missing or set to '0' in the PS Handover Request message or if it has not received the INTER RAT HANDOVER INFO as part of the Source BSS to Target BSS transparent container.

question_31484.question: How should the network select the codec for UTRAN in a speech call if a Supported Codec List information element is received in the CALL CONFIRMED message?
question_31484.ground_truth: The network shall use the list contained in the Supported Codec List information element to select the codec for UTRAN in a speech call if one is received in the CALL CONFIRMED message.

question_31485.question: Which Release of E-UTRA UE does the test applicability defined in section 4.5.1.4.2 apply to?
question_31485.ground_truth: The test applies to all types of E-UTRA UE Release 15 and forward supporting EN-DC FR1 and long DRX cycle.

question_31486.question: What is the implication of infrequent small data feature in terms of session key usage?
question_31486.ground_truth: The infrequent small data feature would result in infrequent usage of session keys, giving an attacker more time to mount a key recovery attack.

question_31487.question: What is the mechanism used in Solution #30 to protect the privacy-sensitive information in the DCR message of UE-to-UE Relay discovery?
question_31487.ground_truth: The mechanism uses a code security parameter to protect the privacy-sensitive information in the DCR message and uses security materials to secure the link establishment.

question_31488.question: What happens to any UE Service ID and associated MSGin5G Client Profile stored by the MSGin5G Server if the MSGin5G Server successfully authorizes the MSGin5G Client in step 3 of the MSGin5G UE de-registration procedure?
question_31488.ground_truth: If the MSGin5G Server successfully authorizes the MSGin5G Client in step 3 of the MSGin5G UE de-registration procedure, it deletes the UE Service ID and any associated MSGin5G Client Profile that it has stored.

question_31489.question: What is the aim of the "Distribution of DL UE throughput in gNB" measurement?
question_31489.ground_truth: The aim of the "Distribution of DL UE throughput in gNB" measurement is to provide the distribution of the UE throughput in downlink, split across multiple slots, for large and small data bursts. It is intended for data bursts that are large enough to require transmissions to be split across multiple slots.

question_31490.question: What entity uses the services of both the LLC sublayer and the MM entity of the MM sublayer in addition to the SMS entity for non-GPRS services?

question_31491.question: What is the objective of this test?
question_31491.ground_truth: The objective of this test is to verify the MS's first position estimate meets the Conformance requirement under GNSS satellite signal conditions that represent simple multi-path conditions.

question_31493.question: What action shall be taken by the ACR service when the evaluation of the incoming communication barring rules results in (allow="false") and one of the matching rules contains the anonymous condition?
question_31493.ground_truth: The procedures specified in clause 4.5.2.6.2 shall be executed.

question_31494.question: What is the maximum interruption time allowed if the target cell is known in the E-UTRAN FDD - UTRAN FDD handover?
question_31494.ground_truth: The interruption time shall be less than Tinterrupt1 = TIU + Tsync + 50 + 10*Fmax + TMC ms.

question_31496.question: What information does the 5GMSu Client process when establishing a transport session for uplink media streaming?
question_31496.ground_truth: The 5GMSu Client processes the Media Entry Point to discover the set of available Service Descriptions, and selects a Dynamic Policy with a matching External reference when establishing a transport session for uplink media streaming.

question_31497.question: Which frequency bands should be focused on regarding the harmonics and IMD falling into Bands 1, 3, 39, 42 and 46, considering that Bands 2, 4, 10, 24, 25, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 43, 46, 48, 65 and 66 are not intended for use in the same region with Band 39 and Band 42?

question_31498.question: What should the UE (MCVideo Client) do when it receives a SIP BYE message during an ongoing On-demand Pre-arranged Group Call with Automatic Commencement Mode?
question_31498.ground_truth: The UE (MCVideo Client) should send a SIP 200 (OK) message and leave the MCVideo session.

question_31500.question: What is the role of a Management Function in the context of the present document?
question_31500.ground_truth: A Management Function captures the essence of what is managed, by implementing the network resource model governed by that management function and providing management data, operations, and notifications. It can produce or consume both classic and Intent-driven MnSs, rendering any management layer intent-driven.

question_31502.question: What is the purpose of the Gap Analysis in the IMS-based Streaming and Download Delivery Enhancements?
question_31502.ground_truth: The purpose of the Gap Analysis is to identify the lack of IMS-based procedures for controlling MBMS File Repair sessions, including those for file repair using conventional HTTP servers, and to propose SIP-based methods and signalling procedures for MBMS file repair sessions controlled by IMS.

question_31503.question: What is the purpose of the "stale" header field parameter in the 407 (Proxy Authentication Required) response?
question_31503.ground_truth: The "stale" header field parameter is set to "true" in the 407 (Proxy Authentication Required) response, indicating that the client has provided a valid challenge response for a stale nonce and should be re-authenticated.

question_31504.question: What is the purpose of the service-level authentication and authorization procedure in 3GPP?
question_31504.ground_truth: The service-level authentication and authorization procedure is used to authenticate and authorize the upper layers of the UE when establishing a PDU session. It is part of the UE-requested PDU session procedure and uses the UUAA protocol.

question_31505.question: When is the MME able to reject Mobility Management signalling requests from UEs due to general overload conditions?
question_31505.ground_truth: The MME may reject Mobility Management signalling requests from UEs due to general overload conditions when a NAS request is rejected, and a Mobility Management back-off timer is sent by the MME and stored per UE if a request without the low access priority indicator is rejected by the MME and if MME maintains the UE context. The MME may immediately reject any subsequent request from the UE before the stored back-off time is expired.

question_31506.question: How many midambles can be supported in each cell for burst type 3, if intermediate shifts are used?
question_31506.ground_truth: The number of midambles that can be supported in each cell for burst type 3, when intermediate shifts are used, is 4 (K=2K').

question_31507.question: What notification is issued when the MBMS client makes a change to the parameters reported to the MAA in response to a getPacketServices() API?
question_31507.ground_truth: The MBMS client notifies MAA with packetServiceListUpdate() as defined in clause 6.4.3.6.

question_31510.question: What are the two types of addresses used for identifying SGSNs and GGSNs in a mobile network?
question_31510.ground_truth: The two types of addresses used for identifying SGSNs and GGSNs in a mobile network are PSTN/ISDN numbers and GSN addresses. GSN addresses consist of an Address Type, an Address Length, and an Address field, which contains either an IPv4 address or an IPv6 address. SGSN Address and GGSN Address are the two types of GSN addresses used in the mobile network.

question_31511.question: What is the priority level of the EPS bearer for MCPTT emergency call compared to an MCPTT imminent peril call?
question_31511.ground_truth: The EPS bearer for MCPTT emergency call has the highest priority level among MCPTT call types, while the EPS bearer for MCPTT imminent peril call has a higher priority level than one for MCPTT call.

question_31512.question: What is the NF Service Consumer's role when activating the User Plane connection of a PDU session?
question_31512.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer (e.g. AMF) requests the SMF to activate the user plane connection of an existing PDU session by sending a POST request with specific information.

question_31514.question: What is the structure of a URI for the Gw/Gwn interface?
question_31514.ground_truth: The structure of a URI for the Gw/Gwn interface includes a scheme, which can be HTTP or HTTPS, an authority with a host and optionally a port, and a path-absolute which identifies the resources.

question_31516.question: When can a UE utilize a COT shared by a COT initiating UE when transmitting PSFCH?
question_31516.ground_truth: A UE can utilize a COT shared by a COT initiating UE when at least one of its PSFCH transmissions is intended for the COT initiating UE.

question_31517.question: What is the condition for a cell to be known by the UE before receiving the report CGI command?
question_31517.ground_truth: A cell is known by the UE before receiving the report CGI command if certain conditions for L3-RSRP measurement reports and SSB detectability are met during the last 5 seconds for FR1 or 3 seconds for FR2.

question_31518.question: What is the purpose of the inter-RAT cell reselection test in 6.2.3.1.1 and 6.2.3.1.2?
question_31518.ground_truth: The purpose of the inter-RAT cell reselection test in 6.2.3.1.1 is to ensure that the UE reselects the cell which belongs to the lower priority inter-RAT NR cell. In 6.2.3.1.2, the test ensures that the UE reselects the cell which belongs to the higher priority inter-RAT NR cell.

question_31519.question: When are the 5GS session management timers T35ab started and stopped on a per DNN basis in the UE?
question_31519.ground_truth: The 5GS session management timers T35ab are started and stopped on a per DNN basis during the PDU session establishment procedure and the UE-requested PDU session modification procedure or the network-requested PDU session release procedure in the UE.

question_31520.question: What does LI stand for in the context of IMS-based services?

question_31522.question: What should a mobile station do when it's in the MM IDLE state and service state SEARCH FOR PLMN, as specified in section 4.2.2.6?
question_31522.ground_truth: When in state MM IDLE and service state SEARCH FOR PLMN, the mobile station should not start any normal location updating attempt, not perform periodic updating, not perform IMSI detach if powered down, reject any request from CM entities for MM connections except emergency calls, and not respond to paging.

question_31523.question: What should the MCPTT client include in the Contact field of the SIP INVITE request for an MCPTT ambient listening call?
question_31523.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should include the g.3gpp.mcptt media feature tag and the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag with the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt" in the Contact header field of the SIP INVITE request.

question_31525.question: How should the feature negotiation procedures be handled between the functional entity invoking an API and the CAPIF core function?
question_31525.ground_truth: The functional entity invoking an API and the CAPIF core function shall use Feature Negotiation Procedures as defined in 3GPP TS 29.122 with the following clarifications: description of the SCEF applies to the CAPIF core function; description of the SCS/AS applies to the functional entity invoking an API; the CAPIF Core Function should not register any feature in the NRF; and the AEF should not register any feature for AEF_Security_API in the NRF.

question_31526.question: What must the terminating service provider indicate to the terminating party when eCNAM identity data is unavailable?
question_31526.ground_truth: The terminating service provider shall indicate the unavailability of eCNAM identity data to the terminating party.

question_31527.question: How are overlaid CDMA subchannels used for dedicated channels?
question_31527.ground_truth: Up to four MS can be multiplexed on the same physical resource, simultaneously transmitting using different orthogonal codes assigned by the network if four PDCHs are assigned for EC operation. The codes are applied per burst over the assigned PDCHs in each TDMA frame and are only applied in case blind physical layer transmissions are used. Overlaid CDMA is applied for transmissions on the uplink, i.e. for EC-PACCH/U and EC-PDTCH/U.

question_31529.question: What is the base object of the GET request in Example 3?

question_31530.question: What are the possible user scenarios for eMBMS service access?
question_31530.ground_truth: There are three possible scenarios: UE receives unicast and broadcast service from the same PLMN, UE receives only broadcast eMBMS service, and UE receives unicast service from one PLMN and eMBMS service through a different PLMN.

question_31532.question: What is the procedure for changing the contents of the present document?
question_31532.ground_truth: The present document's contents can be changed by the TSG with a formal TSG approval, and it will be re-released with a new release date and version number.

question_31533.question: What analytics procedure does the NWDAF use to provide dispersion analytics to an NF or AF?
question_31533.ground_truth: The NWDAF uses the Dispersion Analytic Procedure to provide dispersion analytics in the form of statistics or predictions to an NF or AF.

question_31535.question: What should be done if the message size exceeds the maximum number of information octets in an LLC frame?
question_31535.ground_truth: The messages should be segmented using this limitation if the message size exceeds this value.

question_31536.question: What should the P-CSCF consider as deregistered for a UE when the state attribute in the <registration> element is set to "terminated", and the value of the <uri> sub-element inside the <contact> sub-element is set to the contact address of the user's UE, and the event attribute within the <contact> sub-element belonging to this UE is set to "deactivated", "expired", "probation", "unregistered", or "rejected"?
question_31536.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should consider the indicated public user identity as deregistered for this UE and release all stored information for these public user identity bound to the respective user and remove the public user identity from the list of the public user identities that are registered for the user.

question_31538.question: How is the ACIR calculated for downlink for frequency resource blocks independent of their position in the aggressor channel?
question_31538.ground_truth: The ACIR for downlink for frequency resource blocks independent of their position in the aggressor channel can be obtained from the LTE-A BS ACLR and the victim UE ACS requirements.

question_31541.question: What action should an NF Service Consumer take if it is unable to handle a request but knows that another NF Service Consumer can?
question_31541.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should reply with an HTTP 307/308 redirect response pointing to the URI of the new NF Service Consumer.

question_31542.question: What type of network entities are SIP Application Servers, IM-SSF, and OSA SCS in the context of the S-CSCF and ISC interface?
question_31542.ground_truth: In the context of the S-CSCF and ISC interface, SIP Application Servers, IM-SSF, and OSA SCS all behave as SIP application servers.

question_31543.question: What should be the approach when excluding components from testing in the SCAS instantiation?
question_31543.ground_truth: Components should not be excluded from testing based on evaluation under another scheme or if developed by a third party. Exclusion is only allowed when the SCAS explicitly permits referring to the certificate obtained under a different scheme for a given set of tests.

question_31544.question: What is the factor that will be impacted in the receiver sensitivity degradation in the FDD band, considering the worst case for MSD analysis?
question_31544.ground_truth: The duplexer performance decreasing and the noise level in the Rx band will be impacted in the receiver sensitivity degradation in the FDD band, considering the worst case for MSD analysis.

question_31545.question: What allows user B to roam to another network operator while using MCPTT services?
question_31545.ground_truth: Network operator S has a roaming agreement with network operator R, which allows user B to roam to network operator R while using MCPTT services.

question_31547.question: What should a UE indicate in the SIP request to use the precondition mechanism in session establishment?
question_31547.ground_truth: The UE should indicate the support for the precondition mechanism using the Supported header field mechanism and not indicate the requirement for the precondition mechanism using the Require header field mechanism.

question_31548.question: What operation starts a dialogue between gprsSSF and gsmSCF in clause 14.1.4.1.2?
question_31548.ground_truth: The InitialDPGPRS operation starts a dialogue between gprsSSF and gsmSCF in clause 14.1.4.1.2.

question_31549.question: What type of UEs does the NR intra-frequency RRC re-establishment delay test without serving cell timing apply to?
question_31549.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE from Release 17 onwards.

question_31550.question: What is the expected BFI performance on a speech TCH with DTX and frequency hopping?
question_31550.ground_truth: On average, less than one undetected bad speech frame (false bad frame indication BFI) should be measured in one minute for MS.

question_31551.question: What action must the target UE take if it receives a PROSE DIRECT LINK KEEPALIVE REQUEST message with a keep-alive counter value lower than the last sent value?
question_31551.ground_truth: The target UE must discard the PROSE DIRECT LINK KEEPALIVE REQUEST message in this case.

question_31552.question: When should the PCF include the "relCause" attribute within the SmPolicyDecision data structure of the response to the POST message?
question_31552.ground_truth: The PCF shall do so upon receiving a POST message from the SMF when usage quota is reached and the PCF requests the PDU session termination.

question_31553.question: What is the test requirement for section 6.5A.3.1.5 of the document?
question_31553.ground_truth: The test requirement is the same as in clause 6.5A.3.1.1.5 for section 6.5A.3.1.5 of the document.

question_31555.question: What should the IWF performing the controlling role check to allow an MCPTT user to join an existing group session?
question_31555.ground_truth: The IWF performing the controlling role should check if the MCPTT user is a member of the group and if the MCPTT user is authorized to join the group.

question_31558.question: Which type of message is the RRCSystemInfoRequest?
question_31558.ground_truth: The RRCSystemInfoRequest is a message used to request SI message(s) required by the UE as specified in the 3GPP specification.

question_31561.question: Which type of IE is mandatory for the "NG Setup Request" and should be included in the "SupportedTAList" field?
question_31561.ground_truth: SupportedTAList is a mandatory IE for the "NG Setup Request" which defines the supported TA (Tracking Area) list in the NGAP protocol.

question_31565.question: What message is used in the test described in 26.6.12.1 to verify that the MS is able to correctly release an SDCCH after receiving a CHANNEL RELEASE message?
question_31565.ground_truth: The MS initiates a Layer 2 disconnection process on the main signalling link after the SS sends a CHANNEL RELEASE message and the MS stops transmitting Layer 2 messages after the acknowledgement of the Layer 2 disconnection by the SS.

question_31566.question: What is the identifier value of the Null Ciphering algorithm?
question_31566.ground_truth: The identifier value of the Null Ciphering algorithm is "00002".

question_31569.question: Which UE types does the test applicability defined in section 6.2.1.1.1.2 apply to?
question_31569.ground_truth: The test applicability defined in section 6.2.1.1.1.2 applies to all types of NR Power Class 2 and Power Class 3 UE that do not support Transmit Diversity and are part of Release 17 or forward.

question_31570.question: When does the NEF map the geographical information to the list of TAs?
question_31570.ground_truth: If the AF provides the service area in the form of geographical information, the NEF maps the geographical information to the list of TAs.

question_31571.question: What is the purpose of the Trackside Maintenance Warning System communication in the FRMCS system and what services does it provide?
question_31571.ground_truth: The Trackside Maintenance Warning System communication in the FRMCS system provides mobile communication services for the warning system. It enables temporary communication between sensors and warning entities in the warning system, and the FRMCS Equipment of the local maintenance staff. This communication is used to inform trackside staff about approaching trains entering the area of maintenance.

question_31572.question: What is required to be sent first when FACCH and RATSCCH are scheduled for transmission for the same speech frame on TCH/AHS, O-TCH/AHS, and O-TCH/WHS?
question_31572.ground_truth: If FACCH and RATSCCH are scheduled for transmission for the same speech frame on TCH/AHS, O-TCH/AHS, and O-TCH/WHS, the FACCH shall be sent first, followed by the RATSCCH.

question_31573.question: What does the term "affiliated to an MCPTT group" mean in the context of 3GPP TS 36.579-2?
question_31573.ground_truth: In the context of 3GPP TS 36.579-2, the term "affiliated to an MCPTT group" means that an MCPTT user is associated with a particular MCPTT group, which enables them to participate in MCPTT group communications.

question_31574.question: What is the maximum range of the window size (k) when the Error Recovery Option is activated?
question_31574.ground_truth: The window size may not be larger than 7.

question_31575.question: What is the difference between the two coding methods, the Small symbol coding method and the Large symbol coding method?
question_31575.ground_truth: The Small symbol coding method is used for coding differential indices with a small range of values, while the Large symbol coding method is used for coding differential indices with a larger range of values. The large symbol coding method consists of a scale mode and a pulse mode, representing a larger number of bits compared to the small symbol coding method.

question_31578.question: What should be aligned with MCPTT application plane protection in terms of protecting the MCVideo application plane?
question_31578.ground_truth: The KFC and MKFC as defined in Clause 9.4 of TS 33.179.

question_31579.question: Which modulation is applied to the TFCI code word bits in downlink?
question_31579.ground_truth: The modulation applied to the TFCI code word bits in downlink is the same as that applied to the data symbols.

question_31585.question: What is the format of the communication charge in the case of non-monetary-format?
question_31585.ground_truth: In the case of non-monetary-format, the charge amount is indicated by a number of meter-pulse units.

question_31586.question: What is the overall delay measured in the E-UTRAN TDD - UTRAN TDD event triggered reporting test?
question_31586.ground_truth: The overall delay measured is the time from the beginning of time period T2, to the moment the UE sends an Event B1 triggered measurement report to Cell 2.

question_31587.question: What was used to estimate the performance of Dual Antenna Interference Cancellation (DAIC) in system level simulations for evaluating potential gains in voice capacity?
question_31587.ground_truth: Maximal Ratio Combining (MRC) and Single Antenna Interference Cancellation (SAIC) were used to conservatively estimate the performance of DAIC in system level simulations.

question_31588.question: How many S1-C interfaces and signaling connections does the RN and DeNB maintain in the roxy mechanism?
question_31588.ground_truth: The RN maintains one S1-C interface (to the DeNB), while the DeNB maintains one S1-C interface to each MME in the respective MME pool.

question_31589.question: What is the purpose of including a QoE (Quality of Experience) reporting framework for DASH (Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP) in the recommendations?
question_31589.ground_truth: The inclusion of a QoE reporting framework for DASH allows for better monitoring and management of the user experience when using combined delivery methods.

question_31590.question: What is the measurement provided by DBU.NbrTelPubUserId?
question_31590.ground_truth: The number of provisioned Public User Identities with TEL URI format stored in a HSS.

question_31593.question: How does the GANC pass Cell Broadcast Service information to the MS in the GAN system?
question_31593.ground_truth: The GANC sends the GA-RC CELL BROADCAST INFO message to the MS, including information required by the MS.

question_31594.question: What is the antenna gain for the micro BS in the simulated scenario?
question_31594.ground_truth: The antenna gain for the micro BS in the simulated scenario is 11 dBi.

question_31595.question: How does the KMS function impact the existing network entities when deploying the TBS protocol?
question_31595.ground_truth: When deploying the KMS function in an existing network equipment, there will be an impact on the existing network entities. This includes additional security associations required for interoperability and special consideration for controlling media protection functionality in e2m scenarios.

question_31598.question: Which function controls the charging and establishment of resources in the RAN and PS core network in IMS-based PSS and MBMS procedures?
question_31598.ground_truth: The Policy and Charging Rules Function (PCRF) controls the charging and the establishment of resources in the RAN and PS core network.

question_31601.question: What happens when a Continue with Argument with neither LegID nor CSID is received in the reporting of more than one leg?
question_31601.ground_truth: The number of resumptions required for the leg that was reported will be decremented by 1, and if reporting is performed on more than one leg, then the related leg will be selected following the sequence of the reporting.

question_31602.question: In the context of the service request procedure not accepted by the network, what should the UE do if a SERVICE REJECT message with 5GMM cause #76 or #78 was received without integrity protection?
question_31602.ground_truth: The UE shall discard the message.

question_31603.question: What is the applicability of the NR SA FR1 Beam Failure Detection and Link Recovery Test?
question_31603.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward, supporting standalone NR-U and supporting UL and SSB-based RLM and link recovery on shared channel access.

question_31605.question: What functionality does the Data Collection Coordination Function (DCCF) support in regards to data processing?
question_31605.ground_truth: The DCCF supports determining data sources, determining whether data is being collected, instructing a Messaging Framework to send data to consumers or notification endpoints, formatting and processing of data, and sending data to consumers or notification endpoints.

question_31606.question: What action is taken by the eP-CSCF when media plane optimization is applied and the DTLS protocol layer is to be passed?
question_31606.ground_truth: The eP-CSCF will deactivate media plane interworking in the eIMS-AGW and determine which media streams need to be multiplexed into the same SCTP association using the "tra-SCTP-association" SDP attribute. It will include the IP address received from the eIMS-AGW in the contact line in the SDP offer towards the WIC.

question_31607.question: What provides the number of input data errors during NF service discovery at the NRF?
question_31607.ground_truth: Number of failed NF service discoveries due to errors in the input data in the URI query parameters.

question_31608.question: Which protocol extension contains the RAB-RelocationReleaseList in the RelocationCommandIEs?
question_31608.ground_truth: The ProtocolIE-Container in the RelocationCommandIEs contains the RAB-RelocationReleaseList.

question_31610.question: What does the P-CSCF do upon receiving a SIP INVITE message in the described scenario?
question_31610.ground_truth: The P-CSCF verifies whether the UserID-3 indicated in the SIP INVITE message complies with the tel-URI that was provided to the UE and then forwards the SIP INVITE towards the PSAP if compliant.

question_31611.question: What is the definition of IRP and IS in the context of 3GPP Telecommunication management?
question_31611.ground_truth: IRP stands for Integration Reference Point, which refers to the concept and definitions used in the 3GPP Telecommunication management. IS stands for Information Service, which refers to the information service template in 3GPP Telecommunication management.

question_31612.question: Which transceiver architecture, Homodyne or Heterodyne, has an advantage in phase noise requirements?
question_31612.ground_truth: The Heterodyne architecture has an advantage in phase noise requirements, since the phase noise is logarithmically proportional to the LO frequency, and having two sources of LO reduces the phase noise of the system in the Heterodyne architecture.

question_31613.question: What is the purpose of Step 7a/b in the relay service code setup process?
question_31613.ground_truth: In Step 7a/b, the UE-to-Network relay uses the information received in Step 6 to complete the secure link setup between the Remote UE and the UE-to-Network relay. The UE-to-Network relay adds the encrypted Relay Service Code alias and User Info ID received for the Remote UE as an additional parameter to the Direct Security Mode Command.

question_31614.question: What conditions must be met for the tests on two antenna ports for the PUSCH performance requirement?
question_31614.ground_truth: For the tests on two antenna ports the HARQ retransmissions for multiple codewords are independent.

question_31616.question: What is the difference between the two categories of solutions for traffic identification beyond providing non-wildcarded 5-tuples?
question_31616.ground_truth: The two categories of solutions are Charging separation-only and QoS separation. Charging separation-only solutions involve provisioning application detection filters in the UPF with IP Packet Filter Set (PFS) or PFD parameters, while QoS separation involves provisioning application detection filters in the UE and UPF with either IP Packet Filter Set or PFD parameters.

question_31621.question: What is the role of the Security Parameters Index (SPI) in the Crypto Session (CS)?
question_31621.ground_truth: The SPI in the CS points to a TEK Generation Key (TGK) that is used to derive the TEK for the crypto session using the CS ID (and some other parameters). It could also point to a TEK directly.

question_31623.question: What is the purpose of declaring OTA reference sensitivity per polarization?
question_31623.ground_truth: It is done to ensure that the wanted signal is polarization matched, as the interferer is in many interference requirements.

question_31624.question: What is the response when there is no roaming agreement between the two networks?

question_31628.question: What is the confidence level required for a test to pass in the context of SS-RSRP measurement accuracy?
question_31628.ground_truth: For a test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values for each requirement (R1 to R3) needs to be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_31629.question: What is the role of the MB-SMF in the MBS session creation process without PCC?
question_31629.ground_truth: The MB-SMF is responsible for receiving TMGI allocation and authorization checks from the NEF/MBSF, allocating TMGI(s), and deriving required QoS parameters in the MBS session creation process without PCC.

question_31630.question: What is the role of the Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the 3GPP Technical Specification for Trace Management?
question_31630.ground_truth: The Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the 3GPP Technical Specification for Trace Management is used to define the semantics of the trace management system.

question_31633.question: What is the EPS services status in the EMM-NULL state?
question_31633.ground_truth: EPS services are disabled in the UE and no EPS mobility management function is performed in this state.

question_31635.question: What is the effect of the serving network on the invocation of call transfer?
question_31635.ground_truth: The serving network will apply the barring of invocation of call transfer as specified in TS 22.041 and TS 23.015 after any CAMEL handling of the call legs to be joined by the ECT invocation.

question_31636.question: What is the maximum accepted test system uncertainty for NR in FR1 in 9.9.6?
question_31636.ground_truth: The maximum accepted test system uncertainty for NR in FR1 in 9.9.6 is 100 kHz for BS channel bandwidths up to 10 MHz, 300 kHz for 10 MHz < BS channel bandwidth <= 50 MHz, and 300 kHz for 50 MHz < BS channel bandwidths <= 100 MHz.

question_31637.question: Upon receiving a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message, what action does the AMF take regarding timer T3550 and their 5GMM state?
question_31637.ground_truth: The AMF stops timer T3550 and changes to state 5GMM-REGISTERED upon receiving a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message.

question_31638.question: What is the TS (Initial character) in the ANSWER TO RESET for the SIM card?

question_31639.question: What is the information element type of the 5GS tracking area identity list?
question_31639.ground_truth: The 5GS tracking area identity list is a type 4 information element.

question_31640.question: What should the P-CSCF do when it receives an initial request with an emergency service identifier that is not in its associated lists?
question_31640.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should reject the request by returning a 403 (Forbidden) response to the UE.

question_31641.question: What is the condition under which the basic limit requirement for repeater type 1-C Bandwidth edge is applied in a supported downlink operating band without any carrier transmitted?
question_31641.ground_truth: The basic limit requirement for repeater type 1-C Bandwidth edge is applied in a supported downlink operating band without any carrier transmitted when there are carrier(s) transmitted in another supported downlink operating band.

question_31642.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification in relation to VAS4SMS?
question_31642.ground_truth: The purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification in relation to VAS4SMS is to describe the stage 2 of the VAS4SMS, including the logic architecture, logic elements functionality, signaling flows, and interaction with other features.

question_31644.question: How does the API Invoker initiate the service invocation with the AEF?
question_31644.ground_truth: The API Invoker can send an Authentication Initiation Request to the AEF, including the CCF assigned API invoker ID and UE ID. The AEF provides security information related to the chosen security method, including AEF Key and service API authorization information. The API Invoker and the AEF can then perform mutual authentication using the AEF key and establish a TLS session.

question_31645.question: What is the purpose of the UE Non-3GPP Deregistration timer in the 5G Core?
question_31645.ground_truth: The UE Non-3GPP Deregistration timer in the 5G Core determines when the 5G-RG moves to the RM-DEREGISTERED state after being in the CM-IDLE state.

question_31646.question: What kind of inputs does the cross domain MDA MnS producer consume for MDA purposes?
question_31646.ground_truth: The cross domain MDA MnS producer may consume the MDA MnS provided by RAN and/or CN domains, and produce MDA MnS that may be consumed by 3GPP cross-domain MDA MnS consumer(s).

question_31648.question: What is the functional description of the test equipment required to perform conformance tests for MS?
question_31648.ground_truth: The functional description of the test equipment required to perform conformance tests for MS is not provided in the present document. These requirements should be deduced from the test descriptions and the information in annex 5.

question_31649.question: What does the sendInfoReq() method do in the User Interaction Service Interface and what does it return?
question_31649.ground_truth: The sendInfoReq() method plays an announcement or sends other information to the user and returns an assignmentID.

question_31650.question: What is the purpose of the method appActivityTestErr() in this framework?
question_31650.ground_truth: The client application uses this method to indicate that an error occurred during a framework-requested activity test, allowing the framework to correlate this response with the original request.

question_31651.question: What do the terms "shall" and "shall not" indicate in the context of the present document?
question_31651.ground_truth: The term "shall" in the context of the present document indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, while the term "shall not" indicates an interdiction (prohibition) to do something.

question_31652.question: In what scenario must the UE request for a PDN type IPv4v6?
question_31652.ground_truth: When the IP version capability of the UE is unknown, the UE must request for a PDN type IPv4v6.

question_31653.question: Which order IMD may fall into the Rx frequencies of bands 2, 3, 9, 25, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 39, 46, 48, 69, 70, and 79 for 2UL inter-band CA UE with other systems?
question_31653.ground_truth: Up to 3rd order harmonics and IMD up to 5th order falls into one of these receiving bands for 2UL inter-band CA UE operating with other systems such as WiFi, Bluetooth and GNSS system.

question_31654.question: What information is included in the PERFORM LOCATION RESPONSE message when De-ciphering Data was successfully delivered at the non-anchor 3G MSC?
question_31654.ground_truth: The PERFORM LOCATION RESPONSE message includes a successful result and a positive response message, indicating that the De-ciphering Data was successfully delivered to the MS.

question_31655.question: What is the purpose of the "mbsPccRules" attribute in the MbsPolicyDecision data structure?
question_31655.ground_truth: The "mbsPccRules" attribute in the MbsPolicyDecision data structure is used to provision/update/remove MBS PCC rules for an MBS Policy Association.

question_31656.question: What are the responsibilities of the SMF, PCF, UPF, and UE in the context of RSM?
question_31656.ground_truth: The SMF is responsible for creating ATSSS rules and N4 rules with the new Steering Mode in RSM. The PCF provides PCC rules with the new Steering Mode. The UPF duplicates traffic via the available access paths of a MA PDU session for the downlink traffic if RSM is used for a traffic flow. The UE duplicates traffic via the available access paths of a MA PDU session for the uplink traffic if RSM is used for a traffic flow.

question_31658.question: When provided in system information, what should a UE do with inter-RAT frequencies that do not have a priority listed?
question_31658.ground_truth: If priorities are provided in system information, the UE should ignore all the priorities provided in system information if priorities are also provided in dedicated signaling. If a UE is in camped on any cell state, it should only apply the priorities provided by system information from the current cell and preserves priorities provided by dedicated signaling unless specified otherwise.

question_31661.question: What is the mechanism for service announcement delivery in Option 1?
question_31661.ground_truth: The service announcement can be provided to UEs either via MBMS broadcast mode or unicast, such as PUSH mechanism (WAP, SMS-PP, MMS) and URL (HTTP, FTP).

question_31662.question: What is required for a MTC Device to receive trigger indications from the network?
question_31662.ground_truth: A MTC Device shall be able to receive trigger indications from the network and establish communication with the MTC server when receiving the trigger indication. This can happen in different scenarios: when the MTC Device is in detached state and needs to establish communication, when the MTC Device is in attached state but has no PDP/PDN connection, or when the MTC Device is in attached state and has a PDP/PDN connection.

question_31663.question: What must a UE do if it determines a conflict for a reserved resource for PSSCH transmission?
question_31663.ground_truth: The UE provides conflict information in a PSFCH.

question_31664.question: How can the AMF determine the real data rate usage of a network slice in KI#5?
question_31664.ground_truth: The AMF cannot determine the real data rate usage of a network slice in KI#5, therefore, the data rate of the slice may be calculated as exceeding the quota even if the real data rate of the slice is still lower than the quota, and in that case, new PDU Sessions are not allowed to be established or existing PDU Sessions are not allowed to be activated.

question_31665.question: What is the procedure followed in an LTE system, in case of collision between a periodic CSI report and a HARQ-ACK in a same subframe with PUSCH, and if an aperiodic CSI report is not triggered for the same subframe and if a UE is transmitting PUSCH only on LAA SCell(s)?
question_31665.ground_truth: In an LTE system, in case of collision between a periodic CSI report and a HARQ-ACK in a same subframe with PUSCH, and if an aperiodic CSI report is not triggered for the same subframe, and if a UE is transmitting PUSCH only on LAA SCell(s), the HARQ-ACK and periodic CSI transmission follows the procedure for the case of collision between a periodic CSI report and a HARQ-ACK in the same subframe without PUSCH.

question_31666.question: What is the purpose of the Facility information element in the supplementary service protocol?
question_31666.ground_truth: The Facility information element is used to indicate the invocation and operation of supplementary services, identified by the corresponding operation code within the Facility information element.

question_31667.question: What is the size and structure of the S-NSSAI location validity information information element?
question_31667.ground_truth: The S-NSSAI location validity information information element has a minimum length of 25 octets and a maximum length of 19307 octets, and it can contain per-S-NSSAI location validity information for maximum 8 S-NSSAIs.

question_31668.question: What is the maximum value of the measurement period for the QoE metrics in media streaming?
question_31668.ground_truth: The maximum value of the measurement period for the QoE metrics in media streaming is negotiated via the QoE protocol.

question_31669.question: What is the role of SMF in UE-to-Network Relay?
question_31669.ground_truth: SMF supports procedures for Remote UE report, stores Remote User IDs and related Remote UE info in the ProSe 5G UE-to-Network Relay's SM context for the PDU session associated with the relay, and handles the transfer of Remote UE related parameters in case of SMF change.

question_31670.question: What is the criterion for a successful test in 7.6.2.6.4.1-2?
question_31670.ground_truth: For the test to be successful, the overall delays measured from the beginning of time period T2 should be less than 7682 ms for UE supporting power class 1, or 4802 ms for UE supporting other power class for Test 1 & Test 3 and 81922 ms for UE supporting power class 1, or 51202 ms for UE supporting other power class for Test 2 and Test 4.

question_31672.question: Which element in the "Subquery-info" complex type can be repeated multiple times?
question_31672.ground_truth: The "response-filter" element in the "Subquery-info" complex type can be repeated multiple times.

question_31673.question: Which entities are involved in the PDU Session Create Request in Solution 27 of the KI#1 description?
question_31673.ground_truth: The entities involved in the PDU Session Create Request in Solution 27 are the V-SMF, H-SMF, and UDM.

question_31675.question: Who are the four individuals that took the tour with Quality Tour Guide (QTG)?

question_31679.question: What information does the source MN send to the other signalling connections or other candidate MNs if any, after releasing the resources of the source SN?
question_31679.ground_truth: The source MN sends the SgNB Release Request message, including a Cause indicating MCG mobility and, if applicable, data forwarding information to the other signalling connections or other candidate MNs if any, after releasing the resources of the source SN. The source MN also sends the Handover Cancel message toward the other signalling connections or other candidate MNs if any to cancel the CHO for the UE.

question_31682.question: In which regions do the higher gains of Type 2i and Type 3i receivers have the most significant effect on total average gains?
question_31682.ground_truth: The gains are the highest in the border regions between two cells of a three sector Node B.

question_31684.question: What information is contained in the RAB-ContextItem in this protocol?
question_31684.ground_truth: The RAB-ContextItem contains a RAB-ID, optional dl-GTP-PDU-SequenceNumber, ul-GTP-PDU-SequenceNumber, dl-N-PDU-SequenceNumber, and ul-N-PDU-SequenceNumber, as well as optional iE-Extensions.

question_31685.question: Over what bandwidth is the noise equivalent bandwidth of the measurement bandwidth integrated?
question_31685.ground_truth: The noise is integrated over the measurement bandwidth to obtain the equivalent noise bandwidth of the measurement bandwidth.

question_31686.question: As per 70.12.1.1, what is the requirement for the MS when it receives a complete POSITIONING CAPABILITY REQUEST message?
question_31686.ground_truth: As per 70.12.1.1, when the MS receives a complete POSITIONING CAPABILITY REQUEST message, it shall send the POSITIONING CAPABILITY RESPONSE message which includes the positioning capabilities of the MS and the types of supported assistance data.

question_31688.question: What component interworks the RACH frame received by the PHY entity into the RACH Frame Protocol (RACH FP) entity in the case of separate Controlling and Serving RNC?
question_31688.ground_truth: An Interworking Function (IWF) in the Node B

question_31689.question: What is the conformance requirement when a mobile station receives a message with message type not defined for the protocol discriminator?
question_31689.ground_truth: The mobile station should return a STATUS message when it receives a message with message type not defined for the protocol discriminator from its peer entity.

question_31690.question: What is the effect of unevenly distributed TPC symbols on downlink Tx power consumption in a time aligned TPC symbol timing period?
question_31690.ground_truth: More downlink Tx power is consumed for this TPC symbol timing period.

question_31691.question: What is the service scoping supported by LMISF-IRI in the provisioning of HR LI?
question_31691.ground_truth: LMISF-IRI supports the service scoping of "voice" or "messaging", "reportBeginingAndEnd" or "reportUponChange", and "SuspendOnOutboundInternationalRoaming" in the provisioning of HR LI.

question_31692.question: What is the precondition for establishing a trusted and protected connection between the user and the key management system in IMS environment?
question_31692.ground_truth: The precondition for establishing a trusted and protected connection between the user and the key management system in IMS environment is that the users can establish secure connections with the key management server and that mutual authentication is provided. This can be based on GBA or other types of credentials like username/password, client certificates, onetime passwords, and server certificates.

question_31694.question: What is the purpose of separating the information regarding the served user from the target user/UE in the ISC?
question_31694.ground_truth: Separating the information regarding the served user from the target user/UE in the ISC can help retain information about the served user when the R-URI is retargeted, preventing the loss of information and ensuring that subsequent filter analysis in the S-CSCF is not terminated.

question_31695.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Report on band combinations for concurrent operation of NR/LTE Uu bands/band combinations and one NR/LTE V2X band in Release 18?
question_31695.ground_truth: The purpose is to study the extension of the band combinations for V2X service to grow the NR V2X ecosystem and analyze the self-desensitization problem of concurrent operation band combinations, including harmonics and IMD problem.

question_31696.question: Who can provide satellite coverage availability information to the MME?
question_31696.ground_truth: Satellite coverage availability information can be provided to the MME by O&M (Operation and Maintenance).

question_31697.question: What is the usage of Operator 1 in Cell D, as per the post-conditions?
question_31697.ground_truth: The usage of Operator 1 in Cell D is 20%.

question_31699.question: What is the available time for a test that involves a MS being capable of both GAN A/Gb mode and GAN Iu mode, and no GAN Mode Indicator IE in the GA-RC REGISTER ACCEPT message?

question_31700.question: What is the purpose of the MBMS bearer event notifications provided to the NRM server?
question_31700.ground_truth: The MBMS bearer event notifications are provided to the NRM server to know the status of the MBMS bearer, the network's ability to deliver VAL services, and to trigger the NRM server to switch to a new bearer (unicast or MBMS) if required. The events may include MBMS bearer start result, status, suspension/resume or overload scenarios.

question_31701.question: What error indication is returned by the MS if it is unable to process the request received from the network?
question_31701.ground_truth: The MS shall return an error indication by sending a RELEASE COMPLETE message containing a return error component if it is unable to process the request received from the network.

question_31702.question: In the context of E-UTRAN/Satellite E-UTRAN Intra-frequency measurements, what does the '05' value indicate?
question_31702.ground_truth: The '05' value in E-UTRAN/Satellite E-UTRAN Intra-frequency measurements indicates E-UTRAN/Satellite E-UTRAN intra-frequency measurements for the Evolved Packet System (EPS) in 3GPP.

question_31704.question: What indication is sent by the MME to the eNodeB during the CS-MT-LR procedure for providing location update information using the SGs interface?
question_31704.ground_truth: The MME sends a Paging message with CS indicator that provides information about the CS service. The CS indicator is used to inform the UE that this paging is for MT-LR request.

question_31705.question: What is the maximum difference in SS-RSRQ that the UE can consider for SS-RSRQ re-selections based on absolute priorities for 2 Rx RedCap?
question_31705.ground_truth: The maximum difference in SS-RSRQ that the UE can consider for SS-RSRQ re-selections based on absolute priorities for 2 Rx RedCap is 4 dB.

question_31706.question: What is the purpose of "Enhancements for entering or existing a geographic area" in the context of MCData system to an LMR system interworking?
question_31706.ground_truth: Geographical affiliation and de-affiliation is a feature that allows an authorized MCPTT user to define a geographical area for the purposes of causing the target MCPTT client to affiliate to a group when within this geographic area. Geographical sending of an emergency alert is a feature that allows an authorized MCPTT user to define a geographical area for the purposes of causing the target MCPTT client to send an emergency alert when within this geographic area.

question_31707.question: When using FR2, Dense Urban, UL, with 100MHz bandwidth for AR 1-stream scene/video/data/voice-stream and 30Mbps data rate, what is the mean capacity performance decrease when PDB increases from 10ms to 15ms?
question_31707.ground_truth: The mean capacity performance decreased by about 38.2%.

question_31708.question: What is the technical functionality added to TS~26.139 for RTCP verification for real-time services?
question_31708.ground_truth: The technical functionality added to TS~26.139 for RTCP verification for real-time services includes test cases, test methods, requirements on RTP/RTCP protocol field values, and a method for an RTP/RTCP implementation to announce conformance with the new specification.

question_31709.question: What do the constructions "may" and "need not" indicate in a 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_31709.ground_truth: "May" indicates permission to do something, while "need not" indicates permission not to do something.

question_31710.question: What should the UE do if it supports non-IP PDN type and no PDU session is active during an inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode in EMM-IDLE mode?
question_31710.ground_truth: The UE shall enter substates EMM-DEREGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE and 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE and initiate an attach procedure.

question_31711.question: In the context of 3GPP, what does the term "shall" indicate?
question_31711.ground_truth: The term "shall" in 3GPP indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

question_31713.question: What information does the 5G-RG use when requesting the establishment of a PDU Session for a N5GC device?
question_31713.ground_truth: The 5G-RG requests the establishment of a PDU Session for a N5GC device using the GCI of the CRG that connects the N5GC device.

question_31714.question: What security threat is introduced by the CAG access control mechanism in terms of the privacy of the CAG ID, and what is its potential impact?
question_31714.ground_truth: The security threat introduced by the CAG access control mechanism is that the UE sends the selected matching CAG ID in plain text over the air in its Registration Request message, potentially allowing an adversary to infer the presence of members of a sensitive CAG.

question_31715.question: What registration expiration interval value must the UE use as the desired duration of the registration?
question_31715.ground_truth: The UE must use 600~000 seconds as the registration expiration interval value.

question_31716.question: What is the prerequisite for the test defined in 27.22.14.1.4?
question_31716.ground_truth: The prerequisite for the test is that the ME has been powered on and has performed the PROFILE DOWNLOAD procedure prior to the test.

question_31717.question: In the context of CA, when is the in-gap blocking requirement applied to intra-band non-contiguous CA?
question_31717.ground_truth: The in-gap requirement is applied if the minimum gap condition is met, which is defined as the frequency separation between the center frequencies of the component carriers being larger or equal to the sum of half the bandwidths plus 2 times the maximum bandwidth of the component carriers.

question_31718.question: What message is sent by the initiating UE after receiving an acknowledgement for the PROSE DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION REQUEST?
question_31718.ground_truth: PROSE DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION ACK message

question_31720.question: What is the difference between the first digit's values in the version numbering system used by 3GPP?
question_31720.ground_truth: The first digit's values have the following meanings: 0 - presented to TSG for information, 1 - presented to TSG for approval, and greater than 1 - TSG approved document under change control.

question_31723.question: What should the PGW do if it receives an IP-CAN Session Termination Request for a PDN connection associated with a failed SGW and that has not been restored yet?
question_31723.ground_truth: The PGW should behave as specified in clause~27.2.2.3.

question_31724.question: How does the SMF determine a timer to update the IP address of EAS in DNS message handling rule?
question_31724.ground_truth: The SMF determines the timer to update the IP address of EAS in DNS message handling rule using a method that is out of scope.

question_31725.question: What does the minimum conformance requirements in 6.2E.1.3.1.3 and 6.2E.1.3.2.3 refer to?
question_31725.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are defined in clause 6.2E.1.0.3

question_31726.question: What network elements are responsible for policy and QoS interworking with mobile networks in the BBF network?

question_31727.question: When does E-UTRAN send an "offload" command to the UE in the context of RAN-Controlled WLAN interworking?
question_31727.ground_truth: E-UTRAN sends an "offload" command to the UE when it requires traffic steering to/from WLAN.

question_31729.question: What is the role of the TrCH multiplexing in the process of transmitting data?
question_31729.ground_truth: The TrCH multiplexing is responsible for serially multiplexing the radio frames of each active TrCH into a coded composite transport channel (CCTrCH).

question_31733.question: What will the gNB-DU do if the MBS Service Area IE is not included in the BROADCAST CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message and it has released or established MBS Session resources?
question_31733.ground_truth: If the MBS Service Area IE is not included in the BROADCAST CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message and the gNB-DU has released or established MBS Session resources, it shall include the Broadcast Area Scope IE in the BROADCAST CONTEXT MODIFICATION RESPONSE message to indicate the cells where MBS Session resources are currently established.

question_31734.question: What is the correct activation procedure for SS in 6.5A.2.1.1.4.2?
question_31734.ground_truth: SS activates SCC by sending the activation MAC CE and waits for at least 2 seconds.

question_31735.question: When does the SMF initiate an N4 Session Modification procedure to remove Tunnel Info of AN in the UPF?
question_31735.ground_truth: The SMF initiates this procedure when the service request is triggered by the network and the SMF removes the old I-UPF, indicating that User Plane resources for the PDU Session(s) are being established.

question_31736.question: What message does the gNB-DU send in response to a successful PDC Measurement Initiation procedure with OnDemand report type?
question_31736.ground_truth: The gNB-DU sends the PDC MEASUREMENT INITIATION RESPONSE message with the PDC Measurement Result IE included.

question_31737.question: What attribute of the "entry" element within the "One-To-One-EmergencyAlert" element of the "OnNetwork" element corresponds to the "DisplayName" element of clause 10.2.92 and indicates the name of the MCData user recipient for an on-network MCData emergency one-to-one alert?

question_31738.question: What is the MIME type used to identify the FDT Instance in the response by the server in the File Repair Using the FDTInstanceURI in the Session Schedule procedure?
question_31738.ground_truth: The MIME type used to identify the FDT Instance in the response by the server in the File Repair Using the FDTInstanceURI in the Session Schedule procedure is "application/fdt+xml".

question_31739.question: What is the implication of including the SMS in SGSN offered parameter in the Update PDP Context Request message from the new SGSN to the GGSNs concerned?
question_31739.ground_truth: The new SGSN supports SMS services via SGSN.

question_31741.question: What are the necessary standardization needs to be identified for regular XR split rendering?
question_31741.ground_truth: Regular 2D video encoders and decoders that are capable encode and decode 2K per eye as well as 90 fps and are capable to encode typical graphics frame buffer signals, Pose information in the uplink at sufficiently high frequency, Content Delivery protocols to support the delivery requirements, Edge computing discovery and capability discovery, A simple XR split rendering application framework for single buffer streaming, New 5QIs and QoS support in 5G System for split rendering addressing latency requirements in the range of 10-20ms and bitrate guarantees to be able to stream 50 to 100 Mbps consistently.

question_31742.question: What is the purpose of the PR-7.5.6-4 requirement for the 3GPP system for the tug service?
question_31742.ground_truth: It is to provide a mechanism for registering the UEs dedicated to tug boats and the vessel moved by tug boats as a group of UEs to support group communication.

question_31744.question: What is the difference between "Channel bandwidth" and "Aggregated Channel Bandwidth"?
question_31744.ground_truth: Channel bandwidth refers to the RF bandwidth supporting a single E-UTRA RF carrier, while Aggregated Channel Bandwidth refers to the RF bandwidth in which a UE transmits and receives multiple contiguously aggregated carriers.

question_31745.question: What is the expected response from the UE when it receives SIP INFO with unsupported MSD transfer upon automatic eCall Initiation?
question_31745.ground_truth: The UE shall send an INFO request containing the updated MSD or send an INFO request containing an "ack" element with the appropriate status regarding the MSD transfer (successful or unsuccessful).

question_31748.question: What is the function of the SN Addition Request message in the handover procedure?
question_31748.ground_truth: If the target MN decides to keep the UE context in source SN, the target MN sends SN Addition Request to the SN including the SN UE XnAP ID as a reference to the UE context in the SN that was established by the source MN.

question_31750.question: Which parameters are required to enable Milenage AKA authentication in 5G communication?
question_31750.ground_truth: The parameters required to enable Milenage AKA authentication are OP, OPc, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, r1, r2, r3, r4, and r5.

question_31751.question: What message does the SCEF send to the SCS/AS after processing the Group MT NIDD Submit Request for all UEs?
question_31751.ground_truth: The SCEF sends a single aggregated response message Group MT NIDD Submit Indication (TLTRI associated with the Request of step~1, Hop-by-Hop Acknowledgment Indication(s), Re-Transmission time(s), Trigger Indication(s), Cause(s)).

question_31752.question: What is the definition of bearer services in network communication?
question_31752.ground_truth: Bearer services provide the capability for information transfer between access points and involve only low layer functions. They are network-specific and have network-defined means for bearer control.

question_31753.question: What should the SMF do when it determines that Extended Buffering is allowed and supported by the NEF for mobile terminated data?
