question_31753.ground_truth: The SMF should indicate the Extended Buffering support to AMF and forward the mobile terminated data to AMF.

question_31754.question: What does the phrase "containing a normative element" mean in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
question_31754.ground_truth: In 3GPP technical specifications, a phrase containing a normative element refers to the parts of the document that contain mandatory requirements or prohibitions (indicated by the phrases "shall" and "shall not").

question_31755.question: In which mode does a MS lose its assigned C-RNTI and therefore cannot use the RACH with C-RNTI procedure or be directly addressed by the base station in a DCI?

question_31756.question: What principles does event-based charging for MMS follow?
question_31756.ground_truth: Event-based charging for MMS follows the principle that the relationship between chargeable events and charging events is 1:1, and the relationship between charging events and CDRs is also 1:1. The chargeable event triggers are defined in clause 5.1.1 to 5.1.4, and relate to transactions at the MM1, MM4, and MM7 reference points.

question_31757.question: What is the purpose of the Pre-message procedure as defined in 29.4.2.2?
question_31757.ground_truth: The Pre-message procedure, as defined in 29.4.2.2, involves verifying the correct handling of T.30 DIS/DCS/TCF frames and ensuring conformance to the specifications in 3GPP~TS 03.45 and ITU-T Recommendation T.30 for the MS supporting transparent facsimile group 3.

question_31758.question: What would the user equipment (UE) do if, after inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode, there is a QoS flow description not associated with any QoS rule, but associated with a mapped EPS bearer context, and the respective EPS bearer context is active?
question_31758.ground_truth: The UE shall associate the QoS flow description with the EPS bearer context.

question_31759.question: What information is mandatory for GEA3 and non encrypted mode in mobile stations?
question_31759.ground_truth: It is mandatory for GEA3 and non encrypted mode (i.e. GEA0) to be implemented in mobile stations.

question_31761.question: What is the interface name between the MTC-AAA and the HSS/HLR?

question_31762.question: What type of environment is used for the propagation of the static performance measurement in GPS?

question_31763.question: Under which conditions can the PCF send a notification message to the SMF including the "pcscfRestIndication" attribute set to true for the corresponding PDU session?
question_31763.ground_truth: The PCF can send this message when it receives a request for P-CSCF restoration from the P-CSCF as defined in clause 4.4.7 of 3GPP TS 29.214 or in clause 4.2.2.27 of 3GPP TS 29.514.

question_31765.question: How is the version numbering system used in the technical specification?
question_31765.ground_truth: The version numbering system is based on a three-digit system. The first digit specifies the level of approval of the document, the second digit refers to changes of substance, and the third digit indicates editorial changes.

question_31766.question: What should the UE do when the drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerDL expires for a HARQ process in DL?
question_31766.ground_truth: If the data of the corresponding HARQ process was not successfully decoded, start the drx-RetransmissionTimerDL for the corresponding HARQ process in the first symbol after the expiry of drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerDL-NTN.

question_31768.question: What message type is used by the BM-SC to request the activation of bearer resources for MBMS data transfer?

question_31770.question: What is the DP criterion in the MT SMS TDP descriptions?
question_31770.ground_truth: The DP criterion indicates on which criterion the gsmSSF shall access the gsmSCF. A DP criterion is associated with each TDP. For MT-SMS, the DP criterion is the TDPU type.

question_31771.question: What is the technique used to separate the two users on the uplink in the discussed scheme?
question_31771.ground_truth: The network may use techniques such as joint detection to separate the two users on the uplink.

question_31773.question: What is the difference between the procedure for Emergency Registration and regular registration in this network?
question_31773.ground_truth: During Emergency Registration, the UE does not include NSSAI in the registration message, and the AMF does not send the Allowed NSSAI in the Registration Accept message. Additionally, certain steps in the registration procedure, such as authentication and AMF check for access restrictions, are skipped for Emergency Registration.

question_31774.question: What is the maximum allowed time from the start of T2 to the time UE sending measurement report in the test in section 8.3.10.1.5?
question_31774.ground_truth: The maximum allowed time from the start of T2 to the time UE sending measurement report in the test in section 8.3.10.1.5 is less than 2.71 seconds and BLER shall not exceed 0.013.

question_31775.question: What is the method used for channel allocation in the 3GPP 45.002 sequence generation?
question_31775.ground_truth: Single user TCH channel is preferentially assigned, and if not available, the user is paired with the one on a single user TCH channel with the best signal quality.

question_31776.question: What constraint is applied to the maximum luminance width and height to a Bitstream conforming to the 3GPP VR Main H.265/HEVC Operation Point?
question_31776.ground_truth: A Bitstream conforming to the 3GPP VR Main H.265/HEVC Operation Point shall not exceed the luminance width of 8192 pixels and the luminance height of 8192 pixels.

question_31779.question: What must the UE do during inter-system redirection when the emergency indication is present in the RRC message?
question_31779.ground_truth: The UE uses the emergency indication in the RRC message and the E-UTRAN provides the emergency indication to MME during Tracking Area Update or Attach procedure.

question_31783.question: What should the UE (MCDATA Client) send in response to a SIP MESSAGE message indicating the disposition response from the SS (MCDATA server) for a one-to-one standalone SDS message using the media plane?
question_31783.ground_truth: The UE (MCDATA Client) should respond to the SIP MESSAGE message by sending a SIP 200 (OK) message and delivering the notification to the MCDATA User.

question_31786.question: What should the AMF do when a network slice is to be terminated and a new network slice is to be created?
question_31786.ground_truth: The AMF should update the UE policies (URSP) such that the UE uses the new S-NSSAI for new access attempts and triggers the UE to move the user data from S-NSSAI to be removed to the new S-NSSAI.

question_31787.question: Which PLMNs are considered for selection when no non-forbidden PLMNs are available in solution #26?
question_31787.ground_truth: PLMNs offering disaster roaming are considered for selection when no non-forbidden PLMNs are available in solution #26.

question_31788.question: What information should the V2X application provide to the 3GPP network system for proper resource provisioning?
question_31788.ground_truth: The information includes the service demand (number of involved vehicles, amount of data to be transferred, time windows for transfer), timing requirements (periodic or event-based interaction, interaction before or during an ongoing session, possible time windows for the interaction), and V2X application-specific timing requirements.

question_31789.question: What information is provided in the errorDetails parameter of getMessageContentErr()?
question_31789.ground_truth: The errorDetails parameter of getMessageContentErr() provides additional information about the error that occurred, but the format for this information is not specified.

question_31791.question: What layer of the GSM/UMTS protocol handles the Activate PDP Context Request if the MS Application does not provide any PCO in its request?
question_31791.ground_truth: The MS EGAN Access Mode Switch creates one.

question_31792.question: What is the conformance requirement for the network initiated GPRS detach procedure with the cause 'GPRS services not allowed'?
question_31792.ground_truth: If the network performs a GPRS detach procedure with the cause 'GPRS services not allowed', the Mobile Station shall consider SIM invalid for GPRS services until power is switched off or SIM is removed.

question_31793.question: What information is included in the Short Message sent from the IP-SM-GW to the target MSC, in order to ensure that the reply to this SMS is sent back to it and interworked into the chat session?
question_31793.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW assigns an MSISDN representing the chat session to ensure that the reply to this SMS is sent back to this particular IP-SM-GW.

question_31794.question: What is the role of an RSU (Road Side Unit) in the 3GPP specifications?
question_31794.ground_truth: An RSU is a logical entity that combines V2X application logic with the functionality of an eNB (referred to as eNB-type RSU) or UE (referred to as UE-type RSU).

question_31796.question: What function does the LM.LocationDeterSucc measurement provide?
question_31796.ground_truth: It provides the number of successful location determinations provided by the LMF.

question_31797.question: What are the default Test PDP contexts used in the test cases where no particular Test PDP contexts are specified and UE is in DCH or FACH state?
question_31797.ground_truth: The default Test PDP context used in the test cases where no particular Test PDP contexts are specified and UE is in DCH state is test PDP contextDch1, and in FACH state is test PDP contextFach.

question_31798.question: What is the effect of DRX on time-of-outage percentage in the uni-directional tunnel scenario with DPS?
question_31798.ground_truth: The time-of-outage percentage is very low when the train is traveling in the same direction as the RRH beams orientation with or without DRX, but it is significant when the train travels opposite to the pointing direction of the RRH beams, even without DRX enabled.

question_31799.question: What is the role of SGSN+ in deriving the GSM cipher key Kc?
question_31799.ground_truth: SGSN+ derives the GSM cipher key Kc based on CK and IK and passes it to the new SGSN in the same manner as defined in TS 33.102.

question_31800.question: Under what conditions is an inter-frequency TDD target cell considered known by the UE, for inter-frequency TDD handover?
question_31800.ground_truth: An inter-frequency TDD target cell is considered known by the UE if it has been measured by the UE during the last 5 seconds.

question_31801.question: What is required for scripting in the 3GPP HTML5 profile?
question_31801.ground_truth: In the 3GPP HTML5 profile, user-agents shall support scripting as defined in HTML5 and shall support ECMA scripting language.

question_31804.question: What should the UE do after a successful initial emergency registration?
question_31804.ground_truth: The UE shall insert in the INVITE request, a From header field that includes the public user identity registered via emergency registration, a service URN in the Request-URI of the INVITE request, a To header field with the same emergency service URN as in the Request-URI, and a P-Access-Network-Info header field with a location identifier for routing the IMS emergency call.

question_31805.question: What is the requirement for RLM-RS resource overlapping with GAP in the context of SSB-based radio link monitoring?
question_31805.ground_truth: For a measurement gap, an RLM-RS resource or an SMTC occasion is considered to be overlapped with the GAP if it overlaps a measurement gap occasion. For NCSG measurement gap, an RLM-RS resource or an SMTC occasion is considered to be overlapped with the GAP if it overlaps the VIL1 or VIL2 of NCSG, or it overlaps the ML of NCSG and UE does not support IBM between the target carrier and the serving cell.

question_31806.question: What should be the value of bit 3 in Octet 9, if the MME/S4 SGSN supports CSG Information Change Reporting mechanism for the corresponding session?
question_31806.ground_truth: The value of bit 3 in Octet 9 should be set to 1, if the MME/S4 SGSN supports CSG Information Change Reporting mechanism for the corresponding session.

question_31807.question: What happens when TFO-Negotiation in transcoder A starts but is not successful in Mobile to PSTN call?
question_31807.ground_truth: TFO-Negotiation in transcoder A will start, but will not be successful (the PSTN does not answer) and so will terminate after about 5 seconds. TRAU A will continue to transcode. The MGWs are both transparent and are not aware that TFO was attempted.

question_31809.question: What does Solution #49 propose to address in the context of Key issue #20?
question_31809.ground_truth: Solution #49 provides a discovery service in the EEL so that other component EASs can be discovered and selected by the AC connected EAS based on need.

question_31812.question: When is L3 filtering used in the context of event triggered measurement reporting delay?
question_31812.ground_truth: L3 filtering is used in addition to L1 and L2 filtering to improve the accuracy of measurements. However, it can introduce an additional delay in the event triggered measurement reporting.

question_31814.question: What is the default value of the leaf node "/<x>/<x>/Common/AllowedCancelAlert" in the user profile?
question_31814.ground_truth: The default value of the leaf node "/<x>/<x>/Common/AllowedCancelAlert" in the user profile is true, which allows the MCVideo user to cancel an emergency alert in states "E1: Not in emergency state" and "E2: Emergency state".

question_31815.question: What is the effect of random SNR variations on a per-timeslot basis for some profiles, simulated in section 11.4.2.3.1?
question_31815.ground_truth: The simulated variation on a per-timeslot basis produced no discernible effect in the evaluation of the aggregated formats, for the evaluated cases including some of the most challenging ones.

question_31816.question: How does the ALTO client interact with the ALTO server?
question_31816.ground_truth: The ALTO client queries the ALTO Server, including the peer list, current location, and Cost type required, and the ALTO Server returns to the ALTO Client, a response including a Network Map, a Cost Map, and ranking available peers based on the received input.

question_31817.question: When is the UE ProSe ID provided to the UE under network coverage?
question_31817.ground_truth: The UE ProSe ID is provided to the UE at attach time under network coverage and can be renewed upon UE or network request as part of MM procedures.

question_31818.question: What is the expected outcome of comparing the existing 3GPP PM IRP specifications and TMF TIP Performance Management Business Agreement?
question_31818.ground_truth: The outcome is to analyze and determine any recommendations for updates of the PM IRP, and to identify areas where this work is synergetic with the model harmonization and FM harmonization work.

question_31819.question: What are the different addressing formats supported by the MMS?
question_31819.ground_truth: The MMS supports multiple addressing formats such as E-Mail addresses (RFC 2822), MSISDN (E.164), service provider specific addresses, and short codes for Value Added Services.

question_31821.question: What is the purpose of the Power Monitor package (javax.power.monitor) in MExE Classmark 2 devices?
question_31821.ground_truth: The Power Monitor package is used to access the power level of the MExE device and receive notifications concerning changes in power states in MExE Classmark 2 devices.

question_31822.question: What should the UE do if the "S-NSSAI not available in the current PLMN or SNPN" rejection cause is received in the rejected S-NSSAI(s) of the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message?
question_31822.ground_truth: The UE should store the rejected S-NSSAI(s) in the rejected NSSAI for the current PLMN or SNPN, and not attempt to use this S-NSSAI(s) in the current PLMN or SNPN over any access until switching off the UE or removing the rejected S-NSSAI(s) from the list of rejected NSSAI(s).

question_31823.question: What actions should the UE take when becoming available again in Solution #1?
question_31823.ground_truth: When the UE becomes available again in Solution #1, it sends a Registration Request to the AMF without MICO mode indication and re-establishes PDU sessions that are still required.

question_31824.question: What is the criticality of id-BroadcastMRBs-SetupMod-List in the BroadcastContextModificationResponseIEs F1AP-PROTOCOL-IES?
question_31824.ground_truth: The criticality of id-BroadcastMRBs-SetupMod-List in the BroadcastContextModificationResponseIEs F1AP-PROTOCOL-IES is reject.

question_31825.question: When an inter-frequency L1-RSRP measurement layer i is a candidate to be measured in a specific measurement gap j, what is the total number of intra-frequency, inter-frequency and inter-RAT frequency layers and up to one NR PRS measurement on any one positioning frequency layer, inter-frequency L1-RSRP measurement layers, which are also candidates to be measured in gap j?

question_31826.question: What is the role of the Media Gateway Control Function (MGCF) in the IMS?
question_31826.ground_truth: The MGCF controls the connection state for media channels in an IMS-MGW, communicates with CSCF, BGCF, and circuit switched network entities, determines the next hop depending on the routing number for incoming calls from legacy networks, performs protocol conversion between ISUP/TCAP/SIP-I and the IM subsystem call control protocols, and forwards out of band information received in MGCF to CSCF/IMS-MGW.

question_31829.question: How long is the first part of the test signal (comprising of the first 17,0 s) that is discarded from the analysis in order to allow for convergence of the acoustic echo canceller?
question_31829.ground_truth: The first 17,0 s of the test signal is discarded from the analysis.

question_31830.question: What is the purpose of E-DCH decoupling in 3GPP networks?
question_31830.ground_truth: The purpose of E-DCH decoupling in 3GPP networks is to minimize negative effects of DL/UL mismatch by giving the LPN control of UL grants and UL Tx power allocation to the UE.

question_31832.question: What are the principles for the handing of 5GS security contexts and the activation of ciphering and integrity protection when a NAS signalling connection is established?
question_31832.ground_truth: These principles are provided in subclause 4.4.

question_31833.question: Which solution, independently of how often the group key is updated, offers the best performance for key distribution in MBS?
question_31833.ground_truth: The communication optimized approach 2 as applied to Solution #1 or Solution #11

question_31834.question: How should the manufacturer declared coordinate system orientation of the OTA AAS BS be aligned for the OTA test procedure?
question_31834.ground_truth: The manufacturer declared coordinate system orientation of the OTA AAS BS should be aligned with the test system for the OTA test procedure.

question_31835.question: Which encoding type is used for the content of the SIP MESSAGE request when sending an SM delivery report over IP?
question_31835.ground_truth: The SM-over-IP sender will use content transfer encoding of type "binary" for the encoding of the SM in the body of the SIP MESSAGE request.

question_31837.question: What information does the UE client use to initiate a private call to the identified MCPTT user?
question_31837.ground_truth: The UE client extracts the MCPTT ID of the identified MCPTT user from the MCPTT Parameters of the received SIP MESSAGE request.

question_31838.question: In 3GPP TS 23.503, which Policy Control Request Trigger is associated with the "pras" attribute, which is defined in clause 4.2.3.3.1 and includes the presence reporting areas for which reporting is required or removed?
question_31838.ground_truth: The Policy Control Request Trigger "Change of UE presence in PRA" or if that trigger was already set and needs to be removed, the presence reporting areas for which reporting was required can be managed using the "pras" attribute.

question_31840.question: What is the purpose of the default MuSiK download?
question_31840.ground_truth: The default MuSiK download is used to set, reset or unset a MuSiK and its corresponding MuSiK-ID and is applicable to all groups supported by the MCVideo client, except for certain identified groups for which MuSiKs and MUSiK-IDs are assigned, reassigned or unassigned separately via explicit MuSiK download.

question_31843.question: What is the purpose of the test described in subclause 6.6.2.7.1?
question_31843.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to measure spurious emissions from the BSS transmitter antenna connectors outside the BSS relevant transmit band and to test the intra-BTS intermodulation requirements when the carriers are in operation.

question_31844.question: In what situations can the E-UTRAN initiate the mobility from E-UTRA procedure?
question_31844.ground_truth: The E-UTRAN can initiate the mobility from E-UTRA procedure in response to a MeasurementReport message, reception of CS fallback indication for the UE from MME, or an MCGFailureInformation message, or possibly in response to a specific event.

question_31846.question: In 5G systems, when is the NAS layer informed by the lower layers about the start of an access attempt, and when is the access category authorized?
question_31846.ground_truth: When an access attempt is about to start, the lower layer informs the NAS layer about the start of the access attempt. The NAS layer then derives an access category for the access attempt and asks the AS layer for authorization for the access category. If not authorized, the lower layer blocks the access attempt, and if authorized, the lower layer proceeds with the access attempt.

question_31848.question: What is the event verdict for the intra frequency NR cell re-selection test case if both the "Re-select newly detected Cell 2" and "Re-select already detected Cell 1" events pass?
question_31848.ground_truth: If both events pass, the test passes.

question_31850.question: What should the SMF do when it receives the PCC rule for application detection and control and if the ADC feature is supported?
question_31850.ground_truth: The SMF shall instruct the UPF to detect the application traffic, report the detected application's traffic start/stop events along with the application instance identifier and service data flow descriptions when service data flow descriptions are deducible. The SMF shall report the start/stop of the application to the PCF upon receiving the corresponding event from the UPF.

question_31851.question: What are the parameters in a vehicle that are not constrained like those in a handset, allowing it to facilitate a high category device?
question_31851.ground_truth: The parameters include the physical distribution of antennae, available power, heat dispersal, device size, and number of antennae.

question_31852.question: What is the field called that indicates the type of SI/PSI messages provided by the reporting cell in the NACC application?

question_31853.question: What is the function of the Service-Mode AVP in the 3GPP charging system?
question_31853.ground_truth: The Service-Mode AVP (AVP Code 2032) is of type Unsigned32 and provides the mode for various MMTel supplementary services, such as Communication Forwarding Unconditional (CFU) or Incoming Call Barring (ICB).

question_31854.question: What is the second method described for preserving the user plane state when a UE relocates, called the "5GC assisted procedure"?
question_31854.ground_truth: In this method, the 5G Core (5GC) assists in storing the flow state and transferring it to the new path during handover. The flow state consists of a 3-tuple (destination IP, port, protocol) and segment route list.

question_31856.question: What feature is introduced in PFCP to enable CP functions to instruct UP functions to pause charging?
question_31856.ground_truth: NSPOC (Notify Start Pause of Charging via user plane feature)

question_31858.question: What is the variable Ms expressed in?

question_31860.question: What is the breakout point in the wide bandwidth and narrow bandwidth consideration for Category B OBUE?
question_31860.ground_truth: The breakout point is at BWcontiguous of 500MHz.

question_31861.question: What is the effect of the Suspend Notification message on the S-GW and P-GW?
question_31861.ground_truth: The Suspend Notification message causes the S-GW and P-GW to mark the preserved non-GBR bearers as suspended.

question_31863.question: What numerical value represents the priority given to one particular WLAN in PreferredSSIDList?
question_31863.ground_truth: The Priority is represented as an int numerical value in PreferredSSIDList.

question_31864.question: What is one of the potential requirements for addressing security in a 5G system with satellite access?

question_31865.question: What should the NF Service Consumer (e.g. V-SMF or I-SMF) do in step 1 of the Transfer MO Data service operation?
question_31865.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should send a POST request to the URI of Transfer MO Data custom operation on an individual PDU Session resource in the SMF and the content of the POST request should contain the mobile originated data to be transferred.

question_31867.question: How is the pathID provided to the UE in the 5G LAN group communication proposal?
question_31867.ground_truth: Upon successful PDU Session Establishment, the pathID and destination UE MAC address are provided to the UE.

question_31868.question: In the 6.5.3 signalling control plane description, what is the role of the signalling user agent functional entity?
question_31868.ground_truth: The signalling user agent functional entity acts as the SIP user agent (both client and server) for all SIP transactions.

question_31869.question: What should the UE do when it receives a correct message over Temporary C-RNTI?
question_31869.ground_truth: The UE should send ACK and consider the contention resolution successful, and the random access procedure successfully completed.

question_31871.question: What is the function of the PSA in mapping between the IPv4/v6 address / Prefix of a device behind the UE and the "access side layer 2 header"?
question_31871.ground_truth: The PSA maps between the IPv4/v6 address / Prefix of a device behind the UE and the "access side layer 2 header" as follows: in UL the "access side layer 2 header" framing coming from a device in the Customer Premises is removed by the PSA. The UPF keeps track of the association between an IP address of the UE and the corresponding "access side layer 2 header". In DL the "access side layer 2 header" is added by the UPF before sending the traffic towards a device in the Customer Premises. Necessary MAC address swapping is enforced by the PSA on the "access side layer 2 header" stored from UL traffic.

question_31872.question: What type of data is not considered in the 3GPP Generic User Profile (GUP) out of the following options: Run Time Data, Historic/Statistic Data, and Charging and billing related data?
question_31872.ground_truth: Run Time Data and Historic/Statistic Data are not considered in GUP.

question_31873.question: What is the trigger for the SMF in the Distributed Anchor connectivity model to initiate an EAS rediscovery procedure?
question_31873.ground_truth: The SMF initiates the EAS rediscovery procedure in the Distributed Anchor connectivity model when the common DNAI is triggered for reselection.

question_31875.question: What is the expected benefit of the blind E-DPDCH detection solution?
question_31875.ground_truth: The blind E-DPDCH detection solution is expected to benefit scenarios where a large number of users transmit with a small set of recurring transport formats, such as VoIP, and by eliminating the E-DPCCH from the smallest TB size(s) to extend the coverage of the minimum data rate.

question_31876.question: In what situation would an E-UTRAN capable UE initiate a tracking area update?
question_31876.ground_truth: An E-UTRAN capable UE would initiate a tracking area update when there is a change in its usage setting or voice domain preference, or when it manually selects a CSG cell not present in its allowed or operator CSG lists.

question_31877.question: What happens if the MS does not include a PDP address in the test case?
question_31877.ground_truth: Dynamic PDP address shall be assigned by the SS

question_31879.question: What should the MCPTT client include in the Contact header field of the SIP INVITE request when establishing an MCPTT session?
question_31879.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should include the g.3gpp.mcptt media feature tag and the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag with the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt" in the Contact header field of the SIP INVITE request.

question_31880.question: In the One Dimensional Compact Range Chamber measurement setup, what replaces the standard concave mirror and feed horn setup to generate a plane wave in the quiet zone?
question_31880.ground_truth: A special one dimensional probe is used in place of the concave mirror and feed horn setup.

question_31881.question: What is the role of the W-AGF when the RG is a 5G-RG and the UE behind the RG authenticates to the 5GC using NSWO procedure?
question_31881.ground_truth: When the RG is a 5G-RG and the UE behind the RG authenticates to the 5GC using NSWO procedure, the W-AGF is not involved in the authentication process.

question_31882.question: What message does the mobile station send to the CTS-FP in the classmark change procedure?
question_31882.ground_truth: The mobile station sends a CTS-CLASSMARK CHANGE message to the CTS-FP in the classmark change procedure.

question_31883.question: What is the necessary and sufficient condition for a specific II-NNI traversal scenario type?
question_31883.ground_truth: The presence of the "+g.3gpp.loopback" feature-capability indicator in an initial INVITE request is a necessary and sufficient condition for a "Loopback" II-NNI traversal scenario.

question_31885.question: In what scenarios can the network slice quota checking procedure be applied?
question_31885.ground_truth: The network slice quota checking procedure can be applied for non-roaming and local breakout roaming cases. It is also applicable for LBO (Local Breakout) scenario, where the V-SMF (Virtual SMF) determines the quota for a UE (User Equipment) based on analytical information from the V-NWDAF (Virtual NWDAF).

question_31887.question: What triggers the modification period for system information in LTE?
question_31887.ground_truth: The modification period for system information in LTE is defined by SFN values for which SFN mod m = 0, where m is the number of radio frames comprising the modification period.

question_31888.question: What is the total interruption time (Tinterrupt) in the context of PSCell command?
question_31888.ground_truth: Tinterrupt is the sum of Tsearch, TIU, and Tprocessing, where Tsearch is the time required to search the target cell, TIU is the delay uncertainty due to the random-access procedure, and Tprocessing is the SW processing time needed by UE.

question_31891.question: What is the procedure to replace the DNN during PDU Session Establishment?
question_31891.ground_truth: The PCF provides the selected DNN to the AMF, which uses it in the query towards the NRF for SMF selection and provides both requested and selected DNN to the selected SMF. Whether DNN replacement is performed for roaming sessions depends on operator agreements.

question_31892.question: What interfaces are supported in Architecture scenario C for signalling between the BPCF and the BBF AF?
question_31892.ground_truth: The G/E reference point in BBF domain

question_31893.question: What is the purpose of defining the "Source Packet Indication" in the LCT Header?
question_31893.ground_truth: It is used to indicate whether a packet contains source data or repair data with systematic FEC Schemes that define a different FEC Payload ID format for packets containing only source data compared to the FEC Payload ID format for packets containing repair data.

question_31894.question: What should the ADRF use to verify the credentials of the NFc when it presents CCA as credentials?
question_31894.ground_truth: The ADRF should support the verification of CCA by caching the information provided in step 7.

question_31895.question: What is the effect on the ad hoc group if an emergency or imminent peril indicator is present in the received MCPTT ad hoc group call request?
question_31895.ground_truth: The MCPTT ad hoc group is considered to be in the in-progress emergency state or in-progress imminent peril state until the ad hoc group call is terminated.

question_31896.question: What is the difference between the two variants of the architecture solution 1?
question_31896.ground_truth: Variant 1 has no Sxx control plane, while variant 2 has a control plane Sxx for the setup of a direct data path between H(e)NB and L-GW.

question_31897.question: How does the RAN identify the PDU Set and transmit the PDUs within the PDU Set?
question_31897.ground_truth: The RAN identifies the PDU Set based on the PDU Set info in GTP-U header and transmits PDUs within the PDU Set in an integrated manner, such as dropping the PDU Set as a whole in case of poor network condition.

question_31898.question: What is the role of 3GPP system in supporting service requirements and KPIs for UAVs?
question_31898.ground_truth: The 3GPP system supports service requirements and KPIs related to command and control, payload, and the operation of radio access nodes on-board of UAVs. This is described in 3GPP TS 22.125.

question_31899.question: What are the practical and functional implications of terminating the X3 interface in the user plane function?
question_31899.ground_truth: Operationally difficult to ensure IP connectivity, risk of passing UE permanent identities to the user plane function, user plane function may not be able to provide all the information as defined today over the X3 interface, requirement to have access to UE session related information, and requirement to summarize data traffic on a per IP flow basis.

question_31901.question: What is the packet data protocol used in the test cases?
question_31901.ground_truth: The packet data protocol used in the test cases is IP, with a value of 02 in the bearer parameters.

question_31902.question: What is the effect of not fitting a duplexer when performing tests on a BS?
question_31902.ground_truth: If a duplexer is supplied as an option by the manufacturer, sufficient tests should be repeated with and without the duplexer fitted to verify that the BS meets the requirements of the present document in both cases.

question_31903.question: How does a group member who receives GC data in Unicast way in LTE access the group data when they join the group communication?
question_31903.ground_truth: The group member who receives GC data in Unicast way can access the group data via the Unicast link using their security context, which is separate from other group members. This means that adding or removing a group member will not affect the security of other group members.

question_31904.question: What action does MSC2 take after receiving the updated LCLS-Status message?
question_31904.ground_truth: MSC2 updates the information to the remote end with the new LCLS-Status after handover.

question_31905.question: What is the effect of input level on the performance of the Wideband codec in NAE and Finnish languages?
question_31905.ground_truth: In NAE, the input level has little effect on DMOS, while in Finnish, the scores for low input level are markedly lower.

question_31906.question: What is the name of the subheader in the MAC PDU for SL-SCH that consists of the seven header fields V/R/R/R/R/SRC/DST?

question_31907.question: What is the purpose of SAD and SPD in IPsec?
question_31907.ground_truth: SAD (Security Associations Database) and SPD (Security Policy Database) are used by IPsec to store various security parameters for each Security Association. Negotiable parameters for security association setup are agreed during IMS AKA and maintained in TTCN-3.

question_31909.question: When is access control performed in 5GMM-IDLE mode?
question_31909.ground_truth: Access control is performed in 5GMM-IDLE mode only for the event defined in subclause 4.5.1.

question_31910.question: What is the role of a V2X application enabler client?
question_31910.ground_truth: A V2X application enabler client is an entity that provides the client-side functionalities corresponding to the V2X application enabler layer.

question_31911.question: What is the main feature of Solution 11 for secure channel between USIM and RN and AS integrity for S1/X2?
question_31911.ground_truth: The main features of this solution are autonomous validation of the RN platform, secure channel between USIM-RN and RN, certificate validation client on the UICC, AS integrity for S1/X2, and use of a second USIM for initial IP connectivity prior to RN attachment.

question_31912.question: What should the gNB-CU-CP do if it receives an IAB UP TNL ADDRESS UPDATE message but the update cannot be performed?
question_31912.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP shall respond with an IAB UP TNL ADDRESS UPDATE FAILURE message and include an appropriate cause value.

question_31914.question: When must operators include enhanced "Service Parameters" with the character string "+ue-<ue usage type>" in NAPTR records?
question_31914.ground_truth: When DCN is deployed and the operator needs to provision NAPTR records for UE usage types.

question_31916.question: What is the purpose of determining the impacted UE(s) in this NG-RAN and UPF/NW-TT timing synchronization status reporting process?
question_31916.ground_truth: Determining the impacted UE(s) allows the TSCTSF to take appropriate action based on the status of the timing synchronization and the clock quality acceptance criteria, such as updating the clockQuality information in Announce messages or notifying the service status to the AF.

question_31918.question: From which field does SharedNGU-MulticastTNLInformation come in the context of MBS-SessionTNLInfo5GC?
question_31918.ground_truth: The 'locationdependent' choice within MBS-SessionTNLInfo5GC comes from this field.

question_31919.question: What type of devices support the reception of MBMS data but not uplink transmission?
question_31919.ground_truth: ROM devices support MBMS reception but do not support uplink transmission.

question_31920.question: Which complexType has a sequence that includes "CurrentServingNcgi", "NeighbouringNcgi", and "MbmsSaId" elements, none of them having any specified type?

question_31921.question: What principle is used to compare the measurement results returned by the test system against the test requirements?

question_31922.question: What information is signaled from the N3IWF to the 5G ProSe Layer-3 Remote UE in the dynamic QoS signalling based mechanism for QoS support?
question_31922.ground_truth: The N3IWF signals the PDU Session ID, QFI(s), optionally a DSCP value, optionally the Additional QoS Information, and the PDU Session Establishment Accept message to the 5G ProSe Layer-3 Remote UE.

question_31925.question: What are the other two HARQ enhancement features introduced in the new 5G design?
question_31925.ground_truth: The other two features are enhanced (Type 2) dynamic codebook for HARQ ACK and one-shot (Type 3) codebook for HARQ ACK. These features are introduced to support UE ACK/NACK re-transmissions.

question_31928.question: What is the role of UE-A in the WLAN Direct group formation?
question_31928.ground_truth: UE-A responds to the group setup request and allocates IP addresses to UE-A and UE-B, and functions as the GO (Group Owner) for the WLAN Direct group.

question_31929.question: In which clause is the description of the Bluetooth positioning method and its operation found?
question_31929.ground_truth: The description of the Bluetooth positioning method and its operation is found in clause 16.

question_31930.question: What is the transport format combination on the transport channel mapped to the Primary CCPCH?
question_31930.ground_truth: The transport format combination on the transport channel mapped to the Primary CCPCH is a fixed predefined transport format combination.

question_31931.question: What is the minimum measurement period for E-UTRA measurements when the UE does not need measurement occasions to perform E-UTRA measurements?
question_31931.ground_truth: If the UE does not need measurement occasions to perform E-UTRA measurements, the minimum measurement period for E-UTRA measurements is 480 ms.

question_31932.question: What is the type of the Reason-Header AVP?
question_31932.ground_truth: The Reason-Header AVP is of type UTF8String.

question_31934.question: What is the role of the PDU-Set Delay Budget (PSDB) in 5GS and real-time media?
question_31934.ground_truth: The PDU-Set Delay Budget (PSDB) defines an upper bound for the time that a PDU-Set may be delayed between the UE and the N6 termination point at the UPF, providing an upper bound for the time a PDU-Set may be delayed in both UL and DL directions. It applies to the DL PDU-Set received by the UPF over the N6 interface and to the UL PDU-Set sent by the UE.

question_31935.question: What is the role of the Local NEF in QoS monitoring with local notification?
question_31935.ground_truth: The Local NEF receives local notification of QoS monitoring and transfers it to the AF. It also sends the event notification to the notification endpoint of the AF.

question_31936.question: What is the maximum allowed rate of ACK/NACK feedback loss on any non-dormant serving cell when the UE performs RRM measurements on dormant SCells?
question_31936.ground_truth: The rate of ACK/NACK feedback loss on any non-dormant serving cell resulting from RRM measurements on dormant SCells shall not exceed 1.0%.

question_31937.question: What is the task of the ProSe Function when it receives the Auth Request message?
question_31937.ground_truth: The ProSe Function verifies the authorization for the monitoring UE to perform restricted discovery and identifies the corresponding Target RPAUID.

question_31938.question: In the context of the Floor Idle message, what does the first bit in the subtype being set to '0' indicate?

question_31939.question: What should the ME do if the UICC responds with "allowed, with modifications" and the modified request is beyond the ME's capabilities?
question_31939.ground_truth: If the request is not initiated by a proactive command, the ME may give information to the user on the modified request and the fact that it is beyond the ME's capabilities. If the request is initiated by a proactive command, the ME shall give a TERMINAL RESPONSE to the proactive command and not give any information to the user on the fact that the modified request is beyond the ME's capabilities.

question_31941.question: What should be the CSI report with non-zero CQI index for SCell1 received by the SS earlier than or equal to subframe (m+49) in the scenario described in part 8b?
question_31941.ground_truth: The CSI report should be received by the SS earlier than or equal to subframe (m+49) in the scenario described in part 8b.

question_31942.question: What is the impact of network slice admission control on PDU sessions for priority services in Rel-17, as specified in TS 24.501, clause 4.6.3.1?
question_31942.ground_truth: Based on operator policy, the session management based network slice admission control is not applicable for the PDU session for priority services, or the session management based network slice admission control result is ignored for the PDU session for priority services.

question_31943.question: Why might a UE need to proactively re-discover a usable P-CSCF in the new IP-CAN?
question_31943.ground_truth: The UE may proactively re-discover a usable P-CSCF in the new IP-CAN to avoid service disruptions if it finds out that the old P-CSCF is not usable anymore.

question_31944.question: What is the role of the GMLC in the handover process?
question_31944.ground_truth: The GMLC (Gateway Mobile Location Center) is responsible for acknowledging messages from the source and target sides, as well as conveying the location of the UE to the appropriate serving nodes.

question_31946.question: What is the UE Rx-Tx measurement accuracy requirement for the test described in section 7.6.13.2 of the document?
question_31946.ground_truth: The UE Rx-Tx measurement accuracy requirement for the test is specified in clause 10.1.39.3 of TS 38.133, but the specific value is not provided in the section.

question_31947.question: What does the getFdServices() API do and what are its parameters?
question_31947.ground_truth: The getFdServices() API returns a list describing the available File Delivery Application Service, where each service is described by several output only parameters, and it does not have any input parameters.

question_31948.question: What is the EARFCN range for the carrier frequency in the uplink and downlink?
question_31948.ground_truth: The EARFCN range for the carrier frequency in the uplink and downlink is 0 - 262143.

question_31949.question: What parameters are used for second-level PLC method selection in case the last good frame prior to a loss was coded with HQ MDCT?
question_31949.ground_truth: The parameters used for second-level PLC method selection are output sampling rate, bit rate, voicing, correlation, transient condition, and spectral envelope stability based speech/music classification.

question_31950.question: What is required in the Symbol-Based File Repair Request Message when requesting repair data for a single file?
question_31950.ground_truth: The URI or an identifier of the file, and the MD5 hash value of the transport object if present.

question_31951.question: What is the impact of the solution on AMF?
question_31951.ground_truth: The solution defines "CDRX change" as an access related PCRT in the UE context in RAN and sets a "CDRX change" trigger condition in the UE context in RAN. When the trigger condition is met, RAN informs AMF by using an N2 message.

question_31952.question: What is a 3DOF source system and how is it identified in the FLUS architecture?
question_31952.ground_truth: A 3DOF source system is a FLUS source system that can be defined in a way that enables the user to view the media content from a single observation point in 3D space. It is identified by the unique identifier urn:org:3gpp:flus:3dof:2017 and is defined with a coordinate system that consists of three axes and the ability to look around from a single observation point in 3D space.

question_31953.question: When should the MS initiate the GPRS detach procedure if it has received a Detach Request message with detach type indicating "re-attach required"?
question_31953.ground_truth: The MS should initiate the GPRS detach procedure and deactivate PDP context(s), MBMS context(s), and logical link(s) after receiving a Detach Request message with detach type indicating "re-attach required".

question_31954.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe ID in the network-based solution for ProSe discovery?
question_31954.ground_truth: The ProSe ID is a temporary user identity specific to an application instance of which the ID is assigned by the ProSe Server. It is used for ProSe discovery and communication, and indicates whether it is allocated for open discovery or restrictive discovery.

question_31955.question: What is the role of the N4 Session Context in 5G systems?
question_31955.ground_truth: The N4 Session Context is a set of parameters related to an N4 session, including the N4 session ID, general session-related parameters, PDRs, URRs, QERs, BAR(s), FARs, MARs, and parameters for UPF statistics. The UPF uses these parameters to determine internal resources and manage data traffic for the PDU session.

question_31957.question: What is the minimum power boosting requirement for NB-IoT RBs within 90% of NR channel bandwidth in a channel bandwidth larger than 20 MHz?
question_31957.ground_truth: The minimum power boosting requirement for NB-IoT RBs within 90% of NR channel bandwidth in a channel bandwidth larger than 20 MHz is +6 dB.

question_31959.question: What does the Power Offset For Secondary CPICH for MIMO IE indicate in the context of TS 25.214?
question_31959.ground_truth: The Power Offset For Secondary CPICH for MIMO IE indicates the relative transmit power of the S-CPICH compared to the primary CPICH transmit power, when S-CPICH is used as a phase reference for a second transmit antenna in MIMO mode.

question_31960.question: What should the SMF do, in terms of QoS parameters allocation, for PDU Sessions with UP integrity protection of UP Security Enforcement Information set to Required?
question_31960.ground_truth: The SMF may perform the EPS bearer ID allocation procedure if the UE supports User Plane Integrity Protection with EPS and the AMF supports the associated functionality.

question_31962.question: In closed loop mode 1, what is the role of the feedback signaling message (FSM) and how are its bits transmitted?
question_31962.ground_truth: The FSM bits are transmitted in the FBI field of uplink DPCCH slot(s), and they are used to transmit power and phase settings.

question_31963.question: What is the SMS TPDU in the SMS-PP Download message 3.1.2?
question_31963.ground_truth: The SMS TPDU in the SMS-PP Download message 3.1.2 is used to download (U)SIM data.

question_31964.question: What can IoT devices do before establishing a direct device connection using a non-3GPP access technology?
question_31964.ground_truth: IoT devices can use 3GPP credentials to determine if they are authorized to engage in direct device connection before establishing a connection.

question_31966.question: What is the purpose of the TP-UDHI bit in the TP-User-Data field?
question_31966.ground_truth: The TP-UDHI bit is used to indicate whether the TP-User-Data field contains only the short message or if it includes a header in addition to the message.

question_31967.question: What should the SS do if the UE is not a Release 16 or forward 5G NR UE as per step 5b?
question_31967.ground_truth: The SS does not need to take any action.

question_31970.question: What is a requirement for utilizing overlapping CA approach in an irregular bandwidth from the user equipment (UE) perspective?
question_31970.ground_truth: The UE should support intra-band non-contiguous CA for the combination.

question_31972.question: Which term in the SECAM documentation refers to the formal recognition of a test laboratory's competence in carrying out specific tests or types of assessments related to 3GPP network products?
question_31972.ground_truth: The term "accreditation" in the SECAM documentation refers to the formal recognition of a test laboratory's competence in carrying out specific tests or types of assessments related to 3GPP network products.

question_31973.question: What information is included in the new EDI2 in step 2 of Option 1 for NEF-based EDI provision to a serving operator?
question_31973.ground_truth: When NEF of Operator A translates the received EDI1 from AF to a new EDI2 corresponding to Operator B, it includes the DNAI of Operator B in the new EDI2 and optionally adds N6 traffic routing information in the new EDI2.

question_31976.question: What is the maximum time taken for interruption uncertainty in acquiring the first available PRACH occasion in the new cell?
question_31976.ground_truth: TIU can be up to the summation of SSB to PRACH occasion association period and 10 ms.

question_31977.question: Is it true that If there was another war, Tom and Jerry would join the forces?

question_31978.question: What actions can a UE take while in the RM-DEREGIESTERED state in 5GS Registration Management?
question_31978.ground_truth: A UE in the RM-DEREGISTERED state can attempt to register with the selected PLMN using the Initial Registration procedure if it needs to receive service that requires registration, remain in RM-DEREGISTERED state if receiving a Registration Reject upon Initial Registration, or enter RM-REGISTERED state upon receiving a Registration Accept.

question_31980.question: What is the duration of time window dT in this test scenario?
question_31980.ground_truth: The duration of time window dT in this test scenario is not specified exactly; it is only mentioned that there are three successive time windows dT during the test.

question_31981.question: What shall the MCVideo client do when it receives a SIP INFO request where the Request-URI contains an MCVideo session ID identifying an ongoing group session?
question_31981.ground_truth: The MCVideo client shall follow the actions specified in subclause 6.2.8.1.13, which covers both on-demand and ongoing sessions.

question_31982.question: What is the parameter used to adjust the delay spread in the DS of equation (7.6-17) in the angular power profile calculation?

question_31983.question: What is the purpose of the Cause IE in the M3AP protocol?
question_31983.ground_truth: The Cause IE in the M3AP protocol indicates the reason for a particular event for the M3AP protocol.

question_31985.question: Which data type is used for the "Pre-selected-indication" element in the XML schema?

question_31986.question: What solutions cannot be combined with Solution 4 in terms of PCRF failure handling?
question_31986.ground_truth: Solution 4 should not be combined with Solution 5, which deals with the restoration of PCRF session state.

question_31988.question: What is the role of the TWAN-S2a-Connectivity-Indicator in the 3GPP AAA Server's response?
question_31988.ground_truth: The TWAN-S2a-Connectivity-Indicator indicates if the UE's EAP-AKA' challenge response has been successfully checked, and if set, the 3GPP AAA Server may disregard the received EAP-Payload.

question_31993.question: How does the ProSe UE-to-Network Relay determine the requirement of PC5 Connection?
question_31993.ground_truth: The ProSe UE-to-NW relay determines the requirement of PC5 Connection, e.g. S-NSSAI, DNN, QoS, based on other solutions for Key Issue #3.

question_31994.question: What is one way the MME can control signalling load from SGWs during an overload situation?
question_31994.ground_truth: The MME can reject Downlink Data Notification requests for non-priority traffic from SGWs during an overload situation, allowing it to control the signalling load generated by its SGWs.

question_31998.question: What is the main objective of the simplified architecture for CIoT small data transmission?
question_31998.ground_truth: The main objective is to address key issues by using a simplified architecture that supports transporting small data over NAS signalling messages and combines core network functions.

question_31999.question: What is the significance of local breakout roaming in the 5G connection and mobility charging architecture?
question_31999.ground_truth: Local breakout roaming in the 5G connection and mobility charging architecture allows for the selection of one or both of the architectures depending on the agreement between operators.

question_32001.question: What should the NF service consumer do after sending a successful POST request to the PFDF when the "NotificationPush" feature is supported and the "pfdOp" attribute is set to "RETRIEVE" or not provided?
question_32001.ground_truth: The NF service consumer shall invoke the full pull procedure or the partial pull procedure if the "PartialPull" feature is supported to retrieve the PFDs for the application identifier(s).

question_32002.question: In what situation would the UE set the Measurement Results for the Serving Cell within measResultServingMOList?
question_32002.ground_truth: The UE sets the Measurement Results for the Serving Cell within measResultServingMOList when SSB based serving cell measurements are available for the Serving Cell.

question_32003.question: Which coding scheme is used for the turbo coded MCSs defined for radio transmission?
question_32003.ground_truth: For the turbo coded MCSs defined for radio transmission, the same mother convolutional code as used in UTRAN (Universal Terrestrial Radio Access Network) is used in combination with linear puncturing.

question_32004.question: Which reference point is used for group call procedures for both on-network and off-network?
question_32004.ground_truth: The MCVideo-1 reference point, which exists between the MCVideo client and the MC Video server, is used for group call procedures for both on-network and off-network.

question_32005.question: What is the requirement for E-CSCF when routing an emergency session?
question_32005.ground_truth: E-CSCF shall follow the same rules and procedures as defined in clause 7.3 of the Serving IMS network for emergency session establishment.

question_32006.question: What is the difference between the 3GPP JSON Merge Patch and the standard JSON Merge Patch?
question_32006.ground_truth: 3GPP JSON Merge Patch allows for updating, creating, or deleting descendant resources, whereas standard JSON Merge Patch does not. This is achieved by relaxing the constraint on providing the complete updated array value.

question_32008.question: What is the primary motivation for using a generic secure push layer?
question_32008.ground_truth: The main reason for using a generic secure push layer is to avoid duplication of work and specifications in various applications. By using a generic security layer, multiple applications can leverage the same secure push layer without having to implement and maintain individual security mechanisms.

question_32010.question: What are some considerations for signalling regarding whether or not the network would benefit from the knowledge of whether a mobile terminal supports a SAIC advanced receiver technique or not?
question_32010.ground_truth: Some considerations for signalling include eliminating signalling from the work item, having the network deduce from multiple uplink measurement reports whether SAIC is supported, and having the mobile terminal indicate to the network whether it supports advanced receiver capabilities.

question_32013.question: How much should the UL noise be de-rated when PC2 n77 cross band isolation into n25 is considered?
question_32013.ground_truth: The UL noise should be de-rated by 3.5 dB when PC2 n77 cross band isolation into n25 is considered.

question_32014.question: What happens if the AF guidance for URSP determination targets a group of UEs or any UE?
question_32014.ground_truth: Each individual UE authorization is performed at a later stage by PCF, and NEF authorizes the request based on local policy (e.g. based on AF Id) without requesting for any service specific authorization from UDM.

question_32016.question: What is the purpose of the UE Context Modification procedure in 5G?
question_32016.ground_truth: The UE Context Modification procedure is used to partly modify the established UE context in 5G. This allows for updating certain parameters and information related to the UE's context, such as the security keys and mobile IAB authorization.

question_32018.question: What is the purpose of the dynamic DRA binding created by the H-DRA (proxy) in the home PLMN if an active DRA binding does not exist?
question_32018.ground_truth: The dynamic DRA binding is created by the H-DRA (proxy) in the home PLMN to assign a PCRF node per UE or per IP-CAN session if an active DRA binding does not exist. The user information, such as UE-NAI, is stored in the dynamic DRA binding.

question_32019.question: What will the AMF include in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message if the network slice-specific authentication and authorization has been successfully performed for a particular S-NSSAI?
question_32019.ground_truth: The AMF will include the allowed NSSAI containing the S-NSSAI that has been successfully authenticated and authorized in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

question_32020.question: Who is responsible for encoding the NR-MIB message for the broadcast of SIB1 and other specific SIBs in a 5G network?
question_32020.ground_truth: The gNB-DU is responsible for encoding the NR-MIB message for the broadcast of SIB1, while the gNB-CU is responsible for encoding other SIBs.

question_32022.question: Which interfaces are protected using HTTPS for SEALDD interfaces?
question_32022.ground_truth: The SEALDD-UU, SEALDD-C, SEALDD-S and SEALDD-E interfaces are protected using HTTPS for SEALDD interfaces.

question_32023.question: What will the IWF do if a SIP 404 (Not Found) response is not cached and it receives a SIP INVITE request for controlling MCPTT function of an MCPTT group?
question_32023.ground_truth: The IWF will return a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response to the SIP INVITE request and include the Warning header field received in the SIP 403 (Forbidden) response.

question_32024.question: What is the difference between "contiguous" and "non-contiguous" spectrum in the context of the document?
question_32024.ground_truth: Contiguous spectrum refers to spectrum that is adjacent and connected, while non-contiguous spectrum refers to spectrum that is not adjacent or connected.

question_32026.question: What is the agreed SMTC periodicity bound for reusing the Rel-16 FR1 HST scaling factor for FR2 HST measurements?
question_32026.ground_truth: The agreed SMTC periodicity bound for reusing the Rel-16 FR1 HST scaling factor for FR2 HST measurements is 40ms.

question_32027.question: What is the purpose of the Media Source Extensions (MSE) API in HTML5?
question_32027.ground_truth: The Media Source Extensions (MSE) API in HTML5 allows integration of media streaming into HTML5 documents and provides a flexible solution that can be used in different environments and applications. It currently supports three byte stream formats, including the ISO BMFF Byte Stream Format.

question_32028.question: Which profiles and bit depths are used for H.265/HEVC anchors?
question_32028.ground_truth: The H.265/HEVC anchors use Main 10 Profile and an internal bitdepth of 10 for all sequences.

question_32032.question: When a UE roams and receives Inter-system Mobility Policies from both H-ANDSF and V-ANDSF, which set of policies does the UE select when the RPLMN identity is equal to one of the VPLMNs included in the visited PLMNs with preferred rules?
question_32032.ground_truth: The UE selects the set of Inter-system Mobility Policies from V-ANDSF.

question_32033.question: What technology does the 5G System need to use to provide positioning service with a horizontal accuracy of less than 10 m both indoors and outdoors, and a vertical accuracy of less than 3 m indoors?
question_32033.ground_truth: The 5G System can use a combination of 3GPP technologies and non-3GPP technologies, such as GNSS, Terrestrial Beacon Systems, sensors, WLAN, and Bluetooth-based positioning.

question_32034.question: What action should the participating MCVideo function take if the SIP MESSAGE request for binding a functional alias with the MCVideo group(s) for the MCVideo user does not contain an application/resource-lists+xml MIME body or the <binding-ind> element and the <binding-fa-uri> element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body?
question_32034.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function should reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response, including warning text set to "177 unable to determine target functional alias or group for creating/removing a binding information for the MCVideo user" in a Warning header field.

question_32035.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message with "re-registration required" and for 3GPP access in the network-initiated de-registration procedure?
question_32035.ground_truth: The UE should release the PDU sessions over 3GPP access locally, stop timers T3346, T35ab, and T35cd if they are running, ignore the 5GMM cause IE if received, send a DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT message to the network, enter state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED for 3GPP access, delete temporarily and permanently rejected NSSAI(s) for the current PLMN, and initiate an initial registration after the completion of the de-registration procedure.

question_32036.question: What is the requirement during an IMS MES regarding sending emergency-related data?
question_32036.ground_truth: The realization of the transfer of data during an eCall shall minimize changes to the originating and transit networks, and both the voice and data components of the eCall shall be routed to the same PSAP or designated emergency call center.

question_32037.question: If the server does not support the requested scale value or the content does not support it, what action does the server take for scaled playout?
question_32037.ground_truth: The server decides the level of scaled playout to serve to the client.

question_32038.question: In what situations must the controlling MCPTT function generate a SIP 200 (OK) response towards the MCPTT client?
question_32038.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function must generate a SIP 200 (OK) response towards the MCPTT client when it receives a SIP BYE request and needs to release the media plane resource associated with the SIP session towards the MCPTT client.

question_32040.question: Which algorithm is used to determine a minimum set of source symbols for successful recovery of a matrix?
question_32040.ground_truth: The algorithm described in option 6.1.3.1 uses maximum Gaussian elimination on matrix A to determine a minimum set of source symbols for successful recovery.

question_32041.question: What is the attribute name for the "appServiceDescriptionURI" element in the schema?
question_32041.ground_truth: The attribute name for the "appServiceDescriptionURI" element is "xs:anyURI".

question_32044.question: What is the general format of the SYSTEM INFORMATION UPDATE REQUEST message?
question_32044.ground_truth: The SYSTEM INFORMATION UPDATE REQUEST message contains protocolIEs which is a mandatory presence and protocolExtensions that is optional.

question_32045.question: What is the difference between targeted and non-targeted discovery in ProSe communication?
question_32045.ground_truth: Targeted discovery is used to discover specific application peers, while non-targeted discovery is used to discover any potentially available communications peers and services in a generic manner. No particular application need is the trigger of non-targeted discovery in this case.

question_32046.question: In which situations can the phase shifters change state for beam switching?
question_32046.ground_truth: The phase shifters can change state in a few nanoseconds when using the technology already available today. However, the complete radio system requires more time to change state. The phase shifters can change state during the initial access or during a separate guard time reserved for the link direction switching.

question_32047.question: What takes place during the first two steps of the random access procedure after detecting the random access preamble in NB-IoT?
question_32047.ground_truth: These steps involve the transmission of the random access preamble and the reception of the random access response, which includes a UL grant for the first data transmission.

question_32048.question: What is the handover delay Dhandover to be less than in this test case?
question_32048.ground_truth: The handover delay Dhandover shall be less than 127 ms in this test case.

question_32049.question: What is the prerequisite for sending a DM response if an I frame is received while in unacknowledged mode?
question_32049.ground_truth: The MS must be in unacknowledged mode, and an I frame must be received from the SS.

question_32050.question: What are some of the functionalities provided by the multimedia streaming control web service?
question_32050.ground_truth: The multimedia streaming control web service provides functionalities for controlling and managing media streaming, including getting requests, charging and refunding, transcoding updates, controlling multiple streams, redirecting streams, and multimedia stream control with dynamic QoS.

question_32053.question: What is the difference between a new contact and re-registration in the WIC registration flow?
question_32053.ground_truth: A new contact is when the individual IMPU is already registered, but the contact is different than the stored one. Re-registration is when the individual IMPU is already registered and the contact is the same as the stored one.

question_32054.question: What should the pSEPP do with the extracted values from the JWE object?
question_32054.ground_truth: The pSEPP extracts the serialized values from the components of the JWE object and uses them for further processing.

question_32055.question: What happens if UE needs to break the ePSM cycle for any reason?
question_32055.ground_truth: If UE needs to break the ePSM cycle for any reason, such as initiating MO communication, responding to paging, or sending a Periodic TAU, it returns to the (Ti + Tp) cycle as soon as the network releases the RRC connection.

question_32056.question: What is the requirement for receiver resources allocation in a multicarrier BTS?
question_32056.ground_truth: The required receiver resources for the declared maximum supported number of wanted signals shall be allocated and activated simultaneously at frequencies as evenly distributed as possible over the declared maximum Base Station RF bandwidth including the band edges of the Base Station RF bandwidth during the complete test.

question_32058.question: What is the main advantage of using the SCTP multipath service in this solution?
question_32058.ground_truth: It allows differentiating transmission characteristics and/or prioritization for services running over the SCTP multipath service.

question_32060.question: What is the Access Class Barring (ACB) mechanism for RAN overload control for MTC devices?
question_32060.ground_truth: ACB is a mechanism for barring or not barring access for specific MTC access classes. The network uses control signaling to indicate to individual UEs or group of UEs how to scale the access control parameters when broadcast by the network. This allows different levels of access control to apply for a UE or group of UEs, relative to other UEs in a cell, based on one set of broadcast access control parameters.

question_32062.question: What is the capacity performance for FR2, Indoor Hotspot DL, with 400MHz bandwidth for VR/AR single-stream traffic model, SU-MIMO, 10ms PDB, 60 FPS, 30Mbps, Option 1 UE Antenna parameters: (M, N, P) = (1, 4, 2), 3 panels (left, right, top)?
question_32062.ground_truth: The capacity performance is 34 UEs per cell.

question_32063.question: What parameter is required in the API version when the major version is higher than 1?

question_32065.question: What is the format of the home network domain name in 3GPP systems if there is no ISIM application?
question_32065.ground_truth: The home network domain name consists of "ims." followed by "mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.3gppnetwork.org" where MCC and MNC are derived from the IMSI.

question_32066.question: What is the scope of 3GPP standardization for communication between the MTC Application and the MTC Server ?
question_32066.ground_truth: The communication between the MTC Application and the MTC Server is out of the scope of 3GPP standardization.

question_32067.question: What is the main purpose of alarm incident analysis in network operation and maintenance?
question_32067.ground_truth: The main purpose of alarm incident analysis is to improve the efficiency of network operation and maintenance by correlating and analyzing alarms and deteriorated performance measurements of the same root cause.

question_32068.question: What happens after VAE server 2 determines the local service information based on the UE location?
question_32068.ground_truth: VAE server 2 sends a local service information response, carrying the local service information, to VAE server 1, which then provides the local service information to the VAE client.

question_32070.question: What is the expected sequence 9.7 in the context of the 3GPP 31.111 clauses 6.5.4, 8.70 and 8.71?
question_32070.ground_truth: The ME shall parse and display a PROACTIVE COMMAND wrapped in an item with menuID value 9 in the menu tree rooted at the terminal. The word 'Italic' in the displayed name of the item shall be italicized and the word 'On' shall be displayed on the line below the item.

question_32071.question: Which types of security solutions have been compared for small data transmission?
question_32071.ground_truth: In clause 5.7.6.7, all different solutions for small data transmission are compared from a security perspective. The SA2 solutions are divided into three different groups: CP, UP, and OPT. The CP category includes solutions that use small amounts of data sent using control plane NAS messages, the UP category includes solutions proposing user plane transport in connectionless mode, and the OPT category includes optimizations like data piggy-backing, combining of messages, or re-using of existing security context.

question_32072.question: What is one advantage of using a new media feature tag "g.3gpp.iut.replicator" in Accept-Contact header field?
question_32072.ground_truth: One advantage is that it can be extended to provide more instructions to the network on which media components to replicate.

question_32073.question: What is one of the actions the 5G system can perform related to a PIN Element in terms of communication, access, and relay?
question_32073.ground_truth: The 5G system can communicate with other PIN Elements, access associated applications/services, and use a PIN Element as a relay for communication.

question_32074.question: What is the purpose of the Rx reference point in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_32074.ground_truth: The Rx reference point in the 3GPP technical specification defines the interface between the Policy and Charging Rules Function (PCRF) and the Application Function (AF) to exchange application level session information and allow Policy and Charging Control decisions.

question_32075.question: Which network elements are responsible for interception when the network access is through S2a (trusted Non-3GPP access) for roaming without local breakout (PDN-GW in the HPLMN and S-GW in the VPLMN)?
question_32075.ground_truth: Interception at the PDN-GW is a national option in this case.

question_32076.question: What is the measurement method for intermodulation products with a frequency offset of 1.8 MHz or less from the active TRX in the non-multicarrier BTS class?
question_32076.ground_truth: The power of intermodulation products is measured selectively using video averaging over 50 to 90% of the useful part of the time slot, excluding the mid-amble. The averaging is done over at least 200 time slots, and only active bursts are included in the averaging process. The RF and video filter bandwidth of the measuring instrument should be 30 kHz.

question_32077.question: What parameter within SendAuthenticationInfoArg needs to be present for the Immediate-Response-Preferred AVP to be required within Requested-EUTRAN-Authentication-Info AVP?

question_32078.question: What is the role of the LPP procedures in providing assistance data to the UE and obtaining location information in the Deferred MT-LR Event Reporting Support and MO-LR Service Support?
question_32078.ground_truth: The LPP procedures are used in both cases to transfer UE positioning capabilities, provide assistance data to the UE, and obtain location information from the UE. In the Deferred MT-LR Event Reporting Support, the LPP procedures may be instigated by the LMF or the UE, while in the MO-LR Service Support, the LPP procedures are typically instigated by the UE.

question_32079.question: Who is responsible for collecting application or service-enablement layer related information in Solution #2?
question_32079.ground_truth: ADAE supporting application and service enablement layer analytics collects application or service enablement layer related information in Solution #2.

question_32080.question: What is the purpose of including the Source IP address information and Destination IP address information in the Received MBS information when the Type of multicast MBS session ID is set to "Source specific IP multicast address"?
question_32080.ground_truth: The purpose is to allow the UE to perform the mapping between the requested multicast MBS session ID and the provided TMGI.

question_32081.question: What is the algebraic codebook searchbased on in speech coding?
question_32081.ground_truth: The algebraic codebook search is based on minimizing the mean square error between the weighted input speech and the weighted synthesis speech in closed-loop pitch search.

question_32082.question: What capability does the PCF need to support in order to request NW conditions for the AMF?
question_32082.ground_truth: The PCF needs to support the new EventId and have the logic to judge whether the NW conditions impact the UEs of the AMF.

question_32084.question: What is the role of the NRF in 5GC Service Based Architecture?
question_32084.ground_truth: The NRF (Network Repository Function) in 5GC Service Based Architecture is responsible for maintaining the information of available NF (Network Function) instances and their supported services.

question_32086.question: What are the two channel coding schemes used for TrCHs?
question_32086.ground_truth: The two channel coding schemes used for TrCHs are tail biting convolutional coding and turbo coding.

question_32087.question: Based on 7.3.7.2, what are the default messages used for SIB11 and SIB12 in the inter-system handover from UTRAN FDD to GSM case?
question_32087.ground_truth: The default messages for SIB11 and SIB12 as specified for Cell 1 and Cell 9 in clause 6.1.4.

question_32088.question: What information should be exchanged by the NG-RAN node and the AMF during application layer initialization for the NG interface to work correctly?
question_32088.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node provides the list of supported TA(s) and other information, while the AMF provides PLMN ID and other information needed for the NG interface to work correctly.

question_32090.question: What is the procedure for measuring the TRS in the anechoic chamber method?
question_32090.ground_truth: The procedure for measuring the TRS in the anechoic chamber method involves setting up calls with a NB simulator, sending test signals to the UE, measuring the BER levels of the radio link, and the information on the dedicated channel to extract the DUT receiver performances. The receiver sensitivity is then measured by adjusting the downlink signal level to 95 % throughput of the maximum throughput of the reference channel.
