This process is repeated with a 3-D sampling grid and the minimum RF power level resulting in a data throughput greater than or equal to 95 % throughput of the maximum throughput for each test is recorded.

question_32091.question: What is the effect of an SGSN sending an SGSN Context Acknowledge message to the old SGSN during a combined RA/LA update?
question_32091.ground_truth: It informs the old SGSN that the new SGSN is ready to receive data packets belonging to the activated PDP contexts.

question_32092.question: How is the coverage impact evaluated in terms of coverage margins in Rel-17 RedCap SI?
question_32092.ground_truth: The coverage impact is evaluated by obtaining the link budget performance of the channel, obtaining the target performance requirement for the potential Rel-18 UE within a deployment scenario, and finding the coverage margin for the channel by comparing the link budget performance with the target performance requirement.

question_32094.question: What happens during the CSFB procedure for coordinated NRIs when the UE performs a LAU?
question_32094.ground_truth: The LAU is always routed to operator A since the NRI was allocated by operator A as part of the SGs registration procedure.

question_32095.question: What message does the SGSN send to the RAN along with the RANAP message after receiving a RAU Accept message via a hybrid cell, to indicate whether the UE is a CSG member?
question_32095.ground_truth: The SGSN sends an indication whether the UE is a CSG member to the RAN along with the RANAP message.

question_32097.question: What can be inferred about the origin of notifications, as per this clause?
question_32097.ground_truth: The notifications in this clause may originate from implementation objects, but they do not necessarily imply or identify that the notifications are originated from an instance of the class or its derived class.

question_32099.question: What actions does an operator take when decreasing the capacity of the NSI by changing the capacity of shared network functions?
question_32099.ground_truth: The operator checks if the desired capacity change may negatively impact other NSIs, and if not, changes the capacity of identified shared network functions. If there is anticipated negative impact, the operator will not change the capacity of the shared network functions.

question_32100.question: What is one advantage of the SGW relocation solution at the SGW partial failure?
question_32100.ground_truth: One advantage of the SGW relocation solution is that it allows for the delivery of terminating services to affected UEs even after a SGW partial failure, without requiring UEs to re-attach to the EPS for service continuity.

question_32101.question: How does the BSF indicate support for TMPI in HTTP responses to the UE?
question_32101.ground_truth: The BSF includes a "product" token in the "Server" header field, set to a static string "3gpp-gba-tmpi" in HTTP responses sent to the UE.

question_32102.question: What is the purpose of buffering uplink packets in the target PSA during EAS relocation?
question_32102.ground_truth: Buffering uplink packets in the target PSA during EAS relocation prevents packet loss if the application client sends UL packets to a new EAS before the new EAS is prepared to handle them.

question_32103.question: What kind of temporary identity is assigned to the UE/User requesting MCPTT service at the time of preliminary authentication?
question_32103.ground_truth: The MCPTT application connected to a IMS/SIP core is provided with a pool of IMS identities or IMPI/IMPUs authorized by the operator of the IMS/SIP core, which will temporarily assign such identities to the UE/User requesting MCPTT service.

question_32104.question: In the FDD-FDD intra frequency handover test case, what is the condition for Tsearch if the target cell is known prior to the test?
question_32104.ground_truth: If the target cell is known, then Tsearch = 0 ms.

question_32105.question: What device is used by the master unit controller to send an audio message to all handsets in the intercom system?

question_32107.question: In what situation will the floor control interface send a Floor Deny message with a Reject Cause value of cause #5 (Receive only) to the floor participant?
question_32107.ground_truth: When the effective priority is "receive only" and the floor control interface towards the MCPTT client in the floor control server remains in the 'U: not permitted and Floor Taken' state.

question_32108.question: What is the role of S-RNTI in a network?
question_32108.ground_truth: S-RNTI is a UE identifier which is allocated by the Serving RNC and unique within this SRNC. It is allocated for all UEs having a RRC connection. S-RNTI is reallocated always when the Serving RNC for the RRC connection is changed and deallocated when the RRC connection is released.

question_32111.question: What happens when a PGW terminates the SGi interface?
question_32111.ground_truth: In this case, an S5 interface is used between C-SGN and PGW.

question_32112.question: What is the format of the E-CIDMeasurementTerminationCommand message?
question_32112.ground_truth: The E-CIDMeasurementTerminationCommand message is a SEQUENCE containing a single field, protocolIEs, which is a ProtocolIE-Container object that contains a set of protocol IEs.

question_32113.question: What information does the NEF support taking from the NWDAF for various network functions?
question_32113.ground_truth: The NEF supports taking various types of analytics information from the NWDAF to assist in the functioning of different network functions such as NWDAF, SMF, AMF, and AF.

question_32117.question: What field in the frame format is reserved for future PDU type extensions?
question_32117.ground_truth: The PDU type field in the first octet of the frame

question_32118.question: What is the difference between the granularity period and the reporting period in the context of measurement reports?
question_32118.ground_truth: The granularity period is the length of time over which measurements are taken, while the reporting period is the length of time over which measurement reports are assembled. The number of measurement reports assembled into a measurement result file is based on the reporting period.

question_32119.question: What is the purpose of the "Create IM Sessions" function?
question_32119.ground_truth: It allows an application to establish IM sessions between two or more parties with certain media capabilities. The application may add or remove parties at any time, and add additional sessions with certain media capabilities between parties involved in an existing session.

question_32120.question: What is the main security concern in Key Issue #1?
question_32120.ground_truth: The main security concern in Key Issue #1 is ensuring the authorization of AF/external servers providing satellite coverage availability information to 5GC/EPC.

question_32121.question: What is the maximum number of allowed spurious responses for DCS 1 800 in band for 3GPP TS 05.05 subclause 5.1?
question_32121.ground_truth: The maximum number of allowed spurious responses for DCS 1 800 in band for 3GPP TS 05.05 subclause 5.1 is twelve.

question_32122.question: What factor influences whether a client will be dis-satisfied during feedback cycles?
question_32122.ground_truth: A client is considered to be dis-satisfied during a feedback cycle if the user token parameter for the client exceeds a certain pre-defined threshold, based on the performance of the user during buffering rate monitoring.

question_32123.question: What is the purpose of the User Plane Interworking Unit (UP-IWU) as defined in 3GPP TS 23.726?
question_32123.ground_truth: The User Plane Interworking Unit (UP-IWU) is a logical function that performs user plane interworking between the SIP-I based CS Domain and external SIP-I networks, external ISUP networks, or BICC/ISUP based 3GPP CS networks.

question_32125.question: What is the role of a "Working Group" defined in the document?
question_32125.ground_truth: A Working Group is an official subgroup of a TSG reporting to that TSG, responsible for a specific technical area. They can propose changes to a specification, and are responsible for agreeing to Change Requests for submission to the TSG for approval.

question_32126.question: How is communication between cSEPP and RH1's proxy protected after receiving a request from an NF?
question_32126.ground_truth: Communication between cSEPP and RH1's proxy is protected by TLS.

question_32127.question: What is the immediate action time frame for a mobile station when it receives a commanding message, as indicated in the 52.8.1.9 test case?
question_32127.ground_truth: A mobile station should take an immediate action as a result of the command in any block from block number N+1 to N+6 (inclusive) when it receives a commanding message in block number N.

question_32128.question: When does the UE suspend measurement logging?
question_32128.ground_truth: The UE will suspend measurement logging if conditions like inter-frequency target info, no measResultServingCell in the VarLogMeasReport, or specific measured results in the last logging interval are met.

question_32129.question: What procedure is added to the existing steps described in solution #9 in the proposal for SEALDD enabled data transmission via N6 Tunnel?
question_32129.ground_truth: A new API for N6 tunnel data transfer for specific VAL service is invoked, and a specific SEALDD traffic descriptor is allocated for SEALDD traffic transferring via N6 tunnel.

question_32132.question: When is the repeater EVM requirement applicable for Repeater type 2-O and NCR-Fwd type 2-O?
question_32132.ground_truth: The repeater EVM requirement is applicable for Repeater type 2-O and NCR-Fwd type 2-O when the repeater is operating with an input power level within the range from what is required to reach the rated beam EIRP output power to the minimum power levels specified in the respective clauses.

question_32133.question: What is the key used to derive the PTK for a group member in the 3GPP Sidelink Positioning system?

question_32134.question: What should the SMF set in the 5GSM cause IE of the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message if the user authentication or authorization failed?
question_32134.ground_truth: The SMF should set the 5GSM cause IE of the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message to #29 to indicate that user authentication or authorization failed.

question_32135.question: How will external entities access the network slice management capabilities as per the suggested solution?
question_32135.ground_truth: External entities can access network slice management capabilities using CAPIF alternative 2 and 3. The CAPIF framework will be extended to support MnS exposure and authorization, with a mechanism defined for granular access to MnS from external entities.

question_32137.question: What steps should the MRFP take when receiving a corresponding SDP answer for MSRP media?
question_32137.ground_truth: When receiving a corresponding SDP answer for MSRP media, the MRFP shall provide the value of the received "a=path" SDP attribute to the MRFP in the "MSRP URI Path" information element and use the IP address and TCP port within the first entry of the "a=path" SDP attribute if the "a=msrp-cema" SDP attribute is not present.

question_32139.question: What are the responsibilities of the SCEF in this solution?
question_32139.ground_truth: The SCEF supports procedures to manage sponsored service profiles via Nt, supports generation of AF-Application-Id to identify sponsored service profile over Rx, and supports Spt/Ud reference point for new Spt/Ud procedures.

question_32141.question: What is the requirement for a UE to handle the relative receive timing difference between subframe timing boundary of an E-UTRA cell belonging to the MCG and the closest slot timing boundary of a cell belonging to SCG for inter-band EN-DC?
question_32141.ground_truth: A UE shall be capable of handling a relative receive timing difference between subframe timing boundary of an E-UTRA cell belonging to the MCG and the closest slot timing boundary of a cell belonging to SCG to be aggregated for EN-DC operation.

question_32142.question: What issue is addressed in section 5.9 of the document, regarding the security aspect of a low latency re-authentication procedure?
question_32142.ground_truth: The security aspect of a low latency re-authentication procedure is addressed in section 5.9 of the document.

question_32143.question: What type of service does the "DOWNLOAD" value in the MBMS-User-Service-Type AVP (AVP code 1225) represent in the context of Multimedia Broadcast Multicast Service (MBMS)?
question_32143.ground_truth: The MBMS user service of type: download.

question_32144.question: What is the maximum end-to-end latency tolerated by a professional musician for their audio stream?
question_32144.ground_truth: The maximum end-to-end latency tolerated by a professional musician is 4 milliseconds between their wireless microphone (analogue audio source) and their in-ear monitoring device (analog wireless sink).

question_32147.question: How many different LADNs can the LADN information information element contain at most?
question_32147.ground_truth: The LADN information information element can contain a maximum of 8 different LADNs.

question_32149.question: What should the SGW do when receiving downlink user plane or control plane packet on a maintained S5/S8 bearer while the timer is still running, following partial failure in the MME?
question_32149.ground_truth: The SGW initiates the network triggered service request procedure towards the SGSN and sends an enhanced Downlink Data Notification message to the MME.

question_32150.question: In 7.3.9.4.2, for step 21 of the RADIO BEARER SETUP procedure, which message is used for HSDPA and E-DCH RF tests?
question_32150.ground_truth: The message in clause 9.2, "Contents of RADIO BEARER SETUP message: AM or UM (E-DCH and HSDPA)" is used.

question_32151.question: What needs to be studied to enable a UPF to support multiple network slices using the current protocol?
question_32151.ground_truth: The potential missing functionalities and possible protocol enhancements over PFCP.

question_32152.question: What kind of Diameter-based application is the Wx reference point, and what is its application ID?
question_32152.ground_truth: The Wx reference point is an IETF vendor specific Diameter application with an application identifier of 16777219.

question_32153.question: What is the role of the BSS/RNC identifier (BSS-ID/RNC-ID) in the GERAN/UTRAN part of the PLMN?
question_32153.ground_truth: The BSS-ID/RNC-ID is used to route GERAN/UTRAN interface messages to the correct BSS/RNC.

question_32154.question: What message is sent during the MCPTT group call commencement?
question_32154.ground_truth: The floor request granted message is sent back to the transmitting users during the MCPTT group call commencement, indicating that the MCPTT group call has been successfully setup.

question_32155.question: What is the difference between "full functionality" and "minimum functionality" in the context of MT power levels?
question_32155.ground_truth: "Full functionality" is the highest level of power where the transmit and receive RF circuits are enabled for all supported radio access technologies. "Minimum functionality" is the lowest level of power where minimum power is drawn, and the transmit and receive RF circuits are disabled.

question_32156.question: What fields should the P-CSCF verify to match the received response, if a security association exists and the received response contains Via headers?
question_32156.ground_truth: The P-CSCF performs the verification on a per Via header value basis for the list of Via headers matched with the saved list of Via headers received in the request corresponding to the same dialog, including the P-CSCF via header value.

question_32157.question: How does the uplink interference caused by aerial UEs affect the communication?
question_32157.ground_truth: The uplink interference caused by aerial UEs increases the UL IoT of both aerial and terrestrial UEs, requiring higher resource utilization level to deliver the same offered cell data traffic. It degrades uplink throughput performance of both aerial and terrestrial UEs.

question_32158.question: What are the two options for the steering mode additional indicator in an ATSSS rule?
question_32158.ground_truth: The two options for the steering mode additional indicator are load balancing percentages adjustment operation (LBPAO) and UE assistance operation.

question_32160.question: What protocol is used over the Sy interface for Diameter messages?

question_32161.question: What is the Trigger-Type AVP used for and what type of AVP is it?
question_32161.ground_truth: The Trigger-Type AVP is of type Enumerated and indicates a single re-authorization event type. It is used to indicate a single re-authorization event type when included in the CCA or CCR command.

question_32162.question: What interfaces are suggested for Semi-Autonomous Validation (SAV) for full vendor interoperability?
question_32162.ground_truth: The suggested interfaces for SAV include the ability to store and transfer measurement values independently from H(e)NB architecture and implementation, and the ability to report a list of functionalities to the PVE following a stage 3 component check failure. The specific list of functionalities associated with each component is to be determined by the manufacturers, and the reporting mechanism for H(e)NB to report the list of failed functionality IDs to the SeGW can use the interface in the case where the H(e)NB connects to the H(e)MS via the SeGW over an IPSec tunnel.

question_32163.question: What is the purpose of the "unsolicited result code" in the context of bearer operations?
question_32163.ground_truth: The unsolicited result code is a status code that the system returns after processing a bearer operation.

question_32164.question: What is the role of an intermediate SS7-carrier in a hub-and-spoke architecture for SS7SEGs?
question_32164.ground_truth: An intermediate SS7-carrier in a hub-andamp-spoke architecture for SS7SEGs performs tasks such as TCAP user payload modification, protocol interworking, message screening, and advanced reporting.

question_32165.question: What is the function of the Sxx interface between the H(e)NB and the L-GW?
question_32165.ground_truth: The Sxx interface is for the transport of user plane data and may also include a control plane depending on the Rel-11 features.

question_32166.question: What is the rejection requirement from the BS RF RX filter to protect the BS receiver from its own transmit signal?
question_32166.ground_truth: The rejection requirement from the BS RF RX filter to protect the BS receiver from its own transmit signal is 86 dB.

question_32167.question: What is the purpose of using Polar coding for PDCCH and PBCH?
question_32167.ground_truth: Polar coding is used for PDCCH and PBCH to ensure efficient and reliable transmission of data in the physical downlink control channel and physical broadcast channel.

question_32168.question: What is the procedure for PMIPv6 PDN Connection Lifetime Extension?
question_32168.ground_truth: The PMIPv6 PDN Connection Lifetime Extension procedure is initiated by the MAG to prolong the lifetime of an existing PDN connection with the LMA for an UE that is already attached. The procedure starts with the MAG sending a PBU to the LMA to extend the binding lifetime for the UE's PDN connection, and the LMA confirms the extension by sending a PBA to the MAG.

question_32170.question: What does the MeNB include in the SGNB MODIFICATION REQUEST message to request DL forwarding of downlink data for a bearer?
question_32170.ground_truth: The MeNB may include the DL Forwarding IE within the E-RABs To Be Added Item IE of the SGNB MODIFICATION REQUEST message to request DL forwarding of downlink data for a bearer.

question_32172.question: What technologies are used for localized services in the Monster theme park?
question_32172.ground_truth: The localized services in the Monster theme park are shared using blockchain technologies and based on e-agreements. These services are offered by different providers via a hosting network.

question_32173.question: In which message types does the NAS and RRC protocols need to be supported by the RN when acting as a UE?
question_32173.ground_truth: The RN needs to support the NAS and RRC protocols toward the network for initial attach and bearer management procedures.

question_32174.question: What is the role of the FFAPP application layer functional architecture as specified in subclause 6.2.1?
question_32174.ground_truth: The FFAPP application layer functional architecture is specified to support time sensitive communication services in subclause 6.2.1.

question_32175.question: What is the significance of bit 2 of octet 2 of the Long PDCP PDU Number extension header, and what should the other bits be set to?
question_32175.ground_truth: Bit 2 of octet 2 of the Long PDCP PDU Number extension header is the most significant bit of the PDCP PDU number field, and all other bits should be set to 0.

question_32176.question: What identifying information does the 5G system need to support the use case for mobile metaverse services?
question_32176.ground_truth: Subject to operator policy and national or regional regulation, the 5G system needs to support identification of digital representations (e.g. avatars) associated with users for mobile metaverse services.

question_32177.question: What margin is used between the ACLR and the unwanted emission level for a UTRA base station to not limit co-existence?
question_32177.ground_truth: A 15 dB margin is used between the ACLR and the unwanted emission level for a UTRA base station to not limit co-existence.

question_32180.question: What is the main goal of the Queue Warning service flow?
question_32180.ground_truth: The main goal of the Queue Warning service flow is to minimize the likelihood of crashes and allow for mitigation actions by making the queue information available to other drivers beforehand.

question_32182.question: What is the purpose of the NRM client determining the MBMS bearer quality?
question_32182.ground_truth: The purpose is to indicate if the NRM client is able to receive the MBMS service communication on the bearer, if not, the NRM server will decide to switch to another bearer.

question_32183.question: What is a non-public network as defined in the 3GPP Technical Report?
question_32183.ground_truth: A non-public network is a network that is intended for non-public use.

question_32184.question: What is the initial command sent by the User Identity Module (UICC) to the Mobile Equipment (ME) for setting up a call with UCS2 coding and Katakana characters?

question_32185.question: What should the terminating UE do during session initiation if the received INVITE request enables the precondition mechanism but the terminating UE has it disabled?
question_32185.ground_truth: The terminating UE should reject the INVITE request with a 420 (Bad Extension) response.

question_32186.question: What is the Metadata Index in the ProSe Application Code used for in ProSe Open Discovery?
question_32186.ground_truth: The Metadata Index in the ProSe Application Code reflects the current metadata version, and it is allocated and updated by the Home ProSe Function when a new metadata is uploaded and stored in the ProSe Function for a ProSe Application ID.

question_32187.question: What is the service URN for the manually initiated eCall type of emergency service?
question_32187.ground_truth: The service URN for the manually initiated eCall type of emergency service is "urn:service:sos.ecall.manual".

question_32191.question: What should the UE do if a P-CSCF IPv6 address is not received after steps 4 and 6 of the procedure?
question_32191.ground_truth: The UE will initiate a DNS query for domain address to IPv6 address translation.

question_32194.question: What should the Mobile Station do after lower layer failures, except TCP connection failure, while it is not in the GA-RC-DEREGISTERED state?
question_32194.ground_truth: The MS shall release the TCP connection towards the current GANC, stop timer TU3906, release the secure connection towards the SEGW of the current GANC, start timer TU3905, and enter GA-RC-DEREGISTERED state.

question_32195.question: What should the UE do if it receives a 380 (Alternative Service) response with a P-Asserted-Identity header field with a value equal to the last entry on the Path header field value received during registration?
question_32195.ground_truth: The UE should attempt emergency call via CS domain using appropriate access technology specific procedures, or perform implementation specific actions to establish the emergency call.

question_32197.question: What is the function of the ValidityAreaRef leaf in the ANDSF/DiscoveryInformation/<X> element?
question_32197.ground_truth: The ValidityAreaRef leaf in the ANDSF/DiscoveryInformation/<X> element contains a reference to a ValidityArea interior node, which identifies a ValidityArea interior node in the UE management tree. This allows the network to specify which access networks are available for the UE.

question_32198.question: What attribute determines the reporting method for measurement M1 in LTE or NR?

question_32201.question: What is the overall delay measured for the RRC connection release with redirection to GERAN?
question_32201.ground_truth: The overall delay measured for the RRC connection release with redirection to GERAN is 1120 ms.

question_32202.question: What information does the NWDAF provide to the AMF for assisting handover decisions in 5GS?
question_32202.ground_truth: The NWDAF provides UE mobility information (law/pattern) to the AMF, which includes a cell/TA list or a geographical area that the UE might enter and the time the UE might enter the list of cells/TAs or the geographical area. The duration time that the UE might stay in the list of cells/TAs or the geographical area is also included.

question_32206.question: Who initiates the UE radio bearer test mode procedure?
question_32206.ground_truth: The SS (Signalling Support Sublayer) initiates the UE radio bearer test mode procedure.

question_32207.question: What is the definition of phase-range measurement in the context of GNSS systems?
question_32207.ground_truth: A measurement of the range between a satellite and receiver expressed in units of cycles of the carrier frequency.

question_32209.question: What are the four main types of equipment that make up the test equipment for 5G NR UE full stack testing for network slicing?
question_32209.ground_truth: The four main types of equipment that make up the test equipment for 5G NR UE full stack testing for network slicing are System Simulators, Application Server Simulators, Main Controller, and Application Client Simulators.

question_32211.question: In what scenario would UE1 require the assistance of an Assistant UE to determine the Ranging/Sidelink positioning between UE1 and UE2?
question_32211.ground_truth: When UE1 doesn't know if direct communication with UE2 is possible or when UE2 moves to a place where direct communication is not possible.

question_32212.question: How can QoS be maintained during varying reception conditions in the 9th release?
question_32212.ground_truth: A fine granular rate adaptation is applied to the video stream in the 9th release to avoid abrupt quality changes in an efficient manner when entering bad reception conditions.

question_32213.question: What is delivered to the Sidelink HARQ Entity for this PSSCH duration when a sidelink grant is delivered?
question_32213.ground_truth: The sidelink grant, the selected MCS, and the associated HARQ information.

question_32214.question: Was the card reader removable in Terminal Response 1.2?
question_32214.ground_truth: No, the card reader was not removable in Terminal Response 1.2.

question_32216.question: What is the requirement for the RLC SDU error rate for the MTCH radio bearer in Test 1-3?
question_32216.ground_truth: The requirement is that the RLC SDU error rate be less than 0.1.

question_32218.question: What is the initial cell 2 physical cell identity set to in the test procedure?
question_32218.ground_truth: The initial cell 2 physical cell identity is set equivalent to the initial cell 1 physical cell identity.

question_32223.question: What is the purpose of the MCVideo-2 reference point in the MCVideo system?
question_32223.ground_truth: The MCVideo-2 reference point, which exists between the MCVideo server and the MCVideo user database, is used by the MCVideo server to obtain information about a specific user.

question_32225.question: What is the spreading factor of the Channelisation Code used for a Physical Channel in 1.28Mcps TDD?
question_32225.ground_truth: The spreading factor of the Channelisation Code used for a Physical Channel in 1.28Mcps TDD can be 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16.

question_32228.question: What is the purpose of the test in section 15.10a.4 of the document?
question_32228.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in section 15.10a.4 of the document is to verify that the UE can authenticate itself correctly with the authentication scheme that it supports (HTTP Digest authentication or GAA based authentication) and to check that the simservs document stored in the SS contains the correct pieces of information supplied by the UE.

question_32229.question: What should the UE send when it is made to de-activate ICB?
question_32229.ground_truth: The UE sends an HTTP request to de-activate ICB.

question_32230.question: What information provides the UDM to the AMF during the Registration procedure regarding the Enhanced Coverage Restricted information?
question_32230.ground_truth: The UDM provides Enhanced Coverage Restricted information to the AMF during the Registration procedure, indicating whether the Enhanced Coverage is restricted for the UE per PLMN.

question_32231.question: What is the role of MTLF in the AnLF based error monitoring procedure?
question_32231.ground_truth: In the AnLF based error monitoring procedure, MTLF provides a set of trained ML models and threshold(s) for accuracy to AnLF.

question_32232.question: When can an MS request the use of eDRX during an attach or routing area updating procedure?
question_32232.ground_truth: An MS can request the use of eDRX during an attach or routing area updating procedure, except for an attach for emergency bearer services procedure or a routing area updating procedure for the MS attached for emergency bearer services.

question_32234.question: What is the method used to separate uplink and downlink transmissions in Frequency Division Duplex (FDD)?
question_32234.ground_truth: In FDD, uplink and downlink transmissions use two separated radio frequencies, with each uplink and downlink using different frequency bands.

question_32236.question: What is the send state variable V(S) used for and what is its range of values?
question_32236.ground_truth: V(S) is an associated send state variable of each point-to-point data link connection endpoint when using I-frame commands. It denotes the sequence number of the next in-sequence I-frame to be transmitted and can take on the value 0 through 7.

question_32238.question: What should the S-CSCF do when a REGISTER request contains an emergency registration?
question_32238.ground_truth: The S-CSCF will not perform the network-initiated deregistration procedure for an emergency registration, but will let it expire.

question_32240.question: What is the purpose of the Monitoring capability in the external exposure of network capabilities?
question_32240.ground_truth: The Monitoring capability allows for monitoring of specific events for UE in 5GS and making such monitoring events information available for external exposure via the NEF.

question_32241.question: What are the two scenarios in which the authorization policy for V2X communications over PC5 reference point is given for the UE?
question_32241.ground_truth: The two scenarios are when the UE is "served by E-UTRA" or "served by NR", and when the UE is "not served by E-UTRA" and "not served by NR".

question_32242.question: What should the UE consider as the sorting quantity when determining the reporting order for eventA5, eventA5H1, and eventA5H2 in an E-UTRA cell?
question_32242.ground_truth: The quantity used in the a5-ThresholdEUTRA.

question_32243.question: What happens when the target SGSN deactivates EPS bearer contexts without a PFC being established?
question_32243.ground_truth: The target SGSN maintains the EPS bearer contexts in the target SGSN and keeps the related SAPIs and PFIs, which are deactivated by explicit SM procedures upon the completion of the routing area update (RAU) procedure.

question_32244.question: What is the consequence of the network receiving a CALL CONFIRMED message with a stream identifier including the request entity cannot be provided?
question_32244.ground_truth: The network shall initiate call clearing with cause #44 "requested circuit/channel not available".

question_32245.question: What is the purpose of the test in clause 4.2.14 of the document, and who is it applicable to?
question_32245.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that when the current and target cell operates on the same carrier frequency in normal coverage, the UE is able to search and measure cells to meet the respective intra-frequency cell re-selection requirements. It applies to all types of E-UTRA TDD UE release 13 and forward of UE category M1 and higher, including non-BL/CE UE.

question_32247.question: Which P-CSCF discovery method shall be used if the UE does not contain the IMS management object and the ISIM residing in the UICC supports the P-CSCF list?
question_32247.ground_truth: The UE shall use the method "The UE selects a P-CSCF from the list stored in the ISIM" if the UE does not contain the IMS management object and the ISIM residing in the UICC supports the P-CSCF list.

question_32248.question: What is the expected sequence for the test procedure when verifying that a MS in DTM can complete a handover to a cell in a different routing area with the RA update performed on TBFs and before the CS resources are released?
question_32248.ground_truth: After the MS has received the DTM Information message indicating DTM support in the current cell, it initiates the RA Update procedure by sending the ROUTING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message on the main DCCH. The SS then sends the MS a ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message on the main DCCH without re-allocating the P-TMSI, allowing the MS to complete the handover procedure.

question_32249.question: What is the purpose of the "PTP RAB ID" field in MBMS PTP Radio Bearers for a particular UE?
question_32249.ground_truth: The "PTP RAB ID" field uniquely identifies a MBMS PTP radio bearer for a particular UE, and is used to relate MBMS PTP Radio Bearers to a MBMS RAB in RANAP messages and RRC messages.

question_32250.question: Which type of data is defined in the "im-csi-information-type" complex type in the XML schema?
question_32250.ground_truth: The "im-csi-information-type" complex type can contain any data with the namespace "##any" and any data structure in the XML schema.

question_32253.question: In what case can MSC-B proceed with the handover to a CSG cell without checking the CSG membership of the UE?
question_32253.ground_truth: For subsequent handover of an emergency call to a CSG cell, MSC-B shall skip the CSG membership check and proceed with the handover procedure.

question_32254.question: What request contains the XML body from the URI in the Refer-To header field from the SIP REFER request?

question_32256.question: Who is responsible for initiating the location reporting procedure for the UE in the MBSR network architecture?
question_32256.ground_truth: The LMF (Location Management Function) is responsible for initiating the location reporting procedure for the UE in the MBSR network architecture.

question_32257.question: What is the impact of the operator's security acceptance decision in the SECAM process?
question_32257.ground_truth: The operator's decision on the security acceptance of a network product can affect its internal policies and adherence to regulatory requirements.

question_32259.question: How does the Push Function deliver data to the UE when the SMS environment is not adequate?
question_32259.ground_truth: The Push Function can push a notification to the user allowing the user to establish a direct connection to the Push Function or Push Initiator.

question_32260.question: What should an MS do if it receives the cause "Roaming not allowed in this LA" in response to a LU attempt?
question_32260.ground_truth: The MS should start the Network Selection Procedure and access onto a carrier as part of cell selection.

question_32261.question: What attribute is used for providing Relative Proximity analytics requirements in the "relProxReqs" attribute?
question_32261.ground_truth: The "relProxReqs" attribute includes the identification of DNN, identification of network slice, identification of network area, and/or Relative Proximity analytics requirements for providing Relative Proximity analytics requirements.

question_32265.question: What channel is used by the serving Node B to command the UE to disable or re-enable discontinuous uplink DPCCH transmission?

question_32266.question: What are the fundamental API guidelines for northbound APIs utilizing CAPIF?
question_32266.ground_truth: The API specification should define the function of the API, the resource(s) or endpoints involved, the list of supported operations and their usage, the list of input and output parameters along with applicable schemas, the list of supported response codes, the behavior of the network entity for each supported operation, the list of applicable data types, and the list of applicable protocols and data serialization formats. Additionally, it is recommended to adopt consistent nomenclature, design principles for the use of operations, and a template for consistent API documentation. The API should also be extensible, support access control mechanisms, support charging if applicable, and be backward and forward compatible.

question_32267.question: What information does the network rely on to determine the TA where the UE is geographically located?
question_32267.ground_truth: The network relies on the information reported by the RAN (e.g. ephemeris data) when the paging is needed and the UE is in out-of-coverage.

question_32268.question: What is the purpose of the STN in the context of the document?
question_32268.ground_truth: The STN (Server Transfer Number) is used by the UE (User Equipment) to initiate domain transfer requests.

question_32271.question: What audio and video codecs and formats are required for efficient encoding and distribution in a 3GPP environment?
question_32271.ground_truth: A sufficient set of audio and video codecs are required to allow for encoding and distribution of legacy and new formats in an efficient manner. If legacy content is expected to be distributed, it may be transcoded prior to distribution.

question_32272.question: What is the primary interest of a user when trying to obtain service from a network?
question_32272.ground_truth: A user's primary interest is to be able to obtain service anywhere at any time, even if it means connecting to a non-preferred network.

question_32275.question: Which entity initiates the establishment of the Access Leg via the CS domain in the case of domain transfer to IMS?
question_32275.ground_truth: The DTF identifies the anchored call/session from the user identity and then completes the establishment of the Access Leg via the CS domain.

question_32276.question: What action should an MCPTT client take when receiving a request from the MCPTT user to originate a remote initiated ambient listening call, and the "allow-request-remote-initiated-ambient-listening" element in the MCPTT user profile document is set to "false"?
question_32276.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should inform the MCPTT user and exit the procedure.

question_32277.question: What are the two options for the MDT PLMN List in logged MDT measurements?
question_32277.ground_truth: The two options for the MDT PLMN List in logged MDT measurements are the Management Based MDT PLMN List and the Signalling Based MDT PLMN List.

question_32278.question: What action is taken by the PDN GW when it receives a Proxy Binding Update message indicating de-registration for the IPv4 Home Address only?
question_32278.ground_truth: The PDN GW modifies the existing entry to delete the implied IPv4 home address from its Binding Cache and releases all associated resources, and then sends a Binding Ack message to the UE.

question_32279.question: What action should the MCVideo client take when it receives a SIP INVITE request with an emergency indication for a Pre-arranged Emergency Group Call?
question_32279.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should display an indication for the Pre-arranged MCVideo Emergency Group Call to the MCVideo User and respond to the SS (MCVideo Server) with a SIP 200 (OK) message.

question_32281.question: How can HeNB downlink interference among neighboring HeNB control channels be controlled by frequency partitioning?
question_32281.ground_truth: The LTE carrier can be segmented into separate frequency domain resources, with each interfering HeNB transmitting its control signalling in separate frequency domain resources. Release-8/9 UEs would access the HeNB as a 10 MHz carrier and receive control and broadcast signalling from HeNB within 10 MHz. However, Release-10 UEs can additionally be assigned PDSCH resource on the remaining 10 MHz frequency resources using carrier aggregation.

question_32282.question: What must RH1's proxy verify if another roaming hub (RH2) is present?
question_32282.ground_truth: RH1's proxy shall verify that RH1 is allowed to set up a roaming relation with pSEPP, and RH2's proxy shall verify that RH1 is allowed to set up a roaming relation with pSEPP.

question_32284.question: What is the name of the physical channel on which E-DCH ACK/NACKs are transmitted in FDD mode and 3.84 Mcps and 7.68 Mcps TDD?

question_32286.question: What is the definition of conducted spurious emissions for MS in idle mode in 12.3.2.1?
question_32286.ground_truth: Conducted spurious emissions are any emissions from the antenna connector, when the MS is in idle mode.

question_32287.question: What is the purpose of storing and including 3gpp-Sbi-Routing-Binding headers in subsequent requests?
question_32287.ground_truth: The purpose of storing and including 3gpp-Sbi-Routing-Binding headers in subsequent requests is to enable the NF Service Consumer or SCP to select or reselect an NF Service Producer with access to the original consumer's NF Service Resource context, supporting direct or indirect communication.

question_32288.question: What are the two classes of warning notifications supported in the Korean Public Alert System (KPAS)?
question_32288.ground_truth: The two classes of warning notifications supported in KPAS are class 0 and class 1, which are differentiated per opt-out function.

question_32289.question: What are the frequency error requirements for NCR-MT type 1-C and NCR-MT type 1-H?
question_32289.ground_truth: The IAB-MT requirements specified in clause 6.5.1.2 in TS 38.174 apply to both NCR-MT type 1-C and NCR-MT type 1-H.

question_32291.question: What type of E-UTRA UE releases does the generic duplex-mode test case 8.16.87 apply to?
question_32291.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE releases 11 and forward, TDD UE releases 11 and forward, and UE releases 12 and forward that support 4DL CA.

question_32292.question: What is the first step in setting up a Data Bearer in the User Plane?
question_32292.ground_truth: The first step is a signalling transaction by the Application Protocol in the Control Plane.

question_32293.question: What is the definition and applicability for section 9.4.4E enhanced performance requirements?
question_32293.ground_truth: The definition and applicability in section 9.4.4E is for the detection performance of the HS-SCCH for MIMO only with single-stream restriction-STTD enabled-asymmetric CPICHs and applies for Release 10 and later with optional Tx Diversity on DL Control channels and MIMO-only with single-stream restriction feature.

question_32294.question: What is the purpose of providing a PDU Set Start / End Indicator in the Frame/Slice PDU Family?
question_32294.ground_truth: The PDU Set Start / End Indicator in the Frame/Slice PDU Family allows the RAN to take advantage of time between frames for power saving, as it indicates the start and end of a frame.

question_32295.question: What status code will the BSF send in the response body if it successfully updated an "Individual PCF for a UE Binding" resource?
question_32295.ground_truth: The BSF will send an HTTP "200 OK" status code.

question_32296.question: What is the purpose of the service-based interfaces in the 3GPP network management system?
question_32296.ground_truth: The service-based interfaces in the 3GPP network management system, such as Snsce, provide network slice capability enablement services to VAL servers and NSCE clients.

question_32298.question: What is the condition for the UE to send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message, after receiving a timer value indicating zero, in the same PLMN?
question_32298.ground_truth: The UE can send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message if the PLMN allows it, as per the 3GPP specification.

question_32299.question: What is the purpose of wPSNR metric in HDR sequences?
question_32299.ground_truth: The wPSNR metric in HDR sequences aims to compensate for a different distribution of codewords in HDR content.

question_32301.question: What is the length of the URCMP message header?
question_32301.ground_truth: The length of the URCMP message header is a multiple of 4 octets.

question_32302.question: What does the acronym "RNTI" stand for in the context of E-UTRAN?

question_32305.question: What action should the Node B take if the COMMON TRANSPORT CHANNEL SETUP REQUEST message contains both the Broadcast Reference IE and the IP Multicast Indication IE?
question_32305.ground_truth: The Node B should reject the procedure using the COMMON TRANSPORT CHANNEL SETUP FAILURE message.

question_32306.question: What is the maximum number of SSBs that can be reported in the "SSBToReport-List"?
question_32306.ground_truth: The maximum number of SSBs that can be reported in the "SSBToReport-List" is "maxnoofSSBAreas".

question_32307.question: What action does the en-gNB take when it receives a SGNB MODIFICATION REQUEST message that contains the Serving PLMN IE?
question_32307.ground_truth: The en-gNB may use the Serving PLMN IE for RRM purposes when received in the SGNB MODIFICATION REQUEST message.

question_32309.question: What is the format for defining the E1AP protocol IEs for bearer context release commands and responses in 3GPP TS 38.413?
question_32309.ground_truth: The E1AP protocol IEs for bearer context release commands and responses are defined using the ASN.1 language in the 3GPP TS 38.413 standard. The format consists of a list of named fields, each with a unique identifier, criticality, type, presence, and optional extension container fields.

question_32310.question: How is the off-network MCPTT session set up in the described process?
question_32310.ground_truth: The off-network MCPTT session is set up by the UE-1 distributing the necessary parameters for the session among all the group members. The session is protected by a group key for off-network MCPTT group calls.

question_32311.question: When starting the transition from the RM-DEREGERISTERED state with the intent of transitioning to RM-REGISTERED, what action is taken if the stored 5G NAS security context on the USIM is not marked as valid?
question_32311.ground_truth: If the USIM does not support RM parameters storage, the ME shall retrieve the stored native 5G NAS security context from its non-volatile memory if it is marked as valid.

question_32312.question: What changes were made in the charging mechanism to allow for charging differentiation between 3GPP and unlicensed spectrum access?
question_32312.ground_truth: The charging mechanism was enhanced to collect data of the same flows separately for licensed and unlicensed spectrum by extending the flow based charging (PCC Rules) and bearer charging functions with an additional rating group for the specific collection of traffic over unlicensed spectrum.

question_32313.question: If the ambient viewing type in the received SIP INVITE request is set to "local-init", what should the MCVideo client do?
question_32313.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should provide an indication of the ambient viewing call's progress to the MCVideo user and cache the ambient viewing type as the ambient viewing client role for the call.

question_32314.question: What is the role of the Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the context of 3GPP Technical Specifications?
question_32314.ground_truth: The Integration Reference Point (IRP) is a concept used in 3GPP Technical Specifications for interoperable communication between different systems. IRP defines the external view of 3GPP network elements and their functions, and it provides a consistent interface to these network elements.

question_32315.question: What is the purpose of the privacy protection in the trust domain boundary as specified in subclause 5.10.8?
question_32315.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure privacy by performing privacy protection on SIP requests or SIP responses before sending them outside the trust domain boundary.

question_32316.question: What should the UE do if it receives the Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming" IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message and the TAI is not part of the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming" but belongs to the serving PLMN or equivalent PLMN(s)?
question_32316.ground_truth: The UE shall store the TAI into the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming", ignore the TAI if it does not belong to the serving PLMN or equivalent PLMN(s) and remove the TAI from the stored TAI list if present.

question_32317.question: What should a non-controlling MCVideo function do if the MCVideo user is unauthorized to join a chat group and the SIP INVITE request is for controlling MCVideo function of an MCVideo group?
question_32317.ground_truth: The non-controlling MCVideo function should send a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response with the warning text set to "106 user not authorized to join chat group" in a Warning header field as specified in clause~4.4.

question_32318.question: Who is responsible for triggering the AN Release procedure (5GS) or S1 Release procedure (EPS) with a specific cause value in Solution #4?
question_32318.ground_truth: Upon receipt of the indication from the UE, the AMF (5GC) or MME (EPS) triggers the AN Release procedure (5GS) or S1 Release procedure (EPS) with a specific cause value in the N2 UE Release Context Command (5GS) or S1-AP:S1 UE Context Release Command (EPS) sent to RAN.

question_32319.question: When does the U2U Relay UE forward a discovery solicitation message from the U2U remote UE?
question_32319.ground_truth: The U2U Relay UE forwards a discovery solicitation message from the U2U remote UE only if the SD-RSRP between the U2U Relay UE and the U2U remote UE is above a threshold.

question_32320.question: What is the purpose of aligning radio parameters between UE-to-UE Relay communication and direct communication when the UE is not served by NG-RAN?
question_32320.ground_truth: The alignment of radio parameters aims to ensure consistent behavior for both direct and relayed UE-to-UE communication when the UE is not connected to NG-RAN.

question_32321.question: What is the impact of time-dilated UMTS on the SEM requirement?
question_32321.ground_truth: Time-dilated UMTS may require changes to the SEM (Spectrum Emission Mask) because of the reduced bandwidth and the need to comply with regulatory limits. New values for spurious emissions and intermodulation may need to be defined to protect scalable UMTS systems.

question_32322.question: What does TDM operation refer to in the context of integrating access and backhaul?
question_32322.ground_truth: TDM operation refers to time division multiplexing operation, where there can be no simultaneous transmission in the DU and the MT, nor any simultaneous reception in the DU and the MT.

question_32324.question: What is the role of the (R)AN in adapting the network behavior based on timing information?
question_32324.ground_truth: The (R)AN locally adapts its behavior without further signaling when it receives timing information from the AMF, determining when certain DRBs are no longer active for certain sessions and releasing or deactivating them accordingly.

question_32326.question: What is the target operating BLER for DCI(s) scheduling HARQ-less PDSCH/PUSCH in Rel-16 NR URLLC for link-level PDCCH evaluation?
question_32326.ground_truth: The target operating BLER for DCI(s) scheduling HARQ-less PDSCH/PUSCH in Rel-16 NR URLLC for link-level PDCCH evaluation is smaller than 1e-x, where x is the reliability requirement given in the representative use case for evaluation.

question_32327.question: What procedure is initiated by the network upon receipt of the LOCATION UPDATING REQUEST message from the mobile station?
question_32327.ground_truth: The authentication procedure, as defined in 3GPP TS 42.009, is initiated by the network.

question_32331.question: What is the role of the ProSe function in proximity reporting?
question_32331.ground_truth: The ProSe function reports proximity information to the ProSe application if the criteria for proximity are met.

question_32334.question: What is the condition for group regrouping in multiple MC systems to take place?
question_32334.ground_truth: Group regrouping in multiple MC systems can take place if none of the groups to be regrouped are temporary groups, the groups are not already regrouped into another temporary group, and if the policy allows it, none of the groups to be regrouped are in emergency state.

question_32335.question: What should the MS do when in a limited service state and not camped on a cell?
question_32335.ground_truth: The MS should monitor the signal strength of all 194 RF channels and search for a BCCH carrier which has C1>0 and which is not barred.

question_32336.question: What is the expected UE behavior when receiving an incorrect message over Temporary C-RNTI?
question_32336.ground_truth: The UE shall re-select a preamble and transmit with the calculated PRACH transmission power when the back off time expires unless the received message includes a UE contention resolution identity MAC control element and the UE contention resolution identity included in the MAC control element matches the CCCH SDU transmitted in the uplink message.

question_32337.question: What are the limitations of 3GPP-based technologies in the maritime domain?
question_32337.ground_truth: Some of the legacy 3GPP enabling technologies and solutions may not be able to fully support the performances required by the maritime domain.

question_32339.question: In the context of the Additional E-DCH FDD Setup Information IE, what should the Node B do if the DL Power Balancing Information IE is present?
question_32339.ground_truth: The Node B should use the information in the same way as it is used on the primary uplink frequency.

question_32340.question: Under what condition should the network retransmit the ATTACH ACCEPT message and restart timer T3450?
question_32340.ground_truth: If a lower layer failure occurs before the message ATTACH COMPLETE has been received from the UE, the network should retransmit the ATTACH ACCEPT message and restart timer T3450.

question_32341.question: What is the purpose of the software download function during the establishment of a new eNodeB in the network?
question_32341.ground_truth: The software download functions used during the establishment of a new eNodeB in the network should be reused as much as possible for software upgrade.

question_32344.question: What actions shall the MRFP take when requested to act as a STUN server?
question_32344.ground_truth: The MRFP shall be prepared to answer STUN binding requests, and once a STUN binding request with the "USE-CANDIDATE" flag has been received, the MRFP may send media towards the source of the binding request.

question_32346.question: How does the 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay determine the Source Layer-2 ID when establishing a PC5 link for Unstructured traffic?
question_32346.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay shall choose different Source Layer-2 IDs for different pairs of source and target 5G ProSe Layer-3 End UEs when establishing a PC5 link for Unstructured traffic.

question_32348.question: What are the three example schemes for controlling the RRC state of a UE within the existing LTE system?
question_32348.ground_truth: The three example schemes for controlling the RRC state of a UE within the existing LTE system are: 1) Full use of RRC Connected State, 2) Network Initiated RRC Release (based on RRC Inactivity Timer in the Network), and 3) Network Initiated RRC Release based on mobility.

question_32349.question: What should the MCPTT client do upon receiving a SIP BYE request in the dialog of an ambient listening session?
question_32349.ground_truth: The MCPTT client shall comply with the procedures of subclause 6.2.6 and if the cached ambient listening client role is equal to "listened-to MCPTT user", it shall provide no indication that an ambient listening call has been terminated.

question_32351.question: What requirement applies to a BS operating outside its Base Station RF Bandwidth or Maximum Radio Bandwidth?
question_32351.ground_truth: The ACS and narrowband blocking requirement is always applicable outside the Base Station RF Bandwidth or Maximum Radio Bandwidth.

question_32352.question: What information is typically included in the general information used to describe a loaded ML entity?
question_32352.ground_truth: The general information used to describe a loaded ML entity includes resource information (e.g. mLEntityVersion, mLEntityId, trainingContext), management information (e.g. activation flag, status, creation time, last update time), and capability information (e.g. inference type, performance metrics).

question_32353.question: What is the procedure for a TSG to withdraw specifications and functionality in 3GPP?
question_32353.ground_truth: The procedure involves raising Change Requests to eliminate any references to the functionality, moving applicable text to other specifications, and thoroughly considering the implications and applicability of the withdrawal. The withdrawal may be documented in a work item and should be explicitly identified as an objective.

question_32355.question: What happens if the BSS does not allocate the circuits when a CN initiated RESET is performed in a broadcast-based manner?
question_32355.ground_truth: The BSS will not release the affected calls and circuits, and will not initiate any BLOCK or CIRCUIT GROUP BLOCK procedures for circuits locally blocked on the BSS side.

question_32356.question: What is the expected sequence for the test procedure when testing the behavior of the MS when it receives a GA-RC DEREGISTER message with no cause?
question_32356.ground_truth: The MS is supposed to ignore the received Register Reject Cause Information Element, and proceed as defined in the sub-clause 6.2.4.5.

question_32357.question: What condition should be met before an IWF responds with a SIP 200 (OK) response to a SIP PUBLISH request?
question_32357.ground_truth: An IWF should ensure that the "entity" attribute of the <presence> element is equal to the served MCPTT group ID, and the handled MCPTT ID is the same as the MCPTT ID in the "id" attribute of the <tuple> element.

question_32359.question: What parameter is used to indicate the result of enabling the VAE layer support?
question_32359.ground_truth: The <result> parameter indicates the result of enabling the VAE layer support.

question_32361.question: Which simulator is required for testing V2X services in the 3GPP 5G system?
question_32361.ground_truth: A GNSS Simulator is required for testing V2X services when GNSS synchronization or a geographical position is necessary in the test.

question_32362.question: How many Rx antenna ports is an ATG UE required to have in all operating bands, as a minimum?
question_32362.ground_truth: An ATG UE is required to have a minimum of two Rx antenna ports in all operating bands.

question_32363.question: What is the repetition level for the initial transmission of Msg3 PUSCH if the higher layer parameter pusch-maxNumRepetitionCEmodeA-r13 is not signaled in CEmodeA?
question_32363.ground_truth: The repetition level for the initial transmission of Msg3 PUSCH is 8 if the higher layer parameter pusch-maxNumRepetitionCEmodeA-r13 is not signaled in CEmodeA.

question_32364.question: What is the EGPRS indicator field element used for?
question_32364.ground_truth: The EGPRS indicator field element indicates whether the MS has no TBF using E-GPRS or has a TBF using E-GPRS in the old cell.

question_32365.question: What is the format for providing definitions in the present document?
question_32365.ground_truth: The format for providing definitions in the present document is: <defined term>: <definition>.

question_32367.question: What should the mobile station do after an instance of timer T3168 expires and TBF establishment for the corresponding radio bearer has failed?
question_32367.ground_truth: The mobile station should reinitiate resource request for that radio bearer using the procedures described in sub-clause 8.2.2.1.2.

question_32368.question: What action should the MS take upon receipt of a FACILITY message requiring a password?
question_32368.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a FACILITY message requiring a password, the MS should send a password by sending a FACILITY message.

question_32370.question: What is the primary classification of the "Common RAT Network Resource Model" work item?
question_32370.ground_truth: This work item is a building block.

question_32371.question: Under what conditions does the receiving UM RLC entity discard the received UMD PDU when it is placed in the reception buffer?
question_32371.ground_truth: The receiving UM RLC entity discards the received UMD PDU when its SN falls outside of the reassembly window.

question_32372.question: What is the purpose of the Service-Generic-Information AVP?
question_32372.ground_truth: The Service-Generic-Information AVP is used to transmit service information elements that are used for all services.

question_32373.question: What is the maximum number of contact addresses that the S-CSCF can select and retain for a single public user identity and instance-id at a time?
question_32373.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall not populate the target set with more than one contact with the same public user identity and instance-id at a time. If a request for a particular public user identity and instance-id fails with a 430 response, the S-CSCF shall replace the failed branch with another target with the same public user identity and instance-id, but a different reg-id.

question_32374.question: What is the operation that requests the gsmSSF to reduce the rate of service requests to the gsmSCF?

question_32375.question: What action should the application take after invoking the getFdAvailableFileList() API?
question_32375.ground_truth: The application may access the files that are announced by the parameters in the callback function. If the storage is not defined by the locationPath, the application should access the file before the announced availabilityDeadline.

question_32376.question: What does the "C" field in the Serving Cell Set based SRS Spatial Relation Indication MAC CE indicate?
question_32376.ground_truth: Whether the octets containing Resource Serving Cell ID field(s) and Resource BWP ID field(s) are present.

question_32377.question: What is the purpose of the "ue-upu" custom operation defined in section 6.3.3.2.4.2 of the document?
question_32377.ground_truth: The "ue-upu" custom operation is used by the NF service consumer to request the AUSF to compute the security material needed to ensure the protection of the UPU procedure.

question_32378.question: Which boolean value is set in the Follow-on request indicator if the UE has not received a REGISTRATION ACCEPT or REGISTRATION REJECT message from the network?
question_32378.ground_truth: The value of the Follow-on request indicator is "Follow-on request pending".

question_32379.question: In which cases must the UE indicate support for Reflective QoS for a PDU Session established in EPS with N26 interface?
question_32379.ground_truth: The UE indicates support for Reflective QoS during the PDU Session Establishment procedure for a new PDU Session, and during the PDU Session Modification procedure for an existing PDU Session that has been transferred from EPS to 5GS with N26 interface.

question_32381.question: What is the role of the TDF in relation to the start of a service?
question_32381.ground_truth: The TDF detects the start of a service flow that matches with one of the activated PCC/SDPR Rules and applies any enforcement actions if provided as part of the SDPR rules.

question_32382.question: What is the impact of uplink transmit diversity techniques on NodeB receiver performance?
question_32382.ground_truth: The impact on NodeB receiver performance is not clear, as some results are attributed to the particular ULTD algorithms and NodeB receivers used in simulations. However, for the practical SATD algorithm studied, up to 0.65 dB more power may be required at the NodeB to obtain the same quality. For a sub-optimal BFTD algorithm, a significant impact of up to 2.6 dB on received power was observed.

question_32383.question: What must the UE do when choosing a WLAN that supports S2a connectivity to HPLMN, RPLMN, or both HPLMN and RPLMN?
question_32383.ground_truth: The UE's decision is based on UE implementation-specific mechanisms and the "S2a connectivity preference" provisioned in the UE by the home ANDSF. The "S2a connectivity preference" is either set or not set, and the UE performs service provider selection after selecting a WLAN that has S2a connectivity with the UE's HPLMN, RPLMN, or both HPLMN and RPLMN.

question_32384.question: How are real-valued chip sequences in the Q and I branches combined?
question_32384.ground_truth: The real-valued chip sequence on the Q branch is complex multiplied with j and then summed with the corresponding real-valued chip sequence on the I branch, resulting in a single complex-valued chip sequence.

question_32385.question: What security keys does the AS apply for the integrity protection and ciphering of RRC signalling and user data?

question_32386.question: In the "CellTrafficTrace" procedure, what type of protocol information element indicates the transport layer address of the cell traffic trace collection entity?

question_32387.question: What changes were made in the N-GSM receiver chain with regards to the channel equalizer?
question_32387.ground_truth: The N-GSM receiver chain uses a less complex channel equalizer with a subsequent FFT detector instead of the GMSK trellis-based equalizer used in GPRS/EGPRS. The less complex equalizer does not require extra complexity compared to GPRS/EGPRS, given that the device operates in either GPRS/EGPRS mode or in N-GSM mode.

question_32388.question: What should the target UE replace the original initiating UE's layer-2 ID with in the 5G ProSe direct communication after a successful execution of the PROSE DIRECT LINK SECURITY MODE COMMAND message?
question_32388.ground_truth: The target UE should replace the original initiating UE's layer-2 ID with the new assigned initiating UE's layer-2 ID.

question_32389.question: What should the UE do upon inter-RAT cell selection or reselection while T331 is running?
question_32389.ground_truth: The UE must stop T331 and perform the actions specified in 5.7.8.3.

question_32392.question: What is the function of the PoC server in the IMS architecture?
question_32392.ground_truth: The PoC server is an application server that provides the application level network functionality for the PoC service in the IMS architecture. It communicates with the IMS core using the ISC interface.

question_32393.question: In 3GPP TS 24.229, what should the MCVideo client do if confidentiality and integrity protection are disabled and it has an available access token after user authentication?
question_32393.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body in the SIP REGISTER request with the access token and MCVideo request URI when confidentiality and integrity protection are disabled and it has an available access token after user authentication.

question_32394.question: What information should the ProSe Function in charge of the Proximity request include in a ProSe Proximity Alert request to the targeted UE?
question_32394.ground_truth: It should include the Application Layer User ID and the EPC ProSe User Identity of the requesting UE entering into proximity, and may include assistance information for WLAN direct discovery and communication if the WLAN indication was included in the Proximity request.

question_32395.question: What should an MAA do if it receives the streamingServiceError() notification?
question_32395.ground_truth: The MAA should revalidate the capture call and update the service list by issuing a getStreamingServices().

question_32398.question: What is the filter criterion in the context of the filter data for targeted ad insertion in DASH?
question_32398.ground_truth: The filter criterion is not restricted to a remote Period in DASH, it can be a single URL, or a regular expression pattern that matches the FDT's "Content-Location" attribute of that object during the announced schedule.

question_32399.question: What is the MCVideo emergency state used for in the MCVideo client?
question_32399.ground_truth: The MCVideo emergency state is used to indicate that the MCVideo user is in a life-threatening situation and to manage related actions for MCVideo emergency calls and private calls.

question_32400.question: What HTTP status code is returned when an attempt is made to update the SMS registration information with an IP-SM-GW number that cannot be overwritten?

question_32401.question: In what scenarios can the AMF reject the registration request from the UE?
question_32401.ground_truth: If all the S-NSSAIs included in the requested NSSAI are rejected, if all default S-NSSAIs are not allowed, and if the UE is not registering for onboarding services in SNPN or for emergency services, the AMF may reject the registration request in roaming scenarios.

question_32402.question: What is the mandatory use of all octets in the TP-VP (TP-Validity-Period) in the enhanced format?
question_32402.ground_truth: Although not all octets in the TP-VP may be used, any reserved or unused bits or octets must be set to zero as a mandatory requirement.

question_32405.question: What defines the packet treatment on the radio interface (Uu) in 5G NG-RAN?

question_32406.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group that the given document belongs to?

question_32408.question: What does the "Metrics" field in the Metrics leaf contain?
question_32408.ground_truth: The "Metrics" field contains the list of names that describes the metrics/measurements that are required to be reported in a MTSI call, provided that the MTSI client supports these measurements and the reporting rule conditions are met.

question_32409.question: What is the quantization step size used in the AMR-WB-interoperable mode?
question_32409.ground_truth: The quantization step size used in the AMR-WB-interoperable mode is 2.625.

question_32410.question: What is the purpose of Priority Trunk Queuing in Priority Service?
question_32410.ground_truth: Priority Trunk Queuing provides the capability to place a Priority Service call that has experienced a congestion condition for trunk resources into a queue associated with a trunk group until a trunk becomes available.

question_32412.question: What is a tool used for analysing RRM related measurements and interface tracing in a network?
question_32412.ground_truth: Special tools used for analysing RRM related measurements and interface tracing in a network

question_32413.question: What is the mandatory MIME body that the MCVideo client must include in the SIP MESSAGE request when sending an emergency alert?
question_32413.ground_truth: An application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the <mcvideoinfo> element containing the <mcvideo-Params> element, including the <mcvideo-request-uri>, <alert-ind>, and <mcvideo-client-id> elements.

question_32414.question: What is the qci value used for the audio stream in MCPTT?
question_32414.ground_truth: The qci value used for the audio stream in MCPTT is 65.

question_32416.question: What is the main benefit of Solution 4 in addressing synchronization problems where other solutions do not work?
question_32416.ground_truth: Solution 4 offers improved accuracy in scenarios with significant synchronization errors by compensating for propagation delays, which other solutions may not provide.

question_32417.question: What are the pre-test conditions for test case 8.1.3.1.19 in terms of the NR cells and system information?
question_32417.ground_truth: NR Cell 1 is the PCell, NR Cell 10 is the inter-frequency neighbor cell, and system information combination NR-4 as defined in TS 38.508-1 clause 4.4.3.1.2 is used in the NR PCell.

question_32420.question: What are some necessary capabilities to provide access to essential services in low-ARPU areas?
question_32420.ground_truth: Network sharing capabilities, support for low or no mobility UEs, efficient use of the control and data planes, support for APIs that provide network status information to applications, minimizing traffic on interfaces between the access network and the core network, and support for very large cells.

question_32421.question: What should the floor participant do when it receives the Floor Taken message and the first bit in the subtype of the Floor Taken message is set to '1' (Acknowledgment is required)?
question_32421.ground_truth: The floor participant should send a Floor Ack message with the Message Type field set to '2' (Floor Taken) and the Source field set to '0' (the floor participant is the source). The floor participant should also start the optional timer T103 (End of RTP media) and remain in the 'U: has no permission' state.

question_32422.question: What is a potential requirement for standardized features in a fully autonomous network level for management scopes in the network layer?
question_32422.ground_truth: A potential requirement could be the standardization of features that enable the network to analyze, make decisions, and execute changes to the network elements (NE) layer autonomously.

question_32423.question: What is the requirement for identifying new intra-frequency cells in NB-IoT TDD UE category NB1 and higher?
question_32423.ground_truth: The requirement for identifying new intra-frequency cells in NB-IoT TDD UE category NB1 and higher is that the UE shall be able to identify new intra-frequency cells without an explicit intra-frequency neighbour list containing physical layer cell identities.

question_32425.question: In the context of potential solutions for energy efficiency in shared gNB, what is the difference between the two methods of calculating the energy efficiency KPI?
question_32425.ground_truth: The first method uses estimated energy consumption, while the second method uses measured energy consumption.

question_32427.question: When should the CONTINUE A-B AS NORMAL CALL CLEARING occur?
question_32427.ground_truth: It should be done when there is a disconnect or when the demand expires.

question_32428.question: What does AAS BS receiver refer to in the document?
question_32428.ground_truth: AAS BS receiver refers to the composite receiver function of an AAS BS (Active Antenna System Base Station) receiving in an operating band.

question_32429.question: Which key issue is concluded to be more relevant to topic 2, and is covered by solutions #2.1 and #2.2, thus requiring no further normative work for topic 1?

question_32430.question: What must a network supporting 3GPP access do when an N5CW device initiates a new PDN connection in S1 mode?
question_32430.ground_truth: The network must not allocate PDU session identity value 15.

question_32431.question: What does the sending UE-1 do after receiving the broadcast key response from the serving SLPKMF of UE-1, containing the SLPBK, SLPBK-ID, SLPSK, and expiration time?
question_32431.ground_truth: The sending UE-1 encrypts the UE-1-ID and SL positioning assistance data/SL positioning capability using SLPBK, generates a token using SLPSK, then sends broadcast message, including SLPBK-ID, token, encrypted UE-1-ID, and protected broadcast data.

question_32433.question: What should the SS check regarding the "outgoing-communication-barring" element in the simservs document after step 6 of the test procedure?
question_32433.ground_truth: The SS should check that the simservs document stored in the SS contains the following pieces of information supplied by the UE: an "outgoing-communication-barring" element with "active" attribute set as "true" or with the "active" attribute not present, and within it a specific "cp:ruleset" element.

question_32435.question: In the process of inter-access flow mobility, what should a UE set the O (Overwrite) flag to when performing procedures described in subclause 5.7.2?
question_32435.ground_truth: The UE shall set the O (Overwrite) flag to 0.

question_32436.question: What is the EVM floor requirement for 256QAM, and how do the new phase noise profiles perform in comparison?
question_32436.ground_truth: The EVM floor requirement for 256QAM is -29.1 dB, and the new phase noise profiles from adopting min(Example 1-based, Example 2) and MTK have better EVM floors than this requirement for both CP-OFDM and DFT-S-OFDM, whether adding PTRS correction or not.

question_32437.question: What is the role of the old SGSN when it receives a valid old P-TMSI Signature?
question_32437.ground_truth: The old SGSN validates the old P-TMSI Signature and responds with an appropriate error cause if it does not match the value stored in the old SGSN. This should initiate the security functions in the new SGSN.

question_32439.question: What status code is returned by the HSS when there is no valid data for the UE in the scenario of IMS Registration Status Retrieval?
