question_33079.question: What does the term "Field of view" refer to in the context of the present document?
question_33079.ground_truth: The Field of view is the angle of visible field expressed in degrees measured from the focal point.

question_33081.question: What is the method for triggering the sending of the Application Layer Measurement report in the test model?
question_33081.ground_truth: The sending of the Application Layer Measurement report is triggered using the +CAPPLEVMR AT command in the test model.

question_33082.question: What are the some of the requirements for an intermediate operator CA certificate in case the RA/CA certificates are not directly signed by the operator root CA?
question_33082.ground_truth: In this case, the certificate of any intermediate operator CA shall follow the requirements given in subclause~6.1.4 for SEG CA certificate profiles, with the issuer name being the name of any operator CA and the path length being greater than 0.

question_33083.question: What is the radiation pattern represented by in the far field for an antenna?
question_33083.ground_truth: The radiation pattern is represented by the complex response consisting of the vertical and horizontal polarization components in the far field for an antenna.

question_33085.question: Which service is triggered if the non-reply timer in TAS expires and UE-B has not any other requests or responses after sending an ALERTING indication?

question_33087.question: What system maps UE provided location information to a form that is understood by the 3GPP MBMS system, e.g. MBMS SAI(s) and/or ECGI(s)?

question_33088.question: What is the definition of occupied bandwidth?
question_33088.ground_truth: Occupied bandwidth is the width of a frequency band such that, below the lower and above the upper frequency limits, the mean powers emitted are each equal to a specified percentage of the total mean power of a given emission.

question_33089.question: What is the 5% DL Average-UPT loss for semi-static SBFD at medium load level with SBFD Alt 2 and small packet size?
question_33089.ground_truth: The 5% DL Average-UPT loss for semi-static SBFD at medium load level with SBFD Alt 2 and small packet size is -1.58%.

question_33090.question: What network function is introduced in Solution #15 for managing the common DNAI?

question_33092.question: What should the old BSS do with other messages received during the handover execution procedure?
question_33092.ground_truth: Whilst the handover execution procedure is in operation, any other messages received at the old BSS relating to this connection and concerning assignment, handover, or cipher mode control should be discarded.

question_33093.question: What is the name of the uncertainty assessment term that is the same for both the conducted measurement and the OTA measurement in the context of power control steps in TS~25.141~?
question_33093.ground_truth: The term is "Uncertainty of conducted measurement" and its value is 0.1 dB.

question_33094.question: What is the condition for a UE to send an event triggered measurement report?
question_33094.ground_truth: A UE shall not send any event triggered measurement reports, as long as no reporting criteria are fulfilled.

question_33095.question: What information is contained in the RAB Setup Information message from the new SGSN to the old SGSN?
question_33095.ground_truth: The RAB Setup Information message contains the RNC Tunnel Endpoint Identifier and the RNC IP address for data forwarding from the source SRNC to the target RNC.

question_33096.question: What is the type of the ID id-EquivalentSNPNsList in the SNPN-MobilityInformation-ExtIEs context?
question_33096.ground_truth: An OCTET STRING corresponding to a maximum of 32 bytes.

question_33101.question: What endpoint address does the Media Session Handler use to make its first request at reference point M5 to the 5GMS AF for each media streaming session?
question_33101.ground_truth: The default host name for the 5GMS AF at reference point M5 is "ms.af.3gppservices.org".

question_33102.question: What is the operation mode in which the Mobile Station (MS) should be set for the first iteration (k=1) of the test sequence?
question_33102.ground_truth: The MS should be set in MS operation mode C for the first iteration.

question_33104.question: What is the accuracy requirement for the MS to produce Codec Mode Requests for TU3 channel conditions with ideal frequency hopping, without DTX activated in GSM900 and GSM850?
question_33104.ground_truth: The MS shall produce Codec Mode Requests with the following accuracy: when a carrier to interferer ratio 4 dB higher than a defined upper threshold is applied to the antenna connector, the MS shall request a higher mode with a probability exceeding 90%; when a carrier to interferer ratio 4 dB lower than a defined lower threshold is applied to the antenna connector, the MS shall request a lower mode with a probability exceeding 90%.

question_33105.question: In what situation can the Modify Bearer Request message contain zero IEs without being considered an error by the PGW?
question_33105.ground_truth: A Modify Bearer Request with zero IEs can be used as an implicit resume of suspended bearers in the SGW and PGW. In this case, the PGW should not consider it an error.

question_33106.question: What information about the user should the S-CSCF pass on to the HSS when registering a user?
question_33106.ground_truth: The S-CSCF passes its SIP URI to the HSS to inform the HSS that the user currently registering will be served by the S-CSCF.

question_33107.question: What is the main protocol entity in the UE used by the System Simulator (SS) to control the UE specific testing functions?

question_33109.question: What is the purpose of the Completion Phase in the Enhanced Serving RNS Relocation procedure?
question_33109.ground_truth: In this phase, the MS has been relocated to the Target RNC, and the Target RNC sends an Enhanced Relocation Complete Request message to the SGSN indicating relocated RABs and the status of the relocation.

question_33110.question: What is the type of the "id-TransportLayerAddress" extension in the RAB-SetupItem-RelocReqAck-ExtIEs RANAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION?
question_33110.ground_truth: The type of the "id-TransportLayerAddress" extension is "EXTENSION TransportLayerAddress".

question_33111.question: In the context of call duration in UTRAN cell for CS domain, what is the accumulation period used for converting the time interval RRC RADIO BEARER SETUP COMPLETE and the call completed RRC RADIO BEARER RELEASE into seconds for conversational service?
question_33111.ground_truth: The accumulation period used for converting the time interval RRC RADIO BEARER SETUP COMPLETE and the call completed RRC RADIO BEARER RELEASE into seconds for conversational service is a granularity period.

question_33112.question: What is the purpose of the UAE Server receiving a location report for the UAV/UAV-C by the SEAL's LM server?
question_33112.ground_truth: The purpose of receiving the location report for the UAV/UAV-C by the SEAL's LM server is for the UAE Server to determine the switching of the C2 mode between networks.

question_33113.question: What additional functions does the MAC layer support when providing services to a non-transparent RLC mode entity?
question_33113.ground_truth: The MAC layer supports the following additional functions when providing services to a non-transparent RLC mode entity: Ciphering, Identification of different traffic flows of one or more MSs on the basic physical subchannels, Multiplexing/demultiplexing of higher layer PDUs, Multiplexing/demultiplexing user and control plane data to/from the physical layer for PDTCHs, Scheduling of RLC/MAC data and control PDUs delivered to the physical layer on shared basic physical subchannels, and Splitting/recombining.

question_33115.question: What is the minimum requirement for UL-MIMO transmit intermodulation for UE supporting UL-MIMO with two transmit antenna connectors in a closed-loop spatial multiplexing scheme?
question_33115.ground_truth: The requirements specified in subclause 6.7.1 apply to each transmit antenna connector.

question_33117.question: What is the role of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in the technical specification?
question_33117.ground_truth: The 3GPP is responsible for producing the technical specification, which covers various aspects of telecommunication management and mobile networks with virtualized network functions.

question_33118.question: What should the system simulator set as the PCell, PSCell, and neighbor cell in the preamble for 8.2.3.11.3.3.1?
question_33118.ground_truth: NR Cell 1 is the PCell, NR Cell 10 is the PSCell and NR Cell 3 is Neighbour Cell on FR2.

question_33119.question: What action does the PCEF take when it receives a notification about the removal of an access of a multi-access IP-CAN session?
question_33119.ground_truth: The PCEF initiates an IP-CAN Session Modification procedure to notify the PCRF about the removal of an access, and modifies or deletes the corresponding PCC rules.

question_33120.question: What status code is sent by the AAnF if the KAKMA is not present in the AAnF?
question_33120.ground_truth: The AAnF shall reply with an HTTP "403 Forbidden" status code.

question_33121.question: What is the formula to compute the second independent threshold?
question_33121.ground_truth: It is computed as the product of the first independent threshold and the ratio of the sub-band energies at the beginning and the end of the pre-echo zone.

question_33122.question: What services are exempted from the SOR-CMCI criteria for the UE?
question_33122.ground_truth: Emergency services are exempted from the SOR-CMCI criteria.

question_33123.question: What pre-conditions must be met for the transportation convenience service for the passengers with reduced mobility to be feasible?
question_33123.ground_truth: The pre-conditions include the existence of feasible Mobile Intelligent Assistants, operation under a central control system via 3GPP access, a weak passenger with reduced mobility, and the passenger having an equipment supporting 3GPP access.

question_33124.question: What is the expected parameter value for the password registration failure error when registering a new password for all call restriction services?

question_33125.question: In the document, what does SGM-C stand for and what is its role?
question_33125.ground_truth: SGM-C stands for SEAL Group Management Client. It is a functional entity that acts as the application client for management of groups.

question_33127.question: How does the API exposing function identify the resource owner client in step 3 of clause 6.3.1.2?
question_33127.ground_truth: The API exposing function identifies the resource owner clients by interacting with HSS/UDM when the service API invocation indicates the resource owner client by an external group identifier.

question_33128.question: Over what period of time is the E-DCH related time slot information associated with the E-AGCH valid?
question_33128.ground_truth: The E-DCH related time slot information associated with the E-AGCH shall always refer to either the same or the following radio frame, and shall not refer to two subsequent radio frames.

question_33129.question: What is the purpose of the PS-NI-LR procedure in packet-switched networks?
question_33129.ground_truth: The PS-NI-LR procedure is used to initiate a location request to the GMLC in the event of an emergency situation, such as after emergency attach, service request for emergency, or PDP context activation towards an emergency APN. It is also used to transfer the SGSN address to the GMLC indicated by the old SGSN after the handover or relocation of an emergency PDP context from an old to a new SGSN.

question_33131.question: What is the response code used in support of ACR service?
question_33131.ground_truth: The response code 433 (Anonymity Disallowed) is used in support of ACR service.

question_33132.question: What does the NWDAF containing AnLF indicate when it registers the use of the ML model?
question_33132.ground_truth: When the NWDAF containing AnLF registers the use of the ML model with the NWDAF containing MTLF, it indicates its capability of sending analytics feedback information and/or ML model accuracy information from the analytics consumers for the ML model.

question_33133.question: What is the goal of Automated Cooperative Driving for short distance grouping (CoSdG)?
question_33133.ground_truth: The goal is to enable a leader vehicle to communicate and coordinate with a group of vehicles to allow close following and improve safety and fuel economy by reducing aerodynamic drag.

question_33136.question: What should the BM-SC do when re-establishing the active MBMS bearer services affected by the SGmb path failure?
question_33136.ground_truth: The BM-SC shall encode the MBMS Session Start Request with the same contents as in the original MBMS Session Start Request (or per the last MBMS Session Update Request sent by the BM-SC) and set the "MBMS session re-establishment indication" flag.

question_33137.question: What is the maximum duration allowed for this test procedure?
question_33137.ground_truth: The maximum duration of the test is 5 minutes.

question_33139.question: What is the expected sequence number for the SEND DTMF test with text attribute - Bold On?
question_33139.ground_truth: The expected sequence number for the SEND DTMF test with text attribute - Bold On is 4.6.

question_33140.question: What is the purpose of sending MBMS Heartbeat Request messages in the context of SGmb or MB2-C signalling between the BM-SC and MBMS GW or GCS AS?
question_33140.ground_truth: The purpose of sending MBMS Heartbeat Request messages is to detect a path failure between the involved nodes by monitoring the absence of any other signalling on those interfaces. If no MBMS Heartbeat Answer is received after repeated requests, the SGmb or MB2-C path is considered to be down.

question_33141.question: What should the UE do upon receiving the RRCSetup message if it has connection establishment failure information available in VarConnEstReport and RPLMN is equal to the plmn-Identity stored in VarConnEstReport?
question_33141.ground_truth: The UE should include connEstInfoAvailable in the RRCSetupComplete message.

question_33142.question: Which of the network reference points supports the control plane interactions between the UAS application server and the BM-SC?
question_33142.ground_truth: The MB2-C reference point supports the control plane interactions between the UAS application server and the BM-SC.

question_33143.question: What is the purpose of the SamplePercentage rule in QoE metric reporting?
question_33143.ground_truth: The SamplePercentage rule can be used to set a percentage sample of calls which should report reception. This is useful for statistical data analysis of large populations and increasing scalability due to reduced total uplink signalling.

question_33145.question: What is the message transmitted by UE-1 when it realizes the remote user is not in direct range?
question_33145.ground_truth: The Solicitation message is transmitted by UE-1 when it realizes the remote user is not in direct range.

question_33146.question: What are the steps involved in the PFD Management procedure via SCEF to manage PFDs into the operator network?
question_33146.ground_truth: The procedure involves sending a PFD Management Request message to the SCEF, translating external Application Identifiers to the corresponding Application Identifiers known at the PFDF, sending a PFD Management Request message to the PFDF, creating, updating or deleting the list of PFDs for each Application Identifier into the PFDF, and sending a PFD Management Response message to the 3rd party SCS/AS to provide the feedback of the handling result for the PFD Management Request.

question_33147.question: What entity decides which HSS to query when the I-CSCF receives an INVITE request?
question_33147.ground_truth: The I-CSCF decides which HSS to query when the I-CSCF receives an INVITE request.

question_33148.question: What should be done with the exceeded part of the allocated power of a supported operating band, if it exceeds the declared Prated of the operating band?
question_33148.ground_truth: If the allocated power of a supported operating band exceeds the declared Prated,t of the operating band, the exceeded part should, if possible, be reallocated into the other band(s).

question_33149.question: What should be the value of the "Content-Disposition" header when carrying the information associated with USSD in the g.3gpp.ussd info package?

question_33151.question: What should the NAF do if it does not support the GBA type specified in the "requestGbaPushInfoResponse" message?
question_33151.ground_truth: If the NAF does not support the GBA type in the "requestGbaPushInfoResponse" message, it shall stop processing the message and indicate an error via the O&M subsystem.

question_33153.question: What is the purpose of the "encodedPolyline" element defined in the "tPolyLineType" complex type?
question_33153.ground_truth: The "encodedPolyline" element is used to store a string encoding of a polyline using the polyline encoding algorithm.

question_33154.question: In the context of the 3GPP system, what is a personalized environment for a user that ensures consistent, personalized service, irrespective of the user's location or the terminal used?
question_33154.ground_truth: The "User Profile" is the set of information necessary to provide a user with a consistent, personalized service environment, irrespective of the user's location or the terminal used in the context of the 3GPP system.

question_33158.question: What message does the gNB-CU send to the AMF after receiving a successful response from a gNB-DU in the RAN TSS reporting process?
question_33158.ground_truth: The gNB-CU replies to the AMF by sending the TIMING SYNCHRONISATION STATUS RESPONSE message, indicating that the RAN TSS reporting was successful.

question_33159.question: What is a mobile phone virus, and what are the risks associated with it?
question_33159.ground_truth: A mobile phone virus is a serious threat for users that can result in sensitive information being lost, damages to software and hardware, unavailability of mobile phone services, and additional charges. For the operator, large quantities of junk data distribution will result in network traffic jam and degraded service quality.

question_33160.question: What determines the highest allowed Codec Mode for Tandem Free Operation?
question_33160.ground_truth: The worst of both radio legs determines the highest allowed Codec Mode for Tandem Free Operation.

question_33161.question: What is the purpose of the "group size for EAS discovery" parameter in the solution?
question_33161.ground_truth: The "group size for EAS discovery" parameter is used by the EES to initiate determination of a common EAS when a certain number of EAS discovery requests have been received, in situations where the UE location information is not shared between users.

question_33163.question: What is the reporting range of NRSRP for UE Category NB1?
question_33163.ground_truth: The reporting range of NRSRP for UE Category NB1 is from -156 dBm to -44 dBm with 1 dB resolution. The range in the signalling may be larger than the guaranteed accuracy range.

question_33164.question: What is a Personal Area Network (PAN) in the context of Personal Network Management?
question_33164.ground_truth: A Personal Area Network (PAN) is a local network of the PN-User that consists of at least one UE and may also comprise a number of MEs/MTs, with own radio access means that allow them to directly access the PLMN of the UE. The UE and locally connected additional MEs/MTs are the PNEs of the PAN.

question_33166.question: What is the hifghest priority use case in the RAN work item for the minimization of drive tests?
question_33166.ground_truth: The highest priority use case is coverage optimization.

question_33167.question: What action does the physical layer take if it is instructed to replace the data in the soft buffer for this TB with the data which the MAC entity attempted to decode?
question_33167.ground_truth: The physical layer replaces the data in the soft buffer for this TB with the data which the MAC entity attempted to decode.

question_33168.question: What action does the mobile station take when it receives more than one RLC data block with the FBI set to '1'?
question_33168.ground_truth: It accepts the data from only the first one of these blocks.

question_33169.question: In what circumstances can an AMF terminate PDU Sessions associated with a S-NSSAI?
question_33169.ground_truth: An AMF can terminate PDU Sessions associated with a S-NSSAI if the UE does not perform any actions within the validity time provided by the network.

question_33170.question: What is used to indicate ongoing user data transmission in A/Gb mode in the SGSN?

question_33171.question: For what purpose should the 3GPP network be able to recognize in the FMSS study?
question_33171.ground_truth: In the FMSS study, the 3GPP network should be able to recognize the application characteristics, such as application type (video, web browsing, IM, etc.) and application protocol (HTTP, P2P, etc.), target address name (URL) and application provider (e.g. YoutubeTM) to steer traffic per these application characteristics in order to provide value-added service to third-party applications.

question_33172.question: In what scenario is the triggering of a Scheduling Request for the SL-PRS Resource Request MAC CE?
question_33172.ground_truth: When the checking condition for generating the SL-PRS Resource Request MAC CE is not met.

question_33173.question: What are the functional entities in a 3GPP system called?
question_33173.ground_truth: The functional entities in a 3GPP system are referred to as "basic telecom management functional areas."

question_33174.question: What should be reserved for signalling from the UE to the RAN in a CIoT optimized CN?
question_33174.ground_truth: Codepoint(s) should be reserved for this purpose.

question_33175.question: What type of primitive is used to indicate a normal dialogue end when there is no component primitive?

question_33176.question: What action should the SS take if the MS sets the MS OUT OF MEMORY BIT to 1 in the EGPRS Packet Downlink ACK/NACK message?
question_33176.ground_truth: The SS should only retransmit NACKED RLC data blocks with MCS 9 and continue transmitting new data with MCS 9 when the MS sets the MS OUT OF MEMORY BIT back to 0.

question_33177.question: What action does the V-SMF take if the request for HR-SBO is not authorized and DNS context has been created?
question_33177.ground_truth: The V-SMF deletes the DNS context from the selected V-EASDF and skips subsequent steps related to the EASDF in this procedure.

question_33179.question: What is the purpose of Cryptographic Information Management (CIM) in telecommunications?
question_33179.ground_truth: CIM manages the secret information associated with cryptographic security mechanisms, including enhanced authentication, integrity, and encipherment.

question_33180.question: What is MeasGapId #2 associated with in the measurement test?
question_33180.ground_truth: MeasGapId #2 is associated with RF channel number #3 (NR cell 3) in the measurement test.

question_33182.question: What should the network do when the 5G-GUTI was used and the network does not accept the client certificate of the UE?
question_33182.ground_truth: The network should initiate an identification procedure to retrieve the SUCI from the UE and restart the EAP-based primary authentication and key agreement procedure with the received SUCI.

question_33185.question: Under what circumstances can an UE receive paging messages for other services while engaged in packet data transfer?
question_33185.ground_truth: One mode of network operation allows for paging messages for other services to be received by an UE via the packet data channel without degrading packet data transfer.

question_33186.question: What is required for the coordination of SMS delivery in CSoPS while roaming?
question_33186.ground_truth: The coordination of SMS delivery between SMS over IP, SMS via CSFB, and CSoPS while roaming is FFS.

question_33188.question: Which objectives should the E-UTRAN architecture study focus on related to UTRAN architecture?
question_33188.ground_truth: The E-UTRAN architecture study should focus on identifying the optimum UTRAN network architecture and functional split between RAN network nodes, considering functional splits between UTRAN and CN.

question_33189.question: What device is used to measure the radiated power samples in the e radiation power measurement procedure?
question_33189.ground_truth: A radio communications tester, a corresponding device, a measurement receiver, or a spectrum analyzer can be used to measure the radiated power samples.

question_33190.question: What should the user do if they want to use normal services over the same access while being emergency registered?
question_33190.ground_truth: The user should attempt to receive normal service over another access type if not otherwise prevented by the present document.

question_33191.question: Which header field should the MCPTT client include in the SIP INVITE request, with the public user identity containing a value as specified in 3GPP TS 24.229?

question_33193.question: What is the process for CAT priority in the IMS network where the originating CAT AS includes the originating CAT provision indication in the INVITE message?
question_33193.ground_truth: Based on the originating CAT provision indication in the INVITE message, the terminating CAT AS would not execute the terminating CAT procedure.

question_33194.question: What is the recommended action if the paging policy needs to be changed in the described solution?
question_33194.ground_truth: The AMF may decide whether, when and where to page the UE if the paging policy needs to be changed.

question_33195.question: What are the changes to the Padded HOM proposal for burst symmetry and burst sizes in this investigation?
question_33195.ground_truth: The changes to the Padded HOM proposal include choosing burst symmetry in both uplink and downlink directions, fitting the block size with the burst size, and choosing a narrower spectrum for payload allocation.

question_33196.question: What are the impacts of NG-RAN support for location management functionality on the network?
question_33196.ground_truth: It impacts the NG-C interface, protocol/signalling between NG-RAN and UE, protocol/signalling between NG-RANs, architecture of location management component within NG-RAN, and UE mobility in support of location management functionality in NG-RAN.

question_33197.question: What is the name of the initial message for sgNBAdditionPreparation?

question_33199.question: How many muting frames are there in NRF_WAKEUP?

question_33200.question: What does the acronym PDP stand for in the context of channel modeling?
question_33200.ground_truth: PDP stands for Power Delay Profile in the context of channel modeling.

question_33202.question: What is the role of a B2BUA in IMS?
question_33202.ground_truth: A Back-to-Back User Agent (B2BUA) in IMS is a SIP element capable of handling a collection of User Agents with their own specific behavior as UAC and UAS, linked by application logic fully independent of the SIP rules. This is used in the IM CN subsystem.

question_33204.question: What action is taken as the RAN sharing period is due to expire at 7:00 pm for Jerry's communication?
question_33204.ground_truth: The shared RAN steers Jerry's UE away from RAN X and towards RAN Y based on Operator B's policies.

question_33208.question: What is the significance of the version numbering system used in the TS?
question_33208.ground_truth: The version numbering system indicates the level of TSG approval and the type of changes made to the document. A version number of "x.y.z" indicates that the document is under change control and has undergone technical enhancements, corrections, or updates.

question_33209.question: What component in the network is responsible for replacing the eNB's IP address with the X2-Proxy's IP address during the TNL address discovery procedure?

question_33210.question: What is required for the fallback solution in option 1 to provide mid-call services in IMS?
question_33210.ground_truth: Mid-call services in IMS would be available in option 1 if CAMEL were supported in the VPLMN.

question_33211.question: How is the rate matching output sequence length determined for HARQ-ACK transmission on PUSCH in 6.3.2.4.2.1?
question_33211.ground_truth: The rate matching output sequence length for HARQ-ACK transmission on PUSCH in 6.3.2.4.2.1 is determined by setting the number of CRC bits L to 0 in Clause 6.3.2.4.1.1, and multiplying the result by NL, Qm, and QACK, where NL is the number of transmission layers of the PUSCH, Qm is the modulation order of the PUSCH, and QACK is the number of coded modulation symbols per layer for HARQ-ACK transmission.

question_33213.question: What is the primary function of the AMF upon receipt of the Registration Request message with the UE's indication of support of the MINT feature?
question_33213.ground_truth: Upon receipt of the Registration Request message with the UE's indication of support of the MINT feature, the AMF sends a new information element that contains a new timer, called T35xx, to the UE in Registration Accept message.

question_33214.question: What encapsulation method is used by the NATTT device for packets exchanged on the "public" side in the MT Communication with NATTT solution?
question_33214.ground_truth: The NATTT device relies on UDP encapsulation for packets exchanged on the "public" side in the MT Communication with NATTT solution.

question_33215.question: What action should the SS take if the UE responds on lower priority NR Cell 2 during time duration T1?
question_33215.ground_truth: If the UE responds on lower priority NR Cell 2 during time duration T1, the SS should count a success for the event "Re-select lowe priority Cell 2".

question_33216.question: What is the 3GPP Technical Specification Group that produced the present document?
question_33216.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects

question_33217.question: When should an MTSI client use SDPCapNeg for video media types as per TS 26.114 Rel-8, clause 6.2.1a.2?
question_33217.ground_truth: An MTSI client should use SDPCapNeg for video media types when offering AVPF the first time for a new media type in the session, either offering AVPF and AVP together or offering only AVPF without SDPCapNeg if the answering client is known to support this RTP profile.

question_33219.question: What is required for end-to-end security of TCP based media using TLS for ad-hoc conferences?
question_33219.ground_truth: The IMS UEs and the conference server may use the end-to-end security of the session based message conferencing (MSRP) and conferencing (BFCP) using a TLS tunnel established with the MIKEY-TICKET mechanism. The conference focus should verify that the UE identity is authorized to join the conference.

question_33220.question: What shall be present in the SCEF Reference ID Ext field when the SCEF Reference ID is included?
question_33220.ground_truth: The SCEF Reference ID Ext field shall contain the 64-bit SCEF Reference ID Ext for the event when the SCEF Reference ID is included.

question_33222.question: Which command is used to internally handle all UICC-MT interface locking and file selection routines by the MT (Mobile Termination)?
question_33222.ground_truth: The Restricted UICC logical channel access +CRLA command is used to internally handle all UICC-MT interface locking and file selection routines by the MT (Mobile Termination).

question_33223.question: What is the significance of timestamps in UDR being identified using UTC to avoid time inconsistency due to different timezones?
question_33223.ground_truth: To ensure consistency and accuracy of data in UDR, timestamps are identified using UTC, which eliminates the possibility of time inconsistencies caused by different timezones.

question_33224.question: What is the name of the key derived for integrity protection of user data when the UE is connected to E-UTRA/EPC and capable of user plane integrity protection?

question_33225.question: What is the purpose of the Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) in this process?
question_33225.ground_truth: The DCT is used to convert the de-emphasized signal into the frequency domain.

question_33226.question: In the context of cell access technology, what does "E-UTRA (NB-S1 mode)" and "E-UTRA connected to a 5GCN" represent?
question_33226.ground_truth: "E-UTRA (NB-S1 mode)" refers to NB-IoT (Narrow Band Internet of Things) network, "E-UTRA connected to a 5GCN" indicates that the E-UTRA is connected to an Evolved Packet System (EPS) core network or 5G Core Network (5GCN), depending on the context.

question_33230.question: What does the SCP-specific security requirements clause include?
question_33230.ground_truth: The SCP-specific security requirements clause includes requirements derived from SCP-specific security functional requirements in relevant specifications, as well as security requirements introduced in the present document derived from the threats specific to SCP.

question_33232.question: What is required to use a shared FRMCS Equipment securely?
question_33232.ground_truth: To securely use shared FRMCS Equipment, it is necessary to identify the user for the equipment.

question_33234.question: What is the total cell re-selection delay for the lower priority cell in the test case?
question_33234.ground_truth: The total cell re-selection delay for the lower priority cell is 20.48 seconds.

question_33235.question: What action shall the MS take if it receives an MBMS notification for an MBMS multicast service for which it has activated an MBMS context, or for an MBMS broadcast service which has been selected for reception locally by upper layers, and it is prompted to establish a PS signalling connection?
question_33235.ground_truth: The MS shall set the Service Type to "MBMS multicast service reception" or "MBMS broadcast service reception".

question_33240.question: What message is sent from the SMF+PGW-C to the DN-AAA to request accounting stop in the outlined scenario?
question_33240.ground_truth: The SMF sends an Accounting-Request (STOP) message to the DN-AAA to request accounting stop.

question_33241.question: What provides the number of EAS discovery request successes at the EES?

question_33242.question: What is the definition of "control plane CIoT EPS optimization"?
question_33242.ground_truth: Control plane CIoT EPS optimization refers to signalling optimizations for efficient transport of user data, including optional IP header compression, for user plane data over the control plane through the MME.

question_33244.question: What is the requirement for the Relative Code Domain Error (RCDE) for 64QAM modulated codes?
question_33244.ground_truth: The average Relative Code Domain Error for 64QAM modulated codes shall not exceed -21.9dB at spreading factor 16.

question_33245.question: What is the maximum time allowed for the measurement reporting delay to be less than in 8.16.2.3?
question_33245.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay shall be less than the physical layer measurement period defined in Clause 8.16.2.2a.

question_33246.question: When an MCVideo user that is not the controlling function of an MCVideo group receives a request to initiate a group session, what condition must be met for the MCVideo user to be authorized to initiate the group session?
question_33246.ground_truth: The SIP INVITE request must be for the controlling function of an MCVideo group, the group document associated with the MCVideo group ID for the MCVideo user must contain a rule element authorizing the user to initiate a group session, and the group must support MCVideo services.

question_33247.question: What is the purpose of the DiscardReq parameter in RLC SDU transmission?
question_33247.ground_truth: The DiscardReq parameter indicates whether the transmitting RLC entity needs to inform the upper layers of the discarded RLC SDU. If required, the transmitting RLC entity notifies upper layers when the SDU is discarded.

question_33248.question: What should NF A include in the request when it invokes a service provided by NF B after restarting, as per the described procedure?
question_33248.ground_truth: NF A should include its last recovery timestamp together with the Consumer Id in the request when invoking service provided by NF B, and the same Consumer Id should be used after restarting. If NF A includes Binding Indication(s) in the request, it should include the updated recovery timestamp for the higher level binding entity to which the callback resource context is bound in the Binding Indication with the scope set to "callback".

question_33249.question: What does the term "spurious emissions" refer to in 6.5A.4?
question_33249.ground_truth: Spurious emissions refer to emissions that are caused by unwanted transmitter effects, such as harmonics emission, parasitic emissions, intermodulation products and frequency conversion products, but exclude out of band emissions unless otherwise stated.

question_33250.question: What is the network technology used by the eCall capable UE to establish an eCall in this test case?
question_33250.ground_truth: The eCall capable UE establishes the eCall using the CS domain, which can be UTRA (UTRAN) or GERAN (GSM EDGE Radio Access Network).

question_33255.question: How does the 5G network assist in the intralogistics process in Company A's automobile manufacturing facilities?
question_33255.ground_truth: The 5G network assists in the intralogistics process by transmitting signals for inventory, authenticating and authorizing Ambient IoT devices, performing automatic inventory operations, and providing positioning services for AGVs in Company A's automobile manufacturing facilities.

question_33256.question: What kind of data is collected by ADAEC in the VAL UE session performance analytics procedure?
question_33256.ground_truth: ADAEC collects data such as RTT, throughput, jitter, QoE measurements, QoS profile load, VAL application traffic load etc. from the VAL UE(s) during the VAL UE session.

question_33258.question: What is the responsibility of the ThresholdConditions node in the RANValidityCondition scenario?
question_33258.ground_truth: The ThresholdConditions node is responsible for evaluating the RAN validity condition for a particular flow distribution rule.

question_33260.question: What is the process of triggering session-oriented service establishment as per Solution #1?
question_33260.ground_truth: The V2X application-specific server triggers the VAE server to initiate a session-oriented service to the VAE client, which includes information such as the identity of the VAE client, the identity of the V2X application specific server, the identity of the service session, the V2X service ID, and the "type" or "QoS requirements" of the session. The VAE server then provides a session-oriented service trigger response to the V2X application-specific server, indicating its ability or inability to initiate a session-oriented service with the VAE client.

question_33261.question: What is the measurement window, T, in this process?
question_33261.ground_truth: The measurement window, T, is the same as the test signal period, T, and is synchronized to the PN-sequence of the test signal.

question_33262.question: What is the name of the module that is used for the presentation layer solution in 3GPP services, planned for Release 12?
question_33262.ground_truth: A common and modern scene description solution

question_33263.question: What does the 3GPP TR technical report on Media Production over 5G NPN Systems (Release 17) identify as standardization needs and potential gaps when using 5G Systems for media production?
question_33263.ground_truth: The report identifies the need to identify relevant media production use cases, develop reference media production architectures, identify QoS requirements for media production workflows, clarify the usage of 5G System features for media production, study media device and network orchestration solutions, and collaborate with relevant organizations for media-related aspects.

question_33264.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the test case described in section 17.3.1.1?
question_33264.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement for the test case described in section 17.3.1.1 is specified in clause 17.3.1.0.1.

question_33265.question: What is the primary means of protection of multicast data in the solution?
question_33265.ground_truth: Multicast data protection is performed between UE and MBSTF, the anchor point of the multicast data. The MTK and KID, used for the multicast data protection, is generated by MBSF and securely distributed to UE over the control plane, and to MBSTF.

question_33268.question: What should the NAS do upon receiving an indication that the barring is alleviated for the access category, if the event was a request from upper layers to send a mobile originated SMS over NAS and the NAS did not initiate the NAS transport procedure?
question_33268.ground_truth: The NAS may initiate the NAS transport procedure as specified in subclause~5.4.5 to send the SMS in an UL NAS TRANSPORT message, if still needed.

question_33269.question: What is the difference between an MME and an S4-SGSN when making the selection for a valid SGSN interface using the S-NAPTR procedure?
question_33269.ground_truth: An MME uses "x-3gpp-sgsn:x-s3" while an S4-SGSN uses "x-3gpp-sgsn:x-s16".

question_33270.question: When shall an MCPTT group information entry be copied into a new MCPTT group information entry of the candidate list of the MCPTT group information entries?
question_33270.ground_truth: When the MCPTT group ID is in the served list of the MCPTT group information entries, the expiration time of the MCPTT group information entry has not expired yet, and the IWF determines the user is not to be affiliated with the group.

question_33271.question: What are the advantages of Solutions #12 and #13 in the case of satellite discontinuous coverage?
question_33271.ground_truth: Solution #12 can provide service continuity as much as possible to the UE by reusing existing inter-RAT handover procedures. Solution #13 can give better control to operators during the discontinuous coverage period, allowing them to decide whether to provide service to the UE through alternate PLMN/RAT or keep the UE in no service until it gets back into satellite coverage. These solutions can improve service experience by using alternative access when coverage is lost and enrich more services in the network, while minimizing the impact on Rel-17.

question_33272.question: What message is sent by the MS to retrieve the MultiParty call using the "RetrieveMPTY" invoke component?
question_33272.ground_truth: The MS sends a FACILITY message containing one of the transaction identifiers of the call and an "RetrieveMPTY" invoke component.

question_33273.question: What type of security mechanism must the UE support when sending the unprotected REGISTER request using UDP?
question_33273.ground_truth: The UE must transmit the request from the same IP address and port on which it expects to receive the response to this request.

question_33274.question: What is the purpose of providing Quality of Service information in LCS?
question_33274.ground_truth: LCS Quality of Service information is characterized by three key attributes: LCS QoS Class, Accuracy, and Response Time, and is used to define the degree of adherence to the required QoS.

question_33275.question: What should the UE do if the AMF supports N26 interface and includes the "interworking without N26 interface not supported" in the 5GS network feature support IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
question_33275.ground_truth: The UE shall operate in single-registration mode.

question_33277.question: What mandatory Diameter AVP is used to specify the network domain name of the targeted V2X Control Function?
question_33277.ground_truth: The Destination-Realm AVP is used to specify the network domain name of the targeted V2X Control Function.

question_33278.question: What Action does the network take when the non-3GPP implicit de-registration timer expires and the UE has not contacted the network over the non-3GPP access?
question_33278.ground_truth: The network implicitly de-registers the UE and enters the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED over non-3GPP access for the UE when the non-3GPP implicit de-registration timer expires and the UE has not contacted the network over the non-3GPP access.

question_33281.question: What is the contiguous allocation rule for SL intra-band contiguous CA in the context of NR SL CA?
question_33281.ground_truth: The contiguous allocation rule for SL intra-band contiguous CA is the same as that for NR intra-band contiguous CA in section 6.2A.2.1 in TS38.101-1.

question_33282.question: Which reference points are used for NU1 and NU2 interfaces in direct UDM-HSS interworking?
question_33282.ground_truth: NU1 is a reference point between the HSS and the UDM, while NU2 is a reference point between the HSS and the 5GS-UDR.

question_33283.question: Which message contents are used for testing the UE transmit timing accuracy for EN-DC FR1 UE in 3GPP 5G specifications?
question_33283.ground_truth: The message contents are specified in clause 4.4.1.1.4.3 of the 3GPP 5G specifications.

question_33284.question: What message does the NG-RAN node send to the AMF to indicate that the request for multicast session activation was fulfilled?

question_33285.question: What method is used for uplink scheduling in CIoT devices?
question_33285.ground_truth: The principle of fixed uplink allocation is used for CIoT users in the uplink, removing the need for the device to monitor the downlink for uplink scheduling information.

question_33288.question: What kind of out of band emissions are specified in section 11.1.1.2.2.1?
question_33288.ground_truth: Out of band emissions specified in section 11.1.1.2.2.1 are unwanted emissions immediately outside the nominal channel resulting from the modulation process and non-linearity in the transmitter but excluding spurious emissions.

question_33289.question: What is the role of the CEF (consumer of the NWDAF) in Solution #6.3 NWDAF based Network slice charging?
question_33289.ground_truth: The CEF (consumer of the NWDAF) is used by the CHF (CEF) to collect S-NSSAI charging information (KPIs) for the purpose of NS charging in Solution #6.3 NWDAF based Network slice charging.

question_33291.question: What is the task of the E-CSCF in Procedure D of 6.2.4.6 after receiving the SIP INVITE from the VCC DTF?
question_33291.ground_truth: The E-CSCF updates the anchor LRF with the new SDP information, indicating that the UE is now using the IMS domain and provides the UE IP address.

question_33292.question: What information does the AF provide to PCF_1 and PCF_2?
question_33292.ground_truth: The AF provides TSN QoS parameters for specific ports and TSN parameters used for uplink and downlink TSCAI for the TSN flow to PCF_1 and PCF_2, respectively.

question_33294.question: What is the implication of using longer SRB payloads in S-DCH?
question_33294.ground_truth: The RNC can allocate more time on the S-DCH for users with high signalling need, such that longer SRB payloads can be delivered in a timely manner.

question_33296.question: How much prediction accuracy can AI/ML achieve for a 160ms prediction time and same Set B pattern with 32 Tx beam in Set A?

question_33297.question: What is the benefit of dividing the network into sub-areas based on statistical properties?
question_33297.ground_truth: The benefit of dividing the network into sub-areas based on statistical properties is that it allows for the improvement of the quality of ML model training and provisioning, as well as the ability for all analytics functions to use information on changes in the area to update their models given the change in analytics context.

question_33298.question: What triggers the mobile station to transfer data in the described procedure?
question_33298.ground_truth: The mobile station is triggered to transfer data after receiving a TBF of dynamic allocation from the System Simulator.

question_33299.question: What is the main difference between a ManagedElement and a ManagementNode?
question_33299.ground_truth: The main difference is that the ManagementNode has a special association to the managed elements that it is responsible for managing.

question_33300.question: What is the termination type value "001" reserved for in the termination ID?

question_33302.question: What is one of the mechanisms behind passive IM generation in cellular networks?
question_33302.ground_truth: Corrosion, oxides (due to aging), dissimilar metals in contact, magnetic or paramagnetic materials in the signal path, sharp edges in connectors, defects in workmanship, low contact pressure and small contact area, debris, pollution, dust at the contact areas, vibration, and temperature variation.

question_33303.question: What does the term "Access Stratum" refer to in the context of 3GPP specifications?
question_33303.ground_truth: A functional grouping consisting of the parts in the infrastructure and user equipment specific to the access technique, and the protocols between these parts.

question_33304.question: What should the mobile station do when it has data to send that does not have the same radio bearer identity as the TBF(s) or TBF request(s) in progress?
question_33304.ground_truth: The mobile station shall request uplink resources through one of the following procedures: if the data belongs to a signalling radio bearer, use the SFACCH and establish an additional TBF; if the data belongs to a user radio bearer, establish an additional TBF.

question_33305.question: What is the function of the Media Session Handler in the Media Player's content access process?
question_33305.ground_truth: The Media Session Handler works in conjunction with the MBS Client to manage how the Media Player uses different content based on the hybrid scenario and different policies.

question_33306.question: What parameters are used to determine if the decoded frame contains more likely speech of generic audio in AMR-WB IO modes?
question_33306.ground_truth: The total frame energy and the statistical deviation of the energy variation history are used to determine if the decoded frame contains more likely speech of generic audio in AMR-WB IO modes.

question_33307.question: What should a UE do when a serving cell change occurs during the DL RSCP and UE Rx-Tx time difference measurement period?
question_33307.ground_truth: The UE shall restart DL RSCP and UE Rx-Tx time difference measurements.

question_33308.question: What is the value of X for UE supporting power class 1 in sub-test 1?
question_33308.ground_truth: The value of X for UE supporting power class 1 in sub-test 1 is 7202.

question_33309.question: What is the Correlation MSISDN (C-MSISDN) used for in an IMS CN subsystem?
question_33309.ground_truth: The C-MSISDN is used for correlation of sessions at access transfer and to route a call from the IM CN subsystem to the same user in the CS domain.

question_33313.question: What does the acronym "MUROS" stand for in the context of telecommunications?
question_33313.ground_truth: The acronym "MUROS" stands for "Multi-carrier Overhead Raising Scheme" in the context of telecommunications.

question_33314.question: What is the minimum number of successful tests required for the test to pass in Test 1 and Test 2?
question_33314.ground_truth: The minimum number of successful tests required for the test to pass in Test 1 and Test 2 is 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_33315.question: What are the key issues regarding regulatory constraints and operator security policies for discreet listening?
question_33315.ground_truth: The key issues include specifying the exact communication transmissions allowed for discreet listening, making unauthorized transmissions unavailable, and addressing potential security concerns related to communications and users outside the scope of discreet listening.

question_33317.question: In what situation would the UE not receive the Attach Accept message from the eNodeB?
question_33317.ground_truth: If the eNodeB received an S1-AP Downlink NAS Transport message (e.g. containing the Attach Accept message), the eNodeB sends a RRC Direct Transfer message to the UE instead of the Attach Accept message.

question_33318.question: What entity determines the number of units in the context of requesting resource usage in the first scenario?
question_33318.ground_truth: The CTF (Charging Trigger Function) determines the number of units based on the service requested by the UE-A.

question_33320.question: Which architecture option is the most flexible, supporting legacy deployments, initial service based and smooth migration from legacy to service based?

question_33323.question: What subtitle media profile should a 5GMSd Client support if it supports the reception of subtitles?
question_33323.ground_truth: The IMSC1.1 text track playback requirements should be supported as defined in clause 4.5.1.5.

question_33325.question: What are some key issues when implementing IP-based wireline access to MC Systems requiring low latency and user/media plane capabilities?
question_33325.ground_truth: Key issues include missing low latency user/media plane support, unbundling control plane and media plane, enabling unbundled management between user/media plane and control plane, developing necessary procedures and flows for unbundling control and media plane, supporting extremely low latency requirements, handling user migration with detached IP capability, and providing unbundled management of user and media planes.

question_33326.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network document "In-band control of remote transcoders and rate adaptors for full rate traffic channels (Release 17) Foreword"?
question_33326.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to specify the use and frame structure of 64 kbit/s and 16 kbit/s traffic channels on the Abis interface for full rate speech, enhanced full rate speech, Adaptive Multi-Rate speech, Adaptive Multi-Rate Wideband speech, and full rate data service. The document also specifies the submultiplexing for Adaptive Multi-Rate speech and Wideband speech.

question_33328.question: What is the condition for a UE to move between the two MBMS bearers (TMGI 1 and TMGI 2) without reporting an area change?
question_33328.ground_truth: The condition is that there is an application level signalling bearer (TMGI 9) activated in the full area (i.e. the area of both TMGI 1 and TMGI 2) broadcasting all floor control messages for all calls ongoing in both areas.

question_33330.question: What is the objective of NRTC5 in the context of 4G and 5G testing?
question_33330.ground_truth: The purpose of NRTC5 is to test multi-band operation aspects, considering higher PSD cases with a reduced number of carriers and non-contiguous operation in multi-band mode.

question_33331.question: What is the measurement provided in 4.39.1 HSPA evolution scheduling related measurements?
question_33331.ground_truth: The measurement provided in 4.39.1 HSPA evolution scheduling related measurements is the number of 64QAM scheduled TTIs in UTRAN cell.

question_33332.question: What should the SS do if a Release 15 5G NR UE connects?
question_33332.ground_truth: For Release 15 5G NR UEs, the SS does not need to take any action.

question_33334.question: What is the term used to describe the power of emissions generated or amplified in a receiver that appear at the BS receiver antenna connector?
question_33334.ground_truth: For a type 1-C BS, this term is known as the spurious emissions power.

question_33335.question: What is the main focus of the NR PSCell addition delay requirements?
question_33335.ground_truth: The NR PSCell addition delay requirements focus on the maximum time allowed for a UE, capable of receiving NR PSCell in E-UTRA-FDD and E-UTRA-TDD dual connectivity, to transmit a PRACH preamble after receiving NR PSCell addition in subframe n.

question_33336.question: What is the pre-condition for ending a media transmission initiated by the transmission control server?
question_33336.ground_truth: The pre-condition for ending a media transmission initiated by the transmission control server is that there is an ongoing media transmission and the transmission control server has a valid reason to terminate it, such as revoking the media transmission for another priority transmission or when there are no receiving participants.

question_33337.question: What is required for the SEALDD client and SEALDD server to both get the whole SEALDD traffic descriptor?
question_33337.ground_truth: After the negotiation and establishment of the connections, the SEALDD client gets the mapping information between application traffic and SEALDD flow ID. The SEALDD server gets the mapping information between the SEALDD flow ID, the signalling transmission Session ID and the SEALDD-S connection.

question_33338.question: What is the definition of spurious response in the context of 3GPP TS 05.05 subclause 5.1?
question_33338.ground_truth: Spurious response is the measure of the ability of a receiver to receive a modulated wanted input signal in the presence of an unwanted input signal, on frequencies other than those of the spurious responses or the adjacent channels.

question_33341.question: What shall the Mobile Station do if the network rejects a location updating with the cause "Location Area not allowed"?
question_33341.ground_truth: The Mobile Station shall not perform periodic updating, not respond to paging with TMSI, reject any request from CM entity for MM connection other than for emergency call, not perform IMSI detach, perform normal location updating when a new location area is entered, accept a request for an emergency call, and delete the list of forbidden LAs after switch off.

question_33342.question: How many times should the fax transmission start a speed of 9,6 kBit/s in Phase D of the facsimile transmission in case of a 4th PPR for the same block?
question_33342.ground_truth: The fax transmission should start a speed of 9,6 kBit/s once in Phase D of the facsimile transmission in case of a 4th PPR for the same block.

question_33343.question: What is the parameter denoted as "PCMAX" used for in the Random Access procedure?
question_33343.ground_truth: PCMAX is used to set the maximum power reduction for the initial Random Access preamble transmission.

question_33344.question: What is the procedure for switching from MBMS streaming to PSS streaming without channel change?
question_33344.ground_truth: In order to switch from MBMS to unicast reception of a stream via PSS, a SIP Re-INVITE is issued by the UE with an SDP offer and Request-URI included. After receiving the 200 OK, the UE leaves the multicast channel and starts playback.

question_33345.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP-NSAPI AVP in the ASR command for Gi/Sgi interface?
question_33345.ground_truth: The 3GPP-NSAPI AVP identifies the PDP Context or EPS bearer that is to be terminated in the ASR command for Gi/Sgi interface.

question_33348.question: What is the use of a SIP RE-INVITE message during the MBMS Download Session initiation in clause 14.2?
question_33348.ground_truth: The SIP RE-INVITE message is used to initiate the file repair session and tear down the MBMS download session by sending a SIP Re-INVITE message to the IM CN subsystem, which is then forwarded to the SCF, and then to the HTTP/SIP adapter which selects a HTTP Server for the file repair service, and sends an HTTP POST message to the HTTP server.

question_33349.question: What should the MCData client do upon receiving the first MSRP SEND request as an "active" endpoint or sending the first MSRP SEND request as a "passive" endpoint in an established MSRP session?
question_33349.ground_truth: Upon receiving or sending the first MSRP SEND request, the MCData client can generate and send an SDS message or a disposition notification for a received SDS message, if requested. It can then handle the received content and disposition requests as specified in the corresponding clauses.

question_33350.question: How is the frame rate deviation calculated?
question_33350.ground_truth: The frame rate deviation is equal to the pre-defined frame rate minus the actual playback frame rate.

question_33352.question: When are autonomous gaps used for identifying a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell?
question_33352.ground_truth: Autonomous gaps are used for measuring with the purpose of 'reportCGI' to identify a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell during autonomous gaps in downlink reception and uplink transmission.

question_33353.question: What should the gNB-CU-UP do if the Data Forwarding to E-UTRAN Information List IE is included in the BEARER CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message?
question_33353.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP should use it for inter-system data forwarding from 5GS to EPS as specified in TS38.300.

question_33354.question: What should the UE do to implicitly indicate a preference for NR SCG release?
question_33354.ground_truth: The UE can implicitly indicate a preference for NR SCG release by reporting the maximum aggregated bandwidth preference for power saving as zero for both FR1 and FR2, and by reporting the maximum number of secondary component carriers for power saving as zero for both uplink and downlink.

question_33357.question: What is one advantage of the Multi-Rate concept in a GSM system?
question_33357.ground_truth: One advantage of the Multi-Rate concept in a GSM system is its ability to adapt to changing radio and traffic conditions, as well as being customizable to the specific needs of network operators. This can lead to improvements in robustness to channel errors, capacity, handover, and power control.

question_33358.question: What is the name of the security protocol used in GBA-Push for key establishment?
question_33358.ground_truth: The name of the security protocol used in GBA-Push for key establishment is GBA Push Layer (GPL).

question_33359.question: Which 3GPP TS specifies the conformance requirements for the test case number 6.2.17.3?

question_33360.question: What does the packet filter description include in the context of user-plane packet forwarding?
question_33360.ground_truth: The packet filter description includes IP filter parameters that describe what traffic is subject to the forwarding, such as IP header parameters, SDF filter, TFT, Application ID, or IP filters matching relevant protocols.

question_33362.question: What is one potential function of SEAL in supporting end-to-end redundant transport for URLLC?
question_33362.ground_truth: SEAL can support the packet/data duplication and elimination between client (UE) and server (Network) for end-to-end redundant transport in URLLC.

question_33363.question: What is the minimum number of NB-IoT carriers that a UE should be capable of monitoring for idle mode cell re-selection purposes?
question_33363.ground_truth: A UE should be capable of monitoring at least one intra-frequency carrier and at least two inter-frequency carriers for idle mode cell re-selection purposes.

question_33365.question: What is the purpose of the P-TMSI Signature sent by the SGSN to the MS in Attach Accept and Routeing Area Update Accept messages, and how is it used in the 3GPP network?
question_33365.ground_truth: The P-TMSI Signature is used for identification checking purposes. If the signature is sent by the SGSN since the current P-TMSI was allocated, the MS shall include the P-TMSI Signature in the next Routeing Area Update Request, Detach Request, and Attach Request for identification checking purposes.

question_33366.question: In what situations should the floor participant interface send a Floor Ack message when it receives a Floor Release message from the floor participant?
question_33366.ground_truth: The floor participant interface should send a Floor Ack message to the floor participant when the first bit in the subtype of the Floor Release message is set to '1' (acknowledgement is required) and it is not waiting for the Floor Ack from the floor control server.

question_33369.question: What is the purpose of the e2mKEYSET in the UMTS AKA and EPS AKA cases?
question_33369.ground_truth: In the UMTS AKA case, e2mKEYSET is derived from a concatenation of CK and IK for air interface security. In the EPS AKA case, e2mKEYSET is derived from CK, IK, and KASME for both air interface and E2E security.

question_33371.question: What information does the PCRF provide to the TDF during the initial interaction, which defines the charging system addresses?
question_33371.ground_truth: The PCRF provides Charging information containing OFCS and/or OCS addresses to the TDF defining the offline and online charging system addresses respectively.

question_33372.question: What is the requirement for broadcast group calls in the present release of the specification?
question_33372.ground_truth: The broadcast group calls functionality in the present release of the specification is not compliant with the requirements for user-broadcast group and group-broadcast group calls as specified in 3GPP~TS~22.179, 3GPP~TS~22.280, and 3GPP~TS~23.379.

question_33373.question: What is the traffic model followed for the latency evaluation of downlink application layer ACKs in subclause 7.1.7.3.3?
question_33373.ground_truth: The traffic model from Annex E.2.2 is followed for the latency evaluation of downlink application layer ACKs in subclause 7.1.7.3.3.

question_33375.question: What is the default value for bit 8 in the message type octet for Release 99 and later networks when using a radio connection?
question_33375.ground_truth: The default value for bit 8 is 0.

question_33376.question: What should a remote UE do to a selected sidelink relay UE within a discovery period?
question_33376.ground_truth: A remote UE should measure the SD-RSRP of the selected relay once in every four discovery periods and evaluate if it meets the relay selection criterion.

question_33377.question: What is the purpose of the MN-HA keys derived from the MN-AAA Key using RFC 3957 in the MIP protocol?
question_33377.ground_truth: The MN-HA keys are derived from the MN-AAA Key using RFC 3957 to be used for the MN's home network authentication and key establishment in the MIP protocol.

question_33378.question: How many uplink bandwidths does the UE support on one carrier of one band entry in a band combination?

question_33380.question: What is the benefit of allowing a network operator to indicate a relative level of preference for unicast and broadcast access networks to a UE (User Equipment)?
question_33380.ground_truth: This allows the UE to make informed decisions about which network to use for different services, potentially improving the user experience.

question_33381.question: What is the length of the START value used for initializing counters in ciphering and integrity protection algorithms?
question_33381.ground_truth: The length of the START value is 20 bits.

question_33382.question: What is the first step in activating the unicast carrier mobile termination?
question_33382.ground_truth: The first step is to activate the UE and the unicast carrier mobile termination.

question_33384.question: What is the role of the initial IAB-donor-CU in the backhaul RLF recovery procedure for an IAB-node in SA mode?
question_33384.ground_truth: The initial IAB-donor-CU may release the BH RLC channels and BAP-sublayer routing entries on the initial path between the initial parent IAB-node and the initial IAB-donor-DU in the backhaul RLF recovery procedure for an IAB-node in SA mode.

question_33385.question: What should be the data type if no request body is allowed?
question_33385.ground_truth: If no request body is allowed, the data type should be marked as "n/a".

question_33386.question: When can the ePDG selection attempt result in unauthenticated emergency attachment?
question_33386.ground_truth: The ePDG selection attempt may result in unauthenticated emergency attachment if it fails to authenticate during the attempt or when the UE is not equipped with a UICC.

question_33387.question: What is the purpose of the timer T104 in the UE-initiated PLR report procedure?
question_33387.ground_truth: The purpose of the timer T104 in UE-initiated PLR report procedure is to set a timeout for receiving the PMFP PLR REPORT RESPONSE message from the UPF. Upon expiration of the timer T104, the UE should abort the UE-initiated PLR measurement procedure.

question_33388.question: What is the maximum time that spans the source and corresponding repair packets in the case of FEC support?
question_33388.ground_truth: The maximum time that spans the source and corresponding repair packets should not be more than 300 ms.

question_33389.question: What information does an IRI-POI/CC-TF examine to verify for a target match when the target identity is IMPI and the SIP INVITE is for an originating IMS session?
question_33389.ground_truth: Digest username of Authorization header of the SIP REGISTER.

question_33390.question: What are the two options available for connecting the shared access and the core networks of the participating operators?
question_33390.ground_truth: The two options are direct connections and indirect connections between the shared access and the core networks of the participating operators.

question_33393.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe UE-to-Network Relay?
question_33393.ground_truth: The ProSe UE-to-Network Relay provides the functionality to support connectivity to the network for Remote UEs. It relays unicast traffic between the Remote UE and the network, and may also relay eMBMS traffic using one-to-many ProSe Direct Communication.

question_33395.question: What is the procedure that the MME follows when it locally deactivates the last remaining PDN connection and EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is not supported by the UE or the MME?
question_33395.ground_truth: The MME initiates a network initiated detach procedure.

question_33396.question: What is the base type of the attribute "value" in the XML schema provided?
question_33396.ground_truth: The base type of the attribute "value" is "MBMS-Session-Identity-Type", which is a restriction of "xs:unsignedByte".

question_33397.question: What is the purpose of dictionaries in the Huffman coding algorithm?
question_33397.ground_truth: Dictionaries, which are essentially a list of key words or phrases of up to 255 characters, can result in very high compression rates when they match long strings in the input stream. These matching characters in the stream are replaced with a reference to the dictionary entry.

question_33398.question: Who is responsible for storing ML models in ADRF?
question_33398.ground_truth: MTLF can store ML models in ADRF based on its policy.

question_33399.question: What does the "2nd digit" in the version number x.y.z of a 3GPP TSG Technical Specification or Technical Report represent?
question_33399.ground_truth: The second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, i.e. technical enhancements, corrections, updates, etc.

question_33400.question: How many TDMA frames does the device need to wait between the last data transmission of a fixed uplink allocation and the reception of the first corresponding DL EC-PACCH block (PUAN) for the + 20 dB GPRS reference case?

question_33402.question: In which bands can the 3rd order IMD products caused by 3 DL CA of Band (2 + 2 + 5) fall into that are intended for use in the same geographical area?
question_33402.ground_truth: The 3rd order IMD products may fall into the BS receive band of Bands 5 and 26.

question_33405.question: What is the procedure when the UE is switched off or the USIM is removed, and the UE has stored a Local emergency numbers list?
question_33405.ground_truth: The UE must delete the stored Local emergency numbers list in the user equipment when the UE is switched off or the USIM is removed.

question_33406.question: What is the function of the CLF (Connectivity Session Location and Repository Function) in the IMS emergency services?
question_33406.ground_truth: The CLF registers the association between the IP address allocated to the UE and related network location information, such as access transport equipment characteristics, line identifier, and IP Edge identity.

question_33407.question: What is the purpose of sending a URA UPDATE CONFIRM message in step 7?
question_33407.ground_truth: The purpose of sending a URA UPDATE CONFIRM message in step 7 is to acknowledge the successful transmission of the URA UPDATE message and to continue the procedure with step 10.

question_33408.question: What must the UE include in the Contact header field of the SIP REFER request, if it wishes to be the controller UE for the collaborative session?
question_33408.ground_truth: The UE must include the g.3gpp.iut-controller media feature tag in the Contact header field of the SIP REFER request, to indicate that it wishes to be the controller UE for the collaborative session.

question_33409.question: What action should the participating MCPTT function take when the SIP re-INVITE request is not received from the controlling MCPTT function?
question_33409.ground_truth: If the SIP re-INVITE request is not received from the controlling MCPTT function, the participating MCPTT function should stop timer T55 (Connect), send a Disconnect message to the MCPTT client, start timer T56 (Disconnect), initialize counter C56 (Disconnect) to 1, and enter the 'G: Call releasing' state.

question_33412.question: How does a 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay announce additional parameters to a 5G ProSe Remote UE?
question_33412.ground_truth: A 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay announces additional parameters to a 5G ProSe Remote UE by sending a Relay Discovery Additional Information message periodically until there is no UE requesting to announce the additional parameters.

question_33414.question: How many user plane tunnels can exist in the UE and the UPF after the N4 Session modification?
question_33414.ground_truth: There can be three user plane tunnels in the UE and the UPF after the N4 Session modification.

question_33415.question: What is the requirement for RS-SINR measurements in event-triggered measurement reports in the context of R-E-UTRAN FDD?
question_33415.ground_truth: The RS-SINR measurements contained in event-triggered measurement reports for R-E-UTRAN FDD shall meet the requirements in TS 38.133 clause 10.2.5.

question_33416.question: What is indicated by 3GPP TS 23.228 that needs to be enhanced related to IBCF within the I-CSF and the S-CSCF for the use of the PS-UDF and Cx inter-domain?
question_33416.ground_truth: The need for an indication that an IBCF, which is an enhanced version of Gm (Gm*), can be between the I-CSF and the S-CSCF for the use of PS-UDF and Cx inter-domain.

question_33417.question: What should a UE include in the initial emergency registration request?
question_33417.ground_truth: When a UE performs an initial emergency registration, it includes a "sop" SIP URI parameter in the Contact header field and populates the From and To header fields with the appropriate public user identity. Additionally, the UE handles the emergency registration independently from any other ongoing registration to the IM CN subsystem.

question_33418.question: What are the measurement bandwidths considered when assessing EIRP for a BS?
question_33418.ground_truth: EIRP for a BS is assessed using the measurement bandwidths and the BS antenna gain minus feeder loss. This helps verify compliance with regional requirements, which typically use EIRP, a measure of effective isotropic radiated power.

question_33422.question: In what circumstances should the ME use Early IMS security solution during IMS registration when the ME supports only early IMS security and the IMS network supports fully compliant IMS security?
question_33422.ground_truth: The ME should use Early IMS security solution during IMS registration if both the ME and the IMS network support early IMS security (case 1) or if the ME supports early IMS security and the IMS network supports both early and fully compliant IMS security (case 2).

question_33423.question: Which ETSI document defines energy efficiency metrics and measurement methods for NFV components including VNFs and NFVI?

question_33424.question: What action should the IWF performing the controlling role take if the in-progress emergency group state of the group is set to "false" and the in-progress imminent peril state of the group is set to "true" in an SIP UPDATE request?
question_33424.ground_truth: If the in-progress emergency group state of the group is set to "false" and the in-progress imminent peril state of the group is set to "true", the IWF performing the controlling role shall include a Resource-Priority header field populated with the values for an MCPTT imminent peril group call in the SIP UPDATE request.

question_33426.question: What is the definition of the composite spurious emission requirement for intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation transmission?
question_33426.ground_truth: The composite spurious emission requirement for intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation transmission is a combination of individual sub-block spurious emission requirements that apply to frequency ranges that are more than FOOB away from the edges of each carrier in the gap and out of the gap.

question_33428.question: What is the approach to handle delay jitter for real-time services over IMS?
question_33428.ground_truth: A common solution to handle delay jitter is by introducing a jitter buffer that is designed to handle the variation in packet receiver timing. However, the mere presence of the buffer implicates that the service latency will be increased.

question_33429.question: What is the purpose of the test as outlined in 9.1.53.2?
question_33429.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the RSRP measurement accuracy is within the specified limits, specifically for HD-FDD RSRP measurements for BL/CE UE in CEModeA.

question_33430.question: What shall the UE do upon receipt of the PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message, if it had provided a DNN and an S-NSSAI during the PDU session establishment and timer T3584 is currently running?
question_33430.ground_truth: The UE shall stop both timer T3396 and timer T3584.

question_33431.question: What is the purpose of the RRC-based BWP switch delay on a single CC?
