question_34099.question: When is the MCData server authorized to form a new ad-hoc group when an authorized user initiates an ad-hoc group data communication?
question_34099.ground_truth: If the MCData server of the primary MC system determines that the user at the MCData client is authorized to initiate an ad-hoc group communication and there is no pre-existing ad-hoc group ID, it forms a new ad-hoc group and assigns an MCData ad-hoc group ID for the newly formed ad-hoc group.

question_34100.question: What organization is responsible for the 3GPP Technical Specification Group services and system aspects related to transferring of emergency call data (Release 17)?
question_34100.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group services and system aspects is responsible for the 3GPP Technical Specification Group services and system aspects related to transferring of emergency call data (Release 17).

question_34101.question: What is the ETSI ZSM framework reference architecture's role in enabling zero-touch automated network and service management in a multivendor environment?
question_34101.ground_truth: The ETSI ZSM framework reference architecture provides the ZSM framework reference architecture, which includes distributed management and data services, organized into management domains, integrated via an integration fabric, and allows data sharing across domains. It also provides ZSM service capabilities and cross-domain integration fabric to facilitate providing capabilities and accessing endpoints cross-domain.

question_34102.question: What should a GTP-C entity set as the cause when rejecting a message due to overload?
question_34102.ground_truth: A GTP-C entity should set the cause to "GTP-C Entity Congestion" or "APN congestion" when rejecting a message due to overload.

question_34104.question: What message does the SCS/AS send to the SCEF if it has downlink non-IP data to send to a UE?
question_34104.ground_truth: The SCS/AS sends a MT NIDD Submit Request message to the SCEF.

question_34105.question: What is the mechanism for steering application traffic to a local UPF-PSA in this solution?
question_34105.ground_truth: Session breakout (model 2) requires installing AF influenced routes in UPF-ULCL to steer application traffic to a local UPF-PSA.

question_34106.question: What condition should be added to the network to prevent certain situations when reducing the multislot class?
question_34106.ground_truth: An appropriate network test should be added to 3GPP TS 51.021.

question_34107.question: What function does the PDP context provide in PoC communication?
question_34107.ground_truth: The PDP context provides the bearer for IMS signalling and media transfer in PoC communication.

question_34108.question: What happens if the XML schema of a supplementary service does not accept URIs that could be expressed as a relative URI reference causing a resolution problem?
question_34108.ground_truth: If the XML schema does not accept URIs that could be expressed as a relative URI reference causing a resolution problem, then each of the supplementary services should consider if relative URIs are allowed in the subdocument tree and indicate how to resolve relative URI references. In the absence of further indications, relative URI references should be resolved using the document URI as the base of the relative URI reference.

question_34109.question: What is the initial condition for the mobile station in subclause 26.9.6.2.1.3?
question_34109.ground_truth: The MS is in MM-state "idle, no IMSI", no SIM inserted.

question_34110.question: What is the document part 8 of in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project Technical Specification Group Core Network?
question_34110.ground_truth: The Data Session Control Service Capability Feature (SCF)

question_34111.question: What can the MSGin5G server share with the Application Server if it cannot verify the latter during registration?
question_34111.ground_truth: Sensitive information such as 5GMSGS Client ID, APIs

question_34114.question: What is the scalability support required for the evaluation of E-UTRA procedures for group communication?
question_34114.ground_truth: The scalability support required for the evaluation of E-UTRA procedures for group communication is the ability to support a large number of receiver group members in any area and the future extension flexibility of the number of group communications supported in parallel.

question_34115.question: What is the performance impact of semi-static SBFD on the SBFD operator for UL and DL in all load levels?
question_34115.ground_truth: For the SBFD operator, semi-static SBFD provides performance improvement for UL but suffers from degradation for DL for all load levels.

question_34116.question: What method is used to set the requested values for QoS parameters in the temporary template interface?

question_34117.question: How does the UE determine the Tracking/Location Area Identifier FQDN when attempting to select a non-3GPP access node for an IMS service?
question_34117.ground_truth: The UE uses the Tracking Area wherein it is located and constructs an ePDG or N3IWF TAI FQDN based on the 5GS TAI if it is registered to the 5GS, or based on the EPS TAI if it is registered to EPS.

question_34119.question: What should the initiating UE do after creating the DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION REQUEST message in the PC5 unicast link modification procedure?
question_34119.ground_truth: The initiating UE shall pass this message to the lower layers for transmission along with the initiating UE's layer-2 ID for unicast communication and the target UE's layer-2 ID for unicast communication, and start timer T5001.

question_34121.question: What information does the RAN receive from the Core Network to apply a specific QoS profile for a PDU Session?
question_34121.ground_truth: The RAN receives QoS profiles using NG-C PDU Session control signalling to apply a specific QoS profile for a PDU Session.

question_34122.question: What is the guideline for the sender when changing the Load Metric parameter?
question_34122.ground_truth: The sender should refrain from advertising every small variation in the Load Metric which does not result in useful improvement in node selection logic at the receiver. Instead, a larger variation, e.g. 5 or more units, should be considered as reasonable enough for advertising the new Load Control Information.

question_34123.question: What action does the MME take when it receives a PDN DISCONNECT REJECT message with ESM cause #49 and EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is not supported by the UE or the MME?
question_34123.ground_truth: The MME releases all the resources reserved for the PDN in the network.

question_34127.question: What information does the SI field in AMD PDU indicate in the RLC acknowledged mode?
question_34127.ground_truth: The SI field indicates whether an RLC PDU contains a complete RLC SDU or the first, middle, last segment of an RLC SDU.

question_34128.question: What should the P-CSCF include in the P-Access-Network-Info header field if the IP-CAN-Type value provided by the PCRF is "DVB-RCS2"?
question_34128.ground_truth: If the IP-CAN-Type value provided by the PCRF is "DVB-RCS2", then the P-CSCF shall include a "network-provided" parameter, set the access-type field to "DVB-RCS2", and set the "dvb-rcs2-node-id" parameter with the value provided by the IP-CAN provider.

question_34131.question: What is the purpose of privacy timer value in the policy/parameters related to privacy?
question_34131.ground_truth: The privacy timer value is used to indicate the duration after which the UE shall change each source Layer-2 ID self-assigned by the UE when privacy is required.

question_34132.question: What is User-to-User Information (UUI) in the context of 3GPP technical specification?
question_34132.ground_truth: User-to-User Information (UUI) in the context of 3GPP technical specification is the information transferred by using the UUS supplementary service.

question_34133.question: What is the purpose of the access token request in the service request process?
question_34133.ground_truth: The access token request is the first step in the service request process, where the NF Service Consumer sends a request for an access token to the NRF in the consumer PLMN.

question_34134.question: What should the ACM server do if the functional alias is active for more than one ACM client in the partner MC system?
question_34134.ground_truth: The ACM server sends the request to one of the ACM clients based on the local policy.

question_34135.question: What information must be included in the AF request to let the NEF determine the common DNAI?
question_34135.ground_truth: A list of candidate DNAI(s) and/or EAS IP address must be included in the AF request to let the NEF determine the common DNAI.

question_34136.question: What is the implication of the one-shot large UL timing adjustment for FR2 power class 6 UE?
question_34136.ground_truth: The UE transmit timing immediately after TCI state switch shall meet the requirements of clause 7.1.2.1, with certain exceptions for the first UL transmission after a TCI state switch.

question_34137.question: What happens if the mobile station supports the enhanced network-initiated in-call modification procedure?
question_34137.ground_truth: The mobile station shall indicate this in the Call Control Capabilities IE in the SETUP message.

question_34138.question: What is the purpose of the "SI/PSI Container" information element and what does it contain?
question_34138.ground_truth: The "SI/PSI Container" information element provides the (Packet) System Information messages of the GSM target cell that are required by the mobile station for PS Handover. It contains the subset of System Information message instances encoded for BCCH or PBCCH as specified in 3GPP TS 44.018 and 3GPP TS 44.060.

question_34139.question: What steps must the media storage client follow to upload a file to media storage function for one-to-one file distribution?
question_34139.ground_truth: The media storage client must generate an HTTP POST request, set the Request-URI to the absolute URI identifying the resource on a media storage function, set the Host header field to a hostname identifying the media storage function, set the Content-Type header field to multipart/mixed with a boundary delimiter, insert an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body with required elements and send the HTTP POST request towards the media storage function.

question_34141.question: What is the impact of solution 14 on existing nodes?
question_34141.ground_truth: Solution 14 requires changes in existing nodes such as enabling the eNB to support a new optimized Service Request procedure, the MME to store UE's NH/NCC related context during idle mode, and the UE to store NH/NCC related parameters and update/re-use them for AS security for the next service request.

question_34143.question: What is the purpose of test 41.3.1.4 in 3GPP TS 04.60?
question_34143.ground_truth: The purpose of test 41.3.1.4 in 3GPP TS 04.60 is to verify that the MS, while in DTM, can successfully remove an uplink TBF and return to dedicated mode.

question_34146.question: What is the procedure for ad-hoc group call setup initiated by an authorized user wherein a list of participants is provided by the authorised user and the determined MCPTT users are from multiple MCPTT systems?
question_34146.ground_truth: The MCPTT server of the primary MC system is where the authorized MCPTT user/dispatcher controls the ad-hoc group, the MCPTT server of the primary MC system routes the ad-hoc group call to the MCPTT clients of the invited users based on the ad-hoc group ID provided, and the receiving MCPTT clients notify their corresponding MCPTT users about the incoming ad-hoc group call request.

question_34149.question: What is the difference between the GSM 7 bit default alphabet and 8-bit data in the document?
question_34149.ground_truth: The GSM 7 bit default alphabet in the document indicates that the TP-UD is coded from the GSM 7 bit default alphabet given in the clause. This character set allows for up to 160 characters in a message. On the other hand, 8-bit data indicates that the TP-UD has user-defined coding and allows for up to 140 octets in a message.

question_34152.question: When should the deprecating procedure be used for UML defined model elements?
question_34152.ground_truth: The deprecating procedure should be used between releases and not during the development of a single release, as long as the release is not yet frozen.

question_34154.question: What information does the policy information sent from PCF to SMF include?
question_34154.ground_truth: The policy information includes detection template for PDU Set importance/dependency and different QoS parameters for different PDU Sets, and optional dependency related instructions.

question_34155.question: What is the difference between the general part and the specific band combination part within the document?
question_34155.ground_truth: The general part covers BS and UE specific aspects that are band combination independent, while the specific band combination part covers each band combination and its specific issues independently from each other.

question_34156.question: What should an MS do if two or more packet filters with identical packet filter identifiers are contained in a new request?
question_34156.ground_truth: The MS should reject the modification request with cause "syntactical errors in packet filter(s)".

question_34157.question: What is the purpose of the localized service agreements in the Monster theme park?
question_34157.ground_truth: The localized service agreements allow for automatic establishment of temporary relationships among network operators and service providers for a specific occasion (time and location). These agreements enable seamless service continuity for users even with spotty network coverage.

question_34158.question: What is one of the potential reasons for an operator to control the use of a network slice?
question_34158.ground_truth: The operator may experience congestion in a network slice and would like to control the use of the slice to alleviate the congestion.

question_34159.question: What are the security requirements for the signalling messages between the BM-SC and the GCS AS?
question_34159.ground_truth: The signalling messages between the BM-SC and the GCS AS shall be integrity, confidentiality, and replay protected and the BM-SC and the GCS AS shall be able to mutually authenticate each other.

question_34160.question: What is the purpose of the network domain security feature group?
question_34160.ground_truth: The network domain security feature group includes the set of security features that secure communication between SeGW and CN, protecting against threats to network domain security.

question_34161.question: What is the time period that the IVS uses to detect the call as connected until it detects the first HLACK message, called IVS-PUSH-RTT?
question_34161.ground_truth: The time period that the IVS uses to detect the call as connected until it detects the first HLACK message, called IVS-PUSH-RTT, can assess the complete round-trip time (RTT) of the PSAP in PUSH mode from the IVS perspective.

question_34165.question: In which subclause is the determination of the EC-PICH block for EC-GSM-IoT described?

question_34167.question: What steps does the NSCE server take to retrieve the performance data and analytics data of a network slice from 5GS and OAM system?
question_34167.ground_truth: The NSCE server retrieves the performance data and analytics data of network slice from 5GS by utilizing the APIs defined in TS 23.288 and TS 28.532 for OAM system. The server can also retrieve the network slice status, analytics data, and network slice instance related performance data defined in TS 23.502, TS 23.288, and TS 28.552.

question_34168.question: What is the main CN behavior in the CN-based edge relocation solution?
question_34168.ground_truth: The main CN behavior is to perform application server IP address replacement at edge application server relocation for both UL and DL traffic.

question_34169.question: Which information element is used to transport an SM message within an 5GMM message?
question_34169.ground_truth: The SM message container information element, which is a type 6 information element with a minimum length of 4 octets and a maximum length of 65538 octets, is used to transport an SM message within an 5GMM message.

question_34170.question: What is the procedure for steering of UE in VPLMN after registration not accepted by the UE?
question_34170.ground_truth: If the security check of the received list of preferred PLMN/access technology combinations fails, the UE should send a failure acknowledgement, discard the received list and attempt to obtain service on a higher priority PLMN with the current PLMN considered as the lowest priority. If the UE is in the 5GMM-CONNECTED mode or 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication, the UE may locally release the established N1 NAS signalling connection so as not to delay PLMN selection.

question_34171.question: What are some impacts on mobility when introducing time-dilated UMTS carriers?
question_34171.ground_truth: Some impacts on mobility include distinguishing time-dilated carriers from normal carriers, providing additional information for inter-frequency and inter-RAT procedures, signaling impacts on UE capability, and potential extension of the RRC Connection Request message size.

question_34172.question: What is the value of the constant MAX(a,b)?
question_34172.ground_truth: The larger of a and b

question_34175.question: What is the purpose of the AI/ML abstract performance in the inference phase?
question_34175.ground_truth: The AI/ML abstract performance provides a report of the qualified abstract performance for the AI/ML inference MnS consumer, which can be easily interpreted.

question_34177.question: What should the AMF do with the Enhanced Coverage Restriction information stored in its UE context?
question_34177.ground_truth: The AMF should transfer the Enhanced Coverage Restriction information stored as part of its UE context during AMF change.

question_34178.question: What is the size of the NAS COUNT represented in internal form, and how is it constructed?
question_34178.ground_truth: The NAS COUNT is represented as a 24-bit entity constructed with 8 least significant bits for the NAS sequence number and 16 most significant bits for the NAS overflow counter, resulting in 8+16=24 bits

question_34179.question: What is the maximum mother code size of Polar code used in NR downlink control information?
question_34179.ground_truth: The maximum mother code size of Polar code used in NR downlink control information is 512.

question_34180.question: What is the purpose of the "unavailability period" feature in this solution?
question_34180.ground_truth: The "unavailability period" feature allows the UE to become unavailable for a certain duration, during which the 5GC maintains its context in CM-IDLE and considers the UE unreachable. This is used to address Key issue #1, which is related to the unavailability of the UE.

question_34182.question: What is the purpose of the MPM timer in the 3GPP TS 44.064 standard?
question_34182.ground_truth: The MPM timer is used to prohibit the SGSN from attempting to deliver downlink data to the target MS or page that MS while the timer continues to run in the 3GPP TS 44.064 standard.

question_34183.question: What is the purpose of the Down Link Data Triggered Attach (DLDTA) feature for MME, S4-SGSN, and SGW?
question_34183.ground_truth: The DLDTA enables UEs to make the re-attach to the EPS possible triggered by an arrival of the downlink packet after the MME has restarted.

question_34184.question: What is the difference between the GSM 900 and E-GSM 900 frequency bands for mobile transmit and base receive?
question_34184.ground_truth: For GSM 900, mobile transmit and base receive is 890 MHz to 915 MHz and 935 MHz to 960 MHz, while for E-GSM 900, mobile transmit and base receive is 880 MHz to 915 MHz and 925 MHz to 960 MHz.

question_34186.question: What is the expected sequence for the test of 41.3.2.3 in 3GPP TS 04.60?
question_34186.ground_truth: The expected sequence for the test of 41.3.2.3 in 3GPP TS 04.60 is to repeat the test sequence for k = 1,2.

question_34187.question: Which information element defines SL-ResourcePool?
question_34187.ground_truth: The information element defining SL-ResourcePool is 5.5.

question_34188.question: What is the KPI for communication latency for data packets no larger than 400 bytes in the 3GPP system, as specified in PR.5.5-001?
question_34188.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall support communication latency for data packets 300-400 bytes no larger than 25 ms.

question_34189.question: What is the formula for Kgap in inter-frequency measurements with measurement gaps for UE supporting concurrentMeasGap-r17?
question_34189.ground_truth: Kgap = Ntotal / Navailable, where Navailable is the number of SMTC occasions covered by instances of the non-dropped associated measurement gap within the window W after accounting for collisions, and Ntotal is the total number of SMTC occasions covered by instances of the associated measurement gap within the window W.

question_34190.question: What are the two main types of changes that can result in a new version release of the present document?
question_34190.ground_truth: The two main types of changes are changes of substance, such as technical enhancements, corrections, and updates, and editorial changes, such as formatting or language improvements.

question_34192.question: What must the SMF handle if a PDU session has more than one QoS rule during inter-RAT idle mobility to NB-IoT?
question_34192.ground_truth: The SMF shall initiate a PDU session modification procedure to remove any non-default QoS rules and maintain only the default QoS rule.

question_34193.question: What is the purpose of the Privacy header field and the P-Asserted-Identity header fields in the context of ACR service?
question_34193.ground_truth: The Privacy header field and the P-Asserted-Identity header fields are used to trigger the ACR service.

question_34194.question: What is the size of the resource block assignment field in the DCI format 0B?
question_34194.ground_truth: The resource block assignment field in the DCI format 0B is 5 or 6 bits.

question_34195.question: In the context of the present document, what does "shall" mean?
question_34195.ground_truth: Indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

question_34196.question: How do the UEs of the scientific expedition team upload data during the activities in LocArea?
question_34196.ground_truth: During the activities in LocArea, all UEs register to TerrA's 5G network through SatA's satellite access network and upload data to LocDC with the optimal route in time.

question_34198.question: What is the purpose of the Core Network part (i.e. NAS Container for PS HO) in the handover procedure?
question_34198.ground_truth: The Core Network part (i.e. NAS Container for PS HO) consists of the parameters needed for the handover, such as an XID Command indicating Reset or 'Reset to old XID parameters' and the new IOV-UI for the target cell, and the GPRS ciphering algorithm to be used in the target cell.

question_34199.question: What is the purpose of the "dmrs-DownlinkForPDSCH-MappingTypeB-DCI-1-2" parameter in the context of antenna port bitwidth derivation?
question_34199.ground_truth: The "dmrs-DownlinkForPDSCH-MappingTypeB-DCI-1-2" parameter is used to derive the "Antenna ports" bitwidth for the DownlinkForPDSCH-MappingTypeA-DCI-1-2 in case the mapping type of the PDSCH corresponds to a smaller value.

question_34201.question: When should a network consider the old P-TMSI and old RAI as invalid upon receipt of a GMM message containing a new P-TMSI in Iu mode?
question_34201.ground_truth: The network should consider the old P-TMSI and old RAI as invalid as soon as an acknowledge message (e.g. ATTACH COMPLETE, ROUTING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE and P-TMSI REALLOCATION COMPLETE) is received.

question_34202.question: What is the frequency band for the uplink of UE in the FDD scheme?
question_34202.ground_truth: The frequency band for the uplink of UE in the FDD scheme is 1980 - 2010 MHz.

question_34203.question: What should the UE do with the back-off timer value if it is not received from the 5GMM sublayer or the IE is not included in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message?
question_34203.ground_truth: The UE may send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message or PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message for the same S-NSSAI or without an S-NSSAI.

question_34205.question: What should be the reaction time for a mobile station to enter or exit DTR mode?
question_34205.ground_truth: The reaction time for a mobile station to enter or exit DTR mode is specified in 3GPP TS 45.010.

question_34206.question: What is the value of m used in the formula for calculating the SLR and RLR in 8.2.3, 8.2.4, 8.2.4.1, and 8.2.4.2?
question_34206.ground_truth: The value of m used in the formula for calculating the SLR and RLR in 8.2.3, 8.2.4, 8.2.4.1, and 8.2.4.2 is 0.175.

question_34207.question: What procedure is performed to release bearer context in the gNB-CU-UP initiated by the gNB-CU-CP?
question_34207.ground_truth: The procedure consists of three steps, where the gNB-CU-CP sends a BEARER CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message, the gNB-CU-UP responds with a BEARER CONTEXT MODIFICATION RESPONSE carrying the PDCP UL/DL status, and the F1 UE context modification procedure is performed to stop the data transmission for the UE.

question_34208.question: What will happen if the network does not receive the ROUTING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message from a GPRS MS after sending the ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message?
question_34208.ground_truth: The network shall send the ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message again and restart the timer T3350 if an ROUTING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message is expected. In that case, the retransmission counter related to T3350 is not incremented. If the ROUTING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message is not received until the T3350 expires for four times, the routing area updating procedure is aborted.

question_34211.question: What is the responsibility of the SEAF in a split DU-CU implementation?
question_34211.ground_truth: The SEAF provides the authentication functionality via the AMF in the serving network for a split DU-CU implementation.

question_34212.question: What is the internal sampling rate of the ACELP core when it is selected for WB, SWB or FB signals at bitrates higher than 13.2 kbps?

question_34214.question: What should be the value of the "Method" field in a Transmission control Ack message?
question_34214.ground_truth: The value of the "Method" field in a Transmission control Ack message is '1' (Transmission end response).

question_34216.question: What steps must be taken by the user before initiating the announce request procedure?
question_34216.ground_truth: Before initiating the announce request procedure, the user sets the permissions for the restricted discovery using application layer mechanisms, retrieves the PDUID provisioned to the UE as part of the service authorization procedure, and obtains an RPAUID associated with the UE's PDUID from the ProSe application server.

question_34217.question: What should be delivered by the MAC entity when transmission using PUR is initiated?
question_34217.ground_truth: The MAC entity should deliver the uplink grant, and the associated HARQ information to the HARQ entity for each TTI for which RRC layer has provided uplink grant for transmission using PUR.

question_34218.question: What are the "open interfaces" for full vendor interoperability?
question_34218.ground_truth: The "open interfaces" for full vendor interoperability are the interfaces that allow implementation of H(e)NBs and NEs independently, based on specification only.

question_34219.question: What course of action would the SMF take when it receives a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message during an ongoing network-requested PDU session modification procedure and the PDU session indicated in the message is the same one being modified?
question_34219.ground_truth: The SMF would ignore the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message and proceed with the network-requested PDU session modification procedure as if no message was received from the UE.

question_34220.question: What is the expected response from the repair server when the version identifier associated with the requested byte range does not match the file version at the byte-range repair server?
question_34220.ground_truth: The server will reply with a 412 "Precondition Failed" reply.

question_34221.question: What is the conformance requirement for the BFI performance on a full rate speech TCH (TCH/AFS) with a random RF input?
question_34221.ground_truth: On average, less than one undetected bad speech frame (false bad frame indication) in 60 seconds, meaning a rate of 0.0333%, is allowed.

question_34222.question: What is the maximum bandwidth that can be used for the media encoding in the A->B direction in Use case B?
question_34222.ground_truth: The maximum bandwidth that can be used for the media encoding in the A->B direction in Use case B is 32 kbps.

question_34223.question: What is the role of the SEAL/NSCE in terms of fault management?
question_34223.ground_truth: The SEAL/NSCE detects whether a fault is caused by the 5GS network and exposes the fault report to the third-party. It may also inform the management functions about the location of the fault for clearing it.

question_34224.question: Which BS transmit bands may create IMD issues when transmitting on Band 5 and Band 46?
question_34224.ground_truth: Bands 6, 8, 26, 28, 42, 43, and 44 may create IMD issues when transmitting on Bands 5 and 46.

question_34225.question: What should the IM-SSF do when it encounters an exception condition during handling of a terminating call?
question_34225.ground_truth: The IM-SSF should release any resources made available for setting up the SIP call session and send an error information flow to the gsmSCF, indicating that any outstanding call handling instructions will not run to completion, if a relationship exists between the IM-SSF and the gsmSCF.

question_34228.question: What is the maximum bandwidth that can be reserved for DCI combination 2 in 7.3.3.2?
question_34228.ground_truth: Four physical resource blocks are reserved for 10 MHz, 15 MHz, or 20 MHz bandwidth for DCI combination 2 in 7.3.3.2.

question_34229.question: Which SSC mode is not mandatory for UEs to support, and can lead to non-functionality of certain features?
question_34229.ground_truth: SSC mode 2 is not mandatory for UEs to support, and can lead to non-functionality of certain features.

question_34232.question: What process is performed on the bits input to the code block segmentation after code block segmentation?
question_34232.ground_truth: The bits input to the code block segmentation are denoted by where B is the number of bits in the transport block (including CRC), and the bits after code block segmentation are denoted by where r is the code block number and Kr is the number of bits for code block number r.

question_34233.question: What procedure is defined in clause 6.8.1.2 that applies to both S8-S2a and S8-S2b chaining for multiple PDN connections to a single APN?
question_34233.ground_truth: The UE-initiated Connectivity to Additional PDN

question_34234.question: In the context of 5GC SBI service APIs, what are the conventions for resource structure?
question_34234.ground_truth: The resource structure shall define the structure of the resource URIs, the resources, the associated HTTP methods and custom operations used for the service.

question_34236.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement defined in clause 16.1.1.8.3 for NR RedCap UE with 2Rx from release 17 and forward?
question_34236.ground_truth: NR RedCap UE supporting Rel.17 stationary idle mode relaxed measurement criterion.

question_34238.question: What action must the AMF take if slices are temporarily allowed for SSC3 type of behavior?
question_34238.ground_truth: The AMF must temporarily include the slices in the Allowed NSSAI towards the UE, and may include a back-off timer for the original slice and/or include the original slice in the Rejected NSSAI to prevent the UE from requesting the slice.

question_34239.question: What internal UE behavior is the focus of the test requirements in 8.6.3.1.1, considering the combined FDD and TDD UE for Release 99 and Release 4?
question_34239.ground_truth: The correct reporting of TDD neighbors in AWGN (Additive White Gaussian Noise) propagation conditions in the context of event triggered reporting periods in the UE.

question_34240.question: What is the required Content-Type header field for the HTTP 200(OK) response?

question_34241.question: What is an Alternative Service Requirement that an AF can provide when requesting QoS services?
question_34241.ground_truth: Alternative Service Requirements include a requested 5GS Delay, a requested Guaranteed Flow Bitrate, a requested Packet Error Rate, and an optional Maximum Burst Size parameter.

question_34242.question: What is the role of the EEC in the procedure described in section 7.46.2.2.2?
question_34242.ground_truth: The EEC can be responsible to make decisions on ACR scenarios selection for EAS bundles.

question_34245.question: What is the recommended approach to initial buffering delay in media playback to minimize delay while accounting for network conditions?
question_34245.ground_truth: The client may choose an initial buffering that is less than the required buffering, but it must ensure that it is safe to begin playback prior to fulfilling its target time in order to prevent rebuffering.

question_34247.question: What is the criterion used to replace the overall minimum in the minimum tracking algorithm with a local minimum among the current sub-window, and what are the conditions for such replacement to occur?
question_34247.ground_truth: The condition for replacing the overall minimum in the minimum tracking algorithm with a local minimum among the current sub-window is that it yields only a moderate increase of compared to the current overall minimum, and if the local minimum was not found in the first or last frame of the sub-window. The search range for the local minima lies between 1.1 and 2, and increases as decreases.

question_34248.question: What are the two types of location information reporting that an application can request?
question_34248.ground_truth: The two types of location information reporting are a single report and periodic reports.

question_34249.question: What action does the MME take if it temporarily rejects a Downlink Data Notification message due to stored Paging Restriction Information for the UE?
question_34249.ground_truth: The MME sends a Downlink Data Notification Ack message with an indication that the Downlink Data Notification message has been temporarily rejected.

question_34250.question: In what scenarios can the number of active EPS bearer contexts in the UE not be equal to the maximum number of EPS bearer contexts reached in the network when attempting to establish multiple EPS bearer contexts?
question_34250.ground_truth: In some situations, when attempting to establish multiple EPS bearer contexts, the number of active EPS bearer contexts in the UE when cause #65 is received is not equal to the maximum number of EPS bearer contexts reached in the network.

question_34252.question: What must the P-CSCF do when it receives a 200 (OK) response to a REGISTER request?
question_34252.ground_truth: When the P-CSCF receives a 200 (OK) response to a REGISTER request, it must save the list of service route values in the Service-Route header fields preserving the order, and bind the list either to the contact address or to the registration flow and the associated contact address; it must also associate the list of service route values with the registered public user identity and either the associated contact address or the registration flow and the associated contact address, and store the public user identities, found in the P-Associated-URI header field value, including any associated display names, and any parameters associated with either the user or the identities of the user, and associate them to the registered public user identity.

question_34253.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's study on non-MTC mobile data applications?
question_34253.ground_truth: The study aims to investigate the service scenario/use cases of different mobile data applications and their impact on the current system. It also identifies potential service and operational requirements for possible enhancements to the system.

question_34256.question: What action does the participating MCVideo function perform when generating an SDP offer for on-demand session 1?
question_34256.ground_truth: When generating an SDP offer for on-demand session 1, the participating MCVideo function creates an SDP offer that contains two SDP media-level sections for MCVideo video media and an SDP media-level section for one media-transmission control entity, if present in the received SDP offer. The IP address and port number for the offered media stream and for the offered media transmission control entity, if present, are replaced with the IP address and port number of the participating MCVideo function.

question_34257.question: What is the maximum size of the "EPS quality of service" information element when the value of X is equal to 14 in the context of the bearer parameters for E-UTRAN / Satellite E-UTRAN / NG-RAN / Satellite NG-RAN?
question_34257.ground_truth: The maximum size of the "EPS quality of service" information element is 3 bytes + Bit X+2 when the value of X is equal to 14 in the context of the bearer parameters for E-UTRAN / Satellite E-UTRAN / NG-RAN / Satellite NG-RAN.

question_34258.question: What sources are used for collecting location data in the location accuracy analytics solution?
question_34258.ground_truth: The location data is collected from three sources - NWDAF, SEAL LMS, and A-ADRF. NWDAF provides UE mobility analytics, SEAL LMS provides UE location reports and achieved accuracy, and A-ADRF provides historical location accuracy statistics.

question_34259.question: When should the URIs in the P-Associated-URI header field be removed by the P-CSCF?
question_34259.ground_truth: The URIs in the P-Associated-URI header field might need to be removed when the UE performs the functions of an external attached network, such as an enterprise network.

question_34260.question: What network architecture is Segment Routing based on?
question_34260.ground_truth: Segment Routing is based on source-routing.

question_34261.question: What are the two methods the MRFP can choose from when it becomes unavailable due to a failure?
question_34261.ground_truth: The two methods are the "graceful" method and the "forced" method, where the former clears connections when calls are disconnected, and the latter clears all connections immediately.

question_34263.question: What should the UE do upon completing the logMeasReport within the UEInformationResponse message?
question_34263.ground_truth: The UE should submit the UEInformationResponse message to lower layers for transmission via SRB2 and discard the logged measurement entries included in the logMeasInfoList from VarLogMeasReport upon successful delivery of the UEInformationResponse message confirmed by lower layers.

question_34264.question: How many reference channels are to be measured for the minimum requirement in clause 8.2.4.5?
question_34264.ground_truth: Ten reference channels are to be measured for the minimum requirement in clause 8.2.4.5.

question_34266.question: What are the possible criticality values of E1AP-ELEMENTARY PROCEDURE?
question_34266.ground_truth: The possible criticality values of E1AP-ELEMENTARY PROCEDURE are reject and ignore.

question_34268.question: What is the requirement for the test in step c) in section 20.21.2.5?
question_34268.ground_truth: The first response from the MS shall be on carrier 2 within 33 seconds.

question_34269.question: What is the purpose of the UE-associated Signalling Connection in the 3GPP 3rd Generation Partnership Project?
question_34269.ground_truth: UE-associated Signalling Connection is a logical connection between HNB and HNB-GW associated with a particular User Equipment (UE) over the Iuh reference point, identified by the identities Context ID and CN Domain ID. It establishes a signalling connection between HNB and HNB-GW associated to an Iu signalling connection for a particular UE, providing transparent transport for RANAP messages.

question_34270.question: What message should the SGSN send to the MS if the PDP context cannot be established due to the MS being GPRS detached?
question_34270.ground_truth: The SGSN should send a PDU Notification Response (IMSI, PDP Type, PDP Address, APN, Cause) message with "MS GPRS Detached" as the cause.

question_34271.question: What should be the initial conditions for the Method of Test in clause 10.2.2.2.2.4.1?
question_34271.ground_truth: The initial conditions for the Method of Test in clause 10.2.2.2.2.4.1 include the test environment being normal, the frequencies to be tested being the mid-range, connecting the SS and AWGN noise source and fading simulators to the UE antenna connector, setting the UL Reference Measurement Channel parameters, setting the fading conditions to VA 30, and more.

question_34272.question: What is the size of the FQDN sequence?
question_34272.ground_truth: The FQDN sequence is an octet string of size 4 to 253.

question_34274.question: What is the purpose of coordination between closed control loops?
question_34274.ground_truth: Coordination between closed control loops is needed to improve the performance in order to achieve the goal(s) of the closed control loops, to resolve conflicts between closed control loops, and to provide SLS assurance from the overall management perspective.

question_34275.question: Which solution relies on the RAN sharing between PLMN D and PLMN A and the UE is still served by the same PLMN D via the shared RAN of PLMN A for disaster no longer applicable notification to UE's?

question_34276.question: When does the IBCF provide the UA role, subclause~5.10 and subclause~6.7 SDP, if it provides an application level gateway functionality?
question_34276.ground_truth: If the IBCF provides an application level gateway functionality, it provides the UA role, subclause~5.10 and subclause~6.7 SDP.

question_34277.question: What action is taken after receiving a Suspend Notification message for a suspended UE in the E-UTRAN CS fallback procedure?
question_34277.ground_truth: After receiving a Suspend Notification message, the SGW/PGW marks all non-GBR bearers as suspended and discards packets it receives for the suspended UE.

question_34278.question: In the sequence with timers 2 and 3, what occurs between starting timer 2 and then getting its current value?
question_34278.ground_truth: In the example given, starting timer 2 with a value of 23 hours 59 minutes 59 seconds, followed by getting the current value of the timer, but there is no specific time value given for the current value.

question_34279.question: In the LTE UE DRX mechanism for idle mode and connected mode, what is the sleep duration for connected mode when the paging cycle is 10240ms?
question_34279.ground_truth: The sleep duration for connected mode when the paging cycle is 10240ms is 8624ms.

question_34280.question: What is the minimum size of an RLC PDU for UL (Uplink) in AM and UM operation?
question_34280.ground_truth: The parameter Minimum UL PDU size is applicable for AM and UM operation in the uplink. The Minimum UL PDU size determines the smallest size of the RLC AMD or UMD PDU after segmentation or concatenation. If data to be transmitted is not enough to create a PDU of the minimum size, it is allowed to create a PDU including all data to be transmitted, even if the resulting size is smaller than the Minimum UL RLC PDU size.

question_34281.question: When is an RCSSessionEstablishmentAttempt record generated by the IRI-POI in the RCS Server?
question_34281.ground_truth: The RCSSessionEstablishmentAttempt record is generated by the IRI-POI in the RCS Server when it detects the request for a SIP session to transfer a Large Message Mode CPM Standalone message or for a CPM 1-to-1 Chat Session.

question_34282.question: What does NB-IoT stand for in the context of E-UTRA?
question_34282.ground_truth: NB-IoT stands for NB-IoT in the context of E-UTRA, which allows access to network services via E-UTRA with a channel bandwidth limited to 200 kHz.

question_34284.question: Which requirements for transmit modulation quality apply to UE supporting UL-MIMO at each transmit antenna connector?
question_34284.ground_truth: The requirements for transmit modulation quality include Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) for the allocated resource blocks (RBs), EVM equalizer spectrum flatness, carrier leakage caused by IQ offset, and in-band emissions for the non-allocated RBs.

question_34285.question: When would the "Delete Session Request" procedures be given priority in message throttling?
question_34285.ground_truth: The "Delete Session Request" procedures are given priority over other procedures resulting in the deactivation of PDN connection, bearer(s), or data forwarding tunnel(s) during message throttling.

question_34286.question: When should the old BSS transmit the HANDOVER REQUIRED message in case of a DTM Handover to UTRAN procedure?
question_34286.ground_truth: The old BSS should transmit the HANDOVER REQUIRED message in case of a DTM Handover to UTRAN procedure until a HANDOVER COMMAND message is received from the MSC, a RESET message is received, the reason for the original HANDOVER REQUIRED message disappears, all communication is lost with the MS, or the transaction ends.

question_34287.question: What is a scenario where the multipath transmission of a UDP flow using the MPQUIC steering functionality can lead to the reception of double copies of the same packet?
question_34287.ground_truth: This can occur when the MPQUIC steering functionality applies the redundant steering mode (RSM) for a UDP flow.

question_34288.question: What is the purpose of the mobile performing a combined Attach/TAU during SMS transfer using the control plane only?
question_34288.ground_truth: The purpose is for the mobile to establish a security context for optimized SMS procedures and to indicate that only the control plane should be used, without setting up user plane RABs.

question_34289.question: What is the purpose of the successful session binding of an AF session to an IP-CAN session for UE local IP address in 6.2.2.1?
question_34289.ground_truth: The purpose of the successful session binding is to generate QoS Rules by the PCRF for the purpose of policy control in the BBF domain (i.e. BNG) and to enable gate enforcement and QoS enforcement in the BNF for the UE's offloaded traffic.

question_34291.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message with 5GSM cause value #69 "insufficient resources for specific slice" and Back-off timer value IE not included, for a UE-requested PDU session with a specific S-NSSAI?
question_34291.ground_truth: The UE could send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for the same S-NSSAI.

question_34292.question: Which device is the source device and which is the destination device for the "GET INPUT" command?
question_34292.ground_truth: The SIM is the source device, and the ME is the destination device for the "GET INPUT" command.

question_34293.question: What is the procedure for swapping the calls between B and C after Domain Transfer in the example flow for Domain Transfer to CS?
question_34293.ground_truth: User A subsequently Holds the other end C and Resumes the other end B by sending a Re-INVITE with held SDP for C's session and Resuming B's session. The Re-INVITE is processed at the CSCF and the DTF for Access Leg Update of B's session is established and/or updated of an IP bearer between the other end B and the UE-A.

question_34295.question: What happens if a CFNRy registration request is sent to a network with any network element of protocol version 1?
question_34295.ground_truth: The request will be rejected by the network.

question_34296.question: When is the bearer modification procedure triggered during a session modification event?
question_34296.ground_truth: The bearer modification procedure is triggered by the P-CSCF in receiving the SIP message (SDP Answer) from the IMS entity of terminating side or terminating UE, respectively.

question_34297.question: What should the user equipment (UE) do first when initiating a UE assistance data provisioning procedure in step 5.4.8.2?
question_34297.ground_truth: The UE should allocate an EPTI value as specified in clause 5.4.2.2.

question_34299.question: What should the MS do before sending a CONNECT message to establish a user connection to the radio path?
question_34299.ground_truth: The MS should establish the RLP link correctly and send and receive correct RLP frames in each data block.

question_34300.question: What information should a UE include in an LPP Request Assistance Data message in the context of Multi-RTT positioning?
question_34300.ground_truth: A UE should include information such as the UE's approximate location and serving and neighbour cells, as well as NR E-CID measurements, to help the LMF provide appropriate assistance data.

question_34301.question: What are some examples of conditions that may warrant a session re-negotiation in TS 26.114?
question_34301.ground_truth: Some examples of conditions include the use of multiple codecs requiring different bandwidths, the inclusion of redundancy but its prevention during the session, and the need for frame aggregation.

question_34302.question: What is the significance of the two service access points in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_34302.ground_truth: The two service access points are distinguished by their Service Access Point Identifiers (SAPI). SAPI 0 supports the transfer of signalling information including user-user information, while SAPI 3 supports the transfer of user short messages.

question_34303.question: What is the logical state of the call hold service represented by the state "(Provisioned, Not Applicable, Active and Operative, Not Induced)"?
question_34303.ground_truth: The call hold service is provisioned, not applicable, active and operative, and not induced.

question_34304.question: What types of cells does a UE measure and report on when performing NR measurements?
question_34304.ground_truth: For NR measurement objects, the UE measures and reports on the serving cell(s)/serving Relay UE (for L2 U2N Remote UE), listed cells, and/or detected cells.

question_34305.question: What is the response message sent by the transmission control server to the transmission control participant when ending a media transmission?
question_34305.ground_truth: The transmission control server sends a transmit media end request message to the transmission control participant indicating the reason for ending the media transmission.

question_34306.question: What is the role of the PSA1 and PSA2 in the process of EAS relocation?
question_34306.ground_truth: The PSA1 and PSA2 are responsible for buffering the uplink data as indicated by the SMF. The PSA2 buffers the uplink data with the old EAS IP address and uplink data with new EAS IP address in the case of Flow End marker.

question_34308.question: What should the UE do if the current TAI is stored in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming" and the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message is not integrity protected?
question_34308.ground_truth: The UE shall memorize the current TAI was stored in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming" for non-integrity protected NAS reject message.

question_34309.question: What action does ProSe Function A take when it determines that the UEs are unlikely to enter proximity within the requested time window?
question_34309.ground_truth: ProSe Function A may decide to cancel the Proximity Request procedure if it determines that the UEs are unlikely to enter proximity within the requested time window.

question_34310.question: What should the UE do if it receives an EAP-request/AKA'-challenge message and the SNN check fails?
question_34310.ground_truth: If the SNN check fails, the UE shall send an EAP-response/AKA'-authentication-reject message.

question_34311.question: What is the role of the "5.5.40 V2XServiceIdentifier" and "5.5.41 V2XFrequency" in the "V2XServiceIDtoV2XFrequencyMappingRule" mapping rule?
question_34311.ground_truth: The "5.5.40 V2XServiceIdentifier" is the same as the node defined in subclause 5.5.22, and "5.5.41 V2XFrequency" contains the V2X frequency to which the V2X service identifier value associated to the same mapping rule is mapped.

question_34312.question: What was the conclusion drawn regarding the effect of utilizing redundancy across packets on compression?
question_34312.ground_truth: The conclusion was that compression that takes in to account redundancy across packets provides higher gains when compared to the individual packet compression.

question_34313.question: What element in the MCData function indicates whether integrity protection is enabled for the MCData service?

question_34314.question: What should the SCC AS do when it receives a SIP BYE request from the MGCF and the session only contains CS media?
question_34314.ground_truth: The SCC AS should send a SIP BYE request towards both the access and remote legs.

question_34317.question: What should the BBF do if the PCRF requests the same change to the ARP/QCI for all PCC/QoS Rules bound to the same bearer?
question_34317.ground_truth: The BBF should modify the bearer ARP/QCI as requested.

question_34318.question: What should be done to receive notifications from the NSCE Server on network slice related performance and analytics monitoring event(s)?
question_34318.ground_truth: In order to receive notifications from the NSCE Server on network slice related performance and analytics monitoring event(s), the NSCE Server shall send an HTTP POST request to the service consumer with the request body including the MonitoringNotif data structure, and the service consumer shall respond to the NSCE Server with an HTTP "204 No Content" status code to acknowledge the successful reception and processing of the notification.

question_34319.question: What is the purpose of using adaptive filtering and non-linear modeling in the digital domain for self-interference mitigation?
question_34319.ground_truth: The purpose of using adaptive filtering and non-linear modeling in the digital domain for self-interference mitigation is to accurately model and cancel the residual self-interference that cannot be fully captured in the RF or analog domain.

question_34320.question: What should a controlling MCVideo function do if it receives a SIP MESSAGE request for an MCVideo emergency alert and the sending MCVideo user is not affiliated with the MCVideo group identified by the <mcvideo-request-uri> of the MIME body?
question_34320.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function shall check if the MCVideo user is eligible to be implicitly affiliated with the MCVideo group. If the user is determined not to be eligible, it shall reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and include the warning text "120 user is not affiliated to this group".

question_34321.question: What is the condition for a UE to register with a PLMN offering disaster roaming service?
question_34321.ground_truth: If a UE has no coverage of its HPLMN, then obtains information that a Disaster Condition applies to the UE's HPLMN, the UE can register with a PLMN offering Disaster Roaming service.

question_34322.question: What are the two types of CoMP schemes mentioned for JR (coordinated multi-point reception) in the CoMP cooperating set?
question_34322.ground_truth: The two types of CoMP schemes mentioned for JR are CoMP CS/CB and CoMP reception points may include multiple points in the CoMP cooperating set at each subframe for a certain frequency resource.

question_34323.question: What technique is recommended for coordinating the implementation of HTTP polling process with SUPL procedures?
question_34323.ground_truth: The implementation of the HTTP polling process can be coordinated with the SUPL (Secure User Plane Location) procedures to synchronize the SUPL location report procedures and the HTTP polling procedure so as to reduce unnecessary wait time of polling.

question_34325.question: In test purpose 2, what action does the UE (MCPTT client) take when it receives a GROUP EMERGENCY ALERT message from the same MCPTT Client and the timer TFE1 (Emergency Alert) has not expired yet?
question_34325.ground_truth: The UE (MCPTT Client) shall not send a GROUP EMERGENCY ALERT ACK message in response.

question_34326.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon receiving a SIP MESSAGE request containing a list of MCVideo groups for affiliation and de-affiliation?
question_34326.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should seek confirmation of the list of MCVideo groups for affiliation and de-affiliation, perform affiliation for each entry in the accepted list of MCVideo groups for affiliation, and perform de-affiliation for each entry in the accepted list of MCVideo groups for de-affiliation.

question_34327.question: How many IP address values must be assigned to the UE-AT3SF for operation in this solution?
question_34327.ground_truth: The UE-AT3SF is assigned with IP address values to be used over each access. The exact number depends on the number of accesses being used.

question_34328.question: What parameter is used by the UE when deriving the new Kembt that is used to generate KRRCint, KRRCenc, and KUPenc upon handover, connection re-establishment, connection resume, UP-EDT, and UP transmission using PUR?

question_34329.question: How does the 3GPP system provide priority treatment to the signalling and the audio media flows when MPS is activated for all participants of an MMTEL voice conference?
question_34329.ground_truth: The 3GPP system provides priority treatment to the signalling and the audio media flows for all participants when MPS is activated by an MPS Service User for all participants of an MMTEL voice conference.

question_34331.question: When should the SMF reduce the received BAT offset from the current BAT in UL direction in the TSCAI for the given QoS Flow?
question_34331.ground_truth: After the SMF has setup a QoS Flow between UPF and NG-RAN, the SMF applies the BAT offset reduction.

question_34332.question: What is the difference between "5GS" and "N3IWFFunction" in the context of these measurements?
question_34332.ground_truth: "5GS" refers to the 5th Generation System (5G) of wireless telecommunications, while "N3IWFFunction" refers to functions performed by the N3 Interworking Function (N3IWF).

question_34333.question: When is the UE required to restart the Rx-Tx measurement on the new cell when DRX is used and the PCell is changed due to handover?
question_34333.ground_truth: When the UE is performing UE Rx-Tx time difference measurement while the PCell is changed due to the handover, the UE shall restart the Rx-Tx measurement on the new cell and meet the UE Rx-Tx time difference measurement and accuracy requirements.

question_34335.question: What indicators are set in the uplink direction for all frames in the comfort noise states when using Full Rate Speech?
question_34335.ground_truth: The BFI (Bad Frame Indicator), the SID (Silence Descriptor) indicator and the TAF (Time Alignment Flag) indicator are set.

question_34336.question: What is the action taken by the NAS upon receiving a request from upper layers to initiate the NAS transport procedure to send the SMS in an UL NAS TRANSPORT message?
question_34336.ground_truth: The NAS shall initiate the NAS transport procedure as specified in subclause~5.4.5 to send the SMS in an UL NAS TRANSPORT message.

question_34337.question: What is the purpose of the MIC IE set to the calculated MIC value when the 5G ProSe direct link establishment procedure is for direct communication between the 5G ProSe remote UE and the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE or between the 5G ProSe end UE and the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE and the UE has the DUIK?
question_34337.ground_truth: It is used to ensure secure direct communication between the UEs by including the calculated MIC value in the PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message.

question_34338.question: How are RIM PDUs conveyed through the core network?
question_34338.ground_truth: RIM PDUs are conveyed transparently by the core network to the destination BSS, RNS, eNodeB, or eHRPD eAN, using the Gb, Iu, S1, or S121 interface, or by tunneling towards the target SGSN or MME parenting the destination node through the Gn or S3 interface, respectively.

question_34340.question: What should an MTSI client do to request a desired region of interest?
question_34340.ground_truth: An MTSI client should support Video Region-of-Interest (ROI) signaling as specified in clause~7.3.7 and must support at least one of the following modes to request a desired region of interest.

question_34341.question: What is the maximum output power defined for the inter-band concurrent V2X operation for any transmission bandwidth?
question_34341.ground_truth: The maximum output power is defined for the inter-band concurrent V2X operation for any transmission bandwidth within the channel bandwidth, with separate power classes and maximum power reduction requirements for the licensed band and Band 47.

question_34343.question: What is the state of the new MCPTT group information entry upon adding it to the candidate list in the case where the MCPTT group ID does not have an MCPTT group information entry in the served list of the MCPTT group information entries?
question_34343.ground_truth: The affiliation status of the new MCPTT group information entry is set to the "affiliating" state.

question_34344.question: What should an IWU do if it receives an initial SDP offer from a preceding 3GPP SIP-I node without the RTP Telephony Event and only the default PCM codec is offered?
question_34344.ground_truth: The IWU can either send the SDP offer to the external SIP-I node without the RTP Telephony Event (no compressed codecs included in the offer) or send the SDP offer to the external SIP-I node without any additional non-PCM speech codecs and include the RTP Telephony Event.

question_34345.question: In what mode of operation must the UE be for the LWA, LWIP, and RCLWI procedures to be applicable?
question_34345.ground_truth: The UE must be in ECM-CONNECTED mode for the LWA, LWIP, and RCLWI procedures to be applicable.

question_34347.question: What is the function of the SLm Setup procedure in the SLm interface?
question_34347.ground_truth: The SLm Setup procedure is used to exchange application level data, such as capability information, between the E-SMLC and LMU in order to establish the SLmAP contexts and ensure interoperability on the SLm interface. This procedure is originated by the LMU and is used to initiate the setup of the SLmAP contexts.

question_34350.question: What is the purpose of using autonomous gaps in downlink reception and uplink transmission in this test?
question_34350.ground_truth: The purpose of using autonomous gaps in downlink reception and uplink transmission in this test is to receive MIB and SIB1 message.

question_34351.question: What is the size of the new data indicator field in the DCI format 0C?
question_34351.ground_truth: The new data indicator field in the DCI format 0C is 1 bit.

question_34353.question: What is the purpose of service function chaining in the 5G system?
question_34353.ground_truth: The service function chaining in the 5G system is used to manage service function chaining for deployments where the Hosted Services are provided by the operator or a third party. This allows for the management of specific services or functions that are provided by the 5G network.

question_34354.question: What are the three types of Message Gateways used to deliver MSGin5G messages to different UE types?
question_34354.ground_truth: The Legacy 3GPP Message Gateway, the non-3GPP Message Gateway, and the Broadcast Message Gateway.

question_34355.question: What are the two recently completed auctions in the United States that made additional 75 MHz of mid-band spectrum available for wireless broadband?
question_34355.ground_truth: The two auctions are the successful auction of PCS H block in early 2014 and the completion of Auction #97 in 2015.

question_34356.question: What is the requirement for a 3GPP system to support access from less trusted networks?
question_34356.ground_truth: The 3GPP system should support a temporary identifier for initial attach that hides the UE's long-term identity in less trusted networks.

question_34358.question: What is the name of the measurement that provides the number of initial E-RABs attempted to setup, split into subcounters per E-RAB QoS level (QCI)?

question_34359.question: What should the UE do when it wants to cause the network to initiate a PDU session release over a specific access, as specified in clause 6.4.3.2 of 3GPP TS 24.501?
question_34359.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the UE-requested PDU session release procedure as specified in clause 6.4.3.2 of 3GPP TS 24.501 by sending the PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message to the network over the specific access.

question_34360.question: What is the purpose of having a Single SCAS (Security Assurance Specification) for a given network product class?
question_34360.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure standardization and to define a single set of security requirements for each network product class.

question_34361.question: Which codecs were identified in the 3GPP Technical Report on video codec characterization for 5G services?
question_34361.ground_truth: The codecs identified in the 3GPP Technical Report on video codec characterization for 5G services are H.266/VVC, MPEG-5 EVC, and AOMedia AV1.

question_34362.question: What is the maximum variability in UE delay due to synchronization in LTE, NR, or WLAN access for speech-based calls?
question_34362.ground_truth: Up to 20ms may be expected between different calls.

question_34363.question: What does the HSS/HLR check in step 3 of Variant 2 of the solution?
question_34363.ground_truth: The HSS/HLR checks that IMSI/IMEI pair is authorized and if so, returns the public key associated with the IMEI to the CNN.

question_34364.question: What should the SMF include in the N1 SM container and N2 SM information when sending the PDU Session Establishment Accept in the PDU Session Establishment procedure for non-3GPP access?
question_34364.ground_truth: The SMF should include all QoS information for the QoS Flows, such as QoS Rules in the N1 SM container and QFI(s) and QoS Profile(s) in the N2 SM information.

question_34365.question: What should the AMF do if it receives the Allowed PDU session status IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and the SMF has indicated pending downlink data only?
question_34365.ground_truth: The AMF should notify the SMF that reactivation of the user-plane resources for the corresponding PDU session(s) associated with non-3GPP access can be performed if the corresponding PDU session ID(s) are indicated in the Allowed PDU session status IE.

question_34366.question: What does an active PCC rule mean in regard to service data flow detection and service data flow filters?
question_34366.ground_truth: An active PCC rule means that the service data flow template shall be used for service data flow detection, mapping of downlink packets to the IP-CAN bearer, and service data flow detection of uplink packets on the IP-CAN bearer determined by the bearer binding. Additionally, usage data for the service data flow shall be recorded. For service data flow detection with an application detection filter, the start or stop of the application traffic is reported to the PCRF. The notification for Start may include service data flow filters and application instance identifier associated with the service data flow filters.

question_34368.question: What kind of devices does Ryder want to control using his mobile phone in a single application?
question_34368.ground_truth: Ryder wants to control devices such as TV, refrigerator, air conditioner, clothes washer, oven, and robot cleaner using his mobile phone in a single application.

question_34370.question: What HTTP status code does the BSF send to the PCF when it successfully deletes binding information as detailed in clause 8.5.3?

question_34371.question: How is the Home Network Domain for 5GS structured in 3GPP network?
question_34371.ground_truth: The Home Network Domain for 5GS in 3GPP network is in the format "5gc.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.3gppnetwork.org", where both <MNC> and <MCC> are 3 digits long.

question_34373.question: What should the UE do regarding exclude-listed cells during the cell reselection process?
question_34373.ground_truth: The UE shall not consider any exclude-listed cells as candidate for cell reselection.

question_34374.question: What are the performance objectives for the GERAN enhancements?
question_34374.ground_truth: The GERAN enhancements are expected to provide 50% better spectrum efficiency/capacity, 100% better peak data rates, improved coverage, increased service availability, and reduced latency.

question_34375.question: What should a user do when they want to join two active SIP sessions into a three-way session?
question_34375.ground_truth: They should create a conference at the conference focus by sending an INVITE request with the conference factory URI for the three-way session towards the conference focus. Then, they should decide and perform for each of the active sessions that are requested to be joined to the three-way session, how the remote user should be invited to the three-way session, which can be by performing the procedures for inviting a user to a conference by sending an REFER request to the user or by performing the procedures for inviting a user to a conference by sending a REFER request to the conference focus.

question_34376.question: What is the role of the Media Player in the 5GMS media service playback process?
question_34376.ground_truth: The Media Player is responsible for requesting the media presentation manifest, processing it, selecting the media content, receiving the content from the 5GMS AS, and informing the Media Session Handler about the consumed media content.

question_34377.question: What is the function of the adaptive pre-filter in the algebraic codebook for WB IC mode in subclause 5.2.3.4.1.1?
question_34377.ground_truth: The adaptive pre-filter in the algebraic codebook for WB IC mode in subclause 5.2.3.4.1.1 is designed to amend the pre-filter with a phase scrambling filter. It is used for ensuring the excitation component is missing in the equation for UC mode.

question_34378.question: What is the disadvantage of allowing exclusive usage of the APN back-off timer mechanism or the overload control mechanism at any point of time for performing congestion control at APN level?
question_34378.ground_truth: The disadvantage is that it may not allow a sender to achieve the use case of completely blocking Create Session Request messages while throttling other messages at the same time for a given APN, but this can be addressed by using other mechanisms.

question_34379.question: What action does the MSGin5G Server perform when a message is stored for deferred delivery?
question_34379.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server sends a message response in a new CoAP POST request to the originating entity to confirm the storage of the message for deferred delivery. This response includes the originating MSGin5G Client's address and other specified information.

question_34380.question: How frequently is the UE provided with a new Timing Advance Command MAC control element during each test?

question_34381.question: How does the LMF resolve the cell-ID of the MBSR?
question_34381.ground_truth: The LMF can correlate the cell-ID with the GPSI of the MBSR received by the AMF, query the PLMN level NRF for the MBSR's SUPI and AMF-ID of the AMF serving the MBSR using the cell-ID, or receive the cell-ID with an indication that it is a MBSR from the AMF. In Solution #18, the AMF serving UE provides the cell-ID and AMF ID of the serving MBSR to the LMF.

question_34385.question: Which message serves as the initial message for sgNBinitiatedSgNBModification?

question_34386.question: What is the purpose of subchannel specific power control on DL in enhancing network capacity gains for MUROS-2?
question_34386.ground_truth: Subchannel specific power control on DL increases further network capacity gains due to OSC in the order of 7% to 16% for MUROS-2, showing a promising approach to improving system performance.

question_34387.question: Why are two orthogonal linear polarizations used when measuring the spherical sensitivity pattern of the Device Under Test (DUT)?
question_34387.ground_truth: Two orthogonal linear polarizations are used when measuring the spherical sensitivity pattern of the Device Under Test (DUT) to capture the sensitivity values at all possible polarization states of the antenna and to calculate the Total Radiated Sensitivity (TRS) and Mean Effective Sensitivity (MERS) by integration.

question_34388.question: What steps does the NWDAF follow to receive analytics from multiple NWDAFs with the same "expected waiting time"?
question_34388.ground_truth: The NWDAF Service Consumer indicates the "expected waiting time" as "time when analytics is needed" parameter to those NWDAFs from which it expects to receive analytics latest by the specified time. Each NWDAF generates the requested analytics based on data from related data sources and, if necessary, indicates a "revised waiting time" in an error response. The NWDAF Service Consumer can then receive the analytics based on the indicated time.

question_34391.question: What is the purpose of step 24 in the described process, and why is it skipped if the interconnection network is SIP-unaware?
question_34391.ground_truth: Step 24 is used to send a PROVISIONAL RESPONSE towards the originating UE-A to terminate the early dialog. It is skipped if the interconnection network is SIP-unaware because the additional step is not necessary for the process to work correctly.

question_34392.question: What is the maximum allowed interruption on an activated SCell during SRS carrier based switching?
question_34392.ground_truth: The maximum allowed interruption on an activated SCell during SRS carrier based switching is 5 subframes.

question_34393.question: What should the participating MCVideo function do if the call is a private call and the received SIP REFER request contains a <functional-alias-URI> element of the <anyExt> element of the <mcvideo-Params> element of the <mcvideoinfo> element in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body?
question_34393.ground_truth: It should check if the status of the functional alias is activated for the MCVideo ID. If the functional alias status is activated, then the participating MCVideo function should set the <functional-alias-URI> element of the <anyExt> element of the <mcvideo-Params> element of the <mcvideoinfo> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body in the outgoing SIP INVITE request to the received value. If not, it should not include a <functional-alias-URI> element.

question_34394.question: What should be the difference in RXQUAL values before and after the change in RX quality in the 26.13.1.1.3.1 conformance requirements?
question_34394.ground_truth: The difference in RXQUAL values recorded before and after the change in RX quality should be greater than 3.

question_34396.question: What action should an ICS UE take upon receiving an I1 Success message from the SCC AS after sending an I1 Invite message for I1 augmentation?
question_34396.ground_truth: The ICS UE should treat the ongoing I1 session as established and the existing call being controlled by the respective I1 session.

question_34398.question: What action does the NG-RAN node take when it receives a DISTRIBUTION SETUP REQUEST message with the Shared NG-U Unicast TNL Information IE included?
question_34398.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node uses the included information as the downlink termination point for the shared NG-U transport.

question_34399.question: What are the aspects of the Service Authorization to NG-RAN that needs to be studied for Ranging based services and sidelink positioning over PC5?
question_34399.ground_truth: The aspects of Service Authorization to NG-RAN that need to be studied for Ranging based services and sidelink positioning over PC5 include the service authorization policy/parameter required for the support of Ranging/SL Positioning and how 5GC authorizes the usage of Ranging based services and sidelink positioning over PC5 and the related policy/parameter.

question_34401.question: When is CSI-RS based RLM considered to be within the SMTC window duration?
question_34401.ground_truth: The CSI-RS based RLM is considered to be within the SMTC window duration if it appears within the SMTC window duration.

question_34402.question: What should the transmission participant do upon receiving a Transmission Granted message from the transmission control server?
question_34402.ground_truth: The transmission participant should store the SSRC of granted transmission participant, send a Transmission control Ack message, provide Transmission granted notification to the user, stop timer T100 (Transmission Request), and enter the 'U: has permission to transmit' state.

question_34403.question: What is the effect of re-deriving the reselection priority for a frequency based on the NSAG(s) supported by a cell in 3GPP TS 38.331?
question_34403.ground_truth: The re-derived reselection priority is used for a maximum of 300 seconds, or until new network slice(s) and/or NSAG information are received from NAS.

question_34405.question: What message does the SRNS send to the new 3G-SGSN upon successful receipt of the SRNS Context Request (IMSI) message from the old 3G-SGSN?
question_34405.ground_truth: SRNS Context Response (GTP-SNDs, GTP-SNUs, PDCP-SNDs, PDCP-SNUs) message.

question_34406.question: What should the UE do after sending a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message for de-registration due to switch off?
question_34406.ground_truth: The UE shall try for a period of 5 seconds to send the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message, during which the UE may be switched off as soon as the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message has been sent.
