question_34407.question: What should the PCF do if the request is not authorized or the required QoS is not allowed during MBS session creation?
question_34407.ground_truth: The PCF responds with an error message to the MB-SMF, which then informs the AF about the authorization or QoS failure.

question_34408.question: What is the significance of the first digit in the versioning of 3GPP Technical Specifications?
question_34408.ground_truth: The first digit indicates the stage of the document: (1) presented to TSG for information, (2) presented to TSG for approval, or (3) TSG approved document under change control.

question_34411.question: What is the requirement for a 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE to start the announcing UE procedure for UE-to-network relay discovery?
question_34411.ground_truth: The UE is authorized to act as a UE-to-network relay in the PLMN indicated by the serving cell and is served by NG-RAN or authorized to perform 5G ProSe direct discovery when not served by NG-RAN.

question_34412.question: What should be taken into consideration when using the Timing Advance value for distance measurement?
question_34412.ground_truth: Reflections from the external environment, such as buildings, may affect the accuracy of the distance measurement.

question_34414.question: What is the outcome of the "Transfer of an incoming voice communication" use case?
question_34414.ground_truth: The incoming voice communication is transferred to a new FRMCS User.

question_34416.question: What is the purpose of the XML Schema defined in the MCID service as per the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_34416.ground_truth: The XML Schema is defined to provide the MCID Request/Response and to invoke the temporary mode of the MCID Service. The application/vnd.etsi.mcid+xml MIME type used to provide the request of a missing originating ID and the delivery of the requested originating ID AS of the served user shall be coded as per this XML Schema.

question_34419.question: What should the mobile station do if it receives a PACKET CELL CHANGE CONTINUE message without receiving any neighbor cell system information as a response to a PACKET CELL CHANGE NOTIFICATION message?
question_34419.ground_truth: The mobile station should stop timers T3208 and T3210, if still running, leave CCN mode and continue cell reselection in NC0/NC1 mode.

question_34421.question: What is the conclusion for multi-camera scenarios in terms of controlling media rates?
question_34421.ground_truth: For multi-camera scenarios, there is a need to dynamically control media rates such that not all cameras use the maximum rate all the time, in particular when this may exceed total cell capacity. Additionally, there is a need to reduce media rates of some cameras quickly to avoid data loss on important camera feeds in case of increased cell load or worsening radio conditions.

question_34422.question: In a scheduling request, how would a terminal determine which cell to connect to?
question_34422.ground_truth: The terminal would apply the association guidelines provided in the Reduced Connectivity Information (ResourceCoordinationTransferContainer) message in 3GPP TS38.300 v16.1.0 (2018-july).

question_34423.question: What is the purpose of the architectural requirements document in the 23 series of specifications?
question_34423.ground_truth: The architectural requirements document in the 23 series of specifications outlines the high-level requirements for the Circuit Switched (CS) domain in 3GPP systems based on UTRAN, E-UTRAN, and Iu mode GERAN. It also details the stage 2 procedures that span more than one domain or subsystem.

question_34424.question: Under what circumstances can a UE use a preferred resource set in its resource (re)selection for transmissions to a peer UE providing the preferred resource set?
question_34424.ground_truth: UE should use the preferred resource set in its resource (re)selection for transmissions to a peer UE providing the preferred resource set if the UE has own sensing results.

question_34426.question: What information does the MNO provide to the 3rd party content provider about the eMBMS services?
question_34426.ground_truth: The MNO can provide information about quality metrics, consumption metrics, service registration, delivery, group information and any changes to the delivery modes during service delivery to the 3rd party content provider.

question_34427.question: What should the MCVideo client include in a SIP REGISTER request for service authorization with confidentiality and integrity protection disabled?
question_34427.ground_truth: The MCVideo client shall include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the mcvideo-access-token and mcvideo-client-id elements in the SIP REGISTER request for service authorization if confidentiality and integrity protection are disabled.

question_34428.question: On which subchannel should the MS send access bursts for uplink transmission?
question_34428.ground_truth: The MS should send access bursts on the subchannel defined by the TAI on the PTCCH using TA=0.

question_34429.question: When does an MCPTT group call release due to inactivity?
question_34429.ground_truth: An MCPTT group call is released due to inactivity if it remains inactive for a specific duration, as set by the policy of the MCPTT service provider.

question_34432.question: What are the benefits of using widely accepted open standards and new IT-technologies in a 3GPP system?
question_34432.ground_truth: The benefits of using widely accepted open standards and new IT-technologies in a 3GPP system include the ability to incorporate new successful technologies from the IT-world, realize TMN goals using commonly available technologies for a reasonable cost, and easily adopt new important technologies as they are introduced.

question_34433.question: What header fields are used to identify the start of a PDU set in RTP?
question_34433.ground_truth: A new timestamp, a new Type field in NAL unit header, and the sequence number of the packet with the RTP header M-bit set to 1.

question_34435.question: What is used to apply charging differentiation for service data flows in a multi-access PDN connection?
question_34435.ground_truth: A different access type and rating group can be specified for each service data flow, identified by its PCC Rule.

question_34438.question: What is the purpose of the Traffic Distribution function in the ATSSS function?
question_34438.ground_truth: The Traffic Distribution function in the ATSSS function distributes traffic onto the appropriate 3GPP or non-3GPP access path based on the ATSSS rules/Packet Detection rules and path performance measurement.

question_34439.question: What does "ID" stand for in the abbreviation ICIDefinition"IDentifier"?
question_34439.ground_truth: An "identifier" refers to a unique name given to an element or object for identification purposes.

question_34440.question: What is the function of the WRITE-REPLACE-WARNING-REQUEST Request/Indication primitive?
question_34440.ground_truth: The WRITE-REPLACE-WARNING-REQUEST Request/Indication primitive is used by the CBC to request the MME and the AMF to start or overwrite a warning message broadcast.

question_34441.question: What is the requirement for frequency error that applies to E.2F.4 for NR sidelink operation in unlicensed band?
question_34441.ground_truth: The requirements for frequency error in clause 6.4.1 apply.

question_34444.question: Which request can be used for all codecs to pad the RTCP-APP to be 32 bit aligned?
question_34444.ground_truth: The PADDING request can be used for all codecs to pad the RTCP-APP to be 32 bit aligned.

question_34445.question: What is the impact of handover on the control procedure and the operation of CFNRc?
question_34445.ground_truth: Handover will have no impact on the control procedure and the operation of the service.

question_34446.question: What values does the IoT-PCS Server suggest for Maximum Latency and Maximum Response Time, as part of the network parameter coordination procedure?
question_34446.ground_truth: The IoT-PCS Server suggests Maximum Latency based on the periodicity derived from the UE unified traffic pattern, which includes the schedule elements for the UE's communications with all IoT-Apps. Maximum Response Time is suggested based on the duration of activity derived from the schedule element of the UE unified traffic pattern, indicating how long the UE should stay reachable for downlink communications.

question_34447.question: What action does the LLE take when it receives a frame with a command control field that is not implemented?
question_34447.ground_truth: The LLE shall discard the frame causing the frame rejection condition, transmit a FRMR response frame, and initiate re-establishment.

question_34448.question: What value does the MME store if it determines the unavailability period duration based on satellite coverage availability information?
question_34448.ground_truth: The MME stores the determined unavailability period duration if it is determined based on satellite coverage availability information.

question_34450.question: What happens when a FRMCS User or FRMCS-equipment interrogates the FRMCS System to recognize other functional identities within a certain context?
question_34450.ground_truth: When a FRMCS User or FRMCS-equipment interrogates the FRMCS System to recognize the functional identities of other FRMCS Users or FRMCS-equipment within a certain context, the FRMCS System returns a set of functional identities within the certain context. The requesting FRMCS User or FRMCS-equipment is informed about the own or other FRMCS Users / FRMCS-equipment with a functional identity within a certain context, such as train, region, communication group, Railway Emergency Communication, or all Drivers on a station.

question_34451.question: What is the impact of management capability exposure governance on the Network Slice NRM fragment, and is it within the scope of SA5?
question_34451.ground_truth: It is within the scope of SA5. The NSP sends NSC related information, such as NSC id and NSC granted capabilities, to the NOP. The NOP manages this information in relation to the existing NetworkSlice and NetworkSliceSubnet IOCs.

question_34452.question: What is the responsibility of the GERAN Position Calculation Function (PCF)?
question_34452.ground_truth: The GERAN Position Calculation Function (PCF) is responsible for calculating the location of the MS by applying an algorithmic computation on the collected signal measurements to compute the final location estimate and accuracy.

question_34454.question: What shall the VAE-C include in the Content-Type header field when sending a V2X message reception report?
question_34454.ground_truth: The VAE-C shall set the Content-Type header field to "application/vnd.3gpp.vae-info+xml" when sending a V2X message reception report.

question_34455.question: What is the role of the Gateway GPRS Support Node (GGSN) in the GPRS network supporting services?
question_34455.ground_truth: The Gateway GPRS Support Node (GGSN) is a network element in the GPRS network supporting services that is responsible for providing access to PS-based services for a WLAN UE. It resides either in the home network for access to home services or in the visited 3GPP network for access to local services.

question_34456.question: What is required for testing a notification connection in the VAE HDMap Dynamic Info service?
question_34456.ground_truth: Both the VAE server and service consumer should support testing a notification connection using a separate HTTP connection towards an assigned address.

question_34458.question: When does RRC connection re-establishment occur for a NB-IoT UE supporting RRC connection re-establishment for the Control Plane CIoT EPS/5GS optimisation?
question_34458.ground_truth: A NB-IoT UE supporting RRC connection re-establishment for the Control Plane CIoT EPS/5GS optimisation can initiate the procedure in order to continue the RRC connection when AS security has not been activated.

question_34459.question: What is the SDP information used for in the IMS media flow?
question_34459.ground_truth: The SDP information provides details about the codec information expected by the IMS Media Function. It is used to identify the incoming and outgoing media packets.

question_34461.question: What is the purpose of transmitting the test sequence DTX01.INP on the digital audio interface in the test for speech encoder and DTX functions?
question_34461.ground_truth: The purpose of transmitting the test sequence DTX01.INP is to reset the speech encoder of the MS with a special homing sequence at the beginning of the test sequence. The test sequence is synchronized with the radio transmission on the air interface so that the first traffic frame on the air caused by the first encoder homing frame in the test sequence occurs just after the traffic frame allocated for the SID frame.

question_34462.question: What is the expected sequence in step 2 of the test procedure?
question_34462.ground_truth: The expected sequence in step 2 of the test procedure is the sending of a PACKET ASSIGNMENT message with k=1, followed by k=2.

question_34463.question: What should be the method for measuring the frequency error in the context of OTA frequency error for the Indoor Anechoic Chamber test procedure?
question_34463.ground_truth: The frequency error should be measured in the OTA conformance reference direction, not the beam peak direction of the OTA peak directions set reference direction.

question_34464.question: How can the IBCF derive the sustainable data rate from bandwidth parameters in an SDP media description?
question_34464.ground_truth: The IBCF can use the "b=AS" bandwidth modifier within an SDP body or the "maximum supported bandwidth for the receiving direction" property value from the "a=bw-info" SDP attribute if the IBCF supports the enhanced bandwidth negotiation mechanism.

question_34465.question: What are the two delivery modes for MBS traffic in 5G network?
question_34465.ground_truth: The two delivery modes are 5GC Shared MBS traffic delivery and 5GC Individual MBS traffic delivery.

question_34466.question: What do the terms "shall" and "shall not" indicate in the normative context of the document?
question_34466.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, and "shall not" indicates a prohibition to do something.

question_34467.question: What is required for an IWU to advertise support of the UPDATE method towards an external SIP-I network?
question_34467.ground_truth: The IWU must include the UPDATE method in the ALLOW header of a SIP INVITE request towards the external SIP-I network.

question_34468.question: What happens if an EEC does not send a registration update request prior to the expiration time?
question_34468.ground_truth: The EES will treat the EEC as implicitly de-registered.

question_34469.question: What is the definition and applicability of inner loop power control in the downlink?
question_34469.ground_truth: Inner loop power control in the downlink is the ability of the BS transmitter to adjust the code domain power of a code channel in accordance with the corresponding TPC symbols received in the uplink. The power control step is the required step change in the DL transmitter output power of a code channel in response to the corresponding power control command.

question_34470.question: What is the maximum number of retransmissions per RLC block in the Non-Persistent mode?
question_34470.ground_truth: The maximum number of retransmissions per RLC block in the Non-Persistent mode is 1 or 2.

question_34471.question: Where is the protocol termination for the BCH transport channel type in UMTS located?
question_34471.ground_truth: The protocol termination for the BCH transport channel type is distributed between the Node B and the CRNC, resulting in less signalling on Iub and lower processor load.

question_34472.question: What is the role of the 5GMSu AF in the 5GMS service?
question_34472.ground_truth: The 5GMSu AF acts as an interface between the 5GMSu AS and the 5GMSu Application Provider, fulfilling various control functions such as requesting the instantiation of the content preparation process and managing the uplink streaming.

question_34473.question: What is the specific delay requirement for UE supporting power class 1 or 5 in Test 1?
question_34473.ground_truth: The UE supporting power class 1 or 5 must report the event within 7202 ms for Test 1 for the number of successful tests to be increased.

question_34474.question: What is the name of the complexType that is extended in the "NotifyComments" element?
question_34474.ground_truth: The name of the complexType that is extended in the "NotifyComments" element is "Notification".

question_34475.question: What is the typical size of an Ambient IoT device's ID for home asset management?
question_34475.ground_truth: The typical size of an Ambient IoT device's ID for home asset management is 96 bits.

question_34479.question: What is the benefit of using measurement event specific cell lists in HetNets?
question_34479.ground_truth: This approach allows for a list of cells to apply to some measurement events, such as macro cells, and another list of cells to apply for other measurement events, such as PLN cells. This helps in reducing PSC confusion by identifying each small cell as part of the larger macro cell.

question_34480.question: What should the 3GPP AAA Proxy do on receipt of an authentication and authorization request if the Visited-Network-Identifier AVP is not present?
question_34480.ground_truth: The 3GPP AAA Proxy shall insert the Visited-Network-Identifier AVP before forwarding the request to the 3GPP AAA Server.

question_34481.question: Which SA WG is responsible for the charging architecture control?
question_34481.ground_truth: SA WG5 is responsible for the charging architecture control.

question_34482.question: When is the requirement to apply the operating band unwanted emission limit for a multi-band TAB connector where multiple bands are mapped on the same antenna connector, not applicable?
question_34482.ground_truth: The requirement is not applicable when there is no carrier transmitted in an operating band, and there is a supported downlink band with carrier(s) transmitted and a supported downlink band without any carrier transmitted, and the inter-band gap between the two does not have any cumulative basic limits applied.

question_34484.question: What is the cause of the error returned by the function call in Test Case 17?
question_34484.ground_truth: The error is caused by the invalidation of the EF, which prevents further read or update operations on the EF due to its invalidated status.

question_34486.question: Which video codecs are relevant for today's TV services?
question_34486.ground_truth: The relevant video codecs for today's TV services are H.264/AVC High Profile, H.265/HEVC Main Tier Main Profile, and H.265/HEVC Main Tier Main-10 Profile.

question_34487.question: What is the minimum requirement for a test to be considered successful in the test?
question_34487.ground_truth: Both event detection and percentage of transmitted ACK/NACKs requirements have to be fulfilled simultaneously for a test to be considered successful.

question_34488.question: What is a requirement for the Tuak algorithm in terms of its difference from the MILENAGE algorithm?
question_34488.ground_truth: The Tuak algorithm should be fundamentally different from the MILENAGE algorithm, so that any advance in cryptanalysis that impacts one algorithm should be unlikely to impact the other.

question_34492.question: What is one of the factors that impact the system capacity gains when MUROS co-exists with older legacy handsets?
question_34492.ground_truth: The determining factor for system capacity gains remains the channel blocking, and MUROS gains are significant even at lower levels of penetration.

question_34493.question: What is the format of the UECapabilityInformation message for NB-IoT, as defined in TS 36.331, clause 5.6.3.3?
question_34493.ground_truth: The UECapabilityInformation message for NB-IoT should include UE Radio Access Capability Parameters within the ue-Capability-Container, ue-RadioPagingInfo, and the contents of UECapabilityInformation message as specified in TS 36.331, clause 5.6.3.3.

question_34494.question: What is the 3GPP Technical Specification (TS) 17 focused on in terms of UMTS?
question_34494.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification (TS) 17 focuses on the services provided by the Access Stratum (AS) to the rest of the system in the context of UMTS. It specifies the main functions visible at the boundary between the AS and the rest of the system, describing in general terms the information flows, both control and user data, over this boundary.

question_34495.question: What is the purpose of the TOE and its environment in addressing security threats and organizational policies?
question_34495.ground_truth: The TOE and its environment must be able to address all the threats and organizational security policies.

question_34496.question: What is used to indicate that a header field applies to the media plane in the Security-Client, Security-Server, or Security-Verify header fields defined in IETF RFC 3329?
question_34496.ground_truth: The "mediasec" header field parameter may be used in the Security-Client, Security-Server, or Security-Verify header fields defined in IETF RFC 3329 to indicate that a header field applies to the media plane.

question_34499.question: What value does the MCVideo server set the Expires header field to in the SIP PUBLISH request for an affiliation request?
question_34499.ground_truth: The MCVideo server sets the Expires header field to 4294967295 in the SIP PUBLISH request for an affiliation request.

question_34500.question: In Proximity alerted charging conditions, what is the meaning of the "Time expired with no renewal" change condition?
question_34500.ground_truth: This change condition indicates that the time allowed for proximity alerting has expired and there has been no renewal, leading to the closure of the associated service data container or ProSe group communication container.

question_34501.question: What is the purpose of the cell selection procedure in the 5G network during Idle state?
question_34501.ground_truth: The cell selection procedure in the 5G network during Idle state is used to determine which S-NSSAIs the UE wants to register with and to consider the list of PFBs for the S-NSSAIs included in the Requested NSSAI. This helps in prioritizing the S-NSSAIs and the PFBs to be used for cell selection.

question_34502.question: How does 3GPP NR handle DC subcarriers in the transmitter side?
question_34502.ground_truth: The transmitted DC subcarrier at the transmitter side is modulated, i.e., data is neither rate-matched nor punctured. The signal quality requirement for DC subcarriers is up to RAN4. The receiver should be able to determine the DC subcarrier location, either semi-statically signaled from UE or by specifying the DC subcarrier location.

question_34504.question: What message does the MME send to the eNodeB to deactivate all Radio Bearers associated with a PDN connection?
question_34504.ground_truth: The MME sends the Deactivate Bearer Request message to the eNodeB to release all Radio Bearers associated with the PDN connection.

question_34506.question: What should the MCPTT client display to the MCPTT user when the "alert-ind" element is set to "false" in the "mcpttinfo" element of a SIP re-INVITE request?
question_34506.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should display to the MCPTT user an indication of the MCPTT emergency alert cancellation and the MCPTT ID of the MCPTT user cancelling the MCPTT emergency alert.

question_34507.question: What is the role of the CommonIEsAbort SlPP Information Element?
question_34507.ground_truth: The CommonIEsAbort SlPP Information Element is used to indicate the cause of an abort event, with the options being undefined and slppMessageHeaderError.

question_34508.question: What is the role of the UE in negotiating the use of extended idle mode DRX with the network?
question_34508.ground_truth: The UE includes an extended idle mode DRX parameters information element in the Registration Request message and may also include the UE specific DRX parameters information element for regular idle mode DRX.

question_34509.question: What should the AMF do when the UE does not respond to the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message for the fourth time during network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure?
question_34509.ground_truth: The AMF should abort the network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure and consider it completed as a failure.

question_34510.question: What is the length of time that a UE must wait after a BWP-inactivity timer expires before starting a timer-based BWP switch?
question_34510.ground_truth: The UE must wait for a time duration TBWPswitchDelay, which starts from the beginning of DL slot n, where slot n is the first slot of a DL subframe immediately after the BWP-inactivity timer expires.

question_34511.question: As specified in 8.1, what radiated performance requirements limit the ability of the OTA AAS BS to correctly demodulate radiated signals?
question_34511.ground_truth: The demodulation requirements for an OTA AAS BS are limited to two OTA demodulation branches, and demodulation requirements are the same as those specified for single RAT UTRA operation in FDD, single RAT E-UTRA operation, and MSR operation.

question_34512.question: What type of error handling is described for the operation related errors in clause 10 and the TC services used for reporting operation errors are described in clause 14?
question_34512.ground_truth: Generic error handling for the operation related errors is described in clause 10 and the TC services used for reporting operation errors are described in clause 14.

question_34514.question: What are the three key end-to-end QoS metrics for an XR application?
question_34514.ground_truth: The three key end-to-end QoS metrics for an XR application are Delay, Packet loss rate, and Bit rate.

question_34516.question: What is an example of an operation in the "CAP-SMS-ops-args" module?
question_34516.ground_truth: "opcode-connectSMS" is an example of an operation in the "CAP-SMS-ops-args" module.

question_34517.question: How many voice broadcast channels are established in a cell for a given voice broadcast call?
question_34517.ground_truth: Only one voice broadcast channel is established in each cell for any given voice broadcast call, although there may be a number of simultaneous voice broadcast calls within the same cell.

question_34518.question: Which three architectures are candidate solutions to offer energy savings functionalities for SON?
question_34518.ground_truth: The three candidate architectures are distributed, centralized, and hybrid architectures.

question_34522.question: What is the action taken by the UE if it determines to use connectionless transfer at step~26?
question_34522.ground_truth: The UE obtains any location measurements or location estimate requested in step~19 and sends a positioning message to a RAN node for 3GPP access or an N3IWF for non-3GPP access.

question_34523.question: Which requirements for FR2 are only applicable to FR2-1?
question_34523.ground_truth: The requirements for FR2 that are only applicable to FR2-1 include SFTD measurement requirements in clauses 9.2.5.4, 9.3.8, 10.1.21, CGI identification requirements in clause 9.11, Inter-band CA requirements in all corresponding clauses, and L1-RSRP measurements for a cell with different PCI from serving cell in clause 9.13.

question_34526.question: What information must the NF Service Consumer include in the POST request for I-SMF Context Transfer procedure?
question_34526.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer must include the SMF transfer indication, old SMF ID, and the identifier of the SM Context resource in old SMF in the POST request.

question_34528.question: What is the purpose of "Enhanced Cell ID" (E-CID) based positioning methods?
question_34528.ground_truth: E-CID based positioning methods use UE and/or NG-RAN radio resource related measurements to improve the UE location estimate in comparison to the Cell ID (CID) positioning method.

question_34529.question: What is the role of the TBF (Traffic Channel Behavior Function) in the extended uplink mode?
question_34529.ground_truth: The TBF indicates the current number of RLC data blocks that have not been transmitted in the uplink TBF, and its value is updated and recalculated whenever the RLC entity of the mobile station receives new data from upper layers for transmission in the uplink TBF.

question_34530.question: What is the name of the user equipment (UE) protocol introduced in Rel-17 for enhancing satellite E-UTRAN radio access technology?

question_34531.question: What is one of the recommended requirements for distributing the same signal for both stationary TVs and mobiles?
question_34531.ground_truth: The ability to distribute encapsulation, media formats, and codecs supported by both types of end devices.

question_34532.question: What is tested in 8.2.2.4.5-2?
question_34532.ground_truth: The test in 8.2.2.4.5-2 verifies the minimum performance of closed-loop spatial multiplexing with 2 transmitter antennas superposed with simultaneous PDSCH interference.

question_34534.question: What mode of RLC operation does a TBF use?
question_34534.ground_truth: A TBF may operate in either RLC acknowledged mode, RLC unacknowledged mode or RLC transparent mode.

question_34535.question: What is the minimum number of V2X data and SLSS transmissions that the V2X UE is allowed to drop or delay during T2 in the V2X Synchronization Reference Selection/Reselection test?
question_34535.ground_truth: The V2X UE is allowed to drop or delay no more than 6% of its V2X data and SLSS transmissions during T2.

question_34537.question: What action does the MME take when the timer expires after step 4 during the Serving GW relocation procedure?
question_34537.ground_truth: After the timer expires, the MME releases the bearer(s) in the old Serving GW by sending a Delete Session Request message, which tells the old Serving GW not to initiate a delete procedure towards the PDN GW. The old Serving GW acknowledges the message, and the MME includes any Secondary RAT usage data if the eNodeB had provided it during the procedure.

question_34538.question: How many downlink timeslots are assigned in the Class 19 and 24 test, and under what condition are non-hopping channels assigned for PDCHs?
question_34538.ground_truth: Five downlink timeslots are assigned in the Class 19 and 24 test, and non-hopping channels are assigned for PDCHs when the channels are not within the same frequency band.

question_34539.question: What is the procedure for the "SET UP CALL" command when the ME is not busy with another call?
question_34539.ground_truth: When the ME is not busy with another call, the procedure for the "SET UP CALL" command involves executing a set of commands defined in the expected sequence (e.g., 4.9, 4.10) of the 3GPP standard.

question_34540.question: What does ECS stand for in the context of 5.4.3.3.3?
question_34540.ground_truth: ECS stands for Edge Computing Service in the context of 5.4.3.3.3.

question_34541.question: What is the procedure used between the Presentity Presence Proxy and the HSS, referred to as the Px interface?
question_34541.ground_truth: The procedures between the Presentity Presence Proxy and the HSS, referred to as the Px interface, are handled using the mechanisms defined for the Cx interface.

question_34543.question: What is the responsibility of the NWDAF in the UPF selection process with analytics information?
question_34543.ground_truth: The NWDAF provides analytics on UPFs load based on information from OAM and is responsible for UPF selection in collaboration with the SMF. It considers historical information and predictions, as well as statistics and predictions on UE mobility and UPF load.

question_34544.question: What is the role of the LMF in Network assisted Sidelink Positioning?
question_34544.ground_truth: The LMF is responsible for triggering the Ranging/Sidelink positioning procedure, deriving the UE location estimation based on Ranging/Sidelink positioning and Uu positioning measurements, and providing the LCS location estimation of the UE to the GMLC.

question_34545.question: What is the purpose of the path switching procedure from the direct communication path over PC5 to the direct communication path over Uu?
question_34545.ground_truth: The purpose of this procedure is to enable a ProSe-enabled UE to switch the communication path from the direct communication path over PC5 to the direct communication path over Uu when the UE is communicating with another ProSe-enabled UE via the direct communication path over PC5.

question_34546.question: What is the 3GPP Technical Specification Group that defines the 3GPP file format used by the PSS and MMS services?

question_34548.question: What does the PCF do when the RAN and the UPF have been requested to perform the measurement of QoS Monitoring parameters?
question_34548.ground_truth: The PCF requests the RAN and the UPF to perform the measurement of the QoS Monitoring parameters as needed and as defined in clause 5.8.2.18 of TS23.501.

question_34549.question: What should the network do if the erasure request for CFNRc is not successful?
question_34549.ground_truth: The network shall return an error indication to the MS, indicating that the erasure of CFNRc was unsuccessful.

question_34551.question: What is the purpose of the TFCP indication in the UE and UPF?
question_34551.ground_truth: The TFCP indication in the UE and UPF detects the existing of the TFCP header for packets transported via one PDU session, one QoS flow, or one traffic flow. It differentiates the TFCP packets from other packets in the same QoS flow or PDU session.

question_34552.question: When does a UE not expect to detect, in a same PDCCH monitoring occasion, a DCI format with CRC scrambled by a SI-RNTI, RA-RNTI, MsgB-RNTI, TC-RNTI, P-RNTI, C-RNTI, CS-RNTI, MCS-RNTI, MCCH-RNTI, G-RNTI, G-CS-RNTI, or multicast-MCCH-RNTI and a DCI format with CRC scrambled by a SL-RNTI or SL-CS-RNTI for scheduling respective PDSCH reception and PSSCH transmission on a same serving cell?
question_34552.ground_truth: A UE does not expect to detect, in a same PDCCH monitoring occasion, a DCI format with CRC scrambled by a SI-RNTI, RA-RNTI, MsgB-RNTI, TC-RNTI, P-RNTI, C-RNTI, CS-RNTI, MCS-RNTI, MCCH-RNTI, G-RNTI, G-CS-RNTI, or multicast-MCCH-RNTI and a DCI format with CRC scrambled by a SL-RNTI or SL-CS-RNTI for scheduling respective PDSCH reception and PSSCH transmission on a same serving cell.

question_34553.question: What action does the eCall capable MS take upon completion of the T3243 timer?
question_34553.ground_truth: Upon completion of the T3243 timer, the eCall capable MS performs an IMSI detach from the network.

question_34554.question: What were the specific spurious requirements defined for co-existence with GSM 900, DCS1800, and PHS?
question_34554.ground_truth: The values were derived from the requirements of the system under consideration.

question_34557.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Report on TR on V2V Services based on LTE sidelink?
question_34557.ground_truth: The purpose of the report is to study the radio requirements on V2V services based on LTE sidelink as part of the Rel-14 work item.

question_34558.question: What is the purpose of Solution #6: Handling C2 connection over PC5?
question_34558.ground_truth: Solution #6 aims to address KI#1 "Transport C2 communication over PC5 interface" by enabling UAV and UAV-C to communicate with each other via C2 connection over PC5. It provides C2 connection status information to the application layer, allowing the user to decide on the C2 communication method. The UAS layer, located between the application layer and the AS layer, is responsible for PC5 related operations.

question_34560.question: What is the purpose of <dfname> in the 8.45 +CCHO command?
question_34560.ground_truth: The <dfname> is used in the 8.45 +CCHO command to select the application in the currently selected UICC that the TE wants to communicate with using logical channels.

question_34561.question: What happens when in-order delivery is required for some QoS flows in the SN?
question_34561.ground_truth: The SN buffers the first packets received from the UE for a certain QoS flow until it receives an GTP-U end marker packet indicating that the MN has delivered all UL packets for that QoS flow.

question_34562.question: What is the relationship between e.i.r.p. and e.r.p. in terms of dB?
question_34562.ground_truth: There is a constant difference of 2,15 dB between e.i.r.p. and e.r.p.

question_34563.question: Which method retrieves an individual SM context resource from SMF, V-SMF for HR roaming scenario, or I-SMF?
question_34563.ground_truth: The "retrieve" custom operation is used to retrieve an individual SM context resource from SMF, V-SMF for HR roaming scenario, or I-SMF.

question_34566.question: What does the Code specific field in the Session-identifier information element indicate?
question_34566.ground_truth: The Code specific field in the Session-identifier information element indicates the type of information that is used to identify the session across.

question_34567.question: What is the advantage of Solution 5 over Solution 3 when the successfully delivered NR PDCP PDU SN block size for a certain block is smaller than or equal to 256?
question_34567.ground_truth: The extra cost of the F1/Xn-U of Solution 5 is smaller than the Solution 3.

question_34568.question: What kind of positioning method uses a network of ground-based transmitters for calculating the UE's location?

question_34569.question: What tolerance is included in the test requirements for maximum and minimum changes in transmitted power in steps f), i), and l)?
question_34569.ground_truth: A tolerance of 1 dB is included in the test requirements for maximum and minimum changes in transmitted power in steps f), i), and l).

question_34575.question: How is the start of the SI-window determined for the concerned SI message in the schedulingInfoList?
question_34575.ground_truth: For the concerned SI message in the schedulingInfoList, the start of the SI-window is determined by first determining the number n corresponding to the order of entry in the list, then calculating the integer value x = (n-1) x w, where w is the si-WindowLength, and finally determining the slot a based on the radio frame SFN and T, where T is the si-Periodicity of the concerned SI message and N is the number of slots in a radio frame.

question_34576.question: How should the MAC entity select a set of Random Access resources when there are no sets associated with any feature indication?
question_34576.ground_truth: The MAC entity should consider the set of Random Access resources to not be associated with any feature indication.

question_34579.question: What is the action taken by the NRM server after evaluating the fulfilment/non-fulfilment of the end-to-end QoS in a single pair of UEs communication?
question_34579.ground_truth: The NRM server determines an action, which is the QoS parameter adaptation of one or both links, resulting in a QoS profile downgrade for the link receive QoS notification control or an upgrade for the link that can be upgraded.

question_34580.question: What should the UE use as the first ECCE index for transmission of a corresponding DCI assignment in MPDCCH-PRB-set when using localized transmission?
question_34580.ground_truth: The UE should use the lowest ECCE index used to construct the MPDCCH in the MPDCCH-PRB-set for transmission of the corresponding DCI assignment.

question_34581.question: What determines the Multislot Capability of a mobile station?
question_34581.ground_truth: A value called Multislot Class implicitly determines the Multislot Capability of a mobile station.

question_34585.question: In the SMLC and LCS system, what are the three signalling endpoints for the LCS signalling model?
question_34585.ground_truth: The three signalling endpoints for the LCS signalling model are the SMLC, the LMU, and the LCS-assisted MS.

question_34586.question: What does MBMS-service-associated signalling mean?
question_34586.ground_truth: It is a method in 3GPP network where M2AP messages associated to one MBMS service uses the MBMS-service-associated logical M2-connection for association of the message to the respective MBMS service in eNB and EPC.

question_34587.question: What is the purpose of pre-selecting an MC service user profile for an MC service UE?
question_34587.ground_truth: Pre-selecting an MC service user profile is used to set the MC service user profile to be pre-selected by the MC service server at the next MC service authorization, which can be changed by user interaction or some automated means.

question_34588.question: What is the implication of the statement "The same QoS applies to all MBS service areas of a location dependent MBS Session"?
question_34588.ground_truth: The same Quality of Service (QoS) is provided for all MBS service areas of a location dependent MBS Session, ensuring consistent user experience across different locations.

question_34589.question: What is defined as the relative accuracy of RSRQ in inter-frequency case?
question_34589.ground_truth: The relative accuracy of RSRQ in inter-frequency case is defined as the RSRQ measured from one cell compared to the RSRQ measured from another cell on a different frequency.

question_34591.question: What entity is responsible for discovering and selecting SMF instances during 3GPP access and non-3GPP access for managing the PDU session?
question_34591.ground_truth: The SMF selection functionality in the AMF and SCP

question_34592.question: What is the purpose of the AKMA Key Repository Service (AKRS) in this solution?
question_34592.ground_truth: The AKRS is a service that provides the functionality to retrieve a KAKMA derived from KSEAF for AKMA purposes and store the KSEAF. It can be collocated with the SEAF or AUSF, or run standalone.

question_34593.question: What information must be included in the first RAB ASSIGNMENT RESPONSE message?
question_34593.ground_truth: The first RAB ASSIGNMENT RESPONSE message must include the result for all the requested RABs, such as the list of RABs successfully established or modified, released, failed to establish or modify, or queued.

question_34594.question: What is manual cross-certification in the context of NDS?
question_34594.ground_truth: Manual cross-certification refers to the mutual cross-certifications established directly between the CAs. The CAs need to have a certificate signed by the local CA for each security domain they wish to trust. This approach requires the management of several certificates locally, but it provides a flexible trust management.

question_34595.question: What is the role of a 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-UE relay UE in satisfying the end-to-end QoS requirement between two 5G ProSe layer-3 end UEs?
question_34595.ground_truth: A 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-UE relay UE satisfies the end-to-end QoS requirement between two 5G ProSe layer-3 end UEs by performing QoS control between the source and target end UEs and through the PC5 interface.

question_34596.question: What is the role of the MCC (Management Committee Chair) in relation to the specification rapporteur?
question_34596.ground_truth: The MCC, in cooperation with the specification rapporteur, is responsible for reviewing all CRs (Change Requests) to the specification prior to agreement in the Working Group. The MCC also oversees the technical quality of the specification and serves as a focal point for technical questions.

question_34597.question: Upon receipt of a RELEASE COMPLETE message related to a SS transaction, what should the MS do to maintain the original transaction?
question_34597.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a RELEASE COMPLETE message related to a SS transaction, the MS should release the current SS transaction, but keep the first transaction unaffected.

question_34600.question: Who were the participants in the listening tests conducted by Fraunhofer IIS?
question_34600.ground_truth: The participants were chosen from the Audio Division at Fraunhofer IIS and were considered to be expert listeners. External expert listeners also participated in the test.

question_34601.question: What is the purpose of the Power Headroom reporting procedure in NB-IoT?
question_34601.ground_truth: The Power Headroom reporting procedure is used to provide the serving eNB with information about the difference between the nominal UE maximum transmit power and the estimated power for UL-SCH transmission or SRS transmission per activated Serving Cell in NB-IoT. This information is important for managing uplink resources and maintaining the required power backoff due to power management.

question_34602.question: How does 3GPP TS 28.651 define a Network Resource Model (NRM) IRP?
question_34602.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 28.651 does not define a Network Resource Model (NRM) IRP, instead, it defines the requirements for a NRM IRP for the UTRAN network, in a series of documents including 3GPP TS 28.651, 3GPP TS 28.652, and 3GPP TS 28.653.

question_34603.question: What system determines the alarm level and automatically requests a call or text to be initiated in the described use case?
question_34603.ground_truth: The medical center, also known as the data measuring and policy decision center, determines the alarm level based on a policy and requests a call or text to be initiated.

question_34604.question: What should a UE be capable of in order to handle a relative receive timing difference in FDD inter-band NE-DC with overlapping DL bands, when it is not capable of asynchronous FDD-FDD NE-DC operation?
question_34604.ground_truth: The UE should be capable of synchronized operation.

question_34605.question: What is an ATSSS rule composed of, as defined in 3GPP TS 23.501?
question_34605.ground_truth: An ATSSS rule is composed of an ATSSS rule ID, an ATSSS rule operation, a precedence value of the ATSSS rule, a traffic descriptor matching a service data flow (SDF), and an access selection descriptor.

question_34606.question: What events are associated with one access of a multi-access PDN connection in IP-CAN bearer charging?
question_34606.ground_truth: IP-CAN bearer modification, except QoS change events, are associated with one access of a multi-access PDN connection in IP-CAN bearer charging.

question_34608.question: What is the difference between Current Location and Last Known Location in Location Reporting Monitoring Event?
question_34608.ground_truth: Current Location is the real-time location of the UE, while Last Known Location is the most recently reported location of the UE.

question_34609.question: What is the role of the E-CSCF in the domain transfer of an emergency session from the CS domain towards IMS?
question_34609.ground_truth: The E-CSCF routes the INVITE for domain transfer from CS to IMS to the DTF, which completes the establishment of the Access Leg via IMS.

question_34610.question: What is the implication of not supporting SMS transport over a generic IP-CAN?
question_34610.ground_truth: Users will receive the SMS service using another messaging service, if operator policy allows it.

question_34611.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects in the telecommunication management domain?
question_34611.ground_truth: The purpose is to specify technical requirements and information models for telecommunications management, in particular for the Notification Log Integration Reference Point (IRP) as defined in TS 32.331.

question_34612.question: What is the test requirement for the UE to transmit a measurement report containing the cell global identifier of cell 2 within the time defined by the test, and the minimum number of ACK/NACKs the UE must detect during the test?
question_34612.ground_truth: The test requires the UE to transmit a measurement report containing the cell global identifier of cell 2 within 170 ms from the start of T3, and detect at least 80 ACK/NACKs from the start of T3 until 170 ms. A total of 90% successful tests are required with a 95% confidence level for the test to pass.

question_34613.question: Who is authorized to cancel the floor requests of other MCPTT users in the floor request queue?
question_34613.ground_truth: An authorized MCPTT user with the rights to cancel another MCPTT user's floor request.

question_34615.question: What information should be included in the Vertical Accuracy Code, if available, in connection with Geographical Area?
question_34615.ground_truth: The Vertical Accuracy Code should be included, if available, in connection with Geographical Area to provide vertical position information.

question_34617.question: As defined in section 26.8.1.3.3.1 of the document, what should the MS do when it enters the state U9, "MS Terminating Call Confirmed" and receives a signal information in the preceding SETUP message?
question_34617.ground_truth: As defined in section 26.8.1.3.3.1 of the document, a CC entity in CC-state U9, "MS Terminating Call Confirmed", should either send a ALERTING message to its peer entity and enter state U7 or send a CONNECT message to its peer entity and enter U8, when a signal information is received in the preceding SETUP message.

question_34619.question: What standard specifies the GSM half rate speech codec for the digital cellular telecommunications system?

question_34620.question: What is the purpose of the discovery security materials and authorization tokens in the described procedure?
question_34620.ground_truth: The discovery security materials and authorization tokens are used to establish a secure communication between UEs and authorize their roles in the Ranging and Sidelink Positioning services.

question_34622.question: What should the AMF do if there is no full native 5G NAS security context available when processing a Registration Request message?
question_34622.ground_truth: The AMF should initiate a primary authentication run if there is no full native 5G NAS security context available.

question_34623.question: What should the SMF do when it receives a 5GSM STATUS message with cause value #97?
question_34623.ground_truth: The SMF should abort any ongoing 5GSM procedure related to the PTI or PDU session Id and stop any related timer.

question_34626.question: What is the function of BBIFF-C and BBIFF-U in the context of N9HR LI?
question_34626.ground_truth: BBIFF-C in N9HR architecture provides the BBIFF-C function, responsible for signalling, while BBIFF-U provides the BBIFF-U function, responsible for user plane related tasks in N9HR LI.

question_34628.question: What is the effect of the filter insertion loss in the uplink path of Band 17 on the maximum sensitivity degradation (MSD) for Band 4?
question_34628.ground_truth: The filter insertion loss of 0.5 dB in the uplink path of Band 17 increases the MSD for Band 4 by 0.5 dB for both 5 MHz and 10 MHz channel bandwidths.

question_34629.question: What type of interferer structures can be used to characterize different types of interferers in the solution for the CQI mismatch issue?
question_34629.ground_truth: The different types of interferers can be characterized by the interferer transmitting a different modulation type (e.g. QPSK, 16QAM, or 64QAM), a TBS (Transport Block Size) that can be successfully decoded by the UE that performs interference cancellation, or at (or above) a certain power level.

question_34630.question: In the operation package scfActivationPackage, what is the operation signature invoking the initialDP?

question_34632.question: How does a network sharing supporting UE behave after step 3 in the described scenario, if a different PLMN is chosen in step 2?
question_34632.ground_truth: After step 3, the UE may change its PLMN if the one chosen by the UE is not the same as the serving PLMN/operator chosen by the source RAN during handover.

question_34633.question: In the context of antenna measurements, what is TRP?
question_34633.ground_truth: TRP stands for Total Radiated Power. It is a measure of how much power is radiated by a device in all directions, taking into account both the main beam and any sidelobes.

question_34634.question: What are the required tolerances for the transmitter output power when commanding the transmitter to a power control level outside of its capability?
question_34634.ground_truth: The transmitter output power shall be within the tolerances for the closest power control level corresponding to the type and power class as stated by the manufacturer.

question_34635.question: What is the procedure called when the SMF takes the initiative to activate or deactivate the User Plane connection of a PDU session?
question_34635.ground_truth: Network Triggered Service Request or CN-initiated selective deactivation of the User Plane connection of a PDU session.

question_34637.question: What is one of the elemental components of network controlled mobility for inter-gNB handover, as specified in TS 38.300 clause 9.2.3.1?
question_34637.ground_truth: One of the elemental components of network controlled mobility for inter-gNB handover, as specified in TS 38.300 clause 9.2.3.1, is that the source gNB initiates handover and issues a HANDOVER REQUEST over the Xn interface.

question_34639.question: What should the MCPTT client do upon receiving a SIP 183(Session Progress) response to the SIP INVITE request?
question_34639.ground_truth: The MCPTT client may indicate the progress of the session establishment to the inviting MCPTT user.

question_34640.question: What is the difference between the steps taken in procedure 5.4.2 (Solution A) and the existing IP flow mobility specification for handling IP flow mobility actions when the admission control function rejects a request?
question_34640.ground_truth: In procedure 5.4.2, the HA does not immediately respond with a Binding acknowledge to the UE upon receiving the IP flow mobility request. Instead, the PCEF waits until the PCRF performs admission control in the BBF access network before sending the Binding acknowledgement to the UE. If the BBF access network rejects the request, the PCRF rejects the IP flow mobility routing rule, which then leads to the HA rejecting the IP flow mobility request. This differs from the existing IP flow mobility specification, where the actions taken when the admission control function rejects a request are not specified.

question_34643.question: What is the main goal of reusing UMTS management solutions for E-UTRAN and EPC?
question_34643.ground_truth: The main goal is to minimize standardization and product development efforts, reduce costs and time, provide a base for further functionality development, and ensure a seamless coexistence with UMTS management systems.

question_34644.question: What is the role of HLR in the CCBS service between GSM networks and ISDN networks?
question_34644.ground_truth: The HLR shall provide any necessary signalling interworking between the MAP protocol for call completion services on the MAP D-interface (between the VLR and the HLR) and ISDN CCBS-ASE protocol between the originating and destination networks.

question_34645.question: What protocol is used between the Application Server and the MRFC over the Mr' interface?
question_34645.ground_truth: The protocol used between the Application Server and the MRFC over the Mr' interface is based on Session Initiation Protocol (SIP), as specified in 3GPP TS 24.229.

question_34646.question: Who is the primary consumer of Network Slice Information in 9.17?
question_34646.ground_truth: The VAL server is the primary consumer of Network Slice Information in 9.17.

question_34648.question: What does the ho-NumberNotRequired parameter indicate when included by MSC-A in the Prepare-Handover request?
question_34648.ground_truth: The ho-NumberNotRequired parameter is included by MSC-A, when MSC-A decides not to use any circuit connection with MSC-B.

question_34651.question: What must the GANC ensure when requesting the uplink data rate for a PFC?
question_34651.ground_truth: The GANC must never request an uplink data rate that is lower than the guaranteed uplink bit rate for the PFC, unless the Traffic Class is Interactive class or Background class.

question_34653.question: What protocols are used over the Nc and Mc interfaces in the bearer-independent circuit-switched core network?
question_34653.ground_truth: The protocol used over the Nc interface is an enhanced call control protocol supporting call bearer separation such as BICC, and the protocol used over the Mc interface is H.248.

question_34654.question: What state is the MS in at the end of the test procedure?
question_34654.ground_truth: The MS is in the "Idle, updated" state, with TMSI allocated.

question_34655.question: What Command Code value is used for the ProSe-Authorization-Request (PAR) Command in this specification?
question_34655.ground_truth: The ProSe-Authorization-Request (PAR) Command is indicated by the Command-Code field set to 8388668.

question_34658.question: What is the purpose of the UE in setting up a unicast bearer in case of eMBMS bearer loss?
question_34658.ground_truth: The UE sets up a unicast bearer in case of eMBMS bearer loss to continue receiving the same session.

question_34659.question: What is the implication for NF Service Producers when they register their profile in NRF for restricted Inter-slice access?
question_34659.ground_truth: They need to include a new information element, "allowedSnssaisPerSnssai", which specifies, for each NF-Service Consumer's S-NSSAI, the list of NF-Service Producer's S-NSSAIs it is allowed to access.

question_34660.question: What is the central element of the IN-based solution for Mobile Number Portability (MNP)?

question_34662.question: How many time periods are there in the test scenario described in 6.3.1.7.4.2?
question_34662.ground_truth: The test scenario consists of five successive time periods, with time durations of T1, T2, T3, T4 and T5.

question_34663.question: What should a UE do when it receives a registration reject message with a specific 5GMM cause value over non-3GPP access and it is already registered over another access?
question_34663.ground_truth: The UE should enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE and may perform a registration attempt over the non-3GPP access if another access point for non-3GPP access is available.

question_34664.question: What is the format of the homing frames used in the decoder?
question_34664.ground_truth: The homing frames used in the decoder are in 15-bit-long format, where the parameters are packed into 15-bit-long format in serial format.

question_34665.question: What information is required to be included in the "imminent peril group state cancel" procedure, as specified in subclause 7.5.2.15?
question_34665.ground_truth: In step 2) the MCData client 1 should set the imminent peril indicator. In step 5), MCData users should be notified of the in-progress imminent peril state cancel.

question_34666.question: What information is transmitted through SCI format 2-B for the decoding of PSSCH, with HARQ operation when HARQ-ACK information includes only NACK, or when there is no feedback of HARQ-ACK information?
question_34666.ground_truth: The information transmitted by means of the SCI format 2-B includes HARQ process number, new data indicator, redundancy version, source ID, destination ID, HARQ feedback enabled/disabled indicator, and zone ID.

question_34668.question: What is the initial state of the mobile station at the start of the test procedure?
question_34668.ground_truth: The mobile station (MS) is in MM-state "idle, updated" with valid TMSI and CKSN.

question_34669.question: What should a receiving node do when it receives a response message containing one or more IEs/IE groups marked as "Ignore IE and Notify Sender" which it does not comprehend?
question_34669.ground_truth: The receiving node should ignore the content of the not comprehended IEs/IE groups, continue with the procedure using the understood IEs/IE groups, and initiate the Error Indication procedure to report that one or more IEs/IE groups have been ignored.

question_34671.question: What is the bandwidth required for the channel to be tested?
question_34671.ground_truth: The channel bandwidth to be tested is 10 MHz.

question_34672.question: What should the 3GPP network enable hosting of?
question_34672.ground_truth: The 3GPP network should enable hosting of services (including both MNO provided services and 3rd party provided services) closer to the end user.

question_34673.question: What is the requirement for HTTP error handling as specified in clause 5.2.4?
question_34673.ground_truth: The requirement for HTTP error handling as specified in clause 5.2.4 is that HTTP/2 connection error and stream error shall be supported as specified in clause 5.4 of IETF RFC 9113. Guidelines for error responses to the invocation of APIs of NF services are specified in clause 4.8 of 3GPP TS 29.501, and API specific error responses are specified in the respective technical specifications.

question_34674.question: In what state is the floor control arbitration logic when no MCPTT user currently has permission to send media?
question_34674.ground_truth: The 'G: Floor Idle' state, where the floor control arbitration logic is waiting for a floor request or a queued floor request to be processed.

question_34675.question: When is an E-CSCF used to forward the Re-INVITE in SRVCC for IMS emergency session when the IMS emergency session is active session?
question_34675.ground_truth: An E-CSCF is used to forward the Re-INVITE to the MGCF associated with the PSAP if the PSAP is located in the PSTN or CS Domain, or the Re-INVITE is sent directly to an IP-capable PSAP.

question_34676.question: What is IMS-based Presence in the context of 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects?
question_34676.ground_truth: IMS-based Presence refers to the capability of the IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS) to provide real-time information about the availability and status of users and services, allowing operators to offer a wide range of new multimedia services and applications.

question_34680.question: What is the maximum number of interruptions allowed on a serving cell during MIB decoding time period TMIB when identifying CGI of an NR cell with autonomous gaps?

question_34681.question: How is the adaptive selection performed in the excitation generation process?
question_34681.ground_truth: The adaptive selection is performed by sending 1 bit per sub-frame. The excitation is generated either through the adaptive codebook or its low pass-filtered version, and the path which results in minimum energy of the target signal is selected for the filtered adaptive codebook vector.

question_34682.question: What restrictions might occur when the network determines "user busy" in the customer network?
question_34682.ground_truth: Determination of "network determined user busy" by the network might restrict the ability to deploy and support end user devices which perform local services based on "user determined user busy".

question_34683.question: Which value in the thirty-second to thirty-fourth bits of the Cell-Capability-Container bit string indicates support for three frequencies four cells?

question_34684.question: What is required for the test described in 6.7.6.1.4 to pass?
question_34684.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values in each test must be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_34685.question: What metric was used to evaluate the playout robustness in the transmission simulation?
question_34685.ground_truth: Erroneous Seconds Ratio (ESR) was used to evaluate the playout robustness in the transmission simulation.

question_34686.question: What are the two ways off-network transmission control can be performed?
question_34686.ground_truth: The two ways are single arbitrator, where transmission participants rely on a single participant designated as transmission arbitrator for the arbitration of transmission requests, and self arbitration, where each transmission participant arbitrates its own transmission based on its view of the topology.

question_34687.question: What intermodulation interference is present when Band 13 and Band 46 are operated together?
question_34687.ground_truth: There is a 3rd harmonic interference from Band 13 UL to Band 46 DL.

question_34689.question: What was the increase in capacity performance for FR1, Uma, DL, for VR/AR, with single stream traffic model, DDDUU/DDDSU TDD format, with MU-MIMO, 45Mbps, 10ms PDB, 60 FPS, when using cooperative MIMO/precoding compared to zero-forcing precoding?

question_34690.question: What are the mandatory elements that the <MCPTT-Group-Priority> element shall contain?
question_34690.ground_truth: The <MCPTT-Group-Priority> element shall contain an <MCPTT-Group-ID> element and a <group-priority-hierarchy> element.

question_34691.question: In the E-UTRAN initiated UE Context Modification procedure, what is the function of the Master eNodeB when adding an hybrid HeNB as the SeNodeB?
question_34691.ground_truth: The Master eNodeB sends UE Context Modification Indication message to the MME, including the CSG-ID and the CSG Membership Information of the SeNodeB.

question_34692.question: What is the measurement provided in 4.3.1 a) in UMTS?
question_34692.ground_truth: This measurement provides the number of attempts by RNC to establish an Iu control plane connection between the RNC and a CS CN in UMTS.

question_34693.question: What action should the MS take if a lower layer failure occurs on the new channel before the ASSIGNMENT COMPLETE message has been sent during a dedicated assignment procedure?
question_34693.ground_truth: The MS should deactivate the new channels, reactivate the old channels, reconnect the TCHs if any, trigger the establishment of the main signalling link, send a ASSIGNMENT FAILURE message with cause "protocol error unspecified" on the main DCCH, and resume normal operation as if no assignment attempt occurred.

question_34694.question: What are the requirements for frequency range 1 and frequency range 2 in receiver characteristics for bands operating on NR?
question_34694.ground_truth: The receiver characteristics for bands operating on NR are specified at the antenna connector(s) of the UE for frequency range 1 and over the air of the UE for frequency range 2. The requirements for frequency range 1 and frequency range 2 can be verified separately. For the carrier in frequency range 1, requirements can be verified with NR FR2 link disabled. For the carrier in frequency range 2, requirements can be verified in OTA mode with E-UTRA connecting to the network by OTA without calibration.

question_34695.question: When reassembling SN-PDUs, how are DCOMP, PCOMP and N-PDU number obtained?
question_34695.ground_truth: During reassembly, DCOMP and PCOMP for an N-PDU are retrieved from the first segment (F bit set to 1), and for acknowledged peer-to-peer LLC operation, the N-PDU number is also retrieved from the first segment.

question_34696.question: What is the maximum total EVM allowed for 256QAM to outperform 64QAM in terms of throughput, assuming a 3% Tx EVM and a TDL-A channel?

question_34699.question: How is the UE ID field and BEARER ID field determined for an SRAP Data PDU received from SL-RLC0 in U2N Relay UE?
question_34699.ground_truth: The UE ID field is determined based on the sl-L2IdentityRemote that matches the Layer-2 ID of the remote UE from which the SRAP Data PDU is received, and the BEARER ID field is determined as 0.

question_34700.question: What message MIME type should be included in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-transmission-request+xml message for each currently transmitting MCVideo client?

question_34702.question: What is the name of the complex type used for defining the geometry area in the "tGeographicalAreaChange" complex type?
question_34702.ground_truth: The name of the complex type used for defining the geometry area is "tSpecificAreaType".

question_34704.question: Under what circumstances should the mobile station start to use the LLC NULL frame to perform cell updates?
question_34704.ground_truth: In A/Gb mode, if the ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message contains the Cell Notification information element.

question_34705.question: What should be the measurement reporting delay for Event A6 and Event A1?
question_34705.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay for both Event A6 and Event A1 should be less than 6402 ms from the beginning of time period T2.

question_34706.question: What adaptations are required for eV2X unicast link establishment?
question_34706.ground_truth: The establishment procedure can be reused for eV2X unicast link establishment, with the adapted use of RRC signaling messages instead of PC5 signaling messages. Also, the messages should be transmitted using default AS layer settings that can be understood by the receiving UE.

question_34707.question: What does the RAT field value 51 represent in the 3GPP-RAT-Type sub-attribute?
question_34707.ground_truth: The RAT field value 51 represents NR, which is a Radio Access Technology.

question_34709.question: In what scenario will the UE not diagnose an error and further process the create request for a new mapped EPS bearer context?
question_34709.ground_truth: When the "Create new EPS bearer" operation is used and there is no existing mapped EPS bearer context with the same EPS bearer identity associated with any PDU session.

question_34710.question: What type of solutions are provided by Solution 1 and Solution 9 for analytic services?
question_34710.ground_truth: Solution 1 provides statistics and predictions, while Solution 9 provides recommendations.

question_34712.question: What should the Mobile Station do after deactivating PSM?
question_34712.ground_truth: The Mobile Station should send a ROUTING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message indicating a new value of the T3324 timer set to 'deactivated'.

question_34713.question: What is the requirement for the average transmit power per PRB to be aligned across both assigned carriers in the reference subframe, in order for the UE to meet the requirements for transmission on both assigned component carriers?
question_34713.ground_truth: The UE must meet the requirements for all possible combinations of PUSCH and PUCCH transitions per component carrier, and for SRS transitions on each component carrier. It must also meet the requirements for RACH on the primary component carrier.

question_34714.question: What is the definition of "symbol" and "abbreviation" as used in the present document?
question_34714.ground_truth: In the present document, a "symbol" refers to a format for representing a specific term or concept, while an "abbreviation" is a shortened form of a word or phrase.

question_34715.question: What is the purpose of the "Retransmission flag" parameter?
question_34715.ground_truth: The "Retransmission flag" parameter indicates whether the NR PDCP PDU is a retransmission NR-U packet or not.

question_34716.question: What action does the network take when the attach request is rejected due to core network redirection for CIoT optimizations?
question_34716.ground_truth: The network sets the EMM cause value to #31 "Redirection to 5GCN required" and takes into account the UE's N1 mode capability, the 5GS CIoT network behavior supported by the UE, or the 5GS CIoT network behavior supported by the 5GCN to determine the rejection.

question_34717.question: What is the expected call control result for Expected Sequence 4.3?
question_34717.ground_truth: The expected call control result for Expected Sequence 4.3 is "Allowed with modifications".

question_34718.question: Which TWIF message is sent to the SMS-SC to request the submission of a trigger to the UE?
question_34718.ground_truth: The NEF acts as an MTC-IWF and sends a Submit Trigger message to the SMS-SC as specified in clause~4.13.2.2.8.

question_34720.question: What are some potential benefits of using ambient power-enabled IoT devices in the 5G era?
question_34720.ground_truth: Some potential benefits of using ambient power-enabled IoT devices in the 5G era include the ability to deploy devices in extreme environmental conditions, the use of maintenance-free devices, and the availability of ultra-low complexity, very small device size, and longer life cycle for mass market use cases.

question_34721.question: What must the UE do if it supports V2X communication over E-UTRAN-PC5 or NR-PC5?
question_34721.ground_truth: The UE should set the V2X PC5 bit to "V2X communication over E-UTRAN-PC5 supported" or the V2X NR-PC5 bit to "V2X communication over NR-PC5 supported" in the UE network capability IE of the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

question_34722.question: What should the UE do when it detects physical layer recovery while T310 is running?
question_34722.ground_truth: The UE should resume the RRC connection without explicit signaling.

question_34723.question: What is the difference between the HUT and AAU models in terms of their uniformity and the XPR?
question_34723.ground_truth: The HUT model is uniform in the azimuth angle but non-uniform in the elevation angle with an XPR of 10.7 dB, while the AAU model is non-uniform in both azimuth and elevation angle with an XPR of 5.5 dB.

question_34724.question: What must the responding station do when it receives a power saving control command message?
question_34724.ground_truth: The responding station must acknowledge this command with a power saving control response message but need not obey the command to enter a low-power state.

question_34725.question: What should the PCF do when deriving PCC Rules for non-MPS service and the Priority PDU connectivity service is invoked?
question_34725.ground_truth: The PCF should upgrade the ARP and/or change the 5QI of the PCC Rules to appropriate values for MPS.

question_34727.question: What happens to the data traffic from the Application Layer if it doesn't have a Group Identifier associated?
question_34727.ground_truth: The V2X layer sets the PC5 QoS parameters based on the default mapping between PSID/ITS-AID and PC5 QoS parameters and Range, and then passes it to the AS layer for transmission.

question_34728.question: What is the limit for spurious emissions in the bands 460.4 MHz to 467.6 MHz and 488.8 MHz to 496 MHz for GSM 400 MS?
question_34728.ground_truth: The limit for spurious emissions in the bands 460.4 MHz to 467.6 MHz and 488.8 MHz to 496 MHz for GSM 400 MS is -67 dBm, except in up to three measurements in each of the bands 460.4 MHz to 467.6 MHz and 488.8 MHz to 496 MHz where a level up to -36 dBm is permitted.

question_34729.question: What was the reason for choosing a capacity of 512 bits for the Tuak function?
question_34729.ground_truth: A capacity of 512 bits was chosen for the Tuak function for close alignment with the forthcoming NIST standards.

question_34730.question: What are the compatibility and integration aspects of 5G with legacy communication systems in the energy infrastructure domain?
question_34730.ground_truth: 5G compatibility with legacy systems has been reduced compared to 2G through 4G. However, a 2G, 3G, or 4G system can still be operated simultaneously with the 5G system to maintain support for existing services. Realistically, MNO access to spectrum makes it suboptimal for operations to maintain diverse legacy access networks. Volt's equipment are subject to different decisions taken by various MNO's in the world regions where they operate.

question_34731.question: What are the rules for naming subclasses of the Link IOC?
question_34731.ground_truth: The subclass names of Link IOC shall have the form "Link<X><Y>" where <X> is a string that represents the IOC at one end of the association, and <Y> is a string that represents the IOC at the other end. The order of the two strings should be alphabetically before.

question_34732.question: In the mobile IAB-node RLF recovery procedure described in clause 8.17.4, what corresponds to the Recovery IAB-node?

question_34733.question: What security mechanism should the P-CSCF support, as specified in RFC 3329?

question_34734.question: How does Solution #5 address the problem of keeping the serving operator in case of cell reselection when the UE lacks registration in the source CS domain?
question_34734.ground_truth: Solution #5 includes a solution for keeping the serving operator at cell reselection when the UE lacks registration in the source CS domain.

question_34735.question: What is the requirement for the amount of reference points measured in the measurement procedure for obtaining TRS?
question_34735.ground_truth: To ensure accuracy of TRS, the amount of reference points measured should be at least 4. It is recommended to spread the reference measurements equally during the measurement time.

question_34737.question: What are the maximum measurement reporting delay allowed for periodically triggered measurement reporting, excluding L3 filtering, for INTRA UE category 0?
question_34737.ground_truth: The maximum measurement reporting delay allowed for periodically triggered measurement reporting, excluding L3 filtering, for INTRA UE category 0 is defined in clause 8.5.2.1.1.1.

question_34740.question: What are the conditions under which a projection to the sub pyramid is made?
question_34740.ground_truth: If the pulse density ratio is larger than 0.5 unit pulses per coefficient and is larger than 1, a projection to the sub pyramid is made.

question_34741.question: What is the meaning of "shall" and "shall not" in the 3GPP technical documents?
question_34741.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, while "shall not" indicates a prohibition to do something.

question_34742.question: What interfaces are used in the initial E-UTRAN attach procedure with PMIP-based S5 or S8?
question_34742.ground_truth: Proxy Mobile IP version 6 is used on S5 or S8 interface. The MAG is collocated with the Serving GW for the PMIPv6 procedure between the Serving GW and the PDN GW.

question_34743.question: What should the APN of the default EPS bearer context be mapped to in the PDU session context?
question_34743.ground_truth: The APN of the default EPS bearer context should be mapped to the DNN of the PDU session context.

question_34745.question: What is the maximum time UE can take for UE processing in handover?

question_34746.question: What is the action supported by the CDIV service?
question_34746.ground_truth: The action supported by the CDIV service is forwarding of calls.

question_34747.question: Which interfaces are used for the reference point between the PCRF or OCS and the GMLC?
