question_35053.ground_truth: The purpose of the authorization tokens in the UE-to-UE relay solution is to indicate that the source UE or the UE-to-UE relay are authorized to use a specific relaying service or to serve a specific relaying service. The tokens have an expiration time and are signed with a private key of the core network.

question_35054.question: How is the LSF vector reconstructed for the VC mode at the 16 kHz internal sampling frequency?
question_35054.ground_truth: The LSF vector is reconstructed by decoding one bit at the Scheme selection block, which defines whether the predictive scheme or the safety-net scheme is used. For the safety-net scheme, the LSF vector is calculated from the prediction residual, which is decoded by BC-TCVQ. If the predictive scheme is used, the prediction vector is obtained and the LSF vector is decoded from the prediction residual, which is decoded by BC-TCVQ. The quantized LSF vector is then calculated by equation (1431) for the predictive scheme and equation (1432) for the safety-net scheme.

question_35055.question: What action does the MCVideo Client Application perform upon activation?
question_35055.ground_truth: The MCVideo Client Application has been activated and the user has registered-in as the MCVideo User with the Server as an active user at the Client.

question_35056.question: What is the difference between a user identity and a user identifier in the 3GPP system?
question_35056.ground_truth: A user identity represents a user in a specific context, while a user identifier is a piece of information used to identify one specific user identity in one or more systems.

question_35057.question: What services are applicable in A/Gb mode for mobile stations supporting Voice Group Call Service or Voice Broadcast Service?
question_35057.ground_truth: Voice Group Call Service and Voice Broadcast Service are applicable in A/Gb mode only.

question_35058.question: What should the MS send on the dedicated channel after being assigned one, if it is in the "idle, updated" state and the user has entered the number 112 or 911 (for GSM 900 and 1800 MS), or 08 (for GSM 710, GSM 750, T-GSM 810, GSM 850 and PCS 1 900 MS in Mexico)?
question_35058.ground_truth: The MS should send a CM SERVICE REQUEST message with CM Service Type "emergency call establishment".

question_35060.question: What type of data does SMPTE ST 2110 support in video transport?
question_35060.ground_truth: SMPTE ST 2110 supports only the active part of the image, excluding ancillary data in the vertical blanking interval, which allows for future-proof support for high-resolution formats and specifications.

question_35062.question: What is the effect of the TNG2 timer on the TNG3 timer when handling an in-progress emergency group call?
question_35062.ground_truth: If the TNG2 timer is running for an in-progress emergency group call, the TNG3 timer is stopped. If the MCPTT emergency group call is cancelled, the TNG2 timer is stopped and the TNG3 timer is started instead.

question_35063.question: What message does the source MME send to the source eNodeB to complete the preparation phase towards the source eNodeB in a handover?

question_35064.question: What information does the SL-MO-LR Response include in step 7, if UE1 requested position calculation assistance at step 3?
question_35064.ground_truth: The calculated UE locations obtained from step 6.

question_35067.question: Who is responsible for producing Security Assurance Specifications (SCASs) in the SECAM process?

question_35068.question: In what condition is the ePWS functionality for UEs with no user interface applied?
question_35068.ground_truth: This ePWS functionality is applied for UEs with no user interface if they are capable of identifying the characteristics of a disaster derived from the message identifier of a received warning message.

question_35070.question: What is the role of SMF in Step 2 of changing BP or UL CL and additional PSA for a PDU Session?
question_35070.ground_truth: The SMF establishes the local Target UPF (PSA3) for the PDU Session using N4.

question_35071.question: When should the sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer be started if HARQ feedback is disabled by the SCI and the resource(s) for one or more retransmission opportunities is not scheduled in the SCI?
question_35071.ground_truth: Start the sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer for the corresponding Sidelink process in the slot following the end of PSFCH resource.

question_35073.question: What is the role of the CAG ID in the 5G system?
question_35073.ground_truth: The CAG ID is a unique identifier for a slice in the 5G system. It is used in the registration process for accessing a CAG cell and must be protected to ensure privacy.

question_35074.question: What should the PCF provide if the "TargetNSSAI" feature is supported and a new Target NSSAI is generated in a PDU session with home routed roaming?
question_35074.ground_truth: The new generated Target NSSAI should be encoded in the "targetSnssais" attribute.

question_35075.question: What is the requirement for controlling the scheduling restrictions when a UE performs inter-RAT measurements on a different subcarrier spacing than PDSCH/PDCCH on FR1?
question_35075.ground_truth: The requirements are applicable for UE which does not support mix-numerology capability for scheduling restriction. The UE is not expected to transmit PUCCH/PUSCH/SRS or receive PDCCH/PDSCH/TRS/CSI-RS for CQI on all symbols within EMW duration. When intra-band carrier aggregation is performed, the scheduling restrictions due to a given serving cell also apply to all other serving cells in the same band on the symbols that fully or partially overlap with the restricted symbols.

question_35076.question: What is the purpose of the call flow in 5.10.2.1?
question_35076.ground_truth: The purpose of the call flow in 5.10.2.1 is to establish the delivery of 5GMS media data exclusively via eMBMS, and to specify the procedures for this use case.

question_35077.question: What channel types can be used for the radio interface connection element in the overall connection type?
question_35077.ground_truth: The radio interface connection element in the overall connection type can have the attribute values Full rate TCH, Full rate TCHs, Half rate TCH, and Dm.

question_35078.question: What is the main motivation behind having key separation for AKMA Application Functions (AFs)?
question_35078.ground_truth: To prevent one AKMA AF from decrypting traffic intended for another AKMA AF and to avoid the possibility of an actor injecting malicious packages which the UE would conclude as cryptographically correct.

question_35080.question: How can the MPEG DASH standard be employed for application-specific interactivity event notifications in an MBMS environment?
question_35080.ground_truth: The MPEG DASH standard defines the usage of Events for application-specific interactivity event notifications, where the related semantics and syntax are left to the owner of the Event scheme and associated application. The usage of MPD Events is indicated by the presence of one or more Period.EventStream elements, each instance denoting Events of a common type.

question_35081.question: What is the purpose of the Channel Mode Modify (CMM) procedure?
question_35081.ground_truth: The purpose of the Channel Mode Modify (CMM) procedure is to adjust the radio channel bit rate to match the message speed negotiated end-to-end between the facsimile machines.

question_35082.question: What is the mechanism used in HTTP-based applications defined in 3GPP TS 29.155, 29.251, 29.116, and 29.122 for negotiating supported features between clients and servers?
question_35082.ground_truth: The mechanism involves using "3gpp-Optional-Features" and "3gpp-Required-Features" HTTP headers in requests, and "3gpp-Accepted-Features" HTTP header in responses to communicate desired or required features, as well as the IDL for expressing optional or added features.

question_35083.question: What is the procedure for the SGW control plane to change the user plane session identity?
question_35083.ground_truth: The SGW control plane decides to move the UE session to a new user plane function, allocates session resources in the new function, sends per UE/PDN update messages to MME/PGW, updates the eNB with new S1-U identity, and releases the user plane session from the old function after a timer expires.

question_35084.question: What is the role of KASME in the EPS AKA authentication?
question_35084.ground_truth: KASME is the one freshly generated key used as part of the EPS AKA authentication.

question_35086.question: What is the time duration for dormant BWP switching when UE receives the dormancy indication in the first 3 OFDM symbols of a slot in the serving cell where DCI for dormancy indication is received?
question_35086.ground_truth: TdormantBWPswitchDelay =TBWPswitchDelay+ X, provided that the UE receives the dormancy indication within the first 3 OFDM symbols of a slot in the serving cell where DCI for dormancy indication is received.

question_35087.question: What is the performance requirement for interlaced PUCCH format 0 for ACK missed detection, measured by in terms of required SNR at what probability of detection?
question_35087.ground_truth: The performance requirement for interlaced PUCCH format 0 for ACK missed detection is measured by the required SNR at probability of detection equal to 0.99.

question_35088.question: What is the minimum number of occurrences for the "default-pqi" element?
question_35088.ground_truth: The minimum number of occurrences for the "default-pqi" element is 0.

question_35089.question: What procedure is initiated by the PCRF when the UE moves from the E-UTRAN to a HeNB and there is no Gateway Control Session for the target HeNB?
question_35089.ground_truth: The PCRF initiates the PCRF-initiated Gateway control session establishment procedure as defined in TS~23.203.

question_35090.question: What action should a call control entity take upon receiving a STATUS message with cause value #30 "response to status enquiry"?
question_35090.ground_truth: The call control entity should stop timer T322 and take further appropriate actions based on the information in the STATUS message, relative to its current state.

question_35093.question: What are the two approaches to design the PCCPCH channel with the time dilation solution in time-dilated UMTS?
question_35093.ground_truth: The two approaches are reducing the spreading factor of the PCCPCH channel or adding secondary PCCPCH channels.

question_35094.question: What is one of the actions taken by the UE during the eCall inactivity procedure?
question_35094.ground_truth: One of the actions taken by the UE during the eCall inactivity procedure is stopping other running timers.

question_35095.question: What is the maximum length of the array for the contextValueRange property for NfTypeContext?
question_35095.ground_truth: There is no maximum length for the array, but the array should contain one or more NFType values.

question_35096.question: What action should a UE take when it receives an RRCRelease message with a redirectedCarrierInfo?
question_35096.ground_truth: If a UE receives an RRCRelease message with a redirectedCarrierInfo that includes the core network type, the UE should provide the received cnType to upper layers.

question_35097.question: What type of data does the Equipment-Status AVP contain regarding the status of mobile equipment?
question_35097.ground_truth: The Equipment-Status AVP is of type Enumerated, and shall contain the status of the mobile equipment with possible values as PERMITTEDLISTED, PROHIBITEDLISTED, and TRACKINGLISTED.

question_35098.question: What should be studied in terms of interworking requirements between 3GPP ECN and non-3GPP ECN at the IBCF/TrGW?
question_35098.ground_truth: The need to relay ECN bits, remark ECT(0) to/from ECT(1) IP packets between the IMS and the other SIP networks, support for probing for ECN initiation phase, ECN feedback of ECN-CE marked packets, ECN constant monitoring, use of nonce, and support of RTCP-XR report.

question_35099.question: What is the purpose of the CDIV Session Identifier URI in the Communications Diversion service?
question_35099.ground_truth: The CDIV Session Identifier URI is used to solve the service interaction of CDIV and ECT (Explicit Communication Transfer) by being created and inserted by a diverting AS that is routed through the same AS.

question_35100.question: What function is employed to anchor IMS sessions at the SCC AS for enablement of Access Transfer?
question_35100.ground_truth: A 3pcc (3rd party call control) function is employed to anchor IMS sessions at the SCC AS upon session establishment for enablement of Access Transfer.

question_35101.question: What is the purpose of supporting satellite access in the 5G system and how does it optimize the network for maritime communication?
question_35101.ground_truth: Satellite access in the 5G system helps improve maritime communication efficiency and reduce losses caused by potential maritime accidents. This is achieved by enabling communication between ships through satellites without going via remote data centers, which reduces latencies and improves service continuity.

question_35102.question: What possible cause values can the HNB-GW include in a HNB REGISTER REJECT message when the Cause IE is set to "overload"?
question_35102.ground_truth: The HNB-GW can include "Overload" as a cause value in a HNB REGISTER REJECT message when the Cause IE is set to "overload".

question_35107.question: What is the function of Policy Management in the context of the present document?
question_35107.ground_truth: Policy Management is a function that governs the choices in behaviour of a system, specifying the actions to be taken when specified condition(s) occur.

question_35109.question: What is the main benefit of the public transport information broadcast service using PBS?
question_35109.ground_truth: The main benefit of the public transport information broadcast service using PBS is the convenience it provides to users, including being able to monitor the location of public transport, plan routes and receive estimated arrival times of vehicles, all on their mobile devices.

question_35110.question: What are the radio protocols between the UE and the UE-to-Network Relay specified in?
question_35110.ground_truth: The radio protocols of E-UTRAN between the UE and the UE-to-Network Relay are specified in clause 5.1.2.1 of TS 36.300.

question_35111.question: What is the significance of the value 0000 0000 in the Time field of the Time Indication element?
question_35111.ground_truth: The value 0000 0000 in the Time field of the Time Indication element indicates that the information is valid for a period of 10 seconds.

question_35112.question: What is the test purpose for the early classmark sending procedure during a mobile terminating call with early assignment procedure?
question_35112.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify that the SoLSA MS supports sending information to the network about SoLSA support during a mobile terminated call with early assignment procedure.

question_35113.question: What is the function of the Sidelink Positioning and Ranging Function (SPRF) in the upper layer?
question_35113.ground_truth: The SPRF provides the services to create a Sidelink Positioning/Ranging session between a specified group of UEs, on-demand, periodic, or triggered Sidelink Positioning/Ranging of another UE or a specified group of UEs.

question_35114.question: What is the required UE measurement in the 2.9.5-1 test?
question_35114.ground_truth: The UE is required to read the neighbor cell SSB index and report the acquired SSB index in the 2.9.5-1 test.

question_35115.question: What is the function of a Management Information Base (MIB) in the context of the present document?
question_35115.ground_truth: A Management Information Base (MIB) is an instance of a Network Resource Model (NRM) and has specific values on defined attributes and associations for that instance. It consists of a Name space, Information Object Classes (IOCs) with attributes, and associations between these IOCs. A Management Information Tree (Naming Tree) corresponds to the name space in the MIB.

question_35116.question: What is the additional requirement for BS operating in the same geographical area as UTRA TDD?
question_35116.ground_truth: The additional requirement for BS operating in the same geographical area as UTRA TDD is the BC3 blocking test requirement.

question_35117.question: What is the purpose of using APIs to monitor the status of UEs in a private slice?
question_35117.ground_truth: The purpose of using APIs to monitor the status of UEs in a private slice is to allow a trusted 3rd party, such as a power grid company, to effectively manage their numerous devices, identify and repair abnormal devices, and get the whole picture for their deployed devices in a specific area.

question_35120.question: What should the UE do upon receiving the MPS indicator bit of the 5GS network feature support IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message being set to "Access identity 1 valid in RPLMN or equivalent PLMN"?
question_35120.ground_truth: The UE should consider access identity 1 to be valid.

question_35121.question: What are the requirements for an AAS BS of Medium Range BS class operating in Band Category 1, in terms of the location where the requirements apply?
question_35121.ground_truth: The requirements apply outside the Base Station RF Bandwidth edges and inside any sub-block gap for non-contiguous spectrum. For an AAS BS of Medium Range BS class operating in multiple bands, the requirements apply inside any Inter RF Bandwidth gap.

question_35122.question: What is the measurement that provides the number of PFD creation requests received by the NEF from AF?

question_35124.question: What happens if the timer T390 is running for a specific Access Category, as per TS 38.331, clause 5.3.14.2?
question_35124.ground_truth: The access attempt is considered barred if timer T390 is running for the Access Category.

question_35125.question: Which subclause in TS 36.104 and TS 37.104 specifies the reference sensitivity requirement for MSR BS?
question_35125.ground_truth: The reference sensitivity requirement for MSR BS in TS 37.104 is specified in subclause 7.8.2, and it is the same as the single-RAT only requirement for existing MSR specification.

question_35128.question: What is the main reason for triggering the release of IP-CAN session for offloaded traffic?
question_35128.ground_truth: The IP-CAN session for offloaded traffic is released when the UE is detached from the Fixed Broadband Access network, which could be triggered by the NW or the UE.

question_35129.question: Which information element in PathSwitchRequestAcknowledge message is mandatory and indicates the identifier of the AMF or RAN?

question_35130.question: What is the role of the 3GPP TS 33.501 standard in the use of TLS certificates in 5G SBA?
question_35130.ground_truth: The 3GPP TS 33.501 standard defines the requirements for the use of TLS certificates in 5G SBA for authentication of network functions. It specifies the compliance criteria for TLS client and server certificate profiles.

question_35134.question: Which system information messages are used in 7.3.8, 7.3.9, and 7.3.10 except for the default system information messages specified in clause 6.1.0b?
question_35134.ground_truth: Contents of System information block type 1: RRC, Contents of System information block type 3 and 4: RRC, Contents of System Information Block type 5 (FDD).

question_35135.question: What is the main function of the session binding function in the binding mechanism?
question_35135.ground_truth: The session binding function receives the AF session information and determines the relevant PDU session.

question_35136.question: What is the purpose of the ExpectationFulfilmentResult dataType?
question_35136.ground_truth: The ExpectationFulfilmentResult dataType includes the expectationFulfilmentInfo and targetFulfilmentResults for each IntentExpectation. The expectationFulfilmentInfo describes the status of fulfilment of an intentExpectation and the related reasons for the infeasible status.

question_35138.question: What is the purpose of the "To-id" information element in the context of an I1 Invite message?
question_35138.ground_truth: The "To-id" information element is used to transport a public identity of the To Party in the context of an I1 Invite message.

question_35139.question: What is the difference between the use of "shall" and "must" in 3GPP documents?
question_35139.ground_truth: In 3GPP documents, "shall" is used to indicate a mandatory requirement, while "must" is typically used only in direct citations from external documents or to maintain continuity of style when extending or modifying such documents.

question_35140.question: Which aspect of the signalling connection is negotiated during the establishment of the signalling connection?
question_35140.ground_truth: Zero to several TM signalling radio bearers may be set up for transferring RRC signalling messages using transparent mode RLC.

question_35141.question: Which service operations are supported by the Nnef_Authentication service?
question_35141.ground_truth: The Nnef_Authentication service supports two service operations: AuthenticateAuthorize and Notification.

question_35142.question: What happens if a device fails to complete tasks during the short sync interval?
question_35142.ground_truth: If tasks fail during the short sync interval, the device performs the long sync procedure, which includes neighbour cell measurements and possibly a subsequent cell reselection.

question_35143.question: What is the recommended transport protocol when the MRFP provides a separate IP/UDP/RTP transport for the "application/h224" media stream?

question_35144.question: What is a limitation of the P-Asserted-Identity mechanism in asserting the originating network's identity?
question_35144.ground_truth: The P-Asserted-Identity header extension is not signed by the originating network and could be forged by the originating or intermediate transit networks.

question_35145.question: What should the mobile station do if it responds to a SETUP message with a RELEASE COMPLETE message?
question_35145.ground_truth: If the mobile station responds to a SETUP message with a RELEASE COMPLETE message, it shall release the MM connection and enter the "null" state after sending the RELEASE COMPLETE message.

question_35146.question: What is the formula used to calculate the total layer 2 buffer size for DL/UL in MR-DC?
question_35146.ground_truth: The total layer 2 buffer size is defined as the sum of the number of bytes that the UE is capable of storing in the RLC transmission windows, RLC reception and reassembly windows, and also in PDCP reordering windows for all radio bearers. The required total layer 2 buffer size in MR-DC is the maximum value of the calculated values based on the given formulas.

question_35147.question: Which option tag does the MCVideo client include in the SIP INVITE request for adhoc group call setup using on-demand session?
question_35147.ground_truth: The "timer" option tag is included in the Supported header field of the SIP INVITE request.

question_35148.question: What does the document define as a "Managed Object (MO)" and a "Managed Object Class (MOC)"?
question_35148.ground_truth: A Managed Object (MO) is an abstract entity representing a Network Resource (NR) for the purpose of management, while Managed Object Class (MOC) is a description of all the common characteristics for a number of MOs, such as their attributes, operations, notifications and behavior.

question_35149.question: What was the issue found with the DTMF recognition using a standard DTMF detector, even under ideal conditions?
question_35149.ground_truth: The recognition was poor, with at least one tone showing severe problems even at ideal conditions with nominal DTMF signal frequencies, no additional signals in the speech band, and error-free transmission.

question_35151.question: In "Transmission control during an MCVideo session," what message does the transmission control server send to transmission control participant A after determining to accept the transmit media request?

question_35152.question: What is the maximum size for a maximum size IPv6 packet filter in the Traffic Flow Template information element?
question_35152.ground_truth: The maximum size for a maximum size IPv6 packet filter in the Traffic Flow Template information element is 60 bytes.

question_35153.question: What is the length of the PRBS (Pseudo Random Binary Sequence) used to generate the information bit data in the open loop diversity performance test described in sections 9.2.2A to 9.2.2D?
question_35153.ground_truth: The length of the PRBS (Pseudo Random Binary Sequence) used to generate the information bit data in the open loop diversity performance test described in sections 9.2.2A to 9.2.2D is not specified in the section provided. It is mentioned that the information bit data shall be pseudo random and not repeated before 10 different information bit payload blocks are processed, and the length of each information bit payload block is specified (e.g. 4664 bits). Therefore, the PRBS must be at least 4664 * 10 bits long.

question_35154.question: What should be the initial conditions for testing the requirement specified in 6.2D.3.4?
question_35154.ground_truth: Initial conditions consist of environmental conditions, test frequencies, and channel bandwidths based on NR operating bands. These conditions should be tested with applicable test parameters for each channel bandwidth and subcarrier spacing.

question_35155.question: What are the functional entities for the reference architecture defined in the document?
question_35155.ground_truth: The functional entities for the reference architecture defined in the document include: IMS CAT User Equipment (UE), IMS CAT AS (Application Server), IMS CAT MRFP (Media Resource Function Processor), and IMS network.

question_35158.question: What is the minimum and maximum length of the "Extended rejected NSSAI" information element?
question_35158.ground_truth: The Extended rejected NSSAI information element has a minimum length of 5 octets and a maximum length of 90 octets.

question_35161.question: What is the role of the UE in edge relocation due to DNAI changes?
question_35161.ground_truth: When DNAI changes, the UE receives a DNS re-resolution indication and triggers a new DNS query to discover the new EAS if necessary. If required, the UE re-establishes a connection with the new EAS.

question_35162.question: When should a UE initiate the RRC connection establishment/ resume/ re-establishment procedure for all access causes in the context of NB-IoT UE connected to 5GC?
question_35162.ground_truth: A UE should not initiate the RRC connection establishment/ resume/ re-establishment procedure for all access causes until it has acquired the SystemInformationBlockType14-NB.

question_35163.question: What does KMS use to decrypt Ekms(Ka) and Eb(ID-A,ID-B) in step 4b?
question_35163.ground_truth: KMS uses Ka to decrypt Ekms(Ka) and Eb(ID-A,ID-B) in step 4b.

question_35164.question: What is the role of NEF and the NWDAF in providing the estimated QoS for the XRM stream?
question_35164.ground_truth: The NEF is responsible for forwarding the received new QoS parameter Requested AW from the AF to the NWDAF for the XRM stream. The NWDAF is responsible for predicting the estimated QoS based on the collected information and performing the judgement whether the trigger conditions are met.

question_35165.question: What is the impact of deploying SNSF on RNC Functions?
question_35165.ground_truth: There is no impact on RNC Functions as a result of deploying SNSF.

question_35166.question: What is the requirement for the 3GPP system in regards to implementing a standalone eMBMS network?
question_35166.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall allow to implement a standalone eMBMS network based on a set of EPS functionalities and entities which are required to offer a linear TV service.

question_35167.question: What is the purpose of the STa Re-Authentication procedure in the 3GPP AAA Proxy?
question_35167.ground_truth: The STa Re-Authentication procedure in the 3GPP AAA Proxy is used for re-authenticating the user, and may be initiated at any time by the 3GPP AAA Server based on HPLMN operator policies.

question_35168.question: When is an STI dynamically assigned for the Access Leg during origination or termination of an IMS session?
question_35168.ground_truth: An STI is dynamically assigned for the Access Leg during origination or termination of an IMS session if the Gm or I1 reference point is used and the SCC AS assigns it, or during Access Transfer if a new Access Leg is established.

question_35169.question: What is the role of the PGW in managing bearers for SDF mobility?
question_35169.ground_truth: The PGW is responsible for managing bearers based on SDF mobility, modifying or deleting them on various accesses to comply with QoS requirements and routing rules negotiated with the UE.

question_35171.question: What is a popular audio format for VR platforms enabling sounds from all directions on the horizontal plane to be reproduced?

question_35172.question: What is the procedure for calibrating the Near Field Test Range?
question_35172.ground_truth: The calibration procedure for the Near Field Test Range is captured in clause~8.5.

question_35175.question: What specific test requirements must be met for the RSRP TDD absolute accuracy test to pass?
question_35175.ground_truth: The test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values in each test shall be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_35177.question: What are the three components required to provide mobile haptic services?
question_35177.ground_truth: The three components required are: (1) UEs (User Equipments) that generate haptic senses, (2) haptic information format that both UEs and networks can understand, and (3) telecommunication networks that deliver haptic information for haptic senses.

question_35179.question: What should the SLM server do upon receiving a CoAP GET request where the CoAP URI identifies a deregistration?
question_35179.ground_truth: The SLM server should determine the identity of the sender of the CoAP GET request, and if authorized, it should generate a CoAP 2.04 (Changed) response and send it towards the SLM-C.

question_35180.question: When is the broadcast group call released?
question_35180.ground_truth: If the media transmission from call originating MCVideo user is complete, the broadcast group call is released.

question_35182.question: What is the difference between "Intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation" and "Intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation"?
question_35182.ground_truth: Intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation refers to contiguous NR or E-UTRA carriers aggregated in the same operating band, while Intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation refers to non-contiguous NR or E-UTRA carriers aggregated in the same operating band.

question_35184.question: What protocol is used to initiate a call from ICCF to the VDN in the first scenario?

question_35185.question: What is the measurement obtained by sampling at a pre-defined interval, the interference signal code power of the same Node B reported and then taking the arithmetic mean, with a minimum granularity of a Time Slot (TS), for an Utran Cell in TDD mode?
question_35185.ground_truth: The measurement is called "CARR.MeanTSISCP.TSx", where x represents 0 to 14.

question_35186.question: What is the P-Access-Network-Info header field used for?
question_35186.ground_truth: The P-Access-Network-Info header field is used in an INVITE request for a dialog, any subsequent request or response within a dialog, or in any request. It contains the current point of attachment to the IP-CAN, which is relevant for routing the emergency call. The header field is populated with the location identifier such as the cell id, the line id, or the identity of the I-WLAN access node.

question_35190.question: What should the MCVideo client set the stored last call type change time to upon setting the stored current call type to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL" in the "T0: waiting for the call to establish" state?

question_35193.question: What is the user authentication and authorization flow for MCPTT service, as defined in 3GPP TS 33.179?
question_35193.ground_truth: The user authentication process involves the MCPTT user supplying user credentials for verification with the identity management server. After successful verification, the user is authenticated and authorized for MCPTT service. This may occur before or after SIP registration.

question_35197.question: What should the MS do when it receives a GA-RC DEREGISTER message with a Reject Cause Information Element of 'AP not allowed'?
question_35197.ground_truth: The MS should release the TCP connection established to the GANC, if still established, release the secure connection towards the SEGW associated with the GANC, store the AP-ID in the AP Black List and not initiate a new Register Request from this AP until the AP-ID is removed from the AP black list.

question_35201.question: What should the NG-RAN node include in the NG RESET ACKNOWLEDGE message for each UE association to be reset, if the RAN UE NGAP ID IE is included in the corresponding UE-associated Logical NG-connection Item IE in the NG RESET message?
question_35201.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node should include the RAN UE NGAP ID IE in the corresponding UE-associated Logical NG-connection Item IE in the NG RESET ACKNOWLEDGE message.

question_35205.question: Which network element sends the updated Routing Rules to the PGW in NW-initiated mode?
question_35205.ground_truth: The PCRF sends the updated Routing Rules to the PGW in NW-initiated mode.

question_35206.question: What is the measurement reporting delay requirement for the UE to send a MeasurementReport message in the test procedure?
question_35206.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay requirement for the UE to send a MeasurementReport message is less than (3+L)*40 + 2 ms from the beginning of time period T2.

question_35207.question: What is the criticality level of the "Cause" component in the "RAB-FailedItem-EnhRelocInfoRes" sequence?
question_35207.ground_truth: The criticality level of the "Cause" component in the "RAB-FailedItem-EnhRelocInfoRes" sequence is "CRITICALITY reject".

question_35209.question: What is the period for which the UE is required to exclude the barred cell and the cells on the same frequency as a candidate for cell selection/reselection after being unable to acquire the SIB1 and the intraFreqReselection field in MIB is set to "not allowed"?

question_35210.question: What is a new type of parameter set introduced in H.265 (HEVC) compared to H.264 (AVC)?
question_35210.ground_truth: A new type of parameter set introduced in H.265 (HEVC) is called video parameter set (VPS).

question_35211.question: What is the logical definition of "panel" focus on its behavior rather than physical implementation?
question_35211.ground_truth: A panel is defined as a group of antenna elements that control beams independently, where each panel can select one beam for DL reception, and multiple panels (each selecting one beam per panel) can be used for DL reception simultaneously, assuming a beam is a spatial filter associated with reception, and a physical panel with dual polarization is considered as two "panels."

question_35212.question: What SSL/TLS flag is used in the HTTP GET (upgrade) request for establishing a WebSocket connection?
question_35212.ground_truth: The SSL/TLS flag used in the HTTP GET (upgrade) request for establishing a WebSocket connection is "Sec-WebSocket".

question_35213.question: What is the purpose of the T1, T2, and T3 time durations in the test procedure described?
question_35213.ground_truth: The purpose of T1, T2, and T3 are time intervals for which the UE must transmit uplink signals during specific conditions. T1 and T2 focus on the PCell, while T3 concentrates on the PSCell. They are used to verify the proper detection of out-of-sync and in-sync states for monitoring downlink radio link quality in a dual connectivity scenario.

question_35215.question: What is the response from the SS in the Missed ACK test?
question_35215.ground_truth: In the Missed ACK test, the SS responds with 100% NACK (-1) on cell 1 and 100% ACK (1) on cell 2.

question_35216.question: What is the effect of increasing number of MBS membership changes on the performance of the blue line in Solution 9?
question_35216.ground_truth: As the number of MBS membership changes increases, the performance of the blue line in Solution 9 improves compared to the performance of the purple line.

question_35218.question: When do the AMFRANHandoverCommand and AMFRANHandoverRequest records get generated by the IRI-POI in the AMF?
question_35218.ground_truth: The AMFRANHandoverCommand is generated when the AMF sends a HANDOVER COMMAND message to the source RAN node in response to a HANDOVER REQUIRED message, and the AMFRANHandoverRequest is generated when the AMF receives a HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message from the target RAN node for the target UE.

question_35219.question: What information is provided by the Application Server during the group communication establishment procedure?
question_35219.ground_truth: The Application Server provides a list of authorized users, Application Layer Group ID, and if needed Destination IP address to the initiating UE.

question_35220.question: What are the two potential security requirements to prevent malicious entities from accessing a slice they are not authorized to access or requesting a service from a slice which they are not authorized to access?
question_35220.ground_truth: The 5GS should provide a mechanism that allows the NF Service Producer not to provide service to NF Service Consumers, which are not authorized to access a slice, and a mechanism that allows NRF not to provide access tokens to NF Service Consumers which are not authorized to access a slice.

question_35221.question: What is the requirement for the maximum late call entry time for application layer encrypted calls within one MCPTT system when interworking with other non-3GPP PTT systems?
question_35221.ground_truth: The additional Late call entry time for an MCPTT UE late entering an application layer encrypted call interworking with other non-3GPP PTT systems shall not exceed the difference in the encrypted and unencrypted late call entry times for the interworking system.

question_35222.question: What is the initial action taken by the SS in step 1?
question_35222.ground_truth: The SS uses a Channel Mode Modify procedure to change the active codec set to a specific set with the Initial Codec Mode unspecified.

question_35223.question: How is the scaling factor S derived in the calculation of the measurement period for PRS RSTD measurement in positioning frequency layer i?
question_35223.ground_truth: The scaling factor, S, is calculated as the size of the bitmap if measureSameDL-PRS-ResourceWithDifferentRxTEGs-r17 is not supported or requested by LMF in NR-DL-TDOA-RequestLocationInformation. Otherwise, it is calculated as the number of Rx TEGs UE can measure simultaneously.

question_35225.question: What is the limit for UTRA and E-UTRA in the FCC requirements for BC1 and BC2 bands, as measured in a 100 kHz measurement bandwidth for bands below 1GHz and in 1 MHz for bands above 1GHz?

question_35226.question: What shall the UE do if the Back-off timer value IE is not included or no Back-off timer value is received from the 5GMM sublayer when it tries to send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message or PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message for the same DNN or without a DNN?
question_35226.ground_truth: The UE may send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message or PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message for the same DNN or without a DNN, respectively.

question_35227.question: Under what conditions can the UE consider reselecting an E-UTRA neighbor cell?
question_35227.ground_truth: The UE should not consider a E-UTRA neighbor cell in cell reselection if it is indicated as not allowed in the serving cell's measurement control system information.

question_35228.question: When are the signalled values Qrxlevminoffset and Qqualminoffset applied in the cell selection process?
question_35228.ground_truth: These values are applied when a cell is evaluated for cell selection as a result of a periodic search for a higher priority PLMN while camped normally in a VPLMN.

question_35229.question: What is the step-by-step process of measuring the Doppler spectrum in the Doppler/Temporal correlation validation procedure for FR1 channels in OTA testing using MPAC system?
question_35229.ground_truth: The sine wave (CW) signal is transmitted from the signal generator and transferred via cables to the probe antennas that radiate the signals over the air to the test antenna. The Doppler spectrum is measured by the spectrum analyzer and the trace is saved. The measurement data file (Doppler power spectrum) is analyzed by taking the Fourier transformation to calculate the temporal correlation function, which is then normalized.

question_35230.question: How should the PDN address of a PDU session be mapped to the PDN address of the default EPS bearer context?
question_35230.ground_truth: The PDN address of the default EPS bearer context is set to the PDU address of the PDU session, if the PDU session type is "IPv4", "IPv6" or "IPv4v6".

question_35231.question: If a UE fails to decode the BSIC after two successive attempts during BSIC re-confirmation, what should the UE do to that GSM cell?
question_35231.ground_truth: If the UE fails to decode the BSIC after two successive attempts, the UE shall abort the BSIC re-confirmation attempts for that GSM cell, treat it as a new GSM cell with unidentified BSIC, and move it to the initial BSIC identification procedure.

question_35233.question: What protocol will be used as the transport protocol for SGsAP messages in 10.14.1.2?
question_35233.ground_truth: The Stream Control Transmission Protocol (SCTP) will be used as the transport protocol for SGsAP messages in 10.14.1.2.

question_35234.question: What message does the remote party receive upon making a retrieve request for the held call in the described scenario?
question_35234.ground_truth: The remote party receives a notification of the retrieve request.

question_35235.question: What is the channel bandwidth used for testing in the initial conditions?
question_35235.ground_truth: The channel bandwidth used for testing in the initial conditions is 10 MHz.

question_35237.question: What is the requirement specified in 27.22.4.11.4.2.2 for the ME to conform to in terms of TS 31.111?
question_35237.ground_truth: The ME shall support the Proactive UICC: Send SS facility as defined in TS 31.111, specifically in clause 6.1, 6.4.11, 6.6.10, 8.12.1, 5.2, 8.6, 8.7, 8.2, 8.14, 8.31, and 6.5.

question_35238.question: What is the requirement for codecs when E2EE (End-to-End Encryption) is specified for an MCPTT user and a LMR user in the group call?
question_35238.ground_truth: If E2EE is specified, then the MCPTT users and the LMR users shall use the same codec for the group call.

question_35239.question: What are the aspects that need to be considered for determining one or more assistant UEs for ranging service in a 5GS?
question_35239.ground_truth: These aspects include discovering and determining the assistant UEs, exchanging necessary parameters, and getting the ranging result with the assistance of one or more assistant UEs.

question_35241.question: What should the UE do if at least one of the symbols for a PUSCH transmission overlaps with a DL symbol or an SS/PBCH block?
question_35241.ground_truth: The UE should not count that slot in the number of slots for the PUSCH transmission.

question_35243.question: What is the purpose of the E-SMLC Measurement ID in the SLmAP protocol?
question_35243.ground_truth: The E-SMLC Measurement ID is used to associate all the procedures related to the same measurement initiated by the E-SMLC, and it uniquely identifies a measurement among all ongoing parallel measurements initiated by the same peer.

question_35244.question: What is the requirement for occupied bandwidth for single RAT E-UTRA operation?
question_35244.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for occupied bandwidth for single RAT E-UTRA operation is the same as that stated in 3GPP TS 36.104, subclause 6.6.1.

question_35245.question: What does the cell timing mean in the provided code?
question_35245.ground_truth: In the provided code, cell timing is the timing calculated from the cell, used to generate the GANSS-GPS-Reference-Time-Only. Its integration with the cell coverage area can help determine the GANSS-ReferenceTimeUncertainty, used for the GANSS Reference time.

question_35247.question: What information should be included in each child element of the "List of individual messages" element in the aggregated message?
question_35247.ground_truth: Each child element of the "List of individual messages" element should contain a "Message ID", a "Payload", optional "Application ID" element(s), an optional "Delivery status required" element, and an optional "Priority type" element.

question_35248.question: What is the maximum handover delay for the cell change in the test procedure described in section 7.3.1.3.5?
question_35248.ground_truth: The maximum handover delay for the cell change is 552 ms.

question_35250.question: Which NF is introduced for the new NetworkSliceConvergedCharging service to handle NS quota between the CHF and the NSACF for 5G network slicing charging?

question_35251.question: What should an MS using a SIM without access technology information storage do when searching for PLMN/access technology combinations?
question_35251.ground_truth: An MS using a SIM without access technology information storage should search for all access technologies it is capable of for each PLMN in the "PLMN Selector" data file. The priority ordering amongst the access technologies is implementation dependent.

question_35252.question: What should the UE do upon receipt of PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message over the other access if a PDU session is an MA PDU session already established on a single access?
question_35252.ground_truth: The UE should delete the stored authorized QoS rules, the stored authorized QoS flow descriptions, and the stored mapped EPS bearer contexts if the PDU session is an MA PDU session already established on a single access and the UE receives the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message over the other access.

question_35253.question: What would be the applicability of FR1 or FR2 for specific operating bands within the 7-24 GHz range?
question_35253.ground_truth: Other working groups besides RAN4 would need to confirm whether FR1 or FR2 behavior and requirements can be reused or whether something new is needed.

question_35254.question: What type of data is reported by the Media Session Handler to the 5GMSd~AF in the context of QoE metrics?
question_35254.ground_truth: The Media Session Handler reports QoE metrics to the 5GMSd~AF as defined in clause~4.7.4.4. These parameters include the name of the event consumer, type of QoE metric, and the attribute value of the QoE metric. For each record in the collection, the following parameters are included: record number, AF name, AF release, time of event, QoE metric name, attribute name, and attribute value.

question_35255.question: What is the cause value used in the PS Handover Cancel PDU when the radio contact with the MS is lost during a PS handover?
question_35255.ground_truth: The cause value used in the PS Handover Cancel PDU is Cause = Radio Contact Lost with MS.

question_35256.question: What are the three possible actions the IBCF can take based on local policy upon examining the characteristics of the message body?
question_35256.ground_truth: The IBCF can transit the body, remove the body, or reject the call.

question_35258.question: In 6.5B.4.2.3, what does the term "spurious emissions" mean, and what is its significance?
question_35258.ground_truth: Spurious emissions in 6.5B.4.2.3 are unwanted transmissions such as harmonic emissions, parasitic emissions, intermodulation products, and frequency conversion products. These emissions can interfere with other channels or systems, leading to degradation in the performance or quality of communication. To mitigate the effects, SM.329 and E-UTRA operating band requirements address UE (User Equipment) co-existence through specific emission limits.

question_35260.question: What is the purpose of the MC service server requesting an MBS session update for a higher priority QoS?
question_35260.ground_truth: The purpose is to provide the new required QoS for the group communication if not done during the initial MBS session creation.

question_35262.question: What is the role of the first byte in each record of EF~SMSR?
question_35262.ground_truth: It serves as the link between the status report and the corresponding short message in EF~SMS.

question_35263.question: In which stacks are packets forwarded through the IAB topology based on the IP packet header in architecture group 2?
question_35263.ground_truth: Packets are forwarded through the IAB topology based on the IP packet header in both connection services in architecture group 2.

question_35264.question: For the potential Rel-18 UE in Urban scenario at 2.6GHz with maximum 11-PRB UE bandwidth, what is the target BLER for PDCCH CSS and SIB1?
question_35264.ground_truth: The target BLER of PDCCH CSS is 1% and the target BLER of SIB1 is 10%.

question_35265.question: What option should the SLM-C include in the CoAP FETCH request to observe the location information of another VAL user?

question_35267.question: What is the media type used for the RESTCONF data resource identifier in the "value" parameter of a notification?
question_35267.ground_truth: The media type used for the RESTCONF data resource identifier in the "value" parameter of a notification is "application/yang-data+json".

question_35268.question: What action should the MS take after timer T323 expires in the context of call clearing upon service level upgrade initiation?
question_35268.ground_truth: The MS should initiate the call clearing procedure by sending a DISCONNECT message to the SS (Serving System).

question_35269.question: What service does not interact with the CAT service in the context of call charging?
question_35269.ground_truth: Voice group call service (VGCS) and Voice broadcast service (VBS) are examples of services that do not interact with the CAT service in terms of call charging.

question_35270.question: How does a UE determine the synchronization hierarchy in the absence of GNSS and eNB?
question_35270.ground_truth: A UE which cannot find GNSS, eNB, nor a SyncRef UE, selects an SLSSID randomly from 170-335, and UEs which synchronize to it propagate the same SLSSID.

question_35272.question: Under what circumstances can access to a non-anchor NES cell directly occur?
question_35272.ground_truth: Access to a non-anchor NES cell directly can occur if the SIB transmitted by the anchor cell includes the necessary information to access the non-anchor NES cell.

question_35274.question: What is the purpose of the 5GMS and eMBMS metrics reporting in the 5GMS architecture?
question_35274.ground_truth: The purpose of the 5GMS and eMBMS metrics reporting is to report 5GMS and eMBMS metrics to the 5GMSd AF. This helps to monitor and analyze the performance of the 5GMS content delivery.

question_35276.question: In step 3 of the TBS determination, what should be the action taken when the TBS is determined as the quantized intermediate number of information bits, where M is the size of the active DL bandwidth part in Resource blocks and the number of bits used for frequency domain resource assignment is determined by the size of the active DL bandwidth part and the resource allocation type?
question_35276.ground_truth: The UE should decode the received transport block of size correspondent as per Modulation Coding scheme, time domain resource allocation and PRB's and forwards it to higher layers.

question_35277.question: In the solution, when does the PCF select a different value serving as an alias for the original Relay Service Code for the Remote UE?
question_35277.ground_truth: The PCF selects a different value serving as an alias for the original Relay Service Code for the Remote UE when the relay connection is authorized for the respective relay service code, and this is performed after it has been verified that the relay connection is authorized for the respective relay service code in step 4.

question_35278.question: What is the consequence of user cloning the H(e)NB authentication token?
question_35278.ground_truth: User cloning the H(e)NB authentication token can lead to very harmful impacts, such as the ability to eavesdrop or spoof GSM/3G/LTE calls, and can have serious and wide-ranging consequences for the user and the operator.

question_35279.question: In the scenario where UE A has migrated to a partner MC system and receives an incoming private call, what is the role of MC service server A in processing the private call request?
question_35279.ground_truth: MC service server A performs an authorization check to ensure that the incoming private call is permitted, and also performs a logging policy check to see whether media in the call should be logged in MC system A.

question_35283.question: What is the condition for preamble detection in the testing procedure?
question_35283.ground_truth: Preamble detection should be made only on those access slots where a preamble has been sent in.

question_35285.question: What type of NAS procedures does a UE that only supports EPC based Dual Connectivity with NR as a secondary RAT perform?
question_35285.ground_truth: The UE performs EPC NAS procedures over E-UTRA.

question_35287.question: What is the consequence of a successful CFNRy activation request?
question_35287.ground_truth: The CFNRy service will be erased and automatically deactivated.

question_35288.question: What is the purpose of the 5G System architecture enhancement and clarification in the context of 5GLAN-type services?
question_35288.ground_truth: The purpose is to enable three types of traffic forwarding methods for 5G VN communication, which are N6-based, local switch, and N19-based.

question_35289.question: What is the concatenated N-PDTCH block transmission mode used for in N-GSM?
question_35289.ground_truth: The concatenated N-PDTCH block transmission mode is used with extended TTIs of 160 ms or 240 ms (i.e. 2 or 3 successive transmissions of the 80 ms N-PDTCH block) in N-GSM.

question_35290.question: How does the network redirect a UE between EPC and 5GCN?
question_35290.ground_truth: The network can take into account the UE's N1 mode capability or S1 mode capability, the CIoT network behavior supported and preferred by the UE or the CIoT network behavior supported by the network to determine the redirection.

question_35291.question: What should the SS generate to enable the MS to return to idle state as per Conformance requirement 26.8.1.3.5.7.4?
question_35291.ground_truth: The SS generates a lower layer failure at the MS, generates paging to create RR-connection, and checks the state of the MS by using STATUS ENQUIRY with the relevant transaction identifiers.

question_35292.question: What new complexity is introduced to the network scheduler and to the CQI computation process in the UE by the proposal in 7.2.2.1?
question_35292.ground_truth: The proposal introduces the concept of multiple CQI values, signalling different interferer types for the same channel quality, requiring additional steps in CQI computation algorithms and an additional stage for network to check interferer types within a TTI time frame. The UE's CQI computation process is also extended to include the interferer type.

question_35293.question: What should the UE do when it receives a 380 (Alternative Service) response to an initial request for a dialog, or a standalone transaction, or an unknown method, and the response does not contain a Contact header field with a service URN with a top-level service type of "sos"?
question_35293.ground_truth: The UE shall include a service URN in the Request-URI of the initial request for a dialog or the standalone transaction, or the unknown method transmitted as part of UE detected emergency call procedures.

question_35295.question: What is the function of the IWF in a private call initiated by a LMR user to an MCPTT user in 6.4.2.1?
question_35295.ground_truth: The IWF converts the LMR user identity to the MCPTT ID and performs the protocol translation for a private call initiated by a LMR user to an MCPTT user.

question_35299.question: What is the length of the scrambling code used for the PRACH message part?
question_35299.ground_truth: The scrambling code used for the PRACH message part is 10 ms long.

question_35302.question: What should the NF service consumer do when it successfully receives and processes an event notification from the AF?
question_35302.ground_truth: The NF service consumer should send an HTTP "204 No Content" response to the AF, indicating that it successfully processed the event notification.

question_35303.question: What message does the MMEn send to the MMEo in the first step of the procedure?
question_35303.ground_truth: The MMEn sends a message to the MMEo containing GUTIo and the received TAU message.

question_35304.question: What is one of the motivations for the decryption procedures performed by the IBCF in a hiding network?
question_35304.ground_truth: To allow the correct routing of a response through the hiding network.

question_35305.question: What is the role of PI, CI, and PB in evaluating resource load in URLLC service downlink and uplink?
question_35305.ground_truth: PI, CI, and PB are used to evaluate the resource load in URLLC service downlink and uplink, respectively. PI is used to calculate the ratio of the number of time domain resources that use the PI feature for downlink transmission, representing the resource load of URLLC. Similarly, CI and PB are used to calculate the resource load for uplink transmission with CI or PB triggered.

question_35306.question: What value should be set in the Auth-Session-State AVP when constructing a CLA command as a result of receiving a CancelLocation Ack/Error message in step 8.4.3?
question_35306.ground_truth: The Auth-Session-State AVP should be set to the value NO_STATE_MAINTAINED (1).

question_35307.question: What is the purpose of the direction bit (DIRECTION) in the encryption process?
question_35307.ground_truth: The direction bit determines the direction of transmission of data and helps to avoid using the same keystream to encrypt both uplink and downlink transmissions.

question_35308.question: What entities are supported in the 5GS for ranging/SL positioning service?
question_35308.ground_truth: GMLC supports ranging/SL positioning request for one or multiple UEs, LMF supports ranging/SL positioning request for one or multiple UEs, and AMF supports the registration of location reporting as part of ProSe capabilities from the UE. UE acts as a reference UE to interpret RSCs for location reporting, and acts as a target UE to interpret RSCs for location reporting.

question_35310.question: What is the significance of the SCCP connection in the UTRAN?
question_35310.ground_truth: The SCCP connection is used in the UTRAN to support signalling messages between two RNCs for the transfer of layer 3 messages and for common measurements and information between a pair of RNCs.

question_35311.question: What is the role of evolved Residential Gateways (eRGs) in the use case of indoor LAN to 5G LAN connectivity?
question_35311.ground_truth: The eRGs connect the in-home LAN with the public network and allow interaction between devices belonging to both 5G LAN-VNs and in-home LAN networks.

question_35313.question: What is the requirement for the gap length in compressed mode when TGRRC and TGCFN are not required to use compressed mode?
question_35313.ground_truth: TGPRC and TGCFN shall be set to "Infinity" and "(Current CFN + (256 - TTI/10msec)) mod 256" when TGRRC and TGCFN are not required to use compressed mode.

question_35314.question: How can MDAS be used to optimize paging procedures in 5G networks?
question_35314.ground_truth: MDAS can be used to optimize paging procedures by providing an analytics output indicating the time window at which a group of users is out of coverage on a regular basis. Based on this output, the paging procedures can be initiated efficiently, thereby ensuring the optimal network resource utilization.

question_35315.question: What do bits 2 through 6 of the New IE Flags in RACH DATA FRAME belong to?
question_35315.ground_truth: Bits 2 through 6 of the New IE Flags in RACH DATA FRAME should be set to 0.

question_35316.question: What is the expected outcome and time scale of the 3GPP work item with UID 440065?
question_35316.ground_truth: The expected outcome of the 3GPP work item with UID 440065 is to provide SOAP SS for Interface IRPs that do not already have SOAP SSs defined. The time scale for this work item is not specified in the document.

question_35318.question: Which SCS options are being considered for the high speed train scenario in 5G NR FR2?
question_35318.ground_truth: The options being considered for the SCS in the high speed train scenario in 5G NR FR2 are SCS = 120kHz and SCS = 120kHz and 60kHz.

question_35319.question: What is the frequency range for the unwanted signal transmitted during the test?
question_35319.ground_truth: The unwanted signal is transmitted at a nominal frequency 200 kHz above and below the nominal frequency of the wanted signal.

question_35321.question: What is the abbreviation for "Mobile-Originated Mobile-Terminated" in the context of MSGin5G Service?

question_35323.question: What is the significance of the PDN Connection in the L2TP Tunnel setup?
question_35323.ground_truth: The PDN Connection is a specific piece of information related to the L2TP Tunnel setup, which includes details such as the calling number, indications for IP address allocation, and provision of DNS and NBNS server addresses.

question_35324.question: What action does the MSC-1 server take when it receives a Handover Detect message during a non-LCLS call and has kept the termination towards the serving BSS connected?
question_35324.ground_truth: The MSC-1 server requests the MGW-1 to set the Handover Device to the intermediate state using the Change Flow Direction procedure.

question_35326.question: When was the support of integrity protection of user plane data in PDCP layer introduced as a new feature in 5G systems compared to LTE?
question_35326.ground_truth: The support of integrity protection of user plane data in PDCP layer was introduced as a new feature in Rel-15 compared to LTE.

question_35327.question: What determines the number of bits for the redundancy version when the number of scheduled PDSCH is greater than 1?
question_35327.ground_truth: The number of bits for the redundancy version is determined by the maximum number of schedulable PDSCHs among all entries in the higher layer parameter pdsch-TimeDomainAllocationListForMultiPDSCH.

question_35329.question: What is the purpose of K~EEC-EES in the authentication and authorization process between EEC hosted in a roaming UE and EES?
question_35329.ground_truth: K~EEC-EES is derived by the EES based on the K~EES and EEC ID, and it is used to realize mutual authentication and TLS connection between EEC and EES.

question_35330.question: How does the UE determine the selected WLAN during power-up if it has not registered to any PLMN?
question_35330.ground_truth: The UE shall use WLANSP provided by HPLMN as valid during power-up, while the UE has not registered to any PLMN.

question_35331.question: What is the Top-1 beam pair prediction accuracy for AI/ML with a 1dB margin and for a set B of beams that is 1/16 of set A measured by five sources?
question_35331.ground_truth: AI/ML can achieve less than 50% to about 55%~57%, 60%~70%, 70%~80% prediction accuracy for Top-1 beam pair prediction with a 1dB margin, and the AI/ML can achieve about 55%~70% prediction accuracy based on five different sources.

question_35332.question: What is one of the requirements for the RAN architecture to support for efficient deployment of new services?
question_35332.ground_truth: The RAN architecture should allow for rapid and efficient deployment of new services.

question_35333.question: What are the two solutions provided to minimize latency during handovers?
question_35333.ground_truth: Solution 1 is to implement a RACH-less handover approach, removing the RACH attempt during handovers. Solution 2 is to maintain the source eNB connection during handover, keeping the connection open with the source eNB until the handover is completed successfully.

question_35334.question: What should the NG-RAN node do when it decides to release shared delivery for a multicast MBS session due to lack of serving UEs?
question_35334.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node sends a N2 MBS Session release request to the AMF.

question_35335.question: What are the instructions that the CSE can issue following an initial service event report in CAMEL?
question_35335.ground_truth: Following an initial service event report in CAMEL, the CSE can issued one or more of the following instructions: perform charging activities, activate control service events for the call, order in-band user interaction, or release the call.

question_35336.question: What is required to support MTC UEs with the reduction of supported downlink transmission modes in terms of specification changes?
question_35336.ground_truth: Minor specification changes may be expected, including the feature of reduced downlink transmission modes as a property of the UE category in TS 36.331.

question_35338.question: What is the advantage of assigning a service indication for each service within the MMTel group/suite of services?
question_35338.ground_truth: This approach allows for greater flexibility for the operator who may want to use different service subsets of the MMTel suite/group of services. It also allows for more efficient handling of specific service data for the application server in a distributed services environment.

question_35340.question: What is the difference between the terms "shall" and "should" in 3GPP technical specifications?
question_35340.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement, while "should" indicates a recommendation in 3GPP technical specifications.

question_35342.question: What is the probability of a good state in the Markov channel model?
question_35342.ground_truth: The probability of a good state is given by q/(p+q), where q is the probability of staying in a good state and p is the probability of transitioning from a good state to a bad state.

question_35343.question: What is the function of the Xn-C interface in the Xn interface?
question_35343.ground_truth: The Xn-C interface is the control plane interface between two neighboring New RAN nodes.

question_35344.question: What triggers the handover procedure from GAN to GERAN in the described scenario?
question_35344.ground_truth: The handover from GAN to GERAN is always triggered by the MS (Mobile Station).

question_35345.question: What signalling procedure is used for reporting the Secondary RAT usage data from MME to the Serving GW during IRAT handovers?
question_35345.ground_truth: The procedures 5.7A.3-1 to 5.7A.3-2 in its entirety is executed to provide reporting of Secondary RAT usage data to the Serving GW and to the PDN GW if PGW secondary RAT usage data reporting is active during IRAT handovers.

question_35346.question: What is the precondition for the P-GW to send the updated list of available P-CSCFs to the UE over TWAN?
question_35346.ground_truth: The UE should support the P-CSCF restoration extension for TWAN, the TWAN should support the new WLCP PDN connection modification procedure, and the UE should be using the multi-connection mode.

question_35347.question: What is the role of the TNGF key in the 5G network?
question_35347.ground_truth: The TNGF key is used for mutual authentication between the UE and the TNGF in the 5G network.

question_35348.question: What scheme is used in the example of inter-RNS hard handover with switch in CN, where the UE uses one node B under the target RNC after the handover?
question_35348.ground_truth: The SRNS Relocation scheme is used in this example.

question_35350.question: What procedures does the BM-SC initiated MBMS De-Registration Procedure result in?
question_35350.ground_truth: The BM-SC initiated MBMS De-Registration Procedure results in releasing of all MBMS Bearer Contexts and associated MBMS UE Contexts in the nodes along the distribution tree, tearing down the distribution tree for the delivery of session attributes and MBMS data.

question_35351.question: What is the maximum accepted test system uncertainty for the frequency range 4.2 - 6 GHz?
question_35351.ground_truth: The maximum accepted test system uncertainty for the frequency range 4.2 - 6 GHz is the same as for the 3 - 4.2 GHz range.

question_35352.question: What is the difference between Model A and Model B discovery in the ProSe Direct Discovery procedure?
question_35352.ground_truth: In Model A discovery, the Announcing UE starts to announce the ProSe Application Code on the PC5 interface and the monitoring UE starts to monitor the ProSe Application Code on the PC5 interface. In contrast, Model B discovery involves the Discoverer UE starting to announce the ProSe Query Code on the PC5 interface and the Discoveree UE starting to monitor the ProSe Query Code on the PC5 interface. If a received ProSe Query Code matches any of the Discovery Query Filter(s), the UE announces the associated ProSe Response Code on the PC5 interface.

question_35353.question: What are the requirements for a TAB connector that supports both RX and TX in TDD mode during the transmitter OFF period?
question_35353.ground_truth: The requirements for a TAB connector that supports both RX and TX in TDD mode during the transmitter OFF period are specified in a subclause of the document.

question_35354.question: What is the definition of the sparseness measure in the context of the TCX/HQ technology selection?
question_35354.ground_truth: The sparseness measure is defined as the number of bins in a low band that exceed a certain condition, divided by the total number of bins in that low band, where the condition is that the bin energy is greater than the average energy of all spectrum bands.

question_35355.question: In the scenario where the charging system is aware of the UPF change (Solution 3.4.1), what happens during step B?
question_35355.ground_truth: During step B, the SMF triggers the reporting from UPF1 for consumed quota reporting to the charging system and requests the charging system to allocate the new granted quota for UPF 2.

question_35356.question: What is the minimum requirement for the average BLER for the indicated transport formats subject to an interference source with specified DIP in the minimum requirements for PUCCH 1-1 (CSI Reference Symbol) for enhanced receiver Type A?
question_35356.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for the average BLER for the indicated transport formats subject to an interference source with specified DIP is greater than or equal to 2%.

question_35357.question: When is the NPLI stored at MME used in the GTP-based S5/S8?
question_35357.ground_truth: The NPLI stored at MME is used when MME does not interact with the eNodeB to retrieve location information.

question_35358.question: What shall the UE do if it receives EMM cause #40 and there is no fallback call pending or in progress?
question_35358.ground_truth: The UE shall deactivate all EPS bearer contexts and enter state EMM-DEREGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE. If there is a CS fallback emergency call or CS fallback call pending, a 1xCS fallback emergency call or 1xCS fallback call pending, or a paging for CS fallback or 1xCS fallback, the UE shall attempt to select the appropriate radio access technology or perform a new attach procedure.

question_35360.question: What was the listening level adjusted on for the Rendering Comparison Test?
question_35360.ground_truth: The listening level was adjusted on a global level across all test and reference items.

question_35361.question: What is the role of the IBCF when acting as an exit point and sending a failure response to any received request?
question_35361.ground_truth: The IBCF may insert a Response-Source header field with an "fe" header field parameter constructed with the URN namespace "urn:3gpp:fe", the fe-id part of the URN set to "ibcf" and optionally an appropriate fe-param part of the URN set in accordance with subclause7.2.17.

question_35362.question: What message is sent by the AMF to the source NG-RAN node to transfer the uplink and downlink status during a handover?
question_35362.ground_truth: UPLINK RAN STATUS TRANSFER and DOWNLINK RAN STATUS TRANSFER

question_35365.question: What is replaced by the SMF in MNO in a PLMN?

question_35366.question: What is the initial state for the test procedure in 26.8.1.2 for the establishment of an outgoing call?
question_35366.ground_truth: The initial state for the test procedure is U0, which is the null state in the call control of the mobile station.

question_35367.question: If a UE has successfully integrity checked a received message via 3GPP access and is operating in single-registration mode, what should it do if the message has been successfully integrity checked by the NAS and the EMM cause is #31?
question_35367.ground_truth: The UE should set the 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, delete any 5G-GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list, and ngKSI, reset the registration attempt counter, and enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE.

question_35369.question: What is the KSI used for in the context of UMTS authentication?
question_35369.ground_truth: The KSI is used to ensure UMTS authentication information (CK and IK) consistency between the MS and the VLR and between the MS and the SGSN.

question_35370.question: What does the PF represent in Solution #3.6?
question_35370.ground_truth: In Solution #3.6, the PF is the logical function that serves the clients and applies user-specific handling on the calls, and it can also own a specific MBMS bearer and send media and floor control messages via its own bearer.

question_35371.question: What is the definition of Pout in the context of relay output power?
question_35371.ground_truth: Pout of the relay is the mean power of one carrier delivered to a load with resistance equal to the nominal load impedance of the transmitter.

question_35372.question: What should an MS do upon receiving the same ETWS Primary Notification message more than once?
question_35372.ground_truth: The MS should silently discard the last received Primary Notification message.

question_35373.question: What is the purpose of the "Notify" message type in the 3GPP TS 24.008 standard?
question_35373.ground_truth: This message is sent either from the mobile station or from the network to indicate information pertaining to a call, such as user suspended.

question_35374.question: When during Step H does the lower step size requirement not apply?
question_35374.ground_truth: The lower step size requirement does not apply for the power step adjacent to the Min or Max power threshold for test during Step H.

question_35375.question: What action is taken when NAS signalling messages, having not successfully passed the integrity check, are received in the UE?
question_35375.ground_truth: The NAS layer in the UE shall discard that message.

question_35378.question: What is the purpose of raising the signal energy at high frequency in the process described?
question_35378.ground_truth: The purpose of raising the signal energy at high frequency is to achieve a signal with less spectral dynamics, which enhances the resolution of LPC (Linearly Predictive Coding) analysis. This is especially beneficial in fixed-point implementations.

question_35379.question: What information is included in the claims of the access token?
question_35379.ground_truth: The claims of the access token include the NF Instance Id of NRF (issuer), NF Instance Id of the NF Service Consumer (subject), NF Instance Id or several NF Instance Id(s) of the requested NF Service Producer (audience), expected service name(s) (scope), optionally "additional scope" information (allowed resources and allowed actions (service operations) on the resources), and expiration time (expiration).

question_35380.question: What is the MCVideo imminent peril group state that should be set in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body when the MCVideo client receives notification of the cancellation of the in-progress imminent peril state of the group?
question_35380.ground_truth: The MCVideo imminent peril group state should be set to "MVIG 1: no-imminent-peril".

question_35382.question: What should the HLR do if the Compatibility Information received allows it to deduce a PLMN Bearer Service?
question_35382.ground_truth: The HLR shall pass the corresponding PLMN BC to the VLR in the "Provide Roaming Number" request if the PLMN BC can be deduced from the Compatibility Information.

question_35385.question: What are some advantages and disadvantages of the autonomous ProSe Group formation solution?
question_35385.ground_truth: The autonomous ProSe Group formation solution has several advantages, such as the ability to synchronize clocks, centralize medium access control, assign IP addresses, serve as a UE-to-Network Relay, support 1:1 communication, and centralize authentication. However, it has one significant drawback: the Group Owner is a single point of failure. The solution also requires the definition of functionality in the RAN group, such as centralized medium access control protocol and frame header modifications.

question_35389.question: What are the different ways a test can terminate in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_35389.ground_truth: A test can terminate either explicitly, when it is requested by the IRPManager, or implicitly, when it terminates spontaneously.

question_35390.question: What is the relative L1-RSRP measurement error modeled as for evaluating the system performance?
question_35390.ground_truth: The relative L1-RSRP measurement error can be modeled as additive Gaussian noise with 95% of the density function within the measurement accuracy range, and/or uniformly distributed noise for the error due to baseband and/or RF impairment.

question_35392.question: What should the reportType be set to in order to perform logging at regular time intervals?
