question_36049.question: What is the main goal of the eMCCI work item in enabling users engaged in public safety scenarios to interwork between MC systems and LMR Radio Systems?
question_36049.ground_truth: The main goal of the eMCCI work item is to provide the means to utilize common features such as Group Call, group emergency notifications, grouping of users, grouping of groups, functional aliases, Unit to unit call, user location, and traffic encryption across both types of systems.

question_36050.question: What is the purpose of the "GANSS ID" field in the Requested GANSS Assistance Data?
question_36050.ground_truth: The "GANSS ID" field in the Requested GANSS Assistance Data indicates the GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System) for which the following assistance data is requested, such as Galileo, QZSS, GLONASS, etc.

question_36052.question: What is the uplink transmission waveform used in 5G NR?
question_36052.ground_truth: The uplink transmission waveform is conventional OFDM using a CP with a transform precoding function performing DFT spreading that can be disabled or enabled in 5G NR.

question_36053.question: What is the implication of sharing antenna for CA operation between Band 26 and Band 41?
question_36053.ground_truth: Sharing antenna for CA operation between Band 26 and Band 41 is not recommended as it could result in harmonics and IMDs falling into twenty-two bands in total.

question_36054.question: What action can a child node take upon receiving a BH RLF detection indication from its parent node?
question_36054.ground_truth: A child node may perform local rerouting for upstream traffic over an available backhaul (BH) link after receiving a BH RLF detection indication.

question_36055.question: When is the End-to-end MCPTT Access time (KPI 2) not applicable?
question_36055.ground_truth: The End-to-end MCPTT Access time (KPI 2) is not applicable for an MCPTT Group transmission call setup when no acknowledgement is requested from any Affiliated MCPTT Group Member.

question_36056.question: What procedures are affected by the Control Plane data back-off timer in the AMF?
question_36056.ground_truth: The Control Plane data back-off timer in the AMF does not affect any other mobility management or session management procedure, except for the NAS Messages within the Control Plane Service Request.

question_36057.question: What is the duration of a super frame in the context of SFN level synchronization for paging?
question_36057.ground_truth: The duration of a super frame in the context of SFN level synchronization for paging is in the order of seconds.

question_36058.question: What are the cardinality rules for EES as specified in clause 6.6.2.5?
question_36058.ground_truth: One or more EES(s) may be located in an EDN or one or more EES(s) may be located in an EDN per ECSP.

question_36059.question: What should the UE do if timer T3247 expires when it is in A/Gb mode or Iu mode?
question_36059.ground_truth: The UE should perform the actions as specified in 3GPP TS 24.008.

question_36060.question: What should non-supporting UEs in GERAN and UTRAN use as the "common PLMN-id" in their PLMN (re)selection processes?
question_36060.ground_truth: Non-supporting UEs in GERAN and UTRAN use the broadcast "common PLMN-id" in their PLMN (re)selection processes.

question_36061.question: What is the meaning of "shall" and "shall not" in 3GPP technical specification group documents?
question_36061.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, while "shall not" indicates an interdiction (prohibition) to do something in 3GPP technical specification group documents.

question_36064.question: Which element is the root element of the SEALLocationManagement document in the XML schema description of the location management document?
question_36064.ground_truth: The <location-info> element is the root element of the SEALLocationManagement document.

question_36065.question: What should an UE do if it wants to request an emergency service while being RLOS attached?
question_36065.ground_truth: The UE can detach from RLOS and then perform an emergency attach or establish an emergency PDN connection while staying RLOS attached and then perform IMS emergency registration.

question_36066.question: What event triggers the AMF to interact with the PCF and update RFSP index and/or SMF selection management related policy information in the AMF based on the Allowed NSSAI?
question_36066.ground_truth: A Change of the Allowed NSSAI trigger

question_36069.question: When is a MS considered to be "CAMEL-attached, MS may be reachable for paging" in the packet switched domain?
question_36069.ground_truth: The MS is registered to the GPRS data network, but there are no PDP contexts active for this MS, and the GPRS data network has not determined that the MS is not reachable for paging.

question_36070.question: What information may be included in the PIN policies and parameters for each PIN?
question_36070.ground_truth: PIN ID, PIN type, whether the UE is permitted to act as a PINE, PEGC, and/or PEMC, Permitted Discovery Types, and Security policies and parameters for communication within the PIN.

question_36073.question: What mechanism is used to forward packets from the PDN GW to the ProSe UE-to-Network Relay in the scenario where the Relay is not a member of the IP multicast group yet?
question_36073.ground_truth: The ProSe UE-to-Network Relay sends the IGMP Membership Report (MLD Multicast Listener Report in case of IPv6) to the PDN GW serving the ProSe Relay PDN to join the multicast group.

question_36074.question: What is the impact on an operator's coexistence performance when Wi-Fi and NR-U have DL only traffic for a non-stand-alone NR-U deployment on an unlicensed carrier for an outdoor scenario 2 with one shared unlicensed carrier?
question_36074.ground_truth: One source reported an improvement in 22 of the 24 metrics with a maximum degradation under 5% for the non-replaced Wi-Fi operator.

question_36077.question: What is the main purpose of the "UE mobility event notification" service provided by AMF?
question_36077.ground_truth: The "UE mobility event notification" service provided by AMF is used for reporting UE presence in Area of Interest, which allows SMF to deal with PDU Sessions accordingly, such as reallocating UPF or determining how to handle the PDU Session for LADN.

question_36078.question: What actions are taken by the MME when there is (both idle mode and connected mode) mobility to an eNB that does not support User Plane Integrity Protection with EPS for bearers of PDN Connections with UP integrity protection set to Required?
question_36078.ground_truth: The MME ensures that the PDU session is released.

question_36079.question: What response will the IWF return if a SIP INVITE request for controlling MCPTT function of an MCPTT group is received and a SIP 404 (Not Found) response is cached?
question_36079.ground_truth: The IWF will return a SIP 404 (Not Found) response to the SIP INVITE request and include the Warning header field received in the SIP 404 (Not Found) response.

question_36080.question: What must be done in order to recreate sessions on an existing healthy SGW-U?
question_36080.ground_truth: A logical partition needs to be created on that SGW-U with a logical interface having the specified GTP-U end point address, and there must be enough capacity on that node to take up all the recreated sessions that share the same S5 GTP-U and the same S1U end-point addresses.

question_36081.question: How can noise contrast be reduced in a headset MS?
question_36081.ground_truth: Noise contrast can be reduced in a headset MS by maximizing the signal-to-noise ratio at the microphone input, which can be achieved by simultaneously increasing directivity, reducing sensitivity, and placing the microphone close to the mouth of the talker.

question_36082.question: What is the relationship between the intermodulation frequency and the moments of the statistical variables I1 and I2, when higher order coefficients (a5 and higher) are non-zero?
question_36082.ground_truth: Higher order moments (up to the eighth order for up to fifth order terms) of I1 and I2 become relevant at the given intermodulation frequency, when higher order coefficients (a5 and higher) are non-zero.

question_36083.question: Which discovery type is supported by Model B of ProSe Direct Discovery?
question_36083.ground_truth: Only restricted discovery type is supported by Model B of ProSe Direct Discovery.

question_36084.question: What is the definition of LSA only access in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
question_36084.ground_truth: LSA only access is a feature in 3GPP technical specifications where LSA users are allowed to access the PLMN only within their allowed LSAs, and are not allowed to receive or originate calls outside the LSA area.

question_36085.question: Where is the private user identity retained in the UE, if an ISIM is present?
question_36085.ground_truth: If an ISIM is present, the private user identity is retained within the ISIM in the UE.

question_36086.question: What happens to predefined PCC rules when 3GPP PS Data Off is activated?
question_36086.ground_truth: When 3GPP PS Data Off is activated, predefined PCC rules other than those representing 3GPP PS Data Off Exempt Service can be modified or removed by the PCRF.

question_36087.question: What is the procedure to share the rekeying token with RAN nodes without sending the rekeying token list upfront?
question_36087.ground_truth: The rekeying token is sent directly to the RAN nodes at a certain step, without specifying the token ID.

question_36088.question: How does dynamic traffic affect the average RoT (Round Trip Time) between Lean carrier and CPC cases?
question_36088.ground_truth: With dynamic traffic, the difference in average RoT between Lean carrier and the CPC cases are more pronounced than with a fixed transmission pattern. At a very high load of 100 user/cell, a 4dB lower RoT can be achieved for Lean carrier over the most extreme CPC case with the shortest possible burst size and the longest possible cycle length.

question_36092.question: What existing analytics does Solution #48 propose to use to adjust URSP fields?
question_36092.ground_truth: Solution #48 proposes using analytics such as "Slice Load Level" for S-NSSAI, "DN Performance" for DNN, and "Service Experience" and "WLAN Performance" for Access Type.

question_36093.question: What action should the ICS UE take when an I1 Success message is received while the I1 session at the UE is in the "proceeding" state or "alerted" state?
question_36093.ground_truth: The ICS UE should transit the I1 session to the "confirmed" state and stop any locally generated alerting procedures if applied. The ICS UE should also discard any subsequent I1 Success message if it is received over an unreliable transport-layer connection.

question_36094.question: In the context of the MSR, what determines the dynamic range requirements for UTRA and E-UTRA?
question_36094.ground_truth: The dynamic range requirements for UTRA and E-UTRA are not modified for BC1, BC2 and BC3 in the context of the MSR, and they are specified in TS 25.104, section 7.3.1, TS 25.105, section 7.3.1, and TS 36.104, section 7.3.1.

question_36095.question: Which security mechanism(s) are mandatory for securing Diameter signaling between peers in IETF RFC 6733?
question_36095.ground_truth: TLS/TCP and DTLS/SCTP are the mandatory security mechanisms for Diameter signaling between peers in IETF RFC 6733.

question_36096.question: What are the four possibilities for making a USIM available in the RN?
question_36096.ground_truth: The four possibilities are: 1. Hard-coding the USIM credentials in the RN's secure environment in the factory, 2. Physically making the USIM part of the secure environment in the factory, 3. Inserting the USIM by a field engineer and making it part of the secure environment, and 4. Inserting the USIM by a field engineer when the RN is deployed and not making it part of the secure environment.

question_36097.question: How many bits are used for the timeslot resource related information in the E-AGCH type 2?

question_36098.question: When can an AMF include a list of supported S-NSSAIs in the Steering of Roaming procedure?
question_36098.ground_truth: An AMF can include a list of supported S-NSSAIs in the Steering of Roaming procedure when the UDM receives an indication that the UE has requested Deregistration due to a lack of S-NSSAI support in a VPLMN.

question_36099.question: Which HTTP method is used to query the IMS restoration information using the specified URI?
question_36099.ground_truth: The "GET" method is used to query the IMS restoration information.

question_36100.question: What is the behavior of ME+ during handover from E-UTRAN to UTRAN?
question_36100.ground_truth: ME+ and MME derive a confidentiality key CK' and an integrity key IK' from the KASME, and MME sends CK' and IK' to the target SGSN, which derives CKU/IKU based on KRNC and the selected security algorithm if the target RNC+ supports the enhanced security.

question_36101.question: What action does the target RNC take if the UE Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate IE is included in the RANAP ENHANCED RELOCATION INFORMATION REQUEST message?
question_36101.ground_truth: The target side shall, if supported, store the received UE Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate parameters to control the aggregate data rate of non-GBR traffic for this UE.

question_36102.question: What was the cause of the streaming service issue in the business area #CBD in sub case #2?
question_36102.ground_truth: The issue was caused by a problem with a server in the CDN network.

question_36103.question: What action does the UE take when it has radio link failure information available and RPLMN is included in plmn-Identity stored in VarRLF-Report in test case 8.1.6.1.3.3.1 (2)?
question_36103.ground_truth: UE sends the RRCReestablishmentComplete message with rlf-InfoAvailable included after receiving an RRCReestablishment message.

question_36104.question: In the "Controlled power down UE" use case, what is the service flow that occurs when a FRMCS User initiates the power-down of the UE?
question_36104.ground_truth: When a FRMCS User initiates the power-down of the UE, the UE is deregistered from the FRMCS System, and the FRMCS Equipment de-registers from the FRMCS System. Finally, the UE is switched off.

question_36105.question: What mechanisms can a network node invoke based on the low access priority indicator?
question_36105.ground_truth: A network node can invoke one or more of the following mechanisms: based on the low access priority indicator in NAS request messages and based on the low access priority for RR(C) connection establishment.

question_36107.question: What should the SS initially increase for the test?

question_36108.question: What information does the SMF report to the PCF when a new manageable Ethernet DS-TT port is detected?
question_36108.ground_truth: The SMF provides User plane node ID, the port number and optionally MAC address of the related port of the related PDU Session to the PCF.

question_36110.question: In 6.3.2.2.6.1, when should the participating MCVideo function perform the actions specified in clause 6.3.2.2.6.3?
question_36110.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function must perform the actions specified in clause 6.3.2.2.6.3 when it receives a "SIP INVITE request for terminating participating MCVideo function" that requires manual commencement mode, the invited MCVideo client has one or more pre-established sessions without an associated MCVideo session, the media-level sections for the offered MCVideo video media stream are the same as the existing pre-established session, and the media-level section of the offered media-transmission control entity is the same as the media-level section for media-transmission control entity in the existing pre-established session.

question_36114.question: Which element within the <announcement> contains a list of alternative TMGI used in roaming scenarios?

question_36117.question: Which message should the MSGin5G Gateway Client send the registration response to if the UE supports MSGin5G Gateway service functionality?
question_36117.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Gateway Client sends the registration response to the corresponding MSGin5G Client.

question_36121.question: What does the SAND (Server and Network Assisted DASH) technology, specified in ISO/IEC 23009-5, aim to enhance for DASH content delivery?
question_36121.ground_truth: The SAND technology aims to enhance the delivery of DASH content by introducing messages between DASH clients and network elements or between various network elements. This is done to provide information about real-time operational characteristics of networks, servers, proxies, caches, CDNs, and DASH client's performance and status, with the goal of improving efficiency of streaming sessions.

question_36122.question: What should the UE do when the condition A4-2 is fulfilled for event A4?
question_36122.ground_truth: The UE should consider the leaving condition for event A4 to be satisfied when the inequality A4-2 is fulfilled, which means that the neighboring cell is no longer better than the absolute threshold.

question_36127.question: What is the purpose of GTP-C load & overload control mechanism in GTP-C entities?
question_36127.ground_truth: The purpose of GTP-C load & overload control mechanism in GTP-C entities is to control the number of incoming requests so that the receiving GTP-C entity can successfully process them, avoiding the loss of network services and revenue.

question_36128.question: What MESSAGE request containing a MIME body is required to be supported at the roaming II-NNI for the CS to PS SRVCC feature?
question_36128.ground_truth: The MESSAGE request containing the Accept-Contact header field with the "g.3gpp.path" media feature tag and the "application/vnd.3gpp.srvcc-ext+xml" MIME body.

question_36129.question: What is the role of FAR in the network's security measures to block traffic that is not from or to PVS and DNS server addresses?
question_36129.ground_truth: FAR (Firewall Address Redaction) is used in the network's security measures to block traffic that is not from or to PVS and DNS server addresses.

question_36130.question: What should the UE/MS do if the SGSN indicated 'Reset to default parameters' in the NAS container for PS HO in the Handover from eUTRAN Command message?
question_36130.ground_truth: The UE/MS may avoid triggering XID negotiation for any LLC SAPI used in LLC ADM and wait for the SGSN to initiate it.

question_36131.question: What is the impact of Option 1) on the SMF?
question_36131.ground_truth: In Option 1), the SMF includes an indication that the PDU Session may be re-established on an S-NSSAI different from S-NSSAI-1 in the PDU Session release/modification procedure.

question_36133.question: What does T5 triggering offer in terms of payload size compared to T4 triggering for delivering trigger messages?
question_36133.ground_truth: T5 triggering can carry a larger payload compared to T4 triggering, which allows it to be more efficient for use with standardized service platform protocols that may not fit within a very small data transfer unit.

question_36135.question: What must be done before a MCIM can be downloaded and provisioned into the M2ME?
question_36135.ground_truth: The TRE must perform security-related functions to validate the authenticity and integrity of the M2ME using standardized protocols, such as computation of cryptographic signatures.

question_36136.question: What should be the same port number used for when transmitting and receiving RTP based media to/from the remote network and the MTSI client in terminal?
question_36136.ground_truth: The MTSI MGW shall transmit RTP packets from and receive RTP packets on the same port number, not necessarily the same port number as used to/from the MTSI client in terminal.

question_36139.question: What should the MC service ensure when enabling an MC service UE in an ongoing MC service group session that has just entered an area of media delivery via MBMS bearers?
question_36139.ground_truth: The MC service should ensure that the UE immediately starts receiving the media for that MC service group session via MBMS, while preserving the reception context to minimize or eliminate interruption of service.

question_36140.question: What is the meaning of the "might" construction in the context of the present document?
question_36140.ground_truth: The "might" construction indicates a likelihood that something will or will not happen as a result of action taken by some agency the behavior of which is outside the scope of the present document.

question_36141.question: What should be done at the UDM/HSS side for P-CSCF restoration in the 5GS when a terminating request does not proceed due to a P-CSCF failure?
question_36141.ground_truth: The UDM can either send a P-CSCF restoration indication to the serving SMF for IMS PDU session, triggering IMS PDU session update or re-establishment, or send the indication to the serving AMF for the UE, triggering IMS PDU session re-establishment.

question_36142.question: What action will the P-CSCF take upon receiving an SDP answer to an SDP offer from a remote user with an accepted RTP based media?
question_36142.ground_truth: Upon receiving an SDP answer to an SDP offer from a remote user, the P-CSCF will act as defined in the specification, and remove the SDP crypto attribute for the accepted RTP based media.

question_36144.question: What should the SCC AS do when it wants to establish a new I1 session toward the ICS UE that uses an existing CS bearer leg?
question_36144.ground_truth: The SCC AS should send an I1 Invite message toward the ICS UE, setting the Reason in the I1 Invite message to value hex "003" to indicate that the existing CS bearer leg will be used for this call, and not include the SCC-AS-id information element. The SCC AS should also send a SIP re-INVITE request toward the CS domain that contains an SDP offer received in a SIP INVITE request from the remote UE.

question_36145.question: What is defined as the time between an event that will trigger a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface, excluding certain delays?

question_36146.question: What action should the SGW take if it receives a GTP error indication for a bearer context other than the default bearer when S4-U is used?
question_36146.ground_truth: The SGW may delete its Bearer context and notify the Operation and Maintenance network element, or send a Downlink Data Notification message to the S4-SGSN to re-establish the user plane path without deleting the bearer context.

question_36148.question: What is the role of the H-SMF in the HPLMN in N9HR?
question_36148.ground_truth: The H-SMF in the HPLMN assigns a separate QoS Flow Index (QFI) for IMS signalling related packets and IMS voice related packets in N9HR.

question_36149.question: In 3GPP documentation, what can the enum value "notSupported" mean?

question_36150.question: What should the MCData client include in the "m=" line of an SDP message when composing an SDP offer?
question_36150.ground_truth: The MCData client should include the port number, the protocol field value of "TCP/MSRP" or "TCP/TLS/MSRP", a format list field set to '*', an "a=sendonly" attribute, an "a=path" attribute containing its own MSRP URI, a content type of "a=accept-types:application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-payload", and an "a=setup" attribute set to "actpass".

question_36151.question: Which element in the UAE document contains a string set to either "positive" or "negative" used to indicate the positive or negative result of the reception?

question_36152.question: What RAN4 parameter should be evaluated when selecting the SCS (Subcarrier Spacing) for the 7-24 GHz range?
question_36152.ground_truth: Phase noise should be evaluated when selecting the SCS for the 7-24 GHz range as it is generally worse at higher frequencies for mmWave.

question_36153.question: When does the UE respond to paging as normal when the Service Gap timer is running?
question_36153.ground_truth: When the Service Gap timer is running, the UE shall respond as normal to paging.

question_36154.question: What information can be sent to the end-user by the gsmSRF using the inbandInfo parameter?
question_36154.ground_truth: The inbandInfo parameter can specify the inband information to be sent, which may be a single announcement, text to be sent and transformed to inband information by the gsmSRF, a sequence of announcements, or an announcement with one or more variable parts.

question_36156.question: What should the UE do as soon as possible after a change in priority layer for cell reselection?
question_36156.ground_truth: The UE should search for a higher priority layer for cell reselection as soon as possible after the change of priority.

question_36159.question: What actions does the UE take if it receives session state information for a held session?
question_36159.ground_truth: The UE initiates a session transfer request towards the SCC AS using the dynamic STI for the held session.

question_36160.question: What must be done if detailed location information is available for reporting?
question_36160.ground_truth: The locationInfo must be set to include the locationCoordinates and, if available, the gnss-TOD-msec and verticalVelocityInfo.

question_36161.question: What does the "5gsToEpsMob" attribute encoded in the "uePolReq" message indicate?
question_36161.ground_truth: It indicates that the trigger for the UE Policy Association Establishment is the 5GS to EPS mobility scenario.

question_36162.question: In what situation should a UE not include a Geolocation header field in the INVITE request when initiating an emergency call?
question_36162.ground_truth: If the UE has neither geographical location information available, nor a URI that points to the location information, it should not insert a Geolocation header field in the INVITE request.

question_36163.question: What does the CoAP-1 reference point consist of?
question_36163.ground_truth: The CoAP-1 reference point is based on CoAP and exists between the CoAP client and the CoAP proxy.

question_36164.question: In the emergency call procedure, what is the first message sent by the MS (Mobile Station) after channel assignment by the network?
question_36164.ground_truth: The first message sent by the MS after channel assignment by the network is a CM SERVICE REQUEST message specifying the correct CKSN and TMSI, with CM Service Type "emergency call establishment".

question_36165.question: What is the responsibility of the contact person for each band combination?
question_36165.ground_truth: The contact person for each band combination is responsible for ensuring that the TPs related to the band combination have been implemented.

question_36166.question: What information is indicated to the UE for event-triggered reporting with Event 1A and Event 1F, and what is to be reported?
question_36166.ground_truth: Information indicating to the UE that event-triggered reporting with Event 1A and Event 1F shall be used and "CFN-SFN-Observed Time Difference" shall be reported.

question_36167.question: What is the maximum allowed UE downlink BLER for the inter frequency system information acquisition test in section 8.3.10.2.2?
question_36167.ground_truth: The maximum allowed UE downlink BLER for the inter frequency system information acquisition test in section 8.3.10.2.2 is 0.612.

question_36169.question: What is the purpose of the procedures in section 5.3 of the document?
question_36169.ground_truth: The purpose of the procedures in section 5.3 is to enable Endpoint B to request location measurement data and/or a location estimate from Endpoint A, and to enable Endpoint A to transfer location measurement data and/or a location estimate to Endpoint B in the absence of a request.

question_36170.question: What factors are taken into account in the analysis of RAN latency reduction for the FTP download application?
question_36170.ground_truth: The factors taken into account include backhaul latency, downloaded file size, Uu throughput, L1 control and RS overhead, and UL access latency.

question_36172.question: What are the benefits of reusing UMTS management solutions for E-UTRAN and EPC?
question_36172.ground_truth: The benefits include using proven solutions, reducing standardization and product development efforts, simplifying network integration, and providing a solid base for future functionality development.

question_36173.question: What is the format of the returned bytes for CatGetCHVStatus?
question_36173.ground_truth: The format of the returned bytes for CatGetCHVStatus is specified in 3GPP TS 31.101.

question_36174.question: What is the definition of "Reliability" as used in the document?
question_36174.ground_truth: Reliability is the amount of sent network layer packets successfully delivered to a given node within the time constraint required by the targeted service, divided by the total number of sent network layer packets.

question_36176.question: What is the pre-condition for an EEC to send a registration update request to the EES?
question_36176.ground_truth: The EEC has already registered with the EES.

question_36178.question: What is the action taken in step b) of the test procedure?
question_36178.ground_truth: Step a) and b) are repeated for all Bearer Services/Teleservices declared as supported by the MS.

question_36180.question: What is the definition of Frequency Error as per the document?
question_36180.ground_truth: Frequency Error is the measure of the difference between the actual relay transmit frequency and the assigned frequency.

question_36182.question: What should the Mobile Station (MS) do when it receives an ASSIGNMENT COMMAND message with a Starting Time IE?
question_36182.ground_truth: The MS should react as specified in step 6, but this shall be done at the time specified in Starting Time IE.

question_36183.question: What is the maximum length of the Alpha Identifier for the URL in PROACTIVE COMMAND: LAUNCH BROWSER 5.5.2?

question_36184.question: What is the role of the GA-RRC INITIAL DIRECT TRANSFER message in the GA-RRC connection establishment procedure?
question_36184.ground_truth: The GA-RRC INITIAL DIRECT TRANSFER message is used to transfer the "initial" upper layer message for the domain from the MS to the GANC. Receipt of the GA-RRC INITIAL DIRECT TRANSFER message by the GANC triggers the establishment of the signalling connection to the indicated CN domain for the MS.

question_36185.question: What is the goal of the migration procedure in MC service group communications?
question_36185.ground_truth: The migration procedure allows an MC service user to obtain MC service directly from a partner MC system and continue the group communication in the other MC system.

question_36186.question: How are the two noise floor gains quantized for the low-frequency noise-fill in the generic mode?
question_36186.ground_truth: The two noise floor gains are scalar quantized with 5 bits on a log domain and transmitted to the decoder for the high-frequency noise-fill.

question_36188.question: What condition must be met for the cell re-selection delay to a lower priority E-UTRA cell?
question_36188.ground_truth: The cell re-selection delay to a lower priority E-UTRA cell shall be less than Tevaluate, E-UTRAN + TSI-E-UTRA in RRC_IDLE state.

question_36190.question: What is the effect of switching off the UE on the operator-defined access category definitions?
question_36190.ground_truth: The operator-defined access category definitions are kept after switching off the UE, so that they can be used after switch on.

question_36191.question: What interfaces does the Wireline Access Gateway Function (W-AGF) use to connect the 5G-RG to the 5G Core Network CP and UP functions?
question_36191.ground_truth: The W-AGF interfaces the 5G Core Network CP and UP functions via N2 and N3 interfaces, respectively.

question_36192.question: What is the message that the MME sends to the Serving GW to optimize the signaling in the RRC Connection Resume procedure?
question_36192.ground_truth: Modify Access Bearers Request per UE per PDN connection to the Serving GW is sent by the MME to the Serving GW to optimize the signaling in the RRC Connection Resume procedure.

question_36193.question: What is the output of the intra-LTE load balancing described in section 4.6.5?
question_36193.ground_truth: Handover parameters, including HO trigger threshold

question_36194.question: What is the approximate spatial isolation achieved for a ceiling- or wall-mounted base station with directive antenna radiation patterns in the Nokia study?

question_36197.question: What is the purpose of the "Update PDP context/bearer at P-CSCF failure" mechanism?
question_36197.ground_truth: The "Update PDP context/bearer at P-CSCF failure" mechanism allows the P-CSCF to remain reachable even if it is temporarily unavailable, and enables the S-CSCF to reconnect to the same P-CSCF once it becomes reachable again.

question_36198.question: What should the MCData client do when timer TFS3 (delivery and read) expires for an SDS OFF-NETWORK MESSAGE message with a disposition of DELIVERY AND READ?
question_36198.ground_truth: The MCData client should send first an SDS OFF-NETWORK NOTIFICATION message with a disposition notification type of DELIVERED and then send an SDS OFF-NETWORK NOTIFICATION message with a disposition notification type of READ after the payload is rendered to the MCData User.

question_36199.question: What improvements does the alter ego make after receiving feedback from John?
question_36199.ground_truth: After receiving feedback from John, the autonomous virtual alter ego becomes more accurate and finishes the tasks much more immediately. As a result, the time available to John in life is more than doubled.

question_36200.question: What is the maximum value for the CCNR-CC-T3-timer?
question_36200.ground_truth: The maximum value for the CCNR-CC-T3-timer is 180 minutes.

question_36201.question: What are the pre-conditions for initiating a real-time video stream in the FRMCS system?
question_36201.ground_truth: The pre-conditions for initiating a real-time video stream in the FRMCS system are that the streaming FRMCS User or FRMCS Equipment has registered to a functional identity that is authorized to initiate a real-time video stream, and the receiving FRMCS User or FRMCS Equipment has registered to a functional identity that is authorized to receive a real-time video stream.

question_36202.question: What new requirements may be needed to support the use case of using satellite connectivity to aid in terrestrial network planning?
question_36202.ground_truth: A new requirement may be that the 5G system with satellite access should be able to support collection of information on usage statistics and location of UEs that are connected to the satellite, for network (e.g. terrestrial) planning using optimum resources, subject to regulatory requirements and operator policies.

question_36204.question: What is the main purpose of the NAS Security Mode Command procedure in 5G systems?
question_36204.ground_truth: The NAS Security Mode Command procedure is typically executed as part of the Attach procedure in advance of, or in combination with, executing the ME Identity Check procedure and in the TAU procedure. It is used to establish the security mode between the UE and the network.

question_36205.question: What method is used to create an individual SM context resource in the SMF or V-SMF for HR roaming scenarios?
question_36205.ground_truth: The POST method is used to create an individual SM context resource in the SMF or V-SMF for HR roaming scenarios.

question_36206.question: What is the function of the IWF in the LMR user to MCData user SDS request procedure?
question_36206.ground_truth: The IWF initiates a one-to-one MCData data communication for sending a standalone SDS data to an MCData user over the signalling plane with or without a disposition request.

question_36207.question: What message does the PDN GW send to the UE after updating its binding with the 'client identifier' and 'chaddr' combination for subsequent DHCPv4 procedure?
question_36207.ground_truth: The PDN GW extends an IPv4 lease offer and sends the DHCPv4 Offer with the assigned UE IPv4 address.

question_36209.question: What is step 2 in a procedure triggered by a source request and coordinated with the destination?
question_36209.ground_truth: The NRM server determines if VAL client 1 is authorized to connect to VAL client 2.

question_36211.question: What redundancy levels are supported in 3GPP TS 48.103 for CS Data service with Redundancy over AoIP?
question_36211.ground_truth: The redundancy levels 2 and 3 are supported in 3GPP TS 48.103 for CS Data service with Redundancy over AoIP.

question_36212.question: What is the expected sequence for the activity progress of the fax call as it moves from Phase B to Phase C?
question_36212.ground_truth: The expected sequence for the activity progress of the fax call as it moves from Phase B to Phase C involves the FA sending preamble and CFR frames, the FA entering the BCS-TRA state and receiving the CFR, and the fax transferring data embedded in DATA frames. After the data transfer is complete, the FA sends at least 5 SYNC frames to indicate that the message phase is over and the call proceeds to the next phase or is cleared manually.

question_36216.question: How are silence frames (SID-frames) treated in the calculation of average codec bitrate for audio media?
question_36216.ground_truth: Silence frames (SID-frames) are not counted as "active" and are excluded from the calculation of average codec bitrate for audio media.

question_36218.question: What is one solution for the Random Access Response (RAR) message delay issue in IoT NTN?
question_36218.ground_truth: One solution is adjusting the offset to delay the start of the RA Response window, allowing more time for the RAR message to be received in NTN.

question_36219.question: What happens when an MCPTT user on MCPTT client 1 receives a group call request message?
question_36219.ground_truth: Upon receiving the group call request message, the MCPTT user at MCPTT client 1 may accept or reject the call. Alternatively, they may also perform a late call entry upon receiving a notification message.

question_36220.question: What is the purpose of the VNF PM data related to VR job creation procedure?
question_36220.ground_truth: The VNF PM data related to VR job creation procedure is for creating a PM job that identifies the VNF or VNFC for which the PM data is to be collected, and specifies the periodicity for collection and reporting of performance information.

question_36221.question: What are the applicable events for the PDG in 3GPP WLAN Interworking services?
question_36221.ground_truth: The applicable events for the PDG in 3GPP WLAN Interworking services are I-WLAN Tunnel Establishment, I-WLAN Tunnel Disconnect, and Packet Data Header Information.

question_36222.question: What is sent to MCPTT client 1 after returning from out of coverage?
question_36222.ground_truth: The MCPTT server sends a floor taken to MCPTT client 1, and MCPTT users at MCPTT client 2 and MCPTT client 3 may be notified about the MCPTT client 1 returning to the group call.

question_36223.question: What types of traffic require different QoS parameters in an IAB network?
question_36223.ground_truth: For different types of OAM traffic, it is necessary to use different DRBs between the IAB-MT and the serving DU, and different BH RLC channels for intermediate hops, with different QoS parameters. Alarm messages and commands are transported on a high-priority bearer, while counters may be transported on a lower priority bearer. OAM software downloads generate larger amounts of data but have a lower required data rate and a lower priority than alarms, commands, and counters.

question_36224.question: What element in the DAA-client-event-info contains a list of UASes where e.g. U2X layer has detected possible flight path conflict?

question_36226.question: What is the correct response of a Mobile Station to an Authentication Request message in the 26.7.2.1.1 conformance requirement?
question_36226.ground_truth: A Mobile Station shall correctly respond to an Authentication Request message by sending an Authentication Response message with the SRES information field set to the same value as the one produced by the authentication algorithm in the network.

question_36227.question: What is the purpose of adding integrity protection to some (or all) messages between the eNB and the SAE GW?
question_36227.ground_truth: The purpose of adding integrity protection to some (or all) messages between the eNB and the SAE GW is to prevent backhaul link threats and counter attacks where an attacker forges path-switches on behalf of eNBs. Adding this integrity protection adds close to no overhead in terms of establishing the integrity key, but adds overhead in terms of bulk processing.

question_36228.question: What is a benefit of collocating the IWF in the FAGF-U in terms of reducing hops and handling traffic?
question_36228.ground_truth: When the 5G-RG/FN-RG connects via wireline access, collocating the IWF in the FAGF-U can reduce hops and enable coordinated handling of both RG and UE traffic in the W-5GAN.

question_36229.question: What is the role of the SMF in providing XR traffic assistance information to the gNB?
question_36229.ground_truth: The SMF provides XR traffic assistance information (e.g., UL and/or DL Periodicity, N6 Jitter Information) to the gNB through NG AP TSC Assistance Information for better UE power saving.

question_36231.question: What information does the gNB-CU-UP send to the gNB-CU-CP in the DL DATA NOTIFICATION message during the successful operation of the DL Data Notification procedure?
question_36231.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP sends the PPI IE, PDU Session To Notify List IE, MT-SDT Information IE, or SDT Data Size Threshold Crossed IE in the DL DATA NOTIFICATION message.

question_36232.question: What reference points are used at the service layer to realize peering-based business trunking arrangements?
question_36232.ground_truth: The main reference points from the IMS service layer that are used to realize peering-based business trunking arrangements include e2, Gq', Ici or Mm, Mx, Cx, Sh, and ISC or Ma.

question_36233.question: What is the message contents in Option 1, Step 14A of the test procedure in section 70.9.2.2?
question_36233.ground_truth: RELEASE COMPLETE message containing a LocationNotification return result with verificationResponse set to permissionGranted.

question_36234.question: What is the modulation used for E-PUCH?
question_36234.ground_truth: An E-PUCH may use QPSK or 16QAM modulation symbols.

question_36236.question: What is the security protection of the NOTIFICATION message?
question_36236.ground_truth: The NOTIFICATION message is always sent within SECURITY PROTECTED 5GS NAS MESSAGE message.

question_36239.question: What is the definition of the performance plots on the right hand side?
question_36239.ground_truth: The performance plots on the right hand side are based on the same simulations but are depicted FER versus C/I1, showing the fraction C2 of carrier power C which does not contribute to the wanted signal for user 1.

question_36240.question: What is the expected result of the set command +CSODCP when the uplink data transfer is completed with this data transfer, and an acknowledgement is not requested from the receiver?
question_36240.ground_truth: The network acknowledges transmission of the user data and does not request acknowledgement for the next received downlink data.

question_36241.question: What are the three modular modules used in real-time automatic translation of languages?
question_36241.ground_truth: The three modules are Speech to Text (S2T), Translation, and Text to Speech (T2S).

question_36243.question: What does the E-DCH TDD Maximum Bitrate parameter indicate for an E-DCH in TDD mode?
question_36243.ground_truth: The E-DCH TDD Maximum Bitrate parameter indicates the Maximum Bitrate for an E-DCH in TDD mode.

question_36244.question: What service does the NWDAF offer to provide recommendations?
question_36244.ground_truth: The NWDAF offers a Recommendations service that proposes recommendations (parameter values) to NFs.

question_36246.question: If the UE supports S1 mode, what must it do if it also supports sending an ATTACH REQUEST message containing a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message with request type set to "handover"?
question_36246.ground_truth: The UE must set the HO attach bit to "attach request message containing PDN connectivity request with request type set to handover to transfer PDU session from N1 mode to S1 mode supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

question_36247.question: What happens when the old and the new GUTI shall be considered as valid at the same time on the network side?
question_36247.ground_truth: When a lower layer failure is detected before the GUTI REALLOCATION COMPLETE message is received, the old and the new GUTI shall be considered as valid until the old GUTI can be considered as invalid by the network. The network may then use the old S-TMSI from the old GUTI for paging within the area defined by the old TAI list for an implementation dependent number of paging attempts, and if no response is received to the paging attempts, the network may use the IMSI for paging for an implementation dependent number of paging attempts. In this case, paging with IMSI causes the UE to re-attach.

question_36249.question: What is the difference between "shall" and "might" as used in the present document?
question_36249.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, while "might" indicates a likelihood that something will happen as a result of action taken by some agency the behavior of which is outside the scope of the present document.

question_36252.question: What is the comprehensive content delivery framework in the 3GPP PSS?
question_36252.ground_truth: The comprehensive content delivery framework in the 3GPP PSS is introduced in Release 6 and includes a list of recommended media types and codecs for higher service quality within the 3GPP environments. It also includes optional strong content encryption and integrity protection capabilities, interoperability with cryptographic key management systems, and a standardised container file exchange between PSS providers.

question_36253.question: How can IMS utilize the service based capabilities and service based interfaces of the 5GC for interactions between the IMS and the 5GC?
question_36253.ground_truth: IMS applications and network functions can utilize the service based capabilities and service based interfaces of the 5GC through the use of service based interfaces for interactions between the IMS and the 5GC. The specific 5GC functions that should be interfaced with IMS using service based interfaces will depend on the requirements of the network.

question_36254.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the Contact header field of the SIP INVITE request for a private call with transmission control?
question_36254.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include the g.3gpp.mcvideo media feature tag and the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag in the Contact header field of the SIP INVITE request.

question_36256.question: What entity is responsible for allocating local IP addresses and port numbers for caches in Alternative 3.3.1?

question_36257.question: What will the S-CSCF do if the maximum number of allowed simultaneously registration flows for the UE is reached?
question_36257.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall reject the REGISTER by generating a 403 (Forbidden) response.

question_36258.question: What conditions must be met for an SCell1 activation delay to be counted as correct during repeated tests?
question_36258.ground_truth: The rate of correct observed SCell1 activation delay and SCell1 deactivation delay should be at least 90% with a confidence level of 95% during repeated tests.

question_36259.question: When might the UE need to include the Unavailability information IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message to indicate upcoming availability due to discontinuous coverage?
question_36259.ground_truth: If the network has indicated support for enhanced discontinuous coverage and needs to indicate upcoming availability due to discontinuous coverage, the UE shall include the Unavailability information IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message, with the unavailability type set to "unavailability due to discontinuous coverage".

question_36260.question: What should be the PDP type number in the Requested PDP address information element in the ACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message for non-IP connectivity?

question_36261.question: What does UE need to establish two redundant PDU Sessions and associate duplicated traffic to them?
question_36261.ground_truth: UE needs to use URSP as specified in TS 23.503 to establish two redundant PDU Sessions and associate duplicated traffic to them, or alternatively, UE may perform this task independently from URSP. In the latter case, UE may establish two redundant PDU Sessions even when the application does not duplicate the traffic and does not provide two distinct traffic descriptors. UE may use its implementation of FRER defined in IEEE Std 802.1CB-2017 in the UE's operating system to perform this task.

question_36263.question: What is the value of the "m" line for an RTSP stream in the SIP 200 OK response sent by the PSS Adapter?
question_36263.ground_truth: The value of the "m" line for an RTSP stream in the SIP 200 OK response sent by the PSS Adapter is "m=<media> <port> <transport> <fmt>".

question_36264.question: What does the indication for a rejected CUG call be given to the MS (mobile station) by the network?
question_36264.ground_truth: The indication for a rejected CUG call is given to the MS in the form of "Diagnostics information in cause value #29 'Facility Rejected'" or a "standard call control cause value" in the first clearing message.

question_36265.question: What is the purpose of the Multimedia Session Transfer Information (MST Info)?
question_36265.ground_truth: The MST Info represents the information carried in various SIP/SDP and CS call control messages that provides the necessary details for conducting a session continuity operation, such as a PS-PS session transfer, a transfer of media components between different UEs, etc.

question_36266.question: What is the purpose of the RTCP Disable Test?
question_36266.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to ensure that setting RTCP bandwidth to zero in SDP disables RTCP transmission from the SUT.

question_36267.question: What is the process for establishing a call from a user within an IP-PBX in the outlined architecture?
question_36267.ground_truth: The PBX sends an INVITE towards IMS via the IBCF, which may apply general screening rules and forwards the INVITE to the I-CSCF. The I-CSCF performs the normal (originating request) user location request towards HSS to find the served user and an S-CSCF, and then forwards the request to the S-CSCF. The S-CSCF performs normal originating service invocation for the incoming request and forwards the request to the AS hosting the PBX identity assertion. The AS identifies the PBX, inserts a P-Asserted-Identity, and performs any enterprise specific actions for the user if required. The INVITE is then forwarded to S-CSCF for further onward routing towards the remote side.

question_36269.question: What happens when a PINE sends a PIN Relay Request to the PEMC?
question_36269.ground_truth: The PEMC sends a Relay Activate/Deactivate Request to the PINMF, which authorizes the request and updates the 5G-LAN accordingly. The PINMF may also trigger the authentication and authorization procedure for security purposes.

question_36271.question: What information is included in a notification sent by a PIN Server to a PIN Client in a UE?
question_36271.ground_truth: A notification sent by a PIN Server to a PIN Client in a UE includes discovered PIN ID, details of PINAPP capabilities and corresponding PE IDs, such as Device ID, IP address and Port number.

question_36272.question: What is the difference between the MCX EUTRA test model and the MCX IPCAN test model in the document?
question_36272.ground_truth: The MCX EUTRA test model uses a TTCN implementation for E-UTRA/EPC conformance testing, while the MCX IPCAN test model uses an external E-UTRA/EPC implementation integrated with the SS. The MCX IPCAN test model supports signalling for the MCX PDN only and it is up to the SS implementation to handle potential registrations to other networks.

question_36274.question: What are the general observations on the uplink/downlink interference problem involving aerial UEs?
question_36274.ground_truth: The general observations include the high probability of aerial UEs experiencing cell-edge radio conditions due to their high line-of-sight propagation probability, receiving interference from a larger number of cells than terrestrial UEs. The eNB antennas may not serve the aerial UEs optimally, and the measurement reports may not contain full information due to limit on the number of reported cells.

question_36275.question: When is an ad-hoc group removed by the MC service server?
question_36275.ground_truth: If there is no ongoing communication in the ad-hoc group or once the ongoing communication in the ad-hoc group is terminated, the MC service server removes the ad-hoc group.

question_36276.question: What default response is indicated by the MS when it receives a REGISTER message with notifyAndVerify-LocationAllowedIfNoResponse?
question_36276.ground_truth: The default response is location allowed if no response is received within a predetermined period.

question_36278.question: What is the BCCH ARFCN (Absolutecellular Radiofrequency Channel Number) for the GSM 450, 480, 900, and 1800 systems in the test?

question_36279.question: When should a UE release the PC5 Relay RLC channel for U2U relay operations?
question_36279.ground_truth: For unicast L2 U2U relay operation, a UE should release the RLC entity and corresponding logical channel associated with an SL-RLC-ChannelID if there is no end-to-end sidelink DRB(s) associated with this RLC channel, or if the PC5 Relay RLC channel release was triggered by upper layers or due to sidelink RLF.

question_36280.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe Function starting timer T4014 assigned for each ProSe Query Code and Discovery Response Filter(s) under this discovery entry of the discoverer UE context?
question_36280.ground_truth: The ProSe Function starts timer T4014 to ensure that the discoverer UE sends a new discoverer request for renewing the query-related information no earlier than the discoveree UE renewing its own ProSe Response Code with the ProSe Function.

question_36281.question: What are the consequences when UEs approach HNBs while in deteriorating source cell conditions?
question_36281.ground_truth: The consequences include call drop, downlink interference, and uplink interference in cases where disambiguation is not possible for UEs not capable of SI acquisition.

question_36282.question: When should the UE initiate the measurement reporting procedure after expiry of the periodical reporting timer for a specific measId?
question_36282.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the measurement reporting procedure immediately after the expiry of the periodical reporting timer for a specific measId.

question_36283.question: How can partial failure and restart be handled on a PCRF application level in a single PCRF deployment?
question_36283.ground_truth: In a single PCRF deployment, the PCRF maintains a restart counter in a non-volatile memory, increments the counter immediately after every restart, and sends the new counter value to relevant clients within an existing PCRF application message. This helps clients handle previou total failure and the related restart explicitly.

question_36284.question: What is the purpose of the test described in clause 16.5.1.14.4?
question_36284.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the UE properly detects the out-of-sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink CSI-RS based radio link quality of the PCell when DRX is used for 2 Rx RedCap UE.

question_36285.question: What is the purpose of GLONASS RTK Bias Information in the MAC Network RTK method?
question_36285.ground_truth: GLONASS RTK Bias Information defines the code-phase biases related to the Master Reference Station.

question_36288.question: What function in a virtualized environment is typically only accessible by a handful of specifically authorized individuals in a legacy PNF network?

question_36289.question: What should the receiver do if the Facility IE is checked for protocol errors as specified in subclause 2.2.8 and a protocol error is found?

question_36290.question: Which TS (Technical Specification) specify the method of test for the measurement of UTRA TDD primary CCPCH power and differential accuracy of the Primary CCPCH power?

question_36291.question: What can be applied to limit UL interference and improve the average UL throughput for UEs served by LPNs?
question_36291.ground_truth: Bearer specific rate control, such as E-TFCI restriction

question_36292.question: What is the role of the Physical Layer Common Control Channel (PLCCH) in 3GPP LTE?
question_36292.ground_truth: The Physical Layer Common Control Channel (PLCCH) is a Node B terminated channel which may be used to carry dedicated (UE-specific) TPC and SS information to multiple UEs. It carries TPC and SS information only, no higher layer data is mapped to PLCCH.

question_36293.question: What conditions should be met to initiate timer TFS1 (SDS retransmission) when sending a SDS OFF-NETWORK MESSAGE message with a disposition request type of READ?
question_36293.ground_truth: The UE should be registered and authorized for MCData Service, including authorized for MCData Service in off-network environment, and the UE should be in an off-network environment.

question_36296.question: What is the primary concern for security requirements in handover?
question_36296.ground_truth: The primary concern for security requirements in handover is that it shall not compromise the security of the network providing the new radio resources, the possibly different network providing the original radio resources, and the UE.

question_36298.question: What should be the antenna setup for BS transmitters in Bands 1 and 46 to avoid BS receiver desensitizations in certain frequency bands?
question_36298.ground_truth: The antenna path of BS transmitters in Bands 1 and 46 should meet very stringent 3rd order PIM specifications if the same antenna is used, to prevent BS receiver desensitizations in Bands 5, 6, 8, 11, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 24, 26, 27, 42, and 43.

question_36301.question: What is the purpose of Activity Log Security Service in IRP scenario?
question_36301.ground_truth: Activity Log Security Service is used to log request-related information transferred between communication entities in a secured IRP scenario.

question_36303.question: What is the purpose of the Service Announcement Function (SAF) in the MBMS system?
question_36303.ground_truth: The SAF creates the needed metadata fragments for the MBMS User Service and supports Service Continuity by adding base pattern elements to the USBD, which the UE matches against a portion of the request URL.

question_36304.question: What is the purpose of the "required" keyword in JSON schema?
question_36304.ground_truth: The "required" keyword specifies a requirement for the MnS producer, indicating which properties are required in a JSON document.

question_36305.question: What is the ASN.1 definition used for in the XwAP protocol?
question_36305.ground_truth: The ASN.1 definition specifies the structure and content of XwAP messages. It takes precedence over the tabular format in case of contradiction.

question_36307.question: What message does MCPTT client 2 send to get its queue status in the MCPTT group call flow?
question_36307.ground_truth: MCPTT client 2 sends the queue position request message targeted to MCPTT client 1 (the floor arbitrator) by broadcasting the message to the MCPTT group.

question_36308.question: What is the purpose of the dynamic STI-rSR provided to the UE from the ATCF in CS to PS SRVCC?
question_36308.ground_truth: The dynamic STI-rSR provided to the UE from the ATCF in CS to PS SRVCC is used to enable PS-CS service continuity of IMS multimedia-sessions.

question_36310.question: Which element has a complex type named "groupIdType"?
question_36310.ground_truth: The "groupId" element has a complex type named "groupIdType".

question_36311.question: Which network architectural components are specified in 3GPP TS 24.301, and what are their significance in networking?
question_36311.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 24.301 specifies the "IMS Voice over PS Session (IMSVoPS)" indicator and the "Persistent EPS bearer context". These network architectural components are significant as they enable the IMS-based multimedia session to be established, maintained, and released securely and efficiently.

question_36312.question: How are the connected ambulance's medical devices authorized to share incident data with hospital personnel?
question_36312.ground_truth: The connected ambulance's medical devices are provisioned with parameters allowing establishment of a secure communication link to an authorized application in the hospital or ERC. These parameters enable the devices to share incident data with authorized personnel over the 5G network.

question_36314.question: What interfaces are impacted by Solution #9?
question_36314.ground_truth: Solution #9 impacts the N26 interface and applies to UE interworking between 5G and 4G, including 5G to 4G mobility and 4G to 5G mobility with or without N26.

question_36316.question: What action is taken if reportType is set to reportSFTD and the quantity to be reported becomes available for each requested pair of PCell and NR cell?
question_36316.ground_truth: If reportType is set to reportSFTD and the quantity to be reported becomes available for each requested pair of PCell and NR cell, timer T322 is stopped and the measurement reporting procedure is initiated as specified in section 5.5.5.

question_36317.question: What is the purpose of the test in clause 6.1.11?
question_36317.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in clause 6.1.11 is to verify that the UE is able to send a RRC Connection Re-establishment Request message to the System Simulator within the specified re-establishment delay limits from the moment it detects a loss in RRC connection.

question_36319.question: What information should the IPLMN/VPLMN provide to the CSE when a called party alert event occurs?
question_36319.ground_truth: The IPLMN/VPLMN should provide the event met, the party in the call for which the event is reported, and the type of monitoring to the CSE.

question_36320.question: What should the CRNC do if new traffic is requesting to use the logical resources while they are being blocked and made idle?
question_36320.ground_truth: New traffic shall not be allowed to use the logical resources while the CRNC waits for the resources to become idle and once the resources are blocked.

question_36322.question: What is a Solution Set (SS) in the context of 3GPP TM?
question_36322.ground_truth: A Solution Set (SS) in 3GPP TM is a set of requirements, information service, and solution set definitions for each Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the Telecommunication Management (TM) of 3G systems.

question_36323.question: What does the Technical Report study in terms of network slicing enhancements?
question_36323.ground_truth: The Technical Report studies gaps and performs evaluations of potential architecture enhancements to support network slicing, with the objectives of ensuring service continuity, registration for rejected S-NSSAI, roaming support, network controlled behaviour of network slice usage, support for limited-lifetime services, and enhancement of NSAC when multiple NSACFs are involved.

question_36324.question: What is the definition of the AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message in clause 8.2.1 of the document?
question_36324.ground_truth: The AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message is sent by the AMF to the UE to initiate authentication of the UE identity.

question_36325.question: What is the mandatory requirement to do something indicated by the term "shall" in the context of normative provisions?
question_36325.ground_truth: The term "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something in the context of normative provisions.

question_36327.question: What should the UE do when the entry condition for a specific event is fulfilled for one or more applicable cells during the timeToTrigger defined for that event?
question_36327.ground_truth: The UE should include a measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportList for that measId, set the numberOfReportsSent to 0, include the concerned cell(s) in the cellsTriggeredList defined within the VarMeasReportList for that measId, and initiate the measurement reporting procedure as specified in 5.5.5.

question_36329.question: What is the purpose of lifecycle management in CAPIF?
question_36329.ground_truth: The lifecycle management in CAPIF is for monitoring the running status of service APIs and related operations. It includes monitoring the lifecycle of service APIs, performance status, fault information, and change events of service APIs.

question_36330.question: What standard defines the interface for service super and sub types?
question_36330.ground_truth: The interface for service super and sub types is defined in 3GPP TS 29.198-2.

question_36336.question: What two security features related to entity authentication are provided for 3G networks?
question_36336.ground_truth: For 3G networks, the two security features related to entity authentication are user authentication and network authentication.

question_36337.question: Which component is responsible for checking the requested codec is permitted for the MCPTT group in the procedure for changing the speech codec within an MCPTT group in an LMR system?
question_36337.ground_truth: The MCPTT server is responsible for checking the requested codec is permitted for the MCPTT group in the procedure for changing the speech codec within an MCPTT group in an LMR system.

question_36338.question: Under what circumstances will the network transmit both segments of a segmented control message on the same FACCH?
question_36338.ground_truth: The network will transmit both segments of a segmented control message on the same FACCH as long as the same RTI value is not used at the same time for two separate RLC/MAC control messages.

question_36339.question: What is the difference between a Hosting RAN Provider and a Participating Operator in 3GPP network sharing?
question_36339.ground_truth: A Hosting RAN Provider is the party that shares a hosting RAN, while a Participating Operator is the party that uses the shared RAN facilities provided by a Hosting RAN Provider.

question_36340.question: In the context of SHVC Systems, what is the importance of the VPS extension structure and its contents?
question_36340.ground_truth: The VPS extension structure includes essential information on various aspects such as scalability type, layer set, cross-layer video usability information (VUI), and more, which are relevant for the decoding and display of video content in a scalable manner.

question_36341.question: Under what conditions will the UE-initiated NAS transport procedure be aborted when there is a transmission failure of the UL NAS TRANSPORT message with change in the current TAI?
question_36341.ground_truth: The UE-initiated NAS transport procedure shall be aborted and a registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update shall be initiated if the current TAI is not in the TAI list and the UL NAS TRANSPORT message has to be sent due to change in the current TAI.

question_36342.question: When does the PCF for the PDU session provision the received policy control requested trigger(s)?
question_36342.ground_truth: The PCF for the PDU session provisions the received policy control requested trigger(s) when an update on the current Policy Control Triggers needs to be sent to the SMF+PGW-C and when 5GS to EPS mobility applies.

question_36343.question: What are the two connections used for SEPPs and when is TLS mandatory and when is PRINS mandatory for protection of N32-f connections between the SEPPs?
question_36343.ground_truth: SEPPs use N32-c connections for management of the N32 interface and N32-f connections for sending of JWE and JWS protected messages between the SEPPs. TLS is mandatory for N32-c connections between SEPPs while PRINS is mandatory for protection of N32-f connections between the SEPPs when there are IPX providers which offer IP routing service between SEPPs.

question_36345.question: Which protocol is used to protect the S1-AP/X2-AP interface between the RN and DeNB for the IPsec based flavor?
question_36345.ground_truth: IPsec is used to protect the S1-AP/X2-AP interface between the RN and DeNB for the IPsec based flavor.

question_36347.question: What changes does FLO bring to the radio bearers in terms of flexibility and performance?
question_36347.ground_truth: The radio bearers offered by FLO, with enhancements such as reduced granularity and flexible interleaving, would not only fulfill the IMS requirements in terms of flexibility and performance but also significantly improve the link level performance of real-time IMS services compared to GERAN Release 5.

question_36348.question: What is the maximum Late call entry time (KPI 4a) allowed for 95% of all Late call entry requests?
question_36348.ground_truth: The maximum Late call entry time (KPI 4a) allowed for 95% of all Late call entry requests is less than 150 ms.

question_36349.question: What is one of the responsibilities of the MTC-IWF in the context of group messaging using MBMS option 1?
question_36349.ground_truth: The MTC-IWF is responsible for receiving a group messaging request from the SCS, authorizing the request, interrogating the HSS to determine if the SCS is allowed to send the request to the specific group, and translating and forwarding the group messaging request to the BM-SC/MBMS-GW.

question_36351.question: What is the maximum amount of the magnitude of the timing change that can be made in one adjustment for the uplink transmission?
question_36351.ground_truth: The maximum amount of the magnitude of the timing change in one adjustment for the uplink transmission is Tq seconds.

question_36352.question: When should the P-CSCF remove the Security-Verify and Security-Client header fields?
question_36352.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should remove the Security-Verify and Security-Client header fields if the security association is a temporary one and the contents of the Security-Verify and Security-Server header fields match.

question_36353.question: Who is responsible for controlling the number of QNC messages to be generated by the NG-RAN?
question_36353.ground_truth: The NG-RAN has its own logical to control the number of the QNC messages to 5GC, this is not determined by the AF provided AW.

question_36355.question: What is the purpose of the "Disaster return wait range" information element in the 3GPP specification?
question_36355.ground_truth: The "Disaster return wait range" information element is used to assign a new disaster return wait range to the UE.

question_36356.question: What information does the SCEF send in the Group Message Delivery (TLTRI, TMGI, Delivery Trigger Status) message to the SCS/AS?
question_36356.ground_truth: The SCEF sends the TLTRI, TMGI, and Delivery Trigger Status to indicate whether delivery of the Group Message Payload was successful or not.

question_36357.question: What is an example of a user-initiated application download that can trigger an OTA download mechanism to add an APN into the UICC list?
question_36357.ground_truth: A user-initiated application download #1, where the ME application designer develops the application in a way to inform the user with an alert in case the needed APN on the UICC is missing.

question_36358.question: What is the Adjacent Channel Leakage power Ratio (ACLR) definition that was agreed upon by WG4?
question_36358.ground_truth: ACLR is the ratio of the transmitted power to the power measured after a receiver filter in the adjacent RF channel, both measured within a filter response that is nominally rectangular, with a noise power bandwidth equal to the chip rate.

question_36359.question: What parameter does the MCPTT server check for authorization when receiving an MCPTT private call request, in addition to the encryption algorithm and mode?
question_36359.ground_truth: The MCPTT server checks if the MCPTT user at the MCPTT client is authorized to receive the private call and if the provided functional alias can be used and has been activated for the LMR user homed in the IWF.

question_36360.question: What should the network do when multiple PLMN IDs are broadcasted in a cell selected by NG-RAN?
question_36360.ground_truth: The NG-RAN shall select a target PLMN, taking into account the prioritized list of PLMN IDs provided via Mobility Restriction List from AMF.

question_36361.question: What is the impact on UE when NG-RAN triggers EPS or inter-RAT fallback in 5GS?
question_36361.ground_truth: When NG-RAN triggers EPS or inter-RAT fallback in 5GS, the UE will continue the IMS voice session on E-UTRA or initiate a handover to EPC or 5GC for the IMS voice session based on the selected RAT in 5GS and the support of EPS/inter-RAT fallback in NG-RAN.

question_36362.question: What does the MRDCOptimization-r16 sequence contain in the UE-CapabilityRequestFilterCommon?
question_36362.ground_truth: The MRDCOptimization-r16 sequence contains different codebook types and their respective options. It is used to optimize Multi-RAT operation with XDD and is included in the capability container request list.

question_36363.question: What is the role of an Application Server (AS) in a PIN network?
question_36363.ground_truth: An AS in a PIN network can process sensitive data locally and perform latency sensitive processing for games and office applications.

question_36367.question: What is the purpose of using a fixed length for the RLP frame in UTRAN Iu mode?
question_36367.ground_truth: The fixed length allows for alignment with the underlying radio transmission, eliminating the need for frame delimiters or bit-stuffing.

question_36368.question: What is the purpose of testing the transmission power accuracy of a Base Station?
question_36368.ground_truth: The purpose is to verify the accuracy of the maximum carrier output power across the frequency range and under normal and extreme conditions for all transmitters in the Base Station.

question_36369.question: What should an SNRM-S do after receiving an HTTP POST request message containing specific content-type and MIME body from a VAL server?
question_36369.ground_truth: The SNRM-S should determine to activate MBMS bearer and then send an MBMS bearer announcement message to the SNRM-C.

question_36370.question: What does the eNB do based on the (list of) counter-ids provided with the downlink packet by the PGW and possibly by the SGW for each access type?
question_36370.ground_truth: The eNB increments those data volume counter(s) for the access type over which the data has been sent.

question_36371.question: What is the TDU2 timer in the MCData client?
question_36371.ground_truth: The TDU2 timer is a timer in the MCData client used in conjunction with a FD non-mandatory download. The timer is started when the FD request is received and if the user does not request to download the file within the timer period, the FD request can only be accepted or rejected with an appropriate action by the MCData client.

question_36373.question: What is the transfer method for small data in NAS PDUs and NAS messages for SA2's control plane solutions?
question_36373.ground_truth: Small data is encapsulated in NAS PDUs and transferred in NAS messages for SA2's control plane solutions.

question_36375.question: What does "Release 17" in the title indicate?
question_36375.ground_truth: "Release 17" refers to the version of the technical specification.

question_36376.question: What is maintained during handover of a PDN connection between GTP based connectivity 3GPP access and S2a/S2b GTP based connectivity non-3GPP access for the P-GW?
question_36376.ground_truth: The "EPS default bearer charging identifier" for the default bearer, and the "Charging Id" for the handed-over dedicated bearers

question_36382.question: What is one limitation of Solution 30 and how does it propose to address it?
question_36382.ground_truth: Solution 30 does not explain how to handle the case where a UE attempts to maintain PDU Sessions in slices that are not all accessible in the same operating band. It proposes to optionally use NR/NR Dual Connectivity in such scenarios.

question_36383.question: What is the range of UE efficiency for on-demand MG with concentrated PRS?
question_36383.ground_truth: The range of UE efficiency for on-demand MG with concentrated PRS is 0%-40%.

question_36384.question: What action should the network take upon receiving an AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message from the UE with 5GMM cause #20 "MAC failure"?
question_36384.ground_truth: The network may initiate the identification procedure to obtain the SUCI from the UE and check if the 5G-GUTI used in the 5G authentication challenge corresponded to the correct SUPI. If the mapping of 5G-GUTI to SUPI in the network is incorrect, the network should respond with a new AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message.

question_36385.question: What kind of information can the PCEF enhanced with ADC or TDF provide?
question_36385.ground_truth: The PCEF enhanced with ADC or TDF can provide information such as detected application identifier, allocated application instance identifier, and detected service data flow descriptions.

question_36386.question: What is the condition that the UE should satisfy to report ACK/NACK from the first DL reception scheduled on Cell 2 after T5?
question_36386.ground_truth: The UE should report ACK/NACK from the first DL reception scheduled on Cell 2 after T5, and not send periodical CSI report on Cell 1 during the entire time period T5.

question_36387.question: What must the MCPTT client do when the MCPTT user has not requested an MCPTT emergency alert to be sent and the MCPTT emergency alert state is set to "MEA 1: no-alert"?
question_36387.ground_truth: The MCPTT client must set the <alert-ind> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body to "false".
