question_36389.question: What is the importance of the NRM defined by the E-UTRAN NRM IRP in providing support for telecommunication network management purposes and converged networks?
question_36389.ground_truth: The NRM defined by the E-UTRAN NRM IRP plays a critical role in providing support for telecommunication network management purposes, including the management of converged networks. It aids in ensuring efficient and effective management of network resources and ensuring seamless integration of multiple access technologies.

question_36390.question: What is the output of the corresponding Analytics API?
question_36390.ground_truth: The output is stats or predictions on the EDN load conditions, EES or EAS load stats/predictions, and a recommendation for EAS relocation trigger (due to expected high load or edge resources).

question_36391.question: What is the Tinterrupt equation used in the handover delay Dhandover test requirement?
question_36391.ground_truth: The Tinterrupt equation used in the handover delay Dhandover test requirement is Tsearch + TIU + 20 ms, where Tsearch and TIU are the time required to search the target cell and interruption uncertainty in acquiring the first available PRACH occasion in the new cell, respectively.

question_36392.question: What triggers a change in FRMCS User's communication privileges based on their authentication and authorization status?
question_36392.ground_truth: A change in FRMCS User authentication and authorization status.

question_36393.question: Which RF transmitter architectures are analyzed in LTE-Advanced for component carrier aggregation?
question_36393.ground_truth: Four RF transmitter architectures are analyzed in LTE-Advanced for component carrier aggregation: combining component carriers at digital baseband, in analog baseband waveforms before RF mixer, after mixer but before the power amplifier, and after the power amplifier but before the antenna.

question_36395.question: What is the objective of the use case on transition from IOPS mode to on-network mode?
question_36395.ground_truth: The objective is to describe a scenario where the network reselection is requested to be connected to on-land network when a vessel is approaching back to a maritime region that is in 3GPP network coverage.

question_36396.question: What should the participating MCVideo function include in the SIP INVITE request, if the conditions in step 12) were executed, and the participating MCVideo function determined that the "uri" attribute of only one of the <entry> elements of the application/resource-lists MIME body matched with an <entry> element of the <PrivateCall> element of the MCVideo user profile document?
question_36396.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function should set the <session-type> in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body of the SIP INVITE request generated in subclause~6.3.2.1.3 to "private", if the conditions in step 12) were executed, and the participating MCVideo function determined that the "uri" attribute of only one of the <entry> elements of the application/resource-lists MIME body matched with an <entry> element of the <PrivateCall> element of the MCVideo user profile document.

question_36397.question: What should the network maintain if the authentication procedure was unsuccessful?
question_36397.ground_truth: The network should maintain the EMM-context and EPS security context unchanged upon receiving an AUTHENTICATION REJECT message during an unsuccessful authentication procedure.

question_36398.question: What information must the V2X Control Function include in the V2X-Notify request when revoking authorization for V2X service?
question_36398.ground_truth: The V2X Control Function must include the V2X Permission, PLMN ID, and the IMSI in the request when revoking authorization for V2X service.

question_36399.question: What is the limit that the MAC entity at the SN applies to the scheduled uplink radio traffic at the SN for the UE in all MR-DC cases?
question_36399.ground_truth: The MAC entity at the SN applies the received UL UE AMBR limit to the scheduled uplink radio traffic at the SN for the UE.

question_36400.question: What action must the AMF take when authorization is revoked for an S-NSSAI that is in the current allowed NSSAI for an access type?
question_36400.ground_truth: The AMF must provide a new allowed NSSAI to the UE, excluding the S-NSSAI for which authorization is revoked; and provide a new rejected NSSAI for the failed or revoked NSSAA, including the S-NSSAI in the rejected NSSAI for which the authorization is revoked, with the rejection cause "S-NSSAI not available due to the failed or revoked network slice-specific authentication and authorization".

question_36401.question: What was the application layer FEC packet ratio used in the UEP performance test in the MBSFN channel of 9Mbps throughput in 7 sectors layout?
question_36401.ground_truth: Only the ratio of application layer FEC packets was manipulated to test the UEP performance in the MBSFN channel of 9Mbps throughput in 7 sectors layout.

question_36403.question: What is the main benefit of RAN delay budget reporting for UEs in poor coverage?
question_36403.ground_truth: The main benefit is that it allows UEs to locally adjust air interface delay, improve reliability of uplink transmissions, reduce packet loss, and enhance end-to-end delay and quality performance.

question_36404.question: What is the purpose of the "Associate new ProSe application(s) with existing PC5 QoS flow(s)" link modification operation code in clause 7.7.2.2a?
question_36404.ground_truth: This link modification operation code is used to associate new ProSe applications with existing PC5 QoS flows, allowing for the modification of QoS parameters or the addition of new QoS flows to the existing 5G ProSe direct link.

question_36405.question: What is the role of the UE at mobility during PDU session re-anchoring?
question_36405.ground_truth: The UE starts using the IP address/prefix associated with the new PSA for new traffic flows, or proactively for existing traffic flows where possible. It may also trigger a new DNS request for the Application FQDN and switch to the new AS based on the response.

question_36406.question: What performance is expected of the current BS antenna system, amplifiers, and filters to avoid receiver desensitization caused by IMD interference from Bands 2 and 30?
question_36406.ground_truth: It is expected that the IMD interference generated within the Band 24 receiver would be well below the receiver noise floor eliminating the possibility of receiver desensitization, provided that Bands 2 and 30 BS transmitters do not share the same antenna with Band 24 BS receiver.

question_36407.question: What is the purpose of the TMGI field and the Alternative TMGI fields in the Bearer Announcement message?
question_36407.ground_truth: The TMGI field is used to identify the Multimedia Broadcast Multicast Service (MBMS) service, and the Alternative TMGI fields are used to provide additional identities for the same service.

question_36408.question: What should the MAC entity do if a HARQ process receives downlink feedback information and acknowledgement is indicated?
question_36408.ground_truth: The MAC entity should stop the drx-RetransmissionTimerUL for the corresponding HARQ process.

question_36409.question: In the provided scenario, what method does SEALDD server 2 use to obtain the SEALDD context from SEALDD server 1?
question_36409.ground_truth: SEALDD server 2 uses the pull operation to obtain the SEALDD context from SEALDD server 1.

question_36412.question: What are the FR1 conducted RE power control dynamic range requirements for QPSK and 16QAM, assuming no change in unwanted emission limits and EVM requirements?
question_36412.ground_truth: For QPSK, the conducted RE power up requirement can be reused, and for 16QAM, the conducted RE power down range requirement can also be reused.

question_36413.question: How much isolation improvement is expected after mounting EM absorber materials next to the antenna array in the base station?

question_36414.question: What information is provided in N2 messages when a User Equipment (UE) is served by a cell of this MBSR?
question_36414.ground_truth: The 'Additional ULI' and User Location Information are provided in N2 messages when a UE is served by a cell of this MBSR.

question_36415.question: What is the time period used for the UE to identify a new UTRA TDD cell in the inter RAT equation?
question_36415.ground_truth: The time period used for the UE to identify a new UTRA TDD cell in the inter RAT equation is 800 ms.

question_36416.question: What should the MCPTT Service do if some affiliated members of a group can not be Participants in an unacknowledged MCPTT Group Call?
question_36416.ground_truth: The MCPTT Service should provide an indication to the requester that the call is proceeding without all affiliated members, and shall provide the list of the missing members based on policy established by the MCPTT Administrator.

question_36417.question: What is the limitation when EDA can only be combined with EDA for mobile allocations?
question_36417.ground_truth: If EDA can only be combined with EDA, then the possible combinations are more limited. For example, if mobile 1 transmits 3 or more slots, mobile 2 cannot transmit any slots, and if mobile 2 transmits any slot, mobile 1 cannot transmit more than 2 slots.

question_36419.question: What should the MS do if an unknown field is recognized within a known Access Technology Type?
question_36419.ground_truth: The MS should ignore the unknown field if it is recognized within a known Access Technology Type.

question_36420.question: What is the impact of supporting smaller bandwidth channels in certain regions?
question_36420.ground_truth: Smaller bandwidth channels (e.g. 1.6 GHz) would allow for more channels (e.g., three instead of two) in these regions, easing frequency planning between operators at the cost of reduction in available channel bandwidth per carrier.

question_36421.question: What should the MBMS GW do upon detecting a non-transient SGi-mb path failure?
question_36421.ground_truth: Upon detecting a non-transient SGi-mb path failure, the MBMS GW may tear down the affected MBMS sessions by sending MBMS Session Stop Request message(s) to the MME/SGSN(s) serving the MBMS sessions and Session Termination Request message(s) to the BM-SC with a terminating cause signalling a user plane failure.

question_36423.question: What is the SMF's role for secondary authentication/authorization by a DN-AAA server during the establishment of a PDN connection over 3GPP access to EPC?
question_36423.ground_truth: A SMF+PGW-C shall be used to serve DNN(s) requiring secondary authentication/authorization by a DN-AAA server, and the SMF+PGW-C runs the same procedures with PCF, UDM and DN-AAA regardless of whether the UE is served by EPS or 5GS.

question_36427.question: What is the maximum output power measured for any transmission bandwidth within the aggregated channel bandwidth in EN-DC of E-UTRA and NR in FR1?
question_36427.ground_truth: The maximum output power is measured as the sum of the maximum output power at each UE antenna connector.

question_36428.question: What is the role of envelope normalization in the PFSC process?
question_36428.ground_truth: The envelope normalization process is used to smooth the spectral characteristic of the low-frequency content by dividing it by the maximum amplitude value in each sub-band. This helps to improve the accuracy of the correlation calculation between the low-frequency and high-frequency bands.

question_36430.question: What is the stated method for early pass/fail decision in statistical testing in 21.13.5.2?
question_36430.ground_truth: The specific details of statistical testing of performance are defined in Annex~7.

question_36431.question: What happens to the UE Radio Capability for Paging Information if the UE performs an Attach procedure or a Tracking Area Update procedure for the "first TAU following GERAN/UTRAN/ Attach" or for "UE radio capability update"?
question_36431.ground_truth: The MME deletes all UE Radio Capability for Paging Information that it has stored for that UE.

question_36432.question: What is the primary difference between the User Data Silo and the User Data Convergence (UDC) in the 3GPP system?
question_36432.ground_truth: The User Data Silo is the traditional paradigm of user data deployment, where user data are stored and managed independently in different network entities. In contrast, the User Data Convergence (UDC) moves user data to a centralized repository, where they can be accessed and managed in a common way, regardless of the diversity of user data structures for different services.

question_36435.question: What is the task of the SS in 14.7.3.4.2?
question_36435.ground_truth: The SS transmits Standard Test Signal C1 on the traffic channel, commands the MS to create traffic channel loop back signalling erased frames, produces a static wanted signal and a static interfering signal at the same time, with the amplitude of the wanted signal set to 4 dB above the reference sensitivity level. The unwanted signal is a C.W. signal (Standard test signal IO) of frequency FB in a specific range.

question_36436.question: What should the en-gNB do when it receives the SGNB MODIFICATION REQUEST message containing the RLC Mode IE for an E-RAB in the E-RABs To Be Added Item IE?
question_36436.ground_truth: The en-gNB should consider the RLC Mode IE indicated in the E-RABs To Be Added Item IE in the SGNB MODIFICATION REQUEST message as the mode that the MeNB used for the E-RAB when it was hosted at the MeNB.

question_36437.question: What must the MS include in the Activate PDP Context Request message when initiating a PDP Context Request procedure for emergency services?
question_36437.ground_truth: The MS must include an emergency indication in the Activate PDP Context Request message.

question_36438.question: Under what conditions will an MME send a Modify Access Bearers Request message as part of a UE triggered Service Request procedure if there is no suspended bearer for that UE?
question_36438.ground_truth: The MME will send a Modify Access Bearers Request message if the RAT type has not changed, the Serving Network has not changed, the MME does not need to report a H(e)NB local IP address and UDP port number information change, the MME does not need to send UE's location and/or User CSG information or/and UE Time Zone and/or Presence Reporting Area information to the PDN GW, and the MME does not need to send an MME-FQ-CSID as per the requirements.

question_36439.question: What is the frequency range for the test antenna used in the co-location spurious emission test?
question_36439.ground_truth: The frequency range of the test antenna should be the same as that of the AAS BS for the co-location spurious emission test.

question_36440.question: What is the role of the PDN GW in providing user plane anchor for mobility between 3GPP access and non-3GPP access?
question_36440.ground_truth: The PDN GW includes functionality to act as a LMA or a DSMIPv6 Home Agent for mobility between 3GPP access and non-3GPP access. It also supports allocation of uplink GRE key for each PDN connection within the PDN GW.

question_36441.question: What does the "rSRVCC Information" IE contain in UTRAN?
question_36441.ground_truth: This IE contains information for rSRVCC operation.

question_36442.question: How does AL-FEC compare with MCS dimensioning for the 3 km/hr, 751 MHz use-case with various budgets?
question_36442.ground_truth: AL-FEC provides similar or better performance compared to MCS dimensioning for the 3 km/hr, 751 MHz use-case with different budgets, offering better protection and higher throughput.

question_36443.question: What public identities or identity ranges should a block list contain for Communication Diversions (CDIV)?
question_36443.ground_truth: The public identities or identity ranges of users from which incoming communications are not forwarded when CDIV is activated

question_36444.question: How is the probability of DASH QoE measurements being present in a reception report calculated when the reception reporting procedure is active and DASHQoESamplePercentage is present?
question_36444.ground_truth: The probability is given by the value of DASHQoEProcedure.DASHQoESamplePercentage.

question_36446.question: What is the purpose of steps 4a and 6b in this process?
question_36446.ground_truth: Steps 4a and 6b in this process inform the HS-GW to fetch the PDN GW identity and authorize the active PDN connections.

question_36448.question: How many Rx antenna ports is a Redcap UE required to have at a minimum and maximum?
question_36448.ground_truth: A Redcap UE is required to have a minimum of one Rx antenna port and a maximum of two Rx antenna ports.

question_36450.question: How does the DHCP-based IPv4 address allocation work for one-to-one ProSe Direct Communication between two UEs?
question_36450.ground_truth: One of the two UEs acts as a DHCP server, dynamically allocating IPv4 addresses to the Remote UEs for the duration of the direct communication session.

question_36451.question: What should be reset to "0" when there are one or more backward compatible changes not corresponding to changes to earlier 3GPP Releases in a given 3GPP Release?
question_36451.ground_truth: The 2nd field (MINOR) should be incremented and "0" should be reserved for each intermediate 3GPP Release for possible subsequent changes in that Release.

question_36452.question: What should the MCVideo client display to the user if it receives a SIP re-INVITE request with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the <mcvideoinfo> element containing the <mcvideo-Params> element with the <emergency-ind> element set to a value of "true"?
question_36452.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should display to the MCVideo user the MCVideo ID of the originator of the MCVideo emergency group call and an indication that this is an MCVideo emergency group call.

question_36454.question: What is the formula used to calculate the transmitter OFF power spectral density threshold for NR BS 1-O?
question_36454.ground_truth: The formula used to calculate the transmitter OFF power spectral density threshold for NR BS 1-O is 85dBm/MHz - 30dB + X dB, where X is a scaling factor equal to 9 dB. This gives a threshold of -106 dBm/MHz, which is the minimum requirement for NR BS type 1-O.

question_36456.question: Which media type is defined as continuous media in the document?
question_36456.ground_truth: Continuous media includes speech, audio, and video in the present document.

question_36457.question: What is the clock accuracy requirement for source switching in medical imaging systems?
question_36457.ground_truth: The clock accuracy requirement for source switching in medical imaging systems is less than 1 microsecond.

question_36459.question: How does the UE determine the transmission slots for CQI reports when transmitting CQI reports for the 4th secondary serving HS-DSCH cell as specified in section 4c?
question_36459.ground_truth: The UE should transmit the CQI report of the 4th secondary serving HS-DSCH cell (if present) so that it starts in the same slot as the transmissions of CQI report of the serving HS-DSCH starts.

question_36460.question: What is the function of the API Exposing Function (AEF) in the 3GPP network architecture?
question_36460.ground_truth: The API Exposing Function (AEF) is responsible for exposing APIs (Application Programming Interfaces) towards the Edge Applications. These APIs enable communication between the Edge Applications and the underlying network functions.

question_36461.question: What is the purpose of the "reduced TPC frequency with repetition of TPC commands" mechanism suggested in the document?
question_36461.ground_truth: The purpose is to allow soft combining at the UE in order to reduce DL TPC transmit power, by repeating the TPC command in N consecutive slots.

question_36462.question: What interfaces does the RMS use to interact with other components in the network management system?
question_36462.ground_truth: The RMS uses the 3GPP Type-2 interface to interact with other components in the network management system.

question_36463.question: What is the role of an NeNB-derived Isolated E-UTRAN in improving coverage?
question_36463.ground_truth: An NeNB-derived Isolated E-UTRAN supports local routing and ProSe Group Communication, enhancing communication and coverage in a local area during an incident.

question_36464.question: What action does the terminating AS take when the CC service duration timer CC-T7 expires?
question_36464.ground_truth: The terminating AS sends a NOTIFY request to the originating AS with a "noresource" reason.

question_36465.question: What is the responsibility of the AF in relation to PER requests?
question_36465.ground_truth: The AF requests PER for QoS and Alternative QoS.

question_36468.question: What requirement does the MCVideo client need to follow when generating an initial SIP INVITE request for the establishment of an MCVideo group session?
question_36468.ground_truth: The MCVideo client must follow the UE originating session procedures specified in TS 24.229, with the clarifications given in TS 24.281, clause 9.2.2.2.1.1.

question_36472.question: What is the specification that defines the charging principle, requirements, service operations, and charging information for URLLC service charging in 5G systems?

question_36473.question: What response does the S-CSCF send to the eP-CSCF and the WebRTC IMS Client when the registration is successful?
question_36473.ground_truth: The S-CSCF sends a 200 (OK) response to the eP-CSCF, and the eP-CSCF forwards this response to the WebRTC IMS Client.

question_36475.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 6.5.7C.2.4?
question_36475.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in 6.5.7C.2.4 is to verify DL interruption requirements during UE dynamic switching between two uplink bands with two transmit antenna connectors in TDD-TDD CA.

question_36476.question: What is the difference between a broadcast group call and a regular group call in MCPTT?
question_36476.ground_truth: In a broadcast group call, only the call originating MCPTT user is allowed to transmit media, unless overridden. A broadcast group call takes priority over regular group calls within the same hierarchy.

question_36477.question: What is the expected sequence for an MS which supports TCH/F?
question_36477.ground_truth: The expected sequence for an MS which supports TCH/F is the sequence of steps performed for an MS which supports TCH/F during an execution counter M = 1, 2, 3 for an MS which supports TCH/F. Steps after step 7 are not performed for execution counter M = 3.

question_36478.question: Who does the MCPTT server implicitly affiliate to the MCPTT emergency group if the LMR user is not already affiliated?
question_36478.ground_truth: The MCPTT ID of the LMR user

question_36480.question: What is the condition for the user equipment (UE) to further process a MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message, and if it was processed successfully, delete the old packet filters which have the identical packet filter identifiers?
question_36480.ground_truth: If two or more packet filters with identical packet filter identifiers are contained in the MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message, the UE shall not diagnose an error and further process the MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.

question_36481.question: What is the role of the I-SMF in generating an N4 Session ID and mapping it to the SMF's ID?
question_36481.ground_truth: The I-SMF generates an N4 Session ID and a Rule ID for each rule (unless the ones received from the SMF can be used) and maintains a mapping between the locally generated identifiers and the ones received from the SMF. The I-SMF replaces those IDs in the PDR(s), QER(s), URR(s), and FAR(s) received from the SMF.

question_36484.question: What is the difference between "shall" and "shall, if supported" in the 3GPP 3rd Generation Partnership Project documentation?
question_36484.ground_truth: If a procedure indicates that the receiving node "shall" perform a certain function under a certain condition, it means that the receiving node is required to execute the functionality. If the receiving node "shall, if supported" perform a certain function, it is required to execute the functionality only if it supports it.

question_36485.question: What message does UE1 send to the UE-to-UE Relay when it triggers the Link Identifier Update procedure and needs a new IP address?
question_36485.ground_truth: UE1 sends a Link Identifier Update Request message to the UE-to-UE Relay over the PC5 unicast link, which includes a "new IP address needed" indication and its peer UE info (i.e., UE2 IP address, UE2 User Info), in addition to the usual parameters sent on the Link Identifier Update request message, e.g., Layer-2 ID and security info.

question_36487.question: How is the Ranging and Sidelink positioning service exposed to a UE?
question_36487.ground_truth: A Ranging/Sidelink positioning capable UE may expose the Ranging and Sidelink positioning service to a UE in different ways, such as immediately, periodically, or at a later time. This service may also be initiated by one of the UEs providing the service.

question_36488.question: What information does the body of the SIP MESSAGE request contain when sending an SM delivery report over IP?
question_36488.ground_truth: The body of the SIP MESSAGE request shall contain the RP-ACK or RP-ERROR message for the SM delivery report, as defined in 3GPP TS 24.011.

question_36489.question: What is the principle used for control channels in CZ-UMTS?
question_36489.ground_truth: In CZ-UMTS, control channels follow the principle of zeroing out every alternate chips prior to RRC filter.

question_36491.question: What methods are supported by the "Downlink Message Deliveries" resource?
question_36491.ground_truth: The "Downlink Message Deliveries" resource supports the GET, POST, and DELETE methods.

question_36492.question: What is the role of a 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay?
question_36492.ground_truth: A 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay enables indirect communication between the 5G network and UEs that are out of coverage of the network.

question_36495.question: What is the use of Message Broadcast Web Service in a commercial context?
question_36495.ground_truth: Message Broadcast Web Service can be used for commercial applications, such as sending discount information to customers within a shopping mall, to increase sales.

question_36496.question: What are the factors considered for EASDF selection by NF consumers or SCP in the case of delegated discovery and selection in SCP?
question_36496.ground_truth: The factors considered for EASDF selection are S-NSSAI, DNN, the N6 IP address of the EASDF, the N6 IP address of the PSA UPF, location as per NF profile, and DNAI (if exist).

question_36499.question: Which SS-RSRQ measurement accuracy should the UE meet during T1 and T2 for the test to pass (R1 to R6)?
question_36499.ground_truth: The UE should meet the absolute accuracy requirements for R1, R2, R4, R5 and the relative accuracy requirements for R3, R6 for the test to pass.

question_36500.question: What is the purpose of the NB-IoT guard band Rx test?
question_36500.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to evaluate the performance of the NB-IoT device's receive functionality using the tone located on the NB-IoT PRB's edge, which is closest to the E-UTRA channel edge.

question_36501.question: How should a UE determine whether it is attached to the home PLMN or to a visited PLMN?
question_36501.ground_truth: A UE can determine whether it is attached to the home PLMN or to a visited PLMN by comparing the MCC values derived from its IMSI with the MCC of the PLMN the UE is attached to.

question_36503.question: Can a back-off timer be deactivated upon a PLMN change or inter-system change?
question_36503.ground_truth: No, the back-off timer cannot be stopped upon a PLMN change or inter-system change once it is activated for the PDP context activation procedure and specific PLMN and APN combination.

question_36504.question: What is the timing relation between the start of a subframe of a small bandwidth carrier and the nearest subframe of the legacy carrier in the time-dilated solution?
question_36504.ground_truth: The start of any subframe of the small bandwidth carrier with N=2 begins 4/3 ms after the start of the nearest subframe of the legacy carrier, and the start of any subframe of the small bandwidth carrier with N=4 is aligned with the start of one subframe of legacy carrier.

question_36506.question: What should be met for a specified reference measurement channel, in LTE Rel-8, in order to specify the in-channel selectivity?
question_36506.ground_truth: In LTE Rel-8, in order to specify the in-channel selectivity, a throughput requirement shall be met for a specified reference measurement channel, in the presence of an interfering signal received at a larger power spectral density.

question_36510.question: What message does the SMF create to initiate the network-requested PDU session release procedure?
question_36510.ground_truth: The SMF creates a PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message to initiate the network-requested PDU session release procedure.

question_36513.question: For which mode of operation UMTS MS is it possible to send and receive short messages in Iu mode?
question_36513.ground_truth: For any mode of operation UMTS MS is it possible to send and receive short messages in Iu mode.

question_36514.question: What are the main constraints and requirements provided in the EVS-4 Permanent Document?
question_36514.ground_truth: The constraints and requirements in the EVS-4 Permanent Document set the framework for the EVS codec, covering capability, resource usage, and performance requirements. These requirements include input-output sampling, coded bandwidths, maximum computational complexity, and other essential features and performance parameters.

question_36518.question: What is the implication of including the whole service request message as part of the service request verification?
question_36518.ground_truth: Including the whole service request message as part of the service request verification may double the message size, impacting the system throughput.

question_36519.question: What is the purpose of the first transparent container in the solution?
question_36519.ground_truth: The first transparent container is used to indicate the required trigger events to the target UE and is transferred without alteration through the 5GC to the UE.

question_36520.question: What is the main specification defining TV profiles in DVB?
question_36520.ground_truth: The main specification defining TV profiles in DVB is the ETSI TS 101 154 v2.1.1. This specification defines, among others, video profiles based on H.264/AVC and H.265/HEVC, which are used for SDTV, HDTV, and UHDTV.

question_36521.question: What should the MME include in the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message if connectivity with the requested PDN is accepted and the network considers this PDN connection a LIPA PDN connection?
question_36521.ground_truth: Subject to operator policy, the MME shall include in the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message the Connectivity type IE indicating "the PDN connection is considered a LIPA PDN connection".

question_36522.question: What is the significance of the ISIM application in the 3GPP specification?
question_36522.ground_truth: The ISIM application in the 3GPP specification indicates the collection of IMS security data and functions on a UICC. It may be a distinct application on the UICC. The distinction between ISIM and ISIM application is useful for describing the IMS security architecture, and common authentication keys and functions can be used for IMS and PS domain authentication.

question_36523.question: What is the maximum frequency offset with respect to half of the bandwidth of the measuring filter?
question_36523.ground_truth: The frequency offset is equal to half of the bandwidth of the measuring filter.

question_36524.question: What are the advantages of Tandem Free Operation (TFO) in telecommunications?
question_36524.ground_truth: The advantages of TFO include an improvement in speech quality by avoiding double transcoding, possible savings on inter-PLMN transmission links, reduced processing power requirements for network equipment, and a reduction in end-to-end transmission delay.

question_36528.question: What field of the From-id information element should be set to "Identifier" if the public identity is not the default public user identity?
question_36528.ground_truth: The Code specific field of the From-id information element should be set to "Identifier".

question_36529.question: When should the MAC entity determine the next available PRACH occasion from the PRACH occasions corresponding to the selected SSB in the association period given by ra-AssociationPeriodIndex in the si-RequestPeriod permitted by the restrictions given by the ra-ssb-OccasionMaskIndex?
question_36529.ground_truth: The MAC entity should determine the next available PRACH occasion from the PRACH occasions corresponding to the selected SSB in the association period given by ra-AssociationPeriodIndex in the si-RequestPeriod permitted by the restrictions given by the ra-ssb-OccasionMaskIndex, if an SSB is selected and the Random Access procedure was initiated for SI request.

question_36531.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 7.6.14.2?
question_36531.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that the UE makes correct reporting of an event with network-controlled activation/deactivation of Pre-MG in FR2. This test will partly verify the TDD intra-frequency cell search requirements in 38.133 clause~9.2.6.2 and 9.2.6.3.

question_36532.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 9.1.22?
question_36532.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in section 9.1.22 is to verify that FDD and TDD absolute and relative RSRP measurement accuracy in carrier aggregation is within the specified limits under AWGN propagation conditions.

question_36533.question: Which features of the Technical Report may require a functional description in the TS 25.300 of RAN2 specifications?
question_36533.ground_truth: The features of the Technical Report that may require a functional description in the TS 25.300 of RAN2 specifications include TPC repetition and decimation solutions, improved RRC synchronized procedures, state transition enhancements, improved HARQ retransmission, and extended RNTI.

question_36534.question: What is a procedure that can be used to register UE for ProSe services?
question_36534.ground_truth: ProSe identifiers (ProSe UE IDs and ProSe Application IDs) can be managed by a 3GPP defined entity, such as the ProSe Function or MME.

question_36535.question: What is the maximum delay allowed for non-delay tolerant services in a PIN?
question_36535.ground_truth: The maximum delay allowed for non-delay tolerant services in a PIN is 200ms.

question_36537.question: What is the purpose of the "separation bit" in the AMF field of AUTN in the EMSDP Session Start message?
question_36537.ground_truth: The "separation bit" in the AMF field of AUTN is used to indicate whether UMTS authentication vectors or EPS authentication vectors have been received in the Session Parameters of the EMSDP Session Start message.

question_36539.question: What is the role of PCRF in this solution for enforcing 3GPP PS Data Off policy in the Core Network?
question_36539.ground_truth: PCRF needs to indicate in the enhanced PCC rule whether it is for 3GPP PS Data Off Exempt Service, so that PGW and GGSN can enforce the rule with an indication of 3GPP PS Data Off Exempt Service during IP-CAN Session Establishment, modification, and when receiving the UE's latest 3GPP PS Data Off status.

question_36541.question: What action does the 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay take when storing associations between User Info ID and IP addresses of target 5G ProSe Layer-3 End UEs in its DNS entries?
question_36541.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay acts as a DNS server to other UEs.

question_36542.question: What should the user equipment (UE) do to request radio resources for V2X communication over PC5 when served by E-UTRAN?
question_36542.ground_truth: The UE should follow the procedure outlined in 3GPP TS 24.334 subclause 10.2.2.

question_36545.question: What is the function of the NG-RAN Transport Network Layer (TNL)?
question_36545.ground_truth: The NG-RAN TNL provides services for user plane transport, signalling transport, and security protection for control plane and user plane data on TNL of NG-RAN interfaces. It also specifies the related TNL protocol for each NG-RAN interface.

question_36548.question: What is the effect of including Closed User Group (CUG) information in a CCNL communication?
question_36548.ground_truth: CUG information is not included in the check for a compatible terminal. Therefore, a terminal may react positively to the check for a compatible terminal due to the absence of CUG information, but the terminal may not inform the user of the arrival of the CCNL call.

question_36549.question: What is the purpose of the error concealment procedure defined in the document?
question_36549.ground_truth: The purpose of the error concealment procedure is to conceal the effect of lost AMR speech frames and to mute the output in the case of several lost frames to indicate the breakdown of the channel to the user and avoid generating possible annoying sounds as a result from the error concealment procedure.

question_36550.question: What should a UE do if it is operating in single-registration mode and the service request procedure is rejected with the 5GMM cause with the same value?
question_36550.ground_truth: If a UE is operating in single-registration mode and the service request procedure is rejected with the 5GMM cause with the same value, it shall handle the 5GMM parameters as specified in 3GPP TS 24.501.

question_36553.question: What is the difference between intra-frequency and inter-frequency RSRP accuracy requirements?
question_36553.ground_truth: Intra-frequency RSRP accuracy requirements apply to cells on the same carrier frequency as the serving cell, while inter-frequency RSRP accuracy requirements apply to cells with different carrier frequencies from the serving cell.

question_36555.question: What does the TSCTSF do when it receives the UE location change notification for AoI?
question_36555.ground_truth: The TSCTSF updates to activate or deactivate the time synchronization service for the given UE. If the UE moves out of the Requested Coverage Area, the TSCTSF temporarily removes the UE/DS-TT from the PTP instance and indicates the PTP port state as Inactive for the related DS-TT PTP port.

question_36556.question: What actions does the MAC entity perform during multicast DRX when the "drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerDL-PTM" expires?
question_36556.ground_truth: If the data of the corresponding HARQ process was not successfully decoded, the MAC entity starts the "drx-RetransmissionTimerDL-PTM" for the corresponding HARQ process in the first symbol after the expiry of "drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerDL-PTM".

question_36558.question: What is the outcome if there is a recovery after a timer expiry?
question_36558.ground_truth: The CALL A-B WAITING or CALL A-B HELD/CALL C-B WAITING should be performed based on the specific scenario.

question_36560.question: What is the responsibility of the S-CSCF after receiving the registration request with an expiration time of zero seconds?
question_36560.ground_truth: The S-CSCF sends de-register information to the service control platform, performs appropriate service control procedures, and sends WUDB-Put (Public User Identity, clear S-CSCF name) to the WUDB to remove the association between the user and S-CSCF in the database.

question_36562.question: What should an MS that does not support the Call Hold supplementary service do when the appropriate command is entered while in the U10 call active state?
question_36562.ground_truth: The MS should fail to put the first call on hold, fail to place the second call, and optionally provide an indication to the user of an error.

question_36563.question: What is the scope of 3GPP TS 37.571-2, User Equipment (UE) conformance specification for UE positioning; Part 2: Protocol conformance?
question_36563.ground_truth: The scope of 3GPP TS 37.571-2 is to specify the protocol conformance testing for UTRAN, E-UTRAN and NR User Equipment (UE) supporting UE positioning.

question_36565.question: What is the method used to conduct the subjective tests to verify the codec behavior on 3D-signals in the Audio Codec verification phase?
question_36565.ground_truth: The test method used is the ITU-R BS.1534-1 method, which includes hidden reference and bandwidth-limited anchor signals. Additionally, for this test, anchor points with reduced spatial image were introduced.

question_36566.question: What is the total measurement reporting delay for Event A6 in T2?
question_36566.ground_truth: The total measurement reporting delay for Event A6 in T2 is less than 12802 ms.

question_36568.question: What is the BD-rate gain provided by SHVC compared to HEVC simulcast for aligned IRAP pictures case?
question_36568.ground_truth: The BD-rate gain is up to 40.5%, with an overall average gain of 31.9% for QP delta 2 for aligned IRAP pictures case.

question_36569.question: What is the action taken when there is a request for information provision?

question_36570.question: What action does the 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay perform when the Ethernet type PDU Session is used for Ethernet traffic over PC5 reference point?
question_36570.ground_truth: When the Ethernet type PDU Session is used for Ethernet traffic over PC5 reference point, the 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay acts as an Ethernet switch.

question_36571.question: What is the purpose of including the "3gpp-Sbi-Discovery-target-nf-instance-id" in an HTTP request?
question_36571.ground_truth: The inclusion of the "3gpp-Sbi-Discovery-target-nf-instance-id" in an HTTP request enables the SCP to discover the profile of the target NF instance and possibly reselect a different target NF service instance from the same NF instance or from a different NF instance in the same set.

question_36574.question: What is the suggested value for the Priority header field in the context of emergency sessions in 3GPP TS 23.167?
question_36574.ground_truth: The suggested value for the Priority header field in the context of emergency sessions in 3GPP TS 23.167 is "emergency".

question_36575.question: What does the SS do after sending RLC data blocks on downlink multi carriers that correspond to a small RB size?
question_36575.ground_truth: The SS polls the mobile station for the First Partial Bitmap using the ES/P field in the header of the last downlink data blocks.

question_36577.question: When should the UE stop the Tsor-cm timer associated with "SOR security check not successful", if running?
question_36577.ground_truth: The UE shall stop the Tsor-cm timer associated with "SOR security check not successful", if running, when the security check on the received steering of roaming information is successful.

question_36578.question: What should the Content-Type header contain in the SIP MESSAGE request?

question_36579.question: What are the five speech signal classes that can be classified based on the fixed signal classification parameters?
question_36579.ground_truth: The five speech signal classes that can be classified are UNVOICED CLASS, VOICED CLASS, VOICED TRANSITION CLASS, ONSET CLASS, and AUDIO CLASS.

question_36580.question: Which scenario describes a Hosting RAN Provider sharing RAN capacity automatically with other Participating Operators (e.g., MVNOs)?
question_36580.ground_truth: Scenario and use case 7 describes the situation of a Hosting RAN Provider sharing RAN capacity automatically with other Participating Operators.

question_36581.question: What is the recommended transport bearer addressing for the AAL2 transport layer in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_36581.ground_truth: The recommended transport bearer addressing for the AAL2 transport layer in the 3GPP Technical Specification is AAL2 signalling protocol Capability Set 2, which uses AAL2 transport layer addressing based on embedded E.164 or other AESA variants of the NSAP addressing format.

question_36583.question: When is registration not performed by UEs?
question_36583.ground_truth: Registration is not performed by UEs that are only capable of services that need no registration.

question_36584.question: What should be secured while converting application layer group ID to the destination L2 ID for 5G ProSe group communication?
question_36584.ground_truth: The conversion/mapping procedure should be secured in terms of privacy and traceability to prevent disclosure of group membership of specific UEs.

question_36585.question: What is the effect of transmission power difference between Node Bs in handover on Small cell performance?
question_36585.ground_truth: The performance of Small cell degrades when transmission power difference between Node Bs in handover gets higher. However, this problem can be somewhat mitigated by applying CIO, but there is an upper limit to CIO value that can be used.

question_36586.question: What is the purpose of storing the Inter RAT handover information and MS Classmark~2 and MS Classmark~3 as information elements on the Gb interface?
question_36586.ground_truth: The purpose is to support the case that a SRVCC handover is needed following PS domain handover from GERAN to UTRAN/E-UTRAN.

question_36588.question: What is the consequence of a downlink signalling failure for a MS with EC operation enabled in packet idle mode?
question_36588.ground_truth: A downlink signalling failure results in the MS performing the cell reselection procedure, where it selects a better cell if available.

question_36589.question: What shall the SMF do in order to initiate the PDU EAP result message transport procedure?
question_36589.ground_truth: The SMF shall create a PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION RESULT message, set the PTI IE to "No procedure transaction identity assigned", set the EAP message IE to the EAP-success message provided by the DN, and send the PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION RESULT message.

question_36590.question: As per the 3GPP TS 25.214 v7.1.0 specification, what is used to indicate the location of the FACH?
question_36590.ground_truth: The location of the FACH is indicated on the BCH and both its capacity and location can be changed if required.

question_36591.question: What is the main determinant for an NB-CIoT MS to transition from Connected Mode to Idle Mode or Power Saving Mode?
question_36591.ground_truth: The main determinant for an NB-CIoT MS to transition from Connected Mode to Idle Mode or Power Saving Mode is whether the Connected Mode Release Timer has expired and whether the Active Timer is running.

question_36592.question: What application does the UE need to contain in order to connect to the 5G network?
question_36592.ground_truth: The UE can contain either ISIM and USIM applications or only USIM application on UICC to connect to the 5G network.

question_36594.question: In the naming convention, what does "N" represent in "N" marks a certain data block?
question_36594.ground_truth: "N" represents the number of a certain data block.

question_36595.question: What is the purpose of the "GAN Cell Description" information element in GAN A/Gb mode?
question_36595.ground_truth: The purpose of the "GAN Cell Description" information element is to provide a minimum description of a GAN A/Gb mode cell, e.g. to identify the GAN A/Gb mode cell in order to be handed over from GERAN/UTRAN.

question_36596.question: What should the IWF do if it receives a SIP re-INVITE request with a Resource-Priority header field set to the value indicated for emergency calls and the SIP re-INVITE request does not contain an emergency indication?
question_36596.ground_truth: The IWF should reject the SIP re-INVITE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response.

question_36597.question: When the UE is in NB-N1 mode, what network indication is not provided to the UE during the registration procedure?
question_36597.ground_truth: The network does not indicate support of emergency services when the UE is in NB-N1 mode, as per the specification in 5.5.1.2.4 and 5.5.1.3.4.

question_36598.question: Which UEs are applicable to the access to RLOS?
question_36598.ground_truth: Access to RLOS is applicable to the UEs in WB-S1 mode only. The UEs in NB-S1 mode shall not request access to RLOS.

question_36600.question: What is the minimum power level at which the simulator shall be able to receive uplink transmissions from the UE?
question_36600.ground_truth: The simulator shall be able to receive uplink transmissions from the UE when it is transmitting at the minimum power level defined in 3GPP TS 25.101 for FDD mode, and 3GPP TS 25.102 for TDD mode.

question_36602.question: What is the purpose of the alarm smoothing function in E-OSF?
question_36602.ground_truth: Alarm smoothing is used to handle frequently occurring alarms that are automatically cancelled. It forwards the alarm after a delay, allowing the operator to set the delay time for forwarding alarms on the Management entity that implements E-OSF.

question_36603.question: What should the UAE-C include in the de-registration-info element when sending an HTTP POST request to de-register from the UAE-S?
question_36603.ground_truth: The UAE-C should include a UAV-id element in the de-registration-info element, set to the identity of the UAV which initiates the UAS UE de-registration procedure.

question_36604.question: What action does the EAS take when charging for a one-time UE location request based on PEC?
question_36604.ground_truth: The EAS sends the UE location request to the EES, which then checks the UE location with the 3GPP network and sends the location response back to the EAS.

question_36605.question: What is PFDF and what does it do?
question_36605.ground_truth: PFDF stands for Packet Flow Description Function. It stores PFDs associated with application identifier(s) and transfers them to the PCEF via Gw interface to enable the PCEF to perform accurate application detection when the PFDs are managed by a 3rd party service provider.

question_36608.question: How are the band energies quantized in the Small symbol coding method?
question_36608.ground_truth: In the Small symbol coding method, the band energies are coded using either resized or context-based Huffman coding. The mode selection between resized and context-based coding is based on the estimated number of bits consumed by the respective coding modes. The resized Huffman coding is used for coding the differential indices when LC_MODE is set to 1, and context-based coding is used when LC_MODE is set to 0.

question_36609.question: How does the UE select the type of trusted connectivity ("S2a connectivity" or "5G connectivity") for connecting to the selected PLMN?
question_36609.ground_truth: If both "S2a connectivity" and "5G connectivity" are supported for the selected PLMN, the UE selects "5G connectivity" because it is the preferred type of trusted access. If only one type of trusted connectivity is supported, the UE selects that type.

question_36610.question: What is the responsibility of the TR editor in the context of 3GPP technical documents?
question_36610.ground_truth: The TR editor is responsible for introducing all approved TPs in the current TR.

question_36611.question: What should the MN do if the lists of prepared PSCells received from the candidate SNs in steps 3 and 5 are different?
question_36611.ground_truth: The MN may initiate the SN Modification procedures towards the source SN and all the candidate SNs to inform them about the updated lists of prepared PSCells in other candidate SNs.

question_36613.question: What are the characteristics of the solution for realizing the reliability of user plane between UPF and UE using redundant data transmission in a 5G PDU session?
question_36613.ground_truth: This solution utilizes two N3 tunnels between the RAN node and UPF to realize the reliability of user plane data transmission. The QoS flow redundant transmission in the PDU session is decided by the SMF, with the possibility of protocol stack option 1 in TS 23.725 to be adopted.

question_36614.question: In clause 5.2.2.3.21, what should the NF Service Consumer (e.g. target I-SMF) do to request the source I-SMF to establish one downlink and/or one uplink N9 data forwarding tunnels?
question_36614.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer (e.g. target I-SMF) should send a POST request as specified in clause~5.2.2.3.1, with the dataForwarding attribute set to true, n9DlForwardingTunnel attribute carrying the N9 downlink data forwarding tunnel info of target Branching Point or UL CL, and optionally other information if necessary.

question_36615.question: What is the procedure initiated by when the 5G ProSe remote UE fails to provide specific identification parameters for emergency services?
question_36615.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe direct link identification procedure is initiated by the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE when the 5G ProSe remote UE fails to provide specific identification parameters, such as the IMEI or IMEISV, for emergency services.

question_36616.question: Which mobile terminated short message types can trigger a CAMEL service invocation?
question_36616.ground_truth: Short Message Delivery (TPDU type = SMS-DELIVER) and Short Message Status Report (TPDU type = SMS-STATUS-REPORT) are the short message types that can trigger a CAMEL service invocation.

question_36617.question: What is the responsibility of the LICF within the overall LI system?
question_36617.ground_truth: The LICF is ultimately responsible for all decisions within the overall LI system.

question_36619.question: What is the impact of the versioning system used in the document, and how does it change?
question_36619.ground_truth: The versioning system used in the document has three digits, where the first digit refers to the level of approval of the document, the second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, and the third digit is incremented when only editorial changes have been incorporated.

question_36620.question: What can trigger the network to assign a new UE radio capability ID to the UE, if the UE performs the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update without a UE radio capability ID included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message but has the NG-RAN-RCU bit set to "UE radio capability update needed"?
question_36620.ground_truth: The network can assign a new UE radio capability ID to the UE.

question_36621.question: What protocol is used by the routing functions of layer 3 for passing messages with task 2 in 3GPP access?
question_36621.ground_truth: The protocol discriminator (PD) is used by the routing functions of layer 3 for passing messages with task 2 in 3GPP access.

question_36624.question: When in the "P2: waiting for call response" state, what should the MCPTT client do upon receiving a PRIVATE CALL ACCEPT message?
question_36624.ground_truth: Upon receiving a PRIVATE CALL ACCEPT message in response to PRIVATE CALL SETUP REQUEST message with the same call identifier, the MCPTT client shall store the SDP answer IE received in the PRIVATE CALL ACCEPT message as answer SDP; shall generate a PRIVATE CALL ACCEPT ACK message; shall send the PRIVATE CALL ACCEPT ACK message in response to the request message; shall stop timer TFP1 (call setup retransmission), if running; shall stop timer TFP2 (waiting for call response message), if running; shall establish a media session based on the SDP body of the stored answer SDP; shall start timer TFP5 (max duration); and shall enter the "P4: part of ongoing call" state.

question_36626.question: What should the uplink signal transmission duration be during time duration T3 in the FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for UE Category 1bis?
question_36626.ground_truth: The uplink signal should be transmitted no later than 6500 ms (time point C) after the start of time duration T3.

question_36627.question: What is the minimum percentage of correct events required during repeated tests with a confidence level of 95%?
question_36627.ground_truth: The minimum percentage of correct events required is 90%.

question_36628.question: What does the Integrity Management function provide in the ework framework?
question_36628.ground_truth: The Integrity Management function allows the framework to query and report conditions related to the integrity of the framework, network service capability features, and client applications. Additionally, applications may report on their own conditions and perform heartbeating for continuous operation.

question_36629.question: What is the timing advance (TA) mechanism in NR operations, and what does it adjust?
question_36629.ground_truth: The timing advance (TA) mechanism in NR operations ensures that transmissions from all UEs operating in the same cell are synchronized when received by the same gNB. It adjusts the uplink transmission timing for PUCCH/PUSCH/SRS.

question_36631.question: What is the consequence of using the ViewHandler.findTLV() methods in the context described?
question_36631.ground_truth: Using the ViewHandler.findTLV() methods in the context described is recommended to get each COMPREHENSION TLV, as it allows for easy and efficient retrieval of specific TLVs within the USATEnvelopeHandler.

question_36633.question: What operation does the "Change Character Group" CH Extension Type indicate should be overridden?
question_36633.ground_truth: The initialization parameters of the Character Group (de)coder

question_36635.question: How many consecutive NPUSCH transmissions should be measured for the single tone NPUSCH transmission scenario?
question_36635.ground_truth: The power of 5 consecutive NPUSCH transmissions should be measured for the single tone NPUSCH transmission scenario.

question_36636.question: How does KASUMI process the input data block?
question_36636.ground_truth: KASUMI processes the input data block, I, by dividing it into two 32-bit strings, L0 and R0. Then, it iterates through 8 rounds, updating Li and Ri using a specific round function fi().

question_36638.question: What should be set in the "sl-TxResourceReqListDisc" field to request network to assign NR sidelink discovery messages resource for each destination in NR sidelink discovery messages transmission?
question_36638.ground_truth: The "sl-TxResourceReqListDisc" field should be set to include sl-DestinationIdentityDisc, sl-CastTypeDisc, sl-TxInterestedFreqListDisc, sl-TypeTxSyncListDisc, and sl-DiscoveryType for each destination for which it requests network to assign NR sidelink discovery messages resource in NR sidelink discovery messages transmission.

question_36639.question: What positioning assistance data can be included in positioning System Information Blocks?
question_36639.ground_truth: The positioning assistance data that can be included in positioning System Information Blocks are downlink positioning reference signals (DL PRS) and uplink sounding reference signals for positioning, each of which is characterized by certain parameters.

question_36640.question: What is the data type of the "PacketErrorRate" parameter defined as?

question_36643.question: What procedure shall the UE follow for session initiation and termination in 3GPP TS 24.229 as per 20.1.2?
question_36643.ground_truth: The UE shall follow the procedures specified in 3GPP TS 24.229 for session initiation and termination.

question_36645.question: What should the MAC entity do if SL-PRS Resource Request is triggered and not cancelled?
question_36645.ground_truth: If UL-SCH resources are available for a new transmission, the MAC entity should accommodate the SL-PRS Resource Request MAC CE and its subheader in those resources.

question_36647.question: What is the relative gain in average data rates from antenna switching algorithms for a PA3 channel when the residual BLER target after the 4th transmission is 1%?
question_36647.ground_truth: The relative gain in average data rates from antenna switching algorithms reduces as the BLER target becomes more stringent for a PA3 channel when the residual BLER target after the 4th transmission is 1%.

question_36648.question: What sizing parameters are supported if a terminal indicates "5.3" in the context of UICC capabilities?
question_36648.ground_truth: The "5.3" in the context of UICC capabilities indicates that Screen Sizing Parameters are supported.

question_36649.question: What action should the SMF take if a multicast MBS session has not started or will not start soon when rejecting a UE's request to join a session?
question_36649.ground_truth: The SMF should include a back-off timer value in the Rejection cause for that Received MBS information.

question_36650.question: What are the two new features in H.265 (HEVC) specifically for parallel processing support?
question_36650.ground_truth: The two new features in H.265 (HEVC) for parallel processing support are tiles and wavefront parallel processing (WPP).

question_36651.question: What is the recommendation for BS transmitters supporting CA of Band 4, Band 4 and Band 12 to avoid desensitization of the Band 12-14, 17, 22, 28 or 42-44 BS receiver?
question_36651.ground_truth: It is suggested that BS transmitters supporting CA of Band 4, Band 4 and Band 12 should not share the same antenna with Band 12-14, 17, 22, 28 or 42-44 BS receiver, unless the antenna path meets very stringent third order PIM specification.

question_36653.question: What is the purpose of monitoring data reporting in environmental monitoring using 5GMSG messages?
question_36653.ground_truth: The purpose is to report the monitoring data collected by the sensors periodically, with the devices being equipped with a 5GMSG communication model and minimizing resource usage by connecting to the 5GMSG Service only when needed.

question_36655.question: What is the requirement for the number of DL subframes per radio frame of measured cell for the absolute accuracy of RSRP in UE category M1 with CE mode A?
question_36655.ground_truth: At least 1 DL subframe per radio frame of measured cell is available at the UE for RSRP measurement assuming measured cell is identified cell.

question_36656.question: How does the MS react to a RR MANAGEMENT command received during the measurement procedure?
question_36656.ground_truth: The MS aborts the measurement procedure and starts on the RR MANAGEMENT procedure if a RR MANAGEMENT command is received during the measurement procedure. The MS sends a RR MANAGEMENT RESPONSE message upon completion.

question_36657.question: What should the AMF do if the lower layers indicate that the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message or REGISTRATION REJECT message could not be delivered due to an intra AMF handover, and the target TA is included in the TAI list?
question_36657.ground_truth: Upon successful completion of the intra AMF handover, the AMF shall retransmit the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message or REGISTRATION REJECT message. If a failure of the handover procedure is reported by the lower layer and the N1 NAS signalling connection exists, the AMF shall retransmit the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message or REGISTRATION REJECT message.

question_36658.question: What message should be sent as a response to a Remote UE Report Notification to acknowledge the information related to the remote UE(s) is received?
question_36658.ground_truth: The Remote UE Report Acknowledge message should be sent as the response to a Remote UE Report Notification, to acknowledge the information related to the remote UE(s) is received.

question_36661.question: In the example given, if field10 in InformationElement1 is absent, what is the expected behavior of the UE?
question_36661.ground_truth: The UE does not modify field10 and does not take any action on its child fields, if present.

question_36663.question: What are the two local IDs delivered by the L2 U2U Relay UE to both L2 U2U Remote UEs?
question_36663.ground_truth: The two local IDs delivered by the L2 U2U Relay UE to both L2 U2U Remote UEs are one that identifies the L2 U2U Remote UE and another that identifies the peer L2 U2U Remote UE.

question_36664.question: What significance is assigned to the message type CTS AFA MONITORING COMMAND?

question_36665.question: What must a UE include in the QoS flow information if the PC5 QoS parameters of the QoS flow were changed during the collection period, and the UE received the QoS flow during that period?
question_36665.ground_truth: The UE must include the time stamp for start of reception of the QoS flow in the collection period, the time stamp for end of reception of the QoS flow, the (initial) PC5 QoS parameters of the QoS flow in the collection period, the amount of data of the QoS flow received with the (initial) PC5 QoS parameters, and the time stamp for start of reception of the QoS flow with the new PC5 QoS parameters, the new PC5 QoS parameters of the QoS flow and the amount of data of the QoS flow received with the new PC5 QoS parameters in the collection period.

question_36667.question: What is the purpose of the "Access Transfer Control Function" (ATCF) and what is its role in the IP multimedia core network subsystem (IMS)?
question_36667.ground_truth: The "Access Transfer Control Function" (ATCF) is a network device in the IP multimedia core network subsystem (IMS) responsible for coordinating the transfer of media resources when a user transitions from a 3GPP network to a non-3GPP network. The ATCF enables smooth and efficient access transfer between 3GPP and non-3GPP networks.

question_36668.question: What is the responsibility of a Service Broker in managing service interactions?
question_36668.ground_truth: A Service Broker manages service interactions based on service Interaction Logic, which may be captured by a set of rules based on the service invocation history. The SB manages the execution of the services or applications based on these rules.

question_36669.question: What enhancements are specified in the NR Positioning for TS 22.261?
question_36669.ground_truth: The enhancements include improvement of positioning accuracy and latency, improvements of network and device efficiency, high integrity and reliability requirements, and support for A-GNSS positioning (BDS B2a, B3I, NavIC to NR) for NR positioning methods.

question_36670.question: What should the NGCN site provide in the P-Preferred-Identity header field when presenting a request as originated from a particular NGCN user?
question_36670.ground_truth: The NGCN site should provide the NGCN user identifier in the P-Preferred-Identity header field or in the P-Asserted-Identity header field to indicate the specific NGCN user that a request is originating from.

question_36671.question: Who is responsible for performing TSCAI calculation when the AF maintains the 5G VN Group information?
question_36671.ground_truth: The SMF indicates the (DS-TT, DS-TT) port pair to the PCF when the AF does not maintain the 5G VN Group information.

question_36673.question: What is the test procedure for measuring the Primary CCPCH power in subclause 6.4.5.4.2?
question_36673.ground_truth: The test procedure for measuring the Primary CCPCH power involves first measuring the power with the base station output power set to a specific value, then reducing the output power and repeating the measurement for a total of 4 measurements.

question_36675.question: What is the expected final state of the MS in the test?
question_36675.ground_truth: The expected final state of the MS in the test is CC-state "active".

question_36677.question: What is the technology used in attaching a temperature sensor to each pig in a smart pig farming system?
question_36677.ground_truth: A small, thin, and lightweight Ambient IoT device with a built-in temperature sensor is attached to each pig.

question_36678.question: What is the purpose of the test in 7.6A.4.1?
question_36678.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify a receiver's ability to receive an E-UTRA signal at its assigned channel frequency in the presence of an unwanted narrow band CW interferer at a frequency, which is less than the nominal channel spacing.

question_36681.question: What is the expected number of inter-frequency carriers that a UE which supports idleInactiveNR-MeasReport-r16 should be capable of monitoring for idle mode CA/DC measurements?
question_36681.ground_truth: A UE which supports idleInactiveNR-MeasReport-r16 should be capable of monitoring at least 7 inter-frequency carriers for idle mode CA/DC measurements.

question_36684.question: What should the HA do before receiving a binding update with Lifetime set to "0" from the UE?
question_36684.ground_truth: The HA should remove the DSMIPv6 binding cache entry of the UE and send a Binding Revocation Indication message.

question_36685.question: What action does the SMF take when it receives the "reflectiveQos" attribute set to true for a PCC rule with match-all SDF template?
question_36685.ground_truth: The SMF shall not apply reflective QoS control for the downlink traffic of the service data flows of the PCC rules that reference a QosData decision that includes the "reflectiveQos" attribute set to true.

question_36688.question: What determines the controlling system in a MC service group within the participating system?
question_36688.ground_truth: The MC service group identity of the group determines the controlling system in a MC service group within the participating system.

question_36689.question: What must the MCVideo client do to participate in a Video Push call?
question_36689.ground_truth: The MCVideo client must send a MONP MCVideo message as a UDP message to the local IP address of the MCVideo user on UDP port 8809.

question_36691.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for MAC-CE based uplink spatial relation switch delay as specified in clause 7.5.9.0.1?
question_36691.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement for MAC-CE based uplink spatial relation switch delay is defined in clause 7.5.9.0.1.

question_36692.question: How does the LRF obtain the UE's location information?
question_36692.ground_truth: The LRF may obtain the UE's location information by interacting with the IP-CAN and/or the UE. This may involve communication with a location server in the IP-CAN, communication with an entity supporting UE IP connectivity, or invoking a "RDF" to convert the location information into routing information.

question_36693.question: What is the output of the "Self-Optimization Progress Update Function"?
question_36693.ground_truth: The "Self-Optimization Progress Update Function" updates the self-optimization progress and important events to the operator. It provides a way for the operator to be informed about the current state of the self-optimization process.

question_36696.question: What are the two alternatives for beam reporting supported in NR?
question_36696.ground_truth: The two alternatives for beam reporting supported in NR are Alt 1: UE reports information about TRP Tx Beam(s) that can be received using selected UE Rx beam set(s), and Alt 2: UE reports information about TRP Tx Beam(s) per UE antenna group basis.

question_36697.question: What is required for a mobile station to be compatible with the LSA service?
question_36697.ground_truth: A mobile station is compatible with the LSA service if it provides specific functions such as cell reselection, notification of the current LSA, and complete functionality to allow the use of phase 2 services.

question_36698.question: What type of data does the "<MaxAffiliationsN2>" element contain and what information does it provide to the MCPTT server?
question_36698.ground_truth: The "<MaxAffiliationsN2>" element is of type "nonNegativeInteger" and it indicates to the MCPTT server the maximum number of MCPTT groups that the MCPTT user is authorized to affiliate with.

question_36701.question: What function does the 5G PKMF have in this solution for PC5 communication?
question_36701.ground_truth: The 5G PKMF is responsible for generating the K~PC5 key, authenticating and authorizing the UE-to-network relay, providing the K~PC5 key to the Remote UE, and generating the K~PC5-COM key for secure communication.

question_36702.question: What is the purpose of the Unified Modelling Language (UML) in the 3GPP TS 29.198-4 document?
question_36702.ground_truth: The Unified Modelling Language (UML) is used in the 3GPP TS 29.198-4 document as an object modelling technique to define the Multi-Media Call Control SCF.

question_36703.question: What information does the V-GMLC include in the LCS Service Response message sent to the H-GMLC when the UE has relocated before the area event occurred?
question_36703.ground_truth: The LCS Service Response includes an indication of the event occurrence, the LDR reference number, the H-GMLC address, and the LCS Service Response is sent in accordance with the requested QoS Class. The LDR reference number and the H-GMLC address will be used to identify the source of the original deferred location request in the case that the UE has relocated before the area event occurred. The V-GMLC may record charging information.

question_36704.question: What is the interfering signal offset for the narrowband intermodulation requirement based on CW and E-UTRA 1RB interfering signals?
question_36704.ground_truth: The interfering signal offsets from the RF bandwidth edge are dependent on the RAT/E-UTRA channel bandwidth and are defined in such a way that the whole intermodulation product falls inside the effective channel bandwidth of the outermost carrier.

question_36705.question: What is the function of the P-Charging-Vector header field, and what type of information does it contain?
question_36705.ground_truth: The P-Charging-Vector header field is used to convey charging related information, such as the globally unique IMS charging identifier (ICID) value.

question_36706.question: What is the transport format and port number used in the described interface?
question_36706.ground_truth: The transport format used is UDP and the port number is 44444.

question_36708.question: What is the Advice Of Charge (AOC) service that relates to charging information during a communication?

question_36709.question: How many combinations of OSId and OSAppId values can be specified in the "OSApps" interior node?
question_36709.ground_truth: One or more combinations of OSId and OSAppId values can be specified in the "OSApps" interior node, indicated by its "OneOrMore" occurrence.

question_36710.question: In what situations should the UE stop timer T3440 and proceed with establishing a PDN connection for emergency bearer services?
question_36710.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3440 and proceed with establishing a PDN connection for emergency bearer services when it receives a request from upper layers to establish a PDN connection for emergency bearer services, upon an indication from the lower layers that the RRC connection has been released, or when it has to perform a new attach procedure.

question_36712.question: What is the purpose of the GapCriteria parameter?
question_36712.ground_truth: The GapCriteria parameter is used to indicate the call gapping criteria for the GapOnService sequence and can contain either basic or compound gap criteria.

question_36713.question: What action is taken by MSC-A in case of a rejection or dialogue abortion performed by MSC-A?
question_36713.ground_truth: MSC-A responds with a MAP CLOSE or MAP U/P ABORT and releases the IU connection.

question_36716.question: Which algorithm is used by the SGSN to select the encryption algorithm in GERAN when attaching in GERAN?
question_36716.ground_truth: The SGSN selects the encryption algorithm to use in GERAN.

question_36717.question: What information does the UAE-S send in the HTTP 200 (OK) response when receiving an HTTP POST request containing a UAV application message?
question_36717.ground_truth: In the HTTP 200 (OK) response, the UAE-S shall include a Content-Type header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.uae-info+xml" and may include an application/vnd.3gpp.uae-info+xml MIME body with a UAV-application-message-info element in the UAE-info root element to indicate the acknowledgement of communications between UAVs within a geographical area.

question_36721.question: Why are there compiled copies of the library and headers included in the document?
question_36721.ground_truth: The compiled copies of the library and headers are included in the document for convenience, so that it can be easily built for Windows.

question_36725.question: What enhanced PDCCH monitoring adaptation mechanisms are provided to reduce UE power consumption on PDCCH monitoring in an active BWP?
question_36725.ground_truth: The enhanced PDCCH monitoring adaptation mechanisms include fast adaptation methods, such as reduced PDCCH monitoring at the end of or after a duration of data scheduling, and are triggered by scheduling DCI formats in Type3-PDCCH CSS sets or USS sets on the active DL BWP of the serving cell.

question_36726.question: What is the role of the CQI in the "simplified" Multiflow operation in Solution 3 in 7.3.2.3?
question_36726.ground_truth: In the "simplified" Multiflow operation in Solution 3 in 7.3.2.3, the CQI is used to aid in the offloading decision from the network point of view. If the UE is ICS capable, the CQI reported for the second best cell would reflect the interference cancellation/suppression capability of the UE.

question_36727.question: What is the role of the DNS message identifier in this process?
question_36727.ground_truth: The DNS message identifier uniquely identifies the DNS message reported, allowing the EASDF and SMF to associate the corresponding DNS message handling rule with the identified DNS message.

question_36728.question: What message is to be included in the UEAssistanceInformation message if the UE has a preference on the maximum number of MIMO layers for the cell group for FR2-2 and prefers to reduce the number of maximum MIMO layers of each serving cell operating on FR2 2?

question_36729.question: What message type is used in step 12 when the invoke ID is a reject?

question_36734.question: What is the problem when the time period during which the device can communicate is disrupted?

question_36735.question: What is the key issue #21 focusing on in the context of 3GPP TS 23.548?
question_36735.ground_truth: The key issue #21 is focusing on coordination at the EEL when the composite EASs provide services to the AC on a UE in the context of 3GPP TS 23.548.
