question_38088.question: What should the MAC entity do if the Random Access Preamble was not selected among the contention-based preambles?
question_38088.ground_truth: The MAC entity should select a PUSCH occasion and determine the UL grant and associated HARQ information for the MSGA payload in the selected PUSCH occasion, then deliver the UL grant and associated HARQ information to the HARQ entity.

question_38090.question: What is the purpose of the REPORT record in the context of Lawful Interception?
question_38090.ground_truth: The REPORT record is used to report non-communication related target actions (events) and for reporting unsuccessful packet-mode communication attempts in the context of Lawful Interception.

question_38091.question: What are the two types of UE policies for V2X communication covered in the document?
question_38091.ground_truth: The two types of UE policies for V2X communication covered in the document are UE policies for V2X communication over PC5 and UE policies for V2X communication over Uu.

question_38094.question: What is the definition of a "Group of Frames" in the context of the 3GPP Technical Report?
question_38094.ground_truth: A "Group of Frames" is defined as an interval between two consecutive sync frames in a 3GPP VR streaming service.

question_38095.question: How are the <MNC> and <MCC> digits encoded in the 5GS Tracking Area Identity based ePDG FQDN using a 3 octet TAC?
question_38095.ground_truth: The <MNC> and <MCC> digits are both encoded as 3-digit hexadecimal strings in the 5GS Tracking Area Identity based ePDG FQDN using a 3 octet TAC.

question_38096.question: What is the name of the command line option used for SDR content in Scenario 1?

question_38099.question: Under what conditions can a new FPLMN be added to the SIM without causing an existing FPLMN to be lost?
question_38099.ground_truth: When less than four FPLMNs exist in the EF, the addition of a new FPLMN will not cause any existing FPLMNs to be lost.

question_38101.question: What is the role of the PKMF in providing security materials for ProSe U2N relay?
question_38101.ground_truth: The PKMF provides all security materials for ProSe U2N relay, manages the discovery keys, and provides PC5 keys (i.e., PRUK and PRUK ID) to both the remote UE and relay UE.

question_38103.question: In what situation would the MME run a new EPS AKA and a NAS SMC procedure after the Attach Request but before the AS SMC?
question_38103.ground_truth: If there is no full native EPS NAS security context available in the MME after the Attach Request, such as when the UE has sent an unprotected Attach Request message.

question_38104.question: What is the purpose of the E-UTRAN FDD - UE Transmit Timing Accuracy Tests for Cat-M1 UE in CEModeB?
question_38104.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the Cat-M1 UE in CEModeB has the capability to follow the frame timing change of the connected System Simulator. The UE initial transmit timing accuracy, the maximum amount of timing change in one adjustment, and the minimum and maximum adjustment rate are tested based on the specified limits.

question_38105.question: Which type of de-registration measurements concerning the UE are split into subcounters per response status codes?
question_38105.ground_truth: Failed de-registration procedures initiated by UE

question_38107.question: In the case of UE deregistration as part of a UE-initiated detach, what is the Destination Address field set to in the RRQ that the UE sends to the FA?
question_38107.ground_truth: The Destination Address field is set to the FA's address.

question_38108.question: What is the issue with the "race condition" between the control and user plane signals in the scenario?
question_38108.ground_truth: The issue with the "race condition" is that the user may start talking before the User Plane is fully set up, causing a substantial part of his first utterances to be lost, and in some cases, the User Plane cannot be established and the call attempt ends with failure.

question_38109.question: In the "Call Re-establishment/call under establishment, transmission stopped" test, what should the mobile station not attempt to do when a lower layer failure occurs while an MM-connection is active and the state of the call control entity is not "active"?
question_38109.ground_truth: The mobile station shall not attempt call re-establishment.

question_38112.question: What is the maximum allowed RF output power transmitted by the BTS in the frequency range 918 to 921 MHz?
question_38112.ground_truth: The maximum allowed RF output power actually transmitted by the BTS in the frequency range 918 to 921 MHz depends on the coexistence scenarios and coordination between operators or is defined by the regulatory authority, and is specified in TS 45.005, clause 4.1.2.4.

question_38113.question: If the network supports delivery of SMS via GPRS and this delivery is enabled, what should the network include in the ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message?
question_38113.ground_truth: The network shall include the Additional network feature support IE in the ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message and set the GPRS-SMS indicator.

question_38114.question: What is the definition of "A-SE" and "A-SEM" in the provided document?
question_38114.ground_truth: A-SE stands for Additional spurious emissions and A-SEM stands for Spectrum Emission Mask.

question_38115.question: What is the definition of the cell re-selection delay for E-UTRAN FDD with lower priority?
question_38115.ground_truth: The cell re-selection delay is defined as the time from the beginning of time period T2, to the moment when the UE camps on Cell 2 and starts to send preambles on the PRACH for sending the RRC CONNECTION REQUEST message to perform a Tracking Area Update procedure on Cell 2 (E-UTRA).

question_38117.question: What is the function of the MCPTT group join request in the chat group call model?
question_38117.ground_truth: The MCPTT group join request is used to indicate to the MCPTT server that the MCPTT user associated with the given MCPTT client wishes to participate (begin to receive media) from the group and can be used to generate an implicit affiliation for the MCPTT user to the group.

question_38118.question: What message does the eNB send when a checking value is reached?
question_38118.ground_truth: The eNB sends a Counter Check message which contains the most significant parts of the COUNT values from each active radio bearer.

question_38120.question: What is the purpose of the Group Reporting Guard Time in the monitoring process?
question_38120.ground_truth: The Group Reporting Guard Time is used to ensure that accumulated Monitoring Indication is received by the SCEF before the Group Reporting Guard Timer is expired.

question_38121.question: When does the UE delete the memorized identity of the PLMNs where E-UTRA capability was disabled after enabling E-UTRA capability?
question_38121.ground_truth: When the UE enables E-UTRA capability, it deletes the PLMN from the memorized identity of the PLMNs where E-UTRA capability was disabled.

question_38122.question: When is the ProSe Direct Discovery interception mandatory?
question_38122.ground_truth: Interception of ProSe Direct Discovery is mandatory in the ProSe Function of the PLMN that is used for direct discovery.

question_38123.question: What message does the MS send when it receives the RRLP MULTILATERATION REQUEST message to acknowledge the reception of the message?
question_38123.ground_truth: The MS sends a PDAN message when it receives the RRLP MULTILATERATION REQUEST message on RR layer to acknowledge the reception of the message and include MS accuracy related information.

question_38125.question: What is the purpose of the DISPLAY TEXT command in the USIM Application Toolkit?
question_38125.ground_truth: The DISPLAY TEXT command is used to display Chinese characters on the ME's screen during the USIM Application Toolkit testing.

question_38128.question: What is the unit of measurement for the outgoing handover measurements, such as HO.OutAttTarget.Cause?
question_38128.ground_truth: Each measurement is an integer value. The number of measurements is equal to the number of causes supported plus a possible sum value identified by the .sum suffix.

question_38129.question: What is the difference in CQI reporting in transmission modes 4 and 9, in terms of PUSCH based reporting and RI>1?
question_38129.ground_truth: In transmission mode 4 with RI>1, PUSCH based reporting includes reporting a wideband CQI which comprises a 4-bit wideband CQI for codeword 0 and a 4-bit wideband CQI for codeword 1 for subframe-PUSCH based triggered reporting. However, in transmission mode 9, regardless of the value of RI, the reporting only includes a 4-bit wideband CQI for codeword 0 and a wideband spatial differential CQI. The wideband spatial differential CQI value comprises a 3-bit wideband spatial differential CQI value for codeword 1 offset level.

question_38131.question: What is the impact of the CCBS service on Communication Hold (HOLD)?
question_38131.ground_truth: This IMS supplementary service should not affect any other IMS supplementary service. When receiving a CCBS communication indication, the originating party may invoke the communication hold service in order to make interface resources available for the establishment of the CCBS communication.

question_38132.question: What happens to the EnvelopeResponseHandler after the first invocation of the ProactiveHandler's send method?
question_38132.ground_truth: It is no longer available for use.

question_38133.question: What is a requirement for the Combinational VCC solution to work between LTE and 3G CS?
question_38133.ground_truth: A pre-requisite for C-VCC operation between LTE and 3G CS is that the 3G cell supports both CS voice bearers and PS voice bearers.

question_38134.question: What is the requirement for the UE to receive PDCCH and PDSCH with new TCI-states after the delay as specified in Clause 8.10 in the new BWP in clause 7.5.6.1.0.1?
question_38134.ground_truth: If the UE has the information on the required TCI-state information to receive PDCCH and PDSCH in the new BWP after the delay as specified in Clause 8.10 in the new BWP, it shall be able to receive PDCCH and PDSCH with new TCI-states after the delay as specified in Clause 8.10 in the new BWP.

question_38135.question: How can redundant DIMS Units be stored in a file format using a separate track?
question_38135.ground_truth: Redundant DIMS Units can be stored in a separate track, which shall be linked to the matching main track by a track reference of type 'swto' in the redundant track. The redundant track shall only contain redundant data, and the track they link to shall contain the main data only.

question_38137.question: What should the UE do, if the SGC is active in the network, and after the UE transitions from EMM-CONNECTED mode to EMM-IDLE mode?
question_38137.ground_truth: The network shall start the SGC timer T3447 with the service gap time value available in the EMM context minus 4 minutes, if the UE supports SGC feature and the service gap time value has been sent to the UE with a non-zero value.

question_38138.question: Which clause in TS 24.282 specifies the requirements for the MCData client to send an Enhanced Status with a disposition request of only Delivery via the SDS OFF-NETWORK MESSAGE message?

question_38140.question: What is the enhancement for A-GNSS positioning in 5G network?
question_38140.ground_truth: Enhancements for A-GNSS positioning in 5G network include the support of BDS B2a signal, BDS B3I signal, and NavIC to NR. These enhancements improve the accuracy and reliability of positioning in 5G networks.

question_38141.question: What is a CAMEL monitor relationship in the context of GSM network?
question_38141.ground_truth: A monitor relationship in CAMEL (Customized Application for Mobile network Enhanced Logic) signifies that the gsmSSF is not able to control the call processing through the relationship, and it can only monitor the call.

question_38142.question: What is one of the main goals for the service provider regarding VR content?
question_38142.ground_truth: To minimize the number of different formats while ensuring high-quality presentation on various devices.

question_38143.question: Which method is used to delete a message from its current position in the folder?

question_38144.question: What should the mobile station do if the ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message contains the T3312 extended value IE?
question_38144.ground_truth: Use the T3312 extended value IE as the periodic routing area update timer (T3312).

question_38145.question: Which type of message is used to provide information regarding NR SCG failures detected by the UE?

question_38146.question: What should the Node B report to the CRNC when the resource operational state of a Communication Control Port has changed?
question_38146.ground_truth: The Node B shall report the new resource operational state by sending a RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message containing a "Service Impacting" Indication and the Communication Control Port ID IE when the resource operational state of a Communication Control Port has changed.

question_38147.question: What is the test purpose in the context of intermodulation response for EN-DC within FR1 with five component carriers?
question_38147.ground_truth: The test purpose is to determine the UE's ability to receive data with a given average throughput for a specified reference measurement channel, in the presence of two or more interfering signals which have a specific frequency relationship to the wanted signal, under conditions of ideal propagation and no added noise.

question_38148.question: What is the tray size of a standard DVD player?
question_38148.ground_truth: A standard DVD player tray size is typically 12cm by 8cm.

question_38149.question: What is the requirement for the MCPTT ID in an outgoing SIP INVITE request as per the specification?
question_38149.ground_truth: The MCPTT ID of the called user in the <mcptt-request-uri> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body of the outgoing SIP INVITE request.

question_38151.question: What is the impact of a higher downlink noise floor on the power allocated to common channels in a wireless communication system?
question_38151.ground_truth: As the downlink noise floor increases, more power needs to be allocated to common channels, reducing the available power for traffic channels and increasing the power consumption per traffic channel. This results in a reduced downlink capacity (throughput).

question_38153.question: What are the functions of the MNO in Scenarios 2 and 3?
question_38153.ground_truth: In Scenarios 2 and 3, the MNO makes the TV content available through the PSS server and also through MBMS Broadcast. The PSS server uses 3GP-DASH formats for unicast delivery. In Scenario 3, the MNO manages the dedicated TV service UEs and has agreements with other MNOs. The MNO monitors the TV service consumption per channel in areas and decides to use unicast or MBMS Broadcast usage.

question_38154.question: What status code is returned if the user does not exist when the NF service consumer attempts HSS Authentication Vector Retrieval?

question_38155.question: What RLP parameter does the System Simulator use in the test?

question_38156.question: What information is needed in the Proxy Binding Update message for PDN disconnection?
question_38156.ground_truth: The Proxy Binding Update message for PDN disconnection should include the MN NAI (which identifies the UE), APN, and PDN connection identity to determine which PDN to deregister the UE from.

question_38157.question: When may a change in the serving operator occur for a network sharing non-supporting UE during handover from UTRAN/GERAN to UTRAN?
question_38157.ground_truth: A change in the serving operator may occur when the UE enters Idle mode in both CS and PS domains and the operator chosen by the UE is not the same as the operator chosen by the source RAN during handover.

question_38158.question: What is the pre-test condition for the UE in the test described in clause 10.4.1.3.3.1?
question_38158.ground_truth: The UE is registered over both 3GPP access and non-3GPP access in 2 different PLMNs.

question_38159.question: What problem could potentially occur when the B41 UL carrier aligns with the 3rd order harmonic of the B26 DL carrier in the B26 UE receiver?
question_38159.ground_truth: The problem that could potentially occur is B26 desensitization if the B41 UL and B26 DL 3rd harmonic align, due to the known harmonic mixing problem in typical receiver design. This problem could virtually nullify the receiver function if the receiver could not provide up to 20-dB 3rd order harmonic rejection, even with additional bandpass filters cascaded before the LNA.

question_38160.question: In the context of Event A3, what does it mean when the inequality Mn + Ofn + Ocn - Hys > Mp + Ofp + Ocp is satisfied?
question_38160.ground_truth: This inequality indicates that the neighboring cell, with its offsets, has become a certain offset better than the serving cell, which triggers Event A3.

question_38161.question: What is the maximum number of TFIEs that can be supported by the network?

question_38163.question: What should be the rate of correct events observed during repeated tests with a confidence level of 95%, as per the test requirement in test 1 and 2?

question_38165.question: What is the purpose of the GSM ciphering mode and GSM ciphering algorithm in the authentication and ciphering procedure used for GSM authentication challenge?
question_38165.ground_truth: The purpose is to let the network set the GSM ciphering mode (ciphering/no ciphering) and GSM ciphering algorithm during the authentication and ciphering procedure used for GSM authentication challenge.

question_38166.question: What action should be taken if an Accept-Contact header field in a SIP INVITE request does not include the required media feature tags?
question_38166.ground_truth: The SIP INVITE request should be rejected with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response, and no further steps should be processed.

question_38167.question: What is not specified in TS 38.101 clause 7.3A.6 for exceptions in cross band isolation?
question_38167.ground_truth: The test frequency and channel bandwidth is already specified in TS 38.101.

question_38168.question: What should the I-CSCF do when it receives a 2xx response to a REGISTER request?
question_38168.ground_truth: The I-CSCF should forward the 2xx response to the P-CSCF.

question_38169.question: What is the implication of a high TPC BER for F-DPCH?
question_38169.ground_truth: A TPC BER value above 20% for F-DPCH cannot be tolerated because it generates excessive UL interference to the LPN, reducing then the LPN UL performance.

question_38170.question: What is the purpose of the parameter "callLegSessionID" in the provided methods?
question_38170.ground_truth: The parameter "callLegSessionID" is used to specify the call leg session ID of the call leg in the provided methods.

question_38173.question: What is the minimum requirement for the RRC connection re-establishment delay in the E-UTRAN TDD Inter-frequency RRC Re-establishment test?
question_38173.ground_truth: The RRC re-establishment delay to an unknown E-UTRA TDD inter frequency cell shall be less than 3 seconds.

question_38174.question: What action should the UE take if it receives a 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement PROCEDURE REJECT message from the network?
question_38174.ground_truth: If the message has been successfully integrity checked by the NAS, the UE shall set the update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, delete the stored 5G-GUTI, TAI list, last visited registered TAI, and ngKSI. The USIM shall be considered invalid until switching off the UE or the UICC containing the USIM is removed.

question_38175.question: In the 5G system supporting smart farming, what is a challenge in the automated irrigation use case?
question_38175.ground_truth: The challenge is that low-bit-rate sensors are deployed at high density, and the 5G system must support the efficient processing and transfer of the data generated from these sensors.

question_38176.question: What should the UE do if the operation code in a mapped EPS bearer context is "Create new EPS bearer" and there is already an existing mapped EPS bearer context with the same EPS bearer identity associated with any PDU session?
question_38176.ground_truth: The UE shall not diagnose an error, further process the create request and, if it was processed successfully, not delete the existing mapped EPS bearer context.

question_38178.question: What do the common parameters provided to the 5GC by an LCS Client assist with?
question_38178.ground_truth: The common parameters provided to the 5GC by an LCS Client assist with estimating resource usage in advance for a periodic and triggered location request and deciding whether to accept or reject the request.

question_38179.question: What should the transmission participant do upon receiving a granted response for Receive media request message?
question_38179.ground_truth: The transmission participant should provide receive media success notification to the user, stop timer T103 (Receive Media Request) and enter the 'U: has permission to receive' state.

question_38180.question: What is the impact of using the Attach procedure frequently in the context of NB-IoT?
question_38180.ground_truth: The Attach procedure in NB-IoT is a heavy weight procedure, and frequently using it consumes a significant amount of radio resources and device battery energy. This is because it involves tasks such as an IMEI check, re-authentication, re-establishment of NAS security keys, and re-establishment of RRC security.

question_38181.question: What are two examples of changes of position reported for a GPRS Session relationship?
question_38181.ground_truth: The two examples of changes of position reported for a GPRS Session relationship are Change of Position (PDP Context) and Change of Position (Session).

question_38182.question: What will occur if the application tries to indicate the sender address but groups are not supported by the system?
question_38182.ground_truth: A PolicyException (POL0006) will be returned to the application.

question_38183.question: How does the PDCP Duplication Activation/Deactivation MAC Control Element indicate the activation/deactivation status of a DRB, and what is the size of the MAC control element?
question_38183.ground_truth: The PDCP Duplication Activation/Deactivation MAC Control Element indicates the activation/deactivation status of a DRB by setting the D field to "1" to indicate duplication shall be activated, and to "0" to indicate duplication shall be deactivated. The MAC control element has a fixed size and consists of a single octet containing eight D fields.

question_38184.question: Which RFC specifies the Presence Information Data Format (PIDF) used in multiple 3GPP Presence Service reference points?
question_38184.ground_truth: IETF RFC 3863 specifies the Presence Information Data Format (PIDF) used in multiple 3GPP Presence Service reference points, such as Pen, Pex, and Pw.

question_38185.question: What is the minimum and maximum length of the Alternative NSSAI information element?
question_38185.ground_truth: The Alternative NSSAI information element has a minimum length of 2 octets and a maximum length of 146 octets.

question_38186.question: What should the MS do if it's in automatic SNPN selection mode and the registered SNPN is not available?
question_38186.ground_truth: The MS shall follow the procedure in subclause 4.9.3.1.1 or subclause 4.9.3.1.2 depending on its SNPN selection mode. At switch on, the MS shall use the SNPN selection mode that was used before switching off.

question_38187.question: What security measure is recommended to protect communication between an external MTC Service Provider and the Network from revealing security/privacy sensitive information?
question_38187.ground_truth: Using TLS or IPSec to protect the communication with confidentiality and integrity.

question_38188.question: Who are the potential analytics consumers that can directly contact the NWDAF with related analytics exposure procedures?
question_38188.ground_truth: AMF, SMF, NSSF, PCF, LMF, AF, NEF, OAM, and/or CEF.

question_38190.question: What is the relative Rx Ec/No gain for Switched Antenna Transmit Diversity (SATD) in different channel propagation environments?
question_38190.ground_truth: The relative Rx Ec/No gain for SATD is a range of 2% to 8% in the PA3 channel setting and up to 5% in the VA30 channel setting.

question_38191.question: What is the effect of applying barring of existing PDP contexts in the SGSN?
question_38191.ground_truth: When barring of Packet Oriented Services is applied, the SGSN may deactivate all existing PDP contexts depending on the barring category.

question_38192.question: What is the purpose of defining standard measurements in the technical specification?
question_38192.ground_truth: Defining standard measurements aims to ensure the comparability of measurement data produced in a multi-vendor network for those measurement types that can be standardized across all vendors' implementations.

question_38193.question: What is the MExE Java VM's limitation in loading native libraries?
question_38193.ground_truth: The MExE Java VM can only load native libraries that are intrinsically part of the MExE device implementation and MExE native libraries.

question_38195.question: What is one of the facilities provided in the Network Assistance feature for downlink media streaming?
question_38195.ground_truth: The Network Assistance feature for downlink media streaming provides a facility for bit rate recommendation (throughput estimation) based on network estimations or predictions of available link bandwidth.

question_38196.question: What does the "<L2P>" parameter in the "+CGDATA" command represent?
question_38196.ground_truth: The "<L2P>" parameter in the "+CGDATA" command indicates the layer 2 protocol to be used between the TE and MT, such as PPP (Point-to-point protocol) or PAD (character stream for X.25 character mode).

question_38197.question: What conformance requirements are specified for the pre-test conditions of the test case related to consistent uplink LBT failures?
question_38197.ground_truth: The pre-test conditions of the test case include the use of E-UTRA Cell 1 as PCell, NR Cell 1 as PSCell, and NR Cell 1 as shared spectrum. The system information combination defined in TS 38.508-1 clause 4.4.3.1.1 is used in E-UTRA Cell 1 and NR Cell 1.

question_38199.question: What is the role of the "Roaming Charging Profile" in the message flow?
question_38199.ground_truth: The "Roaming Charging Profile" in the message flow includes information about QoS flow and PDU session level triggers (e.g., both QoS change and user location change) for QBC, and for FBC both rating group and PDU session level triggers may be included.

question_38200.question: What does a Virtual Private Network (VPN) allow a group of users to do in relation to call placement?
question_38200.ground_truth: A VPN allows a group of users to place calls by using digit sequences having different structures and meanings than provided by the public numbering plan.

question_38202.question: What is the current proposal for the output RF spectrum emissions for D2D transmissions, as specified in the 3GPP TS 36.101?
question_38202.ground_truth: The current proposal for the output RF spectrum emissions for D2D transmissions, as specified in the 3GPP TS 36.101, is to apply the existing requirements for output RF spectrum emissions (clause 6.6 in TS 36.101) for D2D transmissions.

question_38203.question: What is the role of the UPF when the SMF authorizes a PDU Session of Ethernet PDU type and the DN-AAA server provides a list of allowed MAC addresses?
question_38203.ground_truth: The SMF sets corresponding filtering rules in the UPF(s) acting as PDU Session Anchor for the PDU Session and the UPF discards any UL traffic that does not contain any of these MAC addresses as a source address.

question_38204.question: What is the issue addressed in Case 1 when the UE returns from Idle mode outside of the SMF Service Area?
question_38204.ground_truth: The issue addressed in Case 1 is an additional I-UPF selection if the same SMF can still serve the UE.

question_38205.question: What is the aim of the Sequence Diagram 5.1, Sending messages and receiving delivery notification in the document?
question_38205.ground_truth: The aim of Sequence Diagram 5.1, Sending messages and receiving delivery notification is to show the process of sending messages on the IpMultiMediaMessaging interface with sendMessageReq(), and how the application can be informed about the delivery status of the message with messageStatusReport(). It also shows how the application can query the delivery status of a message, with queryStatusReq().

question_38206.question: What does the measurement "CC.NbrAnsCallMax" represent?
question_38206.ground_truth: This measurement provides the maximum number of simultaneous online calls which have been answered in the MGCF.

question_38207.question: What information must the AMF include in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message if the network allows SMS delivery over NAS via 3GPP access only, and the UE has set the "supported accesses" bits to "SMS over NAS supported via both 3GPP access and non-3GPP access"?
question_38207.ground_truth: The "allowed accesses" bits of the SMS allowed IE to indicate "SMS over NAS supported via 3GPP access only"

question_38208.question: What is the corresponding channel in LTE for typical urban environments?
question_38208.ground_truth: The corresponding channel in LTE for typical urban environments is ETU.

question_38211.question: What are the two types of messages specified in IEC 61850 standard for DER communication?
question_38211.ground_truth: The two types of messages specified in IEC 61850 standard for DER communication are GOOSE (Generic Object Oriented Substation Events) and SV (Sampled Values) messages. GOOSE messages are typically used to transfer information closely related to monitoring and control functions, while SV messages are used to transfer numerical samples of current and voltage signals.

question_38212.question: What is medium grain scalability (MGS) in SVC?
question_38212.ground_truth: MGS is a quality scalability technique in SVC that achieves different operation points and performs inter-layer prediction at the transform domain, significantly reducing the complexity at the encoder and decoder.

question_38213.question: In what mechanism does the PDN GW use when triggering the basic P-CSCF restoration mechanism?
question_38213.ground_truth: The PDN GW sends a Session Termination Request to the 3GPP AAA Server.

question_38216.question: What are some potential management environment implementation forms for incorporating Physical Termination Point/Connection Termination Point concepts into the 3GPP NRM IRPs?
question_38216.ground_truth: One potential form is to build Physical Termination Point, Connection Termination Point, and TopologicalLink model concepts into the 3GPP NRM IRPs and expose them using 3GPP IRP Agent with external references to link the NEs.

question_38217.question: What is the role of the BA in the local communication using GBA based security?
question_38217.ground_truth: The BA acts as the remote device in the local communication using GBA based security.

question_38219.question: What are the E-UTRAN E-CID measurement requirements for PScell and SCell carrier frequencies, and non-serving E-UTRA carrier frequencies?
question_38219.ground_truth: The E-UTRAN E-CID measurement requirements for PScell and SCell carrier frequencies are specified in section 8.19.5, and for non-serving E-UTRA carrier frequencies are specified in section 8.19.3.

question_38220.question: What are the required functional elements for 3G-324M implementations?
question_38220.ground_truth: 3G-324M implementations are required to have a wireless interface, H.223 with Annex A and B multiplex, and H.245 version 3 or later versions for system control protocol.

question_38221.question: What is the response status code for a successful creation of a new Policy in the NSCE Server?
question_38221.ground_truth: The NSCE Server responds with an HTTP "201 Created" status code for a successful creation of a new Policy.

question_38222.question: What is the requirement for an MS when the back-off timer is started due to the network rejecting a request with the Extended Wait Timer?
question_38222.ground_truth: The MS should not perform new Routing Area Updating before the timer T3346 has expired.

question_38225.question: What is the difference in the strongest co-channel interference between DSR and EGPRS?
question_38225.ground_truth: The strongest co-channel DSR interference is about 2.3~dB lower than the strongest EGPRS interference.

question_38226.question: What special co-location requirements may apply for unsynchronized TDD base stations that are co-located and using the same or adjacent operating bands?
question_38226.ground_truth: Special co-location requirements may apply for unsynchronized TDD base stations that are co-located and using the same or adjacent operating bands, which are not covered by the 3GPP specifications.

question_38227.question: What should the MCVideo client contain in the SIP INVITE request when pulling a video from a MCVideo server?
question_38227.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should contain an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the <mcvideoinfo> element containing the <mcvideo-Params> element with the <session-type> element set to a value of "one-from-server video pull" and the <video-pull-url> element set to the URL of the video file to be streamed.

question_38228.question: What are the three distinct ways used to encode short codewords in the Split PVQ scheme?
question_38228.ground_truth: The three distinct ways are direct bit encoding, 1/8 bit resolution uniform PDF encoding, and asymmetric triangular PDF encoding of band split energy angles, using tailor made CDFs.

question_38231.question: What action is it implementation dependent for the UE when the expiration time has expired and the time indicated by the Retry-After header field does not elapse?
question_38231.ground_truth: It is implementation dependent for the UE whether it sends reregistration due to RAT change or feature tag, which includes the ICSI values that the UE intends to use in a g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag or IARI values that the UE intends to use in the g.3gpp.iari-ref media feature tag during the time indicated by the Retry-After header field.

question_38232.question: What improvements in major mobile metaverse services have been made for better bandwidth and lower latencies?
question_38232.ground_truth: Major improvements for better bandwidth and lower latencies include incorporation of 1200 MHz of new spectrum in the 6 GHz band, support up to 1024 QAM with Wi-Fi 6 and 6E, doubling maximum channel bandwidth available to each device to 320MHz in the 6GHz band with Wi-Fi 7, and incorporating High Band Simultaneous (HBS) Multi-Link Operation (MLO) in 802.11be that aggregates two simultaneous 160 MHz channels reducing latency to < 2msec.

question_38235.question: What should a Mobile Station (MS) do when it receives a message with a message type that is not defined for the Packet Data (PD) or not implemented by the receiver, in the context of 3GPP TS 04.68 or 04.69?
question_38235.ground_truth: The MS should ignore the message. If COMM = T, it should return a STATUS message with cause "message type non-existent or not implemented" and include as diagnostics the message type of the message received.

question_38236.question: What does the first digit of the version number in the 3GPP technical specification indicate?
question_38236.ground_truth: The first digit of the version number indicates the stage of the document in the TSG approval process.

question_38237.question: What kind of scheduling restrictions does the UE cause for inter-frequency SSB based measurements without gap?
question_38237.ground_truth: The UE may cause scheduling restrictions for inter-frequency SSB based measurements without gap as specified in clause 9.3.9.4.

question_38239.question: What is the requirement for the base station classes in relation to the minimum coupling loss in Wide Area Base Stations?
question_38239.ground_truth: The Wide Area Base Stations are characterized by requirements derived from Macro Cell scenarios with a minimum coupling loss equal to 70~dB between the base station and the user equipment.

question_38240.question: What information does the Serving GW indicate to the PCRF after step B.1 in the Gateway Control and QoS Policy Rules Request Procedure?
question_38240.ground_truth: The Serving GW indicates to the PCRF whether the requested QoS Policy Rules Provision could be enforced or not and indicates User Location Information and/or UE Time Zone Information to the PCRF as an Event Report if the corresponding event trigger is set.

question_38242.question: What are the mixing parameters and for bit rates less than 24.4 kb/s?
question_38242.ground_truth: For bit rates less than 24.4 kb/s, the mixing parameters and are estimated as, (720) and (721), respectively.

question_38243.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals Open Service Access (OSA) Parlay X Web Services?
question_38243.ground_truth: The purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals Open Service Access (OSA) Parlay X Web Services is to provide an architecture that enables application developers to make use of network functionality through an open standardized interface.

question_38244.question: What action should a URCMP entity take when a mandatory IE is missing in a Request message?
question_38244.ground_truth: A URCMP entity should log the error and send a Response message with Cause IE value set to "Mandatory IE missing" with the type of the missing mandatory IE.

question_38245.question: What kind of information does the method "reserveAmountErr()" provide in case of a failure?
question_38245.ground_truth: The method "reserveAmountErr()" provides the error code and the request number for the next request in case of a failure.

question_38246.question: What is the structure of the 5GS Tracking Area Identity based ePDG FQDN using a 3 octet TAC?
question_38246.ground_truth: The 5GS Tracking Area Identity based ePDG FQDN using a 3 octet TAC is constructed as "tac-lb<TAC-low-byte>.tac-mb<TAC-middle-byte>.tac-hb<TAC-high-byte>.5gstac.epdg.epc.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.pub.3gppnetwork.org"

question_38248.question: What is the impact of the potential problem identified with the security solution in Solution #4?
question_38248.ground_truth: The potential problem identified with the security solution in Solution #4 is that an attacker can act as a MitM and reject the resume request, causing the UE to transition to idle and then connect to send the data without integrity protection, thereby weakening the security.

question_38249.question: Which bands, when using Band 1 and Band 42 in LTE Advanced Carrier Aggregation, may be affected by IMD products if not given very stringent 3rd order PIM specification?
question_38249.ground_truth: Bands 5, 6, 8, 18, 19, 20, 26, 27, 28, unsynchronized 42, unsynchronized 43, or unsynchronized 44 BS receivers may be affected by IMD products if not given very stringent 3rd order PIM specification when using Band 1 and Band 42 in LTE Advanced Carrier Aggregation.

question_38250.question: In what scenario would the UE set the failureType as "t310-Expiry" when initiating the transmission of the MCGFailureInformation message?
question_38250.ground_truth: This would occur when the UE initiates transmission of the MCGFailureInformation message due to the expiry of T310.

question_38253.question: What is the name of the cell re-selection parameter that specifies the additional offset to be used for cell selection and re-selection in case the RRC Connection Establishment fails on the cell?

question_38254.question: What is the operation code for the RELEASE COMPLETE (SS RETURN RESULT) 1.1A and 1.1B?
question_38254.ground_truth: The operation code for the RELEASE COMPLETE (SS RETURN RESULT) 1.1A is the same as for 1.1B, and it indicates the registration of call forwarding unconditional.

question_38255.question: What is the sequence of message exchanges between the AMF, UPF, source gNB, and target gNB during a handover procedure?
question_38255.ground_truth: The sequence of message exchanges between the AMF, UPF, source gNB, and target gNB during a handover procedure involves the target gNB sending a PATH SWITCH REQUEST message to AMF, 5GC switches the DL data path towards the target gNB and releases any U-plane/TNL resources towards the source gNB, the AMF confirms the PATH SWITCH REQUEST message with the PATH SWITCH REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message, and the target gNB sends the UE CONTEXT RELEASE message to inform the source gNB about the success of the handover.

question_38257.question: If the HTTP DELETE request message from the NF service consumer is accepted, what status code will the BSF send in response?
question_38257.ground_truth: The BSF will respond with an "204 No Content" status code.

question_38259.question: What type of spacer is used with left-handed phantoms?

question_38261.question: What is the use of the BMC-Data41-REQ primitive?
question_38261.ground_truth: The BMC-Data41-REQ primitive is used by upper layer (Transport Layer) to request repeated transmission of CBS messages if the source is ANSI-41 core network.

question_38262.question: What does the "Ci2" field indicate in the IAB-DU Beam Restricted MAC CE?
question_38262.ground_truth: The "Ci2" field in the IAB-DU Beam Restricted MAC CE indicates whether the octet containing the multiplexing mode info IDij field is included or not for each restricted beam within the resource set.

question_38263.question: What is conveyed within an IP-Sec tunnel when the IP-Sec Transport Layer Address IE is present and the GTP Transport Layer Addresses IE within the eNB X2 Extended Transport Layer Addresses IE is not empty?
question_38263.ground_truth: GTP traffic is conveyed within an IP-Sec tunnel terminated at the IP-Sec tunnel end point given in by the IP-Sec Transport Layer Address IE.

question_38264.question: What happens to the traffic type when a UE switches communication paths for the ProSe service?
question_38264.ground_truth: The same traffic type, whether IP type, Ethernet type, or Unstructured type, is maintained between the two communication paths.

question_38266.question: What is required for 5GC and application providers to have different levels of trust and agreement for regulatory requirements and privacy of data?
question_38266.ground_truth: Policies at external boundaries in the routing domain (N6 interface) may be used to handle the transfer of data within a restricted area, as required by privacy regulations.

question_38267.question: In what scenario does the Node B need to include the E-DPCCH Power Boosting Capability IE set to " E-DPCCH Power Boosting Capable" for the Local Cell in the RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message?
question_38267.ground_truth: If the Local Cell is E-DPCCH Power Boosting-capable when it becomes Existing.

question_38268.question: What does the MBMS-Flags AVP provide control indications for?
question_38268.ground_truth: The MBMS-Flags AVP provides control indications for the management of the broadcast or multicast connection in the network, including the setup and release of resources.

question_38269.question: What shall a provider do in the context of normative provisions regarding communication service assurance?
question_38269.ground_truth: The provider shall fulfill the mandatory requirements specified in the 3GPP technical specification.

question_38270.question: What is the maximum allowed interruption time for searching for new FDD inter-frequency cells for each inter-frequency carrier frequency?

question_38271.question: What action does the MCPTT server take when it receives an MCPTT in-progress emergency group state cancel request while a group member in the emergency state is transmitting?
question_38271.ground_truth: The MCPTT in-progress emergency group state cancel request is rejected by the MCPTT server.

question_38272.question: What is the requirement for the information bit data in the test?
question_38272.ground_truth: The information bit data shall be pseudo random and not repeated before 10 different information bit payload blocks are processed.

question_38273.question: What is the significance of considering the SCell as the serving cell in event A6 of the 3GPP specification?
question_38273.ground_truth: The significance of considering the SCell as the serving cell in event A6 is that the neighbor(s) is/are on the same frequency as the SCell, i.e. both are on the frequency indicated in the associated measObject.

question_38274.question: What is the concept behind APN level load control in 3GPP networks?
question_38274.ground_truth: APN level load control refers to advertising the load information with APN level granularity and selection of the target node based on this information, in order to ensure evenly balanced network with APN level load granularity. This helps to have an effective overload control in the network and avoid distribution of sessions at APN level being uneven across PGWs.

question_38275.question: What is the relationship between this Solution Set specification and TS~32.732?
question_38275.ground_truth: This Solution Set specification is related to 3GPP~TS~32.732.

question_38276.question: What is the gain in WMOPS achieved by the alternative EVS implementation using extended basic operators with a weight change for STL2009 basic operators?
question_38276.ground_truth: The gain in WMOPS achieved is 1.07x.

question_38277.question: What is the maximum event triggered measurement reporting delay specified in clause 8.1.2.3.1 of 25.133 without L3 filtering?
question_38277.ground_truth: The event triggered measurement reporting delay, measured without L3 filtering shall be less than T identify inter defined in clause 8.1.2.3.1 of 25.133.

question_38279.question: What interfaces are used in Procedure invoking external product order after receiving product order from NSC?
question_38279.ground_truth: The interface between the NSC and BSS of the NSP, the interface between the BSS of the NSP and BSS of the CSP, the interface between the BSS and the OSS both belonging to the CSP, and the interface between the OSS and the BSS both belonging to the CSP.

question_38280.question: What Codecs can be supported by the local UE and the IMS network?
question_38280.ground_truth: The local UE and the IMS network can support AMR, AMR-WB, and EVS including EVS-IO.

question_38283.question: What is the purpose of providing monitoring key level conditions for usage monitoring in the PCEF or the TDF?
question_38283.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure that there is at least one PCC rule activated for the IP-CAN session that is associated with that Monitoring key in the PCEF, and to ensure that there is at least one ADC rule at the TDF activated for the TDF session that is associated with that Monitoring key.

question_38284.question: What information does the Serving GW send to the SGSN in Modify Bearer Response message after receiving Modify Bearer Response from the PDN GW?
question_38284.ground_truth: Acknowledgement of completion of the handover process

question_38285.question: What is the requirement for network slice admission control for PDU sessions in Rel-17, as specified in TS 24.501, clause 4.6.3.1?
question_38285.ground_truth: The serving PLMN or the HPLMN, or SNPN can perform network slice admission control for the S-NSSAI(s) subject to NSAC to monitor and control the total number of established PDU sessions per network slice.

question_38286.question: What is Key issue #2 related to inter-operator charging in roaming cases?
question_38286.ground_truth: Key issue #2 related to inter-operator charging in roaming cases is that the VPLMN operator may wish to produce bearer level charging information to be used for inter-operator charging (settlements). The logical place for doing this is the VPLMN S-GW, which terminates the S8b interface towards the HPLMN P-GW.

question_38287.question: What should the UE do if the timer value in the Back-off timer value IE is not zero, and the timer value is not deactivated or indicates zero, for the bearer resource allocation procedure in the same PLMN and APN combination?
question_38287.ground_truth: The UE shall not send another BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message in the PLMN for the same APN until the back-off timer expires, the UE is switched off or the USIM is removed.

question_38288.question: When is the test for conducted emission DC power input/output port applicable?
question_38288.ground_truth: The test is applicable when the DC power cable of the UE and/or the ancillary equipment is intended to be 3 m or longer.

question_38290.question: What is the alphabet that the GET INPUT command in TS 11.14 clause 12.15 must support?
question_38290.ground_truth: The GET INPUT command in TS 11.14 clause 12.15 must support the UCS2 facility for the coding of the Cyrillic alphabet, as defined in ISO/IEC 10646.

question_38291.question: What is the role of the USF in Fixed Uplink Allocation (FUA) in EC operation?
question_38291.ground_truth: In FUA, the USF is used in the downlink to indicate to an MS that the uplink is free as long as the FUA is still active. The USF is not used for uplink allocation in FUA, but it is still included in all downlink blocks to allow multiplexing with GPRS, EGPRS and EGPRS2 MSs.

question_38292.question: What should the MCData client do when it has successfully downloaded the file in a standalone one-to-one FD message with a non-mandatory download and with a disposition of "FILE DOWNLOAD COMPLETE UPDATE"?
question_38292.ground_truth: The MCData client should notify the MCDATA User that the file has successfully downloaded and generate an FD NOTIFICATION indicating the successful download of the file.

question_38293.question: What is the purpose of the MILENAGE algorithm set in the 3GPP authentication and key generation functions?
question_38293.ground_truth: The MILENAGE algorithm set provides an example of algorithms that can be used for the 3GPP authentication and key generation functions f1, f1*, f2, f3, f4, f5, and f5*.

question_38294.question: What information must the SLM-C include in the CoAP 2.05 (Content) response when notifying location information?
question_38294.ground_truth: The SLM-C shall include one or more "LocationReport" objects, each "LocationReport" object containing the "valTgtUe", "triggerIds", and "locInfo" attributes.

question_38295.question: What is used to determine every uplink allocation of an EC-PACCH block during downlink assignment?
question_38295.ground_truth: Polling related control parameters in the preceding downlink block(s) are used for determining uplink allocation of an EC-PACCH block during downlink assignment.

question_38299.question: What is the purpose of periodic updating in the mobile station?
question_38299.ground_truth: Periodic updating is used to notify periodically the availability of the mobile station to the network and it is performed by using the location updating procedure.

question_38301.question: What function does the UE perform when supporting PS to CS DRVCC for IMS emergency?
question_38301.ground_truth: The UE stores the E-STN-DR received from IMS and triggers the session DRVCC procedure.

question_38302.question: What is the goal of the second step in registering a new SCF?
question_38302.ground_truth: The goal of the second step is to announce the availability of the new SCF and make it discoverable.

question_38305.question: What is the purpose of the MPEG Network-Based Media Processing (NBMP) specification?
question_38305.ground_truth: The NBMP specification defines data structures for describing workflows and methods for managing them to enable dynamic creation of media processing pipelines and access to processed media data and metadata in real time or in a deferred way.

question_38307.question: In what scenario is it assumed that multiple UEs involved in a multi-modal service with a flow group policy may be served by multiple PCFs?
question_38307.ground_truth: In the scenario for NEF-based coordination across multiple PCFs for multi-modal flow groups with multiple UEs (Solution #64)

question_38308.question: Which 5GS update status should the UE set to when it receives a REGISTRATION REJECT message with 5GMM cause value #2 from the AMF during a mobility and periodic registration procedure on an NGC cell?
question_38308.ground_truth: The UE should set the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED.

question_38309.question: Which procedure is applicable if the UE accesses over a Fixed Broadband Access network which is considered untrusted for NS-WLAN offloaded Traffic?
question_38309.ground_truth: Network-Initiated Dynamic PCC for S2c when accessing untrusted Fixed Broadband Access for NS-WLAN offloaded Traffic, which is the same as S2b case, which is defined in clause~7.7.

question_38310.question: What is the specification used for TLS with OAuth token in the TLS with OAuth token method?
question_38310.ground_truth: The OAuth 2.0 with authorization code grant model is used for TLS with OAuth token in the TLS with OAuth token method.

question_38311.question: What is the content type specified for HTTP bodies in the present specification?
question_38311.ground_truth: JSON (application/json) is the content type specified for HTTP bodies in the present specification.

question_38312.question: What should the NEF do after receiving a successful response from the UDM, if the NEF received from the UDM an error response with the "cause" attribute indicating an application error?
question_38312.ground_truth: The NEF shall relay this error response to the AF with a corresponding application error, when applicable.

question_38313.question: What shall the MS do when it receives a Routeing Area Update Reject (Cause) message or if the routeing area update procedure fails a maximum allowable number of times?
question_38313.ground_truth: The MS shall enter IDLE state when it receives a Routeing Area Update Reject (Cause) message or if the routeing area update procedure fails a maximum allowable number of times.

question_38314.question: What does the primary MCData content server include in its response to the MCData file retrieve request?
question_38314.ground_truth: The primary MCData content server responds with the content of the file to be retrieved and may include the lifetime of the file in the response.

question_38315.question: What is the mandatory HTTP version for SEAL APIs?

question_38317.question: What state does a mobile station enter after releasing all DBPSCHs when in MAC-DTM state?

question_38319.question: What is the result of MO Short Message control in Expected Sequence 1.3?
question_38319.ground_truth: The result is '01' which means Not Allowed.

question_38320.question: What should the MCVideo client do when receiving a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message with a matching MCVideo group ID IE in the "S6: ignoring incoming call announcements" state?
question_38320.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should store the SDP body, call identifier, originating MCVideo user ID, refresh interval, and call start time of the call, stop timer TFG5, start timer TFG5, and remain in the "S6: ignoring incoming call announcements" state.

question_38322.question: What is the formula for calculating BLER for each set of samples?
question_38322.ground_truth: The formula for calculating BLER for each set of samples is (NACK) / (ACK + NACK).

question_38323.question: What type of media can the PTC Media Type Notification event handle?
question_38323.ground_truth: The PTC Media Type Notification event can handle media types other than PTC speech, such as video, images, text, and files.

question_38324.question: What is the requirement for frequency offsets less than 1.8 MHz when the unwanted emission is measured for a single carrier in the described measurement?
question_38324.ground_truth: The unwanted emission must not exceed a mask defined by the cumulation of the spectrum due to modulation and wideband noise from each carrier and IM products.

question_38325.question: What should the UE include in the Supported header field of the REGISTER request if it supports GRUU and multiple registrations?

question_38327.question: In the asset tracking scenario described, what is the approach to ensure consistent time stamps throughout the 5G networks and slices?
question_38327.ground_truth: The 5G system uses a common time base at the monitoring API across the different network slices and 5G networks for time stamps.

question_38329.question: What are the required gNB Tx EVM for 1024QAM for different frequencies in FR1?
question_38329.ground_truth: The required gNB Tx EVM for 1024QAM for frequencies equal to or below 4.2GHz in FR1 is 2.5% and for frequencies above 4.2GHz in FR1 is 2.8%.

question_38330.question: Which protocol is used for charging reference point between MME/SGSN/IWK-SCEF and the CDF?

question_38332.question: How many Command details are present in Expected Sequence 4.5 and 4.6?
question_38332.ground_truth: There are 4 Command details in both Expected Sequence 4.5 and 4.6.

question_38333.question: What are the permitted test methods for transmission and reception tests in 5.1.1.3?
question_38333.ground_truth: The permitted test methods for transmission and reception tests in 5.1.1.3 are DFF, DFF with simplification for centre of beam measurements, IFF, and NFTF.

question_38334.question: What action does the MCPTT client take when it receives a GROUP CALL PROBE message and the MCPTT user has requested the release of the call before the TFG3 timer expires?
question_38334.ground_truth: The MCPTT client releases the call and enters the "S7: Waiting for call announcement after call release" state, without sending a GROUP CALL PROBE message at the expiry of the TFG3 timer.

question_38335.question: What mode does a mobile station leave when it is handed over to a new cell in packet transfer mode?
question_38335.ground_truth: The mobile station leaves packet transfer mode, enters packet idle mode, switches to the new cell, reads the system information, and may then resume packet transfer mode in the new cell.

question_38336.question: What state does the MCData group transition to if an imminent peril indicator is present and the MCData group is not already in the in-progress imminent peril state?
question_38336.ground_truth: The MCData group transitions to the in-progress imminent peril state until cancelled.

question_38337.question: What occurs when the UE provides an EAP-response message in a PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message?
question_38337.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message with an EAP-response message, the SMF stops timer T3590 and provides the EAP message to the DN or handles it locally.

question_38338.question: What is sent in the RADIO LINK FAILURE INDICATION message when the E-DCH non serving cell processing issue is indicated?
question_38338.ground_truth: The Cause IE is set to "Not enough user plane processing resources".

question_38339.question: What is the TAB connector defined as in the context of AAS BS radio architecture?
question_38339.ground_truth: The TAB connector is defined as a conducted requirement reference point in the AAS BS radio architecture, representing the point where a TXU or RXU connects with the RDN.

question_38341.question: What information does the SMF use to determine that all the QoS Flows of a PDU Session are rejected by the target NG-RAN during handover procedure?
question_38341.ground_truth: The SMF receives the notification from the AMF about the failed PDU Session setup.

question_38342.question: What is the concept of self-healing in SON?
question_38342.ground_truth: The concept of self-healing in SON is the ability of the network elements to automatically detect and solve problems related to the network, including issues with intra-5G and inter-RAT mobility.

question_38344.question: What channel is used for the E-HICH on one carrier?
question_38344.ground_truth: A SF16 downlink physical channel is used for the E-HICH on one carrier.

question_38345.question: What does the UPF send to the 5G core (5GC) when it detects 5GS networking timing synchronization status changes?
question_38345.ground_truth: The UPF sends reporting to the 5GC when it detects changes in the 5GS networking timing synchronization status for the original 5G GM timing source. The report contains events like recovery or degradation of the timing source and the corresponding clock class and time validity.

question_38346.question: What is the role of the SCS (Services Capability Server) in the 3GPP system?
question_38346.ground_truth: The SCS in the 3GPP system provides value-added services for MTC and performs user plane and/or control plane communication with the UE, making Tsp a control plane interface internal to the PLMN.

question_38347.question: What should the UE do if the message has been successfully integrity checked by the NAS and the message was received via 3GPP access in single-registration mode?
question_38347.ground_truth: The UE shall set the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, reset the tracking area updating attempt counter, enter the state EMM-REGISTERED, and handle the EMM parameters as specified in 3GPP TS 24.301 for the case when the normal tracking area updating procedure is rejected with the same EMM cause value.

question_38348.question: What RFC defines the "altc" attribute used to indicate alternate IP address versions in SDP offers?

question_38350.question: What is the address value of the SMS-PP Download message?
question_38350.ground_truth: The address value of the SMS-PP Download message is "1234".

question_38351.question: What happens to the UE's update status when it is operating in CS/PS mode 1 or CS/PS mode 2?
question_38351.ground_truth: The UE shall set the update status to U2 NOT UPDATED.

question_38352.question: What is the purpose of instantiating and refining the generic functional requirements in Clause 6?
question_38352.ground_truth: The purpose is to make them meaningful and applicable to all network products of the network product class.

question_38353.question: Which type of PDU is sent from an SGSN to a BSS in 5.3.11 to instruct the BSS to delete queued LLC-PDUs for a TLLI or move the queued LLC-PDUs from an old to a new BVC?

question_38355.question: In the context of the UE's maximum output power with HS-DPCCH, what is the measurement period that must be used to determine the maximum output power?
question_38355.ground_truth: The measurement period shall be at least one timeslot.

question_38356.question: What subframes are excluded from the SI-window for DL-SCH reception?
question_38356.ground_truth: Subframe #5 in radio frames for which SFN mod 2 = 0, any MBSFN subframes, and any uplink subframes in TDD.

question_38357.question: What does the SS version indicator procedures in the network procedure section entail?
question_38357.ground_truth: The SS version indicator procedures in the network procedure section state that at the establishment of layer 3 connection with the MS, the network shall check for the SS screening indicator and note, for the duration of the connection, whether the indicator was sent and its value. Based on this, the network shall decide whether to screen information sent to the MS or invoke the highest supported version of the operation towards the MS.

question_38358.question: What action does the UE take when it includes the "Authorizaton" header field in a deregistration request?
question_38358.ground_truth: By not including the "Authorization" header field in the deregistration request, the UE indicates support GPRS-IMS-Bundled authentication.

question_38359.question: How many visible satellites are available for simulation in GPS Scenario #1 defined in subclause 5.2.1.2.1 of TS 37.571-1?
question_38359.ground_truth: Visible satellites available for simulation in GPS Scenario #1 are PRNs: 2, 6, 10, 17, 18, 21, 26, 29, 30.

question_38360.question: What is the minimum and maximum number of times the "EnterSpecificCell" or "ExitSpecificCell" elements can occur within the "tCellChange" complex type, as defined in the provided XML schema?
question_38360.ground_truth: The "EnterSpecificCell" and "ExitSpecificCell" elements can each occur zero or more times (minOccurs="0" and maxOccurs="unbounded"), as defined in the schema for the "tCellChange" complex type.

question_38361.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 8.18.3, as it relates to IMS AKA algorithm and SIP default port 5060?
question_38361.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to ensure that the UE properly authenticates using GBA or Digest when activating ACR or registering to IMS.

question_38362.question: What is the minimum requirement for the modulation accuracy of a repeater in terms of Error Vector Magnitude?
question_38362.ground_truth: The Error Vector Magnitude shall not be worse than 8 %.

question_38363.question: What is the maximum number of HSDSCH-RNTI values that can be stored in the "Common-HSDSCH-RNTI-List" data structure?
question_38363.ground_truth: The maximum number of HSDSCH-RNTI values that can be stored in the "Common-HSDSCH-RNTI-List" data structure is maxNrOfCommonHRNTI.

question_38364.question: What was the primary purpose of running a rigorous codec selection process in 3GPP?
question_38364.ground_truth: The rigorous codec selection process in 3GPP aimed to choose the candidate to be standardized, cross-check submissions, request additional technical information from proponents, and maintain transparency by outlining the initial information required from the proponents.

question_38365.question: What should the gNB-CU-UP do if it receives a BEARER CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message containing a Security Indication Modify IE in the PDU Session Resource To Modify List IE for a PDU session that may result in the change of security status, but the DRBs that have been established for that PDU session are not requested to be released via the DRB To Remove List IEs?
question_38365.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP should respond with a BEARER CONTEXT MODIFICATION FAILURE message and appropriate cause value.

question_38367.question: What is the purpose of using the current handover procedure to obtain information from the target HNB/HeNB in a handover scenario?
question_38367.ground_truth: The purpose is to obtain information without impacting access control or requiring changes in the behavior of the source RAN node or the UE.

question_38368.question: What is the condition for the if statement in this code snippet?
question_38368.ground_truth: The condition for the if statement is that the maximum value in the array 'x' is less than 'tmp' and is greater than 0.

question_38369.question: What should the MCData client do if it does not have enough resources to handle an incoming SIP INVITE request?
question_38369.ground_truth: The MCData client may reject the SIP INVITE request with an appropriate reject code.

question_38370.question: What is the primary objective of the work item concerning IMS network performance in 3GPP?
question_38370.ground_truth: The primary objective is to define a set of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for IMS network performance, which are based on well-described use cases and standardized with a formula.

question_38371.question: What is the definition of a non-public network and what is its intended use?
question_38371.ground_truth: A non-public network is a network intended for non-public use.

question_38372.question: What is the applicable range for the reported RSRP in 9.1.12.1.4?
question_38372.ground_truth: The reporting range of RSRP is from -140 dBm to -44 dBm with 1 dB resolution.

question_38374.question: What is a possible motivation for two operators to share their RAN resources in a Greenfield deployment?
question_38374.ground_truth: The possible motivation is that both operators jointly agree to build out a new technology and the new shared network infrastructure and operations can be based on capacity and coverage requirements of both operators.

question_38375.question: What should the initiating UE do upon receiving a PROSE DIRECT LINK REKEYING REQUEST message that includes a Re-authentication indication?
question_38375.ground_truth: The initiating UE should pass the PROSE DIRECT LINK REKEYING REQUEST message to the lower layers for transmission along with its own layer-2 ID for unicast communication and the target UE's layer-2 ID for unicast communication. The UE should then start timer T5091 and should not send a new PROSE DIRECT LINK REKEYING REQUEST message to the same target UE while timer T5091 is running.

question_38376.question: What is the function of Discontinuous Transmission (DTX) in GSM mobile communications?
question_38376.ground_truth: The function of DTX is to save power by not transmitting when there is no speech activity.

question_38377.question: What is the purpose of the UE-CapabilityRAT-RequestList?
question_38377.ground_truth: The UE-CapabilityRAT-RequestList is used to request UE capabilities for one or more RATs from the UE.

question_38378.question: What is the measurement provided by the "5.1.1.6.6.9 Number of successful conditional handover executions" metric?
question_38378.ground_truth: The number of successful conditional handover executions received by the source gNB.

question_38380.question: When does the IWF sends IWF group call response to the MCPTT server in an encrypted group call with transcoding?
question_38380.ground_truth: After the IWF receives and decrypts the voice media from the MCPTT client, transcodes it to a LMR codec, re-encrypts it if necessary, and forwards it to the LMR system.

question_38381.question: What is the objective of the Monte-carlo simulations involved in the co-existence study between UMTS and GSM in the 3GPP UMTS system?
question_38381.ground_truth: The objective of the Monte-carlo simulations is to determine the appropriate UMTS BS & UE RF system parameters, Spectrum mask, ACLR (Adjacent Channel power Leakage Ratio), ACS (Adjacent Channel Selectivity), receiver narrow band blocking, etc. for ensuring the good co-existence of UMTS and GSM in the 3GPP UMTS system.

question_38383.question: What happens if the re-authentication of the user is not successful in the STa Re-Authentication procedure?
question_38383.ground_truth: If the re-authentication of the user is not successful, the trusted non-3GPP access network will release all the active PDN connections of the user, except for emergency PDN connections.

question_38384.question: What is the role of ICE in an MCPTT pre-established session?
question_38384.ground_truth: ICE (Interactive Connectivity Establishment) is a technique for traversing network address translators and firewalls to establish peer-to-peer media sessions. In an MCPTT pre-established session, ICE is used to gather and exchange ICE candidates between the MCPTT UE and the media resource function gateway.

question_38385.question: What should the MS do when timer T3319 is running and it receives a Service Request with service type "data"?
question_38385.ground_truth: The MS should not issue the service request unless the flag in the Uplink data status IE has not been set in the last Service Request for the same PDP context.

question_38386.question: What is the effect on the C/Ic threshold when the reference threshold BER increases by 2 dB?
question_38386.ground_truth: The C/Ic threshold increases by the same amount, 2 dB.

question_38387.question: What should the MCData client include in the SIP URI of the SIP REFER request when sending a one-to-one standalone SDS message?
question_38387.ground_truth: The MCData client should include an application/sdp MIME body containing an SDP offer with media attributes in the SIP URI of the SIP REFER request when sending a one-to-one standalone SDS message.

question_38388.question: What is the role of the P-GW in step~2 of the procedure?
question_38388.ground_truth: In step~2, the P-GW is informed of the 3GPP PS Data Off status based on the solution for key issue 1.

question_38390.question: What is the source device and the command type of the first PROACTIVE COMMAND in the sequence 1.1?
question_38390.ground_truth: The source device is SIM, and the command type is SEND DATA.

question_38391.question: In the procedure for testing the UE's CQI reporting and HS-PDSCH BLER performance, what is the condition for passing the UE in step 8?
question_38391.ground_truth: The condition for passing the UE in step 8 is if the ratio ( NACK / ACK + NACK) < 0.1.

question_38392.question: What is the purpose of the Test Management Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_38392.ground_truth: The Test Management IRP within the 3GPP technical specification focuses on defining the semantics of information and interactions across the interface (Itf-N) between the managing system (manager) and the managed system (agent) in a protocol-independent manner. It does not specify the syntax of the information.

question_38393.question: What is the purpose of describing deployment scenarios in the NR study?
question_38393.ground_truth: The purpose of describing deployment scenarios in the NR study is to provide guidelines for designing the radio interface protocols for the New Radio Access Technology based on different scenarios such as cell layout, CN-RAN connection, inter-RAT mobility, and WLAN integration.

question_38395.question: Which subclause of 3GPP TS 04.08 and 3GPP TS 24.008 specifies the requirements for the MS to send a CHANNEL REQUEST message with establishment cause "emergency call" when initiating an emergency call?
question_38395.ground_truth: Subclause 3.3.1.1 of 3GPP TS 04.08 and subclause 5.2.1 of 3GPP TS 24.008.

question_38396.question: What is the basis for the responding 5G ProSe End UE to select a new 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay in the negotiated 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay reselection procedure?
question_38396.ground_truth: The responding 5G ProSe End UE selects a new 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay based on the Relay re-selection indication in the Link Modification Request message.

question_38398.question: What is the condition for the SS to increase the number of successes for the event "Activation" in the test procedure?
question_38398.ground_truth: The SS increases the number of successes for the event "Activation" if a CSI report with a non-zero CQI index is received for the SCell earlier than or equal to a specific subframe or next available uplink resource and DTX in PCell is not observed in certain subframes up to the end of T2.

question_38401.question: What is the goal of synchronous federated learning in "Flocking"?
question_38401.ground_truth: In synchronous federated learning, the goal is to eliminate bias and allow diverse users and devices to participate, ensuring diversity in input data and avoiding a focus on only the "best performing devices."

question_38403.question: When can the location updating procedure be started?
question_38403.ground_truth: The location updating procedure can be started during an RR connection and under specific conditions, such as after network connection request has been rejected, during network operation mode I or II, after a manual network selection, or after entering a new routing area.

question_38405.question: What is the definition of "Carrier aggregation" as provided in the document?
question_38405.ground_truth: Carrier aggregation is the aggregation of two or more component carriers in order to support wider transmission bandwidths.

question_38406.question: Under what conditions should the UE stop receiving DL MAC PDUs as per stored SPS assignment in the DL SPS when the MAC entity has a CS-RNTI?
question_38406.ground_truth: When the UE receives a DL assignment addressed to its stored CS-RNTI in a slot with NDI set as 0 and the PDCCH content indicates deactivation.

question_38408.question: What should the UE do when it receives MBS decision set to "MBS join is rejected" for TMGI-1 with a non-zero back-off timer value?
question_38408.ground_truth: UE shall start a back-off timer T3587 with the value provided in the MBS back-off timer value for TMGI-1, and shall not attempt to join the MBS session with TMGI-1 until the expiry of T3587.

question_38409.question: In what situations should the SidelinkUEInformationNR message be transmitted to indicate the UE no longer requires NR sidelink non-relay discovery message resources?
question_38409.ground_truth: The SidelinkUEInformationNR message should be transmitted if the UE is not required to transmit NR sidelink non-relay discovery messages and the last transmission of the SidelinkUEInformationNR message included sl-TxResourceReqListDisc.

question_38410.question: What should the AMF do when it receives the REGISTRATION REQUEST message with a protocol error during the initial registration procedure?
question_38410.ground_truth: The AMF should return a REGISTRATION REJECT message with one of the 5GMM cause values: #96 (invalid mandatory information), #99 (information element non-existent or not implemented), #100 (conditional IE error), or #111 (protocol error, unspecified).

question_38411.question: What happens during a paging procedure for a UE using USIM1 and if the UE using USIM2 is in CM-Connected state?
question_38411.ground_truth: The AMF may provide in the Paging request message the UE identifier of the other USIM registration (e.g. USIM2 UE ID) which allows NG-RAN to schedule the radio resources USIM2's transmissions in such that the UE using USIM1 is able to receive the Paging message.

question_38412.question: What is the requirement for the 5G system to support service continuity for a remote UE in the context of changing from a direct network connection to an indirect network connection?
question_38412.ground_truth: The 5G system shall support service continuity for a remote UE, when the remote UE changes from one relay UE to another and both relay UEs use 3GPP access to the 5G core network.

question_38413.question: What is one of the cons of Solution 2 for SGW failure?
question_38413.ground_truth: One of the cons of Solution 2 for SGW failure is the extra signalling introduced in the network, which includes extra signalling over S3 to request the ISR associated mobility management node to select the same SGW to maintain ISR activated for each affected UE due to SGW restart or failure, and extra signalling over S5/Gx to report the RAT change during re-activate ISR.

question_38414.question: What is the maximum bit rate for MAC-d flow#1 when using Streaming or interactive or background for DL?
