question_39120.question: What is the definition of the cell reselection delay to a lower priority E-UTRAN cell in this test?
question_39120.ground_truth: The time from the beginning of time period T1, to the moment when the UE camps on cell 2, and starts to send preambles on the PRACH for sending the RRC CONNECTION REQUEST message to perform a Tracking Area Update procedure on cell 2.

question_39122.question: What is the minimum bandwidth requirement to achieve the relative positioning accuracy of 1m@90% (Set A) in IIoT use case for InF-SH scenario for at least 5 sources?

question_39123.question: What is the main trigger for GPRS/EGPRS cell reselection?
question_39123.ground_truth: One important trigger for GPRS/EGPRS cell reselection is failure to reconfirm the serving cell.

question_39124.question: Which 3GPP Releases and work items are related to the enhancements of 3GPP Northbound Interfaces and APIs?
question_39124.ground_truth: The related CRs include TS 24.558, TS 29.122, TS 29.222, TS 29.257, TS 29.486, TS 29.522, and TS 29.549, all of which were approved in various TSGs.

question_39125.question: What is the purpose of the Bootstrapping Server Function (BSF) in the 3GPP Generic Bootstrapping Architecture (GBA)?
question_39125.ground_truth: The Bootstrapping Server Function (BSF) is a GBA specific network function that resides in the home MNO of the user. It facilitates the use of AKA to bootstrap a new GBA master session key named Ks.

question_39126.question: What is the format of the Decorated NAI when the username part includes the IMSI and the service provider has a PLMN ID?
question_39126.ground_truth: The format of the Decorated NAI is 'nai.epc.mnc<homeMNC>.mcc<homeMCC>.3gppnetwork.org !0<IMSI>@nai.epc.mnc<visitedMNC>.mcc<visitedMCC>.3gppnetwork.org' or 'nai.epc.mnc<homeMNC>.mcc<homeMCC>.3gppnetwork.org !6<IMSI>@nai.epc.mnc<visitedMNC>.mcc<visitedMCC>.3gppnetwork.org'

question_39127.question: What standard is the basis for defining the JSON schema of the body of CoAP requests in 7.3.1 of the 3GPP TS 24.546?
question_39127.ground_truth: JSON Schema Draft-07 is the basis for defining the JSON schema of the body of CoAP requests in 7.3.1 of the 3GPP TS 24.546.

question_39129.question: What is the mobile transmit and base receive frequency range for GSM 450?
question_39129.ground_truth: 450.4 MHz to 457.6 MHz for mobile transmit, and 460.4 MHz to 467.6 MHz for base receive.

question_39130.question: Which event is generated at the MMS Proxy-Relay when the MMS Proxy-Relay sends a Retrieve.conf PDU to the target in response to a MMS retrieval request?
question_39130.ground_truth: The MMS Retrieval report event is generated at the MMS Proxy-Relay when the MMS Proxy-Relay sends a Retrieve.conf PDU to the target in response to a MMS retrieval request.

question_39131.question: Which document defines the Tunnel Endpoint Identifier (TEID) in 3GPP?

question_39132.question: What are two of the specifications that the MCPTT unicast media start and stop capability has been enhanced in for the MCPTT service in Release 17?
question_39132.ground_truth: The two specifications that the MCPTT unicast media start and stop capability has been enhanced in for the MCPTT service in Release 17 are TS~22.179 and TS~24.379.

question_39133.question: What type of NR RedCap UEs does clause 17.5.2.9.2 apply to starting from Release 17?
question_39133.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UEs from Release 17 onwards that support pdcch-MonitoringAnyOccasions or pdcch-MonitoringAnyOccasionsWithSpanGap.

question_39134.question: What should the information bit data be for the test environment?
question_39134.ground_truth: The information bit data should be pseudo-random and not repeated before 10 different information bit payload blocks are processed.

question_39135.question: What are some security measures implemented in the NFVI to ensure data protection?
question_39135.ground_truth: The NFVI ensures data protection by encrypting data at rest and in transit, and by using a hardware-mediated execution enclave (HMEE) for secure code execution and data protection.

question_39138.question: What security measures could help minimize the impact of hypervisor and VM breakouts in a network function virtualization infrastructure (NFVI)?
question_39138.ground_truth: The NFVI should provide security isolation to minimize the impact of a hypervisor or VM breakout, and solutions for these requirements are expected to be handled outside of 3GPP. Regular patching of the NFVI and VNFs can also help maintain network security.

question_39139.question: What information should eNB1 include in the HANDOVER REPORT message if a completed handover from a cell of eNB2 to a cell in another RAT resulted in an inter-RAT ping-pong and the UE was successfully handed over to a cell of eNB1?
question_39139.ground_truth: eNB1 should include the Failure cell ECGI IE in the HANDOVER REPORT message to indicate the ECGI of the cell where the re-establishment was successful.

question_39140.question: What functionality does RFC 9220 define in the context of the HTTP/3 protocol?
question_39140.ground_truth: RFC 9220 defines support for the Extended CONNECT functionality in the HTTP/3 protocol.

question_39142.question: What triggers the MCVideo client to send a MCVideo communication parameter update request in on-network?
question_39142.ground_truth: The MCVideo client sends a MCVideo communication parameter update request in on-network due to network conditions changes detected, such as packet loss or packet delay.

question_39144.question: What are the two cells in this test described in section 4.5.1.2.4?
question_39144.ground_truth: Cell 1, which is the E-UTRAN PCell, and Cell 2, which is the PSCell.

question_39145.question: What actions does an entitled dispatcher have the ability to perform to terminate a call?
question_39145.ground_truth: An entitled dispatcher can terminate the call at any time by using a network defined user operation (e.g. via DTMF).

question_39146.question: What message type is sent by the WT to the eNB to report the results of the requested measurements?

question_39147.question: When is the GPRS attach attempt counter reset?
question_39147.ground_truth: The GPRS attach attempt counter is reset in several situations, such as when the MS is powered on, a SIM/USIM is inserted, a GPRS attach or combined GPRS attach procedure is successfully completed, or a new PLMN is selected.

question_39148.question: In off-network floor control, how do floor participants request talk permission when no specific floor control server exists?
question_39148.ground_truth: In off-network, floor participants request talk permission by sending a Floor Request message to all group members. After a well-defined waiting period, if no response is received, the floor participant sends a Floor Taken message indicating itself in the information element which expresses the group member to which this talk permission is given, and continues the talk burst.

question_39149.question: What is the purpose of the test procedure step 1?
question_39149.ground_truth: The purpose of step 1 in the test procedure is to ensure that the UE is in the correct state before starting the test.

question_39151.question: What are the conditions for the UE to perform an initial emergency registration as per TS 24.229, clause 10.9.3.1?
question_39151.ground_truth: The UE should be in test state 1N-A and registered to IMS. The IP-CAN should define emergency bearers and the core network should have indicated that it supports emergency bearers.

question_39155.question: What should a UE do when it fails to access the network due to abnormal cases c), d), or e) in subclause~5.5.1.2.7 and it is in the same selected PLMN or SNPN where the last initial registration request was attempted and the PDU session does not need to be established due to handover of an existing PDN connection for emergency bearer services?
question_39155.ground_truth: It should inform the upper layers of the failure of the procedure and attempt initial registration for emergency services.

question_39158.question: What was the conclusion of the verification laboratory regarding the Eaac+ decoder's source code?
question_39158.ground_truth: The verification laboratory concluded that they are confident that the source code of the Eaac+ decoder can serve as a bit-exact reference of the algorithm, and the instrumentation of the source code conforms to the expectation of a 3GPP reference source code.

question_39160.question: In what scenarios would interception be activated during an ongoing IMS conference call?
question_39160.ground_truth: Interception can be activated during an ongoing IMS conference call when a conference or a conference owner is targeted for interception.

question_39161.question: What is the goal of the security requirements in section 5.6.1.3 for MCVideo?
question_39161.ground_truth: The goal is to ensure that the MCVideo service is secure when providing the service on-network, off-network, through group key management, and during data communication between MCVideo network entities.

question_39163.question: What is the purpose of using different puncturing patterns for the header and data part in a fourtet of timeslots?
question_39163.ground_truth: The purpose is to enable better error detection for slightly longer blocks while maintaining the same code rate as the old format for the data part.

question_39166.question: What is the test requirement for the multi-band RIB in the context of general narrowband intermodulation test requirement?
question_39166.ground_truth: For multi-band RIBs, the narrowband intermodulation requirement applies in addition inside any Inter RF Bandwidth gap, in case the gap size is at least as wide as the E-UTRA interfering signal. The interfering signal offset is defined relative to the Base Station RF Bandwidth edges inside the Inter RF Bandwidth gap.

question_39167.question: What is the minimum uplink class supporting conversational speech in the uplink and 64 kbps in the downlink?
question_39167.ground_truth: UL: 64 kbps, DL on DPCH: 32 kbps plus support of HS-PDSCH and support of E-DCH, HS-PDSCH: category 11, E-DCH: category 1.

question_39168.question: What does the UE-to-UE Relay in the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery Solicitation message not include in the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery Response?
question_39168.ground_truth: The UE-to-UE Relay does not include the User Info ID of the discoveree 5G ProSe End UE in the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery Response.

question_39169.question: What is the subcounter that contains the number of MA PDU sessions created by the SMF, and the measurement is obtained by sampling at a pre-defined interval the number of MA PDU sessions established by SMF, and then taking the arithmetic mean?

question_39170.question: In the context of 2TS EC-RACH Mapping, what should the EC PACKET CHANNEL REQUEST messages sent across 2 timeslots be in order to comply with the 3GPP TS 44.018 standard?
question_39170.ground_truth: The EC PACKET CHANNEL REQUEST messages sent across 2 timeslots on the EC-RACH should be identical and should use the same training sequence code, selected from TS5, TS6, or TS7 based on the uplink component carrier.

question_39171.question: What is the difference between Transmitter ON state and Transmitter OFF state?
question_39171.ground_truth: The Transmitter ON state refers to the time period during which the repeater is transmitting downlink or uplink signals in the corresponding direction, while the Transmitter OFF state is the time period during which the repeater downlink or uplink is not allowed to transmit in the corresponding direction.

question_39172.question: What procedure is used to verify that the MS sends its multislot class in Mobile Station Classmark 3 using Controlled Early Classmark Sending procedure if allowed by network?
question_39172.ground_truth: The Controlled Early Classmark Sending procedure is tested by making the MS initiate a multislot connection while the network indicates whether the procedure is allowed or not. The SS then checks the reception of the CLASSMARK CHANGE message to determine if Early Classmark sending was properly performed.

question_39173.question: What is the function of the "Set BTS Attributes" message in the "Air Interface Management Messages" category?
question_39173.ground_truth: The "Set BTS Attributes" message is used to set various attributes of a BTS (Base Transceiver Station), such as interference level boundaries and load thresholds.

question_39174.question: What is the purpose of the communication recording system in FRMCS?
question_39174.ground_truth: The communication recording system in FRMCS provides means to record communication and communication-related information for voice, video, and data services. The recording includes FRMCS user identities, functional identities, and location information of all involved users.

question_39175.question: When should a UE select a TAI?
question_39175.ground_truth: A UE should select a TAI when it receives multiple TACs from the lower layers or when it has received multiple TACs from the lower layers upon starting to camp on the current cell and the registration area, and the list of allowed tracking areas is updated.

question_39176.question: What happens if there is no WLAN that matches the WLANSP rule(s) from the H-ANDSF, and at least one WLAN matching one or more groups of selection criteria in the WLANSP rule of the HPLMN becomes available?
question_39176.ground_truth: The UE should re-use the WLANSP policies and Inter-system Routing Policies from H-ANDSF.

question_39179.question: What should the UE include in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message when it is performing the PDU session modification procedure to request an always-on PDU session in the 5GS?
question_39179.ground_truth: The UE should include the Always-on PDU session requested IE in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message when it is performing the PDU session modification procedure to request an always-on PDU session in the 5GS.

question_39181.question: What can be used to achieve replay protection in a TBS?
question_39181.ground_truth: Having recipient unique tickets and a replay counter, or having the receiving end modify the ticket's master key in a (pseudo-)random way before it is used for media protection.

question_39182.question: What happens in the SRNS Relocation procedure when using two CN nodes?
question_39182.ground_truth: The source SRNC sends Relocation Required messages to both CN nodes, and when the preparation is completed, the CN node conveys a Relocation Request message to the target RNC. The targets RNC and CN node establish new Iu transport bearers, and when both the source RNC and the target RNC have completed their preparation phase, a Relocation Command message is sent to the source RNC. Upon receiving Relocation Command messages from all CN nodes, the source RNC sends a Relocation Commit message to the target RNC to request the target RNC to proceed with the Relocation.

question_39183.question: How many GINs can be supported per cell in a SNPN?
question_39183.ground_truth: The maximum number of GINs that can be supported per cell in a SNPN is 24.

question_39184.question: What is the role of the CAT server in the IMS multimedia CAT implementation?
question_39184.ground_truth: In the IMS (IP Multimedia Subsystem) environment, a CAT server can be implemented as a CAT Application Server (AS) and Multimedia Resource Function (MRF) to play multimedia CATs.

question_39185.question: What is the role of the H-PCRF in handling a GW control session during S2c-based IP flow mobility, in the case where the UE is not roaming?
question_39185.ground_truth: The H-PCRF stores the information received in the Diameter CCR, derives PCC rules for the PCEF and QoS rules for the BBERF(s), based on the BCM mode of the GW control session, and initiates a Gateway Control and QoS Rules Provision procedure by sending a Diameter RAR.

question_39187.question: What is the definition of "spurious emission" as per ITU-R SM 329?
question_39187.ground_truth: Spurious emission is an emission on a frequency, or frequencies, which are outside the necessary bandwidth and the level of which may be reduced without affecting the corresponding transmission of information.

question_39188.question: What is the impact of joining a chat group call model on existing MCPTT clients?
question_39188.ground_truth: Once an MCPTT client successfully joins a group call which is using the chat model, the MCPTT client connects to the media plane for the call if the call is currently ongoing. If the call is not ongoing, the newly joined MCPTT client will only have pre-established its media parameters for the call.

question_39189.question: What is the middle frequency of the operating band for base stations?
question_39189.ground_truth: M is the appropriate frequency in the middle of the operating band of the BS.

question_39191.question: What action does the UE (MCPTT Client) take when the MCPTT user requests the establishment of an MCPTT emergency group call in an off-network environment?
question_39191.ground_truth: The UE (MCPTT Client) requests an MCPTT emergency group call by sending a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message and respects the floor control imposed by the floor control entity/arbitrator.

question_39192.question: How many MS modes of operation are supported for Iu mode?
question_39192.ground_truth: Three MS modes of operation are supported for Iu mode: A PS/CS mode of operation, a PS mode of operation, and a CS mode of operation, however the CS mode of operation is out of scope in the present document.

question_39194.question: What should the BM-SC do when it detects a non-transient SGmb path failure and the MBMS session was activated by a Group Communication Service Application Server(s)?
question_39194.ground_truth: The BM-SC should notify the GCS AS that the MBMS session has been deactivated.

question_39195.question: Which frequency (ARFCN) does cell B use in GSM900, DCS1800, GSM700, and GSM850?
question_39195.ground_truth: Cell B has BCCH ARFCN = 40 (GSM900), 764 (DCS1800), 477 (GSM700), and 167 (GSM850).

question_39196.question: In the NR SA FR2 event-triggered reporting with gap in DRX test, what is the overall delays measured in Test 2 for UE supporting power class 2, 3 or 4?
question_39196.ground_truth: The overall delays measured in Test 2 for UE supporting power class 2, 3 or 4 is up to 30722 ms.

question_39197.question: What is Trusted Boot (TB) in HV and how does it differ from Secure Boot?
question_39197.ground_truth: Trusted Boot (TB) is a validation process in HV that occurs in stages, similar to Autonomous Validation. However, Trusted Boot involves network validation and verification in addition to local validation during the boot process. Secure Boot, on the other hand, performs only local validation during the boot process and does not involve network validation.

question_39199.question: What is the short range communication in the 3GPP system used for in wearable device communication?
question_39199.ground_truth: The short range communication in the 3GPP system is used for the wearable device to access the 3GPP network directly or via an authorized UE when the two UEs are within a short range.

question_39200.question: What does the QoS-Capability grouped AVP include in the 3GPP AAA protocol?
question_39200.ground_truth: The QoS-Capability grouped AVP includes a list of supported Quality of Service profiles. The QoS-Profile sub-AVP shall have Vendor-ID and Specifier fields set to default value 0 (zero).

question_39201.question: What is the purpose of the test in 8.2.2.2.4?
question_39201.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the UE meets the minimum requirement by monitoring neighboring cells on 2 carriers and performing a first location registration procedure.

question_39204.question: What should the SMF perform if it receives a negative notification response from the AF in Clause 10-11?
question_39204.ground_truth: The SMF may stop the procedure if it receives a negative notification response from the AF in Clause 10-11.

question_39209.question: What should a UE do when it receives a DL assignment with NDI set as 0, indicating activation, and the assigned slot is different from the current slot for receiving DL MAC PDU in the same UL grant TTI?
question_39209.ground_truth: The UE should start receiving DL MAC PDU in the assigned slot and stop receiving in the current slot.

question_39211.question: What should the IWF, performing the originating participating role, include in the Contact header field of the SIP INVITE request?
question_39211.ground_truth: The IWF, performing the originating participating role, should include the g.3gpp.mcptt media feature tag and the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag containing the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt" in the Contact header field of the SIP INVITE request.

question_39212.question: What date and time information does a fileFooter XML element carry?
question_39212.ground_truth: A fileFooter XML element carries the date and time the XML file was assembled.

question_39213.question: What is the procedure followed to verify that the MS implements the AMR Thresholds and Hysteresis parameters correctly?
question_39213.ground_truth: The SS verifies the correct implementation of the AMR Thresholds and Hysteresis parameters by testing the MS implementation under TUHigh and frequency hopping propagation conditions without DTX.

question_39214.question: What does the phrase "might indicate" imply in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
question_39214.ground_truth: In the context of 3GPP technical specifications, the phrase "might indicate" implies a likelihood that something will happen as a result of action taken by some agency the behavior of which is outside the scope of the present document.

question_39215.question: What is the format of the EAP message consisting of the EAP-response message from network?
question_39215.ground_truth: The EAP message consisting of the EAP-response message from network is in hexadecimal format, as defined in IETF RFC 3748, RFC 4187, and RFC 5448. This parameter shall not be subject to conventional character conversion as per +CSCS.

question_39217.question: What does the ETSI ES 202 396-1 standard specify in relation to acoustic testing of terminals?
question_39217.ground_truth: ETSI ES 202 396-1 specifies a background noise simulation technique and background noise database for speech quality performance in the presence of background noise.

question_39218.question: What information does the SGW include in S5 messages during PDN connection establishment and other procedures?
question_39218.ground_truth: The SGW includes the mapped UE Usage Type, location information, and APN in S5 messages during PDN connection establishment. For other procedures, it will decide during the normative work.

question_39219.question: What is the purpose of the transmitter intermodulation requirement in a non-AAS BS, and how is it applied in an AAS BS?
question_39219.ground_truth: The transmitter intermodulation requirement in a non-AAS BS addresses the coexistence between transmitters from different operators, assuming equal power levels and adjacent signals in the frequency domain. In an AAS BS, this requirement is applied to each TAB connector at the transceiver array boundary.

question_39221.question: When does the UE supporting IPv6 indicate support for multi-homed IPv6 PDU session?
question_39221.ground_truth: The UE indicates support for multi-homed IPv6 PDU session during UE-requested PDU session establishment of a PDU session of "IPv6" or "IPv4v6" PDU session type, and during UE-requested PDU session modification performed after an inter-system change under certain conditions.

question_39222.question: Which existing feature is currently being used to partly cover the use case functionality?
question_39222.ground_truth: The Proximity Service (ProSe) services as defined in 3GPP TS 23.303 are currently being used to partly cover the use case functionality.

question_39223.question: What message is sent from the new SGSN to the target RNC to indicate that the necessary resources for the accepted RABs have been allocated?

question_39224.question: What is the effect of reaching the NAF-key life time in a GPL session?
question_39224.ground_truth: When the NAF-key life time is reached in a GPL session, the GPL-session is over and the corresponding NAF SA, downlink GPL-SA, and uplink GPL-SA (if it exists) shall be deleted.

question_39225.question: What types of measurement are defined in subclause 4.9.2 for radio link setups on Iub?
question_39225.ground_truth: The types of measurement defined in subclause 4.9.2 for radio link setups on Iub are: Attempted radio link setups on Iub, Successful radio link setups on Iub, and Failed radio link setups on Iub.

question_39226.question: What is the role of the AN-TL or CN-TL when sending a get-response in the process of transferring a TL-Container?
question_39226.ground_truth: The AN-TL or CN-TL sends a get-response to indicate the elements of the Talker or Listener group such as EndStationInterfaces, InterfaceCapabilities, and Buffer capability.

question_39227.question: What is the MCVideo group ID used for in the off-network MCVideo communication procedure?
question_39227.ground_truth: The MCVideo group ID is used to identify the target group and the discovery group ID in the off-network MCVideo communication procedure.

question_39228.question: What is the length of a PDU set in TS 23.501?
question_39228.ground_truth: A PDU set consists of one or more PDUs carrying the payload of a unit of information generated at the application level, such as frames or video slices for XR Services, as defined in TS 23.501.

question_39229.question: What action must the UE (MCData Client) take when it has been requested to de-affiliate from an MCData group by the MCData User?
question_39229.ground_truth: The UE (MCData Client) must send a SIP PUBLISH message to the SS (MCData Server) to request de-affiliation from the MCData group.

question_39230.question: What are the power levels of the interferers ICoCh2, IAdjCh1, and IAWGN set relative to in the test procedure?
question_39230.ground_truth: The power levels of the interferers ICoCh2, IAdjCh1, and IAWGN are set relative to ICoCh1 in the test procedure.

question_39231.question: What is the responsibility of the IWF in the group regroup process with the MC system?
question_39231.ground_truth: The IWF is responsible for receiving the IWF group regroup request, providing an IWF group regroup response, notifying the group management server regarding the temporary group creation, and handling the translation between temporary group identities and the original interworking group identities used on the LMR system.

question_39232.question: How many options are there for obtaining the operator root certificate in the CMPv2 protocol run?
question_39232.ground_truth: There are two options: Option 1 (provisioning the operator root certificate in the NE prior to the CMPv2 protocol run) and Option 2 (provisioning the operator root certificate in the NE during the CMPv2 protocol run).

question_39233.question: What is the string representation of a video codec information in the context of the 3GPP-QoE-Metrics?
question_39233.ground_truth: The string representation of a video codec information in the context of the 3GPP-QoE-Metrics is "profile=0;level=45" for the profile and level information and "176x144" for the image size.

question_39236.question: What measure should the Mission Critical Service provide to ensure the integrity of all user signalling at the application layer?
question_39236.ground_truth: The Mission Critical Service should provide a means to ensure the integrity of all user signalling at the application layer as per MCSEC-1.4-1.

question_39237.question: What is the main difference between the two MIMO design options described in sections 5.3.2.1 and 5.3.2.2?
question_39237.ground_truth: The main difference is that in option 1, there are two HARQ processes in the same TTI, while in option 2, there is a single HARQ process in the same TTI. Also, the number of E-DCH transport channels in option 1 is one, while in option 2, it is also one, but there are two separate interleaving/physical channel mapping stages.

question_39238.question: How many information bits are there in an access burst for 8 data bit packet access on PRACH and MPRACH?
question_39238.ground_truth: There are 8 information bits in an access burst for 8 data bit packet access on PRACH and MPRACH.

question_39239.question: What is the maximum level of spurious emissions allowed for a base transceiver station (BTS), as measured in dBm after any filters and combiners at an offset from the carrier?
question_39239.ground_truth: The maximum level allowed for a BTS is -36 dBm, or whichever is higher.

question_39240.question: What are the intra-frequency relative RSRP measurement accuracy requirements for discovery signal occasions?
question_39240.ground_truth: The intra-frequency relative RSRP measurement accuracy requirements for discovery signal occasions are the same as those specified in Section 9.1.2.2 of the document.

question_39241.question: What is the measurement provided by the 5GS NEF for each failed background data transfer policy deletion?
question_39241.ground_truth: Each message incrementing the relevant subcounter per failure cause by 1, where each subcounter is an integer value.

question_39242.question: What is the channel spacing in UTRA/FDD?
question_39242.ground_truth: The nominal channel spacing is 5 MHz, but this can be adjusted to optimize performance in a particular deployment scenario.

question_39243.question: What is a pre-condition for the French lead driver to initiate point-to-point communication using Real-Time Speech to Speech translation?
question_39243.ground_truth: The French lead driver must be authorized to initiate point-to-point communications and both drivers must have selected their roles to enable point-to-point communications.

question_39244.question: What is the default Number Plan Identification (NPI) if all the digits are in the range 0-9?
question_39244.ground_truth: The default NPI shall be ITU-T E.164 if all the digits are in the range 0-9.

question_39245.question: What is one of the potential requirements for the 3GPP system to support platooning applications in vehicles?
question_39245.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall be able to provide V2X applications with supported QoS information, regardless of whether a UE related to the V2X application is in coverage of a 3GPP radio access network or not.

question_39246.question: What is the purpose of the sub-picture-level HRD operation in H.265 (HEVC)?
question_39246.ground_truth: The sub-picture-level HRD operation in H.265 (HEVC) is for support of ultralow delay, which specifies a standard-compliant way to enable delay reduction below one picture interval.

question_39247.question: What bandwidth should the UE meet for PRS bandwidth in case of PCell changing while performing RSTD measurements?
question_39247.ground_truth: The UE shall meet the RSTD measurement accuracy for a PRS bandwidth which is not larger than the minimum channel bandwidth of those PCell/SCell(s) on whose carriers RSTD measurement is performed during the RSTD measurement period.

question_39249.question: When must the UE generate an SDP offer upon receiving an INVITE request in section 7.10?
question_39249.ground_truth: The UE must generate an SDP offer if the INVITE request does not include the "precondition" option-tag in the Supported header field and the Require header field, and the IP-CAN performs network-initiated resource reservation for the UE.

question_39250.question: What action does the NAS take if the UE is operating in dual-registration mode and an access attempt is barred due to an MO-MMTEL-voice-call-started indication or similar events?
question_39250.ground_truth: The UE may proceed in S1 mode with the appropriate EMM specific procedures and ESM procedures to make a PDN connection providing access to IMS available.

question_39251.question: When do the inter-frequency absolute RSRP measurement accuracy requirements in discovery signal occasions apply?
question_39251.ground_truth: The inter-frequency absolute RSRP measurement accuracy requirements in discovery signal occasions apply to a cell or TP on a different carrier frequency from that of the serving cell.

question_39253.question: Which UTRAN cells are valid for the "RLM.AttRLDelIur" and "RLM.SuccRLDelIur" measurements?
question_39253.ground_truth: Only UTRAN cells in FDD mode are valid for the "RLM.AttRLDelIur" and "RLM.SuccRLDelIur" measurements.

question_39254.question: What is the main reason for the shift in the US medical device industry from traditional business models to value-based healthcare models?
question_39254.ground_truth: The main reason for this shift is the prioritization of cost effectiveness and cost efficiency by regulators, hospital administrators, and other non-clinicians, as traditional business models based on innovation have resulted in healthcare systems paying for quantity rather than quality.

question_39260.question: Which IE provides the list of E-RNTIs which can be allocated by CRNC in the context of TS 25.214?
question_39260.ground_truth: The E-RNTI List IE provides the list of E-RNTIs which can be allocated by CRNC in the context of TS 25.214.

question_39262.question: What is the purpose of the test "ndom Access Test for 2 SCells"?
question_39262.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that the user equipment's (UE) behavior of the random access procedure for the two secondary cells (SCell1 and SCell2) meets the requirements of the E-UTRAN TDD non-contention based random access in an additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) model. It also checks that the power settings and timing for the physical random access channel (PRACH) for the SCells are within the specified limits.

question_39263.question: What is the procedure for implicit fallback in an ongoing IM session supporting telepresence?
question_39263.ground_truth: Implicit fallback occurs in an ongoing IM session supporting telepresence if there is a network event leading to CLUE message transmission failure. In this case, the session can fall back to a normal IM session. There are four possible ways to handle an ongoing IM session that has fallen back implicitly, including re-establishing the CLUE data channel, resetting the SCTP streams associated with the CLUE data channel, falling back to a normal IM session, or terminating the session.

question_39264.question: How is the first set of input parameters used in the detection of abnormal NF behavior?
question_39264.ground_truth: The first set of input parameters provided by the NFs (NF/NRF) and inputs from OAM to NWDAF is used to assist in the detection of abnormal NF behavior in the 5G system.

question_39265.question: What are the disadvantages of placing the expiration time functionality in the UE?
question_39265.ground_truth: Placing the expiration time functionality in the UE has disadvantages such as requiring duplicate supervision by MME/SGSN/MSC, potential issues with getting the expiration time to the UE, difficulty in precisely monitoring absolute time, race conditions, and unnecessary signaling.

question_39266.question: In what situations would a UE initiate the match report procedure for open ProSe direct discovery?
question_39266.ground_truth: A UE would initiate the match report procedure for open ProSe direct discovery in one of the following situations: when it receives a ProSe Application Code from lower layers and does not have a corresponding ProSe Application ID stored, when it has a stored mapping for the ProSe Application Code but the validity timer T4004 has expired, when the match report refresh timer T4006 of the ProSe Application Code has expired, or when it receives a ProSe Application Code from lower layers that it has stored but excluding the Metadata Index portion.

question_39267.question: How long must more than 1 second has elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell for cell reselection to a lower priority NR frequency or inter-RAT frequency than the serving frequency?
question_39267.ground_truth: The condition for cell reselection to a lower priority NR frequency or inter-RAT frequency than the serving frequency is that more than 1 second has elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell.

question_39269.question: What is the structure of the Bootstrapping Server Function (BSF) address for 3GPP systems?
question_39269.ground_truth: The BSF address for 3GPP systems consists of one or more labels, each label with alphabetic characters (A-Z and a-z), digits (0-9), and hyphen (-), beginning and ending with a letter or digit, and a case-insensitive alphabet. The BSF address is derived from the identity information related to the UICC application used during the bootstrapping procedure.

question_39270.question: What type of AVP and its values are used to indicate the priority (importance) of the message for SMS Charging?
question_39270.ground_truth: The Priority AVP (AVP code 1209), with values Low, Normal, and High

question_39271.question: What is the purpose of a PWS signing proxy in a regulatory domain?
question_39271.ground_truth: A PWS signing proxy (SP) signs PWS warning messages on behalf of Content Broadcasting Entities (CBEs) in the domain of a PWS regulator. The SP applies a certificate and/or digital signature to a warning message and forwards it to the Content Broadcasting Center (CBC) for distribution to user equipment (UEs).

question_39272.question: What information does the SCEF send to the SCS/AS in the MT NIDD Submit Response message if the non-IP data was buffered due to UE being temporarily unreachable?
question_39272.ground_truth: The SCEF sends the MT NIDD Submit Response message to the SCS/AS with the Buffered Indication set to True and the non-IP data sequence number, so the SCS/AS can overwrite or purge the buffered data at a later time. The SCEF also includes the Requested Re-Transmission time to inform the SCS/AS when it is expected to re-transmit the DL data to the currently unreachable UE.

question_39273.question: What debit/reserve operation is performed in the IEC principle when discovery authorization is received for Direct Discovery Request, Match Message, Model B Restricted Discovery Request, or Model B Restricted Discovery Reporting?
question_39273.ground_truth: The Debit operation is performed after discovery authorization of receiving Direct Discovery Request, Match Report Message, Model B Restricted Discovery Request, or Model B Restricted Discovery Reporting.

question_39274.question: What happens to the media plane control signalling during an ongoing MCVideo group call when MCVideo client 1 returns from out of coverage?
question_39274.ground_truth: The media plane between MCVideo client 1 and MCVideo server is re-established using media plane control signalling, and MCVideo server may send media transmission notification to MCVideo client 1, indicating the current transmitter, or transmit media granted, transmit media rejected, or queue position info.

question_39276.question: What does the "T" flag indicate in the GTP-C header and what should its value be for the Echo Request, Echo Response, and Version Not Supported Indication messages?
question_39276.ground_truth: The "T" flag in the GTP-C header indicates if the TEID field is present in the GTP-C header or not. For the Echo Request, Echo Response, and Version Not Supported Indication messages, the "T" flag should be set to "0". For all other EPC specific messages, the "T" flag should be set to "1".

question_39280.question: When does the UE apply ATSSS rules for deciding how to distribute the uplink traffic?
question_39280.ground_truth: After the establishment of a MA PDU Session, the UE applies network-provided policy (i.e. ATSSS rules) and considers local conditions for deciding how to distribute the uplink traffic across the two access networks.

question_39281.question: What information is contained in the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery Response message (Model B)?
question_39281.ground_truth: Source Layer-2 ID, Destination Layer-2 ID, User Info ID of discoveree 5G ProSe End UE, User Info ID of 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay, and Relay Service Code are contained in the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery Response message (Model B).

question_39282.question: What is the method to ensure the integrity and confidentiality protection of ranging result on Uu interface when using enhanced MO-LR procedure?
question_39282.ground_truth: The integrity and confidentiality protection of ranging result on Uu interface can be ensured by NAS security when using enhanced MO-LR procedure.

question_39283.question: What is a spatial anchor in the context of 3GPP TS 22.101?
question_39283.ground_truth: A spatial anchor is an association between a physical location and service information.

question_39284.question: What is one of the main requirements for the SIP Digest-based SSO service?
question_39284.ground_truth: The SIP Digest-based SSO service should allow indicating to the application server the strength of the authentication method used.

question_39287.question: Which 3GPP document specifies the protocol aspects for mission critical data (MCData) signalling control?
question_39287.ground_truth: TS 24.282 Mission Critical Data (MCData) signalling control

question_39288.question: What action is taken by the H-SMF when it receives a MA PDU Session release request from the V-SMF?
question_39288.ground_truth: The H-SMF decides whether the MA PDU Session is released or released over a single access based on its local policy.

question_39289.question: What is the purpose of the default ATSSS rule in Example 4?
question_39289.ground_truth: The default ATSSS rule in Example 4 is used to offload all the traffic of a MA-PDU session to non-3GPP access while avoiding congestion, by steering all traffic using priority-based steering with non-3GPP access given high priority.

question_39290.question: What is the triggering event of the MeasurementReport message in step 6)?
question_39290.ground_truth: The MeasurementReport message in step 6) is triggered by Event A3.

question_39291.question: What is the purpose of step 2 in the procedure, calculating the median value of the CQI reports for each stream?
question_39291.ground_truth: The median CQI value is used as the target CQI value for the SS to transmit the TF in step 3 and step 5 of the procedure.

question_39292.question: What is the measurement that provides the number of successful IP-CAN session termination procedures on Gx interface in 3GPP EPS?

question_39293.question: Which document specifies the 5G NR radio resource control information elements?
question_39293.ground_truth: Section 5.4.1 specifies the 5G NR radio resource control information elements.

question_39295.question: What are the maximum VCL Bit Rate requirements for Receivers conforming to the H.264/AVC 720p Operation Point?
question_39295.ground_truth: Receivers conforming to the H.264/AVC 720p Operation Point are only required to support Bitstreams with the maximum VCL Bit Rate constrained to be 14 Mbps.

question_39298.question: What action should the UE take when the PDU session ID in the PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message belongs to any PDU session in state PDU SESSION INACTIVE in the UE?
question_39298.ground_truth: The UE shall include the 5GSM cause #43 "Invalid PDU session identity" in the 5GSM STATUS message, and set the PDU session ID to the received PDU session ID in the UL NAS TRANSPORT message as specified in subclause~5.4.5.

question_39299.question: What is the difference between the NAS level back-off timer and MS-initiated PDP Context Modification procedure in the context of the SGSN and MS communication?
question_39299.ground_truth: The NAS level back-off timer is used by the SGSN to control congestion by sending deferred requests, while the MS-initiated PDP Context Modification procedure is used by the MS to report 3GPP PS Data Off status change when the Session Management back off timer is running.

question_39301.question: What should be placed adjacent to the lower Base Station RF Bandwidth edge if NB-IoT operation in NR in-band is supported?
question_39301.ground_truth: An NR carrier with NB-IoT operation in NR in-band should be placed adjacent to the lower Base Station RF Bandwidth edge if NB-IoT operation in NR in-band is supported.

question_39303.question: What must the MCVideo client do when it receives an MBMS bearer announcement and enters an area with available general purpose MBMS, and experiences good MBMS bearer radio condition?
question_39303.ground_truth: The MCVideo client must report that it is listening to the MBMS bearer.

question_39305.question: What is the purpose of using the "type: object" keyword in an OpenAPI specification?
question_39305.ground_truth: The "type: object" keyword is used to define a schema as an object in an OpenAPI specification. It is typically used along with the "description," "properties," and "required" keywords to define a specific schema.

question_39306.question: What information is reported by the IM-SSF in the ApplyChargingReport procedure in CAMEL Phase 4 for IP Multimedia call sessions?
question_39306.ground_truth: The IM-SSF reports charging related information to the gsmSCF as requested by the gsmSCF using the "ApplyCharging" operation, including the "CallResult" list with time duration charging result, time information, tariff switch interval, and the party to charge. Additionally, the "CallActive" and "CallReleasedAtTcpExpiry" parameters are reported in the ApplyChargingReport procedure.

question_39307.question: What should a UE do if it is operating in single-registration mode and the service request procedure is rejected with the 5GMM cause value #39?
question_39307.ground_truth: The UE should handle the 5GMM parameters, 5GMM state, and 5GS update status as specified in 3GPP TS 24.501 for the case when the service request procedure performed over 3GPP access is rejected with the 5GMM cause with the same value.

question_39308.question: What is the maximum allowed time for the UE to identify a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell in clause 16.6.5.3.5?
question_39308.ground_truth: The maximum allowed time for the UE to identify a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell in clause 16.6.5.3.5 is 190 ms.

question_39309.question: Which attribute is not applicable for all Bearer Services and why?
question_39309.ground_truth: The "Information Transfer Rate" attribute is not applicable for all Bearer Services because it depends on the reference point assumed in the PLMN, transit or terminating network.

question_39311.question: What is the task of the 3GPP MNO in the use case for multiple private communications in the same network?
question_39311.ground_truth: The 3GPP MNO provides independent private communications for different groups of UEs in the same network.

question_39312.question: What should the UE include in the NAS Transport protocol when establishing a PDU Session with multiple DNNs/S-NSSAIs?
question_39312.ground_truth: The UE should include multiple DNNs/S-NSSAIs or a DNN/S-NSSAI mapped to a group which has subgroups for the multiple DNNs/S-NSSAIs for a PDU Session.

question_39313.question: What does the eNB do after it receives the Initial Context Setup Request from the MME with the optimized GW bearer re-establishment indication?
question_39313.ground_truth: The eNB includes the eNB F-TEID in first UL GTP-U packets to SGW and sends dummy UL GTP-U packets if no UL traffic is received from the UE. It also establishes an S1-U connection with a predefined inactivity timer.

question_39316.question: What is the effect of setting the Requested Discovery Timer to zero in step 1?
question_39316.ground_truth: If the Requested Discovery Timer is included in step 1 and the value is set to zero, the ProSe Function shall remove the discovery entry indicated by the Discovery Entry ID, and release the associated resources.

question_39319.question: In Item 2, what should be the recommended approach for reusing existing AVPs?
question_39319.ground_truth: Proposal 2 (IETF) under Item 2 is recommended by 3GPP for reusing existing AVPs

question_39322.question: What happens when the GGSN receives the Update PDP Context Request during the handover from GERAN/UTRAN to EGAN?
question_39322.ground_truth: The GGSN processes the Update PDP Context Request as defined in the 3GPP TS 23.060 and 29.060, and returns Create PDP Context Response to the Proxy-Gn, which is then sent to the serving EGANC GA-SM.

question_39323.question: What information element can be included in the START CC message to indicate the mobile station's call control capabilities?
question_39323.ground_truth: The CC Capabilities information element (9.3.23a.1) can be included in the START CC message to indicate the mobile station's call control capabilities.

question_39324.question: What is the purpose of the id-gNB-CU-UE-F1AP-ID and id-RAN-UE-PDC-MeasID in the PDC Measurement Initiation Request?
question_39324.ground_truth: The id-gNB-CU-UE-F1AP-ID and id-RAN-UE-PDC-MeasID are IEs in the PDC Measurement Initiation Request that identify the gNB-CU-UE-F1AP-ID and RAN-UE-PDC-MeasID, respectively. The gNB-CU-UE-F1AP-ID identifies the gNB CU UE F1AP connection ID, and RAN-UE-PDC-MeasID identifies the RAN UE PDC measurement identity.

question_39325.question: What value of the "entry-info" attribute in the <uri-entry> element within the <entry> element of the <MCDataGroupInitiation> element indicates the use of the dedicated group as the destination address for a group emergency alert?

question_39326.question: How does Key Issue 1 propose handling accounting and/or usage data records when services are sponsored, particularly in roaming scenarios?
question_39326.ground_truth: In roaming scenarios, a S9 reference point is present between the H-PCRF and the V-PCRF. Accounting and/or usage data records are handled by generating separate records for sponsored IP flows using service specific Charging Key and Monitoring Key or using Sponsor Identity to correlate measurements from different users and services for accounting purposes.

question_39328.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe Layer-2 Group ID parameter in 3GPP~TS~23.303?
question_39328.ground_truth: The ProSe Layer-2 Group ID parameter in 3GPP~TS~23.303 is used to assign a Layer-2 identifier to be used for multicast delivery over PC5 for a specific MCPTT group.

question_39329.question: What does the acronym "ECSD" stand for in the context of telecommunications?

question_39330.question: What should the SGSN/MME do to avoid recurring (quarter/half) hourly applications?
question_39330.ground_truth: The SGSN/MME could ask the MTC Device to delay attach request or connection requests for these applications with the back off time, but identifying such recurring applications is unclear.

question_39332.question: What is the minimum frequency range for 6.7D.4.1 initial conditions?
question_39332.ground_truth: The 6.7D.4.1 initial conditions specify frequencies to be tested as mid-range, as indicated in clause G.2.4.

question_39334.question: What is the scope of the document in relation to H.324?
question_39334.ground_truth: The scope of the document is the changes, deletions, and additions necessary to fully specify a multimedia codec for use in 3GPP networks, which implicitly excludes the network interface and call setup procedures.

question_39335.question: How is the user equipment (UE) location calculated for the TTFF tests in the GPS scenario?
question_39335.ground_truth: The UE location is randomly selected to be within 3 km of the reference location and the altitude is randomly chosen between 0 m to 500 m above the WGS-84 reference ellipsoid.

question_39336.question: Why is there no need for an SGW to throttle PGW originated traffic towards an MME/SGSN, given that an MME/SGW can signal overload information to a PGW to control the traffic?
question_39336.ground_truth: There is no real need for a new overload control procedure from the MME/SGSN to the SGW with the SGW as a consumer of the overload information because it is largely redundant with the existing DDN throttling mechanisms. Additionally, an SGW may continue sending DDN requests for normal priority traffic to an MME/SGSN in overload, but this can be solved by allowing the SGW to throttle DDN requests for normal priority traffic as well.

question_39342.question: In the document, what does the first digit of the version number in the foreword indicate?
question_39342.ground_truth: The first digit of the version number in the foreword of the document represents the stage of the document in the TSG approval process.

question_39343.question: What is the requirement for the UE to apply precoding weights after point D in test case 5.4.5.2?
question_39343.ground_truth: The UE shall apply precoding weights corresponding to the received TPI bits with more than 99% of the time after point D.

question_39344.question: What is the primary function of the 3GPP AAA Proxy Translation Agent in the 3GPP AAA Proxy?
question_39344.ground_truth: The 3GPP AAA Proxy Translation Agent is responsible for converting RADIUS requests to Diameter requests and vice versa.

question_39345.question: What is the maximum number of retransmissions for a MAC-e/MAC-i PDU in HARQ protocol?
question_39345.ground_truth: The maximum number of retransmissions for a MAC-e/MAC-i PDU in HARQ protocol is determined by the UE based on the maximum number of transmissions attribute.

question_39346.question: How are telecommunication services described in this TS?
question_39346.ground_truth: In this TS, telecommunication services are described by attributes that define service characteristics as they apply at the customer's access point, including low layer technical attributes and other associated attributes such as operational and commercial attributes.

question_39347.question: What is the maximum allowed cell re-selection delay to higher priority in this test case?
question_39347.ground_truth: The maximum allowed cell re-selection delay to higher priority in this test case is 68 seconds.

question_39349.question: In the context of home routed roaming scenario, what information does the SMF+PGW-C send to the V-SMF during PDU Session Establishment?
question_39349.ground_truth: In home routed roaming scenario, the SMF+PGW-C sends mapped EPS bearer context(s), the mapping between the received EBI(s) and QFI(s), linked EBI and EPS bearer context(s) to V-SMF during PDU Session Establishment.

question_39350.question: What mode does an EC-GSM-IoT device enter when there are no temporary block flow in packet idle mode, and upper layers request the transfer of LLC PDUs?
question_39350.ground_truth: This triggers the establishment of one or more TBFs and transition to packet transfer mode.

question_39351.question: What action should the UE take when it receives a REGISTRATION REJECT message with cause #11 (PLMN not allowed) during initial registration?
question_39351.ground_truth: The UE should delete any 5G-GUTI, last visited registered TAI, ngKSI, store the PLMN identity in the "forbidden PLMN list", and enter state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH to perform a PLMN selection.

question_39352.question: From the perspective of AI/ML solutions, what is one aspect that has not been studied for CSI feedback enhancement in Rel-18?

question_39356.question: In the procedures for termination of multimedia sessions in the IM CN subsystem, what should the MCPTT client do if it does not have enough resources to handle the call?
question_39356.ground_truth: The MCPTT client may reject the SIP INVITE request if it does not have enough resources to handle the call.

question_39358.question: What needs to be done in case a UE is out of coverage and at least one reference UE is in coverage?
question_39358.ground_truth: The out-of-coverage Target UE can implicitly initiate a MO-LR procedure by starting ranging discovery and connection setup with a nearby Reference UE, and the UE may report its ranging measurements/results to the LMF through the Reference UE that is in coverage.

question_39359.question: What is the main advantage of using network listening as a synchronization solution?
question_39359.ground_truth: The main advantage of using network listening is that it allows the target cell to monitor the source cell directly and maintain synchronization with the source cell.

question_39362.question: What is a noise filling segment in the context of the arithmetic codec?
question_39362.ground_truth: A noise filling segment is a segment of successive bins of the MDCT spectrum between and for which all coefficients are quantized to zero.

question_39363.question: When is timer T200 reset by the k layer entity?
question_39363.ground_truth: The k layer entity resets timer T200 on receipt of a valid I-frame or supervisory frame with N(R) higher than V(A), or on receipt of an REJ with N(R) equal to V(A).

question_39364.question: What are the four basic sources of synchronization for a V2X UE in LTE-V2X?
question_39364.ground_truth: The four basic sources of synchronization for a V2X UE in LTE-V2X are GNSS, the serving eNB, another UE transmitting SLSS (a SyncRef UE), or the UE's internal clock.

question_39365.question: In the context of MGW-A, what is the purpose of bearer termination T2?
question_39365.ground_truth: The purpose of bearer termination T2 in MGW-A is for the bearer towards the succeeding/preceding MGW.

question_39366.question: What is the name of the information made available to the split computation 'policy decision point' regarding the network resources for the augmented reality use case?
question_39366.ground_truth: The network provides current network resource information concerning the UE to network communication performance such as new QoS parameters (GBR), the condition information (time point-a) for update of a new QoS, as well as end-to-end performance between the UE and the computation resources (e.g. in the Service Hosting Environment).

question_39367.question: What is the purpose of using asymmetric keys for SLPP signaling groupcast?
question_39367.ground_truth: The purpose is to prevent a receiver from impersonating the groupcaster in the group if the groupcast keys are symmetric keys.

question_39372.question: What should the MS do when it receives a GA-CSR PAGING REQUEST message while in GA-CSR-DEDICATED state or GA-RC-REGISTERED state?
question_39372.ground_truth: The MS should ignore the GA-CSR PAGING REQUEST message and continue with any ongoing procedure as if the GA-CSR PAGING REQUEST was not received.

question_39375.question: What is Adjacent Channel Leakage power Ratio (ACLR) in the context of NR channel power measurements?
question_39375.ground_truth: ACLR is the ratio of the filtered mean power centered on the assigned NR channel frequency to the filtered mean power centered on an adjacent NR channel frequency at nominal channel spacing.

question_39376.question: In the first phase of CTS, what is the intended environment for the services and features provided?
question_39376.ground_truth: The services and features of CTS in the first phase are intended for residential environment serving one cell.

question_39377.question: When a public user identity makes a successful registration, what should be the value of the "state" attribute in the <contact> element of the NOTIFY request?
question_39377.ground_truth: The value of the "state" attribute in the <contact> element of the NOTIFY request should be "active" for a successful registration.

question_39378.question: What is the maximum Bit Error Rate (BER) allowed for any measured UTRA FDD carrier outside the base station RF bandwidth or maximum radio bandwidth?
question_39378.ground_truth: The BER should not exceed 0.001 for the reference measurement channel as defined in clause 7.2.5.2.

question_39379.question: What state does the floor control interface enter when another MCPTT client has permission to send media, and the MCPTT client attempts to initiate an already existing MCPTT call?
question_39379.ground_truth: The floor control interface enters the 'U: not permitted and Floor Taken' state as specified in clause 6.3.5.4.2.

question_39381.question: What is the procedure for testing the BS type 1-C receiver and each BS type 1-H TAB connector at the reference sensitivity level?
question_39381.ground_truth: The procedure involves connecting the connector to measurement equipment, setting the BS to transmit a signal, starting the signal generator for the wanted signal, measuring the throughput, and repeating the process for all connectors necessary to demonstrate conformance.

question_39382.question: What is the role of PCRF and BPCF in the roaming scenario?
question_39382.ground_truth: In a roaming scenario, the PCRF generates PCC rules for home routed access, installs PCC rules in the PCEF over Gx, and sends PCC rules to the vPCRF for admission control in visited access. The BPCF performs admission control in fixed access and sends QoS rules to the BPCF over S9a for admission control in the fixed access. The BPCF in a roaming scenario would remain the same as in the non-roaming scenario.

question_39383.question: What type of blocking is measured in the in-band selectivity and blocking characteristics?
question_39383.ground_truth: The in-band selectivity and blocking characteristics are measures of the receiver ability to receive a wanted signal at its assigned channel in the presence of an unwanted interferer inside the operating band and are defined by a wideband and a narrowband blocking requirement.

question_39386.question: In the same scenario as question 1, what should be done regarding the cg-RetransmissionTimer for the corresponding HARQ process?
question_39386.ground_truth: The cg-RetransmissionTimer for the corresponding HARQ process should be started or restarted.

question_39387.question: What is the role of HRPD Pre-registration Zone parameter in the pre-registration procedure?
question_39387.ground_truth: HRPD Pre-registration Zone parameter is used to decide whether a re-registration shall be performed by the UE to maintain a valid HRPD context. It is provided by E-UTRAN on the E-UTRAN system information broadcast channel or dedicated RRC signalling.

question_39388.question: When should the time and frequency resources be randomly selected for one or more transmission opportunities, as specified in clause 5.28.2 of the destination UE?
question_39388.ground_truth: The time and frequency resources should be randomly selected for one or more transmission opportunities, as specified in clause 5.28.2 of the destination UE, when there are available resources left in the available resources which occur within the SL DRX Active time and the pool(s) in which all RB sets with Sidelink consistent LBT failure detected and not cancelled are excluded.

question_39389.question: What is the general intermodulation minimum requirement for MSR operation?
question_39389.ground_truth: The intermodulation minimum requirement for MSR operation requires that in the presence of two interfering signals, the throughput for any E-UTRA carrier should be greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput for the reference measurement channel, and the BER for any UTRA FDD or TDD carrier should not exceed 0.001.

question_39390.question: What is the role of a spatial mapping service in mobile networks?
question_39390.ground_truth: A spatial mapping service is a service offered by a mobile network operator that gathers sensor data in order to create and maintain a Spatial Map that can be used to offer customers Spatial Localization Service.

question_39392.question: What is the role of the CDF in handling charging events with missing IEs?
question_39392.ground_truth: The CDF can act upon charging events (ACR) receptions when IEs corresponding to mandatory fields are missing, but it is not expected to fully handle this check since this is the role of the CGF.

question_39393.question: What is the role of the N4 Session Establishment procedure in 5G systems?
question_39393.ground_truth: The N4 Session Establishment procedure provides control parameters to the User Plane Function (UPF), allowing it to manage data traffic for a specific PDU session.

question_39394.question: Which clause specifies the application data model supported by the ASTI API?
question_39394.ground_truth: Clause 5.22.4 provides the data model details of the ASTI API.

question_39395.question: What is the test purpose in 6.5B.2.1.1.1?
question_39395.ground_truth: The purpose of the test case 6.5B.2.1.1.1 is to verify that the power of any UE emissions does not exceed the specified level for the specified aggregated bandwidth for the EN-DC intra-band contiguous.

question_39397.question: What out-of-band blocking requirements apply to the lowest level EN-DC fallbacks (two bands) with E-UTRA single carrier and CA operation for FR1, for both intra-band and inter-band cases?
question_39397.ground_truth: The out-of-band blocking requirements for E-UTRA single carrier and CA operation specified in clauses 7.6.2.1 and 7.6.2.1A of TS 36.101 apply for the lowest level EN-DC fallbacks (two bands) in FR1, for both intra-band and inter-band cases.

question_39398.question: In which subclause are the measurements for the successful emergency session established at E-CSCF defined?

question_39400.question: What interfaces does the non-roaming architecture use for interworking between ePDG/EPC and 5GS?
question_39400.ground_truth: The non-roaming architecture uses interworking with ePDG is only supported with GTP based S2b, S6b interface is optional.

question_39401.question: What is the state of the mobile station at the beginning of the test procedure specified in 58b.1.5a.2?
question_39401.ground_truth: At the beginning of the test procedure specified in 58b.1.5a.2, the mobile station is in the state "idle, GMM-registered" with a P-TMSI allocated, and PDP context 2 activated.

question_39402.question: What should the UE do when sending the UEInformationResponse message containing the measurement result for intra-frequency neighbor cell, in case RLF has occurred?
question_39402.ground_truth: The UE should include the SSB index and associated measurements in the measResultLastServCell if the latest radio measurement results of the serving and neighboring cells are available.

question_39404.question: What is the aim of the FM REQ-FM (1) statement in the NGCOR Fault Management Solution Profile?
question_39404.ground_truth: The aim is to deliver efficient support for the OSS business processes by standardizing the semantics needed to support the process in the interface specification.

question_39405.question: What are the responsibilities of the SMF in the enhanced architecture?
question_39405.ground_truth: Based on reporting requirements issued by NEF, SMF receives DetNet related information reported by UPF on the N4 interface and sends it to NEF as required.

question_39406.question: What is WUS assistance and in what type of procedures can a UE include its UE paging probability information in the Requested WUS assistance information IE?
question_39406.ground_truth: WUS (Wake-Up Signal) assistance is a capability that can indicate the UE's assistance during an attach or tracking area updating procedure for the network to determine the WUS group for paging the UE. A UE can include its UE paging probability information in the Requested WUS assistance information IE during an attach or tracking area updating procedure, except when the UE is attaching for emergency bearer services, or has a PDN connection established for emergency bearer services.

question_39409.question: What is the maximum ratio of missed(up) and all valid up commands, sent for the test to be passed?

question_39410.question: What is the purpose of the U-RNTI value in the HNBAP UE Signalling Transfer message?
question_39410.ground_truth: The U-RNTI value is included in the HNBAP UE Signalling Transfer message to prevent the need for HNB-GW to decode the Cell Update message to know the U-RNTI and to help determine the UE's context.

question_39411.question: What is the LTE Advanced 4 Band Carrier Aggregation with one uplink and four downlink carriers called in section 6.3 of the document?
question_39411.ground_truth: 6.3 (4DL/1UL) of Band 1, Band 3, Band 7 and Band 8

question_39413.question: What is the association law for the flexibility attribute for connection elements?
question_39413.ground_truth: The flexibility attribute for connection elements follows the association law that states if any of the connection elements are Demand, then the overall connection type is Demand.

question_39415.question: What is the impact of operating at GPRS reference MCL+10dB on the uplink (UL) for a dBm device with an output power of 33 dBm?
question_39415.ground_truth: The device experiences a longer battery lifetime due to substantially better downlink (DL) coverage, effectively reducing reception time.

question_39416.question: What must the "username" header field parameter in the Authorization header field be set to when sending a REGISTER request?
question_39416.ground_truth: The "username" header field parameter in the Authorization header field must be set to the value of the private user identity when sending a REGISTER request.

question_39417.question: What should the source eNB do when one or more candidate cells in the Candidate Cells To Be Cancelled List IE included in the CONDITIONAL HANDOVER CANCEL message were not prepared using the same UE-associated signaling connection?
question_39417.ground_truth: The source eNB should ignore those non-associated candidate cells.

question_39419.question: What is required for the start of UE test loop mode 1, mode 2, or mode 4?
question_39419.ground_truth: A prerequisite for UE test loop mode 1, UE test loop mode 2, and UE test loop mode 4 is that at least one bidirectional user plane radio bearer has been established between the SS and UE.

question_39420.question: What type of information is used to associate a UE accessing an application with a set of UEs using Service information and send the PCC rule to the SMF for the PDU Session?
question_39420.ground_truth: The service information of the UE accessing an application is used to associate the UE with the set of UEs and send the PCC rule to the SMF for the PDU Session with the traffic routing policy information provisioned associated with the set of UEs with the service information.

question_39421.question: What procedure is used by the network to suspend the connection if the UE and the network support User Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation?
question_39421.ground_truth: The Connection Suspend procedure is used by the network to suspend the connection.

question_39422.question: What action does the MSGin5G Server take upon receiving the MSGin5G message request?
question_39422.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server determines if the originating UE is allowed to send messages to the recipient UE.

question_39423.question: What are the charging events defined for ProSe Direct Discovery and ProSe EPC-level Discovery charging?
question_39423.ground_truth: The charging events defined for ProSe Direct Discovery charging are Monitor Request, Announce Request, Discovery query, and Discovery response with corresponding ProSe Functions triggering CDR generation, and for ProSe EPC-level Discovery charging are Proximity Request, Proximity Request Renewal, Proximity Request Reject, and Proximity Request Cancellation with corresponding PF-ED-CDR generation and updates.

question_39424.question: In which case should a MS proceed as specified in subclauses 4.5.1.1 or 4.3.5.2 respectively, and increment the counter for "SIM/USIM considered invalid for GPRS services" events?
question_39424.ground_truth: This should be done if the MS receives an ATTACH REJECT or ROUTING AREA UPDATE REJECT message without integrity protection with GMM cause value #3, #6, #7, #8, #11, #12, #13, #14 or #15 before the network has activated the integrity protection for the PS domain.

question_39425.question: When do MME and PGW need to send PRA IDs to SGW and MME, respectively?
question_39425.ground_truth: During Attach and UE requested PDN connectivity procedures, after MME sends the MME ID to SGW, PGW sends PRA IDs and the list of elements for each PRA to SGW, which forwards it to MME for proper handling during IP-CAN session establishment or modification.

question_39426.question: What is the purpose of providing public user identities to the MCPTT UE for MCPTT services in the MCPTT system?
question_39426.ground_truth: The purpose of providing public user identities to the MCPTT UE for MCPTT services in the MCPTT system is to allow for confidentiality of user identities in various cases of business relationships.

question_39429.question: What should the UE be capable of in relation to the number of RLM-RS resources to monitor in a corresponding carrier frequency range?
question_39429.ground_truth: The UE should be able to monitor up to NRLM RLM-RS resources of the same or different types in each corresponding carrier frequency range, depending on a maximum number of SSBs per half frame.

question_39431.question: In the context of the present specification, what does "DRA binding" refer to?
question_39431.ground_truth: DRA binding refers to the PCRF routing information stored per UE or per PDN in the DRA, which includes the user identity, IP address/prefix, APN (if available), and the selected PCRF identity for a certain IP-CAN Session.

question_39432.question: What are the functions of the Radio Resource Control (RRC) sub-layer in the control plane of the S1-based architecture?
question_39432.ground_truth: The Radio Resource Control (RRC) sub-layer in the control plane of the S1-based architecture terminates the Layer 3 dedicated signaling between the MS and the base station, handles the functions related to the control of the RRC connection, and carries the NAS signaling over the DCCH.

question_39433.question: What should the UE do if it is in the ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE substate in EMM-REGISTERED state?
question_39433.ground_truth: The UE should not send any user data, initiate tracking area updating on the expiry of timers T3411, T3402 or T3346, and use requests for non-EPS services from CM layers to trigger a combined tracking area updating procedure. It may also initiate a tracking area updating procedure upon request of the upper layers to establish a PDN connection for emergency bearer services, and if timer T3346 is not running, it may detach locally and initiate an attach for emergency bearer services. Additionally, it may use requests for MMTEL voice call or MMTEL video call from the upper layers to initiate tracking area updating, and initiate tracking area updating in response to paging with S-TMSI or paging with IMSI and domain indicator set to 'CS'.

question_39435.question: What is the function of the Policy Control Function (PCF) in the 5G System architecture?
question_39435.ground_truth: The PCF (Policy Control Function) encompasses policy control decision and flow based charging control functionalities, access and mobility policy decisions, and UE Policy decisions for the control of Access network discovery and selection policy and UE Route Selection Policy (URSP). The PCF offers these capabilities to the NF service consumers, such as the AF and NEF, for the control of service data flow detection, gating, QoS and flow based charging (except credit management) towards the SMF/UPF.

question_39437.question: What should be the minimum reporting criteria for the UE to send event triggered measurement reports, as per clause 8.16.95.4.3?
question_39437.ground_truth: The UE shall not send event triggered measurement reports as long as the reporting criteria are not fulfilled.

question_39438.question: In what state of the cell selection process can the logging be performed at regular time intervals?
question_39438.ground_truth: If the UE is in any cell selection state.

question_39439.question: What is the pre-test condition for this test case in terms of the state of the UE?
question_39439.ground_truth: The UE is in state 1N-A on NR Cell 1.

question_39440.question: What is the purpose of the "EventNotify" resource in the 6.4.5 section?
question_39440.ground_truth: The "EventNotify" resource in the 6.4.5 section represents the callback reference of the NF Service Consumer to receive LCS event notify.

question_39441.question: Which ciphering algorithms are supported by the gNB for ciphering user data between the UE and gNB?
question_39441.ground_truth: The gNB shall support ciphering algorithms -NEA0, 128-NEA1, 128-NEA2.

question_39442.question: What is the purpose of the "PSETR" feature in the 5G System?
question_39442.ground_truth: The "PSETR" feature allows a SMF to reselect an alternative peer SMF using the binding indication of the resource/session contexts or based on the NF profile of the peer SMF.

question_39443.question: What network architecture options are available for the CSP in IMS domain for Voice service type and what are the implications of each option on network provisioning?
question_39443.ground_truth: The CSP may have either a local breakout (LBO) based roaming architecture or a home-routed based roaming architecture. In an LBO-based roaming architecture, the BBIFF-C function is provided by the SMF in a 5GC packet core network and by the SGW-C/SGW in an EPC packet core network, while in a home-routed based roaming architecture, the host NFs that provide the LI functions when the target is non-local ID may differ from the host NFs that provide the LI functions when the target is not non-local ID.

question_39444.question: What should the ME do after sending the FETCH command to the UICC in this test scenario?
question_39444.ground_truth: After sending the FETCH command to the UICC, the ME should send the TERMINAL RESPONSE command with command number "01", type of command "02" and command qualifier "00" in the next message sent to the UICC.

question_39445.question: What is the role of the CAPIF-8 reference point in the CAPIF architecture?
question_39445.ground_truth: The CAPIF-8 reference point supports providing authorization for resource access and managing and revoking the provided authorization between the CAPIF core function and the resource owner client.

question_39446.question: What should be the security header type of the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message if the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message can be accepted and the UE is to send the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message?
question_39446.ground_truth: The security header type of the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message should be set to "integrity protected with the selected 5GS integrity algorithm and the 5G NAS integrity key" if the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message can be accepted and the UE is to send the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message.

question_39447.question: What must the MCVideo server verify before sending a modify ad-hoc group call participants response to the MCVideo client?
