question_39800.ground_truth: For Range 1, it is 0.1 ppm, and for Range 2, it is FFS whether the same frequency error can be reused in this range considering settling time, etc.

question_39802.question: What is the release mechanism of the Non-3GPP Access Connection in 5G systems, in case of NWu, NWt, Yt', Y4 and Y5 connection failure?
question_39802.ground_truth: The N3IWF, TNGF, TWIF, and W-AGF may explicitly release the NWu, NWt, Yt', Y4 and Y5 signalling connection due to connection failure. The release may be determined by the "dead peer detection" mechanism in IKEv2 or other network-specific mechanisms.

question_39803.question: What protocol is used by the MN to perform a bootstrapping procedure with the BSF and generate a shared secret, Ks?
question_39803.ground_truth: Generic Bootstrapping Architecture (GBA) is used by the MN to perform a bootstrapping procedure with the BSF and generate a shared secret, Ks.

question_39804.question: What is the minimum number of occurrences for the "xs:any" element in the "sealloctype" complex type?
question_39804.ground_truth: The "xs:any" element in the "sealloctype" complex type has a minimum number of occurrences of 0.

question_39805.question: What is the role of the PCF in Solution #12?
question_39805.ground_truth: The PCF creates packet filters based on received instructions and/or local policy to discard packets in the UE based on the filter rules.

question_39809.question: What is the procedure used for generating spatially consistent channel variables in drop-based simulations in Clause 7.5?
question_39809.ground_truth: The spatial consistency procedure described in Clause 7.6.3.1 is used for generating cluster-specific and ray-specific random variables in various channel generation steps in Clause 7.5, so that they are spatially consistent.

question_39810.question: What criteria does the NR V2X UE use when evaluating the IC/OOC criteria?
question_39810.ground_truth: The NR V2X UE evaluates the IC/OOC criteria when moving out from the IC to the OOC by considering it to be in OOC when there is no cell meeting the S-criteria.

question_39812.question: What should the public service identity in the local MCVideo system identify when the terminating participating MCVideo function is in an interconnected MCVideo system in a different trust domain?
question_39812.ground_truth: The public service identity can identify the MCVideo gateway server that acts as an entry point in the interconnected MCVideo system from the local MCVideo system.

question_39813.question: What existing mechanisms and methodologies can be used by a UE to access localized services as per clause 6.10.2?
question_39813.ground_truth: A UE can use existing mechanisms and methodologies to access localized services based on Home Network Credentials or Onboarding Mechanism as per clause 6.10.2.1 and 6.10.2.2 respectively.

question_39814.question: What is the minimum requirement for the Error Vector Magnitude (EVM)?
question_39814.ground_truth: The Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) shall not exceed 12.5 %.

question_39815.question: Under what circumstances can a mobile station (MS) initiate GPRS attach for emergency bearer services?
question_39815.ground_truth: A mobile station (MS) can initiate GPRS attach for emergency bearer services in the following substates: NORMAL-SERVICE, LIMITED-SERVICE, ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH, and PLMN-SEARCH.

question_39818.question: What determines the measurement period for PRS RSTD measurement in positioning frequency layer i?
question_39818.ground_truth: The measurement period for PRS RSTD measurement in positioning frequency layer i is determined by the periodicity of the PRS RSTD measurement in positioning frequency layer i (Pi), the number of positioning frequency layers (N), and the index of positioning frequency layer (i). Specifically, it is calculated as Pi * (N/i) if the UE is capable of receiving the same DL PRS resource simultaneously from multiple Rx TEGs, and as Pi * (P/i) if the UE is not capable of receiving the same DL PRS resource simultaneously from multiple Rx TEGs.

question_39819.question: What is the definition of Total Radiated Sensitivity (TRS) in the context of E-UTRA FDD?
question_39819.ground_truth: TRS is defined as the integral of the inverse of the Effective Isotropic Sensitivity (EIS) over a solid angle describing the direction and frequency.

question_39820.question: What action is taken by the eNB to release the S1-U bearers with the SGW?
question_39820.ground_truth: The eNB sends a dummy IP packet to the SGW along with an indication to release the S1-U tunnels.

question_39821.question: Which media formats are used to ensure consistent video distribution formats for 3GPP defined radio bearers?
question_39821.ground_truth: The document is not restricted to operator services, and other third-party content providers may also refer to and use it as a guideline to ensure a consistent quality of experience for TV services on 3GPP radio bearers.

question_39822.question: What is the username part of the P-KID in the solution?
question_39822.ground_truth: The username part of the P-KID includes the Routing Identifier and the P-TID (ProSe Temporary UE Identifier).

question_39823.question: What must the User Equipment (UE) do if the request is related to an IMS communication service that requires the use of an ICSI and the UE supports multiple registrations?
question_39823.ground_truth: The UE shall include the contact address of the UE with an "ob" SIP URI parameter and a g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag in the request.

question_39825.question: When evaluating cells for reselection, to which cells do the SSB side conditions apply?
question_39825.ground_truth: The SSB side conditions apply to both serving and non-serving intra-frequency cells.

question_39826.question: What is the maximum overall delays measured requirement for the test case of NR SA FR1 event-triggered reporting without gap under non-DRX?
question_39826.ground_truth: The overall delays measured shall be less than a total of 802 ms in this test case.

question_39828.question: Which timer is used in the UE to remove an S-NSSAI from the rejected NSSAI for the maximum number of UEs reached after it expires?

question_39829.question: What is the purpose of the UE reading the MCCH messages?
question_39829.ground_truth: The UE reads the MCCH messages to acquire a consistent set of MCCH information in the same modification period.

question_39830.question: What is the purpose of the RACH Busy Threshold and RACH Load Averaging Slots in the context of GSM?
question_39830.ground_truth: RACH Busy Threshold is the threshold of -x dBm for the RACH (Random Access CHannel) and the RACH Load Averaging Slots is the number of RACH burst periods in the range of <0-FFFF>.

question_39831.question: What is the purpose of the termination of On-train incoming voice or video communication from the Controller(s) of the train towards the drivers?
question_39831.ground_truth: The purpose is to allow the controller to end the voice or video communication with the drivers.

question_39832.question: What should the UE do if the "@version" attribute in the SSF information is the same as the stored one?
question_39832.ground_truth: The UE should not update the stored SSF information.

question_39833.question: What is the recommendation regarding the Radix size in the complexity evaluation for the Base Station in the 3GPP EGPRS2 study item?
question_39833.ground_truth: It is recommended to use a Radix size of up to 5 (e.g. 2, 3, 5) for an efficient implementation in the base station.

question_39834.question: What is the reference for the interlace definition in Alt-1 for carriers with bandwidth larger than 20 MHz?

question_39836.question: What is the purpose of RAN sharing in the context of MBS Session resources?
question_39836.ground_truth: RAN sharing allows the gNB to determine whether MBS Session resources can be shared with a broadcast MBS session(s) associated with the same Associated Session ID requested from another 5GC participating in RAN sharing.

question_39839.question: In the context of 3GPP networks, what is the "CAG information list" and what is its role?
question_39839.ground_truth: The "CAG information list" is a list of information about CAGs, provisioned by the network and stored in the UE. It includes an "Allowed CAG list" which specifies the CAG-IDs that a UE is allowed to access for a particular PLMN.

question_39840.question: What is one requirement for system elasticity in the 3GPP system?
question_39840.ground_truth: The 3GPP system should be able to adjust the network capacities dynamically based on variations in demand.

question_39841.question: What is the general principle for resource partitioning in inband relay?
question_39841.ground_truth: The general principle for resource partitioning in inband relay is that the eNB-RN and RN-UE links are time division multiplexed in a single carrier frequency, and RN-eNB and UE-RN links are time division multiplexed in a single carrier frequency.

question_39842.question: What are the two UEs involved in the Ranging/SL positioning service when the UE is involved in the SL ranging?

question_39843.question: What is the measure of the receiver's ability to receive a wanted signal at its assigned channel frequency in the presence of a single code CDMA modulated adjacent channel signal at a given frequency offset?

question_39844.question: How are 16bit UCS2 information handled in the Huffman coder?
question_39844.ground_truth: Both coder and decoder maintain knowledge of "the current" Basic Multilingual Plane row for characters in the input stream, and the row octet itself is then omitted from the output stream for sequences of characters within that row. Transitions between rows are signaled in the output stream by a "special" character.

question_39845.question: What is the editor's note regarding the instantiation for GCS AS in the context with 5GS?
question_39845.ground_truth: The instantiation for GCS AS in the context with 5GS is FFS.

question_39846.question: What are the three aspects that impact the quality of experience for VR services?
question_39846.ground_truth: The three aspects are the transmission network, the content type, and the device.

question_39849.question: What message type is used to setup MBS session resources for a multicast MBS session in the 9.2.5.2.1 message?

question_39852.question: What is the unit of measurement for the metric "Average_Codec_Bitrate"?
question_39852.ground_truth: The unit of measurement for the metric "Average_Codec_Bitrate" is kbit/s (kilobits per second).

question_39853.question: What is the purpose of the Interoperable Indicator in the NF profile of the MTLF?
question_39853.ground_truth: The Interoperable Indicator in the NF profile of the MTLF determines and selects the ML model to be shared, based on the analytic ID and the local policy of the MTLF.

question_39855.question: What is the main advantage of Architecture Alternative 1 in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network Technical Report?
question_39855.ground_truth: The main advantage of Architecture Alternative 1 is that it does not require any new interfaces, as the LMC is an internal function of the NG-RAN node.

question_39856.question: What happens to the Slice-UL-AMBR and Slice-DL-AMBR when a new GBR flow is established or terminated in existing sessions?
question_39856.ground_truth: When a new GBR flow is established or terminated in existing sessions, the PCF recalculates the Slice-UL-AMBR and Slice-DL-AMBR and delivers the new values to the enforcement nodes.

question_39857.question: How does the NG-RAN handle mobility in 5G networks for network slicing?
question_39857.ground_truth: For initial attach, the UE may provide NSSAI to support the selection of an AMF (Access and Mobility Management Function). For subsequent accesses, the UE provides a Temp ID, which is assigned to the UE by the 5GC, to enable the NG-RAN to route the NAS (Non-Access Stratum) message to the appropriate AMF. The NG-RAN is also responsible for handling a service request for a slice that may or may not be available in a given area, and may use the Partially Allowed NSSAI for mobility decisions.

question_39858.question: What should be the SNR value when T2 starts and T3 starts?
question_39858.ground_truth: When T2 starts, the SS shall change the SNR value to T2, and when T3 starts, the SS shall change the SNR value to T3.

question_39861.question: In the context of 4.4.3.2 Serving GW, what is the role of the Serving GW in inter-eNodeB handover?
question_39861.ground_truth: The Serving GW acts as the local mobility anchor point for inter-eNodeB handover and sends one or more "end marker" to the source eNodeB to assist the reordering function in eNodeB.

question_39862.question: What does one DCH data stream always correspond to in the UTRAN?

question_39864.question: What two frequency bands are co-existence studies conducted for in LTE Advanced Carrier Aggregation of Band 7 and Band 28 with 2 uplinks?

question_39865.question: When the UE requested PDN disconnection is detected over PMIP at the PDN-GW in the VPLMN, what event is generated and what information is delivered to the DF2 if available?
question_39865.ground_truth: The PMIP detach/tunnel deactivation event is generated and the following information is delivered to the DF2 if available: target identity, correlation number, time stamp, direction, and the target location or the IAs in case of location dependent interception.

question_39866.question: What is used to identify packets of a specific service data flow in the PCEF?
question_39866.ground_truth: Predefined PCC rules or the service data flow template are used to identify packets of a specific service data flow in the PCEF.

question_39868.question: What action results in CS/PS coordination being achieved in the scenario when a network sharing non-supporting or supporting UE signals for the LAU Request at step 4?
question_39868.ground_truth: CS/PS coordination is achieved in the scenario when a network sharing non-supporting or supporting UE signals for the LAU Request at step 4 when the UE indicates a PLMN change by the RRC IE IDNNS and a PLMN change may cause a change of operator.

question_39870.question: What is the factor considered for determining the CCA mode of a neighbor cell in RRC re-establishment on a carrier with CCA in FR2-2?
question_39870.ground_truth: The CCA mode of a neighbor cell is determined by channelAccessMode2-r17 in RRC re-establishment on a carrier with CCA in FR2-2, if it is enabled, CCA applies, otherwise CCA does not apply.

question_39871.question: What is the first stage of the mode selection process in this complex open-loop method, carried out before LP analysis?

question_39873.question: What should the network do with the PS signalling connection if the mobile station has indicated a follow-on request pending in a ROUTING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message and is not attached for emergency bearer services?
question_39873.ground_truth: The network should prolong the PS signalling connection.

question_39874.question: What components does the APN-AMBR have?
question_39874.ground_truth: The APN-AMBR has an uplink and a downlink component.

question_39875.question: What is the difference between 5G Rel-15 and 5G Rel-16 in terms of location services?
question_39875.ground_truth: In 5G Rel-15, location services provided by the home operator are restricted to location services required by regulation, while in 5G Rel-16, location services will support the commercial use of location by third parties via the home operator.

question_39879.question: What is the prerequisite for VAL server authorization and authentication via the slice enabler layer?
question_39879.ground_truth: The prerequisites for VAL server authorization and authentication via the slice enabler layer are that the NSCE server can be seen as a trusted AF, it has registered to the OAM, and it has been authorized to act as a middle layer for authentication and authorization.

question_39880.question: What is the main alternative for adding a new command to an existing application in diameter?
question_39880.ground_truth: The main alternative would be adding optional IEs indicating the overload status inside existing messages.

question_39881.question: What are the two MCPTT group call models supported by the MCPTT service in the MCPTT system?
question_39881.ground_truth: The MCPTT service supports the chat group (restricted) call model and the pre-arranged group call model for MCPTT group calls.

question_39882.question: Which interference components are stated to be no longer an issue in section 7.24.1.2 in the LTE Advanced Carrier Aggregation?
question_39882.ground_truth: The 2nd harmonic by Band 3 and the 4th IMD that fall into the 4th own Rx frequency of Band 42.

question_39884.question: Which network entity sends the Forward Relocation Response message in the eUTRAN network after receiving resources from the target BSS?

question_39886.question: What information should the AMF include in the NGAP message for a UE with PC5 capable V2X communication in NG-RAN if the UE is PC5 authorized for V2X communication over PC5 reference point?
question_39886.ground_truth: The AMF should include a "V2X services authorized" indication, PC5 QoS parameters, and UE-PC5-AMBR for PC5 transmission resource management in the NGAP message to NG-RAN.

question_39888.question: What is the frequency spacing required for LTE and NR to have subcarrier alignment when the NR channel raster is 15kHz or 30kHz?
question_39888.ground_truth: The LTE EARFCN needs to have a multiple 300kHz offset with the NR ARFCN for subcarrier alignment.

question_39889.question: What information should the SMF include in the "ueInitResReq" attribute when the UE requests to create a new QoS rule?
question_39889.ground_truth: The "reqQos" attribute containing the requested QoS for the new PCC rule and the "packFiltInfo" attribute containing one packet filters requested for creating the new QoS rule.

question_39891.question: What procedures are involved in the allocation of address pool for persistent IP address allocation?
question_39891.ground_truth: The 5GC allocates an address pool for persistent IP address allocation, which can be used for scenarios besides MEC. If address allocation is done by an external DHCP server on the DN, the server should cover multiple local DNs and maintain an address pool for persistent IP address allocation across the local DNs.

question_39892.question: What message is sent by the MME to the eNodeB to enable ciphering of the UP traffic and ciphering and integrity protection of the RRC signalling in the AS security mode command procedure?
question_39892.ground_truth: The MME sends the needed security parameters to the eNodeB.

question_39893.question: What is the message body format for the NotifyMoiChanges message type?
question_39893.ground_truth: The message body for NotifyMoiChanges type includes the name/value pairs representing the attributes of the created or modified object.

question_39894.question: What type of information is carried by the "code-sending-security-parameter" element and the "code-receiving-security-parameter" element in the "restricted-discoverer-response" element?
question_39894.ground_truth: The "code-sending-security-parameter" element contains the parameter defined in clause~11.4.2.33 and the "code-receiving-security-parameter" element also contains the parameter defined in clause~11.4.2.33.

question_39895.question: What is the definition of the MCBearerContextToSetup field in the MCBearerContextSetupRequestIEs E1AP-PROTOCOL-IES sequence?
question_39895.ground_truth: The MCBearerContextToSetup field in the MCBearerContextSetupRequestIEs E1AP-PROTOCOL-IES sequence is a Protocol IE for specifying the MC bearer context to be set up in the MCBearerContextSetupRequest message. It contains a single field, MCBCartesianF1UContextDescriptor, which specifies the F1 U context descriptor of the MBS multicast MBSS session to be established in the request.

question_39896.question: What is the objective of the test procedure outlined in section 9.4.2?
question_39896.ground_truth: The objective of the test procedure outlined in section 9.4.2 is to verify the range and accuracy of the RXQUAL (received signal quality) parameter, which is specified in terms of bit error ratio (BER) before channel decoding averaged over a reporting period.

question_39897.question: What should the UE do if it has a preference for measurement gap requirement in the musim-Assistance IE and no preference for temporary capability restriction?
question_39897.ground_truth: The UE should include the musim-NeedForGapsInfoNR to provide the measurement gap requirement information and should not include the corresponding temporary capability restriction preference in the musim-CapRestriction in the musim-Assistance IE.

question_39898.question: Which method is used by the NF service consumer to fetch the maximum number of registered UEs and/or the maximum number of LBO PDU sessions of a network slice for inbound roamers when the VPLMN NSAC admission mode is determined?
question_39898.ground_truth: The HTTP POST method is used by the NF service consumer to fetch the maximum number of registered UEs and/or the maximum number of LBO PDU sessions of a network slice for inbound roamers when the VPLMN NSAC admission mode is determined.

question_39901.question: What is the FCC rule for the guard band's OOBE performance in dBm/1.4MHz?
question_39901.ground_truth: The FCC rule gives the OOBE of -1.3~dBm / 1.4~MHz for a 3~MHz guard band and -36.3~dBm / 1.4~MHz for a 6~MHz guard band.

question_39902.question: Which IETF specification defines the QUIC protocol?

question_39904.question: What is the difference between abstract classes and concrete classes in the 3GPP Technical Specification document?
question_39904.ground_truth: Abstract classes, such as those in the Generic NRM IRP, define a high-level, implementation-neutral view of managed network elements. Concrete classes, such as those in the E-UTRAN NRM IRP, are specific implementations of the abstract classes.

question_39906.question: What information does the NEF send to the AF when a request to revoke the allocated resources is made?
question_39906.ground_truth: The NEF sends a Nnef_AFsessionWithQoS_Revoke response message to the AF for every UE address in the list associated with the Transaction Reference ID.

question_39908.question: What has been discontinued since Release 13 in this specification?
question_39908.ground_truth: The wireless local area network (WLAN) interworking security feature has been discontinued since Release 13.

question_39909.question: What shall the UE do if it detects any combination of 5G authentication failures during three consecutive authentication challenges?
question_39909.ground_truth: The UE shall deem that the network has failed the authentication check and proceed as if the network has rejected the authentication.

question_39911.question: What is the impact of step 1.1 on the E-UTRA carrier in the test procedure?
question_39911.ground_truth: On the E-UTRA carrier, periodic and aperiodic CQI reports are disabled, SRS is disabled, TimeAlignmentTimerDedicated IE is set to infinity, and downlink and uplink scheduling are disabled.

question_39913.question: What is the definition of "CSG cell"?
question_39913.ground_truth: A CSG cell is a cell in which only members of the CSG can get normal service, and potentially, emergency bearer services.

question_39914.question: What does the AAnF store when it receives the new A-KID, KAKMA, and AKMA Key expiry time from the AUSF during re-authentication?
question_39914.ground_truth: The AAnF stores the newly generated A-KID, KAKMA, and AKMA Key expiry time sent by the AUSF during re-authentication and deletes the old ones.

question_39915.question: What data type is used for the rttValue-r15 in the ASN.1 definition?

question_39916.question: What is one of the key functionality required to support the use case of indoor positioning in the shopping center?
question_39916.ground_truth: One of the key functionalities required to support the use case of indoor positioning in the shopping center is for the 5G system to be able to support authorizing a UE to perform Ambient IoT positioning services with specific Ambient IoT devices.

question_39917.question: What event occurs when the CCBS Request Invocation is carried by TC-BEGIN?

question_39918.question: What is the key requirement for the 3GPP system to support cooperative perception for high/full automated driving use case?
question_39918.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall be capable of transferring periodic broadcast/multicast messages between two UEs supporting V2X application with message payloads of 6500 bytes.

question_39920.question: What should the UE do when it receives a 420 (Bad Extension) response with the Unsupported header containing the option tag "sec-agree" to the REGISTER request?
question_39920.ground_truth: The UE may send another REGISTER request without a security association based on the procedures described in 5.1.1.2A.

question_39921.question: What will UE keep in case of collisions among different MUSIM gaps when "keep solution" is granted?
question_39921.ground_truth: When "keep solution" is granted by the network, the UE shall keep all colliding periodic and aperiodic MUSIM gaps irrespective of the priority of the periodic MUSIM gaps in case of collisions between different MUSIM gaps.

question_39922.question: What should the UE do when it receives "MBS join is rejected" with deactivated back-off timer value for a multicast MBS session, after switching on or inserting the USIM again?
question_39922.ground_truth: UE sends PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST or PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST including the Requested MBS container IE with MBS operation setting to "Join MBS session".

question_39923.question: What logical functions does the SIP database provide?
question_39923.ground_truth: The SIP database provides mobility management, registrar assignment support, call and/or session establishment support, user security information generation, signalling plane security support, user identification handling, access authorization, and service authorization support.

question_39924.question: Which version is used in "CAP-datatypes" for "CAP-classes" and "CAP-IMS-classes"?
question_39924.ground_truth: The version used in "CAP-datatypes" for "CAP-classes" and "CAP-IMS-classes" is "version3(2)".

question_39927.question: In what situation should the MCVideo client include a Resource-Priority header field and comply with the procedures in clause~6.2.8.1.2 when sending a SIP re-INVITE request to upgrade the MCVideo group session?
question_39927.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include a Resource-Priority header field and comply with the procedures in clause~6.2.8.1.2 when sending a SIP re-INVITE request in several situations, such as when the MCVideo user is requesting to upgrade the MCVideo group session to an in-progress emergency group state and is authorized to do so, when the MCVideo user is requesting to upgrade the MCVideo group session to an in-progress imminent peril state and is authorized to do so, and when the MCVideo user has requested to upgrade the MCVideo group session to an MCVideo emergency call.

question_39928.question: What is the purpose of a quality qualification for vendors in SECAM?
question_39928.ground_truth: A quality qualification for vendors in SECAM aims to ensure that the manufacturer's design, development, and manufacturing processes are compliant with a recognized quality assurance standard. This is achieved through a regular review of the manufacturer's quality system as part of an accredited activity, such as an ISO 9000 or an appropriate regional equivalent accreditation.

question_39929.question: What should the NEF do when it receives traffic correlation notification from the SMF and determines that there is no common EAS IP address available for the UEs identified by the Traffic Correlation ID?
question_39929.ground_truth: The NEF should select a common DNAI and/or common EAS using the list of DNAI(s), EAS IP address, and the number of PDU sessions each SMF is serving for the set of UEs. Then, the NEF should update the traffic influence data in UDR with the 5GC determined common EAS/DNAI for the set of UEs.

question_39930.question: What is the purpose of the LSB TCQ for USQ decoding process?
question_39930.ground_truth: The LSB TCQ for USQ decoding process is designed to use the advantages of both USQ and TCQ quantizers in one scheme while excluding the path limitation from the TCQ. It is used to decode the path from the bit-stream and reconstruct the residual array using the arithmetic decoder.

question_39931.question: What should the AS not include in the 200 (OK) response to the initial SIP INVITE request if the AS has sent an SDP answer in a reliable provisional response to the initial SIP INVITE request?
question_39931.ground_truth: The AS shall not include any SDP in the 200 (OK) response to the initial SIP INVITE request.

question_39933.question: What will the GANC do if it receives an uplink message that is associated with a GA-PSR TC (Transport Connection) that does not exist?
question_39933.ground_truth: The GANC will process the message as defined in sub-clause 8.7.2. The GANC may disregard the uplink packet sequence number in this case and initiates GA-PSR TC activation procedure as defined in sub-clause 8.3.

question_39934.question: When, during a UE's connection handover, should the UE continue using the P-CSCF address(es) acquired in the other IP-CAN?
question_39934.ground_truth: If the UE obtains a connection with the IP-CAN through handover from another IP-CAN, and its IP address did not change during the handover, the UE should continue using the P-CSCF address(es) acquired from the other IP-CAN if the UE communicates with the IM CN subsystem via the connection.

question_39935.question: What is the purpose of the `alternativeAccessDelivery` element in the schema?
question_39935.ground_truth: The `alternativeAccessDelivery` element is used to extend the list of elements in the `MBMS deliveryMethod` element. It contains unicast access information for OMA push for MBMS download service when the UE is outside of home network and file download delivery method is used.

question_39936.question: What should the NG-RAN node not do for the concerned PDU session in terms of user plane ciphering?
question_39936.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node should not perform user plane ciphering for the concerned PDU session.

question_39937.question: What is the function of the MCPTT server when receiving an incoming MCPTT private call request for a call with multiple MCPTT UEs and designated MCPTT UE for receiving private calls?
question_39937.ground_truth: The incoming MCPTT private call request is delivered only to the designated MCPTT UE.

question_39939.question: What sources combined with narrowband and/or repetition operations can reach -164 dB MCL @160bps data rate, which meets the coverage requirement for NR, in non-orthogonal MA?

question_39940.question: What mechanism is defined in the 5GS system to allow the AMF to provide Target NSSAI and RFSP to RAN to steer the UE to another cell supporting network slices not available in a current cell?

question_39941.question: What is the change in version number indicates in the 3GPP Technical Specification for the Iuant interface in UTRA, E-UTRA, and NR?
question_39941.ground_truth: The first digit of the version number indicates the level of approval of the document, the second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, and the third digit is incremented when editorial only changes have been incorporated.

question_39942.question: What must be compatible for a UE to obtain a local emergency PDU session?
question_39942.ground_truth: The UE and PLMN must have compatible IP address versions in order for the UE to obtain a local emergency PDU session.

question_39943.question: What is the purpose of using OCSP stapling within the context of 5GC SBA?
question_39943.ground_truth: The purpose of using OCSP stapling within the context of 5GC SBA is to offload the consumption of client resources and the contact with the OCSP server, making the server responsible for performing OCSP requests, reducing latency, increasing the availability of the revocation service, and caching OCSP responses.

question_39944.question: Which bands may the 3rd order IMD products of Band (2 + 12 + 12) CA fall into and what is the recommended solution to avoid receiver desensitization?
question_39944.ground_truth: The 3rd order IMD products of Band (2 + 12 + 12) CA may fall into the BS receive band of Bands 22, 23, 25 and 42. To avoid BS receiver desensitization, it is recommended that the Band (2 + 12 + 12) BS transmitter should not share the same antenna with Band 22, 23, 25 or 42 BS receiver unless the antenna path meets very stringent 3rd order PIM specification. Note that antenna sharing may be allowed as the state-of-the-art continues to evolve in the future.

question_39946.question: What are some potential purposes for data collection in LCM?
question_39946.ground_truth: Some potential purposes include model training, model inference, model monitoring, model selection, and model update.

question_39947.question: What is the definition of a "mobile metaverse server" in the document?
question_39947.ground_truth: A mobile metaverse server is an application server that supports one or more mobile metaverse services to a user through the 5G system.

question_39948.question: How can a mobile station indicate a request for DTMF message transmission to the network?
question_39948.ground_truth: The mobile station initiates DTMF message transmission by sending a START DTMF message on an established FACCH, including the value of the digit to be transmitted (0, 1, ..., 9, A, B, C, D, *, #) in this message.

question_39949.question: What is the function of the "slice offset index" in the context of data writing position?
question_39949.ground_truth: The "slice offset index" is used to move back from the current output data writing position. It determines the starting position of the slice in the output buffer when writing data.

question_39950.question: What is one advantage of the approach enabling UEs to make the re-attach to the EPS possible after an MME partial failure?
question_39950.ground_truth: This approach ensures that UEs can re-attach to the EPS, allowing for continuous communication even after an MME failure.

question_39951.question: What is one way solution 26 enables users to meet KPIs while efficiently getting back to service if the UE temporarily needs to access a cell outside of the defined service area?
question_39951.ground_truth: By using existing mechanisms to allow UE access to cells outside the defined service area if there are resources, while still maintaining the S-NSSAI support on a per-TA level and reducing capabilities for the UE outside the defined service area.

question_39953.question: What field in VarRLF-Report represents the list of EPLMNs stored by the UE?
question_39953.ground_truth: plmn-IdentityList in VarRLF-Report represents the list of EPLMNs stored by the UE.

question_39954.question: What is the requirement for the 5G system's positioning service in terms of latency?
question_39954.ground_truth: The requirement for the 5G system's positioning service's latency is less than 1 second.

question_39955.question: What is the UE required to do during the measurement reporting delay for Test 2 in clause 14.5.1.2.4.1-3?
question_39955.ground_truth: The UE is required to read the neighbour cell SSB index and report the acquired SSB index in Test 2.

question_39956.question: What is the IDC level used for S3-JM-01 in the H.264/AVC anchors?
question_39956.ground_truth: LevelIDC is set to 42 or 52, depending on the resolution.

question_39957.question: What happens if the UE is not capable of receiving the same DL PRS resource simultaneously from multiple Rx TEGs in NR-DL-TDOA-RequestLocationInformation?
question_39957.ground_truth: If the UE is not capable of receiving the same DL PRS resource simultaneously from multiple Rx TEGs, the number of UE Rx TEGs that the UE is requested by LMF to measure the same DL-PRS Resource of a TRP is used, up to the maximum number of Rx TEGs with which UE can support to measure the same PRS resource as reported in NR-UE-TEG-Capability.

question_39958.question: What is the expected final state of the MS after the test procedure?
question_39958.ground_truth: The MS is in MM-state "idle, updated" with a valid TMSI.

question_39959.question: What is the IP version of the multicast IP address that should be set in the "c=" field in the session-level section of the SDP for an off-network MCVideo session?
question_39959.ground_truth: The <nettype> portion of the "c=" field in the session-level section of the SDP for an off-network MCVideo session should be set to "IN" and the <addrtype> portion should be set to the IP version of a multicast IP address of the MCVideo group.

question_39960.question: What is the purpose of the MBMS RAB Establishment Indication procedure?
question_39960.ground_truth: The purpose of the MBMS RAB Establishment Indication procedure is to inform the CN of the establishment of the MBMS RAB corresponding to the MBMS Iu signalling connection used for this procedure.

question_39961.question: What video codec format should be used for 720p HD services?
question_39961.ground_truth: H.264/AVC Progressive High Profile Level 3.1 or H.265/HEVC Main Profile Main Tier Level 3.1.

question_39964.question: Who returns the requested Segment to the MBMS client in step 14a)?
question_39964.ground_truth: The Content Server returns the requested Segment to the MBMS client in step 14a).

question_39966.question: What should the SCC AS do if it receives a SIP error response from the remote UE?
question_39966.ground_truth: The SCC AS should generate an I1 Failure message with an indication describing the error, such as No session exists for the incoming message, Message is badly formatted, or Message is out of sequence.

question_39968.question: What is the size of the vector representing the binary form of a basic midamble code?
question_39968.ground_truth: The size of the vector representing the binary form of a basic midamble code is 128.

question_39971.question: What information does the OCF send to the CTF in the Debit Units Response?
question_39971.ground_truth: The OCF sends the number of units granted as a result of the Debit Units Request in the Debit Units Response.

question_39972.question: What message type is sent by the network to the mobile station to request the mobile to establish a service for the specified CM protocol using the specified SAPI?

question_39973.question: What is the definition of 'ACRONYM' in the context of the present document?
question_39973.ground_truth: In the present document, 'ACRONYM' refers to a shortened form of a word or phrase, where the shorter form consists of initial letters (or other symbols) taken from the words or phrase, and where the initial letters form a pronounceable word, e.g., LTE (Long-Term Evolution).

question_39974.question: What is the function of Bit M1 in the multiframe structure?
question_39974.ground_truth: Bit M1 carries a 31-bit PN multiframe code 0000 1001 0110 0111 1100 0110 1110 101.

question_39977.question: What network element is responsible for discovering the SMF address based on the PGW-C address and TEID?
question_39977.ground_truth: The NRF (Next Generation Radio Access Network - Non-Real Time RAN Central Unit - Functions) is responsible for this task.

question_39979.question: What is the purpose of the serviceTypeDescription output in the second step of service discovery?
question_39979.ground_truth: The serviceTypeDescription output provides information about the property names associated with the SCF, the corresponding property value types, the corresponding property mode, the names of the super types of this type, and whether the type is currently enabled or disabled.

question_39980.question: How are MBSFN Areas used in MBMS system activation?
question_39980.ground_truth: MBSFN Areas are used to identify the exact area of distribution for the MBMS bearer, and the GCS AS chooses one or more MBSFN Area Ids corresponding exactly to the MBSFN Area Id to activate the bearer.

question_39982.question: In what bandwidth is the ACLR applied for BS?
question_39982.ground_truth: The ACLR should apply for both single and multi-carrier BS in the same bandwidth.

question_39983.question: What is the role of the PDN Connection in the context of 5G connectivity?
question_39983.ground_truth: The PDN Connection is a key component in 5G connectivity, allowing for the establishment of user-plane resources in both EPC and 5GC. It is used to simultaneously associate with user-plane resources on non-3GPP access in EPC and 3GPP access in 5GC, facilitating seamless handover and multi-connectivity.

question_39984.question: What is the difference between single-connection mode and multi-connection mode?
question_39984.ground_truth: Single-connection mode is used to establish a PDN connection over trusted WLAN access in single-connection mode, while multi-connection mode is used to establish a PDN connection over trusted WLAN access in multi-connection mode.

question_39986.question: What should a CC-entity of the MS in CC-state U4, "Call Delivered", do when the user requests to terminate the call?
question_39986.ground_truth: It should send a DISCONNECT message and enter the CC-state U11, "Disconnect Request".

question_39987.question: What is the SIP PUBLISH request expiration time set to when indicating that an MCVideo user is no longer interested in a group?
question_39987.ground_truth: The expiration time is set to zero.

question_39989.question: What is the standard general-purpose mechanism for the management of logs containing selected notifications from the network, as defined in the 3GPP TS 32.33x-series?
question_39989.ground_truth: The Notification log IRP, as defined in the 3GPP TS 32.33x-series, sets forth such a mechanism for the management of logs containing selected notifications from the network.

question_39992.question: What command is used to accept an incoming voice group or voice broadcast call in the "modem-compatible" mode of operation?
question_39992.ground_truth: The +CAJOIN command is used to accept an incoming voice group or voice broadcast call in the "modem-compatible" mode of operation.

question_39993.question: What is the purpose of the procedure for informing E-UTRAN about the application layer measurement report?
question_39993.ground_truth: The purpose of this procedure is to inform E-UTRAN about the application layer measurement report in RRC_CONNECTED state.

question_39994.question: What should the MCPTT client include in the Request-URI of a SIP PUBLISH request to indicate the originating participating MCPTT function serving the MCPTT user?
question_39994.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should set the Request-URI to the public service identity identifying the originating participating MCPTT function serving the MCPTT user in a SIP PUBLISH request.

question_39995.question: Which bands may have 3rd order IM products falling into the BS receive bands when B39 and B40 are used together?
question_39995.ground_truth: The 3rd order IMD products may fall into BS receive Bands of 1, 2, 3, 9, 11, 21, 23, 25, 30, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 39, 40, 41, 45, and 65 when considering the maximum bandwidth impact.

question_39997.question: What should the AMF do if there is a mismatch in the UE's 5G security capabilities between the source gNB/ng-eNB and the AMF's locally stored capabilities?
question_39997.ground_truth: The AMF will send its locally stored 5G security capabilities of the UE to the target gNB/ng-eNB in the Path-Switch Acknowledge message.

question_40000.question: What information does the "Requested timer" parameter in the 3GPP 5G DDNMF provide and what is its range?
question_40000.ground_truth: The "Requested timer" parameter indicates the length of the validity timer associated with the ProSe application code or the ProSe restricted code that the UE expects to receive from the 5G DDNMF. The range of this parameter is from 0 to 525600, representing the timer value in units of minutes.

question_40004.question: Which measurements are valid for packet switched traffic?
question_40004.ground_truth: All the measurements in section 4.1.2 are valid for packet switched traffic.

question_40005.question: What are the three scenarios of application interactions in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's technical specification?
question_40005.ground_truth: The three scenarios of application interactions in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's technical specification are application interaction between application servers, application interaction between providing entities, and application interaction between application types.

question_40006.question: What should the UE do if the detach procedure is received during the service request procedure?
question_40006.ground_truth: If the UE receives a DETACH REQUEST message from the network in state EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED, the UE should take the appropriate actions based on the detach type. If the service request was initiated for CS fallback and a CS fallback cancellation request was not received, the UE should attempt to select GERAN or UTRAN radio access technology and proceed with the appropriate MM, CC and GMM specific procedures. If not, the detach procedure should be progressed and the service request procedure should be aborted.

question_40008.question: Which 3GPP reference point and interfaces are used for the SIP-1 reference point between the MCPTT UE SIP User Agent Client and the SIP core to establish a session in support of MCPTT?
question_40008.ground_truth: The 3GPP Gm reference point (with necessary enhancements to support MCPTT requirements and profiled to meet the minimum requirements for support of MCPTT).

question_40009.question: What is the recommended solution to overcome the drawback of the mentioned technique?
question_40009.ground_truth: The recommended solution to overcome the drawback is the use of a "stress cable", or a rotary joint, connected to the main low-loss cable that is connected to the BTS simulator if using a single-polarized probe.

question_40012.question: What is the Doppler uncertainty for both GNSS-AcquisitionAssistances (BDS B1I and BDS B1C)?
question_40012.ground_truth: The Doppler uncertainty for both GNSS-AcquisitionAssistances is 2.5 m/s.

question_40013.question: What message type IE is used to identify the message being sent in RUA messages?

question_40014.question: What are the pre-conditions for initiating a real time video streaming?
question_40014.ground_truth: The pre-conditions for initiating a real time video streaming are that the streaming FRMCS User or FRMCS Equipment has registered to a functional identity that is authorized to initiate a real time video stream, and that the receiving FRMCS User or FRMCS Equipment has registered to a functional identity that is authorized to receive a real time video stream.

question_40015.question: What is the maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell, as specified in 6.1.2.3.5?
question_40015.ground_truth: The maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell is 1280 ms.

question_40016.question: What channel bandwidth would enable efficient usage of 5 GHz allocation in China and 5 GHz IMT allocation in Europe?
question_40016.ground_truth: Support of channel bandwidths such as 1.6 GHz or 2.4 GHz would enable efficient usage of the 5 GHz allocation.

question_40019.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the UE when it receives a RRC message implying E-UTRAN FDD - FDD Intra-band Inter-frequency async DAPS handover?
question_40019.ground_truth: The UE shall be ready to start the transmission of the new uplink PRACH channel within Dhandover1 seconds from the end of the last TTI containing the RRC command.

question_40020.question: What is the name of the mobile-based carpooling service that provides a safety benefit by only providing service to users with proven identities?

question_40021.question: How does a shorter Transmission Time Interval (TTI) affect the overall system performance in the LTE system?
question_40021.ground_truth: A shorter TTI provides faster Channel State Information (CSI) and Hybrid Automatic Repeat Request (HARQ), leading to more accurate rate control algorithms and better matching of selected data rates with rapidly changing radio conditions.

question_40022.question: What is the required TCI-state information that a UE should use to receive PDCCH and PDSCH in the new BWP if it does not have the required activated TCI-states information in the new BWP?
question_40022.ground_truth: The UE shall use old TCI-states before the BWP switch until a new MAC CE updating the required activated TCI-states information is received after the BWP switch.

question_40023.question: What is the definition of Bootstrapping information in GAA?
question_40023.ground_truth: Bootstrapping information in GAA consists of a bootstrapping transaction identifier (B-TID), key material (Ks), the key lifetime (expiry time), the boostrapinfo creation time, the IMPI, and the GUSS (if received from HSS) with BSF control information.

question_40024.question: What should the UE do when the timer F expires?
question_40024.ground_truth: The UE should stop processing of all ongoing dialogs and transactions associated with that flow, release all IP-CAN bearers used for the transport of media, select a different P-CSCF address, and perform the procedures for initial registration.

question_40025.question: What information is provided for each service data flow to apply charging differentiation per access type in NBIFOM charging?
question_40025.ground_truth: A different rating group and potentially different charging method, measurement method, and reporting level are provided for each service data flow in NBIFOM charging to apply charging differentiation per access type.

question_40026.question: What is the purpose of the Mobility below unchanged PSA in Solution #11 for Ethernet PDU Sessions?
question_40026.ground_truth: Mobility below unchanged PSA (PDU Session Anchor) is supported by the solution, which means it does not affect external mechanisms handling the multiple end-to-end paths. Handovers may still introduce interruptions, but in the case of a change of SgNB but the same MgNB, the path via the MgNB remains uninterrupted. Handovers may also lead to a change in end-to-end delay.

question_40027.question: In the solution set based on SOAP, what is used as a description language and what is used as a discovery "layer"?
question_40027.ground_truth: In the solution set based on SOAP, WSDL is used as a description language, and UDDI is used as a discovery "layer".

question_40028.question: What is the function of the energy ratio threshold in the transient detection algorithm?
question_40028.ground_truth: The energy ratio threshold is used to detect a transient in the input signal. If the energy ratio of a sub-frame is above this threshold, then a transient is detected.

question_40030.question: What is the procedure for closing a channel between the UICC and ME?
question_40030.ground_truth: The procedure for closing a channel between the UICC and ME involves the UICC sending a "CLOSE CHANNEL" command to the ME, which specifies the source and destination devices. The ME then responds with a "TERMINAL RESPONSE" command indicating whether the channel was closed successfully.

question_40031.question: What is the formula for calculating the percentage of unrestricted DL UE data volume in gNB?
question_40031.ground_truth: The formula for calculating the percentage of unrestricted DL UE data volume in gNB is: Percentage Unrestricted Volume DL = (Unrestricted Data Volume DL / Total DL Data Volume) x 100. The unrestricted data volume in DL refers to the volume that can be transferred in one slot and no UE throughput sample could be calculated. The total DL data volume is scheduled for each UE, regardless of using only primary- or also supplemental aggregated carriers.

question_40035.question: What does the field "D/U" in the Candidate Cell TCI States Activation/Deactivation MAC CE specify?
question_40035.ground_truth: The field "D/U" in the Candidate Cell TCI States Activation/Deactivation MAC CE indicates whether the TCI state ID in the same octet is for a joint/downlink or an uplink TCI state. If this field is set to 1, the TCI state ID in the same octet is for joint/downlink TCI state. If this field is set to 0, the TCI state ID in the same octet is for uplink TCI state.

question_40036.question: What does the SCF use to derive the MBMS User Key (MUK) if there is no B-TID stored for the UE or the received B-TID is different than the one stored for the UE?
question_40036.ground_truth: The SCF uses the NAF-Id and runs the GBA usage procedure with the BSF over Zn to fetch the NAF keys corresponding to the UE. Then, it derives the MUK from the NAF key as defined in 3GPP TS 33.246.

question_40038.question: What does the abbreviation "3GPP" in the document's title stand for?

question_40039.question: What is one of the responsibilities of the SCS in the context of group messaging using MBMS option 1?
question_40039.ground_truth: The SCS is responsible for sending the group messaging request (External Group Identifier, SCS Identifier, application layer content of the group message, location/area information, RAT(s) information) message to the MTC-IWF.

question_40040.question: What parameters are required for the timeslot shifting procedure in CTSBCH timeslot assignment?
question_40040.ground_truth: The required parameters for the timeslot shifting procedure in CTSBCH timeslot assignment are: TNI (initial timeslot number), BN3, BN2, and BN1, which are the three least significant bits of the FPBI.

question_40041.question: What are some of the elements of polygon meshes?
question_40041.ground_truth: Polygon meshes are defined by vertices, edges, faces, surfaces, groups, materials, and texture coordinates.

question_40045.question: What response should be sent by the ACR service when it rejects a communication due to the conditions specified in clause 4.5.2.6.2?
question_40045.ground_truth: The ACR service shall send a 433 (Anonymity Disallowed) response.

question_40046.question: What common notifications are valid for the IOCs using ChfInfo <dataType> and MFAFFunction <dataType>, without exceptions or additions?
question_40046.ground_truth: The common notifications defined in subclause 5.5 are valid for these IOCs.

question_40050.question: What is the default allocation of cells to carrier frequencies in the MBSFN testing on MBSFN clusters?
question_40050.ground_truth: By default, all cells will provide notification of all services available in that service area in MBSFN testing on MBSFN clusters.

question_40051.question: What action is taken by the ProSe Function serving user A when a Discovery Filter is to be revoked for a UE associated with a Banned PDUID in the same PLMN?
question_40051.ground_truth: The ProSe Function serving user A sends a Discovery Update Request (UE Identity, Discovery Entry ID, Update Info) message to that UE, and the UE removes the Discovery Filter from the ProSe Discovery services operation.

question_40052.question: What enhancements are necessary for IMS to efficiently support devices and networks with multiple slices and different IMS services per slice in 5GC network slicing?
question_40052.ground_truth: This would depend on the specific requirements of the network, but potential enhancements could include support for localized routing of traffic and placement of IMS elements, as well as optimizations for IMS media bearers, IMS signalling bearers, and IMS functions.

question_40054.question: What are the candidate events that are expected to be defined in the 5GMS system?
question_40054.ground_truth: The candidate events that are expected to be defined in the 5GMS system include Consumption reporting, Quality of Experience Metrics reporting, Network Assistance, QoS and Charging usage, and Access logs.

question_40055.question: What is the worst case flat ACLR for frequency offsets with downlink adjacent channel index greater than 40 and uplink adjacent channel index greater than 119 in the context of NB M2M?
question_40055.ground_truth: An adjacent channel leakage power ratio equal to ACLRadj-40 for the downlink and equal to ACLR adj-119 for the uplink.

question_40056.question: What is the minimum requirement for the PDSCH BLER using the transport format indicated by the median CQI in 6.2.2.2.1.4 and what must the BLER be for the transport format indicated by (median CQI-1) and (median CQI+1)?
question_40056.ground_truth: If the PDSCH BLER using the transport format indicated by the median CQI is greater than 0.1, then the BLER using the transport format indicated by (median CQI-1) shall be less than or equal to 0.1. If the PDSCH BLER using the transport format indicated by the median CQI is less than or equal to 0.1, then the BLER using the transport format indicated by (median CQI+1) shall be greater than 0.1.

question_40058.question: What is the purpose of the Write-Replace Warning procedure in this 3GPP communication standard?
question_40058.ground_truth: The Write-Replace Warning procedure is used to start or overwrite the broadcasting of warning messages. The procedure uses non UE-associated signalling to prioritize resources for processing the warning message.

question_40060.question: Which interface is used by the PGW to the ePDG for "UE/ePDG Initiated Detach with GTP on S2b" procedures?
question_40060.ground_truth: The S2b interface is used by the PGW to the ePDG for "UE/ePDG Initiated Detach with GTP on S2b" procedures.

question_40061.question: What is the purpose of the procedure described in 4.9.40?
question_40061.ground_truth: The purpose of the procedure described in 4.9.40 is to establish unicast mode ProSe Direct communication between two User Equipment (UE).

question_40062.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network's work item on LTE-Advanced Intra-band Contiguous Carrier Aggregation in Band 42?
question_40062.ground_truth: The purpose of the work item is to specify the RF requirements for intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation in Band 42, define transmission bandwidth combinations, and add performance requirements for this band in the relevant specifications.

question_40063.question: What action should the MSGin5G Client take upon receiving a request/response message from the Application Client indicating a delivery status report?
question_40063.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Client constructs and sends a CoAP POST request to the MSGin5G Server as specified in clause 6.4.1.1.4.

question_40066.question: What is the maximum value for the guaranteed bit rate for downlink defined in this version of the protocol?
question_40066.ground_truth: The maximum value for the guaranteed bit rate for downlink defined in this version of the protocol is 10 Gbps.

question_40067.question: What are the service offerings in DASH-based signalling for Linear / Live TV using MBMS?
question_40067.ground_truth: The service offerings in DASH-based signalling for Linear / Live TV using MBMS are carried over MBMS bearers as well as using unicast bearers, with unicast bearers offering constant and guaranteed bitrate services. A single video representation is offered over an MBMS bearer in a single MBSFN if the service is a video service. The used resolution is typically in the area of WVGA (854x480) and HD (1280x720). The MBMS bearers offer angular and temporal diversity, and the DASH media segment duration is in range of 1 sec to 2 sec.

question_40068.question: What service corresponds to the CS-domain use of CLIR in a temporary mode in IMS?
question_40068.ground_truth: The IMS provides the core CLIR functionality, which corresponds to the CS-Domain use of CLIR in a temporary mode.

question_40070.question: What are the steps for the SLPP Error Detection procedure in section 5.4.3?
question_40070.ground_truth: Upon receiving an SLPP message, the receiving entity shall attempt to decode it and verify the presence of any errors. If decoding errors are encountered, the receiving entity shall return an SLPP Error message and include the SessionID and the SLPP-TransactionID, if they were decoded, and type of error. If the message is a duplicate, it shall be discarded. If the message is invalid for the current state of the procedure, the procedure shall be aborted and an SLPP Error message shall be returned.

question_40071.question: What should the participating MCVideo function do when it receives a transmission control message associated with a session and an MBMS subchannel is not used for that session?
question_40071.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function should immediately forward the transmission control message to the transmission participant if it is received from the transmission control server and an MBMS subchannel is not used for a transmission in the session.

question_40072.question: What information is provided in the output of the listTypes method?
question_40072.ground_truth: The output of the listTypes method is a list of service type names, which includes standardized or non-standardized SCF names.

question_40073.question: What is the purpose of the InitiatingEntity parameter?
question_40073.ground_truth: The InitiatingEntity parameter is used to indicate the entity that initiated the service change, which can be a mobile station, SGSN, HLR, or GGSN.

question_40074.question: What is the role of EES (OP-B) in the service provisioning response in step 4?
question_40074.ground_truth: EES (OP-B) determines its own endpoint and the endpoint of EES (OP-A) in the service provisioning response based on the SLA with OP-A, allowing any EES (OP-B) to be authorized by the EES (OP-A).

question_40075.question: What does the <ccstatus> parameter indicate and what values can it take?
question_40075.ground_truth: The <ccstatus> parameter is an integer type that indicates the state of the call. It can take the following values: 0 (Idle), 1 (Calling (MO); the call setup has been started), 2 (Connecting (MO); the call is in progress), 3 (Alerting (MO): an alert indication has been received), 4 (Alerting (MT); an alert indication has been sent), 5 (Active; the connection is established), 6 (Released; an outgoing (MO) call is released), 7 (Released; an incoming (MT) call is released), 9 (User busy), 10 (User determined user busy), 11 (Call waiting (MO)), and 12 (Call waiting (MT)).

question_40076.question: In the sentence "This service: allows NF service consumers to store data or analytics in the ADRF, and request/receive notifications about data or analytics that are about to be deleted; allows NF service consumers to retrieve data or analytics from an ADRF; and allows NF service consumers to delete data or analytics from an ADRF.", what does "NF" stand for?
question_40076.ground_truth: "NF" in the context of the document stands for Network Function.

question_40077.question: What is the aim of the "2 out of 3 approach" in the call control related measurements?
question_40077.ground_truth: The aim of the "2 out of 3 approach" is to ensure the reliability of the call control measurements by requiring the fulfillment of at least two out of three conditions for the successful calls.

question_40078.question: What mutual indication is used by the SN and MN to notify whenever QoS requirements for GBR QoS flows cannot be fulfilled anymore or can be fulfilled again in MR-DC with 5GC?
question_40078.ground_truth: SN and MN may indicate whenever QoS requirements for GBR QoS flows cannot be fulfilled anymore or can be fulfilled again. When indicating that GBR QoS flows cannot be fulfilled anymore, SN or MN may additionally indicate the reference to the QoS Parameter Set which it can currently fulfil.

question_40079.question: What is the main function of the SEAL-UU reference point in the application plane?
question_40079.ground_truth: The SEAL-UU reference point supports interactions between a SEAL client and the corresponding SEAL server, enabling generic functionalities for the SEAL service in the SIP core.

question_40081.question: What is the role of the PEMC in the PIN discovery process?
question_40081.ground_truth: The PEMC is responsible for routing the PIN discovery request to the PIN server, performing an authorization check, and sending the PIN discovery response back to the PIN client via PEGC. Additionally, the PEMC may provide the PEGC IP address to the PIN element.

question_40083.question: Which RRM requirements, legacy or enhanced, result in lower mobility failure rates and time-of-outage in the bi-directional Scenario-A without DPS?

question_40084.question: How does the 5G network, in tandem with the Company X's IoT application platform, contribute to the smart laundry use case?
question_40084.ground_truth: The 5G network and the Company X's IoT application platform work together to perform inventory and report the Ambient IoT device attached to the clothes, negotiate the frequency of inventory and report based on user requests, and transmit the necessary information to determine an appropriate laundry mode for washing the specific clothes.

question_40085.question: What is a requirement for providing alternative means for the UE to access the service without using MBMS bearer capabilities?
question_40085.ground_truth: To prevent network overload and to allow for error correction, file downloading, network charging, decryption key transfer, and access to MBMS content if missed due to UE being out of coverage or switched off.

question_40086.question: What must the 3GPP AAA server always (re)request to ensure an unmodified copy of the user identity, regardless of the identity received in EAP-Response/Identity?
question_40086.ground_truth: The 3GPP AAA server must always (re)request the user identity using EAP-Request/AKA-Identity or EAP-Request/SIM/Start.

question_40087.question: What should the UE do if the upper layers provide one or more S-NSSAI in the NB-IoT UE procedure?
question_40087.ground_truth: The UE should include the s-NSSAI-list and set the content to the values provided by the upper layers.

question_40088.question: What is the effect of "operator policies allow forming requests from a URI and if 3xx response is received" on the procedures for forming requests?
question_40088.ground_truth: If operator policies allow forming requests from a URI and a 3xx response is received, then the E-CSCF follows the procedures of RFC 3261 subclause 19.1.5 with the added condition that replacement or inclusion of any header field is subject to operator policy.

question_40090.question: What should UEs that had earlier registered for normal services but cannot be authenticated by the serving network do to request emergency services?
question_40090.ground_truth: They should initiate the Emergency Registration procedure to request emergency services.

question_40091.question: What action should the participating MCVideo function take upon receiving a SIP request that requires implicit affiliation of the sending MCVideo client to an MCVideo group?
question_40091.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function should determine the served MCVideo client ID and the MCVideo group ID from the received SIP request, and then determine the served MCVideo ID from the P-Asserted-Identity header field.

question_40092.question: How is the energy of each sub-frame calculated in this process?
question_40092.ground_truth: The energy of each sub-frame is calculated by squaring the sum of the absolute values of the samples in the sub-frame and dividing by the sub-frame length.

question_40093.question: What are the guidelines for filling in the <TAC-low-byte>, <TAC-middle-byte>, and <TAC-high-byte> in the 5GS Tracking Area Identity based ePDG FQDN using a 3 octet TAC?
question_40093.ground_truth: The guidelines for filling in the <TAC-low-byte>, <TAC-middle-byte>, and <TAC-high-byte> is to insert "0" digit(s) at the left side to fill the 2-digits coding if there are less than 2 significant digits in <TAC-low-byte>, <TAC-middle-byte>, or <TAC-high-byte> in the 5GS Tracking Area Identity based ePDG FQDN using a 3 octet TAC.

question_40094.question: What is the role of the ProSe Code Suffix in the ProSe Code of the ProSe Function?
question_40094.ground_truth: The ProSe Code Suffix is a part of the ProSe Code that is under the control of the announcing application and represents application-specific information.

question_40095.question: What is the role of GA-SM in EGAN implementation?
question_40095.ground_truth: GA-SM is responsible for managing and maintaining PDP context towards the EGANC in EGAN implementation.

question_40096.question: What security procedure is followed during the L2 UE-to-UE Relay reselection using Re-Keying solution?
question_40096.ground_truth: The exchange of security parameters during the UE-to-UE Relay reselection procedure triggers the establishment of new E2E security keys used for the security over the second L2 UE-to-UE Relay in the L2 UE-to-UE Relay reselection using Re-Keying solution. The new security keys are then used for the security of a new PC5 unicast link between the End UEs via the second relay.

question_40098.question: What is meant by "changed instance / alarm" in the context of Delta Synchronization?
question_40098.ground_truth: A managed object instance or alarm is considered "changed" if it is present at the beginning of a period and absent at the end, absent at the beginning and present at the end, or if at least one of its attribute/parameter values is different at the beginning and the end of the period.

question_40099.question: What is the role of the AUSF when verifying the response RES from the UE?
question_40099.ground_truth: The AUSF verifies if the received response RES matches the stored and expected response XRES. If the AUSF has successfully verified, it will continue with the subsequent procedures, otherwise it will return an error to the NSWO NF.

question_40101.question: What is the objective of the traffic path optimization for remote control link?
question_40101.ground_truth: The objective is to minimize the latency of the transmission path for the remote control link between UAV and controller in the MNO network.

question_40102.question: In which situation is the CELP synthesis extended by ringing in the described passage?
question_40102.ground_truth: The CELP synthesis is extended by ringing in the overlap region when the coded audio bandwidth is higher than the bandwidth of the core CELP coder, and it's used to repeat 6.25 ms of high-band signal.

question_40104.question: What is the decision of the CT1 working group for session replication by the SCC AS in push mode, based on subclause 5.7.2?
question_40104.ground_truth: The evaluations and conclusions in subclause 5.7.1 equally apply to the case for session replication by the SCC AS in push mode.

question_40105.question: What is included in a Link Identifier Update Response message?
question_40105.ground_truth: The message includes the new identifier(s) to use, including new Layer-2 ID, Security Information, and optionally new Application Layer ID and IP address/prefix if IP communication is used.

question_40106.question: What should the UE do upon fulfilling the event condition for a periodic report type for a specific measurement?
question_40106.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the measurement reporting procedure, as specified in clause 5.5.5, and include the concerned cell(s) in the cellsTriggeredList.

question_40107.question: What should the SMF do if the SMF Includes the RQ timer IE set to an RQ timer value in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message for reflective QoS supported?
question_40107.ground_truth: If the SMF considers that reflective QoS is supported for QoS flows belonging to this PDU session, the SMF may include the RQ timer IE set to an RQ timer value in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message.

question_40108.question: What message type is sent by the UE if the IE "Measurement command" has the value "modify" in the 3GPP protocol?
question_40108.ground_truth: A MEASUREMENT CONTROL message is sent by the UE if the IE "Measurement command" has the value "modify" in the 3GPP protocol.

question_40110.question: What should the UE do when it receives a 401 (Unauthorized) response to the REGISTER request?
question_40110.ground_truth: On receiving a 401 (Unauthorized) response to the REGISTER request, the UE shall extract the RAND and AUTN parameters and check the validity of the authentication challenge as specified in 3GPP TS 33.203.

question_40111.question: Which ProSe direct discovery type is indicated by the value '0100' in the Message Type parameter?
question_40111.ground_truth: Content Type '0100' is used for model A announcing and for model B discoveree operation in UE-to-Network Relay Discovery Announcement or UE-to-Network Relay Discovery Response.

question_40113.question: What action should the new eNB take if the Bearer Type IE in the RETRIEVE UE CONTEXT RESPONSE message is set to "non IP"?
question_40113.ground_truth: The new eNB should not perform IP header compression for the concerned E-RAB.

question_40114.question: What options are defined for enhanced QoS Monitoring and Control in Solution #16 for eV2X over Uu Interface?
question_40114.ground_truth: Option 1 is RAN based multi-QoS profile, and Option 2 is CN based multi-QoS profile.

question_40115.question: What is the name of the key establishment method used in Solution #10?

question_40117.question: Which connection control protocol can be used for the A interface connection element layer 1?
question_40117.ground_truth: The A interface connection element layer 1 can use 3GPP TS 48.004.

question_40119.question: When does the SMF need to send an Access-Request message to the DN-AAA in the 5G core network?
question_40119.ground_truth: The SMF sends an Access-Request message to the DN-AAA when there is an IPv4 address and/or IPv6 prefix change in the PDU session that is not terminated.

question_40121.question: Which bands can the 3rd IMD products of Band 2 may fall into when transmitting contiguous Band 2 carriers?
question_40121.ground_truth: The 3rd IMD products of Band 2 may fall into the BS receive band of Bands 1, 2, 23, 25, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, and 39 when transmitting contiguous Band 2 carriers.

question_40122.question: What is the purpose of the SDP offer in the SIP INVITE message for a NPVR request?
question_40122.ground_truth: The SDP offer in the SIP INVITE message includes the media, transport, and session description for the NPVR request. This is used to set up the media streams, IP addresses, and RTP ports for the recording session.

question_40125.question: What is the role of the functional alias in the MCData FD request procedure?
question_40125.ground_truth: The functional alias is used to address the target MCData client and can be shared with other MCData users. It may also be used to activate or deactivate the functional alias controlling server within the MC system.

question_40126.question: What happens to the existing bearer when ALCAP is implemented by Q.AAL2 in step 7.8.1.1 and step 7.8.1.2?
question_40126.ground_truth: When ALCAP is implemented by Q.AAL2, it implies the release of the existing bearer and the establishment of a new one.

question_40127.question: What is the role of "cg-SDT-RSRP-ChangeThreshold" in TA validation for CG-SDT?
question_40127.ground_truth: It is an RSRP threshold for the increase/decrease of RSRP for time alignment validation.

question_40130.question: Which European body is working on channeling arrangements in the band 3400-3800 MHz for IMT and when is the deliverable expected to be finalized?
question_40130.ground_truth: ECC PT1 is working on channeling arrangements in the band 3400-3800 MHz for IMT and plans to finalize the draft deliverable in January 2011.

question_40131.question: In what scenarios does the serving node report a change of UE presence in Presence Reporting Area?
question_40131.ground_truth: The serving node reports a change of UE presence in Presence Reporting Area when the MME has been explicitly requested to report location changes to the PDN GW for the UE, or when the UE enters or leaves a Presence Reporting Area defined for the UE.

question_40136.question: What is the main function of the BSSGP protocol in the context of the Gb interface?
question_40136.ground_truth: The main function of the BSSGP protocol is to provide the radio-related, QoS, and routeing information that is required to transmit user data between a BSS and an SGSN.

question_40137.question: Are the algorithms specified in the document mandatory for use as GSM authentication and key generation functions?
question_40137.ground_truth: No, the algorithms specified in the document are not mandatory. The A3 and A8 functions are operator-specifiable and not fully standardized.

question_40138.question: What does the '1' value of the TF bit in the A-Interface Type coding indicate for the Codec Type?
question_40138.ground_truth: TFO Support is selected for this Codec Type.

question_40139.question: What is the role of the PSAP in using a NOVES device in an emergency situation?
question_40139.ground_truth: The PSAP has the capability to attribute all emergency sessions and media content to the originating device and prioritize emergency sessions over non-emergency sessions by the network.

question_40140.question: What is the maximum number of RRC messages and their size needed for performing any desired EPS bearer deactivation during an idle mode TAU procedure?
question_40140.ground_truth: Probably 6 or less RRC messages of less than 20 bytes.

question_40141.question: What is the average basic audio quality score for 3rd order Ambisonics encoded with HE-AACv2 at 256 kbps, averaged across all test conditions?
question_40141.ground_truth: The average basic audio quality score for 3rd order Ambisonics encoded with HE-AACv2 at 256 kbps, averaged across all test conditions, is within the Fair range (40-60 MUSHRA points).

question_40143.question: What does the To header contain in the SIP MESSAGE request?
question_40143.ground_truth: The To header contains the IP-SM-GW.

question_40144.question: What information must the source SGSN include in the Forward Relocation Request message if none of the UE's EPS bearers can be supported by the selected target MME?
question_40144.ground_truth: The source SGSN sends a PS Handover Required Negative Acknowledge (Cause) message to the Source BSS to reject the handover attempt.

question_40145.question: What should the terminating BSS do if the Network ID in the GCR is different from its own Network ID in 4.3.2.3?
