question_40502.question: What message is used by the MS to request the establishment of a parallel MM transaction for supplementary service transaction of erasure of call forwarding?
question_40502.ground_truth: The MS sends a CM SERVICE REQUEST message.

question_40503.question: How does the client algorithm based on buffer fill level determine the media rate?
question_40503.ground_truth: The client algorithm based on buffer fill level determines the media rate by gradually increasing it with the increase of buffer fullness, selecting the lowest media quality when the buffer fullness is 30% or lower, and the highest media rate when the buffer fullness is 80% or higher.

question_40506.question: What should the UE do when it needs to initiate an access attempt and the MPS indicator bit of the 5GS network feature support IE is not set to "Access identity 1 valid in RPLMN or equivalent PLMN" in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
question_40506.ground_truth: The UE should not consider access identity 1 to be valid in this case.

question_40508.question: Which element should be set to true if a list of Relayed-MCData-Group is needed?

question_40509.question: Which channels are used for RF tests for single carrier in 6.2.4.1?
question_40509.ground_truth: The RF channels used for RF tests for single carrier in 6.2.4.1 are B, M, and T.

question_40510.question: What attribute is used to indicate the ID of the established PDU session in a notification?

question_40511.question: What is the meaning of "shall" in the Technical Report?
question_40511.ground_truth: "Shall" in the Technical Report indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

question_40514.question: What is the role of the XML schema in the OIP and OIR services in the 3GPP network?
question_40514.ground_truth: The XML schema is used to define the operator part of the Originating Identity Presentation (OIP) and Originating Identity Restriction (OIR) services in the 3GPP network.

question_40517.question: What is the minimum requirement for single RAT E-UTRA operation in relation to minimum in-band blocking?
question_40517.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for single RAT E-UTRA operation for in-band blocking is defined as applicable outside the Base Station RF Bandwidth or Radio Bandwidth. The interfering signal offset is defined relative to the Base Station RF Bandwidth edges or Radio Bandwidth edges applicable to each RIB. For RIB supporting operation in non-contiguous spectrum, the requirement applies inside any sub-block gap, in case the sub-block gap size is at least 15 MHz.

question_40518.question: What is the recommended approach to the current BS OTA TAE requirements in clause 9.6.3 of TS 38.104?
question_40518.ground_truth: It is recommended to consider improvements to TAE requirements as the current requirement has been in place since UMTS, and the performance has improved in the past 20 years.

question_40520.question: What function does the N3IWF provide in a 5G network with non-3GPP access?
question_40520.ground_truth: The N3IWF provides the interface between a non-3GPP access network and the 5G Core Network CP and UP functions via the N2 and N3 interfaces, respectively.

question_40521.question: What is the function of the "Packet Filtering Information" in the charging system-based solution?
question_40521.ground_truth: The "Packet Filtering Information" provides the billing system enough information about the 3GPP PS Data Off status, enabling the charging system to know if the service is on or off.

question_40522.question: How can a network operator deal with UC generated unintentionally by the user or a UC generating virus outside the MNO network?
question_40522.ground_truth: By providing security updates to devices sending UC and identifying UC through complaint calls to customer service centers.

question_40523.question: In case of PS to CS domain change from S1 mode due to SRVCC or vSRVCC handover and the "null integrity protection algorithm" EIA0 has been used, what should the MS and network do at the PDN connection without integrity protection?
question_40523.ground_truth: The MS and network should not perform key derivation.

question_40524.question: What action does the network take regarding the paging restriction when the UE initiates the registration procedure for initial registration and indicates "emergency registration" in the 5GS registration type IE?
question_40524.ground_truth: The network shall not indicate the support of the paging restriction when the UE initiates the registration procedure for initial registration and indicates "emergency registration" in the 5GS registration type IE.

question_40526.question: What is the purpose of the trackside maintenance warning system in the FRMCS system?
question_40526.ground_truth: The trackside maintenance warning system in the FRMCS system allows for ongoing data communication between various users, which can be terminated under specific conditions.

question_40527.question: Which method is used to retrieve one or more parts of a multipart message from a specific message and folder in the mailbox?

question_40528.question: What is the average overlap of PSNR ranges in Scenario 1 for AV1 and H.264/AVC?
question_40528.ground_truth: The average overlap of PSNR ranges in Scenario 1 for AV1 and H.264/AVC is 53%.

question_40529.question: When would the IRI-POI in the SMF generate an xIRI containing an SMFMAPDUSessionEstablishment record for an MA-Upgrade-Allowed PDU session?
question_40529.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the SMF generates an xIRI containing an SMFMAPDUSessionEstablishment record when a PDU session has been established for the target UE that is an MA PDU session or where the upgrade allowed parameter is set to upgrade allowed and the session is established as an ordinary PDU session.

question_40530.question: How should migrated MC service users utilize the PLMN when accessing MC services in a partner MC system?
question_40530.ground_truth: Migrated MC service users should utilize the PLMN used by the partner MC system to access MC services in the partner MC system, but utilizing the PLMN used by the primary MC system is not precluded.

question_40531.question: What information is provided by a trusted non-3GPP access network during STa access authentication and authorization?
question_40531.ground_truth: During STa access authentication and authorization, a trusted non-3GPP access network provides information on its PMIPv6 or GTPv2 capabilities and the Access Network Identity (ANID) to the 3GPP AAA Server.

question_40532.question: What should the 5G system support to enable operator-controlled alternative authentication methods for network access for IoT devices in isolated deployment scenarios?
question_40532.ground_truth: Different types of credentials for network access

question_40533.question: Who forwards the Segments and/or MPD updates for service X to the local HTTP proxy/cache in step 22)?
question_40533.ground_truth: The MBMS client forwards the Segments and/or MPD updates for service X to the local HTTP proxy/cache in step 22).

question_40534.question: What is the streaming protocol used by SCTP in the Xn-C signalling bearer in the NG-RAN?
question_40534.ground_truth: SCTP is used as the transport layer of the Xn-C signalling bearer, and supports two payload protocol identifiers (ppid) of 61 and 67 for XnAP and DTLS over SCTP, respectively. The byte order of the ppid is big-endian.

question_40536.question: What is a Repeater in the context of 3GPP network?
question_40536.ground_truth: A Repeater is a device in the 3GPP network that receives, amplifies and transmits the radiated or conducted RF carrier both in the down-link direction (from the base station to the mobile area) and in the up-link direction (from the mobile to the base station).

question_40538.question: What is the solution for Restricted ProSe Direct Discovery (on demand announcing) in the ProSe Function?
question_40538.ground_truth: The solution involves the Announce Request procedure and the addition of the Announcing Alert procedure, which is used to trigger announcing for the restricted ProSe Direct Discovery and on demand announcing mechanism.

question_40539.question: What action is taken by the SMS-SC when the trigger message is pending at SMS-SC or if the trigger message delivery fails after being sent to the UE?
question_40539.ground_truth: The SMS-SC deletes the stored trigger message and requests the HSS to remove the SMS-SC address from the Message Waiting List.

question_40541.question: What is the task of the sending UE when performing groupcast security in 3GPP Sidelink Positioning system?
question_40541.ground_truth: The message sending UE performs the following operations: Construct the message, select a valid PGK, generate the PTK, PSK, PEK and PIK, calculate MAC, and if message confidentiality protection is enabled, encrypt the Payload and MAC.

question_40543.question: Who determines the precedence handling of incoming railway emergency voice communication?
question_40543.ground_truth: The prioritisation application determines the precedence handling of incoming railway emergency voice communication within the FRMCS System.

question_40545.question: What happens when a mobile phone is infected with a virus, in terms of network traffic and user charges?
question_40545.ground_truth: The infected mobile phone will distribute large quantities of junk data through SPIM/SPIT continuously to the telecommunication network, resulting in network traffic jam and additional charges to the user's account.

question_40546.question: Which functions are impacted by the new procedures for Slice authentication at first PDU session establishment for the S-NSSAI?
question_40546.ground_truth: The UE, AMF, SMF, and AAA server are impacted by the new procedures for Slice authentication at first PDU session establishment for the S-NSSAI.

question_40548.question: What should the UE do upon reception of a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-network relay discovery response?
question_40548.ground_truth: The UE should use the associated DUSK and UTC-based counter obtained during the reception operation to unscramble and decrypt the message, and use the DUIK and UTC-based counter to verify the MIC field in the unscrambled PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-network relay discovery response.

question_40550.question: What is the effect of the RRBP allocation on one carrier colliding with a USF allocation on another carrier in EGPRS?
question_40550.ground_truth: This results in the same uplink block being granted on more than one carrier at the same time, which is defined as a conflict. The MS shall respond in one of them based on the priorities defined in 3GPP TS 44.060.

question_40551.question: What information is mandatory for the PCEF to include in the authorization request to the PCRF for IP-CAN Bearer establishment?
question_40551.ground_truth: The PCEF must include UE Identity, PDN identifier, IP-CAN type, IPv4 address and IPv6 network prefix (if available), PDN Connection Identifier, default charging method, and IP-CAN bearer establishment modes supported. It may also include the TDF IP address and information on whether PCEF is enhanced with ADC.

question_40552.question: What action should the network take if the REGISTRATION REQUEST message with 5GS registration type IE set to "initial registration" received in state 5GMM-REGISTERED is considered not to be sent by a genuine UE?
question_40552.ground_truth: The network should maintain the 5GMM-context, if any, unchanged.

question_40553.question: In the provided code, what is the presence of "Heartbeat-Interval" in the "ServingCellInfo-FDD-v920"?
question_40553.ground_truth: The presence of "Heartbeat-Interval" in the "ServingCellInfo-FDD-v920" is optional.

question_40554.question: What is the function of an NGN in case of a public network traffic emergency call?
question_40554.ground_truth: An NGN forwards geographical location information received from an NGCN and possibly uses it for routing to an appropriate PSAP if it's a public network traffic emergency call.

question_40556.question: What is the purpose of the group key identifier (GDK-ID) in an SDS message?
question_40556.ground_truth: The GDK-ID in an SDS message is used to identify the group key for confidentiality protecting the MC Service signalling parameters and MCData signalling parameters in a SDS message.

question_40557.question: What should the SMF do if it receives such a request from the NF Service Consumer?
question_40557.ground_truth: The SMF should return a "204 No Content" response and decide whether to release the PDU session or deactivate the user plane connection of the PDU session.

question_40558.question: In the context of 3GPP and IMS, what does the term "Controller capable UE" mean?
question_40558.ground_truth: A UE that is capable of becoming a controller UE in an IMS service continuity context.

question_40559.question: What action is taken by the PDN GW when dynamic PCC is not deployed and a Handover Indication is present?
question_40559.ground_truth: The PDN GW applies local QoS policy and may establish dedicated bearers for the UE.

question_40560.question: What is the pre-condition for EAS discovery in edge node sharing scenario?
question_40560.ground_truth: ECSP-1 and ECSP-2 should have a service level agreement to share edge services.

question_40562.question: What triggers the VAL UE to switch from broadcast MBS session to unicast delivery?
question_40562.ground_truth: The VAL UE switches to unicast delivery when it detects bad broadcast reception quality, such as moving out of the broadcast service area.

question_40563.question: What is the blocking signal power level at the NB-IoT BS receiver with 23dBm interfering LTE UE and 31dBm interfering HPUE?
question_40563.ground_truth: The 99.99%-tile received blocking signal power levels are around -56dBm and -48dBm, respectively, with 23dBm interfering LTE UE and 31dBm interfering HPUE.

question_40564.question: What is the scaling factor used in the minimum conducted requirement for 1-H type NR BS in FR1?
question_40564.ground_truth: The scaling factor used in the minimum conducted requirement for 1-H type NR BS in FR1 is N, which is equal to or less than 8.

question_40565.question: What measurement can the user equipment (UE) include in the LPP Provide Location Information message when initiating a location information delivery procedure in WLAN positioning?
question_40565.ground_truth: The UE can include WLAN information or a location estimate already available at the UE in the LPP Provide Location Information message.

question_40566.question: What is the definition of interruption time TLTM-interrupt?
question_40566.ground_truth: The interruption time TLTM-interrupt is the time between the end of the last TTI containing the MAC-CE command for LTM cell switch until the time the UE transmits the first UL message on the target cell, excluding Tcmd. This value is measured in milliseconds.

question_40569.question: What is the resulting action when the priority in the UPLINK REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message is greater than the current talker priority?
question_40569.ground_truth: When the priority in the UPLINK REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message is greater than the current talker priority, the BSS updates the current talker priority and releases the uplink for an MS being pre-empted if it is served by this BSS.

question_40570.question: What should a floor participant do upon receiving a Floor Taken message from another floor participant?
question_40570.ground_truth: The floor participant should set the stored SSRC of the current floor arbitrator to the SSRC of the granted floor participant in the Floor Taken message, reset the value of the counter C201 to 1, restart timer T201, and remain in 'O: pending request' state.

question_40571.question: What message does the IWF2 send to the HSS in the last step of the "Notification" procedure in a two IWFs scenario?
question_40571.ground_truth: The IWF2 sends NOA to the HSS in the last step of the "Notification" procedure in a two IWFs scenario.

question_40572.question: What is the purpose of the Supported-Features AVP in the S6c or SGd Diameter applications?
question_40572.ground_truth: The Supported-Features AVP in the S6c or SGd Diameter applications is used to identify features that have been defined by 3GPP and to advertise support for new functionality that might introduce backwards incompatible changes.

question_40575.question: In the context of the sl-MeasResultServingRelay when the UE is acting as L2 U2N Remote UE, what does SL-RSRP refer to?
question_40575.ground_truth: SL-RSRP stands for Serving L2 U2N Relay Reference Signal Received Power. It is a measurement of the power level received by the UE from a reference signal transmitted by a serving L2 U2N Relay UE.

question_40576.question: What information related to user plane security enforcement is determined by the SMF upon PDU session establishment?
question_40576.ground_truth: The User Plane Security Enforcement information, including whether Integrity Protection is "Preferred" or "Required" and the corresponding UE Integrity Protection Maximum Data Rate, is determined by the SMF upon PDU session establishment.

question_40577.question: What is the method to calculate the sum of all observed packet sizes for IPv6 packets in the EPS bearer packet flow?
question_40577.ground_truth: The sum of all observed packet sizes for IPv6 packets is the sum of the values contained in the Payload Length field for each packet as specified in IETF RFC 2460.

question_40578.question: What is the role of the SCMF in selecting the common DNAI?
question_40578.ground_truth: The SCMF selects the common DNAI for the collection of UEs that should use a common local part of DN and common EAS. This is a core procedure in the solution and it is part of all solution variants.

question_40579.question: What is the NOTIFY request message content when the invocation of the requested CC service is rejected by the terminating AS due to the maximum number of requests queued against destination B?
question_40579.ground_truth: The NOTIFY request message content will include a 480 (Temporarily Unavailable) response.

question_40580.question: What should be used to ensure an identical or similar source bit-rates when inter-working between IPv4 and IPv6 networks for video?
question_40580.ground_truth: b=AS in IPv6 should be assumed to be a product of b=AS in IPv4 and 1.04, rounded down to a nearest integer, when other information that can be used to re-compute b=AS in IPv6 from b=AS in IPv4 is not present. Likewise, b=AS in IPv4 should be assumed to be a product of b=AS in IPv6 and 0.96, rounded up to a nearest integer.

question_40581.question: What formula is used to calculate TRS from the measured data in 7.2.1.2?
question_40581.ground_truth: TRS is calculated using the formula in Subclause 7.2.1.2, which is a function of EIS and frequency.

question_40582.question: Which test cases, including the specific clauses, apply to UE maximum output power - Spherical coverage in NR UE release 15 and forward?
question_40582.ground_truth: 6.2A.1.2.1.x (x refers to the specific test case, such as 1, 2, or 3) covering 2UL CA, 3UL CA, and 4UL CA, apply to UE maximum output power - Spherical coverage in NR UE release 15 and forward. These test cases are not applicable for certain bandwidth classes due to the lack of appropriate test points.

question_40583.question: What is an example of an undesired application interaction?
question_40583.ground_truth: An example of an undesired application interaction is when applications conflict, meaning application features cannot be realized when they work at the same time.

question_40585.question: What is the difference between GPRS-Attach and GPRS-Detach?
question_40585.ground_truth: GPRS-Attach is the process of indicating the UE's presence to the PLMN for the purpose of using GPRS services, while GPRS-Detach is the process of indicating to the PLMN that the UE will no longer be using the GPRS services.

question_40586.question: What information must the MCS UE indicate to the user if manual partner MC system selection is enabled?
question_40586.ground_truth: The MCS UE shall indicate to the user the identities of all partner MC systems that satisfy conditions 1)-3) in clause 4.2.2.1.2.2.2.

question_40587.question: What should the SIP Request URI and To headers be when sending a vnd.3gpp.sms payload?
question_40587.ground_truth: They should be IM-SM-GW SIP URI.

question_40589.question: What procedure does the TSCTSF use to track the UE's location and determine the UE's presence in an Area of Interest?
question_40589.ground_truth: The AMF(s) track the UE's location to determine the UE's presence in an Area of Interest and notify the TSCTSF about the UE(s) presence (IN, OUT, or UNKNOWN) in the Area of Interest(s).

question_40590.question: What is the maximum run time requirement for the Tuak algorithm's functions?
question_40590.ground_truth: The maximum run time for the Tuak functions is 500 ms total execution time, implemented on a midrange microprocessor IC card with specific resource constraints.

question_40591.question: When interworking with networks which do not support CCBS, what is the action taken when the CCBS service may fail?
question_40591.ground_truth: The CCBS service may fail in such situations, and the network needs to be able to interwork through networks which do not support CCBS.

question_40592.question: What aiding signal is added for the purpose of this test?
question_40592.ground_truth: The SS produces an independent, uncorrelated interfering signal (I) to evaluate the MS's performance under challenging conditions.

question_40595.question: What is the purpose of the Original Dialog Identifier (ODI) added by the Transit Function?
question_40595.ground_truth: The ODI is added by the Transit Function to allow it to identify the message on the incoming side, even if its dialog identification has been changed by the Application Server.

question_40596.question: In what mode does UE A operate with the Target BTS following eSRVCC?
question_40596.ground_truth: UE A operates with the Target BTS following eSRVCC in the Initial Codec Mode, which is EVS-IO mode of operation for encoding and decoding. This helps combat speech path interruption during mode changes.

question_40597.question: What is the technical description of AT-Solution using Early Provisioning in the context of Announcements and Tones (A-T) in GSM networks?
question_40597.ground_truth: In AT-Solution using Early Provisioning, the User Plane in the backward direction is established already during the ringing/alerting phase. This allows the network to maintain the same end-user experience of announcements and ring-back tones provided, even if the call is locally switched.

question_40599.question: What should the UE do when it wants to switch the traffic of the MA PDU Session from the existing non-3GPP access path to the new non-3GPP access path?
question_40599.ground_truth: The UE initiates registration over the new non-3GPP access path and indicates that the registration is for "Non-3GPP path switch", including the identity of the existing MA PDU Session in the "List Of PDU Sessions To Be Activated".

question_40601.question: When must the MS set the "Follow On Request" during an Emergency Attach?
question_40601.ground_truth: The MS must set the "Follow On Request" during an Emergency Attach if there is pending uplink traffic and it initiates the activation of an emergency PDP context after a successful Emergency Attach.

question_40602.question: What is the purpose of step 11 in 3GPP Access to Trusted Non-3GPP IP Access Handover with PMIPv6 on S2a?
question_40602.ground_truth: Step 11 is the actual handover of the PDN connections from 3GPP access to trusted non-3GPP access. The UE disconnects the sessions from 3GPP access and starts using the non-3GPP access. This step can occur in parallel for each PDN.

question_40603.question: What should the registration expiration interval value be set to in the REGISTER request when deregistering a contact address or flow?
question_40603.ground_truth: The registration expiration interval value should be set to the value of zero, appropriate to the deregistration requirements of the user.

question_40605.question: What direction attribute should be carried in each media line in messages sent in Steps 25-28?
question_40605.ground_truth: Each media line should carry the direction attribute "a=inactive".

question_40608.question: What is the feature called that allows the exchange of new SOR-related information between the HPLMN UDM and the UE in a secure manner?
question_40608.ground_truth: This feature is called the "Secure Operations of Roaming with Centralized Manifest Cache Invocation" (SOR-CMCI).

question_40609.question: What are the two communication scenarios between a private standalone MCData User Equipment (UE) and a Land Mobile Radio (LMR) Mobile Station (MS)?
question_40609.ground_truth: The two scenarios are: 1) MCData UE initiates private standalone SDS communication to an LMR MS, and 2) LMR MS initiates a private standalone SDS communication to a MCData UE.

question_40610.question: What is the effect of an MBR>GBR bearer compared to an MBR=GBR bearer in terms of bitrate adaptation?
question_40610.ground_truth: With an MBR>GBR bearer, the adaptation tries to maintain a bitrate in-between these values in most cases, while for an MBR=GBR bearer, the client is expected to use bitrates below GBR whenever adaptation is triggered.

question_40611.question: Which element is a child element of the "notificationIdSet" complexType, which is used in the "correlatedNotification" complexType?
question_40611.ground_truth: The element "notificationId" is a child element of the "notificationIdSet" complexType, which is used in the "correlatedNotification" complexType.

question_40612.question: What information is retrieved by the application client in the UE and provided to the ProSe Application Server in step 0?
question_40612.ground_truth: The PDUID (ProSe Device Unique Identifier) is retrieved by the application client in the UE and provided to the ProSe Application Server in step 0.

question_40613.question: What system information combination is used in NR cells as defined in TS 38.508-1 clause 4.4.3.1.3?

question_40614.question: What types of cells does the UE distinguish in terms of measurement procedures?
question_40614.ground_truth: The UE distinguishes the following types of cells: the NR serving cell(s), listed cells, and detected cells.

question_40615.question: What is the section of the document that discusses the REFSENS requirements for the band combination of n1 and n20?

question_40616.question: How does the procedure for switching from MBMS bearer to unicast bearer work?
question_40616.ground_truth: The procedure for switching from MBMS bearer to unicast bearer involves the MCPTT service using MCPTT-1, MCPTT-4, MCPTT-7, MCPTT-8, and MCPTT-9 reference points for this procedure.

question_40617.question: What entities are impacted by the RSM mechanism and what are their roles in it?
question_40617.ground_truth: The PCF, SMF, UE, UPF, and AF are impacted by the RSM mechanism. The PCF extends PCC rules to include RSM as a possible steering mode. The SMF, UE, and UPF extend ATSSS and N4 rules to include RSM as a possible steering mode, with indications of how much traffic needs to be duplicated and over which access path. The SMF decides to trigger the establishment of a MA PDU Session with RSM based on QoS conditions and checks the UDM for a flag to retrieve QoS Requirements from the NEF at PDU session establishment. The UE extends ATSSS rules to include indication of RSM, of how much traffic needs to be duplicated and over which access path. The UPF extends N4 rules to include indication of RSM, of how much traffic needs to be duplicated and over which access path. The UDM optionally stores flags to retrieve QoS Requirements from the NEF at PDU session establishment.

question_40619.question: What layers are involved in managing mobility within the same cell for NR?
question_40619.ground_truth: Mobility without RRC can be handled by PHY and/or MAC on the beam or TRxP level.

question_40620.question: What should the uplink DPCCH transmission do if the post-verification fails in the initial scenario specified in 5.1.2.2.1.1?
question_40620.ground_truth: If the post-verification fails, the UE shall not transmit on the activated uplink frequency until higher layers consider the downlink physical channel established.

question_40621.question: What is the purpose of re-using the access authentication mechanism in this solution?
question_40621.ground_truth: The purpose of re-using the access authentication mechanism is to perform an independent AKMA authentication run with the purpose to produce an AKMA anchor key in the UE and home network AKMA anchor function (AAuF), while being independent of the key hierarchy resulting from the primary authentication.

question_40624.question: What is the definition of a "PCC decision" and what does it consist of?
question_40624.ground_truth: A "PCC decision" consists of PCC rules and IP-CAN bearer attributes and is provided by the PCRF (Policy and Charging Rules Function) to the PCEF (Policy and Charging Enforcement Function) for policy and charging control and, for PCEF enhanced with ADC, application detection and control.

question_40626.question: When does the AF determine the minimum QoS requirements for the application data transfer?
question_40626.ground_truth: The AF determines the minimum QoS requirements for the application data transfer based on its internal logic, considering the expected number of UEs participating in the desired time windows, network input data, and trigger conditions for group application data transfer.

question_40627.question: What is the maximum delay added to the current time when scheduling a DL message to account for system delay?

question_40628.question: What is the purpose of the confidence indication in the procedure for UE initiates negotiation of PSM/MICO/eDRX?
question_40628.ground_truth: The confidence indication helps the AMF to determine whether to change or respect the requested timers/parameters of power saving mechanism based on the UE's calculation of the confidence level.

question_40629.question: What is the objective of downlink compressed mode under this subclause?
question_40629.ground_truth: The downlink compressed mode is used to create gaps in the downlink transmission, allowing the UE to make measurements on other frequencies.

question_40630.question: What should the mobile station do when it receives a PACKET~DOWNLINK~ASSIGNMENT or MULTIPLE TBF DOWNLINK~ASSIGNMENT message including a Frequency Parameters information element while it is in MAC-DTM state?
question_40630.ground_truth: If the mobile station receives a PACKET~DOWNLINK~ASSIGNMENT or MULTIPLE TBF DOWNLINK~ASSIGNMENT message including a Frequency Parameters information element, the mobile station shall perform an abnormal release without retry.

question_40631.question: When is the MCData-5 reference point not used for obtaining unicast bearers with appropriate QoS from the 5GS?
question_40631.ground_truth: The MCData-5 reference point is not used when the MCData service provider and the PLMN operator do not have an operational agreement for QoS control to be provided directly from the MCData service provider domain.

question_40632.question: What should the ePDG do when receiving a downlink data packet for a UE with the same DSCP marking value in an untrusted Fixed Broadband Access network over S2c?
question_40632.ground_truth: The ePDG should create dedicated child SA for each IP flow which has the same DSCP marking value and copy the DSCP marking value from the received IP header into the new IPSec header before forwarding to the UE as specified in subclause~7.3. Optionally, the ePDG may perform DSCP marking remapping based on the operator's policy.

question_40633.question: Which AVPs should not be supported for the Np reference point if they are from existing Diameter Applications?
question_40633.ground_truth: AVPs from existing Diameter Applications, except for the AVPs from Diameter base protocol.

question_40634.question: What message does the MME send to the E-SMLC to forward the LPPa response or report for a target UE?

question_40637.question: What are the four fields present in the fallbackRAR?
question_40637.ground_truth: The four fields in the fallbackRAR are R, Timing Advance Command, UL Grant, and Temporary C-RNTI.

question_40638.question: What is the measurement period for inter-band EN-DC including FR2?
question_40638.ground_truth: The period of the measurement shall be at least the continuous duration of one active sub-frame.

question_40639.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 6.7.9.3.1?
question_40639.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in section 6.7.9.3.1 is to verify that the L1-SINR measurement accuracy is within the specified limits, and the UE supports L1-SINR measurements.

question_40641.question: Which physical channel parameters are described in clause 6.11.6.4.7.3.2.2?
question_40641.ground_truth: Physical channel parameters for MAC-d flow#2 for DL are described in clause 6.11.6.4.7.3.2.2.

question_40642.question: What is the significance of the version numbering system used in RLP?
question_40642.ground_truth: The version numbering system in RLP indicates the status and changes in the document. For example, a first digit of 'x' shows that the document is presented to the TSG, 'x+1' means it is presented for approval, and 'x+2' indicates that the document is approved and under change control. The second digit is incremented for changes of substance, while the third digit is incremented for editorial changes only.

question_40643.question: What feature allows an NB-IoT UE to use 16-QAM for unicast NPDSCH with a TBS up to 4968 bits for standalone and guard-band deployments and 3624 bits for in-band deployments in Rel-17?
question_40643.ground_truth: 16-QAM for unicast in UL and DL for NB-IoT

question_40644.question: What is the role of the PEMC in the management of PIN and PIN Elements?
question_40644.ground_truth: The PEMC is responsible for managing PIN Elements, such as adding or removing PINEs/PEGCs. The NEF/UDM supports AF provisioning parameters for managing PIN policy and 5GC resources activation/deactivation of a PIN with a parameter of PIN ID.

question_40645.question: Which network entity determines whether UPF/SMF Relocation needs to be performed in solution #40?
question_40645.ground_truth: The SMF determines whether UPF/SMF Relocation needs to be performed in solution #40.

question_40646.question: What can be used to manage access attempts in RAN prior to decoding and authentication of the specific identity of the accessing MTC device in steps 3 and 4?
question_40646.ground_truth: A priority indication at the access attempt can be used to manage access attempts in RAN prior to decoding and authentication of the specific identity of the accessing MTC device in steps 3 and 4.

question_40647.question: What is the relationship between TS 32.332 and the CORBA SS in the 3GPP?
question_40647.ground_truth: TS 32.332 and the CORBA SS are related in that TS 32.332 provides the semantics of operations and notifications for the Notification Log IRP, and the CORBA SS specifies the technical details of implementing it.

question_40648.question: What is subclause 7.1.73a.2.1.2 specifying?
question_40648.ground_truth: Subclause 7.1.73a.2.1.2 specifies the transport channel parameters for Interactive or background / DL:8 kbps / PS RAB in the document.

question_40649.question: What should the MCPTT client do if the MCPTT user is not authorized to cancel the in-progress imminent peril group state of the MCPTT group?
question_40649.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should indicate to the MCPTT user that they are not authorized to cancel the in-progress imminent peral group state of the MCPTT group and skip the remaining steps of the current subclause.

question_40650.question: What is the task of the receiving UE when performing groupcast security in the 3GPP Sidelink Positioning system?
question_40650.ground_truth: The message receiving UE performs the following operations: Select a locally stored PGK, calculate PTK, PSK, PEK, and PIK in the same way as sending UE, if message confidentiality protection is enabled, decrypt the ciphertext, and if message integrity protection is enabled, verify integrity protection by checking the MAC of the message.

question_40651.question: When should the controlling MCVideo function reject a SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response?
question_40651.ground_truth: When the received SIP MESSAGE request is an unauthorized request for an MCVideo emergency alert cancellation and the required conditions are met.

question_40652.question: What is one expected benefit of aligning the radio access architecture with the SDN concept?
question_40652.ground_truth: One expected benefit is a functional decomposition of the radio access, which results in a partial decoupled architecture between user and control plane entities and on network abstractions.

question_40654.question: For combinations of intra-band and inter-band carrier aggregation with three uplink component carriers, which requirements apply to the NR band supporting two contiguous component carriers?
question_40654.ground_truth: The requirements specified in subclause 6.2A.3.1.1 apply.

question_40656.question: What is the definition of "DRBs-Required-ToBeModified-List" and "DRBs-Required-ToBeReleased-List"?
question_40656.ground_truth: "DRBs-Required-ToBeModified-List" and "DRBs-Required-ToBeReleased-List" are used to specify the Data Radio Bear (DRB)s that need to be modified or released during the UE context modification.

question_40657.question: What enumeration is used to define the current state of the MBS Distribution Session?
question_40657.ground_truth: The enumeration DistSessionState represents the current state of the MBS Distribution Session.

question_40658.question: When BSIC re-confirmation is performed, how many idle intervals can the UE use for BSIC re-confirmation?
question_40658.ground_truth: The UE is able to use for BSIC re-confirmation at least 8 identified GSM cells, with the timing information updated every time the BSIC is decoded.

question_40659.question: What is the purpose of an Emergency Services Query Key (ESQK) in the IMS emergency services?
question_40659.ground_truth: The ESQK is used by the Location Retrieval Function (LRF) as a key to look up for the location information and callback information associated with the emergency call instance. It is also used by the PSAP to query location information from the LRF.

question_40660.question: What was the largest percentage increase in beam prediction accuracy for a prediction time up to 1280ms, as reported by the evaluation results from 1 source, in terms of Top-K prediction accuracy or Top-1 prediction accuracy with 1dB error?
question_40660.ground_truth: The largest percentage increase in beam prediction accuracy for a prediction time up to 1280ms was 19.1%.

question_40661.question: Which paging procedure optimization is used in idle mode on EC-PCH in EC-GSM-IoT, different from GPRS/EGPRS?
question_40661.ground_truth: A two burst block is used on EC-PCH, with the possibility to decode it after only one burst has been received.

question_40662.question: What is the role of the Signalling Protection Key (SPK) in the MCPTT environment?
question_40662.ground_truth: The SPK in the MCPTT environment is used to protect floor and media control and XML content within the SIP between MCPTT servers or between MCPTT domains, ensuring the security of public-safety users.

question_40663.question: What symbol duration does the 7.68 Mcps TDD option in the 3GPP technical specification use?
question_40663.ground_truth: The symbol duration used in the 7.68 Mcps TDD option is 5120 * Tc, where Tc is the chip duration equaling 130.2 ns.

question_40664.question: What is the purpose of using a PC5 Link Identifier in NR?
question_40664.ground_truth: The PC5 Link Identifier uniquely identifies a PC5 unicast link in a UE for the lifetime of the PC5 unicast link. It is used to indicate to upper layers the PC5 unicast link in which sidelink RLF was declared and corresponding PC5-RRC connection was released.

question_40665.question: What is the conformance requirement for the two IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT messages in 41.2.3.2?
question_40665.ground_truth: They shall have the same contents of the Request Reference information elements.

question_40667.question: How many columns are assigned to the matrix in frame related 2nd interleaving?
question_40667.ground_truth: C2 = 30 columns are assigned to the matrix in frame related 2nd interleaving.

question_40668.question: What is the expected sequence of messages for the 6.1.2.1.3 test?
question_40668.ground_truth: The expected sequence of messages for the 6.1.2.1.3 test includes the UE transmitting a REGISTER message with an LCS MO-LR request with the "MOLR-Type" set to "locationEstimate", responding with a MEASUREMENT REPORT message, sending a FACILITY message containing an MO-LR result, and finally transmitting a RELEASE COMPLETE message.

question_40669.question: What should be the value of "<network-capability>" when performing DNS procedures to select a combined PGW-C/SMF for PDN connections that may be subject to mobility to 5GS?
question_40669.ground_truth: The value of "<network-capability>" should be "smf" when performing DNS procedures to select a combined PGW-C/SMF for PDN connections that may be subject to mobility to 5GS.

question_40673.question: What actions should the GCS AS take when it detects a BM-SC restart?
question_40673.ground_truth: The GCS AS assumes that all TMGIs assigned by the restarted BM-SC have been de-allocated and may restore MBMS delivery.

question_40674.question: What is the procedure for User Notification Procedure terminated by the mobile station?
question_40674.ground_truth: In this test, after the MS being in the call active state, the SS sends a NOTIFY message to the MS. The MS remains in the active state after receiving the NOTIFY message.

question_40677.question: What does the PLMN List-2 and PLMN List-3 indicate about a non-3GPP access network?
question_40677.ground_truth: The PLMN List-2 indicates support for "S2a connectivity" with a PLMN, while the PLMN List-3 indicates support for "5G connectivity" with a PLMN.

question_40678.question: What are the two types of ICE procedures supported by the MRFC?
question_40678.ground_truth: The two types of ICE procedures supported by the MRFC are ICE lite and Full ICE.

question_40679.question: What action should the P-CSCF take when the value of the Expires header field or expires parameter equals zero in the response to a REGISTER request sent by the UE?
question_40679.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall remove the public user identity found in the To header field, and all the associated public user identities, from the registered public user identities list belonging to this UE and all related stored information. If all public user identities that were registered by this UE are deregistered, the P-CSCF shall delete the security associations (if present) towards the UE, after the server transaction pertaining to this deregistration terminates.

question_40681.question: In what situation should the "Removal of MME Registration for SMS" flag within the NOR-Flags AVP received within NOR be set in the Ready-For-SM message?
question_40681.ground_truth: The "Removal of MME Registration for SMS" flag within the NOR-Flags AVP received within NOR should be set in the Ready-For-SM message if removalofMMERegistrationforSMS was received within the UpdateGprsLocationArg.

question_40682.question: What are the relevant Analytics IDs for Policy decisions?
question_40682.ground_truth: The relevant Analytics IDs for Policy decisions are "Load level information", "Service Experience", "Network Performance", "Abnormal behaviour", "UE Mobility", "UE Communication", "User Data Congestion", "Data Dispersion", "Session Management Congestion Control Experience", "DN Performance", "WLAN performance", and "Redundant Transmission Experience".

question_40683.question: What is the purpose of defining the NRM by this IRP?
question_40683.ground_truth: The purpose of defining the NRM by this IRP is to support communications for telecommunication network management purposes, including management of converged networks.

question_40684.question: What should the PGW do with downlink packets received for a PDN connection affected by an SGW failure that has not been restored yet?
question_40684.ground_truth: The PGW shall discard downlink packets received for a PDN connection maintained after an SGW failure that has not been restored yet. Additionally, the PGW shall stop charging for PDN connections maintained after an SGW failure which have not been restored yet.

question_40685.question: What are the modulation and coding schemes for PDTCH reused for EC-PDTCH?
question_40685.ground_truth: The EGPRS modulation and coding schemes for PDTCH are reused for EC-PDTCH

question_40688.question: What is the purpose of the test procedure sequence described in 6.1.8.3.2?
question_40688.ground_truth: The purpose of the test procedure sequence is to test the functionality of the SDS (Short Data Service) and the establishment of a one-to-one SDS session.

question_40689.question: What provides the network with information about whether the called and calling party are in coverage during communication authorization messages?
question_40689.ground_truth: The in-coverage indication flags provide the network with this information.

question_40691.question: When creating a PDU session establishment request message, what should the UE do with the PTI IE?
question_40691.ground_truth: The UE should allocate a PTI value currently not used and shall set the PTI IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message to the allocated PTI value.

question_40692.question: What is changed in the HSS in order to fulfill the SA1 requirement for monitoring in the network-based pairings?
question_40692.ground_truth: The network-based pairing methods require changes in the HSS to fulfill the SA1 requirement for monitoring. The system should provide mechanisms to detect change of the association between the MTC ME and the UICC.

question_40693.question: What is the result of the MCData group data response forwarded from MCData server in step 8?
question_40693.ground_truth: The MCData group data response received from MCData client 2 to n will be forwarded from MCData server to the MCData user initiating the MCData session data request.

question_40695.question: What is the range of values for the "Error Cause value" field and what do they represent?
question_40695.ground_truth: The "Error Cause value" field has a range of values from 0 to 63, with values from 0 to 15 used for syntactical protocol errors, 16 to 41 used for semantical protocol errors, and 42 to 63 used for other errors.

question_40696.question: What is the input to the encoding process in the evaluated 3GPP video services?
question_40696.ground_truth: A source sequence in 3G file format.

question_40697.question: What is the main function of the Proxy-Gn in reducing signalling delay?
question_40697.ground_truth: The Proxy-Gn reduces signalling delay by ensuring a negligible signalling delay when relaying a PDP context creation of non E-GAN capable MS, which is an order of magnitude 100 times lower than the end-to-end signalling delay for a PDP Context Activation.

question_40698.question: What is the use of a ProSe Application Mask in ProSe Application Code matching?
question_40698.ground_truth: A ProSe Application Mask is used for partial matching of ProSe Application Codes or ProSe Restricted Codes received on the PC5 interface. It allows for more flexible and effective filtering of the received temporary identities in a monitoring UE.

question_40699.question: What is the test procedure for the Indoor Anechoic Chamber in stage 2 of the IAC testing procedure?
question_40699.ground_truth: The IAC testing procedure consists of several steps, including uninstalling the reference antenna, installing the BS, setting the BS to be satisfied with the desired RoAoA, rotating the BS, setting the test signal mean power, and measuring the throughput. This procedure is repeated for each conformance testing direction.

question_40700.question: What is the requirement for the block error rate under any combination of normal and extreme test voltages and ambient temperatures?
question_40700.ground_truth: The block error ratio, as calculated by the SS for different channels and under the different propagation conditions, under any combination of normal and extreme test voltages and ambient temperatures, shall not exceed the conformance requirement.

question_40701.question: What is the request type for a SIP INVITE targeting the controlling MCVideo function of an MCVideo group, with the isfocus media feature tag not included in the Contact header field?
question_40701.ground_truth: A SIP INVITE request for controlling MCVideo function of an MCVideo group

question_40702.question: What is the purpose of altering the downlink radio environment in this test?
question_40702.ground_truth: The purpose of altering the downlink radio environment is to test the MS's response to changes in the carrier to interference ratio.

question_40703.question: What is the system responsible for signaling, transporting, and presenting enhanced and interactive applications on hybrid terminals with both a DVB compliant broadcast connection and a broadband connection, as per the HbbTV specification?

question_40704.question: What are the functional classifications of procedures for the Cx interface?
question_40704.ground_truth: The functional classifications of procedures for the Cx interface include location management procedures, user data handling procedures, user authentication procedures, and IMS Restoration Procedures.

question_40707.question: What should the UE do if it receives an EPS bearer identity (EBI) in the parameters list field of the Authorized QoS flow descriptions IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message for a UE registered for disaster roaming services and for a PDU session which is not a PDU session for emergency services?
question_40707.ground_truth: The UE should locally remove the EPS bearer identity (EBI) from the parameters list field of such one or more authorized QoS flow descriptions.

question_40709.question: What occurs at the charging session termination in clause 5.13.3.1 when online charging is applicable for the IP-CAN session?
question_40709.ground_truth: The IP Edge/PCEF issues the final report and returns the remaining credit to the OCS. The OCS acknowledges the credit report and terminates the online charging session.

question_40711.question: What was the output level of the decoder when a single sinusoidal tone of frequency 1500 Hz was processed through the speech codec in section 21.8?
question_40711.ground_truth: A temporary instability in the decoder was observed for a single sinusoidal tone of frequency 1500 Hz.

question_40712.question: Who needs to set explicit requirements on attestation in a 3GPP network?

question_40714.question: Which aspects are missing or not yet determined in the UE Maximum Output Power for Inter-Band EN-DC including FR2 (1 NR CC) test requirement?
question_40714.ground_truth: The missing elements are Measurement Uncertainties and Test Tolerances for power class 2 and 4, and TimeAlignmentTimerDedicated IE value.

question_40715.question: What should the UE include in the "Start EMSDP session request with E2E" command if it determines that the key needs to be re-agreed?
question_40715.ground_truth: The UE should set the key id to "00", Session id to "00..00", no encryption, and the MAC to "00..00" in the "Start EMSDP session request with E2E" command if it determines that the key needs to be re-agreed.

question_40716.question: When should the UE perform SDS (Single Radio Voice Call Continuous) in terminating sessions if the media bearers cannot be accepted on the PS domain?
question_40716.ground_truth: The UE should perform SDS when it receives an incoming session requesting one or more media (i.e. bi-directional speech media) bearers in the PS domain and determines that the media bearers cannot be accepted on the PS domain.

question_40718.question: What is the consequence of the network sending GMM cause code 'IMSI unknown in HLR' during the routing area updating procedure for an MS?
question_40718.ground_truth: The MS must delete the stored TMSI, LAI, and CKSN. It also considers the SIM invalid for non-GPRS services until power is switched off or the SIM is removed.

question_40719.question: What is the purpose of the AllowedCSGEntries node in the Allowed CSG List MO?
question_40719.ground_truth: The AllowedCSGEntries node is used to allow a reference to a list of allowed CSG entries, and is a child of the <X> node.

question_40721.question: What are the changes introduced for RRM, RLM, and mobility procedures in NR-U, compared to NR licensed specification in Rel-15?
question_40721.ground_truth: Changes introduced for RRM, RLM, and mobility procedures in NR-U include new physical layer design and LBT for the unlicensed operation, which support both synchronous and asynchronous deployments.

question_40722.question: What is used to request measurement(s) in AI/ML based positioning for LMF?
question_40722.ground_truth: Signalling from LMF to request measurement(s) is used to request measurement(s) in AI/ML based positioning for LMF.

question_40723.question: What is the role of the OCS in the process described?
question_40723.ground_truth: The OCS is responsible for performing the Reserve Units Request operation, granting service units, and performing the Debit Units operation.

question_40724.question: What is the difference between the first and second digits in the version number of the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_40724.ground_truth: The first digit represents the level of approval the document has received from the TSG, while the second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, i.e. technical enhancements, corrections, updates, etc.

question_40726.question: What is the objective of the PLAY TONE proactive SIM command, as per the described scenario?
question_40726.ground_truth: The objective of the PLAY TONE proactive SIM command is to verify that the ME plays an audio tone of a specified type and duration, and returns a successful response in the TERMINAL RESPONSE command sent to the SIM.

question_40728.question: What is the purpose of the historical MDA reports in the MDA process?
question_40728.ground_truth: The historical MDA reports can be used by the consumer to retrieve data analysis results that were produced in the past, for example if the reports have been lost or could not be successfully parsed.

question_40729.question: When shall the Pre-emption Capability be set to true?
question_40729.ground_truth: The Pre-emption Capability shall be set to true if any of the original derived PCC Rules have the Pre-emption-Capability value set to true.

question_40730.question: What action should the MBMS Aware Application take after receiving the callback in fileAvailable() API?
question_40730.ground_truth: After receiving the callback, the MBMS Aware Application may access the file that is announced by the parameters in the callback function. If the storage is not defined by the locationPath, the application should arrange for a copy of the file to the application space before the announced availabilityDeadline.

question_40731.question: How can an active CFNRc be deactivated?
question_40731.ground_truth: It can be deactivated explicitly by the user through an appropriate control procedure, automatically when another registration is made, or as a result of the withdrawal of the service.

question_40732.question: What is the role of the Security Gateway (SeGW) in Solution 2?
question_40732.ground_truth: The Security Gateway (SeGW) in Solution 2 is located at the edge of the operator's core network and maintains a secure association with the HeNodeB across an unsecure IP backhaul network.

question_40733.question: What is the difference between mode~II and A/Gb mode in handling periodic RA updates and periodic LA updates?
question_40733.ground_truth: In mode~II, both periodic RA updates and periodic LA updates are performed independently, with RA updates sent to the SGSN and LA updates sent to the MSC/VLR. In A/Gb mode, the periodic RA update timer in the MS is stopped when an LLC PDU is sent and is reset and started when the state returns to STANDBY. In Iu mode, the periodic RA update timer in the MS is stopped when the MM context enters the PMM-CONNECTED state and is reset and started when the state returns to PMM-IDLE.

question_40734.question: What are the responsibilities of EES #A and EES #B in the publication of service APIs?
question_40734.ground_truth: EES #A and EES #B publish the service API provided by its connected API exposing function(s) to CCF #C, and obtains the service API information provided by other EES from centralized CCF #C.

question_40735.question: What event triggers the (R)AN-initiated AN Release procedure?
question_40735.ground_truth: The (R)AN-initiated AN Release procedure can be triggered by several conditions, including Radio Link Failure, User Inactivity, Inter-System Redirection, request for establishment of QoS Flow for IMS voice, Release due to UE generated signalling connection release, mobility restriction, and others.

question_40737.question: What is a Distinguished Name (DN) in the context of network management?
question_40737.ground_truth: A Distinguished Name (DN) is used to uniquely identify a MO within a name space, and is built from a series of "name components," referred to as Relative Distinguished Names (RDNs). From a DN, one can derive the DN of its containing MO, if any. This containment relation is the only relation carried by the DN.

question_40739.question: What is the "ProtocolExtensionContainer" used for in the "MBSMeasurementList-Element" sequence?
question_40739.ground_truth: The "ProtocolExtensionContainer" in the "MBSMeasurementList-Element" sequence is used to define additional protocol extension information, as specified in the PCAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION.

question_40741.question: In EMM-IDLE mode, what actions should the MME take if the UE includes an eKSI in the NAS Key Set Identifier IE and it cannot retrieve the current EPS security context?
question_40741.ground_truth: The MME shall create a new mapped EPS security context and perform a security mode control procedure.

question_40742.question: What is the role of the ePDG in establishing an IPsec tunnel during an emergency session?
question_40742.ground_truth: The ePDG establishes an IPsec tunnel with the UE during an emergency session.

question_40743.question: What is the primary reference point for UAS application related interactions between UAS UE and UAS application server?
question_40743.ground_truth: The reference point U1 supports the UAS application related interactions between UAS UE and UAS application server as specified in 3GPP TS 23.256.

question_40744.question: What is the expected sequence of events in 51.3.6.6?
question_40744.ground_truth: After the mobile station receives a PACKET UPLINK ASSIGNMENT message and switches to the new assigned channels, it should send PACKET DUMMY CONTROL BLOCKs on the new channels whenever the USF is matched.

question_40745.question: When is the pseudo-random data sequence specified for Mode (a) transmitted on the downlink for loopback on the uplink?

question_40746.question: What factors can cause MIC check failure or malformed contents when processing received PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY messages at the ProSe-enabled UE?
question_40746.ground_truth: An erroneous UTC-based counter can cause MIC check failure, and malformed contents after DUSK or DUCK is used for unscrambling or deciphering, as indicated in NOTE~2.

question_40748.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the SIP PUBLISH request if confidentiality and integrity protections are both disabled?
question_40748.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the <mcvideo-access-token> element set to the value of the access token received during the user authentication procedures, and the <mcvideo-client-id> element set to the value of the MCVideo client ID of the originating MCVideo client. Additionally, the client should include an application/poc-settings+xml MIME body with the Answer-Mode Indication setting and the selected-user-profile-index element.

question_40749.question: What should a MS do when it receives an ATTACH REJECT message with GMM cause #11 and is in automatic network selection mode while roaming and trying to attach for emergency bearer services?
question_40749.ground_truth: The MS should enter the state GMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-IMSI.

question_40750.question: What is the maximum time difference allowed between the middle of the received GSM synchronization burst at the UE and the middle of the measurement occasion for the UE to decode a BSIC within a measurement occasion?
question_40750.ground_truth: The UE is able to decode a BSIC within a measurement occasion if the time difference between the middle of the received GSM synchronization burst at the UE and the middle of the measurement occasion is within TBD.

question_40752.question: What does "AUN3 device" refer to in the 3GPP Technical Report?
question_40752.ground_truth: An AUN3 device is a non-3GPP device that can be identified and/or authenticated by 5GC, and it is the focus of Key Issue #1 in the report.

question_40753.question: What information does the MTC ME store in a certificate for verification by the UICC?
question_40753.ground_truth: The MTC ME stores its IMEI(SV) value in the certificate, which is then signed by the operator or vendor.

question_40754.question: What should the P-CSCF do when it receives a target refresh request from the UE for a dialog?
question_40754.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should execute the procedure described in step 1) to 5) in subclause 5.2.6.3, describing the procedure when the P-CSCF receives a target refresh request.

question_40755.question: What is the mode of operation for performing a Combined RA/LA Update in a GERAN network?
question_40755.ground_truth: Mode I in a GERAN network uses the Combined RA/LA Update mode.

question_40757.question: What security mode is used during an initial context setup between the UE and the gNB/ng-eNB to activate an initial KgNB?
question_40757.ground_truth: AS SMC (Access Security Management SessionChapter 6.8.1 in TS 38.331)

question_40759.question: What is the role of NSMF in controlling of automated healing for NSI?
question_40759.ground_truth: NSMF receives the automated healing policies for NSI, triggers the automated healing, evaluates the results of automated healing actions and reports them.

question_40760.question: What is the test procedure for step 6.2.4.2 of the test specified in clause 6.2?
question_40760.ground_truth: The test procedure for step 6.2.4.2 is to set and send continuously up power control commands to the UE until the UE output power is at the maximum level, and then measure the BER of DCH received from the UE at the SS.

question_40761.question: What is the purpose of the Phy-Parameters information element?
question_40761.ground_truth: The Phy-Parameters information element is used to convey the physical layer capabilities.

question_40762.question: What action will the MS take if access barred because of access class control, EAB or ACDC?
question_40762.ground_truth: The service request procedure shall not be started, and the MS stays in the current serving cell and applies normal cell reselection process. The service request procedure may be started by CM layer if it is still necessary.

question_40763.question: What does the Signalling Transport Network (STN) interface Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP) specify?
question_40763.ground_truth: The protocol neutral STN interface NRM IRP

question_40765.question: In what scenario does the Serving GW send the Modify Bearer Request message with the related counter on its CDR?
question_40765.ground_truth: If the Serving GW receives the Modify Bearer Request message with the MO Exception Data Counter indicated but does not send it due to above reasons, then it sends the Modify Bearer Request message with the related counter on its CDR.

question_40766.question: In what modes can the MCID service be offered?
question_40766.ground_truth: The MCID service can be offered in two modes: permanent mode and temporary mode. The permanent mode is active for all incoming communications, and the temporary mode is active only for the incoming communications declared by the served user.

question_40767.question: What is the purpose of the PC5 QoS parameters that are provided to the UE-to-Network Relay during the PDU session modification procedure?
question_40767.ground_truth: The PC5 QoS parameters are used by the UE-to-Network Relay to modify the Layer-2 link based on the PC5 QoS parameters received from the CN.

question_40768.question: What is the use of N parameter in the RLC sublayer?
question_40768.ground_truth: The N parameter indicates that an RLC entity will not send a PDU with "Sequence Number" >=VT(S)+N for AM and "Sequence Number" >=VT(US)+N for UM, where N is a non-negative integer. This parameter is used to limit the number of PDUs sent by an RLC entity.

question_40770.question: What should the mobile station do when it receives an EC PACKET UPLINK ACK/NACK AND CONTENTION RESOLUTION message during timer T3248 that does not address the mobile station?
question_40770.ground_truth: The mobile station should not consider the acknowledgment.

question_40771.question: When does the AF session with QoS provision xIRI get generated in the IRI-POI present in the NEF?
question_40771.ground_truth: The AF session with QoS provision xIRI is generated when the IRI-POI detects that a request to reserve/update/revoke QoS for an AF session associated with the target UE has been received from an AF.

question_40772.question: Which TS in the 5G System's Stage 2 defines procedures for the 5G System?

question_40773.question: What should the USSI AS do if the network successfully performs the USSD information and does not need any further information?
question_40773.ground_truth: The USSI AS should send a BYE request in order to terminate the dialog, populating it with an application/vnd.3gpp.ussd+xml MIME body including a <ussd-string> element and a <language> element.

question_40778.question: What is the handover delay requirement for the test?
question_40778.ground_truth: The handover delay Dhandover shall be less than the total of 2595 ms in this test case, otherwise, the UE will not be ready to start the transmission of the new uplink PRACH channel within Dhandover seconds from the end of the last TTI containing the RRC command.

question_40779.question: What is the aim of the network slice optimization solution?
question_40779.ground_truth: The aim of the network slice optimization solution is to optimize the network slice parameters for vertical applications based on network slice usage patterns and policy of the application, using AF policies to determine the trigger events and expected actions for network slice modification.

question_40781.question: What is the purpose of the utilization state reporting to an AF in the 5G system?
question_40781.ground_truth: It is used to report the current number of UEs registered for a network slice or the current number of PDU Sessions established on a network slice to an AF deployed within a 3GPP system or in a third party domain.

question_40782.question: What is the role of the Network Exposure Function (NEF) in collecting data from an AF?
question_40782.ground_truth: The NEF supports the capability to collect data from an AF as specified in TS~23.501.

question_40784.question: What should the UE include in the Registration Request message to indicate support of new slice granularity per tracking area?
question_40784.ground_truth: The UE should include a 5GMM capability of support of new slice granularity i.e. per tracking area in the Registration Request message.

question_40785.question: What state must the UE be in for the test described in 9.1.9.5.1 to be applicable?
question_40785.ground_truth: The UE must be in the 5GMM-REGISTERED state and have a UE Radio Capability ID assigned in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message for the test to be applicable.

question_40786.question: What is the method of testing the loss of a UA frame during link establishment in the test procedure?
question_40786.ground_truth: The test involves initializing a link establishment for acknowledged data transfer from the MS, ignoring the SABM frame at the SS, and waiting for the MS to send N200 + 1 SABM frames.

question_40787.question: What is the purpose of using PQI mapped from the 5QI in the QoS rule after the deletion of the derived QoS rule(s)?
question_40787.ground_truth: The purpose is to provide QoS differentiation on a per-IPsec Child Security Association basis for the 5G ProSe Layer-3 Remote UE's PDU session(s) established via N3IWF.

question_40790.question: What is the role of the DCD Client in the DCD functionality?
question_40790.ground_truth: The DCD Client acts as an agent that enables the DCD functionality on the handset and serves the DCD-Enabled Client Application(s).

question_40791.question: What is the effect of correct decoding of the interference signal after passing through the post-decoding IC block?
question_40791.ground_truth: If the decoding is correct, the interference signal will be reconstructed with high accuracy.

question_40792.question: What action is taken when timer T390 corresponding to Access Category '2' expires or is stopped?
question_40792.ground_truth: The barring for Access Category '2' is considered to be alleviated.

question_40793.question: What is the purpose of the integrity protection function in the PDCP Data PDU?
question_40793.ground_truth: The integrity protection function in the PDCP Data PDU ensures the protection of the confidentiality and integrity of the data transmitted over the radio interface, providing a secure means of communication between the user equipment (UE) and the 5G network.

question_40794.question: What is the role of the SMF in the 5G VN establishment or update based on the DNAI?
question_40794.ground_truth: The SMF performs PDU Session Modification with the PEGC, adding, updating, or removing QoS flows to serve the PINE, and sends the PIN ID, P2P Routing Rule, and P2N Routing Rule to the PEGC via N1 message during the PDU Session Modification.

question_40795.question: What is the criterion for whether "immediateResponsePreferred" should be included in the SendAuthenticationInfoArg or not?
question_40795.ground_truth: If a Requested-EUTRAN-Authentication-Info AVP or a Requested-UTRAN-GERAN-Authentication-Info AVP is present within AIR, then "immediateResponsePreferred" should be present if and only if the Immediate-Response-Preferred AVP is present within either of those AVPs.

question_40796.question: What is the compact format used by the MnS producer to report complete updates of an object's attributes?
question_40796.ground_truth: The compact format is used when all attributes of an object have been updated with a new value, and it involves reporting that the "attributes" container has been updated completely.

question_40797.question: What is the procedure for PC5 unicast link establishment for C2 communication between a UAV and a UAV-C with dynamic discovery?
question_40797.ground_truth: The UAV-C uses the Direct Discovery procedure to learn the Layer-2 ID of the UAV, and then uses this ID to establish the PC5 unicast link. C2 communication data is transmitted over the link using the respective Layer-2 IDs of the UAV-C and UAV as the source and destination.

question_40798.question: What is the scaling factor for a positioning frequency layer within the associated measurement gap pattern, denoted as , in the equation for the periodicity of the PRS-RSRP measurement in positioning frequency layer i?
question_40798.ground_truth: is equal to the ratio of the total number of available associated gap occasions covering PRS occasions within the window to the number of non-dropped associated gap occasions covering PRS occasions within the window, i.e. = Ntotal / Navailable.

question_40799.question: What is the impact of cell reselection on connectionless mode?
question_40799.ground_truth: Handover is not necessary in connectionless mode, since it is expected to last for a short duration. If cell reselection is required, the UE reselects to the target cell and sets up bearers in connectionless mode. If the UE transitions to connected mode and initiates a Service Request, the signalling is comparable to the number of messages used in an X2 handover.

question_40800.question: What should be done if the isfocus media feature tag is present in the Contact header field of a SIP INVITE request?
question_40800.ground_truth: The SIP INVITE request should be rejected with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response.

question_40803.question: What information does the TMGI AVP contain and who allocates it?
question_40803.ground_truth: The TMGI AVP contains the Temporary Mobile Group Identity allocated to a particular MBMS bearer service and it is allocated by the BM-SC.

question_40804.question: How is the rate of correct initiation/cease delay of SLSS transmissions observed during repeated tests calculated?
question_40804.ground_truth: The rate of correct initiation/cease delay of SLSS transmissions observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

question_40805.question: What should the UE do if the requirements in clause 4.2.2.7 apply and Nlayers needs to be replaced with Nlayers + 1?
question_40805.ground_truth: The UE should follow the requirements in clause 4.2.2.7, with Nlayers replaced with Nlayers + 1.

question_40806.question: What is one action that the RNS may take when the CS service is released in CS fallback?
question_40806.ground_truth: The RNS may select to use RRC Connection Release with Redirect to send the UE back to E-UTRAN at release of the CS service.

question_40809.question: When would the MAC entity randomly select a PRACH occasion for the contention-free Random Access procedure?
question_40809.ground_truth: The MAC entity randomly selects a PRACH occasion when the Random Access procedure is initiated for the CCCH logical channel and the CCCH SDU size plus MAC subheader is greater than ra-MsgA-SizeGroupA.

question_40810.question: What are the two main aspects that motivated the generation of V-Traces?
question_40810.ground_truth: The two main aspects that motivated the generation of V-Traces are that handling several minutes or hours of raw data from a game engine is too significant, and that representative games are typically attached with copyright and licensing terms, hence the raw media data cannot be shared publicly.

question_40812.question: What are the actions required by the UE when verifying the integrity of the NAS Security Mode Command message in the NAS SMC procedure?
question_40812.ground_truth: The UE shall verify the integrity of the NAS Security Mode Command message, including ensuring that the UE security capabilities sent by the MME match the ones stored in the UE, checking the integrity protection using the indicated NAS integrity algorithm and the NAS integrity key based on KASME indicated by the eKSI, and when creating a mapped context, ensuring the received NONCEUE is the same as the NONCEUE sent in the TAU Request and also calculating KASME' from CK, IK and the two nonces.

question_40813.question: What action performed by the NEF does the "AFQ.CreateSucc" measurement represent?
question_40813.ground_truth: It represents the number of successful AF session with QoS creations at the NEF.

question_40814.question: In which writing direction should the glyphs be rotated if vertical text is requested for characters which the terminal cannot render vertically?
question_40814.ground_truth: If vertical text is requested for characters which the terminal cannot render vertically, the terminal may behave as if the characters were not available and the glyphs should not be rotated.

question_40815.question: Which clock is used as the reference for the TTI insertion uncertainty in the test in clause 7.6.2.8.4.2?
question_40815.ground_truth: The TTI insertion uncertainty is equal to 1 ms (TTIDCCH), and 2xTTIDCCH is equal to 2 ms.

question_40816.question: How are MBS session keys generated and distributed in this solution?
question_40816.ground_truth: MB-SMF generates the MBS session key for a particular TMGI and provides it to the UE and the NG-RAN. If multiple MB-SMFs are used within the network, a Key Management Server (KMS) is used to generate the session key and the MBS Key index for the TMGI.

question_40817.question: What is the minimum measured RSRP value for an NR cell to be considered as a high-quality PLMN?
question_40817.ground_truth: The minimum measured RSRP value for an NR cell to be considered as a high-quality PLMN is -110 dBm.

question_40818.question: What is the component of equipment which contains base-band and functionality for controlling Radio unit in the present document?
question_40818.ground_truth: The Radio digital unit is a component of equipment which contains base-band and functionality for controlling Radio unit as per the present document.

question_40820.question: What is required for inter-band FDM coexistence with static power assignment of Pc,max for each carrier in FDM solutions?
question_40820.ground_truth: Synchronization is not assumed for inter-band FDM coexistence with static power assignment of Pc,max for each carrier in FDM solutions.

question_40822.question: What is the KPI "GRANHOSR" a measure of?
question_40822.ground_truth: The KPI "GRANHOSR" measures how often a handover within NR-RAN is successful, regardless of the reason.

question_40823.question: What happens when the Driver terminates the Driver to Controller voice communication in the FRMCS System?
question_40823.ground_truth: The FRMCS System terminates the voice communication and informs all involved Controllers.

question_40826.question: What message is sent by the MC client to the MC gateway UE when it receives an UnmapGroupFromBearer message and participates in the identified group session?

question_40827.question: What should a UE include in the "c=" parameter in the SDP answer if it supports both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses simultaneously and accepts the received SDP offer?
question_40827.ground_truth: The UE should include the IP address type it has acquired or the existing IP address type in the "c=" parameter in the SDP answer.
