question_40829.question: What is the measurement reporting delay requirement for RSRP and RSRQ measurements reported in periodically triggered measurement reports in section 8.13.2.5.1?
question_40829.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay for RSRP and RSRQ measurements reported in periodically triggered measurement reports shall meet the requirements in sections 9.1.21.1, 9.1.21.2 and 9.1.21.6.

question_40830.question: What are the packet data rate requirements for LDM message transmission in this intersection traffic scenario?
question_40830.ground_truth: For safe and automated vehicle control applications, a packet data rate of 50 Mbps or higher is needed for LDM messages transmission. This accounts for packet transmission efficiency of 60-70% and assumes that there are 200 vehicles, each with 50 message transmissions per second, using 450-byte messages.

question_40832.question: What is a multiple scale lattice structure defined by in relation to the lattice codebook?
question_40832.ground_truth: A multiple scale lattice structure is defined by a set of three integers representing the number of leader vectors for each truncation and three positive real numbers representing the scale for each lattice truncation.

question_40834.question: What action shall the UE take if the de-registration request is not due to switch off and it is in the state 5GMM-REGISTERED or 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED?
question_40834.ground_truth: The UE shall start timer T3521 after sending the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message and enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED.

question_40836.question: What measures can be taken to secure a deployed IOPS-capable eNB's Local HSS database during a theft situation?
question_40836.ground_truth: In the event of a theft, the Local HSS database should be held on an encrypted hardware platform to protect the keys from being compromised. New UICCs would need to be issued or UICCs reprogrammed with new credentials, and these updated credentials would need to be provided to a new Local HSS.

question_40837.question: What is the outcome of the CTS enrolment procedure if the mobile station does not have the rights to be enrolled?
question_40837.ground_truth: The fixed part sends a CTS ENROLMENT REJECT message to the mobile station, containing a reject cause and the identity of the fixed part, and the CTS-MS enters in ENROLMENT REJECTED state.

question_40838.question: What is the condition for the location management server to store the optional MC service UE label?
question_40838.ground_truth: If the location information report contains an optional MC service UE label, the location management server stores it together with the location information for the reporting location management client.

question_40840.question: What should the UE do if it receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message that includes an EMM cause value of "#2" (IMSI unknown in HSS)?
question_40840.ground_truth: The UE should stop T3430 if still running, reset the tracking area updating attempt counter, set the update status to U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, delete the TMSI, LAI, and ciphering key sequence number, enter state EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE, and set the USIM as invalid for non-EPS services.

question_40843.question: What technique is used to synchronize the UE and gNB in the Air-to-ground network?
question_40843.ground_truth: Autonomous pre-compensation of the TTA for the RTT between the UE and the gNB

question_40849.question: How many E-UTRA FDD carriers and cells are specified in the test?
question_40849.ground_truth: Two carriers and one cell on each carrier

question_40851.question: What is the format of the HTTP POST request sent by the PCF to the NF service consumer?
question_40851.ground_truth: The PCF includes in the body of the HTTP POST request a "Notification" data type which shall contain the PDTQ Reference ID of the impacted PDTQ policy and the list of candidate PDTQ policies in the "candPolicies" attribute.

question_40853.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon receiving a request from an MCVideo user to release an MCVideo ambient viewing call if it has not received a g.3gpp.mcvideo.ambient-viewing-call-release feature-capability indicator?
question_40853.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should send a SIP BYE request to terminate the call, but should not clear the cache of the data stored for the call, including the ambient viewing client role and ambient viewing type.

question_40856.question: Which interface is used for exchanging session information and policy and charging information during roaming scenarios with either Local Break Out traffic or home-routed traffic?
question_40856.ground_truth: The S9 interface is used for exchanging session information and policy and charging information during roaming scenarios with either Local Break Out traffic or home-routed traffic.

question_40857.question: What protocol is used between the UE and N3IWF to transfer NAS signalling traffic in a 5G network?
question_40857.ground_truth: The signalling IPsec SA is used to transfer NAS signalling traffic between the UE and N3IWF in a 5G network.

question_40858.question: What is the definition of the ARFCN-ValueNR data type?
question_40858.ground_truth: The ARFCN-ValueNR data type is used to indicate the ARFCN applicable for a NR global frequency raster and can take on any integer value from 0 to 3279165.

question_40859.question: What is the role of the TeDRX timer in this solution?
question_40859.ground_truth: The TeDRX timer is used to set the extended I-DRX time value negotiated earlier on NAS level. At the expiration of the TeDRX, the UE monitors the network for paging using normal DRX parameters.

question_40860.question: What is the recommended option for PLMN change event reporting when PCC is deployed?
question_40860.ground_truth: Option 2b is recommended when PCC is deployed.

question_40861.question: What is the primary purpose of IMS Centralized Services?
question_40861.ground_truth: IMS Centralized Services is designed to provide a diverse range of access networks (wired and wireless, wireless and wireline) with communication services and support service continuity between access networks. It utilizes IMS mechanisms and enablers and supports various data application services.

question_40862.question: Under which circumstances does the SGSN/MME update the HSS with the "PDN GW currently in use for emergency services"?
question_40862.ground_truth: The SGSN/MME may update the HSS with the "PDN GW currently in use for emergency services" when the Request Type of the UE requested connectivity procedure indicates "Emergency" during initial attach or UE requested PDN connectivity in the 3GPP access.

question_40863.question: What is the role of the "extension" element in the request message?
question_40863.ground_truth: The BSF may use one or more "extension" elements to include additional data to the request, but the NAF may ignore the additional data.

question_40864.question: How many subcounters are provided for the "Failed session establishments for multi-party sessions" measurement in the MRFCFunction?
question_40864.ground_truth: The number of subcounters is equal to the number of status codes plus a possible sum value identified by the.sum suffix.

question_40866.question: What does the DCD replace-content-id parameter do in the DCD Content metadata?
question_40866.ground_truth: The DCD replace-content-id parameter is used to indicate which content item shall be replaced by the content item for which a content-id is provided in the same message.

question_40867.question: What must the <emergency-ind> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body be set to in order for an MCVideo emergency alert cancellation request to be considered an authorized request for an MCVideo emergency alert cancellation?
question_40867.ground_truth: The <emergency-ind> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body must be set to "false" for an MCVideo emergency alert cancellation request to be considered an authorized request for an MCVideo emergency alert cancellation.

question_40868.question: What should the MS do after sending the HANDOVER COMPLETE message in a speech call?
question_40868.ground_truth: After sending the HANDOVER COMPLETE message in a speech call, the MS sends speech frames whenever it does not have to transmit or acknowledge an I frame on layer 2 of the FACCH.

question_40871.question: Which RLC entity is used to transmit RLC SDUs in acknowledged mode, and what are the primitives associated with it?
question_40871.ground_truth: RLC-AM entity is used to transmit RLC SDUs in acknowledged mode. The primitives associated with it are RLC-AM-DATA-Req, RLC-AM-DATA-Ind, and RLC-AM-DATA-Conf.

question_40875.question: What is the purpose of the Wait for RP-ACK state (State 1) in short message transfer?
question_40875.ground_truth: The Wait for RP-ACK state (State 1) is entered for a mobile terminating short message transfer when the SMR has passed the RP-DATA message to the SMC entity and set the timer TR1N.

question_40876.question: What is the purpose of the proximity request procedure in the UE registration with ProSe Function?
question_40876.ground_truth: The proximity request procedure in the UE registration with ProSe Function is used to register an application for ProSe and activate features such as EPC-level ProSe discovery for a specific application.

question_40877.question: What is the process for re-establishing the RRC connection between the UE and gNB when a failure occurs during the RRC_CONNECTED state?
question_40877.ground_truth: The UE re-establishes the RRC connection by providing the UE Identity to the gNB where the re-establishment occurred. The gNB then requests the last serving gNB for UE Context data. If user data buffered in the last serving gNB needs to be preserved, the gNB provides forwarding addresses, and the last serving gNB provides the SN status to the gNB. The gNB performs path switch, and finally triggers the release of the UE resources at the last serving gNB.

question_40878.question: What is the purpose of the Consent header block element and what is it used for?
question_40878.ground_truth: The Consent header block element may be employed by a requester or a receiver to indicate the privacy policy associated with a message. It is used for indicating intended usage in a request message and how the receiver of the response is to use the response data in a response message.

question_40880.question: What entity initiates the group affiliation procedure in step 1a?

question_40882.question: What modulation scheme is used for 8PSK when the number of TFCI bits are from 6 to 10?
question_40882.ground_truth: A (64,10) sub-code of the second order Reed-Muller code is used for encoding TFCI bits when the number of TFCI bits are from 6 to 10.

question_40884.question: What can cause a network overload in the scenario where massive numbers of mobile users attempt simultaneously to initiate mobile originating services?
question_40884.ground_truth: A network overload can occur due to the massive amount of requests for policy control over Gx, causing the PCRF to be overloaded.

question_40886.question: What are the two key issues clauses in Building Block 3 and Building Block 4?
question_40886.ground_truth: The two key issues clauses are 6.1 and 7.1, for Building Block 3 and Building Block 4, respectively.

question_40887.question: What is the purpose of sending the message N4 Session Modification Request from the SMF to UPF (PSA) in step 20a?
question_40887.ground_truth: To release the CN Tunnel on N3 if it is allocated during the preparation phase.

question_40889.question: Which functional entity is responsible for floor requests and off-network operation's full functionality in decentralized floor control within the MCPTT user's device?

question_40890.question: What are the conditions for usage monitoring to be active on IP-CAN session level in the PCEF?
question_40890.ground_truth: An IP-CAN session is active and a volume and/or time threshold value for the IP-CAN session has been provided in the PCEF.

question_40891.question: What is the difference between SCS-SpecificCarrier and NR-ARFCN?
question_40891.ground_truth: SCS-SpecificCarrier (Subcarrier Spacing-Specific Carrier) is a variable that represents the carrier bandwidth in the NR network, while NR-ARFCN (New Radio Absolute Radio Frequency NR) is a variable that represents the frequency resource allocation in the NR network. The SCS-SpecificCarrier is defined as a variable that ranges from 1 to 275 by default, while the NR-ARFCN is defined as a variable that ranges from 0 to 1599.

question_40892.question: What should a receiver of the first instantiation example do if it has only older versions of the schedule schema?
question_40892.ground_truth: A receiver with only older versions of the schedule schema should use the schema with the highest version number for validating the instantiation, but extensions made in higher versions of the schema will be ignored.

question_40893.question: What information elements should be included in the payload of the CoAP POST request when sending a MSGin5G message delivery status report?
question_40893.ground_truth: The payload of the CoAP POST request should include an "MSGin5G service identifier", "Message Type", "Originating UE Service ID", "Recipient UE Service ID/AS Service ID" (if applicable), "Message ID", "Delivery Status", and "Failure Cause" (if applicable) when sending a MSGin5G message delivery status report.

question_40894.question: What is an IMS Network-Independent Public User Identity (INIPUI) in the context of IP multimedia services?
question_40894.ground_truth: An IMS Network-Independent Public User Identity (INIPUI) is a Public User Identity in the form of a SIP URI where the Domain Name part is a Shared Domain Name.

question_40895.question: What is the function of the Proxy-Gn in the SGSN?
question_40895.ground_truth: The Proxy-Gn in the SGSN is a function that is responsible for routing signalling messages towards the Proxy-Gn in the first request only for non EGAN MS.

question_40899.question: How does the solution mitigate DDoS attack caused by massive number of misbehaving CIoT UEs in RAN?
question_40899.ground_truth: The solution provides mechanism for RAN to reject the malicious CIoT UEs in case of overload. Detection function (DF) detects potential malicious i CIoT UEs and reports the UE list to the AMF, the AMF distributes part of the UE list to the affected RAN. RAN will handle the list based on RAN status, only in case that RAN is going to be overloaded, it may handle these potential malicious UEs with high priority so that the RAN has more resource for normal UEs. When the RAN recovers, the mitigation will be stopped.

question_40900.question: What is the identifier of a local DN in 6.34.2.2?
question_40900.ground_truth: The identifier of a local DN can be DNAI, DNAI-A, or DNAI-B, for example.

question_40901.question: How should the geographical location information of the UE be included if it is available to the UE?
question_40901.ground_truth: The geographical location information of the UE should be included as a PIDF location object in accordance with RFC 4119 and included in a message body with the content type application/pidf+xml in accordance with RFC 6442.

question_40903.question: What is one impact of solution #30 on the AMF?
question_40903.ground_truth: The AMF needs to provide one new cause value "rejected due to AMF not support" for the rejected S-NSSAI, to enable the UE to request the rejected S-NSSAI in UE registration procedure without moving outside of the RA.

question_40906.question: What is the purpose of an Association in the context of the present document?
question_40906.ground_truth: An Association is used to model relationships between Managed Objects and can be implemented in several ways, such as name bindings, reference attributes, or association objects.

question_40907.question: What information does the hPCRF send to the vPCRF in the LBO case?
question_40907.ground_truth: The hPCRF sends QoS Policy Rules Provision to the vPCRF in the LBO case.

question_40910.question: What is the role of the DCCF in the Ndccf DataManagement service described in Section 4.2.1.2?
question_40910.ground_truth: The DCCF provides the functionality to coordinate collection of analytics and/or data from one or more NFs based on requests from one or more NF service consumers as part of the Ndccf DataManagement service.

question_40911.question: What are some of the mandatory and recommended voice codec requirements of IR.39 for HDVC UEs beyond those in TS 26.114 for MTSI clients?
question_40911.ground_truth: Some of these requirements include support for Enhanced Voice Services (EVS) codec, ITU-T G.719 codec, AAC-LD codec, and more.

question_40912.question: What is the purpose of the Relay UE info included in the Direct Communication Request messages?
question_40912.ground_truth: The Relay UE info (e.g. Relay UE ID) included in the Direct Communication Request messages by relays allows UEs to identify and select relays.

question_40914.question: What information should the network provide to the UE for Bluetooth measurements in UE-assisted positioning modes?
question_40914.ground_truth: The network should provide "Bluetooth supervision data" to UE, which contains a list of Bluetooth AP data that are to be measured by UE. Each Bluetooth AP data contains Bluetooth public-address information and/or Bluetooth device-name information.

question_40916.question: What is the prerequisite for valid limit checking when testing the adjacent channel interference performance?
question_40916.ground_truth: At least 990 wavelengths must be crossed with the speed given in the fading profile before limit checking is valid.

question_40917.question: What should the Refer-To header field of the SIP REFER request contain in the application/resource-lists MIME body?
question_40917.ground_truth: A Content-ID ("cid") Uniform Resource Locator (URL) pointing to an application/resource-lists MIME body, and with the Content-ID header field set to this "cid" URL.

question_40918.question: What should the UE (MCPTT Client) send as a response when the SS (MCPTT Server) ends an ongoing MCPTT Group Call by sending a SIP BYE message?
question_40918.ground_truth: The UE (MCPTT Client) should respond with a SIP 200 (OK) message.

question_40919.question: What should an MME do if a PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST message collision occurs during the dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure?
question_40919.ground_truth: The MME should terminate the dedicated bearer context activation procedure locally, release any resources related to this procedure and proceed with the PDN disconnect procedure.

question_40921.question: What must the H-PCF determine if the UE indicated support for 5G ProSe communications over the PC5 reference point, the "ProSe" feature is supported, and the UE POLICY PROVISIONING REQUEST message with the requested 5G ProSe policies is included in the uePolReq attribute?
question_40921.ground_truth: The applicable ProSeP and 5G ProSe N2 PC5 policy based on the operator's policy.

question_40924.question: What message is used to start the cell change order procedure in the 3GPP 04.60 standard?
question_40924.ground_truth: The PACKET CELL CHANGE ORDER message

question_40925.question: What is the term used to describe the combination of channel bandwidths and operating bands for ProSe communication?
question_40925.ground_truth: ProSe combination of channel bandwidths and operating bands

question_40926.question: What should the UE do if Mp - Hys > Thresh1 is met for event B1 leaving condition?
question_40926.ground_truth: The UE should consider the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied.

question_40927.question: What is the issue with frequent status updates and keep-alive messages in always-on mobile data applications?
question_40927.ground_truth: Frequent status updates and keep-alive messages can reduce network efficiency and waste network resources, resulting in a greater consumption of network resources than other applications such as HTTP/WAP browsing applications.

question_40928.question: In Solution 6-2, who is responsible for handling MBMS delivery of mission critical traffic and making decisions on FEC usage for certain groups and types of traffic?
question_40928.ground_truth: Under Solution 6-2, the terminating MC service server that is in charge of handling MBMS delivery of the mission critical traffic is enabled to make decisions on FEC usage for certain groups and types of traffic.

question_40929.question: What should the "notifFlag" attribute be set to in order to mute event notifications and store available events?

question_40933.question: What mechanism is used for an UE to set up an EPC access over WLAN in order to issue an emergency session?
question_40933.ground_truth: The mechanism involves the UE and the network exchanging parameters through EAP-AKA' in case of a regular authentication, and a specific 3GPP AAA server is involved even if no authentication is to take place.

question_40935.question: What is the expected HTTP status code for a successful response of the NF Service Consumer?
question_40935.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer responds with "204 No Content" on success.

question_40936.question: What should a mobile station do when a "missing mandatory IE" error is diagnosed upon receiving a message?
question_40936.ground_truth: If the SM transfer is not completed, the mobile station should ignore the message and return a CP-ERROR message with cause #96 "invalid mandatory information" if an appropriate connection exists. If the SM transfer is completed, the mobile station should ignore the message and enter the Idle State.

question_40937.question: What is the number of frame erasure events that the SS records in the procedure for testing the adjacent channel interference performance using statistical methods?
question_40937.ground_truth: The SS records the number of frame erasure events for the TCH/AFS by examining at least the minimum number of samples of consecutive frames.

question_40938.question: What is the function of the "Support of S1-AP message from MME to eNB to request that UE leaves extended CDRX" in the eNB?
question_40938.ground_truth: The function of this feature is to allow the MME to request the UE to leave the extended CDRX mode, triggered by various RAN or UE originated procedures during handover or MO SMS.

question_40940.question: What is the main difference between Solution #4.1 and Solution #4.2 in the topic of charging the usage of 5G VN group communication?
question_40940.ground_truth: Solution #4.1 aggregates the volume of the PDU sessions of the membership of the 5G LAN VN Group in the SMF, while Solution #4.2 reports the usage per PDU session to the CHF and the CHF aggregates the charging information based on the total usage PDU session.

question_40941.question: In the context of IMS service centralization and continuity, what is the role of the SCC AS?
question_40941.ground_truth: The SCC AS provides functionality required to enable IMS Centralized Services by providing SIP UA behaviour on behalf of the UE for setup and control of IMS sessions using CS bearers, processing SIP signalling for interworking with other IMS functional elements, and influencing the selection of an access network for delivery of incoming sessions to the UE.

question_40942.question: What is the significance of the "broadcast group call indicator" parameter in the group call setup procedure?
question_40942.ground_truth: The "broadcast group call indicator" parameter is significant in the group call setup procedure because it triggers the broadcast group call procedure and allows for only the call originating MCPTT user to transmit media on the call.

question_40943.question: What is the message type and direction of the UPLINK NAS TRANSPORT message?
question_40943.ground_truth: Message type: UPLINK NAS TRANSPORT, Direction: UE to network

question_40944.question: What must the WLAN UE do in order to assist PLMN selection procedure?
question_40944.ground_truth: The WLAN UE shall create a list of available WSIDs, which consists of all WSIDs found in passive scanning and all WSIDs received as a result of active scanning.

question_40945.question: What is the requirement for the block error rate (BLER) performance when the wanted signal is TUhigh faded and the adjacent channel interferer is present for 8-PSK modulation in PDTCH/DAS-5 to 7?
question_40945.ground_truth: The block error rate (BLER) performance for PDTCH/DAS-5 to 7 shall not exceed 10 %.

question_40946.question: When a Priority PDU connectivity service is revoked, what action does the PCF take with respect to the 5QI of the default QoS flow?
question_40946.ground_truth: The PCF sets the 5QI of the default QoS flow as appropriate for the PCF decision.

question_40948.question: What are the two methods for initiating 3pcc procedures?
question_40948.ground_truth: The two methods for initiating 3pcc procedures are by sending re-INVITE requests in existing partial dialogs and by sending INVITE requests to establish new partial dialogs.

question_40949.question: What action should the network take when the originating UE provides identity information but it does not match any registered public identities?
question_40949.ground_truth: The network should replace the UE-provided identity with one that includes the default public user identity.

question_40950.question: What is signaled in-band in the MAC-ehs header to support MAC-ehs SDU segmentation in Node B and reassembly at the UE?
question_40950.ground_truth: The segmentation indication parameter is signaled in-band in the MAC-ehs header to support MAC-ehs SDU segmentation in Node B and reassembly at the UE.

question_40951.question: Which positioning technologies are considered for the identified use cases?
question_40951.ground_truth: Both 3GPP and non-3GPP positioning technologies are considered for the identified use cases. The report provides an illustrative allocation between existing positioning technologies and 3GPP new positioning technologies.

question_40953.question: What should the ProSe Function in the HPLMN do if it receives a valid ProSe Code from the PLMN and the UE context has the Announcing Enabled stored?
question_40953.ground_truth: The ProSe Function in the HPLMN should trigger the Announcing Alert procedure to notify the UE to perform announcing.

question_40959.question: Which protocol message contains "CellMeasurementResult-NR-ENDC-List" and "CellMeasurementResult-E-UTRA-ENDC-List" in the EN-DC Resource Status Update message?
question_40959.ground_truth: The EN-DC Resource Status Update message contains both "CellMeasurementResult-NR-ENDC-List" and "CellMeasurementResult-E-UTRA-ENDC-List".

question_40961.question: What information is required by the NEF for QoS Monitoring for packet delay in 3GPP TS 29.122?
question_40961.ground_truth: The NEF requires the "qosMonInfo" attribute, which includes one or more requested QoS Monitoring Parameter(s) for packet delay, and the "directNotifInd" attribute set to true if the "ExposureToEAS" feature is supported and direct notification is required. Within the QosMonitoringInformation data structure, the AF may include a delay threshold for downlink, uplink, or round trip, the minimum waiting time between subsequent reports, and the maximum period with no QoS measurement results reported.

question_40962.question: What should the target EES do upon receiving an EEC Context Pull request, before storing the EEC Context?
question_40962.ground_truth: The target EES validates the request, verifies security credentials, and uses the EEC Context ID provided to authorize and identify the EEC Context to be relocated.

question_40963.question: In Case C, what are the performance gain and penalty definitions for the current and past active speaker considering the two video resolutions in the analysis?
question_40963.ground_truth: a1 is the performance gain of SHVC over simulcast for coding the two video resolutions of the current active speaker (H and M), b1 is the performance penalty of SHVC versus single layer for coding the two video resolutions of the current active speaker (H and M), a2 is the performance gain of SHVC over simulcast for coding the two video resolutions of the past active speaker (M and T), and b2 is the performance penalty of SHVC versus single layer for coding the two video resolutions of the past active speaker (M and T).

question_40964.question: When allocating RBGs for 5 MHz bandwidth in DCI combination 2, what is the criterion for selecting the first available RBG?
question_40964.ground_truth: If NPRB is even, the first NPRB /2 available RBGs are allocated. If NPRB is odd, then the first (NPRB -1)/2 RBGs and RBG 12 are allocated.

question_40965.question: What mainly determines the order of magnitude of feasible time scales for small cell on/off using legacy procedures?
question_40965.ground_truth: The order of magnitude of feasible time scales for small cell on/off using legacy procedures mainly depends on UE capability, UE status, and the frequency of the cells.

question_40966.question: What should the WLAN UE use by default for parameters in procedures, if available in the USIM?
question_40966.ground_truth: The WLAN UE should use parameters described in the 3GPP specifications available in the USIM by default, if they are available in the USIM.

question_40967.question: What should the UE do if timer T3584 is running or deactivated for an S-NSSAI and DNN in the old PLMN or SNPN, but not running and not deactivated for the S-NSSAI and DNN in the new PLMN or SNPN upon PLMN or SNPN change?
question_40967.ground_truth: The UE is allowed to send a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for the same S-NSSAI and the same DNN in the new PLMN or SNPN.

question_40970.question: In the 5.4.12 policy rule, when the location is indicated with more than one leaf, what should the UE do to match the location?
question_40970.ground_truth: When the location is indicated with more than one leaf in the 5.4.12 policy rule, the UE shall consider the 3GPP location validity condition for the particular rule to be fulfilled only if the present leaf values in the node match with the location of the UE in that radio access technology and the UE shall ignore other existing values, if any.

question_40971.question: What is the difference between the Direct and Indirect architectural models in the 3GPP system?
question_40971.ground_truth: In the Direct Model, the AS connects directly to the operator network for user plane communications with the UE without the use of any external SCS. In the Indirect Model, the AS connects indirectly to the operator network through the services of an SCS for value-added services for MTC, such as control plane device triggering.

question_40973.question: What is the impact of not supporting overload control on interfaces S2a/S2b?
question_40973.ground_truth: Without support of overload control on S2a/S2b, requests could be simply dropped or extremely delayed, resulting in GTP-C retransmissions that increase the load in the PGW and possible failures in handover, PDN connection establishment or deletion.

question_40974.question: What types of IRP specifications are defined by 3GPP?
question_40974.ground_truth: 3GPP defines three types of IRP specifications: one type relates to the definitions of the interface deployed across the Itf-N, and the other two types relate to the network resource model (schema) of the managed network.

question_40975.question: What is the purpose of the "lower layer failure" test described in section 26.8.1.2.9.5 of the document?
question_40975.ground_truth: The purpose of the "lower layer failure" test is to verify that the MS (Mobile Station) can return to the idle mode and have the CC entities relating to the seven mobile originating transaction identifiers in state U0, "Null", when a lower layer failure is detected while in the CC-state U19, "Release Request".

question_40976.question: What happens if a M3AP message does not conform to the defined structure?
question_40976.ground_truth: It is considered an Abstract Syntax Error and handled as defined in clause 10.

question_40978.question: What is the difference between the first and second digits in the version number of the technical report?
question_40978.ground_truth: The first digit of the version number indicates the level of approval of the document by the TSG, while the second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, such as technical enhancements, corrections, and updates.

question_40979.question: What is the size of the port range for the 8-bit address in application port addressing?
question_40979.ground_truth: The port range is up to 255 using 8 bit addressing space.

question_40980.question: What information is required when requesting a Machine Learning (ML) model from a Network Data Analytics Function (NWDAF) containing Model Training and Learning Function (MTLF)?
question_40980.ground_truth: The required information includes a list of Analytics ID(s), NF consumer information (optionally), use case context (optionally), ML Model Interoperability Information (optionally), ML Model Filter Information (optionally), Target of ML Model Reporting (optionally), Requested representative ratio (optionally), ML Model Reporting Information (optionally), ML Model Target Period (optionally), Inference Input Data information (optionally), Notification Target Address and Notification Correlation ID, and optionally supporting multiple ML models.

question_40981.question: What is the purpose of the Type 6 IE container information element?
question_40981.ground_truth: The Type 6 IE container information element is used to transfer type 6 IEs of format TLV-E explicitly specified for inclusion in a message, and can take any value in the range 00 to FF (hexadecimal).

question_40982.question: What is the goal of defining service capability features in a generic way?
question_40982.ground_truth: The goal is to hide network-specific implementations and enable applications to use functions without requiring knowledge of the underlying network capabilities. This results in applications becoming independent of the network domain, making them network-agnostic.

question_40984.question: What message does ProSe Server-A respond with to ProSe Server-B after receiving a ProSe Location Request message?
question_40984.ground_truth: ProSe Server-A responds with a ProSe Location Request Ack message to ProSe Server-B after receiving a ProSe Location Request message from ProSe Server-B.

question_40985.question: What does the POC-5 reference point provide in terms of functionality related to XCAP?
question_40985.ground_truth: The POC-5 reference point provides retrieval of URI Lists from the Shared XDMS using XCAP.

question_40986.question: What is the meaning of NB-IoT operating in-band, guard band, and standalone operation?
question_40986.ground_truth: NB-IoT operating in-band refers to NB-IoT utilization of resource blocks within a normal E-UTRA carrier. NB-IoT operating in guard band utilizes unused resource blocks within a E-UTRA carrier's guard-band. NB-IoT operating standalone utilizes its own spectrum for deployment and is not reliant on any other system.

question_40987.question: What should the terminating MCData participating function do when it receives a media packet on an MBMS bearer that is associated with a group and the MSRP URI in the payload does not match the one provided during session establishment?
question_40987.ground_truth: It should still accept the payload as correctly destined for the terminating MCData client, since MBMS bearers may be shared among multiple clients.

question_40988.question: How many times should the MS resend the DEACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message when the network does not reply, as per 45.4.3.1.1?
question_40988.ground_truth: The MS should resend the DEACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message five times when the network does not reply, as per 45.4.3.1.1.

question_40989.question: What is the role of the Centralized Authorization Service producer in the 3GPP management system?
question_40989.ground_truth: The Centralized Authorization Service producer, also known as Cross Domain Authorization Service producer, provides management capabilities to provision access permissions on MnSs for a MnS consumer or a group of MnS consumers and grant permissions to a MnS consumer explicitly or implicitly.

question_40990.question: When does the V-PCF split the UE policy information in smaller logical independent UE policy information fragments in H-PCF and V-PCF?
question_40990.ground_truth: If the size of UE policy information exceeds the predefined limit in H-PCF or V-PCF, the UE policy information is split into smaller logical independent UE policy information fragments, with each fragment having a size under the predefined limit.

question_40991.question: What is the required ratio of successful reported values for each requirement (R1 to R6) for the test to pass?
question_40991.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values for each requirement (R1 to R6) shall be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_40992.question: What is the purpose of allocating a Sequence Number to each PDU Set?
question_40992.ground_truth: This enables the gNB to estimate the amount of time that it has for the delivery of each PDU from the time that the first PDU of that PDU Set arrives at the gNB.

question_40993.question: What action should the MCData client take upon receiving a successful transmission indication from the media plane?
question_40993.ground_truth: The MCData client should generate a SIP BYE request with a reason code of "200" and text of "transmission succeeded", then send the request towards the MCData server.

question_40994.question: What is the main reason for the high power efficiency in V2P services where P-UEs only send V2X messages?
question_40994.ground_truth: The main reason for high power efficiency in V2P services where P-UEs only send V2X messages is that they do not need to receive V2X messages from V-UEs, thus, reducing the power consumption.

question_40996.question: What is the purpose of the key index in ensuring forward security in the context of the Technical Report?
question_40996.ground_truth: The key index is used to ensure that the UE can determine which key (and key derivations) has been used by the eNB or MME to provide forward security.

question_40997.question: What state do the MCPTT server and media distributor transition to when the floor control server receives an MCPTT call release step~1 request from the application and signaling plane?
question_40997.ground_truth: The floor control server transitions to the 'Releasing' state, while the MCPTT server and media distributor stop sending RTP media packets to MCPTT clients.

question_40999.question: What is the behavior of the MCData group standalone FD request when it is sent toward each MCData user determined in step 3?
question_40999.ground_truth: The MCData group standalone FD request towards each MCData client contains an emergency indicator, an imminent peril indicator, and an alert indicator if it is present in the received MCData group standalone FD request from the MCData client 1.

question_41002.question: What does the dynamic information in the AC Group profile IE include and how is it made available?
question_41002.ground_truth: The dynamic information in the AC Group profile IE includes geographical service area or location information of other UEs involved in the multi-user session. It is made available at runtime through an AC's (Access Class) interaction with the AS (Authentication Server) to which it is registered.

question_41004.question: Which MMS element is responsible for managing MMBoxes?

question_41005.question: What is the result of the old SGSN receiving a Forward Relocation Complete message and a PS Handover Cancel PDU for the same handover?
question_41005.ground_truth: The old SGSN ignores the PS Handover Cancel PDU.

question_41006.question: What is the function of the "UE reflective QoS" in the 3GPP system when interworking with a Fixed Broadband Access network?
question_41006.ground_truth: The "UE reflective QoS" is a function in the UE that supports reflective QoS for uplink traffic over a Fixed Broadband Access network. It creates uplink DSCP marking rules based on the received downlink traffic to set the DSCP field of the outer IP header of the outgoing IP packets.

question_41007.question: What is the function of the Broadcast Channel (BCH) in the downlink transport channels?
question_41007.ground_truth: The Broadcast Channel (BCH) is characterized by its fixed, pre-defined transport format and its requirement to be broadcast in the entire coverage area of the cell, either as a single message or by beamforming different BCH instances.

question_41009.question: What operation should be supported by a MnS producer if it supports the setComment operation?

question_41011.question: In what circumstances is the evaluation of the candidate beams not completed even if the beam failure is detected?
question_41011.ground_truth: The evaluation of the candidate beams is not completed when the required resources are not available, for example, due to a lack of UL-SCH resources for transmission, and this results in the omission of the corresponding octet(s) containing the AC field.

question_41014.question: What entities are involved in the interworking from 5GS to EPS regarding small data rate control for 5GS CIoT UE?
question_41014.ground_truth: During interworking from 5GS to EPS, if Small Data Rate Control applies, the PGW-C+SMF from PGW-U+UFF or from SCEF+NEF, AMF, SMF, and PGW-U+UPF are involved in exchanging information for interworking 5GS to EPS and supporting the use of APN rate control parameters when 5GS CIoT UE backs to EPS.

question_41015.question: What should the MCPTT client do when it receives a SIP 2xx response to the SIP re-INVITE request?
question_41015.ground_truth: When the MCPTT client receives a SIP 2xx response to the SIP re-INVITE request, it should interact with the user plane as specified in 3GPP TS 24.380 and set the MCPTT emergency private priority state of the MCPTT private call to "MEPP 1: no-emergency".

question_41017.question: What is the process of cell selection in multi-beam operations for a UE?
question_41017.ground_truth: The UE derives a cell measurement quantity based on the highest beam measurement quantity value for each cell in multi-beam operations. If the highest beam measurement quantity value is below a threshold, the cell measurement quantity is the highest value. Otherwise, it is the linear average of the power values of up to a certain number of the highest beam measurement quantity values above the threshold.

question_41018.question: What is a prerequisite for TDD-FDD joint operation?
question_41018.ground_truth: A prerequisite for TDD-FDD joint operation is that UEs supporting it shall be able to access both legacy FDD and legacy TDD single mode carriers.

question_41019.question: What is the purpose of the "shared secret" in the CHAP authentication process?
question_41019.ground_truth: The "shared secret" is a piece of secret information that is known only to the client and the framework. It is used to generate the hash for the response octet set, and to validate the response octet set in the challenge phase.

question_41020.question: What is the difference between PDN GW initiated Resource Allocation Deactivation with S2a PMIP and S2a MIPv4?
question_41020.ground_truth: The difference between PDN GW initiated Resource Allocation Deactivation with S2a PMIP and S2a MIPv4 lies in the way the resources are released and the messages exchanged between the PDN GW, Trusted non-3GPP IP access, and vPCRF (Visited PCRF) or hPCRF (Home PCRF). The PMIP (Proxy Mobile IP) based approach involves the use of Binding Revocation Indication and Acknowledgement messages, while the MIPv4 (Mobile IP version 4) based approach uses Registration Revocation and Acknowledgement messages.

question_41023.question: What is the definition of Reverse Charging in the context of communication set up?
question_41023.ground_truth: Reverse Charging is a service that allows the terminating party to be charged for the entire communication, with usage-based charges applicable to the terminating party. The service must be requested by the originating party and explicitly accepted by the terminating party.

question_41024.question: What does the SMF do when the PS Data Off event trigger is provisioned and PCF is deployed?
question_41024.ground_truth: The SMF reports the PS Data Off status to PCF if the PS Data Off event trigger is provisioned. If dynamic PCC is not deployed, the SMF takes the QoS constraints from the VPLMN into account when generating the default QoS rule.

question_41027.question: What message does the source RNS send to the UE in the CS domain relocation procedure?
question_41027.ground_truth: The source RNS sends a HO Command message to the UE in the CS domain relocation procedure, instructing the UE to move to UTRAN/HSPA for VoIMS.

question_41028.question: What is the color code and NCC value for cell B in GSM900, DCS1800, GSM700, and GSM850?
question_41028.ground_truth: PLMN color code, NCC = 3, and BS color code, BCC = 0.

question_41029.question: What information is included in an SMFStartOfInterceptionWithEstablishedMAPDUSession record when reporting an existing PDN Connection?
question_41029.ground_truth: When the SMFStartOfInterceptionWithEstablishedMAPDUSession record is used to report an existing PDN Connection, it includes the ePSStartOfInterceptionWithEstablishedPDNConnection field, the SUPI field (if there is no SUPI associated to the SM context for the target UE, the SUPI field shall be populated with the value of the IMSI from the target UE context), the pDUSessionID field (if there is no PDU Session ID associated to the context for the PDN connection, the pDUSessionID field shall be populated with the EBI of the default bearer for the PDN Connection), and the gTPTunnelID field (if there is no 5G UP tunnel present in the context associated to the PDN Connection, the gTPTunnelID field shall be populated with the F-TEID for the PGW S5 or S8 interface for the default bearer of the PDN Connection).

question_41030.question: In what order does the UE search for a synchronization reference source if it has not selected any synchronization reference in NR sidelink communication/discovery?
question_41030.ground_truth: The UE searches for a synchronization reference source in the following order: UEs with the highest PSBCH-RSRP result in priority group 1, followed by priority group 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6; GNSS with the highest PSBCH-RSRP result in priority group 3; and other UEs with the highest PSBCH-RSRP result in priority group 6.

question_41031.question: What is the difference between Option 1 and Option 2 in the process, and what are the benefits of each option?
question_41031.ground_truth: Option 1 involves the UE-to network relay contacting the Remote UE's 5G PKMF-1 via its 5G PKMF-2, while Option 2 involves the UE-to-network relay retrieving the address of the Remote UE's 5G PKMF-1 from its 5GDDNMF and contacting it directly. Option 1 is useful when there are business agreements between the 5G PKMF-1(Remote UE) and 5G PKMF-2(UE-to-network relay), while Option 2 is useful when the UE-to-network relay needs to contact the 5G PKMF-1(Remote UE) more directly. The interface between the 5G PKMF-2(UE-to-network Relay) and the 5G PKMF-1(Remote UE) is out of the 3GPP scope in both options.

question_41032.question: In which scenario is an MS with a USIM expected to receive a GSM authentication challenge when it expects a UMTS authentication challenge?
question_41032.ground_truth: This scenario occurs if the network sends a GSM authentication challenge instead of a UMTS authentication challenge when the MS expects the latter.

question_41033.question: What is the role of hypermedia in REST architecture?
question_41033.ground_truth: The role of hypermedia in REST architecture is to indicate to the client what is possible to do with a resource. Hypermedia gives the client a hint as to what may be possible next and allows the server to advertise new capabilities.

question_41034.question: Under what conditions can the MCData client reject a SIP INVITE request?
question_41034.ground_truth: The MCData client can reject a SIP INVITE request if it does not have enough resources to handle the call, or for any other reason outside the scope of the specification.

question_41036.question: How many demodulation branches can be tested for conformance requirements for BS type 1-O and BS type 2-O in over-the-air (OTA) testing?
question_41036.ground_truth: Conformance requirements can only be tested for 1 or 2 demodulation branches depending on the number of polarizations supported by the BS, with the required SNR applied separately per polarization.

question_41037.question: What action does the EES take if the EEC is not authorized to deregister the EEC registration information?
question_41037.ground_truth: The EES does not deregister the EEC profile from the EES and does not delete the resource representing EEC registration information.

question_41038.question: What should the MCVideo client do when it receives a Media Transmission Notification message during an incoming Pre-arranged Emergency Group Call with implicit Transmission Control?
question_41038.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should provide media transmission notification to the MCVideo User and send a Receive Media Request message to the SS (MCVideo Server) and respect the Reception Control imposed by the SS (MCVideo Server).

question_41042.question: What is the significance of the PLMN ID in an admission request?
question_41042.ground_truth: The PLMN ID is significant because it enables the NSACF NF to identify roaming UEs and differentiate them from home UEs.

question_41043.question: What is the effect of deploying SNSF on redundancy and failover in the signalling plane?
question_41043.ground_truth: Resilience of the network may be improved through the implementation of nodal redundancy and failover capabilities at the SNSF.

question_41044.question: What is the function of the Abbreviated Dialling feature in a VPN?
question_41044.ground_truth: The Abbreviated Dialling feature in a VPN allows the definition of abbreviated dialling numbers that represent the actual dialling digit sequence, exempting VPN users from call restrictions.

question_41045.question: What HTTP status code is returned by the UDM if the NWDAF registration request is authorized?
question_41045.ground_truth: The UDM responds with "200 OK" or "201 Created" with the message body containing a representation of the created NWDAF registration.

question_41046.question: What is the 3GPP Core Network's role in informing a 3rd party service provider about potential network issues?
question_41046.ground_truth: The 3GPP Core Network can indicate to a 3rd party service provider when data transmissions have a risk of incapability to provide expected throughput and/or QoS in a specific area, and provide information about the UE's status, such as roaming status, loss of connectivity, changes in association between the ME and the USIM, and communication failure events visible to the network.

question_41049.question: If the UE wants all subsequent requests in the dialog to arrive over the same flow identified by the flow token, what SIP URI parameter should it include in the Contact header field?

question_41050.question: Where can the 3GPP Generic User Profile be stored?
question_41050.ground_truth: The 3GPP Generic User Profile can be stored in the home network environment and/or Value Added Service Provider equipment.

question_41051.question: What is RAN sharing and its benefits in a telecommunications network?
question_41051.ground_truth: RAN sharing is a functionality supporting the exchange of information, via the Core Network, between peer application entities located in a GERAN or in a UTRAN access network, allowing two or more CN operators to share the same RAN, i.e. a RAN node connects to multiple CN nodes belonging to different CN operators, enhancing resource utilization and reducing the cost of services.

question_41052.question: What are the procedures for MCPTT client standard SIP registration?
question_41052.ground_truth: The MCPTT client performs standard SIP registration to the SIP core, carrying the public user identity and the security token. The SIP core checks the validity of the token and performs registration with the MCPTT server using the public user identity and the security token.

question_41053.question: What should the Content-Type header field be set to in the HTTP 200 (OK) response message generated by the SNRM-S in step 6.2.3.2.4 (a) (i)?
question_41053.ground_truth: The Content-Type header field should be set to "application/vnd.3gpp.seal-mbms-usage-info+xml".

question_41054.question: What is the role of the UE in relation to Home Network Preference information?
question_41054.ground_truth: The UE uses Home Network Preference information provided by the H-ANDSF or statically provisioned in the UE, and ignores information provided by V-ANDSF.

question_41055.question: When should the UE trigger the Mobility Registration Update procedure to inform the network of its unavailability?
question_41055.ground_truth: The UE should trigger the Mobility Registration Update procedure early enough such that the procedure, under normal conditions, is able to complete before the start of the unreachability period.

question_41056.question: What is the purpose of using a shielded anechoic chamber in OTA unwanted emission testing?
question_41056.ground_truth: The purpose of using a shielded anechoic chamber in OTA unwanted emission testing is to avoid measurement chamber influence and external interferers on the test result.

question_41057.question: What is the name of the test that involves verifying the timing requirements of a UE for ProSe Direct Discovery transmissions?
question_41057.ground_truth: E-UTRAN FDD - UE ProSe Direct Discovery Transmission Timing Accuracy Test

question_41062.question: What is the strategy for reducing the number of PTRS groups for narrower allocations in OFDM?
question_41062.ground_truth: The strategy for reducing the number of PTRS groups for narrower allocations in OFDM is for RAN4 to determine the optimal ratio of available symbols to PTRS symbols, taking into account the 4-symbol limitation per group and 8 groups per OFDM symbol.

question_41063.question: What does the Accumulated-Cost AVP hold in the Transfer-Information AVP?
question_41063.ground_truth: The Accumulated-Cost AVP in the Transfer-Information AVP holds the accumulated cost for the ongoing session in the IMS network.

question_41064.question: What is the required SNR for PUCCH format 3 with DM-RS bundling in 8.3.13.1?
question_41064.ground_truth: The required SNR for PUCCH format 3 with DM-RS bundling is at UCI block error probability not exceeding 1%.

question_41065.question: What is the purpose of the event delivered in case of a change of SGSN during a Routing Area Update using NIDD with SCEF?
question_41065.ground_truth: The purpose of this event is to notify the DF2 of the change in SGSN when a Routing Area Update occurs for an IoT UE using NIDD with SCEF.

question_41067.question: Which network components are impacted by T5 triggering and what adaptations are required?
question_41067.ground_truth: The network components MTC-IWF, HSS, MME/SGSN, and UE have no additional requirements other than supporting the T5 small data delivery service, as the impact specific to triggering is only some criteria that makes a Tsp small data delivery request a trigger delivery request.

question_41068.question: What is the difference between MCData Data signalling payload and MCData Data payload?
question_41068.ground_truth: MCData Data signalling payload includes information necessary for identification and management of MCData messages, while MCData Data payload is the actual user payload for MCData user or application consumption.

question_41069.question: What input data does the NWDAF consume for predicting location accuracy in the training phase?
question_41069.ground_truth: The NWDAF consumes input data such as UE IDs, UE location information, ground truth UE location information and assistance information in the training phase for predicting location accuracy.

question_41071.question: How does the LMISF-IRI uniquely associate a record with the inbound roaming UE for N9HR LI related LI_X2_LITE records?
question_41071.ground_truth: The LMISF-IRI shall use the SUPI and PDU Session ID to uniquely associate a record with the inbound roaming UE for N9HR LI related LI_X2_LITE records.

question_41074.question: What is the role of Quality of Service (QoS) in addressing the key issue of media protocols on 5G?
question_41074.ground_truth: QoS becomes relevant during high network utilization to prioritize packets. In well-planned scenarios, the 5G System fits the needs of the media production, but QoS helps degrade output if proper planning and dimensioning aren't possible in all media production scenarios.

question_41076.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG RAN) in the context of Location Services (LCS) in GERAN?
question_41076.ground_truth: The purpose is to define the GERAN LCS architecture, functional entities and operations to support location methods. This description is specific to the aspects of LCS within the GERAN and does not involve the LCS entities or operations within the Core Network.

question_41077.question: What is the 5% UL Average-UPT gain provided by the semi-static SBFD at a low load level with 40dBm BS transmission power assumed by 1 source?
question_41077.ground_truth: The 5% UL Average-UPT gain provided by the semi-static SBFD at a low load level with 40dBm BS transmission power assumed by 1 source is 9.83%.

question_41078.question: What is the purpose of the Number of payloads IE in clause 15.2.12?
question_41078.ground_truth: The Number of payloads IE in clause 15.2.12 is used to specify the number of Payload IEs that need to be encoded.

question_41079.question: Who can merge two or more existing Railway Emergency Alerts in the FRMCS System?
question_41079.ground_truth: An authorized FRMCS User (i.e., Controller) or an External System (e.g., Traffic Management System or Train Tracking System) is able to merge two or more existing Railway Emergency Alerts in the FRMCS System.

question_41081.question: When should the MAC entity stop the pur-ResponseWindowTimer?
question_41081.ground_truth: The MAC entity should stop the pur-ResponseWindowTimer when L1 ACK for transmission using PUR is received from lower layers or the MAC PDU is successfully decoded, or when a fallback indication for PUR is received from lower layers.

question_41082.question: What is the effect of EPS bearers associated with the same QCI but different ARP values on ProSe Per-Packet Priority over PC5?
question_41082.ground_truth: EPS bearers associated with the same QCI, but different ARP values, result in the same ProSe Per-Packet Priority over PC5.

question_41083.question: What is the term used to describe the monitoring of multiple inter-frequency E-UTRAN carriers, inter-RAT E-UTRAN carriers, inter-RAT UTRA FDD carriers, and inter-frequency NR carriers using gaps in NE-DC operation mode?
question_41083.ground_truth: Monitoring of multiple layers using gaps

question_41084.question: What should the I-CSCF do if it cannot select a S-CSCF which fulfils the mandatory capabilities indicated by the HSS?
question_41084.ground_truth: The I-CSCF should send back a 600 (Busy Everywhere) response to the user.

question_41085.question: What was the strategy used to measure fork positions in the round robin test for initial clamping fork positions?
question_41085.ground_truth: The head of the clamp must not push against the ear/cheek of the HATS and the screen of the device must be mounted correctly. To ensure this, the following general positioning strategy was chosen for Lab #2, and adapted by labs #3 and #4. Bottom position: the fork is moved and tightened as close as possible at the lower edge of the device. Mid position: the fork is moved and tightened as close as possible at the center of the device. Top position: the fork is moved and tightened as close as possible at the most upper edge of the device. Care was taken that the clamp did not produce an overhang.

question_41086.question: What is the purpose of the PDU Session Modification Indication in the context of the New RAN?
question_41086.ground_truth: The PDU Session Modification Indication is used to switch a data path from one termination point at the New RAN to a different termination point.

question_41089.question: How can classifiers use interfaces in object-oriented programming?
question_41089.ground_truth: Instantiable classifiers, such as class or use case, may use interfaces for specifying different services offered by their instances.

question_41092.question: What is the maximum cell re-selection delay allowed for the test in 8.3.5.5.2.1 to pass?
question_41092.ground_truth: The maximum cell re-selection delay allowed for the test in 8.3.5.5.2.1 to pass is 5.7 seconds.

question_41095.question: Which L1-SINR value is compared to the expected L1-SINR value in requirement R1?
question_41095.ground_truth: The L1-SINR value of CSI-RS#0+CSI-IM#0 reported by the UE is compared to the expected L1-SINR value for CSI-RS#0+CSI-IM#0 in requirement R1.

question_41096.question: What procedure is used to update the TFT for an active default or dedicated S2a bearer in PDN GW Initiated Bearer Modification procedure?
question_41096.ground_truth: The Update Bearer Request (EPS bearer Identity, EPS bearer QoS, TFT) message is sent to the TWAG in the BBF domain to update the TFT for an active default or dedicated S2a bearer.

question_41097.question: What is the result of the RECEIVE DATA commands in the logs?
question_41097.ground_truth: The general result of the RECEIVE DATA commands is "Command performed successfully."

question_41098.question: What action does the NAS take if the UE indicates that there is uplink user data pending for one or more PDU sessions when building a REGISTRATION REQUEST or SERVICE REQUEST message?
question_41098.ground_truth: The UE shall indicate the respective PDU sessions in the Uplink data status IE as specified in subclause~5.5.1.3.2 and 5.6.1.2, regardless of the access category for which the access barring check is performed.

question_41099.question: What model is used for testing the output power of a base station using E-UTRA Test Model 1.1?

question_41100.question: What is the output power limit per conductor for the AAS BS in the non-AAS specifications?
question_41100.ground_truth: The output power limit per conductor for the AAS BS in the non-AAS specifications is the same as that used in the non-AAS specifications, the system limit is the non-AAS limit scaled by the number of active transceiver units.

question_41101.question: What is the purpose of the "AKMA key storage and update" requirement in the document?
question_41101.ground_truth: The "AKMA key storage and update" requirement ensures that the AAnF network product stores only the latest AKMA context received by the AUSF, and deletes the old A-KID and KAKMA after receiving the new ones.

question_41102.question: What is the resulting mean capacity performance when bandwidth is increased from 100MHz to 400MHz for FR2, Indoor Hotspot, DL, AR/VR (45 Mbps, 10ms PDB, 60FPS), DDDSU TDD format based on Source 16?
question_41102.ground_truth: The mean capacity performance is increased from 5 UEs per cell to 22.5 UEs per cell.

question_41103.question: What should the UE do to measure the CSI-RS for L1-RSRP in the same OFDM symbol as an SSB for L1-RSRP?
question_41103.ground_truth: The UE shall be able to perform CSI-RS measurement without restrictions if the UE supports simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology. If not, the UE is required to measure one of but not both CSI-RS for L1-RSRP measurement and SSB.

question_41104.question: What is the main difference between the two test set-ups (A and B) in section 9.4.1.2.2?
question_41104.ground_truth: In test set-up A, the interfering signal is added to the wanted signal via a combining network, while in test set-up B, the interfering signal is established by the BSSTE through the BSS.

question_41110.question: Which attribute is used to indicate the highest schema version supported by a UE or network?

question_41112.question: What is the minimum bandwidth for each sub-block in the Base Station RF Bandwidth when constructing NTC4a?
question_41112.ground_truth: The minimum bandwidth for each sub-block is 6MHz.

question_41113.question: What is the purpose of the Local NEF Discovery procedure in step 6.4.2.2?
question_41113.ground_truth: The Local NEF Discovery procedure in step 6.4.2.2 is used by the AF to discover the L-NEF, which is typically registered with an NRF deployed in the operator's domain where the AF resides.

question_41114.question: What is the role of the V2X Application Server in the reference model of the architecture?
question_41114.ground_truth: The V2X Application Server is responsible for connecting to multiple PLMNs and communicating with other V2X Application Servers for the exchange of V2X messages. It also manages MBMS service related information via BM-SC.

question_41117.question: In what scenario will the network set the 5GMM cause value to #78 in the REGISTRATION REJECT message?
question_41117.ground_truth: When the UE's mobility and periodic registration update request is via a satellite NG-RAN cell and the network determines that the UE is in a location where the network is not allowed to operate.

question_41118.question: What should be the state of non-voice PS bearers during SRVCC procedure in E-UTRAN?
question_41118.ground_truth: The handover of non-voice PS bearers is done by the PS bearer splitting function in the MME during SRVCC procedure in E-UTRAN.

question_41120.question: What should be the modifier XML attribute specification value of all XML elements containing NRM instances in a tree of NRM instances with all XML elements having a modifier XML attribute specification of value delete?
question_41120.ground_truth: In a tree of NRM instances with all XML elements having a modifier XML attribute specification of value delete, all XML elements carrying subordinate NRM instances should not appear before the XML element carrying the parent NRM instance.

question_41121.question: What is the interruption time in the interruption requirement for the test to pass?
question_41121.ground_truth: The interruption time in the interruption requirement for the test to pass is Tinterrupt = Tsearch + TIU + 20 ms, where Tsearch = 80 and TIU = 15 ms. If the target cell is known, then Tsearch = 0 ms. If the target cell is unknown and signal quality is sufficient for successful cell detection on the first attempt, then Tsearch = 80 ms. TIU can be up to 30 ms. This requirement applies when UE is not required to perform any synchronization procedure before transmitting on the new PRACH. The interruption time shall be less than Tinterrupt.

question_41122.question: What operation does the PDN GW provide to the PCRF when adding new packet filters to an existing TFT?
question_41122.ground_truth: The PDN GW provides to the PCRF the Gx operation "add filters" when the TFT operation is "Add packet filters to existing TFT".

question_41123.question: What are the necessary updates for the group management server and IWF for the proposal of user regroup between MCPTT and LMR system?
question_41123.ground_truth: The proposal requires new procedures between the group management server and IWF. The group management server creates a temporary interworking group and stores the group information, while the IWF performs the authorization check and provides the group regroup response. The IWF also notifies the LMR system about the temporary interworking group and performs the identity mapping.

question_41125.question: What is the total duration of time period T2 for power class 1 UE and power class 2/3/4 UE respectively?
question_41125.ground_truth: The total duration of time period T2 is 6792 ms for power class 1 UE and 4232 ms for power class 2/3/4 UE.

question_41126.question: What is the purpose of using a structured data type in an OpenAPI specification?
question_41126.ground_truth: A structured data type is useful in an OpenAPI specification when the data types of a complete resource representation have mandatory attributes, or when attributes can be removed by a PATCH operation. It also provides a clear description in the OpenAPI specification file to developers about which modifications need to be supported.

question_41129.question: What is the purpose of the SEALDD enabled regular transmission request information flow?
question_41129.ground_truth: The purpose of the SEALDD enabled regular transmission request information flow is to request the regular application transmission service from the VAL server to the SEALDD server.

question_41130.question: Which resource is modelled with the Collection resource archetype in sections 6.1.3.2.4.6, 6.1.3.3, and 6.1.3.9?
question_41130.ground_truth: The resources in sections 6.1.3.2.4.6, 6.1.3.3, and 6.1.3.9 are modelled with the Collection resource archetype.

question_41131.question: What is the difference between "assignment" and "allocation" in the context of 3GPP specifications?
question_41131.ground_truth: In the context of 3GPP specifications, "assignment" refers to the granting of resources on a semi-static basis, whereas "allocation" refers to the dynamically changing permission to use resources that have been assigned to it and are shared with other users. An exception applies when granting resources using Fixed Uplink Allocation, where only the term "allocation" is used.

question_41133.question: What is the effect of the term "Invalid" in the context of TMSIs and LMSIs after a VLR failure?
question_41133.ground_truth: When TMSIs and LMSIs are deemed invalid, it means that they can no longer be considered accurate, but does not impose restrictions on the implementation.

question_41134.question: How does a UE determine if it is attached to the home PLMN or a visited PLMN?
question_41134.ground_truth: The UE compares the MCC and MNC values derived from its IMSI with the MCC and MNC of the PLMN the UE is attached to. If the MCC and MNC of the PLMN the UE is attached to do not match with the MCC and MNC derived from the IMSI, the UE considers itself to be attached to a visited PLMN.

question_41135.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 6.6.19.4.2?
question_41135.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in 6.6.19.4.2 is to verify the UE's ability to make a correct reporting for NCSG with SSB-based measurement with deactivated SCELL.

question_41138.question: How are SNPN credentials securely provisioned in the UE onboarding process?
question_41138.ground_truth: After the successful NAS SMC, the ON sends Registration Accept to the UE, allowing the UE to securely access the Provisioning Server. The Provisioning Server then securely provisions the SNPN credentials to the UE. The provisioning messages are end-to-end protected between the UE and the PS.

question_41140.question: What is the step where the 5G DDNMF/PKMF sends the Discovery Response message in the integrated Ranging/SL Positioning discovery and link establishment procedure?

question_41142.question: What is the method of test described in 9.4.4A.4.2?
question_41142.ground_truth: The method of test described in 9.4.4A.4.2 is a procedure for testing the performance of a HSDPA connection, which includes setting up a connection with certain parameters and then transmitting data while counting the number of NACK, ACK, and statDTX on the UL HS-DPCCH during the test interval.

question_41143.question: What is the structure of the NID value in assignment mode 0?
question_41143.ground_truth: The NID value in assignment mode 0 consists of a NID PEN and a NID code.

question_41145.question: What is the purpose of Video Composition in the context of TR 22.886?
question_41145.ground_truth: The purpose of Video Composition is to create a single video of the environment by post-processing the videos received from multiple UEs or RSUs, which allows the server to accurately represent the location, relative speed and distance of vehicles, pedestrians, and any objects in that area.

question_41146.question: What is the purpose of the UE TNLA Binding Release procedure?
question_41146.ground_truth: The UE TNLA Binding Release procedure is used to request the NG-RAN node to release the NGAP UE TNLA binding while maintaining NG-U (user plane connectivity) and UE context information.

question_41147.question: What is Key Issue #3 about in the context of SBI-based SM MO?
question_41147.ground_truth: Key Issue #3 is about the need to define a mechanism to select the target PLMN for procedures involving service-based operations that require routing across PLMNs based on GPSI as a public identifier.

question_41148.question: When is a CONTINUE record triggered in the HI2 protocol?
question_41148.ground_truth: A CONTINUE record in the HI2 protocol is triggered when an active PDP context is modified or during an inter-SGSN RAU when the target has at least one PDP context active, and the PLMN does not change.

question_41149.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 58b.3.5.2?
question_41149.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in 58b.3.5.2 is to verify the MS's behavior when a poll is sent during the single carrier fallback radio block period using a non-fallback carrier.

question_41150.question: What is the signalling system used for the interface between the MTC-IWF and the SMS-SC?

question_41152.question: In what situation will the UE multiplex HARQ-ACK information in the PUSCH transmission?
question_41152.ground_truth: When the UE is provided pdsch-HARQ-ACK-Codebook = 'semi-static' for unicast or multicast HARQ-ACK information and would multiplex HARQ-ACK information in a PUSCH transmission that is scheduled by a DCI format that includes a DAI field.

question_41154.question: What are the services included in the interception of voice service type in IMS domain?
question_41154.ground_truth: The services included in the interception of voice service type in IMS domain are delivery of IRI or CC based on the delivery type indicated in the warrant, delivery of LALS reports based on LALS triggering, identifying whether a target is non-local ID, and IMS services such as redirection, conferencing, and application of media.

question_41157.question: What is the source device for the "LAUNCH BROWSER" command from the UICC (Universal Integrated Circuit Card)?
question_41157.ground_truth: The source device for the "LAUNCH BROWSER" command from the UICC is the UICC itself.

question_41158.question: What does the PIN Gateway Client or the target PIN Client use to switch the application session to the target PIN Client?
question_41158.ground_truth: The PIN Gateway Client or the target PIN Client uses the information provided in the request, including the target PIN Client identifier and the application session identifier.

question_41160.question: What is the purpose of energy consumption information exposure in the 5G system?
question_41160.ground_truth: Energy consumption information exposure in the 5G system benefits network internal optimization and service adjustment for 3rd parties. Energy consumption information can include ratio of renewable energy and carbon emission information when available. The reporting period could be set on a monthly or yearly basis and can vary based on location.

question_41161.question: What is the requirement for user service authorization in inter-domain identity management?
question_41161.ground_truth: A user must present an access token issued from the partner IdMS in the partner domain for authorization to services in the partner domain.

question_41162.question: What is the main reason for using the error reporting procedure?
question_41162.ground_truth: The error reporting procedure is used by BTS to report detected errors that cannot be reported by any other procedure.

question_41163.question: What is the purpose of the Periodic Assistance Data Delivery procedure in the DL-TDOA positioning method?
question_41163.ground_truth: The purpose of this procedure is to allow the LMF to provide unsolicited periodic assistance data to the target UE and indicate the end of the assistance data delivery.

question_41164.question: What are the specific requirements for the L-band BS in Japan to ensure co-existence with other bands?
question_41164.ground_truth: The L-band BS in Japan needs to follow specific requirements related to spurious emissions limits, PHS protection, and co-location protection for Wide Area/Local Area/Medium range BS. The L-band BS is also required to protect PHS below -41 dBm/300kHz where L-band and PHS co-exist.

question_41165.question: In what scenarios can the Additional-Identity header field be used?
question_41165.ground_truth: The Additional-Identity header field can be used when an originating UA wants to indicate the identity to be used as an originating identity in a multi-identity service, when a node performs the multi-identity service for an originating UA in an incoming request, when a node has performed the multi-identity service for a terminating identity in an incoming request, or when a terminating UA wants to identify the identity used to contact the terminating user.

question_41166.question: What is the range of values for the delayBudgetReportingProhibitTimer parameter?
question_41166.ground_truth: The delayBudgetReportingProhibitTimer parameter can take any of the values among 0, 0.4, 0.8, 1.6, 3, 6, 12, and 30 seconds.

question_41167.question: What actions does the primary MC service server take if the target MC service user 2 is not authorized to affiliate or de-affiliate to the MC service group(s) in negotiated mode?
question_41167.ground_truth: The primary MC service server will not allow the affiliation or de-affiliation procedures to be triggered, and will maintain the current affiliation status of the target MC service user 2 for the MC service group(s).

question_41168.question: What is the role of the MC service server in activating and deactivating a multicast MBS session?
question_41168.ground_truth: The MC service server is responsible for activating the multicast MBS session when MC data is needed to be transmitted, and for deactivating it when there is no further MC data to be delivered to the associated group.

question_41169.question: What is the condition for an event to pass in this test case?
question_41169.ground_truth: For an event to pass in this test case, the total number of successful loops must be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.
