question_41822.question: What is the benefit of defining the GUP schema as a collection of small schemas rather than a monolithic standalone document?
question_41822.ground_truth: The benefits include modularity, extensibility, readability, and support for versioning.

question_41824.question: What are the two advantages of E-UTRAN compared to legacy systems?
question_41824.ground_truth: E-UTRAN has the advantages of simplicity, which comes from having only one type of node, and a low user data delay, which is achieved through having a low number of nodes in the data path.

question_41825.question: What is the minimum number of cells that an AAS BS must transmit in a specific operating band, to which the AAS BS setting corresponding?

question_41826.question: Which type of E-UTRA UE is the test applicable to?
question_41826.ground_truth: The test applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 16 and forward, supporting EN-DC with a shared spectrum NR carrier, supporting intra-freq measurements on shared channel access and long DRX.

question_41827.question: What is the formula for calculating the interruption time when sameSFN-Indication and mib-RepetitionStatus are included in the handover command?

question_41828.question: What is the purpose of the "ProseKey" service operation in 5G PKMF?
question_41828.ground_truth: The ProseKey service operation is used to retrieve the keying material related to 5G ProSe. It is invoked by a NF Service Consumer, i.e. another 5G PKMF in another PLMN, towards the 5G PKMF to retrieve the 5G ProSe related keying material.

question_41829.question: What entity notifies the AMF of a primary source event in the NG-RAN node?

question_41830.question: What is the recommended approach for introducing an AIPN mobility solution in terms of cost efficiency?
question_41830.ground_truth: An AIPN mobility solution must be able to co-exist with the current 3GPP PS core network in a cost-efficient way.

question_41832.question: What is the scope of the 3GPP technical specification in question?
question_41832.ground_truth: The technical specification defines the interface tests for the Terminal / UICC interface to ensure interoperability between an UICC and a Terminal independently of the respective manufacturer, card issuer or operator.

question_41835.question: What is the main feature of Alternative 1 in the report, and what does it rely on?
question_41835.ground_truth: The main feature of Alternative 1 is the use of a TRE (Trusted Environment) within the M2M equipment for securely managing USIM/ISIM/MCIM applications. It relies on a TRE that can validate the M2M equipment and perform user authentication, while hosting and managing remotely provisioned MCIMs.

question_41836.question: When can the UE choose to autonomously abort communication to perform measurements?
question_41836.ground_truth: If autonomous gaps are used to perform measurements, the UE is allowed to temporarily abort communication with all serving cell(s) within the limits specified in TS 36.133.

question_41838.question: What is sent from the DCSP to the NOP for PEE parameters related to NFVI nodes?
question_41838.ground_truth: The DCSP sends PEE parameters related to NFVI nodes on which the VNF/VNFCs supporting the NOP 5GC NFs run to the NOP.

question_41839.question: What is the use of the Destination Layer-2 ID in ProSe Direct Discovery?
question_41839.ground_truth: The Destination Layer-2 ID in ProSe Direct Discovery indicates a specific target UE layer-2 ID or the layer-2 ID for initial signalling.

question_41841.question: What are the types of communications supported by each MC service?
question_41841.ground_truth: Each MC service supports several types of communications amongst the users, such as group call and private call.

question_41842.question: What is the pre-condition for initiating an MCPTT emergency alert by an MCPTT client?
question_41842.ground_truth: The initiating MCPTT client has been provisioned with an MCPTT group designated as the MCPTT emergency group.

question_41843.question: What response should be sent if the user is not part of the MCData group, as specified in clause 4.7?
question_41843.ground_truth: A SIP 403 (Forbidden) response with the warning text set to "116 user is not part of the MCData group" in a Warning header field as specified in clause 4.7.

question_41844.question: What should the UE be able to receive or transmit after a time duration of TBWPswitchDelay + Y, following the reception of a DCI-based BWP switch?
question_41844.ground_truth: The UE should be able to receive PDSCH for a DL active BWP switch, or transmit PUSCH for a UL active BWP switch.

question_41845.question: What is the maximum UE transmitter power calculated as in the context of E-TFC restriction in UE?
question_41845.ground_truth: The maximum UE transmitter power for E-TFC-j is defined in section 6.5 of TS25.133.

question_41846.question: What should a MS do when it receives a GMM message containing a new P-TMSI in A/Gb mode?
question_41846.ground_truth: The MS should consider the new P-TMSI and new RAI as valid for receiving LLC frames and paging requests, while still considering the old P-TMSI and old RAI as valid for uplink transmission of LLC frames. The MS should consider the old P-TMSI and old RAI as invalid as soon as an LLC frame is received with the local TLLI derived from the new P-TMSI.

question_41847.question: What triggers the generation of an RCSSessionRelease record by the IRI-POI in the RCS Server?
question_41847.ground_truth: The RCSSessionRelease record is generated by the IRI-POI in the RCS Server when a SIP session for the transfer of a Large Message Mode CPM Standalone message or a CPM 1-to-1 Chat Session is released.

question_41849.question: What information should the UE include in the Registration Request (RRQ) message when sending it to the foreign agent?
question_41849.ground_truth: The UE should include the selected care-of address in the Care-of Address field of the RRQ message, the source address as the unspecified address (i.e., 0.0.0.0), the Home Address field as the unspecified address, bits S and D cleared, bit T set to request reverse tunneling, and the NAI extension as specified in RFC 2794. If the UE knows the IP address of the PDN GW, it shall include it in the Home Agent field, otherwise, it should include the unspecified address.

question_41851.question: What is the Interface Under Test (IUT) in MCPTT Conformance testing?
question_41851.ground_truth: The Interface Under Test (IUT) refers to the MCPTT Server or MCPTT Client being tested for conformance in MCPTT Conformance testing.

question_41853.question: What is the purpose of the test in 6.7B.3 and 6.7C.3?
question_41853.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the UE BLER of HS-PDSCH does not exceed 0.1 for the specified parameters and DL reference channel for DB-DC-HSDPA and DC-HSUPA.

question_41854.question: What is the role of the network verifier in the Hybrid Validation method?
question_41854.ground_truth: The network verifier is responsible for verifying the integrity of H(e)NB using the reference metrics, which are stored in three locations and in three categories.

question_41855.question: What should the AMF do if the DNN selected by the network is a LADN DNN?
question_41855.ground_truth: The AMF shall determine the UE presence in the LADN service area, as specified in subclause 6.2.6.

question_41857.question: What is the formula for calculating the target energy level in the process of adapting IGF scale factor band energies?
question_41857.ground_truth: The target energy level is calculated as the product of the hop-size and the maximal possible hop-size, divided by the square of the hop-size.

question_41858.question: What should the initiating UE do after receiving service data or a request from upper layers in the context of the 5G ProSe direct link establishment procedure?
question_41858.ground_truth: The initiating UE shall derive the PC5 QoS parameters and assign the PQFI(s) for the PC5 QoS flows(s) to be established.

question_41860.question: What actions can the S-SEALDD server take when it detects QoS deterioration due to N6/SEALDD overload?
question_41860.ground_truth: The S-SEALDD server may trigger the data transmission quality guarantee procedure, which involves switching to a different SEALDD server based on the QoS monitoring and E2E transmission quality measurement.

question_41861.question: What should an IWU do if it receives a SDP offer from a preceding 3GPP SIP-I node with the RTP Telephony Event and then receives a SDP answer from the external SIP-I network which includes only the PCM speech codec and excludes the RTP Telephony Event?
question_41861.ground_truth: The IWU may apply "transcoding at the PLMN border" by selecting another speech codec than the default PCM codec for the interface toward the SIP-I based CS CN and then include the RTP Telephony Event in the answer it forwards to the SIP-I based CS CN.

question_41862.question: What message is returned by the UE operating as PRU in response to a successful PRU disassociation procedure in 3GPP TS 23.273 clause 6.17.2?
question_41862.ground_truth: The UE operating as PRU returns a RELEASE COMPLETE message containing a PRU-disassociation return result component in response to a successful PRU disassociation procedure in 3GPP TS 23.273 clause 6.17.2.

question_41863.question: What must a CSP be able to do if a target changes serving CSP while under a warrant?
question_41863.ground_truth: They must be able to provide the identity of the new CSP if known.

question_41864.question: What element is the root element of this XML document?
question_41864.ground_truth: The <prose-pc3ch-message> element is the root element of this XML document.

question_41865.question: What should the UDM include in the notification request when sending a POST request to the callbackReference URI for data change notifications to NF?
question_41865.ground_truth: The UDM should include the original array representation in the origValue attribute of the ChangeItem when all the array elements have been removed in the notification.

question_41868.question: What does the MS GA-SM layer perform when it receives GA-SM Activate PDP Context Accept with the PCO as well as the "key" and IP address of its selected tunnel?
question_41868.ground_truth: The MS GA-SM layer performs tunnel switching and sends SMREG-PDP-ACTIVATE-CNF to the MS EGAN Access Mode Switch via the unchanged SMREG-SAP interface.

question_41870.question: What is the purpose of the Key ID and least significant bits of the counter carried in the PDCP header when security is activated?
question_41870.ground_truth: The Key ID and least significant bits of the counter are used to signal which security context is being used and shall be set to K~NRP-sess ID. The payload field and MAC (if required) fields are ciphered if confidentiality protection is activated.

question_41872.question: What should the NSACF do when the local maximum number or local threshold is reached in the hierarchical NSAC architecture?
question_41872.ground_truth: The NSACF may interact with the Primary NSACF before it returns the response back to the SMF+PGW-C.

question_41873.question: What should the floor participant do upon receiving a Floor Granted message?
question_41873.ground_truth: The floor participant should send a Floor Ack message, provide a floor granted notification to the MCPTT user, stop timer T104 (Floor Queue Position Request), start timer T132 (Queued granted user action), and indicate the user that the floor is granted.

question_41874.question: What is the impact of one-to-one mapping between UE bearer and RLC-channel on the backhaul, in terms of QoS differentiation and fairness among UE bearers?
question_41874.ground_truth: When one-to-one mapping is used between UE bearer and RLC-channel on the backhaul, the IAB-node has explicit information on each UE bearer, which allows for appropriate QoS differentiation among QoS profiles and fairness among UE bearers with the same QoS profile. However, enforcement of fairness across UE bearers becomes less granular when UE bearers are aggregated to backhaul RLC-channels.

question_41875.question: What AVP is sent from the 3GPP AAA Server to the Non-3GPP access network to convey the decision about the access network being trusted or untrusted by the HPLMN?

question_41876.question: What is the impact on the UE in Solution #19 as a result of the introduction of a new registration request type in the registration request message?
question_41876.ground_truth: The UE in Solution #19 uses a new registration request type in the registration request message to differentiate a registration request due to disaster roaming from a normal registration request. The AMF of the visiting NW sends an indication to the AUSF of the HPLMN in the primary authentication if the registration is due to disaster roaming.

question_41877.question: What information is included in the NAS message sent from the RNC to the RAN node to redirect the attach request?
question_41877.ground_truth: The NAS message sent from the RNC to the RAN node includes the IMSI, an indication that the UE is attaching, a reject cause code, and the original NAS message.

question_41879.question: What is the conformance requirement for the MS to calculate the path loss criterion parameter C1 used for cell selection and reselection?
question_41879.ground_truth: The MS shall be able to calculate the path loss criterion parameter C1 correctly for cell selection and reselection (3GPP~TS~05.08, subclause 6.4).

question_41880.question: What is the effect of the new spurious emission limits across the band on future similar technologies in the band with in-band compatibility analysis?
question_41880.ground_truth: The new spurious emission limits across the band are identical to the existing spurious emission limit for UTRA that applies for in-band compatibility analysis. This ensures compatibility for future similar technologies in the band.

question_41881.question: What should the UE do if it receives the tracking area not allowed indicator (#12) while operating in S1 mode?
question_41881.ground_truth: The UE should set the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, delete any GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list and eKSI. The UE should also store the current TAI in the list of "forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service" and enter the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE.

question_41882.question: Which architectures does the updated BEST feature in 5G networks support?
question_41882.ground_truth: The updated BEST feature in 5G networks supports a range of architectures, including the original LTE architecture using the UMTS key agreement procedure, an updated LTE architecture using the LTE key agreement procedure, a 5G architecture using the 5G key agreement procedure, and other combinations of LTE/5G/GBA/proprietary key agreement procedures.

question_41883.question: Which system information message is used in 7.1.2 to send a PAGING TYPE 1 message to the UE?
question_41883.ground_truth: The default system information messages are used in 7.1.2 to send a PAGING TYPE 1 message to the UE.

question_41884.question: What is the requirement for the MT to start the synchronization phase in the fax transmission process?
question_41884.ground_truth: The MT starts the synchronization phase by sending the pattern 1/OFF after receiving the MODIFY COMPLETE message.

question_41885.question: Which entity is responsible for controlling the mobility of RRC connections in UMTS?
question_41885.ground_truth: The UTRAN (UMTS Terrestrial Radio Access Network)

question_41886.question: What is the interface that was standardized in Rel-16 to support ng-eNB-CU and ng-eNB-DU split?

question_41888.question: How does the edgePMU concept improve data acquisition in distribution networks?
question_41888.ground_truth: The edgePMU concept separates the data acquisition from the data processing by exploiting the computational capabilities offered by distributed 5G edge clouds. This approach decreases the specialization needed in the data acquisition device and provides flexible cloud solutions for different data use cases. The overall deployment is simplified since there is no need for special communications cabling managed by distribution grid operators.

question_41889.question: What message status code is returned by the UDM when updating the AMF registration for 3GPP access if some of the modification instructions in the PATCH request have been discarded?
question_41889.ground_truth: If some of the modification instructions in the PATCH request have been discarded, and the NF service consumer has included in the supported-feature query parameter the "PatchReport" feature number, the UDM shall respond with "200 OK" with the response body containing PatchResult.

question_41892.question: What is the result code returned if any error is found in the request data when processing a QueryItem?

question_41893.question: What is the command used to write phonebook entries in a specific location in the current phonebook memory storage?
question_41893.ground_truth: The name of the command is +CPBW.

question_41894.question: What is the purpose of the Remaining Maximum Slice Data Rate in network slice data rate control?
question_41894.ground_truth: The Remaining Maximum Slice Data Rate is used to track the data rate usage of a specific network slice. The PCF interacts with the UDR to deduct the value of the authorized Session-AMBR and the MBR of every GBR SDF from the Remaining Maximum Slice Data Rate per S-NSSAI for every PDU Session of this slice.

question_41895.question: What is the purpose of including the UE Usage Type in the Forward Relocation Request message during handover procedures?
question_41895.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure that the target MME/SGSN can determine if the existing Serving GW supports the DCN for the UE based on the UE Usage Type of the UE, local operator policies, and UE context information available at the target network.

question_41897.question: How does the NAS control the RAT for the cell selection process?
question_41897.ground_truth: The NAS can control the RAT by indicating RATs associated with the selected PLMN and maintaining a list of forbidden registration area(s) and a list of equivalent PLMNs.

question_41898.question: What is the procedure for handling MSRP requests in an MSRP session, upon receiving an MSRP request in an MSRP session?
question_41898.ground_truth: Follow the rules and procedures defined in IETF~RFC~4975, reassemble the entire set of MSRP requests into the MCData standalone message before delivering the content to the application.

question_41899.question: How much more network capacity is expected to be developed between 2019 and 2030?
question_41899.ground_truth: The network capacity is expected to increase by 80% compared to the past decade.

question_41900.question: What is the length of the PDCP PDU Number extension header, and how long is its PDCP PDU number field?
question_41900.ground_truth: The PDCP PDU Number extension header is 4 octets long, and its PDCP PDU number field requires 15 bits (in E-UTRAN) or 12 bits (in NG-RAN) to represent the maximum value.

question_41902.question: What is a concern regarding discreet listening and logging for interconnected MC systems when the target MC service user is in a different primary MC system?
question_41902.ground_truth: There are concerns about eavesdropping on communications in another security domain.

question_41903.question: What type of information is covered by the Implementation eXtra Information for Testing (IXIT) proforma?
question_41903.ground_truth: The Implementation eXtra Information for Testing (IXIT) proforma contains all information (in addition to that given in the ICS) related to the UEUT (User Equipment Under Test) and its testing environment. This information is required to run an appropriate test suite against the UEUT.

question_41904.question: What does the term "Mobile Assisted Positioning" imply in the context of Location Services in GERAN?
question_41904.ground_truth: Mobile Assisted Positioning is any mobile centric positioning method where the MS provides position measurements to the network for computation of a location estimate by the network. The network may provide assistance data to the MS to enable position measurements and/or improve measurement performance.

question_41905.question: What is one issue that may arise if the TDF-C starts restoring sessions after the TDF-U restart?
question_41905.ground_truth: This may result in delaying the restoration of prioritized Sx sessions until incoming packets are received for that session.

question_41906.question: When selecting a core network type for initiating emergency calls, what state(s) should the UE be in?
question_41906.ground_truth: The UE should be in the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE or EMM-DEREgISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE.

question_41907.question: What is the objective of the set of media codecs, formats and transport/application protocols specified in the MBMS technical specification?
question_41907.ground_truth: The objective of the set of media codecs, formats and transport/application protocols specified in the MBMS technical specification is to enable the deployment of MBMS user services, either over the MBMS bearer service or other UMTS Bearer Services within the 3GPP system.

question_41908.question: What is a member's unique identity within a group called?
question_41908.ground_truth: A member's unique identity within a group is referred to as "ProSe UE ID."

question_41909.question: In case d) in subclause~5.4.5.2.1, what shall the UE do if it receives steering of roaming information, and what indicators shall it set in the Payload container IE carrying the acknowledgement?
question_41909.ground_truth: In case d) in subclause~5.4.5.2.1, the UE shall set the Payload container IE to "SOR transparent container"; and set the ME support of SOR-CMCI indicator to "SOR-CMCI supported by the ME", the ME support of SOR-SNPN-SI indicator to "SOR-SNPN-SI supported by the ME", and the ME support of SOR-SNPN-SI-LS indicator to "SOR-SNPN-SI-LS supported by the ME" in the Payload container IE carrying the acknowledgement.

question_41910.question: What is the effect of setting the PS data off UE status set command to 1 during UE-requested PDP context activation and UE-requested PDP context modification procedure?
question_41910.ground_truth: The PS data off UE status is activated and indicated to the network that PS data off UE status is activated.

question_41912.question: What is the role of the SS in the test described in 9.1.24.1.4.1?
question_41912.ground_truth: The SS in the test described in 9.1.24.1.4.1 serves as a node B emulator, providing the SS's RSRP values that are used to compare with the actual RSRP values in the Measurement Report messages transmitted periodically by the UE.

question_41915.question: What is the protocol specified in clause 16.1.4A3.1 for triggering PDN connection establishment/release in Multi-Connection mode?

question_41916.question: How can the quality of service be adapted for a multicast service in MBMS User Services?
question_41916.ground_truth: The quality-of-service for a multicast service can be adapted from time to time by providing the UEs (User Equipment) with multiple successive sessions with different quality-of-service for each session. This is defined in TS 22.146.

question_41918.question: What security measures are provided in Solution #1.2 for security when the CSMF is outside the operator's trust domain?
question_41918.ground_truth: The security measures include mutual authentication between CSMF and NSMF using TLS or TLS-PSK, and authorization of CSMF's slicing management service requests based on local policy or OAuth 2.0.

question_41920.question: What is the function of CHF (Charging Function) in the 5G data connectivity domain charging?
question_41920.ground_truth: The CHF collects charging information from SMF (Session Management Function) via Nchf interface for 5G data connectivity domain charging.

question_41921.question: What is the impact of the provided solution for addressing the MBS session release aspects related to group communication services over 5G MBS sessions?
question_41921.ground_truth: The provided solution, which is applicable for both multicast and broadcast MBS sessions, relies on 5G MBS session specifications and functionalities specified in 3GPP TS 23.247.

question_41924.question: What is the Interfering Signal to Noise Ratio (IOT) used for determining the interfering signal power level in decibels relative to milliwatts (dBm)?

question_41925.question: What information is included in the Secondary RAT Data Usage Report message?
question_41925.ground_truth: The Secondary RAT Data Usage Report message includes the data volumes delivered to and received from the UE over the NR radio for the related E-RABs.

question_41926.question: What does the term Service receiver indicate?
question_41926.ground_truth: The entity which receives the service request indication primitive, containing the SDU.

question_41927.question: What is the effect of a restart in a GGSN on the SGSN and the MS?
question_41927.ground_truth: The SGSN shall deactivate all PDP contexts associated with the restarted GGSN and request the MS to reactivate them. Upon restart, the GGSN will delete all PDP contexts, MBMS UE contexts, and MBMS Bearer contexts stored and associated with the peer node that failed.

question_41928.question: What should the NF service producer do when it becomes aware of a change in the NF service consumer and needs to use the new NF service consumer's information in the notification URI?
question_41928.ground_truth: The NF service producer should replace the authority and callback URI Prefix (if any) part of the Notification/Callback URI with the new NF service consumer information.

question_41929.question: What is the meaning of Access Type Preference in a URSP rule?
question_41929.ground_truth: It indicates the Access Type (3GPP or non-3GPP or multi-access) on which the PDU Session should be established when the UE needs to establish a PDU Session when the rule is applied. The type "Multi-Access" indicates that the PDU Session should be established as a MA PDU Session, using both 3GPP access and non-3GPP access.

question_41930.question: What is the range for the value of x0, x1, x2, and x3 in the Timeslot shifting parameters information element?
question_41930.ground_truth: The range for the value of x0, x1, x2, and x3 is from 0 to 7.

question_41931.question: What is the purpose of time window dT in the test?
question_41931.ground_truth: During time window dT, the SNR is changed gradually in small steps.

question_41933.question: What is the source device and the destination device for the Cell Broadcast Download?
question_41933.ground_truth: The source device is the Network, and the destination device is the UICC.

question_41934.question: What is the scope of 3GPP TS 36.579-1?
question_41934.ground_truth: The scope of 3GPP TS 36.579-1 is to define the common test environment for Mission Critical Services over LTE protocol requirements, including the definitions of reference conditions and test signals, default messages, and other parameters, generic procedures, and common requirements for test equipment.

question_41935.question: What is the difference between BS type 1-C and BS type 1-H?
question_41935.ground_truth: BS type 1-C has only conducted requirements, while BS type 1-H has both conducted and radiated requirements.

question_41937.question: What is one of the responsibilities of the SCEF in terms of security?
question_41937.ground_truth: The SCEF is responsible for the authentication and authorization of external entities, including the identification of the API consumer, profile management, and ACL management.

question_41938.question: What is a main requirement for the key management service in the SEAL?
question_41938.ground_truth: The SEAL must support the secure distribution of security-related information, such as encryption keys.

question_41939.question: How is an MBMS URL resolved using an URI RR DNS query as defined in RFC 7553?
question_41939.ground_truth: An MBMS URL that lacks the label suffix shall be resolved using an URI RR DNS query as defined in RFC 7553. The service name shall be "mbms" and the protocol shall be UDP. The DNS query shall be made to the FQDN of the MBMS URL using a query type "URI". The query name shall be the FQDN prepended with "mbms._udp". If found, the DNS response shall contain the new URL that shall match the service ID of the service that carries the resource with the requested URL. Otherwise, the DNS response shall have no DNS URI record.

question_41940.question: What is the purpose of the Maximum Reporting Time and Minimum Reporting Time in the context of location determination in cellular networks?
question_41940.ground_truth: The Maximum Reporting Time is the maximum allowed time between successive area/motion event reports, while the Minimum Reporting Time is the minimum allowed time between such reports. The mobile station defers any event report if needed until the minimum reporting time expires.

question_41942.question: Which charging mechanism involves charging information that can affect the service rendered in real-time?

question_41943.question: What are the procedures for unicast resource management in vertical application layer, as specified in 14.3.3?
question_41943.ground_truth: The procedures for unicast resource management in vertical application layer include setting up bearers, modifying the bearers for an already established VAL service communication, modifying the activation and deactivation of the bearer, QoS characteristics of the bearer, and GBR due to application requirement.

question_41944.question: Which node sends the IMSI/APN information response to the RCAF after receiving an IMSI/APN information request?
question_41944.ground_truth: The MME sends the IMSI/APN information response to the RCAF after receiving an IMSI/APN information request.

question_41945.question: What technology is commonly used for high-volume products and has good performance below 2.5 GHz?

question_41946.question: What should an SNRM-S do after deleting an MBMS resource?
question_41946.ground_truth: After deleting an MBMS resource, the SNRM-S should send an MBMS bearer announcement message to the NRM server to inform it of the deleted resource.

question_41947.question: What determines the Special Access Barring field authorization for a MS that is a member of an Access Class in the range 0-9 and one or more of a special Access Class in the range 11-15?
question_41947.ground_truth: The Special Access Barring field corresponding to its special Access Class sent in EC-SI2 must be authorized for a MS to send a normal report.

question_41948.question: What is the maximum performance gain observed for Max rank 4 for RU greater than or equal to 70% and CSI feedback overhead A?
question_41948.ground_truth: The maximum performance gain observed was 17%.

question_41949.question: Where should sensitive parts of the boot-up process take place?
question_41949.ground_truth: Sensitive parts of the boot-up process should take place with the help of the secure environment inside the eNB.

question_41951.question: In which clause is the minimum conformance requirement defined for 6.3A.4.2.4 (CA 5UL CA)?
question_41951.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are defined in clause 6.3A.4.2.0

question_41952.question: What is the reporting range of NRSRP for UE category NB1 as defined in section 9.1.22A.5?
question_41952.ground_truth: The reporting range of NRSRP for UE category NB1 is the same as defined in section 9.1.22.9.

question_41954.question: What is the difference between 3DoF and 6DoF in XR applications?
question_41954.ground_truth: 3DoF allows for rotational movements around the X, Y, and Z axes, while 6DoF allows for the same rotational movements along with full translational movements along the X, Y, and Z axes, which includes moving up and down, left and right, and forward and backward.

question_41956.question: How can the user activate Call Forwarding on No Reply service?
question_41956.ground_truth: The user can activate CFNRy by e.g. using the MMI command described in 3GPP TS 22.030. This activation request may include information of which Basic Service Group(s) it shall apply to.

question_41957.question: What is the expected impact on legacy UEs and RAN1 specification when using Technique A-3?
question_41957.ground_truth: Legacy UEs and UEs that do not support this technique cannot wake up a cell that is inactive, and they cannot operate in the cell due to the lack of expected transmission from the cell. The specification impact of the technique may include: the design of uplink wake-up signal/channel, signaling details of wake-up signal/channel, conditions for triggering WUS, mechanisms for DL synchronization and UE measurements needed prior to WUS transmission, UE's assistance information to aid wake up operations by gNB, UE behavior/procedure after transmitting WUS, and mechanism on how the UE can be informed about cell activity or lack of activity.

question_41958.question: What should a MS do when the network orders the GPRS detach procedure with the cause 'GPRS services not allowed in this PLMN'?
question_41958.ground_truth: The MS should delete any RAI, P-TMSI, P-TMSI signature, and GPRS ciphering key sequence number stored, set the GPRS update status to GU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, and store the PLMN identity in the "forbidden PLMNs for GPRS service" list. The MS should also set the timer T3212 to its initial value and restart it if it is not already running.

question_41959.question: What is the function of the P-NF in managing PIN in 5GC?
question_41959.ground_truth: The P-NF is a network function that manages PIN in 5GC and provides service operators for PIN management. The PIN AF, which manages PIN on the network side over the application layer, interacts with P-NF via NEF to request PIN management in 5GC.

question_41961.question: Which are the three different architectures defined for the 5G System?
question_41961.ground_truth: Non-roaming architecture, local breakout roaming architecture and home-routed roaming architecture

question_41962.question: What is the purpose of the post-condition "Vessel A and vessel B are safely anchored to the port without any collision or accident"?
question_41962.ground_truth: It indicates the successful completion of the pilotage service.

question_41964.question: What is the role of the CES in the ACR scenarios between the EAS and CAS?
question_41964.ground_truth: The CES acts as an intermediate between the EAS and CAS in the ACR scenarios, replacing the T-EES and T-EAS in some scenarios.

question_41967.question: What is the "Traffic flow aggregate description" information element used for in the session management procedure?
question_41967.ground_truth: The Traffic flow aggregate description information element is used to specify the aggregate of one or more packet filters and their related parameters and operations. It is used in the UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure or the UE requested bearer resource modification procedure.

question_41968.question: In what scenario should the Node B transmit the default PICH bit pattern of all zeros in a TTI for the Uu?
question_41968.ground_truth: If the Node B does not receive a valid FP frame in a TTI or a frame without paging indication information, it assumes that no UE's have to be paged on the Uu in this TTI. In this case, the default PICH bit pattern of all zeros shall be transmitted.

question_41969.question: What is the role of the 3GPP TS 24.294 standard in establishing the service control signalling path over I1?
question_41969.ground_truth: The 3GPP TS 24.294 standard defines mechanisms for the support of establishing the service control signalling path over I1, but support for this mechanism is optional for the SCC AS.

question_41970.question: What are the open issues regarding the local breakout architecture for uplink traffic?
question_41970.ground_truth: The open issues include the use of a single APN for SIPTO and non-SIPTO traffic, standalone L-GW architecture support for LIPA and SIPTO, simultaneous use of LIPA and SIPTO for the same UE, mapping of downlink packets on the appropriate radio bearers, and disconnection of the extension tunnel.

question_41973.question: What action should the network take if the PDP context status information element is included in a ROUTING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message and indicates that certain PDP contexts are in state PDP-INACTIVE, but they are in state PDP-ACTIVE on the network side?
question_41973.ground_truth: The network shall deactivate those PDP contexts locally without peer-to-peer signalling between the MS and the network.

question_41974.question: How is the PCM data of the channels and objects interfaces provided in MPEG-H 3DA?
question_41974.ground_truth: The PCM data of the channels and objects interfaces is provided through the decoder PCM buffer in MPEG-H 3DA, which first contains the regular rendered PCM signals and is subsequently followed by signals carrying the PCM data of the originally transmitted channel representation and the PCM data of the un-rendered output objects.

question_41977.question: What is the main objective of the "Maximum Duration of Test" being T + 7?
question_41977.ground_truth: The main objective of the "Maximum Duration of Test" being T + 7 is to ensure that the MS has enough time to complete the assignment and return an ASSIGNMENT COMPLETE message.

question_41978.question: What is the effect of the <mode> parameter in the Facility lock command?
question_41978.ground_truth: The <mode> parameter in the Facility lock command determines the nature of the action performed on the network facility, whether it is to lock, unlock, or interrogate.

question_41979.question: What is the difference between <fun>=0 and <fun>=129 in the context of MT power levels?
question_41979.ground_truth: <fun>=0 is the minimum functionality level, where minimum power is drawn, and the transmit and receive RF circuits are disabled. <fun>=129 is a reserved value for manufacturers, indicating a prepare for shutdown state, where pending actions resulting in "permanent" changes are executed and the MT is made ready for a shutdown.

question_41980.question: How does the "automatic CSG Selection mode" in the +CCSGS command behave when the <CSGinfo> field is ignored?
question_41980.ground_truth: In "automatic CSG Selection mode", the network determines which CSG Cell the UE registers to, ignoring the <CSGinfo> field.

question_41982.question: What information does the DSO obtain from UEs in the DSO network in the use case?
question_41982.ground_truth: The DSO can obtain information such as the Base station ID of the serving base station for each UE from the UEs in the DSO network.

question_41984.question: What are the parameters that the UE measures for Access Network Performance in this solution?
question_41984.ground_truth: The parameters measured for Access Network Performance are Throughput, Delay, Loss Rate, and possibly Jitter.

question_41985.question: What protocol can be used as an alternative to SIP for adding access-token in SGM messages if the VAL service does not support SIP protocol?
question_41985.ground_truth: HTTP based method can be used as an alternative to SIP for adding access-token in SGM messages if the VAL service does not support SIP protocol.

question_41986.question: How does the SEALDD client become aware of the new SEALDD-Uu IP address and port?
question_41986.ground_truth: The SEALDD client becomes aware of the new SEALDD-Uu IP address and port by acknowledledging the received SEALDD Connection info update notification.

question_41987.question: What is the name of the technical specification that provides stage 1 requirements for maritime usage over 3GPP system for commercial and safety purposes?

question_41988.question: What should the UE do when cause value is #65 "maximum number of EPS bearers reached" in S1 mode?
question_41988.ground_truth: The UE should determine the PLMN's maximum number of EPS bearer contexts in S1 mode as the number of active EPS bearer contexts it has and ignore the Back-off timer value IE and Re-attempt indicator IE provided by the network.

question_41989.question: What network functions need to support a new PDU Session type in the solution?
question_41989.ground_truth: SMF, UPF (N4), UDM, and PCF (Npcf) need to support a new PDU Session type.

question_41990.question: What is the purpose of Temporary Mobile Group Identity (TMGI) in MBMS?
question_41990.ground_truth: TMGI is used for MBMS notification purposes and is a globally unique identity allocated by the BM-SC per MBMS bearer service.

question_41991.question: What is the shift in behavior for the MS when it supports both EC-GSM-IoT, Category M1 or Category NB1 and any other access technology?
question_41991.ground_truth: The interpretation of timer T depends on the access technology in use.

question_41992.question: What is the maximum size of the HS-SCCH set in the serving HS-DSCH cell or any of the activated secondary serving HS-DSCH cells?
question_41992.ground_truth: The maximum size of the HS-SCCH set in any of the serving or secondary serving HS-DSCH cells is 4.

question_41995.question: What would be required to define a new ROHC profile for each set of inner protocols?
question_41995.ground_truth: The work would need to be done in the IETF to avoid defining a non-IETF ROHC profile and pollute the profile identifier space. However, the work would need to be adopted by the ROHC working group, and the pace of the IETF is partly dependent on the level of support for the work.

question_41996.question: What is the pre-condition for the formation of a temporary group in the MCPTT system?
question_41996.ground_truth: A temporary group in the MCPTT system is formed by an authorized MCPTT user or dispatcher through the group regroup procedure and is identified via a temporary MCPTT group ID.

question_41997.question: What is the function of the "tra-media-line-number" SDP attribute in the SDP offer in media plane optimization for WebRTC?
question_41997.ground_truth: The "tra-media-line-number" SDP attribute provides the total number of media lines in the SDP, excluding any media lines with port zero. It is used to detect whether intermediates have removed or disabled media lines.

question_41998.question: What is the maximum bit rate for uplink and downlink of 0 kbit/s called for the PDP contexts?

question_41999.question: What is a precondition for the BM-SC to activate an eMBMS user service to carry the same content as a high-demand unicast service?
question_41999.ground_truth: Business agreements that enable the operator to convert the various content feeds from unicast to broadcast delivery upon high demand of a nominal unicast content/service.

question_42000.question: What is the purpose of the "Intave" parameter in the level of interference averaging process?
question_42000.ground_truth: The "Intave" parameter is used to set the time period over which the level of interference will be averaged on a per cell basis before transmission of the RESOURCE INDICATION message.

question_42001.question: What does the term "DUT" stand for in the context of IAB testing efficiency optimization?

question_42002.question: What is the initial condition for the test described in step 7.3.63.4?
question_42002.ground_truth: The initial condition for the test described in step 7.3.63.4 is a fully synchronized UE with Ncell 1, scheduled uplink transmissions, and two cells specified in this test: Ncell 1 and Cell 1.

question_42005.question: What is the function of the MBS session in the MCVideo system?
question_42005.ground_truth: The MBS session can be used for MCVideo group calls, and the media stream within the session is used for the specific group call. Once the group call over the MBS session is finished, the temporary association information is undone.

question_42006.question: What should an MCPTT client do when it receives a SIP BYE request for releasing the prearranged MCPTT group call?
question_42006.ground_truth: Follow the procedures as specified in subclause~6.2.6.

question_42007.question: What is the procedure for QoS signalling in trusted WLAN when using Single-Connection mode (SCM) based access to EPC?
question_42007.ground_truth: If WLCP multiple bearer PDN connectivity is not supported, the UE and TWAG use a single point-to-point PDN connection to carry all S2a bearers traffic between the UE and TWAG. If WLCP multiple bearer PDN connectivity is supported, the TWAG shall establish a default WLCP bearer for the PDN connection and a separate WLCP bearer for each additional S2a dedicated bearer of the PDN connection using WLCP signalling.

question_42009.question: What should the NAS do if it receives a request to re-establish user-plane resources for an existing PDU session and barring is still in effect for the associated access category?
question_42009.ground_truth: The NAS shall not initiate the service request procedure.

question_42011.question: What values indicate unique sets of initialization parameters in a given character set and language context?
question_42011.ground_truth: Huffman Initialization ID (HI-ID), Keyword Dictionary ID (KD-ID), Punctuator ID (PU-ID), and Character Group ID (CG-ID)

question_42012.question: What is the problem with the Transparent Single-Connection mode and Single-Connection mode if the UE does not know why its new PDN connection or handover request fails?
question_42012.ground_truth: If the UE does not know why its request fails, it may attempt to re-establish connectivity, causing unnecessary signalling towards the 3GPP AAA Server and HSS.

question_42013.question: When should the RNC send a RELOCATION DETECT message to the CN during the Relocation Detect procedure?
question_42013.ground_truth: The target RNC shall send a RELOCATION DETECT message to the CN when a relocation execution trigger is received, upon which the CN may switch the user plane from the source RNC to the target RNC.

question_42019.question: What keys should be used for calculating GERAN keys if the ME+ is using an enhanced security context?
question_42019.ground_truth: CKL and IKL should be used for calculating GERAN keys if the ME+ is using an enhanced security context.

question_42021.question: In the process of requesting IP addresses, how does the IAB-MT specify the number of IPv4 addresses requested per specific usage?
question_42021.ground_truth: The IAB-MT sets the "iab-IPv4-AddressNumReq" field to the number of IPv4 addresses requested per specific usage.

question_42023.question: How many major steps does the BBF service migration procedure involve?
question_42023.ground_truth: The BBF service migration procedure involves two major steps: the interworking step and replacing the RG.

question_42025.question: What conditions determine PDSCH mapping type in the UE in 5G?
question_42025.ground_truth: PDSCH mapping type A or B in the UE in 5G is set based on the Time domain resource assignment field value m, equal to m + 1, in the DCI. The slot allocated for the PDSCH and the starting symbol S and length L combination depend on the Start and length indicator SLIV.

question_42027.question: What action does the CN take when the Relocation Preparation procedure is unsuccessfully terminated for the same relocation of SRNS towards the target RNC?
question_42027.ground_truth: The CN releases the possibly existing Iu signalling connection for the same UE and initiates the Iu Release procedure towards the target RNC with an appropriate value for the Cause IE.

question_42028.question: Which 3GPP specifications are used to define the interaction of AoC with packet services?
question_42028.ground_truth: The interaction of AoC with packet services is not yet defined in 3GPP~TS~09.06 and 3GPP~TS~09.07.

question_42029.question: What information does the PSA UPF record for QoS monitoring of packet delayed between PSA UPF and NG-RAN?
question_42029.ground_truth: The PSA UPF records the time stamps T3 and T4, the 5QI, and the S-NSSAI for each GTP PDU monitoring response packet to calculate the average delay.

question_42030.question: How many different bandwidth classes are defined for contiguous CA in NR FR1?
question_42030.ground_truth: There are 15 different bandwidth classes, from A to O (F is not used)

question_42031.question: What is the purpose of the Near Field to Far Field transform (NFTF) method?
question_42031.ground_truth: The Near Field to Far Field transform (NFTF) method computes the metrics defined in Far Field by using the Near Field to Far Field transformation.

question_42033.question: What is triggered by UE-1 when the reporting criteria are met and the UE is in coverage?
question_42033.ground_truth: UE-1 triggers the usage reporting procedure by sending the usage information report to the ProSe Function.

question_42034.question: What is the method of notifying an AF about AM policy change events?
question_42034.ground_truth: The AM policy change events can be notified to an AF via HTTP POST or Websocket, depending on the support and negotiation between AF and NEF.

question_42038.question: Which indicator is used in the AMF to determine the registration on behalf of an AUN3 device protected interface?
question_42038.ground_truth: The new indicator is used in the registration request to indicate that the registration is on behalf of an AUN3 device, where protection is required for the interface between the AUN3 device and RG.

question_42039.question: What should the UE do if the serving cell fulfils Srxlev < ThreshServing, LowP and a cell of a lower priority RAT/ frequency fulfils Srxlev > ThreshX, LowP during a time interval TreselectionRAT, and more than 1 second has elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell?
question_42039.ground_truth: The UE should reselect a cell as specified, taking into account the corresponding RAT/ frequency and the cell reselection parameters.

question_42041.question: What is the system that the IOPS MC system is capable of informing served users about which other users are also connected to the system?
question_42041.ground_truth: The IOPS system can inform about this through the MC services feature in IOPS mode.

question_42042.question: What should the floor participant do after receiving a Queued Floor Requests message with a Queued Floor Requests Purpose value set to '1' (Cancel Result)?
question_42042.ground_truth: The floor participant should send a Floor Ack message, provide the result of the message for cancellation of a queued floor request to the MCPTT user, stop the timer T134 (Queued Floor Requests), if running, and remain in the current state.

question_42043.question: What is the role of MCIM (Machine Communication Identity Module) in M2ME (M2M equipment) as per the document?
question_42043.ground_truth: MCIM is a term that indicates the collection of M2M security data and functions for an M2ME to access a 3GPP network. It may reside on a UICC or on a TRE.

question_42044.question: What is the purpose of the investigation into NodeB transmitter characteristics against the existing TS 25.104 and TS 37.104?
question_42044.ground_truth: The investigation aims to study the NodeB transmitter characteristics in relation to the existing TS 25.104 and TS 37.104, specifically focusing on metrics such as ACLR and UEM in multi-carrier and standalone scenarios.

question_42046.question: What is the clarification given for SLT-SEC-3 in the document?
question_42046.ground_truth: It may not be possible to retrieve Trace information from IMS NEs from outside the PLMN where the IMS NEs reside.

question_42047.question: What is the requirement for UE-R to start sending SIP INVITE (MCPTT Group Y) messages to the registered MCPTT clients?
question_42047.ground_truth: The MCPTT server in UE-R may start sending SIP INVITE messages to the registered MCPTT clients when the user of UE-R takes part in the MCPTT group communication as an MCPTT Group member.

question_42048.question: How many messages are specified in the Expected Sequence for the test of emergency call?
question_42048.ground_truth: Four messages are specified in the Expected Sequence for the test of emergency call: CLASSMARK CHANGE, PAGING RESPONSE, CONNECT ACKNOWLEDGE and EMERGENCY SETUP.

question_42050.question: What determines the data rate of a physical channel?
question_42050.ground_truth: The data rate of the physical channel depends on the used midamble length.

question_42052.question: What happens in the post-condition of the intent-driven NSI resource capacity planning scenario?
question_42052.ground_truth: The requested NSI resource capacity planning requirements as expressed in the intent from the NSI consumer are fulfilled by the MnS Producer.

question_42053.question: What information does the UE include in the REGISTER message in step 6?
question_42053.ground_truth: The UE includes an LCS MO-LR request with the IE "MOLR-Type" set to "locationEstimate" in the REGISTER message.

question_42056.question: What happens when a participant no longer meets the criteria?
question_42056.ground_truth: The MCVideo server~1 or MCVideo server~2 will detect this and remove the participant from the ongoing ad-hoc group call.

question_42057.question: What kind of relay implementation is described in Solution #8?
question_42057.ground_truth: Solution #8 describes a distributed boundary clock implementation, where the entire 5G system remains untouched, and a translator/adaptor function is used at the edge of the 5G system to take care of the 802.1AS related functions.

question_42058.question: What action should the RE-NWDAF take when it receives an HTTP PUT request with the "notifFlag" attribute set to "RETRIEVAL"?
question_42058.ground_truth: If the "notifFlag" attribute is set to the value "RETRIEVAL", the RE-NWDAF shall send the stored events to the NF service consumer, mute the event notification again and store available events.

question_42059.question: What is the first level of authorization required for a SL Positioning Client UE to request Ranging/SL positioning service?
question_42059.ground_truth: The first level of authorization is for service access, and it is achieved with the existing authorization method during direct discovery and communication establishment as defined in TS 33.503.

question_42060.question: What are the categorization of backhaul listed based on operator inputs?
question_42060.ground_truth: One is ideal backhaul that uses very high throughput and very low latency backhaul such as dedicated point-to-point connection using optical fiber. The other is non-ideal backhaul that uses typical backhaul widely used in the market such as xDSL, microwave, and other backhauls like relaying.

question_42062.question: What is the purpose of the Reset procedure in E1AP?
question_42062.ground_truth: The Reset procedure is used to initialize or re-initialize the E1AP UE-related contexts in the event of a failure in the gNB-CU-CP or gNB-CU-UP.

question_42063.question: What action does the UE take upon receiving a Bluetooth positioning request from the LMF?
question_42063.ground_truth: The UE performs the requested measurements and calculates its own location if possible. It then sends an LPP Provide Location Information message to the LMF, including the result of the measurements before the response time elapses. If the UE cannot perform the requested measurements, it sends any available information in an LPP message of type Provide Location Information with a cause indication for the not provided location information.

question_42064.question: What is the procedure used by the UE to select an ePDG?
question_42064.ground_truth: The UE uses standard DNS mechanisms to retrieve the IP address(es) of the ePDG and follows the procedure described in 3GPP~TS~24.234 for the selection of the PDG.

question_42065.question: What should the MS do upon receiving a GA-RRC PAGING REQUEST message in GA-RC-REGISTERED state but in GERAN/UTRAN mode?
question_42065.ground_truth: The MS should ignore the GA-RRC PAGING REQUEST message and continue with any ongoing procedure as if it was not received.

question_42067.question: What is the format of the "OPEN CHANNEL" command when immediately establishing a link?
question_42067.ground_truth: The command specifies the device identities (SIM as source and ME as destination), the GPRS bearer type, bearer parameters, buffer size, network access name, and transport format (UDP).

question_42068.question: How does the UE perform group member discovery over PC5 interface for Model B?
question_42068.ground_truth: The UE performs group member discovery over PC5 interface with Model B by using two discovery protocol messages, solicitation and response. The discoverer UE initiates the procedure by sending a solicitation message to the targeted group, and the discoveree UE responds with a response message if it belongs to the targeted group.

question_42070.question: What is the expected action of the UE in the test described in 8.1.3.1.13.1 (2), when the SS/PBCH block sorting quantity is below absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation for one beam of the Neighbour Cell, but above for another?
question_42070.ground_truth: The UE is expected to send a MeasurementReport message containing rsIndexResults with resultsSSB-Indexes, including RsIndex above absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation and excluding RsIndex below absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation.

question_42071.question: What information is contained in the Ext-PDP-Address AVP, and under what condition is it relevant to be included in the message?
question_42071.ground_truth: The Ext-PDP-Address AVP contains an additional address of the data protocol, and it is relevant to be included in the message when the PDP supports dual-stack (IPv4v6).

question_42072.question: What is the function of SMF in providing Non-3GPP QoS assistance information?
question_42072.ground_truth: The SMF provides per-QoS flow Non-3GPP QoS assistance information to PEGC, and may include QoS characteristics, GFBR/MFBR (if applicable), ARP, Periodicity.

question_42075.question: What is the scope of the LTE Advanced intra-band non-contiguous Carrier Aggregation in Band 4 for 2UL work item?
question_42075.ground_truth: The present document is the technical report for the LTE Advanced intra-band non-contiguous Carrier Aggregation in Band 4 for 2UL work item, which was approved at TSG RAN #60.

question_42077.question: What should a UE do if it receives a DETACH REQUEST message for "switch off" while a detach procedure is in progress?
question_42077.ground_truth: If the detach procedure is for "switch off", the UE should ignore the DETACH REQUEST message and continue with the ongoing detach procedure.

question_42079.question: What is the role of the Online Charging System (OCS) or Converged Charging System (CCS) in a voice or video call?
question_42079.ground_truth: The OCS or CCS may need to deliver billing/charging in-session notifications to the end user via announcements as part of the rating, balance management and billing process during any phase of a voice or video call.

question_42080.question: What should the IWF do if it receives a SIP re-INVITE request containing an emergency indication set to "true" and the originating MCPTT user is not in an in-progress emergency private call state with the targeted user?
question_42080.ground_truth: The IWF should cache the information that the MCPTT user is in an in-progress emergency private call state with the targeted user.

question_42083.question: What is the role of a PIN client in the overall system?
question_42083.ground_truth: A PIN client is responsible for providing the management procedure to PEMC and routing control procedure to PEGC. It enables the application clients in the UE or PIN element to register available services, perform service discovery, communicate with other PIN clients, act as a relay for direct communication, and maintain PIN profile.

question_42085.question: What is the threat name for a situation where an attacker fraudulently gains direct access to the root account via a network connection?

question_42086.question: What is the UPF residence time reported for in the UPF?
question_42086.ground_truth: The UPF residence time is reported for different port type pair combinations, such as between a device-device side port pair, device-network side port pair and network-network side port pair.

question_42087.question: What is the interdependence of Hop-by-hop ARQ layer placement?
question_42087.ground_truth: There is no interdependence of Hop-by-hop ARQ layer placement.

question_42089.question: What is the purpose of the PDSCH demodulation requirements for CA in Clause 7.2A?
question_42089.ground_truth: The purpose of the PDSCH demodulation requirements for CA in Clause 7.2A is to specify the performance requirements for PDSCH demodulation tests in the context of carrier aggregation.

question_42091.question: How does the Consolidated Data Model relate to the Specialized Information Model in 3GPP telecommunication applications?
question_42091.ground_truth: The Consolidated Data Model is a complete implementation of the Specialized Information Model in the User Data Repository for all the applications. Applications only see the portion of the Consolidated Data Model that is specific to their needs.

question_42093.question: What is the purpose of providing two P-Preferred-Identity header fields in the INVITE request?
question_42093.ground_truth: Providing two P-Preferred-Identity header fields is usually supported by UE acting as enterprise network, which allows the UE to have more than one public user identity or tel URI associated with the public user identity registered via emergency registration.

question_42094.question: When creating a SIP REFER request for a remote initiated ambient listening call within a pre-established session, what should the MCPTT client include in the Refer-To header field?
question_42094.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should set the Refer-To header field to a Content-ID ("cid") Uniform Resource Locator (URL) pointing to an application/resource-lists MIME body, which contains a single <entry> element with a "uri" attribute set to the MCPTT ID of the targeted user and an hname "body" parameter containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info MIME body.

question_42095.question: What is the role of the PCEF (PDN Gateway Control and Policy Enforcement Function) when receiving a request for IP-CAN Bearer establishment?
question_42095.ground_truth: The PCEF receives the request for IP-CAN Bearer establishment and assigns an IP address and (if requested) network prefix for the user. It then requests the authorization of allowed service(s) and PCC Rules information.

question_42097.question: What does the Multi-member AF session with required QoS procedure involve?
question_42097.ground_truth: The Multi-member AF session with required QoS procedure involves the NEF mapping the request for Multi-member AF session with required QoS to individual requests for AF session with required QoS and interacting with each of the UE's serving PCFs on a per AF session basis.

question_42098.question: What should the MME/SGSN do when it receives the APN Rate Control Status from the SCEF during the release of the last PDN Connection?
question_42098.ground_truth: The MME/SGSN stores the APN Rate Control Status in the MM context and sends a Delete SCEF Connection Response message towards the SCEF acknowledging the removal of SCEF Connection information for the UE.

question_42099.question: What does the MC service server 2 (MBMS bearer control role) do with the media distribution request?
question_42099.ground_truth: The MC service server 2 responds to the media distribution request with details about the bearer, informs MC service server 1 about the bearer to use, and subsequently distributes the media to other MC service servers.

question_42100.question: What abbreviation in the document stands for the European Securities and Markets Authority?

question_42101.question: What is the purpose of conformance requirement 1 in the generation of bitmap section?
question_42101.ground_truth: The purpose is to define the rules for building a Full Received Bitmap (FRB) and assigning values to its bits based on the receive state array.

question_42104.question: In CAP for Rel-6, which two data types are used to define an object that carries information related to GPRS and GPRS events?
question_42104.ground_truth: The two data types used to define an object carrying information related to GPRS and GPRS events in CAP for Rel-6 are GPRSChargingID and GPRSMSClass.

question_42106.question: What action should the participating MCVideo function take if it cannot determine the MCVideo session identity from the received SIP INVITE request for originating participating MCVideo function?
question_42106.ground_truth: If the participating MCVideo function cannot determine the MCVideo session identity from the received SIP INVITE request for originating participating MCVideo function, it shall reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 400 (Bad Request) response.

question_42107.question: What information is provided by the "Requested MBMS IP Multicast Address and APN" in the MBMS Service Area IE?
question_42107.ground_truth: This IE informs the RNC about the requested pairs of IP Multicast Address and APN.

question_42108.question: What action does the User Equipment (UE) take when it receives a broadcast message with a "warning type" of 'earthquake' or 'tsunami'?
question_42108.ground_truth: The UE indicates the contents of the "warning message" to the user.

question_42109.question: During which subframes should SCell activation/hibernation interruption not happen in the test procedure for E-UTRAN TDD hibernation and activation of unknown SCell in non-DRX test?
question_42109.ground_truth: SCell activation/hibernation interruption should not happen outside the subframes (m+5) to (m+9) in the test procedure for E-UTRAN TDD hibernation and activation of unknown SCell in non-DRX test.

question_42110.question: How is the performance of MMSE-IRC and MMSE receivers evaluated in the link level evaluation?
question_42110.ground_truth: The performance of MMSE-IRC and MMSE receivers is evaluated by comparing the simulation results of throughput versus SINR and SINR gain of MMSE-IRC over MMSE at the 70 % relative throughput.

question_42111.question: Which maturity model level is recommended for modeling service operations that can naturally map to one of the standard methods?
question_42111.ground_truth: Service operations should implement the Level 2 of the Richardson maturity model, with standard API methods, whenever it is a good match for the style of interaction to model.

question_42112.question: What approach is possible for NR channel bandwidth of 10 MHz for LTE-MTC NB allocation?
question_42112.ground_truth: Aside from a mixed TDM/FDM based approach, a FDM based approach is possible for NR channel bandwidth of 10 MHz for LTE-MTC NB allocation.

question_42113.question: What are the frequency ranges for equipment employing unrestricted and restricted contention-based protocols?
question_42113.ground_truth: Equipment employing unrestricted contention-based protocols can operate throughout the entire 50 MHz, while equipment incorporating a restricted contention-based protocol can only operate in the lower 25 MHz.

question_42114.question: What technology is used for basic safety service in LTE-based Prose direct communication?

question_42115.question: What is the role of the Management Data Analytics Services (MDAS) in self-organizing networks (SON)?
question_42115.ground_truth: The MDAS provides analytics services that can be utilized by other management and SON functions to conduct their functionalities and control actions.

question_42117.question: What is the requirement for the measurement report to be transmitted after receiving the OTDOA-RequestLocationInformation message and the OTDOA assistance data in the OTDOA-ProvideAssistanceData message?
question_42117.ground_truth: The measurement report should be transmitted without any delay caused by other RRC signalling on the DCCH and excluding the delay uncertainty for inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH.

question_42118.question: How is user ID privacy protected in Solution #6?
question_42118.ground_truth: In Solution #6, user ID privacy is protected by the EAP method if it is required during slice authentication.

question_42121.question: What entity receives the coverage data request from the UE in the described solution?
question_42121.ground_truth: The CMS (Coverage Management Server) receives the coverage data request from the UE in the described solution.

question_42123.question: What should the BSS do if it receives a DOWNLOAD-BSS-PFC PDU with an unknown PFI?
question_42123.ground_truth: The BSS should not respond with a CREATE-BSS-PFC PDU if it receives a DOWNLOAD-BSS-PFC PDU with an unknown PFI.

question_42124.question: Who is responsible for initiating an emergency change of USS?
question_42124.ground_truth: The UAE client can initiate an emergency change of USS on behalf of the USS based on the Multi-USS policies.

question_42125.question: What are the two different procedures for UE authentication supported by the AUSF?
question_42125.ground_truth: The two different procedures for UE authentication supported by the AUSF are 5G-AKA and EAP-based authentication.

question_42126.question: What is the function of the MRFC in the described multimedia conference establishment procedure?
question_42126.ground_truth: The MRFC is responsible for creating an ad-hoc conference, requesting resources from the MRFP, sending an SIP INVITE request with the SDP offer, receiving the 200 (OK) final response with the SDP answer, and providing additional bandwidth properties information to the MRFP.

question_42127.question: What is the function of the Primary Authentication Function (PAF) in the SNPN?
question_42127.ground_truth: The PAF in the SNPN is responsible for the translation of SBI protocol and AAA protocol during the primary authentication process.

question_42128.question: What is the format of the UE Specific Information Indication sequence?
question_42128.ground_truth: The UE Specific Information Indication sequence is a SEQUENCE that includes protocolIEs and protocolExtensions. The protocolIEs are themselves a ProtocolIE-Container, which includes a set of UESpecificInformationIndicationIEs. The protocolExtensions are a ProtocolExtensionContainer, which includes a set of UESpecificInformationIndicationExtensions.

question_42130.question: What is the meaningful value of any 5 bits sequence in the multiframe alignment pattern of the TCH/F14.4 or TCH/F28.8 channel codings?
question_42130.ground_truth: Any 5 bits sequence in the multiframe alignment pattern is unique, i.e. the multiframe alignment can take place by the recognition of five successive S1 bits.

question_42133.question: How long should the SS send pseudo random characters with start and stop bit(s) in the 3GPP~TS~04.21 frames to the MS after TCH synchronization has been completed at the SS side?
question_42133.ground_truth: The SS should send pseudo random characters with start and stop bit(s) in the 3GPP~TS~04.21 frames to the MS for approximately 5 seconds after TCH synchronization has been completed at the SS side.

question_42135.question: What are the absolute accuracy requirements for GSM carrier RSSI measurements under normal conditions?
question_42135.ground_truth: Under normal conditions, the absolute accuracy for GSM carrier RSSI measurements should be within +/- 4 dB from -110 dBm to -70 dBm, and within +/- 6 dB from -70 dBm to -38 dBm.

question_42137.question: What is the functionality provided in 4.9 of the NSCE server for multiple slices coordinated resource optimization?
question_42137.ground_truth: This functionality allows the VAL to monitor the usage status of multiple slices in a combined manner, enabling resource adjustment between different slices sharing common network resources for optimized and efficient usage.

question_42138.question: What HTTP response does the PCF receive from the BSF if it is not allowed to create a binding for a certain parameter combination?
question_42138.ground_truth: The PCF receives an HTTP "403 Forbidden" response from the BSF.

question_42142.question: What is the purpose of the MBMS-StartStop-Indication AVP in the RAR message?
question_42142.ground_truth: The MBMS-StartStop-Indication AVP in the RAR message indicates if the command is indicating an MBMS Session Start procedure, an MBMS Session Update procedure, or an MBMS Session Stop procedure.

question_42143.question: What is the procedure when the MCVideo client receives an MBS session announcement from the participating MCVideo function with a specific mbs-service-areas element?
question_42143.ground_truth: If the same value of the mbs-session-id element is already stored, the old announcement element is replaced with the received one. If there is no such element with the same value of mbs-session-id, the received announcement is stored. The remaining parts in step 1) of clause 16.2.2 apply also for MBS, with the clarification that terminology mapping specified in clause J.3.3 applies.

question_42144.question: What should the mobile station do after sending an Area Event Report in location services operations?
question_42144.ground_truth: After sending an Area Event Report, the mobile station may terminate the dialogue by sending a RELEASE COMPLETE message for a single location request. Alternatively, it may initiate another Area Event Report operation by sending a FACILITY message to the network. After the Area Event Report operation, the mobile station shall terminate the dialogue by sending a RELEASE COMPLETE message.

question_42145.question: How is the data or analytics retrieval initiated in the process?
question_42145.ground_truth: The data or analytics retrieval is initiated by the consumer (DCCF or NWDAF) if they indicate in the response that they will retrieve the data or analytics.

question_42147.question: What is the first category of paired bands, and how does it relate to the generation of third-order PIM products?
question_42147.ground_truth: The first category of paired bands is such that the relation between band size and duplex gap size implies that third-order PIM products would never fall in the own receive band, irrespective of RF BW.

question_42149.question: What is the minimum requirement for transmit intermodulation in Band Category 1 for a wanted signal that is UTRA or E-UTRA with maximum channel bandwidth?
question_42149.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for transmit intermodulation in Band Category 1 for a wanted signal that is UTRA or E-UTRA with maximum channel bandwidth is that the transmitter intermodulation level, in the presence of a wanted signal and a interfering signal with a level 30 dB below the wanted signal, shall not exceed the unwanted emission limits specified in subclause 6.6 of the document.

question_42150.question: What message does the AMF include in the N2 Request message to the (R)AN nodes if the associated set of UE Radio Capabilities is available and requested by the (R)AN?
question_42150.ground_truth: The set of UE Radio Capabilities associated to the UE Capability ID of the UE and the complementary set of UE Radio Capabilities of the UE.

question_42151.question: In the context of 3GPP documents, what does the term "TSG" stand for?
question_42151.ground_truth: The Technical Specification Group (TSG) is a body responsible for the development and approval of 3GPP technical specifications.

question_42153.question: What is the @codecs parameter used for on Adaptation Set level?
question_42153.ground_truth: The @codecs parameter on Adaptation Set level signals the maximum required capability to decode any Representation in the Adaptation Set.

question_42156.question: Which supplementary service takes precedence over Communication Forwarding Unconditional (CFU) when both the FA Pilot Identity and an FA member have the service active?
question_42156.ground_truth: CFU treatment is determined by the FA pilot identity if both the FA pilot identity and an FA member have CFU active.

question_42157.question: What is the difference between Scenario A and Scenario B in 6.2.2.2 for triggering the establishment of an S9a session for offloaded traffic?
question_42157.ground_truth: In Scenario A, the BPCF triggers the Indication of IP-CAN session establishment if it becomes aware of a 3GPP UE's attachment, while in Scenario B, the PCRF triggers the Indication of IP-CAN session establishment if the UE attaches to EPC.

question_42158.question: What information does the UE store from the Security-Server header field in the 401 (Unauthorized) response in the IMS network?
question_42158.ground_truth: The UE stores the announcement of the media plane security mechanisms the P-CSCF (IMS-ALG) supports received in the Security-Server header field, if any, labeled with the "mediasec" header field parameter.

question_42159.question: What does URSP stand for in the context of 3GPP 5G System?

question_42160.question: What is the test purpose for the scenario when the SS gives absolutely no information about neighboring cells?
question_42160.ground_truth: The MS should not report on neighboring cells.

question_42162.question: What is the initial state of the UE in the test procedure described in section 9.1.29.4.2?

question_42163.question: What is the compromise solution recommended for service resiliency after an MME failure with restart?
question_42163.ground_truth: This compromise solution enables the UE to reattach to the EPS triggered by downlink data packets or signalling after the MME restarts. This solution includes steps such as SGW maintaining the IMSI and S5/S8 bearers after MME restart detection and sending an enhanced Downlink Data Notification message including IMSI to the associated MME if downlink data packets or signalling arrives while the timer is still running. The MME then pages the UE to start the reattach procedure.

question_42168.question: What does the BM-SC do when it detects a restart in the GCS AS?
question_42168.ground_truth: When the BM-SC detects a restart in the GCS AS, it deallocates (locally) all the TMGIs that had been assigned to the restarted GCS AS and stops all the related MBMS bearers to free the corresponding resources in E-UTRAN.

question_42169.question: What is the effect of using spared TPC symbols for ETI feedback?
question_42169.ground_truth: Using spared TPC symbols for ETI feedback allows for the realization of early termination, which can provide both link-efficiency and battery life improvements.

question_42170.question: What two additional QoS parameters exist for GBR QoS Flows only?
question_42170.ground_truth: Guaranteed Flow Bit Rate (GFBR) and Maximum Flow Bit Rate (MFBR) are the two additional QoS parameters that exist for GBR QoS Flows only.

question_42171.question: What is the goal of IAB topology adaptation?
