question_42846.ground_truth: The NRM server is responsible for validating the connectivity between DS-TTs in the same 5GS TSC bridge, identifying the traffic classes supported by the DS-TTs, and determining the end-to-end latency, including UE-DS-TT residence times, PDBs, and propagation delays for both uplink and downlink.

question_42847.question: Which frequency bands may the 2nd order IMD products and 3rd order IMD products fall into before considering the maximum bandwidth?
question_42847.ground_truth: The 2nd order IMD products may fall into BS receive Bands of 3, 4, 10, 24, 46 and 66, while the 3rd order IMD products may fall into BS receive Bands of 1, 2, 3, 4, 10, 22, 25, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 39, 42, 43, 46, 48, 65 and 66.

question_42850.question: What should be included in the "GANSS TOW msec" if the "GANSS timing of Cell wanted" is not included in the IE?
question_42850.ground_truth: The "GANSS TOW msec" should be set to the GANSS TOW when the position estimate was valid.

question_42851.question: What is not supported during the establishment of a PDN connection over non-3GPP access to EPC?
question_42851.ground_truth: EAP based secondary authentication by a DN-AAA server

question_42853.question: How does the network provide for the UE's active session(s) if the UE moves to an area where the conditional S-NSSAI is not supported?
question_42853.ground_truth: If a UE with active session(s) on conditional S-NSSAI moves to an area where the conditional S-NSSAI is not supported, the session(s) on the conditional S-NSSAI are deactivated, but the context may be preserved so that the session(s) are re-activated when the UE moves to an area which supports the conditional S-NSSAI.

question_42854.question: How can the network operator provide consistent quality for users in its network?
question_42854.ground_truth: The network operator can provide sufficient QoE to all users that have been granted access to the network and can also actively support premium users to maintain a certain service quality when the user plane is congested.

question_42855.question: Which specification describes the g.3gpp.current-location-discovery info package?

question_42858.question: What is the stop condition for the packet count test?
question_42858.ground_truth: The stop condition for the packet count test is when at least three RTCP packets have been sent from the SUT, after sending the first RTP packet (one or more RTCP packets may be sent before the first RTP packet).

question_42860.question: What information does the SRNC pass to the CN regarding the position estimate?
question_42860.ground_truth: The SRNC passes the position estimate, including the positioning method used to obtain the estimate, to the CN. If the CN has requested accuracy for the position estimate, the Location response shall include an indication whether the position estimate satisfies the requested accuracy or not.

question_42861.question: What should be the value of the LENGTH field in the Relative List super-field when there is only one codeword in the super-field of type RLIST?
question_42861.ground_truth: The LENGTH field in the Relative List super-field should have a value of 0000 when there is only one codeword in the super-field of type RLIST.

question_42862.question: What is the effect of receiving an implicit Transmission request due to an upgrade to an emergency group call or imminent peril call in MCVideo communication?
question_42862.ground_truth: When an ongoing session is upgraded to an emergency group call or an imminent peril call, the transmission control server receives an implicit Transmission request and indicates it to the transmission control server arbitration logic. The server then processes the request and sends necessary messages to the transmission participants.

question_42865.question: What is the role of H-NWDAF in determining QoS parameters for an application in Solution#11?
question_42865.ground_truth: H-NWDAF provides service experience analytics to H-PCF to help determine the QoS parameters for an application in Solution#11.

question_42866.question: What actions can UE-2, the new Controller UE, take regarding Media Flow-A if UE-2 only accepts the role of Collaborative Session Controller UE?
question_42866.ground_truth: UE-2 can initiate a media transfer from Controllee UE to another Controllee UE, release the media flow on the Controllee UE, or release the entire Collaborative Session.

question_42867.question: What is the role of the 5G PKMF-1(Remote UE) in Step 2 of the process, and what needs to be done to secure the connection?
question_42867.ground_truth: The 5G PKMF-1(Remote UE) server authenticates and authorizes the Remote UE's ID in Step 2. The same mechanism used to protect the PC3 interface can be reused to secure the connection, such as using solution #5 or solution #11.

question_42868.question: What information is included in the Secondary RAT Data Usage Report message sent by the SN to the MN in case of SN-terminated bearers?
question_42868.ground_truth: The Secondary RAT Data Usage Report message sent by the SN to the MN includes the data volumes of used secondary RAT resources for the related SN-terminated bearers.

question_42869.question: What is the difference between light and heavier background traffic in terms of packet inter-arrival CDFs?
question_42869.ground_truth: Light background traffic has packet inter-arrival CDFs that lie mainly to the right of a straight line drawn from 25% at 100ms through to 75% at 10secs on a plot with logarithmic X-axis and linear Y-axis. On the other hand, heavier background traffic has packet inter-arrival CDFs that lie mainly to the left of the same line.

question_42870.question: Which network element is responsible for policy enforcement in the fixed access network for Quality of Service (QoS)?
question_42870.ground_truth: The IP Edge is the policy enforcement point for QoS in the fixed access network.

question_42873.question: What should the MME do while rejecting connection requests and Attach Requests when the Service Gap timer is running?
question_42873.ground_truth: When rejecting the connection requests and the Attach Requests while the Service Gap timer is running, the MME may include a Mobility Management back-off timer corresponding to the time left of the current Service Gap timer.

question_42874.question: What is the default guaranteed bit rate for downlink if the value indicated in octet 13 and octet 16 of the maximum bit rate for downlink is ignored?
question_42874.ground_truth: The default guaranteed bit rate for downlink is 256 Mbps.

question_42876.question: How does the frequency domain relation between the band size and duplex gap size affect the generation of IM3 products for cellular networks?
question_42876.ground_truth: For the first category of bands, IM3 products would never fall in the own receive band, irrespective of RF BW. For the second category of bands, due to the "small" duplex gap, the own receiver could potentially suffer sensitivity degradation from IM3 products, depending on the size of the RF BW.

question_42877.question: What digital transmission rates are supported for transport over TDM in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_42877.ground_truth: The digital transmission rates supported for transport over TDM are 2048 kbit/s with a frame structure of 32 x 64kbit/s time slots for the E1 interface, and 1544 kbit/s with a frame structure of 24 x 64 kbit/s time slots for the T1 interface.

question_42878.question: What information does the NSACF store when the notification endpoint for EAC Notification is received from the AMF?
question_42878.ground_truth: The NSACF stores the notification endpoint for EAC Notification associated with the S-NSSAI to maintain up-to-date information about the AMFs serving the S-NSSAIs.

question_42879.question: What should be included in the request body when sending an HTTP POST message to submit a consumption report?
question_42879.ground_truth: The request body should be a ConsumptionReport structure, as specified in clause~11.3.3.1.

question_42880.question: What information is included in the From-id information element in the I1 protocol?
question_42880.ground_truth: The From-id information element in the I1 protocol includes either a SIP URI or an E.164 number, and it is used by the SCC AS to identify the ICS UE.

question_42881.question: What are the two main cases for AR conversational services based on MTSI architecture?
question_42881.ground_truth: The two main cases are the symmetrical case (6.5.3.1) and the asymmetrical case (6.5.3.2).

question_42882.question: What interfaces are affected by the new service operations introduced in Solutions #15 and #16?
question_42882.ground_truth: UDM and NEF (User Data Management and Network Exposure Function)

question_42885.question: Who is notified of the ad-hoc group emergency alert cancellation and MC service emergency state being cleared?
question_42885.ground_truth: MC service users are notified of the ad-hoc group emergency alert cancellation, and the MC service emergency state is cleared for them.

question_42887.question: Which level of the UC prevention pyramid discussed in the report can be realized without changing IMS interfaces and protocols?
question_42887.ground_truth: Levels 1 to 5, as long as UC feedback is not based on changes in SIP signaling

question_42888.question: How does blind IC provide gains over Type 3i receivers?
question_42888.ground_truth: Blind IC provides significant gains over Type 3i receivers by using estimated soft symbols in the demodulator to reconstruct the waveform and then perform cancellation.

question_42889.question: What action does MME take when operator intervention or other trigger occurs during a simultaneous 3GPP and TWAN connection?
question_42889.ground_truth: MME initiates a release of the resources on 3GPP access and sends a Delete Session Request to the SGW/PDN GW.

question_42890.question: What is the function of the PCF in the redundant steering mode (RSM) mechanism?
question_42890.ground_truth: The PCF, based on the QoS requirements from the AF, generates PCC rules to be sent to the SMF indicating that the RSM should be used for certain traffic and/or application.

question_42891.question: What is the network element that, in case of overload, can broadcast an "access barring for MTC Devices with Low-Priority-Access" in system information in the E-UTRAN, UTRAN and GERAN protocols?

question_42892.question: In what mode should the LTE positioning protocol (LPP) be supported by the UE for the UE to set the LPP bit to "LPP in N1 mode supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message?
question_42892.ground_truth: The LTE positioning protocol (LPP) should be supported in N1 mode by the UE.

question_42894.question: How does a UE determine which CSG member cells to measure?
question_42894.ground_truth: A UE applies an autonomous search function, per UE implementation, to determine when and where to search for the CSG member cells, and it may ignore not allowed CSG cells in the ranking. The autonomous search procedure is disabled if the UE's CSG whitelist does not exist or is empty.

question_42895.question: What triggers the SMF to initiate a PDU Session Modification Procedure in the case of UPF initiated modification?
question_42895.ground_truth: The UPF initiates the PDU Session Modification procedure by transmitting an N4 Association Update Request, which includes a list of QoS limitations.

question_42896.question: What does Alice need to provide to identify herself as a local resident and access the dump?
question_42896.ground_truth: Alice needs to provide payment information to pay the fee for disposing toxic waste.

question_42897.question: What is the course of action taken by the P-CSCF when there are active dialogs related to a user and security associations are deleted?
question_42897.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall discard all information pertaining to these dialogs without performing any further SIP transactions with the peer entities.

question_42899.question: What are the potential service requirements for the 3GPP system to ensure low latency and high throughput for UAS based remote inspection services?
question_42899.ground_truth: The potential service requirements for the 3GPP system to ensure low latency and high throughput for UAS based remote inspection services are supporting low latency transmission for delivering commands sent by the UAV controller and response message sent by the UAV and bi-directional high throughput from the UAV to the UAV controller via 3GPP network. Additionally, the UAV and UAV controller should support network assisted UAS discovery and 3GPP UE capabilities.

question_42900.question: What happens to the UE during a cell reselection towards a 2G or 3G network when there is a change of pool in the PS domain?
question_42900.ground_truth: In this case, a LAU and RAU occur, and users in the CS/PS domain are distributed between the two operators following CS/PS coordination.

question_42904.question: When deriving the home network realm from the IMSI, what is the second step if the first 5 or 6 digits of the IMSI have been separated into MCC and MNC?
question_42904.ground_truth: Use the MCC and MNC to create the "mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.3gppnetwork.org" network realm.

question_42905.question: What should the H(e)NB check to verify the SeGW's identity?
question_42905.ground_truth: The H(e)NB shall verify the SeGW identity by checking the subjectAltName field of the SeGW certificate against the name of the SeGW used by the H(e)NB to connect to the SeGW.

question_42908.question: How is the authentication message transferred between the UE and the AAA server during the UE-to-network relay process?
question_42908.ground_truth: The Relay UE and the AAA proxy transfer the authentication message between the AAA server and the UE.

question_42909.question: What is the method used for generating CRC bits for the new RTTI coding schemes?
question_42909.ground_truth: The method used for generating the CRC bits for the new RTTI coding schemes is the same as for generating CRC bits for TCH/AFS logical channels.

question_42910.question: In the test procedure for UE specific CBW change delay requirement, what is the initial BWP for the UE on PSCell?
question_42910.ground_truth: The initial BWP for the UE on PSCell is BWP-1.

question_42911.question: What should the UE do if the V2X control function does not receive a request for server-initiated provisioning of the management object within an implementation dependent time after sending of the notification?
question_42911.ground_truth: The V2X control function should determine that the V2X authorization update procedure is unsuccessfully completed if it does not receive a request for server-initiated provisioning of the management object within an implementation dependent time after sending of the notification.

question_42912.question: Who is responsible for the standardization of the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_42912.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification is produced by the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) which is an international collaboration between several telecommunications standards organizations.

question_42913.question: What action is the MCVideo client required to take upon receiving a Transmission end notify message from the transmission participant?
question_42913.ground_truth: The MCVideo client shall inform the user about the media transmission ended by another user and remain in the 'U: reception controller' state.

question_42914.question: What field in the SRS Pathloss Reference RS Update MAC CE indicates the Serving Cell containing activated SRS Resource Set?

question_42916.question: What should a GPRS MS do when it receives a rejected location area updating procedure with ROAMING NOT ALLOWED and it is IMSI attached for CS services in the network?
question_42916.ground_truth: It should set the GPRS update status to GU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, store the LAI in the list of "forbidden location areas for roaming", start timer T3340, and reset the location update attempt counter. If the RR connection does not exist, it should perform a PLMN selection.

question_42917.question: What is the role of the SNA Access Information IE in identifying issues in handover from UTRAN/GERAN to UTRAN, based on UE capability?
question_42917.ground_truth: The SNA Access Information IE is used in the source RNC to indicate the selected core network operator to the source core network node during relocation to a shared network.

question_42920.question: What should the SMF return for a N2 Handover Cancellation with I-SMF Insertion in clause 5.2.2.8.2.13?

question_42921.question: What is the maximum number of policy group members that a solution for group based policing should cater for?
question_42921.ground_truth: At least groups of in the order of 1000 group members.

question_42922.question: What happens if no CC call results from the CC recall mechanism and the recall timer CC-T9 expires?
question_42922.ground_truth: The terminating AS shall send a NOTIFY request to the originating AS with specific header fields and parameters indicating that the CC request has been rejected.

question_42923.question: What information is included in a QoS monitoring event?
question_42923.ground_truth: A QoS monitoring event can include information such as high jitter for TSC flows, notification that maximum survival time is reached for the TSC service, or changes in UE mobility and inter-UE distance. This information is used to determine triggers for TSN policy updates.

question_42924.question: What is the role of the SMLC in the DTAP-LE Information Transfer procedure?
question_42924.ground_truth: The SMLC in the DTAP-LE Information Transfer procedure is responsible for initiating the transfer of LLP messages to a Type A LMU when it has an LLP message to transfer.

question_42925.question: What are the main benefits of using solution 4 for online charging in roaming scenarios?
question_42925.ground_truth: Solution 4 defines a basic roaming package applicable for a set of GSMA services/applications expected to be largely deployed while offering the capability for other services to be deployed between PLMNs in a flexible manner.

question_42929.question: What is the purpose of the CTS enrolment procedure?
question_42929.ground_truth: The CTS enrolment procedure defines an association between a certain CTS-MS and a certain CTS-FP, and ensures the rights of the CTS-MS to use CTS services on this CTS-FP.

question_42930.question: What action will the UE take if the SMS services are not available in the current PLMN?
question_42930.ground_truth: The UE will stop timer T3430 if still running, reset the tracking area updating attempt counter, set the EPS update status to EU1 UPDATED, enter state EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE, and may provide a notification to the user or the upper layers that the SMS services are not available.

question_42931.question: What is the use of Extended Discontinuous Reception (DRX) in the 5G system?
question_42931.ground_truth: Extended Discontinuous Reception (DRX) in the 5G system enables the User Equipment to reduce its power consumption while still being available for MT data and/or network originated procedures within a certain delay dependent on the negotiated DRX cycle value. In CM-IDLE state, DRX cycles of up to almost 44 minutes (for eMTC) and up to almost 3 hours (for NB-IoT) are supported, and in CM-CONNECTED with RRC-INACTIVE, DRX cycles of up to 10.24 seconds are supported.

question_42933.question: What is the Min RSRQ possible with UE measurement accuracy?
question_42933.ground_truth: The Min RSRQ possible with UE measurement accuracy is calculated by applying negative signal uncertainty to the measured cell and positive signal uncertainty to all other cells, and considering cell interference over all 12 carriers. The minimum value is then obtained by subtracting 4 dB from the UE measurement accuracy.

question_42934.question: What action should the UE (MCDATA Client) take if it receives a FD notification via a SIP MESSAGE with "FILE DOWNLOAD REQUEST REJECTED" disposition notification type?
question_42934.ground_truth: The UE (MCDATA Client) should respond to the SIP MESSAGE with a SIP 200 (OK) message and deliver the notification that the remote Client has not accepted the download to the MCDATA User.

question_42935.question: What is the video decoding behavior required for a TP client in terminal receiving a video stream not starting with an IDR/IRAP access unit?
question_42935.ground_truth: The TP client in terminal shall start decoding immediately when it receives data, even if the stream does not start with an IDR/IRAP access unit. Alternatively, it shall start no later than the next IDR/IRAP access unit or the next recovery point Supplemental Enhancement Information (SEI) message, whichever is earlier in decoding order.

question_42936.question: What is the type of the "traceActivationIndicator" field in the RNCTraceInformation sequence?
question_42936.ground_truth: The "traceActivationIndicator" field in the RNCTraceInformation sequence is of the type ENUMERATED with possible values of "activated" or "deactivated".

question_42938.question: What is used by the Media Session Handler to request a specific policy and charging treatment to be applied to a particular application data flow of a downlink or uplink media streaming session?
question_42938.ground_truth: The Dynamic Policies API is used by the Media Session Handler to request a specific policy and charging treatment to be applied to a particular application data flow of a downlink or uplink media streaming session.

question_42939.question: What should an MME/SGSN do if it receives a new list of PRAs replacing the old PRA list from PCRF or OCS at a mobility procedure including an MME/SGSN change?
question_42939.ground_truth: The MME/SGSN should perform reports in following Location Change Reporting including an indication of whether the UE is inside or outside each PRA. The PRA Information also indicates rejected PRA(s) if any.

question_42941.question: How are UE Capability IDs allocated in the network-controlled capabilities sending and UE Capability ID allocation solution?
question_42941.ground_truth: In this solution, the network has the option to allocate UE Capability IDs for the UE Radio Capabilities indicated by a UE. The UE would then use these UE Capability IDs to indicate its supported UE Radio Capabilities to the network.

question_42942.question: What actions does the UE take when the Non-3GPP emergency number indicator is set to "use of non-3GPP emergency numbers permitted"?
question_42942.ground_truth: The UE provides the local emergency numbers to upper layers for the detection of UE initiated emergency call if the UE is connected to a PLMN through non-3GPP access and registered to the same PLMN or different PLMN through 3GPP access in the same country.

question_42943.question: What information can a HNB use to detect if a carrier is occupied by a neighbour cell's primary frequency?
question_42943.ground_truth: The HNB can detect if DwPTS or P-CCPCH is detected on a candidate carrier. If these are detected, the carrier can be affirmed to be occupied by one neighbour cell's primary frequency.

question_42944.question: Who is Adrian's service provider and why is he unable to access data services during the tour?
question_42944.ground_truth: Adrian uses service provider D, but he has turned off his data roaming during his travels.

question_42945.question: When the MME supports GTP-C Load Control feature, what additional information does it take into account for Serving GW selection?
question_42945.ground_truth: When the MME supports the GTP-C Load Control feature, it takes into account the Load Information received from the Serving GW in addition to the Weight Factors received from the DNS server to perform selection of a Serving GW.

question_42946.question: In the context of FDD, what should the Node B do if the Secondary UL Frequency Activation State is present in the Multicell E-DCH Information IE in the Additional E-DCH FDD Setup Information IE?
question_42946.ground_truth: The Node B should use the information as the initial activation state of the Radio Links on the secondary uplink frequency.

question_42947.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP TS 29.198 series of specifications?
question_42947.ground_truth: The 3GPP TS 29.198 series of specifications defines an architecture that enables application developers to make use of network functionality through an open standardized interface, i.e. the OSA API's.

question_42949.question: What should the (V-)PCF do if it becomes aware that a new NF service consumer (AMF) is requiring notifications and knows alternate or backup addresses where to send notifications?
question_42949.ground_truth: The (V-)PCF should exchange the authority part of the corresponding Notification URI with one of those addresses and resend the failed request for termination of the policy association to that URI.

question_42952.question: What is the purpose of the test specified in 8.10.1.1.6A?
question_42952.ground_truth: The purpose of the test specified in 8.10.1.1.6A is to verify rank-two performance for full RB allocation upon antenna ports 7 and 8.

question_42953.question: What should be studied for the enhancement of reliability and reduced latency in sidelink resource allocation mode 2, and what should be considered for this enhancement?
question_42953.ground_truth: The feasibility and benefit of a solution to enhance reliability and reduce latency in sidelink resource allocation mode 2 should be studied. The solution should consider sidelink DRX and inter-UE coordination, where a set of resources is determined at UE-A and sent to UE-B in mode 2 for its own transmission.

question_42955.question: What should the UE do when it receives a SERVICE REJECT message with 5GMM cause value #28 (Restricted service area) after sending a SERVICE REQUEST message?
question_42955.ground_truth: The UE should perform the mobility registration update procedure.

question_42956.question: What is the purpose of the USAT execution environment?
question_42956.ground_truth: The USAT execution environment provides the mechanisms to operate single or multiple USAT-applications.

question_42958.question: Which source observed a mean UL coverage of -103.35dB in Coverage Evaluation Method 1 for FR2, DU, UL, AR 1 stream, #UE/cell=Capacity(8~9) in the second set of observations?
question_42958.ground_truth: Source 18 and Source 16 observed a mean UL coverage of -103.35dB in Coverage Evaluation Method 1 for FR2, DU, UL, AR 1 stream, #UE/cell=Capacity(8~9) in the second set of observations.

question_42959.question: What access type conditions does the SMF enforce when there is more than one access type conditioned session rules provisioned and no session rule without any access type condition?
question_42959.ground_truth: The SMF ensures that any two access type conditioned session rules for the same session differ only in the authorized session-AMBR property.

question_42962.question: What action does the RAN take if it receives a Periodicity Range along with the Periodicity in the TSCAI for a QoS flow?
question_42962.ground_truth: The RAN may determine an adjusted periodicity in order to align the periodicity of the traffic bursts with the expected time interval between subsequent transmission opportunities over the air interface. The adjusted periodicity is forwarded to the AF via the SMF and the PCF together with a BAT offset.

question_42964.question: Who notices the improvement in latency and battery life after the IP connection between Oliver and Mattias is offloaded to ProSe direct communication?
question_42964.ground_truth: Oliver and Mattias notice the improvement in latency and battery life.

question_42965.question: What should the UE do if it is in NB-S1 mode and timer T3447 is running, and none of the specified conditions are met?
question_42965.ground_truth: The UE stays in the current serving cell and applies the normal cell reselection process. The service request procedure is not started.

question_42967.question: What type of E-UTRA TDD UE does the test applicability in section 7.3.57.2 apply to?
question_42967.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA TDD UE release 13 and forward of UE category M1 and higher, including non-BL/CE UE.

question_42968.question: What requirements must be met for the reported NR - E-UTRAN TDD RSRP, RSRQ, and RS-SINR measurements contained in event-triggered measurement reports?
question_42968.ground_truth: The reported NR - E-UTRAN TDD RSRP, RSRQ, and RS-SINR measurements contained in event-triggered measurement reports must meet the requirements in clauses 10.2.2, 10.2.3, and 10.2.5 of the specifications, respectively.

question_42969.question: Which two service access points are defined in the GSM radio interface for layer 2 signalling, and what do they support?
question_42969.ground_truth: The two service access points defined in the GSM radio interface are SAPI 0 and SAPI 3, where SAPI 0 supports the transfer of signalling information including user-user information and SAPI 3 supports the transfer of user short messages.

question_42970.question: When should the False value be used for a structured attribute and all its (descendant) attribute fields when the "isInvariant" property is set to False?
question_42970.ground_truth: The False value should be used for the attribute and all its (descendant) attribute fields if False is also specified for all of them and until a True value is specified for an attribute field.

question_42971.question: What does Source Layer-2 ID and Destination Layer-2 ID mean in the context of Proximity-based Services (ProSe)?
question_42971.ground_truth: Source Layer-2 ID is a link-layer identity that uniquely identifies a device that originates ProSe communication frames, while Destination Layer-2 ID is a link-layer identity that uniquely identifies a device or a group of devices that are recipients of ProSe communication frames.

question_42972.question: What is the format of the LIID in the context of Lawful Interception?
question_42972.ground_truth: The LIID format consists of alphanumeric characters and may contain a lawful authorization reference number and the date when the lawful authorization was issued.

question_42974.question: What is returned by the signServiceAgreement() method?
question_42974.ground_truth: The signServiceAgreement() method returns a structure TpSignatureAndServiceMgr, which contains the digital signature of the framework for the service agreement, and a reference to the service manager interface of the service.

question_42976.question: What HTTP status code should the NEF respond with upon creating a resource for the HTTP POST request?
question_42976.ground_truth: The NEF shall respond with a "201 Created" status code.

question_42977.question: What is the impact of quota management on PDU session specific charging time metering?
question_42977.ground_truth: Time metering starts when PDU session is activated, regardless of quota management.

question_42978.question: What is the drawback of Solution 1 for IOPS MC system?
question_42978.ground_truth: The drawback of Solution 1 is that some parameters in the MC service user profile are not known by the UE, and thus should not be used in an IOPS MC system.

question_42982.question: What processing is required when both the bit-rate and internal sampling rate change during rate switching?
question_42982.ground_truth: The processing described in clause 6.3.4 is performed first, followed by the processing described in clause 6.3.3 if the internal sampling rate is also changing.

question_42983.question: What is the threshold in quiet given for the first and second equation in the Bark scale?
question_42983.ground_truth: The threshold in quiet is given as 15dB/Bark for the first equation and 30dB/Bark for the second equation.

question_42984.question: What is the purpose of the LMF initiated Location Information Transfer Procedure?
question_42984.ground_truth: The purpose of this procedure is to enable the LMF to request additional sensor measurements or to enable the UE to provide sensor measurements to the LMF for position calculation.

question_42985.question: How is the maximum output power determined in the case of a single uplink?
question_42985.ground_truth: In the case of a single uplink, there is no need to determine the maximum output power as it is not applicable.

question_42986.question: What is the percentage of frequency deviation for home BS defined in NOTE 10?
question_42986.ground_truth: The percentage of frequency deviation for home BS defined in NOTE 10 is the aggregated maximum output power of all transmit antenna connectors of Home BS.

question_42988.question: How is the absolute length of the SI-window determined?
question_42988.ground_truth: The absolute length of the SI-window is given by si-WindowLength, which is the duration of time in slots.

question_42989.question: What is the maximum value that the Expires header field in a SIP PUBLISH request can be set to?
question_42989.ground_truth: The maximum value that the Expires header field in a SIP PUBLISH request can be set to is 4294967295.

question_42991.question: How is the MPEG-DASH service mapped to the Application Service concept in the first example?
question_42991.ground_truth: The MPEG-DASH service is mapped to the Application Service concept introduced in clause 4.2.1.5.2. The audio and the V2 video of the Media Presentation are distributed over MBMS and they are all included in one FLUTE session. The MPD and the Initialization segment are delivered as part of the USD fragment.

question_42992.question: When do fresh RRC and UP keys need to be derived in the eNB?
question_42992.ground_truth: Fresh RRC and UP keys are derived in the eNB during inter-eNB handovers and state transitions.

question_42993.question: What is the objective of Traffic Scenario 2 in the context of power demand from users?
question_42993.ground_truth: The objective of Traffic Scenario 2 is to allow on-demand use of Next Generation Radio access for bandwidth boost for fixed broadband access, which would help users control their tariffs and increase Quality of Experience.

question_42994.question: What is the role of the "tReportsType" complex type as defined in the XML schema?
question_42994.ground_truth: The "tReportsType" complex type defines the structure for reporting location-related information. It contains elements for specifying the user ID, latest location, and any additional extensions.

question_42996.question: What is the consequence if the total number of S-NSSAIs in the Allowed NSSAI and Partially Allowed NSSAI exceeds eight in the Partially Allowed NSSAI IE received in the HANDOVER REQUEST message?
question_42996.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node shall consider the procedure as failed.

question_42998.question: What is the expected sequence 1.1 described in 27.22.4.29.4.2 (RECEIVE DATA) procedure?
question_42998.ground_truth: PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP EVENT LIST 1.1.1, TERMINAL RESPONSE: SET UP EVENT LIST 1.1.1, PROACTIVE COMMAND: OPEN CHANNEL 1.1.1, TERMINAL RESPONSE: OPEN CHANNEL 1.1.1A or TERMINAL RESPONSE: OPEN CHANNEL 1.1.1B.

question_42999.question: What is the condition for detecting a lack of low frequency energy?
question_42999.ground_truth: A lack of low frequency energy is detected if the relative energy ratio between two frequency regions is less than a threshold value, which is determined by the average normalized pitch correlation value and the low frequency smoothed energy ratio.

question_43000.question: What parameter is used in the "Update NS" operation to indicate the new deployment flavour applied to the NS instance?
question_43000.ground_truth: The parameter "changeNsFlavourData" is used in the "Update NS" operation to indicate the new deployment flavour applied to the NS instance.

question_43001.question: What should a UE not expect in terms of PUCCH resource overlapping with PUSCH when transmitting aperiodic CSI reports in more than one PUSCH?
question_43001.ground_truth: A UE does not expect a PUCCH resource that results from multiplexing overlapped PUCCH resources to overlap with more than one PUSCHs if each of the more than one PUSCHs includes aperiodic CSI reports.

question_43003.question: What is the requirement for a test to be considered successful?
question_43003.ground_truth: For a test to be considered successful, the requirements on both event detection and percentage of transmitted ACK/NACKs have to be fulfilled simultaneously.

question_43004.question: What should the MCData client set the SDS disposition notification type IE to when generating an SDS delivered notification?
question_43004.ground_truth: The MCData client should set the SDS disposition notification type IE to "DELIVERED" when generating an SDS delivered notification.

question_43005.question: What type of traffic was used to evaluate the system performance of the LTE uplink?
question_43005.ground_truth: VoIP (Voice over Internet Protocol) traffic was used for the evaluation.

question_43006.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for this test?
question_43006.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are the same as defined in 8.16.47.3.

question_43007.question: What is the procedure for the performance with multiple NPBCH TTIs decoding in Narrowband IoT?
question_43007.ground_truth: For the performance with multiple NPBCH TTIs decoding, A is the number of 5120ms durations consisting of contiguous NPBCH TTIs where there is at least one correctly decoded MIB-NB PDU, and B is the number of 5120ms durations consisting of contiguous NPBCH TTIs during the test.

question_43008.question: What is the purpose of the DN-AAA server in the PDU Session Establishment process?
question_43008.ground_truth: The DN-AAA server in the PDU Session Establishment process confirms the successful authentication/authorization of a PDU Session and may provide one or more Frame (IPV6) Route(s) to apply to the PDU Session.

question_43010.question: What should the NF Service Consumer include in the content when invoking the "transfer-update" custom operation if the UE context transfer was completed successfully?
question_43010.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should include the transferStatus attribute set to "TRANSFERRED" in the content when invoking the "transfer-update" custom operation if the UE context transfer was completed successfully.

question_43012.question: What is the purpose of the correction factor in the independent noise filling algorithm used in IGF?
question_43012.ground_truth: The purpose of the correction factor is to adjust the energy of the inserted pseudo random numbers to match the original noise energy level in the decoded MDCT spectrum.

question_43013.question: What does the 3GPP TS 32.xsx family of documents contain?
question_43013.ground_truth: The 3GPP TS 32.xsx family of documents contains the requirements and information model necessary for Telecommunications Management (TM) including TM principles and TM architecture.

question_43015.question: How is the Packet Delay Budget (PDB) interpreted for different QCI values in terms of packet delay?
question_43015.ground_truth: Except for QCI 82 and 83, the PDB is interpreted as a maximum delay with a confidence level of 98% for services using a certain QCI in both uplink and downlink. For services using QCI 82 or 83, a packet delayed by more than the PDB is included in the calculation of the PELR if it is within the Maximum Data Burst Volume and GBR requirements.

question_43016.question: What is a codec that can be used for uplink and downlink sessions in the 3GPP speech recognition framework?
question_43016.ground_truth: Default uplink and downlink codec specifications are included in the 3GPP speech recognition framework.

question_43018.question: What is the task of PF in the process of policy execution?
question_43018.ground_truth: PF makes the decision for policy execution, activates/deactivates the network policy, and provides relevant data and parameters during the process of policy execution.

question_43020.question: What information shall the UE include in the INVITE request if location information is available for routing the IMS emergency call?
question_43020.ground_truth: If location information is available for routing the IMS emergency call, the UE shall include a location identifier such as the cell id, line id, or the identity of the I-WLAN access node in the P-Access-Network-Info header field.

question_43021.question: What information does the Mobile Equipment (ME) return if the WSID or WLAN identifier is requested?
question_43021.ground_truth: The ME returns the WSID or the WLAN identifier of the currently connected I-WLAN or WLAN, respectively. If no I-WLAN or WLAN is connected, the ME returns a "ME currently unable to process command - no service" message.

question_43022.question: What should the companies do when filtering for ongoing combinations in the Contact companies section?
question_43022.ground_truth: The companies should filter for ongoing combinations of their company and leave the line unchanged if all the information about the combination isn't changed.

question_43023.question: What is the default consideration for access to the cell if none of the conditions for barring access are met?
question_43023.ground_truth: If none of the conditions for barring access to the cell are met, then the UE considers access to the cell as not barred.

question_43024.question: How does the Technical Report define the verb "may"?
question_43024.ground_truth: The verb "may" indicates permission to do something.

question_43027.question: What is the role of the RA1'/RAA' function when using the TCH/F14.4 channel coding in A/Gb mode with an AIUR of 64 kbit/s?
question_43027.ground_truth: The RA1'/RAA' function converts between the 64 kbit/s data stream and the input rate to the channel coder when using the TCH/F14.4 channel coding in A/Gb mode with an AIUR of 64 kbit/s.

question_43028.question: How is the background noise and downlink speech stimulus applied in the recording process?
question_43028.ground_truth: The background noise and downlink speech stimulus are applied in the recording process, and a recording of the artificial ear DRP signal is performed.

question_43029.question: What is the role of the Slice PCF in quota management within VPLMN and HPLMN?
question_43029.ground_truth: The Slice PCF in VPLMN allocates quota to the UPF for a specific slice, indicating its association with HPLMN and HPLMN S-NSSAI. If quota management is handled by HPLMN, the Slice PCF in VPLMN needs to communicate with the Slice PCF in HPLMN for quota allocation.

question_43031.question: What is the significance of NSI ID in the network when used with S-NSSAI?
question_43031.ground_truth: NSI ID is only applicable when the consumer of analytics is NSSF or AMF and associated with S-NSSAI.

question_43032.question: In what situation should the UE read the 4-bit "modulation and coding scheme ()" field in the DCI?
question_43032.ground_truth: The UE should read the 4-bit "modulation and coding scheme ()" field in the DCI when the UE is not a BL/CE UE, PDSCH is assigned by MPDCCH DCI format 6-1A, the DCI is mapped onto the UE specific search space and the repetition number field in the DCI indicates PDSCH repetition level 1, and 4 or 6 TBs are scheduled by the corresponding DCI.

question_43034.question: What is the name of the sub-element within the <anyExt> element of the <OnNetwork> element that indicates the geographical area changes that trigger the functional alias activation?

question_43035.question: How does the network determine the QoS for a UE sending data to multiple groups in the 5G network?
question_43035.ground_truth: When a UE sends data to multiple groups, it creates multiple UL packets to send, each mapping to a different PDU Session. The UE applies the QoS rules received from the network on each PDU Session. For Ethernet PDU Sessions, different groups correspond to different values of the UE MAC address and VLAN tag.

question_43038.question: What is the expected measured receive/transmit delay for access bursts?
question_43038.ground_truth: The expected measured receive/transmit delay for access bursts is 3 timeslots (45/26 ms).

question_43039.question: What is the allowed value of the "o=" field in the session-level section of the SDP for an off-network MCVideo session?
question_43039.ground_truth: The <username> portion of the "o=" field in the session-level section of the SDP for an off-network MCVideo session should be set to a dash.

question_43040.question: What is the measurement called that provides the number of outgoing intra-gNB legacy handover preparations requested by the source NRCellCU in a split gNB deployment?

question_43041.question: What method is used by the Control Sink to respond when a session is successfully updated with partial modification?
question_43041.ground_truth: The Control Sink responds with a 200 OK success message indicating that the session was successfully updated and includes the session resource identifier of the session that is updated.

question_43042.question: What should be done if the mcdata-allow-short-data-service is set to "false" in the group document?
question_43042.ground_truth: Send a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response with the warning text set to "206 short data service not allowed for this group" in a Warning header field as specified in clause 4.7.

question_43043.question: In the single arbitrator approach, what happens if an MCVideo client is out of range of the current arbitrator?
question_43043.ground_truth: The MCVideo client is allowed to transmit and also become a transmission arbitrator.

question_43046.question: What happens to the MM context when a GPRS attach is rejected in the MS?
question_43046.ground_truth: The MM context moves to the PMM-DETACHED state and may be deleted in the MS.

question_43047.question: What is the value of the address field for the 4.4.1 case after the call is allowed with modifications?
question_43047.ground_truth: The value of the address field for the 4.4.1 case after the call is allowed with modifications is "987654321".

question_43049.question: When shall the network include the T3324 value IE in the ATTACH ACCEPT message?
question_43049.ground_truth: The network shall include the T3324 value IE in the ATTACH ACCEPT message only if the T3324 value IE was included in the ATTACH REQUEST message, and the network supports and accepts the use of PSM.

question_43050.question: What is the role of the Controller UE in the IUT architecture?
question_43050.ground_truth: The Controller UE is responsible for executing service requests towards the remote end during and after setup of the Collaborative Session. It also authorizes requests for IUT Media Control Related Procedures for the Controllee UE with IUT capabilities.

question_43054.question: When is the value of T used in the periodic attempts when the MS is using any of EC-GSM-IoT, Category M1 or Category NB1?
question_43054.ground_truth: The value of T is used in the range of 2 hours to 240 hours, using 2 hour steps from 2 hours to 80 hours and 4 hour steps from 84 hours to 240 hours.

question_43055.question: Which functional entities support the ACM client?
question_43055.ground_truth: The ACM client is supported by the signalling user agent and the HTTP client functional entities of the signalling control plane.

question_43057.question: Which external networks can an FRMCS System interwork with?
question_43057.ground_truth: An FRMCS System can interwork with various external networks, including the Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN), Private Telephone Network, Private Mobile Radio (PMR) or Land Mobile Radio (LMR), Public Land Mobile network (PLMN), other GSM-R networks, other FRMCS networks, other Wireless Access, and other packet data networks, such as the Internet.

question_43058.question: What should the originating AS do if it receives a NOTIFY request with the cc-state parameter set to 'queued'?
question_43058.ground_truth: The originating AS should stop the CC request timer CC-T2, start the CC service duration timer CC-T3, store the information whether the cc-service-retention parameter has been received or not, and confirm to the caller that the invocation was successful using announcement procedures.

question_43059.question: What details are included in the "Codec information" metric for speech media?
question_43059.ground_truth: For speech media, the "Codec information" metric contains the used speech codec type, represented as in an SDP rtpmap offer, and the used codec settings for bandwidth and redundancy, represented as in an SDP fmtp offer.

question_43060.question: What kind of features do IRPs support in the context of 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects?
question_43060.ground_truth: IRPs support a set of generic features that allow the retrieval of IRP profile and IRP supported versions.

question_43061.question: In the case of a PLMN change, what should happen to the announce request procedure?
question_43061.ground_truth: If a PLMN change occurs before the announce request procedure is completed, the procedure should be aborted. If the UE is authorized to announce in the new PLMN, the procedure should be restarted once the UE is registered on the new PLMN.

question_43062.question: What is the main purpose of the QoS mapping functions located at the AF, PCRF, PCEF, and UE?
question_43062.ground_truth: The main purpose of these mapping functions is the conversion of QoS parameters from one format to another.

question_43063.question: What should the UE do with existing PEIPS assistance information received from the network if the network did not accept the request to use that information?
question_43063.ground_truth: The UE should delete any existing PEIPS assistance information received from the network if the network did not accept the request to use that information.

question_43065.question: What is the purpose of defining the 3GPP management system and its capabilities in the context of network sharing?
question_43065.ground_truth: The purpose of defining the 3GPP management system and its capabilities in the context of network sharing is to provide the necessary functions and interfaces for managing shared resources in RAN and Core Network environments. This allows for the seamless operation and maintenance of the shared network.

question_43066.question: What is the purpose of a Temporary ProSe ID in the direct discovery procedure?
question_43066.ground_truth: A Temporary ProSe ID is used in the direct discovery procedure to identify a user without revealing their permanent ProSe ID. It can be an expression code or a UE ID, and may be re-allocated periodically for security and privacy.

question_43067.question: What is the difference between Individual Line and Group Line services in IP-PBX?
question_43067.ground_truth: Individual Line services are applicable to individual enterprise users, while Group Line services are applicable to groups of users.

question_43068.question: What message does the MN send towards the source SN to indicate that subsequent CPAC is prepared and the source SN continues providing user data to the UE?
question_43068.ground_truth: The MN sends the SN Change Confirm message towards the source SN.

question_43069.question: What is the minimum requirement for the spurious emissions of a BS type 1-C, as specified in TS 38.104 clause 6.6.5.2?
question_43069.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for the spurious emissions of a BS type 1-C is defined in TS 38.104 clause 6.6.5.3.

question_43071.question: How many attempted HTTP DELETE procedures are provided by the measurement XDM.AttHttpDel?

question_43072.question: Which document defines the 3GPP UTRAN NRM IRP XML Definitions for Release 17?
question_43072.ground_truth: Annex B of the present document defines the 3GPP UTRAN NRM IRP XML Definitions for Release 17.

question_43073.question: How does the operator set up communication services in a network slice?
question_43073.ground_truth: Based on the negotiated service requirements, the operator provisions necessary control and management functions to enable the setting up of an end-to-end network slice spanning different slice domains, and manages the end-to-end operation of the network slice to guarantee the availability of application functions deployed in that slice.

question_43074.question: How are the interferers classified in the analysis?
question_43074.ground_truth: The interferers are classified into the following categories: IcX (dominant co-channel narrow or wide interference), IaX (dominant 1st adjacent channel narrow or wide interference), restIcX (sum of all co-channel interference powers excluding the dominant interferer), and restIaX (sum of all adjacent channel interference powers excluding the dominant interferer).

question_43075.question: What is the significance of bit 8 in the GA-PSR Message Type octet?
question_43075.ground_truth: Bit 8 of the GA-PSR Message Type value is the most significant bit, used to indicate the specific message type. It is defined as set to 0 for Basic GA-PSR indication and set to 1 for Combined GA-PSR confirmation.

question_43077.question: What must the Content Provider AS include in the Content Provider Authorization Request message?
question_43077.ground_truth: The Content Provider AS must include necessary authorization credentials in the Content Provider Authorization Request message.

question_43078.question: What are the examples of Host-based Mobility Management Solutions for mobility between 3GPP and Non-3GPP systems?
question_43078.ground_truth: The examples of Host-based Mobility Management Solutions include MIPv4 with FA-CoA, MIPv4 with Co-CoA, MIPv6, HMIPv6, DSMIPv6, and DSMIPv4.

question_43079.question: In what two ways can Network Assistance for downlink media streaming be offered?
question_43079.ground_truth: Network Assistance for downlink media streaming may be offered to the UE in one of two ways: (1) Based on interaction between the UE and the 5GMSd AF with subsequent interaction between the 5GMSd AF and the PCF (or the NEF), (2) Based on interaction between the UE and the RAN, re-using ANBR-based RAN signaling.

question_43080.question: What is the suggested requirement for making the network aware of the minimum and maximum supported bandwidth requirements negotiated between User Equipments (UEs) for each media direction?
question_43080.ground_truth: The suggested requirement is that "it should be possible to make the network aware of the minimum and maximum supported bandwidth requirements negotiated between the UEs for each media direction."

question_43082.question: What action can a device take when it receives a PUAN with a matching TLLI?
question_43082.ground_truth: The device that receives a PUAN with a matching TLLI will still make another access attempt due to the SGSN discarding the LLC PDU.

question_43083.question: What should the SMS Router do if the HLR returns error information when sending a routing information retrieval?
question_43083.ground_truth: The SMS Router should forward the returned error information transparently to the SMS-GMSC.

question_43084.question: What is the minimum ACLR requirement for SL-U in NR?
question_43084.ground_truth: The minimum ACLR requirement for SL-U in NR is 27 dBc for both PC3/PC5 UE with NR MBW.

question_43085.question: What does the test procedure aim to verify for the UE with highSpeedMeasFlagFR2-r17?
question_43085.ground_truth: The test procedure aims to verify the intra frequency NR cell reselection requirements for the UE with highSpeedMeasFlagFR2-r17.

question_43088.question: In which 3GPP TS document can the definitions of the SNSM-SAP service primitives for GSM be found?
question_43088.ground_truth: The definitions of the SNSM-SAP service primitives for GSM can be found in 3GPP TS 44.065.

question_43091.question: What must the controlling MCVideo function do if it receives a SIP re-INVITE request with an imminent peril indication that is an unauthorized request for an MCVideo imminent peril group call?
question_43091.ground_truth: It must reject the SIP re-INVITE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response to the SIP re-INVITE request, and include in the SIP 403 (Forbidden) response an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the imminentperil-ind element set to "false".

question_43092.question: What is the pre-requisite for the NF Service Consumer to request an access token from the vNRF for services of NF Service Producers of a specific NF type?
question_43092.ground_truth: The NF Service consumer must be registered with the vNRF and the hNRF, and the two NRFs must be implicitly authenticated via N32 mutual authentication of SEPPs.

question_43093.question: What steps must the UE follow when receiving a BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message over E-UTRAN?
question_43093.ground_truth: The UE must include the NBIFOM container IE and NBIFOM IP flow mapping parameter in the BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message of the UE requested bearer resource modification procedure.

question_43094.question: What is the purpose of the Initial HeMS's FQDN or IP address in clauses 5.1.2.2 and 5.1.2.3?
question_43094.ground_truth: The Initial HeMS's FQDN or IP address in clauses 5.1.2.2 and 5.1.2.3 is required for the HeNB to establish a secure connection with Initial SeGW and Initial HeMS, as well as a TR-069 session with Initial HeMS for HeNB registration with Serving HeMS.

question_43101.question: What sub-block edges adjacent to the sub-block gap should be used to determine the sub-block edges for NTC21a and NTC21b?
question_43101.ground_truth: The sub-block edges adjacent to the sub-block gap should be determined using the specified Foffset-RAT for the carrier that is adjacent to the sub-block gap for NTC21a and NTC21b.

question_43102.question: What must the NF service consumer do after receiving a response with a binding indication from the NF service producer?
question_43102.ground_truth: The NF service consumer must use the binding indication and resource information received for subsequent requests regarding the concerned resource.

question_43104.question: How does the Total Accessible Resource Requested field of the Extended Resource Indicator IE affect the subsequent mode field?
question_43104.ground_truth: If the Resource Indication Method is not set to method ii) of sub-clause 3.1.3.1, then the Subsequent Mode field is ignored. However, if the Resource Indication Method is set to method ii) of sub-clause 3.1.3.1, then the Subsequent Mode field is decoded as method iv) of sub-clause 3.1.3.1, and the subsequent mode shall be i) or iii) of sub-clause 3.1.3.1, depending on the reporting mode prior to receipt of this IE. If the reporting mode prior to receipt of this IE is neither i) or iii) of sub-clause 3.1.3.1, then the subsequent mode shall be method iv) of sub-clause 3.1.3.1.

question_43106.question: What is the maximum allowed handover delay in this test case?
question_43106.ground_truth: The maximum allowed handover delay is 190 ms.

question_43107.question: What method for OTDOA enhancements in scenarios with RRHs will not only impact the current physical design for positioning signal (possible impact to RAN1), but also require changes in signalling (possible impact to RAN2/3)?
question_43107.ground_truth: Solution 3: Different PRS sequences for different RRHs in the same cell.

question_43108.question: What is the default behavior of the UE when the UE has not selected a WLAN and has received LWA/RCLWI signalling?
question_43108.ground_truth: The UE shall accept the LWA/RCLWI signalling and apply WLAN access selection and traffic routing based on the applicable LWA/RCLWI procedures.

question_43112.question: What should the UE do if it is not authorized for a certain CAG or authorized for CAG cells only, and receives this cause value from a non-3GPP access or from an SNPN cell?
question_43112.ground_truth: This is considered an abnormal case, and the UE should follow the behavior specified in subclause 5.5.2.3.4.

question_43114.question: What is the major aspect covered in this solution for PC5 service authorization and policy/parameter provisioning to a UE?
question_43114.ground_truth: The two major aspects covered in this solution are enhancing procedures related to PC5 service authorization and policy/parameter provisioning to a UE and identifying necessary information for PC5 service authorization and provisioning.

question_43116.question: What is the test requirement for 27.14.4.4.2 after entering the new PIN in the context of 3GPP~TS 02.30 and 3GPP~TS 11.11 specifications?
question_43116.ground_truth: After step (d), the ME shall indicate that the PIN has been accepted after entering the new PIN.

question_43118.question: What is the expected outcome of the MS after sending the AoCC acknowledge in the CONNECT message?
question_43118.ground_truth: The call is maintained until cleared by the MS.

question_43120.question: What is the purpose of the gateway control session between the BPCF and the PCRF?
question_43120.ground_truth: The gateway control session between the BPCF and the PCRF is established for the UE to request policy decisions for EPC routed traffic. It is linked to the IP-CAN session over Gx interface, which is established for the PDN Connection in the PDN GW.

question_43121.question: What measures should be taken to preserve the structure of ProSe Codes before security processing, as noted in NOTE 1?
question_43121.ground_truth: The measures should be taken in a way that does not affect the security of the ProSe Codes.

question_43122.question: What are the service-based interfaces in the CAPIF architecture?
question_43122.ground_truth: The CAPIF service-based interfaces are Cccf and Caef, exhibited by the CAPIF core function and the API exposing function, respectively.

question_43123.question: What HTTP status code indicates the successful creation of a Server Certificate resource?
question_43123.ground_truth: Upon successful creation of a Server Certificate resource, the 5GMSd~AF shall respond with a 201 (Created) response message.

question_43124.question: What happens if both UEs select to use link-local IPv6 addresses for a unicast link?
question_43124.ground_truth: Both UEs must disable the duplicate address detection defined in RFC 4862 to prevent duplicate link-local addresses.

question_43125.question: What are the two 3GPP audio codecs that participated as reference codecs in the ITU-T tests?

question_43126.question: What is the MRFP's role when comparing session IDs in MSRP media handling?
question_43126.ground_truth: The MRFP shall compare only the session-id of the received MSRP packets with the stored session-id, which is in accordance with IETF draft-ietf-simple-msrp-sessmatch-10 and compatible with peers using IETF RFC 4975 or RFC 6714.

question_43127.question: What shall not exceed the level that the MN offered when setting up the split bearer in step 1, when the SN decides the amount of resources to allocate for a specific E-RAB?
question_43127.ground_truth: The QoS level requested from the MN.

question_43128.question: What condition must be satisfied for the leaving condition C2-2 of the event?
question_43128.ground_truth: The leaving condition C2-2 is satisfied when the inequality C2-2, which involves the measurement result of channel busy ratio of the transmission resource pool and the threshold parameter, is fulfilled.

question_43129.question: What must the old AMF do if it has PDU Sessions for a different access type and cannot relocate the N2 interface to the new AMF?
question_43129.ground_truth: The old AMF returns the UE's SUPI and indicates that the Registration Request has been validated for integrity protection, but does not include the rest of the UE context.

question_43130.question: Which entry in the user profile of MCPTT client 2 does the MCPTT server check to verify if MCPTT client 2 is authorized to transfer the MCPTT private call?
question_43130.ground_truth: The MCPTT server checks the "Allow private call transfer" entry in the user profile of MCPTT client 2.

question_43134.question: What form of communication does the ProSe Ad-Hoc mode use for communication within the network?
question_43134.ground_truth: Communication in the ProSe Ad-Hoc mode is layer-2 based and does not use IP.

question_43136.question: How will the UE decide to perform measurements on NR inter-frequencies or inter-RAT frequency cells of equal or lower priority?
question_43136.ground_truth: The UE measures NR inter-frequencies or inter-RAT frequency cells of equal or lower priority when the serving cell does not meet Srxlev > SnonIntraSearchP and Squal > SnonIntraSearchQ.

question_43137.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the FDD intra-frequency relative accuracy test of RSRP in 5MHz bandwidth?
question_43137.ground_truth: The relative accuracy of RSRP is defined as the RSRP measured from one cell compared to the RSRP measured from another cell on the same frequency.

question_43138.question: What is the purpose of the test described in clause 7.1.3.4.1.3?
question_43138.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in clause 7.1.3.4.1.3 is to ensure that when the UE is requested to make a non-lossless handover by SS, it is able to transmit and receive the next PDCP Data PDU with SN value 0.

question_43139.question: Under which circumstances should the floor participant interface send a Floor Revoke message to the floor participant?
question_43139.ground_truth: The floor participant interface should send a Floor Revoke message to the floor participant when it receives an indication from the network media interface that RTP media packets are received from the MCPTT client while in the 'P: has no permission' state.

question_43140.question: What is used to create an end-to-end secure session between two MCPTT UEs for private calls, independent of the transmission path?

question_43141.question: When is the 5GSM cause IE included in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMPLETE message?
question_43141.ground_truth: The 5GSM cause IE is included in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMPLETE message if UEs compliant with version 15.3.0 of the specification send it.

question_43142.question: What conditions must be satisfied for the UE to consider the entering condition for event B2 to be met, as specified in TS 38.331, clause 5.5.4.9?
question_43142.ground_truth: The UE considers the entering condition for event B2 to be satisfied when both conditions B2-1 and B2-2, as specified in TS 38.331, clause 5.5.4.9, are fulfilled.

question_43143.question: What is the measurement reporting delay exclusion in the context of TTI of the uplink DCCH?
question_43143.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay excludes a delay which is caused by no UL resources for the UE to send the measurement report.

question_43145.question: Which specifications are used to support the SOAP solution set in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_43145.ground_truth: The SOAP 1.1 specification, WSDL 1.1 specification, XPath 1.0 specification, and Notification IRP SOAP SS are used to support the SOAP solution set in the 3GPP Technical Specification.

question_43146.question: What is a requirement for the reported channel occupancy measurement values in inter-frequency channel occupancy measurements?
question_43146.ground_truth: The reported channel occupancy measurement values contained in measurement reports should be based on the measurement reporting range specified in TS 38.331.

question_43147.question: What is the risk level assigned to threat #12 and what should be done to mitigate it?
question_43147.ground_truth: The risk level assigned to threat #12 is 9 (critical). To mitigate this threat, the registration procedure must be trust-worthy and the provisioning process should be securely bound to the registration.

question_43148.question: What should the RNC do if it has received Redirection Indication IE from all attempted CN operators?
question_43148.ground_truth: The RNC shall select the most appropriate NAS-PDU among the NAS-PDU IEs received from the attempted CN nodes based on the stored information as part of the Rerouting function and send it back to the UE.

question_43149.question: What is sent from the H-SMF to PCF in step 9 when dynamic PCC is to be used for the MA PDU Session?
question_43149.ground_truth: An "MA PDU Request" indication and the ATSSS Capabilities of the MA PDU session. The H-SMF also provides the currently used list of Access Type(s) and RAT Type(s) for the MA-PDU session to the PCF.

question_43150.question: When should the UE send keep-alives associated with the session towards the P-CSCF?
question_43150.ground_truth: The UE should send keep-alives if the Via header field of any provisional response or the final 200 (OK) response for the initial INVITE request contains a "keep" header field parameter with a value.

question_43152.question: What is the purpose of altering the radio environment in steps 1c, 1f, 2c, 2f of the test?
question_43152.ground_truth: The radio environment is altered to reduce or increase the carrier to interference ratio (C/I) in specific steps of the test, which in turn triggers the MS to recommend a different coding rate. This allows for the testing of the MS's ability to adapt to changing radio conditions.

question_43154.question: Which network function is responsible for terminating the N2 and N3 interfaces for untrusted non-3GPP access?

question_43156.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for all types of NR UE as per clause 6.5A.3.3.0?
question_43156.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are the same as in clause 6.5A.3.3.0 for all types of NR UE release 15 and forward.

question_43157.question: What is the RIM routing address used for in the Radio Access Network?
question_43157.ground_truth: The RIM routing address identifies the source or destination BSS when RIM is used to support the exchange of information within the Radio Access Network. The routing address can be the cell identifier (RAI + CI) for GERAN and UTRAN, the eNB identifier for E-UTRAN, or the eHRPD Sector ID IE for eHRPD.

question_43159.question: What is the advantage of solution #42 in improving dynamic EAS instantiation?
question_43159.ground_truth: Solution #42 improves dynamic EAS instantiation by using instantiable EAS information provisioned by MnS, UE type sent from the EEC, and AC requirement during EAS discovery, enabling the EES to select and request an appropriate EAS to be instantiated.

question_43160.question: What is the effect of setting a non-zero value to a zero value of heartbeatNtfPeriod?
question_43160.ground_truth: Setting a non-zero value to a zero value of heartbeatNtfPeriod triggers an immediate heartbeat notification, which becomes the base for the new heartbeat period.

question_43161.question: What is the role of the NF discovery functionality in the NF service discovery process?
question_43161.ground_truth: The NF discovery functionality enables a Control Plane Network Function or SCP to discover NF instance(s) that provide the expected NF service(s).

question_43165.question: What information does the UE include in the UE radio capability ID IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if both a network-assigned UE radio capability ID and a manufacturer-assigned UE Radio Capability ID are applicable?
question_43165.ground_truth: The UE includes the network-assigned UE radio capability ID in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

question_43166.question: What is the purpose of group call in MCPTT services?
question_43166.ground_truth: Group call is a pre-arranged call between MCPTT users who are already provisioned as members of a group. It provides a mechanism for authorized MCPTT users to communicate with affiliated MCPTT members of that group.

question_43167.question: How are transmitter requirements expressed in LTE Rel-8 and LTE-Advanced?
question_43167.ground_truth: In LTE Rel-8, transmitter requirements are expressed for a single transmitter antenna connector, while in LTE-Advanced, they apply for each transmitter antenna connector for DB-DC-HSDPA with separates antenna connectors and multiple antenna connectors.

question_43170.question: How does the FRMCS system manage the priority of the railway emergency alert?
question_43170.ground_truth: The priority of the railway emergency alert is managed by the arbitration rules, and it has the priority which matches the application category of CRITICAL DATA within the FRMCS system.

question_43176.question: What does the NF Service consumer or SCF select when multiple NF Service instances within a NF Service Set are exposed and the original NF producer instance is not available anymore?
question_43176.ground_truth: The NF Service consumer or SCF selects another NF Service instance of the same NF Service Set within the NF instance, if available. Otherwise, it selects a different NF instance within the same NF Set.

question_43177.question: What is the Time-Usage AVP used for and what type of AVP is it?
question_43177.ground_truth: The Time-Usage AVP is of type Unsigned32 and holds the effective used time within the service data container reporting interval.

question_43178.question: What is the required minimum test time due to fading for TUhigh in the test described in 14.19.2.2.4?
question_43178.ground_truth: The required minimum test time due to fading for TUhigh in the test described in 14.19.2.2.4 is 990 wavelengths, which needs to be considered before limit checking is valid.

question_43179.question: What is the purpose of the MBMS heartbeat procedure in the 3GPP network?
question_43179.ground_truth: The MBMS heartbeat procedure enables the BM-SC and MBMS GW to detect an SGmb path failure or the restart of the peer MBMS node.

question_43182.question: What is the conformance requirement for a MS with implementation after Rel.98 and later in test 34.2.7.2b?
question_43182.ground_truth: On receipt of a short message, the MS shall check the originating address and replace any existing stored message with the same Protocol Identifier code and originating address with the new short message and other parameter values.

question_43184.question: What triggers the BPCF to initiate S9a session establishment in clause 5.2.2.1.2?
question_43184.ground_truth: The BPCF initiates S9a session establishment if it receives the trigger in step 3 and policy interworking with PCRF is supported.

question_43186.question: What should be done if 1 set of e-parameters is received and there is no Tariff Switch running for the Session, but there are e-parameters stored for it?

question_43188.question: What is the requirement for the UE to send an Event A3 triggered measurement report in Test 2?
question_43188.ground_truth: In Test 2, the UE shall send one Event A3 triggered measurement report, with a measurement reporting delay less than 51.2 s from the beginning of time period T2.

question_43189.question: What should a mobile station supporting DTM do, to complete testing for k=1 and MSs indicating support of single slot DTM shall additionally complete testing for k=2?
question_43189.ground_truth: The mobile station supporting DTM shall complete testing for k=1 and MSs indicating support of single slot DTM shall additionally complete testing for k=2.

question_43190.question: What is the range of Maximum bit rate for downlink (extended-2) in octet 19?
question_43190.ground_truth: The range of values for octet 19 is from 260 Mbps to 10 Gbps in 4 Mbps to 10 Gbps increments.

question_43192.question: What is the role of the mobile base station relay (IAB-node) in providing 5G coverage and communication to UEs?
question_43192.ground_truth: The mobile base station relay (IAB-node) provides 5G coverage and communication to UEs (both inside the vehicle and in its vicinity) through a wireless connection to the 5G network via an IAB-donor gNB.

question_43193.question: What HTTP method is used to retrieve a single resource representation, such as a Part class instance, from the server?
question_43193.ground_truth: The HTTP GET method is used to retrieve a single resource representation from the server.

question_43194.question: What should be stored in the list of "PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location" in the UE?
question_43194.ground_truth: Each entry in the list consists of the PLMN identity, the geographical location, if known, where 5GMM cause value #78 "PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location" was received, and a UE implementation specific distance value if the geographical location exists.

question_43195.question: What is the minimum requirement for the maximum power measured at step c) for a GSM 900 or DCS 1800 BSS in section 6.6.2.1.4?
question_43195.ground_truth: The maximum power measured shall not exceed -47 dBm for a GSM 900 BSS or -57 dBm for a DCS 1800 BSS

question_43197.question: What is the maximum number of taps recommended for the TU channel model when using DSR?
question_43197.ground_truth: For TU channel model, it is recommended to use 6 taps for DSR.

question_43198.question: What must the UE do to become aware of proximity of a connectivity service provided by a UE-to-network relay?
question_43198.ground_truth: The UE must initiate the monitoring UE procedure for UE-to-network relay discovery to become aware of proximity of a connectivity service provided by a UE-to-network relay.

question_43199.question: What is the role of the NWDAF in providing observed service experience?
question_43199.ground_truth: The NWDAF provides observed service experience as defined in clause 6.4.3, which can be provided individually per user equipment (UE) or group of UEs, or globally, and can be averaged per application or across a set of applications on a network slice.

question_43201.question: What is the recommended maximum steering angle that should be considered when defining the intended set of directions (in cell) for an Active Antenna System (AAS) in a spatial emission requirement?
question_43201.ground_truth: The intended set of directions (in cell) for an AAS in a spatial emission requirement is defined only for the OTA peak directions set that corresponds to the maximum expected steering angles of the AAS in azimuth and elevation.

question_43203.question: What is the requirement for the UE to use the associated DUSK, DUCK, and DUIK to process a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for direct discovery response or direct discovery solicitation?
question_43203.ground_truth: To unscramble, decrypt, and verify the MIC field of the message, respectively.

question_43205.question: What information does the MME include in the Delete Bearer Command message it sends to the Serving GW to deactivate a selected dedicated bearer?
question_43205.ground_truth: The MME includes the EPS Bearer Identity, User Location Information, UE Time Zone, RAN/NAS Release Cause if available, Secondary RAT usage data, and PSCell ID if received in step 1.

question_43207.question: Why might situation 3 require the MC UE to report location information at every MBMS SAI change?
