question_43550.ground_truth: The issue is that the current test procedures for time masks are based on power measurement in a relatively long period compared with the transient period, and these procedures can't provide enough resolution to identify non-conformant UEs for time masks between 2 active time slots with different power levels.

question_43551.question: What is the role of the AAnF in the solution described in clause 6.31.2?
question_43551.ground_truth: The AAnF maintains the mapping relationship between the A-KID and the SUPI of the UE in this solution.

question_43553.question: In what direction does the message transit in scenario 4.1.8 before reaching the destination NE inside the PLMN?
question_43553.ground_truth: The message may transit several transit nodes outside the PLMN, an SS7 Security Gateway of the PLMN in inbound direction, and several transit nodes within the PLMN before it reaches the destination NE inside the PLMN.

question_43555.question: What is the Doppler shift when a high-speed train travels north from Paris?
question_43555.ground_truth: The Doppler shift is highest for a platform moving along longitude compared to a moving platform along latitude, with a maximum rate of change of approximately -23 mHz/s.

question_43557.question: What is the term "CSG ID" referring to in the context of NB-IoT UEs?
question_43557.ground_truth: CSG ID refers to the Cell Global Identity of a cell in the context of NB-IoT UEs.

question_43558.question: What is the difference between the P-TMSI type set to "native P-TMSI" and "mapped P-TMSI"?
question_43558.ground_truth: P-TMSI type set to "native P-TMSI" indicates that the MS has obtained a valid P-TMSI and RAI, while P-TMSI type set to "mapped P-TMSI" indicates that the MS has mapped a GUTI to P-TMSI, P-TMSI signature, and RAI using the GUTI allocated by an MME.

question_43559.question: What is the purpose of the L3Address child node in the GeographicalArea node?
question_43559.ground_truth: The L3Address child node in the GeographicalArea node indicates the V2X server address that is applicable when the UE is located in the geographical area indicated by the GeographicalArea child node.

question_43560.question: What is the principle of QoS flow Based Charging in clause 5.2.1.5?
question_43560.ground_truth: QoS flow Based Charging allows the SMF to collect charging information related to data volumes per PDU session, categorized per QoS Flow. QBC doesn't support quota management.

question_43561.question: What is the role of the Um/Uu radio interface and R reference point in GPRS access?
question_43561.ground_truth: The Um/Uu radio interface is used for mobile access to GPRS services, while the R reference point is used for message origination or reception and differs for MSs and PLMN.

question_43562.question: What is the role of the API invoker obtaining resource owner consent solution in CAPIF?
question_43562.ground_truth: The API invoker obtaining resource owner consent solution in CAPIF addresses the key issues of obtaining resource owner consent in the UE- and AF-originated API invocation scenarios. It may reuse well-known authorization procedures such as OAuth 2.0 for obtaining resource owner consent.

question_43564.question: What is the purpose of using a 128-bit ciphering algorithm in the present clause?
question_43564.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure secure communication between E-UTRAN and UTRAN.

question_43565.question: What is the purpose of the Integrity Principle of Operation in the Positioning Integrity section?
question_43565.ground_truth: The purpose of the Integrity Principle of Operation is to ensure that the network will ensure that the probability of errors exceeding a certain bound for longer than a certain time is less than or equal to the residual risk plus a variable IRallocation component.

question_43567.question: What is the purpose of supporting mobile base station relay-assisted 5G services for UEs in a vehicle?
question_43567.ground_truth: The 5G system shall support mechanisms to optimize mobility and energy efficiency for UEs located in a vehicle equipped with a base station relay, and to provide 5G access for both UEs in the vehicle and around it.

question_43569.question: What is the impact of UE-to-Network Relay on the Access Type preference IE?
question_43569.ground_truth: The existing "Access Type preference" IE should be extended to include PC5 path so that the Remote UE can determine which type of access should be used.

question_43571.question: How is the time period T1 defined in the test case described?
question_43571.ground_truth: T1 is initially 30 s to allow enough time for the UE to search for cells as it has no prior knowledge of these.

question_43572.question: When is the frequency domain resource allocation determined by uplink resource allocation type 1?
question_43572.ground_truth: The frequency domain resource allocation is determined by uplink resource allocation type 1 when useInterlacePUCCH-PUSCH is not provided by BWP-UplinkCommon and BWP-UplinkDedicated, and the initial UL BWP and initial UL BWP have the same SCS, same CP length, and the active UL BWP includes all RBs of the initial UL BWP.

question_43573.question: What is the minimum test time due to multipath conditions that requires at least 990 wavelengths to be crossed with the speed given in the fading profile?
question_43573.ground_truth: The minimum test time due to multipath conditions exceeds the target test time, and the test runs for the minimum test time due to multipath conditions.

question_43574.question: What is the purpose of modifying a pre-established session in MCPTT?
question_43574.ground_truth: The purpose of modifying a pre-established session in MCPTT is to update the ICE (Interactive Connectivity Establishment) candidate pair for the pre-established session, this could be to switch a media session from the inactive to the active state, or to modify the characteristics of the corresponding GBR (Guaranteed Bit Rate) bearers.

question_43576.question: Which state does the HLR store the logical state of the call hold service in?
question_43576.ground_truth: The HLR stores the logical state of the call hold service in the Provisioning State, Registration State, Activation State, and HLR Induction State.

question_43578.question: What is the difference between the maximum supported and maximum desired bandwidth?
question_43578.ground_truth: The maximum supported bandwidth is the maximum bandwidth that a network or terminal can support, while the maximum desired bandwidth is the maximum bandwidth that a network or terminal desires for a particular session or media component.

question_43579.question: What is the function of the GGSN when External PDN Address Allocation is used and DHCPv4 is the chosen protocol?
question_43579.ground_truth: If External PDN Address Allocation is used and DHCPv4 is chosen as the protocol, the GGSN provides the function of a DHCPv4 Client.

question_43581.question: In what scenario is FEC used to protect MBMS transmissions?
question_43581.ground_truth: FEC can be applied by the BM-SC or directly by the MC service server to protect media transported by a MBMS bearer and reach the required level of QoS, but FEC decoding is always performed by the MC service client.

question_43583.question: Which SIP capabilities are mandatory for the NGCN-NGN interface in relation to session control?
question_43583.ground_truth: The support of INVITE initiated dialogs is mandatory if media sessions are supported across the NGCN - NGN interface where media can be any mix of audio, video, and application data.

question_43584.question: What HTTP method is used for the "send-routing-info-sm" custom operation in the 6.2.3.9.4.2 resource?
question_43584.ground_truth: This operation uses the POST method for the "send-routing-info-sm" custom operation in the 6.2.3.9.4.2 resource.

question_43585.question: What is the role of the Charging Gateway Function (CGF) in 3GPP Technical Specifications?
question_43585.ground_truth: The Charging Gateway Function (CGF) is responsible for the transfer of CDR files from the 5G connection and mobility CGF to the billing domain (BD).

question_43586.question: Which protocol should the 5G system be able to distribute high-precision timing information as per to enable the synchronous timing of broadcast devices over the network?
question_43586.ground_truth: The Precision Time Protocol (IEEE 1588-2008) in SMPTE ST2059 profile.

question_43587.question: What does the acronym "DAPS" stand for in the PDCP specification?
question_43587.ground_truth: DAPS stands for Dual Active Protocol Stack, which is a bearer used in the context of handover in mobile networks.

question_43588.question: What is the use of the selectService() method?
question_43588.ground_truth: The selectService() method is used by the client application to identify the service that the client application wishes to use.

question_43589.question: What is the role of the NSCE server in the 5GS network when there is a failure in the application/service?
question_43589.ground_truth: The NSCE server can detect if the application/service error is caused by the 5GS network or not. If it is, the NSCE server sends the fault diagnosis report to the OAM system to indicate the server fault causing the application/service failure.

question_43590.question: What are the pre-conditions for updating the selected MC service user profile for an MC service?
question_43590.ground_truth: The pre-conditions for updating the selected MC service user profile within a single MC service include user authentication in the identity management server, secure access to the MC service server, obtained multiple MC service user profiles, MC service authorization, and triggering of the MC service client to select a particular MC service user profile as active.

question_43591.question: When should the MSGin5G Gateway Client start a timer for periodic bulk registration?
question_43591.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Gateway Client may start a timer for periodic bulk registration based on implementation, for example, when the first registration request from the Constrained UE has the "false" value of the "Registration urgent degree" element.

question_43592.question: What does LDM server do in the Intersection Safety Information System and how does it generate LDM information?
question_43592.ground_truth: The LDM server in the Intersection Safety Information System monitors road conditions using road radars and traffic signals. It then generates LDM information based on this data and delivers it to user equipment (UE) through RSU (Road-Side Units) or broadcasting.

question_43593.question: What is the minimum SINR required for 256QAM to achieve a higher spectrum efficiency than 64QAM in AWGN channels?

question_43594.question: What is the purpose of the Multimedia Messaging Web Service aspects of the interface in Part 5 of the OSA specifications?
question_43594.ground_truth: The Multimedia Messaging Web Service aspects of the interface in Part 5 of the OSA specifications specify the multimedia messaging functionality provided by the network, including data definitions, interface specification, and fault definitions.

question_43597.question: What message does the LMF send to the serving gNB of the target UE to request UL-SRS activation?
question_43597.ground_truth: The LMF sends the NRPPa Positioning Activation Request message to the serving gNB of the target UE to request UL-SRS activation for the target UE.

question_43598.question: If a network cannot accept the attach request for initiating a PDN connection for emergency bearer services with attach type not set to "emergency attach", what should a MS do to attempt GPRS attach for emergency bearer services?
question_43598.ground_truth: The MS should inform the upper layers of the failure of the procedure or attempt GPRS attach for emergency bearer services if access is granted or because of a cell change.

question_43599.question: What is the precondition for the Modification of ad-hoc group call criteria by an authorized user?
question_43599.ground_truth: The MCPTT user at the MCPTT client 1 needs to be authorized to modify the criteria and both the MCPTT server and the MCPTT client 1 should be aware of the criteria related to the ongoing ad-hoc group call.

question_43600.question: What is the objective of the initial conditions of the test procedure?
question_43600.ground_truth: The objective of the initial conditions of the test procedure is to set up the test environment for the UE, including the frequencies to be tested, the use of two cells on the same frequency, and the reporting of event 1A and event 1B.

question_43601.question: What should the SMF do if NG-RAN decides to trigger EPS or inter-RAT fallback?
question_43601.ground_truth: The SMF should release resources in the non-3GPP AN as specified in specific clauses.

question_43602.question: What is the Initial conditions for the Method of test in 7.1.7.4.1?
question_43602.ground_truth: The initial conditions for the Method of test in 7.1.7.4.1 include using a radio communications tester or a corresponding device as a NB/BS simulator, setting up calls to the DUT, sending test signals to the UE, measuring the BER levels of the radio link and the information on the dedicated channel to extract the DUT receiver performances. The chamber environment constraints and coordinate system, Phantom Specifications and Test environment are also specified in this section.

question_43603.question: What is the role of the IP-SM-GW in this process?
question_43603.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW is responsible for performing service-level interworking by converting Instant Messages to Short Messages and delivering them to the UE. It also obtains routing information for the UE from the HLR/HSS.

question_43604.question: What is used for broadcast of assistance data for E-OTD and A-GNSS?
question_43604.ground_truth: The CS mechanism (Cell Broadcast on CBCH) is used for broadcast of assistance data for all MSs, irrespective of which domain (CS or PS) they are located in.

question_43607.question: Which entity is responsible for generating PCC rules (for QoS control on Uu) and the PC5 QoS parameters (for QoS control on PC5)?
question_43607.ground_truth: The Policy Control Function (PCF) is responsible for generating PCC rules (for QoS control on Uu) and the PC5 QoS parameters (for QoS control on PC5).

question_43608.question: In the context of cloud robotics, what kind of tasks can robots offload to the cloud?
question_43608.ground_truth: Robots can offload compute-intensive tasks like image processing, voice recognition, and even download new skills via the cloud.

question_43609.question: What information should the VAE-C include in the HTTP 200(OK) response message if the PC5 provisioning status request is successful?
question_43609.ground_truth: If the PC5 provisioning status request is successful, the VAE-C should include a <result> element set to the value "success", a <PC5-policy-status-report> element corresponding to the PC5 policy status request, and send the HTTP 200(OK) response towards the VAE-S.

question_43610.question: What is one possible way to send short messages to machines using SIP?
question_43610.ground_truth: The message payload can be sent directly in a SIP message if it is short enough.

question_43611.question: What mechanism should the SEAL layer provide to support the monitoring of UAV location?
question_43611.ground_truth: The SEAL layer should provide a mechanism to support the monitoring of UAV location as per requirement AR-4.5.2-a.

question_43612.question: What is the value of the burst parameter X and replenishment parameter Y for network flow control in Service 3 (UUS3)?
question_43612.ground_truth: The value of the burst parameter X is 16, while the value of the replenishment parameter Y is 8.

question_43614.question: What is the approach taken when the input vector is an all zero vector or the sub-vector gain is very low?
question_43614.ground_truth: A valid PVQ-vector is deterministically created by assigning half of the unit pulses to the first position, and the remaining unit pulses to the last position.

question_43615.question: How many code words are transmitted in each slot?
question_43615.ground_truth: Only one code word is transmitted in each slot

question_43616.question: What is the meaning of the IP type value "0" in the 3GPP-Allocate-IP-Type sub-attribute?
question_43616.ground_truth: The IP type value "0" means that the P-GW/GGSN does not allocate IPv4 address or IPv6 prefix, and it is typically used for PDN/PDP type IPv4v6 and deferred IPv4 addressing, with the IPv4 address allocated by the AAA server and IPv6 prefix allocated by some other means.

question_43617.question: What message does the MS send to the SS to confirm the handover and activate the channels in sending and receiving mode?
question_43617.ground_truth: When the MS receives a PACKET PHYSICAL INFORMATION message, it stops timer T3216, stops sending access bursts and activates the channels in sending and receiving mode.

question_43618.question: What information does the PCF provide to the TSCTSF for device side ports when integration with IETF Deterministic Networking applies?
question_43618.ground_truth: The PCF provides the user-plane node ID, port number, IP address or IPv6 prefix allocated to the PDU Session, and MTU size for IPv4 or IPv6 (optional) to the TSCTSF for device side ports.

question_43621.question: When must the UE include a SUCI in a NAS message?
question_43621.ground_truth: The UE must include a SUCI in the following NAS messages: Registration Request message, Identity Response message, and De-Registration Request message.

question_43622.question: What HTTP method should the NF service consumer use to send a request for updating a record?
question_43622.ground_truth: The NF service consumer should use a PUT request to send a request for updating a record.

question_43625.question: What is the difference between quantization-non-aware training and quantization-aware training in the CSI compression use case?
question_43625.ground_truth: Quantization-non-aware training involves passing float-format variables directly from the CSI generation part to the CSI reconstruction part during training, while quantization-aware training involves quantization/dequantization being involved in the training process.

question_43626.question: What is the requirement for UE measurement capability for NR CA and MR-DC measurement purposes in idle mode cell re-selection?
question_43626.ground_truth: For idle mode cell re-selection purposes, and for UE supporting IdleInactiveMeasurements-r16 or idleInactiveEUTRA-MeasReport-r16, for NR CA and MR-DC measurement purpose, the UE shall be capable of monitoring at least: Intra-frequency carrier, 7 NR inter-frequency carriers, 7 FDD E-UTRA inter-RAT carriers, and 7 TDD E-UTRA inter-RAT carriers. In addition, a UE supporting E-UTRA measurements in RRC_IDLE state shall be capable of monitoring a total of at least 14 carrier frequency layers, which includes serving layer, comprising of any above defined combination of E-UTRA FDD, E-UTRA TDD and NR layers.

question_43629.question: What are the two alternatives for AI/ML model input in the BM-Case2 sub-use case for beam management?
question_43629.ground_truth: The two alternatives for AI/ML model input in the BM-Case2 sub-use case are L1-RSRP measurement based on Set B or L1-RSRP measurement based on Set B and the corresponding DL Tx and/or Rx beam ID.

question_43631.question: What steps are taken to retrieve user plane congestion status for a specific UE location?
question_43631.ground_truth: Steps include sending a request to the NWDAF, checking the UE location by retrieving the AMF serving the UE, and interrogating the AMF about the UE location. If necessary, the NWDAF requests the user plane congestion status for the UE location to OAM.

question_43633.question: What is the initial condition for the OTA sensitivity test procedure?
question_43633.ground_truth: The initial condition for the OTA sensitivity test procedure is that the AAS BS is placed in the same place as the calibrated point in the test system and the manufacturer declared coordinate system orientation of the AAS BS is aligned with the test system.

question_43634.question: How long can the SS wait for the final CP-ACK before transmitting the CM SERVICE ACCEPT in a Rel-4 or later MS?
question_43634.ground_truth: The SS waits for the UE to transmit the final CP-ACK for a maximum of 5 seconds before transmitting the CM SERVICE ACCEPT in a Rel-4 or later MS.

question_43636.question: What should the UE do if the mobility from E-UTRA fails?
question_43636.ground_truth: The UE should stop T304, if running, indicate to upper layers that the CS fallback procedure has failed, and initiate the connection re-establishment procedure.

question_43637.question: What is the structure of the RIMS value in the Authentication Parameter RIMS information element?
question_43637.ground_truth: The RIMS value consists of 64 bits, with bit 8 of octet 2 being the most significant bit and bit 1 of octet 9 being the least significant bit.

question_43638.question: What does the SCC AS do when performing the Access Transfer for the held session, if there are more than two sessions with speech media?
question_43638.ground_truth: The SCC AS selects the second-most recently active session to put on hold, or otherwise selects the held session that has been most recently made inactive.

question_43639.question: What is an objective for the 360 experiences for Alex and his friends in section 5.6?
question_43639.ground_truth: They want to communicate verbally as if they are sitting next to each other, with spatial audio cues, while watching a live football match.

question_43640.question: What is the role of the Radio Side Unit (RSU) in the vehicle diagnostic and repair notification service?
question_43640.ground_truth: The RSU serves as the transmission medium to collect and transmit data from the vehicle to the repair center when the vehicle passes an RSU.

question_43643.question: What indication does the MAP-PREPARE-HANDOVER response contain in clause 8.1.1 when the subsequent Handover Number allocation procedure is not invoked until the completion of the basic UMTS to GSM handover procedure?

question_43644.question: What is the length of the PLMN ID part of the ProSe Discovery UE ID?
question_43644.ground_truth: The PLMN ID part of the ProSe Discovery UE ID is 32 bits in length.

question_43646.question: What happens if multiple rules are defined in the Management Object for QoE metric reporting?
question_43646.ground_truth: In case multiple rules are defined in the Management Object, the MTSI client should only report metrics when all individual rules evaluate to true.

question_43647.question: How long does the UE have to wait before it can turn off its transmitter power after the expiry of the T310 timer in non-DRX mode?
question_43647.ground_truth: The UE has to wait for 40 ms before turning off its transmitter power after the expiry of the T310 timer in non-DRX mode.

question_43648.question: How should the UE handle the EMM parameters when receiving 5GMM cause #79 via 3GPP access in single-registration mode?
question_43648.ground_truth: The UE sets the EPS update status to EU2 NOT UPDATED, resets the tracking area updating attempt counter, enters the state EMM-REGISTERED, and may re-attempt the registration procedure for services other than UAS services.

question_43649.question: What is the condition for an MCPTT emergency group call request to be considered an authorized request for an MCPTT emergency group call?
question_43649.ground_truth: The IWF considers the MCPTT emergency group call request to be an authorized request for an MCPTT emergency group call if it determines that the calling user is authorized for emergency-group-call, and emergency-group-calls for the selected group are allowed.

question_43650.question: What HTTP method should the NF Service Consumer use to invoke the "transfer-update" custom operation on the URI of an "Individual ueContext" resource?
question_43650.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should use the HTTP method POST to invoke the "transfer-update" custom operation on the URI of an "Individual ueContext" resource.

question_43652.question: What is one of the potential new requirements needed to support Ambient IoT devices with limited energy storage capability?
question_43652.ground_truth: Energy efficient communication mechanisms to minimize device communication power consumption

question_43653.question: What is the CSI-RS measurement behavior for FR1 when the SSB for RLM is within the active BWP and has the same SCS as CSI-RS for RLM?
question_43653.ground_truth: If the SSB for RLM is within the active BWP and has the same SCS as CSI-RS for RLM in FR1, the UE shall be able to perform the CSI-RS measurement without restrictions.

question_43655.question: What information does the Envelope-Start-Time AVP hold?
question_43655.ground_truth: The Envelope-Start-Time AVP holds the time of the packet of user data which caused the time envelope to start.

question_43656.question: What is the purpose of using EDT (Emergency Dowlink Transmission) in the on-roaming UE procedure?
question_43656.ground_truth: The purpose of using EDT in the on-roaming UE procedure is to report the occurrence of trigger events and provide associated location information, which can minimize the duration of the signalling connection.

question_43657.question: What is the purpose of the PC5 unicast link security establishment, as defined in clause 5.3 of TS 33.536 in the procedure for UE-to-UE communication?
question_43657.ground_truth: The PC5 unicast link security is established between the UEs and the UE-to-UE Relay to protect the communication between them.

question_43658.question: What is one potential benefit of using the T5 small data service?
question_43658.ground_truth: The T5 small data service offers improved efficiency for multiple different usages, such as for device triggering or any infrequent small data application.

question_43659.question: What is the purpose of the SCEF-Reference-ID-Ext AVP when the "Extended Reference IDs" feature is supported?
question_43659.ground_truth: When the "Extended Reference IDs" feature is supported, the SCEF-Reference-ID-Ext AVP is used instead of SCEF-Reference-ID, and the SCEF-Reference-ID AVP is required in the grouped AVP by the sender. However, its content is discarded by the receiver.

question_43661.question: What is the difference between Method 2 and Method 2b in BMCA procedure?
question_43661.ground_truth: Method 2b is an optional optimization for Method 2. It filters the Announce messages in the ingress port based on the priority vector. A TSN node with multiple ports, the status of each port and priority vector need to be aggregated to make a centralized decision on the TSN node level.

question_43662.question: What must the UE (MCPTT Client) do when it receives a Disconnect message, if the first bit in the subtype of the Disconnect message is set to '1' (acknowledgement is required)?
question_43662.ground_truth: The UE (MCPTT Client) sends the Acknowledgement message with the Reason Code set to 'Accepted' and remains in 'U: Pre-established session not in use' state.

question_43663.question: What is the function of the UE Radio Capability ID for use in the selected PLMN, in the RRC connection establishment signalling associated with the TAU Request?
question_43663.ground_truth: The UE Radio Capability ID for use in the selected PLMN is used to indicate the UE's support of the CIoT EPS Optimisations relevant for MME selection, and to provide the UE Radio Capability ID of the newly selected PLMN in the UE context to the eNodeB.

question_43664.question: With proactive transcoding in the alternative 1 OMR procedure, what should the IMS-ALG do if the terminating side selects one of the original Codecs and no transcoding is needed?
question_43664.ground_truth: If no transcoding is needed, the IMS-ALG should forward any OMR SDP extension attributes to allow full OMR to occur, so that the media path can be correctly established with OMR in one SDP offer/answer transaction.

question_43665.question: What is the role of the operator and the third party in supplying the list of PFDs?
question_43665.ground_truth: The operator stores the Application Identifier and the list of PFDs in the Sponsoring context Repository, while the third party updates the list of flows it is ready to sponsor based on its business needs.

question_43666.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon expiry of timer TFG2 in the "S3: part of ongoing call" state?
question_43666.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should release the current call and return to the "Idle" state.

question_43667.question: What is the recommended approach, from the signaling point of view, for specifying two TX/RX carrier spacings for a single band?
question_43667.ground_truth: The recommended approach is to specify two TX/RX carrier spacings for a single band, rather than multiple band plans with fixed duplexing schemes.

question_43668.question: What type of value is allocated to the UE in GERAN/UTRAN for the Active Time value, the extended periodic RAU value, and the GPRS READY timer value?
question_43668.ground_truth: One byte in an 8 bit format.

question_43669.question: What is the difference between T3313 and T3315 in Iu mode?
question_43669.ground_truth: T3315 is set to a value smaller than T3-RESPONSE, while T3313 has no such restriction.

question_43670.question: What is the term for a set of transport blocks that are exchanged between L1 and MAC at the same time instance using the same transport channel?

question_43671.question: How is forking controlled in the webRTC architecture?
question_43671.ground_truth: Forking control in the webRTC architecture is achieved by deploying the caller preference feature, as defined in RFC 3841, with the parameters "explicit" and "require" to ensure that a WIC is only contacted at the eP-CSCF where the WIC is actually registered. The eP-CSCF feature tag is included in the contact information when the eP-CSCF registers the wIMPU with the IMS core.

question_43674.question: What are the components affected by the implementation of this solution?
question_43674.ground_truth: UE, RAN, and Core Network are affected by the implementation of this solution.

question_43675.question: In the provided format for MobilityRestrictionList, what does 'EquivalentPLMNs' indicate?
question_43675.ground_truth: EquivalentPLMNs indicate a list of equivalent PLMNs in which roaming can be allowed when it is in the MICO Mode.

question_43676.question: What is the role of the relay UE in the SIB forwarding mechanism for NR PC5 relay?
question_43676.ground_truth: The relay UE forwards the necessary SIB and paging information to remote UE upon acquisition from the network, based on the request and detailed parameter from remote UE.

question_43679.question: What procedure occurs if an application request data connectivity and the corresponding S-NSSAI is not in the Allowed NSSAI?
question_43679.ground_truth: The UE first sends a request to register with the S-NSSAI before processing further RSDs or before the UE concludes that the RSD is invalid.

question_43680.question: What is the general requirement in section 6.8 regarding the inhibition of the generation of intermodulation signals in the non-linear elements of a repeater caused by the presence of the wanted signal and an interfering signal reaching the repeater via the output port?
question_43680.ground_truth: The output intermodulation requirement is a measure of the capability of the repeater to inhibit the generation of signals in its non-linear elements caused by the presence of the wanted signal and an interfering signal reaching the repeater via the output port. The requirement shall apply during the transmitter ON state and the transmitter transient period. The output intermodulation level is the power of the intermodulation products when an interfering signal is injected into the antenna connector.

question_43681.question: What is the role of the 3GPP IRP IS modelling repertoire in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_43681.ground_truth: The 3GPP IRP IS modelling repertoire is a set of UML notations and model elements used in the 3GPP Technical Specification to capture the behavior of the systems in the IRP IS context. It documents the necessary and sufficient set of UML notations and model elements for use by 3GPP IRP IS authors.

question_43682.question: In the 'O: has no permission' state, what action does the floor participant take if it receives an indication from the MCPTT user that they want to send media?
question_43682.ground_truth: The floor participant sends a Floor Request message to other clients.

question_43683.question: What information does a P'-Trace include that is not in a P-Trace?
question_43683.ground_truth: A P'-Trace includes losses and delays observed due to the delivery over a network, while a P-Trace does not.

question_43686.question: What is the purpose of the generic capability filtering mechanism at the VAE server and the VAE client in Solution #22?
question_43686.ground_truth: The purpose is to provide a capability filtering mechanism at the VAE server and the VAE client, enabling interoperability between V2X application clients and V2X application services supporting multiple capabilities.

question_43687.question: What is an Application Data Model View in the context of 3GPP telecommunication applications?
question_43687.ground_truth: An Application Data Model View is a specific implementation and protocol-dependent view of the Specialized Information Model for a given application. It includes implementation details and specific data required by the application.

question_43688.question: What type of authentication can be used between an SCP and a network function when there is co-location between them?
question_43688.ground_truth: Authentication between the SCP and network function can be implicit due to co-location.

question_43689.question: What should a PIN Element have in terms of management capabilities?
question_43689.ground_truth: A PIN Element should have at least one PIN Element with Management Capabilities.

question_43690.question: What entity maps the priority from the PDCP header to the GTP-U extension header in uplink packets?

question_43691.question: What is the purpose of including the "move together" information in various messages during handover?
question_43691.ground_truth: The "move together" information is used to differentiate the case that UE handover due to moving together with the MBSR from the case that UE handover to leave the MBSR.

question_43694.question: What are the appropriate values for the "g-3gpp-ps-data-off" media feature tag in 3GPP IP multimedia call control protocol based on Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) and Session Description Protocol (SDP)?
question_43694.ground_truth: The appropriate values for the "g-3gpp-ps-data-off" media feature tag are "active", "inactive", and a token.

question_43698.question: What is the time period during which the SS waits for random access requests information from the UE to perform cell re-selection on Cell 2 in step 3 of the test described in 6.1.2.3?
question_43698.ground_truth: The time period during which the SS waits for random access requests information from the UE to perform cell re-selection on Cell 2 in step 3 of the test described in 6.1.2.3 is the duration of T1.

question_43699.question: What does the MSC/VLR do upon reception of the SGsAP Alert Request (IMSI) message from the MME?
question_43699.ground_truth: The MSC/VLR sends a UE Activity Indication (IMSI) message towards the MME if the activity detected by the MME does not lead to any procedure towards the MSC/VLR.

question_43701.question: What is the time required to search the target cell if the target cell is unknown and signal quality is sufficient for successful cell detection on the first attempt?
question_43701.ground_truth: If the target cell is unknown and signal quality is sufficient for successful cell detection on the first attempt, then Tsearch = 80 ms.

question_43702.question: What should the Node B do when the HS-DSCH Information IE is present in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message?
question_43702.ground_truth: The Node B shall setup the requested HS-PDSCH resources on the Serving HS-DSCH Radio Link indicated by the HS-PDSCH RL ID IE and include the HARQ Memory Partitioning IE in the HS-DSCH Information Response IE in the RADIO LINK SETUP RESPONSE message.

question_43703.question: When is the "StartSourcePortNumber" leaf present in the IP flow description?
question_43703.ground_truth: The "StartSourcePortNumber" leaf is present in the IP flow description when the flow distribution rule matches the port numbers contained in the range between StartSourcePortNumber and EndSourcePortNumber against destination port field of the uplink traffic packets.

question_43704.question: How do idle mode UEs receive ETWS information in the ETWS system?
question_43704.ground_truth: For idle mode UEs, the ETWS warning information is broadcast within the cell. The UE follows its normal DRX scheme and is commanded to receive the ETWS information when it wakes up for its paging occasion and ETWS information is being sent. The ETWS information is made available to the GERAN/UTRAN/E-UTRAN using the CBS infrastructure and mechanisms.

question_43706.question: How does the responding 5G ProSe End UE select a new 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay?
question_43706.ground_truth: The responding 5G ProSe End UE selects a new 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay from the candidate UEs based on the Relay re-selection indication in the Link Modification Request message.

question_43707.question: What is the purpose of ProSe direct discovery and EPC-level ProSe discovery in Proximity-based Services (ProSe)?
question_43707.ground_truth: ProSe direct discovery and EPC-level ProSe discovery are functions in Proximity-based Services (ProSe) that enable two ProSe-enabled UEs to discover each other and communicate directly. These functions are applicable for both Public Safety UE and non-Public Safety UE.

question_43708.question: In what scenario does Rel-17 of the ATSSS work support the establishment of user-plane resources over a 3GPP access connected to EPC?
question_43708.ground_truth: In Rel-17, a MA PDU Session established over the 5G core network can simultaneously send traffic over a 3GPP access connected to EPC and over a non-3GPP access connected to 5GC.

question_43710.question: What is the difference between the Bad Frame Indication (BFI) flag and the Unreliable Frame Indication (UFI) flag in the RSS?
question_43710.ground_truth: The Bad Frame Indication (BFI) flag is used by the RSS to indicate lost speech or SID frames, while the Unreliable Frame Indication (UFI) flag is used to indicate unreliably decoded speech or SID frames.

question_43711.question: What is the difference between the access burst (AB) and the extended access burst (Extended AB)?
question_43711.ground_truth: The access burst (AB) is used for random access and is characterized by a longer guard period to cater to burst transmission from a mobile that does not know the timing advance. In contrast, the extended access burst (Extended AB) is used for random access with the Multilateration Timing Advance method and contains 30 information bits.

question_43712.question: How does the IOPS MC system communicate with the common services core during a backhaul failure?
question_43712.ground_truth: In the event of a backhaul failure, the IOPS MC system uses the common services core in the IOPS MC system instead of the common services core in the primary MC system. The common services core in the IOPS MC system must be kept in sync with the primary MC system's common service core.

question_43714.question: What is the requirement for the PRBSequence used in this test?
question_43714.ground_truth: The PRBSequence must be at least 6438 * 10 bits long.

question_43715.question: What is the definition of "SMP" in the context of the 3GPP technical report?
question_43715.ground_truth: SMP stands for Personal Mobile Service.

question_43717.question: What is the state of the calls when the MS sends a FACILITY message containing an invoke component set to BuildMPTY?
question_43717.ground_truth: Both calls shall enter auxiliary state "MPTY request".

question_43722.question: What is the procedure for sending non-IP data between a CIoT device and an Application Server using UDP/IP encapsulation?
question_43722.ground_truth: The UE sends non-IP data to the C-SGN/MME/SGW over the bearer, which in turn forwards the data to the Application Server encapsulated in UDP/IP. For downlink non-IP traffic, the Application Server sends non-IP data for the UE encapsulated in UDP/IP to the P-GW or C-SGN. The P-GW or C-SGN removes the UDP/IP header and forwards the downlink non-IP traffic to the UE using the UE's non-IP bearer.

question_43724.question: What should the VAE-S include in the HTTP 200 (OK) response message to the VAE-C after updating group information?
question_43724.ground_truth: The VAE-S should include a Content-Type header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.vae-info+xml" and an application/vnd.3gpp.vae-info+xml MIME body with a <dynamic-group-update-info> element in the <VAE-info> root element, which includes the result and suggestion (if any) of the dynamic group information update request.

question_43725.question: What should be the RF reference frequency of the NR carrier and the carrier frequency of the LTE when the LTE carrier is located at subcarrier index 7 within a NR RB in the downlink direction when the NR subcarrier spacing is 15kHz?
question_43725.ground_truth: The RF reference frequency of the NR carrier should be 120 * K1 (KHz) and the carrier frequency of the LTE should be 300 * K2 + 300 (KHz) where K1 and K2 are integers.

question_43726.question: What is the meaning of the "b=AS:75" line in the SIP message?
question_43726.ground_truth: The "b=AS:75" line in the SIP message indicates that the maximum bitrate for the audio component is 75 kbps.

question_43727.question: How is the address of the EDNCS of the serving PLMN derived?
question_43727.ground_truth: The EDNCS address is derived by taking the first 5 or 6 digits of the MCC and MNC and creating the "mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.3gppnetwork.org" domain name.

question_43728.question: What is the purpose of scrambling the RI bits in a way that maximizes the Euclidean distance of the modulation symbols carrying rank information?
question_43728.ground_truth: The purpose is to reduce the correlation between the modulation symbols carrying rank information.

question_43729.question: What are the two categories of spurious emissions defined in ITU-R Recommendation SM.329 for testing a base station?
question_43729.ground_truth: The two categories of spurious emissions defined in ITU-R Recommendation SM.329 for testing a base station are Category A and Category B.

question_43732.question: What section of 3GPP TS 45.005 is referenced as the procedure for frequency error and modulation accuracy measurements for one transmitted burst?
question_43732.ground_truth: The procedure for frequency error and modulation accuracy measurements for one transmitted burst is outlined in 13.17.1a.4.2, and the detailed steps for this procedure are described in this section.

question_43733.question: What happens to an emergency registered UE after the emergency session has ended?
question_43733.ground_truth: After the emergency session has ended, the UE may explicitly deregister and register to normal services without waiting for the emergency PDU session deactivation by the SMF.

question_43734.question: What is the potential consequence of insecure data storage in GNP?
question_43734.ground_truth: An attacker can retrieve sensitive data if it has been stored in an insecure way.

question_43735.question: In what scenario can the AF (Application Function) influence traffic routing?
question_43735.ground_truth: The AF can influence traffic routing in the case of Home Routed deployments with Session Breakout, where Traffic Influence policies are provided directly from V-NEF to V-SMF, bypassing the PCF.

question_43740.question: What is the role of the CDF in SMS transactions for SMS offline charging and online charging scenarios?
question_43740.ground_truth: The CDF receives Charging Data Request messages from the SMS Node in SMS offline charging scenarios, and creates CDRs and acknowledges the reception of data. In SMS online charging scenarios, the CDF may apply a different charging model for Termination scenarios, where the recipient UE is charged for the delivered SM instead of the originator or both parties.

question_43741.question: What should an N5CW device supporting 3GPP access refrain from allocating as PDU session identity value when establishing a new PDN connection in S1 mode?

question_43744.question: What is the difference between the service manager and the network in terms of notification provisioning?
question_43744.ground_truth: The service manager is used for provisioning notifications set using createNotification() while the network is used for provisioning notifications that are NOT set using createNotification() but via, for instance, a network management system.

question_43745.question: What is the CLTA used for in OTA testing?
question_43745.ground_truth: The CLTA is a practical passive antenna used for conformance testing of the co-location requirements based on the definition of the co-location reference antenna, and it is a passive antenna that can be used for testing base stations implemented with a planar antenna array.

question_43746.question: How are supplementary services applied to individual IMS services?
question_43746.ground_truth: Supplementary services apply to individual IMS services, and users may handle them differently depending on their settings and preferences. A single supplementary service, when applied to two different IMS services, may not only have different user-settings but even different service behavior.

question_43747.question: What should an AS do when it acts as a SIP proxy and forks the request?
question_43747.ground_truth: The AS should not fork the request if the fork-directive in the Request-Disposition header field is set to "no-fork".

question_43749.question: What is the condition for a successful test in section 4.5.1.4.4.2?
question_43749.ground_truth: The condition for a successful test is if the SS detects uplink power equal to or higher than the minimum output power in the On-duration part of every DRX cycle during the period specified in the test.

question_43750.question: What is the OTA ACLR absolute limit for Category A AAS BS of Medium Range BS class and Local Area BS class?
question_43750.ground_truth: For Category A, Medium Range BS class, the OTA ACLR absolute limit is -19 dBm/MHz, while for Local Area BS class, the limit is -26 dBm/MHz.

question_43751.question: What is the requirement for the initial output power for intra-band contiguous CA, as defined in absolute power control tolerance per component carrier in 6.3A.4.1.1.1?
question_43751.ground_truth: The UE must be able to set its initial output power to a specific value for the first sub-frame at the start of a contiguous transmission or non-contiguous transmission with a transmission gap on each active component carrier larger than 20ms.

question_43752.question: What is the parameter V(R) used for in the 3GPP TS 44.060 standard?
question_43752.ground_truth: V(R) is used in the calculation of the Block Start Indicator (BSN) for the Mobile Station (MS) in the 3GPP TS 44.060 standard.

question_43754.question: What is the unwanted CW interfering signal band blocking defined for an LTE based 5G terrestrial broadcast?
question_43754.ground_truth: Out-of-band band blocking is defined for an unwanted CW interfering signal falling more than 15 MHz below or above the UE receive band. For the first 15 MHz below or above the UE receive band, the appropriate in-band blocking or adjacent channel selectivity shall be applied.

question_43757.question: What indicators should the MS include in its response to the network for a USSD request?
question_43757.ground_truth: The alphabet indicator should indicate "SMS default alphabet" and the language indicator should indicate "language unspecified".

question_43758.question: What is the purpose of the NRM client sending the MBS listening status report?
question_43758.ground_truth: The NRM client sends the MBS listening status report to indicate the broadcast reception quality associated with the MBS session ID and to inform the NRM server if the media can be received with sufficient quality over the broadcast MBS session.

question_43760.question: How is the average percentage of uplink symbols calculated?
question_43760.ground_truth: The average percentage of uplink symbols is calculated as 0.5*(DutyNR,x/maxDutyNR,x + DutyNR,y/maxDutyNR,y) where DutyNR,x and DutyNR,y represent the actual percentage of uplink symbols transmitted in the same evaluation period for NR Band x and NR Band y respectively, and maxDutyNR,x and maxDutyNR,y represent the field of UE capability 0.5xmaxUplinkDutyCycle-PC2-FR1 or maxUplinkDutyCycle-PC1dot5-MPE-FR1 per band as defined in TS 38.331.

question_43762.question: What is the state of the MCVideo client emergency group after an MCVideo emergency group call is granted?
question_43762.ground_truth: The MCVideo client emergency group state is set to "MVEG 2: in-progress".

question_43763.question: What are the two strata of NGN architecture?
question_43763.ground_truth: The two strata of NGN architecture are the Transport stratum and the Service stratum, which are decoupled to better support the complexity of NGN.

question_43764.question: What should an EES do if the EEC registration request fails after the EEC Context Pull relocation?
question_43764.ground_truth: The EES shall determine the EEC Context information stale and send a failure response with a corresponding cause.

question_43765.question: What information is included in the usage information report for ProSe Groupcast mode of Direct Communication?
question_43765.ground_truth: The usage information report for ProSe Groupcast mode of Direct Communication includes information about the Group Parameters, timestamps of the first transmission/reception, amount of data transmitted and received (with location information), list of locations of the UE when in NR coverage, and list of timestamps of when UE goes in/out of NR coverage.

question_43766.question: In what scenarios can the call set up request procedure be triggered to initiate contact with the CSE?
question_43766.ground_truth: The call set up request procedure can be triggered if the call set up request occurs, the call set up request procedure is passed, and the PLMN is provisioned with network based service information.

question_43768.question: What is the impact of chip zeroing on the cross-correlation properties of synchronization codes and PSCs in CZ-UMTS?
question_43768.ground_truth: The cross-correlation properties of synchronization codes and PSCs are still maintained with chip zeroing in CZ-UMTS. The peak of the auto-correlation of synchronization codes is reduced with chip zeroing. The cross-correlation of a pair of secondary synchronization codes is also similar with chip zeroing in CZ-UMTS.

question_43769.question: What should the MAC entity do upon receiving a fallbackRAR during the Random Access procedure?
question_43769.ground_truth: Upon receiving a fallbackRAR, the MAC entity may stop msgB-ResponseWindow once the Random Access Response reception is considered as successful.

question_43770.question: What is the frequency separation for a single-band BS with separate antenna connector for measurement if the adjacent connector is not being tested?
question_43770.ground_truth: The frequency separation for a single-band BS with separate antenna connector for measurement is the highest assigned channel frequency of the transmitted signal.

question_43771.question: What is the potential impact of Solution #5.6 and the possible extension of Solution #5.1 on the current TS32.290 standard?
question_43771.ground_truth: Solution #5.6 with the possible extension of #5.1 solution could be taken into normative work based requirements for key issues #5a, #5b, and #5c in TS32.290.

question_43772.question: What is the purpose of the initial AS security activation procedure in 5G NR?
question_43772.ground_truth: The purpose of the initial AS security activation procedure is to activate AS security upon RRC connection establishment.

question_43773.question: When is the periodic RA update procedure started regardless of whether the MS is IMSI-attached or not, and regardless of the network operation mode?
question_43773.ground_truth: When the MS returns to GERAN/UTRAN PS coverage

question_43776.question: What is the minimum output power allowed for a Relay backhaul link with one antenna connector?
question_43776.ground_truth: The minimum output power for a Relay backhaul link with one antenna connector should not exceed -50dBm.

question_43778.question: Which 3GPP Work Area includes the "IRP Solution Set Specification Organisation Improvements (OAM-IRP-SS)" work item?
question_43778.ground_truth: Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects (TSG SA)

question_43779.question: What are the KPIs that the 5G system should address for the use of Ambient IoT devices on smart pig farms?
question_43779.ground_truth: The 5G system should address KPIs related to smart manhole cover safety monitoring using Ambient IoT.

question_43782.question: What is the minimum number of samples required for limit checking before a pass/fail decision can be made in the test?
question_43782.ground_truth: The minimum number of samples required for limit checking before a pass/fail decision can be made in the test is 990 wavelengths, based on the multipath and interference conditions in the test.

question_43783.question: What are the conditions that need to be satisfied for the first envelope to be adjusted by equation (1652)?
question_43783.ground_truth: The first envelope is adjusted by equation (1652) if the conditions: , , , , and are all satisfied.

question_43784.question: What types of NR UE does the test apply to, starting from release 15?
question_43784.ground_truth: The test applies to all types of NR UE release 15 and forward supporting SA FR2 and 2DL CA.

question_43786.question: Which system information combination is replaced in test case 8.1.6.1.3.2.3.2?

question_43787.question: What is the delay uncertainty for the measurement reporting on the DCCH, excluding the delay caused by inserting the measurement report into the TTI of the uplink DCCH?
question_43787.ground_truth: The delay uncertainty is: 2 x TTIDCCH, where TTIDCCH is the duration of subframe or slot or subslot when the measurement report is transmitted on the PUSCH with subframe or slot or subslot duration.

question_43788.question: What can cause a "ServiceException" fault with the error code "SVC0280" in the "sendSms" operation?
question_43788.ground_truth: The error code "SVC0280" in the "sendSms" operation indicates that the message is too long. This "ServiceException" fault can occur when the message is longer than the maximum supported length, causing the message content to be sent as several concatenated short messages.

question_43791.question: How long is the data field of burst type 1, measured in chips?
question_43791.ground_truth: The data fields of burst type 1 are 2070 chips long.

question_43793.question: Which information element contains a list of CA band combinations?
question_43793.ground_truth: BandCombinationList information element contains a list of CA band combinations.

question_43794.question: What should the BGCF do when it receives a subsequent request whose initial request applied loopback routeing?
question_43794.ground_truth: The BGCF should remove the "orig-ioi" header field parameter received in the P-Charging-Vector header field, if present and insert a type 1 "orig-ioi" header field parameter into the P-Charging-Vector header field and set it to the value that identifies the home network of the served user. The BGCF should not include the "term-ioi" header field parameter.

question_43795.question: What is the purpose of the NSAG information in the 5GMM registration procedure?
question_43795.ground_truth: The NSAG information is used to indicate the network slice support for a particular location, and up to 4 NSAG entries can be associated with a TAI list in the NSAG information IE.

question_43796.question: In what situations is paging on a non-anchor NES cell without SIB or a non-anchor NES cell without SSB and SIB not supported?
question_43796.ground_truth: Paging on a non-anchor NES cell without SIB or a non-anchor NES cell without SSB and SIB is not supported in any scenario.

question_43797.question: What is the maximum end-to-end latency required for high/full automated platooning use case?

question_43798.question: What does the abbreviation "3GPP" in the document title stand for?

question_43800.question: What message is sent from the MS to the GANC in GERAN A/Gb mode to GAN mode PS handover to provide a list of target UTRAN cells for PS handover?
question_43800.ground_truth: The GA-PSR HANDOVER INFORMATION message is sent from the MS to the GANC in GERAN A/Gb mode to GAN mode PS handover to provide a list of target UTRAN cells for PS handover.

question_43801.question: What information should be included in the "application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME" body of a SIP MESSAGE request?
question_43801.ground_truth: The "application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME" body of a SIP MESSAGE request should contain the MCVideo client ID, and may include functional aliases or user-requested priority.

question_43804.question: What is the purpose of the Non-3GPP path switching information information element?
question_43804.ground_truth: The Non-3GPP path switching information information element is used to request from the network to keep using the user plane resources of the old non-3GPP access during path switching to the new non-3GPP access.

question_43805.question: What should the ICS UE do when it receives a SIP reINVITE request requesting the media over the CS bearer to be deleted?
question_43805.ground_truth: If the ICS UE has a SIP REGISTER request associated with the ongoing CS call, the UE should send a SIP reINVITE request requesting the media over the CS bearer to be deleted. If a DISCONNECT message for the CS bearer was already received, the ICS UE should accept the request to delete the media over the CS bearer.

question_43806.question: What is the Doppler shift when an airplane moves north from the equator?
question_43806.ground_truth: The Doppler shift plotted as a function of the latitude, with a maximum rate of change of approximately -90 mHz/s.

question_43807.question: What are the frame repetition rates for EDGE channel codings TCH/F34.2 or TCH/F28.8 when RA1'/RAA' function adapts the data stream to 14,5 kbit/s substreams?
question_43807.ground_truth: The frame repetition rates for EDGE channel codings TCH/F34.2 or TCH/F28.8 when RA1'/RAA' function adapts the data stream to 14,5 kbit/s substreams are halved compared to the 64 kbit/s case.

question_43808.question: What is the standard symbol for the network node "Base Station" in the document?
question_43808.ground_truth: The standard symbol for the network node "Base Station" in the document is "BS".

question_43809.question: What is the definition of Transmit OFF power in the context of the repeater?
question_43809.ground_truth: Transmit OFF power is the mean power measured over 70/N us filtered with a square filter of bandwidth equal to the passband bandwidth of the repeater (BWpassband) centred on the assigned channel frequency during the transmitter OFF state.

question_43810.question: What is the range for the integer value of Octet 1 in the Predefined Animation?
question_43810.ground_truth: The integer value of Octet 1 in the Predefined Animation should be in the range 0 (beginning of the SM data) to the maximum number of characters included in the SM data.

question_43811.question: What does the TSCTSF do upon receiving the notification from the AMF about the UE's presence in the AoI and the spatial validity condition?
question_43811.ground_truth: Based on the notification from the AMF, the TSCTSF determines whether to activate time synchronization service for this UE. If the UE location is within the spatial validity condition, the TSCTSF enables access stratum time distribution for the UE, otherwise it disables access stratum time distribution for the UE.

question_43812.question: What is the maximum reduction to UE maximum output power when using Additional Maximum Power Reduction (A-MPR) for the case of 2UL CA?
question_43812.ground_truth: The total reduction to UE maximum output power is max(MPR, A-MPR), where MPR is defined in clause 6.2A.2.

question_43814.question: What is the purpose of the key establishment between a UICC Hosting Device and a Remote Device?
question_43814.ground_truth: The purpose of the key establishment is to provision a shared key between the UICC Hosting Device and the Remote Device, which is then used to secure the interface between them.

question_43815.question: Which information element provides the MME Name in the S6a ULR Origin-Host AVP?
question_43815.ground_truth: The MME Name is provided in the Diameter Identity of the MME in the S6a ULR Origin-Host AVP.

question_43817.question: What should the MCVideo client do when it receives a SIP BYE message during an On-demand Pre-arranged Group Call with Automatic Commencement Mode?
question_43817.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should send a SIP 200 (OK) message and leave the MCVideo session.

question_43818.question: What MIME subtype should be included in the media description in the SDP for audio media flows that support both audio codec and DTMF payloads in RTP packets?
question_43818.ground_truth: The MIME subtype "telephone-event" should be included in the media description in the SDP for audio media flows that support both audio codec and DTMF payloads in RTP packets.

question_43819.question: In the context of this specification, what does the term 'UMTS Entity authentication and key agreement' refer to?
question_43819.ground_truth: UMTS Entity authentication and key agreement is a process that authenticates a user to a serving network domain and generates a key for secure communication.

question_43820.question: What is the reference signal level used for the calculation of the test signal level?
question_43820.ground_truth: The reference signal level used for the calculation of the test signal level is -4.7 dBPa.

question_43821.question: What is the purpose of including the Sharing-Key-UL AVP and/or Sharing-Key-DL AVP within the Media-Component-Description AVP in the AF session modification?
question_43821.ground_truth: To indicate that the related media of the modified AF session may share resources with other media components in the related direction that include the same Sharing-Key-UL and or Sharing-Key-DL AVP.

question_43822.question: What is the percentage of protocol stack memory and the dynamic and static memory reduction for EC-GSM compared to a pure GPRS implementation?
question_43822.ground_truth: The percentage of protocol stack memory and the dynamic and static memory reduction for EC-GSM is around 35-40%.

question_43824.question: What are the two fundamental approaches to achieve energy savings in inter-RAT energy savings scenario, and what are the two primary energy saving procedures?
question_43824.ground_truth: The two fundamental approaches to achieve energy savings in inter-RAT energy savings scenario are OAM-based approach and Signalling-based approach. The two primary energy saving procedures are OAM-based solution for E-UTRAN cell entering or waking up from dormant mode, and Signalling based solution for E-UTRAN cell entering or waking up from dormant mode.

question_43825.question: What is the purpose of the Access Link Control Application Part (ALCAP) in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_43825.ground_truth: ALCAP is a generic name for the transport signalling protocols used to set-up and teardown transport bearers in the 3GPP technical specification.

question_43826.question: What is the effect of 5GMM cause #76 on the UE's behavior in non-3GPP access?
question_43826.ground_truth: If the UE receives 5GMM cause #76 from a non-3GPP access or from a cell belonging to an SNPN, it considers this as an abnormal case.

question_43827.question: What type of tunnel activation event is generated when the attach or PDN connectivity activation is detected over PMIPv6 at the PDN-GW in the VPLMN?

question_43829.question: What should the UE do if A/Gb mode or Iu mode is supported and the service request procedure is rejected with the same GMM cause value?
question_43829.ground_truth: The UE shall handle the MM parameters update status, TMSI, LAI, ciphering key sequence number and the location update attempt counter, and the GMM parameters GMM state and GPRS update status as specified in 3GPP~TS~24.008.

question_43830.question: What is called the propagation of alarm between two endpoints that are operating the same protocol layer?

question_43833.question: What is the difference between a Service and a Service Capability Feature in the OSA context?
question_43833.ground_truth: In the OSA Application Programming Interface (API) itself, the SCFs as identified in the 3GPP requirements and architecture are reflected as "services," in terms like service instance lifecycle manager, service discovery. Thus, there is no real difference between a Service and a Service Capability Feature in the OSA context.

question_43834.question: What is the impact of the quality of service indication in sending requests?
question_43834.ground_truth: The quality of service indication covers aspects such as message order, effect on other on-going traffic, and delay. A finite number of quality of service classes are identified, and the one to apply to a message is indicated.

question_43835.question: What is the role of the LPC (Linear Predictive Coding) analysis windows in speech processing?
question_43835.ground_truth: The LPC analysis windows are used to divide the speech signal into multiple time frames and calculate the linear predictive coding coefficients, which represent the spectral envelope of the speech signal.

question_43836.question: What is an example of detection method for uplink transmissions from victim UEs to determine the presence of victim UEs in the vicinity of a HeNB?
question_43836.ground_truth: The victim UEs will be transmitting data and control information on the uplink, and these uplink transmissions can be detected by the HeNB to determine if there are any victim UEs nearby.

question_43837.question: What should a UE do upon reception of a PDCCH for BWP switching at a Serving Cell while a Random Access procedure is ongoing in the MAC entity?
question_43837.ground_truth: If the PDCCH for BWP switching is received for the C-RNTI indicating successful Random Access procedure completion, the UE shall perform BWP switching to a BWP indicated by the PDCCH. Otherwise, the UE may either switch BWP or ignore the PDCCH for BWP switching, except for ongoing contention-based Random Access procedures, where the UE shall perform BWP switching.

question_43839.question: Which service is allocated the 610-690 MHz band in Region 3 on a primary basis?
question_43839.ground_truth: The 610-690 MHz band is allocated to Fixed Service, Mobile Service and Broadcasting Service on a primary basis in Region 3.

question_43841.question: What shall the ME obtain from the Number-of-Pages byte of the UMTS message?
question_43841.ground_truth: The number of Cell Broadcast pages to be constructed.

question_43843.question: When do S4-SGSN and SGW (Serving GPRS Support Node and Serving Gateway) support the network triggered service restoration procedure?
question_43843.ground_truth: An S4-SGSN and an SGW supporting the optional network triggered service restoration procedure shall behave as specified in clause 25.

question_43844.question: What is the purpose of the MapGroupToBearer message in the MBMS bearer procedures?
question_43844.ground_truth: The MapGroupToBearer message includes association information between the group communication and the MBMS bearer, indicating the media stream within one MBMS bearer that is used for the specific group communication.

question_43846.question: What does UE2 do after receiving a packet with UE1's new IP address?
question_43846.ground_truth: UE2 starts using UE1's new IP address and may forget UE1's old IP address.

question_43848.question: What must the NAT entity do when it receives an incoming packet from the MTC server that matches the MPF rule?
question_43848.ground_truth: The NAT entity must perform the normal NAPT on the public UE device IP address and DST port #, and then forward the packet to the UE.

question_43849.question: How can the end-to-end PSR% value in DL and UL be obtained?
question_43849.ground_truth: The end-to-end PSR% values in DL and UL are calculated as the product of the PSR% in DL and UL over the Uu and N3 interfaces using Equations 6-9.

question_43850.question: What is the requirement for non-consecutive DTX subframes in step 8b?
question_43850.ground_truth: Less than or equal to 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes should be observed by the SS anywhere during the specified subframes up to the end of T2.

question_43851.question: What are the requirements and recommendations for the Media Presentation Timeline in 3GPP-DASH?
question_43851.ground_truth: The requirements and recommendations for the Media Presentation Timeline in 3GPP-DASH are provided in ISO/IEC 23009-1 clause 7.2.1 and 7.3.2.

question_43853.question: What should the MCVideo client set as the SDP IE in a GROUP CALL BROADCAST message?
question_43853.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should set the SDP IE in a GROUP CALL BROADCAST message to the stored SDP body of the call.

question_43854.question: What is the difference between structured and unstructured data in the context of the UDR?
question_43854.ground_truth: Structured data is data where the data model is known and used by the UDR, while unstructured data is data where the data model is not standardized and is not aware of its structure.

question_43855.question: When does a UE that is not registered need to be in state EMM-DEREGISTERED and state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED in 3GPP access?
question_43855.ground_truth: A UE that is not registered shall be in state EMM-DEREGISTERED and state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED for 3GPP access.

question_43856.question: When does the MAC entity consider the Random Access Response reception successful?
question_43856.ground_truth: When the MAC entity receives the TPC, PUCCH resource Indicator, ChannelAccess-CPext (if indicated), and HARQ feedback Timing Indicator in the successRAR.

question_43857.question: What is one potential requirement for supporting MPS for streaming video in the 3GPP system?
question_43857.ground_truth: One potential requirement is the ability to identify an incoming MMTEL video or video conference call/session from another network as an MPS call/session based on the MPS priority markings and handle it with priority.

question_43858.question: What is the mechanism for synchronizing UE IP address/prefix usage status between SMFs in the SMF set?
question_43858.ground_truth: The mechanism consists of sharing the maintained IP address/prefix list with usage indication records among SMFs in the SMF set and ensuring proper session redirection. This helps avoid disrupting existing PFCP sessions and interactions with other NFs.

question_43859.question: What is one of the goals of 3GPP's tight test system uncertainty requirements?
question_43859.ground_truth: One goal is to make the tests as reproducible as possible, as without accurate test system calibration, the test results can change from day to day or frequency to frequency.

question_43860.question: What should the TTCN do after the initial registration of the user equipment (UE)?
question_43860.ground_truth: After the initial registration, the TTCN waits for the UE to close any TCP connection on the unprotected port before proceeding.

question_43861.question: What is the purpose of the IFMP in the IP-CAN Session Modification procedure?
question_43861.ground_truth: The IFMP in the IP-CAN Session Modification procedure is used by the UE to signal to the PGW that an access is not available anymore, and to request the PGW to apply new routing rules.

question_43862.question: What is the purpose of the "EPS bearer status" in the TAU Request message?
question_43862.ground_truth: The EPS bearer status in the TAU Request message indicates the status of each EPS bearer that is active in the UE.

question_43863.question: What should be avoided in order to prevent desensitization of the receive band for Bands 1, 3, 9, 39, 42 or 43 in a BS with a Band (3 + 8 + 27) BS transmitter?
question_43863.ground_truth: The Band (3 + 8 + 27) BS transmitter should not share the same antenna with Bands 1, 3, 9, 42, or 43 BS receiver.

question_43864.question: What is an example of a use case for Ambient IoT in automated warehousing?
question_43864.ground_truth: One example of a use case for Ambient IoT in automated warehousing is the use of Ambient IoT devices for efficient management of storage information in each stage of the automated warehouse inventory scenario, including verification and unloading, gate-in inventory, inventory, gate-out inventory, and check & loading.

question_43866.question: What is the action taken by the MGW when the "Modify Bearer Characteristics" procedure contains a codec not currently in use and framing protocol is used in support mode?
question_43866.ground_truth: The MGW shall be prepared to handle a framing protocol initialisation.

question_43872.question: How is the PDCCH resource block that a MS needs to receive computed?
question_43872.ground_truth: The PDCCH resource block that a MS needs to receive is computed based on the IMSI and the number of resource blocks for the corresponding coverage class within one default paging cycle.

question_43873.question: As per section 6.2.1, what are the types of data that NWDAF can retrieve from various sources for the computation of network analytics?
question_43873.ground_truth: NWDAF can retrieve OAM global NF data, data available in NFs such as behavior data related to individual UEs or UE groups and pre-computed metrics covering UE populations, NF data available in the 5GC, and data available in AF. Additionally, NWDAF can collect data via DCCF data management service if DCCF is present in the network.

question_43874.question: What media transport protocols are supported by MCPTT clients?
question_43874.ground_truth: MCPTT clients support both RTP and SRTP media transport.

question_43876.question: What does the acronym "APT" stand for in the context of the document?
question_43876.ground_truth: APT600 MHz NR Band is referred to as APT in the document, but its full form is not provided. Considering the document's context, APT could stand for "Additional Preferred Territory" or a similar term related to the frequency band for mobile broadband communication.

question_43877.question: What is the relationship between a TLS session and a zero trust deployment plan in the context of 5GC?
question_43877.ground_truth: A TLS session can be considered equivalent to a "session" in the context of a zero trust deployment plan in 5GC, as it involves mutual authentication of the TLS peers and helps establish a secured communication channel between NF consumers and producers.

question_43878.question: Under what conditions should the SGSN explicitly deactivate all PDP contexts associated with the LIPA PDN connection?
question_43878.ground_truth: If the L-GW Transport Layer Address provided by the lower layer together with the service request is different from the GGSN address associated with the PDP context of the LIPA PDN connection or if no L-GW Transport Layer Address is provided together with the service request by the lower layer.

question_43879.question: What does MPR value represent in the definition of Maximum Output Power with DC-HSUPA?
question_43879.ground_truth: The Maximum Power Reduction (MPR) for the nominal maximum output power is used to define the maximum output power with DC-HSUPA.

question_43881.question: What is the initial condition in 4.5A.5.2.2?
question_43881.ground_truth: The initial condition in 4.5A.5.2.2 is that the UE has established an IPsec security association.

question_43882.question: What is the verification procedure for the channel model implementation specified in Annex M?
question_43882.ground_truth: The verification of the channel model implementation can be part of the laboratory accreditation process and only needs to be performed once for each channel model as long as the setup and instruments remain unchanged. Otherwise, it may need to be performed prior to starting each throughput test.

question_43883.question: In what situation would the SMF+PGW-C generate an SMFMAPDUSessionEstablishment record?
question_43883.ground_truth: When the SMF+PGW-C detects that a PDN Connection has been established for the target UE and associated to a multi-access PDU Session.

question_43884.question: What was the outcome of the "OPEN CHANNEL" command with command number 1 in the passed example?
question_43884.ground_truth: The command was performed successfully and the channel status indicated that the link was established or the PDP context was activated.

question_43885.question: Which parameter determines the measurement requirements for a secondary component carrier with deactivated SCell in the absence of common DRX?
question_43885.ground_truth: The parameter measCycleSCell is used to determine the measurement requirements for a secondary component carrier with deactivated SCell in the absence of common DRX.

question_43886.question: What should the 3GPP AAA Server do if it determines that the WLAN AN is RADIUS based?
question_43886.ground_truth: The 3GPP AAA Server should construct the Diameter QoS-Resources AVP such that it can be translated into a RADIUS 3GPP-WLAN-QoS-Filter-Rule attribute if it determines that the WLAN AN is RADIUS based.

question_43887.question: Which clause of the document specifies the minimum requirements for single RAT UTRA operation for all BS classes?
question_43887.ground_truth: Clause 7.4.3 specifies the minimum requirements for single RAT UTRA operation for all BS classes.

question_43888.question: What message does the SS send to the MS when the call clearance procedure is successful?
question_43888.ground_truth: The SS sends a RELEASE COMPLETE message with cause #81 "invalid transaction identifier value" to the MS.

question_43890.question: What is the role of the RNC1 in the ANR report received over Uu, when there is no Iur connectivity to some of the RNCs included in the report?
