question_44227.question: In which scenario are all planes, including the application services layer, SIP core, and 5GS, administered by the same party?
question_44227.ground_truth: Scenario 1: Common administration of all planes

question_44231.question: What are the factors the initiating UE should consider before selecting the default destination layer-2 ID for unicast initial signalling when establishing a single PC5 unicast link for more than one V2X service?
question_44231.ground_truth: The initiating UE should consider the V2X services that are mapped to distinct default destination layer-2 IDs and ensure that the selected default destination layer-2 ID is compatible with the network layer protocol and security policy required for those V2X services.

question_44232.question: What should the MAC entity do upon receiving a Timing Advance Command MAC CE and if an NTA has been maintained with the indicated TAG?
question_44232.ground_truth: The MAC entity should apply the Timing Advance Command for the indicated TAG.

question_44235.question: What is the test purpose in subclause 26.9.6.2.1.2?
question_44235.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify that the MS in the "idle, no IMSI" state, when made to call the number 112 (for GSM 900 and 1800 MS), or 911 (for GSM 710, GSM 750, T-GSM 810, GSM 850 and PCS 1 900 MS in USA and Canada), or 08 (for GSM 710, GSM 750, T-GSM 810, GSM 850 and PCS 1 900 MS in Mexico), sends a CHANNEL REQUEST message with establishment cause "emergency call".

question_44236.question: What is the expected response of the IUT (MCPTT Server) in section 5.1.1(3) of the document when the SS (MCPTT Client) requests user service authorization after identity management key material has been provided?
question_44236.ground_truth: The IUT (MCPTT Server) is expected to respond to the SS (MCPTT Client) with SIP 200 (OK) messages when the SS (MCPTT Client) requests user service authorization in section 5.1.1(3) of the document.

question_44237.question: What does the "EPS Attach Success Rate" KPI indicate and how is it computed?
question_44237.ground_truth: The "EPS Attach Success Rate" KPI describes the ratio of the number of successfully performed EPS attach procedures to the number of attempted EPS attach procedures for EPC network. It is obtained by successful EPS attach procedures divided by attempted EPS attach procedures.

question_44240.question: What is the purpose of the eMLPP supplementary service in 3GPP?
question_44240.ground_truth: The eMLPP service in 3GPP specifies the procedures used at the radio interface for normal operation, invocation, registration, and interrogation of the enhanced Multi-Level Precedence and Pre-emption service.

question_44241.question: What is the purpose of the test in this procedure?
question_44241.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the variance of the CQI reports is within the limits defined and that a BLER of 10% falls between the TF based on cell specific Median CQI-1 and the TF based on cell specific Median CQI TF or between the TF based on cell specific Median CQI and the TF based on cell specific Median CQI+2.

question_44242.question: Which HTTP method is specified for modifying the Service Specific active authorizations in the UDR in clause 5.2.49.3.4 of the 3GPP TS 29.501 standard?
question_44242.ground_truth: The PATCH method is specified for modifying the Service Specific active authorizations in the UDR.

question_44243.question: How is the measurement in 5.1.1.1.7.1 obtained?
question_44243.ground_truth: The measurement is obtained by the gNB performing the GTP PDU packet delay measurement for QoS monitoring and recording the time stamps in the GTP-U header of each GTP PDU monitoring response packet, excluding the D1 UL PDCP Delay. The gNB then increments the corresponding bin with the delay range where the DRul falls into by 1 for the counters.

question_44245.question: What is the data type 'TpClientAppID' defined as?
question_44245.ground_truth: It is defined as a string of characters that uniquely identifies the application.

question_44247.question: In what scenario does the UE initiate the release of the MA PDU Session over all accesses?
question_44247.ground_truth: When at UE mobility, the service area of the SMF does not include the location where the UE camps and the PDU Session is a MA PDU Session, the AMF initiates the release of the MA PDU Session over all accesses served by this AMF. This applies to Registration, Service Request, Xn Hand-over, or N2 Hand-Over procedures.

question_44248.question: What are the pre-conditions the initiating UE should meet before it initiates the PC5 unicast link establishment procedure?
question_44248.ground_truth: The initiating UE should ensure that it has a request from upper layers to transmit packets for V2X services over PC5, is using unicast mode, has a layer-2 ID that is not being used by other existing PC5 unicast links, has the layer-2 ID of the destination UE available, and meets the authorization and limited service state requirements for V2X communication over PC5.

question_44249.question: What happens when the DDNMF checks the MIC in step 13 of ProSe Direct Communication for Model A?
question_44249.ground_truth: The DDNMF checks the MIC for the discovered ProSe Code.

question_44250.question: What specific yes/no questions is the prehospital examination trying to answer?
question_44250.ground_truth: The prehospital examination aims to answer questions such as "Is there a pneumothorax?" or "Is there free fluid in the pleura, pericardium and peritoneum?" related to conditions like trauma, respiratory insufficiency, shock, cardiac arrest, abdominal pain, or abdominal aortic aneurysm.

question_44251.question: How many data objects for channel status are included in the GET STATUS command response from the ME to the UICC?
question_44251.ground_truth: The number of channel status data objects in the GET STATUS command response is the same as the number of channels supported by the ME.

question_44252.question: What is the purpose of the NEF service in Solution #24?
question_44252.ground_truth: The NEF service in Solution #24 enables communication between NFs in the PLMN and V2X Application Server for V2X service provisioning.

question_44253.question: What call handling features are affected by Priority Service?
question_44253.ground_truth: Call waiting, call forwarding, and call redirection are affected by Priority Service. Priority Service call users will not receive an incoming call indication while the call is being queued. Service users will not be allowed to invoke Priority Service calls through call forwarding or re-direction.

question_44254.question: What is the purpose of PLMN selection when a "Disaster Condition" applies?
question_44254.ground_truth: The UE shall perform PLMN selection as specified, with the addition that if all available PLMNs are in the UE's "forbidden PLMNs" list, the UE may indicate whether the available PLMNs can accommodate Disaster Inbound Roamers. Once the MS has registered on a PLMN without Disaster Condition and the PLMN without Disaster Condition is selected by the user, the MS shall not automatically register on a different PLMN unless the new PLMN is declared as an equivalent PLMN by the registered PLMN and the new PLMN can accommodate Disaster Inbound Roamers.

question_44257.question: What are the four different power consumption conditions defined for the NR UE power consumption model?
question_44257.ground_truth: The four different power consumption conditions for the NR UE power consumption model are: Deep sleep, Light sleep, Active RX only, and Active TX only.

question_44259.question: What is the difference between Early Assignment and Late Assignment in Mobile-to-Mobile call setup?
question_44259.ground_truth: Early Assignment refers to allocating resources in the BSS prior to the ringing phase in Mobile-to-Mobile call setup, while Late Assignment allocates resources in the BSS only after the ringing phase. The difference between the two is that with Early Assignment, the radio resources take a considerable time to set up, while with Late Assignment, no radio network user plane costs are generated until the user accepts the call.

question_44261.question: How does a UE segment the encoded RRC PDU when initiating the UL message segment transfer procedure?
question_44261.ground_truth: The UE segments the encoded RRC PDU based on the maximum supported size of a PDCP SDU specified in TS 38.323. The UE should minimize the number of segments and set the contents of the ULDedicatedMessageSegment messages accordingly.

question_44262.question: What is the role of GUSS in GBA?
question_44262.ground_truth: GUSS stands for GBA User Security Settings and it contains BSF specific information and the set of all application-specific USSs (User Security Settings).

question_44263.question: What is the Payload Protocol Identifier assigned by IANA for M2-AP and M3-AP in E-UTRAN?
question_44263.ground_truth: The Payload Protocol Identifier assigned by IANA for M2-AP is 43 and for M3-AP is 44 in E-UTRAN.

question_44264.question: What is the purpose of the EES performing an authorization check before storing the EAS profile?
question_44264.ground_truth: To verify whether the EAS has the authorization to register on the EES.

question_44268.question: What should the MME allocate as the default LAI for SMS over SGs when not all MSCs support the SGs interface?
question_44268.ground_truth: The MME should allocate a default (non-broadcast) LAI associated with a VLR that supports the SGs interface in such situations.

question_44269.question: What message is used by the LMF to initiate a PRU disassociation procedure in 3GPP TS 23.273 clause 6.17.2?
question_44269.ground_truth: The REGISTER message containing a PRU-disassociation invoke component is used by the LMF to initiate a PRU disassociation procedure in 3GPP TS 23.273 clause 6.17.2.

question_44271.question: What is the maximum number of SMTC occasions groups not available at the UE for an unknown FR2-2 SCell activation in an intra-band scenario, if Trs is greater than 40 ms?

question_44273.question: How does the network verify the forwarded-to number before accepting a call forwarding request?
question_44273.ground_truth: The network verifies the forwarded-to number by checking if the number is within the allowed number range before accepting the call forwarding request.

question_44274.question: Which message is sent between RNCs during Relocation?
question_44274.ground_truth: The 9.1.43 RANAP RELOCATION INFORMATION message is sent between RNCs during Relocation.

question_44275.question: What should the MCPTT client do upon receiving a "SIP MESSAGE request for group selection change response for terminating client"?
question_44275.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should determine the success or failure of the sent group selection change request and indicate the result to the MCPTT user.

question_44276.question: What is the procedure followed in releasing an ongoing MCPTT group call involving groups from multiple MCPTT systems?
question_44276.ground_truth: The MCPTT server releasing the ongoing MCPTT group call shall identify the participants of the ongoing group call and generate a group call release message to release the current session. Then initiate a group call release request message towards each accessible participant of the ongoing group call. If some group members are part of a partner MCPTT system, then the MCPTT server initiates a group call release request message to the MCPTT server of the partner MCPTT system with the target group's MCPTT group ID information.

question_44278.question: What should be placed in the middle of the maximum radiated Base Station RF Bandwidth when constructing ATCR4b?

question_44279.question: What is the requirement for the uplink control signalling of each stream in dual stream transmission?
question_44279.ground_truth: The uplink control signalling of each stream, including ACK/NACK, RMF, and RTBS information, shall be sent within one HS-SICH TTI. A new format of HS-SICH with SF=8 is used to maintain the same code rate as the legacy HS-SICH.

question_44282.question: How are the mixing parameters and estimated for bit rates less than 24.4 kb/s?
question_44282.ground_truth: The mixing parameters and are estimated using equations (1571) and (1572) respectively, in the case where the bit rates are less than 24.4 kb/s.

question_44283.question: What does the acronym FACH stand for in HSDSCH-FDD-Secondary-Serving-Information-To-Modify-Unsynchronised?

question_44285.question: What is the significance of the 'UP-PRUK ID' parameter in 5G ProSe security messages over PC8?
question_44285.ground_truth: The UP-PRUK ID parameter is used to indicate the identifier of the UE stored UP-PRUK. It consists of two fields: UP-PRUK ID format field and UP-PRUK ID field.

question_44286.question: Under what conditions should the Node B reject the procedure when the DCH Enhancements Information IE is present in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message in FDD?
question_44286.ground_truth: The Node B should reject the procedure if the DL DPCH Slot Format IE is not set to "17" or "18" or if the UL DPCCH Slot Format IE is not set to "5".

question_44287.question: What should the MAC entity do if the sl-IUC-ReportTimer for the triggered SL-IUC Information reporting expires?
question_44287.ground_truth: Cancel the triggered SL-IUC Information reporting.

question_44288.question: What should the MCVideo ad-hoc group call request contain in order to indicate an implicit transmit media request?
question_44288.ground_truth: The MCVideo ad-hoc group call request should contain an indication of an implicit transmit media request if there is a transmission request to transmit.

question_44289.question: What is the current status of the present document as per the 3GPP?
question_44289.ground_truth: The contents of the present document are subject to continuing work within the TSG and may change following formal TSG approval. It will be re-released by the TSG with an identifying change of release date and an increase in version number after TSG approval.

question_44290.question: How are the fine gain adjustment bits derived in the Harmonic mode for the bit allocation process?
question_44290.ground_truth: The fine gain adjustment bits are derived in the same manner as in the encoder, where more bits are allocated to the bands in a perceptually significant group than those in a less significant group.

question_44292.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 24.341, what is used to indicate that a SIP MESSAGE request corresponds to a short message submitted by the SM-over-IP sender?

question_44293.question: Which file format is used for MMS Message Bodies?
question_44293.ground_truth: MMS Message Bodies conform to Internet Message Bodies as defined in RFC 2045 and may conform to MIME multipart format as defined in RFC 2046.

question_44294.question: What is the required SNR at probability of detection equal to 0.99 for interlaced PUCCH format 3 ACK missed detection?
question_44294.ground_truth: The required SNR at probability of detection equal to 0.99 for interlaced PUCCH format 3 ACK missed detection is determined by the two parameters: probability of false detection of the ACK and the probability of detection of ACK.

question_44298.question: What are the three types of CC aggregation scenarios based on UE capability in LTE-Advanced?
question_44298.ground_truth: Intra band contiguous CC aggregation, Intra band non-contiguous CC aggregation, and Inter band non-contiguous CC aggregation are the three types of CC aggregation scenarios based on UE capability in LTE-Advanced.

question_44300.question: What protocol is used to establish a direct HTTPS connection between the key management client and the MCPTT KMS in the procedure where the MCPTT proxy is not used?

question_44301.question: What is the size of the Serving Cell ID field in the Unified TCI States Activation/Deactivation MAC CE?
question_44301.ground_truth: The size of the Serving Cell ID field in the Unified TCI States Activation/Deactivation MAC CE is 5 bits.

question_44308.question: What is the source device in the RECEIVE DATA proactive command with a command number of 2.7.1?
question_44308.ground_truth: The source device is UICC in the RECEIVE DATA proactive command with a command number of 2.7.1.

question_44310.question: What does HSS need to send to the UICC if the UICC sends the first message in the two-pass ECDH key exchange?
question_44310.ground_truth: HSS can send the secret ECDH parameter encrypted and signed under an HSS public key and an HSS private key.

question_44313.question: When should the MCPTT client include the Resource-Priority header field and comply with the procedures in subclause 6.2.8.1.12?
question_44313.ground_truth: When the MCPTT client imminent peril group state for this group is set to "MIG 2: in-progress" or "MIG 4: confirm-pending"

question_44314.question: What is an alternative solution to negotiating the use of the speech codec requested by the LMR system within an MCPTT group in an LMR system?
question_44314.ground_truth: An alternative solution is a transcoding solution, where the change of LMR codec is hidden from the MCPTT system.

question_44315.question: What is the purpose of DCCF and MFAF relocation?
question_44315.ground_truth: The purpose of DCCF and MFAF relocation is to align the serving areas of the DCCF and MFAF with the serving areas of the data and analytics source. This ensures that the UE DCCF and MFAF context can be transferred or setup in the new DCCF and MFAF.

question_44318.question: What is the format of the BroadcastContextSetupResponse message?
question_44318.ground_truth: The BroadcastContextSetupResponse message is a SEQUENCE containing a single field, protocolIEs, which is a ProtocolIE-Container object that contains a set of BroadcastContextSetupResponseIEs.

question_44319.question: What action can be taken to delay the 2G LA/RA update and avoid deletion of UMTS temporary IDs and registered LAI/RAI during a UMTS restart in a specific geographic area?
question_44319.ground_truth: Activate ACB on GSM cells during the UMTS restart in that geographic area.

question_44320.question: How is the content of the present 3GPP Technical Specification document structured?
question_44320.ground_truth: The content of the document is structured into four main sections: Scope, Definitions and Abbraviations, Solution Set Definitions, and References. The scope section gives an overview of the document, the Definitions and Abbraviations section lays out the terms and abbreviations used in the document, the Solution Set Definitions section defines the contents of the two solution sets: CORBA SS and XML definitions, and References lists the documentation and standards used in the creation of the 3GPP Technical Specification.

question_44322.question: What is the purpose of the MTC Device Trigger in the 3GPP system?
question_44322.ground_truth: The MTC Device Trigger is a service in the 3GPP system that allows an MTC Server to establish communication with an MTC Device. It can cause a PDP/PDN connection to be established or re-established if it wasn't working due to an error condition in the network. The trigger is based on an identifier that identifies the MTC Device and it can only be used by authorized MTC Servers.

question_44324.question: What is the role of the PDN GW in the HSS/AAA-initiated detach procedure when the S2c session for a given UE and a given PDN is to be terminated immediately?
question_44324.ground_truth: The PDN GW sends a detach request message to the UE and executes a PCEF-Initiated IP-CAN Session Termination Procedure with the PCRF if there is an active PCC session for the UE.

question_44325.question: How is non-call related supplementary service information transmitted in IRI records?
question_44325.ground_truth: Non-call related service information is transmitted as received from the signalling protocol. It is a general principle to transmit such information as received from the signalling protocol.

question_44326.question: What type of value is W-AGF-ID in UserLocationInformationNR?
question_44326.ground_truth: W-AGF-ID in UserLocationInformationNR is a choice of either globalLine-ID or HFCNode-ID. The globalLine-ID is a Global Line-ID and the HFCNode-ID is a HFC Node-ID in the case of the IDs being chosen by the experienced cable professional for the Cable industry and when the W-AGF type is selected in UserLocationInformationNR.

question_44332.question: When is the "ii-nni" Route header field parameter removed by the node at the end of the II-NNI traversal scenario?
question_44332.ground_truth: The "ii-nni" Route header field parameter is removed by the node at the end of the II-NNI traversal scenario when it is represented by the URI in the Request-URI.

question_44334.question: In the reality TV show the voice is described as mellow, which means what?

question_44335.question: In the context of the described method, how can the bandwidth of a CZ-UMTS received signal be reduced by half?
question_44335.ground_truth: The bandwidth of a CZ-UMTS received signal can be reduced by half by applying a mask of (1,0,1,0) to the received samples, effectively throwing out every other sample, and creating an image copy of the lower W/2 spectrum in the upper part of the spectrum, which can be equalized by the UMTS equalizer of bandwidth W.

question_44336.question: What is the role of the DNS Message Handling Rules in routing DNS queries?
question_44336.ground_truth: The DNS Message Handling Rules are used to determine where DNS queries are sent, based on the PDU Session and the V-SBO information provided by the H-SMF. All DNS Queries using this PDU Session go to the V-EASDF, and DNS resolution for the local routed traffic is handled based on the Rel-17 mechanism for EAS discovery using EASDF.

question_44337.question: What is the process followed by the initiator to select the KMS URI to sign the MIKEY message when the KMS list is not empty?
question_44337.ground_truth: The initiator can select a KMS URI from the reduced list using local policy, the Home KMS, or the first KMS URI from the list.

question_44338.question: What is the effect of the third digit in the version numbering system used in the 3GPP 3rd Generation Partnership Project Technical Specification?
question_44338.ground_truth: The third digit in the version numbering system (x.y.z) used in the 3GPP 3rd Generation Partnership Project Technical Specification is incremented when only editorial changes have been incorporated in the document.

question_44339.question: What is the requirement for Step 2 in the Gateway Control and QoS Policy Rules Request Procedure?
question_44339.ground_truth: The Trusted non-3GPP IP access provides the UE request or release of resources as an Event Report in Step 2.

question_44340.question: What clause specifies the requirements for reporting the failure of QoS flows in a PDU session to the H-SMF or SMF?

question_44341.question: What is thepurpose of the Access point name information element?
question_44341.ground_truth: The Access point name information element identifies the packet data network to which the GPRS user wishes to connect and notifies the access point of the packet data network that wishes to connect to the MS.

question_44343.question: What action is taken by the UE upon accessing the target eNodeB after the handover procedure?
question_44343.ground_truth: The UE sends the HO to E-UTRAN Complete message and implicitly derives and deactivates the EPS bearers for which an E-RAB was not established.

question_44344.question: What information should the IWF cache if the SIP re-INVITE request is a valid request for an MCPTT imminent peril group call cancellation?
question_44344.ground_truth: The IWF should cache the information that the MCPTT user no longer has an outstanding MCPTT imminent peril group call, after successfully processing the SIP re-INVITE request for an MCPTT imminent peril group call cancellation.

question_44345.question: What information is reported by the GGSN/PGW to other network nodes in case of user plane congestion?
question_44345.ground_truth: The congestion information is reported to other network nodes by including the RCI (RAN Congestion Information) and the Cell ID in the uplink data traffic packets. Additionally, the GGSN/PGW may report the congestion information to other network nodes via event reporting over Gx or Rx interfaces.

question_44346.question: What is the spreading factor used for the HS-SCCH, HS-SICH, and E-PUCH?
question_44346.ground_truth: The spreading factor used for the HS-SCCH, HS-SICH, and E-PUCH is SF = 16.

question_44347.question: What is the role of the Tester Object (TO) in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_44347.ground_truth: The Tester Object (TO) is a managed object that is instantiated for the purpose of monitoring and controlling a test invocation. Each test invocation has one associated TO, which is created and deleted by managed objects with TARR functionality.

question_44348.question: What are some key modelling objectives for channel models in 5G systems?
question_44348.ground_truth: Some key objectives include taking into account the outcome of RAN-level discussions in the '5G' requirement study item, considering complexity in terms of description, generating channel coefficients, development complexity, and simulation time, supporting frequency range up to 100 GHz, and supporting large channel bandwidths.

question_44349.question: What should the MS send in the first frame during the negotiation procedure with the SS if the MS is using RLP parameters different from the default parameters?
question_44349.ground_truth: The MS should send an XID (C=1, P=1) frame containing a set of RLP parameters different from the default set.

question_44352.question: What is the default value for a spare bit in 3GPP TS 24.008, if not indicated otherwise in the description of information elements?
question_44352.ground_truth: With few exceptions, spare bits in 3GPP TS 24.008 are indicated as being set to "0" by the sending side and their value shall be ignored by the receiving side.

question_44353.question: What is the CORBA Solution Set (SS) and how is it related to the EPC NRM IRP?
question_44353.ground_truth: The CORBA Solution Set (SS) is a set of specifications defining the mapping of the IRP information model to the protocol specific details necessary for implementation in a CORBA/IDL environment. It is related to 3GPP TS 32.752 v9.3.X.

question_44355.question: What is the result of modifying the media flow in a Collaborative Session?
question_44355.ground_truth: Modifying the media flow(s) in a Collaborative Session allows UE-1 and UE-2 to re-negotiate media information with the remote party, possibly resulting in changes to the media flow or its details.

question_44357.question: What happens when the MS performs a routing area updating procedure and the ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message is delayed from the SS?
question_44357.ground_truth: The MS performs a cell update into a new routing area and re-initiates a routing area updating procedure in the new routing area. The attempt counter is not incremented.

question_44358.question: What should a participating MCPTT function do when it receives a Floor Taken message with a higher message-sequence-number value than the stored one?
question_44358.ground_truth: It should replace the stored message-sequence-number value with the received one, set the acknowledgment bit to '0', and send the received Floor Taken message over the MBMS subchannel.

question_44359.question: What is the formula for calculating the minimum output power for intra-band con-current V2X operation for NR sidelink as specified in clause 6.3E.1 in TS38.101-1?
question_44359.ground_truth: The requirement for NR sidelink is specified in clause 6.3E.1 in TS38.101-1.

question_44360.question: In the 8.69 parameter, when the current serving cell is not a UTRA FDD or UTRA TDD cell, what is set to 255?

question_44361.question: What happens when the new MME/UPE receives the UE parameters from the UE in the Intra LTE-Access-System change in idle state with user context transfer process?
question_44361.ground_truth: The new MME/UPE derives an address of the UE's old MME/UPE from the parameters sent by the UE and sends the UE parameters to the old MME/UPE to request the UE context.

question_44362.question: In case 2, what will the network do if the TFT operation is "Delete packet filters from existing TFT"?
question_44362.ground_truth: The network will process the new request and, if no error is detected, perform an EPS bearer context modification procedure including the value of EPS bearer identity for packet filter IE in the EPS bearer identity IE and a TFT IE with TFT operation = "Delete existing TFT".

question_44363.question: What should the MCVideo client do when it receives a PRIVATE CALL RELEASE message while in the "P3: waiting for release response" state?
question_44363.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should generate a PRIVATE CALL RELEASE message, send it in response, increment the value of timer CFP3, start timer TFP3, and remain in the "P3: waiting for release response" state.

question_44364.question: What message does CDF send to CGF1 when it receives the Data Record Transfer Response message with the Cause value being "Request related to possibly duplicated packets already fulfilled"?
question_44364.ground_truth: CDF gives the CGF2 a command to release the corresponding CDR packet(s) from CGF2's buffer for potentially duplicated packets.

question_44365.question: What is the purpose of the eP-CSCF including the identity of the WWSF if the WAF belongs to the third party network?
question_44365.ground_truth: To ensure the correct identity of the WAF and to check if it matches with the identity provided by the HSS.

question_44367.question: What percentage of PC1 UE can achieve a minimum SINR of 25 dB at the BS side in the indoor scenario?

question_44369.question: What measures can be taken to deal with botnet scenarios in UC detection?
question_44369.ground_truth: Measures to deal with botnet scenarios in UC detection include content analysis, in-session detection, rating, and response methods, and careful trade-off between the complexity imposed to IMS and the expected threat.

question_44370.question: What is the expected Cause IE value for the "Delete Bearer Response" message to indicate successful deletion of an EPS bearer?
question_44370.ground_truth: If the EPS bearer has been modified in the MME/SGSN/TWAN/ePDG, the Cause IE value should either be "Request accepted" or "Request accepted partially" in the "Update Bearer Response" message. Other possible cause values indicate an unsuccessful deletion of the EPS bearer.

question_44371.question: In subframe #3 every 10 subframes, what should the SS send to the UE for downlink transmission?
question_44371.ground_truth: The SS sends downlink PDSCH MAC padding bits as well as 0 dB TPC command for PUCCH via the MPDCCH to the UE.

question_44372.question: In the formula for TRS, what does Cn represent?
question_44372.ground_truth: Cn represents the path loss in the cables connecting the measurement receiver to the fixed measurement antenna n.

question_44374.question: What is the requirement for a media security solution in 3GPP and TISPAN networks regarding sending messages on the media path?
question_44374.ground_truth: Only media traffic can be sent over the media path in 3GPP and TISPAN networks.

question_44376.question: What special command can the MDMS issue when there are special circumstances that cannot be cut off?
question_44376.ground_truth: The MDMS can issue a power protection command in advance to ensure that the smart meter will not trip for related circumstances.

question_44377.question: What is the meaning of the "Cause Value" in the "Cause" element?
question_44377.ground_truth: The "Cause Value" in the "Cause" element is a code that indicates the reason for a particular event to have occurred, grouped into classes that represent normal events, resource unavailability, service or option not available but implemented, service or option not implemented or currently disabled, invalid message, protocol error, or interworking.

question_44378.question: What is the function of the Mobile Content Provider in section 5.3?
question_44378.ground_truth: The Mobile Content Provider, also known as Mobile PBCP, provides personal broadcasting service using mobile devices for outdoor group activities such as guided tours and carpooling.

question_44379.question: What is the responsibility of the IAB-node DU when a descendant IAB-node recovers from an upstream RLF in the backhaul network?
question_44379.ground_truth: The IAB-node DU provides BH RLF-recovery for former ancestor nodes in case a descendant IAB-node can recover from such an upstream RLF.

question_44380.question: What is the aim of Part 2 in the MPEG-I standard?
question_44380.ground_truth: Part 2 of the MPEG-I standard, Omnidirectional MediA Format, aims to define a format for immersive media.

question_44381.question: What is the measurement provided in 5.8.2.2.1?
question_44381.ground_truth: The number of QoS flows successfully modified via untrusted non-3GPP access.

question_44382.question: What should be included in the "Service Parameters" when performing DNS procedures to discover all GTP based S5/S8 interfaces for selecting a combined PGW-C/SMF?
question_44382.ground_truth: The "Service Parameters" should include "x-3gpp-pgw:x-s5-gtp+nc-smf" and "x-3gpp-pgw:x-s8-gtp+nc-smf" when performing DNS procedures to discover all GTP based S5/S8 interfaces for selecting a combined PGW-C/SMF.

question_44384.question: Which HTTP standard header shall be supported on Nudr interface as defined in clause 5.2.2 of 3GPP TS 29.500?
question_44384.ground_truth: The HTTP standard headers that shall be supported on Nudr interface include the "Content type", "Cache-Control", "ETag", "If-None-Match", "If-Match", "Last-Modified", and "If-Modified-Since" headers.

question_44385.question: What is the definition of "Offline Charging" in the 3GPP technical specification document?
question_44385.ground_truth: In the 3GPP technical specification document, "Offline Charging" is a charging mechanism where charging information does not affect, in real-time, the service rendered.

question_44386.question: What should the MCVideo server check if location information was included in the MCVideo ad-hoc group call request?
question_44386.ground_truth: If location information was included in the MCVideo ad-hoc group call request, the MCVideo server checks the privacy policy of the MCVideo user to decide if the location information of MCVideo client can be provided to other users on the call.

question_44387.question: What is the role of an MGCF/IM-MGW in interworking between a 3GPP network and a CS network, in terms of ECN support?
question_44387.ground_truth: An MGCF/IM-MGW in a 3GPP network that supports MTSI can interwork between an ECN-capable client and a CS network that handles ECN-marked packets properly.

question_44388.question: What is the action taken by the SMF when releasing PDU Sessions associated with a congested S-NSSAI?
question_44388.ground_truth: The SMF sends a PDU Session Release Request message towards the UE with a back-off time associated either to the S-NSSAI only or a combination of the S-NSSAI and a specific DNN.

question_44389.question: What does the "Timing Advance Command" field in the fallbackRAR indicate?
question_44389.ground_truth: The "Timing Advance Command" field in the fallbackRAR indicates the index value TA used to control the amount of timing adjustment that the MAC entity has to apply.

question_44392.question: How does the media handling differ in the scenarios described in section 6.1 compared to the scenarios in section 6.2?
question_44392.ground_truth: In section 6.1, the media is handled by the local IP gateway in the serving operator's network after the IMS session is established. In contrast, in section 6.2, there are two PDN GWs used for anchoring IMS bearer traffic, one in the home network and one in the visited network.

question_44396.question: What information is stored in the node named "V2XNRFrequency"?
question_44396.ground_truth: It contains the V2X NR frequency to which the V2X service identifier value associated to the same mapping rule is mapped.

question_44397.question: What should the network do if the stored GPRS ciphering key sequence number does not match the one received from the MS in the ATTACH REQUEST message?
question_44397.ground_truth: The network should authenticate the MS.

question_44398.question: What is the general result for OPEN CHANNEL command in 27.22.11.5~Test requirement?
question_44398.ground_truth: Command performed successfully or Command performed with modifications

question_44399.question: What happens to the MCData emergency state when an MCData group is not in the in-progress emergency state but an emergency indicator is present in the received MCData group standalone data request?
question_44399.ground_truth: The MCData group is considered to be in the in-progress emergency state until cancelled.

question_44400.question: What is the outcome when the UE receives a DL paging applying to a PDU session for S-NSSAI2 and the TAI1 and TAI2 are supported by cells under different gNBs, and the gNB selects a preferred band from one of the TA2's bands for S-NSSAI2?
question_44400.ground_truth: The UE shall trigger cell reselection to this preferred band only considering cells in the RA.

question_44401.question: What are the two cases identified for the specification of MMTEL data over Ud?
question_44401.ground_truth: The two cases identified for the specification of MMTEL data over Ud are: (1) the Ud interface between a TAS-FE and UDR, and (2) the Ud interface between a HSS-FE (supporting IMS) and the UDR.

question_44403.question: What should the AMF include in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message if the initial registration procedure is not for emergency services and the UE supports WUS assistance information?
question_44403.ground_truth: If the UE supports WUS assistance information and the AMF supports and accepts the use of WUS assistance information for the UE, then the AMF shall determine the negotiated UE paging probability information for the UE, store it in the 5GMM context of the UE, and include it in the Negotiated WUS assistance information IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

question_44404.question: What should the controlling MCData function include in the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request if the SIP MESSAGE is to be sent on behalf of a user homed in the IWF?
question_44404.ground_truth: The controlling MCData function should create the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body, the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body, and the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-payload MIME body in the outgoing SIP MESSAGE request.

question_44405.question: What is the role of SMF in sending N4 rules and QoS profiles to UPF and RAN node respectively?
question_44405.ground_truth: SMF is responsible for sending N4 rules to UPF to instruct packet handling/treatment policy and identifying PDU Sets of corresponding protocols. SMF also sends QoS profiles to the RAN node via AMF and instructs RAN to perform PDU Set integrated QoS handling.

question_44406.question: What does the source MME determine based on the 'Target RNC Identifier' IE to determine the type of handover during an IRAT handover to UTRAN Iu mode?

question_44408.question: What should the UE do if the received UL grant value is different in size than the MSGA payload in a 2-step RA type procedure?
question_44408.ground_truth: The behavior of the UE is not defined in this situation.

question_44409.question: What are the advantages of the multi-loop decoding used in the SHVC architecture over the single-loop decoding used in SVC?
question_44409.ground_truth: The multi-loop decoding used in the SHVC architecture allows for more flexibility in inter-layer prediction, allowing all samples from the reference layers within the specified reference regions to be used, whereas the single-loop decoding of SVC has limitations such as not supporting arbitrary down-switching at any picture and negatively impacting coding efficiency.

question_44410.question: What is the function of the primary common pilot (P-CPICH) in a combined cell deployment?
question_44410.ground_truth: The primary common pilot (P-CPICH) is continuously transmitted in a combined cell deployment and is used by the user equipment (UE) to compute the channel quality indicator (CQI) based on the combined pilots.

question_44411.question: What information does the UE include in the NAS PDU when sending uplink data in step 1?
question_44411.ground_truth: The NAS PDU includes the EPS Bearer ID and encrypted Uplink Data. For IP PDN type PDN connections, the UE may also indicate in the NAS Release Assistance Information whether no further Uplink or Downlink Data transmissions are expected.

question_44413.question: Who does the source RNC/BSS send a Relocation Required message to when deciding to initiate an inter RAT/mode PS handover towards the GERAN A/Gb mode?
question_44413.ground_truth: The source RNC/BSS sends a Relocation Required message to the 3G/2G SGSN when deciding to initiate an inter RAT/mode PS handover towards the GERAN A/Gb mode.

question_44415.question: What is the purpose of the use case regarding the pressure powered switch in the Ambient IoT network?
question_44415.ground_truth: The purpose of the use case is to propose a requirement for optimizing Ambient IoT signaling, reducing the amount of signaling interactions, and saving power and time.

question_44417.question: How many elements can be present in the servantCellIndexList-r17 of the IntraBandCC-CombinationReqList-r17?

question_44419.question: What is the difference in performance between the "communication optimized approach 2" (green line) and the "default approach" (red line) in Solution 9?
question_44419.ground_truth: The "communication optimized approach 2" (green line) shows the best performance in all cases compared to the "default approach" (red line) in Solution 9.

question_44420.question: What should the MeNB do if the en-gNB requests modification of a UE context but does not admit any modification requested by the MeNB?
question_44420.ground_truth: The MeNB should send the SGNB MODIFICATION REQUEST REJECT message to the en-gNB with an appropriate value in the Cause IE.

question_44421.question: How can signalling traffic be intercepted and decrypted in roaming scenarios?
question_44421.ground_truth: In roaming scenarios, intercepting and decrypting signalling traffic requires an interoperation agreement between the visited network and the entity handling KMS. The KMS, typically located in the home network, needs to establish the needed session keys with the corresponding users. If the visited network is not involved in the encryption, only encrypted content would be available for LI in that network.

question_44422.question: What does the GERAN-Vector AVP contain in the 3GPP 29.061-800 specification?
question_44422.ground_truth: The GERAN-Vector AVP is of type Grouped, and it shall contain a GERAN Vector, which includes the RAND, SRES, and Kc for GERAN authentication and authorization.

question_44424.question: In which scenarios can the PCRF based P-CSCF restoration be used in roaming scenarios?
question_44424.ground_truth: The PCRF based P-CSCF restoration can be used in roaming scenarios if both HPLMN and VPLMN support it, or when HPLMN does not support it but VPLMN does and NAT is not performed.

question_44425.question: What is the role of the SL Positioning Server UE in the 3GPP architecture?
question_44425.ground_truth: The SL Positioning Server UE is responsible for performing positioning calculations for the SL Positioning Client UE using measurements received from the SL Reference UE and/or the Target UE.

question_44426.question: What message does the UE(MCVideo Client) send to the SS(MCVideo Server) to establish a MCVideo Imminent Peril Chat Group Call?
question_44426.ground_truth: The UE(MCVideo Client) sends a SIP INVITE message to the SS(MCVideo Server) to establish a MCVideo Imminent Peril Chat Group Call.

question_44427.question: What does the abbreviation GPS stand for?

question_44428.question: What existing interfaces need to be upgraded to support Model B discovery?
question_44428.ground_truth: PC3, PC6, and PC7 interfaces need to be upgraded to support Model B discovery.

question_44429.question: What must a load/3GP-DASH client support in order to comply with this specification?
question_44429.ground_truth: A load/3GP-DASH client must support the formats and codecs as specified in this specification, access services as defined in clause 5.2, use the supported protocols as specified in clause 5.3, and conform to the specific features and formats outlined in clauses 6, 7, 10, and 13.

question_44430.question: What should the AMF do with the UE's PDU sessions when the UE de-registers for 5GS services over non-3GPP access?
question_44430.ground_truth: When the UE de-registers for 5GS services over non-3GPP access, the AMF shall release the PDU sessions for this particular UE locally without peer-to-peer signaling between the UE and the network.

question_44431.question: What is the primary objective of solution #8 regarding V2X application function influence in edge computing?
question_44431.ground_truth: The main goal is to make use of the Application Function (AF) influence on traffic routing feature to support edge computing for V2X, allowing efficient routing of V2X messages or traffic to/from V2X Application Servers in a local DN.

question_44433.question: What is the purpose of the transmitter exclusion band in the context of an AAS base station?
question_44433.ground_truth: The transmitter exclusion band in an AAS base station is the frequency range over which no tests of radiated immunity of a transmitter are made. It only applies to over-the-air (OTA) AAS base stations.

question_44434.question: What is the purpose of the UE Capability ID in TS 23.003?
question_44434.ground_truth: The UE Capability ID in TS 23.003 is used to identify the capabilities of a user equipment (UE) in a GTP-U tunnel for IAB.

question_44437.question: What message does the 3G/2G SGSN send to the target BSS during a PS handover preparation phase?
question_44437.ground_truth: The 3G/2G SGSN sends a PS Handover Request message to the target BSS during a PS handover preparation phase.

question_44439.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 9.2.16.1.4 of the document?
question_44439.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in section 9.2.16.1.4 of the document is to verify that the RSRQ measurement accuracy under time domain measurement resource restriction with CRS assistance information and non-MBSFN ABS within the specified limits for E-UTRA TDD type UE.

question_44442.question: What is the main goal of implicit feedback in the context of DL CoMP?
question_44442.ground_truth: The main goal of implicit feedback is to determine the best transmission strategy based on hypotheses such as single vs. multi-user MIMO, single cell/point vs. coordinated transmission, and transmit precoder.

question_44444.question: What is the purpose of the initial set of TPC commands with "Decrease Tx power" in the UTRA TDD test method?
question_44444.ground_truth: The purpose is to control the code domain power of the active DPCH to reach its minimum and measure it during the active chips of a transmit time slot TS i of the AAS BS.

question_44445.question: What is the purpose of an Anchor PDCCH in RPR mode?
question_44445.ground_truth: Anchor PDCCHs in RPR mode serve as a point in time where the MS can be contacted by the base station, similar to the paging occasions in Idle Mode.

question_44446.question: When attempting a packet access for signalling, what should the Low Access Priority Signalling field be set to in the PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message?
question_44446.ground_truth: The Low Access Priority Signalling field should be set to "1".

question_44447.question: What happens if the AF provides QoS duration and QoS inactivity interval?
question_44447.ground_truth: The PCF allocates resources at the beginning of each QoS duration interval and releases the resources at the end of the corresponding QoS duration interval. This process is repeated until the AF session is revoked.

question_44448.question: What type of traffic is the XDMS designed for?

question_44449.question: What is the role of the AA-Request command in the Rx protocol?
question_44449.ground_truth: The AA-Request command is used by the AF to request the authorization of resources for a specific AF session from the PCRF.

question_44450.question: What information is required to isolate the impacts of a security breach at the WWSF?
question_44450.ground_truth: The IMS core needs to know the identity of the WWSF that authorized the user to access the IMS core to adequately address a potential compromise at the WWSF.

question_44451.question: What action is taken if an odd number of PCOMP values are used by a compression algorithm?
question_44451.ground_truth: The last PCOMP value is set to 0 in the compression field by the transmitting SNDCP entity, and it is ignored by the receiving SNDCP entity.

question_44452.question: What is the effect of the absence of the "App-ID" node on the evaluation of an IP flow?
question_44452.ground_truth: The absence of the "App-ID" node indicates that the application identifier is not examined when matching packets against the IP flow description of the rule.

question_44454.question: What is the role of the CAS in the ACR scenario if the CAS initiates it?
question_44454.ground_truth: During the ACR execution phase, the CAS needs to know the EES before continuing with T-EAS discovery. Once the CAS knows the EES, the T-EAS discovery and the remaining steps are similar to the "S-EAS decided ACR scenario" as specified in TS 23.558 clause 8.8.2.4.

question_44455.question: When should the UE keep the TCP connection during the entire duration of the emergency session?
question_44455.ground_truth: If the response for the initial INVITE request indicates that the UE is behind NAT, and the INVITE request was sent over TCP connection, the UE shall keep the TCP connection during the entire duration of the emergency session.

question_44456.question: How does the frequency of operation impact the achievable throughput and burst durations in the considered AL-FEC applications?
question_44456.ground_truth: At higher frequencies, the impact of coherence time on burst durations is that, with the same FEC latency budget, losses bursts are shorter at higher frequencies, leading to similar or better performance for RLC due to shorter loss bursts in high-frequency usage.

question_44458.question: What does the CRITICALITY status REJECT imply?
question_44458.ground_truth: The REJECT criticality status means that the system should reject the request because it doesn't meet the criteria.

question_44461.question: Which TS document specifies the conformance requirements related to the current test case?
question_44461.ground_truth: The conformance requirements for this test case are specified in TS 24.379, clauses 10.1.2.2.1.1, 10.1.2.2.1.2, 6.2.6 and TS 24.380, clauses 6.2.4.2.3, 6.2.4.3.2, 6.2.4.3.2 unless otherwise stated, these are Rel-13 requirements.

question_44462.question: Which requirements for FR2 Power Class 6 are applicable for the UE type of high speed train roof-mounted UE?
question_44462.ground_truth: For Rel-17 FR2 power class 6 for the UE type of high speed train roof-mounted UE, UE shall only be in NR SA operation, and specific measurement and evaluation period requirements, delay requirements, and UL timing adjustment requirements are applicable when any two SSBs from non-collocated adjacent RRHs are not on the same or consecutive symbols.

question_44463.question: What are the power efficiency requirements for MTC devices in the 3GPP study?
question_44463.ground_truth: The power consumption of MTC devices is required to be reduced compared with legacy GPRS (non EGPRS), so that they can have up to ten years battery life with a battery capacity of 5 Wh (Watt-hours), even in locations with adverse coverage conditions.

question_44464.question: What is the purpose of the Detach type IE in the EMM protocol?
question_44464.ground_truth: The Detach type IE in the EMM protocol is used to indicate the type of detach in a cellular network.

question_44465.question: What is the UL UPT gain or loss of SBFD deployment case 4 (FR1) for low and high load levels for the legacy TDD operator?
question_44465.ground_truth: For the legacy TDD operator, regarding the performance impact of semi-static SBFD to legacy TDD of another operator, there may be limited or large degradation for UL and DL performance. Specifically, for low load levels, the UL UPT gain/loss is (-13.50%, -21.26%, -16.74%), while for high load levels, the UL UPT gain/loss is (-24.39%, -0.53%, -0.90%).

question_44466.question: What process does the UE follow when requesting an IPv6 network prefix allocation with IPv4 address allocation in single-connection mode?
question_44466.ground_truth: The TWAG requests both IPv6 network prefix and IPv4 address in the Create Session Request or Proxy Binding Update message, allocates and sends the IPv6 network prefix to the UE in RA message, and allocates and sends the IPv4 address to the TWAG in the Create Session Response or Proxy Binding Acknowledgement message.

question_44467.question: What is the purpose of a test eCall?
question_44467.ground_truth: A test eCall is used to confirm that the IVS is capable of correctly sending the MSD to the Test PSAP and providing a voice circuit to enable communication between the tester and the PSAP.

question_44469.question: What is the purpose of charging data in the context of MBMS?
question_44469.ground_truth: Charging data is used to track and bill the usage of MBMS services. It is generated at the MBMS Transport Service layer and the MBMS User Service layer, and may be related to security procedures for the end user in addition to the usage of MBMS services.

question_44470.question: What is the function of RAN signalling in the 5GMSu system?
question_44470.ground_truth: RAN signalling is employed to support uplink Network Assistance functionality, allowing for interactions between RAN control and user plane entities for scheduling and passthrough functionality.

question_44472.question: What should the PCF set the value of AW to in the PCC rules if the XRM AF provides a Requested AW?
question_44472.ground_truth: The PCF should set the value of AW as the value of the Requested AW from the AF, if the value of AW is allowed based on the policy in the PCF.

question_44474.question: What must the UE do if it determines it will lose coverage and will become unavailable in the future?
question_44474.ground_truth: The UE must trigger the Mobility Registration Update procedure to inform the network of its unavailability. The UE may determine a Start of Unavailability Period and/or Unavailability Period Duration and include them in the Mobility Registration Update procedure.

question_44476.question: How does an instance match a list of alternative data types described using the OpenAPI "oneOf" keyword?
question_44476.ground_truth: An instance matches a list of alternative data types described using the OpenAPI "oneOf" keyword if it matches against one and only one of the alternative data types.

question_44477.question: What steps should be taken if an NE CA key pair is compromised?
question_44477.ground_truth: Existing security connections do not need to be torn down, but all NE certificates will need to be revoked. A new NE CA key pair must be created and used to issue certificates to all NEs in the operator's domain.

question_44478.question: What is the implementation option if no network slice is available for the camped PLMN or SNPN in non-3GPP access?
question_44478.ground_truth: As an implementation option, the UE may start a timer for re-enabling the N1 mode capability for non-3GPP access after it was disabled.

question_44481.question: What is one of the responsibilities of an AS when acting as an originating UA?
question_44481.ground_truth: An AS acting as an originating UA shall add an "as-addr" and an "as-id" element of the "fe-identifier" header field parameter to the P-Charging-Vector header field with its own address or identifier and application identifier to an initial request.

question_44482.question: What is one drawback of introducing multiple new RAT Types for satellite orbits?
question_44482.ground_truth: The drawback is that a single RAT type for satellite access might prevent the 5G system from using certain QoS profiles (5QIs) that meet user requirements due to the wide range of latencies possible in satellite networks.

question_44484.question: What is the purpose of the bootstrapping procedure during the STa Access Authentication and Authorization procedure?
question_44484.ground_truth: The bootstrapping procedure during the STa Access Authentication and Authorization procedure provides an ER server with keying material that will be used for further EAP re-authentication procedures using ERP.

question_44485.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP project's Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals?
question_44485.ground_truth: The purpose of the 3GPP project's Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals is to define the Open Service Access (OSA) Application Programming Interface (API) Mapping, specifically focusing on the user location - user status service mapping and its mapping to Session Initiation Protocol (SIP).

question_44486.question: What command is sent by the MGW when the "Distant Codec List" procedure is initiated?
question_44486.ground_truth: The MGW sends a NOT.req command with the necessary information.

question_44487.question: What is the requirement for occupied bandwidth for EN-DC with Tx Diversity within FR1?
question_44487.ground_truth: The occupied bandwidth requirement for E-UTRA single carrier specified in clause 6.6.1 of TS 36.101 and for NR single carrier specified in clause 6.5G.1 of TS 38.101-1 apply.

question_44492.question: Which range of private notify message error type values shall be allocated in 3GPP TS 24.502?
question_44492.ground_truth: The private notify message error type values between 15500 and 15599 shall be allocated in 3GPP TS 24.502.

question_44493.question: Which group took over the responsibility of specifying codecs and formats for MMS services starting from Release 5?

question_44498.question: What is the purpose of the Management service template in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project?
question_44498.ground_truth: The Management service template is used for the production of requirement specifications for management and orchestration of 3GPP networks.

question_44500.question: Which network component sends the RAT type information to the PCRF when dynamic PCC is deployed?
question_44500.ground_truth: The P-GW sends RAT type information to the PCRF when dynamic PCC is deployed and RAT type information needs to be conveyed from the P-GW to the PCRF.

question_44501.question: What is the target identifier format supported by the MDF2 for ETSI TS 103 221-1 or equivalent messages when provisioned over LI_X1 using the X1 protocol?
question_44501.ground_truth: The MDF2 supports the target identifier format of "IMPU" in ETSI TS 103 221-1 or equivalent messages when provisioned over LI_X1 using the X1 protocol.

question_44502.question: What is the purpose of Load Balancing (LB) in LTE?
question_44502.ground_truth: The purpose of LB is to handle uneven distribution of the traffic load over multiple cells and maintain high radio resource utilization and QoS for in-progress sessions.

question_44503.question: How are supplementary services characterized in 3GPP specifications?
question_44503.ground_truth: Supplementary services are characterized by using a set of operations involved in service provision and usage, such as provision/withdrawal, registration/erasure, activation/deactivation, invocation, and interrogation.

question_44504.question: What is the required BER for multicarrier BTS equipped with a multicarrier receiver under static propagation conditions and for input levels up to -40 dBm for Wide Area class?
question_44504.ground_truth: The required BER for multicarrier BTS equipped with a multicarrier receiver under static propagation conditions and for input levels up to -40 dBm for Wide Area class is less than or equal to 10-3.

question_44506.question: What was agreed upon at 3GPP GERAN#39 regarding common Link to System Mapping for DL and UL?
question_44506.ground_truth: It was agreed not to investigate further for DL and UL a common Link to System Mapping based on some proposals, but instead perform verification of L2S mapping in MTS-1 to MTS 4 scenarios.

question_44507.question: What protocol is used by the 5GMS AS to expose an HTTP/3-based endpoint to the 5GMSu Application Provider at reference point M2u for media egest?

question_44508.question: What should be done if an SEG has been removed from the network?
question_44508.ground_truth: The SAs shall be removed using device-specific management methods, and the operator of the SEG shall have the certificate listed in his CRL or OCSP server. Additionally, the SPD of the partner network may have to be adapted.

question_44509.question: What is the required block error rate (BLER) performance for PDTCH/MCS1 to 4 under the presence of two unwanted signals in both GMSK and 8-PSK modulations?
question_44509.ground_truth: The block error rate (BLER) performance for PDTCH/MCS1 to 4 under the presence of two unwanted signals in both GMSK and 8-PSK modulations shall not exceed 10%.

question_44510.question: What information about the successful credit request is passed as a parameter to the creditAmountRes() method?
question_44510.ground_truth: The session ID, request number, credited amount, reserved amount, and the request number for the next request are passed as parameters to the creditAmountRes() method.

question_44512.question: What are the time durations for T1 and T2 in the measurement control information?
question_44512.ground_truth: The time duration for T1 is not specified and T2 is 5122 ms for UE supporting power class 1, or 3202 ms for UE supporting other power class.

question_44514.question: When does the ECS identify the EES(s) based on the UE-specific service information and UE location?
question_44514.ground_truth: When neither Application group profile nor AC profiles(s) are provided.

question_44515.question: What must the SS do after the beginning of T2, regarding sending Active Set Update commands?
question_44515.ground_truth: The SS sends an Active Set Update command to remove cell 4 from the active set, and later sends another Active Set Update command to add cell 1 to the active set.

question_44516.question: What data type is specified for the "transaction-ID" element?
question_44516.ground_truth: The "transaction-ID" element is defined to be of type "xs:integer".

question_44517.question: What does the first digit of the version number in the 3GPP technical documents indicate?
question_44517.ground_truth: The first digit of the version number in 3GPP technical documents indicates the stage of the document's development. A value of 1 indicates that the document is presented to TSG for information, 2 means it is presented to TSG for approval, and 3 or greater indicates that the document is TSG approved and under change control.

question_44518.question: What is a Transfer Syntax Error in the context of ASN.1 decoding?
question_44518.ground_truth: A Transfer Syntax Error occurs when the receiver is not able to decode the received physical message due to issues such as violation of value ranges or list element constraints, missing mandatory elements, or wrong order of elements in ASN.1 SEQUENCE definitions.

question_44520.question: What is the requirement for interworking with IMS?
question_44520.ground_truth: The SMF shall use the P-CSCF discovery, N7 interface for policy and charging control of QoS flows for IMS media flows, and P-CSCF restoration for interworking with IMS.

question_44523.question: What is the purpose of the test defined in section 4.5.1.4.4 of the document?
question_44523.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the UE properly detects in-sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the PSCell when DRX is used.

question_44524.question: When must the UE meet the inner loop power control requirements?
question_44524.ground_truth: The UE must meet the inner loop power control requirements over the power range bounded by the Minimum output power as defined in subclause 6.4.3, and the Maximum output power supported by the UE.

question_44525.question: What is the duration of each dT period in the test procedure?
question_44525.ground_truth: Each dT period has the same duration, which is not specified in the test procedure.

question_44526.question: What action does the RAN take when a misbehaving UE is indicated by S-TMSI/ResumeID in the blacklist and the RAN is overloaded?
question_44526.ground_truth: The RAN rejects the UE with a wait timer and the UE does not connect to the RAN again during the wait timer period.

question_44527.question: When is a UE not required to perform BSIC re-confirmation for a cell on a BCCH carrier?
question_44527.ground_truth: If the UE detects on a BCCH carrier a BSIC which is indicated as not allowed for that carrier in the measurement control system information of the serving cell.

question_44528.question: How many isolators are used in the TX paths of an uplink dual carrier mobile and what is their function?
question_44528.ground_truth: Two isolators are used in the TX paths of an uplink dual carrier mobile. They are used to satisfy the requirements for emissions in TX and RX bands, with one isolator in the upper TX path dedicated for uplink dual carrier and one in the lower TX path that can be reused for single carrier mode.

question_44529.question: What is the action taken by SCC AS-1 when the Controller UE sends a release media request to release Media-B on Controllee UE-2?
question_44529.ground_truth: SCC AS-1 verifies the authorization of the Controller UE and sends a Release Media request towards UE-2 to release Media-B on UE-2.

question_44530.question: What is the difference between the Hybrid requirements set and OTA requirements set for the AAS BS?
question_44530.ground_truth: Hybrid requirements set is the same as the existing AAS BS Rel-13 set of conducted and radiated requirements whereas the OTA requirements set is the full OTA set of RF requirements which will be added as additional sub-clauses to the existing radiated requirements in the Rel-15 version of the technical specification TS 37.105.

question_44531.question: Who is responsible for registering notification endpoints in the described solution?
question_44531.ground_truth: NRF allows end-service consumers to register notification endpoints, which can be discovered by RCF for sending notifications.

question_44532.question: What is the potential requirement for V2X minimum QoS use case when an ambulance is supported?
question_44532.ground_truth: The 3GPP network shall be able to provide means to prioritize V2X message transmission for a UE supporting V2X serving specific purpose (e.g. ambulance or patrol car on duty).

question_44533.question: What type of system simulators were used for both synchronous and asynchronous network evaluations?
question_44533.ground_truth: Synchronous system simulators were used for both synchronous and asynchronous network evaluations.

question_44536.question: What does the measurement name CARR.AverageLayersUl represent?
question_44536.ground_truth: The measurement name CARR.AverageLayersUl represents the average value of scheduled MIMO layers per PRB per cell on the UL.

question_44537.question: What security mechanisms does IETF describe for securing an SRv6 network within a single domain?
question_44537.ground_truth: The security mechanisms described in IETF~draft-ietf-6man-segment-routing-header-18 only allow securing an SRv6 network within a single domain.

question_44538.question: Which interface should be implemented by the IM CN subsystem entities using the W2 reference point?
question_44538.ground_truth: SIP may be implemented as an option by the IM CN subsystem entities using the W2 reference point.

question_44539.question: What is the main purpose of the 26.12.2.1.2 test procedure?
question_44539.ground_truth: The main purpose of the 26.12.2.1.2 test procedure is to test that the MS shall correctly apply the handover procedure in the non-synchronized case when the call is in progress, and handover is performed between TCH/F with/without frequency hopping towards a TCH/F with/without frequency hopping, and the mode of either the current or the target channel is set to full rate speech version 2 (enhanced full rate speech).

question_44540.question: What type is represented by the enumeration "LocationType" in the 6.4.6.3.3 section?
question_44540.ground_truth: The enumeration "LocationType" represents the type of location measurement requested in the 6.4.6.3.3 section.

question_44541.question: In the context of network operation mode II, what is the initial state of the mobile station for test procedure 3?
question_44541.ground_truth: The mobile station is Idle Updated on cell A in MCC2/MNC1/LAC1/RAC1 (Not HPLMN).

question_44542.question: What is the requirement for the minimum number of correct events observed during repeated tests, as specified in the test?
question_44542.ground_truth: The requirement for the minimum number of correct events observed during repeated tests is 90%, with a confidence level of 95%.

question_44543.question: What is required to ensure the DSO can receive a consistent service from communication service providers, independently of the location?
question_44543.ground_truth: Standardized parameters and communication interfaces allowing secure and highly available exchange of management data, must be established for all DSOs and MNOs.

question_44544.question: What is the purpose of a COPS DRQ message in the context of 3G networks?
question_44544.ground_truth: A COPS DRQ message is used to indicate the release of a PDP Context to the PDF in 3G networks.

question_44545.question: What is the outcome of the VAL group communication in the procedure described in 14.3.4A.10.2?
question_44545.ground_truth: The VAL data is delivered over 5G MBS session (either broadcast or multicast session mode) and over EPS via an eMBMS bearer. The NRM server sends the necessary information related to receiving the DL VAL data in the form of the MapGroupToBearer.

question_44546.question: What is the role of the S-CSCF in determining a P-CSCF as reachable or non-reachable?
question_44546.ground_truth: The S-CSCF considers the P-CSCF to be reachable as soon as a SIP request, including REGISTER, is received from that P-CSCF.

question_44550.question: Which NR Transmit intermodulation requirements are applied for NR SL-U, and what priority is given to Power class 3 SL when operating concurrently with Power class 3 Uu in a licensed band?
question_44550.ground_truth: The NR Transmit intermodulation requirements defined in clause 6.5.4 of TS 38.101-1 are applied for NR SL-U. Power class 3 SL@Un-licensed operating concurrently with Power class 3 Uu@Licensed is considered the second priority if Power class 3 SL is agreed upon for single carrier operation in an unlicensed band.

question_44551.question: What is the relative accuracy of RSRQ in the inter-frequency case?
question_44551.ground_truth: The relative accuracy of RSRQ in the inter-frequency case is defined as the RSRQ measured from one cell compared to the RSRQ measured from another cell on a different frequency.

question_44553.question: What must the AF provide in the Optional Alternative Service Requirements, if the AF does not include a QoS Reference in the AF request?
question_44553.ground_truth: If the AF does not include a QoS Reference in the AF request, the AF must provide Requested Alternative QoS Parameter Set(s) in a prioritized order in the Optional Alternative Service Requirements.

question_44554.question: What is the purpose of TS 32.240 in 3GPP Technical Specifications?
question_44554.ground_truth: TS 32.240 specifies the common 3GPP charging architecture and provides an umbrella for other charging management TSs.

question_44555.question: What is the difference between an MCPTT imminent peril group call and an MCPTT group call?
question_44555.ground_truth: An MCPTT imminent peril group call is a special case of a group call where the group in-progress imminent peril state is considered cancelled when the call ends. The MCPTT user who initiated the imminent peril call or an authorized user may cancel the in-progress imminent peril state with an MCPTT imminent peril group cancel message. In contrast, a regular group call in the MCPTT system does not have these specific characteristics.

question_44556.question: What is the impact of a PCRF failure on PCC contexts and Diameter sessions?
question_44556.ground_truth: When a PCRF fails, the PCC contexts and Diameter sessions affected by the failure are lost in the PCRF.

question_44557.question: What does the SMF+PGW-C store in step 7 of the UUAA procedure?
question_44557.ground_truth: The SMF+PGW-C stores the results, together with the GPSI and the CAA-level UAV ID in step 7 of the UUAA procedure.

question_44558.question: What is the purpose of the Discontinuous Coverage Wait (DCW) timer in the context of UEs using NTN RANs?
question_44558.ground_truth: The DCW timer ensures UEs do not initiate 5G NAS signalling to 5GCN within a specific discontinuous period and allows UEs to determine the appropriate moment to trigger 5G NAS signalling based on broadcast satellite ephemeris data.

question_44560.question: What information is measured in the SFN-CFN observed time difference?
question_44560.ground_truth: The SFN-CFN observed time difference measures the time difference between the active cell and a neighbor cell that is in the same frequency.

question_44561.question: Under what circumstances would the UE obtain session parameters for the related MBMS download session transport?
question_44561.ground_truth: The UE would obtain session parameters for the related MBMS download session transport by using one of the following methods: pre-storing the related session parameters in the MBMS UE, pre-storing the session parameters in the MBMS application, acquisition via delivery over OMA PUSH, or downloading the session parameters from an HTTP server resolved from the Service Announcement FQDN.

question_44562.question: What procedure is used by the DTF of the VCC AS to update the Access Leg and the Remote Leg associated with the other end C's session in standard iFC processing at the CSCF?
question_44562.ground_truth: The DTF of the VCC AS uses the Access Leg Update procedure to update the Access Leg and the Remote Leg associated with the other end C's session in standard iFC processing at the CSCF.

question_44563.question: What should be the criteria when considering cell reselection to a cell on a lower priority NR frequency or inter-RAT frequency than the serving frequency?
question_44563.ground_truth: The UE should reselect a cell on a lower priority NR frequency or inter-RAT frequency if the serving cell fulfils Squal < ThreshServing, LowQ and a lower priority NR or E-UTRA frequency fulfils Squal > ThreshX, LowQ within the TreselectionRAT interval, and more than 1 second has elapsed since the UE camped on the current serving cell.

question_44564.question: Which type of service is currently used by most MTC applications for sending MT messages, but not for MO messages?
question_44564.ground_truth: SMS service is currently used by most MTC applications for sending MT messages, but not for MO messages.

question_44566.question: What is the purpose of the reference architecture model, reference points, and functional entities described in TS~23.682?
question_44566.ground_truth: These elements are used to facilitate communications with packet data networks and applications.

question_44567.question: What are the three methods for a customer to obtain service from the same slice that it uses in home network when roaming to another network?
question_44567.ground_truth: The three methods are: a) Define standardized slices, b) Define slices with comparable characteristics, and c) Define signaling to allow the HPLMN specific slices to be "ported" to a serving PLMN.

question_44572.question: What should the MUSIM UE in the CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message do when the Request type is set to "NAS signalling connection release" or "Rejection of paging", and it receives a SERVICE ACCEPT message in response to cases p and q in clause 5.6.1.1?
question_44572.ground_truth: The UE should treat the receipt of SERVICE ACCEPT message as the successful completion of the procedure and reset the service request attempt counter. It should not deactivate EPS bearer contexts locally.

question_44574.question: What resource URI variable is defined in clause 5.2.54.2 of the 3GPP TS 29.501 standard for the "5G MBS Group" resource?
question_44574.ground_truth: The resource URI variable for the "5G MBS Group" resource is "mbs-group-membership".

question_44575.question: What should the Node B do if the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message includes the Serving HS-DSCH Radio Link Change information and the Node B is required to setup the requested HS-PDSCH resources on the Serving HS-DSCH Radio Link?
question_44575.ground_truth: The Node B shall setup the requested HS-PDSCH resources on the Serving HS-DSCH Radio Link and include the HARQ Memory Partitioning IE in the HS-DSCH FDD Information Response IE in the RADIO LINK ADDITION RESPONSE message.

question_44576.question: What is the method of time synchronization in a 5G system where the UE provides time information to attached devices using implementation specific means?

question_44577.question: What is the responsibility of the SEAF in the 5G authentication and key agreement procedure?
question_44577.ground_truth: The SEAF is responsible for sending RAND, AUTN to the UE in a NAS message Authentication Request and forwarding the RAND and AUTN received in NAS message Authentication Request to the USIM.

question_44578.question: Who is responsible for selecting the new server and what factors are considered in this decision?
question_44578.ground_truth: The service provider is responsible for selecting the new server, taking into account the UE location, network delay, business requirements, computation resource, and storage resource of application servers.

question_44579.question: What is the mean power saving gain provided by the R17 PDCCH monitoring adaptation for FR1, DL+UL joint evaluation, DU, AR30 with 2 UL streams and high load in Source 18?
question_44579.ground_truth: The mean power saving gain provided is 11.25%.
