question_44580.question: Which legacy mobile services supported by 3GPP systems should be accessible at sea as long as the coverage of 3GPP systems is supported at sea?
question_44580.ground_truth: The list includes mobile internet access, real-time audio and video streaming, TV broadcast and multicast services, SMS, MMS, voice call and video call, etc.

question_44581.question: What is the format of the From header in a SIP MESSAGE request sent by the SM-over-IP receiver to create a delivery report?
question_44581.ground_truth: The From header should contain a public user identity of the SM-over-IP receiver.

question_44584.question: What action is taken when the payload of an MCData group standalone data request is for MCData user consumption?
question_44584.ground_truth: The MCData users of MCData clients 2 to n may be notified and the payload is passed to the just started application, if necessary.

question_44585.question: What is the role of the MBMS UE in receiving MBMS data?
question_44585.ground_truth: The MBMS UE hosts the MBMS User Services receiver function, which may receive data from MBMS bearer services or from unicast bearer services.

question_44586.question: What signal does the Public Safety UE-Network Relay Node broadcast to enable User-UEs to detect its presence and obtain time synchronization?

question_44588.question: What potential security requirements are listed for ensuring the security of the MSGin5G-1 to MSGin5G-4 interfaces?
question_44588.ground_truth: Confidentiality protection, integrity protection, and replay protection shall be supported on the MSGin5G-1-4 interfaces.

question_44589.question: What capacity does a Mobile Network Operator (MNO) provide to an OTT provider for delivering TV content in high resolution quality, minimum jitter, and low latency?
question_44589.ground_truth: A Mobile Network Operator (MNO) can provide dedicated broadcast capacity to an OTT provider for delivering TV content in high resolution quality, minimum jitter, and low latency.

question_44590.question: What is the role of temporal ID in H.265 (HEVC)?
question_44590.ground_truth: The temporal ID in H.265 (HEVC) is used for improved temporal scalability by signalling temporal ID in the NAL unit header, restricting pictures of a particular temporal sub-layer from being used for inter prediction reference by pictures of a higher temporal sub-layer, and specifying that each sub-bitstream extraction output must be a conforming bitstream.

question_44591.question: What is the process of assigning a ProSe Layer-2 Group ID to a V2X application group?
question_44591.ground_truth: The VAE server assigns a ProSe Layer-2 Group ID from the ProSe Layer-2 Group ID pool to a V2X application group ID and then delivers the assignment to the VAE client.

question_44592.question: What action does the UE take upon reception of sk-Counter when in E-UTRA/EPC or E-UTRA/5GC?
question_44592.ground_truth: Upon reception of sk-Counter in E-UTRA/EPC or E-UTRA/5GC, the UE updates the S-KgNB key, derives the KRRCenc and KUPenc keys, and derives the KRRCint and KUPint keys based on the received sk-Counter value and the KeNB key.

question_44593.question: What is the thermal noise power equal to, in dBm?
question_44593.ground_truth: The thermal noise power is equal to -99 dBm.

question_44594.question: What is the effect of using a one dimensional array of antenna modules and a special receive network in the One Dimensional Compact Range Chamber measurement setup?
question_44594.ground_truth: It results in a plane wave in the vertical direction, and eliminates the need for near field to far field transformation.

question_44595.question: What is the purpose of the Gm reference point when delivering the incoming session to the ICS UE?
question_44595.ground_truth: The Gm reference point can be used for communication of service control signalling, and if the CS bearer is used for the media, the Gm reference point may be used for communication of service control signalling.

question_44596.question: What is the method used to trigger the HTTP request corresponding to the network-initiated messages for EPC-level ProSe discovery?
question_44596.ground_truth: Either HTTP long polling or OMA Push can be used to trigger the HTTP request corresponding to the network-initiated messages.

question_44597.question: How does non-API level authentication occur between a client and the Framework via an underlying distribution technology mechanism?
question_44597.ground_truth: The client calls initiateAuthenticationWithVersion and specifies the desired authentication mechanism. The framework then returns a reference to the Access interface, which can be used for further communication and negotiation of the signing algorithm.

question_44598.question: What is the purpose of the N26 interface in 5GS?
question_44598.ground_truth: The N26 interface is used for interworking between the EPC and the 5GCN through E-UTRAN.

question_44599.question: What information is required for PLMNs offering disaster roaming?
question_44599.ground_truth: PLMNs offering disaster roaming require the information of applicability of Disaster Condition, disaster area, and the PLMNs with at least one functioning NG-RAN node in the disaster area offering disaster roaming to UEs in the disaster area, and the HPLMN needs to provide the access identities appropriate for the visited country when the UE roams.

question_44601.question: What should the SeNB do upon receiving the UE CONTEXT RELEASE message during EN-DC for E-RABs for which data forwarding has been performed?
question_44601.ground_truth: The SeNB should continue forwarding U-plane data as long as packets are received from the EPC or the buffer has not been emptied.

question_44602.question: What represents the relative priority for a session in the Reservation-Priority AVP at the AA-Request level?
question_44602.ground_truth: The Reservation-Priority at the AA-Request level represents the relative priority for a session in the Reservation-Priority AVP.

question_44604.question: What is one potential requirement for the 5G system in the context of accurate positioning for emergency services?
question_44604.ground_truth: One potential requirement is that the 5G system shall be able to provide positioning service with three-dimensional position accuracy and associated KPI targets, determined by regulatory agencies.

question_44605.question: What is the difference between Alternative 1 and Alternative 3 in the Access Transfer Preparation steps?
question_44605.ground_truth: The difference is that in Alternative 3, the UE and ATCF negotiate the voice codec and voice media bearer prior to the CS call, while in Alternative 1, these steps are performed after the CS call.

question_44606.question: What are the two procedures described in detail for the analytics solution?
question_44606.ground_truth: The two procedures described in detail are one for VAL server performance analytics, and one for VAL session/UE related analytics.

question_44607.question: What should the UE do if it has its location information available and wants to include it in the INVITE request for an emergency call?
question_44607.ground_truth: The UE should include a Geolocation header field in the INVITE request with the location information in a PIDF location object, and a Geolocation-Routing header field with a "yes" header field value to indicate that the location of the UE can be used by other entities to make routing decisions.

question_44608.question: In which search spaces is the UE not required to monitor an MPDCCH search space if any ECCEs corresponding to any of its MPDCCH candidates occur within a frame before and also occur within the next frame?
question_44608.ground_truth: MPDCCH UE-specific search space and Type0-MPDCCH common search space.

question_44609.question: When is it not required to perform the receiver test for subPRB allocation for a BS declared to be capable of E-UTRA with NB-IoT in-band operations?
question_44609.ground_truth: It is not required to perform the receiver test for subPRB allocation for a BS declared to be capable of E-UTRA with NB-IoT in-band operations if the BS is only required to pass the receiver tests for E-UTRA with NB-IoT in-band or guard band; it is not required to perform the receiver tests again for E-UTRA only.

question_44610.question: What is the requirement for X in the ACLR calculation in clause 9.7.3.2?
question_44610.ground_truth: X equals 9 dB in the ACLR calculation.

question_44611.question: What is the purpose of the "PDUSessionResourceSetupListSURes" in the "PDUSessionResourceSetupResponse" message?
question_44611.ground_truth: The "PDUSessionResourceSetupListSURes" contains a list of PDU session resources that have been successfully setup for the specific UE. This information is used to confirm that the network has successfully allocated the requested PDU session resources for the UE.

question_44614.question: What should the Node B do if it has received the COMMON MEASUREMENT TERMINATION REQUEST message for a measurement?
question_44614.ground_truth: The Node B should terminate reporting of the common measurements corresponding to the Measurement ID IE in the message.

question_44615.question: What information is included in the Link Modification Request message regarding new PC5 QoS Flow(s)?
question_44615.ground_truth: The Link Modification Request message includes QoS Info for each new PC5 QoS Flow, such as the PFI, PC5 QoS parameters, and optionally the associated ProSe identifier(s). Optional PC5 QoS Rules may also be included.

question_44616.question: What is the procedure when the MCVideo client receives an MBS session announcement from the participating MCVideo function?
question_44616.ground_truth: The MCVideo client follows the procedure in clause 16.2.2, with terminology mapping specified in clause J.3.3.

question_44617.question: When extending the application by adding new AVPs for a feature, what should be the setting for the M bit of the new AVPs?
question_44617.ground_truth: The M bit of the new AVPs should be cleared.

question_44618.question: What is used to identify a QoS flow in the 5G system, and how is it unique?
question_44618.ground_truth: A QoS Flow ID (QFI) is used to identify a QoS flow in the 5G system, and it is unique within a PDU session.

question_44621.question: What type of UE is required to meet the minimum conformance requirements defined in clause 5.6.5.0.1?
question_44621.ground_truth: EN-DC UE Rel-16 and forward supporting EN-DC with PSCell in FR2 and capable of acquiring CGI from neighbor NR cell using autonomous gap.

question_44622.question: What action is taken by the network when a lower layer failure is detected before the P-TMSI REALLOCATION COMPLETE message is received?
question_44622.ground_truth: The network considers both the old and the new P-TMSI as occupied until the old P-TMSI can be considered as invalid. The network may use the old or new P-TMSI for paging and may re-initiate the P-TMSI reallocation procedure if no response is received to the paging attempts.

question_44623.question: What are the two main programs for the implementation of the Enhanced aacPlus codec?
question_44623.ground_truth: The two main programs are enhAacPlusEnc.exe for encoding and enhAacPlusDec.exe for decoding.

question_44624.question: How is a communication service instance realized in a single network slice instance?
question_44624.ground_truth: The CSP receives a request to realize a communication service instance, performs feasibility checks, translates the service SLS into parameterized network slice template information, and checks the capacity of the network slice instance. If sufficient capacity is available, the communication service instance is assigned to the network slice instance.

question_44625.question: In subclause 10.2, what length of time is the TPI combining period, and when does it begin?
question_44625.ground_truth: The TPI combining period has a length of one slot and begins at the downlink slot boundary of the F-TPICH.

question_44627.question: What conditions should be met for the IRI-POI present in the Telephony AS or IBCF to generate an xIRI containing a STIRSHAKENSignatureValidation record?
question_44627.ground_truth: The IRI-POI present in the Telephony AS or IBCF generates an xIRI containing a STIRSHAKENSignatureValidation record when certain conditions are met, such as interacting with the VERIFICATION AS, receiving PASSporTs in the SIP INVITE request, and specific patterns in the Request URI, To headers, and P-Asserted Identity, From headers of SIP INVITE request.

question_44629.question: What is the impact of the described solution on existing nodes and functionality?
question_44629.ground_truth: The solution introduces new procedures between the MCPTT server and the IWF, increasing signalling load across IWF-1. It allows users from different systems to initiate group calls, but cannot be executed if the clients of one system cannot call a group on the other system, or when the LMR system uses only group regrouping or linked groups.

question_44632.question: When does a Collaborative Session establish, and the roles of Controller UE and Controllee UE are determined?
question_44632.ground_truth: A Collaborative Session is established when a UE (UE-1 or UE-2) controls media that corresponds to the solicitation from another UE (UE-2 or UE-1). Upon establishment, UE-1 becomes the Controller UE and UE-2 becomes the Controllee UE.

question_44634.question: What is the purpose of the "Each failed attempt to add a radio link shall be considered separately" statement?
question_44634.ground_truth: The statement indicates that each failed attempt to add a radio link will be accounted for individually.

question_44635.question: What happens if the SCEF receives a NIDD request while it is already buffering data and the quota or rate of data submissions has been exceeded?
question_44635.ground_truth: The SCEF sends a MT NIDD Submit Response with a failure cause and the flow stops at this step.

question_44638.question: What must the UE do if it does not receive any selection of NAS integrity and ciphering algorithms during a handover command in Evolved Packet System (EPS)?
question_44638.ground_truth: The UE continues to use the same algorithms as before the handover.

question_44639.question: What data type represents the Specific data for the CHF and includes which data type as one of its attributes?
question_44639.ground_truth: The ChffInfo <dataType> that represents the Specific data for the CHF and includes the data type as one of its attributes.

question_44640.question: When multiple EASs are discovered for a specific AC, what can EEC-1 do with this information?
question_44640.ground_truth: EEC-1 may select one or more EASs to enable AC communication with one of the selected EASs, considering the Grouping required information.

question_44641.question: What information does the MBS listening status report contain, and what is its significance for the MC service server?
question_44641.ground_truth: The MBS listening status report contains information about the broadcast reception quality from the MC service client. It helps the MC service server determine whether to stop or resume the unicast delivery toward the reported MC service client, ensuring service continuity for the client when moving out of the broadcast service area and re-entering it again.

question_44642.question: Which information element is used to indicate the cause of a Position Periodic Report?

question_44643.question: What is the purpose of the measurements performed by HeNB for interference mitigation and maintaining coverage?
question_44643.ground_truth: The purpose of the measurements performed by HeNB for interference mitigation is to provide sufficient information to the HeNB for the purpose of interference mitigation, while the measurements for maintaining coverage are to provide sufficient information to the HeNB such that the HeNB coverage can be maintained.

question_44644.question: What is the initial codec mode set in Step 2b for the Channel Mode Modify procedure?
question_44644.ground_truth: The initial codec mode is set to the 7.95 kbit/s mode in Step 2b for the Channel Mode Modify procedure.

question_44646.question: What information must be included in the same SIP header as the encrypted information in the CBC mode of AES?
question_44646.ground_truth: The same initialization vector (IV) must be included in the same SIP header as the encrypted information in the CBC mode of AES.

question_44647.question: What are the requirements for the coding of the Communication diversion service in 3GPP TS 24.229?
question_44647.ground_truth: The Communication diversion service in 3GPP TS 24.229 uses SIP messages and parameters. The SIP messages for redirection and certain parameters are specified in 3GPP TS 24.229. The service also uses headers such as the Privacy header, History-Info header, P-Asserted-Identity, GRUU, and cause-param.

question_44648.question: What is the purpose of the Re-authentication procedure for UAVs in the 5G system?
question_44648.ground_truth: The Re-authentication procedure is used to re-authenticate the UAV at any time after the initial registration, and it can be initiated by the USS or the AMF (when the networking supports UUAA during registration).

question_44650.question: What should a UE do when timer T3444 or T3445 expires and it is in the EMM-REGISTERED substate except for substates EMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH or EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE?
question_44650.ground_truth: The UE should stop other running timers, perform a detach procedure for EPS services only or for both EPS services and non-EPS services, delete any GUTI, TAI list, last visited registered TAI, list of equivalent PLMNs, and eKSI, and enter EMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE state.

question_44651.question: What should be the first response of the SoLSA MS after the SS is switched on in step b) of the test procedure?
question_44651.ground_truth: The first response from the SoLSA MS should be received on carrier 1 within 50 s after the SS is switched on.

question_44653.question: Which functional entity is used for the management of groups within the MC system?
question_44653.ground_truth: The group management server functional entity is used for the management of groups supported within the MC service provider.

question_44655.question: What are the two authentication schemes that the user equipment (UE) can support for authenticating with the SS?
question_44655.ground_truth: HTTP Digest authentication or GAA based authentication

question_44657.question: What is the general principle for selection of test points for UE additional maximum output power reduction for CA (A-MPR) test cases in TS 38.101?
question_44657.ground_truth: The general principle for selection of test points for A-MPR test cases is to test the minimum and maximum Total power backoff values and the maximum unbalanced Total power backoff among CCs.

question_44659.question: What information does the gNB-DU initiate to report the outcome of the F1 interface setup between a target logical gNB-DU and a target F1-terminating IAB-donor-CU?
question_44659.ground_truth: The MIAB F1 SETUP OUTCOME NOTIFICATION message

question_44660.question: What must the UE include in the ATTACH REQUEST message if it supports ciphered broadcast assistance data and needs to obtain new ciphering keys?
question_44660.ground_truth: The UE must include the Additional information requested IE with the CipherKey bit set to "ciphering keys for ciphered broadcast assistance data requested" in the ATTACH REQUEST message.

question_44661.question: What procedure is initiated by the S-GW in step 5?
question_44661.ground_truth: The S-GW initiates the Gateway Control and QoS Rules Request Procedure in step 5.

question_44663.question: What is the difference between the modal verbs "shall" and "should" in 3GPP Technical Specification documents?
question_44663.ground_truth: The modal verb "shall" in 3GPP Technical Specification documents indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, while the modal verb "should" indicates a recommendation to do something.

question_44664.question: In the procedure for erasure of call forwarding, what is the purpose of the CHANNEL REQUEST message with establishment cause set to "other services requested by the mobile user"?
question_44664.ground_truth: The purpose of the CHANNEL REQUEST message is to establish a parallel MM transaction before sending the CM SERVICE REQUEST with CM service type indicating "supplementary service activation".

question_44665.question: Which type of charging aspects are covered in the document?
question_44665.ground_truth: Charging aspects are addressed as far as SIP signalling is concerned.

question_44666.question: What percentage rate of correct cell re-selections is required for the E-UTRAN FDD FDD Intra frequency case for normal coverage?
question_44666.ground_truth: The rate of correct cell re-selections observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

question_44667.question: What functional entity is responsible for providing support for centralized floor control for on-network operation and distributed floor control for off-network operation?
question_44667.ground_truth: The Floor control server functional entity is responsible for providing support for centralized floor control for on-network operation and distributed floor control for off-network operation.

question_44668.question: What is required for the audio Operation Point definitions to hold?
question_44668.ground_truth: The audio Operation Point definitions require a collection of content formats, VR specific rendering metadata, and encoding format combined with a receiver that can decode and render any conforming bitstream.

question_44669.question: What is the purpose of the RAB Assignment procedure?
question_44669.ground_truth: The RAB Assignment procedure is used to establish new RABs and/or to modify and/or release already established RABs for a given UE.

question_44670.question: What is the finest granularity of QoS differentiation in a 5G system?

question_44671.question: What field in the Desired IAB-MT PSD range MAC CE indicates the maximum value for PSD range?

question_44672.question: What are the two alternatives for minimizing the break time in the voice path during domain transfer?
question_44672.ground_truth: The two alternatives are: a) triggering the forwarding of the CS call setup by the IWF after receiving the Inter RAT HO Command, and b) delaying the step 13 for a certain period and potentially enhancing the VCC application to introduce an MGW to the media path to maintain voice media continuity.

question_44673.question: What should the source BSS do during handover to a GERAN shared network for a GERAN supporting UE?
question_44673.ground_truth: The source BSS should provide PLMN index information corresponding to the selected target PLMN-id via the source RAN and indicate the RAI corresponding to the selected PLMN.

question_44674.question: What is the action taken by the CSI AS when it receives a SIP re-INVITE request or SIP UPDATE request with one or more 'm=' lines with the port number set to zero?
question_44674.ground_truth: The CSI AS shall act as specified in the clause 9.3.3.6.

question_44675.question: What does the alternative "Iu-CS based solution" include in its reference architecture?
question_44675.ground_truth: The alternative "Iu-CS based solution" includes reference points for control and user plane protocols between the MME, MSC, S-GW, and specific functional entities like the Iu-CS Adaptor (ICA). These entities handle the interworking with the MME for CS domain services over advanced PS access.

question_44676.question: What are the minimum conformance requirements defined in 6.3A.4.2.2.3?
question_44676.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are defined in clause 6.3A.4.2.0

question_44679.question: What does the abbreviation "eMLPP" stand for?

question_44680.question: What is the objective of generating the anchors in the described scenario?
question_44680.ground_truth: The objective of generating the anchors is to define detailed test conditions, verify the down scaling from 10 to 8 bit, set the verification status for the H.264/AVC anchors, and set the verification status for the H.265/HEVC test streams.

question_44681.question: What types of content can be ingested using the 5GMS architecture?
question_44681.ground_truth: The 5GMS architecture supports the ingest of live streaming content, on-demand streaming content, and static files such as images and scene descriptions.

question_44682.question: What is the meaning of the criticality information "Ignore IE and Notify Sender" in HNBAP messages?
question_44682.ground_truth: When the criticality information of an IE/IE group in an HNBAP message is set to "Ignore IE and Notify Sender", the receiving node shall ignore the procedure and initiate the Error Indication procedure when a procedure is received with a Procedure Code marked with "Ignore IE and Notify Sender" which the receiving node does not comprehend.

question_44683.question: What kind of communication system is commonly used to support the distributed application in this use case?
question_44683.ground_truth: Modern communication systems primarily use the international IEC 61850 standard to support this distributed application. It provides the required flexibility and interactivity for the implementation of self-healing functions.

question_44685.question: What should the MS do when it is in sub-state U2ws and considers itself not to be the originator of the group call?
question_44685.ground_truth: The MS should consider the transaction identifier received in the next GCC message from the network to be the TI of the group call.

question_44686.question: How do UPF and NEF enforce Small Data Rate Control when provided with 'number of additional allowed exception report packets per time unit'?
question_44686.ground_truth: When UPF and NEF are provided with 'number of additional allowed exception report packets per time unit', the 'maximum allowed rate' equals the 'number of packets per time unit' plus the 'number of additional allowed exception report packets per time unit'. UPF or NEF may enforce the uplink rate by discarding or delaying packets that exceed the 'maximum allowed rate', and they shall enforce the downlink rate by discarding or delaying packets that exceed the downlink part of the 'maximum allowed rate'.

question_44687.question: What should be the size of the uplink CS payload stream's new speech sample in each RTP packet, not including any redundant speech sample, if AMR is used with FEC by sending redundant frames?
question_44687.ground_truth: The sample size is defined as the size of the new speech sample in each RTP packet, not including any redundant speech sample.

question_44689.question: What is the role of a PLMN in the 5G system regarding roaming services?
question_44689.ground_truth: A PLMN in the 5G system can support both bi-lateral direct relationships with other PLMNs and make use of roaming service provider services toward different roaming partners. They can accept or reject registration attempts on behalf of the involved PLMNs based on the roaming agreements.

question_44690.question: What should be the @value of the Viewpoint descriptor in an Ensemble?
question_44690.ground_truth: The @value of the Viewpoint descriptor can either be a single unsigned integer or a tuple of integer values, separated by a white-spaces, specifying the azimuth and elevation of the centre point of the sphere region in units of 2-16 degrees relative to the 3GPP coordinate system for which this Ensemble has been optimized.

question_44691.question: What function is responsible for handling interrogation of CFB?
question_44691.ground_truth: The VLR is responsible for handling interrogation of CFB which returns the required information or error to the MS.

question_44692.question: What is a solution described to solve the long backhaul latency issue?
question_44692.ground_truth: The solution described is a UE assisted local cache solution, where local caching can be achieved by using a local path if the UE is legal for the selective acceleration (cache) request from the core network.

question_44694.question: What is the mechanism used to multiplex several RTP/UDP/IP packets in AoIP?
question_44694.ground_truth: The mechanism used to multiplex several RTP/UDP/IP packets in AoIP is to increase bandwidth utilization by combining them into larger but fewer IP packets. This is specified as optional functionality and requires the usage of RTCP for negotiation of multiplexing between the nodes.

question_44695.question: What is the "Application Identity" format for EPC-level ProSe discovery messages?
question_44695.ground_truth: The "Application Identity" format consists of two parts: the OS ID, which is a UUID as specified in IETF RFC 4122, and the OS App ID, which is a string containing the OS specific application identifier.

question_44697.question: What is the purpose of the test case described in 7.5.1.7?
question_44697.ground_truth: The purpose of this test case is to verify that the UE (User Equipment) properly detects out-of-sync for monitoring downlink CSI-RS based radio link quality of the PCell (Primary Cell) when DRX (Discontinuous Reception) is used.

question_44698.question: What is the difference between a local TLLI and a random TLLI?
question_44698.ground_truth: A local TLLI is built using a valid P-TMSI with the first two bits set to 1, while a random TLLI is built with the first bit set to 0, and bits 29 down to 27 set to 1, and the rest of the bits chosen randomly.

question_44699.question: What action does the VAE Server take when it receives an HTTP DELETE message for a valid Individual Downlink Message Delivery resource?
question_44699.ground_truth: The VAE Server deletes the resource and responds to the service consumer with a 204 No Content success message.

question_44700.question: What message does the SRNC send to the UE to confirm a cell update in URA-PCH?
question_44700.ground_truth: The RRC Cell Update Confirm message is sent by the SRNC to the UE to confirm a cell update in URA-PCH.

question_44702.question: What is the maximum number of thresholds for Excess Packet Delay?

question_44703.question: What is the reference measurement timing for inter-frequency measurements?
question_44703.ground_truth: The reference measurement timing for inter-frequency measurement is up to UE implementation and shall be based on the timing of one of the target cells.

question_44704.question: What is the maximum measurement reporting delay for Event 1A and Event 1F?

question_44705.question: What should the mobile station do when it receives a PACKET UPLINK ACK/NACK message requesting retransmission of RLC data blocks in the acknowledged mode of RLC data transmission?
question_44705.ground_truth: The mobile station should wait for allocation of uplink resources and then retransmit the RLC data blocks requested, restarting timer T3180 after each block is transmitted. It should then start timer T3182 and wait for a PACKET UPLINK ACK/NACK message as above.

question_44706.question: What is the delay uncertainty when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH in section 8.1.2.7.3.3?
question_44706.ground_truth: The delay uncertainty is 2 x TTIDCCH where TTIDCCH is the duration of subframe or slot or subslot when the measurement report is transmitted on the PUSCH with subframe or slot or subslot duration.

question_44707.question: What is the maximum allowed time for the UE to identify a new CGI of E-UTRA cell?

question_44709.question: What is the state of the MS in the initial conditions of the test procedure?
question_44709.ground_truth: The MS is in the GA-CSR-IDLE state in the service of the GAN cell.

question_44711.question: What feature does the MRFP need to support for the MRFC to include "a=rtcp-fb" lines related to the "3gpp-roi-predefined" parameter in the SDP answer?

question_44712.question: What is the name of the key generated by the AKMA WID, used for providing secure TLS connections between the UE and the AF?

question_44713.question: What is the intended use of the test suites designed for the 5GS UE conformance testing in TS 38.523-3?
question_44713.ground_truth: The test suites designed in TS 38.523-3 are intended for use in the 5GS UE conformance testing, specifically for the testing of the communication protocols used by the UE to connect to the 5G System.

question_44714.question: What should the MS do on returning to the idle mode as per Conformance requirement 26.8.1.3.5.6.2?
question_44714.ground_truth: On returning to the idle mode, the MS shall release the MM-connection and the CC-entities relating to the seven mobile terminating transaction identifiers shall be in CC-state U0, "Null".

question_44715.question: How many QoS Flow Identifiers can be included in the "PagingPolicyDifferentiation" SEQUENCE as per the 3GPP TS 38.300 standard?
question_44715.ground_truth: One QoS Flow Identifier can be included in the "PagingPolicyDifferentiation" SEQUENCE as per the 3GPP TS 38.300 standard.

question_44716.question: When should the UE send the initial INVITE request for an emergency session set-up for an unregistered user?
question_44716.ground_truth: The UE shall send only the initial INVITE requests to the port advertised to the UE during the P-CSCF discovery procedure.

question_44717.question: What is the minimum requirement for BS type 1-C regarding Tx spurious emissions for each antenna connector?
question_44717.ground_truth: The Tx spurious emissions for each antenna connector of BS type 1-C shall not exceed the basic limits specified in clause 6.6.5.2.

question_44718.question: How is the processing structure different in the single HARQ process and single E-DCH transport channel scheme compared to the non-MIMO case?
question_44718.ground_truth: In the single HARQ process and single E-DCH transport channel scheme, the processing structure is almost identical to the processing structure as defined in the legacy non-MIMO case, except for the introduction of S-E-DPDCH, which doubles the number of physical channels. There are now two separate interleaving/physical channel mapping stages- one for the E-DPDCH physical channels and the other for the S-E-DPDCH channels.

question_44719.question: What should the mobile station do when it receives a paging message containing a priority level for which automatic answering is enabled in group receive mode?
question_44719.ground_truth: The mobile station should automatically respond to the paging message containing a priority level for which automatic answering is enabled and equal to the ongoing call's priority level or higher, as specified in 3GPP~TS 03.67 subclause 11.3.2.4.

question_44720.question: What are the possible values of the privacy check related action indicator for call/session related case?
question_44720.ground_truth: The possible values are: "Location allowed without notification", "Location allowed with notification", "Location with notification and privacy verification; location allowed if no response", and "Location with notification and privacy verification; location restricted if no response".

question_44721.question: How is ACK/NACK & CQI coding affected by the introduction of time-dilated cells?
question_44721.ground_truth: The ACK/NACK & CQI coding remains unaffected by the introduction of time-dilated cells.

question_44724.question: What is the role of the "EAP-5G" method in the registration procedure via trusted non-3GPP access?
question_44724.ground_truth: The "EAP-5G" method is used between the UE and the TNGF in the registration procedure via trusted non-3GPP access for encapsulating NAS messages.

question_44725.question: What is the allowed maximum output power reduction (MPR) for UEs indicating IE dualPA-Architecture supported in intra-band non-contiguous CA power class 3 when B is in the range of 1.08 to 2.16?

question_44727.question: What does the NEF do with the first UE location it receives from the AMF or HGMLC?
question_44727.ground_truth: The NEF returns the first UE location to the consumer AF or consumer NF. If the LCS service request is LDR type, LDR reference ID will be included in response message, and H(V)-LMF may store the LDR request information at H(V)-UDR.

question_44729.question: What happens in clause 6a during a handover from 5GS to EPS or inter-system redirection to EPS with N26 interface?
question_44729.ground_truth: The UE initiates the TAU procedure when connected to EPS.

question_44730.question: What should the MCX Service provide to support coordination between mission critical services?
question_44730.ground_truth: The MCX Service should provide a mechanism for MCX Services used by the same mission critical group to interact with each other.

question_44731.question: What should the UE do if the SQN parameter derived from the 401 (Unauthorized) is out of range?
question_44731.ground_truth: If the SQN parameter derived from the 401 (Unauthorized) is out of range, the UE should respond with a further REGISTER indicating that the challenge has been deemed invalid, and the subsequent REGISTER request should contain no "auts" Authorization header field parameter and an empty "response" Authorization header field parameter. Additionally, the UE should populate a new Security-Client header field within the REGISTER request and associated contact address, set to specify the security mechanism it supports, the IPsec layer algorithms it supports, and the parameters needed for the new security association setup.

question_44735.question: What should the MAC entity do if the number of consecutive DTX events reaches a predefined limit for a carrier applied for HARQ-based Sidelink RLF detection?
question_44735.ground_truth: The MAC entity should trigger the TX carrier (re-)selection procedure as specified in clause 5.22.1.11 and indicate HARQ-based Sidelink carrier failure to RRC.

question_44737.question: What TC message includes the GPRS Reference Number in the gprsSSF-to-gsmSCF messages?
question_44737.ground_truth: The InitialDPGPRS operation includes the GPRS Reference Number in the gprsSSF-to-gsmSCF messages.

question_44739.question: What message does the NG-RAN send to the UE in the RRC message?
question_44739.ground_truth: The NG-RAN sends an RRC message to the UE, the RRC message may include the N1 message.

question_44740.question: What is the impact of N:1 bearer mapping in the process described?
question_44740.ground_truth: With N:1 bearer mapping, UE bearers and backhaul bearers may not be set up or modified at the same time.

question_44741.question: What protocol control entities are responsible for realizing most functions of layer 3 and its sub-layers in the 5GS NAS layer 3 protocol?
question_44741.ground_truth: Protocol control entities are responsible for realizing most functions of layer 3 and its sub-layers in the 5GS NAS layer 3 protocol.

question_44742.question: What is the required confidence level and the minimum number of successful tests for the test to pass in the test described in 6.5.1.4.5?
question_44742.ground_truth: The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90% with a confidence level of 95%, and the total number of successful tests shall be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

question_44743.question: What ITU-T defined FCAPS network management domain does the Alarm IRP specifically deal with?

question_44744.question: What is the purpose of the L-CAAF within the ICS UE?
question_44744.ground_truth: The L-CAAF within the ICS UE enables communication between ICS UEs and the IMS network by providing necessary adaptation functions for I1-cs.

question_44745.question: What is not specified in the existing 3GPP management system regarding Network Function Services (MnS) exposure for NR and 5GC related performance?
question_44745.ground_truth: The definition and format of the authorization rule for network management capability exposure, as well as how to expose MnS directly from OSS.

question_44746.question: What is the channel data length in the RECEIVE DATA proactive command with a command number of 2.6.1?
question_44746.ground_truth: The channel data length is 200 in the RECEIVE DATA proactive command with a command number of 2.6.1.

question_44747.question: What should the UE include in the From header field of the INVITE request after a successful initial emergency registration?
question_44747.ground_truth: The UE should include the public user identity registered via emergency registration or the tel URI associated with the public user identity registered via emergency registration in the From header field of the INVITE request after a successful initial emergency registration.

question_44749.question: What are the two SL PRS resource allocation schemes that are considered for applicability of the above options?
question_44749.ground_truth: The two SL PRS resource allocation schemes that are considered for applicability of the above options are scheme 1 and scheme 2.

question_44750.question: What is a potential challenge when supporting service continuity for UEs that cross between the PLMN and the type-a network?
question_44750.ground_truth: Disruption of service when handing over between the two networks

question_44753.question: What is the length of the TMSI in bits?
question_44753.ground_truth: The TMSI consists of 4 octets which is equivalent to 32 bits.

question_44754.question: What reference points can be used by the MC service server to obtain unicast communication flows with appropriate QoS from the 5GS?
question_44754.ground_truth: The Rx/N5 or N33~reference point can be used by the MC service server to obtain unicast communication flows with appropriate QoS from the 5GS.

question_44755.question: Which statement describes the purpose of 52.10.2.2 test?
question_44755.ground_truth: The purpose of the 52.10.2.2 test is to verify that the IPA capable MS uses the correct Access Type in the EGPRS PACKET CHANNEL REQUEST for user data transfer with requested RLC mode as acknowledged.

question_44758.question: Which RFC specifies the syntax for the "isub-encoding" tel URI parameter?

question_44759.question: When must a UE obtain system information over the Uu interface?
question_44759.ground_truth: A UE is not required to obtain system information over the Uu interface, but it may decide to perform the SI acquisition procedure over Uu interface as defined in clause 5.2.2.3.

question_44760.question: What information is not needed in this solution for determining the delivery method and transport address?
question_44760.ground_truth: The push delivery method and transport address (UE_trp) are not needed in this solution as the MTC-IWF will select the trigger delivery method.

question_44761.question: What is the maximum measurement reporting delay for Test 1 and Test 2?
question_44761.ground_truth: The maximum measurement reporting delay for Test 1 is less than 4322 ms and for Test 2 is less than 30722 ms, including a 2 ms TTI (Transmission Time Interval) insertion uncertainty.

question_44762.question: What is the role of VNF application specific parameters and VNF non-application specific parameters in NFV?
question_44762.ground_truth: VNF application specific parameters are 3GPP service related and defined by 3GPP. Examples include network element name, network element address, etc. VNF non-application specific parameters are non-3GPP service related and defined by ETSI NFV ISG. An example of this is VM parameters.

question_44763.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 45.005, what does the abbreviation SCPIR stand for?

question_44764.question: What should be done when UL-SCH resources are available for a new transmission and the UL-SCH resources can accommodate the Enhanced BFR MAC CE plus its subheader as a result of LCP?
question_44764.ground_truth: The Multiplexing and Assembly procedure should be instructed to generate the Enhanced BFR MAC CE.

question_44767.question: What is the main advantage of the "Error concealment tools" in the Enhanced aacPlus decoder?
question_44767.ground_truth: The "Error concealment tools" in the Enhanced aacPlus decoder make the decoder robust against transmission errors like frame loss, thus mitigating audible effects of such errors.

question_44769.question: What is the main functionality of the replicator in the replication framework in a 3GPP system?
question_44769.ground_truth: The replicator in the 3GPP system enables the awareness of multiple replicated packet streams and optimizes their treatment in the 3GPP system. The Replicator functionality is conducted by the UPF or SMF for user plane and control plane, respectively.

question_44770.question: What is required to proceed with the next iteration, in case the iteration or random access procedure for BFD fails?
question_44770.ground_truth: To proceed with the next iteration, the SS must ensure the UE is in state RRC_CONNECTED with specific procedure parameters, and if that fails, switch the UE OFF/ON.

question_44772.question: Which MIME subtype name is used for FEC stream?
question_44772.ground_truth: The MIME subtype name used for FEC stream is "flexfec"

question_44773.question: What is the signalling message used to offer a waiting call to a busy MS?
question_44773.ground_truth: A waiting call is offered to a busy MS using a normal SETUP message including a "Signal" information element with value #7 (call waiting tone on)

question_44775.question: What type of transmission is required for an EGPRS PACKET CHANNEL REQUEST to indicate support of IMMEDIATE PACKET ASSIGNMENT (IPA)?
question_44775.ground_truth: A random reference is drawn randomly from a uniform probability distribution for every new transmission, and a capability indication is included in the request to indicate IPA support.

question_44777.question: What is the recommended action for networks to avoid having access attempts for non-always-on PDU sessions being blocked due to access barring of always-on PDU sessions?
question_44777.ground_truth: The recommended action is for networks to assign the highest precedence values to operator-defined access category definition which can be matched by always-on PDU sessions.

question_44778.question: What is the result of an attacker replacing a TAU message with an unprotected Attach Message?
question_44778.ground_truth: The attacker forces the MME to delete the UE bearers.

question_44781.question: What should the UE do when it resolves overlapping for PUCCH and PUSCH transmissions of different priority indexes?
question_44781.ground_truth: The UE drops PUSCH transmissions of smaller priority index that overlap with a PUCCH transmission with positive SR of larger priority index prior to multiplexing UCI in a PUSCH transmission of smaller priority index, if any.

question_44782.question: How does the MS identify the identity of the GANC and its SGW for setting up a secure tunnel?
question_44782.ground_truth: The MS shall be made known to the identity of the GANC and its SGW, in terms of the IP address or equivalent, through various mechanisms such as provisioning in the terminal.

question_44785.question: Where should the SSRC of the floor participant be included in the Floor Granted message?
question_44785.ground_truth: The SSRC of the floor participant should be included in the SSRC of queued floor participant field in the Floor Granted message.

question_44786.question: What should the UE do if it receives a SystemInformationBlockType12 that contains a complete warning message but missing geographical area coordinates?
question_44786.ground_truth: If the SystemInformationBlockType12 contains a complete warning message but missing geographical area coordinates, the UE should store the received warningMessageSegment, store the received warningAreaCoordinatesSegment (if any), and continue reception of SystemInformationBlockType12.

question_44789.question: What latency impact may occur with MPEG-H 3D Audio in terms of lip-synch and user head orientation?
question_44789.ground_truth: With orientation sensor inputs of an MPEG-H 3D Audio decoder changing, there will be algorithmic and implementation latency (perhaps tens of ms) between user head movement and the desired sound field orientation, which will not impact audio/visual synchronization (i.e. lip synch), but only represents the lag of the rendered sound field with respect to the user head orientation.

question_44792.question: What is the purpose of leaf nodes for luminance quantization parameter in video streaming?
question_44792.ground_truth: Leaf nodes for luminance quantization parameter are used to set a lower threshold for the image clarity to be maintained in video streaming.

question_44793.question: What should a P-CSCF include in the P-Charging-Vector header field when receiving a request from a UE performing the functions of an external attached network using static mode of operation?
question_44793.ground_truth: A "icid-value" header field parameter and a type 1 "orig-ioi" header field parameter identifying the sending network of the request.

question_44797.question: What is the name of the complex type that includes a sequence of "updated-filter" elements with the type "RestrictedDiscFilter-info" and an optional "anyExt" element of type "anyExtType"?
question_44797.ground_truth: The name of the complex type is "RestrictedMonitoringUpdate-info".

question_44798.question: What is the role of MCData client 1 in the MCData group?
question_44798.ground_truth: MCData client 1 is the sender of the MCData FD request, it sends the file metadata information and may initiate a mandatory download.

question_44800.question: What is the purpose of the EEC responding to the EES with an authorization token in this process?
question_44800.ground_truth: The EEC responds to the EES with an authorization token to authorize the ACR (Access and Move EES Context) to be used for the application context transfer from the S-EES and T-EES.

question_44801.question: Which method can be used to retrieve the remaining amount of the reservation?
question_44801.ground_truth: The method named 'getAmountLeft()' can be used to retrieve the remaining amount of the reservation.

question_44802.question: What does the ProSe Function in the HPLMN return after receiving the Auth Response from the ProSe Application Server in step 3.b?
question_44802.ground_truth: The ProSe Function verifies that the received PDUID belongs to the requesting UE and retrieves the ProSe Query Code and an associated validity timer in step 4.

question_44803.question: What should the MCVideo client do when an MCVideo user requests to end the ongoing MCVideo Chat Group Call?
question_44803.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should send a Transmission End Request and receive a Transmission End Response from the SS (MCVideo Server), and then send a SIP BYE request to leave the MCVideo session.

question_44804.question: What is the role of the KUR key in identifying URLLC services based on Dual Connectivity architecture?
question_44804.ground_truth: The KUR key is used to identify the URLLC services in case there are only two redundant data transmission PDU sessions of multiple PDU sessions.

question_44805.question: What does the bitmap in uplink resource allocation of type 0 indicate?
question_44805.ground_truth: The bitmap in uplink resource allocation of type 0 indicates the Resource Block Groups (RBGs) that are allocated to the scheduled UE, where an RBG is a set of consecutive virtual resource blocks defined by higher layer parameter rbg-Size.

question_44808.question: What is the difference between S5/S8-GTP and S5/S8-PMIP in the context of IP flow mobility solutions for S2b (GTP)?
question_44808.ground_truth: In S5/S8-GTP, the user plane is tunneled between the PDN GW and the ePDG, while in S5/S8-PMIP, the user plane is not tunneled between the PDN GW and the ePDG.

question_44809.question: What should the UE do if the user-plane resources of a PDU session have been successfully reactivated over the 3GPP access?
question_44809.ground_truth: The UE considers the corresponding PDU session to be associated with the 3GPP access.

question_44810.question: What action does the UE take if it receives a PDN MODIFICATION REJECT message with the NBIFOM container IE and a specific NBIFOM status parameter with an appropriate error value?
question_44810.ground_truth: The UE shall send a PDN MODIFICATION REJECT message with the NBIFOM container IE and include the NBIFOM status parameter with the appropriate error value.

question_44813.question: What should the MCPTT client do when the MCPTT User requests to upgrade the ongoing off-network MCPTT group call to an MCPTT emergency group call?
question_44813.ground_truth: The UE (MCPTT Client) should send a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message and enters the T1: in-progress emergency group call state.

question_44815.question: In what situation would a UE be required to repeat HARQ-ACK information in the Type-3 HARQ-ACK codebook?
question_44815.ground_truth: When a UE receives a SPS PDSCH or a PDSCH from a DCI format, or if maxCodeBlockGroupsPerTransportBlock is provided for serving cell c and pdsch-HARQ-ACK-OneShotFeedbackCBG is provided, the UE will repeat HARQ-ACK information.

question_44818.question: What is the signal level at the MS receiver input at which a certain BER must be achieved, as referred to in 14.2.5.1?
question_44818.ground_truth: The reference sensitivity for data channels

question_44819.question: What should the UE do if the security mode command cannot be accepted in a 5GS network?
question_44819.ground_truth: The UE should send a SECURITY MODE REJECT message indicating the cause of the issue, such as a UE security capabilities mismatch or security mode rejected with an unspecified cause.

question_44821.question: What should the UE do if it detects a GSM BCCH carrier with a BSIC that is indicated as not allowed for that carrier in the measurement control system information of the serving cell?
question_44821.ground_truth: The UE is not required to perform BSIC re-confirmation for that cell if it detects a GSM BCCH carrier with a BSIC that is indicated as not allowed for that carrier in the measurement control system information of the serving cell.

question_44823.question: What happens in step 2 when providing hybrid interactive services?
question_44823.ground_truth: In step 2, the media presentation manifest only points to content in the local Media Server, and steps 13, 17-20 are terminated on the local Media Server.

question_44824.question: What information is used to unambiguously identify a logical link between the MS and SGSN in the network layer routeing?
question_44824.ground_truth: In the MS, NSAPI identifies the PDP-SAP and between the MS and the SGSN, TLLI unambiguously identifies the logical link. The NSAPI may be related to either one IP address or two IP addresses (one IPv4 and one IPv6 if PDP Type IPv4v6 is supported and used).

question_44826.question: What should the UDM respond with when there is no valid shared data for one or more of the shared-data-ids?
question_44826.ground_truth: HTTP status code "404 Not Found" shall be returned with additional error information in the response body.

question_44827.question: What is the mapping between RANAP and BSSMAP assignment messages used for in the MAP-E interface?
question_44827.ground_truth: It is used for mapping RANAP RAB Assignment Response messages to BSSMAP Assignment Complete or BSSMAP Assignment Failure messages, based on the result of the RANAP message.

question_44828.question: What is the purpose of introducing the 'restoration indicator' flag in the SGs paging request message in another network?
question_44828.ground_truth: The 'restoration indicator' flag is introduced in the SGs paging request to force receiving MMEs to accept the request and proceed with CSFB or SMS procedures even in 'MME-reset = false' or unknown UE cases.

question_44829.question: What information must the PCF include in the PccRule data instance if EAS rediscovery is required?
question_44829.ground_truth: The PCF must include the necessary information to identify the traffic within the "appId" attribute and the "easRedisInd" attribute set to true.

question_44830.question: What is the required support needed for applicability of the E-UTRA HD-FDD UE Transmit Timing Accuracy Tests in clause 7.1.22.2?
question_44830.ground_truth: The required support is FGI bit 5 by all types of E-UTRA HD-FDD UE Release 14 and forward of UE category M2 and higher, including non-BL/CE UE.

question_44831.question: What actions can a UE take while in the RM-REGISTERED state in 5GS Registration Management?
question_44831.ground_truth: A UE in the RM-REGISTERED state can perform Mobility Registration Update procedure, perform Periodic Registration Update procedure, update capability information or protocol parameters by performing a Mobility Registration Update procedure, perform Deregistration procedure to no longer be registered with the PLMN, or enter RM-DEREGISTERED state when receiving a Registration Reject message or a Deregistration message.

question_44833.question: What mechanism does the 3GPP system use to provide a User Identifier for a non-3GPP device?
question_44833.ground_truth: The 3GPP system provides a User Identifier for a non-3GPP device that is connected to the network via a UE that acts as a gateway.

question_44837.question: What does the term "3G-324M codec" refer to in the 3GPP TS 26.114 document?
question_44837.ground_truth: The term "3G-324M codec" refers to the implementation of ITU-T Recommendation H.324 and all its elements adapted to the 3G environment, which consists of an encoder and a decoder.

question_44839.question: In the context of the BBF access network, what are SWx, SWa, and STa reference points used for?
question_44839.ground_truth: SWx is used for inter-operator charging, SWa connects the BBF AAA proxy with the 3GPP AAA Server/Proxy for transporting access authentication, authorization, and charging-related information securely, and STa connects the BBF AAA proxy with the 3GPP AAA Server/Proxy for transporting access authentication, authorization, mobility parameters, and charging-related information securely.

question_44840.question: What is the criterion for determining the PGW's APN related resources as compared to other PGWs in the network?
question_44840.ground_truth: The PGW's APN related resources can be determined by multiplying the APN-relative-capacity and DNS-weight-factor of the PGW.

question_44841.question: What is the purpose of a ProxyClass in the context of InformationObjectClass?
question_44841.ground_truth: A ProxyClass encapsulates attributes, links, methods, and interactions that are present in the represented InformationObjectClass and cannot define its own behavior other than those already defined by the represented InformationObjectClass.

question_44843.question: Where should the header compression be performed for minimizing the impact on the late entry KPI in MBSFN?
question_44843.ground_truth: The header compression should be performed within the BM-SC to minimize the impact on the late entry KPI.

question_44844.question: What is the purpose of the PVS IPv4 Address container contents?
question_44844.ground_truth: The PVS IPv4 Address container contents indicate the PVS IPv4 Address and, optionally, the related DNN and S-NSSAI.

question_44845.question: What action should the PCF take if MBS policy authorization is not successful or the required MBS policies are not allowed in an update request for an existing MBS Policy Association?
question_44845.ground_truth: The PCF should reject the request with an appropriate error response.

question_44846.question: What is the current issue with IMS charging correlation that does not allow the Billing Domain to judge its integrity?
question_44846.ground_truth: Currently, the Billing Domain does not know which IMS network element is generating offline charging information and is involved in an IMS call, making it difficult to judge the integrity of IMS charging correlation.

question_44847.question: What information must the NAF provide to the BSF regarding user identity?
question_44847.ground_truth: The NAF shall be able to indicate the user identity to the BSF. Both public and private identities are allowed.

question_44849.question: What is the purpose of the Allowed NSSAI in the registration procedure?
question_44849.ground_truth: The Allowed NSSAI contains S-NSSAIs that the UE has requested and that are allowed in the whole RA (i.e. each TA of the RA) and, in case of temporary slices, are currently available.

question_44850.question: How long does the MME store a PLMN assigned ID in the "UE Manufacturer Assigned operation requested list"?
question_44850.ground_truth: The MME stores a PLMN assigned ID in the "UE Manufacturer Assigned operation requested list" for a time duration that is implementation specific.

question_44851.question: What must the participating MCVideo function do upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP BYE request?
question_44851.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function shall send a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP BYE request received from the controlling MCVideo function and shall interact with the media plane for releasing media plane resources associated with the SIP session with the MCVideo client.

question_44852.question: What is the definition of a non-anchor NES cell without SIB in the context of 6.1.7.4?
question_44852.ground_truth: A non-anchor NES cell without SIB is a cell where the UE cannot receive SIB.

question_44853.question: What is the threshold value for overall delay measured for Test 1 in clause 16.6.1.3.5-1?

question_44854.question: What is the role of the AMF within the 5GC?
question_44854.ground_truth: The AMF, or Access and Mobility Management Function, is responsible for providing services to SMF, other AMF, PCF, SMSF, LMF, GMLC, CBCF, PWS-IWF, NWDAF, DCCF, NEF, TSCTSF, and MB-SMF via the Namf service based interface in the 5G System.

question_44856.question: What message does the HPLMN ProSe Function send to the announcing UE after receiving the Announce Alert Response message from the UE?
question_44856.ground_truth: The HPLMN ProSe Function sends a Discovery Request (UE Identity, Discovery Entry ID, Update Info) message to the UE, indicating the UE's identity and Discovery Entry ID.

question_44859.question: When should the UE transmit a MeasurementReport message triggered by Event A6 in this test procedure?
question_44859.ground_truth: The UE should transmit a MeasurementReport message triggered by Event A6 in this test procedure when the overall delays measured from the beginning of time period T2 is less than 12802 ms and at least 99.5% of all expected ACK/NACKS are detected by the system simulator from the start of T1 until the measurement report is received during T2 for PCell, and when the overall delays measured from the beginning of time period T4 is less than 3202 ms and at least 99.5% of all expected ACK/NACKS are detected by the system simulator from the start of T4 until the measurement report is received during T4 for both PCell and SCell2.

question_44860.question: How can a ProSe-enabled UE create a ProSe Group autonomously?
question_44860.ground_truth: A ProSe-enabled UE can create a ProSe Group in one of two ways: (1) by autonomously becoming a Group Owner, creating a new group identity, and serving requests from other ProSe-enabled UEs that want to become group members, or (2) by starting a ProSe Group after discovering another ProSe-enabled UE in close proximity, negotiating the Group Owner role, and starting the group as a two-member group.

question_44861.question: What should be done with TAB connectors not under test when connecting one for measurement?
question_44861.ground_truth: All TAB connectors not under test should be terminated.

question_44865.question: What is the source device in the SEND DTMF proactive command in expected sequence 1.1 and 1.2?
question_44865.ground_truth: The source device in the SEND DTMF proactive command in expected sequence 1.1 is the SIM, and in expected sequence 1.2 is also the SIM.

question_44866.question: What is the difference between MO and MT messages in SMS?
question_44866.ground_truth: MO messages are those that are sent from a phone, while MT messages are those that are received on a phone.

question_44868.question: What happens if the MCVideo ad-hoc group call request is not authorized by the MCVideo server?
question_44868.ground_truth: If the MCVideo ad-hoc group call request is not authorized, the MCVideo server and client shall not proceed with the rest of the steps.

question_44870.question: What is the role of the IOC (Network Slice Subnet Controller) in a 5G network?
question_44870.ground_truth: The IOC controls the lifecycle of the Network Slice Subnet MOI and handles network slice subnet related requirements in a 5G network.

question_44871.question: How can the sending data link layer entity deal with low priority Layer 3 messages when a "high" priority message arrives?
question_44871.ground_truth: When a "high" priority message arrives, the sending data link layer entity shall discard all preceding untransmitted Layer 3 messages using the same data link layer connection with "low" priority. If there are untransmitted octets in the low priority message, the first N201 untransmitted octets shall be discarded if the total number of untransmitted octets exceeds N201. The remaining N201 untransmitted octets, if any, shall be transmitted when permitted by flow control in a single I frame with the M bit set to "0". Low priority data that is not discarded shall be retransmitted if necessary until acknowledged.

question_44872.question: In step g) of the procedure for TCH/FS measurement, what is the fading function that the SS sets the MS into, when testing ARFCNs 5 and 964 for R-GSM~900 and ER-GSM 900, as well as the High ARFCN range?
question_44872.ground_truth: The SS sets the MS into a static fading function when testing ARFCNs 5 and 964 for R-GSM~900 and ER-GSM 900, as well as the High ARFCN range.

question_44874.question: How does Solution 4 address the availability requirement in a standalone way?
question_44874.ground_truth: Solution 4 is an enhanced version of RIBS, which is designed to work in a standalone way. This ensures that it can function independently, without requiring any other phase synchronization functions.

question_44875.question: What is the purpose of the Capability Transfer procedure in DL-AoD positioning?
question_44875.ground_truth: The Capability Transfer procedure in DL-AoD positioning is used to transfer the capabilities of the user equipment (UE) to the LMF, allowing the LMF to provide appropriate assistance data for the UE.

question_44878.question: What are the typical conditions that can trigger a network to initiate a handover?
question_44878.ground_truth: Handover may be initiated by the network based on RF criteria such as signal level, connection quality, power level propagation delay, and traffic criteria such as current traffic loading per cell, interference levels, maintenance requests, etc.

question_44879.question: What are the potential threats for device triggering in MTC communications?
question_44879.ground_truth: The potential threats for device triggering include false network attack and tamper attack. False network attack occurs when an attacker impersonates a network to send a trigger indication to the UE, which can waste the UE's power. Tamper attack occurs when the trigger indication is tampered by the attacker, causing the UE to establish a PDN connection to the wrong MTC server or be rejected by the MTC server, resulting in the inability to communicate with the correct MTC server and increased power consumption.

question_44880.question: What is the UE measurement requirement when the UE has evaluated that the serving cell does not fulfill the cell selection criterion S in consecutive T cycles?
question_44880.ground_truth: The UE shall initiate the measurements of all neighbour cells indicated by the serving cell, regardless of the measurement rules currently limiting UE measurement activities.

question_44881.question: What should the MS do if the SS sends an I+S frame numbered N(S)=NSS+KIM+1 mod(62) during the verification of KIM?
question_44881.ground_truth: The MS should ignore this frame and it should not acknowledge or reject it.

question_44882.question: What mechanism does the DSO use to provide the MNO with information about the expected time of energy service restoration?
question_44882.ground_truth: The DSO provides the MNO with this information by including it in the Interface Operations Container (IOC) that is created for the DSO's energy distribution service outage and rapid recovery.

question_44883.question: What is the effect of including an "orig-ioi" header field parameter in the P-Charging-Vector header field?
question_44883.ground_truth: It identifies the sending network of the request message and is used to determine the IMS communication service and matching initial filter criteria.

question_44886.question: What is the current status of the suitability of technical conditions of ECC DEC (11) 06 to 5G?
question_44886.ground_truth: The suitability of technical conditions of ECC DEC (11) 06 to 5G is being studied in 3GPP RAN4 based on the task from ECC Plenary (June 2016). The assessment is focused on the frequency bands 3400-3600MHz and 3600-3800MHz.

question_44887.question: What is the effect of having "topoff" in the existing SGW hostname in the S-NAPTR procedure?
question_44887.ground_truth: If the existing SGW hostname has "topoff", the candidate list of PGW is used in the order given to try to contact a PGW, after moving any colocated SGW/PGW to the front of the candidate list while maintaining relative order within that set.

question_44888.question: What signal is sent by the RNC upon successfully releasing the MBMS Iu signalling connection in the MBMS Session Stop procedure?

question_44890.question: What should the RNC do if it receives a RAB ASSIGNMENT REQUEST message containing a RABs To Be Released IE while there is an ongoing RAB Assignment procedure for a RAB indicated within the RABs To Be Released IE?
question_44890.ground_truth: The RNC should discard the preceding RAB Assignment procedure for that specific RAB, release any related resources and report the released RAB within the RAB ASSIGNMENT RESPONSE message.

question_44892.question: What is used end-to-end in TrFO manner after the codec change from EVS to AMR-NB?

question_44893.question: What is the role of a single company in introducing Technical Performances (TPs) in the current TR?
question_44893.ground_truth: A single company is responsible for introducing all approved TPs in the current TR, and it is the responsibility of the contact person of each band combination to ensure that the TPs related to the band combination have been implemented.

question_44895.question: Which metrics are used to gauge the distribution of RACH preambles sent based on the numberOfPreamblesSent-r9 value?
question_44895.ground_truth: The measurement is obtained by incrementing the measurement bin corresponding to the value of IE numberOfPreamblesSent-r9 reported by UE inside UEInformationResponse message. The measurement is incremented each time a UEInformationResponse message containing rach-Report-r9 IE is received.

question_44896.question: Which method does the IdP use to send an encrypted K1 to the RP inside a message which is sent via the UE?
question_44896.ground_truth: The IdP sends an encrypted K1 to the RP inside a message which is sent via the UE using the SIP Digest method.

question_44898.question: What is the purpose of the PC5 link in the UE-to-Network relaying procedure?
question_44898.ground_truth: The PC5 link is used for the connection between a Remote UE and a Relay UE, and is established in step 2 when the Remote UE provides its SUCI to the Relay UE.

question_44900.question: What is a use case for applying threshold conditions in the ATSSS work?
question_44900.ground_truth: Threshold conditions are used to specify how a steering mode should be applied based on a specific condition, such as requiring that the measured RTT of an access be less than 100ms for traffic to be transferred.

question_44901.question: What are the three BSSLAP messages used to handle error scenarios during the U-TDOA location process?
question_44901.ground_truth: The BSSLAP messages used for error handling are Reset, Reject, and Abort.

question_44902.question: What are the main reasons for GTP-C overload situations in a network?
question_44902.ground_truth: The main reasons for GTP-C overload situations in a network include internal resource capacity issues, deficiencies of GTP-C entity components, and GTP-C signaling based scenarios like traffic floods, large number of TAU/RAU requests, frequent transitions between idle and connected mode, exceptional events, scattered non-3GPP coverage, and mass mobility.

question_44903.question: What must the UPF do when the RAN load becomes lower or the report event happens (e.g. congestion ends)?
question_44903.ground_truth: The UPF resumes the data transmission to the RAN.

question_44904.question: What should the UPF support in order to report usage information to the SMF?
question_44904.ground_truth: The UPF should support periodic reporting, reporting based on usage thresholds provided by the SMF, and reporting on demand received from the SMF.

question_44905.question: What action should the MBMS interface take when receiving RTP media packets or floor control messages over the MBMS subchannel without an association to an ongoing conversation in a group session?
question_44905.ground_truth: It should ignore the received floor control message or RTP media packet.

question_44907.question: What types of networks is the 3GPP Trace Management IRP Solution Set applicable to?
question_44907.ground_truth: The 3GPP Trace Management IRP Solution Set is applicable to UMTS networks and EPS networks.

question_44909.question: What is the action taken when the received SIP re-INVITE request contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the `<emergency-ind>` element set to a value of "false" and is an unauthorized request for an MCVideo emergency group call cancellation in step 5a)?
question_44909.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function shall reject the SIP re-INVITE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response and include in the SIP 403 (Forbidden) response an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body as specified in annex F.1 with a `<emergency-ind>` element set to a value of "true".

question_44910.question: What is the main benefit of a deferred location for the UE availability event?
question_44910.ground_truth: It avoids reliance on notifying an external client when the UE next becomes available and requiring the external client to then issue an MR-LR request before the UE again becomes unavailable.

question_44911.question: How does the eNA feature support eV2XARC Work Item?
question_44911.ground_truth: The eNA feature is applicable to the eV2XARC Work Item, where the V2X Application Server acting as an Application Function (AF) may consume relevant network data analytics provided by NWDAF for the purposes of adjustment of the application, such as adjustment of the authorized QoS for a service data flow template.

question_44914.question: What are the PTC service events defined for PTC Service Registration in the PTC Surveillance Events?
question_44914.ground_truth: The PTC Service Registration event is defined for the PTC target registering, re-registering, or deregistering for a PTC service in the PTC Surveillance Events.

question_44915.question: What trigger event is responsible for generating the PF-DC-CDR for a specific group and ProSe one-to-many Direct Communication communication in event based charging?
question_44915.ground_truth: The trigger event for generating the PF-DC-CDR for a specific group and ProSe one-to-many Direct Communication communication in event based charging is the Received Direct Communication Usage Report event for a group.

question_44916.question: What should a participating MCPTT function do when it receives a floor control message other than the Floor Idle and Floor Taken message?
question_44916.ground_truth: It should forward the floor control message, restart timer T15 (Conversation), and remain in the 'M: A conversation is active' state.

question_44917.question: What should the MCPTT client include in the P-Preferred-Service header field of the SIP MESSAGE request when sending an MCPTT emergency alert?
question_44917.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should include the ICSI value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt" in the P-Preferred-Service header field.

question_44918.question: What is the name of the CR that provides the capability for management service consumers to discover the exposed management services in the 3GPP management system?
question_44918.ground_truth: 5G network and network slicing management supports a service-based management architecture where deployed management service instances are exposed by management service producers. This WI adds the capability for management service consumers to discover the exposed management services in the 3GPP management system.

question_44919.question: What type of emissions do not include out-of-band emissions in the definition of unwanted emissions?

question_44921.question: When is an SMTC occasion not available at the UE during FR2 inter-frequency measurements with CCA?
question_44921.ground_truth: An SMTC occasion is not available when the gNB fails to detect at least one candidate SSB position within the discovery burst transmission window for a given SS/PBCH block index.

question_44922.question: What measures are required to protect the NAS signaling between an IOPS-capable Public Safety UE and a local MME?
question_44922.ground_truth: The NAS signaling between an IOPS-capable Public Safety UE and a local MME shall be confidentially protected and integrity protected with replay protection.

question_44923.question: When is a UP entity considered to be overloaded?
question_44923.ground_truth: A UP entity is considered to be overloaded when it operates over its signalling capacity, leading to diminished performance in handling incoming and outgoing traffic.

question_44925.question: In what scenario would a UE use the first set of power control parameters for FR1 when provided with more than one?
question_44925.ground_truth: When the UE receives an activation command indicating one or two of the more than one sets of power control parameters for FR1.

question_44926.question: Which media feature tag and header field parameters shall the MCPTT client include in an Accept-Contact header field?
question_44926.ground_truth: The MCPTT client shall include the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag containing the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt" along with the "require" and "explicit" header field parameters in the Accept-Contact header field.
