question_46248.ground_truth: The traffic load in the cell represented in the Old BSS information or Inter-System Information information elements in the HANDOVER REQUEST message.

question_46249.question: What is the consideration for condition A3-1 and condition A3-2, as specified in TS 38.331, clause 5.5.4.4?
question_46249.ground_truth: The UE should consider the entering condition for this event to be satisfied when condition A3-1 is fulfilled and the leaving condition for this event to be satisfied when condition A3-2 is fulfilled. The variables Mn and Mp are expressed in dBm in case of RSRP, or in dB in case of RSRQ and RS-SINR. The offset and hysteresis parameters (Ofn, Ocn, Ofp, Ocp, Hys) are expressed in dB.

question_46250.question: What is the intended audience of the railway emergency communication within its two main purposes in railway operation?
question_46250.ground_truth: Alerting the drivers or other railway staff or users about an emergency, and exchanging additional information, when required, based on operational rules, are the two main purposes of this communication. The railway emergency communication consists of an alert phase and an optional voice and/or data communication phase.

question_46252.question: What action should the MS take if it cannot accept a modification request during network initiated PDP context modification?
question_46252.ground_truth: The MS shall initiate the PDP context deactivation procedure for the NSAPI that has been indicated in the message MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST.

question_46253.question: What must the GMM layer in the MS notify the LLC layer before sending an initial GMM message in a new cell in A/Gb mode if an established UMTS security context exists?
question_46253.ground_truth: The GMM layer in the MS must notify the LLC layer whether ciphering shall be used or not in such cases.

question_46254.question: What action should a mobile station (MS) take if it receives a MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REJECT message with SM cause value #26 and the Back-off timer value IE is included?
question_46254.ground_truth: The MS shall stop timer T3396 associated with the corresponding APN, if it is running. The MS shall then start timer T3396 with the value provided in the Back-off timer value IE and not send another ACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST, ACTIVATE SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST or MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message with exception of those identified in subclause~6.1.3.3, for the same APN until timer T3396 expires or timer T3396 is stopped.

question_46255.question: Which sublayers are responsible for the U-plane protocol stack in E-UTRAN?
question_46255.ground_truth: The RLC and MAC sublayers, which are terminated in eNB on the network side, perform the functions for the U-plane protocol stack in E-UTRAN.

question_46256.question: What is the role of the ProSe Key Management Function in providing PSDKs to the UE?
question_46256.ground_truth: The ProSe Key Management Function sends the relevant PSDKs to the UE using MIKEY after it has successfully responded to the Key Request message from the UE, if the check of step 2.ii is successful, and if the UE is authorized to receive keys for the requested discoveries.

question_46257.question: What does the "Stream-URL" parameter indicate in the "3GPP-QoE-Metrics" header?
question_46257.ground_truth: The "Stream-URL" parameter in the "3GPP-QoE-Metrics" header specifies the RTSP session or media control URL that identifies the media the metrics apply to.

question_46258.question: What should the UE do if it has its location information available while performing subclause 5.1.6.12.3?
question_46258.ground_truth: The UE shall provide the location information.

question_46261.question: What is the role of the Channel Number element in the messages on the A-bis interface?
question_46261.ground_truth: The Channel Number element is included in the messages to support the distribution of messages to relevant physical channels on the TRX. This ensures that the messages are sent to the correct radio channel on the transceiver.

question_46262.question: What is the role of the User Data Repository (UDR) in the 3GPP system?
question_46262.ground_truth: The User Data Repository (UDR) in the 3GPP system is a new facility that stores, manages, and provides easy access to user data for different services, promoting service and network convergence to support new services, including Internet services and UE applications.

question_46263.question: What is the purpose of the Immediate Connect supported for all circuit-switched basic services?
question_46263.ground_truth: It allows for the immediate establishment of a call for all circuit-switched basic services.

question_46269.question: What is the conformance requirement when a GPRS MS is already attached for non-GPRS services and wants to perform an attach for GPRS services?
question_46269.ground_truth: The combined GPRS attach procedure is performed as specified in 3GPP~TS~04.08 / 3GPP~TS~24.008 subclause 4.7.3.2.

question_46270.question: What shall the UE do if it receives a message used in a 5GMM common procedure before the de-registration procedure is completed?
question_46270.ground_truth: If the UE receives a message used in a 5GMM common procedure before the de-registration procedure has been completed, both the 5GMM common procedure and the de-registration procedure shall continue.

question_46271.question: What is the purpose of the procedure for providing the MME with EPS authentication vectors in 3GPP 33.102?
question_46271.ground_truth: The purpose of this procedure is to provide the MME with EPS authentication vectors (RAND, AUTN, XRES, KASME) from the user's HSS to perform user authentication. Each EPS authentication vector can be used to authenticate the UE during an EPS AKA procedure.

question_46272.question: What networks can be used for the MCPTT service?
question_46272.ground_truth: The MCPTT service primarily uses E-UTRAN, but certain application functions can be supported using MCPTT UEs in E-UTRAN or via non-3GPP access networks.

question_46274.question: What is the difference between the getMessageListRes() and getMessageListErr() methods?
question_46274.ground_truth: The getMessageListRes() method returns the result of a getMessageListReq() method, and it provides the list of messageIDs in the SCF, as well as an indication of whether the returned list is the final part of the complete list. On the other hand, the getMessageListErr() method indicates that the request to list the messageIDs was not successful, and it provides the error which led to the original request failing.

question_46275.question: What is the recommendation for the uplink TPC of the SHO UE to ensure sufficient reception quality for F-DPCH?
question_46275.ground_truth: The recommendation is that the uplink TPC of the SHO UE tracks the LPN F-DPCH SIR to ensure sufficient reception quality for F-DPCH in HetNet deployments.

question_46276.question: What is the role of the Slice-MBR (i.e. Total Slice-AMBR) in KI#5?
question_46276.ground_truth: The Slice-MBR (i.e. Total Slice-AMBR) in KI#5 limits the bitrate in a S-NSSAI, ensuring that the aggregate MBR of the SDFs of the PDU sessions of all UEs that use the slice do not exceed the Slice-MBR value.

question_46278.question: What is the initial state of the mobile station (MS) before the test procedure starts?
question_46278.ground_truth: The MS is in the active state (U10) of a call using a full rate TCH in non-hopping mode on cell A.

question_46279.question: What triggers the MC service server to send an IWF emergency alert request when an MC service user initiates an emergency alert?
question_46279.ground_truth: The MC service server sends an IWF emergency alert request when an MC service user initiates an emergency alert and there are affiliated group members that are homed on the IWF.

question_46280.question: What is the main factor determining the PA linearity requirement in FR1 as opposed to FR2-1?
question_46280.ground_truth: In FR1, the PA linearity requirement is dominated by out-of-channel emission requirements, such as ACLR, while in FR2-1, it is driven by in-channel requirements, such as EVM and in-band emissions due to spectral regrowth from IM3.

question_46281.question: What impact does DTMF sending have on the CAT service during multimedia calls?
question_46281.ground_truth: DTMF sending is currently not permitted during multimedia calls. However, a proposal has been made to allow DTMF sending during multimedia calls for specific CAT copy/stop commands. The transmission can be done through the H.245 UserInputIndication message during a multimedia call.

question_46282.question: What is the purpose of the "5G Wireless sensing" feature?
question_46282.ground_truth: The "5G Wireless sensing" feature provides capabilities to obtain information about the characteristics of the environment and/or objects within the environment using NR radio frequency signals.

question_46283.question: What display refresh rate is recommended to eliminate visible flicker in VR displays?
question_46283.ground_truth: A minimum of 90 Hz display refresh rate is recommended to eliminate visible flicker in VR displays.

question_46284.question: What information is included in the CSGinfo, and how is it displayed?
question_46284.ground_truth: CSGinfo consists of CSGType, HNB Name, CSGID, and CSG Associated PLMN MCC MNC, each delimited by a comma and in a particular order. It is displayed in alphanumeric format as CSGType, HNB Name, CSGID, and CSG Associated PLMN MCC MNC, and in numeric format only as CSGID and CSG Associated PLMN MCC MNC.

question_46289.question: What action does the CN take when it receives a RELOCATION REQUIRED message containing the CSG Id IE and the Cell Access Mode IE set to "hybrid"?
question_46289.ground_truth: The CN provides the CSG Membership Status IE of the UE and the target CSG Id to the target side.

question_46290.question: What type of handover scenario is described in 5.6.1, and when is it considered valid?
question_46290.ground_truth: This scenario is a concurrent CS and PS Handover from UTRAN/GERAN to UTRAN/GERAN, MOCN, with no combined procedure. It is valid for networks not broadcasting multiple PLMN lists.

question_46291.question: What is the measurement "DL Packet Loss rate on Uu" used for in the 5G network?
question_46291.ground_truth: This measurement is used to provide the DL packet (i.e., RLC SDU) Loss rate on the Uu interface for an NR cell and is used for performance assurance within integrity area (user plane connection quality) and for reliability KPI.

question_46292.question: What is the difference between the QoS profile contents for GBR and non-GBR QoS in 3GPP TS 23.287?
question_46292.ground_truth: For GBR QoS, the PC5 QoS profile contains the guaranteed flow bit rate (GFBR) and maximum flow bit rate (MFBR), while for non-GBR QoS, the PC5 QoS profile contains the PC5 link aggregated bit rate consisting of a per link aggregate maximum bit rate (PC5 LINK-AMBR).

question_46293.question: What triggers in a rating group may lead to several charging data requests when a request payload exceeds recommended values?

question_46295.question: What is the purpose of the GET method supported for the Location Information resource?
question_46295.ground_truth: The GET method for the Location Information resource is used to obtain the UE(s) information in an application defined proximity range of a location.

question_46297.question: What is the role of the AAA server in 5G networks?
question_46297.ground_truth: The AAA server is responsible for initiating the Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization, or the Authorization revocation procedure in 5G networks.

question_46298.question: What is the step taken by the EEC if the ACR complete notification indicates that EEC context relocation has failed after a successful ACR?
question_46298.ground_truth: The EEC can trigger EAS Information provisioning procedure to re-select the ACR scenarios.

question_46299.question: In which mode is the MS not allowed to accept a GSM authentication challenge if a USIM is inserted?
question_46299.ground_truth: In Iu mode, the MS shall not accept a GSM authentication challenge if a USIM is inserted.

question_46300.question: What note states that the MOVE command is not required if T1 has been already moved during the call establishment procedure?

question_46302.question: What action does the new MME take if a UE with at least one EPS bearer for emergency services tries to access a restricted TA?
question_46302.ground_truth: The new MME accepts the Tracking Area Update Request and deactivates all non-emergency PDN connections.

question_46305.question: How can an NF Service Producer discover AMFs within an AMF set or backup AMF?
question_46305.ground_truth: An NF Service Producer can use the Nnrf_NFDiscovery service to discover AMFs within an AMF set or backup AMF.

question_46306.question: What protocol is used between a gNB/LMC and a UE for positioning procedures?
question_46306.ground_truth: The LPP protocol (TS 36.355) is used for positioning procedures between an LMF and a target UE, and can also be reused between a gNB/LMC and a target UE.

question_46307.question: What is the related IMD problem for 4DL/2UL DC cases?
question_46307.ground_truth: The related IMD problem for 4DL/2UL DC cases is solved at lower DC band combinations such as 3DL/2UL DC combos and 2DL/2UL DC combos. There is no need to specify the MSD requirement for this DC combination.

question_46308.question: What can be achieved under sensitivity limited conditions in terms of performance improvement?
question_46308.ground_truth: Under sensitivity limited conditions, a higher inter symbol interference will result in slightly lower coverage. However, a considerable improvement can still be achieved.

question_46309.question: When can an MCX User be reached by its functional alias from within the MCX Service system?
question_46309.ground_truth: An MCX User shall be reachable by its functional alias from within the MCX Service system where the functional alias was activated, and while migrated to partner MCX Service systems.

question_46310.question: What component is responsible for translating Uu QoS information into PC5 QoS parameters in a UE-to-Network Relay?
question_46310.ground_truth: The UE-to-Network Relay is responsible for translating Uu QoS information into PC5 QoS parameters.

question_46311.question: What information is required to identify PDU Sets from 5GS traffic?
question_46311.ground_truth: Additional information about the SDF, which can be provided by the Application Function

question_46312.question: What should the MS (Mobile Station) do upon receiving a downlink user data message from the GANC (Gateway Access Point Node Controller) in the GPRS (General Packet Radio Service) network?
question_46312.ground_truth: The MS should restart TU4001 timer, extract the received LLC PDU and TLLI and forward the PDU to the LLC layer via the GRR SAP as per standard GPRS. The MS shall also increment the expected downlink packet sequence number for each GA-PSR-UNITDATA message received from the GANC.

question_46315.question: What is the method header in 6.2.7.24.1.1 for normal execution?

question_46316.question: When can the Railway Subsystem automatically register a FRMCS User or an FRMCS Equipment to a functional identity in the FRMCS system?
question_46316.ground_truth: Based on the user identification, operational conditions, like schedules when entering the train, location, time, recent activity, etc., the Railway Subsystem shall be able automatically register a FRMCS User or an FRMCS Equipment to a functional identity.

question_46319.question: What is the relationship between TRS and EIS in the Anechoic Chamber method?
question_46319.ground_truth: TRS is defined as the inverted integral of EIS over a sphere, where EIS is the minimum power level at which the throughput exceeds or equals 95% of the maximum throughput of the specified reference measurement channel.

question_46320.question: What happens if the NSACF indicates failure for the access different from the access over which the MA PDU Session Establishment Request is received, while the UE is registered in both accesses?
question_46320.ground_truth: The SMF accepts the MA PDU Session Request and does not provide a back-off timer to the UE.

question_46321.question: What action must the AMF take during the initial registration procedure if a new 5G-GUTI has not been allocated and the UE has been switched off and then switched on?
question_46321.ground_truth: The AMF must include the new assigned 5G-GUTI together with the assigned TAI list in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

question_46322.question: What happens if the request message contains several Modify elements, but the receiver implementation supports only one in a single message?

question_46323.question: What should the SS do if the MS recommends to use the 12.65 kbit/s in the downlink after the carrier to interference has been altered in step 4m?
question_46323.ground_truth: The SS should increment the successful C/I increase event counter.

question_46324.question: What should the network include in the ue-CapabilityRAT-ContainerList if the ue-CapabilityRAT-RequestList contains a UE-CapabilityRAT-Request with rat-Type set to eutra-nr?
question_46324.ground_truth: If the UE supports (NG)EN-DC or NE-DC, the network should include in the ue-CapabilityRAT-ContainerList a UE-CapabilityRAT-Container of the type UE-MRDC-Capability and with the rat-Type set to eutra-nr, along with the supportedBandCombinationList and featureSetCombinations.

question_46325.question: What action does the UE take when the RRCReject message is received in response to an RRCSetupRequest?
question_46325.ground_truth: The UE informs the upper layers about the failure to setup the RRC connection, and the procedure ends.

question_46326.question: What is the role of V-PSA in collecting and reporting charging information between UE and V-EAS?
question_46326.ground_truth: V-PSA collects and reports the charging information between UE and V-EAS based on the corresponding URR.

question_46327.question: How does NSQ adjust the data rates of the PDU sessions when the Slice-AMBR maximum limit has been reached?
question_46327.ground_truth: NSQ initiates a new request informing all SMF(s) which have active PDU session(s) associated with the same S-NSSAI to dynamically adjust the data rates of all the PDU sessions active for the S-NSSAI. NSQ includes the S-NSSAI, a cause code "Insufficient resources for specific slice or DNN", and the percentage or an absolute value of the data rate to be reduced for session-AMBR associated with PDU Session ID(s) of UE (2..n).

question_46328.question: What is the role of the eP-CSCF in verifying the web-page origin of the connection request from a WebRTC IMS Client?
question_46328.ground_truth: The eP-CSCF can verify that the web-page establishing the signalling connection comes from a trusted domain by inspecting the value of the Origin header, which is inserted by the browser in the WebSocket handshake and in every HTTP request.

question_46329.question: What does performance assurance of communication services include?
question_46329.ground_truth: Performance assurance of communication services includes the performance monitoring, performance analytics, and performance guarantee of communication services. It aims to restore the communication service performance to a level specified in the SLS or other service KQI descriptions as soon as possible.

question_46330.question: What component is used by each UE to identify and retrieve the security context/keys when receiving a message in this V2X Service-oriented method?
question_46330.ground_truth: A portion of the session identifier (i.e., Kd session ID) is used by each UE to identify and retrieve the security context/keys when receiving a message in this V2X Service-oriented method.

question_46333.question: What is the purpose of the FRESH value in the data integrity process?
question_46333.ground_truth: The FRESH value is a random number generated by the RNC to ensure that the user is not replaying old MAC-Is, and is an input to the function f9 to derive the MAC-I.

question_46334.question: Which type of UEs is the "halfDuplexRedCapAllowed" field applicable to, and in which message is it indicated?
question_46334.ground_truth: The "halfDuplexRedCapAllowed" field is applicable to (e)RedCap UEs and is indicated in SIB1 message.

question_46336.question: What information is returned by HLR~A during a general interrogation of CCBS?
question_46336.ground_truth: In response to a general interrogation, HLR~A returns the AddressOfB, BasicServiceCode and CCBS index for each CCBS Request in the queue, in chronological order.

question_46339.question: What should be the position of the antenna when testing equipment with a detachable antenna?
question_46339.ground_truth: The equipment should be tested with the antenna fitted in a manner typical of normal intended use.

question_46340.question: What is the appropriate HTTP status code for success when updating an Individual USS Change Policy using the HTTP PUT method?
question_46340.ground_truth: The appropriate HTTP status code for success when updating an Individual USS Change Policy using the HTTP PUT method is an HTTP "200 OK" status code.

question_46341.question: What is the maximum value that the "Queue Position Info" value can have if the MCPTT client is queued and the MCPTT server can determine the queue position?
question_46341.ground_truth: The maximum value that the "Queue Position Info" value can have if the MCPTT client is queued and the MCPTT server can determine the queue position is '254'.

question_46342.question: What uncertainty is allowed for when evaluating the maximum adjustment rate in any 200ms period?
question_46342.ground_truth: An additional 1/4 chip quantization uncertainty must be allowed for when evaluating the maximum adjustment rate in any 200ms period.

question_46343.question: What is a recommended approach for transmitting IMS Telephony service data in a space and transmission bandwidth efficient manner?
question_46343.ground_truth: A binary storage approach is recommended for defining IMS service data. This approach is space efficient, making it transmission bandwidth efficient as well, and can model various types of data associated with Telephony supplementary services.

question_46344.question: What are the two categories of methods for monitoring the accuracy of AI/ML model output in positioning?

question_46345.question: Over what interface is the CFSI bit used and what does it indicate?
question_46345.ground_truth: The CFSI bit (Change F-TEID support indication) is used over the S1-U and S5/S8 interfaces to indicate whether the SGW can change the assigned GTP-U F-TEID in the current procedure. If the SGW needs to modify the GTP-U F-TEID and the CFSI flag is set to 1 in the corresponding request message, the SGW shall include the new F-TEID in the Modify Bearer Response/Modify Access Bearers Response message.

question_46347.question: What is the purpose of using both EAP-AKA and certificate for bundled authentication in the context of device and hosting party authentication?
question_46347.ground_truth: The purpose is to authenticate the hosting party in addition to the device authentication, with the authentication flow being similar to the device authentication.

question_46348.question: What should the MCVideo client do when negotiated support of queueing Transmission requests is specified in clause 14, if a Transmission Queue Position Info message is sent to the requesting transmission participant?
question_46348.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include the queue position and transmission priority in the Queue Info field, and if the group call is a broadcast group call, a system call, an emergency call, an imminent peril call, or a temporary group session, it should include the Transmission Indicator field with appropriate indications.

question_46350.question: What is the condition that needs to be met in order to increase the confidence level of successful tests to 95%?
question_46350.ground_truth: The condition to increase the confidence level of successful tests to 95% is that the total number of successful tests should be more than 90% of the cases.

question_46351.question: What is the implementation margin for NF in IAB-MT reference sensitivity calculations?
question_46351.ground_truth: The implementation margin for NF in IAB-MT reference sensitivity calculations is 2dB.

question_46352.question: What action can an AMF take if a UE requests a S-NSSAI that is subject to insufficient network capacity for maximum number of UEs?
question_46352.ground_truth: The AMF can either include the S-NSSAI in the Partially Allowed NSSAI or reject it partially in the Registration Area (RA), depending on the local policy.

question_46354.question: What should the UE do if the network informs it should re-register to the network and the UE wishes to de-register for 5GS services over 3GPP access, or over both 3GPP access and non-3GPP access when the UE is registered in the same PLMN for both accesses?
question_46354.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the de-registration procedure with the appropriate access type.

question_46355.question: What is the required condition for the preferred primary precoding vector to be applied to the primary transport block in two transport block transmission?
question_46355.ground_truth: The preferred primary precoding vector is applied to the primary transport block in two transport block transmission when the CQI reported by the UE indicates a preference for two transport blocks and the preferred primary precoding vector corresponds to the highest reported CQI value.

question_46357.question: What is a solution for a deferred MT-LR location procedure for the UE availability event in EPC access that is aligned with the current MT-LR location procedure for the UE availability event for GSM and UMTS access?
question_46357.ground_truth: One solution is to add a deferred MT-LR location procedure for the UE availability event in TS23.271 for EPC access that is aligned with the current MT-LR location procedure for the UE availability event for GSM and UMTS access. This solution would allow an external client to request a deferred location for the UE availability event without having to know in advance which access type the UE is using.

question_46358.question: In the test procedure for measuring the average throughput, what is the purpose of the CW signal generator with interfering signals?
question_46358.ground_truth: The CW signal generator is used to ensure that the test procedure is performed in the presence of interfering signals. This is done to ensure that the throughput measurement is robust and accurate.

question_46360.question: What is the domain identity option for ciphering and integrity key in 8.5.4.4.1?

question_46362.question: When does the P-GW send an Accounting Request (Interim) to the Diameter server?
question_46362.ground_truth: Upon occurrence of a chargeable event such as RAT change, S-GW address change, QoS change, or IPv4 address allocation/release/re-allocation for deferred IPv4 addressing.

question_46365.question: What are the counters used to define the timing state of signals in CTS?
question_46365.ground_truth: In CTS, the signals transmitted by CTS-FP and synchronization is achieved with the help of the following counters: Quarter symbol number QN (0 - 624), Symbol number BN (0 - 156), Timeslot number TN (0 - 7), and TDMA frame number FN (0 to (26 x 51 x 2048) - 1 = 2715647). Additionally, the CTS-MS manages different sets of counters for CTS operation and GSM operation.

question_46366.question: What is the requirement for the SS to switch the power setting from T2 to T3?
question_46366.ground_truth: The SS shall switch the power setting from T2 to T3 after the SS receives the MeasurementReport message in step 8) or when T2 expires.

question_46367.question: What is the purpose of the maximumInterval field in the AreaEventReporting sequence?
question_46367.ground_truth: The maximumInterval field in the AreaEventReporting sequence specifies the maximum time interval between consecutive event reports, in seconds.

question_46368.question: What should the MCData client do upon receiving a "initial SIP INVITE request for SDS session for terminating MCData client" in TS 24.282, clause 9.2.4.2.4?
question_46368.ground_truth: The MCData client should follow the procedures for termination of multimedia sessions in the IM CN subsystem as specified in 3GPP TS 24.229, as clarified in subclause 9.2.4.2.4. The MCData client may reject the SIP INVITE request if it does not have enough resources to handle the call, and may display to the MCData user the MCData ID of the inviting MCData user and the type of SDS request.

question_46369.question: What is the result of the first REFRESH command?
question_46369.ground_truth: The result is that the command was performed successfully.

question_46370.question: What information does the "NCGI" attribute in an <app-specific-info> element provide?
question_46370.ground_truth: The "NCGI" attribute in an <app-specific-info> element indicates the NG-RAN Cell Global Identification of the NG-RAN cell where the UE was camping on or which the UE used in the 5GMM-CONNECTED mode when relaying the data.

question_46371.question: What is the penalty for not fulfilling the overall delays measured requirement in Test 1 and Test 2 of 5.6.2.3.5-1?
question_46371.ground_truth: If the UE fails to report the event within the overall delays measured requirement, the number of failure tests is increased by one.

question_46372.question: What security features should be transparent to the user or application?
question_46372.ground_truth: The security features such as AS confidentiality, AS integrity, NAS confidentiality, and NAS integrity should be transparent to the user or application.

question_46374.question: What protocol is used between the MRFC and the S-CSCF for establishing a media control channel?
question_46374.ground_truth: The protocol used between the MRFC and the S-CSCF for establishing a media control channel is based on Session Initiation Protocol (SIP), as specified in 3GPP TS 24.229.

question_46375.question: What must the UE (MCData Client) do when receiving an enhanced status via the SDS OFF-NETWORK MESSAGE message in the test purpose 7.2.2.1 of the TS 24.282 clause?
question_46375.ground_truth: The UE sends SDS OFF-NETWORK NOTIFICATION message with a disposition notification type of DELIVERED, initiates counter CFS2 (SDS notification retransmission) to 1, starts timer TFS2 (SDS notification retransmission), and renders the operational value of the received Enhanced Status ID as enhanced status to the MCDATA User.

question_46376.question: In which 5GMM state and mode should the UE be for receiving an RRCRelease message including mpsPriorityIndication and IE redirectedCarrierInfo to establish an RRC connection on the new frequency included in IE redirectedCarrierInfo?
question_46376.ground_truth: UE should be in 5GMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE state and 5GMM-IDLE mode for receiving an RRCRelease message including mpsPriorityIndication and IE redirectedCarrierInfo to establish an RRC connection on the new frequency included in IE redirectedCarrierInfo.

question_46379.question: What is the message type that the SMF or SMF+PGW-C sends to the UPF or UPF+PGW-U if any existing L2TP tunnel cannot be used to serve the PDU Session?

question_46380.question: What kind of data is Periodic-Time, Scheduled-Communication-Time, Stationary-Indication, and Validity-Time?
question_46380.ground_truth: These are all permanent data conditionally stored in the SCEF, HSS, and MME.

question_46383.question: What happens when the railway emergency call in the GSM-R system is terminated during an ongoing railway emergency voice communication?
question_46383.ground_truth: When the Railway Emergency Call in the GSM-R system is terminated, the railway emergency alert and the railway emergency voice communication in the FRMCS System is terminated too.

question_46384.question: When should the measurement logging be suspended due to IDC problems?
question_46384.ground_truth: If the UE detected IDC problems during the last logging interval and the measResultServCell in VarLogMeasReport is not empty.

question_46386.question: What should be the SS's action upon successful decoding of uplink power during time duration T5?
question_46386.ground_truth: The number of successful tests should be increased by one.

question_46387.question: What shall be done if the MS supports idle mode but idle mode indication is disabled on the SIM card?
question_46387.ground_truth: The SoLSA MS shall not display the LSA name of the current LSA to the user if the idle mode support is disabled and the idle mode indication is disabled on the SIM card.

question_46389.question: What is the role of the SGSN in interfacing with the MSC/VLR for optional CAMEL control using the Ge reference point?
question_46389.ground_truth: The SGSN interfaces with the GSM-SCF for optional CAMEL control using Ge reference point to support call-related and non-call-related services involving VLR and MSC. The CAMEL (Customized Applications for Mobile network Enhanced Logic) framework allows the SGSN to interact with the MSC/VLR for various services and functions.

question_46391.question: Which solution is feasible for 5G ProSe Direct Discovery charging with 5G DDNMF?
question_46391.ground_truth: Solution #1.1 is feasible for 5G ProSe Direct Discovery charging with 5G DDNMF.

question_46392.question: In what circumstances, should the LCG be mapped for IAB nodes between the ingress and egress links for Pre-emptive BSR?
question_46392.ground_truth: The LCG mapping between the ingress and egress links of an IAB node for purposes of determining expected change in occupancy of IAB-MT buffers (to be reported as Pre-emptive BSR) is left to implementation.

question_46395.question: What is the usage of the "Mean number of RRC Connections" measurement?
question_46395.ground_truth: The measurement of "Mean number of RRC Connections" is used for monitoring the number of RRC connections in connected mode during the granularity period.

question_46396.question: What is the requirement for PRS resources in the measurement period requirements for NR-Multi-RTT-ProvideAssistanceData and NR-Multi-RTT-RequestLocationInformation messages in 3GPP 5G NR physical layer in order to be measured during a certain time span?
question_46396.ground_truth: The time span of the PRS resource instance in the measurement period requirements for NR-Multi-RTT-ProvideAssistanceData and NR-Multi-RTT-RequestLocationInformation messages in 3GPP 5G NR physical layer should not be greater than the UE reported capability N.

question_46397.question: What is the difference in the handling of the "Time Alignment" field when the timing is to be advanced or delayed in the Static Time Alignment state?
question_46397.ground_truth: If the timing is to be advanced, the TRAU sets the "Time Alignment" field in the next downlink frame as ordered and then the 4 (2) last bits of the frame are not transferred (the T-bits). If the timing is to be delayed, the TRAU sets the "Time Alignment" field in the next downlink frame as ordered and then delays the subsequent frame by adding the appropriate number of binary "1" between the frames.

question_46398.question: What is the name of the channel model that is a simplification for less complex simulations and testing?
question_46398.ground_truth: An example of a simplified model is shown in Annex B.

question_46401.question: What kind of abstract syntax error occurs when the receiver gets an IE/IE group in the wrong order or with too many occurrences?
question_46401.ground_truth: Receiving IEs or IE groups in the wrong order or with too many occurrences will result in an abstract syntax error, causing the receiver to reject the procedure.

question_46402.question: Which type of NR UEs does the test described in section 7.6.15.2.3 apply to?
question_46402.ground_truth: The test described in section 7.6.15.2.3 applies to all types of NR UEs supporting concurrent gap capability from release 17 onwards.

question_46404.question: What should the P-CSCF do if it receives a 2xx response for a BYE request matching an existing dialog?
question_46404.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall delete all the stored information related to the dialog.

question_46406.question: What is the standard S1 interface in the context of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project?
question_46406.ground_truth: The standard S1 interface is a type of connection between the Home eNodeB Subsystem (HeNS) and the Evolved Packet Core (EPC). Specifically, it refers to the connection between the Home eNodeB (HeNB) and the Mobility Management Entity (MME) using the S1-MME interface and between the HeNB and the Serving Gateway (S-GW) using the S1-U interface.

question_46409.question: How is the power of the high-band excitation determined in the 23.85 kbit/s mode?
question_46409.ground_truth: In the 23.85 kbit/s mode, the power of the high-band excitation is decoded from the received gain index.

question_46410.question: What is not required for the AMF-based SAE binding mechanism to bind authentication vectors to SAE use?
question_46410.ground_truth: Requirement for changes to R99 USIMs is not required for the AMF-based SAE binding mechanism to bind authentication vectors to SAE use.

question_46414.question: Which type of UEs does the inter-frequency RRC re-establishment delay test apply to, starting from Release 17?
question_46414.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UEs from Release 17 onwards.

question_46416.question: In subclause 5.6.1.1 b), for location services message, what should the UE set in the Payload container type IE of the CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message?
question_46416.ground_truth: The UE should set the Payload container type IE to "Location services message container".

question_46417.question: What is required for the V2X Application Server to know which MBS session(s) are serving the target MBS service area to forward V2X messages?
question_46417.ground_truth: The V2X Application Server obtains the UE location information, such as geographic location or Cell ID, to determine the MBS service area and derive MBS session information.

question_46418.question: What message status code does the DCCF respond with when it successfully sends analytics data to all notification endpoints?

question_46420.question: How is the desired buffer size calculated in Solution 2?
question_46420.ground_truth: In Solution 2, the desired buffer size is calculated by estimating the size of the additional amount of data required to compensate for transport network delays, based on the transmission rate over the air interface and the transport network delay received from the control plane message sent by the node hosting the PDCP entity.

question_46422.question: What does the abbreviation CA stand for in the document?
question_46422.ground_truth: CA stands for Carrier Aggregation in the document.

question_46423.question: What is the tilt angle used in the talk mode testing of the DUT?
question_46423.ground_truth: The tilt angle used in the talk mode testing of the DUT is 6 degrees. This is used to simulate the DUT being positioned against the user's cheek during a phone call, while maintaining a consistent positioning and spacing between the DUT and the head phantom.

question_46427.question: What background noises were used in the evaluation of the HEAD 3-dimensional Playback of Acoustic Sound Scenarios?
question_46427.ground_truth: The background noises used were road noise, train station, full-size car 130 km/h, and cafeteria noise.

question_46428.question: In the provided format for MobilityRestrictionList, what does ENUMERATED mean in the context?
question_46428.ground_truth: Enumerated is a type definition that defines a list of possible enumerations for a field to take.

question_46429.question: When the SS starts T3 timer, how long until the SS shall start transmitting the RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection, as defined in step 10)?
question_46429.ground_truth: The SS shall start transmitting the RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection 170 ms after starting T3.

question_46430.question: What SIP URI parameter and its values should be included in the REFER request for roaming II-NNI?
question_46430.ground_truth: The "method" SIP URI parameter should be set to "BYE", "INVITE", or not present.

question_46433.question: How many main service states does the PS domain have in the CN?
question_46433.ground_truth: The PS domain in the CN has three main service states: PS-DETACHED, PS-IDLE, and PS-CONNECTED.

question_46434.question: What additional action does the MCPTT server take if functional alias is present in the ad hoc group call request?
question_46434.ground_truth: The MCPTT server checks whether the functional alias is allowed to be used and has been activated for the user.

question_46435.question: What message does the IRI-POI in the MME generate when it detects that the MME considers a service request procedure by the target UE to be completed successfully?

question_46437.question: Which key exchange protocol is suggested for solution #4?
question_46437.ground_truth: Elliptic Curve Diffie Hellman is suggested as the key exchange algorithm for solution #4.

question_46440.question: What is the PDU Session ID length?
question_46440.ground_truth: The length of a PDUSessionID is 8 bits.

question_46441.question: What is the maximum autonomous time adjustment step Tq used for in setting the test requirements and tolerances?
question_46441.ground_truth: The maximum autonomous time adjustment step Tq is used for setting the test requirements and tolerances for the UE transmit timing accuracy.

question_46442.question: What action does the UE take when it receives UPDATE UE LOCATION INFORMATION message?
question_46442.ground_truth: The UE stores the received location information and maintains it until reception of RESET UE POSITIONING STORED INFORMATION or UPDATE UE LOCATION INFORMATION message. Information not supported by the UE may be discarded.

question_46446.question: What is the requirement for SEALDD discovery using EEL?
question_46446.ground_truth: The requirement for SEALDD discovery using EEL is an enhanced EAS profile with seamless transport service continuity capability during EAS registration procedure, which supports TCP/TLS/QUIC context transfer.

question_46447.question: What action should the S-CSCF take when it receives a REGISTER request with a registration expiration interval value of zero and a "sos" SIP URI parameter in the Contact header field?
question_46447.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall reject the REGISTER request by sending a 501 (Not Implemented) response.

question_46448.question: What should the UE do if the additionalPmax is not present in the same entry of the selected additionalSpectrumEmission within NS-PmaxList, and the frequency band is selected from freqBandIndicator or multiBandInfoList?
question_46448.ground_truth: The UE should apply the p-Max.

question_46450.question: What API request is used to initiate the device triggering procedure in the NRM server?
question_46450.ground_truth: The device triggering procedure is initiated by an API request from a VAL Server.

question_46451.question: What is the criticality for the mBMSSessionStart RANAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?

question_46452.question: What should a participating MCVideo function do if the binding between the MCVideo ID and public user identity does not exist for a terminating SIP INVITE request?
question_46452.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function should reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response.

question_46453.question: What is the procedure that normal attached UEs follow to receive emergency bearer services?
question_46453.ground_truth: Normal attached UEs initiate the UE Requested PDN Connectivity procedure to receive emergency bearer services.

question_46454.question: How should the media-level b=AS bandwidth be aligned with the MBR of the bearer for several media streams?
question_46454.ground_truth: If a bearer carries several media streams, then it is the sum of the media-level b=AS bandwidths for those media streams that should be aligned with the MBR of the bearer.

question_46455.question: Which US state was the first to legalize medical marijuana?

question_46456.question: Which RFC profiles the format and semantics of certificates and Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs) for the Internet PKI?

question_46457.question: Which direction and timer is associated with the "InitiateCallAttempt" operation?
question_46457.ground_truth: The "InitiateCallAttempt" operation is associated with the gsmSCF (Serving Control Function) sending a request to the gsmSSF (Service Switching Function) and the Timer Tica.

question_46458.question: What does the SCC AS send to UE-2 after a successful session transfer?
question_46458.ground_truth: The SCC AS sends an IUT media and service control transfer response to UE-2, signifying the completion of the session transfer.

question_46459.question: What is the role of the AUSF in the 5G authentication procedure?
question_46459.ground_truth: The AUSF is responsible for deriving the KASEAF from the MSK and the KAUSF from the MSK. It also performs the authentication of the UE using the information received from the UDM and sends the authentication result to the AMF/SEAF.

question_46460.question: What are the fundamental procedures of SBI-based SM MO within SMS that need enhancements compared to 3GPP TS 23.040?
question_46460.ground_truth: The fundamental procedures that need enhancements are the procedures for SBI-based MO Message Transfer and other SM MO procedures in 3GPP TS 23.040 that are affected by SBI-based SM MO.

question_46461.question: In outdoor scenario B, what is the term used to refer to the 5th percentile of users, also known as 'tail' users, in the discussion provided in section 6.2.5?
question_46461.ground_truth: In outdoor scenario B, 5th percentile users are referred to as 'tail' users in the discussion provided in section 6.2.5.

question_46463.question: How is QoE information collected in mobile networks?
question_46463.ground_truth: QoE information is collected by the end user application in the UE and is then collected by the management system for analysis and/or Key Performance Indicator (KPI) calculations.

question_46464.question: What is the responsibility of the SMF in 5G architecture?
question_46464.ground_truth: The SMF is responsible for the enforcement of session management related policy decisions from the PCF, such as service flow detection, QoS, charging, gating, traffic usage reporting, traffic steering, and access traffic steering, switching and splitting within a MA PDU Session.

question_46465.question: What is the purpose of the Capability Transfer procedure in SLPP?
question_46465.ground_truth: The Capability Transfer procedure in SLPP enables the transfer of positioning and protocol capabilities related to SLPP and the positioning methods supported by it, from Endpoint A to Endpoint B.

question_46467.question: What measures should be taken when measured throughput in downlink is assessed during immunity tests?
question_46467.ground_truth: The output of the transmitter should be connected to equipment meeting the requirements for throughput assessment. The signal supplied to the equipment should be within the range for which the assessment of throughput is not impaired, and power control should be off during immunity testing.

question_46468.question: In what mode is the UE when it has user data pending over non-3GPP access and is in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode over non-3GPP access?
question_46468.ground_truth: The UE is in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode over non-3GPP access.

question_46469.question: What information elements are required for normal UE based testing for TS 37.571-1 subclause 6?
question_46469.ground_truth: The required information elements include GPS Reference Time, GANSS Reference Time, GANSS Time Model (for multi-GNSS tests), GPS Reference UE Position, GANSS Reference UE Position, GPS Navigation Model, GANSS Navigation Model, GANSS Additional Navigation Model, GPS Ionospheric Model, GANSS Ionospheric Model, GANSS Additional Ionospheric Model, GPS UTC Model, and GANSS Auxiliary Information.

question_46470.question: What is the maximum allowed power for the multicarrier BTS classes in case of an exception at -36 dBm?
question_46470.ground_truth: The maximum allowed power for the Wide Area, Medium Range, and Local Area multicarrier BTS classes in case of an exception at -36 dBm is -36 dBm, -42 dBm, and -50 dBm respectively.

question_46471.question: What types of services are in scope for the 3GPP's study?
question_46471.ground_truth: The services in scope include conversational voice and video services, messaging services, and supplementary services applied to the above.

question_46474.question: When performing a DCI-based BWP switch on a single CC, what is the maximum time duration before a UE can transmit or receive DL/UL signals after the BWP switch occurs?
question_46474.ground_truth: The UE is not required to transmit UL signals or receive DL signals until the first DL or UL slot occurs right after a time duration of TBWPswitchDelay which starts from the beginning of DL slot n except DCI-based BWP switch triggering on the cell where DCI-based BWP switch occurs.

question_46477.question: What is the length of the E-UTRAN/Satellite E-UTRAN Cell Identifier (ECI) for Satellite E-UTRAN?
question_46477.ground_truth: ECI has a length of 28 bits for Satellite E-UTRAN.

question_46478.question: What is the maximum power allowed for a GSM 900, DCS 1800 or T-GSM810 BSS in the bands 460.4 - 467.6 MHz and 488.8 - 496.0 MHz?

question_46479.question: What should be ensured before measuring the packet generation and treatment for MTSI-based speech with LTE, NR, or WLAN access?
question_46479.ground_truth: The clock skew between the UE and the reference client should be compensated by adjusting the clock of the reference client to match the clock of the UE, with an inaccuracy of less than 1ppm. Also, the packet generation by the reference client and the packet treatment of the test equipment should be free of jitter.

question_46480.question: When can a device estimate its coverage as necessary in EC-GSM?
question_46480.ground_truth: A device can estimate its coverage as necessary when it is not in packet transfer mode or in a power saving state.

question_46482.question: What action should the UE take if the TFT operation is an operation other than "Create new TFT" and there are semantic errors in TFT operations?
question_46482.ground_truth: The UE shall initiate a PDU session modification procedure by sending a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message to delete the mapped EPS bearer context with 5GSM cause #41 "semantic error in the TFT operation".

question_46483.question: What is the measurement provided by RAB CS connection set-up time (Maximum) in UMTS?
question_46483.ground_truth: This measurement provides the maximum time during each granularity period for a RNC to establish a RAB CS connection.

question_46484.question: What should the mobile station do when it receives an EC DOWNLINK ASSIGNMENT message while listening to the EC-PACCH?
question_46484.ground_truth: The mobile station should stop timer T3238, release the uplink TBF, and act on the assigned resources.

question_46485.question: What is the difference between "may" and "need not" in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network Technical Report?
question_46485.ground_truth: "May" indicates permission to do something, while "need not" indicates permission not to do something in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network Technical Report.

question_46487.question: Which automation pattern uses measurements of the actual output to compare the actual output with the desired output response?

question_46488.question: What is the relationship between 3GPP TS 28.653 and 3GPP TS 28.652?
question_46488.ground_truth: This Solution Set specification is related to 3GPP TS 28.652 V14.0.X.

question_46489.question: What is the frame rate that is considered sufficient for sending one XR Viewer Pose in alignment with the rendered video?
question_46489.ground_truth: A frame rate of 60fps (frames per second) is considered sufficient for sending one XR Viewer Pose in alignment with the rendered video.

question_46490.question: What should the MS do when starting the PS domain signalling connection?
question_46490.ground_truth: After starting timer TU5911 for the PS domain, the MS should transmit a GA-RRC ACTIVATE CHANNEL ACK message including the IE "CN Domain Identity" and the IE "PTC Activation Ack List".

question_46491.question: What is one of the conformance requirements for the IPA Uplink Assignment struct when one phase packet access is granted to a mobile station?
question_46491.ground_truth: When one phase packet access is granted to a mobile station, the IPA Uplink Assignment struct must contain parameters specific to different mobile stations, such as the temporary flow identity, USF value, EGPRS channel coding command for RLC data block, timing advance value, and the Radio Access Capabilities Request bit.

question_46493.question: What is the size of the HARQ process number field?
question_46493.ground_truth: The size of the HARQ process number field is 5 bits if determined by harq-ProcessNumberSizeDCI-0-2-v1700, or 0, 1, 2, 3, or 4 bits if determined by harq-ProcessNumberSizeDCI-0-2.

question_46495.question: What is the purpose of the ATSSS-LL functionality in the UE and UPF?
question_46495.ground_truth: The ATSSS-LL functionality is a data switching function that decides how to steer, switch and split the uplink traffic across 3GPP and non-3GPP accesses in the UE. In the UPF, the ATSSS-LL functionalityis enabled for a MA PDU Session by an ATSSS-LL functionality indication in the Multi-Access Rules (MAR). The ATSSS-LL functionality is mandatory for specific cases as detailed in the answer.

question_46496.question: What is the purpose of the WLAN Link Layer ID in the EPC support for WLAN direct discovery and communication?
question_46496.ground_truth: The WLAN Link Layer ID is used in addition to the EPC-level identities to support WLAN direct discovery and communication between two UEs. It identifies the link layer of the WLAN interface onUE, allowing the UEs to communicate directly, without relying on the cellular network.

question_46498.question: What is the purpose of the HTTP GET method for the "DAA Policies" resource?
question_46498.ground_truth: The HTTP GET method for the "DAA Policies" resource allows a service consumer to retrieve all the active DAA Policies managed by the UAE Server.

question_46499.question: What is the name of the lattice used in this speech coding system?
question_46499.ground_truth: The name of the lattice used in this speech coding system is RE8.

question_46500.question: What message does the NSSAAF send directly to the NSS-AAA or via the AAA-P for network slice specific authentication and authorization?
question_46500.ground_truth: The NSSAAF sends a Diameter DER message.

question_46501.question: What happens when a requested area event or motion event is detected and the minimum reporting time interval has elapsed since the last report?
question_46501.ground_truth: An event trigger is detected by the UE and reported to the LCS client if the UE can register via E-UTRAN access with a permitted PLMN.

question_46503.question: How does an SPS enable sharing among different layers in HEVC?
question_46503.ground_truth: By making sure all SPSs share the same vale space of their SPS IDs, regardless of the layer ID values in their NAL unit headers, SPSs can enable sharing between sequence parameter sets of different layers.

question_46505.question: What are the primary distinctions between the Linear Prediction (LP) synthesis filter and the Short-Term synthesis filter in the AMR-WB codec, and what are their frequencies?
question_46505.ground_truth: The Linear Prediction (LP) synthesis filter and the Short-Term synthesis filter in the AMR-WB codec are similar in their purpose of modeling and predicting the speech signal by analyzing and reconstructing its spectral characteristics. The Linear Prediction (LP) synthesis filter is also called the all-pole or long-term synthesis filter, and it consists of a series of poles (but no zeros) in the frequency domain. This is in contrast to the Short-Term synthesis filter, which is usually a 16th-order filter with additional zero and pole structures to shape the spectral envelope. The Linear Prediction (LP) filter has a transfer function of A(z), which models the LP parameters, and the Short-Term synthesis filter has a transfer function of H(z), which models the excitation and impulse response of the speech signal. Typically, the Linear Prediction (LP) filter is applied to the speech signal at a lower sampling rate (e.g., 8 kHz) for modeling the long-term characteristics of the speech signal, whereas the Short-Term synthesis filter is applied at a higher sampling rate (e.g., 16 kHz) to capture the detailed and fast-changing characteristics of the speech signal.

question_46506.question: What should be the input power distribution among the active DL CCs in order to meet the in-band blocking requirement for inter-band carrier aggregation with one component carrier per operating band and the uplink assigned to one NR band?
question_46506.ground_truth: The input power should be distributed among the active DL CCs so their PSDs are aligned with each other.

question_46508.question: What is the recommended approach to signalling mobile receiver capabilities?
question_46508.ground_truth: The recommended approach is to send a release-independent indication of receiver support to the network in the Mobile Station Classmark 3 Information Element and the Mobile Station Radio Access Capability Information Element.

question_46509.question: What field in Format 6-0B is used for 4 HARQ-ACK indications by bitmap, with the order of the bitmap to HARQ process index mapping in ascending order from MSB to LSB?
question_46509.ground_truth: The 4 LSB bits of the Scheduling TBs for Unicast Field

question_46511.question: What is the purpose of the HGMLC in the 5GC-MT-LR procedure?
question_46511.ground_truth: The HGMLC uses the reference number received from the VGMLC to identify the periodic and triggered location request and then sends the location estimate and type of trigger event to the external LCS client.

question_46512.question: In what ways can the selection of tariffs for AoC services be conditioned and restricted?
question_46512.ground_truth: The selection of tariffs for AoC services can be conditioned based on various charging information requirements and user-related parameters. This may include details like the Calling Party Category (CPC), user balances, consumed resources, discounts, benefits, or commercial agreements with the service provider.

question_46515.question: What are the required elements within the <anyExt> element of an MSR request?
question_46515.ground_truth: The required elements within the <anyExt> element of an MSR request are MCDataContentServerURI and MessageStoreHostname.

question_46517.question: What is the single direction latency for a mobile to mobile VoIP call with the HS-HARQ protocol combined with a 10 msec TTI?
question_46517.ground_truth: The single direction latency for a mobile to mobile VoIP call with the HS-HARQ protocol combined with a 10 msec TTI is approximately 140 msec.

question_46518.question: If the network supports DTM, when shall the kind of paging co-ordination be provided?
question_46518.ground_truth: This kind of paging co-ordination shall be provided in network mode of operation~I, and may be provided also in network mode of operation~II or III.

question_46519.question: What percentage of outage for the NB~PS system is typical?
question_46519.ground_truth: A maximum amount of outage for the NB~PS system of 2.5% is typical.

question_46520.question: What kind of resources are denoted by the r15:supplementaryUnicastAppService element?
question_46520.ground_truth: The r15:supplementaryUnicastAppService element denotes one or more available unicast resources which are supplemental to resources provided on broadcast, i.e. they provide an additional user experience.

question_46521.question: What other signalling network may be supported by the NRM as defined in the 3GPP TS 28.734 technical specification in the future?
question_46521.ground_truth: The NRM as defined in the 3GPP TS 28.734 technical specification may be extended in the future to support other signalling network technologies, such as IP-based STNs, in addition to the ones already supported (e.g. MTP3, M3UA).

question_46522.question: When should the UE ignore the "Extended wait time CP data" from the lower layers?
question_46522.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the "Extended wait time CP data" from the lower layers if it is not operating in NB-S1 mode or if it does not support timer T3448.

question_46524.question: What must an MTSI client do in response to a CVO being offered to be sent in SDP?
question_46524.ground_truth: An MTSI client supporting CVO shall respond to receive CVO when CVO is offered to be sent in SDP, by including exactly one of the offered extmap attributes.

question_46525.question: Which location update status is represented by byte 11 with a value of 01?

question_46526.question: How is "LCS Server" defined in the document?
question_46526.ground_truth: An LCS Server is a software and/or hardware entity that offers LCS capabilities. The LCS Server accepts requests, services requests, and sends back responses to received requests. The LCS server consists of LCS components, which are distributed to one or more PLMN and/or service provider.

question_46527.question: What are the effects on performance for radio block mapping in time-slot and frequency domain?
question_46527.ground_truth: For radio block mapping in time-slot domain, performance is degraded by up to 3.5 dB for MCS-1 and MCS-5, and improved by up to 1.7 dB for MCS-4 and MCS-9. While for radio block mapping in frequency domain, performance is unchanged for all MCS:s with ideal frequency hopping, and the same performance as with ideal frequency hopping without hopping since interleaving is done over four frequencies.

question_46528.question: What is used in Option 3 to identify the importance/dependency relationship between different PDU sets in a PDU sets group?
question_46528.ground_truth: The media application (i.e. AF) may provide/update to 5GS importance/dependency information of PDU sets in the form of group size (i.e. number of PDU set), indication of starting/ending PDU set of a group of PDU sets, and importance/dependency information of the PDU set with respects to the position/order of PDU set in the group of PDU sets.

question_46529.question: What action does the (MB-)SMF take when there are no more UEs using a multicast session?
question_46529.ground_truth: The (MB-)SMF may release the PDU session for the multicast session identified by the received multicast session ID if no UE is left using the multicast session.

question_46530.question: What is the purpose of the MSGin5G Service?
question_46530.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Service is a MNO message service within the 5G System that enables point-to-point, application-to-point, group and broadcast message delivery for thing-to-thing communication and person-to-thing communication.

question_46532.question: What is the significance of GTP-U Echo Request/Response messages in QoS monitoring for a QoS Flow?
question_46532.ground_truth: GTP-U Echo Request/Response messages are used in the corresponding user plane transport path(s) to perform packet delay measurement for a QoS Flow, independent of the corresponding PDU Session and 5QI.

question_46533.question: What is the validity procedure for the authorization information in the initial registration request to the eP-CSCF?
question_46533.ground_truth: The eP-CSCF validates the authorization information in the initial registration request from the WebRTC IMS Client. The validation of the authorization information is successful, the eP-CSCF will proceed with the IMS registration on behalf of the user. If the validation fails, the eP-CSCF will not proceed with the registration.

question_46536.question: What is the role of AMF in managing TNL associations in a 5G-AN node?
question_46536.ground_truth: The AMF provides the 5G-AN node with weight factors for each TNL association of the AMF, and can request to add or remove TNL associations to the AMF. The AMF also indicates the set of TNL associations used for UE-associated and non-UE associated signalling.

question_46537.question: What is one of the characteristics of the "higher reliability, higher availability and lower latency" use case family described in section 5.2?
question_46537.ground_truth: The network and its services are consistently available, with minimal downtime.

question_46539.question: What is the requirement for an automatic surveillance of the communication between the managing system and the managed system in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_46539.ground_truth: The requirement is to ensure the availability and reliability of the management in 3G systems.

question_46540.question: When can the CHF/OCS provide announcement information in IMS?
question_46540.ground_truth: The CHF/OCS can provide announcement information upon interaction with the AS or the IMS-GWF during different phases of an IMS session, such as at session initiation, during an ongoing established IMS session, and at IMS session termination due to final quota consumption.

question_46542.question: What does the UDR do after it informs the NEF about the result of the operation in step~3b?
question_46542.ground_truth: The UDR stores, updates, or removes the policy data of step~3a in the UDR, having translated any External Group Identifier to an Internal Group Identifier and any GPSI to a SUPI.

question_46544.question: What is the measurement window where the sum of the power measured in theta and phi polarization is 99% of the "Total EIRP"?
question_46544.ground_truth: The measurement window is identified as the one whose center is aligned on the center of the channel for which the sum of the power measured in theta and phi polarization is 99% of the "Total EIRP".

question_46546.question: What is a pro of Solution 3 for MME/SGSN Failure without Restoration?
question_46546.ground_truth: A pro of Solution 3 for MME/SGSN Failure without Restoration is the ability to page a UE even when it camps on the failed MME/SGSN, ensuring continuity of mobile-terminated service.

question_46548.question: What is the purpose of using IPv6 multi-homing for a PDU Session?
question_46548.ground_truth: The purpose of using IPv6 multi-homing for a PDU Session is to provide access to the Data Network via more than one PDU Session Anchor, allowing for traffic routing and merging to the UE.

question_46549.question: What happens after the MCPTT client and the IWF release all the media plane resources used for the private call?
question_46549.ground_truth: If the private call was established with floor control, floor control resources are released and the MCPTT client cannot make further requests for floor control or send media.

question_46550.question: How is the traffic descriptor information transferred in the Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay procedure?
question_46550.ground_truth: The Remote UE sends the traffic descriptors of the service which is to be relayed to the ProSe 5G UE-to-Network Relay during PC5 connection establishment.

question_46551.question: When will a UE initiate the transmission of the MBMSInterestIndication message if SystemInformationBlockType20 is broadcast by the PCell?
question_46551.ground_truth: A UE should initiate the transmission of the MBMSInterestIndication message if since the last time the UE transmitted an MBMSInterestIndication message, the UE connected to a PCell not broadcasting SystemInformationBlockType20, or if the set of MBMS services of interest determined in accordance with 5.8.5.3a is different from mbms-Services included in the last transmission of the MBMSInterestIndication message.

question_46553.question: When is it necessary for an MPS Service User to invoke DTS for VPN access to an enterprise network?
question_46553.ground_truth: When normal data service is degraded due to a disaster or emergency event and the VPN connection to the MPS capable enterprise network cannot be established.

question_46554.question: What happens to the TNG3 timer when two or more active group calls are merged?
question_46554.ground_truth: When two or more active group calls are merged, the TNG3 timer for each hosted group call is stopped. Instead, a new TNG3 timer is started for the temporary group call.

question_46555.question: What function does the eNodeB use to distribute UEs entering or being re-directed to an appropriate DCN?
question_46555.ground_truth: The DCN Load Balancing functionality permits UEs to be distributed in a manner that achieves load balancing between the CN nodes of the same DCN.

question_46556.question: What should the SS look for in subframes (m+5), (m+9), and (m+13) and (m+18) up to the end of T2 for inter-band CA UE in step 8a?

question_46557.question: What three quality numbers are measured in the electrical interface UE measurement?
question_46557.ground_truth: The three quality numbers measured in the electrical interface UE measurement are N-MOS-LQOw, S-MOS-LQOw, and G-MOS-LQOw.

question_46558.question: Which subclause of the IOC uses the data type "V2X communication mode" in GSMA NG.116?
question_46558.ground_truth: The subclause 6.5 of the IOC using the data type "V2X communication mode" in GSMA NG.116 is 6.3.16.

question_46563.question: What modification is being made to the sr-ProhibitTimer to support IoT NTN?
question_46563.ground_truth: The sr-ProhibitTimer is being modified to include larger values to support IoT NTN.

question_46564.question: What is the purpose of the Position Calculation procedure in the PCAP context?
question_46564.ground_truth: The Position Calculation procedure enables an SRNC to query an SAS for a position estimate of a UE, using connectionless signalling.

question_46566.question: What is the action required of the MS when it receives a CIPHERING MODE COMMAND message with Cipher Response bit set to "IMEISV shall be included" and the Cipher Mode Setting is "no ciphering"?
question_46566.ground_truth: The MS shall include the IMEISV in the Mobile Identity IE in the CIPHERING MODE COMPLETE message.

question_46567.question: In the "UE-PositioningCapability" structure, what does the "NetworkAssistedGPSSuport" field represent?
question_46567.ground_truth: The "NetworkAssistedGANSSSuport" field in the "UE-PositioningCapability" structure is a Boolean value that represents the support for network-assisted GANSS (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou, etc.) by the user equipment.

question_46568.question: What is the function of the AAR command for the Gmb interface?
question_46568.ground_truth: The AAR command is used for user authorization, modifying an MBMS UE Context in the BM-SC, or registering the GGSN for a multicast MBMS bearer service. It can also be used to activate a Trace Session in the BM-SC.

question_46569.question: What happens to an IMS session if the AF does not provide an emergency indication to the PCRF when establishing a session via the emergency PDN connection?
question_46569.ground_truth: The PCRF rejects the IMS session.

question_46571.question: What is the role of TS 36.101 and TS 38.101-1 in determining the supported bandwidths of inter-band EN-DC?
question_46571.ground_truth: The supported bandwidths of inter-band EN-DC is consisting with BCS of LTE CA specified in TS 36.101 and BCS of NR CA specified in TS 38.101-1.

question_46574.question: What should a participating MCVideo function do upon receiving a SIP INVITE request containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the <session-type> element set to a value of "one-to-one video push", for originating participating MCVideo function?
question_46574.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function should perform the procedures as specified in clause~10.2.2.3.1.1.

question_46575.question: What happens if some or all requested measurement data cannot be collected by a measurement job?
question_46575.ground_truth: This should be indicated in the measurement report, and the destination of the result report should be capable of coping with missing or incomplete measurement reports.

question_46576.question: What is the purpose of the CS-MGW in a 3GPP network?
question_46576.ground_truth: The CS-MGW, or Circuit Switched Media Gateway, is used in a 3GPP network to enable communication between different types of networks, such as the RAN and the PSTN.

question_46577.question: What issues can arise in small cell deployment scenarios?
question_46577.ground_truth: Some issues that can arise in small cell deployment scenarios include severe interference among synchronization signals/reference signals, larger UE effort on inter-frequency small cell identification in multi-carrier operation scenarios, larger cell planning effort to avoid PCI collision and PCI confusion in super-dense deployment, and the necessity of an efficient mechanism to support small cell on/off operation.

question_46578.question: What is an XR Spatial Compute pipeline used for in the context of AR/MR?
question_46578.ground_truth: An XR Spatial Compute pipeline is used for setting up spatial compute downlink and uplink delivery sessions for spatial description related data. This allows for the exchange of spatial compute information between the AR Runtime and the media delivery function.

question_46579.question: What is the purpose of the MCData file retrieve request (7.5.2.1.19) and MCData file retrieve response (7.5.2.1.20)?
question_46579.ground_truth: The MCData file retrieve request is sent from an MCData content server in a partner MCData system to an MCData content server in the primary MCData system of the source of the content, requesting to retrieve a file. The MCData file retrieve response is the response sent from the MCData content server in the primary MCData system of the source of the content to an MCData content server in a partner MCData system, indicating the success or failure of the retrieve request.

question_46580.question: What measures must be taken when using TE Advanced Carrier Aggregation of Band 5 and Band 17 (1 UL) to avoid IMD products from distorting the spectrum?
question_46580.ground_truth: The 3rd IMD products between Band 5 and Band 17 carriers may fall into the BS receive band of bands 7, 8, 12, 20, 28, 40, and 41. To avoid this, the involved BS transmitters should not share the same antenna with Band 5 and 17 BS receivers or meet very stringent PIM specifications.

question_46581.question: What is the role of the NAS message container in the Registration Request message?
question_46581.ground_truth: The NAS message container is used to send non-cleartext IEs in the Registration Request message if the UE has a valid 5G NAS security context.

question_46582.question: What message is used by the mobile station to indicate a retransmitted message in case of request for retransmission?
question_46582.ground_truth: The PACKET~UPLINK~ACK/NACK message is used by the mobile station to indicate a retransmitted message.

question_46583.question: Which entity is responsible for the management of multi-vendor and multi-technology network elements in the 3GPP system?
question_46583.ground_truth: The Network Manager is responsible for managing a network using open and well-standardized interfaces, supporting communication with multi-vendor and multi-technology network elements.

question_46585.question: What is the purpose of the FulfilmentInfo attributes?
question_46585.ground_truth: The FulfilmentInfo attributes provide information about the fulfilment of an intent, including the status of fulfilment and the related reasons for an infeasible status.

question_46586.question: What is the initial state of the eCall capable MS before initiating a test eCall?
question_46586.ground_truth: The eCall capable MS is in an eCall Inactive state before initiating a test eCall.

question_46588.question: What action does the UE take when removing one access from the PDN connection?
question_46588.ground_truth: The UE sends a Detach Request to the MME, which in turn sends the delete bearer request message to S-GW to initiate the removal of 3GPP access procedure.

question_46589.question: What is the HARQ feedback mode for the first HARQ-ACK reporting mode when the UE correctly decodes a transport block?
question_46589.ground_truth: The HARQ feedback is an ACK value.

question_46590.question: What are the two modes for DL scheduling in TBS determination?
question_46590.ground_truth: The two modes for DL scheduling in TBS determination are automatic mode and explicit mode.

question_46591.question: What is the role of user confirmation in the redial mechanism described in the 3GPP Technical Report?
question_46591.ground_truth: Although the 3GPP Technical Report does not specify the MMI of UEs, it does describe some MMI actions and notes the importance of user confirmation in certain steps of the procedure, such as the "switch to video" and "switch to voice" answer functions.

question_46593.question: What should the network do when it decides to activate congestion control for transport of user data via the control plane?
question_46593.ground_truth: The network may include a value for the control plane data back-off timer T3448 in REGISTRATION ACCEPT, SERVICE ACCEPT or SERVICE REJECT message, and shall store an control plane data back-off time on a per UE basis. The UE starts the timer T3448 with the value informed in the message.

question_46595.question: What is the format of the multipart/mixed body when the UE sends an INFO request but is not able to provide an updated MSD?
question_46595.ground_truth: The multipart/mixed body includes an "application/EmergencyCallData.Control+xml" MIME body part with an "ack" element containing information about the failed request.

question_46597.question: Which specification provides the test environment for 3GPP TS 36.521-2 testing?
question_46597.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 36.508 provides the common test environment for 3GPP TS 36.521-2 testing.

question_46598.question: What is the effect of changing IMS voice over PS session indicator from supported to unsupported on ongoing IMS sessions?
question_46598.ground_truth: It will not impact the ongoing IMS sessions; any changes apply only to new IMS sessions initiated after the ongoing IMS session is terminated.
