question_47267.ground_truth: The purpose of the test specified in section 8.3.1.3.4 of the document is to verify the UE capability of supporting non quasi-colocated antenna ports when the UE receives DCI format 2D in a scenario where the three transmission points have different Cell ID and non-colliding CRS.

question_47268.question: What is the role of the MME in the shared eMBMS network?
question_47268.ground_truth: The MME in the shared eMBMS network needs to fulfill only the functions required for MBMS, as defined in TS~23.246.

question_47269.question: What is the precondition mechanism referred to in TS 24.229, clause 6.1?
question_47269.ground_truth: The precondition mechanism is a mechanism defined in RFC 3312 and updated by RFC 4032 that is used for the integration of resource management and SIP in TS 24.229.

question_47270.question: What is the RSRP measurement accuracy for all measured cells when reporting periodically or event-triggered?
question_47270.ground_truth: The RSRP measurement accuracy for all measured cells when reporting periodically or event-triggered is specified in the sub-clauses 9.1.21.1 and 9.1.21.2.

question_47272.question: What did the simulation results from LG Electronics show for 39 GHz regarding the feasibility of different phase noise profiles?
question_47272.ground_truth: The simulation results for 39 GHz showed that the feasibility is only achieved in case 6, while case 4 and case 5 cannot achieve below 3.5% EVM.

question_47273.question: What action should the IP-SM-GW take when it receives a third-party REGISTER request and there is no Authorization header field received from the UE that is contained in a "message/sip" MIME body of the third party REGISTER request?
question_47273.ground_truth: Derive the IMSI from the public user identity obtained from the "To" header field in the REGISTER request received from the UE that is contained in a "message/sip" MIME body of the third party REGISTER request.

question_47274.question: What must the IUT media and service control transfer request include in order to identify the transferred session, the target of the transferred session, and the access leg to be transferred to UE-2?
question_47274.ground_truth: The IUT media and service control transfer request must include enough information to identify the transferred session, the target of the transferred session (UE-2), and the access leg of UE-1 to be transferred to UE-2.

question_47277.question: What are the two options for introducing the ACK in the DL slot format to avoid having to reserve an OVSF code for the ACK channel?
question_47277.ground_truth: The two options are introducing a new field in the DL slot-format to carry the ACK, or I-Q multiplexing the ACK with the TPC symbols.

question_47278.question: Which protocol is defined in 3GPP TS 24.572 for enabling LCS-UP?
question_47278.ground_truth: The Location Services User Plane (LCS-UP) protocol is defined in 3GPP TS 24.572 for enabling LCS-UP.

question_47279.question: What method is used for Deregistration Notifications in the 6.2.5 resource?
question_47279.ground_truth: The POST method is used for Deregistration Notifications in the 6.2.5 resource.

question_47280.question: What should a data link layer entity do when in the idle state and receiving an MDL-RELEASE-REQUEST primitive?
question_47280.ground_truth: The data link layer entity should enter the null state without issuing any commands to the peer entity.

question_47281.question: What is the role of the Application-driven Quality of Service (QoS) Web Service in the OSA specifications?
question_47281.ground_truth: The Application-driven QoS Web Service is part of the OSA specifications that enable applications to dynamically change the quality of service (e.g. bandwidth) available on end user network connections.

question_47282.question: What is the purpose of NSAG information in 5G networks?
question_47282.ground_truth: NSAG information includes a list of NSAGs, each with an NSAG ID, a list of S-NSSAIs associated with the NSAG, a priority value associated with the NSAG, and optionally a list of TAIs in which the NSAG is valid. It is used to assist network slice-based cell reselection and random access.

question_47284.question: What are the conditions for the PRS-RSRPP measurement requirements to apply?
question_47284.ground_truth: The PRS-RSRPP measurement requirements apply when the UE has received a message from LMF via LPP requesting the UE to measure and report PRS-RSRPP measurements, and the UE is capable of supporting the PRS-RSRPP measurement in RRC INACTIVE state.

question_47285.question: What is required from a UE for the new registration type in this solution?
question_47285.ground_truth: The UE needs to handle Associated-Identifiers and related information and support the new registration type for swapping sets of isolated slices.

question_47286.question: What is the state that the MCVideo client sets as true, when it has sent a GROUP EMERGENCY ALERT message?
question_47286.ground_truth: The MCVideo client sets the stored emergency state as "true", when it has sent a GROUP EMERGENCY ALERT message.

question_47287.question: When is the CoMP Information IE considered valid for RRM by the receiving eNB?
question_47287.ground_truth: The CoMP Information IE is considered valid starting in the subframe indicated by the Start SFN IE and Start Subframe Number IE, if present. If the Start SFN IE and Start Subframe Number IE are not present, then the receiving eNB considers the CoMP Information IE as immediately valid. The CoMP Information IE remains valid until an update of the same IE, received in a new LOAD INFORMATION message, is considered valid.

question_47288.question: What should the MCVideo client do if a SIP MESSAGE request is received with an `<alert-ind>` element set to "false" and contains the required information in the MIME body?
question_47288.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should display an indication of the MCVideo emergency alert cancellation and associated information, including the MCVideo group identity and originator of the MCVideo emergency alert.

question_47289.question: What action should the SGSN take if it receives a ROUTING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message from an MS with a LIPA PDN connection, and no L-GW Transport Layer Address is provided together with the ROUTING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message by the lower layer?
question_47289.ground_truth: The SGSN shall locally deactivate all PDP contexts associated with the LIPA PDN connection.

question_47290.question: What should the P-CSCF include in the Request-URI when forwarding an emergency service request?
question_47290.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall include an emergency service URN with a top-level service type of "sos" in the Request-URI when forwarding an emergency service request.

question_47292.question: What are the benefits of the monitoring service described in 4.2.5?
question_47292.ground_truth: The monitoring service can ensure the UE is not used for other purposes and requests the detection of change of association between the UE and the UICC. It can also activate an anti-theft application service when the user leaves their car.

question_47294.question: What is the sub-domain format for a Stand-alone Non-Public Network (SNPN) in 5GS?
question_47294.ground_truth: The Home Network Domain for a Stand-alone Non-Public Network (SNPN) in 5GS is in the format "5gc.nid<NID>.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.3gppnetwork.org", where <MNC> and <MCC> are 3 digits long and NID is encoded as hexadecimal digits as specified in clause~12.7.

question_47295.question: What actions should the UE take if the timer value received for timer T3396 in the Back-off timer value IE is not zero or deactivated, and a DNN was provided during the PDU session establishment?
question_47295.ground_truth: The UE shall stop timer T3396 associated with the corresponding DNN, start timer T3396 with the value provided in the Back-off timer value IE, and shall not send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message or PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message for the same DNN until timer T3396 expires or is stopped.

question_47296.question: What is the definition of a UE special conformance test function in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_47296.ground_truth: A UE special conformance test function is a mandatory requirement for 5GS conformance testing that forms part of the core requirements of the UE design. It is defined in the 3GPP specification and includes any relevant procedures and Test Mode Control (TMC) message contents used for information exchange.

question_47297.question: What changes to procedures in TS 23.401 are captured in clause 4.11.0a?
question_47297.ground_truth: Clause 4.11.0a captures changes to procedures in TS 23.401 that are common to interworking based on N26 and interworking without N26.

question_47298.question: What function is required in the P-GW to support the IP based group messaging solution over EPC?
question_47298.ground_truth: A new IP multicast router function is required in the P-GW for the IP based group messaging solution over EPC.

question_47301.question: What are the three criteria that determine the HNB DL power setting?
question_47301.ground_truth: The three criteria are: (1) the CPICH Ec/No at the expected edge of coverage of the HNB is of sufficient quality for adequate coverage/performance, (2) the macro layer CPICH Ec/No at the expected edge of coverage of the HNB is not severely degraded, and (3) the adjacent-channel macro layer CPICH Ec/No at certain distance/pathloss from the HNB is not severely degraded.

question_47302.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG RAN) UTRAN Iur Interface Data Transport and Transport Signalling for Common Transport Channel data streams (Release 17)?
question_47302.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to provide a specification of the UTRAN RNC-RNC (Iur) interface Data Transport and Transport Signalling for Common Transport Channel data streams, which includes the definitions and abbreviations, and the specifications notations for the interfaces.

question_47303.question: What MATLAB function was used to generate a Tukey window for the headphone compensation filter?
question_47303.ground_truth: The MATLAB function tukeywin was used to generate a Tukey window with a taper ratio of 0.7 for the headphone compensation filter.

question_47305.question: What is the header field used to provide announcements during an established communication session as defined in 3GPP TS 24.628?
question_47305.ground_truth: The Call-Info header field in a re-INVITE request should be supported at the II-NNI.

question_47306.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP TS defining the stage 3 description of USSD operations in the 3GPP system?
question_47306.ground_truth: The 3GPP TS specifies the interactions between the mobile network and the mobile station for USSD operations, including the messages exchanged and the expected responses.

question_47307.question: What is the standard signal level used for calibration in both analogue and digital connections?
question_47307.ground_truth: The standard signal level used for calibration in both analogue and digital connections is -60 dBV for analogue connections and -16 dBm0 for digital connections.

question_47308.question: What type of de-registration procedure initiated by the HSS is used to measure the number of failed de-registration procedures initiated by the HSS at the S-CSCF in the IMS?
question_47308.ground_truth: Failed de-registration procedures initiated by HSS

question_47309.question: Which operation code is associated with the 'playAnnouncement' in the CAP-operationcodes module?

question_47311.question: What is the mandatory mode for remotely changing another MCPTT user's affiliated MCPTT group(s)?
question_47311.ground_truth: The mandatory mode for remotely changing another MCPTT user's affiliated MCPTT group(s) is a procedure where an authorized user can change the target user's MCPTT group affiliation without requiring the target user's approval. The primary MCPTT server checks if the authorized user is authorized to initiate the change and if the target user is authorized for the requested affiliation relationship.

question_47313.question: What action should the Node B take when the E-DCH TDD Information To Modify IE includes the E-DCH MAC-d Flow Multiplexing List IE for an E-DCH MAC-d flow?
question_47313.ground_truth: The Node B should use this information for the related resource allocation operation.

question_47314.question: What does the User-UE do when it detects the Public Safety UE-Network Relay Node's 'beacon' signal?
question_47314.ground_truth: The User-UE initiates a Tracking Area Update that indicates there is also data to be sent (e.g. "follow on request" is set) irrespective of whether or not there is actually data to be sent.

question_47315.question: What is the purpose of the omr-s-att, omr-m-bw, and omr-s-bw attributes in networks with OMR procedures?
question_47315.ground_truth: These attributes encapsulate a session or media-level SDP attribute that is applicable if a particular border gateway is bypassed.

question_47316.question: What is the minimum value for the "MinimumHeading" in the "HeadingType" complex type?

question_47318.question: What is the relationship between the "Minimum Requirements" and "Test Requirements" in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_47318.ground_truth: The Minimum Requirements in the specification do not account for measurement uncertainty. The test specification in RAN5 will define final test tolerances for FR1 TRP TRS. The test tolerances are used to relax the minimum requirements in this specification to create test requirements.

question_47319.question: What authentication methods are used in the AKMA authentication procedure?
question_47319.ground_truth: The two authentication methods used in the AKMA authentication procedure are EAP-AKA' and 5G AKA.

question_47320.question: What is the purpose of the "changeMOIs" operation?
question_47320.ground_truth: The "changeMOIs" operation is invoked by MnS consumers to request a MnS producer to create, delete, and update one or more objects using a single request, making changes to the managed objects in the order they appear in the request.

question_47321.question: What is the maximum amount of degradation when replacing a SCBTS with a MCBTS for the 600 kHz GSM carrier separation scenario?
question_47321.ground_truth: The maximum degradation is less than 0.02 dB for class 2, while the impact is insignificant in multiple carrier scenarios, even with more realistic IM emission levels.

question_47323.question: What should be the maximum event triggered measurement reporting delay for GSM cells with BSIC verified for Event B2?
question_47323.ground_truth: The maximum event triggered measurement reporting delay for GSM cells with BSIC verified for Event B2 is less than 7202 ms from the beginning of time period T2.

question_47324.question: Which clauses are used to define the primary level settings in 9.1.7.2.5-1?
question_47324.ground_truth: Clause 7.1 of 3GPP TS 36.508, 7.2 of 3GPP TS 36.508, and 7.3 of 3GPP TS 36.508.

question_47325.question: When is extended RLC/MAC control message segmentation not used?
question_47325.ground_truth: Extended RLC/MAC control message segmentation is not used when the contents of a control message can be sent using one or two RLC/MAC control blocks.

question_47326.question: What happens if an invalid CallSessionIdentifier or CallParticipants is provided in the PlayTextMessageRequest operation?
question_47326.ground_truth: It will result in an invalid input value exception.

question_47327.question: What is the meaning of "shall" in the context of 3GPP technical specifications and technical reports?
question_47327.ground_truth: "Shall" in the context of 3GPP technical specifications and technical reports indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

question_47328.question: What is the difference between abortActionRes and abortActionErr methods in the OSA specifications?
question_47328.ground_truth: abortActionRes is an asynchronous method that confirms that the request to abort a user interaction operation on a call was successful, whereas abortActionErr is an asynchronous method that indicates that the request to abort a user interaction on a call resulted in an error.

question_47329.question: Which MCX Service mechanism must be supported by the MCX Service Ad hoc Group Communications in terms of security requirements?
question_47329.ground_truth: As per R-6.15.5.2-009, MCX Service Ad hoc Group Communications shall support the applicable security requirements as identified in sub-clause 5.12.

question_47330.question: What happens when the MC service client 1 initiates an ad hoc group emergency alert?
question_47330.ground_truth: The MC service client 1 sends an ad hoc group emergency alert request to the MC service server A, which then checks the user's authorization and determines the list of participants based on the provided criteria from MC system A and the partner MC system B.

question_47331.question: What should the UE do upon expiry of the periodical reporting timer for a specific measurement?
question_47331.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the measurement reporting procedure, as specified in clause 5.5.5.

question_47333.question: What information should the IMS AS include in the SDP offer for the UE to select between unicast and multicast offers?
question_47333.ground_truth: The SDP offer in the IMS AS includes alternate offers in the SDP, one containing a unicast IP address/port, and the other containing a multicast IP address/port.

question_47334.question: How is the ThreshChUtilWLANLow threshold condition evaluated if only the ThreshChUtilWLANLowRAN node is present?
question_47334.ground_truth: If the ThreshChUtilWLANLowRAN node is present and the ThreshChUtilWLANLow threshold value has been received from E-UTRAN/UTRAN, the UE shall consider this node as matching if the measurement value ChannelUtilizationWLAN is smaller than the ThreshChUtilWLANLow threshold value.

question_47335.question: What is the AMF required to perform before the S-NSSAI subject to NSAC is included in the Allowed NSSAI or Partially Allowed NSSAI and sent to the UE, when EAC mode is activated?
question_47335.ground_truth: The number of UEs per network slice availability check and update procedure.

question_47336.question: What is the current sharing factor P and PCBD applied to in RLM and BFD for FR2 HST?
question_47336.ground_truth: The current sharing factor P and PCBD applied to RLM and BFD for FR2 HST is the existing one.

question_47338.question: What functions does the MME/SGSN perform upon reception of the acknowledgement from the UE in the "UE application trigger request" procedure?
question_47338.ground_truth: The MME/SGSN removes the UE application trigger request information from its database, notifies the HLR/HSS that the UE has received the "UE application trigger request" by sending a Diameter Notification message or a MAP Update GPRS Location message.

question_47339.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 16.6.1.8?
question_47339.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the UE makes correct reporting of an event and partly verifies the intra-frequency cell identification and measurement period requirements.

question_47340.question: What events does a PTC Group Session support?
question_47340.ground_truth: A PTC Group Session supports a One-to-One, One-to-Many, or One-to-Many-to-One sessions with session initiation request/response, session modification, joining/leaving, termination, voice communication beginning, ending, or being forced disconnected.

question_47341.question: What is the role of the SMF/UPF when handling DHCPv6 signalling from the UE?
question_47341.ground_truth: The SMF/UPF acts as a DHCPv6 server as seen from the UE and can allocate the IP address itself or use an external server to allocate the IP address.

question_47342.question: What information does the AMF2 use to select the UDM?
question_47342.ground_truth: The AMF2 selects the UDM based on the 5G-RG SUPI.

question_47343.question: What is the purpose of the "cellForWhichToReportCGI" field in the ReportCGI information element?
question_47343.ground_truth: The "cellForWhichToReportCGI" field in the ReportCGI information element specifies the cell for which to report CGI. This information element is used to communicate information about the serving cell to the UE.

question_47344.question: What is the purpose of the FLISR solution in feeder automation applications?
question_47344.ground_truth: The FLISR solution is designed for feeder automation applications to support the self-healing of power distribution grids with overhead lines. It serves as control units for reclosers and disconnectors in overhead line distribution grids, conducts self-healing of the distribution line in typically 500 ms by isolating the faults, and operates autonomously without the need of a regional controller or control centre.

question_47345.question: What is the sampling rate of the ALDO window in the 32 kHz case?
question_47345.ground_truth: The sampling rate of the ALDO window in the 32 kHz case is 16 kHz.

question_47346.question: In "CALL CONTROL RESULT 1.5.1", what is the general result for the call control?

question_47347.question: In what cases does the H-PCRF select the applicable PCC Rules for application detection and control (ADC)?
question_47347.ground_truth: The H-PCRF selects the applicable PCC Rules for ADC for the PCEF supporting ADC feature, the solicited application reporting with a TDF, or for solicited application reporting with a TDF in the non-roaming case or for the Home Routed scenario.

question_47349.question: What service does Solution 14 propose to use for data collection in 5GC NFs and AFs?
question_47349.ground_truth: The solution proposes to use the existing Event Exposure Service offered by NFs such as AMF, SMF, PCF, and UDM for data collection.

question_47350.question: Does the UE support channel Bandwidth of 90MHz on one carrier of one band entry in a band combination?

question_47351.question: What is the requirement for identification of a known NR target cell, as defined in clause 5.6.5.0.1.2?
question_47351.ground_truth: The UE shall identify and report the CGI of a known NR target cell when requested by the network for the purpose of reportCGI. Only one cell is provided to the UE with cellForWhichToReportCGI for identifying the CGI.

question_47352.question: What should the floor participant do when timer T206 (Stop talking warning) expires?
question_47352.ground_truth: When timer T206 (Stop talking warning) expires, the floor participant may notify the MCPTT user that the transmission time limit is about to reach, start timer T207 (Stop talking), and remain in the current state.

question_47353.question: What is the philosophy of CC in gaining assurance for CC evaluation?
question_47353.ground_truth: The CC philosophy in gaining assurance is through an evaluation of the product that is to be trusted, with an emphasis on scope, depth, and rigor in the evaluation.

question_47354.question: What is the UE required to do for SSB based RLM when SSB for RLM is in the same OFDM symbol as BFD, CBD or L1-RSRP measurement for FR1?
question_47354.ground_truth: The UE is required to perform the SSB measurements with measurement restrictions when the SSB for RLM is in the same OFDM symbol as BFD, CBD or L1-RSRP measurement. UE is required to measure one of but not both SSB for RLM and CSI-RS when the SSB and CSI-RS have different SCS and when UE does not support simultaneousRxSSB-DiffNumerology. Longer measurement periods for SSB based RLM are expected in this case.

question_47357.question: How many different classes of LMU (Location Measurement Unit) are defined in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_47357.ground_truth: Three different classes of LMU (LMU class 1, LMU class 2 and LMU class 3) are defined in the 3GPP technical specification.

question_47358.question: What is the task of the SS when it receives the MeasurementReport message in step 6)?
question_47358.ground_truth: After the SS receives the MeasurementReport message in step 6), it transmits the RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection, including the release of the established radio bearers and all radio resources.

question_47359.question: What are the general data collection principles for network-side model training?
question_47359.ground_truth: The general data collection principles for network-side model training include UE supporting data logging, UE reporting collected data periodically, event-based, and on-demand, and considering UE memory, processing power, energy consumption, and signaling overhead.

question_47360.question: What is the purpose of the Slice-AMBR limit in 5G networks?
question_47360.ground_truth: The Slice-AMBR limit ensures that the maximum allowed data rate is not exceeded per network slice.

question_47361.question: What is the purpose of the SS transmitting the unwanted signal in the test for 16-QAM modulation?
question_47361.ground_truth: The purpose is to measure the performance of the system in the presence of interference.

question_47362.question: Which separation frequency is used between IMT/LTE and MSS to protect the MSS frequency range (1518-1559 MHz)?
question_47362.ground_truth: The separation frequency between IMT/LTE and MSS used to protect the MSS frequency range (1518-1559 MHz) is 1 MHz.

question_47363.question: What occurs when the BM-SC activates the MBMS Broadcast bearer?
question_47363.ground_truth: When the MBMS Broadcast bearer is activated, the BM-SC MBMS Delivery Function (MDF) starts sending the user plane data.

question_47364.question: What must the MCData client set the Number of payloads IE to when generating an DATA PAYLOAD message for SDS?
question_47364.ground_truth: The MCData client must set the Number of payloads IE to the number of Payload IEs that needs to be encoded.

question_47365.question: In step 4a of the example flow, what information is included in the SDP offer sent by IMS-ALG1 in the 200 OK response?
question_47365.ground_truth: The SDP offer includes a media line for each media line forwarded in the original SDP offer, with copied codec information, connection information for TrGW1b, and a visited-realm attribute with a temporary GRUU.

question_47367.question: What type of information is contained in the MT-SDT-Indicator field?

question_47368.question: Who is the current ruler of Portugal?

question_47369.question: What is the significance of the version number format used in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_47369.ground_truth: The version number format indicates the level of approval and changes made to the document. For example, a version number of x.y.z indicates that the first digit represents the level of approval, the second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, and the third digit is incremented for editorial changes.

question_47370.question: What is the maximum UE transmitter power for E-TFC-j in the equation for NRPMj?

question_47371.question: How is quota management handled in SSC mode when the granted quota is volume for multiple UPFs?
question_47371.ground_truth: The quota can be shared by UPFs, managed by UPFs, or granted to the SMF for a single UPF, depending on the operator's policy.

question_47374.question: What does the "RS-IndexNR-r15" information element indicate?
question_47374.ground_truth: It is used to identify an NR Reference Signal with an integer value from 0 to maxRS-Index-1-r15-1, where maxRS-Index-1-r15 is the maximum number of RS-IndexN-r15 values that can be signaled in a single message.

question_47375.question: What is the input of the Inference function for generating the Inference Output?
question_47375.ground_truth: The input of the Inference function is the data provided by the Data Collection function, which is also referred to as Inference Data.

question_47376.question: What should be provided as the identity of an LMR group in an MCData system?
question_47376.ground_truth: The identity of an LMR group should be provided as an MCData group ID in an MCData system.

question_47377.question: In the context of "RAN-INFORMATION-APPLICATION-ERROR RIM PDU Indications", what does the "Erroneous Application Container" field contain?
question_47377.ground_truth: The "Erroneous Application Container" field contains the erroneous Application Container IE.

question_47379.question: What is the test procedure step that ensures the UE is in State 3A-RF with Cell 1 as the active cell?
question_47379.ground_truth: Step 2.1 in the test procedure ensures that the UE is in State 3A-RF with Cell 1 as the active cell.

question_47380.question: What is the applicability of the TRS test in TS 37.144?
question_47380.ground_truth: The TRS test in TS 37.144 applies to all types of UTRA for the TDD UE for Release 11 and later releases that support LME. It can also be optionally executed for Release 7 and onward UE's supporting LME feature.

question_47382.question: What must the MS do upon receiving a FM result information in the RELEASE COMPLETE message?
question_47382.ground_truth: Check that the MS provides the appropriate user indication (as described by the manufacturer) based on the result of the FM operation.

question_47384.question: What is the main goal of the solution #12 for 5G satellite access?
question_47384.ground_truth: The main objectives of this solution are to minimize 5GCN impact, confine mobility aspects to NG-RAN, enable satellite access using NR or other radio access techniques, support regulatory and operational requirements, and ensure that the UE uses the Core Network of the country in which the UE is physically located.

question_47385.question: Which two pieces of information must the UE extract or derive when sending a protected REGISTER request during user-initiated emergency reregistration?
question_47385.ground_truth: A public user identity and a private user identity

question_47386.question: What are the two transport options specified in the 3GPP Technical Specification for DCH and E-DCH data streams in Iur and Iub interfaces?
question_47386.ground_truth: The two transport options specified are: ATM based transport (ATM Transport Option) and IP based transport (IP Transport Option).

question_47387.question: What should the MS do if it receives a syntactical error in packet filters during a PDP context activation?
question_47387.ground_truth: The MS should reject the activation request with cause "syntactical errors in packet filter(s)".

question_47389.question: What can the PDN GW do after releasing the IPv6 prefix to prevent immediate use by other users?
question_47389.ground_truth: After releasing the IPv6 prefix, the PDN GW should not assign that IPv6 prefix to other users immediately. This is true for both IPv4 and IPv6 address assignments.

question_47393.question: What is the repeater type 1-H spurious emission requirement demonstration criteria?
question_47393.ground_truth: The repeater type 1-H spurious emission requirement can be demonstrated by meeting at least one of the following two criteria as determined by the manufacturer: the sum of the emissions power measured on each TAB connector in the TAB connector TX min cell group is less than or equal to the limit as defined in this clause for the respective frequency span, or the unwanted emissions power at each TAB connector is less than or equal to the repeater type 1-H limit as defined in this clause for the respective frequency span, scaled by -10log10(n), where n is the number of TAB connectors in the TAB connector TX min cell group.

question_47394.question: What is the basic format of an NR-CellIdentity SlPP Information Element?
question_47394.ground_truth: The NR-PhysCellID SlPP information element is used to define the NR physical cell identifier. The NR-PhysCellID is formatted as n integer value between 0 and 1007.

question_47395.question: What kind of changes would require the third digit to be incremented in the version number of a document?
question_47395.ground_truth: The third digit is incremented when only editorial changes have been incorporated in the document, i.e., no changes of substance.

question_47396.question: If the current frame is in LP-based CNG and the bit-rate is equal to or greater than 9.6 kbps, what internal sampling rate will be employed in EVS for LP-based coding?
question_47396.ground_truth: 16 kHz internal sampling rate will be employed.

question_47398.question: What does the NTN Control function determine in the feeder link switch over between two gNBs?
question_47398.ground_truth: The NTN Control function determines the point in time when the feeder link switch over between two gNBs is performed.

question_47399.question: What should the UE do when it sends a CP-DATA containing an RP-DATA RPDU encapsulated in an Uplink NAS transport message?
question_47399.ground_truth: The UE should expect to receive a CP-DATA containing an RP-ACK RPDU encapsulated in a Downlink NAS transport message, and in response, send a CP-ACK encapsulated in an Uplink NAS Transport message.

question_47401.question: What is a prerequisite for calls to be possible to handover from UTRAN/GERAN to E-UTRAN/HSPA?
question_47401.ground_truth: The prerequisite for calls to be possible to handover from UTRAN/GERAN to E-UTRAN/HSPA is that they have been anchored in IMS at the time of their establishment.

question_47403.question: What can be done to reduce the test burden for PC3 MOP requirements?
question_47403.ground_truth: One band combination can be chosen to verify PC3 MOP testing for some band combinations in the same row, randomly choosing one band combination that UE supports.

question_47404.question: What is the definition of the limit lines for testing adjacent channel interference performance, as specified in the test requirements?
question_47404.ground_truth: Testing adjacent channel interference performance is performed using statistical methods that lead to an early pass/fail decision with test time significantly reduced for MS with BER/BLER not on the limit. The limit lines for BER/BLER performance testing are defined in Annex~6.2. The wrong decision risk F for one single error ratio test is Fpass = Ffail = F = 0.2, and the wrong decision probability D per test step is Dpass = Dfail = D = 0.0085. The parameters for limit lines are D = 0.000085, M = 1.5, ne the number of (error) events, and ns the number of samples. The error rate is calculated from ne and ns.

question_47407.question: How are the maximum average power and downlink power levels established in the present document?
question_47407.ground_truth: Maximum average power is defined as the average transmitter output power obtained over any specified time interval, including periods with no transmission, when the transmit time slots are at the maximum power setting. For downlink power levels, the present document specifies the appropriate values depending on the specific test.

question_47408.question: How does the MAC entity handle a downlink assignment for a TTI in a bundle for NB-IoT UEs or BL UEs or UEs in enhanced coverage?
question_47408.ground_truth: The MAC entity attempts to decode the received data, and if successful, delivers the decoded MAC PDU to the disassembly and demultiplexing entity. If the data was not successfully decoded, the MAC entity maintains the data and attempts to decode it in subsequent transmissions within the bundle.

question_47409.question: When will the terminating UE send an 180 (Ringing) response after indicating the resources are not available during SDP negotiation?
question_47409.ground_truth: The terminating UE sends an 180 (Ringing) response after the resources on the terminating side are successfully reserved, if it supports the precondition mechanism and has indicated the resources are not available during SDP negotiation.

question_47411.question: What should be the measurement bandwidth for a multi-carrier and/or CA operation BS in order to improve measurement accuracy, sensitivity, and efficiency while avoiding carrier leakage?
question_47411.ground_truth: The resolution bandwidth should be smaller than the measurement bandwidth when measuring the emission power of a multi-carrier and/or CA operation BS.

question_47412.question: What is the primary goal of the clock synchronization in the wireless audio-production system?
question_47412.ground_truth: The primary goal of the clock synchronization in the wireless audio-production system is to ensure that every audio sample has a precise and unique relation to the system time, and the system time and synchronization accuracy must be much higher than the audio sampling clock.

question_47413.question: What is the performance impact of semi-static SBFD on the legacy TDD operator for UL and DL in all load levels?
question_47413.ground_truth: For the legacy TDD operator, regarding the performance impact of semi-static SBFD to legacy TDD of another operator, there may be limited improvement or degradation for UL and DL performance.

question_47414.question: What is the consequence of the 2nd harmonic of Band 28 Tx falling into Band 11 Rx?
question_47414.ground_truth: The 2nd harmonic of Band 28 Tx falling into Band 11 Rx may result in Intermodulation Distortion (IMD) interference, which could lead to receiver desensitization in Band 11.

question_47415.question: What action should the NRM server take if successful upon creating a new "Individual MBS Resource" resource and initiating downlink data delivery?
question_47415.ground_truth: The NRM server should respond to the VAL server with an HTTP "201 Created" status code with the response body containing a representation of the created resource and potentially additional information (e.g. the user plane addressing information of the NRM Server for downlink data delivery) within the MBSResourceResp data structure.

question_47416.question: What is the name of the measurement type that provides the number of failed relocation resource allocations with UE involved for PS domain per cause?

question_47417.question: What information should the VPLMN provide to the CSE when a change of position event occurs?
question_47417.ground_truth: The VPLMN should provide the event met, the type of monitoring, event specific data (including location information), and charge result if charging supervision is provided.

question_47418.question: What must the UE do with Inter-APN Routing Policies, which is delivered by a VPLMN?
question_47418.ground_truth: The UE shall ignore any Inter-APN Routing Policy, which is delivered by a VPLMN.

question_47419.question: What is the role of the "apiRoot" component in the resource URI definition for the Location Information resource?
question_47419.ground_truth: The "apiRoot" component is the base URI for the location management server and is used to define the resource URI for the Location Information resource.

question_47420.question: What information does the terminal need to store for network efficiency in case of multiple MEs per user?
question_47420.ground_truth: The terminal needs to store information about the other terminals' capabilities.

question_47421.question: Which measurement related to the N4 interface provides the number of failed N4 session establishments at the UPF?
question_47421.ground_truth: The "Number of failed N4 session establishments" measurement

question_47423.question: What is a sub-use case in the exposure of network slice as a product?
question_47423.ground_truth: A sub-use case is a scenario with specific organizations and systems involved in the exposure of network slice as a product.

question_47425.question: What is the PDN GW Allocation Type, and where is it stored?
question_47425.ground_truth: The PDN GW Allocation Type indicates if PDN has been statically provisioned or dynamically selected by the MME. It is a permanent data stored in HSS and temporary data stored in MME.

question_47428.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the SIP MESSAGE request to change the selected group?
question_47428.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include the ICSI value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcvideo", a P-Preferred-Service header field, an Accept-Contact header field, a P-Preferred-Identity header field (optional), a resource-lists+xml MIME body, and an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body in the SIP MESSAGE request.

question_47429.question: What are the network-unrelated solutions for PWS security?
question_47429.ground_truth: Solutions 6 and 7, described in clause 8.6.1, are network-unrelated solutions. They both consume minimal link and core network resources, and keep operator liability to a minimum.

question_47431.question: What must the ME do if the UICC responds with '01' in the MO Short Message control result?
question_47431.ground_truth: The ME must not send the short message since it is not allowed.

question_47432.question: What kind of interactions between the Provisioning AF and the Data Collection AF are mediated by the NEF when the Provisioning AF and the Data Collection AF are located in different trust domains?
question_47432.ground_truth: The NEF mediates the interactions between the Provisioning AF and the Data Collection AF when the Provisioning AF and the Data Collection AF are located in different trust domains, as specified in clause~A.3 or A~4 of TS 26.531.

question_47433.question: Which solution is used to support deterministic communication to UEs operating applications?

question_47437.question: What is required to support the steering of roaming capability?
question_47437.ground_truth: For steering of roaming, the 5G network needs to be able to allow the home network to steer its UE(s) to a hosting network, considering the location, times, coverage of the hosting network and the services offered by the home network and hosting network.

question_47438.question: What are the main functions of the Network Exposure Function (NEF) in the 3GPP network?
question_47438.ground_truth: The Network Exposure Function (NEF) in the 3GPP network is responsible for supporting service exposure, including the service exposure framework specified in R-15, and providing location service exposure to external applications.

question_47439.question: What security requirement applies when the MTC Server is located outside the 3GPP operator domain and communicates with the 3GPP network?
question_47439.ground_truth: Mutual authentication, integrity and confidentiality protected signalling messages, and the ability for the 3GPP network to determine if the MTC server is authorized to send triggers to a UE.

question_47440.question: What is the criticality level of id-Registration-Request in the WTStatusRequest-IEs?
question_47440.ground_truth: The criticality level of id-Registration-Request is reject.

question_47442.question: In the context of HSDPA, what does the acronym MAC-hs stand for?

question_47444.question: What is the impact of the above modifications on transactions or dialogs already in progress?
question_47444.ground_truth: The procedures have no impact on transactions or dialogs already in progress and are effective only for new transactions and dialogs.

question_47445.question: What should the BSS do if it receives a DL-UNITDATA message containing the Redirection Indication IE from a CN operator that is not the last attempted CN operator?
question_47445.ground_truth: The BSS shall re-initiate the procedure towards the identified CN operator if it can uniquely identify it, or initiate the MS Registration Enquiry procedure in the CS domain if it cannot.

question_47447.question: What is the minimum number of possible values for the Random Reference in case of Channel Request?
question_47447.ground_truth: The minimum number of possible values for the Random Reference in case of Channel Request is 4 (0...3).

question_47449.question: What is the gap requirement between the PDCCH that the UE monitors in the Type2-PDCCH CSS set and the PDCCH that the UE monitors in the Type0-PDCCH CSS set for the UE to receive system information update?
question_47449.ground_truth: The gap between the UE's reception of PDCCH that UE monitors in the Type2-PDCCH CSS set and that notifies system information update, and the PDCCH that UE monitors in the Type0-PDCCH CSS set, is greater than 2 slots.

question_47450.question: What should the UE do when it receives an AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message, with 5GMM cause #71 "ngKSI already in use" from the network?
question_47450.ground_truth: Upon receipt of an AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message from the UE with 5GMM cause #71 "ngKSI already in use", the network performs necessary actions to select a new ngKSI and send the same EAP-request message to the UE. Upon receiving a new AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message with the EAP message IE containing an EAP-request message from the network, the UE should stop timer T3520, if running, process the EAP-request message as normal.

question_47452.question: What should the UE do if the "service-level device ID set" is included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains the "service-level-AA pending indication"?
question_47452.ground_truth: The UE should return a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message to the AMF and not attempt to perform another registration procedure for UAS services until the UUAA-MM procedure is completed successfully.

question_47454.question: What is the method used for testing the fulfilment of minimum performance requirements for eCall in-band modem implementations?
question_47454.ground_truth: Objective measures, such as average MSD transmission times, are used for testing the fulfilment of minimum performance requirements. These measures are the same for all implementations and shall be met by all non-bit exact fixed-point receiver implementations of the IVS and PSAP.

question_47455.question: What is the maximum time allowed for the SS to read BCCH data from a GSM cell during inter-RAT cell re-selection?
question_47455.ground_truth: The maximum time allowed for the SS to read BCCH data from a GSM cell during inter-RAT cell re-selection is Tbcch + 50 ms.

question_47457.question: What is the purpose of deferred activation/deactivation in an ADC rule?
question_47457.ground_truth: Deferred activation/deactivation in an ADC rule allows for the rule to automatically activate/deactivate at a designated time.

question_47458.question: What action does the GANC take when it wants to redirect the MS based on updated information?
question_47458.ground_truth: The GANC may optionally send the GA-RC REGISTER REDIRECT when it wants to redirect the MS based on updated information.

question_47459.question: What is one of the components that was calculated to prevent own receiver desensitization in the LTE-A UL and DL CA combinations?
question_47459.ground_truth: 2nd and 3rd order harmonics and 2nd, 3rd, 4th, and 5th order intermodulation products.

question_47460.question: What is the basis for the 5G Media Streaming protocols and formats?
question_47460.ground_truth: The 5G Media Streaming protocols and formats are based on the Common Media Application Format (CMAF), which is a unified format for media streaming across different protocols, such as Dynamic Streaming over HTTP (DASH) and HTTP Live Streaming (HLS).

question_47461.question: What does the floor control server perform when it receives an instruction to merge group calls (R: Merge) from the application and signaling plane?
question_47461.ground_truth: The floor control server performs the actions described in clause 6.5.2.3 and enters the 'Start-stop' state.

question_47462.question: What is the difference between the two sets of requirements specified in the document?
question_47462.ground_truth: The hybrid requirements set applies to AAS BS with both a conducted and a radiated interface, while the OTA requirements set applies to AAS BS with a radiated interface only.

question_47463.question: What is the role of the NRF/DHCP server in managing the UE's IP address pool for one DNN of the UPF in the NRF-based mechanism?
question_47463.ground_truth: The NRF/DHCP server manages the whole UE's IP address pool for one DNN of the UPF in the NRF-based mechanism.

question_47464.question: What is the maximum number of transport blocks that the UE considers when determining a number of HARQ-ACK information bits if maxNrofCodeWordsScheduledByDCI = 1 and nrofHARQ-BundlingGroups = 1?
question_47464.ground_truth: The UE considers a maximum of one transport block.

question_47465.question: What does the OMA Game Service generally consist of in the context of mobile game service?
question_47465.ground_truth: In the context of mobile game service, OMA Game Service generally consists of game server and IMS service capability.

question_47466.question: When should the initiating UE send a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message after receiving a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message from the target UE?
question_47466.ground_truth: The initiating UE should send a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message after receiving a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message from the target UE and performing the PC5 QoS flow establishment over 5G ProSe direct link as specified in the corresponding clause.

question_47467.question: What should be done if the user identified by the MCVideo ID in the SIP INVITE request is not authorized to join the prearranged group session?
question_47467.ground_truth: A SIP 403 (Forbidden) response should be sent with the warning text set to "121 user is not allowed to join the group call" in a Warning header field and skip the rest of the steps.

question_47468.question: What is the effect of the Application context relocation in the service switch in Solution #10?
question_47468.ground_truth: In Solution #10, the Application context is relocated along with the application context to another PINE, which allows the service to resume after the context relocation. This procedure changes the destination IP address and maintains the integrity of the application process by terminating the application traffic from the application server at the PINE first.

question_47470.question: What action does the old MME take if the new MME does not support CIoT EPS Optimization?
question_47470.ground_truth: The old MME will release the PDN connection and discard buffered data if the new MME does not support CIoT EPS Optimization.

question_47472.question: What action does the ME and network take to derive and store a 128-bit packet-switched GSM ciphering key or GPRS GSM Kc128 in an established UMTS security context?
question_47472.ground_truth: The ME and network may derive and store a 128-bit packet-switched GSM Kc128 from an established UMTS security context. The ME with a USIM in use shall compute a new GPRS GSM Kc128 using the GPRS UMTS ciphering key and the GPRS UMTS integrity key from an established UMTS security context. The network shall compute the GPRS GSM Kc128 using the GPRS UMTS integrity key and the GPRS UMTS ciphering key from an established UMTS security context only when a GEA ciphering algorithm that requires a 128-bit ciphering key is to be used.

question_47473.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals in producing the report on Local Call Local Switch (LCLS) system impacts?
question_47473.ground_truth: The purpose is to analyze and evaluate different solutions for LCLS in order to determine the benefits provided compared to the identified impacts on the core network.

question_47474.question: When does the PCF request SMF to confirm resources associated with MPS for DTS invocation/revocation?
question_47474.ground_truth: Upon receipt from an AF of a request to report the successful outcome of MPS for DTS invocation/revocation of priority handling for the default QoS flow, the PCF requests the SMF to confirm that the resources associated with the MPS for DTS invocation/revocation are successfully allocated.

question_47476.question: What is the first step in the Authenticated re-registration procedure?
question_47476.ground_truth: The UE sends unprotected REGISTER messages (SM1) to the P-CSCF.

question_47477.question: In which state can a UE enter after successfully authenticated for UAS services and a re-authentication through UUAA-MM procedure fails?
question_47477.ground_truth: The UE responds to the DEREGISTRATION REQUEST with DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT message, but the UE can't use UAS services.

question_47480.question: What shall the UAE-C perform when detecting a condition for switching C2 communication mode?
question_47480.ground_truth: Upon detecting a condition for switching C2 communication mode, the UAE-C shall generate an HTTP POST request with the C2-related-trigger-event-report element, including the expected or actual application QoS/QoE parameters and send the request towards the UAE-S. Upon receiving an HTTP 200 (OK) message containing the C2-operation-mode-switching element, the UAE-C may start C2 communication using the indicated C2 communication mode and generate an HTTP POST request with the C2-operation-mode-switching-performed element, indicating the result of the reception.

question_47482.question: What is the role of MM system information in the UE's registration procedure towards the CN?
question_47482.ground_truth: Broadcast MM system information, such as information about the present LA, TA or RA, determines when the UE initiates a location registration procedure towards the CN.

question_47483.question: What is the purpose of the "if absent" clause in some of the indicators in ServiceInteractionIndicatorsTwo?
question_47483.ground_truth: The "if absent" clause in some of the indicators in ServiceInteractionIndicatorsTwo indicates that if the indicator is not present, then the CAMEL service does not affect the corresponding treatment.

question_47486.question: What is the reporting range of RSRP in the FDD absolute RSRP accuracy test for E-UTRA Carrier Aggregation for 20 MHz?
question_47486.ground_truth: The reporting range of RSRP is defined from -140 dBm to -44 dBm with 1 dB resolution.

question_47487.question: When would the ISC gateway function require the periodic refreshment of the session?
question_47487.ground_truth: The ISC gateway function may require the periodic refreshment of the session to avoid hung states in the ISC gateway function when it receives an INVITE request. If the ISC gateway function requires the session to be refreshed, it shall apply the procedures described in RFC 4028.

question_47488.question: What is the AS's action for CAT stop in response to receiving a specific DTMF digit?
question_47488.ground_truth: Upon receipt of the specific DTMF digit for CAT stop, the AS stops media for the CAT service and forwards the SIP 200 (OK) response to the originating UE. The specifics of how the AS stops the called party's CAT is out of the scope of the document.

question_47489.question: What is the indicator in NAS request messages that the SGSN may reject before rejecting messages without the low access priority indicator?

question_47493.question: What should the UE do if it receives a GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message before completing the tracking area updating procedure?
question_47493.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message and proceed with the tracking area updating procedure.

question_47495.question: How are encryption keys managed in P25 and TETRA systems?
question_47495.ground_truth: P25 and TETRA systems typically use manual key management or Over-the-air Rekeying (OTAR) from a Key Management Facility (KMF) to mobile radios.

question_47497.question: What is the role of PRUK in PC5 link security establishment for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay service?
question_47497.ground_truth: PRUK (Prose Remote User Key) is used in PC5 link security establishment for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay service. It is used to derive the K~NRP~ different from the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network service. PRUK ID is used to identify the PRUK in the Direct Communication Request (DCR) message.

question_47498.question: In what scenario would the numberOfLBTFailures variable be incremented?
question_47498.ground_truth: The variable "numberOfLBTFailures" would be incremented if at least one LBT failure indication has been received from lower layers during the random-access procedure.

question_47499.question: What is the role of the SCEF in the Get Session Properties procedure?
question_47499.ground_truth: The SCEF acts as a Content Provider after the completion of the Get Session Properties procedure.

question_47500.question: What is the function of the NWDAF in the procedure for NWDAF assisted NTN coverage analytics?
question_47500.ground_truth: The NWDAF produces Analytics with Analytics ID: NTN coverage, based on requested NTN coverage Type, the Target UE ID(s), Analytics Filter Information, and Analytics Reporting Information, and provides it to the AMF as NF consumer.

question_47501.question: What should a UE do if it receives a 5GMM cause value over non-3GPP access and has not yet registered over non-3GPP access, with USIM valid for 5GS services over non-3GPP access?
question_47501.ground_truth: The UE should perform a registration attempt over non-3GPP access if another access point for non-3GPP access is available, or if 3GPP access is available, the UE is not registered over 3GPP access yet, and the USIM is not considered invalid for 5GS services over 3GPP access, perform registration attempt over the 3GPP access.

question_47502.question: What is the function of the MacBearerRouting field in the common part of the data ASP in NR data routing between the RLC layer of PSCell and the lower layers?
question_47502.ground_truth: The MacBearerRouting field in the common part of the data ASP provides the NR data routing between the RLC layer of PSCell and the lower layers of either PSCell or SCell.

question_47503.question: What is the procedure for subsequent lost SID frames?
question_47503.ground_truth: For subsequent lost SID frames, a muting technique is used on the comfort noise that gradually decreases the output level (-3~dB/frame), resulting in silencing of the output of the decoder. The muting of the output is maintained for subsequent lost SID frames.

question_47504.question: How is the EAP ID used to identify the UE and slice for authorization in the NSSAA framework?
question_47504.ground_truth: The EAP ID, which is provided by the UE for S-NSSAI in a NAS MM Transport message, is used to identify the UE and slice for authorization in the NSSAA framework. The EAP ID is sent from the AMF to the NSSAAF, which forwards it to the AAA-S along with the S-NSSAI (Slice/Subnet Specific Application Identifier) and GPSI (Global Proxy Identifier). The AAA-S stores the GPSI to create an association with the EAP ID in the EAP ID response message so that it can later use it to revoke authorization or trigger re-authentication. The AAA-S uses the EAP-ID and S-NSSAI to identify for which UE and slice authorization is requested.

question_47506.question: Which command is used to indicate the result of a command sent by the terminal to the UICC?
question_47506.ground_truth: TERMINAL RESPONSE command is used to indicate the result of a command sent by the terminal to the UICC.

question_47507.question: What MIME type is used for encoding the session resource information in the Content-Type field?
question_47507.ground_truth: The MIME type used for encoding the session resource information in the Content-Type field is JSON.

question_47508.question: What are the advantages of using Padded HOM as opposed to Zero-padded pattern?
question_47508.ground_truth: With Padded HOM, user data symbols at both ends are repeated with the reverse order on the sub-carriers at the edge of the signal BW, providing potential performance improvement at the receiver.

question_47509.question: What are the three possible implementation approaches for digital dual carrier MS using one PA with two antennas?
question_47509.ground_truth: The three possible implementation approaches are: a) dual, single-carrier PA's, driving either one of the two antennas, post-combining; b) dual, single-carrier PA's, with each PA coupled to one of two antennas; or c) a single wideband PA supporting dual carriers, driving a single antenna.

question_47510.question: What is one of the conditions for a UE to use 5G NSWO without 5GS registration?
question_47510.ground_truth: The UE must not first connect to a WLAN access network with 5GS credentials and then perform 5GS registration without releasing the WLAN and establishing a new WLAN association for the Trusted non-3GPP access registration procedure.

question_47511.question: What is the function of the Online Charging Interface (CH-2)?
question_47511.ground_truth: It supports quota requests, renewed quota requests, reporting of portion of unused quota, rating, credit checking, correlation, refunding facility.

question_47512.question: What information should eNB1 include in the HANDOVER REPORT message if the mobility information is available for a handover from eNB2 to eNB1?
question_47512.ground_truth: eNB1 should include the Mobility Information IE and the Source cell C-RNTI IE in the HANDOVER REPORT message if the mobility information is available for a handover from eNB2 to eNB1.

question_47513.question: What does the UE do when it has moved to PS and is ready to re-establish the session control of the media?
question_47513.ground_truth: The UE sends an Access Transfer Complete request with the provided STI-rSR, e.g. by using a SIP INVITE request.

question_47514.question: What is the Diameter application identifier assigned to the S6c Diameter application?
question_47514.ground_truth: The Diameter application identifier assigned to the S6c Diameter application is 16777312.

question_47515.question: What is the primary goal of raw format adaptation in the context of media content provision for AR glasses?
question_47515.ground_truth: The primary goal of raw format adaptation is to match the formats received and generated on the phone to those supported on the proprietary link in order to minimize format conversion and transcoding issues.

question_47517.question: What should be checked in step c of the test procedure in 26.6.23.2?
question_47517.ground_truth: It should be checked that the MS is not retransmitting the SACCH messages on uplink.

question_47518.question: In the context of a PLMN hosting a Non-Public Network, what should be the connection type for a UE capable of simultaneously receiving both NPN and PLMN services?
question_47518.ground_truth: When a UE is capable of accessing both NPN and PLMN services, it should be registered with the Host PLMN first, maintain separate Mobility Management context for NPN and PLMN, use the same NAS connection for control plane communications with the NPN (which is served by another NPN-dedicated AMF), and have one single RRC connection. The serving RAN will have two N2 connections with PLMN serving AMF, one for PLMN and the other for NPN. The UE should activate the NAS connection with the PLMN AMF even for NPN service in IDLE state. The UE should also use PLMN DRX parameters for monitoring paging for both PLMN and NPN.

question_47519.question: What response triggers the sending of the RELOCATION CMD in 3G-MSC-A?
question_47519.ground_truth: Positive result in the response to Prepare-Handover request

question_47520.question: What is the name of the complexType "RulesForAffiliationManagementType" that contains a choice of elements, including "ListOfLocationCriteria", "ListOfActiveFunctionalAliasCriteria", an "any" element with processContents set to "lax", and an "anyAttribute" element with processContents also set to "lax"?
question_47520.ground_truth: The name of the complexType is "RulesForAffiliationManagementType".

question_47521.question: What is the procedure when a request issued over the interface fails?
question_47521.ground_truth: When a request issued over the interface fails, the LIPF should raise an alert in the appropriate LI Operations and Management (O&M) system and further procedures are left to CSP policy to define.

question_47522.question: What is the initial state of the MS in the test described in 44.2.3.2.6.1?
question_47522.ground_truth: The MS is Idle Updated on cell A.

question_47523.question: Which two network elements are analyzed for energy efficiency optimization in the context of 3GPP Self-Organizing Networks (SON)?
question_47523.ground_truth: Radio Access Networks (RAN) and Evolved UTRAN (E-UTRAN) are analyzed for energy efficiency optimization in the context of 3GPP Self-Organizing Networks (SON).

question_47524.question: What is required for the network to change the UMTS codec during an ongoing speech call?
question_47524.ground_truth: The network shall send the new selected codec type in the NAS (Network Access Stratum) Synchronisation Indicator IE

question_47527.question: How does a UE determine the antenna ports of a serving cell for NB-IoT?
question_47527.ground_truth: The UE may derive cell-specific reference signal sequence and raster offset from the higher layer parameter eutra-CRS-SequenceInfo if the higher layer parameter operationModeInfo indicates inband-SamePCI for a cell.

question_47528.question: What information does the TFT-Filter AVP contain and what are its restrictions?
question_47528.ground_truth: The TFT-Filter AVP contains information about the TFT packet filter, including the direction, protocol, source IP address, source port, destination IP address, and destination port. The IPFilterRule type shall be used with the following restrictions: Action shall be set to "permit", no options shall be used, and the invert modifier "!" for addresses shall not be used. The direction "out" refers to downlink direction and "in" refers to uplink direction.

question_47530.question: In which case will the Node B initiate the Radio Link Pre-emption procedure, and what should it do after that?
question_47530.ground_truth: The Node B may initiate the Radio Link Pre-emption procedure at any time after establishing a Radio Link, and it shall send the RADIO LINK PREEMPTION REQUIRED INDICATION message to the CRNC using the Communication Control Port assigned to the concerned Node B Communication Context. If all Radio Links for a CRNC Communication Context ID should be pre-empted, the RL Information IE shall be omitted. If one or several but not all Radio Links should be pre-empted for a CRNC Communication Context, the Radio Links that should be pre-empted shall be indicated in the RL Information IE. The Radio Link(s) that should be pre-empted should be deleted by the CRNC.

question_47531.question: Which two components are set to the ON condition by the SS during the synchronization phase?
question_47531.ground_truth: CT106 and CT109 are set to the ON condition by the SS during the synchronization phase.

question_47532.question: What information is included in the C2 mode switching confirmation request message sent by the UAE Server to the UAS application specific server?
question_47532.ground_truth: The UAS identifier, the cause for switching, and the switching option (active links between network 1 and network 2, direct to network-assisted or network-assisted to direct or to UTM-Navigated).

question_47533.question: How is the OTA RE power control dynamic range requirement for BS type 2-O determined for FR2?
question_47533.ground_truth: The OTA RE power control dynamic range requirement for BS type 2-O is not defined for FR2 due to considerations about power boosting/de-boosting and coverage extensions for mmW scenarios.

question_47534.question: What was the conclusion regarding the use of DTMF in the speech channel with the GSM half rate codec for commercial application?
question_47534.ground_truth: A serious commercial application using DTMF in the speech channel should not be supported with the GSM half rate codec.

question_47535.question: What are the colorimetry options for the DECE SD Media Profile?
question_47535.ground_truth: The DECE SD Media Profile supports BT.709, BT.601 for 525-line video systems, and BT.1700 for 625-line video systems.

question_47537.question: What should the target eNB do with the received FIRST DL COUNT Value IE in the EARLY STATUS TRANSFER message?
question_47537.ground_truth: The target eNB should use the received value as the COUNT of the first downlink SDU that the source eNB forwards to the target eNB.

question_47538.question: What is the purpose of the list of equivalent PLMNs in UE?
question_47538.ground_truth: The UE stores a list of equivalent PLMNs, which are regarded as equivalent to each other for PLMN selection and cell selection/re-selection. The same list is used by 5GMM, EMM, GMM and MM.

question_47539.question: What are the possible causes for an announcement to be completed, as reported by the MRFP to the MRFC?
question_47539.ground_truth: The announcement is completed when either of the following has occurred: the announcement has been completed successfully, a DTMF digit is detected by the MRFP, or the playing announcement is not successful.

question_47540.question: What should be performed by an IPv6 node when handling IPv4 packet forwarding for IPv6 packets encapsulated in IPv4?
question_47540.ground_truth: By default, the IPv6 Traffic Class field should be copied to the IPv4 ToS (Type of Service) field when handling IPv4 packet forwarding for IPv6 packets encapsulated in IPv4.

question_47542.question: How does an ME respond when it receives a MORE TIME proactive UICC command, as defined in TS 31.111 clause 6.4.4?
question_47542.ground_truth: An ME sends a TERMINAL RESPONSE (OK) to the UICC after it receives a MORE TIME proactive UICC command when the ME conforms to the requirements defined in TS 31.111 clause 6.4.4, clause 6.6.4, clause 5.2, clause 8.6, and clause 8.7.

question_47545.question: When does the network operate in mode II, meaning that the packet common control channel shall not be allocated in the cell for GPRS-attached MSs?
question_47545.ground_truth: When no SGSN-MSC/VLR association exists and all MSC-originated paging of GPRS-attached MSs shall go via the A interface, and co-ordination of paging cannot be performed by the core network.

question_47546.question: What is the method used to split each encoding index into two parts in the multi-track joint coding processing?
question_47546.ground_truth: The original index is split into two indexes by a factor, where the length of each interval is not greater than a certain value. This is done to avoid directly combining encoding indexes and exceeding the bit width generally used for operating.

question_47547.question: What is the difference between a Private communication release and a Private communication reject?
question_47547.ground_truth: A Private communication release is a request to terminate an ongoing Private communication, while a Private communication reject is a response to a Private communication request indicating that the request has been denied.

question_47548.question: What should the MAC entity do when it receives a MAC PDU containing MAC sub PDUs each containing a MAC SDU that is greater than 256 bytes (16 bits L field used) with a padding MAC sub PDU at the end?
question_47548.ground_truth: The MAC entity should successfully decode the MAC PDU and forward to higher layer.

question_47549.question: What extensions are allowed in management information models while still remaining compliant with 3GPP SA5's specifications?
question_47549.ground_truth: Vendor-specific IOCs, new attribute types, and notifications can be added with vendor-specific IOCs and attributes. Also, NRM IOCs can be subclassed with specified behavior and added vendor-specific behavior with vendor-specific attributes. Vendor-specific attribute names must be distinguishable from existing attribute names.

question_47551.question: What should a receiver do when it encounters an Abstract Syntax Error due to missing IEs/IE groups based on their presence information?
question_47551.ground_truth: If the IEs/IE groups are marked as mandatory or conditionally present and the condition is true, the receiver should initiate the Error Indication procedure.

question_47552.question: What is the power source for the plug-in UE during the test setup?
question_47552.ground_truth: The real functional laptop supplies power to the plug-in UE during the test setup.

question_47553.question: What message does a BSS send to an SGSN when it has new Radio Access capability information for a MS?

question_47554.question: What is used to assess the distribution of broadcast channel block error probability in a simulated network for establishing broadcast channel coverage?
question_47554.ground_truth: An appropriate link-system mapping is applied at each point in the simulated network

question_47555.question: Which clause of the general unsolicited emissions section of the specification document defines the specific variation of the unwanted emissions mask for certain frequency ranges, band classes, categories of emissions, and power levels for sub-6 GHz?

question_47557.question: What does RNTI represent in the context of UMTS connected mode?
question_47557.ground_truth: RNTI, or Radio Network Temporary Identity, is a unique identifier assigned to a UE (User Equipment) when it establishes an RRC connection to UTRAN. There are two types of RNTI: Serving RNTI, which is assigned by the Serving RNC, and c-RNTI, which is assigned by the Controlling RNC for communication on DCCH (Dedicated Control CHannels).

question_47558.question: What is the purpose of the "New signalling procedure to trigger group monitoring activation" steps in the Serving GW and MME/SGSN sections?
question_47558.ground_truth: The "New signalling procedure to trigger group monitoring activation" steps in the Serving GW and MME/SGSN sections refer to the development of new procedures for activating group monitoring in the network, specifically for activating monitoring from the Serving GW to the MME/SGSN and from the MME/SGSN to the HSS.

question_47560.question: When should the selection and acknowledgement of security algorithms take place in SAE/LTE?
question_47560.ground_truth: The selection and acknowledgement of algorithms should take place immediately after or during each network attachment or during idle to active transitions.

question_47561.question: What is the purpose of the Performance Management (PM) Integration Reference Point (IRP) as specified in the document?
question_47561.ground_truth: The purpose of the PMIRP is to collect performance related data, which can be used to locate potential problems in the 3GPP network system.

question_47563.question: What information is used for Ethernet traffic flow classification in the 5G system?
question_47563.ground_truth: Source and Destination MAC address, Ethertype, including multiple Ethertypes in double-tagging, VLAN tags including VLAN ID and PCP, in addition to the existing fields used in Traffic Flow Templates (TFT).

question_47564.question: What is the primary purpose of throughput boosting in the context of client buffer filling?
question_47564.ground_truth: The primary purpose of throughput boosting is to speed up the filling of the client buffer, by temporarily increasing network throughput for this client. This can be used at the beginning of a session to shorten the time to playout and during the video session to re-fill the buffer quickly and avoid stalling of the video playout due to large changes in link throughput.

question_47565.question: What are the default settings for cell No.11 in the GSM system related to the UTRAN test scenario with two PLMN and cells belonging to two different frequencies?
question_47565.ground_truth: The default settings for cell No.11 (FDD) in the GSM system related to the UTRAN test scenario with two PLMN and cells belonging to two different frequencies are found in System Information Block type 11 for cell No.11 (FDD).

question_47566.question: What is the expected response of the MS when it receives a IDENTITY REQUEST message with ciphering enabled and the Identity Type IE set to "IMEISV"?
question_47566.ground_truth: The MS shall return its IMEISV in the Mobile Identity IE contained within the IDENTITY RESPONSE message.

question_47570.question: For what purpose does the SAD algorithm output a Boolean flag?
question_47570.ground_truth: The SAD algorithm outputs a Boolean flag to indicate whether each 20 ms frame contains signals that should be transmitted, i.e. speech, music or other audio.

question_47573.question: What is the role of channel reciprocity in feedback and measurement mechanisms for downlink coordinated multi-point transmission in LTE-Advanced?
question_47573.ground_truth: Channel reciprocity may be exploited for reporting dynamic channel conditions between the multiple transmission points and the UE and for facilitating the decision on the set of participating transmission points.

question_47574.question: In what situation is the entire packet pushed to APDC compression memory in this solution?
question_47574.ground_truth: The entire packet is pushed to APDC compression memory in packet action 011 and 101, and when resetting APDC compression memory to all zeros.

question_47575.question: What happens when a UE initiates a mobility registration update procedure during intra UE-AMF mobility?
question_47575.ground_truth: The AMF determines the conditions to trigger paging and initiates a paging request message to the IAB-donor gNB-du #2. The UE then initiates the UE Triggered Service Request procedure.

question_47576.question: In NB-S1 mode, what action does the MME take if the UE requested "SMS only" in the Additional update type IE and the MME decides to accept the attach request for EPS services and "SMS only"?
question_47576.ground_truth: The MME indicates "SMS only" in the Additional update result IE and sets the EPS attach result IE to "EPS only" in the ATTACH ACCEPT message.

question_47577.question: What is the purpose of the "integrity-protected" parameter in the Authorization header of a REGISTER request?
question_47577.ground_truth: The "integrity-protected" parameter in the Authorization header of a REGISTER request specifies whether the S-CSCF should perform integrity check or not for the request.

question_47578.question: What should the network do when it receives a message with syntactically incorrect optional IEs?
question_47578.ground_truth: The network should take the same approach as the UE, which is to treat all syntactically incorrect optional IEs as not present in the message.

question_47580.question: What is the unit for the Accumulated originating session time and Accumulated terminating session time measurements?
question_47580.ground_truth: The unit for the Accumulated originating session time and Accumulated terminating session time measurements is milliseconds.
