question_47581.question: What should the UE do if timer T302 expires or is stopped and timer T390 corresponding to an Access Category is not running or if timer T390 corresponding to an Access Category other than '2' expires or is stopped and timer T302 is not running?
question_47581.ground_truth: The UE should consider the barring for that Access Category to be alleviated.

question_47582.question: In 4.3.5.2, what is the action to be taken by the UE when its periodic TAU timer expires and it is currently camping on an E-UTRAN cell or in ECM-CONNECTED state?
question_47582.ground_truth: If ISR is activated, the UE shall start the GERAN/UTRAN Deactivate ISR timer, and perform a Routing Area Update when it next returns to GERAN/UTRAN coverage. If the UE is EPS attached only and either camps on an E-UTRAN cell or is in ECM CONNECTED state when the UE's periodic LAU timer expires, the UE shall perform a Location Area Update procedure in NMO II or combined RA/LA update in NMO I when it next returns to GERAN/UTRAN coverage.

question_47583.question: What does it mean when bit 7 of the TP-Protocol-Identifier is set to 0 and bit 6 is set to 1?
question_47583.ground_truth: When bit 7 of the TP-Protocol-Identifier is set to 0 and bit 6 is set to 1, bits 5..0 are used as defined below. These values indicate specific message types, such as Short Message Type 0, Replace Short Message Type 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, and Device Triggering Short Message.

question_47585.question: What are Personal IoT Networks and Customer Premises Networks in the context of the 5G system?
question_47585.ground_truth: Personal IoT Networks (PINs) and Customer Premises Networks (CPNs) are networks located within a premises, such as a residence or office, and provide local connectivity between UEs and/or non-3GPP devices using an evolved Residential Gateway (eRG) and Premises Radio Access Station (PRAS). These networks have access to 5G network services via wireline, wireless, or hybrid access. PINs consist of PIN Elements that communicate using PIN Direct Connection and have access to the 5G network services via a PIN Element with Gateway Capability.

question_47586.question: What is the scope of the 3GPP TS 48.0xx series of Technical Specifications?
question_47586.ground_truth: The 3GPP TS 48.0xx series of Technical Specifications deals with the definition of the base station system (BSS) to mobile switching center (MSC) interface, known as the A-interface, for the GSM system.

question_47587.question: What is the region defined for the application of a slope in the 10 MHz region on both sides of the UMTS bandwidth?
question_47587.ground_truth: The region is applied to further improve protection between services.

question_47588.question: Who is responsible for defining the reporting characteristics related to the data trustworthiness reports of an ML entity?
question_47588.ground_truth: The producer of ML training, testing, and AI/ML inference services should support a capability that enables an authorized MnS consumer to define these reporting characteristics.

question_47589.question: What is the structure of the MBSMulticastF1UContextDescriptor?
question_47589.ground_truth: The MBSMulticastF1UContextDescriptor is a sequence that consists of a multicastF1UContextReferenceE1, an mc-F1UCtxtusage, an mbsAreaSession (optional), and an iE-Extensions (optional).

question_47591.question: What is the procedure followed by the IWF in delivering the affiliation to the LMR system when a MCPTT user affiliates to the group?
question_47591.ground_truth: The procedure is outside the scope of the present document and is not specified.

question_47592.question: What shall the MCData client indicate to an MCData client when an SDS message is undelivered?
question_47592.ground_truth: The MCData client shall indicate to an MCData client that an SDS message was undelivered and can store the message for later re-delivery.

question_47594.question: What is the condition of the first call in the scenario "CALL A-B HELD/CALL C-B WAITING"?
question_47594.ground_truth: The first call (A-B) is held, and the second call (C-B) is waiting.

question_47595.question: What is the role of the MRFP in the "Media Stream Processing" function in relation to managing access rights to shared resources?
question_47595.ground_truth: The MRFP, under the control of the MRFC, provides media stream resources and manages access rights to these shared resources in a conferencing environment, such as floor control.

question_47596.question: What message does NFVO send to NM after deleting an NS instance identifier?

question_47597.question: What is the difference between "shall" and "must" in 3GPP technical specifications and reports?
question_47597.ground_truth: The construction "shall" is used instead of "must" in 3GPP technical specifications and reports, except in direct citations from external documents or to maintain continuity of style when extending or modifying provisions of such documents.

question_47599.question: What is the purpose of the CN common GSM-MAP NAS system information element for the CS domain?
question_47599.ground_truth: The CN common GSM-MAP NAS system information element for the CS domain provides the MS with actual parameter settings of parameters relevant only for MM functionality.

question_47601.question: What is the test method for determining the delay in the sending direction for handset or headset UE?
question_47601.ground_truth: The delay is measured by subtracting the delays introduced by the test equipment from the measured value between the reference point and the electrical access point of the test equipment.

question_47602.question: What is the purpose of the MUK in the communication optimized approach 1?
question_47602.ground_truth: The MUK is used to securely deliver transport keys in a point-to-point connection in the communication optimized approach 1.

question_47603.question: What action does the P-CSCF take upon receiving an SDP offer from remote UE with an BFCP-based media in terms of SDP fingerprint attribute?
question_47603.ground_truth: The P-CSCF removes the SDP fingerprint attribute in the SDP offer for each end-to-access-edge protected BFCP-based media.

question_47604.question: What is the purpose of the ISRP for IFOM rules in the UE and extended PCC rules in the PGW in this solution?
question_47604.ground_truth: The ISRP for IFOM rules in the UE and the extended PCC rules in the PGW are used to define preferred access types for certain service data flows (SDFs).

question_47605.question: What action should the UE take when the TFT operation is "Delete existing TFT" for a dedicated EPS bearer context and the TFT is already empty?
question_47605.ground_truth: The UE should send a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMPLETE message for the ongoing PDU session modification procedure and initiate a new PDU session modification procedure to delete the mapped EPS bearer context using 5GSM cause #41 "semantic error in the TFT operation".

question_47606.question: How does the BSS provide additional notification into ongoing voice broadcast, group calls and point-to-point calls in the cell?
question_47606.ground_truth: The BSS sends initial notification messages on FACCH to all other ongoing voice broadcast, group calls, and point-to-point calls in the cell, along with the broadcast call reference, priority level if eMLPP applies, and possibly the TCH description.

question_47608.question: Which clause in TS 38.321 determines how the HARQ process shall consider a transmission to be a new transmission or a retransmission based on the NDI?

question_47611.question: What is the outcome if the value of timer T3346 is greater than the value of timer T3512 in a REGISTRATION REJECT message during a registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update?
question_47611.ground_truth: If the value of timer T3346 is greater than the value of timer T3512 in a REGISTRATION REJECT message during a registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update, the AMF sets the mobile reachable timer and the implicit de-registration timer such that the sum of the timer values is greater than the value of timer T3346.

question_47612.question: What response does a UE receive if the S-CSCF supports GIBA in an IMS registration?
question_47612.ground_truth: The UE receives a 200 OK response.

question_47613.question: Which standards specify the services that provide application support to construct, manage, and process messages distributed between end users or between infrastructure and end-users based on payload received from the V2X application(s)?
question_47613.ground_truth: The standards SAE J2945/3, SAE J2945/4, SAE J2945/6, and ISO 21217:2014 specify the services that provide application support to construct, manage, and process messages distributed between end users or between infrastructure and end-users based on payload received from the V2X application(s).

question_47615.question: What is the note about the offset between the center base station of the aggressor system and the center base station of the victim system in Note 2?
question_47615.ground_truth: Note 2 states that considering the aggressor ISD and victim ISD of 1.2 R or 1.22 R and R respectively, the offset between the center base station of the aggressor system and the center base station of the victim system equals to that when both aggressor and victim ISDs are R.

question_47616.question: What is the purpose of user-initiated emergency reregistration in the context of 3GPP TS 24.229?
question_47616.ground_truth: The purpose of user-initiated emergency reregistration is to ensure that the user can maintain emergency call services even when the user's registration has expired, and to establish a new emergency call or continue ongoing emergency calls.

question_47619.question: What should the AMF provide to the UE in a roaming case if it provides a Partially Allowed NSSAI?
question_47619.ground_truth: The AMF should provide mapping information of each S-NSSAI of the Partially Allowed NSSAI to the corresponding HPLMN S-NSSAI.

question_47621.question: What information is provided in the NRM server's response after calculating the schedule for a VAL Stream ID?
question_47621.ground_truth: The NRM server response includes per-stream filtering and policing parameters, TSC QoS information and related flow information, a forwarding rule to identify the DS-TT MAC address of the corresponding PDU session, and TSC Assistance information for the stream, based on the 5GS bridge delay information.

question_47622.question: What was the purpose of the European Commission's Broadband vision analysis?
question_47622.ground_truth: The purpose of the analysis was to evaluate the impact of 2 RX on throughput, required for European Commission's Broadband vision, as part of RAN 4 meeting discussions.

question_47623.question: What should the UE do when it receives a REGISTRATION REJECT message including 5GMM cause value #95?
question_47623.ground_truth: UE shall delete 5G-GUTI, last visited TAI and ngKSI, performs a PLMN selection after timer T3502 timeout.

question_47625.question: In use case #2, what is the role of the V-SMF when a UE moves from PLMN A to PLMN B?
question_47625.ground_truth: In use case #2, a V-SMF is allocated in the serving PLMN (PLMN B) to control the UPF(s) in the VPLMN. The H-SMF controls the anchor UPF in PLMN A.

question_47626.question: What is a feature provided by the MCX Service that allows an authorized MCX UE to determine the current list of members of an MCX Service Group regardless of their membership?
question_47626.ground_truth: The MCX Service shall provide, upon request, the current list of members of an MCX Service Group to an authorized user regardless of the MCX UE's membership.

question_47627.question: Why are version numbers important in namespaces for specification documents?
question_47627.ground_truth: Version numbers in namespaces enable multiple versions of a specification to be identified easily, both by human inspection and by machine inspection.

question_47628.question: What must be available for an ADMC fault to be cleared in the NE?
question_47628.ground_truth: System operator functions must be available to request the clearing of ADAC alarms/faults in the NE.

question_47629.question: When should the Node B include the Multicell E-DCH Restriction IE in the Possible Secondary Serving Cell List IE?
question_47629.ground_truth: The Node B should include the Multicell E-DCH Restriction IE in the Possible Secondary Serving Cell List IE when a cell in the list is restricted for use as an Additional E-DCH on the secondary uplink frequency with the Local Cell as the corresponding cell of the primary uplink frequency.

question_47630.question: What message is sent by the AMF to the UDM for 3GPP access deregistration?
question_47630.ground_truth: The AMF sends a PATCH request to the resource representing the UE's AMF registration for 3GPP access.

question_47631.question: What types of information can the ANDSF provide to the UE?
question_47631.ground_truth: The ANDSF can provide various types of information to the UE, which includes inter-system mobility policies, network access discovery information, and inter-system routing policies. The types of information it provides are determined by the operator's requirements and the roaming agreements.

question_47633.question: How is the Random Access Preamble selected for NB-IoT UEs if ra-PreambleIndex and PRACH resource are explicitly signalled?
question_47633.ground_truth: If the ra-PreambleIndex signalled is not 000000, the Random Access Preamble is set using the formula nprach-SubcarrierOffset + nprach-NumCBRA-StartSubcarriers + (ra-PreambleIndex modulo (nprach-NumSubcarriers - nprach-NumCBRA-StartSubcarriers)). Otherwise, the Random Access Preamble is selected based on the PRACH resource and support for multi-tone Msg3 transmission.

question_47634.question: What is the difference between an MnS consumer and an Exposed MnS consumer?
question_47634.ground_truth: An MnS consumer is equivalent to an Exposed MnS consumer with the difference that an MnS consumer is inside the trust domain of the CSP or NOP, while an Exposed MnS consumer is outside the trust domain of the CSP or NOP.

question_47635.question: What parameters does SSR Orbit Corrections provide the GNSS receiver with regarding satellite orbit corrections?
question_47635.ground_truth: SSR Orbit Corrections provides the GNSS receiver with parameters for orbit corrections in radial, along-track, and cross-track components, as well as correlation time and orbit error rate for integrity purposes.

question_47636.question: What action should a participating MCVideo function take if it receives a SIP REFER request for a pre-established session with a "SIP 500 (Server Internal Error)" response?
question_47636.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function may reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response and include a Retry-After header field. It shall not continue with the rest of the steps.

question_47637.question: What is the role of the FAE server in the 3GPP system connectivity between FF application specific clients?
question_47637.ground_truth: The FAE server provides necessary information such as identifiers of FF application specific clients and transport requirements in the request message for establishing or modifying the 3GPP system level connectivity between FF application specific clients.

question_47638.question: What is the first reason for changing the characteristics of the radio channel during a call?
question_47638.ground_truth: The first reason for changing the characteristics of the radio channel during a call is for the swap from speech to data and vice versa.

question_47639.question: What should the UE do when it does not have geographical location information available and does not have a URI that points to the location information during an emergency call?
question_47639.ground_truth: The UE shall not insert a Geolocation header field in the INVITE request.

question_47640.question: Which Telecommunications requirements does SuM fulfill in the 3G environment?
question_47640.ground_truth: SuM fulfills the requirements of device diversity, access diversity, and service diversity in the 3G environment.

question_47643.question: What is the difference between online and offline charging in the present document?
question_47643.ground_truth: Online charging is a charging mechanism where charging information affects the service rendered in real-time, while offline charging is a charging mechanism where charging information does not affect the service rendered in real-time.

question_47644.question: Which procedures requesting the creation of PDN connection, creation or modification of bearers, or creation of data forwarding tunnel should be given the lowest level of priority and would be throttled during network congestion resulting in denial of new services?
question_47644.ground_truth: Create Session Request during PDN connection request, Create Bearer Request, Update Bearer Request, Bearer Resource Command, Modify Bearer Command, and Create Indirect Data Forwarding Tunnel Request.

question_47647.question: What is the requirement for the probability of false detection of the ACK in 8.3.6.1 in TS 36.104?
question_47647.ground_truth: The probability of false detection of the ACK shall be 0.01 or less.

question_47648.question: What is one potential standardization area for interactive immersive media services?
question_47648.ground_truth: One potential standardization area is cross-layer design, with radio and 5G system optimizations for QoS support.

question_47649.question: What action does the UPF/NW-TT perform upon reception of the notification in step~5 if the time source for the Time Sync service requested to be activated is in the UPF/NW-TT?
question_47649.ground_truth: The UPF/NW-TT starts to create and distribute the (g)PTP messages of the 5G GM to the UE.

question_47650.question: Which HTTP protocol versions are required to be supported by the 5GMS AF at interfaces M1 and M5?
question_47650.ground_truth: The 5GMS AF shall expose both HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 endpoints at interfaces M1 and M5.

question_47651.question: What is the purpose of HTTP verbs at level 2 of the IRP REST Solution Set compliance?
question_47651.ground_truth: At level 2, HTTP methods are used for their real purpose and not just as a tunneling mechanism. The type of action the server performs is conveyed by the HTTP verb, distinguishing between safe (read-only) actions and unsafe (read-write) actions on the resources.

question_47652.question: What must the User Equipment (UE) do when it supports 3GPP PS data off and receives a REGISTER request?
question_47652.ground_truth: The UE must include the "+g.3gpp.ps-data-off" header field parameter in the REGISTER request.

question_47653.question: When is the IPSec tunnel modification procedure performed in this specification?
question_47653.ground_truth: The IPSec tunnel modification procedure is performed in this specification when the IPSec tunnel between the UE and the ePDG has been modified due to the UE initiated IPSec tunnel update procedure, or the UE local IP address updating, and the UE supports MOBIKE.

question_47654.question: How are NAS messages exchanged between the UE and AMF secured during inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode?
question_47654.ground_truth: The UE generates the mapped 5G NAS security context from the NAS security related parameters received in the AS signalling from the AMF. After the inter-system change in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode, the UE sends the REGISTRATION REQUEST message integrity protected using the mapped 5G NAS security context and the AMF decides whether to take the native or mapped 5G NAS security context into use. From that point forward, all NAS messages exchanged between the UE and AMF are sent integrity protected and, except for specific messages, ciphered using the chosen security context.

question_47655.question: What should the MME do with the related MBMS bearer contexts when an Iu path failure is detected by the RNC, and the corresponding MBMS bearer contexts are not re-established via any S4-SGSN?
question_47655.ground_truth: The S4-SGSN should maintain the related MBMS bearer contexts but shall locally delete the RNC related information, i.e., Iu related resources, for all MBMS service associations.

question_47657.question: What is the purpose of the exchange of information between UE-A and UE-B?
question_47657.ground_truth: The purpose of the exchange of information is to give UE-B information about resource occupancy acquired by UE-A which it might not be able to determine on its own due to hidden nodes, exposed nodes, persistent collisions, etc.

question_47658.question: Which device type in the 5G STandalone AR (STAR) UE provides all UE functionalities and is referred to as a STandalone AR UE?
question_47658.ground_truth: The device type that includes all UE functionalities and is referred to as a STandalone AR UE is the 5G STandalone AR (STAR) UE.

question_47660.question: When can AMF send the satellite backhaul category to PCF?
question_47660.ground_truth: It is sent when the UE is accessing gNB with satellite backhaul, and AMF is aware of the satellite backhaul category.

question_47662.question: What is the maximum number of times the element "xs:any" with processContents "lax" can appear in the XML schema?
question_47662.ground_truth: The maximum number of times the element "xs:any" with processContents "lax" can appear in the XML schema is 1.

question_47663.question: What is the difference between the first digit values in the version number (x in the document)?
question_47663.ground_truth: The first digit of the version number indicates the stage of the document's development: 0 for information, 1 for approval, and 3 or higher for TSG-approved documents under change control.

question_47667.question: What is the purpose of the T5068 timer in the 5G DDNMF discoveree request procedure?
question_47667.ground_truth: The T5068 timer is used in the 5G DDNMF discoveree request procedure to assign a validity timer for the ProSe response code, ProSe query code, and discovery query filter(s).

question_47668.question: What is the normalization factor used for, in relation to 14.10.8.2?
question_47668.ground_truth: The normalization factor is used to account for potential improved receiver performances when calculating the test levels.

question_47669.question: What is the purpose of the "<choice>" stereotype in UML?
question_47669.ground_truth: The "<choice>" stereotype represents one of a set of classes (when used as an information model element) or one of a set of data types (when used as an operations model element) to support scenarios where the specific kind of class or data type cannot be determined at model specification time.

question_47670.question: What is the purpose of the SYNC protocol within the BM-SC in the context of header compression?
question_47670.ground_truth: The SYNC protocol within the BM-SC allows for alignment of full header packets with the MSP, which is necessary for the full benefits of header compression to be realized.

question_47671.question: What message is sent by the AMF to inform the source NG-RAN node that resources for the handover have been prepared at the target side?

question_47672.question: What are the possible techniques that the UE can use to locate itself in a specific Geographical Area?
question_47672.ground_truth: When the UE is in coverage of a 3GPP RAT, it can use information derived from the serving PLMN. When the UE is not in coverage of a 3GPP RAT, it can use other techniques, e.g. Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS).

question_47673.question: What action is taken by the target MME when the timer at the target MME expires in step 7?
question_47673.ground_truth: The target MME starts a timer if the target MME applies indirect forwarding, and informs the Serving GW that it is now responsible for all the EPS bearers the UE has established.

question_47674.question: What should be included in a PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message during contention resolution?
question_47674.ground_truth: The TLLI should be included in the PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message during contention resolution.

question_47676.question: What actions should the AMF take if the UE has included a ngKSI indicating a current 5G NAS security context in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message, but the AMF cannot retrieve the current 5G NAS security context as indicated by the ngKSI and 5G-GUTI sent by the UE?
question_47676.ground_truth: The AMF should treat the REGISTRATION REQUEST message as failed the integrity check and take actions as specified in subclause~4.4.4.3.

question_47677.question: When is the deletion of bearers between the Serving GW and the MME considered complete?
question_47677.ground_truth: When the Serving GW receives a Delete Bearer Response from the MME

question_47678.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe Device ID in ProSe Direct Discovery?
question_47678.ground_truth: The ProSe Device ID is used to determine if a Destination Layer 2-ID has been provisioned for the type of communication being requested (e.g. unicast, groupcast, or broadcast) in ProSe Direct Discovery.

question_47679.question: What is the goal of Scenario 3 in the 3GPP - WLAN interworking scenarios?
question_47679.ground_truth: The goal of Scenario 3 is to allow the operator to extend 3GPP system PS based services to the WLAN, such as APNs, IMS based services, location based services, instant messaging, presence based services, MBMS, and any service that is built upon the combination of several of these components.

question_47681.question: What action does the SCC AS take upon receiving a SIP ACK request from the CS domain after sending a SIP 200 (OK) response to the remote UE?
question_47681.ground_truth: The SCC AS sends a SIP ACK toward the remote UE, releases the SIP dialog on the Source Access Leg by sending a SIP BYE request via the SIP dialog over the Gm reference point on the Source Access Leg if the SIP dialog is still active, and sends an I1 Success message toward the UE over the I1 interface.

question_47682.question: What are the general requirements for 3GPP enhancement for TV service support?
question_47682.ground_truth: The general requirements for 3GPP enhancement for TV service support include on-demand network capacity assignment for TV services, support for downlink only broadcasting based on a set of EPS functionalities and entities, on-demand network broadcast service area coverage management for TV transport services, support for content delivery up to UHD resolution, and support for combinations of SD, FHD and UHD resolution TV transport services.

question_47683.question: What is the role of the SEALDD-S data transmission connection information of the SEALDD server side in the SEALDD process?
question_47683.ground_truth: The SEALDD-S data transmission connection information of the SEALDD server side is used by the VAL server and SEALDD server to establish the data transmission connection between VAL server and SEALDD server for application data transfer.

question_47684.question: What is the role of the Terminal Adaptation Function (TAF) in the 3GPP system?
question_47684.ground_truth: The Terminal Adaptation Function (TAF) is responsible for the functions needed for terminal adaptation within the 3GPP system. It enables non-voice traffic in the PLMN by connecting various kinds of terminal equipment to the Mobile Termination (MT).

question_47685.question: What mechanism can be used for indication of packets to be retransmitted and informing the sender of loss of particular RTP packets for sender to take necessary actions to recover from errors?
question_47685.ground_truth: Generic NACK message can be used for indication of packets to be retransmitted as well as informing the sender of loss of particular RTP packets for sender to take necessary actions to recover from errors.

question_47686.question: What condition must be met for the CFNL service to operate in the 5G network?
question_47686.ground_truth: The CFNL service enables a served user to redirect incoming communications to another user in case the served user is not registered (logged-in) to the 5G network. The service may operate on all communications, or just those associated with specified basic services.

question_47687.question: Which UE parameter formulation was agreed to be used for the UE co-channel Tx model, as it is a minimum performance requirement rather than a typical requirement?
question_47687.ground_truth: The formulation from the current specification is being used for the UE co-channel Tx model.

question_47691.question: When should the UE associate the PDU session with the control plane only indication after an inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode?
question_47691.ground_truth: When the EPS bearer context(s) of the PDN connection are associated with the control plane only indication and the PDN connection supports interworking to 5GS.

question_47692.question: What is the expected sequence of message contents in step 14 of the test procedure?
question_47692.ground_truth: The expected sequence of message contents in step 14 of the test procedure is 52.3.1.1.7, which includes conformance requirements for the mobile station to follow during uplink transfer.

question_47693.question: What are the frequency bands to be used for calculating the sending sensitivity of handset terminals in SLR measurement?
question_47693.ground_truth: For calculating the sending sensitivity of handset terminals in SLR measurement, the 14 frequency bands from 220 Hz to 8 kHz (bands 4 to 17 in ITU-T Recommendation P.79) should be used.

question_47694.question: What is the maximum rate of ACK/NACK feedback loss allowed on any active E-UTRA serving cell when CSI and RRM measurements are performed on NR SCell(s) in dormancy?
question_47694.ground_truth: 0.5% and 1.0% for CSI and RRM measurements, respectively.

question_47695.question: What are the possible subcounters for the measurement DANS.SerSubReceived in 5.18.3.1.1?
question_47695.ground_truth: Subcounters per service name, subcounters per Analytics ID, and subcounters per S-NSSAI.

question_47696.question: What is the key used in the TLS security tunnel establishment between the UE and the 5G MSG Server in Step 4?
question_47696.ground_truth: The key K5GMSG, which is generated through the key negotiation process between the UE and the 5G MSG Server in Step 1-3.

question_47697.question: What property does the "IntentHandlingCapability" data type contain that describes the expectation object type which can be supported by a specific intent handling function of MnS producer?
question_47697.ground_truth: The "supportedExpectationObjectType" property of the "IntentHandlingCapability" data type describes the expectation object type which can be supported by a specific intent handling function of MnS producer.

question_47699.question: Which MIME body should be included in the SIP INVITE request, with the <mcptt-request-uri> element set to the group identity?

question_47700.question: Under what conditions will a UE stay in the current serving cell and attempt to use the rejected S-NSSAI(s) after reaching the maximum number of UEs?
question_47700.ground_truth: When the UE wants to obtain services in the current serving cell without performing a PLMN selection or SNPN selection and has rejected NSSAI for the maximum number of UEs reached.

question_47701.question: What is the purpose of the test procedure in 14.4.1.3, related to conformance requirements 1, 2, and 3 under propagation condition TUlow with no frequency hopping?
question_47701.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that the MS does not exceed the conformance requirements 1, 2, and 3 under propagation conditions TUlow with no frequency hopping.

question_47702.question: What is the effect of having a DNN in both the Traffic descriptor and Route Selection Descriptor of a USRP rule in terms of DNN replacement policy for UEs?
question_47702.ground_truth: To provide uniform service experience for UEs from earlier Releases, when a USRP rule with a DNN in both, Traffic descriptor and Route Selection Descriptor, is provided to the UEs, the DNN(s) used in the Traffic descriptor would also need to be included in the policy for DNN replacement in the network. In addition, a lower priority Route Selection Descriptor without a DNN would also need to be provided to the UEs.

question_47703.question: What components contribute to the user interaction delay in the context of gaming?
question_47703.ground_truth: The user interaction delay in gaming consists of the time taken to capture user interaction in the game client, deliver it to the game engine/server, and process it by the game engine/server.

question_47706.question: What does the "Constraints" clause in W4.5.2 indicate?
question_47706.ground_truth: This clause indicates whether there are any constraints affecting attributes and each constraint is defined by a triplet (propertyName, affectedAttributes, propertyDefinition).

question_47707.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification in the context of facsimile group 3 in a 3GPP system?
question_47707.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification describes the technical realization of facsimile group 3 using non-transparent network support within the 3GPP system.

question_47709.question: What action should the UE take if the EPS services are not allowed in the current PLMN?
question_47709.ground_truth: The UE shall set the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED and delete any GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI List and eKSI. The UE shall reset the tracking area updating attempt counter and shall enter the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH.

question_47710.question: What are the two possible values for the update flag in the POST request for the NumOfUEsUpdate service operation?
question_47710.ground_truth: The two possible values for the update flag in the POST request for the NumOfUEsUpdate service operation are "INCREASE" for a UE to be registered to a specific slice, and "DECREASE" for a UE to be deregistered from a specific slice.

question_47711.question: What is added by the I-CSCF-hA1 and the S-CSCF-hA1 in the Record-Route header field?
question_47711.ground_truth: Both the I-CSCF-hA1 and the S-CSCF-hA1 adds entries to the Record-Route header field. The AS could store the entries and setup a new Record-Route header field only with the AS URI as an entry.

question_47712.question: What should an AMF consider when determining its paging strategy?
question_47712.ground_truth: The AMF should take into consideration whether a gNB is using Paging subgrouping based on the UE's temporary ID.

question_47713.question: What is the role of the "3GPP publishes a Solution Set document" in the RESTful interface?
question_47713.ground_truth: The Solution Set document in a RESTful interface formally describes the schema for each interface in a machine-readable version.

question_47714.question: If the received SIP INVITE request includes a specific alert-info header field value, what should the MCVideo client do?
question_47714.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should not give any indication of the progress of the call to the MCVideo user.

question_47715.question: What should the UE (MCVideo client) do if it can determine the group identity to be a TGI and can associate it with a MCVideo group ID?
question_47715.ground_truth: The UE (MCVideo client) should set the `<associated-group-id>` element to the MCVideo group ID.

question_47717.question: What is the impact of service continuity procedure on the delivery of media streams?
question_47717.ground_truth: The procedure is completed when all media streams have been transferred on the UE-to-network relay leg. After that, UE-1 may deregister the on-network leg if it still has a direct network connection.

question_47718.question: What should the UE do if access for "originating signalling" is barred in NB-S1 mode and the detach signalling procedure cannot be started?
question_47718.ground_truth: The UE stays in the current serving cell and applies the normal cell reselection process. Further UE behavior is implementation specific.

question_47720.question: What action does the NG-RAN take if the AMF provides a Target NSSAI and the current TA does not support it?
question_47720.ground_truth: The NG-RAN may apply redirection or handover of the UE to a cell in another TA supporting the Target NSSAI.

question_47721.question: What is the purpose of the list of recent invitations in MCVideo?
question_47721.ground_truth: The list of recent invitations is stored and presented to the user on demand, allowing users to manage their group communication preferences.

question_47722.question: What should the floor control interface do upon receiving the Floor Idle message from the floor control server arbitration logic in the MCPTT server, if no indication is stored?
question_47722.ground_truth: Enter the 'U: not permitted and Floor Idle' state.

question_47723.question: What is the role of 5G system in providing QoS for a service in the described use case?
question_47723.ground_truth: The 5G system provides the required QoS (e.g. reliability, end-to-end latency, and bandwidth) for a service and supports prioritization of resources when necessary for that service.

question_47725.question: What is the role of the PDN GW in network-initiated NBIFOM mode if the UE successfully connects with the network but does not receive an NBIFOM indication from the network?
question_47725.ground_truth: If the UE successfully connects with the network but does not receive an NBIFOM indication, the UE assumes that its PDN connection over the first access was handed over to the new access.

question_47726.question: What should the UE do if the back-off timer is used in N1 mode for a PLMN and APN combination and the network indicates that re-attempt in S1 mode is not allowed?
question_47726.ground_truth: The UE should not send any BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message in this PLMN for the same APN after inter-system change to S1 mode until the timer expires, the UE is switched off or the USIM is removed.

question_47727.question: What is the sublayer that the PDCP entities are associated with?

question_47728.question: What is the issue with the PCRF's inability to supply different rating group or service id for different PCC rules in the described scenario?
question_47728.ground_truth: This makes it difficult for the charging system to correlate the PS CDR and IMS CDR, as there may be one PS CDR with multiple AF-Correlation-Information.

question_47729.question: What action should the UE take if T421 expires or if the target L2 U2N Relay UE changes its serving PCell to a different cell before path addition or change and MCG transmission is not suspended?
question_47729.ground_truth: The UE shall initiate the indirect path failure information procedure as specified in clause 5.7.3c to report indirect path addition/change failure.

question_47730.question: What entity verifies the P-TMSI Signature in the 3GPP network if the signature is included in a Routeing Area Update Request, Detach Request, or Attach Request message from a MS?

question_47731.question: What is the role of the third control loop in the alternative rate adaptation scheme with 3 loops?
question_47731.ground_truth: The third control loop is used for signalling a back-off value applied to the granted rate for controlling the transmission rate and keeping a desirable HARQ retransmission rate.

question_47732.question: What is the responsibility of the PIN server when the life cycle of a PIN has ended or the PIN server decides to stop providing PIN service in a PIN?
question_47732.ground_truth: The PIN server should trigger a PIN delete procedure to the PEMC which manages the PIN.

question_47735.question: What is the purpose of transmitting Silence Descriptor (SID) information during the SACCH/T block period in 3GPP TS~45.008 standard?
question_47735.ground_truth: The purpose is to transmit dummy information during the SACCH/T block period, which is specific to DTX operation and does not constitute a logical channel.

question_47738.question: How do UEs establish a connection in the IAB network utilizing MBSR mobility?
question_47738.ground_truth: UEs can establish a connection via the cells served by MBSR. The IAB-DU and m-CU pair form the serving gNB for the UEs, and standard procedures are used without impacting the UE.

question_47740.question: What is the method used by the target ng-eNB to validate the UE request and retrieve the UE context when a RRC Resume Request message is received?
question_47740.ground_truth: The target ng-eNB extracts the I-RNTI from the RRC Resume Request message and contacts the source ng-eNB based on the information in the I-RNTI, sending an Xn-AP Retrieve UE Context Request message that includes the I-RNTI, ShortResumeMAC-I, and target Cell-ID, in order to validate the UE request and retrieve the UE context.

question_47741.question: What should the PC5 QoS rule identifier, PQFI, packet filters, and precedence value be passed to in the lower layers for 5G ProSe communication over PC5?
question_47741.ground_truth: The PC5 QoS rule identifier, PQFI, packet filters, and precedence value should be passed to the lower layers for further processing and communication.

question_47742.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for inter-band EN-DC within FR1 and FR2 in TS 38.101-3?
question_47742.ground_truth: The spurious emissions requirement for E-UTRA single carrier and CA operation specified in clauses 7.9.1 and 7.9.1A of TS 36.101, and NR single carrier and CA operation specified in clauses 7.9 and 7.9A of TS 38.101-1 apply. The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.101-3 clause 7.9B.5.

question_47743.question: What is the purpose of the CONNECT message in the Call Control service class?
question_47743.ground_truth: The CONNECT message is used to indicate call acceptance by the Mobile terminated user, and call control is requested to attach the user connection if it is not yet attached.

question_47744.question: What is the command type in the "PROACTIVE COMMAND: RECEIVE DATA" with a command qualifier of RFU and a source device of UICC?

question_47746.question: When does the cardinality of a data structure in the response body indicate the presence condition of the data structure?
question_47746.ground_truth: The cardinality of a data structure in the response body indicates the presence condition of the data structure when it is set to "0..1" for a presence condition of "C" or "O", and to "1" for a presence condition of "M".

question_47747.question: What is the format of the ServiceType enumerated type?
question_47747.ground_truth: It is an ENUMERATED containing qMC-for-streaming-service, qMC-for-MSTI-service, and other values.

question_47748.question: What operation is performed on the HARQ-ACK information bits of the first and second transport blocks when harq-ACK-SpatialBundlingPUCCH is provided to the UE?
question_47748.ground_truth: A binary AND operation is performed.

question_47749.question: What document specifies the SOAP Solution Set (SS) for the IRP with semantics specified in Delta Synchronization IRP IS?
question_47749.ground_truth: The present document, which is part of a TS-family covering the 3rd Generation Partnership Project; Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects; Telecommunication management; Communication Surveillance management Integration Reference Point (IRP), specifies the SOAP SS for the IRP with semantics specified in Delta Synchronization IRP IS.

question_47750.question: What is the duration of time period T1 in the test procedure?
question_47750.ground_truth: T1 is the duration of time before the UE has timing information of cell 2.

question_47751.question: What should a UE do when it determines that the plink transmission timings based on timing adjustment indications from an MCG and an SCG are different?
question_47751.ground_truth: The UE should adjust the transmission timing for PUSCH/SRS/PUCCH on all serving cells in the band with the synchronous contiguous intra-band EN-DC based on the timing adjustment indication for a TAG from a serving cell in MCG in the band.

question_47752.question: How can reliability of uplink control signalling (PUCCH) be maintained for HeNBs and macro-eNBs?
question_47752.ground_truth: By making use of PUCCH offsets for enabling orthogonal PUCCH assignments between the HeNB and macro-eNB users.

question_47753.question: What is the requirement for the cell re-selection delay to an already detected cell in the described test scenario?
question_47753.ground_truth: The cell re-selection delay to an already detected cell should be less than a total of 7.68 seconds (allowed to be 8 seconds) in this test case.

question_47754.question: What is the agreement between RAN2 and RAN4 regarding release independent support of Rel-16 transparent TxD capability for PC2?
question_47754.ground_truth: RAN2 agreed to support release independent transparent TxD capability for PC2 in Rel-15, by allowing early implementation of the Rel-16 CRs.

question_47755.question: What factor, aside from a DRX cycle of 160 ms, can cause an increase in the number of failures in beam switch rate?
question_47755.ground_truth: A lower number of beams per RRH

question_47757.question: What is the maximum power emitted by the MS in the frequency band of 925 MHz to 935 MHz?
question_47757.ground_truth: The maximum power emitted by the MS in the frequency band of 925 MHz to 935 MHz is -67 dBm.

question_47759.question: What is the name of the connection between the MTC-IWF and the HLR/HSS in the 3GPP MTC architecture?
question_47759.ground_truth: The S6m reference point is used by MTC-IWFs to connect to the HLR/HSS.

question_47760.question: What is the definition of AI/ML Inference History in 5.2.1.4?
question_47760.ground_truth: AI/ML Inference History is an IOC that contains the critical properties and modules needed to accomplish ML Testing, including the list of MLInferenceHistoryRequests, the list of ML entities, and MLInferenceHistoryReporting to report on MLInferenceHistoryRequests or their related outcomes.

question_47761.question: Which Bands are not intended for use in the same geographical area as Bands 29 and 70?
question_47761.ground_truth: Bands 11, 21, 28, 42, 44, 45, and 66 are not intended for use in the same geographical area as Bands 29 and 70.

question_47762.question: What information does the S-AMF send to the S-RAN in the Handover Command message when uplink packets are sent from T-RAN to T-UPF and UPF (PSA) and downlink packets are sent from UPF (PSA) to S-RAN via S-UPF?
question_47762.ground_truth: The S-RAN should start forwarding of downlink data from the S-RAN towards the T-RAN towards QoS Flows or DRBs subject to data forwarding. This may be either direct (step~3a) or indirect forwarding (step~3b).

question_47766.question: What are the three mechanisms by which the CTS-FP can receive necessary operation data?
question_47766.ground_truth: The three mechanisms are: 1) via a fixed network connection between CTS-FP and the CTS operator, 2) directly from the GSM network when the CTS-FP is connected via radio to a GSM PLMN, and 3) by means of network information via the radio interface from the cellular network to the CTS-MS.

question_47770.question: What is the difference between ACLR and EVM requirement in the context of conducting and over-the-air (OTA) testing?
question_47770.ground_truth: The ACLR (Adjacent Channel Leakage Ratio) requirement is important in all directions, while the EVM (Error Vector Magnitude) requirement is only important in specific directions from the AAS BS, where the base station intends to communicate with the user equipment (UE).

question_47771.question: What is the role of the MSGin5G Gateway Client in relation to MSGin5G UE registration responses?
question_47771.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Gateway Client splits the bulk registration response into multiple individual UE registration responses.

question_47772.question: In the context of a SIP NOTIFY request, what does the <p-id> child element of the <presence> root element of the application/pidf+xml MIME body indicate?
question_47772.ground_truth: The <p-id> element value indicates the SIP PUBLISH request which triggered sending of the SIP NOTIFY request

question_47773.question: What is the required confidence level for assessing whether the UE's L1-RSRP report meets the specified requirements in the EN-DC FR1 CSI-RS-based L1-RSRP measurement in non-DRX test?

question_47776.question: What is necessary for the 5G system to support authentication of a UE with 3GPP credentials for communication with entities in a CPN?
question_47776.ground_truth: The CPN needs to be connected with the 5G core network.

question_47777.question: What is the default action for unrecognized header extensions in FLUTE?
question_47777.ground_truth: The default action for unrecognized header extensions is to ignore them.

question_47780.question: When should the UE include its IMEISV in the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message?
question_47780.ground_truth: If the UE supports at least one 3GPP access technology, it must include its IMEISV in the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message when the AMF indicated it was required in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.

question_47781.question: What should the terminating network do if network-provided identity information about the originator is available and presentation is allowed?
question_47781.ground_truth: The terminating network should include that information in the requests sent to the UE.

question_47782.question: What is the function of the Network Data Analytics Function (NWDAF) in the 5G system?
question_47782.ground_truth: The NWDAF is responsible for providing slice specific network data analytics, notifying/publishing slice specific network status analytic information to the PCF(s), and providing load level information of network slice.

question_47783.question: What action does the BSS take when it initiates the radio interface uplink release procedure?
question_47783.ground_truth: When the BSS receives the UPLINK RELEASE COMMAND message to initiate the radio interface uplink release procedure, it shall initiate the procedure and release the uplink for the requesting MS.

question_47784.question: What are the benefits of using an AIPN for offering IP-based services?
question_47784.ground_truth: An AIPN allows AIPN operators to offer IP-based services and provide inter-working methods with IP service providers, while supporting applications designed based on AIPN capabilities without the need for explicit standardisation.

question_47785.question: What is the goal of a 5G LAN-type service being able to collect charging information based on resource usage?
question_47785.ground_truth: The goal is to support regulatory requirements and charge users for their use of the 5G PVN based on resource usage such as licensed or unlicensed spectrum, QoS, and applications.

question_47786.question: What is the minimum frequency hopping interval for the uplink when uplink frequency hopping is enabled in the base station sector?
question_47786.ground_truth: The minimum frequency hopping interval for the uplink is 8 slots, corresponding to 40 ms.

question_47787.question: Which network component sends the small data rate control indication to the SMF during PDU session establishment?
question_47787.ground_truth: The AMF sends the small data rate control indication to the SMF during PDU session establishment if it has stored in the AMF for the PDU session.

question_47789.question: What are the two delivery methods defined for MBMS user services?
question_47789.ground_truth: The two delivery methods defined for MBMS user services are streaming and download.

question_47790.question: What are the general timing requirements for the delivery of Interception Related Information (IRI) data records?
question_47790.ground_truth: The IRI data records should be sent by the delivery function to the LEMF over the HI2 within seconds of the detection of the triggering event by the IAP at least 95% of the time. Additionally, each IRI data record should contain a time-stamp, based on the intercepting node's clock that is generated following the detection of the IRI triggering event.

question_47791.question: What is the drawback of Alternative 2 in ICS Data Management?
question_47791.ground_truth: The drawback of Alternative 2 is that the CS telephony supplementary service settings UI cannot be used after the one-time upgrade to MMTel services.

question_47792.question: What does the ARF do when the L-DN DNS Server cannot provide an IP address for the requested FQDN in the L-DN DNS Server case?
question_47792.ground_truth: The ARF forwards the DNS query to a cloud DNS server or resolves the FQDN using its own DNS information. Once the FQDN is resolved to an IP address, the ARF sends the DNS Reply to the UE.

question_47793.question: What effect does the receipt of a COPS DRQ message have on the PDF in a 3G network?
question_47793.ground_truth: Upon receipt of the COPS DRQ message, the PDF may forward an indication to an application function over the Gq reference point indicating that network resources have been removed.

question_47794.question: When are the messages counted in UR.Request?
question_47794.ground_truth: On receipt of request messages (e.g, Diameter command Update-Location-Request) by HSS from other NEs.

question_47797.question: When should the UE set the RQoS bit to "Reflective QoS supported" in the 5GSM capability IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message?
question_47797.ground_truth: The UE should set the RQoS bit to "Reflective QoS supported" in the 5GSM capability IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message if it supports reflective QoS and it requests to establish a new PDU session of "IPv4", "IPv6", "IPv4v6" or "Ethernet" PDU session type, it requests to transfer an existing PDN connection in the EPS of "IPv4", "IPv6", "IPv4v6", or "Ethernet" PDN type or of "Non-IP" PDN type mapping to "Ethernet" PDU session type, to the 5GS, or it requests to transfer an existing PDN connection in an untrusted non-3GPP access connected to the EPC of "IPv4", "IPv6" or "IPv4v6" PDN type to the 5GS.

question_47798.question: In the context of non-contiguous intra-band CA, what does the term "composite emission requirement" refer to?
question_47798.ground_truth: Composite emission requirement is the emission requirement for non-contiguous intraband CA transmission, derived from the single E-UTRA carrier spectrum emission mask (SEM) and spurious emission requirements, and is applicable to multiple sub-blocks.

question_47800.question: When should the IWF performing the controlling role indicate to the media plane that all final responses are received?
question_47800.ground_truth: The IWF should indicate this when all non-controlling MCPTT functions hosting constituent MCPTT groups have responded with a SIP 2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx, or 6xx response to the SIP INVITE request for non-controlling MCPTT function of an MCPTT group, and all expected SIP INFO requests containing a floor request have been received.

question_47801.question: Which propagation condition does not have to be met for a Home BS?
question_47801.ground_truth: The multipath fading Case 2 and Case 3 are not required to be met for a Home BS.

question_47803.question: What should a UE do when it receives an SDP offer in a network-initiated USSD session?
question_47803.ground_truth: A UE should also add a zero port number value to any media description received in the associated SDP offer.

question_47804.question: What should the UE do immediately after the quantity to be reported becomes available for a requested pair of PCell and NR cell in TS 38.331, clause 5.5.5.1?
question_47804.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the measurement reporting procedure, as specified in 5.5.5.

question_47805.question: What is the difference between the first sampling frequency and the second sampling frequency used in the spectral analysis?
question_47805.ground_truth: The difference between the first sampling frequency and the second sampling frequency used in the spectral analysis is 128 samples.

question_47806.question: What should the SMF do if it detects a mismatch between the UE EPS security capabilities and the one received from the UE during an interworking-handover from EPS to 5GS?
question_47806.ground_truth: The SMF shall send an N2 CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message to inform the target ng-eNB about the correct UE EPS security capabilities and the target ng-eNB shall take the new UE EPS security capabilities into account.

question_47808.question: What does the 5GMSu-Aware Application do upon deciding to activate the streaming service transmission?
question_47808.ground_truth: The 5GMSu-Aware Application provides the Service Access Information to the 5GMSu Client to initiate the streaming service transmission.

question_47809.question: What standard defines the data channel establishment for SCTP association?

question_47810.question: What does the MMS Relay/Server do in the MMSNA?
question_47810.ground_truth: The MMS Relay/Server in the MMS Network Architecture (MMSNA) is responsible for storage and handling of incoming and outgoing messages and for the transfer of messages between different service providers.

question_47812.question: What kind of information is provided by the 5G system to the Factory System?
question_47812.ground_truth: The 5G system provides all information concerning the container, including information about the sensors and their reference, to the Factory System.

question_47814.question: What is the required total layer 2 buffer size for NR sidelink communication?
question_47814.ground_truth: The required total layer 2 buffer size for NR sidelink communication is the maximum value of the calculated values based on the formula max(MaxSLtxDataRate * RLC RTT + MaxSLrxDataRate * RLC RTT) for each band combination and the applicable Feature Set combination in the supported NR sidelink band combinations. The RLC RTT for NR sidelink communication corresponds to the smallest SCS numerology supported in the band combination and the applicable Feature Set combination.

question_47816.question: When does an eCall only mobile station that is not capable of eCall over IMS initiate a routing area updating procedure in 3GPP TS 24.008?
question_47816.ground_truth: An eCall only mobile station that is not capable of eCall over IMS shall not perform a normal or combined routing area updating procedure.

question_47817.question: What is the eCall In-band Modem specified in the document?
question_47817.ground_truth: The eCall In-band Modem is a modem pair that operates full-duplex and allows reliable transmission of eCall Minimum Set of Data from IVS to PSAP via the voice channel of the emergency voice call through cellular and PSTN networks.

question_47818.question: What is the implication of the "10 MHz rule" on the unwanted emission limits for an NR specification?
question_47818.ground_truth: The "10 MHz rule" is a voluntary constraint put by 3GPP on the emission limits for LTE and WCDMA. For IMT-2020 and the new bands, the regulation recommends the "250% rule" as defined in ITU-R Recommendation SM.1539-1, which gives a considerably larger offset from the carrier edge or band edge than the 10 MHz used today for LTE and WCDMA.

question_47819.question: What is the test purpose for the procedure collision when a P-TMSI reallocation COMMAND message is received while waiting for a Routing Area Update ACCEPT message?
question_47819.ground_truth: The test purpose is to check the behavior of the MS in such a collision scenario.

question_47820.question: What is the general blocking referred to in subclause 7.4.1?
question_47820.ground_truth: General blocking is the ability of the receiver unit to receive a wanted signal at its assigned channel in the presence of an unwanted interferer inside the operating band.

question_47821.question: What must the target eNodeB node do if it has different stored UE radio capabilities compared to the radio capabilities applicable to the target eNodeB node?
question_47821.ground_truth: The target eNodeB node must trigger retrieval of the E-UTRA radio capability information again from the UE.

question_47823.question: What is one of the impacts of high-density antenna arrays when considering SCS selection within the 7-24 GHz range?
question_47823.ground_truth: The effects of increased range and beam selectivity due to high-density antenna arrays can impact SCS selection within the 7-24 GHz range.

question_47825.question: What is the role of Node B in acquiring the entire channel estimation of the two antennas of the UE in dual stream transmission?
question_47825.ground_truth: The Node B acquires the entire channel estimation of the two antennas of the UE in dual stream transmission by selecting the transmit antenna based on HCSN or ECSN, which requires the UE to time switch transmit the uplink channels by the two antennas.

question_47826.question: What should the terminating MCData client do upon receiving an MSRP SEND request from the terminating participating function?
question_47826.ground_truth: The terminating MCData client should process the received MSRP SEND message as a message arriving from the originating side, after decapsulating the payload in SRTP/UDP/IP packets transmitted on an MBMS bearer towards the terminating MCData client.

question_47827.question: What is the structure of the Single Resource MBMS URL?
question_47827.ground_truth: The Single Resource MBMS URL is composed of a prefix, mid-part, and suffix. The prefix is a URL that is the serviceId of the service on which the resource is available. The suffix contains a URI that is the identifier of the desired resource. The mid-part currently has no defined content.

question_47828.question: What is the priority of an emergency group call in MCPTT systems, compared to other PTT calls?
question_47828.ground_truth: An emergency group call is the most critical of mission critical PTT calls, having the highest priority when allocation of resources is concerned.

question_47830.question: In what situation must the UE set the TIN to "GUTI" and stop the periodic routing area update timer T3312 or T3323, if running?
question_47830.ground_truth: When the network informs the UE about the support of specific features in the EPS network feature support information element and the UE is required to set the TIN to "GUTI" as per the conditions specified in the 3GPP TS 24.008.

question_47831.question: Who is responsible for specifying the mapping of W-5GAN resources and 5GC QoS for the FN-CRG?
question_47831.ground_truth: CableLabs is responsible for specifying the mapping of W-5GAN resources and 5GC QoS for the FN-CRG.

question_47835.question: What is the result of the Activate PDP Context Confirmation during the GERAN to EGAN handover procedure?
question_47835.ground_truth: The data path between the MS and the GGSN is established across the EGANC.

question_47836.question: How is the value of N2 set for the Mobile Station during the negotiation procedure?
question_47836.ground_truth: The value of N2 is negotiated by the Mobile Station to a non-default value during the negotiation procedure.

question_47837.question: How does the SMF report the multicast and broadcast communication charging in Solution #3.3?
question_47837.ground_truth: The multicast and broadcast communication charging is covered by the unicast communication per PDU session per UE, which is the aggregation of the volume usage. When N19-based forwarding is used, the SMF reports the volume per PDU sessions for the 5G VN Group members, which the CHF may aggregate per 5G VG group.

question_47838.question: What does the Length field represent in the floor control messages?
question_47838.ground_truth: The Length field is coded as specified in clause~8.1.2 for each of the floor control messages, indicating the length of the message in 32-bit words, excluding the fixed 32-bit words at the beginning of the message.

question_47839.question: How can Reference UEs in the SL Positioning Server UE role gather information about nearby Reference UEs or ranging "constellations"?
question_47839.ground_truth: Reference UEs in the SL Positioning Server UE role can gather information by performing ranging discovery, exchanging capabilities and location information, or performing ranging with such nearby Reference UEs. This information can then be used to invite other Reference UEs to join a ranging session for sidelink positioning of a Target UE.

question_47840.question: What is a possible function of the Network Exposure Function (NEF) in the 5G Core Network?
question_47840.ground_truth: The Network Exposure Function (NEF) in the 5G Core Network exposes network information and capabilities to an Edge Computing Application Function.

question_47842.question: What information is included in the resource representation returned to the 5GMSd Application Provider after creating an umbrella Provisioning Session?
question_47842.ground_truth: The resource representation includes a Provisioning Session Identifier and a canonical 5GMSd AS host name for the Provisioning Session.

question_47843.question: What is the purpose of the gprsSSF - gsmSCF interface defined in subclause 6.1.2.2?
question_47843.ground_truth: This interface is used by the gsmSCF to control a GPRS session or individual PDP context in a certain gprsSSF. GPRS dialogues between the gprsSSF and the gsmSCF on this interface are opened as a result of the gprsSSF sending a request for instructions to the gsmSCF.

question_47844.question: What is the purpose of the capability transfer procedure in SL-AoA and SL-TDOA positioning methods?
question_47844.ground_truth: The capability transfer procedure in SL-AoA and SL-TDOA positioning methods is used to determine the capabilities of the User Equipment (UE) for positioning, and to ensure that both UEs have compatible capabilities and settings for successful positioning.

question_47845.question: What is the name of the allocation (1RB4x) for which maximum boosting may be supported in the new-inner region?

question_47846.question: What should the NG-RAN node store upon receiving the PDU Session Resource Setup Request List IE in the INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message?
question_47846.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node should behave the same as defined in the PDU Session Resource Setup procedure and report the result for each PDU session resource requested to be set up in the INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP RESPONSE message.

question_47847.question: What is the purpose of the null-MMEGI in the MME?
question_47847.ground_truth: The null-MMEGI in the MME is used to indicate a specific dedicated CN when multiple dedicated CNs are deployed.

question_47848.question: What is the function of the spatial anchor in the described use case?
question_47848.ground_truth: The spatial anchor is a concept that associates space with service information. It is determined by the spatial anchor producer, who decides what to share and its location, constraints, and additional information. The spatial anchor consumer can recognize anchors associated with locations and use them to obtain the associated information.

question_47850.question: How are separate test antennas for the wanted and interfering signals accommodated in the test procedure?
question_47850.ground_truth: If separate test antennas are required for the wanted and interfering signals, they need to be carefully aligned with the transmitter and receiver, covering the same frequency ranges as the system under test.

question_47851.question: What is the purpose of sending the SYNCH-UL sequence to cell 2?
question_47851.ground_truth: The SYNCH-UL sequence is sent in the UpPTS to cell 2 to check if it is received less than 650 ms from the beginning of T2. If it is received within this time, the number of successful tests is increased by one else, the number of failure tests is increased by one.

question_47852.question: How often does the livestock health management application retrieve temperature sensor data from the Ambient IoT devices?

question_47853.question: What should the SS do if the CMR indicates that the MS recommends to use a lower codec mode than the current one in step 4d?
question_47853.ground_truth: The SS should increment the successful C/I decrease event counter.

question_47854.question: What is the maximum duration of test for the test case in the 3GPP protocol that verifies that the MS is able to correctly release a TCH/F even if the SS does not L2 acknowledge the L2 DISC frame?
question_47854.ground_truth: The maximum duration of this test is 25 seconds.

question_47855.question: What is the purpose of the Max-Breadth header field in preventing forking loops within an NGCN site?
question_47855.ground_truth: The Max-Breadth header field limits the number of nodes that can forward the request within the NGCN site, preventing forking loops.

question_47858.question: What is the maximum allowed overall delay in the test?
question_47858.ground_truth: The maximum allowed overall delay in the test is 170 ms.

question_47860.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group in relation to Virtual Reality (VR) streaming audio?
question_47860.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group is responsible for defining Audio media profiles for VR streaming services, including characterization tests for candidate solutions.

question_47861.question: What should the PCF do if it receives a "307 Temporary Redirect" response when sending a policy update notification request?
question_47861.ground_truth: The PCF should resend the failed policy update notification request using the received URI in the Location header field as Notification URI.

question_47862.question: What are the three possible schemes for estimating the covariance matrix to obtain the MMSE-IRC receiver weight matrix?
question_47862.ground_truth: The three possible schemes are the CRS (Cell-specific Reference Signal) based covariance matrix estimation scheme, the DM-RS (Demodulation Reference Signal) based covariance matrix estimation scheme, and the Data signal based covariance matrix estimation scheme.

question_47864.question: What message type should be used for sending the BSSAP+-MS-INFORMATION-REQUEST message?

question_47865.question: What must the VAE-C do upon receiving an HTTP POST request containing a V2X message?
question_47865.ground_truth: The VAE-C must evaluate the content of the <result> element.

question_47866.question: How is the sequence number of a particular short message within the concatenated short message determined?
question_47866.ground_truth: The sequence number of a particular short message within the concatenated short message is indicated by an octet that contains a value in the range 0 to 255, indicating the sequence number of a particular short message within the concatenated short message. The value starts at 1 and increments by one for every short message sent within the concatenated short message.

question_47869.question: In which scenarios, apart from the non-roaming case, is the procedure for UE-initiated resource request and release utilized?
question_47869.ground_truth: This procedure is utilized for the Non-Roaming, Roaming, and Local Breakout cases

question_47871.question: What is the purpose of the user plane data congestion analytics report provided by the MDAS producer?
question_47871.ground_truth: The user plane data congestion analytics report provided by the MDAS producer can support SLS assurance to perform further evaluation.

question_47872.question: When an MCVideo call is established with session announcement including an explicit transmission request, what should the originating transmission participant do to establish a media session with the stored SDP body of the call?
question_47872.ground_truth: The originating transmission participant should establish a media session based on the stored SDP body of the call, start transmission control as the originating transmission participant as specified in clause~a.b in 3GPP~TS~24.581, and enter the "S3: part of ongoing call" state.

question_47873.question: What is the name of the default phase of the Codec Mode Indication in downlink direction when the transmission phase is odd?
question_47873.ground_truth: The default phase of the Codec Mode Indication in downlink direction when the transmission phase is odd is called "odd".

question_47874.question: What is the result of the MBS session stop request in the 5GS when the MCPTT server decides to stop the corresponding MBS session?
question_47874.ground_truth: The 5GS removes the joined MCPTT UEs from the corresponding MBS session in case of multicast sessions, releasing the respective network resources.

question_47875.question: What is the effect of time dilation on the physical layer parameters in time-dilated UMTS?
question_47875.ground_truth: Due to time dilation, all time-related physical layer parameters in time-dilated UMTS are scaled accordingly, i.e., dilated N times relative to UMTS.

question_47876.question: What is the difference between Call Forwarding Unconditional and Call Forwarding on Busy, No Reply, or Not Reachable?
question_47876.ground_truth: Call Forwarding Unconditional is always active and forwards all incoming calls, while Call Forwarding on Busy, No Reply, or Not Reachable are only active under specific conditions (phone is busy, not answered after a certain number of rings, or phone is turned off or out of reach) and forwards calls only under those conditions.

question_47877.question: What is the role of the PIN-1 reference point in the application enablement layer architecture?
question_47877.ground_truth: The PIN-1 reference point allows for interaction between the PIN client and the application client on the PINE to provide and consume services.

question_47879.question: What is one way to improve the federated learning model?
question_47879.ground_truth: Providing feedback on the federated learning model performance in real-world applications

question_47880.question: What should the UE do if it is not registered in its HPLMN or in a PLMN within the EHPLMN list, and it needs to start a back-off timer for a PDU session modification procedure?
question_47880.ground_truth: The UE should use the default value of 12 minutes for the back-off timer.

question_47882.question: What is the purpose of the eNodeB Control Plane Relocation Indication procedure in Control Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation?
question_47882.ground_truth: The eNodeB Control Plane Relocation Indication procedure in Control Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation is used to request the MME to authenticate the UE's re-establishment request and initiate the establishment of the UE's S1 connection and, if necessary, the S11-U connection after the UE has initiated a RRC Re-establishment procedure in a new eNodeB.

question_47885.question: What is the primary purpose of the Container Prefix in the RAN messages?
question_47885.ground_truth: The Container Prefix consists of RIM Application Identity and message-specific information and it is used to supervise the end-to-end transport of the messages.

question_47886.question: What is the purpose of the "Steering Functionality" in the context of Access Traffic Steering, Switching, and Splitting (ATSSS) rules?
question_47886.ground_truth: The "Steering Functionality" in the context of ATSSS rules identifies whether the Multi-Path Transmission Control Protocol (MPTCP) functionality, the Multi-Path Quic functionality, or the Access Traffic Steering, Switching, and Splitting - Link Layer (ATSSS-LL) functionality should be used to steer the traffic of the matching SDF. This is used when the UE supports multiple functionalities for ATSSS.

question_47887.question: What should the gNB-CU-CP consider when selecting UEs for MDT data collection?
question_47887.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-CP should consider if the UE is in the specified area and if the serving PLMN is within the Management Based MDT PLMN List when selecting UEs for MDT data collection.

question_47888.question: What action should the SMLC take if it receives insufficient position measurements and cannot initiate another positioning attempt?
question_47888.ground_truth: The SMLC may return a BSSAP-LE Perform Location response containing a less accurate location estimate, or return a response message containing no location estimate and indicate the cause of failure.

question_47889.question: What is the requirement for the Error Vector Magnitude as per the minimum requirement for E-UTRA and NB-IoT?
question_47889.ground_truth: The Error Vector Magnitude should be within the limit specified by the minimum requirement for E-UTRA and NB-IoT.

question_47890.question: What network entities are responsible for collecting charging information per QoS flow for roamers in Local Breakout scenarios?

question_47891.question: What is the purpose of the "signing-time" attribute in the digitalSignature parameter?
question_47891.ground_truth: The "signing-time" attribute is used to provide replay prevention and confirm the framework's identity to the client. The client can check that the terminationText has been signed by the framework, and if a match is made, the access session is terminated.

question_47892.question: What should a R99 or later MS do when the network performs a GPRS detach procedure with the cause 'location area not allowed' and a new location area is entered?
question_47892.ground_truth: The MS should perform combined GPRS attach and delete the list of forbidden LAs when power is switched off.

question_47894.question: What is the required total handover delay for the test to pass?
question_47894.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests should be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

question_47895.question: How many TBFs can be established in the same TTI on a DBPSCH if a TBF for transfer of upper-layer PDUs in the direction from the network to the mobile station is already established?
question_47895.ground_truth: If a TBF for transfer of upper-layer PDUs in the direction from the network to the mobile station is already established, TBF establishment can also be done on PACCH.

question_47896.question: In the test architecture described in section 5.3, what is the role of the data injection?
question_47896.ground_truth: In the test architecture described in section 5.3, the data injection acts as a counterpart to the system under test, including both RTP/RTCP sender and receiver.

question_47898.question: What is the mandatory attribute of the 'Customer' entity in the SID?
question_47898.ground_truth: 'customerId' is a mandatory attribute of the 'Customer' entity in the SID.

question_47899.question: What is the difference in frequency between the two cells for which the SS-RSRQ measurement accuracy is being compared in this case?
