question_48228.ground_truth: The NAS may initiate the NAS transport procedure as specified in subclause~5.4.5 to send the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message, if still needed.

question_48229.question: What is the function of a relay node as defined in 3GPP~TS~23.401?
question_48229.ground_truth: A network element in the E-UTRAN, wirelessly connected to an eNode B and providing relaying function to UEs served by the E-UTRAN.

question_48230.question: What should the UE do if it has a non-current native EPS security context when initiating the tracking area updating procedure in EMM-IDLE mode?
question_48230.ground_truth: The UE should include the KSIASME in the Non-current native NAS key set identifier IE and its associated GUTI, as specified above, either in the Old GUTI IE or in the Additional GUTI IE of the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message. The UE shall set the TSC flag in the Non-current native NAS key set identifier IE to "native security context".

question_48231.question: What is the maximum time requirement for a cell to remain known if any two closest SMTC occasions are available at the UE for measurement?
question_48231.ground_truth: The maximum time requirement for a cell to remain known is defined in clause 9.2A.4.3.

question_48232.question: What happens when a new MPD is available and the MIME type is application/dash+xml or application/dash+xml profiles='urn:mpeg:dash:profile:cmaf:2019'?
question_48232.ground_truth: The Media Presentation Description fragment is extracted by the MBMS client, stored in the Manifest parameter, and made available at the location specified in the MnifestURI parameter.

question_48233.question: What are the messages used by the DASH clients to indicate their desired bandwidth levels in SAND?
question_48233.ground_truth: The SAND status message SharedResourceAllocation is used by the DASH clients to indicate their desired bandwidth levels in SAND.

question_48234.question: What is the integrity protection algorithm used in cipher suite 1 for GPL?
question_48234.ground_truth: The integrity protection algorithm used in cipher suite 1 for GPL is HMAC-SHA256-32.

question_48235.question: Who has the responsibility to authorize AF requests for application guidance on URSP Rule determination in the VPLMN?
question_48235.ground_truth: The NEF (Network Exposure Function) in the VPLMN is responsible for authorizing AF requests for application guidance on URSP Rule determination.

question_48236.question: What is the format of the U2U discovery message that is protected by the security mechanism specified in KI#1?
question_48236.ground_truth: The format of the U2U discovery message that is protected by the security mechanism specified in KI#1 is the same as the normal U2U discovery message.

question_48237.question: What is the IMS CS Control Channel (ICCC) used for in this solution?
question_48237.ground_truth: The IMS CS Control Channel (ICCC) is used to transport signalling between the ICS UE or L-CAAF-n and the IMS when accessing IMS services via the CS domain. It is used for IMS registration, session establishment and/or service control of IMS sessions using CS voice bearers.

question_48239.question: What should the conference focus do to terminate a conference?
question_48239.ground_truth: The conference focus should remove all present conference participants and deallocate the conference URI.

question_48240.question: What does the key management client establish when the HTTP proxy is not used between the KMS and the KMS client?
question_48240.ground_truth: The key management client establishes a direct HTTPS connection to the KMS when the HTTP proxy is not used between the KMS and the KMS client.

question_48242.question: What type of measurement procedures are explained in the document for the handheld UE?
question_48242.ground_truth: The measurement procedures explained in the document for the handheld UE include those for roaming bands in the speech mode position (beside the head and beside the head and hand) and browsing mode position.

question_48243.question: What does accessing SNPN services via a PLMN mean?
question_48243.ground_truth: Accessing SNPN services via a PLMN occurs when the UE is connecting to the 5GCN of the SNPN using the 3GPP access of the PLMN.

question_48245.question: What should the MBMS client do if the getVersion() API call is not supported by the MAA?
question_48245.ground_truth: The MBMS client should not use the API, and the MAA should deregister if the version number is not supported by the MAA.

question_48246.question: In what situation will the floor control interface send a Floor Idle message to the MCPTT client?
question_48246.ground_truth: When no other MCPTT client has the permission to send media in an established session.

question_48249.question: What interface modifications are required for Solution 4 implementation?
question_48249.ground_truth: Solution 4 brings minimal impact on interfaces, as it relies on signaling already specified for RIBS with an additional IE for geolocation information.

question_48250.question: What should a UE do if it is registered for emergency services and receives a SECURITY MODE COMMAND message with ngKSI value "000" and 5G-IA0 and 5G-EA0 as selected 5G NAS security algorithms?
question_48250.ground_truth: The UE shall locally derive and take in use 5G NAS security context and delete existing current 5G NAS security context.

question_48252.question: What does "may" indicate in the context of the present document?
question_48252.ground_truth: "May" indicates permission to do something in the context of the present document.

question_48253.question: What is the duration of a measurement reporting delay as defined in clause 9.9.5.2.3?
question_48253.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay is the time between the moment when the periodic measurement report is triggered and the moment when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface.

question_48254.question: Which scenarios are chosen for drawing observations and bottleneck identification for FR1 and FR2?
question_48254.ground_truth: The scenarios chosen for FR1 are Urban 4GHz TDD, Urban 2.6GHz TDD, Rural 4GHz TDD NLOS O2I, Rural 700MHz FDD NLOS O2I, Rural 2GHz FDD NLOS O2I, Rural 2.6GHz TDD NLOS O2I, and Rural 4GHz with long distance TDD LOS O2O. For FR2, the chosen scenarios are Urban 28GHz TDD NLOS O2I and Indoor 28GHz TDD NLOS.

question_48257.question: What is the purpose of timer T101 in the handover device's procedures?
question_48257.ground_truth: Timer T101 supervises the queuing time for a free channel, and if it expires, a no channel indication is generated.

question_48258.question: What are the pre-conditions for logging service API invocations at AEF?
question_48258.ground_truth: The pre-conditions for logging service API invocations at AEF include the invocation of service API(s) from one or more API invokers and the availability of the AEF's authorization details with the CAPIF core function.

question_48259.question: What is the signaling range requirement for the transport channel BLER in the 9.1.1.7.2 range/mapping?
question_48259.ground_truth: The signaling range for the transport channel BLER may be larger than the guaranteed accuracy range.

question_48261.question: What is the method used to send a negative acknowledgement in the downlink channel?
question_48261.ground_truth: The MS sends an EGPRS PACKET DOWNLINK ACK/NACK or EGPRS PACKET DOWNLINK ACK/NACK TYPE 2 message to indicate a negative acknowledgement in the downlink channel.

question_48262.question: Which transmission points are used in section 8.3.2.4.2 with multiple NZP CSI-RS resources and same Cell ID?
question_48262.ground_truth: Transmission point 1 (TP 1) and Transmission point 2 (TP 2) are used in section 8.3.2.4.2 with multiple NZP CSI-RS resources and same Cell ID.

question_48263.question: What is the duplex distance between the blocks in Austria's block arrangement 1?
question_48263.ground_truth: Two blocks are grouped with a duplex distance of 100 MHz in block arrangement 1.

question_48264.question: How can the network determine if an unprotected Attach message is intended to replace a TAU message?
question_48264.ground_truth: By checking if the TAU message was sent before the Attach message and if the Active flag was set in the TAU message.

question_48265.question: What is the confidentiality method used to protect signalling information elements on physical connections?
question_48265.ground_truth: A bit per bit or stream cipher is used, where the data flow on the radio path is obtained by the bit per bit binary addition of the user data flow and a ciphering bit stream generated by algorithm A5 using a key determined as specified in subclause 4.3.

question_48266.question: What is the order in which LPP procedures generally occur?
question_48266.ground_truth: Despite the flexibility allowed by LPP, it is expected that procedures will normally occur in the following order: 1. Capability Transfer, 2. Assistance Data Transfer, and 3. Location Information Transfer (measurements and/or location estimate) for LPP procedures.

question_48267.question: What does rangeToBestCell specify in cell selection and re-selection?
question_48267.ground_truth: rangeToBestCell specifies the R value range which the cells whose R value is within the range can be a candidate for the highest ranked cell in intra-frequency and equal priority inter-frequency cell re-selection, and among the cells on the highest priority frequency(ies) for inter-frequency cell re-selection within NR.

question_48268.question: What is the minimum mean power for the CW and E-UTRA (or 1.28Mcps UTRA TDD) interfering signals in the generic MSR intermodulation requirement?
question_48268.ground_truth: The minimum mean power for the CW and E-UTRA (or 1.28Mcps UTRA TDD) interfering signals is -48dBm.

question_48269.question: Who initiates the AM Policy Modification procedure to adjust the RFSP index?
question_48269.ground_truth: The PCF initiates the AM Policy Modification procedure to adjust the RFSP index based on various inputs, such as network congestion in 5G or a request from the AF.

question_48272.question: What is the significance of the "CSMT" flag in the location update request message in the CS Fallback flows for terminating calls?
question_48272.ground_truth: The "CSMT" flag in the location update request message indicates that the signaling link should be maintained for a longer duration in case the IAM (Initial Attach Message) is delayed by the old MSC/VLR.

question_48273.question: How can a NF Service Consumer discover the features supported by a NF Service Producer?
question_48273.ground_truth: A NF Service Consumer can discover the features supported by a NF Service Producer using the NRF, if the latter has registered the features it supports to the NRF.

question_48274.question: What information is included in the MbsPccRule data structure?
question_48274.ground_truth: The MbsPccRule data structure is composed of an MBS PCC rule identifier, the MBS service data flow template, precedence information, and the MBS authorized QoS to be applied for the MBS service data flow.

question_48276.question: When determining the Maximum APN restriction based on the received APN Restriction of each PDP context in the new SGSN, what should be taken into account?
question_48276.ground_truth: The new SGSN should determine the Maximum APN restriction based on the received APN Restriction of each PDP context/EPS Bearer Context for using S4 from the GGSN/P-GW or old S4-SGSN for using S4, and then store the new Maximum APN restriction value.

question_48277.question: In step 4 of the solution, what do the UE-to-Network relay's AMF, AUSF, UDM, and PKMF do together for the Remote UE?
question_48277.ground_truth: They authenticate the Remote UE, verify if the Remote UE and the selected Relay UE are authorized to set up a relay connection for the given Relay Service Code and generate the respective key material for the remote UE and selected UE-to-Network relay.

question_48279.question: What is the requirement for the delay uncertainty in the measurement reporting delay excluding the delay caused by no UL resources for UE to send the measurement report?
question_48279.ground_truth: The delay uncertainty is 2 x TTIDCCH where TTIDCCH is the duration of subframe or slot or subslot when the measurement report is transmitted on the PUSCH with subframe or slot or subslot duration.

question_48284.question: What is the maximum number of occurrences of the "query-filter" element in the "RestrictedDiscovereeRsp-info" complex type?
question_48284.ground_truth: The "query-filter" element can occur an unbounded number of times in the "RestrictedDiscovereeRsp-info" complex type.

question_48285.question: How is the multicast group key message (MGKM1) structured in the communication optimized approach 1?
question_48285.ground_truth: The MGKM1 consists of encrypted values of the group key, one for each set of UEs, using the corresponding transport key. It also includes a hash of the group key for confirmation of the update.

question_48286.question: What is the main advantage of the codec-aware option for media path optimization in the base algorithm?
question_48286.ground_truth: The codec-aware option allows for either the deletion of a potential transcoding point on the media path or the relocation of a potential transcoding point from an earlier TrGW on the media path to a later TrGW on the media path, which may lead to a shorter end-to-end media path.

question_48287.question: What is the role of the MMS Relay/Server in the MMS network?
question_48287.ground_truth: The MMS Relay/Server is responsible for handling the MMS messages, generating charging data, and managing the communication between different elements of the MMS network.

question_48288.question: How many tail bits are added in the convolutional coding procedure for EGPRS?
question_48288.ground_truth: Six tail bits (TB) are added in the convolutional coding procedure for EGPRS.

question_48290.question: What is the end state shown for disconnection of a single remote party in the MPTY call?
question_48290.ground_truth: The end state shown for disconnection of a single remote party in the MPTY call is A-B ACTIVE / MPTY HELD, indicating that the disconnection will not necessarily cause the MPTY call to be released.

question_48291.question: What is the scope of Clause 6.2.1.2.1.3.2 in terms of release?
question_48291.ground_truth: The scope of Clause 6.2.1.2.1.3.2 is Release 18.

question_48292.question: What conditions determine the success or failure of the SCell deactivation on intra-band CA UEs?
question_48292.ground_truth: For intra-band CA UEs, if the last CSI report is received by the SS earlier than or equal to subframe (n+8) and there is no DTX in PCell during the subframes (n+5) to (n+13), the number of successes for the event "Deactivation" is increased by one, otherwise a fail for the event "Deactivation" is counted.

question_48293.question: What type of message does the UE respond with when it receives a SIP MESSAGE message for a standalone one-to-one file distribution message with a mandatory download and a specific disposition?
question_48293.ground_truth: The UE responds with a SIP 200 (OK) message.

question_48294.question: What happens before the security establishment between two 5G ProSe layer-2 end UEs via a 5G ProSe layer-2 UE-to-UE relay UE?
question_48294.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe direct link establishment occurs between the source 5G ProSe end UE and the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE and between the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE and the target 5G ProSe end UE.

question_48295.question: What is the process for releasing SCG resources when the SDAP entity is hosted by the MN in MR-DC with 5GC?
question_48295.ground_truth: The MN provides DRB QoS flow level QoS parameters and QoS flow to DRB mapping information for SCG resources to the SN, which the SN may reject.

question_48297.question: What is the purpose of the test in section 9.1.72?
question_48297.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in section 9.1.72 is to verify that RSRP absolute and relative measurement accuracy in carrier aggregation are within the specified limits under AWGN propagation conditions.

question_48298.question: What should the UE do if the RPLMN is not included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarRLF-Report upon receiving the UEInformationRequest message, with rlf-ReportReq set to true?
question_48298.ground_truth: The UE should submit the UEInformationResponse message to lower layers for transmission via SRB1 without the rlf-Report.

question_48299.question: What is the difference in procedure between inter-PLMN V-SMF insertion and inter-PLMN V-SMF change?
question_48299.ground_truth: Inter-PLMN V-SMF insertion occurs when the UE moves out of H-SMF service area to a new PLMN V-SMF service area during a service request. Inter-PLMN V-SMF change occurs when the UE moves to a new PLMN V-SMF service area in a serving PLMN for a service request procedure. The CHF interaction is similar for N2 and Xn based handover procedures in both cases.

question_48300.question: During SCells activation, in which subframes can interruption of PCell not happen outside?
question_48300.ground_truth: For FDD PCell, interruption of PCell during SCells activation shall not happen outside subframes (m+5) to (m+9), (m+15) to (m+19), (m+25) to (m+29), (m+35) to (m+39), (m+45) to (m+49) and (m+55) to (m+59). For TDD PCell, interruption of PCell during SCells activation shall not happen outside subframes (m+5) to (m+11) and (m+20) to (m+26).

question_48301.question: What is the process for transferring UE context from the old AMF-UE to the new AMF-UE during UE mobility with the MBSR?
question_48301.ground_truth: The process involves multiple steps, starting with the MBSR sending a Registration Request towards the 5GC via the NG-RAN or performing a handover procedure. The NG-RAN sends the Link IDs to the new AMF serving the UE, and the new AMF sends the Link IDs to the old AMF serving the UE for requesting bulk UE context transfer. The old AMF stores the UE context with the Link ID, enabling bulk UE context transfer.

question_48302.question: What should the MCPTT client do upon receiving a SIP 2xx response to a request for an MCPTT emergency private call, if the MCPTT emergency private call state is set to "MEPC 2: emergency-pc-requested" or "MEPC 3: emergency-pc-granted"?
question_48302.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should set the MCPTT emergency private priority state of the call to "MEPP 2: in-progress" if it was not already set, set the MCPTT emergency private call state to "MEPC 3: emergency-pc-granted", and include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body in the SIP re-INVITE request with the <emergency-ind> element set to "false".

question_48304.question: What is the advantage of technical UC identification in the terminating network?
question_48304.ground_truth: The terminating network can perform technical UC identification using an IMR-based PUCI AS for the purpose of identifying forged sender identities, but this requires reliable authentication of the originating network.

question_48307.question: What is the purpose of a Conformance Test Suite in the context of MSE functions?
question_48307.ground_truth: A Conformance Test Suite is a collection of tests covering the breadth of the MSE functions, including the definition of test cases, test assets, and success criteria to pass the tests. The considerations documented are expected to allow third parties to implement a full Conformance Test Suite in order to test the 3GPP-defined APIs and conformance for correct implementation.

question_48309.question: What is the role of the reference calibration antenna in the 3D MPAC test method?
question_48309.ground_truth: The reference calibration antenna is used to ensure that the downlink signal power is correct and to calibrate the path loss for each probe in the 3D MPAC system.

question_48311.question: What type of access thresholds can be used in the IARP for APN rules to enable routing policies?

question_48312.question: What are the two principles for realizing QoS control based on spending limits using existing PCC and online charging functionality in 4.3.2.1?
question_48312.ground_truth: The two principles are using a service specific Charging Key for the service before reaching its spending limits, and using a second Charging Key for the service after reaching its spending limits.

question_48313.question: What is the purpose of the PIN-11 reference point?
question_48313.ground_truth: The PIN-11 reference point is an interface between an AS and the PIN Management Client, which is used to enable PINAPP functionality and interactions. It may be an extension of the PIN-9 and PIN-6 interfaces.

question_48314.question: What is the objective of the method of test procedure described in clause X.4.2?
question_48314.ground_truth: The objective of the method of test procedure described in clause X.4.2 is to provide further details of the test definition and define the steps necessary to perform the test.

question_48316.question: What is the procedure for 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay reselection by the 5G ProSe Remote UE?
question_48316.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe Remote UE performs measurement of the signal strength of the PC5 unicast link with the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay for relay reselection. The 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay discovery procedures are used to discover available 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relays for reselection.

question_48317.question: What is the rule for selecting the PCC band in the Intra-band non-contiguous + Intra-band contiguous test case?
question_48317.ground_truth: The PCC band is allocated to the highest carrier in the Intra-band non-contiguous + Intra-band contiguous test case, unless the DL band is below the UL band and has a wider operating bandwidth than the UL.

question_48318.question: What performance objectives should be met for Cellular IoT systems in the 3GPP study?
question_48318.ground_truth: The performance objectives for Cellular IoT systems in the 3GPP study include improved indoor coverage with an extended coverage of 20 dB compared to commercially available legacy GPRS devices, support of a massive number of low throughput devices, reduced complexity, improved power efficiency, and compatibility with legacy GPRS/WCDMA/LTE systems.

question_48319.question: How does the 16APK(8,8) R=1.5 modulation compare to the 16QAM modulation in terms of PAPR and dynamic range?
question_48319.ground_truth: The 16APK(8,8) R=1.5 modulation has far more relaxed PAPR and dynamic range compared to the 16QAM modulation.

question_48320.question: What should a UE do upon detection of an early-out-of-sync event in a serving cell?
question_48320.ground_truth: The UE should consider an "early-out-of-sync" event to be detected and initiate transmission of the UEAssistanceInformation message in accordance with 5.6.10.

question_48326.question: How is the total reduction to UE maximum output power calculated in the presence of additional maximum power reduction (A-MPR)?
question_48326.ground_truth: The total reduction to UE maximum output power is max(MPR, A-MPR) where MPR is defined in clause 6.2.2 and A-MPR is defined in clause 6.2.3.

question_48327.question: What list does the UE select the highest priority PLMN from if it is included in both the list of available PLMNs and the Operator Controlled PLMN Selector list?
question_48327.ground_truth: The UE selects the highest priority PLMN from the Operator Controlled PLMN Selector list if it is also included in the list of available PLMNs.

question_48329.question: What should the MS return on the new main signalling link after receiving an ASSIGNMENT COMPLETE message on the new main signalling link?
question_48329.ground_truth: The SS sends the PACKET ASSIGNMENT message to the MS over the main signalling link to establish the packet resources and the MS enters DTM.

question_48331.question: What is the procedure for withdrawal of the CLIP Supplementary Service?
question_48331.ground_truth: The CLIP Supplementary Service can be withdrawn at the customer's request or for administrative reasons. The withdrawal results in the deactivation of the CLIP Supplementary Service.

question_48333.question: What is the difference between the actual coverage area of an isolated island cell and the planned isolated island cell area?
question_48333.ground_truth: The actual coverage area of an isolated island cell is smaller than the planned isolated island cell area, and this difference represents coverage holes that need to be optimized.

question_48334.question: What is the first independent threshold in the sub-sub-block index?
question_48334.ground_truth: It is a threshold that does not depend on the sub-sub-block index.

question_48336.question: What action does the P-GW take if the Diameter Accounting Request (START) information is required before processing user packets?
question_48336.ground_truth: The P-GW may drop user data until an Accounting-Answer (START) is received from the Diameter server.

question_48338.question: Which procedure is used by the PCRF to initiate the provision of unsolicited PCC rules in 3GPP EPS?

question_48339.question: When does a UE apply the MCCH information acquisition procedure upon becoming interested to receive MBS broadcast services?
question_48339.ground_truth: A UE should apply the MCCH information acquisition procedure upon becoming interested to receive MBS broadcast services upon entering the cell providing SIB20, upon receiving SIB20 of an SCell via dedicated signalling, and upon receiving a notification that the MCCH information has changed due to the start of new MBS service(s).

question_48340.question: What were the second most common causes of telecommunications service failures in Europe and the UK between 2019-2020?
question_48340.ground_truth: Power cuts were the second most common causes of telecommunications service failures in Europe and the UK between 2019-2020.

question_48341.question: What is the purpose of the DomainComponentRDN in the DN EBNF?
question_48341.ground_truth: The DomainComponentRDN represents a naming attribute with the "DC" value in a distinguished name, which is used to align the name space with DNS.

question_48342.question: What should be done if the test system for a test has a measurement uncertainty greater than that specified in clause 4.1?
question_48342.ground_truth: If the test system for a test has a measurement uncertainty greater than that specified in clause 4.1, it is still permitted to use the apparatus. However, an adjustment must be made to tighten the test requirement, making the test harder to pass.

question_48343.question: What should the transmission participant do upon receiving an MCVideo call release step 1 request from the application and signalling plane when the MCVideo call is going to be released or when the transmission participant is leaving the MCVideo call?
question_48343.ground_truth: The transmission participant shall stop receiving reception control messages, request the MCVideo client to stop receiving RTP media packets, and enter the 'Call releasing' state.

question_48344.question: What is the purpose of using a RLOS-specific MME in E-UTRAN?
question_48344.ground_truth: The purpose of using a RLOS-specific MME in E-UTRAN is to limit the impact to "normal" UEs when massive signalling for RLOS is originated from unauthenticated UEs or authenticated UEs in limited service state.

question_48345.question: What should the new BSS do if after sending a HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message, it receives a PS-HANDOVER-REQUEST-NACK PDU indicating a failure of the ongoing PS Handover Request procedure due to timer T24 expiry?
question_48345.ground_truth: The new BSS should send a PS-HANDOVER-REQUEST-NACK PDU to the SGSN with cause "DTM Handover - Timer expiry".

question_48346.question: What coding scheme is used in the DISPLAY TEXT command for transmission of 8-bit data?
question_48346.ground_truth: The unpacked coding scheme is used for transmission of 8-bit data in the DISPLAY TEXT command.

question_48347.question: What is the role of the UE in selecting a subset of RACH resources for preamble transmission in NR?
question_48347.ground_truth: The UE selects a subset of RACH preamble indices based on the association between a subset of RACH resources and a DL measurement.

question_48348.question: Which entity is responsible for supporting the modification of periodic RAU/TAU and mobile reachable timer values, and providing the MTC device with the new timer value during the next RAU/TAU procedure or by initiating detach with "re-attach indication"?

question_48349.question: In Solution #12, what method is used to transfer a paging message when the UE cannot listen to the Uu paging?
question_48349.ground_truth: In Solution #12, when the UE cannot listen to the Uu paging, the SMF or MME in PLMN A initiates direct paging in PLMN A, and after some delay, it provides MSISDN of the other USIM and SMS payload containing Push Notification to SMS-SC via NEF.

question_48350.question: What is the reference cell power for downlink physical channels and signals, unless specified otherwise in a signalling test case?
question_48350.ground_truth: The reference cell power is the EPRE of the secondary synchronization signal (SSS) and is referred to as "SS/PBCH SSS EPRE".

question_48351.question: What is required for the 5G system to support 5G LAN-type service to UEs using ProSe communication?
question_48351.ground_truth: The 5G system should be able to provide this support.

question_48352.question: What does the SCC AS perform before it requests the Controller UE-1 to authorize the pull request or it authorizes the request on behalf of UE-1 when transferring Collaborative Session Control to UE-2?
question_48352.ground_truth: The SCC AS performs authorization as specified in clause~6a.12, ensures that UE-2 can act as the Controller UE for this Collaborative Session, and that the Public User Identity used by UE-1 shares the service profile with the Public User Identity used by UE-2 for the Collaborative Session.

question_48354.question: What is the function of the BCCH space requirements in the 6.2.5.3 section?
question_48354.ground_truth: The BCCH space requirements in the 6.2.5.3 section are used to reduce the system information space requirements compared to that of legacy GSM networks and include the elimination or reduction of specific functionalities like CS related functionalities, Network measurements reporting, Inter-RAT mobility, etc.

question_48355.question: What should the mobile station do when it is in the acknowledged mode of RLC data transmission and receives a PACKET UPLINK ACK/NACK message with the Final Ack Indicator bit set to '1' while there are no ongoing downlink TBFs?
question_48355.ground_truth: The mobile station shall transmit the PACKET CONTROL ACKNOWLEDGEMENT message and release the TBF, then entering packet idle mode.

question_48356.question: What is the time alignment error requirement for UL OLTD operation with two active transmit antenna connectors?
question_48356.ground_truth: The time alignment error shall not exceed 0.4Tc for UE with two active transmit antenna connectors in UL OLTD operation.

question_48357.question: What action should an IBCF take if there is no response to a SIP request and its retransmissions, and the IBCF supports S-CSCF restoration procedures?
question_48357.ground_truth: The IBCF should reject the request by returning a 504 (Server Time-out) response, and include in the response a Content-Type header field, a P-Asserted-Identity header field, and a 3GPP IM CN subsystem XML body containing information about the alternative service.

question_48359.question: What type of request shall be supported at the roaming II-NNI with the "g.3gpp.mcdata" media feature tag in the Contact header field and an "application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml" MIME body in the REGISTER request?
question_48359.ground_truth: A REGISTER request including the specified Contact header field, the specified Content-Type header field, the specified application/mikey MIME body, the specified MIME bodies, the specified Resource-Share header field, and the specified g.3gpp.priority-share feature-capability indicator shall be supported at the roaming II-NNI for MCData.

question_48360.question: What should the UE do if the timer value of T3585 indicates zero and it received the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message?
question_48360.ground_truth: The UE can send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message or PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message for the same S-NSSAI or without an S-NSSAI.

question_48361.question: What is the effect of NAS level mobility management congestion control on the value of T3246 or T3346 in reject messages?
question_48361.ground_truth: When NAS level mobility management congestion control is active, the network may include a value for the mobility management back-off timer T3246 or T3346 in the reject messages. The MS starts the mobility management back-off timer with the value received in the mobility management reject messages.

question_48366.question: What happens when the requested IP version is not supported in the PDN connection in the UE initiates an allocation of IPv4 address or an IPv6 prefix?

question_48367.question: What happens to MBS traffic when a UE leaves the MBS session?
question_48367.ground_truth: The MBS traffic cannot be decrypted, and integrity protection check will fail as the rekeying token is never delivered to the UE which left the MBS session.

question_48370.question: What does the "n" represent in the unsolicited result code +C5GREGN3GPP:<n> when <n>=1, 2, or 3?
question_48370.ground_truth: The "n" in the unsolicited result code +C5GREGN3GPP:<n> represents an integer type value that enables different unsolicited result codes for network registration status in 5GS over non-3GPP access.

question_48372.question: When are the cached context and associated Token deleted in LTE systems?
question_48372.ground_truth: The cached context and associated Token are deleted in the UE when it detaches from the network, upon expiration of the associated lifetime, when the PDCP Counter approaches the locally preset maximum limit, after AKA authentication with a new KASME, when the UE returns with no Token indication, or if the eNB receives a security context from the MME for a UE without a valid cached context associated with the valid Token.

question_48373.question: What is the one-shot Control plane-based Network triggered ranging device discovery procedure in 6.18.2.2?
question_48373.ground_truth: The one-shot Control plane-based Network triggered ranging device discovery procedure in 6.18.2.2 is initiated by UE#1 sending a Ranging device discovery request to the AMF. The AMF checks for authorization, selects an LMF, and sends the Ranging device discovery request to the LMF. The LMF determines the roles of UE#1 and UE#2 and sends a Ranging device activation request to UE#2. UE#2 activates its ranging device discovery, and once complete, the LMF sends a ranging device discovery response to the AMF, who forwards it to UE#1.

question_48374.question: What should a UE operating in CS/PS mode 1 of operation with "IMS voice available" do when the tracking area updating attempt counter is equal to 5 and T3402 as indicated by the network is zero?
question_48374.ground_truth: The UE should perform the actions defined for the expiry of the timer T3402.

question_48375.question: How does a UE acquire new SC-MCCH information in the case of a change in ongoing MBMS service(s) transmitted using SC-PTM?
question_48375.ground_truth: The UE acquires the new SC-MCCH information scheduled by the PDCCH at the start of the next modification period.

question_48377.question: In M=19, what is the MS and SS relationship after the handover command?
question_48377.ground_truth: After the handover command, they are using a full-rate TCH with speech full rate version 3 and non-hopping mode on cell B.

question_48378.question: Which HTTP status code is returned and what is the content of the response message when the QuotaUpdate service operation is successful?
question_48378.ground_truth: "200 OK" and the content of the POST response shall contain the updated maximum number of registered inbound roaming UEs and/or the maximum number of LBO PDU sessions.

question_48379.question: What is the maximum number of URLLC users per cell assumed in the evaluation for the transport industry, which resulted in a UE satisfaction percentage higher than 95% for both downlink and uplink transmission?
question_48379.ground_truth: The maximum number of URLLC users per cell assumed in the evaluation for the transport industry is 6 or 10, which resulted in a UE satisfaction percentage higher than 95% for downlink transmission.

question_48380.question: What is the purpose of secondary authentication in the context of UE onboarding architecture?
question_48380.ground_truth: Secondary authentication is used in the context of the UE onboarding architecture to authenticate UEs using different S-NSSAI/DNNs for the onboarding PDU Sessions even though the DN-AAA servers that authenticate the UEs can reside in different administrative domains.

question_48381.question: What type of AVP is the Transcoder-Inserted-Indication AVP, and what values does it have?
question_48381.ground_truth: The Transcoder-Inserted-Indication AVP is of type Enumerated and indicates if a transcoder is inserted or not for the SDP media component. The values are "Transcoder Not Inserted" and "Transcoder Inserted".

question_48382.question: What should the HA do if S2c data integrity protection is used and the IPsec anti-replay feature is implemented for each QoS flow?
question_48382.ground_truth: The HA shall set per QoS flow DSCP marking on IP outer header as specified in the subclause~7.3.

question_48384.question: What information can the emergency team obtain about UEs using the real-time UE information service?
question_48384.ground_truth: The emergency team is allowed to obtain the number of UEs present in a requested area and their anonymous location.

question_48386.question: What should an IMS-ALG do if an IP realm is found on the incoming signalling path?
question_48386.ground_truth: If the IP realm is on the incoming signalling path, the IMS-ALG should forward an SDP answer with the connection information of the IP realm and bypass the controlled TrGW, then remove the IP realm and corresponding Path Parameters from the forwarded SDP answer.

question_48388.question: What should the UE do if it receives an Authentication-Info in the response to a REGISTER request and the response contains a "pub-gruu" parameter or a "temp-gruu" parameter or both?
question_48388.ground_truth: If the UE supports GRUU, it should store the value of those parameters as the GRUUs for the UE in association with the public user identity that was registered.

question_48389.question: What is the role of the BSF in this process?
question_48389.ground_truth: The BSF generates a multi-modal profile for each multi-modal data flows group, maintains the multi-modal profile, and notifies the changes of profile to PCF. It also removes the binding information for a PDU Session or for a UE, if all the related AF sessions of the Multi-modal service released.

question_48390.question: Which company states that the residual co-site inter-sector interference can be controlled, causing up to 1 dB desensitization of the receiver for co-site inter-sector co-channel inter-subband interference in a three sector deployment?
question_48390.ground_truth: Out of the three companies that provided technical inputs for co-site inter-sector co-channel inter-subband interference, one states that the residual co-site inter-sector interference can be controlled, causing up to 1 dB desensitization of the receiver in a three sector deployment.

question_48393.question: What is the procedure if the mobile station supports both Transparent and Non Transparent modes and the mobile station responds with a CALL CONFIRMED message in the context of UDI in X.32 case in Packet Service?
question_48393.ground_truth: The procedure involves sending a BC GSM message starting with 04 08 X1 XX 96 20 13 63 A0 C6.

question_48396.question: What is the role of the UDM/ProSe App Server in U2U relay discovery authorization in a 5G network?
question_48396.ground_truth: The UDM/ProSe App Server checks whether the UE is allowed to play the roles it claims in U2U relay discovery, and returns the allowed roles through the Authorization Check Request.

question_48397.question: What is the main advantage of using a buffer filled with a priority scheduling algorithm in comparison to a standard buffer in poor reception conditions?
question_48397.ground_truth: With a priority scheduling algorithm, the high quality data runs out earlier than lower qualities, allowing for keeping the playout alive during longer outages than in the standard case.

question_48399.question: What is measured in Test 3 of the procedure and in which section of the specification are the allowed values for it defined?
question_48399.ground_truth: The power and timing of the first preamble and the relative power and timing applied to additional preambles are measured in Test 3. The allowed values for this measurement are defined in 7.3.2.2.4.5 and 7.3.2.2.4.5-3.

question_48400.question: What is the procedure that determines the positioning method to be used for locating an UE, based on the requested QoS and the UE and network capabilities?

question_48401.question: What version and protocol is used by the SWd interface of the 3GPP AAA Proxy?
question_48401.ground_truth: The SWd interface of the 3GPP AAA Proxy is based on Diameter, as defined in IETF RFC 6733, and contains the following additions and extensions: IETF RFC 4005, IETF RFC 4072, IETF RFC 5779, and IETF RFC 5447. The SWd interface uses the same application ID as the interface that it is connected to.

question_48402.question: What is the relationship between the values in the UL and DL columns?
question_48402.ground_truth: The values in the UL and DL columns are related, as they determine the uplink and downlink bit rates, but the DL values are generally much higher since the network is capable of handling more data in the downlink direction than the uplink direction.

question_48403.question: What is the purpose of the padding field in the frame format?
question_48403.ground_truth: To ensure that the PDU Session user plane protocol PDU length is (n*4-2) octets, where n is a positive integer

question_48404.question: When can the UE reselect a new EAS for the FQDN with an EAS Discovery procedure?
question_48404.ground_truth: The UE can reselect a new EAS for the FQDN with an EAS Discovery procedure during the establishment of a new PDU Session or when following the recommended UE behavior for SSC modes 2, 3, or multi-homed PDU Sessions.

question_48405.question: What kind of information does the NWDAF provide and which network function shall utilize the NWDAF service?
question_48405.ground_truth: The NWDAF provides analysis information to assist the NF consumer in selecting an optimal NF instance. This service is intended for use by network function consumers.

question_48406.question: What is the 16-bit message authentication token used for in the 5G control plane?
question_48406.ground_truth: It is used for message authentication between the UE and the source gNB/ng-eNB, and to validate UE requests and retrieve UE context in the 5G control plane.

question_48408.question: How are ObjectContexts defined for end-to-end Network Resource Optimization Expectation?
question_48408.ground_truth: ObjectContexts for end-to-end Network Resource Optimization Expectation are defined by combining the ObjectContexts for the RAN (Radio Access Network) and 5GC Network Expectations, as outlined in their respective clauses (6.2.2.1.2 and 6.2.2.1.4.2).

question_48409.question: What command is used to request a challenge token to enable access to a specific command set in the MT?

question_48410.question: What is the procedure used in order to signal to the Node B the adjustment to be performed by the UE in the uplink timing?
question_48410.ground_truth: The Timing Advance procedure is used in order to signal to the Node B the adjustment to be performed by the UE in the uplink timing. This procedure is used by the Node B to adjust its layer 1 to allow for accurate impulse averaging.

question_48412.question: What is the requirement for the physical cellidentifier assignment in the establishment of a new eNodeB in the network?
question_48412.ground_truth: The physical cell identifier should be assigned fully automatically without manual intervention and it should be collision free.

question_48413.question: What is the minimum power threshold for UE in 5.9AA.2?
question_48413.ground_truth: The minimum power threshold for UE is -50 dBm/3.84 MHz.

question_48414.question: What is the role of the CSP in the 3GPP network regarding access to the LEMF?
question_48414.ground_truth: The CSP (Communications Service Provider) is responsible for providing access to the LEMF (Lawful Interception Management Facility) for the LEA (Law Enforcement Agency).

question_48415.question: What is the role of the IP Edge/PCEF in the described procedures?
question_48415.ground_truth: The IP Edge/PCEF is responsible for QoS enforcement, mapping between PCC rules and network-specific parameters, and communicating with other network entities.

question_48416.question: What is the parameter M in the limit checking?
question_48416.ground_truth: The parameter M is a bad DUT factor and is equal to 1.5 in the limit checking.

question_48417.question: What is the role of the IMS in controlling overload, and what are the overload control requirements?
question_48417.ground_truth: The IMS should have mechanisms available to control overload and achieve high service request response rates during an overload event, using expansive controls such as load balancing, resource replication, and overload detection. The overload control should be applicable both within a service provider's IMS and between different service providers' IMSs and within an IMS subsystem and between different IMS subsystems.

question_48418.question: What should the H-GMLC include in the LCS service response when sending it to the LCS client in a deferred location request procedure for a change of area event?
question_48418.ground_truth: The H-GMLC should include the LDR reference number assigned to the LCS service request, and the information whether the deferred area event may be reported one time only, or several times.

question_48419.question: What entities handle the location register for Circuit Switched (CS) services, other than the HLR, in a mobile network?

question_48420.question: In what scenario would the MCPTT client send a SIP PUBLISH request to activate one or more functional aliases?
question_48420.ground_truth: When the MCPTT user requests to activate one or more functional aliases using the MCPTT client.

question_48421.question: What is a difference in priority between PLMNs offering disaster roaming and other PLMNs in solution #23?
question_48421.ground_truth: PLMNs offering disaster roaming have a lower priority than other PLMNs in solution #23.

question_48422.question: Which two methods are used for analytics information feedback between the NWDAF and the PCF?
question_48422.ground_truth: The two methods are Solution 1 (clause~6.1) and Solution 2 (clause~6.2).

question_48424.question: What is the outcome for Frequency Domain Coordination Scheme compared to No Coordination for FR1 Urban Macro scenario in case of large packet size?
question_48424.ground_truth: Based on results from one source, the Frequency Domain Coordination Scheme has lower mean and 5% DL Average-UPT for all load levels, and lower UL Average-UPT mean and higher 5% UL Average-UPT for all load levels.

question_48425.question: Who is responsible for performing the authentication for Coverage Map Transfer in the described process?
question_48425.ground_truth: The CMS (Coverage Map Server) performs the authentication for Coverage Map Transfer in the described process.

question_48426.question: How does the solution "Power Saving based on AMF awareness of coverage information" determine the parameters for eDRX, MICO mode, and periodic registration timer?
question_48426.ground_truth: The solution enhances the AMF to derive the power-saving parameters based on the coverage information. When the UE is within the network coverage, the AMF initiates the periodic registration update request or wakes up the UE to monitor the paging occasion. The existing procedures for reachability, MT data buffering, and exposure can be reused as the discontinuous coverage information is taken into account.

question_48430.question: What should the IWF do when receiving a SIP INVITE request for a private call, that contains more than one <entry> element?
question_48430.ground_truth: If the incoming SIP INVITE request for a private call contains more than one <entry> element, the IWF shall reject the request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response.

question_48434.question: What is the potential solution for mobility management related issues in clause 6.5?
question_48434.ground_truth: The potential solution for mobility management related issues involves using MDAS to provision and select a particular target gNB for handover to reduce or avoid HO rejections. The MDAS producer provides a HO optimization analytics report containing the current and future resource consumption, resources capabilities, and other KPIs' status for the available target gNB(s). The MDAS consumer adjusts resources and selection criteria based on the report.

question_48435.question: How do the SEPPs establish a mutually authenticated TLS connection with the peer SEPP?
question_48435.ground_truth: When the responding SEPP needs to initiate traffic in the reverse direction to the sending SEPP, the responding SEPP sets up a second N32-c connection by establishing a mutually authenticated TLS connection with the peer SEPP.

question_48438.question: What is the effect of the 'query status' value of '<mode>' parameter in the context of network interrogation?
question_48438.ground_truth: The 'query status' value of the '<mode>' parameter enables the querying of the status of a network service.

question_48439.question: What is the primary concern in the risk analysis of UC threats in IMS?
question_48439.ground_truth: The primary concern is the privacy violation threat, which can be a serious threat to users' privacy and can occur through spamming or unsolicited communications.

question_48440.question: In what scenario will the UE respond to an authentication request message with an authentication response message containing an EAP-success message?
question_48440.ground_truth: This occurs when the network is successfully validated, and the UE sends the authentication response message to the network.

question_48442.question: What signal level is used for the Composite Source Signal (CSS) test signal for MTSI-based speech measurements?
question_48442.ground_truth: The test signal level is -16 dBm0 measured at the digital reference point or the equivalent analogue point.

question_48443.question: What happens when one or more SL transmissions from a UE overlap in time with one or more overlapping UL transmissions from the UE, and the UE performs the SL transmission?
question_48443.ground_truth: The UE performs the SL transmission if the SL transmission is prioritized over all UL transmissions subject to both the UE multiplexing and processing timelines with respect to the first SL transmission and the first UL transmission, where the UE processing timeline with respect to the first SL transmission and the first UL transmission is same as when one or more SL transmissions overlap in time with multiple non-overlapping UL transmissions.

question_48444.question: What is the significance of the version number presented by the 3GPP technical specification?
question_48444.ground_truth: The version number presented as "x.y.z" indicates the following: x denotes the stage of approval, y denotes the number of significant changes, and z denotes the number of editorial changes.

question_48445.question: What must the NG-RAN node do if it receives the UE User Plane CIoT Support Indicator IE in the PATH SWITCH REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message?
question_48445.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node must store this information in the UE context and consider that User Plane CIoT 5GS Optimisation is supported for the UE if it is supported.

question_48446.question: What should the S-CSCF do if the UE supports GIBA and authentication fails in an IMS registration?
question_48446.ground_truth: The S-CSCF returns a 403 forbidden response to the UE.

question_48449.question: What is the role of the 3GPP AAA proxy in VPLMN?
question_48449.ground_truth: The 3GPP AAA proxy in VPLMN provides Authentication, Authorisation and location management services necessary for roaming non-3GPP Access users to get access to EPS.

question_48450.question: What components make up the parameters provided from the SMF to the UPF over the N4 reference point in 5G systems?
question_48450.ground_truth: The parameters provided from the SMF to the UPF over the N4 reference point include an N4 Session ID, and may also contain packet detection rules, forwarding action rules, multi-access rules, usage reporting rules, QoS enforcement rules, session reporting rules, trace requirements, port management information container, and bridge/router information.

question_48451.question: What information does the 3G UARFCN information element indicate?
question_48451.ground_truth: The 3G UARFCN information element indicates the UARFCN value of the current UTRAN serving cell, if the current serving cell is a UTRAN cell.

question_48452.question: What is the conducted requirement for the TX OFF level in FR1 for co-sited BS in dBm?
question_48452.ground_truth: The conducted requirement for the TX OFF level in FR1 for co-sited BS is -108.5 dBm.

question_48453.question: What is the minimum requirement for the Media Streams field?
question_48453.ground_truth: At the minimum, one <Media Stream> value shall be included in the Media Streams field.

question_48454.question: What is the formula for calculating the Total Radiated Power (TRP) in UTRA FDD mode?
question_48454.ground_truth: TRP is calculated as the average of the power in the low, mid, and high channels, with each channel's power calculated as the logarithm base 10 of the sum of 1/3 of the total power in the channel divided by the sum of the reference power transfer function, where the reference power transfer function is the calibrated average power transfer function for a fixed measurement antenna.

question_48456.question: What methods does the IpConfCallControlManager inherit from?
question_48456.ground_truth: The IpConfCallControlManager interface inherits from the IpMultiMediaCallControlManager interface, which in turn inherits from the Multi Party Call Control interface.

question_48457.question: What reason does the PGW give that results in rejecting a UE-initiated bearer resource allocation/modification request?
question_48457.ground_truth: The PGW rejects a UE-initiated bearer resource allocation/modification request if it has requested a bearer resource allocation/modification for the same service using a network-initiated procedure, as indicated by "collision with network initiated request".

question_48459.question: Which LAA network deployment with LAA sensing thresholds of -82 dBm for DL and -62 dBm for UL showed improvements in 22 out of the 24 measured metrics for the non-replaced Wi-Fi network?

question_48460.question: What information does the TWAN use to derive the emergency related policies to apply if the UE has not provided its IMSI?
question_48460.ground_truth: The TWAN uses the IMEI to derive the emergency related policies to apply if the UE has not provided its IMSI.

question_48463.question: What is the outcome of the CFU deactivation request if no basic service group code is provided?
question_48463.ground_truth: The deactivation request applies to all basic services for which CFU is active.

question_48464.question: What does the UE do with the received Service Gap Time when a Service Gap timer is running and it moves from 5GC to EPC?
question_48464.ground_truth: The UE stores the received Service Gap Time for later use when the timer needs to be started next time, and the Service Gap timer that was started before the system change is kept running in the UE and applied for EPC.

question_48465.question: What is the focus of the described closed control loop assurance solution?
question_48465.ground_truth: The solution enables a service provider to continuously deliver the requested level of communication service quality by adjusting and optimizing the services provided by NG-RAN and 5GC.

question_48466.question: Under which conditions should the UE use the shared COT for SL grant transmission?
question_48466.ground_truth: The UE should use the shared COT if the resources used for initial transmission for the SL grant are within the COT duration and the MAC entity decides to use shared COT with type-2 LBT.

question_48467.question: What is the role of the ICCF in the IMS architecture?
question_48467.ground_truth: The ICCF (Internet Connection Chamber Function) is responsible for access selection, routing of SIP INVITE messages, and initiating the ICS Incoming Call Request in the IMS (IP Multimedia Subsystem) architecture.

question_48469.question: What is the purpose of the co-location requirements in OTA testing?
question_48469.ground_truth: The co-location requirements in OTA testing ensure that both co-located systems can operate with minimal degradation to each other, and they are specified as power levels into or out of the conducted interface of the co-location reference antenna for conformance testing.

question_48470.question: What is the purpose of updating the existing rekeying procedure in the solution described?
question_48470.ground_truth: The purpose of updating the existing rekeying procedure is to enable the exchange of new identifiers, including L2 IDs and Kd session ID, between communicating UEs for privacy protection of unicast messages over PC5.

question_48471.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP management system supporting the capability to enable the DSO to provide the site operator with information concerning the time duration for which site operator would actually be able to provide communication services?
question_48471.ground_truth: The purpose is to achieve coordinated recovery of DSO's energy distribution services for a particular region.

question_48472.question: What is the significance of the first digit in the version number used in the 3GPP Technical Specification Group documents?
question_48472.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number indicates the stage of the document's development. If it is 0, the document is presented to TSG for information. If it is 1, the document is presented to TSG for approval. If it is greater than or equal to 3, the document is a TSG approved document under change control.

question_48474.question: What is the purpose of the "Framework for the description of telecommunication services and applications" in 3GPP specifications?
question_48474.ground_truth: The purpose of the framework is to describe the telecommunication services and applications offered by 3GPP specifications, including basic telecommunication services (bearer services and teleservices), service capabilities, and supplementary services.

question_48475.question: What happens to the QoS Flows of Priority PDU connectivity services when their state is modified from disabled to enabled?
question_48475.ground_truth: The QoS Flows are established/modified to have the service appropriate settings of the ARP and 5QI parameters, plus associated QoS characteristics as appropriate

question_48476.question: What exception is thrown if the value2 parameter in the appendTLV method is null?

question_48477.question: Why does the MnS producer use the compact format for cases where not all attributes of an object have been updated?
question_48477.ground_truth: The MnS producer may use the compact format even when not all attributes have been updated in order to maintain consistency with the IETF RFC 6902 clause 4.3, which allows for replacing attribute values with the same value without errors.

question_48478.question: Which type of SIP signalling is not covered in the present release of this specification?
question_48478.ground_truth: SIP signalling traversing the NNI between an application server and the remaining IMS functional entities, as well as SIP signalling traversing the NNI between an ISC gateway and an AS in an enterprise network, are not considered in the present release of this specification.

question_48479.question: What is the security framework defined by 3GPP for NF level?
question_48479.ground_truth: 3GPP has defined a security framework for NF level that is based on the Service Based Architecture and involves transport layer security based on X.509 certificates for mutual authentication between NFs.

question_48480.question: What shall the initiating UE do if the security procedure over user plane is used?
question_48480.ground_truth: If the security procedure over user plane is used, the initiating UE shall include a K~nrp~freshness parameter 1, set to a 128-bit nonce value generated by the initiating UE.

question_48481.question: What does the probability of event Em represent in the context of the HS-SCCH Type 3 Performance test in section 9.4.3B?
question_48481.ground_truth: The probability of event Em represents the detection performance of the HS-SCCH, which is declared when the UE is signalled on HS-SCCH-1, but DTX is observed in the corresponding HS-DPCCH ACK/NACK field.

question_48482.question: What insertion loss can be expected, on average, from B1 filters?
question_48482.ground_truth: The average insertion loss for B1 filters is 2.2 dB.

question_48483.question: What should the UE ensure if it is triggered by an upper layer application to stop soliciting proximity of a connectivity service provided by a 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE?
question_48483.ground_truth: The UE should keep on passing the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-network relay discovery solicitation for transmission until it is triggered by an upper layer application to stop soliciting proximity of a connectivity service provided by a 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE or until the UE stops being authorized to perform the discoverer UE procedure for UE-to-network relay discovery.

question_48484.question: What is the role of CHF (Tenant CCS) in the described network slice actual duration charging solution?
question_48484.ground_truth: CHF (Tenant CCS) counts the duration of the network slice for the tenant and provides an appropriate charging data response.

question_48486.question: What is the requirement for the ratio of successful reported values in the FDD-TDD inter-frequency absolute accuracy test?
question_48486.ground_truth: For the FDD-TDD inter-frequency absolute accuracy test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values in each test must be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_48487.question: What action should the UE take upon sending the DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT message if due to the EPS bearer context deactivation, only the PDN connection for emergency bearer services remains established?
question_48487.ground_truth: The UE should consider itself attached for emergency bearer services only and stop timer T3396 if it is running for the APN provided by the UE. The UE should then re-initiate the UE requested PDN connectivity procedure for the same APN as the deactivated default EPS bearer context to reactivate the EPS bearer context.

question_48488.question: What should the MS do when it receives a Registration Reject message with a Network Congestion cause?
question_48488.ground_truth: The MS should stop timer TU3904, ignore the received Register Reject Cause Information Element, and proceed as defined in sub-clause 6.2.4.5. If the MS is not in the process of GANC selection, it should extract the Register Reject Cause information element and act as following depending on the value of the Reject Cause IE. If the Reject Cause is Network Congestion, the MS should create a random value between zero and the received value in IE 'TU3907 Timer' and add this value to the received value in IE 'TU3907 Timer' and use this as the new value for TU3907.

question_48490.question: What is the purpose of the N5 and Rx reference points in the context of MC service sessions?
question_48490.ground_truth: The N5 and Rx reference points are used for resource management of MC service sessions, including QoS control. They exist between the SIP core and the 5GS.

question_48491.question: What is the usage of the Reserved fields in subclause 6.5.2?
question_48491.ground_truth: The Reserved fields in subclause 6.5.2 should not be modified when updating a dataset in the HSS.

question_48492.question: What HTTP status code should the MBSF send to the NF service consumer upon successful deletion of a resource?
question_48492.ground_truth: The MBSF should respond with an HTTP "204 No Content" status code to indicate a successful deletion of a resource.

question_48493.question: What is the purpose of the E-SMLC sending a Location Information message to the MME in step 1 of "Obtaining Non-UE Associated Network Assistance Data"?
question_48493.ground_truth: The purpose of this step is for the E-SMLC to request eNodeB position related information from the E-UTRAN for network assisted and network based positioning, which is not associated with a UE location session. The target eNodeB identity and E-SMLC identity are included for MME routing purposes.

question_48495.question: What should the Access Sever (AS) do when it receives a request containing an Additional-Identity header field and the user identified in the P-Asserted-Identity is not allowed to use the identity in the Additional-Identity header field?
question_48495.ground_truth: The AS should reject the request using a 403 (Forbidden) response including a warning header field 399 "Identity not allowed" and skip the rest of the steps.

question_48496.question: What should the UE do if it is in the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-SUPI state and it needs to make an outgoing call using an emergency number stored on the ME?
question_48496.ground_truth: The UE establishes an RRC connection with the establishmentCause set to "emergency", attempts an Initial registration for emergency services, accepts and applies security with NULL security and integrity algorithms, and establishes an emergency PDU session by sending an UL NAS TRANSPORT message with Request type set to "initial emergency request" and a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST.

question_48498.question: What is the purpose of the procedure described in clause 4.11.2.2 of TS23.502 in relation to mobility from 5GS to EPS?
question_48498.ground_truth: The purpose of the procedure is to specify the movements of UEs operating in single-registration or dual-registration mode from 5GS to EPS, including network sharing and IP address preservation.

question_48499.question: What is the condition for a UE to transmit a PSFCH with HARQ-ACK information in response to a PSSCH reception?
question_48499.ground_truth: The HARQ feedback enabled indicator field in an associated SCI format 2-A/2-B/2-C has value 1.

question_48500.question: What action does the SMF take upon receipt of a SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message and the PDU session ID?
question_48500.ground_truth: The SMF provides the service-level-AA payload received in the SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message to the DN.

question_48501.question: What element contains one or more transactions sent from the ProSe Function to the UE as a response to an announcing request if the ProSe Function accepts the request?

question_48502.question: What does the RABMAS-RAB-ESTABLISH-IND service primitive indicate in UMTS?
question_48502.ground_truth: This service primitive is an indication from the Access Stratum layer that radio access bearer setup for the indicated list of RAB IDs (contains NSAPI) has commenced.

question_48503.question: What should be set if this random-access procedure is triggered by RedCap, includes redCap, and the value of used feature or combination of features is different from the triggeredFeatureCombination?
question_48503.ground_truth: The usedFeatureCombination should be set to indicate one or more features of FeatureCombination associated to the random-access resource used in the random-access procedure, including redCap.

question_48505.question: What is the significance of the UIC system scenarios requirements and UIC RF parameters documents in GSM 05.05?
question_48505.ground_truth: The UIC system scenarios requirements document identifies the relevant system and interference scenarios for UIC equipments, and the noise levels and signal levels arising out of the worst cases. The UIC RF parameters document discusses all the parameters in GSM 05.05 and determines the RF requirements for UIC equipments, to be in line with the scenario requirements where possible and feasible, or being a reasonable compromise where not. The resulting specifications were incorporated into GSM 05.05 by Change Request no. A027.

question_48506.question: In the context of Step 6, what happens when the Branching Point or UL CL has no traffic filter towards PSA1?
question_48506.ground_truth: The SMF sends a session release request with N4 session ID to PSA1, and PSA1 releases all tunnel resources and contexts associated with the N4 session.

question_48508.question: What is the function of the IRI-POI present in the NEF in handling xIRIs for NIDD using NEF?
question_48508.ground_truth: The IRI-POI present in the NEF handles xIRIs for NIDD using NEF, including PDU session establishment, modification, release, start of interception with established PDU session, and unsuccessful procedure events.

question_48509.question: How does the SIM stored maximum authorized precedence level influence UE actions?
question_48509.ground_truth: The SIM stored maximum authorized precedence level allows the mobile station to check that only an authorized level is used for set-up.

question_48510.question: What happens to the sidelink grant if the associated sidelink process does not have data to be sent?
question_48510.ground_truth: If there is no data to be sent in the associated sidelink process, the sidelink grant will be ignored.

question_48511.question: In Solution #18, what is the role of the 5G DDNMF (5G Direct Dynamic Node Management Function) in the UE-to-network relay authorization and PC5 link setup process?
question_48511.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF provides the discovery parameters and ProSe Key Management Function (PKMF) address to the remote UE and UE-to-network relay during the authorization and PC5 link setup process.

question_48514.question: What must a UE support in order to perform SRS carrier based switching for SCells in E-UTRA FDD, TDD, and TDD-FDD dual connectivity?
question_48514.ground_truth: The UE must support the requirements defined in Section 8.8, provided that at least DL subframe #0 or DL subframe #5 per radio frame is available for measurements at the UE in the measurement cell.

question_48515.question: What happens to a call if the forwarded-to destination is not reachable during call forwarding on no reply?
question_48515.ground_truth: The network will clear the call towards the calling user with an indication that the call cannot be completed.

question_48517.question: What should the MS do when the SERVICE REJECT message contains GMM cause value #25 and is not integrity protected?
question_48517.ground_truth: The MS should discard the message and take different actions depending on the received reject cause value. For example, if the reject cause value is #3 or #6, the MS should consider the SIM/USIM as invalid for GPRS services and non-GPRS services until switching off or the SIM/USIM is removed.

question_48518.question: What is the role of the AMF in the PLMN when an S-NSSAI is associated with more than one Network Slice instance?
question_48518.ground_truth: The AMF instance serving the UE may logically belong to more than one Network Slice instance associated with the S-NSSAI when multiple Network Slice instances associated with the same S-NSSAI are deployed in the same Tracking Areas. In such cases, the network selects and serves the UE with only one Network Slice instance associated with the S-NSSAI at any one time, except in cases where the currently serving Network Slice instance is no longer valid in a given Registration Area or a change in the UE's Allowed NSSAI occurs.

question_48519.question: How does a GMLC identify an LCS client?
question_48519.ground_truth: An LCS client is identified by an E.164 number or APN-NI, which is administered as permanent data in the GMLC for each LCS client.

question_48520.question: What is the logical entity that offers management capability to an Exposed MnS consumer called?

question_48521.question: What is the purpose of the "Enabler for coordination of SCS/AS initiated downlink transmission" solution described in section 5.1?
question_48521.ground_truth: The purpose of this solution is to handle the high latency of power saving devices on the application level by waiting with the transmission until the device becomes active and starting a packet transmission in the "active window", making the communication with the device without delay and finalizing the subsequent application processing promptly.

question_48523.question: Which UE-initiated PMFP procedures can be performed for a non-default QoS rule if the UE supports performance measurement function protocol procedures for it?
question_48523.ground_truth: The UE-initiated PMFP procedures that can be performed for a non-default QoS rule if the UE supports performance measurement function protocol procedures for it are UE-initiated RTT measurement procedure, access availability or unavailability report procedure, UE-initiated PLR measurement procedure, UE assistance data provisioning procedure, and UE assistance data termination procedure.

question_48524.question: What are the preconditions for using redundant transmission as the action to meet connection reliability requirements?
question_48524.ground_truth: The preconditions include having a SEALDD service policy with data transmission quality guarantees and being authorized to request redundant transport services on behalf of the VAL client.

question_48526.question: What does the P-CSCF (IMS-ALG) modify in the SDP offer before sending it to the core network?
question_48526.ground_truth: The P-CSCF (IMS-ALG) modifies the SDP offer by setting the transport to "TCP/MSRP", removing the SDP fingerprint attribute, and including the fingerprint attribute received from the UE in the remote descriptor.

question_48528.question: What are the roles of the "Admin", "Push" and "Pull" reference points in the SFR system?
question_48528.ground_truth: The "Admin" reference point is responsible for managing transactions between the SFR enabled Feed Reader and the SFR server for optimized feed delivery. The "Push" reference point enables feed content delivery using OMA Push or MBMS download, while the "Pull" reference point facilitates feed content retrieval when the SFR enabled Feed Reader pulls content from the SFR server. The "Push" and "Pull" reference points use a subset of the OMA DCD-2 and DCD-1 reference points for transaction handling.

question_48529.question: When should the UE start to send keep-alives towards the P-CSCF?
question_48529.ground_truth: The UE shall start to send keep-alives associated with the session towards the P-CSCF if the Via header field of any provisional response, or of the final 200 (OK) response, for the initial INVITE request contains a "keep" header field parameter with a value.

question_48530.question: What is the purpose of the Additional Slice Information in TA granularity in the registration response?
question_48530.ground_truth: The Additional Slice Information in TA granularity in the registration response is provided to the UE to indicate the mapping between an S-NSSAI within the rejected S-NSSAIs and TAIs that can support such S-NSSAI, allowing the UE to start a registration update when it moves to a TA where the rejected S-NSSAI can be supported.

question_48532.question: What is the role of the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay in PC5 link security establishment between the source UE and the target UE?
question_48532.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay acts as a relay between the source UE and the target UE in PC5 link security establishment. It sends a Direct Communication Request message that contains Relay Service Code to the target UE to trigger the second hop PC5 link establishment. The UE-to-UE Relay verifies the Direct Security Mode Complete message from both the source UE and the target UE to assure that they are authorized to get the relay service. After successful verification, the UE-to-UE Relay sends a Direct Communication Ack message to the target UE to complete the PC5 connection establishment procedure.

question_48533.question: In which 5GMM state can a service request procedure or registration procedure be triggered to transition the UE from 5GMM-IDLE mode or 5GMM-IDLE mode with suspend indication to 5GMM-CONNECTED mode?
question_48533.ground_truth: A service request procedure or registration procedure can be triggered in 5GMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION-UPDATE state to transition the UE from 5GMM-IDLE mode or 5GMM-IDLE mode with suspend indication to 5GMM-CONNECTED mode.

question_48534.question: In the context of the described Attach procedure, what is the role of the MME in assigning an IP address to the device?
question_48534.ground_truth: The MME is responsible for assigning an IP address to the device, either an APN-wide private IPv4 address or an IPv6 global unicast address, from a pool of addresses locally provisioned for the requested APN and for the combined S-GW/P-GW (CGW) that is assigned to the device.

question_48535.question: What should the SM-over-IP sender do when an SM over IP is to be submitted?
question_48535.ground_truth: When an SM-over-IP sender wants to submit an SM over IP, the SM-over-IP sender shall send a SIP MESSAGE request, with the Request-URI containing the PSI of the SM-over-IP sender, the From header containing a public user identity of the SM-over-IP sender, and the To header containing a public user identity of the SM-over-IP recipient.

question_48538.question: What action does the UPF take after determining that the destination port number could also be served by the same 5GS Bridge?
question_48538.ground_truth: The UPF informs the SMF about the port-pair details, allowing the SMF to report the port-pair to UE1, so that it can complete the PDU Establishment procedure.
