question_48540.question: In the context of the solution 8, what does the discovery of management service exposure enable?
question_48540.ground_truth: The discovery of management service exposure enables the utilization of capabilities/features of the management system by applications, including the discovery of MnS and the capabilities of the network and analysis results from the NSCE Server.

question_48541.question: What is one of the potential standardization needs for viewport-dependent XR media delivery?
question_48541.ground_truth: One of the potential standardization needs for viewport-dependent XR media delivery is very high-bitrate and efficient/scalable streaming protocols.

question_48542.question: What happens in the Initiating state of the Originating Call Leg, in terms of network events and their potential effects on the application?
question_48542.ground_truth: In the Initiating state of the Originating Call Leg, the network checks the authority/ability of the party to place the connection to the remote (destination) party with the given properties. The setup of the connection for the party has been initiated and the application activity timer is being provided. Events such as the receipt of destination address information, receipt of a release, or expiry of the application activity timer can all cause a transition to the Releasing state.

question_48543.question: What is the definition of a Dedicated File (DF) in the context of a 3GPP system?
question_48543.ground_truth: A Dedicated File (DF) is a file containing access conditions and, optionally, Elementary Files (EFs) or other Dedicated Files (DFs).

question_48544.question: What type of measurement result file consists of multiple NEs and a single granularity period?
question_48544.ground_truth: The type of measurement result file that consists of multiple NEs and a single granularity period is indicated by "B" in the file name.

question_48545.question: What is the recommended approach for defining the network parts of UMTS?
question_48545.ground_truth: A modular approach, where a module represents a part of a UMTS network that implements some functionality.

question_48547.question: Which reference point in the TNAP-TNGF architecture facilitates the transfer of user-plane PDU data between the UE and the TNGF?
question_48547.ground_truth: The NWt-up reference point in the TNAP-TNGF architecture facilitates the transfer of user-plane PDU data between the UE and the TNGF.

question_48548.question: What was the result of the ITU-WB Selection Test in which a number of Requirements and Objectives were specified for the candidate coders in the Terms of Reference (ToR) for Wideband Coders?
question_48548.ground_truth: Of the 40 statistical comparisons, there was only one failure in the Dynastat LL, the ToR Requirement that condition C04 (4.1458) score significantly "Better Than" C20 (4.0677). With a 95% statistical criterion for pass/fail, it would have been reasonable to expect at least two failures based on chance alone.

question_48549.question: What is the description of Key Issue 1 in the document?
question_48549.ground_truth: Key Issue 1 in the document aims to describe a architecture reference model that is appropriate to fulfil the requirements of Cellular IoT (CIoT) for ultra-low complexity and low throughput "Internet of Things" devices that may also be constrained e.g. with regard to processing power, memory, battery capacity, etc. It will address high level Architecture Reference Model, network elements and reference point for CIoT.

question_48551.question: What is the requirement for prefixing attribute names when they have the same name in more than one class and different properties?
question_48551.ground_truth: The attribute names should be prefixed with the class name followed by a period.

question_48552.question: What information is included in the identity list during group creation?
question_48552.ground_truth: The identity list contains the list of FF UE IDs that are part of the group to be created. If the group member list is empty, an empty group is created.

question_48553.question: What is the method used to balance robustness versus link efficiency in the context of Multiflow and graceful handover?
question_48553.ground_truth: This is achieved by establishing a Multiflow link to the target and routing data only over the source, then bicasting through both links, and finally only through the target, allowing for a way to balance robustness versus link efficiency.

question_48554.question: What should the S-CSCF do if the WAF or WWSF is barred?
question_48554.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall send a 403 (Forbidden) response to the REGISTER request.

question_48555.question: What does the "rtx-time" payload-format-specific parameter specify in RTP retransmission?
question_48555.ground_truth: The maximum time a sender will keep an original RTP packet in its buffers available for retransmission

question_48556.question: In step 8a, what is the time interval between the start of CSI reporting for SCell1 and the first available uplink resource for reporting valid CSI, if subframe (m+54) cannot be used?
question_48556.ground_truth: The time interval is up to the end of T2.

question_48558.question: What happens if the 3G/2G SGSN indicated Reset in the NAS container for PS HO included in the Handover from UTRAN Command message, and the SGSN wants to use the default parameters in the XID negotiation for LLC SAPIs used in LLC ADM?
question_48558.ground_truth: In this case, the SGSN shall send an empty XID Command to perform LLC/SNDCP XID negotiation.

question_48559.question: What is the term used to describe the condition where users move out of E-UTRAN coverage?

question_48560.question: What is the purpose of the TP-Failure-Cause field in SM-TL?
question_48560.ground_truth: The TP-Failure-Cause field is used to report the reason for failure to transfer or process a short message. It consists of a single octet used as follows: to indicate the cause of the failure in transferring or processing the message.

question_48562.question: What is the purpose of defining UTRA ACLR requirement in the context of both UTRA and E-UTRA protection?
question_48562.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure the protection of both UTRA and E-UTRA in the specifications.

question_48563.question: What treatment will the 3GPP system provide to an MMTEL video call when MPS is activated for a call?
question_48563.ground_truth: The 3GPP system will provide priority treatment to the affected signalling, and the audio and video media flows when MPS is activated for an MMTEL video call.

question_48564.question: What determines the URSP (User Plane Resource Selection Policy) rules in the 5G Core network?
question_48564.ground_truth: The URSP rules are determined by the PCF (Policy Control Function) based on the policy requested by the Application Function (AF) in step~0 of the process.

question_48565.question: What are the potential impacts of GSMA OPG work on EAS discovery in the 5G architecture?
question_48565.ground_truth: The GSMA OPG work may have potential impacts on EAS discovery in the 5G architecture. The 5GS (5G System) should facilitate edge relocation between an EAS deployed by a source EHE provider to another EHE deployed by a target EHE provider, even in scenarios when EHEs are operated by different service providers.

question_48566.question: What should the MCData client do once it has finished receiving the file from the SS (MCDATA server)?
question_48566.ground_truth: The MCData client should wait for a SIP BYE message to release communications, respond with a SIP 200 (OK) message, and then send a "FILE DOWNLOAD COMPLETED" disposition via a SIP MESSAGE message.

question_48567.question: When the H-PCRF receives a Diameter CCR message indicating gateway control session termination in step 2b, which message does it send to the V-PCRF or BBERF in response?
question_48567.ground_truth: The H-PCRF acknowledges the session or subsession termination request by sending a Diameter CCA message to the V-PCRF or BBERF.

question_48568.question: What is the objective of the 3GPP work item on the introduction of TDD operating band in the L-band for LTE?
question_48568.ground_truth: The objective of this work item is to specify technical requirements for deploying LTE TDD operation in the L-band.

question_48569.question: What is required to establish a security context for end-to-end secure communications between MCPTT users?
question_48569.ground_truth: The MCPTT key management server (KMS) manages the security domain, and for any endpoint to use or access end-to-end secure communications, it needs to be provisioned with keying material associated with its identity by the KMS.

question_48570.question: What is the difference between a localization and a location related service experience?
question_48570.ground_truth: Localization refers to a known location in 3D space, including an orientation, while location related service experience refers to user interaction and information provided by a service to a user that is relevant to the physical location in which the user accesses the service.

question_48571.question: What is the purpose of the Management Instruction function in the protocol?
question_48571.ground_truth: The Management Instruction function is responsible for managing the Inference function by making decisions based on data received from the Data Collection function and the Inference function.

question_48572.question: What should the number of transport blocks and HARQ-ACK bits be for a UE to use PUCCH format 4 and a PUCCH resource with a TPC field value to determine the PUCCH resource value?
question_48572.ground_truth: If the total number of HARQ-ACK bits and scheduling request bit (if any) and periodic CSI bits (if any) is more than 22.

question_48573.question: What is contained in the <transmission> element if the UE was out of E-UTRAN coverage?
question_48573.ground_truth: If the UE was out of E-UTRAN coverage, the <transmission> element contains a mandatory "amount" attribute indicating the amount of octets transmitted to the ProSe group during the out of E-UTRAN coverage period and an optional "timestamp" attribute indicating the date and time of the first transmission during the out of E-UTRAN coverage period.

question_48575.question: What happens if the number of retransmissions reaches the maximum number of retransmissions due to several false or missed ACK detections in series?
question_48575.ground_truth: The first new data on the E-DPDCH with E-DPCCH are not the consequence of ACK, and this case is not counted as a sample.

question_48577.question: What is the minimum required interference signal level for the co-location minimum requirement in BS type 1-C, relative to the rated total output power in the operating band?
question_48577.ground_truth: The interfering signal level is 30 dB below the rated total output power in the operating band for the co-location minimum requirement in BS type 1-C.

question_48579.question: What criteria must be met for the L1-SINR test to pass?
question_48579.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values in each test must be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_48582.question: What action should be taken by the source SGSN during an RA update, in the case of inter-SGSN mobility, if SIPTO at the local network is allowed for the APN associated with a PDN connection and in case of collocated LGW?
question_48582.ground_truth: The source SGSN should not include the bearer(s) corresponding to the SIPTO at the local network PDN connection into the PDP context and shall release the core network resources associated to the SIPTO at the local network PDN connection by performing the SGSN-initiated PDP Context Deactivation before sending the Context Response.

question_48585.question: What is the required spacing for NR carriers and E-UTRA carriers when added in TC21.1 for transmitter tests?
question_48585.ground_truth: The nominal carrier spacing defined in clause~4.5.1 shall apply.

question_48586.question: In what scenarios should the P-CSCF not forward a REGISTER request containing an "sos" SIP URI parameter in the Contact header field and not containing an Authorization header field?
question_48586.ground_truth: When the network supports IMS Services for roaming users in deployments without IMS-level roaming interfaces, the UE is roaming, there is no II-NNI to the HPLMN of the served user, and the access type is not set to "3GPP-NR-ProSe-L3UNR". Or, if required by operator policy and the UE is not roaming.

question_48587.question: What is the purpose of the FDD-FDD inter frequency absolute RSRP accuracy test for CA idle mode measurements for non-overlapping carriers?
question_48587.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that the FDD-FDD inter frequency absolute RSRP accuracy for CA idle mode measurements for non-overlapping carrier is within the specified limits.

question_48588.question: What is the primary difference between UE-assisted and UE-based OTDOA positioning methods in 3G UMTS network?
question_48588.ground_truth: The primary difference between UE-assisted and UE-based OTDOA positioning methods in 3G UMTS network is where the actual position calculation is carried out. In UE-assisted mode, the UE measures the difference in time of arrival of several cells and signals the measurement results to the network, where the SRNC or the SAS carries out the position calculation. In UE-based mode, the UE makes the measurements and also carries out the position calculation, and thus requires additional information such as the position of the measured Node Bs for the position calculation.

question_48590.question: What entities can use the UE side entities' service experience information and for what purpose?
question_48590.ground_truth: The application service provider or any other event can use the UE side entities' service experience information for predictions of application performance analytics, for determining the VAL server performance analytics, or for further analysis of the service experience report from other UEs to predict analytics.

question_48592.question: What is the variable that defines the interruption uncertainty in acquiring the first available PRACH occasion in the new cell in Dhandover1?

question_48594.question: What existing test procedures will the study aim to adapt from RAN4 and RAN5?
question_48594.ground_truth: The study will aim to adapt test procedures for single antenna port, transmit diversity, and open and closed loop spatial multiplexing from RAN4 and RAN5.

question_48595.question: What should a MS do if it is IMSI attached and receives a ROAMING NOT ALLOWED status?
question_48595.ground_truth: The MS should set the update status to U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, delete any TMSI, LAI and ciphering key sequence number, reset the location update attempt counter and change to the MM IDLE state.

question_48596.question: What does the <TAC> in the Tracking Area Identity based N3IWF FQDN represent?
question_48596.ground_truth: The TAC (Tracking Area Code) together with MCC and MNC identifies the Tracking Area Identity the UE is located in.

question_48597.question: What is a separate IP flow mobility procedure required for in the addition of access in network-provided Routing Rules during the initial PDN connection establishment?
question_48597.ground_truth: This is required because the UE cannot acknowledge the network-provided Routing Rules during the addition of an access, as there is no way for the UE to do so.

question_48599.question: What should the UE do upon receipt of an AUTHENTICATION REJECT message with a valid integrity check during an unsuccessful authentication procedure if the network is operating in single-registration mode?
question_48599.ground_truth: The UE should handle the 5GMM parameters as specified in 3GPP TS 24.501 for the case when the authentication procedure performed over 3GPP access is not accepted by the network.

question_48601.question: What should be the periodicity for SSB transmissions for inter-IAB cell search and measurement in stage 2, for a SA frequency layer in Solution 1-B?
question_48601.ground_truth: SSBs for inter-IAB cell search and measurement in stage 2, for a SA frequency layer in Solution 1-B, should follow the currently defined periodicity for initial access.

question_48603.question: What is required for throttled Trace Recording Session in terms of clearing up?
question_48603.ground_truth: It shall be possible for the NE to clear up a throttled trace recording session if there are sufficient resources available within the NE.

question_48604.question: What is the purpose of the SLm interface and where is it specified?
question_48604.ground_truth: The SLm interface is a control plane interface between the E-UTRAN Serving Mobile Location Centre (E-SMLC) and the Location Measurement Unit (LMU) in the Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access Network (E-UTRAN). The interface is specified in the 3GPP TS 36.45x series of technical specifications.

question_48608.question: What is the functionality of the MAG entity in PMIPv6?
question_48608.ground_truth: The MAG entity in PMIPv6 is responsible for termination of the UE-MAG link-local protocols and forwarding of user plane IP packets between the UE-MAG point-to-point logical link and the S2a tunnel for the UE.

question_48609.question: What action does the AMF take if a UE supporting UAS services provides CAA-level UAV ID during registration?
question_48609.ground_truth: The AMF may trigger the UUAA-MM procedure if a UE supporting UAS services provides CAA-level UAV ID during registration.

question_48611.question: What are the three types of services a terminal in V2X may provide?
question_48611.ground_truth: A terminal in V2X may provide V2V (vehicle-to-vehicle), V2P (vehicle-to-pedestrian), and V2I (vehicle-to-infrastructure) services.

question_48615.question: Which cell measurement procedure must the UE support for the 5G-SRVCC from NG-RAN to 3GPP UTRAN?
question_48615.ground_truth: The UE should support UTRAN cell measurement procedure.

question_48616.question: What is the role of the Unified Data Repository (UDR) in the 5G system architecture?
question_48616.ground_truth: The UDR is responsible for storing permanent and transient/temporary data in the 5G system architecture. It can be accessed and managed by various network functions (NFs) such as Provisioning-FE, UDM-FE, PCF-FE, and NEF-FE.

question_48617.question: What are the three basic types of tests that an operator may expect when a new NF is delivered?
question_48617.ground_truth: The three basic types of tests are unit and acceptance tests, which involve testing the independent functioning of the NF; integration tests, which refer to limited functionality horizontal tests with other NF; and system tests, which refer to testing the NFs functioning as part of a complete NSSI, NSI, or communication service instance.

question_48618.question: What is the purpose of the test in phase B to verify the correct speed conversion for the BCS phases?
question_48618.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the FA detects a change of the TCH access rate, updates the speed conversion factor, and utilizes it for the up-conversion of the BCS signalling to the message speed and vice versa.

question_48620.question: In which subclause of 3GPP TS 04.60 is the procedure described for the inter-RAT (GPRS to UTRAN) cell change order testing scenario with a known cell and T3174 expiry?
question_48620.ground_truth: The procedure is described in subclause 8.4.2 of 3GPP TS 04.60 for the inter-RAT (GPRS to UTRAN) cell change order testing scenario with a known cell and T3174 expiry.

question_48622.question: What is the format of the measurement name "RRC.ConnEstabAtt.Cause"?
question_48622.ground_truth: The measurement name "RRC.ConnEstabAtt.Cause" has the form where "Cause" identifies the establishment cause.

question_48623.question: What is the minimum number of carriers used for FDD cells when calculating the filtering of CPICH RSCP for an already identified inter-frequency cell?
question_48623.ground_truth: The parameter NcarrierFDD is the number of carriers used for FDD cells.

question_48624.question: On which timeslots is the first part of the extended dual slot access burst transmitted in a burst with equal size to the active part of the normal burst?
question_48624.ground_truth: The first part of the extended dual slot access burst is transmitted in a burst with equal size to the active part of the normal burst on timeslots with TN = 0, 2, 4, and 6.

question_48625.question: What is the method used to destroy a voucher?
question_48625.ground_truth: The method used to destroy a voucher is destroyVoucherReq().

question_48626.question: What should the UE do if the received values of messageIdentifier and/or serialNumber are not the same as any of the pairs for which a warning message is currently being assembled on reception of SIB8?
question_48626.ground_truth: The UE should start assembling a warning message for this messageIdentifier and serialNumber pair, store the received warningMessageSegment, store the received warningAreaCoordinatesSegment (if any), and continue reception of SIB8.

question_48630.question: What does the Warning Area List consist of and how is it used?
question_48630.ground_truth: The Warning Area List consists of a list of Cell IDs, a list of TAIs, or one or more Emergency Area IDs. It is used by the eNodeB to identify the cells where to distribute the warning message. If it is absent, it is interpreted as "all cells on the eNodeB".

question_48631.question: What must the UE do after storing the SNPN identity in the "permanently forbidden SNPNs" list for the specific access type for which the REGISTRATION REJECT message was received?
question_48631.ground_truth: When the UE stores the SNPN identity in the "permanently forbidden SNPNs" list for the specific access type for which the REGISTRATION REJECT message was received, it is required to delete any 5G-GUTI, last visited registered TAI and ngKSI, and set the 5GS update status to 5U3 (ROAMING NOT ALLOWED) for that access type. If the UE is not operating in SNPN access operation mode, it shall store the 5GS update status in a non-volatile memory in the USIM or in the non-volatile memory in the ME. If the UE performs onboarding services in SNPN or the SNPN selection is made manually by the user, it will attempt to register with the SNPN, even if the SNPN identify is stored in the "permanently forbidden SNPNs" list.

question_48632.question: What does the "mode" parameter represent in the context of UE modes of operation for EPS?
question_48632.ground_truth: The "mode" parameter in the context of UE modes of operation for EPS indicates the mode of operation, with possible values being PS mode 2, CS/PS mode 1, CS/PS mode 2, and PS mode 1.

question_48634.question: What is the function of the MAF007 in a PLMN?
question_48634.ground_truth: The MAF007 in a PLMN is responsible for determining the authorizations relating to Call Forwarding Unconditional (CFU).

question_48637.question: What is the role of IMS-ALG1 in the removal of codec C2 in the example flow of recording information of removed codec in the IP realm?
question_48637.ground_truth: IMS-ALG1 removes codec C2 and records C2 and the related position of 2 in the forwarded IP realm.

question_48638.question: What is the format of the UE-CapabilityRAT-Container list?
question_48638.ground_truth: The UE-CapabilityRAT-Container list is a list of UE-CapabilityRAT-Container, where each UE-CapabilityRAT-Container contains the rat-Type and ue-CapabilityRAT-Container as octet string.

question_48639.question: What are the main new functionalities and support requirements for commercial services not provided by the existing LCS Mobile Terminated architecture?
question_48639.ground_truth: The main new functionalities include privacy settings, scalability, support of low latency LCS, Mobile Originating Location Request scenario, and location service exposure, with the need to support roaming scenarios and IoT UEs for commercial services.

question_48640.question: What are some of the functions of WSP in addition to the basic HTTP/1.1 function?
question_48640.ground_truth: Some additional functions of WSP include session establishment and management, header encoding, asynchronous transactions, transaction abort, datagram transport, and push.

question_48641.question: What is the suggested approach for determining the IAB-MT spurious level for unsynchronized co-existing service?
question_48641.ground_truth: The IAB-MT spurious level does not need to be tighter than the IAB-DU receiver spurious requirement for unsynchronized co-existing service.

question_48642.question: What is the purpose of the Tsor-cm timer in the UE?
question_48642.ground_truth: The Tsor-cm timer is used to release PDU sessions or services and enter idle mode in the UE, and its value is based on the UE's current PDU session attribute type, service type, and SOR security check.

question_48644.question: What is the requirement for efficient and low-complexity combining of multiple cells for the provision of multi-cell MBMS/Broadcast service?

question_48645.question: What is the attribute "intent preemption capability" used for in MnS?
question_48645.ground_truth: The attribute "intent preemption capability" is used by the MnS consumer to specify whether the preemption will be triggered or not for their intent.

question_48646.question: What API is used to log the information related to service API invocations on the CAPIF core function?
question_48646.ground_truth: The Logging API invocations APIs, as defined in 3GPP TS 23.222, allow API exposing functions via CAPIF-3/3e reference points to log the information related to service API invocations on the CAPIF core function.

question_48648.question: What is the purpose of the HSS/AAA-initiated detach procedure for the Evolved Packet Core?
question_48648.ground_truth: The purpose of this procedure is to delete the UE from the Evolved Packet Core and initiate the detach procedure for each access system to which the UE is registered.

question_48651.question: What is the ratio of the highest frequency in a supported operating band to the lowest frequency in the same supported operating band?

question_48652.question: When should the SMF initiate a PDU Session modification to retrieve the current access network information of the UE?
question_48652.ground_truth: If the SMF receives a request to install/modify or remove a PCC rule with Access Network Information report parameters, the SMF should initiate a PDU Session modification to retrieve the current access network information of the UE and forward it to the PCF.

question_48653.question: What method is used by the I-CSCF to request for UE's authorization to register or establish a session?
question_48653.ground_truth: The I-CSCF sends a POST request (custom method: authorize) to request for UE's authorization to register or establish an originating/terminating session.

question_48654.question: Which types of E-UTRA UE does this test apply to?
question_48654.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 13 and forward that support DL LAA and have FGI bits 5 and 111.

question_48655.question: What is the definition of HS-DSCH in UMTS?
question_48655.ground_truth: The HS-DSCH is a resource that exists in the downlink only, and it has an impact on the physical and transport channel levels. It is a common pool of radio resources shared dynamically between several UEs, and it employs a specified part of the downlink resources.

question_48656.question: What should the mobile station do when it receives an IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message in the 51.2.6.1.1 conformance requirement?
question_48656.ground_truth: The mobile station shall stop monitoring downlink CCCH and switches to the assigned PDCH and starts listening for downlink RLC/MAC blocks identified by the assigned TFI; and starts timer T3190.

question_48658.question: What is the role of the NF Service Consumer in the release of RAN resources?
question_48658.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer shall request the source V-SMF or I-SMF to release the resources in the VPLMN without sending a PDU session release command to the UE.

question_48659.question: What does the 3GPP Technical Specification Group focus on in the "Enhanced support of Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) in the 5G System" study?
question_48659.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group focuses on enhancing the 5G System to support Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), specifically by enabling enhanced support for Time Sensitive Communication to support deterministic applications.

question_48661.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in relation to the IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS)?
question_48661.ground_truth: The 3GPP provides the technical specification for the IMS, which includes the procedures for optimal media routeing (OMR) within the IMS.

question_48662.question: What is the expected format for the message sent in step 4 if the Correlation ID or SIPTO Correlation ID is included in step~4?
question_48662.ground_truth: The eNodeB shall use the included information to establish a direct user plane path to the L-GW and forward uplink data for Local IP Access or SIPTO at the Local Network with L-GW function collocated with the (H)eNB accordingly.

question_48665.question: What protocol is currently used as a transport for most GBA bootstrapping variants?

question_48666.question: What is the procedure used by a UE supporting NR sidelink U2N Relay UE operation to forward NR sidelink integrated discovery messages or Model B Discovery messages?
question_48666.ground_truth: The procedure is used to evaluate AS layer conditions and determine whether a UE is in proximity to a NR sidelink U2U Relay UE in Model A Discovery messages.

question_48668.question: What is an implication for an initial talk permission request for a group member in a call?
question_48668.ground_truth: The initial talk permission request can be implied by the SIP message which initiates the call without any specific Floor Request message.

question_48670.question: What is the meaning of "may" in 3GPP Technical Specifications?
question_48670.ground_truth: "May" indicates permission to do something within the context of normative provisions.

question_48671.question: What is the requirement for the U-plane interruption time in LTE architecture to be lower than the requirement for inter-RAT handover?
question_48671.ground_truth: The U-plane interruption time is expected to be lower than the requirement for inter-RAT handover, even in the case of inter-RAT HO from LTE to 2G/3G.

question_48672.question: In the context of 3GPP specifications, what is the function of the RNC in the network architecture?
question_48672.ground_truth: The RNC, or Radio Network Controller, is a key component of the 3GPP network architecture that manages the radio network and interfaces with the core network to handle the mobility of mobile stations.

question_48673.question: What is the function of the NRF in the new SMS routing solution using NRF?
question_48673.ground_truth: The NRF supports the registration and discovery of newly defined services in the new solution.

question_48676.question: What is the effect of the N(S) sequence error exception condition on timer T200?
question_48676.ground_truth: If the k layer entity detects an N(S) sequence error but has not yet transmitted a REJ frame, timer T200 does not get reset on receipt of a supervisory command frame.

question_48681.question: Which interfaces in GCS AS and BM-SC are responsible for signalling data and user data communication and what security measures are taken for them?
question_48681.ground_truth: MB2 interface in GCS AS and BM-SC are responsible for signalling data and user data communication, which is protected against eavesdropping and manipulation of data using NDS/IP for confidentiality and integrity protection.

question_48682.question: What is the role of IAK in the set up of initial trust for 5GC NFs?
question_48682.ground_truth: IAK is an initial credential that is distributed out-of-band between the operator CA/RA and the NF via OAM system, and is used as initial trust to authenticate the NF.

question_48683.question: What are the events that are applicable at the HNB GW for intercepting information from a HNB?
question_48683.ground_truth: The events that are applicable at the HNB GW for intercepting information from a HNB are Target UE Registration to HNB, Target UE De-Registration from HNB, Start of Interception with HNB attached UE, and Target UE HNB Handover.

question_48686.question: In which frequency range does the power of any spurious emission not exceed -27 dBm/MHz for BS operating in Band n13 and n14 in certain regions?
question_48686.ground_truth: The power of any spurious emission shall not exceed: -27 dBm/MHz, for BS operating in Band n13 and n14, within the frequency range from 10 MHz below the lowest frequency of the BS downlink operating band up to 10 MHz above the highest frequency of the BS downlink operating band.

question_48687.question: What does the 5G System need to achieve in terms of localization accuracy, as per the potential requirements?
question_48687.ground_truth: The 5G System needs to provide positioning service with a horizontal accuracy less than 10 m and, indoors, with a vertical accuracy less than 3 m.

question_48688.question: What should the confidence level be for the statistical pass/fail decisions?
question_48688.ground_truth: The confidence level should be 95% for the statistical pass/fail decisions.

question_48689.question: What should the UE include in the Accept-Contact header field containing the ICSI value if the IMS communication service absolutely requires that the terminating UE understand the IMS communication service in order to be able to accept the session?
question_48689.ground_truth: The UE should include the parameters require and explicit in the Accept-Contact header field containing the ICSI value.

question_48690.question: What is the purpose of 5G VN group communications in the 5G network?
question_48690.ground_truth: 5G VN group communications in the 5G network are used for enabling group communications, where each group maps to a DNN and slice that may be associated with its own QoS policies. Each group is associated with an IP multicast address or a set of IP singlecast addresses and QoS policies to allow for dedicated QoS parameters.

question_48691.question: What is one potential specification impact of sub-PRB transmission with single slot?
question_48691.ground_truth: One potential specification impact of sub-PRB transmission with single slot is frequency domain resource allocation.

question_48693.question: What is one of the recommended requirements for the mosaic service on the server-side?
question_48693.ground_truth: One of the recommended requirements is that the solution should rely on a presentation layer that enables the service provider to realize the navigation of the component video streams embedded within a single video stream that is provided to the UE.

question_48699.question: What should a participating MCPTT function do when it receives a Floor Release Multi Talker message with a lower or the same message-sequence-number value as the stored one?
question_48699.ground_truth: It should discard the received Floor Release Multi Talker message.

question_48700.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a response with an SDP body, where the precondition mechanism is used, if the response includes the "precondition" option-tag in the Require header field?
question_48700.ground_truth: The UE should include a Require header field with the "precondition" option-tag in subsequent requests with an SDP body that the UE sends in the same dialog.

question_48703.question: What does V-SMF do after receiving a DNS query in step~11 of scenario~2.1 with HPLMN monitoring?
question_48703.ground_truth: V-SMF provides message handling rules to V-EASDF, including an ECS to append to the DNS query corresponding to the candidate local PSA and H-EASDF as the next DNS server to send the query to.

question_48704.question: What is the role of the Itf-N interface in the management of the 3G network?
question_48704.ground_truth: The Itf-N interface in the 3G network is built up by a number of Integration Reference Points (IRPs) and a related Name Convention, which realize the functional capabilities over this interface.

question_48705.question: How does the network determine the total amount of non-scheduled transmissions for a UE in FDD?
question_48705.ground_truth: The network determines the total amount of non-scheduled transmissions for a UE in FDD by considering the sum of the non-scheduled grant.

question_48706.question: What is the purpose of the "2 out of 3 approach" in MRFC session control measurements?
question_48706.ground_truth: The "2 out of 3 approach" in MRFC session control measurements means that the measurements should be evaluated based on two out of the three key performance indicators: attempt, success, and failure.

question_48708.question: What should the source SGSN include in the Forward Relocation Request message when the target cell is a CSG cell?
question_48708.ground_truth: The source SGSN should include the CSG ID in the Forward Relocation Request message when the target cell is a CSG cell.

question_48710.question: What is the objective of the work item regarding specifying LTE sidelink enhancements for V2V services?
question_48710.ground_truth: The objective of this work item is to specify the necessary LTE sidelink enhancements for V2V services.

question_48711.question: What information is provisioned in the UE in support of the UE assuming the role of a 5G ProSe End UE and thereby enabling the use of a 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay?
question_48711.ground_truth: Authorisation policy for using a 5G ProSe Layer-3 and/or Layer-2 UE-to-UE Relay, Policy/parameters for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery, and validity time indicating the expiration time of the Policy/Parameter for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay discovery and communication.

question_48714.question: What action should a UE take if the UE is not authorized for restricted 5G ProSe direct discovery model A announcing?
question_48714.ground_truth: The UE should abort the discovery procedure if it is not authorized for restricted 5G ProSe direct discovery model A announcing.

question_48715.question: What is the maximum payload length in bytes and field length in bits in the MAC-PDU header?
question_48715.ground_truth: The maximum payload length is 32 bytes and is defined by a 5-bit length field in the MAC-PDU header.

question_48717.question: What is the AMR-WB+ codec's approach to the low-frequency and high-frequency signals?
question_48717.ground_truth: The AMR-WB+ codec uses a switched ACELP and transform coded excitation (TCX) for low-frequency signal encoding and decoding. For the high-frequency signal, a bandwidth extension (BWE) method is used to encode with fewer bits.

question_48719.question: What is the timing accuracy required for the normative reference in event reporting?
question_48719.ground_truth: The timing accuracy required for the normative reference in event reporting is 3GPP TS 36.133.

question_48720.question: What should the UE do upon transitioning from any cell selection state to the camped normally state in terms of logging?
question_48720.ground_truth: The UE should perform logging immediately upon transitioning.

question_48721.question: What aspects of network performance should KPIs in E-UTRAN/EPC evaluate?
question_48721.ground_truth: KPIs in E-UTRAN/EPC should evaluate accessibility, retainability, mobility, integrity, and usability of the network.

question_48722.question: What should the UE do if the SDP answer contains both the "b=RS:" and "b=RR:" attributes set to zero?
question_48722.ground_truth: The UE must not send RTCP packets and must consider RTCP to be disabled for the session, regardless of the values assigned to these attributes in the corresponding SDP offer.

question_48723.question: In the SFN-SFN Observed Time Difference scenario, what value does the Node B calculate each time it receives a new measurement result after point C in the measurement model?

question_48724.question: What benefits does the support of EGPRS Packet Access Enhancement provide in the context of R99 MS?
question_48724.ground_truth: The support of EGPRS Packet Access Enhancement for a R99 MS allows the use of EGPRS PACKET CHANNEL REQUEST for responding to Paging Request for TBF Establishment, improving the efficiency of data transmission.

question_48725.question: What is the required condition for sending an RRC message to release PSCell (Cell 2) during T3?
question_48725.ground_truth: The UE must have sent at least one CQI report with a non-zero CQI index for PSCell (Cell 2) during T3.

question_48727.question: When should the minimum adjustment rate of 233 ns/s be evaluated from?
question_48727.ground_truth: The minimum adjustment rate of 233 ns/s should be evaluated from the end of the RRC procedure delay until the UE has converged on the new reference cell.

question_48728.question: What is the type of id-MeasurementInitiationResult-List in the WTStatusResponse-IEs?
question_48728.ground_truth: The type of id-MeasurementInitiationResult-List is MeasurementInitiationResult-List.

question_48729.question: What state does the MCPTT client enter when the stored current call type is set to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL" and the MCPTT user accepts the call when MCPTT user acknowledgement is required or the MCPTT client sends GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message on expiry of timer TFG1?
question_48729.ground_truth: The MCPTT client enters "T1: in-progress emergency group call" state.

question_48730.question: How does the AMF determine the central NSACF in the 5GS only slices solution?
question_48730.ground_truth: The AMF determines the central NSACF by discovering the NSACF performing the PLMN global counting and updating the NF profile for the NSACF to indicate that it is the central NSACF for the S-NSSAI handling the PLMN global count for 5GS slices.

question_48731.question: What is the difference between "active antenna system base station" and "array element" in the provided definitions section?
question_48731.ground_truth: An active antenna system base station is a base station system combining an antenna array with a transceiver unit array and a radio distribution network. An array element, on the other hand, is a subdivision of a passive antenna array consisting of a single radiating element or a group of radiating elements with a fixed radiation pattern.

question_48734.question: What is the percentage of UEs transmitting above 23dBm for PC Set 4A and 4B based on the simulation results?
question_48734.ground_truth: The percentage of UEs transmitting above 23dBm is around 5 % for PC Set 4A and around 10 % for PC Set 4B.

question_48735.question: When does the MME check if the CSG Id of the serving cell belongs to the Allowed CSG List?
question_48735.ground_truth: The MME checks the CSG Id in the message containing the attach request, tracking area update request, or service request received from the Home eNodeB.

question_48736.question: What information does the NG-RAN node provide in the SECONDARY RAT DATA USAGE REPORT message?
question_48736.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node reports in the SECONDARY RAT DATA USAGE REPORT message location information of the UE in the User Location Information IE.

question_48738.question: What is the difference between frequency hopping and random RF input in BFI performance tests?
question_48738.ground_truth: Frequency hopping refers to the use of multiple channels for transmitting signals while random RF input refers to the use of a carrier modulated with random data as the input signal during the BFI performance test.

question_48739.question: What is the purpose of the LSA Identifier information element in the 3GPP TS 24.008 protocol?
question_48739.ground_truth: The LSA Identifier information element in the 3GPP TS 24.008 protocol uniquely identifies a LSA (Location Area).

question_48740.question: What should the MRFC do if it receives image sizes within an SDP body on the Mr interface and they are not all supported by the MRFP?
question_48740.ground_truth: The MRFC should only send the list of corresponding MRFP supported image sizes to the MRFP.

question_48742.question: What command type is used in the set up event list 8.3.1 for launching a browser if it is not already launched?

question_48743.question: What is a pre-condition for the procedure described in 7.4.2.5.2?
question_48743.ground_truth: A pre-condition for the procedure described in 7.4.2.5.2 is that MCData users on MCData clients 1 to n belong to the same group and are already registered for receiving MCData service and affiliated.

question_48745.question: What is the requirement for the BS transmitter supporting multiple-carrier transmission, including carrier aggregation, regarding the application of RF performance requirements at each antenna connector?
question_48745.ground_truth: The same principle as for single-carrier transmission should be adopted for multiple-carrier transmission, where the requirements apply at each antenna connector.

question_48746.question: What should the NAS do when a match is found during the evaluation of an access attempt in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode?
question_48746.ground_truth: The NAS should pass the access category for which there was a match to the lower layers. The access barring check is performed by the lower layers.

question_48747.question: What is the purpose of the variable Bj in the Logical Channel Prioritization procedure?
question_48747.ground_truth: The variable Bj is maintained for each logical channel j and initialized to zero when the logical channel is established. It incremented by the product of PBR and T (time elapsed since Bj was last incremented) before every instance of the LCP procedure.

question_48749.question: What information does the W-AGF send to the selected AMF during the initial registration process for the FN-RG?
question_48749.ground_truth: The W-AGF sends a Registration Request to the selected AMF within an N2 initial UE message that includes the NAS Registration Request, ULI, Establishment cause, UE context request, Allowed NSSAI, and Authenticated Indication.

question_48750.question: In what context is the MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message used?
question_48750.ground_truth: The MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message is used in the UE requested bearer resource modification procedure or the UE requested bearer resource allocation procedure.

question_48753.question: What is the definition of "Mapped 5QI" in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_48753.ground_truth: 5QI that is used for a DRB within the gNB when a single 5QI is assigned to the DRB, used for separating certain measurements per QoS class.

question_48754.question: How does the DS-TT maintain the Disabled, Initializing and Faulty state for the PTP ports?
question_48754.ground_truth: While in Disabled, Initializing or Faulty state, the port in the DS-TT discards any (g)PTP messages it may receive from the upstream PTP instance or from the NW-TT via user plane.

question_48755.question: What is the relationship between the NF management lifecycle and certificate management lifecycle that needs to be considered in the design of an automated certificate management for SBA?
question_48755.ground_truth: The NF management lifecycle and certificate management lifecycle need to be considered together in the design of an automated certificate management for SBA, because certificates are issued for NFs and their lifecycles have some relations.

question_48756.question: What is the formula for calculating the Uplink power control window size for NR CC?
question_48756.ground_truth: The Uplink power control window size for NR CC is calculated as 1dB (UE power step~size) + 0.7dB (UE power step tolerance) + (Test system relative power measurement uncertainty).

question_48759.question: What is the significance of the three digits in the version number of a 3GPP technical report?
question_48759.ground_truth: The first digit indicates the stage of approval of the document, the second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, and the third digit is incremented when only editorial changes have been made.

question_48760.question: What should the MS include in the GA-CSR CLASSMARK CHANGE message?
question_48760.ground_truth: The MS should include the IE "Mobile Classmark 2" in the GA-CSR CLASSMARK CHANGE message, and may also contain a IE "Mobile Classmark 3" depending on the MS capabilities.

question_48762.question: What is the maximum measurement reporting delay specified in the requirement?
question_48762.ground_truth: The maximum measurement reporting delay specified in the requirement is 7682 ms.

question_48764.question: What is the role of the ProSe Application Server in the non-roaming case?
question_48764.ground_truth: The ProSe Application Server allocates a Restricted ProSe App User ID for the ProSe Discovery UE ID, stores the binding between the ProSe Discovery UE ID and the Restricted ProSe App User ID, and returns the Restricted ProSe App User ID to the application client in the UE.

question_48767.question: What is the length of the sensing window used by a sensing UE to maintain a moving sensing window in the immediate past of which resources have been reserved by other UEs?
question_48767.ground_truth: The sensing window is 1000 ms long for FDD systems.

question_48768.question: What is the maximum allowed UL TX power for a UE to transmit any preamble?
question_48768.ground_truth: The absolute power of any preamble shall not exceed the maximum allowed UL TX power with more than what is specified in section 6.5.

question_48770.question: What operation is invoked on the application in case of a fault detected on the user interaction, such as a link failure to the IVR system?

question_48771.question: When will the number of bits allocated to each group be adjusted further based on the average envelope of the third group?
question_48771.ground_truth: The number of bits allocated to each group is adjusted further when the average envelope of the third group is more than 12.

question_48772.question: What message does the MS send to the network if it receives an incomplete RRLP MEASURE POSITION REQUEST?
question_48772.ground_truth: The MS sends an RRLP PROTOCOL ERROR message to the network.

question_48773.question: What does the <Group regroup alias length> value represent in the MBMS notifications control message?
question_48773.ground_truth: The <Group regroup alias length> value is a binary value indicating the length in octets of the <Group regroup alias> value item except padding.

question_48776.question: What is the purpose of the group regroup request and response in the group management information flow?
question_48776.ground_truth: The group regroup request is used to describe the information flow from the group management client to the group management server for temporarily combining several MC service groups, and the group regroup response is used to describe the information flow from the group management server to the group management client indicating success or failure of the request.

question_48777.question: What is the test requirement for the number of missed ACK/NACKs during T3 for Test 1 and Test 2?
question_48777.ground_truth: For Test 1, at least 98.75% of all expected ACK/NACKs during T3 shall be transmitted by the ProSe UE. For Test 2, at least 97.5% of all expected ACK/NACKs during T3 shall be transmitted by the ProSe UE.

question_48778.question: In what scenarios is the 1st downlink data detected for an Idle-Mode UE by SGW-U?
question_48778.ground_truth: When SGW-U receives the downlink packet but no S1-bearer for transmission, and buffering is performed by SGW-U, it detects the 1st downlink data for an Idle-Mode UE. The detection is reported to SGW-C for the purpose of paging the UE, and the DSCP of the packet is also reported if instructed by SGW-C.

question_48779.question: What is the objective of the performance part of the eAAS WID?
question_48779.ground_truth: The objective of the performance part of the eAAS WID is to clarify which conducted BS demodulation requirements can be applied as radiated requirements for the OTA AAS BS and the methods for conformance testing of such requirements.

question_48780.question: What message does the eNodeB send to the UE when it decides to trigger an Inter RAT HO preparation towards a 2G/3G system?
question_48780.ground_truth: The eNodeB sends a RRC "HO to CS Request" message to the UE.

question_48781.question: What message does the SS send to establish a concurrent downlink GPRS TBF with the Extended Dynamic Allocation MAC mode?
question_48781.ground_truth: The SS sends a PACKET DOWNLINK ASSIGNMENT message to the MS to establish a concurrent downlink GPRS TBF with the Extended Dynamic Allocation MAC mode.

question_48782.question: What are the limiting factors for high speed performance for LTE system?
question_48782.ground_truth: The two major limiting factors for high speed performance for LTE system are Inter-carrier interference (ICI) caused by high speed and higher carrier frequency, and the receiver's capability to track Doppler shift with reasonable channel estimation performance.

question_48783.question: How many timeslots simultaneously should an MBMS capable mobile station be capable of receiving in different scenarios?
question_48783.ground_truth: (1) up to 4 timeslots simultaneously, if the MS must listen to the (P)BCCH and (P)CCCH, (2) up to 5 timeslots simultaneously, if PBCCH/PCCCH is mapped on one of the PDCHs, (3) up to 5 timeslots simultaneously, if system information and paging messages are transmitted on the PACCH of the MBMS radio bearer.

question_48785.question: What should the 5G-RG acting on behalf of the AUN3 device do when it receives an AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message containing an EAP-request message from the network?
question_48785.ground_truth: The 5G-RG acting on behalf of the AUN3 device should stop timer T3520, if running, and then provide the EAP-request message to the AUN3 device as normally.

question_48786.question: What should a UE do if it cannot comprehend a field value in an RRC message?
question_48786.ground_truth: If the UE cannot comprehend a field value in an RRC message, it should treat the message as if the field were absent and in accordance with clause 10.4 of TS 38.331.

question_48787.question: What action should the AS take if the CAT service provided by the AS serving the terminating UE needs to be rejected?
question_48787.ground_truth: The AS should include a P-Asserted-Identity header field containing the public user identity of the terminating user, remove the early-session SDP offer from the response, forward the SIP 18x response to the originating UE, and insert an early-session SDP answer with all media port numbers set to "0" before forwarding the SIP PRACK request if received.

question_48790.question: What does the acronym "IBCF" stand for, as per the document?
question_48790.ground_truth: IBCF stands for Interconnection Border Control Function.

question_48791.question: What does the GBR parameter in the SAE QoS profile correspond to?
question_48791.ground_truth: The GBR parameter in the SAE QoS profile corresponds to the Guaranteed Bit Rate applied to the SAE bearer, which is a bit rate of traffic per SAE bearer, consisting of two components: uplink and downlink. It only applies to GBR bearers.

question_48792.question: What is the maximum duration of the test for AoCC time related charging for MS originated call?
question_48792.ground_truth: The maximum duration of the test for AoCC time related charging for MS originated call is 30 minutes.

question_48794.question: What action does the MME/SGSN take when PS Data-Off is activated and an APN is removed from the list of exempted APNs?
question_48794.ground_truth: If an APN is removed from the list of exempted APNs, the MME/SGSN serving the UE releases the PDP contexts/PDN connections that are not targeting an APN in the list of exempted APNs as described above.

question_48796.question: How is the partly ciphered security mechanism used for initial uplink layer 3 NAS message of MO packet delivery in SA2's solutions?
question_48796.ground_truth: The partly ciphered security mechanism is used to carry small data packets in an encrypted IE of the new initial L3 message, and the network generates a key stream to decipher this partly ciphered initial layer 3 message.

question_48797.question: What is the battery life with transmission every 2 hours of 50B or 200B on 20mw GNSS power consumption of integrated architecture?
question_48797.ground_truth: Over 2 years battery life with transmission every 2hr of 50B, and over 10 years with transmission every day of 50B or 200B on 20mw GNSS power consumption of integrated architecture.

question_48798.question: What interaction takes place between the CP and UP function during the IP-CAN session termination procedure where TDF-C releases Sx session from TDF-U?
question_48798.ground_truth: The TDF-C releases the existing Sx session from the TDF-U during the IP-CAN session termination procedure.

question_48799.question: What should the mobile station do when timer T3192 expires after releasing a downlink TBF?
question_48799.ground_truth: The mobile station shall release the downlink TBF and return to packet idle mode if it is in half duplex mode and received an uplink assignment during the TBF release procedure, or return to dedicated mode if it is in dual transfer mode and has no ongoing uplink TBF.

question_48800.question: When does the network include a "force to standby" information element in GMM signalling procedures?
question_48800.ground_truth: The network includes the "force to standby" information element to indicate whether or not the READY timer should be stopped when returning to the GMM-REGISTERED state.

question_48801.question: What is the purpose of the test described?
question_48801.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described is to verify the successful call forwarding and the final state of the MS.

question_48802.question: What is the purpose of the tests in 9.2.5.1 and 9.2.5.2?
question_48802.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in 9.2.5.1 is to verify that FDD absolute RSRQ measurement accuracy in carrier aggregation is within the specified limits under AWGN propagation conditions, while the purpose of the test in 9.2.5.2 is to verify that FDD relative RSRQ measurement accuracy in carrier aggregation is within the specified limits under AWGN propagation conditions.

question_48805.question: What information must the Access Server (AS) exclude from the SDP answer if it has sent SDP answer in a reliable provisional response to the initial SIP INVITE request?
question_48805.ground_truth: The AS must exclude CAT related media descriptions from the SDP answer before forwarding the SDP answer to the terminating UE.

question_48806.question: What happens after the SCC AS performs a remote leg update towards the remote end?
question_48806.ground_truth: The remote end accepts the offer and selects the most preferred codec it can support.

question_48809.question: What is the role of a VLAN ID in the routing of Ethernet frames in a 5G system?
question_48809.ground_truth: The VLAN ID is used to determine if a broadcast frame should be forwarded to a specific UE or not.

question_48810.question: What should the MnF of performance assurance generate for the object instance of NRCellRelation MOI(s) referring to the neighboring gNB CU NF in the performance data file reporting service?
question_48810.ground_truth: The MnF of performance assurance generates the measurement for the object instance of NRCellRelation MOI(s) referring to the neighboring gNB CU NF in the performance data file reporting service.

question_48811.question: Which model in the 5G ProSe Direct Discovery category has the feature of an application-controlled extension?
question_48811.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe Direct Discovery Model A with application-controlled extension is the model in the 5G ProSe Direct Discovery category with this feature.

question_48812.question: How does the relay node detect a PDSCH transmission intended for it in a subframe?
question_48812.ground_truth: If the relay node receives a resource allocation that overlaps a PRB pair in which it detects a downlink assignment, it shall assume that there is a PDSCH transmission for it in the second slot of that PRB pair.

question_48814.question: What is the role of UE1 in step 6b?
question_48814.ground_truth: UE1 instigates the SLPP Location Information Transfer procedure among UEs 1 to n, and obtains sidelink location measurements in this step.

question_48816.question: What action does the P-GW take, when it decides to release the IPv4 address for deferred IPv4 addressing?
question_48816.ground_truth: The P-GW informs the accounting server about the deallocation of the IPv4 address by sending a RADIUS Accounting-Request Interim-Update without the Framed-IP-Address attribute.

question_48817.question: What is the purpose of the control channel in the TE-UE multiplexer?
question_48817.ground_truth: The control channel in the TE-UE multiplexer is used for exchanging management information, such as parameter negotiation, power saving control information, testing, flow control, close down, etc.

question_48818.question: What is the purpose of the "Response Request" information element?
question_48818.ground_truth: The presence of the "Response Request" information element indicates that a Handover Required Reject message is required by the BSS if the Handover Required message does not result in a handover.

question_48819.question: What type of issues are addressed in the document?
question_48819.ground_truth: The present document addresses the issues related to control plane signalling, security, numbering/naming/addressing, and user plane issues such as transport protocol, media and codecs.

question_48820.question: What is the role of the SAS in the WLAN positioning procedure?
question_48820.ground_truth: The SAS initiates the WLAN positioning procedure and calculates the UE position based on the measurements obtained from the UE.

question_48823.question: What is the test purpose for verifying the MS's first position estimate meets the Conformance requirement under GPS satellite signal conditions that represent ideal conditions?
question_48823.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify the MS's first position estimate meets the Conformance requirement under GPS satellite signal conditions that represent ideal conditions.

question_48824.question: What is the result if the base station fails to decode a Random Access Request message or an access collision occurs?
question_48824.ground_truth: If the base station fails to decode a Random Access Request message or an access collision occurs, then the base station is unable to provide a response for the MS.

question_48825.question: What is the intended use of the private message mechanism in HNBAP for non-standard use?
question_48825.ground_truth: The private message mechanism in HNBAP for non-standard use should be used for special operator- or vendor-specific features, not considered part of the basic functionality, or for research purposes such as evaluating new algorithms/features before standardization.

question_48826.question: What is the method used by the NEF to report the UP path management event notification to the AF?
question_48826.ground_truth: The Event Notification is used by the NEF to report the UP path management event notification from the SMF to the AF.

question_48827.question: What is the maximum overall delays measured allowed in the test case?
question_48827.ground_truth: The overall delays measured shall be less than a total of 2882 ms in this test case.

question_48828.question: What method is used to modify operator specific data in the UDR?
question_48828.ground_truth: The PATCH method is used to modify operator specific data in the UDR.

question_48829.question: What TS value is given by, k-Offset, in the determination of time and frequency pre-compensation for a BL/CE UE communicating over NTN?
question_48829.ground_truth: The value of k-Offset provided by higher layers, through the higher layer parameter k-Offset, is given by, k-Offset, in the determination of time and frequency pre-compensation for a BL/CE UE communicating over NTN.

question_48830.question: What is the role of the P-Asserted-Identity header in the AS's actions for early session model?
question_48830.ground_truth: The P-Asserted-Identity header is used in the SIP 183 (Session Progress) response to indicate the public user identity of the served user to the originating UE, unless privacy policy or restriction services prevent providing the public user identity.

question_48831.question: Which feature-list ID does the S6c application use?
question_48831.ground_truth: The S6c application uses the Feature-List-ID AVP value of 1.

question_48832.question: What specification defines the test tolerances used to relax the minimum requirements in the present specification?

question_48833.question: What will a UE without a valid USIM do in 5GMM-IDLE mode over 3GPP access when it needs to establish a PDU session for emergency services?
question_48833.ground_truth: The UE will perform registration procedure with 5GS registration type IE set to "emergency registration".

question_48834.question: What should the UE do if timer T302 expires or is stopped, and there is an Access Category for which T390 is not running?
question_48834.ground_truth: The UE should consider the barring for that Access Category to be alleviated.

question_48835.question: What does SACCH stand for in the context of GSM and UMTS?

question_48836.question: What is the role of the UPF as an anchor point in Intra-/Inter-RAT mobility?
question_48836.ground_truth: The UPF serves as an anchor point for Intra-RAT or Inter-RAT mobility, allowing seamless mobility between different Radio Access Technologies (RATs) while maintaining session continuity.

question_48838.question: What should the MRFC do when it receives an ACK request for a session?
question_48838.ground_truth: When the MRFC receives an ACK request for a session, this may be considered as an event to direct the MRFP to start the playing of a tone or announcement.

question_48840.question: What is the role of the Global Analysis Laboratory (GAL) in the EVS codec selection process?
question_48840.ground_truth: The Global Analysis Laboratory (GAL) is responsible for evaluating each candidate against the requirements in the Qualification Phase of the EVS codec selection process.

question_48841.question: What should the SEPP do when it receives an HTTP request from a NF with a request URI containing a telescopic FQDN and a 3gpp-Sbi-Target-apiRoot header?
question_48841.ground_truth: The SEPP should ignore the 3gpp-Sbi-Target-apiRoot header and route the request using the telescopic FQDN.

question_48843.question: What is the definition of VAMOS as per the 3GPP study item?
question_48843.ground_truth: VAMOS stands for Voice services over Adaptive Multi-user Channels on One Slot, and was specified as a Rel-9 feature to theoretically double the voice capacity of GERAN per BTS transceiver.

question_48844.question: What should a UE do if it detects a cell in a higher priority search but reselection has not occurred?
question_48844.ground_truth: The UE is not required to continuously measure the detected cell to evaluate the ongoing possibility of reselection.

question_48845.question: What protocol stack is used for the user plane of the PC5 interface in NR sidelink communication?
question_48845.ground_truth: The AS protocol stack for user plane in the PC5 interface consists of SDAP, PDCP, RLC and MAC sublayers, and the physical layer.

question_48846.question: What is the method for interworking between different networks in the context of IM sessions supporting telepresence?
question_48846.ground_truth: The network to network interface should pass the SIP/SDP messages containing CLUE channel establishment request. Otherwise, a normal session will be established instead.

question_48847.question: What action does the SNRM-S take when the sender of an HTTP POST request for network assisted QoS management initiation is not an authorized user?
question_48847.ground_truth: The SNRM-S responds with an HTTP 403 (Forbidden) response and avoids the rest of the steps.

question_48849.question: What information does the UAE server provide to the USS when providing a notification about a possible change of USS?
question_48849.ground_truth: The UAE server provides information about the UAV location from the 3GPP network and policies from the USS for multi-USS deployment.

question_48852.question: What is the condition for the calculation of beta c,C,j when AC,j is greater than 1?
question_48852.ground_truth: The condition is beta c,C,j <= 1 / AC,j

question_48853.question: What action does the IM-SSF take after receiving a "FurnishChargingInformation" operation in the "Waiting for Instructions" state?
question_48853.ground_truth: The IM-SSF creates the call record if necessary and writes the free-format information carried in the operation into the call record.

question_48855.question: What is the message content in 8.23.3.4.3?
question_48855.ground_truth: The message content is the same as in clause 8.23.1.4.3.

question_48856.question: What parameters does the UE or application supplier need to provide to indicate the information of the application using network slicing during testing?
question_48856.ground_truth: The UE or application supplier is recommended to provide the following parameters: the application's traffic descriptor, the corresponding application data, the UE's policy section management list, and the UE's policy part.

question_48857.question: What is the role of the UE in this process, and what actions does it take?
question_48857.ground_truth: The UE establishes redundant PDU sessions with the 5G network using updated URSP rules. This allows for the creation of redundant SEALDD traffic for increased reliability.

question_48858.question: What is the purpose of the Signalling Bearer(s) in the Transport Network User Plane?
question_48858.ground_truth: The Signalling Bearer(s) in the Transport Network User Plane are used for Application Protocol, and their control actions are considered Operations and Maintenance (O&M) actions.

question_48859.question: What should a recipient do when it receives out-of-sequence information elements in a message?
question_48859.ground_truth: If the recipient can't accept out-of-sequence information elements, it should regard the message as containing unexpected and/or missing information elements and follow the procedures of sub-clause 3.1.19.1 and/or 3.1.19.2.

question_48863.question: What is the guide for in-channel selectivity testing for a multi-carrier BS?
question_48863.ground_truth: Two simultaneous wanted signals, one at the lowest assigned channel frequency and one at the highest assigned channel frequency are chosen together with their corresponding in-channel interfering signals. This is to ensure that the currently specified single carrier requirements should be simultaneously fulfilled at the lowest and highest assigned E-UTRA channel frequency.

question_48864.question: What is the difference between active scanning and passive scanning in the context of the document?
question_48864.ground_truth: Active scanning is the capability of a WLAN UE to actively solicit support for a WSID by probing it, while passive scanning is the capability of a WLAN UE to look for the support for a specific WSID by listening to the WSIDs broadcast in the beacon signal.

question_48866.question: What is the size of the bitmap in octets in the Bitmap super-field, given by the value of the LENGTH field plus one?
question_48866.ground_truth: The size of the bitmap in octets in the Bitmap super-field is equal to the value of the LENGTH field plus one.

question_48868.question: How does data generation differ between model training and network-side model inference in beam management use cases?
question_48868.ground_truth: During model training, data can be generated by either the UE or gNB, while for network-side model inference, input data is generated by the UE and terminated at the gNB. For UE-side model inference, input data is internally available at the UE.

question_48872.question: What network elements in EPC send Charging Data Requests to the CDF?
question_48872.ground_truth: S-GW, ePDG, TWAG, P-GW, and MME

question_48873.question: What should be the value of the Freeze-M-TMSI flag in the PUA-Flags AVP when constructing a PurgeMS-Res message as a result of receiving a PUA command in step 8.4.2?
question_48873.ground_truth: The Freeze-M-TMSI flag in the PUA-Flags AVP should be present if a Freeze-M-TMSI indication was received within the PUA-Flags AVP within PUA.

question_48874.question: When a downlink control block encoded using CS-1 occurs in the first two TDMA frames of a given basic radio block period, in what radio block period should the mobile station transmit uplink data blocks if it receives the assigned USF in the first reduced radio block period of a given basic radio block period?
question_48874.ground_truth: The mobile station should transmit uplink data blocks in the second reduced radio block period starting in the same basic radio block period and continuing with the second reduced radio block period in the following basic radio block periods.

question_48875.question: What action should an MS supporting S1 mode take if the ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message contains no indication that ISR is activated?
question_48875.ground_truth: The MS shall set the TIN to "P-TMSI" and shall stop the periodic tracking area update timer T3412 or T3423, if running.

question_48878.question: What typically happens in a network if Assured Forwarding (AF) packet handling is used with too high values for Maximum Bandwidth Requirement (MBR) and Guaranteed Bandwidth Requirement (GBR)?
question_48878.ground_truth: Under-allocation typically happens if a network assigns too high MBR and GBR values and if the other networks assign MBR and GBR with lower values, leading to misalignment of both MBR and GBR between the different networks.

question_48882.question: For which test case is the testability still under analysis for bands other than n257, n258, n260, and n261?
question_48882.ground_truth: The testability is under analysis for 6.5A.3.3.4, 6.5A.3.3.5, 6.5A.3.3.6, and 6.5A.3.3.7.

question_48884.question: What are the two options for preventing or reducing uplink data loss after the EAS relocation in Solution #27?
question_48884.ground_truth: The two options for preventing or reducing uplink data loss after the EAS relocation in Solution #27 are: Option 2a - buffering the uplink packets for EC session in the target PSA UPF and relying on the application layer to notify the source EAS of the last uplink packet, and Option 2b - buffering the uplink packets for EC session in the target PSA UPF and using a temporary forwarding tunnel between the source and target PSA UPF to forward the packets towards the old EAS.

question_48885.question: What is the condition for the high layer in TS 38.331 signalling of smtc2 to be present?
question_48885.ground_truth: The high layer in TS 38.331 signalling of smtc2 is present when TSMTCperiod follows smtc2.

question_48886.question: What message does the source UTRAN (HSPA) send to the target SGSN when it decides to trigger a handover to GERAN for a 3GPP SRVCC UE?
question_48886.ground_truth: Relocation Required (Target ID, Source to Target Transparent Container, SRVCC Handover Indication) message.

question_48887.question: What is the function of the AC association Profile in the enhanced Discover T-EAS procedure?
question_48887.ground_truth: It includes information about an association between ACs on an UE and other ACs indicating that the use of a common EAS is required, and is used in the EAS discovery request to determine whether a common EAS is available for the associated ACs.

question_48888.question: What are the key considerations for satellite-based backhaul in cross-border coverage?
question_48888.ground_truth: The key considerations for satellite-based backhaul in cross-border coverage include ensuring the UE is using a core network of the country it is physically located in, enabling per-country, UE specific prohibition of satellite access, handling emergency calls, addressing Lawful Interception, and charging/tariff notifications.

question_48890.question: In potential solution #2 for URLLC type of network slice, what is the Performance of Network Slice (Pns) based on latency?
question_48890.ground_truth: The Performance of Network Slice (Pns) based on latency for URLLC type of network slice is the inverse of the end-to-end User Plane (UP) latency of the network slice.

question_48891.question: What should be included in the SRB Modified List IE for successfully modified SRBs with logical channel identities for the primary path, if CA based PDCP duplication is initiated for the concerned SRBs?
question_48891.ground_truth: The SRB Modified List IE should include effectively modified SRBs with logical channel identities for the primary path, if CA based PDCP duplication is initiated for the concerned SRBs.

question_48892.question: What is the purpose of the MBMS-SESSION-START-REQUEST PDU in the described network?
question_48892.ground_truth: The MBMS-SESSION-START-REQUEST PDU allows a SGSN to request a BSS to start an MBMS session.

question_48894.question: What mode is used in Solution 1.5 in the case where the serving UPF is relocated after events that may benefit from UPF relocation, leading to a newly allocated IP address/prefix for PDU session of IP Type, under the "make before break" model?
question_48894.ground_truth: SSC Mode 3 is used in Solution 1.5.

question_48895.question: In what direction does the requirement apply for the repeater?
question_48895.ground_truth: The requirement applies only to the down-link direction of the repeater.

question_48897.question: In what scenario should the UE initiate a PDU session modification procedure by sending a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message to delete the mapped EPS bearer context with 5GSM cause #44?
question_48897.ground_truth: When a packet filter consists of conflicting packet filter components that would render the packet filter ineffective, after sending the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMPLETE for the ongoing PDU session modification procedure.

question_48898.question: What standard specifies the format and procedure for exchanging JOSE protected messages over the N32 interface in 3GPP networks?

question_48901.question: What should the MRFC include in the SDP offer if the Arbitrary ROI feature is not supported?
