question_48901.ground_truth: If the MRFP does not support the Arbitrary ROI feature, the MRFC shall send the SDP offer without any Arbitrary ROI related SDP attributes within the SIP signalling.

question_48903.question: What is the outcome if all the EPS bearers of the UE have emergency ARP value and the new MME proceeds with the update location procedure and it fails?
question_48903.ground_truth: If all the EPS bearers of the UE have emergency ARP value, the new MME may skip the update location procedure and the TAU procedure will proceed, but if the update location procedure is initiated and it fails, the MME releases any local MME EPS Bearer contexts for this particular UE.

question_48904.question: What information can the RAN provide to the PSA UPF regarding congestion for a GBR QoS Flow?
question_48904.ground_truth: The RAN can provide congestion information for both uplink and downlink of a GBR QoS Flow to the PSA UPF.

question_48905.question: How long is the measurement period TMeasurement Period, GSM for 32 GSM carriers being measured?
question_48905.ground_truth: For a Measurement Gap Repetition Period (MGRP) of 80ms, Mgsm is equal to ceil (Ncarriers, GSM /20) where Ncarriers, GSM is the number of GSM carriers on which cells are being measured, so for 32 GSM carriers being measured, TMeasurement Period, GSM is 160ms.

question_48906.question: What is the action taken by the GGSN when the allocated IPv4 address is released?
question_48906.ground_truth: The GGSN informs the accounting server about the deallocation of the IPv4 address by sending Diameter Accounting-Request INTERIM-UPDATE without the Framed-IP-Address AVP.

question_48907.question: What does the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG RAN) focus on in the present document?
question_48907.ground_truth: The 3GPP TSG RAN focuses on establishing the TRP (Total Radiated Power) and TRS (Total Radiated Sensitivity) requirements for NR UEs operating on Range 1 Standalone and Range 1 Interworking operation with other radios.

question_48908.question: What is the role of the USIM in deriving additional keys in EPS AKA?
question_48908.ground_truth: When the AMF bit indicating additional key derivation is set to 1, the USIM derives e2mKEYSET from CK and IK for air interface security.

question_48909.question: What is the RLC-PDU size for the low MCS value in the MBMS bearer service?
question_48909.ground_truth: The RLC-PDU size for the low MCS value (MCS=9) in the MBMS bearer service is 501 bytes.

question_48910.question: What method should the NF Service Consumer use to retrieve an MBS distribution session in the MBSTF?
question_48910.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should use the HTTP GET method to retrieve an MBS distribution session in the MBSTF.

question_48912.question: What is the role of the IBCF (IMS-ALG) in the 3GPP network and what, if any, is its relationship to the media feature-tags?
question_48912.ground_truth: The IBCF (IMS-ALG) is a 3GPP network component responsible for the transparent processing of some presence or conference extensions. It does not have an explicit relationship to the media feature-tags, but it is mentioned as a component that may require further clarification in the context of 3GPP IMS-ALG transparency.

question_48913.question: What should the WLAN UE structure the "Supported PLMNs list for WLAN access" file as, and what should be the form of the "realm" in the "realm-list"?
question_48913.ground_truth: The WLAN UE should structure the "Supported PLMNs list for WLAN access" file as per the "realm-list" specified in IETF RFC 4284, and each "realm" in the "realm-list" should be of the form of a home network domain name as defined in subclause 14.2 of 3GPP TS 23.003.

question_48914.question: What is the role of the 3GPP management system in monitoring the KPIs of CSI resource part?
question_48914.ground_truth: The 3GPP management system monitors the KPIs of CSI resource part to evaluate SLA fulfilment and ensure that service requirements are met.

question_48917.question: Which message is used by IAB-MT to request the network to allocate IP addresses for the collocated IAB-DU or inform the network about IP addresses allocated to the collocated IAB-DU?

question_48918.question: What protocol should an SNRM-S use to generate a POST request message for MBMS bearer suspension reporting?
question_48918.ground_truth: The SNRM-S should use HTTP protocol, specifically an HTTP POST request, to send a message for MBMS bearer suspension reporting.

question_48919.question: What is the purpose of the reject (REJ) frame in the established error recovery mode?
question_48919.ground_truth: The reject (REJ) frame is used to request retransmission of I frames starting with the frame numbered N(R).

question_48921.question: What is the conformance requirement for the ME to support the SET UP MENU and MENU SELECTION commands?
question_48921.ground_truth: The ME must support the SET UP MENU command as defined in TS 31.111 clause 5, 6.4.8, 6.6.7, 6.8, 6.11, 8.6, 8.7, 8.2, 8.9, and 9.4. The ME must also support MENU SELECTION as defined in TS 31.111 clause 4.4, 5.2, 6.4.8, 6.9, 7.2, 8.7, and 8.10.

question_48924.question: What is the method for charging support for NSWO traffic for 3GPP UE and fixed devices in the BBF network?
question_48924.ground_truth: Offline and online charging is supported by the 3GPP and BBF domain based on existing capability supported by B reference point and IP edge with limitations based on AAA RADIUS/Diameter accounting in the BBF network.

question_48928.question: In the Multi-Representation VoD (MR-VoD) scenario, what is the effect on the ranking of a particular video clip if each of the versions associated with the video clip is requested with more or less equal probability?
question_48928.ground_truth: If a certain version of a video is cached, it is highly likely that all other versions need to be cached as well. Consequently, in order to attain the same cache-hit-ratio in the MR-VOD scenario as in the SR-VOD scenario, the cache should be able to store all N versions of the video instead of just one.

question_48929.question: What is the parameter <n> in 7.34 Enhanced closed user group used for?
question_48929.ground_truth: The parameter <n> in 7.34 Enhanced closed user group is used to set the CUG activation on a per call basis.

question_48932.question: Which NS lifecycle change notification is sent to NM to indicate the result of the NS update procedure?
question_48932.ground_truth: The "NFV_NS_LIFECYCLE_EVENT" with "NM:NS_UPDATE_COMP_EVT" event is sent to NM to indicate the result of the NS update procedure.

question_48933.question: How many active CP anchor nodes are there per UE and per gNB in the NG-RAN?
question_48933.ground_truth: There is one (active) CP anchor node per UE in the 5GC (AMF) and one (active) CP anchor per gNB in the NG-RAN (gNB-CU-CP).

question_48934.question: What action is triggered at the MeNB if the RLC Mode IE is included for an E-RAB within the E-RABs To Be Released List IE in the SGNB MODIFICATION REQUIRED message?
question_48934.ground_truth: The MeNB shall trigger PDCP data recovery if it receives the RLC Status IE in the SGNB MODIFICATION REQUIRED message and assumes that RLC has been reestablished at the en-gNB.

question_48936.question: What should the UE not do during T4 as specified in 7.3.60.5?
question_48936.ground_truth: The UE shall not conduct any NPUSCH transmission during T4.

question_48940.question: What is used for the functions of the data link control sublayer in Multiple frame acknowledged mode for V.120 interworking?
question_48940.ground_truth: The functions of the data link control sublayer are sending RNR or withholding update of the sequence state variable V(R)

question_48944.question: What is the action taken by the BSS when it receives a SABM(L3msg) message from the MS?
question_48944.ground_truth: Upon receiving a SABM(L3msg) message, the BSS sets up the layer 2 link and includes the mobile station identity and classmark information in the message.

question_48945.question: What network function does the NWDAF send an HTTP "201 Created" response to after retrieving fine granularity locations of UEs in step 4a-4b?

question_48946.question: What does the AF do after receiving the SMF id and other parameters from the UDM?
question_48946.ground_truth: The AF determines the PDU session used for the user plane connection between UE and AF.

question_48947.question: How can a passive attacker track the UE using cell level measurement reports in LTE?
question_48947.ground_truth: A passive attacker can track the UE's movements based on the cell level measurement reports and obtain more accurate location information than just using the information of current cell location.

question_48949.question: What are the two formats of RTP header extension used for piggybacking timestamps?
question_48949.ground_truth: The two formats are the one-byte and two-byte formats.

question_48950.question: What mode can the eNB receive and send small data on for Uu and S1-U interfaces?

question_48952.question: What should the UE do when it receives the rejected NSSAI with the rejection cause of "S-NSSAI not available in the current PLMN or SNPN"?
question_48952.ground_truth: The UE shall store the rejected S-NSSAI(s) and not attempt to use them in the current PLMN or SNPN until specified conditions are met.

question_48953.question: In clause 5.2.3.2.5, what is the definition and encoding for blvalue, nfinst, backupamfinst, nfset, nfservinst, and nfserviceset?
question_48953.ground_truth: The definition and encoding for these terms can be found in clause 5.2.3.2.5.

question_48956.question: What is the requirement for DTX observation in step 8b, 8c, and 8d?
question_48956.ground_truth: DTX should not be observed by the SS anywhere outside the specified subframes up to the end of T2 or T3, depending on the step.

question_48957.question: What network does the UE select when approaching Shanghai harbor?
question_48957.ground_truth: The UE selects the terrestrial network TerrB for connectivity when approaching Shanghai harbor.

question_48959.question: What are the three main components of the Intent-driven MnS?
question_48959.ground_truth: The three main components are MnS component type A, MnS component type B, and MnS component type C, representing operations, the model of intent, and performance and fault information related to the intent, respectively.

question_48960.question: What should be included in the co-existence studies for the 2nd and 3rd harmonics and IMD products?
question_48960.ground_truth: The co-existence studies should include the 2nd and 3rd harmonics and IMD products caused in the BS by transmitting the specified CA combination, derived from the constituent 2DL and 3DL CA fall-back modes.

question_48962.question: What is the role of the VAE application layer in Solution #3 of the QoS monitoring and control for eV2X communications?
question_48962.ground_truth: The VAE application layer adapts based on the adapted service and QoS requirements in Solution #3 of the QoS monitoring and control for eV2X communications.

question_48964.question: What is the consideration for networks in disaster areas to support Public Warning System (PWS) and PWS Security?
question_48964.ground_truth: There are several considerations for networks in disaster areas to support PWS and PWS Security, including the availability of a Connection to a regular CBE, and the presence of a Local CBE function to sign warning messages that can be verified with a public key available to the UE. If there is no local CBE or if its public key cannot be distributed, then all warning messages may need to be discarded or the risk of an attack creating panic through false warning messages may have to be accepted.

question_48965.question: What is the minimum and maximum test duration for the SS in the test procedure?
question_48965.ground_truth: The minimum test duration is 6 minutes for GSM700, GSM850, GSM900 and 3 minutes for DCS1800, PCS1900. The maximum test duration is 20 minutes for all mentioned bands.

question_48966.question: What is the role of the beamforming block in a BFTD UE transmitter?
question_48966.ground_truth: The beamforming block in a BFTD UE transmitter is responsible for selecting beamforming weights, which are used to adjust the amplitude and phase offset between the two transmit paths, and may belong to a finite quantized set.

question_48967.question: What is the function of Cell B in the UE's network selection process?
question_48967.ground_truth: Cell B broadcasts the PLMN identifiers of the participating operators, allowing the UE to recognize its Home operator and potentially reselect to its HPLMN.

question_48968.question: What information should the AMF provide in the InitialRANUEContextSetup type of the xIRI message to the NG-RAN when requesting the setup of the UE context?
question_48968.ground_truth: The InitialRANUEContextSetup type contains information such as the target NSSAI, RAT selection priority, user authorization, and 5G-ProSe authorization.

question_48969.question: What should the I-CSCF include in the P-User-Database header field upon receiving a request from a UE that includes the Redirect-Host AVP value?
question_48969.ground_truth: The I-CSCF should include the received Redirect-Host AVP value in the P-User-Database header field.

question_48971.question: What type of packet-oriented services can be restricted by the "Barring of all Packet Oriented Services" option?
question_48971.ground_truth: All packet-oriented services can be restricted with this option.

question_48972.question: What triggers the "Availability after DDN failure" notification to the SCS/AS?
question_48972.ground_truth: Each notification is triggered by a downlink data discard (DDN) failure, i.e., when the SCS/AS sends a downlink packet which is discarded by Serving GW, and the UE is unreachable.

question_48974.question: What type of information element is the NAS security algorithms?
question_48974.ground_truth: The NAS security algorithms is a type 3 information element with a length of 2 octets.

question_48975.question: How does the UE determine the absolute priorities of different E-UTRAN frequencies or inter-RAT frequencies?
question_48975.ground_truth: The UE determines the absolute priorities of different E-UTRAN frequencies or inter-RAT frequencies from the system information, RRCConnectionRelease message, or by inheriting from another RAT at inter-RAT (re)selection. If priorities are provided in dedicated signalling, the UE shall ignore all the priorities provided in system information.

question_48976.question: What should the MME and SGSN consider when making use of the Notification procedure, particularly for emergency-attached unauthenticated UEs?
question_48976.ground_truth: The MME or SGSN shall not use the Notification procedure for emergency-attached unauthenticated UEs. For authenticated UEs using emergency services, the MME should make use of the Notification procedure to inform the HSS about the PDN-GW selected to establish emergency PDN connections.

question_48977.question: What is the role of the PCF (Policy Control Function) in the 5GC network?
question_48977.ground_truth: The PCF is responsible for creating PCC (Policy and Charging Control) rules for PDU sessions based on the SFC classification role of the PSA (Policy and Charging Function) UPF and other information.

question_48978.question: What is the delay indication specific to data traffic channels for Tra0?
question_48978.ground_truth: The delay indication specific to data traffic channels for Tra0 is the time required for buffering in the IWF and TA in the transmit direction for asynchronous-to-synchronous conversion and overspeed/underspeed detection and correction.

question_48979.question: What is the minimum period for evaluating the maximum adjustment rate in any 200ms period?
question_48979.ground_truth: The minimum period for evaluating the maximum adjustment rate in any 200ms period is 200ms.

question_48980.question: From the perspective of basic performance gain over non-AI/ML benchmark, what is one CSI feedback enhancement aspect that has not been studied in Rel-18?

question_48981.question: What should the UE include in the MEASUREMENT REPORT when it is not able to calculate a position?
question_48981.ground_truth: The UE should include IE "UE positioning error" in the MEASUREMENT REPORT and set the contents of this IE as specified in subclause 8.6.7.19.5 when it is not able to calculate a position.

question_48982.question: What is the test method specified for evaluating the RF common mode performance of equipment and ancillary equipment in the frequency range of 0.15 MHz to 80 MHz?
question_48982.ground_truth: The test method specified is IEC 61000-4-6.

question_48986.question: When should the UE include the P-Preferred-Identity header field in an emergency call?
question_48986.ground_truth: If defined by the access technology specific annex, the UE should populate the P-Preferred-Identity header field in the INVITE request with an equipment identifier as a SIP URI in an emergency call.

question_48988.question: What functionality does the MCData notification server provide in MCData service?
question_48988.ground_truth: The MCData notification server provides the centralized notification function in the network to inform the recipient about the data delivery progress in MCData service.

question_48989.question: What is the role of the AMF/MME in determining the future periodic registration timer/TAU timer for UEs with no mobility in Solution 9?
question_48989.ground_truth: The AMF/MME determines the future periodic registration timer/TAU timer based on the UE location and the satellite coverage information for UEs with no mobility.

question_48991.question: What are the key namespaces defined in WSDL?
question_48991.ground_truth: The key namespaces defined in WSDL are XML Schema namespaces for data type definitions, shared fault namespaces, WSDL interface namespace for Web Service interface definitions, WSDL schema local interface namespace for XML Schema definitions contained in the WSDL interface definition, and WSDL binding namespace for service bindings definitions.

question_48992.question: What should the MME do if it receives an SGs Paging message while SMS activities are ongoing and a power saving mechanism is being used by the UE?
question_48992.ground_truth: The MME may include the Maximum UE Availability Time IE in the SGs AP UE-Activity-Indication message to indicate the time until which the UE is expected to be reachable.

question_48995.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe Restricted Direct Discovery monitoring authorization policy?
question_48995.ground_truth: The ProSe Restricted Direct Discovery monitoring authorization policy specifies the PLMNs in which the UE is authorized to perform ProSe Restricted Direct Discovery monitoring.

question_48997.question: What should a UE do if not all metrics related to the provided thresholds can be acquired for a WLAN BSS?
question_48997.ground_truth: If not all metrics can be acquired for a WLAN BSS, the UE shall exclude that WLAN BSS from the evaluation of the rule.

question_48999.question: What is the unit for UE throughput in kbit per second?
question_48999.ground_truth: Each measurement for UE throughput is a real value representing the throughput in kbit per second, with the number of measurements being equal to one. If optional QoS level subcounters, S-NSSAI subcounters, PLMN ID subcounters, and BWP subcounters are performed, the number of measurements is equal to the number of mapped 5QIs, supported S-NSSAIs, PLMN IDs, and Active BWPs.

question_49000.question: What is the basis for Alternative 3 in terms of IM-SMS interworking?
question_49000.ground_truth: Alternative 3 is based on service level interworking from IM to SM on the terminating side, where the IP-SM-GW will not perform SMS router functionality.

question_49001.question: What should the IWF do when it originates a prearranged group session for an LMR user, and the user is not affiliated to the group and this is an authorized request for originating a priority call?
question_49001.ground_truth: The IWF shall determine the public service identity of the controlling MCPTT function associated with the group identity of the group on which the call is to be originated.

question_49003.question: What message does the source SN send to the MN when it initiates the conditional SN change procedure?
question_49003.ground_truth: The source SN sends an "SgNB Change Required" message to the MN when it initiates the conditional SN change procedure.

question_49004.question: What is the resource unit size for the control channel in NR?
question_49004.ground_truth: In frequency-domain, a PRB (or a multiple of PRBs) is the resource unit size (may or may not including DM-RS) for control channel.

question_49005.question: What message does the MTC-IWF send to the SCS after receiving a device trigger from the SCS?
question_49005.ground_truth: The MTC-IWF sends a Device Trigger Report (External Identifier or MSISDN and trigger reference number) message to the SCS with a cause value indicating the trigger delivery outcome.

question_49006.question: What technique is used to increase uplink capacity for CIoT devices?
question_49006.ground_truth: An overlaid CDMA technique is used to increase uplink capacity for CIoT devices, allowing multiplexing of multiple users simultaneously on the same physical channel.

question_49007.question: What is the maximum field strength authorized for WMTS stations in the 608-614 MHz band?
question_49007.ground_truth: The maximum field strength authorized for WMTS stations in the 608-614 MHz band is 200 mV/m (10.8 dBm/120 kHz EIRP).

question_49009.question: What should a MS do if it receives a SERVICE REJECT message without integrity protection with a certain GMM cause value and the timer T3247 is not running?
question_49009.ground_truth: If the MS receives a SERVICE REJECT message without integrity protection with a GMM cause value of #3, #6, #7, #8, #11, #12, #13, or #15 before the network has activated the integrity protection for the PS domain and the timer T3247 is not running, the MS shall start timer T3247 with a random value and then proceed as specified in items 6, 7, 8, 9, and 10 above.

question_49011.question: How can duplicate delivery of CC be suppressed in the generation and delivery of xCC?
question_49011.ground_truth: Duplicate delivery of CC can be suppressed by implementing measures to prevent multiple deliveries of the same data packet, such as using unique identifiers for each packet and storing their delivery status.

question_49012.question: What is the process outlined in Solution 2 for MME failure by reattachment with HSS interaction?
question_49012.ground_truth: The SGW maintains S5/S8 bearers after detecting MME restart, and when it receives downlink data packets, it sends an enhanced Downlink Data Notification message including IMSI to the associated MME. The MME then checks for UE registration and pages UE if necessary.

question_49013.question: In step 9, what does the H-SMF send to H-PCF in the SM Policy Control Create message, if dynamic PCC is to be used for the MA PDU Session, in the context of home-routed roaming and the UE registered to different PLMNs over both access?
question_49013.ground_truth: The H-SMF sends an "MA PDU Network-Upgrade Allowed" indication and ATSSS Capabilities of the MA PDU session to H-PCF.

question_49014.question: When will the SGW send a Modify Bearer Request message on the S5/S8 interface?
question_49014.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a Modify Bearer Request message that includes the Secondary RAT Usage Data Report from the MME, the SGW shall send a Modify Bearer Request message on the S5/S8 interface if the IRPGW flag is set to 1 in the Secondary RAT Usage Data Report IE.

question_49015.question: What is the role of the SEALDD client in downlink traffic when using MSGin5G services?
question_49015.ground_truth: The SEALDD client is responsible for delivering the MSGin5G message to the VAL client or providing the content in the payload of the message to the VAL client with SEALDD API, upon receiving the MSGin5G message from the SEALDD server.

question_49016.question: When will the UE not send any event triggered measurement reports?
question_49016.ground_truth: The UE will not send any event triggered measurement reports as long as no reporting criteria are fulfilled.

question_49017.question: How does 3GPP TS 22.182 handle the Connected Number in calls?
question_49017.ground_truth: The Connected Number and other related information are sent in the backward direction to the calling party as received from the called party, and are not impacted by the CAT service.

question_49018.question: What is the requirement for determining frame erasure events for SACCH testing in 14.20.8.4.2?
question_49018.ground_truth: The SS determines the frame erasure events during at least the minimum number of samples of SACCH frames.

question_49020.question: What is the procedure followed for the handling of FQC information in the downlink path?
question_49020.ground_truth: In the downlink path, a CRC is added if necessary to the frame payload and passed together with the FQC. If the payload stems from a transcoding unit of the NAS within the CN, the FQC is always set to "frame good". In the SRNC, a CRC-check is made, and a decision is made whether to deliver the frame or not based on the consistency of the Iu UP frame and the FQC value.

question_49021.question: What is the maximum power level allowed for the GPRS MS in the band 935 MHz to 960 MHz under normal conditions as defined in 3GPP TS 45.005, subclause 4.2.1?
question_49021.ground_truth: The maximum power level allowed for the GPRS MS in the band 935 MHz to 960 MHz under normal conditions is -79 dBm.

question_49022.question: What is the role of the NWDAF in predicting the achieved LCS QoS in the future time?
question_49022.ground_truth: The NWDAF can predict the achieved LCS QoS in the future time by interfacing with the GMLC/AMF to obtain location information using the LCS procedures.

question_49023.question: What is the requirement for service switching in a PIN?
question_49023.ground_truth: The requirement is to support a mechanism for service switching in a PIN between different PIN applications, for achieving better service experience.

question_49025.question: What should the UE do when it receives 5GMM cause #78 from a non-satellite NG-RAN cell?
question_49025.ground_truth: The UE sets the 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes specific information, resets the registration attempt counter, stores the PLMN identity in the list of "PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location", starts a corresponding timer instance, and enters the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH.

question_49027.question: What does the Serving MLC entity do in the context of CAMEL network?
question_49027.ground_truth: The Serving MLC entity performs location information retrieval in the CAMEL network.

question_49028.question: What component receives a message when a new call that matches the event criteria arrives in the pre-paid service application?
question_49028.ground_truth: The object implementing the IpCallControlManager receives the message when a new call that matches the event criteria arrives in the pre-paid service application.

question_49029.question: What is the purpose of the frequency gap between sub-blocks?
question_49029.ground_truth: The frequency gap between sub-blocks is used for co-existence in un-coordinated operation.

question_49032.question: What is the minimum requirement for the receiver's ability to receive the test signal in high speed train conditions with a BLER not exceeding the specified limit?
question_49032.ground_truth: The minimum requirement is specified in TS 25.104, clause 8.5A.2.

question_49033.question: What message does the RAN return to the SGSN in a Location Report message when it has obtained a location estimate that satisfies the requested accuracy?
question_49033.ground_truth: The RAN returns a Location Report message to the SGSN with an indication that the obtained location estimate satisfies the requested accuracy, carrying the location estimate that was obtained.

question_49034.question: What is the AVP Header type for the MIP-Home-Agent-Address in 3GPP AAA protocol?
question_49034.ground_truth: The AVP Header type for the MIP-Home-Agent-Address is 279.

question_49035.question: In Test 2, what is the requirement for the overall delay measured when DRX cycle length is 1280 ms?
question_49035.ground_truth: The overall delay measured when DRX cycle length is 1280 ms shall be less than a total of 26882 ms.

question_49036.question: What should the controlling MCPTT function include in the SIP INVITE request when inviting a user to an MCPTT session?
question_49036.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function shall include the <mcptt-request-uri> element set to the MCPTT ID of the terminating user and the <mcptt-calling-group-id> element set to the group identity in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body in the outgoing SIP INVITE request.

question_49037.question: What is the function of ADRF in storing AI/ML models?
question_49037.ground_truth: ADRF is being enhanced to store AI/ML models so that they can be distributed and shared among network functions (NFs).

question_49038.question: What is the distribution of a frame size in TR 38.838?
question_49038.ground_truth: The size of a frame is determined by the given data rates and frame rates, which is modelled as a random variable following truncated Gaussian distribution.

question_49039.question: What happens in step 1 of the service flow for enhancing on-network group communication service mode?
question_49039.ground_truth: After initial disaster, an emergency message delivery service based on on-network group communication among train driver, customer service staff, or train operations staff is preceded without any problem.

question_49040.question: What is the purpose of the P-Charging-Vector header field in the initial INVITE request?
question_49040.ground_truth: The P-CSCF-vA1 adds the P-Charging-Vector header field containing a new ICID value in the "icid" header field parameter and an "orig-ioi" header field parameter. The IOI value is of type 1 and identifies the visited network vA (i.e. visited-a).

question_49043.question: What can be explicitly specified by the consumer in the context of Area of Interest?
question_49043.ground_truth: The area of interest can be explicitly specified by the consumer for the NWDAF to request the same area capability from MDAF or MDA MnS producer, i.e. be capable to produce analytics in the specified area.

question_49045.question: What action should the initiating UE take when it receives a PROSE PATH SWITCHING REQUEST message during an ongoing path switching procedure?
question_49045.ground_truth: The initiating UE should stop the ongoing procedure and wait for an implementation-dependent time for initiating a new PROSE PATH SWITCHING REQUEST towards the target UE, if still needed.

question_49046.question: What protocols does the FT IRP support for file transfer?
question_49046.ground_truth: The FT IRP supports the use of FTP and SFTP protocols for file transfer between the IRP Manager and IRP Agent.

question_49047.question: What is one of the benefits of the solution for supporting multiple PRAs per IP-CAN session in a dynamic manner without using Location Change Reporting procedure?
question_49047.ground_truth: One of the benefits is that MME ID becomes part of the UE's MM Context, allowing MME to report PRA changes to PCRF during S1-based handover and UE triggered Service Request procedures more efficiently.

question_49049.question: What is the "orig-ioi" header field parameter in the P-Charging-Vector header field in the SIP REGISTER request message?
question_49049.ground_truth: The "orig-ioi" header field parameter in the P-Charging-Vector header field in the SIP REGISTER request message is used to identify the source network in the charging scenarios.

question_49050.question: What is the maximum occupied bandwidth allowed for the transmitter in section 11.1.1.2.1?
question_49050.ground_truth: The maximum occupied bandwidth allowed for the transmitter in section 11.1.1.2.1 is less than 10 MHz.

question_49051.question: What feature is added into the URSP regarding PINE specific guidance by AF?
question_49051.ground_truth: A new Traffic Descriptor component, "Source descriptors", is added into the URSP to uniquely identify the PINE or PIN generating the traffic.

question_49055.question: What procedure should the UE perform before sending a SDS OFF-NETWORK MESSAGE message with a disposition request type of DELIVERY?
question_49055.ground_truth: The UE should send a SDS OFF-NETWORK MESSAGE message and initiate counter CFS1 (SDS retransmission) to 1 and start timer TFS1 (SDS retransmission) when the MCDATA User requests to send a standalone one-to-one SDS message with a disposition request type of DELIVERY.

question_49056.question: What is the note in the EATF's implementation-dependant equipment identifier correlation?
question_49056.ground_truth: The method for correlation of the call legs at the EATF if SIP or ISUP does not provide this information is implementation dependant.

question_49058.question: What are the parameters that should be recorded in the antenna measurement system?
question_49058.ground_truth: The distance between the measurement and reference antennas, cable losses and other losses associated with the measurement setup, the power of the signal source at the reference antenna connector, and the noise level of the receiver with no signal applied.

question_49060.question: How does the UE associate an UL user data packet with a QFI in the PDU session?
question_49060.ground_truth: The UE shall attempt to associate the UL user data packet with the QFI of a signalled QoS rule associated with the PDU session which has a set of packet filters containing a packet filter for UL direction matching or containing a packet filter for both UL and DL directions matching the UL user data packet, or with the QFI of a derived QoS rule which has the packet filter for UL direction matching the UL user data packet.

question_49061.question: What is the minimum number of error events required for an early decision in this test?
question_49061.ground_truth: For an early pass decision, 1 or more (inclusive artificial error) error events are necessary, while for an early fail decision, 7 or more error events are required.

question_49063.question: What action should a UE take if the maximum number of preamble transmission counter has been reached for the random access procedure on PCell or PSCell?
question_49063.ground_truth: The UE should indicate a random access problem to upper layers.

question_49064.question: What architecture related requirements were focused on in TS 23.180?
question_49064.ground_truth: The functional architecture, procedures, and information flows to support MC services in the IOPS mode of operation were addressed in TS 23.180. The requirements were focused on the case of a backhaul failure between the radio access network (RAN) and the macro Evolved Packet Core (EPC).

question_49065.question: What is the effect of receiving TFO when not provisioned in thenetwork?
question_49065.ground_truth: When a normal call is handed over between two parts of a network, and the new part is provisioned with TFO, the call will switch to TFO if appropriate. However, if the new part is not provisioned with TFO, the call will revert to normal operation.

question_49066.question: What is the goal of the "Retrieve UE Information function" (5.22)?
question_49066.ground_truth: The "Retrieve UE Information function" enables the NG-RAN node to request UE information (e.g. QoS differentiation information) from the AMF before the setup of the NG connection for NB-IoT UE(s) using Control Plane CIoT 5GS Optimization.

question_49068.question: What action can the PCRF take to ensure that an MCPTT session is prioritized if it receives the MCPTT-Identifier AVP?
question_49068.ground_truth: The PCRF may take specific actions on the corresponding IP-CAN to ensure that the MCPTT session is prioritized if it receives the MCPTT-Identifier AVP.

question_49069.question: What is the channel raster for all bands in UTRA/FDD?
question_49069.ground_truth: The channel raster is 200 kHz for all bands.

question_49070.question: What is the purpose of the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay in 3GPP systems?
question_49070.ground_truth: The 5G Prose UE-to-Network Relay is a 5G ProSe-enabled UE that provides functionality to support connectivity to the network for 5G ProSe Remote UE(s).

question_49072.question: What is the purpose of the procedure for trunk originated dialled services?
question_49072.ground_truth: The purpose of this procedure is to detect a call set-up request at the point where the called party number has been compared with the stored network service numbers, and allow the CSE to modify the handling of the call set-up request. The PLMN should suspend call processing, make contact with the CSE, and await further instructions from the CSE.

question_49073.question: What are the default and alternative connectivity options used for EN-DC and NGEN-DC testing?
question_49073.ground_truth: The default connectivity option used for EN-DC and NGEN-DC testing is EN-DC, and the alternative option is NGEN-DC, which can be used if a UE does not support EN-DC.

question_49074.question: What is the recommended format for the MRFC and MRFP names?
question_49074.ground_truth: The recommended format for the MRFC and MRFP names is a fully qualified domain name, such as "MRFC1.whatever.net" or "mg1.whatever.net".

question_49075.question: What should be the 'fmt' portion set to in the "m=" field of the media-level section for MCPTT speech in the SDP body for a private call in an off-network MCPTT session?
question_49075.ground_truth: The 'fmt' portion should be set to indicate RTP payload type numbers in the "m=" field of the media-level section for MCPTT speech in the SDP body for a private call in an off-network MCPTT session.

question_49077.question: What is the goal of the 3GPP study on support for 3GPP voice interworking with enterprise IP-PBX (VINE)?
question_49077.ground_truth: The study aims to provide use cases and requirements for interworking between 3GPP networks and Enterprise voice services while maintaining operator visibility, control, and security.

question_49080.question: What are the general requirements of the application architecture for enabling edge applications?
question_49080.ground_truth: The general requirements of the application architecture for enabling edge applications include application client portability, edge application server's portability, service differentiation, flexible deployment, and interworking with 3GPP network.

question_49081.question: What is the definition of EIRP accuracy in the context of an AAS BS?
question_49081.ground_truth: EIRP accuracy refers to the maximum deviation of the DUT (i.e. the AAS BS) to a declared performance requirement. The AAS base station EIRP accuracy requirement is determined by taking into account non-AAS base station EIRP accuracy and an estimate of the achievable accuracy by AAS BS.

question_49083.question: What is the requirement for simultaneous support of multiple service level trace instances in PLMN and UE?
question_49083.ground_truth: The requirement for simultaneous support of multiple service level trace instances in PLMN and UE is defined in SLT-OSR-1. This allows for several services initiated from the same UE to each have a Trace Recording Session Reference.

question_49084.question: In what circumstances does the UE shall not initiate an initial registration for emergency services over the current access, if the UE is already registered for emergency services over the non-current access?
question_49084.ground_truth: The UE shall not initiate an initial registration for emergency services over the current access, if the UE is already registered for emergency services over the non-current access, unless the initial registration has to be initiated to perform handover of an existing emergency PDU session from the non-current access to the current access.

question_49085.question: What is the significance of the UE initiating RRC Connection Resume procedure upon receiving RAN initiated paging?
question_49085.ground_truth: The UE initiating RRC Connection Resume procedure upon receiving RAN initiated paging indicates that the UE starts the process of establishing a connection with the network upon receiving a paging message.

question_49086.question: Which new RTCP feedback type has been introduced for DBI signaling in sub-clause 7.3.8?
question_49086.ground_truth: The new RTCP feedback type introduced for DBI signaling in sub-clause 7.3.8 is "3gpp-delay-budget".

question_49087.question: How many measurements should be used for filtering CPICH Ec/Io and CPICH RSCP of each measured intra-frequency cell?
question_49087.ground_truth: At least two measurements should be used for filtering CPICH Ec/Io and CPICH RSCP of each measured intra-frequency cell.

question_49088.question: What is the HTTP status code that indicates the deletion of an MBS User Data Ingest Session was successful?
question_49088.ground_truth: The HTTP status code that indicates the deletion of an MBS User Data Ingest Session was successful is 204 No Content.

question_49089.question: What is required for protecting IMS signalling between the UE and the P-CSCF?
question_49089.ground_truth: It is necessary to agree on shared keys provided by IMS AKA and a set of parameters specific to a protection method. The security mode setup is used to negotiate the SA parameters required for IPsec ESP with authentication and confidentiality.

question_49090.question: What should a UE do when it has been made to attempt Consultative Call Transfer?
question_49090.ground_truth: The UE should put the original called party on hold and set up a voice call with the transfer target and put them on hold, then send a REFER to the original called party.

question_49092.question: What is the condition for the presence of longFTNsupport in the CFU registration request?
question_49092.ground_truth: The condition for the presence of longFTNsupport in the CFU registration request is specified in 3GPP TS 23.082.

question_49093.question: What should be the basis for a GTP-C entity deciding whether to use the overload control feature?
question_49093.ground_truth: A GTP-C entity should decide whether to use the overload control feature based on operator's policy within the PLMN or across PLMN boundaries.

question_49095.question: What are the two organizations/SDOs that define broadcast TV service layer functionality?

question_49097.question: What is the procedure for an MSGin5G UE that initiates an MSGin5G message request?
question_49097.ground_truth: The Application Client in the UE sends a request to the MSGin5G Client for invoking the MSGin5G Client to send a new MSGin5G message to a recipient or to multiple recipients.

question_49099.question: What determines if the V2X UE is in the service area of VAE server 2 of V2X service provider B?
question_49099.ground_truth: The local service information corresponding to the service area of VAE server 2 is not available at VAE server 1, so the VAE server 1 sends a local service information request to VAE server 2, including the location of the V2X UE, to determine the local service information.

question_49101.question: What action will the UE take if it receives a PDU Session Modification Command with a Cause indicating a change of S-NSSAI and the same DN?
question_49101.ground_truth: The UE will change the S-NSSAI of the corresponding PDU session to the selected S-NSSAI in the PDU Session Modification Command, and may initiate the PDU Session Establishment procedure with the new S-NSSAI.

question_49102.question: What does the present document, 28.601, focus on in terms of network elements?
question_49102.ground_truth: The present document, 28.601, focuses on the definition of NRM IRP IOCs for management support of several nodes in the 3GPP system, such as WAG, PDG, 3GPP AAA, etc.

question_49105.question: How the modulation used in the burst is detected by the receiver?
question_49105.ground_truth: A predefined set of circular shifts of the TS symbol vector is performed to detect the modulation used in the burst.

question_49109.question: Which document defines the basic functions of the NM (Network Manager)?
question_49109.ground_truth: The basic functions of the NM are beyond the scope of the present document.

question_49110.question: How does the MC system use the MC user information in the interconnection scenario?
question_49110.ground_truth: The MC system uses the received MC user information to forward the communication/media to the correct MC system where the targeted MC service client resides.

question_49111.question: How many unicast messages are required for the default approach and communication approach 1 with a single transport key for any value of C?

question_49113.question: What is one of the PLMN selection considerations for manual PLMN selection in the event of a disaster condition?
question_49113.ground_truth: During manual PLMN selection, a mean is needed to indicate to the upper layers that some forbidden PLMNs support disaster roaming and to inform the user that these PLMNs are available for selection.

question_49114.question: What is the parameter specified in the "supportedCSI-RS-ResourceList-r18" field?
question_49114.ground_truth: The "supportedCSI-RS-ResourceList-r18" parameter specifies a list of supported CSI-RS resources for Rel-16-based doppler CSI.

question_49116.question: What action should the UE take when it returns to coverage in the UE network selection mode?
question_49116.ground_truth: When the UE returns to coverage in the UE network selection mode, the UE selects the highest priority OPLMN and RAT combination and attempts to attach on the selected cell and PLMN.

question_49118.question: What is the parameter that needs to be propagated throughout the system when the LAC changes due to a new power up?
question_49118.ground_truth: The HNB-GW will receive the new LAC (and thus SAI) during HNBAP HNB Register Request, and it may also need to forward an SABP Restart message from the HNB towards the CBC.

question_49120.question: What is the definition of a multi-band RIB in NR operation?
question_49120.ground_truth: A multi-band RIB is an operating band-specific RIB which is paired with one or more additional operating band-specific RIBs, where the multiple bands are supported through common active electronic component(s).

question_49121.question: What is the difference between UE-TMBR and UE-AMBR in 5G?
question_49121.ground_truth: UE-TMBR indicates the maximum overall bandwidth per UE, controlling the maximum bandwidth for the sum of both GBR and non-GBR traffic of the UE, while UE-AMBR indicates the maximum bandwidth per UE for the sum of both GBR and non-GBR traffic of the PDU Session.

question_49123.question: What should the UE do when it receives the rejected NSSAI with the rejection cause of "S-NSSAI not available due to maximum number of UEs reached" if the back-off timer value is zero?
question_49123.ground_truth: The UE does not consider the S-NSSAI as the rejected S-NSSAI, and starts the timer T3526 with an implementation-specific back-off timer value.

question_49124.question: What is the purpose of the "uac-BarringForAccessIdentity" in the PLMNs offering disaster roaming?
question_49124.ground_truth: The "uac-BarringForAccessIdentity" is used to indicate that a UE is allowed to select the PLMN when the UE has chosen the corresponding access identity and the barring factor is set to zero.

question_49126.question: What is the purpose of the test described in subclause 26.16.4, as derived from the test in subclause 26.12 and entitled "Structured procedures / MS terminated call / early assignment"?
question_49126.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the MS's ability to indicate and include in the mobile originating SETUP for speech call all the speech versions that it supports, and to initiate a normal channel assignment procedure after receiving an ASSIGNMENT COMMAND message using full rate version 3 or half rate version 3.

question_49127.question: What is the mode of the UE at the start of the test sequence described in 6.3.1.10?
question_49127.ground_truth: The UE is in Switched OFF mode at the start of the test sequence described in 6.3.1.10.

question_49128.question: What is used to characterize the penetration loss through the external wall, PLtw, in the O-to-I building penetration loss model?
question_49128.ground_truth: PLtw is characterized by an additional loss for non-perpendicular incidence and the penetration loss of material i.

question_49129.question: What is the purpose of the array of power samples measured in f)?
question_49129.ground_truth: The array of power samples is used to measure the access burst power/time relationship and is referenced in time to the center of the useful transmitted bits and in power to the 0 dB reference.

question_49130.question: What is the main difference between the Geographical Zones approach and the Virtual Cells Approach with Reduced Impacts?
question_49130.ground_truth: The Geographical Zones approach defines geographical zones with geographical borders that match operational or regulatory constraints of PLMNs, while the Virtual Cells Approach with Reduced Impacts is a variant of the Virtual Cells approach that has reduced impacts to a UE, NG-RAN, and 5GCN.

question_49131.question: What is a potential security requirement to address the issue of data location and lifecycle in virtualised 3GPP NFs?
question_49131.ground_truth: Solutions should increase assurance that sensitive information of a virtualised 3GPP NF is protected during its lifecycle process to avoid leakage of the information to other VNFs reusing the storage resource.

question_49132.question: What does the PDN GW do if it receives a detach indication message from the HSS/AAA for PMIP-based S8-S2a chaining?
question_49132.ground_truth: The PDN GW sends a Detach Indication message to the MAG in the Trusted Non-3GPP Access Network or ePDG to detach a specific UE.

question_49133.question: What steps are taken by the SGW-C and SGW-U during detach and bearer deactivation?
question_49133.ground_truth: The SGW-C sends an Sx Session Modification Request to the SGW-U, indicating SGW-U to stop counting uplink packets for the affected bearers and discard uplink packets received from eNodeB for the affected bearers. The SGW-U sends an Sx Session Modification Response to the SGW-C.

question_49134.question: When using NCTCRS, what is the comparison between the gains of NCTCRS and idealized dynamic small cell on/off?
question_49134.ground_truth: The gains of NCTCRS and idealized dynamic small cell on/off are comparable in most results.

question_49136.question: What URI formats can be used at the Ici in an IMS network?
question_49136.ground_truth: The following URI formats can be used at the Ici: SIP URI, tel URI, IM URI, and PRES URI. However, not all URI formats are required to be supported at the non-roaming or roaming II-NNI.

question_49137.question: What should be the value of the duration field in the Track Header Box ('tkhd')?
question_49137.ground_truth: The value of the duration field in the Track Header Box ('tkhd') shall be set to '0'.

question_49139.question: What is the use of the Security Indication IE in X2AP?
question_49139.ground_truth: The Security Indication IE in X2AP indicates the user plane integrity protection requirement for the corresponding E-RAB in an X2AP message.

question_49140.question: What triggers the NG-RAN to request location service when the UE is in CM CONNECTED mode?
question_49140.ground_truth: The NG-RAN detects the need to get accurate UE location.

question_49141.question: What is one of the issues to be addressed in the ProSe Direct Discovery procedure?
question_49141.ground_truth: Discovering other UE(s) in interested group(s) over the PC5 interface, where the group information can come from the application layer.

question_49142.question: What is the purpose of the Security-Server header field in the 401 (Unauthorized) response to a REGISTER request?
question_49142.ground_truth: The Security-Server header field in the 401 (Unauthorized) response to a REGISTER request contains the parameters required for the setup of the set of security associations. The UE should check the existence of the Security-Server header field in the 401 (Unauthorized) response and use the parameters received in the Security-Server header field to setup the temporary set of security associations.

question_49143.question: What is the maximum value of "PacketDRX" parameter defined as?
question_49143.ground_truth: The "PacketDRX" enumerated type is defined with the following values in the 3GPP TS 38.300 standard: v32, v64, v128, and v256. The maximum value of this type is v256.

question_49144.question: What should the eNodeB do after entering ECM-IDLE if Service Gap Control is being applied for the UE and the Service Gap timer is not already running?
question_49144.ground_truth: The Service Gap timer shall be started in the UE when entering ECM-IDLE, unless the connection was initiated as a response to paging of an MT event, after a TAU procedure without any active flag or signalling active flag set or after a TAU procedure for network access for regulatory prioritized services like Emergency services or exception reporting.

question_49147.question: What is the requirement for DTS activation when data service is congested in the 3GPP system?
question_49147.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall support a means for DTS activation when data service is congested at the request of the MPS Service User.

question_49148.question: What is the power level of the noise source (Noc) for all operating bands in FR1, as defined in Clause 4.4.3.2.2?
question_49148.ground_truth: A fixed Noc power level of -134 dBm/Hz is used for all operating bands in FR1.

question_49149.question: What information does the IPA Single Block Uplink Assignment struct contain regarding the uplink block assigned to multiple mobile stations in IMMEDIATE PACKET ASSIGNMENT message?
question_49149.ground_truth: The IPA Single Block Uplink Assignment struct contains the power control parameter setting, timing advance value, relative TBF starting time, frequency parameters, and a common timeslot number for all mobile stations addressed in this construction.

question_49151.question: What is the system-dependent delay for Tabisd?
question_49151.ground_truth: The system-dependent delay for Tabisd is the time required to transmit the 260 speech frame data bits over the 16 kbit/s A-bis-interface in the downlink direction.

question_49153.question: What is the recommended approach for providing the identity of the currently serving MME/SGSN to the PGW during existing S5/S8 signalling?
question_49153.ground_truth: It is recommended to provide the identity of the currently serving MME/SGSN to the PGW only during the existing S5/S8 signalling.

question_49154.question: Which method is defined for the Push mode in 5GS to protect the PCEF/TDF from overload?
question_49154.ground_truth: The notification push is defined for the Push mode in 5GS to protect the PCEF/TDF from overload, where the PFDF sends a request with notification flag to the PCEF/TDF, and then PCFE/TDF initiates separate pull requests to retrieve the PFDs for different application identifier(s) immediately or within the allowed-delay by considering the load of the PCEF/TDF.

question_49155.question: What are the three types of indicators defined in the current version of the specifications?
question_49155.ground_truth: The three types of indicators defined are Acquisition Indicator (AI), Page Indicator (PI), and MBMS Notification Indicator (NI).

question_49157.question: What is the purpose of a trust assertion in the context of MPS for an MMTEL voice or video call?
question_49157.ground_truth: The purpose of a trust assertion is to allow an originating network to send a trust assertion for the MPS priority markings and a receiving network to verify the assertion to determine whether it can trust the priority markings and admit the call with the priority markings.

question_49159.question: What should the UE do if the resumption occurs after release with redirect with mpsPriorityIndication?
question_49159.ground_truth: The UE should set the resumeCause to mps-PriorityAccess.

question_49160.question: What is the action taken by the gprsSSF postconditions when the gprsSSME FSM transits to the state "Non-call Associated Treatment"?
question_49160.ground_truth: The gprsSSME FSM sends a Return Result "ActivityTestGPRS" to the gsmSCF and closes the temporary TC dialogue.

question_49161.question: What is one of the outcomes of the dynamic EAS instantiation triggering procedure in Solution #32?
question_49161.ground_truth: One of the outcomes of the dynamic EAS instantiation triggering procedure is that the EES gets informed by an EAS registration procedure of the instantiated EAS with the EAS information (e.g. EAS profile).

question_49163.question: What must the NG-RAN node do if it fails to perform UE context update?
question_49163.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node shall respond with the UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION FAILURE message to the AMF with an appropriate cause value in the Cause IE.

question_49164.question: What is the meaning of Migration in the context of 3GPP Technical Specifications for Mission Critical systems?
question_49164.ground_truth: Migration is a means for an MCPTT user to obtain MCPTT service directly from a partner MCPTT system.

question_49166.question: What causes the target CN node to delete the session resources established during the handover preparation phase in SGW (SGW-C and SGW-U) or (SMF and UPF) when receiving a "Relocation Cancel" indication?
question_49166.ground_truth: Based on the Relocation Cancel Indication, the target CN node (MME or AMF) deletes the session resources established during handover preparation phase in SGW (SGW-C and SGW-U)/ (SMF and UPF).

question_49168.question: What is the purpose of the PDCCH Message Indication in reducing the amount of information the MS needs to receive upon wake-up when it is not paged?
question_49168.ground_truth: The PDCCH Message Indication minimizes the amount of information the MS needs to receive upon wake-up by broadcasting downlink message indication rather than paging message, allowing for network to send paging message, downlink assignment message or other kind of MAC control messages to MS in idle mode.

question_49169.question: What is the consequence of an error within a policy decision type and/or condition data not referred by any provisioned PCC or session rules?
question_49169.ground_truth: The error is encoded within the "policyDecFailureReports" attribute as specified in the PolicyDecisionFailureCode data structure.

question_49170.question: When scheduling PSSCH by means of DCI format 5 or 5A, what information is transmitted about the resource block assignment for PUSCH?
question_49170.ground_truth: The resource block assignment for PUSCH is transmitted by means of +5 bits or +6 bits, which provide the resource allocation within the narrowband using UL resource allocation type 0 for DCI format 5, and UL resource allocation type 5 for DCI format 5A.

question_49171.question: What is the recommended approach for initiators to handle media ports in IMS?
question_49171.ground_truth: The recommended approach is for initiators to offer one plaintext media port and one port for protected content.

question_49173.question: What is a 5G VN group communication and what does the SMF do to support it?
question_49173.ground_truth: A 5G VN group communication is a virtual data network capable of supporting 5G LAN-type service over the 5G system. The SMF embeds the CTF to generate 5G VN group communication charging information towards the CHF based on the user plane architecture.

question_49174.question: What is the maximum number of inter-frequency and inter-RAT neighboring cells that can be included in the measResultNeighCells, if available?
question_49174.ground_truth: 6 intra-frequency and 3 inter-frequency neighbors per frequency and 3 inter-RAT neighbors per frequency/set of frequencies per RAT

question_49175.question: Which parameter represents the EarlySyncInformation-List type in the F1AP protocol?

question_49176.question: What should be supported for PWS-UEs or ePWS-UEs that provide maritime communication services?
question_49176.ground_truth: Requirements specified in 3GPP TS 22.268 shall be supported for PWS-UEs or ePWS-UEs that provide maritime communication services.

question_49177.question: Which section of TS 24.379 specifies the requirements for an idle MCPTT client when it receives a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message for an imminent peril group call when MCPTT user acknowledgement is not required?

question_49179.question: What is the objective of mobility optimization in the context of the document?
question_49179.ground_truth: The objective of mobility optimization is to dynamically improve the UE (User Equipment) handover performance by minimizing the call drops, RLFs (Radio Link Failures), unnecessary handovers, and ping-pong, so as to improve end-user experience and increase network capacity.

question_49180.question: What is the role of the UDM/UDR in the multicast authorization revocation process?
question_49180.ground_truth: The UDM/UDR notifies the (MB-)SMF when the authorization for a UE to join the multicast service/application is revoked, and includes the multicast session ID and UE identifier in the notification.

question_49181.question: What is the role of the UE in the public key verification process in the LTE system?
question_49181.ground_truth: The UE verifies the signature of the warning messages using the latest public key and signature algorithm. If it fails to do so and has the optional next public key and key ID, it will try to verify the signature with the next public key.

question_49182.question: What should the MC gateway UE do when it receives an indication that RAN has suspended the MBMS bearer?
question_49182.ground_truth: The MC gateway UE should detect the MBMS suspension and send an MC GW MBMS suspension indication to the MC Client residing on non-3GPP device.

question_49183.question: What is Sol#9's proposal for handling Non-IP traffic in UE-to-UE relay connections?
question_49183.ground_truth: Sol#9 proposes using the identity information of UE in the Adaptation Layer for data forwarding between Source UE and Target UE, supporting both non-IP and IP traffic.

question_49184.question: What is the result of the P-CSCF not providing ICE support when a NAT traversal mechanism is provided towards the UE?
question_49184.ground_truth: When the P-CSCF provides a NAT traversal mechanism towards the UE, it will not provide ICE support towards the UE, but can still provide ICE support towards the core network in scenarios where ICE is used in the core network.

question_49185.question: What should the participating MCVideo function include in the SIP MESSAGE request when sending a MuSiK download message?
question_49185.ground_truth: When sending a MuSiK download message, the participating MCVideo function should include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-mbms-usage-info+xml MIME body with either an <mbms-explicitMuSiK-download> element or an <mbms-defaultMuSiK-download> element, and the corresponding <group> elements associated with the MuSiK being downloaded.

question_49186.question: What data type is "adStartNSSAIList" defined as?

question_49187.question: How are the elements of the complex basic midamble code derived from its binary representation?
question_49187.ground_truth: The elements of the complex basic midamble code are derived from its binary representation by taking the real and imaginary parts alternately.

question_49188.question: What are the three possible values for the "subcarrierSpacing" attribute in the provided schema, as specified in 3GPP TS 36.211?
question_49188.ground_truth: The three possible values for the "subcarrierSpacing" attribute in the provided schema, as specified in 3GPP TS 36.211, are 1.25, 7.5, and 15.

question_49189.question: What is the role of the MCVideo server in processing a group call request from MCVideo client 1?
question_49189.ground_truth: The MCVideo server checks if the user of MCVideo client 1 is authorized to initiate a group call for the selected group, resolves the MCVideo group ID to determine the members of that group and their affiliation status, and sends the group call request to the other affiliated members.

question_49190.question: How much attenuation is required for an interferer in the adjacent channel spectrum and interferers elsewhere in the SMR band?
question_49190.ground_truth: For an interferer in the adjacent channel spectrum, an additional 39 dB of protection is required, while interferers elsewhere in the SMR band will only require an additional 30 dB of protection.

question_49192.question: What are the two alternatives for the evaluation of Option 2: Set B is variable for AI/ML model inputs?
question_49192.ground_truth: Alt 1: Explicit information of Tx beam ID and/or Rx beam ID, Alt 2: Tx beam ID and/or Rx beam ID is used as explicit inputs of AI/ML.

question_49193.question: What is the difference in UE location information provided to PCRF when S2c and S2b-GTP are used?
question_49193.ground_truth: When S2c is used, PCRF receives UE location information from the PDN GW via Gx reference point, which is the CoA. When S2b-GTP is used, PCRF receives UE local IP address as UE location information from the ePDG via Gxb* reference point.

question_49194.question: What information is provided by the Media Session Handler at API invocation in step 3b?
question_49194.ground_truth: The Flow Description is provided by the Media Session Handler at API invocation in step 3b.

question_49195.question: What is one of the ways to generate viewport-dependent video bitstreams for the multi-stream approach?
question_49195.ground_truth: Using viewport-dependent projection or mapping, such as a truncated pyramid or a cubic projection with a viewport-dependent mapping/packing.

question_49197.question: What is the action taken by the BBERF in case of a PDN disconnection, mobility to other access, or termination of a pre-registration at the BBERF in clause~4.4.4.1?
question_49197.ground_truth: The BBERF is requested to terminate its gateway control session, and it sends a Diameter CCR message to the H-PCRF to indicate the gateway control session termination.

question_49199.question: Which RABs are required to provide CBS via the signalling RB (CTCH) on SCCPCH in the provided combinations?
question_49199.ground_truth: SRB for PCCH, SRB for CCCH, and SRBs for DCCH are required to provide CBS via the signalling RB (CTCH) on SCCPCH.

question_49200.question: What action will the PCF take if monitoring time and subsequent threshold value are used for a Monitoring key and monitoring is to be continued for that Monitoring key?
question_49200.ground_truth: The PCF shall provide new threshold value(s) in the response to the SMF and also provide the monitoring time value.

question_49202.question: What is the procedure for generating a transmission quality measurement report in the context of SEALDD servers?
question_49202.ground_truth: The S-SEALDD server can generate a transmission quality measurement report based on the SEALDD enabled transmission quality measurement procedure (defined in clause 9.7.2.1) and assess whether the current transmission quality matches the QoS requirements of the VAL application.

question_49204.question: What is the purpose of this test?
question_49204.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify the reception of DPCH in a UE while downlink is in a compressed mode. The UE needs to preserve the BLER using sufficient low DL power. It is also verified that UE applies the Delta SIR values, which are signalled from network, in its outer loop power control algorithm.

question_49208.question: What is the role of the GERAN Location System Control Function (LSCF)?
question_49208.ground_truth: The GERAN Location System Control Function (LSCF) is responsible for coordinating location requests and managing call-related and non-call-related location requests in the GERAN system. It also insulates the Location clients in the Core Network from the detailed operation of the location method, and records LCS usage data for the location service request.

question_49209.question: What is the purpose of the SAD flag in the DTX/CNG operation?
question_49209.ground_truth: The purpose of the SAD flag in the DTX/CNG operation is to indicate whether the input signal is active (= 1) or merely background noise (= 0).

question_49210.question: What is the maximum duration of the test procedure 53.1.2.16.3?
question_49210.ground_truth: The maximum duration of the test procedure 53.1.2.16.3 is 30 minutes.

question_49211.question: How is TC6a constructed for the maximum Base Station RF Bandwidth?
question_49211.ground_truth: TC6a is constructed by placing a single UTRA carrier in the middle of the maximum Base Station RF Bandwidth, which may be shifted maximum 100 kHz to align with the channel raster.

question_49212.question: What happens when UE-2 accepts the role of Collaborative Session Controller UE and the transfer of Media Flow-A in steps 3a-4a?
question_49212.ground_truth: The SCC AS performs Remote Leg Update procedure towards the remote party.

question_49213.question: How many identified cells must a UE be capable of performing SS-RSRP, SS-RSRQ, and SS-SINR measurements for intra-frequency layers in FR1 during a layer 1 measurement period?
question_49213.ground_truth: UE shall be capable of performing measurements for at least 8 identified cells during a layer 1 measurement period.

question_49215.question: What are the three open issues mentioned related to the provision of QoS information for the Edge Application Server?
question_49215.ground_truth: The three open issues are whether QoS information can be exposed to the Edge Application Server, whether to differentiate QoS requirements for the same type of Edge Application Servers, and whether to define policy rules for certain Edge Application Servers.

question_49216.question: What is the procedure for upgrading an MCPTT group call to an imminent peril group call?
question_49216.ground_truth: The procedure involves the MCPTT user at MCPTT client 1 initiating an imminent peril call, sending an MCPTT imminent peril group call request to the MCPTT server, the MCPTT server adjusting the priority of the underlying bearer, and sending the imminent peril group call request towards the MCPTT clients of the affiliated MCPTT group members. The receiving MCPTT clients send an MCPTT imminent peril group call response to the MCPTT server to acknowledge the upgrade request.

question_49217.question: What should the UE 3GPP PS Data Off status "active" mean for the SMF when a handover from one access-system to another occurs?
question_49217.ground_truth: The downlink and optionally uplink traffic for services not belonging to the list(s) of 3GPP PS Data Off Exempt Services is only prevented via the 3GPP access.

question_49218.question: What is the difference between the 'Otherrealm' and 'Visitedrealm' in the Decorated NAI?
question_49218.ground_truth: 'Otherrealm' is the realm built using the PLMN ID (visitedMCC + visitedMNC) if the service provider selected as a result of the service provider selection has a PLMN ID, while 'Visitedrealm' is a domain name of a service provider if the selected service provider does not have a PLMN ID.

question_49219.question: What is the definition of power control dynamic range in 6.4.3.1?
question_49219.ground_truth: The power control dynamic range is the difference between the maximum and the minimum code domain power of one power controlled code channel for a specified reference condition.

question_49220.question: What is the state of the UE after the preamble in the test case?
question_49220.ground_truth: The UE is in the 'switched-off' state after the preamble in the test case.

question_49221.question: What should the network do when the mobile reachable timer expires in Iu mode and ISR is not activated?
question_49221.ground_truth: The network may start the implicit detach timer with a network-dependent value, and if the implicit detach timer expires before the MS contacts the network, the network shall implicitly detach the MS.

question_49222.question: What is the purpose of the grace time in "Graceful termination of services" before a PCRF failure?
question_49222.ground_truth: The grace time in "Graceful termination of services" before a PCRF failure is used to revoke the termination of services once successful restoration of state has been achieved.

question_49223.question: What enhancements should be considered to support the pagination downloading mechanism for NF profile sub-items?
question_49223.ground_truth: Following enhancements should be considered: indicating paginated data retrieval feature support in NF Discovery request, checking if the requesting NF supports paginated data retrieval feature and if at least one NF profile sub-item has large volume of content, keeping the detected NF profile sub-item with empty content, indicating a special pagination reference for retrieving the content of the NF profile sub-item and sending NF Discovery response with paginatedDataReference IE that carries the original resource URI of the NF profile sub-item, paginated-data-retrieval URL, total pages of the NF profile sub-item, and page size.

question_49224.question: What is the expected sequence of frames for the SS and MS when sending and receiving preamble and EOP in phase D of the fax transmission?
question_49224.ground_truth: The expected sequence is: SS sends preamble and EOP, FA enters BCS-TRA state and conveys EOP to fax machine, fax answers with MCF frame, FA enters BCS-REC state, transmits BCS-REC identifier, and conveys MCF* frame to SS, then FA enters IDLE state.

question_49226.question: What message does the SS send in option 1, after a delay of 8 seconds, to request positioning measurements by the MS, using the same reference number and extended reference IE as the first one?
question_49226.ground_truth: The SS sends the second RRLP MEASURE POSITION REQUEST with the same REFERENCE NUMBER and the same EXTENDED REFERENCE IE as the first one.

question_49228.question: What is the role of an SS (server) in UE positioning test cases in 3GPP TS 37.571-2?
question_49228.ground_truth: The SS (server) is responsible for supplying assistance data to the UE during the test cases in 3GPP TS 37.571-2.

question_49229.question: What does it mean when a MCIM is in the "Activated" state?
question_49229.ground_truth: An instance of the MCIM is authorized for operational use.

question_49231.question: What is the procedure to be followed by the UE when there are no WLANs selected and the ANDSF rules control the WLAN access selection and traffic routing?
question_49231.ground_truth: The UE may repeat the procedure from step 1, taking into consideration selection criteria with lower priority from the active WLANSP rule.

question_49236.question: What are the ways for UPF to identify the PDU Set of a video frame?
question_49236.ground_truth: UPF can identify a video frame as a PDU Set using RTP header, such as the Marker (M) bit in the RTP timestamp, RTP header extension with S and E bits in the Frame Marking, or the periodicity via UPF.

question_49237.question: What is the difference between the "international" and "international-exHC" conditions in the communication barring service?
question_49237.ground_truth: The "international" condition allows barring of specific media when the request URI corresponds to a telephone number and does not point to a destination served by a network within the country where the originating user is located. The "international-exHC" condition also includes the condition that the destination should not be in the served user's home network.

question_49238.question: What is the service arrangement between TT Y and network operator S in the context of MCPTT?
question_49238.ground_truth: TT Y has a service arrangement with network operator S for MCPTT services.

question_49239.question: What represents the collection of individual File Distributions in the VAE server?
question_49239.ground_truth: The resource "File Distributions" represents the collection of individual File Distributions in the VAE server.

question_49241.question: Which 3GPP document provides the details of the XML schema for the E-UTRAN Network Resources IRP NRM?
question_49241.ground_truth: Annex A of the present document, also known as TS 32.762 V9.5.x, provides the details of the XML schema for the E-UTRAN Network Resources IRP NRM.

question_49242.question: What modifications are necessary for the lower sub-band transmission to support Band 27?
question_49242.ground_truth: Modifications are required for operating band unwanted emissions and additional spurious emission requirements.

question_49243.question: What is the purpose of the "Barring for media combined with call routing, alternative 2" sequence in 3GPP TS 29.198-4?
question_49243.ground_truth: The "Barring for media combined with call routing, alternative 2" sequence illustrates how one application can influence both the call routing and the media establishment of one call, separating media establishment and call establishment as two separately triggered applications.

question_49244.question: What is one of the modes of operation for the list of AlarmInformation instances in AlarmList?
question_49244.ground_truth: The list of AlarmInformation instances in AlarmList can be returned synchronously or via notifications in asynchronous mode of operation.

question_49245.question: What is the maximum time limit for a long timer in CAP?

question_49247.question: What happens to the measurement period when inter-frequency handover occurs while inter-frequency RSTD measurements are being performed?
question_49247.ground_truth: The RSTD measurement period is adjusted based on the number of times the inter-frequency handover occurs during the RSTD measurement period and the time during which the inter-frequency RSTD measurement may not be possible due to inter-frequency handover.

question_49250.question: What should the IWF set the "SGSN area restricted" flag to in the NOR-Flags AVP within a NOR command if an sgsnAreaRestricted indication was received within the UpdateGprsLocationArg?
question_49250.ground_truth: The IWF should set the "SGSN area restricted" flag to 1 in the NOR-Flags AVP within a NOR command if an sgsnAreaRestricted indication was received within the UpdateGprsLocationArg.
