question_49251.question: What is the use of the "Subsequent Authorized Session-AMBR / Subsequent Authorized default 5QI/ARP" provided by the PCF?
question_49251.ground_truth: These parameters are used to modify the QoS settings for a PCC rule at a specific time defined by the "Time Condition" parameter.

question_49253.question: What should the AMF do to avoid using the old GUAMI when allocating a 5G-GUTI for UEs?
question_49253.ground_truth: The AMF should not use the old GUAMI to allocate a 5G-GUTI for UEs that are being served by the Target AMF.

question_49255.question: What are the collaboration scenarios, deployment architectures, and potential open issues concerning network slicing extensions that are to be studied further in Release 18?
question_49255.ground_truth: The collaboration scenarios, deployment architectures, and potential open issues concerning network slicing extensions that are to be studied further in Release 18 include those related to media services delivered to end users using different network slices.

question_49256.question: What is one of the properties required for the SSMS system to support cooperative driving and intersection safety use cases?
question_49256.ground_truth: Low latency communication for precision positioning and control, significant data bandwidth would be needed for SSMS.

question_49257.question: What is the meaning of "RF" in the document title?

question_49259.question: What are the two lattices used in the RE8 lattice sub-bands?
question_49259.ground_truth: The two lattices used in the RE8 lattice sub-bands are the 8-dimensional lattice G and the lattice scaled by 2.

question_49260.question: What should be the maximum mean power received at the UE antenna port?
question_49260.ground_truth: It should not degrade the specified BER performance

question_49261.question: What does the callAborted() method indicate in the IpAppCallControlManager interface?
question_49261.ground_truth: The callAborted() method indicates to the application that the call object has aborted or terminated abnormally and no further communication will be possible between the call and the application.

question_49262.question: What is the frequency response of the output signal when the Eaac+ codec is used with stereo output at a bit rate of 18 kbps?
question_49262.ground_truth: The output is band limited to 12 kHz, and the output signal is attenuated in the frequency range 6 kHz to 12 kHz.

question_49263.question: What is the focus of Key Issue #8, which is related to the support of edge computing?
question_49263.ground_truth: Key Issue #8 is focused on whether the existing mechanisms specified in TS~23.501 can be reused for V2X purposes and whether any enhancements are needed to support specific needs for V2X, such as local routing to/from V2X Application Server(s) in a local DN close to NG-RAN.

question_49266.question: What is the significance of the three digits in the version number of a 3GPP technical specification?
question_49266.ground_truth: The first digit indicates the stage of the document (information, approval, or TSG approved), the second digit is incremented for changes of substance, and the third digit is incremented for editorial changes only.

question_49267.question: What are the requirements for the MCData client to discover the absolute URI of the media storage function, in accordance with TS 24.282, clause 10.2.1.3.2?
question_49267.ground_truth: The MCData client should build the SIP MESSAGE, include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body with the <request-type> element containing the value "msf-disc-req", and send the SIP MESSAGE towards the participating MCData function. The MCData client should follow the rules and procedures of 3GPP TS 24.229 for the SIP MESSAGE processing.

question_49269.question: What course of action should the UE take if there are syntactical errors in packet filters, such as two or more packet filters in the resultant TFT would have identical packet filter identifiers?
question_49269.ground_truth: The UE shall initiate a PDU session modification procedure by sending a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message to delete the mapped EPS bearer context with 5GSM cause #45 "syntactical errors in packet filter(s)".

question_49271.question: Which frequency band is considered for ITS operation in Europe?
question_49271.ground_truth: The 63-64 GHz frequency bands are allowed for ITS on a harmonized use basis in Europe, with a maximum radiated power of 40 dBm E.I.R.P.

question_49274.question: What is the difference in video quality between H.264/AVC and SVC streams in terms of PSNR after 67% and up to 95%~98% coverage area?
question_49274.ground_truth: The PSNR of SVC streams maintains 30.2 dB, while the H.264/AVC drops quickly to the minimum level.

question_49275.question: What procedure is used by the ProSe Function in the HPLMN to revoke authorization for ProSe Direct Discovery?
question_49275.ground_truth: The ProSe Direct Discovery Authorization Update Procedure is used by the ProSe Function in the HPLMN to revoke authorization for ProSe Direct Discovery.

question_49277.question: How is the Analytics Info message transferred between the UE and NWDAF?
question_49277.ground_truth: The NAS AnalyticsInfo request message can be an UL NAS Transport message and the NAS AnalyticsInfo Notify message can be a DL NAS Transport message.

question_49278.question: What initiates the LMU measurement updates, including the initial one, in the signalling process between RNC and stand-alone LMU?
question_49278.ground_truth: The update of LMU measurement is triggered by a LCS request from the client that is internal to UTRAN.

question_49279.question: Which German-based organization developed the QuaDRiGa channel model, which includes a collection of features from SCM(e) and WINNER channel models along with novel modelling approaches for quasi-deterministic multi-link tracking and Massive MIMO modelling?

question_49280.question: What are some of the functionalities provided by the Edge Application Server Discovery Function (EASDF) in 5G Edge Computing?
question_49280.ground_truth: EASDF provides functionalities such as DNS message handling, adding EDNS Client Subnet option, reporting information related to received DNS messages, buffering/discarding DNS messages, and providing a DNS response with a specific IP address for DNS queries in 5G Edge Computing.

question_49281.question: When is the dummy MSISDN value (all digits set to 0) required for the MSISDN in GSM/UMTS applications?
question_49281.ground_truth: The dummy MSISDN value is required when the MSISDN is not available in messages, for backward compatibility purposes.

question_49287.question: When does the TDF initiate the TDF session establishment procedure in case of unsolicited application reporting?
question_49287.ground_truth: The TDF initiates the TDF session establishment procedure in case of unsolicited application reporting when it detects the first application start for an IPv4 address or IPv6 address.

question_49288.question: What should the MS do upon receiving a CM SERVICE ACCEPT message in the test case "Outgoing call / U0.1 MM connection pending / CM service accepted"?
question_49288.ground_truth: The MS should send a SETUP message specifying the Called party BCD number and then enter CC state U1, "Call initiated".

question_49290.question: What is the maximum duration of the test performed for both channel modes of the multi-rate codec, i.e. full rate and half rate?
question_49290.ground_truth: The maximum duration of the test is 3 minutes.

question_49291.question: When will the MCVideo function reject the SIP REFER request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response?
question_49291.ground_truth: If the received SIP REFER request contains an application/resource-lists+xml MIME body with more than one <entry> element.

question_49295.question: Which message is used by an MME to request an eNodeB to report the current cell ID serving the UE?
question_49295.ground_truth: The MME sends a Location Reporting Control message to the eNodeB to request the eNodeB to report the current Cell ID serving the UE.

question_49296.question: What is the maximum allowed interruption duration when transitioning from non-DRX to DRX for PCell and the activated SCell in SCG, if PSCell is in non-DRX?

question_49297.question: What is the handling of a CC call if the called user B activates CFB after user A has activated CC on user B?
question_49297.ground_truth: A CC call from user A which encounters a busy condition at user B can either be treated as a CCBS or forwarded as a normal communication.

question_49300.question: What fault is returned to the application if the same device is indicated in both the ReferenceAddresses and the MonitoredAddresses in the StartDistanceNotificationRequest operation?
question_49300.ground_truth: A ServiceException (SVC0005: Duplicate correlator) will be returned.

question_49301.question: What is the purpose of the access priority bit in CIoT devices attempting to access the system autonomously on TN0 or TN1?
question_49301.ground_truth: The purpose of the access priority bit in CIoT devices is to indicate that the access attempt is to report a critical event such as an alarm, allowing the BSS to prioritize resource allocation for this user based on this information.

question_49304.question: What is the definition of Psharing factor in the context of SSB-based radio link monitoring?
question_49304.ground_truth: The Psharing factor is a value of 1 if the RLM-RS resource outside gap is not overlapped with the SSB symbols indicated by SSB-ToMeasure or ss-RSSI-Measurement, and 3 otherwise.

question_49305.question: What is one advantage of utilizing NWDAF to optimize connection management in Solution 22?
question_49305.ground_truth: One advantage is the ability to predict the time window in which the UE has or doesn't have UL/DL data transmission, allowing for more efficient network management.

question_49306.question: In what situation can the network initiate the release of the USF of a particular TBF?
question_49306.ground_truth: The network may initiate the release of the USF of a particular TBF by sending a PACKET UPLINK ACK/NACK message with the Final Ack Indicator set to '1'.

question_49307.question: What is the MAC level message name for ANBR in LTE access?
question_49307.ground_truth: The MAC level message name for ANBR in LTE access is "Recommended bit rate MAC Control Element".

question_49308.question: What should the MCData client insert in the SIP MESSAGE request for a targeted MCData user?
question_49308.ground_truth: The MCData client should insert an application/resource-lists+xml MIME body containing the MCData ID of the targeted MCData user in the SIP MESSAGE request.

question_49309.question: What does the CAMEL Capability Handling in GPRS-CSI indicate?
question_49309.ground_truth: CAMEL Capability Handling in GPRS-CSI indicates the CAMEL Phase that is required for the GPRS service.

question_49310.question: What should the UE do if it is in case o, and has pending user data for PDU sessions without active user-plane resources?
question_49310.ground_truth: The UE shall include the Uplink data status IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message indicating the PDU session(s) for which the UE has pending user data to be sent, and the PDU session(s) for which user-plane resources were active prior to receiving the fallback indication.

question_49312.question: Which message is sent by the en-gNB to the eNB to indicate that for any of the requested measurement objects the measurement cannot be initiated?

question_49315.question: Which four integer values are associated with 4.1.4 for the CS domain?
question_49315.ground_truth: The four integer values associated with 4.1.4 for the CS domain are RAB.AttModCS.Conv, RAB.AttModCS.Strm, RAB.AttModCS.Intact, and RAB.AttModCS.Bgrd.

question_49316.question: What assistance data IEs are available for use in each test for normal MS based testing?
question_49316.ground_truth: The Reference Time IE, GPS Reference Time Extension IE, Reference Location IE, Almanac IE, GPS Almanac Extension IE, Navigation Model IE, Acquisition Assistance IE, and GPS Acquisition Assistance Extension IE are available for use in each test for normal MS based testing.

question_49317.question: When the 5G SRVCC from NG-RAN to UTRAN occurs, what action is taken with regard to the UE's PDU sessions?
question_49317.ground_truth: After the 5G SRVCC to UTRAN, all the PDU sessions of the UE are released.

question_49318.question: What is the purpose of VR Metrics in the context of a 3GPP VR Presentation?
question_49318.ground_truth: VR Metrics is a functionality where the client collects specific quality-related metrics during a session and reports them back to a network side node for further analysis. This is an extension of the QoE metrics concept in 3GP-DASH to cover VR-specific metrics.

question_49319.question: What is the method of placing a call on hold in this test procedure?
question_49319.ground_truth: A call is placed on hold by sending a HOLD message and entering auxiliary state "hold request" in this test procedure.

question_49320.question: What should the VAL server include in the HTTP POST request message when requesting unicast resources or modifying already allocated unicast resources for VAL communications?
question_49320.ground_truth: The VAL server should include a Request-URI set to the URI corresponding to the identity of the SNRM-S, an Accept header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.seal-unicast-info+xml", a Content-Type header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.seal-unicast-info +xml", and an application/vnd.3gpp.seal-unicast-info+xml MIME body with an <adaptation> element in the <unicast-info> root element.

question_49321.question: What is the user plane protocol defined for the Iu and Nb interface on the forward bearer establishment?
question_49321.ground_truth: The Iu/Nb UP Protocol is defined for the user plane protocol for the Iu and Nb interface on the forward bearer establishment.

question_49322.question: What steps should an application take to manage the storage of collected files?
question_49322.ground_truth: The application should define a local directory locationPath on the device, where successfully collected files will be copied/moved before making the file available to the application. It should also select a value for the parameter registrationValidityDuration to constrain the amount of storage the MBMS client will use.

question_49323.question: What is the purpose of the Tunnelling of non-GSM Signalling Messages Function (A/Gb mode)?
question_49323.ground_truth: The Tunnelling of non-GSM Signalling Messages Function (A/Gb mode) is used to tunnel messages between the MS and the SGSN using the TOM protocol and the LLC unacknowledged mode procedures. It uses two LLC SAPs for communication between the MS and the SGSN; one for high-priority messages and one for low-priority messages. A network that supports TIA/EIA-136 shall support the TOM protocol and the Gs interface.

question_49324.question: How is the main and screenshare video indicated in an SDP offer for MMCMH?
question_49324.ground_truth: The main video is indicated by the "a=content:main" under the "m=" line, and the screenshare video is indicated as a separate SDP video "m=" line, identified by "a=content:slides" under that "m=" line.

question_49325.question: What is the participating MCVideo function required to do upon receiving a SIP BYE request from the controlling MCVideo function?
question_49325.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function shall interact with the media plane for releasing media plane resources associated with the SIP session with the controlling MCVideo function, shall generate a SIP BYE request, shall include a P-Asserted-Identity header field in the outgoing SIP BYE request, if the received SIP BYE request contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body, shall copy it into the outgoing SIP BYE request, and shall send the SIP BYE request to the MCVideo client.

question_49327.question: What should the UE do if the T3346 timer is running and it is not in the 5GMM-CONNECTED mode or has not received a paging or NOTIFICATION message?
question_49327.ground_truth: The UE should stay in the current serving cell and apply the normal cell reselection process.

question_49330.question: What must occur for an xIRI containing a PTCInstantPersonalAlert record to be created in a PTC server?
question_49330.ground_truth: The IRI-POI present in the PTC server generates an xIRI containing a PTCInstantPersonalAlert record when the IRI-POI present in the PTC server detects that an Instant Personal Alert (IPA) (i.e. a request for one participant to initiate a one-to-one PTC session) is initiated by or sent to the PTC target.

question_49331.question: What should the MRFC do if it receives the SDP answer with the SDP "a=bw-info" attribute(s)?
question_49331.ground_truth: If the MRFC receives the SDP answer with the SDP "a=bw-info" attribute(s), it shall include for the selected payload type the "Additional Bandwidth Properties" information element in the remote descriptor indicating the media bandwidth range for rate adaptation.

question_49332.question: In what scenarios is the Origination-Id header field applicable?
question_49332.ground_truth: The Origination-Id header field is applicable when a node has performed attestation of an identity in an incoming request, or when a border node has performed gateway attestation of the request itself.

question_49334.question: What is the relationship between OTA sensitivity and OTA REFSENS in terms of performance level?
question_49334.ground_truth: OTA sensitivity is intended to meet or exceed the performance level of OTA REFSENS.

question_49335.question: When should the list of "allowed tracking areas" and the list of "non-allowed tracking areas" be erased?
question_49335.ground_truth: The lists should be erased when the UE is switched off, or when the UICC containing the USIM is removed or updated.

question_49336.question: In the 6.5.2.1 application plane description, what is the role of the group management server functional entity?
question_49336.ground_truth: The group management server functional entity provides management of groups supported within the MCPTT service provider.

question_49337.question: What does the IP layer handle in the context of Trusted Non-3GPP IP Access FA user plane?
question_49337.ground_truth: The IP layer handles termination of the UE-FA link-local protocols (e.g. ARP messages) and forwarding of user plane IP packets between the UE-FA point-to-point logical link and the S2a tunnel for the UE in the context of Trusted Non-3GPP IP Access FA user plane.

question_49338.question: In what scenarios should the MME include the nonceMME and nonceUE when creating a mapped EPS security context?
question_49338.ground_truth: The MME includes both the nonceMME and the nonceUE when creating a mapped EPS security context during inter-system change from A/Gb mode to S1 mode or Iu mode to S1 mode in EMM-IDLE mode.

question_49340.question: What functionality would an MME need to support for the solution of returning a last known location for a UE that is unavailable?
question_49340.ground_truth: When receiving an MT-LR location request indicating "current or last known location" for a UE that is unavailable, the MME would need to send a request to an E-SMLC with the last known cell ID and a new flag indicating a request for a last known location. The MME would also need to indicate a last known location when returning an MT-LR location response to the GMLC.

question_49342.question: What is the default value of Trs in the equation for calculating the time interval for a frequency handover?
question_49342.ground_truth: The default value of Trs in the equation for calculating the time interval for a frequency handover is 5ms.

question_49344.question: What is the objective of Energy Efficiency KPI of URLLC Network Slice based on its Reliability in Key Issue #6?
question_49344.ground_truth: The objective is to assess the Energy Efficiency (EE) KPI of a URLLC network slice based on its reliability to provide a more comprehensive and useful energy efficiency KPI, as reliability is an integral part of URLLC slice performance.

question_49345.question: What should the 5G system be able to do in order to support enhanced timing resiliency?
question_49345.ground_truth: The 5G system should be able to collaborate with different types of time sources, such as GNSS, TBS/MBS, and Sync over Fiber, to provide robust time synchronization. It should also maintain accurate time synchronization during degradation or loss of the primary timing reference and support mechanisms to monitor for timing source failure, detect when reference timing signals are no longer viable, and determine if there is degradation of the 5G time synchronization.

question_49347.question: What modifications are made in step 3 of the procedure described in clause 4.11.1.2.2.2?
question_49347.ground_truth: The modification is the inclusion of an additional optional parameter called "Return Preferred" in step 3 of the procedure described in clause 4.11.1.2.2.2.

question_49348.question: What are the possible enhancement methods for reducing control signalling overhead?
question_49348.ground_truth: Multi-subframe scheduling and cross-subframe scheduling have been considered, but their usefulness and potential gains remain diverse and any significant gains have not been identified.

question_49352.question: What information does the "List of set-up PFCs" parameter provide?
question_49352.ground_truth: The "List of set-up PFCs" parameter contains the Packet Flow Identifiers of the PFCs that were successfully allocated in the target system during a PS handover.

question_49353.question: What should the MS do when it receives a PAGING REQUEST TYPE 3 message while in the "idle, updated" state?
question_49353.ground_truth: The MS should respond to the PAGING REQUEST TYPE 3 message by sending CHANNEL REQUESTs, and then sending a correct PAGING RESPONSE if a channel is assigned.

question_49354.question: What is the difference between an "ITT4RT MRF" and an "MSMTSI MRF"?
question_49354.ground_truth: An "ITT4RT MRF" is an ITT4RT client implemented by functionality included in the MRFC and the MRFP, while an "MSMTSI MRF" is an MSMTSI client implemented by functionality included in the MRFC and the MRFP.

question_49355.question: What is the role of the SCEF in the interaction with the SPR/UDR?
question_49355.ground_truth: The SCEF is responsible for sending a list of new packet flow descriptions and the corresponding identification of the third party service provider to the SPR/UDR.

question_49357.question: What information does the AF include in the request when requesting SFC policies based on pre-defined SF services (Option 2)?
question_49357.ground_truth: The AF includes an ASP identifier, optionally a UE identifier or Group identifier, and a list of one or more SF service identifiers, which are scalar values that identify a particular service of the Service Function.

question_49359.question: What is the function of Solution #43 in terms of exposing network information?
question_49359.ground_truth: Solution #43 reuses current CAPIF mechanism to expose the information, and CAPIF API exposing function is integrated in the UPF.

question_49361.question: What is the role of the Identity Management in the MCPTT UE log on procedure?
question_49361.ground_truth: The Identity Management is responsible for authenticating the MCPTT UE, assigning a temporary MCPTT user identity for this MCPTT UE, and updating the association of the UE to the public user identity.

question_49362.question: What are the value range and purpose of the Ack/Nack field in the Iu UP PDU Type 14 Format?
question_49362.ground_truth: The Ack/Nack field takes the value of 0 for control procedure frame, 1 for positive acknowledgement (ACK), 2 for negative acknowledgement (NACK), and 3 for reserved. It tells if the frame is a control procedure frame, a positive acknowledgement (ACK), or a negative acknowledgement (NACK) of a control procedure frame.

question_49363.question: What is the primary role of LMUs (Location Measurement Units) in OTDOA (Observed Time Difference of Arrivo) based positioning?
question_49363.ground_truth: LMUs directly measure the SFN-SFN Observed Time Difference between neighbouring and reference cells and return the measurements to the CRNC (Controlled Radio Network Controller) for processing.

question_49364.question: What does the MC service server (controlling role) do with the media received from MC service client 2?
question_49364.ground_truth: The MC service server (controlling role) distributes the media to the MC service servers (participating role) with the desired MBMS bearers, to MC service server(s) (participating role) that require the media for unicast distribution as well as to its own locally served MC service clients.

question_49365.question: Under what circumstances should the Random Access Preambles group B be selected?
question_49365.ground_truth: The Random Access Preambles group B should be selected if Random Access Procedure was initiated for the CCCH logical channel and the CCCH SDU size plus MAC header is greater than messageSizeGroupA.

question_49366.question: What is the purpose of the HTTPS request sent from the BA to the OP/NAF?
question_49366.ground_truth: The purpose of this message is that the OP is able to redirect the BA. It may be done explicitly by the user or may be done automatically by the browser without further user interaction or triggered by the AA if local communication is available.

question_49367.question: How long is the ICID value unique for in 3GPP IMS networks?
question_49367.ground_truth: The ICID value is unique across all 3GPP IMS networks for at least one month.

question_49371.question: What is the purpose of the "TSG change control" specification status?
question_49371.ground_truth: The "TSG change control" specification status indicates that the Technical Specification Group is responsible for approval of Change Requests for the specification.

question_49372.question: What should the UE do when it receives PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message with MBS decision set to "MBS join is rejected" and deactivated MBS back-off timer value while joining an MBS session?
question_49372.ground_truth: UE shall transport the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMPLETE message and shall not attempt to join the multicast MBS session with the same TMGI until the UE is switched off, the USIM is removed.

question_49374.question: What is a "structured procedure" in the context of the 3GPP's GAN technical specification?
question_49374.ground_truth: A "structured procedure" in the context of the 3GPP's GAN technical specification refers to a specific sequence of "elementary procedures" used in the Generic Access (GA) protocol control entities to accomplish a particular task, such as initiating or terminating a connection.

question_49375.question: What is the role of User Equipment (UE) in UTRAN UE positioning?
question_49375.ground_truth: The UE may transmit the needed signals for uplink based UE Positioning measurements and to make measurements of downlink signals. The UE may also contain an independent positioning function (e.g., GPS, WLAN, Bluetooth, Barometric Pressure, TBS) and thus be able to report its position, independent of the UTRAN transmissions.

question_49376.question: What is the revocation status check mechanism for H(e)MS certificates?
question_49376.ground_truth: The H(e)MS may check the revocation status of the H(e)NB certificate using CRLs or OCSP.

question_49377.question: What should the MCData client do upon receiving a "SIP MESSAGE request for SDS disposition notification for terminating MCData client" or a "SIP MESSAGE request for FD disposition notification for terminating MCData client"?
question_49377.ground_truth: The MCData client should decode the contents of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body and deliver the notification to the user or application.

question_49379.question: When the MCPTT client receives a SIP INVITE message with an emergency indication for an MCPTT On-demand Chat Group Emergency Group Call, what should the UE (MCPTT Client) do?
question_49379.ground_truth: The UE (MCPTT Client) should send a SIP 200 OK as a response to the SIP INVITE message and respect floor control.

question_49380.question: Which mechanism is used to simulate the users or control signals on the other orthogonal channels of a downlink?

question_49381.question: What is the requirement for RSRP, RSRQ, and RS-SINR measurements for E-UTRAN TDD when higher layer filtering is used?
question_49381.ground_truth: An additional cell identification delay can be expected.

question_49382.question: What action does the AUSF take after receiving a POST request containing a DELETE message to remove the authentication result in the Authentication Result Removal with 5G AKA method procedure?
question_49382.ground_truth: The AUSF sends a DELETE request to the UDM for removing the authentication result of the UE after receiving the DELETE request message.

question_49383.question: When is the Re-Auth-Request (RAR) command used in the Diameter protocol?
question_49383.ground_truth: The Re-Auth-Request (RAR) command is used in the Diameter protocol to initiate re-authentication and re-authorization procedures from a 3GPP AAA server to an untrusted non-3GPP access network NAS.

question_49385.question: What is the condition for the SS to increase the number of successful tests in the testing procedure for CSI-RS based beam failure detection and link recovery in non-DRX?
question_49385.ground_truth: The SS increases the number of successful tests if the SS detects uplink power on the NR carrier equal to or higher than the minimum output power, does not detect preamble on a beam before time point B, and detects preamble on a beam before time point F.

question_49386.question: What should the IWF performing the controlling role do if it receives a SIP INVITE request that includes an MCPTT session identity of an ongoing MCPTT session and the user identified by the MCPTT ID is not authorized to join the prearranged group session?
question_49386.ground_truth: The IWF performing the controlling role should send a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response with the warning text set to "121 user is not authorized to join the group call" to the originating network.

question_49388.question: What is the main difference in procedure between solutions #1.3 and #1.4 in the evaluation and conclusion section?
question_49388.ground_truth: Solution #1.3 preserves the charging session associated with the established PDU session, while solution #1.4 releases the charging session associated with the old PDU session and creates a new charging session in the PDU session anchor relocation in SSC mode 3.

question_49389.question: What is the format of the Cell-Frequency-List-InformationItem-LCR-MulFreq-ResourceStatusInd in the Cell-Frequency-List-Information-LCR-MulFreq-ResourceStatusInd?
question_49389.ground_truth: The Cell-Frequency-List-InformationItem-LCR-MulFreq-ResourceStatusInd is a sequence that contains several parameters including uARFCN, resourceOperationalState, availabilityStatus, cause (optional), and iE-Extensions (optional).

question_49390.question: What should the P-CSCF include in the P-Charging-Vector header field when forwarding any response to the above request?
question_49390.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall include an "icid-value" header field parameter set to the value received in the initial request for the dialog, the "orig-ioi" header field parameter, if received in the request, and a type 1 "term-ioi" header field parameter that identifies the sending network.

question_49394.question: Which sections of the document are affected by the editor's note about the missing TT analysis in section 16.7.3.4.1?
question_49394.ground_truth: The editor's note about the missing TT analysis in section 16.7.3.4.1 affects sections 16.7.3.4.1.1, 16.7.3.4.1.1.4.2, and 16.7.3.4.1.1.5.

question_49396.question: What is the action the UE takes if it receives no random access response within the RA Response window of 80 sub-frames?
question_49396.ground_truth: The UE considers the random access response reception not successful, re-selects a preamble, and transmits with the calculated PRACH transmission power when the backoff time expires.

question_49398.question: What should the MS do when it receives a CM RE-ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message?
question_49398.ground_truth: The MS should send a CM RE-ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message with a CM SERVICE REJECT CAUSE informing the reason for not establishing the requested connection, or a CM SERVICE ACCEPT message if the requested connection can be established.

question_49399.question: In the inter-band PCC(FDD) and SCells case, what is the maximum number of non-consecutive DTX subframes that can be observed by the SS for increasing the number of successes for the event "Activation"?
question_49399.ground_truth: The maximum number of non-consecutive DTX subframes that can be observed by the SS for increasing the number of successes for the event "Activation" is 2.

question_49400.question: What is the OTA receiver spurious emissions requirement for multi-band RIBs in RX only operation?
question_49400.ground_truth: The RX spurious emissions requirements for multi-band RIBs in RX only operation are subject to exclusion zones in each supported operating band.

question_49401.question: What is the purpose of the MBMS URL handler in the logical model of a system that has library support for fetching resources referred to by URLs?
question_49401.ground_truth: The MBMS URL handler is positioned within the logical model of a system that has library support for fetching resources (files) referred to by URLs. It uses MBMS-API functions to communicate with the MBMS client to return the identified resource from an MBMS User service.

question_49403.question: When generating an xIRI for the SMS-SUBMIT or SMS-DELIVER type TPDUs, what should the IRI-POI in the SMSF use for sMSTPDU when the TruncateTPUserData parameter is included in its provisioning?
question_49403.ground_truth: When the IRI-POI in the SMSF is generating an xIRI for the SMS-SUBMIT or SMS-DELIVER type TPDUs and the TruncateTPUserData parameter is included in its provisioning, the IRI-POI shall use the truncatedSMSTPDU in the SMSReport record. This is different from the sMSTPDU field, which is always used for the sMSTPDU field of the SMSReport record.

question_49404.question: What is the purpose of the 5G DDNMF FQDN, and how is it constructed?
question_49404.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF FQDN is used by the UE to discover the 5G DDNMF. It is constructed by combining the AMF Instance FQDN, SMF Set FQDN, AMF Pointer, Set ID, and AMF Region ID with the "5gc.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.3gppnetwork.org" label. This FQDN uniquely identifies an AMF Instance within a 5G network.

question_49405.question: What should the UE do if the network selected for the emergency session attempt is the CS domain?
question_49405.ground_truth: If the domain selected for the emergency session attempt is the CS domain (e.g. the UE has selected GERAN or UTRAN radio access technology), then the UE shall use the stored Local Emergency Numbers List, in addition to the emergency numbers stored on the USIM and the ME, to determine if it is to send an EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message or a EMERGENCY SETUP message or a SETUP message to the network.

question_49406.question: What action should a VLR take if it cannot obtain fresh security related information from the HLR due to a system failure?
question_49406.ground_truth: The VLR may re-use a set of security related information which is marked as used.

question_49407.question: What is the function of the E-OSF in managing performance thresholds?
question_49407.ground_truth: The E-OSF can query, modify, delete, and switch the performance threshold between active and inactive. When active, the E-OSF monitors the performance data and generates alarms, while in the hang-up status, it stops monitoring and does not generate alarms.

question_49408.question: What information is included in the RANAP DIRECT TRANSFER message sent by the HNB GW to the SGSN in the 3GPP HNB procedures for signalling of Tunnel Information for PS services?
question_49408.ground_truth: The tunnel information and the FQDN of the BPCF.

question_49409.question: What is a key management service system based on, in terms of negotiation between peers or pre-distributed knowledge?
question_49409.ground_truth: Key management systems are based on negotiation between peers, such as Diffie-Hellman based schemes, or pre-distributed knowledge of user credentials.

question_49410.question: What is the minimum granularity of DCI monitoring occasion in NR?
question_49410.ground_truth: At least for single-stage DCI design, for slots, minimum granularity of DCI monitoring occasion is once per slot.

question_49411.question: What is one of the responsibilities of the SRAP entity for U2N Remote UE?
question_49411.ground_truth: The SRAP entity for U2N Remote UE is responsible for mapping a radio bearer identified by BEARER ID field to the egress PC5 Relay RLC channel via RRC.

question_49413.question: Which work area is responsible for the 3GPP work item with UID 440065?
question_49413.ground_truth: The 3GPP work area responsible for the 3GPP work item with UID 440065 is SA5.

question_49415.question: What is the common characteristic of all the fields in a PDCP PDU, except for the PDCP PDU header and MAC-I?
question_49415.ground_truth: All the fields other than the PDCP PDU header and MAC-I in a PDCP PDU make up the Data field, which includes the uncompressed or compressed SDU (Service Data Unit).

question_49416.question: What is the difference between NR-PCI and EUTRA-PCI?
question_49416.ground_truth: NR-PCI (New Radio Physical Cell Identity) is a variable that identifies the physical cell ID of a cell in the NR network, while EUTRA-PCI (Evolved UTRA Physical Cell Identity) is a variable that identifies the physical cell ID of a cell in the E-UTRA/E-UTRAN network. The NR-PCI is defined as a variable that ranges from 0 to 506, while the EUTRA-PCI is defined as a variable that ranges from 0 to 507.

question_49418.question: What part is carried within the PS Handover Command message sent from the source BSS to the MS for PS handover from A/Gb mode to A/Gb mode?
question_49418.ground_truth: The Core Network part of the Target BSS to Source BSS Transparent Container, carrying parameters relevant for the MS and the core network, is carried within the PS Handover Command message sent from the source BSS to the MS for PS handover from A/Gb mode to A/Gb mode.

question_49423.question: What network entity is responsible for running the Spanning Tree algorithm to prevent loops in the Ethernet network?

question_49424.question: In what scenario does the system randomly select time and frequency resources for one or more transmission opportunities from the available resources, considering the first set of transmission opportunities as initial transmission opportunities and the other set(s) of transmission opportunities as retransmission opportunities?
question_49424.ground_truth: When one or more SL-PRS retransmissions are selected and the selected resource pool is SL-PRS dedicated resource pool.

question_49425.question: When does the UE need to indicate its support to receive ECS address(es) via NAS in 5G network?
question_49425.ground_truth: A UE that hosts EEC(s) may indicate in the PCO that it supports the ability to receive ECS address(es) via NAS and to transfer the ECS Address(es) to the EEC(s).

question_49426.question: What determines the impacted UE(s) in Alternative 1 for NG-RAN Time Sync Status reporting?
question_49426.ground_truth: The TSCTSF determines the impacted UE(s) based on their location and the NG-RAN timing synchronization status reports received from AMF.

question_49428.question: What entity is responsible for determining whether the S-NSSAI needs to be changed for an ongoing PDU session in solution #40?
question_49428.ground_truth: The PCF (Policy Control Function) is responsible for determining whether the S-NSSAI needs to be changed for an ongoing PDU session in solution #40.

question_49429.question: What should the UE do if it detects the first expiry of timer T3582 during the UE-requested PDU session release procedure?
question_49429.ground_truth: The UE shall retransmit the PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message and the PDU session information, reset and start timer T3582. This retransmission is repeated four times, and if it still fails, the UE shall abort the procedure, release the allocated PTI, perform a local release of the PDU session, and perform the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update by sending a REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

question_49430.question: What is the purpose of network selection principles in NR satellite access?
question_49430.ground_truth: The principles ensure that a UE selects a PLMN that is allowed to operate in the UE location by using its awareness of its location.

question_49431.question: What is the format of the TRP Information Response message?
question_49431.ground_truth: The TRP Information Response message is a SEQUENCE that contains a ProtocolIE-Container, which includes a set of ProtocolIE-SingleContainer elements, each with a specific ID, Criticality, Type, Presence, and optional Additional Information.

question_49432.question: How long is the maximum duration of the test of Immediate Connect?
question_49432.ground_truth: The maximum duration of the test of Immediate Connect is 1 minute.

question_49435.question: What is the purpose of using a model ID in AI/ML models?
question_49435.ground_truth: A model ID is used to identify an AI/ML model and can be associated with the selection, (de)activation, or switching of a model or linked to the "Model Transfer/Delivery" information. It can also be used for proper model validation and testing procedures.

question_49436.question: What is the action taken by the AMF when it receives a CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message which includes a CIoT small data container IE?
question_49436.ground_truth: The AMF deciphers the value part of the CIoT small data container IE and handles the message as specified in subclause~5.6.1.4.2.

question_49437.question: When is the ATTACH ACCEPT message sent by the network to the MS?
question_49437.ground_truth: The ATTACH ACCEPT message is sent by the network to the MS to indicate that the corresponding attach request has been accepted by the network. This message is sent after receiving a valid ATTACH REQUEST message from the MS.

question_49439.question: What information does the ePDG include in the Gateway Control Session establishment request in clause 5.2.2.1.2?
question_49439.ground_truth: The ePDG includes the IMSI, APN, IP-CAN type, UE IP address allocated by EPC, and outer IP header information of the tunnelled traffic in the message to the PCRF.

question_49441.question: What is the measurement period for FDD inter frequency measurements if the UE does not need idle intervals?
question_49441.ground_truth: If the UE does not require idle intervals for FDD inter frequency measurements, the measurement period is 480 ms.

question_49442.question: What is the minimum percentage of correct events that must be observed during repeated tests?
question_49442.ground_truth: The minimum percentage of correct events that must be observed during repeated tests is 90%.

question_49443.question: What is the significance of the third digit in the version number of a 3GPP technical specification?
question_49443.ground_truth: The third digit is incremented when editorial only changes have been incorporated in the document, i.e. no technical enhancements, corrections, updates, etc. have been made to the document.

question_49444.question: When is the list of equivalent PLMNs updated?
question_49444.ground_truth: The UE shall update or delete this list at the end of each attach or combined attach or tracking area updating or combined tracking area updating procedure.

question_49445.question: What is the parameter that indicates a successful outgoing serving E-DCH cell change attempt per neighbor cell relation in 3GPP TS 25.331?

question_49446.question: What should the MS do if it has initiated the routing area updating procedure due to a change in the UE's usage setting, and the ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message contains an indication that ISR is activated?
question_49446.ground_truth: The MS shall set the TIN to "P-TMSI" and shall stop the periodic tracking area update timer T3412 or T3423, if running.

question_49447.question: What is the impact of intersystem change events on CDR and IP-CAN session?
question_49447.ground_truth: Intersystem change events close the CDR and a new one is opened if the IP-CAN session is still active.

question_49448.question: What is the difference between RNC centric and SAS centric modes of operation as defined in the document?
question_49448.ground_truth: In RNC centric mode, the RNC is responsible for position method selection and initiation, while in SAS centric mode, the SAS is responsible for position method selection and initiation.

question_49449.question: What is the purpose of the SABM frame in RLP?
question_49449.ground_truth: The SABM frame is used to initiate a link for numbered information transfer (going from ADM to ABM) or to reset a link already established for numbered information transfer. It is always issued with the P-bit set to "1".

question_49451.question: What is the SW processing time (Tprocessing) needed by the UE for a PCell in FR2?
question_49451.ground_truth: The SW processing time needed by the UE for a PCell in FR2 is 40 ms.

question_49452.question: What must the TSCTSF do if a UE that is part of a PTP instance is served by a RAN node that lost synchronization to a primary reference time source?
question_49452.ground_truth: The TSCTSF must change the clockClass attribute for all UEs that are part of that PTP instance, or mark the impacted UE PTP port as disabled and keep the clockClass of other UEs unchanged.

question_49453.question: What parameter in BSSMAP-LE PERFORM LOCATION RESPONSE message is used to send a successful location estimate for the target MS?
question_49453.ground_truth: The Location Estimate parameter in the BSSMAP-LE PERFORM LOCATION RESPONSE message provides the location estimate for the target MS in case of a successful location attempt.

question_49454.question: What is the type of the element "ProSe-Application-Code" that is a child of the "DiscFilter-info" complex type?
question_49454.ground_truth: The type of the element "ProSe-Application-Code" is "xs:hexBinary".

question_49455.question: What is the requirement for the power of all four bursts within the radio block in step a) of 22.3.5?
question_49455.ground_truth: The power of all four bursts within the radio block measured in step a) and c) shall be within the accuracies specified for the power class of the mobile under test.

question_49456.question: What are the benefits of Option 1 in splitting NR functions between central and distributed units?
question_49456.ground_truth: Option 1 allows a separate User-plane (U-plane) while having a centralized RRC/RRM. It also provides benefits in handling some edge computing or low latency use cases where the user data needs to be located close to the transmission point.

question_49458.question: What type of handover is considered in case ii) of the document?
question_49458.ground_truth: Handover between Base Station Subsystems connected to different MSCs is considered in case ii) of the document.

question_49459.question: What is subclause 6.10.2.4.1.53b.1 in the document specifying?
question_49459.ground_truth: Subclause 6.10.2.4.1.53b.1 specifies the uplink for the RAB combination Conversational / unknown / UL:64 DL:128 kbps / CS RAB + Interactive or Background / UL:128 DL:128 kbps / PS RAB + UL:3.4 DL:3.4 kbps SRBs for DCCH.

question_49460.question: What procedures are initiated from the SIP core local inbound/outbound proxy when the MC service server decides to modify the parameters of a unicast bearer?
question_49460.ground_truth: PCC procedures, as defined in 3GPP TS 23.203, are initiated from the SIP core local inbound/outbound proxy when the MC service server decides to modify the parameters of a unicast bearer.

question_49461.question: What should the network do if authentication is not successful in the EAP-response/AKA'-challenge message?
question_49461.ground_truth: The network should send an EAP-request/AKA'-notification message that implies failure, or if earlier procedures were not successful, an EAP-failure message.

question_49462.question: What type of errors can result in the UE rejecting a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message with 5GSM cause #44 or #45?
question_49462.ground_truth: Semantic errors in packet filters (#44) or syntactical errors in packet filters (#45)

question_49463.question: What is the role of A/337 in ATSC 3.0 standard?
question_49463.ground_truth: A/337 defines the signaling of the delivery method and properties of broadcaster applications bound to linear services, and synchronization of application-initiated actions to the underlying audio/video content.

question_49464.question: What procedure is used to send specific call information for a single call party to the gsmSCF as requested by the gsmSCF?
question_49464.ground_truth: The CallInformationReport procedure is used to send specific call information for a single call party to the gsmSCF as requested by the gsmSCF. It is sent at the end of a call party connection which is indicated by one of the events specified below.

question_49465.question: When can the SEPP skip converting URIs into telescopic FQDNs?
question_49465.ground_truth: The SEPP can skip converting URIs into telescopic FQDNs when the remote PLMN supports the 3gpp-Sbi-Target-apiRoot header and the corresponding HTTP request or response contains the 3gpp-Sbi-Target-apiRoot header.

question_49466.question: What REST design principle states that messages should include all information required to process the message?
question_49466.ground_truth: Self-descriptive messages is a REST design principle that states that messages should include all information required to process the message.

question_49467.question: What is the parameter TInter1 used for in inter-RAT requirements when NCSG is used?
question_49467.ground_truth: The parameter TInter1 specifies the minimum conformance requirements for inter-RAT measurement when NCSG is used.

question_49468.question: What is the purpose of receiving on-network MCX Service Group and off-network MCX Service Group Communications simultaneously?
question_49468.ground_truth: This is useful for ensuring that the MCX UE user can stay informed about multiple active communications on their affiliated MCX Service Groups, whether they are on-network or off-network.

question_49469.question: What is the maximum number of reporting criteria that a UE with support for frame structure 3 and 6 SCell carrier frequencies needs to be able to handle in total for inter-frequency measurements?

question_49470.question: What was the IIP2 level of the typical transceiver chip, and what IIP2 level was required to meet the blocker requirements with the basic architecture?
question_49470.ground_truth: The typical transceiver chip had an IIP2 of 42.9 dBm, while an IIP2 of 76 dBm was needed to meet the blocker requirements with the basic architecture.

question_49471.question: How does the encoding of the stereo Low band use the ACELP mode?
question_49471.ground_truth: The encoding of the stereo Low band does not use the ACELP mode.

question_49472.question: How is authorization for V2X communications over PC5 reference point determined?
question_49472.ground_truth: The UE gets authorization to use V2X communications over PC5 reference point on a per PLMN basis in the serving PLMN by the V2X Control Function in the HPLMN. The V2X Control Function in the HPLMN requests authorization information from the V2X Control Function of the serving PLMN and informs the UE of the final authorization information.

question_49475.question: What is the teardown indicator information element used for in a DEACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message?
question_49475.ground_truth: The teardown indicator information element is used to indicate whether only the PDP context associated with this specific TI or all active PDP contexts sharing the same PDP address and APN as the PDP context associated with this specific TI shall be deactivated.

question_49476.question: What are the different solutions considered for transferring/delivering AI/ML models in network operations?
question_49476.ground_truth: The different solutions considered include using gNB or Core Network to transfer/deliver AI/ML models to UE via RRC, NAS, or User Plane signalling. OAM can also transfer/deliver AI/ML models to UE via OAM-UE control plane signalling or IP tunnel.

question_49477.question: In what scenario would the higher layer parameter numberActivatedAperiodicCSI-RS-Resources be set to '1' for a serving cell?
question_49477.ground_truth: When a report is being made for the activated CSI-RS resource for the serving cell.

question_49478.question: Are charging requirements specified in this version of the specification?
question_49478.ground_truth: No, charging requirements are not specified in this version of the specification and may be provided in a later version of the present document.

question_49479.question: What is the purpose of introducing a Ranging/SL Positioning layer for 5G?
question_49479.ground_truth: The Ranging/SL Positioning layer is introduced to control Ranging/SL Positioning operations, manage direct communication between UEs, and provide security for these operations.

question_49480.question: What is the difference between the createCallLeg() and createAndRouteCallLegReq() methods in the IpMultiPartyCall interface?
question_49480.ground_truth: The createCallLeg() method is used to create a new call leg object, while the createAndRouteCallLegReq() method is an asynchronous operation used to create and route a new call leg. The createAndRouteCallLegReq() method makes the connection to the destination party and attaches the call leg to the call, while the createCallLeg() method does not make the connection. Requested events will be reported on the IpAppCallLeg interface in the createAndRouteCallLegReq() method.

question_49481.question: Which parameter represents the SLDRXCycleList type in the F1AP protocol?

question_49482.question: What is the purpose of the tests specified in 8.13.3.3.1, regarding single-layer spatial multiplexing 2 Tx Antenna Port with TM4 interference model for FDD PCell in TDD-FDD (CA and DC)?
question_49482.ground_truth: The purpose of these tests is to verify the closed loop rank-one performance with wideband precoding with two transmit antennas when the PDSCH transmission in the serving cell is interfered by PDSCH of one dominant interfering cell applying transmission mode 4 interference model defined in clause B.5.3.

question_49484.question: Which functions does a Network Repository Function (NRF) perform in the 5G system?
question_49484.ground_truth: The NRF function maintains a list of available services in the 5G system and provides information about the network functions (NFs) to the NF service consumers upon request.

question_49486.question: What is the purpose of the 5G ProSe direct discovery procedure over PC5 interface?
question_49486.ground_truth: The purpose of the 5G ProSe direct discovery procedure over PC5 interface is to enable a ProSe-enabled UE to detect and identify another ProSe-enabled UE over PC5 interface.

question_49488.question: What is the reference level used to calculate the sending sensitivity for hands-free terminals in the MRP?
question_49488.ground_truth: The averaged test signal level measured in each frequency band at the MRP is used as the reference level for calculating the sending sensitivity for hands-free terminals in the MRP.

question_49490.question: What must the SGM-C include in a CoAP PUT request when updating a VAL group document?
question_49490.ground_truth: The SGM-C must include the CoAP URI identifying the individual VAL group document, the Content-Format option set to "application/vnd.3gpp.seal-group-doc+cbor", and the VALGroupDocument object with members and member details.

question_49491.question: Which network aspect is managed by Mobility Management?
question_49491.ground_truth: The relation between the mobile station and the UTRAN is managed by Mobility Management.

question_49492.question: What is the purpose of establishing a shared secret (association) between the RP and the OP in OpenID Architecture?
question_49492.ground_truth: The purpose of this shared secret is that the OP can sign subsequent messages and the RP can verify those messages.

question_49493.question: For which V2X positioning use cases do the 3GPP specifications provide the high accuracy positioning requirements?
question_49493.ground_truth: The 3GPP specifications provide the high accuracy positioning requirements for V2X in TS 22.261, with a summary in Clause 7.3.2.2 with a note that these requirements include V2X.

question_49495.question: When the reportSFTD-Meas is set to true, and the corresponding measObject concerns NR, what should be considered applicable?
question_49495.ground_truth: The NR PSCell should be considered applicable.

question_49496.question: Which parameters for UE and BS specific requirements are considered for the introduction of the Band n259 in TS 38.101-2?
question_49496.ground_truth: For introducing band n259, the RF requirements for UE specific parameters considered are PUMax tolerance, minimum output power, transmit OFF power, adjacent channel leakage ratio, and spurious emission band UE co-existence. For BS specific requirements, the parameters considered are radiated transmitter characteristics and radiated receiver characteristics.

question_49497.question: What procedure does the MCVideo client follow when it receives a PRIVATE CALL REJECT message from the terminating user in the "P5: pending" state upon an indication from MCVideo User to accept the incoming private call?
question_49497.ground_truth: Generate a PRIVATE CALL REJECT message, set the call identifier IE to the stored call identifier, set the MCVideo user ID of the caller IE with the stored caller ID, set the MCVideo user ID of the callee IE with the stored callee ID, set the Reason IE as "FAILED" or "E2E SECURITY CONTEXT FAILURE", send the PRIVATE CALL REJECT message, and enter the "P1: ignoring same call id" state.

question_49498.question: What is the requirement for an active PDP context associated with the IMS APN in the GGSN?
question_49498.ground_truth: The corresponding IP address or prefix must be stored in the HSS.

question_49499.question: Which 3GPP technical specification documents define the OSA APIs in detail?
question_49499.ground_truth: 29.198-01 to 29.198-18, 29.198-16, and 29.199-01 to 29.199-22 are the 3GPP technical specification documents that define the OSA APIs in detail.

question_49500.question: Which procedures for RF test are defined in TS 34.108 clause 7.3?
question_49500.ground_truth: The initial conditions of TS 34.108 clause 7.3 refer to the generic setup procedures defined in TS 34.108 clause 7.2.

question_49503.question: Which information element is a mandatory part of the MeasurementResponse and MeasurementFailure messages?
question_49503.ground_truth: id-UL-RTOAMeasurements is a mandatory part of the MeasurementResponse and MeasurementFailure messages.

question_49504.question: What is the role of the SEAL Client in the MSGin5G system architecture?
question_49504.ground_truth: The SEAL Client interacts with SEAL Servers over the SEAL-S reference point specified for each SEAL service, and the MSGin5G Client interacts with SEAL Clients over the SEAL-C reference point specified for each SEAL service.

question_49505.question: What should be included in the Request-URI when sending a REGISTER request?
question_49505.ground_truth: The Request-URI should be set to the SIP URI of the domain name of the home network used to address the REGISTER request.

question_49506.question: What is one area of spatial domain enhancement studied for gNB-to-gNB co-channel CLI handling?
question_49506.ground_truth: The exchange of DL Tx beam information of the gNB between gNBs.

question_49507.question: What is the method to support packet filtering in IP PDU session type?
question_49507.ground_truth: It supports packet filtering based on any combination of Source/destination IP address or IPv6 prefix, Source/destination port number, Protocol ID of the protocol above IP/Next header type, Type of Service (TOS)/Traffic class (IPv6) and Mask, Flow Label (IPv6), and Security parameter index.

question_49509.question: What is the performance criteria for ancillary equipment in the RF electromagnetic field test as per clause 9.3?
question_49509.ground_truth: The performance criteria for ancillary equipment in the RF electromagnetic field test as per clause 9.3 is the same as subclause 6.3.

question_49510.question: What is the purpose of the "fileDownloadStateUpdate()" notification in the MBMS client and MAA interaction?
question_49510.ground_truth: The "fileDownloadStateUpdate()" notification is used by the MAA to request information about the current state of files requested to be downloaded by the MBMS client on behalf of the MAA.

question_49511.question: Which devices were specified as the source and destination for the REFRESH 1.4.1 response?
question_49511.ground_truth: The source device is ME, and the destination device is UICC.

question_49512.question: In the context of 5GSM, what is the state when the PDU session context is active in the network?

question_49513.question: In Coverage Evaluation Method 2, which frequency is used by Source 18 in the DL traffic model for FR2, InH, DL, VR/AR30, #UE/cell=Capacity(7~8)?
question_49513.ground_truth: In Coverage Evaluation Method 2, Source 18 used a frequency of -104.9dB in the DL traffic model for FR2, InH, DL, VR/AR30, #UE/cell=Capacity(7~8).

question_49514.question: What is the purpose of adapting the SCAS instantiation in a network product?
question_49514.ground_truth: The purpose is to cater to special circumstances, such as partial implementation of a network product class, or when there is no fully fitting SCAS for a SECAM evaluation. Adaptation helps avoid complexity and vast coverage of multiple parallel versions with minor differences.

question_49515.question: What type of events can trigger a toolkit application in a SIM card?
question_49515.ground_truth: Toolkit applications in a SIM card can be triggered by various events such as download of terminal profile, user's selection in the SIM's menu, SMS reception, reception of a short message, cell broadcast message, call control by SIM, event download, MO short message control by SIM, timer expiration, unrecognized envelope, status command, and experimental or proprietary events.

question_49516.question: What is the condition that the SS shall meet before switching the power setting from T1 to T2?
question_49516.ground_truth: The SS shall meet the condition that when T1 expires, before switching the power setting from T1 to T2.

question_49518.question: When should a UE change the value of the source Layer-2 ID self-assigned by the UE for V2X communication over PC5 and the source IP address self-assigned by the UE for V2X communication over PC5 upon initiating transmission of V2X communication over PC5?
question_49518.ground_truth: A UE should change the value of the source Layer-2 ID self-assigned by the UE for V2X communication over PC5 and the source IP address self-assigned by the UE for V2X communication over PC5 upon initiating transmission of V2X communication over PC5 if the V2X service identifier of a V2X service requesting transmission of V2X communication over PC5 is in the list of V2X services which require privacy for V2X communication over PC5 as specified in subclause 5.2.4, and the UE is located in a geographical area in which this V2X service requires privacy for V2X communication over PC5 as specified in subclause 5.2.4.

question_49519.question: In 5G system, what is the technology used to reduce the high data rate of closed-circuit video and still provide excellent video quality?
question_49519.ground_truth: There are existing standards, such as MPEG-2, MPEG-4, and M-JPEG, that reduce the data rate of closed-circuit video, while providing excellent video quality.

question_49520.question: What type of handover does not support DAPS handover for FR2 to FR2 case?
question_49520.ground_truth: Intra-NR RAN handover does not support DAPS handover for FR2 to FR2 case.

question_49522.question: What is the maximum number of preamble transmission attempts that a UE can make for the random access procedure?

question_49526.question: What is the impact of the ground truth data in analytics accuracy monitoring?
question_49526.ground_truth: The ground truth data is the actual measured data observed at the time which the prediction refers to. In the ground truth data, the actual result is compared with the predicted result to determine the accuracy. However, the ground truth data can be impacted when Analytics Feedback Information shows that an action is triggered by the analytics output in the consumer.

question_49528.question: What happens if the CTS-MS is unable to use the parameters instructed by the CTS INTRACELL HANDOVER COMMAND message?
question_49528.ground_truth: The CTS-MS will return a CTS INTRACELL HANDOVER FAILURE message and remain on the current channel(s) and use the old channel description or channel mode.

question_49530.question: What is required for the backhaul link's security?
question_49530.ground_truth: The backhaul link shall provide integrity, confidentiality, and replay protection of the transmitted data. IPsec usage for the backhaul link is mandatory to implement, but optional to use based on an operator's policy.

question_49532.question: What should a UE with access class 0 to 9 or without an IMSI do if access class 10 is indicated as barred in a cell when initiating an emergency call?
question_49532.ground_truth: The UE is not allowed to initiate emergency calls in this cell.

question_49533.question: What is the data type of the "entry-info" attribute in the "EntryType" complex type?
question_49533.ground_truth: The "entry-info" attribute in the "EntryType" complex type is of the data type "EntryInfoTypeList".

question_49534.question: What operation is performed to obtain the number of octets of incoming RTP packets at MRFP?
question_49534.ground_truth: The number of incoming RTP packet octets (bytes) on receipt by the MRFP of a RTP packet is accumulated.

question_49536.question: How is the length of the channelisation code determined for different Mcps options?
question_49536.ground_truth: For 3.84Mcps TDD and 1.28Mcps TDD, Qk can be 1, 2, 4, 8, or 16, while for 7.68Mcps TDD, Qk can be 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, or 32.

question_49537.question: How is the artificial feedback of the receive signal into the sending path implemented for testing echo and double talk scenarios?
question_49537.ground_truth: The artificial feedback is realized as part of the test system, with the received and decoded signal from the UE being fed back into the sending direction in advance of the encoding/protocol/hardware layer.

question_49538.question: In the E-SMLC Initiated Assistance Data Delivery followed by Location Information Transfer: UE-Assisted procedure, what should the UE send in response to a location request when it has received assistance data and is asked to provide location measurements?
question_49538.ground_truth: The UE should send a PROVIDE LOCATION INFORMATION message containing location measurements.

question_49539.question: What is the purpose of the Network feature support information element?
question_49539.ground_truth: The Network feature support information element is a type 1 information element with the purpose of indicating whether certain features are supported by the network. If this IE is not included, then the respective features are not supported.

question_49540.question: Who is the charged party and who is the charging party in the business interface between the Network slice service provider and the Network slice provider related to NSI usage and NSI management?
question_49540.ground_truth: In the business interface between the Network slice service provider (charged party) and the Network slice provider (charging party), it is considered for charging capabilities related to NSI usage and NSI management.

question_49541.question: What is a requirement for a UE to negotiate UE paging probability information with the network?
question_49541.ground_truth: The UE should not have an active emergency PDU session when negotiating UE paging probability information with the network.

question_49542.question: When is the NASS-IMS bundled authentication applicable?
question_49542.ground_truth: The NASS-IMS bundled authentication is applicable to UEs that contain neither USIM nor ISIM. Authentication is achieved via the registration and reregistration procedures. NASS-bundled authentication is granted by the network upon receipt by the UE of a 200 (OK) response to the initial REGISTER request.

question_49547.question: What should the MME do if it does not receive a response from the UE after a predetermined time period when waiting for the UE to grant or withhold permission for a location request?
question_49547.ground_truth: The MME shall infer a "no response" condition and return an error response to the GMLC if privacy verification was requested and either the UE user denies permission or there is no response with the UE privacy profile received from the GMLC indicating barring of the location request.

question_49548.question: What are the reference points specified for the MCX-n?
question_49548.ground_truth: The MCX-n reference points are specified in 3GPP TS 23.379, 3GPP TS 23.281, and 3GPP TS 23.282.

question_49550.question: What is the action taken by the SS when a fail is counted for the event "Activation" or "Deactivation" or when T3 expires?
question_49550.ground_truth: The SS shall transmit a RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources.

question_49552.question: What is the definition of Transmit minimum power and Transmit OFF power in the FD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync in DRX for UE Category 1bis?
question_49552.ground_truth: Transmit minimum power is the minimum UE output power of -39 dBm, defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.2.5. Transmit OFF power is the maximum UE output power of -48.5 dBm, defined in 3GPP TS 36.521-1 clause 6.3.3.5.

question_49555.question: What is the purpose of studying the Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning (AI/ML) management capabilities and services for 5GS in the 3GPP TSG Technical Specification and Report on AI/ML management?
question_49555.ground_truth: The study aims to facilitate enabling the existing and new challenging use cases that 5G offers and to maximize efficiency and bring intelligence and automation in various domains of the 5GS.

question_49556.question: What is the purpose of the floor request queue in the controlling MCPTT function?
question_49556.ground_truth: The floor request queue in the controlling MCPTT function is used to store received floor request messages for all MCPTT clients participating in an MCPTT call.

question_49561.question: Which test mode as defined in 3GPP TS 44.014 subclause 5.4 is used for the test?
question_49561.ground_truth: Mode (a) transmitting pseudo-random data sequence in RLC data blocks is used for the test.

question_49562.question: In which TFO version does the Immediate Codec Type Optimisation become effective?
question_49562.ground_truth: The Immediate Codec Type Optimisation becomes effective in TFO version 5 or higher.

question_49563.question: What is a limitation of using diversity in keys to prevent compromise?
question_49563.ground_truth: Diversity in keys does not make it less likely that any one particular key is compromised; it only reduces the likelihood that a second key is compromised in the same way as a first one.

question_49564.question: What is the expected rate of correct events for this test case?
question_49564.ground_truth: The expected rate of correct events for this test case is at least 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_49566.question: What is the role of the AMF in 5G networks as defined in 3GPP TS 23.501 and 3GPP TS 33.501?
question_49566.ground_truth: The AMF serves as the access and mobility management function in the 5G core network.

question_49567.question: How are the Information Object Classes defined in the present document?
question_49567.ground_truth: The Information Object Classes are defined with imported information entities and local labels, presented in class diagrams with attributes and relationships, and in some cases, inheritance from other information object classes.

question_49568.question: What is the content type header that the SM-over-IP sender must include in the SIP MESSAGE request when submitting a short message?

question_49569.question: When can an MCVideo user be notified that the video can now be transmitted?
question_49569.ground_truth: Once an MCVideo client determines that it has higher transmission priority and no response to the sent transmission request message is received, it sends the transmission arbitration taken message to the MCVideo group.

question_49571.question: Which devices are specified as the source and destination for the SEND USSD proactive command from the UICC to the network?
question_49571.ground_truth: The source device is UICC and the destination device is Network

question_49572.question: What is the meaning of "logMeasAvailable" in the context of the logged measurement entries?
question_49572.ground_truth: The "logMeasAvailable" indicates that there are additional logged measurement entries available that are not included in the logMeasInfoList within the UEInformationResponse message.

question_49573.question: What is the main goal of the Content Delivery Establishment Procedure?
question_49573.ground_truth: The main goal is to establish the content delivery after the user chooses a content, by sending a Content ID to the Tracker AS for fetching a Peer list.

question_49574.question: What is the function of the multiplexing of HS-SICH type 2 information fields?
question_49574.ground_truth: The multiplexing of HS-SICH type 2 information fields combines the CQI bits for each stream with the repetition coded ACK/NACK bits for each stream to produce the bits d1,d2...dU where U is the number of physical channel bits carried by HS-SICH.

question_49575.question: What was the increase in capacity performance for FR1, Indoor Hotspot, DL, with coexistence between uRLLC service and XR service, with VR/AR single-stream traffic model, 30Mbps, 60FPS, 10ms, with DDDSU, MU-MIMO, when using the Rel-15 Preemption technique and prioritizing the transmission of I frame?
question_49575.ground_truth: The capacity performance was increased by 38.8% (from 8.5 UEs per cell to 11.8 UEs per cell).

question_49577.question: Which abbreviations are specific to the GSM/EDGE Channel coding (Release 17) document in addition to those listed in 3GPP TR 21.905?
question_49577.ground_truth: The additional abbreviations in the GSM/EDGE Channel coding (Release 17) document are BTTI, ESAB, EDAB, eTFI, FANR, PAN, PANI, RTTI, TFI, and TTI.

question_49578.question: What makes it difficult to balance the energy saving effect and service experience in 5G networks?
question_49578.ground_truth: It is difficult to evaluate the influence on service experience (e.g. UL/DL RAN UE throughput, latency) of energy saving actions beforehand, which makes it difficult to balance the energy saving effect and service experience.

question_49580.question: What is the range of values for U, the length of the output sequence, in the E-AGCH type 2?
question_49580.ground_truth: For 1.28Mcps U = 172, for 3.84Mcps and 7.68Mcps U = 242, and for burst type 2 U = 274.

question_49581.question: What aspects will be studied in relation to steering application traffic for processing at different locations?
question_49581.ground_truth: The aspects that will be studied include how to steer application traffic for processing at different locations, such as at the local Application first and then at the central application server(s)/or UE, or at the central application server first and then at the local application server.

question_49582.question: What is the preferred traffic conditioning action applied to adapt to the available resources in the BM-SC for point-to-point bearer services?
question_49582.ground_truth: Packet dropping is the preferred traffic conditioning action applied to adapt to the available resources in the BM-SC for point-to-point bearer services.

question_49583.question: What must the UE provide in the Registration Request message towards the 5GC in N2/NAS message to indicate its capability to sort out S-NSSAIs in priority order?
question_49583.ground_truth: The UE provides an indication of its capability to sort out the S-NSSAIs which are included in the Request S-NSSAIs in priority order in the Registration Request message.

question_49584.question: What is the maximum allowed time for monitoring the downlink of the serving cell for paging reception during inter-frequency cell re-selection?
question_49584.ground_truth: The maximum allowed time for monitoring the downlink of the serving cell for paging reception during inter-frequency cell re-selection is TSI-EUTRA + 50 ms.

question_49585.question: What type of information is the TLLI field in the Multilateration Timing Advance application?
question_49585.ground_truth: The TLLI field is encoded as the value part of the TLLI information element in 3GPP TS 44.018, not including 3GPP TS 44.018 IEI.

question_49586.question: What is a prerequisite for the USIM application to operate in a 2G mode with a 3G algorithm?
question_49586.ground_truth: A fixed virtual 2G mode is required for the USIM application to operate in a 2G mode with a 3G algorithm.

question_49590.question: What is the core use case of time-sensitive networking (TSN) in industrial automation and energy automation?
question_49590.ground_truth: The core use case of TSN in industrial automation and energy automation is providing reliable, low-latency, high-bandwidth, and time-deterministic communication between devices, enabling real-time communication and control for various applications, including control loops in industrial communication networks and substations in energy automation.
