question_49950.ground_truth: Upon starting the LOCATION UPDATING procedure, the network initiates a CLASSMARK ENQUIRY procedure. The MS reports that it supports GERAN FEATURES PACKAGE 2 in the CLASSMARK CHANGE. The network completes the LOCATION UPDATING procedure and assigns a mobile identity. The MS is then assigned a channel that supports Enhanced Power Control. The timings for reports, commands, and power level changes are verified. After this, the network disables Enhanced Power Control and checks that the MS returns to using normal power control.

question_49951.question: What is the method described for relay device authentication in the new architecture?
question_49951.ground_truth: Implicit platform authentication is provided as part of the RN attach procedure.

question_49952.question: What is the reporting range of RSRP, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.133?
question_49952.ground_truth: The reporting range of RSRP is defined from -140 dBm to -44 dBm with 1 dB resolution.

question_49955.question: How many RLC data blocks can be contained in one RLC/MAC block in EGPRS2-A uplink for MCS-1, MCS-2, MCS-3, MCS-4, MCS-5, and MCS-6?
question_49955.ground_truth: One RLC data block per RLC/MAC block.

question_49956.question: What is a multimedia messaging body part (MMBP) in the context of this specification?
question_49956.ground_truth: An MMBP is a part of a message body that may include media content, metadata, and processing requirements. It may be the entire part of a message body or a sub-part, with its own media type and associated metadata parameters.

question_49957.question: What information is required as an input when requesting the network to revoke the AF session with requested QoS for a UE or a list of UEs?

question_49958.question: How is user data over GERAN distinguished in the test model?
question_49958.ground_truth: User data over GERAN is distinguished between raw user data (raw mode) and IP data (IP mode) in the test model.

question_49959.question: What is the status condition returned by the UICC when an AUTHENTICATE command is sent to the UICC with an incorrect signed data?
question_49959.ground_truth: The status condition returned by the UICC when an AUTHENTICATE command is sent to the UICC with an incorrect signed data is SW1~=~'98', SW2~=~'62' - authentication error, incorrect MAC.

question_49960.question: What is the transmit power of the common midamble in the downlink when Common Midamble Allocation is used?
question_49960.ground_truth: The transmit power of this common midamble is such that there is no power offset between the data parts and the midamble part of the overall transmit signal within one time slot.

question_49961.question: What operation is invoked in the gprsProcessingPackage operation package?
question_49961.ground_truth: The CONSUMER INVOKES continueGPRS operation is invoked in the gprsProcessingPackage operation package.

question_49962.question: What is the difference between general requirements and additional requirements in 3GPP TS 38.101-3?
question_49962.ground_truth: In 3GPP TS 38.101-3, general requirements are mandated to be met in all scenarios, while additional requirements are specified for specific scenarios. In addition to meeting the general requirement, the UE is mandated to meet the additional requirements for those specific scenarios.

question_49963.question: What should a UE capable of MBMS reception do upon initializing schedulingInfoList if SystemInformationBlockType13 is present and the UE does not have a valid version stored?

question_49964.question: What is the difference between an inner and outer contiguous allocation in intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation?
question_49964.ground_truth: An inner contiguous allocation is a range of RB in a component carrier with a lower frequency and with a smaller number of RB allocated, while an outer contiguous allocation is a range of RB in a component carrier with a higher frequency or with a larger number of RB allocated.

question_49965.question: In the context of inter-frequency FDD cell re-selection, what is the condition for cell re-selection to an inter-frequency FDD cell for the interruption time requirement to apply?
question_49965.ground_truth: The condition is that the UE does not need measurement occasions to perform inter-frequency FDD measurements.

question_49966.question: What are some of the network causes for overload situations in the Ro reference point?
question_49966.ground_truth: The network causes can be a huge surge in mobility management signalling, flood of attach over E-UTRAN access resulting in flood of default bearer establishment signalling, flood of resources allocations for mobile originating services, flood of signalling for mobile terminating services, and flood of ULI update.

question_49967.question: What 1st priority channels do not meet the absolute MPL target in the Urban 28GHz TDD NLOS O2I scenario?
question_49967.ground_truth: PUSCH eMBB DDDSU, PUSCH eMBB DDSU, PUSCH VoIP DDDSU, PDSCH eMBB DDSU, PUCCH Format 1, PUCCH Format 3 11bits, PUCCH Format 3 22bits, SSB, PRACH Format B4: 20.30dB, PDCCH of Msg2, PUSCH of Msg3, PDSCH of Msg4, PDSCH eMBB DDDSU, PUSCH VoIP DDSU

question_49969.question: How is the Visited Country Emergency N3IWF FQDN constructed?

question_49971.question: What frequency range is recommended for the NTN satellite bands?
question_49971.ground_truth: The recommended frequency range for NTN satellite bands is from 2 GHz to 6 GHz.

question_49972.question: What is the function of the 3GPP-Session-AMBR AVP in the RAA command?
question_49972.ground_truth: The 3GPP-Session-AMBR AVP in the RAA command indicates the maximum amount of bitrate assigned to downlink and uplink data traffic for the user.

question_49973.question: What is the role of NWDAF in the solution described in Solution #9 related to anomalous NF behaviour detection?
question_49973.ground_truth: NWDAF is used as a central NF or entry point to collect data in the solution described in Solution #9 related to anomalous NF behaviour detection.

question_49974.question: What is the false detection rate for the random access request in the NB M2M system for all simulation cases?
question_49974.ground_truth: The false detection rate for the random access request in the NB M2M system is very low in all the simulation cases, with no false detections within 1000000 realizations for all the 4 cases.

question_49975.question: What is the definition of the reference sensitivity power level (REFSENS) for both Intra-band non-contiguous CA and Intra-band contiguous CA?
question_49975.ground_truth: REFSENS is defined as the EIS level at the center of the quiet zone in the RX beam peak direction, at which the throughput shall meet or exceed the requirements for the specified reference measurement channel.

question_49976.question: In the test described in 3GPP TS 03.64 subclause 6.5.7.2, when is the mobile station required to use the continuous update timing advance mechanism?
question_49976.ground_truth: The mobile station is required to use the continuous update timing advance mechanism when the timing advance index (TAI) is included in the packet uplink assignment construction in the same timeslot as the assigned PDCH.

question_49977.question: What is the effect of inter-frequency measurements on the measurement gap pattern when using a single measurement gap pattern for all concurrent inter-frequency measurements?
question_49977.ground_truth: If the UE requires measurement gaps to perform inter-frequency measurements, a single measurement gap pattern is used for all concurrent inter-frequency measurements, including inter-frequency channel occupancy measurements.

question_49979.question: What is the purpose of including the SS-Status parameter in the result of a successful CFNRy erasure request?
question_49979.ground_truth: The SS-Status parameter is included to provide backwards compatibility with phase 1.

question_49981.question: What does the "Serving Cell ID" field indicate in the SP CSI reporting on PUCCH Activation/Deactivation MAC CE?
question_49981.ground_truth: The "Serving Cell ID" field in the SP CSI reporting on PUCCH Activation/Deactivation MAC CE indicates the identity of the Serving Cell for which the MAC CE applies.

question_49982.question: What is the behavior of AMF based on the "last message indication"?
question_49982.ground_truth: The behavior of AMF based on the "last message indication" is implementation specific.

question_49983.question: In what order should an MS order the PLMN/access technology combinations in Note 1h?
question_49983.ground_truth: In Note 1h, the MS should order the PLMN/access technology combinations in order of decreasing signal quality within each access technology, and the order between PLMN/access technology combinations with different access technologies is an MS implementation issue.

question_49984.question: In the context of MCPTT, what is the purpose of the associated-group-id element?
question_49984.ground_truth: The purpose of the <associated-group-id> element in the context of MCPTT is to indicate a MCPTT group ID that is associated with the TGI if the TGI can be determined to be a MCPTT group ID. This helps to establish the correct association in case the TGI represents a temporary group.

question_49985.question: What is the purpose of the "Power Saving based on AMF awareness of coverage information" solution?
question_49985.ground_truth: The purpose of this solution is to resolve Key Issue #2, which aims to enhance power-saving mechanisms for UE in discontinuous coverage, ensuring that the UE does not attempt PLMN access when there is no network coverage.

question_49987.question: What is the conformance requirement for the ISIM initialization?
question_49987.ground_truth: The conformance requirement for the ISIM initialization is defined in TS 31.103 clause 5.1.1.2.

question_49988.question: What information is stored in the MS for GPRS services when the GSIM is GPRS service-aware?
question_49988.ground_truth: If the GSIM is GPRS service-aware, then the IMSI, P-TMSI, P-TMSI Signature, Routeing Area, Kc, and CKSN stored in the GSIM shall be used for GPRS services.

question_49991.question: What is a key issue in P25 and TETRA systems regarding E2EE key management?
question_49991.ground_truth: A key issue is the lack of standardized protocols for binding a talk-group or other plaintext to a particular key, and that P25 allows users to override the radio's programmed key selection.

question_49992.question: What is the procedure to be followed by the UE for manual EPC network selection in WiMAX access?
question_49992.ground_truth: The UE shall present the list of available EPC networks to the user, and if HPLMN or equivalent PLMNs are available, they shall be shown in the highest ranking order.

question_49994.question: When can co-location requirements be tested using a standard test antenna instead of a co-location test antenna?
question_49994.ground_truth: Co-location requirements may be tested with a standard test antenna, such as a dipole, to take advantage of its easy availability, greater repeatability, reduced number of required antennas, and potentially higher gain in the direction of the AAS base station. The translation between measured power levels in the standard test antenna and the co-location reference antenna must be shown.

question_49995.question: What should the network return in response to a specific CFNRc interrogation request if it is not registered?
question_49995.ground_truth: The network shall return the SS-Status parameter indicating "not registered".

question_49996.question: Which TSs were turned into empty specifications and replaced by TSs 37.46x in the feature that transfers the contents of TSs 25.46x to 37.46x?

question_49997.question: What is the function of the DRA in handling multiple PCRFs in an operator's network realm?
question_49997.ground_truth: The DRA is used to keep status of the assigned PCRF for a certain UE and IP-CAN session across all reference points. It supports the functionality of a proxy agent and a redirect agent, and operates in either proxy or redirect mode based on operator's requirements.

question_49998.question: What determines the minimum guardband applied adjacent to 60 kHz SCS when multiple numerologies are multiplexed in the same symbol and the UE channel bandwidth is greater than 200 MHz?
question_49998.ground_truth: The minimum guardband applied adjacent to 60 kHz SCS when multiple numerologies are multiplexed in the same symbol and the UE channel bandwidth is greater than 200 MHz is the same as the minimum guardband defined for 120 kHz SCS for the same UE channel bandwidth.

question_49999.question: Under what conditions should an MS not consider a PLMN as a PLMN selection candidate?
question_49999.ground_truth: An MS should not consider a PLMN as a PLMN selection candidate if voice service was not possible on that PLMN, unless that PLMN is available in GERAN or UTRAN or no other allowed PLMN is available, or if the MS only supports EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection and the PLMN does not advertise support for it, or if the MS is in eCall only mode and the PLMN does not advertise support for eCall over IMS.

question_50002.question: What should the UE do if all segments of a warning message have been received within a period of 3 hours?
question_50002.ground_truth: The UE should assemble the warning message, forward the received warning message, messageIdentifier, serialNumber, and dataCodingScheme to upper layers, stop reception of SIB7, and discard the current values of messageIdentifier and serialNumber for SIB7.

question_50003.question: What is the impact of using external databases to manage users in the solution for web authentication of WIC?
question_50003.ground_truth: The solution may not support message waiting flag for SMS, as it generally requires support of HSS per user, and some solutions use external databases to manage users.

question_50004.question: How does the power pre-allocation work for non-empty non-scheduled flow in each uplink frequency when the UE has more than one Activated Uplink Frequency in FDD?
question_50004.ground_truth: The power is pre-allocated for all non-empty non-scheduled flow on the Primary Uplink Frequency, and the remaining power is split among all the Activated Uplink Frequencies in proportion to the respective serving grants.

question_50006.question: What should the SGSN/MME do upon receiving a reject message from the GGSN/PGW?
question_50006.ground_truth: The SGSN/MME can append a back off time to the reject message and send it to the MTC Device, or let the MTC Device randomize its local back-off time.

question_50007.question: Who triggers the paging procedure in Solution #11 when the UE does not respond to a paging message before the timer elapses?
question_50007.ground_truth: In Solution #11, when the UE does not respond to a paging message before the timer elapses, the network (AMF or MME) triggers the paging procedure.

question_50008.question: What action does the target MME take for each EPS bearer requested to be established during an Inter-RAT handover to the E-UTRAN?
question_50008.ground_truth: The target MME requests the eNodeB to allocate resources for all EPS bearers received from the source side and ignores any Activity Status Indicator within an EPS Bearer Context.

question_50011.question: What are the four types of networks that an AIPN should support to offer 3GPP services to users through Personal Networks, Personal Area Networks, Ad-hoc Networks, and Moving Networks?
question_50011.ground_truth: AIPN should support Personal Networks, Personal Area Networks (PAN), Ad-hoc Networks, and Moving Networks for offering 3GPP services to users.

question_50012.question: What technique is used to distinguish between RACH access requests made for alarm reporting and those made for normal reporting?
question_50012.ground_truth: CIoT devices include a single priority bit in the RACH access request to allow the BSS to distinguish between the two types of reporting.

question_50013.question: In what scenario is the Inter System Resume procedure applicable for handover?
question_50013.ground_truth: The Inter System Resume procedure is only applicable in the case of A/Gb mode to Iu mode handover.

question_50014.question: In the NDS/AF PKI architecture, what is the significance of the simple trust model and manual cross-certification?
question_50014.ground_truth: The simple trust model of the NDS/AF avoids the introduction of transitive trust and additional authorization information, implying that cross-certification is done manually to ensure security and verify the authenticity of certificates.

question_50016.question: What is the relationship between policy counters and Charging key?
question_50016.ground_truth: Policy counters and Charging key can have a 1-1 relationship or services that share the same Charging key can be associated with different policy counters, and vice versa.

question_50017.question: What is the difference between authorized transfer and autonomous transfer in UE-initiated IP flow mobility?
question_50017.ground_truth: Authorized transfer is used when IP flows can be transmitted on the source access but should preferably be transferred to a target access, while autonomous transfer is used when IP flows can no longer be transmitted on the source access. In authorized transfer, there is signaling between the UE and the network, while in autonomous transfer, the UE simply moves the traffic to the target access with no signaling.

question_50018.question: What should the P-CSCF add to the dialog request to indicate that it is an originating request?
question_50018.ground_truth: The "orig" parameter should be added to the dialog request to indicate that it is an originating request.

question_50019.question: What happens if there is repeated integrity checking failure during the Iu Release Request and Clear Request mapping?
question_50019.ground_truth: The message contents are invalid, and the request will be rejected due to signalling connection release or invalid message contents.

question_50020.question: What happens if the bearer(s) are still established after the GW (BBERF) removes the QoS rules in the PCRF-Initiated Gateway Control Session Termination procedure?
question_50020.ground_truth: The GW (BBERF) initiates an IP-CAN specific bearer removal procedure for the removed QoS rules.

question_50022.question: What is the requirement for the ePDG in selecting an ePDG for emergency services, as per phase 2?
question_50022.ground_truth: The ePDG should be selected in the same country as the UE and enable access to a PSAP in the same country as the UE, and be capable of supporting emergency services by providing access to a PSAP serving a geographic area in which the UE is located for any country where PSAPs serve different geographic areas.

question_50023.question: What is the initial condition for testing the SEND SHORT MESSAGE (normal) in 27.22.4.10.1.4.1?
question_50023.ground_truth: The ME should be connected to the SIM Simulator, powered on, and have performed the PROFILE DOWNLOAD procedure before this test.

question_50026.question: What does the "speech / data indicator" field in the "Channel Type" information element represent?
question_50026.ground_truth: The "speech / data indicator" field in the "Channel Type" information element represents the type of channel being requested, with possible values being speech, data, signalling, or speech + CTM Text Telephony.

question_50027.question: What is the purpose of quantization in the CSI compression use case?
question_50027.ground_truth: Quantization is used to compress the CSI generated at the UE side and transmitted to the gNB side, reducing the amount of data that needs to be transmitted.

question_50028.question: What is the goal of service quality optimization in 5G?
question_50028.ground_truth: The goal is to enable service quality optimization, such as minimizing average latency on the communication services provided to the URLLC category of services.

question_50029.question: Which stage 3 features and improvements were included in Release 17 to support various enhanced UAV scenarios for commercial and government sectors?
question_50029.ground_truth: TR 22.829, TS 22.261, and TS 22.125 were included in Release 17 to support various enhanced UAV scenarios for commercial and government sectors.

question_50032.question: What attribute(s) of the MBSUserDataIngSessionPatch data structure can be updated only if the corresponding MBS Distribution Session is in the "INACTIVE" state?
question_50032.ground_truth: The MBSUserDataIngSessionPatch data structure attributes that can be updated only if the corresponding MBS Distribution Session is in the "INACTIVE" state are all the other attributes within each map entry, except for the "mbsSessionId", the "mbsDisSessionId", and the "locationDependent" attributes.

question_50033.question: What is the required data type for the "serviceID" element in the "mbmsSecurityDeregister" complex type in the provided XML schema?
question_50033.ground_truth: The "serviceID" element must be of the "xs:anyURI" data type.

question_50034.question: What is the minimum requirement for ACK false alarm in multipath fading conditions?
question_50034.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for ACK false alarm in multipath fading conditions is that P(DTX->ACK) shall be 10-2 or less.

question_50035.question: What is the pre-condition for the NSI resource allocation optimization use case?
question_50035.ground_truth: The NSI(s) have been deployed, and the NSI management service producer is in operation.

question_50036.question: What should the NF Service Consumer do when it wants to request the SMF to cancel the handover of a PDU session?
question_50036.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should request the SMF to cancel the handover by sending a POST request with the hoState attribute updated to CANCELLED, and including cause information.

question_50037.question: Which frequency band was not considered in TR 38.815 for NR but introduced in the same Rel-15 work item?
question_50037.ground_truth: NR band n261 (TDD 27500 - 28350 MHz) was introduced by the same Rel-15 work item for NR, but was not considered in TR 38.815.

question_50038.question: In the CA-based scheme, what can be done to handle downlink interference for control signaling?
question_50038.ground_truth: Downlink interference coordination techniques can be used for the data part, and downlink interference coordination techniques can be used for the data part, and the control signaling can be scheduled on multiple component carriers with reduced transmission power.

question_50039.question: What is the purpose of the test tolerances (TT) in 3GPP TS 38.101-3?
question_50039.ground_truth: The test tolerances (TT) are used to relax the minimum requirements in 3GPP TS 38.101-3 to create test requirements. For some requirements, including regulatory requirements, the test tolerance is set to zero.

question_50040.question: What should the UE include in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if it supports UAS services?
question_50040.ground_truth: If the UE supports UAS services, it should set the UAS bit to "UAS services supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

question_50041.question: When performing the automatic commencement mode procedures, what must the IWF performing the participating role include in the SDP answer in the SIP 200 (OK) response to the SDP offer in the incoming SIP INVITE request?
question_50041.ground_truth: The IWF must include an "m=audio" media-level section for the accepted MCPTT speech media stream consisting of specific media-level attributes and the "i=" field set to "speech".

question_50042.question: How is the channel coding for HS-SCCH type 9 done in 4.6I.4?
question_50042.ground_truth: Channel coding for the HS-SCCH type 9 shall be done with the general method described in 4.2.3 with the following specific parameters: the rate 1/3 convolutional coding shall be used for HS-SCCH type 9.

question_50043.question: What is the role of the 2G+3G-SGSN during the TMSI reallocation process?
question_50043.ground_truth: The 2G+3G-SGSN sends a TMSI Reallocation Complete message to the VLR after the MS confirms the VLR TMSI.

question_50045.question: What is the procedure for the SCC AS when it receives a SIP BYE message from a remote ICS UE?
question_50045.ground_truth: When the SCC AS receives a SIP BYE message from a remote ICS UE, it responds with a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP BYE message, releases the I1 session, and sets a CS bearer release timer value if there are no more I1 service control sessions using the CS bearer.

question_50046.question: What is the maximum/minimum duration of the test?

question_50047.question: What is the subject of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Report 26.944?
question_50047.ground_truth: The report focuses on end-to-end multimedia service performance metrics for 3G networks.

question_50048.question: What action is taken by the RNC if the Non Searching Indication IE is present and UTRAN paging coordination is not required?
question_50048.ground_truth: The UTRAN paging coordination function is not activated.

question_50052.question: What technique is used for transmitting the first copy of the coded block as early as possible if the number of encoded bits is not greater than the number of available physical bits?
question_50052.ground_truth: Intra-coded-block interleaving is applied followed by repetition.

question_50054.question: What kind of information does the "WLAN" leaf in "ANDSF/HomeNetworkPreference/RanMobilitySetUsed/<X>/WLAN" contain?
question_50054.ground_truth: The WLAN leaf in "ANDSF/HomeNetworkPreference/RanMobilitySetUsed/<X>/WLAN" indicates the SSID of a WLAN.

question_50056.question: What should the network do when the PACKET~UPLINK~ACK/NACK message has the Final Ack Indicator bit set to '1' and the mobile station has not initiated the establishment of a new uplink TBF?
question_50056.ground_truth: The network should transmit the PACKET CONTROL ACKNOWLEDGEMENT message and release the TBF, and the mobile station should return to MAC-Idle state if in MAC-Shared state or MAC-Dedicated state if in MAC-DTM state.

question_50057.question: What is the ideal RSRP and RSRQ for the high speed train RRM?
question_50057.ground_truth: The ideal RSRP and RSRQ for the high speed train RRM are defined as the signal power under AWGN channel, with RSRP excluding noise and RSRQ including noise.

question_50058.question: What is the role of a TrGW in a 3GPP network?
question_50058.ground_truth: A TrGW, or Transition Gateway, is used in a 3GPP network to enable communication between IPv6 only terminals and IPv4 networks. It can translate IPv6 packets to IPv4 and vice versa.

question_50059.question: What kind of network does wireless operator A use to deploy the broadcast/multicast service with wide geographic area coverage?
question_50059.ground_truth: An overlay forming a single frequency network

question_50060.question: What is the method of test for Half Rate Uplink speech transcoding in the described passage?
question_50060.ground_truth: The SS sends a reset pulse to the MS on the digital audio interface. The SS synchronizes the input of the test sequences via the digital audio interface to the framing of the MS in the uplink. The SS then sends test sequences and records the 5,6 kbit/s output bit stream obtained by channel decoding the incoming bit stream from the air interface. The recordings are compared to the sequences describing the speech parameters contained in the files SEQ01.COD, SEQ02.COD and SEQ03.COD.

question_50061.question: What does the modified list of media information and FEC information in the SDP announcement include?
question_50061.ground_truth: The modified list of media information and FEC information in the SDP announcement includes the media descriptions (codecs, transport protocols, bitrates, destination IP addresses and ports) and FEC information (IP destination and port, and an upper bound to the additional latency due to FEC application).

question_50062.question: How does handover affect the control procedure and the operation of the service?
question_50062.ground_truth: Handover has no impact on the control procedure and the operation of the CFU service.

question_50063.question: What is the requirement for the UE to report RSTD for the reference cell and its neighbor cells in inter-frequency OTDOA measurements?
question_50063.ground_truth: The UE physical layer shall be capable of reporting RSTD for the reference cell and all the neighbor cells i out of at least (n-1) neighbor cells within specified conditions.

question_50064.question: What is the purpose of splitting the MS Classmark into distinct and independent information sets?
question_50064.ground_truth: The purpose is to allow the introduction of new radio access technologies in the future and to ensure the information set is independent of the type of network the MS is about to attach (A/Gb mode or Iu mode).

question_50065.question: What is the primary consideration when deciding whether to use cryptographic means to secure the interface between the Network Entity and an individual instance of SCEF, if the interface can be physically protected?
question_50065.ground_truth: If the interface can be physically protected, there is no need to use protection via cryptographic means.

question_50066.question: What is the confidence level required in the TDD Intra frequency conditional handover test case?

question_50068.question: When comparing time-dilated UMTS with N = 4 and UMTS, what is the approximate ratio of average burst rate if the load per MHz is the same?
question_50068.ground_truth: The average burst rate of UMTS would be approximately 4 times the average burst rate of Time dilated UMTS with N = 4.

question_50069.question: What device does Rosy use to establish a data connection to the network for her ECG?
question_50069.ground_truth: A smart phone acts as a gateway UE for Rosy's ECG.

question_50070.question: What information does the UAE server send when real-time UAV status information is available?
question_50070.ground_truth: The UAE server sends notification of one or more real-time UAV(s) status information to the UAS application specific server.

question_50071.question: What should the UE do if it receives Random Access Responses, but none of them contain a Random Access Preamble identifier that matches the transmitted Random Access Preamble?
question_50071.ground_truth: The UE shall re-transmit the preamble with the calculated PRACH transmission power if all received Random Access Responses contain Random Access Preamble identifiers that do not match the transmitted Random Access Preamble.

question_50072.question: What action does the UE take upon receiving the UEInformationRequest message if the logMeasReport is present and the RPLMN is included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarLogMeasReport?
question_50072.ground_truth: The UE sets the absoluteTimeStamp, traceReference, traceRecordingSessionRef, and tce-Id, and includes one or more entries from VarLogMeasReport starting from the entries logged first. If there are additional logged measurement entries, the UE sets the logMeasAvailable to include them.

question_50073.question: What does the "Scope-token" consist of in the context of the 3gpp-Sbi-Other-Access-Scopes header?
question_50073.ground_truth: The "Scope-token" consists of a list of space-delimited, case-sensitive strings, containing one or more NF service name(s) of the NF service producer and/or additional resource/operation-level scope(s) for these APIs that are not already contained in the 3gpp-Sbi-Access-Scope header.

question_50077.question: What should the MME do when it receives a Modify Bearer Response message?
question_50077.ground_truth: If the MME has sent the counter for the RRC Cause "MO Exception data" in the Modify Bearer Resquest, the MME shall reset the counter value when receiving the Modify Bearer Response message.

question_50078.question: What is the relationship between the NRM and the Federated Network Information Model (FNIM)?
question_50078.ground_truth: The NRM is a member of the FNIM, and its information is derived from the FNIM Umbrella Information Model (UIM).

question_50080.question: What is the function of the BMCA function in the NW-TT port, when the Announce receipt timeout or Sync receipt timeout has expired for a SlavePort?
question_50080.ground_truth: The BMCA function in the NW-TT port re-evaluates the DS-TT and NW-TT port states, when the Announce receipt timeout or Sync receipt timeout has expired for a SlavePort.

question_50081.question: What should be the condition for the successful completion of the test?
question_50081.ground_truth: For the successful completion of the test, the UE should transmit a MeasurementReport message triggered by Event A3, with a measurement reporting delay less than 3.2 s from the beginning of time period T2.

question_50082.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP technical report on Dual Connectivity (DC) of 4 LTE bands and 1 NR band?
question_50082.ground_truth: The purpose is to gather relevant background information and studies to address DC of 4 LTE bands (4DL/1UL) and 1 NR band (1DL/1UL) for the Rel-17 band combinations.

question_50083.question: When would the Node B include the Power Local Cell Group ID IE for the Local Cell in the RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message?
question_50083.ground_truth: When the Node B internal power resources are pooled for a group of Local Cells, the Node B shall include the Power Local Cell Group ID IE for the Local Cell in the RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message.

question_50084.question: What action would be taken if call A-B is disconnected based on note 7?
question_50084.ground_truth: The network will continue with call A-B as a normal call clearing operation.

question_50085.question: What are the potential specification impacts for sidelink positioning from the perspective of RAN1?
question_50085.ground_truth: The potential specification impacts for sidelink positioning from the perspective of RAN1 include specification changes to support PC5-only-based positioning and combination of Uu- and PC5-based positioning, introduction of RTT-type solution(s) using SL, SL-AoA, SL-TDOA, new sidelink reference signal (SL PRS) including details of sequence design, physical structure, resource mapping, SL PRS resource allocation scheme 1 and 2, SL PRS transmission in dedicated resource pool or shared resource pool, support of Open Loop Power Control (OLPC) for SL PRS transmissions, and details of sidelink positioning measurement reporting.

question_50087.question: What is the initial level of the SS's power control level in the setup procedure for a TCH/F?
question_50087.ground_truth: The power control level is set to maximum power in the initial setup procedure for a TCH/F.

question_50089.question: What is the primary cell referred to when the procedures described in clause 7.2 are applied for the secondary PUCCH group?
question_50089.ground_truth: The primary cell is referred to as the PUCCH-SCell of the secondary PUCCH group when the procedures described in clause 7.2 are applied for the secondary PUCCH group.

question_50090.question: What action should the GGSN take if it does not have the MBMS Bearer Context information for a requested MBMS bearer service?
question_50090.ground_truth: The GGSN sends a MBMS Registration Request to the BM-SC.

question_50091.question: What is the purpose of SMF receiving a redirection indication with PCF ID from the PCF for the PDU session?
question_50091.ground_truth: SMF shall terminate the current SM Policy Control association and reselects a PCF based on the received PCF ID.

question_50093.question: What key issue was identified in terms of IP connectivity between MC systems?
question_50093.ground_truth: The key issue is the lack of investigations on IP connectivity point-to-point and group standalone transmissions that involve two MC systems, as well as scenarios when the MC service user is abroad and uses home breakout or local breakout. The solution includes investigating and developing solutions for these scenarios.

question_50094.question: What shall the participating MCPTT function do upon receiving a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP BYE request the terminating MCPTT function sent?
question_50094.ground_truth: Forward a SIP 200 (OK) response to the MCPTT client and interact with the media plane for releasing media plane resources associated with the SIP session with the controlling MCPTT function.

question_50095.question: What is the effect of an embedded TFO message on the TFO frame?
question_50095.ground_truth: The TFO frame synchronization pattern will be affected by the presence of an embedded TFO message, without compromising the synchronization performances.

question_50096.question: What is the typical isolation for co-site inter-sector interference between a TX full power transmission of one sector to one receiver chain of the other sector?

question_50098.question: What is the purpose of the two-message assignment in 41.2.3.1?
question_50098.ground_truth: The purpose is to verify that the MS correctly decodes a two-message assignment and switches to the assigned PDCH.

question_50100.question: What message types require both SGW FQ-CSID and MME FQ-CSID in the case of inter SGW HO/TAU when the MME does not support the feature?
question_50100.ground_truth: Modify Bearer Request and Proxy Binding Update (if PMIPv6 is used)

question_50101.question: Which types of interference are considered in the evaluation of the techniques discussed in sections 8.2 and 8.3?
question_50101.ground_truth: Sensitivity limited performance, co-channel interference performance, adj channel interference performance, and DTS-2 performance.

question_50105.question: What are the two considered bitrates for the video encoding process?
question_50105.ground_truth: The two bitrates are 64 kbit/s and 128 kbit/s.

question_50107.question: What security mechanisms are used for the interface between W-5GAN and 5GC?
question_50107.ground_truth: The N2 interface between the W-5GAN and the AMF is secured as defined in clause 9.2 of the present document, and the N3 interface between the W-5GAN and the UPF is secured as defined in clause 9.3 of the present document.

question_50108.question: What should the SCC AS do upon receiving a SIP 18x response from the remote UE when sending SIP INVITE requests on both legs?
question_50108.ground_truth: Upon receiving a SIP 18x response from the remote UE, the SCC AS should send a SIP 18x response on both legs, i.e., with the ICS UE and with the CS domain.

question_50109.question: What is the purpose of the Core Network Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP) as defined in the present document?
question_50109.ground_truth: The Core Network Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP) defines requirements for the management of 3GPP network resources, specifically for the Core Network (CN) network resources, including support for converged networks and consistency between UTRAN/GERAN and CN parameters.

question_50110.question: What is the role of the "fallback UE radio capability" in Solution #14?
question_50110.ground_truth: The "fallback UE radio capability" is used by Rel-16 CN nodes when communicating with pre-Rel-16 RAN nodes to avoid pre-Rel-16 RAN nodes needing to retrieve a "full" UE Radio Access Capability over the radio interface.

question_50112.question: What are the requirements for architecture and migration of Next Generation Radio Access Technologies?
question_50112.ground_truth: The RAN architecture for the Next Generation Radio Access Technologies shall support tight interworking between the new RAT and LTE, connectivity through multiple transmission points, different options and flexibility for splitting the RAN architecture, and deployment flexibility e.g. to host relevant RAN, CN and application functions close together at the edges of the network.

question_50114.question: What is Non-Seamless WLAN Offload (NSWO)?
question_50114.ground_truth: Non-Seamless WLAN Offload (NSWO) is a capability of routing specific IP flows over WLAN access without traversing the EPC.

question_50116.question: Which authentication methods can be used by the NF Service Consumer to authenticate to the NF Service Producer for indirect communication if the PLMN uses token-based authorization and its policy mandates that the NRF authenticate the NF Service Consumer before granting an access token?
question_50116.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer can authenticate at the application layer using CCA based authentication as specified in clause 13.3.8. This authentication is optional to use and based on operator policy.

question_50118.question: What is required for IP-CAN bearer specific offline charging, as per TS 23.203?
question_50118.ground_truth: IP-CAN bearer specific rating group/service identifier, as defined in clause 5.3.1.1, is required for IP-CAN bearer specific offline charging.

question_50119.question: What is the effect of expiration of barring timers on access control?
question_50119.ground_truth: At expiry of barring timers, the indication of alleviation of access barring is indicated to the NAS on a per access category basis, allowing the NAS to reinitiate the procedure to send the initial NAS message if still needed.

question_50120.question: What are the potential contents of the iE-Extensions field in the PDUSessionResourceModifyIndicationTransfer message?
question_50120.ground_truth: The iE-Extensions field in the PDUSessionResourceModifyIndicationTransfer message can contain ID-SecondaryRATUsageInformation, ID-SecurityResult, ID-RedundantDLQosFlowPerTNLInformation, ID-AdditionalRedundantDLQosFlowPerTNLInformation, or ID-GlobalRANNodeID.

question_50121.question: What information element indicates to the S-CSCF the Registered Private Identities, which were registered with the Public Identity received in the request command?

question_50122.question: What should the 5G-RG do when it receives an EAP response/Identity with a NAI-based SUPI from an AUN3 device behind it?
question_50122.ground_truth: The 5G-RG shall construct a SUCI using the null-scheme from the NAI-based SUPI if the NAI-based SUPI is received from the AUN3 device in step 3 (as in clause 7B.7.2).

question_50125.question: What instruction does the AMF provide in the Registration Accept message regarding the registration of PDU Sessions in the UE?
question_50125.ground_truth: The AMF indicates the established PDU Sessions to the UE in the PDU Session status. The UE removes locally any internal resources related to PDU Sessions that are not marked as established in the received PDU Session status.

question_50126.question: In what mode must the UE be for the local IP address in traffic flow aggregate description and TFT filter to be supported in order to include the IE in the message?
question_50126.ground_truth: The UE must be in NB-S1 mode.

question_50127.question: What is the purpose of the Dynamic Resource Allocation Control (DRAC) procedure in the network?
question_50127.ground_truth: The Dynamic Resource Allocation Control (DRAC) procedure in the network regular broadcasts parameters to the UE, such as transmission probability and maximum total bit rate, to control the UE's uplink DCHs.

question_50128.question: What are the advantages of using HTTP/2 for the heartbeat mechanism in the 5GC compared to HTTP/1.1?
question_50128.ground_truth: HTTP/2 has several advantages over HTTP/1.1 for the heartbeat mechanism in the 5GC, including the multiplexing of HTTP requests over the same TCP connection which prevents HOL blocking at the HTTP level and eliminates the need to open multiple TCP connections towards the same HTTP server. Additionally, HTTP/2 provides binary framing which allows for easier and more efficient parsing of HTTP frames and includes header compression for reduced overhead.

question_50129.question: What is the procedure for H-ANDSF discovery by the UE during DNS lookup resolution?
question_50129.ground_truth: The UE builds a Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) that is set to the ANFSF-SN FQDN and included in the DNS request. The UE then selects the IP address of the H-ANDSF included in the DNS response message.

question_50130.question: What is the role of the Technical Specification Group (TSG) in the 3GPP?
question_50130.ground_truth: The Technical Specification Group (TSG) is responsible for producing technical specifications and reports for the 3GPP. The contents of the present document are subject to continuing work within the TSG and may change following formal TSG approval.

question_50131.question: What should the MCPTT client include in the Accept-Contact header field of the SIP INVITE request for an MCPTT group call?
question_50131.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should include an Accept-Contact header field containing the g.3gpp.mcptt media feature tag along with the "require" and "explicit" header field parameters in the SIP INVITE request for an MCPTT group call.

question_50132.question: In what scenario would the variable "contentionDetected" be set to true?
question_50132.ground_truth: The variable "contentionDetected" would be set to true if the random access attempt is a 4-step random access attempt and the SS/PBCH block RSRP of the SS/PBCH block corresponding to the random-access resource used in the random-access attempt is at or above rsrp-ThresholdSSB.

question_50133.question: How does the 5G system provide the real-time virtual scene to local users in IoE based social networking services?
question_50133.ground_truth: The real-time virtual scene is provided to local users as an AR scenario by proximity smart terminals.

question_50137.question: What is the purpose of L3 filtering in the measurement reporting delay?
question_50137.ground_truth: L3 filtering can cause an additional delay in the measurement reporting delay.

question_50139.question: What must the manufacturer declare regarding the NB-IoT operating mode for the declared supported band?
question_50139.ground_truth: The manufacturer must declare which NB-IoT operating mode (standalone, in-band, or guard band) the base station supports for each declared supported band.

question_50140.question: What is the procedure followed by the NF Service Consumer during N2 based handover for exchanging N3/N9 forwarding tunnel information with the NF Service Producer?
question_50140.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer sends a POST request containing dataForwarding attribute set to true, n9DlForwardingTnlList attribute carrying the N9 downlink indirect data forwarding tunnel(s) info of target I-UPF, and n9UlForwardingTnlList attribute carrying the N9 uplink indirect data forwarding tunnel(s) info of target I-UPF.

question_50142.question: What is the network element that sends an "Info request" when a mobile number is roaming?

question_50143.question: What is the purpose of NWDAF in monitoring the behavior of NFs?
question_50143.ground_truth: NWDAF supports the monitoring of the behavior of all NFs to ensure that they behave as defined/specified. If the NFs behave erroneously, NWDAF should be able to detect the anomaly so that appropriate steps can be taken.

question_50144.question: How much power can be harvested by an Ambient IoT device for home asset management if the energy is harvested from radio waves?
question_50144.ground_truth: Only tens of micro-watts power can be harvested by an Ambient IoT device for home asset management if the energy is harvested from radio waves.

question_50145.question: What should the NTXU,countedpercell value be for FCC guidance in MIMO systems in Region 2?
question_50145.ground_truth: NTXU,countedpercell should be equal to 1 for the purposes of calculating the spurious emissions limits in 6.6.6.2, 6.6.6.3 or 6.6.6.4 in Region 2.

question_50146.question: What is a required capability for multimode User Equipments (UEs) that support 3GPP and WLAN accesses for simultaneous active mode of operation?
question_50146.ground_truth: Support for simultaneous active mode of operation between different technology sets is not required for UEs that support 3GPP and WLAN accesses.

question_50147.question: What is the minimum requirement for a UTRA FDD OTA sensitivity in the presence of an interfering signal?
question_50147.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for a UTRA FDD OTA sensitivity in the presence of an interfering signal is defined in subclause 10.2.3.

question_50149.question: Who is informed about the user exiting the conference call in the described procedure?
question_50149.ground_truth: The conference server informs everybody about the user exiting the conference call, giving details on which user and their order in the call.

question_50150.question: What is the effect of a RRCConnectionReject message with deprioritisationReq on the UE?
question_50150.ground_truth: The UE considers all E-UTRA frequencies and inter-RAT frequencies to be of the lowest priority while T325 is running, and it deletes any stored deprioritisation request(s) when a PLMN selection is performed.

question_50151.question: What should the UE do during T2 if there are no uplink resources for reporting the valid CSI in subframe (m+49)?
question_50151.ground_truth: The UE should use the next available uplink resource for reporting the corresponding valid CSI.

question_50155.question: What is the purpose of R-5.1.1-002 requirement in the 5G system?
question_50155.ground_truth: The R-5.1.1-002 requirement in the 5G system is about providing a mechanism to associate and coordinate data flows related to one or multiple UEs, which is particularly useful for digital twin applications provided by mobile metaverse services.

question_50156.question: What should a UE do when it detects a DCI format providing the PDCCH monitoring adaptation field indicating to skip PDCCH monitoring for the duration on the active DL BWP of a SpCell?
question_50156.ground_truth: After the UE detects a DCI format providing the PDCCH monitoring adaptation field indicating to the UE to skip PDCCH monitoring for the duration on the active DL BWP of a SpCell, when contention resolution is successful, the UE resumes PDCCH monitoring on the SpCell.

question_50157.question: What is the format of text provided by MBMS User Services?
question_50157.ground_truth: The format of text provided by MBMS User Services is a minimum requirement, and other media types such as still images, video, speech, and mono/stereo audio are also supported.

question_50160.question: What is the E-UTRA serving cell for the EN-DC setup in the test environment?
question_50160.ground_truth: Cell 1, also known as the PCell, is the E-UTRA serving cell for the EN-DC setup.

question_50162.question: What factors should be considered in NR design regarding UE radio access capabilities?
question_50162.ground_truth: Hardware sharing between NR and other radio transceivers, interference between NR and other radio transceivers, and exceptional UE issues like overheating problems.

question_50164.question: What is the purpose of verification of cell reselection as implicitly tested in subclause 20.3?
question_50164.ground_truth: The purpose of verification of cell reselection in subclause 20.3 is to ensure that the MS can perform cell reselection correctly and that it meets the requirements of the 3GPP TS 05.08, subclause 6.6.1.

question_50165.question: What is the scope of the tokenCAPIF in the TLS with OAuth token method?
question_50165.ground_truth: The scope of the tokenCAPIF in the TLS with OAuth token method includes API invoker ID, service API ID, and resource owner ID.

question_50166.question: What are the main components of the MExE service environment?
question_50166.ground_truth: The MExE service environment consists of two main parts: the user interface (buttons, menus, screens, and MMI) and the MExE MMI (providing support for services and functionality on the MExE device). The MExE MMI is not standardized, allowing for manufacturer innovation and catering to evolving market needs while MExE services operate within its capabilities.

question_50167.question: What should a call control entity do when it receives a STATUS message with an incompatible call control state?
question_50167.ground_truth: It should clear the call by sending a RELEASE COMPLETE message with cause #101 "message not compatible with protocol state".

question_50170.question: What is the purpose of the "Authenticate" service operation offered by the AUSF?
question_50170.ground_truth: The "Authenticate" service operation permits the requester network function, usually the Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF), to initiate the authentication of the UE by providing the UE's identifier and serving network name to the AUSF.

question_50172.question: What is the required BER (bit error rate) for any measured E-UTRA carrier as defined in clause 7.7.5.4-1, 7.7.5.4-2, and 7.7.5.4-3?
question_50172.ground_truth: The BER for any measured E-UTRA carrier should be less than or equal to 0.001.

question_50173.question: What issue can arise when using acoustic echo suppression in the mobile environment?
question_50173.ground_truth: Severe speech clipping and noise contrast can occur.

question_50174.question: What is the purpose of checking the topologically correct IPv4 Home address in the Binding Lifetime Extension procedure of the LMA?
question_50174.ground_truth: The LMA checks if the received IPv4 Home address is topologically correct to ensure a valid IPv4 Home address assignment for the UE's PDN connection.

question_50177.question: What message is sent by the network to the UE to reject the modification of a dedicated bearer resource?

question_50178.question: What protection mechanism is defined for the NIDD API in the NEF?

question_50179.question: What actions does an SMLC perform after a restart to restore data for a specific LMU?
question_50179.ground_truth: The SMLC opens a signalling connection to the LMU, sends an LLP Reset message to the LMU, and the LMU cancels any LCS measurement and O&M tasks and sends an LLP Reset acknowledgement to the SMLC.

question_50180.question: What are the service flow requirements for cloud rendering for gaming?
question_50180.ground_truth: The service flows for cloud rendering for gaming include low packet delay and high bandwidth requirements for uplink and downlink traffic, guaranteed data rate and high frame rate, and low packet loss rate for sensor data and rendered multimedia data.

question_50181.question: Which header shall be supported by the Data Collection AF at reference points R1, R2, R3, and R4 as per clause 5.3.2.4?

question_50183.question: What is the final flag that is used to represent the activity of the signal?
question_50183.ground_truth: The final flag that is used to represent the activity of the signal is a combination of three flags, representing different trade-offs between quality and efficiency. This flag is set to one for active signals, which are any useful signals bearing meaningful information, and set to zero for inactive signals, which have no meaningful information.

question_50184.question: What must the MCData client do upon the expiry of timer TFS1 in step 9.3.2.3.1 of the TS 24.282 clause?
question_50184.ground_truth: The MCData client generates a SDS OFF-NETWORK MESSAGE message, sets the Sender MCData user ID IE to its own MCData user ID, and increments the counter CFS1(SDS retransmission) by 1.

question_50186.question: What determines the maximum allowed rate to be used in E-TFC selection for inactive processes in TDD?
question_50186.ground_truth: The maximum allowed rate to be used in E-TFC selection for inactive processes in TDD is 0.

question_50187.question: What is the purpose of the "Confidentiality, integrity and replay protections over SBA interface" requirement for the AAnF network product?
question_50187.ground_truth: The "Confidentiality, integrity and replay protections over SBA interface" requirement ensures that data transferred over the SBA interface between the AAnF and AF/NEF or AUSF is confidentiality, integrity, and replay protected.

question_50188.question: What is the role of the User Info ID in the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery?
question_50188.ground_truth: The User Info ID is a unique identifier for each Prose UE, which is used to request and return security materials during the UE-to-UE Relay Discovery procedure.

question_50190.question: What is the name of the 3D video packing format that consists in sub-sampling the two views which compose a stereoscopic 3D video and pack them together in a 2D frame infrastructure?

question_50191.question: What is a key issue for supporting unauthenticated UEs access to RLOS using EPC?
question_50191.ground_truth: A large number of malicious and unauthenticated UEs with RLOS connection could deplete network resources in EPS network by incurring additional signalling and generating traffic.

question_50192.question: What is the purpose of using unique device identifiers in the 5G system?
question_50192.ground_truth: The purpose of using unique device identifiers in the 5G system is to reliably identify a recovered smartphone as stolen and support the tracing of illegal reuse, repurpose or resale of stolen smartphones.

question_50195.question: What is the IP Multicast address used for in the one-to-many communication session?
question_50195.ground_truth: The IP Multicast address is used to identify the one-to-many communication session.

question_50196.question: What memory component is used to generate the time-domain signal at the CELP sampling rate in the MDCT based TCX decoder?
question_50196.ground_truth: The MDCT based TCX decoder generates two time-domain signals, one at the output sampling rate and one at the CELP sampling rate. The signal at the CELP sampling rate is used to update the CELP memories.

question_50198.question: What information does the I-SMF provide to the SMF regarding DNAI for local traffic steering?
question_50198.ground_truth: The I-SMF provides the SMF with a list of DNAI it supports for a PDU session, and the SMF may provide the DNAI(s) of interest for local traffic steering to the I-SMF. The I-SMF is responsible for the insertion, modification, and removal of UPF(s) for local traffic steering.

question_50200.question: What should the en-gNB do upon receiving the UE CONTEXT RELEASE message during EN-DC for E-RABs for which data forwarding has been performed?
question_50200.ground_truth: The en-gNB should continue forwarding U-plane data as long as packets are received from the EPC or the buffer has not been emptied.

question_50201.question: What is the synchronization requirement for the UE before the start of the time duration T1?
question_50201.ground_truth: The UE shall be fully synchronized to the PSCell before the start of the time duration T1.

question_50203.question: In which clause of TS 38.331 does it specify that if AS security has been successfully activated, the UE shall perform certain actions related to Rx-Tx time difference measurement?

question_50204.question: What is required for the signServiceAgreement() method to complete the signing of the service agreement?
question_50204.ground_truth: The signServiceAgreement() method completes the signing of the service agreement only after the digital signature verification of the response of signServiceAgreement() on the application's IpAppServiceAgreementManagement interface has been completed.

question_50205.question: What must the ME do with new cell broadcast pages?
question_50205.ground_truth: The ME shall identify new cell broadcast pages by their message identifier, serial number, and page values.

question_50207.question: What procedure is followed to calculate the 2D position error when testing A-GPS positioning?
question_50207.ground_truth: The procedure involves comparing the reported Location Information in the Measure Position Response message against the simulated position of the MS, and then calculating the 2D position error as specified in sub clause 70.11.4.2.3.

question_50208.question: What is the measured value that will be used to decide whether the equipment meets the requirements of the test report?
question_50208.ground_truth: The measured value related to the corresponding limit will be used to decide if the equipment meets the requirements of the test report.

question_50210.question: What should a mobile station in packet transfer mode do, if it receives an uplink assignment during the TBF release procedure and there is no ongoing uplink TBF?
question_50210.ground_truth: The mobile station in packet transfer mode shall return to packet idle mode.

question_50211.question: What is the default value for the "<allow-signalling-protection>" element of the "<protection-between-mcdata-servers>" element?
question_50211.ground_truth: The default value for the "<allow-signalling-protection>" element of the "<protection-between-mcdata-servers>" element is "true", indicating that signaling protection between MCData servers is enabled.

question_50212.question: What should the UE do if the contention resolution timer expires?
question_50212.ground_truth: The UE should re-select a preamble and transmit with the calculated PRACH transmission power when the back off time expires.

question_50213.question: What is needed to allow the user to remain anonymous towards the Relying Party in scenarios 2 and 4 while still allowing GBA authentication?
question_50213.ground_truth: The user's AA identifier and the Relying Party's OpenID Authentication Request, which are needed to initiate the GBA authentication with the OP/NAF, can be done without any GBA specific user information in the initial User-Supplied Identifier. This allows the user to remain anonymous towards the Relying Party.

question_50214.question: What does a suffix A subclause specify in TS 36.102 for UE category M1?
question_50214.ground_truth: In TS 36.102, the suffix A subclause specifies the applicable minimum requirements for UE category M1 where they differ from the requirements in the main subclause.

question_50215.question: When must the AMF update the Allowed CAG list in the Mobility Restrictions towards NG-RAN?
question_50215.ground_truth: The AMF must update the Allowed CAG list in the Mobility Restrictions towards NG-RAN if the evaluation of the validity condition of an entry in the Allowed CAG list changes between true and false.

question_50216.question: What is the number of timing advance estimations used in the RLC Data Block method for obtaining a timing advance value?

question_50217.question: What happens when a network element involved in CFNRy is of Phase~1?
question_50217.ground_truth: If any network element involved is of Phase~1, only information concerning basic service groups for which the activation state has the value "Active and Operative" will be returned, and CFNRy Registration requests which use a subaddress and all CFNRy Activation and Deactivation requests will be rejected.

question_50218.question: What is the purpose of the Additional OTA transmitter spurious emissions requirements in section 6.5.4.5.4?
question_50218.ground_truth: These requirements are intended to protect systems operating in frequency ranges other than the repeater-Node, and may be applied as optional or mandatory protection by local or regional regulations for an NR operating band.

question_50219.question: What is the procedure for handling a UE's inter-system change from E-UTRAN to GERAN/UTRAN for the first time?
question_50219.ground_truth: The EPS bearer context will include both EPS specific information and GERAN/UTRAN specific information.

question_50220.question: What is the authentication mechanism used in the 3GPP system to access the network?
question_50220.ground_truth: Authentication is performed using a SIM/USIM application resident on a UICC. The USIM on the UICC is required to access the 3GPP system, and only a single USIM can be active at any time.

question_50221.question: When should the UE initiate the detach procedure?
question_50221.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the detach procedure if it is switched off, the USIM card is removed, if it wishes to detach for EPS services, if it wishes to detach for non-EPS services, or as part of the eCall inactivity procedure.

question_50222.question: What is the action taken by the SS after T3 expires in the test procedure?
question_50222.ground_truth: After T3 expires, the SS transmits an RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection including the release of established radio bearers and all radio resources.

question_50223.question: Which entity is required to store a TMPI together with the corresponding IMPI until the next bootstrapping procedure is executed using this TMPI?

question_50224.question: What is the minimum number of downlink cells required for a UE to support NR-DC operation?
question_50224.ground_truth: For a UE to support NR-DC operation, it needs to be capable of monitoring at least one downlink cell for each of the following combinations: Ncells,r15/r16, Ncells,r15/r17, and Ncells,r16/r17.

question_50225.question: In response to a location request from a VAL user, what should the SLM-C include in the <report-request> element?
question_50225.ground_truth: The SLM-C should include at least one child element: an <immediate-report-indicator> element and/or the location reporting elements that are requested.

question_50226.question: What action does the NF service consumer take in response to the NWDAF containing MTLF reporting the ML model information?
question_50226.ground_truth: The NF service consumer responds to the NWDAF containing MTLF with an HTTP "204 No Content" message.

question_50227.question: What is the use of the UE-CapabilityRequestFilterCommon?
question_50227.ground_truth: The UE-CapabilityRequestFilterCommon is used to request filtered UE capabilities. The filter is common for all capability containers that are requested.

question_50229.question: When shall a system include the Floor Indicator field with appropriate indications?
question_50229.ground_truth: When a group call is a broadcast group call, a system call, an emergency call, an imminent peril call, or a temporary group session

question_50230.question: What field in the DL TX Power Adjustment MAC CE and Desired DL TX Power Adjustment MAC CE contains the adjustment to a node's DL TX power or desired DL TX power adjustment?

question_50231.question: What is the purpose of the Supported Codec List information element in 3GPP TS 24.008?
question_50231.ground_truth: The Supported Codec List information element in 3GPP TS 24.008 is used to specify the coding of the supported codec list elements for the UMTS radio access technology.

question_50233.question: What should the UAV include in the Direct Communication Request when setting up C2 communication with PC5?
question_50233.ground_truth: The UAV should include the U2X service type (indicating C2 service), UAV identifier, UAV-C identifier, U2X service security policy specific to the C2 service, security capability, and key establishment information in the Direct Communication Request when setting up C2 communication with PC5.

question_50234.question: Which frequency bands, when used for carrier aggregation in LTE Advanced, may result in intermodulation products falling within the receive block of Band 20?

question_50235.question: What is the purpose of the media handling capabilities of a telepresence client (TP UE) as specified in the document?
question_50235.ground_truth: The media handling capabilities of a telepresence client (TP UE) are specified in the document to support conversational speech, video and text transported over RTP in an IMS-based telepresence service.

question_50237.question: What is the purpose of creating 5GVN group membership data when creating a 5GVN group for 5G LAN-Type communication?
question_50237.ground_truth: The 5GVN group membership data is used to map the VAL group ID to the External Group ID and make a list of GPSIs corresponding to the identity list provided by the VAL server.

question_50239.question: What is an XML schema in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
question_50239.ground_truth: In the context of 3GPP technical specifications, an XML schema is a more powerful definition than a DTD. It defines structure and content constraints to be respected by an XML document to conform with this XML schema. It is an XML document itself that conforms with the XML schema for XML schemas.

question_50240.question: What is the name of the complexType named "SNR-rangeType" which contains a sequence of "Low-SNR" and "High-SNR" elements?

question_50241.question: What should the timestamp field of the ETSI TS 102 232-1 PSHeader structure be set to?
question_50241.ground_truth: The timestamp field of the ETSI TS 102 232-1 PSHeader structure should be set to the time at which the RCS server event was observed (i.e. the timestamp field of the xIRI).

question_50242.question: What should the UE do when it wants to request a modification of bearer resources for a traffic flow aggregate, and the existing GBR needs to be modified?
question_50242.ground_truth: The UE should set the TFT operation code in the Traffic flow aggregate IE to "no TFT operation" and include the packet filter identifier(s) to which the change of the GBR applies in the Packet filter identifier parameter in the parameters list, and indicate the new GBR requested for the EPS bearer context in the Required traffic flow QoS IE.

question_50244.question: What is the purpose of the "Application Context Transfer" procedure in the context of Edge Computing?
question_50244.ground_truth: The Application Context Transfer procedure is part of the service continuity mechanism in Edge Computing, which involves the transfer of the Application Context between the source and target Edge Application Servers during service handover.

question_50246.question: What steps does the AMF take upon receiving a DL GENERIC TRANSPORT message with the message container type IE set to "SMS"?
question_50246.ground_truth: The AMF forwards the SMS message of the UL GENERIC TRANSPORT message towards the SMSF associated with the UE.

question_50247.question: What message does the gNB-DU send to transfer information associated to an F1-C interface instance?
question_50247.ground_truth: The gNB-DU sends the F1 SETUP REQUEST message to the gNB-CU, transferring information associated to an F1-C interface instance.

question_50248.question: What is the purpose of the document "High power UE (power class 2) for EN-DC with 1 LTE band + 1 NR TDD band" in the 3GPP technical specification group?
question_50248.ground_truth: The purpose is to gather relevant background information and studies to address Power Class 2 EN-DC of 1 LTE band and 1 NR TDD band for the Rel-17 band combinations.

question_50254.question: What is the function of the BM-SC in MBMS user service provisioning and delivery?
question_50254.ground_truth: The BM-SC provides various MBMS user service specific services such as provisioning and delivery of MBMS user services.

question_50255.question: What is measured during T1 and T2 in the test described in 7.8.2.4.2?
question_50255.ground_truth: During T1, the downlink DPCH/Ior power ratio averaged over one slot is measured, and during T2, the SS waits for T1 to expire and measures the downlink DPCH/Ior power ratio.

question_50256.question: What is the recommended action to prevent antenna PIM causing BS receiver desensitization on Bands 5, 8, 26, 28, 42, 43, and 44 when transmitting on Bands 5 and 46?
question_50256.ground_truth: It is recommended that Bands 5 and 46 BS transmitters do not share the same antenna with Bands 5, 8, 26, 28, 42, 43, and 44 BS receivers, so as to prevent antenna PIM causing Bands 5, 8, 26, 28, 42, 43, and 44 BS receiver desensitization.

question_50257.question: What is the purpose of the file format defined in 3GPP TS 32.432?
question_50257.ground_truth: The file format defined in 3GPP TS 32.432 is for the bulk transfer of performance measurement results to the NM. It specifies the format for measurement result files that can be transferred from the network (NEs or EM) to the NM.

question_50258.question: What is the requirement for TWAN support in the solution for emergency session over TWAN for an UE with USIM?
question_50258.ground_truth: The solution assumes the TWAN supports emergency services. This means that the TWAN should be capable of providing access for emergency services.

question_50260.question: What should the AMF do if a PDU Session Establishment Request is received from an Emergency Registered UE and the Request Type is not set to "Emergency Request" or "Existing Emergency PDU Session"?
question_50260.ground_truth: The AMF should reject the request with an appropriate reject cause.

question_50262.question: What is the minimum rejection required by the BS receiver IF and baseband filter with 5 MHz uplink channel bandwidth and 5 MHz in-band blocker?
question_50262.ground_truth: The minimum rejection required by the BS receiver IF and baseband filter with 5 MHz uplink channel bandwidth and 5 MHz in-band blocker is 54.72 dB.

question_50264.question: What actions does the IWK-SCEF take when the request indicates continuous reporting with successful authorization?
question_50264.ground_truth: The IWK-SCEF stores the received parameters, sends an acknowledgement to the MME/SGSN, and starts watching for the indicated Monitoring Event(s).

question_50265.question: What is the maximum allowable measurement reporting delay for Event B2 in test 1 and test 3?

question_50266.question: What action should a MS take when it receives a rejection cause #7 for GPRS services?
question_50266.ground_truth: The MS should set the GPRS update status to GU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, delete any P-TMSI, P-TMSI signature, RAI and GPRS ciphering key sequence number, and consider the SIM/USIM as invalid for GPRS services until switching off or SIM/USIM removal. The new GMM state is GMM-DEREGISTERED and the new MM state is MM IDLE.

question_50267.question: What event is represented by the "UCM.EntryUpdateReq" measurement received by the NEF?
question_50267.ground_truth: It represents the number of UCMF dictionary entry update requests received by the NEF from the AF.

question_50268.question: In which scenario should the SEPP select the data encryption and modification policy applicable for the specific notification type and target PLMN, using the notification type list stored as specified in subclause 5.2.3.3?
question_50268.ground_truth: When the incoming HTTP/2 message has the "3gpp-Sbi-Callback" header.

question_50271.question: What is the purpose of the Common ID procedure in the specified context?
question_50271.ground_truth: The purpose of the Common ID procedure is to inform the RNC about the permanent NAS UE Identity (i.e. IMSI) of a user, which can be used for UTRAN paging coordination, access control, and authorizing the use of radio resources.

question_50272.question: How is the magnitude spectrum calculated for the sinusoidal analysis in Phase ECU?
question_50272.ground_truth: The magnitude spectrum is calculated by windowing the analysis frame buffer with a Hamming-rectangular window, passing it through a FFT, and saving the resulting spectrum. Then, the peaks of this magnitude spectrum are located by a peak picking method, and their positions are further refined by using parabolic interpolation to make them available in highest possible resolution.

question_50273.question: What security measure is not required at the MAC layer if confidentiality and integrity protection are provided at layers above it?

question_50274.question: What is the maximum allowed probability of ACK/NACK feedback loss on any active serving cell for a UE performing RLM/BFD measurements on a deactivated PSCell in bfd-and-RLM with value true mode?

question_50275.question: What is the purpose of adding a bearer RAT type parameter in the EPS?
question_50275.ground_truth: The purpose is to identify unlicensed spectrum in a dual connectivity environment and to define a bearer RAT type information per bearer.

question_50276.question: What is specified in clause 6.9.2.2.1 of the document, in regards to HTTP standard headers?
question_50276.ground_truth: This clause specifies the usage of HTTP standard headers, as specified in clause 5.2.2 of 3GPP TS 29.500.

question_50277.question: What IE specifies an integer in 40 bit binary representation, denoting compressed originator-to-dispatcher information in the GCC protocol?

question_50278.question: What is the purpose of the REPORT record in MMS service interception?
question_50278.ground_truth: The REPORT record is used to convey the events of MMS service interception.

question_50279.question: What level of security does SDES offer for IMS media compared to SIP signalling?
question_50279.ground_truth: SDES provides the same level of security for IMS media as for SIP signalling. It allows user plane traffic to be properly secured based on the keys exchanged by SDES.

question_50280.question: Is the requirement for multiplexing of multicast/broadcast and unicast relevant to dedicated MBMS networks?
question_50280.ground_truth: No, it is not relevant to dedicated MBMS networks.

question_50282.question: When should the MAC entity set the resource reservation interval in the re-selected resource to replace pre-empted resource?
question_50282.ground_truth: It is up to UE implementation to decide whether to set the resource reservation interval in the re-selected resource to replace pre-empted resource.

question_50283.question: What should the originating transmission participant do when an MCVideo call is established with a session announcement including an explicit transmission request?
question_50283.ground_truth: The originating transmission participant should create an instance of a transmission participant state transition diagram for basic operation state machine, send Transmission Granted message towards other transmission participants with the granted priority, MCVideo user's own MCVideo ID, and call types if applicable, and enter the 'O: transmission arbitration' state.

question_50284.question: What should the TWIF do when it receives a Decorated NAI in the Registration Request message from the N5CW device?
question_50284.ground_truth: The TWIF should send the NAI which corresponds to the HPLMN by removing the decoration from the Decorated NAI.

question_50285.question: What is the performance comparison of RSACCH and RSACCH-1 for SACCH information throughput at high and bad channel conditions?
question_50285.ground_truth: RSACCH-1, which is based on an ideal implementation, yields close or better performance than RSACCH-2 at bad channel conditions and close or better performance than the legacy SACCH at good channel conditions. This performance serves as a bound for the performance of RSACCH-2 and the legacy SACCH.

question_50286.question: Which functional entities are collocated with the MCPTT application in on-network operation and allocated to the user's device in off-network operation?
