question_50288.question: How are the radio frequency (RF) front-end requirements approached in the report?
question_50288.ground_truth: The RF front-end requirements are described based on the band combination basis, and the actual requirements are added to the corresponding technical specification.

question_50291.question: What are the two formats for the "to-address" or "from-address" in the SMS message?
question_50291.ground_truth: The two formats for the "to-address" or "from-address" in the SMS message are "user@domain1.domain2" or "User Name <user@domain1.domain2>".

question_50293.question: What is the role of the "T3396 value" information element in the "deactivate PDP context request" message?
question_50293.ground_truth: The network may include the "T3396 value" information element if the ESM cause is #26 "insufficient resources" in the "deactivate PDP context request" message.

question_50295.question: What is the requirement for UE when active BWP switching occurs during the measurement gaps for PRS measurement in RedCap UEs?
question_50295.ground_truth: Active BWP switching should not occur during the measurement gaps for PRS measurement.

question_50297.question: Which network elements are involved in increasing the counter in "5.1.1.10.3 Number of released active DRBs"?
question_50297.ground_truth: The NG-RAN, AMF, and UE are involved in increasing the counter.

question_50299.question: What reference point is used for transport and routing of SIP signalling in the MCData-SDS-1 reference point in the MCData system?
question_50299.ground_truth: The SIP-1 and SIP-2 reference points

question_50301.question: How are the preparation and execution phases of a CHO procedure managed in the control plane?
question_50301.ground_truth: In the control plane, the preparation and execution phases of a CHO procedure are performed without the involvement of the 5GC. Preparation messages are exchanged directly between gNBs, and the source gNB releases resources at the source gNB during the conditional handover completion phase, which is triggered by the target gNB.

question_50302.question: What should a UE do if there is no appropriate 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE around?
question_50302.ground_truth: It is left to UE implementation on how to handle the case when there is no appropriate 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE around.

question_50303.question: What type of NR UE does the test applicability in 6.5A.2.2.1.2 apply to?
question_50303.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of NR UE release 15 and forward that supports FR2 2UL CA.

question_50304.question: What information does the Access-Network-Info AVP contain in a trusted WLAN?
question_50304.ground_truth: The Access-Network-Info AVP contains the SSID, BSSID, Location-Information, Location-Data, Operator-Name, Logical-Access-ID, and other optional AVPs in a trusted WLAN.

question_50306.question: What is the authentication method used by the NSWOF during the SWa' Authentication and Authorization procedure?
question_50306.ground_truth: EAP-AKA' as specified in RFC 5448 is used as the authentication method during the SWa' Authentication and Authorization procedure in the 3GPP NS-WL system.

question_50307.question: In the REDUNDANT steering mode, when should the UE and UPF send the traffic of the SDF on both accesses if a threshold value is provided?
question_50307.ground_truth: The UE and UPF shall send the traffic of the SDF on both accesses if the measurement of RTT or Packet Loss Rate on both accesses exceeds the values for RTT or Packet Loss Rate provided in the "rttThres" or "plrThres" attributes.

question_50308.question: What architecture is required for RF pattern matching technology in 3GPP?
question_50308.ground_truth: The currently approved 3GPP LCS architecture can accommodate RF pattern matching technology without any modifications needed.

question_50309.question: What is the role of the System Simulator in MCPTT conformance testing?
question_50309.ground_truth: The System Simulator (SS) in MCPTT conformance testing is responsible for simulating at least all 3 MCPTT functions, the MCPTT Server, and MCPTT Clients during testing of the MCPTT Server on the Server-to-Server interface.

question_50311.question: What potential issues can arise with the increasing number of applications on UEs and machine type communications?
question_50311.ground_truth: The potential issues include congestion or failure of third-party entities that interact with UE applications, which can cause excessive use of 3GPP network resources and network congestion.

question_50312.question: What is the suggested value for the intermodulation components for testing purposes in some areas?
question_50312.ground_truth: In some areas, to avoid uncoordinated system impacts, it may be beneficial to use a more stringent value of -70 dBc rms for intermodulation components.

question_50313.question: What are the two alternatives being studied for expression of angle of arrival measurement error for determination of positioning integrity for UL AoA?
question_50313.ground_truth: The two alternatives being studied are Alt. 1: No conversion (e.g., the measurement error is expressed as error in AoA or ZoA in LCS/GCS), and Alt. 2: Conversion function (defined as function of AoA/ZoA in LCS).

question_50314.question: What state is the remote party "B" in before disconnecting?

question_50315.question: What is the action taken by the MS when it receives a PACKET DOWNLINK ASSIGNMENT message containing packet downlink assignment on its PCH and the SS transmits a number of downlink RLC data blocks, sets FBI bit and polls the MS with a valid RRBP?
question_50315.ground_truth: The MS responds with PACKET CONTROL ACKNOWLEDGEMENT when it receives a PACKET DOWNLINK ASSIGNMENT message containing packet downlink assignment on its PCH and the SS transmits a number of downlink RLC data blocks, sets FBI bit and polls the MS with a valid RRBP.

question_50316.question: What is the main challenge in addressing the main threats for non-IMS interconnection in 7.5.1?
question_50316.ground_truth: Ensuring secure VoIP exchanges at least at the signalling level and if possible at the media level also, while supporting the roaming scenario where the sender is in a visited network.

question_50317.question: What sub-element can be included in the "any-cell-change" element?
question_50317.ground_truth: The "any-cell-change" element can include the following sub-element: "trigger-id", which is used to indicate a unique identifier for the trigger.

question_50319.question: What does the Hardware Load Indicator IE indicate in the 3GPP 5G standard?
question_50319.ground_truth: The Hardware Load Indicator IE indicates the status of the Hardware Load.

question_50320.question: What are the RFR measurement results for Device 2 on HATS 2?
question_50320.ground_truth: Device 2 fails the RFR mask for all measurement points on HATS 2. In-band sensitivity differences between HATS 1 and HATS 2 exceed 10dB at 250Hz and reach 8dB at 2.5kHz.

question_50321.question: What action should the network take if the UE sends an AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message with a valid SQN and MAC, but the mapping of 5G-GUTI to SUPI is incorrect?
question_50321.ground_truth: The network should respond by sending a new AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message to the UE.

question_50323.question: How can the presence of NZP CSI-RS and CSI-IM be informed to a UE in LAA?
question_50323.ground_truth: This may be done implicitly or explicitly, and may or may not involve signalling to the UE.

question_50325.question: What action does the ProSe Function take when the value of the Requested Discovery Timer is set to zero in step~1?
question_50325.ground_truth: The ProSe Function shall remove the discovery entry indicated by the Discovery Entry ID and release the associated resources.

question_50326.question: What types of delivery modes does the V1-AE reference point support?
question_50326.ground_truth: The V1-AE reference point supports both unicast and multicast delivery modes.

question_50327.question: What condition determines the non-applicability of a sub-block spectrum emission mask for some frequency?
question_50327.ground_truth: A sub-block spectrum emission mask does not apply for some frequency if it overlaps with the sub-block bandwidth of another sub-block.

question_50328.question: What are the definitions of AP, IOC, IRP, NRM, PLMN, UML, and WLAN in the context of 3GPP's telecommunications management specifications?
question_50328.ground_truth: AP is an abbreviation for Access Point, IOC stands for Information Object Class, IRP means Integration Reference Point, NRM is Network Resource Model, PLMN represents Public Land Mobile Network, UML stands for Unified Modelling Language, and WLAN means Wireless Local Area Network.

question_50329.question: What are the potential threats if security issues are not considered for protecting SL groupcast/broadcast communications?
question_50329.ground_truth: The potential threats if security issues are not considered for protecting SL groupcast/broadcast communications are passive attackers eavesdropping on privacy sensitive data, active attackers intercepting, modifying or replaying data packets, and UEs being impersonated by an attacker.

question_50330.question: In what time interval should the base station be able to change steering direction in order to prevent degradation of downlink performance when having multiple User Equipments (UEs) scheduled in different directions?
question_50330.ground_truth: The base station should be able to change steering direction in a time interval less than the cyclic prefix (CP) length, in order to prevent degradation of downlink performance.

question_50331.question: What is the measurement accuracy for all measured cells specified in section 9?
question_50331.ground_truth: The measurement accuracy for all measured cells is as specified in section 9.

question_50332.question: What is the function of the SS in transmitting a number of different TA values on the PTCCH for the TAI assigned to the MS?
question_50332.ground_truth: The SS transmits different TA values on the PTCCH for the TAI assigned to the MS to measure the receive/transmit delay for each burst and to change the TA values for the other TAI with no correlation.

question_50334.question: In the equation for average DL delay in gNB-DU for a network slice subnet, what does the variable "W" represent?
question_50334.ground_truth: W is the measurement for the weighted average in the equation for average DL delay in gNB-DU for a network slice subnet.

question_50335.question: What parameter allows negotiating the GERAN-specific condition for rate switching in MTSI?
question_50335.ground_truth: The SDP Parameters "mode-change-capability" and "mode-change-period" allow negotiating this GERAN-specific condition for rate switching in MTSI.

question_50336.question: What should the S-CCF do when it receives any response to the above request and the response contains a term-ioi parameter?
question_50336.ground_truth: The S-CCF should store the value of the received term-ioi parameter in the P-Charging-Vector header and remove all received ioi parameters from the forwarded response if next hop is not an AS.

question_50337.question: What is the main objective of the new solution for NTN coverage analysis?
question_50337.ground_truth: The main objective of the new solution for NTN coverage analysis is to leverage NWDAF's data collection and analytics exposure capabilities for NTN coverage estimation.

question_50341.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a UEInformationRequest message after having sent an RRCSetupComplete message with connEstFailInfoAvailable?
question_50341.ground_truth: The UE should include the connection establishment failure information in the RRCSetupComplete message, if available.

question_50343.question: What is the content of the "RL-InformationResponseList-RL-AdditionRspFDD" sequence in NBAP?
question_50343.ground_truth: The "RL-InformationResponseList-RL-AdditionRspFDD" sequence, as its name suggests, contains a list of RL-Information-Responses for a given frame offset ID. The RL-Information-Responses from id-TimeslotISCP-Information-List-DL-PowerBalancing-Activation-Information-ItemIE-RL-AdditionalResponseTDD sequence in NBAP is used in FDD with TD-SCDMA. It includes 1..maxNrOfDLs-1 NR AND DL parameters for the response to an E-RNAP RLC-Specific-DCH-Info request (< reject> case) or ID-LCR (< reject> case) in the "ProtocolIEs" field for this RadioLinkAdditionResponseFDD. The PSSCH mapping between the first and second cells, while oversampling is specified for 1.28 Mcps TDD such as when 15ms and 20ms frame lengths apply. The usage of the corresponding parameters fields in the response for this ID-LCR is determined by the frequency multiplexing rate chosen in the request.

question_50344.question: What is the result for the TERMINAL RESPONSE (Command Performed Successfully) in the sequence 1.2?
question_50344.ground_truth: The channel data length is more than 255 bytes of space available in the Tx buffer.

question_50345.question: What is the purpose of the second detailed scaling process on each of the two selected bands after the second bit allocation?
question_50345.ground_truth: The second detailed scaling process is implemented on each of the two selected bands after the second bit allocation to obtain the number of pulses for each of the two selected bands, same as the first detailed scaling process.

question_50347.question: What is Parlay X and how does it relate to Open Service Access (OSA) and Web Services?
question_50347.ground_truth: Parlay X is a set of technical specifications, part of the 3GPP standard, which defines an architecture enabling application developers to use network functionality through open standardized interfaces (OSA APIs). OSA APIs allow for interoperable machine-to-machine interaction over a network using the Web Services framework.

question_50348.question: What is the procedure for authorization in the UE-to-UE Relay Discovery?
question_50348.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF of the Source UE/Target UE sends an authorization request to the PCF/UDM of the Source UE/Target UE or the ProSe App Server. If authorized, the 5G DDNMF of the Source UE/Target UE contacts the indicated PLMN's 5G DDNMF of the UE-to-UE Relay by sending a Discovery Request message including the PC5 UE security capability. The 5G DDNMF of the UE-to-UE Relay may exchange authorization messages with the ProSe Application Server. If authorized, the 5G DDNMF of the UE-to-UE Relay responds to the 5G DDNMF of the Source UE/Target UE with a Discovery Response message including the Code Security Parameters and a chosen PC5 ciphering algorithm.

question_50349.question: How long is the delay uncertainty before the ECGI reporting in the uplink DCCH?
question_50349.ground_truth: The delay uncertainty is twice the TTI of the uplink DCCH.

question_50350.question: What is the difference in NRIs coordination for LAU and RAU in a 2G or 3G network?
question_50350.ground_truth: During a cell reselection in a 2G or 3G network, LAU NRIs are coordinated, while RAU NRIs are coordinated when the same operator is selected in the CS and PS domains.

question_50351.question: What part of the data packet does the RAN-level compression algorithm process?
question_50351.ground_truth: The RAN-level compression algorithm processes the payload part of the data packet, and not the headers.

question_50352.question: What is the condition for the reference signals of RLM, BFD, CBD, or L1-RSRP for beam reporting on FR2 serving frequencies to not be fully overlapped by intra-frequency SMTC occasions?
question_50352.ground_truth: If any of the reference signals for RLM, BFD, CBD, or L1-RSRP on any FR2 serving frequency in the same band outside the measurement gap are not completely covered by intra-frequency SMTC occasions, this condition is met.

question_50353.question: What is the effect of L3 filtering on the measurement accuracy and reporting delay in UTRA and E-UTRAN FDD?
question_50353.ground_truth: When L3 filtering is used, there is an additional delay in measurement reporting and an impact on measurement accuracy for all measured cells, as specified in clause 9 and 8.17.5.2.6.

question_50354.question: What is the threat related to forging network information, and what transport protocol is it relevant to?
question_50354.ground_truth: Forged network information, or spoofed IP source address, is a threat that is relevant only to connection-less transport protocol such as UDP.

question_50355.question: What action does the Mobile Station (MS) take in response to a page during the transmission of a cell broadcast short message?
question_50355.ground_truth: The MS is required to respond to the page, even if it is receiving a cell broadcast short message at the time.

question_50357.question: In what scenario must the UE initiate the PDP context modification procedure?
question_50357.ground_truth: When the PDN connection is a multi-access PDN connection for IP flows over GERAN or UTRAN and trusted WLAN using SCM, the move-traffic-to-WLAN indication is received from the access stratum layer of the 3GPP access, and the Local Operating Environment Information in the UE does not contain non-radio-related conditions that prohibit the use of WLAN access, then the UE must initiate the PDP context modification procedure.

question_50358.question: What is the requirement for OTA modulation quality in UTRA FDD as per TS 37.105 clause 9.6.4.2?
question_50358.ground_truth: The in MSR operation minimum requirement for AAS BS in UTRA FDD is defined in TS 37.105 clause 9.6.4.2.

question_50360.question: What are the synchronization functions implemented in the MS and BTS for circuit-switched handovers?
question_50360.ground_truth: The synchronization functions implemented in the MS and BTS for circuit-switched handovers are the pseudo synchronization scheme for circuit-switched handovers to support the scheme. This is optional, but the MS must measure and report the Observed Timing Difference (OTD).

question_50361.question: What is the role of the GTP-U Error Indication message in handling mobility while a Small data fast path is active from an eNB perspective?
question_50361.ground_truth: The GTP-U Error Indication message is used to indicate an error in the GTP-U protocol, and in the context of a Small data fast path, it is used to inform the SGW that there is undelivered DL data that needs to be stored in the SGW buffer and initiate a DDN.

question_50362.question: What should the NF Service Consumer (AMF) provide in the POST request to the AUSF in the Authentication for FN-RG procedure?
question_50362.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer (AMF) should provide the UE Id and the authenticated indication in the POST request to the AUSF.

question_50366.question: What is the difference between UTRA FDD and UTRA TDD in terms of the modulation of the interferer?
question_50366.ground_truth: UTRA FDD uses a WCDMA modulated signal for the interferer, while UTRA TDD uses an OFDM modulated interferer.

question_50368.question: What indicator is taken into account by the upper layers when selecting the access domain for voice sessions or calls in a UE with IMS voice over PS session capability?
question_50368.ground_truth: The IMS voice over PS session indicator

question_50369.question: What are the voice and video media bearer requirements for vSRVCC?
question_50369.ground_truth: For vSRVCC, the UE uses one voice and one video media component over the associated QCI=1 and vSRVCC marked PS bearers for bearer identification reasons.

question_50372.question: What is the purpose of the FF application layer functional model in Solution #1?
question_50372.ground_truth: The FF application layer functional model in Solution #1 provides the architecture and functional model required for addressing the application layer support aspects.

question_50373.question: What is the expected response of the UE upon receiving the RRCResume message?
question_50373.ground_truth: Upon receiving the RRCResume message, the UE decrypts the message and verifies its integrity, and if successful, the UE deletes the current K_RRCint key and saves the newly derived K_RRCint, K_RRCenc, K_UPenc, and K_UPint as part of the UE current AS security context. The UE then sends the RRCResumeComplete message on SRB1 using the current K_RRCint and K_RRCenc.

question_50374.question: What is the requirement for a UE that does not support simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology when measuring CSI-RS for RLM and SSB?
question_50374.ground_truth: If a UE does not support simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology, it is required to measure one of CSI-RS for RLM or SSB, and longer measurement periods for CSI-RS based RLM are expected.

question_50375.question: What is the minimum number of Carrier Frequency Layers that a UE category M1 in normal coverage shall be capable of monitoring?
question_50375.ground_truth: A UE category M1 in normal coverage shall be capable of monitoring at least 5 carrier frequency layers, including one serving carrier frequency and any combination of E-UTRA FDD inter-frequency and E-UTRA TDD inter-frequency layers.

question_50376.question: What is the format used for the uniform format in digital PCM to analogue conversion?
question_50376.ground_truth: The uniform format is represented in two's complement in digital PCM to analogue conversion.

question_50378.question: In which circumstance is the UE allowed to send uplink exception reports even if the limit for the small data rate control has been reached?
question_50378.ground_truth: The UE is allowed to send uplink exception reports even if the limit for the small data rate control has been reached if an allowed indication of additional exception reports is provided with the small data rate control parameters and either the additional small data rate control parameters for exception data is provided and the limit for additional rate for exception data reporting is not reached, or the additional small data rate control parameters for exception data is not provided.

question_50379.question: How does authentication proceed in the Wm reference point for IMS emergency calls?
question_50379.ground_truth: Authentication may be skipped entirely for IMS emergency calls depending on national regulations or operator preferences. If the checks for an IMS emergency call fail, the 3GPP AAA Server sends an Authentication Answer including an EAP failure to the PDG.

question_50381.question: What is the required status line for a successful registration response?
question_50381.ground_truth: A successful registration response shall start with a 200 OK status line in the response header.

question_50382.question: What is a possible result of service level interworking when a UE only supports Instant Message?
question_50382.ground_truth: Service level interworking is required when a UE only supports Instant Message and receives a Short Message from the other side, as the UE is not able to resolve the message format.

question_50383.question: What is the role of the protocol between UE and MTC-IWF?
question_50383.ground_truth: The protocol between UE and MTC-IWF can be based on PDCP and provides ciphering, deciphering, integrity protection, and integrity verification for the NAS and application layer protocol for MTC.

question_50385.question: How is the NF Service Consumer authenticated by the NRF?
question_50385.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer is authenticated by the NRF using one of the methods described in clause 13.3.1.2, and if successful, receives an access token for accessing the NF Service Producer services based on the NRF policy.

question_50386.question: What is the name of the time duration defined in clause 8.6.3A.1 for a non-simultaneous RRC based BWP switch on multiple CCs?
question_50386.ground_truth: The name of the time duration defined in clause 8.6.3A.1 for a non-simultaneous RRC based BWP switch on multiple CCs is T.

question_50387.question: What should the SS do when determining the number of residual bit error events for the bits of class II and Ib?
question_50387.ground_truth: The SS should examine sequences of at least the minimum number of samples of consecutive bits of class II or Ib, taking bits only from frames not signalled as erased.

question_50388.question: What is the role of the IM CN Subsystem in the procedures for Forced Playout Constraints?
question_50388.ground_truth: The IM CN Subsystem handles the SIP dialog, while the SCF checks the user's service rights and issues the forced playout constraints policy to the UE and PSS Adapter.

question_50390.question: What is the role of the gNB antenna field pattern and gNB antenna orientation and polarization in this model?
question_50390.ground_truth: The gNB antenna field pattern, gNB antenna orientation and polarization are used to specify the emulated gNB parameters.

question_50392.question: What shall the MCPTT client do upon receiving a request from an MCPTT user to establish an MCPTT ambient listening call that has been authorized successfully?
question_50392.ground_truth: The MCPTT client shall generate an initial SIP INVITE request by following the UE originating session procedures specified in 3GPP TS 24.229, with the clarifications given in clause 11.1.6.2.1.1 of TS 24.379.

question_50395.question: In which cases does the network provide ATSSS rules and Measurement Assistance Information?
question_50395.ground_truth: The network provides ATSSS rules and Measurement Assistance Information if the UE indicates it is capable of supporting ATSSS-LL functionality with any steering mode and the network accepts to activate it.

question_50396.question: How should the MME and UE derive KeNB during handover from UTRAN to E-UTRAN?
question_50396.ground_truth: The MME and UE shall derive KeNB by applying the KDF defined in Annex A.3 using the mapped key K'ASME and 232-1 as the value of the uplink NAS COUNT parameter.

question_50398.question: What does the term "3GPP" in the document stand for?

question_50400.question: If the event which triggered the access attempt was a request from upper layers to establish a new PDU session and the access attempt is barred, what action does 5GMM take?
question_50400.ground_truth: 5GMM shall not initiate the NAS transport procedure to send the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message. Upon receiving an indication from the lower layers that the barring is alleviated for the access category with which the access attempt was associated, the NAS may initiate the NAS transport procedure as specified in subclause~5.4.5, if still needed.

question_50401.question: How is the cut-off frequency information sent when the coding mode is INACTIVE, at the lowest bitrate of 7.2 or 8.0 kbit/s?
question_50401.ground_truth: Only 1 bit is used to send the cut-off frequency information in this case.

question_50402.question: Under what conditions should the MAC entity generate a Recommended bit rate MAC CE and cancel the corresponding Recommended bit rate query?
question_50402.ground_truth: The MAC entity should generate a Recommended bit rate MAC CE and cancel the Recommended bit rate query if a Recommended bit rate query has been triggered and not cancelled, if the bitRateQueryProhibitTimer for the logical channel and direction of this Recommended bit rate query is not running, if the MAC entity has UL resources allocated for new transmission and the allocated UL resources can accommodate a Recommended bit rate MAC CE plus its subheader, and if the upper layers request a new Recommended bit rate query trigger.

question_50403.question: What event triggers the charging event in the 5G ProSe Direct Communication for PC5 QoS Flow Based Charging?
question_50403.ground_truth: The Received Direct Communication Usage Report event for a Broadcast, Groupcast or Unicast Direct Communication is triggered by the 5G-DDNMF receiving a usage information report from the UE over PC5.

question_50404.question: What is the procedure for finding the nearest neighbor in the RE8 lattice?
question_50404.ground_truth: The procedure for finding the nearest neighbor in the RE8 lattice involves rounding the components of the input vector to the nearest integer, then adjusting one component at a time to ensure that the sum of the components is an integer multiple of 4, and finally selecting the nearest neighbor from two possible lattice points.

question_50405.question: What is one of the impacts on the AMF/MME as a result of the Generalized Unavailability Period solution?
question_50405.ground_truth: The AMF/MME needs to support an unavailability period indication in Registration or TAU procedure and store the unavailability period in the UE context.

question_50407.question: What is the purpose of the ROHC-Max-CID AVP in the TMGI-Allocation-Response AVP?
question_50407.ground_truth: The ROHC-Max-CID AVP, if included in the TMGI-Allocation-Response AVP, specifies the maximum number of concurrent ROHC identifiers (CIDs) for an MBMS bearer.

question_50408.question: What information must be included in the ModifyTask and DeactivateTask messages sent to the MDF2 or MDF3 by the LIPF?
question_50408.ground_truth: The XID of the Task created by the ActivateTask message must be included in the ModifyTask and DeactivateTask messages sent to the MDF2 or MDF3 by the LIPF.

question_50410.question: How is the convolution between the glottal-shape codebook entry and the impulse response computed in the first step of the algorithm?
question_50410.ground_truth: The convolution is computed by first calculating the convolution between the glottal-shape codebook entry for a specific position and the impulse response. The convolution is then shifted to the right by one with a zero added at the beginning for the following rows.

question_50411.question: When applying FEC protection, what does the BM-SC use for the FEC scheme?
question_50411.ground_truth: When applying FEC protection, the BM-SC uses the MBMS FEC scheme as specified by section 8.2.2. The FEC protection covers UDP payload and can be applied in both the forward only and the proxy modes of the Transparent delivery method.

question_50412.question: What should the UE do when it enters a different RRC state, in terms of cell reselection?
question_50412.ground_truth: The UE should consider the priorities provided by dedicated signaling and the remaining validity time of T320 when selecting a cell in the new RRC state.

question_50414.question: When adding a new value to a multivalue attribute, how does one specify the position of the new value?
question_50414.ground_truth: The "insert" subparameter can be used to specify whether the new value is added before or after the specified element.

question_50415.question: What is the purpose of the Granted-Service-Unit AVP and the Specific-Action AVP in the Sponsored-Connectivity-Data AVP in the AA-Request in 3GPP networks?
question_50415.ground_truth: The Granted-Service-Unit AVP and the Specific-Action AVP in the Sponsored-Connectivity-Data AVP in the AA-Request in 3GPP networks are used to support the usage monitoring of sponsored data connectivity, where the AF can request notification when the usage threshold has been reached.

question_50416.question: What IP address allocation mechanism can be used for a PDU Session used by IPTV?
question_50416.ground_truth: Deferred DHCPV4 IP address allocation is one possible IP address allocation mechanism that can be used for a PDU Session used by IPTV.

question_50417.question: What should the SS do after the Event 1A triggered measurement is reported during time period T2?
question_50417.ground_truth: After the Event 1A triggered measurement is reported during time period T2, the SS shall send an Active Set Update command with activation time "start of T3" adding cell 2 to the active set.

question_50418.question: What is one of the characteristics of the downlink peak spectral efficiency in LTE-Advanced?
question_50418.ground_truth: The downlink peak spectral efficiency in LTE-Advanced is already fulfilled in LTE Rel-8, and further improved performance can be achieved by using additional technology features such as downlink 8-layer spatial multiplexing.

question_50419.question: What does the `r12:appComponent` child element of the `deliveryMethod` element indicate?
question_50419.ground_truth: The `r12:appComponent` child element of the `deliveryMethod` element identifies the application content component(s) carried on the MBMS delivery session associated with that deliveryMethod instance. It indicates the number and types of application content component(s) carried on the corresponding delivery session. The collection of `r12:appComponent` attribute names across all deliveryMethod instances of an MBMS User Service represents the complete set of application content components available to the MBMS application affiliated with that MBMS User Service.

question_50421.question: What is the role of the 3GPP AAA server when authorizing the MCM for EPC access?
question_50421.ground_truth: When authorizing the MCM for EPC access, the 3GPP AAA server derives the WLCP key to protect the WLCP signalling and provides the key to the TWAN.

question_50422.question: What is the definition of a "Service Interruption" in the context of this study?
question_50422.ground_truth: A Service Interruption is a period of time in which one or more network elements do not respond to requests and do not send any requests to the rest of the system.

question_50423.question: What is the action taken when a UE receives a recommended PLMN list and all the recommended PLMNs are not available?
question_50423.ground_truth: In such cases, the UE will switch to limited service state.

question_50424.question: What is the role of the new SAE MME/UPE in the network registration confirmation for the UE in the 2G/3G system?
question_50424.ground_truth: The new SAE MME/UPE confirms the network registration of the UE in the 2G/3G system by deriving the address of the UE's MME/UPE from the parameters sent by the UE.

question_50426.question: When is a PDCP status report for the DAPS bearer sent by the UE during an inter-frequency DAPS handover?
question_50426.ground_truth: A PDCP status report for the DAPS bearer is sent by the UE when the upper layer requests an uplink data switching or when the associated RLC entity is released for a radio bearer.

question_50427.question: How does the dual eye buffer model differ from the single eye buffer model in terms of packet arrival?
question_50427.ground_truth: In the dual eye buffer model, the left and right eye frames arrive separately with a time offset, which makes the arrival process effectively equivalent to have two times of frame rates and half mean packet size of that of single eye buffer model.

question_50429.question: What action does the UDM take when it cannot authorize an SMF registration operation due to access barring or roaming restrictions?
question_50429.ground_truth: The UDM responds with HTTP status code "403 Forbidden" and includes additional error information in the response body.

question_50430.question: What is a threat introduced by management APIs in the context of 3GPP networks?
question_50430.ground_truth: Without appropriate security level minima for management APIs, underlying management and licensing APIs introduce standardized mechanisms to access 3GPP NFs with lower levels of security than those accepted by 3GPP.

question_50434.question: What must the MS return when it receives new AoCI parameters mid-way through a call in a Facility IE which is contained within a FACILITY message?
question_50434.ground_truth: The MS must return a FACILITY message containing the acknowledgement within 1 second.

question_50436.question: What action does the SGW take when it detects a restart in the ISR associated CN node for a UE?
question_50436.ground_truth: The SGW maintains the UE contexts while removing the IP address and TEID of the failed CN node. Paging is initiated in the TAI list using S-TMSI or in the RAI using the P-TMSI.

question_50437.question: What is the solution for handling multiple QoS flows of one UE together?
question_50437.ground_truth: The solution for handling multiple QoS flows of one UE together is to provide a group of (Flow description, QoS requirement associated to the Flow Description) with the Handling Together Indication. The AF provides this group and the PCF authorizes it. When the network allocates resources for the QoS flows mapped for multiple modals data flows, those QoS flows should be handled together, e.g. set up together, or release together.

question_50438.question: In which situations is the UE allowed to send uplink IP packets when the 3GPP PS data off UE status is "activated"?
question_50438.ground_truth: The UE can send uplink IP packets in the following situations: when the UE is in its HPLMN or EHPLMN and the packet is indicated in the list of 3GPP PS data off exempt services in HPLMN or EHPLMN, when the UE is in the VPLMN and the list of 3GPP PS data off exempt services in HPLMN or EHPLMN is present, when the UE is in the VPLMN and the list of 3GPP PS data off exempt services in VPLMN is present, when the packet is indicated in the EF3GPPPSDATAOFF USIM file, and when the packet is due to procedures specified in 3GPP TS 24.229 and 3GPP TS 24.623.

question_50439.question: When could the UE determine the need to terminate the periodic location procedure if it moves out of coverage of the PLMN(s) in which the location reports are allowed?
question_50439.ground_truth: The UE may determine the need for termination if it is unable to instigate an MO-LR TTTP request for some period of time (e.g. some multiple of the required periodic location interval).

question_50440.question: What is the role of the SGW-C in the Evolved Packet System (EPS)?
question_50440.ground_truth: The SGW-C is responsible for providing the functionality of the SGW, except for the functions performed by the SGW-U, and for selecting and controlling the SGW-U.

question_50441.question: What should a UE do if the last running Tsor-cm timer for any PDU session or service stops or expires and the UE is in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode but has not obtained service on a higher priority PLMN or SNPN?
question_50441.ground_truth: The UE shall perform the deregistration procedure that releases all the established PDU sessions and services, if any, and once the UE enters idle mode it shall attempt to obtain service on a higher priority PLMN or SNPN as specified in clause~4.4.3.3 by acting as if timer T that controls periodic attempts has expired or as specified in clause~4.9.3.

question_50442.question: What is the number of codewords per PDSCH assignment per UE supported in NR for MIMO schemes?
question_50442.ground_truth: 1 codeword for 1 to 4-layer transmission, and 2 codewords for 5 to 8-layer transmission.

question_50443.question: What should be considered while performing WLAN selection by the UE?
question_50443.ground_truth: The UE performs WLAN selection based on the active WLANSP rule without taking into account real-time events associated with the active ISRP rule. However, events such as change of WLAN load information, change of UE location, and change of time of day may lead to WLAN selection or reselection based on the WLANSP rule.

question_50446.question: What type of frames are classified as the INACTIVE CLASS and used only in the decoder?
question_50446.ground_truth: The INACTIVE CLASS comprises all inactive frames and it is used in the decoder to indicate the lack of speech activity in the signal.

question_50448.question: In which section of the report does the 3GPP clarify the definition and measurement point of the Quality of Experience?
question_50448.ground_truth: Section 4.1 provides the 3GPP's definition and exact E2E measurement point of Quality of Experience (QoE).

question_50449.question: What is NSSP (Network Slice Selection Policy) in 5G system?
question_50449.ground_truth: NSSP is a set of one or more NSSP rules, where an NSSP rule is either a non-default NSSP rule including an application identifier, an S-NSSAI and/or a DNN, and a precedence value of the NSSP rule, or a default NSSP rule including an S-NSSAI and/or a DNN. It is used to prioritize the transmission of PDUs (Packet Data Units) from an application to a network slice.

question_50450.question: What is the main focus of the 3GPP Technical Report on GPRS Tunnelling Protocol for Control plane (GTP-C) overload control mechanisms?
question_50450.ground_truth: The main focus is on the definition of "Load Control" and "Overload Control" related information to ensure a common multi-vendor interpretation of this information for interoperability between various GTP-C nodes, and the mechanisms to address various "Notes" specified in the 3GPP TR 23.843 v1.0.0.

question_50451.question: What are the pros of Solution 1 for PGW failure with restart?
question_50451.ground_truth: The pros of Solution 1 for PGW failure with restart include a quicker service recovery and a known release cause, which are beneficial in maintaining the quality of the network.

question_50453.question: What information should be included in the HTTP POST request message from the UAE-S to the UAS application specific server when forwarding DAA client event information received from the UAS application specific server?
question_50453.ground_truth: The HTTP POST request message sent from the UAE-S to the UAS application specific server should include an application/vnd.3gpp.uae-info+xml MIME body with a <DAA-client-event-info> element in the <UAE-info> root element, which contains information about the UAS identity, location, and conflicts.

question_50454.question: How many neighbouring cells should be included in the measResultNeighCells when available?
question_50454.ground_truth: At most, 6 intra-frequency and 3 inter-frequency neighbours per frequency, as well as 3 inter-RAT neighbours, per frequency/set of frequencies per RAT should be included in the measResultNeighCells.

question_50455.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) and what does the Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG-RAN) work on?
question_50455.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) is a collaboration between multiple standards organizations to create specifications for mobile communication systems, and TSG-RAN is a group within 3GPP that focuses on the radio access network technology.

question_50456.question: What action does the SGW take when it receives packets from an old Gn/Gp SGSN after receiving the reserved TEID and IP address parameters from the new SGSN?
question_50456.ground_truth: The SGW discards any packets received from old Gn/Gp SGSN.

question_50457.question: What is the purpose of an Implementation Conformance Statement (ICS) proforma for 3GPP Releases starting from Release 5 up to the Release indicated on the cover page of the present document?
question_50457.ground_truth: The purpose of an Implementation Conformance Statement (ICS) proforma for 3GPP Releases starting from Release 5 up to the Release indicated on the cover page of the present document is to specify a recommended applicability statement for the test cases included in TS 34.229-1 and TS 34.229-5. This applicability statement is based on the features implemented in the UE. The ICS proforma is recommended to be completed for an implementation or system claimed to conform to the specified 3GPP release.

question_50458.question: What are the two different filter bandwidths used in the transmitter shaping pulses to determine the performance impact of shaping filter?
question_50458.ground_truth: The two different filter bandwidths used in the transmitter shaping pulses are 240 kHz and 325 kHz.

question_50460.question: Who decides on the PCC rules and Event Triggers and provisions them to the PDN GW?
question_50460.ground_truth: The PCRF decides on the PCC rules and Event Triggers and provisions them to the PDN GW.

question_50461.question: What are the main parameters that define the UE transmit timing accuracy behavior of the UE in 3GPP 5G specifications?
question_50461.ground_truth: The main parameters are the initial transmit timing accuracy, maximum amount of timing change in one adjustment, and the minimum and maximum adjustment rate.

question_50462.question: Which method sends mobile originated data received over NAS for a given PDU session towards SMF, V-SMF for HR roaming scenarios, or I-SMF?
question_50462.ground_truth: The "send-mo-data" custom operation is used to send mobile originated data received over NAS for a given PDU session towards SMF, V-SMF for HR roaming scenarios, or I-SMF.

question_50464.question: What is the role of the NSCE server in relation to performance and analytics monitoring job creation?
question_50464.ground_truth: The NSCE server checks if the VAL server is authorized to request the network slice performance and analytics data monitoring job and determines the requested data needed to collect from the network side.

question_50465.question: What provides UE-access to the TNAN in a trusted non-3GPP access network?
question_50465.ground_truth: The Trusted Non-3GPP Access Point (TNAP) is responsible for providing UE-access to the TNAN in a trusted non-3GPP access network.

question_50468.question: What does the phrase "shall not indicate" mean in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
question_50468.ground_truth: The phrase "shall not indicate" in 3GPP technical specifications implies an interdiction (prohibition) to do something.

question_50469.question: What is the initial mode of the mobile station in the first test scenario?
question_50469.ground_truth: The mobile station is in group receive mode in the first test scenario.

question_50470.question: What is the expected response status code when attempting to read the NRM root resource?

question_50471.question: What issue does the cell broadcast solution address for triggering MTC devices that are attached?
question_50471.ground_truth: The cell broadcast solution addresses the issue of limiting signaling between the CN and MTC devices and triggering communications without a PDP/PDN connection or SMS.

question_50472.question: What message does the GANC receive to signal the need for handover to the CN and send a GA-RRC RELOCATION COMMAND message to the MS?

question_50473.question: What is not permitted to be included if the IE GAN PLMN List is included?
question_50473.ground_truth: If the IE GAN PLMN List is included, it is not permitted to include the Serving GANC-SEGW IP address, Serving GANC-SEGW FQDN, Serving GANC IP address, Serving GANC FQDN, and Serving GANC TCP port number.

question_50474.question: What is the positioning mechanism that uses measurements in the MS of the Enhanced Observed Time Difference of arrival of bursts of nearby pairs of BTSs?
question_50474.ground_truth: Enhanced Observed Time Difference (E-OTD) positioning mechanism

question_50475.question: What is the maximum number of reporting criteria that a UE, capable of supporting EN-DC operation with NR PSCell and one or more NR carrier frequencies, needs to be able to handle in parallel per category for inter-frequency measurements?

question_50476.question: What happens to the corresponding PCC rules when the AF session termination or modification procedure removes media flows?
question_50476.ground_truth: The AF session termination or modification procedure that removes media flows triggers the removal of the corresponding PCC rules from the SMF.

question_50477.question: What is the general principle for achieving extended coverage in EC-GSM?
question_50477.ground_truth: The general principle for achieving extended coverage in EC-GSM is using blind repetitions for the control channels and, for the data channels, a combination of blind repetitions of the lowest MCS supported in EGPRS today, i.e. MCS-1 and HARQ retransmissions. The number of blind repetitions is associated with different coverage classes.

question_50479.question: Which command is used to reject an incoming voice group or voice broadcast call in the "modem-compatible" mode of operation?
question_50479.ground_truth: The +CAREJ command is used to reject an incoming voice group or voice broadcast call in the "modem-compatible" mode of operation.

question_50480.question: Which message is used to provide information regarding indirect path failure detected by the MP remote UE?

question_50481.question: What is the role of the NRM server when inter-system switching from LTE eMBMS to 5G MBS session occurs?
question_50481.ground_truth: The NRM server is responsible for providing the VAL services to the client over 5G MBS sessions and for sending an MBS session announcement indicating information such as the session mode to serve the NRM client, the corresponding MBS session ID, and the required stream information to receive the media related to the group communication.

question_50482.question: Who is responsible for the authentication and authorization aspects of the MCData message store access?
question_50482.ground_truth: The authentication and authorization aspects of MCData message store access are the responsibility of SA3 and thus outside the scope of the present document.

question_50483.question: What is a Sub-Representation in the context of 3GP-DASH media presentation?
question_50483.ground_truth: A Sub-Representation, described by the SubRepresentation element, is a part of the regular Representation that provides properties of one or more embedded media content components, such as language, codec, or quality level.

question_50484.question: What is the purpose of the Surplus redistribution process in TCQ quantization?
question_50484.ground_truth: The Surplus redistribution process is used to handle the surplus when the number of non-zero positions is not controlled by the scaling and redistribution operations.

question_50485.question: How does the SMF handle triggers for chargeable events in converged charging?
question_50485.ground_truth: The SMF uses triggers, which are enable or disabled by the CHF or the PDU session termination, to report chargeable events.

question_50486.question: What must the H-GMLC do if the location request contains a pseudonym of the target UE?
question_50486.ground_truth: The H-GMLC shall use the pseudonym of the target UE in the location response to the R-GMLC or the LCS client.

question_50487.question: What is the purpose of the Association Info in the Association Policy?
question_50487.ground_truth: The Association Info in the Association Policy includes allowed/blocked MAC addresses and/or Link Info (SSID/BT ID and password) for provisioning to the PEGC, securing and protecting the Association Info from the PINMF is necessary.

question_50488.question: Which organization is responsible for allocating frequency bands for International Mobile Telecommunications (IMT) around the world?

question_50489.question: What should the T-gNB do if the UE's ongoing or re-mapped/fallback slice(s) is rejected based on the slice re-mapping policy?
question_50489.ground_truth: The T-gNB shall include the further re-mapped/fallback decision in the HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message to the AMF.

question_50490.question: When generating a file download completed notification, what shall the MCData client set the FD disposition notification type IE to?
question_50490.ground_truth: The MCData client shall set the FD disposition notification type IE as "FILE DOWNLOAD COMPLETED" as specified in subclause 15.2.6.

question_50491.question: In what ways can service interaction be improved by using GUP mechanisms?
question_50491.ground_truth: By allowing services to access user data through GUP mechanisms, users or operators can allow certain services to access user data from other services, enabling better personalization and integration of services.

question_50492.question: What is the procedure for providing IP address continuity on inter-system mobility for UEs that support 5GC NAS and EPC NAS and operate in single registration mode?
question_50492.ground_truth: Interworking procedures with N26 support provide IP address continuity on inter-system mobility.

question_50494.question: What is required to support converged charging for 5G VN group communication, including unicast, broadcast and multicast communication?
question_50494.ground_truth: REQ-3GPPCH-VNC-01 states that the 5G system should support converged charging for 5G VN group communication, including the unicast, broadcast and multicast communication.

question_50497.question: What is one of the differences between private calls in on-network and off-network?
question_50497.ground_truth: Private calls in on-network can be established with or without floor control, while private calls in off-network are always established with floor control.

question_50499.question: What can the b=AS value computation of AMR and AMR-WB, and EVS Primary mode consider when computing the bandwidth to use?
question_50499.ground_truth: The b=AS value computation of AMR and AMR-WB, and EVS Primary mode can consider statistical variations, such as the effects of DTX, in the scheduling and call admission control, but not in the computation of the b=AS value.

question_50500.question: What should a UE capable of NR sidelink communication/discovery and SLSS/PSBCH transmission do when transmitting NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning under certain conditions?
question_50500.ground_truth: It should provide synchronization information for NR sidelink communication/discovery and SLSS/PSBCH transmission.

question_50501.question: In what situations would a UE discard its NAS security context and follow the procedure for protection of initial NAS message?
question_50501.ground_truth: A UE would discard its NAS security context and follow the procedure for protection of initial NAS message if it selects a PLMN other than the Registered PLMN/EPLMN in the 5GMM-IDLE state and has a NAS security context containing the NEA0.

question_50503.question: Which statement is true about the PLMN selection enhancements towards a shared RAN?
question_50503.ground_truth: When a UE is moving towards a shared RAN, it can select its HPLMN based on operator guidance to get a better user experience.

question_50504.question: What error indication message is used to inform that some error has been detected in the originating node and is sent in the direction of both WT and eNB?

question_50505.question: What is the difference between the first and second digits of the version numbering system used in 3GPP Technical Specifications?
question_50505.ground_truth: The first digit indicates the maturity level of the document, while the second digit represents the level of technical enhancements, corrections, or updates made to the document.

question_50506.question: What are the two subtypes of WVG objects supported in the WVG graphical primitive?
question_50506.ground_truth: The two subtypes of WVG objects supported in the WVG graphical primitive are the Standard WVG object and the Character Size WVG object.

question_50507.question: What are the extra requirements and test point selection for TDD/FDD 2Rx capable RedCap UE in the context of UE conformance test cases?
question_50507.ground_truth: The extra requirements for TDD/FDD 2Rx capable RedCap UE include 2Rx REFSENS requirements with a maximum channel bandwidth of 20 MHz. For Rx test cases, the same test points for non-RedCap UE apply except that the Low, Mid, Hight test channel bandwidth shall be selected among channel bandwidths up to 20MHz.

question_50508.question: What should the GANC do when it receives the GA-RRC RELEASE REQUEST message from the MS, indicating that the MS needs to release the GA-RRC connection and signaling connection to a particular CN domain?
question_50508.ground_truth: The GANC should request the selected CN domain to release the Iu connection for the MS, including all active RABs for that domain.

question_50511.question: What is the effect of temperature that needs to be accounted for in the sensitivity requirements for the lowest and highest operating channels?
question_50511.ground_truth: The effect of temperature on the sensitivity requirements for the lowest and highest operating channels is that it is difficult to maintain linearity for the band edge channels without increasing the pass-band attenuation.

question_50513.question: What is the function of the LMF upon receiving a request for deferred UE location from the AMF?
question_50513.ground_truth: The LMF instigates a UE positioning procedure and requests information from the UE regarding its positioning capabilities. The LMF then sends a Periodic-Triggered Location Request to the UE via the serving AMF, which carries the location request information received from the AMF including the HGMLC contact address and LDR reference number.

question_50514.question: What may be required for NR Band n28 repeater to fulfill spurious emissions limits for co-existence with E-UTRA Band 27 UL operating band?

question_50515.question: How do the UEs negotiate the individual Unicast PC5 DRXs in a Unicast Link communication?
question_50515.ground_truth: The individual Unicast PC5 DRXs of two UEs are negotiated in one procedure, which is initiated by the UE that triggers the PC5 signalling procedure. When the Unicast PC5 DRX of one UE needs to be updated, the Rx UE initiates the update procedure toward the other UE.

question_50517.question: When cannot voice services be guaranteed to be available for mobile terminated calls in the Mobility Management back-off timer?
question_50517.ground_truth: It cannot be guaranteed that voice services will be available for mobile terminated calls while the Mobility Management back-off timer is running.

question_50519.question: What is the role of the UAS application-specific server in the USS change procedure?
question_50519.ground_truth: The UAS application-specific server follows the UAS change procedure after receiving a USS change trigger notify indicating a recommended USS change for the UAS with the target USS ID.

question_50520.question: What is the purpose of the "device identity" in the group affiliation procedure?
question_50520.ground_truth: The device identity uniquey identifies the UE within the group affiliation procedure. It is used by the MCPTT AS to correlate it with the application-level identity (MCPTT ID).

question_50521.question: What procedure can be used to obtain TRP estimate when antenna symmetries are compatible with pattern multiplication?
question_50521.ground_truth: The two-cuts with pattern multiplication method (clause~6.3.2.2.2) can be used to obtain TRP estimate when antenna symmetries are compatible with pattern multiplication.

question_50522.question: What should the MME do if the TAU Request contains a higher priority NAS algorithm?
question_50522.ground_truth: The MME shall run a NAS security mode command procedure to change the NAS algorithms.

question_50526.question: What is the role of the AF in determining the targets for the time synchronization status monitoring?
question_50526.ground_truth: The AF may request network timing synchronization status monitoring, providing filter information, such as UE IDs, DNN/S-NSSAI, or time synchronization service identifiers, to determine the targets of the monitoring.

question_50527.question: Which reference point is used to connect the MTC-IWF to SMS-SC inside HPLMN domain?

question_50530.question: What is the definition of "Band category" in the context of the document?
question_50530.ground_truth: A Band category is a group of operating bands for which the same MSR scenarios apply.

question_50531.question: What should be included in the Contact header field in the SIP INVITE request generated by the non-controlling MCVideo function?
question_50531.ground_truth: The Contact header field shall include the g.3gpp.mcvideo media feature tag, the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag with the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcvideo", and the isfocus media feature tag.

question_50537.question: What is the expected impact on access delay/latency when using UE C-DRX alignment in different load conditions?
question_50537.ground_truth: At low and medium load, there is an expectation of up to 28.93% increase in average EE (Energy Efficiency). However, at light load, there can be up to 12.24% decrease in average EE. Additionally, a marginal increment or up to 50% increment in access delay/latency can be observed.

question_50538.question: What condition must be met for the access attempt to be considered as allowed when one or more Access Identities are indicated and for a specific Access Identity the corresponding bit in the uac-BarringForAccessIdentity is set to zero?
question_50538.ground_truth: The establishment of the RRC connection must be the result of release with redirect with mpsPriorityIndication.

question_50539.question: What method should be used to modify AMF registration data for 3GPP access in the UDR?
question_50539.ground_truth: The PATCH method should be used to modify AMF registration data for 3GPP access in the UDR.

question_50540.question: What should be studied further for mid-call procedures to allow the release of core network resources?
question_50540.ground_truth: The option to allow the release of core network resources in mid-call procedures should be studied further.

question_50541.question: What should be avoided to prevent multiple transcoding in inter-operator agreements?
question_50541.ground_truth: To avoid multiple transcoding, applicable codecs at the II-NNI should be restricted as little as possible in the inter-operator agreements.

question_50542.question: What does the MSC-S switched call success rate KPI measure?
question_50542.ground_truth: The MSC-S switched call success rate KPI describes the ratio of the number of successful calls for MSC-S originating traffic and successful incoming calls from a given MSC-S to the number of attempted calls for MSC-S acknowledged for originating traffic and incoming calls from MSC-S, and is used to evaluate switched call performance.

question_50543.question: What is the message used by the UE to request to retrieve the UE Context from the anchor NG-RAN Node?

question_50544.question: What shall the controlling MCVideo function do upon receiving a SIP re-INVITE request for an on-demand prearranged MCVideo group session with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the <emergency-ind> element set to a value of "true" and if it is an authorized request to initiate an MCVideo emergency group call?
question_50544.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function shall cache the MCVideo ID of the MCVideo user who has initiated an MCVideo emergency call, start timer TNG2 (in-progress emergency group call timer), generate SIP re-INVITE requests for the MCVideo emergency group call to the other participants of the MCVideo group call, and send the SIP re-INVITEs towards the other participants of the MCVideo group call.

question_50545.question: What is the purpose of using ICE in WebRTC media transport?
question_50545.ground_truth: ICE (Interactive Connectivity Establishment) is used in WebRTC media transport to determine which of the received transport addresses are actually reachable. It helps establish an agreed candidate pair for media transport.

question_50546.question: What action does the ePDG take after receiving the updated routing rules from the UE and before sending them to the PDN GW?
question_50546.ground_truth: The ePDG sends a Bearer Resource Command message to the PDN GW, which includes the updated routing rules and the default EPS bearer ID.

question_50547.question: In the naming convention, what does "B" stand for in the naming of bursts or blocks where "B0" marks the first burst or block carrying bits from the data block with n = 0 (first data block in the transmission)?
question_50547.ground_truth: "B" in "B0" stands for burst in the naming convention.

question_50548.question: Who is responsible for the maintenance of over Release-8 and new OSA Stage 1, 2 and 3 work beyond Rel-9 after June 2008?
question_50548.ground_truth: OMA (Open Mobile Alliance) is responsible for the maintenance of over Release-8 and new OSA Stage 1, 2 and 3 work beyond Rel-9 after June 2008.

question_50549.question: How does the participating MCVideo function determine the MCVideo ID of the calling user?
question_50549.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function shall determine the MCVideo ID of the calling user from the public user identity in the P-Asserted-Identity header field of the SIP REFER request.

question_50550.question: What is the difference between the Control Plane (CP) Entity and the User Plane (UP) Entity in a 3GPP network?
question_50550.ground_truth: The Control Plane (CP) Entity is responsible for handling the Control Plane Functions, while the User Plane (UP) Entity is responsible for handling the User Plane Functions. The Control Plane Functions include SGW and PGW in EPS without CUPS, SGW-C and PGW-C in EPS with CUPS, and SMF in 5GS. The User Plane Functions include SGW and PGW in EPS without CUPS, SGW-U and PGW-U in EPS with CUPS, and UPF in 5GS.

question_50552.question: What action does the SS take in step 1.15C if the MS sends a "location updating request" on channel 1 after powering on and after the SS has switched off carrier 3?
question_50552.ground_truth: The SS sends a "location updating accept" message on carrier 1. After 5 seconds, the SS checks the MS "selected PLMN indicator."

question_50555.question: What is the impact of the Service Domain Selection in the mobile terminated calls from the PSTN/CS domain?
question_50555.ground_truth: The Service Domain Selection (SDS) determines whether the mobile terminated call is to be delivered to the CS domain or the IMS in the PSTN/CS domain, giving the operator the ability to choose the best option for each case.

question_50556.question: How should the media storage client on the MCData client send HTTP requests for downloading a file from the media storage function on the controlling MCData function?
question_50556.ground_truth: The media storage client on the MCData client should generate an HTTP GET request and send it towards the media storage function on the controlling MCData function.

question_50557.question: What is the role of the SMF in the initial N4 Session modification procedure?
question_50557.ground_truth: The SMF initiates the N4 Session modification procedure and provides the AN Tunnel Info to the UPF.

question_50558.question: What is the default handling of an exception condition in the CAMEL system?
question_50558.ground_truth: Default handling of the exception condition includes general actions to ensure that no resources remain inappropriately allocated.

question_50560.question: Who provides the analytics data for management purposes in the MDAS system?
question_50560.ground_truth: The MDAS producer provides the analytics data for management purposes based on the data related to different types of NFs or entities in the network, e.g., data reported from gNB and other core network functions.

question_50563.question: What determines the affiliated members of a non-regroup based on the group document?
question_50563.ground_truth: The affiliated members of a non-regroup based on the group document are determined by the MCVideo server from the entries contained in the <list> element of the group document.

question_50564.question: What should the MAC entity do if one or more carriers are considered as candidate carriers for TX carrier (re-)selection?
question_50564.ground_truth: The MAC entity should select one or more carriers with the lowest CBR from the candidate carriers for each sidelink logical channel where data is available.

question_50565.question: What should the UE do with the stored rejected NSAAI for the current PLMN when the UICC containing the USIM is removed?
question_50565.ground_truth: The UE should delete the stored rejected NSAAI for the current PLMN when the UICC containing the USIM is removed.

question_50566.question: How are V2X message formats handled in the upper layer for V2X communication?
question_50566.ground_truth: The V2X message formats are handled by upper layer via Session Description Protocol (SDP).

question_50567.question: What action should the MS take if it has stored a FQDN of the GANC-SEGW, and it does not already have an established secure connection to this GANC-SEGW?
question_50567.ground_truth: The MS should perform a public DNS query to retrieve the IP-address of the GANC-SEGW and then establish a secure connection towards the GANC-SEGW.

question_50568.question: What are the interfaces used by the BEST service?
question_50568.ground_truth: The BEST service uses various interfaces, including S6a between the HSS and the HSE, EMKS, and UE, as well as BEST-C, BEST-U, EAS-C, and EAS-U between various components.

question_50569.question: What is the range of values for the "intentPriority" property?
question_50569.ground_truth: The "intentPriority" property can have a value between 1 and 100, inclusive.

question_50571.question: What is one of the open issues related to the UE-originated API invocation scenario?
question_50571.ground_truth: One of the open issues related to the UE-originated API invocation scenario is whether the existing CAPIF functional model is sufficient for this type of API invocation.

question_50574.question: What are the three digits in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Specification and what do they represent?
question_50574.ground_truth: The three digits in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Specification represent the following: (1) the level of TSG approval, (2) significant technical changes, and (3) editorial changes.

question_50575.question: What servings cells are affected by the scheduling restrictions when TDD intra-band carrier aggregation is performed?
question_50575.ground_truth: The scheduling restrictions due to a given serving cell also apply to another serving cell in the same band on the symbols that fully or partially overlap with the aforementioned restricted symbols if the UE does not have the capability of supporting simultaneousRxTxInterBandCA for this band pair.

question_50576.question: What are the main components of the E-UTRAN NRM IRP architecture?
question_50576.ground_truth: The E-UTRAN NRM IRP architecture includes Requirements, a protocol-neutral Information Service, and one or more Solution Sets. The solution sets are specific to the network element, such as the CORBA Solution Set. The architecture also includes managed objects (MO), managed object classes (MOC), and information object classes (IOC) to facilitate the communication and management of network resources.

question_50580.question: What is the purpose of the TNL association in the 5G core network?
question_50580.ground_truth: The TNL association in the 5G core network refers to the tunnel endpoint name identifier used to exchange messages between the 5G-AN and AMF. The weight factors associated with TNL associations help in load distribution of the initial N2 messages.

question_50581.question: What is the conformance requirement when a CC entity of a MS in CC-state U8, "Connect Request", receives a RELEASE message as per Conformance requirement 26.8.1.3.5.6.2?
question_50581.ground_truth: A CC entity of a MS in CC-state U8, "Connect Request", upon receipt of a RELEASE shall return a RELEASE COMPLETE and enter the CC-state U0, "Null".

question_50583.question: What is one of the main challenges for the tactile internet in terms of latency?
question_50583.ground_truth: The human sensory system requires a millisecond or lower latency for tactile internet applications to give the impression of immediate response.

question_50585.question: What is the result of unblocking a blocked MCIM?
question_50585.ground_truth: The MCIM is restored to the "Activated" state.

question_50586.question: What dominant factor affects the UE HO requirements for mobility in the case of NR FR2 frequency range?
question_50586.ground_truth: The Doppler shift dominates over any static frequency error at high speed when it comes to UE HO requirements for mobility in the case of NR FR2 frequency range.

question_50587.question: What action does the new SGSN take when it receives the Forward Relocation Request message and cannot support the indicated ciphering algorithm?
question_50587.ground_truth: If the new SGSN does not support the indicated ciphering algorithm, it selects a new ciphering algorithm, sends it transparently to the MS, and transfers the IOV-UI parameter used in the ciphering procedure to the MS.

question_50588.question: What attribute indicates whether the client is a Higher Granularity CVO capable receiver of 3GP files?

question_50591.question: What is one of the situations where the size of the UE Radio Capability may be too large to be carried in a single message on one or more interfaces involved in handover?
question_50591.ground_truth: When transferring radio capability information related to all of the UE's RATs in the "source to target transparent container".

question_50592.question: What does the UE have to do during T3?
question_50592.ground_truth: During T3, the UE is expected to detect OOS (Out-Of-Sync) and declare RLM (Radio Link Monitoring).

question_50593.question: What is one benefit of using immersive cockpits displayed on virtual reality head-mounted displays for tele-operated driving?
question_50593.ground_truth: Merging additional information from a digital twin improves user safety and makes operations more accurate.

question_50594.question: What XML-related terms and definitions are used in the present document?
question_50594.ground_truth: The terms and definitions used in the present document include: XML file, XML document, XML declaration, XML element, empty XML element, XML content, XML start-tag, XML end-tag, XML empty-element tag, XML attribute specification, Document Type Definition (DTD), XML schema, XML namespace, XML complex type, and XML element type.

question_50595.question: What is the difference between the second and third version number digit in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_50595.ground_truth: The second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, i.e. technical enhancements, corrections, updates, etc. while the third digit is incremented when editorial only changes have been incorporated in the document.

question_50596.question: What action should the UE take upon receiving a new TAI list during a mobility registration update procedure?
question_50596.ground_truth: The UE should delete its old TAI list and store the received TAI list.

question_50597.question: What is the option tag defined in IETF RFC 4916 should be supported at II-NNI for the support of terminating identification presentation and restriction in IMS networks?
question_50597.ground_truth: The option tag "from-change" defined in IETF RFC 4916 should be supported at II-NNI for the support of terminating identification presentation and restriction in IMS networks.

question_50598.question: What is the reporting range of CSI-RSRP?
question_50598.ground_truth: The reporting range of CSI-RSRP is from -140 dBm to -44 dBm with 1 dB resolution.

question_50599.question: What is the purpose of the Bj variable in the Logical channel prioritization procedure?
question_50599.ground_truth: The Bj variable is used to maintain a priority for each logical channel, which is initialized to zero when the logical channel is established and incremented before every instance of the LCP procedure. The value of Bj can be greater than the bucket size, in which case it is set to the bucket size.

question_50600.question: What should be forwarded in real-time if the NM connection to subordinate entities is up?
question_50600.ground_truth: Alarm reports are forwarded in real-time to the NM via appropriate filtering if the NM connection to subordinate entities is up.

question_50601.question: What should be the antenna path specification so that BS transmitters on Bands 19 and 46 do not share the same antenna due to PIM concerns?
question_50601.ground_truth: The antenna path should meet very stringent 3rd order PIM specification so that the PIM will not cause the BS receiver desensitisations in Bands 3, 4, 8, 9, 10, 20, 22, 41, 42, 43, and 66.

question_50602.question: What is the OTA ACLR absolute limit for an E-UTRA AAS BS of Local Area BS class?
question_50602.ground_truth: The OTA ACLR absolute limit for an E-UTRA AAS BS of Local Area BS class is -23 dBm/MHz.

question_50603.question: What actions does the PCEF take when receiving PCC Rules from the H-PCRF?
question_50603.ground_truth: The PCEF installs the received PCC Rules, enforces the authorized QoS and enables or disables service flows, sets the upper limit for MBR, and, in case of PCEF supporting Application Detection and Control feature, enforces the application detection and control.

question_50604.question: What are the two integer values used to represent the mean number of OVSF codes used in the downlink of a UTRAN cell?
question_50604.ground_truth: The two integer values used are "TCR.DLMeanCodeResUsed.SF1" and "TCR.DLMeanCodeResUsed.SF16".

question_50605.question: What initiates the high-level procedure for enabling or disabling the restriction of location information dissemination?
question_50605.ground_truth: The location management client~1 initiates this request, containing an indication to enable or disable the restriction.

question_50606.question: What should the terminating UE do if the received INVITE request includes the "precondition" option-tag in the Require header field, and the precondition mechanism is disabled?
question_50606.ground_truth: The terminating UE should reject the INVITE request with a 420 (Bad Extension) response.

question_50607.question: What issue can be avoided with the combined cell deployment in terms of downlink/uplink?
question_50607.ground_truth: The introduction of LPNs in a macro coverage area can cause a downlink/uplink imbalance problem, but this can be avoided in the combined cell deployment.

question_50608.question: What is the UE's behavior after receiving network slices incompatibility attributes per allowed S-NSSAI?
question_50608.ground_truth: The UE shall not attempt to establish or request user resources for simultaneous PDU sessions on network slices identified as incompatible based on the received attributes.

question_50610.question: What is the purpose of the RNSAP Common Transport Channel Resources Initialisation Request message in 7.18.3?
question_50610.ground_truth: The RNSAP Common Transport Channel Resources Initialisation Request message is used by the SRNC to setup a common channel for the UE via DRNC and obtain the C-RNTI needed for RRC messages.

question_50611.question: What is the purpose of the TriggeredStatusReportingStartReq method defined in the OSA Mobility Interface Class?
question_50611.ground_truth: The TriggeredStatusReportingStartReq method is used to request triggered status reports when one or several users' status is registered/re-registered from the IMS core network. The user status service will only send a report when the status changes (registred to de-registred and vice-versa).
