question_51957.ground_truth: The UE shall abort the registration procedure if a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message with specific 5GMM cause values is received before the registration procedure is completed, if a T3510 timeout occurs, if a timer T3346 is running when the network indicates that a cell change is necessary, if the lower layers indicate that the access attempt is barred, if the lower layers indicate that there is a transmission failure or that the RRC connection has been suspended, if a change in the current TAI is detected, if a DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message is received before the registration procedure is completed, if the UE needs to start the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update and de-registration procedure collision, or if this would result in violation of subclause 5.5.1.3.5.

question_51960.question: What is the purpose of the gNB-DU Status Indication procedure?
question_51960.ground_truth: The purpose of the gNB-DU Status Indication procedure is to inform the gNB-CU that the gNB-DU is overloaded so that overload reduction actions can be applied, and to inform the IAB-donor-CU about a downlink congestion at an IAB-DU or an IAB-donor-DU.

question_51961.question: What is the role of the ProSe Function serving user A after receiving the Authorization Update message?
question_51961.ground_truth: The ProSe Function serving user A acknowledges the Authorization Update message and analyzes the received N pairs of Banned Restricted ProSe App User ID - Banned ProSe Discovery UE ID. If the PLMN ID in the Banned ProSe Discovery UE ID indicates the same PLMN of user A, the ProSe Function sends a Discovery Update Request message to the UE of the banned user.

question_51962.question: How is the Paging Policy Indicator (PPI) determined in the case of UPF buffering downlink packets?
question_51962.ground_truth: When PPD applies, the SMF determines the PPI based on the DSCP received from the UPF in the Downlink Data Report sent to the SMF.

question_51963.question: What should the mobile station supporting multimedia CAT during the alerting phase do if there is a multimedia CAT available during call establishment?
question_51963.ground_truth: The mobile station should attach the user connection for multimedia as soon as an appropriate channel in multimedia mode is available and set up an H.324 call. If an error or H.324 call clearing occurs during the setup or the lifetime of the H.324 call during the alerting phase, the mobile station should not abort the call and the call control entity of the calling mobile station should remain in its current state.

question_51964.question: Which complex type contains the NCGI attribute and what is its data type?

question_51966.question: What is one of the benefits of the procedures described in clause 6.22.2?
question_51966.ground_truth: One benefit of the procedures described in clause 6.22.2 is that both UE using NR satellite access and E-UTRAN satellite access can receive the coverage data in a consistent way.

question_51969.question: What should the SIP re-INVITE request contain to be considered a valid request for an MCPTT imminent peril group call cancellation?
question_51969.ground_truth: The SIP re-INVITE request should contain an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body with the <imminentperil-ind> element set to a value of "true" for a valid request for an MCPTT imminent peril group call cancellation.

question_51970.question: How does the usage of SVC improve the performance of the system in terms of cache-hit-ratio compared to the use of MR-VoD?
question_51970.ground_truth: The usage of SVC improves the performance of the system in terms of cache-hit-ratio compared to the use of MR-VoD by efficiently utilizing the available resources.

question_51972.question: In the context of case g), what will the UE do if the 5GMM cause IE is set to the 5GMM cause #28 "Restricted service area"?
question_51972.ground_truth: The UE will pass to the 5GSM sublayer an indication that the 5GSM message was not forwarded due to service area restrictions, enter the state 5GMM-REGISTERED.NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE if the DL NAS TRANSPORT message is received over 3GPP access, and perform the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update without waiting for the release of the N1 NAS signalling connection.

question_51973.question: Which UEs should implement UEA0, UEA1, and UEA2?
question_51973.ground_truth: UEs should implement UEA0, UEA1, and UEA2.

question_51976.question: What information does the Server NWDAF aggregate during Federated Learning training procedure?
question_51976.ground_truth: The Server NWDAF aggregates all the local training results for Abnormal Classifier, including the volume of the local dataset and parameters for update of the Abnormal Classifier.

question_51977.question: What does the "reporting" parameter in the EPSFB status report indicate?
question_51977.ground_truth: The "reporting" parameter in the EPSFB status report indicates whether the reporting of EPSFB status is enabled or disabled.

question_51978.question: What does d'y represent in the Available MIMO Layers Coverage Map measurements?
question_51978.ground_truth: d'y represents the sub-cell radius within the observed cell up to where a UE with the given number of MIMO layers in DL (for 5.1.1.30.7) or UL (for 5.1.1.30.8) per PRB can be localized.

question_51981.question: What is the definition of a "5G LAN-type Service" in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
question_51981.ground_truth: A "5G LAN-type Service" is a service over the 5G system that offers private communication using IP and/or non-IP type communications.

question_51982.question: What is the role of the RAI/RNC-ID FQDN when selecting the GGSN for S1-flex tenants in a 3GPP network?
question_51982.ground_truth: The RAI/RNC-ID FQDN is used in addition to the APN FQDN when selecting the GGSN for S1-flex tenants in a 3GPP network.

question_51983.question: What is the enhancement suggested to improve the MTC-IWF behavior in case of overload indication from the SMS-SC?
question_51983.ground_truth: The SMS-SC may send a "back-off timer" together with the overload indicator to inform the MTC-IWF when the SMS-SC is expected to restore the services.

question_51986.question: What action does the V-PCRF take when a new S9 subsession is created?
question_51986.ground_truth: If new subsessions are created, the V-PCRF includes within the Subsession-Enforcement-Info AVP, the Subsession-Id AVP set to the value of a new subsession identifier, and the Subsession-Operation AVP set to the value "ESTABLISHMENT".

question_51987.question: What are the three GTT Host environments defined in the specification for text transmission?
question_51987.ground_truth: The three GTT Host environments are IP Multimedia based on IETF RFC 3261 (SIP), Circuit Switched Multimedia based on 3G.324, and Circuit Switched voice channel.

question_51988.question: What is the periodicity for SystemInformationBlockType1-MBMS in normal subframes?
question_51988.ground_truth: The SystemInformationBlockType1-MBMS uses a fixed schedule with a periodicity of 160 ms in normal subframes.

question_51989.question: What is the Test Tolerance (TT) for regulatory receiver directional requirements for OTA RX IMD?
question_51989.ground_truth: The Test Tolerance (TT) for regulatory receiver directional requirements for OTA RX IMD is zero.

question_51990.question: What is the maximum bandwidth for measurement of spurious emissions at the edge of each frequency range?
question_51990.ground_truth: The lowest frequency of the measurement position in each frequency range should be set at the lowest boundary of the frequency range plus MBW/2 and the highest frequency of the measurement position in each frequency range should be set at the highest boundary of the frequency range minus MBW/2, where MBW denotes the measurement bandwidth defined for the protected band.

question_51993.question: What is the difference between Ambient IoT direct network communication and Ambient IoT indirect network communication?
question_51993.ground_truth: Ambient IoT direct network communication represents communication between the Ambient IoT device and 5G network with no UE conveying information between the Ambient IoT device and the 5G network, while Ambient IoT indirect network communication represents communication between the Ambient IoT device and the 5G network where there is an Ambient IoT capable UE helping in conveying information between the Ambient IoT device and the 5G network.

question_51994.question: How is the global gain estimated in the process?
question_51994.ground_truth: The global gain is estimated by computing the energy of each block of 4 coefficients, and then performing a bisection search with a final resolution of 0.125dB to find the optimal gain.

question_51995.question: What is the requirement for NCR-Fwd and NCR-MT in the uplink for minimum requirement NCR-Fwd type 1-C and type 1-H?
question_51995.ground_truth: The operating band unwanted emissions limits shall apply to the total emissions from both the NCR-Fwd and NCR-MT for joint transmission in the uplink for minimum requirement NCR-Fwd type 1-C and type 1-H.

question_51998.question: What is the purpose of the PDU session reactivation result information element, and what is its minimum and maximum length?
question_51998.ground_truth: The PDU session reactivation result information element indicates the result of PDU sessions activation requested by UE in Uplink data status IE of SERVICE REQUEST message. It is a type 4 information element with minimum length of 4 octets and maximum length of 34 octets.

question_51999.question: What is the role of the PCRF in S9a session establishment during an IPSec tunnel update initiated by the UE?
question_51999.ground_truth: The PCRF initiates Gateway Control Session establishment with the BPCF to establish S9a Session during an IPSec tunnel update initiated by the UE.

question_52000.question: What should the mobile station do after receiving an encapsulated IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT REJECT message in response to emergency call establishment?
question_52000.ground_truth: The mobile station should attempt to originate an emergency call whilst T3122 is running after receiving an encapsulated IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT REJECT message in response to emergency call establishment.

question_52002.question: Under what conditions should the controlling MCVideo function include the warning text set to "122 too many participants" in the SIP 200 (OK) response?
question_52002.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should include the warning text set to "122 too many participants" in the SIP 200 (OK) response if all members were not invited because the prearranged MCVideo group has exceeded the on-network-max-participant-count members.

question_52004.question: What is the XML Definitions Solution Set in the SuM NRM IRP?
question_52004.ground_truth: The 3GPP SuM NRM IRP XML Definitions Solution Set (defined in Annex A) specifies the XML definitions used in the SuM NRM IRP.

question_52005.question: What is the purpose of the "catch all" entry with the lowest priority in policy/parameter mappings in 5G ProSe Direct Communication?
question_52005.ground_truth: This entry is used for ProSe services that do not have explicit policy/parameters mapping above.

question_52006.question: What indication is sent to the UE in case of untrusted access to notify whether it supports emergency services?
question_52006.ground_truth: In case of untrusted access, the ePDG notifies the UE whether it supports emergency services in IKE signalling.

question_52007.question: What should the MAC entity do when it receives a downlink assignment for this PDCCH occasion and this serving cell on the PDCCH for the MAC entity's C-RNTI or Temporary C-RNTI and has not received a downlink assignment for this PDCCH occasion and another serving cell on the PDCCH for the MAC entity's C-RNTI or Temporary C-RNTI?
question_52007.ground_truth: The MAC entity should consider the NDI to have been toggled, indicate the presence of a downlink assignment, and deliver the associated HARQ information to the HARQ entity.

question_52009.question: What is the purpose of the Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the EPC NRM?
question_52009.ground_truth: The Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the EPC NRM is the interface that is used to access the information defined by the NRM. It is used to communicate between an IRPAgent and an IRPManager for telecommunication network management purposes, including management of converged networks.

question_52010.question: What is the minimum test time due to fading for testing under multipath and interference conditions?
question_52010.ground_truth: The minimum test time due to fading for testing under multipath and interference conditions is when 990 wavelengths are crossed with the speed given in the fading profile.

question_52011.question: What should the MS do after N2 retransmissions of the same RR frame (C=1, P=1) without an answer?
question_52011.ground_truth: The MS should reset or disconnect the RLP link by sending a SABM (C=1,P=1) or a DISC (C=1) frame.

question_52012.question: What is the difference between header-only compression mode and full-packet compression mode in this solution?
question_52012.ground_truth: In header-only compression mode, only the first APDCHeaderLength octets of the original packet are compressed, while in full-packet compression mode, the entire packet is compressed. Additionally, no deep packet inspection (DPI) is performed in header-only compression mode.

question_52013.question: How are the adjusted time envelopes encoded in the case of TRANSIENT frames?
question_52013.ground_truth: The adjusted time envelopes are rounded and quantized with four bits using uniform scalar quantization.

question_52015.question: What are the arguments against partial ciphering in GSM/GPRS networks?
question_52015.ground_truth: It requires changes to the BTS, which is considered unwelcome due to cost

question_52016.question: What is the maximum size of an SDS message for an MCData client to send an one-to-one SDS message if the value of the "max-data-size-sds-bytes" is 1000 and the value of the "MaxData1To1" is 500?
question_52016.ground_truth: The maximum size of an SDS message for an MCData client to send an one-to-one SDS message is 500 bytes.

question_52017.question: What is the threshold for the MS to indicate and include in the mobile originating SETUP for a speech call?
question_52017.ground_truth: The MS shall indicate and include all the speech versions that it supports.

question_52021.question: What actions must the mobile station take if an appropriate channel for call establishment is not available for 30 seconds?
question_52021.ground_truth: The mobile station may initiate call clearing.

question_52022.question: What action is triggered by the application client in the UE after receiving the Target RPAUIDs from the ProSe Application Server?
question_52022.ground_truth: The application client in the UE triggers the UE to perform the ProSe query procedure, providing its own RPAUID and the Target RPAUIDs.

question_52024.question: What should the MCData UE include in the Contact header field of the SIP REGISTER request when performing a re-registration without the supported g.3gpp.mcdata media feature tags?
question_52024.ground_truth: The MCData UE should include the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag containing the supported MCData service ICSIs in the Contact header field of the SIP REGISTER request.

question_52025.question: What does the MCVideo client do if there are several MCVideo groups where the MCVideo user is a member?
question_52025.ground_truth: If the MCVideo user selected a TGI where there are several MCVideo groups where the MCVideo user is a member, the MCVideo client selects one of those MCVideo groups.

question_52026.question: What is the role of the CAPIF Function in relation to the "authorization before allowing access to resources" solution?
question_52026.ground_truth: The CAPIF Function plays a crucial role in establishing a secure application session with the application key derived from the CAPIF Key related to the Resource Owner.

question_52028.question: What operation allows modifying one or more attributes of one or more managed objects on a MnS producer?

question_52029.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon receiving a request from an MCVideo user to leave an MCVideo adhoc group session that was established using a pre-established session?
question_52029.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should follow the procedures specified in clause~6.2.4.2.

question_52030.question: What SDP attribute is added to the SDP offer in step 3 when changing the transport protocol from "TCP/BFCP" to "TCP/TLS/BFCP"?

question_52031.question: What is the objective of load balancing in the context of 5G networks?
question_52031.ground_truth: The objective of load balancing in 5G networks is to distribute load evenly among cells and areas of cells, transfer part of the traffic from congested cells or areas to improve network performance, and optimize handover parameters and actions to enhance user experience and system capacity.

question_52032.question: What should the UE transmit in the INVITE if it is performing an automatic eCall over IMS?
question_52032.ground_truth: The UE shall transmit INVITE with all applicable headers for automatic eCall over IMS, and this includes the MSD in the INVITE.

question_52034.question: How does the EVS-SWB codec perform in mixed/music rate switching performance under clean channel and impaired channel conditions?
question_52034.ground_truth: The EVS-SWB performance is significantly better than the corresponding reference condition both under clean channel and under impaired channel for mixed/music content.

question_52035.question: What is the function of the "fe-identifier" header field parameter in the IM CN subsystem?
question_52035.ground_truth: The "fe-identifier" header field parameter is used to inform the billing domain which IM CN subsystem functional entities have created charging information. It is added to the P-Charging-Vector header field when generating charging information, and contains information about the specific IM CN subsystem functional entities and associated ASs involved in the charging events.

question_52036.question: What function is used to provide end-to-end QoS for the 5G relay architecture?
question_52036.ground_truth: The 5G network adjusts the delay within the 5G network to compensate for the delays incurred in non-5G networks such as Wi-Fi, the Internet, to provide end-to-end QoS for the 5G relay architecture.

question_52037.question: What is the maximum number of radio frames within the transmission time intervals of all transport channels that are multiplexed into the same CCTrCH during a handover procedure that uses the TDD options?
question_52037.ground_truth: Fmax denotes the maximum number of radio frames within the transmission time intervals of all transport channels that are multiplexed into the same CCTrCH.

question_52038.question: What should the MCData client include in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body of the SIP REFER request when the MCData communication establishment fails?
question_52038.ground_truth: The MCData client should include the <mcdata-communication-state> element set to "establish-fail" in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body of the SIP REFER request when the MCData communication establishment fails.

question_52039.question: Which RepetitionFactorExtended value in the SchedulingRequest in 3GPP TS38.300 v16.1.0 (2018-july) indicates 16 times repetition of Counting/Listening/Triggering?

question_52040.question: What type of notifications can be set using the enableNotifications() method?
question_52040.ground_truth: The enableNotifications() method is used to indicate that the application is able to receive notifications which are provisioned from within the network (i.e. these notifications are NOT set using createNotification() but via, for instance, a network management system).

question_52041.question: What is the initial state of the MS before the test procedure starts?
question_52041.ground_truth: The MS is in an idle, updated state with a released channel and a TMSI allocated.

question_52043.question: What are the values for maximum number of No. of RLC duplication state for RLCDuplicationInformation in 3GPP TS38.300 v16.1.0 (2018-july) in 3GPP TS38.300 v16.1.0 (2018-july)?

question_52044.question: What is the scenario described in Scenario #4, where a virtual operator leases a network slice from the MNO to provide service to its customers?
question_52044.ground_truth: Network slicing scenario for a virtual operator

question_52047.question: What is the purpose of the Buffer Status reporting (BSR) procedure in 5G NR?
question_52047.ground_truth: The Buffer Status reporting (BSR) procedure is used to provide the serving gNB with information about UL data volume in the MAC entity. It includes several parameters like periodicBSR-Timer, retxBSR-Timer, logicalChannelSR-DelayTimer, etc which controls the BSR.

question_52048.question: What does the Edge Enabler Client determine in the first step of the Edge Enabler Client triggered application context relocation solution?
question_52048.ground_truth: The Edge Enabler Client determines if the application context for the UE needs to be relocated based on the EDN service area and UE location information.

question_52049.question: What is a requirement for roaming in the context of group messaging using MBMS?
question_52049.ground_truth: To allow for roaming, the Mz interface as defined in TS 23.246 needs to be supported in eMBMS.

question_52050.question: What are the generic requirements for AVP filtering to be consistent across different reference points (e.g. Gy, S6a) towards roaming partners?
question_52050.ground_truth: The generic requirements for AVP filtering involve relying on existing specifications for Proxy OCS and DEAs to ensure consistent filtering across different reference points towards roaming partners.

question_52052.question: What information does the break signal octet carry in a data stream for the DLC?
question_52052.ground_truth: The break signal octet carries information about a break signal detected in the data stream for the DLC.

question_52053.question: What is the role of the TWAG in the establishment of an S2a bearer in a multiple point-to-point connection UE-TWAN setup?
question_52053.ground_truth: The TWAG establishes dedicated S2a bearers on S2a for the same PDN connection based on PCC decisions. It also maintains a 1 to 1 mapping between an S2a bearer and a WLCP bearer.

question_52054.question: What information does the DNS AF check to determine if edge breakout is needed in step 2 of the detailed procedure using ECS option?
question_52054.ground_truth: The DNS AF checks if the App (FQDN) is under an SLA agreement for Edge and if an App Session Context exits for this IP in PCF, meaning that there is edge breakout already applied for an UE session.

question_52056.question: What is the total number of coded bits for all the encoded HARQ-ACK blocks for FDD or TDD HARQ-ACK multiplexing?
question_52056.ground_truth: The total number of coded bits for all the encoded HARQ-ACK blocks is denoted by "z".

question_52059.question: Which type of X2AP IoT element does the ID-Ethernet-Type represent in the context of the E-RABs-To-Be-SetupRetrieve-Item X2AP-PROTOCOL-IES?
question_52059.ground_truth: The ID-Ethernet-Type element represents the Ethernet-Type in the context of the E-RABs-To-Be-SetupRetrieve-Item X2AP-PROTOCOL-IES.

question_52060.question: What is the basic network architecture described in Alternative 1, and what are the primary services provided in this solution?
question_52060.ground_truth: The basic network architecture in Alternative 1 consists of several functions and roles, such as Connectivity Credential Issuing Function, Discovery and Registration Function, and MCIM Download and Provisioning Function. The primary services provided include initial and operational connectivity, application, and M2ME supply.

question_52062.question: What is the timing of the measurement period used for UE transmit power estimation in this test?
question_52062.ground_truth: The timing of the measurement period is one slot, which is the same as the timing of the DPCH slot.

question_52063.question: How are the registers used to keep track of the history of SAD1-related decisions?
question_52063.ground_truth: The registers are updated to reflect the latest frames with regard to the decisions by removing the oldest decision and adding the latest, and updating to reflect the current number of active frames in the registers.

question_52064.question: How does the Mobile Base Station Relay (MBSR) broadcast the service time information in its vicinity?
question_52064.ground_truth: The MBSR broadcasts the service time information in its vicinity by including it in System Information Blocks (SIBs) when commanded to broadcast SIBs.

question_52065.question: What message is sent by the new MME to the old MME/S4-SGSN when buffered DL data should be forwarded to a specific F-TEID, either in the eNB or for indirect forwarding?

question_52066.question: What is the required minimum conformance level for the rate of correct SyncRef UE (re)selection in repeated tests in NR sidelink communication?
question_52066.ground_truth: The required minimum conformance level for the rate of correct SyncRef UE (re)selection in repeated tests is at least 90%.

question_52067.question: What action will the UE take if two or more packet filters with identical packet filter identifiers are not contained in the new request and the old packet filters have the identical packet filter identifiers?
question_52067.ground_truth: If two or more packet filters with identical packet filter identifiers are not contained in the new request, the UE will not diagnose an error, further process the new request and, if successful, delete the old packet filters with the identical packet filter identifiers.

question_52068.question: What does the PCF provision when a PCC rule is provisioned to the I-SMF?
question_52068.ground_truth: The PCF provisions the usage threshold for a MK included in a PCC rule at the time the PCC Rule is provisioned to the SMF. If the PCC Rule is provisioned to the I-SMF, the PCF also provides a usage threshold to the I-SMF for traffic steering.

question_52070.question: What is the difference between the two solutions provided for CN and RAN level key separation?
question_52070.ground_truth: Solution 1 provides fresh keys for communication between the UE and network and checks the presence of the UICC, while solution 2 limits the amount of data compromised if an attacker compromises a collapsed RNC and only allows data from the current session to be compromised.

question_52071.question: What is the purpose of Common TA offset in NTN?
question_52071.ground_truth: Common TA offset is used to compensate for the propagation delay in NTNs by allowing the UE sufficient processing time between a downlink reception and an uplink transmission.

question_52072.question: What is the procedure to generate the multi-path fading propagation conditions using the CDL models?
question_52072.ground_truth: The procedure involves generating cluster delays, then scaling them by a desired RMS delay spread. After that, arrival and departure angles are generated based on the scaled delay. Then, the azimuth and zenith angles are coupled within a cluster.

question_52073.question: What is the "ready to transmit" state for the MS described in the test procedure?
question_52073.ground_truth: The MS is in the 'ready to transmit' state when it has established a signalling link indicating the correct timing advance and power level on the new DCCH on cell B.

question_52075.question: What should the MCVideo client do when it receives a SIP 2xx response to the SIP INVITE request and the MCVideo emergency group call state is set to "MVEGC 2: emergency-call-requested" or "MVEGC 3: emergency-call-granted"?
question_52075.ground_truth: The MCVideo client shall perform the actions specified in subclause~6.2.8.1.4 when it receives a SIP 2xx response to the SIP INVITE request and the MCVideo emergency group call state is set to "MVEGC 2: emergency-call-requested" or "MVEGC 3: emergency-call-granted".

question_52077.question: What should the mobile station do if a valid minimum set of System Information messages for the new cell is not stored in the MS operating in A/Gb mode during PS handover?
question_52077.ground_truth: The mobile station should return to the cell on which the PS HANDOVER COMMAND message was received, send a PACKET CELL CHANGE FAILURE message with cause "PS Handover failure-others" and resume the TBFs that were ongoing in the old cell.

question_52078.question: What is the role of the AF and application domain controllers in determining the anycast IP route information for forwarding application packets from the UE to the "closest" application server?
question_52078.ground_truth: The AF and application domain controllers use N6 network measurements provided by OAM, along with other application domain policy for determining the anycast IP route information. This information is derived and pushed to N6 routers corresponding to EAS instances provisioned by the application domain.

question_52079.question: What system sends a location request to the 4G GMLC when the NEF determines that a UE resides in the 4G network and needs to know its location for LDR type services?

question_52080.question: What is the purpose of specifying Least Restrictive Technical Conditions (LRTC) in terms of Block Edge Mask (BEM) for the LTE FDD 2,6GHz Supplemental Downlink band (2 570-2 620 MHz)?
question_52080.ground_truth: The purpose of specifying LRTC in terms of BEM for the LTE FDD 2,6GHz Supplemental Downlink band is to ensure the harmonized utilization of spectrum for mobile/fixed communications networks operating within the band 2 500-2 690 MHz, while minimizing interference between different networks.

question_52081.question: What message is used to request the NG-RAN node to transfer OTDOA information to the LMF?
question_52081.ground_truth: The OTDOA INFORMATION REQUEST message is used to request the NG-RAN node to transfer OTDOA information to the LMF.

question_52082.question: What is the method for generating the random MS locations for TTFF tests in TS 51.010-1?
question_52082.ground_truth: For every Test Instance in each TTFF test case, the MS location is randomly selected to be within 3 km of the Reference Location with the Altitude of the MS being randomly selected between 0 m to 500 m above WGS-84 reference ellipsoid.

question_52083.question: What are the two phases for Cooperative Short Distance Grouping (CoSdG) and how do they differ?
question_52083.ground_truth: Phase I involves a trained professional driver leading a group of fully automated following vehicles with small distance between them and up to 40Hz message exchange. Phase II involves all vehicles being driven fully automatically, allowing smaller distances between them, requiring a higher transmission frequency of 100Hz, and reduced end-to-end latency.

question_52084.question: What must a UE do if it detects a cdma2000 1X cell that has met cell reselection criterion and Treselection timer has a non-zero value?
question_52084.ground_truth: Evaluate this CDMA2000 1X cell for the Treselection time and reselect that cell if the reselection criteria are met within this duration.

question_52085.question: What should be the Squal value for a cell to be considered during cell reselection to a lower priority NR frequency or inter-RAT frequency than the serving frequency?
question_52085.ground_truth: The Squal value for a cell should be greater than ThreshX, LowQ during a time interval TreselectionRAT for it to be considered during cell reselection to a lower priority NR frequency or inter-RAT frequency than the serving frequency.

question_52087.question: In 5G Media Streaming, what does the H.264 (AVC) media decoding capability AVC-HD-Dec stand for?
question_52087.ground_truth: AVC-HD-Dec is the capability to decode H.264 (AVC) Progressive High Profile Level 3.1 bitstreams, with a maximum VCL Bit Rate of 14 Mbps and specific cpbBrVclFactor and cpbBrNalFactor values.

question_52088.question: What does the "followingARFCNs" field represent in the "CarrierFreqsGERAN" information element?
question_52088.ground_truth: The "followingARFCNs" field represents a list of GERAN BCCH carrier frequencies, which can be represented as an explicit list, equally spaced ARFCNs, or a variable bit map of ARFCNs.

question_52089.question: What should the P-CSCF do when receiving an INVITE dialog request, regarding the Contact and CSeq header field values?
question_52089.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should replace the saved Contact and CSeq header field values, and save the GRUU received in the Contact header field of the request.

question_52091.question: What type of interference occurs when the UE is in SHO and the macro cell is the serving cell while the LPN downlink signal generates interference to the macro UEs?
question_52091.ground_truth: DL interference from LPN to macro node UEs.

question_52093.question: What are the general results of the commands performed?
question_52093.ground_truth: The first and third commands were performed successfully but the second command was performed successfully but with an unsuccessful request for an icon display.

question_52094.question: What is sent over the 5G MBS session during a group call in MCVideo?
question_52094.ground_truth: Both the media packets as well as the floor control messages to the receiving users are sent on the 5G MBS session. Optionally a separate 5G MBS session could be used for the floor control messages.

question_52095.question: What is the purpose of the document "3GPP TS 37.571-3: User Equipment (UE) conformance specification for UE positioning; Part 3: Implementation Conformance Statement (ICS)"?
question_52095.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to provide the Implementation Conformance Statement (ICS) proforma for UTRAN, E-UTRAN and NR User Equipment (UE) supporting UE positioning, in compliance with the relevant requirements, and in accordance with the relevant guidance given in ISO/IEC 9646-1 and ISO/IEC 9646-7.

question_52097.question: What does the "3GPP" in the document's title stand for?
question_52097.ground_truth: The "3GPP" in the document's title stands for the "Third Generation Partnership Project", which is a collaboration between telecommunications standards organizations to develop specifications for mobile networks.

question_52099.question: What is one of the responsibilities of the MCData client once it stores the information associated with the MBMS user service?
question_52099.ground_truth: The MCData client must activate the monitoring of the MBMS bearer using the TMGI and other MBMS user service related information.

question_52100.question: What should be the value of the stream identifier in the SETUP message if the network supports multicall and there are no other ongoing calls?
question_52100.ground_truth: The value of the stream identifier shall be equal to 1.

question_52101.question: In the context of the document, what does the acronym XML stand for?

question_52102.question: What should be added in the fulfillmentInfo or intent report when a Self-Organizing Network (SON) orchestration fails or succeeds for intent fulfillment?
question_52102.ground_truth: An attribute may be added in the fulfillmentInfo or intent report for the failure or success of SON orchestration.

question_52103.question: What data type is used for the "TriggerId" attribute in the "tNcgi" type?
question_52103.ground_truth: The data type used for the "TriggerId" attribute in the "tNcgi" type is xs:string.

question_52104.question: What is the requirement for the RMS90 error calculated in Step i)?
question_52104.ground_truth: The requirement for the RMS90 error calculated in Step i) is less than 1.5 microseconds.

question_52105.question: What is the maximum allowed power for UE transmission on Primary and Secondary uplink frequencies when the UE has more than one Activated Uplink Frequency in FDD?
question_52105.ground_truth: The maximum allowed power for UE transmission on Primary Uplink Frequency is the sum of the power pre-allocated for all non-empty non-scheduled MAC-d flows and the power P(i) as a result of the power splitting for this frequency. For the Secondary Uplink Frequency, the maximum allowed power for UE transmission is the resulting P(i) power for this frequency.

question_52107.question: Which UE peak rate reduction options do not cause a coverage loss?
question_52107.ground_truth: PR1 and PR2 UE peak rate reduction options are not expected to cause coverage loss.

question_52109.question: What should the MAC entity do when a PDCCH for BWP switching is received during an ongoing Random Access procedure on that serving cell?
question_52109.ground_truth: If the PDCCH for BWP switching is received while an ongoing Random Access procedure is ongoing, the MAC entity should stop the ongoing Random Access procedure and initiate a new Random Access procedure after performing the BWP switching.

question_52110.question: What is the minimum length of the Service area list information element?
question_52110.ground_truth: The Service area list information element has a minimum length of 6 octets.

question_52111.question: What is the role of the FRMCS security server in sharing FRMCS Equipment by FRMCS Users?
question_52111.ground_truth: The FRMCS security server confirms the user identification and provides authentication information to the trainborne UE to register the train driver as the user of the trainborne UE to relay a call.

question_52113.question: What is the function of the De-multiplexing entity in Dual Cell E-DCH operation and 1.28 Mcps TDD Multi-Carrier E-DCH operation?
question_52113.ground_truth: In Dual Cell E-DCH operation, there is one De-multiplexing entity per E-DCH transport channel, and in 1.28 Mcps TDD Multi-Carrier E-DCH operation, there is one De-multiplexing entity for all E-DCH transport channels per UE.

question_52114.question: What information does the MS include in the LCS-MOLR Invoke message when requesting its own location?
question_52114.ground_truth: The LCS QoS information (e.g. accuracy and response time) is included in the LCS-MOLR Invoke message when requesting its own location.

question_52115.question: What action does the UE take when T5 expires during the test procedure?
question_52115.ground_truth: The UE transmits a RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection, including the release of established radio bearers and all radio resources.

question_52119.question: What is the impact of passing the tests in accordance with the described test procedure?
question_52119.ground_truth: Successfully passing the test indicates that the UE meets the requirements outlined in the test specification, namely the E-UTRA radio link monitoring requirements in 3GPP TS 36.133. It ensures the proper detection of out-of-sync and in-sync states for monitoring downlink radio link quality in various scenarios, which in turn guarantees efficient communication and effective utilization of network resources.

question_52121.question: What is the role of an NGCN-to-NGCN relationship in the NGN business model?
question_52121.ground_truth: An NGCN-to-NGCN relationship represents a relationship between two NGCNs that may belong to different operators or represent parts of the same NGCN. This relationship is used to create communications in some scenarios, and both NGCNs have their own relationship with an NGN.

question_52122.question: In what scenario would the UE set the failureType as "bh-RLF" during the initiation of the MCGFailureInformation message transmission?
question_52122.ground_truth: This would occur when the UE initiates transmission of the MCGFailureInformation message due to a BH RLF indication on BAP entity from the MCG and the UE is connected as an IAB-node.

question_52124.question: What are some trust models that can be used to establish a trust relationship between a MnS consumer and producer in a 3GPP management system?
question_52124.ground_truth: Some trust models include validated trust, direct historical trust, mediated trust, mandated trust, hybrid trust, direct trust, transitive trust, and delegating trust.

question_52125.question: What is one of the requirements for the mobile station during a finely synchronized handover?
question_52125.ground_truth: The mobile station shall correctly apply the handover procedure from TCH/F with frequency hopping to TCH/F without frequency hopping in the finely synchronized case when a call is in progress.

question_52126.question: What is the purpose of the "TrBk concatenation / Code block segmentation" step in the 3GPP TS?
question_52126.ground_truth: The "TrBk concatenation / Code block segmentation" step in the 3GPP TS is used to divide transport blocks into smaller code blocks, if necessary, before applying channel coding. This step can also involve the concatenation of multiple transport blocks into a single block, if required.

question_52127.question: Which parameter is used to indicate the relative time since cell identity information was collected by the UE?
question_52127.ground_truth: The cell-info-age parameter is used to indicate the relative time since cell identity information was collected by the UE.

question_52128.question: What is the intention of the SA3 catalogue in the context of network product class security?
question_52128.ground_truth: The intention of the SA3 catalogue is to construct a security requirements catalogue for network product classes, by adapting existing security requirements from identified sources and reusing them during the normative phase of other network product classes.

question_52129.question: What is the minimum SNR for the serving cell in uplink TCI state switching?
question_52129.ground_truth: The minimum SNR for the serving cell in uplink TCI state switching is -3dB.

question_52130.question: What does the "AuthorizedV2XServiceList" node contain, and what is its significance in this authorization list?
question_52130.ground_truth: The "AuthorizedV2XServiceList" node contains V2X services identified by a V2X service identifier that are authorized for V2X communication over LTE-Uu. This node is significant as it specifies which V2X services are allowed to communicate over this network.

question_52131.question: What is the effect of including the Transport Mode in a PCC rule that is used for the detected SDF?
question_52131.ground_truth: The Transport Mode may be included in a PCC rule that is used for the detected SDF only when the Steering functionality is the MPQUIC functionality.

question_52132.question: What is the capability that can be used by MnS consumer to request intent-driven MnS producer to check the feasibility for intent fulfillment before intent creation?
question_52132.ground_truth: The intent fulfilment feasibility check capability which can be used by MnS consumer.

question_52135.question: What should the SM entity do when it receives the MODIFY SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message from the network in the UMTS case?
question_52135.ground_truth: The SM entity should modify the corresponding PDP context based on the information received in the message and return the MODIFY SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT ACCEPT message to the network to confirm.

question_52136.question: What should the UE include in the REMOTE UE REPORT message for the IPv4 address it allocated to a 5G ProSe remote UE if the UE enabled TCP usage to the 5G ProSe remote UE?
question_52136.ground_truth: The UE shall include in the REMOTE UE REPORT message the TCP port range assigned to the 5G ProSe remote UE in the NAT function of 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay if the UE allocated an IPv4 address to a 5G ProSe remote UE and enabled TCP usage to the 5G ProSe remote UE.

question_52138.question: What should be the operation of the ME in Expected Sequence 5.1, as defined in clause 27.22.4.23.5.4.2?
question_52138.ground_truth: The ME shall operate in the manner defined in expected sequence 5.1, which is to respond to an AT Command contained within a RUN AT COMMAND with UCS2 alpha identifier presented in Chinese.

question_52139.question: What is the percentage of system access attempts that were not successful after reaching the maximum number of RACH requests, for both 23 dBm and 33 dBm output power levels?
question_52139.ground_truth: The percentage of failed system access attempts is very small (< 0.03 %) for both output power levels.

question_52140.question: What is the initial condition for the SoLSA MS when performing emergency cell reselection?
question_52140.ground_truth: The SoLSA MS shall monitor the received signal level of all RF channels within its band of operation and search for a BCCH carrier which has C1 > 0 and which is not barred.

question_52141.question: What is the maximum length supported by the system for a RAN-INFORMATION/Initial Multiple Report PDU in MBMS data channel?
question_52141.ground_truth: "RAN-INFORMATION/Initial Multiple Report or RAN-INFORMATION/Single Report PDU exceeds the maximum supported length" is one of the causes for sending an Application Error Container IE in MBMS data channel.

question_52142.question: What triggers EAS rediscovery in the H-SMF during PDU Session modification?
question_52142.ground_truth: V-SMF triggers EAS rediscovery when there is insertion, change, or removal of V-PSA for the PDU Session.

question_52143.question: What is the role of the VCC Application when it receives the "2G CS Handover Required" message from the CS Proxy?
question_52143.ground_truth: When the VCC Application receives the "2G CS Handover Required" message from the CS Proxy, it takes on the role of an anchor MSC-server in the "basic handover procedure requiring a circuit connection between MSC-A and MSC-B."

question_52145.question: What will the MME do upon receipt of the SERVICE REQUEST message in the NAS signalling connection if the MUSIM UE does not include the Paging restriction IE in the EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message?
question_52145.ground_truth: The MME shall delete any stored paging restriction for the UE and stop restricting paging.

question_52146.question: What shall the MCVideo client do if it receives a SIP re-INVITE request with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body having the <emergency-ind> element set to "true"?
question_52146.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should display to the MCVideo user the MCVideo ID of the originator of the MCVideo emergency group call and an indication that this is an MCVideo emergency group call.

question_52147.question: What will the UE do if the list of preferred PLMN/access technology combinations is received in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message while in the manual PLMN selection mode?
question_52147.ground_truth: The UE will not modify the "Operator Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology" list in this case.

question_52148.question: Which network entity is responsible for requesting the GMLC to start/stop reporting the list of UEs entering or leaving the area(s) of interest?
question_52148.ground_truth: The PCRF is responsible for requesting the GMLC to start/stop reporting the list of UEs entering or leaving the area(s) of interest.

question_52149.question: What is required for a client to initiate the SEALDD service with the SEALDD server?
question_52149.ground_truth: The client needs to have the SEALDD server's address to initiate the SEALDD service.

question_52150.question: What is a condition for the network to trigger the delivery of downlink data to the UE, when using user plane MT-EDT procedures?
question_52150.ground_truth: The UE must support user plane CIoT EPS optimization and the network must have accepted the use of user plane CIoT EPS optimization.

question_52152.question: In what scenario does a UE assume that a DM-RS antenna port for PDCCH receptions in the CORESET and a DM-RS antenna port for PDSCH receptions scheduled by DCI formats provided by PDCCH receptions in the CORESET are quasi co-located with the reference signals provided by the indicated TCI-State?
question_52152.ground_truth: If the UE is provided TCI-State and followUnifiedTCI-State for the CORESET.

question_52154.question: What should an MS do when resources are reallocated by a PACKET UPLINK ASSIGNMENT message in EGPRS TBF mode?
question_52154.ground_truth: The MS should take into consideration the new resources allocated in the PACKET UPLINK ASSIGNMENT message by using the new TFI and coding scheme for transmission of new RLC data blocks and by not including TLLI in the RLC Data Block header.

question_52155.question: What is the meaning of "E-RAB" as used in the context of the document?

question_52156.question: How can an operator control access to service producer resources dynamically?
question_52156.ground_truth: An operator can control access to service producer resources dynamically by requiring NF consumers and producers to mutually authenticate during TLS session establishment via certificates, and then requiring the NF consumer to present an OAuth2.0 authorization token to the producer in the service request within the TLS tunnel.

question_52159.question: What is the purpose of the status checking function in the context of the simple number translation service?
question_52159.ground_truth: The status checking function determines whether the user is available to receive a call or not, and sends a release cause to the calling party if the user is busy.

question_52160.question: What is the role of the PCC framework in QoS control?
question_52160.ground_truth: The PCC (Policy and Charging Control) framework in 5G systems is responsible for providing mechanisms to initiate QoS (Quality of Service) Flow establishment and modification as part of the QoS control. It can handle both guaranteed bitrate (GBR) bearers and non-guaranteed bitrate bearers.

question_52161.question: What must a UE do when it receives a 422 (Session Interval Too Small) response to an INVITE request with a Min-SE header field?
question_52161.ground_truth: The UE must retry the request in accordance with RFC 4028 subclause 7.4.

question_52162.question: What should be treated jointly when poor network conditions prevent resource allocation to a service flow?
question_52162.ground_truth: Other service flows in the same coordination group should be treated jointly to save network resources.

question_52163.question: What is the aim of the OSA architecture in 3GPP networks?
question_52163.ground_truth: The aim of the OSA architecture in 3GPP networks is to provide an open standardized interface for application developers to access network functionality.

question_52164.question: Why is it preferred to use the end-to-end architecture for message screening, if protection mode 1 is agreed upon by the communicating PLMNs?
question_52164.ground_truth: From a security point of view, using the end-to-end architecture for message screening is preferred when protection mode 1 is agreed upon by the communicating PLMNs, as it provides better protection against spoofing and unauthorized access.

question_52165.question: What is the overall delays measured test requirement in 6.6.1.4.4.4?
question_52165.ground_truth: The overall delays measured test requirement is expressed as: Overall delays measured = measurement reporting delay + TTI insertion uncertainty. The measurement reporting delay = Tidentify_intra_without_index and Tidentify_intra_without_index = TPSS/SSS_sync_intra + TSSB_measurement_period_intra.

question_52167.question: What is the mean UL Average-UPT gain for semi-static SBFD at high load level with SBFD Alt 4 and small packet size?
question_52167.ground_truth: The mean UL Average-UPT gain for semi-static SBFD at high load level with SBFD Alt 4 and small packet size is 249.09%.

question_52168.question: When is the SGSN required to adjust the mobile reachable timer and/or implicit detach timer to minimize unneeded signalling after the Mobility Management back-off timer expires?
question_52168.ground_truth: If the SGSN rejects a Routing Area Update Request or a Service Request with a Mobility Management back-off timer which is larger than the sum of the MS's periodic RA Update timer plus the implicit detach timer.

question_52169.question: What should the MS do upon receiving the CONNECT message?
question_52169.ground_truth: The MS should return a CONNECT ACKNOWLEDGE message.

question_52170.question: What are the three features that are relevant to the specific TAFs for facsimile service in the Error Correction mode?
question_52170.ground_truth: The three features that are relevant to the specific TAFs for facsimile service in the Error Correction mode are the additional HDLC frame to be detected, the handling of the Message phase, and the modification of the Channel rate (CMM request).

question_52171.question: What is one of the functions of the RLC layer in EGPRS and EC-GSM-IoT?
question_52171.ground_truth: The RLC layer in EGPRS and EC-GSM-IoT is responsible for storing soft values of erroneous RLC data blocks and combining them with the retransmitted RLC data blocks in incremental redundancy (IR) mode.

question_52172.question: What does an Iub DCH Data Port represent in the UTRAN network?
question_52172.ground_truth: An Iub DCH Data Port represents one user plane transport bearer, which carries only one DCH data stream, except in the case of coordinated DCHs where data streams are multiplexed on one user plane transport bearer.

question_52173.question: What is the Test Tolerance for the Relative Code Domain Error test?
question_52173.ground_truth: The Test Tolerance for this test is defined in clause F.2, and the explanation of how the Minimum Requirement has been relaxed by the Test Tolerance is given in clause F.4.

question_52174.question: What is the minimum number of residual bit error events determined by the SS for the bits of class Ib and class II?
question_52174.ground_truth: The SS determines the minimum number of residual bit error events for the bits of class Ib and class II by examining at least the minimum number of samples of consecutive bits.

question_52175.question: What is required for an application in a SL Positioning Client UE to retrieve the location information of a Target UE?
question_52175.ground_truth: The SL Positioning Client UE needs to initiate discovery to discover the Target UE and issue a Service Request message over PC5 to the Target UE.

question_52177.question: When should the E-CSCF store the access-network-charging-info parameter from the P-Charging-Vector header field?
question_52177.ground_truth: The E-CSCF should store the access-network-charging-info parameter from the P-Charging-Vector header field when it receives any request or response related to a UE-originated dialog or standalone transaction.

question_52178.question: In what order does a UE apply ISMP, IARP, and ISRP when they are all available and the ANDSF rules control the WLAN access selection and traffic routing?
question_52178.ground_truth: The UE first applies the ISMP, then the IARP, and finally the ISRP.

question_52179.question: When can the CSE invoke CAMEL warning tones for a SCUDIF call?
question_52179.ground_truth: The CAMEL warning tone may be ordered by the CSE if the selected service is not multi media at the time of tone connection.

question_52182.question: What is the role of the MGCF in the IMS architecture?
question_52182.ground_truth: The MGCF (Media Gateway Control Function) is responsible for setting up the bearer control signalling session, performing a setup of the MGW, and creating an INVITE with an Offer containing the SDP from the MGW in the IMS architecture.

question_52183.question: What action does the MS need to take after receiving the HANDOVER COMMAND from the SS?
question_52183.ground_truth: The MS needs to send 4 access bursts on the new DCCH to cell B and establish a signalling link with the correct timing advance before sending the HANDOVER COMPLETE message.

question_52184.question: What are the two deployment options for IMS in intercepting the service type of Voice?
question_52184.ground_truth: The two deployment options for IMS in intercepting the service type of Voice are Default and Alternate option.

question_52185.question: When should the MME reject a PDN Connectivity Request from an emergency attached or RLOS attached UE?
question_52185.ground_truth: The MME should reject the request if the UE indicated Control Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation supported in Preferred Network Behaviour, supports header compression, and the PDN Connectivity Request is not allowed by the UE's mobility or access restrictions.

question_52186.question: What is the purpose of the conference focus in the described use case?
question_52186.ground_truth: The conference focus is an entity responsible for hosting and managing conferences, including creating, maintaining, and manipulating media. It also implements conference policies such as talk burst control and assigning participant rights.

question_52187.question: What is the frequency offset of the unwanted signal transmitted in step b)?
question_52187.ground_truth: The unwanted signal is transmitted at a nominal frequency 200 kHz above or below the nominal frequency of the wanted signal in step b).

question_52189.question: What is the required format of the source and destination device identifier in the call control communication process?
question_52189.ground_truth: The source device is always "ME" (short for Mobile Equipment), and the destination device is always "UICC" (short for Universal Integrated Circuit Card).

question_52192.question: What is one potential requirement for providing efficient transfer of infrequent uplink data for low power devices in the context of wide area sensor monitoring and event driven alarms?
question_52192.ground_truth: One potential requirement is that the system shall support efficient transfer of infrequent uplink data for low power devices, to minimize overhead while uploading data.

question_52193.question: What is a 5G Virtual Network (VN) group in the context of 5G LAN-type service?
question_52193.ground_truth: A 5G Virtual Network (VN) group is a set of UEs using private communication for 5G LAN-type services characterized by 5G VN group identities, 5G VN group membership, and 5G VN group data.

question_52195.question: What clauses provide additional details on BSSAP message transfer on E-Interface?
question_52195.ground_truth: Clauses 4.5.4 and 4.7.4.1 provide additional details on BSSAP message transfer on E-Interface.

question_52196.question: What is the purpose of the SMF in the PDU Session establishment or modification process in 5G?
question_52196.ground_truth: The SMF (Session Management Function) plays a crucial role in the PDU Session establishment or modification process in 5G. It creates or updates the SM policy, which includes traffic routing information, based on received application traffic like DNS Query or service data for the application.

question_52198.question: What should be the value of the TPC commands transmitted during steps B and C in the test procedure?
question_52198.ground_truth: During step B, a sequence of 50 TPC commands with the value 1 should be transmitted, and during step C, a sequence of 50 TPC commands with the value 0 should be transmitted.

question_52200.question: What is the main challenge of filtering in mm-wave frequencies?
question_52200.ground_truth: The main challenge is the limited size and the high level of integration required for mm-wave frequencies, making it difficult to fit discrete mm-wave filters in the available space.

question_52201.question: What is the risk if the MSGin5G server shares sensitive information with an unverified Application Server?
question_52201.ground_truth: The Application Server can use this information to mount attacks and get services without authorization.

question_52202.question: Who is responsible for checking the authorization of the MCPTT user to initiate the change of affiliation relationship in the primary MCPTT server?
question_52202.ground_truth: The primary MCPTT server is responsible for checking the authorization of the MCPTT user to initiate the change of affiliation relationship in the primary MCPTT server.

question_52203.question: What is the frequency range that is likely to experience intermodulation between the LTE 450 transmission and the SARC transmitter?
question_52203.ground_truth: The 3rd order intermodulation term between the LTE 450 transmission and the SARC transmitter is likely to fall within the receive band, which is 5 MHz away from the SARC transmitter.

question_52204.question: What is the maximum aggregate adjustment rate for the UE uplink timing?
question_52204.ground_truth: The maximum aggregate adjustment rate is Tq per 200ms.

question_52205.question: What is the role of the packed regions and the layering order in the RWP SEI message in the 360-degree video bitstream?
question_52205.ground_truth: The RWP SEI message does not define the role of the packed regions and the layering order in the 360-degree video bitstream. An RTP header extension (RHE) can be used for carrying this information.

question_52207.question: What is the purpose of calculating scaling factors for the predicted bands in the Normal mode PFSC decoding process?
question_52207.ground_truth: The scaling factors are used to adjust the energy of the predicted high-frequency spectrum based on the decoded band energies.

question_52208.question: What is the Unreliable Frame Ratio (UFR) in the context of 3GPP~TS~06.21?
question_52208.ground_truth: The Unreliable Frame Ratio (UFR) is the ratio of frames declared as erased or unreliable to the total number of frames transmitted.

question_52211.question: What is the APDU remote command coding method defined in the document?
question_52211.ground_truth: The APDU remote command coding should comply with ETSI TS 102 226, as defined in the present document.

question_52214.question: What is the purpose of the HXRES* in the 5G HE AV on the AUSF side during 5G AKA authentication?
question_52214.ground_truth: The HXRES* is calculated from XRES* and KSEAF, and replaces XRES* in the 5G HE AV to protect the EAP security features from bidding down.

question_52215.question: What is one of the requirements for efficient content delivery in the 5G system?
question_52215.ground_truth: The 5G system shall enable efficient delivery of content from a content caching application under the control of the operator.

question_52217.question: What constitutes the capabilities of the UAS application enabler layer for efficient use and deployment of UAS in 3GPP networks?
question_52217.ground_truth: The capabilities of the UAS application enabler layer include the functional architecture, procedures, and information flows necessary for efficient use and deployment of UAS over 3GPP systems.

question_52218.question: What should a UE do if it, while one or more Tsor-cm timers are running, cannot recover the N1 NAS signalling connection?
question_52218.ground_truth: The UE shall stop the timer(s) in this case.

question_52219.question: What is the key issue that Solution #4 aims to address?
question_52219.ground_truth: Solution #4 aims to address Key Issue #1, which is the ability to establish direct C2 communication between a UAV and a UAV-C over PC5.

question_52221.question: What is the applicability for the spectral emission mask test for intra-band non-contiguous EN-DC?
question_52221.ground_truth: The test applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 15 and forward, supporting intra-band non-contiguous EN-DC.

question_52223.question: What is the definition of "reliability" as defined in 3GPP TR 22.874 V18.2.0?
question_52223.ground_truth: Reliability is defined as the percentage value of the amount of sent network layer packets successfully delivered to a given system entity within the time constraint required by the targeted service, divided by the total number of sent network layer packets.

question_52224.question: What is the size of the security contents when using a Keyed-MAC signature scheme with an ECQV certificate structure at 112-bit security level?
question_52224.ground_truth: The security contents occupy 73-bytes in total.

question_52225.question: What is removed from the stored rejected NSSAI when a new allowed NSSAI is received for a given PLMN or SNPN?
question_52225.ground_truth: The S-NSSAI(s) included in the new allowed NSSAI are removed from the stored rejected NSSAI for the current PLMN or SNPN, the rejected NSSAI for the current registration area, the rejected NSSAI for the maximum number of UEs reached, and the partially rejected NSSAI.

question_52226.question: What is the test purpose in clause 8.2.1.3, in regards to DCH demodulation in static propagation conditions?
question_52226.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify the receiver's ability to receive the test signal under static propagation conditions with a BLER not exceeding a specified limit.

question_52227.question: What is the role of the Leading Operator Platform (L-OP) and Participating Operator Platform (P-OP) in the Edge Federation?
question_52227.ground_truth: The L-OP and P-OP are both ECSP Management Systems, where the P-OP provides its EDN to be shared with the L-OP.

question_52228.question: What must the H-GMLC do if the location estimate of the target UE is not allowed to be provided to the LCS Client due to privacy check failure?
question_52228.ground_truth: The H-GMLC must initiate a cancellation procedure.

question_52229.question: What is the difference in procedure for SRBs when the reordering function is used and not used?
question_52229.ground_truth: When the reordering function is not used, the UE directly delivers the resulting PDCP SDU to the upper layer, assuming integrity verification is passed or not applicable. When the reordering function is used, the UE follows the procedures specified in clause 5.1.2.1.4.1.

question_52230.question: What is the concept behind the Narrowband GSM (N-GSM) evolution of GSM to support low rate data devices?
question_52230.ground_truth: The N-GSM concept combines precoding and hybrid modulation, achieving a waveform that occupies only a fraction of bandwidth compared to normal symbol rate. It also results in an extended time-to-transmit interval (TTI) for RLC blocks, adding repetition and adaptive chase combining, allowing more efficient resource utilization compared to blind repetitions. This provides extended coverage for various radio channel conditions and supports a wider set of use-cases.

question_52231.question: What is the pre-condition for initiating late call entry signalling in the LMR system?
question_52231.ground_truth: A group call is already ongoing in the LMR system, and the LMR system is the controlling system for the interworking group call.

question_52232.question: What should the data link layer entity in the MS do if timer T200 expires before a UA response is received?
question_52232.ground_truth: If timer T200 expires before a UA response has been received, the data link layer entity shall retransmit the SABM command as in sub-clause 8.4.1.4, set timer T200 right before transmitting a frame, increment the retransmission counter by 1, and retransmit the SABM command N200 times. After N200 retransmissions, the data link layer shall enter the idle state and issue a DL-RELEASE-INDICATION primitive to the layer 3 entity.

question_52233.question: What is the function of the layer-2 frame header in this solution?
question_52233.ground_truth: The layer-2 frame header in this solution contains at least a Destination Layer-2 ID that can be set to a unicast, groupcast, or broadcast identifier, and a Source Layer-2 ID that is always set to a unicast identifier.

question_52235.question: What is the measurement provided by the "PHR Measurement" in the context of 3GPP 5G specifications?
question_52235.ground_truth: The "PHR Measurement" provides a bin distribution (histogram) of Type 1 power headroom measurements.

question_52237.question: What happens in Step 8 of the session release: AoC-E - serving party clears?
question_52237.ground_truth: The CDF closes the MMTel-CDR with AoC-E and AoC Information included.

question_52239.question: What is the message sent by the gNB-CU to gNB-DU in case the gNB-CU is not able to execute the requested functions in the Multicast Context Notification procedure?
question_52239.ground_truth: The MULTICAST CONTEXT NOTIFICATION REFUSE message is sent by the gNB-CU to gNB-DU in case the gNB-CU is not able to execute the requested functions in the Multicast Context Notification procedure.

question_52240.question: What action does the MME take when it receives a Downlink Data Notification message for which no MM context exists?
question_52240.ground_truth: The MME returns a Downlink Data Notification Acknowledge message to the Serving GW with an appropriate cause and deletes the related Bearer context.

question_52242.question: What is the primary focus of primary frequency control with up to 100% RES?
question_52242.ground_truth: The primary focus of primary frequency control with up to 100% RES is on the instant monitoring and control of the frequency in the grid.

question_52244.question: What information does the AMF include in the Registration Accept message for the UE with regards to the Allowed NSSAI?
question_52244.ground_truth: The Allowed NSSAI provided in the Registration Accept is valid in the Registration Area and it applies for all the PLMNs which have their Tracking Areas included in the Registration Area. The Mapping Of Allowed NSSAI is the mapping of each S-NSSAI of the Allowed NSSAI to the HPLMN S-NSSAIs.

question_52245.question: What is the measurement that provides the number of attempts to add a radio link to the active link set on the UMTS UTRAN side made by the UE called?
question_52245.ground_truth: The name of the measurement is SHO.AttRLAddUESide.

question_52246.question: What happens to the lists of forbidden tracking areas when the UE is switched off or the UICC containing the USIM is removed?
question_52246.ground_truth: The lists of forbidden tracking areas are erased when the UE is switched off or the UICC containing the USIM is removed.

question_52247.question: What operation mode handover is addressed only in the "NB-IoT/eMTC support for Non-Terrestrial Networks" work item in Rel-17?

question_52250.question: Which type of E-UTRA UE does the test applicability described in 5.3.2.2.3.2 apply to?
question_52250.ground_truth: The test applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 16 and forward, supporting EN-DC with FR2 and twoStepRACH-r16.

question_52251.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) and what is the purpose of its Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects, Telecommunication Management?
question_52251.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) is an organization that develops technical specifications for the telecommunications industry. The Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects, Telecommunication Management is a part of these specifications that focuses on the management of telecommunication systems and services.

question_52252.question: In what situation must a UE perform an initial emergency registration before attempting an emergency call?
question_52252.ground_truth: When the IM CN subsystem is selected and the UE is currently attached to its home operator's network (e.g. HPLMN) and the UE is currently registered, or if the UE is not currently registered, or if the UE is attached to a different network than its home operator's network (e.g. VPLMN).

question_52253.question: What kind of CDR content is generated by the SMS-SC when the SC receives a "SMS Deliver" message in PEC mode?
question_52253.ground_truth: The SMS-SC generates a SC-DVT-T4 CDR when the SC receives a "SMS Deliver" message in PEC mode.

question_52254.question: What is the purpose of the "UE Identity Index Value" information element?
question_52254.ground_truth: This information element is used by the NG-RAN node to calculate the Paging Frame as specified in the 3GPP technical specifications.

question_52255.question: What is the link layer performance impact of splitting the payload into 2 blocks in the case of MCS7 for an interference limited channel?
question_52255.ground_truth: Splitting the payload into 2 blocks causes a loss in performance of about 1.6 dB as compared to single block coding in the case of MCS7 for an interference limited channel.

question_52256.question: When is an additional cell identification delay expected in the context of higher layer filtering for NR - E-UTRAN TDD RSRP, RSRQ, and RS-SINR measurements?
question_52256.ground_truth: An additional cell identification delay can be expected in the case where higher layer filtering is used for NR - E-UTRAN TDD RSRP, RSRQ, and RS-SINR measurements.

question_52257.question: What is a significant feature of the IMS environment, compared to a general environment for offering SIP and VoIP services?
question_52257.ground_truth: The most salient feature of the IMS environment is that it is fully controlled by the operators.

question_52258.question: What is the bandwidth of the 1447-1467MHz band for TD-LTE in China?
question_52258.ground_truth: The channel bandwidth for the 1447-1467MHz band for TD-LTE in China is 10MHz and 20MHz.

question_52260.question: How does the ASM server communicate with the VAL server and the 3GPP network in the on-network functional model for application service management?
question_52260.ground_truth: The ASM server communicates with the VAL server using the ASM-S interface and the 3GPP network using the N33 reference point in the on-network functional model for application service management.

question_52261.question: What action does the PGW-C take when it receives the PCEF-Initiated IP-CAN Session Modification Procedure with the PCRF?
question_52261.ground_truth: The PGW-C executes the procedure by sending an Sx Session Modification Request to the PGW-U for modifying the Sx session for the UE.

question_52262.question: During which subframe should the UE stop sending CSI reports for SCell during T5 in the test procedure for E-UTRAN TDD hibernation and activation of unknown SCell in non-DRX test?
question_52262.ground_truth: The UE should stop sending CSI reports for SCell at latest in a subframe (n+8) during T5 in the test procedure for E-UTRAN TDD hibernation and activation of unknown SCell in non-DRX test.

question_52263.question: What transport layer security protocol, besides IPsec, is supported for mutual authentication over the N2 interface between the AMF and the 5G-AN?
question_52263.ground_truth: DTLS (Datagram Transport Layer Security) is supported for mutual authentication over the N2 interface between the AMF and the 5G-AN.

question_52264.question: What action does the old SGSN take upon expiration of a timer for supervising when resources in the old Serving GW should be released?
question_52264.ground_truth: When the timer for supervising when resources in the old Serving GW expires, the old SGSN releases the S-GW resources.

question_52265.question: What should the IP-SM-GW include in the Request-URI when sending a SIP MESSAGE request with an RP-ERROR message?
question_52265.ground_truth: The Request-URI should contain the sending user's URI.

question_52266.question: What is the effect of sub-block gap on the requirement applicability for RIBs supporting operation in non-contiguous spectrum?
question_52266.ground_truth: The requirement is also applicable inside a sub-block gap for interfering signal offsets where the interfering signal falls completely within the sub-block gap.

question_52268.question: What is the criticality of the "id-GlobalCN-ID" extension in the RelocationRequestExtensions RANAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION?
question_52268.ground_truth: The criticality of the "id-GlobalCN-ID" extension is "reject".

question_52270.question: In the context of the NDS/AF PKI architecture, what is a SEG CA responsible for issuing?
question_52270.ground_truth: A SEG CA of the domain issues certificates to the SEGs in the domain that have interconnection with SEGs in other domains (i.e., Za-interface) and can also be used in communication with an NE over the Zb-interface.

question_52271.question: What are some potential new requirements needed to support the use case of on-site audio contribution in live programs using 5G?
question_52271.ground_truth: Some potential new requirements necessary to support this use case include the 5G system supporting hot-plugging for new devices to be dynamically added to and removed from a live performance application without any observable impact on the other devices and communication streams, supporting UE speeds of up to 5 km/h and UE rotations of 0.52 rad/s, supporting industry standards for precision clock synchronisation for IP based AV systems, and supporting power management functionality to enable multimedia streaming for several hours on a battery or hot swappable batteries.

question_52272.question: What are the initial conditions for the test procedure in 9.2.1GA.4.1 and 9.2.1GB.4.1?
question_52272.ground_truth: The initial conditions for the test procedure in 9.2.1GA.4.1 and 9.2.1GB.4.1 are test environment: normal; frequencies to be tested: mid range, and the setup of the SS, fader, and AWGN noise source to the UE antenna connector.

question_52273.question: What is the role of the CS-MGW in a 3GPP network?
question_52273.ground_truth: The CS-MGW interfaces with the UTRAN and the core network over Iu. It provides media conversion, bearer control, and payload processing for circuit and packet networks. It also supports mobile specific functions such as handover and anchoring.

question_52275.question: What is the state of the MS in the network initiated PTC re-activation scenario?
question_52275.ground_truth: The MS is in the GA-RRC-CONNECTED state and the PMM-CONNECTED state during the network initiated PTC re-activation scenario.

question_52278.question: How does the UE determine the presence of STTD encoding on a P-CCPCH in a UMTS network?
question_52278.ground_truth: The UE can determine the presence of STTD encoding on the P-CCPCH by receiving higher layer messages, by demodulating the Secondary Common Control Physical Channel (S-CCPCH), or by a combination of the above two. During power on and handover between cells, the UE can determine the presence of STTD encoding on the P-CCPCH, either by receiving the higher layer message or by demodulating the SCH channel.

question_52279.question: What is the role of the reg-await-auth timer in the registration process?
question_52279.ground_truth: The reg-await-auth timer is used to set a temporary SIP level lifetime for the temporary set of security associations during the registration process.

question_52282.question: What should the SCC AS do if an existing leg for a session already exists using a different IP-CAN?
