question_53647.ground_truth: The band index with the minimum envelope is calculated by finding the index of attenuation factor if certain conditions are met, and then adjusting the spectrum of the upper band accordingly.

question_53648.question: How are NRM reference attributes mapped in the CorbaSS?
question_53648.ground_truth: NRM reference attributes are mapped as attributes in the CorbaSS. The names of the reference attributes in the NRM are mapped to the corresponding attribute names in the MOC. When cardinality is 0..1 or 1..1, the datatype for the reference attribute is defined as a MOReference, and when more than one referred MO is allowed, the reference attribute will be of type MOReferenceSet.

question_53652.question: What are the types of measurement control messages for L1 measurements?
question_53652.ground_truth: The types of measurement control messages for L1 measurements are setup, modify and release, which are used to initiate, modify or release specific measurements.

question_53653.question: Under what circumstances does the SMLC abandon the estimate of the MS location based on the information received from the BSS during an MTA procedure?
question_53653.ground_truth: If the SMLC includes "MTA Access Security Method" IE in the RRLP message sent for a given MTA procedure and does not receive a corresponding "MTA Signature" from the BSS, the SMLC abandons the estimate of the MS location based on the information received from the BSS.

question_53657.question: What functions does the physical layer provide to higher layers in E-UTRA?
question_53657.ground_truth: The physical layer provides data transport services to higher layers, offering functions such as error detection on the transport channel, FEC encoding/decoding, Hybrid ARQ soft-combining, and mapping of the coded transport channel onto physical channels.

question_53659.question: What is the procedure for PCF based Service Authorization and Provisioning to a 5G ProSe Remote UE or UE-to-Network Relay?
question_53659.ground_truth: The procedure involves the registration procedures as defined in TS~23.502, UE Policy Association Establishment procedure, and UE Policy Association Modification procedure. The AMF selects the PCF which supports 5G ProSe information provisioning and establishes a UE policy association with the PCF for 5G ProSe Remote UE or UE-to-Network Relay information provisioning delivery.

question_53660.question: What is the startup procedure for a PIN client to join a PIN?
question_53660.ground_truth: The PIN client sends the PIN Management PINE join into PIN request to PEMC, which includes the security credentials, UE identifier, and PIN client profile information. Upon receiving the request, the PEMC performs an authorization check and sends a successful PIN Management PINE join into PIN response to PIN client.

question_53661.question: How does a MS signal a change in its coverage class to the network?
question_53661.ground_truth: A MS signals a change in its coverage class to the network by carrying the estimated downlink coverage class in the random access procedure when it performs random access, and by passing its identity to the base station in the first uplink transmission when using the RACH with Random Number procedure. The base station can identify the MS from the C-RNTI value used in the RACH with C-RNTI procedure.

question_53662.question: What is the action of the MCPTT client when in the "Q2: in-progress emergency private call" state and there is an indication to cancel the emergency private call?
question_53662.ground_truth: The MCPTT client shall generate a PRIVATE CALL EMERGENCY CANCEL message, send it, stop TFP8 timer, initialize the CFP6 counter to 1, start timer TFP6, set the stored current call type, and enter the "Q1: in-progress private call" state.

question_53663.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network in releasing the "LTE Advanced 4 Band Carrier Aggregation (4DL/1UL); Release 13" document?
question_53663.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to gather relevant background information and studies in order to address 4DL Inter-band Carrier Aggregation requirements for the Rel-13 band combinations.

question_53664.question: What is the maximum byte boundary for a SELECT ITEM proactive SIM command?
question_53664.ground_truth: The maximum byte boundary for a SELECT ITEM proactive SIM command is 255 bytes BER-TLV (Basic Encoding Rules-Tag Length Value)

question_53666.question: What is the role of the floor arbitrator in off-network MCPTT operations?
question_53666.ground_truth: The floor arbitrator controls the floor, indicating who has the right to speak, and can grant the right to speak to the next speaker, transfer the floor arbitrator role, and manage the floor control queue.

question_53667.question: What is the task of the PCEF after receiving the PCC Rules from the PCRF containing traffic steering control information?
question_53667.ground_truth: The PCEF enforces the decision and if online charging is applicable, it may request credit for new charging keys from the OCS and/or return the remaining credit for charging keys no longer active to the OCS.

question_53672.question: What type of security is provided for non-RRC signalling traffic between the RN and DeNB in the standard E-UTRAN air interface?
question_53672.ground_truth: The non-RRC signalling traffic between the RN and DeNB is not integrity protected in the standard E-UTRAN air interface.

question_53675.question: What is the procedure for determining the corresponding downlink PDCH pair for a given uplink PDCH pair using timeslots i and j, where j > i?
question_53675.ground_truth: The corresponding downlink PDCH pair is the one using timeslots i and j, or if no such PDCH pair is specified, the one using timeslots i-1 and i, or if no such PDCH pair is specified, the one using timeslots i-2 and i, or if such a PDCH pair exists, the one using timeslots i-3 and i.

question_53676.question: What is the status code that the Control Sink sends to the Control Source when a session is successfully created?
question_53676.ground_truth: The Control Sink responds back to the Control Source with a 201 success message indicating that the session is successfully created.

question_53677.question: What is a pre-requisite for Key Issue #7 solution?
question_53677.ground_truth: The hPLMN must support at least static authorization.

question_53678.question: Which parameter in the 3gpp-Sbi-Routing-Binding header indicates the preferred binding to a binding entity?

question_53680.question: What should the (V-)PCF do upon reception of an HTTP POST request during AMF relocation?
question_53680.ground_truth: The (V-)PCF should update the "Individual UE Policy Association" resource, determine the applicable policy, and include the "suppFeat" attribute with the negotiated supported features and the complete "Individual UE Policy Association" resource representation in the PolicyUpdate data structure.

question_53681.question: What is the role of the SMF in 3GPP networks when an external DHCPv6 server in a DN is used to obtain requested parameters?
question_53681.ground_truth: The SMF acts as a DHCPv6 client towards the external DHCPv6 server while acting a DHCPv6 server towards the UE

question_53683.question: What should the MCData client do upon receiving a SIP 2xx response to the SIP REFER request when receiving a request from an MCData user to initiate a group SDS session within a pre-established session?
question_53683.ground_truth: Interact with the media plane as specified in 3GPP TS 24.582.

question_53686.question: What are the two options for the maximum interference signal level for testing intra system intermodulation in a hybrid AAS BS?
question_53686.ground_truth: The two options for the maximum interference signal level for testing intra system intermodulation in a hybrid AAS BS are: (1) equal to the maximum intra array leakage power for each TAB connector in the transceiver array boundary for each operating band, or (2) equal to the leakage power of the TAB connector experiencing the most leakage power in the array, to be applied for all TAB connectors.

question_53688.question: How is the partner MC system selected for migration?
question_53688.ground_truth: The partner MC system can be selected manually by the user or automatically by an application in the MC service UE, based on the current location or serving PLMN of the MC service UE.

question_53690.question: What type of data types are defined in clause 6.5.6.3.2 of the document?
question_53690.ground_truth: Simple data types are defined in clause 6.5.6.3.2 of the document.

question_53691.question: What is the purpose of the test defined in 6.5A.2.1.2.2?
question_53691.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the power of any UE emission for FR2 3UL CA does not exceed specified levels for the specified channel bandwidth.

question_53692.question: When selecting an NWDAF for ML model provisioning, what additional factors can be considered by the NWDAF?
question_53692.ground_truth: The NWDAF can consider the S-NSSAI(s), area(s) of interest, ML model filter information parameters, time period of interest, FL capability type, NF type(s) or NF set ID(s) of the data source(s), and ML model interoperability indicator.

question_53693.question: What is the function of the List of Queued Users field in the Floor Queue Request message?
question_53693.ground_truth: The List of Queued Users field in the Floor Queue Request message is used to indicate the list of users whose request for permission to send media is queued when sending a message for cancellation of a queued floor request or sending a response message to the cancellation of a queued floor request.

question_53694.question: What are the two main parts of the feedback in support of DL CoMP?
question_53694.ground_truth: The two main parts of the feedback in support of DL CoMP are the channel part and the noise-and-interference part.

question_53696.question: What must the System Simulator (SS) verify during a TBF transfer if a Timing Advance Index is not present in the IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message?
question_53696.ground_truth: The SS must verify that the MS does not send any access bursts in idle frames.

question_53702.question: In what scenario does the MCPTT private call setup procedure for manual commencement mode focus on?
question_53702.ground_truth: The MCPTT private call setup procedure for manual commencement mode focuses on a scenario where an MCPTT user is initiating an MCPTT private call for communicating with another MCPTT user in manual commencement mode.

question_53703.question: In the SL LBT failure MAC CE, what does the Ri field indicate when set to 1?
question_53703.ground_truth: A consistent LBT failure has been triggered and not cancelled in the RB set.

question_53704.question: What is an <Archetype> in object-oriented programming?
question_53704.ground_truth: An <Archetype> is a form or template representing common class properties of a number of represented <InformationObjectClass>. It represents a placeholder class whose attributes, links, operations and interactions may or may not be present in the represented <InformationObjectClass>.

question_53705.question: Which protocol element is mandatory to be included in the "MeasurementRequest-IEs" sequence?
question_53705.ground_truth: The "ID id-LMF-Measurement-ID" and "ID id-TRP-MeasurementRequestList" elements are mandatory in the "MeasurementRequest-IEs" sequence.

question_53706.question: What happens when a user exits the conference call in the described procedure?
question_53706.ground_truth: When a user exits the conference call, no new authentication procedures are necessary, but the group key changes to ensure security.

question_53707.question: What should the MCVideo client include in a SIP re-INVITE request when the MCVideo user requests to upgrade the MCVideo group session to an in-progress emergency group state and is authorized to do so?
question_53707.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body by following the procedures in clause~6.2.8.1.1 when sending a SIP re-INVITE request to upgrade the MCVideo group session to an in-progress emergency group state.

question_53708.question: What should the UE do if it receives the 5GSM network feature support IE in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message with the non-3GPP access path switching bit set to "non-3GPP access path switching supported" during the PDU session establishment procedure?
question_53708.ground_truth: The UE may include the NSONR bit with value set to "non-3GPP path switching while using old non-3GPP resources requested" in the Non-3GPP path switching information IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message while performing the registration procedure for mobility registration update for non-3GPP access path switching.

question_53709.question: What information is reported in the Packet Data Header Summary Reports (PDSRs) when packet header information reporting is authorized?
question_53709.ground_truth: Depending on the requirements of the warrant, the PDSRs can be in summary form and include information such as packet flow description, cell identifiers, and packet data size.

question_53710.question: What is the main purpose of the Information Transfer procedure in the 3GPP network?
question_53710.ground_truth: The Information Transfer procedure is used to transfer information from the CN to the RNC using connectionless signalling.

question_53711.question: What is the size of the N-MAC header payload in the downlink?
question_53711.ground_truth: The N-MAC header payload size in the downlink is 8 bits.

question_53713.question: What does the abbreviation "3GPP" stand for?

question_53714.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's technical report on E-UTRA NR Dual Connectivity with LTE 5DL/1UL and one NR band?
question_53714.ground_truth: The purpose of the report is to gather relevant background information and studies to address Dual Connectivity band combinations of LTE 5DL/1UL + one NR band for the Rel-15 band combinations.

question_53716.question: What action does the PCEF take if no PCC rule is activated for the IP-CAN session at initial establishment?
question_53716.ground_truth: The PCEF rejects the IP-CAN session establishment.

question_53717.question: What functionality is being tested in Test Case 1 under the "Test Procedure" section for CatSelectItem?
question_53717.ground_truth: It is testing the initialization of a select list with a title.

question_53719.question: What are the primary goals of solutions 5 and 8 in the evaluation section?
question_53719.ground_truth: Solution 5 aims to restore PCRF session data effectively and reduce impacts on the PCRF infrastructure, while solution 8 combines bulk signaling to minimize effects on the PCRF infrastructure and optimize the restoration process.

question_53720.question: What is the required TAE for intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation in E-UTRA test requirement?
question_53720.ground_truth: The time alignment error shall not exceed 285 ns.

question_53721.question: What should the UE do when it considers a list of entries to include 'list' in the field name?
question_53721.ground_truth: The UE should create a combined list by concatenating the additional entries included in the extension field to the original field while maintaining the order among both the original and the additional entries.

question_53722.question: What intercepted event sent to DF2 should include Observed SIP URI, Observed TEL URI, Event Time and Date, Network element identifier, and XCAP Message?
question_53722.ground_truth: An intercepted XCAP report sent to DF2.

question_53723.question: What action shall the network take if the timer T3260 expires in the network during the authentication procedure?
question_53723.ground_truth: The network shall abort the authentication procedure and any ongoing MM specific procedure, release all MM connections, and initiate the RR connection release procedure.

question_53724.question: What is the purpose of the Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN) Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP) in 3GPP's telecommunications management?
question_53724.ground_truth: The WLAN NRM IRP is a set of specifications defining requirements for and a protocol-neutral Information Service (IS) to enable an IRPAgent to communicate management information concerning WLAN management to one or more IRPManagers.

question_53726.question: What is the purpose of the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-UE relay discovery solicitation?
question_53726.ground_truth: The purpose of the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-UE relay discovery solicitation is to generate a message to the discoveree end UE containing the UE-to-UE relay UE info parameter, relay service code parameter, resource status indicator, MIC, UTC-based counter, and ProSe direct discovery PC5 message type parameter.

question_53728.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon receiving a SIP BYE request to release the MCVideo chat session?
question_53728.ground_truth: Upon receiving a SIP BYE request for releasing the MCVideo chat session, the MCVideo client shall follow the procedures as specified in subclause 6.2.6 of TS 24.281.

question_53730.question: In satellite-based NTN, what are the significant design constraints for Non Terrestrial Network deployment?
question_53730.ground_truth: The significant design constraints for Non Terrestrial Network deployment are measured by Ke factor, the angle between the UE velocity and the vector pointing to the cell, and the delay spread.

question_53732.question: What reference points are defined in the non-roaming 5G System architecture for U2X communication over PC5?
question_53732.ground_truth: In the non-roaming 5G System architecture for U2X communication over PC5, the reference points defined are U2X1, U2X5, N1, and N2.

question_53733.question: What does the acronym ASN.1 stand for, as used in the document?

question_53734.question: How are the channels organized in terms of operations in the GSM/EDGE Channel coding (Release 17) document?
question_53734.ground_truth: The channels are organized to have a unified decoder structure, with the information bits coded with a systematic block code, followed by encoding with a convolutional code or turbo code, reordering and interleaving the coded bits, and adding a stealing flag.

question_53735.question: What is the raw BER performance difference between 16-QAM and 8-PSK?
question_53735.ground_truth: 16-QAM is approximately 2 dB to 3~dB less sensitive to errors than 8-PSK in terms of raw BER performance.

question_53736.question: What is the name of the complex type defined in the NrmClass of the genericNrm.xsd schema?
question_53736.ground_truth: The name of the complex type is "NrmClass".

question_53737.question: What is the main motivation behind "Fine grained" requirement statement in the NGCOR Fault Management Solution Profile?
question_53737.ground_truth: The main motivation behind "Fine grained" requirement statement is to focus on using valid use cases to motivate the interface design while adding more capabilities only where really needed, as adding more capabilities may lead to complex and expensive implementations which hinder its adoption.

question_53738.question: What is the Test Tolerance applied to the minimum requirement for UE relative code domain power accuracy for HS-DPCCH and E-DCH for UL CLTD activation state 1?
question_53738.ground_truth: The Test Tolerance applied to the minimum requirement for UE relative code domain power accuracy for HS-DPCCH and E-DCH for UL CLTD activation state 1 is non-zero, as defined in clause F.2 of the document. The explanation of how the Minimum Requirement has been relaxed by the Test Tolerance is given in clause F.4.

question_53740.question: What is UERetentionInformation?
question_53740.ground_truth: UERetentionInformation is an enumerated type that can be set to one of the two possible values: ues-retained and others.

question_53742.question: What is the operation used to assure a minimum significant value of a spectral line in the power spectrum?
question_53742.ground_truth: The operation used to assure a minimum significant value of a spectral line in the power spectrum is the squaring of the absolute value of both MDST and MDCT coefficients and then summing them up.

question_53743.question: What are the three packet filter components supported in the V2X Packet Filter Set?
question_53743.ground_truth: The V2X Packet Filter Set supports packet filters based on V2X service type, Source/Destination Layer-2 ID, and Application Layer ID (e.g. Station ID).

question_53744.question: What is the minimum number of segments that the IETF RFC 5322 E-Mail Header may span in case it exceeds the data part of a single SM?
question_53744.ground_truth: The IETF RFC 5322 E-Mail Header may span over one or several subsequent segments of the concatenated SM in case it exceeds the data part of a single SM.

question_53745.question: What information should be included in a NOTIFY request generated when sending a NOTIFY request for the registration state of a user?
question_53745.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should include the state information of all registered public user identities of the user, i.e. the full state information, in every NOTIFY request.

question_53746.question: Under what conditions can the UE choose not to perform intra-frequency measurements for the current frequency?
question_53746.ground_truth: The UE may choose not to perform intra-frequency measurements if the serving cell fulfils Srxlev > SIntraSearchP and Squal > SIntraSearchQ.

question_53747.question: Which enumerated value in the "statusType" simple type indicates that the functional alias is in the process of being activated?
question_53747.ground_truth: The enumerated value "activating" in the "statusType" simple type indicates that the functional alias is in the process of being activated.

question_53748.question: What is the purpose of the State Management Data Definition IRP in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_53748.ground_truth: The State Management Data Definition IRP in the 3GPP Technical Specification is used to specify and standardize the generic attributes for modeling and managing the resources of 3G networks at the Itf-N. It expresses key aspects of the usability and general availability of network resources.

question_53749.question: What is the purpose of the "ue-PositionEstimate" field in the "CellId-MeasuredResultsInfo" sequence?
question_53749.ground_truth: The "ue-PositionEstimate" field in the "CellId-MeasuredResultsInfo" sequence is used to define the estimated position of the user equipment.

question_53751.question: What is the purpose of the Subnetwork Dependent Convergence Protocol (SNDCP) in the General Packet Radio Service (GPRS)?
question_53751.ground_truth: The Subnetwork Dependent Convergence Protocol (SNDCP) for the General Packet Radio Service (GPRS) provides multplexing of several PDPs, compression/decompression of user data, compression/decompression of protocol control information, segmentation of a network protocol data unit (N-PDU) into Logical Link Control Protocol Data Units (LL-PDUs) and re-assembly of LL-PDUs into an N-PDU.

question_53753.question: What is the role of a CSMF in the management of communication services?
question_53753.ground_truth: The CSMF is responsible for provisioning and management of communication service instances and requesting the necessary resources to realize these instances.

question_53757.question: What is the effect of reducng the uplink control channel overhead on increased data capacity?
question_53757.ground_truth: Reducing the uplink control channel overhead could allow increased rates or increased number of users in the cell. It is worth studying reduced UL control channel overhead in cases when uplink data transmission is on-going to improve cell capacity and coverage.

question_53758.question: What is the type of information contained in the "primary-SCH-Information" and "secondary-SCH-Information"?
question_53758.ground_truth: The "primary-SCH-Information" and "secondary-SCH-Information" contain information about the primary and secondary SCH, and this information is of type "P-SCH-Information-AuditRsp".

question_53759.question: What are some of the lifecycle management operations of an intent request in Intent driven management?
question_53759.ground_truth: The lifecycle management operations of an intent request include creating, activating, monitoring network service and performance before and after the implementation of the intent, supervising the fault status before and after the implementation of the intent, de-activating, deleting, querying, and rolling back the intent.

question_53760.question: What requirement must be met by a toolkit applet after a post method is called?
question_53760.ground_truth: The toolkit applet can continue its processing, such as preparing a proactive command.

question_53762.question: What is one way to address the problem of large transport network delays in Scenario 3?
question_53762.ground_truth: One way to address this problem is to allow the node hosting the PDCP entity to send additional data on top of the desired buffer size to compensate for transport link delays.

question_53765.question: What is the purpose of the NRM server sending a user plane delivery mode message when the last UE moves out of the LTE MBMS service area?
question_53765.ground_truth: The NRM server informs the VAL server to stop sending DL VAL data via the eMBMS bearer to ensure efficient resource utilization.

question_53767.question: What is the criticality of the 'id-UESecurityCapabilities' in the NGAP-PROTOCOL-IES list?
question_53767.ground_truth: The criticality of 'id-UESecurityCapabilities' in the NGAP-PROTOCOL-IES list is 'ignore'.

question_53768.question: What should the mobile station (MS) do when it receives an RR, MM, or CC message with a "missing conditional IE", "unexpected conditional IE", or syntactically incorrect conditional IE?
question_53768.ground_truth: The MS should ignore the message, except for returning a status message (STATUS, MM STATUS, GMM STATUS, or SM STATUS) with cause value #~100 "conditional IE error".

question_53772.question: What is the role of the RE-NWDAF in the roaming architecture for data collection and analytics exposure?
question_53772.ground_truth: The RE-NWDAF is responsible for exchanging data or analytics between PLMNs, and it checks user consent in roaming scenarios.

question_53773.question: What information flows are specified for EES registration?
question_53773.ground_truth: The information flows specified for EES registration are the EES registration request and response, EES registration update request and response, and EES registration de-registration request and response.

question_53774.question: What is the role of the 5G network in this smart agriculture system?
question_53774.ground_truth: The 5G network provides communication services for the smart agriculture system. It is used to trigger the ambient IoT controllers periodically, transmit operation information to the controllers, and receive status information from the controllers. The 5G network allows for real-time communication between the FMP and the ambient IoT controllers.

question_53775.question: What is required for an ID based on the IMEI or MEID when the UE does not support GRUU and does not support multiple registrations?
question_53775.ground_truth: No additional requirements are imposed on the network.

question_53776.question: How does the 10th percentile throughput change for non TX-diversity users when the penetration level is 25% and the inter-site distance is 2.8 km?
question_53776.ground_truth: Depending on the load, the 10th percentile throughput of non TX-diversity users is either increased or decreased, however some loss was seen at VA30 channel.

question_53779.question: What is the outcome when the UE is registered with S-NSSAI1 and S-NSSAI2 while camped on TAI2, and the AMF provides Allowed S-NSSAI = (S-NSSAI1, S-NSSAI2) and RA = TAI2?
question_53779.ground_truth: The UE is now able to use both S-NSSAI1 and S-NSSAI2 while camped on TAI2.

question_53782.question: What information do the session description and the MBMS download delivery protocol provide to an MBMS client to determine missing data from an MBMS download?
question_53782.ground_truth: The session description and the MBMS download delivery protocol provide the client with sufficient information to determine the source block and encoding symbol structure of each file, as well as which source symbols should have been transmitted but have not been received. The client is also able to determine the number of symbols it has received for each source block of each file, and thus the number of further symbols required to decode the block.

question_53783.question: What is the PCF's role in defining QoS and charging for service data flow detection?
question_53783.ground_truth: The PCF provides Rules for application and service data flow detection, gating, QoS and flow based charging to the SMF.

question_53784.question: What information can the DN-AAA server send to the SMF upon authorization of PDU Session Establishment?
question_53784.ground_truth: The DN-AAA server may send a reference to authorization data for policy and charging control, a list of allowed MAC addresses, a list of allowed VLAN Ids, Session-AMBR for the PDU Session, L2TP information, and Framed Route information for the PDU Session.

question_53787.question: What should the gNB-CU-UP do if the Integrity Protection Indication IE is set to "not needed" for each PDU session for which the Security Indication IE is included in the PDU Session Resource To Setup List IE or the Security Indication Modify IE is included in the PDU Session Resource To Modify List IE of the BEARER CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message?
question_53787.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP shall not perform user plane integrity protection for the concerned PDU session.

question_53789.question: In what scenario does the network establish a new PDU session before a UE can join a multicast MBS session?
question_53789.ground_truth: If the UE has no appropriate PDU session established with the DNN and S-NSSAI for the multicast MBS session, the network proceeds with establishment of the associated PDU session.

question_53790.question: What should the MS do after sending the GA-PSR-ACTIVATE-UTC-ACK message to the GANC?
question_53790.ground_truth: After sending the GA-PSR-ACTIVATE-UTC-ACK message, the MS sets the uplink packet sequence number to 0 and sets the expected downlink packet sequence number to 0.

question_53791.question: What should the MS do when it receives the GA-RC REGISTER REJECT message with a Register Reject Cause IE value of 'Network Congestion'?
question_53791.ground_truth: It may initiate release of its half of the bidirectional TCP connection.

question_53794.question: What is the purpose of the ATSSS Low-Layer functionality in the UE?
question_53794.ground_truth: The ATSSS Low-Layer functionality in the UE can steer, switch, and split all types of traffic, including TCP traffic, UDP traffic, Ethernet traffic, etc.

question_53795.question: What actions does the UE perform upon reception of the RRCSetup in 5.3.3.4?
question_53795.ground_truth: The UE shall indicate to NCR-Fwd to cease forwarding if the RRCSetup is received in response to an RRCReestablishmentRequest, or if it is received in response to an RRCResumeRequest or RRCResumeRequest1. The UE shall also instruct the MAC entity to stop the cg-SDT-TimeAlignmentTimer if it is running.

question_53797.question: What is the requirement for the operator to minimize the number of interrogations and information sent between the SMF and CHF for their IoT data connectivity offer?
question_53797.ground_truth: Simplify charging for IoT devices and protect 5GS from charging system overload due to many CDRs

question_53798.question: In which section of the document does the requirement for PRACH false alarm probability apply?

question_53800.question: When dynamic satellite backhaul is used, what can be measured by the PCF using QoS monitoring?

question_53802.question: How does a monitoring UE perform ProSe Application Code matching?
question_53802.ground_truth: A monitoring UE considers it a full match if both the PLMN ID and temporary identity match with the corresponding contents of the Discovery Filter. A partial match is obtained if the PLMN ID matches fully and the temporary identity matches partially with the corresponding contents of the ProSe Application Mask.

question_53803.question: How shall each test applet retrieve test results when selecting it?
question_53803.ground_truth: Each test applet shall extend the TestToolkitApplet abstract class in the uicc.usim.util package in order to retrieve test results when selecting it.

question_53804.question: What message should the UE send as a response to the REFER request in a consultative call transfer?
question_53804.ground_truth: The UE should respond with a 2xx response to the REFER request.

question_53805.question: What action does the SMF take when it detects that the provisioning of PCC Rules failed for an IMS Emergency service?
question_53805.ground_truth: The SMF initiates the PCC rule error handling procedure.

question_53806.question: What does the display mode "immediate" and "normal" mean for CBS messages?
question_53806.ground_truth: The display mode "immediate" means that the CBS message is supposed to be on the display all the time, while "normal" means that the CBS message will be displayed only when the user wants to see it.

question_53807.question: What should the MeNB do if it receives a SGNB MODIFICATION REQUEST message containing the Full E-RAB Level QoS Parameters IE or the Requested SCG E-RAB Level QoS Parameters IE with a GBR bearer that does not contain the GBR QoS Information IE?
question_53807.ground_truth: The MeNB should not admit the corresponding E-RAB.

question_53808.question: Which interface is used for the purpose of Interworking between 3GPP and BBF networks to transfer QoS information from the PDN GW to the TWAG?
question_53808.ground_truth: The S2a interface is used for this purpose.

question_53809.question: What are the representative sub-use cases for positioning accuracy enhancements?
question_53809.ground_truth: The representative sub-use cases for positioning accuracy enhancements are direct AI/ML positioning, with the AI/ML model output being the UE location, and AI/ML assisted positioning, with the AI/ML model output being a new measurement or enhancement of an existing measurement.

question_53810.question: What is the basic objective of the fixed network Group 3 Facsimile service?
question_53810.ground_truth: The basic objective of the fixed network Group 3 Facsimile service is to provide an international telematic service for ISO A4 document transmission between two facsimile stations.

question_53811.question: What parameter does the UE select while initializing the Random Access procedure?
question_53811.ground_truth: The UE selects a set of Random Access resources.

question_53812.question: What is the role of Client NWDAF 1 and Client NWDAF 2 during the Federated Learning training procedure?
question_53812.ground_truth: Client NWDAF 1 and Client NWDAF 2 further train the retrieved Abnormal Classifier from the Server NWDAF, respectively, based on the local raw data.

question_53814.question: What should a mobile station (MS) do upon receipt of a MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REJECT message?
question_53814.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REJECT message, the MS shall stop timer T3381 and enter the state PDP-ACTIVE.

question_53815.question: How is the position selected for adding or deleting a pulse to minimize the distortion?
question_53815.ground_truth: The position that minimizes the distortion d is selected for adding or deleting a pulse.

question_53816.question: What is the procedure for initiating an MCPTT private call in manual commencement mode between users in multiple MCPTT systems?
question_53816.ground_truth: The procedure is similar to automatic commencement mode, but the called MCPTT user has to manually accept the call. The MCPTT server sends an MCPTT private call request towards the MCPTT clients specified in the original MCPTT private call request, and the called MCPTT user is alerted to the incoming private call.

question_53818.question: What should the Node B include in the RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message when the GBMA capability has changed for the Local Cell in 1.28Mcps TDD?
question_53818.ground_truth: When the GBMA capability has changed for the Local Cell in 1.28Mcps TDD, the Node B should include the GBMA Capability IE in the RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message and indicate the new capability.

question_53819.question: What was the outcome of the first command sent (OPEN CHANNEL 2.1)?
question_53819.ground_truth: The first command was performed successfully and the channel was established with GPRS as the bearer type.

question_53821.question: What is the purpose of the FREQUENCY REDEFINITION message in the third test scenario?
question_53821.ground_truth: The FREQUENCY REDEFINITION message is used to verify that the mobile station starts using the new frequencies and hopping sequence at the correct time in the third test scenario.

question_53822.question: What should a GTP entity do when it receives an unexpected triggered message?
question_53822.ground_truth: If a GTP entity receives an unexpected triggered message, it should discard the message and log an error. However, if the message is an unexpected triggered request message (e.g. a Delete Bearer Request), the GTP entity may choose to accept the message.

question_53823.question: What is the requirement for a UE supporting early IPv4 implementations when using DHCP for P-CSCF discovery in IPv4?
question_53823.ground_truth: A UE supporting early IPv4 implementations needs to support DHCPv4 when using DHCP for P-CSCF discovery in IPv4.

question_53824.question: What happens to the MCPTT private call between MCPTT client 1 and MCPTT client 2 if the MCPTT private call transfer is cancelled due to failed authorization or rejection of the call?
question_53824.ground_truth: The MCPTT private call between MCPTT client 1 and MCPTT client 2 remains up.

question_53825.question: In potential solution #1 for energy efficiency in shared gNB, who estimates the per Operator energy consumption?
question_53825.ground_truth: The per Operator energy consumption is estimated by calculating the proportion of each operator's data volume over the total data volume, and then applying this proportion in the estimation of the per operator energy consumption.

question_53826.question: What is a CSG area and how is it identified?
question_53826.ground_truth: A CSG area is a collection of one or more cells that have a common CSG identity (CSG id). It can be identified by a CSG id along with the associated Tracking Area Identities (TAIs).

question_53828.question: Which 3GPP specification document provides the definition for the feature-capability indicator named g.3gpp.in-call-access-update?
question_53828.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 24.229, "IP multimedia call control protocol based on Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) and Session Description Protocol (SDP); Stage 3".

question_53829.question: What is the purpose of the MCPTT private call call-back request fulfillment procedure within one MCPTT system?
question_53829.ground_truth: The purpose is to establish an MCPTT private call between the two users after an MCPTT private call call-back request has been successfully made.

question_53830.question: Which feedback messages should an MTSI client support when offering AVPF for all media streams containing video?
question_53830.ground_truth: An MTSI client is required to support AVPF feedback messages trr-int, NACK, and PLI and the CCM feedback messages FIR, TMMBR, and TMMBN. These feedback messages can only be used together with AVPF and shall be negotiated in SDP offer/answer before they can be used in the session.

question_53831.question: What is the main issue with providing integrity protection for S1 signalling packets over the Un user plane?
question_53831.ground_truth: The main issue is that the Un user plane does not provide integrity protection, but integration protection for S1 signalling is mandatory.

question_53832.question: Which solution allows for an operator to upgrade his pre-Rel-8 HLR to a Rel-8 HSS gradually?
question_53832.ground_truth: Solution 6 allows an operator to start from solution 5 (UMTS level security and unmodified pre-Rel-8 HLR) and upgrade his pre-Rel-8 HLR to a Rel-8 HSS at a later time.

question_53833.question: What is the effect of an Inactivity Detection Time value of zero for a Monitoring key?
question_53833.ground_truth: The time measurement is performed continuously from the point at which it was started until time based usage monitoring is disabled.

question_53834.question: How can the standardisation of AIPN capabilities affect non-standardised applications?
question_53834.ground_truth: The standardisation of AIPN capabilities allows non-standardised applications to be created, as long as care is taken to maintain interoperability.

question_53835.question: What is the purpose of increasing the number of slots in an extended dynamic mode TBF during testing?
question_53835.ground_truth: The purpose is to verify that the mobile station (MS) adheres to the new allocation properly after the number of slots is increased in an extended dynamic mode TBF.

question_53836.question: What should the IWF do in case the called party's modem responds with a modem answering tone but does not provide a V.8 response at all?
question_53836.ground_truth: The IWF should clear the call in such cases.

question_53837.question: How can the IWF determine the handled MCPTT ID in the SIP request?
question_53837.ground_truth: The handled MCPTT ID is identified in the `<mcptt-calling-user-id>` element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body of the SIP request.

question_53840.question: Who is responsible for setting the Downlink signal level to the appropriate REFSENS value, as per the given scenario?
question_53840.ground_truth: The Signaling System (SS) is responsible for setting the Downlink signal level to the appropriate REFSENS value.

question_53841.question: What is the relationship between the identity management service and authorization in the SEAL?
question_53841.ground_truth: The relationship between the identity management service and authorization in the SEAL is "Fully Functional Specification" (FFS).

question_53844.question: What initial conditions are required in the test procedure described in 7.8.1B.4.1?
question_53844.ground_truth: The initial conditions for the test include a normal test environment and mid-range frequencies to be tested. The UE should be connected to an SS, a multipath fading simulator, and an AWGN source.

question_53845.question: What is the TP-MTI value in the SMS-PP (SEND SHORT MESSAGE) Message 2.1 and 3.1?
question_53845.ground_truth: TP-MTI value in the SMS-PP (SEND SHORT MESSAGE) Message 2.1 and 3.1 is SMS-SUBMIT.

question_53846.question: What is the purpose of the MCPTT User associating to an MCPTT UE in off-network mode?
question_53846.ground_truth: The purpose is to allow the MCPTT UE to operate in off-network mode by entering identifying/authenticating credentials and accessing local information and applications, potentially with a temporary MCPTT User Identity.

question_53847.question: What must the GW (PCEF) do after receiving IP-CAN session signalling for IP-CAN Session modification in step 2 of the IP-CAN Session Modification?
question_53847.ground_truth: The GW (PCEF) may make a decision to trigger IP-CAN Session modification based on the signalling received.

question_53848.question: What is the value of P in FR2 when the CSI-RS is partially overlapped with GAP and is partially overlapped with SMTC occasion but the SMTC occasion is not overlapped with GAP?
question_53848.ground_truth: When the CSI-RS is partially overlapped with GAP and SMTC occasion but not overlapped with GAP, P = 0.5 if TSMTCperiod is not equal to xRP or TCSI-RS is less than 0.5*TSMTCperiod when TSMTCperiod is equal to xRP. For all other cases, P = 1.

question_53852.question: What is the test setup for E-UTRA PCell in the context of EN-DC within FR1?
question_53852.ground_truth: The test setup for E-UTRA PCell is specified in Clause 9.1.2.

question_53854.question: What is the purpose of the "serviceID" element in the "mbmsSecurityDeregister" complex type in the provided XML schema?
question_53854.ground_truth: The "serviceID" element is used to specify the identification of the service for which the MBMS security deregistration is being performed.

question_53855.question: What is the role of the MBMS management server in the establishment of MBMS bearers for media data and signalling transmission in group communication?
question_53855.ground_truth: The MBMS management server determines and sends notifications for dynamically established MBMS bearers for media data and/or media control signalling transmission for the group communication.

question_53856.question: What should the non-controlling MCVideo function do if it is unable to process a SIP MESSAGE request due to lack of resources or risk of congestion?
question_53856.ground_truth: The non-controlling MCVideo function can reject the SIP MESSAGE request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response, including a Retry-After header field to the SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response, and skip the rest of the steps.

question_53857.question: What is the role of the TNGF during UE's mobility from TNAP1 to TNAP2?
question_53857.ground_truth: The TNGF identifies the UE, retrieves the context, checks the stored context, derives the TNAP' keys, and responds back to TNAP2 with the generated key.

question_53858.question: What is the S-CSCF responsible for upon receipt of a 200 (OK) response for a REGISTER request?
question_53858.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall create and send a 200 (OK) response for the REGISTER request as specified in the subclause mentioned.

question_53859.question: What does the 5.4.4.3 procedure involve in the 5G System?
question_53859.ground_truth: The 5.4.4.3 procedure involves providing information on recommended cells and RAN nodes for paging to help determine the RAN nodes to be paged and provide information on recommended cells to each of these RAN nodes.

question_53861.question: What certificates are used by the UE for one-way authentication of the O-SNPN during the registration procedure?
question_53861.ground_truth: The UE uses the set of roots of trust certificate information provided during manufacturing for one-way authentication of the O-SNPN.

question_53863.question: What should be the value of T3412 if the ATTACH ACCEPT message contains the T3412 extended value IE and the UE shall use the value in T3412 extended value IE as periodic tracking area update timer (T3412)?
question_53863.ground_truth: The UE shall use the value in T3412 extended value IE as periodic tracking area update timer (T3412).

question_53865.question: What should the UE (MCDATA Client) do when it receives an MSRP SEND message with a disposition of "READ"?
question_53865.ground_truth: The UE (MCDATA Client) should respond with a MSRP 200 (OK) message, render the contents of the Payload IE to the MCDATA User, and then send a MSRP SEND message with a disposition notification of "READ".

question_53866.question: When is a PDN GW required to execute appropriate 3GPP resource release procedures based on routing rules provided by the UE during an addition of an access in UE-initiated NBIFOM mode?
question_53866.ground_truth: This happens when the UE provided Routing Rules to the network when adding trusted WLAN access to the PDN Connection during the initial PDN connection establishment.

question_53870.question: What is the purpose of the 5GMM capability information element, and what is its minimum and maximum length?
question_53870.ground_truth: The 5GMM capability information element provides the network with information concerning aspects of the UE related to the 5GCN or interworking with the EPS. It is a type 4 information element with a minimum length of 3 octets and a maximum length of 15 octets.

question_53871.question: What is the action for the SS to apply to 5G NR Release 16 and forward UEs related to the backoff on the PCell power?
question_53871.ground_truth: The SS applies a backoff on the PCell power by activating the UE Power Limit Function (UPLF) and performs the ACTIVATE POWER LIMIT REQUEST procedure as specified in TS 38.508-1 clause 4.9.32 with TOTAL NR AGGREGATED BANDWIDTH and PCELL NR bandwidth as per Test CC Combination setting.

question_53872.question: As per 14.2.7.2, what are the conformance requirements for TCH/EFS under STATIC and TUhigh propagation conditions?
question_53872.ground_truth: The conformance requirements for TCH/EFS under STATIC and TUhigh propagation conditions include verifying that the MS does not exceed conformance requirements 1, 2, 3, and 4 with an allowance for the statistical significance of the test.

question_53873.question: What is the expiry time for timers T3322 and T3323 in 3GPP TS 42.018?
question_53873.ground_truth: The expiry time for timers T3322 and T3323 is 120 seconds.

question_53874.question: What is the expected sequence 2.1A in the procedure for the ME in the test method described in 27.22.4.11.2.4.2?
question_53874.ground_truth: The expected sequence 2.1A is "SEND SS, call forward unconditional, all bearers, successful, basic icon self-explanatory, successful."

question_53875.question: What is the scientific study of ants called?

question_53876.question: What is high latency communication and what is its purpose?
question_53876.ground_truth: High latency communication is a feature used to handle mobile terminated communication with UEs being unreachable while using power saving functions. The purpose of this feature is to handle initial response time before normal exchange of packets is established, and includes extended buffering of MT data at the Gn/Gp-SGSN or at the Serving GW, and establishing the user plane for delivering the buffered data when the UE contacts the SGSN by signalling.

question_53877.question: What is the purpose of the Timer-based BWP switch?
question_53877.ground_truth: The purpose of the Timer-based BWP switch is to switch the bandwidth part from BWP-2 back to the default bandwidth part - BWP-1 on PSCell and SCell after the expiration of the bwp-InactivityTimer timer.

question_53880.question: What is one strategy for optimizing the overall speech quality during intra-cell handover when repacking for higher radio efficiency under high load conditions?
question_53880.ground_truth: One strategy is to handover calls with good to best radio conditions from the old codec type to the new codec type, while keeping calls with low radio conditions in the old codec type.

question_53881.question: What are the two main components of Uplink Time Synchronization for TSN system clocks?
question_53881.ground_truth: The two main components of Uplink Time Synchronization for TSN system clocks are distribution time mechanisms for 5GS internal clock and TSN system clocks.

question_53882.question: What are some limitations of VCO and PLL performance and limitations for mm-wave frequencies for different technologies?
question_53882.ground_truth: Some limitations include phase noise increasing by 6 dB every time the carrier frequency doubles, phase noise being inversely proportional to the square of the loaded quality factor of the resonator, and 1/f noise up-conversion giving rise to close-to-carrier phase noise increase.

question_53885.question: What type of value should be defined in the "Timers" element for the timer value of floor queue position request?

question_53888.question: Which clause in the 3GPP specification corresponds to the "AllowedLocallyInitiatedAmbientViewing" element?
question_53888.ground_truth: The "allow-request-locally-initiated-ambient-viewing" element corresponds to the "AllowedLocallyInitiatedAmbientViewing" element in clause 13.2.87A2 of the 3GPP specification.

question_53890.question: What are the permitted values for the <CUG_pointer> parameter in the 7.34 Enhanced closed user group?
question_53890.ground_truth: The permitted values for the <CUG_pointer> parameter in the 7.34 Enhanced closed user group is from 1 to n, where n is implementation specific.

question_53891.question: What are the main interactions that should be supported by corresponding services in solution #7.1 for the service interface for SMF and Charging Domain?
question_53891.ground_truth: The main interactions that should be supported by corresponding services in solution #7.1 for the service interface for SMF and Charging Domain are the interaction between SMF and charging domain, and the termination action of charging server.

question_53892.question: What does the MC service client do when it receives MC service data via unicast delivery and broadcast MBS session?
question_53892.ground_truth: When an MC service client receives MC service data via unicast delivery and broadcast MBS session, the network mechanism stops unicast delivery to these users after some time.

question_53894.question: In the ACDC system, what does the ACDC function do when it is activated?
question_53894.ground_truth: When the ACDC function is activated, the UE allows/restricts UE-initiated applications based on the ACDC allowed application lists.

question_53898.question: What is the action taken by the BBERF in step 7d after the H-PCRF denies an authorization and informs the V-PCRF, if applicable?
question_53898.ground_truth: The H-PCRF may provide new or modified QoS rules to the V-PCRF, which the V-PCRF acknowledges and provisions to the target BBERF in step 7e.

question_53899.question: What is the role of K~NRP~ in PC5 link security establishment between the source UE and the UE-to-UE Relay over User Plane?
question_53899.ground_truth: K~NRP~ is a parameter used in PC5 link security establishment between the source UE and the UE-to-UE Relay over User Plane. It is derived differently for 5G ProSe UE-to-Network service and 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay service by 5G PKMF. The UE-to-UE Relay derives the session key K~NRP-SESS~ and confidentiality key NRPEK based on PC5 policies.

question_53900.question: What is the purpose of the pre-registration procedure in the optimized E-UTRAN to HRPD handover procedure?
question_53900.ground_truth: The purpose of the pre-registration procedure in the optimized E-UTRAN to HRPD handover procedure is to establish and maintain a dormant session in the target HRPD access, while the UE remains connected to the E-UTRAN/MME.

question_53901.question: In what circumstances is reduced U-plane latency expected in Advanced E-UTRA and Advanced E-UTRAN?
question_53901.ground_truth: U-plane latency reduction is expected in situations where the UE does not have a valid scheduling assignment and when the UE needs to synchronize and obtain a scheduling assignment.

question_53903.question: Which procedure is used to remove a profile or selected GUP components from the repository?
question_53903.ground_truth: The Delete procedure is used by the application to remove a profile or selected GUP components from the repository, requiring the attached resource identity and component type.

question_53904.question: What is the function of the HRPD RAT in the HRPD RAT location condition for the ISMP rule?
question_53904.ground_truth: The HRPD RAT in the HRPD RAT location condition for the ISMP rule represents the AAA, Roaming, and Traffic management related to the High Rate Packet Data (HRPD) functionality in the Evolved Multimedia Broadcast Multicast Services (E-MBMS).

question_53905.question: How often does the SS change the Codec Mode Indication and Codec Mode Command in the co-channel rejection test?
question_53905.ground_truth: The SS changes the Codec Mode Indication and Codec Mode Command at the neighbor mode every 22 speech frames, or 440 ms, following a specific scanning pattern.

question_53907.question: How does the MCVideo service help MCVideo Administrators to authorize an MCVideo User to remotely activate another MCVideo User's camera?
question_53907.ground_truth: The MCVideo service provides a mechanism that allows MCVideo Administrators to grant specific permissions to an MCVideo User, which includes the ability to remotely activate another MCVideo User's camera.

question_53909.question: What is the minimum requirement for narrowband blocking in the context of MSR based on a E-UTRA 1RB interfering signal with mean power of -49dBm?
question_53909.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for narrowband blocking in the context of MSR based on a E-UTRA 1RB interfering signal with mean power of -49dBm is that the interfering signal offsets may be dependent on the victim E-UTRA channel bandwidth. The 240~kHz offset correspond to the first RB (closest to the RF bandwidth edge) of an E-UTRA interfering signal.

question_53910.question: What is the time duration that the UE is not required to transmit or receive signals during a UE specific CBW change in EN-DC UE?
question_53910.ground_truth: The time duration is defined by the length of the RRC procedure delay and the time used by the UE to perform CBW change.

question_53911.question: What are the two main privacy aspects considered within the scope of the Generalized Privacy capability?
question_53911.ground_truth: The two main privacy aspects considered are protection of personal data and non-disclosure of identity.

question_53912.question: When can the new BSS take the old BSS's pre-emption recommendation into account?
question_53912.ground_truth: The new BSS may take into account the old BSS's recommendation to allow pre-emption or not allow pre-emption when performing the Handover resource allocation procedure.

question_53913.question: What should the mobile station do when the RR connection is released during a local IMSI detach process?
question_53913.ground_truth: The mobile station should delay the local release of the channel to allow a normal release from the network side until the T3220 timeout. If this is not possible, the RR sublayer on the mobile station side should be aborted.

question_53916.question: What transport protocol is used as the default for establishing data channels in the ICE procedure?

question_53920.question: What message does the PDN GW send to the MAG in the trusted non-3GPP access in response to a Proxy Binding Update message with a zero lifetime value?
question_53920.ground_truth: The PDN GW sends a Proxy Binding Ack message with a zero lifetime value and an IPv4 only indicator to the MAG in the trusted non-3GPP access.

question_53921.question: What were the two coding solutions tested in the ITU-R BS.1534-3 binaural listening test, along with a third solution for diversifying the MUSHRA test?
question_53921.ground_truth: The two coding solutions tested were the HE-AACv2 codec used to encode stereo pairs and the MPEG-H Low Complexity profile. The third solution was not relevant for 3GPP analysis purposes.

question_53925.question: What is the effect of the LRF noting the domain change in the domain transfer procedure from CS to IMS?
question_53925.ground_truth: The LRF will interact with the appropriate GMLC if necessary when it notes the domain change. It may not have to interact with a GMLC until the PSAP requests a location update.

question_53926.question: What happens if a control relationship exists and the CSE instructs the IPLMN/VPLMN to initiate a new call leg for a mobile originated call or mobile terminating call in the VPLMN?
question_53926.ground_truth: The new call leg will be subject to the Outgoing Call Barring Supplementary Services and the Outgoing Operator Determined Barring categories, but the CSE can suppress the invocation of conditional barring of outgoing calls.

question_53927.question: How many pairs of security associations does the UE need to set up to send registrations?
question_53927.ground_truth: The UE needs to set up two pairs of security associations to send registrations and any other subsequent requests.

question_53929.question: When should the network include the fields broadcasted in E-UTRA SystemInformationBlockType1 associated to 5GC in the cgi-Info-5GC within a Measurement Report?
question_53929.ground_truth: The network should include the fields broadcasted in E-UTRA SystemInformationBlockType1 associated to 5GC in the cgi-Info-5GC within a Measurement Report if the UE is E-UTRA/5GC capable and all mandatory fields of the cgi-Info-5GC for the concerned cell have been obtained.

question_53931.question: What are the advantages of Alternative 4 for including Load Control Information?
question_53931.ground_truth: The advantages are reduced processing and storage requirement on the sender node, simplicity in implementation at the sender node, and less overhead in the message with less message processing requirement at the receiver.

question_53932.question: What is the role of the 5G PKMF-1 in checking if the Remote UE and the UE-to-network relay are allowed to communicate with each other?
question_53932.ground_truth: The 5G PKMF-1 can perform this check if it has an SBI to the UDM (of Remote UE). If not, the 5GDDNMF-1 performs the check instead.

question_53933.question: What mechanism can be used to minimize the search window for cell detection in the case of synchronized transmission of SS/RS from small cells within the same cluster?
question_53933.ground_truth: The mechanism involves using network assistance, specifically rough timing information of the synchronized transmission of SS/RS, to reduce the UE's effort on small cell discovery.

question_53934.question: What does the third digit (z) in the version numbering scheme indicate?
question_53934.ground_truth: The third digit (z) is incremented when editorial only changes have been incorporated in the document and does not reflect technical enhancements, corrections, updates, or concepts such as wideband, super-wideband, and fullband.

question_53937.question: What is the expected sequence of frames in the scenario where the MS must repeat the checkpoint procedure due to a failure to receive an acknowledgement within the T1 time-out following the sending of an I+S frame?
question_53937.ground_truth: The expected sequence of frames for this scenario includes the MS sending a S frame with C/R=1 and P/F=1 after T1 has expired, retransmitting the I+S frame, and then receiving an RR frame with F bit set to 1 acknowledging the I+S frame.

question_53938.question: In 6.5.2, what is enhanced with evaluations of conditional handover conditions to enable handover of UEs faster during the switching of NES modes?

question_53939.question: What is the expected final state of the MS in the test described in 26.8.1.2.6.4?

question_53940.question: What is the difference between the conducted requirements and the radiated requirements in an AAS BS?
question_53940.ground_truth: Conducted requirements are defined at the transceiver array boundary (TAB) and the radio distribution network (RDN) in a hybrid AAS BS, while radiated requirements are defined at the radiated interface boundary (RIB) for an OTA AAS BS.

question_53941.question: What charging information is reported by the SMF in a PDU session charging SSC mode 3 IPv6 Multi Homed scenario?
question_53941.ground_truth: The charging information for usage reporting of UPF1, quota request for UPF2, and request quota for UPF2 is reported by the SMF in a PDU session charging SSC mode 3 IPv6 Multi Homed scenario, if quota management per UPF is enabled.

question_53943.question: What is the function of the GBA in the context of the 5G system?
question_53943.ground_truth: The GBA (Generic Bootstrapping Architecture) is a system in the 5G network that provides a secure method for establishing a shared secret between the network and a UE, which can be used for authentication purposes.

question_53946.question: What is the default access control class of the USIM type B?

question_53947.question: What specification document is reused in the definition of the Mandatory Flags field?

question_53951.question: In which mode can the Local Emergency Numbers List be updated in the UE, if it is in S1 mode, A/Gb or Iu mode, or N1 mode?
question_53951.ground_truth: The Local Emergency Numbers List can be updated with EMM procedures if the UE is in S1 mode, with GMM and MM procedures if the UE is in A/Gb or Iu mode, and with 5GMM procedures if the UE is in N1 mode.

question_53953.question: What is the importance of the noise factor in the predicted spectrum generation for the high-frequency region?
question_53953.ground_truth: The noise factor is used to control the amount of noise inserted in the predicted spectrum at the decoder. It is calculated using the energies of the selected coefficients in the high-frequency region and scalar quantized using a 2-bit scalar quantizer.

question_53955.question: What is the function of the RAN Information Management (RIM) protocol in the 3GPP TS 44.064 standard?
question_53955.ground_truth: The RIM protocol allows the exchange of the information between two BSSs or between a BSS and an RNS or between a BSS and an eNodeB or between an eNodeB and an eHRPD eAN transparently through the core network in the 3GPP TS 44.064 standard.

question_53956.question: What message does an eNodeB/RNC send to indicate a user's MBMS UE Context status during a Routing Area Update procedure?
question_53956.ground_truth: The eNodeBs/RNCs send IP multicast Join or Leave message to the received user plane IP multicast address allocated by the MBMS GW.

question_53957.question: What should the AMF do if the UE mobility is from EPS to 5GS and the UE is in idle state?
question_53957.ground_truth: The UE should include a TAU request message integrity protected using the EPS security context in the Registration Request and provide the GUAMI part of the native 5G-GUTI in RRC to enable the NG-RAN to route the Registration Request to the same AMF.

question_53958.question: What is the definition of transmit OFF power in sub-clause 6.5.1.1?
question_53958.ground_truth: The transmit OFF power is defined as the RRC filtered mean power in a duration of at least one timeslot excluding any transient periods, and the requirement for the transmit OFF power shall be less than -56 dBm.

question_53959.question: What is required for a UE behind an RG to authenticate to the 5GC using NSWO procedure?
question_53959.ground_truth: The UE behind an RG can authenticate to the 5GC using NSWO procedure by first obtaining a local IP address after authenticating to the 5GC.

question_53960.question: What message does the MS send to initiate the self-location request for assistance data?
question_53960.ground_truth: The MS sends a REGISTER message containing Facility IE LCS MO-LR with MOLR-TYPE set to assistance data.

question_53962.question: What type of messages is reported as Intercept Related Information for the interception of multi-media service?
question_53962.ground_truth: SIP messaging is reported as Intercept Related Information for the interception of multi-media service.

question_53963.question: What can be used to mitigate uplink control signalling (PUCCH) interference from HUE to macro-eNB and from MUE to HeNB?
question_53963.ground_truth: Enabling orthogonal transmissions and making use of PUCCH offsets for orthogonal PUCCH assignments between HeNBs and macro-eNBs users.

question_53965.question: What is the purpose of updating the Allowed NSSAI for each Access Type in FIC Authentication and Authorization?
question_53965.ground_truth: The Allowed NSSAI for each Access Type is updated to allow for Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization, and to determine which Access Type to use if both are subject to authentication and authorization.

question_53971.question: What does Solution #6 propose for storing UE Capability IDs and their associated UE Radio Capabilities?
question_53971.ground_truth: Solution #6 proposes storing the UE Capability IDs and their associated UE Radio Capabilities in a dictionary stored in the AMF or a stand-alone Network Function in the 5GC that can be queried by the AMF and locally stored (replicated) in the (R)AN.

question_53972.question: What action does the MME take if it receives a Detach Request from the UE via a CSG cell with the cause indicating the UE is not allowed to access this CSG?
question_53972.ground_truth: If the UE receives Detach Request from the MME via a CSG cell with the cause indicating the UE is not allowed to access this CSG, the UE shall remove this CSG ID and associated PLMN from its Allowed CSG list, if present.

question_53975.question: What should an MME do if both the UE and network support discontinuous coverage?
question_53975.ground_truth: The MME should provide the Enhanced Discontinuous Coverage Support indication if both the UE and network support discontinuous coverage.

question_53977.question: What is the purpose of the CDMA2000 1xRTT Parameters in the CSFBParametersRequestCDMA2000 message and why does the UE need them?
question_53977.ground_truth: The CDMA2000 1xRTT Parameters in the CSFBParametersRequestCDMA2000 message are needed for the UE to generate the CDMA2000 1xRTT Registration message used to register with the CDMA2000 1xRTT Network which is required to support CSFB to CDMA2000 1xRTT.

question_53979.question: When should the AMF include the UE Radio Capability for Paging Information in the N2 Paging message?
question_53979.ground_truth: The AMF should include the UE Radio Capability for Paging Information in the N2 Paging message if it is available in the AMF for the UE.

question_53981.question: When are PRACH requirement tests applicable for PRACH formats in high-speed train scenarios?
question_53981.ground_truth: The PRACH requirement tests are applicable for each PRACH format declared to be supported for high-speed train scenarios.

question_53982.question: Which interfaces are defined for communication between GUP entities in the 3GPP Generic User Profile (GUP) architecture?
question_53982.ground_truth: Two interfaces, Rp and Rg, are defined for communication between GUP entities in the 3GPP Generic User Profile (GUP) architecture.

question_53983.question: What is the role of the "ii-nni" header field parameter in the P-Charging-Vector header field, and when is it added or removed?
question_53983.ground_truth: The "ii-nni" header field parameter in the P-Charging-Vector header field specifies the II-NNI traversal scenario type. It is added to the P-Charging-Vector header field by a node in the beginning of an II-NNI traversal scenario and removed by the node in the end of the scenario.

question_53984.question: What is the difference between override mode and negotiated mode for media reception control?
question_53984.ground_truth: In override mode, the transmission control server determines the video stream to be overridden, while in negotiated mode, the transmission control participant determines the video stream to be overridden.

question_53985.question: What benefit does a 5G PVN bring to a BYOD environment in an enterprise?
question_53985.ground_truth: The 5G PVN can provide mobile broadband services to all devices used in the work place, while also providing a secure intranet for access to all enterprise systems such as printers, databases, software tools. Additionally, this support can be provided by the 5G PVN without the need for multiple operators to provide concurrent coverage, minimizing interference.

question_53986.question: What is the purpose of the TPC (Transmission Power Control) commands from the SS (Node B) to the UE in this process?
question_53986.ground_truth: The purpose of the TPC commands from the SS (Node B) to the UE in this process is to maintain the required output power levels for the half slot periods and to activate the loopback test mode for HSDPA.

question_53987.question: What is the mean DL coverage in Coverage Evaluation Method 1 for FR1, InH, DL, VR/AR30, #UE=Capacity(5~11) in the first set of observations?
question_53987.ground_truth: The mean DL coverage in Coverage Evaluation Method 1 for FR1, InH, DL, VR/AR30, #UE=Capacity(5~11) in the first set of observations is -76.62dB.

question_53988.question: How is authorisation conveyed within the MC System?
question_53988.ground_truth: Authorisation is conveyed within the MC System by using an EAR (EAP Authentication Request) to authenticate the requester, and through various authentication and authorisation mechanisms for different scenarios.

question_53989.question: Why is candidate training device selection more complex in federated learning over wireless links as compared to federated learning in data centers?
question_53989.ground_truth: It is more complex due to the presence of other high priority and non-latency-tolerant data transmitted by the training devices, which affects their ability to upload locally trained models.

question_53990.question: What is the command type in the RECEIVE DATA proactive command with a command number of 1?

question_53992.question: What action does the 3GP-DASH client take when it requests Network Assistance during media segment download?
question_53992.ground_truth: The 3GP-DASH client sends a single SAND signaling exchange to the DANE, which activates either the rate recommendation function or a sequence of both functions, based on whether a delivery boost is needed or not.

question_53993.question: What should a UE in EMM-IDLE mode do if at least one PLMN reported by lower layers is in the list of authorized PLMNs for V2X communication over PC5 and provides radio resources for V2X communication over PC5, and the UE does not have an emergency PDN connection?
question_53993.ground_truth: The UE in EMM-IDLE mode should perform PLMN selection triggered by V2X communication over PC5 as specified in 3GPP TS 23.122.

question_53994.question: What is the time period for T_Measurement_Period Intra defined in 8.3.5.1.2?
question_53994.ground_truth: T_Measurement_Period Intra is defined as 200 ms in 8.3.5.1.2.

question_53995.question: What should the UE do while waiting for the reporting criteria to be fulfilled in test 1 and 2?
question_53995.ground_truth: The UE should not send event triggered measurement reports.

question_53996.question: What are the two modes of the MBMS bearer service?
question_53996.ground_truth: The two modes of the MBMS bearer service are Broadcast Mode and Multicast Mode. Broadcast Mode is supported for EPS and GPRS, and Multicast Mode is supported for GPRS.

question_53997.question: In a non-roaming scenario, what action should the SMF take after detecting a new interception for a UE is activated and the 5GSM state within the SMF for that UE is 5GSM: PDU SESSION ACTIVE or PDU SESSION MODIFICATION PENDING?
question_53997.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the SMF generates an xIRI containing the SMFStartOfInterceptionWithEstablishedMAPDUSession record.

question_54000.question: What should a floor participant do upon receiving a Floor Granted message in the 'O: has permission' state, when the User ID field matches its own MCPTT ID and the SSRC matches the stored SSRC of the current arbitrator?
question_54000.ground_truth: The floor participant should set the stored SSRC of the current arbitrator to its own SSRC, stop timer T203 and T201, clear the stored SSRC of the candidate arbitrator, and enter 'O: has permission' state.

question_54001.question: What protocol is used to transfer NRPPa PDUs between an LMF and an NG-RAN node?
question_54001.ground_truth: The NRPPa protocol is transparent to the AMF and is carried over the NG interface in either UE associated mode or non-UE associated mode.

question_54003.question: What are some perceptual audio quality attributes that the 3GPP work item proposes for assessing immersive audio systems?
question_54003.ground_truth: The 3GPP work item proposes timbre, localization (or "immersion"), and distortion as perceptual audio quality attributes for assessing immersive audio systems.

question_54004.question: What is the size of a radio block in bits for the UAS-10 packet data block type?
question_54004.ground_truth: The size of a radio block in bits for the UAS-10 packet data block type is 42x211 + 231x2 + 2 = 1838.

question_54005.question: What is the main challenge when using a pre-provisioned list of PLMNs for disaster roaming?
question_54005.ground_truth: The main challenge is that all PLMNs in the pre-provisioned list may be damaged by the same disaster, making it impossible for the UE to select a PLMN offering disaster roaming.

question_54008.question: What is the purpose of decomposing the Web Service definition in Parlay X?
question_54008.ground_truth: Decomposition of the Web Service definition in Parlay X improves the overall definition and maintenance process, allows for separation of interface and binding, and supports better deployment.

question_54010.question: Which AMR codec modes are significantly better than the GSM FR codec in all error conditions?
question_54010.ground_truth: The two lowest AMR codec modes, 5.15 and 4.75, are significantly better than the GSM FR codec in all error conditions.

question_54011.question: What should be set if contention based random-access resources are used in the random-access procedure and msgA-SubcarrierSpacing associated to the 2 step random-access resources is available?
question_54011.ground_truth: The msgA-SubcarrierSpacing associated to the 2 step random-access resources used in the random-access procedure should be set.

question_54013.question: What information does the signal generator send during the procedure and how is it used?
question_54013.ground_truth: The signal generator sends a test pattern, which is used to check the number of incorrectly decoded CQI and for two antenna ports, it is sent on the same PUCCH resource block with different channel indices.

question_54014.question: What action does the MRFP take when it receives an RTP header extension for Arbitrary ROI and applies video transcoding?
question_54014.ground_truth: The MRFP keeps the predefined ROI information unchanged during the transcoding and copies the received RTP header extension for Arbitrary ROI to the succeeding outgoing RTP stream(s) after transcoding the associated group of packets.

question_54016.question: What is one advantage of using a Diameter Proxy Agent (PA1) in a home realm?
question_54016.ground_truth: One advantage of using a Diameter Proxy Agent (PA1) in a home realm is that the home operator can hide its internal PCRF topology by only providing information about the DRA to an external network and not the selected PCRF.

question_54019.question: Which SDO currently uses 3GPP's Interface IRP specifications for managing their own managed nodes?

question_54020.question: Which timer is used by the MME to limit the amount of time waiting for a location response from the E-SMLC?
