question_54690.ground_truth: The SMF serves as an intermediary between the PINE and the PEGC, sending routing information to the UPF to allow or disallow the relay between PINEs via the 5GC. It also sends PIN status information to the UPF for downlink data notification for a specific PINE.

question_54691.question: What must be done by the HTTP/SIP adapter upon receipt of a SIP BYE message from the SCF?
question_54691.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a SIP BYE message from the SCF, the HTTP/SIP adapter shall send a HTTP POST message to the HTTP Server.

question_54692.question: What should the MCPTT client do if the SIP re-INVITE request contains an MCPTT imminent peril group call with the "imminentperil-ind" element set to "false"?
question_54692.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should display to the MCPTT user the MCPTT ID of the MCPTT user cancelling the MCPTT imminent peril group call and an indication that this is an MCPTT imminent peril group call, and set the MCPTT imminent peril group state to "MIG 1: no-imminent-peril" and the MCPTT imminent peril group call state to "MIGC 1: imminent-peril-gc-capable".

question_54694.question: How does the SMF indicate to the UE when the AN resources onto which a QoS Flow is mapped are released?
question_54694.ground_truth: The AN (Access Network) shall indicate to the SMF when the AN resources onto which a QoS Flow is mapped are released, not the other way around.

question_54695.question: What is the role of the Non-3GPP Interworking Function (N3IWF) or Trusted Non-3GPP Gateway (TNGF) in a non-3GPP access network?
question_54695.ground_truth: The N3IWF or TNGF interfaces with the Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF) to support non-3GPP access networks by terminating the NAS interface instance, handling NAS signaling with the UE, authenticating UEs, managing mobility and security contexts, and other functions.

question_54697.question: What is the scope of the Technical Specification (Release 17) for Layer 1 on the F1 interface?
question_54697.ground_truth: The present document specifies the standards allowed to implement Layer 1 on the F1 interface, it doesn't specify the transmission delay requirements and O&M requirements.

question_54699.question: What are the three types of output power accuracy requirement, and which BS types do they apply to?
question_54699.ground_truth: The three types of output power accuracy requirement are Base station output power, Radiated transmit power, and OTA base station output power. They apply to BS type 1-C and BS type 1-H, BS type 1-H normal conditions only, and BS type 1-O and BS type 2-O normal and extreme conditions, respectively.

question_54703.question: What should be done with the `<contact>` element if a public user identity has been deregistered and this has been indicated in the NOTIFY request but no new registration has occurred?
question_54703.ground_truth: It should not be included in subsequent NOTIFY requests.

question_54704.question: What is the maximum allowed interruption duration for an SCell in asynchronous dual connectivity, when it is added or released and belongs to MCG, on the PCell?

question_54705.question: What should the UE (MCDATA Client) do when it receives a SIP 200 (OK) message with the a=setup attribute set to "passive" in response to a SIP INVITE message?
question_54705.ground_truth: The UE (MCDATA Client) should send a blank MSRP SEND message to bind the MSRP connection and then sends the one-to-one session SDS message via a MSRP SEND message with a disposition of "DELIVERY".

question_54707.question: What does the S-NSSAI (Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information) in the 3GPP technical specification indicate?
question_54707.ground_truth: The S-NSSAI contains the Slice/Service type and Slice Differentiator for which the SSIM application is used for NS (Network Slice) in 3GPP telecom networks.

question_54711.question: What is the role of the NWDAF in determining the UE ID list located in a finer granularity area?
question_54711.ground_truth: The NWDAF can request the UE location information for all the UEs located in the cell and determine the UE ID list by itself. Alternatively, the NWDAF can request LMF to provide the UE ID list located in the finer granularity area by including both the Cell ID and the finer granularity area information into the request service operation to the LMF.

question_54712.question: What is the difference between Outside-In Tracking and Inside-out Tracking in XR applications?
question_54712.ground_truth: Outside-In Tracking uses sensors placed in a stationary location to track the movement of an object in a designated area, while Inside-out Tracking has the cameras or sensors located on the device being tracked.

question_54713.question: What is the role of a "network proxy/server" in the operation on demand (MooD) of the BM-SC?
question_54713.ground_truth: The network proxy/server in MooD detects whether unicast traffic volume for the same service or content exceeds a certain threshold, indicates it to the BM-SC to enable MBMS offloading, and delivers user location information to the BM-SC for MooD decision.

question_54715.question: What is defined as an MCPTT group in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_54715.ground_truth: An MCPTT group is defined as a mechanism by which an MCPTT user can make one-to-many MCPTT transmissions to other MCPTT users that are affiliated members of an MCPTT group.

question_54716.question: Which regulatory body has designated the bands 3.4-3.8 GHz for BWA deployment and provided conditions for flexible usage modes?
question_54716.ground_truth: The European Communications Committee (ECC) has designated the bands 3.4-3.8 GHz for BWA deployment and provided conditions for flexible usage modes within authorized BWA deployments.

question_54717.question: What are the main functional elements of floor arbitrator in a loosely coupled model?
question_54717.ground_truth: The main functional elements of a floor arbitrator in a loosely coupled model include the central media policy server, central conference policy server, mixer, floor control chair, floor control server, and protocol stack for group communication.

question_54718.question: What action should the MCVideo client take upon expiry of timer TFG3 in the "S2: waiting for call announcement" state?
question_54718.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should generate a GROUP CALL PROBE message with the stored MCVideo group ID, and send it with TFG3 call probe retransmission.

question_54719.question: What is the 3GPP Technical Specification document that defines the Evolved 3GPP Packet Switched Domain, also known as the Evolved Packet System (EPS), providing IP connectivity using the Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access Network (E-UTRAN)?
question_54719.ground_truth: The present document, also known as TS 23.401.

question_54720.question: What message is displayed when the system requests information (req) and receives an information acknowledgment (ack)?

question_54721.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the non-anchor carrier test?
question_54721.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are the same as defined in 6.2.17.3.

question_54722.question: In the "PLMN operator administers SIP core with SIP identities administered by MC service provider" scenario, are the security roots held in the MC service provider's SIP database available to the PLMN operator?
question_54722.ground_truth: No, derived parameters are provided to the SIP core to allow signalling control plane authentication to take place, but the security roots required for access to the signalling control plane are not available to the PLMN operator as these are held in the MC service provider's SIP database.

question_54724.question: In the VALInfo XML document, what are the two possible root elements, each indicating the type of XML document representation?
question_54724.ground_truth: The two possible root elements for the VALInfo XML document are <seal-request-uri> or <VAL-group-id>.

question_54725.question: What type of channels requires the application of a test signal with normal GSM modulation, specified power, and a chosen time slot for both circuit and packet switched channels?
question_54725.ground_truth: Circuit switched channels, excluding ECSD with slow frequency hopping disabled and AMR-WB, 8-PSK modulated AMR and AMR-WB channels. Also, packet switched channels, excluding ECSD with slow frequency hopping disabled and AMR-WB, 8-PSK modulated AMR and AMR-WB channels with PAN included, are required to use this test signal setup.

question_54726.question: What action should a BSS take if it receives a RIM PDU with a Destination Cell Identifier IE value that does not match any of its parented cells?
question_54726.ground_truth: The BSS should discard the PDU and send a STATUS PDU with the cause value set to "Unknown Destination address" back to the SGSN.

question_54727.question: What procedures are described in clauses 7.27.2.8.1.2 and 7.27.2.8.1.3?
question_54727.ground_truth: Clause 7.27.2.8.1.2 describes the EES procedure for updating AC Association information available at CAAR, and clause 7.27.2.8.1.3 describes the ECS procedure for querying the AC Association information at CAAR.

question_54730.question: What is the role of the ICCF in the I1-cs Application Server model?
question_54730.ground_truth: The ICCF is the last AS in the I1-cs Application Server model and is involved in both CS and PS access. It collocates with DSF and is invoked via filter criteria for terminating iFC.

question_54731.question: What is the minimum number of ACK/NACK that a UE must transmit on FDD PSCell and each of activated FDD SCell(s) during an identification of a new E-UTRA cell?

question_54732.question: What triggers a UE to change its IPv6 address due to privacy concerns?
question_54732.ground_truth: The UE may change its interface identity of the IPv6 address if it receives a new IPv6 prefix, as defined in RFC 8981.

question_54733.question: What is the AS Name, and in which network entity is it stored?
question_54733.ground_truth: The AS Name identifies the application server hosting the Public Service Identity and is used for direct routing of a Public Service Identity. It is stored in the HSS (Home Subsystem).

question_54734.question: What is the purpose of the RIM procedures between RAN nodes?
question_54734.ground_truth: The RIM procedures allow the exchange of information between RAN nodes transparently for the Core Network, including a container that shall not be interpreted by Core Network nodes.

question_54735.question: What function creates a time-stamped authentication event associated with the target including relevant information such as the user's identity provided to the WAF in the 3GPP network?

question_54736.question: What protocols are used for data link layer and transport layer in the F1 interface?
question_54736.ground_truth: For the data link layer, any protocol that fulfills the requirements can be used, and for the transport layer, an IP based Transport protocol is used.

question_54738.question: What does the Call-Identifier field in the I1 message common part specify?
question_54738.ground_truth: The Call-Identifier field uniquely specifies the I1 session across all I1 interfaces, consisting of two subfields - part-1 and part-2.

question_54739.question: What does the 5G system support for parties of an IMS call in terms of video and avatar media?
question_54739.ground_truth: The 5G system supports bidirectional transitioning between video and avatar media for parties of an IMS call, given user consent.

question_54740.question: In section 8.4.1.2, what 4th order intermodulation product falls into its own 4th RX band 42 in section 8.4.1.2?

question_54741.question: What is the main focus of Solution 11 in the context of 6.11.2?
question_54741.ground_truth: The main focus of Solution 11 in the context of 6.11.2 is addressing Key Issue 5 by providing a procedure for communication service management, including lifecycle and communication assurance.

question_54742.question: When should the UE transmit HS-DPCCH and E-DPDCH, and transmit HS-DPCCH if instructed by MAC layer after passing the defined number of TTIs of DPCCH only transmission?
question_54742.ground_truth: After starting transmitting DPCCH, the UE should transmit E-DPCCH and E-DPDCH after the defined number of TTIs of DPCCH only transmission has passed and transmit HS-DPCCH if instructed by the MAC layer after passing the defined number of TTIs of DPCCH only transmission.

question_54744.question: What is the implication of the "O" supportQualifier for an attribute?
question_54744.ground_truth: The implication of the "O" supportQualifier for an attribute is that the attribute is optional, but the read and write qualifiers indicate how the optional attribute shall be supported, should it be supported.

question_54745.question: What is the use of DCI format 4 in the 5G NR standard?
question_54745.ground_truth: DCI format 4 is used for the scheduling of PUSCH in one UL cell with multi-antenna port transmission mode.

question_54746.question: What must a mobile station in 3GPP TS 04.60 do when it receives a PACKET TBF RELEASE message with a cause value of "Abnormal release" on the PACCH?
question_54746.ground_truth: The mobile station must immediately stop transmitting and follow the abnormal release with the random access procedure.

question_54747.question: What is the condition for a cell to be considered as a candidate for reselection if it is not a CAG cell and the CAG-only indication in the UE is set?
question_54747.ground_truth: The cell will not be considered as a candidate for reselection.

question_54750.question: What physical layer aspects are re-used in the evolution of GERAN?
question_54750.ground_truth: The physical layer aspects that are re-used in the evolution of GERAN include multiple access, timeslot and frame structure, channel mapping, burst building, and burst multiplexing, coding, reordering and partitioning, interleaving, differential encoding, and modulation. However, a new packet control channel format and new Point-to-Multipoint control message and an associated coding block type are designed for CIoT devices.

question_54752.question: What is the EES de-registration procedure used for?
question_54752.ground_truth: The EES uses the EES de-registration procedure to remove its information from the ECS.

question_54753.question: Who does NWDAF provide the observed service experience to in 5GC?
question_54753.ground_truth: NWDAF provides the data analytics to the consumer NF, indicating how well the used QoS Parameters satisfy the Service MoS agreed between the MNO and the end user or between the MNO and the external ASP.

question_54754.question: What should the IWF performing the controlling role include in the SIP 200 (OK) response if it decides to proceed with the establishment of the group call without all required group members?
question_54754.ground_truth: The IWF performing the controlling role should include the warning text set to "111 group call proceeded without all required group members" in a Warning header field as specified in 3GPP~TS~24.379 clause~4.4.

question_54757.question: What are the two "Handover Switching Points" that exist in eSRVCC?
question_54757.ground_truth: The two "Handover Switching Points" that exist in eSRVCC are the "Handover on Air" and the "Handover in the ATGW". The Handover on Air involves the local UE disconnecting from the LTE RAN and reconnecting to the Target RAN, while the Handover in the ATGW is the theoretical and practical synchronization of the handover in the ATGW with the handover on air.

question_54759.question: What is the UE Rx beam sweeping factor in FR1 for PRS RSTD measurement period calculation?
question_54759.ground_truth: In FR1, the UE Rx beam sweeping factor is 1.

question_54762.question: What is a FeasibilityCheckAndReservationJob in network slicing?
question_54762.ground_truth: A FeasibilityCheckAndReservationJob represents a feasibility check and reservation job for network slicing related requirements to determine whether the network slicing related requirements can be satisfied. The IOC can be used to express a feasibility check and reservation job requirement for the specified network slicing related requirements (i.e. ServiceProfile, SliceProfile) and to represent the consumer's requirements for resource reservation for corresponding network slicing related requirements.

question_54763.question: How many bits are swapped in the first round of bit swapping for UAS-10 type 0?

question_54764.question: What is the scope of GCSE Groups?
question_54764.ground_truth: GCSE Groups are of system wide scope. Optionally, they may be geographically restricted.

question_54765.question: What action should the originator of the DISC command take if timer T200 expires before a UA or DM response is received?
question_54765.ground_truth: The originator of the DISC command should retransmit the DISC command, set timer T200 right before transmitting a frame, and increment the retransmission counter.

question_54766.question: What is the format of the label that the UE derives from the IMSI to identify the Provisioning GANC when the U()SIM is not provisioned with the FQDN or IP address of the Provisioning GANC?
question_54766.ground_truth: The UE derives the FQDN for the Provisioning GANC by creating a domain name as specified in 17.3.1 and adding the label "pganc." to the beginning of the domain name.

question_54767.question: What is the basic TTI (Transmission Time Interval) in EGPRS for a single Physical Data Channel (PDCH) in the uplink?
question_54767.ground_truth: The basic TTI in EGPRS for a single PDCH in the uplink is always 20 ms.

question_54770.question: What is the procedure for the UE-to-UE Relay Discovery Key Request in Model B?
question_54770.ground_truth: In Model B, the UE-to-UE Relay initiates the procedure by sending a Relay Discovery Key Request message containing its User Info ID and Relay Service Code (RSC) to its 5G DDNMF to get associated security materials. Then, the 5G DDNMF returns the Code Security Parameters along with the chosen PC5 ciphering algorithm to the UE-to-UE Relay.

question_54771.question: How is the 3GPP Generic User Profile managed within the home network?
question_54771.ground_truth: Within the home network, the components of the Generic User Profile may be distributed in various network nodes. Only one master of the component exists, but one or more copies of the master component may exist. The home operator shall be able to copy master components, which are located outside the home network to the home network. Within the home network, functionality exists that is able to locate GUP components, thereby making applications unaware of the actual location of the components. The administration and management of the data associated with this functionality is under the control of the home network.

question_54772.question: What is the format of the RerouteNASRequest procedure?
question_54772.ground_truth: The RerouteNASRequest procedure is a SEQUENCE containing protocolIEs and protocolExtensions, where the former is a ProtocolIE-Container with RerouteNASRequestIEs (which contains various ID, CRITICALITY, TYPE, and presence information) and the latter is a ProtocolExtensionContainer with RerouteNASRequestExtensions (which contains additional protocol extension information).

question_54773.question: What is the purpose of the TSC stream creation procedure?
question_54773.ground_truth: The TSC stream creation procedure enables the VAL server to establish TSC connectivity with the required QoS between the UEs connected to the 5GS after the stream discovery procedure. This procedure allows for pre-conditions, such as established Ethernet PDU sessions for each UE's DS-TT port MAC address and connectivity validation between DS-TTs.

question_54775.question: What procedure does the MME initiate upon receiving the BEARER RESOURCE RELEASE REQUEST message if the bearer resource release is accepted by the network?
question_54775.ground_truth: The MME initiates either the dedicated bearer context deactivation procedure or one of the dedicated bearer context modification procedures.

question_54776.question: How much time does a fixed period delay have between the start of a TDMA frame on the downlink and uplink?
question_54776.ground_truth: The fixed period delay between the start of a TDMA frame on the downlink and uplink is three timeslots.

question_54777.question: How many successive time periods does the test for verifying the correct reporting of an event when doing inter frequency and E-UTRAN FDD measurements consist of?
question_54777.ground_truth: Two successive time periods, with time durations T1 and T2.

question_54778.question: What shall the network do after receiving an ATTACH COMPLETE message?
question_54778.ground_truth: The network stops timer T3350 and changes to state GMM-REGISTERED.

question_54779.question: What is the purpose of the test in section 8.4.2.5 of the document?
question_54779.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the UE's ability to make a correct reporting of an event without SSB time index detection in non-DRX within E-UTRA - NR FR2 cell search requirements.

question_54781.question: What is the initial state of the mobile station in the test scenario?
question_54781.ground_truth: The mobile station is in the state "idle, GMM-registered" with a P-TMSI allocated, SPLIT PG CYCLE negotiated, and PDP context 2 activated.

question_54782.question: What is the requirement for the MS after the second step of "20.26.3.2 Procedure"?
question_54782.ground_truth: After the second step of "20.26.3.2 Procedure", the MS is required to perform a location update procedure on carrier 1 within 60 seconds.

question_54783.question: What is the relation of the present document to TS 32.240, TS 32.298, TS 32.295, TS 32.297 and TS 32.299 in the 3GPP charging TSs?
question_54783.ground_truth: The present document is related to TS 32.240, TS 32.298, TS 32.295, TS 32.297 and TS 32.299 as they specify the common 3GPP charging architecture, the parameters, abstract syntax and encoding rules for the CDRs, a transaction-based mechanism for the transfer of CDRs within the network, a file-based mechanism used to transfer the CDRs from the network to the operator's Billing Domain, and the 3GPP Diameter application that is used for PS domain offline and online charging.

question_54784.question: In what ways can the relative weight be considered in proportion to coverage while calculating energy efficiency?
question_54784.ground_truth: The relative weight in proportion to coverage can be calculated by dividing the coverage of a specific scenario by the system total coverage, allowing for comparisons between systems targeting different geographic areas.

question_54785.question: What action should the PCF take when requesting the SMF to report accumulated usage for one or more enabled usage monitoring control instances?
question_54785.ground_truth: The PCF should include the "lastReqUsageData" attribute within an HTTP POST request or response, specifying one or more reference(s) to the usage monitoring data decision(s) within the "refUmIds" attribute or setting the "allUmIds" attribute to true.

question_54786.question: What is the rationale for the inclusion of a Link Identifier Update Request message?
question_54786.ground_truth: The Link Identifier Update Request message is used to update the peer before the impending change of the identifiers used for the link, in order to avoid service interruptions due to privacy requirements and frequent identifier changes.

question_54787.question: What does Bit 1 in Octet 5 of the CSG Information Reporting Action indicate when set to "1"?
question_54787.ground_truth: It indicates to start reporting User CSG Info when the UE enters/leaves/access through the CSG Cell.

question_54789.question: What measures should be taken in case the 5G-SRVCC handover from NG-RAN to UTRAN has not been completed successfully and the MS has derived a new UMTS security context for the CS domain?
question_54789.ground_truth: The MS and the network should delete the new derived UMTS security context for the CS domain, and the network should also delete the already established UMTS security context for the CS domain if the CKSN is equal.

question_54790.question: What should the UE not transmit or receive during the measurement of SSB indexes or periodic/semi-persistent/aperiodic CSI-RS resources for L1-RSRP measurement in FR2-2, when using 480 kHz SCS or 960 kHz SCS?
question_54790.ground_truth: PUCCH/PUSCH/SRS or PDCCH/PDSCH/CSI-RS for tracking/CSI-RS for CQI on the corresponding symbols.

question_54791.question: What action triggers the generation of the Debit Units and Reserve Units Request message for MMS online charging?
question_54791.ground_truth: The Debit Units and Reserve Units Request message is generated when the MMS R/S generates Debit / Reserve Units information that can be transferred from the CTF to the OCF for MMS online charging.

question_54792.question: What is one of the responsibilities of the 5G system regarding service discovery in a PIN?
question_54792.ground_truth: The 5G system is responsible for authorizing or deauthorizing a UE to perform service discovery of PIN Elements over the 5G network.

question_54794.question: What is the purpose of the "Reset" message in the passed passage?
question_54794.ground_truth: The "Reset" message is used to reset the NAS signaling connection with the UE, and it can be used to reset all or part of the E1 interface connections associated with a UE.

question_54795.question: Which message is sent by the MS in Option 1, Section 70.9.3.1.1?
question_54795.ground_truth: The MS responds with a RELEASE COMPLETE message containing a LocationNotification return result with verificationResponse set to permissionGranted.

question_54796.question: What is an alternative method for computing the line spectrum frequencies from the immittance spectrum frequency representation in the AMR-WB IO mode?
question_54796.ground_truth: This can be achieved by first solving the coefficients of the polynomials from the immittance spectrum frequency representation, and then solving for the coefficients of the line spectrum frequencies from a set of equations that relate the two representations.

question_54798.question: What is the difference between an on-demand PDP context and a pre-established PDP context in PoC communication?
question_54798.ground_truth: An on-demand PDP context is established when needed, while a pre-established PDP context is established beforehand.

question_54800.question: What techniques can be used for cell association in load balancing/shifting?
question_54800.ground_truth: Some techniques for cell association include cell association based on RSRP with a bias, cell association based on RSRQ with a bias or threshold, cell association based on long-term SINR UE measurements with a bias, cell association based on a function of UE measurements with network-side information, and cell association based on RSRQ or SINR UE measurements within a shortened measurement interval.

question_54802.question: What is an issue that may arise if the DNS resolvers or servers in the third party do not support RFC 7871?
question_54802.ground_truth: When UE DNS Queries are sent to another DNS Resolver instead, if that is centrally deployed and it does not support RFC 7871, the selected AS might not be closest to the User PSA. Complementary application layer mechanisms may be needed to reselect AS based on the source IP address of the user application traffic.

question_54803.question: What is the procedure followed by UE with ICS capabilities to transfer real-time media flow(s) of an IMS session in PS to CS direction?
question_54803.ground_truth: UE initiates registration with IMS via the new PS access, sends an INVITE including the STI to establish the Access Leg via the PS access and an indication to use a CS bearer for the real-time media, and retains some non real-time media flow(s) in the original PS access, if any non real-time media is present.

question_54805.question: What is the default behavior of the MS receiving a call if no non-zero SS screening indicator is received?
question_54805.ground_truth: If the MS receives a call with no non-zero SS screening indicator, the CNAP information will not be provided.

question_54806.question: In the test requirement section, what is the maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell in this test case?

question_54807.question: What is the difference in applying the overload indication mechanism in Update Location dialogue and other requests?
question_54807.ground_truth: The overload indication mechanism can be applied in a node internal manner without HSS/HLR triggering based on the implementation specific mechanism for other requests.

question_54810.question: What are the required pre-conditions for the group deletion procedure?
question_54810.ground_truth: The group management clients, the group management server, and the MC service server should belong to the same MC system, and the group management client should be an authorized user for the group deletion operation.

question_54811.question: What does the pdcp-DuplicationSplitSRB and pdcp-DuplicationSplitDRB fields represent in the PDCP-ParametersMRDC information element?
question_54811.ground_truth: These fields represent the support for PDCP duplication and splitting for source and/or DRB RLCs in MRDC.

question_54814.question: What information does the ProSe layer of each remaining member UE pass to the AS layer after a group member leaves the ongoing group communication?
question_54814.ground_truth: The ProSe layer of each remaining member UE passes the updated Group Size and Member ID provided by the application layer to the AS layer.

question_54816.question: What is the condition for the MS to perform a cell update procedure?
question_54816.ground_truth: A cell update procedure is performed when the MS enters a new cell inside the current RA and the MS is in READY state. If the RA has changed, a routeing area update is executed instead of a cell update.

question_54818.question: What is the objective of the 3GPP Work Item titled "Support of RTTI in IMS charging"?
question_54818.ground_truth: The objective is to create a framework to handle RTTI (Real-time Transfer of Tariff Information) for offline and online charging purposes in 3GPP IMS charging, and to grant a secure and reliable transfer of RTTI.

question_54819.question: Why are the conducted and radiated requirements tested separately in clause 6.5A.3.1.2?
question_54819.ground_truth: The requirements are tested separately due to issues with combined testing of NR FR1 conducted mode with NR FR2 in radiated mode.

question_54820.question: What are the test levels specified for fast transients on AC mains power input ports in IEC 61000-4-4?
question_54820.ground_truth: The test level for fast transients on AC mains power input ports is 1 kV open circuit voltage.

question_54821.question: What is the public user identity that the UE uses in all REGISTER requests when GPRS-IMS-Bundled authentication is used for registration, regardless of the available implicitly registered IMPUs?
question_54821.ground_truth: The UE uses the temporary IMPU as the public user identity in all REGISTER requests when GPRS-IMS-Bundled authentication is used for registration.

question_54822.question: What is the minimum number of successful tests required for the test to pass?
question_54822.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests should be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

question_54823.question: What is the role of the IpMultiMediaCallControlManager interface in the MultiMedia Call Control service?
question_54823.ground_truth: The IpMultiMediaCallControlManager interface provides the management functions to the Multi-Media Call Control service. It allows the application programmer to create, destroy, change, and receive media stream related notifications.

question_54824.question: What is the significance of the LIID parameter in MBMS Lawful Interception (LI)?
question_54824.ground_truth: The LIID (Lawful Interception Identifier) is used for identification and correlation purposes in the context of MBMS Lawful Interception (LI). It is assigned by the authorized operator and is used within any information exchanged at the handover interfaces HI2 and HI3.

question_54826.question: What message does the target BSS send to MSC-1 when LCLS is connected?
question_54826.ground_truth: The target BSS informs MSC-1 that LCLS is connected.

question_54827.question: What action is taken by the LLC sublayer when the LLGMM-SUSPEND-REQ service primitive is issued?
question_54827.ground_truth: When the LLC sublayer receives the LLGMM-SUSPEND-REQ service primitive, all the LLC links will cease sending PDUs. The parameter page indicates that data shall be sent if available and therefore paging shall be needed, or the cause indicates that data shall not be sent until a RESUME-REQ is received.

question_54831.question: What is the function of an aggregator NWDAF in a multiple NWDAF deployment scenario?
question_54831.ground_truth: An aggregator NWDAF is an NWDAF instance with additional capabilities to aggregate output analytics provided by other NWDAFs. It can divide an area of interest into sub-areas and send analytics requests to corresponding NWDAFs based on their supported analytics areas and capabilities.

question_54832.question: When is the "split bearer" alternative used in Dual Connectivity?
question_54832.ground_truth: The "split bearer" alternative is used in Dual Connectivity when the U-plane termination point is changed in the E-UTRAN by means of S1-MME signalling without changing the S1-MME termination point.

question_54834.question: What message does the DN-AAA send to the SMF+PGW-C to initiate the PDU session establishment procedure when the DN-AAA is responsible for IP address allocation?
question_54834.ground_truth: The DN-AAA sends the Access-Accept message to the SMF+PGW-C to initiate the PDU session establishment procedure when the DN-AAA is responsible for IP address allocation.

question_54835.question: In which scenario should the HeNB select a carrier frequency that corresponds to the smaller measured RSRP?
question_54835.ground_truth: If the HeNB is overlaid by only one priority carrier frequency, it should select a carrier frequency that corresponds to the smaller measured RSRP.

question_54836.question: What happens to UE NAS messages during a MME triggered handover?
question_54836.ground_truth: During a MME triggered handover, the serving (old) MME ignores all UE NAS messages after the handover is triggered, and the dedicated (new) MME starts handling UE NAS messages after GUTI reallocation is complete.

question_54837.question: What is the impact of reducing air-interface latency on TCP slow-start performance?
question_54837.ground_truth: Reduced air-interface latency can help achieve higher user perceived throughput even for smaller TCP sessions. The same benefits in terms of TCP slow-start performance can be observed with latency reduction in general, regardless of how the lower latency is achieved.

question_54838.question: How does the "CDRX change" trigger condition be set in RAN?
question_54838.ground_truth: The "CDRX change" trigger condition can be set in RAN by using an N2 message sent from AMF to RAN, indicating the conditions for RAN to inform AMF of a CDRX change.

question_54839.question: Under which condition do the multi-slot PUCCH requirement tests apply?
question_54839.ground_truth: The multi-slot PUCCH requirement tests apply only if the base station (BS) supports it.

question_54840.question: In what circumstances is a UE allowed to send a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for the same S-NSSAI in the new PLMN, upon PLMN change?
question_54840.ground_truth: If timer T3585 is running or is deactivated for an S-NSSAI and the old PLMN, but not running and not deactivated for the S-NSSAI and new PLMN, the UE is allowed to send a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for the same S-NSSAI in the new PLMN.

question_54841.question: What is the impact of one symbol length TTI on UPT for large file size in the 3GPP macro scenario?
question_54841.ground_truth: One symbol length TTI can bring significant UPT gain in average for large file size in the 3GPP macro scenario.

question_54842.question: What happens when the mobile station receives an updated value of TA from the BTS on the downlink PTCCH?
question_54842.ground_truth: The mobile station should always use the last received TA value for the uplink transmission.

question_54843.question: What was the largest percentage increase in beam prediction accuracy for a 320ms prediction time, as reported by the evaluation results from 7 sources?
question_54843.ground_truth: The largest percentage increase in beam prediction accuracy for a 320ms prediction time was 8%.

question_54844.question: What are the steps to produce a 3D mesh in a production facility using stereo cameras?
question_54844.ground_truth: The steps are: capturing the scene using an array of cameras, performing keying to segment foreground and background, generating depth information using a depth estimator for each stereo pair, merging depth information using a 3D fusion process, filtering out occluded 3D points to obtain advanced foreground segmentation, and performing post-processing of the 3D point cloud to obtain a simplified textured mesh.

question_54846.question: What is the UE's minimum requirement for the number of ACK/NACK transmissions during the identification of a new CGI of E-UTRA cell when no DRX is used?
question_54846.ground_truth: The UE shall have more than 60 ACK/NACKs transmitted during the identification of a new CGI of E-UTRA cell when no DRX is used.

question_54847.question: What are the initial conditions for the MCX CO call release procedure?
question_54847.ground_truth: The initial conditions are specified in the test case which calls the procedure. The term MCX refers to MCPTT, MCVideo, or MCData.

question_54848.question: What is geographical routing and how does it work?
question_54848.ground_truth: Geographical routing is the process of converting the PDU's geographical area definition into an equivalent radio coverage map. PDU stands for Protocol Data Unit and is a term used in networking to describe a unit of data that is transmitted between two devices. In geographical routing, the PDU's geographical area is converted into a radio coverage map, which allows the network to determine the optimal locations to transmit the PDU, based on the radio coverage and the locations of other devices in the network.

question_54849.question: In the fullpowerMode1 for Rel.16, what is added for a UE supporting non-coherent capability?
question_54849.ground_truth: A non-antenna selection TPMI with the same power scaling as in Rel.15 is added.

question_54851.question: In 7.3.2.4.2, which message is used for step 19 and 21 of the RADIO BEARER SETUP procedure?
question_54851.ground_truth: The message in clause 9.2, "Contents of RADIO BEARER SETUP message: AM or UM" is used.

question_54852.question: What is the purpose of the Identification Token and/or Access Token in this solution?
question_54852.ground_truth: The Identification Token and/or Access Token are used for the UE to acquire an application request from the Application Function, such as a request for a list of Edge Application Servers, and for the Edge Enabler Server to perform Access Token Verification. The Access Token may be verified locally or in interaction with the AAF.

question_54854.question: What is the role of the PCRF in the described IMS solution with dedicated RLOS-APN?
question_54854.ground_truth: The PCRF in the described IMS solution with dedicated RLOS-APN indicates to the P-CSCF when the UE is RLOS detached from the EPC while an IMS session is still ongoing.

question_54855.question: What should be met in order for Band 22, 30, 40, 42 and 43 BS transmitters and receivers to share the same antenna path?
question_54855.ground_truth: The antenna path should meet very stringent third order PIM specification so that the antenna PIM will not cause Band 22, 30, 40, 42 and 43 BS receiver desensitization.

question_54856.question: What should the Node B do when the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message includes the Uplink Synchronisation Parameters LCR IE in the context of 1.28Mcps TDD?
question_54856.ground_truth: The Node B should use the indicated values of Uplink Synchronisation Stepsize IE and Uplink Synchronisation Frequency IE when evaluating the timing of the UL synchronisation.

question_54859.question: What should the Node B report to the CRNC when the power capability of a Power Local Cell Group changes?
question_54859.ground_truth: The Node B shall report the new capability by sending a RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message with the Indication Type IE set equal to "Service Impacting" and the Power Local Cell Group Information IE reporting the change when the power capability of a Power Local Cell Group changes. The Node B should also include the Maximum DL Power Capability IE in the Local Cell Information IE for all the Local Cells belonging to the concerned Power Local Cell Group.

question_54860.question: What is the effect of the application server being introduced in the SIP routeing process?
question_54860.ground_truth: The introduction of an application server in the SIP routeing process can affect the flow by the addition of extra URLs to SIP header fields and by the inclusion of functionality provided by the application server in this and subsequent flows.

question_54862.question: What should the E-CSCF convey towards the MGCF if a Geolocation header field is present in the request?
question_54862.ground_truth: The E-CSCF should convey the Geolocation header field towards the MGCF if it is present in the request.

question_54863.question: What is the purpose of the TRE in the M2ME system?
question_54863.ground_truth: The TRE in the M2ME system is a logically separate area in the M2M equipment with hardware support for secure storage and secure execution environment for multiple MCIMs and for certain functions concerned with the provisioning and management of MCIMs.

question_54864.question: What is the duration of each measurement of power level at specific frequencies in the verification of output RF spectrum due to modulation under normal conditions?
question_54864.ground_truth: The duration of each measurement is such as to cover at least 10 burst transmissions at FT, the nominal center frequency.

question_54865.question: What action does the Secondary Absolute Grant affect if it is received by the UE and affects the SG?
question_54865.ground_truth: The SG is set to the received value when the Secondary Absolute Grant affects the SG.

question_54866.question: What is the purpose of including the "ReportDiversionPASSporTInfo" parameter in the ActivateTask message of an IMS session that is later redirected?
question_54866.ground_truth: The purpose is to identify whether the "div" PASSporT information needs to be reported to certain Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs) for the redirected IMS session.

question_54867.question: What message is sent by the network to indicate the activation of a PDP context?
question_54867.ground_truth: The "Activate PDP context accept" message is sent by the network to indicate the activation of a PDP context.

question_54868.question: What is one of the main differences between the described solution alternatives in mapping the RAN coverage service?
question_54868.ground_truth: One of the main differences is whether the RAN coverage service is mapped in Company-NB systems to a NetworkSlice and ServiceProfile or NetworkSliceSubnet and SliceProfile. The chosen approach will have an impact on network slicing concepts and terminology, as well as the NRM used to represent network slices and slice constituents in both Company-NA and Company-NB management systems.

question_54871.question: What should the MCVideo client do when it is in the "P3: waiting for release response" state and timer TFP3 expires with a maximum number of retransmissions reached?
question_54871.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should terminate the media session, start timer TFP7, and enter the "P1: ignoring same call id" state.

question_54872.question: What is the definition of the "ALUID" abbreviation as given in the document?
question_54872.ground_truth: "ALUID" stands for Application Layer User ID.

question_54873.question: What is the purpose of the first sequence in the USIM Application Toolkit testing procedure?
question_54873.ground_truth: The purpose of the first sequence in the USIM Application Toolkit testing procedure is to test the functionality of proactive UICC commands.

question_54874.question: What is the property of "non-overlapping" Segments and Subsegments used for in 3GPP-DASH?
question_54874.ground_truth: The property of "non-overlapping" Segments (respectively Subsegments) is used to define the terms Segment alignment and Subsegment alignment in 3GPP-DASH.

question_54875.question: When is the NSAG information deleted by the UE?
question_54875.ground_truth: The NSAG information is deleted by the UE when the UE is switched off or when the UE is deregistered from the registered PLMN or the registered SNPN.

question_54876.question: What should be done if the trigger type is set to event, the event includes a numberOfTriggeringCells, and the event's entry condition is fulfilled for one or more applicable cells for all measurements after layer 3 filtering?
question_54876.ground_truth: If the number of cells in the cellsTriggeredList is larger than or equal to numberOfTriggeringCells, include the concerned cells in the cellsTriggeredList. If not, initiate the measurement reporting procedure and include the concerned cells in the cellsTriggeredList.

question_54877.question: Which type name is the PDU Session context type representation?

question_54878.question: What happens to the keys when the UE and eNB release the RRC connection during the ECM-IDLE to ECM-CONNECTED transition?
question_54878.ground_truth: The UE and eNB delete the keys they store. The MME maintains the security context for ECM-IDLE state UEs, while the eNB only stores the keys for UEs with established RRC connection.

question_54879.question: What is the definition of QoE and QoS in the context of the present document?
question_54879.ground_truth: QoE (Quality of Experience) refers to the overall performance of a service as experienced by the user, and QoS (Quality of Service) refers to the technical requirements and capabilities that enable the delivery of a service to meet the user's expectations.

question_54881.question: What kind of notification delivery methods are used in the enhanced architecture for Edge Application?
question_54881.ground_truth: The notification delivery methods for Edge Application include Long-polling, WebSocket, FCM, APNS, and OMA Push. These methods allow for flexible notifications delivery to EEC.

question_54884.question: What does the "Call setup time" metric measure on SIP level?
question_54884.ground_truth: The "Call setup time" metric is the time between the transmitted INVITE, and the reception of either "200 OK" or "180 RINGING" (whichever comes first).

question_54885.question: How does Solution#2.1 support QoS flow based charging in the 5G system?
question_54885.ground_truth: Solution#2.1 supports QoS flow based charging by having the reporting level as per combination of the rating group and QFI. This means that the charging information is reported for each combination of the rating group and QFI, allowing for a more detailed breakdown of charging information.

question_54886.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's (3GPP) role in the telecommunications industry?
question_54886.ground_truth: The 3GPP is an international collaboration of telecommunications standards organizations that develops specifications for the technical compatibility of 3GPP radio-access, core network, and service technologies.

question_54887.question: Which method is used to retrieve location information in the PS domain from all nodes (AMF, MME and SGSN)?
question_54887.ground_truth: The GET method with the "requested-nodes" query parameter not included will retrieve location information in the PS domain from all nodes (AMF, MME and SGSN).

question_54890.question: What is the purpose of the monitoring UE procedure for relay discovery additional information in 5G ProSe?
question_54890.ground_truth: The purpose of the monitoring UE procedure for relay discovery additional information is to enable a 5G ProSe remote UE to become aware of the additional information of the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE.

question_54891.question: What action does the MME take if the UE requested PDN connectivity in the attach request and the MME supports EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection, but the attach type is not "EPS emergency attach" or "EPS RLOS attach"?
question_54891.ground_truth: The MME sends the ATTACH ACCEPT message together with an ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message contained in the ESM message container information element to activate the default bearer.

question_54892.question: What should the P-CSCF do when it receives an initial request for a dialog or a request for a standalone transaction from a UE that is not considered as privileged sender?
question_54892.ground_truth: When the P-CSCF receives an initial request for a dialog or a request for a standalone transaction from a UE that is not considered as privileged sender, it identifies the originator and served user of the request by the default public user identity.

question_54893.question: What does Solution 28: MBS service de-announcement focus on?
question_54893.ground_truth: Solution 28: MBS service de-announcement focuses on the MBS session being no longer used and the MC service client is informed with the MBS session de-announcement. This allows the MC client UE to stop monitoring the broadcast MBS session or leave the multicast MBS session, promoting efficient usage of network resources.

question_54894.question: In which mode is an MBMS Broadcast Context always implicitly in the 'Active' state?
question_54894.ground_truth: In MBMS Broadcast mode, the MBMS Bearer Context is always implicitly in the 'Active' state.

question_54896.question: What protocol does the UPF use to exchange N6 signalling for IP multicast traffic?
question_54896.ground_truth: The PIM (Protocol-Independent Multicast) protocol is used by the UPF to exchange N6 signalling for IP multicast traffic.

question_54898.question: What is the measurement provided by GTP.InDataPktN19PsaUpf and GTP.InDataPktN19PsaUpf.SNSSAI?
question_54898.ground_truth: The number of GTP data PDUs received on the N19 interface by the PSA UPF, optionally split into subcounters per S-NSSAI.

question_54900.question: What is the main challenge of providing an audio distribution service in a large venue with several thousands of people?
question_54900.ground_truth: One of the main challenges is guaranteeing the quality of service for both users using the normal cellular network data and voice services as well as the ones listening to the streams of the audio distribution system, as they would bring their own mobile devices and be served by different MNOs.

question_54901.question: What is the pre-condition for the edge computing management system to know the information of the UPFs for the local data network?
question_54901.ground_truth: The edge computing management system needs to be aware of the QoS requirements on the N6 interface.

question_54903.question: What should the mobile station initiate when the NC measurement report interval timer T3158 expires?
question_54903.ground_truth: At expiry of the timer T3158, the mobile station shall restart the expired timer T3158, perform the measurements and initiate the packet access.

question_54904.question: What information does the SMF include in the N2 SM information when providing MBS session information to the NG-RAN nodes?
question_54904.ground_truth: The SMF includes the MBS service area and Area Session ID in the N2 SM information when providing MBS session information to the NG-RAN nodes.

question_54906.question: What should the value of the "request-type" element be in a group standalone SDS message?
question_54906.ground_truth: The value of the "request-type" element should be "group-sds" in a group standalone SDS message.

question_54907.question: What should the I-CSCF do if it cannot select an S-CSCF which meets the mandatory capabilities indicated by the HSS?
question_54907.ground_truth: The I-CSCF shall inform the operator via the O&M subsystem.

question_54909.question: What is the request type for a SIP MESSAGE targeting the non-controlling MCVideo function of an MCVideo group, with the isfocus media feature tag not included in the Contact header field?
question_54909.ground_truth: A SIP INVITE request from participating MCVideo function for non-controlling MCVideo function of an MCVideo group

question_54910.question: What are the three types of information elements in analytics outputs?
question_54910.ground_truth: The three types of information elements in analytics outputs are common information elements that can be generated by MDA and be applicable for all MDA capabilities, capability-specific information elements, and optionally, vendor-specific extensions.

question_54914.question: What is the purpose of the load balancing mechanism in the context of the load control feature?
question_54914.ground_truth: The purpose of load balancing is to effectively distribute the load amongst nodes, preventing any single node from being overloaded while ensuring that other nodes do not operate near their maximum capacity.

question_54915.question: What data is included in the "QosMonitoringData" instances generated by the PCF if the "EnQoSMon" feature is supported?
question_54915.ground_truth: The "QosMonitoringData" instances include the indication of the type of QoS monitoring parameter (e.g. packet delay or congestion information or data rate), the requested QoS monitoring parameter(s) to be measured (i.e. DL/UL round trip packet delay or, if the "EnQoSMon" feature is supported, UL/DL congestion information or UL/DL data rate), and the frequency(s) of reporting (e.g. event triggered and/or periodic).

question_54916.question: What is a guideline for optional releases in a database?
question_54916.ground_truth: Optional releases in a database must not become mandatory. This ensures that network entities that do not recognize these new releases may ignore the functionality represented.

question_54917.question: What are the general MTP level 3 exceptions and modifications to ANSI T1.111.4, regardless of whether the SGSN supports STP functionality?
question_54917.ground_truth: The exceptions include the support of ANSI specific Signalling Link Congestion Control, inclusion of the SGSN signalling point code in the national signalling point code scheme or a separate signalling network, support of ANSI specific Network Congestion, basic link management procedures, the service indicator and sub service field for Gs interface operation, and relevance of the formats and codes to required messages.

question_54918.question: What message is sent by the media storage client to the media storage function on the MCData content server to request a file download?

question_54919.question: What is the channel raster for category NB1 and NB2 in-band, guard-band and standalone operation?
question_54919.ground_truth: Channel raster for category NB1 and NB2 is 100 kHz.

question_54920.question: What does the 9.2.32 UE Context Kept Indicator indicate in the XwAP protocol?
question_54920.ground_truth: The 9.2.32 UE Context Kept Indicator indicates that the UE Context at the WT is kept in case of inter-eNB handover without WT Change procedure, as specified in TS 36.300.

question_54923.question: What is the CGI reporting scheduling restriction when a RedCap UE is identifying the CGI of an NR cell with autonomous gaps?
question_54923.ground_truth: When a RedCap UE is identifying the CGI of an NR cell with autonomous gaps, the UE is not expected to transmit or receive specific signal types during certain time periods related to MIB and SIB1 decoding.

question_54927.question: What should MCVideo client B do if there is an ongoing private communication with MCVideo client C?
question_54927.ground_truth: MCVideo client B will skip discovering MCVideo client C and proceed to the next steps

question_54928.question: How are the UMTS cipher/integrity keys CK and IK derived during a PS handover from Iu to Gb mode in a UMTS security context?
question_54928.ground_truth: The UMTS cipher/integrity keys CK and IK are derived from the UMTS cipher/integrity keys CK and IK agreed during the latest UMTS AKA procedure in case of a PS intra SGSN Handover.

question_54929.question: What is the average cell throughput and throughput gain at cell border for MDSR compared to EGPRS in the 1/3 re-use scenario?
question_54929.ground_truth: The average cell throughput gain for MDSR was 1.6 times higher and at cell border, it was 67%.

question_54930.question: What should Media Gateways do when they receive packets with RTP payload types (PT) that do not match the Local Descriptor contents?
question_54930.ground_truth: Media Gateways should discard such packets.

question_54931.question: What are the preconditions for the gsmSSF in the "SplitLeg Procedure" section in order to place the specified leg in a new target Call Segment?
question_54931.ground_truth: A control relationship exists between the gsmSCF and the gsmSSF. The CSID1 is either the source Call Segment or the target Call Segment. User interaction is not in progress in the source Call Segment. The BCSM for the leg to be split shall be in the alerting phase or in the active phase.

question_54932.question: What happens when the MS sends a Routeing Area Update Request message to the new 3G-SGSN in the inter-system change?
question_54932.ground_truth: The MS sends a Routeing Area Update Request message to the new 3G-SGSN indicating the start of the update procedure, old RAI, old P-TMSI, and other relevant information.

question_54933.question: What is the default value for the temporary mode of the CLIR Supplementary Service?
question_54933.ground_truth: The default value for the temporary mode of the CLIR Supplementary Service is "presentation restricted".

question_54935.question: How does the network determine the Allowed NSSAI in this solution?
question_54935.ground_truth: The network determines the Allowed NSSAI based on the Requested NSSAI, which includes S-NSSAIs that all belong to at least one common SUG.

question_54937.question: What are the three types of interfaces specified in the present NDS document?
question_54937.ground_truth: The Za interface, which is the interface between SEGs belonging to different networks/security domains (a Za interface may be an intra or an inter operator interface), the Zb interface, which is the interface between SEGs and NEs and interface between NEs within the same network/security domain, and the Za-interface between two security domains of the same operator.

question_54938.question: What should the RNC do if it receives a DIRECT TRANSFER message from the CN containing SIPTO L-GW Transport Layer Address IE?
question_54938.ground_truth: The RNC shall consider the procedure as failed.

question_54940.question: What is the expected final state of the MS after the test procedure for class 1 short messages?
question_54940.ground_truth: The expected final state of the MS is idle, updated.

question_54941.question: What should the SS do if the MS recommends to use a codec mode higher than 8.85 kbit/s in the downlink, after the carrier to interference ratio has been altered?
question_54941.ground_truth: The SS should increment the successful C/I increase event counter.

question_54942.question: What is the result of increasing the frequency of AKA runs to limit the amount of data the attacker gets access to?
question_54942.ground_truth: Increasing the frequency of AKA runs would limit the amount of data the attacker gets access to, but it also increases the load on the network, authentication vector consumption, and adds delay in accessing those services.

question_54943.question: In the architecture for WebRTC IMS Client access to IMS, what is the role of the WWSF (WebRTC Web Server Function)?
question_54943.ground_truth: The WWSF is the first web server contacted by the user, and it obtains an authorization token from the WAF for the WIC to include in the SIP register request for verification by the eP-CSCF.

question_54945.question: What is the advantage of increasing PDCCH monitoring capability for Rel-16 NR URLLC?
question_54945.ground_truth: It is beneficial while increasing UE complexity and supports a larger number of non-overlapped CCEs per slot for channel estimation.

question_54946.question: What is the expected color format for the alpha identifier when the "Strikethrough On" attribute is used in the CLOSE CHANNEL proactive command?
question_54946.ground_truth: The expected color format for the alpha identifier when the "Strikethrough On" attribute is used in the CLOSE CHANNEL proactive command is Dark Green Foreground, Bright Yellow Background.

question_54947.question: What does the acronym NOA stand for in the diameter header message?

question_54948.question: What action should the receiver take when it receives overload control information with a more recent sequence number?
question_54948.ground_truth: The receiver should overwrite the stored overload control information with the newly received information.

question_54949.question: What is the purpose of Step 3 in Solution 2 for SGW failure?
question_54949.ground_truth: In Step 3 of Solution 2 for SGW failure, the ISR associated mobility management node indicates the SGW has been selected or the SGW relocation has failed by sending an S3 message to the ISR associated node.

question_54950.question: In what mode can the UE (MCVideo Client) request to affiliate a target user to an MCVideo group?
question_54950.ground_truth: The UE (MCVideo Client) can request to affiliate a target user to an MCVideo group via mandatory mode.

question_54951.question: What is the effect of using a scale value other than 1 for streaming?
question_54951.ground_truth: It should not change the streaming bitrate of the corresponding media stream.

question_54952.question: What are the minimum performance requirements for the downlink physical channels specified in Annex C.3.2 in section 9.5.1.1-2, 9.5.1.2-2, 9.5.2.1-2, and 9.5.2.2-2?
question_54952.ground_truth: The minimum performance requirements for the downlink physical channels specified in Annex C.3.2 are defined in section 9.5.1.1-2, 9.5.1.2-2, 9.5.2.1-2, and 9.5.2.2-2 as the ratio of the throughput obtained based on UE reported RI and that obtained with fixed rank 1 or rank 2 transmissions.

question_54953.question: What is the PRACH transmission time for the E-UTRAN TDD-FDD inter frequency handover test case after the start of time period T3?
question_54953.ground_truth: If the UE transmits the uplink PRACH to Cell 2 less than 50 ms from the beginning of time period T3, then the test is considered successful.

question_54954.question: What is the length of the preamble used in dedicated carrier MBSFN mode?
question_54954.ground_truth: The length of the preamble used in dedicated carrier MBSFN mode is 96.

question_54955.question: What condition must be met for the event "Deactivation" to be counted as a success in the FDD PCell case?
question_54955.ground_truth: The PCell and SCells must be intra-band or inter-band with at most 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes outside the specified ranges.

question_54956.question: What type of messages are exchanged between the UE and ProSe Key Management Function for Public Safety Discoveries?
question_54956.ground_truth: There are two types of messages exchanged - Key Request and Response messages, and MIKEY messages. Key Request and Response messages are used by the UE to request and receive the relevant PSDK and associated security material for the Public Safety Discoveries it wishes to protect. MIKEY messages are used by the ProSe Key Management Function to send the PSDKs to the UE.

question_54957.question: What message is sent by the system simulator during the call to check if the MS correctly handles an unknown RATSCCH REQ message?
question_54957.ground_truth: The system simulator sends an unknown RATSCCH_REQ message, with message content as all zeros.

question_54958.question: What is the message discriminator for the "BearerRearrangement" procedure?

question_54960.question: What is not allowed for a UE, whether it has an ongoing IMS session or not, when it comes to transferring the PDN connection providing access to IMS between EPC via non-3GPP access and 5GCN via NG-RAN?
question_54960.ground_truth: If the value of a certain leaf is set to 2, the UE is not allowed to transfer the PDN connection providing access to IMS between EPC via non-3GPP access and 5GCN via NG-RAN.

question_54963.question: What is the outcome for the AMF if the originally requested network slice is overloaded or not available and a compatible S-NSSAI is included in the PDU Session Establishment Request message?
question_54963.ground_truth: If the originally requested network slice is overloaded or not available and a compatible S-NSSAI is included in the PDU Session Establishment Request message, the AMF selects an SMF based on the compatible S-NSSAI and continues the PDU Session establishment procedure on the compatible S-NSSAI instead of the originally requested S-NSSAI.

question_54965.question: What message is sent by the source MME to the UE during a SRVCC handover from E-UTRAN?
question_54965.ground_truth: Handover Command (Target to Source Transparent Container) message

question_54966.question: What is the mechanism used by 3GPP to negotiate supported features between the client and server?
question_54966.ground_truth: 3GPP uses the "3gpp-Optional-Features" and "3gpp-Required-Features" HTTP header fields to express desired or required features, and the "3gpp-Accepted-Features" HTTP header field to express accepted features.

question_54967.question: What are the achievable gains in energy and power consumption by using longer DRX cycles?
question_54967.ground_truth: The achievable gains in energy and power consumption are by using longer DRX cycles, but this may reduce the responsiveness of low mobility MTC devices and require applications that can tolerate longer latency periods.

question_54969.question: What is the maximum individual phase error allowed for all measured bursts in subclause 13.1.5.2?
question_54969.ground_truth: The maximum individual phase error allowed for all measured bursts in subclause 13.1.5.2 is 20 degrees.

question_54970.question: What is the requirement for the 3GPP management system to enable an authorized data consumer to request management data specified by 3GPP to be produced by certain managed object instance(s) only?

question_54971.question: What should a UE do if it is in the 5GMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE state?
question_54971.ground_truth: The UE should perform cell selection/reselection and may initiate registration for emergency services.

question_54972.question: What is the requirement for L1-SINR measurement when CSI-RS is used as CMR and CSI-IM as IMR?
question_54972.ground_truth: The number of CSI-RS resources in the resource set for CMR and the number of CSI-IM resources in the resource set for IMR should be the same.

question_54974.question: What is the time duration required for a cell to be considered known in the context of RRC re-establishment for CEModeB?
question_54974.ground_truth: A cell is considered known in the context of RRC re-establishment for CEModeB if it has been meeting the relevant cell identification requirement for a time duration equal to or longer than the time duration required for the cell identification.

question_54975.question: What should the source gNB do if it detects that the target gNB is non-MBS supporting before the handover preparation phase?
question_54975.ground_truth: The source gNB should change the QFI(s) in the forwarded packets to the associated PDU Session QFI(s) if mapping information is available.

question_54976.question: How are the simulation steps for co-existence simulation methodology followed in 5G NR coexistence?
question_54976.ground_truth: The simulation steps involve generating an aggressor and victim network, associating UEs with base stations based on coupling loss, computing throughput in the victim systems without considering ACI and with considering ACI, and determining RF parameters based on the degradation caused by ACI.

question_54977.question: What is the purpose of the Uplink Network Assistance (UNA) feature in a FLUS system?
question_54977.ground_truth: The UNA feature in a FLUS system enables a FLUS source to improve the quality of experience (QoE) of content up-streaming sessions by providing network assistance from a Network Assistance Server (NAssS).

question_54979.question: What is the role of ProSe Function of the HPLMN in Proximity-based Services (ProSe)?
question_54979.ground_truth: The ProSe Function of the HPLMN is responsible for obtaining and merging the service authorization for ProSe direct discovery and ProSe direct communication from the UE and the ProSe Function of each local PLMN or VPLMN. It then sends the merged service authorization to the UE. The ProSe Function of the HPLMN also provides the service authorization for ProSe direct discovery and ProSe direct communication for Public Safety UE, indicating the required radio parameters to be used and the ProSe UE-to-network relay related parameters.

question_54981.question: In the solution, what is the role of the MIC (Message Integrity Check) in the ProSe discovery message?
question_54981.ground_truth: The MIC in the ProSe discovery message is used to verify the authenticity and integrity of the ProSe App Code and the UTC-based counter associated with the discovery slot based on the Discovery Key, preventing replays or modifications of the discovery message.

question_54982.question: What two types of frameworks are specified for coordination in Remote Interference Management (RIM) to mitigate remote interference?

question_54983.question: What is the Inter RAT information container, and what is its minimum and maximum length?
question_54983.ground_truth: The Inter RAT information container is an information element that supplies the network with Iu mode related information that needs to be transferred at PS inter-system handover to Iu mode. It has a minimum length of 3 octets and a maximum length of 250 octets.

question_54984.question: What identified issue is mentioned regarding cell reselection to UTRAN or GERAN, user is not registered in the CS domain of the target network (5.7.2)?
question_54984.ground_truth: An issue is uncoordinated users in the scenario where NRIs are uncoordinated. Users may stay uncoordinated since NRIs from the CS and PS domains are considered coordinated in the target network.

question_54985.question: What provides no protection for users connected to a compromised RNC/NodeB in the described scenario?
question_54985.ground_truth: Changing keys (either via re-authentication or UTRAN KH) provides no protection for users connected to a collapsed RNC/NodeB which is under the control of an attacker for an extended period of time.

question_54986.question: What is used by an MME to determine the VLR number in CS Fallback when multiple MSC/VLRs serve the same LAI?
question_54986.ground_truth: An MME uses the LAI and NRI or a hash value from the IMSI to determine the VLR number.

question_54987.question: What should the UE be capable of, in terms of detecting and measuring inter-frequency RSTD, as specified in Section 8.1.2.6.1?
question_54987.ground_truth: The UE should be capable of detecting and measuring inter-frequency RSTD for at least 16 cells, including the reference cell, within a certain time period as specified in Section 8.1.2.6.1.

question_54988.question: What message does the UE send to the LMF in a REGISTER message to cancel an ongoing periodic or triggered location procedure in 3GPP TS 24.080?

question_54989.question: What is the purpose of the Relay Service Code (RSC) in the described mechanism?
question_54989.ground_truth: The Relay Service Code (RSC) is used for discovery and PC5 link setup between the remote UE and N3IWF for accessing the 5GC.

question_54990.question: What is recommended to indicate the availability of symbol-based repair servers for legacy terminals in the Associated Delivery Procedures?
question_54990.ground_truth: For backwards compatibility, re-use the "serviceURI" element in the Associated Delivery Procedures to indicate the availability of symbol-based repair servers for legacy terminals.

question_54991.question: What is the requirement for the IMS with regards to handling an incoming session addressed to an unallocated identity?
question_54991.ground_truth: The IMS shall be able to reject, re-route or trigger service logic to that incoming session if it is addressed to an identity administered by the operator but not allocated to a user or a service.

question_54992.question: What are the conditions for performing CSI-RS measurement with restrictions for FR1?
question_54992.ground_truth: The UE shall be able to perform CSI-RS measurement with restrictions if the SSB for RLM, BFD, CBD, or L1-RSRP measurement is within the active BWP and has different SCS than CSI-RS for RLM, unless the UE supports simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology.

question_54993.question: What is the role of the PAnF within the 5GC?
question_54993.ground_truth: The PAnF is the network entity in the 5G Core Network (5GC) that supports security procedures over the Control Plane for the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network relay and 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay as specified in 3GPP~TS~33.503.

question_54995.question: What is the frequency range to be tested for E-UTRA FDD?

question_54996.question: What is the initial communication path for MCPTT service between two user equipment (UE) in the EPC?
question_54996.ground_truth: The initial communication path for MCPTT service between two user equipment (UE) in the EPC is through IP addresses IP@A1 and IP@B1 for all media packets.

question_54997.question: What is the purpose of the local inbound/outbound proxy in the communication system?
question_54997.ground_truth: The local inbound/outbound proxy functional entity acts as both an inbound and outbound proxy for all SIP transactions, providing NAT traversal, resource control, routing of requests and responses, SIP signalling security, and address resolution based on the PLMN operator policy.

question_54998.question: What terms and definitions provided by 3GPP TS 29.198-1 apply to the 3GPP TS 29.198-4 document?
question_54998.ground_truth: The terms and definitions provided by 3GPP TS 29.198-1 apply to the 3GPP TS 29.198-4 document.

question_54999.question: In which scenarios does the SGW-U construct end marker packet(s)?
question_54999.ground_truth: The SGW-U constructs end marker packet(s) in case of eNodeB relocation during handover procedure without SGW-U change, and in case of SGW-U relocation during handover procedure.

question_55000.question: What does the first digit in the version number (e.g. x.y.z) of a 3GPP TS indicate?
question_55000.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number indicates the stage of the document's development, with 0 indicating a presentation to the TSG for information, 1 indicating presentation to the TSG for approval, and values greater than 1 indicating a TSG approved document under change control.

question_55001.question: What is the purpose of the '<actions>' element with an empty value in a matching rule?
question_55001.ground_truth: The purpose of the '<actions>' element with an empty value in a matching rule is to abandon the rest of the rules and continue with the terminating procedures, which can be used to avoid that a communication diversion based on multiple media conditions is diverted by a later rule with only one of these media conditions.

question_55002.question: What should the VAE-S include in the HTTP 200 (OK) response message, if the local service information is successfully determined?
question_55002.ground_truth: A <local-service-info-content> element which provides the local service information to the VAE-C

question_55004.question: What is the target time for delivery of the MSD in an eCall?
question_55004.ground_truth: The target time for delivery of the MSD in an eCall is 4 seconds.

question_55007.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification (TS) 22.104?
question_55007.ground_truth: The purpose of this TS is to define the circuit telecommunication services supported by a GSM PLMN within the digital cellular telecommunications system (Phase 2+).

question_55009.question: What should the PSAP know to increase its confidence level regarding a non-voice emergency media?
question_55009.ground_truth: The PSAP should know that the non-voice emergency media is from an authenticated device.

question_55010.question: What is the purpose of the N2InfoNotify service operation in the AMF planned removal procedure with UDSF deployed?
question_55010.ground_truth: The N2InfoNotify service operation is used by an initial AMF to forward uplink N2 signaling to the target AMF in the AMF planned removal procedure with UDSF deployed.

question_55011.question: What is the purpose of the procedure for CN-initiated selective deactivation of UP connection of an existing PDU Session?
question_55011.ground_truth: The procedure aims to deactivate the UP connection of an established PDU Session of a UE in CM-CONNECTED state.

question_55012.question: When is the start of T3 in clause 16.6.5.3.4?
question_55012.ground_truth: The start of T3 is the instant when the last TTI containing the RRC message implying SI reading is sent to the UE in clause 16.6.5.3.4.

question_55013.question: In step 6 of the test procedure given in clause 17.6.1.4.4.2, what values determine the success or failure of the test?
question_55013.ground_truth: In step 6 of the test procedure, the UE performs transmits a MeasurementReport message triggered by Event A3. The delays measured from T2's beginning are compared to X ms for Test 1 or Y ms for Test 2. If the delay is less than X or Y ms, the number of successful tests is increased by one. If the UE fails to report the event within the required delay, the number of failure tests is increased by one.

question_55017.question: What is the reason for keeping the user identity request and response message procedure in LTE flexible?
