question_55362.ground_truth: Since the SATD UE uses a single, common, transmit chain until the PA output, and the duplexer does not affect most existing core Tx requirements, there's no need to test against all core Tx requirements again with the second transmit chain when the UE is in SATD mode.

question_55364.question: What is the condition for establishing a dedicated bearer for WB-E-UTRA?
question_55364.ground_truth: The decision to establish or modify a dedicated bearer for WB-E-UTRA can only be taken by the EPC, and the bearer level QoS parameter values are always assigned by the EPC.

question_55365.question: Which 3GPP standards specify the service requirements for MCVideo group and private streaming?
question_55365.ground_truth: The corresponding service requirements for MCVideo group and private streaming are defined in 3GPP TS 22.280 and 3GPP TS 22.281.

question_55366.question: What is the role of the AS in providing location information of other UEs?
question_55366.ground_truth: The AS does not provide location information of other UEs to each AC unless the users involved in the multi-user session have consented to sharing their individual UE (User Equipment) location information. The application layer mechanism for a user to share consent with the AS is outside the scope of SA6.

question_55367.question: In what scenario would the network determine a Target NSSAI for the UE during a Registration procedure?
question_55367.ground_truth: This would occur if the UE requests a new S-NSSAI which is not supported in the UE's current Tracking Area.

question_55369.question: What determines the presentation time of images in an HEVC encoded image/image sequence?
question_55369.ground_truth: The RTP timestamps determine the presentation time of images in an HEVC encoded image/image sequence.

question_55371.question: In the third-party REGISTER request, what should the S-CSCF do if there is more than one message body to be included?
question_55371.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should include a multipart message body and set the value of the Content-Type header field to "multipart/mixed".

question_55372.question: What is the role of the GANC in establishing a GA-CSR connection?
question_55372.ground_truth: The GANC is responsible for receiving the GA-CSR REQUEST message from the MS and either accepting or rejecting the connection establishment request.

question_55373.question: What does the "allow" value in the "Defined values" section determine?
question_55373.ground_truth: The "allow" value in the "Defined values" section determines whether location disclosure is allowed or not.

question_55375.question: When would the step 12 and 13 be skipped?
question_55375.ground_truth: If the PDU session establishment failed between step 5 and step 11, then steps 12 and 13 would be skipped.

question_55376.question: What action must the MME perform if there is a partial fault in one or more components and corresponding CSIDs are assigned?
question_55376.ground_truth: The MME must perform implementation-specific operations to clean up any residual state associated with the assigned CSIDs and send a GTPv2 Delete PDN Connection Set Request message containing all the MME CSIDs of the failing components to the SGW peers that support the feature.

question_55377.question: What is the purpose of the SM-RL-DATA-REQuest service primitive on the MS side?
question_55377.ground_truth: The SM-RL-DATA-REQuest service primitive on the MS side is used to request the passing of the SMS-TPDU and necessary control information to SM-RL. It implies the establishment of an SM-RL connection for MO message transfer, forming of the RP-DATA message containing the SMS-TPDU, and transfer of the RP-DATA message as an RPDU in an MNSMS-EST-Req.

question_55378.question: What message does the HSE send in response to a EMSDP Session Start message?
question_55378.ground_truth: The HSE sends a EMSDP Session Start message, which includes an EAS container that may contain an identifier for the Enterprise Key.

question_55379.question: What measurement provides the number of incoming bytes received for a virtualized 3GPP NF?
question_55379.ground_truth: DataVolum.InBytes measurement provides the number of incoming bytes received for a virtualized 3GPP NF.

question_55380.question: What is the format required for initial session descriptions in a PSS client?
question_55380.ground_truth: The formats supported by a PSS client for initial session descriptions are SDP or plain RTSP URL.

question_55381.question: What is the maximum duration of the test for GSM900 band specified in the test procedure?
question_55381.ground_truth: The maximum duration of the test for GSM900 band specified in the test procedure is 38 minutes.

question_55384.question: What is the purpose of sending an SAR with a new Server Assignment Type as REASSIGNMENT to request backuped data from the HSS?
question_55384.ground_truth: The purpose of sending an SAR with a new Server Assignment Type as REASSIGNMENT to request backuped data from the HSS is to re-assign a new S-CSCF for the user when the related Public User Identity is registered and the HSS does not have the S-CSCF info.

question_55385.question: What is the role of the PCF in Application Detection and Control requirements?
question_55385.ground_truth: The PCF can instruct the SMF on which applications to detect, and whether to report start or stop events to the PCF. Upon receiving the report from the SMF, the PCF can make policy decisions based on the information received and send the corresponding updated or new PCC rules to the SMF.

question_55386.question: What should a mobile station do, when it receives new data from upper layers for transmission in the uplink TBF while it is operating in extended uplink TBF mode?
question_55386.ground_truth: The mobile station shall update the TBC value and recalculate the CV for the new untransmitted RLC data block.

question_55387.question: What does "MSD" stand for in the technical report?
question_55387.ground_truth: MSD stands for Maximum Summary Duty Cycle in the context of the technical report.

question_55388.question: What is the purpose of solution #16 in addressing key issue #6.2, CAG ID Privacy?
question_55388.ground_truth: Solution #16 proposes modifying the handling of CAG ID during idle to connected transitions on a CAG cell. This solution sends the CAG-ID that the UE is accessing in encrypted NAS signalling. This ensures that the CAG ID is confidential and available only to authorized parties.

question_55389.question: What should a UE with no support for IFOM, MAPCON, or non-seamless offload capabilities use if both ISMP and ISRP are available and the ANDSF rules control the WLAN access selection and traffic routing?
question_55389.ground_truth: The UE will use the ISMP.

question_55391.question: What is the role of the NEF in supporting the Location dependent broadcast service?
question_55391.ground_truth: The NEF selects MB-SMF as ingress control node(s) for different MBS service areas, maps possible external identifiers for MBS service areas to network-internal identifiers, and uses the service area to discover the MB-SMF.

question_55392.question: In the context of an ongoing On-demand Pre-arranged Group Call with Automatic Commencement Mode, what must the UE (MCPTT Client) do when the MCPTT User wants to upgrade the ongoing MCPTT Group Call to an MCPTT Emergency Group Call with floor control?
question_55392.ground_truth: The UE (MCPTT Client) must send a SIP re-INVITE request and upon receipt of a SIP 2xx response, consider the call as being upgraded to Emergency Group Call (emergency group call state = "MEGC 3: emergency-call-granted").

question_55393.question: What is the function of the Service Registration feature in ework?
question_55393.ground_truth: The Service Registration feature enables non-framework service capability features to register with the Framework, allowing authorized applications to discover available non-framework service capability features.

question_55395.question: What should the SM entity do when it receives the RABMSM-MODIFY-IND primitive from the RABM entity to indicate the change of the QoS for an NSAPI?
question_55395.ground_truth: The SM entity should adjust the QoS for the corresponding PDP context and inform the RABM entity that the indicated NSAPI and QoS profile are now in use with the RABMSM-MODIFY-RSP primitive.

question_55396.question: What is the applicability of the requirements for Relative Code Domain Error when 16QAM is used on any of the UL code channels?
question_55396.ground_truth: The requirements for Relative Code Domain Error do not apply when the ECDP of any code channel is less than -30dB or the nominal code domain power of any code channel is less than -30dB.

question_55397.question: What is the purpose of the start of MBMS bearer context chargeable event?
question_55397.ground_truth: The start of MBMS bearer context chargeable event is used to create a new CDR for the MBMS bearer context and capture the data volume for it.

question_55398.question: What should the UE not transmit on the union of restricted serving cell symbols due to SS-RSRQ measurement on an FR2 inter-frequency cell without MG and NCSG?

question_55399.question: Which 5G specifications focus on stage-3 protocols for the MBS distribution methods based on existing MBMS delivery methods, addressing reference point M4?

question_55400.question: Which solution, for inter-provider charging for 5GS capabilities usage, is the most feasible and preferrable as per the evaluation in clause 7.1.5.3?

question_55403.question: What is the main function of the IPcon distribution function of the MCData server?
question_55403.ground_truth: The IPcon distribution function of the MCData server is responsible for the distribution of IP Data to MCData communication participants, including the reception and replication of uplink IP Data, distribution of downlink data using unicast and multicast transport, and applying necessary policy for IP Data transaction.

question_55404.question: What is the name of the network element located in the BBF domain in Architecture scenario B?

question_55405.question: What is the maximum time duration for T1?
question_55405.ground_truth: The maximum time duration for T1 is 27 seconds.

question_55406.question: What network element is responsible for detecting congestion in the RAN?

question_55407.question: What is the performance difference in capacity between legacy BSR and enhanced BSR for FR1, Dense Urban, UL, AR (1 stream: Scene/video/data/voice-stream), 10Mbps, 60FPS, 30ms PDB, with DDDSU, SU-MIMO?
question_55407.ground_truth: The capacity performance is increased from 7 UEs per cell with legacy BSR to 8.4 UEs per cell with enhanced BSR, a 20% improvement.

question_55410.question: In what scenario would the Modify Bearer Request message not include any Bearer Contexts during a Tracking/Routeing Area Update procedure?
question_55410.ground_truth: When the Modify Bearer Request message is sent from the old MME/SGSN as part of a Tracking/Routeing Area Update procedure with SGW change and data forwarding, it should only include the Bearer Contexts to be modified. Since the UE has left the old MME/SGSN, other information related to the UE, such as ULI or UE Time Zone, is no longer valid.

question_55411.question: What are the restrictions on scheduling availability for a UE with different subcarrier spacing than PDSCH/PDCCH for RLM?
question_55411.ground_truth: If a UE performs RLM with different subcarrier spacing than PDSCH/PDCCH, there are restrictions on scheduling availability, such as no PUCCH, PUSCH, SRS, PDCCH, PDSCH, or CSI-RS for tracking or CQI on SSB symbols to be measured for radio link monitoring.

question_55412.question: What is the power backoff that is required for a 5 timeslot allocation in the uplink as compared to 4 timeslots?
question_55412.ground_truth: For a 5 timeslot allocation in the uplink, a 7dB backoff from maximum power is required as compared to a 6dB backoff for 4 timeslots.

question_55413.question: What is the role of the MCPTT gateway server as specified in 7.4.2.3.8?
question_55413.ground_truth: The MCPTT gateway server provides support for MCPTT interconnection services with a partner MCPTT system in a different trust domain whilst providing topology hiding. It acts as a proxy for one or more MCPTT servers in the partner MCPTT system without needing to expose the MCPTT servers in the primary MCPTT system outside the trusted domain of the primary MCPTT system.

question_55414.question: What is the normative reference for the minimum conformance requirements in clause 6.4.1.0.1?
question_55414.ground_truth: The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 clause A.6.4.1.1.

question_55415.question: In the scenario described in section 11a, what is required for the event "Deactivation" to be considered a success?
question_55415.ground_truth: The last CSI report must be received by the SS earlier than or equal to subframe (n+8), DTX should not be observed outside the specified subframes, and at most 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes should be observed within two specific subframe ranges.

question_55416.question: What RFC document could be potentially utilized for the transfer of the STN?
question_55416.ground_truth: RFC 4483 could be potentially utilized for the transfer of the STN.

question_55417.question: When does the SMF indicate the target access type in step 3a of Network Triggered Service Request?
question_55417.ground_truth: The SMF indicates the access type (3GPP access or non-3GPP access) over which the user plane resources are to be activated for the MA PDU Session in step 3a of Network Triggered Service Request.

question_55418.question: How does the UE determine if a PLMN can accept Disaster Inbound Roamers?
question_55418.ground_truth: The UE determines if a PLMN can accept Disaster Inbound Roamers by checking if the PLMN is in the DRS-supported PLMN list and if the PLMN's NG-RAN cell broadcasts the "disaster roaming PLMN list" including the PLMN ID of the PLMN D.

question_55420.question: What are the requirements for using IMS AKA keys for media protection over the access network?
question_55420.ground_truth: The requirements include securing media between the IMS UE and a protection endpoint, using existing shared secret keys for SA establishment, protecting RTP and MSRP traffic, controlling the use of protection mechanism by the IMS operator, and controlling protection mechanism using SIP signaling.

question_55421.question: What is the role of the NRM client when it indicates to the NRM server that the VAL UE is able to receive VAL service communication over MBMS?
question_55421.ground_truth: The NRM client shares the MBMS bearer related information with the VAL client and indicates to the NRM server that the VAL UE is able to receive VAL service communication over MBMS. The NRM server may decide to use the MBMS bearer instead of unicast bearer for VAL service communication sessions based on available information.

question_55423.question: What happens to the payload in uplink TBF retransmissions when the RESEGMENT bit is set to '1'?

question_55425.question: What will the V-PCRF do when it receives an AAR command for the establishment of the AF signalling session from the V-AF and is not required to forward the message to the H-PCRF?
question_55425.ground_truth: The V-PCRF will handle the AF signalling session locally and acknowledge the AAR command by sending an AAA command to the V-AF.

question_55426.question: What action does MCPTT user 2 need to take in manual commencement mode to accept a private call request?
question_55426.ground_truth: MCPTT user 2 needs to take some action to accept the private call request via the user interface in manual commencement mode.

question_55427.question: What information is allocated for the target 5G ProSe Layer-3 End UE if IP traffic is used in 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Communication?
question_55427.ground_truth: IPv6 prefix or IPv4 address is allocated for the target 5G ProSe Layer-3 End UE

question_55428.question: What is the purpose of the "establishment of the secure connection" in the 3GPP's GAN technical specification?
question_55428.ground_truth: The "establishment of the secure connection" refers to the process by which the MS and GANC-SEGW set up an IPsec tunnel for secure communication. This includes the use of EAP-SIM or EAP-AKA for mutual authentication of the MS and the core network, and the negotiation of Traffic Selectors (TS) for securing the communication.

question_55430.question: How is PCF notified of the power mode information in QoS adjustment?
question_55430.ground_truth: The power mode information can be carried by the PDU session establishment/modification procedure and SM policy association establishment/modification procedure via NAS signalling or by informing AF of the power mode info, and then the AF sends the power mode info to PCF directly or via NEF.

question_55432.question: What condition can be used for handling RTCP traffic?
question_55432.ground_truth: PCC Rules are able to specify rules for mapping RTCP packets per Application ID with existing architecture, and an RTCP header parsing information can also be specified to map RTCP packets to a different QoS Flow. Additionally, if AF does not want to use Application ID linked packet filters to identify RTCP flows, there needs to be a support for additional fields in the IP packet filter set to handle RTCP traffic.

question_55433.question: What should a mobile station do, when it is in an uplink TBF operating in extended uplink TBF mode and the RLC entity of the mobile station receives new data from upper layers for transmission in the uplink TBF, before it sends an RLC data block with CV=0?
question_55433.ground_truth: The mobile station shall recalculate the CV when a new PDU is received from upper layers before it has sent an RLC data block with CV=0.

question_55434.question: What is the action taken by UEs when close to the timeout of the service time of the MBSR?
question_55434.ground_truth: When close to the timeout of the service time of the MBSR, the UEs start the cell reselection and perform the re-establishment procedure to continue the services.

question_55436.question: In what circumstances is a delivery report sent in this process?
question_55436.ground_truth: A delivery report is sent if the Delivery status requested information element is included in the MSGin5G Broadcast message and the message is received by a recipient MSGin5G UE.

question_55437.question: What entity is responsible for retrieving the cryptographic verification key of socialnet.com to verify the received token when the eP-CSCF is processing a REGISTER request?

question_55438.question: What is one of the input parameters for Intent driven MnS Producer when executing a CSIatEdge intent?
question_55438.ground_truth: The input parameters for Intent driven MnS Producer include service type, service requirements, service availability, and edge identification information.

question_55439.question: In case k) in subclause~5.4.5.2.1, what should the UE do if it has multiple payloads?
question_55439.ground_truth: In case k) in subclause~5.4.5.2.1, the UE shall set the Payload container type IE to "Multiple payloads", and set each payload container entry in the Payload container IE as specified in cases a) to j) above.

question_55440.question: What is the maximum input level requirement for E-UTRA and NR single carrier and CA operation that applies to inter-band EN-DC including FR2, as specified in section 7.4B.4 of the document?
question_55440.ground_truth: The maximum input level requirement for E-UTRA single carrier and CA operation specified in clauses 7.4.1 and 7.4.1A of TS 36.101 and for NR single carrier and CA operation specified in clauses 7.4, 7.4A and 7.4B of TS~38.101-2 apply.

question_55441.question: What video codec and audio codec are required for sharing videos on WhatsApp?
question_55441.ground_truth: H.264/AVC video codec and AAC audio codec are needed today for sharing videos on WhatsApp.

question_55442.question: What should the mobile station do if the Facility IE is encoded as "simple recall alignment" in the CC_ESTABLISHMENT message?
question_55442.ground_truth: The mobile station shall copy the Facility IE and SS Version IE from the set-up container to the SETUP message without verifying or modifying the contents of these information elements.

question_55443.question: What HTTP methods are supported for the "Data Storages" resource?
question_55443.ground_truth: This resource supports the GET and POST HTTP methods.

question_55444.question: What action should the MGCF take when it receives an initial INVITE request with Supported header field indicating "100rel" for calls terminating in circuit-switched networks?
question_55444.ground_truth: The MGCF should store the fe-identifier header field parameter of the P-Charging-Vector header field, store the value of the orig-ioi header field parameter received in the P-Charging-Vector header field, send a 100 (Trying) response, send a 183 "Session Progress" response after a matching codec is found or no codec is required at the MGW, set the Require header field to the value of "100rel", and insert a P-Charging-Vector header field in the response with necessary parameters.

question_55445.question: What procedure must the MRFC follow after receiving the SIP 200 OK final response (or 18x provisional response) with the SDP answer from the IMS UE-B?
question_55445.ground_truth: The MRFC must extract the key management data from the keymgmt-data field, base64 decode it to reconstruct the original TRANSFER-RESP message, verify the TRANSFER-RESP message, and verify that the authenticated identity of the recipient corresponds to the policy for the call before completing the media security set-up.

question_55446.question: What is the degradation in Top-1 beam prediction accuracy for DL Tx beam prediction, when considering independent measurement errors for all Tx beams with a 1 dB margin, compared to the one without measurement error for Set B/Set A being 1/2 and 1/4 respectively?
question_55446.ground_truth: The performance degradation is 10% and 20% for Set B/Set A being 1/2 and 1/4, respectively.

question_55447.question: When might the AMF remove the additional S-NSSAI from the PDU session?
question_55447.ground_truth: The AMF removes the additional S-NSSAI from the PDU session when it detects that the originally requested S-NSSAI is not congested.

question_55448.question: What is the requirement for the final power step adjacent to the Min or Max power threshold for test?
question_55448.ground_truth: The lower step size requirement does not apply for the final power step adjacent to the Min or Max power threshold for test.

question_55449.question: What is the main focus of the evaluation in clause 6.1.5.1, 6.1.5.2, and 6.1.5.3?
question_55449.ground_truth: The main focus of the evaluation in clause 6.1.5.1 is end user charging for PNI-NPN network usage of access, while in clause 6.1.5.2 is converged charging for number of UEs and in clause 6.1.5.3 is converged charging for number of PDU sessions.

question_55450.question: What is the meaning of "may" in the 3GPP technical specifications?
question_55450.ground_truth: "May" in 3GPP technical specifications indicates permission to do something.

question_55451.question: Which TS (Technical Specification) clause specifies the network's possible actions when resuming a suspended RRC connection?

question_55453.question: What does the new SGSN do after updating the PDP context fields?
question_55453.ground_truth: The new SGSN sends an Update PDP Context Response (TEID) message to the GGSN to receive new incoming downlink IP packets.

question_55456.question: What should the MC client do with the MBMS suspension report after receiving it from the MC gateway UE?
question_55456.ground_truth: The MC client can decide to send the MBMS bearer suspension report to the MC service server only if instructed by the MC service server.

question_55457.question: What is the purpose of the REFER request in the context of SIP sessions?
question_55457.ground_truth: The REFER request is used to invite another user to a SIP session, specifically in the context of joining two or more active sessions to a three-way session.

question_55460.question: What happens if the GPI corresponds to an already existing NAF SA?
question_55460.ground_truth: The UE will not invoke a UICC application, but silently drop the GPI and terminate the GPI processing.

question_55461.question: What message is sent by the AMF to the UE upon a successful deregistration, except when the deregistration type is switch-off?
question_55461.ground_truth: The Deregistration Accept message is not sent.

question_55462.question: What is the interruption time for a UE not requiring idle intervals and measurement occasions in GSM?
question_55462.ground_truth: The interruption time for a UE not requiring idle intervals and measurement occasions in GSM is 480 ms.

question_55463.question: What is one challenge associated with reverse intermodulation in dual carrier RF?
question_55463.ground_truth: One challenge associated with reverse intermodulation is the need for good isolation between transmitters to avoid intermodulation products. With 40 dB of isolation, it is possible to obtain about -70 dBc IMD levels, but this is not trivial.

question_55464.question: What should the network use as a minimum packet size for a PDU Session type Unstructured in both uplink and downlink?
question_55464.ground_truth: The network shall use a maximum packet size of at least 128 octets for a PDU Session type Unstructured in both uplink and downlink.

question_55465.question: What is the impact of the TIR service on the TIP service in 4.6.2 and 4.6.3?
question_55465.ground_truth: The TIR service usually takes precedence over the TIP service. However, the TIP service can take precedence over the TIR service if the originating user has an override category. This is a national matter and is outside the scope of the present document.

question_55468.question: Under what condition should the CatFindNthTLV function return the pointer to the found TLV in the proactive command buffer?
question_55468.ground_truth: The function should return the pointer when the occurrence argument is 1 (first) and the Tag argument is the TLV tag being searched for.

question_55469.question: What is the method to support PS for SA PDU session between Trusted and Untrusted N3GPP access without changing RAT type?
question_55469.ground_truth: It is recommended to select a solution that supports PS for SA PDU session between Trusted and Untrusted N3GPP access without changing RAT type for seamless communication and mobility.

question_55470.question: What is the purpose of the IF Side Initiated Radio Access Bearer Establishment operations?
question_55470.ground_truth: The IF Side Initiated Radio Access Bearer Establishment operations allow the transfer of control messages for radio access bearer establishment between non-access strata elements on each side of the access interface, initiating a radio access bearer and requesting transmission resource allocation.

question_55471.question: How many strongest BCCH carriers of the GSM cells does the UE need to continuously attempt to decode the BSIC in one measurement gap?
question_55471.ground_truth: The UE shall continuously attempt to decode the BSIC of SCH on the BCCH carrier of the 8 strongest BCCH carriers of the GSM cells indicated in the Inter-RAT cell info list.

question_55472.question: What does the MSGin5G Server do with the UE Service ID and associated MSGin5G Client Profile upon successful registration of a MSGin5G UE?
question_55472.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server stores the UE Service ID and associated MSGin5G Client Profile.

question_55473.question: What is the definition of the Calling Line Identification Restriction (CLIR) Supplementary Service?
question_55473.ground_truth: The CLIR Supplementary Service enables the calling party to prevent presentation of its line identity to the called party.

question_55476.question: What support indication does the NEF forward to the AF regarding alternative QoS profiles?
question_55476.ground_truth: The NEF forwards the received support indication to the AF when TSCTSF or the PCF supports alternative QoS profiles.

question_55477.question: When is the DMRS sequence initialization set to 1 bit?
question_55477.ground_truth: The DMRS sequence initialization is set to 1 bit when transform precoder is disabled by higher layers or if the Transform precoder indicator field is present.

question_55478.question: What geographical areas may be associated with NR-PC5 unicast security policies as per 3GPP TS 33.185?
question_55478.ground_truth: The NR-PC5 unicast security policies are associated with one or more geographical areas where the NR-PC5 unicast security policy applies.

question_55479.question: In what network operation mode~I should the MS initiate the periodic location update procedure immediately after being IMSI-attached to a network?

question_55480.question: What should be the minimum rate of correct events observed during repeated tests for the UE to pass the test?

question_55482.question: What is the RRC re-establishment delay without serving cell timing?
question_55482.ground_truth: The RRC re-establishment delay is defined as the time from the start of time period T3, to the moment when the UE starts to send PRACH preambles to cell 2 for sending the RRCReestablishmentRequest message to cell 2. The RRC re-establishment delay to an unknown NR intra frequency cell without serving cell timing shall be less than 5 s.

question_55483.question: What are the main processes involved in the centralized energy saving process within an energy efficiency management group?
question_55483.ground_truth: The main processes involved in the centralized energy saving process within an energy efficiency management group are monitoring, analysis, decision, execution, and evaluation.

question_55484.question: What is the adjustment of scaling done prior to performing the flip-and-decimate-by-4 operation for signals with relatively higher energy in the high band in the fixed point operation?
question_55484.ground_truth: A headroom of 3 bits is provided prior to decimation to avoid any saturation in the decimation operation.

question_55486.question: If the Serving GW receives additional downlink data packets before the expiry of the timer, what action does it take?
question_55486.ground_truth: The Serving GW does not restart this timer and continues to buffer the downlink data.

question_55487.question: What is the purpose of using redundancy in accordance with the requirements and recommendations defined in clause 9 when high packet loss rates are encountered?
question_55487.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure that the quality of the media data is maintained even in the presence of packet loss.

question_55490.question: After successful bootstrapping procedure, what do the UE and the BSF contain?
question_55490.ground_truth: After the successful bootstrapping procedure, the UE and the BSF both contain the key material (Ks) and the B-TID. The BSF also contains a set of security-specific attributes related to the UE.

question_55491.question: What should a WT include in a WT STATUS REPORT message for each BSS?
question_55491.ground_truth: The BSS Load IE, the WAN Metrics IE, and the Available Channel Utilization IE, if the corresponding bits are set in the Report Characteristics IE included in the WT STATUS REQUEST message

question_55494.question: What is the duration of DL PRS symbols in ms corresponding to "ppw-durationOfPRS-ProcessingSymbolsN" or "ppw-durationOfPRS-ProcessingSymbolsN2" in TS 37.355?
question_55494.ground_truth: DL PRS symbols duration in ms corresponds to the "ppw-durationOfPRS-ProcessingSymbolsN" if positioning frequency layer i is in Case 1, and to "ppw-durationOfPRS-ProcessingSymbolsN2" if positioning frequency layer i is in Case 2.

question_55495.question: What is the maximum allowed TIU in NR to UTRAN handover?
question_55495.ground_truth: TIU can be up to one UTRA frame (10 ms).

question_55497.question: Are there any data framing requirements for the WebRTC Web Server Function (WWSF)?
question_55497.ground_truth: No, there are no data framing requirements for the WWSF.

question_55498.question: What should the UE include in the Via header field for an emergency request's response, if the UE receives incoming requests via UDP?
question_55498.ground_truth: The UE shall include the IP address of the UE in the sent-by field and the unprotected server port value where the UE will receive the response in the top Via header field. The UE shall also include a "rport" header field parameter with no value in the top Via header field for UDP.

question_55499.question: What NAS messages are used to carry the "UE application trigger request" notification and its acknowledgement for LTE access?
question_55499.ground_truth: The DOWNLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message and the UPLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message with a Generic message container type IE set to a specific value for the transfer of "UE application trigger request" and with the Generic message container IE containing the "UE application trigger request" information are used for LTE access.

question_55500.question: What is the main purpose of repeating steps b) to d) with different fading conditions and hopping modes?
question_55500.ground_truth: To test the MS's performance under different channel conditions

question_55502.question: What is the role of the broker in the brokered notification pattern?
question_55502.ground_truth: In the brokered notification pattern, the broker's role is to filter and disseminate all the notifications produced by the publisher.

question_55503.question: What are the two main areas of enhancements investigated in the technical report?
question_55503.ground_truth: The two main areas of enhancements investigated in the technical report are Signalling Overhead Reduction and UE Power Consumption.

question_55504.question: What is the responsibility of the gateway server in the migration service authorization process?
question_55504.ground_truth: The gateway server forwards migration requests and responses between the primary MC system and the partner MC system.

question_55505.question: Who needs to be considered in the paging area management requirements?
question_55505.ground_truth: The paging area management requirements need to consider no-mobility UEs and low-mobility UEs, as limiting paging areas is beneficial for both groups. This is because low-mobility UEs will not move over a wide range of area in a given time.

question_55506.question: When does a UE not expect to multiplex in a Type-2 HARQ-ACK codebook HARQ-ACK information that is in response to a detection of a DCI format that does not include a counter DAI field?
question_55506.ground_truth: A UE does not expect to multiplex in a Type-2 HARQ-ACK codebook HARQ-ACK information that is in response to a detection of a DCI format that does not include a counter DAI field.

question_55507.question: What percentage of the increase in transmission and distribution network lines is attributed to the rise of renewable energy?
question_55507.ground_truth: Around 30% of the increase in transmission lines and 20% of the increase in distribution network lines are due to the increase of renewables.

question_55508.question: What would the MAC entity do if there are no valid PUCCH resources for pending SR triggers due to the SL-PRS resource colliding with PUCCH resources for other SR triggers?
question_55508.ground_truth: If there are no valid PUCCH resources for pending SR triggers due to the SL-PRS resource colliding with PUCCH resources for other SR triggers, the MAC entity would leave the selection of which PUCCH resource to signal the SR on to UE implementation.

question_55509.question: When should a UE transmit MsgA PRACH in association with a contention-free Random Access Preamble for beam failure recovery request?
question_55509.ground_truth: The UE should transmit MsgA PRACH on the next available PRACH occasion from the PRACH occasions corresponding to the selected SSB permitted by the given restrictions, and randomly select the PRACH preamble and occasion amongst the associated PRACH occasions occurring simultaneously but on different subcarriers.

question_55510.question: What is the purpose of studying the procedures and service continuity enhancements for UEs served by the mobile base station relay in the case of mobility within the same IAB-donor gNB and mobility between different IAB-donor gNBs?
question_55510.ground_truth: The purpose is to efficiently deliver data to UEs by enhancing current procedures of mobility and service continuity. The study should consider the cell information change and handover requirements, as well as efficient mobility and service continuity.

question_55512.question: What is the purpose of the PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP CALL command in the test description?
question_55512.ground_truth: The PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP CALL command is used to simulate a set up call proactive command, which is a command from the SIM to the ME to set up a call.

question_55513.question: What is the significance of the version number x.y.z of the 3GPP technical specifications?
question_55513.ground_truth: The first digit denotes the stage of the document's approval in the TSG, the second digit indicates technical enhancements, corrections or updates, and the third digit signifies editorial changes.

question_55514.question: What are the main properties of the Full MBMS service mode in the IP-based mode of the pass-through system?
question_55514.ground_truth: The main properties of the Full MBMS service mode include the ability to reuse existing 3GPP service layer for consumption of the media and the Content Provider offers the service conforming to 3GPP TV services, where the DASH Server and DASH client comply with the 3GPP DASH formats as defined in TS 26.247.

question_55515.question: What triggers priority handling of paging in times of congestion at the (R)AN?
question_55515.ground_truth: The inclusion of the "Paging Priority" in the N2 "Paging" message

question_55516.question: What modulation techniques are used for the current EGPRS coding schemes?
question_55516.ground_truth: 8-PSK, 16-QAM and 32-QAM modulations are used for the current EGPRS coding schemes.

question_55517.question: What extra signalling is introduced in the network with Solution 2 for PGW failure when ISR is active?
question_55517.ground_truth: Solution 2 for PGW failure when ISR is active introduces extra signalling over S3 to request the ISR associated mobility management node to select the same SGW to maintain ISR activated for each affected UEs due to SGW Partial failure, over S3 to request the ISR associated mobility management node to remove UE context when UE has moved to another MME or S4-SGSN, and over S3 to allow the MME inform the ISR associated node S4-SGSN about the SGW partial failure.

question_55518.question: What information does the TWAN-S2a-Failure-Cause AVP contain in case of S2a connectivity establishment failure?
question_55518.ground_truth: The TWAN-S2a-Failure-Cause AVP contains a 32-bit cause value field that indicates the cause of S2a connectivity establishment failure to the 3GPP AAA Server by the TWAN.

question_55519.question: What message does the SS send to indicate a failure in the cell change procedure?
question_55519.ground_truth: The SS sends a PACKET CELL CHANGE FAILURE message to indicate a failure in the cell change procedure.

question_55520.question: What must be included in the "Positioning Methods" if the UE wants to perform GANSS measurements on multiple GANSS frequencies?
question_55520.ground_truth: "GANSS Multi-frequency Measurement Requested" IE with a supported GANSS and one of its signals measured.

question_55521.question: In the acknowledged mode data, what is the maximum RLC PDU size allowed when using "Flexible RLC PDU size"?
question_55521.ground_truth: The maximum size of the data field of the RLC PDU is 1503 octets when using "Flexible RLC PDU size".

question_55522.question: In what ways can the network autonomy be implemented in different management scopes?
question_55522.ground_truth: The network autonomy can be implemented in different management scopes, including autonomy in NE layer, autonomy in domain layer, autonomy in cross domain layer, and autonomy in communication service layer.

question_55523.question: What is the applicability of Wide Area operating band unwanted emission requirements for a TAB connector operating in Band Category 2?
question_55523.ground_truth: The requirements apply outside the Base Station RF Bandwidth edges and inside any sub-block gap for a TAB connector operating in Band Category 2.

question_55524.question: What is the ICID and what is its role in the IM CN subsystem?
question_55524.ground_truth: The ICID (IM CN subsystem charging identifier) is a session-level data shared among entities in the IM CN subsystem. It is used for the correlation between SIP transactions and CDRs.

question_55525.question: What does the HSS do in step 2 when performing Location Information Retrieval in the 5GC network?
question_55525.ground_truth: The HSS contacts the MME and/or SGSN to retrieve location information.

question_55526.question: What is the purpose of the procedure in 4.5A.4?
question_55526.ground_truth: The purpose of the procedure in 4.5A.4 is to allow the successful completion of IMS signalling.

question_55527.question: How many service level groups are defined in TS 22.261 for V2X high accuracy positioning requirements?
question_55527.ground_truth: Seven service level groups are defined in TS 22.261 for V2X high accuracy positioning requirements: Service level 1 to Service level 7.

question_55528.question: What is the difference between Stand-alone Non-Public Networks (SNPN) and Public Network Integrated NPNs?
question_55528.ground_truth: Stand-alone Non-Public Networks (SNPN) are operated independently and do not rely on network functions provided by a PLMN, while Public Network Integrated NPNs rely on the support of a PLMN.

question_55530.question: What exception is thrown by the array manipulation methods if there is an attempt to access an element outside of the array's bounds?

question_55531.question: What is the purpose of the signServiceAgreement() method in the framework?
question_55531.ground_truth: The signServiceAgreement() method is used by the client application to sign an agreement on the service. It is used as a way of non-repudiation of the intention to use the service by the client application.

question_55532.question: What happens when the location information of the location management client 1 is available in the location management server?
question_55532.ground_truth: A location information report is sent to the location management client 2 or VAL server.

question_55534.question: What are the reference points of the EPC-level Discovery ProSe Function?
question_55534.ground_truth: The EPC-level Discovery ProSe Function has reference points towards the Application Server (PC2), towards other ProSe Functions (PC6), towards the HSS (PC4a), and towards the UE (PC3).

question_55535.question: What action should the UE take if the network sends a PDN session establishment failure due to reaching the maximum number of PDU sessions?
question_55535.ground_truth: The UE needs to release an established PDU session to establish a new PDU session.

question_55537.question: Which SCCP primitives are necessary for the E1 interface?
question_55537.ground_truth: The necessary SCCP primitives for the E1 interface are those specified in ITU-T Recommendations Q.711, Q.712, Q.713 and Q.714.

question_55538.question: What is the initial version of an operator's Specialized Information Model (SpIM) created from?
question_55538.ground_truth: The initial version of an operator's Specialized Information Model (SpIM) is generated through operator-specific specialization of CBIM, such as through definition of operator-specific end-user groupings.

question_55539.question: What is the complex type name for describing a private call on a network?

question_55540.question: What is the name of the "special cell" in the LTE-Advanced system that provides security input and NAS mobility information?
question_55540.ground_truth: The "special cell" is a term used to describe the cell in the LTE-Advanced system that provides specific security input and NAS mobility information, such as one ECGI, one PCI, and one ARFCN, to the user equipment (UE).

question_55541.question: What is the definition of the performance requirement for PUSCH in terms of SNR and throughput?
question_55541.ground_truth: The performance requirement of PUSCH is determined by a minimum required throughput for a given SNR, expressed as a fraction of maximum throughput for the FRCs listed in annex A, assuming HARQ re-transmissions.

question_55542.question: What action is taken by the MRFC to inform the AS-hA1 that the announcement is terminated?
question_55542.ground_truth: The MRFC interacts with the MRFP to inform it that the announcement is terminated.

question_55543.question: What is the functionality of the lawful interception (LI) entities in EPS nodes for Evolved Packet System?
question_55543.ground_truth: The LI functional entities (ADMF, DF, MF, LEMF) are responsible for lawful interception in EPS nodes.

question_55545.question: What is the purpose of the Queued Floor Requests message when it is a response to the cancellation of a queued floor request originated by a floor participant?
question_55545.ground_truth: The purpose of the Queued Floor Requests message is to specify the request made by the floor participant to the floor control server.

question_55546.question: What should the transmission participant do upon receiving a Transmission end response message with the first bit in the subtype of the Transmission end response message set to '1'?
question_55546.ground_truth: The transmission participant should send a Transmission control Ack message, provide a Transmission end notification to the MCVideo user if desired, stop timer T101, and enter the 'U: has no permission to transmit' state.

question_55548.question: What shall be the MS's response when the SS sends M bits of start polarity and 2M bits of stop polarity over the R-interface for 1 second?
question_55548.ground_truth: The MS shall correctly receive and interpret the M bits of start polarity and 2M bits of stop polarity over the R-interface in accordance with the specified test requirements.

question_55550.question: What is the term used for providing per call basis changes to the supplementary service CUG?

question_55551.question: What is the difference between the PTP port states when using a Boundary Clock and when it operates as a Transparent Clock?
question_55551.ground_truth: When the 5GS operates as a Boundary Clock, it maintains the PTP port states and uses the port number of the ingress DS-TT and domainNumber and sdoId in the received PTP message to assign the PTP message to a PTP instance in the NW-TT. However, when the 5GS operates as a Transparent Clock, it does not maintain the PTP port states, and the ingress PTP messages received on a PTP Port are retransmitted on all other PTP Ports of the Transparent Clock subject to the rules of the underlying transport protocol.

question_55552.question: What does the term "RX antennas" refer to in the context of radiated performance requirements description for a BS?
question_55552.ground_truth: In the context of radiated performance requirements for a BS, the term "RX antennas" refers to the demodulation branches (i.e. not physical antennas of the antenna array).

question_55553.question: How is the integrity of the NF profile protected in the modified NF Service Registration procedure with remote attestation?
question_55553.ground_truth: The integrity of the NF profile is protected by using digital signatures in the registration request by the VNF. The NF profile is signed by the OAM, NFV MANO, or an authorized delegate when the VNF instance is provisioned and instantiated on the NFVI.

question_55554.question: What is the role of the 6.3.2.4.1.x clauses in the 6.3.2.4.2 clause?
question_55554.ground_truth: The 6.3.2.4.1.x clauses are used to determine QACK, Q'CSI,1, Q'CSI,2, and Q'CSI,0 for HARQ-ACK, CSI part 1, CSI part 2, and CG-UCI transmission on PUSCH. These Q values are used in the rate matching output sequence length formula for HARQ-ACK and CSI transmission on PUSCH in 6.3.2.4.1 and 6.3.2.4.1.x clauses.

question_55556.question: What action should the UE take when activating a 5G NAS security context during a security mode control procedure?
question_55556.ground_truth: If the UE is activating a 5G NAS security context resulting from a security mode control procedure, it should send a SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message with the entire REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

question_55557.question: What information does the MC service server (controlling role) inform all participating MC service servers about?
question_55557.ground_truth: The MC service server (controlling role) informs all participating MC service servers about which service areas will receive multicast and the associated information such as TMGIs.

question_55558.question: When should the "phone-context" parameter be set to the home network domain name preceded by the string "geo-local"?
question_55558.ground_truth: The "phone-context" parameter should be set to the home network domain name preceded by the string "geo-local" if the access network information is not available in the UE.

question_55559.question: What should the MAC entity do if a fallbackRAR is received during the RACH procedure with contention resolution?
question_55559.ground_truth: If the MAC entity receives a fallbackRAR during the RACH procedure with contention resolution, it must transmit a MSG3 using the UL grant scheduled in the fallbackRAR.

question_55560.question: What should the MS do after a successful location update and being in the "idle, updated" state, if it is an R97/R98 MS that supports speech?
question_55560.ground_truth: The MS should send a CHANNEL REQUEST message with correct establishment cause "emergency call".

question_55561.question: What is a requirement for point-to-point delivery verification in MBMS user services?
question_55561.ground_truth: A potential requirement for point-to-point delivery verification for delivered content is one characteristic of service examples in MBMS user services.

question_55562.question: What are the mechanisms that can be used to trigger service announcements in MBMS?
question_55562.ground_truth: The mechanisms include MBMS bearer capabilities, PUSH mechanism (WAP push), URL (WAP, HTTP), SMS (point-to-point), and SMS-CB cell broadcast.

question_55564.question: What are the two types of session keys to be considered for group message protection in MTC architecture?
question_55564.ground_truth: The two types of session keys to be considered are individual session keys per UE in the group and a same group session key for all UEs in the group.

question_55565.question: What type of command is used in the 3.1.1 proactive SIM command?

question_55566.question: What is the purpose of the AlarmIRP class in the document?
question_55566.ground_truth: The AlarmIRP class in the document represents the alarm management capabilities specified by the document and inherits attributes from the ManagedGenericIRP class.

question_55567.question: What is the purpose of providing Discovery Codes (DC) and Discovery Filters (DF) in 5G Direct Discovery using Model A?
question_55567.ground_truth: The purpose of providing DC and DF in 5G Direct Discovery using Model A is that the Announcing UE can broadcast its presence and ProSe application using DC, while Monitoring UEs can recognize and identify the Announcing UE using DF.

question_55568.question: What is the purpose of the Reference Time Information Report procedure?
question_55568.ground_truth: The purpose of the Reference Time Information Report procedure is to report accurate reference time information from the gNB-DU to the gNB-CU using non-UE associated signaling.

question_55570.question: What should the en-gNB consider a valid value for UL and DL Coordination Information IE, unless it receives a new update for the same UE?
question_55570.ground_truth: The en-gNB should consider the received UL Coordination Information IE value valid until reception of a new update of the IE for the same UE. The same applies to the DL Coordination Information IE.

question_55571.question: What is included in the 5G ProSe direct link context for UE-to-network relay?
question_55571.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe direct link context for UE-to-network relay includes user info ID and layer-2 ID of the 5G ProSe remote UE and the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE, relay service code, and in the case of Layer-3 UE-to-network relay, the network layer protocol and PC5 QoS flow information.

question_55572.question: What is the main challenge with radio propagation in a rail environment?
question_55572.ground_truth: The main challenge is the wide range of conditions, such as high train speed, train movement, and different locations (e.g. tunnels, stations, shunting yards) that can affect wireless communication.

question_55573.question: What is the structure of the 5G-S-TMSI in relation to the GUTI and 5GS-TMSI?
question_55573.ground_truth: The 5G-S-TMSI is constructed from the AMF Set ID, the AMF Pointer and the 5GS-TMSI. It is a shortened form of the 5GS-GUTI, used for radio signalling procedures such as paging and Service Request.

question_55574.question: What global standards organization develops the 3GPP technical specifications, which include the E-UTRAN NRM IRP specifications?
question_55574.ground_truth: The 3GPP technical specifications are developed by the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP), a global organization that brings together telecommunications standards associations for the creation of specifications for mobile telecommunications.

question_55576.question: What is the role of the NAS Registration Request message during the initial registration process for the FN-RG?
question_55576.ground_truth: The NAS Registration Request message contains the SUCI or 5G-GUTI of the FN-RG, security parameters/UE security capability, UE MM Core Network Capability, PDU Session Status, Follow-on request, and Requested NSSAI.

question_55578.question: What element and attribute are used in the MIME body indicating per-group dynamic data to indicate an MCVideo client's interest in a particular MCVideo group?

question_55579.question: What is the primary aim of the Tandem Free Operation (TFO) feature?
question_55579.ground_truth: The primary aim of the TFO feature is to realize improvements in speech quality by avoiding tandeming speech codecs in mobile to mobile speech calls.

question_55580.question: What is the name of the method that lists all client applications belonging to an enterprise operator?

question_55581.question: What is the state of the UE at the end of the preamble stage of the test procedure?
question_55581.ground_truth: The UE is in E-UTRA Registered, Idle Mode state, and the MCPTT Client Application has been activated with the User registered-in as the MCPTT User with the Server as active user at the Client.

question_55582.question: What is the purpose of the half rate speech processing functions in the GSM system?
question_55582.ground_truth: The half rate speech processing functions in the GSM system are responsible for the speech processing functions in the half-rate channel, which includes speech transcoding, Discontinuous Transmission (DTX), Voice Activity Detector (VAD), and comfort noise aspects.

question_55584.question: What is the P-Charging-Vector header used for in IMS networks?
question_55584.ground_truth: The P-Charging-Vector header is used to include the ICID and is included in all SIP methods. This header allows charging data to be correlated between different IMS elements.

question_55585.question: What network entity is responsible for supporting the transfer of short messages between the Service Centre and mobile stations in GSM/UMTS/EPS networks?

question_55588.question: What should the UE do if the 5GSM cause value is #50 "PDU session type IPv4 only allowed" in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message and the UE receives a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT COMAND message later without an DNN and with a request type different from "initial emergency request"?
question_55588.ground_truth: The UE shall not send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message without an DNN and with request type different from "initial emergency request" until the PDU session is released.

question_55589.question: What is the purpose of providing multiple ML models to AnLF?
question_55589.ground_truth: Providing multiple ML models to AnLF may help improve analytics accuracy. Each ML model is assigned a unique ML Model identifier, and the optimal model is selected based on input data type and representative ratio.

question_55590.question: What steps does the NRM server take to establish Uu connectivity between the UEs of two NRM clients?
question_55590.ground_truth: The NRM server triggers the 3GPP system to establish Uu connectivity between the UEs with the required QoS.

question_55592.question: What should the originating transmission participant do when an MCVideo call is established with session announcement including an explicit transmission request?
question_55592.ground_truth: The originating transmission participant shall create an instance of a transmission participant state transition diagram for basic operation state machine, send a Transmission Granted message towards other transmission participants, and enter the 'O: transmission arbitration' state.

question_55594.question: What should the MS do if it receives a DETACH REQUEST message from the network in state GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED with detach type "re-attach not required" and no cause code, or "re-attach not required"' and the cause code is not #2 "IMSI unknown in HLR"?
question_55594.ground_truth: The GPRS detach procedure shall be progressed and the GPRS attach procedure shall be aborted.

question_55595.question: What is the role of the SMF in mapping PCC rules to ATSSS rules and Packet Detection Rules?
question_55595.ground_truth: The SMF maps PCC rules received from the PCF to ATSSS rules, which are sent to the UE via the AMF. It also maps PCC rules to Packet Detection Rules and other N4 rules, which are sent to the UPF.

question_55596.question: What should the MAC entity do when it receives an LTM Cell Switch Command MAC CE including a Timing Advance Command?
question_55596.ground_truth: The MAC entity applies the Timing Advance Command for the PTAG and starts or restarts the timeAlignmentTimer associated with the PTAG.

question_55597.question: What additional measures should be taken into account during the session lifetime if there is a possibility that the UP integrity protection and encryption indication status is changed?
question_55597.ground_truth: The latest URLLC Radio and System Architecture TR 23.725 must be taken into account and the UE and NG-RAN must be informed of any changes in the UP security policy.

question_55600.question: What technologies are considered for the extended concept of ranking the available candidate PLMNs in automatic PLMN selection?
question_55600.ground_truth: The existing concept of ranking the available candidate PLMNs in automatic PLMN selection is extended to cover also cdma2000 1xRTT and cdma2000 HRPD Radio Access Technologies.

question_55601.question: What factors can affect the UE Rx beam sweeping factor in the measurement period requirement, as specified in clause 4.5.5.5?
question_55601.ground_truth: The UE Rx beam sweeping factor can be affected by the frequency layer being measured, as well as the capability reported by the UE and indicated by the LMF for lower Rx beam sweeping factors in FR2 and FR1.

question_55602.question: What is the justification for the introduction of a new Power Class for Band 14 for Region 2?
question_55602.ground_truth: The justification for the introduction of a new Power Class for Band 14 for Region 2 is that the current limitation on UL power is a bottleneck to enable higher achievable data rate with broader coverage, which are essential for Public Safety Broadband (PSBB) systems to provide the necessary population coverage and UL throughput requirements for Public Safety and US Homeland Security.

question_55603.question: What is the requirement defined for the uplink signal detection in 7.3.35.5?
question_55603.ground_truth: UE output power equal to or higher than Transmit minimum power -39 dBm means uplink signal.

question_55605.question: What is the purpose of Solution 1 in terms of MC service user profile data synchronization?
question_55605.ground_truth: The purpose of Solution 1 is to synchronize the MC service user profile with the current (or IOPS tagged) profile that is currently active and downloaded in the MC service client, updating the MC service user profile for the MC service user in the IOPS MC system.

question_55607.question: What is the action taken when a dynamic sidelink grant is available for retransmission(s) of a MAC PDU?
question_55607.ground_truth: The PSCCH duration(s) and PSSCH duration(s) corresponding to retransmission(s) of the MAC PDU are cleared from the sidelink grant.

question_55608.question: What is the function of the scope parameter in a Binding Indication?
question_55608.ground_truth: The scope parameter in a Binding Indication identifies the applicability of the binding information, i.e. the scenario associated with it.

question_55609.question: What does the UE do upon receiving the PMFP PLR count request message?
question_55609.ground_truth: The UE starts counting the received DL packets over the QoS flow and sends the PMFP PLR count response message to the UPF.

question_55610.question: Which two companies' TSC Sets (Training Sequence Candidates Sets) were selected for further evaluation in the successive work item VAMOS?
question_55610.ground_truth: Huawei Technologies Ltd and Research in Motion Ltd

question_55614.question: What is the initial state of the mobile station in the test procedure?
question_55614.ground_truth: The mobile station is brought into the state U1 in the test procedure.

question_55616.question: Which entities are informed by the MME when downlink data is not delivered to the UE?
question_55616.ground_truth: The SCEF is informed by the MME when downlink data is not delivered to the UE.

question_55617.question: What are the two types of applications that can be distinguished in the FRMCS System?
question_55617.ground_truth: The two types of applications that can be distinguished are applications that are aware of their transport service requirements and those that are not.

question_55618.question: How can the blocked AoA pairs be addressed without impacting test time in the 3-axis positioner implementation?
question_55618.ground_truth: The blocked AoA pairs can be addressed without impacting test time by exchanging some pre-identified test AoAs across the two hemisphere scans, leveraging the mechanical outline of the inside positioner.

question_55619.question: What should be the value of bit 1 in Octet 8, if the new MME/SGSN has successfully authenticated the UE?
question_55619.ground_truth: The value of bit 1 in Octet 8 should be set to 1, if the new MME/SGSN has successfully authenticated the UE.

question_55620.question: What status code will the NWDAF respond with if the "timeAnaNeeded" attribute is provided and the requested analytics information is not ready when the specified time is reached?
question_55620.ground_truth: The NWDAF may send a "500 Internal Server Error" status code to the NF service consumer.

question_55621.question: What must the BM-SC include in the MBMS-Bearer-Response AVP for a successful MBMS bearer modification?
question_55621.ground_truth: The BM-SC shall include the TMGI AVP and the MBMS-Flow-Identifier AVP, and may include Radio-Frequency AVP(s) indicating the modified radio frequency.

question_55622.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification in the document presented?
question_55622.ground_truth: The purpose of the 3GPP Technical Specification in the document presented is to specify architecture enhancements to facilitate communications with packet data networks and applications, specifically for Machine Type Communication (MTC) applications on the (external) network/MTC servers.

question_55623.question: How long does the UE need to wait after detecting a new cell in a higher priority search before determining that reselection has not occurred?
question_55623.ground_truth: The UE is not required to continuously measure the detected cell to evaluate the ongoing possibility of re-selection. However, the minimum measurement filtering requirements specified later in this section shall still be met by the UE before it makes any determination that it may stop measuring the cell.

question_55624.question: What is the difference between a "Conference" and a "Telepresence" in the context of IP multimedia services?
question_55624.ground_truth: A "Conference" is an IP multimedia session with two or more participants, while "Telepresence" is a specific type of conference with interactive audio-visual communications experience between remote locations, optimizing various attributes such as audio and video quality, eye contact, and spatial audio.

question_55627.question: What must the eNB determine for setting the PS-to-CS handover indicator in the described scenario?
question_55627.ground_truth: The eNB must determine if the target is GERAN with DTM but without DTM HO support and the UE supports DTM, or if the target is UTRAN (HSPA) without PS HO support.

question_55628.question: What is the difference between IAB-MT and IAB-DU in 3GPP TS 38.174?
question_55628.ground_truth: IAB-DU is responsible for interfacing with UEs and IAB-MT, while IAB-MT is responsible for interfacing with IAB-DU only. This functional split represents the Base Station functionality and the UE functionality, respectively.

question_55630.question: What is the main criterion for triggering DNS handling functionalities in the SMF in Option 1?
question_55630.ground_truth: The main criterion for triggering DNS handling functionalities in the SMF in Option 1 is when certain criterion, such as FQDN (Fully Qualified Domain Name), is matched in the received DNS response message.

question_55631.question: What rule does the initial AMF follow in the case of home-routed roaming scenario to associate the UE's EPS PDN connections to 5GS PDU Sessions?
question_55631.ground_truth: The initial AMF stores an association of the PDU Session ID, S-NSSAI, and the SMF ID for each UE's EPS PDN connections, and the SMF includes mapping between EBI(s) and QFI(s) as part of N2 SM Information container.

question_55632.question: What is the difference in UL Average-UPT between the case with no DL power adjustment and the case with DL power adjustment (3 dB power back off) in FR1 2-layer Scenario B based on Source 1?
question_55632.ground_truth: With a large packet size, the DL power adjustment results in a higher or similar mean and 5% UL Average-UPT for all load levels compared to the case with no DL power adjustment.

question_55634.question: How many child PDU sessions can a multi-access PDU session contain?
question_55634.ground_truth: A multi-access PDU session can contain two child PDU sessions, one established over 3GPP access and the other over untrusted non-3GPP access.

question_55635.question: What happens to the MCVideo emergency state if an MCVideo emergency ad-hoc group call is initiated or the emergency state is already set for the MCVideo client?
question_55635.ground_truth: If there is an MCVideo emergency ad-hoh group call initiated or the emergency state is already set for the MCVideo client, the MCVideo ad-hoc group call request contains an emergency indicator and the MCVideo emergency state of the MCVideo client is retained until explicitly cancelled by the user of MCVideo client.

question_55636.question: Who is responsible for managing a private enterprise's access in a controlled environment, such as a company office?
question_55636.ground_truth: The management of a private enterprise's access in a controlled environment is typically the responsibility of the company itself.

question_55637.question: In which TDMA frame number should the first burst carrying a segment of the Packet Ack/Nack message be physically transmitted if the last burst of the corresponding RLC data block was recently (re)transmitted?
question_55637.ground_truth: The first burst carrying a segment of the Packet Ack/Nack message should be physically transmitted in the TDMA frame number FNresp where FNresp < FNcomm + Trmin +1 if the last burst of the corresponding RLC data block was recently (re)transmitted.

question_55638.question: What is the indication from the physical layer to the MAC that is required for NR-U?
question_55638.ground_truth: An indication from the physical layer to the MAC is required for NR-U to indicate that power ramping is not applied when preamble is not transmitted due to LBT failure and ra-ResponseWindow is not started when the preamble is not transmitted due to LBT failure.

question_55640.question: What should the SGSN do after restarting before the next authenticated radio contact with the MS?
question_55640.ground_truth: The SGSN should request the MS to identify itself with the IMSI in order to make a relationship between the IMSI and the received old TLLI.

question_55642.question: What does the L1 BLER indicate in a live network?
question_55642.ground_truth: The L1 BLER (Link-level Block Error Ratio) is between 15% and 40% in fading multipath scenarios in live networks.

question_55643.question: What are the exceptions for specific message contents in section 7.2.3.3.1.8.4?
question_55643.ground_truth: The exceptions are HOLD (Step 3), FACILITY with Invoke component (Step 4), HOLD ACKNOWLEDGE (Step 5), FACILITY with Return Result component (Step 6).

question_55644.question: What does the EES-B do if the required EAS(s) is not registered with EES-A?
question_55644.ground_truth: EES-B sends EAS discovery request over EDGE-9 reference point to the EES-A to obtain matching EAS details.

question_55645.question: Which user plane protocol stack is used for L3 UE-to-NW Relay access via N3IWF?
question_55645.ground_truth: The user plane protocol stack for L3 UE-to-NW Relay access via N3IWF is the same as the user plane protocol stack for untrusted non-3GPP access.

question_55648.question: What must the UE include in the SIP INFO request to indicate an unsuccessful MSD update?
question_55648.ground_truth: The UE must include a 200 OK message with a correctly composed SIP INFO message and set the "success" attribute to false in the "ack" element to indicate an unsuccessful MSD update.

question_55650.question: What is the purpose of the DisCoNoserviceapplicability parameter in Solution #13?
question_55650.ground_truth: The DisCoNoserviceapplicability parameter in Solution #13 is used to determine whether to negotiate power saving mechanisms for staying at no service in the current PLMN before entering no service discontinues NTN coverage, and whether to remain in no service or perform PLMN selection procedure after entering no service discontinuous NTN coverage.

question_55651.question: What protocol should the MCData client use to send a SIP MESSAGE request for discovering the absolute URI of the media storage function?
question_55651.ground_truth: The MCData client should use the SIP protocol to send a SIP MESSAGE request for discovering the absolute URI of the media storage function, as specified in 3GPP TS 24.229 and IETF RFC 3428.

question_55652.question: What should the Signalling Proxy be able to do in order to prevent overload of application signalling at the MCX Server?
question_55652.ground_truth: The Signalling Proxy should be able to block, throttle or prioritise the signalling routed into the MC Domain.

question_55653.question: What does a mask with all bits set to "1" in a filter represent in ProSe Direct Discovery?
question_55653.ground_truth: A mask with all bits set to "1" in a filter represents a full matching requirement for ProSe Response Codes in PC5 interface messages.

question_55654.question: What are the two types of warning indication procedures added in release 12 of 3GPP TS 23.041?
question_55654.ground_truth: The two types of warning indication procedures added in release 12 of 3GPP TS 23.041 are the Write-Replace Warning Indication and Stop-Warning Indication procedures.

question_55656.question: What forms the majority of the delay in the transition from Idle to Connected mode in LTE-Advanced, and how much of an improvement can be achieved by reducing processing delays?
question_55656.ground_truth: Processing delays in the different nodes form around 75% of the delay in the transition from Idle to Connected mode in LTE-Advanced. Any improvement in processing delays can have a large impact on the overall latency.

question_55657.question: What interfaces and functions are included in the online charging architecture for the PS domain based on P-GW with included PCEF and TDF?
question_55657.ground_truth: The Ro interface and the associated Diameter application are used in the online charging architecture for the PS domain based on P-GW with included PCEF and TDF.

question_55659.question: What information does the User Equipment (UE) convey to the network when it is not able to sort all the Slice-Network Slice Selection Assistance Information (S-NSSAIs) in priority order?
question_55659.ground_truth: The UE conveys to the network the number of S-NSSAIs it has sorted in priority order.

question_55660.question: What is the role of FQI in backward compatibility to SCI for GERAN?
question_55660.ground_truth: FQI is meant to allow any type of classification, while SCI is typically associated with service category or application based classification. FQI allows operators to explicitly and quantitatively set the RAN handling at different levels of congestion, whereas SCI is intended for application specific RAN optimizations. FQI is suggested as an evolution for rel-11 GERAN SCI in rel-12.

question_55661.question: What does the 5G DDNMF do when it cannot retrieve the corresponding discoveree UE context for a target RPAUID?
question_55661.ground_truth: If the 5G DDNMF cannot retrieve the corresponding discoveree UE context for a target RPAUID, it can skip the processing of this target RPAUID.

question_55662.question: What is the default adopted MU value for the Indoor Anechoic Chamber and Compact Antenna Test Range in the context of OTA frequency error for the NFTR test procedure?
question_55662.ground_truth: The default adopted MU value is adopted for the OTA MU for both the Indoor Anechoic Chamber and Compact Antenna Test Range.

question_55663.question: When does the floor control server send a floor request cancel notify message?
question_55663.ground_truth: When the floor request cancel in step 2 is sent by an authorized user (e.g., dispatcher) to cancel the floor request(s) of other participant(s) from the floor request queue, the floor request cancel notify message is sent to the affected floor participant.

question_55664.question: What is the difference between "will" and "might" in the context of 3GPP technical documents?
question_55664.ground_truth: In 3GPP technical documents, "will" indicates that something is certain or expected to happen as a result of action taken by an agency outside the scope of the document, while "might" indicates a likelihood that something will happen as a result of action taken by some agency outside the scope of the document.

question_55665.question: What should the UE do upon the expiry of T321 for a measId?
question_55665.ground_truth: The UE should include a measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportList for the corresponding measId, set the numberOfReportsSent to 0, and initiate the measurement reporting procedure, as specified in 5.5.5.

question_55667.question: What is the role of the gateway server in the primary MC system?
question_55667.ground_truth: The gateway server in the primary MC system provides gateway services to one or more MC services, such as MCPTT, MCVideo, and MCData. It also interfaces with the primary MCPTT system of the MCPTT group and provides a single point of contact between MCPTT servers and MCPTT UEs in the partner MC system of the group without exposing the internal network architecture of the partner MC system.

question_55668.question: What does the first digit in the version number in a 3GPP technical specification document indicate?
question_55668.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number of a 3GPP technical specification document indicates the status of the document in the TSG: presented for information, presented for approval, or TSG approved under change control.

question_55670.question: What does the MRFC do with the MIKEY-TICKET ticket when it creates the ticket by itself?
question_55670.ground_truth: In this case, the MRFC performs all key and ticket generation functions otherwise performed by the KMS using MIKEY-TICKET mode 3 as specified in IETF~RFC~6043.

question_55672.question: What is the purpose of the GA-RRC RELOCATION ACCESS message?
question_55672.ground_truth: The GA-RRC RELOCATION ACCESS message is sent by the MS to the GANC to indicate that the MS has been commanded to handover a CS domain session to GAN Iu mode but the GA-RRC CS domain sub-layer entity in the MS is not yet in the GA-RRC CONNECTED state.

question_55674.question: What should the device do when entering the Ready State in EC-GSM, if the carrier signal strength values are decreased below some known threshold?
question_55674.ground_truth: When the device leaves the packet transfer mode and enters Ready State in EC-GSM, if the carrier signal strength values are decreased below some known threshold, serving cell and neighbor cell measurements should be made to trigger a possible update of the cell and coverage class.

question_55675.question: What does the network have to do upon receipt of a REQUEST SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT ACTIVATION message from the MS, if the TI in Linked TI IE matches an already established PDP context?
question_55675.ground_truth: The network should validate the message by verifying the TI and reply with an ACTIVATE SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT ACCEPT message, if the request can be accepted.

question_55678.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function do when sending a SIP MESSAGE request to remove a regroup from a terminating participating MCVideo function?
