question_56025.question: What speech communication options must be supported by MTSI clients in terminals offering speech communication?
question_56025.ground_truth: MTSI clients in terminals offering speech communication must support narrowband, wideband, and super-wideband communication.

question_56028.question: How can elements be defined as optional in XML Schema?
question_56028.ground_truth: Elements can be defined as optional in XML Schema by using the minOccurs attribute with a value of zero.

question_56029.question: What should the RNC include in the Area Identity IE of the LOCATION REPORT message in case of direct report for Service Area?
question_56029.ground_truth: If the LOCATION REPORT message is sent as an answer to a request for a direct report of Service Area and the current Service Area cannot be determined by the RNC, the RNC shall include the Last Known Service Area IE instead of the Area Identity IE, and a cause value to indicate that the request could not be fulfilled.

question_56030.question: Which core network components are impacted by CSI in the radio access network?
question_56030.ground_truth: For CSI to function, the radio access network requires DTM support for GERAN access and multiRAB support for UTRAN access. However, the PS Core and the CS Core Network remain unchanged.

question_56031.question: What is the confidence level required for the test to pass?
question_56031.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests observed during repeated tests shall be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

question_56032.question: Under what circumstances does the mobile station delete the stored Local Emergency Numbers List in its memory?
question_56032.ground_truth: The mobile station shall delete the stored Local Emergency Numbers List if there is no list contained in the LOCATION UPDATING ACCEPT message, or if the mobile equipment has successfully registered to a PLMN in a different country from that of the PLMN that sent the Local Emergency Numbers List. The list shall also be deleted at switch off and removal of the SIM/USIM.

question_56033.question: When is a manual stop initiated for Assured Voice Communication (AVC)?
question_56033.ground_truth: A manual stop for AVC can be initiated by the FRMCS User who manually invoked it, in cases where it was not automatically stopped when the ongoing voice communication was terminated by one of the involved users.

question_56034.question: What mechanism is used to secure the signalling channel for Security Alternative B in the EPS?
question_56034.ground_truth: IPSec/IKEv2 is used to secure the signalling channel only in Security Alternative B.

question_56035.question: What is the purpose of the Requests Responded information element in a Data Record Transfer Response?
question_56035.ground_truth: The Requests Responded information element identifies the Data Record Transfer Requests that are being responded to by a Data Record Transfer Response.

question_56036.question: What is the principle of self-containment in the context of FLUTE and the advanced FLUTE protocol?
question_56036.ground_truth: In FLUTE, the receiver needs to first fetch an FDT instance, while in the advanced FLUTE, the file should be self-contained, i.e. it should contain its own metadata to enable the client to identify it.

question_56037.question: What should an EES do upon successful validation of an EEC registration request containing an EEC context ID and a S-EES Endpoint?
question_56037.ground_truth: The EES performs an EEC Context Pull relocation from the S-EES, and the source and target EES perform EEC Context handling as detailed in clause~8.9.1.

question_56038.question: When encountering a field with a not comprehended value in an RRC message, what should a UE do if a default value is not defined for this field and it is not optional?
question_56038.ground_truth: The UE should treat the message as if the field were absent and in accordance with clause 10.4.

question_56039.question: What is the purpose of the AF transaction identifier in the communication between the AF and the 5GC?
question_56039.ground_truth: The AF transaction identifier is used to update or remove the AF request and to identify corresponding UP path management event notifications.

question_56040.question: What is the role of the identity management server in the MCS context?
question_56040.ground_truth: The identity management server is responsible for authenticating the MC ID and contains the knowledge and means to verify the credentials supplied by the user.

question_56042.question: What should the MS do if it fails to complete the periodic RA update procedure after a retry scheme while in GERAN/UTRAN PS coverage?
question_56042.ground_truth: The MS shall wait a back-off time equal to the periodic LA update timer broadcast by the network before restarting the periodic RA update procedure.

question_56043.question: What must a UE performing idle mode DC measurements be capable of, in terms of reporting RSRP/RSRQ measurements for SSB and S-Synchronization Signal Blocks, when idle mode DC measurement reporting is requested by the network?
question_56043.ground_truth: The UE must be capable of reporting SS-RSRP and SS-RSRQ measurements of the carriers for idle mode DC measurements with the specified measurement accuracy.

question_56044.question: In the test procedure described in subclause 26.5.5.2.3.3, what action does the System Simulator (SS) take after initiating the RR connection release?
question_56044.ground_truth: The SS waits for the disconnection of the main signalling link.

question_56045.question: What type of information element is the EAP message, and what is its minimum and maximum length?
question_56045.ground_truth: The EAP message is a type 6 information element with a minimum length of 7 octets and a maximum length of 1503 octets.

question_56046.question: What must the UE do if the emergency services fallback is available and the lower layers indicate that the emergency services fallback attempt failed?
question_56046.ground_truth: The UE may behave as if the emergency services fallback is not available.

question_56047.question: What should the S-CSCF do if the public user identity and the private user identity in the REGISTER request do not match any registered user and the S-CSCF does not support S-CSCF restoration procedures?
question_56047.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall respond with a 500 (Server Internal Error) response to the UE.

question_56048.question: What type of traffic is the "Number of simultaneous online watchers (Mean)" measurement valid for?

question_56049.question: What is a called party alert event, and how should the IPLMN/VPLMN respond when it occurs?
question_56049.ground_truth: A called party alert event is a procedure used to manage an outgoing call setup when the called party is alerted. When the IPLMN/VPLMN detects this event, it should suspend call processing and notify the CSE, or notify the CSE and continue call processing.

question_56050.question: What is the purpose of the TSN AF in the 5GS TSN bridge?
question_56050.ground_truth: The TSN AF (TSN Access Gateway Function) in the 5GS TSN bridge stores the binding relationship between ports and PDU Sessions, and uses this information to forward traffic to the appropriate egress port.

question_56053.question: What is the purpose of an Edge Enabler Client sending an Edge Application Server discovery request to the Edge Enabler Server?
question_56053.ground_truth: The Edge Enabler Client sends a discovery request to the Edge Enabler Server to retrieve information about a particular Edge Application Server or a category of Edge Application Servers, along with query filters for access permissions, features, and location availability.

question_56054.question: What is the test requirement for 27.14.6.5 after changing the PIN2 in the context of 3GPP~TS 02.30 and 3GPP~TS 11.11 specifications?
question_56054.ground_truth: After successfully changing the PIN2, the MS shall give an indication that the new PIN2 is accepted.

question_56056.question: What is the range of values that can be assigned to the protocolIEs in the CommonMeasurementReport-IEs sequence, as defined by the NBAP-PROTOCOL-IES standard?
question_56056.ground_truth: The range of values that can be assigned to the protocolIEs in the CommonMeasurementReport-IEs sequence is defined by the NBAP-PROTOCOL-IES standard, and includes the values "Cell", "RACH", "CPCH", "S-Measurement", "ERAB", "E-RACH", "BM-SFR", and "CG-RPT".

question_56057.question: What is the purpose of up-sampling the lower band synthesis signal from 12.8 kHz to 16 kHz in the high frequency band?
question_56057.ground_truth: The purpose of up-sampling the lower band synthesis signal from 12.8 kHz to 16 kHz in the high frequency band is to compensate for the down-sampling that occurred in the pre-processing stage.

question_56058.question: What type of information can the "NeighbouringNcgi" and "MbmsSaId" elements hold, as indicated in the provided XML schema?
question_56058.ground_truth: The "NeighbouringNcgi" and "MbmsSaId" elements both hold location-related information, with the "NeighbouringNcgi" containing information about neighboring network area codes and "MbmsSaId" containing information about MBMS Service Area Identities.

question_56059.question: What events can lead to a network-initiated GPRS detach in the context of CAMEL?
question_56059.ground_truth: The network can initiate a GPRS detach if the network has not received a periodic routeing area update from the MS, indicating that the MS is unreachable.

question_56060.question: What is the frequency range of the third order harmonics created by a part of the uplink of Band 8 in the LTE Advanced carrier aggregation of Band 2 and Band 30?
question_56060.ground_truth: The frequency range of the third order harmonics created by a part of the uplink of Band 8 is 880-897~MHz, specifically the first 17~MHz.

question_56061.question: Which binary serialization format specification is developed primarily for constrained devices and applications?
question_56061.ground_truth: CBOR is developed primarily for constrained devices and applications, such as IoT devices.

question_56062.question: What should the MS send after receiving an ASSIGNMENT COMMAND message with early assignment of traffic channel(s)?
question_56062.ground_truth: The MS should reply with an ASSIGNMENT COMPLETE message and continue the call establishment by either sending a CONNECT message or sending an ALERTING message, depending on the PICS/PIXIT statement.

question_56063.question: What message is returned by the NSSF when it is able to find authorized network slice information in response to a slice-info-request-for-registration query?

question_56064.question: What does the SCEF use to determine what APN will be used to enable transfer of non-IP data between the UE and the SCS/AS?
question_56064.ground_truth: The SCEF uses the SCS/AS Identifier and External Group Identifier, External Identifier or MSISDN to determine what APN will be used to enable transfer of non-IP data between the UE and the SCS/AS.

question_56065.question: Which CHOICE value in BasicGapCriteria indicates a called address value?

question_56066.question: What should the TDF-U do once it has re-established the Sx session and received an IP packet?
question_56066.ground_truth: The TDF-U shall forward the received IP packet to the peer IP session entity.

question_56067.question: What is used to derive KTNAP' during mobility using the described input parameters?
question_56067.ground_truth: KTNGF is used to derive KTNAP' during mobility using the FC, COUNT, and length of COUNT as input parameters.

question_56069.question: What is the mapping of a burst for EC-CCCH/D/M and EC-PICH in the document?
question_56069.ground_truth: The mapping of a burst is given by the rule e(B,j) = pc(j) for j = 0,1,...,115 and B=0,1 for EC-CCCH/D/M and EC-PICH in the document.

question_56071.question: What happens in steps 6-7 of the process?
question_56071.ground_truth: In steps 6-7, the ProSe Function sends a Debit Units Request to the OCS indicating that granted units have been used. If authorization for the Announce command is unsuccessful, granted units are returned.

question_56072.question: What is the initial request in the described flow and who is it sent from?
question_56072.ground_truth: The initial request is an INVITE request sent from IBCF-hA2 to I-CSCF-hA1.

question_56073.question: What does the "Floor Revoke" message Reject Cause #6 "No resources available" indicate?
question_56073.ground_truth: Reject Cause #6 "No resources available" in the "Floor Revoke" message indicates that the floor control server can no longer grant MCPTT client to send media due to congestion.

question_56074.question: What is the principle used for the Edge application to invoke the service API for RAN QoS Information in solution #43?
question_56074.ground_truth: The principle used for the Edge application to invoke the service API for RAN QoS Information is that the UE and Edge application have established a session, and this triggers the Edge application to invoke the service API for RAN QoS Information.

question_56075.question: What is the purpose of the PositioningActivationFailure message and what are its fields?
question_56075.ground_truth: The PositioningActivationFailure message is used to indicate the failure of a positioning activation procedure. It has a protocolIEs field, a ProtocolIE-Container, and an optional set of information elements defined by PositioningActivationFailureIEs. This set includes id-gNB-CU-UE-F1AP-ID, id-gNB-DU-UE-F1AP-ID, id-Cause, and id-CriticalityDiagnostics.

question_56078.question: What is the requirement for a MS that has enabled EC operation in order to attempt packet access?
question_56078.ground_truth: The MS is required to have read a complete EC-SI message set no longer than 24 hours prior to attempting packet access and re-acquire EC-SI if the EC-BCCH CHANGE MARK field has changed.

question_56079.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe Query Code and Discovery Response Filter in ProSe Direct Discovery?
question_56079.ground_truth: The ProSe Query Code is used to solicit a response from a discoveree UE for a particular target RPAUID, and the Discovery Response Filter contains one code and one or more masks to be used for matching ProSe Response Codes in PC5 interface messages.

question_56080.question: What profile is used to generate the H.266/VVC bitstreams in the provided scenario?
question_56080.ground_truth: The Main 10 Profile is used to generate the H.266/VVC bitstreams in the provided scenario.

question_56082.question: What should the UE do if it receives a SystemInformationBlockType11 and all segments of a warning message have been received?
question_56082.ground_truth: The UE should assemble the warning message from the received warningMessageSegment, forward the received warning message, messageIdentifier, serialNumber and dataCodingScheme to upper layers, stop reception of SystemInformationBlockType11, and discard the current values of messageIdentifier and serialNumber for SystemInformationBlockType11.

question_56084.question: What is the number of paging indicators per radio frame if the paging indicator length is 8 symbols?
question_56084.ground_truth: The number of paging indicators per radio frame is given by the paging indicator length, which is 32 in this case.

question_56085.question: What is the role of the gNB-DU after detecting a primary source event in the RAN TSS reporting process?
question_56085.ground_truth: Upon detecting the primary source event, the gNB-DU provides an updated RAN TSS report to the gNB-CU by sending a TIMING SYNCHRONISATION STATUS REPORT message. This message contains the current RAN TSS attributes received from the gNB-DU.

question_56086.question: What is the modulation scheme that the IWF V.34 modem is required to initiate for ITU-T Recommendation V.8 handshaking?
question_56086.ground_truth: The IWF V.34 modem must initiate the ITU-T Recommendation V.34 modulation scheme for the V.8 handshaking.

question_56087.question: What is one of the suggested GSM/GPRS solutions for distributing the public key to the UE?
question_56087.ground_truth: One solution is to re-use the current GSM/GPRS security mechanism with initiating ciphering using a UE-controlled timer.

question_56089.question: Under what conditions is a sender required to handle and process the Load Control Information?
question_56089.ground_truth: A sender is required to handle and process the Load Control Information if it receives the parameter from a PGW while performing node selection for a given APN, and if the APN level load control feature is supported and enabled.

question_56090.question: What is the purpose of the XID negotiations test to verify when the SS sends IOV-UI to the MS in a XID command?
question_56090.ground_truth: The test verifies that the MS ciphers its output using the specified value of IOV-UI, that it applies to all SAPIs using this TLLI, and that Identity Response sent from the MS is not ciphered.

question_56091.question: What is a protocol in the context of layer 3?
question_56091.ground_truth: A protocol is a set of rules and formats by which the information (control information and user data) is exchanged between two peers in the same sub-layer. It is defined in the Technical Specifications identified in clause 4.3.4.

question_56092.question: What is the role of the 5G DDNMF in the ProSe Direct Discovery procedure?
question_56092.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF supports charging for Direct Discovery, transfers charging data for Direct Discovery to CHF, and reports chargeable events to the CHF.

question_56093.question: What is the purpose of Service Information in a 3GPP network?
question_56093.ground_truth: Service Information is optional transparent information that is not processed by the HSS or the S-CSCF. It may be included in the body of a SIP request sent from the S-CSCF to the AS if available in the initial filter criteria.

question_56095.question: What are the security threats associated with open platforms in relation to GAA in 3GPP TS 33.234?
question_56095.ground_truth: The security threats include a malicious application accessing the UICC directly to function as a GAA server, accessing the GAA server private data, or accessing the GAA server API to obtain NAF specific GAA credentials. These can result in a loss of private data.

question_56096.question: What is the impact of a 504 (Server Time-Out) response on REGISTER request forwarding?
question_56096.ground_truth: If the P-CSCF fails to forward the REGISTER request to any exit point or entry point, it shall send back a 504 (Server Time-Out) response to the user.

question_56098.question: What should the MME and PDN GW do to support dedicated RLOS EPS bearer for UEs that are unauthenticated?
question_56098.ground_truth: For RLOS attached UEs which are unauthenticated, the PDN GW provides the IMEI as the UE Identity instead of IMSI, to the PCRF. If dynamic PCC is deployed, the PCRF sets the ARP of the PCC rules to a value that is reserved for RLOS. If dynamic PCC is not deployed, the PDN GW uses the ARP of the default RLOS EPS bearer for any potentially initiated dedicated RLOS EPS bearer.

question_56099.question: What is the reference sensitivity power level REFSENS as defined in clause 7.2 of the document?
question_56099.ground_truth: The reference sensitivity power level REFSENS is the minimum mean power applied to both the backhaul antenna ports at which the throughput shall meet or exceed the requirements for the specified reference measurement channel.

question_56102.question: What are the three types of Interference Suppression (IS) receivers that can be used in LTE?
question_56102.ground_truth: The three types of Interference Suppression (IS) receivers are LMMSE-IRC, E-LMMSE-IRC, and Widely linear MMSE-IRC (WLMMSE-IRC).

question_56105.question: What is the role of the MAG in learning about PDN GW support for multiple PDN connections to the same APN?
question_56105.ground_truth: The MAG learns from the PBA whether the PDN GW supports multiple PDN connections to the same APN or not.

question_56106.question: What error is returned by the gsmSSF to the gsmSCF when the connection establishment fails?

question_56107.question: What is the impact on existing nodes and functionality when implementing MCPTT emergency call requests and responses through the IWF?
question_56107.ground_truth: Each message and media packet should be sent only once to the IWF and not for every affiliated LMR group member behind the IWF.

question_56108.question: How does the AF determine coverage information for the UE?
question_56108.ground_truth: The AF determines coverage information for the UE based on its awareness of UE location, UE trajectory, and satellite coverage information. It can provide this information as a list of time and coverage in/out pairs.

question_56109.question: When should the UE reselect a new cell based on a range of R values of cells?
question_56109.ground_truth: A UE should reselect a new cell based on a range of R values of cells if the R value of the highest ranked cell is within rangeToBestCell of the R value of the highest ranked cell among the cells meeting the cell reselection criteria.

question_56111.question: What is the recommended operation for sending orientation information if the sensor's indication is fluctuating between two quantization levels?
question_56111.ground_truth: It is recommended to apply filtering on the time and angular domain to prevent a "ping-pong" effect in the case where the measured value is fluctuating between two quantization levels.

question_56112.question: What message is sent by the MME to the eNodeB to initiate the S1 release procedure?
question_56112.ground_truth: The S1 UE Context Release Command (Cause) message.

question_56113.question: What algorithm is used to compute the 32-bit MAC in GIA5?

question_56114.question: How does the GCSE security architecture define the potential high-level security areas?
question_56114.ground_truth: The GCSE security architecture defines five main areas: A) Security for GCSE communication between the UE and 3GPP network, B) Security for GCSE within MuSe, C) Security for GCSE communication between EPC/MuSe and GCS AS, D) Security for GCSE communication between UE and GCS AS, and E) Security for GCSE communication between two ProSe enabled Public Safety UE.

question_56115.question: What steps should the AF take to remove the information about the AF signalling IP flows?
question_56115.ground_truth: If the Rx Diameter session is only used for AF Signalling IP flows, the AF closes the session by sending a Session-Termination-Request (STR) command. Otherwise, it removes the IP flows within the Media-Sub-Component AVP by supplying the Flow-Status AVP with the value "REMOVED".

question_56116.question: What is the requirement for a UE to meet the measurement accuracy for RXLEV stated in TS 45.008, as per 8.4a.2.5.1?
question_56116.ground_truth: The UE must take at least 3 GSM carrier RSSI samples per GSM carrier in the monitored set during the measurement period.

question_56117.question: What happens once the VAL UE is able to receive the VAL data via the broadcast MBS session?
question_56117.ground_truth: The NRM server sends a user plane delivery mode message to the VAL server, indicating to stop the unicast delivery towards the VAL UE, hence the VAL UE then receives the VAL data only via the broadcast MBS session.

question_56118.question: What is the difference between "TPC repetition with fast DL power control" and "TPC repetition with slow DL power control"?
question_56118.ground_truth: In "TPC repetition with fast DL power control", the UE estimates the SIR every slot and transmits independent DL power control commands across the repeated TPCs. In "TPC repetition with slow DL power control", the UE estimates the SIR after soft combining the repeated TPCs and transmits the same DL power control command across all slots of the repeated TPCs.

question_56119.question: What is the performance metric used for Layer 1?
question_56119.ground_truth: The performance metric is SGCS for Layer 1.

question_56120.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the test described in section 5.1.50.3?
question_56120.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement for the test described in section 5.1.50.3 is the same as that in section 5.1.47.

question_56123.question: What are the design principles for uplink control signaling in LTE-Advanced?
question_56123.ground_truth: The Rel-10 PUCCH design supports up to five DL component carriers. For signalling of HARQ ACK/NACK on PUCCH for downlink transmission, following mechanisms are supported: All HARQ ACK/NACK for a UE can be transmitted on PUCCH in absence of PUSCH transmission. The design of the ACK/NACK resource allocation should consider performance and power control aspects.

question_56124.question: What error message does the MS send to the network if it fails to decode a RRLP MEASURE POSITION REQUEST message?
question_56124.ground_truth: The MS sends a RRLP PROTOCOL ERROR message to the network.

question_56125.question: What is the role of the bit separation and collection function in the rate-matching process for uncoded TrCHs, convolutionally encoded TrCHs, and turbo encoded TrCHs with repetition?
question_56125.ground_truth: The bit separation and bit collection functions are transparent for uncoded TrCHs, convolutionally encoded TrCHs, and turbo encoded TrCHs with repetition in the rate-matching process.

question_56126.question: What is the difference between a default EPS bearer and a non-GBR bearer?
question_56126.ground_truth: A default EPS bearer is a non-GBR bearer.

question_56127.question: What message does the PDN GW send to the TWAN to deactivate all S2a bearers belonging to a specific PDN connection?
question_56127.ground_truth: The PDN GW sends a Delete Bearer Request message (EPS Bearer Identity, Cause) to the TWAN to deactivate all S2a bearers belonging to a specific PDN connection.

question_56131.question: When will the MCData group FD in-progress priority state cancel request be rejected by the MCData server?
question_56131.ground_truth: The MCData group FD in-progress priority state cancel request will be rejected if a group member that is in the emergency state is transmitting when the request is received by the MCData server.

question_56132.question: What is the purpose of the test if GPRS attach is performed while IMSI attached?
question_56132.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the behavior of the MS in this specific scenario.

question_56134.question: What is a roaming services provider responsible for in the 5G system?
question_56134.ground_truth: A roaming services provider is responsible for facilitating the deployment and operation of roaming services between a client operator and a set of selected connected operators in the 5G system. They handle the technical implementation of roaming relations in a scalable and operationally efficient way.

question_56135.question: What information should be contained in the analytics report describing the RAN user plane congestion problem?
question_56135.ground_truth: The analytics report describing the RAN user plane congestion problem should contain information such as the type of congestion, start and end time, geographical area, root cause, affected objects, severity level, and recommended actions to solve the problem.

question_56136.question: What response does the NWDAF send when it successfully provides the UE Location and UE Location Accuracy to the GMLC?
question_56136.ground_truth: The NWDAF sends an HTTP "201 Created" response when it successfully provides UE Location and UE Location Accuracy.

question_56138.question: What should the UE do upon receipt of a PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message with 5GSM cause #26 "insufficient resources" and a non-zero Back-off timer value, and a DNN was provided during the PDU session establishment?
question_56138.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3396 associated with the corresponding DNN, if it is running, and not send a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for the same DNN until timer T3396 expires or is stopped.

question_56139.question: What should the UE do during T5 regarding CSI reports for PSCell?
question_56139.ground_truth: The UE should stop sending CSI reports for PSCell in at most 16ms into T5. If this condition is met, it counts as a success for event "RELEASE", otherwise, it is a failure.

question_56140.question: What is the purpose of the access token provided to the SEAL UE for key management services?
question_56140.ground_truth: The access token provided to the SEAL UE for key management services is used to enable security for VAL services and to grant use of the requested VAL service if the access token is valid.

question_56141.question: What are the two methods defined for providing the notification in the 5.4.2.2.3 section?
question_56141.ground_truth: The two methods defined are Notification via HTTP POST and Notification via Websocket.

question_56142.question: What is the purpose of specifying REST/HTTP and JSON for low-medium non-real-time reporting in the 3GPP 5G management framework?
question_56142.ground_truth: This specification aims to align the 3GPP 5G management framework with ONAP for the reporting of FM/PM data.

question_56143.question: What must the UE include in an UPDATE request, if available, and if defined for the access type as specified in subclause 7.2A.4?
question_56143.ground_truth: The UE shall include in the UPDATE request a P-Access-Network-Info header field and it shall contain a location identifier such as the cell id or the identity of the WLAN access node.

question_56146.question: In what scenario should the "Release assistance indication" IE be included in a message?
question_56146.ground_truth: The "Release assistance indication" IE should be included in a message when the UE informs the network whether no further data transmission is expected or only a single downlink data transmission is expected after the current uplink data transmission.

question_56147.question: How are the number of per-band peak candidates determined in the described classification system?
question_56147.ground_truth: The number of per-band peak candidates is determined by comparing the absolute values of transform coefficients to a threshold, and extracting those that exceed it.

question_56148.question: Where are the minimum conformance requirements specified for the NR inter-frequency RRC re-establishment test?
question_56148.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements for this test are specified in clause 17.3.2.1.0.

question_56149.question: What is the definition of "W1" in the context of the document?
question_56149.ground_truth: W1 is the interface between an ng-eNB-CU and an ng-eNB-DU, providing an interconnection point between the ng-eNB-CU and the ng-eNB-DU.

question_56150.question: What action does the UE take when the entering condition for event A4 is satisfied?
question_56150.ground_truth: When the entering condition for event A4 is satisfied, the UE sends the MeasurementReport message at regular intervals while the condition is still met.

question_56151.question: What is the synchronization procedure for the Physical Synchronization Channel (PSCH)?
question_56151.ground_truth: The synchronization procedure for the Physical Synchronization Channel (PSCH) is achieved by implementing a correlation-based search algorithm to find the PSS sequences.

question_56153.question: What major issue has arisen due to the use of multiple name conventions for network resources in the past?
question_56153.ground_truth: One major issue that has arisen is the requirement for network management applications to understand multiple name conventions to manage NEs. This can lead to complications and inefficiencies in managing a network.

question_56154.question: What should be the order of listed cells in the measurement result based on RSRP and RSRQ, if RSRP measurements are available?
question_56154.ground_truth: The cell with the highest RSRP is listed first, otherwise the cell with the highest RSRQ is listed first.

question_56155.question: What is the required maximum deviation between the DL RS power indicated on the DL-SCH and the DL RS power of each E-UTRA carrier, as defined in the minimum requirement for E-UTRA operation?
question_56155.ground_truth: The absolute accuracy of the DL RS power is defined as the maximum deviation between the DL RS power indicated on the DL-SCH and the DL RS power of each E-UTRA carrier.

question_56156.question: What message specific cause values can be indicated in a Create Bearer Response message?
question_56156.ground_truth: The possible message specific cause values for a Create Bearer Response message include "Request accepted", "Request accepted partially", "Context not found", "Semantic error in the TFT operation", "Syntactic error in the TFT operation", "Semantic errors in packet filter(s)", and "Syntactic errors in packet filter(s)".

question_56158.question: What should the UE do with priorities provided by dedicated signalling when it enters a different RRC state, the optional validity time of dedicated priorities (T320) expires, an RRCRelease message with the field cellReselectionPriorities absent is received, or a PLMN selection or SNPN selection is performed on request by NAS?
question_56158.ground_truth: The UE should delete priorities provided by dedicated signalling in these scenarios.

question_56161.question: Which new radio based services can inter-work with an AIPN and potentially create revenue for an AIPN operator?
question_56161.ground_truth: Personal Networks, RFIDs, and multi-hop access networks.

question_56162.question: What should be the orientation of the positioner and base station for performing TRP measurements?
question_56162.ground_truth: The positioner and base station should be oriented such that the direction to be tested aligns with the test antenna in order to perform measurements for TRP determination.

question_56163.question: What information does the "CS to PS SRVCC Allowed" indicator represent and where is it stored?
question_56163.ground_truth: The CS to PS SRVCC Allowed indicator represents whether the user is allowed to have CS to PS Single Radio Voice Call Continuity or not, and it is stored in the HSS and VLR.

question_56164.question: What is the message used by the UE to initiate a DNS NAPTR query to select the transport protocol by default?
question_56164.ground_truth: UE initiates a DNS NAPTR query to select the transport protocol by default using the default message in annex B.1 with the exceptions described in NOTE 3.

question_56165.question: What information is included in the 5GS location information for 3GPP access in 5G ProSe?
question_56165.ground_truth: Bytes 1 to 13 (HEX): 5G-GUTI, Bytes 14 to 19 (HEX): Last visited registered TAI in 5GS for 3GPP access, Byte 20 (BIN): 5G update status for 3GPP access

question_56166.question: How can the UPF identify the PDU Set for the AF Information Provisioning?
question_56166.ground_truth: The UPF may identify the PDU Set based on matching RTP/SRTP headers and payload, or by UPF implementation such as PDU Set detection based on traffic characteristics. However, the detailed mechanisms for PDU Set information identification in UPF are not standardized.

question_56167.question: What type of positioning procedure is performed for network assisted sidelink positioning when the target UE is in network coverage?
question_56167.ground_truth: Both MT-LR and MO-LR procedures are supported for network assisted sidelink positioning when the target UE is in network coverage.

question_56168.question: When the S-CSCF receives any response to the NOTIFY request, what information should it store?
question_56168.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall store the value of the "term-ioi" header field parameter received in the P-Charging-Vector header field, if present.

question_56170.question: Which organization created the CAP-errortypes module?

question_56171.question: What is the process of the session setup in the originating procedures?
question_56171.ground_truth: A user within the PBX tries to establish a call and the PBX sends an INVITE towards IMS via the IBCF. The IBCF may apply general screening rules to the request and adds a P-Served-User-Identity to the INVITE with the identity of the PBX. The IBCF sends the INVITE to the Transit function and the Transit function forwards the request to the AS hosting the PBX identity assertion. Based on the P-Served-User-Identity, this AS identifies the PBX and inserts a P-Asserted-Identity. The INVITE is then forwarded for further onward routing towards the remote side.

question_56172.question: What should the BSS do if any type of BSSGP PDU is received with a syntactical error in a mandatory IE?
question_56172.ground_truth: The BSS should discard the PDU and send a STATUS PDU (cause "Invalid mandatory information") to the source of the PDU.

question_56173.question: What does the UE need to do if 5GMM cause #77 is received from a wireline access network?
question_56173.ground_truth: If 5GMM cause #77 is received from a wireline access network by the 5G-RG or the W-AGF acting on behalf of the FN-CRG (or on behalf of the N5GC device), the UE shall initiate the appropriate action.

question_56174.question: What is the requirement for UE when CSI-RS for BFD measurement is in the same OFDM symbol as SSB for RLM, BFD, CBD, or L1-RSRP measurement in both FR1 and FR2?
question_56174.ground_truth: UE is not required to receive CSI-RS for BFD measurement in the PRBs that overlap with an SSB.

question_56175.question: What are the two procedures mentioned for checking UE reachability at EPC NAS level?
question_56175.ground_truth: The two procedures are the UE Reachability Notification Request procedure and the UE Activity Notification procedure.

question_56176.question: What is the role of SMF in deriving QoS profile and AQP(s) for each QoS flow in a service flow group?
question_56176.ground_truth: SMF derives QoS profile and AQP(s) for each QoS flow in a service flow group based on the PCC rule.

question_56177.question: What message does UE5 return if it accepts the request to establish a relay path via UE2?
question_56177.ground_truth: UE5 returns a connection establish response message to UE2 including an indication whether UE5 accepts the request to establish a relay path via UE2 or not.

question_56178.question: What is the procedure for UE-to-UE Relay discovery Model A?
question_56178.ground_truth: The procedure for UE-to-UE Relay discovery Model A involves UE-1 performing the Group Member Discovery procedure and discovering UE-R as its only neighbour. UE-R then performs the Group Member Discovery procedure and discovers both UE-1 and UE-2. UE-R decides that it can act as a UE-to-UE Relay and announces this by periodically transmitting an Announcement message. UE-1 then establishes a one-to-one communication link with UE-R and engages in communication with UE-2 via UE-R.

question_56179.question: When UE test loop mode B is used in Standalone NR, what entity's SDUs does the UE loop back?
question_56179.ground_truth: The UE loops back SDAP SDUs for bi-directional QoS Flows when UE test loop mode B is used in Standalone NR.

question_56180.question: When does SMF notify PCF to trigger a L4S QoS flow establishment?
question_56180.ground_truth: SMF notifies PCF to trigger a L4S QoS flow establishment when L4S traffic is detected and PCF is used for the authorization request.

question_56182.question: What action is taken when the sidelink radio link failure is detected for a specific destination in NR sidelink communication?
question_56182.ground_truth: When the sidelink radio link failure is detected for a specific destination, the PDCP entity, RLC entity, and the logical channel of the sidelink DRB for the specific destination are released.

question_56184.question: What type of information is contained in the "protocolIEs" field in the "ResourceStatusFailure" SEQUENCE?
question_56184.ground_truth: ProtocolIE-Container, which contains a list of ProtocolIE-SingleContainer objects.

question_56185.question: What is the measurement that provides the number of received MAC-e PDUs including acknowledged and unacknowledged PDUs during the period of measurement, detected in MAC-e layer in the serving E-DCH cell?

question_56190.question: In the case where the initial registration request cannot be accepted by the network and the AMF sends a REGISTRATION REJECT message to the UE, what action should the UE take when it receives a REGISTRATION REJECT message with cause #3 (Illegal UE) or #6 (Illegal ME)?
question_56190.ground_truth: The UE should set the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED, reset the registration attempt counter, and enter state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH.

question_56191.question: What message does the network send in response to a PACKET CS REQUEST message during MO Call Establishment - Allocation of CS Resources Only - Downlink TBF procedure?
question_56191.ground_truth: The network sends an encapsulated IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message in response to a PACKET CS REQUEST message during MO Call Establishment - Allocation of CS Resources Only - Downlink TBF procedure.

question_56192.question: What is the subject of 3GPP Technical Specification TS 28.653 for Release 17?
question_56192.ground_truth: The present document specifies the Solution Sets for the UTRAN NRM IRP.

question_56193.question: What is the role of the MME when interworking with 3GPP CS?
question_56193.ground_truth: When the MME supports the interworking to 3GPP CS, it supports the following functions: performing the PS bearer splitting function, handling the non-voice PS bearers handover, initiating the SRVCC handover procedure, coordinating PS handover and SRVCC handover procedures, and supporting interworking and SRVCC related functions for 1xRTT CDMA access.

question_56194.question: What is the function of the comfort noise evaluation algorithm in GSM mobile communications?
question_56194.ground_truth: The comfort noise evaluation algorithm calculates the comfort noise parameters over a period of time to overcome the problem of background acoustic noise disappearing when the radio transmission is switched off.

question_56196.question: How many bits are used for the HARQ index with offset if two TBs are scheduled?

question_56197.question: What is the general blocking requirement level for an MSR base station for both band categories?
question_56197.ground_truth: The same general blocking requirement level of +16~dBm is applicable for both band categories.

question_56199.question: What is the purpose of the Technical Specification Group (TSG) in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP)?
question_56199.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group (TSG) is responsible for producing and maintaining the set of specifications applicable to 3G-324M multimedia terminals in the 3GPP system.

question_56200.question: What is the rule for intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation in terms of CA adjacent channel leakage power ratio?
question_56200.ground_truth: The CA adjacent channel leakage power ratio is the ratio of the sum of the filtered mean power centred on each assigned channel frequency to the filtered mean power centred on an adjacent NR channel frequency at nominal channel spacing.

question_56201.question: Under what circumstances should the E-CSCF require the periodic refreshment of the session?
question_56201.ground_truth: The E-CSCF may require the periodic refreshment of the session if it requires the session to be refreshed to avoid hung states in the E-CSCF, provided support for this functionality is available in the UE or the PSAP or MGCF.

question_56202.question: What is the purpose of the HNBAP ASN.1 definition in the HNBAP standard?
question_56202.ground_truth: The HNBAP ASN.1 definition specifies the structure and content of HNBAP messages, allowing for a standardized communication between network functions in 3GPP cellular networks.

question_56203.question: What is the impact on the actual overall delays measured due to the TTI insertion uncertainty of the measurement report in DCCH?
question_56203.ground_truth: The actual overall delays measured may be up to 2xTTIDCCH higher than the measurement reporting delays above due to the TTI insertion uncertainty of the measurement report in DCCH.

question_56204.question: What is the expected choice of the source eNB for RRC and UP algorithms after a handover?
question_56204.ground_truth: If supported by the target eNB, the source eNB shall choose the currently used security algorithms. Otherwise, it shall select an algorithm based on the UE capabilities and allowed algorithms set for the UE.

question_56205.question: What protection relay sampling rate would result in a transfer interval of 0.833 ms for high speed current differential protection?

question_56207.question: Regarding the efficient representation of UE capabilities, what is one option among the three presented in TSG~RAN and SA~WG2?
question_56207.ground_truth: One option is using a newly defined identifier that potentially reflects the actual UE capabilities.

question_56208.question: What is the consequence of a mismatch in the HLC/LLC information element during a call set-up request?
question_56208.ground_truth: The MS will reject the offered call using the cause No.88 "Incompatible Destination".

question_56209.question: What is the CGI reporting delay defined as in the context of 3GPP TS 36.331?
question_56209.ground_truth: The CGI reporting delay is defined as the time between a command that will trigger a CGI report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface, excluding a delay uncertainty of 2 x TTIDCCH and any delay caused by lack of UL resources for UE to send the measurement report.

question_56210.question: What is the required format for at least one PoC Address?
question_56210.ground_truth: At least one PoC Address has to be in the format of a SIP URI.

question_56212.question: What conditions should be met for the UE to start reporting valid ACK/NACK for PCell?
question_56212.ground_truth: The UE should start reporting valid ACK/NACK for PCell from the first UL slot that occurs after the beginning of DL slot.

question_56213.question: What is the priority handling policy in the ISC gateway function?
question_56213.ground_truth: The ISC gateway function gives priority over other transactions or dialogs to requests that support priority, either through an authorized Resource-Priority header field or a temporarily authorized Resource-Priority header field. It adjusts the priority treatment of transactions or dialogs based on the most recently received authorized Resource-Priority header field or backwards indication value.

question_56215.question: What is the maximum interruption time for paging reception at intra-frequency cell re-selection when the target cell belongs to a different satellite than the current one and the target cell's satellite is non-GEO, and if the target cell is known?
question_56215.ground_truth: The maximum interruption time for paging reception at intra-frequency cell re-selection when the target cell belongs to a different satellite than the current one and the target cell's satellite is non-GEO, and if the target cell is known, is TSI-EUTRA-M1-EC + 125 ms.

question_56216.question: What is the Carrier Frequency Error conformance requirement for GSM 700, 850, 900, DCS 1800, and PCS 1 900?
question_56216.ground_truth: The Carrier Frequency Error for GSM 700, 850, 900, DCS 1800, and PCS 1 900 should be accurate to within 0,1 ppm compared to signals received from the BS for signal levels down to 3 dB below the reference sensitivity level.

question_56217.question: What should be taken as HARQ-ACK with priority index 1 for rate matching in the first scenario?
question_56217.ground_truth: HARQ-ACK with priority index 1 should be taken as HARQ-ACK for rate matching in the first scenario.

question_56218.question: What information should be provided by the PCF within the "umDecs" attribute to indicate the applicable threshold(s) for usage monitoring control?
question_56218.ground_truth: The PCF should include the volume threshold, time threshold, or both volume and time threshold in the "umDecs" attribute for each usage monitoring control instance to provide the initial threshold(s) to the SMF during PDU session establishment and modification.

question_56219.question: What is the role of the controlling MCPTT function when MCPTT clients are listening to the MBMS subchannel?
question_56219.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function sends multiple copies of the same media packet and Floor Idle/Taken message to each individual MCPTT client, while the participating MCPTT function only forwards one single media packet or message.

question_56220.question: When is a new data block added to the "List of Application Specific Data" attribute of the PF-DC-CDR?
question_56220.ground_truth: A new data block can be added to the list for all open group PF-DC-CDRs, when the UE sends usage information report(s) to the ProSe Function.

question_56221.question: What should the MCVideo client do if the received SIP MESSAGE request contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with an <affiliation-required> element set to "true"?
question_56221.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should affiliate to the MCVideo group identified by the <mcvideo-calling-group-id> element in the MIME body and invoke the procedures of clause 8.2.1.3 if it hasn't already.

question_56224.question: What is the purpose of the 7.68 Mcps TDD option in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_56224.ground_truth: The 7.68 Mcps TDD option in the 3GPP technical specification is an evolution of the 3.84 Mcps TDD option to a higher chip rate, providing significant enhancements in terms of user experience and capacity, with a focus on low-speed to medium-speed mobility scenarios.

question_56225.question: What is the role of the NRM server in inter-system switching from LTE eMBMS to 5G unicast PDU session?
question_56225.ground_truth: The NRM server provides VAL services to the client over 5G MBS sessions, either broadcast or multicast, after the VAL UE switches from the LTE network to 5G.

question_56226.question: What is the recommended mechanism for bundling an interactivity application with other associated content?
question_56226.ground_truth: The recommended mechanism is to define a means for uniquely identifying the interactivity application among the bundled content items.

question_56229.question: What happens if the registration request is not accepted by the MSGin5G Client on the MSGin5G UE?
question_56229.ground_truth: If the registration request is not accepted, the MSGin5G Client on the MSGin5G UE constructs the registration response and sends it to the application client on the non-MSGin5G UE, including the Registration Result indicating the registration is not accepted and the Failure Reason indicating an appropriate reason for the rejection.

question_56231.question: Which reference point connects with the 3GPP network system in one or more PLMN operator domain?

question_56232.question: What must a UE do when the 3GPP PS data off status is activated and the UE is being made to initiate a video call?
question_56232.ground_truth: If the 3GPP PS data off status is active, the UE does not send INVITE for video call.

question_56233.question: What happens when MCPTT client 1 sets its MCPTT emergency state?
question_56233.ground_truth: While MCPTT client 1 is in the emergency state, all MCPTT group and private calls initiated by MCPTT client 1 are initiated as MCPTT emergency calls.

question_56234.question: In the unacknowledged mode data and acknowledged mode data, what is the constraint on the length of RLC SDUs?
question_56234.ground_truth: The length of RLC SDUs is constrained to a multiple of 8 bits in unacknowledged mode data and acknowledged mode data.

question_56236.question: What should the HNB-GW include in the UE REGISTER ACCEPT message in case of CSG membership status update for a UE?
question_56236.ground_truth: The HNB-GW shall include the CSG Membership Status IE for the UE registering to the cell in the UE REGISTER ACCEPT message.

question_56237.question: What is the primary MCPTT system's role in initiating a group call involving groups from multiple MCPTT systems?
question_56237.ground_truth: The primary MCPTT system is responsible for getting the group information including the constituent MCPTT groups' identities, accessible group members list of the constituent groups, and other related data. It then initiates directly a call request to the accessible group members using the detailed user information and/or location information.

question_56238.question: What should a mobile station do if no measurement parameters are received from the old cell and none have been brought from the old cell, upon a cell change?
question_56238.ground_truth: The mobile station should use the broadcast measurement parameters from PSI5 or use the default parameter values in the new cell until a new PACKET MEASUREMENT ORDER message is received.

question_56240.question: What standard specifies the procedures for CS to PS handover within 3GPP access networks in the context of TS 23.216?
question_56240.ground_truth: TS 23.216 specifies the procedures for CS to PS handover within 3GPP access networks in the context of TS 23.216.

question_56242.question: What message does the MS send to the network if it cannot perform the measurement?
question_56242.ground_truth: The MS sends a RRLP MEASURE POSITION RESPONSE message containing a Location Error component with an error indication if the measurement is not possible.

question_56243.question: What information does the AMF determine to check the satellite backhaul for UE?
question_56243.ground_truth: The AMF determines whether the UE is accessing the network via satellite backhaul and the satellite category (GEO, MEO, LEO) if yes.

question_56244.question: What is the purpose of the "user-level blacklist" in the user profile?
question_56244.ground_truth: The user-level blacklist in the user profile enables the user to create and manipulate a list of users, identified by their addresses, from whom they do not want to receive messages.

question_56246.question: What is the agreed power class for capability signaling for all releases in RAN4?
question_56246.ground_truth: RAN4 agreed that the capability signaling applies for all power classes for both Rel-15 and Rel-16, in a release-independent manner.

question_56247.question: Where does the Session node appear in the hierarchical structure of session level QoE metrics definitions?
question_56247.ground_truth: The Session node is the starting point of the session level QoE metrics definitions.

question_56248.question: How is a MA-PDU session established when the UE is not registered via non-3GPP access during the initial session establishment?
question_56248.ground_truth: The MA-PDU session is established over 3GPP access initially, and user-plane resources over non-3GPP access are established later after the UE registers via non-3GPP access.

question_56251.question: What is the leaving condition for event A4H2 to be satisfied?
question_56251.ground_truth: At least one of condition A4H2-3 and condition A4H2-4 must be fulfilled.

question_56252.question: What are the minimum requirements for the reported CQI value to be in the range of +/-2 of the reported median for UE HS-DSCH categories 1-20 under AWGN environments?
question_56252.ground_truth: The reported CQI value should be in the range of +/-2 of the reported median more than 90% of the time. If the HS-PDSCH BLER using the transport format indicated by median CQI is less than or equal to 0.1, the BLER using the transport format indicated by the (median CQI +2) shall be greater than 0.1. If the HS-PDSCH BLER using the transport format indicated by the median CQI is greater than 0.1, the BLER using transport format indicated by (median CQI -1) shall be less than or equal to 0.1.

question_56253.question: What would be the source of the one-to-one communication security policy for the A-DDNMF and M-DDNMF in the discovery procedures?
question_56253.ground_truth: The security policy is obtained by the A-DDNMF and M-DDNMF from PCF or other selected methods during the normative phase.

question_56255.question: What is the impact of multi-homing based PSA addition to the PDU Session for IMS on the UE?
question_56255.ground_truth: Multi-homing based PSA addition to the PDU Session for IMS has an impact on the UE as it requires the addition of an additional PDU Session Anchor and Branching Point or UL CL, which can affect the UE's behavior.

question_56258.question: What are some policies that the Home KMS may apply around the use of external security domains?
question_56258.ground_truth: The Home KMS may apply policies around allowing KRRs, reporting KRRs, requiring signed KRRs, requesting unknown KMS certificates, and holding communication until KMS acceptance.

question_56259.question: What type of bearer service is used for the channel that is opened between the ME and UICC?
question_56259.ground_truth: The bearer service used is GPRS (General Packet Radio Service), a type of mobile data communication service.

question_56260.question: What is the difference between APR and RPR sub-modes in Connected Mode?
question_56260.ground_truth: In APR, the MS receives all PDCCHs transmitted by the base station, while in RPR, the MS receives a subset of the PDCCHs, allowing for power savings and provide the opportunity for additional data transfer.

question_56261.question: What are the essential components for providing communication services in a 5G network?
question_56261.ground_truth: The group of NG-RAN and 5GC nodes are essential for providing communication services in a 5G network.

question_56262.question: What is the potential issue with implementing Option B2a with a single duplexer using current filter technology?
question_56262.ground_truth: The potential issue with implementing Option B2a with a single duplexer is the small duplex gap, which makes it challenging to protect the upper part of the RX band from the own TX. This issue still exists even if the band is split into n71 and the additional frequency range as Option B2a.

question_56264.question: In FR1, DL+UL evaluation, DU, VR30, what is the mean power saving gain provided by the enhanced PDCCH monitoring adaptation with jitter handling scheme with marginal loss in DL+UL UE satisfied rate?
question_56264.ground_truth: The mean power saving gain provided by the enhanced PDCCH monitoring adaptation with jitter handling scheme in FR1, DL+UL evaluation, DU, VR30 is 40.64%.

question_56265.question: What should be used as the Application-Unique String in Annex C.4 when there are multiple PDN connections with different protocols?
question_56265.ground_truth: The least important retention (from the ARP value) PDN connections would have to be dropped until a list of viable SGW of one protocol meeting the retention policies is found.

question_56267.question: What is the function of the Mapping Resource Duration Indicator in the E-AGCH, and what is its size in bits?
question_56267.ground_truth: The Mapping Resource Duration Indicator in the E-AGCH indicates the duration of resource allocation. It is represented by 3 bits, if present.

question_56268.question: What are the two main types of mobile relay operation defined?
question_56268.ground_truth: The two main types of mobile relay operation defined in the technical report are in-band and out-band relay. In-band relay involves both the backhaul and access links using the same frequency band. Out-band relay uses separate frequency bands for the backhaul and access links.

question_56270.question: What is the normal burst transmitter output power measurement procedure?
question_56270.ground_truth: The SS takes power measurement samples evenly distributed over the duration of one burst with a sampling rate of at least 2/T, where T is the bit duration. The array of power samples measured are referenced in time to the centre of the useful transmitted bits and in power to the 0 dB reference, both identified in a.

question_56271.question: What is the purpose of receiving service information for a 3GPP UE in non-roaming scenarios?
question_56271.ground_truth: The purpose is to provision QoS Rules over S9a for offloaded traffic in the Fixed Broadband Access.

question_56272.question: What should the UE do to indicate a correct event in these tests?
question_56272.ground_truth: A correct event is defined as UE behaving correctly in all specified steps. The correct events observed during repeated tests should be at least 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_56273.question: What is one of the requirements for the Remote Driving use case group in terms of data rate?
question_56273.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall support user experienced data rate up to 1 Mbps at DL and 20 Mbps at UL for UE supporting V2X application between V2X application server and UE.

question_56274.question: What is the range of directions from the AAS BS where the EVM (Error Vector Magnitude) requirement is tested for conformance?
question_56274.ground_truth: For conformance testing, EVM is tested in the center direction and the 4 extreme directions in theta and phi of the OTA coverage range.

question_56275.question: What is used to signal the necessary information for DASH-based 3GPP VR delivery?
question_56275.ground_truth: The Adaptation Sets are included in a VR Media Presentation, documented in a DASH MPD, and the necessary MPD signaling is generated.

question_56276.question: Under what conditions should the UE send a NAS message completely unciphered?
question_56276.ground_truth: The UE should send a NAS message completely unciphered in the initial NAS message, except for the CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message including an ESM message container information element or a NAS message container information element.

question_56280.question: What message does the MCPTT server B send to release the MCPTT UE using a pre-established session from the MCPTT call?
question_56280.ground_truth: The MCPTT server B sends the DISCONNECT message to MCPTT UE-B over the pre-established bearer to release the MCPTT UE from the MCPTT call.

question_56281.question: What should be the maximum size of an RLC SDU segment if it is to be transmitted in the associated MAC entity?
question_56281.ground_truth: The UE should maximize the transmission of data and segment the RLC SDU to fill the grant of the associated MAC entity as much as possible.

question_56284.question: How should the relative order of attributes within a structured data type be interpreted?
question_56284.ground_truth: The relative order of attributes within a structured data type does not imply any specific ordering of the corresponding JSON elements in a JSON object. Attribute names within a structured data type should be unique, and implementations should not be dependent on attribute ordering.

question_56286.question: What is the main function of the CRC attachment step in the coding/multiplexing process in Flexible Layer One?
question_56286.ground_truth: The main function of the CRC attachment step is to provide error detection on transport blocks through a Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC).

question_56288.question: What is the format of the input data structure in the POST request for the NumOfUEsUpdate service operation?
question_56288.ground_truth: The input data structure in the POST request for the NumOfUEsUpdate service operation is called UeACRequestData, and it contains information such as the SUPI(s) of the UE(s), the access type, a list of S-NSSAIs subject to NSAC, and the NF Instance ID.

question_56289.question: How is the nominal channel spacing defined between two adjacent E-UTRA carriers, as defined in 5.4A.1?
question_56289.ground_truth: The nominal channel spacing between two adjacent E-UTRA carriers is defined as the average of the two respective E-UTRA channel bandwidths, (BWChannel(1) + BWChannel(2))/2

question_56291.question: What is the role of the SMF in ensuring in-sequence delivery for 5G LAN PDU session?
question_56291.ground_truth: The SMF indicates the UPF to remove the GTP-U SN of the packets of a 5G LAN PDU Session, before deliver it to internal interface and add GTP-U SN to packets received from N19 tunnel before sending to gNB.

question_56293.question: What is the negotiated mode for remotely changing another MCPTT user's affiliated MCPTT group(s)?
question_56293.ground_truth: The negotiated mode for remotely changing another MCPTT user's affiliated MCPTT group(s) is a procedure where the authorized user sends a MCPTT group affiliation change request to the primary MCPTT server, and the target MCPTT user needs to approve the change before it is implemented. The primary MCPTT server checks if the authorized user is authorized to initiate the change and if the target user is authorized for the requested affiliation relationship.

question_56294.question: Which scenario requires testing both at the repeater passband edges and inside the sub-block gaps?
question_56294.ground_truth: For non-contiguous spectrum operation, some requirements apply both at the repeater passband edges and inside the sub-block gaps.

question_56296.question: What is the minimum number of cells that the FDD Relative RSRQ Accuracy for E-UTRA Carrier Aggregation test applies to?
question_56296.ground_truth: The FDD Relative RSRQ Accuracy for E-UTRA Carrier Aggregation test applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 11 and forward that support CA with at least two cells.

question_56297.question: Which mechanism is used to securely negotiate the algorithm and integrity algorithm used for securing data on the network access link?
question_56297.ground_truth: A security mode negotiation between the user and the network is used to securely negotiate the algorithms.

question_56299.question: What action does the PCRF take if the usage allowance for a certain IP-CAN session is exceeded?
question_56299.ground_truth: The PCRF deducts the value of the usage report from the totally allowed usage for that PDN and UE, minimizing the risk of exceeding the usage allowance.

question_56300.question: What are the power classes used to define the maximum output power for any transmission bandwidth within the channel bandwidth in E-UTRA?
question_56300.ground_truth: UE power classes 1 and 3 are currently specified in TS 36.101.

question_56301.question: What were the three options identified to resolve the issue of supporting type B PUCCH repetitions with different PUCCH formats?
question_56301.ground_truth: Option 1: restrict type B PUCCH repetition applicable to actual repetitions with the same PUCCH format, Option 2: allow type B PUCCH repetition with different PUCCH formats, Option 3: introduce and specify PUCCH format 3/4 of length 1/2/3 OFDM symbols to support type B PUCCH repetition.

question_56302.question: What is the effect of the Concurrent Warning Message (CWM) indicator in the Write-Replace Warning Request NG-RAN message in the warning message delivery procedure?
question_56302.ground_truth: The CBCF sets the CWM indicator in all Write-Replace Warning Request NG-RAN messages, if the PLMN or SNPN supports concurrent warning message broadcasts.

question_56303.question: What is the behavior defined in clause 4.5.7.2.1 and how does it apply during the IKE tunnel establishment procedure?
question_56303.ground_truth: The behavior defined in clause 4.5.7.2.1 requires the UE to provide an indication that the EPC access is for emergency services. This indication is used by the 3GPP AAA server to give precedence to this session in case of signaling congestion and for unauthenticated UE without roaming permission to not carry out roaming and location checks for this UE.

question_56304.question: What message does the UE send in the first step of the SIP based MBMS User Service Registration procedure?
question_56304.ground_truth: The UE sends a SIP INVITE message to the SCF via the IM CN subsystem.

question_56306.question: What element type appears as the base type for multiple extensions in the XML schema?
question_56306.ground_truth: The "xe:Notification" element type appears as the base type for multiple extensions in the XML schema.

question_56307.question: What should the SCC AS or controller UE check for replication authorization?
question_56307.ground_truth: The SCC AS or controller UE should check for specific protocol indications for replication authorization, and a specific protocol indication might be needed to authorize the request for replication.

question_56308.question: What will the MS do when it receives the GA-RRC DEACTIVATE CHANNEL message for a specific circuit transport channel?
question_56308.ground_truth: The MS will deactivate the identified CTC and send a GA-RRC DEACTIVATE CHANNEL COMPLETE message to the GANC when it receives the GA-RRC DEACTIVATE CHANNEL message for a specific circuit transport channel.

question_56309.question: What is the meaning of the term "TLIV encoded" in the context of information elements?
question_56309.ground_truth: TLIV encoded means that an information element is encoded using Type, Length, Instance, and Value fields.

question_56310.question: Under what conditions does the EES store common EAS information and related Application Group ID?
question_56310.ground_truth: If common EAS information related to the Application Group ID is not available, and the EES needs to select the common EAS, the EES identifies an EAS for the Application Group ID based on the provided EAS discovery filters and stores the common EAS information and related Application Group ID.

question_56313.question: What are the key aspects of system performance that the evaluation and selection process in the 3GPP technical report aims to improve?
question_56313.ground_truth: The key aspects include improving bandwidth efficiency, reliability, decoding resource requirements, and addressing backward compatibility issues.

question_56314.question: What are the steps involved in delivering MT small data in this solution?
question_56314.ground_truth: When the C-SGN receives a small data packet to a device which is in idle mode, the MME initiates a paging procedure, encrypts the small data packet and adds a security header, and sends a paging request to all selected RAN nodes. The RAN node performs paging and delivers the MT small data packet to the UE, sending a message to the C-SGN to confirm delivery.

question_56316.question: What is the requirement for the Ta reference point for supporting QoS differentiation in trusted non-3GPP access?
question_56316.ground_truth: The Ta reference point should be able to carry the TNAP ID to the TNGF for supporting QoS differentiation in trusted non-3GPP access.

question_56317.question: Which fields are included in the FCS calculation for UIH frames?
question_56317.ground_truth: The FCS is calculated for UIH frames over the address, control, and length fields only, not the information field.

question_56319.question: What determines if a target can be a non-local ID in provisioning POIs and TFs?
question_56319.ground_truth: A target can be a non-local ID only when the service type is Voice or Messaging.

question_56321.question: What does the MCData server do when all types of disposition IE are not included in a unicast downlink delivery to MCData clients who are not in the MCData ID list?
question_56321.ground_truth: The MCData server does not send the MCData group standalone data request to those clients.

question_56322.question: When is the MS not allowed to include the Mobile Identity IE in the CIPHERING MODE COMPLETE message?
question_56322.ground_truth: When the MS receives the CIPHERING MODE COMMAND message with Cipher Response bit set to "IMEISV shall not be included".

question_56323.question: When an MSRP SEND request for file distribution contains multiple chunks, what should the terminating MCData client do when it receives each chunk?
question_56323.ground_truth: It should wait until all further partial message chunks have been received, reassemble them, and then process the entire set of chunks as a single file.

question_56327.question: Who triggers the HTTP digest authentication procedure towards the UE in 10.2.2?
question_56327.ground_truth: The SSF (Service Switching Function) triggers the HTTP digest authentication procedure towards the UE in 10.2.2.

question_56328.question: What is the function of the S9a interface in the 3GPP and BBF architecture?
question_56328.ground_truth: The S9a interface in the 3GPP and BBF architecture provides transfer of dynamic QoS control policies from the H(e)NB Policy Function to the BBF Policy BPCF.

question_56329.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) and what is the purpose of its Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network?
question_56329.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) is a collaboration between multiple telecommunications standard development organizations. The Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network is responsible for defining the radio aspect of the 3GPP system, including the User Equipment (UE) and Mobile Station (MS) over-the-air performance requirements.

question_56330.question: When does the corresponding node report the highest NR PDCP sequence number in case of RLC AM in the Downlink Data Delivery Status procedure?
question_56330.ground_truth: The highest NR PDCP sequence number is reported in case of RLC AM, as the highest NR PDCP PDU sequence number successfully delivered in sequence to the UE among those NR PDCP PDUs received from the node hosting the NR PDCP entity, excluding retransmission NR PDCP PDUs.

question_56331.question: What is required for a UE that starts an emergency session and has not yet made an initial attach in E-UTRAN?
question_56331.ground_truth: The UE should not perform an emergency attach procedure until it is in limited service mode and attempting to set up an emergency session.

question_56332.question: What is the status code that the TSCTSF responds with, upon receiving responses from each DS-TT and NW-TT?

question_56333.question: What interfaces support the use of FQPCs and RPCs in EPC for the Ga interface?
question_56333.ground_truth: Both FQPCs and RPCs can be supported on the Ga interface in EPC, with the support of FQPCs being mandatory and RPCs being optional.

question_56335.question: What is required before a conventional LMR user can be authenticated and authorized to use the MC service server?
question_56335.ground_truth: The conventional LMR user must be registered and the user must be authenticated and authorized to use the MC service server.

question_56336.question: What are the functions of the RLC entity?
question_56336.ground_truth: The RLC entity is responsible for the segmentation and reassembly of variable-length upper layer PDUs into/from smaller RLC PDUs, concatenation, padding, transfer of user data, error correction, in-sequence delivery of upper layer PDUs, duplicate detection, flow control, sequence number check, protocol error detection and recovery, ciphering, and SDU discard.

question_56337.question: What information does the PDN GW use to select the PDN connection in the case when the PDN~GW receives a PBU containing an IPv6 prefix or an IPv4 address associated to one of the PDN connections?
question_56337.ground_truth: The PDN GW uses the IPv6 prefix or the IPv4 address to select the PDN connection out of the active PDN connections.

question_56338.question: What is the format for carrying multiple data sets in a single message in the context of ion layer protocols?
question_56338.ground_truth: The format is called multipart and the messages are known as multipart messages.

question_56339.question: What is the purpose of P.R.5.9-001 in the 3GPP system?
question_56339.ground_truth: The purpose of P.R.5.9-001 is to provide a method that minimizes the decline of service experience from UAV to UAV controller due to data network reasons.

question_56340.question: What is the purpose of the "contextSelectivity" property?
question_56340.ground_truth: The "contextSelectivity" property represents the constraints and conditions that should apply for the entire intent, even if there may be specific contexts defined for specific parts of the intent.

question_56342.question: What should not be modified for supporting the SIP Digest-based SSO service in IMS core network nodes?
question_56342.ground_truth: IMS core network nodes shall not be modified for supporting the SIP Digest-based SSO service.

question_56344.question: What restrictions are placed on the UP Security Policy sent from the SMF to the gNBs for establishing PDU sessions with UEs belonging to the same 5GLAN Group?
question_56344.ground_truth: The SMF shall not send the "Preferred" option for encryption and integrity protection, and the gNBs shall not override the received UP Security Policy.

question_56345.question: What are the target MOS scores for the bit rate calculation in the subjective tests?
question_56345.ground_truth: The target MOS scores for the bit rate calculation are 3.5, which is in between "Fair" and "Good".

question_56346.question: What is the purpose of GTP-C load control in the SGW or PGW selection?
question_56346.ground_truth: GTP-C load control allows for the advertising of load information at node level, i.e. the SGW or PGW load, and selecting the target node based on this information, avoiding the need for code space coordination between AMF Region ID and MMEGI for EPS interworking with 5GS.

question_56347.question: What information is transferred via GTP tunnels using the APN-AMBR?
question_56347.ground_truth: The APN-AMBR (Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate) is used to specify the maximum bitrate per UE for each radio network technology (RNTG) delivered to the PDN address of a particular APN. The sending entity copies the value part of the AMBR into the Value field of the AMBR (APN-AMBR) IE when transferring via GTP tunnels.

question_56349.question: What is the role of the ARF in the L-DN DNS Server case when it provides an IP address?
question_56349.ground_truth: The ARF resolves the FQDN into an IP address, sends a DNS Reply to the UE, and triggers the 5G core network to insert a local UPF in the data path for routing traffic between the Application Client in the UE and the Application Server in the L-DN.

question_56350.question: What is the responsibility of the RAN if a location request is made on a non-speech circuit call?
question_56350.ground_truth: If a location request is made on a non-speech circuit call, it is up to the RAN to decide whether positioning is possible based on the applicable position methods and requested QoS.

question_56352.question: What is the role of the V-PCRF in enforcing visited operator policies for roaming scenarios?
