question_57671.ground_truth: The boresight direction of DL PRS, beam information of DL PRS, the granularity of boresight direction of DL-PRS and its influence on positioning integrity, the feasibility and complexity of modelling boresight direction and beam information, the feasibility of obtaining quality/statistical parameters of beam information from gNB, and the influence on measurement errors at the UE should be considered further during normative work.

question_57674.question: How long is the TEID-C valid for S3, S10, S16, and N26 interfaces?
question_57674.ground_truth: A TEID-C on the S3/S10/S16/N26 interface shall be released after its associated UE context is removed or the UE is detached.

question_57675.question: What are the service preconditions for the load control use case in the power distribution grid?
question_57675.ground_truth: The load control terminals report the total amount of interruptible load, and a test instrument simulates the HVDC transmission fault and sends fault analyses to the control primary station.

question_57677.question: What should the SS PER decoder accept in the UL direction when distinguishing the extension and padding parts is not required?
question_57677.ground_truth: The SS PER decoder should match and accept RRC PDUs with any bit string in the extension and padding parts, and discard the remaining part of the received bit string regardless of the RLC mode.

question_57679.question: What should the network do if it is in the "CC-establishment confirmed" state and it receives a CC-ESTABLISHMENT CONFIRMED message without a Supported Codec List information element?
question_57679.ground_truth: For UMTS, the network shall select the default UMTS speech codec. For GERAN, the network shall select GSM full rate speech version 1.

question_57680.question: In the context of 3GPP System Architecture Evolution Security Architecture, what is forward security in the context of KeNB key derivation?
question_57680.ground_truth: In the context of KeNB key derivation, forward security refers to the property that, for an eNB with knowledge of a KeNB, shared with a UE, it shall be computationally infeasible to predict any future KeNB, that will be used between the same UE and another eNB.

question_57681.question: What is the meaning of "shall" in 3GPP technical specifications and reports?
question_57681.ground_truth: "Shall" in 3GPP technical specifications and reports indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

question_57682.question: What organizations contribute to the development of the 3GPP technical specifications?
question_57682.ground_truth: The 3GPP (3rd Generation Partnership Project) Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG RAN) develops the 3GPP technical specifications for the NG-RAN, NR-MIB, and Xn interfaces.

question_57683.question: What RDF schema is used for the PSS device capability profile structure?
question_57683.ground_truth: The PSS device capability profile structure follows the RDF schema of the CC/PP framework and UAProf.

question_57685.question: In the above passage, what is the requirement for a UE in Automatic Mode when looking for a higher priority PLMN of the same country as the currently registered PLMN?
question_57685.ground_truth: A UE in Automatic Mode shall make periodic attempts to look for a higher priority PLMN of the same country as the currently registered PLMN. For the ranking of PLMNs, the UE shall use the order used in subclause 3.2.2.2. In the case that the MS has stored a list of equivalent PLMNs, the UE shall only select a PLMN if it has a higher priority than all the PLMNs, in the list of equivalent PLMNs, which are of the same country as the currently registered PLMN.

question_57687.question: What action is the mobile station required to take when the network sends an Immediate Packet Assignment message with an assigned block period?
question_57687.ground_truth: The mobile station may use the block period to send a PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message to initiate the two-phase access defined in 3GPP TS 04.018.

question_57688.question: How many blocks are transmitted by the SS with incorrect BCS in the first set of tests?

question_57690.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon receiving a SIP INVITE message for an MCVideo remote initiated ambient viewing call, if the UE is already registered and authorized for the MCVideo Service?
question_57690.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should send a SIP 200 (OK) message and respect the Transmission Control imposed by the MCVideo Server.

question_57691.question: What is the maximum allowed intermodulation component level in dBm for all intermodulation products in the relevant TX band, for multicarrier BTS in the case where the RF transmit equipment is operating with one carrier?
question_57691.ground_truth: The intermodulation products shall never exceed -16 dBm, measured in a 100 kHz bandwidth.

question_57692.question: What is the role of the RFCS profile in the provisioning of a RFCS?
question_57692.ground_truth: The RFCS profile holds all information needed to describe the capabilities of an RFCS and provides a set of parameters for each instance of an RFCS.

question_57694.question: What is the purpose of ANDSF-provided Inter-System Routing Policy (ISRP) rules?
question_57694.ground_truth: The ISRP is a set of operator-defined rules that the UE uses to route IP traffic simultaneously over multiple radio access interfaces when available. The rules help the UE meet operator routing preferences and offload preferences by deciding when a particular access technology or access network is restricted for a specific IP traffic flow and selecting the most preferable access technologies or access networks for routing IP traffic.

question_57695.question: What is the Uplink Information Exchange Request sequence used for?
question_57695.ground_truth: The Uplink Information Exchange Request sequence is used in 3GPP network protocols to request the transfer of specific information from a remote network.

question_57696.question: What is the protocol and the function of the AMF in the network?
question_57696.ground_truth: The Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF) is a function in the 5G Core Network (5GC) that performs the user's access and mobility management. It is defined in TS~23.501 of the 3GPP specifications. The AMF is responsible for the network access control, authentication and authorization of the UE, connection establishment and release, session management, and mobility management. It communicates with the other functions in the 5GC to provide a seamless and secure experience for the user.

question_57697.question: What is the requirement for UE to report CQI index = 0 when the UE has available uplink resources for reporting CQI for the SCell?
question_57697.ground_truth: UE shall report CQI index = 0 (out of range) as defined in section 7.7.3 when the UE has available uplink resources for reporting CQI for the SCell.

question_57699.question: What is the recommended action for spare bits included in the MM Context IE of GTPv1?
question_57699.ground_truth: Spare bits in the MM Context IE of GTPv1 should be set to 1's before sending the MM Context IE to Gn/Gp SGSN.

question_57700.question: What should the 3GPP network support for QoS for services hosted closer to the end user?
question_57700.ground_truth: The 3GPP network should be able to support QoS for services hosted closer to the end user.

question_57701.question: What is the functional area that allows the operator to detect the occurrence of faults in the network in real-time?

question_57703.question: What does the PGW use to know how much data has been sent on licensed access and how much data has been sent over unlicensed spectrum for each IP packet in the case of home-routed roaming scenario?
question_57703.ground_truth: The PGW can know this by reading the access type indication and incrementing the appropriate counter(s).

question_57706.question: What is the maximum RRC procedure delay defined in 3GPP TS 36.331 clause 11.2?
question_57706.ground_truth: The maximum RRC procedure delay is 15 ms.

question_57707.question: What is the suggested method of addressing threat 7 (DoS type attacks) for the described solution?
question_57707.ground_truth: For threat 7a, an attacker removing a USIM may simply cause physical damage; there is no clear way to mitigate this Threat 7b can be addressed by binding a USIM with a specific RN in the MME during the authentication process, as the MME authenticates both USIM and RN entities.

question_57708.question: What should a floor participant do when it receives a Floor Release message and the SSRC in the message matches with the stored SSRC of the current arbitrator or with the stored SSRC of the candidate arbitrator?
question_57708.ground_truth: The floor participant should provide floor idle notification to the MCPTT user, stop timer T203 (End of RTP media), start timer T230 (Inactivity), clear the stored SSRC of the candidate arbitrator, clear the stored SSRC of the current arbitrator, and enter the 'O: silence' state.

question_57709.question: What are the scheduling restrictions on UE performing L1-RSRP measurement on FR2 during TRP specific candidate beam detection?
question_57709.ground_truth: The UE is not expected to transmit or receive certain types of data on reference symbols to be measured for TRP specific candidate beam detection.

question_57711.question: What is the first method described for preserving the user plane state when a user equipment (UE) relocates, called the "application domain aware procedure"?
question_57711.ground_truth: In this method, the edge application server (EAS) in the current location sends a URL for a local anycast address that primarily selects the same server instance, even when a new location is chosen for the UE. This is done to ensure that the flow state is persisted in the same server instance during any relocation procedures.

question_57713.question: What is a potential solution to interoperability issues caused by multiple options co-existence?
question_57713.ground_truth: Recommending or mandating the support of certain core features for NFs complying with 3GPP Release 17.

question_57717.question: What is the function of the "Handover-Info" header field when reaching a UE?
question_57717.ground_truth: The "Handover-Info" header field when reaching a UE only contains information of whether the UE initiated or terminated the call which does not have any security or privacy impacts.

question_57718.question: What is the 3GPP organization responsible for in the context of mobile telecommunications?
question_57718.ground_truth: The 3GPP (3rd Generation Partnership Project) is a collaboration between multiple telecommunications standard development organizations, responsible for producing technical specifications for mobile communications systems, including E-UTRA (Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access) and the Packet Data Convergence Protocol (PDCP).

question_57719.question: What is the purpose of the Iupc interface in the UTRAN architecture?
question_57719.ground_truth: The Iupc interface in the UTRAN architecture connects the RNC to a supported Positioning NodeB (SAS) to provide full internal support for the user equipment (UE) positioning method.

question_57720.question: What is the requirement for UE when using SyncRefUE on a carrier frequency subject to CCA to derive transmission timing for V2X sidelink communication?
question_57720.ground_truth: The UE shall meet all the transmit timing requirements defined in clause 12.2.5 provided that at least one S-SSB is available at the UE during the last 160ms.

question_57722.question: What modifications are made to the coding schemes in section 11.7?
question_57722.ground_truth: The coding schemes of RLC data are modified by aggregating two uplink allocated timeslots of RTTI TBF and bearing the short bitmap, thus the RLC data payload and its coding scheme can be maintained as before.

question_57723.question: What is the role of the 'layer' value in visually composed tracks including video and text?
question_57723.ground_truth: The 'layer' value is used for layering visually composed tracks, comparing to z-index in SMIL. More negative layer values are towards the viewer.

question_57724.question: What action does the TSCTSF take when an AF-requested (g)PTP time synchronization service is allowed for the UE and DNN/S-NSSAI?
question_57724.ground_truth: The TSCTSF creates an AF-session and stores the DNN, S-NSSAI, IP address, and SUPI for the AF-session.

question_57725.question: What are the benefits of the small data solution in LTE?
question_57725.ground_truth: The small data solution has the benefits of no establishment of DRBs and no resource reservation over the radio interface, reduced signalling procedures in the core network and radio interface.

question_57727.question: What is the CAMEL Prepaid Warning Tone signal used for?
question_57727.ground_truth: The CAMEL Prepaid Warning Tone signal is used to generate a CAMEL prepaid warning tone to inform the party that the Max Call Period Duration is about to expire.

question_57729.question: What is the purpose of the RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message in the context of reporting errors?
question_57729.ground_truth: When the RESOURCE STATUS INDICATION message is used to report an error, only one cause value for all reported objects can be sent in one message.

question_57730.question: What is one of the 3GPP system's capabilities for providing 3GPP services to UEs using various access networks?
question_57730.ground_truth: The 3GPP system can support at least the following 3GPP/non-3GPP access interworking capabilities: Inter-system mobility between 3GPP and non-3GPP access networks.

question_57731.question: What should the UE do if the Back-off timer value IE is not included or no Back-off timer value is received from the 5GMM sublayer?
question_57731.ground_truth: The UE may send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message or PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message for the same S-NSSAI or without an S-NSSAI.

question_57732.question: What is the role of the Application Function (AF) in the described solution?
question_57732.ground_truth: The Application Function (AF) is responsible for requesting SFC policies and influencing traffic routing to an N6-LAN based on predefined SFC policies. The AF can become aware of available SFC policies through SLA agreements or by querying the 3GPP network via a new SBI interface.

question_57734.question: What is the behavior of the gsmSCF if it returns a Continue information flow for an MO, MF, or TO call?
question_57734.ground_truth: If the gsmSCF returns a Continue information flow, the call shall continue with the original CUG information unchanged.

question_57735.question: What kind of data does the MDAS producer require to generate the traffic analytics report?
question_57735.ground_truth: The MDAS producer requires performance measurements, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and data defined in specific technical standards such as TS 28.552, TS 28.554, TS 37.320, and TS 32.422.

question_57736.question: What is the role of the PoC AS (A) in the pre-established session with automatic answer?
question_57736.ground_truth: The PoC AS (A) establishes the pre-established session for PoC communication and routes the session establishment request to the PoC AS (A). It also sends an INVITE request to PoC AS (B) and acknowledges the media establishment request message, sending a talk burst confirm to UE-A.

question_57737.question: What HTTP status code is returned when the resource for updating the PSI activation state does not exist?

question_57738.question: What must the S-CSCF do when the HSS indicates that another S-CSCF is already assigned for the user?
question_57738.ground_truth: The S-CSCF must return a 305 (Use Proxy) response containing the SIP URI of the assigned S-CSCF.

question_57739.question: Which step in the Movement Behaviour Analytics procedure does the NWDAF derive the Movement Behaviour Analytics based on the data collected from the AMF and/or GMLC?

question_57740.question: What is the role of timing advance in the uplink in a wireless communication system?
question_57740.ground_truth: Timing advance is used in uplink to align the uplink radio signals from the user equipment (UE) to the UTRAN both in case of uplink Dedicated Physical Channels (DPCH), E-PUCH, E-RUCCH and of Physical Uplink Shared Channels (PUSCH). The handling of timing advance can be divided into four main categories: measurement, initial assignment, updates during operation, and setting on handover.

question_57744.question: Which circuit numbers are used in the transparent mode for mapping DTE/DCE signalling information to Dm channel and in-band signalling information?
question_57744.ground_truth: The circuit numbers used are those specified in V.24 for mapping DTE/DCE signalling information to Dm channel and in-band signalling information in the transparent mode.

question_57745.question: What is the requirement for decoder conformance testing?
question_57745.ground_truth: The decoder conformance testing is carried out using "black-box" tests, where the decoder's output is compared to the reference decoder's output for specific input test vectors, various codec operation modes, and bit rates.

question_57746.question: What should the service consumer include in the request body when sending an HTTP POST request to the NSCE server to request the creation of a Slice Related Communication Service?
question_57746.ground_truth: The SliceCommService data structure should be included in the request body.

question_57750.question: What is the difference between NCR-Fwd type 1-C and NCR-Fwd type 1-H in terms of transmit spurious emissions requirements?
question_57750.ground_truth: NCR-Fwd type 1-H has more stringent requirements, where the power summation emissions at the TAB connectors of the TAB connectors of the TAB connector TX min cell group shall not exceed a limit specified as the basic limit + X, while NCR-Fwd type 1-C has a less stringent requirement where the tx spurious emissions shall not exceed the basic limits specified in clause 6.5.4.2.

question_57751.question: In which 5GSM sublayer state does the UE have initiated a PDU session release procedure towards the network and is waiting for a response from the network?

question_57752.question: How much of a beam prediction accuracy increase was achieved by AI/ML in terms of Top-1 beam prediction accuracy, when using measurements from 5 time instances with a measurement periodicity of 160ms?
question_57752.ground_truth: AI/ML can increase the beam prediction accuracy by 22.5%.

question_57753.question: For which UE power classes and test frequencies is the 5.6.1.3 test case incomplete?
question_57753.ground_truth: The 5.6.1.3 test case is incomplete for UE power classes other than PC3 and incomplete for test frequencies > 40.8 GHz.

question_57754.question: In what substate would the UE be if the UE fails to find a cell during the cell selection procedure in the EMM state?

question_57755.question: What is the condition for the UE to deliver the reassembled SDU to upper layers when the RLC entity receives an UMD PDU?
question_57755.ground_truth: The UE delivers the reassembled SDU to upper layers when all byte segments with a specific SN are received and placed into the reception buffer.

question_57757.question: What is used as the HARQ process identifier for UL transmission with an UL grant in RA Response or for UL transmission for MSG payload?

question_57758.question: What is the purpose of the Port management information container in the 3GPP specification?
question_57758.ground_truth: The Port management information container IE is used to convey a port management information container when the UE needs to convey it.

question_57759.question: What is required for supporting change of area for a detached UE via GMLC?
question_57759.ground_truth: Supporting change of area for a detached UE via GMLC requires functional enhancements to LCS service architecture, as the conditions under which it is allowed are very restrictive, and deferred reporting functionality, as defined in TS-23.271, is not presently supported for E-UTRAN access.

question_57760.question: What status code does the Broadcast Message Gateway send to the MSGin5G Server in response to a successful delivery of a message?
question_57760.ground_truth: The Broadcast Message Gateway responds to the MSGin5G Server with a 204 No Content message when the message delivery is successful.

question_57761.question: For which scenarios is no characterization possible in the process of comparing a codec against H.265/HEVC SCC (Screen-Extended Main 10 profile)?
question_57761.ground_truth: Scenario 1 and scenario 4 have no characterization possible.

question_57762.question: What is the primary purpose of the real-time hydrographic and environmental information service (IMO MSP 15)?
question_57762.ground_truth: The real-time hydrographic and environmental information service is essential to safeguard navigation at sea and protect the environment by providing real-time information about the sea and environmental conditions.

question_57763.question: When must the UE return the OTDOA measures to the SRNC?
question_57763.ground_truth: The UE returns the OTDOA measures to the SRNC after the SRNC requests measurement of the OTDOA for the signals in the active and neighborhood sets in step 4.

question_57765.question: What does the solution 12 focus on, based on the 3GPP specification?
question_57765.ground_truth: Solution 12 presents a new SBA service to optimize Cx operations between IMS and CSCF, in order to avoid the issues associated with using existing Release 15 UDM services for the same purpose.

question_57766.question: What should the UE do if the last established PDU session is an emergency PDU session and the UDM has not requested an acknowledgment from the UE?
question_57766.ground_truth: The UE shall attempt to perform the PLMN selection after the release of the emergency PDU session and expiration of timer T.

question_57767.question: What is the purpose of defining several permutations for each given MAIOA size?
question_57767.ground_truth: It requires another parameter, a MAIO permutation number (MAIOPN), to be signaled to the mobile station to select the specific permutation to use.

question_57769.question: What is the formula for the nominal CDP ratio in the communication system?
question_57769.ground_truth: The nominal CDP ratio is calculated using the formula: 10*log((Nominal CDP) / (Sum of all nominal CDPs)).

question_57770.question: What is the definition of an "Entry point" in the context of the 3GPP TISPAN endorsement for TISPAN NGN requirements?
question_57770.ground_truth: An "Entry point" refers to the IBCF, which provides "border control concepts" as specified in 3GPP TS 23.228. In this case, the IBCF acts as an entry point for the network, and if "border control concepts" aren't applied, the I-CSCF acts as an entry point.

question_57772.question: What information does the MNO use to define traffic steering policies in the FMSS study?
question_57772.ground_truth: The MNO uses information such as user profile, RAT type, application characteristics, etc. to define traffic steering policies in the FMSS study.

question_57773.question: Which message IE includes control information related to the security protection of a 5GMM message and is 4 bits in size?

question_57774.question: What should the gNB-DU do when it has received the Polluted Measurement Indicator IE in the UE context setup procedure?
question_57774.ground_truth: The gNB-DU should include the information contained in the Polluted Measurement Indicator IE as part of the measurement report to be sent to the TCE if it has received the Polluted Measurement Indicator IE in the UE context setup procedure.

question_57775.question: What parameter does the postAsBERTLV method take in addition to statusType?

question_57776.question: What is the role of the AF in determining port pairs for DS-TT ports?
question_57776.ground_truth: The AF determines port pairs for DS-TT ports based on the DS-TT information of the DS-TT ports and calculates the bridge delay for the port pair.

question_57777.question: Which subclause specifies the minimum requirement for output power dynamics for NB-IoT operation in NR in-band?
question_57777.ground_truth: Subclause 6.3.5 specifies the minimum requirement for output power dynamics for NB-IoT operation in NR in-band.

question_57778.question: What is the Avp Code of the QoS-Capability AVP defined in IETF RFC 5777 in 3GPP AAA protocol?

question_57780.question: When is the controlling MCVideo function required to send a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response to the originating network with a warning text set to "120 user is not affiliated to this group"?
question_57780.ground_truth: When the user identified by the MCVideo ID is not affiliated with the MCVideo group ID associated with the MCVideo session identity.

question_57781.question: How is the per-UE per-AV application layer master session key (Ks) derived in this solution?
question_57781.ground_truth: The per-UE per-AV application layer master session key (Ks) is derived from the CK and IK generated during the 3GPP-AKA procedure in the HSS.

question_57784.question: In the context of the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message, what should the Node B include in the Additional E-DCH Cell Information Response RL Add IE if it supports activation of power balancing for the Additional E-DCH RL by the message and the power balancing is active for the Additional E-DCH RL?
question_57784.ground_truth: The Node B should include the DL Power Balancing Activation Indicator IE.

question_57785.question: Which parameter is used in E-UTRAN and NG-RAN to indicate the identity of an Operation and Maintenance Centre to which Trace Records shall be sent?

question_57787.question: What happens when T1 expires?
question_57787.ground_truth: When T1 expires, either a disconnect demand is sent, or there is no user responding.

question_57788.question: What is required for the AF to indicate a certain media component version to the PCRF?
question_57788.ground_truth: The AF may assign a content version to the media component related to certain service and provide the PCRF with the Content-Version AVP as part of the Media-Component-Description AVP.

question_57789.question: What is the purpose of scheduling the segment availability start time with a small safety delay in the MPD for content authors?
question_57789.ground_truth: This allows the content author to avoid too aggressive requests, have flexibility in publishing segments, and provide a certain amount of safety margins, although it may lead to slightly increased end-to-end latencies.

question_57790.question: What is HS-DSCH-FDD-Secondary-Serving-Information-Response used for?
question_57790.ground_truth: HS-DSCH-FDD-Secondary-Serving-Information-Response is used to convey information to the secondary UE related to the Uplink Secondary Serving Resources

question_57791.question: In what scenario must the UE include a "response" Authorization header field parameter in the SQN?
question_57791.ground_truth: When the SQN is out of range.

question_57792.question: What action does a UE need to take if the de-registration type is "re-registration not required" and the 5GMM cause is "Illegal UE"?
question_57792.ground_truth: The UE may enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH for PLMN selection.

question_57794.question: What message is used by the mobile station to respond to a poll from the network in the context of GPRS?
question_57794.ground_truth: The mobile station responds to a poll by sending a PACKET DOWNLINK ACK/NACK or a PACKET CONTROL ACKNOWLEDGEMENT message in the uplink radio block specified by the RRBP field.

question_57795.question: What is the function of the "PDU session ID" in the DL NAS TRANSPORT message?
question_57795.ground_truth: The "PDU session ID" in the DL NAS TRANSPORT message is included by the AMF when the Payload container type IE is set to "N1 SM information" or "CIoT user data container" to indicate the PDU session.

question_57797.question: Which network type does the MCVideo service primarily focus on, but not limited to?
question_57797.ground_truth: The MCVideo service primarily focuses on transport over commercial and dedicated 3GPP networks, although it may be used in other networks.

question_57798.question: How much coupling loss is required for the limited service transmitter to LTE450 BS in order to have a 1 dB desense?
question_57798.ground_truth: 106 dB of connector to connector coupling loss is required.

question_57799.question: What action is taken by the IBCF-hA1 when receiving a 183 (Session Progress) response?
question_57799.ground_truth: The IBCF-hA1 releases resources reserved in the media gateway and keeps the content of the SDP unchanged.

question_57800.question: What action does the MCVideo client take when the stored current call type is "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL" and a certain timer is started?
question_57800.ground_truth: The MCVideo client starts timer TFG13 with a specific value.

question_57801.question: In what scenarios will the PCEF initiate an IP-CAN session termination procedure?
question_57801.ground_truth: If there is no PCC rule active for a successfully established IP-CAN session at any later point in time, the PCEF shall initiate an IP-CAN session termination procedure.

question_57802.question: What is the role of the Request Interceptor in CORBA security mechanisms?
question_57802.ground_truth: The Request Interceptor is a CORBA mechanism used to transfer credentials and service contexts between the IRPManager and IRPAgent to address security requirements.

question_57804.question: What is the maximum allowed interruption of PCell during SCells activation and deactivation for FDD PCell and TDD PCell?
question_57804.ground_truth: The interruption of PCell shall not be more than the values specified for intra-band CA and inter-band CA in Clause 7.8.2 during SCells activation and deactivation for FDD PCell and TDD PCell.

question_57805.question: What are the specific requirements for Cooperative Short Distance Grouping (CoSdG) in terms of wireless communications?
question_57805.ground_truth: CoSdG requires reliable wireless communications among vehicles in a cooperative group, support for lower latency message exchange, higher reliability of message exchange, support for high density of transmitting UEs, and support for larger messages exchanged.

question_57806.question: Which two mechanisms are listed as possible options for negotiating fine-granular extensions to 5G Service-Based Interfaces using HTTP protocol mechanisms?
question_57806.ground_truth: The two options are a mechanism based on 3GPP-Optional-Features and 3GPP-Accepted-Features custom HTTP headers, and a mechanism based on similar information embedded in HTTP bodies.

question_57808.question: What is the difference between a 2G ME and a 2G/3G dual mode ME?
question_57808.ground_truth: A 3G ME is a single mode ME that only supports a 3G radio access network, while a 2G/3G dual mode ME supports both a 2G and a 3G radio access network.

question_57810.question: What action should the mobile station take when it receives the PACKET~DBPSCH~ASSIGNMENT message and has been assigned more DBPSCHs than it supports?
question_57810.ground_truth: The mobile station shall ignore the assignment and return to MAC-Idle state.

question_57812.question: What is the simulation result regarding the TTI utilization for non-empty LPNs and macro cells in the LPN network?
question_57812.ground_truth: Even if placing 4 LPNs with 37dBm transmit power, the TTI utilization of non-empty LPNs is significantly less than the TTI utilization for macro cells.

question_57814.question: What event is triggered for the ICCF to send a SIP 200 OK and media path to be established end-to-end?
question_57814.ground_truth: The ICCF receives SIP 200 OK after sending a SIP INVITE to the C party.

question_57816.question: What action does the SCF take if the parent has the rights to perform Parental Control on the child when the SCF receives a SIP MESSAGE for Parental Control?
question_57816.ground_truth: The SCF updates the child's profile with adding a forbidden program, and initiates the PSS streaming teardown procedure or MBMS streaming teardown procedure.

question_57817.question: What are the different coverage scenarios that the coverage mechanisms should effectively cope with?
question_57817.ground_truth: The different coverage scenarios include limited coverage in a 'sea' of coverage provided by another radio system or radio access mode, selective operation at a geographical boundary with extensive UTRAN coverage on one side and extensive coverage from another radio system on the other side, and geographically co-located areas of UTRAN coverage and another radio system.

question_57819.question: What protocol specifications is the Communication Continuity Management Object compatible with?
question_57819.ground_truth: The OMA Device Management protocol specifications, version 1.2 and upwards

question_57820.question: What is the role of the UE upon receiving a location request from the LMF?
question_57820.ground_truth: The UE notifies the user of the location request and verifies user permission if UE privacy is to be verified. The UE then returns a supplementary services Location Notification response to the AMF indicating whether the user grants or withholds permission for the location request. The UE also performs a network triggered service request if needed to move the UE into connected state before responding to the location request.

question_57821.question: What is Scenario 1 for the interaction between eDRX and PSM?
question_57821.ground_truth: In Scenario 1, the UE requests parameters for both PSM and extended DRX as alternatives for the network to decide. This may indicate that the UE does not know which power saving solution is supported in the network.

question_57823.question: When must an AS handle requests addressed to its currently valid GRUUs?
question_57823.ground_truth: The AS must handle requests addressed to its currently valid GRUUs when received outside of the dialog in which the GRUU was provided.

question_57824.question: What reference point is used for presentation of the SIP UA behavior towards IMS for control of user sessions between the ICCF and the CSCF?
question_57824.ground_truth: The I2 reference point is used between the ICCF and the CSCF for presentation of the SIP UA behavior towards IMS for control of user sessions.

question_57825.question: What should the MS do if it is in state GMM-REGISTERED and an ATTACH REQUEST message is received?
question_57825.ground_truth: If an ATTACH REQUEST message is received in state GMM-REGISTERED, the network may initiate the GMM common procedures; if it turned out that the ATTACH REQUEST message was send by an MS that has already been attached, the GMM context, PDP contexts and MBMS contexts, if any, are deleted and the new ATTACH REQUEST is progressed.

question_57829.question: What should the SS do after activating SCC in step 5?
question_57829.ground_truth: After activating SCC in step 5, the SS shall monitor CSI reports for SCell sent from the UE and ACK/NACK sent in PCell during SCell activation.

question_57830.question: What is the length and type of the WUS assistance information information element?
question_57830.ground_truth: The WUS assistance information is a type 4 information element, with a minimum length of 3 octets.

question_57832.question: What is the impact of the Ranging service exposure solution on the existing nodes and functionality?
question_57832.ground_truth: The Ranging service exposure solution has impacts on the following entities: UE(s) - requiring support for ranging service exposure, support for invoking the ranging service, and support for Ranging/Sidelink positioning over the PC5.

question_57833.question: What is the required minimum confidence level and rate of correct events during the test?
question_57833.ground_truth: The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_57835.question: When is the REPORT record triggered for a target ProSe Remote UE in ProSe UE-to-NW Relay?
question_57835.ground_truth: The REPORT record is triggered when the target ProSe Remote UE connects to or disconnects from a ProSe UE-to-NW Relay in ProSe remote UE communications.

question_57836.question: How many types of Common Pilot Channels are there in a UMTS network?
question_57836.ground_truth: There are two types of Common Pilot Channels in a UMTS network, the Primary and Secondary CPICH.

question_57838.question: In the End-to-end only approach, what is the disadvantage regarding handling of messages during an overloaded condition?
question_57838.ground_truth: The intermediate node may receive more messages than it can handle.

question_57839.question: What action does the S-CSCF take when the session timer expires and the session has been requested to be refreshed periodically?
question_57839.ground_truth: The S-CSCF deletes all stored information related to the dialog.

question_57840.question: What is the maximum allowed cell re-selection delay to an already detected cell in the test case?
question_57840.ground_truth: The maximum allowed cell re-selection delay to an already detected cell in the test case is 3.2 seconds.

question_57841.question: What is the difference between a Type A LMU and a Type B LMU in the context of GERAN Network Location Procedures?
question_57841.ground_truth: A Type A LMU operates in A/Gb Mode CS Domain and can support positioning of mobile stations in Iu Mode, while a Type B LMU operates independently of the mode of the MS and can also support positioning of mobile stations in Iu Mode.

question_57843.question: What information does the old SGSN extract upon receiving the Forward Relocation Request message?
question_57843.ground_truth: The old SGSN extracts the NSAPIs, SAPIs, and PFIs from the PDP Contexts contained in the Forward Relocation Request message.

question_57844.question: In what circumstance can the multi-access PDN connection be removed?
question_57844.ground_truth: The multi-access PDN connection can be removed when the multi-access PDN connection via 3GPP access network is removed and the multi-access PDN connection via WLAN access network is maintained or the multi-access PDN connection via WLAN access network is removed and the multi-access PDN connection via 3GPP access network is maintained.

question_57845.question: What is the message type for the paging request in mobility management?
question_57845.ground_truth: The message type for the paging request in mobility management is CTS PAGING REQUEST.

question_57847.question: What is the purpose of the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay discovery security material request procedure?
question_57847.ground_truth: The purpose of the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay discovery security material request procedure is for the UE to obtain the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay discovery security material for 5G ProSe remote UE or 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE.

question_57848.question: What is the effect of initiating or cancelling an MCVideo emergency alert in clause~11 on an MCVideo group or its participants?
question_57848.ground_truth: Initiating or cancelling an MCVideo emergency alert for a group in clause~11 will target the group and result in the initiator being implicitly affiliated to the group, while not impacting the in-progress emergency state of the targeted group or the EPS bearers' priority.

question_57849.question: What is the expected result for the SEND USSD procedure to be considered successful?
question_57849.ground_truth: The ME shall operate in the manner defined in expected sequence 4.10 (or 5.1, or 6.1 depending on the question)

question_57850.question: When should the target BSS initiate the PS Handover Complete procedure?
question_57850.ground_truth: The target BSS should initiate the PS Handover Complete procedure on reception of the first correct RLC data block (sent in normal burst format) from the MS in the target cell in the case of PS Handover or on receipt of an RR HANDOVER COMPLETE message on the main DCCH in the target cell in the case of DTM Handover.

question_57851.question: When does the V-AMF consider an S-NSSAI as an Allowed S-NSSAI?
question_57851.ground_truth: The V-AMF considers the S-NSSAI as an Allowed S-NSSAI, if the requested S-NSSAI is subject to network slice quota checking and the network slice quota has not been reached yet. Additionally, if no S-NSSAI can be provided in the Allowed NSSAI, then the AMF provides an empty Allowed NSSAI.

question_57852.question: Which command enables or disables reporting of PS to CS Single Radio Voice Call Continuity (SRVCC)?
question_57852.ground_truth: The 8.64 +CIREP command enables or disables reporting of PS to CS Single Radio Voice Call Continuity (SRVCC).

question_57853.question: What are the main uses of the broadcast connection in the HbbTV context?
question_57853.ground_truth: The main uses of the broadcast connection in HbbTV are the transmission of broadcast TV, radio and data services, signaling of broadcast-related applications, transport of broadcast-related applications and associated data, and synchronization of applications and TV/radio/data services.

question_57855.question: What is the required communication capability for the PC service in the Smart Grid?
question_57855.ground_truth: The PC service in the Smart Grid requires real-time, bi-directional communication capabilities to collect measurement and switch notifications in one direction and to apply control signals to inverters in the other direction.

question_57856.question: Who can request the PIN server discovery procedure via the PEGC?
question_57856.ground_truth: Some PIN elements can initiate the PIN server discovery procedure via the PEGC, typically through application layer connections via WiFi or Bluetooth.

question_57857.question: Which 3GPP Technical Specifications were updated in Release 11 regarding acoustic requirements and test specifications?
question_57857.ground_truth: TS 26.131 and TS 26.132 were updated in Release 11 to accommodate many advances in acoustic requirements and test specifications.

question_57859.question: What must the UE do when it is registered, in PDU SESSION ACTIVE state, and in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode, and the PS Data Off status is changed to "active"?
question_57859.ground_truth: The UE must perform a PDU session modification procedure, providing the PS Data Off status set to "active".

question_57860.question: In the context of 3GPP system requirements, what user experienced data rate is targeted while moving slowly?
question_57860.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall support a user experienced data rate of up to Gbps while moving slowly.

question_57861.question: What should the P-CSCF do when it receives a 200 (OK) response containing an SDP offer, and resource authorization procedure over the Gq' interface is required?
question_57861.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall check the SIP message containing the SDP answer for this SDP offer, and if necessary, terminate the session if resources cannot be granted.

question_57863.question: What is the step taken by the SCP when forwarding a request to the HTTP server for connecting inbound?
question_57863.ground_truth: The SCP shall connect inbound to an authority server for the target resource when forwarding a request to the HTTP server. For connecting inbound to an authority not in the same PLMN, the SCP shall connect to the Security Edge Protection Proxy.

question_57865.question: What should the S-CSCF do when the SCC AS invokes it as part of originating or terminating iFC execution?
question_57865.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should establish or terminate a Remote Leg toward the remote end for an originating or terminating IMS session, and coordinate the signalling exchange between the Access Leg and the Remote Leg associated with the anchored IMS session.

question_57867.question: What should the SNRM-S do if it receives an HTTP POST request message with a Content-Type header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.seal-mbms-usage-info+xml" but the sender is not authorized to report mbms listening status?
question_57867.ground_truth: The SNRM-S shall respond with a HTTP 403 (Forbidden) response to the HTTP POST request and shall skip the rest of the steps.

question_57868.question: In which substate can a MS initiate a TMSI reallocation procedure for identity confidentiality?
question_57868.ground_truth: The TMSI reallocation procedure can be initiated by the network at any time while a RR connection exists between the network and the mobile station.

question_57871.question: What should the SCC AS include in the SIP INVITE request if multiple contacts are registered in the PS domain and it decides to establish all media types over the same IP-CAN?
question_57871.ground_truth: The SCC AS should include an Accept-Contact header field containing the g.3gpp.accesstype media feature tag value associated with the selected PS domain IP-CAN.

question_57872.question: Which Information Object Class (IOC) has been specified for trace management in the context of SBMA and Streaming Trace reporting in the Generic NRM TSs 28.622 and 28.623?
question_57872.ground_truth: The new TraceJob Information Object Class (IOC) also known as "Trace control NRM fragment" has been specified for this purpose in the Generic NRM TSs 28.622 and 28.623.

question_57873.question: What information does the new MSC/VLR include in the MAP Update Location message if the MTRF Supported flag is present?
question_57873.ground_truth: The new MSC/VLR includes the new LMSI in the MAP Update Location message if the MTRF Supported flag is present, which allows the VLR to set up the Mobile Terminating Roaming Forwarding call during the mobile terminated CS service delivery via an alternative MME in MME pool procedure when the new SGs association is established towards a new VLR.

question_57874.question: What is the maximum time that a UE shall store a "warning message" when the UE is outside the Warning Area Coordinates?
question_57874.ground_truth: The UE shall store the "warning message" in the list of "warning messages" to be checked for geo-fencing during a UE implementation specific time which shall not be greater than 24 hours.

question_57876.question: Which content leads to the lowest quality scores for both HMD1 and HMD2?

question_57877.question: As per 6.3.2.2, which standardized reference interfaces can the 3GPP intent driven MnS be applicable for, given the potential deployment scenario #2?
question_57877.ground_truth: The 3GPP intent driven MnS can be applicable for the management interactions for Intent-NOP between NOP and NEP, management interactions for Intent-CSP between CSP and NOP, and TM Forum intent management API can be applicable for management interactions for Intent-CSC between CSC and CSP.

question_57878.question: What is the condition for counting a success for the event "Re-select already detected Ncell 1" in the HD-FDD intra frequency cell re-selection test case?
question_57878.ground_truth: A success for the event "Re-select already detected Ncell 1" is counted if the UE responds on the already detected cell, Ncell 1, during time duration T3 within 15 seconds from the beginning of time period T3.

question_57880.question: What is a pre-determined method for invoking the MPS for MMTEL voice from a public UE?
question_57880.ground_truth: A pre-determined method for invoking the MPS for MMTEL voice from a public UE is using a predetermined access number.

question_57882.question: What should the network do on receipt of a PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message indicating a change of RLC mode?
question_57882.ground_truth: Release the uplink TBF at a point determined by the network

question_57883.question: What should the UE do upon expiration of T319 and failure of the random access procedure in NR?
question_57883.ground_truth: The UE should store the connection resume failure information in this situation.

question_57884.question: What is the difference between CMAS and EU-ALERT specific requirements for warning notifications?
question_57884.ground_truth: CMAS supports up to 360 characters of GSM 7 bit Default Alphabet, while EU-ALERT supports 3 levels of severity for alert messages, and 1 level for advisory messages. CMAS supports 5 classes of warning notifications, while EU-ALERT supports 3 types of warning notifications.

question_57885.question: Which two tasks are executed by UEs during a live concert setting?
question_57885.ground_truth: Image shooting and video optimization, as well as artist face recognition and musical instrument identification are tasks executed by UEs during a live concert setting.

question_57886.question: In what situations does the V-PCRF request for PCC or QoS rules from the H-PCRF?
question_57886.ground_truth: The V-PCRF requests for PCC or QoS rules from the H-PCRF in the following instances: when it receives a Diameter CCR command from the PCEF requesting PCC for a roaming user, when it receives a Diameter CCR command from the BBERF requesting QoS Rules for a roaming user, and when it receives a Diameter CCR command from the TDF requesting ADC Rules for a roaming user.

question_57887.question: What is the recommended prioritization scheme for uplink CPRACH (Compact Packet Random Access Channel) in EGPRS?
question_57887.ground_truth: A prioritization scheme is recommended for uplink CPRACH in EGPRS. The mobile station (MS) may choose to either ignore the USF (Uplink State Flag) or use the USF to determine the CPRACH in the same way as for the other blocks. Optionally, the first blocks in the ordered list of blocks can only be used as CPRACH.

question_57888.question: What is the maximum duration of an interruption allowed on the source cell during intra-frequency handover?
question_57888.ground_truth: The maximum duration of an interruption allowed on the source cell during intra-frequency handover is 5 ms for synchronous handover, and 6 ms for asynchronous handover.

question_57889.question: What was the mean power saving gain provided by making evenly spaced traffic arrival offset in FR1, DL evaluation, DU, VR30Mbps-30Fps?
question_57889.ground_truth: The mean power saving gain provided by making evenly spaced traffic arrival offset in FR1, DL evaluation, DU, VR30Mbps-30Fps was 8.48%.

question_57891.question: Which extractor is used to get a conforming HEVC bitstream in the context of tile-based streaming?
question_57891.ground_truth: The untransformed sample entry type 'hvc2' is used as an extractor.

question_57892.question: What is the minimum time interval that the UE is required to search for and measure higher priority inter-frequency layers in the first scenario?
question_57892.ground_truth: The minimum rate at which the UE is required to search for and measure higher priority layers in the first scenario is the same as that defined in the clause.

question_57894.question: What is the role of SMF in determining which PDU session or flow needs the "enhanced handover"?
question_57894.ground_truth: SMF determines which PDU session or flow needs the "enhanced handover" during the HO procedure preparation.

question_57896.question: What should the SS check for in case a2, step a2-2?
question_57896.ground_truth: The SS should check for 2*T1 that the SREJ frame is not repeated by the MS.

question_57897.question: What is the main purpose of Step 0 in the PDU Session Establishment procedure?
question_57897.ground_truth: The main purpose of Step 0 in the PDU Session Establishment procedure is for the UE to choose a S-NSSAI that can be used for the PDU Session, taking into account the Network Slice exclusion rules from VPLMN. If the UE chooses a S-NSSAI that cannot be used simultaneously with other S-NSSAIs where PDU Sessions are already established, the UE initiates a PDU Session Release procedure.

question_57901.question: What interfaces are used between the PCF and P-CSCF to enable IMS services in the 5G system architecture?

question_57902.question: What is the role of the PCEF in IP Edge for BBF-defined Fixed Broadband Access?
question_57902.ground_truth: The PCEF in the IP Edge supports Gxd, Gyd and Gzd reference points, credit management, reporting, termination action, policy control functions, standardized QoS characteristics, application detection and redirection functionalities as defined in TS 23.203.

question_57903.question: What is the purpose of the "deliver-as-message" operation in the MSGin5G Server?
question_57903.ground_truth: The "deliver-as-message" operation is used by the Application Server to deliver a message to a specific MSGin5G Server.

question_57904.question: Which element can contain a list of <Instance-ID-URN> or <IMEI-range> in the mcdata-UE-id element?

question_57907.question: How long is the total time allotted for cell re-selection delay to an already detected cell in the test case for UE fulfilling stationary criterion?
question_57907.ground_truth: The total time allotted for cell re-selection delay to an already detected cell in the test case for UE fulfilling stationary criterion is 154.88 seconds (allow 155 s).

question_57908.question: What is the purpose of the public emergency call handling in the FRMCS system?
question_57908.ground_truth: The FRMCS System is able to route the emergency call based on the current position of the initiating FRMCS User. This feature allows FRMCS Users to indicate events that endanger public safety or require public safety involvement.

question_57909.question: When does UE store the selected TLS authentication method in Solution #6?
question_57909.ground_truth: UE that hosts EEC(s) stores the selected TLS authentication method while roaming, after receiving the ECS/EES authentication method information from SMF (via PCO) and finding that the selected TLS authentication method is not supported by ECS/EES.

question_57911.question: Which interfaces does the Iub share the transmission with?
question_57911.ground_truth: Transmission sharing between the GSM/GPRS Abis interface and the Iub interface shall not be precluded.

question_57912.question: What message is used to inform the mobile station about rearrangements initiated by a remote non-PLMN user?

question_57914.question: What is the role of the FL Server NWDAF in the federated learning process execution phase?
question_57914.ground_truth: The FL Server NWDAF in the federated learning process execution phase monitors the status changes of FL Client NWDAF(s), reselects FL Client NWDAF(s) based on updated status, availability, and capability, discovers new FL Client NWDAF(s) via NRF, and allows FL Client NWDAF(s) to join or leave the federated learning process dynamically.

question_57916.question: What is the expected response of the SoLSA MS after step b)?
question_57916.ground_truth: The expected response of the SoLSA MS after step b is a response on carrier 1 within 50 s with no LSA indication on the SoLSA MS.

question_57917.question: What action is (re-)selected by the (target) V-SMF to support EAS discovery with a local DNS server?
question_57917.ground_truth: The (target) V-SMF re-selects a local DNS server, typically based on the target UE location.

question_57918.question: What is added to MCPTT servers and MCPTT clients in this solution?
question_57918.ground_truth: The functionality for activation and deactivation of discreet listening to a specified target MCPTT group and the functionality for provision of discreet listening towards a group call to the authorized user without incorporating this authorized user into the group membership.

question_57920.question: What is the procedure followed by the mobile station when a message containing a syntactically incorrect mandatory IE or an unknown IE encoded as "comprehension required" is received, as per 45.5.1.1.1?
question_57920.ground_truth: The mobile station returns an SM-STATUS message with cause #96 "invalid mandatory information" if the message is an SM message, or a GMM-STATUS message with cause #96 "invalid mandatory information" if the message is a GMM message. If the message is not compatible with the protocol state, the mobile station returns a status message (STATUS or MM STATUS depending on the protocol discriminator) with cause #98 "Message type not compatible with protocol state".

question_57922.question: What are the two options for routing the voice media flow of a private call in the MCPTT system?
question_57922.ground_truth: Option 1: Through the primary MCPTT system if both users in the call belong to the same organization. Option 2: The voice media flow may be routed locally, under the control of the primary MCPTT system, through an entity allowing the duplication of the media flow to the primary MCPTT system of each user.

question_57923.question: What action can the TSG take if they decide that a specification is no longer going to be maintained?
question_57923.ground_truth: The TSG may decide that no further Change Requests should be considered, but the specification remains available.

question_57924.question: What does the RulePriority leaf indicate in the WLANSP rules?
question_57924.ground_truth: The RulePriority leaf represents the priority given to one particular rule in the WLANSP rules.

question_57925.question: What happens when there is a Transmitter Off Frequency?
question_57925.ground_truth: The system will not be able to transmit data or signals at the specified frequency.

question_57926.question: What information must the MS include in the HANDOVER COMPLETE message if the HANDOVER COMMAND message includes a request for Mobile Time Difference IE?
question_57926.ground_truth: The MS shall return the Mobile Time Difference IE in the HANDOVER COMPLETE message indicating the sum of the observed time difference between the cells and the timing advance used on the old cell.

question_57927.question: What is the main difference between congestion control in NR-V2X and LTE-V2X?
question_57927.ground_truth: In NR-V2X, each packet is associated with a single 'priority' value, which is comparable to PPPP in LTE-V2X. The priority value is transmitted in the first-stage SCI associated with each transport block.

question_57928.question: What is the maximum frames per second that the HEVC-UHD-Enc can support?
question_57928.ground_truth: The HEVC-UHD-Enc can support up to 480 frames per second.

question_57932.question: What is the definition of absolute accuracy of RSRP in the context of E-UTRAN FDD and TDD?
question_57932.ground_truth: The absolute accuracy of RSRP is defined as the RSRP measured from a cell that has different carrier frequency from the serving cell. This measurement is used for handover between UTRAN FDD and E-UTRAN FDD/TDD.

question_57933.question: What parameters must be present in the request for the HSS to download E-UTRAN authentication vectors to the MME?
question_57933.ground_truth: The Requested-EUTRAN-Authentication-Info AVP must be present in the request.

question_57934.question: What resource represents the Parameter Provision Profile Data for the 5G VN Groups, which is queried by the UDM?

question_57935.question: What is the meaning of the "p" symbol in the dialling number string "012340123456p1p2"?
question_57935.ground_truth: The "p" symbol in the dialling number string represents a pause between the called number and the supplementary services information.

question_57938.question: What is a solution for deriving a last known location for a UE that is not available for a current MT-LR location request?
question_57938.ground_truth: A solution is for a serving MME to retain the last known serving cell ID after a UE goes into idle state and a timestamp for when this occurred. The last serving cell ID may be used to derive a last known location should an MT-LR request be received later from an external client when the UE is still unavailable.

question_57940.question: What is the primary objective of the OVLI solution in the 3GGP strategy?
question_57940.ground_truth: The primary objective of the OVLI solution in the 3GGP strategy is to address the overload of servers and allow future extensibility for other requested actions.

question_57941.question: What action should the MCData client take when it receives a 2xx response to the SIP INVITE request?
question_57941.ground_truth: Upon receiving a 2xx response to the SIP INVITE request, the MCData client shall send an ACK request, start the SIP Session timer, and interact with the media plane.

question_57943.question: What should the UE include in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if it is in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode and changes the radio capability for NG-RAN or E-UTRAN?
question_57943.ground_truth: The UE shall initiate the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update including the 5GS update type IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message with the NG-RAN-RCU bit set to "UE radio capability update needed".

question_57944.question: What is the difference between an MSGin5G Client residing in a constrained device and one residing in an unconstrained device?
question_57944.ground_truth: Both use the same transport/data formats and have the same capabilities.

question_57946.question: When the P-CSCF receives an initial request for a dialog, what info should it save from the P-Called-Party-ID header field received in the request?
question_57946.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should save the public user identity from the P-Called-Party-ID header field received in the request.

question_57950.question: What is the purpose of the Edge Enabler Layer's roaming architecture?
question_57950.ground_truth: The of the Edge Enabler Layer's roaming architecture is to support roaming of UEs by utilizing Edge Counterparts (ECSs) provided in the home and visited networks, supporting two primary roaming scenarios: local breakout roaming architecture and home routed roaming architecture.

question_57951.question: What is the purpose of the Application Transport Mechanism (APM) and Application Transport Message (ATM) in the 3GPP bearer independent CS core network?
question_57951.ground_truth: The Application Transport Mechanism (APM) and Application Transport Message (ATM) are used in the 3GPP bearer independent CS core network to provide message transport for the BICC protocols.

question_57952.question: What activation/deactivation type is supported by the generic framework described in clause 5.1.11.4.2.1 and extended with the "Switch for 'activated' and 'deactivated' status"?

question_57953.question: How does the UDM respond to the NEF when retrieving the AF specific UE Identifier?
question_57953.ground_truth: The UDM responds to the NEF with an AF specific UE Identifier represented as an External Identifier for the UE which is uniquely associated with the Application Port ID, MTC Provider Information and/or AF Identifier.

question_57954.question: What is used to accomplish the feature of restricting access to the USIM to an authorized user or a number of authorized users?
question_57954.ground_truth: The shared secret (e.g. a PIN) stored securely in the USIM is used to accomplish this feature.

question_57955.question: What is the purpose of the test for Initiation/Cease of SLSS Transmission with V2X Sidelink Communication for SyncRef UE as Timing Reference?
question_57955.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the requirements related to the evaluation time allowed to initiate and cease SLSS transmissions defined in clause 13.3.1.3 when SyncRef UE is used as a timing reference.

question_57956.question: What is the major difference between non-AAS and AAS architectures and requirement sets?
question_57956.ground_truth: The major differences are that the AAS BS refers to a system of many transceiver units and has the antenna included as part of the architecture with a radiated interface, while non-AAS specifications refer to only a single Transceiver.

question_57958.question: What is denoted by after rate matching the turbo coded blocks?
question_57958.ground_truth: where r is the coded block number, and is the number of rate matched bits for code block number r.

question_57959.question: What should the mobile station do when it has data to send for an SRB that can be sent on SFACCH, and neither a TBF nor a TBF establishment request is ongoing for this SRB?
question_57959.ground_truth: The mobile station may select a current TBF on an SBPSCH, construct an uplink RLC data block that includes octet 3, and send the SRB data at the TBF's next scheduled transmission opportunity for an RLC data block.

question_57960.question: What must the MCData client do if the "/<x>/<x>/Common/MCData/AllowedSDS" leaf node is set to false in the group document?
question_57960.ground_truth: The MCData client must reject the request to send SDS and not continue with the rest of the steps.

question_57961.question: For sidelink transmission in the SLRB, what modification should be made when performing the header compression of the PDCP Data PDU when the SDU type is IP?
question_57961.ground_truth: The UE should perform the header compression using ROHC as specified in clause 5.7.4.

question_57962.question: What is responsible for classifying and marking QoS flows and their corresponding packets with a unique identifier in 3GPP~TS~23.501?
question_57962.ground_truth: The QoS flow level and corresponding packets are classified and marked using an identifier in accordance with 3GPP~TS~23.501.

question_57963.question: What is the maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks (TSI-NR) assumed in this test case?
question_57963.ground_truth: The maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell is 1280 ms.

question_57964.question: Which element within the 'response-announce' contains the transaction-ID?

question_57965.question: What should the MCPTT client do upon receipt of a SIP BYE request in the dialog of an ambient listening session?
question_57965.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a SIP BYE request in the dialog of an ambient listening session, the MCPTT client shall comply with the procedures of subclause 6.2.6. If the cached ambient listening client role is equal to "listened-to MCPTT user", the MCPTT client should provide no indication that an ambient listening call has been terminated. If the cached ambient listening client role is equal to "listening MCPTT user", the MCPTT client may provide an indication to the MCPTT user that the ambient listening call has been terminated, and shall clear the cache of the stored data.

question_57966.question: What is the procedure for continuous reporting of performance characteristics to be measured in 5G systems?
question_57966.ground_truth: When performance characteristics to be measured indicate continuous reporting along with certain parameters such as periodic time interval, Group Reporting Guard time, threshold value, Maximum number of reports, or Maximum duration of reporting, the NEF performs the aggregation of the event reporting about performance characteristics to be measured for each UE group member, and sends the aggregated reporting to AF as achieved performance for performance characteristics to be measured.

question_57967.question: What is the role of the LM server in the process of notifying location monitoring events to the VAL server?
question_57967.ground_truth: The LM server is responsible for sending notifications of location monitoring events to the VAL server, providing real-time information on the location of tracked objects or individuals.

question_57968.question: What software was used for digital audio playback during the wideband objective measurements and band-passed level adjustment?

question_57969.question: When is reporting of changes of UE presence in a Presence Reporting Area supported during inter-RAT mobility?
question_57969.ground_truth: Reporting of changes of UE presence in a Presence Reporting Area is supported at inter-RAT mobility if the target MME/S4-SGSN supports location information change reporting.

question_57970.question: What is the role of SA2 in the 3GPP work?
question_57970.ground_truth: SA2 is responsible for defining the architecture for the features and the system, dividing the features into building blocks, and forwarding the building blocks to the relevant TSGs for the detailed work. SA2 also ensures that all required work for a full system specification of the features relevant to 3GPP takes place within 3GPP without overlap between groups.

question_57972.question: What is a PDCH in the context of 3GPP TS~45.008 standard?
question_57972.ground_truth: A PDCH is a physical channel allocated to carry packet logical channels, and a PDCH shall carry packet logical channels only.

question_57973.question: What is the risk if the infrequent or frequent small data is not integrity protected between the UE and network?
question_57973.ground_truth: An attacker could modify the small data or even inject fake small data packets on behalf of the IoT device or the network on the air interface.

question_57974.question: What are the security mechanism options for the X2-interface?
question_57974.ground_truth: The security mechanism options for the X2-interface are CUG/VPN, COLP, CLIP, authentication, and encryption.

question_57975.question: If the UE requests the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay discovery security material for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE, what should the 5G DDNMF include in the response?
question_57975.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF shall include the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay discovery security material for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE, the expiration timer of the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay discovery security material for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE, and the selected ciphering algorithm.

question_57977.question: What status change request will the UE (MCVideo Client) send in mandatory mode to another MCVideo user, if the MCVideo user requests it?
question_57977.ground_truth: The UE (MCVideo Client) will send an affiliation status change request in mandatory mode to another MCVideo user if the MCVideo user requests it.

question_57979.question: What is the purpose of Framed Route information in 5G Networks?
question_57979.ground_truth: Framed Route information in 5G Networks is used to support an IP network behind a UE, such that a range of IPv4 addresses or IPv6 prefixes is reachable over a single PDU Session, especially for enterprise connectivity.

question_57981.question: Under what conditions may the SGSN activate the APN based Session Management congestion control?
question_57981.ground_truth: The SGSN may activate the APN based Session Management congestion control in case of congestion situation at SGSN, or by OAM at SGSN, or by a restart or recovery condition of a GGSN or PDN~GW, or by a partial failure or recovery of a GGSN or PDN~GW for a particular APN(s).

question_57982.question: When does the SMS-SC send a "Delivery Report Request" to MTC-IWF in the SMS delivery from SMS-SC for Device Triggering?
question_57982.ground_truth: The SMS-SC sends a "Delivery Report Request" to MTC-IWF with appropriate result associated to the successful delivery of the device trigger to the UE, after the SMS-SC receives "SMS Deliver Answer" message as the delivery success of the SM transfer.

question_57983.question: What is the minimum coupling loss equal to for Local Area Base Stations, derived from Pico Cell scenarios?
question_57983.ground_truth: The minimum coupling loss equal to for Local Area Base Stations, derived from Pico Cell scenarios, is 45 dB.

question_57984.question: What information does the header of the GRE packet contain when carrying the UL PDU over an IPsec Child SA?
question_57984.ground_truth: The header of the GRE packet carries the QFI associated with the UL PDU and the identity of the PDU Session.

question_57985.question: What is the purpose of the CAPIF Security API?
question_57985.ground_truth: The CAPIF Security APIs allow API invokers to negotiate the service security method and obtain authorization for invoking service APIs. It also allows API exposing function to obtain authentication information of the API invoker for authentication and revoke the authorization for service APIs.

question_57986.question: What is the MCVideo imminent peril group call state that should be set in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body when the MCVideo client receives notification of the cancellation of the in-progress imminent peril state of the group?
question_57986.ground_truth: The MCVideo imminent peril group call state should be set to "MVIGC 1: imminent-peril-gc-capable".

question_57987.question: What is the definition of SLPP-MessageBody?
question_57987.ground_truth: The SLPP-MessageBody identifies the type of an SLPP message and contains all SLPP information specifically associated with that type.

question_57988.question: What is the effect of utilizing RRM measurements and reporting for normal operations for MDT measurement reporting?
question_57988.ground_truth: There is no impact to the UE when RRM measurements and reporting for normal operations are utilized for MDT measurement reporting.

question_57989.question: How does the UE determine when to send indications to the network regarding IP flow mobility?
question_57989.ground_truth: The UE uses its local operating environment, as defined in TS23.261, to decide when to send indications to the network about IP flow mobility. For example, if the UE loses the WLAN signal and has active IP flows over WLAN, it indicates to the network that WLAN cannot be used for traffic routing.

question_57990.question: What procedure is used by the Content Provider AS to modify an existing TV service?
question_57990.ground_truth: The TV Service Modification Procedure is used by the Content Provider AS to request modification of an existing TV service.

question_57991.question: When does an MS set the DRX cycle length that is specific to the PS domain?
question_57991.ground_truth: An MS sets the DRX cycle length that is specific to the PS domain during the attach procedure and when changing from A/Gb mode to Iu mode in the routeing area update procedure.

question_57992.question: What is the limit for the RRC re-establishment delay in clause 6.1.10.4?
question_57992.ground_truth: The limit for the RRC re-establishment delay in clause 6.1.10.4 is less than 1.5 seconds.

question_57994.question: What information does the NG-RAN node take into account when determining the feedback to provide if the RAN Feedback Type IE is included in the TSC Traffic Characteristics IE?
question_57994.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node takes the RAN Feedback Type IE into account when determining the feedback to provide in the TSC Traffic Characteristics Feedback IE in the PDU Session Resource Modify Response Transfer IE in the PDU SESSION RESOURCE MODIFY RESPONSE message.

question_57996.question: What action does the participating MCVideo function take when it receives a SIP 4xx, 5xx or 6xx response to the SIP MESSAGE request?
question_57996.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function forwards the error response to the MCVideo client.

question_57997.question: What is the role of Cell 1, Cell 2, and Cell 3 in this test?
question_57997.ground_truth: Cell 1 is the PCell on the TDD primary component carrier, Cell 2 is the SCell on the FDD secondary component carrier, and Cell 3 is the neighboring cell on the FDD secondary component carrier used for connection setup.

question_57999.question: What procedure is used for the case when the gNB-CU triggers conditional handover or conditional PSCell change or subsequent CPAC within the same gNB-CU?
question_57999.ground_truth: Inter-gNB-DU Conditional Handover or Conditional PSCell Change or subsequent CPAC

question_58000.question: What is the role of the ISC gateway function as an exit point for SIP transactions?
question_58000.ground_truth: As an exit point, the ISC gateway function receives requests sent from the S-CSCF to the AS via the ISC gateway function. It shall give priority over other transactions or dialogs for requests that support priority and have an authorised Resource-Priority header field. The ISC gateway function can also perform special treatment of such transactions or dialogs, such as filtering, higher priority processing, and routeing.

question_58001.question: When should the MCPTT client include the Resource-Priority header field in the SIP INVITE request?
question_58001.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should include the Resource-Priority header field in the SIP INVITE request if the MCPTT emergency group state for this group is set to "MEG 2: in-progress" or "MEG 4: confirm-pending", or if the MCPTT client imminent peril group state for this group is set to "MIG 2: in-progress" or "MIG 4: confirm-pending".

question_58003.question: What is the function of the key download mechanism in the MCX system?
question_58003.ground_truth: The key download mechanism allows keys to be sent from the MCX Server to the MCX clients for the protection of signaling channels.

question_58004.question: What is the procedure when the MC service client is not required to initiate a unicast bearer to send a location report or MBMS listening report?
question_58004.ground_truth: The UE may move between the two MBMS bearers (TMGI 1 and TMGI 2) without the need to report an area change, as long as there is an application level signalling bearer (TMGI 9) activated in the full area (i.e. the area of both TMGI 1 and TMGI 2).

question_58005.question: What is the name of the problem faced when higher order modulation MS are multiplexed with legacy GPRS/EGPRS MS on the same downlink PDCH:s?
question_58005.ground_truth: The multiplexing issues of higher order modulations.

question_58007.question: What is the role of an SCP in a network?
question_58007.ground_truth: An SCP (Service Capability Server) is a network function responsible for handling service capability management, network capability management, and service characteristics management. It includes SCP capacity information, SCP load information, SCP priority, location information, Served Location(s), Network Slice related Identifiers such as S-NSSAI, NSI ID, and NF sets of NFs served by the SCP.

question_58008.question: What information must the CHF report to the PCF if spending limit reporting is enabled for a policy counter?
question_58008.ground_truth: The CHF must notify the PCF of changes in the status of the policy counter and optionally pending statuses with their activation time.

question_58009.question: Which type of data is used for short message support and where is it stored?
question_58009.ground_truth: Data for short message support includes MWD, MNRF, MCEF, MNRG, UNRI, MNRR-MSC, MNRR-SGSN, UNRR, and the MME number for MT SMS. These are temporarily stored in the VLR, MME, and/or HLR, and in some cases, conditionally stored in the HLR.

question_58010.question: What exception is thrown if the compareOffset or compareLength or both would cause access outside array bounds or if compareLength is negative in the findAndCompareValue method?
