question_58011.question: When might the SMF handling of the PDU session with respect to the Integrity Protection status be up to SMF implementation decision?
question_58011.ground_truth: In the case of dual connectivity, when the Integrity Protection is set to "Preferred" and the Master RAN node cannot fulfil a User Plane Security Enforcement with a value of Preferred.

question_58013.question: What information does the MCID service register?
question_58013.ground_truth: The MCID service registers the Destination Party Identity Information, originating Party Identity Information, and the local time and date of the invocation in the network serving the called user.

question_58014.question: What is the role of the CAPIF Core Function (CCF) in the onboarding process for UE originated API invocation?
question_58014.ground_truth: The CAPIF Core Function (CCF) is responsible for providing the UE with CAPIF Core Function information, determining security context related to the UE, and storing the CCF key, Kccf ID, and UE ID during the onboarding process.

question_58015.question: What command is indicated by the Command-Code field set to 8388674 and the "R" bit set in the Command Flags field?

question_58017.question: What are the two options available for routing the voice media flow for a private call in MCPTT?
question_58017.ground_truth: Option 1 involves routing the voice media flow through the primary MCPTT system, while Option 2 allows for local routing of the media flow under the control of the primary MCPTT system.

question_58018.question: In the context of this specification, how many 5G VN groups can a PDU Session provide access to?
question_58018.ground_truth: A PDU Session provides access to one and only one 5G VN group.

question_58020.question: What is the purpose of the 3gpp-Sbi-Correlation-Info header in HTTP requests and responses?
question_58020.ground_truth: The 3gpp-Sbi-Correlation-Info header in HTTP requests and responses is used to identify the UE related to the HTTP request or response, enabling network analytics tools or probes to easily identify messages that were exchanged for a given UE.

question_58022.question: For carrier aggregation of Band 3 and Band 40, what bands may have a potential issue with harmonics and IMD interference, and should be focused on for careful consideration?

question_58023.question: In what order do the client and the MCData message store communicate when updating metadata of a stored object?
question_58023.ground_truth: The message store client sends an update a stored object request to the MCData message store, and the MCData message store sends an update a stored object response back to the message store client.

question_58025.question: What is the purpose of the "RA not allowed flag" and where is it stored?
question_58025.ground_truth: The "RA not allowed flag" is set to restrict service on a routing area basis. It is stored in the SGSN.

question_58027.question: What should the UE do when an emergency call is being made?
question_58027.ground_truth: The UE should not include end-to-end media security on any media in the SDP offer when it detects that an emergency call is being made.

question_58030.question: What is the action taken if no LLC is received and only octets 1 to 4 are received in the ISDN BC-IE?
question_58030.ground_truth: The following PLMN-BC parameters shall be set to their respective values (fixed network user rate: 64 kbit/s, connection element: transparent) if no LLC is received and only octets 1 to 4 are received in the ISDN BC-IE.

question_58031.question: How many samples does the SS take for each BER of looped back bursts?
question_58031.ground_truth: The SS shall take 10 samples for each BER of looped back bursts.

question_58032.question: How is application plane signalling secured in a MCPTT system?
question_58032.ground_truth: Application plane signalling is secured using signalling protection, which encrypts all HTTP and SIP connections into the MCPTT domain and protects MCPTT-specific signalling from non-MCPTT entities.

question_58033.question: What is the definition of "Operating band" in the context of the present document?
question_58033.ground_truth: Operating band is the frequency range in which NR operates, that is defined with a specific set of technical requirements.

question_58034.question: What exception is thrown if the compareBuffer is null in the findAndCompareValue method?

question_58035.question: What message is used to initiate the Secondary UL Frequency Update procedure for FDD?
question_58035.ground_truth: The SECONDARY UL FREQUENCY UPDATE INDICATION message is used by the Node B to initiate the Secondary UL Frequency Update procedure for FDD.

question_58037.question: What is the role of the SS in counting the number of blocks transmitted with the current coding scheme for different channels and coding schemes under TUhigh propagation condition, under any combination of normal and extreme test voltages and ambient temperatures, in order to meet the conformance requirement?
question_58037.ground_truth: The SS calculates the block error ratio for different channels and coding schemes under TUhigh propagation condition, and resets the counters once the number of blocks transmitted with the current coding scheme reaches or exceeds the minimum number of blocks. The SS continues this process until the block error ratio does not exceed the conformance requirement.

question_58039.question: What is the purpose of improved random accessibility support in H.265 (HEVC)?
question_58039.ground_truth: The purpose of improved random accessibility support in H.265 (HEVC) is to include signalling of IRAP pictures beyond IDR pictures and provide six different NAL units to signal the properties of the IRAP pictures, which can be used to better match the stream access point types as defined in the ISOBMFF.

question_58040.question: What should the S-CSCF do with the preloaded Route header fields when reregistering or initially registering a user?
question_58040.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should replace the existing list of pre-loaded Route header fields with a new list, and bind it to either the contact address of the UE or the registration flow and the associated contact address.

question_58042.question: What are the three conditions for aborting the MTA procedure with enhanced security in the BSSMAP-LE PERFORM LOCATION ABORT message?
question_58042.ground_truth: The three conditions for aborting the MTA procedure with enhanced security are: detecting a duplicate RLC data block, detecting a RLC data block with a greater ``MTA Instance'' field value, and detecting a RLC data block with "Final MTA Access" = TRUE for which the corresponding "MTA Instance" field has the same value as a RLC data block for which "Final MTA Access" = FALSE.

question_58043.question: In the 5G Media Streaming scenario, which entity is the Resource Server, which is the Resource Owner and which is the Client in an OAuth 2.0 architecture when authorizing access to Network Assistance feature of the 5GMS AF?
question_58043.ground_truth: The 5GMS AF is the Resource Server, the 5GMS Application Provider is the Resource Owner, and the Media Session Handler is the Client.

question_58044.question: What is the purpose of inter-AMF handovers in the 5G system?
question_58044.ground_truth: Inter-AMF handovers are used to transfer the management of user equipment's access and mobility from one AMF to another in the 5G system.

question_58046.question: What action must the network take upon reception of an MBMS SERVICE REQUEST message from a mobile station?
question_58046.ground_truth: The network, upon reception of an MBMS SERVICE REQUEST message from a mobile station, estimates the number of mobile stations interested in the session in a given cell, and may use this estimate to establish an MBMS bearer.

question_58047.question: What should the SS do after receiving a CMR from the MS, if the MS recommends to use a codec mode of 6.7 kbit/s or higher in the downlink?
question_58047.ground_truth: The SS should increment the successful C/I increase event counter.

question_58048.question: What are the three predefined response texts that can be included in the response of the +GCAP command, indicating supported capability areas?

question_58049.question: What type of channel is a Bm channel?
question_58049.ground_truth: A Bm channel is a bi-directional or uni-directional user channel, able to carry a variety of bit streams, including voice encoded at 13 kbit/s, and data transmission at different bit rates.

question_58050.question: What should the UE do if it receives a DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message with the EPS bearer context of a default EPS bearer context and ESM cause~#39 "reactivation requested" over the 3GPP access?
question_58050.ground_truth: If the corresponding PDN connection is established over both 3GPP access and WLAN, the UE shall complete the EPS bearer context deactivation, locally release the corresponding PDN connection over trusted WLAN and untrusted WLAN, and then re-establish the PDN connection(s) at least over one access with the choice of the access being implementation specific.

question_58051.question: What is the primary scope of 3GPP's involvement in an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Collision Avoidance System (UCAS)?
question_58051.ground_truth: The primary scope of 3GPP's involvement in UCAS is to provide accurate live positioning information into the UTM from the UAS or MNO, and to ensure timely feedback from the UTM to the UAS via the UAV controller.

question_58052.question: What is the typical delay for the UL allocation and timing advance step in the interruption time?
question_58052.ground_truth: The typical delay for the UL allocation and timing advance step in the interruption time is 5 ms.

question_58053.question: How does the SMF perform network slice admission control for redundant PDU sessions?
question_58053.ground_truth: The SMF performs network slice admission control for each PDU session independently for a set of redundant PDU sessions.

question_58054.question: Which access must the UE initially establish a PDN connection for, when attaching to a 3GPP access with multiple PDN connections via WLAN?
question_58054.ground_truth: The UE should initially establish a PDN connection for the desired PDN connections that will use IP flow mobility for the WLAN access.

question_58055.question: What system or protocol is used to perform PDN GW selection in step 1 of the trusted non-3GPP IP access?

question_58057.question: How many dB better than the current serving cell should an inter-frequency cell be for filtering to start the evaluation process?
question_58057.ground_truth: The filtering shall be such that the UE shall be capable of evaluating that an inter-frequency cell has become better ranked than the serving cell within (Ncarrier-1) * TevaluateTDD from the moment the inter-frequency cell became at least 3 dB better than the current serving cell.

question_58059.question: What should the UE do if it is in the state 5GMM-REGISTERED and in 5GMM-IDLE mode over non-3GPP access, and needs to change the SMS over NAS capability?
question_58059.ground_truth: The UE should initiate and successfully complete the registration procedure for mobility registration update.

question_58060.question: What RFC specifies the GZip algorithm used for content encoding of files in the download delivery method?

question_58061.question: How does HeNB determine its operating frequency based on the measured RSRP of surrounding frequency layers?
question_58061.ground_truth: If the measured RSRP of both higher and lower priority frequency layers exceeds a predefined set of thresholds, the HeNB should select its operating frequency that is being used by the cell that has the lower priority for interference mitigation.

question_58062.question: What signal does the SS transmit on the traffic channel along with the unwanted signal?
question_58062.ground_truth: The SS transmits the wanted signal, which is the Standard Test Signal C1, with TUhigh propagation profile, at the nominal frequency of the receiver.

question_58064.question: What is the condition for starting time period T2 after T1 expires?
question_58064.ground_truth: Time period T2 starts after T1 expires and the UE has re-selected Cell 2 within T1.

question_58066.question: What must the Request-URI of a REGISTER request be set to?
question_58066.ground_truth: The Request-URI of a REGISTER request must be set to the SIP URI of the domain name of the home network.

question_58068.question: What requirement must be met for the MCVideo client to update the stored SDP body of a call in the "S3: part of ongoing call" state?
question_58068.ground_truth: The MCVideo client updates the stored SDP body of a call in the "S3: part of ongoing call" state only if the media session is adjusted based on the stored SDP body of the call and the transmission control is restarted as a terminating transmission participant.

question_58072.question: In the scenario, how does the IWF handle emergency alert cancel requests when the group's LMR users have individual affiliations?
question_58072.ground_truth: When the LMR users have individual affiliations, the IWF sends an individual IWF emergency alert cancel request message to the IWF for each affiliated LMR user.

question_58074.question: What is the pre-test condition for System Simulator as per the given input?
question_58074.ground_truth: The System Simulator's parameters are set to the default parameters for basic E-UTRA Single cell network scenarios, as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508 clause 4.4.

question_58076.question: What happens to the UEs on the blacklist when the RAN is continuously overloaded or new RAN UE NGAP ID is added in option 2?
question_58076.ground_truth: The timer may be reset to the start value after wrapping around to extend the validity of the blacklist for another timer cycle.

question_58077.question: How is the general result range specified in the terminal response to a USAT command?
question_58077.ground_truth: The general result range specifies the general results for which the modification applies. For every general result within the general result range, the corresponding operations shall be taken into account by the USAT Interpreter.

question_58078.question: What should the UE do if the HPLMN updates the SOR-CMCI in the USIM such that it contains no SOR-CMCI rules?
question_58078.ground_truth: The UE behaviour described in clause~C.4.2 applies.

question_58081.question: What is the purpose of TMSI reallocation procedure?
question_58081.ground_truth: The purpose of the TMSI reallocation procedure is to allocate a new TMSI/LAI pair to a user after the initiation of ciphering, ensuring the ciphering of communication over the radio path.

question_58082.question: What will be the impact when a single group is subject to simultaneous group regroup requests from both sides of IWF-1 interface?
question_58082.ground_truth: The impact may lead to the IWF informing the group management server, which informs the group management client, who in turn informs the authorized MC service user of the LMR group(s) that cannot be group regrouped.

question_58083.question: What are some of the file formats used for storing volumetric media primitives?
question_58083.ground_truth: OBJ, PLY, and GPU command buffer in OpenGL-based languages (e.g., glTF Buffer) are some of the methods used for encapsulating the primitives of volumetric media. A sequence of primitive files, such as multiple OBJs, PLYs or a set of GPU command buffers, in a time may present an animation of volumetric presentation.

question_58084.question: What is the difference between "Open ProSe direct discovery" and "Restricted ProSe direct discovery"?
question_58084.ground_truth: "Open ProSe direct discovery" is a type of ProSe direct discovery that takes place without explicit permission from the ProSe-enabled UE being discovered. In contrast, "Restricted ProSe direct discovery" only occurs with explicit permission from the ProSe-enabled UE being discovered.

question_58085.question: What should a UE using MICO mode do before initiating MO data or MO signaling if it is not within its registration area?
question_58085.ground_truth: The UE needs to perform a Mobility Registration Update before initiating MO data or MO signaling if it is not within the registration area.

question_58086.question: What should an MCPTT client do when it receives a GROUP CALL BROADCAST message with the same Call identifier IE, while in the "B3: pending user action" state, and the MCPTT user rejects the incoming broadcast call?
question_58086.ground_truth: The MCPTT client stops TFB3 (waiting for the user), starts TFB1 (max duration), and enters the "B4: ignoring same call ID" state.

question_58087.question: What should an MME do at a Tracking Area Update with an MME change if ISR Activated is indicated?
question_58087.ground_truth: ISR Activated should not be indicated at a Tracking Area Update with an MME change.

question_58088.question: What is the role of the SGSN when using S4 interface in packet routing and transfer?
question_58088.ground_truth: If packet routing and transfer takes place between the SGSN and the S-GW using S4, PDP contexts need to be mapped into EPS bearer contexts and vice versa. Context mapping is handled by the SGSN when using S4. This is transparent to the MS.

question_58089.question: What is the maximum send rate for UE-A and UE-B in IMS-A and IMS-B?
question_58089.ground_truth: The maximum send rate for UE-A and UE-B in IMS-A and IMS-B is 315 kbps.

question_58090.question: Who is responsible for sending the TIMING SYNCHRONISATION STATUS REQUEST message in the RAN TSS reporting process?
question_58090.ground_truth: The AMF requests RAN TSS reporting by sending the TIMING SYNCHRONISATION STATUS REQUEST message to the gNB-CU. The gNB-CU then requests RAN TSS reporting from at least one gNB-DU by sending the TIMING SYNCHRONISATION STATUS REQUEST message to the gNB-DU.

question_58091.question: What does the "maximum response time" refer to in the solution described in clause 5.7.1?
question_58091.ground_truth: The "maximum response time" refers to the delay an application may experience for the initial downlink IP packet after a pause in packet transmissions where a power saving function has become active for the 3GPP IP connection.

question_58092.question: What information does the r12:appService child element of the userServiceDescription element provide in the Unified Service Description (USD)?
question_58092.ground_truth: The r12:appService child element of the userServiceDescription element provides the identities of identical and alternative versions of an application service content item which can be substituted for one another in accordance to MooD operation or operator policy.

question_58095.question: Under what conditions is a MUSIM UE allowed to request the network to release the NAS signalling connection during tracking area updating procedure due to mobility to a tracking area outside the current tracking area list?
question_58095.ground_truth: If the network has already indicated support for NAS signalling connection release in the current stored tracking area list and the UE doesn't have a PDN connection for emergency bearer services established.

question_58097.question: What should the eNB start after receiving and successfully verifying the AS security mode complete message?

question_58099.question: What service provides a list of current calls controlled by the MT for which the <ccidx> is allocated?
question_58099.ground_truth: The 8.74 List of current calls +CLCCS command returns a list of current calls controlled by the MT for which the <ccidx> is allocated.

question_58100.question: What is required by the SGW when the DLDTA timer expires in the SGW?
question_58100.ground_truth: If the DLDTA timer expires, the maintained resources due to the DLDTA shall be locally deleted. This treatment is required in case the other SGW is chosen when UE re-attaches to the EPC after the MME failure.

question_58102.question: What kind of service is MBMS, as defined in TS23.246?
question_58102.ground_truth: MBMS is a point-to-multipoint service in which data is transmitted from a single source entity to multiple recipients, allowing for the sharing of network resources.

question_58103.question: What is the error type that occurs when a required parameter is missing in a CAP operation?

question_58104.question: What is the goal of the Dual IP address scenario in 3GPP Terminology?
question_58104.ground_truth: The goal of the Dual IP address scenario in 3GPP Terminology is to allow for co-existence of IMS signalling anchored in the home network, along with media streams anchored in the home network, in the visited network or in both.

question_58105.question: What is the impact of adopting the alternative method based on bin-averaging for the -3 dB geometry case?
question_58105.ground_truth: The change was made to obtain a consistent and accurate interference profile for the -3 dB geometry case, as there was a significant difference in link level throughput results using the random draw method for this case.

question_58106.question: What is the role of the MME in LCS?
question_58106.ground_truth: The MME in LCS is responsible for charging and billing, coordination of LCS, selection of E-SMLC, processing location requests, authorization and operation of LCS services, and informing HLR/HSS about the UE's LCS capabilities.

question_58107.question: What are the three different conditions under which the TCH/FS FER measurements in frequency hopping under interference conditions are tested?
question_58107.ground_truth: The three different conditions under which the TCH/FS FER measurements in frequency hopping under interference conditions are tested are the Normal condition, the Extreme Temperature condition, and the Vibration condition.

question_58108.question: What is the time frame of each H-SFN value in the context of the extended idle mode DRX?
question_58108.ground_truth: Each H-SFN value corresponds to a cycle of the legacy SFN of 1024 radio frames, i.e. 10.24s.

question_58109.question: What is the purpose of Test 8.3.1.1.2 for NB-IoT FDD UE release 17 and forward of category NB1 and NB2 that supports IOT NTN?
question_58109.ground_truth: The purpose of Test 8.3.1.1.2 is to verify the UE's ability to receive a predefined test signal, representing a multi-path fading channel that is determined by the SNR with a percentage of the information bit throughput for a specified downlink Reference Measurement Channel (RMC) not falling below a specified value for transmission on one antenna ports.

question_58112.question: Who are the intended users of the Common API Framework for 3GPP Northbound APIs?
question_58112.ground_truth: The intended users of the Common API Framework for 3GPP Northbound APIs are third-party developers that may not be familiar with 3GPP networks and their underlying complexities.

question_58113.question: What are the two stages in the calibration of the absolute level of DUT measurement results?
question_58113.ground_truth: Stage 1 involves using a calibration antenna to perform the calibration, while Stage 2 involves the actual measurement with the DUT as either the transmitter or receiver.

question_58115.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the SIP INVITE request when the MCVideo user has requested the origination of an MCVideo emergency group call?
question_58115.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should comply with the procedures in subclause~6.2.8.1.1 when the MCVideo user has requested the origination of an MCVideo emergency group call.

question_58116.question: What is the necessity of making backward compatibility when introducing a new method for broadcasting a Warning message in a HNB-GW?
question_58116.ground_truth: Making backward compatibility is essential when introducing a new method for broadcasting a Warning message in a HNB-GW to ensure that the older HNB-GW versions can still properly interpret and use the message.

question_58117.question: What is the role of the NAS protocol in the RRC protocol?
question_58117.ground_truth: The NAS protocol provides services for inter-RAT handover procedures, security activation, and transfer of dedicated NAS information and non-3GPP dedicated information.

question_58118.question: What is the role of the IBCF in the IMS network?
question_58118.ground_truth: The IBCF function is responsible for providing policy enforcement between IMS networks and other SIP-based multimedia networks.

question_58119.question: What are the requirements for single band tests for multi-band TAB connectors in clause 7.5.4.2.5?
question_58119.ground_truth: The requirements for single band tests for multi-band TAB connectors in clause 7.5.4.2.5 state that the steps from clauses 7.5.4.2.1 to 7.5.4.2.4 should be repeated per involved band for single band tests for multi-band TAB connectors with no carrier activated in the other band.

question_58121.question: What should the UE do when it receives an ESM INFORMATION REQUEST message with a PTI value that does not match any PTI in use?
question_58121.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the message if the PTI is an unassigned or reserved value. If the PTI is an assigned value that does not match any PTI in use for a pending UE requested PDN connectivity procedure for which the ESM information transfer flag was set in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message, the UE should respond with an ESM STATUS message including ESM cause #47 "PTI mismatch".

question_58123.question: What is theSS's action when T1 expires in the test?
question_58123.ground_truth: When T1 expires, the SS switches the power setting from T1 to T2 and starts T2.

question_58124.question: What should the SS (MCVideo server) do when entering the state 'U: permitted' as specified in subclause~6.3.5.5.2?
question_58124.ground_truth: The transmission control interface towards the MCVideo client in the transmission control server shall enter the state 'U: permitted'.

question_58125.question: What is the function of IPv6 prefix delegation via DHCPv6 for 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay?
question_58125.ground_truth: The IPv6 prefix delegation via DHCPv6 for 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay assigns IPv6 prefixes from IPv6 prefix range that have been assigned to the PDU Session used for the relay traffic via IPv6 prefix delegation.

question_58126.question: Can existing Connection Management mechanisms be reused for a UE accessing 5GC via satellite 3GPP access?
question_58126.ground_truth: This is a point expected to be studied within Key Issue 3.

question_58127.question: What is the procedure to follow when a PUA intends to publish its own view of the presentity's presence information?
question_58127.ground_truth: The PUA generates a PUBLISH request by acting as an Event Publication Agent (EPA) in accordance with RFC~3903, and supports the "application/pidf+xml" content type, the Presence Information Data Format (PIDF) extensions, and location information as defined in the corresponding RFCs. The PUA may also use RFC~5196 and RFC~5264 for advanced features.

question_58128.question: What is the maximum number of data channels allowed in a single SDP media description in the WebRTC data channel specification?
question_58128.ground_truth: There is no limit to the number of data channels in an SDP media description, but the aggregate of all defined data channels shall keep within the set bandwidth limit.

question_58129.question: What information does the "qos-flow-id" attribute in a <qos-flow> element provide?
question_58129.ground_truth: The "qos-flow-id" attribute in a <qos-flow> element contains the parameter defined in clause~11.6.2.15, which indicates the identification of a QoS flow used by the UE for 5G ProSe direct communication.

question_58130.question: What is the role of the NWDAF in the negotiation of power saving mechanisms for UE in the NTN coverage?
question_58130.ground_truth: The NWDAF assists UE in negotiation of power saving mechanisms such as PSM, MICO, and eDRX by providing the UE with the estimate of the in NTN coverage period and the estimate of the out of NTN coverage period. The UE can then use these estimates to negotiate the timer/parameters of power saving mechanisms.

question_58131.question: What is the initial conditions for performing the procedure in section 7.2.4.1?
question_58131.ground_truth: The UE is operated under normal test conditions, and the Test-USIM is inserted in the UE.

question_58132.question: What system is responsible for storing the information of the temporary group, including the temporary MC service group ID, off-network information, and the MC service IDs of the groups being combined, in the described scenario?

question_58135.question: What is the concept of "mutually exclusive slices" in the context of network slices?
question_58135.ground_truth: Mutually exclusive slices are network slices that cannot be accessed simultaneously by a user equipment (UE) due to conflicting resource requirements or restrictions.

question_58136.question: What is the difference between service initiated by application server and service initiated by 5GC NF?
question_58136.ground_truth: The main difference is that in the service initiated by application server, NEF checks the authorization of the AF, while in service initiated by 5GC NF, 5GC NF checks the authorization of the AF.

question_58138.question: What is the condition for an EC-GSM-IoT mobile station to be barred from network access when sending a normal report?
question_58138.ground_truth: A MS that is a member of an Access Class in the range 0-9 is attempting to send a normal report and determines that the Normal Access Barring field sent in EC-SI2 is not authorized.

question_58139.question: What is the role of the VAL server in the vertical application layer?
question_58139.ground_truth: The VAL server is responsible for supporting both unicast and multicast delivery modes for the VAL client. It communicates with the SEAL server over the reference point SEAL-S.

question_58140.question: What additional tasks does the telecom system perform in Level 2 network autonomy for RAN NE provisioning?
question_58140.ground_truth: In Level 2 network autonomy for RAN NE provisioning, the telecom system performs the tasks of connecting the RAN NE to the management system and collecting the RAN NE information, in addition to the tasks performed by the human in Level 1.

question_58143.question: What should a BSS do if an unexpected conditional Information Element is received in the RIM container of a RAN-INFORMATION PDU, RAN-INFORMATION-REQUEST PDU, RAN-INFORMATION-ACK PDU or RAN-INFORMATION-APPLICATION-ERROR PDU?
question_58143.ground_truth: The BSS should send a RAN-INFORMATION-ERROR PDU containing the complete received PDU and with the RIM Cause IE set to "Unexpected Conditional IE" back to the originating BSS and discard the received PDU.

question_58144.question: What is the absolute power calculation used for in 6.8.2.3.2, step 8?
question_58144.ground_truth: The absolute power calculation is used to determine the TRP measurement for the assigned channel frequency in the passband.

question_58146.question: What information does the source MME include in the Forward Relocation Request when the target cell is a hybrid or CSG cell, or if there are emergency bearers and the target cell is a CSG cell?
question_58146.ground_truth: The CSG ID and CSG Membership Indication, indicating whether the UE is a CSG member.

question_58148.question: What does the MeasurementReport message contain?
question_58148.ground_truth: The MeasurementReport message contains the indication of measurement results.

question_58150.question: What should be adjusted in the MME when an extended I-DRX cycle is involved in the MME/SGSN?
question_58150.ground_truth: The paging retransmission strategy should be adjusted in the MME when an extended I-DRX cycle is involved in the MME/SGSN.

question_58153.question: What is the Initial Codec Mode in step 1a) of the procedure?
question_58153.ground_truth: The Initial Codec Mode is not specified in 1a), so the default ICM rule is used.

question_58154.question: What is the IRI data record transmission requirement in relation to the detection of the triggering event by the IAP?
question_58154.ground_truth: Each IRI data record shall be sent by the delivery function to the LEMF over the HI2 within seconds of the detection of the triggering event by the IAP at least 95% of the time.

question_58155.question: What action should the NF Service Consumer take when it receives a 4xx/5xx response from the SMF during the EPS to 5GS Handover Preparation using N26 interface?
question_58155.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer (e.g. AMF) shall regard the hoState of the SM Context to be NONE.

question_58156.question: What is the role of the Broadcast Multicast Service Centre (BM-SC) in MBMS architecture?
question_58156.ground_truth: The BM-SC provides a set of functions for MBMS User Services. It may support functions for different MBMS User Services from the same or different physical network elements.

question_58160.question: What information does the eNodeB include in the S1-AP Initial UE message when relaying the NAS PDU to the MME?
question_58160.ground_truth: The eNodeB includes the "EDT Session" indication in the S1-AP Initial UE message when the RRCEarlyDataRequest message was received in step 1. The eNodeB may also indicate the UE's Coverage Level to the MME.

question_58161.question: When should the initiating UE initiate the 5G ProSe direct link release procedure based on the expiry of timer T5084?
question_58161.ground_truth: The initiating UE may initiate the 5G ProSe direct link release procedure to release a 5G ProSe direct link upon expiry of the timer T5084.

question_58163.question: How does an APN Network Identifier ensure uniqueness within or between GPRS/EPS PLMNs?
question_58163.ground_truth: An APN Network Identifier is typically a domain name, which is unique, and usually allocated by the PLMN if it belongs to an organization that has officially reserved that name in the Internet domain.

question_58164.question: What should the MS do after receiving an I+S frame from the SS with N(S) = NSS mod(62) and N(R) = NMS mod (62)?
question_58164.ground_truth: The MS should transmit an I+S frame with N(S) = NSS mod(62) and N(R) = NMS mod (62).

question_58167.question: What is the format of the LCID field in a MAC subheader for DL-SCH and UL-SCH?
question_58167.ground_truth: The LCID field is a 6-bit field that identifies the logical channel instance of the corresponding MAC SDU or the type of the corresponding MAC CE or padding. If the LCID field is set to 34 or 33, additional octets are present in the MAC subheader containing the eLCID field.

question_58168.question: What should the MS include in the ACTIVATE SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message?
question_58168.ground_truth: The MS should include the selected NSAPI, QoS profile, requested LLC SAPI, and Linked TI in the ACTIVATE SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message.

question_58169.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Report on charging aspects of 5G system architecture phase 1?
question_58169.ground_truth: The purpose of the report is to study the charging architecture, principles, and functionalities for a 5G System Phase 1, and provide a prioritization of different features to allow a phased approach for normative work.

question_58170.question: What operation is represented by the measurement "Failed number of PDN-GW initiated Dedicated Bearer Creation" in the context of EPS packet switching?
question_58170.ground_truth: The operation is the failed creation of a dedicated bearer by the PDN-GW (PDN Gateway) in EPS (Evolved Packet System) packet switching.

question_58171.question: What is the objective of clause 4.7.4.0.1?
question_58171.ground_truth: The objective of clause 4.7.4.0.1 is to specify SSB based absolute L1-RSRP measurement accuracy requirements.

question_58173.question: What is the minimum requirement for Test 1 and Test 2 in terms of the UE's behavior in soft handover?
question_58173.ground_truth: Test 1 verifies that the UE follows only the reliable TPC commands in soft handover, while Test 2 verifies that the UE follows all the reliable TPC commands in soft handover.

question_58174.question: What must the MS do when it receives an SN-DATA PDU with the F bit set to 0 in the Receive First Segment state during acknowledged mode data transfer?
question_58174.ground_truth: The MS shall discard the SN-DATA PDU and re-establish the acknowledged LLC operation for the SAPI used.

question_58175.question: What does the "Assistance Information Type" field describe?
question_58175.ground_truth: The "Assistance Information Type" field describes the type of radio quality assistance information provided by the corresponding node to the node hosting the NR PDCP entity.

question_58176.question: How many paging indicators are transmitted in each radio frame for the PICH?
question_58176.ground_truth: NPI paging indicators are transmitted in each radio frame for the PICH, where NPI depends on the paging indicator length and the burst type.

question_58177.question: What is the Phase III: ACR Execution in the Discover T-EAS procedure used by the EEC in TS 23.558 clause 8.8.2.2 Initiation by EEC using regular EAS Discovery?
question_58177.ground_truth: Phase III: ACR Execution involves performing Service Provisioning and discovery of T-EAS, and relocation of the application context from the EAS to CAS.

question_58179.question: What must the CRNC manage between cells to ensure equal bitrate allocation in a multi-cell RLS?
question_58179.ground_truth: Load excess indicator to signal when the frequency of "Down" commands towards UEs exceeds a pre-defined level.

question_58180.question: What is the definition of the "Primary mechanical mode" in the present document?
question_58180.ground_truth: The Primary mechanical mode is the mode of a UE that is most often used for a specific user scenario. Each terminal has at least one primary mechanical mode, with additional primary mechanical modes potentially applicable to different user scenarios.

question_58181.question: What action does the network take when it wants to re-associate a DRB with a different key (KeNB to S-KeNB or vice versa)?
question_58181.ground_truth: The network provides the drb-Identity value in the (target) drb-ToAddModList and sets the reestablishPDCP flag, without listing the drb-Identity in the (source) drb-ToReleaseList. Additionally, the network also ensures that the RLC receiver entities do not deliver old PDCP PDUs to the re-established PDCP entity.

question_58182.question: What is the condition for 1-RSRP measurement, EMW, and SMTC/SSB/CSI-RS occasions to be considered colliding?
question_58182.ground_truth: The 1-RSRP measurement, EMW, and SMTC/SSB/CSI-RS occasions are considered colliding if the two occasions are fully or partially overlapping in the time domain, provided that inter-RAT measurement during EMW would cause scheduling restriction.

question_58183.question: What is described in the 5.3.4 use case?
question_58183.ground_truth: The 5.3.4 use case describes a mobile specialist practice, which is a healthcare solution where a mobile practice is located in a truck and contains medical imaging equipment and a network of dedicated 5G access points for transmitting diagnostic data in real-time to a remote expert.

question_58186.question: What happens to the back-off timer if the network allows re-attempt in A/Gb or Iu mode or N1 mode for the same APN?
question_58186.ground_truth: The UE shall consider the back-off timer to be applicable only to the EPS session management in S1 mode for the rejected EPS session management procedure and the given PLMN and APN combination. If re-attempt in A/Gb and Iu mode and N1 mode is not allowed, the UE shall consider the back-off timer to be applicable to all three NAS protocols, i.e. EPS session management in S1 mode for the rejected EPS session management procedure, GPRS session management in A/Gb and Iu mode for the corresponding session management procedure and the given PLMN and APN combination, and 5GS session management in N1 mode for the corresponding session management procedure and the given PLMN and APN combination.

question_58187.question: What is the role of a Hosting RAN Provider in the context of 3GPP network sharing?
question_58187.ground_truth: A Hosting RAN Provider is a RAN provider that shares its hosting RAN with one or more participating operators. They have primary operational access to particular licensed spectrum and provide facilities to allow participating operators to share the RAN covered under the network sharing arrangement.

question_58188.question: What action does the HSS take when the user's roaming entitlement is not allowed in the new VLR area?
question_58188.ground_truth: The HSS sends a "Roaming Not Allowed" response and updates the user's IMS data with the CS Registration Status of "Not Registered".

question_58190.question: In the UE Policy Association Termination procedure, who notifies the changing of RAT type from EPS to 5GS?
question_58190.ground_truth: The SMF+P-GW-C notifies the PCF for the PDU session of the changing of RAT type from EPS to 5GS.

question_58192.question: What is the purpose of the discard port number "9" in the SIP REFER request?
question_58192.ground_truth: The discard port number "9" is used in the case where the port number of the target UE is not known, however in this case it is unclear if this concept is correct as the port number of the target UE is known.

question_58193.question: How does the MSGin5G Server determine if a UE is available for message delivery?
question_58193.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server uses the UE's availability registration and de-registration to determine if the UE is available for message delivery. If a UE is unavailable, the MSGin5G Server will store the message and deliver it once the UE becomes available.

question_58194.question: What action does an SGW take when it receives a FQ-CSID value of a PGW over S5/S8, or a FQ-CSID value of a MME over S11?
question_58194.ground_truth: The SGW overwrites the current stored FQ-CSID value with the received value

question_58195.question: In which network slices can the 5GMSd AS(s) be accessed?
question_58195.ground_truth: The 5GMSd AS(s) can only be accessed through the DNN(s) used by the network slice(s) provisioned for the distribution of that content.

question_58196.question: Where is security enforced between the endpoints in a remote UE and gNB, and how is traffic relayed securely over two links without exposing plaintext data to the UE-to-Network Relay?
question_58196.ground_truth: Security is enforced at the PDCP layer between the endpoints in a remote UE and gNB. The PDCP traffic is relayed securely over two links between the Remote UE and the UE-to-Network Relay UE and between the UE-to-Network Relay UE to the gNB without exposing any plaintext data to the UE-to-Network Relay.

question_58199.question: What is the procedure for a UE to obtain additional IPv6 prefixes for a PDU session through DHCPv6?
question_58199.ground_truth: The UE sends a DHCPv6 Solicit message containing one or more identity association for prefix delegation options to the SMF, which upon receiving one or more identity association for prefix delegation prefixes, allocates additional IPv6 prefixes to the UE.

question_58200.question: What information can the MCPTT Service provide to the initiating MCPTT User if the required Affiliated MCPTT Group Members did not acknowledge the call setup?
question_58200.ground_truth: The MCPTT Service can provide the list of MCPTT Group Members who did not acknowledge the call to the initiating MCPTT User.

question_58202.question: What is the name of the logical database that stores the relationship between an individual IMPU and the S-CSCF serving that IMPU in the context of the architecture described?

question_58204.question: How is the creation, deletion, and modification of the MOIs in the context of SBMA and Streaming Trace reporting performed without a dedicated API?
question_58204.ground_truth: The creation, deletion, and modification of the MOIs for SBMA and Streaming Trace reporting is performed by the means of Provisioning Management Service (Provisioning MnS) specified in TS~28.532.

question_58205.question: What is the role of the Access Network in handling positioning procedures in LCS?
question_58205.ground_truth: The Access Network is involved in the handling of various positioning procedures in LCS.

question_58206.question: What happens when an MCPTT client connects to the media plane for a group call which is using the chat model, and the call is not currently ongoing?
question_58206.ground_truth: When an MCPTT client successfully joins a group call which is using the chat model, the MCPTT client connects to the media plane for the call if the call is currently ongoing. If the call is not currently ongoing, the newly joined MCPTT client will only have pre-established its media parameters for the call. To transmit media, the MCPTT client must use a normal floor control procedure for requesting the floor.

question_58207.question: Which IE does the source eNodeB include in the Handover Required message when the target cell is a hybrid cell during an IRAT handover to UTRAN Iu mode?

question_58208.question: What is the source address of a GTPv2 Initial message?
question_58208.ground_truth: The source address of a GTPv2 Initial message should be an IP address of the source GTPv2 entity from which the message is originating.

question_58210.question: How can multiple antennas at the UE be used to achieve diversity and array gain for SC-PTM and MBSFN?
question_58210.ground_truth: Multiple antennas at the UE can be used to achieve diversity and array gain by exploiting the spatial separation of the antennas to improve the quality of the received signal. For SC-PTM, multiple antennas can improve the reliability of the link by providing diversity against fading. For MBSFN, multiple antennas can increase the capacity of the network by enabling the reception of multiple signals simultaneously.

question_58211.question: What are the potential subframes for NZP CSI-RS and CSI-IM in LAA, from a UE perspective?
question_58211.ground_truth: The potential subframes for NZP CSI-RS and CSI-IM in LAA, from a UE perspective, can be periodic, aperiodic, or a combination of both.

question_58212.question: How long does it take, on average, for a UE to join an ongoing group communication when it already has up-to-date SIB13 and registered with the GCSE AS?
question_58212.ground_truth: On average, it takes 300ms for joining an ongoing group communication requirement when the UE has already kept informed of SIB13 contents and have registered with the GCSE AS.

question_58214.question: When should the mobile station (MS) start timer T3312 in A/Gb mode?
question_58214.ground_truth: The MS should start timer T3312 with its initial value when the READY timer is stopped or expires, or the mobile station is in a state other than GMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE.

question_58215.question: What is the difference between the three versions of the document, as indicated by the first digit in the version numbering (e.g. x.y.z)?
question_58215.ground_truth: The first digit in the version numbering represents the maturity of the document. 1 indicates that the document has been presented to the TSG for information, 2 means that it has been presented to TSG for approval, and 3 or greater indicates that the document is TSG approved and under change control.

question_58217.question: What is the range of values for the "scalingfactor-r18" parameter?
question_58217.ground_truth: The "scalingfactor-r18" parameter can take one of the three values "n1", "n2", or "n4".

question_58220.question: Why should the solution for soft recovery after a PCRF restart not be combined with "strict termination of services"?
question_58220.ground_truth: The solution for soft recovery after a PCRF restart should not be combined with "strict termination of services" because it would compete strongly for resources and the balance between gain and effort is estimated to be unfavorable.

question_58221.question: What information should the MCData client set the Request-URI of the SIP INVITE request to when generating a SIP INVITE message?
question_58221.ground_truth: The MCData client should set the Request-URI of the SIP INVITE request to the public service identity identifying the participating MCData function serving the MCData user.

question_58222.question: What should the MCData client do upon receiving a SIP MESSAGE request for SDS disposition notification for terminating MCData client?
question_58222.ground_truth: The MCData client should decode the contents of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body and deliver the notification to the user or application.

question_58223.question: What is the role of the first digit of the version number presented in the document's foreword, as it pertains to the document's stage of approval and change control?
question_58223.ground_truth: The first digit indicates the stage of approval and change control: 1 - presented to TSG for information; 2 - presented to TSG for approval; or 3 or greater - TSG approved document under change control.

question_58224.question: What should be included in the SDP for each media stream and the session?
question_58224.ground_truth: The SDP should include bandwidth information for each media stream and for the session, with the bandwidth information described by the Application Specific (AS) bandwidth modifier as defined in RFC 4566.

question_58225.question: What is the purpose of the "Feature-Caps" header field in SIP requests?
question_58225.ground_truth: The "Feature-Caps" header field contains the "g.3gpp.ii-nni feature-capability indicators" that allow nodes to determine which local policies to apply, depending on the II-NNI traversal scenario type in the SIP request.

question_58226.question: What is required for UE-1 to add existing CS media in a new IMS Session and Gm Service Control (6.3.3.2) per the mentioned document?
question_58226.ground_truth: The existing session must have CS media, and UE-1 must send an INVITE towards SCC AS to control the CS media using ICS capabilities and to establish a new session indicating that the control of the existing CS media is transferred to the new session.

question_58227.question: What is the purpose of the MBMS Indicator Channel (MICH) type1 in carrying MBMS notification indicators on a non-MBSFN dedicated carrier?
question_58227.ground_truth: The MBMS Indicator Channel (MICH) type1 is used to carry the MBMS notification indicators on a non-MBSFN dedicated carrier to make decisions on individual MBMS notification indicators.

question_58228.question: What action does the SGW-C perform when it detects the failure of an SGW-U without a restart, to restore user plane sessions?
question_58228.ground_truth: The SGW-C identifies and selects a new SGW-U entity to take up the user plane sessions lost from the failed SGW-U, using the procedures in subclause 5.12 of 3GPP TS 23.214.

question_58229.question: What was the buffer size that was set for the "OPEN CHANNEL" command in the example?
question_58229.ground_truth: The buffer size was set to 1000 for the "OPEN CHANNEL" command.

question_58230.question: What operation is invoked by the network slice provisioning MnS consumer to request the provider to deallocate a service profile in an NSI?

question_58231.question: What should the target UE do upon receiving a DIRECT LINK SECURITY MODE REJECT message?
question_58231.ground_truth: The target UE should stop timer T5007, provide an indication to the lower layer of deactivation of the PC5 unicast security protection and deletion of security context for the PC5 unicast link, and abort the ongoing procedure that triggered the initiation of the link security mode control procedure.

question_58233.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 32.401, what does the term "NEs" mean?
question_58233.ground_truth: In the document, "NEs" is used as an abbreviation for Network Elements.

question_58234.question: When does the UE consider the access attempt as allowed if one or more Access Identities are indicated?
question_58234.ground_truth: The UE considers the access attempt as allowed if the corresponding bit is set to zero in the uac-BarringForAccessIdentity contained in the "UAC barring parameter" for at least one of the indicated Access Identities.

question_58236.question: What is the potential specification impact for L1/L2 based UE-UE CLI measurement compared to L3 based UE-UE CLI measurement?
question_58236.ground_truth: For L1/L2 based UE-UE CLI measurement, there is a potential specification impact, while for L3 based UE-UE CLI measurement, there is no specification impact.

question_58237.question: Which subclause describes the solution for achieving the group call between MCPTT system and LMR system on an interworking group defined in the LMR system?
question_58237.ground_truth: Subclause 6.4.4.2.2 describes the solution for achieving the group call between MCPTT system and LMR system by creating an interworking group in LMR system.

question_58238.question: What is the role of the UE in V2X-based group communication for commercial services?
question_58238.ground_truth: The UE obtains the Application Layer Group ID for the group communication from the Application Server by using application layer signalling, determines the Destination Layer-2 ID based on the Application Layer Group ID, and sends service data using V2X-based group communication over PC5 when group communications can take place.

question_58240.question: What is the purpose of the "ProSe direct link modification ack" message?
question_58240.ground_truth: The "ProSe direct link modification ack" message is sent by the UE to a peer UE to acknowledge the direct link modification procedure.

question_58241.question: What is used to identify the subgroups of energy applications within one safety zone?

question_58242.question: What is the role of the Relay-GW in mobile relay scenario when changing to different DeNBs?
question_58242.ground_truth: The Relay-GW may be changed for routing optimization purpose, where applicable, but it is independent of the RN mobility procedure and may be performed after HO completes in mobile relay scenario.

question_58243.question: Which components of the 5GC use the Coordination Identifier in the tactile and multi-modal communication service?
question_58243.ground_truth: The SMF and PCF use the Coordination Identifier to obtain the QoS Policies for the tactile and multi-modal communication service from the UDR. The UE hosted applications use it to provide to the network during PDU Session Establishment, similar to how a DNN would be provided.

question_58244.question: What is the difference between low and high frequency resolution SBR envelopes in the Enhanced aacPlus general audio codec?
question_58244.ground_truth: In the Enhanced aacPlus general audio codec, low frequency resolution SBR envelopes have a larger number of frequency bands compared to high frequency resolution SBR envelopes, which have a smaller number of frequency bands.

question_58245.question: What action does the UE take if the "UE positioning GPS Navigation Model" is included and an update is provided for a satellite in step 2?
question_58245.ground_truth: The UE acts as specified in subclause 8.6.7.19.3.4 and stores the IE "UE positioning GPS Ephemeris and Clock Correction parameters" at the position indicated by the "Sat ID" in the "UE positioning GPS Navigation Model".

question_58246.question: What should the ME do upon receiving the PROVIDE LOCAL INFORMATION command containing a request for location information?
question_58246.ground_truth: The ME shall return the requested location information, which includes the mobile country code (MCC), mobile network code (MNC), location area code/tracking area code (LAC/TAC), and cell ID of the current serving cell within a TERMINAL RESPONSE.

question_58247.question: What does the acronym LLA stand for in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_58247.ground_truth: LLA stands for Logical Layered Architecture, which is a concept for the structuring of management functionality that organizes the functions into groups called "logical layers" and describes the relationship between layers.

question_58249.question: What is the purpose of the test in 8.7.3C subclause?
question_58249.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that for any reported value of UE Transmitted Power, the actual UE mean power lies within the range specified in clause 8.7.3C.2.

question_58250.question: How does the process of generating a NEST (Network Slice Enablement Set) work in the context of 3GPP network architecture?
question_58250.ground_truth: The NSP maps the service requirements into the attributes of the GST with appropriate values to generate the NEST once the Network Slice Customer (NSC) provides the service requirements for the use case to the NSP.

question_58251.question: In what type of network should the SMF not request EBI allocation when a MA PDU Session is established only over non-3GPP access?

question_58252.question: In what scenarios is the SCell activation delay defined in FR1 for intra-band SCell activation?
question_58252.ground_truth: In FR1, the SCell activation delay for intra-band SCell activation is defined as the occasion when all active serving cells and SCells being activated or released are transmitting SSB bursts in the same slot.

question_58253.question: When should the floor participant request the MCPTT client to stop sending RTP media packets towards other MCPTT clients?
question_58253.ground_truth: The floor participant should request the MCPTT client to stop sending RTP media packets towards other MCPTT clients when the floor participant receives a Floor Request message with pre-emption indication or when timer T207 (Stop talking) expires and at least one Floor Request message is stored, indicating that queueing mode is used in the session.

question_58254.question: Which information element is mandatory in the "BroadcastSessionSetupRequestIEs" sequence?
question_58254.ground_truth: The "ID id-MBS-SessionID", "ID id-S-NSSAI", "ID id-MBS-ServiceArea", and "ID id-MBSSessionSetupRequestTransfer" information elements are mandatory in the "BroadcastSessionSetupRequestIEs" sequence.

question_58255.question: What is the maximum length of a short message within the TP-UD field when using uncompressed 8-bit data?
question_58255.ground_truth: The maximum length of a short message within the TP-UD field when using uncompressed 8-bit data is 134 octets.

question_58256.question: What should a UE do with the radio link failure information after 48 hours of detecting the radio link failure, a power off, detach, or entering another RAT in NB-IoT?
question_58256.ground_truth: The UE may discard the radio link failure information, i.e. release the UE variable VarRLF-Report (VarRLF-Report-NB in NB-IoT).

question_58257.question: What action should the gNB-CU-UP take if it receives a BEARER CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message containing a QoS Flow Level QoS Parameters IE for a GBR QoS Flow but where the GBR QoS Flow Information IE is not present?
question_58257.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP should report the establishment of the corresponding QoS Flow as failed in the corresponding Flow Failed List IE of the BEARER CONTEXT SETUP RESPONSE message with an appropriate cause value.

question_58258.question: What kind of channel model is used for UE mobility in the satellite and HAPS communications?
question_58258.ground_truth: A Jake's Doppler spectrum is considered for UE mobility in the satellite and HAPS communications.

question_58260.question: What should the MME do when it receives a BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message for a PDN connection established for emergency bearer services?
question_58260.ground_truth: The MME should reply with a BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT message with ESM cause #30 "request rejected by Serving GW or PDN GW" in this case.

question_58261.question: What is the role of the "WLAN Access Gateway (WAG)" in the 3GPP/WLAN interworking network architecture?
question_58261.ground_truth: The WLAN Access Gateway (WAG) in the 3GPP/WLAN interworking network architecture is responsible for providing a radio access point for WLAN devices and interfacing with the 3GPP system.

question_58263.question: What is the requirement for the MS when receiving a HANDOVER TO UTRAN COMMAND message from GSM and the target frequency is not implemented in the MS?
question_58263.ground_truth: The MS shall return a HANDOVER FAILURE message with cause "frequency not implemented" and continue the voice call on the old channel.

question_58264.question: What are the different levels to be considered for an overload control mechanism in 3GPP Charging Applications?
question_58264.ground_truth: The different levels are at Diameter protocol level, at Diameter Application level (Accounting Application and Credit-Control Application), at 3GPP Charging Application level (Ro/Rf), and at "3GPP-service-Context" level (PS-Charging, IMS-Charging, SMS-Charging, etc.).

question_58266.question: What network scenarios are specified in sub clause 4.4.1.2.2 of the document?
question_58266.ground_truth: Non-standalone E-UTRA single cell and FDD or TDD NR intra-frequency single mode multi cell environment, FDD or TDD E-UTRA intra-frequency single mode multi cell and FDD or TDD NR inter-frequency single mode multi cell environment, FDD or TDD E-UTRA inter-frequency single mode multi cell and FDD or TDD NR inter-frequency single mode multi cell environment, and single E-UTRA cell and FDD or TDD NR inter-band single mode multi cell environment are specified in sub clause 4.4.1.2.2 of the document.

question_58267.question: What does the BSS do before sending the PS Handover Required Acknowledge message to the source BSS in the execution phase?
question_58267.ground_truth: Before sending the PS Handover Required Acknowledge message, the SGSN, based on QoS, may suspend downlink data transfer for any PDP contexts, and the source BSS, based on QoS, may try to empty the downlink BSS buffer for any BSS PFCs.

question_58269.question: What types of information may be relevant for software inventory in the SID model?
question_58269.ground_truth: Attributes such as RootEntity.objectID, RootEntity.commonName, RootEntity.desctiption, RootEntity.version, Software.buildNumber, Software.majorVersion, Software.minorVersion, Software.maintenanceVersion, Software.targetPlatform, Resource.usageState, LogicalResource.serviceState, and LogicalResource.isOperational may be relevant for software inventory in the SID model.

question_58270.question: What is the purpose of defining PLMN connection types?
question_58270.ground_truth: The definition of PLMN connection types provides the necessary input to identify the network capabilities of a PLMN and facilitates the specification of network-to-network interfaces. It may also assist in the allocation of network performance parameters and in determining the network capabilities required to support a specific telecommunication service.

question_58272.question: What is the requirement for H(e)NB device authentication with the SeGW?
question_58272.ground_truth: If the operator chooses not to use IPsec, mutual authentication between the H(e)NB device and the SeGW is required. The interface between the H(e)NB and SeGW shall then be secured with a mechanism that provides layer 2 security for confidentiality and integrity protection of communications. This mechanism then shall also bind this secure communications to device authentication between H(e)NB and SeGW and optional HPM authentication.

question_58273.question: What statistics should be kept for a signal generator sending random codewords in regular time periods in the context of ACK missed detection?
question_58273.ground_truth: The statistics kept are the number of falsely detected ACK bits in the idle periods and the number of missed ACK bits.

question_58274.question: What drawbacks does the solution have in terms of UE's data transmission process in connection less mode?
question_58274.ground_truth: In connection less mode, UE decides the cell changes, which may collide with network-based resource control. This may cause potential issues with network control and resource allocation.

question_58276.question: How long is the S-SSB period in NR sidelink communication?
question_58276.ground_truth: The S-SSB period is 160 ms in NR sidelink communication.

question_58277.question: In situation 11f, what is the condition for the band relation between PCC(TDD) and SCell1 to be intra-band and the other SCells to be inter-band?
question_58277.ground_truth: The condition is that the band relation between PCC(TDD) and SCell1 is intra-band and the band relation between PCC(TDD) and other SCells are inter-band.

question_58278.question: What is the role of the ProSe UE-to-Network Relay in unicast uplink traffic?
question_58278.ground_truth: The ProSe UE-to-Network Relay uses the uplink TFTs to select the uplink EPS bearers for relayed uplink packets independently from the ProSe Per Packet Priority applied over PC5 by Remote UEs.

question_58279.question: What is the procedure for activating a Group Communication Session by establishing a PDU Session?
question_58279.ground_truth: The procedure involves the AF requesting the NEF to activate the Group Communication Session, the NEF checking authorization, retrieving the list of UE identifiers of the group, updating the UE policy, notifying the PCF for updating policy data, and initiating the UE Policy delivery procedure.

question_58280.question: What is the test purpose described in section 17.5.1.4?
question_58280.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in section 17.5.1.4 is to verify that the UE properly detects the out of sync and in sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the PCell.

question_58281.question: What is the main impact when applying higher order modulations with increasing degree?
question_58281.ground_truth: The main impact is on the RF receiver and transmitter, with modest increases in computational complexity at the receiver.

question_58282.question: What is the expected action of the UE during time duration T3?
question_58282.ground_truth: During time duration T3, the UE is expected to detect Out-Of-Sync (OOS) and declare Radio Link Failure (RLF).

question_58284.question: What is the purpose of energy saving management solutions in 5G networks?
question_58284.ground_truth: The purpose of energy saving management solutions is to lower operational expense by decreasing power consumption in 5G networks, while maintaining coverage, capacity, and quality of service.

question_58287.question: What happens when a FRMCS User joins a voice communication in progress?
question_58287.ground_truth: Other FRMCS Users involved in the communication receive a notification that the FRMCS User has joined, and the user is identified to them.

question_58288.question: What action does the AMF take if a 5G-GUTI was sent in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message and the UE sends a REGISTRATION COMPLETE message?
question_58288.ground_truth: The AMF shall stop timer T3550 and change to state 5GMM-REGISTERED. The 5G-GUTI, if sent in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message, shall be considered as valid.

question_58289.question: Who is responsible for the OAM work task in SA5 for the Local IP Access and Selected Internet IP Traffic Offload work item?
question_58289.ground_truth: SA5, Zou Lan <zlan@huawei.com> and Chen Gang <chengang@chinamobile.com>

question_58290.question: What is one of the main requirements for the 7.68 Mcps TDD option in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_58290.ground_truth: One of the main requirements for the 7.68 Mcps TDD option in the 3GPP technical specification is to minimize the user equipment (UE) and network complexity while maintaining a given system performance level.

question_58291.question: When sending continuously uplink power control commands to the UE, what delay is allowed after the first TPC command before the UE reaches its PUMAX level?
question_58291.ground_truth: At least 200 ms from the first TPC command is allowed for the UE to reach its PUMAX level.

question_58292.question: What should the UE indicate in the de-registration type IE when the de-registration procedure is triggered due to USIM removal?
question_58292.ground_truth: The UE shall indicate "switch off" in the de-registration type IE.

question_58293.question: What is the relaying mechanism used by IAB in the NR Uu backhaul links?
question_58293.ground_truth: IAB performs relaying at layer-2, and therefore does not require a local UPF.

question_58294.question: In which time period does L2 interruption occur while identifying CGI of an NR cell with autonomous gaps, where autonomous gaps are used in the frequency range of PCell or any activated SCell?
question_58294.ground_truth: L2 interruption occurs during SIB1 decoding time period TSIB1 (ms) specified in clause 9.11, when the CORESET for RMSI scheduling multiplexing patterns 2 and 3 are used.

question_58296.question: In what state does the network enter after starting a de-registration procedure for 5GMM and waiting for a response from the UE?
question_58296.ground_truth: The network enters state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED after it has started a de-registration procedure and is waiting for a response from the UE.

question_58299.question: Which network layer protocols can be encapsulated in N-PDUs in the cellular IoT traffic model?
question_58299.ground_truth: N-PDUs may consist of the encapsulation of the following protocols: IP, UDP or TCP, TLS/DTLS, Application-level protocol such as HTTP or COAP.

question_58300.question: What is the response message from the BSS to a BSSMAP-LE Assistance Information Request message?
question_58300.ground_truth: The BSS responds with a BSSMAP-LE Assistance Information Response message, which may include the (EC-)RACH control parameters, Coverage class thresholds, and BTS Reception Accuracy Capability applicable to the set of cells requested for assistance information.

question_58301.question: What is the requirement for the number of antenna ports that must be connected with data source from the system simulator when 4RX is supported?
question_58301.ground_truth: All four Rx ports must be connected with data source from the system simulator.

question_58303.question: What type of base station operation is not supported by the AAS BS?
question_58303.ground_truth: NB-IoT in-band, NB-IoT guard band, standalone NB-IoT operation, Band 46 operation, and Band 49 operation are not supported by the AAS BS.

question_58306.question: What is the purpose of the CAPIF-5 reference point?
question_58306.ground_truth: The CAPIF-5 reference point is used for management of service API, API invoker, and API provider domain function information. It supports functions such as accessing service API invocation logs, enabling the API management function to monitor events related to service APIs invocations, and enabling the API provider to monitor the status of service APIs.

question_58307.question: What constraints should be followed for all Representations in an Adaptation Set?
question_58307.ground_truth: The identical coverage information, frame rates, and stereoscopic information should be present on all Representations in an Adaptation Set, both on ISO BMFF and elementary stream level.

question_58308.question: What action does the MCPTT client take when it receives RTP media packets and there is no stored SSRC of the current floor arbitrator?
question_58308.ground_truth: The MCPTT client requests to render the RTP media packets, resets the counter C201 (Floor Request) to 1, sets the stored SSRC of the current floor arbitrator to the SSRC of the RTP media packet, restarts timer T203 (End of RTP media), and remains in the 'O: pending request' state.

question_58309.question: What is the procedure for setting the contents of UECapabilityInformation message if the ue-CapabilityRequest includes eutra and the UE supports both FDD and TDD, as defined in TS 36.331, clause 5.6.3.3?
question_58309.ground_truth: The fields for FDD and TDD should be set to include the values applicable for both modes, except for fdd-Add-UE-EUTRA-Capabilities and tdd-Add-UE-EUTRA-Capabilities (including their sub-fields) which should reflect the additional functionality applicable for FDD or TDD respectively.

question_58311.question: What should the S-EES do if the status in step 8 indicates a successful ACT and it is a non-planning case?
question_58311.ground_truth: The S-EES sends the ACR information notification (ACR complete) message immediately to the EEC to confirm that the ACR has completed in a non-planning case.

question_58312.question: What entities does the MBMS User Service interface with in the MBMS system?
question_58312.ground_truth: The MBMS User Service interfaces with the BM-SC, the GGSN or MBMS-GW, and the UE. In addition, for MBMS delivery of Group Communication Services, it interfaces with the GCS Application Server via the MB2 interface.

question_58313.question: What is the main task of the client application management interface in this framework?
question_58313.ground_truth: The main task of the client application management interface is to register, modify, and delete client applications (Client Application Management) and manage groups of client applications (SAG Management).

question_58314.question: What is the command type for the SEND DTMF service?
question_58314.ground_truth: The command type for the SEND DTMF service is "SEND DTMF".

question_58316.question: What is the role of the "Conference Focus" in IP multimedia services?
question_58316.ground_truth: The "Conference Focus" is an entity that has the abilities to host conferences, including their creation, maintenance, and manipulation of the media. It implements the conference policy, such as rules for talk burst control, assigning priorities, and participant rights.

question_58317.question: What action does the T-RAN take if it does not receive the UE Radio Capability ID along with the UE radio access capabilities from the source RAN node during a handover procedure?
question_58317.ground_truth: The T-RAN proceeds with the handover using the received UE radio access capabilities.

question_58320.question: For what purposes is the Handover-Info header field used?
question_58320.ground_truth: The Handover-Info header field is used to indicate that the UE needs to be re-authenticated using mechanisms defined in 3GPP TS 24.229, and to inform when a re-authentication of a UE entering the mobile network has been completed. It can also be used to inform the UE of the role in a call, fulfilling legal requirements.

question_58322.question: What action does the UE take when deregistering all contact addresses associated with its public user identity and private user identity?
question_58322.ground_truth: The UE sends a single REGISTER request, using one of its contact addresses and the associated set of security associations or TLS session, containing a public user identity that is being deregistered in the To header field, and a single Contact header field with value of "*" and the Expires header field with a value of "0".

question_58323.question: What is the system that provides data connection for AR glasses to access metaverse services in this use case?
question_58323.ground_truth: The 5G system, which can be connected to the 5G network through direct device connection or NG-RAN.

question_58324.question: When should the UE delete stored deprioritisation requests?
question_58324.ground_truth: The UE shall delete stored deprioritisation requests when it enters a different RRC state, the optional validity time of dedicated priorities (T320) expires, or when a PLMN selection is performed on request by NAS.

question_58325.question: What should the transmitter spurious emission limits in LTE-Advanced comply with, for each antenna connector?
question_58325.ground_truth: The transmitter spurious emission limits of LTE-Advanced should comply with ITU-R SM.329, for each antenna connector.

question_58326.question: What happens to the TCX gain if only the second packet is lost in a TCX512 frame?
question_58326.ground_truth: The full TCX gain is obtained from the first packet.

question_58329.question: What is the objective of the mechanisms studied in the "Study on remote interference management for NR"?
question_58329.ground_truth: The objective of the mechanisms studied is to improve network robustness and address strong remote base station interference, identify which gNBs generate strong remote interference, and coordinate additional strategies among gNBs for mitigating remote interference.

question_58331.question: What should a UE do if the Back-off timer value IE is not included and the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST was sent standalone?
question_58331.ground_truth: The UE may send another PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST, BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST, or BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message for the same APN.

question_58332.question: How are the default/alternate options determined in a roaming scenario for a non-local ID target?
question_58332.ground_truth: The default/alternate options used in the HPLMN and the VPLMN are mutually independent when the target is a non-local ID in a roaming scenario.

question_58333.question: Which section in this text provides the measurement uncertainties and test tolerances for intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation CA?
question_58333.ground_truth: This information has not been determined yet and might be addressed in the future (labeled as "TBD" in the original text).

question_58334.question: What is the AF request information that the NEF stores in the UDR as "Application Data" when creating a new request?
question_58334.ground_truth: The AF request information that the NEF stores in the UDR as "Application Data" when creating a new request includes the information described in clause 5.2.6.11.

question_58336.question: What is the feature on phones that emulates key press feedback, similar to key press signaling on analogue telephones?
question_58336.ground_truth: Mobile or SIP phones provide features that emulate the key press feedback.

question_58338.question: What is the name of the two states that the GA-RC sub-layer in the MS can be in?
question_58338.ground_truth: The GA-RC sub-layer in the MS can be in either the GA-RC-DEREGISTERED or GA-RC-REGISTERED state.

question_58339.question: What does the ECS do if the EAS instantiation status corresponding to the EASID requested by AC/EEC is instantiable but not yet instantiated?
question_58339.ground_truth: The EEC selects one EES to perform EAS discovery and instantiate the EAS.

question_58341.question: What should a UE do when the S-NSSAI time validity information indicates that the S-NSSAI is available?
