question_59338.question: What message does the MS send when it receives a RRLP MEASURE POSITION REQUEST and is unable to perform positioning measurements?
question_59338.ground_truth: The MS may request additional assistance data by sending an RRLP Measure Position Response message containing a location error with IE LocErrorReason set to gpsAssDataMissing.

question_59339.question: What is the requirement for supporting tele-operated driving?
question_59339.ground_truth: Supporting functions are required at the VAE layer to enable tele-operated driving of the vehicle(s) on a sustained basis between the V2X application server and one or more V2X UEs.

question_59341.question: How many example platforms were used to determine the final SNR references?
question_59341.ground_truth: Three example platforms were used to determine the final SNR references.

question_59342.question: What is the primary objective of the testing in 9.3.1BC.4.2?
question_59342.ground_truth: The primary objective of the testing in 9.3.1BC.4.2 is to verify that the UE reports a limited range of CQI values under the predefined channel conditions and that the BLER versus CQI has the correct sense.

question_59343.question: What is the request made by the group management client of the administrator/dispatcher/authorized MC service user in step 1 of group creation?
question_59343.ground_truth: The group management client of the administrator/dispatcher/authorized MC service user requests group create operation to the group management server, including the identities of the users being combined and the information of the MC services that are enabled on the group.

question_59346.question: What should the GGSN do when the "list of downstream nodes" of a particular MBMS Bearer Context becomes empty and it has no MBMS UE Contexts linked to that MBMS Bearer Context?
question_59346.ground_truth: The GGSN sends a De-Registration Request (IP multicast address, APN) message to the BM-SC to remove the identifier of the GGSN from the "list of downstream nodes" parameter of the affected MBMS Bearer Context and confirm the operation by sending a De-Registration Response message to the GGSN.

question_59347.question: What is the algorithm used by the BSS to determine the target cell list for handover when localized service area is supported?
question_59347.ground_truth: The algorithm is not defined further in the present document.

question_59349.question: What is the purpose of local user authentication in the GBA_ME-based solution?
question_59349.ground_truth: The purpose of local user authentication in the GBA_ME-based solution is for the GAA server to confirm the presence of the authorized user and derive new NAF keys bound to the ongoing transaction.

question_59350.question: In case of a BearerContextModificationResponse message, what is the only ProtocolIE-Container that is criticality-critical?
question_59350.ground_truth: The System-BearerContextModificationResponse is the only ProtocolIE-Container that is criticality-critical in case of a BearerContextModificationResponse message.

question_59352.question: What are the required assistance data information elements for A-GPS Minimum Performance test cases defined in TS 51.010-1 subclause 70.11?
question_59352.ground_truth: They include Assistance Data Reference Time, Assistance Data Reference Location, Assistance Data Navigation Model, Assistance Data Ionospheric Model, Assistance Data Almanac, Assistance Data GPS Almanac Extension, and Assistance Data Acquisition Assistance.

question_59353.question: What action should the SeNB take if it receives a SENB MODIFICATION REQUEST message containing multiple E-RAB ID IEs set to the same value in the E-RABs To Be Added List IE or E-RABs To Be Modified List IE?
question_59353.ground_truth: The SeNB should not admit the action requested for the corresponding E-RABs.

question_59354.question: What should the NG-RAN node do if it receives the UE Context Release procedure upon reception of a UE CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST message with the release cause different than user inactivity?
question_59354.ground_truth: The UE Context Release procedure should be initiated upon reception of a UE CONTEXT RELEASE REQUEST message with the release cause different than user inactivity.

question_59355.question: What are the two forms of traffic channels that are defined to carry encoded speech and what is their gross rate?
question_59355.ground_truth: The two forms of traffic channels that are defined to carry encoded speech are the full rate traffic channel for speech (TCH/FS) and the half rate traffic channel for speech (TCH/HS). The gross rate of TCH/FS is 22,8 kbit/s and the gross rate of TCH/HS is 11,4 kbit/s.

question_59356.question: What is the test applicability for the EN-DC FR2 SSB based L1-RSRP measurement accuracy?
question_59356.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR UE supporting E-UTRA and EN-DC from Release 15 onwards.

question_59357.question: What information is provided by the SMF to the UPF during PDU Session Modification when redundant transmission is activated?
question_59357.ground_truth: The SMF provides AN Tunnel Info to the UPF as well as the corresponding forwarding rules, which indicates the UPF to replicate the downlink packets and send each replicate via one of DL N3 tunnels separately to NG-RAN, and eliminate the duplicate uplink packets received from the two UL N3 tunnels.

question_59358.question: What is the function of the mobility management sublayer in EPS services?
question_59358.ground_truth: The main function of the mobility management sublayer is to support the mobility of a user equipment, such as informing the network of its present location and providing user identity confidentiality.

question_59359.question: What is the format of the "auth-token" parameter in the "ggsn-charging-info" parameter in the P-Charging-Vector header field?
question_59359.ground_truth: The "auth-token" parameter is a sequence of 1 or more hexadecimal digits.

question_59361.question: What is the maximum event triggered measurement reporting delay for a GSM cell with verified BSIC, measured without L3 filtering?
question_59361.ground_truth: The maximum event triggered measurement reporting delay for a GSM cell with verified BSIC, measured without L3 filtering is 960 ms.

question_59362.question: What are some performance management features related to URLLC resource load?
question_59362.ground_truth: Some performance management features related to URLLC resource load include CI (Cancellation Indication), PB (Power Boosting), PI (Preemption Indication), UL (Uplink) Cancellation Mechanisms, Enhanced UL Power Control, and PRB (Physical Resource Blocks) usage rate-related measurements in TS 28.552.

question_59363.question: What does End UE#2 establish in Scenario #2 after sending a Link Release Response message to End UE#1?
question_59363.ground_truth: End UE#2 establishes a new KNRP ID combining MSB of KNRP ID with received LSB of KNRP ID.

question_59364.question: How many scenes were created and used in the test for audio localization?
question_59364.ground_truth: 10 different scenes were created by rendering one or two sound sources at different angles and mixing moving sources with stationary sources.

question_59365.question: Which potential requirement is related to delivering V2X messages by an RSU?
question_59365.ground_truth: PR.5.14.5-002 is the potential requirement related to delivering V2X messages by an RSU, which states: "When requested by the V2X Service layer, an RSU shall be able to deliver V2X messages to a traffic safety server and/or UEs supporting V2I Service and/or to other RSUs."

question_59366.question: What does the HST FR2 Scenario-A mobility performance demonstrate?
question_59366.ground_truth: It demonstrates that the HST FR2 Scenario-A deployment, where the train is traveling in the direction opposite to serving beam orientation, may experience mobility challenges when DRX cycle of 40 ms is used in enhanced requirements. However, mobility robustness is sufficient when DRX cycle of 40 ms is used in Scenario-A with enhanced requirements.

question_59367.question: What are some of the potential normative works for the XR processing and media centric architectures in 6G?
question_59367.ground_truth: The potential normative works for XR processing and media centric architectures in 6G include display, tracking and pose generation, viewport rendering, capture of real-world content, media encoding, media decoding, media content delivery, 5GS communication, media formats, metadata, and other data delivered on communication links, and spatial location processing.

question_59369.question: What is the potential requirement for identification related to a MnS consumer in a different management domain within the 3GPP management system?

question_59371.question: What is the role of the CBC in the cell broadcast service?
question_59371.ground_truth: The CBC is responsible for managing CBS messages and determining the CBS delivery parameters for the BSS/RNS.

question_59374.question: What does MNP stand for in the context of the document?

question_59375.question: Which access types does the MP-DCCP solution support in the context of ATSSS?
question_59375.ground_truth: The MP-DCCP solution supports both 3GPP and non-3GPP access in the context of ATSSS.

question_59376.question: What is the purpose of introducing authorization of the role of the UE during discovery in solution #4?
question_59376.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure that the roles of the UEs involved in Ranging/Sidelink Positioning services are properly authorized, which helps to prevent unauthorized UEs from cheating and violating service, privacy, or charging rules.

question_59377.question: In 8.2.2.4.1C, what type of interference model is used in the tests?
question_59377.ground_truth: The tests in 8.2.2.4.1C are conducted using the transmission mode 4 interference model defined in clause B.5.3.

question_59379.question: What is the purpose of the Ga-SM protocol in the PS control plane?
question_59379.ground_truth: GA-SM protocol takes the role of NAS 24.008 and reuses 24.008 SM messages. It allows for a make-before-break handover during PDP context establishment.

question_59381.question: What does a role name indicate in an association relationship?
question_59381.ground_truth: A role name in an association relationship indicates the role played by the model element involved in that association.

question_59383.question: What is the purpose of the eNA feature in the 5G system?
question_59383.ground_truth: The eNA feature in the 5G system specifies the data collected by NWDAF and the NWDAF output to support network automation, and includes architecture enhancements of the 5G system to support network data analytics service and a framework to enable data collection and provide analytics to consumers.

question_59384.question: Under shared spectrum channel access, what does a BS need to comply with, in addition to the regional requirements for operation?
question_59384.ground_truth: In addition to regional requirements, a BS may need to comply with operating band unwanted emissions limits, which could be in the form of conducted power, power spectral density, EIRP, or other types of limits.

question_59386.question: What should the PDG do with the user information when it performs the tunnel disconnect procedure?
question_59386.ground_truth: The PDG shall remove any stored user information pertaining to that APN after performing the tunnel disconnect procedure.

question_59387.question: What is the purpose of the PC5 interface in ProSe Direct Discovery?
question_59387.ground_truth: The PC5 interface is used for ProSe Direct Discovery communication between User Equipments (UEs) in the same ProSe Relay Cell.

question_59388.question: What is the method used to report subjective test results for the 3GPP audio codecs in the present document?
question_59388.ground_truth: The method used to report subjective test results for the 3GPP audio codecs in the present document is MUltiple Stimuli with Hidden Reference and Anchors (MUSHRA).

question_59389.question: Who collects information from the peer Dedicated 5GS Network Function in this process?
question_59389.ground_truth: The Dedicated 5GS UE Function is responsible for collecting information from its peer Dedicated 5GS Network Function, such as the 5GMS AS, BM-SC, and MBSF.

question_59391.question: How many sine sweep repeats were used to measure each BRIR on average?
question_59391.ground_truth: Each BRIR was measured as the average of 4 logarithmic sine sweep repeats.

question_59392.question: What should a UE do if there is no reference signal received for the CSI measurement over the delay corresponding to the minimum requirements, and there are no uplink resources for reporting the valid CSI in the required subframe?
question_59392.ground_truth: The UE shall use the next available uplink resource for reporting the corresponding valid CSI.

question_59393.question: How should the MGCF indicate support for the preconditions mechanism in responses that include an SDP body to the session modification request?
question_59393.ground_truth: If the precondition mechanism is used for session modification, the MGCF shall indicate support for the preconditions mechanism by using the Require header field in responses that include an SDP body to the session modification request.

question_59394.question: What shall a transmission participant do when it receives a Transmission Request message with a priority different than the default transmission priority?
question_59394.ground_truth: The transmission participant shall include the Transmission Priority field with the requested priority in the Transmission Request message.

question_59396.question: What is the role of the 3GPP network in the verification of authorization tokens?
question_59396.ground_truth: The 3GPP network can verify the authorization token on behalf of the UE-to-UE relay if it is in 3GPP coverage.

question_59398.question: What is the recommendation for including the Vendor-Specific-Application-Id AVP in new 3GPP applications?
question_59398.ground_truth: It is recommended not to include the Vendor-Specific-Application-Id AVP in the command's CCF specification for new 3GPP applications.

question_59399.question: What should an MTSI client in terminal do when it receives an ANBR message for the local uplink that triggers an adaptation decision?
question_59399.ground_truth: If the adaptation decision results in a reduction of the media sender bitrate, it should be initiated immediately without further signaling. If the adaptation decision results in an increase of the media sender bitrate, the media sender should wait for sufficient time for the remote media receiver to receive and react to the corresponding TMMBN message.

question_59400.question: What is the primary use case of the MCData-FD-4 reference point?
question_59400.ground_truth: The MCData-FD-4 reference point is used by the media storage client of MCData UE to upload and download files to the media storage function of the MCData content server.

question_59401.question: What is the timing requirement for the delivery of IRI and CC in the 3GPP network?
question_59401.ground_truth: The IRI and CC shall be delivered in as near real-time as possible. The CSP shall timestamp IRI and CC delivery with a time zone indication (e.g., UTC offset) as part of the timestamp.

question_59402.question: What is the interfering signal for the General blocking test requirement for an NR wanted signal with a channel bandwidth greater than 20 MHz?
question_59402.ground_truth: The interfering signal for the General blocking test requirement for an NR wanted signal with a channel bandwidth greater than 20 MHz should be a 20 MHz E-UTRA signal.

question_59403.question: Which channels were identified as potential bottleneck channels for the Urban 28 GHz scenario?
question_59403.ground_truth: The channels identified as potential bottleneck channels for the Urban 28 GHz scenario are PUSCH eMBB (DDDSU and DDSU), PUSCH VoIP (DDDSU and DDSU), PUCCH F3 11bits, PUCCH F3 22bits, PRACH B4, PUSCH of Msg3.

question_59404.question: What should the MCVideo server consider as the served MCVideo group information entry in the list of MCVideo group information entries?
question_59404.ground_truth: The MCVideo server should consider an MCVideo group information entry such that it is in the list of MCVideo group information entries and the MCVideo group ID of the MCVideo group information entry is equal to the served MCVideo group ID.

question_59406.question: What is the purpose of the "oauth2-requested-services" parameter in the Sbi-Nrf-Uri header?
question_59406.ground_truth: The "oauth2-requested-services" parameter indicates the list of NRF services for which OAuth2 based authorization is required for accessing the respective NRF services.

question_59407.question: What kind of bearers are setup for the MT in IAB-MTs?
question_59407.ground_truth: The bearers are used by the MT for its own data and signalling traffic, and one or more RLC-channels are included for backhauling.

question_59408.question: What indication does the StartStop-Indication AVP provide for an MBMS bearer?
question_59408.ground_truth: The StartStop-Indication AVP indicates whether an activation, modification, or deactivation of an MBMS bearer is requested.

question_59409.question: What is the goal of HTML5 in terms of browser compatibility and plugin-free environment?
question_59409.ground_truth: HTML5 was specified to create convergence among a wide range of interoperable browsers and to operate in a plugin-free environment by providing APIs to fulfill most of the plugin needs.

question_59410.question: What is the noise rise threshold set for the macro layer and micro layer in Option A and Option B?
question_59410.ground_truth: In Option A, the noise rise threshold for the macro layer is 6 dB and for the micro layer is 20 dB. In Option B, the noise rise threshold is 6 dB for both the macro and micro layer, but the microcells are de-sensitized of 14 dB.

question_59411.question: What should a terminating transmission participant do when an MCVideo call is established and it has received a Transmission Granted message?
question_59411.ground_truth: The terminating transmission participant shall create an instance of a transmission participant state transition diagram, start timer T230 (Inactivity), and enter the 'O: silence' state.

question_59412.question: What is the role of the PGW-C+SMF in the 5G core network?
question_59412.ground_truth: The PGW-C+SMF in the 5G core network provides N4 rules to UPF for performing QoS enforcement and for mapping downlink traffic to appropriate GTP-U tunnels.

question_59413.question: What was the result of the fifth proactive command response (OPEN CHANNEL 2.5.1A)?
question_59413.ground_truth: The command was performed with modifications (buffer size) and the channel identifier 1 was activated.

question_59415.question: What decision does the target BSS make based on the ABQP for each PFC to assign radio resources?
question_59415.ground_truth: The target BSS decides which PFCs need resources using an implementation-specific algorithm, and allocates TBFs for each PFC that it can accommodate.

question_59418.question: What is the aim of the CAPIF support for service APIs from multiple providers?
question_59418.ground_truth: To allow multiple API providers to host and operate CAPIF in a coordinated fashion and offer operator B's or 3rd party service providers' service APIs via the operator A hosted CAPIF.

question_59419.question: In the 41.5.1.1.3.2 test procedure, what is the purpose of verifying that the MS does not attempt to establish an uplink TBF whilst in DM and in a cell that indicates that DTM is unsupported?
question_59419.ground_truth: To ensure that the MS understands the SI6 Rest Octets information element, which indicates network support of DTM, and does not attempt to establish an uplink TBF whilst in such conditions.

question_59421.question: What should the network or MS do if errors occur during the processing of the Facility Information Element in call independent SS procedures?
question_59421.ground_truth: The network or MS may clear the call and reject the supplementary services request by means of a clearing message which contains a Return Error component with the appropriate parameter in the Facility Information Element.

question_59422.question: How do Codec Mode Commands (CMC) work in GERAN, and what is their significance for the user plane?
question_59422.ground_truth: In GERAN, Codec Mode Commands (CMC) are transported in SID and Speech frames in the user plane. These commands repeat endlessly to provide extreme robust forward error correction, allowing fast error recovery even in the user plane. This ensures optimal communication quality for humans by improving response times and synchronization between media payload and Codec Mode Requests (CMR).

question_59423.question: What is the synchronization time at high SNR for both the original EC-SCH and alternative EC-SCH designs?
question_59423.ground_truth: The synchronization time at the high SNR (i.e. at the low end of the coupling loss range) can be significantly reduced by decoding the legacy SCH in addition to the EC-SCH for both the original and alternative EC-SCH designs.

question_59424.question: What is the purpose of the "Manage UE Policy Command" message in the "Contents of UE Policy Delivery messages" section?
question_59424.ground_truth: The "Manage UE Policy Command" message is used to manage UE policies in E-UTRA-PC5 communications. It specifies the V2X services to be provisioned to the UE, and the policy rules for each V2X service.

question_59425.question: What is the function of the "V2X service identifier to V2X E-UTRA frequency mapping rules" section?
question_59425.ground_truth: This section maps V2X service identifiers to V2X E-UTRA frequencies in E-UTRA-PC5 communications, which is used to determine the frequency band for V2X communications.

question_59426.question: What is the purpose of optimizing the DPCCH slot format in the downlink?
question_59426.ground_truth: The purpose is to eliminate dedicated pilots in the downlink and re-allocate the freed-up pilot bit positions to data bits, which can achieve significant improvements in link efficiency and inter-cell interference.

question_59427.question: What is the aim of Network A's agreement with Network C in the "Use Case of Home Network Steering UEs to Different Localized Service Networks"?
question_59427.ground_truth: The aim is to allow Network A's UEs to use Network C's network during the fair to access the localized services and connectivity provided by Network A.

question_59428.question: What is the requirement for the measurement reporting delay for the E-UTRAN TDD-TDD inter frequency measurements test?
question_59428.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between an event that will trigger a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface, assuming that the measurement report is not delayed by other RRC signalling on the DCCH. This measurement reporting delay excludes a delay uncertainty resulted when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH.

question_59430.question: What should the MME do if the DETACH REQUEST message could not be delivered due to an intra MME handover and the target TA is included in the TAI list?
question_59430.ground_truth: Upon successful completion of the intra MME handover, the MME shall retransmit the DETACH REQUEST message.

question_59431.question: What new measurements are recommended for NR carrier phase positioning?
question_59431.ground_truth: The new measurements recommended for NR carrier phase positioning include the difference between the carrier phase measured from the DL PRS signal(s) of the target TRP and the carrier phase measured from the DL PRS signal(s) of the reference TRP for DL carrier phase positioning, and the carrier phases measured from the UL SRS for positioning purpose for UL carrier phase positioning.

question_59432.question: What are the mechanisms used by the DNS system to provide a translation of the FQDN of an EAS into the address of an EAS as close as possible to the UE in a 5G system?
question_59432.ground_truth: The DNS system uses the source IP address of the incoming DNS Query and/or an EDNS Client Subnet (ECS) option to provide a translation of the FQDN of an EAS into the address of an EAS as close as possible to the UE in a 5G system. The DNS information for private namespaces can be provisioned in the EAS Deployment Information via AF request with the Application Identifier, or DNN and NSSAI.

question_59433.question: What should the UE do if it has connection establishment failure information or connection resume failure information available in VarConnEstFailReport or VarConnEstFailReportList and if the RPLMN is equal to the plmn-Identity stored in VarConnEstFailReport or in at least one of the entries of VarConnEstFailReportList?
question_59433.ground_truth: Include connEstFailInfoAvailable in the RRCSetupComplete message.

question_59434.question: What feature does the HSS support, as indicated in the "Gdd in SGSN" feature?
question_59434.ground_truth: The HSS supports the "Gdd in SGSN" feature, where "Gdd" stands for "Gateway Drug Selection."

question_59435.question: What message and parameters does the UE send to the RAN during the registration process?
question_59435.ground_truth: The UE sends an AN message with AN parameters (including the selected NPN ID) and a Registration Request (with certain parameters) to the RAN.

question_59436.question: In the 8.69 parameter, when the current serving cell is not an E-UTRA cell, what is set to 255?

question_59437.question: What must the I-CSCF do when it receives an initial request and the topmost Route header contains more than one URI?
question_59437.ground_truth: The I-CSCF removes its own SIP URI from the topmost Route header and forwards the request based on the topmost Route header.

question_59438.question: What method is used to request the calculation of authentication vector(s) for the provided SUPI and the requested authentication method in the HssSecurityInformation resource?
question_59438.ground_truth: The "generate-av" custom operation is used to request the calculation of authentication vector(s) for the provided SUPI and the requested authentication method in the HssSecurityInformation resource.

question_59440.question: What are the new or enhanced 5G performance measurements defined in Rel-16 for NG-RAN and 5GC?
question_59440.ground_truth: The new or enhanced 5G performance measurements are defined for network functions in NG-RAN and 5GC, covering aspects related to QoS flow, handover success rate, UE throughput, PDU session success rate, PDU session establishment time, inter-gNB handover execution time, and latency in NG-RAN nodes and interfaces.

question_59442.question: What does the term "II-NNI" refer to in the document?
question_59442.ground_truth: II-NNI refers to the Inter-IMS Network to Network Interface consisting of Ici and Izi reference points between IMS networks.

question_59443.question: What are two methods recommended for achieving guaranteed QoS and high efficiency usage of AIPN resources in an AIPN?
question_59443.ground_truth: The two methods recommended are the ability to control routing of IP traffic dynamically based on resource usage conditions, and the ability to monitor the AIPN entities' statistics in real-time to route IP traffic dynamically based on network conditions.

question_59444.question: How do power cuts impact the telecom network?
question_59444.ground_truth: Power cuts can impact the telecom network by causing service outages, either as a primary or secondary cause. This is because the telecom network requires electricity and has a limited capacity to operate without energy from the power grid. If there is a failure in the power grid, the faulty part needs to be disconnected to avoid risk for fire or human injuries due to short circuit.

question_59445.question: How does the target 5G-AN node handle handover during inter NG-RAN node handover without Xn interface?
question_59445.ground_truth: During inter NG-RAN node handover without Xn interface, if an NGAP UE-TNLA-binding exists for a UE, the source 5G-AN node sends the N2 Handover Required message using the corresponding TNL address of the AMF. If no NGAP UE-TNLA-binding exists, the source 5G-AN node creates one by selecting a TNL association from the available TNL associations for the target 5G-AN node. The target AMF selects a TNL association from the available TNL associations for the target 5G-AN node and sends the N2 Handover Request message via this TNL association.

question_59447.question: What was the impact on the Wi-Fi network when at least 20% of the offered traffic was not served in one source?
question_59447.ground_truth: There was a degradation in 9 out of the 24 measured metrics, including a degradation of 98% in the 5th percentile throughput for the coexisting Wi-Fi operator.

question_59448.question: What is the maximum allowed interruption time (Tinterrupt) for an intra-frequency or inter-frequency handover in NR FR2?
question_59448.ground_truth: Tinterrupt should be less than the sum of Tsearch, TIU, Tprocessing, and Tmargin.

question_59449.question: What is the main advantage of the synchronized double handover solution?
question_59449.ground_truth: It eliminates the load on the Abis and A-Interface, double delay jumps, handover signaling on A-Interfaces, and transcoding effort, providing a substantial improvement in quality.

question_59450.question: What requirement does BEREC Guidelines on Roaming Regulation Draft state about enabling customers to access regulated voice, SMS and data roaming services provided as a bundle by any alternative roaming provider?
question_59450.ground_truth: BEREC Guidelines on Roaming Regulation Draft requires that domestic mobile providers shall enable their customers to access regulated voice, SMS and data roaming services provided as a bundle by any alternative roaming provider.

question_59451.question: What is a requirement for placing individually addressed calls to a user in a partner MC system?
question_59451.ground_truth: The address of the called party should include the address of the primary MC system of the called party.

question_59452.question: What are the four types of IRI records and when should they be used?
question_59452.ground_truth: The four types of IRI records are IRI-Begin, IRI-End, IRI-Continue, and IRI-REPORT. IRI-Begin should be used at the first event of a communication attempt, IRI-End at the end of a communication attempt, IRI-Continue at any time during a communication attempt, and IRI-REPORT for non-communication related events.

question_59453.question: What are the conditions for a WLAN to be considered for traffic steering from UTRAN to WLAN in terms of ChannelUtilizationWLAN, BackhaulRateDlWLAN, BackhaulRateUlWLAN, and BeaconRSSI?
question_59453.ground_truth: A WLAN is considered for traffic steering from UTRAN to WLAN if ChannelUtilizationWLAN is less than ThreshChUtilWLAN, Low, BackhaulRateDlWLAN is greater than ThreshBackhRateDLWLAN, High, BackhaulRateUlWLAN is greater than ThreshBackhRateULWLAN, High, and BeaconRSSI is greater than ThreshBeaconRSSIWLAN, High.

question_59454.question: What does the 9.2.2.140 IE provide in the context of UE?
question_59454.ground_truth: This IE provides position data that is UE-based.

question_59455.question: What should the call control entity of the MS in the "disconnect indication" state do upon receipt of a DISCONNECT message with an Allowed Actions IE indicating "Activation of CCBS is possible"?
question_59455.ground_truth: The call control entity of the MS in the "disconnect indication" state, upon receipt of a DISCONNECT message with an Allowed Actions IE indicating "Activation of CCBS is possible", should pass the indication to the upper layer, enter the "disconnect indication" state, stop all running call control timers and await a response from the upper layers.

question_59457.question: What type of information is required in a request for maritime safety information from a UE in 3GPP system?
question_59457.ground_truth: The information related to a vessel-dedicated UE's actual position, including current position, heading, speed, and scheduled navigational routes, is required in a message sent from a UE in order to request a maritime safety information.

question_59458.question: In what scenarios does the S9a establishment procedure get triggered from the PCRF when there is an IP-CAN session establishment?
question_59458.ground_truth: The S9a establishment procedure from the PCRF gets triggered in two scenarios: when a Gxb* session is established by ePDG, and when IP-CAN session establishment is done via S2c or untrusted s2b-GTP.

question_59459.question: When should a UE initiating emergency services not indicate MICO preference during Registration procedure?
question_59459.ground_truth: A UE initiating emergency services should not indicate MICO preference during the Registration procedure.

question_59461.question: What HTTP method is used to modify an existing resource in order to update an individual LPI Parameters Provisioning resource?
question_59461.ground_truth: The PATCH method is used to modify an existing resource in order to update an individual LPI Parameters Provisioning resource.

question_59462.question: How should the UE populate the Contact header field of a request if IMS AKA is in use as a security mechanism and the UE has not obtained a GRUU?
question_59462.ground_truth: The UE should populate the Contact header field with the protected server port and the respective contact address.

question_59465.question: What is the measurement provided in 5.1.1.1.7.1, and what does it calculate?
question_59465.ground_truth: The measurement provided in 5.1.1.1.7.1 is the distribution of UL packet delay between NG-RAN and UE, which includes the delay in NG-RAN and the delay over Uu interface, excluding D1 UL PDCP delay in the UE. This measurement is calculated per PLMN ID, per 5QI, and per supported S-NSSAI.

question_59466.question: What component does the Relay UE use to filter out the received frames based on the ProSe Layer-2 Group ID contained in the Destination Layer-2 ID?

question_59467.question: What is the effect of the IP-CAN session modification procedure in the solution described in clause 7.2.1.2?
question_59467.ground_truth: The IP-CAN session modification procedure is used to update the routing rules and install the relevant QoS rules in the correct BBERFs.

question_59468.question: What is the purpose of the back-off timer value in an EPS session management reject message?
question_59468.ground_truth: It regulates the time interval at which the UE may retry the same procedure.

question_59469.question: What happens if the UE fails to perform the handover correctly in the test procedure?
question_59469.ground_truth: If the UE fails to perform the handover correctly, it will result in a failure test, and the UE will switch back to serving Cell 1 or be switched off.

question_59470.question: What must the MS do when it receives new charging information mid-way through a call in the form of a Facility IE contained within a FACILITY message?
question_59470.ground_truth: The MS must correctly indicate the total charge considering both sets of charging information.

question_59475.question: What is one of the requirements for the minimum conformance in 8.16.88?
question_59475.ground_truth: One of the requirements for the minimum conformance in 8.16.88 is the normative reference 3GPP TS 36.133, clause 8.3.3.2.1, and A.8.16.88.

question_59476.question: What is one of the charging-related potential requirements for the 5G LAN-type service?

question_59477.question: If the Random Access procedure was initiated for SI request, what should the MAC entity do if there is no contention-free Random Access Resource associated with the selected CSI-RS?
question_59477.ground_truth: The MAC entity should determine the next available PRACH occasion from the PRACH occasions corresponding to the SSB in candidateBeamRSList which is quasi-collocated with the selected CSI-RS.

question_59478.question: Which interfaces does the document define for trusted and untrusted WLAN using S2a and S2b interfaces?
question_59478.ground_truth: The document defines solutions addressing trusted WLAN using S2a interface and untrusted WLAN using S2b interface.

question_59479.question: What happens if a CFB activation or deactivation request is received by a network element that is of protocol version 1?
question_59479.ground_truth: The request will be rejected by the network.

question_59480.question: What are the design constraints recommended for mono/stereo backward compatibility in the surround sound codec?
question_59480.ground_truth: The design constraints recommended for mono/stereo backward compatibility in the surround sound codec include the ability to ignore additional side information by non-surround-capable terminals, deliver a mono or stereo backward-compatible part of the bit-stream, and provide automatic or artistic stereo downmix depending on the core coder.

question_59481.question: What is the purpose of the MPVQ indexing scheme in the encoder side?
question_59481.ground_truth: The MPVQ indexing scheme on the encoder side is run in the order of position to position 0.

question_59482.question: What is the "Forbidden PLMN" data field set to in step 1.1 of the procedure if there is no HPLMN search timer value available on the SIM?
question_59482.ground_truth: The "Forbidden PLMN" data field shall contain NULL values.

question_59486.question: What is the maximum value of the "INTEGER" in the "RequestTypeAccuracyCode" field in the "RequestTypeAccuracy" structure?
question_59486.ground_truth: The maximum value of the "INTEGER" in the "RequestTypeAccuracyCode" field in the "RequestTypeAccuracy" structure is 127.

question_59488.question: What is the role of the SS (Support Station) in the described testing procedure?
question_59488.ground_truth: The SS is responsible for negatively acknowledging the MS's uplink RLC data blocks and checking if the MS re-transmits them correctly using the required MCS and PAN field.

question_59492.question: What is the length of the COUNT-I and the RRC HFN?
question_59492.ground_truth: The COUNT-I is 32 bits long, while the RRC HFN is 28 bits long.

question_59494.question: What should the 3GPP AAA Proxy do upon receipt of a DER message with the IMEI-Check-Request-in-VPLMN bit set to 1 in the DER-Flags AVP?
question_59494.ground_truth: The 3GPP AAA Proxy should check the Mobile Equipment's identity status towards the EIR and determine whether to continue or stop the authentication and authorization procedure based on the IMEI check result and availability of IMEI(SV).

question_59495.question: What are some of the IDL alternatives that can be used for web technology (RESTful APIs, HTTP/JSON, etc.) in the 3GPP system architecture?
question_59495.ground_truth: Some of the IDL alternatives that can be used for web technology in the 3GPP system architecture include ASN.1, RELAX-NG, WSDL / XML Schema, ABNF, YANG, OpenAPI Specification (Swagger), JSON Schema, JSON Content Rules, JSON RPC, Protocol Buffers and Apache Thrift.

question_59496.question: What is the SOAP Solution Set (SS) in the context of 3GPP's Bulk CM IRP?
question_59496.ground_truth: The SOAP Solution Set (SS) is a specific set of technical specifications for the IRP's semantics, which specifies the use of SOAP for the IRP to interact with an Information Service (IS).

question_59497.question: What is the purpose of introducing a "notification" mechanism in Release 15 5GC?
question_59497.ground_truth: The purpose of introducing a "notification" mechanism in Release 15 5GC is to allow the core network to request the RAN to not release the radio bearer/QoS Flow when the QoS guarantee cannot be met, and to notify the Core Network when the QoS drops and when it is restored.

question_59498.question: What determines which bearers are subject to the throttling of Downlink Data Notification requests in the SGW-C?
question_59498.ground_truth: The SGW-C determines which bearers are subject to the throttling of Downlink Data Notification requests on the basis of the bearer's ARP priority level and the operator policy.

question_59499.question: What is the definition of Nfreq in the context of Increased UE carrier monitoring E-UTRA?
question_59499.ground_truth: Nfreq = Nfreq,n + Nfreq,r, where Nfreq,n is the total number of interfrequency carriers to be monitored with normal measurement performance and Nfreq,r is the total number of interfrequency carriers to be monitored with reduced measurement performance.

question_59500.question: What is the measure of a receiver's capability to receive wanted data packets without being degraded by an interfering signal in an adjacent channel?

question_59503.question: What does the acronym GTP-U stand for in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_59503.ground_truth: GTP-U stands for GPRS Tunnelling Protocol - User Plane.

question_59504.question: What is the role of the Relay in the Layer-3 based UE-to-UE Relay re-selection process?
question_59504.ground_truth: The Relay determines if the PC5 Link Modification Request message is destined to the Target UE and forwards the message to the Target UE if it is. The Relay also sends a PC5 Link Modification Request message to the Target UE if it is the one being changed.

question_59505.question: In which cases should the UE use a target TCI state's associated TCI state for L1-RSRP measurement reporting in an LTM cell switch?
question_59505.ground_truth: The UE should use a target TCI state's associated TCI state for L1-RSRP measurement reporting when the target TCI state is in the LTM candidate cell active TCI state list or the serving cell active TCI state list, and the time between receiving the MAC-CE activating the target TCI state and the LTM cell switch command meets specific conditions.

question_59507.question: What is the maximum number of NAS security parameters from NGRAN?

question_59508.question: What is the failure cause identifier for failed credit re-authorization procedures in the context of 3GPP EPS?

question_59509.question: What is the purpose of selecting two bands and calculating three average energies in the spectral envelope estimation process?
question_59509.ground_truth: The purpose of selecting two bands and calculating three average energies in the spectral envelope estimation process is to obtain the spectral envelopes used for the following frequency adjustment.

question_59510.question: What are the IP addressing requirements for the NG-RAN nodes over the Xn interface?
question_59510.ground_truth: The NG-RAN nodes over the Xn interface must support both IPv6 and IPv4, and there may be one or several IP addresses in both nodes. The source NG-RAN node sends downstream and upstream packets to the target NG-RAN node IP address associated with the specific flow.

question_59513.question: What is the purpose of the Determine Location Request message in the SL Positioning procedure?
question_59513.ground_truth: The Determine Location Request message is used by the Target UE to the SL Positioning Server UE to determine the Target UE location. This message includes necessary information as required by the Client and may also include SL Reference UEs if SL positioning or ranging is requested.

question_59514.question: How does Solution 11 address the threat of impersonating a RN to attack a user attached to the RN?
question_59514.ground_truth: Solution 11 implicitly provides platform authentication between the secure environment in the RN platform and the network entity, resulting in the same assurances that a platform authentication would provide.

question_59515.question: What is the indication state when the VLR handles a "Send Information for MT SMS" procedure, given that the state of the indicator "Location Information Confirmed in HLR" is "Not Confirmed"?
question_59515.ground_truth: The state of the indicator "Location Information Confirmed in HLR" does not affect the "Send Information for MT SMS" procedure, the VLR handles the request in the normal way.

question_59516.question: What is the main mechanism for avoiding and handling overload situations for eHRPD over S2a as specified in clause 4.3.7.5 of TS 23.401?
question_59516.ground_truth: The main mechanism is the rejection of PDN connection requests from UEs.

question_59518.question: What are the limitations of the mechanism for Diameter overload control in 3GPP networks?
question_59518.ground_truth: The mechanism has limitations such as the use of Supported-Features AVP not being supported by all Diameter applications in 3GPP, the mechanism being applicable only for clients and servers, support of a feature being defined as a Boolean state, and the mechanism's use being undefined for non-3GPP Diameter nodes.

question_59519.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function do when processing a SIP INVITE request for an MCVideo emergency group call?
question_59519.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should generate a SIP INVITE request as specified in clause~6.3.3.1.2 and set the Request-URI to the public service identity of the terminating participating MCVideo function associated with the MCVideo ID of the targeted MCVideo user.

question_59521.question: What is the maximum base station RF bandwidth for the top of the supported frequency range in each operating band?
question_59521.ground_truth: TRFBW is the maximum base station RF bandwidth for the top of the supported frequency range in each operating band.

question_59522.question: What are the two options for FL Server NWDAF if FL Client NWDAF is not able to complete the training of the interim local ML model within the maximum response time?
question_59522.ground_truth: FL Server NWDAF may send a new maximum response time or inform the FL Client NWDAF to cease ML model training and report the current local ML model updates.

question_59526.question: When can a UE re-attempt PDU session establishment for the same DNN in a PLMN?
question_59526.ground_truth: A UE can re-attempt PDU session establishment in a PLMN if it is registered to a new PLMN that was not in the list of equivalent PLMNs at the time of rejection, or if the network allows re-attempt in an equivalent PLMN.

question_59528.question: When must a Direct Communication Accept message be sent to UE-1 by the target UE?
question_59528.ground_truth: A Direct Communication Accept message must be sent to UE-1 by the target UE if the Target User Info is included in the Direct Communication Request message and the Application Layer ID for the target UE matches.

question_59530.question: How does the SECAM process determine the assurance level of a network product?
question_59530.ground_truth: The assurance level in SECAM is related to the evaluation effort in terms of scope, depth, and rigor, but SECAM considers only one assurance level per network product class as the three parameters are expected to be constant.

question_59531.question: What does the gross bit rate (GBR) QoS Information IE indicate?
question_59531.ground_truth: The gross bit rate (GBR) QoS Information IE indicates the maximum and guaranteed bit rates of a GBR E-RAB for downlink and uplink.

question_59533.question: What sub-clause describes the evaluation of different positioning of training symbols for improved performance?
question_59533.ground_truth: Sub-clause 6.2.3.1 describes the evaluation of different positioning of training symbols for improved performance.

question_59536.question: What is the impact of Solution #45 in terms of low latency exposure?
question_59536.ground_truth: Solution #45 does not bring any additional benefit in terms of low latency exposure.

question_59537.question: What should be done if the UE receives an error message from the BSF when sending a TMPI?
question_59537.ground_truth: The UE shall delete the TMPI and retry the request using the IMPI.

question_59539.question: What is the maximum carrier leakage (Origin Suppression) for 8-PSK modulation under normal conditions for all other bands?
question_59539.ground_truth: The maximum carrier leakage (Origin Suppression) for 8-PSK modulation under normal conditions for all other bands should exceed 30 dB.

question_59540.question: What should the MCData client set in an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body when requesting to start a group SDS session?
question_59540.ground_truth: The MCData client should set the <request-type> element to a value of "group-sds-session", the <mcdata-request-uri> element to the MCData group identity, and the <mcdata-client-id> element to the MCData client ID of the originating MCData client.

question_59543.question: What should MTSI clients in terminals supporting super-wideband or fullband speech communication support?
question_59543.ground_truth: MTSI clients in terminals supporting super-wideband or fullband speech communication shall support EVS codec.

question_59545.question: What type of PDU is requested to be sent from an SGSN to a BSS in 5.3.3b?

question_59546.question: What message is sent by the Serving GW to the source eNodeB to inform it about the forwarding parameters for data forwarding?
question_59546.ground_truth: Create Indirect Data Forwarding Tunnel Response

question_59547.question: How does the PSS server determine the size of the timeshift buffer?
question_59547.ground_truth: The size of the timeshift buffer is determined by the server and is not limited by this specification.

question_59548.question: What is the role of the 5G PKMF-2 in the Key Response message process?
question_59548.ground_truth: The 5G PKMF-2 forwards the Key Response message including the GPI (if available) to the UE-to-network Relay.

question_59549.question: What is the purpose of including the "Service Parameter" of "x-3gpp-pgw:x-gn" in the S-NAPTR procedure?
question_59549.ground_truth: Including the "Service Parameter" of "x-3gpp-pgw:x-gn" in the S-NAPTR procedure potentially biases towards a collocated PGW/GGSN.

question_59550.question: What should the MCPTT client do when it wants to report the MBMS bearer listening status?
question_59550.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should generate a SIP MESSAGE request and include in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-mbms-usage-info+xml MIME body the mbms-listening-status element set to "listening" or "not-listening", the TGMI elements for which the listening status applies, and the general-purpose element set to "true" or "false" as appropriate.

question_59551.question: What is the name of the feature that allows the network to delay or reduce handoffs of a Multimedia Telephony Service for IMS (MTSI) terminal?
question_59551.ground_truth: Coverage and Handoff Enhancements for Multimedia (CHEM)

question_59552.question: What actions does the BCC entity in the MS take when it receives a TERMINATION REQUEST message and is in the U5 state, and the timer Tterm has not expired?
question_59552.ground_truth: When the BCC entity in the MS receives a TERMINATION REQUEST message and is in the U5 state, and the timer Tterm has not expired, it informs higher layers and stops Tterm.

question_59553.question: What should the MCPTT client do when it receives a request to establish an MCPTT On-demand Pre-arranged Group Call using a user regroup?
question_59553.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should send a SIP INVITE message using the user regroup to establish an MCPTT On-demand Pre-arranged Group Call.

question_59554.question: What should the 1.8V technology ME do if it identifies a 3V technology SIM during the SIM type recognition procedure?
question_59554.ground_truth: If a 1.8V technology ME identifies a 3V technology SIM during the SIM type recognition procedure, it shall deactivate the SIM/ME interface and reject the SIM immediately without issuing any further command.

question_59555.question: What data type represents information of an AMF Instance?

question_59556.question: What is the minimum attenuation required for the RX duplexer of the Scell and TX band supporting the Pcell to meet cross-band isolation requirements between Band 7 and Band 22?
question_59556.ground_truth: The minimum attenuation required for the RX duplexer of the Scell is 40 dB and for the TX duplexer of the Pcell is 30 dB.

question_59557.question: What should a node do with the MME's FQ-CSID if it supports partial failure handling?
question_59557.ground_truth: If the SGW receives the MME's FQ-CSID, it shall generate and include its own FQ-CSID in the Sx Session Establishment procedure to indicate support for partial failure handling. If the SGW supports partial failure handling, it shall forward MME's FQ-CSID to PGW with a Create Session Request or Proxy Binding Update message across S5/S8 interface. Similarly, the PGW shall store the MME's FQ-CSID and send its own FQ-CSID back to the SGW if it supports partial failure handling.

question_59558.question: What does UE-to-UE Relay do if it receives a DNS query from UE2 and the IP discovery authorization required indication is set but no token is provided?
question_59558.ground_truth: UE-to-UE Relay sends a PC5-S IP Discovery Authorization Request message with UE2's User Info, UE2's IP address, and the token from UE2 (if received on the Query) to UE1, requesting authorization to share UE1's IP address with UE2.

question_59559.question: What happens if the non-speech media and speech media are split for a certain UE in the SCC AS?
question_59559.ground_truth: The T-ADS in the SCC AS delivers the split session only to this particular UE.

question_59561.question: What is the maximum amount of timing change in one adjustment for the initial transmit timing accuracy in Test 1 and Test 2?
question_59561.ground_truth: The maximum amount of timing change in one adjustment for the initial transmit timing accuracy in Test 1 and Test 2 is Tq seconds.

question_59562.question: What was the power saving gain observed in FR1, DL evaluation, DU, VR45 for the enhanced CDRX with additional active time scheme?

question_59563.question: What is the purpose of the I-CSCF-hA1 changing the URI in the Request-URI from a SIP URI to a tel URI?
question_59563.ground_truth: The purpose of the I-CSCF-hA1 changing the URI in the Request-URI from a SIP URI to a tel URI is to use a consistent URI format for further processing.

question_59565.question: What should the system do if it receives a SIP re-INVITE request and lacks resources to process it?
question_59565.ground_truth: The system may reject the SIP re-INVITE request with a 500 (Server Internal Error) response, including a Retry-After header field to inform the user when it can try again.

question_59566.question: What should the call control entity of the MS do when it receives an ALERTING message in the "mobile originating call proceeding" state and the user connection is not attached to the radio path for speech calls?
question_59566.ground_truth: It shall enter "call delivered" state and generate an alerting indication internally.

question_59567.question: What should the target cell do when it receives a handover request without an "MBS-support" indicator from the source cell during a multicast session?
question_59567.ground_truth: The target cell sets up PDU Session Resources mapped to the MBS multicast Session and infers that MBS multicast data packets delivery should be switched to 5GC individual MBS traffic delivery.

question_59569.question: What message should the target UE send if it cannot accept the PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE REQUEST message?
question_59569.ground_truth: The target UE should send a PROSE DIRECT LINK IDENTIFIER UPDATE REJECT message.

question_59570.question: What is the maximum number of re-attempts for the UE to retry the service request procedure when case o) in clause 5.6.1.1 occurs?
question_59570.ground_truth: The maximum number of re-attempts for the UE to retry the service request procedure when case o) in clause 5.6.1.1 occurs is 5.

question_59573.question: When can measurements of node offsets be made using the RNC-Node B Node Synchronisation procedure?
question_59573.ground_truth: Measurements can be made at the start or restart, as well as during normal operation to supervise node stability.

question_59574.question: What is the purpose of the test of the speech decoder/DTX functions (downlink) in the described passage?
question_59574.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the DTX receiver functions, consisting of a SID frame detector, comfort noise generator functions and lost frame substitution and muting functions, are functioning correctly as per predefined sequences.

question_59576.question: What does the TpAssignmentID returned by the sendMessageWithNotifyReq() method indicate?
question_59576.ground_truth: The TpAssignmentID returned by the sendMessageWithNotifyReq() method is a reference to the request for later use by the application.

question_59577.question: What is the purpose of the Xn-U Address Indication procedure in the conditional handover procedure?
question_59577.ground_truth: The Xn-U Address Indication procedure provides different forwarding addresses for prepared conditional handovers and stops already initiated early data forwarding for some SN-terminated bearers.

question_59578.question: What is the significance of the <regtype> parameter in the PLMN selection command?
question_59578.ground_truth: The <regtype> parameter in the PLMN selection command indicates whether the registration procedure shall be performed for disaster roaming service or not.

question_59581.question: What is the purpose of the 'implicit key authentication' in the authentication and key agreement process between the UE and the network?
question_59581.ground_truth: 'Implicit key authentication' refers to the authentication provided through the successful use of keys resulting from authentication and key agreement in subsequent procedures.

question_59582.question: What is the required condition for the reference sensitivity to be met with all downlink component carriers active and any one of the uplink carriers active, as specified in the document?
question_59582.ground_truth: This is a requirement for the UE to meet the specifications in Annexes A.2.2, A.2.3, and A.3.2, with certain dynamic OCNG Pattern OP.1 FDD/TDD specifications for the DL-signal.

question_59583.question: What should the VAE-S include in the HTTP POST request when receiving a request for session-oriented service termination?
question_59583.ground_truth: The VAE-S should include a Content-Type header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.vae-info+xml", an application/vnd.3gpp.vae-info+xml MIME body with a <session-oriented-termination-info> element in the <VAE-info> root element, a <session-id> element set to the session identifier to be terminated, and send the HTTP POST request towards the VAE-C.

question_59584.question: How many frames are there in an interleaving period of 20 msec?
question_59584.ground_truth: There are 2 frames in an interleaving period of 20 msec.

question_59586.question: What is the method used for signal class estimation in the EVS decoder?
question_59586.ground_truth: The signal class estimation in the EVS decoder is based on the zero-crossing parameter, pitch-synchronous normalized correlation, pitch coherence parameter, spectral tilt, and pitch synchronous relative energy at the end of the frame.

question_59587.question: What is the function of the "MBMS User Service Receiver" in the associated-delivery process?
question_59587.ground_truth: The "MBMS User Service Receiver" combines the reception via the MBMS Bearer Service and interactive bearer services in a controlled way. It may invoke optional "Associated-Delivery Processing Servers" after the actual MBMS data reception from the clients for procedures such as point-to-point file repair for delivering missing data to clients.

question_59588.question: What is the goal of multi-RAT load-balancing between satellite RANs and terrestrial RANs?
question_59588.ground_truth: The goal is to optimize radio resource usage and traffic flow control in 5GC and 3GPP Management.

question_59589.question: What should an NF service consumer send to request that subsequent notifications are sent to a new NF service consumer?
question_59589.ground_truth: The "notifUri" attribute within the NsmfEventExposure data structure can be modified to request that subsequent notifications are sent to a new NF service consumer.

question_59593.question: What two system information are acquired by UE from PSS/SSS and MIB if SN is an eNB, or NR-PSS/SSS and PBCH if SN is a gNB in EN-DC?
question_59593.ground_truth: The UE acquires at least, radio frame timing and SFN of SCG from the PSS/SSS and MIB (if the SN is an eNB) / NR-PSS/SSS and PBCH (if the SN is a gNB) of the PSCell in EN-DC.

question_59594.question: What is the purpose of defining a new 3GPP Application Code for 'NSSAA support' in the UICC?
question_59594.ground_truth: The purpose of defining a new 3GPP Application Code for 'NSSAA support' is to identify the application(s) in the UICC supporting NSSAA procedure. This allows the ME to easily identify the appropriate NSSAA application to use.

question_59595.question: What is the meaning of CORBA in the context of this specification?
question_59595.ground_truth: CORBA stands for Common Object Request Broker Architecture.

question_59596.question: What does the may construction indicate in the context of the 3GPP technical specification?
question_59596.ground_truth: The may construction in the context of the 3GPP technical specification indicates permission to do something. It implies that something is possible.

question_59598.question: What is the CGI reporting delay in the context of a UE identifying the CGI of an NR cell?
question_59598.ground_truth: The CGI reporting delay is the time between a command that will trigger a CGI report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface.

question_59600.question: What should the UE do if the REGISTRATION ACCEPT contains the allowed NSSAI and includes one or more new S-NSSAIs?
question_59600.ground_truth: The UE shall store the included allowed NSSAI together with the PLMN identity of the registered PLMN and the registration area as specified in subclause~13.2.2.

question_59601.question: What mechanism is used in the target gNB for duplication detection and reordering for RLC-AM bearers?
question_59601.ground_truth: A window-based mechanism is used in the target gNB for duplication detection and reordering for RLC-AM bearers.

question_59602.question: What does the TS define as "Location Dependent Interception"?
question_59602.ground_truth: Location Dependent Interception is defined as interception within a PLMN service area that is restricted to one or several Interception Areas (IA).

question_59603.question: What is the responsibility of the GW in the Pre-Paid sequence with regards to the network?
question_59603.ground_truth: The GW forwards charging information and tariff switch times to the network, and handles call continuation and termination.

question_59605.question: What is the difference between EN-DC FR2-FR2 event-triggered reporting in non-DRX and DRX with SSB time index detection?
question_59605.ground_truth: EN-DC FR2-FR2 event-triggered reporting in non-DRX verifies the UE's correct reporting of an event within inter-frequency cell search requirements without DRX cycles, while EN-DC FR2-FR2 event-triggered reporting in DRX with SSB time index detection verifies the UE's correct reporting of an event within inter-frequency cell search requirements with long DRX cycles.

question_59606.question: What is MCData and what are its sub-services?
question_59606.ground_truth: MCData is a suite of services which utilizes a common functional architecture to support MC services over LTE, including the common services core. The sub-services of MCData include short data service (SDS), file distribution (FD), and data streaming (DS).

question_59607.question: What is the procedure if the mobile station supports both Transparent and Non Transparent modes and the mobile station responds with a CALL CONFIRMED message in the context of X.32 case in Packet Service?
question_59607.ground_truth: The procedure involves sending a BC GSM message starting with 04 08 A2 XX 86 2.

question_59608.question: What must the Content-Type header field be set to in the HTTP POST request for receiving a UAV application message?
question_59608.ground_truth: The Content-Type header field must be set to "application/vnd.3gpp.uae-info+xml" in the HTTP POST request for receiving a UAV application message.

question_59610.question: What is the name of the unidirectional channels that can be present in a UE, either in the downlink or uplink, depending on the services and the state of the UE?

question_59611.question: What indicators are involved in the N2 handover in 5GS?
question_59611.ground_truth: The key change indicators involved in N2 handovers are: 1) source AMF indicates AS key re-keying required, 2) source AMF indicates that KAMF is calculated using horizontal KAMF derivation, 3) target AMF indicates horizontal KAMF derivation to the UE, 4) target AMF indicates an AS key re-keying to the gNB/ng-eNB, and 5) gNB/ng-eNB indicates an AS re-keying to the UE.

question_59612.question: What information is communicated in the AF request for network slice selection?
question_59612.ground_truth: The AF request includes the IMS Service Id, Service Profile Id, information on the IMS Application provider, and optionally the affected UE(s) by providing an external identifier (e.g. MSISDN).

question_59613.question: What is the minimum requirement for the output bit sequence in the static Layer 1 functions test?
question_59613.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for the output bit sequence in the static Layer 1 functions test is that it should be bit exact for all logical channel types.

question_59614.question: What should the PCF do with the remaining allowed usage for a user, if the last PDU Session of a user for a DNN and S-NSSAI combination is terminated?
question_59614.ground_truth: The PCF shall store the remaining allowed usage in the UDR.

question_59615.question: How is the timing difference information sent to the target RNC in Option 1b?
question_59615.ground_truth: The timing difference information is sent to the target RNC using explicit new IEs in Option 1b.

question_59616.question: What are some examples of immersive media in the context of AR/MR?
question_59616.ground_truth: Examples of immersive media in AR/MR include 2D/3D media such as overlays and drawings, 3D media such as furniture and animated representations, and volumetric video of a person or a 3D modeled person. Simple textual overlays and 2D video are also considered immersive media.

question_59617.question: What information should the ME include in the MeasurementReport if inter-RAT (UTRAN) measurements are requested by the USIM?
question_59617.ground_truth: The ME should include IE "measResultListUTRA-FDD-r16" in IE "measResults" and report CPICH Ec/No, CPICH RSCP, and Physical Cell ID for the up to 8 strongest inter-RAT UTRAN cells per monitored frequency.

question_59618.question: What does the acronym "CORBA" stand for in the context of the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_59618.ground_truth: CORBA stands for Common Object Request Broker Architecture, which is one of the abbreviations used in the document.

question_59619.question: What is the purpose of the LISSF in connection with a POI present in an UPF, if an SMF belongs to an SMF set?
question_59619.ground_truth: The purpose of the LISSF is to allow the TFs present in different SMFs of an SMF set to manage the interceptions at the POI present in an UPF, modify or stop the interceptions in the POIs present in the UPF, and to provide a continued interception by storing the LI state information. The TF present in the SMF stores the related necessary information (e.g. correlation information) in case a different TF has to manage the interception at that POI.

question_59621.question: What is the purpose of defining callbackUri for data restoration in NF profiles in UDR consumers and UDM consumers?
question_59621.ground_truth: The purpose of defining callbackUri for data restoration is to receive notifications when potential UDR data inconsistency occurs and enable data restoration.

question_59622.question: Which type of data is "DeferredLocationExt" in the LocationNotificationArg sequence?
question_59622.ground_truth: The "DeferredLocationExt" in the LocationNotificationArg sequence is a bit string used to represent various deferred location event types.

question_59625.question: What should be the priority of the logical channels in order to satisfy the condition "at least one of the MAC CE and the logical channel and pending SL-PRS transmission(s) with the highest priority" for SL grant transmission?
question_59625.ground_truth: The logical channels should have the highest priority based on their sl-threshCBR-FreqReselection value, and they should also have pending SL-PRS transmissions associated with the SL grant.

question_59626.question: What should be the difference in output power between the highest and the lowest power level for QPSK, AQPSK, 8-PSK, 16-QAM, and 32-QAM modulations, with the exception of the highest power level?
question_59626.ground_truth: The difference should be 2*N~dB below the absolute output power at power control level 0 for the modulation with the highest output power capability.

question_59627.question: What is the Active Time value (T3324) coded as in the GPRS Timer~2 information element?
question_59627.ground_truth: It is coded as one byte (octet~3) of the GPRS Timer~2 information element coded as a bit format, for example, "00100100" equals 4 minutes.

question_59629.question: What are the most frequent error cases to be handled in HARQ operation?
question_59629.ground_truth: The most frequent error cases to be handled in HARQ operation include NACK detected as an ACK, ACK detected as a NACK, and errors in HARQ operation during soft handover in FDD.

question_59630.question: What is the purpose of the Auth Request message sent from the ProSe Function to the Application Server?
question_59630.ground_truth: The Auth Request message sent from the ProSe Function to the Application Server is used to check for the authorization of the application represented by the Application ID and to get the Discovery Filter for monitoring.

question_59632.question: Which two elements in the "security-parameters-for-remote-UE-type" complex type share the same data type?
question_59632.ground_truth: The elements "code-sending-security-parameters-for-model-A" and "code-receiving-security-parameters-for-model-B" both use the data type "code-sending-or-receiving-security-parameters-type".

question_59633.question: In the context of 1.28Mcps TDD, what information must the Node B include in the Multi-Carrier E-DCH Information Response LCR IE for establishing a transport bearer for each E-DCH MAC-d flow being established using the Separate Iub transport bearer mode?
question_59633.ground_truth: The Binding ID IE and Transport Layer Address IE.

question_59634.question: How does the S-NAPTR procedure logically output the candidate list of SGW-Us for a given TAI/eNodeB-ID/RAI/RNC-ID?
question_59634.ground_truth: The S-NAPTR procedure outputs a list of host names coupled with a service, a protocol, a port, and a list of IPv4 and IPv6 addresses for a given TAI/eNodeB-ID/RAI/RNC-ID.

question_59635.question: What HTTP status code indicates success in updating or revoking the authorization for announcing for a UE?

question_59636.question: What is the length of the analysis window used in the GSM enhanced full rate codec?
question_59636.ground_truth: The length of the analysis window used in the GSM enhanced full rate codec is 240 samples.

question_59637.question: What is required regarding access control for users accessing WLAN?
question_59637.ground_truth: Access control for users accessing WLAN should have the same level of security as a 3GPP system authentication procedure. Additionally, successful 3GPP system-based access control is a prerequisite for utilizing the WLAN-3GPP interworking service.

question_59638.question: What is the purpose of the test described in clause 10.4.2.6.4?
question_59638.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the behavior of the UE when measuring the signal strength of two NR cells and the LTE cell in different frequencies.

question_59639.question: What is the relevance of the TOI in FEC?
question_59639.ground_truth: TOI, or Transport Object Identifier, is used to assign ADUs to the same source block, for example, when using a unique TOI for ADU.

question_59640.question: What is the resolution for the SIR mapping for Type 1 and Type 2 as specified in section 9.2.1.11.5?
question_59640.ground_truth: The resolution for the SIR mapping for Type 1 and Type 2 is 2dB.

question_59641.question: In the context of TS 38.331, clause 5.5.4.3, what is the term used to describe the case where the entry condition for an event is fulfilled for one or more applicable transmission resource pools not included in the poolsTriggeredList?
question_59641.ground_truth: When a subsequent transmission resource pool triggers the event

question_59642.question: What type of TAB connectors apply to an operating band that is only supported by single band connectors in a TAB connector TX min cell group or a TAB connector RX min cell group?
question_59642.ground_truth: Single band requirements apply to that set of TAB connectors.

question_59644.question: In multi-layer HEVC extensions, what is the role of an independent non-base layer rewriting process?
question_59644.ground_truth: The independent non-base layer rewriting process can "transcode" independent non-base layers to a bitstream that conforms to a single-layer profile, allowing for a more efficient handling of these layers in the context of multi-layer video coding and decoding.

question_59645.question: What principle is described in the Area Broadcast Group Communication interworking between GSM-R and FRMCS Users use case?
question_59645.ground_truth: It describes an area broadcast group communication between FRMCS Users and GSM-R Users, and vice versa, with the precondition that the Users are authorized and in the same group communication area defined by the FRMCS System.

question_59648.question: What is the range of the Value field, given that it consists of 4 bits?
question_59648.ground_truth: The range of the Value field is from 1*10-1 to 1*10-6.

question_59649.question: What is the Chroma format supported by the HEVC-UHD-Enc?
question_59649.ground_truth: The Chroma format supported by the HEVC-UHD-Enc is 4:2:0.

question_59650.question: What are the requirements for the FDD inter-frequency relative accuracy test in clause 9.1.3.2?
question_59650.ground_truth: The requirements for the FDD inter-frequency relative accuracy test include support for FGI bits 16 and 25, inter-frequency relative accuracy measurement of RSRP, and the fulfillment of certain conditions such as transmission of cell specific reference signals, fulfillment of 3GPP TS 36.101 clause 7.3 for reference sensitivity, and specific RSRP and channel conditions.

question_59651.question: What is the number of precoding matrices used for 3-layer transmission in uplink spatial multiplexing with four transmit antennas?

question_59652.question: Is it permitted for a CSP to rely on another CSP or jurisdiction to ensure Lawful Interception (LI) activity can occur?
question_59652.ground_truth: No, it is not permitted for a CSP to rely on another CSP or jurisdiction to ensure LI activity can occur. A serving network shall not share LI target identities with a home network in the case of roaming or vice versa.

question_59653.question: How many times can the "restricted-code-security-material" element occur in the "RestrictedAnnounceRsp-info" complex type?
question_59653.ground_truth: The "restricted-code-security-material" element can occur only once in the "RestrictedAnnounceRsp-info" complex type.

question_59654.question: When testing RRM CA requirements, what is the number of supported CCs that the UE shall be tested with?
question_59654.ground_truth: The UE shall be tested using the highest number of supported CCs.

question_59655.question: What is the purpose of defining the terms and abbreviations in the present document?
question_59655.ground_truth: The purpose of defining the terms and abbreviations in the present document is to ensure a common understanding of the terms and abbreviations used in the document.

question_59656.question: What is the challenge for WLAN Access Point installation from the perspective of emergency calls?
question_59656.ground_truth: In many implementations, it is outside the control of a network operator where a WLAN Access Point is installed, and hence it is possible that a WLAN Access Point is installed outside the coverage area of a network operator's cellular network. Since it is not possible to determine when a user registers for voice over WLAN service if they will or will not make an emergency call in the future, the network needs to apply local policies regarding normal voice calling when the device connects for any voice service, not just emergency voice service.

question_59659.question: What is the procedure for testing UE relative code domain power accuracy for UL CLTD activation state 3?
question_59659.ground_truth: The procedure involves repeating steps 1 to 8, including setting the Absolute Grant, SS sending an HS-SCCH order activating UL_CLTD activation state 3, and measuring relative code domain power at the active transmit antenna connector.

question_59661.question: What is the purpose of using nominal UTIs in beam management discussions?
question_59661.ground_truth: The purpose of using nominal UTIs in beam management discussions is for discussion purposes only, and their actual value can vary based on the specific AI/ML model and implementation.

question_59663.question: How would the document be re-released if the TSG were to make technical enhancements or corrections?
question_59663.ground_truth: If the TSG modifies the contents of the document, it will be re-released with an identifying change of release date and an increase in version number. The second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, such as technical enhancements, corrections, updates, etc.

question_59664.question: What is a UE group identifier used for in the context of negotiating DNN(s) and/or S-NSSAI(s) with a third party?
question_59664.ground_truth: A UE group identifier is used to identify a group of UEs of a third party for the purpose of enforcing specific policies on the traffic generated by these UEs.
