question_61679.ground_truth: During an intra-SRNS relocation, the new FRESH is generated, and IKU and CKU are derived using the new FRESH, algorithm ID, and the current KRNC. The target RNC+ and the source RNC+ are the same one during this procedure.

question_61680.question: Which operation code is associated with the 'initialDP' in the CAP-operationcodes module?

question_61682.question: What is the new media feature tag that the controller UE can include in the Contact header field of the SIP REFER request, to indicate whether it wishes to be the controller UE or not for the collaborative session?
question_61682.ground_truth: The new media feature tag is "g.3gpp current-iut-controller" and its value can be set to "active" to indicate that the UE is the active controller, or "passive" to indicate that the UE is not the active controller.

question_61683.question: What is the major difference between manual roaming and operator provided or operator supported pre-paid service?
question_61683.ground_truth: The major difference is that manual roaming only supports outbound calls, not inbound calls.

question_61684.question: What is the purpose of the createFolderReq() method?
question_61684.ground_truth: The createFolderReq() method is used to create a new folder in the mailbox opened by the specified mailbox session. The name of the new folder may be passed in.

question_61685.question: What is required to be included in the Via header field sent by the UE when sending a REGISTER request?
question_61685.ground_truth: The IP address or FQDN of the UE should be included in the sent-by field of the Via header field.

question_61686.question: What is the impact of providing the (unconditional) Authorized APN-AMBR in every interaction with the PCEF?
question_61686.ground_truth: The PCEF shall apply the Authorized APN-AMBR as APN-AMBR for all IP-CAN sessions of the UE to the same APN and shall communicate the changed APN-AMBR to the UE.

question_61687.question: What action does the SMF take after providing QoS Monitoring Policy for dynamic satellite backhaul delay control?
question_61687.ground_truth: The SMF initiates N4 Session Modification with the UPF and reports to the PCF if the measured backhaul network delay exceeds the Threshold Value.

question_61689.question: In the context of 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-UE relay, what information is set as the target end UE info in the user info ID of the peer 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE?
question_61689.ground_truth: The information is set to the user info ID of the peer 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE with which the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay communication is to be released.

question_61692.question: What is the requirement for the UAS to broadcast its identity and location?
question_61692.ground_truth: The UAS shall be able to locally broadcast its identity and location via local broadcast with a rate of at least once per 1s and up to a range of 500m. The locally broadcast information should not expose personally identifiable information to general users.

question_61693.question: What measures can be taken to ensure the network information provided to the UE for small data transmission does not expose the network topology and network sensitive information?
question_61693.ground_truth: Measures can include encoding the TEID in the Bearer Resource ID rather than the S-GW IP address, using many-to-one mappings for S-GW identifiers to S-GW IP addresses, and implementing mechanisms to prevent eavesdropping and modification attacks on the Uu interface.

question_61694.question: How is the synthesized full band signal de-emphasized in the high band coding information?
question_61694.ground_truth: The synthesized full band signal is de-emphasized by moving correcting the spectrum, de-emphasizing the spectrum, and modulating the signal with gain shape values and overall frame gain parameter.

question_61695.question: What is the purpose of the LCLS-Status IE in the LCLS-Status-Update message?
question_61695.ground_truth: The LCLS-Status IE in the LCLS-Status-Update message indicates the LCLS disconnection.

question_61696.question: In the NCR Access Link Beam Indication MAC CE, what does the A/D field indicate when set to 1?
question_61696.ground_truth: The forwarding resource list indicated in Resource set ID field is being activated

question_61697.question: What is the role of the "expires" attribute in the <functionalAlias> element of an application/pidf+xml MIME body indicating per-functional alias information?
question_61697.ground_truth: The "expires" attribute in the <functionalAlias> element of an application/pidf+xml MIME body indicating per-functional alias information indicates the expiration of activation of the functional alias for the MCVideo user.

question_61698.question: In what situations is the UE required to initiate initial registration?
question_61698.ground_truth: The UE must initiate initial registration when performing initial registration for 5GS services, initial registration for emergency services, initial registration for SMS over NAS, and when moving from GERAN to NG-RAN coverage or from UTRAN to NG-RAN coverage.

question_61699.question: What are the tasks in the radio network coverage optimization workflow that are accomplished by a human in Level 0 of network autonomy?
question_61699.ground_truth: In Level 0 of network autonomy, all the tasks in the radio network coverage optimization workflow, including Task A to Task G, are accomplished by human.

question_61701.question: How many information element identifier values are available for assignment in the 3GPP TS 24.008 protocol?
question_61701.ground_truth: There are 133 information element identifier values available for assignment in the 3GPP TS 24.008 protocol.

question_61702.question: For the UE operating with Band 42 DL and B42 UL simultaneously, what can cause a maximum sensitivity degradation (MSD) situation?
question_61702.ground_truth: The 5th harmonic of Band 28 UL will fall into Band 42 DL, causing a maximum sensitivity degradation (MSD) situation.

question_61703.question: What is the message that the eNB sends to the UE to complete the contention resolution in the RRC Connection Resume procedure?
question_61703.ground_truth: In message 4, designated here as RRC Connection Resume Complete the network completes the contention resolution in the RRC Connection Resume procedure.

question_61704.question: What does MU-MIMO stand for in the context of 3GPP TR 38.902?

question_61705.question: What is the role of the MME upon receipt of an indication that the 3GPP PS Data Off feature is activated or deactivated?
question_61705.ground_truth: The MME must initiate the proper procedure towards the P-GW at initial attach, new PDN connection setup, or existing PDN connection to ensure that the P-GW performs the necessary actions.

question_61706.question: At what bit/s rate is the Binary Coded Signalling supported in the UMTS PLMN environment?
question_61706.ground_truth: Only the standard 300 bit/s Binary Coded Signalling is supported in the UMTS PLMN environment.

question_61707.question: What causes the mapping between RELOCATION REQUIRED and HANDOVER REQUEST in the context of handover between UMTS and GSM networks?
question_61707.ground_truth: The mapping between RELOCATION REQUIRED and HANDOVER REQUEST in the context of handover between UMTS and GSM networks is caused by the handover of a mobile station between two systems or cells.

question_61709.question: Why is it more difficult to use filters in mmWave frequencies compared to lower frequencies in a transceiver?
question_61709.ground_truth: Filters at the RF front end in mmWave frequencies face several challenges that make their use more difficult compared to lower frequencies. These challenges include the need to satisfy more constraints, including resonance frequency, coupling factor, quality factor, temperature sensitivity, and others. Additionally, the high insertion loss to both the TX and RX paths of the transceiver, power losses caused by impedance mismatches, extra loss added by filters that are not impedance matched to the power amplifier, and increased die size or PCB area of the transceiver.

question_61710.question: What does the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects cover in relation to telecommunication management?
question_61710.ground_truth: It covers the Telecommunication management; Home enhanced Node B Subsystem (HeNS); Network Resource Model (NRM); Integration Reference Point (IRP); and Solution Set (SS) definitions.

question_61712.question: What is the role of NEF services in enabling communication between NFs in the PLMN and a ProSe Application Server?
question_61712.ground_truth: NEF services enable communication between NFs in the PLMN and a ProSe Application Server by storing ProSe service parameters in the UDR upon receiving them from the ProSe Application Server.

question_61714.question: How many data-related possible sequences can be transmitted in the simplified HS-SCCH type 1?
question_61714.ground_truth: There are 15 data-related possible sequences plus the sequence corresponding to an HS-SCCH order.

question_61715.question: What message does the eNodeB send to the MME/SGSN after receiving the Handover Confirmation from the UE?
question_61715.ground_truth: The eNodeB sends a Handover Notify to the MME/SGSN after receiving the Handover Confirmation from the UE.

question_61716.question: What is the communication mode used for DAA in Solution #5?
question_61716.ground_truth: Both broadcast and unicast communication modes are used for DAA in Solution #5, depending on the scenario.

question_61717.question: What action should an MCPTT client take if it receives a request from a user to cancel the in-progress emergency condition on a chat MCPTT group and the user is not authorized to do so?
question_61717.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should indicate to the user that they are not authorized to cancel the in-progress emergency group state of the MCPTT group and skip the remaining steps of the current subclause.

question_61719.question: What does the file server do in the Home NodeB (HNB) to HNB Management System (HMS) interface?
question_61719.ground_truth: The file server in the HNB to HMS interface may be used for file upload or download as instructed by the TR-069 manager, and it may also be used by other applications in the MNO (Mobile Network Operator) domain.

question_61721.question: What is the maximum allowable Error Vector Magnitude when 16QAM modulation is used on any of the uplink code channels in a carrier?
question_61721.ground_truth: The maximum allowable Error Vector Magnitude when 16QAM modulation is used on any of the uplink code channels in a carrier is 14%.

question_61723.question: What are the responsibilities of the PEGC in the PIN enabler architecture?
question_61723.ground_truth: The PEGC in the PIN enabler architecture supports gateway capability for PIN, performs the role of an entity supporting management capability for PIN, and enables direct communication between PIN clients when a gateway device is unavailable. It also maintains the PIN profile, supports the delivery of credentials and PIN server address, and enables PIN discovery.

question_61724.question: What is the procedure for IPsec tunnel establishment if the H(e)NB only supports IPsec?
question_61724.ground_truth: The procedure for IPsec tunnel establishment if the H(e)NB only supports IPsec is using IKEv2 protocol to set up at least one IPsec tunnel to protect the traffic with SeGW, i.e. a pair of unidirectional SAs between H(e)NB and SeGW. All signalling, user, and management plane traffic over the interface between H(e)NB and SeGW shall be sent through an IPsec ESP tunnel (with NAT-T UDP encapsulation as necessary) that is established as a result of the authentication procedure.

question_61725.question: What is the purpose of Announce messages in the context of TSN and IEEE 802.1AS?
question_61725.ground_truth: Announce messages are used for exchanging clock information between systems in a TSN domain, containing the system identity and root clock for the given TSN entity.

question_61726.question: What is the purpose of PC5 QoS Rules in the classification and marking of user plane traffic?
question_61726.ground_truth: PC5 QoS Rules are used to classify and mark user plane traffic, and to map PC5 QoS Flows to radio resources at the access stratum layer.

question_61728.question: In the context of E-UTRA, what is the reference bandwidth and its significance?
question_61728.ground_truth: Reference bandwidth is the RF bandwidth in which an emission level is specified. It is used to define the RF requirements for transmission and reception in E-UTRA.

question_61729.question: In the context of IAB-nodes, what is the role of the F1-terminating IAB-donor, as defined in the document?
question_61729.ground_truth: The F1-terminating IAB-donor refers to the IAB-donor that terminates F1 for the boundary IAB-node or a mobile IAB-node.

question_61730.question: What should be prevented to ensure the security of permanently stored secrets in the HSS/HLR in the context of SSO?
question_61730.ground_truth: Information leakage due to credential usage for SSO by application servers or entities outside the operator's control should be prevented.

question_61731.question: What type of location events does the current control plane location solution in TS~23.271 support for periodic and triggered location?
question_61731.ground_truth: The current control plane location solution in TS~23.271 supports periodic and triggered location for events such as periodic event, area event, UE availability event, and UE motion event.

question_61732.question: What is the definition of a beam in the context of an AAS BS?
question_61732.ground_truth: A beam (of the antenna) is the main lobe of the radiation pattern of an antenna array, created by means of a superposition of the signals radiated from different parts of the AAS BS antenna array.

question_61733.question: What is the purpose of the TAE requirement for the AAS BS in TS 37.105?
question_61733.ground_truth: The TAE requirement for the AAS BS in TS 37.105 is to reduce the number of test combinations and ensure the largest timing difference between two reference signals in the AAS BS transmitting from multiple antennas via MIMO, CA or a combination of these.

question_61734.question: What is the procedure for creating an NFV Network Service (NS) when receiving a request for creating an EAS application instance?
question_61734.ground_truth: The ECSP management system automatically creates an NSD for EAS creation. For the same ASP, the ECSP management system could use a single NS for all its EAS VNFs instantiation.

question_61735.question: What are the particular features of the UMTS facsimile group 3 Teleservice?
question_61735.ground_truth: The UMTS facsimile group 3 Teleservice uses point-to-point communication, has an information transfer mode of circuit, duplex, asynchronous, supports both mobile originated and mobile terminated calls, allows different end-to-end message speeds within the same connection, and envisages the use of the standard asynchronous terminal adaptation function for non-transparent network support.

question_61738.question: When should a UE initiate transmission of the SidelinkUEInformation message to indicate the sidelink discovery gaps required by the UE?
question_61738.ground_truth: The UE should initiate transmission of the SidelinkUEInformation message to indicate the sidelink discovery gaps required by the UE if it requires sidelink discovery gaps, and certain conditions regarding SystemInformationBlockType19 and gapRequestsAllowed are met.

question_61739.question: What is the role of time-stamp information in the floor control process for an MC service client using this option?
question_61739.ground_truth: The MC service client is required to include an accurate time-stamp into its floor request messages. The floor control server supports the feature by making priority, floor grant arbitration, and queue position allocation using the time-stamp information received in the floor request message.

question_61743.question: What message should the mobile station send on the PACCH to indicate a change of RLC mode and start timer T3168?

question_61744.question: What information elements should be included in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message when it is sent as part of the registration request for inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode?
question_61744.ground_truth: The TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message should include only mandatory information elements and the EPS update type IE set to "TA updating". If the UE has a current EPS security context, the UE shall include the eKSI in the NAS Key Set Identifier IE and integrity protect the message.

question_61745.question: What is the network architecture discussed in the document?
question_61745.ground_truth: The network architecture discussed in the document is the 5G System, as specified in 3GPP TS 23.501, 23.502, and 23.503.

question_61746.question: What is the purpose of the "Signature generation xIRI" in the context of STIR/SHAKEN and RCD procedures?
question_61746.ground_truth: The "Signature generation xIRI" is generated by the IRI-POI present in the Telephony AS or egress IBCF when they have sent a signing request to the AS for signing and received a signing response containing the Identity header. This interaction occurs when a SIP INVITE request is received from the UE. The xIRI contains the identity token and the initial caller number if changes occur on that number.

question_61749.question: What action does the target NG-RAN take when it receives an N2 Path Switch Request from the target NG-RAN during handover preparation phase?
question_61749.ground_truth: The target NG-RAN sends a response to the AMF, indicating whether it supports MBS to the SMF in the N2 SM information. If it does, the SMF knows that the target NG-RAN supports MBS and determines the delivery method. If not, the 5GC Shared MBS traffic delivery or 5GC Individual MBS traffic delivery is still used for MBS data transferring.

question_61750.question: What is the purpose of the I1-cs in the session control signalling path in IMS?
question_61750.ground_truth: The I1-cs is used for session control signalling after handover from the GPRS EDGE access capable of DTM to any 2G/3G access.

question_61752.question: What information does the <mcpttinfo> element contain in the SDP offer on receiving a SIP INVITE request?
question_61752.ground_truth: The <mcpttinfo> element contains the <mcptt-Params> element with the session-type, mcptt-request-uri, mcptt-client-id, and, optionally, the associated-group-id, when the group identity can be determined to be a TGI.

question_61753.question: What is the name of the multiplexing scheme used in EC operation?

question_61754.question: What steps are taken to relocate SEALDD servers and obtain the quality guarantee service?
question_61754.ground_truth: The S-SEALDD server performs the SEALDD relocation procedure for the switched SEALDD servers and VAL servers, and after successful relocation, the SEALDD client can connect to the selected T-SEALDD server to obtain the data transmission quality guarantee service.

question_61755.question: What should a UE do when measuring the CSI-RS for L1-RSRP measurement and it is in the same OFDM symbol as SSB for RLM, BFD, CBD, or L1-RSRP measurement on the same or different CCs in the same band?
question_61755.ground_truth: The UE is required to measure one of but not both CSI-RS for L1-RSRP measurement and SSB. A longer measurement period is expected, and no further requirements are defined.

question_61756.question: When will the P-CSCF ignore the received location information?
question_61756.ground_truth: When the default bearer/dedicated bearer for IMS signaling is terminated, the P-CSCF will ignore the received location information.

question_61757.question: What is the performance difference between SACCH and AHS4.75 in MTS-2 when the Shifted SACCH is employed?

question_61759.question: What should the AMF serving the UE indicate to the LMF to solve the problem of the cell ID/TAC of MBSR not reflecting the location of the UE?
question_61759.ground_truth: The AMF serving the UE should indicate to the LMF the existence of the MBSR, and provide the MBSR's position information when receiving measurement reports from MBSR or by querying the MBSR with specific time information.

question_61760.question: What is the difference between the three versions of the released document and what do they indicate?
question_61760.ground_truth: The three versions of the released document indicate the stage of approval and change. Version 3.x.z indicates that the TSG has approved the document under change control (x > 0). The second digit (y) indicates technical enhancements, corrections, updates, etc., while the third digit (z) is incremented for editorial only changes.

question_61762.question: What is the purpose of the HSS/HLR's awareness of the data structure in the specific transparent data file?
question_61762.ground_truth: The HSS/HLR needs to be aware of the data structure of the specific transparent data file to convert the CS service data to the related transparent data and back again as needed.

question_61763.question: What is the BCCH ARFCN value for cell A in the initial conditions for 450/900 MS?

question_61765.question: What is the pre-test condition specified for the UE in these test cases?
question_61765.ground_truth: The UE begins the test with no assistance data stored for all sub-test cases dependent on the positioning method(s) supported by the UE.

question_61766.question: Which access network can MCPTT UEs use to obtain access to the MCPTT service and support a subset of the functionality specified in this specification?
question_61766.ground_truth: MCPTT UEs can use non-3GPP access networks to obtain access to the MCPTT service and support a subset of the functionality specified in this specification.

question_61767.question: What is the maximum RRC procedure delay defined in clause 11.2 in TS~36.331?
question_61767.ground_truth: The maximum RRC procedure delay defined in clause 11.2 in TS~36.331 is TRRC milliseconds.

question_61769.question: What must the network include in the ATTACH ACCEPT message if the MS included the MS network capability or UE network capability in the ATTACH REQUEST message and the network supports and accepts the use of eDRX?
question_61769.ground_truth: The network must include the extended DRX parameters IE in the ATTACH ACCEPT message.

question_61770.question: What action should the NG-RAN node take if the Redundant QoS Flow Indicator IE is included and set to "false" for all QoS flows in a PDU session?
question_61770.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node should stop the redundant transmission and release the redundant tunnel for the concerned PDU session if it supports it.

question_61771.question: What action must the MS take when timer T3182 expires in RLC unacknowledged mode?
question_61771.ground_truth: The MS releases the TBF as if a PACKET UPLINK ACK/NACK message was received when timer T3182 expires.

question_61772.question: What is the problem with additional transcoding between the target radio leg and the ATGW in eSRVCC procedures?
question_61772.ground_truth: Additional transcoding between the target radio leg and the ATGW in eSRVCC procedures may add one or more unnecessary transcoding point(s) for the call, thereby degrading the quality of the ongoing call unnecessarily.

question_61774.question: What are the potential consequences for operators when upgrading network SW versions without a coherent version handling approach?
question_61774.ground_truth: If there is no coherent version handling approach, access attempts by the IRPManager to some network devices may result in failed access attempts, type mismatch alarms, and inability to update or read some MO attributes, causing operational challenges during network SW upgrades.

question_61775.question: What is used to accommodate the propagation delay in the Air-to-ground network?
question_61775.ground_truth: The timing relationship is enhanced by one cell-specific offset (:)

question_61776.question: What is the process of dividing the resulting residual signal in the NELP coding scheme?
question_61776.ground_truth: The resulting residual signal is divided into smaller sub-frames whose gains are computed and quantized. The quantized gains are then applied to a randomly generated sparse excitation which is shaped by a set of bandpass filters.

question_61777.question: What information does the Overload Control Information IE include in every GTP-C messages when the overload state does not change?
question_61777.ground_truth: The Overload Control Information IE includes information that minimizes the processing required at the overloaded GTP-C entity and its GTP-C peers upon sending/receiving GTP-C signalling.

question_61778.question: What actions should a UE take upon receiving a MasterInformationBlockSidelink message?
question_61778.ground_truth: Upon receiving the message, the UE should apply the values included in the received MasterInformationBlockSidelink message.

question_61779.question: What does the Number-Of-Requested-Vectors AVP indicate in the 3GPP 29.061-800 specification?
question_61779.ground_truth: The Number-Of-Requested-Vectors AVP is of type Unsigned32, and it indicates the number of authentication vectors the MME or SGSN is prepared to receive.

question_61782.question: What is the purpose of the high-band log energy sum in this process?
question_61782.ground_truth: The high-band log energy sum is used to calculate the high-band high sparseness flag, which indicates whether the high-band spectrum of the frame is highly sparse.

question_61784.question: What should a TWAN do when it receives a GTP error indication for the default bearer from a PGW?
question_61784.ground_truth: The TWAN should delete all the bearer contexts associated with the PDN connection and may initiate the release of the corresponding WLAN specific resource. The TWAN may also notify the Operation and Maintenance network element.

question_61785.question: What should be the value of the "state" attribute within the `<registration>` element if a user is actively registered and no existing registrations have been replaced or removed?

question_61786.question: When should the SGSN send a Ready for SM (IMSI, MS Reachable) message to the HLR?
question_61786.ground_truth: The SGSN should send a Ready for SM (IMSI, MS Reachable) message to the HLR when it contains an MM context of the MS and MNRG for that MS is set.

question_61787.question: How many received signal level measurement samples are required for a UE not using measurement occasions and idle intervals to perform GSM measurements for a GSM carrier RSSI measurement?
question_61787.ground_truth: At least 3 received signal level measurement samples are required for a UE not using measurement occasions and idle intervals to perform GSM measurements for a GSM carrier RSSI measurement.

question_61789.question: What is the post-condition for Oiver and Mattias playing their game using a ProSe direct connection?
question_61789.ground_truth: Oliver and Mattias notice improved battery time and latency.

question_61790.question: What is the minimum number of samples for C/I increases and decreases in this test?
question_61790.ground_truth: The minimum number of samples for C/I increases and decreases is 500 each.

question_61792.question: What should the MAC entity do if there are resources remaining after allocating to the logical channels with SBj greater than 0?
question_61792.ground_truth: If any resources remain, all the logical channels are served in a strict decreasing priority order until either the data for that logical channel or the SL grant is exhausted.

question_61793.question: What does the 5G system support regarding Access Identities and Access Categories in unified access control?
question_61793.ground_truth: The 5G system supports extensibility to include additional standardized Access Identities and Access Categories, and flexibility for operators to define operator-defined Access Categories using their own criterion, such as network slicing, application, and application server.

question_61794.question: What is the requirement for cell reserved for future use in the CIoT system design?
question_61794.ground_truth: The CIoT system should support a "cell reserved for future use" with the default that UE do not select or reselect such a cell.

question_61796.question: What is KI#5 enforced by the AMF for maximum data rate per network slice?
question_61796.ground_truth: The AMF sums the Slice-MBR of all UEs in Connected mode which have established PDU Sessions in the network slice and ensures the total data rate does not exceed the allowed value in the quota for the network slice.

question_61797.question: What is the message that the SCEF sends to the SCS/AS in case of failure in the MO-SMS via T8 procedure?
question_61797.ground_truth: The SCEF sends the Trigger Delivery Report message to the SCS/AS in case of failure in the MO-SMS via T8 procedure.

question_61798.question: What should the MCVideo client do when it receives a SIP INVITE request and it contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the <mcvideoinfo> element containing the <mcvideo-Params> element with the <imminentperil-ind> element set to a value of "true"?
question_61798.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should display to the MCVideo user an indication that this is a SIP INVITE request for an MCVideo imminent peril group call, display the MCVideo ID of the originator of the MCVideo imminent peril group call, and display the MCVideo group identity of the group with the imminent peril condition. The MCVideo imminent peril group state is then set to "MVIG 3: in-progress".

question_61799.question: What event can trigger the PCEF to report to the PCRF if the IP-CAN session is not terminated due to a credit management session failure and the UE is resumed from suspend state?
question_61799.ground_truth: The UE resumed from suspend state event trigger

question_61800.question: What information is included in the Auth Response message from the ProSe Application Server?
question_61800.ground_truth: The Auth Response message from the ProSe Application Server includes the PDUID, which corresponds to the RPAUID stored in the server, a response type set to "restricted discovery/query ack", and each Target ProSe Discovery UE ID returned with the corresponding Target RPAUID that the RPAUID is allowed to discover.

question_61801.question: What pre-conditions must be met for an FRMCS User to join an ongoing video conference?
question_61801.ground_truth: The pre-conditions for joining an ongoing video conference are that there is an ongoing video conference and the FRMCS User is authorized to join it.

question_61802.question: In the "S2: waiting for call announcement" state, what does the MCPTT client generate when timer TFG1 (wait for call announcement) expires?
question_61802.ground_truth: The MCPTT client generates a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message with the relevant information and sends it to the network.

question_61803.question: What video resolution and frame rate were used for LTE-OTT Test1 and Test2 in driving conditions?

question_61804.question: Which network entity sends the Handover from eUTRAN Command message to the UE/MS during the handover procedure in the eUTRAN network?

question_61808.question: What are the three components that the UE needs to measure for each CSI-RS resource during a layer 1 measurement period for intra-frequency layers in CSI-RS based L3 measurements in R16?
question_61808.ground_truth: The three components are CSI-RSRP, CSI-RSRQ, and CSI-SINR.

question_61809.question: What action does the MCPTT server take if the functional alias is provided in both the group call request and via binding?
question_61809.ground_truth: The MCPTT server implementation determines a value for the functional alias to be used.

question_61810.question: What is the result of a successful early decoding event in FET?
question_61810.ground_truth: A successful early decoding event in FET results in a reduction of the SIR target.

question_61811.question: What is the difference between near real-time and real-time charging billing information processing?
question_61811.ground_truth: Near real-time charging and billing information processing should take less than one minute, while real-time processing should take less than one second.

question_61812.question: What information should be contained in a SUSPEND PDU sent from a BSS to an SGSN during a suspension process?
question_61812.ground_truth: A SUSPEND PDU contains the TLLI of the MS and the Routeing Area of the MS as received in the Layer 3 Um interface message GPRS Suspension Request.

question_61813.question: Which flag within Octet 5 of MBMS Flags indicates that the MBMS Session Start Request message is used to re-establish an MBMS session?
question_61813.ground_truth: Bit 1 (MSRI) in Octet 5 of MBMS Flags indicates that the MBMS Session Start Request message is used to re-establish an MBMS session.

question_61814.question: How can context constraints be applied to expectation targets?
question_61814.ground_truth: Each expectation target may be constrained to only be achieved for a very specific set of conditions as context constraints. The context describes a set of conditions to trigger corresponding management tasks to achieve the expectation targets.

question_61815.question: What is the role of the SMF in handling charging for redundant transmission in URLLC?
question_61815.ground_truth: The SMF is responsible for collecting charging information for redundant transmission in URLLC and reporting it to the CHF for specific cases.

question_61816.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon receiving a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message when in the "T1: in-progress emergency group call" or "T2: in-progress basic group call" or "T3: in-progress imminent peril group call" state?
question_61816.ground_truth: If the received GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message has a different originating MCVideo user ID IE or Call identifier IE than the current call, the MCVideo client should compare the current call type and call start time with the call type and call start time in the received message, and update the call type and start time if necessary. Then, the MCVideo client should store the new last call type change time and last user to change call type.

question_61818.question: What is the pre-condition for the NRM server to perform the BDT policy negotiation update?
question_61818.ground_truth: The NRM server is currently serving only one VAL server.

question_61819.question: What does the TS 32.29x range of TSs cover in the new charging principle?
question_61819.ground_truth: The TS 32.29x range of TSs covers common aspects, such as CDR parameter and syntax descriptions, converged online and offline charging applications, and the charging interactions within the network, as well as between the network and the billing domain.

question_61820.question: What is the quality assessment conclusion for C7-C2, i.e the evaluation codec with binaural post-processing versus the server-side surround anchor?
question_61820.ground_truth: For all but one lab, the evaluation codec with binaural post-processing is statistically equivalent to the server-side surround anchor, implying that the MPS + binaural postprocessing at 64 kbps is "same as" C7 (server-side binaural conversion + HE-AAC at 64 kbps).

question_61822.question: What must a UE do upon initiating a Random Access procedure on a Serving Cell when the MAC entity switches the active DL BWP?
question_61822.ground_truth: If the MAC entity switches the active DL BWP after receiving a PDCCH for BWP switching and the defaultDownlinkBWP-Id is different from the current DL BWP or if the UE is a RedCap UE and initialDownlinkBWP-RedCap is different from the current DL BWP, the UE must start or restart the bwp-InactivityTimer associated with the active DL BWP.

question_61823.question: What is the function of the AS when the "no-fork" directive is not ignored in forking-based CAT provided by the terminating IMS domain?
question_61823.ground_truth: Based on local policy, the AS chooses to ignore the "no-fork" directive included in the INVITE message. In this case, the AS generates a reliable "183 Session Progress" response to UE-A as if this is a response from a forked INVITE, which establishes an early dialog (D2). This response message contains the SDP answer (A2) which helps to establish the CAT media path between the MRFP and UE-A.

question_61827.question: What is the throughput requirement for an E-UTRA carrier in the presence of two interfering signals?
question_61827.ground_truth: The throughput for an E-UTRA carrier shall be greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channel.

question_61828.question: What is the difference between automatic and manual commencement modes for MCPTT private calls?
question_61828.ground_truth: In automatic commencement mode, the call is established automatically, while in manual commencement mode, the called MCPTT user has to manually accept the call.

question_61829.question: What does Vl represent in the context of network energy efficiency?
question_61829.ground_truth: Vl represents the aggregated throughput served in the simulated or measured area for traffic level l, or equivalently served traffic volume divided by the simulation or measurement period.

question_61830.question: What type of PDU Sessions can be established as always-on PDU Sessions?
question_61830.ground_truth: The 3GPP specification allows for either IPv4, IPv6, or IPv4v6 (dual-stack) type PDU Sessions to be established as always-on PDU Sessions.

question_61831.question: What is the role of an encapsulation format in the context of storage and delivery?
question_61831.ground_truth: An encapsulation format encapsulates an elementary stream with its coding structure information and metadata information. It provides partial access of a media fragment on time axis, which is useful for adaptive streaming and storage purpose.

question_61833.question: What is a Managed Object (MO) in the context of 3GPP TS 28.622?
question_61833.ground_truth: A Managed Object (MO) is a managed entity that is being managed by a management system. It is defined in the Management Information Model (MIM) and can represent a network resource or a network element.

question_61834.question: What is the maximum number of frequencies that can be specified in SL-CarrierFreqInfoList-r12 and SL-CarrierFreqInfoList-r11 in the ASN.1 definition?
question_61834.ground_truth: The maximum number of frequencies that can be specified in SL-CarrierFreqInfoList-r11 and SL-CarrierFreqInfoList-r12 in the ASN.1 definition is maxFreq.

question_61835.question: What does the AMF consider a UE to be reachable by CN paging?
question_61835.ground_truth: The AMF considers a UE to be reachable by CN paging if the UE is in RM-REGISTERED state and the UE CM state in the AMF is CM-IDLE state, unless the UE applies MICO mode or the UE has indicated Unavailability Period Duration.

question_61836.question: What type of compensation in an OFDM communication system, which is based on the existing Rel-15 NR PTRS structure, was reported to have a better performance for high MCS (64QAM) with normal CP when using 480 kHz and 960 kHz SCS compared to 120 kHz and 240 kHz SCS, when only CPE (compensation phase) compensation is used based on the existing Rel-15 NR PTRS structure?

question_61838.question: What is the operation code used in the "RELEASE COMPLETE" command with error code 1.1?
question_61838.ground_truth: The operation code used in the "RELEASE COMPLETE" command with error code 1.1 is "REGISTER SS RETURN ERROR".

question_61839.question: What should the UE set the Request-URI to for an automatically initiated eCall type of emergency service?
question_61839.ground_truth: The UE should set the Request-URI to "urn:service:sos.ecall.automatic" for an automatically initiated eCall type of emergency service.

question_61840.question: What is one method to reduce overall latency from Idle mode to Connected mode in LTE-Advanced by approximately 20ms?
question_61840.ground_truth: Combining the RRC Connection Request and NAS Service Request messages so that they can be processed in parallel at the eNB and MME respectively.

question_61841.question: Why is it necessary to include the II-NNI traversal type in a SIP request to avoid leading to an incorrect scenario type indication?
question_61841.ground_truth: Including the II-NNI traversal type in a SIP request allows intermediate nodes with legacy implementations to determine the correct local policy to apply, reducing the risk of incorrect scenario type indication.

question_61842.question: What are the reporting ranges for UL Angle of Arrival (UL-AoA)?
question_61842.ground_truth: The reporting range of UL Angle of Arrival (UL-AoA) for azimuth angle of arrival (A-AoA) is from -180 degree to +180 degree with a reporting resolution of 0.1 degree, and for zenith angle of arrival (Z-AoA) is from 0 degree to +180 degree with a reporting resolution of 0.1 degree.

question_61843.question: What is the purpose of timer T3346 in the normal routing area updating procedure?
question_61843.ground_truth: Timer T3346 is used to initiate the normal routing area updating procedure upon reception of a paging indication, using P-TMSI, if the timer is running and the MS is in state GMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE and the RAI of the current cell is the same as the stored RAI.

question_61844.question: What message does the UE need to transmit after the SS switches the power setting from T1 to T2?
question_61844.ground_truth: The UE shall transmit a MeasurementReport message triggered by Event A6.

question_61845.question: What mode do user equipment (UEs) of on-board passengers use when a vessel is in 3GPP network coverage?
question_61845.ground_truth: UEs of on-board passengers use the on-land network connection when a vessel is in 3GPP network coverage.

question_61846.question: What is the architecture for Trusted Non-3GPP Access Network in the 5G system?
question_61846.ground_truth: The Trusted Non-3GPP Access Network (TNAN) is the access node that performs the termination of N2 and N3 reference points, termination of access network interface, and relay of N1 to/from the UE. From the 3GPP point of view, the TNAN network is composed by the TNGF and the Trusted Non-3GPP Access Point (TNAP) which are interconnected via the reference point Ta.

question_61847.question: What is the main functionalities of policy control?
question_61847.ground_truth: The policy control includes functionalities such as binding, gating control, event reporting, QoS control, redirection, and IP-CAN bearer establishment

question_61848.question: What is the requirement for the UE transmitter off criterion in the test defined in clause 5.4.4A.5?
question_61848.ground_truth: The UE transmitter off criterion is defined in clause 5.5.1 (Transmit off power).

question_61849.question: In what situation will a UE start or restart the bwp-InactivityTimer associated with the active DL BWP?
question_61849.ground_truth: A UE starts or restarts the bwp-InactivityTimer associated with the active DL BWP in several situations, including receiving a PDCCH indicating downlink assignment or uplink grant, successfully completing a Random Access procedure, transmitting or receiving a MAC PDU, and switching to a DL BWP that is not indicated by the defaultDownlinkBWP-Id.

question_61850.question: What is the maximum TA adjustment range for satellite links with any SCS selection?
question_61850.ground_truth: The maximum TA adjustment range for satellite links is larger than the TTI with any SCS selection.

question_61851.question: What is the maximum number of access control parameter sets?

question_61852.question: How does the decoding complexity of SHVC solution compare to HEVC simulcast solution in multi-stream multiparty video conferencing?
question_61852.ground_truth: The decoding complexity of SHVC solution depends on the resolution of each layer, whereas for HEVC simulcast solution, only one single layer stream needs to be decoded.

question_61853.question: What is the method for computing the mean MOS-LQO value in the speak quality loss in sending direction?
question_61853.ground_truth: For both the reference and test conditions, perform the measurement 20 times and discard the first measurement. Compute a score for each 6 s speech sentence pair and average to produce a mean MOS-LQO value.

question_61854.question: What should the MS do if the replayed MS network capability and replayed MS Radio Access Capability IE in the ATTACH ACCEPT message are not the same as those in the ATTACH REQUEST message in A/Gb mode?
question_61854.ground_truth: The MS should ignore the ATTACH ACCEPT message.

question_61855.question: What does a UE transmit on a PUCCH when it detects a DCI format that provides SPS PDSCH release?
question_61855.ground_truth: If a UE detects a DCI format that provides SPS PDSCH release, the UE generates a positive acknowledgement (ACK).

question_61857.question: What should the mobile station do when it switches to the assigned DBPSCHs and the timer T3190 expires?
question_61857.ground_truth: On expiry of timer T3190, the mobile station shall abort the procedure and return to MAC-Idle state.

question_61858.question: What should the CP function do if it receives a G-PDU packet and there is no active session for it?
question_61858.ground_truth: The CP function shall generate a GTP-U Error Indication and send it to the UP function, then delete the G-PDU after checking for active sessions.

question_61860.question: What is the purpose of the Non-3GPP NW provided policies information element?
question_61860.ground_truth: The Non-3GPP NW provided policies information element indicates to the MS whether emergency numbers provided via non-3GPP access can be used to initiate UE detected emergency calls.

question_61861.question: What are the primary functions of KRRs in the solution described?
question_61861.ground_truth: KRRs contain a list of KMS URIs for both the initiator and the receiver, allowing secure communication between different security domains (KMSs) by sharing information about which KMS can be used with the target key management client. KRRs can be used to address incorrect KMS URIs or when the primary or partner application server disallows communications using the specified KMS URI.

question_61862.question: What is the purpose of introducing the KUR key in the proposal?
question_61862.ground_truth: The KUR key is introduced for securing the redundant data transmission in multiple redundant PDU sessions handled between UE and gNB.

question_61864.question: What should the SMF send as an HTTP response message to the PFDF if the request to retrieve PFD(s) from the PFDF is successful?
question_61864.ground_truth: The SMF replies to the PFDF with an HTTP POST response message "204 No Content" indicating the successful provisioning of all PFDs.

question_61865.question: In what situation does the 5GMM cause IE get set to the 5GMM cause #92 "insufficient user-plane resources for the PDU session"?
question_61865.ground_truth: This occurs when there are insufficient user-plane resources for the PDU session, preventing the 5GSM message from being forwarded.

question_61866.question: When do the requirements of subclauses 6.6.1.1, 6.6.1.2, and 6.6.1.3 apply in the present subclause?
question_61866.ground_truth: The requirements of subclauses 6.6.1.1, 6.6.1.2, and 6.6.1.3 apply in the present subclause for the protection of PHS and specific frequencies falling between certain ranges.

question_61868.question: What shall the MS do if it has pending user data and no radio access bearer is established for the corresponding PDP context, and T3319 is not running or it has not set the flag in the Uplink data status IE for this PDP context in the last Service Request?
question_61868.ground_truth: The MS shall initiate the Service request procedure by an indication from the lower layers, and set the Service Type to "data".

question_61870.question: What type of CSI-RS based intra-frequency measurement is applied to a measurement object i when there is no measurement gap and none of the CSI-RS resources for L3 measurement of this intra-frequency measurement object are overlapped by the measurement gap?
question_61870.ground_truth: CSI-RS based intra-frequency measurement in clause 9.10D.2, when none of CSI-RS resources for L3 measurement of this intra-frequency measurement object are overlapped by the measurement gap.

question_61872.question: In the 52.8.1.10.2 test case, what is being verified?
question_61872.ground_truth: The mobile station's capability to repeat packet access initiation 4 times in case of a contention resolution failure is being verified.

question_61873.question: When does the eNodeB skip steps 12a and proceed with step~12b in case of receiving End Indication indicating no further data?
question_61873.ground_truth: If the eNodeB does not proceed with RRC connection establishment, then the eNodeB skips step~12a and initiates step~12b.

question_61875.question: What must the UE do to retrieve the 3GPP WLAN Support of Emergency Services information advertised by WLANs?
question_61875.ground_truth: The UE must use ANQP procedures to retrieve the 3GPP WLAN Support of Emergency Services information advertised by WLANs.

question_61876.question: What is the purpose of TSC Assistance Information (TSCAI) in the RTT-based PDC mechanism?
question_61876.ground_truth: The TSCAI provides additional information about the traffic flow, such as burst arrival time, burst periodicity, and survival time, to more efficiently schedule periodic, deterministic traffic flows and improve link reliability.

question_61878.question: What abbreviation is used in the document to represent the Authentication and Key Management for Applications?

question_61879.question: In the described scenario for mobile control panels with safety functions, what mode of communication does a safety protocol in conjunction with the "black channel" principle ensure?
question_61879.ground_truth: The safety protocol in conjunction with the "black channel" principle ensures a certain safety level with no or only minor requirements on the communication channel.

question_61882.question: What should be done upon receiving a SIP BYE request in a pre-established session in MCData?
question_61882.ground_truth: The MCData client shall check for any active MCData sessions using the pre-established session and if there is, the client shall remove the MCData client from the MCData session and follow the procedure described in subclause~13.2.3.2.2; if there is no active MCData session using the pre-established session, follow the procedure in subclause~13.2.3.2.2.1.

question_61884.question: What are the two main parts of any solution for PWS security?
question_61884.ground_truth: The two main parts are a protection mechanism for public key distribution and a transport mechanism for public key distribution to the terminal.

question_61885.question: In the test described in 26.14.9.3.3, what is the expected outcome after the MS indicates a group/broadcast call and joins the VGCS/VBS call on MMI request?
question_61885.ground_truth: The expected outcome is that the MS stays in idle mode after the test procedure.

question_61886.question: What information is included in the Link Modification Accept message?
question_61886.ground_truth: The Link Modification Accept message includes QoS Info for each PC5 QoS Flow requested by UE-1. The QoS Info includes the PFI, PC5 QoS parameters (such as PQI and conditionally other parameters), and the associated V2X service type(s) for each PC5 QoS Flow.

question_61887.question: What should be set in the servCellIdentity when the UE is in any cell selection state?
question_61887.ground_truth: The servCellIdentity should be set to indicate the global cell identity of the last logged cell that the UE was camping on.

question_61888.question: What is the minimum synchronization requirement for a HeNB when deriving its synchronization from a larger cell?
question_61888.ground_truth: A different synchronization requirement is required compared with that in small cells, and it should be equal to the propagation delay between the HeNB and the donor cell plus 1.33 us.

question_61889.question: What is the requirement for the SMF to bind a PCC rule to the default QoS flow?
question_61889.ground_truth: The SMF shall bind the related PCC rule to the default QoS flow if the "defQosFlowIndication" attribute is provided and set to true.

question_61890.question: What happens if there is a QoS fulfilment failure in RAN for a UE?
question_61890.ground_truth: The UE releases all the flows related to the flow coordination group ID, NEF is informed abut the QoS fulfilment failure, and NEF informs AF about the failure.

question_61891.question: How does the MSGin5G Server deliver messages to a recipient on a different UE?
question_61891.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server delivers messages to an MSGin5G Service endpoint based on the terminating MSGin5G Service ID, which may be served by the same MSGin5G Server or another MSGin5G Server. If the MSGin5G Service ID is served by another MSGin5G Server, the MSGin5G Server will forward the messages to the next MSGin5G Server until it reaches the home of the terminating MSGin5G Service ID.

question_61892.question: What is the role of the entitled FRMCS User in the revoke permission to talk use case?
question_61892.ground_truth: The entitled FRMCS User in the revoke permission to talk use case is responsible for revoking the permission to talk of any of the FRMCS Users currently with permission to talk.

question_61894.question: What is the role of RAN in ProSe one-to-many communication?
question_61894.ground_truth: RAN requires a method to signal the resources used for ProSe one-to-many communication when the UE is served by E-UTRAN.

question_61895.question: What publication number is associated with the TSG RAN specifications for 4C-HSDPA?
question_61895.ground_truth: The publication number associated with the TSG RAN specifications for 4C-HSDPA is TS 25.101.

question_61896.question: What action does the target gNB take when it receives a valid token from the source gNB but does not support the ciphering and integrity algorithms used in the source cell?
question_61896.ground_truth: The target gNB derives new RRC keys based on the KgNB and the AS algorithms used in the source cell and sends an RRCReestablishment message to the UE.

question_61897.question: What is the difference between the non-OACSU and OACSU options in mobile terminating call establishment?
question_61897.ground_truth: The non-OACSU option initiates user alerting only after allocating a traffic channel, while the OACSU option initiates user alerting as soon as the mobile station accepts the call, and assigns the traffic channel later.

question_61898.question: When receiving an HTTP POST request to share location information, what action does the SLM-S take if the sender is not authorized to obtain location information?
question_61898.ground_truth: The SLM-S responds with a HTTP 403 (Forbidden) response to the HTTP POST request and skips the rest of the steps.

question_61899.question: What is required for monitoring UE peers in a PDU Session in this solution?
question_61899.ground_truth: The PCF can request the SMF to notify new UE destinations in a PDU Session via Policy Control Request Triggers (PCRT) within the Session Management.

question_61900.question: In what situations should the mobile station send a PACKET CELL CHANGE FAILURE message to the network?
question_61900.ground_truth: The mobile station sends a PACKET CELL CHANGE FAILURE message to the network if it cannot synchronize to the new cell, timer T3174 expires before a successful completion of the network controlled cell reselection procedure, or if it is unable to use the frequency ordered by the network.

question_61901.question: What actions should a UE take if the network rejects the registration procedure due to EMM cause value #11 or #35?
question_61901.ground_truth: The UE shall set the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED and delete specific information, reset certain counters, store the PLMN identity in the "forbidden PLMN list" and start timer T3245 (if applicable).

question_61903.question: Which solution describes the L2 Relay and its features?
question_61903.ground_truth: Sol#7 describes the L2 Relay, including its registration and connection management, path selection, mobility restrictions, connection establishment, QoS handling, paging and security. The Remote UE accesses RAN via a UE-to-Network Relay UE using RAN specified L2 relay method and the data of Remote UE is protected by PDCP layer between the Remote UE and the RAN.

question_61904.question: How are the public/private keys used in the verification of authorization tokens?
question_61904.ground_truth: The public key is used to verify the authorization token and check the policies/claims in the token by the receiving side to decide if it should continue the procedure.

question_61906.question: When can a UE consider the start of the unavailability period, in relation to providing unavailability information in the last tracking area updating procedure?
question_61906.ground_truth: If the UE did not include a start of the unavailability period in the last tracking area updating procedure, the MME shall consider the start of the unavailability period to be the time at which MME received the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message to the UE.

question_61907.question: In the 3GPP 5G System, what is the definition of a 5GS-capable UE?
question_61907.ground_truth: A 5GS-capable UE is a UE that is capable of accessing the 5G System (5GS) and is equipped with a USIM capable of providing necessary authentication and authorization credentials for accessing the 5GS.

question_61908.question: What is the goal of multicast service access control in a 5G system?
question_61908.ground_truth: The goal is to allow UEs to join multicast groups based on multicast service access control information, judge whether an UE is allowed to access multicast services, and provide a better service experience by performing more granular multicast service access control when multiple devices connect to an eRG.

question_61910.question: What is the role of the type flag in HS-SCCH type 6 and 7 information field mapping?
question_61910.ground_truth: The type flag is used to distinguish HS-SCCH type 6 from other types in type 6, and HS-SCCH type 7 from other types in type 7.

question_61911.question: How is the location of a resource represented in the SID model?
question_61911.ground_truth: The location of a resource is not represented by an attribute in the SID model, but is linked to an instance of the abstract class "LocalPlace" through the association PhysicalResource.ResourceIsAtPlace.

question_61913.question: When will the monitoring UE's ProSe Function in the HPLMN make use of the ProSe Match Report Info procedure for open discovery?
question_61913.ground_truth: The monitoring UE's ProSe Function in the HPLMN may make use of this procedure to send a match report information to the ProSe Function of the visited PLMN in which the announcing UE is roaming when the monitored PLMN-Id provided by the monitoring UE during the Match Report procedure is different from the PLMN-Id contained in the ProSe Application Code discovered by the monitoring UE.

question_61914.question: What information is included in the Request-URI of the SIP INVITE message?
question_61914.ground_truth: The Request-URI is composed of a user and domain part. The user part contains the content identifier, and the domain part is the Service Provider domain name. Both are obtained from the Service Selection Fund (SSF).

question_61916.question: When should a UE not provide HARQ-ACK information for PDSCH receptions?
question_61916.ground_truth: A UE does not provide HARQ-ACK information for PDSCH receptions if it is not provided harq-FeedbackEnablerMulticast for a G-RNTI for multicast or G-CS-RNTI and pdsch-HARQ-ACK-Codebook = dynamic for multicast HARQ-ACK information. If a UE is provided pdsch-HARQ-ACK-Codebook = semi-static for multicast HARQ-ACK information, the UE does not expect to be provided harq-FeedbackEnablerMulticast with value set to 'dci-enabler' for a G-RNTI or a G-CS-RNTI.

question_61917.question: What is the purpose of pre-establishing MBMS bearers before a group communication session?
question_61917.ground_truth: Pre-establishing MBMS bearers before a group communication session ensures that the bearers are ready for use when needed, improving the efficiency and speed of the communication.

question_61920.question: What should the UE do when it receives an incorrect message over Temporary C-RNTI?
question_61920.ground_truth: The UE should re-select a preamble and transmit with the calculated PRACH transmission power when the backoff time expires.

question_61923.question: What measurements does the PCEF support for charging?
question_61923.ground_truth: The PCEF supports data volume, duration, combined volume/duration, and event-based measurement for charging.

question_61924.question: What is the requirement for the measurement reporting delay during T2, in order for the test to be considered a success?
question_61924.ground_truth: The UE shall transmit a MeasurementReport message triggered by Event A3 within less than 1040 ms from the beginning of time period T2 in order for the test to be considered a success.

question_61926.question: What is the maximum number of activated TCI states in the TCI States Activation/Deactivation for UE-specific PDSCH MAC CE?
question_61926.ground_truth: The maximum number of activated TCI states in the TCI States Activation/Deactivation for UE-specific PDSCH MAC CE is 8.

question_61927.question: What must the home network control regarding the key establishment between a UICC Hosting Device and a Remote Device?
question_61927.ground_truth: The home network shall be able to control whether the Remote Device is authorized to establish a shared key with the UICC Hosting Device.

question_61928.question: What is the function of Quota Management in OMA Charging Enabler?
question_61928.ground_truth: The Quota Management function is responsible for allocating and granting quotas of service usage that a particular user may engage in OMA Charging Enabler. A Charging Enabler User that is granted a quota from the Quota Management function is responsible for ensuring that the service usage does not exceed the quota, or in some cases, may request additional quotas.

question_61929.question: What is the purpose of the Terminating Identification Presentation (TIP) and Terminating Identification Restriction (TIR) services specified in the document?
question_61929.ground_truth: The Terminating Identification Presentation (TIP) service provides the originating party with the possibility of receiving trusted information in order to identify the terminating party, while the Terminating Identification Restriction (TIR) is a service offered to the terminating party which enables the terminating party to prevent presentation of the terminating identity information to the originating party.

question_61930.question: What should the UE do when it receives an SDP answer with a "passive" attribute value for the setup attribute?
question_61930.ground_truth: The UE should perform the TLS client role for the session described in the SDP offer and answer.

question_61931.question: What is a 5G LAN-type service, as defined in the document?
question_61931.ground_truth: A 5G LAN-type service is a service over the 5G system offering private communication using IP and/or non-IP type communications.

question_61932.question: Which attribute in the "pPolicyCtrlReqTriggers" includes the accumulated usage reports if the "UMC" feature is supported?

question_61933.question: What should the ME delete as soon as the 3G security mode command or the GSM cipher mode command is received?
question_61933.ground_truth: The ME shall delete the stored values RAND, RES and SRES (if they exist) as soon as the 3G security mode command or the GSM cipher mode command is received by the ME or the connection is aborted.

question_61935.question: What is required for secure transport over the Un interface in the relay architecture?
question_61935.ground_truth: AS security provided by PDCP or network domain security provided by NDS/IP, or a combination of both, should be applied for secure transport over the Un interface.

question_61936.question: What is the difference between an MCPTT emergency or imminent peril group call and a regular group call?
question_61936.ground_truth: In an MCPTT emergency or imminent peril group call, the response must contain an emergency or imminent peril indicator, whereas a regular group call does not have this requirement.

question_61939.question: Which interface is used for the communication between the CSS and the Gn/Gp SGSN for roaming UEs?
question_61939.ground_truth: The Ghv reference point is used for the communication between the CSS and the Gn/Gp SGSN for roaming UEs.

question_61940.question: What must the PDN GW do before requesting the MME to report location changes?
question_61940.ground_truth: The PDN GW must have received the indication for corresponding support from the MME before it can request the MME to report location changes.

question_61941.question: What is the definition of "front-to-back ratio" as used in the document?
question_61941.ground_truth: The "front-to-back ratio" is the ratio of maximum directivity of an antenna to its directivity in a specified rearward direction.

question_61942.question: How is the priority level determined when MPS is invoked for all participants on an MMTEL video conference call?
question_61942.ground_truth: The user priority level is based on the host MPS User, except in cases where the individual participants have a higher user priority level, the higher user priority level is kept.

question_61944.question: What should a UE do upon receiving a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-network relay discovery announcement, if it is authorized to monitor the corresponding connectivity service?
question_61944.ground_truth: The UE should unscramble, decrypt, and verify the MIC field in the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-network relay discovery announcement, using the received DUSK, DUCK, and UTC-based counter.

question_61945.question: What is the main reason for the cost savings when reducing the maximum bandwidth without lowering the peak data rate for MTC UEs?
question_61945.ground_truth: The main reason for the cost savings when reducing the maximum bandwidth without lowering the peak data rate for MTC UEs is the lower complexity of FFT/IFFT and receiver processing block of baseband processing.

question_61946.question: When does the Network Function or SCP use the telescopic FQDN in the Request URI of the HTTP Request?
question_61946.ground_truth: The Network Function or SCP uses the telescopic FQDN in the Request URI of the HTTP Request when it is ready to communicate with a target Network Function or SCP in another PLMN. The Network Function or SCP also uses the telescopic FQDN in the 3gpp-Sbi-Target-apiRoot custom HTTP header of the HTTP Request during TLS setup.

question_61948.question: What are the responsibilities of the various stakeholders in the 3GPP system?
question_61948.ground_truth: The responsibilities of the various stakeholders in the 3GPP system include the VAL user, VAL service provider, SEALDD provider, and PLMN operator, and involve agreements, arrangements, and interactions related to the SEALDD services.

question_61950.question: What procedure is used to request a UE to send collected measurement logs in 3GPP TS 25.331, TS 36.331, and TS 38.331?
question_61950.ground_truth: The UE Information procedure is used to request a UE to send collected measurement logs in 3GPP TS 25.331, TS 36.331, and TS 38.331.

question_61951.question: What are the objectives for introducing new candidate techniques in the BSS with minimal impacts to hardware and network planning?
question_61951.ground_truth: Objective C3 aims to change MS hardware as little as possible and minimize additional processing power and memory requirements. Objective C4 aims to change BSS hardware as little as possible and avoid hardware upgrades. Objective C5 aims to minimize network planning impacts, avoid interference to legacy MS on the downlink, and consider special cases for the band edge, country border regions, and interferer modeling in link evaluations.

question_61952.question: What components are used to measure the test purpose of modulation quality in UTRA FDD method of test?
question_61952.ground_truth: The test purpose of modulation quality in UTRA FDD method of test involves measuring the Error Vector Magnitude and frequency error using TM1, TM4, and TM5 test models, and the power of the signal.

question_61953.question: What should the protocol entity do when it receives a message with a syntactically incorrect optional IE?
question_61953.ground_truth: The protocol entity should treat all syntactically incorrect optional IEs in a message as not present.

question_61955.question: What elements can be included in the "report-request" element?
question_61955.ground_truth: The "report-request" element can include the following elements: "immediate-report-indicator", "current-location", "triggering-criteria", "geographical-area-change", "minimum-interval-length", "requested-loc-access-type", and "requested-pos-method".

question_61957.question: Where is the description of the functional alias management server found?
question_61957.ground_truth: The functional alias management server is described in subclause~7.4.2.2.13.

question_61959.question: What happens when the MCData clients receive a MCData FD request?
question_61959.ground_truth: The MCData clients check if any policy is to be asserted to limit certain types of message or content to certain members. If the policy assertion is positive, the receiving MCData clients notifies the user about the incoming MCData group standalone FD request.

question_61960.question: What is the function of the HTTP Content Server in terms of LI capabilities?
question_61960.ground_truth: The HTTP Content Server has LI capabilities to generate xIRI records and xCC when a file is uploaded, downloaded or retrieved by a target user.

question_61964.question: What requirement does the USIM need to support for this solution to work?
question_61964.ground_truth: The USIM needs to support Diffie-Hellman based key agreement for this solution to work.

question_61965.question: What is the main purpose of Technique A-3 in the network energy saving and performance impact analysis?
question_61965.ground_truth: The main purpose of Technique A-3 in the network energy saving and performance impact analysis is to enable the UE to send an uplink wake-up signal to request transitioning of a cell from no or reduced transmission/reception activity to active transmission or reception of a channel/signal. This technique can be applied to UEs in one or more RRC states.

question_61966.question: What record does the IRI-POI in the SCEF generate when it detects that a Non-IP PDN Connection needs to be released for the target UE?
question_61966.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the SCEF generates an xIRI containing an SCEFPDNConnectionRelease record when it detects that a Non-IP PDN Connection needs to be released for the target UE.

question_61967.question: What is the unit for the requested RABs, and what does it depend on in the PS domain?
question_61967.ground_truth: The unit for the requested RABs is an integer value, and it depends on the traffic class in the PS domain.

question_61968.question: What is one implication of using the home PLMN of a partner MC system to access MC services in migration for the MC service user's data message store?
question_61968.ground_truth: The MC service user's data message store will not be available when using the home PLMN of the partner MC system to access MC services in migration.

question_61970.question: As per clause 12, what is the importance of measuring and reporting the interactivity consumption towards the protection of user privacy?
question_61970.ground_truth: Associated with this is the expectation that the usage of the reported interactivity usage is restricted to the MBMS User Service to which the interactivity events pertain, and assumes that the user has explicitly opted in to such interactivity usage collection and reporting. In addition, the 3GPP operator, on behalf of the end user, may wish to ensure that interactivity usage information is maintained in secure storage on the user device, and that transmission of that information to the network is secure.

question_61972.question: What should the MS return as a status message when it receives a semantically incorrect message and COMM=T?
question_61972.ground_truth: The MS returns a STATUS message with cause value "semantically incorrect message" and including, if possible, the complete message received.

question_61974.question: What is the purpose of the "RateSet" leaf node in the context of speech codecs?
question_61974.ground_truth: The "RateSet" leaf node represents a list of bit rates used by speech codecs. Each value in the list can be interpreted as either the highest rate or the average rate, depending on the specific codec.

question_61975.question: What is the action taken by the UE after receiving a Detach Accept message with "EPS Detach only" in step 1 of a UE-initiated Detach procedure for E-UTRAN?
question_61975.ground_truth: The UE disables E-UTRAN and selects an appropriate GERAN or UTRAN cell.

question_61976.question: What is Split charging service in a telecommunications network?
question_61976.ground_truth: Split charging service allows the network operator to distribute the charges for a call between the two parties involved. It charges both the calling party and the served user with a split charging rate for this kind of call.

question_61977.question: What triggers the Announcing Alert procedures in VPLMN or Local PLMN when a UE in the vicinity of the announcing UE detects the associated Announcing Enabled indication in the UE context?
question_61977.ground_truth: The HPLMN ProSe Function sends an Announce Authorization message to the ProSe Function in VPLMN or Local PLMN, indicating the RPAUID, Application ID, validity timer, ProSe Restricted Code, UE Identity, and Discovery Entry ID.

question_61981.question: What is the direction to be tested in the reference beam direction pair?

question_61984.question: What is the name of the speed dependent re-selection parameter that specifies the additional time period before the UE can enter Normal-mobility state?

question_61985.question: When would an MCVideo user initiate an imminent peril group call?
question_61985.ground_truth: An MCVideo user would initiate an imminent peril group call in a scenario where they need to communicate with other affiliated MCVideo members of the same MCVideo group about an imminent peril situation.

question_61986.question: What is the purpose of including the oBSS Node ID within the Call Reference ID during call establishment?
question_61986.ground_truth: The purpose of including the oBSS Node ID within the Call Reference ID is to determine whether the call is an intra-BSS call, and to avoid complex solutions to issues related to the BSS Node ID changing during handover.

question_61987.question: What is the format of the NF Service Set ID for a NF Service Set in a SNPN?
question_61987.ground_truth: The NF Service Set ID for a NF Service Set in a SNPN is in the format of set<Set ID>.sn<Service Name>.nfi<NF Instance ID>.5gc.nid<NID>.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC> where MNC and MCC identify the PLMN of the NF Service Set, NID identifies the SNPN of the NF Service Set, Network Identifier (NID) is encoded as hexadecimal digits, NFInstanceID identifies the NF instance of the NF Service set, ServiceName identifies the NF service of the NF Service of the NF Service set, and Set ID is a service specific Set ID within the NF instance.

question_61988.question: What is one of the positioning requirements for a 5G system with satellite access?
question_61988.ground_truth: The system shall be able to support 3GPP positioning methods for UEs using only satellite access.

question_61989.question: What are the procedures supported by the Xn interface in 5G networks?
question_61989.ground_truth: The Xn interface in 5G networks supports procedures over the control plane (Xn-C) and user plane (Xn-U), including mobility management procedures, dual connectivity procedures, global procedures, interface management procedures, energy saving procedures, resource coordination procedures, QMC support procedures, and AI/ML support procedures.

question_61990.question: What does the TDD DPCH Offset represent in the allocation of a group of dedicated physical channels?
question_61990.ground_truth: The TDD DPCH Offset represents the phase information for the allocation of a group of dedicated physical channels in the CCTrCH.

question_61992.question: When should the MC gateway UE send an MC GW MBMS suspension indication to the MC client?
question_61992.ground_truth: The MC gateway UE can choose to send the MC GW MBMS suspension indication to the MC client whenever RAN suspends the MBMS bearer, even if the MC client is not instructed to report the MBMS bearer suspension.

question_61993.question: Which procedure is used to seize a TDM circuit?
question_61993.ground_truth: The Reserve Circuit procedure is used to seize a TDM circuit in 3GPP CS CN.

question_61994.question: What is the impact of the proposal described in section 6.4.1 on the RAN?
question_61994.ground_truth: The proposal described in section 6.4.1 has no impact on the RAN, except in the case where the RAN is responsible for authorizing CE.

question_61995.question: What is the maximum number of bits required to encode the index of 4 signed pulses in a track for cases 0 and 4 in the "Encoding 4 signed pulses per track" section?
question_61995.ground_truth: 4M bits (where M is the number of bits per track).

question_61996.question: What should be done if an MCVideo user is not affiliated with the MCVideo group identified by the group identity in a SIP INVITE request?
question_61996.ground_truth: The system should check if the MCVideo user is eligible for implicit affiliation, and if not, the SIP INVITE request should be rejected with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response.

question_61997.question: How can LMF obtain location measurements or location estimate from a UE via LPP protocol?
question_61997.ground_truth: LMF can obtain location measurements or location estimate from a UE via LPP protocol, as specified in TS~36.355.
