question_61999.question: When must the UE use the "move traffic to/from WLAN" indications from Access Stratum as specified in the "RAN rules / RCLWI handling" parameter?
question_61999.ground_truth: The UE must use the "move traffic to/from WLAN" indications from Access Stratum if the "RAN rules / RCLWI handling" parameter is set, the UE has no ISRP rule valid in the registered PLMN, and the UE supports RAN-assisted WLAN interworking and/or RCLWI.

question_62000.question: What two functions can be included in the CU with RRM functions?
question_62000.ground_truth: The two functions that can be included in the CU with RRM functions are Call Admission Control and Load balancing.

question_62002.question: What does it mean when the '1' value is flagged in Redundancy Level in the RTP packet?

question_62003.question: What are the initial conditions for the test procedure for IMS MT call release in 5GC?
question_62003.ground_truth: The initial conditions involve one NR cell connected to 5GC with default parameters and the user equipment in state 3N-A on the NR Cell with an active IMS call.

question_62004.question: What resolutions does the model support for video coding?
question_62004.ground_truth: The supported video resolutions are 240p, 360p, 480p, 720p, and 1080p.

question_62005.question: What is the maximum number of characters in <text> in the 8.32 command?
question_62005.ground_truth: The maximum number of characters in <text> in the 8.32 command is defined by the manufacturer.

question_62006.question: What is the impact on the SAS centric approach due to the presence of the Iur in the overall network architecture for U-TDOA?
question_62006.ground_truth: The impact on the SAS centric approach due to the presence of the Iur is FFS (for future study).

question_62008.question: Which field is an optional field in the "DCH-Information-RL-AdditionRspTDD" sequence?
question_62008.ground_truth: "dSCH-Information" is an optional field in the "DCH-Information-RL-AdditionRspTDD" sequence.

question_62010.question: What are the AFs and PCRFs expected to set for max-requested-bandwidth and MBR parameters for both uplink and downlink directions?
question_62010.ground_truth: The AFs are expected to set the Max-Requested-Bandwidth to 32 kbps for both uplink and downlink, and the PCRFs will set MBR-UL and MBR-DL parameters to 32 kbps for both directions.

question_62011.question: How many uplink channels are used in NB-CIoT, and how is ACLRadj-x defined?
question_62011.ground_truth: In NB-CIoT, 5 kHz uplink channels are used. ACLRadj-x is defined as the x-th adjacent channel leakage power ratio, where x = floor(carrier spacing/channel bandwidth) + 1.

question_62012.question: What is the purpose of the "access-Restriction" extension in an X.509 version 3 certificate?
question_62012.ground_truth: The "access-Restriction" extension in an X.509 version 3 certificate is used to prevent applications from accessing network services, regardless of user permissions.

question_62013.question: What information elements are considered transparent in the BSSMAP HANDOVER REQUIRED message?
question_62013.ground_truth: Transparent information elements in the BSSMAP HANDOVER REQUIRED message are those that are defined as transparent and thus not essential to the message.

question_62015.question: What is the carrier separation required for UMTS and GSM to be deployed in the same geographical area in coordinated operation?
question_62015.ground_truth: The carrier separation required for UMTS and GSM to be deployed in the same geographical area in coordinated operation is 2.8 MHz.

question_62016.question: What factors determine the availability of a file to be retrieved when it is sent to another MCData user?
question_62016.ground_truth: The availability of a file to be retrieved is subject to expiry time and size limitations, and determined by the file storage policy.

question_62017.question: What is the requirement for the indication of a VCC event in the charging information?
question_62017.ground_truth: It shall be possible to indicate in the charging information that a VCC event has occurred, so that appropriate ratings can be applied for the CS and IMS parts of the continued voice call.

question_62018.question: Which UE physical layer measurements are specifically defined in the current version of the technical specification for the E-UTRA physical layer?
question_62018.ground_truth: Reference Signal Received Power (RSRP), Reference Signal Received Quality (RSRQ), Reference Signal Time Difference (RSTD), UE GNSS Timing of Cell Frames for UE positioning, UE GNSS code measurements, and UE GNSS carrier phase measurements are some of the UE physical layer measurements defined in the current version of the technical specification.

question_62020.question: What entities in the controlling MCPTT function have a direct communication interface to the application and signalling plane?
question_62020.ground_truth: All entities in the controlling MCPTT function have a direct communication interface to the application and signalling plane.

question_62021.question: What is the role of the Action TLV in the USAT Interpreter?
question_62021.ground_truth: The Action TLV defines the behavior of the USAT Interpreter when the general result of the terminal response (TR) is part of the associated general result range. It determines the actions taken by the USAT Interpreter based on the general result.

question_62022.question: How many bits does the Selective Status Report facility use to control the creation of Status Reports?
question_62022.ground_truth: The Selective Status Report facility uses 8 bits (octet 1) to control the creation of Status Reports.

question_62023.question: What is the cause "PFCP session restoration failure due to requested resource not available" indicative of in the Intermediate UPF?
question_62023.ground_truth: This cause indicates scenarios where the requested IP address is no longer available at the UPF and cannot be assigned to any PFCP session, due to factors such as decommissioning by OAM or partial hardware failure.

question_62024.question: What should the P-CSCF insert in the Feature-Caps header field when forwarding the target refresh request?
question_62024.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should insert the same header field parameters with the same parameter values in the Feature-Caps header field when forwarding the target refresh request in the same direction.

question_62026.question: What are the two types of EVS coder implementations that 3GPP has standardized for enhanced speech and audio communication?
question_62026.ground_truth: The two types of EVS coder implementations that 3GPP has standardized for enhanced speech and audio communication are a fixed-point version (TS 26.442) and a floating-point version (TS 26.443).

question_62031.question: What new revenue opportunities could be created by adding a data channel to IMS?
question_62031.ground_truth: This could unlock an addressable market for communication service providers worldwide in various industry segments like Remote Health, Remote Drone Control, Remote Education, Remote Security, Remote Machinery Control, Augmented Reality, and Consumer-to-business Interaction.

question_62033.question: What should be done if a file download complete notification is required in step 5.b?
question_62033.ground_truth: Include a FD disposition request type IE set to "FILE DOWNLOAD COMPLETED UPDATE" in the FD SIGNALLING PAYLOAD message and include and set the Mandatory download IE to "MANDATORY DOWNLOAD".

question_62034.question: What was the evaluation method used to assess the muting behavior of the AMR-WB in section 23?
question_62034.ground_truth: The muting behavior of the AMR-WB was evaluated through expert listening tests on overload input level, and there was no evidence of any significant problems such as gross instability.

question_62035.question: What is the format of the input message in the GIA4 integrity algorithm?
question_62035.ground_truth: The input message in the GIA4 integrity algorithm may be between 1 and 65536 octets long.

question_62036.question: What is the feature in Rel-16 that allows up to two users to transmit simultaneously when the number of PUSCH repetitions is greater than or equal to 64 for full-PRB allocation?

question_62037.question: What should the UE check for when receiving the 200 (OK) response to the REGISTER request?
question_62037.ground_truth: The UE should store the list of URIs contained in the P-Associated-URI header value, which contains the URIs that are associated to the registered public user identity.

question_62038.question: What is the requirement for the UE to perform RSRP and RSRQ measurements?
question_62038.ground_truth: The UE shall be capable of performing RSRP and RSRQ measurements of at least 4 inter-frequency cells per FDD inter-frequency.

question_62039.question: What message is used to transfer the UE Location Privacy Indication information to the UDM?
question_62039.ground_truth: The AMF shall transfer the UE Location Privacy Indication information in LocationPrivacySetting message to UDM when the UE has generated or updated the UE Location Privacy Indication by sending the LocationPrivacySetting message in UL NAS TRANSPORT.

question_62041.question: What is the ultimate goal of optimizing the TS length for PCE2?
question_62041.ground_truth: The ultimate goal is to provide some extra symbols for other use, such as more padding symbols at the edge of the signal BW, while minimizing the loss on channel estimation.

question_62042.question: What are the capabilities of the Network Slice management architecture, as per REQ-5GNS-CON-05?
question_62042.ground_truth: The Network Slice management architecture shall provide capabilities to manage the total view of all created slice instances.

question_62044.question: What is the requirement for private calls to functional aliases simultaneously activated by multiple MCX Users?
question_62044.ground_truth: The MCX Service system shall support private calls and private emergency calls to a functional alias simultaneously activated by multiple MCX Users. The MCX Service system shall provide a mechanism for the MCX Service Administrator to select the mechanism to be used for handling of private calls to functional aliases that are allowed to be simultaneously active for multiple MCX Users.

question_62046.question: What should a BSS do if the RIM container included in a RAN-INFORMATION-ERROR PDU contains an unknown value in the RIM Application Identity IE?
question_62046.ground_truth: The BSS should discard the RIM PDU without further action.

question_62049.question: When sending a SIP MESSAGE request for File Delivery over SIP (FDS), what action should the MCData client take if the payload contained in the Payload IE in the FD SIGNALLING PAYLOAD message does not contain an Application ID IE?
question_62049.ground_truth: The MCData client shall determine that the payload contained in the Payload IE in the FD SIGNALLING PAYLOAD message is for user consumption, shall notify the user about the incoming FD request, and if the FD SIGNALLING PAYLOAD message contains a Metadata IE, shall deliver the contents of the Metadata IE to the user.

question_62050.question: What is the purpose of the multiuser talker control application in the multi-train voice communication system?
question_62050.ground_truth: If the Driver and/or Ground FRMCS User is connected to more than one Drivers and/or Ground FRMCS Users, the multiuser talker control application is used to manage the precedence of the incoming voice communication at the Driver and the Ground FRMCS User.

question_62051.question: Which solution follows proposals already available for Rel-10 but was finally removed as not necessary, as per Solution 2b?
question_62051.ground_truth: Solution 2b follows proposals already available for Rel-10 but was finally removed as not necessary.

question_62052.question: What is the minimum rate of correct cell re-selections required during repeated tests?
question_62052.ground_truth: The rate of correct cell re-selections observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

question_62053.question: What are the two ways sensing can be implemented in 5G wireless communication and sensing network?
question_62053.ground_truth: The two ways are Monostatic sensing, where the sensing transmitter and sensing receiver are co-located in the same entity, and Bistatic sensing, where the sensing receiver and sensing transmitter are in different entities.

question_62055.question: What does TP-PID value 0 indicate in SEND SHORT MESSAGE command?

question_62056.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP system's interworking with WLANs as specified in the present document?
question_62056.ground_truth: The purpose is to specify the network selection, including authentication and access authorization procedures for the interworking of the 3GPP system and WLANs. It also specifies the tunnel management procedures used for establishing an end-to-end tunnel from the WLAN UE to the 3GPP network via the Wu reference point.

question_62057.question: What is the importance of the system context in the IRP IS specification?
question_62057.ground_truth: The system context provides the general definition of the System Context for the IRP, which is essential for understanding the system's behavior and functionality.

question_62060.question: What is a Representation in the context of 3GP-DASH media presentation?
question_62060.ground_truth: A Representation, represented by the Representation element, is one of the alternative choices of the complete set or subset of media content components in a media presentation during a defined Period. It specifies the format, encoding, and other properties of the media content.

question_62061.question: What does "should not" indicate in the context of the present document?
question_62061.ground_truth: "Should not" indicates a recommendation not to do something in the context of the present document.

question_62062.question: In the context of PDU set level QoS handling, what is the role of SMF and UPF?
question_62062.ground_truth: SMF derives PDU set level QoS policies/profiles considering PDU set level QoS handling and delivers enhanced N4 rules and QoS profiles to UPF and NG-RAN. UPF identifies PDU sets by detecting higher layer packet headers and applies PDU set level QoS policies considering application level QoS policies.

question_62064.question: Which two security-related components does the solution #17 architecturally assume to be present besides the standard 5G network entities like AMF, UDM, AUSF, etc.?

question_62065.question: What does Solution 13 do to help meet regulatory requirements identified in Key Issue 10?
question_62065.ground_truth: Solution 13 helps meet regulatory requirements identified in Key Issue 10 by helping to ensure that the UE is registered to a PLMN of the same country as the present UE location. This is done by giving the UE a hint of which MCC PLMNs to attempt instead if it is not aware of its location.

question_62067.question: In Dual Connectivity, which RAN node is responsible for performing all necessary N2 related functions such as mobility management, relaying of NAS signalling, etc. and managing the handling of user plane connection?
question_62067.ground_truth: The RAN node at which the N2 terminates, performed by the Master RAN Node.

question_62069.question: What is the difference between fast forward tunnelling and delayed backward tunnelling?
question_62069.ground_truth: In fast forward tunnelling, the tunnel data is transferred in the IAM and the subsequent Tunnel Information message(s), while in delayed backward tunnelling, the tunnel data is transferred in the Tunnel Information messages following the IAM.

question_62070.question: In test procedure 1, what happens after the access class x is indicated as not barred?
question_62070.ground_truth: A GPRS attach procedure is performed.

question_62071.question: In the test architecture described in section 5.2, what are the capabilities of the test instrument?
question_62071.ground_truth: In the test architecture described in section 5.2, the test instrument is capable of both observing RTP/RTCP traffic and acting as a fully functional counterpart to the system under test, including both RTP/RTCP sender and receiver.

question_62073.question: What are the two types of reference points used for MCVideo signalling, and what is their purpose?
question_62073.ground_truth: The two types of reference points used for MCVideo signalling are MCVideo-1 and MCVideo-3. MCVideo-1 is used for MCVideo application signalling for establishing a session in support of MCVideo service between the MCVideo client and the MCVideo server, while MCVideo-3 is used for MCVideo application signalling between the MCVideo server and another MCVideo server or between the MCVideo server and the MC gateway server.

question_62074.question: What should the UE do if intra-RAT cell selection or reselection occurs while T331 is running and the validity cell list is included in the entry in the validity area list for the corresponding carrier frequency?
question_62074.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T331 and perform the actions as specified in 5.6.20.3.

question_62076.question: What is the primary purpose of the MTC-IWF load control in the interaction with SMS-SC?
question_62076.ground_truth: The primary purpose of the MTC-IWF load control is to handle signalling load and avoid signalling overload from MTC servers sending triggering requests to target UEs for specific applications.

question_62078.question: What is the potential interference concern for the LTE 450 UE on the SARC receive band?
question_62078.ground_truth: The potential interference concern for the LTE 450 UE on the SARC receive band is that the UE emissions, if not sufficiently attenuated, may interfere with transmissions in the SARC receive band, leading to a reduction in signal quality.

question_62079.question: What should be included in the CoAP payload when sending an aggregated MSGin5G message delivery status report?
question_62079.ground_truth: When sending an aggregated MSGin5G message delivery status report, the CoAP payload should include an "MSGin5G service identifier", "Message Type", "Originating UE Service ID", "Recipient UE Service ID/AS Service ID" (if applicable), "Message ID", "Delivery Status", "Failure Cause" (if applicable), "Number of individual messages", and a "List of individual messages" element, with each child element containing the "Message ID", "Delivery Status", and optional "Failure Cause" of each individual MSGin5G message delivery status report.

question_62080.question: What actions should an SGSN take after receiving a RADIO-STATUS PDU indicating conditions 1-4?
question_62080.ground_truth: After receiving a RADIO-STATUS PDU with cause value indicating Conditions 1-4, the SGSN may try to locate the mobile station in case any downlink LLC PDU needs to be sent to the mobile station, as it can not expect to receive systematically an uplink LLC PDU from the mobile station. To this avail, the SGSN should send a PAGING-PS PDU towards the mobile station.

question_62081.question: In what situations will the new AMF determine that certain PDU Sessions cannot be supported in the new Registration Area?
question_62081.ground_truth: The new AMF will make this determination if one or more S-NSSAIs used in the old Registration Area cannot be served in the target Registration Area, or if continuity of the PDU Sessions cannot be supported between networks due to factors such as SNPN-SNPN mobility or inter-PLMN mobility without an HR agreement.

question_62082.question: What message does the SS respond with after the UE sends a DHCPINFORM message with option code 120 in step 5 of the P-CSCF discovery process using DHCP?
question_62082.ground_truth: The SS responds by DHCPACK message providing the domain names of P-CSCF address(es) and giving a DNS server address.

question_62084.question: What action does the SMF take after PCC rules are supplied by H-PCF for the MA PDU session control information in the 5GS to EPS handover scenario using N26 interface?
question_62084.ground_truth: The SMF initiates the establishment of user-plane resources over non-3GPP access and derives the ATSSS rules for the UE and the N4 rules for the H-UPF after PCC rules are supplied by H-PCF for the MA PDU session control information in the 5GS to EPS handover scenario using N26 interface.

question_62086.question: What action should the MCPTT client take upon receiving an initial SIP INVITE request for the private call without media-level section for floor control entity?
question_62086.ground_truth: The MCPTT client shall consider the request as the request for private call without floor control and shall follow the procedures as specified in subclause~11.1.1.2.1.2 for on-demand session and subclause~11.1.1.2.2.2 for pre-established session.

question_62087.question: What is the purpose of the Forward Relocation Response message in inter-SGSN SRNS relocation?
question_62087.ground_truth: It indicates that the target RNC is ready to receive forwarded downlink packets from the source SRNC, i.e., the relocation resource allocation procedure has been terminated successfully.

question_62088.question: For a single-band MSR base station with GSM/EDGE single RAT operation in Band Category 2, which requirements shall apply for all transmission modes foreseen by the manufacturer's specification, regardless of the type of transmitter?
question_62088.ground_truth: The requirements in TS 45.005 clause 6.6.2.3 apply to an MSR base station for any operating band with GSM/EDGE single RAT operation in Band Category 2.

question_62089.question: What is the requirement for the 3GPP management system to enable an authorized data consumer to request management data specified by 3GPP to be reported to the requesting or another authorized data consumer?

question_62091.question: What should the UE do if it detects N3C connection failure in the IndirectPathFailureInformation message?
question_62091.ground_truth: The UE should set the failureTypeIndirectPath as "n3c-Failure".

question_62092.question: What should the MCData client include in the "m=message" media-level section for the MCData media stream when composing an SDP offer?
question_62092.ground_truth: The MCData client should include the IP address and port number, a protocol field value of "TCP/MSRP" or "TCP/TLS/MSRP" for TLS, a format list field set to '*', an "a=sendonly" attribute, an "a=path" attribute containing its own MSRP URI, set the content type as "a=accept-types:application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-payload", and set the a=setup attribute as "actpass".

question_62093.question: How is the SNPN ID coded in the Replacement field used in DNS-based Discovery of SNPN N3IWF for regulatory requirements?
question_62093.ground_truth: The SNPN ID is coded in the Replacement field used in DNS-based Discovery of SNPN N3IWF for regulatory requirements as "sos.n3iwf.5gc.snpnid<SNPNID>.mcc<MCC>.pub.3gppnetwork.org".

question_62094.question: What should the SMF+PGW-C do when it receives a re-authentication request for a MA PDU Session and the UE is not reachable?
question_62094.ground_truth: The SMF+PGW-C shall inform the DN-AAA server that the re-authentication is not possible with error code 3002 and optional "WLAN" and "EUTRA" within the 3GPP-RAT-Type.

question_62095.question: What is the role of the IWF performing the participating role upon receipt of a SIP re-INVITE targeting a user homed in the IWF for an MCPTT chat group?
question_62095.ground_truth: The IWF performing the participating role shall perform the steps specified in 10.2.1.1.2.

question_62097.question: What is the pre-condition for initiating railway emergency voice communication?
question_62097.ground_truth: The railway emergency alert must be active.

question_62098.question: What does the abbreviation "HNB" stand for in the context of 3GPP?
question_62098.ground_truth: HNB stands for Home Node B in the context of 3GPP.

question_62099.question: What are the recommended special considerations for the AR profile of the split rendering media service enabler?
question_62099.ground_truth: The recommended special considerations for the AR profile include the formats to be supported on AR glasses, post-processing for pose correction and integration with XR runtimes, power consumption challenge for AR glasses, metrics and KPIs for AR glasses, QoS and QoE requirements for AR type of applications, and other AR-specific considerations.

question_62100.question: Which leaf node contains a Boolean parameter that enables or disables ECN-based adaptation?

question_62101.question: What is the role of the mobile terminal in the use case when connected to a 3DTV set?
question_62101.ground_truth: The mobile terminal acts as a mobile Set top box, receiving and decoding the 3D video content and transmitting it to the 3DTV display.

question_62102.question: Which network entity sends the PS Handover Request message to request resource allocation in the target BSS during the handover procedure?

question_62103.question: What is the recommended timeslot and subchannel for GERAN in order to avoid conflicts with other reserved purposes?
question_62103.ground_truth: Timeslot 3 shall be used as the timeslot assigned for GERAN CS traffic, and the subchannel used in GERAN L2 access message is valid only for specific logical channel types (FACCH/H, SDCCH/8, SDCCH/4). For other logical channel types, the subchannel field should be coded as 15 for compatibility with TTCN2 test cases.

question_62104.question: What action does the I-CSCF take when receiving a response containing a "term-ioi" header field parameter in the P-Charging-Vector header field?
question_62104.ground_truth: The I-CSCF removes all received "orig-ioi" and "term-ioi" header field parameters from the forwarded response, inserts the stored "orig-ioi" header field parameter if received in the request, and inserts a type 2 "term-ioi" header field parameter with a value that identifies the sending network of the response.

question_62105.question: What is the action taken by the Controller UE when informed by the SCC AS that the Controllee UE has released a media flow it terminates?
question_62105.ground_truth: The Controller UE initiates one of four procedures to transfer or remove the media flow from the Collaborative Session.

question_62107.question: What should the power of the first preamble be, in dBm, as specified in clause 4.3.2.2.2.5-2?
question_62107.ground_truth: The power of the first preamble should be -22 dBm.

question_62108.question: What interfaces are used for MC services to access MBS PCC capabilities if the MC service server and the 5GS are in different trust domains with respect to MBS?
question_62108.ground_truth: N33 needs to be used to gain access to the MBS control plane capabilities and the PCC capabilities.

question_62110.question: What happens to the downlink traffic from untrusted non-3GPP access when the UPF switches user plane tunnels?
question_62110.ground_truth: The UPF switches all downlink traffic from untrusted non-3GPP access to trusted non-3GPP access.

question_62111.question: How many tests are included in the characterization tests for VR streaming audio in the 3GPP Technical Report?
question_62111.ground_truth: There are three tests included, Test 1, Test 2, and Test 3.

question_62114.question: What is the function of Information Elements (IEs) in GTP' messaging?
question_62114.ground_truth: Information Elements (IEs) in GTP' messaging contain additional information about the GTP' message. They are encoded in TLV or TV formats and are sorted with the Type fields in ascending order.

question_62116.question: What functionality does T-ADS perform for terminating sessions in IMS Service Centralization and Continuity enabled networks?
question_62116.ground_truth: T-ADS selects CS access and/or one or more PS access network(s) to be used to deliver a terminating session to the UE.

question_62118.question: What are the discoverability criteria for PINE in PINE and 5GC communication?
question_62118.ground_truth: PINEs are allowed to be discovered if requested for a specific service, group ID, user-defined name, or time (time slot).

question_62119.question: Which type of E-UTRA UE FDD is applicable for this test in 8.16.1.2?
question_62119.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA UE FDD release 10 and forward that support CA with Intra-band contiguous CA, Inter-band CA, or Intra-band non-contiguous CA, with FGI bit 111 support.

question_62120.question: What are the Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for positioning use cases?
question_62120.ground_truth: The KPIs for positioning use cases include position accuracy, speed accuracy, bearing accuracy, timestamp accuracy, availability, latency, time to first fix, update rate, power consumption, energy per fix, and system scalability.

question_62121.question: How does network slice load analysis support SLAs assurance?
question_62121.ground_truth: Network slice load analysis considers the load of services with different characteristics and distribution over time and location. MDAS producer utilizes performance measurements to identify degradation of network performance and KPIs due to load issues. The analytics results can support SLA assurance by evaluating potential actions for load management.

question_62124.question: What is the effect of the interconnection network being SIP-unaware in step 30?
question_62124.ground_truth: If the interconnection network is SIP-unaware, step 30 is skipped and step 33 is executed between S-CSCF-hA and IBCF-hB instead.

question_62125.question: What is the field "TP-VPF" in the SMS-SUBMIT message used for?
question_62125.ground_truth: The field "TP-VPF" in the SMS-SUBMIT message is used to indicate the format of the "TP-VP" (Validity Period) field, which can be relative, enhanced, or absolute format.

question_62126.question: What is the maximum time allowed for a UE to read the relevant system information and complete the RRC procedure delay for a UTRAN cell?
question_62126.ground_truth: The maximum time allowed is 7.92 seconds.

question_62127.question: What is the role of the DN-AAA server in the 5G core network?
question_62127.ground_truth: The DN-AAA server is responsible for authorizing and authenticicating the PDN (Packet Data Network) connections in the 5G core network.

question_62128.question: What is the behavior of ME+ during RAU and TAU procedures in UTRAN and E-UTRAN?
question_62128.ground_truth: The behavior of ME+ during RAU and TAU procedures in UTRAN and E-UTRAN is the same as specified in TS 33.401.

question_62129.question: What is the main aim of the announcing mode in a network of devices?
question_62129.ground_truth: The main aim of the announcing mode is for a device, such as a printer, to send messages at regular intervals to announce its presence and capabilities to the network, so it can be efficiently discovered by the correct group of users without causing signalling overload.

question_62132.question: What is the role of the NEF in the 3GPP network when the value is updated by the UDM?
question_62132.ground_truth: The NEF notifies the AF of the actual value that is being applied in the 3GPP network.

question_62133.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 8.3.5.5.2.3?
question_62133.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the requirement for the UTRA FDD to E-UTRA FDD inter-RAT cell reselection delay.

question_62134.question: What are the pre-requisites for switching traffic between non-3GPP access paths in Solution #5.1?
question_62134.ground_truth: The pre-requisites for switching traffic between non-3GPP access paths in Solution #5.1 are that the UE has already registered to 5GC via trusted non-3GPP access and has established a MA PDU session over trusted non-3GPP access.

question_62135.question: What steps can the MME/SGSN take to alleviate network congestion?
question_62135.ground_truth: During network congestion, the MME/SGSN can prevent further network congestion by ensuring no UEs are triggered while the particular congestion remains, either by activating MTC-IWF overload control or by storing the trigger request for a target UE and restarting forwarding when the congestion is resolved and the validity time of the trigger is not expired.

question_62136.question: What benefit does the utilization of licensed spectrum provide in industrial process automation, compared to unlicensed technologies?
question_62136.ground_truth: The utilization of licensed spectrum can overcome the vulnerability to same-band interference and therefore enable higher reliability.

question_62137.question: What type of information is included in the ProtocolIEs of the SLMSetupResponse message?
question_62137.ground_truth: The ProtocolIEs of the SLMSetupResponse message includes an id-ESMLC-ID and may also include id-CriticalityDiagnostics.

question_62138.question: What are the two alternatives considered in Scenario E for the initial attach in roaming LBO?
question_62138.ground_truth: Alternative A (use of S9) and Alternative B (no S9)

question_62139.question: What is the common maximum accepted test system uncertainty value (in dB) for absolute and relative OTA ACLR tests, for TT (Test Tolerance)?
question_62139.ground_truth: The common maximum accepted test system uncertainty value is 0 dB for absolute and relative OTA ACLR tests, for TT.

question_62140.question: What HTTP method is used to delete a single resource representing a managed object instance?
question_62140.ground_truth: The HTTP DELETE method is used to delete a single resource representing a managed object instance.

question_62143.question: What are the trigger types for a periodic or triggered MT-LR procedure for sidelink positioning/ranging?
question_62143.ground_truth: The trigger types for a periodic or triggered MT-LR procedure for sidelink positioning/ranging include area event trigger, motion event trigger, and range trigger, each with different options.

question_62144.question: What is the minimum number of successful tests that must be observed for the test to be concluded successfully?
question_62144.ground_truth: At least 90% of the repeated tests must have correct events for the test to be concluded successfully.

question_62145.question: What is the minimum number of (error) events required for an early pass decision?
question_62145.ground_truth: For an early pass decision, the minimum number of (error) events required is 1.

question_62146.question: In the context of supervising mIoT terminals, what is the role of the NWDAF in collecting runtime data for misbehaving IoT UEs?
question_62146.ground_truth: The NWDAF can request the 3GPP network to start monitoring UE states to collect necessary runtime data like UE current location, data rate, etc. Afterward, the NWDAF performs data analysis to identify rogue behavior for a single or multiple UEs based on the comparison with expected UE behaviors.

question_62147.question: What is the maximum outage increase for the EC-GSM performance when exposed to an uncoordinated UTRA or E-UTRA aggressor?
question_62147.ground_truth: The maximum outage increase for the EC-GSM performance when exposed to an uncoordinated UTRA or E-UTRA aggressor is 0.6 percentage points for the uplink and 1 percent-unit for the downlink when the EC-GSM is fully loaded. When the EC-GSM load is reduced to a single TS, the relative outage degradation increases, but the levels never go above 1 percent-unit for both uplink and downlink.

question_62148.question: What is the function of the Protocol-Identifier information element in the SMS architecture?
question_62148.ground_truth: The Protocol-Identifier information element is used by the SM-TL to either refer to the higher layer protocol being used or to indicate interworking with a certain type of telematic device.

question_62149.question: Which type name indicates a feature supported by the H-SMF to the V-SMF?

question_62151.question: What is the length of the ci-3gpp2 parameter when the Carrier-ID is not included?
question_62151.ground_truth: The length of the ci-3gpp2 parameter is 34 hexadecimal characters when the Carrier-ID is not included.

question_62152.question: What is the implication of AAS BS having a multi-band TAB connector, and what is the difference between single and multi-band requirements?
question_62152.ground_truth: A multi-band TAB connector enables AAS BS to operate in multiple operating bands through common active electronic components. Single band requirements apply to a specific operating band, while multi-band requirements apply to multiple operating bands or exclude some bands as defined for a particular requirement.

question_62153.question: What is the meaning of PS-PS session continuity in the context of multimedia sessions?
question_62153.ground_truth: PS-PS session continuity refers to the transfer of a multimedia session with multiple media components between two different packet-switched (PS) access networks, to maintain a high-quality user experience due to user's movement from one network to another.

question_62154.question: What is the condition for the measurement reporting delay in section 8.2.11.3.2.1?
question_62154.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between an event that triggers a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface, excluding delays caused by other RRC signalling on the DCCH and a delay uncertainty resulting from inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH.

question_62156.question: What services does the PDCP entity expect from the LWAAP entity?
question_62156.ground_truth: The PDCP entity expects user plane data transfer service from the LWAAP entity.

question_62157.question: What should the Node B do if the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message includes the UE support of non-rectangular resource allocation IE?
question_62157.ground_truth: The Node B should use this information to determine whether to include the Non-rectangular resource allocation indicator IE and the Non-rectangular resource timeslot set IE or not.

question_62160.question: When would the 5G DDNMF skip the check of the ProSe application ID in the discovery procedure?
question_62160.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF skips the check of the ProSe application ID if the ProSe application ID is known or if the 5G DDNMF performs the check for authorization to announce the ProSe application ID.

question_62161.question: What video resolution does H.264/AVC High Profile level 4.1 support?

question_62162.question: Which entities are responsible for controlling and enforcing QoS policies for IP traffic exchanged by fixed devices in the fixed broadband access?
question_62162.ground_truth: The PCRF controls directly the IP Edge in the fixed broadband access without the mediation of the BPCF for enforcing QoS policies for IP traffic exchanged by fixed devices in the fixed broadband access.

question_62164.question: What should the ICS UE include in an I1 Bye message when releasing an I1 session using the I1 session control channel?
question_62164.ground_truth: The ICS UE should include a From-id information element and a To-id information element, as well as a Privacy information element that indicates the ICS UE's privacy preferences.

question_62166.question: When would a UE need to re-evaluate the location of a PDN GW for an APN associated with a PDN connection in case of SIPTO?
question_62166.ground_truth: If SIPTO is allowed for the APN associated with a PDN connection, the MME would need to re-evaluate the location of a PDN GW for that connection upon deactivation of the PDN connection.

question_62167.question: Where is the CCBS Description information element formed during the activation of CCBS?
question_62167.ground_truth: The CCBS Description information element is formed in the HLR~A during the activation of CCBS.

question_62169.question: What is the purpose of the SS sending a MAC PDU containing the MAC control element 'Timing Advance Command' in connected mode to prevent the UE from doing RACH procedure for PUCCH synchronization?
question_62169.ground_truth: The purpose is to maintain PUCCH synchronization at the UE by periodically sending the MAC control element.

question_62170.question: What is the value of P when in the monitored cell there are measurement gaps overlapping with some but not all occasions of the CSI-RS in FR1?
question_62170.ground_truth: P = , which means the accuracy requirements for this condition are not specified.

question_62172.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group Core Network's Open Service Access (OSA) Application Programming Interface (API) Mapping?
question_62172.ground_truth: The purpose is to define an architecture that enables application developers to make use of network functionality through an open standardized interface (OSA API's).

question_62173.question: How does the SDC Functionality respond if it does not find any corresponding sponsored data related information for the received PFD information?
question_62173.ground_truth: The SDC Functionality responds null to the PCEF/TDF, and the PCEF/TDF stores the PFD with the original Charging Key of the match-all PCC/ADC rule.

question_62174.question: How long did it take for the raw data from the MRI scan to be processed and uploaded for diagnosis in the MSP?
question_62174.ground_truth: It took less than 10 seconds for the raw data from the MRI scan to be processed and uploaded for diagnosis in the MSP.

question_62176.question: What does the optional control flag in an MO message represent?
question_62176.ground_truth: The optional control flag in an MO message represents a particular Service Centre or email gateway specific function required to be invoked.

question_62179.question: What message type and direction are used for a UE to request setup of a private call with another UE?
question_62179.ground_truth: "PRIVATE CALL SETUP REQUEST" and "UE to another UE"

question_62180.question: When should the "X-HTTP-Method-Override: GET" HTTP header be included in a request?
question_62180.ground_truth: When the query exceeds the supported URI length limit, the query may be passed in the payload body of a POST request instead of the target URI of a GET request, and the "X-HTTP-Method-Override: GET" HTTP header shall be included in the request.

question_62183.question: What information does NAS container for PS HO indicate in a 3G/2G SGSN?
question_62183.ground_truth: The NAS container for PS HO indicates 'Reset to the old XID parameters' or 'Reset to default parameters' in a 3G/2G SGSN.

question_62184.question: What is used by DS-enabled routers to make routing decisions based on traffic class?
question_62184.ground_truth: The DS Code Point (DSCP) of the DS field is used by DS-enabled routers to make routing decisions based on traffic class.

question_62185.question: What should be the maximum duration of the FO Negotiation search for finding a distant TFO Partner?
question_62185.ground_truth: The maximum duration of the FO Negotiation search is 30 seconds.

question_62186.question: What is the role of the Inter-3GPP Mobility Anchor?
question_62186.ground_truth: The Inter-3GPP Mobility Anchor is the functional entity that anchors the user plane for mobility between 3GPP 2G/3G access systems and the E-UTRA access system.

question_62187.question: What is the maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell in the intra frequency NR cell re-selection test case?
question_62187.ground_truth: The maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell in the intra frequency NR cell re-selection test case is 1280ms.

question_62189.question: What information is included in the RRC Connection Resume Request message in step 4?
question_62189.ground_truth: The RRC Connection Resume Request message in step 4 includes the UE's Resume Id, Authentication Token, Bearer Identity, and Establishment Cause. It may also contain User Plane multiplexed by MAC, using the resumed stored security context to encrypt the User Plane.

question_62191.question: What is the role of the AAuF during the authentication procedure in the AKMA architecture?
question_62191.ground_truth: The AAuF takes the role of the EAP authentication server during the authentication procedure in the AKMA architecture.

question_62193.question: What status is indicated to the user if the UE receives a REGISTER message with the LCS-LocationNotification Invoke component set to NotifyAndVerify-LocationNotAllowedIfNoResponse?
question_62193.ground_truth: The UE indicates that the default response is location not allowed, and allows the user to accept or deny the request.

question_62194.question: What is the role of the S11-interface in the Evolved Packet Core?
question_62194.ground_truth: The S11-interface is used to support mobility and bearer management between the MME and S-GW.

question_62195.question: How does the MT of each IAB-node in Architecture 1b sustain NAS connectivity to the NGC?
question_62195.ground_truth: The MT of each IAB-node in Architecture 1b sustains NAS connectivity to the NGC via a modified RLC* over the F1* protocol stack.

question_62198.question: What is the main principle of the client-server model in REST architecture?
question_62198.ground_truth: The main principle of the client-server model in REST architecture is to split responsibilities between the client and the server, where the client sends a request and the server responds to it. This allows for simplification, portability, and scalability.

question_62199.question: What was the increase in capacity performance for FR1, Dense urban, DL, with VR/AR GOP-based multi-stream traffic model, 30Mbps, 60FPS, 10ms PDB, with DDDSU, MU-MIMO, when using the FLIT scheduler and prioritizing the transmission of I frame?
question_62199.ground_truth: The capacity performance increased by 43.3% (from 6 UEs per cell to 8.6 UEs per cell).

question_62201.question: What was the COT sharing procedure that was assumed by one source in 8.3.1.1, where it was permitted by EN 301 893, and showed improvement in all measured metrics and in VoIP performance for the non-replaced Wi-Fi operator?
question_62201.ground_truth: The COT sharing procedure that was assumed by one source in 8.3.1.1, where it was permitted by EN 301 893, and showed improvement in all measured metrics and in VoIP performance for the non-replaced Wi-Fi operator was using category 1 LBT for gaps less than or equal to 16us, for gaps above 16us but do not exceed 25us, and gaps that exceed 25us, category 2 LBT is used for channel access in the COT used for control information transmission.

question_62205.question: What is the impact of PGW-C storing the FQ-CSID allocated by the PGW-U for partial failure handling?
question_62205.ground_truth: It reduces the possibility to send massive user plane data to the PGW-C as many Sx sessions are affected by the partial failure of the PGW-U.

question_62206.question: What two actions does a PDR and FAR pair in a UPF perform regarding traffic forwarding?
question_62206.ground_truth: A PDR and FAR pair in a UPF performs the action of detecting the destination address of a packet and instructing the UPF to forward the traffic to the UPF internal interface or adding an outer header and forwarding the traffic to the next UPF.

question_62207.question: What is the role of channel coding in the 3GPP TS?
question_62207.ground_truth: Channel coding is a key component of the 3GPP TS that combines error detection, error correction, and rate matching with interleaving and transport channels mapping onto/splitting from physical channels.

question_62209.question: What should an MCVideo server do to provide the controlling role for group calls and private calls in the MCVideo system?
question_62209.ground_truth: The MCVideo server acting in a controlling role should implement the procedures defined in 3GPP TS 23.281, 24.229, and 23.468 for unicast delivery, MBMS delivery, and service continuity.

question_62210.question: What should the AS do if the UE has indicated support for both the "telephone-event" media subtype and the SIP INFO mechanism for DTMF transport?
question_62210.ground_truth: Based on operator policy, the AS should choose which DTMF transport mechanism to use for CAT control between the UE and the AS. If the AS wants to use the SIP INFO mechanism for DTMF transport, it should indicate support for the mechanism in a reliable response sent to the UE by including a Recv-Info header field with a "infoDtmf" value. If the AS wants to use the "telephone-event" media subtype for DTMF transport, it should include the "telephone-event" in the SDP for CAT media, sent to the UE.

question_62211.question: When multiple registrations mechanism is used and a user binds a public user identity to several registration flows, how many <contact> elements will the NOTIFY request contain in this case?
question_62211.ground_truth: The NOTIFY request will contain one <contact> element for each registration flow in this case.

question_62212.question: Which types of NR UE do the test in 6.4A.1.1.2 apply to?
question_62212.ground_truth: The test in 6.4A.1.1.2 applies to all types of NR UE release 15 and forward that supports FR2 2UL CA.

question_62213.question: What is required for handling DL UP data in a long DRX cycle in E-UTRAN?
question_62213.ground_truth: It is recommended to make use of an adapted application that can handle high latency communication and use IP/UDP instead of TCP for DL UP data in a long DRX cycle in E-UTRAN.

question_62214.question: What is the mandatory parameter of the CID that should be internationally unique?
question_62214.ground_truth: The Network IDentifier (NID) is the mandatory parameter of the CID that should be internally unique.

question_62216.question: What is the purpose of the TS 32.24X specification in the new charging principle?
question_62216.ground_truth: The TS 32.24X specification outlines the common architecture and principle for the vertical charging as an umbrella, while a set of charging specific TSs covers the 5GS domains and 5G service levels.

question_62217.question: What is the purpose of the MCData file upload request (7.5.2.1.28) and MCData file upload response (7.5.2.1.29)?
question_62217.ground_truth: The MCData file upload request is sent from the MCData client to the MCData server, requesting to upload a file. The MCData file upload response is the response sent from the MCData server to the MCData client, indicating the success or failure of the upload request.

question_62219.question: What message is sent by the AMF to indicate to the NG-RAN node that the UE context and the related PDU session contexts have been suspended in the 5GC?

question_62220.question: Which IEs are mandatory in the "PDUSessionResourceModifyIndicationIEs" in the NGAP-PROTOCOL-IES?
question_62220.ground_truth: The "id-AMF-UE-NGAP-ID" and "id-RAN-UE-NGAP-ID" IEs are mandatory, and the "id-PDUSessionResourceModifyListModInd" IE is also mandatory in the "PDUSessionResourceModifyIndicationIEs".

question_62221.question: What should the UE do to change the dialog capabilities for a given IMS communication service?
question_62221.ground_truth: The UE can change the dialog capabilities for a given IMS communication service by adding a media or requesting a supplementary service if defined for the IMS communication service as identified by the ICSI value using the same dialog. If not defined, the UE should initiate a new initial request to the other user.

question_62222.question: What is the measurement "Number of QoS flows attempted to release" and what it is used for?
question_62222.ground_truth: This measurement provides the number of QoS flows that were attempted to release. This measurement is used to keep track of the number of QoS flows that are released from the system. It is split into subcounters per QoS level and per S-NSSAI.

question_62223.question: What functions does the MCX UE perform in relation to monitoring multiple MCX Service communications?
question_62223.ground_truth: The MCX UE monitors multiple MCX Service communications, determines which group to present to the MCX user based on their choice, the priority associated with the sender, or other considerations, and maintains the identities of the other active receiving groups for display on the MCX UE.

question_62224.question: What is the required UE ACLR adj-23 for NB-CIoT UE, as determined through interpolation, for less than 5% uplink 5%-ile throughput reduction?
question_62224.ground_truth: The required UE ACLR adj-23 for NB-CIoT UE, as determined through interpolation, for less than 5% uplink 5%-ile throughput reduction is 44 dB.

question_62226.question: What action does the NEF take if the AF request for updating the AF session with required QoS is not authorized?
question_62226.ground_truth: The NEF replies to the AF with a Result value indicating that the authorization failed

question_62227.question: What is the maximum length of the information field in I frames in the defined system, if no other value is negotiated?
question_62227.ground_truth: The default maximum length of the information field in I frames is 256 octets.

question_62230.question: What kind of protocol is TCP, in terms of its handling of client and server roles?
question_62230.ground_truth: TCP is a client/server protocol, where there are different state transitioning behaviors (and procedures, called TCP OPEN) at client and server sides during the establishment phase of a TCP transport connection.

question_62231.question: What should the SMF do when a PCC rule can no longer be enforced?
question_62231.ground_truth: The SMF shall set the "ruleStatus" attribute to INACTIVE when a PCC rule was successfully installed/activated but can no longer be enforced.

question_62232.question: What is the purpose of the Sub-Protocol Discriminator in the first octet of CTS Radio Resource management and CTS Mobility Management messages?
question_62232.ground_truth: The Sub-Protocol Discriminator (SPD) in the first octet of CTS Radio Resource management and CTS Mobility Management messages is used to define the SPD and its use as per GSM~04.07.

question_62233.question: Under what conditions should a UE initiate the NR sidelink synchronization information transmission procedure for NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning?
question_62233.ground_truth: The UE should have NR sidelink communication/discovery and SLSS/PSBCH transmission capabilities, meet the conditions for NR sidelink communication/discovery/positioning operation, and meet specific frequency and synchronization reference conditions.

question_62234.question: What is the purpose of the "Triggering Optimization Function" in the self-optimization process?
question_62234.ground_truth: The "Triggering Optimization Function" is responsible for analyzing input data and determining if the system's objectives and targets have been met. If not, it triggers the optimization algorithms to make corrective decisions.

question_62235.question: What additional action does the I-SMF need to perform when a UL CL/BP is inserted?
question_62235.ground_truth: The I-SMF needs to report to the A-SMF that a UL CL/BP is inserted, and the A-SMF reports SM context information that includes the session AMBR for enforcement and the rules for traffic measurements in the ULCL/BP.

question_62236.question: What is the purpose of solution #41 in enhancing edge support services?
question_62236.ground_truth: The purpose of solution #41 is to provide edge load analytics service for an EDN to improve operations and performance of an EDN, particularly in terms of statistics or predictions on parameters related to the EAS/EES load.

question_62237.question: Which algorithm is used by the UE to generate the SUCI when performing registration for emergency services or initiating a de-registration procedure before the registration procedure for emergency services was completed successfully?
question_62237.ground_truth: The UE uses the "null-scheme" to generate the SUCI in these situations.

question_62239.question: What is the purpose of Traffic measurements in telecommunications networks?
question_62239.ground_truth: Traffic measurements provide data from which the planning and operation of the network can be carried out. They are used to evaluate traffic load on the radio or core network interfaces, usage of resources within the network nodes, and user activation and use of supplementary services.

question_62240.question: What is the output of the NWDAF analytics for anomalous NF behavior detection?
question_62240.ground_truth: The NWDAF provides requested NF anomalous information along with the corresponding root cause, such as a malicious NF trying to attack other NFs for denial of service, or an erroneous NF unable to provide service to other NFs.

question_62241.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 44.2.1.2.7a to verify in the MS?
question_62241.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the MS uses the extended back-off timer if the network rejects a request with the Extended Wait Timer.

question_62242.question: What caching algorithm is used to analyze the performance of the cache for the VOD service?
question_62242.ground_truth: The Last Recently Used (LRU) caching algorithm.

question_62244.question: What should be the format of specification filenames?
question_62244.ground_truth: Specification filenames should be of the form aabbb-xyz.eee, where aa and bbb have the same significance as in the specification number and x, y, and z have the same significance as in the version number. For multi-part specifications, the filename should be extended to aabbb-n-xyz.eee, where n is the part number.

question_62245.question: What type of dynamic profile information is maintained at the PIN server, PEMC, and PEGC for a PIN?
question_62245.ground_truth: Dynamic profile information maintained at these entities includes PIN element membership, PIN element status, PIN element capability, services provided by PIN elements, and associated PEMC IP addresses. The information is updated based on events occurring in the PIN, such as PINE joining or leaving, role of PEMC or PEGC changing, or PIN elements offering new services.

question_62246.question: What is the network expected to take into account in satellite operations to extend the maximum cell size?
question_62246.ground_truth: In satellite operations, it is expected that the network can take into account the common propagation delay to extend the maximum cell size.

question_62247.question: What is the purpose of the network-initiated dynamic policy control for offloaded traffic described in 6.3.2?
question_62247.ground_truth: The network-initiated dynamic policy control for offloaded traffic allows for policy changes to be enforced in the BBF domain based on network conditions, such as changes in the UE's location or changes in network congestion.

question_62248.question: How many orthogonal sequences are divided into for Non-Scheduled transmissions and E-DCH semi-persistent scheduling operation?
question_62248.ground_truth: The 80 orthogonal sequences are divided into 20 groups, with each group including 4 sequences of contiguous logical resource tag ID.

question_62249.question: What is the performance of N-SCH in terms of BLER at 164 dB MCL for different TU values?
question_62249.ground_truth: N-SCH achieves 10% BLER at 164 dB MCL for TU1.2nFH, corresponding to Es/No=-6.3 dB with a negative margin of only 0.5 dB. However, N-SCH coverage performance is significantly better in other legacy GSM radio propagation conditions (TU50, RA250 and HT100) compared to TU1.2noFH.

question_62250.question: What is the role of SMPTE ST 2110-40 in ancillary metadata transport?
question_62250.ground_truth: SMPTE ST 2110-40 provides a mechanism for carriage over IP of traditionally-carried SMPTE ST 291 metadata, convenient for systems where metadata is converted between IP and SDI domains. It supports all ST 291 payloads, including carriage of timing markers, DRM restrictions, and audio metadata.

question_62251.question: What is the consequence if octet 5 indicates signalling in the periodicity IE?
question_62251.ground_truth: If octet 5 indicates signalling, then octet 5 is spare in the periodicity IE.

question_62254.question: What is the purpose of the session state publication in the context of the NGCN-NGN interface?
question_62254.ground_truth: The purpose of session state publication in the context of the NGCN-NGN interface is to allow for the support of the PUBLISH method which is used to notify changes in user's registration state or availability status. This is optional for NGCN but it enables features such as user presence and instant messaging.

question_62255.question: What is the phone number of the recipient of the short message in the first example?

question_62256.question: What should the Node B include in the RADIO LINK ADDITION RESPONSE message if it uses MU-MIMO and can allocate standalone midamble resource?
question_62256.ground_truth: The Node B should include the Standalone Midamble Channel Information IE in the MU-MIMO Information Response IE in the RADIO LINK ADDITION RESPONSE message.

question_62258.question: What are some of the benefits of pre-processing sensor data on the gateway before forwarding to the cloud?
question_62258.ground_truth: Some benefits of pre-processing sensor data on the gateway before forwarding to the cloud are reducing the traffic load to the cloud, lowering uplink requirements, and decreasing the computational resources needed on the cloud.

question_62259.question: What is the data type of the "longitude" and "latitude" elements in a tPointCoordinate type?

question_62260.question: What is the purpose of the openMailbox() method in the IpMultiMediaMessagingManager interface?
question_62260.ground_truth: The openMailbox() method opens a mailbox for the application and returns the session ID and reference to the IpMailbox interface for use by the application.

question_62262.question: What message is sent by the gNB-CU to the NCR-MT during the NCR integration procedure?
question_62262.ground_truth: The gNB-CU provides the authorization information to the gNB-DU after receiving the NCR authorization information from 5GC.

question_62266.question: What happens if an access category is not provided or not recognized by the UE?
question_62266.ground_truth: The UE will use access category 3 for uplink signalling or access category 7 for uplink data instead.

question_62267.question: What is the purpose of using the ADA framework in the creation of a virtualized binaural audio system?
question_62267.ground_truth: The purpose of using the ADA framework in the creation of a virtualized binaural audio system is to drive optimal experiential performance by realistically introducing perceptual cues of height and externalization, while minimizing unnatural reverb, distortion, or timbral coloration.

question_62268.question: What is the function of the MME/AMF in supporting the MUSIM Assistance Information and procedures as specified in 5.17.4?
question_62268.ground_truth: The MME/AMF supports storing and resending MUSIM Assistance Information to the RAN (in N2/S1 messages as applicable), PF/PO calculation, and provision of MUSIM Assistance Information.

question_62270.question: What is the purpose of AR-5.2.3.2-a, AR-5.2.3.2-b, and AR-5.2.3.2-c?
question_62270.ground_truth: AR-5.2.3.2-a describes the requirement that the application layer architecture must provide mechanisms for an EEC (Edge Enabler Component) to register to the EES (Edge Enabled System). AR-5.2.3.2-b describes the requirement for mechanisms for an EEC to de-register, and AR-5.2.3.2-c describes the requirement for mechanisms to detect abnormal termination of an EEC registration.

question_62271.question: What is the requirement for the "received" header field parameter to exist in the Via header field provided by the user during the registration process for an already registered public user identity linked to the same private user identity?
question_62271.ground_truth: The "received" header field parameter must exist in the Via header field provided by the user during the registration process for an already registered public user identity linked to the same private user identity.

question_62273.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Report (TR) on UTRAN functions in Release 17?
question_62273.ground_truth: The purpose of this TR is to describe the UTRAN functions by means of signalling procedure examples (Message Sequence Charts). The signalling procedure examples show the interaction between the UE, the different UTRAN nodes and the CN to perform system functions. This gives an overall understanding of how the UTRAN works in example scenarios.

question_62274.question: What is the maximum number of UCI information bits that the UE can transmit using a PUCCH resource in the first PUCCH resource set?
question_62274.ground_truth: The maximum number of UCI information bits that the UE can transmit using a PUCCH resource in the first PUCCH resource set is 2.

question_62275.question: What is the role of the SMF in the network initiated approach of PDU Session Transfer from Source Slice to Target Slice?
question_62275.ground_truth: The SMF initiates a PDU Session transfer from a source slice to a target slice by sending a PDU Session Modification Request to the UE and extending the PDU Session Modification Request to include the needed information about the source and target slices.

question_62277.question: What is the purpose of the E2M Security Endpoint (EMSE) in Solution 10?
question_62277.ground_truth: The EMSE is an entity that is authorized to obtain e2m keys from the E2M Key Server (EMKS) and can reside in an operator's home network or a trusted third party domain. The EMKS always resides in an operator's home network. The EMSE and EMKS could be implemented stand-alone or combined with HSS or GGSN or P-GW.

question_62278.question: What is the purpose of the "P-Charging-Vector" header field in the SIP message?
question_62278.ground_truth: The "P-Charging-Vector" header field is used to identify the interconnection network and the interconnection point in the network.

question_62279.question: What should the UE do if it receives no Random Access Response within the RA Response window in a contention-free Random Access Preamble for beam failure recovery request?
question_62279.ground_truth: The UE should stop monitoring for Random Access Response(s), and transmit the preamble with the calculated PRACH transmission power for the next available PRACH occasion if all received Random Access Responses contain Random Access Preamble identifiers that do not match the transmitted Random Access Preamble.

question_62281.question: What is the impact of self-interference on the reference sensitivity requirement for BS Type 1-H in SBFD symbols?
question_62281.ground_truth: No sensitivity degradation is allowed for BS Type 1-H in SBFD symbols for the reference sensitivity requirement.

question_62282.question: What should be the basis for deciding on service delivery when different technologies can provide an offered or required service within the serving network?
question_62282.ground_truth: The decision should be based on preferences identified in the user profile and serving network capabilities and conditions.

question_62284.question: What was the power saving gain observed in FR1, DL evaluation, InH, VR30 for the enhanced PDCCH for jitter handling scheme?

question_62285.question: What are the two new identifiers that the initiating UE generates in the described procedure?
question_62285.ground_truth: The initiating UE generates a new L2 ID and a new Most Significant Bit (MSB) of the Kd session ID.

question_62286.question: What method is used by the PSS client to request a switch to new content within a single RTSP round trip?
question_62286.ground_truth: The PSS client sends a PLAY request to initiate a switch via content URL without specifying individual streams, and includes the "SDP-Requested" header to signal its intent.

question_62287.question: What should the UE do when multiplexing unicast and multicast HARQ-ACK information in the same PUCCH?
question_62287.ground_truth: The UE should append the HARQ-ACK codebooks for the multicast HARQ-ACK information to the HARQ-ACK codebooks for the unicast HARQ-ACK information.

question_62288.question: What requirement is imposed on the H(e)MS link regarding data transmitted between H(e)MS and H(e)NB?
question_62288.ground_truth: The H(e)MS link must provide integrity, confidentiality, and replay protection of the transmitted data between H(e)MS and H(e)NB.

question_62289.question: What is the role of the Edge-Enabler Client (UE) and Edge Application Server in 5G system?
question_62289.ground_truth: The Edge-Enabler Client (UE) and Edge Application Server in 5G system are responsible for enabling and managing edge-based applications.

question_62290.question: What should be the time difference between the first and last measurement used for filtering, when determining if a high chip rate TDD cell has become better ranked than the serving cell?
question_62290.ground_truth: The time difference between the first and last measurement used for filtering should be at least TmeasureTDD/2.

question_62291.question: How does a UE determine if a slice is mutually exclusive with other slices in the network?
question_62291.ground_truth: The UE derives mutually exclusive slices based on the Allowed NSSAI provided by the network and the order of priority in the Requested NSSAI. If a slice in the Requested NSSAI is not included in the Allowed NSSAI and is not explicitly rejected, the UE assumes it to be mutually exclusive with one or more slices in the Allowed NSSAI.

question_62292.question: What extra indicator is needed in addition to the broadcast indicator for support of Emergency Services over NG-RAN to indicate limited service state support for UEs in limited service state?
question_62292.ground_truth: The broadcast indicator for support of Emergency Services over NG-RAN that indicates limited service state support.

question_62294.question: What is the main goal of the test requirement specified in clause 10.5.1.1.3?
question_62294.ground_truth: The main goal of the test requirement specified in clause 10.5.1.1.3 is to ensure that the SS-RSRP measurement accuracy is within the specified limits when the serving cell is subject to CCA.

question_62295.question: What is the definition of the default QoS rule for IP type PDU Session or Ethernet type PDU Session?
question_62295.ground_truth: The default QoS rule is the only QoS rule of a PDU Session which may contain a Packet Filter Set that allows all UL packets, and in this case, the highest precedence value can be used for the QoS rule.

question_62297.question: What is the role of the SMF in the procedure for this solution?
question_62297.ground_truth: The SMF is responsible for translating the reference time from the 5G clock to an external clock, taking into account the CN delay and clock drift, before sending the translated transmission opportunities information back to the AF through the PCF/TSCTSF/NEF or directly to the TSN-AF.

question_62300.question: What two 3GPP file format profiles must an MBMS client support?
question_62300.ground_truth: The Basic profile and the Extended presentation profile of the 3GPP file format 3GPP~TS~26.244

question_62302.question: What information is sent by the AMF in the N2 Request message to the RAN about the AMF's capabilities?
question_62302.ground_truth: The AMF includes Core Network Assistance Information, such as Core Network assisted RAN parameters tuning and Core Network assisted RAN paging information, in the N2 message to the RAN.

question_62304.question: How does the registration process work for a dual-radio UE when there is coverage from both PLMN and non-public NG-RAN?
question_62304.ground_truth: A dual-radio UE can register with both PLMN and non-public networks when there is coverage from both, or it can register with each network using N3IWF access to minimize interruption time when NG-RAN access is lost for one of the networks. The registration occurs in the following order: (1) UE registers to PLMN 5GC via PLMN NG-RAN access, (2) UE establishes PDU session(s) via PLMN NG-RAN access for PLMN services, (3) UE registers to non-public 5GC via non-public NG-RAN access, (4) UE establishes PDU session(s) via non-public NG-RAN access for non-public services, (5)-(6) Optional registration to non-public/PLMN 5GC via N3IWF access.

question_62305.question: What is the purpose of version numbering in 3GPP technical specifications?
question_62305.ground_truth: The version number of a 3GPP technical specification consists of three digits, where the first digit indicates the stage of the document, the second digit is incremented for changes of substance, and the third digit is incremented when only editorial changes have been incorporated.

question_62306.question: What is the primary function of NG-RAN in mapping QoS Flows to DRBs?
question_62306.ground_truth: NG-RAN maps QoS flows to DRBs based on QFI and the associated QoS profiles

question_62307.question: What is the effect of using two beams per RRH on successful beam switch rate per CPE per second in a uni-directional scenario compared to one beam per RRH?
question_62307.ground_truth: There are clearly more beam switches with 2 beams per RRH than 1 beam per RRH, but beam ping-pongs are less common in case of 2 beams per RRH.

question_62308.question: What is the purpose of the "AF Charging Identifier" or "afChargId" parameter in Solution #1a for correlating 5GS charging related messages with edge application?
question_62308.ground_truth: The purpose of the "AF Charging Identifier" or "afChargId" parameter in Solution #1a for correlating 5GS charging related messages with edge application is to establish a relationship between the charging identifier and the edge application. However, this solution requires offline coordination between the PLMN operator and the ECSP/ASP to ensure the correctness of the correlation between this parameter and the edge application.

question_62310.question: Which performance metrics does the 3GPP management system monitor for the base station's network traffic or network slice?
question_62310.ground_truth: The 3GPP management system monitors latency, throughput, packet loss, and availability for the base station's network traffic or network slice.

question_62311.question: What is the primary condition for no scheduling restrictions due to radio link monitoring based on SSB as RLM-RS in FR1?
question_62311.ground_truth: There are no scheduling restrictions due to radio link monitoring based on SSB as RLM-RS in FR1 if the UE supports simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology.

question_62312.question: Which 3GPP document and subclause details the procedure for establishing an uplink TBF using the packet request procedure?
question_62312.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 04.18/44.018 sub-clause 3.4.22.1.1 defines the procedure for establishing an uplink TBF using the packet request procedure.

question_62314.question: What aspect of the test case 5.5.1.9 is missing or not yet determined?
question_62314.ground_truth: The test tolerances and test system uncertainties applicable to this test, as well as the message content, are missing or not yet determined for the test case 5.5.1.9.

question_62315.question: What is the meaning of Ndata1 and Ndata2 in the document?
question_62315.ground_truth: Ndata1 represents the number of data bits per downlink slot in Data1 field, while Ndata2 represents the number of data bits per downlink slot in Data2 field, which is 0 if the slot format does not contain a Data2 field.

question_62316.question: What are the two solutions recommended for addressing Key Issue #1 in TR 23.725?
question_62316.ground_truth: The two solutions are "Redundant user plane paths based on dual connectivity" and "Supporting redundant data transmission via single UPF and single RAN node".

question_62317.question: What is the frequency resolution for measurements?
question_62317.ground_truth: Measurements are made at 200 kHz intervals.

question_62319.question: What does the term "POI" stand for in the context of the present document?
question_62319.ground_truth: POI stands for Point Of Interception in the context of the present document, referring to the internal interfaces used internally within a 3GPP network for intercepting communications.

question_62321.question: What should a UE do if it is in the "5GMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE" state and fails to register successfully to the network?
question_62321.ground_truth: The UE shall initiate the Registration procedure by indicating that the registration is to receive Emergency Services and a Follow-on request is included in the Registration Request to initiate PDU Session Establishment procedure with a Request Type indicating "Emergency Request".

question_62323.question: What is the role of the 3GPP AAA server in providing the UE with the ANID in EAP signalling?
question_62323.ground_truth: The 3GPP AAA server provides the UE with the ANID in EAP signalling during the authentication process.

question_62324.question: In what mode is the UE in the scenario described, in relation to PLMN selection?
question_62324.ground_truth: The UE is in Automatic PLMN selection mode.

question_62325.question: What is the length of the Authentication Parameter CH and Authentication Parameter XRES information elements?
question_62325.ground_truth: The Authentication Parameter CH and Authentication Parameter XRES information elements are both type 3 information elements with 17 octets length.

question_62327.question: Which module contains the operations and operation arguments used for the smsSSF-gsmSCF interface?
question_62327.ground_truth: The "CAP-SMS-ops-args" module contains the operations and operation arguments used for the smsSSF-gsmSCF interface.

question_62329.question: Which transport block is multiplexed for CSI report(s) when a UE is scheduled to transmit a transport block and aperiodic CSI report(s) on PUSCH by a 'CSI request' field on a DCI?
question_62329.ground_truth: The CSI report(s) is multiplexed only on the first actual repetition for a UE that is scheduled to transmit a transport block and aperiodic CSI report(s) on PUSCH by a 'CSI request' field on a DCI.

question_62330.question: What should a UE do when it encounters a message with "syntactically incorrect mandatory IE", "unknown IEI in the message", or "out of sequence IE" that is encoded as "comprehension required"?
question_62330.ground_truth: The UE should return a status message (5GMM STATUS or 5GSM STATUS depending on the EPD) with cause #96 "invalid mandatory information".

question_62331.question: What is the function of the MGCF in the event of a forked SIP INVITE request?
