question_62331.ground_truth: The MGCF interworks with multiple early dialogues and sends two SIP UPDATE requests to the succeeding IMS node to signal within both dialogues that preconditions are met, when preconditions are fulfilled in either dialogue.

question_62332.question: Which device is the source device and which device is the destination device in the RECEIVE DATA logs?
question_62332.ground_truth: In the RECEIVE DATA logs, the ME is the source device, and the UICC is the destination device.

question_62333.question: What is the aim of Service Continuity Scenarios 1 and 2 in Centralized IMS Service Control?
question_62333.ground_truth: The aim of Service Continuity Scenarios 1 and 2 in Centralized IMS Service Control is to enable bi-directional speech call continuity between bi-directional speech media capable IP-CAN and CS access, as specified in TS~23.206.

question_62334.question: Which are the three types of Radio Access Bearers (RAB) services in the 3GPP UTRA network?
question_62334.ground_truth: The three types of Radio Access Bearers (RAB) services in the 3GPP UTRA network are Interactive or background class Radio Access Bearers (PS domain), Streaming class Radio Access Bearers (CS domain), and Conversational class Radio Access Bearers (CS domain).

question_62335.question: What is the procedure for storing class 2 messages in the SIM?
question_62335.ground_truth: The MS shall ensure that the message has been correctly transferred to the SMS data field in the SIM before sending an acknowledgement to the SC. If the short message cannot be stored in the SIM and there is other short message storage available at the MS, the MS shall return a "protocol error, unspecified" error message. If all the short message storage at the MS is already in use, the MS shall return "memory capacity exceeded".

question_62337.question: What is the process of deactivating a network slice instance?
question_62337.ground_truth: The NSMF identifies the corresponding NSSIs to be deactivated. The NSMF sends NSSI deactivation requests to the corresponding NSSMF for the NSSIs to be deactivated. The NSSMF deactivates the NSSI by deactivating all necessary constituents and notifies the NSMF after the NSSI is deactivated. Once all NSSIs are inactive, the NSMF changes the state of NSI to inactive.

question_62338.question: What is the action required when the cause of the PROSE DIRECT LINK SECURITY MODE REJECT message is #14 "Authentication synchronisation error"?
question_62338.ground_truth: Fetch a fresh GPI by sending a Key Request message including RAND and AUTS.

question_62339.question: What type is used to report location information derived from the P-Access-Network-Information or Cellular-Network-Info header of a SIP message?

question_62340.question: What information does the UE need to identify the EPS security context used for the derivation of a mapped 5G security context?
question_62340.ground_truth: The AMF includes the ngKSI to the UE in NAS SMC procedure for the UE to identify the EPS security context used for the derivation of a mapped 5G security context.

question_62341.question: What is the minimum requirement specified in sub-clause 6.4.4.2 for the purpose of conformance testing?
question_62341.ground_truth: This subclause specifies a test case that provides additional information for interpreting the minimum requirement for conformance testing.

question_62342.question: What is the method used to evaluate the L1-SINR reported values in the test procedure?
question_62342.ground_truth: The SS shall check the L1-SINR reported values of CSI-RS#0+CSI-IM#0 and CSI-RS#1+CSI-IM#1 in the periodic L1-SINR reports for the following requirements: R1 and R2.

question_62344.question: What characteristic must the beacon channels have?
question_62344.ground_truth: Beacon channels are transmitted with reference power, without beamforming, with burst type 1 or 4 when MBSFN is applied to beacon channels, with midambles m(1) and m(2) exclusively in the time slot, and with midambles m(9) and m(10) always left unused (if 16 midambles are allowed in that cell) in the time slot.

question_62345.question: What are the two major entities that cover the set of 3GPP functionalities?
question_62345.ground_truth: The two major entities are the Home Environment and the Serving Network. The Home Environment holds the functionalities that enable a user to obtain 3GPP services in a consistent manner, while the Serving Network provides the user with access to the services of the Home Environment.

question_62346.question: What action does the floor control server take when it receives a floor request message with the audio cut-in policy and floor queue disabled?
question_62346.ground_truth: The floor control server immediately grants the floor to the requesting participant and revokes the floor from the current speaker.

question_62351.question: In which scenario does the AA initiate the GBA session with the NAF after receiving the session ID token from the BA?
question_62351.ground_truth: Scenario 3 describes this approach, where the AA and BA use a local communication link to exchange the session ID token.

question_62353.question: What entity receives the trigger to set up a new AF session and provides Service Information in step 14?
question_62353.ground_truth: The AF (Access and Mobility Management Function)

question_62355.question: What is the role of the UE in UE test loop mode 3 regarding the received data?
question_62355.ground_truth: In UE test loop mode 3, the UE only counts the received data and does not loop it back to the SS.

question_62356.question: What are the two types of charging from SMF and AMF for UEs as specified in TS 32.255 and TS 32.256 respectively?
question_62356.ground_truth: The two types of charging from SMF are 5G data connectivity charging, and from AMF is 5G connection and mobility charging.

question_62357.question: What is the role of the NEF in the process described?
question_62357.ground_truth: The NEF is responsible for authorizing the network status request from the AF, storing necessary information, sending network status responses, and verifying and storing network status reports.

question_62358.question: When is a frame considered as an UNVOICED TRANSITION CLASS?
question_62358.ground_truth: The UNVOICED TRANSITION CLASS comprises unvoiced frames with a possible voiced onset at the end, where the onset is still too short or not well-built enough to use the concealment designed for voiced frames.

question_62359.question: What should the UE do with the Tsor-cm timer value for the associated PDU session or service if a new SOR-CMCI is received and the value of Tsor-cm timer in the new SOR-CMCI is smaller than the current value of the running Tsor-cm timer for the associated PDU session or service?
question_62359.ground_truth: The Tsor-cm timer value for the associated PDU session or service shall be replaced with the value in the new SOR-CMCI without stopping and restarting the timer.

question_62360.question: What is the main motivation for paging area management in Cellular IoT devices?
question_62360.ground_truth: The main motivation is that the last known cell information about a device may not be accurate, even if the device is stationary. This is due to changes in radio load conditions and neighboring conditions, such as the presence of new buildings blocking signals.

question_62361.question: What action does the terminating MCPTT client take when it does not have an available pre-established session during call setup for a pre-arranged group call?
question_62361.ground_truth: If the terminating MCPTT client does not have an available pre-established session during call setup for a pre-arranged group call, the call setup proceeds as an on-demand call setup.

question_62363.question: What is the role of the V-PCRF in the roaming scenario?
question_62363.ground_truth: In the roaming scenario, the V-PCRF provisions PCC Rules to the PCEF located in the IP edge and is responsible for policy control.

question_62364.question: What is the purpose of the CatPollInterval function?
question_62364.ground_truth: The CatPollInterval function issues the proactive command POLL INTERVAL that requests the ME to set a time interval between status APDU that the ME sends to the UICC.

question_62368.question: What does a 5QI value between 65 and 67 represent?
question_62368.ground_truth: A 5QI value between 65 and 67 represents guaranteed bit rate QoS flows.

question_62369.question: What is the purpose of the SAID in a GPL-SA?
question_62369.ground_truth: The SAID in a GPL-SA helps identify the GPL-SAs within a Push-NAF or a UE. It is used for replay protection, indexing of GPL-SA's, and identifying uplink/downlink GPL-SA.

question_62370.question: What should the IBCF do when it receives a SIP request as an exit or an entry point and the SIP request contains a "logme" header field parameter in the SIP Session-ID header field?
question_62370.ground_truth: The IBCF shall log all SIP requests and responses that contain a "logme" header field parameter in the SIP Session-ID header field if required by local policy.

question_62371.question: What type of access does not support eCall Over IMS for emergency calls?
question_62371.ground_truth: Non-3GPP access and NR via SNPN do not support eCall Over IMS for emergency calls.

question_62372.question: Which network-triggered leaving options are available for multi-USIM devices, and what are their impacts on EUTRA, NR, and S1/NG systems?
question_62372.ground_truth: NAS-triggered leaving (UE-requested Leave and Resumption via NAS signaling) and RRC-triggered leaving (UE-requested Leave and Resumption via RRC signaling) are the two options available. RRC-triggered leaving impacts EUTRA/NR, while NAS-triggered leaving impacts S1/NG. RRC-triggered leaving allows for fast resumption, while NAS-triggered leaving requires CN-triggered NG/S1 release or update procedure for resumption.

question_62374.question: What are the requirements for the accuracy of NR SS-RSRP measurements in FR1 for DC Idle Mode Measurements?
question_62374.ground_truth: The accuracy requirements of NR SS-RSRP measurements in FR1 for DC Idle Mode Measurements are the same as the Inter-frequency RSRP accuracy requirements for FR1 CA/DC Idle Mode Measurements in TS 38.133 subclause 10.1.4B.

question_62376.question: In FR2, DL only evaluation, DU, VR/AR45 and low load, what is the mean power saving gain provided by the R17 PDCCH monitoring adaptation scheme?
question_62376.ground_truth: The mean power saving gain provided by the R17 PDCCH monitoring adaptation scheme in FR2, DL only evaluation, DU, VR/AR45 and low load is 28.25%.

question_62378.question: What is the purpose of the network element identifier (NEID) in the network identifier (NID)?
question_62378.ground_truth: The NEID is used to uniquely identify the network element carrying out LI operations.

question_62379.question: What is the role of the reference power transfer function (Pref,n) in the calculation of TRS?
question_62379.ground_truth: The reference power transfer function (Pref,n) is used as a normalization factor for the calculation of TRS. It is used to account for the reference power received by the fixed measurement antenna.

question_62380.question: When should an Access Server (AS) translate a received number to a globally routeable SIP URI or an international tel URI?
question_62380.ground_truth: The AS should translate the received number to a globally routeable SIP URI or an international tel URI if the home network supports the roaming architecture for voice over IMS with local breakout, or if it determines that the received geo-local number corresponds to a home local service number that can be used by a roaming user, or if it is used to access a service in the visited network, or if it is used to access the local addressing plan of the visited network.

question_62381.question: What should the MCPTT client do if a Resource-Priority header field is included in the incoming SIP re-INVITE request?
question_62381.ground_truth: The MCPTT client may check the Resource-Priority header field and perform further actions outside the scope of this specification to act upon the included Resource-Priority header field.

question_62382.question: What is the unicast mode A2X Direct Communication used for in 3GPP system?
question_62382.ground_truth: The unicast mode A2X Direct Communication is used by two UEs that directly exchange traffic for the A2X applications running between the peer UEs. The PC5 unicast signalling supports confidentiality protection, integrity protection and anti-replay protection.

question_62383.question: What should the AMF do if the UE can use SMS over NAS and the SMSF selection is successful?
question_62383.ground_truth: The AMF should send the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message after the SMSF has confirmed that the activation of the SMS service was successful.

question_62384.question: What are the two parts of the IWF and what do they do?
question_62384.ground_truth: The two parts of the IWF are an interface to the relevant MC server, and an interface to the LMR system. The first part, IWF-1, IWF-2, and IWF-3, are based on a subset of reference points from TS~23.379 and TS~23.282, and are responsible for communication between the IWF and the MC server. The second part is responsible for the interface between the IWF and the LMR system, and provides a generic architecture to interwork between different LMR systems such as TETRA, P25 and DMR.

question_62385.question: What steps does NRF take to verify the service request from the NF Service Consumer?
question_62385.ground_truth: NRF verifies the authenticity of the NF Service Consumer using CCA, checks the service request by verifying the hash of the service request and the protected HL headers, and ensures the headers are not modified.

question_62387.question: What is the main added cost of SAV to the network operator?
question_62387.ground_truth: The main added cost of SAV to the network operator is the cost of the PVE.

question_62389.question: What is the requirement for SCell activation delay in the 3GPP TS 36.133 standard for successful SCell activation?
question_62389.ground_truth: The UE shall send the first CSI report for SCell at latest 9ms into T2 for a correct SCell activation delay.

question_62390.question: Which IEs are optional in UEContextSuspendResponseIEs?
question_62390.ground_truth: The id-Extended-ConnectedTime, id-CriticalityDiagnostics, and id-PDUSessionResourceResumeListRESRes are optional IEs in UEContextSuspendResponseIEs.

question_62392.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the request-URI when generating a SIP MESSAGE request to report the MBMS bearer listening status?
question_62392.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include the MBMS public service identity of the participating MCVideo function in the Request-URI.

question_62393.question: What action must the CBCF take when it receives a Stop Emergency Broadcast Request from CBE?
question_62393.ground_truth: The CBCF shall authenticate this request, identify which AMFs need to be contacted, and determine the information to be placed into the Warning Area Information Element. It then sends a Stop Warning Request NG-RAN message to AMFs.

question_62394.question: What information is sent by the new MME in the Context Request message to the old MME/S4 SGSN to retrieve the user information?
question_62394.ground_truth: The new MME sends a Context Request (old GUTI, MME Address, UE Validated, complete TAU Request message, P-TMSI Signature, CIoT EPS Optimisation support indication) message to the old MME/S4 SGSN.

question_62396.question: What is the role of the MAA in communicating with the MBMS client?
question_62396.ground_truth: The MAA initiates the communication with the MBMS client using the MBMS-API, and the MBMS client provides the delivered user data to the MAA.

question_62399.question: What is the minimum number of (error) events required for an early fail decision in this test?
question_62399.ground_truth: At least 7 (error) events are necessary for an early fail decision.

question_62400.question: How many bits are used for the code resource related information in the E-AGCH type 2?

question_62401.question: What are the two functions of the Base Station System (BSS) in the 3GPP system?
question_62401.ground_truth: The Base Station System (BSS) is responsible for communicating with mobile stations in a certain area and may consist of one or more base stations, each supporting one or more cells. The radio equipment for BSS is described in the 45-series, 48-series and 25-series of 3GPP specifications.

question_62402.question: What is the target for speech with low one-way service latency in the 3GPP system?
question_62402.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall support speech with very low one-way service latency of 10 ms.

question_62404.question: What message does the MS send if it requests additional assistance data that is not available in the SS?
question_62404.ground_truth: The SS sends the second RRLP Measure Position Request message without assistance data.

question_62405.question: What procedure does the MSC-A server use to request MGW-A to release the resources when a procedure between the MSC-A server and the MGW fails?

question_62407.question: What is the required input signal level in dBm for the GSM 850 and E-GSM 900 Wide Area multicarrier BTS equipped with multicarrier receiver for static propagation conditions in the multicarrier RF test?
question_62407.ground_truth: The required input signal level in dBm for the GSM 850 and E-GSM 900 Wide Area multicarrier BTS equipped with multicarrier receiver for static propagation conditions in the multicarrier RF test is -16 dBm.

question_62408.question: What does the UE do when it receives a CP-DATA containing an RP-ACK RPDU encapsulated in a Downlink NAS transport message when sending SMS over NAS in 5GMM-Idle mode?
question_62408.ground_truth: The UE sends a CP-ACK encapsulated in an Uplink NAS Transport message.

question_62409.question: What part of the TFCP solution has an impact on both UE and UPF, increasing the packet size transported by TFCP?
question_62409.ground_truth: The TFCP Tunnel Info has an impact on the packet size transported by TFCP in the TFCP part of the solution.

question_62410.question: What should the UPF do after receiving a N4 session establishment request for the same PDU session in step 10.1?
question_62410.ground_truth: The UPF should establish a new N4 session for the same PDU session based on the parameters received in step 8 and step 9, if applicable.

question_62412.question: What message is received when an MCPTT broadcast group call is established, and what is the response of the terminating MCPTT user?
question_62412.ground_truth: When an MCPTT broadcast group call is established, the terminating MCPTT user receives an RTP media packet. In response, the terminating MCPTT user sets the stored SSRC of the current floor arbitrator to the SSRC of the RTP media packet, restarts (or starts, if not running already) timer T203 (End of RTP media), requests the MCPTT client to start rendering received RTP media packets, and enters the 'O: has no permission' state.

question_62413.question: What does the SS do with the GSM CARRIER RSSI values reported in the first measurement report?
question_62413.ground_truth: The SS discards the GSM CARRIER RSSI values reported in the first measurement report.

question_62414.question: What should the UE do if it has no selected SyncRef UE and the UE is not directly synchronized to GNSS for NR sidelink communication?
question_62414.ground_truth: The UE should transmit NR sidelink communication and if the conditions for NR sidelink communication operation are met, transmit sidelink SSB on the frequency used for NR sidelink communication.

question_62416.question: What is the role of the IRPManager in relation to vendor-specific extensions?
question_62416.ground_truth: The IRPManager is not required to have knowledge of vendor-specific extensions, but it may need to be implemented with an awareness that extensions can exist and behave accordingly.

question_62420.question: What should the PGW do if it initiates the PDN GW Initiated Resource Allocation Deactivation procedure as part of the P-CSCF restoration procedure over WLAN access?
question_62420.ground_truth: The PGW shall include the 3GPP Specific PMIPv6 error code IE and set it to the cause "Reactivation requested".

question_62421.question: What action does the RNC take to remove relevant information related to an MBMS service on the MCCH when it receives a RANAP MBMS Session Stop message from the CN?
question_62421.ground_truth: The RNC sends a RANAP MBMS Session Stop Response message back to the SGSN and removes relevant information related to the MBMS service on the MCCH.

question_62422.question: What is the function of the method pulse() in this framework?
question_62422.ground_truth: The framework uses the method pulse() to send its heartbeat to the client application or the client application uses this method to send its heartbeat to the framework, depending on which interface it implements. The application will be expecting a pulse at the end of every interval specified in the parameter to the IpHeartBeatMgmt.enableHeartbeat() method or IpAppHeartBeatMgmt.enableAppHeartbeat() method. If the pulse() is not received within the specified interval, then the framework or client application can be deemed to have failed the heartbeat.

question_62424.question: What is the purpose of the authentication mechanism between the MS and the SGW in the Up interface security?
question_62424.ground_truth: The purpose of the authentication mechanism between the MS and the SGW in the Up interface security is to establish IPSec security associations using IKEv2 and public key signature-based authentication with certificates. This is to ensure mutual authentication, encryption, and data integrity for the signalling and user-plane traffic sent between the MS and the SGW over the Up interface.

question_62425.question: What services does the PDCP layer provide to upper layers (RRM or SDAP)?
question_62425.ground_truth: The PDCP layer provides services such as transfer of user plane and control plane data, header compression, uplink data compression, ciphering, and integrity protection to the RRC or SDAP layers.

question_62426.question: How can an AIPN contribute to reducing CAPEX and OPEX costs for future mobile networks?
question_62426.ground_truth: An AIPN enables the use of general-purpose IP technology, tailored to mobile services, resulting in improvements in system efficiency and significant reductions in equipment and operational costs.

question_62427.question: What is the purpose of step 6.3B.4.2.4.2 in the test procedure?
question_62427.ground_truth: The purpose of step 6.3B.4.2.4.2 in the test procedure is to perform the test with the set initial conditions and measure the output power of the transmitted NPRACH preamble.

question_62429.question: Which option provides guaranteed delivery of downlink messages to the UE and can determine if data was successfully delivered to the SCEF?
question_62429.ground_truth: Option 1 in Alternative 5a provides guaranteed delivery of downlink messages to the UE and can determine if data was successfully delivered to the SCEF.

question_62430.question: What is the condition for activating the UE beamlock function in step (b)?
question_62430.ground_truth: The UE beamlock function is activated in step (b) after deactivating the UE Beamlock Function (UBF) by performing the procedure as specified in TS 38.508-1 clause 4.9.3.

question_62431.question: What is the effect of the Registration Restrictions mechanism on the 5G-RG's registration request?
question_62431.ground_truth: When the 5G-RG is located in the WWC Non-Allowed Area of the Registration Restriction which is received from the network, it does not initiate Registration Request, Service Request, and PDU Session Management Procedure.

question_62434.question: What is the name of the 3GPP TS that provides the functionalities of scene description, text, bitmap graphics, still images, HTML5, and presentation description in 3GPP PSS?

question_62435.question: In what scenario would the AMF select non-3GPP access over 3GPP access for sending the DL NAS TRANSPORT message?
question_62435.ground_truth: The AMF would select non-3GPP access if the UE is registered to the network via both 3GPP access and non-3GPP access, SMS over NAS is allowed, the UE is in MICO mode, the UE is in 5GMM-IDLE mode for 3GPP access and in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode for non-3GPP access, and the delivery of the DL NAS TRANSPORT message over 3GPP access has failed.

question_62436.question: What does the RAB Establishment Success Rate KPI evaluate in the UTRAN network?
question_62436.ground_truth: This KPI is used to evaluate service accessibility across UTRAN in the UTRAN+PS core network.

question_62437.question: What is the recommended length for the External-Identifier value?
question_62437.ground_truth: The recommended length for the External-Identifier value is 253 octets.

question_62438.question: What is the time duration of T5 in 7.3.22.4.1?
question_62438.ground_truth: The time duration of T5 in 7.3.22.4.1 is 420 ms.

question_62439.question: What does the PTT1/PTT1c reference point represent in the MCPTT application server?
question_62439.ground_truth: PTT1/PTT1c represents the control plane signalling needed for establishing MCPTT sessions, supporting service registration, and similar control-related functionality.

question_62441.question: What must the UE do after receiving a PDU session reactivation result error cause IE with a 5GMM cause set to #69 "insufficient resources for specific slice"?
question_62441.ground_truth: The UE can start a back-off timer, and upon expiry of the back-off timer, the UE can re-send a request for user-plane re-establishment for the associated PDU session.

question_62442.question: What is the significance of "network context" in the analytics provided by the MDA MnS producer?
question_62442.ground_truth: Network context, reflecting network status at the time of enabling data collection, is important for the MDA MnS consumer to understand the network conditions related to the obtained analytics and hence be able to use such analytics more efficiently.

question_62443.question: What IOC is provided for sub-classing only and all information object classes defined in TS that support the Federated Network Information Model (FNIM) concept shall inherit from it?

question_62444.question: What is the mean DL Average-UPT gain for semi-static SBFD at high load level with a small packet size, SBFD Alt 4, and 40dBm BS transmission power?

question_62445.question: What is the role of the Local EPC in IOPS mode?
question_62445.ground_truth: The Local EPC is an entity which provides functionality that eNBs in IOPS mode of operation use, instead of the Macro EPC, in order to support public safety services.

question_62446.question: What is the purpose of the BSSAP-LE extension in 3GPP?
question_62446.ground_truth: The BSSAP-LE extension in 3GPP is used to support location services on interfaces based on the use of BSSAP.

question_62447.question: What type of filter is recommended to be used in the measurement of power in 5.9.4.2?
question_62447.ground_truth: A filter with approximately Gaussian characteristic (typical spectrum analyzer filter).

question_62448.question: What is the use of Packet Switched (PS) handover in a GPRS network?
question_62448.ground_truth: Packet Switched (PS) handover is introduced to support real-time packet-switched service with strict QoS requirements on low latency and packet loss. PS handover reduces the service interruption of the user plane information at cell change compared to the cell-reselection and enables methods to improve buffer handling of user plane data in order to reduce packet loss at cell-change. It is the handover between GERAN PS and UTRAN PS.

question_62449.question: What is the role of the IWF in the group regroup procedures detailed in 3GPP TS 23.280?
question_62449.ground_truth: The IWF behaves as a peer MC service server with a peer group management client and peer group management server in the group regroup procedures detailed in 3GPP TS 23.280.

question_62452.question: What happens to the Mutually Exclusive Access Slicing Group when the UE attaches to the Rel-16 UE that is not capable of supporting Mutually Exclusive Slicing Access?
question_62452.ground_truth: UE will be provided with S-NSSAI(s) that can serve the UE simultaneously, no impact to Rel-15 UE.

question_62453.question: What is the format of the XID information field and what does it contain?
question_62453.ground_truth: The XID information field consists of type and length fields, where the type field occupies bits 8 to 5 and the length field occupies bits 4 to 1. The least significant bit is always transmitted first. The information field contains the value of the parameter being negotiated, where the length-indicator gives the number of octets that the value occupies.

question_62455.question: In which step does the UE send an RRC Location Measurement Indication message to the serving gNB to request measurement gaps for performing location measurements or timing acquisition procedures, if required?
question_62455.ground_truth: In step 1 of Location Measurement Indication procedure (7.4.1.1)

question_62457.question: In what mode can a GPRS MS perform a PLMN selection if an RR connection exists and it is in operation mode A?
question_62457.ground_truth: A GPRS MS operating in MS operation mode A and has an RR connection can only perform a PLMN selection when the RR connection is subsequently released.

question_62458.question: How does the MSGin5G Client on the MSGin5G UE allocate a specified MAC address or UDP port for exchanging information between the MSGin5G Client on the MSGin5G UE and the Application Client on the non-MSGin5G UE?
question_62458.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Client on the MSGin5G UE allocates a specified MAC address or UDP port for exchanging information between the MSGin5G Client on the MSGin5G UE and the Application Client on the non-MSGin5G UE based on the connection mode, e.g. L2 or L3 connection. The transport mechanism is based on the legacy transport protocol.

question_62461.question: What event triggers a cell update procedure in a GPRS network?
question_62461.ground_truth: A cell update procedure is triggered when a MS enters a new cell inside the current RA and the MS is in READY state.

question_62463.question: What should the UE do if new UE policies for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE are included in the MANAGE UE POLICY COMMAND message?
question_62463.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T5053 (if running) and start using the new UE policies for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE included in the MANAGE UE POLICY COMMAND message. If the security related parameters for discovery are included in the new UE policies for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE, the UE should also start timer T5055 with the value included in the security related parameters for discovery.

question_62465.question: Which message is sent by the gNB-CU-UP to indicate that the setup of MBS session resources for a multicast MBS session was unsuccessful in the 9.2.5.2.3 message?

question_62467.question: What is the procedure for the UE to establish one or more additional PDN connections as defined in clause 5.5.2.7 for UE-Initiated Connectivity to Additional PDN with DSMIPv6 on S2c over trusted BBF access?
question_62467.ground_truth: The UE repeats the procedure steps 6-12 in clause 5.5.2.1 for each additional PDN the UE wants to connect to.

question_62468.question: What is the function of the SIP database in the partner MC system when it receives a get SIP authentication information request?
question_62468.ground_truth: The SIP database in the partner MC system recognizes the inbound migration SIP private user identity and determines the identifier of the MC service user's SIP database in the primary MC system, the primary MC system's SIP private user identity, and the primary MC system's SIP public user identity.

question_62469.question: What are the conditions under which Private Calls with Floor control can be set up?
question_62469.ground_truth: Private Calls with Floor control can be set up based on Call Commencement Modes, which are determined by the MCPTT Service.

question_62471.question: Which GSM standard provides the ANSI-C code for the GSM half rate speech codec?

question_62474.question: What are the two available capacity cases for evaluating MBMS capacity for voice group communications?
question_62474.ground_truth: The two available capacity cases are 3.13 b/s/Hz and MCS = 64QAM (4/5) = > 1502 kbps available in MBMS per 1 MHz of spectrum, and 0.99 b/s/Hz and MCS = 16QAM (1/3) = > 198 kbps available in MBMS per 1 MHz of spectrum.

question_62475.question: How many failures are allowed for the frequency band 486 MHz to 502 MHz?
question_62475.ground_truth: A maximum of three failures are allowed for the frequency band 486 MHz to 502 MHz.

question_62476.question: What action does the H-PCRF take when it decides to terminate a specific S9 session?
question_62476.ground_truth: The H-PCRF sends an RAR command to the V-PCRF indicating the termination of the S9 session and includes the Session-Release-Cause AVP at the command level.

question_62477.question: In step 5, what should the S-CSCF do if the initial request did not match any unexecuted initial filter criteria?
question_62477.ground_truth: If the initial request did not match any unexecuted initial filter criteria, the S-CSCF should remove the transit-ioi header field parameter from the P-Charging-Vector header field, insert a type 2 orig-ioi header field parameter into the P-Charging-Vector header field, and remove the Relayed-Charge header field, if present.

question_62479.question: During intra-MSC-B handover execution, what should the MSC-B do with appropriate messages towards the MS, while the MS is not in communication with the Core Network?
question_62479.ground_truth: While the MS is not in communication with the Core Network during the intra-MSC-B handover execution, the MSC-B should queue all appropriate messages towards the MS, delivering them once communication is resumed.

question_62481.question: What should the NAS do when the UE indicates pending user data for one or more PDU sessions when it builds a REGISTRATION REQUEST or SERVICE REQUEST message for the access attempt?
question_62481.ground_truth: The NAS shall indicate the respective PDU sessions in the Uplink data status IE as specified in subclause~5.5.1.3.2 and 5.6.1.2, regardless of the access category for which the access barring check is performed.

question_62482.question: What is used to identify the requester of the notification information when the received presence reporting area identifier corresponds to the PRA set id?

question_62483.question: What action does the SMF take if the UE provides an "MA PDU Request" indication and the AMF determines that the UE is registered via both accesses in different PLMN but the current S-NSSAI is not in the Allowed NSSAI for both accesses?
question_62483.ground_truth: The AMF rejects the PDU session modification if the UE provides an "MA PDU Request" indication.

question_62484.question: What are the definitions of DL and UL transmission bursts in the context of LAA?
question_62484.ground_truth: Each DL transmission burst is a continuous transmission from a DL transmitting node with no transmission immediately before or after from the same node on the same CC, and each UL transmission burst from a UE perspective is a continuous transmission from a UE with no transmission immediately before or after from the same UE on the same CC.

question_62485.question: What is the pre-condition for using ADAES (TR 23.700-36) in solution #41?
question_62485.ground_truth: The pre-condition for using ADAES (TR 23.700-36) in solution #41 is that SEAL ADAES services are available at the edge data network and accessible to the EES.

question_62486.question: What techniques does NR-U need to consider for mobility-related measurements, regarding limitations to the transmission of reference signals due to LBT?
question_62486.ground_truth: NR-U needs to consider techniques to handle reduced RS (e.g. SS/PBCH block and CSI-RS) transmission opportunities due to LBT failure.

question_62488.question: What action does the S-EES take after receiving the ACR initiation data from the EEC for ACR launching procedure?
question_62488.ground_truth: The S-EES authorizes the request from the EEC, decides to execute ACR based on the received information, and sends the ACR management notification for the "ACT start" event to the S-EAS to initiate ACT between the S-EAS and the CAS.

question_62490.question: What does the MBMS GW do after storing the session attributes and the list of MBMS control plane nodes in the MBMS bearer context?
question_62490.ground_truth: The MBMS GW sends a Session Start Request message including the session attributes to MMEs and/or SGSNs listed in the "list of MBMS control plane nodes" parameter after filtering the list using the Access indicator.

question_62492.question: What is the requirement for LTE BS transmitter in terms of allowed connector to connector coupling loss to the receiver of the limited services terminal and why is no additional requirement defined in 3GPP specification?
question_62492.ground_truth: The required connector to connector coupling loss is 98 dB. It is not defined in the 3GPP specification because there is no regulatory requirement on unwanted emission for LTE BS coexistence with the limited service.

question_62493.question: What information is included in a Binding Indication when it is part of a service request?
question_62493.ground_truth: A Binding Indication in a service request includes a 3gpp-Sbi-Binding header with parameters indicating a preferred binding level (to a NF Service Instance, NF Service Set, NF Instance, or NF set), and at least one of the NF Service Instance, NF Service Set, NF Instance, or NF Set IDs. It may also include the scope and service name parameters, indicating the service(s) for which the binding information applies.

question_62495.question: What is the expected response time for the 1.8V only ME to deactivate the SIM/ME interface and reject the SIM after receiving the status information from the SIM?
question_62495.ground_truth: The 1.8V only ME should deactivate the SIM/ME interface and reject the SIM within 5 seconds after receiving the status information from the SIM.

question_62496.question: What is the main idea behind the Grant Detection proposal for TDM scheduling?
question_62496.ground_truth: The Grant Detection proposal suggests that when a transmission occurs, all other TDM UEs who receive an E-AGCH transmission which is not intended for them should automatically set their Serving Grants to zero.

question_62497.question: What does the acronym SLS stand for in the context of 3GPP Technical Specification?

question_62499.question: What protocol is used to provide reliable transport for both the GA-RC and GA-CSR signalling between the MS and GANC in the CS Domain control plane architecture?
question_62499.ground_truth: A single TCP connection is used to provide reliable transport for both the GA-RC and GA-CSR signalling between the MS and GANC in the CS Domain control plane architecture.

question_62500.question: What is the minimum time requirement for the UE to transmit the PRACH to cell 2 for the test to pass?
question_62500.ground_truth: The UE shall start to transmit the PRACH to Cell 2 less than 85ms from the beginning of time period T3.

question_62502.question: When should the MS include the extended DRX parameters IE in the ROUTING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message?
question_62502.ground_truth: If the MS supports eDRX and requests the use of eDRX, it should include the extended DRX parameters IE in the ROUTING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

question_62503.question: What is the test purpose described in section 6.6.3.3, in relation to occupied bandwidth?
question_62503.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify that the emission of the base station does not occupy an excessive bandwidth for the service to be provided and is, therefore, not likely to create interference to other users of the spectrum beyond undue limits.

question_62504.question: What is the main function of the AMF in relation to paging collisions between USIMs?
question_62504.ground_truth: The AMF is responsible for detecting the indication from the UE in the Registration Request message and returning a new 5G-GUTI in the Registration Accept message to the UE.

question_62505.question: What interface class is inherited from IpService and provides functions to send information to or gather information from the user?

question_62506.question: What type of information does an S-Trace provide?
question_62506.ground_truth: An S-Trace provides sufficient information to the content delivery module to create IP packets.

question_62508.question: What actions does the floor control server take when switching from a controlling MCPTT function mode to a non-controlling MCPTT function mode?
question_62508.ground_truth: The floor control server prepares for acting as a non-controlling MCPTT function by releasing the instant used for general floor control operation and generating a random temporary identifier for each MCPTT client. It also stores associations, capabilities, and initiates the 'floor participant interface state transition' state machine.

question_62510.question: What is the procedure code for the "informationReporting" procedure?

question_62512.question: What is the maximum number of patterns that the UE shall use to attempt to decode the unknown BSIC of the GSM cell in the initial BSIC identification procedure for a UE requiring compressed mode?
question_62512.ground_truth: The maximum number of patterns that the UE shall use to attempt to decode the unknown BSIC of the GSM cell in the initial BSIC identification procedure for a UE requiring compressed mode is indicated by Nidentify abort, which is signaled to the UE together with the transmission gap pattern sequence.

question_62513.question: What must the UE do before initiating the measurement reporting procedure?
question_62513.ground_truth: The UE must complete a successful security activation before initiating the measurement reporting procedure.

question_62514.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification in the present document?
question_62514.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification in the present document outlines the Performance Management procedures for mobile networks that include virtualized network functions (VNF).

question_62515.question: What is the measurement "RLM.SuccRLDelIub" representing in the context of UTRAN cells?
question_62515.ground_truth: The measurement "RLM.SuccRLDelIub" represents the number of successful radio link deletions on Iub for each UTRAN cell in FDD and TDD modes.

question_62516.question: What type of signal quality information is used in the solution for UE-to-UE Relay reselection for the selection of the new UE-to-UE Relay?
question_62516.ground_truth: The solution for UE-to-UE Relay reselection does not specify the type of signal quality information used. It only notes that signal quality information needs to be coordinated with RAN WG for candidate UE-to-UE Relay selection.

question_62517.question: What should the IWF performing the participating role do when it receives a SIP INVITE request containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body with the <mcpttinfo> element containing the <mcptt-Params> element with the <emergency-ind> element set to a value of "true"?
question_62517.ground_truth: The IWF shall set the MCPTT emergency group state to "MEG 2: in-progress", set the MCPTT imminent peril group state to "MIG 1: no-imminent-peril", and set the MCPTT imminent peril group call state to "MIGC 1: imminent-peril-gc-capable".

question_62518.question: In what scenario is EAS rediscovery triggered by AF not covered?
question_62518.ground_truth: EAS rediscovery triggered by AF is not covered in scenario 1a.

question_62519.question: What is the method of test for the spurious emissions test in a BS receiver, and what is the default measurement procedure for this test?
question_62519.ground_truth: The method of test for the spurious emissions test in a BS receiver is specified in clause 7.7.4. The default measurement procedure involves connecting a measurement receiver to the BS antenna connector, enabling the BS receiver, terminating the BS Tx antenna connector, setting the detection mode to True RMS, and averaging the emission power over an appropriate time duration.

question_62520.question: What network element in a 3GPP network supports the Indirect and Hybrid models of MTC by terminating the Tsp, T4, and S6m reference points, and is responsible for hiding the internal PLMN topology and relaying or translating signalling protocols used over Tsp?

question_62523.question: What is the meaning of MC (Mission Critical) in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_62523.ground_truth: MC is a generic name for any one of the three mission critical services: MCPTT, MCVideo, or MCData.

question_62524.question: What is the principle when transporting DTMF information in the core network to minimize interworking between out of band and in band DTMF signalling?
question_62524.ground_truth: The general principle is to use the DTMF signalling method of the preceding node whenever possible. A node supporting out of band DTMF signalling shall also be able to receive inband DTMF digits, but no DTMF digit shall be duplicated.

question_62525.question: What information should be included in each LCI by the LC-H feature supporting NF?
question_62525.ground_truth: Each LCI should include the Timestamp, Load Metric, and Scope parameters, as well as the S-NSSAI/DNN relative capacity when applying S-NSSAI/DNN based load control.

question_62526.question: Which DNS queries are performed by the PSA in the Server Discovery procedure?
question_62526.ground_truth: The PSA performs PTR, SRV, A/AAAA DNS queries to retrieve the necessary information for the PSA to route the UE packets to the EAS.

question_62528.question: What is the function of the border function in the AEP?
question_62528.ground_truth: The border function in the AEP hides and un-hides the identities carried by the SIP signalling from and to the underlying IMS/SIP core.

question_62529.question: What should the UE consider as the sorting quantity when reportQuantities is set to rsrq?
question_62529.ground_truth: The UE should consider RSRQ as the sorting quantity when reportQuantities is set to rsrq.

question_62531.question: What is the measurement "In-session activity time for QoS flow"?
question_62531.ground_truth: This measurement provides the aggregated active session time for a QoS flow in a cell. The measurement is split into subcounters per QoS level and is defined for QoS flows with bursty flow and continuous flow. In case of bursty flow this is said to be "in session" for a UE if there is user data in the PDCP queue in any of the directions or if any QoS flow data (UL or DL) has been transferred during the last 100 ms for that 5QI. In case of continuous flow this is seen as being "in session" as long as the UE is in RRC connected state, and the session time is increased from the first data transmission on the QoS flow until 100 ms after the last data transmission on the QoS flow.

question_62532.question: Which specification imports relevant definitions to the SOAP solution set for the Trace Management IRP?
question_62532.ground_truth: The 3GPP TS 32.445 specification imports relevant definitions to the SOAP solution set for the Trace Management IRP.

question_62533.question: What shall the AS send to the calling user when it rejects a communication due to barred anonymity?
question_62533.ground_truth: The AS shall send a 433 (Anonymity Disallowed) response to the calling user.

question_62534.question: What should the MCVideo client do when it wants to leave the ongoing group session?
question_62534.ground_truth: The MCVideo client shall follow the procedures as specified in clause~6.2.4.1 to leave the MCVideo session that has been established using an on-demand session.

question_62536.question: What is the maximum channel bandwidth for SL operation in licensed band for NR V2X operation?
question_62536.ground_truth: The maximum channel bandwidth for SL operation in licensed band for NR V2X operation is 40 MHz.

question_62537.question: In the context of 3.2.2.91 Talker Identity, what does the Bits 4 to 8 in octets 4 etc. represent?
question_62537.ground_truth: Bits 4 to 8 are spare in octets 4 etc.

question_62538.question: What is the definition of the "Edge Application Server" and the "Edge Hosting Environment" as given in the document?
question_62538.ground_truth: An "Edge Application Server" is an Application Server resident in the "Edge Hosting Environment", and the "Edge Hosting Environment" is an environment that provides support required for the execution of the Edge Application Server.

question_62539.question: How does the UE handle feared events in the described positioning system?
question_62539.ground_truth: The UE is responsible for monitoring localized feared events, such as multipath, cycle slips, and satellite issues, to ensure they are detected and mitigated within the required Time To Alarm (TTA).

question_62541.question: How many octets of the AC field are included in the Truncated Enhanced BFR MAC CE if there are no octets containing the AC field for SpCell?
question_62541.ground_truth: For the Truncated Enhanced BFR MAC CE, one octet containing the AC field is included for SCell(s) and then the second octet containing the AC field, if any, is included for SCell(s) while not exceeding the available grant size. The number of the octets containing the AC field can be zero if there are no octets containing the AC field for SpCell.

question_62542.question: What should the UE do regarding event triggered measurement reports during repeated tests?
question_62542.ground_truth: The UE should send Event B1 triggered measurement reports for cells 2, 3, and 4, with a measurement reporting delay less than 21.95s (cell 2) and 204.8s (cell 3 and 4) from the beginning of time period T2. The UE should not send event triggered measurement reports as long as the reporting criteria are not fulfilled.

question_62543.question: What is the criticality of id-TransmittedCarrierPowerOfAllCodesNotUsedForHSTransmission in NBAP-PROTOCOL-IES?
question_62543.ground_truth: The criticality of id-TransmittedCarrierPowerOfAllCodesNotUsedForHSTransmission in NBAP-PROTOCOL-IES is reject.

question_62544.question: What is the purpose of the Media Service Enabler in the 5G System architecture?
question_62544.ground_truth: The Media Service Enabler (MSE) in the 5G System architecture provides a set of 3GPP-specified functions to simplify operations for the Application Provider.

question_62545.question: What is the method used to control heavy users' data consumption in Use Case 2?
question_62545.ground_truth: The method used to control heavy users' data consumption in Use Case 2 is reducing their data rate if their data usage exceeds a volume threshold and only when RAN user plane congestion occurs.

question_62546.question: What is the condition that must be met for the minimum performance requirement for CQI reporting under AWGN conditions in FDD and half-duplex FDD?
question_62546.ground_truth: The condition that must be met for the minimum performance requirement for CQI reporting under AWGN conditions in FDD and half-duplex FDD is that the UE must support at least 4 downlink DL-SCH component carriers and 1 receive antenna.

question_62547.question: What does the IPDL TDD Parameters IE provide information about in the context of 3.84Mcps TDD or 7.68Mcps TDD?
question_62547.ground_truth: The IPDL TDD Parameters IE provides information about IPDL (Interface Phase Length) to be applied for 3.84Mcps TDD or 7.68Mcps TDD when activated.

question_62549.question: In the context of A.2.2.1, when the target RNC can deduce that the ME is not updated, from which message does it deduce this information?
question_62549.ground_truth: The target RNC deduces this information from the lack of the enhanced UTRAN KH IE in the RAN Mobility Information Confirm (uplink message 10)/UTRAN Mobility Information Confirm (uplink message 10)/uplink RRC message 8.

question_62551.question: What is the purpose of the UEContextTransfer service operation in the context of 3GPP technical specification documents related to 5G System Access and Mobility Management Services?
question_62551.ground_truth: The UEContextTransfer service operation is used to transfer UE Context, e.g. the UE's SUPI and MM Context, in the source AMF to the target AMF during General Registration procedure and Registration with Onboarding SNPN. The UEContextTransfer service operation is invoked by the NF Service Consumer towards the AMF when the target AMF receives a Registration Request with the UE's 5G-GUTI included and the serving AMF has changed since last registration.

question_62552.question: What information is the SMF required to include in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message if the UE has requested to join a multicast MBS session?
question_62552.ground_truth: The SMF shall include the TMGI for the multicast MBS session IDs that the UE is allowed to join, if any, in the Received MBS container IE, MBS start time, MBS security container, and separate QoS flows dedicated for multicast by including the Authorized QoS flow descriptions IE if no separate QoS flows exist.

question_62554.question: What is the primary reason for the relaxation of the allocation policy and enlargement of the available code values for vendor-specific applications?
question_62554.ground_truth: The deadlock caused by SDOs abusively reusing and twisting existing commands to avoid the lengthy procedure of IETF RFC publication was the primary reason for this change.

question_62555.question: What component needs to be modified to handle the procedure for SGW UP session identity change in the PGW?
question_62555.ground_truth: The PGW needs modification to handle the procedure for SGW UP session identity change.

question_62556.question: What is the role of KASME in EPS?
question_62556.ground_truth: KASME is a key used to derive other keys, such as NAS keys, KeNB, NH, and NAS-token in MME. It is also used for deriving security contexts during intersystem Handover.

question_62557.question: What should the measurement reporting delay exclude when measuring the time between an event that triggers a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the report over the air interface?
question_62557.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay excludes a delay uncertainty resulted when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH and a delay which caused by no UL resources for UE to send the measurement report.

question_62558.question: What happens when a user has been registered on a 3GPP AAA Server and all subsequent Diameter traffic related to this user is routed to this 3GPP AAA Server?
question_62558.ground_truth: This means that the user's traffic will be consistently directed to the same 3GPP AAA Server, allowing for an optimized and efficient flow of data.

question_62559.question: What is the purpose of the Information Service (IS) part of the Entry Point IRP (EPIRP) in 3GPP technical specifications?
question_62559.ground_truth: The Information Service (IS) part of the Entry Point IRP (EPIRP) specifies the semantics of the information and interactions visible across the interface (Itf-N) between the managing system and the managed system, in a protocol-independent way. The information is specified by means of Information Object Classes (IOCs) and SupportIOCs, and the interactions by means of operations and notifications.

question_62561.question: What is the name of the "integration of resource management and SIP" extension in this subclause?

question_62562.question: What action does the SMS-SC take after receiving a "Device Trigger Request" indicating "Recall" from an MTC-IWF?
question_62562.ground_truth: The SMS-SC determines if the trigger message identified by the External Identifier or MSISDN, SCS Identifier, and old trigger reference number in the received Device Trigger Recall message, is pending at SMS-SC. The stored trigger message is then deleted.

question_62565.question: What should the WLAN UE do if the "I-WLAN Last Registered PLMN" data file is not available in the USIM or the ME, and neither the "User Controlled PLMN Selector for I-WLAN access" nor the "Operator Controlled PLMN Selector for I-WLAN access" data files are available in the USIM or the ME?
question_62565.ground_truth: The WLAN UE shall present any available PLMN in random order.

question_62567.question: What are the main use cases for load control in 3GPP networks?
question_62567.ground_truth: The main use cases for load control in 3GPP networks are HSS, 3GPP AAA Server, and PCRF, with the host selection topic.

question_62569.question: What information is included in the CSR report?
question_62569.ground_truth: The CSR report includes the specific cell site information servicing the target, such as geo-location or civic location of cell sites.

question_62570.question: Which band's IMD, generated by dual uplink of Band 21 and Band n78, does not fall into the own Rx of Band 3?
question_62570.ground_truth: IMD generated by dual uplink of Band 21 + Band n78 doesn't fall into own Rx of band 3

question_62572.question: What is the purpose of the Framework part of the OSA API specification?
question_62572.ground_truth: The Framework part of the OSA API specification specifies the sequence diagrams, class diagrams, interface specifications, state transition diagrams, data definitions, IDL description of the interfaces, WSDL Description of the interfaces and reference to the Java API description of the interfaces. This enable application developers to make use of network functionality through an open standardized interface.

question_62573.question: When controlling 5G QoS flows by SIP core or MC service server, what interfaces can be used between the SIP core and PCF in 5GS for bearer or MC service resource control?
question_62573.ground_truth: Either the N5 interface or the Rx interface can be used between the SIP core and PCF in 5GS for bearer or MC service resource control.

question_62574.question: What is the TPC pattern when higher layers indicate by "First RLS indicator" that the radio link is part of the first radio link set sent to the UE or if the radio link initialisation is caused by an HS-SCCH order to activate the secondary uplink frequency and the value 'n' obtained from the parameter "DL TPC pattern 01 count" passed by higher layers is different from 0?
question_62574.ground_truth: The TPC pattern consists of n instances of the pair of TPC commands ("0","1"), followed by one instance of TPC command "1".

question_62576.question: Why is it necessary to include the current values of the counters for NAS integrity and NAS encryption, as well as the old NAS keys and KASME in the MME context response message during tracking area updates upon idle mode mobility?
question_62576.ground_truth: It is necessary to ensure the security and integrity of the data, as well as to have the old NAS keys and KASME in case of key separation or other security measures that may need to be taken.

question_62577.question: Which colorimetry formats are considered relevant for the TV Video Profiles?
question_62577.ground_truth: The relevant colorimetry formats for the TV Video Profiles are BT.709 and BT.2020. If no signal is provided for the color space, BT.709 should be assumed as the default color space.

question_62578.question: How much Tx-Rx spatial isolation is achievable between two separate panels for FR2 in optimal conditions?
question_62578.ground_truth: An optimal Tx-Rx spatial isolation of at least 80-90 dB can be achieved between two separate panels for FR2.

question_62579.question: What is the name of the NF service specified for ADRF that supports the N5g-ddnmf service?

question_62580.question: In the scenario of PS Handover, non-DTM, MOCN and no combined update procedure, what is the procedure when the UE goes idle?
question_62580.ground_truth: The UE sends a Location Update Request to the target BSS.

question_62581.question: Which radio channel error condition was included in the eCall modem selection tests to represent a rural scenario?
question_62581.ground_truth: The GMSK Full Rate radio channel at RSSI value -100 dBm with no other interferer was included in the eCall modem selection tests to represent a rural scenario.

question_62582.question: How is the RA-RNTI or MSGB-RNTI computed for Random Access Preamble transmission or MSGA?
question_62582.ground_truth: The RA-RNTI and MSGB-RNTI are computed using the index of the first OFDM symbol of the PRACH occasion, the index of the first slot of the PRACH occasion in a system frame, the index of the PRACH occasion in the frequency domain, and the UL carrier used for Random Access Preamble transmission.

question_62583.question: What addressing scheme is used when the FRMCS Equipment is registered to the FRMCS System?
question_62583.ground_truth: The functional identity addressing scheme is used when the FRMCS Equipment is registered to the FRMCS System.

question_62585.question: Under which conditions should the mobile station respond to the PACKET POLLING REQUEST message with a PACKET CONTROL ACKNOWLEDGEMENT message in the access burst format?
question_62585.ground_truth: The mobile station should respond with a PACKET CONTROL ACKNOWLEDGEMENT message in the access burst format if it has received a PACKET DOWNLINK ASSIGNMENT message with no starting time or with a starting time that has already elapsed, and the PACKET POLLING REQUEST message requests the access burst format.

question_62587.question: What is the role of the AAA-1 interface in regards to the SIP database?
question_62587.ground_truth: The AAA-1 interface is used to expose the SIP database when it is located within the SIP core. If the SIP database is located within the SIP core, the AAA-1 interface is not exposed.

question_62588.question: What is the value of TInter1 used in the formula for measurement reporting delay?
question_62588.ground_truth: The value of TInter1 used in the formula for measurement reporting delay is 60 ms.

question_62589.question: What are the validity conditions for the wideband RSRQ accuracy requirements in 9.1.5.4?
question_62589.ground_truth: The conditions include a measured cell with one, two, or four antenna ports, fulfillment of Clause 7.3 in TS 36.101, RSRP in dBm based on Annex B.3.1, and AllowedMeasBandwidth as 50 resource blocks or larger.

question_62591.question: What action is taken when the mobile station is in the GA-RRC-IDLE state and the GA-RRC REQUEST ACCEPT message is received, if timer TU5908 is already active?
question_62591.ground_truth: The GA-RRC REQUEST ACCEPT message is ignored and the ongoing procedure continues as if the message was not received.

question_62592.question: What is the role of the mobile service provider in supporting different applications with distinct connectivity needs, QoS requirements, and billing profiles in the automotive use case?
question_62592.ground_truth: The mobile service provider supports the automotive service provider by utilizing network based features to avoid application misusage of lower cost connectivity, providing different levels of characteristics such as Quality of service and charging for each application type, and using bearer service attributes QCI and ARP or Policy Control and Charging to provide the right bearer service characteristics and priority as well as charging/billing in accordance with the SLA.

question_62593.question: Who is responsible for authorizing a UE as a UE-to-UE relay or a UE to communicate with another UE via a UE-to-UE Relay in 5G System?
question_62593.ground_truth: This key issue directs SA3 to study the authorization aspects in the UE-to-UE relay scenario.

question_62595.question: What should the target BSS do upon receipt of the PS Handover Complete Acknowledge message, in any subsequent PS handover to GERAN A/Gb mode?
question_62595.ground_truth: The target BSS shall set the 'Reliable INTER RAT HANDOVER' to '1' in the PS Handover Required message in any subsequent PS handover to GERAN A/Gb mode, and overwrite its current INTER RAT HANDOVER INFO with the new one in the PS Handover Complete Acknowledge message.

question_62597.question: What is the format of patch documents in 3GPP JSON Patch?
question_62597.ground_truth: Patch documents using the "3gpp-patch+json" media type need to conform to the "application/json" media type.

question_62599.question: What MIME types and message bodies are supported over the II-NNI?
question_62599.ground_truth: The MIME types "application/sdp" and multipart message bodies (multipart/mixed, multipart/related, and multipart/alternative) are supported over the II-NNI. Other MIME types may be supported over the II-NNI based on agreement between operators.

question_62600.question: How should the "attrA" and "attrB" be updated in the resource representation sent to the MnS Producer?
question_62600.ground_truth: To update "attrA" and "attrB", the received resource representation needs to contain "attrA" with the new value and "attrB" with the new value.

question_62603.question: What is used to minimize load and delay in the upper 16k extension part in AMR-WB Mode 15,85 kbit/s?
question_62603.ground_truth: D-Bits in columns 3, 5, and 7 of the TRAU Frame structure in the upper extension part are used to minimize load and delay in the upper 16k extension part in AMR-WB Mode 15,85 kbit/s.

question_62605.question: What is the method used to ensure the UE MAC address is reported in an Ethernet PDU Session type?
question_62605.ground_truth: The SMF may, upon PCF request, control the UPF to report different MAC addresses used as UE address in a PDU Session.

question_62607.question: What is the condition under which the union of restricted serving cell symbols is defined for measurement of MO i?
question_62607.ground_truth: When serving cell symbols overlap with SSB symbols to be measured on MO i, or when serving cell symbols overlap with the SMTC window for MO i.

question_62608.question: How does a UE obtain a ProSe Response Code for restricted 5G ProSe Direct Discovery, Model B?
question_62608.ground_truth: The UE sends a discovery request to the 5G DDNMF in the HPLMN to obtain a ProSe Response Code, and the 5G DDNMF interacts with the ProSe Application Server for the authorization of the discovery request.

question_62609.question: What is the purpose of the Lawful Interception Identifier (LIID) within the ASN.1 module in the context of lawful interception?
question_62609.ground_truth: The Lawful Interception Identifier (LIID) is a special identifier assigned by the authorized operator (NO/AN/SP) to each target identity related to an interception measure. It is used for identification and correlation purposes within any information exchanged at the handover interfaces HI2 and HI3.

question_62610.question: What is the purpose of the login procedure in ProSe-enabled applications?
question_62610.ground_truth: The login procedure for ProSe-enabled applications is used to authenticate the user and establish a connection between the application and the ProSe function or server. It can be done through the PC1 or PC3 interface, depending on the options chosen.

question_62611.question: What is the operation package that includes callInformationReport, callInformationRequest, and is invoked by gsmSSF with the return value set in CAP?

question_62615.question: What is the role of the LMISF-CC in the IMS signalling and media packet delivery process?
question_62615.ground_truth: The LMISF-CC is responsible for receiving and processing the associated IMS media packets delivered by the BBIFF-C and generating xCC from the received IMS media related user plane packets.

question_62620.question: What happens to the state of the AMF when a registration procedure fails due to exceeding quota?
question_62620.ground_truth: The AMF deregisters the UE when the registration attempt fails due to exceeding the quota.

question_62621.question: What should the MCVideo client do if the MCVideo emergency group call state is set to "MVEGC 3: emergency-call-granted" and the MCVideo emergency alert state is set to a value other than "MVEA 1: no-alert" and the MCVideo user has indicated that the MCVideo emergency alert on the MCVideo group should be cancelled in addition to the MCVideo emergency group call?
question_62621.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include in the SIP re-INVITE request an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the <emergency-ind> element set to "false", include in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body an <alert-ind> element set to "false", set the MCVideo emergency alert state to "MVEA 4: Emergency-alert-cancel-pending", clear the MCVideo emergency state, indicate to the MCVideo user that they are not authorised to cancel the MCVideo emergency alert if it is not an authorised request, and set the MCVideo emergency group state of the MCVideo group to "MVEG 3: cancel-pending".

question_62622.question: Which node in the FLUS MO contains a collection of information about a FLUS sink?
question_62622.ground_truth: The node "/<X>/Sink/<X>" contains a collection of information about a FLUS sink.

question_62623.question: What is the definition of cell re-selection delay in 8.3.5.1.1?
question_62623.ground_truth: The cell re-selection delay is defined as the time between the occurrence of an event that will trigger the cell reselection process and the moment in time when the UE starts sending preambles on the PRACH for sending RRC CELL UPDATE message to the UTRAN.

question_62627.question: What is the definition of single-band TAB connector in the context of NR?
question_62627.ground_truth: A single-band TAB connector supports operation only in a single operating band, or operation in multiple operating bands without any common active electronic component(s).

question_62628.question: What is the final status that can be returned by the "GetSmsDeliveryStatus" operation?
question_62628.ground_truth: The final delivery status that can be returned by the "GetSmsDeliveryStatus" operation includes 'DeliveredToNetwork', 'DeliveryUncertain', 'DeliveryImpossible', and 'DeliveredToTerminal'.

question_62629.question: Who is responsible for enforcing user consent for edge computing in the context of 5G?
question_62629.ground_truth: If EES is utilizing 5GC services without NEF, the EES acts as the consent enforcing entity. Otherwise, if the EES is utilizing 5GC services via NEF, the NEF acts as the consent enforcing entity.

question_62630.question: What are the main steps in the USSD transport alternative for ICCC procedure for setting up terminating sessions?
question_62630.ground_truth: The main steps in the USSD transport alternative for ICCC procedure for setting up terminating sessions are receiving an incoming SIP INVITE, performing access selection, sending an Incoming Call Request in a USSD message, fetching a number such as MSRN if a media connection is not established, sending an USSD message to the HSS, and receiving and responding to a SETUP message.

question_62632.question: What is the DTS-3 procedure in the context of chronous co-channel interferer of type I1 as specified in TS 51.010 annex 5.2?
question_62632.ground_truth: The DTS-3 procedure is a test required to ensure that the block error ratio, as calculated by the SS for different channels under the TU High propagation conditions, does not exceed the conformance requirement.

question_62633.question: In the context of the present document, which documents define the terms and abbreviations used in the report?
question_62633.ground_truth: The terms and abbreviations used in the report are defined in TR 25.990, TS 25.401, and TS 25.423.

question_62634.question: What information should the NG-RAN node store upon receipt of the UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND message?
question_62634.ground_truth: Upon receipt of the UE CONTEXT RELEASE COMMAND message, the NG-RAN node should release all related signalling and user data transport resources.

question_62635.question: What is the purpose of the STR message in the MBMS de-registration procedure initiated by the GGSN?
question_62635.ground_truth: The STR message is used by the GGSN to inform the BM-SC that it does not need to receive signaling, session attributes and data for a particular multicast MBMS bearer service anymore, and therefore would like to be removed from the corresponding distribution tree.

question_62636.question: What are the general guidelines for writing test cases in SECAM?
question_62636.ground_truth: The general guidelines for writing test cases in SECAM are that the test case should describe the aim of the test and what it is trying to demonstrate, should be specific enough to write an effective test, should avoid duplications, should be efficient to execute, and should not assume implementation-specific details, unless explicitly stated. The tests should be applicable to all elements in one or more network product classes.

question_62637.question: Which Diameter based request does Solution 1 propose that the DRA-like entity sends to the DRA to obtain the PCRF address?
question_62637.ground_truth: Solution 1 proposes that the DRA-like entity sends a Diameter based Rx message, such as AAR, to the DRA to obtain the PCRF address.

question_62638.question: What is the role of the NWDAF in the 5G System architecture?
question_62638.ground_truth: The NWDAF is responsible for collecting data from various 5GC NFs, exposing analytics to 5GC NFs, and storing and retrieving data in the ADRF.

question_62639.question: What are the two main functionalities provided by the PCF to the AMF for Access and Mobility Management?
question_62639.ground_truth: The PCF provides Access and Mobility Management related policies and UE policies to the AMF, and evaluates operator policies that are triggered by events received from the AMF.

question_62640.question: What is the standard format for encoding the bodies of HTTP requests and successful HTTP responses in CAPIF APIs?

question_62641.question: What should be the Diameter Application Id value used for the SWm reference point?

question_62644.question: What should the response line be if the service is not active for any class when querying the status of a network service?
question_62644.ground_truth: The response line should return '<status>=0' (not active) if the service is not active for any class when querying the status of a network service.

question_62649.question: What is the SNR needed to achieve 90% of peak throughput for 64QAM MCS28 under AWGN conditions?
question_62649.ground_truth: The SNR needed is slightly higher than that for 256QAM MCS21 under AWGN conditions.

question_62650.question: What is the requirement in 8.3.1.1, for DCH demodulation in multipath fading Case 1?
question_62650.ground_truth: The requirement in 8.3.1.1 is the maximum BLER allowed when the receiver input signal is at a specified Eb/N0 limit in multipath fading Case 1.

question_62651.question: What does 3GPP MTSIMA MO allow in terms of controlling bit rate in a 3GPP network?
question_62651.ground_truth: 3GPP MTSIMA MO allows for shaping a rough trajectory of the bit rate over time-varying transmission conditions, with the maximum and minimum bit rates determined during session setup using RateSet leaf of 3GPP MTSINP MO.

question_62653.question: In what situation does MCData server A send an ad hoc group data session request to another MC system's MCData server?
question_62653.ground_truth: When MCData server A identifies that the criteria require adding participants from another MC system, MCData server A sends an ad hoc group data session request to the MCData server in that MC system.

question_62655.question: What are the main parameters of the NOTIFICATION/FACCH message in the first step of the first test scenario?
question_62655.ground_truth: The NOTIFICATION/FACCH message contains a Paging Information IE which addresses the mobile station in the first step of the first test scenario.

question_62656.question: What state is an affected UE kept in when the 5G-AN releases the NGAP TNLA binding?
question_62656.ground_truth: The affected UE is kept in CM-CONNECTED state and the corresponding N3 interface is also kept.

question_62657.question: What is stored to show the quantities of the last logged cell the UE was camping on in the UE's camping state?

question_62658.question: How can high-speed moving vehicles be supported in fast moving airplanes with enhanced user experience in the 3GPP system beyond 2020?
question_62658.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall support enhanced mobile broadband services in fast moving vehicles (up to 500 km/h) with enhanced user experience. Additionally, it shall support enhanced connectivity services in fast moving airplanes (up to 1000 km/h) with enhanced user experience.

question_62659.question: What is the basic principle behind the C/I based power control algorithm?
question_62659.ground_truth: The C/I based power control algorithm compares the C/I value at the receiver with the minimum required and the maximum allowed C/I value to keep the received C/I in its fixed boundaries. If the C/I is in the required scope, the transmission power is varied to keep the received power in its fixed boundaries.

question_62660.question: What is the action taken when the GA-RRC REQUEST REJECT message is received, if timer TU5908 is already active for the indicated domain?
question_62660.ground_truth: The GA-RRC REQUEST REJECT message is ignored and the ongoing procedure continues as if the message was not received.

question_62662.question: What is the role of the NSACF in 5GS-EPS interworking with EPS counting active?
question_62662.ground_truth: The NSACF is responsible for performing the PLMN global counting for the maximum number of Registered UEs for interworking between 5GS and EPS.

question_62664.question: What is the implication of an AF using maximum number of H-PCF instances to be returned from NRF for the AMF?
question_62664.ground_truth: The AF can indicate the maximum number of H-PCF instances to be returned from NRF during PCF discovery and selection. The AMF may use the received V-PCF ID and available binding information to send the UE policy association establishment request, which also includes the H-PCF ID, to the SCP.

question_62665.question: What message does the PDN GW send to the Serving GW after receiving the Delete Bearer Request message?
question_62665.ground_truth: The PDN GW sends a Delete Bearer Response (TEID, EPS Bearer Identity, User Location Information) message to the Serving GW.
