question_63006.ground_truth: The two possible cause values in a Detach Notification message are "Local Detach" and "Complete Detach".

question_63007.question: What network entities are responsible for adding the II-NNI traversal scenario type indication in the SIP signalling?
question_63007.ground_truth: S-CSCF, P-CSCF, AS, TRF, and BGCF are the network entities responsible for adding the II-NNI traversal scenario type indication in the SIP signalling.

question_63009.question: What are the main network requirements for multimedia communication between multiple users in the described use case?
question_63009.ground_truth: The network must fulfill typical QoS requirements, including low end-to-end delay, high throughput, and high availability, to ensure satisfactory user experience for multimedia communication.

question_63011.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the applicability of this test?
question_63011.ground_truth: The UE should support intra-frequency SI acquisition in FDD for HO and FGI bit 5 of UE category 0.

question_63012.question: What information is used in the ERROR INDICATION message when the Error Indication procedure is triggered by UE associated signalling, in the course of handover signalling or signalling for dual connectivity?
question_63012.ground_truth: The Old eNB UE X2AP ID IE and the New eNB UE X2AP ID IE shall be included in the ERROR INDICATION message along with the Cause IE or the Criticality Diagnostics IE.

question_63013.question: What must the UE used for MTC do to communicate the public portion of the MPF rule to the MTC Server?
question_63013.ground_truth: The UE used for MTC can send a transport layer message using the appropriate IP address and port numbers, or send this information via an application layer message.

question_63016.question: What is the procedure defined in 3G TS 33.102 that 2G AKA has to support for a mixed 2G/3G network environment?

question_63017.question: What should be included in the subjectAltName field for SEPP inter-domain certificate profiles used in inter-SNPN domain N32 certificates?
question_63017.ground_truth: The subjectAltName field for SEPP inter-domain certificate profiles used in inter-SNPN domain N32 certificates should include all PLMN IDs and Network identifiers identify the SNPN in SAN fields as DNS name for where it runs the N32 connection.

question_63018.question: What is the overall algorithmic delay for WB, SWB and FB output in the EVS codec?
question_63018.ground_truth: The overall algorithmic delay is 32 ms for WB, SWB and FB output in the EVS codec.

question_63019.question: What should the P-CSCF do if the verification of the Route header fields fails during the processing of a request?
question_63019.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should return a 400 (Bad Request) response, or replace the Route header field value in the request with the list of Record-Route header fields.

question_63020.question: Which media components are being negotiated in the SIP message?
question_63020.ground_truth: The media components being negotiated in the SIP message are audio and video.

question_63021.question: What is the purpose of the NF and NF service discovery procedure in the 5G System?
question_63021.ground_truth: The NF and NF service discovery procedure enables Core Network entities (NFs or Service Communication Proxy (SCP)) to discover a set of NF instance(s) and NF service instance(s) for a specific NF service or an NF type. This is implemented via the Network Repository Function (NRF) which is the logical function that is used to support the functionality of NF and NF service discovery and status notification.

question_63022.question: What is the purpose of characterizing the defining stages of AI/ML related algorithms in the 3GPP framework for AI/ML?
question_63022.ground_truth: The purpose of characterizing the defining stages of AI/ML related algorithms is to identify the model generation, model validation, model testing, inference operation, model deployment, model monitoring, and model updating associated with the air-interface.

question_63023.question: In inter-band EN-DC of E-UTRA and NR in FR1, what is the maximum output power for any transmission bandwidth within the aggregated channel bandwidth, defined by the UE Power Classes?
question_63023.ground_truth: The maximum output power is measured as the sum of the maximum output power at each UE antenna connector, with a period of measurement of at least one subframe (1ms).

question_63025.question: What is the state of an EPS network, where the EPS capability is disabled in the UE and no EPS mobility management function is performed?

question_63026.question: What is the HTTP response when the PFDF cannot ensure that the PCEF/TDF will pull the PFDs in time?
question_63026.ground_truth: The PFDF sends an HTTP response with a failure reason and the caching time value used in the comparison, and may still store the PFDs for this application identifier.

question_63027.question: What is the main purpose of the test in 7.8.4.3.1 section?
question_63027.ground_truth: The main purpose of the test in 7.8.4.3.1 section is to verify the ability of the receiver to inhibit the generation of intermodulation products in its non-linear elements caused by the presence of two high-level interfering signals at frequencies with a specific relationship to the frequency of the wanted signal.

question_63028.question: Which technical committee produced the present document in the 3GPP TS 23.206 Release 7?
question_63028.ground_truth: Telecommunications and Internet converged Services and Protocols for Advanced Networking (TISPAN)

question_63029.question: What is the purpose of a PIN profile in the PIN management procedure?
question_63029.ground_truth: A PIN profile describes the related information about PINE, PEMC, and PEGC, and this information can be seen as the control plane management information for the PIN.

question_63030.question: What is the role of the NG-RAN in providing the UE specific PC5 DRX cycle to the UE?
question_63030.ground_truth: The NG-RAN provides the UE specific PC5 DRX cycle to the UE based on the PC5 QoS parameters which are provided from the AMF during the registration procedure.

question_63031.question: What network function may need to be developed for the "P-AKA'" authentication method?
question_63031.ground_truth: A new network function AAuF (AKMA Authentication Function) may need to be developed which interfaces with the UPF and can invoke the related SBA-based interfaces of the AUSF.

question_63032.question: What message does the new SGSN send to the old MME to get the context for the UE?
question_63032.ground_truth: A Context Request message containing the P-TMSI, old RAI, New SGSN Address, and P-TMSI Signature.

question_63033.question: In the context of step 14, what message does the SS transmit if the conditions for releasing the RRC connection are met?
question_63033.ground_truth: The SS transmits a RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection and all radio resources.

question_63034.question: What should the MS start transmitting after sending the GA-RRC MODIFY CHANNEL ACK message?
question_63034.ground_truth: After sending the GA-RRC MODIFY CHANNEL ACK message, the MS should start transmitting RTP packets based on the successful parameter modifications.

question_63035.question: What is the expected behavior for a UE when it supports multiple RATs in 5GS Registration Management?
question_63035.ground_truth: To prevent extra signaling load due to Mobility Registration Update at each RAT change, it is preferable not to generate RAT-specific TAI lists for a UE supporting multiple RATs.

question_63036.question: What should the AS do when forwarding a request for the MuD service serving identity C?
question_63036.ground_truth: The AS should replace the P-Asserted-Identity header field with the identity in the Additional-Identity header field if the P-Asserted-Identity header can be modified, or if the P-Asserted-Identity header cannot be modified, set the Privacy header field "id" to keep the native identity private in the P-Asserted-Identity header field.

question_63037.question: What changes are required in the core network nodes for this solution to work?
question_63037.ground_truth: The solution is designed to work transparently with core network nodes, meaning no changes are required to SGSNs, GGSNs, MMEs, S-GWs, and P-GWs.

question_63039.question: What is the logical interface specified in the document between the NG-RAN and the 5GC?

question_63040.question: What are the conditions for test case c) regarding frequency offsets, when the same total number of exceptions M for N active carriers shall apply as given above for test case a)?
question_63040.ground_truth: The same total number of exceptions M for N active carriers shall apply as given above for test case a), including the range of frequency offsets between 0.6 MHz above the uppermost carrier of the lower sub-block and 0.6 MHz below the lowermost carrier of the upper sub-block.

question_63041.question: What is the purpose of the paging indication message on EC-PICH (EC PAGING INDICATION)?
question_63041.ground_truth: The purpose of the paging indication message is to convey a wake-up or sleep indication to a mobile station capable of receiving EC-PICH in a specific coverage class condition (CC3 or CC4). It enables the mobile station to detect its paging block by correlation with the transmitted sequence.

question_63042.question: What are the four medium access modes supported in this wireless communication system?
question_63042.ground_truth: The four medium access modes supported are Dynamic allocation, Fixed Uplink Allocation, Extended Dynamic allocation, and Exclusive allocation.

question_63044.question: What action should the 5G-AN take when an AMF fails and the UE is in CM-CONNECTED state?
question_63044.ground_truth: The 5G-AN should release the NGAP UE-TNLA-binding with the corresponding AMF for the respective UE(s) while maintaining N3 (user plane connectivity) and other UE context information.

question_63045.question: What message does the SMLC send to the serving BSS to request for assistance information needed for the Multilateration Timing Advance procedure?
question_63045.ground_truth: The SMLC sends a BSSMAP-LE Assistance Information Request message to the serving BSS to request for assistance information.

question_63046.question: What is the test requirement for the multi-band RIB in the context of intermodulation test requirement?
question_63046.ground_truth: The interfering signals for the multi-band RIB intermodulation test requirement shall be a CW signal and an E-UTRA, NR or UTRA signal, as specified in TS 37.104, Annex A. The requirement is applicable outside the Base Station RF Bandwidth or Radio Bandwidth, with the interfering signal offset defined relative to the Base Station RF Bandwidth edges or Radio Bandwidth edges.

question_63047.question: How is the egress RLC channel determined for a SRAP Data PDU to be transmitted for SL-DRBs in U2N Relay UE?
question_63047.ground_truth: The egress RLC channel is determined based on the sl-RemoteUE-RB-Identity associated with the entry containing the sl-EgressRLC-ChannelPC5 which matches LCID of the PC5 Relay RLC Channel from which the SRAP Data PDU is received, and the DRB identity is BEARER ID plus 1 for DRB.

question_63048.question: What is the function of the IRPManager in 3GPP's SuM architecture?
question_63048.ground_truth: The IRPManager in 3GPP's SuM architecture is responsible for implementing and supporting the SuM IRP, and it can reside in an Element Manager (EM) or a Network Element (NE). It also chooses one of the two System Contexts defined by 3GPP.

question_63049.question: What must the MCData client include in the SIP MESSAGE request when sending a one-to-one standalone FD message?
question_63049.ground_truth: The MCData client must include an application/resource-lists+xml MIME body with the MCData ID of the target MCData user, and an application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-info+xml MIME body with a <request-type> element set to "one-to-one-fd" when sending a one-to-one standalone FD message.

question_63050.question: What is Inter-cell Interference Coordination (ICIC) concerned with in LTE?
question_63050.ground_truth: ICIC is concerned with managing radio resources to keep inter-cell interference under control in LTE.

question_63051.question: What should be avoided to minimize unnecessary load on core network entities involved in mobility management?
question_63051.ground_truth: Unnecessary or excessive Attach and location updating procedures (LAU, RAU, TAU) and frequent RAT reselection should be avoided, especially when ISR is not applicable.

question_63052.question: What type and length is the S1 mode to N1 mode NAS transparent container information element?
question_63052.ground_truth: The S1 mode to N1 mode NAS transparent container information element is a type 4 information element with a length of 10 octets.

question_63053.question: What is the initial condition for the three-way session creation for video test?
question_63053.ground_truth: UE contains either SIM application (GIBA), ISIM and USIM applications or only USIM application on UICC and has discovered P-CSCF, registered to IMS services.

question_63054.question: What status is the conversation between A and B in?
question_63054.ground_truth: The conversation between A and B is currently active and held.

question_63058.question: What is the rationale behind the classification of unwanted emissions as out-of-band and spurious in 3GPP specifications?
question_63058.ground_truth: Out-of-band emissions result from the modulation process and non-linearity in the transmitter but excluding spurious emissions. Spurious emissions are emissions on a frequency, or frequencies, outside the necessary bandwidth that do not affect the corresponding transmission of information.

question_63061.question: What should the UE do if the current TAI is not in the TAI list, and there is a transmission failure of TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message indication with TAI change from lower layers?
question_63061.ground_truth: The UE should abort the tracking area updating procedure and re-initiate it immediately. The UE should also set the EPS update status to EU2 NOT UPDATED.

question_63062.question: When is the quasi-collocation (QCL) of DMRS ports grouping supported?
question_63062.ground_truth: DMRS ports grouping is supported when they are within one group and are Quasi-collocated (QCL)ed, and DMRS ports in different groups are non-QCLed.

question_63063.question: What effect does the 16QAM modulation have on the beta value used to compute the Nominal CDP?
question_63063.ground_truth: When the UE uses 16QAM modulation, a correction factor shall be applied to the betaed value used to compute the Nominal CDP.

question_63064.question: What information is included in a Routeing Area Identity (RAI)?
question_63064.ground_truth: RAI includes MCC, MNC, LAC, and RAC. RAC identifies one or several cells, while the rest of the parameters identify the PLMN and LA.

question_63066.question: What role does the SRNC play in acquiring information about the cells neighboring each served cell?
question_63066.ground_truth: The SRNC can acquire information about the cells neighboring each served cell by relying on Release 9 UEs to report System Information for detected cells.

question_63067.question: What should the floor participant do upon receiving an indication to request to resume unicast media in the 'U: has no permission' state?
question_63067.ground_truth: The floor participant should send the Unicast Media Flow Control message toward the floor control server with the Media Flow Control Indicator field value set to '1'.

question_63068.question: In which scenarios is the SMF able to collect charging information per service data flow for roamers?
question_63068.ground_truth: In Local Breakout scenarios and based on Visited Operator policy, the SMF in VPLMN may collect charging information per service data flow for roamers.

question_63069.question: What is a potential security requirement to mitigate the risk of a bidding down attack in the NAS based redirection solution?
question_63069.ground_truth: The 5GS shall protect the redirection message.

question_63070.question: What is the function of the MCPTT server in 6.4.2.1?
question_63070.ground_truth: The MCPTT server calls the called MCPTT user at MCPTT client 1 to join the MCPTT private call.

question_63071.question: What is the fundamental operating principle of the VAD?
question_63071.ground_truth: The VAD is a binary flag that indicates whether each 20 ms frame produced by the speech encoder contains speech or not. It uses energy detection, filtering, and threshold comparison to distinguish between noise with speech present and noise without speech present.

question_63072.question: How does the relaxation of Band 41 REFSENS affect the UE reference sensitivity requirement for carrier aggregation?
question_63072.ground_truth: The relaxation of Band 41 REFSENS by 2 dB allows for maximum flexibility in supporting carrier aggregation, such as non-contiguous carrier aggregation or higher orders of CC aggregation, in Band 41.

question_63073.question: What is the precondition mechanism referred to in TS 24.229, clause 5.1.4A.2 and 6.1?
question_63073.ground_truth: The precondition mechanism is the "integration of resource management and SIP" and is defined in RFC 3312, as updated by RFC 4032.

question_63075.question: What is the purpose of the administrator root public key in a MExE device?
question_63075.ground_truth: The administrator root public key is primarily used for designating an administrator of the third party certificates in a MExE device.

question_63076.question: What are the QoS Flows and the corresponding 5QI values for IMS signalling messages and media packets in the context of N9HR?
question_63076.ground_truth: IMS signalling packets have a 5QI value of 5 and media packets (for voice) have a 5QI value of 1.

question_63078.question: What is the purpose of redefining the RRBP and ES/P fields in the header of EGPRS DL data blocks?
question_63078.ground_truth: The purpose is to enable the network to dynamically request either the short bitmap (default case) or the conventional Ack/Nack message when necessary to recover from the loss of several successive polling requests/polling responses.

question_63079.question: What is the main feature introduced in Rel-16 to improve the performance of coexistence with NR in legacy LTE-MTC?
question_63079.ground_truth: Finer-granularity LTE-MTC resource reservation in both the time and frequency domain for unicast MPDCCH/PDSCH/PUSCH/PUCCH transmissions in connected mode in CE mode A/B.

question_63082.question: What is the purpose of having a canonical node name for a node in the context of S-NAPTR procedure?
question_63082.ground_truth: A canonical node name uniquely identifies a node, while an alias provides alternative names for the same node. In the context of S-NAPTR procedure, there should be only one canonical node name for a node, with CNAME records being used to create aliases for the canonical node name or any other FQDN.

question_63083.question: What message type is sent by the MS to the network to indicate that authentication has failed, and should contain the AUTS parameter?

question_63084.question: Which test case should be used to test the invocation behavior of the CatStatus API when the "Status" argument is NULL?
question_63084.ground_truth: Test Case 4: Status with NULL argument

question_63085.question: What must the network consider in order to avoid wasting radio resources when sending RLC blocks to a mobile station?
question_63085.ground_truth: The network should avoid (re)transmitting RLC blocks that will not be considered as valid by the mobile stations, as this would lead to a waste of radio resources.

question_63086.question: Which country has specific RF requirements and only allows synchronization operation between operators with adjacent TDD carriers in the same TDD operation band?

question_63090.question: What is the purpose of the "TransmittedCarrierPowerOfAllCodesNotUsedForHS-PDSCH-HS-SCCH-E-AGCH-E-RGCHOrE-HICHTransmissionCellPortionValue" field?
question_63090.ground_truth: The "TransmittedCarrierPowerOfAllCodesNotUsedForHS-PDSCH-HS-SCCH-E-AGCH-E-RGCHOrE-HICHTransmissionCellPortionValue" field stores the transmission power of all codes that are not used for HS-PDSCH, HS-SCCH, E-AGCH, E-RGCH, or E-HICH transmission on a cell.

question_63091.question: What security information must be sent in the P-Access-Network-Info header field?
question_63091.ground_truth: If a security association or TLS session exists and is available to the UE, the P-Access-Network-Info header field must be set as specified for the access network technology.

question_63092.question: What is the role of the AAA server in the "secondary authentication" procedure before the delegated PDU Session is accepted?
question_63092.ground_truth: The AAA server is responsible for authenticating the UE identified by NAI and deriving a Master Session Key (MSK) for securing the communication over the trusted WLAN air interface.

question_63093.question: How does network load impact the achievable energy efficiency in a real network?
question_63093.ground_truth: Network load, resulting from traffic and connection densities, impacts the energy efficiency in a real network by increasing complexity in calculating and assessing the energy efficiency KPI, especially considering spatial and temporal variations in network load.

question_63094.question: How does the UE determine if the visited country mandates the selection of ePDG in that country?
question_63094.ground_truth: The UE performs a DNS NAPTR query using the Visited Country FQDN, and if the result contains the service instance names of the form "epdg.epc.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.pub.3gppnetwork.org", the UE shall determine that the visited country mandates the selection of the ePDG in that country.

question_63095.question: What are the differences between SA5 and MTOSI methodologies concerning the model definition?
question_63095.ground_truth: In SA5, the model and operations are defined in independent levels of documentation, while in MTOSI R1.1, the model and operations are mixed together. However, MTOSI is making the distinction as defined in the SA5 methodology in the next MTOSI releases.

question_63098.question: What was the increase in capacity performance for FR1, Uma, DL, for CG, with single stream traffic model, DDDUU/DDDSU TDD format, with SU-MIMO, 30Mbps, 15ms PDB, 60 FPS, when using cooperative MIMO/precoding compared to zero-forcing precoding?

question_63099.question: What is the requirement for the External Service Identifier to be useful and convenient in the context of 5G Media Streaming?
question_63099.ground_truth: The External Service Identifier needs to be unique on a given 5GMS System and the same across all 5G Systems to be useful and convenient in the context of 5G Media Streaming.

question_63100.question: What is the role of the PCEF in enforcing the actions included in the activated PCC Rule for a specific UE access to a Third party application?
question_63100.ground_truth: The PCEF is responsible for enforcing the actions included in the activated PCC Rule at the time the UE accesses the Third party application, such as requesting a quota, accumulating usage, or enforcing QoS.

question_63101.question: What should the BSS do when it fails to respond to a PERFORM-LOCATION-REQUEST PDU?
question_63101.ground_truth: The BSS should return a PERFORM-LOCATION-RESPONSE PDU with a LCS cause value indicating the failure cause.

question_63102.question: What protocol is used to transport the CS domain user plane between the MS and GANC in the GAN architecture?
question_63102.ground_truth: The CS domain user plane is transported over RTP/UDP between MS and GANC in the GAN architecture.

question_63103.question: What is the UE's action in response to receiving UEInformationRequest message with idleModeMeasurementReq if the measurement procedure was unsuccessful and RRC connection re-establishment occurred?
question_63103.ground_truth: UE does not report measurement results in UEInformationResponse message

question_63105.question: What is the impact of using an UE transmission/reception within SBFD and non-SBFD symbols within a slot on potential interruption of transmissions/receptions during transition?
question_63105.ground_truth: It can cause potential interruption of transmissions/receptions during transition, which may require the use of guard times to ensure proper functioning.

question_63106.question: Which network identifier does the "servingPlmn" attribute encode, and what does it consist of?
question_63106.ground_truth: The identifier of the serving network, which consists of the PLMN Identifier or the SNPN Identifier.

question_63107.question: What action should the network take if it receives an ESM message with a reserved or assigned EPS bearer identity value that does not match an existing EPS bearer context?
question_63107.ground_truth: The network should respond with an ESM STATUS message, including ESM cause #43 "invalid EPS bearer identity".

question_63108.question: What are the two parts of storage in a CHF that the operator wants to control the size of the message for?
question_63108.ground_truth: CDR storage before sending to the CGF and allocation of resource for the SBI

question_63110.question: What does the AttenuationFactor represent in the HS-DSCH throughput for fixed reference channels for MU-MIMO requirements?
question_63110.ground_truth: The AttenuationFactor represents the ratio of user's signal power to interference user's signal power in the HS-DSCH throughput for fixed reference channels for MU-MIMO requirements.

question_63111.question: What is the MCL value for the Local Area base station in the same geographic area for the adjacent channels where the ACLR requirement applies and the carrier separation is 5 MHz or less?
question_63111.ground_truth: The MCL value for the Local Area base station in the same geographic area for the adjacent channels where the ACLR requirement applies and the carrier separation is 5 MHz or less is 87 dB.

question_63113.question: When should the UE initiate a registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update?
question_63113.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update if the UE radio capability ID deletion indication IE is set to "Network-assigned UE radio capability IDs deletion requested" in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

question_63114.question: Which attribute is set to "passive" when the SCC AS acts as a routing B2BUA?
question_63114.ground_truth: The "a=setup" attribute is set to "passive" in this case.

question_63116.question: What is the subsequent action taken by the MCPTT server after it sends an MCPTT call transfer request towards the MCPTT server 1?
question_63116.ground_truth: The MCPTT server 1 sends an MCPTT call transfer request towards the MCPTT client 1.

question_63120.question: In what situations does the UE have to meet the maxUplinkDutyCycle-PC2-FR1 requirement for FR1 bands?
question_63120.ground_truth: The UE has to meet the maxUplinkDutyCycle-PC2-FR1 requirement when the UE indicates power class 2 and the percentage of uplink symbols transmitted in a certain evaluation period meets the specified conditions.

question_63121.question: What is the Primitive Type of BMC-Data41-REQ?
question_63121.ground_truth: The Primitive Type of BMC-Data41-REQ is request.

question_63122.question: What is the general cause value introduced for UE-associated messages in 5G system architecture?

question_63123.question: What mechanism provides transport network redundancy with SCTP?
question_63123.ground_truth: Transport network redundancy may be achieved by SCTP multi-homing between two end-points, of which one or both is assigned with multiple IP addresses, resulting in SCTP end-points supporting a multi-homed remote SCTP end-point.

question_63125.question: How can an ATSSS capable UE use the measurements available at the MPTCP layer?
question_63125.ground_truth: An ATSSS capable UE that supports the MPTCP steering functionality can use the measurements available at the MPTCP layer to perform access performance measurements.

question_63127.question: In the case of AM RLC entity for SRB#2, what happens when the UE's reply is received successfully during lossless SRNS relocation in the "UE not involved" scenario?
question_63127.ground_truth: The RLC entities for affected radio bearers (other than SRB#2) are re-established, and the HFN values for each RB are set to the START value in the message for corresponding CN domain. Data buffers are also flushed for each RB.

question_63128.question: What is the purpose of the CLIR invocation information element?
question_63128.ground_truth: The CLIR invocation information element is sent by the mobile station to the network in the SETUP message to invoke CLIR (Connected Line Identification Restriction) service.

question_63129.question: Who is responsible for allocating resources during MCPTT Group Call setup?
question_63129.ground_truth: The MCPTT AS is responsible for allocating resources during MCPTT Group Call setup.

question_63130.question: What should the NF Service Consumer return on success, if the ContextStatusNotification does not contain a N2 MBS Session Management container with a Broadcast Session Transport Request Transfer IE?
question_63130.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer shall return a "204 No Content" response.

question_63131.question: How is the Multimedia Priority Service invoked and when does it receive priority treatment in the network?
question_63131.ground_truth: The Multimedia Priority Service is invoked only when requested and an idle voice or traffic channel is not available. It receives priority ingress treatment for session origination and priority egress treatment for session delivery.

question_63132.question: When should the MME send a DETACH REQUEST message to the UE with detach type "re-attach required"?
question_63132.ground_truth: The MME should send a DETACH REQUEST message to the UE with detach type "re-attach required" when the service request received is not due to CS fallback or 1xCS fallback.

question_63134.question: In the flow of Scenario I Alternative B, who initiates communication with OCS for RG for the Peer to Peer service?
question_63134.ground_truth: The TDF initiates communication with OCS for RG for the Peer to Peer service.

question_63136.question: What is one of the ways in which network functions and enterprise applications are isolated to run seemingly one at a time and protected by either locking mechanisms or database versioning?

question_63139.question: What are the four main parts of a plain NAS message header for EPS protocols EMM and ESM?
question_63139.ground_truth: The four main parts of a plain NAS message header for EPS protocols EMM and ESM are the protocol discriminator (1/2 octet), a half octet used in some cases as security header type and in other cases as an EPS bearer identity (1/2 octet), a message type octet, and one octet included in some cases and used as a procedure transaction identity (PTI).

question_63140.question: What conditions should be met before the UE sets the logMeasAvailable in the RRCSetupComplete message, as specified in TS 38.331, clause 8.1.6.1.2.1.2.1?
question_63140.ground_truth: The UE should set the logMeasAvailable in the RRCSetupComplete message if it has logged measurements available for NR, the RPLMN is included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarLogMeasReport, and the logged measurements are not included in the logMeasReport in the UEInformationResponse message.

question_63141.question: What action does the GANC take when it receives the GA-RRC UPLINK DIRECT TRANSFER message from the MS in the GA-RRC-CONNECTED state?
question_63141.ground_truth: The GANC transfers the NAS message to the CN using the existing signalling connection.

question_63142.question: What is the difference between the 7.6.3.1 and 7.6.3.2 call flows in terms of sending the SIP INVITE request?
question_63142.ground_truth: In 7.6.3.1, the MGCF defers sending of INVITE until preconditions are met, while in 7.6.3.2, the MGCF sends the SIP INVITE request to the next IMS node before preconditions are fulfilled and requests support for preconditions.

question_63143.question: What was the issue raised in RAN4#93 regarding the "famous sentence" in Rel-15 CR for EN-DC power class clarification?
question_63143.ground_truth: The issue was that the "famous sentence" regarding the UE's power class in EN-DC was unclear, and some vendors wanted to revise the related parameters for more precise PHR reporting.

question_63144.question: What is the function of the Direct Tunnel in the Home eNodeB Subsystem?
question_63144.ground_truth: The Direct Tunnel in the Home eNodeB Subsystem allows for a direct connection between the Home eNodeB Subsystem and the GGSN or Serving GW nodes, bypassing the need for a separate user plane entity.

question_63145.question: What information related to a user's location does the SGSN need to collect for charging purposes in a GPRS network?
question_63145.ground_truth: The SGSN needs to collect information about the user's location, including HPLMN (Home PLMN), VPLMN (Visited PLMN), and optional higher-accuracy location information such as RAI/CGI/SAI.

question_63146.question: What is the main difference between inter-DRNC and intra-DRNC synchronised serving HS-DSCH cell change at a hard handover?
question_63146.ground_truth: The main difference is that in inter-DRNC, the source and target nodes are controlled by two different DRNCs, and in intra-DRNC, both nodes are controlled by the same DRNC. The HS-DSCH mobility procedure is performed in one step for inter-DRNC, and two steps for intra-DRNC.

question_63148.question: What are the required functionalities to support the implementation of Solutions #61 and #62 in NWDAF and ADRF?
question_63148.ground_truth: The required functionalities for implementing Solutions #61 and #62 include the ability of ADRF to store and send ML models, the ability of NWDAF to modify ML filter information and manage ML model storage, and the use of new services for ML model storage, provisioning, and retrieval.

question_63149.question: What is the role of the PGW in the creation of a bearer?
question_63149.ground_truth: The PGW interacts with the PCRF in case dynamic PCC is deployed and initiates the creation of the bearer by sending a Create Bearer Request to the SGW.

question_63150.question: In which scenario would the UE receive a 5GMM cause #90 along with the 5GSM message from the Payload container IE of the DL NAS TRANSPORT message?
question_63150.ground_truth: The UE receives a 5GMM cause #90 along with the 5GSM message from the Payload container IE of the DL NAS TRANSPORT message when the UE is registered to a PLMN via a satellite NG-RAN cell that is not allowed to operate at the present UE location, and the payload of the DL NAS TRANSPORT message cannot be forwarded due to a routing failure.

question_63151.question: What should the MME do if it locally deactivates the EPS bearer contexts of the last remaining PDN connection for non-emergency bearer services and only the PDN connection for emergency bearer services remains established for the UE?
question_63151.ground_truth: The MME considers the UE to be attached for emergency bearer services only.

question_63153.question: What is the purpose of the test procedure in 5.3.2.2.2.4.2?
question_63153.ground_truth: The purpose of the test procedure in 5.3.2.2.2.4.2 is to validate the correct behavior of the UE when transmitting SSB-based and CSI-RS-based Random Access Preambles.

question_63154.question: What is the role of the ThresholdMonitor IOC and on what object instances does it monitor performance metrics?
question_63154.ground_truth: The ThresholdMonitor IOC represents a threshold monitor for performance metrics. It can be name-contained by SubNetwork, ManagedElement, or ManagedFunction. The ThresholdMonitor monitors performance metrics on all object instances below and including the instance name-containing the ThresholdMonitor.

question_63155.question: What restriction is applied when the UE performs inter-frequency measurements on FR1 with a different subcarrier spacing than PDSCH/PDCCH?
question_63155.ground_truth: The UE is not expected to receive PDCCH/PDSCH/TRS/CSI-RS for CQI on the union of restricted serving cell symbols due to measurement of all MOs.

question_63156.question: What is the main advantage of mandating the support of IPsec Transport mode on particular interfaces?
question_63156.ground_truth: The advantage is the smaller IPsec header overhead provided by Transport mode, which eliminates the need for Network Address Translations (NATs) and reduces security domain restrictions.

question_63158.question: What should the minimum number of PRS subframes per cell measurement be in inter-frequency RSTD?
question_63158.ground_truth: The minimum number of PRS subframes per cell measurement in inter-frequency RSTD is as specified in Section 9.1.25.3.

question_63160.question: What should the transmission participant do when it receives a Media reception end request message with the first bit in the subtype set to "1" (Acknowledgment is required)?
question_63160.ground_truth: The transmission participant shall send a Reception control Ack message, inform the user that the receiving RTP media is being ended, request the MCVideo client to discard any remaining buffered RTP media packets and stop displaying to user, send a Media reception end response message towards the transmission control server, and enter the 'terminated' state.

question_63161.question: What happens when an event of interest occurs in ECS?
question_63161.ground_truth: The ECS pushes the event to the CallBack URL, which is then forwarded to the EEC via the push function.

question_63162.question: What is the condition for the old SGSN to initiate the relocation resource allocation procedure?
question_63162.ground_truth: The old SGSN initiates the relocation resource allocation procedure in case of inter-SGSN SRNS relocation.

question_63163.question: What is the definition of transmit OFF power and in what condition the transmitter is considered OFF?
question_63163.ground_truth: Transmit OFF power is the TRP in the channel bandwidth when the transmitter is OFF. The transmitter is considered OFF when the UE is not allowed to transmit on any of its ports.

question_63164.question: To establish which session, what multimedia components need to be transferred from the UE-1 host to UE-2 host in the discussed scenario?
question_63164.ground_truth: To transfer the video portion of the session from UE-1 to UE-2, the SIP REFER request is used to establish the media transfer by including the "m" attribute with the value set to "video 3002 RTP/AVP 98 99" in the "Refer-To" header of the REFER message.

question_63165.question: Which test purpose is reused for the spurious emissions test for the E-UTRA component with 4 NR CCs?
question_63165.ground_truth: The same test purpose as in clause 6.5.3.1 for the NR carrier, which is to verify that the UE complies with the spurious emission test requirements for EN-DC with 4 NR CCs.

question_63166.question: When is re-attempt in A/Gb, Iu, or N1 mode for the same APN (or no APN, if no APN was indicated by the UE) allowed, for the SM cause values #50 "PDN type IPv4 only allowed", #51 "PDN type IPv6 only allowed", #57 "PDN type IPv4v6 only allowed", #58 "PDN type non IP only allowed" and #61 "PDN type Ethernet only allowed"?
question_63166.ground_truth: Re-attempt in A/Gb, Iu, or N1 mode for the same APN (or no APN, if no APN was indicated by the UE) is only allowed using the PDN type(s) indicated by the network for these SM cause values.

question_63170.question: What information should the UDM store when an AMF registers with it?
question_63170.ground_truth: The UDM stores AMF-Set-X-ID, AMF instance, and PLMN-ID for later use when the new serving AMF needs to be contacted.

question_63171.question: What does the '1' value of bit 1 in octet 1 of the GTP' header indicate?
question_63171.ground_truth: In GTP' v0, the '1' value of bit 1 in octet 1 of the GTP' header indicates the usage of the 6 octets header. For all other versions of GTP, this bit is not used and is set to '0'.

question_63172.question: What is an "association" between a VLR and an SGSN in the context of the 3GPP system?
question_63172.ground_truth: An association consists of the SGSN storing the number of the VLR serving the MS for circuit switched services and the VLR storing the number of the SGSN serving the MS for packet switched services. This association is only applicable to MSs in class-A mode of operation and MSs in class-B mode of operation.

question_63173.question: What is the impact of reducing the number of unique BSIC code points to 8 in a BSIC plan on the EC-GSM-IoT synchronization performance?
question_63173.ground_truth: Reducing the number of unique BSIC code points to 8 in a BSIC plan does not have a significant impact on the EC-GSM-IoT synchronization performance.

question_63174.question: What is one potential advantage of using an HTTP body mechanism for negotiating fine-granular extensions in 5G Service-Based Interfaces compared to using custom HTTP headers?
question_63174.ground_truth: One potential advantage is that HTTP bodies are handled directly by applications, while HTTP custom headers can be stripped by some HTTP proxies. Another possible advantage is that the scope of negotiation results can be defined straightforwardly in a top-level resource or subresource representing the NF Service Consumer.

question_63175.question: What are the main issues discussed in the document related to the backhaul long latency problem?
question_63175.ground_truth: The main issues discussed are the impact of long distances between the RAN and the node hosting the application content, and the number of routers on this route, which can result in long transportation latency and affect certain kinds of service.

question_63176.question: What is the initial power control level used by the MS immediately after switching between normal and fast power control mechanisms?
question_63176.ground_truth: The initial power control level to be used by the MS immediately after switching between normal and fast power control mechanisms is the level last commanded by the normal power control mechanism in both cases.

question_63178.question: What network function in the 5GC network does not require any additional functionality to support the MPQUIC-IP steering functionality defined in Rel-18?
question_63178.ground_truth: The AMF (Access and Mobility Management Function) in the 5GC network does not require any additional functionality to support the MPQUIC-IP steering functionality defined in Rel-18.

question_63179.question: What should the network do to maintain the uplink TBF during temporary inactive periods, where the mobile station has no RLC information to send?
question_63179.ground_truth: The network should continue allocating the mobile station uplink radio blocks during the inactivity period, using the procedures defined in clause 8.1.1 for each medium access mode, and send an RLC/MAC control block in each uplink radio block allocated by the network, if there is no RLC data block ready to send.

question_63180.question: What is the pre-condition for the one-to-one off-network MCVideo communication procedure?
question_63180.ground_truth: The pre-condition for the one-to-one off-network MCVideo communication procedure is that the private communication is ongoing between MCVideo client 1 and MCVideo client 2, and MCVideo client 1 is transmitting video to MCVideo client 2.

question_63181.question: What is the purpose of timingslots ISCP measurement in 3GPP TS 36.104 V17.0.0?
question_63181.ground_truth: The timingslots ISCP measurement is a measure of intercell interference in the 3GPP TS 36.104 V17.0.0, which applies only for TDD mode.

question_63182.question: What are the main sets of procedures introduced for NACC in Release 4?
question_63182.ground_truth: The two main sets of procedures introduced for NACC in Release 4 are: 1) sending neighboring cell system information to an MS for initial access after a cell change, and 2) Cell Change Notification (CCN) mode procedures, which support an MS with a cell re-selection and put the MS into CCN mode before the cell change.

question_63184.question: What is the minimum requirement for the Transmit OFF power for 1.28Mcps TDD MC-HSUPA?
question_63184.ground_truth: The transmit OFF power is defined per carrier as the RRC filtered mean power in a duration of at least one timeslot excluding any transient periods. The requirement for the transmit OFF power in each carrier shall be less than -65 dBm, when the transmissions in all carriers are turned off.

question_63185.question: What action must the PDN GW take if it supports 3GPP PS Data Off and receives the 3GPP PS Data Off status in the PCO from the UE?
question_63185.ground_truth: The PDN GW shall provide the 3GPP PS Data Off status to the PCRF and include 3GPP PS Data Off support in the PCO returned to the UE.

question_63186.question: What is the definition of the accuracy requirements for the RSRQ FDD - FDD inter frequency relative accuracy test?
question_63186.ground_truth: The accuracy requirements for the RSRQ FDD - FDD inter frequency relative accuracy test are defined as the RSRQ measured from one cell compared to the RSRQ measured from another cell on a different frequency. These requirements are valid under specific conditions, including the transmission of cell-specific reference signals from one, two, or four antenna ports, fulfillment of reference sensitivity conditions, and a maximum difference in RSRP and channel IO.

question_63187.question: What does a UE use for CSG cell selection and reselection in 3GPP mobile networks?
question_63187.ground_truth: A UE uses the CSG whitelist along with the CSG Identity and associated PLMN ID broadcast by the CSG Cells in CSG cell selection and reselection.

question_63188.question: Which algorithm was selected as the winner of the SHA-3 competition and is used in the Tuak design?

question_63190.question: What should the MBMS GW do when an SGmb path failure is detected and the SGmb path remains down for a duration longer than the maximum path failure duration?
question_63190.ground_truth: The MBMS GW should deactivate all related MBMS Bearer contexts locally and send MBMS Session Stop Requests towards all MME/SGSNs in which the MBMS bearer services are active.

question_63191.question: What is the difference between an open loop SON process and a closed loop SON process?
question_63191.ground_truth: An open loop SON process is semi-autonomous and allows for human intervention, while a closed loop SON process is fully autonomous and only allows for human intervention in case of exceptions.

question_63192.question: What service allows real-time tracking of assets using the Ambient IoT service in airport terminals or shipping ports?
question_63192.ground_truth: The Ambient IoT service provides real-time inventory and location information of different types of assets, allowing for efficient operation through (re)-deployment of assets based on time-varying demand in different locations, prolonged asset life through timely maintenance, improved safety and travel experience, and asset theft prevention.

question_63193.question: What should the SMF do if resources are not allocated in one access network, when the PCC rule allows a GBR QoS Flow in both accesses and the Steering Mode is Redundant?
question_63193.ground_truth: The SMF shall notify the PCF about the resource allocation failure and indicate the respective Access Type.

question_63196.question: What are the two modes between which the network can switch to trade-off capacity vs peak data rate?
question_63196.ground_truth: The two modes are Receive Diversity (RxDiv) mode and the Dual/Multi-carrier mode (MC).

question_63197.question: What should the MS do upon receipt of a CIPHERING MODE COMMAND during an RR connection in A/Gb mode while an established UMTS security context is present?
question_63197.ground_truth: The MS should load the GSM ciphering key from the USIM and take it into use if the CIPHERING MODE COMMAND indicates an A5 ciphering algorithm that requires a 64-bit ciphering key. The MS should also derive a GSM Kc128 from the UMTS ciphering key and the UMTS integrity key using the conversion function named "c3".

question_63198.question: What is the purpose of the "g-3gpp.icsi-ref" feature-capability indicator in 3GPP IP multimedia call control protocol based on Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) and Session Description Protocol (SDP)?
question_63198.ground_truth: The "g-3gpp.icsi-ref" feature-capability indicator indicates the software applications supported by the entity in a standalone transaction or in the dialog.

question_63200.question: What is the role of the M6u API in the UE 5G Uplink Media Streaming functions?
question_63200.ground_truth: The M6u API is used to control the Core Functions and the Media Remote Control function of the UE 5G Uplink Media Streaming functions.

question_63201.question: What is the DIR2 measure used for in the link level modelling for SAIC receivers?
question_63201.ground_truth: The DIR2 measure is used to investigate the validity of using a simple two cochannel interferer model when evaluating the SAIC link level performance.

question_63202.question: Which interface is used for delivering PTC Intercept Product based on duplication of packets without modification at the PoC/MCPTT server?
question_63202.ground_truth: The X3-interface is used for delivering PTC Intercept Product based on duplication of packets without modification at the PoC/MCPTT server.

question_63203.question: What is the role of the NRM server in the MBS session update process?
question_63203.ground_truth: The NRM server is responsible for performing the MBS session update with PCC procedure towards the 5GS, based on the update requirements from the VAL server.

question_63204.question: When is the active flag included in the TAU Request message?
question_63204.ground_truth: The active flag is included in the TAU Request message when the UE requests to activate the radio and S1 bearers for all the active EPS Bearers by the TAU procedure when the UE is in ECM-IDLE state.

question_63205.question: What is a Hosted SEPP scenario in the context of TS 33.501?
question_63205.ground_truth: A Hosted SEPP scenario refers to a network architecture where a hosted SEPP (Service Capability Exposure Point) is used to facilitate communication between different PLMNs (Public Land Mobile Networks) in a 5G system. The Hosted SEPP is not deployed at the edge of the PLMN, and the scenario introduces security requirements for the connection between PLMNs and the Hosted SEPP operator.

question_63207.question: What is the purpose of the Overall Description of the GPRS Radio Interface in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_63207.ground_truth: The Overall Description of the GPRS Radio Interface provides the services offered to higher-layer functions, the distribution of required functions into functional groups, a definition of the capabilities of each functional group, service primitives for each functional group, including a description of what services and information flows are to be provided, and a model of operation for information flows within and between the functions.

question_63209.question: What is the function of the AATRF in the described processes?
question_63209.ground_truth: The AATRF assigns new Sub-Area type IDs to the new environment properties discovered and stores the updated AOI partitioning along with the properties' description.

question_63210.question: What is the state of the UE when the eCall inactivity procedure is started?
question_63210.ground_truth: The UE is in any 5GMM-REGISTERED substate except 5GMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH or 5GMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE, or in 5GMM-IDLE mode.

question_63211.question: What should the 5G-RG or the W-AGF acting on behalf of the FN-RG do if none of the S-NSSAIs in the route selection descriptor is in the allowed NSSAI?
question_63211.ground_truth: The 5G-RG or the W-AGF acting on behalf of the FN-RG should proceed to step 4 if none of the S-NSSAIs in the route selection descriptor is in the allowed NSSAI.

question_63212.question: What should a MS do upon receiving an ATTACH REJECT message with a GMM cause value other than #11, when attempting to attach for emergency bearer services?
question_63212.ground_truth: In addition to the actions described in subclause~4.7.3.1.4, the MS should inform the upper layers of the failure of the procedure.

question_63213.question: What is the possibility of user-initiated data connections, known as Attended Data Traffic, being successfully established when RAN becomes congested?
question_63213.ground_truth: The likelihood of successful establishment and having good through-put for Attended Data Traffic increases when operators treat the data connection activation requests differently based on user initiation.

question_63216.question: In temporary group formation involving multiple MC systems, what is the pre-condition regarding the security aspects between primary and partner MC systems?
question_63216.ground_truth: The pre-condition is that the security aspects of sharing the user information between primary and partner MC systems are governed as per the service provider agreement between them.

question_63217.question: What is the purpose of MCSEC-7.1-2, allowing the decryption of signalling and traffic routed to the non-3GPP system without compromising other data?
question_63217.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure successful interworking between systems with different security mechanisms.

question_63218.question: What is the measure of a receiver's ability to receive a wanted input signal in the presence of an unwanted input signal without exceeding a given degradation, for frequencies other than those of spurious responses or adjacent channels, called?

question_63219.question: What standard specifies the media handling and interaction in Multimedia telephony for IMS?

question_63220.question: What type of mobility procedure is defined in clause 4.23.12.7.1, where the handover is from EPS to 5GS using N26 interface and I-SMF is inserted?
question_63220.ground_truth: Preparation phase for handover from EPS to 5GS using N26 interface with I-SMF insertion.

question_63221.question: What is the encoding method for the absolute vector in the indexing of codevector in base codebook?
question_63221.ground_truth: The encoding method for the absolute vector is a multi-level permutation-based index encoding method.

question_63223.question: What is the maximum allowable BER (bit error rate) for any measured UTRA FDD carrier as defined in clause 7.7.5.2-1 and 7.7.5.2-2?
question_63223.ground_truth: The BER for any measured UTRA FDD carrier should not exceed 0.001.

question_63225.question: What should the floor participant do upon receiving an indication from the MCPTT user to release the queued floor request?
question_63225.ground_truth: The floor participant should send a Floor Release message and enter the 'U: pending Release' state.

question_63226.question: What is the condition for a PRB in the first interlace to be excluded from the resources for a PSFCH transmission in operation with shared spectrum channel access and sl-PSFCH-Type = 'type2'?
question_63226.ground_truth: The PRB is excluded if the difference between the PRB indexes in the first interlace is less than or equal to 5 for certain conditions regarding the PRB subset and the difference between the highest and lowest PRB indexes in the PSFCH transmission.

question_63229.question: What should a UE do when it receives the PMF-Resume Duplication Request message from the UPF?
question_63229.ground_truth: The UE may restart to duplicate the type of traffic for which traffic duplication is resumed based on the provided Redundant steering mode policies and UE implementation.

question_63230.question: What is the role of the Policy Template in the provisioning process?
question_63230.ground_truth: A Policy Template is identified by a Policy Template Id and contains semi-static parameters, including the API entry for the PCF/NEF interactions. It is provisioned by the 5GMSd Application Provider and used by the Media Session Handler when invoking a dynamic policy.

question_63231.question: What is the effect of reducing the bandwidth on the cost savings for MTC UEs?
question_63231.ground_truth: Reducing the bandwidth provides significant cost savings, mainly due to reduced baseband processing. However, the exact number for the relative cost savings varies from one source to another.

question_63232.question: What actions does the Transit Function take if the triggers of the list do not match with the SPTs of the request?
question_63232.ground_truth: The Transit Function proceeds with the next Transit Invocation Criteria in the list until the last criteria has been checked.

question_63233.question: What does the UE indicate in the AN parameters if it is an IAB-node accessing 5GS?
question_63233.ground_truth: The AN parameters shall include an IAB-Indication if the UE is an IAB-node accessing 5GS.

question_63234.question: What does the "Warning Area List NG-RAN" parameter in the Warning Message Content NG-RAN indicate?
question_63234.ground_truth: The Warning Area List NG-RAN parameter in the Warning Message Content NG-RAN indicates the areas where the warning message needs to be broadcast, and consists of a Cell ID list, a NG-RAN TAI list, or an Emergency Area ID list.

question_63235.question: What is the purpose of the HS-SCCH orders in Dual Cell E-DCH operation?
question_63235.ground_truth: The HS-SCCH orders are used by the Node-B to activate and deactivate the Secondary Downlink Frequency and Secondary Uplink Frequency in Dual Cell E-DCH operation.

question_63237.question: What is the meaning of the term "UAS Service Supplier (USS)" in the context of this 3GPP technical specification?
question_63237.ground_truth: A USS is an entity that provides services to support the safe and efficient use of airspace by providing services to the operator/pilot of a UAS in meeting UTM operational requirements.

question_63238.question: In what mode does the UE determine the next paging window for the first eDRX, if no response is received to the paging attempts for the first eDRX and has to use the other S-TMSI from the other GUTI for paging in the second eDRX?
question_63238.ground_truth: The network shall start timer T3415 long enough to care for the paging attempts for both eDRXs.

question_63239.question: What is the role of SCTP in 3GPP TS 36.423?
question_63239.ground_truth: SCTP (IETF RFC 4960) is the transport layer of X2 signalling bearer in 3GPP TS 36.423, and it is used for reliable delivery of X2-AP messages between eNB and en-gNB.

question_63240.question: What HTTP methods can be used to request the update or modification of an MBS User Data Ingest Session?
question_63240.ground_truth: The HTTP methods that can be used to request the update or modification of an MBS User Data Ingest Session are PUT and PATCH.

question_63241.question: What should the NAS do when the lower layers indicate that an access attempt is allowed?
question_63241.ground_truth: The NAS should initiate the procedure to send the initial NAS message for the access attempt.

question_63242.question: What is the minimum number of ports that should be selected for testing if the equipment has a large number of ports?
question_63242.ground_truth: A sufficient number shall be selected to simulate actual operation conditions and to ensure that all the different types of termination are tested.

question_63243.question: What happens to new failed policy decisions when the PCF receives a report?
question_63243.ground_truth: They are not installed in the SMF.

question_63244.question: What does the "clientId" attribute represent in the "rackType" complex type in the XML syntax for a reception report request?
question_63244.ground_truth: The "clientId" attribute in the "rackType" complex type in the XML syntax for a reception report request represents the identifier for a client.

question_63245.question: What is the header field used to provide announcements when a communication request is rejected as defined in 3GPP TS 24.628?
question_63245.ground_truth: The Error-Info header field in the 3xx, 4xx, 5xx or 6xx response to the INVITE request.

question_63246.question: What is the purpose of the performance assurance feature in Rel-16 with respect to management services and 5G performance data?
question_63246.ground_truth: The performance assurance feature in Rel-16 enhances the management of both 5G performance data and related management services.

question_63247.question: What does the MGCF do when it receives a 2xx final response for an early dialogue and the remote resources at IM-MGW do not match?
question_63247.ground_truth: The MGCF requires updating the allocated resources and creates an encapsulated ANM or CON message, sends it within a final 200 OK response to the initial INVITE to the SIP-I based circuit-switched 3GPP core network. To avoid transcoding, the MGCF constructs a new SDP offer based upon the remote resources and sends it within an UPDATE or re-INVITE request.

question_63249.question: What shall the transmission participant do after sending the Transmission end request message?
question_63249.ground_truth: Stop timer T100 and start timer T101.

question_63250.question: What is the main challenge in transitioning from hop-by-hop security to end-to-end security in 5G roaming scenarios?
question_63250.ground_truth: Ensuring that the benefits provided by IPX providers and roaming hubs are maintained, while meeting the 5G security requirements on N32 and avoiding complexities from maintaining a large set of roaming partner-specific modification policies.

question_63251.question: What procedure is initiated by the H-PCRF when the UE initiated IP-CAN session termination is performed and the AF is located in the VPLMN?
question_63251.ground_truth: For each AF session identified in step 4 as bound to the IP-CAN Session being removed, steps 2-10 are executed to proxy AF session signaling over S9 between the V-AF and the H-PCRF.

question_63253.question: What action should the MS take if it receives an unexpected GA-PSR-DEACTIVATE-UTC-ACK message response while the GA-PSR is in GA-PSR-STANDBY state?

question_63254.question: What is the limit for conducted output power based on 3 kHz bandwidth as per the Power Spectrum Density requirement for LTE point-to-multipoint communication?
question_63254.ground_truth: The limit for conducted output power based on 3 kHz bandwidth as per the Power Spectrum Density requirement for LTE point-to-multipoint communication is 8 dBm in any 3 kHz band during any time interval of continuous transmission.

question_63256.question: What is the difference between the solution of compressing the outer and inner headers separately, excluding GTP and including GTP?
question_63256.ground_truth: The solution of compressing the outer and inner headers separately, including GTP, requires the definition of a new ROHC profile for IP/UDP/GTP, which requires effort from the IETF or 3GPP. The resulting compressed header would be 1 byte for the ROHC packet type and 2 bytes of CID.

question_63257.question: What does the term "IRP" stands for in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
question_63257.ground_truth: IRP stands for Integration Reference Point, which is a way of communication between network elements.

question_63258.question: What does "SUL" stand for in the document?

question_63259.question: How many timeslots are assigned to the uplink TBF in the assignment message for EGPRS when K = 4?
question_63259.ground_truth: The number of timeslots assigned to the uplink TBF in the assignment message for EGPRS when K = 4 is 3.

question_63260.question: What IETF RFC describes the reliability of provisional responses needed for the reliable exchange of an SDP offer and SDP answer in IMS networks?

question_63261.question: What is the formula for the estimation error of the timing of the strongest path in NPRACH for preamble detection?
question_63261.ground_truth: The estimation error of the timing of the strongest path is larger than 3.646 us.

question_63264.question: What modes of communication does 5G ProSe direct communication over PC5 support?
question_63264.ground_truth: 5G ProSe direct communication over PC5 supports broadcast mode, groupcast mode, and unicast mode. The UE may use the PC5 DRX mechanism to perform 5G ProSe direct communication over PC5 interface for broadcast mode and groupcast mode when the UE is not served by NG-RAN.

question_63265.question: What is a Broadcast MBS session and how does it differ from a Multicast MBS session in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_63265.ground_truth: A Broadcast MBS session is an MBS session used to deliver a broadcast communication service, characterized by the content to send and the geographical area where to distribute it. It is used to simultaneously provide the same service and specific content data to all UEs in a geographical area. In contrast, a Multicast MBS session is an MBS session used to deliver a multicast communication service, which is characterized by the content to send, the list of UEs that may receive the service, and optionally a geographical area where to distribute it.

question_63266.question: For what purpose should the gNB-DU use the Resource Coordination Transfer Information IE, and when should it be included in the UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message?
question_63266.ground_truth: The gNB-DU should use the Resource Coordination Transfer Information IE for resource coordination. It should be included in the UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message for EN-DC, NGEN-DC, or NE-DC operation after completion of UE Context Setup procedures.

question_63268.question: What should the MS do when it receives a TCP Reset after TCP connection failure in the state GA-CSR IDLE?
question_63268.ground_truth: The MS tries to re-establish the TCP connection, and if successful, sends the GA-RC SYNCHRONIZATION INFORMATION to the GANC. If unsuccessful, the MS releases the related local GA-RC or GA-PSR resources, and continues as per section 9.5.

question_63272.question: What is the maximum duration that a UE should monitor downlink channels of the serving NB-IoT cell for paging reception during intra-frequency and inter-frequency cell re-selection?
question_63272.ground_truth: The maximum duration for paging reception monitoring during intra-frequency and inter-frequency cell re-selection is TSI-NB1-NC + 100 ms.

question_63273.question: What is the purpose of grouping bands for satellite access in NB-IOT and category M1?
question_63273.ground_truth: The purpose is to increase the readability of the specification.

question_63274.question: Which mode of H(e)NB provides services to non-CSG members as well as CSG members?
question_63274.ground_truth: Hybrid access mode is the mode of H(e)NB that provides services to non-CSG members as well as CSG members.

question_63275.question: What is the required interruption time when the UE receives a RRC message implying FDD/TDD handover with the activation time "now" or earlier than RRC procedure delay seconds from the end of the last TTI containing the RRC command?
question_63275.ground_truth: The UE shall be ready to start the transmission of the new uplink DPCH within Dhandover seconds from the end of the last TTI containing the RRC command, where Dhandover is the RRC procedure delay plus the interruption time.

question_63276.question: What are the protocols used for compressing headers of the encapsulated traffic in IHC?
question_63276.ground_truth: Ethernet Header Compression (EHC) and Robust Header Compression (ROHC)

question_63278.question: What operation type is specified in the Notify sent by the VNFM to the EM in step 4.2.3.1.2 to indicate the result of VNF scaling?

question_63279.question: If the MS has reached the maximum number of active PDP contexts and additional PDP context is requested, what action shall the MS not take?
question_63279.ground_truth: Send an ACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message or an ACTIVATE SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message to activate the additional PDP context.

question_63281.question: What is the maximum allowed difference in received power for the UE in 6.3.8.2.2.1?
question_63281.ground_truth: The maximum allowed difference in received power for the UE in 6.3.8.2.2.1 is specified in 8.2.1.7 of TS 36.101.

question_63282.question: What is the effect of using the "allRequests" parameter in the Cancel operation for the gsmSSF?
question_63282.ground_truth: When the "allRequests" parameter is used, all armed EDPs are disarmed, and any pending "ApplyChargingReport" and "CallInformationReport" are cancelled, causing the gsmSSF FSM to transit to the state "Idle".

question_63283.question: What is the implementation-dependent delay for Ttransc?
question_63283.ground_truth: The implementation-dependent delay for Ttransc is the speech encoder processing time, from input of the last PCM sample to output of the final encoded bit.

question_63286.question: What message does the new IAB-donor-CU send to the new parent IAB-DU in the backhaul RLF recovery procedure for an IAB-node in SA mode?
question_63286.ground_truth: The new IAB-donor-CU sends a DL RRC MESSAGE TRANSFER message to the new parent IAB-DU, to convey the generated RRCReestablishment message in the backhaul RLF recovery procedure for an IAB-node in SA mode.

question_63288.question: What message does the MAG send to the PDN GW to establish a new registration for the UE?
question_63288.ground_truth: The MAG sends a Proxy Binding Update message (MN-NAI, Lifetime, Access Technology Type, Handover Indicator, APN, GRE key for downlink traffic) to the PDN GW.

question_63291.question: What should NM request NFVO to do if the virtualized part of a gNB needs to be instantiated by updating an existing NS?
question_63291.ground_truth: NM should request NFVO to on-board the VNF package corresponding to the virtualized part of a gNB, on-board the PNFD corresponding to the non-virtualized part of a gNB, update the NSD if needed, enable the VNF package and NSD, and update the NS identified by nsInstanceId.

question_63292.question: What is the procedure for short message forwarding when it is active for terminating user?
question_63292.ground_truth: When short message forwarding is active for terminating user, the VAS AS B takes a loop check for original SM, decides the message needs to be forwarded or not, and delivers the original short message to the MS C or the terminating user accordingly. The VAS AS B then sends a report to SMS Node B, and the SMS Node B notifies the originating side of the delivery status.

question_63293.question: What is the FAE server's response after the 3GPP system establishes or modifies the requested connectivity?
question_63293.ground_truth: The FAE server notifies both FAE clients of the established connection including its properties such as a FFA-2 direct service connection identifier and duration, regardless of traffic routing between FAE client 1 and FAE client 2 over FFA-2.

question_63294.question: In the MSGin5G message segment recovery procedure, what should be included in the CoAP payload for indicating the range of missing segments?
question_63294.ground_truth: In the MSGin5G message segment recovery procedure, a "List of Segment range" element should be included in the CoAP payload encoded in JSON format for indicating the range of missing segments. Each segment range consists of start and end sequence numbers of missing segments, e.g. (5-7, 10-10, 15-19).

question_63296.question: What is the required capability of the signal generation device in terms of clock signal frequency?
question_63296.ground_truth: The signal generation device shall be capable of generating square wave signals for the clock on the UICC in the range of 1~MHz to 5~MHz.

question_63298.question: What action would the transmission participant take upon receiving Transmission Rejected message, if the <User ID> value in the User ID field matches its own MCVideo ID and User ID of transmission participant sending the Transmission Rejected message matches the stored User ID of current transmission arbitrator?
question_63298.ground_truth: The transmission participant would stop the timer T201 (Transmission Request), provide transmission deny notification to the user, may display the transmission deny reason to the user using information in the Reject Cause field, and enter 'O: has no permission' state.

question_63299.question: What is the role of Quality of Experience (QoE) information collection in mobile networks?
question_63299.ground_truth: Quality of Experience (QoE) information collection provides detailed information at the session level on a number of User Equipment (UEs) and is vital for network operators, especially for real-time services that require high data rates and low latency.

question_63302.question: What is the result of the PCC updating the bearer priority for the bearer that contains the SDFs associated with the same priority sharing information?
question_63302.ground_truth: The priority is set to the highest priority (lowest ARP) among those SDFs.

question_63303.question: What happens to the MCPTT group call when it is upgraded to an MCPTT emergency group call?
question_63303.ground_truth: All MCPTT group calls within the group are processed as emergency group calls by the MCPTT server, and MCPTT group members that are not in the emergency state set the requested priority of all group call requests to high priority.

question_63308.question: What must the Source Port or Flow Label field be for GTP-U messages (excluding Echo Response and encapsulated T-PDUs) when sent over the transport network?
question_63308.ground_truth: Dynamically set by the sending GTP-U entity to help balance the load in the transport network

question_63309.question: What is the implication of the GGSN detecting that the 3GPP PS Data Off UE Status is active in Iu mode of operation?
question_63309.ground_truth: The GGSN shall indicate this to the charging system for offline and online charging.

question_63310.question: What is the purpose of the Policy Control Function (PCF) in the 5G Core Network?
question_63310.ground_truth: The Policy Control Function (PCF) may support interactions with the slice replacement functionality in the AMF and may provide slice replacement related policies to the AMF.

question_63311.question: What is the measurement provided in 5.1.1.1.6, and what does it calculate?
question_63311.ground_truth: The measurement provided in 5.1.1.1.6 is the distribution of DL packet delay between NG-RAN and UE. It calculates the delay incurred in NG-RAN and the delay over Uu interface. The measurement is calculated per PLMN ID, per 5QI, and per supported S-NSSAI.

question_63312.question: What is the keyword used in JSON schema to describe a set of valid schema documents sent over the wire in HTTP request and response messages of the ProvMnS?

question_63313.question: What are the two sidelink resource allocation schemes for SL-PRS transmission and reception?
question_63313.ground_truth: The two sidelink resource allocation schemes for SL-PRS transmission and reception are scheme 1, where the SL-PRS resource allocation is provided by the network, and scheme 2, where the UE decides the SL-PRS transmission resources in the resource pool(s).

question_63314.question: What message does the MS send to the network to initiate a MO-LR procedure with control classmark sending, indicating its LCS positioning method capability?
question_63314.ground_truth: The MS sends a REGISTER message containing a LCS-MOLR invoke component with MO-LR TYPE set to LocationEstimate, LCS QoS value and other optional fields if needed.

question_63315.question: When will the UE abort the service request procedure, stop timer T3417, T3417ext or T3417ext-mt and locally release any resources allocated for the service request procedure?
question_63315.ground_truth: When the service request was not initiated for CS fallback or 1xCS fallback, when T3417 expired, or when the UE triggered the service request procedure in EMM-IDLE mode in order to obtain packet services and the service request is initiated for a reason other than those listed in NOTE 3.

question_63316.question: What information is considered at two levels in the context of GTP-c load/overload control?
question_63316.ground_truth: The Overload information is considered at two levels: GTP-c Node and APN.

question_63319.question: What is the requirement for determining authorization for initiating an MCPTT imminent peril call?
question_63319.ground_truth: The IWF shall obtain the MCPTT user profile and the group information if the MCPTT user is authorized to initiate an imminent peril call and if the IWF allows the group to support imminent peril calls.

question_63320.question: What message type is used for the network to acknowledge the modification of an active PDP context in the "network to MS direction"?
question_63320.ground_truth: Modify PDP context accept (Network to MS direction)

question_63321.question: What should the AMF do when making the UE aware of DL data that has arrived without downlink N3 tunnel information?
question_63321.ground_truth: The AMF should initiate Network Triggered Service Request procedure, unless the UE is unreachable or reachable only for regulatory prioritized service and the PDU Session is not for regulatory prioritized service.

question_63322.question: What is the format of the parameter "pathlossReferenceInformation" in the structure "SRSResourceSet-Item"?

question_63326.question: What is the SNR value at the start of time duration T2?
question_63326.ground_truth: The SNR value at the start of time duration T2 is the same as the SNR value at the end of time window dT before T2.

question_63328.question: What is the objective of the work item specified in the document?
question_63328.ground_truth: The objective of the work item is to specify the RF requirements for E-UTRA medium range and MSR medium range and local area BS classes.

question_63329.question: What is the spectral shape constraint used for computing the FIR filter for the mid-band processing?
question_63329.ground_truth: A novel spectral shape constraint is used for computing the FIR filter for the mid-band processing.

question_63330.question: If the SIM Toolkit Framework uses the SET UP IDLE MODE TEXT proactive command, can another applet overwrite this text at a later stage?
question_63330.ground_truth: The SIM Toolkit Framework cannot guarantee that if the SET UP IDLE MODE TEXT proactive command is used by a toolkit applet, another toolkit applet will not overwrite this text at a later stage.
