question_63332.question: Who is the work item rapporteur for the SA5 features related to Home NB and HeNB management in Release 9?

question_63333.question: What should the UE (MCDATA Client) do when the MCDATA User requests to release the one-to-one SDS session?
question_63333.ground_truth: The UE (MCDATA Client) should send a SIP BYE message to the SDS server to release the one-to-one SDS session.

question_63334.question: What is the modulation used for uplink transmission when an EGPRS MS only supports GMSK modulation in the test?
question_63334.ground_truth: A GMSK-modulated signal will be used for UL transmission.

question_63335.question: Which long term CQI reporting method allows the reuse of the legacy HS-DPCCH slot format?
question_63335.ground_truth: Solution 2 allows the reuse of the legacy HS-DPCCH slot format for long term CQI reporting.

question_63336.question: Which interface definition is not provided in the document for standardized X2?
question_63336.ground_truth: The standardized X2 interface is not provided in the document for transporting IRI.

question_63337.question: What were the findings of the sleep ratio and sleep duration for NR satellite access network?
question_63337.ground_truth: The network can achieve more than 80% of sleep ratio with an SSB set period of 5ms, and more than 90% with an SSB set period of greater than 10ms. NR network can achieve more than 150ms of sleep duration with an SSB set period of 160ms.

question_63338.question: What information does the 3GPP Core Network use to define traffic steering policies in (S)Gi-LAN for efficient and flexible mobile service steering?
question_63338.ground_truth: The 3GPP Core Network uses information such as user profile, network operator's policies, RAT type, application characteristics and UE location to define traffic steering policies in (S)Gi-LAN for efficient and flexible mobile service steering.

question_63339.question: What information does the User Plane status information event notification contain?
question_63339.ground_truth: The User Plane status information event notification contains the PDU Session ID, User Plane Inactivity Timer, and PDU Session status.

question_63341.question: What does the parameter "group" indicate in a binding indication?
question_63341.ground_truth: The parameter "group" is a boolean indicating if the binding indication is for a group of resource/session contexts.

question_63343.question: What is the outage rate percentage per call in bi-directional Scenario-B without DPS with a train traveling in the opposite direction?
question_63343.ground_truth: The outage rate percentage per call in bi-directional Scenario-B without DPS with a train traveling in the opposite direction is significantly higher with DRX 160 ms than in other DRX cycles.

question_63344.question: What is one way that broadcast transmission of Ads can occur in advance of the ad break?
question_63344.ground_truth: Broadcast transmission of Ads can occur well in advance of the ad break (e.g. overnight before the football game the next day) through selective download and caching of Ads by the MBMS client.

question_63345.question: What are the signalling interworking procedures between ISUP and SIP protocols defined in ITU-T Recommendation Q.1912.5, profile C?
question_63345.ground_truth: The signalling interworking procedures between ISUP and SIP protocols defined in ITU-T Recommendation Q.1912.5, profile C include interworking for ISUP capabilities, signalling information, SIP messages and SDP parameters, among others.

question_63346.question: In which message and layer does the UE include a P-TMSI signature for authentication and identification purposes in the subsequent attach, routing area update or detach procedure?
question_63346.ground_truth: The P-TMSI signature is used in combination with a valid P-TMSI in an ATTACH REQUEST, ROUTING AREA UPDATE REQUEST, or if present, an DE-REGISTER P-TMSI COMPLETE message in the GMM layer.

question_63347.question: What is the use of LegID in CAP V4?
question_63347.ground_truth: In CAP V4, two types of LegID may be exchanged between the gsmSCF and the gsmSSF - Sending Side LegID and Receiving Side LegID. Sending Side LegID is used in operations sent from the gsmSCF to the gsmSSF, and Receiving Side LegID is used in operations sent from the gsmSSF to the gsmSCF.

question_63348.question: Which state is the MCPTT client in after sending an Acknowledgement message when it receives a Disconnect message?
question_63348.ground_truth: It remains in the state 'U: Pre-established session not in use'.

question_63351.question: In the ST-LR test series, how were the codecs tested for performance characterization over bit-rate?
question_63351.ground_truth: Two experiments involved the two selected 3GPP audio codecs operating at different bit-rates in mono and stereo modes. In each experiment, the MUSHRA ratings from 15 subjects, 12 test items, and two listening labs created the results.

question_63352.question: If the security check is successful, what should the UE do with the secured packet after receiving it from the AMF?
question_63352.ground_truth: The UE shall upload the secured packet to the USIM using procedures in 3GPP~TS~31.111.

question_63353.question: What is the main objective of a 5GC Network Expectation?
question_63353.ground_truth: A 5GC Network Expectation is an IntentExpectation that represents the expectations of a MnS consumer for a 5GC network (5G core network) to meet their demands relating to the provision and assurance of specified network services.

question_63354.question: What is the purpose of the measurement named SC.SuccSession180.AT in the context of 4.1.2.16 Successful session establishments per access technology?
question_63354.ground_truth: The purpose of the measurement named SC.SuccSession180.AT is to provide the number of successful session establishments from the UE belonging to a given access technology at P-CSCF.

question_63355.question: Under what conditions will the gprsSSF transit to the state "Idle" after the RequestReportGPRSEvent procedure?
question_63355.ground_truth: The gprsSSF transits to the state "Idle" after the RequestReportGPRSEvent procedure if there are no pending reports or armed events.

question_63356.question: What is the purpose of UEContextReleaseComplete message in F1AP protocol?
question_63356.ground_truth: UEContextReleaseComplete message in F1AP protocol is used to confirm the completion of a UE context release procedure.

question_63358.question: What element is used to indicate success or failure of the resource request operation in the request-result sub-element?
question_63358.ground_truth: A string set to either "success" or "failure"

question_63359.question: What does bit 7 in octet 5 indicate in non-transparent service?
question_63359.ground_truth: Bit 7 in octet 5 indicates the type of service for non-transparent service: 0 indicates transparent service, 1 indicates non-transparent service.

question_63363.question: What is the purpose of using different DMRS resources in contention based PUSCH resource assignments?
question_63363.ground_truth: The purpose is to allow the eNB to identify the exact UE that performed the PUSCH transmission, even if collision happens.

question_63365.question: For option DL-1 and DL-2, what needs to be done for the new designs of PCFICH/PHICH/PDCCH when reducing bandwidth?
question_63365.ground_truth: These channels would need to be sent within the bandwidth supported by the MTC UEs, and a common search space would also need to be defined. The corresponding PUCCH resource mapping for HARQ-ACK may also be affected.

question_63366.question: What message does the MS send upon receiving the Packet Physical Information message in a pre-synchronised handover?
question_63366.ground_truth: The MS sends uplink LLC PDUs, e.g. a Routing Area Update Request message or uplink user data packets to the SGSN immediately after receiving the Packet Physical Information message or, in a synchronised or pre-synchronised handover, immediately if the PS Handover Access message is not required to be sent.

question_63367.question: In 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay update procedure, what message is used to update the target 5G ProSe end UE(s) with the source 5G ProSe end UE's new IP address/prefix and new Application layer ID?
question_63367.ground_truth: The PROSE UE TO UE RELAY UPDATE REQUEST message is used to update the target 5G ProSe end UE(s) with the source 5G ProSe end UE's new IP address/prefix and new Application layer ID.

question_63369.question: How does the data rate for time-dilated UMTS change for delay sensitive radio bearers such as the standalone 3.4 kbps signalling radio bearers on DCH?
question_63369.ground_truth: For time-dilated UMTS N=2, the same bit-rate as UMTS should be maintained for delay sensitive radio bearers such as the standalone 3.4 kbps signalling radio bearers on DCH.

question_63370.question: What does the Radio-Resource-Loading-List indicate and what information does it contain?
question_63370.ground_truth: The Radio-Resource-Loading-List indicates a list of the predicted short term load of each cell in the list expressed as a percentage. The calculation of this percentage is an implementation matter, but the load should reflect the number of used slots, and schedule messages and reserved slots must be taken into account. The cells in the list are described as per clause~9.3.11 and the information element Radio-Resource-Loading is associated with each cell in the list. This information element is related to the particular referenced cell in the list and contains the cells load.

question_63371.question: What is the purpose of the "Message Identifier" in the H.248 package?
question_63371.ground_truth: The "Message Identifier" is used to identify the originator of the message. It consists of the fully qualified domain name of the TrGW and IBCF.

question_63373.question: Under what circumstances should an IWF reject a request to send SDS to an MCData group?
question_63373.ground_truth: If the <mcdata-allow-short-data-service> element under the <list-service> element, in the group document, is set to "false" for the MCData group.

question_63374.question: How many logical RN UEs are there in the Alt.2 relay node with dual Rel-10 relays?
question_63374.ground_truth: There are two logical RN UEs that work alternatively to support the high-speed train scenario in Alt.2 relay node with dual Rel-10 relays.

question_63375.question: What is the procedure for storing user data in non-volatile memory in the secondary device?
question_63375.ground_truth: The secondary device stores user data in non-volatile memory starting with the relative memory address offset given in the initiating message and ensures that the number of octets to write is less than or equal to MaxDataReceiveLength minus 3.

question_63378.question: What should the NF Service Consumer do after receiving a 200 OK response from the SMF upon a request to deactivate the N3 tunnel of a PDU session?
question_63378.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should return a 200 OK response with the upCnxState attribute set to DEACTIVATED.

question_63379.question: What is the significance of the "name: value" pair in the manifest file?
question_63379.ground_truth: The "name: value" pair in the manifest file provides information about the data in the JAR file, such as the type of the contained files and their intended usage.

question_63380.question: What is the difference between a Medium Range Base Station and a Wide Area Base Station in terms of minimum coupling loss?
question_63380.ground_truth: A Medium Range Base Station has a minimum coupling loss of 53 dB, while a Wide Area Base Station has a minimum coupling loss of 70 dB.

question_63381.question: What information is used to identify the UE for whom the Proxy Binding Update message is being sent in the Proxy Binding Update message?
question_63381.ground_truth: The MN NAI (Mobile Node - Network Access Identifier) identifies the UE for whom the message is being sent.

question_63383.question: What is the purpose of a PCC rule in the 5GC system?
question_63383.ground_truth: A PCC rule in the 5GC system is used to detect a packet belonging to a service data flow, identify the service to which the service data flow contributes to, provide applicable charging parameters for a service data flow, and provide policy control for a service data flow.

question_63385.question: What is the purpose of the test case described in 7.5.1.5.1?
question_63385.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that the UE (User Equipment) properly detects out-of-sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink CSI-RS (Cumulative Spectrogram Image) based radio link quality of the PCell (Primary Cell) when no DRX (Discontinuous Reception) is used.

question_63386.question: What is the main issue identified for NR operation in unlicensed band for connected mode mobility?
question_63386.ground_truth: The main issue identified is the reduced transmission opportunities for different signalings due to LBT failure.

question_63387.question: What is the mean power saving gain provided by the R17 PDCCH monitoring adaptation scheme in FR1, DL only evaluation, InH, VR/AR30 and low load?
question_63387.ground_truth: The mean power saving gain provided is 23.33%.

question_63390.question: What is the purpose of the radio bearer test mode in the context of UE test loop function?
question_63390.ground_truth: The radio bearer test mode is used to set up radio bearers to be terminated in the UE test loop function without involving CC or SM, and to disable any control mechanisms in NAS protocols or in any UE applications that could release the RRC connection.

question_63391.question: What does the "3gpp-Sbi-Routing-Binding" HTTP custom header parameter indicate in the context of 3GPP Technical Specification Group Core Network and Terminals?
question_63391.ground_truth: The "3gpp-Sbi-Routing-Binding" HTTP custom header parameter (bl) indicates the binding entity towards which a preferred binding exists. This can be an NF Service Instance, NF Service Set, NF Instance, or an NF Set.

question_63392.question: What is the minimum received power level that a RAT specific requirement is met, for an isotropic directivity device equivalent to the sensitivity of the discussed device exposed to an incoming wave from a defined Angle of Arrival (AoA)?

question_63393.question: What is the purpose of the Initial-DL-DPCH-TimingAdjustment_Allowed field in NBAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION?
question_63393.ground_truth: The Initial-DL-DPCH-TimingAdjustment_Allowed field in NBAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION is for specifying the initial Lolin TX WINDOW phase difference accepted by the NoDE, the first value is 0 and last value is 100, the value is for 3GPP, please refer to 3GPP TS 45.001 for more information

question_63395.question: What information can be included in the SAND header of an HTTP request in the described messaging protocol?
question_63395.ground_truth: The SAND header of an HTTP request in this messaging protocol can include status messages on proxy caching, such as anticipated requests, accepted alternatives, and next alternatives.

question_63398.question: How many successful reported values are required for the test to pass?
question_63398.ground_truth: The ratio of successful reported values in each test must be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95% for the test to pass.

question_63399.question: What specifications have been introduced to support SRVCC from 5G to 3G?

question_63400.question: How does the PGW-C+SMF provide S-NSSAI to the UE when establishing a PDN connection over EPC?
question_63400.ground_truth: The PGW-C+SMF provides the S-NSSAI and a PLMN ID that the S-NSSAI relates to when establishing a PDN connection over EPC.

question_63401.question: What does the Resource-Share header field indicate in the initial REGISTER request in the 3GPP network architecture?
question_63401.ground_truth: The Resource-Share header field in the initial REGISTER request indicates that the P-CSCF supports resource sharing and defers the determination of potential resource sharing to an AS in the home network.

question_63402.question: What adjustment is applied to the wanted input signal level for all classes of MS that support 8-PSK speech channels, as specified in the test procedure?
question_63402.ground_truth: An additional +2 dB adjustment is applied to the wanted input signal level for all classes of MS that support 8-PSK speech channels.

question_63403.question: What is the system information combination for NR Cells 1 and 3, as defined in TS 38.508-1?
question_63403.ground_truth: The system information combination for NR Cells 1 and 3 is NR-1.

question_63404.question: Which command type is used in the TERMINAL RESPONSE message with 3G Session Reset procedure?
question_63404.ground_truth: The REFRESH command type is used in the TERMINAL RESPONSE message with 3G Session Reset procedure.

question_63405.question: How does the MnS consumer determine if an attribute field has been deleted or not changed when some attribute fields are not reported?
question_63405.ground_truth: The MnS consumer cannot distinguish between the two cases based on the information in the notification because the old attribute fields are not included in the notification.

question_63406.question: What is the impact of the new procedures between the group management server and IWF on existing nodes and functionality?
question_63406.ground_truth: The new procedures may impact existing nodes and functionality by introducing a new user regroup procedure for interworking, which replaces the existing group creation procedure defined in 3GPP~TS~23.379.

question_63407.question: What message does the control plane function send to the user plane function to request the modification of an existing PDN or TDF session?
question_63407.ground_truth: The control plane function sends a Sx session modification request message to the user plane function, which contains the structured control information that defines how the user plane function needs to modify the session.

question_63408.question: What does the UE send after receiving a 200 OK concluding the authentication when it has started authentication using Digest or GBA?
question_63408.ground_truth: The UE sends an HTTP request to activate incoming communication barring for all calls (ICB).

question_63409.question: What events are detected by Mobility Robustness Optimization related to connection failures due to intra-system mobility?
question_63409.ground_truth: Intra-system Too Late Handover, Intra-system Too Early Handover, and Intra-system Handover to Wrong Cell are detected by Mobility Robustness Optimization.

question_63411.question: What are the three general architectures to offer energy savings functionalities?
question_63411.ground_truth: The three architectures are Distributed, NM-Centralized, and EM-Centralized.

question_63412.question: What shall the participating MCPTT function include in the SIP 200 (OK) response when generating it?
question_63412.ground_truth: A SDP answer as specified in subclause 6.3.2.1.2.1.

question_63413.question: When is the use of control plane CIoT 5GS optimization mandatory for the network in NB-N1 mode?
question_63413.ground_truth: The use of control plane CIoT 5GS optimization is mandatory for the network in NB-N1 mode to support efficient transport of user data or SMS messages over control plane via the AMF.

question_63414.question: What is the difference between "self-declaration" and "evaluation without accreditation" in the context of the document?
question_63414.ground_truth: "Self-declaration" refers to a vendor-provided declaration of its network product's security based on an evaluation report, while "evaluation without accreditation" refers to an evaluation process without accreditation of the labs in the country where the Security Assurance process is required.

question_63416.question: What should the UE do if it has received a REGISTRATION REJECT message including 5GMM cause #5 "PEI not accepted" during an initial registration for emergency services?
question_63416.ground_truth: The UE shall enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-SUPI.

question_63417.question: What is the purpose of the location service registration procedure?
question_63417.ground_truth: The location service registration procedure allows the Location Management Client to register the available location services to the LM Server, providing the UE's identifier and UE-based location capabilities, so that the LM Server can request location information for the target UE when necessary.

question_63418.question: What does the NF do when it receives partial update indicator true in the NFR procedure?
question_63418.ground_truth: The NF compares the received NF status data with the NF profile locally stored and recognizes out which data is changed. The UDM stores received recovery time and user identifier ranges if the recovery time or user identifier ranges are changed. The UDM may include UDR recovery indication, recovery time of UDR, and impacted user identifier ranges in response headers via NF service consumers. The NF service consumers synchronize data related to the indicated users based on local policy.

question_63419.question: When performing the manual commencement mode procedures, what should the MCVideo client do if the MCVideo user declines the MCVideo session invitation?
question_63419.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should send a SIP 480 (Temporarily Unavailable) response towards the MCVideo server with a warning text set to: "110 user declined the call invitation".

question_63420.question: What is the pre-condition for media replication in the partner MC system of the MC service group?
question_63420.ground_truth: MC service clients 1, 2, 3 and n have affiliated to the MC service group and are receiving MC service in the primary MC system of the MC service group or one or more of MC service clients 2, 3 and n have successfully migrated to a partner MC system.

question_63421.question: What is the minimum required isolation for ensuring co-location of two base stations in the 7 - 24 GHz region with a victim sensitivity degradation of 1dB?
question_63421.ground_truth: An isolation of at least 70dB will be required.

question_63422.question: What is the procedure for releasing a chat group call?
question_63422.ground_truth: The server can release a chat group call by sending a group call release to all joined clients. This will release the media plane for all joined clients.

question_63424.question: In what situations is the UE required to receive E-HICH subframes?
question_63424.ground_truth: The UE is required to receive E-HICH subframes when it has received DRX de-activation or when it shall receive E-HICH subframes corresponding to an E-DCH transmission.

question_63425.question: What data type is used for the "transaction-ID" in the "AnnounceRsp-info" and "MonitorRsp-info" complex types?
question_63425.ground_truth: The "transaction-ID" in the "AnnounceRsp-info" and "MonitorRsp-info" complex types is of the "integer" data type.

question_63426.question: What is the maximum BLER performance for PDTCH/MCS5 to 9?
question_63426.ground_truth: The maximum BLER performance for PDTCH/MCS5 to 9 depends on the coding schemes, and it should not exceed 10% or 30%.

question_63427.question: What is a CS call in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
question_63427.ground_truth: A CS call, or Circuit Switched call, is a call routed through the CS domain. It can be a speech call, fax call, or data call, and it uses one bearer at a time.

question_63429.question: What is the main challenge in mapping the desired slice coverage into a geographical coverage area?
question_63429.ground_truth: The challenges are mapping the coverage area in the service profile to TA list assigned to cells, and ensuring that the desired slice coverage can be mapped to the coverage footprint of a cell or set of cells.

question_63430.question: What precautions must be taken when using LTE-Advanced Carrier Aggregation of Band 3 and Band 7 with 2 DLs to prevent distortions from falling into the receive bands of other bands?
question_63430.ground_truth: Harmonics and intermodulation products should not fall into the own receive bands. However, for the 1 UE operating in B3 + B7 and any other band simultaneously, this should not be a problem, given that UE filters can effectively attenuate these IMD products.

question_63431.question: What action must the MCPTT server take if a binding exists between the IMS public user identity and the MCPTT ID in the request, and the validity period of the binding has not expired?
question_63431.ground_truth: The MCPTT server must download the MCPTT user profile from the MCPTT user database if it is not already stored at the MCPTT server.

question_63433.question: What happens to the stored 5G-GUTI, TAI list, and last visited registered TAI when a certain error occurs in non-3GPP access?
question_63433.ground_truth: The UE should delete these stored values when the AUTHENTICATION REJECT message is received over non-3GPP access.

question_63434.question: When the UE determines the number of resource elements (NRE) for a PUSCH within a slot, what is used to determine the number of subcarriers in the frequency domain in a physical resource block (PRB)?
question_63434.ground_truth: The number of subcarriers in the frequency domain in a PRB is determined by the numerology used for the uplink, which is specified in TS 38.214.

question_63435.question: What is the format of a CBS message and how is it transmitted?
question_63435.ground_truth: A CBS message comprises of up to 15 pages, each consisting of 82 octets which equates to 93 characters. These pages may be concatenated to form a message. The messages are broadcasted cyclically by the cell and transmitted to defined geographical areas known as cell broadcast areas, which may comprise of one or more cells, or may cover an entire PLMN or SNPN.

question_63436.question: What message is used to assign downlink PS resources to the MS by the SS?
question_63436.ground_truth: The PACKET ASSIGNMENT message is used to assign downlink PS resources to the MS by the SS.

question_63437.question: What is the general principle of LPC (Linearly Predictive Coding) shaping in MDCT domain?
question_63437.ground_truth: LPC shaping is performed in the MDCT domain by applying gain factors computed from weighted quantized LP filter coefficients to the MDCT spectrum.

question_63438.question: What actions does the PSS Adapter take upon receipt of a SIP INVITE message?
question_63438.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a SIP INVITE message, the PSS Adapter resolves the RTSP URI based on the R-URI, SDP parameters and selected PSS Server, may send a DESCRIBE message to the PSS Server to fetch the SDP file, constructs and sends RTSP SETUP message(s) to setup the relevant media streams, and returns the answer SDP to the UE in the SIP 200 OK.

question_63439.question: What is the purpose of the Secure Invocation Interceptor in the SAS protocol?
question_63439.ground_truth: The Secure Invocation Interceptor in the SAS protocol is a message-level interceptor that is able to check and protect messages (requests and replies) for both integrity and confidentiality.

question_63440.question: What is the mechanism that the 3GPP System needs to support for indicating active or inactive identities on a UE?
question_63440.ground_truth: The 3GPP System needs to support a mechanism that allows an authorized user to set user preferences to indicate which identities are active or inactive on a specific UE.

question_63441.question: What should the NF Service Consumer send in the POST request to the AUSF for protecting UE Parameters Update Data?
question_63441.ground_truth: The POST request to the AUSF should contain the UE Parameters Update Data (UPU Data), the UPU Header, and the acknowledge indication.

question_63442.question: What is the maximum duration of the test for the MS to invoke a self-location request by sending the network a REGISTER message containing an MO-LR Request of type "locationEstimate"?
question_63442.ground_truth: The maximum duration of the test is 10 minutes.

question_63443.question: What should the SGW do upon receiving the Delete PDN Connection Set Request message from the MME following partial failure in the MME?
question_63443.ground_truth: The SGW maintains the UE contexts and starts a timer for the corresponding MME.

question_63444.question: What must a CSP be able to do if they manage a Third Party ME or UE with relay or forward function?
question_63444.ground_truth: They must be able to report the communications status of such Third Party ME or UE.

question_63445.question: What is the estimated processing load for PSS detection in the NB-CIoT system?
question_63445.ground_truth: The estimated processing load for PSS detection in the NB-CIoT system is around 50 Mops, including a 30% margin.

question_63446.question: What should the ME do upon successful completion of an ENVELOPE (USSD Data Download) command?
question_63446.ground_truth: The ME should respond with "command performed successfully".

question_63448.question: What is the significance of indicating support for N3 data transfer in the 5G Preferred Network Behaviour?
question_63448.ground_truth: If N3 data transfer is supported, the UE can perform data transfer that is not subject to CIoT 5GS Optimizations.

question_63450.question: When do the receiving MCData clients 2 to n automatically send an accepted response?
question_63450.ground_truth: The receiving MCData clients 2 to n automatically send an accepted response if the incoming request includes a mandatory download indication.

question_63451.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Report on load and overload control of 5GC Service Based Interfaces?
question_63451.ground_truth: The purpose of the report is to identify key requirements for the load and overload control on the service based interfaces, analyze the 3GPP Release 15 overload control mechanism for the service based interfaces, and identify solutions for addressing the requirements for load and overload control on the service based interfaces.

question_63453.question: What is the functionality provided by a Local Gateway (L-GW) in this solution?
question_63453.ground_truth: A Local Gateway provides functions such as gateway and routing to/from external PDN, tunnelling of IP packets through the extension tunnel, IP address handling, minimal state maintenance, coordination with (e)NB on usage of local breakout, decision function on usage of local breakout for uplink traffic, decision function on routing for downlink traffic, and traffic monitoring and reporting function.

question_63454.question: What should the old MME do for Control Plane CIoT EPS Optimisation when the DL data is buffered in the old MME and the DL Data Expiration Time has not expired?
question_63454.ground_truth: The old MME shall discard the buffered DL data in this case.

question_63456.question: What action should the UE take if timer T3493 expires for the third time during the Remote UE Report procedure?
question_63456.ground_truth: The UE should abort the procedure and release any resources for this procedure on the third expiry of timer T3493 during the Remote UE Report procedure.

question_63457.question: How does the server NWDAF determine which client NWDAFs to select for a FL group?
question_63457.ground_truth: The server NWDAF selects client NWDAFs based on the FL role information and analytics ID, as well as other data details registered at the NRF during the NF profile registration phase.

question_63458.question: What is the difference between OPc and TOPc in the context of 3GPP TS 35.205 and 3GPP TS 35.231?
question_63458.ground_truth: Both OPc and TOPc are derived from OP and TOP, respectively, and a K value, and are stored in the USIM. The main difference is that OPc is used for Evolved Packet System (EPS) authentication, while TOPc is used for TUAK-based authentication.

question_63460.question: What system should support an option where the UE can be identified without the use of an E.164-MSISDN?
question_63460.ground_truth: The PLMN should support this option.

question_63461.question: In the 41.5.1.2.2.3 test procedure, what action is taken by the MS if it is in an active call and receives a PACKET NOTIFICATION message on the main DCCH while in GMM Standby state?
question_63461.ground_truth: The MS returns a block LLC frame to the SS as Cell Update, moving into Ready state.

question_63464.question: How are HARQ-ACK bits transmitted using PUCCH format 1a or PUCCH format 1b in TDD with HARQ-ACK bundling?
question_63464.ground_truth: The bundled 1 or 2 HARQ-ACK bits are transmitted using PUCCH format 1a or PUCCH format 1b, respectively.

question_63466.question: What information does the parameter "counter2" provide?
question_63466.ground_truth: The parameter "counter2" indicates the counter value of E-UTRA STCH PDCP SDU packets when `<type2>=1` and of NR STCH SDAP SDU packets when `<type2>=2`.

question_63468.question: In the context of 6a.9.1.3, what action does UE-1 take when it receives a status update from UE-2 soliciting media flow transfer?
question_63468.ground_truth: UE-1 uses the relevant IUT procedure to transfer the media flow to UE-2.

question_63469.question: What is the requirement for media protection that has the greatest impact on the choice of key management scheme?
question_63469.ground_truth: Requirement 44 in clause 5.10, which states that the key management solution shall support deferred delivery of protected media, is the requirement that has the greatest impact on the choice of key management scheme. It restricts the types of key management that can be used and requires that the sender/initiator must have access to media keys before the receiver has been contacted.

question_63470.question: What is a trigger condition for converged charging in 5G ProSe Direct Discovery with 5G DDNMF and Direct Discovery over PC5 reference point?
question_63470.ground_truth: The UE receives a Direct Discovery Request with a ProSe Application Code for open discovery.

question_63471.question: What action does the new SGSN take when the Routing Area Update Request is initiated in PMM-IDLE/STANDBY state?
question_63471.ground_truth: The new SGSN deactivates all non-emergency PDP contexts without PDP Context deactivation signalling between the UE and the SGSN.

question_63472.question: What decision does the MCPTT server make when initiating a new MCPTT call regarding the downlink media?
question_63472.ground_truth: The MCPTT server decides to use unicast bearers or broadcast bearers for the downlink media.

question_63474.question: What methods can be used to secure the usage of the USIM to a specific UE?
question_63474.ground_truth: Two methods can be used: USAT application pairing and PIN presentation pairing.

question_63477.question: What should be the combination of pos0, pos1, and pos2 that can be declared for BS Type 2-O in FR2 HST scenario as per the manufacturer declaration?
question_63477.ground_truth: All combinations of pos0, pos1, and pos2 can be declared for BS Type 2-O in FR2 HST scenario as per the manufacturer declaration.

question_63478.question: Which type of NAS messages are transferred by the signalling radio bearer set up for high priority by the higher layers?
question_63478.ground_truth: The NAS messages set to "high priority" by the higher layers are transferred by the signalling radio bearer set up for high priority by the higher layers.

question_63479.question: What happens if both manually initiated and sCPOverloaded control types are active for the same gap criteria?
question_63479.ground_truth: The manually initiated control is applied.

question_63480.question: What should a floor participant do upon expiry of timer T201, when the counter C201 has not reached its upper limit?
question_63480.ground_truth: The floor participant should send the Floor Request message to other floor participants, including the Floor Priority field with the requested priority, the MCPTT ID of the own MCPTT user in the User ID field, and a Floor Indicator field if the call is a broadcast group call, and restart timer T201, and remain in the 'O: pending request' state.

question_63484.question: What is the uncertainty of the altitude information in the Assistance Data Reference Location?
question_63484.ground_truth: The uncertainty of the altitude information in the Assistance Data Reference Location is 500 m.

question_63486.question: What is the impact of reducing maximum bandwidth on the UL coverage of PUCCH and PUSCH?
question_63486.ground_truth: The coverage of PUCCH is smaller due to the loss in frequency diversity, and the coverage of PUSCH can be smaller due to the loss in frequency hopping gain or frequency selective scheduling gain.

question_63488.question: What is the difference between the RSRQ absolute accuracy and relative accuracy for carrier aggregation tests?
question_63488.ground_truth: The RSRQ absolute accuracy for carrier aggregation test is the RSRQ measured from the primary component carrier and the RSRQ measured from the secondary component carrier. The RSRQ relative accuracy for carrier aggregation test is the RSRQ measured from the secondary component carrier (Cell 2) compared with the RSRQ measured from the primary component carrier (Cell 1).

question_63489.question: In the "Release 9x ME" column, what does the "M" notation indicate?
question_63489.ground_truth: The "M" notation in the "Release 9x ME" column indicates that the capability is required to be supported.

question_63491.question: In which state should a mobile station return if it fails to establish a new uplink TBF on SBPSCH(s) after an abnormal release with access retry?
question_63491.ground_truth: The mobile station shall report an RLC/MAC failure to upper layers and apply DRX mode procedures.

question_63492.question: What is the formula used to calculate the TRP for the AAS BS in the OTA specification?
question_63492.ground_truth: The formula used to calculate the TRP for the AAS BS in the OTA specification is PRated,c,TRP = PRated,c,sys - LTX

question_63493.question: Which sub-layer of Layer 2 interfaces the physical layer (Layer 1) in the LTE system?

question_63494.question: What should be the modulation scheme used when the repeater supports 64QAM without power back off for RUL-FR2-TM3.1?

question_63495.question: What should the UE do if it is not able to obtain synchronization towards the serving cell for PUR transmission?
question_63495.ground_truth: The UE shall drop the PUR transmission.

question_63496.question: What type of AVP is the NIDD-Submission AVP and what information does it hold?
question_63496.ground_truth: The NIDD-Submission AVP is of type Grouped and holds information about the NIDD submission for CP data transfer. It has the following components: Submission-Timestamp, Event-Timestamp, Accounting-Input-Octets, Accounting-Output-Octets, and Change-Condition.

question_63498.question: What is the role of the V-PCRF in step 2 of the procedure for terminating an IP-CAN session when the AF is located in the VPLMN?
question_63498.ground_truth: If the UE is roaming in a Visited Access scenario, the V-PCRF sends a RAR with the Session-Release-Cause AVP to the PCEF to request the termination of the S9 session.

question_63499.question: What should the target AMF do if it receives the keyAmfChangeInd in a handover procedure?
question_63499.ground_truth: The target AMF should compute a new key, store the new key and NH pair, and send the new key and NH pair to the target ng-eNB/gNB within the NGAP HANDOVER REQUEST message.

question_63504.question: Who is responsible for the model/functionality control in a gNB-side model for 5G NR?
question_63504.ground_truth: The model/functionality control (e.g., selection, (de)activation, switching, fallback, etc.) is performed by the gNB in a gNB-side model for 5G NR.

question_63506.question: What is the purpose of the MCData server communication release request in subclause 7.7.2.3.2.2?
question_63506.ground_truth: The MCData server sends this request to release an ongoing MCData communication when at least one of the communication release conditions are met.

question_63507.question: What is the purpose of the "Cell Identification discriminator" field in the protocol extension container?
question_63507.ground_truth: The "Cell Identification discriminator" field in the protocol extension container is used to identify a UTRAN cell for cell load information. It is coded as the RNC-ID (0..4095) or the Extended RNC-ID (4096..65535).

question_63508.question: What status value can a new virtual provisioned pipe have before the provider makes a decision regarding the request in the createVPrP() method?

question_63509.question: What is the format of the payload in the RTP packet that contains redundant data blocks?
question_63509.ground_truth: The format of the payload in the RTP packet that contains redundant data blocks could use the format defined in RFC2198.

question_63510.question: What is the definition of occupied bandwidth for UL MIMO in the context of NR-DC?
question_63510.ground_truth: The occupied bandwidth for UL MIMO is defined as the bandwidth containing 99 % of the total integrated mean power of the transmitted spectrum on the assigned channel at each transmit antenna connector.

question_63511.question: How do L1 re-transmissions affect higher layer throughput tests?
question_63511.ground_truth: L1 re-transmissions dominate in higher layer throughput tests, especially in demanding noisy fading multipath scenarios, and can mask higher layer bugs.

question_63512.question: What is the mapping of a burst for EC-PACCH/U/M in the document?
question_63512.ground_truth: The mapping of a burst is given by the rule e

question_63513.question: What should the participating MCVideo function do if confidentiality protection is enabled and it has received a CSK for service authorization?
question_63513.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function should perform a key download procedure for the CSK using a SIP MESSAGE request as specified in 3GPP TS 33.180 clause 9.2.1, if confidentiality protection is enabled and it has received a CSK for service authorization.

question_63514.question: What protocols are used in the Wa reference point of the 3GPP system to WLAN interworking?
question_63514.ground_truth: The Wa reference point uses both Diameter-based and RADIUS-based protocols, including RFC 2865, RFC 3579, RFC 5580, RFC 3576, RFC 4849, and RFC 4372, and Diameter Base as defined in RFC 3588, including RFC 4072, RFC 4005, and RFC 5580, to inter-work with two kinds of WLAN ANs.

question_63516.question: What is the maximum output power requirement for a base station in normal operating conditions?
question_63516.ground_truth: In normal conditions, the base station maximum output power shall remain within +2 dB and -2 dB of the manufacturer's rated output power.

question_63517.question: What is the requirement for the Peak Code Domain Error for 7.68 Mcps with a spreading factor of 32?
question_63517.ground_truth: The Peak Code Domain Error for 7.68 Mcps with a spreading factor of 32 shall not exceed -31 dB.

question_63518.question: What is the role of the User Plane Function (UPF) in 5G networks?
question_63518.ground_truth: The UPF is responsible for processing and forwarding data packets in the user plane, enforcing policy rules, handling QoS, and managing traffic usage reporting in 5G networks.

question_63522.question: What is the meaning of SDU transfer delay in the context of ITU-T X.140?
question_63522.ground_truth: The value of elapsed time between the start of transfer and successful transfer of a specified service data unit (SDU).

question_63523.question: What is the action taken when the reported measurement result plus the hysteresis value is less than the threshold for a given event?
question_63523.ground_truth: The entering condition for the event is considered satisfied, meaning that the event is triggered.

question_63524.question: What is the purpose of increasing the geographical coverage of the RAI in the 2G/3G system to decrease Update Location message from the SGSN to the HSS/HLR?
question_63524.ground_truth: To decrease the required inter-RAT TAU/RAU of the UE which moves between the border of S4-GSN and MME.

question_63525.question: What information is included in the request body when updating or revoking the authorization for monitoring for a UE?
question_63525.ground_truth: Discovery Type, TTL, and other relevant information, such as application ID, banned RPAUID, and banned PDUID in the request body when using the MonitorUpdate service operation.

question_63526.question: What must the P-CSCF do if the UE did not include any confidentiality algorithm in SM6?
question_63526.ground_truth: The P-CSCF will select the NULL encryption algorithm if the UE did not include any confidentiality algorithm in SM6.

question_63527.question: What is the primary role of the primary PCF in local quota distribution and redistribution?
question_63527.ground_truth: The primary PCF proactively distributes the local quotas to the associated PCFs of the specific S-NSSAI and redistributes the local quotas of the specific S-NSSAI based on the status reported by the secondary PCFs.

question_63528.question: What shall the UE do upon receipt of a service-level-AA payload from the upper layers?
question_63528.ground_truth: The UE shall create a SERVICE-LEVEL AUTHENTICATION COMPLETE message and set the service-level-AA payload of the Service-level-AA container IE to the received payload.

question_63530.question: What does the "required-EEC-services" parameter contain in the unsolicited result code +CE5EECSRV?
question_63530.ground_truth: The "required-EEC-services" parameter contains either or both: the list of EAS characteristics and the list of EAS dynamic information filter, or the list of EAS information including the identifier and endpoint address of the EAS for ACR operation.

question_63531.question: When does UE use old TCI-states before the BWP switch until a new MAC CE updating the required TCI-state information for PDCCH and PDSCH is received after the BWP switch?
question_63531.ground_truth: When UE does not have the required TCI-state information to receive PDCCH and PDSCH in the new BWP.

question_63533.question: What is the purpose of the "AC-security-credential" parameter in the unsolicited result code +CE5EECSRV?
question_63533.ground_truth: The "AC-security-credential" parameter indicates the security credential associated with the application client profile to be used for checking validity of the request by the edge enabling layer in the MT.

question_63535.question: What is the requirement specified in section 4.9 for a UE supporting ca-IdleModeMeasurements?
question_63535.ground_truth: A UE supporting ca-IdleModeMeasurements shall perform the idle mode measurement on the inter-frequency CA candidate frequencies/cells indicated by higher layers and meet the requirement specified in this section. Additionally, the UE shall fulfill the requirements defined for a UE supporting ca-IdleModeMeasurements as defined in this section. The requirements apply provided that the UE is provided with a valid timer T331 by dedicated RRC signaling and T331 is running.

question_63537.question: How many radio frequency channels does GSM 900 support, including the guard band?
question_63537.ground_truth: GSM 900 supports 194 radio frequency channels, including a guard band of 200 kHz at each end of the sub-bands.

question_63538.question: What is the significance of the SRVCC handover in the call flow?
question_63538.ground_truth: The SRVCC handover is a call handover from the UTRAN or GERAN with PS handover support to E-UTRAN, including the handling of the non-voice component.

question_63540.question: What should the mobile station ignore in the RRLP MEASURE POSITION REQUEST if the old and new RRLP MEASURE POSITION REQUESTS have the same Reference Number?
question_63540.ground_truth: The mobile station should ignore the latter RRLP MEASURE POSITION REQUEST.

question_63541.question: How is the header part of the Radio Block encoded in EGPRS and EGPRS2?
question_63541.ground_truth: The header part of the Radio Block is encoded independently from the data part of the Radio Block in EGPRS and EGPRS2. An 8-bit CRC is calculated over the header, followed by rate 1/3 convolutional coding and possibly puncturing for error correction. Additionally, a PAN field is included for transmission using FANR, which is independently coded from the header and data parts of the Radio Block.

question_63542.question: What is the purpose of the power measurements in the test regarding the "maximum output power"?
question_63542.ground_truth: The purpose of the power measurements in the test regarding the "maximum output power" is to ensure that the maximum RF carrier power of the BTS fulfills the requirements defined in 3GPP TS 45.005, clause 4.1.2.4 for ER-GSM 900 BTS.

question_63543.question: What is the purpose of UE pseudonymity in V2X services?
question_63543.ground_truth: The purpose of UE pseudonymity in V2X services is to conceal personal data from attackers, and to provide privacy for the V2X enabled UE.

question_63544.question: How are initial pitch lags determined?
question_63544.ground_truth: Initial pitch lags are determined by searching for the maximum weighted normalized correlation in the four sections in each of the three segments or half-frames, for both pitch delay ranges.

question_63545.question: What should a UE do upon receiving the RRCRelease message, if deprioritisationReq is included and the UE supports RRC connection release with deprioritisation?
question_63545.ground_truth: The UE should start or restart timer T325 with the timer value set to the deprioritisationTimer signalled and store the deprioritisationReq until T325 expiry.

question_63546.question: What should the UE do with the random access report information after 48 hours of the last successful random access procedure or the failed or completed on-demand system information acquisition procedure?
question_63546.ground_truth: The UE may discard the random access report information.

question_63547.question: What signaling procedure specifies the source RAT to target RAT in SRVCC?

question_63548.question: What is the function of ICCF in the Line ID Services for CS sessions using standard CS procedures?
question_63548.ground_truth: ICCF provides a SIP UA behavior on behalf of the ICS UE for CS sessions established using standard CS procedures and redirected to IMS. It also provides control of these services in IMS with the use of ICCC.

question_63550.question: What is the purpose of the group call release request sent by the MCVideo server?
question_63550.ground_truth: The MCVideo server sends a group call release request to each participant of the ongoing group call to release ongoing session resources.

question_63552.question: What is the definition of Advice of Charge (Information) (AoCI) in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_63552.ground_truth: Advice of Charge (Information) (AoCI) is a charging supplementary service that allows the served Mobile Station (MS) to receive charging information on every successful request for an applicable telecommunications service.

question_63558.question: What is the duration of each segment of the ALDO window at 48 kHz?
question_63558.ground_truth: The first segment is 690 samples, the second segment is 690 samples, the third segment is 420 samples, and the fourth segment is 270 samples.

question_63559.question: What is the purpose of storing the PFD(s) in the UDR (User Data Repository) when the "pull" mode is used and the Allowed Delay is shorter than the caching time value?
question_63559.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure that the PFD(s) are stored and available for use, even if the Allowed Delay is shorter than the caching time value.

question_63560.question: What state does a terminating floor participant in an MCPTT call enter after starting timer T230 and the inactivity state machine, as per TS 24.380?
question_63560.ground_truth: The terminating floor participant enters the 'O: silence' state.

question_63562.question: What represents a unique packet filter identifier within the PDN connection in the TFT packet filter identifier and the EPS Bearer identifier?

question_63563.question: What is required of the service consumer when the NSCE Server sends a notification on Network Slice Lifecycle Management event(s)?
question_63563.ground_truth: When the NSCE Server sends a notification on Network Slice Lifecycle Management event(s), the service consumer needs to respond with an HTTP "204 No Content" status code to acknowledge the reception of the notification.

question_63564.question: What are the types of reporting that can be requested as part of the Location Reporting procedure between AMF and NG-RAN?
question_63564.ground_truth: The types of reporting that can be requested as part of the Location Reporting procedure between AMF and NG-RAN include single standalone reports, continuous reports of cell changes, reports when the UE moves out of or into an Area of Interest, and reports for Area of Interest based on UE presence.

question_63565.question: What is the range of high accuracy uncertainty for an ellipsoid point in meters?
question_63565.ground_truth: The high accuracy uncertainty for an ellipsoid point ranges from 0 to 46.49129 meters, with a resolution of less than 5 millimeters.

question_63567.question: What is the duration of T2 in the V2X Synchronization Reference Selection/Reselection test?
question_63567.ground_truth: The duration of T2 is 8.8 seconds.

question_63568.question: What is the peak throughput for the new MCSs defined for 32QAM?
question_63568.ground_truth: The peak throughput for the new MCSs defined for 32QAM is up to 99.2 kbps.

question_63569.question: What is the reporting range of RSRP for the TDD inter-frequency absolute RSRP accuracy test?
question_63569.ground_truth: The reporting range of RSRP is from -140 dBm to -44 dBm with 1 dB resolution.

question_63570.question: What is the difference between ePDG selection for regular services and ePDG selection for emergency services?
question_63570.ground_truth: The main difference is that for ePDG selection for emergency services, the UE shall use an ePDG to access a PLMN in the country where the UE is, and ePDG selection for emergency services is not needed when the UE is currently connected to an ePDG in the local country that has indicated support for emergency services. Additionally, there is a dedicated DNS query for ePDG selection for emergency services.

question_63572.question: When does the PDN GW provide 3GPP PS Data Off status to the PCRF?
question_63572.ground_truth: If the PDN GW receives 3GPP PS Data Off status in the PCO from the UE and supports 3GPP PS Data Off, it shall provide the 3GPP PS Data Off status to the PCRF.

question_63575.question: Who has the authority to accept or refuse the request to initiate periodic location?
question_63575.ground_truth: Any entity (MSC/SGSN, V-GMLC, H-GMLC, R-GMLC, and LCS Client) is enabled to accept or refuse the request to initiate periodic location.

question_63577.question: Which TS (Technical Specification) clause specifies the measurement object addition/modification procedure?
question_63577.ground_truth: TS 38.331, clause 5.5.2.5 specifies the measurement object addition/modification procedure.

question_63579.question: What is the purpose of the redundant transport mechanism in SEALDD service policy?
question_63579.ground_truth: The redundant transport mechanism is used by SEALDD to improve data transmission quality. It is activated based on measurement reports to meet connection reliability requirements specified in the SEALDD service policy.

question_63581.question: What is the purpose of the "Niwmsc" service-based interface in the 5G System architecture?
question_63581.ground_truth: The "Niwmsc" service-based interface is used by the SMSF to access services offered by the SMS-IWMSC, which facilitates the transfer of Mobile Originated short messages.

question_63582.question: What action should the CRNC take if the RESET REQUEST message is received and there is an ongoing procedure related to a CRNC Communication Context indicated in the message?
question_63582.ground_truth: The CRNC shall abort the ongoing procedure related to the indicated CRNC Communication Context.

question_63584.question: What is the effect of receiving a FACILITY message including a Return Error component on the MS?
question_63584.ground_truth: The MS returns both calls to their original call states.

question_63586.question: What is the recommended solution for mapping RAN coverage service in Company-NB in a NetworkSliceSubnet instance and SliceProfile?
question_63586.ground_truth: It is recommended to map the RAN coverage service in Company-NB to a NetworkSliceSubnet instance and SliceProfile to ensure the definition of network slice remains aligned across 3GPP WGs.

question_63587.question: What is the requirement for the success rate of the test in section 7.2.10.5 of the document?
question_63587.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests shall be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

question_63588.question: What is the significance of the "Y" clause in interface definition?
question_63588.ground_truth: The "Y" clause in interface definition represents a number immediately following "X" and is used to define interfaces and their properties.

question_63591.question: What state does the MCVideo client enter upon expiration of timer TFG1 in the "S7: Waiting for call announcement after call release" state?
question_63591.ground_truth: The MCVideo client enters the "S1: start-stop" state upon expiration of timer TFG1 in the "S7: Waiting for call announcement after call release" state.

question_63593.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP-Session-S-NSSAI attribute in 3GPP Vendor-Specific attribute?
question_63593.ground_truth: The 3GPP-Session-S-NSSAI attribute is used to indicate the S-NSSAI that is associated with the PDU Session.

question_63594.question: What is the role of 3GPP UEs with PSS and/or MBMS client in the 3GPP Technical Report scenario?
question_63594.ground_truth: The 3GPP UEs with PSS and/or MBMS client in the scenario are responsible for receiving and decoding the content received over 3GPP networks, which may be heterogeneous in terms of capabilities, such as display resolutions, decoding capabilities, audio rendering capabilities and more.

question_63595.question: What message does the SGW send to the PDN GW to indicate the inclusion of LTE-M RAT type in the Modify Bearer Request?
question_63595.ground_truth: If the UE is using the LTE-M RAT type and the PDN GW expects LTE-M RAT type reporting, the MME includes the LTE-M RAT type reporting to PGW flag in the Modify Bearer Request. The SGW shall include the LTE-M RAT type in the Modify Bearer Request message to the PGW.

question_63596.question: What is the difference between Non-MSGin5G UE and Application Server de-registration procedures?
question_63596.ground_truth: In Non-MSGin5G UE de-registration, the Message Gateway is responsible for initiating the de-registration from the MSGin5G Server on behalf of the Non-MSGin5G UEs, while in Application Server de-registration, the Application Server is responsible for triggering the de-registration from the MSGin5G Server. The authentication procedures for Non-MSGin5G UE de-registration are built on top of Annex Y.2 of 3GPP TS 33.501 while the authentication procedures for Application Server de-registration are built on top of Annex Y.4 of 3GPP TS 33.501.

question_63597.question: What must the AMF do if it cannot assign EBI(s) for a PDU Session due to Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization?
question_63597.ground_truth: The AMF should indicate EBI assignment failure.

question_63599.question: What is the set of cells that contains at least the Serving E-DCH cell and from which the UE can receive and combine one Relative Grant called in the document?
question_63599.ground_truth: Serving E-DCH RLS or Serving RLS (FDD only)

question_63601.question: What is the requirement specified for in-band blocking in clause 6.5A.2.1 of the minimum requirements?
question_63601.ground_truth: The requirement specified for in-band blocking in clause 6.5A.2.1 of the minimum requirements is that the BLER measured on each individual cell shall not exceed 0.1 for an unwanted interfering signal falling into the UE receive band or into the first 15 MHz below or above the UE receive band.

question_63602.question: What is the identifier for the measurement of the number of successful intra-NRCell SSB Beam switch executions?

question_63603.question: What are some of the elements that are typically included in Warning Notifications provided through PWS?
question_63603.ground_truth: Warning Notifications typically include an event description, information about the area affected, recommended actions to take, an expiration time with time zone, and the sending agency.

question_63605.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP enhancement for TV service?
question_63605.ground_truth: The 3GPP enhancement for TV service aims to analyze the gap and propose potential requirements to enhance the 3GPP system for supporting various TV services, including linear TV, live, video on demand, smart TV, and Over The Top (OTT) content.

question_63607.question: What is the focus of the NG-RAN technical specification in Release 17?
question_63607.ground_truth: The specification outlines the standards for implementing layer 1 on the NG interface

question_63608.question: When should the UE include the Uplink data status IE and the Allowed PDU session status IE in the SERVICE REQUEST message?
question_63608.ground_truth: The UE should include the Uplink data status IE and the Allowed PDU session status IE in the SERVICE REQUEST message for cases other than o) and p) in subclause 5.6.1.1.

question_63609.question: What information is included in the FeasibilityCheckAndReservationJob IOC?
question_63609.ground_truth: The FeasibilityCheckAndReservationJob IOC includes attributes inherited from the Top IOC (defined in TS 28.622) and attributes such as "resourceReservation" to represent the consumer's requirements for resource reservation, "requestedReservationExpiration" to represent the validity period of the resource reservation, and "feasibilityTimeWindow" to represent the consumer's request for checking whether the network slicing related requirements can be satisfied at a specified time window.

question_63610.question: What should be ensured when performing receiver tests with a duplexer fitted, as noted in NOTE 1?
question_63610.ground_truth: When performing receiver tests with a duplexer fitted, it is important to ensure that the output from the transmitters does not affect the test apparatus. This can be achieved using a combination of attenuators, isolators and filters.

question_63611.question: What is the test purpose described in section 6.3A.1.2.1?
question_63611.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify the UE's ability to transmit with a broadband output power below the value specified in the test requirement when the power on each component carrier is set to a minimum value, but for 3UL CA instead of 2UL CA.

question_63612.question: What issues may arise when using TE Advanced Carrier Aggregation of Band 3 and Band 8 due to harmonics and intermodulation distortions?
question_63612.ground_truth: Distortions caused by 2nd order harmonics of Band 8 may occur within the passband of Band 3, and intermodulation distortions from two DL (Band 3 and Band 8) can occur at specific frequency ranges. Additional filtering or desensitization may be necessary to address these issues.

question_63613.question: What is the problem with the approach of rejecting new PDN connection or handover requests when the network is not able to process it successfully using existing IPsec tunnel establishment procedures?
question_63613.ground_truth: The problem is that the UE access to the APN via the untrusted access may be deferred for an undetermined duration, if the UE remains connected to the current ePDG.

question_63614.question: What is the role of the MC service client in requesting communication resources at session establishment?
question_63614.ground_truth: The MC service client sends a session establishment request with an SDP offer and access resource details to the MC service server.

question_63615.question: What is the purpose of the ECGI (E-UTRAN Cell Global Identity) in the CS domain?
question_63615.ground_truth: The ECGI is used to define the E-UTRAN CS domain identity in the CS domain. When the MME/SGSN and PGW/GGSN pertain to the same PLMN, the ECGI shall be communicated via ECGI to the PGW for both supporting and non-supporting UEs.

question_63617.question: What additional requirement must be met by the coefficients within Range 1 and Range 2, aside from the ripple requirement?
question_63617.ground_truth: The relative difference between the maximum coefficient in Range 1 and the minimum coefficient in Range 2 must not be larger than 6 dB, and the relative difference between the maximum coefficient in Range 2 and the minimum coefficient in Range 1 must not be larger than 10 dB.

question_63619.question: What should a UE connected to 5GC do with a PDU that failed its integrity check?
question_63619.ground_truth: The concerned PDU should be discarded by the receiving PDCP entity.

question_63620.question: What does GA-AltitudeAndDirection in the provided code represent?
question_63620.ground_truth: GA-AltitudeAndDirection represents the altitude and direction of a point with uncertainty, as it includes altitudeAndDirection which is an object holding the altitude and direction of the point, uncertaintyAltitude which is an integer representing the uncertainty of the altitude, and confidence which is an integer representing the confidence level of the altitude.

question_63621.question: When should the UE not include an "a=3ge2ae:requested" attribute in any of its SDP offers?
question_63621.ground_truth: If the P-CSCF did not indicate support for end-to-access-edge media security using DTLS-SRTP, SDES, TLS, or certificate fingerprints during registration, the UE should not include an "a=3ge2ae:requested" attribute in any of its SDP offers.

question_63622.question: What is the purpose of the RP-SMMA message?
question_63622.ground_truth: The RP-SMMA message is sent by the mobile station to relay a notification to the network that the mobile has memory available to receive one or more short messages.

question_63624.question: What is the parameter that should be at least 90% in the test requirements?
question_63624.ground_truth: The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

question_63625.question: What is the capability that the PWS-UE does not support regarding Warning Notifications?
question_63625.ground_truth: The PWS-UE does not support any capabilities to forward, reply to, or copy and paste the content of Warning Notifications.

question_63627.question: When does the MSGin5G Server discard a message instead of delivering it?
question_63627.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server discards a message when the recipient UE has not become available before the message expiration time or maximum deferred time, and when store and forward services are not requested by the sender and the deferred message service is not enabled by the MSGin5G service provider.

question_63628.question: What is the range for reporting the SS-RSRQ in 4.7.2.0.1?
question_63628.ground_truth: The reporting range of SS-RSRQ is defined from -43 dB to 20 dB with 0.5 dB resolution.

question_63629.question: How can mobility optimization help network operation?
question_63629.ground_truth: Mobility optimization helps identify localized lack of coverage or the need to adapt network parameters, such as handover settings, to improve the handover success rate and overall network performance.

question_63633.question: In what scenarios is the procedure defined in clause 6.2.3 useful?
question_63633.ground_truth: The procedure defined in clause 6.2.3 allows for support of IMS emergency calls outside the normal coverage area of a network, and enables an IMS Core Network to support IMS Emergency Calls for its users when it does not possess all the necessary entities. The procedure can be transparent to the UE, the PSAP, and IMS Core 2, and the trust relationship between IMS Core 1 and IMS Core 2 should be able to settle any UE identity and call back URI provided by IMS Core 1.

question_63635.question: What is the purpose of the Geolocation header field in INVITE request during an emergency call?
question_63635.ground_truth: The Geolocation header field in INVITE request during an emergency call contains the location information of the UE, which can be used by other entities to make routing decisions.

question_63636.question: What is the role of the AMF after it receives the EAP result for each S-NSSAI from the NSSAA procedure?
question_63636.ground_truth: The AMF stores the EAP result for each S-NSSAI for which the NSSAA procedure in steps 1-17 was executed.

question_63639.question: What is the impact of providing a null value argument to the CatPutOneByteTLV function?
question_63639.ground_truth: If the value is null, the invocation is a No-Operation (NOP), and the contents of the proactive command buffer are not changed.

question_63640.question: What shall the UE set in the Reconnection to the network due to RAN timing synchronization status change (RANtiming) bit in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if the UE supports the reconnection to the network due to RAN timing synchronization status change?
question_63640.ground_truth: The UE shall set the Reconnection to the network due to RAN timing synchronization status change (RANtiming) bit to "Reconnection to the network due to RAN timing synchronization status change supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message if the UE supports the reconnection to the network due to RAN timing synchronization status change.

question_63641.question: What initial conditions are required when measuring the normal burst transmitter output power for 8PSK?
question_63641.ground_truth: Power may be determined by applying the technique described for GMSK in subclause 13.16.2.4.1.2 a) and then averaging over multiple bursts to achieve sufficient accuracy. Alternatively, an estimation technique based on a single burst may be used, as long as it yields the same result as the long term average.

question_63643.question: What are the two types of activation defined in the trace high-level architecture section?
question_63643.ground_truth: The two types of activation defined in the trace high-level architecture section are management based activation and signalling based activation.

question_63645.question: What should the UE do if it receives an error response indicating "incompatible network address format" after sending an initial INVITE request that includes only an IPv6 address in the SDP offer?
question_63645.ground_truth: If the UE receives an error response indicating "incompatible network address format", it should send an ACK as per standard SIP procedures, acquire an IPv4 address or use an existing IPv4 address, and send a new initial INVITE request to the same destination containing only the IPv4 address in the SDP offer.

question_63646.question: What is the procedure for the intermodulation rejection test for speech channels?
question_63646.ground_truth: The procedure involves setting up a call with particular parameters, sending a wanted signal, and two interfering signals, and then measuring the frame erasure rate for class II bits.

question_63648.question: In what cases does the AUSF provide services to SNPNs (Stand-alone Non-Public Networks)?
question_63648.ground_truth: The AUSF provides services to SNPNs in scenarios such as roaming, UE access using credentials from a Credentials Holder, UE onboarding, and the authentication of 5G ProSe Remote UEs and 5G ProSe End UEs.

question_63649.question: What is the minimum interfering signal gap size for which the additional BC3 blocking test requirement applies inside the sub-block gap or inter RF bandwidth gap for RIBs?
question_63649.ground_truth: The minimum interfering signal gap size is 3 MHz for the sub-block gap and 4.8 MHz for the inter RF bandwidth gap.

question_63651.question: What should the RNC include in the UPLINK INFORMATION EXCHANGE REQUEST message if the Information Exchange Type IE is set to "request"?
question_63651.ground_truth: If the Information Exchange Type IE is set to "request", the RNC should include the Information Request Type IE in the message to indicate the nature of the information requested.

question_63653.question: What is the objective of the LTE Advanced Carrier Aggregation in Band 40 for 3DL work item?
question_63653.ground_truth: The objective of this work item is to provide specification support for intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation in LTE TDD Band 40 for 3DL.

question_63655.question: If frequency hopping is not enabled, what value is assigned to the frequency hopping flag for TBs?
question_63655.ground_truth: The frequency hopping flag for TBs is set to 0.

question_63660.question: What is the purpose of a cross-domain MDA in the context of service assurance?
question_63660.ground_truth: A cross-domain MDA facilitates service assurance by adopting output from one or multiple single-domain MDAs.

question_63661.question: What is one disadvantage of using a DRA in the case of roaming?
question_63661.ground_truth: One disadvantage of using a DRA in the case of roaming is that two hops are in the path for all messages, including the message from the client such as the BBERF, making at least three hops before making it to the H-PCRF.

question_63662.question: What information does the "3GPP-Link-Char" header take as arguments?
question_63662.ground_truth: The "3GPP-Link-Char" header takes one or more arguments, including GBW (link's guaranteed bit-rate), MBW (link's maximum bit-rate), and MTD (link's maximum transfer delay).

question_63663.question: What security procedure is used for PC5 link security establishment between the source UE and the UE-to-UE Relay over User Plane?
question_63663.ground_truth: The PC5 link security establishment procedure over User Plane for 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay involves the source UE performing the discovery procedure and discovering the target UE via UE-to-UE Relay. The source UE then sends a Direct Communication Request (DCR) to the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay, which contains the PRUK ID or a SUCI if the source UE does not have a valid PRUK, Relay Service Code (RSC), and K~NRP~ freshness parameter 1.

question_63665.question: What is the difference between downlink radio link monitoring in non-DRX mode and DRX mode?
question_63665.ground_truth: In non-DRX mode, the UE (user equipment) assesses the radio link quality every radio frame, while in DRX mode, the UE assesses the radio link quality at least once every DRX period.

question_63666.question: What is the purpose of the tests specified in 8.2.3.3.1 and 8.2.3.3.2 for TDD FDD CA with TDD PCell and a varying number of DL CCs?
question_63666.ground_truth: The purpose of these tests is to verify the closed loop rank-two performance with wideband and frequency selective precoding.

question_63667.question: What should the CC AS do if a user has activated CFU after the user A has activated CC on the user B?
question_63667.ground_truth: The CC AS shall revoke the CC request by sending a NOTIFY request to the originating AS and send a "CC cancelled" notification to user A.

question_63668.question: What media formats can be played by the MRFC when using the General Play Multimedia function?
question_63668.ground_truth: The MRFC can play any combination of audio, video, and messaging media streams, as long as they comply with the 3GPP multimedia file formats.

question_63671.question: What is one way for the 5GS network to align the burst arrive time and the next transmission opportunity on the respective direction of the traffic to reduce potential buffering delay?
question_63671.ground_truth: The 5GS and the AF can receive time information from the same master clock, and both pro-active and reactive feedback modes are supported for aligning the burst arrive time and the next transmission opportunity in both UL and DL directions.

question_63672.question: What should be the RTCP bandwidth if the media bandwidth is 100 kbps?
question_63672.ground_truth: RFC 3550 recommends that the RTCP bandwidth default be 5% of the media bandwidth. Therefore, if the media bandwidth is 100 kbps, the RTCP bandwidth should be 5 kbps.

question_63674.question: How can a UE access the Network Assistance function?
question_63674.ground_truth: Access to the Network Assistance function in the UE can be realized flexibly, and may be subject to certification against a compliance regime that includes testing of its Network Assistance client functionality before being authorized to access this feature in a real service.

question_63675.question: What is the resolution step for differential reporting RSTD measurement for the first DL RSTD measurement?
question_63675.ground_truth: The resolution step for differential reporting RSTD measurement for the first DL RSTD measurement is 2kTc.

question_63676.question: What happens to timer T3346 if the MS enters state GMM-DEREGISTERED while the timer is running and SIM/USIM remains the same?
question_63676.ground_truth: The timer T3346 continues running until it expires or it is stopped, even if the MS enters state GMM-DEREGISTERED and the SIM/USIM remains the same.

question_63677.question: What should the UE do when the TFT operation results in no IP packet ever fitting this packet filter?
question_63677.ground_truth: If a packet filter consists of conflicting packet filter components which would render the packet filter ineffective, i.e. no IP packet will ever fit this packet filter, the network should send a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message to delete the mapped EPS bearer context with 5GSM cause #44 "semantic errors in packet filter(s)".

question_63678.question: What is the purpose of removing the IQ offset power in UE Relative CDP accuracy measurement?
question_63678.ground_truth: The purpose of removing the IQ offset power in UE Relative CDP accuracy measurement is to ensure the accuracy of the measurement, as this power can impact the accuracy of the measured CDP ratio.

question_63679.question: In what mode is the UE required to stay in the current serving cell and apply the normal cell reselection process before starting the mobility and periodic registration update procedure when timer T3447 expires or is stopped?

question_63680.question: What is the primary procedure involved in split rendering for an XR Device to join an XR application?
