question_63680.ground_truth: An XR Device collects XR pose (or a predicted XR pose), XR Pose is sent to XR Server, The XR Server uses the pose to pre-render the XR viewport, XR Viewport is encoded with 2D media encoders, The compressed media is sent to XR device along with XR pose that it was rendered for, The XR device decompresses video and uses the XR pose provided with the video frame and the actual XR pose for an improved prediction using and to correct the local pose, e.g. using ATW.

question_63681.question: What is the procedure when UE and PGW have different steering preferences for the same IP flow?
question_63681.ground_truth: When the PGW sends an IP flow mobility request, the UE decides whether to accept or reject it. If the IP flow mobility request conflicts with the active IFOM rules in the UE or cannot be executed due to other constraints, the UE rejects the request. If the UE determines that its IP flow mobility request was rejected, it marks the associated IP flow(s) as non-transferrable and does not attempt to initiate IP flow mobility for this flow on the existing multi-access PDN connection.

question_63682.question: What is the difference between "BS type 1-C" and "BS type 1-H" base stations?
question_63682.ground_truth: "BS type 1-C" base stations have requirements set only at individual antenna connectors, while "BS type 1-H" base stations have requirements set at individual TAB connectors and OTA requirements at the RIB.

question_63684.question: What is a difference between non-gap-assisted and gap-assisted measurements?
question_63684.ground_truth: In non-gap-assisted scenarios, the UE can carry out measurements without measurement gaps. In gap-assisted scenarios, the UE cannot be assumed to be able to carry out measurements without measurement gaps.

question_63685.question: What was the main reason for updating the 3GPP test specifications?
question_63685.ground_truth: Recently, User Equipment (UE) have come to market featuring other means of radiating sound to the user, such as through vibrating displays, which necessitated an update of 3GPP test specifications.

question_63686.question: What is the reporting accuracy of the channel quality indicator under frequency non-selective conditions, as specified in section 9.9.1?
question_63686.ground_truth: The reporting accuracy of the channel quality indicator under frequency non-selective conditions is determined by the reporting variance and the BLER performance using the transport format indicated by the reported CQI median.

question_63687.question: What is the role of the AEF in generating an OAuth access token?
question_63687.ground_truth: The AEF generates and sends an OAuth access token, which includes UE ID and CCF ID along with other claims.

question_63688.question: What is the role of SEALDD enabler layer in the data traffic transition of E2E redundant transmission for outbound data delivery?
question_63688.ground_truth: In the data traffic transition of E2E redundant transmission, the SEALDD enabler layer duplicates the application packets and maps them to two SEALDD traffic with the same Flow ID. Then, it sends the SEALDD traffic to different destination addresses or ports and different source addresses or ports based on the SEALDD traffic descriptors of the SEALDD flow.

question_63690.question: What is the maximum number of values that the ENUMERATED keyword can take in a choice definition?
question_63690.ground_truth: It can take a maximum of 256 values, given that the number of values is represented as an enumerated type in a machine-readable JSON format.

question_63691.question: What are the requirements when the user plane protocol on N9 is different from the user plane protocol on N3 in 5G systems?
question_63691.ground_truth: When the user plane protocol on N9 is different from the user plane protocol on N3 in 5G systems, the interworking of user plane packets from one protocol to the other should be well specified with minimal processing impacts.

question_63692.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP Technical Report on Dual Connectivity (DC) of LTE and NR bands?
question_63692.ground_truth: The purpose is to gather relevant background information and studies to address DC of 5 LTE bands and 1 NR band for Rel-17 band combinations.

question_63693.question: What is the expected behaviour of the mobile station when it receives an IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message on the PACCH from the network in the described scenario?
question_63693.ground_truth: Upon receiving an encapsulated IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message in the PACKET CS COMMAND message on the PACCH, the mobile station shall initiate the establishment of the CS connection. It is also expected to no longer respond to polling on the old packet switched resources.

question_63696.question: What are the typical heights for mounting base stations (BSs) in office environments and shopping malls?
question_63696.ground_truth: In both office environments and shopping malls, BSs are typically mounted at a height of 2-3 meters on ceilings or walls.

question_63697.question: What is the modification made in the multiband relaxation framework enhancement for REL16?
question_63697.ground_truth: In REL16, a new concept was adopted where relaxation is defined per band basis instead of retaining the original MBR concept with a relaxation cap in REL15.

question_63698.question: How are IP flows routed in the PCC enhancements when multiple simultaneous access connections are present?
question_63698.ground_truth: IP flows are routed by exchanging SDF specific routeing addresses and using PCRF to associate multiple Gxx sessions with a single Gx session based on these addresses.

question_63699.question: What is the reference interference level defined for in the context of 3GPP TS 45.005 subclause 6.2?
question_63699.ground_truth: The reference interference level is a measure of the capability of the receiver to receive a wanted modulated signal without exceeding a given degradation due to the presence of an unwanted modulated signal at the same carrier frequency (co-channel interference) or at any adjacent carrier frequencies (adjacent channel interference).

question_63700.question: What procedure is used to allow MCPTT clients to listen to an activated MBMS bearer?
question_63700.ground_truth: The announcement of the TMGI and the definition of an association between the identity of the general purpose MBMS subchannel and the TMGI together with the parameters differentiating this general purpose MBMS subchannel in this MBMS bearer.

question_63701.question: What is the main reason given for binding SAE keys to the PLMN identity during key establishment?
question_63701.ground_truth: The main reason given is future-proofing SAE against network impersonation threats which may become relevant in SAE due to drastic changes in the environment and business models.

question_63703.question: What are the benefits of on-demand DL-PRS functionality from a physical layer perspective?
question_63703.ground_truth: The benefits of on-demand DL-PRS functionality from a physical layer perspective include efficiency, reduced latency, and improved accuracy. It avoids unnecessary transmission and waste of energy, provides more flexibility in meeting response time requirements, and allows for dynamic adjustment of DL-PRS parameters to meet accuracy requirements.

question_63704.question: When the MS sends a MODIFY message to the SS indicating a user-initiated service level upgrade, what state does the MS enter after sending the message?
question_63704.ground_truth: The MS enters the "mobile originating modify" state (U26).

question_63705.question: What will the UE do if the message has been successfully integrity checked by the NAS and the UE receives the REGISTRATION REJECT message via satellite NG-RAN, with the Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming" IE in the REGISTRATION REJECT message and if the TAI(s) included in the IE is not part of the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming"?
question_63705.ground_truth: The UE shall store the TAI(s) belonging to the serving PLMN or equivalent PLMN(s) and ignore the TAI(s) which do not belong to the serving PLMN or equivalent PLMN(s) included in the IE, if not already stored, into the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming".

question_63706.question: What is the purpose of the UAS Application Enabler (UAE) layer as specified in 3GPP TS 23.255?
question_63706.ground_truth: The UAS Application Enabler (UAE) layer provides application layer support for UAS services, including UAS application communication between the UE and the UAE server, and among UEs over the U1-AE interface using unicast Uu.

question_63707.question: What are the basic physical subchannel block sizes that can be produced by the coding/multiplexing unit for FLO?
question_63707.ground_truth: The basic physical subchannel block sizes for FLO are 464 bits for full-rate GMSK, 232 bits for half-rate GMSK, 1392 bits for full-rate 8PSK, and 696 bits for half-rate 8PSK.

question_63709.question: What is the condition for a neighbor cell to be considered an intra-frequency cell during RRC re-establishment procedures for a RedCap UE?
question_63709.ground_truth: The center frequency and subcarrier spacing of the reference SSB of the serving cell should be the same as the center frequency and subcarrier spacing of the reference SSB of the neighbor cell.

question_63711.question: In the final state of the test procedure, what is the expected SINR for the MS?
question_63711.ground_truth: The SINR can vary depending on the test case, but in general, it is a measure of the signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio.

question_63714.question: What is the focus of the Group Communication Service Enabler (GCSE) in LTE?
question_63714.ground_truth: GCSE in LTE is designed to distribute content efficiently and flexibly to multiple users in a controlled manner. It supports various modes of operation, such as voice, video, or data communication, and allows users to communicate with multiple groups simultaneously in parallel.

question_63715.question: What message does the UE transmit when it initiates a registration attempt without a valid 5G NAS security context?
question_63715.ground_truth: The UE sends the REGISTRATION REQUEST message without integrity protection and encryption.

question_63716.question: What does the "CC" abbreviation refer to, in the context of the measurements?
question_63716.ground_truth: "CC" stands for Counter, and it refers to the sub-counters that are incremented to keep track of the number of events in a specific range or type.

question_63717.question: What should the MS do if it is in state GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED and the GPRS attach procedure is aborted and the GPRS detach procedure is performed?
question_63717.ground_truth: This occurs when the MS is in state GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED and a mobile originated detach is required.

question_63719.question: What charging-related parameter applies to both 3GPP and Non-3GPP accesses?
question_63719.ground_truth: The other charging-related parameters, excluding the Charging key, apply to both 3GPP and Non-3GPP accesses.

question_63720.question: What message is sent by the eNodeB to the MME if there is no further data expected and no S1-U bearers are established?
question_63720.ground_truth: The MME sends a S1 UE Context Release Command immediately after the S1-AP message including the Downlink data encapsulated in NAS PDU.

question_63721.question: What state exists on the network side when the network has received an answer but the network has not yet awarded the call for a mobile terminating call?
question_63721.ground_truth: The state that exists on the network side when the network has received an answer but the network has not yet awarded the call for a mobile terminating call is "connect request" (N8).

question_63722.question: In what scenario does the UE select a cell of the EHPLMN and attempt a Registration on the selected cell?
question_63722.ground_truth: When the UE is in Automatic network selection mode, and the EHPLMN, UPLMN, and OPLMN/access technology combinations are available and the UE is fitted with a USIM with Access Technology data files for each PLMN.

question_63723.question: What is the implication of a UE operating in a cross-border scenario with access provided by a non-terrestrial network operator?
question_63723.ground_truth: The regulations may not be compatible in a cross-border scenario. The UE and the network must comply with the frequency and operational regulations of both territories. If there are access restrictions, data retention and privacy laws, mandatory encryption of traffic or other incompatible regulations in the cross-border region, there must be a negotiated and harmonized set of regulations between the territories.

question_63725.question: What is the component name of the expected behavior model of the S-CSCF?
question_63725.ground_truth: The components include the Combined I/OLSM, the ILCM, the OLCM, and the Registrar and Notifier.

question_63726.question: In the scenario where the UE is provided with pdsch-TimeDomainAllocationListForMultiPDSCH and pdsch-TimeDomainAllocationListForMultiPDSCH for two HARQ-ACK sub-codebooks determination, when does the UE count a serving cell as two times in the pseudo-code operation?
question_63726.ground_truth: The UE counts a serving cell as two times in the pseudo-code operation if, for an active DL BWP of a serving cell, the UE is not provided with coresetPoolIndex or is provided with coresetPoolIndex with value 0 for one or more first CORESETs and is provided with coresetPoolIndex with value 1 for one or more second CORESETs, and is provided ackNackFeedbackMode = joint.

question_63727.question: How may the SMF indicate PSA UPF selection in the ePCO?
question_63727.ground_truth: The SMF includes an "edge-anchored" indication, which tells the UE that the PDU Session has a local PSA UPF and a "5GC-preference" or "3GPP-access-preference" indication, which communicates the network's preference to keep traffic in the 5GC or on the 3GPP access.

question_63728.question: When is the proposal in 7.2.2.1 applicable for mitigating the CQI mismatch issue?
question_63728.ground_truth: The proposal is applicable in scenarios when the serving cell and the interfering cell are co-located or there is some communication between them (i.e., Macro and LPN).

question_63730.question: What are some techniques for PDSCH coverage enhancement?
question_63730.ground_truth: The techniques for PDSCH coverage enhancement include repetition in the time domain, RS power boosting, increased RS density, and PSD boosting.

question_63731.question: Which SCF is used by application to interact with the service to manage the user announcement and recorded messages?
question_63731.ground_truth: The Generic User Interaction Administration service capability feature is used by application to interact with the service to manage the user announcement and recorded messages.

question_63732.question: Which devices showed significant SIG degradations in double talking conditions for handset mode?
question_63732.ground_truth: Devices I and K showed significant SIG degradations in double talking conditions for handset mode.

question_63733.question: What is the purpose of an Implementation Conformance Statement (ICS) in the 3GPP TS 36.579 series of technical specifications?
question_63733.ground_truth: The purpose of an Implementation Conformance Statement (ICS) in the 3GPP TS 36.579 series of technical specifications is to provide a declaration by the MCPTT Client supplier on whether optional functions or procedures have been implemented, which may be subject to conformance testing.

question_63734.question: Which component is responsible for taking appropriate decisions to save energy in the 5G core network based on the analytics provided by the MDAF in Potential Solution #1?
question_63734.ground_truth: A Management Function, in charge of energy saving.

question_63735.question: What is the reaction from the SMF when interworking triggers for 5GS and EPC are disabled?
question_63735.ground_truth: The SMF will record usage for both source and target network accesses into a common count and consume the same quota in both networks. The source access specific triggers will no longer be applicable, and the target access specific triggers will apply instead.

question_63736.question: What is the requirement for the overall delays measured in the test, expressed as the sum of measurement reporting delay and TTI insertion uncertainty?
question_63736.ground_truth: The overall delays measured shall be less than a total of 1002 ms in this test case (note: this gives a total of 1000 ms for measurement reporting delay plus 2 ms for TTI insertion uncertainty).

question_63738.question: What argument does the splitLeg operation accept?

question_63739.question: What is the maximum allowed timing difference between different BTSs (allowed tolerance) for extended DRX (eDRX) in a routing area (RA)?
question_63739.ground_truth: The maximum allowed timing difference between different BTSs (allowed tolerance) for extended DRX (eDRX) in a routing area (RA) is less than 4 seconds, measured at the BTS antenna.

question_63740.question: In the FT key hierarchy, what is the relationship between PMK-R0 and PMK-R1 in Step 4 of the FT procedure?
question_63740.ground_truth: PMK-R0 is provided to the new AP as PMK-R1 during the FT procedure.

question_63741.question: What is the implication of registering a Public User Identity on multiple WICs?
question_63741.ground_truth: The S-CSCF that supports the feature may be selected as the next S-CSCF for the registered user if the current S-CSCF on which the user is registered fails.

question_63743.question: What is the definition of a "telepresence system" as given in the document?
question_63743.ground_truth: A telepresence system is defined as a set of functions, devices and network elements which are able to capture, deliver, manage and render multiple high quality interactive audio and video signals in a telepresence conference.

question_63744.question: What does the "prefer 3GPP RPLMN" indication specify in Home Network Preferences?
question_63744.ground_truth: The "prefer 3GPP RPLMN" indication specifies how a roaming UE selects a PLMN in order to perform 3GPP-based authentication over WLAN access. The UE attempts to select the RPLMN or a service provider included in EVSP of the RPLMN when this indication is set.

question_63745.question: Who were the members of the listening panel?
question_63745.ground_truth: The listening panel consisted of 12 subjects, most of them experienced in audio but not only professionally involved, all remaining listeners were respectful regarding the listening instructions.

question_63748.question: What is a network slice in the context of 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_63748.ground_truth: A network slice is a logical network that provides specific network capabilities and network characteristics, supporting various service properties for network slice customers.

question_63750.question: What is the state of the UE after it is registered on PLMN1 (NR Cell 1) using the specified procedure?
question_63750.ground_truth: The UE is in state 3N-A on NR Cell 1 (serving cell) after registration.

question_63751.question: What identifies the target for the relocation of SRNS in the case of UMTS-UMTS relocation?
question_63751.ground_truth: The Target ID may be the target RNC-ID.

question_63752.question: What enhancements does the RAN need for broadcasting NPN information in SIB and selecting AMF based on NPN information from a UE?
question_63752.ground_truth: The RAN requires an enhancement to broadcast NPN information in SIB, including PLMN ID and NPN ID, and an enhancement to select AMF based on NPN information from a UE.

question_63753.question: What is the required horizontal position accuracy for the 5G positioning service in the shared bike use case?
question_63753.ground_truth: The required horizontal position accuracy for the 5G positioning service in the shared bike use case is 2m.

question_63756.question: What protocol is used to provide PCC rules to the vPCRF function in the Visited network, which then distributes the PCC information towards PDN SAE GW2 via S7?

question_63760.question: What should the UE do if the AUTHENTICATION REJECT message is received and the SNPN-specific attempt counter for the SNPN sending the message has reached its maximum value?
question_63760.ground_truth: The UE should set the update status to "5U3.ROAMING NOT ALLOWED", delete certain stored information, store the SNPN identity in the "permanently forbidden SNPNs" list for onboarding services, enter the state "5GMM-DEREGISTERED", and perform an SNPN selection or an SNPN selection for onboarding services.

question_63761.question: What is the purpose of creating an interworking group in the MCPTT system when establishing a group call between the MCPTT system and an LMR system?
question_63761.ground_truth: The purpose is to have a group consisting of members from both the MCPTT system and the LMR system, allowing communication between them.

question_63762.question: What happens if the UE receives two consecutive AUTHENTICATION FAILURE messages with 5GMM cause #21 "synch failure" from the network?
question_63762.ground_truth: Upon receipt of two consecutive AUTHENTICATION FAILURE messages with 5GMM cause #21 "synch failure" from the network, the UE may terminate the 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure by sending an AUTHENTICATION REJECT message.

question_63764.question: What is the function of the AAA/NAT Control in the NAT traversal solution using controlled NAT?
question_63764.ground_truth: The AAA/NAT Control function updates the DNS with the IP address for the UE and the ports to which it can be reached for specific advertised services. This allows the MTC Server to perform a DNS query and retrieve the correct IP address (and port) for the device it wishes to contact.

question_63765.question: How does the MS indicate acceptance of a mobile terminating call for speech calls?
question_63765.ground_truth: The MS indicates acceptance by sending the CONNECT message, and attaching the user connection at latest when sending the connect message, except if there is no compatible radio resource available at that time. If there is no immediate connect, the attachment shall be delayed until such a resource becomes available.

question_63767.question: How would the IWF handle cancelling MCPTT emergency private call states, and what would the MCPTT emergency private priority state and Resource-Priority header be for a regular MCPTT private call?
question_63767.ground_truth: To cancel MCPTT emergency private call states, the IWF performing the participating role would generate a SIP re-INVITE request with specific parameters, and set the MCPTT emergency private priority state to "MEPP 3: cancel-pending". For a regular MCPTT private call, the Resource-Priority header would be populated with the values for a normal MCPTT private call as specified in clause~6.4.1.11.

question_63768.question: Who sends the Warning Status Query Request message in this procedure?
question_63768.ground_truth: The CBC (Connectivity Bridge Control) sends the Warning Status Query Request message in this procedure.

question_63769.question: What is the minimum physical separation between the D2D Rx UE and the interference that causes less than or equal to 3~dB of desense, assuming co-channel D2D UEs operating in the same band?
question_63769.ground_truth: 399 m for handheld and 1124 m for vehicle UE for B14.

question_63770.question: What is the role of the Notification Log Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the communications system?
question_63770.ground_truth: The Notification Log Integration Reference Point (IRP) provides a standard general-purpose mechanism for the management of logs containing selected notifications from the network, allowing historical analysis of faults and conditions.

question_63772.question: What procedures are applied with additions for PCF based Service Authorization and Provisioning to 5G ProSe UE?
question_63772.ground_truth: The Registration procedures as defined in clause~4.2.2.2 of TS~23.502, UE Policy Association Establishment procedure as defined in clause~4.16.11 of TS~23.502 and UE Policy Association Modification procedure as defined in clause~4.16.12 of TS~23.502 apply with additions for PCF based Service Authorization and Provisioning to 5G ProSe UE.

question_63775.question: What action should the S-CSCF take if a P-Preferred-Service header field is present and there is a match between the request and the ICSI value?
question_63775.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should include a P-Asserted-Service header field in the request containing the ICSI value and remove the P-Preferred-Service header field, as specified in 4Cb.

question_63777.question: What should the NWDAF containing AnLF do when it determines that the ML Model used has low accuracy in procedure 6.2.13.2?
question_63777.ground_truth: The NWDAF containing AnLF determines that it needs to check further the data sources and compute data source rating. It initiates rating of a data source by requesting and receiving supplementary data from different data sources.

question_63778.question: In the F1AP UE messages, what does the Criticality status IGNORE mean?
question_63778.ground_truth: The IGNORE criticality status means that the receiving end should ignore the message if it doesn't understand it.  Even if the end understands the message, the system still treats it as ignorable.

question_63779.question: What is the significance of the "qualifiers" used in the IS template in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_63779.ground_truth: The qualifiers (M, O, CM, CO, and C) define the characteristics of class attributes and operation/notification parameters in the IS template.

question_63781.question: How does a larger allowable pathloss or indoor penetration factor impact downlink capacity loss in urban areas?
question_63781.ground_truth: A larger allowable pathloss or indoor penetration factor will increase the downlink capacity loss in urban areas. This is because there is more power allocated to common channels for maintaining the same cell range or indoor coverage, leaving less power for traffic channels.

question_63783.question: What determines if the criterion on the basic service is satisfied during an incoming call request event procedure?
question_63783.ground_truth: The criterion on the basic service is satisfied if the basic service used for the call corresponds to any basic service code defined in the criterion or if no basic service criterion is specified.

question_63784.question: What is the format of each service instance general property?
question_63784.ground_truth: Each service instance general property includes the service name, service version, service ID, service description, product name, product version, operation set, compatible service, backward compatibility level, migration required, data migrated, migration date and time, and support for regular expressions in address range.

question_63785.question: How does Alternative 1 ensure correct resource allocation in relation to resource admission control?
question_63785.ground_truth: Alternative 1 ensures correct resource allocation by completing the SDP negotiation and media optimization concurrently, and triggering resource admission control only after these processes have completed.

question_63786.question: What is the maximum end-to-end latency for a 5G system providing service with satellite access using GEO, MEO, and LEO based satellite access?
question_63786.ground_truth: The 5G system providing service with satellite access shall be able to support GEO based satellite access with up to 285 ms end-to-end latency, MEO based satellite access with up to 95 ms end-to-end latency, and LEO based satellite access with up to 35 ms end-to-end latency.

question_63788.question: Which algorithms are used for the protection of payloads in SDS messages?
question_63788.ground_truth: The protection of payloads in SDS messages can support the AES-128-GCM, AES-128-CCM, AES-128-CTR, and AES-256-GCM algorithms as defined in RFC 5116.

question_63789.question: What should the MCData client include in the "m=" media-level sections for the MCData media stream?
question_63789.ground_truth: The MCData client should include a=sendonly attribute and set the content type as "a=accept-types:application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-payload". It should set the a=setup attribute as "actpass".

question_63790.question: In which subclause is the behavior of the UE with access identity 1 described for MPS when operating in SNPN access operation mode?
question_63790.ground_truth: The behavior of the UE with access identity 1 is described in subclause~4.5.2A for MPS when operating in SNPN access operation mode.

question_63791.question: What is the required behavior of the UE when transmitting preamble for UL-SCH resource application during time duration T5 in this test scenario?
question_63791.ground_truth: The UE shall transmit preamble for UL-SCH resource application, followed by MAC-CE on the assigned uplink resources containing a beam associated with the candidate beam set q1 during time duration T5.

question_63792.question: What does the mobile station do with a PACKET ACCESS REJECT message containing a Reject structure addressed to the mobile station, as specified in step 11 of the test procedure?
question_63792.ground_truth: The mobile station shall stop timer T3168 and indicate a packet access failure to upper layer, as specified in step 11 of the test procedure.

question_63793.question: What are the possible consequences of not having the radio channel requirement met in the network?
question_63793.ground_truth: The mobile station may cease receiving data, and there may be a release of the connection during a data phase.

question_63794.question: Which interface is fully standardized for the purpose of Fault Management of 3GPP systems, as seen from the Network Manager (NM)?
question_63794.ground_truth: The Itf-N is fully standardized for the purpose of Fault Management of 3GPP systems, as seen from the Network Manager (NM).

question_63795.question: What should the IBCF do when it receives a message with a body part for a UE from an S-CSCF, and the body part is not optional and its Content-Type is the 3GPP IM CN subsystem XML body?
question_63795.ground_truth: The IBCF shall transparently forward the message with the body part and the header field(s) that describe the body part.

question_63797.question: What methods may be used to send RADIUS Access-Request when IPv4 address and/or IPv6 prefix is (re-)allocated or de-allocated?
question_63797.ground_truth: The SMF (or SMF+PGW-C for EPC interworking) may use the already established authentication session to inform the DN-AAA server by sending RADIUS Access-Request with the latest list of IPv4 address and/or IPv6 prefix(es) when IPv4 address and/or IPv6 prefix is (re-)allocated or de-allocated.

question_63798.question: What condition must be met for the MME/S4-SGSN to perform pro-active SGW relocation for all the UEs affected by the SGW failure?
question_63798.ground_truth: The MME/S4-SGSN should perform pro-active SGW relocation for all the UEs affected by the SGW failure to allow these UEs to be reconnected to the network in a relatively short time.

question_63799.question: What is the role of the IK (Integrity Key) in the data integrity process?
question_63799.ground_truth: The IK is a 128-bit key that is used as an input parameter in the function f9 to derive a MAC-I for data integrity authentication.

question_63800.question: What is the purpose of the Indoor Anechoic Chamber testing procedure in relation to output power dynamics?
question_63800.ground_truth: The Indoor Anechoic Chamber testing procedure is used to assess compliance for the OTA total power dynamic range by measuring the EIRP of the BS transmitting at Prated,c,EIRP on all PRBs and then a second time with the BS transmitting on a single PRB.

question_63801.question: What message does the eNB send to the WT to initiate the addition of resources for LWA?
question_63801.ground_truth: The eNB sends the WT ADDITION REQUEST message to the WT to initiate the procedures for adding resources for LWA.

question_63803.question: In the reference sensitivity test for TCH/AFS, what is the initial amplitude of the wanted signal, as defined in step b)?
question_63803.ground_truth: The initial amplitude of the wanted signal is set to the reference sensitivity level.

question_63805.question: What is the procedure for test 84.4.2.3.3 and 84.4.2.4.3?
question_63805.ground_truth: The system simulator is set up with one GERAN cell and one GAN cell, the mobile station is camped on a GERAN cell with an active voice call in GA-RC-REGISTERED state. The system simulator initiates a paging procedure by sending a GA-RRC PAGING REQUEST message to the MS, the MS ignores the GA-RRC PAGING REQUEST and continues with any ongoing procedures as if the GA-RRC PAGING REQUEST was not received. Then, the voice call is deactivated, and GA-RRC RELEASE is sent to the MS to verify that the MS is in GA-RRC-IDLE state, and GA-RRC PAGING REQUEST (CS domain) is sent to verify that the MS in GA-RRC-IDLE state. MS answers by sending GA-RRC INITIAL DIRECT TRANSFER (CS domain) message containing the page response.

question_63806.question: What are the initial conditions for the test described in 8.16.6.4?
question_63806.ground_truth: The test initial conditions include a normal test environment, specific frequencies to be tested, a 20 MHz channel bandwidth, and specific power levels for the cells used in the test.

question_63807.question: What is one of the potential requirements for the 5G system to support AR applications with contextual information?
question_63807.ground_truth: The 5G system shall be able to provide positioning service to support AR applications with 1-3 m horizontal position accuracy, 80% availability, for static or UE moving at speed below 50km/h outdoor.

question_63808.question: What is RAN-visible QoE information and how is it derived?
question_63808.ground_truth: RAN-visible QoE information is simplified QoE information derived from individual SA4-defined QoE metrics, which the RAN may use for various types of optimizations. It can be derived from individual metrics such as buffer level or combinations of these values. SA4 should be consulted on how the values are derived.

question_63811.question: What is the role of TRF in the visited network in roaming user architecture with local breakout, as per the document?
question_63811.ground_truth: TRF (Transit and Roaming Function) in the visited network is used in a roaming architecture for voice over IMS with local breakout.

question_63812.question: What is the expected sequence 1.1A in the simulator?
question_63812.ground_truth: The expected sequence 1.1A is a successful SEND SS command for call forward unconditional, all bearers.

question_63813.question: How are the test data sets selected for Rijndael and the other 3GPP security functions?
question_63813.ground_truth: The test data sets are chosen to ensure that every S-Box entry is used, and each input bit of the functions is given a '0' and '1' state. The Rijndael test data sets are used to choose the initial values for the other functions in a way that each input bit to those functions is also in a '0' and '1' state.

question_63814.question: What action should the network take if a MS is involved in a voice group call or voice broadcast call and a CHANNEL RELEASE is sent?
question_63814.ground_truth: The network may include a group channel description in the CHANNEL RELEASE, describing the voice group if a MS is involved in a voice group call or voice broadcast call and a CHANNEL RELEASE is sent.

question_63815.question: What action should the Node B take upon receiving an INFORMATION EXCHANGE TERMINATION REQUEST message?
question_63815.ground_truth: The Node B shall terminate the provision of information corresponding to the Information Exchange ID.

question_63816.question: What is the purpose of Group Call Area Identities (Group Call Area Id) in VGCS and VBS?
question_63816.ground_truth: Group Call Area Identities identify service areas within VGCS and VBS, grouping cells together for the services.

question_63817.question: What are some candidate parameters to consider when defining a test decoder?
question_63817.ground_truth: The candidate parameters include training data set for TE decoder training, model structure, performance parameters for the TE decoder, maximum FLOPs allowed for the test decoder, maximum number/size of model parameters, compression ratio of decoder, quantization level, and other parameters that are not precluded.

question_63818.question: What information does the NF service consumer receive upon a successful request to retrieve the location information for the PS domain?
question_63818.ground_truth: Upon a successful request, the NF service consumer receives a "200 OK" response containing the location information for the requested domain (PS) and the requested nodes or all nodes (if no requested nodes were present in the request).

question_63819.question: When should the mobile station attach the user connection during a mobile terminating call?
question_63819.ground_truth: For speech calls, the mobile station shall attach the user connection at latest when sending the CONNECT message, and for data calls, the mobile station shall attach the user connection when receiving the CONNECT ACKNOWLEDGE message from the network.

question_63820.question: What mode of communication is required for a UE to perform direct communication one-to-many in a ProSe-enabled Public Safety UEs?
question_63820.ground_truth: The UE must be authorized to perform direct communication one-to-many in the PLMN.

question_63821.question: In what mode does the mobile station transmit a PACKET DOWNLINK ACK/NACK message when the FBI is set to '1' and there is a valid RRBP field?

question_63822.question: What is the SSRC parameter used for in the RTP-Info header field?
question_63822.ground_truth: The SSRC parameter gives the synchronization source (SSRC) of the RTP flow to which the RTP timestamp and sequence number apply, it is used when the SSRC changes after a fast content switching operation.

question_63824.question: What is the purpose of the test specified in clause 8.2.4.3?
question_63824.ground_truth: The purpose of the test specified in clause 8.2.4.3 is to verify the receiver's ability to achieve throughput under high speed train conditions for a given SNR.

question_63825.question: In what circumstances shall the User Equipment (UE) request for PDU Session Type "IPv4v6" when using 5G network?
question_63825.ground_truth: When the IP version capability of the UE is unknown in the UE (as in the case when the MT and TE are separated and the capability of the TE is not known in the MT), the UE shall request for PDU Session Type "IPv4v6".

question_63826.question: What are the two cells deployed in this test?
question_63826.ground_truth: One FR1 NR PCell (Cell 1) and an E-UTRA neighbour cell (Cell 2).

question_63827.question: What is the significance of ECN in network information provisioning to local applications?
question_63827.ground_truth: ECN is significant as it provides information about network status to the UE and AS, and is not specific to 3GPP access. It is used to indicate potential congestion and help keep low latency traffic uncongested.

question_63828.question: What is the applicability of the requirements in subclause 8.16 for UE category M2?
question_63828.ground_truth: The applicability of the requirements in subclause 8.16 for UE category M2 is defined in Section 3.6.

question_63829.question: What is the purpose of the getPose function in the XRFrame?
question_63829.ground_truth: The getPose function returns the relationship between two XRSpaces, which are passed in as input to that function. It is used to determine the position and orientation of objects in the scene.

question_63830.question: What are the requirements when the user plane protocol is used for 5G system in non-roaming or LBO roaming cases?
question_63830.ground_truth: In non-roaming or LBO roaming cases, and PDU sessions not using SSC mode 2 or 3, an I-SMF may be inserted to control the UPF terminating the N3 interface. The SMF provides the I-SMF with necessary information to make traffic routing related decisions and I-UPF selection decisions.

question_63831.question: What message is returned by the BSS if it receives a VGCS/VBS ASSIGNMENT REQUEST message that calls up a blocked terrestrial circuit?
question_63831.ground_truth: A VGCS/VBS ASSIGNMENT FAILURE message is sent (Cause value: "requested terrestrial resource unavailable") and a BLOCK message is sent for the concerned terrestrial circuit.

question_63832.question: What is required for taking a PCC rule into service or out of service at a specific time of day without any PCC interaction?
question_63832.ground_truth: This can be done without requiring any PCC interaction as long as the conditions for taking the PCC rule into service or out of service are fulfilled.

question_63834.question: What is the warning message format used in common for CMAS, KPAS, and EU-Alert?
question_63834.ground_truth: The warning message format used in common for CMAS, KPAS, and EU-Alert is defined in TS 23.041 and differs slightly depending on the access technology, but the main content remains the same.

question_63835.question: What are the two types of entities in the test scenarios, with regards to implementation?
question_63835.ground_truth: The two types of entities in the test scenarios are those that are always simulated and those that are Implementation Under Test (IUT).

question_63836.question: What is the expected behavior of the MS when it receives consecutive IMMEDIATE PACKET ASSIGNMENT messages with the same packet reference request and FN offset?
question_63836.ground_truth: The MS should react to only the IMMEDIATE PACKET ASSIGNMENT message with the matching uplink TFI or USF values when it receives consecutive messages with identical packet reference requests and FN offsets.

question_63837.question: What is the significance of the channel data length in the "PROACTIVE COMMAND: RECEIVE DATA" commands?
question_63837.ground_truth: The channel data length specifies the maximum number of bytes that the channel can transmit.

question_63839.question: How should the hash algorithms and signature algorithms be chosen to generate signatures and proof-of-possession?
question_63839.ground_truth: The hash algorithms used before generating signatures in the protection field of PKIMessage and for proof-of-possession should be the same as the hash algorithms specified in TS 33.310 subclause 6.1.1 for certificate signatures. The signature algorithms should be the same as that used in the related certificate profile.

question_63842.question: What is the requirement for declaring a downlink signalling failure when an MS has enabled EC operation in packet idle mode?
question_63842.ground_truth: A downlink signalling failure is declared if the MS fails to decode EC-SCH within 2.5 seconds during an attempt to synchronize to a cell.

question_63843.question: What is the purpose of the Type field in ProSe discovery messages?
question_63843.ground_truth: The Type field in ProSe discovery messages is used to indicate the type of information contained in the Content field. It can indicate the ProSe UE Identity or ProSe Group Identity, the ProSe Application Identity, or both.

question_63844.question: What is the purpose of the CTSARCH in the GSM-CTS system?
question_63844.ground_truth: The CTSARCH is transmitted in the uplink by the CTS-MS to request dedicated radio resources from the CTS-FP in the GSM-CTS system.

question_63845.question: What is the definition of Correlation ID in the context of LIPA PDN connection?
question_63845.ground_truth: Correlation ID is a parameter that enables direct user plane path between the HNB and L-GW for a LIPA PDN connection.

question_63846.question: What are the valid values for @frameRate as per clause 5.1.3?

question_63847.question: What is an example of a use case for the tactile internet that requires high reliability?
question_63847.ground_truth: Remote control of vehicles and robots, real-time control of flying and driving things requires high reliability in the tactile internet.

question_63848.question: How many HARQ-ACK bits does the UE need to generate for TBs that belong to the same TB bundle?
question_63848.ground_truth: The UE needs to generate M HARQ-ACK bits by performing a logical AND operation of HARQ-ACKs across all TBs in each TB bundle, where b = 1, ..., M.

question_63850.question: What is the difference between a multicast and a broadcast MBS session?
question_63850.ground_truth: A multicast MBS session is a two-way communication between the MC service server and a specific group of MC service UEs, while a broadcast MBS session is a one-way communication from the MC service server to a group of MC service UEs that have joined the session.

question_63851.question: When is the OTA transmitter OFF power minimum requirement applicable for a multi-band RIB?
question_63851.ground_truth: The requirement is only applicable during the transmitter OFF period in all supported operating bands when the AAS BS is operating in a multi-band RIB that supports transmission in multiple bands.

question_63854.question: What type of measurement provides the number of 403-Forbidden response messages generated for UEs belonging to other IMS network domains with roaming agreements, split into subcounters per network domain, and has a sum subcounter if only a subset of per network measurements is supported?
question_63854.ground_truth: Number of SIP 403 (Forbidden) messages for the roamers

question_63855.question: What does ACLRadj-x represent in the context of coexistence with UTRA?
question_63855.ground_truth: ACLRadj-x represents the x-th adjacent channel leakage power ratio, defined over the 15 kHz downlink channels and 5 kHz uplink channels used in NB M2M.

question_63856.question: What is the security protection of the REGISTRATION REJECT message?
question_63856.ground_truth: The REGISTRATION REJECT message is sent without integrity protection before the secure exchange of NAS messages has been established and within SECURITY PROTECTED 5GS NAS MESSAGE message after the secure exchange of NAS messages has been established.

question_63857.question: What should an MS perform in a new RA if it has eITRI information but no GUTI or P-TMSI?
question_63857.ground_truth: The MS shall perform an initial UE identity request procedure.

question_63858.question: What is the length of the block sequence number (BSN) for TCH TBF mode?
question_63858.ground_truth: The length of the block sequence number (BSN) for TCH TBF mode is 8 bits.

question_63859.question: When is the KMS Redirect Response (KRR) procedure initiated in this solution?
question_63859.ground_truth: The KRR procedure may be initiated by application servers in the signalling path or by the terminating MCX entity when the KMS URI in the MIKEY message may be incorrect, or the primary or partner application server disallows communications using the specified KMS URI for various reasons.

question_63860.question: What is the measurement reporting delay that assumes the measurement report is not delayed by other RRC signalling on the DCCH, but excludes a delay uncertainty resulted when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH?
question_63860.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay assumes the measurement report is not delayed by other RRC signalling on the DCCH, but excludes a delay uncertainty resulted when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH.

question_63861.question: What message does the floor control interface send to an MCPTT client when no MCPTT client has permission to send media but an MCPTT call exists?
question_63861.ground_truth: The floor control interface sends a Floor Idle message to the MCPTT client, which includes a Message Sequence Number field, a Floor Indicator field (in case of a group call), and sends a Floor Idle message to the MCPTT client.

question_63862.question: What entity initiates the policy and charging rules provision procedure to request the NPLI in the GTP-based S5/S8?

question_63863.question: What is the attribute name for a list of content types relevant for streaming over RTP or HTTP?

question_63865.question: In the context of AI/ML-based load balancing model, what is the purpose of collecting output data in OAM (Operation, Administration, and Maintenance)?
question_63865.ground_truth: The output data collected in OAM is used as the supervised learning label data for the AI/ML-based load balancing model training. This data includes selection of the target cell for load balancing and the predicted UE(s) selected to be handed over to the target NG-RAN node.

question_63866.question: What are the two SAN classes currently defined for SAN type 1-O and SAN type 1-H?
question_63866.ground_truth: The two SAN classes currently defined for SAN type 1-O and SAN type 1-H are LEO and GEO.

question_63867.question: What is the main focus of Solution 5 in reducing overhead for repetitive non-successful privacy verification?
question_63867.ground_truth: Solution 5 focuses on reusing the existing privacy verification procedure as much as possible without bringing in extra NAS signalling overhead.

question_63868.question: What document defines the information service (IS) of the Core Network (CN) and non-3GPP access interworking system?
question_63868.ground_truth: 28.602 defines the information service (IS) of the Core Network (CN) and non-3GPP access interworking system.

question_63870.question: What information does the EEC include in the ACR request message for solution #21?
question_63870.ground_truth: The EEC includes its expectation or knowledge of the time that it expects the prediction to happen within the ACR request at latest.

question_63872.question: What is a Top-Heavy UE in the context of dispersion analytics?
question_63872.ground_truth: A Top-Heavy UE is a UE with a dispersion percentile rating higher than a threshold value (e.g. 0.9) at a location or a slice, determined based on either Data volume dispersion or Transactions dispersion.

question_63874.question: What are the major requirements for QoS (Quality of Service) monitoring or assurance in the 5G System?
question_63874.ground_truth: The 5G System should provide real-time E2E QoS monitoring, support for QoS monitoring of a group of UEs, an interface to initiate QoS monitoring and request QoS parameters, events, and logging information, with the capability to provide real-time service QoS parameters, log the communication history, and support various levels of granularity for QoS monitoring. Provide event notification upon detecting QoS level errors, identify the type and location of communication errors, and support event-based QoS monitoring while adapting to user-defined request response times and update/refresh rates.

question_63875.question: What is the purpose of the Multiple points of control (MPCTR) mechanism in an SCF-SSF relationship?
question_63875.ground_truth: The Multiple points of control (MPCTR) mechanism in an SCF-SSF relationship allows more than one service logic to act on the same (half) call.

question_63876.question: What is the definition of end-to-end latency as given in the document?
question_63876.ground_truth: End-to-end latency is the time that takes to transfer a given piece of information from a source to a destination, measured at the communication interface, from the moment it is transmitted by the source to the moment it is successfully received at the destination.

question_63877.question: Which positioning method in NR Enhanced Cell ID (NR E-CID) uses additional UE measurements and/or gNB measurements to improve the UE location estimate?

question_63878.question: What is the purpose of the channel coding block in the process described?
question_63878.ground_truth: The channel coding block is responsible for encoding the information bits delivered to it using Polar coding.

question_63879.question: What is required for implementing encryption in Option B of MBMS Delivery mode?
question_63879.ground_truth: Implementing encryption in Option B requires the BM-SC to have knowledge of GCS group members.

question_63881.question: In the <stat> parameter of the +CREG command, what does the value 2 represent?
question_63881.ground_truth: The value 2 in the <stat> parameter of the +CREG command represents that the MT (mobile terminal) is registered in the home network.

question_63882.question: What is the alpha or transparency value range in this terminal specification?
question_63882.ground_truth: The alpha or transparency value ranges from 0, indicating a fully transparent colour, to 255, indicating a fully opaque colour.

question_63883.question: What is the required minimum bit rate for 3G-324M terminals?
question_63883.ground_truth: 3G-324M terminals shall support at least 32 kbit/s minimum bit rate at the mux to wireless network interface.

question_63884.question: What is the procedure for an LCS PeriodicTriggered Invoke operation in 5G Networks?
question_63884.ground_truth: The LMF sends a REGISTER message to the UE containing the supplementary services LCS PeriodicTriggered Invoke component. The UE returns a RELEASE COMPLETE message to the LMF containing an LCS PeriodicTriggered return result if it can support the periodic or triggered location.

question_63885.question: What is the outcome when a newly affiliated or out-of-coverage MCVideo client successfully joins an ongoing group call?
question_63885.ground_truth: The MCVideo client is successfully added to the ongoing group call, and the other MCVideo client users are notified of the new member joining the group call. A notification with information about media transmissions in the group call is sent to the MCVideo client.

question_63888.question: In the described GNSS test scenario, what should be done if the MS does not return a valid result within the Max response time?

question_63889.question: What is required for the MC system to enable access for MC clients using non-3GPP devices?
question_63889.ground_truth: The MC system relies on a unique relationship between the MC service identities and the corresponding media streams passing the MC gateway UE towards the MC system sharing 3GPP connectivity of the MC gateway UE.

question_63890.question: When is the network controlled cell reselection procedure considered successfully completed by the mobile station?
question_63890.ground_truth: The mobile station considers the network controlled cell reselection procedure successfully completed when it has performed access and successfully completed contention resolution in the new cell.

question_63892.question: What operation is performed on the ACMmax field in the SIM of the mobile station?
question_63892.ground_truth: The ACMmax field in the SIM of the mobile station is set to 2 units.

question_63893.question: What should a UE in CM-CONNECTED state in 5GC do if the NG-RAN performs RRC Connection Release with Redirection to E-UTRAN based on certain criteria?
question_63893.ground_truth: The UE should release the RRC Connection with the NG-RAN and establish a new RRC Connection with the E-UTRAN.

question_63894.question: What is the requirement for the "SIMViewException" constructor in the API?
question_63894.ground_truth: The requirement is that the method with the header public SIMViewException(short reason) throws SIMViewException complies with its definition in the API.

question_63896.question: What should the MCData client do if an existing conversation is indicated when sending an SDS message?
question_63896.ground_truth: The MCData client should store the conversation identifier of the indicated conversation as SDS conversation ID if an existing conversation is indicated.

question_63898.question: In the context of 6a.9.1.2, what request does UE-2 send to the network to transfer media flow from UE-1 to UE-2?
question_63898.ground_truth: UE-2 sends an IUT media transfer request to transfer the media flow from UE-1 to UE-2.

question_63899.question: What should the MCPTT client include in the "m" line of the SDP offer when composing it for an ambient listening call?
question_63899.ground_truth: The "m" line of the SDP offer should contain "m=audio" media-level section for the MCPTT media stream.

question_63900.question: What is the name of the new procedures introduced to reduce signalling overhead and processing load in the network in 6.18.1.1?
question_63900.ground_truth: The new procedures introduced are 'RRC Suspend' and 'RRC Resume'.

question_63901.question: What are the frequency bands and channel arrangement for the GSM-CTS?
question_63901.ground_truth: The frequency bands and channel arrangement for the GSM-CTS are as specified in GSM 05.05 clause 2.

question_63903.question: What functionality is responsible for handling service continuity when a UE leaves or enters MBMS bearer coverage?
question_63903.ground_truth: The Service Layer in UE and network handles service continuity when a UE leaves or enters MBMS bearer coverage.

question_63904.question: What is the condition for unaffected channel combinations in difficult band combinations for LTE-NR inter-band combinations?
question_63904.ground_truth: The following formulas define which channel combinations within difficult band combinations are not affected by IM2 and IM3. Simultaneous UL transmission is mandatory for the unaffected channel combinations in difficult band combinations.

question_63906.question: What is the purpose of a PC5 QoS profile in the context of PC5 QoS parameters mapping rules in the 3GPP specification?
question_63906.ground_truth: The PC5 QoS profile contains parameters such as the PC5 QoS, PC5 flow bit rates, PC5 link aggregated bit rate, priority level, averaging window, maximum data burst volume, etc.

question_63907.question: How much time does the MS have to transmit the CLASSMARK CHANGE message during a contention resolution procedure if the last timeslot of the block containing a Layer 2 UA frame occurs at time T?
question_63907.ground_truth: The MS should transmit the CLASSMARK CHANGE message, if applicable, before T+40 ms.

question_63908.question: What is the smooth transition region in the filtering process of the time-domain excitation contribution in the frequency domain?
question_63908.ground_truth: The smooth transition region is situated above the cut-off frequency and below the zeroed bins, allowing for a smooth spectral transition between the unchanged spectrum below and the zeroed bins in higher frequencies.

question_63909.question: What are the two types of locations considered for the methodology evaluation in section 4.2?
question_63909.ground_truth: The two types of locations considered are an exposed location and the core network.

question_63911.question: What action should a UE take if the T3442 value received in a SERVICE REJECT message is not zero?
question_63911.ground_truth: The UE should start timer T3442 and enter the state EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE.

question_63913.question: How should the Source to Target Transparent Container IE be encoded when PS handover to E-UTRAN is required?
question_63913.ground_truth: The Source to Target Transparent Container IE should be encoded as the Source RNC to Target RNC Transparent Container IE as specified in 3GPP TS 25.413.

question_63914.question: Where do the radio interface protocols get terminated for DCH in the UTRAN?
question_63914.ground_truth: The radio interface protocols for DCH are terminated in the Serving RNC, but if no macrodiversity applies, the physical layer is terminated in Node B.

question_63917.question: What describes the absolute value of the deviation of the measured distance and/or direction between two UEs to the true distance and/or direction value in ranging based services?

question_63918.question: What is an example of a nesting level in an RRC message?
question_63918.ground_truth: A field that is one nesting level up compared to the erroneous field is called the 'parent' field.

question_63919.question: What is the requirement for carrier spacing between component carriers in order to define the occupied bandwidth for contiguous CA?
question_63919.ground_truth: The carrier spacing between component carriers shall be in accordance with the nominal channel spacing defined for contiguously aggregated component carriers in Clause 5.4.

question_63920.question: What type of connection is used between the IAB-node and IAB-donor in Architecture 1a?
question_63920.ground_truth: In Architecture 1a, the IAB-node connects to the IAB-donor via a modified form of F1, referred to as F1*.

question_63921.question: What is the maximum time allowed for a UE to switch back to its serving cell frequency during MBMS reception?
question_63921.ground_truth: The UE is required to start switching back to its serving cell frequency 1 timeslot prior to the start of the MBMS reception.

question_63922.question: What is the difference between integrity availability and target integrity risk?
question_63922.ground_truth: Integrity availability is the percentage of time that the positioning error is below the required alert limit, while target integrity risk is the probability that the positioning error exceeds the alert limit without warning the user within the required time-to-alert.

question_63923.question: What must the TWAN do to allow the PGW to use the P-CSCF restoration extension?
question_63923.ground_truth: The TWAN must advertise the support of the WLCP PDN connection modification request procedure over S2a at establishment (or handover) of the IMS PDN connection.

question_63924.question: What is the minimum requirement for time alignment in UTRA FDD for single RAT UTRA operation?
question_63924.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for time alignment in UTRA FDD for single RAT UTRA operation is the same as those in 3GPP TS 25.104, subclause 6.8.4.1.

question_63925.question: What should the MAC entity do when it receives a Recommended bit rate MAC CE from the gNB for a specific logical channel and direction?
question_63925.ground_truth: Upon reception of a Recommended bit rate MAC CE, the MAC entity should indicate the recommended bit rate for the indicated logical channel and direction to upper layers.

question_63926.question: What is the primary responsibility of the IpMultiPartyCallControlManager interface?
question_63926.ground_truth: The IpMultiPartyCallControlManager interface provides the management functions to the multi-party call control service and allows the application to create call objects, provide overload control functionality, and enable or disable call-related event notifications.

question_63927.question: What is the purpose of the "Current time" parameter in the 3GPP 5G DDNMF?
question_63927.ground_truth: The "Current time" parameter is used to carry the current UTC-based time at the 5G DDNMF.

question_63928.question: In order to achieve a modulo 8 length of the data before the RC/CC/DS field in the Response Header, what fields should be included in the calculation of RC/CC/DS if used for a Response Packet in a single SMS-PP?
question_63928.ground_truth: The RPL, the RHL and three octets set to '02' '71' '00' shall be included in the calculation of RC/CC/DS if used.

question_63930.question: What is the benefit of the solution for service continuity planning?
question_63930.ground_truth: The benefit of the solution for service continuity planning is that it allows the EAS to not have to monitor the UE mobility and determine when to send the ACR status update message to the EES. This is achieved by having the EES notify the EEC of the completion of ACR once the UE has moved to the predicted or expected location. This reduces the workload on the EAS and allows for more efficient use of resources.

question_63931.question: What signal is sent to functional unit 4 to indicate successful handover of a call in the UMTS network?
question_63931.ground_truth: Iu-RELOCATION-COMPLETE or A-HANDOVER-COMPLETE is sent to functional unit 4 to indicate successful handover of a call in the UMTS network.

question_63936.question: How does the network establish the short-term key in the first approach discussed for managing keys on the network side?
question_63936.ground_truth: Kmed is held back by the AuC or a secure proxy sat in front of the HLR, and the short-lived session keys are derived and sent to the SGSN when needed.

question_63938.question: What is the GAA Service Identifier and where it is stored?
question_63938.ground_truth: The GAA Service Identifier (GSID) is an integer, which uniquely identifies a GAA Service. It is stored in the HSS, BSF and NAF.

question_63940.question: What information element may optionally be included in an I1 message and identifies alternative addresses the UE should attempt to use?

question_63941.question: What is the role of the jitter in the packet arrival model?
question_63941.ground_truth: The jitter is a random variable added to the periodic packet arrival to model varying frame encoding delay and network transfer time in a real system.

question_63942.question: What is the function of the SGW during the Execution phase in the event of a failed Anchor MME?
question_63942.ground_truth: If the SGW detects a failure of the Anchor MME, it initiates the restoration procedure and checks the URCR status of the affected UEs. If the URCR status of the UE is enabled, the SGW sends the Paging Indication Request message to the Paging MME with the latest DAIP. The Paging MME initiates IMSI-based paging, and the UE initiates the Initial Attach procedure to reattach to the network and receive EPS services.

question_63943.question: What is the value of P for FR2 when the CSI-RS for BFD measurement is not overlapped with measurement gap and candidate beam detection RS is fully overlapped with SMTC occasion?
question_63943.ground_truth: The value of P is the Psharing factor, which is equal to 3 by default.

question_63944.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 12.13a.3 with regards to IMS mobile terminated speech call setup?
question_63944.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the UE correctly performs IMS mobile terminated speech call setup when using IMS Multimedia Telephony without preconditions.

question_63946.question: What is the responsibility of the source gNB/ng-eNB during the RRCResume procedure?
question_63946.ground_truth: The source gNB/ng-eNB responds to the Retrieve UE Context Request message by retrieving the stored UE context and verifying the ResumeMAC-I/shortResumeMAC-I using its own K_RRCint. If validation is successful, the source gNB/ng-eNB calculates a new K_NG-RAN* and responds with the UE context to the target gNB/ng-eNB.

question_63947.question: What actions should the AMF take when aware that some signalling or data is pending in the network for an unreachable UE?
question_63947.ground_truth: If the AMF is aware that some signalling or data is pending in the network for an UE that is known as being unreachable for a long duration, the AMF maintains the N2 connection for at least the Extended Connected Time. The Extended Connected Time value is provided in a NG-AP message to the RAN to keep the UE in RRC_CONNECTED state regardless of inactivity.

question_63948.question: What must the IWU do when it receives an ISUP message from an external SIP-I network prior to preconditions being met?
question_63948.ground_truth: The IWU shall queue the ISUP message and propagate it to the preceding 3GPP node once preconditions are met.

question_63949.question: When sending an SDP offer without the "a=msrp-cema" SDP attribute, in what situation can it occur?
question_63949.ground_truth: This situation can only occur if an MSRP IWF acting as SDP offerer is present.

question_63950.question: What should the AS do when it determines that the AS shall divert a communication and if the last history-info entry contains no hi-targeted-to-uri element for the served user?
question_63950.ground_truth: The AS shall set the following information in the retargeted initial INVITE request: the diverting parties address, the diverted-to party address, and diversion information.

question_63951.question: What is the purpose of the test case 27.8.3?
question_63951.ground_truth: The purpose of the test case 27.8.3 is to verify that the MS correctly updates the EFPLMNsel in the SIM.

question_63952.question: What is the requirement for extending the 3GPP system towards downlink only broadcasting?
question_63952.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall allow the MNO to implement a network supporting downlink only broadcasting based on a set of functionalities and entities which are required for content delivery.

question_63953.question: What are the required attributes for the "User-ID" element in the "UserProfileType" complex type?
question_63953.ground_truth: The required attribute for the "User-ID" element is "xs:anyURI".

question_63954.question: In what situation would a UE ignore the RAN rules and perform WLAN access selection based on RAN rules?
question_63954.ground_truth: When the UE has a valid IARP rule from HPLMN and cannot simultaneously route IP traffic to both 3GPP access and WLAN access.

question_63955.question: What should the AS performing the CDIV service do when communications diversion occurs in terms of sending the original INVITE message?
question_63955.ground_truth: The AS should always send the original INVITE message without eCNAM information when communications diversion occurs.

question_63958.question: What is the definition of RequestCapabilities?
question_63958.ground_truth: RequestCapabilities is a sequence that contains critical extensions and a set of SLPP information elements, including CommonIEsRequestCapabilities, CommonSL-PRS-MethodsIEsRequestCapabilities, etc.

question_63960.question: What are the two classes of Elementary Procedures (EPs) in the M3AP protocol?
question_63960.ground_truth: Class 1 EPs are those with a response (success and/or failure), and Class 2 EPs are those without a response.

question_63961.question: How are the tests referenced in the 3GPP Technical Specification for testing the (U)SIM API for Java CardTM?
question_63961.ground_truth: Each test is referenced using the name of the API, package, class, and method, along with any input parameters.

question_63962.question: What optional parameter in the IANA registration template specifies the character set for the application/vnd.3gpp.uae-info+xml MIME body?

question_63963.question: What shall the UE do upon the reception of a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-UE relay discovery response?
question_63963.ground_truth: Upon the reception of a PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message for UE-to-UE relay discovery response, the UE shall obtain a UTC time, generate a UTC-based counter, use it to recover the UTC-based counter, unscramble and decrypt the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message and direct discovery set IE, and verify the MIC field.

question_63964.question: What is the effect of setting the administrative state of a Channel to locked?
question_63964.ground_truth: It discontinues all transmission and reception of information on Air interface and all telecommunication (traffic and signalling) information transmission on A-bis interface.

question_63966.question: What is the role of Sensitivity and DARP test scenario-2 in link level performance characterization for uplink scheme?
question_63966.ground_truth: Sensitivity is evaluated for noise distortions and DARP test scenario-2 for interference limited scenarios. The performance is characterized for full rate and half rate AMR channels using selected codec rates.

question_63967.question: What is the requirement for the first CSI report for SCell in subframe (m+8) and (m+10)?
question_63967.ground_truth: The first CSI report for SCell should be received by the SS in subframe (m+8) or (m+10) if the subframe (m+8) was subject to interruption.

question_63968.question: What percentage of successful tests is required for the test to pass?
question_63968.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests shall be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

question_63970.question: What is the method used to ensure a one-to-one association between the USIM-RN and the RN in the pre-shared key case?
question_63970.ground_truth: In the pre-shared key case, the one-to-one association between the USIM-RN and the RN is ensured by the fact that the pre-shared key between them is unique and not available in any other entity.

question_63973.question: What parameters are expected to be signaled on what level in DASH?
question_63973.ground_truth: In DASH, the (Display) Picture Resolution, frame rates, video codec profile level, and color primaries and transfer function are expected to be signaled on the Adaptation Set level, while the encoded picture resolution, frame rates, and video codec level are expected to be signaled on the Representation level.

question_63974.question: How long can a test of the frequency redefinition last?
question_63974.ground_truth: The maximum duration of a frequency redefinition test is 5 minutes, including 1 minute for any necessary operator actions.

question_63975.question: What event triggers the access network to send a notification to the SMF regarding the guaranteed FGBR (Guaranteed Flow Bit Rate) of a QoS Flow?
question_63975.ground_truth: When the GFBR can no longer (or can again) be guaranteed for a QoS Flow during its lifetime.

question_63976.question: What do receiving MCPTT clients send to the MCPTT server to acknowledge the MCPTT emergency state cancel?
question_63976.ground_truth: The receiving MCPTT clients send the MCPTT emergency state cancel response to the MCPTT server to acknowledge the MCPTT emergency state cancel. For a multicast call scenario, these acknowledgements are not sent.

question_63977.question: What are the MIME types used in 5G ProSe direct discovery messages?
question_63977.ground_truth: The MIME type used to carry information related to the 5G ProSe discovery operation is application/vnd.3gpp-prose-pc3a+xml.

question_63978.question: What should the MCData client do upon receiving an SDS disposition notification?
question_63978.ground_truth: Upon receiving an SDS disposition notification, the MCData client should decode the contents of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body and deliver the notification to the user or application.

question_63979.question: What is the time period used for identifying a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell when no DRX is used, as defined in the requirement?
question_63979.ground_truth: The time period used for identifying a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell when no DRX is used is 150 ms.

question_63981.question: What is the purpose of the Client-Server Key (CSK) in the MCPTT environment?
question_63981.ground_truth: The CSK in the MCPTT environment is used to protect floor and media control signalling between the MCPTT client and the MCPTT Server, protect sensitive MCPTT application data in the signalling plane, and protect the Access Token in the signalling plane.

question_63983.question: What is the shortest periodicity of all RS resources in set when DRX is not used?
question_63983.ground_truth: The shortest periodicity of all RS resources in set for the accessed cell, corresponding to either the shortest periodicity of the SSB in the set or CSI-RS resource in the set.

question_63984.question: What is the principle behind the calculation of Load Control Information?
question_63984.ground_truth: The calculation of Load Control Information is implementation dependent, which means that each vendor can decide on the specifics of the calculation.

question_63985.question: How does the communication network change as the following train approaches the leading train in virtual coupling?
question_63985.ground_truth: Initially, the two trains are connected through the 3GPP network, but as the following train further approaches, they switch to a connection with very short end-to-end latency through the PC5 interface.

question_63986.question: What do filtering conditions include in the context of consumer request?
question_63986.ground_truth: Filtering conditions include the conditions in a consumer request which indicate the report triggering criteria. The recipient NWDAF needs to identify where filtering conditions can be applied and include any of them that relate to the subsequent request towards MDAF or MDA MnS producer.

question_63988.question: What is the effect of not having P-Asserted-Identity or Privacy header fields in the SIP response in 4.5.2.1?
question_63988.ground_truth: If there are no P-Asserted-Identity header fields and the Privacy header field is set to "id", it indicates that the network-provided identity information was withheld due to presentation restriction. If neither are present, it means that the network-provided identity information was not available.

question_63990.question: What is the result returned by the SMF if the validation of some of the received PCC rules is unsuccessful?
question_63990.ground_truth: The SMF replies to the PCF with an HTTP "200 OK" status code and includes one or more RuleReport data structure(s) to report the failure for the affected PCC rule(s) within the PartialSuccessReport data structure.

question_63993.question: What information should the gNB-DU include in the BROADCAST CONTEXT MODIFICATION RESPONSE message if some MRBs fail to be established?
question_63993.ground_truth: If some MRBs fail to be established, the gNB-DU should include them in the Broadcast MRB Failed To Be Setup List IE of the BROADCAST CONTEXT MODIFICATION RESPONSE message.

question_63994.question: What is the test procedure for section 16.7.5.1.4.2, and where can it be found?
question_63994.ground_truth: The test procedure for section 16.7.5.1.4.2 is the same as the one given in clause 6.7.5.1.4.2.

question_63995.question: Which parameter is mandatory in the "DCH-Information-RL-AdditionRspTDD" sequence?

question_63996.question: What is the role of the Bearer Control Signalling Path in Centralized IMS Services Control?
question_63996.ground_truth: The Bearer Control Signalling Path is the standard CS signalling path used to control the call established to set up CS voice bearer between the UE and IMS in Centralized IMS Services Control.

question_63997.question: What is the purpose of defining the interruption window on PCell or any activated SCell in MCG for NR standalone mode, or on PSCell or any activated SCell in SCG for EN-DC mode?
question_63997.ground_truth: The purpose of defining the interruption window is to allow for RF retuning during PUCCH SCell activation and to ensure that there is no interruption of PRACH on PUCCH SCell and other active SCells in the same band.
