question_63998.question: What procedure is used to acknowledge or retransmit RLC/MAC data blocks in downlink data transfer?
question_63998.ground_truth: Acknowledged RLC/MAC mode operation is used for selective ARQ operation, while unacknowledged RLC/MAC mode operation and non-persistent RLC/MAC mode operation are used for other retransmission procedures.

question_63999.question: What are the source and destination devices for the "SET UP CALL 1.5.1A" command?
question_63999.ground_truth: The source device is ME, and the destination device is UICC.

question_64000.question: What is the Adaptive Multi-Rate Wideband (AMR-WB) speech codec and what is it used for?
question_64000.ground_truth: The Adaptive Multi-Rate Wideband (AMR-WB) speech codec is a technology used for speech processing in multimedia and packet-based applications. It is a standard for encoding and decoding speech signals in a wideband frequency range, resulting in improved audio quality.

question_64001.question: What is the purpose of the UE Radio Capability Info Indication procedure?
question_64001.ground_truth: The UE Radio Capability Info Indication procedure allows the NG-RAN node to provide UE radio capability-related information to the AMF for use in managing UE radio capability information in the network.

question_64003.question: How is the identity information of source UE and target UE used for forwarding or routing messages in the Adaptation Layer?
question_64003.ground_truth: The details of the identity information of source UE and target UE used to forward or route messages in the Adaptation Layer will be defined in cooperation with RAN WGs during normative phase.

question_64004.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon receipt of a SIP BYE request for an ambient viewing call?
question_64004.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should comply with certain procedures, clear the cache of stored data, and provide no indication or an indication to the MCVideo user that the ambient viewing call has been terminated based on the cached ambient viewing client role.

question_64005.question: How does V-SMF set charging information indications in solution #2.15?
question_64005.ground_truth: V-SMF sets an indication for two groups of information elements, one for V-CHF and the other for H-CHF in solution #2.15.

question_64006.question: How should the mobile station respond to an IDENTITY REQUEST message with the TIN (Type of Identity) indicating "GUTI" and the MS holds a valid GUTI?
question_64006.ground_truth: The MS should map the GUTI into a P-TMSI, P-TMSI signature, and RAI as specified in 3GPP~TS~23.003, and indicate the P-TMSI in the Mobile identity IE, the RAI in the Routing area identification IE, and the P-TMSI signature in the P-TMSI signature IE.

question_64007.question: What should the MCPTT client do in the "S4: pending user action without confirm indication" state when it receives an indication from the MCPTT user to reject the incoming group call?
question_64007.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should stop timer TFG4, start timer TFG5, and enter the "S6: ignoring incoming call announcements" state.

question_64010.question: What is the impact of the "non-HSUPA" and "non-HSDPA" terms in the context of bearer operations?
question_64010.ground_truth: These terms indicate R99 to pre-HSDPA or pre-HSUPA UMTS bearers.

question_64011.question: What is the total maximum time for overall delays measured in the asynchronous inter frequency cells test in CA mode?
question_64011.ground_truth: The total maximum time for overall delays measured in the asynchronous inter frequency cells test in CA mode is 4802 ms.

question_64012.question: What may the H-RE-NWDAF do with the input data based on HPLMN operator policies and what may it do with the data after that?
question_64012.ground_truth: The H-RE-NWDAF may restrict the exposed input data based on HPLMN operator policies (that may depend on the VPLMN) and may store them for auditing.

question_64014.question: What attribute indicates the satellite backhaul category in a notification for satellite backhaul category change?

question_64015.question: What does the attacker aim to achieve by breaking into a collapsed RNC/NodeB in a particular area?
question_64015.ground_truth: The attacker's objective is to monitor traffic in a certain area and not to follow a user around and intercept his/her traffic while moving. The attacker can achieve this by breaking into a collapsed RNC/NodeB covering that area.

question_64016.question: What is the default response from UDR on success when deleting a data?
question_64016.ground_truth: On success, the UDR responds with "204 No Content" with an empty response body.

question_64017.question: What should the floor control interface do if the MCPTT client negotiated support for queuing and the effective priority level is not pre-emptive when receiving a floor request?
question_64017.ground_truth: The floor control interface shall insert the MCPTT client into the active floor request queue, if not inserted yet, or update the position of the MCPTT client in the active floor request queue, if already inserted, to the position immediately following all queued requests at the same effective priority level.

question_64018.question: What actions can the MCData service take in regards to data transmission requests?
question_64018.ground_truth: The MCData service can reject data transmission requests, queue them, or withhold permission to transmit data automatically.

question_64019.question: What is one of the risks associated with false Base Stations (BSs) broadcasting false Warning Notifications?
question_64019.ground_truth: One risk is to induce panic in the population by sending false warning messages.

question_64020.question: What is the handover delay test requirement in the case of E-UTRA FDD for UE category 1bis?
question_64020.ground_truth: The handover delay Dhandover shall be less than a total of 50 ms in this test case, which is the sum of maximum RRC procedure delay plus Tinterrupt.

question_64021.question: What should the ME do if the USSD control string is longer than the maximum length that can be transmitted to the UICC?
question_64021.ground_truth: If the USSD control string is longer than the maximum length that can be transmitted to the UICC, then the ME shall truncate the URI to the maximum length that can be transmitted to the UICC and send a URI truncated tag to indicate the truncation.

question_64022.question: What is the task of the ADMF in the context of LI functions in CSP networks?
question_64022.ground_truth: The ADMF receives warrant information from Law Enforcement Agencies and provisions the LI functions present in various Network Functions (NFs) of the serving CSP network. Upon provisioning, the LI is activated in those NFs, and the LI functions within those NFs monitor the target's communications and provide the LI as required by the warrant.

question_64023.question: When will the S-CSCF set the state attribute within the <contact> element to "rejected" in the NOTIFY request?
question_64023.ground_truth: The S-CSCF will set the state attribute within the <contact> element to "rejected" if it does not expect the UE to reregister after deregistering the public user identity.

question_64024.question: What is the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) for a QPSK signal operating at a rate of 1/3?
question_64024.ground_truth: The SNR for a QPSK signal operating at a rate of 1/3 is -1 dB.

question_64025.question: Which HTTP status code does the MSGin5G Server return to the AS to indicate the successful deregistration of the AS information?
question_64025.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server returns the HTTP "200 OK" status code to the AS.

question_64027.question: Based on the 3GPP Technical Report, what are the potential benefits of 2 Rx vehicular UE as compared to 4 Rx HH UE in terms of cell coverage and Maximum allowable path loss?
question_64027.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Report indicates that 2 Rx Vehicular UE can provide a larger Maximum allowable path loss value than 4 Rx HH UE and can provide at least 11% larger cell coverage than a 4 Rx HH UE in n41.

question_64029.question: Which bands are being considered for deployment of Advanced E-UTRA and Advanced E-UTRAN?
question_64029.ground_truth: The identified bands for deployment of Advanced E-UTRA and Advanced E-UTRAN include the 450-470 MHz band, 698-862 MHz band, 790-862 MHz band, 2.3-2.4 GHz band, 3.4-4.2 GHz band, and 4.4-4.99 GHz band.

question_64031.question: What is the recommended action to take when the term "shall" is used in a normative context in a referenced non-3GPP document?
question_64031.ground_truth: The recommended action is to follow the normative requirement stated in the referenced non-3GPP document.

question_64034.question: What is the role of the VAL server in the procedure of multiple slices coordinated resource optimization?
question_64034.ground_truth: The VAL server initiates the request for multiple slices coordinated resource optimization towards the NSCE server.

question_64035.question: What is the pre-test condition for MCVideo test case 6.1.4.1?
question_64035.ground_truth: The pre-test conditions are the same as for MCPTT test case 6.1.4.1, with the term "MCPTT" replaced with "MCVideo".

question_64040.question: What media feature tags should the MCVideo client include in the Contact header field of a SIP REGISTER request for service authorization?
question_64040.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include the g.3gpp.mcvideo media feature tag and the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag containing the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcvideo" in the Contact header field of a SIP REGISTER request for service authorization.

question_64041.question: What is the design principle for downlink control signaling on multiple component carriers in LTE-Advanced?
question_64041.ground_truth: For signalling of resource assignments for downlink and uplink transmission, PDCCH on a component carrier assigns PDSCH resources on the same component carrier and PUSCH resources on a single linked UL component carrier. The same Rel-8 PDCCH structure and DCI formats are used on each component carrier.

question_64042.question: What is the purpose of using a two-way delay budget (TWDB) as a new 5QI parameter in 6.29 solution?
question_64042.ground_truth: The purpose of using a two-way delay budget (TWDB) as a new 5QI parameter in 6.29 solution is to increase the DL PDB by an amount equal to the unused UL PDB (and vice versa) to allow an immersive experience for interactive services by keeping the round-trip delay (RTD) below a certain threshold (RTDmax).

question_64044.question: What action does the MS take if the stored LAI is different from the one of the current serving cell and the routing area updating attempt counter is smaller than 5?
question_64044.ground_truth: The MS deletes any LAI, TMSI, ciphering key sequence number, and set the update status to U2 NOT UPDATED. The MM state remains MM LOCATION UPDATING PENDING.

question_64046.question: What technology is mentioned as a potential solution for highly modular and flexible production modules that efficiently and flexibly interact with each other in the context of Connected Industries or Industrial IoT scenarios?

question_64048.question: What is the difference between Deployment Scenario A and B in Parlay X Web Services?
question_64048.ground_truth: Deployment Scenario A combines Web Services interfaces facing the exterior of the network with OSA interfaces facing the interior, while Deployment Scenario B combines Web Services interfaces facing the exterior with network element-specific interfaces facing the interior.

question_64049.question: What is the purpose of Step 7 in the described procedure, and when can it occur?
question_64049.ground_truth: Step 7 involves continuing with the MCVideo group call, which has been transformed into an MCVideo emergency group call. It can occur at any time following step 3, and prior to step 8, based on specific conditions.

question_64050.question: What shall the MME do upon receiving a GTPv2 Delete PDN Connection Set Response message with a specific cause value after sending a Delete PDN Connection Set Request message?
question_64050.ground_truth: The MME is not required to perform any further recovery actions towards SGW and PGW peers for PDN connections in the connection set identified by the MME FQ-CSID(s), regardless of the cause value in the response.

question_64051.question: How is the security functionality handled in the connectionless transmission mode in solution 3b?
question_64051.ground_truth: The security functionality is retained between the UE and the eNB and handled at the PDCP layer. A separate connectionless security context is used by the UE and eNB when the connectionless transmission mode is enabled. The UE uses the connectionless security context and derives the security key (KCLT) for encrypting the small data packet.

question_64053.question: What should the 5G-RG acting on behalf of the AUN3 device do upon receiving an EAP-failure message in the AUTHENTICATION REJECT message?
question_64053.ground_truth: If the EAP-failure message is received in an AUTHENTICATION REJECT message, the 5G-RG acting on behalf of the AUN3 device should start timer T3247 with a random value uniformly drawn from the range between 30 minutes and 60 minutes, if the timer is not running.

question_64054.question: What is the type of attach procedure that a GPRS-attached MS uses when performing a GPRS attach while already IMSI attached in A/Gb mode?
question_64054.ground_truth: The Attach Type in this case is "GPRS Attach while already IMSI attached".

question_64055.question: When should the leaving condition for event A3 be considered satisfied?
question_64055.ground_truth: The leaving condition for event A3 is considered satisfied when the condition A3-2 (Mn + Ofn + Ocn + Hys < Mp + Ofp + Ocp + Off) is fulfilled. Note that Mn, Ofn, Ocn, Mp, Ofp, Ocp, Hys, and Off are expressed in dB, and Mn, Mp are expressed in dBm in case of RSRP, or in dB in case of RSRQ and RS-SINR.

question_64056.question: What are the pre-conditions for the optimized handover procedure from E-UTRAN to WiMAX?
question_64056.ground_truth: The UE must be attached in the WiMAX through pre-registration, and the UE must initiate the handover procedure while still attached to the E-UTRAN network and after it has done handover preparation in the target WiMAX network.

question_64057.question: Which family name is used for measurements related to Data Radio Bearer in the 3GPP technical specification?

question_64059.question: What should the MCVideo client do if an imminent peril indication is included in an incoming SIP INVITE request?
question_64059.ground_truth: If the SIP INVITE request contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the <mcvideo-Params> element containing the <imminentperil-ind> element set to a value of "true", the MCVideo client should display an indication of an MCVideo imminent peril group call to the user and set the MCVideo imminent peril group state to "MVIG 2: in-progress".

question_64060.question: How is the RUA registration by the ICCF initiated for non-ICS UEs?
question_64060.ground_truth: For non-ICS UEs, either the M-CSI attach/detach trigger can be used to inform the ICCF when a UE attaches/detaches, or the HSS can push the attach/detach trigger to inform the ICCF when a UE attaches/detaches.

question_64061.question: What should be the average time interval between successive RAPs in a video Bitstream?
question_64061.ground_truth: It is recommended that RAPs occur in the video Bitstream on average at least every 2 seconds.

question_64062.question: What happens when the PCF provisions a PCC rule with Traffic Parameter Information or PDU Set Control Information?
question_64062.ground_truth: A new QoS Flow is created and the PCC rule is bound to it, with no other PCC rule bound to this QoS Flow.

question_64064.question: What is the solution considered for consistent support of low-latency streaming formats on M4d?
question_64064.ground_truth: The solution considered for consistent support of low-latency streaming formats on M4d is DASH-IF Low-Latency Extensions, which includes UTC Time Sync for accurate latency measurements and new DASH and CMAF functionalities that support enhanced TV services such as pre-selection.

question_64066.question: What should the Authorization header field, as defined in RFC 2617, not be included in the REGISTER request to indicate support for GPRS-IMS-Bundled authentication?
question_64066.ground_truth: It should not be included in the REGISTER request to indicate support for GPRS-IMS-Bundled authentication.

question_64068.question: What is the purpose of the "appReqNotification" structure described in section 6.3.6.2.4?
question_64068.ground_truth: The "appReqNotification" structure defines an application requirement notification message that can be used to notify the result of the network resource adaptation corresponding to the V2X application requirement.

question_64069.question: For which type of IOI is no string prefix used in setting the value of the "orig-ioi" and "term-ioi" header field parameters?
question_64069.ground_truth: If an IOI is a type 2 IOI, no string prefix is used.

question_64070.question: What should a mobile station do after receiving a NOTIFICATION/NCH or NOTIFICATION/FACCH message that contains group call reference(s) that are active in the MS?
question_64070.ground_truth: After receiving a NOTIFICATION/NCH or NOTIFICATION/FACCH message that contains group call reference(s) that are active in the MS, the mobile station shall correctly indicate the notified group/broadcast call reference(s) and join the VGCS/VBS call on the correct channel if a description for the VGCS/VBS channel is included. If no description for the VGCS/VBS channel is included, the mobile station shall establish an RR connection to respond to the notification.

question_64071.question: What happens if the resource representation contains only "attrC" with some value?
question_64071.ground_truth: The new representation after the update contains only "attrC". The existing attributes "attrA" and "attrB" are deleted.

question_64072.question: What is the bandwidth that is used to measure the output power of the UE in UL OLTD operation?
question_64072.ground_truth: The output power is measured in a bandwidth of at least (1+ times the chip rate of the radio access mode.

question_64074.question: What is the measurement name for failed user location query procedures due to a specific failure cause at I-CSCF?
question_64074.ground_truth: The measurement name has the form LIQ.FailLIA.Cause, where Cause identifies the failure cause.

question_64075.question: What is the purpose of the TRP test in 6.3.2.3?
question_64075.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that TRPaverage and TRPmin of the UE is not below specified values, to ensure that the UE has sufficient radiated power to maintain a connection.

question_64077.question: What is the effect of dithering in the comfort noise generation?
question_64077.ground_truth: Dithering in the comfort noise generation introduces random fluctuations in the ISF vector and energy parameters to avoid artificial patterns and ensure a natural sounding noise.

question_64078.question: What is the condition for counting a success for the event "Re-select Cell 2" during the test scenario?
question_64078.ground_truth: The UE must respond on Cell 2 during time duration T1 within 58.9 seconds from the beginning of time period T1.

question_64080.question: What is a PRA ID?
question_64080.ground_truth: The PRA ID is used to identify a Presence Reporting Area (PRA) and can be used for reporting changes of UE presence in a PRA for policy control or charging decisions.

question_64081.question: In what scenario should the UE perform PLMN selection triggered by 5G ProSe direct discovery, as specified in 3GPP TS 23.122?
question_64081.ground_truth: The UE should perform PLMN selection triggered by 5G ProSe direct discovery if it is in 5GMM-IDLE mode and does not have an emergency PDU session.

question_64083.question: How many types of Elementary Procedures (EPs) are there in X2AP and what are the differences between these two types?
question_64083.ground_truth: There are two types of EPs in X2AP: Class 1 and Class 2. Class 1 EPs include a response (success or failure) in a unit of interaction between two eNBs, while Class 2 EPs do not include a response.

question_64084.question: What determines the RFSP Index for radio resource management functionality in a 5G network?
question_64084.ground_truth: The RFSP Index for Allowed NSSAI and RFSP Index for Target NSSAI define the RFSP Index for radio resource management functionality.

question_64085.question: What is the primary purpose of the Post-conditions of the PC service in the Smart Grid?
question_64085.ground_truth: The Post-conditions of the PC service in the Smart Grid are to optimize the management of distribution grid power flows, prevent possible contingencies and overloading of grid components, improve efficient operation of the power grid, power quality, and grid reliability.

question_64086.question: What is the purpose of the cell-ranking criterion Rs for a serving cell?
question_64086.ground_truth: The purpose of the cell-ranking criterion Rs for a serving cell is to determine the rank of the serving cell compared to other cells. The rank is used to determine which cell the UE should select for camping.

question_64087.question: What is the threshold for frequency offset between transmitting RB (aggressor) and receiving channel edge (victim) that determines whether ACS1 or ACS2 applies?
question_64087.ground_truth: The frequency offset between transmitting RB (aggressor) and receiving channel edge (victim) is smaller than 10MHz then ACS1 applies, and if the frequency offset is larger than 10MHz then ACS2 applies.

question_64088.question: Which African country did Morocco gain independence from in 1956?

question_64090.question: What is the significance of the registration and provisioning phases being cryptographically bound together?
question_64090.ground_truth: The registration and provisioning phases being cryptographically bound together ensures the security of the MCIMs during the transfer from a download and provisioning service to the M2ME. This binding process prevents unauthorized access and ensures the integrity of the MCIMs.

question_64091.question: What are the possible states of EPS bearer contexts in the network side?
question_64091.ground_truth: The possible states of EPS bearer contexts in the network side are BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE, BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE PENDING, BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE, BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE PENDING, and BEARER CONTEXT MODIFY PENDING.

question_64092.question: What are the two groups of service attributes used to describe circuit telecommunication services in this TS?
question_64092.ground_truth: The two groups of service attributes are low layer attributes and high layer attributes.

question_64093.question: What should the S-CSCF do if the request is not forwarded to an AS and the outgoing Request-URI is a SIP URI with a "user" SIP URI parameter equals "dialstring" and the domain name of the SIP URI belongs to the home network?
question_64093.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should either forward the request to any appropriate entity in the originator's home network or send an appropriate SIP response to the originator.

question_64094.question: What are the mechanisms for providing location in emergency calls in the IM CN subsystem?
question_64094.ground_truth: The mechanisms for providing location in emergency calls include the UE including a Geolocation header field, the UE including a P-Access-Network-Info header field, the P-CSCF including a P-Access-Network-Info header field, the LRF allocating a location reference, and the S-CSCF including a P-Access-Network-Info header field.

question_64095.question: What is the significance of the TERMINAL RESPONSE in the command response?
question_64095.ground_truth: The TERMINAL RESPONSE indicates that the command was performed successfully and also contains the channel status.

question_64096.question: What is the basic identify E-UTRA FDD UE cat 0 for intra for the minimum measurement period for intra frequency measurements for UE category 0 in the intra-frequency event triggered reporting test?
question_64096.ground_truth: The basic identify E-UTRA FDD UE cat 0 for intra is 1000 ms.

question_64097.question: What is the purpose of the NAS key set identifier information element and what type is it?
question_64097.ground_truth: The NAS key set identifier is allocated by the network and is used to indicate the key set identifier of the current EPS security context. It is a type 1 information element.

question_64098.question: What is the purpose of defining two patterns for discontinuous uplink DPCCH operation?
question_64098.ground_truth: To adapt to the data transmission activity and achieve higher DTX gain based on standardized rules.

question_64099.question: What type is used to report information derived from the Geolocation-header of a SIP message?

question_64100.question: How does the method using RFSP/SPID approach help in distinguishing 2Rx vehicular UEs from other UE types?
question_64100.ground_truth: By defining a new SPID value for "vehicle authorized for 2Rx use" in RFSP/SPID, the MME/AMF can supply the RFSP value to the RAN to control or limit radio resource allocation for 2Rx devices in unauthorized vehicles, allowing for network-based identification of 2Rx vehicular UEs.

question_64101.question: What is the purpose of the discontinuous transmission (DTX) in the GSM half rate speech codec?
question_64101.ground_truth: The discontinuous transmission (DTX) for half rate speech traffic channels specifies the method of reducing the amount of data that needs to be transmitted when there is no voice activity.

question_64103.question: What is the value used for the <dest-address> subfield in the source-filter attribute of the SDP file?
question_64103.ground_truth: The value used for the <dest-address> subfield in the source-filter attribute of the SDP file is the * value.

question_64104.question: What should be done with the MS positioning error in the Measure Position Response message if it does not return a valid result within the Max response time?

question_64106.question: Which reference point supports the communication between the UE and the IM CN subsystem?
question_64106.ground_truth: The Gm reference point supports the communication between the UE and the IM CN subsystem.

question_64107.question: What is the additional optional packetization time for PCM encoded speech in a BICC based Core Network over the Nb interface?

question_64108.question: What is the primary function of the QUIC protocol in relation to HTTP/3?
question_64108.ground_truth: The QUIC protocol is used as the transport layer for HTTP/3 and provides functions such as connection and stream multiplexing, fast startup, loss recovery, and congestion control.

question_64111.question: What should the P-CSCF do if it receives a request for an unknown method from the UE that does not relate to an existing dialog and there is a service route value list exists for the served user of the request?
question_64111.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall select an I-CSCF and insert a Route header field with the URI of the I-CSCF as the topmost Route header field if the UE is performing the functions of an external attached network using static mode of operation, and preserve the order of the Service-Route header field with the list of URIs received in the request if not.

question_64113.question: What are the benefits of user data convergence in 3GPP networks?
question_64113.ground_truth: User data convergence in 3GPP networks can significantly enhance the ability to offer complex and combined services, reduce data redundancy, unify the user data access interface and its protocol, and promote new service application development.

question_64114.question: What component of the GCS AS is responsible for sending the media on both unicast and multicast paths towards the Remote UE in the ProSe UE-to-Network Relay architecture?
question_64114.ground_truth: The User Plane part of the GCS AS

question_64115.question: What happens if a PDU Session needs to be re-anchored to a distributed anchor point?
question_64115.ground_truth: If a PDU Session needs to be re-anchored to a distributed anchor point, the UE will trigger a DNS Query for an FQDN and the DNS Response from the query will determine the selected EAS. If there's a change in the PDU Session Anchor in SSC mode 2 or 3, the SMF will indicate to the EASDF to discard the DNS Response and the UE will restart the DNS Query.

question_64116.question: What is the initial state of the mobile station in the test described?

question_64117.question: What is the purpose of the new functionality between the AGCH and EC-AGCH?
question_64117.ground_truth: The new functionality between the AGCH and EC-AGCH is used to support the same functionality between the two in case a device has determined its access to be on the RACH on TS0 and will monitor the corresponding DL resource on the AGCH on TS0 for a response to its access request, and the same principle would apply on EC-RACH and EC-AGCH on TS1.

question_64118.question: Who is responsible for rejecting additional emergency PDN Connection requests in 4.5.7.2.7?
question_64118.ground_truth: The ePDG/TWAG is responsible for rejecting any additional emergency PDN Connection requests in 4.5.7.2.7.

question_64120.question: What are the minimum conformance requirements for the TDD RSRP relative measurements of cells?
question_64120.ground_truth: The TDD RSRP relative measurements of cells shall meet the relative accuracy requirements defined in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.2.4, and these accuracy requirements are valid under specific conditions, such as the transmission of cell-specific reference signals, fulfillment of reference sensitivity conditions, and specific RSRP values, among others.

question_64121.question: What is the state of the Mobile Station (MS) before it starts the test procedure?
question_64121.ground_truth: The MS is in Packet Idle mode, GPRS attached with support of GERAN Feature Package 1 indicated in MS Radio Access Capabilities, and PDP context 2 established.

question_64122.question: How should the UE include its geographical location information in an UPDATE request, if the geographical location information of the UE is available but it is not aware of the URI that points to where the UE's location is stored?
question_64122.ground_truth: The UE should include the geographical location information as PIDF location object in a message body with the content type application/pidf+xml in accordance with RFC 4119 and include the location object in a message body with the content type application/pidf+xml in accordance with RFC 6442.

question_64123.question: What are the possible statuses that the LCLS Status IE can indicate?
question_64123.ground_truth: The LCLS Status IE can indicate that LCLS is to be released, LCLS is to be released due to handover, LCLS is to be re-connected after LCLS break, or Indicate DL data after handover - Handover Detected.

question_64129.question: What is the function of the Proxy-CSCF (P-CSCF) in the IMS architecture?
question_64129.ground_truth: The Proxy-CSCF (P-CSCF) is responsible for handling SIP signaling towards the IM SS and providing the point of entry and exit of IMS for the UE.

question_64130.question: In the pre-condition of the tug service, what is the role of the ENC service?
question_64130.ground_truth: The ENC service provides the latest information about a port or sea area, such as the depth of water, buoys, navigational routes, and berth information.

question_64132.question: What is the maximum duration of the test for verifying that the MS does not change the PTC parameters if requested to make an illegal change to a parameter?
question_64132.ground_truth: The maximum duration of the test is 1 min.

question_64134.question: Which SCCP messages are supported on the E1 Interface?
question_64134.ground_truth: All ITU-T Recommendation Q.712 subclauses 1.1 to 1.14 SCCP messages are supported on the E1 Interface, but SOG and SOR messages are not used.

question_64137.question: What is the role of LCID in identifying ingress RLC channels?
question_64137.ground_truth: LCID (Logical Channel Identifier) is used on the MAC sub-header to determine the ingress RLC channel at the receiver. However, the exact placement and usage of the LCID in the L2 header stack differ based on the design example and the specific bearer mapping type (N:1 or 1:1).

question_64138.question: What is the purpose of the RAB-TrCH-Mapping and RAB-TrCH-MappingItem sequences in the 3GPP TS 25.427 standard?
question_64138.ground_truth: The RAB-TrCH-Mapping and RAB-TrCH-MappingItem sequences allow the definition of mappings between the radio access bearer (RAB) and transport channel (TrCH), including parameters like rab-ID, trCH-ID-List, and iE-Extensions.

question_64139.question: What is the expected sequence if the MS sends a FACILITY message containing the same transaction identifier and a return error component after requesting a private communication with Call A-B?
question_64139.ground_truth: Both calls shall return to their initial states, and the call states shall be verified by the SS sending a STATUS ENQUIRY message in respect of the transaction identifier of each call.

question_64141.question: What reference point is introduced to remove unnecessary protocol stacks between UE and the EGANC in the enhanced Up reference point?

question_64142.question: What information is provided from the "Monitor" step to the "Analyze" step in the closed control loop?
question_64142.ground_truth: The information provided from the "Monitor" step to the "Analyze" step includes performance measurements, KPI's, performance threshold monitoring events, and fault supervision events.

question_64143.question: What is one role of the Device Trigger Gateway solution in addressing the Key Issue - MTC Identifiers?
question_64143.ground_truth: The Device Trigger Gateway solution addresses part of the Key Issue - MTC Identifiers by supporting MSISDN-less delivery of MT SMS, allowing SMS-based device triggering without an MSISDN.

question_64144.question: How is a private call or pre-arranged group call request made using a pre-established session in MCPTT?
question_64144.ground_truth: On-network MCPTT UEs use SIP procedures to establish call for outgoing private call setup or pre-arranged group call using a pre-established session. Media plane control procedures are used for incoming pre-arranged group calls, while SIP procedures are used for incoming private calls in automatic commencement mode and manual commencement mode.

question_64145.question: What special co-existence requirements may apply to the case of operation with overlapping frequency arrangements in the same geographical area, which are not covered by the 3GPP specifications?
question_64145.ground_truth: Special co-existence requirements may apply to the case of operation with overlapping frequency arrangements in the same geographical area, which are not covered by the 3GPP specifications.

question_64147.question: What should the NG-RAN node do when the Report Characteristics IE is set to "OnDemand" and the Inter-RAT Measurement Quantities IE is included in the E-CID MEASUREMENT INITIATION REQUEST message?
question_64147.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node should provide the corresponding measurements, if available in the NG-RAN node, in the Inter-RAT Measurement Result IE in E-CID MEASUREMENT INITIATION RESPONSE message.

question_64150.question: In what situation can the immediate assignment procedure be initiated by the RR entity of the mobile station?
question_64150.ground_truth: The immediate assignment procedure can be initiated by the RR entity of the mobile station in response to a request from the MM sublayer to enter the dedicated mode or in response to a CTS~PAGING~REQUEST message.

question_64151.question: Which timer is started for each of the allocated traffic channels when sending synchronization patterns to the UE?
question_64151.ground_truth: Timer T is started for each of the allocated traffic channels when sending synchronization patterns to the UE.

question_64153.question: Upon receiving a REGISTER request without an Authorization header at the S-CSCF, what should it do?
question_64153.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall identify the user by the public user identity in the To header of the REGISTER request, store the UE's IP address or prefix, and check whether a "received" parameter exists in the Via header field provided by the UE.

question_64154.question: In which situation should the MAC entity select any SSB?
question_64154.ground_truth: The MAC entity should select any SSB if no SSB with SS-RSRP above rsrp-ThresholdSSB is available or if it is in contention-based Random Access preamble selection for the second transmission of Msg3.

question_64157.question: What should the UE do when it considers the leaving condition to be satisfied for the A6 event?
question_64157.ground_truth: The UE should remove the concerned cell(s) from the cellsTriggeredList and stop the periodical reporting timer, if running.

question_64158.question: What is the security requirement for providing equivalence with MCPTT in video communications?
question_64158.ground_truth: From a security point-of-view, video communications are equivalent to voice communications, but with a different (video-enabled) codec. Hence the security requirements on eMCPTT also apply to MCVideo.

question_64159.question: What should the UE do after receiving a REGISTRATION REJECT message with 5GMM cause #79 (UAS services not allowed), and it is operated in single-registration mode?
question_64159.ground_truth: If the UE is operating in single-registration mode and receives a REGISTRATION REJECT message with 5GMM cause #79 (UAS services not allowed), it shall set the EPS update status to EU2 NOT UPDATED, reset the tracking area updating attempt counter, and enter the state EMM-REGISTERED.

question_64161.question: What are the three sets of functions required for a GSM PLMN connection?
question_64161.ground_truth: The three sets of functions required for a GSM PLMN connection are: (i) connection means for user information, including transmission and switching, (ii) control functions and protocols, including signalling, flow/congestion control and routing functions, and (iii) operations and management functions, including network management and maintenance functions.

question_64162.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Report on Fixed Mobile Convergence?
question_64162.ground_truth: The purpose of the report is to define the metadata for Performance Management (PM) performance measurements, known as Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) or counters, in order to enforce consistency in the description and definition of all standardized performance measurements in converged networks.

question_64163.question: When the input bit sequence to the channel coding operation for SPUCCH format 4 has a length of E, how is the output bit sequence obtained?
question_64163.ground_truth: The output bit sequence is obtained by circular repetition of the sequence, where i = 0, 1, 2, ..., E-1.

question_64164.question: What is the aim of Solution #1: Change of USS during flight?
question_64164.ground_truth: The aim of Solution #1: Change of USS during flight is to address the gaps identified in Key Issue #2: Support for multi-USS deployments by registering the UAE clients and the UAE servers multi-USS capabilities to the USS, provision of the capabilities and policies of the USS to the UAE client and the UAE server, and assistance by the UAE layer at change of USS.

question_64165.question: In the definition of hard handover delay, what does Dhandover equal to?
question_64165.ground_truth: The hard handover delay Dhandover equals the RRC procedure delay plus the interruption time.

question_64166.question: What should the UDM do if the NF service consumer sends a request to delete a Parameter Provisioning Data Entry and the Parameter Provisioning Data Entry for the AF does not exist?
question_64166.ground_truth: The UDM should return HTTP status code "404 Not Found" including additional error information in the response body.

question_64168.question: How is the DUT positioned if the sum of the readings from Step 2 and 3 is less than 30 mm?
question_64168.ground_truth: The DUT is positioned on the 30 mm location on the spacer instead.

question_64171.question: In the context of adding a NR SCell belonging to MCG, how long may the interruption on PSCell or activated Scell in SCG be, when the SCell is added, and how is the duration of the interruption determined?
question_64171.ground_truth: An interruption on PSCell or activated Scell in SCG when one NR SCell belonging to MCG is added is not allowed to exceed X1 subframes for synchronous intraband NE-DC, X1+1 subframes for asynchronous intraband NE-DC, 1 subframe for synchronous interband NE-DC, or 2 subframes for asynchronous interband NE-DC. X1 is equal to the duration of the SMTC of the Scell being added + 1 ms.

question_64172.question: In periodic communication for automation, what is the typical length of periodic intervals?
question_64172.ground_truth: Most periodic intervals in communication for automation are rather short.

question_64175.question: What is the requirement to pass the test for missed ACK and false ACK in 10.2.2.1.2A.2?
question_64175.ground_truth: To pass the test, the ratio (missed (ACK) / all valid ACKs, sent) must be less than or equal to 0.05 and the ratio (false (ACK) / all valid samples) must be less than or equal to 0.0002.

question_64176.question: Which documents, as listed in the 3GPP series, are related to the half rate speech traffic channels and voice activity detection?

question_64177.question: In the test requirement 27.22.4.9.3.5, which expected sequence is the ME meant to operate in accordance with?

question_64178.question: When should a P-CSCF initiate the PCRF based P-CSCF restoration procedure with a 404 (Not Found) response?
question_64178.ground_truth: When it has no binding for the identity in the Request-URI, the Restoration-Info header field is included in the incoming request, and the PCRF based P-CSCF restoration is supported.

question_64181.question: What information does the MSC/IWF use for selecting the modem type and speed for non-transparent service support?
question_64181.ground_truth: The MSC/IWF uses the Compatibility information contained in the call set-up or call confirmed message for selecting the modem type and speed for non-transparent service support.

question_64182.question: What is the effect of speed on the UE's receiver performance in a Unidirectional SFN network?
question_64182.ground_truth: The simulation results suggest that the receiver performance of a UE operating in a Unidirectional SFN network is insensitive to the speed at which it is moving.

question_64184.question: What is the procedure followed if the UE decides to accept only non-speech media in the request that includes bi-directional speech or CS media?
question_64184.ground_truth: The SCC AS splits the non-speech media from the bi-directional speech or CS media for this UE and re-attempts the terminating call setup directly towards the same UE over the CS domain if possible.

question_64185.question: What is the pre-requisite for transferring a media flow from one Controllee UE to another using the controller?
question_64185.ground_truth: A collaborative session with two media flows, Media-A on the Controller UE and Media-B on the first Controllee UE.

question_64186.question: How is network management capability exposure regulated via BSS?
question_64186.ground_truth: Exposure of service data to companies that are external to the operator is regulated by contracts. Different customers may have access to different management capabilities, which may differ on what attributes/policies/intents are allowed to be changed, which value ranges changes are allowed, and which performance metrics are allowed to be exposed.

question_64187.question: What are the propagation conditions for the gNB SRS-RSRP absolute accuracy requirements in FR1 and FR2?
question_64187.ground_truth: The propagation conditions for the gNB SRS-RSRP absolute accuracy requirements in FR1 and FR2 are AWGN propagation conditions.

question_64188.question: What is the main objective of provisioning 5G network to support UAS services?
question_64188.ground_truth: To avoid safety risks such as mid-air collision with another UAV, loss of control of a UAV, intentional misuse of a UAV, and sharing of airspace by various UAS users. This is done by guaranteeing QoS for the C2 communication.

question_64189.question: What parameter should be used as a link antenna instead of the measurement antenna when using an LTE link in the indirect far field (IFF) method 1?
question_64189.ground_truth: A link antenna should be used as a link antenna instead of the measurement antenna when using an LTE link in the indirect far field (IFF) method 1, to provide the LTE link to the DUT in NSA mode and NR CA mode.

question_64190.question: What should the S-CSCF do if the NP data was obtained from the database and there is no "npdi" parameter in the received request, and the translation from an international public telecommunications number to a SIP URI failed?
question_64190.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall replace the URI in the Request-URI with the obtained NP data, prior to forwarding the request to the BGCF or other appropriate entity.

question_64191.question: What information is used to correlate associated application usage of PS bearer level resources in the IMS domain?
question_64191.ground_truth: An Application Function (AF), such as the P-CSCF, may provide an AF-Charging-Identifier (typically the ICID) to the PCRF when authorizing PS domain resources. The AF-Charging-Identifier is then included in PCC rules and usage reports to associate resources with an IMS session.

question_64192.question: In MCVideo Conformance testing, what are the possible roles of the System Simulator (SS)?
question_64192.ground_truth: The System Simulator (SS) in MCVideo Conformance testing can simulate the MCVideo Server, MCVideo Clients, MCVideo Users, and MCVideo groups as necessary for testing.

question_64193.question: When would a UE not transmit subframe-PUCCH in a given subframe if the UE detects PDCCH/SPDCCH with uplink DCI format 7-0A/7-0B corresponding to a slot/subslot-PUSCH transmission in the same subframe?
question_64193.ground_truth: This would occur if the UE is not capable of simultaneous transmission of different uplink signal durations to different serving cells, and if there is a collision between a slot-PUCCH of the first serving cell and a subframe-PUSCH/PUCCH/SRS/PRACH of the second serving cell, or if there is a subslot-PUCCH of the first serving cell and a subframe/slot-PUSCH/PUCCH/SRS/PRACH of the second serving cell.

question_64194.question: What is the procedure for pause of charging when I-SMF is involved for a PDU Session?
question_64194.ground_truth: When I-SMF is involved for a PDU Session, the procedure for pause of charging is applied by replacing the H-SMF with SMF and V-SMF with I-SMF. When a Local UPF (PSA) is involved, the SMF stops or starts the usage reporting including usage reporting at the Local UPF (PSA) via the I-SMF.

question_64195.question: When a railway emergency alert is terminated in the FRMCS system and there is an ongoing railway emergency call in the GSM-R system, what happens to the railway emergency voice communication in the FRMCS system?
question_64195.ground_truth: The railway emergency voice communication in the FRMCS system continues to be active when a railway emergency alert is terminated and there is an ongoing railway emergency call in the GSM-R system.

question_64196.question: What should the UE do at switch on or following recovery from lack of coverage, in automatic network selection mode, with HPLMN, UPLMN, and OPLMN NG-RAN cells available and a USIM with Access Technology data files for each PLMN?
question_64196.ground_truth: The UE should select a cell of the highest priority PLMN and attempt registration with mobility on the selected cell.

question_64197.question: What is the location updating procedure that the MS should follow after receiving a LOCATION UPDATING ACCEPT or a LOCATION UPDATING REJECT message?
question_64197.ground_truth: The MS should stop and reset the timer T3212 and perform a periodic location updating after T3212 expiry.

question_64198.question: What is the minimum requirement for the OTA occupied bandwidth for BS type 1-O and BS type 2-O?
question_64198.ground_truth: The OTA occupied bandwidth for each NR carrier should be less than the BS channel bandwidth for both BS type 1-O and BS type 2-O. For intra-band contiguous CA, the OTA occupied bandwidth should be less than or equal to the aggregated BS channel bandwidth.

question_64199.question: What should the SS do when setting up RF parameters while MEASUREMENT REPORT messages from UE are ignored in Test 2 and Test 3?
question_64199.ground_truth: The SS should wait for an additional 1s and ignore MEASUREMENT REPORT messages during this period, before repeating steps 5), 6), and 7).

question_64200.question: What are the two criteria considered in the comparison of solutions 1 and 2 for improved RRC synchronized procedures?
question_64200.ground_truth: The two criteria considered are signalling saving and latency reduction.

question_64202.question: What is the role of the Pre-emption Capability IE and Pre-emption Vulnerability IE in the MBMS session establishment process?
question_64202.ground_truth: The Pre-emption Capability IE and Pre-emption Vulnerability IE are used to determine whether the session has to be started unconditionally and immediately, and to determine whether the session shall be included in the pre-emption process.

question_64203.question: In the evaluation of PBCH coverage impact, what was the PBCH performance degradation (in dB) of the potential Rel-18 UE with soft/selective combining and RF retuning compared to Rel-15 NR UE with soft/selective combining?
question_64203.ground_truth: The PBCH performance degradation (in dB) of the potential Rel-18 UE with soft/selective combining and RF retuning compared to Rel-15 NR UE with soft/selective combining was 9.3.

question_64204.question: What is the common ground between the two solutions to manage and track the NF instance identifiers per end entity in the trust chain management?
question_64204.ground_truth: Both solutions require building an initial trust between NF and operator CA and verifying the NF identity at the certificate enrolment phase.

question_64206.question: What is the purpose of performing Downlink DSCP marking on the outer header for EPC routed traffic in the WLAN case?
question_64206.ground_truth: The purpose of performing downlink DSCP marking on the outer header for EPC routed traffic in the WLAN case is that the P-GW in the 3GPP domain sets a per-flow DSCP marking on each packet outer header.

question_64209.question: What is the role of the PEMC in registering the PINE and PEGC with the PIN server?
question_64209.ground_truth: The PEMC registers the PINE and PEGC with the PIN server by substituting for them and handling the registration process on their behalf.

question_64210.question: What type of service experience does the AR Enabled Immersive Experience use case provide?
question_64210.ground_truth: The AR Enabled Immersive Experience use case provides a location-agnostic service experience of watching movies in certain circumstances, such as at home or on the train, through AR glasses. It provides an immersive watching experience with 3D cinematic effects, and allows users to invite friends to watch a movie at different places simultaneously.

question_64211.question: What is the duration of the E-UTRA test models for PBCH?

question_64212.question: What is the criticality of the "id-E-AI-Capability" in the provided code?

question_64214.question: What is the header that contains the date and time when the originating entity initiated the request in the 3GPP SBI interface?

question_64216.question: What should the AMF do with the content of the Payload container IE and Payload container information IE when the Additional information IE is not included in the UL NAS TRANSPORT message and the Payload container type is "Location services message container"?
question_64216.ground_truth: The AMF shall provide the Payload container type and the content of the Payload container IE and Payload container information, if included, to the location services application.

question_64217.question: What is the purpose of the Initial Record (IRI) in the context of MBMS?
question_64217.ground_truth: The Initial Record (IRI) in the context of MBMS is used to convey the first event of MBMS service interception.

question_64218.question: Which SMF/UPF action is taken if the UPF receives an IGMP / MLD request for the first time?
question_64218.ground_truth: If the UPF receives an IGMP / MLD request for the first time, the UPF exchanges N6 signalling such as PIM to connect to the N6 multicast distribution tree related with this IP multicast traffic.

question_64219.question: What should a UE do when it is camped on an E-UTRAN cell that indicates support for ProSe direct communication but it is not authorized for it?
question_64219.ground_truth: The UE should perform either ProSe direct communication procedures specified in subclause 10.2.2 or ProSe direct communication procedures specified in subclause 10.2.3, depending on the network support.

question_64221.question: When is the UE allowed to deactivate MICO mode and activate the AS layer for multicast or broadcast MBS sessions?
question_64221.ground_truth: The UE is allowed to deactivate MICO mode and activate the AS layer at the MBS start time and at any scheduled activation times of a multicast or broadcast MBS session, if those times are available.

question_64222.question: What should the gsmSRF/SSF request the MGW to do when playing an announcement as per clause 14.1.2.2?
question_64222.ground_truth: The gsmSRF/SSF should request the MGW to play the announcement as per the procedures described in clause 14.6.

question_64223.question: What is one of the main considerations for the evolution of the 3GPP system to an AIPN?
question_64223.ground_truth: Extensibility to enable step-by-step implementation without negatively affecting basic system performance.

question_64224.question: What is the difference between the on-network and off-network group information update procedures?
question_64224.ground_truth: The on-network procedure involves the V2X application specific server informing the VAE server about the updates, while the off-network procedure involves the V2X application specific client in V2X UE A informing the VAE client in V2X UE A.

question_64225.question: What happens to the location update attempt counter when the mobile station is in the MM IDLE sub-state ATTEMPTING to UPDATE and the location updating procedure is triggered?
question_64225.ground_truth: The location update attempt counter is reset when a new PLMN is selected or a new location area is entered after the location updating procedure is triggered in the MM IDLE sub-state ATTEMPTING to UPDATE.

question_64226.question: What are the files provided for assisting in codec type approval testing?
question_64226.ground_truth: SEQ05.INP and SEQ05.DEC are two homing sequences provided for assisting in codec type approval testing.

question_64227.question: In what scenarios is the Gate status set to "closed" in the PCC rules for non 3GPP PS Data Off Exempt Services?
question_64227.ground_truth: The Gate status is set to "closed" in the PCC rules for non 3GPP PS Data Off Exempt Services when the received UE's 3GPP PS Data Off status is activated and the related downlink service data flow shall be prevented at the PGW/GGSN.

question_64228.question: What is the main advantage of using frequency hopping capability in a network?
question_64228.ground_truth: The main advantage of using frequency hopping capability in a network is to provide diversity on one transmission link and average the quality on all communications through interferers diversity.

question_64229.question: How do conducted and OTA FDD systems differ in terms of receiver spurious emission requirements?
question_64229.ground_truth: Conducted FDD systems do not have expected receiver spurious emissions to increase the total spurious emission level, as the transmitter and the receiver are both on at the same time and can be specified on separate connectors. On the other hand, OTA FDD systems do not have receiver spurious emission requirements as the requirement is over the air and the transmitter and receiver cannot be separated.

question_64230.question: What should the MAC entity do during contention-based Random Access preamble selection if the potential Msg3 size is greater than ra-Msg3SizeGroupA and the pathloss is less than a certain value?
question_64230.ground_truth: The MAC entity should select the Random Access Preambles group B.

question_64231.question: What is the purpose of the UUAA Authorization Payload in the UUAA procedure?
question_64231.ground_truth: The UUAA Authorization Payload is used to send UAS security information to the UAV on successful completion of a UUAA. The contents of the security information are out of scope of the 3GPP specifications.

question_64233.question: What does the "Reserved bit" in the GNSS Validity Duration Report MAC Control Element indicate?
question_64233.ground_truth: The "Reserved bit" in the GNSS Validity Duration Report MAC Control Element is set to 0.

question_64235.question: What is the goal of the blocking characteristics test in 14.7.4.2?
question_64235.ground_truth: The goal of the test is to verify the in-band and out-of-band blocking performance of the receiver. The test specifies that the reference sensitivity performance shall be met when a useful signal at a specific frequency is input to the receiver along with a continuous sine wave signal at a particular level.

question_64236.question: When should the NF service consumer or the SCP request a new access token when they receive a "401 Unauthorized" response or a "403 Forbidden" response with a "WWW-Authenticate" header from the NF service producer?
question_64236.ground_truth: They should request a new access token when they receive an error response, e.g. to retrieve a new access token with the scopes or claims required by the NF service producer.

question_64239.question: What should the NAS (non-access stratum) do upon receiving an indication from the lower layers that the barring is alleviated for the access category with which the access attempt was associated, if the event which triggered the access attempt was a request from upper layers to send a mobile originated SMS over NAS?
question_64239.ground_truth: The NAS may initiate the NAS transport procedure as specified in subclause~5.4.5 to send the SMS in an UL NAS TRANSPORT message, if still needed.

question_64240.question: When is a mobile station required to exit DTR mode?
question_64240.ground_truth: When an RLC data block with BSN equal to V(S) is transmitted and the medium access mode is Dynamic Allocation.

question_64243.question: What is the abbreviation for "International Alphabet No. 5" in the context of telecommunications?

question_64245.question: What is the purpose of the HomeNetworkIndication leaf in the selection criteria node?
question_64245.ground_truth: The HomeNetworkIndication leaf indicates whether only the WLANs that are operated by the home operator could match the group of selection criteria or not.

question_64246.question: What is the role of the PC5 SRAP sublayer in L2 U2N Relay for uplink data?
question_64246.ground_truth: The PC5 SRAP sublayer at the L2 U2N Remote UE is responsible for UL bearer mapping between L2 U2N Remote UE end-to-end Uu Radio Bearers and egress PC5 Relay RLC channels.

question_64247.question: What should the network do when it receives a PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST message with an unassigned or reserved EPS bearer identity value?
question_64247.ground_truth: The network should respond with a PDN DISCONNECT REJECT message including ESM cause #43 "invalid EPS bearer identity".

question_64248.question: When should the UE include the Integrity protection maximum data rate IE in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message?
question_64248.ground_truth: The UE shall include the Integrity protection maximum data rate IE in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message to indicate the maximum data rate per UE for user-plane integrity protection supported by the UE for uplink and the maximum data rate per UE for user-plane integrity protection supported by the UE for downlink.

question_64249.question: How many bits are used for the "Time domain resource assignment" field in the DCI, when the DCI is not for a random access procedure?

question_64250.question: What is one of the principles of solution #26 to support multiple areas and resource partitioning?
question_64250.ground_truth: One of the principles is to support moving UEs by defining smaller TAs and maintaining a uniform support of network slice availability per TA.

question_64251.question: What is the format of the OS specific application identifier?
question_64251.ground_truth: The format of the OS specific application identifier is manufacturer specific.

question_64252.question: What is the purpose of temporarily disabling an MCX UE in the MCX Service?
question_64252.ground_truth: Temporarily disabling an MCX UE limits its access capability per Mission Critical Organization policy and can be re-enabled by the MCX Service Administrator or an authorized MCX User. This mechanism is used to provide a temporary solution when an MCX UE needs to be disabled for maintenance, troubleshooting, or user behavior correction.

question_64253.question: Which type of network sharing is supported for NR-DC in 5G system architecture?
question_64253.ground_truth: NR-DC within a single SNPN or within PNI-NPN or across PLMN and PNI-NPN is supported for 5G system architecture

question_64254.question: What is the maximum time allowed for the cell to remain known, before the UE is required to meet the corresponding PSS/SSS detection requirement in inter-frequency CCA?
question_64254.ground_truth: The maximum time requirement for the cell to remain known

question_64257.question: What is the command number for the GET INKEY type command in the expected sequence 6.1A?

question_64258.question: Upon inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode in 5GMM-IDLE mode, what does the UE do when initiating the mobility registration update procedure if handover PDU session from EPC is supported by the AMF?
question_64258.ground_truth: The UE shall transfer all active PDN connections from S1 mode to N1 mode by initiating the PDU session establishment procedure with request type set to "existing PDU session".

question_64260.question: What is the purpose of the PHR MAC CEs?
question_64260.ground_truth: The PHR MAC CEs indicate the presence of a Power Headroom (PH) field for the Serving Cell and the presence of a Pcmax,f,c for assumed PUSCH field for the Serving Cell. The PH field indicates the power headroom level and the PCMAX,f,c field indicates the PCMAX,f,c value used for calculation of the preceding PH field.

question_64261.question: What is the difference between the multicast mode and broadcast mode of MBMS?
question_64261.ground_truth: In the multicast mode, data is efficiently transmitted from a single source to a multicast group in the associated multicast service area. While in the broadcast mode, data is transmitted from a single source entity to all users in a broadcast service area.

question_64262.question: What is the action taken by the Source HNB after receiving the RNSAP: ENHANCED RELOCATION REQUEST message?
question_64262.ground_truth: The Source HNB decides to relocate the UE to the Target HNB.

question_64263.question: What is the purpose of the property "initdir" and what are its possible values?
question_64263.ground_truth: The property "initdir" indicates whether or not the termination in the MGW should expect initialisation information or initiate UP initialisation itself. The possible values it can take are "In" (for incoming) and "Out" (for outgoing).

question_64264.question: What is the purpose of the test described in clause 16.5.4.2.4?
question_64264.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in clause 16.5.4.2.4 is to verify the UE specific CBW change delay requirement for NR RedCap UEs with 2 Rx.

question_64265.question: What should be the value of the "numberOfRequestedVectors" in the SendAuthenticationInfoArg when there is no Requested-EUTRAN-Authentication-Info AVP and Requested-UTRAN-GERAN-Authentication-Info AVP is present within AIR?
question_64265.ground_truth: The value of the Number-Of-Requested-Vectors AVP received within the Requested-UTRAN-GERAN-Authentication-Info AVP.

question_64267.question: What is the function of the PLMN component MAF009 (Call forwarding on no reply authorizations examination)?
question_64267.ground_truth: MAF009 is a function that authorizes a PLMN component to determine the authorizations relating to call forwarding on no reply.

question_64268.question: How does the registration procedure for a 5G-RG connecting to a 5GC via W-5GAN differ from that of NG-RAN?
question_64268.ground_truth: When a 5G-RG connects to a 5GC via W-5GAN, a W-CP protocol stack message is used between the 5G-RG and the W-5GAN to encapsulate NAS messages. The authentication method is executed between the 5G-RG and AUSF.

question_64271.question: What should the responder TC-USER do when it receives a TC-BEGIN indication primitive with an unsupported application-context-name?
question_64271.ground_truth: The responder TC-USER should issue a TC-U-ABORT request primitive if the application-context-name included in the primitive is not supported.

question_64272.question: When should the floor control server interface send a Floor Taken message?
question_64272.ground_truth: It should send a Floor Taken message when: (a) there is no stored SSRC for dual floor, (b) there is a stored SSRC for dual floor and the G-bit is not set to '1', or (c) there is a stored SSRC for dual floor and the G-bit is set to '1' for specific floor participants.

question_64273.question: What is the purpose of the provisioning and management of services in MExE?
question_64273.ground_truth: The purpose of provisioning and management of services in MExE is to provide a standardized method for MExE devices to discover, install, control, execute, terminate, and delete services, and includes download and installation of the service's client application.

question_64274.question: In section 6.1.2.4.2, what are the two clauses in TS 38.304 that specify the conformance requirements relevant to the test case?

question_64275.question: What is a PIN Element with Gateway Capability, and what is its function in a PIN?
question_64275.ground_truth: A PIN Element with Gateway Capability is a UE PIN Element that has the ability to provide connectivity to and from the 5G network for other PIN Elements that use PIN direct connections.

question_64277.question: When does the PDG drop user data before processing user packets?
question_64277.ground_truth: The PDG drops user data before processing user packets if some external applications require RADIUS Accounting request (Start) information before they can process user packets, and if the Accounting Response (START) is not received.

question_64278.question: What is an AAMRule in the context of AAM?
question_64278.ground_truth: An AAMRule is a way for the IRPManager to define which alarms or alarm clearings deliver significant or insignificant information. The choice of rule depends on various factors, such as the type of alarm, environment, and time of day. The goal is to reduce the number of reported alarms to a reasonable and manageable level.

question_64280.question: What should the UE do if it has a valid GUTI and is initiating the detach procedure for EPS services only?
question_64280.ground_truth: The UE should populate the EPS mobile identity IE with the valid GUTI.

question_64282.question: What is the impact of transcoding on media security in SIP traffic?
question_64282.ground_truth: In order to support transcoding in SIP traffic, media protection needs to be terminated before or at the transcoder. The current IMS architecture has specified that transcoding function may be present in the TrGW, the MRFP and the CS/IMS-MGW. Hence, the media security architecture shall not prevent a visited network from providing transcoding service on behalf of flows for roaming UE.

question_64283.question: What is the purpose of providing a centralized application for the MNO to manage devices and their groups in an enterprise?
question_64283.ground_truth: The purpose is to efficiently provide information about devices and their groups to the MNO, as traditional methods like phone calls and emails are time-consuming and not convenient for managers when adding new devices or creating new groups.

question_64284.question: What is the function of UE-to-UE relays in communication between UEs?
question_64284.ground_truth: UE-to-UE relays provide a service of relaying traffic among UEs. They can be authorized to participate in the establishment of unicast communication between two UEs by broadcasting Direct Communication Request messages.

question_64285.question: What action does the HSS take when it decides to cancel a Monitoring Event for indicated UEs?
question_64285.ground_truth: The HSS includes the External Identifier or MSISDN of the indicated UEs towards the SCEF to cancel the Monitoring Event.

question_64287.question: What is the purpose of the correction factor in the CDP formula for 16QAM modulation in the communication system?
question_64287.ground_truth: The purpose of the correction factor is to ensure the accuracy of the CDP for each individual code power relative to the total power of all active codes in the presence of 16QAM modulation. This factor depends on the fractions of symbols (00, 01, 10, 11) transmitted during the test.

question_64288.question: What is the role of the 'Event Specific Information' in the Event Report SMS Information Flow?
question_64288.ground_truth: The 'Event Specific Information' contains specific information about the event type in the Event Report SMS Information Flow.

question_64289.question: What is a "web application" in the context of the present document?
question_64289.ground_truth: A "web application" is an Internet-enabled, client-server software application, typically written in HTML, Javascript and CSS, for which the client (or user interface) runs in the web browser.

question_64291.question: How does the NG-RAN calculate UL packet delay if there is no UL service packet for UL packet delay monitoring?
question_64291.ground_truth: In this case, the NG-RAN sends a dummy UL packet as a monitoring response, which includes the received times and local times at different stages of the process.

question_64293.question: What should a Mobile Station (MS) claiming to not support AoCC do when it receives a CONNECT message with AoCC information while in the U4 state?
question_64293.ground_truth: The MS should ignore the AoCC information and not send any AoCC information acknowledgement.

question_64295.question: What is the effect of security requirements on exception procedures or unsuccessful outcome in the VGCS service?
question_64295.ground_truth: VGCS service has security requirements like over-the-air ciphering and Guaranteeing privacy of SMS, failure indication, call rejection and call maintenance when a group call member want to establish, operate or participate in the voice group call, this is as per the document.

question_64296.question: What is the maximum number of elements in the "Unsuccessful-PDSCHSetList-PSCH-ReconfFailureTDD" sequence?
question_64296.ground_truth: The "Unsuccessful-PDSCHSetList-PSCH-ReconfFailureTDD" sequence is a sequence of elements of type "Unsuccessful-PDSCHSetItem-PSCH-ReconfFailureTDD," and its maximum number of elements is equal to "maxNrOfPDSCHSets."

question_64298.question: What should the UE do with the Geolocation header field, if it has neither geographical location information available, nor a URI that points to the location information?
question_64298.ground_truth: The UE shall not insert a Geolocation header field in the UPDATE request if it has neither geographical location information available, nor a URI that points to the location information.

question_64300.question: Who is responsible for aggregating the collected data in the VPLMN?
question_64300.ground_truth: The V-NWDAF is responsible for aggregating the collected data from different NFs/DCCF in the VPLMN.

question_64301.question: What is the time limit set for an individual MSD transmission trial in the eCall modem selection tests?
question_64301.ground_truth: The time limit set for an individual MSD transmission trial in the eCall modem selection tests is 200 seconds.

question_64302.question: What frequency bands may be impacted by 3rd IMD products when Bands 20 and 38 are simultaneously active in BS supporting CA?
question_64302.ground_truth: 3rd IMD products may fall into the BS receive band of Bands 5-7, 13-14, 18-20, 26-27, 38, 41 and 44.

question_64303.question: How can measurement data be stored when requested to be stored locally in the NE?
question_64303.ground_truth: The storage capacity, duration, and method of deletion for locally stored measurement data in the NE are implementation-dependent.

question_64304.question: What is the role of the synchronization raster in NR frequency band identification?
question_64304.ground_truth: The synchronization raster determines the cell selection in NR frequency bands, with the UE searching for the strongest cell on each carrier frequency based on CD-SSBs located on the synchronization raster.

question_64305.question: What is the requirement for the ratio of successful reported values for the RSRQ FDD - FDD inter frequency absolute accuracy test to pass?
question_64305.ground_truth: The requirement for the ratio of successful reported values for the RSRQ FDD - FDD inter frequency absolute accuracy test to pass is more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_64306.question: What should the user equipment (UE) store as the default public user identity when it receives a 200 (OK) response to a REGISTER request?
question_64306.ground_truth: The UE should store the first URI on the list of URIs present in the P-Associated-URI header field as the default public user identity.

question_64310.question: How many non-consecutive DTX subframes are allowed by the SS when monitoring SCell1 during the subframes (m+5) to (m+13) in the inter-band PCell FDD case?
question_64310.ground_truth: The SS should allow for at most 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes when monitoring SCell1 during the subframes (m+5) to (m+13).

question_64311.question: What is the reference point PC3 used for in ProSe discovery using Presence Service architecture?
question_64311.ground_truth: The reference point PC3 is used from the UE/Application to the ProSe Watcher Proxy for publishing ProSe Information and receiving notifications when two UEs are in proximity.

question_64313.question: How long should the PSCell be released if the UE does not re-establish the connection in 1 second?
question_64313.ground_truth: The SS shall ensure the PSCell is released if the UE has not re-established the connection in at least 1 second.

question_64314.question: What is the purpose of the Transfer of Downlink User Data procedure in the X2 UP protocol?
question_64314.ground_truth: The Transfer of Downlink User Data procedure provides X2-U specific sequence number information at the transfer of user data carrying a DL PDCP PDU and helps the MeNB avoid PDCP HFN desynchronization for individual E-RABs.

question_64315.question: What is one potential issue with buffering the packet at the TDF-C?
question_64315.ground_truth: Buffering the packet at the TDF-C may cause a short duration during which the TDF-C has to buffer the packet.

question_64317.question: What does the "Mission Critical Video (MCVideo) User Equipment (UE) Protocol conformance specification" specify?
question_64317.ground_truth: The document specifies the requirements and test procedures for MCVideo UE's compliance with the MCVideo protocol, to ensure proper communication and interoperability between different UE's.

question_64318.question: What measures can be taken to protect the UICC from unauthorized removal in the M2ME?
question_64318.ground_truth: Appropriate implementation-dependent physical measures can be put in place to physically prevent unauthorized removal of the UICC, and logical protection can also be used to restrict the use of an UICC to a given M2ME and protect further data exchanged on the UICC-M2ME interface.

question_64319.question: What is the maximum validity duration that requires the UE to apply the system information acquisition procedure unless explicitly stated otherwise?
question_64319.ground_truth: Upon exceeding the maximum validity duration.

question_64323.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in relation to the Communication Waiting (CW) service?
question_64323.ground_truth: The 3GPP is a collaborative project that produces technical specifications for the CW service, which informs a user of limited resources available for an incoming communication.

question_64324.question: What are the criteria used for semi-static on/off schemes based on traffic load?
question_64324.ground_truth: For semi-static on/off based on traffic load, a turned-off small cell may be turned on if the traffic load in a neighborhood of the cell increases to a certain level, and a turned-on small cell may be turned off if the traffic load in a neighborhood of the cell decreases to a certain level.

question_64326.question: In the context of UM and AM RLC, when are padding "Length Indicators" added to an RLC PDU?
question_64326.ground_truth: Padding "Length Indicators" are added to an RLC PDU when one or more padding octets are present in the RLC PDU for a 7-bit "Length Indicator", and when two or more padding octets are present in the RLC PDU for a 15-bit "Length Indicator".

question_64327.question: When is the Network Daylight Saving Time IE sent by the network?
question_64327.ground_truth: When this IE is sent, the contents indicate the value used to adjust the local time zone.

question_64329.question: What is the suggested course of action for the BS transmitters supporting 3 DL CA of Band 3, Band 7, and Band 7 to avoid desensitization issues?
