question_65003.question: In the context of the test procedure, what is the expected outcome if the MS is required to inform the network of its DL coverage class?
question_65003.ground_truth: The MS should use the DL Coverage Class field in the EC Packet Channel Request message to indicate the selected downlink CC.

question_65004.question: What are Application Specific Credentials in the context of 3GPP TS 33.234?
question_65004.ground_truth: Application Specific Credentials are credentials such as keys, identifiers, and related data that are specific to authorized applications and need to be protected against malicious access.

question_65005.question: What is the Adjacent Channel Selectivity (ACS) in section 11.1.2.2.1?
question_65005.ground_truth: Adjacent Channel Selectivity (ACS) in section 11.1.2.2.1 is a measure of a receiver's ability to receive a wanted signal at its assigned channel frequency in the presence of adjacent channel signal at a given frequency offset from the center frequency of the assigned channel.

question_65006.question: What should TOuk be for TCI state switching involving other QCL types, other than QCL-TypeD, in L1-RSRP measurement?

question_65008.question: What is the objective of the FRMCS Positioning Accuracy use case 12.14?
question_65008.ground_truth: The objective of this use case is to specify the accuracy parameter values for positioning a train, track side worker, and other stationary and non-stationary objects inside the track system.

question_65009.question: Which data type is used for the "PrivateCallListEntry" element in the XML schema?

question_65010.question: What is the function of the Authentication/Authorization Function in the Edge Enabler Client authentication/authorization procedure?
question_65010.ground_truth: The Authentication/Authorization Function determines the appropriate authentication method for the Edge Enabler Client in the Edge Enabler Client authentication/authorization procedure.

question_65012.question: What is one solution to the issue of inefficient secondary serving cell change during multi-carrier operation in HetNets?
question_65012.ground_truth: One possible solution is enhancing the intra-frequency carrier handover procedure for multi-carrier operation. This can be achieved by optimizing the handover performance for specific use cases, such as working in DC-HSDPA operation and changing the best cell to the secondary carrier. This can be done by using inter-frequency measurement events in order to change the serving cell more efficiently.

question_65013.question: What is the purpose of enabling the notification mechanism so that subsequent framework events can be sent to the application in the Event Notification Sequence Diagrams?
question_65013.ground_truth: To inform the application of the availability of new SCFs of the requested type(s).

question_65014.question: What is the reference point used for an entity outside the 3GPP network to communicate with UEs used for MTC via SMS?
question_65014.ground_truth: The Tsms reference point is used for communication between an entity outside the 3GPP network and UEs used for MTC via SMS.

question_65015.question: What information is used by Ethernet switches to find the shortest path to a specific device in the network?
question_65015.ground_truth: Bridge Protocol Data Units (BPDUs) with information on available ports

question_65016.question: What are the possible cause values for the "Cause IE" in the "Update Bearer Response" message?
question_65016.ground_truth: The possible cause values for the "Cause IE" in the "Update Bearer Response" message include "Request accepted", "Request accepted partially", "Context not found", "Semantic error in the TFT operation", "Syntactic error in the TFT operation", "Semantic errors in packet filter(s)", "Syntactic errors in packet filter(s)", "Denied in RAT", "UE refuses", "Unable to page UE", "UE not responding", "Unable to page UE due to Suspension", "Temporarily rejected due to handover/TAU/RAU procedure in progress", "MME/SGSN refuses due to VPLMN Policy", and "UE is temporarily not reachable due to power saving."

question_65017.question: What does the UE (MCPTT Client) need to do in order to respond to MCPTT messages after accepting an On-demand Pre-arranged Group Call in Manual Commencement Mode?
question_65017.ground_truth: The UE (MCPTT Client) sends an SIP 200 (OK) and responds to MCPTT messages with an Acknowledgement.

question_65020.question: How should a UE behave if the Back-off timer value IE is not included, and the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST was sent together with an ATTACH REQUEST?
question_65020.ground_truth: The UE shall ignore the Re-attempt indicator IE provided by the network in PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT and proceed as specified in the PDN connectivity procedure clause. In this case, proceed as specified in clause~5.5.1.2.6, item~d.

question_65023.question: What is the purpose of TS 24.229 clause 5.2.7.2 and 5.2.7.3?
question_65023.ground_truth: The purpose is to enable the P-CSCF to require the periodic refreshment of the session to avoid hung states in the P-CSCF. The functionality requires support from at least one of the UEs.

question_65024.question: What is the length of interruption allowed on PCell due to DL BWP switching in SCell1 and SCell2, and how is it calculated?
question_65024.ground_truth: The length of interruption on PCell due to DL BWP switching of SCell1 and SCell2 shall fulfill requirements in clause 7.5.6.3.0.1.3, and it is calculated by counting the slots from the time when the BWP switch commands are received or bwp-InactivityTimer timers expire until ACK/NACKs are sent in SCell1 and SCell2.

question_65029.question: What information is signalled from the MME/SGSN to the H(e)NB during the E-RAB/RAB establishment process in the collocated L-GW case?
question_65029.ground_truth: A Correlation ID, which is the TEID or the GRE keys of the L-GW for the user plane.

question_65031.question: What is the name of the procedure code for the cUDUTAInformationTransfer procedure?

question_65034.question: Who checks whether the provided functional alias is allowed to be used and has been activated for the user in the MCData server?

question_65035.question: In which document and clause is the behavior of the UE when initiating an access attempt specified?
question_65035.ground_truth: The behavior is specified in TS 24.501, clause 4.5.2.

question_65037.question: What should the MnS producer responsible for AI/ML inference management have a capability to allow an authorized MnS consumer to do regarding an ML entity?
question_65037.ground_truth: Activate or deactivate an ML entity.

question_65038.question: What are the reference points used by the SEAL Data Delivery system in the 3GPP system?
question_65038.ground_truth: The SEAL Data Delivery system uses the SEALDD-UU, SEALDD-C, SEALDD-S, SEALDD-E, N6, NEF (N33) reference points in the 3GPP system for communication between the SEAL Data Delivery server, SEAL Data Delivery client, and other 3GPP network functions.

question_65039.question: What is the state 'U: has permission' in the context of MCPTT?
question_65039.ground_truth: In the 'U: has permission' state, the floor participant is permitted to send RTP media and can receive floor control messages. The floor participant can release permission to send RTP media at any time, even before sending any media.

question_65042.question: For each successfully established DRB, what information should the gNB-CU-UP provide in the respective UL UP Parameters IE of the BEARER CONTEXT MODIFICATION RESPONSE?
question_65042.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP shall provide one UL UP Transport Layer Information Item per cell group entry contained in the respective Cell Group Information IE of the BEARER CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message.

question_65045.question: What should be the value of the length parameter in 6.2.9.8.1.1 if only a few characters of the menu entry should be displayed?
question_65045.ground_truth: The length parameter should be set to the number of characters desired for the menu entry.

question_65046.question: What happens if a call is forwarded on no reply and the subaddress is not passed by the HLR to the VLR?
question_65046.ground_truth: Calls will be forwarded without the subaddress.

question_65047.question: What is the objective of the predictive slice modification solution?
question_65047.ground_truth: The predictive slice modification solution aims to allow the NSCE server deployed inside the EDN to interact with the NSCE server outside the EDN to optimize the network slice for vertical applications based on AF policy. The NSCE server may interact with 5GS and OAM system to monitor the network slice and trigger network slice modification proactively.

question_65049.question: What TS (Technical Specification) standard defines the DNS AF's involvement in the DNS communication of UEs authorized for edge services?

question_65052.question: What should be the direction of the OTA AAS BS for the OTA test procedure?
question_65052.ground_truth: The direction of the OTA AAS BS should be set in the declared direction to be tested for the OTA test procedure.

question_65053.question: What is the purpose of a HNB being able to detect macro neighboring cells?
question_65053.ground_truth: The purpose is to support handover from HNB to macro network and add macro neighboring cells to their neighbor cell list automatically.

question_65054.question: What are the functions of the XDM Client in the Presence Data Model?
question_65054.ground_truth: The XDM Client has to support the XDM Client procedures and the XCAP application usages.

question_65057.question: What is the primary requirement for the Direct Communication procedure in ProSe?
question_65057.ground_truth: Direct Communication in ProSe requires that the UE is an authorized ProSe-enabled Public Safety UE and has the necessary group context, including the ProSe Layer-2 Group ID and ProSe Group IP multicast address.

question_65061.question: What is the test purpose for the SET UP MENU and ENVELOPE MENU SELECTION?
question_65061.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify the integration of menu items in UCS2 coding contained in the SET UP MENU proactive UICC command and the returns a successful response in the TERMINAL RESPONSE command sent to the UICC. The testing also ensures the proper passing of the identifier of the selected menu item to the UICC using the ENVELOPE (MENU SELECTION) command, and the proper replacement and removal of the toolkit menu.

question_65064.question: What is the recommended option to avoid SRVCC false trigger for WebRTC traffic?
question_65064.ground_truth: The recommended option is not to use QCI I for WebRTC traffic.

question_65066.question: How does the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay identify the remote UE for emergency service?
question_65066.ground_truth: In the Remote UE Report for the emergency service, the Remote User ID (i.e. (UP-/CP-) PRUK ID) or the PEI is used as the UE ID, depending on the successful authentication of the remote UE and USIM availability.

question_65067.question: What type of data connection requests are prohibited in a congested stadium area for Unattended Data Traffic based on user category?
question_65067.ground_truth: Requests for data connection establishments/reactivations for Unattended Data Traffic are not serviced by default in the stadium area, based on user category.

question_65068.question: What information about the failed request is passed as a parameter to the creditAmountErr() method?
question_65068.ground_truth: The session ID, request number, error code, and the request number for the next request are passed as parameters to the creditAmountErr() method.

question_65070.question: What message does the MS send after receiving the requested location estimate or assistance data from the network?
question_65070.ground_truth: The MS sends a RELEASE COMPLETE message to the network to clear the dialogue.

question_65071.question: What should the MME do if the Location Timer expires before receiving a location response from the E-SMLC while in the LOCATION state?
question_65071.ground_truth: The MME should indicate a location failure to the original requesting entity and re-enter IDLE state.

question_65072.question: In which clause is the requirement specified for UE with 1-layer UL MIMO transmission for MPR?
question_65072.ground_truth: The same MPR requirements are applicable to UE with 1-layer UL MIMO transmission as with 2-layer UL MIMO transmission, as specified in clause 6.2D.2.

question_65073.question: What information is stored in the UDR by the (H-)PCF when the "EpsUrsp" feature is supported and URSP provisioning in EPS is done?
question_65073.ground_truth: When the "EpsUrsp" feature is supported and URSP provisioning in EPS is done, the (H-)PCF stores in the UDR, UPSCs and related URSP sections of the own PLMN it provided to a UE, the PEI received from the NF service consumer, the OSId(s) received from the UE within the "UE STATE INDICATION" message, the indication of UE's support for URSP provisioning in EPS included in the "UE STATE INDICATION" message, and the indication of UE's support for reporting URSP rule enforcement included in the "UE STATE INDICATION" message.

question_65074.question: What is the difference between IFOM and IARP rules?
question_65074.ground_truth: IFOM rules determine which access network should be used for an IP traffic flow, while IARP rules determine which traffic should be routed across different PDN connections and which traffic should be non-seamlessly offloaded to WLAN.

question_65076.question: What is the purpose of the Authorise Routing Rule Request message in the IP-CAN Session Modification procedure?
question_65076.ground_truth: The Authorise Routing Rule Request message in the IP-CAN Session Modification procedure is used by the P-GW to send new routing rules to the UE.

question_65077.question: What type of scenario is expected to be addressed by the LA BS (Low Altitude Base Station) class?
question_65077.ground_truth: Indoor hotspot scenarios, which have relatively small coverage, high capacity, and high user throughput driven by high-density low-mobility users, are expected to be addressed by the LA BS class.

question_65078.question: What should the UE do if an entry with the matching physCellId exists in the ssb-PositionQCL-CellsToAddModList?
question_65078.ground_truth: The UE should replace the entry with the value received for this physCellId.

question_65079.question: What must the MCVideo client include in the SIP re-INVITE request when upgrading an ongoing MCVideo private call to an emergency private call?
question_65079.ground_truth: The MCVideo client must include an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body, a Resource-Priority header field, and an SDP offer with the media parameters as currently established.

question_65080.question: Which protocol stack can be used to implement speech recognition capabilities in IMS?
question_65080.ground_truth: IMS provides a protocol stack, including SIP/SDP, RTP, and QoS, that can be used to implement speech recognition capabilities.

question_65081.question: What is the requirement for the reporting range of RSRP in the described scenario?
question_65081.ground_truth: The reporting range of RSRP is defined from -140 dBm to -44 dBm with 1 dB resolution.

question_65083.question: What information does the MC service server provide for the broadcast MBS session?
question_65083.ground_truth: The MC service server provides service description information associated with the broadcast MBS session, including TMGI, SDP information, and announcement acknowledgment.

question_65085.question: What is the role of the SL Positioning Server in this solution?
question_65085.ground_truth: In this solution, SL Positioning Server functionalities can be provided by UE1, UE2, and/or a SL Positioning Server UE. This means that no LMF involvement is needed, and UE-only Operation can be applied.

question_65087.question: What is the MC service server requirement to support 5G MBS related functionalities and reference points for signalling and media in transport only mode?
question_65087.ground_truth: The MC service server must support corresponding reference points applicable for signalling and media in transport only mode to provide 5G MBS related functionalities.

question_65088.question: What is the measurement reporting delay exclusion in the measurement reporting delay definition?
question_65088.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay excludes a delay uncertainty resulted when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH, and a delay which caused by no UL resources for UE to send the measurement report.

question_65089.question: What type of GSM physical channel handles uplink packet random access for MBMS?

question_65090.question: What is the key concept behind passing through compressed media formats for XR runtimes?
question_65090.ground_truth: The key concept is to pass through the media format from the 5G network over the tethering link using the OpenXR or the general runtime API, allowing the addition of local data and the inclusion of the security framework or protocol.

question_65091.question: What are the requirements for authorizing a UE to relay traffic as a relay UE in the 5G system?
question_65091.ground_truth: The 5G system shall authorize a UE to relay traffic as a relay UE, allowing relaying only for remote UEs belonging to the same network operator or the same application layer group.

question_65092.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement related to cell identification for the UE?
question_65092.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement is that the UE shall be able to identify new intra-frequency cells and perform RSRP measurements of identified intra-frequency cells without an explicit intra-frequency neighbour cell list containing physical layer cell identities. During the RRC_CONNECTED state, the UE shall continuously measure identified intra frequency cells and additionally search for and identify new intra frequency cells.

question_65094.question: What is an Internal-Group Identifier in 3GPP TS 23.501 and how is it composed?
question_65094.ground_truth: An Internal-Group Identifier is a network internal globally unique ID that identifies a set of SUPIs from a given network grouped together for a specific group-related service. It is composed in the same way as an IMSI-Group Identifier, with the same ranges (0-8,388,607 for UE-dedicated PRA and 8,388,608 to 16,777,215 for Core Network predefined PRA).

question_65095.question: What is the exception in message contents in HD-FDD Radio Link Monitoring Test for Out-of-sync without DRX for UE Category NB1 in Enhanced Coverage compared to the Standalone condition specified in 3GPP TS 36.508?
question_65095.ground_truth: The exception is the use of the "Guardband" condition in message contents instead of the Standalone condition.

question_65096.question: What is the primary function of the 5G system in supporting cyber-physical control applications in vertical domains?
question_65096.ground_truth: The 5G system provides ultra-reliable and dependable communication with high communication service availability and low or very low end-to-end latency.

question_65097.question: When can the MCPTT user at MCPTT client 1 be notified about the incoming call (step 12)?
question_65097.ground_truth: The MCPTT user at MCPTT client 1 is notified after the MCPTT call transfer response is received by MCPTT client 1, and before releasing the private call with MCPTT client 2.

question_65098.question: In what type of deployment scenarios can the MC service user database be combined with an HSS?
question_65098.ground_truth: The MC service user database can be combined with an HSS in deployment scenarios when the MC service provider and the PLMN operator are part of the same trust domain.

question_65099.question: What technique can be used for dual-carrier in BTS equalizer when additional Adjacent Channel Rejection (ACR) is required?
question_65099.ground_truth: The synchronous nature (time and frequency offset) of dual-carrier transmission can be exploited in the BTS equalizer by using dual-carrier joint detection.

question_65101.question: What is the lowest bitrate that UE-B could achieve when encapsulating 8 non-redundant frames in the packets in the B->A direction in Use case B?
question_65101.ground_truth: The lowest bitrate that UE-B could achieve is 14 kbps.

question_65102.question: What types of small data transmission are supported by the Lightweight CN architecture for CIoT?
question_65102.ground_truth: The Lightweight CN architecture supports infrequent small data transmission, including IP and non-IP data, and SMS.

question_65105.question: What is the impact of DL-only LAA based category 1 on the non-replaced Wi-Fi network in terms of performance metrics?
question_65105.ground_truth: DL-only LAA based category 1 showed degradation in 22 out of 24 performance metrics for the non-replaced Wi-Fi network.

question_65106.question: What is the purpose of establishing a secure channel between a UICC and a terminal?
question_65106.ground_truth: The purpose is to protect the communication between the UICC and the terminal when sensitive applications are split between the two and data is exchanged between them.

question_65107.question: What is the message functional definition and content for RAB ASSIGNMENT REQUEST?
question_65107.ground_truth: This message is sent by the CN to request the establishment, modification or release of one or more RABs for the same UE. The message is sent in connection oriented mode.

question_65109.question: What is the procedure for the Discovery phase in this solution alternative?
question_65109.ground_truth: The UE can exchange information about the other UE's connection ID on WLAN Direct, such as MAC addresses.

question_65110.question: What are the three functions of the Layer 1 transmitter that the BSS needs to verify in this test?
question_65110.ground_truth: The three functions of the Layer 1 transmitter that the BSS needs to verify in this test are the RF equipment, the multiplexing and multiple access functions, and the interleaving and the channel encoding on the transmit side.

question_65111.question: What is the flow that the CM client in the UE follows to obtain the user profile (UE initiated) for additional services?
question_65111.ground_truth: The flow that the CM client in the UE follows to obtain the user profile (UE initiated) for additional services is the "MCX user obtains the user profile (UE initiated)" flow from clause 10.1.4.3 of 3GPP TS 23.280, where it presents an access token in the Get MCX user profile request over HTTP.

question_65112.question: What technology is the state planning to use for the sensors' communication system?
question_65112.ground_truth: The state is planning to use a wireless network for the sensors' communication system.

question_65113.question: What is the main advantage of using an activation signal before the test signal?
question_65113.ground_truth: The main advantage of using an activation signal before the test signal is to ensure that the UE is in a typical state during measurement, allowing for accurate results.

question_65116.question: What is the definition of the term "UAS" in the present document?
question_65116.ground_truth: The term "UAS" in the present document stands for Uncrewed Aerial System.

question_65117.question: What is the purpose of XID frames when the P/F-bit is set to "1"?
question_65117.ground_truth: XID frames with the P/F-bit set to "1" are used for negotiating parameters of RLP and layer 2 Relay function. They can be sent in both ADM and ABM.

question_65118.question: What is the requirement for testing the SEND DTMF proactive UICC command with UCS2 Display in Katakana?
question_65118.ground_truth: The requirement for testing the SEND DTMF proactive UICC command with UCS2 Display in Katakana is that the ME shall support the Proactive UICC: Send DTMF facility as defined in specific clauses of TS 31.111. Additionally, the ME shall support the UCS2 facility for the coding of the Katakana characters, as defined in ISO/IEC 10646. The testing should verify that the ME sends the DTMF string contained in the SEND DTMF proactive UICC command to the network, and returns a successful response in the TERMINAL RESPONSE command sent to the UICC. The testing should also verify that the ME does not locally generate audible DTMF tones and play them to the user. If the ME is in idle mode, it should inform the UICC using

question_65120.question: What should the UE do upon receiving an EAP-failure message during the EAP based primary authentication and key agreement procedure?
question_65120.ground_truth: The UE should delete the partial native 5G NAS security context, if any, and consider the procedure complete. If the EAP-failure message is received in an AUTHENTICATION REJECT message, the UE should set the update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, delete the stored 5G-GUTI, TAI list, last visited registered TAI and ngKSI, and set the USIM as invalid until switching off the UE or removing the UICC containing the USIM.

question_65121.question: What is one approach to time synchronization between the UE and the PWS message signer?
question_65121.ground_truth: One approach to time synchronization is through the use of a PWS timer provisioned in UEs at manufacture with a conservative time, which can then be adjusted by a PWS timestamp update message similar in concept to the PWS CA update message.

question_65124.question: What is an example of a service for which the NAS needs to be informed when it starts and stops?
question_65124.ground_truth: Emergency service, MMTEL voice, MMTEL video, SMSoIP, SMS over NAS, 5GC-MO-LR procedure, UE-requested policy provisioning procedure for V2XP, ProSeP or both, and CIoT user data transfer over the control plane.

question_65125.question: What is the definition of an alarm in the context of the 3GPP TS 37.46x series of Technical Specifications?
question_65125.ground_truth: An alarm is a persistent indication of a fault.

question_65127.question: What is the service area ID or cell ID used for in the context of the VLR and SGSN association?
question_65127.ground_truth: The service area ID or cell ID is used to identify the location of the mobile station (MS) in the network, specifically the cell in which the MS last established radio contact.

question_65128.question: What is the role of the network slice capability enablement server in API invocation requests within a network slice?
question_65128.ground_truth: The network slice capability enablement server is responsible for sending service API invocation requests to the producers of the service APIs within the slice API and authenticating and authorizing the API invoker.

question_65130.question: What is the purpose of Key Quality Indicator (KQI) in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
question_65130.ground_truth: KQI is used as the primary input for management of internal or supplier/partner SLAs that calculate actual service delivery quality against design targets or in the case of supplier/partner contractual agreements.

question_65131.question: Which data type is used to store the list of MBS-Multicast-MRB-Items in the MulticastCU2DURRCInfo structure?

question_65133.question: What are the minimum conformance requirements for transmit modulation quality for E-UTRA single carrier and CA operation in the NR carrier?
question_65133.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements for transmit modulation quality for E-UTRA single carrier, CA operation and UL-MIMO specified in TS 36.101 clauses 6.5.2, 6.5.2A, and 6.5.2B apply.

question_65134.question: What are some critical factors when designing GCSE security for public safety users?
question_65134.ground_truth: GCSE security for public safety users must allow e2e (UE to UE) and e2ae (UE to GCS AS) security in LTE to ensure the safety of personal and national security communication. These security measures should protect data from being compromised or intercepted by unauthorized users.

question_65136.question: What information does the AMF provide to the UE in the PDU session Establishment Response, in terms of network slice timing information?
question_65136.ground_truth: The AMF provides the combined timing information for the S-NSSAIs of the PDU session to the UE in the PDU session Establishment Response, indicating whether the network slices have an end of life or are periodic.

question_65137.question: What is required for global roaming cases to receive appropriate Public Safety QoS in this solution?
question_65137.ground_truth: ORK operators are required for global roaming cases to receive appropriate Public Safety QoS in this solution.

question_65139.question: How many carrier frequency layers should the UE be capable of monitoring for idle mode cell re-selection purposes?
question_65139.ground_truth: The UE should be capable of monitoring at least 8 carrier frequency layers, including the serving layer, for idle mode cell re-selection purposes.

question_65140.question: What is the main focus of the general part in the document?
question_65140.ground_truth: The general part covers BS and UE specific aspects of 5DL Inter-band Carrier Aggregation, providing band combination-independent information and requirements.

question_65142.question: What is the primary purpose of BMCA function in the U-plane of 3GPP networks?
question_65142.ground_truth: The primary purpose of the BMCA function in the U-plane is to avoid message loops for time synchronization and determine the port state of the gPTP instance. It runs the BMCA algorithm to select the best master clock and generate Announce messages accordingly, assisting in establishing time synchronization among network devices.

question_65144.question: What is the impact of frequent P-CSCF re-discoveries on multimedia session continuity?
question_65144.ground_truth: Frequent P-CSCF re-discoveries can introduce a considerable additional delay to the session transfer procedure and may negatively impact session continuity, especially when DHCP is used.

question_65145.question: What should the MAG do during the PMIPv6 PDN Connection Handover procedure for generating a downlink GRE key?
question_65145.ground_truth: The MAG should generate a downlink GRE key that is not already in use locally for the PDN connection's downlink traffic to that UE, as specified in the GRE Key Option for PMIPv6 specification.

question_65146.question: What must the eNodeB include in the RAN usage data Report message to the MME if the MME supports RACS and the eNodeB has Secondary RAT usage data to report?
question_65146.ground_truth: The eNodeB must include the Secondary RAT usage data and a handover flag indicating that the report should be buffered before forwarding the Secondary RAT usage charging data to the MME.

question_65148.question: What action is taken when the network responds to the MS with a lower QoS than that requested?
question_65148.ground_truth: The MS shall either accept the negotiated QoS or initiate the PDP context deactivation procedure.

question_65149.question: What is the "SIB3 value tag wrap-around issue" identified in the 3GPP study?
question_65149.ground_truth: The "SIB3 value tag wrap-around issue" refers to the frequent updating of SIB3 for access control purposes, which might cause the value tag to wrap-around frequently, potentially leading to a UE having out of date barring information.

question_65151.question: What is the significance of the MPTY bridge in the Multi Party service?
question_65151.ground_truth: The MPTY bridge in the Multi Party service is responsible for connecting multiple parties in a call and allowing them to communicate with each other.

question_65152.question: What is the purpose of the TP-UDL bit in the SMPP protocol?
question_65152.ground_truth: The TP-UDL bit indicates whether the TP-UDL field or the TP-UD field is present in the TP-User-Data field. A receiving entity shall assume a value of 0x00 for the TP-DCS field if the TP-UDL bit is set to zero.

question_65154.question: What type of priority is given to the Railway Emergency Alert in the FRMCS System?
question_65154.ground_truth: The priority of the Railway Emergency Alert matches the application category of CRITICAL DATA within the FRMCS System.

question_65156.question: What action should the MCVideo client take if the user is not authorized to cancel the in-progress emergency group state of the MCVideo group?
question_65156.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should indicate to the user that they are not authorized to cancel the in-progress emergency group state of the MCVideo group and skip the remaining steps of the current clause.

question_65159.question: What does the "SSIM application" refer to in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_65159.ground_truth: The "SSIM application" is a UICC application that provides mechanisms for Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization (NSSAA) in 3GPP telecom networks.

question_65160.question: What is the purpose of the Authentication-Info AVP in the 3GPP 29.061-800 specification?
question_65160.ground_truth: The Authentication-Info AVP is of type Grouped, and it contains the authentication vectors required for authenticating a user.

question_65162.question: What is the role of the AS-OLCM in the functional model of the AS?
question_65162.ground_truth: The AS-OLCM stores transaction state and may optionally store session state depending on the specific service being executed. It also interfaces to the S-CSCF (OLCM) for an outgoing leg.

question_65163.question: In which band is the UE required to measure one of the CSI-IM for L1-SINR measurement and SSB when beam failure is detected in FR2?

question_65166.question: What is the function of a Session-AMBR in a PDU session?
question_65166.ground_truth: A Session-AMBR limits the aggregate bit rate that can be expected to be provided across all Non-GBR QoS flows for a specific PDU session for both Uplink and Downlink traffic.

question_65167.question: What procedure does the SMF follow when it receives a notification from the NG-RAN that the GFBR can be guaranteed for the QoS Flow?
question_65167.ground_truth: The SMF requests the NG-RAN to establish the QoS Flow and add it to the PDU session by triggering a PDU Session Modification procedure.

question_65168.question: What is the difference between the terms "version" and "release" when describing the document's changes?
question_65168.ground_truth: "Version" refers to a document presented to the TSG for information, approval, or under change control, while "release" refers to a new version of the document with a change of release date and an increased version number.

question_65169.question: What does the SMF+PGW-C do if the Handover Indication is present in the Create Session Request and the SMF+PGW-C detects it corresponds to a PDU Session for a LADN in 5GC?

question_65172.question: What should a UE do before sending a SIP request related to an emergency call, if emergency registration is needed?
question_65172.ground_truth: The UE should perform an emergency registration prior to sending the SIP request related to the emergency call.

question_65173.question: Which IMD generated by dual uplink of Band 1 and Band n257 may fall into the own Rx of Band 3?

question_65174.question: What is the subject of TS 37.483 in relation to the 3GPP?
question_65174.ground_truth: TS 37.483 is a technical specification produced by the 3GPP for the radio access network (NG-RAN) and the E1 Application Protocol (E1AP), as detailed in Release 17.

question_65176.question: What new capabilities does the UE need to support in order to initiate Mobility Registration Update signalling only when moving out of the predicted sequence of Registration Areas?
question_65176.ground_truth: UE needs to support decoding of more than one Registration Area in Registration Accept message and omitting Mobility Registration Update when cell re-selection or validity period moves the UE from the current Registration Area to the next one in the ordered Registration Area List.

question_65177.question: What message does the source MME send to the target SGSN to request the CN to establish resources in the target RNC, target SGSN and the Serving GW during an IRAT handover to UTRAN Iu mode?

question_65178.question: What is the procedure for establishing a forwarding tunnel between old I-UPF and new I-UPF in the 3GPP network?
question_65178.ground_truth: If the service request is triggered by the network and a new I-UPF is selected, a forwarding tunnel may need to be established between the old I-UPF and the new I-UPF to forward buffered data.

question_65179.question: What is the purpose of the synthesis filter (denominator) part of the formant postfilter in speech processing?
question_65179.ground_truth: The synthesis filter (denominator) part of the formant postfilter is used for estimating the original speech signal in speech processing applications.

question_65182.question: What are the two classifications of latency from the FRMCS System point of view?
question_65182.ground_truth: From the FRMCS System point of view, the two classifications of latency are Low (user data delay harms the functioning of the application) and Normal (user data delay does not harm the sequence and progress of the application).

question_65183.question: Which discovery procedures will be determined by SA~WG3 for network-controlled authentication and authorization of a Remote UE using a Relay UE's serving network resources?
question_65183.ground_truth: The network-controlled authentication and authorization procedures for a Remote UE to use the network resources (e.g. PDU Session and Network Slice) of the Relay UE's serving network.

question_65186.question: What information is included in an eNB UE context when an active state for a UE is completed or after handover resource allocation during handover preparation?
question_65186.ground_truth: At least UE state information, security information, UE capability information and the identities of the UE-associated logical S1-connection.

question_65188.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG RAN) in the context of LTE-Advanced intra-band non-contiguous Carrier Aggregation (CA) in Band 2?
question_65188.ground_truth: The 3GPP TSG RAN is responsible for producing technical specifications for LTE-Advanced, including intra-band non-contiguous CA in Band 2.

question_65189.question: What are the end points for non-tethered or embedded connections in the context of 5G NR UE Application Layer Data Throughput measurement?
question_65189.ground_truth: The end points for non-tethered or embedded connections are the application running on the UE and a corresponding Data Server that is adjacent to the simulated lab-based Core Network.

question_65191.question: What is a MAC PDU in the context of DRX operation?
question_65191.ground_truth: A MAC PDU is a MAC protocol data unit, which consists of a set of RLC data blocks and control elements. It is used in MAC entity's C-RNTI, CS-RNTI, INT-RNTI, SFI-RNTI, SP-CSI-RNTI, TPC-PUCCH-RNTI, TPC-PUSCH-RNTI, and TPC-SRS-RNTI.

question_65192.question: What is the conducted OBUE limit for the OTA requirement in the 5.6.5.2 section?
question_65192.ground_truth: The conducted OBUE limit for the OTA requirement is the AAS limit as defined in the TS 37.105 specification.

question_65193.question: Which test methodology provided higher resolution power in the subjective testing of 360-degree videos using HMD?
question_65193.ground_truth: DSIS provided higher resolution power as compared to the other two test methodologies.

question_65194.question: What is one of the potential security requirements for enabling services for UEs connecting to the PARLOS portal?
question_65194.ground_truth: At a minimum, it shall be possible for the network and the UE to establish end-to-end security at the application layer while providing PARLOS services.

question_65195.question: What should the BSS do if it is unable to buffer the paging request until the next occurrence of the nominal paging group for the indicated MS during the paging procedure?
question_65195.ground_truth: The BSS shall respond to the PAGING-PS PDU by sending a PAGING-PS-REJECT PDU to the SGSN and includes information indicating the time until the next paging occasion therein.

question_65196.question: When is it possible to delete an existing QoS rule associated with a QoS flow description within an EPS bearer context, where there is no existing QoS rule with the same QoS rule identifier associated with a QoS flow description stored for the EPS bearer context being modified?
question_65196.ground_truth: This is possible when deleting an existing QoS rule that is not associated with a QoS flow description in the current EPS bearer context.

question_65197.question: What transport protocol is mandatory for carrying SAND messages?
question_65197.ground_truth: If SAND is supported, HTTP must be supported as the minimum transport protocol for carrying SAND messages.

question_65199.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function do if timer TNG1 (acknowledged call setup timer) is not running, the local counter of the number of SIP 200 (OK) responses received from invited members is equal to the value of the on-network-minimum-number-to-start element of the group document, and a final SIP 4xx, 5xx or 6xx response is received from an invited MCVideo client?
question_65199.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should send the SIP final response towards the inviting MCVideo client if a SIP final response was received from all the other invited MCVideo clients and the SIP 200 (OK) response is not yet sent, or remove the invited MCVideo client from the MCVideo Session if a SIP final response other than 2xx or 3xx was received from all the invited MCVideo clients and the SIP 200 (OK) response is already sent.

question_65201.question: What is the unit of the intra-cluster delay spread and the corresponding intra-cluster angular spreads in 7.6.2.2?
question_65201.ground_truth: The intra-cluster delay spread is given in seconds (s), and the corresponding intra-cluster angular spreads are given in degrees.

question_65202.question: What is the requirement for the MS when the MS on a CAG cell is not switched on or returned to coverage, and a CAG cell with a PLMN ID becomes available?
question_65202.ground_truth: If the MS is in Automatic network selection mode and is not switched on or returned to coverage, and a CAG cell with a PLMN ID becomes available, then the MS shall not select the CAG cell if its CAG-ID is not present in the "Allowed CAG list" associated with that PLMN in the "CAG information list".

question_65204.question: What are the factors that can affect the UE Application Layer Data Throughput performance for tethered connections?
question_65204.ground_truth: The PC drivers, typically USB, can affect the UE Application Layer Data Throughput performance for tethered connections.

question_65206.question: In the procedure of inter-MN RRC Resume without MN initiated SN change, what is the role of SN UE XnAP ID in step 3?
question_65206.ground_truth: SN UE XnAP ID is used as a reference to the UE context in the SN that was established by the source MN during the Xn Retrieve UE Context procedure.

question_65207.question: What is the final outcome of the network optimization process?
question_65207.ground_truth: The result is a call between the UE and the PSTN solely via IMS.

question_65208.question: What is the consequence of the "IP Multicast Accept" action value when detecting the IGMPv3 Leave message or MLD Done message via the PDU Session?
question_65208.ground_truth: When the "IP Multicast Accept" action value detects the IGMPv3 Leave message or MLD Done message via the PDU Session, it indicates that the UPF needs to remove the PDU Session from the requested multicast group distribution.

question_65209.question: What is the role of the Online Charging System (OCS) in the 3GPP system?
question_65209.ground_truth: The Online Charging System (OCS) is responsible for handling online charging in the 3GPP system, including real-time processing of charging data and managing the charging of users.

question_65210.question: What does the term "LTE" stand for in section 9's header?
question_65210.ground_truth: LTE stands for Long-Term Evolution, a wireless communication standard used in mobile networks.

question_65211.question: What is the version of the schema used in the first instantiation example?
question_65211.ground_truth: The schema version used in the first instantiation example is 3.

question_65212.question: What should the UE do when timer T3512 expires?
question_65212.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update and indicate "periodic registration updating" in the 5GS registration type IE.

question_65213.question: What is the format of the test signals provided for use in testing compliance to the minimum performance requirements?
question_65213.ground_truth: All signals are raw data, linear 16-bit signed PCM coded audio data at a sampling rate of 8000 Hz, coded in Big-Endian format.

question_65214.question: What should be performed before the VLR/SGSN determines which UIAs and UEAs are allowed to be used for integrity and ciphering?
question_65214.ground_truth: The MS sends the Initial L3 message, which contains the user identity and the KSI (Key Set Identifier), to the VLR/SGSN. Additionally, user identity request and authentication of the user, and generation of new security keys may be performed.

question_65215.question: What is the purpose of the T1, T2, and T3 parameters in the Node Synchronisation procedure?
question_65215.ground_truth: T1 is the RNC specific frame number (RFN) that indicates the time when the RNC sends a frame to the transport layer, T2 is the Node B specific frame number (BFN) indicating the time when Node B receives the corresponding DL NODE SYNCHRONISATION control frame, and T3 is the BFN indicating the time when Node B sends a frame to the transport layer.

question_65216.question: What should the mobile station do if the failure is due to any other reason, other than those specified earlier?
question_65216.ground_truth: The mobile station should return to MAC-Idle state, notify higher layer (TBF establishment failure), transactions in progress shall be aborted and cell reselection continues.

question_65217.question: What is the purpose of bulked data in NWDAF as an alternative to providing individual events?
question_65217.ground_truth: Bulked data in NWDAF can be used for analytics inference or ML model training by providing a set of data samples from collected event notifications in the form of bulked data for an Analytics ID.

question_65218.question: What is the rationale behind binding a context to a key in SAE key establishment?
question_65218.ground_truth: The rationale behind binding a context to a key in SAE key establishment is to prevent the compromise of the key from being exploited in a key establishment procedure in a different context. This helps to ensure the security of the system in a multi-access and multi-stakeholder environment.

question_65220.question: What should the UE do with the authorized QoS rules and the session-AMBR if the number of these authorized QoS rules, packet filters, or QoS flow descriptions associated with the PDU session have reached the maximum number supported by the UE?
question_65220.ground_truth: The UE may initiate the PDU session release procedure by sending a PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message with 5GSM cause #26 "insufficient resources".

question_65221.question: What should be the PLMN parameter Information Transfer Capability when an LLC element is not present?

question_65223.question: What is the role of the IDLE mode SIGnaling Reduction (ISR) function in GERAN and E-UTRAN networks?
question_65223.ground_truth: The IDLE mode Signaling Reduction function provides a mechanism to limit signalling during cell-reselection in idle mode between GERAN and E-UTRAN networks.

question_65224.question: What is the purpose of an eRG in the 5G system?
question_65224.ground_truth: An eRG (enhanced Radio Gateway) enables user access to 5G services and supports multicast/broadcast services within a CPN. It can communicate with the 5G network or operate independently if network connectivity is lost.

question_65225.question: What action does the IBCF take regarding ECN in relation to multimedia priority service?
question_65225.ground_truth: Subject to local policy, the IBCF prohibits the negotiation of ECN (Explicit Congestion Notification) during SDP offer/answer exchanges associated with multimedia priority service, to ensure efficient resource usage.

question_65226.question: What is the definition of an AVP and an IE in the 3GPP charging system?
question_65226.ground_truth: AVP stands for Attribute Value Pair, which is used to transfer charging information. An IE, or Information Element, is a set of AVPs transported together within a message.

question_65227.question: Who is responsible for determining the timing advance (TA) at handover access and random access?
question_65227.ground_truth: TRX determines the TA at handover access and random access.

question_65228.question: What is the structure of the PDUSessionResourceFailedToSetupListSURes data type, which is a sequence of PDUSessionResourceFailedToSetupItemSURes?
question_65228.ground_truth: Each instance of PDUSessionResourceFailedToSetupItemSURes contains a PDUSessionID, a PDUSessionResourceSetupUnsuccessfulTransfer, and an optional ProtocolExtensionContainer.

question_65229.question: How is the downlink timing defined for the reference cell?
question_65229.ground_truth: The downlink timing is defined as the time when the first detected path (in time) of the corresponding downlink frame is received from the reference cell.

question_65230.question: What is the architectural requirement for the functional alias format in MC service communications?
question_65230.ground_truth: The functional alias provides a complementary, role-based user identification scheme, taking a form of a URI with the host part identifying the home MC system functional alias controlling server. It requires an unique association with the corresponding MC service ID.

question_65231.question: What is the requirement for the UE's behavior upon emergency registration expiration, as defined in 3GPP TS 24.229?
question_65231.ground_truth: The UE shall not perform user-initiated emergency reregistration in the absence of emergency-related dialog, standalone transactions, and emergency call initiation. Once the UE registers a public user identity and an associated contact address via emergency registration, the UE shall not perform user-initiated deregistration of the respective public user identity and the associated contact address.

question_65232.question: Which procedure is used to report to the MRFC the result of an ASR request, where the MRFP has recognized and matched the detected speech to the specified grammar file?

question_65233.question: What is the responsibility of the PDN GW in handling access technology with dynamic policy provisioning deployed?
question_65233.ground_truth: The PDN GW relies on the PCRF for indication of the handling required due to the access technology when dynamic policy provisioning is deployed.

question_65235.question: What must the MCPTT client do when it receives a Map Group To Bearer message over the general purpose MBMS subchannel?
question_65235.ground_truth: The MCPTT client must associate the TMGI in the TMGI field, the MBMS subchannel for audio and for floor control with the MCPTT group identity in the MCPTT Group ID field.

question_65237.question: What is the lowest frequency that should be set for the measurement position in each frequency range when measuring conditions at the edge of the frequency range?
question_65237.ground_truth: The lowest frequency of the measurement position in each frequency range should be set at the lowest boundary of the frequency range plus MBW/2.

question_65238.question: What is the first step in securing downloading a Third Party application to a MExE device?
question_65238.ground_truth: The first step in securing downloading a Third Party application to a MExE device is installing root public keys for a number of Certification Authorities (CAs) in the MExE device at manufacture.

question_65240.question: What should the MME or SGSN do when they receive a VCSG Reset message?
question_65240.ground_truth: The MME or SGSN marks "Location Information Confirmed in CSS" records as "Not Confirmed" and triggers the restoration procedure if needed.

question_65241.question: What is the initial condition of the system simulator for the 6.1.2.3.4 test?
question_65241.ground_truth: The initial condition of the system simulator for the 6.1.2.3.4 test is a 1 cell with default parameters and satellite signals as specified in 4.2.

question_65245.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) and what does it cover in terms of telecommunications?
question_65245.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) is a collaboration between groups of telecommunications standardization bodies, focusing on the evolution of mobile systems and standards. It covers services and system aspects, telecommunication management, and specifications such as fault management, alarm integration, and extensible markup language definitions.

question_65247.question: What is the impact of intermodulation products caused by BS supporting carrier aggregation of Band 2 and Band 13 on Band 41?
question_65247.ground_truth: The 2nd IMD products may fall into the BS receive band of Band 41.

question_65248.question: What is the requirement for the Network Resource Models (NRMs) in regard to State Management IRP version?
question_65248.ground_truth: All Network Resource Models (NRMs) of one release must support the same State Management IRP version.

question_65249.question: What is the minimum rate of correct events for achieving the confidence level of 95% in the repeated tests during Sub-test#1 and Sub-test#2?
question_65249.ground_truth: The minimum rate of correct events should be 90%.

question_65250.question: What is the difference between the maximum carrier output power per TAB connector and rated carrier output power per TAB connector?
question_65250.ground_truth: Maximum carrier output power per TAB connector is the mean power level measured on a particular carrier at the array boundary antenna connectors, during the transmitter ON period. Rated carrier output power per TAB connector is the mean power level associated with a particular carrier declared by the manufacturer to be available at the TAB connector, during the transmitter ON period in the specified reference condition.

question_65251.question: What are the two classifications of the relay node's usage of spectrum in a cellular network with a donor cell?
question_65251.ground_truth: The two classifications are inband and outband, where inband means the eNB-relay link shares the same carrier frequency as relay-UE links, and outband means the eNB-relay link does not operate in the same carrier frequency as relay-UE links.

question_65252.question: What is the purpose of the deferred session linking procedure in clause 4.5.2.6?
question_65252.ground_truth: The deferred session linking procedure assists the PCRF to avoid linking the Gateway Control Session with an obsolete Gx Session at initial IP-CAN Session Establishment and during inter-system BBERF relocation.

question_65253.question: What component manages the security context in MCPTT networks and contains home KMS certificate (domain specific key material associated to the KMS) and/or an updated TrK for the user?

question_65254.question: What is the role of the target SGSN/MME in the CS to PS HO Request procedure?
question_65254.ground_truth: The target SGSN/MME allocates resources in UTRAN/E-UTRAN after receiving the relocation request from the Source SGSN / source MME.

question_65256.question: What is the role of an Element Manager (EM) in 3GPP TS 28.621?
question_65256.ground_truth: An Element Manager (EM) provides a package of end-user functions for management of a set of closely related types of Network Elements (NEs) in the 3G network. It can be divided into two main categories: Element Management Functions for management of NEs on an individual basis and Sub-Network Management Functions related to a network model for a set of NEs.

question_65257.question: What is required for Small Data Transmission in this optimization proposal?
question_65257.ground_truth: The system needs to support transmissions of small amounts of data efficiently with minimal network impact.

question_65258.question: Which certificate-based authentication method is used for H(e)NB authentication in this solution?
question_65258.ground_truth: IKEv2 with certificates is used for mutual authentication between H(e)NB and SeGW to authenticate the H(e)NB and the core network, as well as allowing the binding of hosting party authentication.

question_65261.question: What is the main difference between the interim solution and full IMS security in terms of authentication?
question_65261.ground_truth: The interim solution relies on bearer level security at the GPRS or UMTS PS level and does not authenticate at the IMS level, whereas full IMS security requires a USIM or ISIM and sets up IPsec security associations between UE and P-CSCF.

question_65262.question: What is used by the identities in the end-entity certificates for DTLS implementation and usage?
question_65262.ground_truth: The identities in the end-entity certificates are used for authentication and policy checks in DTLS implementation and usage.

question_65263.question: What is the required rate of correct events during repeated tests in 5.5.2.8.4.3?
question_65263.ground_truth: The required rate of correct events during repeated tests is 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_65264.question: What is the purpose of the Supplementary Services Location Notification operation in 5G Networks?
question_65264.ground_truth: The Supplementary Services Location Notification operation enables the AMF to trigger the end-user notification verification process on the UE using NAS signalling for 5GC-MT-LR procedures for immediate or deferred location.

question_65265.question: What does the reference time choice mean in the provided code?
question_65265.ground_truth: The reference time choice in the provided code is used to determine the type of clock used to reference the position of the UE. It is a choice that determines if the UE will use the GpsReferenceTimeUncertainty, GANSS-Reference-Time-Only, or UTRAN-GANSSReferenceTimeResult, or another unknown or extended result.

question_65266.question: When does the MAC entity randomly select the time and frequency resources for SL-SCH and SCI of a sidelink grant from the selected resource pool?
question_65266.ground_truth: The MAC entity randomly selects the time and frequency resources for SL-SCH and SCI of a sidelink grant from the selected resource pool if more than one pool of resources has an associated priority list which includes the priority of the sidelink logical channel with the highest priority in the MAC PDU to be transmitted.

question_65267.question: What techniques have been implemented in the codec to improve performance in frame erasure conditions?
question_65267.ground_truth: The techniques include the TC mode, the safety-net approach for LSF quantization, memory-less gain quantization, and the transmission of concealment/recovery parameters in the bitstream to the decoder.

question_65268.question: When a voice group call is initiated, how is the network notifying the group call members?
question_65268.ground_truth: Notification messages are sent on the Notification CHannel (NCH) and voice group call channel FACCHs to notify the group call members, both participating and not participating. This process is carried out throughout the call to provide the late entry facility. In case of emergency mode, the network sends an emergency mode indication in the notification messages.

question_65270.question: Which PUCCH format should the UE use to transmit UCI, if the transmission is over 1 symbol or 2 symbols and the number of HARQ-ACK information bits with positive or negative SR is 1 or 2?
question_65270.ground_truth: The UE should use PUCCH format 0 under these conditions.

question_65271.question: What action should be taken by the MAC entity if UL-SCH resources are not available for a new transmission and the Extended Pre-emptive BSR or Pre-emptive BSR MAC CE cannot be accommodated?
question_65271.ground_truth: The MAC entity should trigger a Scheduling Request.

question_65272.question: What does the VISP send to the NOP via the interface between VISP ETSI MANO and the NOP OSS?
question_65272.ground_truth: The VISP sends performance measurements related to VNF/VNFCs to the NOP via the interface between the VISP ETSI MANO and the NOP OSS.

question_65273.question: When an inter-frequency L1-RSRP measurement layer in Minter,i,j contributes to the number of cells in an inter-frequency layer, what does the resulting value represent?
question_65273.ground_truth: The resulting value represents the number of cells to be measured for L1-RSRP measurement in that inter-frequency layer.

question_65274.question: What requirement does 3GPP TS 22.179 specify for the late entry KPI?
question_65274.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 22.179 requires a late entry below 150 ms (KPI 4a) or below 350 ms (KPI 4b).

question_65275.question: What recent draft multipath extension is relevant to media production workflows and what is its primary purpose?
question_65275.ground_truth: A recent draft multipath extension adopted by the IETF QUIC Working Group allows a pair of QUIC endpoints to use multiple network paths simultaneously (i.e. link bonding) to increase the aggregate capacity of a connection, improve the robustness/resilience of the connection, or a combination of both in media production workflows.

question_65276.question: What is the function of the most local DNS resolver and proper authoritative server, and why are they not always reachable via the most local PSA?
question_65276.ground_truth: The most local DNS resolver and the proper authoritative server are responsible for resolving domain names to IP addresses. They may not always be reachable via the most local PSA because the PSA is not the only network element that can communicate with the DNS servers. Other network components, such as the UPF, can also interact with the DNS servers while serving the UE.

question_65280.question: What is the corresponding RTP payload size that fits most ideally into the transport format for the 258.4 kbps PS RAB with 40 ms TTI?
question_65280.ground_truth: The corresponding RTP payload sizes that fit most ideally into the transport formats are 936, 2232, 3528, 4792, 5136, 6328, 7720, 8872, and 10304 bits.

question_65282.question: What is the procedure when a UE moves a PDU Session from EPS to 5GS and I-SMF is inserted?
question_65282.ground_truth: This procedure is described in the non N26 based Interworking Procedures with I-SMF, specifically in the mobility procedure from EPS to 5GS without N26 interface (4.23.13.2). The mechanisms described in clause 4.23.5.1 are applied during step 9 of the procedure.

question_65283.question: What is the purpose of sending a preamble before the actual RACH message in the testing procedure?
question_65283.ground_truth: The purpose of sending a preamble before the actual RACH message is to check if the receiver can detect the preamble correctly, which indicates that the RACH message can be properly received and decoded.

question_65284.question: What is the action taken if the number of filtered ACK+NACK responses does not reach 1000 in step 5 of the procedure?
question_65284.ground_truth: The procedure does not specify the action to be taken in this situation.

question_65285.question: Which element is used in the "UAV-application-message-info" to indicate the UAV's proximity range information?
question_65285.ground_truth: The "application-defined-proximity-range-info" element is used in the "UAV-application-message-info" to indicate the UAV's proximity range information.

question_65286.question: What is the role of the 3GPP AAA Proxy in WLAN charging?
question_65286.ground_truth: The 3GPP AAA Proxy is responsible for forwarding accounting requests and messages in WLAN charging, and for performing Radius-Diameter translation in the roaming case.

question_65287.question: What are the potential advantages of using cloud computing to replace human operators in coordinating multiple vehicles?
question_65287.ground_truth: It can lead to reduced potential traffic congestion, better fuel efficiency, and overall improvement in travel time due to better coordination among vehicles.

question_65289.question: In what scenarios would an IWF include a Resource-Priority header in a SIP request for MCPTT emergency private calls, and which header value would correspond to an emergency priority level?
question_65289.ground_truth: The IWF would include a Resource-Priority header in the SIP request for MCPTT emergency private calls if the MCPTT emergency private call state is set to "MEPC 2: emergency-pc-requested", "MEPC 3: emergency-pc-granted", or if the MCPTT emergency private priority state of a call is "MEPP 2: in-progress". In case of an MCPTT emergency priority level, the header value would include the priority as specified in clause~6.4.1.11, aiding earlier priority adjustment by the infrastructure.

question_65291.question: Which network function handles the SM signalling between the UE and the SMF?
question_65291.ground_truth: The NAS-SM in the UE and the SMF handle the SM signalling between the UE and the SMF.

question_65292.question: What is the purpose of the present document as defined in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project?
question_65292.ground_truth: The present document defines the Diameter-based interfaces specific to SMS when used in conjunction with the SMS in MME or SMS in 5GS architectures.

question_65293.question: What mode does the SS use to establish a downlink TBF in the RLC layer for the test?
question_65293.ground_truth: The SS establishes a downlink TBF in Incremental Redundancy RLC mode for the test.

question_65294.question: What should the UE do if the new cell is not better ranked than the serving cell during a time interval TreselectionRAT?
question_65294.ground_truth: The UE shall not reselect the new cell in this case.

question_65295.question: What is the purpose of interrogation in the context of the ADMF?
question_65295.ground_truth: Interrogation is used for consistency checking for the interception function, such as for audit functionality. It involves checking activations for a given LEA or target identity at the MSC/VLR, GMSC, or Delivery Functions.

question_65296.question: What is the maximum number of RLM-RS resources that the UE shall be able to monitor?
question_65296.ground_truth: UE shall be able to monitor up to NRLM RLM-RS resources of the same or different types in each corresponding carrier frequency range.

question_65300.question: What is the focus of the 3GPP Technical Specification, network energy savings for NR (Release 18), in terms of power saving techniques?
question_65300.ground_truth: The study prioritizes idle/empty and low/medium load scenarios, allows for different loads among carriers and neighbor cells, and ensures that legacy UEs can continue accessing a network implementing Release 18 network energy savings techniques. It also identifies energy-saving techniques on the gNB and UE side in various domains.

question_65303.question: For which tasks does the S-CCF act as the SIP registrar for all UAs belonging to the IM CN subsystem and with public user identities?
question_65303.ground_truth: The S-CCF acts as the SIP registrar for all UAs belonging to the IM CN subsystem and with public user identities and screens all registration requests first to see if they do relate to an emergency public user identity.

question_65304.question: What functionality does the MCX Service need to provide to allow off-network operation for MCX UEs?
question_65304.ground_truth: The MCX Service needs to provide a mechanism for pre-provisioning MCX UEs with an MCX Service User Profile, including an alphanumeric identifier, a number of off-network MCX Service Groups, a MCX Service User ID, and an alphanumeric identifier for each MCX Service User ID.

question_65305.question: What must the UE indicate in the UE MM Core Network Capability of the Registration Request message for LADN support?
question_65305.ground_truth: The UE indicates the support of LADN per DNN and S-NSSAI of the UE in the UE MM Core Network Capability of the Registration Request message.

question_65306.question: What is the main difference between the private slices A and D in terms of interaction with the PLMN?
question_65306.ground_truth: In slice A, there is strict separation from the PLMN, meaning no interaction is possible, whereas in slice D, the MNO must provide appropriate security measures and APIs to ensure the factory system cannot negatively impact the rest of the network outside of slice D.

question_65308.question: When M is defined as in the equation for MPR to meet -30dBm/MHz, what is MPR for PC3 with indicating dualPA-Architecture supported when B is in the range of 3.24 to 5.04?

question_65309.question: What is the role of the Integration Reference Point (IRP) as defined in the 3GPP TS 28.734 technical specification?
question_65309.ground_truth: The Integration Reference Point (IRP) is a part of the Network Resource Model (NRM) in the Signalling Transport Network (STN) interface, which defines the requirements for network management in 3GPP networks. It is used for telecommunication network management purposes, including the management of converged networks.

question_65310.question: What action should an NF Service Consumer take upon receiving a successful response to the revocation notification service operation?
question_65310.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer should revoke the slice-specific authentication and authorization result for the given UE and trigger the release of any PDU sessions associated with the given slice.

question_65312.question: In what situations can a PIN be deleted?
question_65312.ground_truth: A PIN can be deleted if the PEMC decides to delete it or if the PIN has been in existence for longer than its life cycle.

question_65313.question: What should an MAA call to stop consuming a Media service?
question_65313.ground_truth: The stopStreamingService() API should be called by an MAA to stop consuming a Media service.

question_65314.question: What is the format of the XML document included in the Parental Control Allowing Request from the child to the SCF?
question_65314.ground_truth: The XML document includes the following parameters: ChildUserID, ParentUserID, and ProgramID.

question_65315.question: What is the difference between contiguous and non-contiguous spectrum in the context of UTRA Base Stations?
question_65315.ground_truth: Contiguous spectrum consists of a contiguous block of spectrum with no sub-block gap(s), while non-contiguous spectrum consists of two or more sub-blocks separated by sub-block gap(s).

question_65316.question: What does the StreamingAccept attribute specify for each content type?
question_65316.ground_truth: A set of MIME parameters to signal receiver capabilities for each content type that supports multiple parameter sets.

question_65317.question: Which parameter can give details about why <number> does not contain a calling party BCD number in the 3GPP network?

question_65319.question: What steps should the SS follow to Release the connection in state 3A-NB for an NB-IoT-enabled UE?
question_65319.ground_truth: The SS should follow these steps to release the connection for a UE in state 3A-NB for an NB-IoT network: (i) the SS sends the 'SystemInformationModification' message to update the system information, (ii) the SS ensures the UE transitions to state 2A-NB with CP CIoT Optimisation, and (iii) the SS and UE perform the required handshake, followed by the release of the connection.

question_65320.question: What happens if the AMF has an EPS security context received from the source MME and the UE has a valid native 5G NAS security context?
question_65320.ground_truth: The AMF verifies the MAC of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message and if successful, re-establishes the secure exchange of NAS messages using the native 5G NAS security context.

question_65323.question: What does the function "Tight Interworking with E-UTRA" provide in terms of data flow aggregation?
question_65323.ground_truth: This function enables tight interworking between NR and E-UTRA by means of data flow aggregation, including at least dual connectivity, for both collocated and non-collocated site deployments.

question_65324.question: What are the requirements for Wireless Self-Backhauling in the Radio Access Network (RAN) in the 5G system?
question_65324.ground_truth: The 5G network should enable operators to support wireless self-backhaul using NR and E-UTRA. It should also support flexible and efficient wireless self-backhaul for both indoor and outdoor scenarios, and flexible partitioning of radio resources between access and backhaul functions.

question_65325.question: What should the UE do when the periodical reporting timer expires for event A4?
question_65325.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the measurement reporting procedure as specified in 5.5.5 when the periodical reporting timer expires for event A4.

question_65326.question: What are the supported video resolutions and frames per second (fps) for MCVideo clients using the H.264 (AVC) codec?
question_65326.ground_truth: MCVideo clients should support video encoding up to 720p (1280x720 @ 30fps) and 1080p (3840x2160 @ 30fps) with the H.264 (AVC) codec, depending on their capabilities and the MCVideo service.

question_65327.question: What is the difference between DL-DATA primitives and DL-UNIT DATA primitives in the context of multiple frame operation?
question_65327.ground_truth: DL-DATA primitives are used to pass message units to and from the data link layer layer~3 for transmission and reception using multiple frame acknowledged operation, while DL-UNIT DATA primitives are used for unacknowledged operation.

question_65328.question: What is the recommended method for NR sidelink communication device operating in the resources that UE is expected to use for transmission and reception via PC5 interface?
question_65328.ground_truth: The recommended method for NR sidelink communication device operating in the resources that UE is expected to use for transmission and reception via PC5 interface is to use NR-SS-UE 1 and 2.

question_65329.question: What is the device identity of the destination device in the initial terminal response?
question_65329.ground_truth: The destination device is the UICC.

question_65330.question: What state does the MSC-A server requests MGW-A to set the Handover Device to when it receives the MAP Prepare Subsequent Handover response message or the Relocation Detect message?

question_65331.question: What should the SMF do if the Local DNS Server IP address needs to be notified or updated to the UE based on the operator's policy or UE's mobility in Option C?
question_65331.ground_truth: The SMF sends a PDU Session Modification Command (Local DNS Server Address) to the UE.

question_65332.question: When might the UDM initiate a primary authentication procedure?
question_65332.ground_truth: The UDM might initiate a primary authentication procedure upon receiving a message indicating that the SoR/UPU counter is about to wrap around, or based on the expiration time of the primary authentication.

question_65337.question: What entity is enhanced in this solution to indicate the need of L-SMF selection during offloading traffic?
question_65337.ground_truth: The A-SMF and I-SMF are enhanced to indicate the need of L-SMF selection during offloading traffic.

question_65338.question: What is the significance of the partialSuspensionOfItfN.xsd file in the context of the document?
question_65338.ground_truth: The partialSuspensionOfItfN.xsd file is significant, as it defines the Partial Suspension of Itf-N IRP's specific XML schema and element types used for notifyChangeOfPartialSuspensionOfItfN notifications.

question_65339.question: How many parallel components (PTCs) are there in the component architecture for E-UTRAN conformance tests?
question_65339.ground_truth: There are four parallel components (PTCs) in the component architecture for E-UTRAN conformance tests: E-UTRAN, UTRAN, GERAN, and other technologies like 3GPP2 UTRAN.

question_65340.question: In 8.2.3.1, what is the reason for the UE to discover P-CSCF2 and register with S-CSCF via P-CSCF2 instead of P-CSCF1?
question_65340.ground_truth: The UE registers with S-CSCF via P-CSCF2 in 8.2.3.1 to maintain ongoing IMS sessions seamlessly by performing policy and QoS controls required at the access gateway serving AN-2.

question_65342.question: What procedure is performed by the gNB-CU-CP to retrieve the PDCP UL/DL status and to exchange the TNL address information for the bearers?
question_65342.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-CP performs the Bearer Context Modification procedure to retrieve the PDCP UL/DL status and to exchange the TNL address information for the bearers.

question_65343.question: What is the mechanism that enables the receiver to determine if a short Ack/Nack report is included in the UL RLC data block?
question_65343.ground_truth: A spare bit in the RLC/MAC header is used to indicate the presence of a piggy-backed Ack/Nack report in the UL RLC data block. This mechanism is applicable to all three EGPRS header types.

question_65345.question: What is the maximum user rate in the PLMN BC-IE when the connection element is "transparent" for unrestricted digital interworking?
question_65345.ground_truth: 8 kbit/s or 16 kbit/s, depending on the user rate.

question_65347.question: How many transport blocks are indicated by the one bit indication in four stream transmission?
question_65347.ground_truth: Two transport blocks are indicated by the one bit indication in four stream transmission.

question_65348.question: Under what conditions should the gNB-DU re-establish the RLC entity when CA-based packet duplication is active?
question_65348.ground_truth: The gNB-DU should consider re-establishing the RLC entity indicated by the RLC Failure Indication IE when CA-based packet duplication is active, and include the Associated SCell List IE in the UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION RESPONSE message.

question_65350.question: What information does the UE include in the measResultListNR of measResultNeighCells when the SS/PBCH block-based measurement quantities are available?
