question_65350.ground_truth: The UE includes all the available measurement quantities of the best measured cells, other than the source PCell(in case HO failure) or PCell (in case RLF), ordered based on SS/PBCH block RSRP or SINR.

question_65351.question: What is the main issue with the presence of phase noise in OFDM-based systems, especially in FR2?
question_65351.ground_truth: The main issue with the presence of phase noise in OFDM-based systems, especially in FR2, is that it destroys the orthogonality of subcarriers, resulting in CPE (constant phase error) and ICI (intercarrier interference), which causes scattering of constellation points.

question_65352.question: What is the definition of the cell specific median-CQI value?
question_65352.ground_truth: The cell specific median-CQI value is the CQI that is at or crosses 50% distribution from the lower CQI side.

question_65353.question: What is the maximum allowed measurement reporting delay from the beginning of T2 for Cell 2 events in Section 8.6.1.3A.4.1?
question_65353.ground_truth: The maximum allowed measurement reporting delay from the beginning of T2 for Cell 2 events is 880 ms.

question_65356.question: What are the three options for service description that the AF can use when including the ServiceParameterData data structure in the HTTP POST request message body?
question_65356.ground_truth: The three options for service description that the AF can use are: a) a combination of DNN and S-NSSAI within the "dnn" attribute and the "snssai" attribute respectively, b) an AF Service Identifier within the "afServiceId" attribute, or c) an application identifier within the "appId" attribute.

question_65357.question: What is the language of the operator specified in the Accept-Language header field?
question_65357.ground_truth: The language of the operator is specified in the Accept-Language header field.

question_65358.question: What is the primary problem with the interaction between the mid-call announcements and tones solution and the Lawful Interception (LI) solution using bicasting?
question_65358.ground_truth: The primary problem is that, with bicasting, the BSS would receive the through-connected bicast speech, making it difficult for the BSS to distinguish voice announcements from downlink speech.

question_65359.question: In the track header box, what unit are the values tx, ty, width, and height defined in?
question_65359.ground_truth: The values tx, ty, width, and height in the track header box are defined in the same units as the track dimensions.

question_65360.question: What is the role of the Edge Enabler Layer (EEL) in supporting roaming for edge applications?
question_65360.ground_truth: The EEL uses Edge Counterparts (ECSs) provided in home and visited PLMNs to enable edge applications for roaming UEs. The EEC in the UE obtains edge enabler layer services from V-ECS and V-EES. There are two supported roaming models: local breakout roaming architecture and home routed roaming architecture.

question_65363.question: What happens if an idle traffic channel is not available during the mobile originating call establishment phase?
question_65363.ground_truth: The network may place the traffic channel request in a queue, and if all positions in the queue are occupied, the network will clear the calls using cause #34 "no circuit/channel available".

question_65365.question: Which are the main 6 components of the stateful media session loop?
question_65365.ground_truth: The 6 components of the stateful media session loop are: acquiring and sharing the latest pose information, sending the latest pose information, pre-rendering of the media, sending the pre-rendered media, decoding and processing the media data, and rendering the media and passing it for further processing

question_65366.question: What action triggers the IWF to send an IWF emergency alert cancel request to the MC service group?
question_65366.ground_truth: The IWF sends an IWF emergency alert cancel request to the MC service group when an LMR user initiates an emergency alert cancel.

question_65367.question: When can one or more threshold values be provided in the context of Load-Balancing steering mode with fixed split percentages?
question_65367.ground_truth: One or more threshold values can be provided when the steering mode is Priority-based or when the steering mode is Load-Balancing with fixed split percentages. These threshold values apply to both accesses and are used by the UE and UPF to determine when to stop or reduce traffic on an access.

question_65368.question: What components of the protocol stack are hosted on the eNB-CP in E-UTRAN?
question_65368.ground_truth: The eNB-CP in E-UTRAN hosts the RRC, RLC, MAC, and PHY layers of the control plane, and the control plane part of the PDCP protocol.

question_65369.question: What is the applicable number of encoded ACK/NACK bits per sub-frame for PUCCH format 3 in 8.3.5.1?
question_65369.ground_truth: The number of encoded ACK/NACK bits per sub-frame for PUCCH format 3 is defined for two cases - 4AN bits for FDD and TDD, and 16AN bits for TDD.

question_65370.question: What is the main goal of Key Issue #2a and #2b?
question_65370.ground_truth: The main goal of Key Issue #2a and #2b is to establish a charging mechanism in the visited MNO for 5G data connectivity usage and conveying the charging information to the home MNO.

question_65371.question: What is the recommended reference signal for NR carrier phase positioning?
question_65371.ground_truth: Existing DL PRS and UL SRS for positioning purpose are recommended as the reference signals for NR carrier phase positioning.

question_65372.question: What is the purpose of the 5GLAN work that is under standardization to support 5G LAN-type services over 5G system?
question_65372.ground_truth: The purpose is to support 5G LAN-type services over 5G system in a maritime environment inside a vessel, which is similar to residential, enterprise, or industrial automation environments.

question_65373.question: What is the purpose of the "id-Cause" parameter in the "ProtocolIE-Container" sequence in the Iu-ReleaseCommand message?
question_65373.ground_truth: The "id-Cause" parameter in the "ProtocolIE-Container" sequence in the Iu-ReleaseCommand message indicates the cause of the release, such as the type of release, with a variety of options like "unsuccessful linking list", indicating the reason for the failure, and "NAS-PDU", indicating a NAS-PDU type.

question_65375.question: What is the format of the NAPTR flag in the DNS record for a PGW-C/SMF set in a 3GPP network?
question_65375.ground_truth: The NAPTR flag in the DNS record for a PGW-C/SMF set in a 3GPP network should be set to "".

question_65376.question: What are the key issues identified in the context of wholesale charging towards additional actors in an MNO?
question_65376.ground_truth: The key issues identified are: #3a - Collection of charging information in home MNO about the 5G data connectivity usage per MVNO, #3b - Collection of charging information in home MNO about the 5G connection and mobility usage per MVNO, and #3c - Collection of charging information in home MNO about the SMS usage per MVNO.

question_65377.question: What is the role of the TSCTSF in the process of QoS and Alternative QoS?
question_65377.ground_truth: The TSCTSF supports receiving Requested PER from NEF and sending to PCF.

question_65378.question: What is the purpose of the Alternative-APN AVP and when is it included in the Gmb interface?
question_65378.ground_truth: The Alternative-APN AVP contains the value of a new APN and it is included in the Gmb interface if the UE must use a different APN for the MBMS PDP Context from the one used in the Join message.

question_65379.question: What is the role of PCEF in the evolved 3GPP system architecture for 3GPP accesses?
question_65379.ground_truth: PCEF (Policy and Charging Enforcement Function) is a main function of the PCC (Policy and Charging Control) in the evolved 3GPP system architecture for 3GPP accesses.

question_65381.question: What ITU-T Recommendation is used for establishing AAL2 connections towards the circuit switched domain in the ATM transport option?

question_65383.question: What is the condition for the event "Deactivation" to be successful in the intra-band and inter-band scenario?
question_65383.ground_truth: The last CSI report must be received by the SS earlier than or equal to subframe (n+8), and DTX must not be observed by the SS outside the specified subframes for the event "Deactivation" to be successful in the intra-band and inter-band scenario.

question_65384.question: What action does the MRFP take when it receives a request from the MRFC to modify the media properties based on the provided Floor Request Decisions notification?
question_65384.ground_truth: The MRFP modifies the Floor status of the associated Client

question_65386.question: What is the total time given for measurement reporting delay plus TTI insertion uncertainty for Event A6 triggered measurement report?
question_65386.ground_truth: The total time given for measurement reporting delay plus TTI insertion uncertainty for Event A6 triggered measurement report is 6402 ms.

question_65388.question: When is the UE required to search for and measure inter-frequency layers of higher, equal, or lower priority?
question_65388.ground_truth: The UE is required to search for and measure inter-frequency layers of higher, equal, or lower priority if Srxlev <= SnonIntraSearchP or Squal <= SnonIntraSearchQ.

question_65390.question: What advantages does Alternative 3 provide compared to Alternative 1 and Alternative 2?
question_65390.ground_truth: Alternative 3 provides the advantages of Alternative 1 for some peers and Alternative 2 for others. It allows the sender to avoid redundant information when following Alternative 1, and not requiring to remember the value of load information towards a peer node for Alternative 2.

question_65391.question: What should the SS do if there is an UL grant scheduled for the second search space cycle when it receives an E indicating a HARQ NACK for a DL transmission in search space cycle N?
question_65391.ground_truth: The SS should postpone this UL grant for one cycle.

question_65393.question: What should the floor control interface do if an indication that the participant is overriding without revoke is stored?
question_65393.ground_truth: The floor control interface shall send Floor Idle message to the associated floor participant, shall remove the indication that a participant is overriding without revoke, and shall remain in the 'U: permitted' state.

question_65394.question: What are the different procedures for UL data scheduling in NR?
question_65394.ground_truth: UL data scheduling (MCS/precoder/rank) is based on non-precoded SRS transmission by UE, UL data scheduling (MCS/precoder/rank) is based on precoded SRS(s) transmission by UE, UL data scheduling (MCS/precoder/rank) is based on a combination of non-precoded and precoded SRS transmission by UE.

question_65395.question: What action does the UE (MCDATA Client) take when it receives a SIP MESSAGE request with FD notification?
question_65395.ground_truth: The UE (MCDATA Client) responds to the SIP MESSAGE message with a SIP 200 (OK) message and delivers the notification to the MCDATA User.

question_65396.question: How does the number of representations influence the saved traffic on the transit link?
question_65396.ground_truth: The number of representations significantly influences the saved traffic on the transit link, with a higher number of representations leading to greater savings.

question_65400.question: What is the function used to compute the DL can to DL can be computed as the difference between the TWDB and a function of the UL latency?
question_65400.ground_truth: The function of the UL latency can be the maximum of the latency experienced by a sequence of consecutive packets transmitted in UL over a sliding window, or the average or the upper bound of the confidence interval of the UL latency.

question_65401.question: What is the definition of MAC-hs Guaranteed Bit Rate in 3GPP TS 25.331?
question_65401.ground_truth: The MAC-hs Guaranteed Bit Rate IE indicates the guaranteed number of bits per second that Node B should deliver over the air interface under normal operating conditions (provided there is data to deliver).

question_65404.question: What is the objective of using the in-band emission (IBE) requirement based model for co-channel interference case?
question_65404.ground_truth: The objective of using the in-band emission (IBE) requirement based model for the co-channel interference case is that the RF effect could be dominant, and the frequency offset and time offset are not significant factors influencing UE-UE interference.

question_65406.question: What information is used to establish each MP-DCCP connection between the MDTC in the UE and the MDTS in the UPF?
question_65406.ground_truth: Information such as the destination IP address and port for each MP-DCCP connection, as well as the selected QoS flow and stearing mode, is used to establish each MP-DCCP connection.

question_65407.question: What is the difference between separate establishment and combined establishment for a Multi-Access PDU session?
question_65407.ground_truth: Separate establishment refers to the establishment of the two child PDU sessions with two separate PDU session establishment procedures, while combined establishment refers to the establishment of two child PDU sessions in parallel with a single "UE Requested MA-PDU session establishment" procedure.

question_65408.question: What security measure is implemented in Solution 4 to protect the S1 and X2 user plane traffic over the Un interface?
question_65408.ground_truth: Solution 4 uses IPsec for integrity of S1 and X2, and AS security otherwise.

question_65409.question: When is the Location Area Identification IE included in the GA RC REGISTER REJECT message?
question_65409.ground_truth: The Location Area Identification IE shall be included if the Register Reject Cause 'Location not allowed' or 'Network Congestion' is returned to the MS.

question_65410.question: What is the synchronization requirement for a less strict scenario between two 5G NR systems in FR1 with a smaller cell size?
question_65410.ground_truth: A synchronization requirement of 3 microseconds (Tsync=3~us) would be allowed.

question_65411.question: What kind of data can the "AnyCellChange" element contain, based on its type definition in the provided XML schema?
question_65411.ground_truth: The "AnyCellChange" element can contain data of the type "tEmptyTypeAttribute", as defined by its type definition "tEmptyTypeAttribute" in the schema.

question_65412.question: What security considerations should be taken into account for the "application/3gpp-ims+xml" media type?
question_65412.ground_truth: The security considerations for the "application/3gpp-ims+xml" media type are the same as those for "application/xml" as specified in RFC 3023 and the security considerations for SIP as specified in RFC 3261.

question_65413.question: What should the SLM client include in the HTTP POST request to send a location service deregistration request?
question_65413.ground_truth: The SLM client should include a Request-URI set to the URI corresponding to the identity of the SLM-S, an Authorization header field with the "Bearer" authentication scheme set to an access token of the "bearer" token type, and an application/vnd.3gpp.seal-location-info+xml MIME body that includes a <location-info> root element with a <VAL-user-id> element set to the identity of the VAL user or the VAL UE for location service deregistration.

question_65414.question: What are the three high-priority scenarios for CSI feedback enhancements?
question_65414.ground_truth: The three high-priority scenarios for CSI feedback enhancements are Scenarios A, B, and C.

question_65415.question: What should a UE in CS/PS mode 1 of operation with "IMS voice not available" do when the tracking area updating procedure indicating "combined TA/LA updating with IMSI attach" is triggered again after timer T3402 expires in the UE?
question_65415.ground_truth: The UE should continue with the combined tracking area updating procedure indicating "combined TA/LA updating with IMSI attach".

question_65417.question: What is the complexity target for Device C in the RAN design targets?
question_65417.ground_truth: The complexity target for Device C is to be orders-of-magnitude lower than NB-IoT.

question_65418.question: What other modes of communication are considered for V2V (vehicle-to-vehicle) communication apart from PC5?
question_65418.ground_truth: The other mode of communication considered for V2V is Uu, which represents V2V communication through the cellular network.

question_65419.question: What happens if none of the LMFs have UE context information available for a "missing UE"?
question_65419.ground_truth: If none of the LMFs have UE context information available for a "missing UE", the LMF may issue a request to the AMF to assign the "missing" UE to the same LMF.

question_65420.question: What is the PR (Potential New Requirement) needed to support the use case for protecting a power line in a distribution grid?
question_65420.ground_truth: The 5G system shall support an end-to-end latency of less than 5~ms or 10~ms, depending on the applied voltage level.

question_65421.question: What action does the P-CSCF take upon receiving a SIP INVITE message with an "anonymous user" parameter in the stated scenario?
question_65421.ground_truth: The P-CSCF either internally retrieves the one or more EPS-level identities and the MSISDN received during registration, or performs the registration procedure again to retrieve the required information. Then, the P-CSCF forwards the SIP INVITE (UserID-4) towards the PSAP, where UserID-4 is derived from one of the EPS-level identities received during registration.

question_65422.question: With what priority level shall the RNC consider the requested RAB if the Extended Alternative Maximum Bit Rate IE is signalled in one direction?
question_65422.ground_truth: If the Extended Alternative Maximum Bit Rate IE is signalled in one direction, the RNC shall use it in both directions for that entry or discrete value. If the Supported Alternative Maximum Bit Rate IE is present, it shall be used in both directions for all entries in the list or discrete values.

question_65423.question: What is the purpose of establishing a Bearer Control Path with RUA of the ICCF in the example flow for Domain Transfer to CS?
question_65423.ground_truth: The purpose of establishing a Bearer Control Path with RUA of the ICCF in the example flow for Domain Transfer to CS is to initiate the Domain Transfer.

question_65424.question: What is the time period used to calculate the measurement period Tmeasurement inter for inter-frequency P-CCPCH RSCP measurements?

question_65425.question: What section defines common procedures for RF testing?
question_65425.ground_truth: Section 5.4 defines common procedures for RF testing.

question_65426.question: What is the role of the NG CP in the session modification procedure?
question_65426.ground_truth: The NG CP initiates the PDU Session Modification procedure and modifies the PDU Session and the context for the PDU session in the gNB.

question_65427.question: How does the 5G DDNMF map the ProSe application code to the corresponding ProSe application ID?
question_65427.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF maps the ProSe application code to the corresponding ProSe application ID from the PLMN-specific, country-specific, or global database, depending on the type of ProSe application code.

question_65428.question: What is the recommended maximum bandwidth for RTCP traffic for the RS and RR field at media level?
question_65428.ground_truth: The recommended maximum bandwidth for RTCP traffic for the RS field at media level is 8 000 bps, and for the RR field at media level is 6 000 bps.

question_65429.question: What should the UE do if the SI message cannot be decoded from the accumulated SI message transmissions by the end of the SI-window?
question_65429.ground_truth: The UE should continue reception and accumulation of SI message transmissions on DL-SCH in the next SI-window occasion for the concerned SI message.

question_65431.question: Which node in the S9 protocol acts as a Diameter server and which acts as a Diameter client?
question_65431.ground_truth: In the S9 protocol, the H-PCRF acts as a Diameter server, and the V-PCRF acts as the Diameter client.

question_65432.question: What is the difference between event-based charging and session-based charging in the NS Converged Charging solution?
question_65432.ground_truth: Event-based charging triggers charging based on the number of UEs going above or below a threshold, while session-based charging starts charging when the number of UEs is above a certain value and stops when it falls below that value.

question_65433.question: What type of AVP is the Coverage-Status AVP and what values are defined for it?
question_65433.ground_truth: The Coverage-Status AVP is of type Enumerated and it indicates whether UE is served by E-UTRAN or not. The defined values are: Out of coverage, In coverage.

question_65434.question: What solution provides enhancements for an ECS to query an ECS-ER and obtain information about partner ECS that provide service provisioning for a particular application?

question_65436.question: What is the expected input from the Content Provider in the high-level requirements regarding content ingestion?
question_65436.ground_truth: The BM-SC ought to be informed by the CP on whether the video files can be fetched by the UE over unicast from the CP server, the basic characteristics of the service such as service name and service language, and the time that a given file is expected to be available to the MBMS-aware application for rendering.

question_65437.question: What is the role of the EEC in the ACR launching procedure?
question_65437.ground_truth: The EEC performs ACR launching procedure indicating S-EES with ACR type (normal ACR or service continuity planning) and predicted/expected UE location or EAS service area. The EEC is the one that sends an ACR request message to the EES in order to start ACR. The ACR request message includes ACR type to indicate whether the ACR is for normal ACR or service continuity planning. The ACR request message includes Predicted/Expected UE location or EAS service area to indicate that the EES should detect whether the UE has moves to the Predicted/Expected UE location or EAS service area or not in ACR clean-up phase.

question_65439.question: What information does the RANAP ENHANCED RELOCATION INFORMATION REQUEST message contain?
question_65439.ground_truth: The message contains various IEs (Information Elements) such as Source RNC To Target RNC Transparent Container IE, Old Iu Signalling Connection Identifier CS domain IE, Global CN-ID for CS, RABs to be Setup List, etc.

question_65440.question: What is the role of the Receiving RNC in the ANR reporting procedure for UTRAN cells over the Iur interface?
question_65440.ground_truth: The Receiving RNC in the ANR reporting procedure for UTRAN cells over the Iur interface is responsible for retrieving the ANR report over the Uu interface, terminating the relevant ANR report entry, and forwarding the ANR report to the Base RNCs over Iur with the RNSAP Direct Information Transfer procedure. The Receiving RNC may also use the RNSAP Information Exchange Initiation procedure to request cell information from a neighbour RNC.

question_65441.question: What potential security requirement should the 5G System provide to protect the discovery messages for UE-to-UE Relay discovery?
question_65441.ground_truth: The 5G System shall provide a means for confidentiality protection, integrity protection and replay protection of discovery messages for UE-to-UE Relay discovery.

question_65442.question: What is the activation indicator for the call forwarding unconditional feature in the RELEASE COMPLETE (SS RETURN RESULT) 2.1 coding?

question_65444.question: What is the minimum number of timeslots that an EFTA capable MS should be able to receive and acknowledge correctly while no frequency hopping is used?
question_65444.ground_truth: An EFTA capable MS should be able to receive and acknowledge correctly on a maximum of 8 timeslots while no frequency hopping is used.

question_65445.question: How does the network initiate a session transfer using Working SC policies?
question_65445.ground_truth: The network can initiate a session transfer to the preferred domain (e.g., IMS) by updating the UE's Working SC policies with new values, such as requiring an immediate transfer to the preferred domain.

question_65446.question: What message does the AMF provide to NG-RAN during the initial context setup if the UE Radio Capabilities associated with the UE Capability ID are available in the AMF?
question_65446.ground_truth: The AMF includes the UE Radio Capabilities in the NGAP INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message as part of the UE context in this step in case NG-RAN indicated in step 3 that the UE Capability ID was unknown.

question_65447.question: What is the test purpose for 9.1.43.2.2 in TDD Intra Frequency Relative RSRP Accuracy for UE category 0?
question_65447.ground_truth: The test purpose for 9.1.43.2.2 is to verify that the TDD intra-frequency relative RSRP measurement accuracy is within the specified limit for all bands.

question_65449.question: What should the IWF performing the controlling role do if the received SIP MESSAGE request for emergency notification indicates a successful delivery and the MCPTT function is controlling the emergency alert?
question_65449.ground_truth: The IWF should generate a SIP 2xx response and follow the procedures specified in 3GPP TS 24.229.

question_65450.question: What is the purpose of the UE Context Release procedure in 5G?
question_65450.ground_truth: The UE Context Release procedure is used by the AMF to order the release of the UE-associated logical NG-connection in 5G, for example, after the completion of a transaction between the UE and the 5GC, or when the UE has initiated the establishment of a new UE-associated logical NG-connection.

question_65452.question: What is the length of the PGK Index field?
question_65452.ground_truth: The PGK Index field is 5 bits in length.

question_65453.question: What action does the IRI-POI present in the SMF+PGW-C take when home routed roaming interception is enabled in the visited network as per Option A specified in clause 6.3.1?
question_65453.ground_truth: When home routed roaming interception is enabled in the visited network as per Option A specified in clause 6.3.1, the IRI-POI present in the SMF+PGW-C is implemented in accordance with Option B or Option C specified in clause 6.3.1.

question_65454.question: What is the definition of "satellite access" in this 3GPP Technical Report?
question_65454.ground_truth: Satellite access refers to direct connectivity between the user terminal and the satellite.

question_65455.question: What is the basic approach to generate HDR metrics?
question_65455.ground_truth: The basic approach to generate HDR metrics involves transforming YUV sequences to 4:4:4 and then to floating point RGB to obtain 32-bit EXR floating point representation, and then computing PSNRL100 and DE100.

question_65456.question: What is the purpose of the solution described in 7.22.2 for Edge Application Server discovery?
question_65456.ground_truth: The purpose of this solution is to enable discovery of Edge Application Servers running in different Edge Data Networks, via Edge Enabler Servers responsible for the service areas of the aforementioned Edge Application Servers. This distributed topology for discovery allows Edge Enabler Clients to connect only to a single Edge Enabler Server, saving resources on the UE and reducing data traffic in the network.

question_65458.question: What information is included in the MCPTT private call response from the MCPTT client to the MCPTT server?
question_65458.ground_truth: The MCPTT private call response from the MCPTT client to the MCPTT server includes an indication of success or failure, and if the indication is failure, it may also include one or more alternatives to the parameter values contained in the MCPTT private call request.

question_65459.question: How does the second solution mitigate anti-replay attacks for Ranging/SL Positioning discovers?
question_65459.ground_truth: The second solution uses a random-nonce-based challenge-response mechanism to anti-replay attacks for Ranging/SL Positioning discover.

question_65463.question: What are the MSGin5G message transfer requirements for the SEALDD service?
question_65463.ground_truth: The SEALDD service shall provide a mechanism to support SEALDD traffic transmission using MSGin5G message.

question_65464.question: What action does the SMF take when there is a need to update the MBS service area?
question_65464.ground_truth: The SMF triggers the PDU Session Modification procedure and updates the PDU session resources associated with the multicast MBS session with the new MBS service area.

question_65465.question: What triggers the inter-CU backhaul RLF recovery procedure for an IAB-node in SA mode?
question_65465.ground_truth: The inter-CU backhaul RLF recovery procedure for an IAB-node in SA mode is triggered when the IAB-MT of the IAB-node detects backhaul RLF.

question_65466.question: Who is able to initiate a railway emergency alert in the FRMCS system?
question_65466.ground_truth: An FRMCS user is able to initiate a railway emergency alert in the FRMCS system.

question_65467.question: Which measurement indicates the total number of UL (Uplink) TBs, excluding HARQ retransmissions, received in a cell?
question_65467.ground_truth: The measurement TB.TotNbrUl provides the total number of UL TBs received in a cell for each measurement granularity interval.

question_65469.question: What does the N32 interface consist of?
question_65469.ground_truth: The N32 interface consists of two separate interfaces: N32-c, a control plane interface between SEPPs for initial handshake and negotiating parameters; and N32-f, a forwarding interface between SEPPs for message forwarding with security protection applied.

question_65473.question: What is the network slice selection in SC Mode 1?
question_65473.ground_truth: The network slice selection in SC Mode 1 is 01 01 01 01 with ST: MBB and SD: 010101.

question_65474.question: What is the function of the User Service Discovery/Announcement function?
question_65474.ground_truth: The User Service Discovery/Announcement function provides service description information necessary to initiate an MBMS user service.

question_65476.question: What is the requirement for managing data flows from different mission critical services when applying priority decisions?
question_65476.ground_truth: Priority management should manage all data flows from the different mission critical services together when applying priority decisions.

question_65477.question: What is the proposal for identifying the dependency of PDU Sets with the same Layer ID and Temporal ID in H.265 and H.266?
question_65477.ground_truth: Instead of an explicit dependency ID, the importance ID can be used both as importance information and dependency information.

question_65478.question: What is the difference between E-DPDCH power extrapolation formula and E-DPDCH power interpolation formula used in the calculation of the E-DPDCH gain factor?
question_65478.ground_truth: The E-DPDCH power extrapolation formula is used to compute the gain factor of an E-DPDCH when the E-TFCI of the i-th E-DPDCH is greater than or equal to the E-TFCI of the M-th reference E-DPDCH and less than the E-TFCI of the (M-1)-th reference E-DPDCH. On the other hand, the E-DPDCH power interpolation formula is used when the E-TFCI of the i-th E-DPDCH is smaller than the E-TFCI of the 1st reference E-DPDCH and greater than or equal to the E-TFCI of the M-th reference E-DPDCH.

question_65480.question: What action does the UE take when it receives an INVITE for a voice call while the Terminating Identification Restriction (TIR) is active in temporary mode?
question_65480.ground_truth: The UE includes the Privacy header with privacy type of "id" in any non-100 responses it sends upon receipt of a SIP request.

question_65481.question: What are the values for the Range leaf for V2X groupcast mode communication over the NR-PC5?
question_65481.ground_truth: The values are 1-65535, a 16 bits unsigned integer value indicating range in meters.

question_65482.question: What should the Node B do if the UE TS0 Capability LCR IE is included in the UE Capabilities Information IE in the HS-DSCH Information IE in a 1.28Mcps TDD system?
question_65482.ground_truth: The Node B may use this information in HSDPA resources allocation for the UE.

question_65483.question: What are the general high-level requirements for the present IRP in the context of 3GPP Telecommunication Management?
question_65483.ground_truth: The general high-level requirements for the present IRP include IRP-related requirements from 3GPP TS~32.101, 3GPP TS~32.102, and 3GPP TS 32.600. Additionally, the Network Resource Model defined by this IRP should be generic, not containing any domain-specific definitions, and should support management of UMTS-GSM Inter-system handover.

question_65484.question: What is the primary layer where security policies are enforced for Ranging/SL Positioning operations?
question_65484.ground_truth: SR5 security policies are enforced on the PDCP layer for Ranging/SL Positioning operations.

question_65485.question: What should a UE consider when randomly selecting time and frequency resources for V2X sidelink communication?
question_65485.ground_truth: The UE should ensure that the randomly selected time and frequency resources fulfill the latency requirement.

question_65486.question: How are threat agents described in the provided structure?
question_65486.ground_truth: Threat agents are described by aspects such as expertise, resources, opportunity, and motivation, and are assigned levels to facilitate the selection of protection mechanisms or requirements.

question_65488.question: What is the responsibility of the EE Policy Management function in the energy efficiency control framework?
question_65488.ground_truth: The EE Policy Management function is responsible for defining and managing the energy efficiency control policies related to the energy consumption status and control operations at the network, equipment, and site levels in the energy efficiency control framework.

question_65489.question: In the GEA5 algorithm, what is the assignment operator "=" used as in several programming languages?
question_65489.ground_truth: The assignment operator "=" in GEA5 is used to assign a new value to a variable, which takes place after the assignment took place.

question_65490.question: What should the S-CSCF do when determining the duration of an emergency registration?
question_65490.ground_truth: The duration of the emergency registration is subject to national regulation and can be subject to roaming agreements.

question_65491.question: What should the network do if it has downlink user data pending for a UE, the AMF has stored paging restriction of the UE, and the Paging restriction type is set to "All paging is restricted except for specified PDU session(s)"?
question_65491.ground_truth: The network should page the UE only when it has downlink user data pending for PDU session(s) that paging is not restricted based on the stored paging restriction.

question_65492.question: When is the NAS security mode command procedure initiated with the UE in the 5G system?
question_65492.ground_truth: The NAS security mode command procedure is initiated with the UE upon successful completion of the 5G AKA primary authentication in the 5G system.

question_65493.question: What capability is required for the robotic controls to ensure appropriate actions are taken by the robots?

question_65494.question: What information should the BM-SC include in the MBMS Session Start procedure if BM-SC trace is activated and BM-SC supports both IPv4 and IPv6?
question_65494.ground_truth: The BM-SC should include both an IPv4 and an IPv6 IP Multicast address together with the corresponding IP addresses of the multicast source.

question_65495.question: Which clause should be referred to for the specific message contents in procedure P5 and P6, except for step 2 in procedure P6?
question_65495.ground_truth: Clause 9 should be referred to for the specific message contents in procedure P5 and P6, except for step 2 in procedure P6 where the message titled "Transition to CELL_FACH" from clause 9 is used.

question_65500.question: What is the role of the SEAL NRM service enabler in exposing Time Sensitive Communication (TSC) capabilities of the 5G system?
question_65500.ground_truth: The SEAL NRM service enabler exposes TSC capabilities of the 5G system, which supports integration with an IEEE TSN system as well as 5G-native TSC services.

question_65503.question: Under what condition shall the PCF remove the active PCC Rule with the highest Priority Level value?
question_65503.ground_truth: The PCF shall remove the active PCC Rule with the highest Priority Level value if there are more than one PCC Rule with the Priority Level value higher than the derived Priority Level value of new or modified PCC Rule.

question_65504.question: What is the behavior of a UE when a mandatory field is missing in an RRC message received on the DCCH or CCCH, or a PC5 RRC message received on the SCCH?
question_65504.ground_truth: The UE will ignore the message.

question_65505.question: How many dB less than the number specified for 2Rx tests should be the SNR requirements for testing 8Rx capable UEs with only 4Rx supported RF bands?

question_65507.question: What is a premises radio access station, and what is an example of it?
question_65507.ground_truth: A premises radio access station is a base station installed at a customer premises network. An example of it would be a 5G base station that is installed at a private business or residence.

question_65508.question: What is the purpose of including the 5G-GUTI assigned to the N5CW device over 3GPP access in the NAI when the N5CW device registers to 5GC over 3GPP access?
question_65508.ground_truth: The purpose is to enable the TWIF to select the same AMF as the one serving the N5CW device over 3GPP access.

question_65509.question: What is the difference between use case #1 and use case #2 in terms of the control interface between RMS and DM?
question_65509.ground_truth: In use case #1, the control interface from RMS to DM is not in the scope of ETSI ES 202~336-12, while in use case #2, the control interface between RMS and DM is in the scope of ETSI ES 202~336-12 and can be specified by 3GPP using CORBA IDL and SOAP/XML or by defining a REST / XML interface.

question_65510.question: What requirement must the UE meet after step 2 in the P-CSCF discovery process using DHCP?
question_65510.ground_truth: After step 2, the UE shall initiate a P-CSCF discovery employing DHCP.

question_65511.question: What action does the NEF take when geographical area or civic address information is provided by the AF for MBS service area?
question_65511.ground_truth: The NEF translates the MBS service area to Cell ID list or TAI list and may further check the MBS capability within the MBS service area.

question_65512.question: How long does the SS wait before switching off the UE and returning to step 1 in case of a failure in step 6?
question_65512.ground_truth: The SS waits for a total of 15s from the beginning of T1 before switching off the UE and returning to step 1.

question_65514.question: What is the role of the AMF during a UE triggered service request when a new I-SMF needs to be selected due to I-SMF reallocation, insertion, or removal?
question_65514.ground_truth: The AMF determines and selects a new I-SMF based on the specified scenario (reallocation, insertion, or removal). It then invokes the Nsmf_PDUSession_CreateSMContext Request (old I-SMF ID) service operation to the new I-SMF to establish the new I-SMF context for the UE.

question_65515.question: When should a new functionality be defined as optional in the V4 interface?
question_65515.ground_truth: A new functionality should be defined as optional in the V4 interface when it is introduced and if backwards incompatible changes cannot be avoided.

question_65517.question: What is the general relevance of the test results in the present document?
question_65517.ground_truth: The test results in the present document are generally valid for all Release 6 services and applications which are based on the Release~6 audio codecs, including Packet switched Streaming Service (PSS), Multimedia Messaging Service (MMS), Multimedia Broadcast and Multicast Service (MBMS), IMS Messaging Service and Presence Service, and apply to all similar applications with similar constraints (e.g. bit-rate, mono/stereo).

question_65518.question: In what situation can the UE initiate a PDU session modification procedure by sending a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message to delete the mapped EPS bearer context with 5GSM cause #41?
question_65518.ground_truth: If the TFT operation = "Delete existing TFT" for a dedicated EPS bearer context, after sending the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMPLETE for the ongoing PDU session modification procedure.

question_65519.question: What measures can be taken to mitigate RAN user plane congestion during Rx session establishment?
question_65519.ground_truth: Existing bandwidth limitation parameters on the Rx interface can be utilized to mitigate RAN user plane congestion during Rx session establishment.

question_65520.question: What is the conformance requirement for a UE supporting RFC 4028 when it receives a 422 (Session Interval Too Small) to an INVITE request with a Min-SE header field?
question_65520.ground_truth: The UE should retry the request in accordance with RFC 4028 subclause 7.4.

question_65521.question: What happens when Network-Based IP-Can Bearer Flow Optimization (NBIFOM) is not possible for an IP-CAN session?
question_65521.ground_truth: When NBIFOM is not possible, the PCRF indicates to the PGW to release the access. Proper signaling is sent to the UE for the UE not to retry adding the access to the corresponding PDN connection immediately.

question_65522.question: In what unit is the ECDP ratio defined in TS25101 6.2.3?
question_65522.ground_truth: The ECDP ratio is defined in TS25101 6.2.3 in terms of power ratio, relative to the non-zero beta code in the composite reference waveform.

question_65523.question: What is the formula to calculate the variable Ntotal in the context of CSI-RS resource occasions within a window W?
question_65523.ground_truth: Ntotal is the total number of CSI-RS resource occasions within the window W, including those that overlap with measurement gap occasions, MUSIM gap occasions, or SMTC occasions within the window.

question_65524.question: What must the SGSN return if it receives a LCS Location Notification Return Result message indicating that permission for location is not granted?
question_65524.ground_truth: The SGSN shall return an error response to the GMLC.

question_65525.question: When is a UE allowed to drop LTE and NR V2X SL transmission or reception for up to 1ms when synchronization source is changed?
question_65525.ground_truth: UE is allowed to drop LTE and NR V2X SL transmission or reception for up to 1ms when synchronization source is changed in the scenarios listed in 12.7.2.

question_65527.question: How is the non-3GPP delay budget determined in the 5GS network?
question_65527.ground_truth: If the UE supports providing the non-3GPP delay budget, it may provide the network with the non-3GPP delay budget for the one or more QoS flows associated with the PDU sessions for a PIN during the PDU session modification procedure. The network takes into account the received non-3GPP delay budget to ensure the end-to-end QoS requirement of a PINE.

question_65528.question: What is the difference between "online charging" and "offline charging" in the context of charging in telecommunication networks?
question_65528.ground_truth: "Online charging" is a charging mechanism where charging information can affect the service rendered in real-time, requiring direct interaction with bearer/session/service control. "Offline charging" is a process where charging information is collected as a "charging event" and then evaluated at a later stage for billing purposes.

question_65530.question: What should the UE do if the ngKSI matches a valid non-current native 5G NAS security context and the UE has a mapped 5G NAS security context as the current 5G NAS security context?
question_65530.ground_truth: If the ngKSI matches a valid non-current native 5G NAS security context and the UE has a mapped 5G NAS security context as the current 5G NAS security context, the UE should take the non-current native 5G NAS security context into use which then becomes the current native 5G NAS security context and delete the mapped 5G NAS security context.

question_65531.question: What stack does the Xn Application PDUs use to be transmitted between two NG-RAN nodes?
question_65531.ground_truth: The Xn Application PDUs use the SCTP/IP/Data link layer/Physical layer stack for transmission between two NG-RAN nodes.

question_65534.question: What network entity is expected to discover UE communication pattern in Solution 22?
question_65534.ground_truth: The NWDAF is expected to discover UE communication pattern in Solution 22.

question_65535.question: What services are described in the use case on communication between wearable IoT devices and maritime rescue coordination centre for saving a life?
question_65535.ground_truth: The services described in this use case include a passenger using IoT devices such as air jackets or smart bands to transmit location and health information to the maritime rescue coordination centre when in distress. The maritime rescue coordination centre can use moving UEs such as drones to locate and rescue people in distress.

question_65536.question: What should the Mobile Station do when its attempt counter is smaller than 4, and a failure has occurred during a normal location updating procedure?
question_65536.ground_truth: The Mobile Station shall resend its Location Updating Request message with Mobile Identity IE set to its IMSI, CKSN IE set to "no key is available", and the Location Updating type set to "normal location updating".

question_65537.question: What is the purpose of the QoS parameters in the process described?
question_65537.ground_truth: The QoS parameters define different aspects of the UE and its bearers that are considered, guaranteed, or enforced by the network nodes to provide appropriate QoS treatment for each DRB.

question_65538.question: What should the MS discriminate to identify the second RTTI block in the 20 ms time unit as an "8-PSK 2-burst RTTI block"?
question_65538.ground_truth: The MS should discriminate between '0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0' and '1,1,1,0,0,0,0,1' in the stealing flags.

question_65540.question: What is the difference in network selection process between a UE operating in a PLMN access operation mode and a UE operating in SNPN access operation mode?
question_65540.ground_truth: A UE operating in PLMN access operation mode goes through the PLMN selection process, while a UE operating in SNPN access operation mode performs the SNPN selection process.

question_65541.question: Who maintains the reference software for the 3GPP file format?
question_65541.ground_truth: The reference software for the 3GPP file format is maintained by ISO/IEC, as part of the overall reference software.

question_65542.question: How can the SS verify the call states during an explicit call transfer attempt?
question_65542.ground_truth: The SS sends a STATUS ENQUIRY message in respect of the transaction identifier of each call, and receives a STATUS message indicating the appropriate call state.

question_65544.question: What is the role of the group management functions in the MCPTT architecture?
question_65544.ground_truth: The group management functions (e.g. admission control; linking of groups;) should be implemented on a separate node from the main PTT functions (e.g. "call" setup/termination; allocation of TMGI to UE; floor control;) to enable parts of the MCPTT solution to be reused for other applications.

question_65545.question: Which network element verifies the PLMN-ID (or SNPN ID) contained in the API request in the NF Service Producer during service access based on a token verification process?
question_65545.ground_truth: The NF Service Producer verifies the PLMN-ID (or SNPN ID) contained in the API request during service access based on a token verification process.

question_65546.question: How is an E.164 number included in the "From-id" information element when it is transporting an International number?
question_65546.ground_truth: The E.164 number, when included in the "From-id" information element to transport an International number, is binary encoded in the octet 3, octet 4, octet 5, etc., with the most significant digit of the E.164 digit-string encoded in the bits numbers 8, 7, 6, and 5 of octet number 3, and the bit-pattern "1111" used as the end-delimiter for the E.164 digit-string.

question_65547.question: What message is sent by the GGSN to the SGSNs in the list of downstream nodes parameter of the corresponding MBMS Bearer Context when a broadcast MBMS bearer service is started?
question_65547.ground_truth: The MBMS Session Start Request message containing the session attributes and the 2G/3G indicator.

question_65550.question: What is the role of the lease time in the management of PDU sessions in 5GC?
question_65550.ground_truth: The lease time is the duration for which an IP address is reserved for a UE in a PDU session in 5GC. It is chosen by the operator of the AAA server and stored in the PDU session context. SMFs of an SMF set share their contexts, allowing any SMF that may take over the control of the PDU session to determine if the lease time is approaching expiry and initiate a AAA re-authorization to renew the IP address.

question_65551.question: How is the co-location reference antenna defined for conformance testing?
question_65551.ground_truth: The co-location reference antenna is defined as a single column passive antenna with the same vertical radiating dimension, frequency range, and polarization as the composite antenna of the AAS base station. It should be placed at a distance d from the edge of the AAS BS.

question_65553.question: What is the format of USSD messages that are transported in SIP INFO requests, SIP INVITE requests, and SIP BYE requests in IP Multimedia Core Network Subsystem (IMS)?
question_65553.ground_truth: USSD messages are transported in SIP INFO requests, SIP INVITE requests, and SIP BYE requests in IP Multimedia Core Network Subsystem (IMS) using the application/vnd.3gpp.ussd+xml MIME body.

question_65555.question: What is the maximum number of Base Station RF Bandwidth for non-contiguous operation in UTC2?
question_65555.ground_truth: The Base Station RF Bandwidth consists of one sub-block gap and two sub-blocks located at the edges of the declared maximum Base Station RF Bandwidth.

question_65556.question: Which network operation can be provisioned in HPLMN per each VPLMN?
question_65556.ground_truth: VPLMN Specific Offloading Policy can be provisioned in HPLMN per each VPLMN based on the service level agreement between HPLMN and VPLMN.

question_65557.question: What are the main identifiable entities in use by the MCPTT Service?
question_65557.ground_truth: The main identifiable entities in use by the MCPTT Service are Mission Critical Organizations, MCPTT Groups, MCPTT Users, and MCPTT Administrators.

question_65561.question: When UE-2 receives a notification on PLMN-1, and it decides to accept the paging notification, what steps should it take?
question_65561.ground_truth: When UE-2 decides to accept a paging notification on PLMN-1, it indicates this to AMF-1 via a mobility registration message. In response, AMF-1 notes that the new PLMN will receive paging notifications on the user plane at IP-2 for UE-1. UE-2 then proceeds to execute a service request in PLMN-2, and PLMN-1 stops paging the UE on the control plane.

question_65562.question: What is the function of the Discontinuous Transmission (DTX) in the EVS codec?
question_65562.ground_truth: The Discontinuous Transmission (DTX) function in the EVS codec allows for the input signal to be encoded at a lower average rate by taking speech inactivity into account. This helps conserve UE power and improve network capacity.

question_65563.question: What action should a BSS take if it receives an IE with semantically incorrect contents within a RIM container?
question_65563.ground_truth: The receiving BSS should ignore that IE and treat the rest of the RIM container. If the rest of the RIM container can no longer be handled because this IE was ignored, the receiving BSS should send a RAN-INFORMATION-ERROR PDU containing the complete received PDU and with the RIM Cause IE set to "Semantically incorrect PDU" back to the originating BSS and discard the received PDU.

question_65564.question: What should the UE do when it detects consistent uplink LBT failure indication from SCG MAC in NR-DC?
question_65564.ground_truth: The UE should consider radio link failure to be detected for the SCG, suspend SCG transmission for all SRBs and DRBs, reset SCG MAC, stop T304 for the SCG if running, and initiate the SCG failure information procedure to report the SCG radio link failure.

question_65566.question: What message does the SS send to verify the call states of each call?
question_65566.ground_truth: The SS sends a STATUS ENQUIRY message in respect of the transaction identifier of each call.

question_65571.question: What does the NWDAF collect as input for Redundant Transmission Experience related analytics in the 5G network?
question_65571.ground_truth: The NWDAF collects UE mobility information from OAM, MDAS/MDAF, 5GC and AFs, as well as service data from AF and performance measurements on user data congestion. Additionally, the NWDAF collects information for PDU session established with redundant transmission from the SMF.

question_65574.question: How many cells are there in the test with one E-UTRA FDD carrier and two cells on the other E-UTRA FDD carrier?
question_65574.ground_truth: There are three cells in the test.

question_65575.question: What should be present in a FAILURE-INDICATION-E-UTRAN message sent by the PWS-IWF to the CBC?
question_65575.ground_truth: If the FAILURE-INDICATION-E-UTRAN message is sent by the PWS-IWF to the CBC, the Failed Cell List NG-RAN IE and the Global RAN Node ID IE shall be present and populated with the appropriate information.

question_65577.question: What is the external network type information element used for in the Interworking Security Data message?
question_65577.ground_truth: The external network type information element is used to identify the type of the network represented by the IWF.

question_65579.question: What is the purpose of the P-Asserted-Identity header field included in the outgoing SIP INVITE request set to the public service identity of the controlling MCVideo function?
question_65579.ground_truth: The purpose of the P-Asserted-Identity header field is to provide a way to assert the identity of the user sending the SIP request. In this case, it is used to assert the identity of the controlling MCVideo function.

question_65580.question: What state should the MCPTT client enter when it releases permission to send RTP media?
question_65580.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should enter the "O: silence" state.

question_65581.question: How can centralized information obtained from the MNO improve the monitoring of telecommunications service failures?
question_65581.ground_truth: Centralized information obtained from the MNO can assist in determining the cause of performance problems, improve the efficiency of measurements, and provide finer granularity even if the network performance seriously declines. It also helps in distinguishing if the problem is in the DSO's network or the MNO's network, and in acquiring data even as the network performance deteriorates.

question_65582.question: Which UE categories does the test applicability apply to for the E-UTRAN HD - FDD Intra frequency case for CE UE in enhanced coverage?
question_65582.ground_truth: The test applies to all types of E-UTRA HD-FDD UE release 13 and forward of UE category M1 and higher, including non-BL/CE UE, with support for CEModeB.

question_65583.question: What information concerning DUSK, DUCK, and DUIK is used in UE-to-UE relay discovery?
question_65583.ground_truth: In UE-to-UE relay discovery, DUSK is used to unscramble the direct discovery set, DUCK is used to decrypt the direct discovery set if included in the code-receiving security parameter, and DUIK is used to verify the MIC for the direct discovery set.

question_65584.question: When sending CFU information to a Phase 1 VLR, what action should the HLR take based on the logical state held?
question_65584.ground_truth: The HLR should convert the logical state held into a form that the VLR can accept.

question_65585.question: What is the minimum number of successful reported values to pass each test for carrier aggregation?
question_65585.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values in each test must be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_65588.question: What are the potential charging requirements for ProSe services in 5GS?
question_65588.ground_truth: The potential charging requirements include supporting converged charging and charging information reporting for ProSe Communication, collecting charging information from UE, identifying chargeable events, charging for PDU Session types of IP, Ethernet, and Unstructured, and charging for Layer-2 and Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay in the 5G system.

question_65589.question: What should be the format of the UE's request for file repair when the server only supports byte range requests?
question_65589.ground_truth: The Byte-Range-Based File Repair Request Message Format using HTTP/1.1 GET or partial GET requests.

question_65592.question: What services do mobile stations supporting Voice Group Call Service (VGCS) or Voice Broadcast Service (VBS) typically implement?
question_65592.ground_truth: Mobile stations supporting VGCS or VBS may implement the following services: VBS listening, VBS originating, VGCS listening, VGCS talking, and VGCS originating.

question_65593.question: What is the definition of the SL measurement reporting delay for UE report to LMF?
question_65593.ground_truth: The SL measurement reporting delay for UE report to LMF is the time between the moment when the measurement report is triggered and the moment when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface, excluding the delay uncertainty from inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH.

question_65595.question: What is the difference between the charging procedures described in 9ch-b1 and 2ch-b2a?
question_65595.ground_truth: The main difference is the type of charging information sent to the CCS. In 9ch-b1, the "UE allowed volume" is sent, while in 2ch-b2a, the "UE consumed volume" is sent.

question_65596.question: When should the Sender submit AMD PDUs to the lower layer for transmission?
question_65596.ground_truth: The Sender should submit AMD PDUs to the lower layer for transmission if the AMD PDU has a "Sequence Number" less than VT(MS) or the AMD PDU has a "Sequence Number" equal to VT(S)-1, and if the AMD PDU is not restricted to be transmitted by the local suspend function.

question_65597.question: What is the role of the UPFs in reporting bitrate to the PCF in Method 1 and Method 2?
question_65597.ground_truth: In Method 1, the UPFs measure the N6/N19 interface UL/DL throughputs for the S-NSSAI and report the average N6/N19 interface UL/DL bitrate per S-NSSAI to the PCF via the SMFs frequently. While in Method 2, the UPFs measure the N6/N19 interface UL/DL throughputs for the S-NSSAI and report the average N6/N19 interface UL/DL bitrate per S-NSSAI to the PCFs via the SMFs frequently. The PCFs store the latest received report from the UPFs in the UDR. Each PCF involved can read the latest report of all the UPFs in the slice from the UDR and calculate the actual data rate of the whole slice.

question_65598.question: What is the purpose of the "colour codes" in the independent definition of cells and TAs?
question_65598.ground_truth: The color codes are used to ensure unique cell IDs when a cell may not be wholly within a single TA. The color codes can be used to split a base cell that overlaps with multiple TAs into separate cell portions, allowing for a serving cell ID to be determined from both the base cell and the TA within which the UE is located. This ensures unique cell IDs as long as no two TAs that share part of the same boundary or vertex have the same color code.

question_65599.question: What is the objective of studying a simplified version of the HS-SCCH Type 1 for UMTS?
question_65599.ground_truth: The objective is to simplify the decoding of the HS-SCCH Type 1 for UEs undergoing bad radio conditions.

question_65600.question: What should the target BSS include in the SI/PSI messages if the MS supports network sharing and the target cell supports network sharing?
question_65600.ground_truth: The target BSS should include the same PLMN ID in the SI/PSI messages as the one received in the Target Cell Identifier IE in the PS-HANDOVER-REQUEST PDU.

question_65601.question: What is the impact of the network function NSQ on dynamic adjustment of data rate per slice?
question_65601.ground_truth: The NSQ performs dynamic adjustment of data rate per slice via NAS signalling, on reaching the allowed Slice-AMBR limit.

question_65602.question: What message does the gNB-CU send to the gNB-DU to initiate the procedure of allocating TNL addresses for IAB-nodes?
question_65602.ground_truth: The IAB TNL ADDRESS REQUEST message

question_65603.question: What is the primary classification of the work item regarding Energy Savings Management OAM?
question_65603.ground_truth: This work item is a Building Block.

question_65604.question: Which countries were the first to report issues related to spectrum subsets for Band n77?
question_65604.ground_truth: The issues related to spectrum subsets for Band n77 were first reported in the US and Canada.

question_65605.question: What is the test method for the immunity test in section 9.4.2 of the document?
question_65605.ground_truth: The test method is in accordance with IEC 61000-4-4, with a test level of 0.5 kV open circuit voltage for signal ports, telecommunication ports, and control ports. The test level for DC power input/output ports is also 0.5 kV open circuit voltage, and 1 kV open circuit voltage for AC mains power input ports.

question_65606.question: What is the definition of a "backward index" in the context of 3GPP networks?
question_65606.ground_truth: A "backward index" is a method used in 3GPP networks to store against a shared data value the list of identities (e.g. IMSIs) that share the shared data value.

question_65607.question: What should be considered when swapping across redundant tools in DASH?
question_65607.ground_truth: The content author offering the service redundant to the client, inserting periods at a swap instance, or sending a completely new MPD are considerations when swapping across redundant tools in DASH.

question_65609.question: What is the test purpose when the MS has to register to another GANC when it receives Registration Redirect as a response on the Registration Request message?
question_65609.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify that the MS can register to another GANC when it receives Registration Redirect as a response on the Registration Request message.

question_65610.question: What should the UE do if it has radio link failure or handover failure information available and the RPLMN is included in plmn-IdentityList stored in VarRLF-Report?
question_65610.ground_truth: The UE includes rlf-InfoAvailable in the RRCReestablishmentComplete message.

question_65611.question: What is the aim of the requirement in TS 22.261 that a 5G system with satellite access shall be able to select the communication link providing the UE with the best service options?
question_65611.ground_truth: The aim of this requirement is to ensure that the 5G system with satellite access is able to select the communication link that provides the best service options for the UE, in terms of bandwidth, connectivity, coverage, and other factors. This is important due to the unique challenges posed by satellite communication, such as high latency and limited bandwidth.

question_65612.question: What should the SGSN include in the Routeing Area Update Accept message if it decides to enable extended idle mode DRX for an MS that included the extended idle mode DRX parameters?
question_65612.ground_truth: The SGSN should include the extended idle mode DRX parameters information element in the Routeing Area Update Accept message if it decides to enable extended idle mode DRX for an MS that included the extended idle mode DRX parameters.

question_65616.question: What event occurs when the channel changes from idle to call C-B waiting?
question_65616.ground_truth: C releases the waiting call, causing the channel to change from idle to call C-B waiting.

question_65617.question: What action should an MRFC take upon reception of an RTCP feedback message with the "DBI" signalling and the "query parameter q" set to '0'?
question_65617.ground_truth: The MRFC may use the additional delay budget to improve the reliability of its outgoing media stream to reduce packet loss.

question_65618.question: What protocol is used between a SIP-I based CS CN and an Interworking Unit for signalling, where the underlying signalling transport is IP?
question_65618.ground_truth: The protocol used is IP (IETF~RFC~791 or IETF~RFC~2460), SCTP (IETF~RFC~4960), and SIP-I.

question_65619.question: What is the purpose of parameter provisioning in the SCEF?
question_65619.ground_truth: The purpose of parameter provisioning in the SCEF is to allow an SCS/AS to tell the network when a device is expected to communicate, so that the core network can create assistance information for the RAN and the RAN can minimize UE state transitions.

question_65620.question: What response is sent by the AS-hA1 to the S-CSCF-hA1 in response to the SIP INVITE request, including an answer to the SDP and with the P-Early-Media header field set to "sendonly"?
question_65620.ground_truth: The AS-hA1 sends a SIP 183 (Session progress) response to the S-CSCF-hA1 with an answer to the SDP, a P-Early-Media header field set to "sendonly" and the Require header field set to "100rel".

question_65621.question: What is the main objective of the new NEF service introduced in the solution?
question_65621.ground_truth: The main objective of the new NEF service is to provide provisioning of traffic characteristics and monitoring of performance characteristics applicable to each UE of a given group in 5GC.

question_65622.question: What is the difference between "shall" and "should" in the context of 3GPP documentation?
question_65622.ground_truth: "Shall" is a mandatory requirement and indicates that a specific action must be taken, while "should" is a recommendation and suggests that a certain course of action would be preferable.

question_65625.question: What should be the synchronization status of the UE prior to the start of time duration T1?
question_65625.ground_truth: The UE should be fully synchronized to cell 1 prior to the start of time duration T1.

question_65626.question: What is the use of the <mode> parameter in the PLMN selection command?
question_65626.ground_truth: The <mode> parameter in the PLMN selection command determines whether the network selection is done automatically by the MT or is forced by this command to a specific access technology or operator.

question_65628.question: What is the meaning of TS 35 in the context of 6.10.3.4.1.35?
question_65628.ground_truth: TS 35 refers to Transport Channel Parameters for Interactive or background / UL:384 DL:2048 kbps / PS RAB + UL:3.4 DL:3.4 kbps SRBs for DCCH.

question_65629.question: What is the response of the mobile station if it does not support the indicated mode?
question_65629.ground_truth: The mobile station retains the old mode and returns the associated channel mode information in the CHANNEL MODE MODIFY ACKNOWLEDGE message.

question_65631.question: What is the main challenge for using an intermediate frequency (IF) testing approach for NR RRM testing?
question_65631.ground_truth: The main challenge for using an IF testing approach for NR RRM testing is that it would exclude all components that operate at the radio frequency and the algorithms that control such components from the test.

question_65632.question: What is the purpose of the parameter SnonIntraSearchP in the context of 3GPP TS 38.304, clause 5.2.4.5?
question_65632.ground_truth: The parameter SnonIntraSearchP specifies the Srxlev threshold (in dB) for NR inter-frequency and inter-RAT measurements.

question_65634.question: What is the percentage of the estimated total emissions from human activity that the telecom industry, including both ICT and telecoms, accounted for in 2007?
question_65634.ground_truth: The telecom industry accounted for approximately 2% of the estimated total emissions from human activity in 2007.

question_65636.question: What must the CSP do when informed by a CSC that a communication service instance will cease to exist?
question_65636.ground_truth: The CSP has to check the communication service inventory, unassign the communication service instance from the network slice instance, and modify or terminate the network slice instance as required.

question_65637.question: What network functions in 3GPP 5G networks are used for launching Performance Management (PM) jobs to collect measurements?
question_65637.ground_truth: Performance measurement jobs in 3GPP 5G networks are launched from an application service consumer on network functions.

question_65639.question: What information is added at the end of each UDP payload to create FEC source packets in the streaming delivery service of MBMS?
question_65639.ground_truth: A 3-byte FEC source payload ID field is added at the end of each UDP payload to create FEC source packets in the streaming delivery service of MBMS.

question_65640.question: Are any changes required to the current requirements specified in TS 36.104 and TS 36.141 for BS capable of multi-carrier and/or CA operation in contiguous spectrum in a single band?
question_65640.ground_truth: No change is required as the current requirements are agnostic to the number of CC supported by the BS in intra-band contiguous CA operation.

question_65641.question: What is the role of the AMF in associating the PDU session with an additional S-NSSAI?
question_65641.ground_truth: The AMF determines if the PDU session needs to be associated with an additional S-NSSAI and provides the S-NSSAI to the I-SMF or SMF.

question_65644.question: How many failures are allowed for the PCS 1 900 frequency band 1 910 MHz to 2 010 MHz?
question_65644.ground_truth: A maximum of twelve failures are allowed for the PCS 1 900 frequency band 1 910 MHz to 2 010 MHz, with a restriction that if grouped, it should not exceed three 200 kHz channels per group.

question_65647.question: What is the challenge in achieving channel-based alignment in protection relays?
question_65647.ground_truth: The challenge is that the communication channels (from Relay-a to Relay-b, and from Relay-b to Relay-a) should be highly symmetrical regarding latency to achieve accurate time synchronization and correct differential current calculation.

question_65649.question: What is the purpose of the <seal-mbms-rohc> element within the <announcement> element and in which RFC is its use specified?
question_65649.ground_truth: The <seal-mbms-rohc> element within the <announcement> element indicates that the flows delivered by the announced MBMS bearer are header compressed with ROHC. Its use is specified in IETF RFC 5795 and 3095.

question_65651.question: What is the role of the timing advance command TA in this test procedure?
question_65651.ground_truth: The timing advance command TA is used to adjust the current NTA value. It is set to 31 in T1, indicating adjustment of the current NTA value, and to 39 in T2, indicating adjustment of the current NTA value by 128.

question_65652.question: What message type shall include the queue position and floor priority in the Queue Info field?
question_65652.ground_truth: The Floor Queue Position Info message

question_65653.question: When should the HSS include S-CSCF Restoration Information in the response message, instead of the Associated-Registered-Identities AVP?
question_65653.ground_truth: The HSS should include S-CSCF Restoration Information in the response message if it returns all the S-CSCF Restoration Information in the response, then the S-CSCF can ignore the Associated-Registered-Identities AVP and skip additional server-assignment-request since the information is already made available.

question_65654.question: What should the mobile station do if it receives an RLC/MAC block on the new assigned resources and timer T3190 has not yet expired?
question_65654.ground_truth: The mobile station should restart timer T3190.

question_65655.question: What does "DRC" stand for in the context of 5G Media Streaming?
question_65655.ground_truth: DRC stands for Dynamic Range Control, which is a function for backwards compatibility with AMR-WB in the EVS codec.

question_65656.question: What is the role of the Content Provider (CP) in the first use-case described in the document?
question_65656.ground_truth: The Content Provider in the first use-case is responsible for offering multiple camera angles of a sports match into stadiums. They negotiate service-related aspects like broadcast areas, times, and media quality with the network operator and use APIs or a self-service GUI for session and content provisioning.

question_65658.question: What is the role of a SIP proxy with regard to the Relayed-Charge header field?
question_65658.ground_truth: A SIP proxy that supports this extension and receives a request or response without the Relayed-Charge header field may insert a Relayed-Charge header field prior to forwarding the message, while a proxy that receives a request or response with the Relayed-Charge header field can use the values to produce charging records and modify the header field as needed.

question_65659.question: What action does the TSCTSF take when the UE is located within the Time Synchronization Coverage Area?
question_65659.ground_truth: The TSCTSF activates time synchronization service for the UE and creates a PTP port in the DS-TT.

question_65661.question: What are the 2 security mechanisms available for nodes communicating in different domains for protecting SRv6 user plane traffic?
question_65661.ground_truth: In the enhanced mode, HMAC or IPSec with AH can be used for nodes communicating in different domains. In the traditional mode, IPSec with AH can be used for securing inter-PLMN.

question_65662.question: What is the Time Alignment Timer in this test?
question_65662.ground_truth: In this test, the UE shall be provided at least once every 500ms with new Timing Advance Command MAC control element to restart the Time alignment timer to keep UE uplink time alignment.

question_65664.question: What should the 5G system support for a UE that is authorized to access multiple network slices of one operator which cannot be simultaneously used?
question_65664.ground_truth: The 5G system should minimize service interruption time when the UE changes the access from one network slice to another network slice.

question_65666.question: Which bands' 3rd order harmonics may fall into the BS receive band of Band 46 when the Band 39 BS is transmitting?
question_65666.ground_truth: The 3rd order harmonics of the Band 39 BS transmitting may fall into the BS receive band of Bands 46.

question_65667.question: What is the role of the MGW-Id in the network?
question_65667.ground_truth: The MGW-Id is information sent on the Nc interface to aid Media Gateway selection by the succeeding/preceding node. It is bearer independent and can be translated into a signalling address towards the appropriate MGW.

question_65668.question: What is a property of NF instances in a virtualized environment?
question_65668.ground_truth: In a virtualized environment, NF instances may be instantiated/torn-down dynamically, which means that the SBA shall allow to discover the NFs.

question_65669.question: Who is responsible for storing the Authorized IP QoS parameters per for each IP flow or bidirectional combination of IP flows?
question_65669.ground_truth: The PCRF is responsible for storing the Authorized IP QoS parameters per for each IP flow or bidirectional combination of IP flows.

question_65670.question: Who is responsible for adding its address in the GIADDR option and the assigned UE IPv4 address in the "Address Request" option when relaying a DHCPv4 Discovery message in the PMIPv6 tunnel to the PDN GW?
question_65670.ground_truth: The Serving GW acting as a relay agent

question_65671.question: What does the DL-GROUP-AMBR limit for group based policy control?
question_65671.ground_truth: The DL-GROUP-AMBR limits the aggregated bit rate to be provided for the PDN connections within a PCEF for all MTC devices belong to the same group in the downlink direction.

question_65672.question: What information is required to locate the cellular connection (USIM) at a Smart Grid asset?
question_65672.ground_truth: Accurate and updated inventory with the geographical location of the USIM at the Smart Grid asset is required for this purpose.

question_65673.question: What is the definition of low mobility for MTC Device?
question_65673.ground_truth: For low mobility MTC Device, it is studied how to reduce the frequency of mobility management procedures and how to optimize the paging. There are three scenarios: a) not move frequently and may move only within a small area, b) not move frequently but may move within a wide area, and c) not move normally, i.e. with fixed location.

question_65674.question: What is the requirement for enabling interactions of multiple API exposing functional entities between trust domains?
question_65674.ground_truth: The CAPIF should enable interactions of multiple API exposing functional entities between trust domains to allow for communication and usage of APIs across different trust domains.
