question_65676.question: Which value in MBMS-E-RAB-QoS-Parameters indicates preemption?
question_65676.ground_truth: Preemption is indicated by 7 in the MBMS-E-RAB-QoS-Parameters ProtocolIE.

question_65677.question: What message does the target SGSN send to the target RNC after the target RNC sends the Relocation Complete message to the target SGSN in a handover?

question_65678.question: How many CSI-RS resources must the UE be able to measure for FR1 and FR2 during each layer 1 measurement period for each intra-frequency layer in CSI-RS based L3 measurements in R16?
question_65678.ground_truth: For FR1, the UE must be able to measure at least 32 CSI-RS resources and for FR2, at least 32 CSI-RS resources.

question_65679.question: What network information can be exposed by the L-PSA UPF to the local AF in real-time?
question_65679.ground_truth: User path latency can be exposed by the L-PSA UPF to the local AF in real-time.

question_65680.question: What is the input format for the speech encoder in the GSM system?
question_65680.ground_truth: The input for the speech encoder in the GSM system is a 13-bit uniform Pulse Code Modulated (PCM) signal.

question_65681.question: What information should the SMF provide to the AMF during 5GS to EPS handover if direct data forwarding applies?
question_65681.ground_truth: The SMF should provide DL forwarding tunnel information to be sent to the source 5G-AN by the AMF if direct or indirect data forwarding applies. If direct data forwarding applies, the DL forwarding tunnel information should contain the E-UTRAN tunnel info for data forwarding per EPS bearer received from the MME.

question_65682.question: What action should the gNB-CU-UP take if the MC Bearer Context Status Change is set to "Suspend" in the MC BEARER CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message?
question_65682.ground_truth: If the MC Bearer Context Status Change in the MC BEARER CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message is set to "Suspend", the gNB-CU-UP shall suspend DL data transmission to the gNB-DU and buffer received DL data, triggering the MC Bearer Notification procedure to indicate DL data arrival.

question_65683.question: When can an UE send an event-triggered measurement report in R-E-UTRAN FDD?
question_65683.ground_truth: An UE shall not send any event-triggered measurement reports as long as no reporting criteria are fulfilled.

question_65684.question: Which message type is used by the NG-RAN node to request the release of the NG-U transport after a broadcast MBS session?

question_65686.question: What is the purpose of the USAT Interpreter system information partition in the Environment variable area of the SAT Interpreter?
question_65686.ground_truth: The USAT Interpreter system information partition in the Environment variable area of the SAT Interpreter is preloaded during the manufacturing process of the USIM or during the runtime of the USAT Interpreter and contains at least information about write access to the partition and read access of the partition.

question_65690.question: When constructing an UpdateGprsLocation-Arg message, under what condition should the 'add-info' parameter be present?
question_65690.ground_truth: The 'add-info' parameter should be present if a Terminal-Information AVP was present in the received NOR.

question_65691.question: What is the default behavior of a UE when roaming in a VPLMN that only supports SRVCC?
question_65691.ground_truth: If a VPLMN only supports SRVCC, the default behavior of the UE is not to autonomously attempt to (re-)select the E-UTRAN for the duration of the time the UE stays in a VPLMN and PLMNs equivalent to the VPLMN.

question_65692.question: What is the procedure for inter-system redirection to EPS without N26 interface if the UE supports a specific flag for PDN connectivity request during the attach procedure?
question_65692.ground_truth: The UE initiates the Attach with PDN connectivity request with request type "handover" if interworking without N26 is supported.

question_65693.question: What aspects of network performance other than throughputs may be impacted by enhancements to the small cell on/off procedure?
question_65693.ground_truth: Other potential network impacts include network coverage, legacy UE support, mobility, and energy consumption.

question_65695.question: What are the two RPS lists introduced in HEVC version 2 for inter-layer reference pictures?

question_65697.question: What is the purpose of the "permitted algorithms octet" in the "Encryption Information" element?
question_65697.ground_truth: The "permitted algorithms octet" in the "Encryption Information" element is a bit map that indicates the allowed encryption algorithms or no encryption for controlling any encryption equipment at the BSS.

question_65700.question: In the COMMON MEASUREMENT REPORTING procedure, if the Common Measurement Type IE is set to "UTRAN GANSS Timing of Cell Frames for UE Positioning", in the TUTRAN-GANSS Measurement Threshold Information scenario, when the Predicted TUTRAN-GANSS Deviation Limit IE is included, under what condition the Node B shall initiate the Common Measurement Reporting procedure and set n equal to zero?
question_65700.ground_truth: When the absolute value of Fn rises above the threshold indicated by the Predicted TUTRAN-GANSS Deviation Limit IE.

question_65702.question: Which network entities does the NSCE server communicate with over the NEF (N33) reference point?
question_65702.ground_truth: The NSCE server, acting as an Application Function (AF), communicates with 5G Core Network functions via the NEF (N33) reference point for interactions with PCF, NSACF, etc.

question_65704.question: In which situation would a collision of activation requests for Service 3 (UUS3) occur?
question_65704.ground_truth: A collision of activation requests for Service 3 (UUS3) occurs when there is an outstanding request for service 3 and a subsequent request is received from the remote user.

question_65705.question: What new stage 2 features were added in Release 17 for attestation and verification of MPS authorization?
question_65705.ground_truth: New stage 1 requirements were added for the attestation and verification of MPS authorization in Release 17.

question_65706.question: What are the two parts of the PSCH used to provide time and frequency synchronization for devices?
question_65706.ground_truth: The two parts of the PSCH used to provide time and frequency synchronization for devices are PSS (Primary Synchronization Signal) and SSS (Secondary Synchronization Signal).

question_65707.question: What is the size of the LOCI file in bytes?
question_65707.ground_truth: The LOCI file is 11 Bytes in size.

question_65708.question: What is the role of the IWF in the process of establishing a group call when an LMR user starts a call over the interworking group defined in the LMR system?
question_65708.ground_truth: The IWF is responsible for the identity conversion and protocol translation, sending the group call request to the appropriate parties and confirming successful group call establishment.

question_65710.question: What does the term "EIRP" stand for in the regional requirement notation?
question_65710.ground_truth: EIRP stands for Equivalent Isotropically Radiated Power.

question_65711.question: What are the main features of the MCData service?
question_65711.ground_truth: The main features of the MCData service are conversation management, transmission and reception control, communication release, and enhanced status.

question_65712.question: What is the term used to describe the interference that can occur when DL signals of an aggressor cell interfere with UL signals of a victim cell due to the atmospheric ducting phenomenon in TDD networks?
question_65712.ground_truth: Remote interference is the term used to describe this type of interference in TDD networks.

question_65713.question: When should an MS that is in CS/PS mode of operation perform the Combined RA / LA Update procedures during a periodic RA update?
question_65713.ground_truth: When the network operates in mode~I and the MS is engaged in a CS connection.

question_65714.question: What is an "IP-CAN session" as defined in the document?
question_65714.ground_truth: An IP-CAN session is an association between a UE and an IP network, identified by one or more UE IPv4 addresses/and/or Ipv6 prefix together with UE identity information and a PDN represented by a PDN ID. It incorporates one or more IP-CAN bearers and exists as long as the related UE IPv4 address and/or IPv6 prefix are assigned and announced to the IP network.

question_65715.question: What is the definition of "beam direction pair" as used in the document?
question_65715.ground_truth: A "beam direction pair" is a data set consisting of the beam center direction and the related beam peak direction.

question_65716.question: What is the maximum duration of the test for the test case of starting and stopping ciphering in the MS?
question_65716.ground_truth: The maximum duration of the test is 5 minutes, including 1 minute for any necessary operator actions.

question_65718.question: What is the minimum number of (error) events required for an early fail decision?
question_65718.ground_truth: For an early fail decision, ne should be greater than or equal to 7.

question_65719.question: What is the principle behind minimizing transmission delays in 5G systems acting as a TSN bridge?
question_65719.ground_truth: The principle is to adapt the sending times of the application function for UL streams and enable the application client to adapt its transmission times, so that the 5G system can provide independent delays for the CNC in the TSN network.

question_65720.question: What requirements does CCBS place on the Location Update procedure when the MS is monitored?
question_65720.ground_truth: CCBS places extra requirements on the Location Update procedure in the HLR when the MS is monitored. Refer to clause~6.4 for more details.

question_65721.question: How does the UE handle forced playout constraints policy during playback of a PSS service?
question_65721.ground_truth: The UE identifies SIP INFO messages containing forced playout constraints policy, extracts the policy from the message body, and stores it. During playback, the UE should not issue any RTSP request message that is not supported as indicated in the policy.

question_65722.question: What are the channel models required for NR FR1 and FR2 MIMO OTA testing?
question_65722.ground_truth: For NR FR1 and FR2 MIMO OTA testing, the required channel models to be measured are FR1 UMi CDL-A, FR1 UMa CDL-C, FR2 InO CDL-A, and FR2 UMi CDL-C.

question_65723.question: What happens when an emergency attached MS's periodic RA update timer expires in PMM-IDLE state?
question_65723.ground_truth: The MS enters PMM-DETACHED state and remains emergency attached to allow for subsequent emergency services without a need to emergency attach again.

question_65724.question: What should be the final state of the MS upon detecting a lower layer failure, while in CC-state U12, "Disconnect Indication"?
question_65724.ground_truth: The final state of the MS should be U0, "Null".

question_65725.question: What is the role of the MAC-d PDU Length field in this structure?
question_65725.ground_truth: The MAC-d PDU Length field in this structure indicates the length of every MAC-d PDU (Protocol Data Unit) in the payload of the HS-DSCH DATA FRAME in number of bits. The value range is from 0 to 5000.

question_65726.question: What are the two possible solutions for ACR service continuity planning update?
question_65726.ground_truth: The two possible solutions are modifying the ACR service after the launch (described in 7.6.2.1) and pausing the ACR services for a pre-defined time or till the detection entity decides to resume the ACR (described in 7.6.2.1 as part of the EEC-based modification procedure).

question_65728.question: What test procedure should be followed to test the behavior of the MS if the network rejects the GPRS attach procedure with the cause 'roaming not allowed in this location area'?
question_65728.ground_truth: The test procedure involves rejecting the GPRS attach with the specified cause, storing the LA in the 'forbidden location areas for roaming' list, and periodically searching for the HPLMN.

question_65729.question: What is the action taken by the 5GMSu AF in the third step of the ion scenario 5 call flow?
question_65729.ground_truth: The 5GMSu AF requests the 5GMSu AS to confirm the availability of content resources for egest.

question_65730.question: What is the effect of a PRS resource being across two sampling durations of N within duration on the measurement requirements?
question_65730.ground_truth: The measurement requirements do not apply for a PRS resource if the PRS resource is across two sampling durations of N within duration.

question_65731.question: What should the MGCF not indicate when sending requests or responses related to a dialog?
question_65731.ground_truth: The requirement for the precondition mechanism by using the Require header field.

question_65732.question: Which Release does the 6.2A test apply to in order to verify that the UE BLER of HS-PDSCH on each individual cell shall not exceed 0,1?
question_65732.ground_truth: The 6.2A test applies to Release 8 and later releases.

question_65733.question: What are the two features that the 5G system (with mobile metaverse services) is expected to support for distributed virtual environments (DVEs)?
question_65733.ground_truth: The two features are mobile metaverse media support among multiple users and user identity management.

question_65735.question: What procedure is followed by the ProSe UE-to-NW Relay and Remote UE in steps 1-4 of solution 6 for Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay?
question_65735.ground_truth: ProSe UE-to-NW Relay and Remote UE follow the procedures described in steps 1-4 in clause 6.6.2 Procedures, of solution 6: Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay, with the below enhancements for N3IWF support.

question_65736.question: In alternative 2 of the PDP context activation procedure, what is the role of the GGSN in sending a Connectivity Request message to the selected GGSN in step 2?
question_65736.ground_truth: The GGSN sends a Connectivity Request message (IMSI, APN) to the selected GGSN in step 2 to initiate the Network-Requested PDP Context Activation procedure.

question_65737.question: What action does the UE take upon receiving a 181 (Call is being forwarded) response?
question_65737.ground_truth: When several forked responses are received, the UE requests the "logical OR" of the resources indicated in the multiple responses to avoid allocation of unnecessary resources.

question_65738.question: How does haptic technology enable new services for telecommunication operators?
question_65738.ground_truth: Haptic technology enables operators to provide new services built upon haptic sense, provide a source of additional revenue, enrich existing services, and develop new services by extending existing ones with haptic sense.

question_65741.question: When should the SMF initiate the UE-requested PDU session modification procedure if the timer T3396, T3584, T3585 or the back-off timer is running?
question_65741.ground_truth: The SMF should initiate the UE-requested PDU session modification procedure after expiry of timer T3396, T3584 or T3585 or after expiry of the back-off timer when the timer T3396, T3584, T3585 or the back-off timer is running.

question_65742.question: In what circumstance does the network selection occur with a valid USIM in the UE when it is in a limited service state over non-3GPP access?
question_65742.ground_truth: The network selection occurs as defined in 3GPP TS 24.502 when a registration, network-initiated de-registration, or service request is performed.

question_65743.question: What does SHVC refer to in the context of 3GPP multimedia services?
question_65743.ground_truth: SHVC stands for Scalable High Efficiency Video Coding, a scalable extension of H.265/HEVC for 3GPP multimedia services that improves coding efficiency by employing inter-layer prediction.

question_65744.question: What should be included in an HTTP POST request message when requesting the creation of a new "Individual Data Reporting Provisioning Session" resource?
question_65744.ground_truth: The HTTP POST request message should include the request body with the DataReportingProvisioningSession data structure when creating a new provisioning session.

question_65747.question: What does the Information Service (IS) part of the CSIRP define in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_65747.ground_truth: The Information Service (IS) part of the CSIRP defines the semantics of the information and the interactions visible across the interface (Itf-N) between the managing system and the managed system. It specifies the information by means of Information Object Classes (IOCs) and the interactions by means of operations and notifications.

question_65748.question: What is the limit for the identifier size in the Targeted Discovery search using ProSe Communication?
question_65748.ground_truth: There is practically no limit for the identifier size in the Targeted Discovery search using ProSe Communication.

question_65749.question: What is the requirement for the PDSCH BLER using the transport format indicated by the median CQI0 - 1 and median CQI1 - 1?
question_65749.ground_truth: The PDSCH BLER using the transport format indicated by the median CQI0 - 1 and median CQI1 - 1 should be less than or equal to 0.1.

question_65751.question: Which parameters of the media adaptation management procedures can be determined during session setup and do not require management from outside?
question_65751.ground_truth: The maximum or minimum bit rate of speech and video codecs, and round-trip time (RTT) are some of the parameters that can be determined during session setup and do not require management from outside.

question_65752.question: What is the action taken by the SCC AS upon receiving a SIP INVITE, identifying the need to correlate it with a subsequent access leg?
question_65752.ground_truth: The SCC AS decides to split the session over PS and CS domains.

question_65753.question: What are the parameters in location estimate in LCS Authorisation Request?
question_65753.ground_truth: Location estimate may contain the same information as the LCS Identity request, i.e. the pseudonym of the target UE, if needed, Type of location, i.e. "current location", "current or last known location" or "initial location", Velocity of the UE, if needed, LCS capability sets of serving nodes, if needed, and Location estimate, if needed and available.

question_65754.question: What is the functionality of volume based charging for VoLTE services in P-GW?
question_65754.ground_truth: The P-GW collects charging information for VoLTE service through FBC which is applicable to VoLTE service data flows. This functionality is supported by the P-GW, with PGW-CDR keeping a record of offline charging data.

question_65758.question: What is the role of the SNSM-STATUS.request primitive in the SNDCP layer?
question_65758.ground_truth: The SNSM-STATUS.request primitive is used by the SNDCP layer to inform the SM sub-layer that the SNDCP cannot continue its operation due to errors at the LLC layer or at the SNDCP layer. The Cause parameter in the primitive indicates the cause of the error.

question_65759.question: What network function provides UE authentication services in the AKMA architecture?
question_65759.ground_truth: The AAuF (AKMA Authentication Function) is the authentication anchor that provides UE authentication services in the AKMA architecture.

question_65760.question: What does the UE initiate when one of the conditions listed in clause "Triggers for tracking area update" applies in the handover procedure?
question_65760.ground_truth: The UE initiates a Tracking Area Update procedure when one of the conditions listed in clause "Triggers for tracking area update" applies.

question_65762.question: What action does the H-PCF take if there are updated Service Parameters from the V-PCF in the roaming case?
question_65762.ground_truth: The H-PCF may take the Service Parameters obtained from V-PCF to generate URSP rules applicable in the VPLMN as specified in clause~4.15.6.10.

question_65763.question: What is the data type of the parameter "deltaLatitude" in the structure "RelativeGeodeticLocation"?
question_65763.ground_truth: The data type of the parameter "deltaLatitude" in the structure "RelativeGeodeticLocation" is integer.

question_65764.question: What is the role of the Packet Measurement Function (PMF) in the Access Network Performance Measurements?
question_65764.ground_truth: The Packet Measurement Function PMF is responsible for correlating measurement packets with the corresponding access type for accurate measurement results for each access. The PMF of the User Equipment (UE) side correlates the sent measurement request and received measurement response messages via the same access type, while the PMF of the UPF side correlates the sent measurement request and received measurement response messages via the same N3 or N9 Tunnel. The PMF of the UPF side also records the relationship between the RTT measurement result and the N3 or N9 Tunnel.

question_65766.question: In DCI format 1/1B/1D/2/2A/2B/2C/2D with CRC scrambled by C-RNTI or SPS C-RNTI, what should the UE do first to determine the TBS index?
question_65766.ground_truth: The UE shall first determine the TBS index using the procedure in Clause 7.1.7.

question_65767.question: How many dB link budget gain is shown for sub-PRB transmission with multi-slot aggregation in source R1-2008874?
question_65767.ground_truth: Around 0.8 dB link budget gain is shown for sub-PRB transmission with multi-slot aggregation in source R1-2008874.

question_65769.question: What is the test requirement for UCI block error probability in 8.3.13.1?
question_65769.ground_truth: The performance is measured by the required SNR at UCI block error probability not exceeding 1%.

question_65770.question: What are the two methods for the 3GPP network to support the delivery of IMS VoIP and IMS VoIP supplementary services to the LEMF for LI purposes?
question_65770.ground_truth: Intercepted IMS VoIP communications (e.g. IRI or IRI/CC) are delivered separately from other IMS services; Intercepted IMS VoIP communications are delivered as part of all other services.

question_65771.question: What was the order of degradation of a MNRU at 30 dB S/N compared to the original speech sample in the AMR codec mode tests?
question_65771.ground_truth: The order of degradation was not as bad as a being qualified as 'Slightly worse' in the 7-point CMOS scale.

question_65772.question: What are the available values for the "RSRP-RangeSL4-r13" field in the RS-Range information element?
question_65772.ground_truth: The available values for the "RSRP-RangeSL4-r13" field in the RS-Range information element are in the range of 0 to 49.

question_65773.question: What organization is responsible for defining SCTE-104 and SMPTE ST 2110-41?
question_65773.ground_truth: SMPTE (Society of Motion Picture and Television Engineers)

question_65774.question: What information should be included in the I1 Invite message when the ICS UE wants to add I1 control to an ongoing call?
question_65774.ground_truth: The I1 Invite message should include a Reason field set to hex "002" to indicate that augmentation is requested.

question_65775.question: What are some of the functions performed by the MB-UPF for multicast and broadcast MBS sessions?
question_65775.ground_truth: The MB-UPF performs packet processing of incoming downlink packets for multicast and broadcast flows, QoS enforcement, interaction with MB-SMF for receiving multicast and broadcast data, and delivery of multicast and broadcast data to RAN nodes for 5GC Shared MBS traffic delivery method.

question_65776.question: What is the role of the VAL server in relation to performance and analytics monitoring job creation?
question_65776.ground_truth: The VAL server sends a request to the NSCE server to create a network slice related performance and analytics monitoring job, indicating the required end-to-end network slice related data performance data.

question_65777.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 4.2.12?
question_65777.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in 4.2.12 is to verify for a CE UE that when the current and target cell operates on the same carrier frequency in normal coverage, the UE is able to search and measure cells to meet the respective intra-frequency cell re-selection requirements.

question_65779.question: What indicates the mapping of the MPRACH on a particular PDCH?
question_65779.ground_truth: The network indicates the value of the USF associated with the MPRACH on a particular PDCH in the notification message.

question_65781.question: What information is included in the NWDAF report parameters after analytics processing?
question_65781.ground_truth: The Analytics Reporting Parameters include event specific network attack detection analytics information with the corresponding attack detection and threat alerts respectively.

question_65782.question: What is the shared risk principle as defined in Recommendation ITU-R M.1545?
question_65782.ground_truth: The shared risk principle is a method for comparing measurement results to test requirements, where the measurement results returned by the test system are compared without any modification against the test requirements.

question_65783.question: What is the HTTP status code that the NSCE Server responds with upon success when the service consumer requests Network Slice Information delivery?
question_65783.ground_truth: The NSCE Server responds with an HTTP "204 No Content" status code.

question_65784.question: What is one solution for the MBMS use case from a video coding point of view for premium and normal video services?
question_65784.ground_truth: HEVC simulcast, where two independently encoded HEVC bitstreams representing the same video content, but with different spatial resolutions, are transmitted.

question_65785.question: What information should be included in the POST request in the Create service operation when a MA-PDU session is requested?
question_65785.ground_truth: The POST request in the Create service operation should include the indication that a MA-PDU session is requested when the UE requests a MA-PDU session.

question_65786.question: What does the 3GPP Anchor functionally do in the 2G/3G access system and LTE access system?
question_65786.ground_truth: The 3GPP Anchor functions as a functional entity that anchors the user plane for mobility between the 2G/3G access system and the LTE access system.

question_65787.question: What NAS timers and procedures are not stopped when the unavailability period is activated?
question_65787.ground_truth: Timers T3512, T3346, T3447, T3448, T3396, T3584, T3585, any back-off timers, T3245, T3247, the timer T controlling the periodic search for HPLMN or EHPLMN or higher prioritized PLMNs, and the timer T~SENSE~ controlling the periodic search for PLMNs satisfying the operator controlled signal level threshold are not stopped when the unavailability period is activated.

question_65788.question: What is the result of TERMINAL RESPONSE for sequence 1.3, step 4, in which the TIMER MANAGEMENT command is used with the qualifier "deactivate the Timer"?
question_65788.ground_truth: The timer is deactivated and the corresponding value is implied to be less than the value specified before deactivation.

question_65789.question: What action does the AMF take if the UE receives a Service Reject message with a specific cause value in the PLMN?
question_65789.ground_truth: The UE attempts to select a new PLMN.

question_65790.question: What is the purpose of the "RRC re-establishment procedure" for NB-IoT UEs?
question_65790.ground_truth: The purpose of the "RRC re-establishment procedure" for NB-IoT UEs is to establish an RRC connection with a target cell when the current RRC connection is lost due to radio link failure or radio link problem.

question_65791.question: What is done when the PoR is sent using SMS-DELIVER-REPORT but the Response Packet is larger than a single SMS-DELIVER-REPORT TP element?
question_65791.ground_truth: When the PoR is sent using SMS-DELIVER-REPORT but the Response Packet is too large, a single Response Packet is sent as SMS-DELIVER-REPORT with no additional data and immediate resubmission in a complete SMS-SUBMIT packet.

question_65792.question: What are the two methods of key transfer supported by GBA-Push?
question_65792.ground_truth: The two methods of key transfer supported by GBA-Push are Pull and Push.

question_65796.question: What should the IWF include in the Contact header field when sending a SIP 183 (Session Progress) response as the non-controlling role of a 3GPP MCPTT group?
question_65796.ground_truth: The IWF should include the g.3gpp.mcptt media feature tag and the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag containing the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt" in the Contact header field.

question_65797.question: What procedure does the SCC AS follow when adding new PS media to an existing IMS session with CS media and Gm Service Control?
question_65797.ground_truth: The SCC AS initiates a new session using the Gm reference point with ICS capabilities, establishing the Gm Service Control Signalling Path together with the media addition.

question_65798.question: What is the purpose of the Connectivity Credential Issuing Function (CCIF) in M2M communication?
question_65798.ground_truth: The Connectivity Credential Issuing Function (CCIF) is responsible for generating the credentials required for initial network connectivity of M2MEs. It supports the function of issuing preliminary credentials, such as preliminary IMSI numbers and preliminary keys, to M2MEs.

question_65800.question: How does solution #2 enhance E2E redundant transmission?
question_65800.ground_truth: Solution #2 introduces an enhanced E2E redundant transmission architecture and a traffic flow model for the SEALDD enabler layer.

question_65801.question: What are the initial conditions for beam correspondence for PC7 UEs?
question_65801.ground_truth: The beam correspondence requirements for PC7 UEs are applied under certain side conditions, such as the provision of downlink reference signals, maintenance of QCL between SSB and CSI-RS, and fulfillment of L1-RSRP measurement conditions.

question_65802.question: What is the expected response when roam is set to No?
question_65802.ground_truth: When roam is set to No, it is expected that the call will not be roaming.

question_65803.question: What is the difference between non-roaming and roaming cases in the 3GPP system?
question_65803.ground_truth: In the non-roaming case, the AAnF provides the IRI-POI function, while in the roaming case, the network-internal AF provides the IRI-POI function.

question_65805.question: What should the PCF do when there is a temporary slice with a limited lifetime?
question_65805.ground_truth: The PCF should get the information of the temporary slice, generate Route Selection Validation Criteria in the URSP, and the UE will release the PDU Session gracefully based on URSP.

question_65806.question: What is a security requirement for ProSe open discovery for mitigating replay and impersonation attacks?
question_65806.ground_truth: The system shall support a method to mitigate the replay and impersonation attacks for ProSe open discovery.

question_65807.question: What action should the V-PCRF take if it receives a CCR command for IP-CAN session establishment with the NBIFOM-Support AVP and NBIFOM-Mode AVP from the PCEF, and the H-PCRF supports NBIFOM feature?
question_65807.ground_truth: The V-PCRF shall forward the NBIFOM-Support AVP, NBIFOM-Mode AVP and RAN-Rule-Support AVP (if applicable) received from the H-PCRF to the PCEF.

question_65808.question: What is the purpose of TC4 in the context of testing multi-RAT operations with GSM for the transmitter?
question_65808.ground_truth: The purpose of TC4 is to test multi-RAT operations with GSM for the transmitter.

question_65809.question: What should the SCP include in the service response to the NF service consumer if it obtains an access token from the NRF with some access scopes indicated in the service request?
question_65809.ground_truth: The SCP may include the access token it has obtained from the NRF in the service response to the NF service consumer, by including the 3gpp-Sbi-Access-Token header, for possible re-use in subsequent service requests by the NF service consumer.

question_65812.question: When will the AMF include pending NSSAI in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
question_65812.ground_truth: The AMF will include pending NSSAI in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message when network slice-specific authentication and authorization is performed or ongoing for one or more S-NSSAIs in the requested NSSAI that was not included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

question_65813.question: What does CTFC stand for and what is its purpose in FLO mode?
question_65813.ground_truth: CTFC stands for Calculated Transport Format Combination. It is used to signal the transport format combination set, with every possible transport format combination being uniquely identified by one CTFC.

question_65814.question: What is the purpose of the Accumulated Call Meter (ACM)?
question_65814.ground_truth: The Accumulated Call Meter (ACM) accumulates the total units for both the current call and all preceding calls. It is essential for certain applications, and if the ACM is equal to or greater than the value of ACMmax, then all calls in progress, chargeable to the user, shall be terminated by the ME once the chargeable interval determined by the CAI has elapsed.

question_65815.question: What is rebuffering defined as in the context of media streaming?
question_65815.ground_truth: Rebuffering is defined as any stall in playback time due to any involuntary event at the client side in media streaming.

question_65816.question: What steps does the MS take if sequencing has been activated for the PTC, and it receives a GA-RRC PDU message from the GANC using the PTC?
question_65816.ground_truth: The MS shall increment the expected downlink GA-RRC PDU sequence number for each GA-RRC PDU message received from the GANC using the PTC.

question_65817.question: What should a controlling MCVideo function do if it receives a SIP MESSAGE request for emergency notification and an Accept-Contact header field does not include the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag containing the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcvideo"?
question_65817.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function shall reject the SIP request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response.

question_65819.question: What happens if the new donor gNB-CU cannot establish the N2 reference point with the UE-AMFs?
question_65819.ground_truth: The new donor gNB-CU indicates this to the MBSR, which then changes the TAC to broadcast during the full migration phase. This triggers the UEs to perform mobility registration and a new UE-AMF to be selected, resulting in a new 5G-GUTI allocation.

question_65823.question: What determines which FRMCS users will receive the railway emergency alert?
question_65823.ground_truth: The FRMCS system determines which FRMCS users will receive the railway emergency alert, based on a set of conditions provided by the initiator.

question_65824.question: What are the official colors of the United Nations?
question_65824.ground_truth: The official colors of the United Nations are light blue and white.

question_65826.question: What information can eNB1 use to determine the nature of the failure if the NB-IoT RLF Report Container IE is included in the RLF INDICATION message by eNB2?
question_65826.ground_truth: eNB1 can use the NB-IoT RLF Report Container IE to determine the nature of the failure if it is included in the RLF INDICATION message sent after successful re-establishment.

question_65827.question: What is the role of the ProSe Relay UE in the communication process between the End UE and the GCSE-AS?
question_65827.ground_truth: The ProSe Relay UE acts as a PS Relay, which is authorized by its MME to activate the ProSe Relay PDN. It is responsible for allocating the End UE a locally significant IP address and distributing data to the End UE using unicast or IP Multicast.

question_65830.question: What is the purpose of PIN ID?
question_65830.ground_truth: PIN ID is a unique value in PLMN that identifies the PIN. It consists of a string assigned by the PIN server and an identifier of the PIN server.

question_65831.question: What are the advantages of using periodic UE measurement logging for drive tests?
question_65831.ground_truth: Periodic UE measurement logging is more cost-effective and reliable, as it allows for measurements to be taken in inaccessible areas or indoors, and provides an extended coverage of analysis than just relying on cell-level statistics.

question_65832.question: What is the impact on performance from overriding USF bits in the EC-PACCH block on the DL in the network?
question_65832.ground_truth: Overriding USF bits in the EC-PACCH block on the DL negatively impacts the data block performance by around 0.2-0.3 dB, but the coverage improvement target of 20 dB compared to GPRS is still met.

question_65833.question: What is the role of the SS in determining the number of residual bit error events for the bits of class Ib in the test procedure?
question_65833.ground_truth: The SS determines the number of residual bit error events for the bits of class Ib by examining sequences of at least the minimum number of samples of consecutive bits of class Ib, taking only the bits from frames not signalled as erased.

question_65834.question: When can a remote UE stop monitoring Relay Discovery Additional Information?
question_65834.ground_truth: A remote UE can stop monitoring Relay Discovery Additional Information if the TMGI monitoring refresh timer T4104 has expired or the ECGI announcement request refresh timer T4106 has expired (depending on the information being monitored). The UE may instruct the lower layers to start or stop monitoring with an indication that the message is for relay.

question_65835.question: What is the considerations made to support user's privacy in positioning services?
question_65835.ground_truth: Positioning services should provide mechanisms to protect the UE's privacy and the privacy of the UE's user or owner, and be able to provide positioning services on demand without continuously tracking the UE's position.

question_65836.question: Which transport protocol is specified in the 3GPP Technical Specification for E-UTRAN M1 data transport (Release 17) for user plane interfaces between E-UTRAN and EPC?

question_65837.question: What UE actions are not required during UE specific CBW change?
question_65837.ground_truth: The UE is not required to transmit UL signals or receive DL signals during the time duration defined for UE specific CBW change.

question_65838.question: Which transmitter (Band 3 or Band 20) contributes to the 2nd and 3rd order IMD products that fall into the own Rx frequency of Band 7 in the 2nd and 3rd order IMD study?
question_65838.ground_truth: Band 3 and Band 20 contribute to the 2nd and 3rd order IMD products that fall into the own Rx frequency of Band 7.

question_65839.question: What is the first alternative band plan for the AWS-Extension band that meets the Basic interoperability requirement and complies with the FCC expectations for interoperability across AWS-1/3/4?
question_65839.ground_truth: Alternative 1 (70+70 MHz band plan) is the first alternative band plan that fulfills these criteria.

question_65840.question: What is the objective of the intent driven RAN energy saving approach?
question_65840.ground_truth: The objective of the intent driven RAN energy saving approach is to lower operational expense by decreasing power consumption in 5G networks, using intelligent mechanisms and analyzing optimal energy saving management solutions while maintaining service experience.

question_65841.question: What services are no longer required by a PLMN from Release 4 onwards?
question_65841.ground_truth: From Release 4 onwards, the following services are no longer required by a PLMN: synchronous Bearer Service non-transparent (BS 30 NT), Basic Packet access, and Teleservice Facsimile non-transparent (TS 61/62 NT).

question_65842.question: What is the conformance requirement covered in section 11.8.1.2?
question_65842.ground_truth: The conformance requirement covered in section 11.8.1.2 is clause 4.9.2.2 of TS 23.502, which specifies how to hand over a UE from a source 3GPP access to a target Untrusted non-3GPP access and how to handover a PDU Session from 3GPP access to untrusted non-3GPP access.

question_65843.question: What action should the Serving GW take if it receives additional downlink data packets for a UE while waiting for the user plane to be established and the buffer time DL Data Buffer Expiration Time has not expired?
question_65843.ground_truth: The Serving GW should buffer these downlink data packets and should not send a new Downlink Data Notification.

question_65845.question: What action is taken when the related call or call leg is terminated for any reason in the Active state and in the Release Pending State?
question_65845.ground_truth: A transition is made back to the Active state in the Release Pending State, and to the Finished state in both the Active and Release Pending states.

question_65849.question: What are the challenges of managing E-UTRAN and EPC networks in terms of Operations and Maintenance (O&M)?
question_65849.ground_truth: The challenges include increased network complexity, managing a greater number of network elements, reducing network complexity, and lowering operating costs.

question_65850.question: What does Solution 8 provide in terms of PCRF resilience?
question_65850.ground_truth: Solution 8 provides PCRF resilience by duplicating PCRF session state information to PCRF clients in opaque containers.

question_65851.question: What does NPDCCH repetition level represent for channel quality reporting?
question_65851.ground_truth: The NPDCCH repetition level, used in DL channel quality reporting, indicates the minimum NPDCCH repetition level that satisfies the target hypothetical NPDCCH block error rate for a specific channel quality measured on the anchor or non-anchor carrier.

question_65852.question: What is the noise level at the base station receiver, the additional interference caused by the repeaters out of band gain, in the uncoordinated and co-ordinated scenarios?
question_65852.ground_truth: In the uncoordinated scenario, the additional interference caused by the repeaters out of band gain is 0.3 dB, and in the co-ordinated scenario, it is 0.5 dB, at the 99% level.

question_65854.question: What information should be included in the SETUP message for a mobile originating call?
question_65854.ground_truth: The SETUP message should contain the called party address information and all the information required by the network to process the call, including the Supported Codec List information element.

question_65855.question: What triggers the de-authorization of a slice by the Slice-AAA, resulting in the release of all corresponding PDU sessions?
question_65855.ground_truth: The Slice-AAA indicates revocation of a slice authorization.

question_65857.question: What are the three error correction techniques for wireless channel in low-latency production?
question_65857.ground_truth: The three error correction techniques are Application Layer Forward Error/Erasure Correction (AL-FEC) which includes redundant coded bits in the bit stream, Automatic Repeat Query (ARQ) which involves retransmitting data that was not received, and Frame repair, an error concealment technique that interpolates undecodable video frames from successfully decoded frames.

question_65858.question: What is the potential risk if a UE's IMSI is transmitted too frequently?
question_65858.ground_truth: The user's permanent identity would not be protected, making it easier for an adversary to intercept and potentially use the IMSI for malicious purposes.

question_65859.question: What must the P-CSCF do before forwarding the initial INVITE request?
question_65859.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall respond to all INVITE requests with a 100 (Trying) provisional response before forwarding the initial INVITE request.

question_65861.question: What is the difference between the status of the UE's non-3GPP 5GMM instance and the status of the UE's 3GPP 5GMM instance?
question_65861.ground_truth: The status of the UE's non-3GPP 5GMM instance and the status of the UE's 3GPP 5GMM instance are independent and can be different in 5G systems.

question_65862.question: What measurements should be performed if the measObject is associated to UTRA-FDD?
question_65862.ground_truth: The corresponding measurements associated to neighboring cells on the frequencies indicated in the concerned measObject should be performed.

question_65864.question: When GPRS-IMS-Bundled authentication is in use, what is not expected to be received after sending a REGISTER request?
question_65864.ground_truth: A 401 (Unauthorized) response to the REGISTER request.

question_65865.question: What address is used as the source address when sending uplink data over the N6 PtP tunnel?
question_65865.ground_truth: The IPv6 prefix allocated for the PDU session plus the suffix assigned for the N6 PtP tunnel is used as the source address for uplink data.

question_65866.question: What happens if there is a failed RRC integrity check during RRC integrity protection?
question_65866.ground_truth: If a failed RRC integrity check is detected after the start of integrity protection, the concerned message will be discarded. This can happen on the eNB side or on the UE side. When the cause for integrity protection failure is not a context mismatch, such as a key or HFN mismatch, running a recovery procedure is necessary and unnecessarily adds load to the system. However, priority was given to a procedure that allows recovery from deadlock caused by context mismatch due to the lack of means for the UE to reliably detect the cause of integrity protection failure and the fact that the only identified consequence of active attack is limited to non-persistent DoS effects.

question_65869.question: What is the parameter that is tested for the EN-DC FR1 PSCell activation and deactivation delay?
question_65869.ground_truth: The NR PSCell activation and deactivation delay under EN-DC are tested.

question_65870.question: What is the format of an Anonymous NAI (Network Access Identifier) in the context of a Limited Service State?
question_65870.ground_truth: The Emergency NAI for Limited Service State takes the form of imei<IMEI> or mac<MAC> @ sos.invalid.

question_65871.question: How can the impact of small form factor be considered in the link budget calculation for uplink and downlink channels in Rel-17 RedCap SI?
question_65871.ground_truth: The impact can be reflected by optionally including a 3dB loss of antenna gain in the link budget calculation for FR1 bands.

question_65873.question: What is a Protocol Implementation Conformance Statement (PICS) proforma used for in the 3GPP specification?
question_65873.ground_truth: In the context of 3GPP, the PICS proforma is a document in the form of a questionnaire that, when completed for an implementation or system, states which capabilities have been implemented and the extent to which the implementation or system is conformant to the given specification.

question_65874.question: What is the potential new requirement to support the use case that a UE uses home network services and localized services at the same time?
question_65874.ground_truth: The potential new requirement is that a UE should be able to simultaneously connect to its home network and to a hosting network if both networks are available, e.g. to use its home network services and localized services at the same time.

question_65875.question: What information can be exchanged between the H-PCRF and a restarted V-PCRF for a home routed access?
question_65875.ground_truth: The H-PCRF sends up-to-date QoS rules and event triggers (per gateway control session) to the restarted V-PCRF.

question_65876.question: What should the UE do if the UE Radio Capability for Paging Information changes for either RAT?
question_65876.ground_truth: The UE follows the same procedures as if the UE Radio Capability changes.

question_65877.question: What are the three application areas in future electric-power distribution?
question_65877.ground_truth: Primary frequency control with up to 100% RES, secondary frequency control with up to 100% RES, and distributed voltage control with up to 100% RES.

question_65878.question: What is the role of the Security Gateway (SGW) in the GANC's control plane functionality?
question_65878.ground_truth: The Security Gateway (SGW) in the GANC is responsible for setting up a secure tunnel with the mobile station (MS) for mutual authentication, encryption, and data integrity.

question_65879.question: What are the four types of content that can be shared as Enhanced Call Information (ECI) between calling and called parties?
question_65879.ground_truth: Text, still image, graphic, and audio

question_65880.question: What should the P-CSCF do when it receives a Contact header field towards the UE?
question_65880.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall transparently forward a received Contact header field towards the UE when the Contact header field contains a GRUU or a media feature tag indicating a capability for which the URI can be used.

question_65881.question: When should the UE include an instance ID in the Contact header field?
question_65881.ground_truth: The UE shall include a "+sip.instance" header field parameter containing the instance ID if it supports GRUU, multiple registrations, has an IMEI available, or has a MEID available.

question_65882.question: What must the network indicate to the UE for the maximum data rate per UE for user-plane integrity protection supported by the UE for the lifetim of the PDU session?
question_65882.ground_truth: The network should provide the UE Integrity Protection Maximum Data Rate to the UE.

question_65884.question: Which service category lies within the five classifications and includes Mobile Broadband, UHD / Hologram, and High-mobility?
question_65884.ground_truth: The Enhanced Mobile Broadband category includes Mobile Broadband, UHD / Hologram, and High-mobility.

question_65885.question: What is the prerequisite for the handover procedure to be initiated?
question_65885.ground_truth: The handover procedure is initiated by the network and with the MS in a dedicated mode.

question_65889.question: Which type of NSAP addressing formats should be used for the AAL2 transport layer?
question_65889.ground_truth: The AAL2 transport layer uses the embedded E.164 or other AESA variants of the NSAP addressing formats ITU-T Rec. X.213 and ITU-T Recommendation E.191.

question_65890.question: What is the purpose of the NG-RAN in the AMF based Local LMF selection process?
question_65890.ground_truth: The NG-RAN supports positioning capability, such as location measurement and calculation, in the AMF based Local LMF selection process.

question_65891.question: What should the MCPTT client check to determine the success or failure of a sent remotely initiated private call request?
question_65891.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should check the value of the <remotely-initiated-call-outcome> element contained in the <anyExt> element of the <mcptt-Params> element of the <mcpttinfo> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body included in the received SIP MESSAGE request.

question_65892.question: Under what conditions shall the newly visited VLRn/SGSNn create an entry and store authentication vectors and current security context data?
question_65892.ground_truth: If the VLRn/SGSNn receives a user identity response with an IMSI, it creates an entry and stores any authentication vectors and any data on the current security context that may be included.

question_65893.question: What should a WT do if it cannot accept an Xw SETUP message?
question_65893.ground_truth: It should respond with an Xw SETUP FAILURE message with an appropriate cause value

question_65894.question: What is the total number of transceiver units that a BS type 1-O must support if it is declared to support more than 1 cell?
question_65894.ground_truth: If a BS type 1-O is declared to support more than 1 cell, the total number of transceiver units must be greater than 8* Ncells.

question_65895.question: What is a trust chain in the context of SBA architecture and certificate verification?
question_65895.ground_truth: A trust chain in the context of SBA (Service-Based Architecture) architecture and certificate verification refers to the sequence of certificates used to verify the identity of a TLS (Transport Layer Security) entity. In this trust chain, the root CA (Certificate Authority) serves as the trust anchor in a chain of trust within a security domain. All certificates in a security domain are signed by the root certificate directly or indirectly. Each security domain can have only one root CA, and it creates cross-certificates when operators make an interconnection agreement, allowing TLS entities of two different security domains to establish a secure connection.

question_65897.question: What action does the PGW-C take when it determines to stop the charging and usage monitoring actions for the PDN connection?
question_65897.ground_truth: The PGW-C sends an Sx session modification request message to the PGW-U and modifies all the Usage Reporting Rules within the PDN connection to indicate the usage collection shall be stopped.

question_65902.question: Which component sends the DL dropped data volume reports per PDU session to the AMF when the AN connection is released?
question_65902.ground_truth: The RAN, depending on the chosen solution, is responsible for issuing DL dropped data volume reports per PDU session to the AMF when the AN connection is released.

question_65903.question: What is the format of the privateIEs in the PrivateMessage definition?
question_65903.ground_truth: The privateIEs in the PrivateMessage is a SEQUENCE consisting of PrivateIEs that contain a list of PrivateMessage-IEs.

question_65904.question: What is the name of the padding pattern that uses higher order modulation to centralize user data symbols within the signal bandwidth of a burst?

question_65906.question: For which scenario is GBA based security used to facilitate the local communication between AA and BA?
question_65906.ground_truth: GBA based security is used in scenario 3 when the AA and BA use a local communication link to exchange the session ID token.

question_65907.question: What are the considerations when defining the scope of Media Service Enablers?
question_65907.ground_truth: When defining the scope of Media Service Enablers, the following considerations should be taken into account: the definition of the principal properties of Media Service Enablers, the definition of minimum and typical functionalities of Media Service Enablers, identification of possibly relevant stage-2 and stage-3 work for Media Service Enablers, and collection of relevant Media Service Enablers for normative work.

question_65908.question: What is the purpose of version numbering in the 3GPP technical specification document?
question_65908.ground_truth: The purpose of version numbering in the 3GPP technical specification document is to indicate the level of change and approval in the document. The first digit indicates the level of approval, the second digit indicates a change in substance such as technical enhancements, corrections, updates, etc and the third digit indicates an editorial only change in the document.

question_65909.question: How long does an elementary procedure requested by an initiating message have to provide a response message, if not otherwise specified?
question_65909.ground_truth: An elementary procedure requested by an initiating message has to provide a response message within 1 second, if not otherwise specified.

question_65912.question: What is the role of higher layers in midamble allocation for DL physical channels, other than the association for K=8 midambles?
question_65912.ground_truth: Higher layers or layer 1 explicitly assigns the midamble for all other DL physical channels.

question_65913.question: In step 7 of the procedure, what is the action taken if the ratio (NACK / ACK + NACK) is less than 0.1?
question_65913.ground_truth: The UE passes in this case.

question_65915.question: What should the UE do if lower layers indicate to calculate an NAS MAC?
question_65915.ground_truth: The UE should calculate an NAS MAC as specified in 3GPP~TS~33.401 and then provide the calculated NAS MAC and 5 least significant bits of the uplink NAS COUNT used to calculate the NAS MAC to lower layers. The UE should also increase the uplink NAS COUNT by one after the calculation of the NAS MAC.

question_65916.question: What message should the MS send to invoke an explicit call transfer between two active calls?
question_65916.ground_truth: The MS shall send a FACILITY message with a transaction identifier for either call and containing an ExplicitCT invoke component.

question_65917.question: What is the purpose of verifying the maxptime value in the formation of a valid RTP payload?
question_65917.ground_truth: The purpose of verifying the maxptime value is to ensure that the provisional RTP payload is not longer than what maxptime allows. If it is, the oldest speech frames are removed until the length of the payload no longer violates the maxptime value.

question_65918.question: What is used to map content to DASH segments in 3GPP VR distribution?
question_65918.ground_truth: The content is mapped to DASH segments using Adaptation Sets, which are included in a VR Media Presentation and documented in a DASH MPD.

question_65919.question: What should the UE do if the security check on the steering of roaming information fails and the UE is in automatic network selection mode?
question_65919.ground_truth: If the security check on the steering of roaming information fails and the UE is in automatic network selection mode, the UE shall wait until it moves to idle mode or 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication before attempting to obtain service on a higher priority PLMN.

question_65920.question: How does the NF Service Producer validate the accessed NF instance ID in the CCA?
question_65920.ground_truth: The NF Service Producer checks if the NF instance ID for which the access token was provided in the CCA matches the NF instance ID in the CCA. Additionally, it also verifies the authenticity of the service request using the SRV hash value and the protected HL headers.

question_65924.question: What is the state that the MCPTT client enters when it receives a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message and becomes a terminating floor participant in an ongoing call?
question_65924.ground_truth: The "S3: part of ongoing call" state.

question_65925.question: What is the command qualifier for expected sequence 1.8 and 1.9?
question_65925.ground_truth: The command qualifier for expected sequence 1.8 is "if not busy on another call" and for expected sequence 1.9 is "only if not currently busy on another call with redial".

question_65928.question: What multipath mitigation method is recommended for NR carrier phase positioning?
question_65928.ground_truth: At least the double differential technique with PRU is recommended for UE-based, and UE-assisted NR carrier phase positioning for eliminating the impact of the initial phases of the transmitter and the receiver.

question_65930.question: What message does the UE send if it needs to make an emergency call and it doesn't have credentials?
question_65930.ground_truth: The UE sends a correctly composed INVITE request for an anonymous emergency call and completes call setup.

question_65931.question: What actions should be taken when an IPv6 packet has a non-zero Segments Left field in the routing header?
question_65931.ground_truth: When a routing header with a non-zero Segments Left field is present in the IPv6 packet, the packet should be translated, and an ICMPv6 "parameter problem/ erroneous header field encountered" Type 4/Code 0 error message shall be returned to the sender with the Pointer field indicating the first byte of the Segments Left field.

question_65934.question: What action does the PCRF take when it receives from the AF an AAR command with a request for the MPS for DTS?
question_65934.ground_truth: The PCRF installs the event trigger for the MPS for DTS request using the corresponding procedures specified in 3GPP TS 29.212 if the AF requests the notification.

question_65935.question: What triggers the SMF to request Session Management Congestion Control Experience analytics from the NWDAF?
question_65935.ground_truth: Potential congestion conditions trigger the SMF to request Session Management Congestion Control Experience analytics from the NWDAF.

question_65938.question: For which types of access may the UE support the extended P-CSCF restoration mechanism?
question_65938.ground_truth: The UE may support the extended P-CSCF restoration mechanism for 3GPP access, TWAN, and untrusted WLAN.

question_65939.question: What are the main differences between the product specification and 3GPP 5G NRM in terms of network slice characteristics?
question_65939.ground_truth: The product specification provides more abstract and business-level characteristics of the product being offered, while the 3GPP 5G NRM defines more technical and standardized attributes and performance measurements for the network slice.

question_65940.question: What action should the SMF take if it receives TSCAI input information from the external GM in the time offset and cumulative rateRatio (when available) between external time and 5GS time?
question_65940.ground_truth: The SMF should correct the value of the burst arrival time and periodicy, and forward the derived TSCAI parameters per QoS Flow basis to the AN-RAN.

question_65942.question: What is the significance of the conducted output measurement for FR1 transmitter OFF power requirement?
question_65942.ground_truth: The FR1 transmitter OFF power is measured as the conducted output of the CLTA, no accurate measurements are required in the chamber itself, and the MU analysis of the TX OFF measurement is agnostic to the chamber used.

question_65943.question: What is the UE requirement for the TDD RSRQ relative accuracy test?
question_65943.ground_truth: For the TDD RSRQ relative accuracy test, the UE must support CA with Intra-band contiguous CA, Inter-band CA, or Intra-band non-contiguous CA.

question_65945.question: What is the effect of the timer Tcp expiring for a leg in a call and the condition "Release if duration exceeded" being true for that leg?
question_65945.ground_truth: When the timer Tcp expires for a leg in a call and the condition "Release if duration exceeded" is true for that leg, the leg ceases to exist.

question_65946.question: What is the purpose of the Call Forward All (CFA) service, also known as CFV or CFU, in comparison to other call forwarding services?
question_65946.ground_truth: The CFA service is unique in that it ignores the state of the endpoint and always forwards calls, whereas other call forwarding services take the endpoint's state into account.

question_65947.question: Which DSCP value should be used for the inter-operator interface for security reasons?
question_65947.ground_truth: The 3GPP-Negotiated-DSCP sub-attribute should not be used for an inter-operator interface for security reasons.

question_65948.question: Which HTTP method is used to delete a specific File Distribution in the VAE server?
question_65948.ground_truth: The HTTP method "DELETE" is used to delete a specific File Distribution in the VAE server.

question_65951.question: What happens when a multimedia session is transferred between two different access networks as per PS-PS session continuity scenario?
question_65951.ground_truth: All or some ongoing media components in the source access network are transferred to the target access network. If it's not possible or not desired to transfer all media, part of the media components are transferred, and the remaining component(s) are released or kept.

question_65952.question: What is the role of the H(e)NB policy function in the context of 3GPP-BBF interworking for H(e)NB access?
question_65952.ground_truth: The H(e)NB policy function performs control based on bearers (EPS bearers or PDP contexts) made visible to it, and requests BPCF for admission control in the BBF network. When using the S9a interface, the BPCF uses this information to identify the BNG the H(e)NB connects to and perform admission control based on bandwidth requirements and QoS attributes.

question_65954.question: What should the SGSN do if Direct Tunnel cannot be maintained during a Routeing Area Update in an intra-SGSN SRNS Relocation?
question_65954.ground_truth: The SGSN needs to re-establish RABs and initiate the Update PDP Context procedure to update the IP Address and TEID for Uplink and Downlink data.

question_65955.question: Which network manages the minimum duration timing and minimum interval timing in procedure "Send DTMF" and "Stop DTMF"?
question_65955.ground_truth: The MGW manages these timings for sending and stopping DTMF.

question_65956.question: What is the condition for PUSCH scheduling in 6.3.4.4.4.2-1?
question_65956.ground_truth: Every 10 sub-frames (10ms) schedule the UE's PUSCH data transmission for 1 sub-frame (1ms) and transmit 0 dB TPC command for PUSCH via the PDCCH to make the UE transmit PUSCH.

question_65957.question: What actions should the MCVideo client perform on receiving a Transmission End Request message from the associated transmission participant?
question_65957.ground_truth: The MCVideo client shall send a Transmission control Ack message, forward the Transmission End Request message to the general transmission control operation state machine of the transmission control arbitration logic in the MCVideo server, and remain in the 'U: permitted' state.

question_65960.question: How does multi-level MCS allocation for SVC coded layers affect the channel capacity compared to single MCS AVC transmission?
question_65960.ground_truth: Multi-level MCS allocation for SVC coded layers increases the channel capacity compared to single MCS AVC transmission for a given constant bitrate.

question_65961.question: What is the UE required to measure, in terms of the number of carriers used for 1.28 Mcps TDD cells, before evaluating that a 1.28 Mcps TDD cell has become better ranked than the serving cell within NcarrierNTDD * TevaluateNTDD?
question_65961.ground_truth: The UE is required to measure the UE shall filter PCCPCH RSCP measurements of each measured 1.28 Mcps TDD cell using at least 2 measurements, which are taken so that the time difference between the first measurement and the last measurement used for filtering is at least TmeasureNTDD/2.

question_65962.question: What is the maximum allowed handover delay for an unknown target cell?
question_65962.ground_truth: The maximum allowed handover delay for an unknown target cell is 130 ms in this test case, which gives a total of 15 ms for maximum RRC procedure delay plus 115 ms for Tinterrupt.

question_65963.question: What protocols does the potential new NF need to support for the "P-AKA'" authentication method?
question_65963.ground_truth: The potential new NF needs to support the PANA and EAPoL protocols since the authentication method is EAP-AKA' and UP PDU sessions are of the IP or Ethernet type respectively.

question_65964.question: What should the MME do when it receives a GTP error indication from a SGW?
question_65964.ground_truth: The MME should delete its bearer context and may notify the Operation and Maintenance network element. The MME should also deactivate the corresponding PDN connection towards the UE with the cause "re-activation required", or initiate an explicit detach with reattached required procedure as appropriate.

question_65965.question: What is the concept of "managed alarm" in 3GPP and what is its purpose?
question_65965.ground_truth: A "managed alarm" is the management representation of the alarm in the NM domain. Its purpose is to include added states and other information that relate to the alarm management process, allowing the operator to enrich the information for preventing or mitigating network and service outage and degradation. It applies to any severity level.

question_65966.question: What happens if late DNS handling occurs, and the SMF notifies back to LDNSR?
question_65966.ground_truth: When late DNS handling occurs and the SMF notifies back to LDNSR, the DNS processing resumes, and any further DNS query is forwarded for resolution without LDNSR intervention.

question_65968.question: What action does the SS take when the measurement reporting delay is less than 3842ms in this procedure?
question_65968.ground_truth: The SS increases the number of successful tests by one if the measurement reporting delay is less than 3842ms.

question_65970.question: What information is carried in the SRP message for a DL Stream in the 5GS network?
question_65970.ground_truth: The SRP message for a DL Stream in the 5GS network carries the Stream ID, DataFrameParameters, UserToNetworkRequirements, AccumulatedLatency, and TrafficSpecification.

question_65971.question: What is the size of the Code Phase Search Window for both GNSS-AcquisitionAssistances (BDS B1I and BDS B1C)?
question_65971.ground_truth: The Code Phase Search Window is derived for each satellite using a 3 km radius UE position uncertainty for both GNSS-AcquisitionAssistances.

question_65972.question: What information does the UE include in the IE "UE positioning Position Estimate Info" when it calculates a position using a standalone positioning method in step 3?
question_65972.ground_truth: The UE includes the IE "UE positioning Position Estimate Info" and sets the contents as specified, including the SFN when the position was determined, the UE GPS timing of cell frames, and the UE Positioning GPS Reference Time Uncertainty, among other information.

question_65973.question: What is the initial state of the MS in the simulator scenario?
question_65973.ground_truth: The MS is in the state GA-RC DEREGISTERED.

question_65974.question: What is the condition that should be met for stereo in the psychoacoustic model to use Mid/Side Stereo coding?
question_65974.ground_truth: The condition is that the absolute value of the energy difference between the left and right channels divided by the sum of their energies should be less than 3%.

question_65975.question: What security mechanism is used in EAP-AKA method for secure key exchange and authorization between entities?
question_65975.ground_truth: AKA protocol, which can resist attacks like replay, eavesdropping, tampering, etc.

question_65976.question: At which bitrate is the LTP gain reduced in the TCX coding mode in the EVS encoder?
question_65976.ground_truth: The LTP gain is reduced at 48 kbps in the TCX coding mode for the EVS encoder

question_65978.question: What changes are necessary to introduce header compression for media streams transported over MBMS managed and processed at the application layer?
question_65978.ground_truth: The necessary changes include adding the ROHC component in the media distribution function in the MCPTT server and media mixer in the MCPTT UE, adding information about ROHC in the MBMS bearer announcement message, and specifying the processing of received data packets over MBMS in the MCPTT UE to take possible header compression into account.

question_65979.question: What is the OTA CACLR limit for an E-UTRA AAS BS of Wide Area BS class in Category B?
question_65979.ground_truth: The OTA CACLR limit for an E-UTRA AAS BS of Wide Area BS class in Category B is -6 dBm/MHz.

question_65980.question: What is the scaling parameter in the loudness tool, which sets the relation between the digital signal level and the assumed acoustic presentation level, called?

question_65981.question: When are the requirements in NR DAPS handover clause applicable?
question_65981.ground_truth: The requirements in this clause are applicable to DAPS handover to change the NR PCell to another NR cell, given certain conditions.

question_65982.question: What should a UE include in the BID identifier mobility option of the Binding Update message when requesting a flow handover?
question_65982.ground_truth: When requesting a flow handover, a UE should include a BID identifier mobility option in the Binding Update with the UE-assigned BID field identifying the routing address that the UE wants to use to exchange the packets matching the routing filters.

question_65983.question: When should the PLMN BC parameter Intermediate Rate be set to 16 kbit/s, 8 kbit/s, and "unknown", respectively?
question_65983.ground_truth: The PLMN BC parameter Intermediate Rate should be set to 16 kbit/s if the user rate is 9.6 or 12 kbit/s and the connection element is "transparent", 8 kbit/s if the user rate is 9.6 kbit/s and the connection element is "non-transparent", and "unknown" if the user rate value is "unknown" and any value can be used.

question_65984.question: What indicates which of the code groups the cell's downlink scrambling code belongs to in the Secondary SCH?
question_65984.ground_truth: The SSC (Secondary Synchronisation Codes) in the Secondary SCH indicate which of the code groups the cell's downlink scrambling code belongs to.

question_65985.question: What happens when a message recording is completed successfully in 3GPP TS 26.244?
question_65985.ground_truth: If the message recording is successful, the MRFP shall save the recorded content to the specified URI. If the message recording is not successful, the MRFP shall discard the recorded content. The MRFP shall then notify the message recording completion event to the MRFC. The cause of the message recording completion may be that the maximum record time has elapsed, or the message recording is not successful. The MRFC may indicate to the AS that the message record has been stopped.

question_65986.question: What is one potential solution to avoid being forwarded to a voice mail server if a redial attempt is unsuccessful?
question_65986.ground_truth: One potential solution to avoid being forwarded to a voice mail server if a redial attempt is unsuccessful is for the A party to signal (e.g. by appending a suffix to the dialled digits) to MSC-A that call forwarding should be inhibited. However, this requires support from both the UE and the MSC-A to implement.

question_65987.question: What is the role of the Federated Network Information Model (FNIM) concept in the present document?
question_65987.ground_truth: The Federated Network Information Model (FNIM) concept is supported in the present document, with the relevant Information Object Classes (IOCs) defined in the document being directly or indirectly inherited from those specified in the Umbrella Information Model (UIM) of 3GPP TS 28.620.

question_65988.question: What channel is received by all mobile stations within a cell for the worst path loss?
question_65988.ground_truth: The PBCH modulation and coding is designed to cater for the worst path loss, hence the same channel is received by all mobile stations within a cell.

question_65990.question: How does the MSGin5G UE-2 communicate with the MSGin5G Server if the MSGin5G UE-2 is a constrained device that does not connect to the 3GPP network directly for message exchange with the MSGin5G Server?
question_65990.ground_truth: The MSGin5G UE-2 can use an MSGin5G UE-1 as a relay to communicate with the MSGin5G Server, or interact with an MSGin5G Gateway UE which supports MSGin5G Gateway Client.

question_65991.question: What should the UE do when a higher priority NG-RAN HPLMN becomes available while camped on an NR VPLMN cell?
question_65991.ground_truth: The UE should select and camp on a cell of the HPLMN and attempt registration on the selected cell when the higher priority PLMN search timer T expires.

question_65993.question: What is the result of the DRA dropping or rejecting answers to messages originated by the PCRF when it is overloaded in the PA2 mode?
question_65993.ground_truth: This can result in timeouts at the client without the knowledge of the PCRF, potentially causing session state mismatches, improper charging, usage monitoring, QoS issues, or failed triggering procedures.

question_65994.question: What is the purpose of the MCPTT functional alias resolution request message?
question_65994.ground_truth: The MCPTT functional alias resolution request message is used by the MCPTT server to resolve a functional alias to the corresponding MCPTT ID for which the functional alias is active. The message is sent to the MCPTT FA controlling server 1, which determines the MCPTT service provider and forwards the message to the corresponding MCPTT FA controlling server to resolve the functional alias.

question_65995.question: What 2GPP bands need to be considered when analyzing the intermodulation products caused by a carrier aggregation of Band 3 and Band 32?
question_65995.ground_truth: The 2nd order IMD products of this carrier aggregation may not fall into any of the BS receiver bands of 3GPP bands. However, the 3rd order IMD products may fall into the BS receive bands of Bands 1, 2, 3, 9, 10, 11, 21, 25, 30, 33, 35, 37, 39, 40, 45, 65 and 66. When the maximum bandwidth is considered, the 3rd order IMD products do not fall into the BS receive bands of Bands 1, 3, 9, 10, 33, 37, 65 and 66.

question_65996.question: What should be the setting of the split block field in the header for retransmitted RLC data blocks using two radio blocks with MCS4, MCS-5, MCS-6, UAS-7, UAS-8, UAS-9, UAS-10, or UAS-11?
question_65996.ground_truth: The split block field in the header for retransmitted RLC data blocks using two radio blocks with MCS4, MCS-5, MCS-6, UAS-7, UAS-8, UAS-9, UAS-10, or UAS-11 should be set to indicate that the RLC data block is split, and the order of the two parts.

question_65998.question: When must the UE not consider an E-UTRA neighbor cell in cell reselection?
question_65998.ground_truth: The UE must not consider an E-UTRA neighbor cell in cell reselection if it is indicated as not allowed in the measurement control system information of the serving cell.

question_65999.question: What should the MCVideo client do if it receives a SIP 2xx response to a SIP request for a priority group call and the MCVideo emergency group call state is set to "MVEGC 2: emergency-call-requested" or "MVEGC 3: emergency-call-granted"?
