question_65999.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should set the MCVideo client emergency group state of the group to "MVEG 2: in-progress", set the MCVideo emergency group call state to "MVEGC 3: emergency-call-granted", and set the MCVideo imminent peril group call state to "MVIGC 1: imminent-peril-capable" and the MCVideo imminent peril group state to "MVIG 1: no-imminent-peril" if the SIP 2xx response to the SIP request for a priority group call does not contain a Warning header field as specified in clause 4.4 with the warning text containing the mcvideo-warn-code set to "149".

question_66000.question: What action should the UE take when it receives the Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming" or "5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service" IE in the REGISTRATION REJECT message and if the TAI(s) included in the IE is not part of the corresponding list?
question_66000.ground_truth: The UE should store the TAI(s) included in the IE, if not already stored, into the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming" or "5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service".

question_66002.question: What is one potential solution to avoid any specification impact when reducing bandwidth?
question_66002.ground_truth: Introduce a low bandwidth carrier for MTC UEs, and all MTC UEs are served by this carrier while non-MTC UEs utilize the bandwidth associated with the other carrier(s) using Carrier Aggregation.

question_66003.question: What applicability conditions are specified for the 2UL CA test case in the document?
question_66003.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of NR UE release 15 and forward that supports FR2 2UL CA.

question_66004.question: What is the purpose of the 5G ProSe direct link re-keying procedure?
question_66004.ground_truth: The purpose is to derive a new K~NRP-sess~ and, optionally, a new K~NRP~ for an existing 5G ProSe direct link that is not between 5G ProSe remote UE and 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE.

question_66005.question: What is used to determine the priority index for a PUSCH transmission with semi-persistent CSI report?
question_66005.ground_truth: A priority indicator field, if provided, in a DCI format that activates the semi-persistent CSI report.

question_66006.question: What is Key Issue #1 in the context of security aspects related to enhanced Network Slices?
question_66006.ground_truth: Key Issue #1 is to study how to perform Network Slice Access authentication and authorization specific for the Network Slice Access authentication that uses User Identities and Credentials different from the 3GPP SUPI and takes place after the primary authentication. The key issue addresses access control to Network Slices and how the UE and the Network know when additional authorization and authentication are required.

question_66007.question: Who does the MCPTT server send the MCPTT first-to-answer call request to in the case of a call with multiple potential target recipients?
question_66007.ground_truth: The MCPTT server sends an MCPTT first-to-answer call request to each potential target recipient, including those identified by a functional alias who have activated the alias.

question_66008.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon receiving a SIP INVITE message for a locally initiated MCVideo ambient viewing call, if the MCVideo user has not restricted the reason for failure and the MCVideo client does not have enough resources to handle the call?
question_66008.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should reject the SIP INVITE request with an appropriate reject code and warning texts indicating that it does not have enough resources to handle the call.

question_66009.question: What is the range of the RSSI measurement reporting defined in Clause 10.1.34.3?
question_66009.ground_truth: The reporting range of RSSI measurement is defined from -100 dBm to -25 dBm with 1 dBm resolution.

question_66012.question: What is the formula for calculating the energy efficiency of an NFVI platform with a VNF deployed under service capacity level i?

question_66013.question: What actions should the ProSe Function in the Local PLMN or VPLMN take when receiving a ProSe Direct Discovery Authorization request?
question_66013.ground_truth: When receiving a ProSe Direct Discovery Authorization request, the ProSe Function in the Local PLMN or VPLMN should check the value of the Discovery Type. Depending on the value, the ProSe Function will check if the UE is authorized to announce in the respective PLMN and respond accordingly with the appropriate result code. The ProSe Function must also store the UE identity and ProSe Validity Timer to perform charging. If no ProSe Application Code is included in the request, the ProSe Function must remove the discovery entry associated with the Discovery Entry ID for the requesting UE.

question_66014.question: What is the purpose of the registrar function provided by the registrar / application service selection functional entity?
question_66014.ground_truth: The registrar function (with integral provision of a location server) registers the user and maintains the association of the location and identity of the user in a location service. It provides notifications of the registration states and supports authentication for identities provided within SIP signalling.

question_66015.question: What action shall the gNB-DU take if the Network Controlled Repeater Authorized IE is set to "not authorized" in the UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message?
question_66015.ground_truth: If the Network Controlled Repeater Authorized IE is set to "not authorized", the gNB-DU shall, if supported, initiate actions to ensure that the UE is no longer accessing as a Network Controlled Repeater.

question_66016.question: What are the two procedures involved in addressing Key Issue #6: Avoiding UE to Switch away from EC PDU Session?
question_66016.ground_truth: The two procedures involved are determining what EAS traffic is targeted for avoidance of switching away from the 5GS for edge computing service and indicating to the UE such determination and related information for the targeted application traffic to prevent switching away from the PDU Session used for edge computing when connectivity outside 5GS becomes available.

question_66017.question: What is the format of the SID leaf in the 5.4.22 policy rule?
question_66017.ground_truth: The format of the SID leaf in the 5.4.22 policy rule is a chr (character) type with an occurrence of One.

question_66018.question: What is the effect of CSIPTO on the 3GPP system in terms of PDN connections?
question_66018.ground_truth: CSIPTO requires the ability to establish and simultaneously use two PDN connections with the same PDN, with each connection using a separate packet gateway.

question_66021.question: What are the two main scenarios of multipath in the context of GNSS?
question_66021.ground_truth: The two main scenarios are Multipath without blockage (Line-of-Sight, LOS) and Multipath with blockage or shadowing (Non-Line of Sight, NLoS).

question_66022.question: What is the procedure followed for security mechanism selection between SEPPs for protecting NF service-related signalling over N32?
question_66022.ground_truth: The procedure for security mechanism selection between SEPPs for protecting NF service-related signalling over N32 allows SEPPs to negotiate which security mechanism to use, providing robustness and future-proofness, e.g. in case new algorithms are introduced in the future.

question_66023.question: What must the mobile station do if the emergency number list is received from the network?
question_66023.ground_truth: The mobile station shall store the Local Emergency Numbers List, as provided by the network, and use the stored list to detect that the number dialled is an emergency number in addition to the emergency numbers stored on the SIM/USIM or ME.

question_66024.question: What is the definition of "Local service" and "Hosting network" in the present document?
question_66024.ground_truth: "Local service" is a service that is localized and/or can be bounded in time, realized via applications or connectivity. "Hosting network" is a network providing access to Local/Localized services.

question_66025.question: What is the function of the AF in supporting secure MBS traffic delivery between the UE and the NG-RAN?
question_66025.ground_truth: The AF requests activation of an MBS bearer by sending an Activate MBS Bearer Request message to the NEF/MBSF. This triggers the MBS session to be activated, which results in the distribution of MBS security context data to the AMF and the RAN.

question_66027.question: What is the role of the MGCF for supporting provision of CSI terminating session?
question_66027.ground_truth: No specific role has been identified for the MGCF, any CSI capability related information provided to the MGCF will not be interworked.

question_66028.question: What types of packet filters are supported for unicast mode 5G ProSe direct communication over PC5?
question_66028.ground_truth: Three types of packet filters are supported for unicast mode 5G ProSe direct communication over PC5: the ProSe IP packet filter set, the ProSe packet filter set, and the ProSe Ethernet packet filter set.

question_66029.question: What is the definition of OSA in the context of 3GPP specifications?
question_66029.ground_truth: OSA, in the context of 3GPP specifications, is an architecture that enables application developers to make use of network functionality through an open standardized interface, i.e. the OSA APIs.

question_66031.question: How much attenuation is required for the external, post-PA filter to provide for 1 dB receiver desensitization due to UE PA OOBE?
question_66031.ground_truth: The external, post-PA filter should provide an additional isolation of 34.9 dB.

question_66035.question: What should the UE do if it receives a request for an access attempt in 5GMM-IDLE mode and has uplink user data pending for one or more PDU sessions?
question_66035.ground_truth: The UE shall indicate the respective PDU sessions in the Uplink data status IE, regardless of the access category for which the access barring check is performed.

question_66036.question: What is the purpose of the security measure in R-5.12-001 of the MCX Service?
question_66036.ground_truth: The purpose of this security measure is to ensure the confidentiality and integrity of all user traffic and signaling at the application layer in the MCX Service.

question_66037.question: In the 3GPP network architecture, what feature-capability indicator does the P-CSCF include in the REGISTER request if it supports priority sharing?
question_66037.ground_truth: The P-CSCF includes the g.3gpp.priority-share feature-capability indicator in the Feature-Caps header field in the REGISTER request to indicate its support for priority sharing, allowing the AS to determine the use of priority sharing and include the Priority-Share header field in a request or response towards the P-CSCF.

question_66038.question: What message type should the MS transmit to deactivate call restriction services with any parameters?
question_66038.ground_truth: The MS should transmit a REGISTER message to deactivate call restriction services with any parameters.

question_66039.question: What should the target UE do if it receives a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for 5G ProSe direct communication between a 5G ProSe remote UE and the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE and the encrypted relay service code does not match with the one that the target UE has sent during 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay discovery procedure?
question_66039.ground_truth: The target UE shall abort the 5G ProSe direct link establishment procedure.

question_66040.question: What is the primary challenge with counting bytes as continuous time in the 5G system?
question_66040.ground_truth: The challenge with counting bytes as continuous time is that it is imprecise, making it difficult for a UE to control and optimize the usage of the interface. This is because the counting may seem random to a UE, as it depends on how the application is designed and the network is performing.

question_66043.question: What is the purpose of the Security-Server header in the 401 (Unauthorized) response sent by the P-CSCF to the UE?
question_66043.ground_truth: The Security-Server header in the 401 (Unauthorized) response sent by the P-CSCF to the UE contains the P-CSCF static security list and the parameters needed for the security association setup. This allows the P-CSCF to negotiate and set up two pairs of security associations with the UE during the registration procedure.

question_66045.question: What information should a P system provide to a UTM about a UAV and its controller?
question_66045.ground_truth: A P system should enable an MNO to augment the data sent to a UTM with network-based positioning information of a UAV and its controller. This can be trust-based or additional location information based on network information.

question_66046.question: Who is responsible for the Self-Healing OAM requirements and solutions work item?

question_66047.question: What security parameters are needed by a UE receiving a discovery message in model A of the ProSe Discovery procedure?
question_66047.ground_truth: The security parameters needed by a UE receiving a discovery message in model A of the ProSe Discovery procedure are provided in the Code-Receiving Security Parameters.

question_66048.question: What action should the MS take if it receives SM cause value #50 "PDP type IPv4 only allowed" in the ACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT ACCEPT message?
question_66048.ground_truth: The MS shall not request another PDP context to get a PDP Type different from the one allowed by the network, until all PDP contexts to the given APN are deactivated or the PDP type used to access to the APN is changed.

question_66049.question: What must the UE do in single-registration mode with N26 interface when at least one PDU session of non-IP PDN type is active?
question_66049.ground_truth: The UE shall map the PDU session(s) to the default EPS bearer context(s) and initiate an EPS attach procedure in the ATTACH REQUEST message with a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message with request type set to "handover" or "handover of emergency bearer services" based on the session type and whether it is an emergency PDU session.

question_66050.question: In the case of coordinated NRIs, what is the issue with CS/PS uncoordinated users in the target network?
question_66050.ground_truth: CS/PS uncoordinated users will stay uncoordinated since NRIs are assumed to be coordinated in the target network.

question_66052.question: Which specific type of information does the BearerCapability parameter indicate?
question_66052.ground_truth: It indicates the type of bearer capability connection to the user.

question_66054.question: What are the two possible cases for round-trip delay monitoring?
question_66054.ground_truth: The two possible cases for round-trip delay monitoring are when the UL and DL traffic are within the same QoS flow or when the main UL and DL traffic are separated into two different QoS flows.

question_66055.question: What exception is thrown if, when calling the method findAndCompareValue, the parameter dstBuffer is null?

question_66056.question: What parameter does the TP UE need to include in the SIP REGISTER request for registration in an IM session supporting telepresence?

question_66057.question: How are the time-domain excitation contributions determined in the GSC mode when 1 or 2 subframes are used?
question_66057.ground_truth: The time-domain excitation contributions are determined using ordinary closed-loop pitch search as in subclause 5.2.3.1.4.1 when 1 or 2 subframes are used in the GSC mode.

question_66058.question: What is the name of the modulation code used for the convolutional mother code in subclause 5.3a.6.4?
question_66058.ground_truth: The modulation code used is the 1/6 rate convolutional mother code.

question_66065.question: When checking the Via header field provided by the UE in a request other than a REGISTER request, against which stored IP address does the S-CSCF compare the received IP address?
question_66065.ground_truth: The S-CSCF compares the received IP address (or prefix) in the Via header field provided by the UE against the stored UE IP address (or prefix).

question_66067.question: What is the purpose of the CAAF of the ICCF in the IMS architecture?
question_66067.ground_truth: The CAAF (Call and Access Function) of the ICCF is responsible for performing the necessary adaptation and relaying information needed for the generation of SIP messages, acting as a B2BUA, and terminating USSD messages in the IMS architecture.

question_66068.question: What is the purpose of the Terminal-Information AVP in the S6a/S6d interface protocol?
question_66068.ground_truth: The Terminal-Information AVP contains the information about the user's terminal. It includes the IMEI, 3GPP2-MEID, and Software-Version AVPs, among others.

question_66070.question: What is necessary to handle responses and reports for asynchronous methods?
question_66070.ground_truth: The application or service developer must implement the relevant IpApp<name> or IpSvc<name> interfaces to provide the callback mechanism for handling responses and reports for asynchronous methods.

question_66072.question: What should the gNB-DU include in the measurement report to be sent to the TCE if the UE reports a polluted measurement indication?
question_66072.ground_truth: The gNB-DU should include the polluted measurement indication as part of the measurement report to be sent to the TCE if the UE reports such an indication.

question_66073.question: What should the SMF do upon receiving a successful request to activate the User Plane connection of a PDU session?
question_66073.ground_truth: The SMF should set the upCnxState attribute to ACTIVATING, request the 5G-AN to assign resources to the PDU session, and update the UPF with the 5G-AN's F-TEID(s) for downlink traffic.

question_66074.question: What is the significance of the version numbering system used in the 3GPP Technical Specification documents?
question_66074.ground_truth: The version numbering system (x.y.z) indicates the stage of approval of the document, where x represents the stage of approval, y indicates technical enhancements or corrections, and z indicates editorial changes.

question_66076.question: What are the three potential technical solutions identified to support different APNs for different applications in 3GPP system?
question_66076.ground_truth: The three potential technical solutions identified are network features, Device Management, and the UICC.

question_66078.question: What action should the UE take upon satisfying the leaving condition for the NR sidelink measurement event?
question_66078.ground_truth: When the leaving condition of the NR sidelink measurement event is satisfied (Ms - Hys > Thresh), the UE can start the periodical reporting timer, if it is not already running, with the value of sl-ReportInterval for this sl-MeasId.

question_66079.question: What is the second digit incremented for in the versioning of the present document?
question_66079.ground_truth: The second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, i.e. technical enhancements, corrections, updates, etc.

question_66080.question: What should the UE do with existing SAs when it changes its IP address?
question_66080.ground_truth: The UE should delete the existing SAs and initiate an unprotected registration procedure using the new IP address in the packets carrying the REGISTER messages.

question_66081.question: What transport signalling protocol(s) are specified for the Iur data transport for Common Transport Channel data streams in TSG RAN UTRAN Iur Interface Data Transport and Transport Signalling (Release 17)?
question_66081.ground_truth: The transport signalling protocols used to establish the user plane for the Iur data transport for Common Transport Channel data streams are specified in clause 6 of the document.

question_66082.question: What is the ID of the CAG human-readable network name for Cell 2 in the network parameters for Cell 2 in sequence 1.30?
question_66082.ground_truth: The ID of the CAG human-readable network name for Cell 2 in the network parameters for Cell 2 in sequence 1.30 is 00 00 00 02.

question_66083.question: What is the condition for a positioning frequency layer to be counted as a candidate for a measurement gap occasion?
question_66083.ground_truth: A positioning frequency layer is counted as a candidate for a measurement gap occasion if at least one PRS resource on that positioning frequency layer is fully covered by the MGL excluding RF switching time.

question_66085.question: What is the purpose of solution 7.19 for application context relocation?
question_66085.ground_truth: Solution 7.19 is supplementary to solution 9 for application context relocation, where a source Edge Enabler Server can obtain a target Edge Enabler Server information via an EDNCS. This allows for a smoother transfer of application context from one Edge Enabler Server to another.

question_66086.question: How does the orthogonal sub channel concept increase voice capacity?
question_66086.ground_truth: The orthogonal sub channel concept increases voice capacity by multiplexing two mobile stations simultaneously on the same radio resource, relying on GMSK capability of handsets, and separating subchannels using non-correlated training sequences.

question_66087.question: What is the transmit power required for 20 dB coverage extension in the NB M2M solution?
question_66087.ground_truth: The NB M2M solution achieves 20 dB coverage extension using a MS transmit power of only +23 dBm (200 mW), resulting in a peak current requirement that is compatible with a wider range of battery technologies.

question_66088.question: What is the objective of adding wider channel bandwidths in NR band n28?
question_66088.ground_truth: The objective is to allow operators to make more efficient use of their available spectrum, particularly for operators who have spectrum larger than 20MHz in NR band n28.

question_66089.question: What should the transmission participant do when it receives a transmission control message before the SIP 200 (OK) response in a call?
question_66089.ground_truth: The transmission participant should store the transmission control message if it receives it before the SIP 200 (OK) response.

question_66090.question: What information must the PGW-C/SMF return to the SGW in the Create Session Response message if the SGW supports the Restoration of PDN connections after a PGW-C/SMF Change procedure?
question_66090.ground_truth: The PGW-C/SMF must return a PGW Change Info IE containing the PGW Set FQDN or Alternative PGW-C/SMF FQDN or IP addresses of PGW/SMFs in the set. This indicates to the SGW that alternative PGW-C/SMF instances can be found using the provided FQDN or IP addresses if a PGW-C/SMF becomes no longer reachable.

question_66091.question: What is the procedure followed for the handling of FQC information at CN in the uplink path?
question_66091.ground_truth: At CN, a CRC check is made of the frame payload, and the Iu UP frame and the appropriate frame quality classification information are passed through the RNL-SAP. If the CRC check indicates that the payload is corrupted, the frame is dropped, forwarded, or forwarded with the FQC set based on the corruption and the Delivery of erroneous SDU IE setting.

question_66093.question: What is the difference between QoE, ESQoS, and SQoS parameters?
question_66093.ground_truth: QoE parameters describe the end-user's perceived quality, SQoS parameters are related to network status, and ESQoS parameters describe the QoS of the end-to-end service.

question_66094.question: What is the main feature of the solution that employs a Secure Channel between USIM and RN and AS integrity for S1 /X2 with a modified KASME?
question_66094.ground_truth: The main features include autonomous validation of the RN platform, secure channel between USIM-RN and RN, certificate validation client on the UICC, AS integrity for S1 /X2, computation of KASME on the UICC, and key derivation function for KASME dependent on whether a secure channel is established.

question_66096.question: In 6.6.1.1, what message does the UE send when it detects that the 3GPP link is not usable?
question_66096.ground_truth: The UE sends the WLCP Modification Command message including a 3GPP unusable indication.

question_66098.question: What is the role of management services in the context of ML-based network automation solutions?
question_66098.ground_truth: Management services are required to identify the capabilities of the involved ML entities and to map those capabilities to the desired logic in ML-based network automation solutions.

question_66100.question: What does MCX stand for in the context of Mission Critical and the present document?
question_66100.ground_truth: MCX represents PTT (push-to-talk), Video, or Data, depending on the context, in the context of Mission Critical communication applications.

question_66101.question: What should the MCPTT client do when it receives a request from an MCPTT user to initiate or join an MCPTT group session within a pre-established session?
question_66101.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should generate a SIP REFER request outside a dialog, setting the Request URI to the session identity of the pre-established session, and the Refer-To header field to a Content-ID URL pointing to an application/resource-lists MIME body. The MIME body should include a single <entry> element with the chat group identity.

question_66103.question: What information does the "PLMN" leaf in "ANDSF/HomeNetworkPreference/RanMobilitySetUsed/<X>/PLMN" indicate?
question_66103.ground_truth: The PLMN leaf in "ANDSF/HomeNetworkPreference/RanMobilitySetUsed/<X>/PLMN" indicates a PLMN.

question_66104.question: What is the concept of "Flocking" in the context of 5GS?
question_66104.ground_truth: The term "Flocking" in 5GS refers to a group with performance requirements that consider the group's "teamwork" instead of the "total" or "best performers" in the group.

question_66105.question: What function does the LMISF perform when an IMS signalling message involves a target in the context of inbound roaming?
question_66105.ground_truth: The LMISF generates an IRI from the IMS signalling messages and delivers it to the Delivery Function 2 over the X2 reference point.

question_66107.question: What type of services are provided with the 5GS CIoT optimizations in Use Case #7?
question_66107.ground_truth: In Use Case #7, the 5GS CIoT optimizations provide communication services like massive access of NB-IoT devices with business values such as power saving, small data rate but large number of devices for 5GS CIoT UEs.

question_66108.question: What are the conditions for a successful test of SSB-based beam failure detection?
question_66108.ground_truth: The test is considered successful if, during a specific time interval, the SS detects uplink power on the NR carrier, does not detect preamble on a beam associated with the candidate beam set q1 before time point B, and detects preamble on a beam associated with the candidate beam set q1 before a specific time point F.

question_66109.question: What are the two options for the AI/ML model server to obtain the user's location information?
question_66109.ground_truth: Option 1: Directly from the user's device over the application layer. Option 2: Via the location service provided by the 5G network.

question_66110.question: What functionality does the media distribution function provide in the MCPTT service?
question_66110.ground_truth: The media distribution function is responsible for the distribution of media to MCPTT call participants, including the reception of uplink MCPTT UE media transmission, replication as needed, distribution to participants, and providing a media mixing function where multiple media streams are combined.

question_66111.question: When can a UE measure the CSI-RS for CBD without restrictions for FR1 even if the SSB for RLM, BFD, CBD or L1-RSRP measurement and the CSI-RS for CBD measurement are in the same OFDM symbol?
question_66111.ground_truth: A UE can measure the CSI-RS for CBD without restrictions for FR1 even if the SSB for RLM, BFD, CBD or L1-RSRP measurement and the CSI-RS for CBD measurement are in the same OFDM symbol when they are not in a CSI-RS resource set with repetition ON, and they and both of the PDSCHs are on the same OFDM symbol(s), with the CSI-RS and PDSCH having the same QCL source as the active TCI state of the corresponding PDSCH.

question_66112.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in relation to Mission Critical Services (MCSs)?
question_66112.ground_truth: The 3GPP provides the technical specification for the identity management and authentication protocols needed to support MCSs, which are services that require preferential handling compared to normal telecommunication services.

question_66113.question: What is the precondition for an MCData user to initiate an ad-hoc group data communication in the context of subclause 7.17.3.2.1 or 7.17.3.2.3?
question_66113.ground_truth: The MCData client must first establish a media plane for file transmission with the MCData server.

question_66114.question: What is the purpose of comparing the long term average pitch gain of the GSC temporal contribution and the last value of the cut-off frequency to a threshold in the 5.3 procedure?
question_66114.ground_truth: The purpose is to decide if it is allowed to remove all the temporal contribution, with the cut-off frequency becoming 0.

question_66115.question: How are keys managed during a BEST session between the UE and HSE?
question_66115.ground_truth: At any time during the BEST session, either the UE or the HSE may trigger a re-negotiation of the keys being used for the BEST service using the EMSDP Manage Keys Request and Response exchange. The newly generated keys take effect immediately for EMSDP based BEST UP services.

question_66116.question: Once the UE acknowledges the PDU Session Release Command by sending a NAS message, what is the next action taken by the (R)AN?
question_66116.ground_truth: If the NAS message from the UE indicates PDU Session Release Ack, the (R)AN forwards the NAS message by sending a N2 NAS uplink transport (NAS message (PDU Session ID, N1 SM container (PDU Session Release Ack)), User Location Information) to the AMF.

question_66118.question: What are the supported E-UTRA bandwidths for intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation in Band 42?
question_66118.ground_truth: The supported E-UTRA bandwidths for intra-band contiguous CA in Band 42 are 5MHz, 10MHz, 15MHz, and 20 MHz channel bandwidths, which can support carrier aggregation in contiguous spectrum block ranging from 25 to 40MHz.

question_66119.question: What value of byte 3 (b5) indicates that the UE is authorized to use "operator-managed" radio resources?

question_66120.question: What is used for the establishment of TLS protected media packets when e2e protection of MSRP based media is provided between an IMS UE and a remote IMS or non-IMS UE or MRFP?
question_66120.ground_truth: The established key from the key management mechanisms defined by MIKEY-TICKET is used to setup a TLS-PSK tunnel between the two parties for the establishment of TLS protected media packets.

question_66122.question: Who is responsible for authorizing a UE for using localized services in the Monster theme park?
question_66122.ground_truth: The home network operator is responsible for authorizing a UE for using localized services via a visited hosting network for a certain period of time and/or location. The UE can use home network services or selected localized services via the hosting network during this time.

question_66123.question: What information does the "rO-VolumeIfNoTariffSwitch" parameter indicate in the "transferredVolumeRollOver" parameter?
question_66123.ground_truth: It indicates how many times the volumeIfNoTariffSwitch parameter of the chargingResult has rolled over.

question_66124.question: What parameters does the LCS Service Request include for periodic location reporting?
question_66124.ground_truth: The LCS Service Request includes the time interval between successive location reports, the total number of reports, and may include location QoS.

question_66125.question: Which three flags should be set to 1 for a given Presence Reporting Area Identifier when the reporting of change of UE presence for the PRA Set is active and the UE presence has changed for at least one PRA within the PRA Set?
question_66125.ground_truth: The Additional PRA (APRA) flag in octet 8, Inside PRA (IPRA) flag, and Outside PRA flag (OPRA) should be set to 1, when the reporting of change of UE presence for the PRA Set is active and the UE presence has changed for at least one PRA within the PRA Set.

question_66126.question: What should the target NG-RAN do when it receives multicast MBS session information from the source NG-RAN and supports MBS?
question_66126.ground_truth: The target NG-RAN allocates shared NG-RAN resources for the UE and prepares for 5GC Shared MBS traffic delivery.

question_66127.question: What should the mobile station do if it receives a PACKET POLLING REQUEST message with a starting time that has already elapsed?
question_66127.ground_truth: The mobile station should ignore the RRBP field if it is received as part of an RLC/MAC block containing a Packet Paging Request, Packet Access Reject, or Packet Queuing Notification message.

question_66129.question: What certificate enrolment mechanism is recommended for backhaul security in base stations?
question_66129.ground_truth: The base station obtains the operator-signed certificate on its own public key from RA/CA using CMPv2.

question_66130.question: What should be the MGCF's action when receiving an INVITE request from a circuit-switched network in order to create the initial SDP offer?
question_66130.ground_truth: When generating an SDP offer for a call originating in a circuit-switched network, the MGCF shall populate the SDP message with the codecs supported by the associated MGW (Media Gateway).

question_66132.question: What procedure does the UE perform after receiving the coverage data from the AMF during the 5GS PDU Session Establishment?
question_66132.ground_truth: The UE stores and processes the received coverage data and performs corresponding procedures, such as taking into account the coverage data when deciding whether to remain with no service or attempt to register on available different RATs/PLMNs to receive normal service during the out of coverage period.

question_66135.question: What happens when there is no UE Radio Capability corresponding to the UE capability ID in Solution #2?
question_66135.ground_truth: If there is no UE Radio Capability corresponding to the UE capability ID, an indication that the UE Radio Capability is not available is also conveyed to the AMF along with the UE capability ID.

question_66136.question: What is the definition of the interruption time in the context of handover to a new cell?
question_66136.ground_truth: The interruption time is the time between the end of the last TTI containing the RRC command on the old PDSCH and the time the UE starts transmission of the new PRACH, excluding the RRC procedure delay.

question_66138.question: What is the role of the Serving GW in the bearer modification procedure?
question_66138.ground_truth: The Serving GW is responsible for sending the Bearer Resource Command message to the PDN GW to request changes to the EPS bearer, based on information received from the SGSN. It also interacts with the PCRF to provide or request information about the TFT, QCI, and GBR.

question_66139.question: What network elements are required for the AOC service on the terminating network side?
question_66139.ground_truth: No specific requirements are needed in the network on the terminating network side for the AOC service.

question_66140.question: What is the structure of the 5G-GUTI and its derivatives?
question_66140.ground_truth: The 5G-GUTI has two main components: the GUAMI and the 5G-TMSI; and the 5G-S-TMSI has three main components: the AMF set ID, the AMF pointer, and the 5G-TMSI.

question_66141.question: What is the test requirement for the overall delays measured in this test case?
question_66141.ground_truth: The overall delays measured shall be less than a total of 7682 ms in this test case.

question_66143.question: What does the use case on "Addition of UE in a 3GPP private group communications" describe?
question_66143.ground_truth: This use case describes the addition of new equipment into an existing 3GPP private group communications with automatic private group update, i.e. as soon as equipment is added in the company.

question_66144.question: What is the composition of low and high loss in the O-to-I penetration loss models, and why is it a simulation parameter?
question_66144.ground_truth: The composition of low and high loss in the O-to-I penetration loss models is a simulation parameter because it depends on the use of metal-coated glass in buildings and the deployment scenarios. This use is expected to differ in different markets and regions of the world and may increase over years due to new regulations and energy saving initiatives.

question_66145.question: When is a 5G ProSe remote UE authorized to initiate 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay communication in a geographical area where it is provisioned with radio parameters?
question_66145.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe remote UE is authorized to initiate 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay communication in a geographical area where it is provisioned with radio parameters if it can determine its location in that area.

question_66146.question: What is the condition for sending continuously uplink power control "up" commands to the UE in the test procedure?
question_66146.ground_truth: The condition for sending continuously uplink power control "up" commands to the UE is that there is at least one active uplink subframe.

question_66150.question: What does the "SON Transfer Application Identity" element specify within the target BSS node?
question_66150.ground_truth: It specifies the addressed SON Transfer application within the target BSS node.

question_66152.question: What defines a correct ACK for new data received by the UE from the SS?
question_66152.ground_truth: If the UE indicates on the E-DPCCH new data, the ACK from the SS was received as ACK by the UE.

question_66153.question: What is the difference between CAPIF-1 and CAPIF-1e, and between CAPIF-2 and CAPIF-2e?
question_66153.ground_truth: CAPIF-1 and CAPIF-2 are used for API invoker interactions within the PLMN trust domain, while CAPIF-1e and CAPIF-2e are used for API invoker interactions outside the PLMN trust domain.

question_66155.question: Which three types of data can an end-user have from an operator's point of view?
question_66155.ground_truth: Profile data, Completely private data, and Private data influencing the call processing.

question_66157.question: How should data be sent between the LI application, MF, and LEMF?
question_66157.ground_truth: The specified data communication methods provide a general means of data communication between the LEA and the operator's mediation function, such as FTP or TPKT/TCP/IP.

question_66158.question: What is the purpose of the UE Power Limit Function (UPLF) in the test procedure?
question_66158.ground_truth: The UE Power Limit Function (UPLF) is used to deactivate the UE's power limit function in the test procedure.

question_66159.question: What does the V-GMLC return when the periodic and triggered location request is activated in the UE?
question_66159.ground_truth: The V-GMLC returns an LCS Service Response via the H-GMLC and R-GMLC to the LCS Client to notify whether the periodic and triggered location request was activated in the UE.

question_66160.question: What are the conditions for a UE to perform a tracking area update?
question_66160.ground_truth: A UE performs the tracking area update procedure if the TAI in the EMM system information is not in the list of TA's registered with the network, or when the UE hands over to an E-UTRAN cell and its TIN indicates "P-TMSI".

question_66161.question: How are the MCPTT users and LMR users connected in terms of codec usage when E2EE is specified?
question_66161.ground_truth: Both MCPTT users and LMR users must use the same codec.

question_66164.question: How often should a UE not using measurement occasions and idle intervals perform BSIC verification to confirm monitoring the same cell?
question_66164.ground_truth: It should perform BSIC verification at least every 10 seconds for the 6 strongest GSM carriers.

question_66166.question: What needs to be provided to achieve integrity protection for a ProSe restricted discovery message?
question_66166.ground_truth: Either a Discovery User Scrambling Key (DUSK) or a Discovery User Integrity Key (DUIK) needs to be provided to achieve integrity protection for a ProSe restricted discovery message.

question_66168.question: What is the expected functionality of sensors generating waveform measurements or cameras in terms of data transmission?
question_66168.ground_truth: The waveform sensors and cameras are expected to buffer and transmit the data periodically to save battery by enabling discontinuous transmission.

question_66169.question: In what scenario would IPv6 prefix be allocated during adding an additional PDU Session Anchor for IPv6 multi-homing?
question_66169.ground_truth: IPv6 prefix allocation during adding additional PDU Session Anchor procedure for IPv6 multi-homing.

question_66170.question: What must the AMF confirm before notifying the SMF of multi-modality readiness?
question_66170.ground_truth: The AMF must confirm that both UE1 and UE2 are in the same NG-RAN before notifying the SMF of multi-modality readiness.

question_66171.question: What determines the choice between data-path optimization and IP address preservation?
question_66171.ground_truth: The choice between data-path optimization and IP address preservation depends on the applications, as certain applications prefer one over the other based on factors such as the type of flow and whether IP address preservation is required or not.

question_66172.question: What is the purpose of the message contents in E-UTRAN FDD-WLAN Event Triggered Reporting in non-DRX under AWGN?
question_66172.ground_truth: The purpose of the message contents in E-UTRAN FDD-WLAN Event Triggered Reporting in non-DRX under AWGN is to verify the UE's ability to make a correct reporting of an event when doing inter-RAT (WLAN) measurements under AWGN condition within the E-UTRA FDD.

question_66173.question: What are the interfaces of a PWS signing proxy and what security measures are needed?
question_66173.ground_truth: A PWS signing proxy (SP) has interfaces with Content Broadcasting Entities (CBEs) and Content Broadcasting Centers (CBCs). These interfaces must provide message integrity, message origin authentication, and prevent unauthorized entities from generating warning messages or sending them to UEs. Security measures, such as IKE/IPsec with certificates or pre-shared keys and physical security, can be used for these interfaces.

question_66174.question: What should be done if an aggregated message is too large to be sent to a recipient and segmentation is not permitted?
question_66174.ground_truth: If an aggregated message is too large to be sent to a recipient and segmentation is not permitted, the MSGin5G Server should handle it as specified in clause 8.4.2.

question_66175.question: In the video call phase, at what point is H.245 setup between the UE-A and the CAT-Server?
question_66175.ground_truth: H.245 is setup between UE-A and the CAT-Server after the call is bothway through connected in MSC-A Server.

question_66177.question: What action should the P-CSCF take if it receives an initial request for a dialog or standalone transaction, or an unknown method, from an unregistered user on the advertised IP address and port?
question_66177.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should inspect the Request URI for known emergency service identifiers, and if found, include an emergency service URN in the Request-URI and select an E-CSCF to add to the topmost Route header.

question_66178.question: What are the services supported by service scoping for IMS-based services?
question_66178.ground_truth: The services supported by service scoping for IMS-based services include Voice, PTC, Messaging, RCS, and LALS.

question_66179.question: What should the GGSN do to determine if Network-Requested PDP Context Activation is supported for a PDP address?
question_66179.ground_truth: The GGSN checks if there is static PDP information for that PDP address.

question_66180.question: What are the best burst formats for DAS-12b and DBS-12b based on the study?
question_66180.ground_truth: The best burst format for DAS-12b is header bit swapping and shifting of 88 bits, and for DBS-12b is header bit swapping and shifting of 54 bits.

question_66181.question: What does Solution 14 assume about the API invoker in a CAPIF core function initiated revocation procedure?
question_66181.ground_truth: Solution 14 assumes that the API invoker is a UE/AF when reusing the CAPIF core function initiated revocation procedure to enable user authorization revocation.

question_66182.question: What does carrier aggregation refer to in the context of 3GPP's technical specifications?
question_66182.ground_truth: Carrier aggregation refers to the aggregation of two or more component carriers in order to support wider transmission bandwidths.

question_66183.question: What should a UE do if it receives a 5GSM cause value #33 upon sending PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST?
question_66183.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the Back-off timer value and Re-attempt indicator, and may send PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST again after evaluating URSP rules.

question_66184.question: What are the two options for performing V2X policy provisioning update procedure in Solution #7?
question_66184.ground_truth: The two options for performing V2X policy provisioning update procedure in Solution #7 are Option 1: UE-triggered V2X policy provisioning update procedure, and Option 2: AF-based service parameter provisioning for V2X communications by the PCF of the PLMNs.

question_66185.question: What information is used to identify the user equipment (UE) when the user identity is not available or cannot be authenticated in IP-CAN session establishment?
question_66185.ground_truth: The IMEI (International Mobile Equipment Identity) of the UE is used to identify the UE when the user identity is not available or cannot be authenticated.

question_66186.question: What is a necessary response delay during unacknowledged operation in the context of multiple frame operation in data link layer procedures?
question_66186.ground_truth: The necessary response delay is the maximum time that a data link entity has to respond to a data link command frame requesting response whose last burst has been received.

question_66187.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP system in terms of V2X applications?
question_66187.ground_truth: The 3GPP system is responsible for exposing services and capabilities to V2X applications to support offering of the applications, including supporting V2X applications to dynamically request specific quality of service of communication services and providing required quality of service to communication services on demand for different V2X applications.

question_66189.question: What is one of the conditions for the SMF to initiate an SMF-initiated SM Policy Association Modification procedure?
question_66189.ground_truth: The SMF may initiate an SMF-initiated SM Policy Association Modification procedure if new intermediate UPF insertion or allocation of a new UPF is required.

question_66190.question: What does the document mean by "metaverse" in the context of 3GPP TS 22.101?
question_66190.ground_truth: The document uses "metaverse" to refer to a shared, perceived set of interactive perceived spaces that can be persistent and mobile.

question_66192.question: When should the UE set the network policy on unsecured redirection to GERAN or UTRAN to "Unsecured redirection to GERAN or UTRAN not allowed" and indicate this to the lower layers?
question_66192.ground_truth: The UE shall set the network policy on unsecured redirection to GERAN or UTRAN to "Unsecured redirection to GERAN or UTRAN not allowed" and indicate this to the lower layers when the UE initiates an EPS attach or tracking area updating procedure in a PLMN different from the PLMN where the UE performed the last successful EPS attach or tracking area updating procedure, when the UE is switched on, or when the UICC containing the USIM is removed.

question_66193.question: In which country is the user located if the UE performs a DNS query using the Visited Country Emergency FQDN for N3IWF and the Visited Country Emergency FQDN for ePDG?
question_66193.ground_truth: The user is located in a visited country.

question_66194.question: What happens to the EPS bearer contexts when a MA PDU session is transferred to EPC during UE's Idle mode?
question_66194.ground_truth: The EPS bearer contexts are retrieved from SMF by MME after UE sends the TAU request to MME. After the 3GPP leg of MA PDU Session is transferred to EPS through TAU procedure, SMF releases the network resource over N3GPP.

question_66195.question: What is the maximum RRC procedure delay, as specified in clause 11.2 in TS 36.331, for handover procedures?
question_66195.ground_truth: The maximum RRC procedure delay is 15 ms.

question_66196.question: Which component is optional in the "ContinuousPacketConnectivity-DRX-Information-ResponseLCR" sequence?

question_66198.question: What function does the EATF provide in the IMS network for enabling service continuity of IMS emergency sessions and eCall over IMS?
question_66198.ground_truth: The EATF provides IMS-based mechanisms for enabling service continuity of IMS emergency sessions and eCall over IMS, and acts as a routing B2BUA which invokes third party call control (3pcc) for enablement of Access Transfer.

question_66199.question: What is the purpose of the vendor extension in the media adaptation management procedures?
question_66199.ground_truth: The vendor extension in the media adaptation management procedures is used to include parameters that are not provided by 3GPP MTSIMA MO but are specific to a particular application or device vendor.

question_66200.question: What logical channels does E-UTRA employ to provide control information for unicast and MBMS services?
question_66200.ground_truth: E-UTRA employs DCCH and CCCH for unicast control information and MCCH for MBMS common control information.

question_66201.question: What is the role of the secondary PEMC (PEMC-S) in managing a PIN with multiple PEMCs?
question_66201.ground_truth: The secondary PEMC (PEMC-S) is responsible for performing certain PIN management operations and sending requests to the primary PEMC (PEMC-P) to perform other operations.

question_66204.question: What action does the BSS take when it receives a RESET IP RESOURCE message?
question_66204.ground_truth: The BSS releases locally the resources and references associated with the Call Identifiers indicated in the received message.

question_66205.question: What action should the mobile station take if the routing area updating attempt counter is smaller than 5, the stored RAI is equal to the RAI of the current serving cell, and the GMM update status is equal to GU1 UPDATED?
question_66205.ground_truth: The mobile station should keep the GMM update status GU1 UPDATED and change state to GMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE-MM. It should start timer T3311. When timer T3311 expires, the combined routing area update procedure indicating "combined RA/LA updating with IMSI attach" is triggered again.

question_66206.question: What is the test purpose for testing that the MS reacts correctly when receiving a HANDOVER TO UTRAN COMMAND and the handover fails because of a protocol error?
question_66206.ground_truth: The test purpose is to ensure that the MS reactivates the old channel and transmits an RR STATUS message to the network on the old channel in the GSM cell when the handover to UTRAN fails because of a protocol error.

question_66207.question: What action does the UE take when it receives an EAS rediscovery indication for a specific EAS?
question_66207.ground_truth: The UE is instructed to trigger an EAS discovery procedure to get new EAS information for the specific EAS with the rediscovery triggered.

question_66208.question: What does the "Administrative State" attribute indicate with the hexadecimal value FF?
question_66208.ground_truth: The hexadecimal value FF in the "Administrative State" attribute represents "Adm. state not supported."

question_66209.question: When is a UE required to perform measurements of inter-frequency layers with a priority higher than the priority of the current serving layer?
question_66209.ground_truth: If the UE has received absolute priority information for inter-frequency layers, the UE shall perform measurements of inter-frequency layers with a priority higher than the priority of the current serving layer.

question_66210.question: What action should the MS take if no TFT IE is received in the REQUEST SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT ACTIVATION message?
question_66210.ground_truth: The MS has two options: (A) reply with a REQUEST SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT ACTIVATION REJECT message, cause code indicating "semantic error in the TFT operation" or (B) accept the network's requested secondary PDP context activation and proceed as specified in subclause 6.1.3.2.1a. If another PDP context with the same PDP address and APN without a TFT exists, the MS shall deactivate this old PDP context without a TFT by explicit peer-to-peer signaling between the MS and the network.

question_66211.question: What is the state of the MCPTT emergency group call when the IWF needs to include a Resource-Priority header field with emergency level priority in the SIP INVITE request?
question_66211.ground_truth: If the MCPTT emergency group call state is set to "MEGC 2: emergency-call-requested" or "MEGC 3: emergency-call-granted", or if the MCPTT client emergency group state of the group is set to "MEG 2: in-progress", the IWF needs to include a Resource-Priority header field with emergency level priority in the SIP INVITE request.

question_66212.question: What devices must be protected from any terrestrial operation in the 1675-1680 MHz band?
question_66212.ground_truth: Two downlink MetSat services deployed in 1675-1680 MHz band, namely Sensor Data Link (SD) and Data Collection Platform Report (DCPR) on future GOES-R satellite, must be protected from any terrestrial operation in the same band.

question_66213.question: What is the purpose of radio link monitoring on UE with reduced capabilities as specified in clause 8.1B.1?
question_66213.ground_truth: The purpose is to detect the downlink radio link quality of the PCell.

question_66214.question: What does the SIP 202 (Accepted) response sent from UE-1 in step 5-6 of the ECT call flow indicate?
question_66214.ground_truth: The SIP 202 (Accepted) response sent from UE-1 in step 5-6 of the ECT call flow indicates that UE-1 has accepted the blind ECT transfer request sent from the SCC AS in step 3-4.

question_66215.question: What is the role of the SCCP in the Gs interface?
question_66215.ground_truth: The SCCP is used to provide message routing between the SGSN and the VLR in the Gs interface. It allows for the connection of one SGSN to several VLRs and doesn't require segmentation at the SCCP level.

question_66216.question: What happens when the GANC receives a GA-PSR TC activation message with an active GA-PSR TC?
question_66216.ground_truth: The GANC responds with the GA-PSR-ACTIVATE-UTC-ACK message and sets the expected uplink packet sequence number to 0.

question_66217.question: What is the expected sequence number when performing the test for the LAUNCH BROWSER command with Bold On text attribute?

question_66218.question: How should Test Case 13 (TC13) be constructed for transmitter tests?
question_66218.ground_truth: Add NB-IoT carriers at the upper edge and GSM carriers at the lower edge, alternately using 600 kHz spacing, until the Base Station RF Bandwidth is filled or the total number of supported carriers is reached. Add extra E-UTRA carriers of the same bandwidth in the middle if possible.

question_66219.question: What action results in incrementing the relevant subcounter per S-NSSAI by 1 in the "Number of PDU Sessions failed to setup" measurement?
question_66219.ground_truth: Each PDU Session listed in the "PDU Session Resource Failed to Setup List" IE, which is transmitted by the N3IWF to the AMF, increments the relevant subcounter per failure cause by 1.

question_66220.question: What is the effect of including the MBMS-StartStop-Indication AVP with the value UPDATE in the RAR message for the MBMS Session Update procedure?
question_66220.ground_truth: The value UPDATE in the MBMS-StartStop-Indication AVP indicates that the MBMS GW(s) should update their session attributes.

question_66221.question: What is the maximum allowed value for Tprocessing in the handover procedure for FR1-FR1 NR-DC to FR1-FR1 NR-DC?
question_66221.ground_truth: The maximum allowed value for Tprocessing in the handover procedure for FR1-FR1 NR-DC to FR1-FR1 NR-DC is 25 ms.

question_66222.question: What is the purpose of the "timestamp" header field parameter in the "Resource-Share" header field?
question_66222.ground_truth: The "timestamp" header field parameter in the "Resource-Share" header field indicates when the application server determined the resource sharing rules and is used to determine the most applicable resource sharing option. It is also used to detect and resolve race conditions caused by retransmissions of requests or responses carrying the Resource header field.

question_66225.question: What is part of the Rel-15 solution for the SMF NF profile delivery from NRF to AMF?
question_66225.ground_truth: The SMF SA (Service Area) is already part of the SMF NF profile delivered from NRF to AMF in Rel-15.

question_66226.question: What is the construction method for TC1a and TC1b?
question_66226.ground_truth: TC1a is constructed by placing UTRA FDD carriers adjacent to the upper and lower Base Station RF Bandwidth edges, and alternately placing a UTRA FDD carrier adjacent to the already placed carriers until there is no more space or the BS does not support more carriers. TC1b is constructed in a similar way, but with UTRA TDD carriers.

question_66227.question: When is the RIM procedure triggered by the Controlling BSS to exchange SON Transfer Request and SON Transfer Response containers between BSSs in the SON Transfer RIM application?
question_66227.ground_truth: The RIM procedure is triggered by the Controlling BSS to exchange SON Transfer Request and SON Transfer Response containers between BSSs in the SON Transfer RIM application.

question_66230.question: What protocol is used by the media storage client for standalone data file download from the MCData content server?

question_66232.question: What is the communication method used when the UE sensors are near hospital beds or operation rooms, and communicate with local display equipment?
question_66232.ground_truth: The UE sensors communicate with each other and provide information to a local display equipment for doctors and nurses to monitor.

question_66233.question: What is the length of the ProSe Layer-2 Group ID?
question_66233.ground_truth: The ProSe Layer-2 Group ID is 24 bits long.

question_66234.question: What is the minimum success rate required for RRC re-establishments during repeated tests?
question_66234.ground_truth: The minimum success rate required for RRC re-establishments during repeated tests is 90%.

question_66235.question: What is the role of the GMLC in the LCS architecture and what are the functions of the different types of GMLCs?
question_66235.ground_truth: The GMLC contains functionality required to support LCS. It is the first node an external LCS client accesses in a PLMN and it sends positioning requests to various network elements and receives final location estimates from them. The Requesting GMLC receives the request from LCS client, the Visited GMLC is associated with the serving node of the target mobile, and the Home GMLC resides in the target mobile's home PLMN and is responsible for the control of privacy checking of the target mobile.

question_66236.question: What protocol is used as the basic session control protocol for creating an IM session supporting telepresence?

question_66237.question: What is the purpose of inter-domain identity management in the context of MCX?
question_66237.ground_truth: The purpose is to allow a MCX User in one domain to access services in a different domain.

question_66238.question: What is the signal that the SS transmits on Cell 1 before starting time duration T1?
question_66238.ground_truth: The SS transmits NCD-SSB on Cell 1 before starting time duration T1.

question_66240.question: What should the network do when it receives an interrogation with the values "all forwarding SS" or "all conditional forwarding SS"?
question_66240.ground_truth: The network should send a return error component.

question_66242.question: What is the purpose of group specific NAS level congestion control in the case of Group specific NAS level congestion control for Mobility Management signalling?
question_66242.ground_truth: The group specific NAS level congestion control for Mobility Management signalling applies to a specific group of MSs and these MSs may belong to multiple groups. The SGSN may reject the Mobility Management requests from the MSs belonging to this particular group with a Mobility Management back-off timer.

question_66244.question: When is the "Location information" data object required in a call set-up?
question_66244.ground_truth: The "Location information" data object is required in a call set-up if the call is performed over GERAN, UTRAN, E-UTRAN, Satellite E-UTRAN, NG-RAN or Satellite NG-RAN.

question_66245.question: What is the overall delay allowed in the test for the total number of successful tests to pass?
question_66245.ground_truth: The overall delay allowed in the test for the total number of successful tests to pass is 170 ms.

question_66246.question: What will happen to the revalidation time timer if the PCF omits the "revalidationTime" attribute in the HTTP POST response message?
question_66246.ground_truth: The revalidation function remains enabled, but the timer remains stopped till the PCF provides a revalidation time within the "revalidationTime" attribute.

question_66247.question: What is necessary to enable attestation of a virtualized 3GPP NF through the full attestation chain?
question_66247.ground_truth: Solutions potentially required both inside and outside 3GPP, encompassing hardware, virtualization, and NF layers.

question_66248.question: What is the purpose of measuring the average throughput for a sufficient duration when measuring spurious frequencies?
question_66248.ground_truth: The purpose of measuring the average throughput for a sufficient duration is to achieve statistical significance as specified in Annex H.

question_66249.question: In the mentioned document, what is the difference in procedure when EPS interworking with N26 is supported and when it is not?
question_66249.ground_truth: For PDU Sessions with 3GPP access supporting EPS interworking with N26, EBI allocation is applied. For PDU Sessions via 3GPP access without N26 interworking support or for sessions via non-3GPP access, EBI allocation is not applied.

question_66250.question: What is the maximum time for a UE to read the relevant system information blocks in order to camp on a cell, as assumed in this test case?

question_66251.question: What is the main function of the procedure described in clause 6.2.3 for a successful handover, excluding the use of the Mobile Application Part (MAP)?
question_66251.ground_truth: The procedure covers handover cases without the use of the Mobile Application Part (MAP) for signaling.

question_66252.question: Which filters perform better in central allocations for allocation sizes less than or equal to 16 PRB in the TDL-C300ns, TDL-A 30ns and TDL-D 30ns channels?
question_66252.ground_truth: Less aggressive filters perform better in central allocations for allocation sizes less than or equal to 16 PRB in the TDL-C300ns, TDL-A 30ns and TDL-D 30ns channels.

question_66254.question: In Expected Sequence 3.4B, what is the General Result for the TERMINAL RESPONSE?
question_66254.ground_truth: The General Result for the TERMINAL RESPONSE in Expected Sequence 3.4B is "Command performed successfully, but requested icon could not be displayed".

question_66255.question: What is the AF's responsibility in the MBS session creation process without PCC?
question_66255.ground_truth: The AF is responsible for initiating the MBS session creation process, requesting TMGI allocation, and sending the MBS session information to UEs in the MBS session creation process without PCC.

question_66258.question: What happens in the handover procedure when the source MME detects that the UE has a LIPA PDN connection and the handover is S1-based?
question_66258.ground_truth: The source MME shall reject the handover if the UE has a LIPA PDN connection and the handover is S1-based.

question_66260.question: What is the goal of PR.5.5.3-001 and PR.5.5.3-002 in terms of data transmission?
question_66260.ground_truth: The goal of PR.5.5.3-001 is to make the 3GPP system efficient and flexible for both small and large data transmission from the same device. The goal of PR.5.5.3-002 is to minimize signalling overhead for security in transmitting small data while maintaining security.

question_66262.question: What parameter in the XID parameter negotiation is used to identify a data compression entity on a SAPI?

question_66263.question: What is the purpose of the test defined in clause 4.7.3.2.1.1?
question_66263.ground_truth: The purpose of the test defined in clause 4.7.3.2.1.1 is to verify that the inter-frequency SS-SINR absolute measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for all bands.

question_66264.question: What is the gain provided by the semi-static SBFD in the downlink (DL) when using SBFD Alt 3 and a large packet size at a low load level?
question_66264.ground_truth: The semi-static SBFD provides a mean and 5% DL Average-UPT gain of 2.01%.

question_66267.question: In what format do the unsolicited result codes +CMCCSS<x> / +CMCCSSEND support phone numbers?
question_66267.ground_truth: The unsolicited result codes +CMCCSS<x> / +CMCCSSEND support phone numbers in the SIP URI format.

question_66268.question: What is the mean capacity performance decrease with FR1, Dense Urban, UL, with 100MHz bandwidth for AR 1-stream scene/video/data/voice-stream, and with 10Mbps to 20Mbps data rate change when PDB increases from 10ms to 15ms for the AR 1-stream scene/video/data/voice-stream?
question_66268.ground_truth: The mean capacity performance decreased by about 44.44% between 10Mbps and 20Mbps.

question_66269.question: What is the current mechanism for adapting UL-DL allocation in LTE TDD and what could be an additional mechanism?
question_66269.ground_truth: The current mechanism for adapting UL-DL allocation in LTE TDD is based on the system information change procedure. An additional mechanism could be dynamic allocation of subframes to UL or DL.

question_66271.question: What should an intermediate node, acting as a Routeing B2BUA, do when creating the first response for an initial request in the terminating case?
question_66271.ground_truth: The intermediate node must include the P-Charging-Vector and P-Charging-Function-Addresses headers, and send the 200 (OK) response only after the resource reservation has been completed.

question_66273.question: What should the Iu UP protocol layers (sending and receiving) do if after N RC repetitions, the error situation for RATE CONTROL control frame persists?
question_66273.ground_truth: The Iu UP protocol layers take appropriate local actions.

question_66274.question: In which state is the MS before the test starts?
question_66274.ground_truth: The MS is in the "idle, updated" state with a TMSI allocated.

question_66275.question: What is the measurement that provides the number of attempted initial registrations from the UE belonging to a given access technology, valid only for the P-CSCF and each measurement having a form of UR.AttInitReg.AT where AT identifies the access technology the UE is belonging to?

question_66277.question: What is the one-to-many ProSe direct communication policy parameters consisting of for each application layer group?
question_66277.ground_truth: The one-to-many ProSe direct communication policy parameters include the ProSe Layer-2 Group ID, ProSe Group IP multicast address, IP version, IPv4 source address, Key Management Function address, and Application Layer Group ID for each application layer group.

question_66278.question: What does the Tm parameter represent and in what cases is it used?
question_66278.ground_truth: The Tm parameter represents the time difference between the received PCCPCH path of the source cell and the received PCCPCH paths of other target cells. It is used when the UE changes its state from common channel to dedicated channel state or when adding another RL in dedicated channel state.

question_66281.question: What is a common requirement for the communication protocols used for remote access to industrial devices?
question_66281.ground_truth: They should be able to communicate data of any kind, from single bytes to continuous streams, considering that power and memory limited devices will be communicating.

question_66282.question: What is the impact on the 10th percentile user throughput for non-TX-diversity users when the inter-site distance is 2.8 km in the PA3 channel?
question_66282.ground_truth: There are losses seen in the 10th percentile user throughput for non-TX-diversity users when the inter-site distance is 2.8 km in the PA3 channel.

question_66284.question: In what scenario would the CC-TF send a second trigger to the CC-POI for intercepting media in the reverse direction?
question_66284.ground_truth: This would occur when the media streams are asymmetric, and either the SDP offer is received, or the SDP answer is received, and the AS/MRFC receives the acknowledgement to the H.248: Add Context or H.248 Mod Context from the MRFP.

question_66285.question: What is the procedure to determine the number of residual bit error events for the bits of Class Ib?
question_66285.ground_truth: The SS determines the number of residual bit error events for the bits of Class Ib by examining at least the minimum number of samples of consecutive bits of Class Ib, taking into account only the bits from those frames that are not signalled as erased.

question_66286.question: What entities are responsible for retrieving Discovery parameters for ProSe Direct Discovery?
question_66286.ground_truth: The Announcing UE or Discoveree UE retrieves Discovery parameters for announcing or monitoring from the 5GS, as specified in clause 6.18.2.3 and 6.18.2.4.

question_66287.question: What message does the MS send to the network when requesting its own location or sending its location to another LCS client?
question_66287.ground_truth: The MS sends a DTAP LCS MOLR invoke to VMSC, which carries LCS QoS information such as accuracy and response time.

question_66288.question: What is the protocol stack used for the control message exchange between the UE-AT3SF and UPc-AT3SF?
question_66288.ground_truth: UDP based Control Plane Protocol Stack over 5G-AN

question_66289.question: What information must the MCVideo client include in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-mbms-usage-info+xml MIME body when reporting the MBMS bearer listening status?
question_66289.ground_truth: The MCVideo client must include an <mbms-listening-status> element set to "listening" or "not-listening," one or more <TMGI> elements specifying the TMGI value for which the listening status applies, and the MCVideo session identity if applicable.

question_66290.question: What action does the SMF take when it has received the EPS Bearer Status from the AMF, and there are EPS bearers deleted by the UE without notification?
question_66290.ground_truth: The SMF+PGW-C shall release those EPS bearers, the corresponding 5G QoS Rule(s), and the QoS Flow level QoS parameters locally.

question_66291.question: What is the purpose of the S9 Diameter application as used over the S9 reference point in 3GPP?
question_66291.ground_truth: The S9 Diameter application is used over the S9 reference point to install PCC rules or QoS rules generated in the HPLMN into the VPLMN, transport events that may occur in the VPLMN to the HPLMN, install ADC rules generated in the HPLMN into the VPLMN, and transport application detection and control information from the VPLMN to the HPLMN.

question_66293.question: What is the role of the Iur interface regarding traffic management of Common Transport Channels, and what are the two functionalities involved in it?
question_66293.ground_truth: The Iur interface handles traffic management of Common Transport Channels through the preparation of Common Transport Channel resources and paging functionality.

question_66295.question: What mechanism does the MCData Service provide to enable private communications off-network?
question_66295.ground_truth: The MCData Service provides a mechanism for an MCData User to cancel a private communication prior to the communication setup, and a means for an authorized MCData User to initiate a private communication with any MCData User for which they are authorized.

question_66299.question: What is the role of MME in the NAS Resumption procedure in EPS?
question_66299.ground_truth: In the NAS Resumption procedure in EPS, the MME sends S11 message to SGW for different PDN connections/services indicating the return to normal MT service handling.

question_66301.question: What is the condition for the Psharing factor to be equal to 1 when the reference signals are not fully overlapped by intra-frequency SMTC occasions?
question_66301.ground_truth: The condition is that the reference signals are not fully overlapped by intra-frequency SMTC occasions and not overlapped by SSB symbols or 1 symbol before and after each consecutive SSB symbols.

question_66302.question: What is the role of the PS-Information AVP in transmitting additional PS service specific information elements?
question_66302.ground_truth: The PS-Information AVP is of type Grouped and allows the transmission of additional PS service specific information elements in the 3GPP network.

question_66303.question: What are the three functionalities that the ProSe Server can have as defined in the Presence specification?
question_66303.ground_truth: The ProSe Server can have the functionality of a watcher, fetcher, and/or principal.

question_66305.question: What actions shall the MCVideo client take when in the "S2: waiting for call announcement" state, upon expiry of TFG1 (wait for call announcement), as per TS 24.281 clause 9.3.2.4.3.1?
question_66305.ground_truth: The MCVideo client shall stop timer TFG3, generate an SDP body, store the SDP body, generate a random number, store the refresh interval, store its own MCVideo user ID, store the current UTC time, generate a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message, send the message, establish a media session, start transmission control as an originating transmission participant, start timers TFG6 and TFG2, and enter the "S3: part of ongoing call" state.

question_66307.question: What is the requirement for the BW (Bandwidth) of the CSI-RS on the intra-frequency neighbor cell for CSI-RS based measurements?
question_66307.ground_truth: The BW of the CSI-RS on the intra-frequency neighbor cell should be within the active BWP (Bandwidth Part) of the UE.

question_66310.question: What is the purpose of the UE-initiated non-SM message transport procedure?
question_66310.ground_truth: The UE-initiated non-SM message transport procedure provides a transport of SMS or an LPP message from the UE to the AMF in a 5GMM message.

question_66311.question: What is the maximum time allowed to read BCCH data from the target GERAN cell (Tsi-GERAN) in the test?

question_66312.question: What are the two types of transmitter intermodulation cases captured by the transmitter intermodulation requirement for BS type 1-H?
question_66312.ground_truth: The two types of transmitter intermodulation cases for BS type 1-H are co-location transmitter intermodulation and intra-system transmitter intermodulation, where the interfering signal is from a co-located base station and from other transmitter units within the BS type 1-H, respectively.

question_66313.question: What is the maximum number of times the "serviceArea" element can appear in the "infoBinding" element?
question_66313.ground_truth: The "serviceArea" element can appear an unbounded number of times in the "infoBinding" element, as indicated by the "maxOccurs" attribute.

question_66314.question: What is the impact of network congestion on the QoS of Camera#1 and Camera#4?
question_66314.ground_truth: When the target QoS of Camera#1 can't be guaranteed due to network congestion, 5GS reduces QoS of Camera#4 to make sure QoS of Camera#1 is guaranteed. Once the congestion is relieved, 5GS increases QoS of Camera#4 while the target QoS of Camera#1 is still guaranteed.

question_66315.question: What is the difference between PLMN Authentication and NPN Authentication in the context of network access?
question_66315.ground_truth: PLMN Authentication refers to the authentication of a UE (User Equipment) with a PLMN (Public Land Mobile Network) using PLMN-specific credentials, while NPN Authentication is the authentication of a UE using NPN (Non-Public Network) specific credentials for NPN access.

question_66320.question: How can security procedures be implemented during the Direct communication phase on WLAN Direct?
question_66320.ground_truth: Security material for WLAN Direct communication can be pre-provisioned in the UEs, or security keys can be provided by the serving MME following similar procedures to network authorized procedures.

question_66321.question: How does the Logical Channel Prioritization procedure work in 3GPP TS 38.321?
question_66321.ground_truth: In 3GPP TS 38.321, the Logical Channel Prioritization procedure is applied whenever a new transmission is performed, with priorities set by RRC for each logical channel, and resources allocated to logical channels in decreasing priority order based on the PBR (Prioritized Bit Rate) and BSD (Bucket Size Duration) values.
