question_67345.question: What is one potential action the M2M service may take if data transmission is less urgent?
question_67345.ground_truth: If data transmission is less urgent, then depending on the estimated time of mitigation of the congestion situation, the M2M service may try sending the data at a later time.

question_67346.question: When would the data volume be counted once in case of redundant transmission over the N3 interface?
question_67346.ground_truth: The data volume would be counted once in the following cases: for Dual Connectivity based on redundant User Plane Paths, for redundant transmission with two N3/N9 tunnels between NG-RAN and PSA UPF, and for redundant transmission between the NG-RAN and PSA UPF with a single PDU Session.

question_67347.question: What should the UE do before sending aperiodic L1-SINR measurement reports?
question_67347.ground_truth: The UE should receive a DCI for triggering report before sending aperiodic L1-SINR measurement reports.

question_67348.question: What is the procedure when the user equipment (UE) is in CM-IDLE state and the 3GPP access is available, and the access and mobility management function (AMF) initiates the paging procedure for a network triggered service request?
question_67348.ground_truth: The UE initiates the UE triggered service request procedure when it receives the paging request from the AMF.

question_67349.question: What is the purpose of transferring the "UE security capability" information in an unprotected message?
question_67349.ground_truth: The purpose of transferring the "UE security capability" information in an unprotected message is to provide the network with the ciphering and integrity capabilities of the MS, so that the integrity protection can be started after receiving the correct "UE security capability" information.

question_67350.question: Under what conditions will the AMF include the non-3GPP de-registration timer value IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
question_67350.ground_truth: The AMF will include the non-3GPP de-registration timer value IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message only if the REGISTRATION REQUEST message was sent over the non-3GPP access.

question_67351.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the E-UTRAN FDD - UTRAN FDD handover test in this test case?
question_67351.ground_truth: Instead of A.5.2.1, use A.5.2.11 for the minimum conformance requirements.

question_67352.question: What should be removed when the IWF performing the participating role receives a SIP 4xx, 5xx or 6xx response for an implicit affiliation status change operation?
question_67352.ground_truth: The MCData group ID entry added by the procedures of clause 8.3.2.12 should be removed if it has the MCData group ID set to the MCData group ID of the MCData group associated with the received SIP 4xx, 5xx, or 6xx response.

question_67353.question: What factors in addition to compression efficiency are considered for performance evaluation of UL data compression algorithms?
question_67353.ground_truth: Processing complexity of compressor/decompressor, memory requirements, byte alignment, and reliability.

question_67354.question: What message is returned by the BSS if it receives a VGCS/VBS ASSIGNMENT REQUEST message for a terrestrial circuit that is already assigned to another call?
question_67354.ground_truth: A VGCS/VBS ASSIGNMENT FAILURE message is returned with the Cause value of "terrestrial circuit already allocated".

question_67355.question: What is the behavior of the MS if the negotiated READY timer value indicates that the ready timer function is deactivated?
question_67355.ground_truth: If the negotiated READY timer value indicates that the ready timer function is deactivated, then the MS shall behave as if the READY timer never expires, i.e. the MS remains in the READY state all the time.

question_67356.question: When is it optional for the MCVideo client to include an "a=ssrc" attribute, indicating its preferred RTP SSRC to the MCVideo server for the subsequent RTP audio media flow?
question_67356.ground_truth: It is optional for the MCVideo client to include an "a=ssrc" attribute if it is initiating a call with implicit transmission request and the final RTP audio SSRC value that the client will have to use has not been received.

question_67357.question: What does the MCData message store return in response to a synchronization request from a message store client?
question_67357.ground_truth: The MCData message store returns all the stored objects, based on the synchronization filter criteria, to the message store client in the MCData synchronization response.

question_67358.question: What is the role of the "priority" element in the protocol extension container?
question_67358.ground_truth: The "priority" element in the protocol extension container indicates the priority of the request. It is used to determine the level of importance of a request, with priority level 1 being the highest and priority level 14 being the lowest.

question_67359.question: What is the basic conducted requirement for the in-band blocking frequency range, in 7.2.4 for minimum requirement for BS type 1-C and BS type 1-H?
question_67359.ground_truth: The minimum conducted requirement is defined at the antenna connector for BS type 1-C and at the TAB connector for BS type 1-H.

question_67361.question: What should the MCPTT Service do for private calls with floor control interworking between the MCPTT Service and non-3GPP PTT systems that do support private call override?
question_67361.ground_truth: The MCPTT Service shall provide a mechanism for Participants to override an active MCPTT transmission of a transmitting Participant when the priority level of the overriding Participant is ranked higher than the priority level of the transmitting Participant.

question_67362.question: Which capability of SEAL has been enhanced in Rel-17 to support temporary groups in a VAL system?

question_67363.question: What is the name of the message used to request CDMA2000 1xRTT Parameters from the network?

question_67364.question: What is the mobility management state of the MS after the network receives the packet paging response from the MS?
question_67364.ground_truth: After the network receives the packet paging response from the MS, the mobility management state of the MS is Ready.

question_67366.question: When must the UE be in State 3A-RF for the test to proceed?
question_67366.ground_truth: The UE must be in State 3A-RF (idle) for the test to proceed.

question_67367.question: What should the secondary device return as the HW or SW version number if the application is missing or no HW or SW version number is found?
question_67367.ground_truth: An empty string shall be returned as the HW or SW version number.

question_67368.question: What is the difference between a "Attempted Iu connection release" and a "Successful Iu connection release" measurement?
question_67368.ground_truth: "Attempted Iu connection release" measurement tracks the number of attempted releases by a CN, while "Successful Iu connection release" measurement tracks the number of successful releases by a CN.

question_67371.question: What is the maximum length of a Short Message (TP-UDL) value in SEND SHORT MESSAGE command of USS?
question_67371.ground_truth: The maximum length of a Short Message value in SEND SHORT MESSAGE command is 324967.

question_67373.question: What does the Absolute Grant (Power) Value in the E-AGCH represent, and what is its size in bits?
question_67373.ground_truth: The Absolute Grant (Power) Value in the E-AGCH represents a dB value used for power control. It is represented by 5 bits.

question_67374.question: What is the role of the MCVideo server~2 in the ad-hoc group call?
question_67374.ground_truth: The MCVideo server~2 receives and sends ad-hoc group call requests and responses between the MCVideo server~1 and the MCVideo clients~3/4.

question_67375.question: What should the MS do after successfully completing the CS handover from GAN A/Gb mode?
question_67375.ground_truth: After successfully completing the CS handover from GAN A/Gb mode, the MS should release all radio resources associated with the GAN connection, switch to target radio access technology mode, i.e. detach the GA-RR entity from the RR-SAP, and enter GA-RC-REGISTERED state.

question_67377.question: What should the MS do if the network grants it a single address PDP type when it requested a dual address PDP type (IPv4v6)?
question_67377.ground_truth: The MS should request for the activation of a parallel PDP Context to the same APN with a single address PDP type (IPv4 or IPv6) other than the one already activated.

question_67378.question: What is agreed for resource allocation in frequency-domain for SBFD operation in case of unaligned boundaries between resource block group(s)/reporting subband(s) and SBFD subbands?
question_67378.ground_truth: For SBFD-aware UEs, the part of the DL RBG inside the DL subband can be used and the part of the UL RBG inside the UL subband can be used for better resource utilization, at least for semi-static SBFD.

question_67381.question: What is the purpose of the 3gpp-Sbi-Max-Rsp-Time header in the 3GPP SBI interface?
question_67381.ground_truth: The 3gpp-Sbi-Max-Rsp-Time header indicates the duration expressed in milliseconds since the absolute time indicated in the 3gpp-Sbi-Sender-Timestamp header or the 3gpp-Sbi-Origination-Timestamp header.

question_67383.question: Who are notified on the main DCCH by the network regarding an MBMS session in dedicated mode or MAC-Dedicated state?
question_67383.ground_truth: Mobile stations in dedicated mode or MAC-Dedicated state

question_67387.question: What actions are taken in Step 6 for acknowledged LLC mode in the uplink slot allocation process?
question_67387.ground_truth: Downlink TBF establishment and PDP Context Activation are performed.

question_67388.question: What is the purpose of the test case 6.2.8.1 in the context of MCData client?
question_67388.ground_truth: The purpose of the test case 6.2.8.1 is to ensure that when the MCData client receives a SIP MESSAGE for a group standalone FD message with a mandatory download and without a disposition request, it responds with a SIP 200 OK message and generates an FD NOTIFICATION indicating acceptance of the FD request.

question_67389.question: What is the field that directly precedes the "Length of User Data Header" and represents the total length of the TP-User-Data field including its header, if present?

question_67392.question: What does the Open Service Access (OSA) enable within the network functional environment?
question_67392.ground_truth: The OSA enables applications implementing the services to make use of network functionality, allowing developers to design new applications or enhancements with a minimum impact on the application's design when new network functionality becomes available.

question_67393.question: What is the maximum length of time that an eCall modem transmission trial can last if the error patterns are used in the GSM FR radio channel error condition?
question_67393.ground_truth: If the error patterns are used in the GSM FR radio channel error condition, the maximum length of time that an eCall modem transmission trial can last is 200 seconds.

question_67394.question: What is the acknowledgement mechanism used by the k layer entity for I-frames?
question_67394.ground_truth: The k layer entity uses the N(R) value in the received frame as an acknowledgement for all the I-frames it has transmitted with an N(S) up to and including the received N(R)-1.

question_67395.question: What are the two points of reference for the requirements in the AAS BS?
question_67395.ground_truth: The requirements in the AAS BS are defined for two points of reference - Radiated requirements and Conducted requirements.

question_67397.question: What is the purpose of the "Extended LADN information" information element?
question_67397.ground_truth: The "Extended LADN information" information element is included to assign new extended LADN information to the UE or delete the extended LADN information at the UE side.

question_67399.question: What is the UL index LSB value for a slot-PUSCH transmission in slot 4, 15, or 16 that is scheduled with a PDCCH/SPDCCH in which the LSB of the UL index is set to 1?
question_67399.ground_truth: The UL index LSB value is 5.

question_67400.question: What should be the position of the last CSI report received by the SS, relative to subframe (n+8), for the event "Deactivation" to be considered a success in the intra-band PCell TDD case?
question_67400.ground_truth: The last CSI report should be received by the SS earlier than or equal to subframe (n+8) for the event "Deactivation" to be considered a success in the intra-band PCell TDD case.

question_67401.question: What event triggers the SMF to send a notification before activating the UP path towards a new DNAI?
question_67401.ground_truth: A DNAI change in UP path management events.

question_67403.question: What is Dual Tone Multi Frequency (DTMF) signalling within the 3GPP system?
question_67403.ground_truth: It is a system used for sending signals over the 3GPP network, typically from a mobile device to a landline. It is used to transmit specific tones, representing specific digits, that are used to convey information through the network.

question_67404.question: What is the function of the Network Node Selection Function (NNSF) in eNodeB?
question_67404.ground_truth: The Network Node Selection Function (NNSF) in eNodeB is responsible for routing messages based on the MME Code, GUTI, and GUMMEI included in the messages.

question_67405.question: When will logical call records be output during call processing in the gsmSSF?
question_67405.ground_truth: Logical call records will be output when a disconnection event is propagated to the call leg associated with it, or when a Connect operation to create a connection to a Follow-on Called Party is received.

question_67406.question: What is the type of file format used for the rate switching profile in the encoder program?
question_67406.ground_truth: The rate switching profile in the encoder program is a binary file, generated by 'gen-rate-profile', which is part of STL 2009, as contained in ITU-T G.191.

question_67407.question: What types of policies/parameters can be requested in the UE Policy Container for UE triggered 5G ProSe policy provisioning?
question_67407.ground_truth: The types of policies/parameters that can be requested include those for 5G ProSe Direct Discovery, 5G ProSe Direct Communication, 5G ProSe Layer-2 Remote UE, 5G ProSe Layer-3 Remote UE, 5G ProSe Layer-2 UE-to-Network Relay, 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-Network Relay, 5G ProSe Layer-2 End UE, 5G ProSe Layer-3 End UE, 5G ProSe Layer-2 UE-to-UE Relay, and 5G ProSe Layer-3 UE-to-UE Relay.

question_67408.question: What is the function of the Nature of Address Indicator in the GT, and which specific type of address does the value 000 0100 represent?
question_67408.ground_truth: The Nature of Address Indicator in the GT indicates the type of numbering system, and the value 000 0100 specifically refers to an International Significant Number.

question_67409.question: What should the MBMS client do if it receives a regular HTTP GET request with the 'Accept' header that does not contain 'application/3gpp-partial' media type and it has received a partial file with at least one byte?
question_67409.ground_truth: The MBMS client should respond with HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found, and include 'application/3gpp-partial' in the response.

question_67410.question: What are the main considerations when investigating NodeB receiver blocking compared to the existing TS 25.104 (Standalone) and TS 37.104 (Multi-carrier)?
question_67410.ground_truth: The main considerations are the ACS (Adjacent Channel Selectivity) and in-band blocking for Band I and Band VIII in Standalone scenarios. For Band I, it is important to have at least 2.5/N MHz +200 kHz for 5/N MHz time-dilated UMTS carriers, while for Band VIII, stricter design is required to resist narrow band blocking interference. The same requirements apply for Band VIII.

question_67411.question: What information does the EC AF provide to the local NEF to get relevant information from MnS producer?
question_67411.ground_truth: The EC AF provides data delivery information, the APP or EAS identity, and information needed to get information from MnS producer.

question_67412.question: What is the first message sent from the New RAN during a UE connection request?
question_67412.ground_truth: The first message sent from the New RAN during a UE connection request is the INITIAL UE MESSAGE.

question_67414.question: What is the difference between EMM-CONNECTED mode and EMM-IDLE mode in the 3GPP System Architecture Evolution (SAE)?
question_67414.ground_truth: A UE is in EMM-CONNECTED mode when there is a NAS signalling connection established between UE and the network, while a UE is in EMM-IDLE mode when no NAS signalling connection between UE and network exists.

question_67415.question: What should be included in a CFNRy registration request from a mobile user?
question_67415.ground_truth: A CFNRy registration request from a mobile user should include the SS-Code of the forwarding service to be registered and possibly the applicable BasicServiceCode and NoReplyConditionTime.

question_67417.question: What is the role of MIP in the non-3GPP access system when the UE is not performing handovers between access systems?
question_67417.ground_truth: There is overhead from Mobile IP tunnelling when the UE is not performing handovers between access systems.

question_67419.question: What is the primary purpose of the ARP in the context of bearer establishment or modification requests?
question_67419.ground_truth: The primary purpose of the ARP is to decide whether a bearer establishment / modification request can be accepted or needs to be rejected due to resource limitations, with the priority level used to ensure that the request of the bearer with the higher priority level is preferred.

question_67422.question: What action is taken when a mobile is in the EMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE substate?
question_67422.ground_truth: The substate EMM-REGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE is chosen in the UE, if it is known that a selected cell is unable to provide normal service.

question_67423.question: What does CACLR represent in a gap between passbands?
question_67423.ground_truth: CACLR in a gap between passbands is the ratio of the sum of the filtered mean power centered on the assigned channel frequencies for the two carriers adjacent to each side of the gap between passbands, and the filtered mean power centered on a frequency channel adjacent to one of the respective passband edges.

question_67425.question: What type of connections can the UE and the P-CSCF set up from their client port to the other end's server port in the TCP case?
question_67425.ground_truth: Both the UE and the P-CSCF can set up a TCP connection from their client port to the other end's server port on demand.

question_67426.question: What band, when operating in DC, can cause IMD3 to fall into the own Rx of band n78, based on co-existence studies?

question_67427.question: What are the default conditions for the SS in this test?
question_67427.ground_truth: The default conditions for the SS simulate one cell with default settings as defined in the GPRS general defaults, except for the PCCCH description which is not supported by the network.

question_67428.question: What is the maximum range class for ProSe discovery that is allowed to use?
question_67428.ground_truth: The maximum range class for ProSe discovery that is allowed to use is one of the aspects that need to be considered in the authorization for ProSe capability feature solutions when authorizing the UE.

question_67429.question: Which type of packets can be more processing intensive for identifying and characterizing PDU sets in HTTP/2 and HTTP/3?
question_67429.ground_truth: Packets that carry multiple streams that are dynamically ordered and possibly encrypted.

question_67430.question: In the scenario described in step 5.4.6, what is the pre-requisite for the retrieval of the IMEI when requested by an IMS-AS?
question_67430.ground_truth: The IMEI for a given UE stored in HSS and UDM is always synchronized. When the HSS detects that the IMEI for a UE changes (e.g. during an Update Location in EPS), the HSS informs the UDM about the IMEI change which stores the new IMEI accordingly. Similarly, when UDM detects that the IMEI changes, the UDM informs the HSS about the IMEI change which stores the new IMEI accordingly. This allows that the retrieval of the IMEI for a given UE requested by an IMS-AS from HSS via Sh can be executed locally by HSS without the need of additional interworking between the HSS and the UDM.

question_67432.question: What is the role of the NRF in the SMF selection and reselection procedure?
question_67432.ground_truth: The NRF is used to select I-SMFs based on S-NSSAI and UE location information when the AMF cannot determine whether an I-SMF needs to be selected or not.

question_67433.question: What type of service operates in ITS spectrum and/or LTE licensed operating bands for communication between vehicles and everything?

question_67435.question: What is the delay for a UE to start sending SYNCH-UL sequence for sending the RRC CELL UPDATE message to the UTRAN during cell re-selection to a TDD cell in CELL_FACH state?
question_67435.ground_truth: The delay for a UE to start sending SYNCH-UL sequence for sending the RRC CELL UPDATE message to the UTRAN during cell re-selection to a TDD cell in CELL_FACH state is called the cell re-selection delay.

question_67436.question: What is the OCF (Operation and Maintenance Conformance Framework) conformance requirement for the TP-UDHI and TP-User-Data-Header?
question_67436.ground_truth: The OCF conformance requirement for the TP-UDHI and TP-User-Data-Header is covered in TS 23.040, clause 9.2.3.23 and 9.2.3.24.

question_67437.question: What bands should not share the same antenna with Band 4, 10, 41 or 43 BS receiver in order to prevent desensitization?

question_67438.question: What is the maximum allowed time for a UE to start transmitting a new PRACH after receiving an RRC command during handover with PSCell?

question_67439.question: What is required for a UE or an Application Server to use the MSGin5G Service?
question_67439.ground_truth: They need to register with the MSGin5G Server using their identity, security credentials, supported capabilities, and availability.

question_67440.question: What is the difference between Class 1 and Class 2 Elementary Procedures (EPs) in SLmAP?
question_67440.ground_truth: Class 1 EPs are those that have a response message, while Class 2 EPs are those that do not have a response message and are considered always successful.

question_67441.question: When should the MAC entity select Random Access Preambles group B for 2-step RA type during a Random Access procedure?
question_67441.ground_truth: The MAC entity should select Random Access Preambles group B for 2-step RA type if the Random Access procedure was initiated for the CCCH logical channel and the CCCH SDU size plus MAC subheader is greater than ra-MsgA-SizeGroupA.

question_67442.question: What is the reporting range for SRS-RSRP and its resolution?
question_67442.ground_truth: The reporting range of SRS-RSRP is defined from -140 dBm to -44 dBm with 1 dB resolution.

question_67443.question: What is the role of rATType in the PDUSessionUsageReport definition?
question_67443.ground_truth: rATType represents the type of technology used in the radio access network for the PDUSession, which can be nr, eutra, nr-unlicensed, e-utra-unlicensed, or other.

question_67444.question: What information is provided by the HSS for V2X communication over PC5 reference point?
question_67444.ground_truth: The HSS provides information on whether the UE is authorized to perform V2X communication over PC5 reference point, UE-PC5-AMBR for V2X communication over PC5 reference point, PC5 QoS parameters for V2X communication over NR PC5 reference point, and the list of PLMNs where the UE is authorized to perform V2X communication over PC5 reference point.

question_67445.question: In the urban microcell environment, how are the path powers determined?
question_67445.ground_truth: In the urban microcell environment, the path powers are determined using a power-delay envelope, which is the average behavior of the power-delay profile. These powers are then varied with respect to the average envelope using a randomizing process to reproduce the variations experienced in the actual channel.

question_67448.question: What should the mobile station do if timer T3168 expires and the PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message has been transmitted four times?
question_67448.ground_truth: Perform an abnormal release with access retry

question_67449.question: What happens when MCPTT client 1 finishes transmission and releases the floor in a private call controlled by the LMR system?
question_67449.ground_truth: The media flows from the LMR user to the IWF and on to MCPTT client 1 (7a) and (7b).

question_67450.question: In the Stale Check procedure, what HTTP status code is returned by the NF service consumer in case of partial success when responding to the POST request sent by the UDM?

question_67451.question: What is the purpose of the MS sending PACKET CELL CHANGE NOTIFICATION in the CCN mode?
question_67451.ground_truth: The MS sends PACKET CELL CHANGE NOTIFICATION in the CCN mode to indicate that it has entered a congestion control mode (CCN) due to a low signal strength.

question_67453.question: Which clause in TS 24.501 is relevant to the UE in single-registration mode with Interworking without N26 interface supported?
question_67453.ground_truth: Clause 4.5.4.1 in TS 24.501 is relevant to the UE in single-registration mode with Interworking without N26 interface supported.

question_67454.question: What is involved in the message protection functionality of the N32-f interface?
question_67454.ground_truth: The message protection functionality of the N32-f interface involves applying application layer security mechanisms to protect messages exchanged between NF service consumers and NF service producers across PLMNs.

question_67456.question: What message does the Anchor MSC-1 server send to the far end MSC-2 server to prepare for LCLS disconnection for Handover?
question_67456.ground_truth: The Anchor MSC-1 server sends the "LCLS-Status-Change-Request" message to the far end MSC-2 server to prepare for LCLS disconnection for Handover.

question_67458.question: What is the purpose of activating RCI reporting in the 3GPP system?
question_67458.ground_truth: Activating RCI reporting allows the eNodeB to send congestion information to the PCRF for a specific UE's EPS bearer, which the PCRF can use to determine the appropriate congestion mitigation/abatement status.

question_67459.question: What is the cause value set in the PACKET CELL CHANGE FAILURE message if the PACKET CELL CHANGE ORDER message commands the mobile station to a frequency in a frequency band not supported by the mobile station?
question_67459.ground_truth: The cause value set in the PACKET CELL CHANGE FAILURE message is "frequency not implemented" if the PACKET CELL CHANGE ORDER message commands the mobile station to a frequency in a frequency band not supported by the mobile station.

question_67460.question: What is the purpose of the test in section 9.3.7H.3?
question_67460.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in section 9.3.7H.3 is to verify that when using the transport format (TF) based on the median CQI, the BLER for blocks associated with CQI reports of median CQI is less than or equal to 60%, and the BLER for blocks associated with CQI reports of median CQI+2 is less than or equal to 15%.

question_67462.question: What is the purpose of using Policy-Counter-Id in charging session establishment?
question_67462.ground_truth: The Policy-Counter-Id is used to reference counters that are applicable for a single service or a group of services in the OCS. When services are mapped to the same Policy-Counter-Id, they share the same counter state and applicable threshold values in the OCS.

question_67464.question: What is the minimum requirement for transmit intermodulation for all TDD options?
question_67464.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for transmit intermodulation is that the transmit intermodulation level should not exceed the out of band or the spurious emission requirements of subclause 6.6.2 and 6.6.3, respectively.

question_67465.question: What is the identity used for the UE requested ESM procedures and released when the procedure is completed?

question_67466.question: What is the function of a speech transcoder in a GSM or 3G system?
question_67466.ground_truth: A speech transcoder in a GSM or 3G system converts the speech encoding from one format, usually from G.711, to a format optimized for the transmission over the Air Interface, relating to a specific speech Codec.

question_67467.question: What actions are taken when a functional alias is deactivated/activated or shared between several MC service IDs?
question_67467.ground_truth: When a functional alias is deactivated, the corresponding location management client stops sending periodic location information reports. If a functional alias is activated for a new MC service client, the location management server activates location information reporting for this location management client. If a functional alias is shared between several MC service IDs, all location management clients sharing the same functional alias will send location information until the functional alias status changes for the individual MC service IDs, such as in the case of a takeover.

question_67468.question: What is the effect of fine-tuning dataset size on positioning error when changing the InF scenario from scenario A to scenario B?
question_67468.ground_truth: The positioning error varies, with a smaller fine-tuning dataset size resulting in a larger positioning error in some cases and a smaller positioning error in others.

question_67469.question: What should be included in the SIP MESSAGE request when sending SDS messages or SDS disposition notifications in order to indicate the correct media feature tag?
question_67469.ground_truth: The Accept-Contact header field containing the g.3gpp.mcdata.sds media feature tag.

question_67471.question: When are IRI records generated for the start and end of a multi-party call (MPTY) conference?
question_67471.ground_truth: IRI records are generated for the events indicating the start and the end of the MPTY conference.

question_67472.question: What is the test purpose when testing the behavior of the MS for the GPRS detach procedure for non-GPRS services?
question_67472.ground_truth: The test purpose is to ensure that the MS can perform an GPRS detach for non-GPRS services and that CS services are not possible afterwards. The MS achieves this by performing a GPRS attach for non-GPRS services by a routing area update procedure and CS services are not possible afterwards.

question_67473.question: What is the type of the "latitude" and "longitude" elements in the "tPointCoordinate" complex type as defined in the XML schema?
question_67473.ground_truth: The "latitude" and "longitude" elements in the "tPointCoordinate" complex type are of type "sealloc:tCoordinateType", which likely represents a coordinate within a geographical area.

question_67474.question: What is the modulation type used for the wanted signal in the last test scenario?
question_67474.ground_truth: The modulation type used for the wanted signal is 8-PSK.

question_67475.question: What factors impact the NAS layer, OS layer, and application when supporting the edge relocation solution?
question_67475.ground_truth: The impacts to the NAS layer, OS layer, and application include receiving the new EAS's information (new EAS address and its FQDN and/or the UE port number, and the indication for UE to suspend uplink data) in the NAS layer, re-establishing a connection with the target EAS, suspending and resuming the uplink transferring of application data in the NAS layer, and recognizing the new EAS IP address provided by the lower layer and switching to the new EAS use it in the application client layer.

question_67476.question: How should the ePDG handle a downlink IP packet received via an S2b bearer of the PDN connection?
question_67476.ground_truth: The ePDG shall forward a downlink IP packet received via an S2b bearer of the PDN connection using a UE's ESP SPI bound to the S2b bearer. The ePDG shall set the DSCP field of the outer IP header of the ESP packet based on the QCI and ARP of the S2b bearer via which the downlink packet was received.

question_67477.question: What are the initial conditions for Test requirement 27.22.4.26.7.4.1?
question_67477.ground_truth: The ME is connected to the USIM Simulator and the USS. The elementary files are coded as USIM Application Toolkit default. Prior to this test, the ME shall have been powered on and performed the PROFILE DOWNLOAD procedure.

question_67481.question: What factors can the UDR selection function in UDR NF consumers consider when selecting a UDR instance?
question_67481.ground_truth: The UDR selection function in UDR NF consumers can consider the Data Set Identifier of the data to be managed in UDR, UDM Group ID the UE's SUPI belongs to, SUPI, GPSI or External Group ID, and UDR capability to store application data that is applicable on any UE.

question_67482.question: What is the purpose of the P-Visited-Network-ID header field in the SIP REGISTER request message?
question_67482.ground_truth: The P-Visited-Network-ID header field in the SIP REGISTER request message contains the identifier of the P-CSCF network, which may be the visited network domain name or any other identifier that identifies the visited network at the home network.

question_67483.question: What is the recommended range for the ARP priority level for QoS Flows within an operator domain?
question_67483.ground_truth: The recommended range for the ARP priority level for QoS Flows within an operator domain is 1 to 8, with 1 being the highest priority.

question_67484.question: Which bit rate demonstrates improved performance of EVS-WB compared to EVS AMR-WB IO case C in FER conditions?

question_67485.question: What is the purpose of the SSAP protocol in CCBS?
question_67485.ground_truth: The SSAP protocol is used for CCBS procedures on the interface between the originating and destination networks.

question_67486.question: What is the role of MNO B in managing and authorizing avatar usage rights?
question_67486.ground_truth: MNO B provides management and authorization of avatar usage rights, including assigning unique identification codes for avatars, identifying and storing avatars and their IDs, associating avatars with their owners, and providing avatar storage services.

question_67487.question: What are some of the service requirements for the MSGin5G Service?
question_67487.ground_truth: Some of the service requirements for the MSGin5G Service include support for various message communication models (e.g. point-to-point, application-to-point, group and broadcast messaging), support for addressing UEs by IMSI/MSISDN or IMEI, support for varying payload sizes, and support for message delivery acknowledgements.

question_67488.question: What is the role of the Messaging SCF in the OSA MM APIs?
question_67488.ground_truth: The Messaging SCF in the OSA MM APIs can interface with various messaging network elements or contain those network elements, using network protocols that are not mandated by OSA Multi Media Messaging SCF.

question_67489.question: What is prohibited for entities on the signalling path to insert into the media path that intervene above the transport layer?
question_67489.ground_truth: Transcoding, language translation, recording, re-encrypting and re-signing are prohibited for entities on the signalling path to insert into the media path that intervene above the transport layer.

question_67491.question: What is the primary mechanism used to ensure data integrity in the T.30 protocol procedure?
question_67491.ground_truth: The primary mechanism used to ensure data integrity in the T.30 protocol procedure is a confirmation mechanism that is used at the beginning and at the end of the Fax page transmission.

question_67492.question: What does the UE do with the assistance data received from the LMF in the DL-TDOA positioning method?
question_67492.ground_truth: The UE stores the assistance data for the TRP and maintains the already stored assistance data for other TRPs. If the UE receives assistance data for a TRP for which it has already stored assistance data, it overwrites the stored assistance data.

question_67494.question: What simple type is used to define the tOperationResultType enumeration that can have one of the two values: "Success" or "Failure"?
question_67494.ground_truth: The simple type tOperationResultType defines the enumeration with two possible values: "Sucess" or "Failure" and is used to specify the operation result in various complex types.

question_67495.question: What is the purpose of the PID field in the PDCP PDU?
question_67495.ground_truth: The PID field in the PDCP PDU is used to identify different types of header compression protocols and to distinguish different header compression protocol packet types within a header compression protocol.

question_67498.question: What should the IBCF do if the SDP answer contains at least one of the codecs from the original SDP offer?
question_67498.ground_truth: The IBCF shall not invoke the transcoding function.

question_67499.question: What is the default behavior of the S-CSCF if the contact of the application server fails in UE-originating or UE-terminating requests?
question_67499.ground_truth: If the contact of the application server fails, the S-CSCF shall use the "default handling" associated with the initial Filter Criteria to determine if it shall either terminate the call or let the call continue based on the information in the filter criteria. The default behavior is to let the call continue.

question_67500.question: In which scenarios are the CAG restrictions for accessing a PLMN's 5GCN not applied?
question_67500.ground_truth: The CAG restrictions are not applied in a PLMN when a UE accesses the PLMN due to emergency services or emergency services fallback.

question_67501.question: What is the functional difference between Option A and Option B in terms of LCS functionalities implementation?
question_67501.ground_truth: In Option A, the AMF partially implements LSOF functionality, while the MME implements most of the LCS functionalities. In Option B, the LMF implements all LCS functionalities in E-SMLC and most of the LCS functionalities in MME. Additionally, Option B utilizes UDSF to store UE-related positioning context.

question_67502.question: What is the end-to-end delay requirement for transferring V2N Service layer messages between a UE and receiving UEs in the E-UTRAN?
question_67502.ground_truth: The end-to-end delay for transferring V2N Service layer messages should not be larger than 500 ms in the E-UTRAN.

question_67503.question: What happens to all IMSI records in a VLR when it restarts after a failure?
question_67503.ground_truth: All IMSI records affected by the failure are erased and must be restored individually through "Provide Roaming Number" requests or "Update Location Area" requests for each mobile station.

question_67508.question: What are some capabilities provided by MBS that could be used by the NRM server?
question_67508.ground_truth: The capabilities provided by MBS that could be used by the NRM server include MBS session creation, MBS session update, MBS session release, MBS session ID allocation, and dynamic PCC control for MBS session.

question_67509.question: What message does the UE send to the gNB to initiate the LTM procedure?
question_67509.ground_truth: The UE sends a MeasurementReport message to the gNB.

question_67510.question: What is the length of each segment used in the time-domain transient detector?
question_67510.ground_truth: Each segment used in the time-domain transient detector is of length 2.5 milliseconds.

question_67512.question: What information element is used to associate all the messages belonging to the same procedure?

question_67513.question: What should the UE do when timer T3346 is running and a new PLMN is entered while the UE is in state EMM-REGISTERED?
question_67513.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3346 when initiating mobility management procedures in the new PLMN.

question_67514.question: What should the UE do, if it cannot successfully decode the BSIC of a GSM BCCH carrier within a certain time limit?
question_67514.ground_truth: The UE shall abort the BSIC decoding attempts for that specific GSM BCCH carrier and proceed to try decoding the BSIC of the next carrier in signal strength order.

question_67515.question: What is the purpose of HARQ entity in the MAC layer for transmitting on the UL-SCH?
question_67515.ground_truth: The HARQ entity in the MAC layer is responsible for transmitting on the UL-SCH by receiving uplink grants from lower layers and performing HARQ information and handling for the requested transmissions.

question_67516.question: What happens if the PCEF rejects the establishment of a default bearer in a roaming scenario?
question_67516.ground_truth: If the PCEF rejects the establishment of the default bearer, this implies that Attach via E-UTRAN will fail.

question_67517.question: What UE behavior is required when there is a PUSCH repetition Type A or TB processing over multiple slots, and AvailableSlotCounting is enabled?
question_67517.ground_truth: The UE counts the slots in the number of slots for a PUSCH transmission if it does not transmit the PUSCH in the scheduled slot.

question_67518.question: What should the IP-SM-GW set the Content-Type header to in a SIP MESSAGE request when sending a short message?
question_67518.ground_truth: The IP-SM-GW should set the Content-Type header to "multipart/mixed" in a SIP MESSAGE request when sending a short message.

question_67520.question: What is the interface used by the data streaming and distribution function of the MCData server to send multicast data stream to the DS function of the MCData client in the MCData-DS-3 reference point?
question_67520.ground_truth: The MB2-U interface defined in 3GPP TS 23.468 is used in the MCData-DS-3 reference point.

question_67521.question: What is the expected result in the proactiveCommandBuffer if CatSetupIdleModeText is called with a length of 0 and a non-null text in Test Case 3?

question_67522.question: What are the two possible ways to represent a user's position in a volumetric scene?
question_67522.ground_truth: A user's position in a volumetric scene can be represented by either a set of X, Y, and Z coordinates in the Cartesian coordinate system or by a translation matrix.

question_67523.question: What is the role of the 3GPP AAA Proxy in the LBO case?
question_67523.ground_truth: The 3GPP AAA Proxy acts as an intermediary, forwarding messages between the 3GPP AAA Server in the HPLMN and the PDN GW in the VPLMN.

question_67524.question: What is CoID defined as in 3GPP TS 23.153?
question_67524.ground_truth: CoID is defined as the Codec IDentification in 3GPP TS 23.153, denoting a specific Codec Type.

question_67525.question: What encoding style does the SOAP Solution Set (SS) use in WSDL file?
question_67525.ground_truth: The SOAP Solution Set (SS) uses "literal" encoding style in WSDL file.

question_67527.question: What interfaces are present in the reference architecture for network slice ordering, provisioning and assurance?
question_67527.ground_truth: The interfaces present in this reference architecture include Interface ITF-1, ITF-2, ITF-3, ITF-4, ITF-5, and ITF-6, which represent inter- and intra-organization interfaces within the network slice management system.

question_67528.question: How does intent translation occur in Intent-driven MnS?
question_67528.ground_truth: Intent translation involves the MnS producer deriving activities for networks and services or other intents based on the MnS consumer's request. This may involve consuming other management services to fulfil or satisfy the intent. Conflicts between the intent and other intents or non-intent requirements must be detected and resolved during the intent translation process.

question_67529.question: What is the main difference between "PMM-CONNECTED" and "PMM-IDLE" state for a UE?
question_67529.ground_truth: A UE in "PMM-CONNECTED" state has an RRC connection established and radio resources are reserved for data transfer, whereas a UE in "PMM-IDLE" state is allowed to select a different RAN node for continuing MBMS services.

question_67530.question: What should the TAC element in the IMEI-rangeType element contain?
question_67530.ground_truth: A decimal value with a maximum of 8 digits.

question_67532.question: What are the key enablers for media producers to leverage the network of a Mobile Network Operator for an Outside Broadcast contribution event?
question_67532.ground_truth: The NEF APIs are the key enablers for media producers to leverage the network of a Mobile Network Operator for an Outside Broadcast contribution event.

question_67533.question: Which entity supports the functions for the N5 and N33 reference points in the 5GS?

question_67535.question: What is the maximum code block size in the E-UTRA system?
question_67535.ground_truth: The maximum code block size in the E-UTRA system is Z = 6144.

question_67536.question: What should the 5G System support to allow a PIN to use PIN direct connection in non-operator managed spectrum when it has no connectivity to the 5G system?
question_67536.ground_truth: Mechanisms to provision a PIN and collect charging information regarding PIN Elements.

question_67537.question: What should the UE do if it receives the MTCH and identifies new intra-frequency cells?
question_67537.ground_truth: The UE should take the new intra-frequency cells into use for MTCH combing purposes.

question_67538.question: What is a device that has both a conducted RF interface and a radiated RF interface in the far field and conforms to a hybrid requirements set?

question_67540.question: Which organization is responsible for the "Charging for Optimal Media Routeing" work item?

question_67541.question: What must the MS do when it receives a command to change the MCS during the countdown procedure?
question_67541.ground_truth: The MS must recalculate the CV values for any untransmitted RLC data blocks using the new RLC data block size.

question_67543.question: What should the ePDG do if it supports emergency services and the UE indicated the establishment of an emergency session during the IKEv2 tunnel establishment?
question_67543.ground_truth: The ePDG shall include the Emergency-Services AVP, with the Emergency-Indication bit set, in the authentication and authorization request to the AAA Server.

question_67544.question: What is the role of NEF (Non-3GPP Network Function Entity) in QoS sustainability analytics for V2X communication?
question_67544.ground_truth: NEF corresponds to the NF (Network Function) consumer, and the V2X Application Server acting as an Application Function communicates with the NEF to obtain notifications on QoS sustainability analytics.

question_67546.question: What is the definition of Mobile Termination (MT) in the context of the 3GPP system?
question_67546.ground_truth: The term "Mobile Termination (MT)" in the context of the 3GPP system refers to a functional entity that contains the Terminal Adaptation Functions (TAF) which enables the use of synchronous bearer services in the PLMN and the attachment of Synchronous Terminals to an MT.

question_67547.question: What should the conference focus do upon receiving a REFER request that requests the removal of another conference participant?
question_67547.ground_truth: The conference focus should verify the conference URI, SIP URI, method parameter, and user identity before removing the requested conference participant.

question_67549.question: Which element shall be included in the <service-discovery-info> element?
question_67549.ground_truth: A <V2X-UE-id> element or a <result> element shall be included in the <service-discovery-info> element.

question_67550.question: What is the evaluation method for satellite backhaul category and backhaul delay for Solution #1?
question_67550.ground_truth: The satellite backhaul category and backhaul delay need to be stored for charging and statistics reasons in Solution #1.

question_67551.question: What is the aim of Solution 1 in enabling language-independent content in warning messages?
question_67551.ground_truth: The aim of Solution 1 is to enable language-independent content, such as unicode symbols, to be included in warning messages for devices with conventional display screens, making it possible for foreigners to intuitively understand the meaning of the contents.

question_67552.question: In what scenario is the UE allowed to initiate the Session Management procedures for high priority access and emergency services even when the Session Management back-off timer is running?
question_67552.ground_truth: When the UE needs to establish a session for high priority access or emergency services, it can still initiate the Session Management procedures even if the back-off timer is currently running.

question_67553.question: What network elements in EPC generate CDRs to collect charging information?
question_67553.ground_truth: SGSN, MME, S-GW, ePDG, TWAG, P-GW, and TDF generate CDRs to collect charging information.

question_67554.question: What is the test procedure for a UE with E-UTRA support to initiate an emergency call over IMS?
question_67554.ground_truth: The test procedure involves a manual or automatic eCall over IMS, emergency registration, SS waiting for INVITE request, sending 200 OK with ACK, and MT call release.

question_67559.question: What should an SGW do when it receives a Create Session Request message for a UE for which some S5/S8 bearers are maintained?
question_67559.ground_truth: The SGW should delete all the bearers for this UE and proceed with the Create Session Request message handling as specified in 3GPP TS~29.274.

question_67561.question: What is the definition of the reference sensitivity power level PREFSENS in LTE Rel-8?
question_67561.ground_truth: The reference sensitivity power level PREFSENS in LTE Rel-8 is the minimum mean power of a carrier received at the antenna connector at which a throughput requirement shall be met for a specified reference measurement channel.

question_67562.question: What is the definition of "direct network connection" as used in the document?
question_67562.ground_truth: A direct network connection is a mode of network connection where there is no relay UE between a UE and the 5G network.

question_67563.question: What happens when an MCPTT user receives an invitation to an MCPTT private call in manual commencement mode?
question_67563.ground_truth: The receiving MCPTT client sends an MCPTT ringing message to the MCPTT client that initiated the call.

question_67564.question: What is an example of a scenario that can cause overload in the 5GC service based interfaces due to UE initiated signalling?
question_67564.ground_truth: A large number of UEs performing mobility registration procedure, such as in densely populated areas with mass rapid transport systems.

question_67565.question: What are the conditions for the Random Access Preamble in Test 1?
question_67565.ground_truth: The Random Access Preamble shall be one of the Random Access Preambles associated with SSB index 0, arrive on a PRACH occasion which belongs to the PRACH occasions corresponding to the SSB with index 0, and the selected PRACH occasion shall belong to the PRACH occasions permitted by the restrictions given by the ra-ssb-OccasionMaskIndex.

question_67567.question: What is the purpose of the nonce input in the anchor key generation?
question_67567.ground_truth: The nonce input in the anchor key generation provides an additional layer of security by making it harder for an attacker to predict the key.

question_67568.question: In what circumstances should a UE not average CSI-RS measurements in subframe n1 with CSI-RS measurements in subframe n2 for a LAA Scell?
question_67568.ground_truth: The UE should not average CSI-RS measurement in subframe n1 with CSI-RS measurement in a later subframe n2, if any OFDM symbol of subframe n1 or any subframe from subframe n1+1 to subframe n2, is not occupied.

question_67569.question: What message does the MN send to the SN to indicate a change in the bearer context, such as adding, modifying, or releasing SCG bearer(s) or SCG RLC bearer(s)?

question_67572.question: If the UE fails to establish a PDU Session with any of the Route Selection Descriptors, what does the UE try next?
question_67572.ground_truth: The UE tries other URSP rules in the order of Rule Precedence with matching Traffic descriptors, except the URSP rule with the "match-all" Traffic descriptor, if any.

question_67573.question: What is the implication of Indirect Network Sharing on regulatory services support for participating operators and the hosting operator?
question_67573.ground_truth: The requirements to support regulatory services, such as PWS or emergency calls, apply to all operators participating in Indirect Network Sharing, as well as the hosting operator.

question_67574.question: What is the significance of a functional alias in the chat group (restricted) call model?
question_67574.ground_truth: A functional alias is a selected identifier used by a MCVideo client during the whole participation within a chat group call, it is used to indicate the user's membership in the group and to negotiate media parameters for the group call.

question_67575.question: What must the SGM-S do when it receives a group creation request with the "category" attribute value of "LOCATION_BASED"?
question_67575.ground_truth: The SGM-S must obtain the list of users based on the location provided in the "geoIds" attribute and include it in the group document. Additionally, the SGM-S must create a new individual group member resource for each new member in the group.

question_67576.question: What is the TEST REQUIREMENT for Method of Test 10.1 in the USIM Application Toolkit?
question_67576.ground_truth: The TEST REQUIREMENT for Method of Test 10.1 in the USIM Application Toolkit is that the ME shall operate in the manner defined in Expected Sequence 10.1, which involves DISPLAY TEXT for UCS2-coded Katakana characters.

question_67577.question: What is the IP mobility management selection when the UE provides an indication of its supported mobility modes during handover between accesses?
question_67577.ground_truth: The network makes the IPMS decision on handover to non-3GPP accesses based on the supported mobility modes between the two access technologies involved in the handover and the network's support for those modes.

question_67578.question: What action does the AMF take if it receives a Service Request that cannot be accepted by the network?
question_67578.ground_truth: The AMF responds with a Service Reject message to the UE.

question_67579.question: What is the purpose of the CFU service in 5G?
question_67579.ground_truth: The CFU service enables a served user to have the network redirect to another user communications which are addressed to the served user's address, and it may operate on all communication or just those associated with specified services. The served user's ability to originate communications is unaffected by the CFU supplementary service.

question_67580.question: What is the main difference between the normal mobile originating/terminating (multimedia) call scenario and the multimedia CAT call scenario?
question_67580.ground_truth: In the multimedia CAT call scenario, the UE indicates in the SETUP message if it supports the capability to setup an early multimedia CAT call prior to the multimedia call towards the end party signals.

question_67581.question: In which situation would users of MBMS UEs that only support a single MBMS bearer be subject to a degraded user experience?
question_67581.ground_truth: Users of MBMS UEs that only support a single MBMS bearer would be subject to a degraded user experience when the network distributes the content components of a MBMS User Service using multiple FLUTE sessions over multiple MBMS bearers, and those content components required for the consumption of a given MBMS application service are delivered on separate MBMS bearers.

question_67582.question: In which situations does the MAC entity need to flush the HARQ buffer of the identified HARQ process?
question_67582.ground_truth: When no MAC PDU has been obtained for the identified HARQ process and the uplink grant is not ignored.

question_67583.question: What should the UE do if it has an emergency PDU session established or is establishing an emergency PDU session and receives the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message before the timeout of timer T3520?
question_67583.ground_truth: The UE shall deem that the network has passed the authentication check successfully, stop timer T3520, respectively, and execute the security mode control procedure.

question_67584.question: What is the data type of the "ace-enabled-indicator" element in the "RestrictedDiscReq-info" and "RestrictedAnnounceRsp-info" complex types?
question_67584.ground_truth: The data type of the "ace-enabled-indicator" element in both the "RestrictedDiscReq-info" and "RestrictedAnnounceRsp-info" complex types is xs:integer.

question_67585.question: What is the cause of the higher set point required for beamforming transmit diversity?
question_67585.ground_truth: The higher set point is caused by the normalized mean square channel estimation error (NMSE) being worse for beamforming transmit diversity due to the induced fluctuations in the channel caused by the beamforming algorithm.

question_67587.question: In 6.6.2.6.2c, what is the reason for repeating step b) for the specific frequency bands?
question_67587.ground_truth: It is performed to ensure that the spurious emissions from the BSS transmitter antenna connector meet the requirements for those specific frequency bands.

question_67588.question: What is the purpose of providing "link-specific multipath" IP addresses/prefixes in the context of MPTCP and MPQUIC functionalities in the UPF?
question_67588.ground_truth: The "link-specific multipath" IP addresses/prefixes are provided for the UE to establish UDP subflows with the MPTCP and MPQUIC proxy functionalities in the UPF.

question_67589.question: What is the duration of the transient period between two SRS resources of an SRS resource set for antenna switching for 15kHz, 30kHz, and 60kHz SCS?
question_67589.ground_truth: The transient period between two SRS resources of an SRS resource set for antenna switching for 15kHz, 30kHz, and 60kHz SCS is one symbol.

question_67591.question: What is the "Initial Registration Success Rate of S-CSCF" KPI used to evaluate?
question_67591.ground_truth: The "Initial Registration Success Rate of S-CSCF" KPI is used to evaluate accessibility performance provided by IMS and network performance.

question_67592.question: What should the MCData client do upon receiving a SIP MESSAGE request for disposition notification for terminating MCData client?
question_67592.ground_truth: The MCData client should decode the contents of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcdata-signalling MIME body and deliver the notification to the user or application.

question_67594.question: What should the MCData Client do when the MCDATA User requests to send a one-to-one SDS Session message with a disposition of "READ" in step 3 of the procedure sequence?
question_67594.ground_truth: The MCData Client should send a one-to-one session SDS message via a MSRP SEND message with a disposition of "DELIVERY".

question_67595.question: What is the purpose of the Service-level-AA response information element?
question_67595.ground_truth: The Service-level-AA response information element provides information regarding the service level authentication and authorization request, e.g. to indicate that the authentication and authorization request to the service level authentication server was successful, or to notify that service level authorization is revoked.

question_67597.question: What is the purpose of the search range in the band search process?
question_67597.ground_truth: The search range in the band search process is used to define the frequency positions of the non-zero normalized low-frequency MDCT coefficients, which are used to calculate the correlation with the representative MDCT coefficients. By defining the search range, the computational complexity of the correlation calculation can be reduced, making the process more efficient.

question_67599.question: Which UE releases does the 9.2.29 test apply to?
question_67599.ground_truth: The 9.2.29 test applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE release 12 and forward.

question_67601.question: How can conformance to the AAS BS spurious emission requirements be demonstrated for single RAT E-UTRA operation?
question_67601.ground_truth: Conformance to the AAS BS spurious emission requirements can be demonstrated by meeting at least one of the following criteria as determined by the manufacturer for single RAT E-UTRA operation: (1) the sum of emissions power measured on each Tab connector in the Tab connector TX min cell group is less than or equal to the AAS BS limit, or (2) unwanted emissions power at each Tab connector is less than or equal to the AAS BS limit, scaled by -10log10(n), where n is the number of Tab connectors in the Tab connector TX min cell group.

question_67602.question: What is the applicability of the present document in relation to the CS core network?
question_67602.ground_truth: The present document is applicable only for ATM or IP transport in the CS core network.

question_67603.question: What is the smallest separation distance of own PCC UL and SCC DL for Band 4?
question_67603.ground_truth: The smallest separation distance of own PCC UL and SCC DL for Band 4 is 355 MHz.

question_67606.question: If the TEID range is managed by the NRF (Network Repository Function), what function does the NRF need to support in the solution described in section 6.14.3?
question_67606.ground_truth: The NRF needs to support the TEID management function in the solution described in section 6.14.3 if the TEID range is managed by the NRF.

question_67607.question: In the context of PDCP Duplication, what is the purpose of test case (1) in 7.1.3.5.5.1?
question_67607.ground_truth: The purpose of test case (1) is to ensure that when the UE has PDCP SDUs available for transmission, it transmits the PDCP SDUs on both the associated RLC entities.

question_67608.question: What method should an AF use to request the creation of an MBS session?
question_67608.ground_truth: An AF should send an HTTP POST request to the NEF to request the creation of an MBS session, with the request message body including the MbsSessionCreateReq data structure.

question_67610.question: What is the test purpose for the UE in non-emergency IMS services mode to initiate an eCall over IMS automatically?
question_67610.ground_truth: The purpose is to verify that the UE can correctly register to IMS emergency services and initiate an eCall over IMS in automatic mode.

question_67611.question: What is the purpose of the CAPIF enabling interactions between multiple API exposing functional entities within the same trust domain?
question_67611.ground_truth: The purpose is to support the discovery and usage of APIs within the same trust domain, allowing for seamless communication between different API provider domain functions.

question_67612.question: What is a pre-arranged group in the context of MCVideo?
question_67612.ground_truth: A pre-arranged group is an MCVideo group that is pre-defined with an MCVideo group ID and member list in the group management server, with all members belonging to the same MC system.

question_67613.question: What does the fading characteristic of the signals represent and how is it set?
question_67613.ground_truth: The fading characteristic of the signals represents the signal strength variation over a certain distance or time. The TU50 and TUHigh fading characteristic is set during the test by the SS.

question_67614.question: What step in the process is performed by the W-AGF when the FN-RG connects to a W-AGF via a layer-2 (L2) connection?
question_67614.ground_truth: The W-AGF selects an AMF based on the AN parameters and local policy.

question_67618.question: What is the function of the CHANNEL REQUEST message and where is it used in the mobile station's procedure?
question_67618.ground_truth: The CHANNEL REQUEST message is used in the RR connection, and it is used in both channel establishment and release. In channel establishment, it is sent as part of the IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message, and in channel release, it is sent as part of the CHANNEL RELEASE message.

question_67619.question: What is the result when the MS sends an RRLP Measure Position Response message containing a location error with IE LocErrorReason set to gpsAssDataMissing?
question_67619.ground_truth: If the requested assistance data is available in the SS, then the SS provides the requested assistance data in one or more RRLP Assistance Data delivery messages followed by a second RRLP Measure Position Request message. If the entire requested assistance data is not available in the SS, then the SS sends the second RRLP Measure Position Request message without assistance data.

question_67620.question: When the CC-POI is expected to populate the SDP Session Description field of X3 PDU with the SDP information received in the LocalSDP?
question_67620.ground_truth: The CC-POI is expected to populate the SDP Session Description field of X3 PDU with the SDP information received in the LocalSDP for the xCC that represent the incoming media streams destined to the IP address and UDP port number specified as the target identifiers.

question_67621.question: What is the function responsible for initiating the construction of a list of items to be displayed to the user in the SIM Toolkit?
question_67621.ground_truth: CatSelectItem initiates the construction of a list of items to be displayed to the user in the SIM Toolkit.

question_67623.question: What mobility enhancements are supported by LTE-Advanced?
question_67623.ground_truth: LTE-Advanced supports mobility across the cellular network at speeds from 0 to 15 km/h, 15 to 120 km/h with high performance, and up to 350 km/h (or even 500 km/h depending on the frequency band). It also optimizes delay and packet loss during intra-system handover.

question_67624.question: What is the role of PDCCHs in the procedure?
question_67624.ground_truth: PDCCHs in the procedure are used to send new transmissions continuously on E-UTRA PCell, PSCell, and SCell to ensure that the UE will have ACK/NACK sending. They are also used to trigger PSCell DL BWP switch and SCell DL BWP switch to switch bandwidth part from BWP-1 to BWP-2.

question_67625.question: What does the SCC AS need to determine when it receives an INVITE with STN-SR indicating Single Radio VCC procedures for Access Transfer to CS access?
question_67625.ground_truth: The SCC AS uses the STN-SR to determine that Access Transfer using Single Radio VCC is requested. It may also retrieve the C-MSISDN from the HSS and identify the correct anchored session (i.e. the held session) to proceed with the Access Transfer of the held session for the UE.

question_67627.question: What is the purpose of the MAXCELLINEBN and MAXCELLINENGB constants in the ServedEUTRAcellsENDCX2ManagementList data type within END-DC X2 SETUP REQUEST?
question_67627.ground_truth: The MAXCELLINEBN constant represents the maximum number of cells in an ENB, while MAXCELLINENGB represents the maximum number of cells in an ENG-B. These constants define the size of the servedEUTRAcellsENDCX2ManagementList data type used in the END-DC X2 SETUP REQUEST message.

question_67628.question: What is the purpose of the AAA server in the solution described in clause 7.2.1.2?
question_67628.ground_truth: The AAA server provides the PDN GW identities to the trusted non-3GPP access system as part of the access authentication and authorization procedure.

question_67629.question: In what cases does SMF select a DNAI during the process?
question_67629.ground_truth: SMF selects a DNAI during the process when no DNAI could be used in step~5 for the group.

question_67631.question: Which terminating service defines the requirements for interactions between presenting and withholding the terminating party's identity?
question_67631.ground_truth: Terminating Identification Presentation (TIP) and Terminating Identification Restriction (TIR)

question_67632.question: When is the CP counter used in the EMSDP protocol?
question_67632.ground_truth: The CP counter is used for control plane data messages that are incremented every control plane message to protect against replay attacks.

question_67633.question: What is the reporting requirement for Propagation Delay Compensation in an FR2 cell if the PRS or TRS for PDC measurement is QCLed with active TCI state for PDCCH/PDSCH?
question_67633.ground_truth: There are no scheduling restrictions due to PDC measurement performed based on PRS or TRS.

question_67634.question: What is the role of the GUP server and RAF in GUP authorization?
question_67634.ground_truth: The GUP server and RAF have access to the authorization rules and are responsible for the execution of the authorization logic. They may also add usage directives to transported actual data, including privacy policies that the GUP requestor must follow when using, storing, and/or distributing the received data.

question_67636.question: What is the main difference between rasterization and ray-traced rendering?
question_67636.ground_truth: Rasterization focuses on enabling real-time rendering at a desired quality, while ray tracing is used to mimic light transmission to produce more realistic images.

question_67637.question: What is the function of the Iq reference point (6a.7.23) between the Proxy-CSCF and the IMS Access Gateway?
question_67637.ground_truth: The Iq reference point is used to convey the necessary information that is needed to allocate and release transport addresses between the Proxy-CSCF and the IMS Access Gateway.

question_67638.question: What services are invoked after any terminating CAMEL based service?
question_67638.ground_truth: Call Forwarding Unconditional is invoked after any terminating CAMEL based service.

question_67640.question: What functionality is provided by the T5 small data service in relation to trigger messages or payloads?
question_67640.ground_truth: The T5 small data service provides encryption or integrity protection in an end-to-end manner for the trigger message or payload, allowing any node on the delivery path or the receiver to verify message integrity.

question_67641.question: What is the role of the PCF in the context of QoS control over Uu and PC5?
question_67641.ground_truth: The PCF detects the need for specific QoS, issues corresponding PCC rules and invokes PDU Session Modification procedure including the required specific QoS parameters that are provided to the N3IWF.

question_67642.question: What is the consequence of a UE being in SHO and power controlled towards the LPN, making it problematic to reliably receive essential control channel information in the serving cell?
question_67642.ground_truth: Poor HSPA cell throughput in the serving cell, state-oscillations and dropped calls may occur due to the weak link between the serving NodeB and the UE.

question_67643.question: What is the role of the OCS in the IMS Network Element?
question_67643.ground_truth: The OCS (Online Charging System) is responsible for granting service units in the IMS Network Element, such as during session establishment, updates, and termination.

question_67647.question: What does the IN Service Indicator (INSIN) feature enable in inter-network calls in IN CS-3?
question_67647.ground_truth: INSIN permits the receiving network, in an inter-network call, to receive an indication of the service used in the received call from the originating network.

question_67648.question: What is the role of the ISC gateway function in terms of addressing?
question_67648.ground_truth: The ISC gateway function exists on a one-to-one basis with its addressed AS, meaning that the URI used to address the ISC gateway function will always reach the same AS beyond the ISC gateway function.

question_67650.question: What is the purpose of the message ID in the APDU IE when segmenting an SMLCPP message into multiple BSSMAP-LE messages?
question_67650.ground_truth: The message ID in the APDU IE is used to recognize a particular message to which that segment belongs. The sending entity can select any of the available values (0-65535) that is not currently used between it and the receiving entity. This allows the receiving entity to recognize missing or duplicated elements and discard the entire message if necessary.

question_67651.question: What action does a UA take when receiving an initial SDP offer with a valid media line codec but invalid or missing OMR attributes in IMS-ALG?
question_67651.ground_truth: The UA shall remove all OMR related attributes associated with the media line.

question_67653.question: What is the consequence of failing to meet the requirements in this test?
question_67653.ground_truth: If a requirement is not met, it can lead to the test failing, indicating that the UE does not meet the required specifications for NR SA FR2 SS-RSRP measurement accuracy.

question_67655.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) and what is the purpose of the Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects?
question_67655.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) is a collaboration of telecommunications standards associations. The Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects is responsible for the development of specifications for 3GPP services and systems.

question_67656.question: What are the physical channels defined in the downlink and uplink of the NR radio interface?
question_67656.ground_truth: The physical channels defined in the downlink are the Physical Downlink Shared Channel (PDSCH), the Physical Downlink Control Channel (PDCCH), and the Physical Broadcast Channel (PBCH). The physical channels defined in the uplink are the Physical Random Access Channel (PRACH), the Physical Uplink Shared Channel (PUSCH), and the Physical Uplink Control Channel (PUCCH).

question_67657.question: What entities in the UE interact with upper layers with respect to the URSP?
question_67657.ground_truth: Each of the 5GSM entities in the UE shall indicate attributes of a newly established PDU session to the upper layers if the URSP requires interaction between upper layers and the 5GSM entities in the UE.

question_67658.question: What is the purpose of the "2 out of 3 approach" in the clause 4.1.6 and 4.1.7 for CS and PS domain?
question_67658.ground_truth: The three measurement types defined in the clause 4.1.6 and 4.1.7 for CS and PS domain are subject to the "2 out of 3 approach" to ensure the accuracy of the measurement.

question_67659.question: What is the role of Service Capability Enablement Function (SCEF) in ePSM?
question_67659.ground_truth: Service Capability Enablement Function (SCEF) is used to provide the parameters defining the periodic cycle (Tref, Ti, Tp) to the 3rd party AS in ePSM.

question_67660.question: What should be employed for the support of SIPTO service for eHRPD access?
question_67660.ground_truth: Topological naming should be employed to find the shortest user plane path from the HSGW to the PGW based on the topological closeness.

question_67662.question: What is the structure of the PDUSessionResourceFailedToSetupListHOAck data type, which is a sequence of PDUSessionResourceFailedToSetupItemHOAck?
question_67662.ground_truth: Each instance of PDUSessionResourceFailedToSetupItemHOAck contains a PDUSessionID, a HandoverResourceAllocationUnsuccessfulTransfer, and an optional ProtocolExtensionContainer.

question_67663.question: What should the UE do upon consistent uplink LBT failure indication from MCG MAC while T304 is not running?
question_67663.ground_truth: The UE considers radio link failure to be detected for the MCG and initiates the connection re-establishment procedure.

question_67666.question: What information is included in the AS registration request?
question_67666.ground_truth: The AS registration request includes the requestor identifier, security credentials of the AS, the AS service identifier of the service associated with the AS, and the connectivity information of the AS.

question_67667.question: What are the parameters that need to be considered for a particular uplink grant when fully controlling uplink grant assignments using TTCN?
question_67667.ground_truth: The parameters that need to be considered include time domain resource allocation, frequency domain resource allocation, and DCI parameters.

question_67668.question: What is the role of EES#1 in the ACR procedure for bundled EAS located on multiple EES within the same EHE?
question_67668.ground_truth: EES#1 is responsible for notifying the associated EES#2 with the need for application context relocation and ensuring that the target EES(s) are in the same EHE by performing retrieve T-EES and T-EAS discovery procedures. It also determines the target EHE for the bundled EAS and performs T-EAS discovery.

question_67669.question: What is the requirement for BS equipment regarding environmental conditions in the 3GPP specification?
question_67669.ground_truth: The BS equipment shall fulfill all the requirements in the full range of environmental conditions for the relevant environmental class from the relevant IEC specifications, specifically the 721-3-3 for stationary use at weather protected locations and 721-3-4 for stationary use at non-weather protected locations.

question_67670.question: What is the reason for the result code in BSSMAP information RANAP information elements, in case De-ciphering Keys are not available?
question_67670.ground_truth: The reason for the result code in BSSMAP information RANAP information elements is System Failure when De-ciphering Keys are not available.

question_67671.question: What is the role of a Media Session Handler in the 5GMS system?
question_67671.ground_truth: A Media Session Handler, in the context of 5GMS, is responsible for requesting maximal authorized bit rate and minimal authorized packet loss rate values.

question_67672.question: How does the UE identify the most recently delivered Filter Description instance?
