question_68346.ground_truth: A piggybacked initial message shares a common IP header with a triggered response message when it is carried as a concatenation after a triggered response message in the same IP packet. In this case, the IP Source Address for the IP packet containing both the triggered response message and the piggybacked initial message should be the same as the IP Address used for the triggered response message. Similarly, the IP Destination Address for the IP packet containing both the triggered response message and the piggybacked initial message should be the same as the IP Address used for the triggered response message.

question_68347.question: What should be the value of the ICSI in the P-Asserted-Service header field when generating a SIP PUBLISH request?
question_68347.ground_truth: The ICSI value should be "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata" in the P-Asserted-Service header field when generating a SIP PUBLISH request.

question_68348.question: What is the purpose of creating a network slice instance associated with a satellite RAN in the described context?
question_68348.ground_truth: The purpose of creating a network slice instance associated with a satellite RAN is to support a communication service and the description of the satellite RAN characteristics. This is necessary due to the unique characteristics of satellite RAN, such as large coverage areas and high latency.

question_68350.question: What is the degradation in beam prediction accuracy for DL Tx beam prediction with a 1 dB margin, when considering a common measurement error for all Tx beams in a given Rx beam?
question_68350.ground_truth: There is a slight performance degradation of less than 0.2%.

question_68351.question: What phase does the IRIs become available in ProSe Remote UE communications?
question_68351.ground_truth: The IRIs become available in the following phases of ProSe Remote UE communications: when a target ProSe Remote UE connects or disconnects from a ProSe UE-to-NW Relay, when a ProSe Remote UE connects or disconnects from a target ProSe UE-to-NW Relay, when a target ProSe Remote UE starts or ends communication using a ProSe UE-to-NW Relay, when interception is started for a target ProSe Remote UE with ongoing communication, and when interception is started for a ProSe UE-to-NW Relay with connected ProSe Remote UE(s).

question_68353.question: What is the primary motivation for this work item?
question_68353.ground_truth: The primary motivation for this work item is that Band 38 is a key global TDD band (allocated for TDD in European countries, China, and others) and operators have expressed interest in supporting carrier aggregation in this band.

question_68357.question: When can the UE omit the octets containing the Power Headroom field and the PCMAX,f,c field for Serving Cells in the other MAC entity?
question_68357.ground_truth: The UE may omit the octets containing the Power Headroom field and the PCMAX,f,c field for Serving Cells in the other MAC entity except for the PCell, if the UE does not support dynamic power sharing.

question_68360.question: What action should the service consumer take to request the termination of a Downlink Message Delivery?
question_68360.ground_truth: The service consumer should send a DELETE method to the VAE Server with the URI of the Individual Downlink Message Delivery resource.

question_68366.question: What actions should a UE perform if the ATTACH REJECT message is integrity protected and the timer value in the Back-off timer value IE indicates zero or deactivation since the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST was sent together with an ATTACH REQUEST?
question_68366.ground_truth: If the timer value indicates zero or deactivation, the UE shall not initiate a new attach procedure or send another PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message with the same APN or without an APN in the PLMN until the UE is switched off or the USIM is removed.

question_68368.question: What is the expected HTTP status code received upon a successful deregistration of a UE's SMSF registration for 3GPP access?
question_68368.ground_truth: The UDM responds with "204 No Content".

question_68369.question: What is the function of the "Deciphering Keys" information element in 3GPP TS 24.008?
question_68369.ground_truth: The "Deciphering Keys" information element is used to indicate the requested GPS assistance data in a variable length information element, which is coded in the same way as the equivalent octets in the Deciphering Key element of 3GPP TS 49.031.

question_68370.question: What is a new concept for RAN4 BS specifications in intra-band, non-contiguous carrier aggregation?
question_68370.ground_truth: Appropriate extension of the transmit and receive RF requirements across the gaps between carriers is required to facilitate co-existence between uncoordinated systems.

question_68371.question: In the case of 5G-RG initiated deregistration, what should the 5G-RG do before initiating its own deregistration when it has registered AUN3 devices connected to it?
question_68371.ground_truth: The 5G-RG should first deregister each of the registered AUN3 devices connected to it (if any) before initiating the deregistration of itself.

question_68372.question: What is the purpose of a MAC subPDU with Backoff Indicator only?
question_68372.ground_truth: The MAC subPDU with Backoff Indicator only is placed at the beginning of the MAC PDU to indicate the backoff time to UE.

question_68373.question: Which IOC represents an IOC for SEPPFunction and ExternalSEPPFunction, and includes the attributes defined in both IOCs?

question_68374.question: What is the minimum requirement for FDD PCell in 8.13.3.5.1-2 and 8.13.3.5.2-2?
question_68374.ground_truth: The minimum requirement is to verify closed loop rank-two performance with wideband and frequency selective precoding for FDD PCell.

question_68376.question: What should the UE do when the back-off timer value indicates zero and an S-NSSAI was provided by the UE during the PDU session establishment?
question_68376.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3585 associated with the S-NSSAI of the PDU session if it is running, for the PLMN or SNPN based on the context.

question_68377.question: What is the identity that should be used in the SMF+PGW-C for interception when EPC-5GC interworking architecture is used?
question_68377.ground_truth: SUPI, IMSI, GPSI, MSISDN, PEI, IMEI

question_68378.question: What is the function of the AMF in the 5G network?
question_68378.ground_truth: The AMF is responsible for managing the UE's connection to the 5G network, including determining the appropriate TNGF for the UE to use and establishing the NWt connection between the UE and the TNGF.

question_68379.question: Which method is used to fetch analytics information via the NEF in the AnalyticsExposure API?
question_68379.ground_truth: The "fetch" custom operation is used to fetch analytics information via the NEF in the AnalyticsExposure API.

question_68381.question: What action is taken by the abortSessionOperation to the currently active asynchronous operation?
question_68381.ground_truth: The abortSessionOperation causes the session state machine to exit the current state and enter a new state.

question_68382.question: What can an MC user do to confirm the reception of a notification message from the IOPS MC system?
question_68382.ground_truth: The MC user can confirm the reception of the notification message to the IOPS MC system.

question_68387.question: What is the purpose of the "a=alternative-tmgi" attribute in FLUTE session?
question_68387.ground_truth: The "a=alternative-tmgi" attribute is used at the session level and lists all alternative values to the TMGI in the MBMS bearer mode declaration attribute, used for the broadcast of the FLUTE session data. This allows the UE to determine if the service is available at its current location.

question_68388.question: What is the minimum set of System Info Types provided by the SS to the MS during a Non-synchronized PS Handover?
question_68388.ground_truth: The minimum set of System Info Types provided by the SS to the MS during a Non-synchronized PS Handover includes information about the target cell's physical characteristics and the required handover procedures.

question_68389.question: What feature allows HD-FDD Cat. M1 UEs to use a DL TBS of up to 1736 bits in CE Mode A in Rel-17?
question_68389.ground_truth: Maximum DL TBS of 1736 bits for eMTC

question_68391.question: What information must be provided in the SIP MESSAGE request when sending a short message?
question_68391.ground_truth: The Request-URI, From header, To header, Content-Type header, and the body of the request must be provided in the SIP MESSAGE request.

question_68394.question: What is the difference between a packet flow and a service data flow in the 5G System?
question_68394.ground_truth: A packet flow is a specific user data flow from and/or to the UE, while a service data flow is an aggregate set of packet flows carried through the UPF that matches a service data flow template.

question_68395.question: What sub-elements are included in the "triggering-criteria" element in the example XML document?
question_68395.ground_truth: The "triggering-criteria" element includes the following sub-elements: "cell-change", "plmn-change", "mbms-sa-change", "mbsfn-area-change", "periodic-report", "travelled-distance", "vertical-application-event", and "geographical-area-change".

question_68396.question: Who is notified when MCPTT client 1 is granted the floor in a private call controlled by the LMR system?
question_68396.ground_truth: The MCPTT server informs MCPTT client 1 that the floor has been granted to MCPTT client 1.

question_68397.question: What should the MCData server do if Step 7 is not received?
question_68397.ground_truth: The MCData server should not delay or impede the file download in Step 10 if Step 7 is not received, to prevent the discreet listening service from causing any perceived change to the MCData FD service.

question_68398.question: What type of corrections does SSR STEC Corrections provide on a per satellite basis?
question_68398.ground_truth: The ionosphere residual risk parameters, correlation time for ionosphere range error and rate, and the mean and standard deviation that bounds the residual Ionospheric Error and its associated error rate.

question_68399.question: What is the function of the network in detecting signalling congestion caused by MTC devices?
question_68399.ground_truth: The network functions (e.g. OAM) are used to detect whether the signalling congestion caused by MTC devices occurs within one kind of link set or not.

question_68400.question: What should be activated for PC5 user plane when sending ranging result through 5GC?
question_68400.ground_truth: Integrity and confidentiality protection should be activated for PC5 user plane when sending ranging result through 5GC.

question_68401.question: What is the name of the message that the UE sends to CN/AS after successful establishment of layer 1 and 2 connections in UTRAN to GSM/BSS inter-RAT handover procedure?

question_68403.question: Who are notified through an fwAvailStatusInd message when the framework detects an internal problem?
question_68403.ground_truth: Services with fault management callbacks are notified through an fwAvailStatusInd message when the framework detects an internal problem.

question_68405.question: What information must the RCAF release after receiving the Release context request message from the PCRF in step 3 of the IP-CAN Session Termination procedure?
question_68405.ground_truth: The RCAF must release the context corresponding to the given UE for the given APN by releasing any reporting restrictions and not indicating to the PCRF that the congestion state is over.

question_68406.question: What should the UE do when establishing a 5G ProSe direct link for direct communication with a 5G ProSe remote UE and a 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE?
question_68406.ground_truth: The UE should apply the DUCK or DUSK used for UE-to-network relay discovery and encrypt the relay service code and UP-PRUK ID or CP-PRUK ID for creating a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message.

question_68407.question: What action may the SMF take if the PCF requests notification of SM Policy Association and there is any PDU Session established to that DNN?
question_68407.ground_truth: The AMF informs the SMF of updates of the NWDAF ID(s) used for UE related Analytics and corresponding Analytics ID(s) and sends a notification of SM Policy Association establishment Indication.

question_68408.question: What is the main objective of the LTE Advanced Carrier Aggregation in Band 41 work item?
question_68408.ground_truth: The objective of this work item is to provide specification support for intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation in LTE TDD Band 41.

question_68409.question: What is the maximum duration of an interruption allowed when an E-UTRA SCell is directly activated or hibernated in MCG, if the active serving cell is in the same band as the E-UTRA SCell being activated or hibernated and the UE supports interBandMRDC-WithOverlapDL-Bands-r16?
question_68409.ground_truth: The maximum duration of the interruption is equal to the longest SMTC duration among all active serving cells in MCG, plus 5ms.

question_68411.question: What SIP header field is added by the IBCF-vA1 when topology hiding is required and the Path header field is applied topology hiding?
question_68411.ground_truth: The "Path" header field is added by the IBCF-vA1 when topology hiding is required and the Path header field is applied topology hiding.

question_68412.question: What should be the primary goal of a revised definition of an alarm?
question_68412.ground_truth: The primary goal should be to emphasize that alarms must exist solely as a tool for the benefit of the operator and requiring operator action to avoid a consequence.

question_68413.question: What should the MS do if it receives any downlink user data packets while waiting for the GA-PSR-DEACTIVATE-UTC-ACK message response during the GA-PSR deactivation procedure?
question_68413.ground_truth: The MS should abort the deactivation procedure and restart TU4001 timer.

question_68414.question: What is the maximum tolerated ratio for missed(ACK)/all valid ACKs, sent for the test to pass?
question_68414.ground_truth: The maximum tolerated ratio for missed(ACK)/all valid ACKs, sent for the test to pass is 0.01.

question_68415.question: What is the role of the SCC Application in session transfer?
question_68415.ground_truth: The SCC Application analyzes the session transfer request and decides whether to wait for a session transfer request in CS access, update the remote leg, or modify the media components of the existing dialog identified in the REFER request.

question_68417.question: In what scenarios should the "Additional GUTI" information element be included while sending a REGISTRATION REQUEST message in 5GS?
question_68417.ground_truth: The "Additional GUTI" information element should be included if the UE performs the registration procedure due to inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode, the UE operates in single-registration mode and the UE has a valid 5G-GUTI, or if the UE holds two valid native 5G-GUTIs and one of the valid native 5G-GUTI was assigned by the PLMN with which the UE is performing the registration.

question_68420.question: What action should the IWF take when it receives a SIP 4xx, SIP 5xx response or SIP 6xx response to the SIP re-INVITE request, and the SIP response contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body with an <imminentperil-ind> element set to a value of "true"?
question_68420.ground_truth: The IWF shall set the MCPTT imminent peril group state as "MIG 2: in-progress".

question_68421.question: How is the signal stability estimated in the second stage of the speech/music classifier?
question_68421.ground_truth: Signal stability is estimated in the second stage of the speech/music classifier by calculating the frame-to-frame difference of the total energy of the input signal, the mean energy difference over the last 40 frames, and the statistical deviation of the delta-energy values around this mean over the last 15 frames.

question_68422.question: What is a CLUE channel as defined in the document?
question_68422.ground_truth: A CLUE channel is defined as a reliable, bidirectional, transport mechanism used to convey CLUE messages. A CLUE channel consists of one SCTP stream in each direction over a DTLS/SCTP session.

question_68423.question: What conditions must be met for media plane optimization to be applied for a media line by an eP-CSCF?
question_68423.ground_truth: Media plane optimization is to be applied when the eP-CSCF forwards the SDP offer towards a WIC, the eP-CSCF does not need to perform legal interception, a "tra-m-line" or a "tra-SCTP-association" media level SDP attribute has been received, and a session level contact line is included in the SDP offer.

question_68424.question: What is the fundamental transmit waveform pulse used in CZ-UMTS obtained from?
question_68424.ground_truth: It is obtained by dilating the UMTS RRC pulse shaping filter.

question_68425.question: What is the cell re-selection delay requirement in clause 16.1.1.8.5 for UE fulfilling stationary relaxed measurements?
question_68425.ground_truth: The cell re-selection delay to a lower priority cell should be less than 32 seconds, and to a higher priority cell should also be less than 32 seconds for UE meeting stationary relaxed measurements.

question_68426.question: What action does the Serving GW take when it receives the first Delete Session Request message from the MME or SGSN in ISR activated state?
question_68426.ground_truth: The Serving GW deactivates ISR, releases the related EPS Bearer context information and responds with Delete Session Response (Cause).

question_68427.question: What is the purpose of the test procedure for TRP in UTRA FDD mode?
question_68427.ground_truth: The purpose of the test procedure for TRP in UTRA FDD mode is to verify that the TRP of the UE is not below specified values, as a lower TRP decreases the coverage area.

question_68428.question: What should the MCPTT client include in the SIP MESSAGE request when reporting the MBMS bearer listening status?
question_68428.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should include the MBMS public service identity received in the P-Asserted-Identity header field of the announcement message in the Request-URI, an Accept-Contact header field with the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media-feature tag, a public user identity in the P-Preferred-Identity header field, a P-Preferred-Service header field with the value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt," and an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-mbms-usage-info+xml MIME body with the <version> element set to "1."

question_68429.question: What is the purpose of the IBCF building and sending a verificationRequest when it receives an initial INVITE, re-INVITE or MESSAGE request containing one or more SIP Identity header fields?
question_68429.ground_truth: To decode the Identity header fields containing a PASSporT SHAKEN JSON Web Token and/or a PASSporT rph JSON Web Token with an optional PASSporT sph JSON Web Token and verify the information (originating identity, diverting identities, contents of the Resource-Priority and Priority header fields).

question_68430.question: What are the three types of transactions between IRPManagers and IRPAgents?
question_68430.ground_truth: Operation invocation, notification, and file transfer.

question_68431.question: What is the maximum aggregate adjustment rate for UE transmit timing accuracy in E-UTRAN TDD?
question_68431.ground_truth: The maximum aggregate adjustment rate for UE transmit timing accuracy in E-UTRAN TDD is 59.43*Ts per 192ms for carrier frequency under 1 GHz or 60.03*Ts per 192ms for carrier frequency over 1 GHz.

question_68433.question: What is the role of a Relay UE in connecting to the SatA network?
question_68433.ground_truth: A Relay UE can be used by the User Equipment (UE) to connect to the SatA network when needed.

question_68434.question: What should the SGW do when it detects a peer's partial failure during PDN connection establishment?
question_68434.ground_truth: If the SGW supports the feature, it shall send a S5/S8 GTPv2 Delete PDN Connection Set Request message to PGW peers supporting the feature, and send a S11 GTPv2 Delete PDN Connection Set Response message with an appropriate Cause value to the MME.

question_68435.question: What is the format of the "Broadcast-To-Be-Cancelled-List" in the "PWSCancelRequest" sequence?
question_68435.ground_truth: The "Broadcast-To-Be-Cancelled-List" in the "PWSCancelRequest" sequence is a sequence of "Broadcast-To-Be-Cancelled-List-ItemIEs" with a minimum size of 1 and a maximum size of "maxCellingNBDU".

question_68436.question: What is the purpose of the "3GPP Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network - LTE IoT NTN operating bands (Release 18)" document?
question_68436.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to provide technical specifications for LTE IoT NTN operating bands.

question_68441.question: What is the purpose of inter-RAT handover from UTRAN TDD to E-UTRAN TDD?
question_68441.ground_truth: The purpose is to transfer a connection between the UE and UTRAN TDD to E-UTRAN TDD.

question_68442.question: What should the MS do if it is in state GMM-DEREGISTERED with substate PLMN-SEARCH and a new PLMN is selected?
question_68442.ground_truth: The MS shall reset the GPRS attach attempt counter and initiate the GPRS attach procedure when a new PLMN is selected in the PLMN-SEARCH substate.

question_68443.question: What must the ME do if the UICC responds with '93 00' when delivering a Cell Broadcast page?
question_68443.ground_truth: The ME shall consider that the Cell Broadcast page has not been delivered successfully and may retry to deliver the same Cell Broadcast page.

question_68445.question: What is the recommended action regarding the impact of IMD and harmonics on Bands 5, 8, 28, and 40 in 6.33.1.2?
question_68445.ground_truth: The recommendation is to focus on the harmonics and IMD falling into Bands 5, 8, 28, and 40, and to observe that Bands 6, 12, 13, 14, 17, 18, 19, 20, 24, 26, 27, 30, 43 and 44 are not intended for use in the same geographical area as Bands 28 and 40.

question_68446.question: What is the name of the TS (technical specification) that specifies the conformance requirements related to the MS (mobile station) scanning for a new PLMN (public land mobile network) in a VPLMN (visited PLMN)?

question_68447.question: What are the two types of relaying in the LTE-Advanced system?
question_68447.ground_truth: The two types of relaying in the LTE-Advanced system are inband relay, where the eNB-RN link shares the same carrier frequency with RN-UE links, and outband relay, where the eNB-RN link does not operate in the same carrier frequency as RN-UE links.

question_68448.question: Which DHCP message is sent by the UE when it receives a DHCPOFFER without the Rapid Commit Option?
question_68448.ground_truth: The UE sends a DHCPREQUEST message as a response to the DHCPOFFER when the Rapid Commit Option is not used.

question_68449.question: What is a possible strategy for the client entity to choose a serving entity in a redundancy and load-sharing scenario?
question_68449.ground_truth: One strategy for the client entity to choose a serving entity in a redundancy and load-sharing scenario is to use a 'request and respond' mechanism, where the client entity sends out a request and the serving entity that responds faster or with the highest service priority is chosen. This can be used to achieve redundancy and load sharing among many entities while improving the precision of load sharing.

question_68450.question: What must be included in the Context Response message for an RLOS attached UE without a USIM?
question_68450.ground_truth: For an RLOS attached UE without a USIM, the IMSI cannot be included in the Context Response message, and security parameters are only included if available.

question_68451.question: What triggers the IWF to send an IWF group call request to the MCPTT server for establishing a group call in an interworking group call?
question_68451.ground_truth: When an LMR user initiates a group call and the interworking group information is known in the MCPTT server and IWF.

question_68453.question: What should the MCPTT client include in the Contact header field of the SIP INVITE request if it supports the g.3gpp.mcptt media feature tag?
question_68453.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should include the g.3gpp.mcptt media feature tag and the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag with the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt" in the Contact header field of the SIP INVITE request.

question_68455.question: What identifies PDU sets and per-PDU set information in the described mechanism?
question_68455.ground_truth: The RTP/SRTP header and payload are used to identify PDU sets and per-PDU set information.

question_68457.question: What is the requirement for the IARP for APN to be applied?
question_68457.ground_truth: The IARP for APN can be applied only when it steers IP traffic to an existing PDN connection.

question_68458.question: What is one of the security requirements for ensuring the availability of GCs when users are added to a GCSE group?
question_68458.ground_truth: A mechanism should be provided to ensure the availability of GCs when users are added to a GCSE group.

question_68460.question: What is the purpose of user authorization during CTS-MS de-enrollment?
question_68460.ground_truth: User authorization during CTS-MS de-enrollment is to prevent misuse by unauthorized users and unintended CTS-MS de-enrollment.

question_68462.question: What are the two scenarios that can trigger the establishment of a NAS Signalling Connection?
question_68462.ground_truth: The NAS Signalling Connection can be established either by a terminal request for a service or by a paging from the CN.

question_68463.question: What are the different options for applying end-to-end media protection in multimedia telephony?
question_68463.ground_truth: The options include applying security based on user request, callee identity, or as an automatic service without user intervention.

question_68465.question: What is defined as " media burst" in the specification?
question_68465.ground_truth: A media burst is a flow of media from an MCPTT client that has been given permission to send media.

question_68466.question: What action must the IMS UE-B take upon reception of the SIP INVITE request with the SDP offer containing the media stream that uses transport "TCP/TLS/MSRP"?
question_68466.ground_truth: The IMS UE-B must check if it is authorized to resolve the ticket and if it is, must interact with the KMS to resolve the ticket and receive keys.

question_68467.question: What secure tunnels are established after the communication path is successfully established between UE1 and UE5?
question_68467.ground_truth: After the tunnel between UE1 and UE2, and the tunnel between UE2 and UE5 are established, UE1 can send data to UE5.

question_68470.question: What should the call control entity of the network do upon expiry of timer T338 upon sending a DISCONNECT message with an Allowed Actions IE indicating "Activation of CCBS is possible"?
question_68470.ground_truth: Upon expiry of timer T338, the call control entity of the network should continue clearing by sending a RELEASE message with the cause number originally contained in the DISCONNECT message, starting timer T308, and entering the "release request" state.

question_68473.question: What is the purpose of the symbols used in the 3GPP specification, as noted in Section 3.2?
question_68473.ground_truth: The symbols used in the 3GPP specification, as noted in Section 3.2, are explanatory in nature. They are used to explain the terms and definitions used in the specification.

question_68476.question: What is the main function of the LNA in a receiver?
question_68476.ground_truth: The main function of the LNA (Low Noise Amplifier) in a receiver is to amplify the received signal and suppress the noise contribution of the downconverter.

question_68478.question: What is the purpose of the SACCH Information element (9.3.29)?
question_68478.ground_truth: It carries the SACCH filling information, such as System Information messages, EXTENDED MEASUREMENT ORDER message or MEASUREMENT INFORMATION message, to be used on a specific channel for periodic transmission on SACCH.

question_68479.question: What is the role of the NWDAF in 5G networks?
question_68479.ground_truth: The NWDAF verifies whether the triggering conditions are met and derives the requested analytics for the network.

question_68480.question: What are the three steps involved in the call flow for mobile originated small data transmission with immediate return to idle?
question_68480.ground_truth: During registration or registration update, the UE and C-SGN establish the security context for transmission of MO/MT connectionless small data. When the UE is in idle mode and has a small data packet to transmit, it creates a message with a security header and encrypted small data packet. Then, it initiates an enhanced RACH procedure and sends the encrypted small data packet to the RAN node.

question_68482.question: What is the method used by P to interrogate the gsmSCF for profile information in USSD?
question_68482.ground_truth: The interrogate MSP operation containing the MSP code is sent to the gsmSCF using USSD.

question_68484.question: What is the purpose of the message store in the context of MCData and discreet listening?
question_68484.ground_truth: The message store is a feature in MCData where content of transactions can be stored for later retrieval. In the context of discreet listening, an authorized user may require access to the content of information exchanged from the message store.

question_68485.question: How does Cell Broadcast work in 3GPP networks for emergency area warnings?
question_68485.ground_truth: The Cell Broadcast system sends a warning message and target area for distribution to the impacted cells. The CBC determines the broadcast SAIs of cells whose coverage overlaps the target area and sends SABP messages to HNB-GWs to route incoming SABP messages from the CBC.

question_68486.question: What is the maximum power emitted by the GSM 400, GSM 900 and DCS 1800 MS allowed in the band of 1805 MHz to 1880 MHz under extreme conditions as defined in 3GPP TS 45.005, subclause 4.2.1 and 3GPP TS 45.005, annex D subclauses D.2.1 and D.2.2?
question_68486.ground_truth: The maximum power emitted by the GSM 400, GSM 900 and DCS 1800 MS allowed in the band of 1805 MHz to 1880 MHz under extreme conditions is up to -36 dBm in five measurements.

question_68487.question: What is the name of the test model that illustrates the relationship between various channels from logical channels to physical channels and it is used when all DCH are associated with a single HS-DSCH in SS (FDD, Rel-5 or later)?
question_68487.ground_truth: The DCH-HS-DSCH model for FDD, Rel-5 or later.

question_68488.question: What APIs should SEALDD enabler provide for data storage service use and monitoring?
question_68488.ground_truth: SEALDD enabler should provide APIs for creating, refreshing, updating, and deleting stored data; as well as APIs for monitoring the status of the stored data.

question_68490.question: What information is required to be reported by ICE when location information is delivered by an ICE?
question_68490.ground_truth: The civic address associated with the access network point as known by the CSP needs to be added by the MF if the location information of the target is delivered by an ICE. The method used to obtain the civic address depends on the CSP implementation.

question_68491.question: What is the advantage of Solution 2 for UE Allowed CSG list management in hybrid access mode H(e)NB?
question_68491.ground_truth: The advantage of this solution is that it can introduce hybrid mode CSG support without upgrading the large number of successful mobility management signalling scenarios between UE and network for differentiating whether it is CSG related or not.

question_68492.question: What can be reused as the reference signals to enable positioning based on NR carrier phase measurements in both UE-based and UE-assisted positioning?

question_68494.question: What action does the UE take when receiving the RAU Accept message, if the ISR Activated indication is not included in the message?
question_68494.ground_truth: The UE sets its TIN to "P-TMSI" when receiving the RAU Accept message, if the ISR Activated indication is not included in the message.

question_68495.question: What does the term "shall" indicate in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network Technical Report?
question_68495.ground_truth: "Shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network Technical Report.

question_68497.question: How many successful reported values out of the total number of reported values are required for each requirement (R1 to R6) for the test to pass?
question_68497.ground_truth: The ratio of successful reported values for each requirement (R1 to R6) should be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_68498.question: What services does the SDAP sublayer provide to the user plane upper layers?
question_68498.ground_truth: The SDAP sublayer provides its service to the user plane upper layers for transfer of user plane data.

question_68499.question: What is the purpose of providing an IP address associated with the L-PSA in DNS EDNS Client Subnet option in NOTE 9?
question_68499.ground_truth: Providing an IP address associated with the L-PSA in DNS EDNS Client Subnet option protects the privacy of the UE's IP address, by allowing the DNS server to consider the EDNS Client Subnet option when resolving the FQDN.

question_68502.question: What does the eNB establish if not already present, after receiving the HeNB address from the SCTP INIT chunk?
question_68502.ground_truth: The eNB establishes an SCTP association with the HeNB if none is already present.

question_68503.question: What is the method used to quantize the de-quantizer gain?
question_68503.ground_truth: A 6-bit scalar quantizer is used, where the quantization levels are uniformly distributed in the linear domain.

question_68504.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects study on improving awareness of user location change?
question_68504.ground_truth: The purpose is to study improvements of awareness of user location change in connected mode, specifically focusing on extending the existing PRA change reporting mechanism for multiple PRAs per PDN connection and optimizing signalling load in PLMN partitioning scenario.

question_68505.question: What is the purpose of the XML Protection Key (XPK) in the protection mechanisms?
question_68505.ground_truth: The XML Protection Key (XPK) is used in the protection mechanisms to encrypt and sign XML content in communications between clients, servers, and the KMS.

question_68509.question: What type of media can be streamed to PSS clients using RTSP/RTP, even if included with timed text in a 3GP file?

question_68512.question: What types of NR UE is the NR SA FR2 event-triggered reporting without gap in DRX test case applicable to?
question_68512.ground_truth: The NR SA FR2 event-triggered reporting without gap in DRX test case applies to all types of NR UE release 15 and forward, supporting 5GS NR SA FR2 and long DRX cycle.

question_68514.question: What does the value 0 in the length-N column-vector with l-th element 1 for k=l (), and 0 otherwise, correspond to?
question_68514.ground_truth: The value 0 in the length-N column-vector with l-th element 1 for k=l (), and 0 otherwise, corresponds to the index for the layer.

question_68515.question: What are the conditions for the applicable requirements in 6.2.6.1 and 6.2.7.1 for the E-UTRA or NB-IoT Home BS?
question_68515.ground_truth: The requirements in 6.2.6.1 and 6.2.7.1 are only applicable to Home BS and under AWGN radio propagation conditions. The licensee for the Home BS operating channel and adjacent channels must be different for these requirements to apply. The requirements do not apply if the Home BS's operating channel and both adjacent channels are licensed to the same operator.

question_68516.question: When does a GPRS MS in MS operation mode A need to perform the normal routing area update procedure during an ongoing circuit-switched transaction?
question_68516.ground_truth: Always, if a normal GPRS attach or a normal routing area updating procedure was performed during the circuit-switched transaction.

question_68517.question: What action does a UE take to enter the DCM-CONNECTED state from the DCM-IDLE state?
question_68517.ground_truth: The UE establishes a signalling connection with at least one other UE using the Direct Connection Request message.

question_68518.question: In Scenario 4, how is the random access period determined in S4-ETM-02?
question_68518.ground_truth: In S4-ETM-02, the random access period is set to approximately 1 second and is achieved by using 32 for 30fps sequences and 64 for 60fps sequences.

question_68519.question: For the inter-frequency RSRQ accuracy requirements in 9.1.6.1, what are the required validity conditions?
question_68519.ground_truth: Conditions for 9.1.6.1 include one, two, or four antenna port transmitted CRS, fulfillment of Clause 7.3 in TS 36.101, RSRP in dBm based on Annex B.3.3, and different carrier frequencies for serving and measured cells.

question_68523.question: What is the main role of the Immersive media renderer in AR and MR applications?
question_68523.ground_truth: The Immersive media renderer in AR and MR applications is responsible for the generation of one or two eye buffers from the visual content, typically using GPUs. It may include rendering operations for audio, 2D or 3D visual rendering, as well as pose correction functionalities.

question_68524.question: What should the AMF do if the UE has indicated support for partial network slice?
question_68524.ground_truth: The AMF should include the Partially allowed NSSAI IE in the Registration accept type 6 IE container IE of the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

question_68526.question: What should the Served-Party-IP-Address AVP contain in case static IP address allocation is used for the User Equipment (UE)?
question_68526.ground_truth: The Served-Party-IP-Address AVP may contain either an IPv4 address, an IPv6 address/prefix, or both, an IPv4 address and an IPv6 address/prefix, in case static IP address allocation is used for the UE.

question_68527.question: What is the purpose of the deleteMessageReq() method?
question_68527.ground_truth: The deleteMessageReq() method is used to delete a recorded message and returns the ID assigned by the generic user interaction interface for a user interaction request.

question_68528.question: What should the UE (MCVideo Client) do upon receiving MBMS subchannel control messages?
question_68528.ground_truth: The UE (MCVideo Client) should respond by sending an MBMS listening status message via SIP MESSAGE.

question_68529.question: What is the purpose of extending the Analytic ID = "Service Experience" in solution #48?
question_68529.ground_truth: The purpose of extending the Analytic ID = "Service Experience" is to add more analytics to help re-evaluate the URSP rules by including the performance in 3GPP access, non-3GPP access type, and multi-Access type for each application under different access type of PDU session.

question_68530.question: Which IEEE protocols need to be supported for fully distributed TSN model integration with 5GS?
question_68530.ground_truth: IEEE protocols such as MSRP for TSN stream resource registration need to be supported for fully distributed TSN model integration with 5GS.

question_68532.question: What should the SLM-C do upon expiry of the timer T101 where current value of the counter C101 is greater than or equal to N?
question_68532.ground_truth: The SLM-C should consider the message sending as a failure, stop the timer T101, inform the VAL user about the failure, and enter the "Stop" state.

question_68533.question: What should the NAS do upon receiving an indication from the lower layers that the barring is alleviated for the access category with which the access attempt was associated, if the event which triggered the access attempt was a request from upper layers to re-establish the user-plane resources for an existing PDU session?
question_68533.ground_truth: The NAS may initiate the service request procedure as specified in subclause~5.6.1, if still needed.

question_68534.question: What is the purpose of the `<plmn-change>` element in the `<triggering-criteria>`?
question_68534.ground_truth: It is used to trigger a report when the PLMN (Public Land Mobile Network) changes.

question_68536.question: What should the UE do if the timer value of T3585 is deactivated and it received the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message?
question_68536.ground_truth: The UE shall not send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message or PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message for a non-emergency PDU session until certain conditions are met.

question_68538.question: What is the test purpose in section 16.6.4.6.1 of the document?
question_68538.ground_truth: The test purpose in section 16.6.4.6.1 of the document is to verify that the UE makes correct reporting of L1-RSRP measurement.

question_68539.question: What command should the SIM send to perform a successful REFRESH with SIM Initialization?
question_68539.ground_truth: The SIM should send the "REFRESH" command with a command qualifier of "SIM Initialization" to perform a successful REFRESH with SIM Initialization.

question_68540.question: What is the impact of the secondary NSSAI determination on services, entities, and interfaces?
question_68540.ground_truth: The determination of the secondary NSSAI on initial registration procedure impacts the AMF, NSSF, SMF, and UE, NG-RAN. The AMF needs to support the storage of the secondary NSSAI information, send the original secondary NSSAI information from S-AMF to T-AMF during the RAN handover and related processing. The SMF triggers PDU session modification when receiving the secondary NSSAI from AMF. The UE and NG-RAN handle PDU session modification, which is related to the secondary NSSAI.

question_68541.question: What is the action taken by the ProSe Function when it receives a PC3 message that indicates an unsupported ProSe discovery mechanism?
question_68541.ground_truth: The ProSe Function should discard the message.

question_68542.question: In what state shall the UE receiver be during the downlink radio frequency (RF) measurements defined in clause 7?
question_68542.ground_truth: UE receiver should be continuously on during the downlink RF measurements in clause 7 to ensure proper testing.

question_68543.question: What does the csi-RS-CFRA-ForHO field represent in the Phy-ParametersCommon sequence?
question_68543.ground_truth: This field represents the support for CSI-RS-CFRA for HO in the Phy-ParametersCommon sequence.

question_68544.question: What is the role of the Link ID during handover procedures?
question_68544.ground_truth: The Link ID is used to associate the UE with the MBSR and to track the status of UEs during handover.

question_68545.question: What information can the TWAP use to select a TWIF that supports the UE's desired PLMN and S-NSSAI?
question_68545.ground_truth: The TWAP can use the PLMNs and S-NSSAIs supported by all TWIFs it can interwork with, which is provided by the TWIF in step 0b.

question_68546.question: What is the state of the Gs association if the SGSN receives a normal attach request or a normal routing area update request from the MS in state Gs-ASSOCIATED?
question_68546.ground_truth: The state of the Gs association changes to Gs-NULL without explicit signalling towards the VLR.

question_68547.question: What is the prediction structure for S4-ETM-01 in Scenario 4?
question_68547.ground_truth: The prediction structure for S4-ETM-01 in Scenario 4 is a hierarchical QP structure, with GOP size equal to 8 and each B picture referring to up to 4 preceding pictures in display order. Temporal filtering is disabled.

question_68548.question: What measurement metric is used for transmitter power measurements in TRP TRS OTA testing for FR1?
question_68548.ground_truth: Total Radiated Power (TRP) is used as the measurement metric for transmitter power measurements in TRP TRS OTA testing for FR1.

question_68549.question: What is the output obtained from the MIC calculation function in the integrity protection process?
question_68549.ground_truth: The output obtained from the MIC calculation function in the integrity protection process is a 4-byte sequence that is set as the value of the MIC for the message.

question_68551.question: What is the effect of the propagation time between the BS and the victim on the co-existence TX OFF level?
question_68551.ground_truth: The co-existence TX OFF level has tighter timing requirements to account for the propagation time between the BS and the victim.

question_68552.question: What is sent per access type in the management of 5G parameters, i.e., independently over 3GPP access or non-3GPP access?
question_68552.ground_truth: Allowed NSSAI, Rejected NSSAI (when the NSSAI is rejected for the current registration area or is rejected for the maximum number of UEs reached), and additional parameters when the UE is not registered to the same PLMN or SNPN over 3GPP and non-3GPP access.

question_68553.question: What procedure is initiated by the non-3GPP-GW in step 9?
question_68553.ground_truth: The non-3GPP-GW initiates the Gateway Control and QoS Rules Request Procedure in step 9.

question_68554.question: What happens after the MC service server determines the list of participants in the ad-hoc group emergency alert?
question_68554.ground_truth: The MC service server sends an ad-hoc group emergency alert request towards the relevant MC service clients and the receiving clients send an ad-hoc group emergency alert response to acknowledge the alert.

question_68555.question: What happens when an MBS QoS flow is removed?
question_68555.ground_truth: When an MBS QoS flow is removed, the MB-SMF shall report to the PCF that the MBS PCC rules bound to this MBS QoS flow are removed.

question_68556.question: When does the IBCF-vA1 route the INVITE request via IC network A and send the INVITE request?
question_68556.ground_truth: The IBCF-vA1 routes the INVITE request via IC network A and sends the INVITE request to the IC-A1 based on local policy.

question_68557.question: What is the maximum occurrence of the "match" element that is a child of the "RestrictedDiscFilter-info" complex type?
question_68557.ground_truth: The maximum occurrence of the "match" element is "unbounded".

question_68559.question: What is the maximum limit for the ECDP of any code channel before the requirements for Relative Code Domain Error no longer apply?
question_68559.ground_truth: When the ECDP of any code channel is less than -30dB.

question_68561.question: What is the exception in the message contents for 7.3.63.5?
question_68561.ground_truth: The exception in the message contents for 7.3.63.5 is that the test requires the UE to switch to uplink and complete the uplink transmission, and then switch back to downlink for a correct event to be considered. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

question_68563.question: What is the main purpose of the NSQ function in Solution #10?
question_68563.ground_truth: The NSQ function in Solution #10 controls and restricts the number of PDU Sessions per Network Slice identified by S-NSSAI. It manages the network slice related quota and enforces such quota when a UE requests to establish a new PDU Session to the network slice.

question_68564.question: What is the requirement for the ME when responding to a RUN AT COMMAND with a right alignment text attribute?
question_68564.ground_truth: The ME shall respond to the RUN AT COMMAND as if it were initiated by an attached TE and return an AT Response within a TERMINAL RESPONSE to the UICC.

question_68565.question: Who is this test applicable to?
question_68565.ground_truth: This test is applicable to UE that supports SUL, and is defined in TS 38.133 and TS 36.331 starting from Release 15.

question_68566.question: What should a MS do when timers T3311 or T3302 are running and a relevant timer is stopped?
question_68566.ground_truth: The MS should stop the running timer and act as if the stopped timer has expired.

question_68567.question: What is the range of operation of the network slice data rate control in clause 4.2.6.8 for the PCF?
question_68567.ground_truth: The network slice data rate control in clause 4.2.6.8 applies to the S-NSSAI to which the received request relates.

question_68568.question: What is the significance of the "Additional TERMINAL PROFILE after UICC activation" feature in the context of USAT profile download?
question_68568.ground_truth: The "Additional TERMINAL PROFILE after UICC activation" feature determines whether the UICC supports the ability to download an additional terminal profile after the UICC has already been activated.

question_68570.question: In the context of a REGISTER request protected by a security association, what should the UE include in the Contact header field's hostport parameter and the Via header field's sent-by field?
question_68570.ground_truth: The UE should include the protected server port value in both the Contact header field's hostport parameter and the Via header field's sent-by field.

question_68571.question: What action does the UE take regarding CSI reports for SCell1 in the final step before T2 expires?
question_68571.ground_truth: The UE shall stop sending CSI reports for SCell1 and the SS shall continue to monitor CSI reports for SCell1 sent from the UE and ACK.

question_68572.question: What is the default action of the IM-SSF when an exception condition is encountered during a terminating call?
question_68572.ground_truth: When an exception condition is encountered, the IM-SSF should release any resources made available for setting up the SIP call session, and send an error information flow to the gsmSCF, indicating that any outstanding call handling instructions will not run to completion, if a relationship exists between the IM-SSF and the gsmSCF.

question_68573.question: What is the test purpose in clause 6.7.3.1.1, as it pertains to SS-SINR measurement accuracy?
question_68573.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify that the intra-frequency SS-SINR measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for all bands.

question_68574.question: What is the role of the device in NOVES emergency communication?
question_68574.ground_truth: The device plays a crucial role in NOVES emergency communication. It provides positive indication of an emergency session, routes text messages to the PSAP, and possibly supports additional media streams. The device also should not draw attention to the user when receiving messages and can enter "emergency mode" following the emergency session.

question_68577.question: What action does the Node B take when the HARQ Memory Partitioning Per UARFCN IE is included in the HS-DSCH Common System Information Response LCR IE for a multi-frequency cell?
question_68577.ground_truth: The Node B includes the UARFCN IE in the HS-DSCH Common System Information Response LCR IE to indicate the frequency of the HARQ Memory Partitioning Per UARFCN IE in the HS-DSCH Common System Information Response LCR IE.

question_68578.question: What is used to build a SUCI for FN BRG and FN CRG in 5GC?
question_68578.ground_truth: The GLI and the GCI are used to build a SUCI for FN BRG and FN CRG in 5GC respectively.

question_68579.question: In situation 11d, what is the condition for the subframes in which DTX should not be observed by the SS during the T3 period for all intra-band PCell TDD cases?
question_68579.ground_truth: The condition is that DTX should not be observed by the SS outside the subframes (n+5) to (n+9) and (n+20), the subframes (n+35) to (n+43), the subframes (n+50) to (n+53), and the subframes (n+65) to (n+84) up to the end of T3. Alternatively, DTX should not be observed by the SS outside the subframes (n+6) to (n+14) and (n+28) and (n+33), and the subframes (n+51) to (n+58) and (n+63) to (n+74) up to the end of T3. Additionally, DTX should not be observed

question_68580.question: What does the L2 U2N Relay UE need to establish before L2 U2N Remote UE establishes a Uu RRC connection with the network?
question_68580.ground_truth: The L2 U2N Remote UE needs to establish its own PDU sessions/DRBs with the network before user plane data transmission, and the NR sidelink PC5 unicast link establishment procedures can be used to setup a secure unicast link between L2 U2N Remote UE and L2 U2N Relay UE before L2 U2N Remote UE establishes a Uu RRC connection with the network via L2 U2N Relay UE.

question_68582.question: What type of data can the NF service consumer retrieve using the "IMS Identity Data Retrieval" feature?
question_68582.ground_truth: The NF service consumer can retrieve the UE's Implicit Registration Set and Alias Group information using the "IMS Identity Data Retrieval" feature.

question_68583.question: What is the purpose of providing broadcasted TAC(s) by the gNB as part of ULI?
question_68583.ground_truth: The gNB reports the broadcasted TAC(s) of the selected PLMN to the AMF as part of ULI to enable the AMF to determine whether the UE is allowed to operate at its present location.

question_68586.question: What message is sent by the UE upon MM connection establishment for an emergency call?

question_68588.question: What should the UE do if the ESM cause value is #26 and the Back-off timer value IE is included in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message?
question_68588.ground_truth: The UE shall ignore the Re-attempt indicator IE provided by the network and stop timer T3396 associated with the corresponding APN if it is running. The UE shall start timer T3396 with the value provided in the Back-off timer value IE and shall not send another PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST, BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST, or BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message for the same APN that was sent by the UE until the timer expires.

question_68589.question: What is the significance of the Primary NSACF in the NSACF system?
question_68589.ground_truth: The Primary NSACF is significant because it manages the global Maximum number value and distributes it to other NSACFs. It also determines whether the UE ID entry update is to be performed at the NSACF or Primary NSACF and supports the update of PDU session number.

question_68590.question: When shall the UE respond to an AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message?
question_68590.ground_truth: The UE shall respond to an AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message except for the cases described in clauses 5.4.2.6 and 5.4.2.7 case k.

question_68591.question: What does "EIR" mean in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?

question_68592.question: What type of attach procedure, as defined in the 3GPP TS 24.301 standard, provides the number of failed combined attach procedures due to specific reject causes, with a sum subcounter for all supported causes?

question_68594.question: What impact do communication holding, terminating and originating identification presentation and restriction, conference, communication deflection, call waiting, and anonymous communication rejection and communication session barring services have on the MCID service?
question_68594.ground_truth: None of these services affect the operation of the MCID service.

question_68596.question: What is the pre-condition for initiating an Inter-RAT handover to the E-UTRAN?
question_68596.ground_truth: The UE is in READY state (GERAN A/Gb mode), the UE has at least one PDP/EPS Bearer Context established, and the BSS must support PFM, Packet Flow Management, procedures.

question_68598.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 6.2.8 of the document?
question_68598.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the behavior of the UE's random access procedure for the SCell in an AWGN model and to ensure that the PRACH power settings and timing for the SCell are within the specified limits.

question_68599.question: What is the main function of Radio Resource Management (RRM) in NR networks?
question_68599.ground_truth: RRM ensures the efficient use of available radio resources and provides mechanisms to meet radio resource related requirements in NR networks.

question_68600.question: What is the definition of FR1 and FR2 in the 3GPP technical report on the 7.125 - 24.250 GHz range for the Next Generation access technologies?
question_68600.ground_truth: FR1 is defined as the frequency range between 410 MHz and 7125 MHz and FR2 is defined as the frequency range between 24250 MHz and 52600 MHz in the 3GPP technical report on the 7.125 - 24.250 GHz range for the Next Generation access technologies.

question_68601.question: What is the purpose of the UTRA Carrier RSSI absolute measurement accuracy requirement?
question_68601.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure that the UTRA Carrier RSSI measurement is within the specified limits, which is important for inter-frequency handover evaluation.

question_68602.question: Which operational mode in the Part 15 rules has a channel availability check time requirement in the U-NII (Unlicensed National Information Infrastructure) bands?
question_68602.ground_truth: The requirement for channel availability check time applies in the master operational mode.

question_68605.question: What does the AMF do with UE policy information in 5G?
question_68605.ground_truth: The AMF forwards UE policy information transparently to the UE in 5G and does not need to understand its content.

question_68606.question: What should the PDN GW take into account when the PS-to-CS handover indicator is notified by the MME/SGSN?
question_68606.ground_truth: The PDN GW shall support the PS-to-CS handover indicator as notified by the MME/SGSN.

question_68609.question: What is the purpose of downlink inter cell interference coordination?
question_68609.ground_truth: The purpose is to restrain interference and increase system capacity when a UE located in a cell-edge area suffers downlink interference from its neighbor cell.

question_68610.question: What was the audio material used in the test for spatial localization assessment?
question_68610.ground_truth: The audio material consisted of sound sources that would be perceived as typical point sources originating from certain points in space. The recordings used were all mono recordings with very little background noise and reverberation, consisting of male and female voices and the sound of screws rattling in a glass.

question_68611.question: What is the purpose of the N4 Association Setup Procedure in 4G Core Network?
question_68611.ground_truth: The N4 Association Setup Procedure is used to setup an N4 association between the SMF and the UPF, enabling the SMF to use the resources of the UPF for subsequent N4 Sessions.

question_68616.question: What is the difference between Option A and Option B for ProSe announcing UE?
question_68616.ground_truth: Option A allows the permitted announcing UEs to contend with each other for available radio resources, while Option B requires the UE to request radio resources from the network before it performs the announcement.

question_68618.question: What should be used for testing a TAB connector that is declared to support single carrier operation only in an operating band?
question_68618.ground_truth: A single carrier (SC) should be used for testing a TAB connector that is declared to support single carrier operation only in an operating band.

question_68619.question: What is the requirement for UE with two active transmit antenna connectors in UL OLTD operation in terms of sub-clause 6.6.3.1 apply at each transmit antenna connector?
question_68619.ground_truth: The requirement for UE with two active transmit antenna connectors in UL OLTD operation is that the requirements specified in sub-clause 6.6.3.1 apply at each transmit antenna connector.

question_68620.question: What is the purpose of the joint USQ and TCQ decoding block in the fine structure decoding process?
question_68620.ground_truth: The purpose of the joint USQ and TCQ decoding block is to de-quantize the fine structure of the normalized spectrum by decoding the magnitude information with arithmetic decoding and de-quantizing the magnitudes of the gathered ISCs using the joint USQ and TCQ decoding.

question_68621.question: What is the delay uncertainty that is added to the measurement reporting delay when transmitting the measurement report on the PUSCH with subframe duration, as per Clause 8.6.2.2.1.2.1.3?
question_68621.ground_truth: The delay uncertainty that is added to the measurement reporting delay when transmitting the measurement report on the PUSCH with subframe duration, as per Clause 8.6.2.2.1.2.1.3, is 2 x TTIDCCH, where TTIDCCH is the duration of subframe.

question_68622.question: What is the purpose of the "ACR facilitation" event?
question_68622.ground_truth: The "ACR facilitation" event is used to request the EES to make the decision for ACR, discover the T-EAS(s), influence the traffic for the selected T-EAS, and notify the S-EAS of the selected T-EAS.

question_68623.question: What procedure does the UE initiate when handed over to a 2G/3G target cell before receiving LAI or NMO information?
question_68623.ground_truth: The UE initiates a Location Area Update procedure immediately.

question_68625.question: What mechanisms can be utilized to fulfill intents in Intent-driven MnS?
question_68625.ground_truth: There are multiple mechanisms that can be used to fulfill intents in Intent-driven MnS, including rule-based mechanisms, closed loop mechanisms, and AI/ML based mechanisms. These mechanisms can be combined in solutions of various complexity.

question_68626.question: What are the main functions of the Node B Communication Context?
question_68626.ground_truth: A Node B Communication Context corresponds to all the dedicated resources that are necessary for a user in dedicated mode and using dedicated and/or shared channels as restricted to a given Node B. It includes the list of cells where dedicated and/or shared physical resources are used, the list of DCH, DSCH, USCH, HS-DSCH and E-DCH MAC-d flows which are used by the respective UE, the list of Iub DCH Data Ports, DSCH Data ports, USCH data ports, HS-DSCH Data ports and E-DCH Data ports, the list of Iub DCH Data Ports, DSCH and USCH data ports, corresponding DCH, DSCH, USCH, HS-DSCH and E-DCH MAC-d flows and cells which are carried on these data ports and Physical layer parameters (outer loop power control, etc).

question_68628.question: What constructs indicate a prohibition in the context of this 3GPP technical specification?
question_68628.ground_truth: The constructs "shall not" and "must not" indicate a prohibition or interdiction to do something in the context of normative provisions.

question_68629.question: What is the expected behavior of the UE during time duration T3?
question_68629.ground_truth: During T3, the UE is expected to detect OOS (Out-of-Sync) and declare RLF (Radio Link Failure).

question_68630.question: What should the UE do when it determines that the network has failed the authentication check during a 5G AKA based procedure in the second scenario described in section 11.4.1.1(2)?
question_68630.ground_truth: The UE should continue using the current security context, release all non-emergency PDU sessions by initiating UE-requested PDU session release procedure, and not treat the active cell as barred for non-emergency services.

question_68631.question: What changes are required in the gNB to support overlapping UE channel bandwidth (CBW) from a network perspective?
question_68631.ground_truth: The gNB has to support the irregular channel bandwidth. It can be implemented by a new channel bandwidth, or through RF combining of two existing regular channel bandwidths.

question_68632.question: What message does the gNB-DU send to the UE if the gNB-CU-CP sends the PAGING message to the gNB-DU to indicate MT-SDT?
question_68632.ground_truth: The gNB-DU includes the MT-SDT indicator in the Paging message sent to the UE.

question_68633.question: What should the MS do when it receives an RNR frame with N(S) = V(R ) +1?
question_68633.ground_truth: The MS should respond with an ACK frame, indicating that frames up to and including N(R) - 1 and frame N(R) + 1 have been received correctly.

question_68636.question: What is the impact of overlap signalling on the core entities of the IM CN subsystem?
question_68636.ground_truth: The support of overlap signalling within the IM CN subsystem is optional and dependent on the network policy. Overlap signalling can impact the routing of INVITE requests and entities such as the S-CSCF, the transit routing function, the I-CSCF, and application servers.

question_68639.question: What action should the S-CSCF take when a type 2 IOI is received in the term-ioi header field parameter?
question_68639.ground_truth: A type 2 IOI indicates the sending network of the response, so the S-CSCF should include this value in the forwarded response when the next hop is not an AS.

question_68640.question: In what circumstances will an SNPN be removed from the list of "temporarily forbidden SNPNs" in the ME?
question_68640.ground_truth: An SNPN can be removed from the list of "temporarily forbidden SNPNs" if there is a successful LR after a subsequent manual selection of the SNPN, if the MS implementation specific timer not shorter than 60 minutes expires, or if certain other conditions are met, such as the expiration of a timer or the successful completion of an EAP or 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure.

question_68641.question: What are the common procedures to support positioning in the GERAN Network Location Procedures?
question_68641.ground_truth: The procedures described in this clause enable an SMLC to obtain positioning related information or instigate positioning for a particular target MS. The procedures are applicable to all positioning methods after an SMLC receives a BSSAP-LE Perform Location request for a target MS until a BSSAP-LE Perform Location response is returned to the originator.

question_68642.question: What should the MCVideo client do if it cannot find a binding between the public user identity and an MCVideo ID or if the validity period of an existing binding has expired, upon receiving a SIP INVITE request for an on-demand private call?
question_68642.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 404 (Not Found) response with the warning text set to "141 user unknown to the participating function" in a Warning header field as specified in clause~4.4.

question_68643.question: What does "SS" stand for in the context of the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_68643.ground_truth: In the 3GPP Technical Specification, "SS" stands for Solution Set.

question_68644.question: When a WLAN UE has connectivity to the HPLMN via a VPLMN, what W-APN OI should the WLAN UE build the W-APN with?
question_68644.ground_truth: The W-APN OI should correspond to the VPLMN ID.

question_68645.question: When should a UE perform an enhanced LCP procedure in mode 2 resource allocation?
question_68645.ground_truth: A UE may perform an enhanced LCP procedure in mode 2 resource allocation to satisfy COT sharing requirements, when a UE wishes to transmit on a carrier that it did not initially select, or when the UE detects carrier failure on a specific carrier during unicast transmission.

question_68646.question: What should the UE do when the primary carrier is determined to be out-of-synchronization, regardless of the secondary carrier's state?
question_68646.ground_truth: The UE should shut off its transmitter for both primary and secondary carriers.

question_68648.question: What shall the UE do if it receives 5GMM cause #76 and the CAG information list does not contain the serving VPLMN's entry?
question_68648.ground_truth: The UE shall remove the serving VPLMN's entry of the "CAG information list" stored in the UE when the UE receives the CAG information list in a serving PLMN other than the HPLMN or EHPLMN and the CAG information list does not contain the serving VPLMN's entry.

question_68649.question: In which handover procedure is the N2InfoNotify service operation used to notify that the handover procedure has been successful in the target side?
question_68649.ground_truth: During an Inter-NG-RAN node N2 based handover procedure, the N2InfoNotify service operation is invoked by a NF Service Producer towards the NF Service Consumer to notify the successful handover.

question_68650.question: What should the MCData client do on successful download of the file, if the received FD SIGNALLING PAYLOAD message contained an FD disposition request type IE requesting a file download completed update indication?
question_68650.ground_truth: The MCData client should follow the procedures described in subclause 12.2.1.1, including sending a disposition notification to the participating MCData function serving the MCData user that the file download has been completed.

question_68651.question: What is the purpose of the wIMPU Registrar in the webRTC architecture?
question_68651.ground_truth: The wIMPU Registrar holds registration information for individual IMPUs allocated to WICs and stores an entry for every individual IMPU allocated to a WIC. It can be updated upon registration of a new contact or registration update and is removed upon de-registration or registration timer expiry.

question_68652.question: What is the range of Top-K(=2) DL Tx beam prediction accuracy achieved by AI/ML in the fourth evaluation scenario?
question_68652.ground_truth: The range of Top-K(=2) DL Tx beam prediction accuracy achieved by AI/ML in the fourth evaluation scenario is 65%-75% and 80%-90%.

question_68653.question: What message does UE2 send to UE1 after receiving its new IP address/prefix?
question_68653.ground_truth: UE2 sends a PC5 Relay Update Response message to UE1 including all parameters received on the PC5 Relay Update Request message.

question_68654.question: What protocols are used in the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay for the user plane?
question_68654.ground_truth: The user plane for 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay consists of GTP-U, SMF, UDP/IP, Uu, and PC5-U protocols.

question_68655.question: What change does the PCRF make to the PCC rules when it receives new IP flows from PGW in UE-initiated mode?
question_68655.ground_truth: The PCRF updates the PCC rules, e.g. by changing the Routing Access Type of PCC Rules, and provides the updated PCC rules to the PGW.

question_68657.question: What is the role of the 5G DDNMF in the 5G Core Network (5GC)?
question_68657.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF in the 5G Core Network (5GC) supports Direct Discovery Services, and invokes services provided by the 5G DDNMF in Local PLMN and/or in VPLMN via the N5g-ddnmf service based interface.

question_68658.question: What is the component that sends a request to the UDR for the information related to the PDU Session and provides the Internal Group ID and Priority Level as the policy data of XRM service?

question_68659.question: What is the purpose of 5.1.1.32.2 in the context of SS-SINR distribution per SSB?
question_68659.ground_truth: The purpose of 5.1.1.32.2 is to provide the distribution of SS-SINR per SSB received by the gNB of a serving cell from UEs in the measResults IEs.

question_68661.question: What message is sent from the MS to the GANC during the execution phase of a PS handover from GAN mode to GERAN A/Gb mode?
question_68661.ground_truth: The GA-PSR UPLINK QUALITY INDICATION message is sent from the GANC to the MS during the execution phase of a PS handover from GAN mode to GERAN A/Gb mode to provide it with PS service related information.

question_68664.question: What is required for secure data transfer in 3GPP networks?
question_68664.ground_truth: A secure transfer mechanism is required for the highly secure transfer of applications and/or associated data to/from the UICC/USIM in 3GPP networks.

question_68666.question: What should the clock rate of the presentation be if the presentation contains referenced video that needs to be synchronized with the presentation?
question_68666.ground_truth: The clock rate should be no less than 90,000.

question_68667.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement specified in section 7.6.15.2.4?
question_68667.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement specified in section 7.6.15.2.4 is that the UE sends one Event A3 triggered measurement report for each neighbouring cell, with a measurement reporting delay less than X ms from the beginning of time period T2, where X is 10240 for UE supporting power class 1, or 6400 for UE supporting other power class.

question_68668.question: What is the purpose of a broadcast regroup call in MCPTT?
question_68668.ground_truth: A broadcast regroup call in MCPTT is used to initiate a one-way communication to a set of MCPTT groups, which are regrouped only for the duration of the broadcast call.

question_68670.question: In what direction does the MM STATUS message be sent, when the mobile station reports certain error conditions?

question_68671.question: What is the modification of the contents of the document in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's technical specification group radio access network's work item for LTE Advanced intra-band non-contiguous Carrier Aggregation in Band 42 for 3 downlinks?
question_68671.ground_truth: The contents of the present document may change following formal TSG approval, and it will be re-released by the TSG with an identifying change of release date and an increase in version number as follows: version x.y.z.

question_68672.question: What does the revokedCertificates field in the CertificateList contain?
question_68672.ground_truth: The revokedCertificates field identifies certificates that have been revoked and is identified by their serial numbers.

question_68674.question: What is the difference between a global number and a local number in the context of Public User Identity?
question_68674.ground_truth: A global number is in E.164 format, while a local number is a number with a "phone-context" parameter that identifies the scope of its validity.

question_68675.question: What should the UE do upon receiving an AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message containing an EAP-request/AKA'-challenge message from the network?
question_68675.ground_truth: The UE should stop any running retransmission timers (e.g. T3510, T3517 or T3521) and start timer T3520 when it sends the AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message containing the EAP-response message.

question_68676.question: What are the functions of an RCS Server?
question_68676.ground_truth: An RCS Server provides support, services or functions for RCS. It can be any server involved in performing support, services or functions for RCS.

question_68677.question: What is the leaving condition for event A2 in clause 5.5.4.3 of TS 38.331?
question_68677.ground_truth: The leaving condition for event A2 is fulfilled when inequality A2-2 is satisfied, i.e. Ms - Hys > Thresh.

question_68679.question: Which two countries in Latin America auctioned spectrum in the 3.4-3.6 GHz band and acquired them in pairs?

question_68681.question: How does the TNGF notify the UE of a Disaster Condition via trusted non-3GPP access?
question_68681.ground_truth: The TNGF sends an INFORMATIONAL Request message to the UE, which includes an indication that Disaster Condition applies or the PLMN ID(s) of PLMNs with Disaster Condition, the recommended disaster roaming PLMN list, etc. When the UE is registered to PLMN with Disaster Condition via non-3GPP access, the TNGF of PLMN with Disaster Condition sends an indication to the UE that Disaster Condition applies. When the UE is registered to PLMN without Disaster Condition via non-3GPP access, the TNGF of PLMN without Disaster Condition sends PLMN ID(s) of PLMNs with Disaster Condition to the UE.

question_68682.question: What is the definition of the term "SHE" in the context of the present document?
question_68682.ground_truth: The term "SHE" in the context of the present document stands for "service hosting environment."

question_68683.question: What is responsible for managing PDU sessions for providing data connectivity to the UE in the 5GCN?

question_68684.question: What are the considerations for introducing precoding in the UE transmitter in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project?
question_68684.ground_truth: The considerations for introducing precoding in the UE transmitter in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project include using two orthogonal precoding vectors for the two spatial streams, indicating the precoders to be used at the UE by the NodeB on the downlink, and choosing the precoder codebook size and frequency for precoder choice indication.

question_68685.question: What happens if RNS-A is unable to allocate resources when it receives the IUR-ENHANCED-RELOCATION-REQUEST message?
question_68685.ground_truth: RNS-A terminates the procedure and sends an IUR-ENHANCED-RELOCATION-FAILURE message to RNS-B.

question_68686.question: In which situations should the MME or SGSN make use of the Update VCSG Location procedure?
question_68686.ground_truth: The MME or SGSN should make use of the Update VCSG Location procedure when the VPLMN supports Autonomous CSG Roaming, the HPLMN has enabled Autonomous CSG Roaming in the VPLMN, the UE has requested an initial attach or a tracking area procedure or a routing area procedure to a CSG cell, and the MME or SGSN have not yet registered the UE in the CSS.

question_68687.question: What kind of info is provided in the OTDOA (LTE) Neighbour Cells Info List?
question_68687.ground_truth: The OTDOA (LTE) Neighbour Cells Info List provides information about the neighboring cells in LTE network in the context of OTDOA (LTE) positioning method. It likely includes details such as their cell identity, frequency, and radio type.

question_68688.question: What is the procedure for initiating LWA, LWIP, or LAA when the unlicensed spectrum is subject to Secondary RAT Restriction?
question_68688.ground_truth: The eNB shall not initiate LWA, LWIP, or LAA procedure if the unlicensed spectrum is subject to Secondary RAT Restriction.

question_68689.question: What is the concept of ProSe discovery feature in relation to V2X services?
question_68689.ground_truth: ProSe discovery feature is not required for V2X services, but can be used by a V2X supporting UE if implemented.
