question_68690.question: What action does the UE take when the timer T102 expires in the access availability or unavailability report procedure?
question_68690.ground_truth: The UE retransmits the PMFP ACCESS REPORT message up to four times, and on the fifth expiry, the UE aborts the procedure.

question_68692.question: What is the definition of "full stack" in the context of 5G NR UE full stack testing for network slicing?
question_68692.ground_truth: "Full stack" refers to the multilayer combined performance of the UE's Radio link protocol data processing, Radio link protocol signalling processing, TCP/IP processing, and Internet Application processing in the testing of a 5G NR UE supporting network slicing.

question_68694.question: Which CDR is used as input for the wholesale charging of the home MNO in Solution #1.2?
question_68694.ground_truth: The CDR generated in the CHF in the visited MNO is used as input for the wholesale charging of the home MNO in Solution #1.2.

question_68695.question: What should the initiating UE do if it does not receive a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message after sending a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message without the Target user info IE?
question_68695.ground_truth: The initiating UE may retransmit the PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message and restart timer T5080.

question_68697.question: In which TS (Technical Specification) clause is T319a timer started for SDT if conditions for initiating SDT in accordance with 5.3.13.1b are met?
question_68697.ground_truth: The T319a timer is started for SDT when the lower layers first transmit the CCCH message if conditions for initiating SDT in accordance with 5.3.13.1b are met.

question_68698.question: What is required for a mobile station to transmit DTMF messages?
question_68698.ground_truth: The mobile station must have the user connection for speech attached and an appropriate channel must be available for DTMF message transmission.

question_68699.question: In what mode(s) does the MS initiate the routing area updating procedure in 3GPP TS 24.008?
question_68699.ground_truth: The routing area updating procedure is always initiated by the MS, and it is only invoked in state GMM-REGISTERED.

question_68700.question: What data type is expected for the "Max-Simul-Data-Transmissions-Nc4" and "Max-Data-Transmissions-In-Group-Nc5" elements?
question_68700.ground_truth: A positive integer is expected for both elements.

question_68701.question: What is the difference between Candidate IP-PFS Solution 4a and 4b in terms of how they handle QoS for uplink and downlink traffic?
question_68701.ground_truth: In Solution 4a, the UPF creates a "UE-derived QoS Rule" for the downlink traffic, and in Solution 4b, the IP packet with the ToS value is re-used for downlink traffic in the 5GMS AS.

question_68702.question: What message does the MME build when sending the S1-AP Deactivate Bearer Request message to the eNodeB before the last PDN connection for the UE is released?
question_68702.ground_truth: The MME builds a NAS Deactivate EPS Bearer Context Request message including the EPS Bearer Identity and a WLAN offloadability indication, and includes it in the S1-AP Deactivate Bearer Request message.

question_68704.question: What are the frequency ranges where harmonics occur due to three downlink component carriers (3DL) and one uplink (1UL) in NR CA n25-n66-n77?
question_68704.ground_truth: There are 2nd harmonic issues from n25 and n66 UL into n77 DL, which need to be addressed in lower order combination.

question_68705.question: What are the two types of group call models described in MCPTT?
question_68705.ground_truth: The two types of group call models described in MCPTT are pre-arranged group call and chat group call.

question_68706.question: What data type is the "user-profile-index" element?

question_68708.question: What is required for a UE to calculate the response parameters for the EPS AKA procedure?
question_68708.ground_truth: The UE requires the parameters in the AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message sent by the network to calculate the response parameters.

question_68709.question: What is the total time for detecting and measuring at least n cells in inter-frequency RSTD?
question_68709.ground_truth: TMIB ms, where TMIB is the time required for acquiring the MIB information of the target cell, and MGL is the Measurement Gap Repetition Period.

question_68712.question: What does the term "simulation frequencies" refer to in the context of the E-UTRA frequency bands?
question_68712.ground_truth: Simulation frequencies are the two frequencies (900 MHz and 2000 MHz) used to map the frequency bands to in order to limit the number of frequencies to be simulated in various simulation scenarios.

question_68713.question: What is the Time of Arrival Window Startpoint and Endpoint in the context of Timing Adjustment?
question_68713.ground_truth: The Time of Arrival Window Endpoint (ToAWE) is the time point by which the DL data shall arrive to the Node B from Iub, and the Time of Arrival Window Startpoint (ToAWS) is the time after which the DL data shall arrive to the Node B from Iub.

question_68715.question: What condition allows the new SGSN to skip releasing resources in the target cell during a PS handover?
question_68715.ground_truth: If the resources on the target side have already been released when the Relocation Cancel Request message is received by the new SGSN, or if the MS has successfully made access on the target side when the Relocation Cancel Request message is received, the new SGSN skips releasing resources in the target cell.

question_68717.question: What are the two options for monitoring AI/ML model performance in lifecycle management?
question_68717.ground_truth: Monitoring based on inference accuracy, and monitoring based on system performance.

question_68718.question: What should be the measurement reporting delay in this test case?
question_68718.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay should be less than 8 seconds in this test case.

question_68719.question: What is the purpose of the customization of alarm prompt function set in E-OSF?
question_68719.ground_truth: The customization of alarm prompt function set in E-OSF allows for the display of alarm levels in different colors, customization of audible alarms, and sorting of alarms based on severity. This helps operators to quickly identify and respond to critical alarms.

question_68721.question: What action should the UE take if it receives a paging message for SMS while it is in idle mode?
question_68721.ground_truth: The UE is paged on E-UTRAN and by the SGSN on GERAN and/or UTRAN. When camped on E-UTRAN, the UE responds to the MME. When camped on GERAN or UTRAN, the UE responds to the MSC.

question_68722.question: What state does the MM sublayer enter when the identified CM entity indicates that it has sent the first CM message to start the CM recall procedure?
question_68722.ground_truth: The MM sublayer enters the state MM CONNECTION ACTIVE.

question_68723.question: What should be the relative power for MsgA ramping step in dB in NR PUSCH transmissions?
question_68723.ground_truth: The relative power for MsgA ramping step in dB in NR PUSCH transmissions is 2 dB.

question_68725.question: What is a pre-condition for the FRMCS Equipment used by train drivers, customer service staff, and train operations staff to support on-network and off-network group communication services?
question_68725.ground_truth: The FRMCS Equipment for train driver, customer service staff, and train operations staff should support device-to-device communications in the perspective of transport layer.

question_68727.question: How is the 3GPP-GPRS Negotiated QoS profile encoded for GGSN in the release 98 in the RADIUS attribute as specified in subclause 16.4.7.2?
question_68727.ground_truth: The release 98 QoS profile data is 3 octets long, which then results in a 6 octets UTF-8 encoded string.

question_68728.question: Which reference point is used for interworking with circuit switched networks?
question_68728.ground_truth: The Mg reference point is used for interworking with circuit switched networks.

question_68729.question: What is the purpose of the Binding Update message in the solution described in clause 7.2.1.2?
question_68729.ground_truth: The Binding Update message is used to update the routing rules for a specific APN and indicate the routing filters for which IP packets should be sent via the non-3GPP access.

question_68730.question: When is the PCell interruption allowed in the NR UE supporting EN-DC?
question_68730.ground_truth: The PCell interruption is allowed only after the UE starts to execute a conditional PSCell addition.

question_68731.question: What is the characteristic difference between a Type 1 relay node and a Type 2 relay node?
question_68731.ground_truth: The main difference is that a Type 1 relay node controls cells with their own Physical Cell IDs, while a Type 2 relay node does not have a separate Physical Cell ID and would not create any new cells.

question_68734.question: What is the definition of "application-to-point message" as used in the document?
question_68734.ground_truth: An application-to-point message is a message that is originated at a UE and terminated at an application server in the network or originated at an application server in the network and terminated at a UE.

question_68736.question: What should the gNB-DU do if the Transmission Stop Indicator IE is included within the DRB to Be Modified Item IE in the UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION REQUEST message and set to "true"?
question_68736.ground_truth: If supported, the gNB-DU shall stop the data transmission for the DRB and it is up to the gNB-DU implementation when to stop the UE scheduling for that DRB.

question_68738.question: What should be the mobile station's priority in selecting a mobile identity type when there is no TMSI available?
question_68738.ground_truth: The mobile station should use the IMSI as the mobile identity type in this case.

question_68739.question: What is Adjacent Channel Selectivity (ACS) in the context of 5G terrestrial broadcast?
question_68739.ground_truth: ACS is a measure of a receiver's ability to receive an E-UTRA signal at its assigned channel frequency in the presence of an adjacent channel signal at a given frequency offset from the center frequency of the assigned channel.

question_68740.question: What is the role of the L2 U2N Remote UE in unified access control?
question_68740.ground_truth: The L2 U2N Remote UE performs unified access control as defined in TS 38.331, while the L2 U2N Relay UE does not perform UAC for L2 U2N Remote UE's data.

question_68741.question: What is the parent element of "prose-direct-discovery-response" in the XML schema?
question_68741.ground_truth: The parent element of "prose-direct-discovery-response" is the anonymous complexType that it is defined within.

question_68743.question: What is the role of the Mobile Termination (MT) in the 3GPP system?
question_68743.ground_truth: The Mobile Termination (MT) is a fully integrated MS including data terminal and its adaptation functions. It provides a physical connection for the R reference point, ensures conformity of terminal service requests to network capability, and supports data services such as flow control, rate adaptation, and Layer 2 Relay functions.

question_68744.question: What should be done if the maximum number of participants allowed in a group session has already been reached and the user identified by the MCPTT ID in the SIP INVITE request is not deemed to have a higher priority by local policy?
question_68744.ground_truth: A SIP 486 (Busy Here) response should be returned with the warning text set to "122 too many participants".

question_68745.question: What action will be taken when a user is removed from a group in the context of GMK associated with that group?
question_68745.ground_truth: The Group Management Server may choose to update the GMK associated with the group ID.

question_68746.question: What state does the MCPTT client enter upon receiving an indication from the MCPTT user to release the group call in the "S2: waiting for call announcement" state?
question_68746.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should stop the TFG3 timer and enter the "S7: Waiting for call announcement after call release" state.

question_68748.question: What is the performance comparison between full network assistance and blind detection of spatial precoding scheme for TM4 interference in a 2x2 system?
question_68748.ground_truth: Using blind detection of spatial precoding scheme for the TM4 interference may result in substantial performance degradation compared to the full network assistance scenario, especially in case of MIMO rank 2 interference for 2x2 systems.

question_68749.question: In the context of clause~4.23.7.2.2, what is the task of the SMF in step 5, when no I-SMF change or removal is needed during inter NG-RAN node N2 handover procedure?
question_68749.ground_truth: The I-SMF checks whether I-UPF needs to be reallocated, i.e. select a T-UPF.

question_68750.question: What does the old SGSN send to the new SGSN regarding active PDP contexts in inter-SGSN inter-RAT/mode PS handover?
question_68750.ground_truth: The old SGSN sends all active PDP Contexts to the new SGSN indicating the PFIs and the XID parameters related to those PDP Contexts.

question_68752.question: What type of measurement is MM.TauIntraSgwSucc?
question_68752.ground_truth: This measurement provides the number of successfully performed tracking area update procedures without Serving GW change within an MME area.

question_68753.question: How does the DSO query the UPS related information?
question_68753.ground_truth: The DSO can query the UPS related information as and when required by using the getMOIAttributes operation. For example, the DSO can query the identity of the DSO energy supply meter, the MNO base station, the remaining UPS backup duration of a particular site, etc.

question_68754.question: Which additional requirements are applicable to UE category M2, unless explicitly defined otherwise?
question_68754.ground_truth: The additional requirements applicable to UE category M2, unless explicitly defined otherwise, are: Cell Selection and Re-selection Requirements in section 4.7, Handover requirements in section 5.5 and 5.6, Random access requirements in section 6.2.3, RRC re-establishment requirements in section 6.7, RRC connection release with redirection requirements in section 6.8, Radio Link monitoring requreiements in section 7.19, Timing advance requirements in section 7.28, UE timer accuracy requirement in section 7.27, E-UTRAN intra frequency measurement requirements in section 8.13.2.1 and 8.13.3.1, E-UTRAN inter frequency measurement requirements in section 8.13.2.6 and 8.13.3.5, UE measurement capability in section 8.13.2.7 and 8.13.3.6, and Measurement accuracy requirements in section 9.1.21.1 to 9.1.21.16.

question_68756.question: What does an MME Pool Area define?
question_68756.ground_truth: An MME Pool Area is an area within which a UE may be served without need to change the serving MME. It is served by one or more MMEs in parallel and is a collection of complete Tracking Areas.

question_68759.question: What is the CFCS in the context of communication services?
question_68759.ground_truth: The CFCS is the Customer Facing Communication Service, which is what the customer sees and interacts with.

question_68760.question: In GPRS MS operation modes, what does the MS's ability to operate different services depend on?
question_68760.ground_truth: The MS's ability to operate different services depends on whether it supports both GPRS and non-GPRS services and whether it can operate GPRS and other GSM services simultaneously.

question_68762.question: What entity initiates the authorization check of a Client UE when the Client UE requests Ranging/SL positioning service through PC5?
question_68762.ground_truth: The discovered UE (e.g. UE1) initiates the authorization check of the Client UE by sending an authorization request to the core network.

question_68763.question: What is the basic limit for NR Bands n78 in subclause 7.2.2.1, regarding additional spurious emissions requirements for minimum requirement for BS type 1-C and BS type 1-H?
question_68763.ground_truth: The basic limits for NR Bands n78 in subclause 7.2.2.1 are -52 dBm/MHz.

question_68764.question: What does the KPI "PDUSesMeanNbr" measure in a network slice?
question_68764.ground_truth: The mean number of PDU sessions that are successfully established in a network slice.

question_68765.question: What is the maximum duration for the Normal class of communication session setup time in the FRMCS system?
question_68765.ground_truth: The maximum duration for the Normal class of communication session setup time in the FRMCS system is 3 seconds.

question_68769.question: What is the role of the local Scientific Research Station in the scientific expedition?
question_68769.ground_truth: The local Scientific Research Station supports data analytics and research in LocArea. It is equipped with a data center (LocDC) and connects to the 5G core network of the remote Scientific Data Center (RemDC) located in RemArea.

question_68770.question: Which network function is enhanced in Option B to support Positioning Assistance Data storage and retrieval?
question_68770.ground_truth: The UDM is enhanced in Option B to support Positioning Assistance Data storage, and support assistance data retrieval from other CP NFs.

question_68771.question: What information does the Load Control Sequence Number contain in the context of the LCI IE?
question_68771.ground_truth: The Load Control Sequence Number contains a value that indicates the sequence number associated with the LCI IE, and is used to differentiate any two LCI IEs generated at two different instances by the same GTP-C entity.

question_68773.question: What is the definition of the abbreviation "AAU" in the context of the 3GPP Technical Specification, network energy savings for NR (Release 18)?
question_68773.ground_truth: In the 3GPP Technical Specification, "AAU" stands for Active Antenna Unit.

question_68774.question: Which procedures does a MIPv4 handover involve?
question_68774.ground_truth: A MIPv4 handover involves the UE changing access between trusted non-3GPP accesses and updating the care-of address of its binding in the PDN GW/home agent. Upon detecting movement, the UE will register with the new FA. In the registration message from the UE, the home address and the IP address of the home agent are known.

question_68775.question: What is the coding rate of the turbo encoder schemed used for TrCHs?
question_68775.ground_truth: The coding rate of the turbo encoder is 1/3.

question_68776.question: What does the <Maximum bitrate DL> and <Maximum bitrate UL> parameters indicate?
question_68776.ground_truth: The <Maximum bitrate DL> parameter indicates the maximum number of kbits/s delivered by UMTS (down-link traffic) at a SAP, while the <Maximum bitrate UL> parameter indicates the maximum number of kbits/s delivered to UMTS (up-link traffic) at a SAP.

question_68778.question: What type of information does the term "QoS requirements" include in the context of the Analytics Filter Information?
question_68778.ground_truth: The QoS requirements refer to the 5QI, additional QoS parameters, or the QoS Characteristics attributes and their values.

question_68780.question: What is the negative response information element in the "Send Info For Incoming Call negative response" information flow from VLR to MSC?
question_68780.ground_truth: The negative response information element in this information flow can take the following values: "Bearer service not provisioned", "Call barred (Operator determined barring)", "Call barred (Supplementary service barring)", "CUG reject (Inconsistent access information - index incompatible with basic service)", "CUG reject (Inconsistent access information - no CUG selected)", "CUG reject (Outgoing calls barred within the CUG)", "CUG reject (Unknown CUG index)", and "Teleservice not provisioned".

question_68781.question: How are application layer measurement reports sent from the UE to the network?
question_68781.ground_truth: Application layer measurement reports are sent from the UE to the network by encapsulating them in a transparent container and sending them in the MeasurementReportAppLayer message, as specified in TS 38.331.

question_68782.question: What is the purpose of the MC service client monitoring the broadcast MBS session in this solution?
question_68782.ground_truth: The MC service client monitors the broadcast MBS session to receive MC service data and report the broadcast reception quality to the MC service server for making decisions about delivering the MC service data.

question_68783.question: What is the requirement for a MS when receiving an LU reject with cause value "LA not allowed"?
question_68783.ground_truth: When receiving an LU reject with cause value "LA not allowed", the MS shall continue to perform normal cell-reselection, ignore the fact that the cell is part of a forbidden LA, and not reject a cell for camping on because it is part of a forbidden LA.

question_68784.question: What is the effect of preactivation on network services in terms of service impact and elapse time?
question_68784.ground_truth: Preactivation with "least service impact" minimizes disruption to network services, while "least elapse time" minimizes elapse time for completing the execution, with disruption of network services being of secondary importance.

question_68785.question: When does a UE that supports dual connectivity with NR as a secondary RAT always perform initial access through E-UTRA?
question_68785.ground_truth: It always performs initial access through E-UTRA but never through NR.

question_68786.question: What is the purpose of the `group-priority-hierarchy` element in the `<MCVideo-Group-Priority>` element of the 3GPP 24.483 standard?
question_68786.ground_truth: The `group-priority-hierarchy` element in the `<MCVideo-Group-Priority>` element is used to identify the relative priority level of an MCVideo group, with 0 being the lowest priority and 7 being the highest priority.

question_68788.question: When is it recommended for the initiating UE to send the Link Modification Request to the receiving UE?
question_68788.ground_truth: If the signalling and user plane security policies of the new V2X service are satisfied by the security in use for the PC5 unicast link, the initiating UE shall send the Link Modification Request to the receiving UE. The receiving UE shall reject the Link Modification Request if the security in use for the PC5 unicast link does not match the signalling and user plane security policies of the new V2X service.

question_68789.question: What change is required for the client and server in solution PA1?
question_68789.ground_truth: No changes are required for the client and server in solution PA1.

question_68790.question: What does the <RAAI> parameter indicate when the current MICO mode is 1?
question_68790.ground_truth: The <RAAI> parameter indicates whether all PLMN registration areas are allocated or not. When <RAAI> is present and the current MICO mode is 1, it indicates that all PLMN registration areas are allocated.

question_68791.question: What is the maximum RRC procedure delay for E-UTRAN TDD-FDD inter frequency conditional handover test case?
question_68791.ground_truth: The maximum RRC procedure delay for E-UTRAN TDD-FDD inter frequency conditional handover test case is 15 ms.

question_68792.question: What is Key Issue #12 about in the context of 5G networks?
question_68792.ground_truth: Key Issue #12 focuses on studying whether changes to Emergency Service procedures are required to support defined scenarios in 5G, particularly in the case of 5G-RG and FN-RG connecting via wireline or 5G-RG connecting via NG RAN to the 5GC.

question_68799.question: How many types of responses can a Class 1 EP in F1AP have?
question_68799.ground_truth: A Class 1 EP in F1AP can have three types of responses: successful, unsuccessful, or both.

question_68800.question: What is the difference in Adjacent Channel Rejection Ratio (ACRR) requirement between uplink and downlink?
question_68800.ground_truth: The ACRR requirement applies during the transmitter ON state, and the requirement is differentiated between uplink and downlink.

question_68801.question: How are authorization tokens verified in the 5GMS system?
question_68801.ground_truth: The 5GMS AF verifies authorization tokens by validating them against the list of currently valid tokens provisioned in advance by the 5GMS Application Provider.

question_68802.question: What is the main function of the AMF in Alternative 2 when a UE establishes a latency sensitive PDU session?
question_68802.ground_truth: The AMF recalculates the RA based on the service area of UPF to assure that the UE will not change the UPF when the Service Request procedure is triggered.

question_68804.question: What are the three main parties responsible for ensuring the security of an industrial system?
question_68804.ground_truth: The product supplier, the integrator, and the infrastructure operator.

question_68805.question: What is the main factor affecting the average air-interface latency for UEs in connected mode in the LTE system?
question_68805.ground_truth: The main factor affecting the average air-interface latency for UEs in connected mode in the LTE system is the node processing times (downlink to uplink).

question_68809.question: What action shall the conference focus take upon verification of the user's identity and authorization of the request in the context of conference creation or user joining a conference?
question_68809.ground_truth: If the request can be authorized, the conference focus shall set the contact header to the conference URI and request resources from the mixer.

question_68811.question: What is the target outage zone specified for a User Equipment (UE) located in an adjacent channel with respect to the Home Base Station (BS)?
question_68811.ground_truth: The target outage zone is 47dB around the Home BS for a UE on the adjacent channel, with an allowance of 2 dB for measurement errors.

question_68812.question: What is the expected response from the UDR when the NF-Group ID Retrieval procedure is successful?
question_68812.ground_truth: When the NF-Group ID Retrieval procedure is successful, the UDR responds with "200 OK" and the requested data in the message body.

question_68813.question: What is the role of a PWS in providing network-independent location verification?
question_68813.ground_truth: User involvement in PWS can provide network-independent location information. However, it needs to be mandated to ensure consistency and compatibility.

question_68814.question: What facility in the handset profile does the check method check if the index is 0x03?
question_68814.ground_truth: The check method checks the facility specified by the index passed as an argument. In this case, if the index is 0x03, the method checks that facility.

question_68815.question: What is the purpose of the restrict location information dissemination procedure?
question_68815.ground_truth: The purpose of the restrict location information dissemination procedure is to allow the location management client to control the location information dissemination at any time by sending a restrict location information dissemination request to the location management server. The location management server will then indicate to the location management server whether the location information can be disseminated further or not.

question_68816.question: What is the number of secondary SCH codes allocated for each code set in Case 1?
question_68816.ground_truth: Three secondary SCH codes are allocated for each code set in Case 1.

question_68817.question: What should the CAPIF core function do if a consumer sends an HTTP DELETE message to un-publish a service API and the consumer is not authorized to un-publish service APIs?
question_68817.ground_truth: The CAPIF core function should respond to the consumer with an appropriate error status code as defined in clause~8.2.5.

question_68820.question: What should the NF Service Producer do when it receives an updated Binding Indication as part of a callback response?
question_68820.ground_truth: The NF Service Producer should use the updated Binding Indication for subsequent callback requests initiated by the NF Service Producer.

question_68821.question: What is the purpose of the LMA sending a BRI to the MAG in the LMA Initiated PDN Connection Deletion Procedure?
question_68821.ground_truth: The LMA sends a BRI to the MAG to revoke the binding between the MAG and LMA in the PDN Connection of the UE.

question_68825.question: What is a TNL association in the context of 5G-AN node?
question_68825.ground_truth: A TNL (Tightly Coupled Non-Real-time) association in the context of 5G-AN node refers to the connection between the AMF and the 5G-AN node over the N2 interface for signaling traffic.

question_68828.question: What is the size of the allocation within the indicated narrowband using UL resource allocation type 5 when the flag for sub-PRB resource allocation is present and set to 1?

question_68829.question: What is the expected final state of the MS in the test defined in sub-clause 81.2.3.2?
question_68829.ground_truth: The MS will stay in the state of GA-RC DEREGISTERED as the registration fails.

question_68831.question: What is the role of the Security Edge Protection Proxy (SEPP) in the 5G System architecture?
question_68831.ground_truth: The SEPP is responsible for protecting control plane messages at the perimeter of the PLMN.

question_68832.question: What is the purpose of the "No Reply" cause in the "HHO.FailOutIntraNodeB" and "HHO.FailOutInterNodeBIntraRNC" measurements?
question_68832.ground_truth: The "No Reply" cause is used to identify instances where an expected RRC message is not received by the source RNC, indicating a failed hard handover due to a timeout or other communication failure.

question_68833.question: What is the purpose of the PHY-Status-IND primitive?
question_68833.ground_truth: The PHY-Status-IND primitive is used by the L1 to notify higher layers of an event that has occurred. The parameters of this primitive include Feedback information and Event value.

question_68834.question: What is the main use case description for provision of an International M2M Service for a Business Customer in the document?
question_68834.ground_truth: The main use case is described in section 4.3 of the document, where a business customer needs a M2M type service that requires mobile devices to be deployed in multiple countries. The mobile network operator that will provide the M2M service does not have operations in most of the countries involved and therefore needs to use the eUICC based solutions to manage the provision of correct APN(s) for the foreign mobile networks.

question_68835.question: In which of the described cases is the number of successes for the event "Deactivation" increased by one in the intra-band PCell FDD scenario?
question_68835.ground_truth: The number of successes for the event "Deactivation" is increased by one when the last CSI report is received by the SS earlier than or equal to subframe (n+8), and DTX is not observed by the SS anywhere outside the specified subframes in the intra-band PCell FDD scenario.

question_68838.question: What is the primary MCPTT system in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_68838.ground_truth: The primary MCPTT system is a MCPTT system where the MCPTT User Profile of an MCPTT User is defined.

question_68839.question: What is the benefit of using an application level signalling bearer like TMGI 9?
question_68839.ground_truth: The benefit of using an application level signalling bearer like TMGI 9 is that MC service clients can receive floor control messages for all calls going on in the areas of both TMGI 1 and TMGI 2. It also allows a MC service client to request to receive a specific call over a unicast instead of an MBMS bearer, if interested in a call going on in a different area.

question_68840.question: What should the UE do in the above scenario if the radio link quality is worse than Qout,LR and two coresetPoolIndex values are provided?
question_68840.ground_truth: The UE monitors PDCCH in the first or second CORESETs and receives PDSCH scheduled/activated by PDCCH in those CORESETs, and aperiodic CSI-RS resource that apply a TCI-State specific to each CORESET. The UE also transmits PUSCH, PUCCH, and SRS that apply TCI-State or TCI-UL-State specific to each CORESET.

question_68842.question: In the indoor scenario, what percentage of PC1 UE can achieve the target SNR of 30 dB at 39 GHz (n260)?

question_68844.question: What is the purpose of the first-stage SCI in 5G V2X with NR sidelink?
question_68844.ground_truth: The first-stage SCI in 5G V2X with NR sidelink contains information to enable sensing operations, as well as information about the resource allocation of the PSSCH.

question_68846.question: What is the purpose of the Attempted session establishments from users of other network domains measurement in IBCF?
question_68846.ground_truth: The Attempted session establishments from users of other network domains measurement in IBCF provides the number of attempted session establishments originated from users belonging to other network domains at the IBCF in the terminating network. The measurement is split into subcounters per network domain.

question_68847.question: What shall the MCData client do when it receives a SIP 200 (OK) message with the a=setup attribute set to "passive" after requesting the establishment of a MSRP connection?
question_68847.ground_truth: The MCData client shall send a blank MSRP SEND message to bind the MSRP connection and then sends the group standalone SDS message via a MSRP SEND message with a disposition of "DELIVERY".

question_68853.question: What should the Mobile Station do after TCP connection failure while it is in the GA-CSR DEDICATED state?
question_68853.ground_truth: The MS shall release the TCP connection towards the current GANC, stop timer TU3906, release the secure connection towards the SEGW of the current GANC, start timer TU3905, and enter GA-RC-DEREGISTERED state.

question_68855.question: What is the role of an outgoing ECD (OECD) and an incoming ECD (IECD) in the context of hybrid echo generated by the calling and called party?
question_68855.ground_truth: An OECD is responsible for the hybrid echo generated by the calling party in the originating Media Gateway, while an IECD is responsible for the hybrid echo generated by the called party in the terminating Media Gateway.

question_68856.question: What requested info is included in the Ranging/SL positioning service request by the LMF based on the Ranging/SL positioning result calculation mode?
question_68856.ground_truth: If UE based mode is selected, Ranging/Sidelink positioning result is requested; if LMF based mode is selected, Measurement data is requested; if hybrid mode is selected, both Measurement data and Ranging/Sidelink positioning result are requested.

question_68857.question: What message does the SS send to the MS in step 11 of the KET Measurement Order testing scenario?
question_68857.ground_truth: The SS sends a PACKET CELL CHANGE ORDER message to the MS in step 11 of the KET Measurement Order testing scenario.

question_68858.question: What types of messages are defined in the CD supplementary service?
question_68858.ground_truth: There are several types of messages defined in the CD supplementary service, including CD Request, CD Request Acknowledgement, CD Request Negative Response, Process Call Waiting Negative Response, Complete Call Negative Response, and Send Info for Incoming Call Negative Response.

question_68859.question: What should the SMF do when it identifies an existing PDU session or emergency PDU session based on the PDU Session ID in a POST request?
question_68859.ground_truth: The SMF should update the existing SM context and provide the representation of the updated SM context in the "201 Created" response to the NF Service Consumer.

question_68861.question: What should the floor control arbitration logic do upon receiving an RTP media packet from a permitted MCPTT client if the session is not an ambient listening call?
question_68861.ground_truth: Start timer T2 if not running, restart timer T1, stop timer T20 if running, instruct the media distributor to forward the RTP media packets to MCPTT clients, and remain in the 'G: Floor Taken' state.

question_68862.question: What is the frequency separation between the transmitter and receiver in UTRA/FDD?
question_68862.ground_truth: UTRA/FDD is designed to operate with a fixed or variable transmit-receive frequency separation.

question_68864.question: Who is responsible for the model/functionality control in a UE-side model for 5G NR?
question_68864.ground_truth: The model/functionality control (e.g., selection, (de)activation, switching, fallback, etc.) is performed by the UE when the monitoring resides within the UE.

question_68865.question: What action does UE take once it receives the traffic channel information from the 1xRTT system and performs traffic channel acquisition over the 1xRTT access?
question_68865.ground_truth: The UE sends a 1xRTT handoff completion message to the 1xRTT CS access (e.g., 1xRTT BSS).

question_68866.question: What protocol is used for the eNodeB-MME control plane?
question_68866.ground_truth: The S1 Application Protocol (S1-AP) is used for the eNodeB-MME control plane.

question_68869.question: What does the term "FDD" stand for in the abbreviations list?
question_68869.ground_truth: FDD stands for Frequency Division Duplex.

question_68870.question: What message is used in PMIP S2a-based connections to indicate the current TWAN Identifier, timestamp, and UE time zone?
question_68870.ground_truth: The Proxy Binding Update and Proxy Binding Acknowledgement messages in PMIP S2a-based connections include the current TWAN Identifier, timestamp, and UE time zone.

question_68871.question: What is the required number of successful reported values for each requirement (R1 to R3) in the EN-DC FR1 CSI-RS-based L1-RSRP measurement in non-DRX test?
question_68871.ground_truth: The number of successful reported values for each requirement (R1 to R3) must be more than 90% to pass the test. Each requirement is evaluated independently.

question_68873.question: How does the MnS producer determine the file location in the file-based reporting methods?
question_68873.ground_truth: In the file-based reporting methods, the MnS producer stores the files on the MnS consumer, such as a file server, at the location specified by the "fileLocation" attribute.

question_68874.question: What is the system that provides the ProSe App Code and security material to the announcing UE in the described solution?
question_68874.ground_truth: The DDNMF (Direct Discovery Name Management Function) in the UE's HPLMN (Home PLMN) is responsible for providing the ProSe App Code and security material to the announcing UE in the described solution.

question_68875.question: What procedures are used for one-time or continuous reporting of analytics for user data congestion in a geographic area?
question_68875.ground_truth: The procedures for one-time or continuous reporting of analytics for user data congestion in a geographic area are defined in clause~6.8.4.1.

question_68877.question: What should the UE include in the UEInformationResponse message if it has logged measurement entries that are not included in the logMeasInfoList?
question_68877.ground_truth: The UE includes the logMeasAvailable in the UEInformationResponse message.

question_68881.question: What is the purpose of the Reset-Request (RSR) command in the V4 interface?
question_68881.ground_truth: The Reset-Request (RSR) command is used in the V4 interface to reset the session and is sent from HSS to the V2X Control Function.

question_68883.question: What service can be provided at the discretion of the network operator but is outside the scope of the CAMEL specification?
question_68883.ground_truth: Serving network-based service numbers may be provided at the discretion of the network operator but are outside the scope of this specification.

question_68885.question: What is the purpose of the Discovery Entry ID in the Discovery Request/Response message in the PC3 reference point?
question_68885.ground_truth: The PC3 reference point needs to be updated to support the Discovery Entry ID in the Discovery Request/Response message to confirm the corresponding operation.

question_68886.question: What should be included in the Reception Report request for an MBMS transmission?
question_68886.ground_truth: The Reception Report request should include the URI of the file for which delivery is being confirmed, use a single HTTP session to confirm the successful delivery of a single file, and include the URI of the file for which delivery is being confirmed in XML format.

question_68888.question: What device is the source and destination for the expected sequence 6.1A?
question_68888.ground_truth: The source device is SIM and the destination device is ME.

question_68889.question: How many AMR codec modes are not significantly impacted by the input speech level compared to EFR in tandeming?
question_68889.ground_truth: The highest modes (12.2 down to 7.4 kbit/s) are not significantly impacted by the input speech level compared to EFR in tandeming.

question_68890.question: What is the purpose of providing an indication, like setting Bit 1 of the AMF field, in the AV sent by the HSS?
question_68890.ground_truth: The purpose of providing an indication in the AV sent by the HSS is to control the binding feature, to indicate whether the AV should be processed or bypassed. This allows the HSS to determine whether to encrypt the RAND or not, without requiring the involvement of MME, eNB, or UICC.

question_68892.question: What does the term "TSG" refer to in the context of 3GPP?
question_68892.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group.

question_68894.question: What should a UE with a deactivated NR SCG do when it has uplink data to send on a DRB for which there is no MCG RLC bearer?
question_68894.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the procedure to inform E-UTRAN, so that the NR SCG can be activated to transmit the uplink data.

question_68895.question: What is the purpose of using fog computing or multi-access edge computing in a sensor network setup?
question_68895.ground_truth: The purpose of using fog computing or multi-access edge computing in a sensor network setup is to keep sensitive data in a fabrication site and keep the automated process independent of an internet connection, and also to reduce power consumption of the sensing devices and enhance their durability.

question_68896.question: What information should NM provide to NFVO when requesting to update the NS identified by nsInstanceId?
question_68896.ground_truth: NM should provide the updateType as "InstantiateVnf", and instantiateVnfData containing the information for the virtualized part of the gNB, transport network requirements between the virtualized and non-virtualized parts of the gNB, location constraints, and other necessary attributes.

question_68897.question: What are the main contributors to complexity reduction for Option PT2 in relaxed UE processing timeline?
question_68897.ground_truth: The main contributors to complexity reduction for Option PT2 in relaxed UE processing timeline are the baseband: DL control processing & decoder (when both PT1 and PT2 are supported), baseband: UL processing block, and baseband: MIMO specific processing block.

question_68898.question: What is the event being downloaded in the test case described?
question_68898.ground_truth: The event being downloaded is the MT Call event.

question_68900.question: What are the supported facsimile message speeds in the UMTS PLMN environment?
question_68900.ground_truth: The supported facsimile message speeds in the UMTS PLMN environment are 2400, 4800, 7200, 9600, 12000, and 14400 bit/s.

question_68902.question: What is the purpose of 5.4 use case in the context of smart glasses and a smartphone?
question_68902.ground_truth: The purpose of the use case is to enable the smartphone to switch between non 3GPP RAT and 3GPP RAT direct device connections autonomously based on congestion and quality of service, providing a better user experience.

question_68903.question: What is recommended after a handover from GERAN or UTRAN into E-UTRAN if there is no native security context in E-UTRAN?
question_68903.ground_truth: It is strongly recommended to run an AKA and perform a key change on-the-fly of the entire key hierarchy as soon as possible after the handover.

question_68904.question: What is the consequence of the new AMF not receiving the PEI in the UE context transfer during initial registration?
question_68904.ground_truth: If the new AMF does not receive the PEI in the UE context transfer during initial registration, it will initiate the Identity Request procedure to retrieve the PEI from the UE.

question_68905.question: When will the MS indicate "no service" to the user?
question_68905.ground_truth: If registration cannot be achieved because no PLMNs are available and allowable, and the MS does not support access to RLOS, the MS indicates "no service" to the user.

question_68907.question: If the MS receives an ACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT ACCEPT message and the WLAN offload indication information element is included, what should the MS do with the WLAN offload acceptability values for this PDN connection?
question_68907.ground_truth: The MS should store the WLAN offload acceptability values for this PDN connection and use the UTRAN offload acceptability value to determine whether this PDN connection is offloadable to WLAN or not.

question_68909.question: What is the initial time for T1 in 8.2.3.1.4.2?
question_68909.ground_truth: T1 is initially 30 s to allow enough time for the UE to search for cells as it has no prior knowledge of these.

question_68910.question: What is the maximum number of CBR ranges for dedicated SL PRS resource pool?
question_68910.ground_truth: The maximum number of CBR ranges for dedicated SL PRS resource pool is 7.

question_68912.question: What coding is used for the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT parameters if the "SM PDU DN request container" is too large in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message?
question_68912.ground_truth: The ME may decide not to include the "SM PDU DN request container" and any subsequent information elements of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message inside the "PDU Session Establishment parameters".

question_68915.question: What are the two disadvantages mentioned for SOAP in the context of Rx interface?
question_68915.ground_truth: The two disadvantages are the high complexity and the slow processing due to the complex XML format.

question_68916.question: Which term is used in the document to indicate a mandatory requirement to do something?
question_68916.ground_truth: The term "shall" is used in the document to indicate a mandatory requirement to do something.

question_68917.question: Which types of NR UE does this test apply to, starting from which release?
question_68917.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR UE from Release 15 onwards.

question_68918.question: What is the purpose of using a Temp ID in the gNB routing process?
question_68918.ground_truth: The Temp ID serves as a unique identifier for the serving CCNF in the gNB routing process, ensuring proper routing regardless of the availability of the MDD.

question_68919.question: What information does the TSN AF use to derive the TSN QoS information for a given TSN stream or flow of aggregated TSN streams?
question_68919.ground_truth: The TSN AF uses the priority values in the stream filter instances in PSFP information, 5GS bridge delay information, and scheduled traffic information to derive the TSN QoS information for a given TSN stream or flow of aggregated TSN streams.

question_68920.question: What information is passed to the extendLifeTimeRes() method when the extend lifetime request is successful?
question_68920.ground_truth: The session ID is passed to the extendLifeTimeRes() method when the extend lifetime request is successful.

question_68923.question: How does the update granularity of timing advance become more accurate when SCS increases?
question_68923.ground_truth: The update granularity of timing advance becomes more accurate when SCS increases, which is necessary for 52.6-71 GHz to consider UE timing advance requirements, including UE initial access timing error limit, BS controlled timing advance, UE autonomous timing adjustment requirements, and the aggregated adjustment rate during work item.

question_68927.question: What is the objective of the split control for robotics use case?
question_68927.ground_truth: The objective of the split control for robotics use case is to enable fast and reliable sensing, planning, and controlling for mobile robots in an ever-changing environment without requiring intensive computations on board. This is achieved by offloading computations from robots to the cloud and performing local processing for low-latency responses during periods when network access quality is varying worse.

question_68928.question: What is the procedure for the PDN GW-initiated PDN Disconnection Procedure if the UE binding lifetime has expired?
question_68928.ground_truth: If the PDN GW-initiated PDN Disconnection Procedure is triggered by the UE binding lifetime expiration, steps 1 and 2 may be omitted.

question_68929.question: How much was the degradation in UBER performance when UBER was at 10%?
question_68929.ground_truth: The UBER performance degraded by about 0.6dB at UBER=10%.

question_68930.question: What indicates differentiation between logical channels in uplink and downlink resource sharing?
question_68930.ground_truth: The type of message which is indicated in the radio block header allows differentiation between logical channels in uplink and downlink resource sharing.

question_68931.question: What should the MCE do when it receives an MBMS Session Start Request after the M3AP path failure, if the "MBMS session re-establishment indication" flag is not set?
question_68931.ground_truth: The MCE should initiate the Reset or M3 Setup Request procedure towards the related MME, and the MME should then subsequently re-establish the MBMS bearer services affected by the M3AP path failure by initiating MBMS Session Start procedure(s) towards the MCE.

question_68932.question: What should the user do if they want to set up a call other than speech or emergency calls in the CTS?
question_68932.ground_truth: The user should send the request to the CTS-FP, which may issue a rejection cause.

question_68934.question: What action should the UE take if the expiration time in the <contact> sub-element that it registered is shortened, as indicated in a NOTIFY related to the reg event package?
question_68934.ground_truth: The UE should adjust the expiration time for that public user identity using the expires attribute of the <contact> sub-element that it registered. If required, the UE should also start the re-authentication procedures by initiating a reregistration.

question_68936.question: What is the purpose of the Follow-on Proceed information element?
question_68936.ground_truth: The Follow-on Proceed information element indicates that an MM connection may be established on an existing RR connection.

question_68940.question: What is the result of the "BARRING OF REGISTRATION OF ANY COMMUNICATION DIVERTED-TO ADDRESS EXHPLMNC" enumeration value in the tDivertedToAddressRegistrationBarring simple type?
question_68940.ground_truth: Registration of any international communication diverted-to address except addresses within the hplmn country is barred.

question_68941.question: What conditions must be met for the relative CSI-RSRP measurement requirements to be valid?
question_68941.ground_truth: The relative CSI-RSRP measurement requirements apply when the CSI reference signals in discovery signal occasions are transmitted on one antenna port only from each TP, conditions defined in 36.101 Clause~7.3 for reference sensitivity are fulfilled, and CSI-RSRP is specified in Annex B.3.15 or Annex B.3.17 for a corresponding Band, depending on the scenario.

question_68942.question: What information is provided by the HSS to the 3GPP AAA server or MME/S4-SGSN when a UE moves between 3GPP and non-3GPP accesses?
question_68942.ground_truth: The PDN GW identity and the corresponding PDN information for each of the already allocated PDN Gateway(s).

question_68943.question: What is the purpose of the MapGroupToMBSsession message in the MCPTT system?
question_68943.ground_truth: The MapGroupToMBSsession message includes association information between the group call and MBS session, allowing the MCPTT server to send media packets to all users who will receive the call via the MBS delivery.

question_68944.question: What is the impact of deprecating the use of the Vendor-Specific-Application-Id AVP in commands for vendor-specific applications?
question_68944.ground_truth: The deprecation of the Vendor-Specific-Application-Id AVP in commands for vendor-specific applications has no impact on existing or new 3GPP applications.

question_68945.question: What does the acronym "IRP" represent in the document?
question_68945.ground_truth: In the document, "IRP" stands for "Integration Reference Point."

question_68946.question: What should the UE do during T4 regarding PUSCH transmission for PSCell?
question_68946.ground_truth: The UE should stop sending PUSCH for PSCell no later than the slot defined in T4, otherwise, it should increase the number of failed iterations by one and switch off the UE.

question_68947.question: Which type of information is included in the HS-DSCH-Resources-Information-AuditRsp field?
question_68947.ground_truth: The HS-DSCH-Resources-Information-AuditRsp field includes information about the resource operational state, availability status, and iE-Extensions of an HS-DSCH resource.

question_68948.question: What information does the Node B include in the CELL SYNCHRONISATION FAILURE INDICATION message if a specific CSB transmission fails?
question_68948.ground_truth: The CSB Transmission ID IE to uniquely identify the concerned CSB transmission

question_68950.question: What are the three reference points between the CAPIF core functions and the API provider functions?

question_68953.question: How does the un-processed vector with special RAND work in avoiding denial of service and resource exhaust attacks?
question_68953.ground_truth: The use of the un-processed vector with special RAND is rare and limited to cases when the binding feature should be bypassed for a specially equipped device. Although it may reduce unpredictability of RES, the use of the un-processed vector is designed to limit potential security risks and improve network reliability.

question_68954.question: What happens when a PINE is removed from a PIN?
question_68954.ground_truth: There are two possible ways to remove a PINE from a PIN: the PINE leaves the PIN, or the PEMC/PIN server removes the PINE from the PIN.

question_68957.question: What is ULFPTx Mode 0 in Mechanism-2, UE used for?
question_68957.ground_truth: ULFPTx Mode 0 is used for UEs with full-rated PAs on each TX chain and enables full power transmission.

question_68958.question: What is the definition of Access Transfer as per the document?
question_68958.ground_truth: Access Transfer is the transfer at the IMS-level of one or more media paths of an ongoing IMS session on one UE between PS to CS access; or transfer at the IMS-level of both the signalling and the media path of an ongoing IMS session on a UE between different IP-CANs.

question_68960.question: What are the objectives of deriving an optimum QoS profile?
question_68960.ground_truth: The objectives of deriving an optimum QoS profile are to ensure service performance, avoid over-demanding or under-demanding network costs, and make more accurate traffic routing decisions.

question_68961.question: In E-UTRAN FDD inter-frequency OTDOA measurements, what is the condition for the UE to report the RSTD for the reference cell and all neighbor cells?
question_68961.ground_truth: The UE physical layer shall be capable of reporting RSTD for the reference cell and all the neighbor cells i out of at least (n-1) neighbor cells within provided the conditions apply for all subframes of at least PRS positioning occasions, PRP is less than or equal to 1,2 dBm, and for all Frequency Bands meet -15 dB for the reference cell and -15 dB for neighbor cell i.

question_68962.question: What is the expected UE behavior when a WLAN AP is not included in wlan-NameList in test case 8.1.6.3.3.3.2?
question_68962.ground_truth: The UE must not include the measurement result of the WLAN AP not included in wlan-NameList in the UEInformationResponse message.

question_68963.question: How many patterns of association between midambles and channelisation codes are there for special default midamble allocation scheme for MIMO dual stream transmission?
question_68963.ground_truth: There are two patterns (pattern 1 and pattern 2) of the association between midambles and channelisation codes for special default midamble allocation scheme for MIMO dual stream transmission.

question_68965.question: What information does CU-UP send in the E1AP message UE BEARER SETUP RESPONSE in step 3?
question_68965.ground_truth: CU-UP sends at least S1 DL TNL address and F1 UL TNL address for SCG bearer in the E1AP message UE BEARER SETUP RESPONSE in step 3.

question_68966.question: When will the UE perform access barring check for the Access Category during the initiation of the procedure?
question_68966.ground_truth: If the UE selects a UAC-BarringPerCat entry and the corresponding UAC-BarringInfoSet is available, the UE performs access barring check for the Access Category using the selected UAC-BarringInfoSet as the "UAC barring parameter".

question_68967.question: What is the significance of the IRP requirements subset in the 3GPP's TSG?
question_68967.ground_truth: The IRP requirements subset is significant because it allows for the selection of a subset of IRP requirements based on input from operators, which can be used to satisfy specific network management contexts and needs.

question_68968.question: Which two elements are common to both the tMbmsLevelType and tNetworkMonitoringInfoType, and what are their data types?
question_68968.ground_truth: The two common elements are "geographical-area" and "time-validity". Their data types are tGeographicalAreaDef and tIntegerAttributeType, respectively.

question_68969.question: What action will the IWF take if an MCPTT group for the served MCPTT group ID does not exist?
question_68969.ground_truth: The IWF will consider the MCPTT user to be ineligible for affiliation and skip the rest of the steps.

question_68970.question: What is the purpose of the Test Tolerance in this test requirement?
question_68970.ground_truth: The Test Tolerance is used to relax the Minimum Requirement for the test, and the explanation of how the Minimum Requirement has been relaxed by the Test Tolerance is given in clause F.4.

question_68972.question: What entities are responsible for the interactions when supporting SMS over IP in deployment scenarios with 2G/3G/4G accesses?
question_68972.ground_truth: The interactions are between HSS, UDM, and SMS over IP as defined in 3GPP TS 23.204.

question_68973.question: What is the purpose of using 5G credentials for UE behind an RG when it is not using untrusted Non-3GPP access to register?
question_68973.ground_truth: Using 5G credentials for UE behind an RG, even when it is not using untrusted Non-3GPP access to register, allows operators to identify UE behind RG and offer enhanced services such as Wi-Fi speed increase.

question_68975.question: What should the UE do when the entry condition for event A3 is not met for a neighbor NR cell?
question_68975.ground_truth: The UE should not send a MeasurementReport.

question_68976.question: What is the maximum time for the MS to be ready to transmit the CIPHERING MODE COMPLETE message after receiving the CIPHERING MODE COMMAND message?
question_68976.ground_truth: The MS should be ready to transmit the CIPHERING MODE COMPLETE message before 500 ms after the end of the CIPHERING MODE COMMAND message.

question_68977.question: What are the two main steps in determining the position of a UE within the UTRAN?
question_68977.ground_truth: The two main steps are signal measurements and position estimate (and optional velocity computation) based on those measurements.

question_68978.question: What action should the UE take if it experiences internal overheating and prefers to temporarily reduce its DL and UL category?
question_68978.ground_truth: Include reducedUE-Category in the OverheatingAssistance IE, and set reducedUE-CategoryDL and reducedUE-CategoryUL to the number to which the UE prefers to temporarily reduce its DL and UL category.

question_68982.question: What is the purpose of the 5GS providing Assisted or Complement Timing in this solution?
question_68982.ground_truth: The 5GS provides Assisted Timing as a backup timing service or Complement Timing to complement the external inaccurate primary local source.

question_68983.question: What is the role of an Attester in a typical attestation cycle?
question_68983.ground_truth: The Attester performs integrity measurements on the target system and generates a set of claims, known as Evidence, to show that the system has not been breached and is in a valid state.

question_68985.question: What is the effect on the positioning accuracy when Nt is reduced to 128, for AI/ML assisted positioning?
question_68985.ground_truth: Reducing Nt from 256 to 128 does not appreciably degrade the positioning accuracy, while the measurement size and signalling overhead shrink to (approximately) 1/2 that of Nt=256.

question_68988.question: What does Solution 8 propose to enhance the AKA (Authentication and Key Agreement) for Relay nodes?
question_68988.ground_truth: Solution 8 proposes to enhance AKA by including device authentication using a symmetric key between the RN and HSS/MME. The user plane traffic is protected using AS level security enhanced authentication with mutual authentication based on credentials stored on the RN.

question_68989.question: What is the purpose of the BEST service's five general processes between the UE and the HSE?
question_68989.ground_truth: The five general processes between the UE and the HSE in the BEST service are session initiation and key agreement, key management, data transfer, session termination, and message rejection.

question_68990.question: What is one way that QoS differentiation can be provided in solution #16?
question_68990.ground_truth: QoS differentiation can be provided for different PINEs per PDU session / S-NSSAI and per QoS flow basis. The default QoS associated with the PDU session can be different based on the DNN and S-NSSAI. The PEGC can identify the communication from PINEs based on, for example, MAC address or IP addresses.

question_68991.question: How do capturing devices communicate spatial information in the mentioned use case?
question_68991.ground_truth: The capturing devices communicate the spatial information via a UE that can access the mobile network of the MNO that supports spatial mapping.

question_68994.question: What is the requirement for cell phase synchronization accuracy of IAB-DUs in Rel-15 and gNBs?
question_68994.ground_truth: The cell phase synchronization accuracy requirement of IAB-DUs is the same as that for Rel-15 gNBs.

question_68995.question: What is the initial DL BWP set to for the 7MHz allocation in SIB1?
question_68995.ground_truth: The initial DL BWP (BWP#0) is set to 5 MHz to accommodate legacy and new UEs.

question_68996.question: What is the purpose of the 5G system in optimizing mobility management for ambient-enabled IoT devices?
question_68996.ground_truth: The 5G system aims to support mobile ambient-enabled IoT devices that are unable to stay constantly active, improving their mobility management.

question_68997.question: When should the UE include the Geolocation-Routing header field with a "yes" header field value?
question_68997.ground_truth: The UE should include the Geolocation-Routing header field with a "yes" header field value if the UE includes a Geolocation header field. This indicates that the location of the UE can be used by other entities to make routing decisions.

question_68998.question: What does the service request procedure do?
question_68998.ground_truth: The service request procedure is used by the UE to establish a secure connection to the network or to request the resource reservation for sending data, or both.

question_68999.question: What message does the source gNB-DU send to the gNB-CU when the gNB-CU requests to create an UE context and setup one or more data bearers for inter-gNB-DU mobility?

question_69000.question: In which mode is the BSN 4 bits in length and ranges from 0 to 15 in DCCH TBF mode and CDCH TBF mode?
question_69000.ground_truth: DCCH TBF mode and CDCH TBF mode

question_69002.question: What should the browser do if the URL provided in the "PROACTIVE COMMAND: LAUNCH BROWSER" does not match the Default URL or the URL that can be reached from the gateway defined by default in the browser parameters?
question_69002.ground_truth: The browser should respond with an HTTP status error code (4xx "Client Error" or 5xx "Server Error") and ignore the URL request regarding the test case verdict generation.

question_69004.question: In what scenarios should the UE include the Uplink data status IE in the SERVICE REQUEST message when sending it over a 5G network?
question_69004.ground_truth: The Uplink data status IE should be included in the SERVICE REQUEST message when the UE has one or more active always-on PDU sessions associated with the access type over which the SERVICE REQUEST message is sent and the user-plane resources for those PDU sessions are not established. Additionally, the Uplink data status IE should be included if the UE has pending user data to be sent for those PDU sessions.

question_69005.question: What is the difference between Authentication (AUTC) and Authorization code (AUTZ) in a VPN?
question_69005.ground_truth: Authentication in a VPN verifies if a user is allowed to exercise certain options in the network, while Authorization code allows a VPN user to override calling restrictions of the VPN station from which the call is made.

question_69006.question: What digit range is used for protocol number or next header in IPv4 and IPv6 for the specified <protocol number (ipv4) / next header (ipv6)< parameter?
question_69006.ground_truth: The <protocol number (ipv4) / next header (ipv6)< parameter uses a digit range from 0 to 255.

question_69008.question: What event should be used to indicate to the UE measurement control information indicating to the UE that event-triggered reporting is used?
question_69008.ground_truth: Event A3 is used to indicate to the UE measurement control information indicating to the UE that event-triggered reporting is used.

question_69009.question: What is the procedure for user-initiated emergency reregistration, as defined in 3GPP TS 24.229?
question_69009.ground_truth: The procedure for user-initiated emergency reregistration involves the user's equipment (UE) performing a new emergency registration if half of the time for the emergency registration has expired, and if there are emergency-related dialogs, standalone transactions, or the user initiates an emergency call. The UE will not perform user-initiated emergency reregistration in any other cases.

question_69010.question: What is the impact of a successful EAS de-registration with the EES?
question_69010.ground_truth: The EES removes the registered EAS Profile and replies to the EAS with an EAS de-registration response.

question_69011.question: What is the version of the schema that the network should set for the schemaVersion element?
question_69011.ground_truth: The schemaVersion should be set to 3.

question_69012.question: What aspects of beam peak search procedures for CA are yet to be determined for certain cases?
question_69012.ground_truth: The aspect of beam peak search procedures for CA is to be determined for the case where the frequency separation is larger than 800 MHz, and the device manufacturer does not explicitly declare that the beam peak is applicable for a group of other intra-band combinations. This aspect is currently not determined in the specifications.

question_69015.question: What types of nodes and functionality require enhancements to support new monitoring messages and/or IEs?
question_69015.ground_truth: The Tsp and T5 interface require enhancements to support new monitoring messages and/or IEs.

question_69016.question: What is the minimum uplink rate for the combination described in 7.4.5a?

question_69017.question: What is the action taken when a new MCVideo group information entry is not added to the candidate list for a specific MCVideo group ID?
question_69017.ground_truth: The candidate list is discarded, and the server skips the remaining steps.

question_69019.question: What is one of the conformance requirements for the 27.22.7.15 Network search mode change event, as defined in the 3GPP TS 31.111 clause 4.13?
question_69019.ground_truth: The ME shall support the network search mode mechanism.

question_69020.question: Which signalling messages can result in extensive signalling overload for S4 and S11 interfaces?
question_69020.ground_truth: Modify Bearer Request and Create Session Request/Response can result in extensive signalling overload for S4 and S11 interfaces.

question_69023.question: What should the SS do if the UE requests navigation model and almanac assistance data in A-GNSS test cases?
question_69023.ground_truth: The SS should provide them in different MEASUREMENT CONTROL or ASSISTANCE DATA DELIVERY messages.

question_69024.question: What are the models used for subslot TTI tests with different QAM modulation at minimum power?

question_69025.question: What action should the SGSN take if an active PDP context needs to be modified but the MS is not in the READY or PMM CONNECTED state?
question_69025.ground_truth: The SGSN should directly delete the concerned PDP context(s).

question_69027.question: What should the UE do if the 380 (Alternative Service) response contains an IM CN subsystem XML body with the type set to "emergency" and the CS domain is available?
question_69027.ground_truth: The UE should attempt emergency call via CS domain using appropriate access technology specific procedures.

question_69029.question: How does intent assurance differ from intent fulfillment in Intent-driven MnS?
question_69029.ground_truth: Intent assurance is a part of intent fulfillment that focuses on the recurring actions needed to keep assurance requirements achieved. This is contrasted with intent deployment, where the intent's goal only describes the availability or presence of a network or service.

question_69030.question: What is the role of the MME when intercepting SMS over NAS?
question_69030.ground_truth: The MME acts as an ICE when intercepting SMS over NAS.

question_69031.question: What is the role of IOI in IMS messages?
question_69031.ground_truth: IOI is a globally unique identifier used for inter operator accounting purposes in IMS messages.

question_69032.question: What is the applicability of the test case described in 7.5.1.5.2?
question_69032.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of NR (New Radio) UE (User Equipment) from Release 15 onwards supporting 5GS (5G System) NR (New Radio) SA (Standalone) FR2 (Frequency Range 2) and CSI-RS (Cumulative Spectrogram Image) based RLM (Radio Link Monitoring).

question_69033.question: What is the purpose of using Huffman coding in the large symbol coding method?
question_69033.ground_truth: Huffman coding is used for efficient encoding of the new differential indices in the large symbol coding method.

question_69034.question: What is the purpose of Stage 2 in the context of HSCSD as per the document?
question_69034.ground_truth: Stage 2 identifies the functional capabilities and information flows needed to support the HSCSD service. It also identifies various possible physical locations for the functional capabilities. The output of Stage 2 is used as an input to Stage 3, the design of signalling system and switching Recommendations.

question_69035.question: How is the APNx-load-metric calculated when the PGW has not advertised the APN's load-metric?
question_69035.ground_truth: The APNx-load-metric, representing the load-metric for an APN without one advertised by the PGW, can be calculated using the formula provided in the document. It involves using the load-metric of available APNs, the PGW-load-metric, and the capacity and resource-limit of those APNs.

question_69036.question: What is the optional parameter in the AssistRequestInstructions operation that specifies the capabilities of the gsmSSF?

question_69037.question: What kinds of charging data are required to be supported by the PCEF in the P-GW for session based online charging?
question_69037.ground_truth: The PCEF in the P-GW is required to support charging data related to IP-CAN bearers and charging data related to service data flows for session based online charging.

question_69038.question: When is the establishment of necessary radio resources performed for unsuccessful PS handover?
question_69038.ground_truth: This will be performed upon MS arrival in the target cell if not all the PFCs were successfully created in the target BSS or not all the RABs were allocated in the target RNS.

question_69039.question: What is the test purpose for testing the stopping and resetting of the timer T3212 in the periodic location updating procedure when the MS has responded to paging and the first correct L3 message that is not an RR message is received?
question_69039.ground_truth: The purpose is to verify that the MS stops and resets the timer T3212 in the specified scenario.

question_69040.question: What should the system simulator set as default parameters for the serving cell in this test?
question_69040.ground_truth: The system simulator should set the serving cell with default parameters.

question_69041.question: Which logical channels should be prioritized over NR sidelink communication?
question_69041.ground_truth: Any MAC CE listed in a higher order than 'data from any Logical Channel, except data from UL-CCCH' should be prioritized over NR sidelink communication.

question_69043.question: What is the purpose of the I-SMF (Intermediate SMF) sending a quota request to the CHF in the 19ch-a step?
question_69043.ground_truth: The I-SMF sends a quota request to the CHF in the 19ch-a step to request quota for both its own and I-SMF usage when "start of service data flow" needs quota from the CHF.

question_69045.question: How were the results of the listening test analyzed to provide an overall ranking of the audio systems?
question_69045.ground_truth: The results were analyzed by constructing a matrix of preferences from the comparisons and then rescaling and summing over the test subjects. This allowed for the ranking of the audio systems on different quality scales, such as timbre and immersion.

question_69046.question: What is the maximum number of GUAMI?

question_69049.question: What is the difference between centralized SON, distributed SON, and hybrid SON?
question_69049.ground_truth: In centralized SON, the SON algorithm is located in the 3GPP management system and executed towards the networks. In distributed SON, the SON algorithm is located in the network functions and executed in the network nodes. In hybrid SON, the SON algorithm is partially located in the 3GPP management system and partially located in the network functions.

question_69051.question: How does the UE allocate PDCCH candidates for monitoring to USS sets for the primary cell?
question_69051.ground_truth: UE allocates PDCCH candidates for monitoring to USS sets for the

question_69052.question: What should the network do if it receives a registration request indicating initial or emergency registration from the UE before the UE-initiated de-registration procedure has been completed?
question_69052.ground_truth: The network shall abort the de-registration procedure and the registration procedure shall be progressed.

question_69053.question: What should a UE do if T3410 timeout occurs during an attach procedure for cases b, c, d, l, la, and m?
question_69053.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3410, increment the attach attempt counter, and start timer T3411 if the attach request is not for emergency bearer services. If the attach request is for emergency bearer services and the attach type is not set to "EPS emergency attach", the UE should start the attach procedure when timer T3411 expires.

question_69054.question: When does the gsmSSF use the operation timer for EstablishTemporaryConnection?
question_69054.ground_truth: The gsmSSF uses the operation timer for EstablishTemporaryConnection to ensure that it is longer than the maximum allowed time for the signalling procedures to accept the connection.

question_69055.question: What message types are expected in the specific sequence of the interaction between the system simulator and the mobile station?
question_69055.ground_truth: The expected message types in the specific sequence are REGISTER and RElease COMPLETE.

question_69057.question: What information needs to be indicated for the negotiation mechanism for MBMS security on the MB2 interface?
question_69057.ground_truth: The negotiation mechanism for MBMS security on the MB2 interface would allow the GCS AS to indicate whether it has security applied or whether it requires MBMS security services from BM-SC, and for the BM-SC to response if it supports MBMS security services.

question_69058.question: What is the topology adaptation procedure where the IAB-MT migrates from an old parent node to a new parent node?
question_69058.ground_truth: The topology adaptation procedure involves the migrating IAB-node becoming a boundary IAB-node with its IAB-DU retaining F1AP with the source IAB-donor-CU while its IAB-MT obtains RRC connectivity with the target IAB-donor-CU. These steps occur during the migration process from the source IAB-donor-CU to the target IAB-donor-CU.

question_69059.question: What is the maximum cycle length for WB-E-UTRA, LTE-M, and NB-IoT in the case where the extended idle mode DRX cycle length is 10.24s or longer?

question_69060.question: What is the function of the CAAR in the 3GPP TS 23.558 clause 8.9.1.5?
