question_69384.ground_truth: The 2nd order harmonics of the Band 39 BS transmitting may fall into the BS receive band of Bands 43, and the 3rd order harmonics of the Band 39 BS transmitting may fall into the BS receive band of Bands 46.

question_69385.question: What is the term used to describe the concept of a wait time parameter in the E-UTRAN, UTRAN and GERAN protocols, which is the basis for the wait time solution to handle overload conditions?

question_69386.question: What protocol is used by the PCF to send an HTTP request to the UDR, in order to update the Remaining Maximum Slice Data Rate information in the "SlicePolicyControlData" resource?

question_69387.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the Accept-Contact header field of the SIP INVITE request for a private call with transmission control?
question_69387.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should include an Accept-Contact header field containing the g.3gpp.mcvideo media feature tag along with the "require" and "explicit" header field parameters in the SIP INVITE request.

question_69389.question: Upon receiving a SIP INVITE request with SDP information, what action does the SCC AS take to establish a collaborative session for media components served by the "controller UE"?
question_69389.ground_truth: The SCC AS sends a SIP INVITE request to the remote party with SDP information containing the port numbers of the UE for the media component(s) served by the "controller UE".

question_69393.question: How does the application forward a packet to the UE PDU layer in the 5G LAN group communication proposal?
question_69393.ground_truth: The application forwards the packet to the UE PDU layer using a standard protocol such as HTTP, e.g. HTTP: GET foo.com.

question_69394.question: What should be done when the mobile station detects a transmit window stall condition in RLC acknowledged mode?
question_69394.ground_truth: Upon detecting a transmit window stall condition, the mobile station shall set the Stall Indicator (SI) bit in all subsequent uplink RLC data blocks and start timer T3182. If timer T3182 expires before the reception of a PACKET DBPSCH UPLINK ACK/NACK message that makes V(S) < V(A)+WS, the mobile station shall notify a link failure to the RRC layer which in turn shall stop the corresponding RLC entity.

question_69395.question: What is the CRNC Communication Context used for in NBAP?
question_69395.ground_truth: The CRNC Communication Context contains the necessary information for the CRNC for communication with a specific UE and is identified by the CRNC Communication Context ID.

question_69396.question: What should the XCAP server do if it receives a request requiring a password, but the password in the request does not match the current password stored for the user?
question_69396.ground_truth: The XCAP server should respond with an HTTP 409 (Conflict) response.

question_69397.question: What is the role of Sub-part 5 of Part 4 in the OSA API specification?
question_69397.ground_truth: Sub-part 5 of Part 4 of the OSA API specification focuses on the Conference call control Service Capability Feature (SCF). It includes the detailed specifications for implementing conference call control features in 3GPP networks.

question_69399.question: What character in ABNF represents the start of a comment that continues to the end of the line?
question_69399.ground_truth: The semicolon character (";") indicates the start of a comment that continues to the end of the line in ABNF.

question_69401.question: What action is taken if the assigned downlink resources are not reassigned within the reaction time defined in 3GPP TS 45.010?
question_69401.ground_truth: If the assigned downlink resources are not reassigned within the reaction time defined in 3GPP TS 45.010, the mobile station will not be able to respond to polling for downlink ack/nack or USF grant.

question_69402.question: What must the new SGSN do if it cannot derive the old SGSN to send the SGSN Context Request message to?
question_69402.ground_truth: The new SGSN will derive an SGSN that it believes is the old SGSN, which can be either the actual old SGSN or associated with the same pool area as the actual old SGSN. This derived SGSN will then determine the correct old SGSN from the P-TMSI and relay the message to it.

question_69403.question: What message is used to assign uplink resources to a device in response to an access request on the EC-RACH on TS1 using Access Burst (AB)?
question_69403.ground_truth: The EC-AGCH Fixed Uplink Allocation 1 message

question_69407.question: What are the four approaches for real-time automatic translation of languages in rail communication?
question_69407.ground_truth: The four approaches are Speech to Speech (S2S), Speech to Text (S2T), Text to Speech (T2S), and Text to Text (T2T).

question_69409.question: What message type is used to request the establishment of a parallel MM transaction for the registration of a password for all call restriction services?

question_69410.question: What information can satellite coverage availability information include?
question_69410.ground_truth: Satellite coverage availability information can include details about when and where satellite coverage is expected to be available in a given area.

question_69413.question: What is the purpose of the soft buffer management test for FDD PCell in 8.2.3.2.1A?
question_69413.ground_truth: The purpose of the soft buffer management test for FDD PCell in 8.2.3.2.1A is to verify the UE performance with proper instantaneous buffer implementation for FDD as PCell.

question_69415.question: What is the difference between the LocalSDP and RemoteSDP in the IMS media flow?
question_69415.ground_truth: The LocalSDP is associated with the incoming media packets, providing the SDP information expected by the IMS Media Function that has the CC-POI. On the other hand, the RemoteSDP is associated with the outgoing media packets and provides the SDP information expected by the remote end of the media flow.

question_69416.question: What information is included in the logged measurement report for downlink pilot strength measurements in 3GPP TS 38.331?
question_69416.ground_truth: The logged measurement report for downlink pilot strength measurements in 3GPP TS 38.331 consists of measurement results for the serving cell, available UE measurements performed in idle or inactive for intra-frequency/inter-frequency/inter-RAT, time stamp and location information.

question_69417.question: What two security measures can be implemented to prevent compromise of SAE systems from affecting pre-SAE systems?
question_69417.ground_truth: The two security measures are to ensure that CK, IK in AKA authentication vectors used for SAE never leave the HSS, and to use a verifiable difference in AKA authentication vectors given by the HSS to pre-SAE entities and SAE entities.

question_69418.question: What is responsible for establishing an S1 or Iu connection after the reception of a signalling establishment request with a specific CN service domain type?
question_69418.ground_truth: The RAN (Radio Access Network) is responsible for this task.

question_69421.question: What is the minimum and maximum length of the calling party subaddress information element?
question_69421.ground_truth: The minimum length of the calling party subaddress information element is 2 octets and the maximum length is 23 octets.

question_69422.question: When can the test coverage for FDD and TDD tests be considered fulfilled without executing single carrier tests?
question_69422.ground_truth: The test coverage can be fulfilled without executing single carrier tests if corresponding CA tests are tested for FDD tests specified in 8.2.1.1.1, 8.2.1.3.1, 8.2.1.4.3, and 8.7.1, and for TDD tests specified in 8.2.2.1.1, 8.2.2.3.1, 8.2.2.4.3, and 8.7.2.

question_69423.question: What is a key difference between the B2C type of services and the Network Slice concept within the 3GPP TR 23.501 standard?
question_69423.ground_truth: B2C type of services are fulfilled by different PDU connectivity services provided via corresponding PDU sessions, while Network Slice concept makes use of a single network slice, and different PDU sessions may belong to different network slices.

question_69427.question: What message is used to initiate the Information Exchange Termination procedure?
question_69427.ground_truth: The INFORMATION EXCHANGE TERMINATION REQUEST message

question_69428.question: What should the UE do if it supports ProSe direct discovery, ProSe direct communication, or acting as a ProSe UE-to-network relay?
question_69428.ground_truth: The UE should set the ProSe bit to "ProSe supported" and include the corresponding ProSe direct discovery, ProSe direct communication, or ProSe UE-to-network relay bit in the UE network capability IE of the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

question_69429.question: What happens if a Controller is no longer authorized to be part of a Railway Emergency Alert in the FRMCS System?
question_69429.ground_truth: The Controller will be notified but will not be able to manually leave the temporary group of the Railway Emergency Alert. The FRMCS System will terminate the alert of the non-authorized Controller.

question_69430.question: How does the downlink interference from multiple cells received at aerial UEs affect the network?
question_69430.ground_truth: The downlink interference from multiple cells received at aerial UEs degrades downlink throughput performance for both aerial and terrestrial UEs. It requires higher resource utilization level to deliver the same offered cell data traffic, further decreasing the spectral efficiency in the network.

question_69432.question: What is the exit event that moves the GPRS PDP Context from the Idle state to the PDP Context Setup state?

question_69433.question: What should the UE do if it receives the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message with the T3512 value IE from an SNPN?
question_69433.ground_truth: If the UE receives the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message with the T3512 value IE from an SNPN, the UE shall use the value in the T3512 value IE as periodic registration update timer (T3512).

question_69434.question: What resources are maintained in the SGW and PGW after an MME partial failure detection?
question_69434.ground_truth: UE resources (S5/S8 bearer contexts) are maintained until downlink packets arrive for the UE or the timer set in SGW expires. However, no extra network resources are allocated for the affected UEs before and after the MME partial failure.

question_69436.question: What is an Element Manager (EM) in the context of the present document?
question_69436.ground_truth: An Element Manager (EM) is a system that provides a package of end-user functions for management of a set of closely related types of Network Elements (NEs), including Element Management Functions for management of NEs on an individual basis, and Sub-Network Management Functions that are related to a network model for a set of NEs constituting a clearly defined sub-network.

question_69437.question: What are the required characteristics of a networking protocol in a 3GPP system?
question_69437.ground_truth: A networking protocol in a 3GPP system must be capable of running over all supported bearers, support existing transport protocols and their applications, and be widely available, cheap, and reliable.

question_69438.question: What is the impact of the Warning Status Query procedure on the MME (Mobility Management Entity)?
question_69438.ground_truth: The MME distributes the Warning Status Query Request message and receives the Warning Status Reports, which it sends to the CBC. The MME may also aggregate multiple Warning Status Lists to reduce signaling over the SBc interface.

question_69439.question: What information is returned by the AMF to the UE after successful UUAA during PDU Session Establishment?
question_69439.ground_truth: The AMF sends the UUAA result (success/failure) and the UUAA Authorization Payload to the UE.

question_69443.question: What action does the HARQ process take if it is the first received transmission for the TB and it is associated with a broadcast process?
question_69443.ground_truth: The HARQ process considers this transmission to be a new transmission.

question_69446.question: What is the procedure for sending an MCPTT private call request when the originator requests the floor initially?
question_69446.ground_truth: The MCPTT private call request includes a data element indicating that the originator is requesting the floor. This eliminates the need for a separate initial floor request message during media plane establishment.

question_69447.question: What is Selected IP Traffic Offload (SIPTO) for PS Domain only?
question_69447.ground_truth: SIPTO is a mechanism that enables the 3GPP system to offload selected internet traffic towards a defined IP network close to the UE's point of attachment to the access network. The feature improves network efficiency, and is accompanied by a set of requirements for implementation.

question_69449.question: What information flow is shared from the MC client on a non-3GPP device to the MC gateway UE for sharing the details of MBMS bearer announcement received by the MC Client from the MC Service server?

question_69450.question: How does the PDU Families concept provide flexibility for cases where Media Unit Identification is only available for a sub-set of PDU Families?
question_69450.ground_truth: The PDU Families concept provides flexibility by allowing intermediate classification and marking of packets based on identified media types and layer dependencies, even if some parts of the frame-type and slice remain unidentified. This classification can be used to apply differentiated packet handling policies based on whether packets are associated with a "base layer" or "enhancement layer".

question_69451.question: What is the purpose of the Full name for network IE in GMM information message from the network?
question_69451.ground_truth: The Full name for network IE in GMM information message from the network indicates the full length name of the network that the network wishes the mobile station to associate with the MCC and MNC contained in the routing area identification of the current cell.

question_69453.question: What is the response time of the MS to an IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message with a Wait Indication?
question_69453.ground_truth: The MS shall respond to PAGING REQUEST messages sent later than T + (W + 1) s after receiving an IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT REJECT message with a Wait Indication of W seconds.

question_69454.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project Technical Specification Group's study on continuous integration and continuous delivery support for 3GPP NFs?
question_69454.ground_truth: The study aims to automate CI-CD based testing of 3GPP NFs after delivery to an operator's operation environment, and to describe the support the 3GPP system provides for CI-CD and other testing.

question_69456.question: Which information element is included in the request MBMS context activation message to allow the MS to associate the MBMS context with the PDP context over which the IGMP/MLD join message was sent?

question_69457.question: What is the cause of a Database Inconsistency error?
question_69457.ground_truth: This error occurs when there is a mismatch or inconsistency in the data or parameters within a database.

question_69458.question: What information is included in the PC5-S Direct Communication Request in ProSe Direct Discovery?
question_69458.ground_truth: The PC5-S Direct Communication Request in ProSe Direct Discovery includes the ProSe Application ID, Source User Info, Target User Info, and Destination Layer-2 ID.

question_69459.question: What is one method recommended to verify the usage of the ISIM for IMS initial registration?
question_69459.ground_truth: Using a probe between the UICC and the terminal to verify that the information is read from the ISIM.

question_69460.question: What is the role of the LMISF in mid-call interception?
question_69460.ground_truth: The LMISF maintains the IMS call state and, when the target identity is involved in an ongoing IMS call, it starts the interception by delivering the SIP message to the Delivery Function 2 over the X2 reference point.

question_69461.question: What is the maximum value for the "MaximumSpeed" in the "SpeedType" complex type?

question_69462.question: What should be stored when a UE is outside the coverage area and is not using the associated USIM?
question_69462.ground_truth: Usage information for a given IMSI should remain stored on the UICC or ME when a UE is out of coverage and not using the USIM associated with that IMSI.

question_69463.question: What procedure is performed by the SCC AS during session transfer for an inactive session with speech media?
question_69463.ground_truth: The SCC AS selects the second-most recently active session and puts it on hold, or otherwise selects the held session that has been most recently made inactive. All other sessions are released.

question_69466.question: What is the function of UE in the described initial conditions?
question_69466.ground_truth: The UE's function in the described initial conditions is to be fully synchronized with Cell 1 prior to the start of the time duration T1, provide periodic CSI reporting, and adhere to UL CCA model in its transmissions.

question_69469.question: What is the requirement for the measurement reporting delay excluding a delay uncertainty when the measurement report is transmitted on the PUSCH with subframe or slot or subslot duration?
question_69469.ground_truth: The delay uncertainty is 2 x TTIDCCH, where TTIDCCH is the duration of subframe or slot or subslot when the measurement report is transmitted on the PUSCH with subframe or slot or subslot duration.

question_69470.question: What is the definition of repeatability (or test-retest reliability) in the context of 3GPP security assurance methodology?
question_69470.ground_truth: Repeatability, or test-retest reliability, is the ability of a 3GPP security assurance methodology to produce identical test results given identical inputs and conditions.

question_69471.question: What action does the UE take regarding equal priorities between RATs in terms of delete priorities provided by dedicated signalling?
question_69471.ground_truth: Equal priorities between RATs are not supported in terms of delete priorities provided by dedicated signalling.

question_69473.question: How does the MC service server communicate with the MC service client during MBMS MC receive-only mode?
question_69473.ground_truth: The MC service server sends messages to the MC service client over an MBMS bearer on the application level signalling MBMS bearer, which may contain encrypted mission critical identities associated with the subset of clients addressed.

question_69475.question: How many reporting criteria for Intra-frequency event type 1G and an arbitrary combination of event types 1H and 1I should the UE support in the 8.3B section?
question_69475.ground_truth: The UE should support at least 2 reporting criteria for Intra-frequency event type 1G and at least 4 reporting criteria for an arbitrary combination of event types 1H and 1I in the 8.3B section.

question_69476.question: What are the three types of receiver architectures considered for NAICS in the 3GPP study?
question_69476.ground_truth: The three types of receiver architectures considered are pre-decoding IC receiver, post-decoding IC receiver, and Type 3i receiver.

question_69478.question: What is the subject of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network document specified in Release 18?
question_69478.ground_truth: The user equipment (UE) conformance specification for the 5G System (5GS), specifically focusing on the common test environment.

question_69479.question: What is the purpose of the Carrier leakage test in 6.4A.2.2.1?
question_69479.ground_truth: The purpose of the Carrier leakage test in 6.4A.2.2.1 is to exercise the UE transmitter and verify its modulation quality in terms of carrier leakage.

question_69485.question: What are the three components of an MCX UE that should be provisioned for off-network operation?
question_69485.ground_truth: An MCX UE should be provisioned with an MCX Service User Profile, authentication and end-to-end security keys, and off-network MCX Service Groups for use in off-network operations.

question_69486.question: What protocols developed by IETF can be used in 3GPP to protect user traffic on an end-to-end basis?

question_69489.question: What are the three models (A, B, and C) described in the document for ARPF and UDR setup?
question_69489.ground_truth: Model A stores security parameters only in the ARPF, Model B stores security parameters only in the UDR, and Model C stores security parameters both in the ARPF and the UDR.

question_69490.question: What is the maximum allowed delay for a UE to start sending CSI reports for PCell after the start of T3 in the test procedure 4.5.11.1.4.2?
question_69490.ground_truth: The UE shall transmit at least one periodic CSI report for PCell during T3.

question_69491.question: What happens when the MCVideo client B determines that the MCVideo user B has ignored the Private communication request?
question_69491.ground_truth: The MCVideo client B sends a Private communication reject response to the MCVideo client A and the MCVideo client A notifies the MCVideo user A that the Private communication request was rejected (or ignored).

question_69495.question: What is the charging model in a service data flow that is governed by a PCC rule with an "Offline" charging method?
question_69495.ground_truth: Quota management is not required for this service data flow, and usage reporting is required without affecting the delivery.

question_69497.question: How is the residual frequency offset after synchronization modeled?
question_69497.ground_truth: The residual frequency offset after synchronization at MCL = 164 dB is safely modeled by a normal distribution with mean 0 Hz and standard deviation of 10 Hz.

question_69498.question: How should Test Case 10 (TC10) be constructed in the case where a base station supports more than one NB-IoT carrier?
question_69498.ground_truth: Place two NB-IoT carriers at the edges of the Base Station RF Bandwidth, with two UTRA FDD carriers in the middle. Add NB-IoT carriers at the edges using 600 kHz spacing, and add extra UTRA FDD carriers if possible.

question_69499.question: In operation without shared spectrum channel access and for SS/PBCH block and CORESET multiplexing patterns 2 and 3, when does a UE monitor PDCCH in the Type0-PDCCH CSS set?
question_69499.ground_truth: A UE monitors PDCCH in the Type0-PDCCH CSS set over one slot with Type0-PDCCH CSS set periodicity equal to the periodicity of SS/PBCH block.

question_69500.question: How can the MME reduce message processing load on local competing networks in the event of a network failure?
question_69500.ground_truth: By using a Periodic TAU timer value sent by the HSS and/or the low access priority indication, the MME can allocate a long periodic TAU timer value to the UE, slowing down the rate of movement of UEs from a failed network to other local competing networks.

question_69502.question: What should the "From" and "To" header fields be set to when sending a REGISTER request that will remove the binding between the public user identity and one of its contact addresses or flows?
question_69502.ground_truth: The "From" and "To" header fields should be set to the SIP URI that contains either the public user identity to be deregistered or, if the UE supports RFC~6140 and performs the functions of an external attached network, the main URI of the UE.

question_69503.question: What is the requirement for the SFTD measurement reporting delay, assuming that the measurement report is not delayed by other RRC signaling on the DCCH?
question_69503.ground_truth: The SFTD measurement reporting delay shall be less than the measurement period defined in clause 8.17.2.2.

question_69504.question: What is the SCCP Message type in the intermediate unprotected representation when the SCCP Message type in the intermediate unprotected representation is "UDT"?
question_69504.ground_truth: The SCCP Message type in the intermediate unprotected representation is "UDT" when the protected message is transported within an SCCP UDT message.

question_69506.question: What is the purpose of evaluating the estimated UE transmit power when determining if a TFC meets the Elimination criterion?
question_69506.ground_truth: The UE estimates the UE transmit power needed for a TFC, and if this estimated value is greater than the Maximum UE transmitter power for a specified number of successive measurement periods, the TFC is considered to have met the Elimination criterion.

question_69507.question: What triggers the sending of notifications by the 5GMSd AF to the 5GMSd Application Provider?
question_69507.ground_truth: The 5GMSd AF sends notifications in response to event-related occurrences or at periodic intervals.

question_69508.question: What is Key Issue 2 in the 3GPP study on sponsored data connectivity improvements?
question_69508.ground_truth: Key Issue 2 is related to managing sponsored data connectivity information inside the operator's network. It aims to improve the existing management mechanism for sponsored data connectivity information and includes the provisioning of information related to sponsored data connectivity to PCEF/TDF.

question_69509.question: What is the level of the test signal for handset or headset UE in this process?
question_69509.ground_truth: The level of the test signal is -4,7~dBPa at the MRP for handset or headset UE.

question_69510.question: What is the role of the SMF in the translation of RAN BAW to 5GS ingress BAW?
question_69510.ground_truth: The SMF translates RAN BAW to 5GS ingress BAW and signals RAN preferences to PCF.

question_69511.question: What is a challenge in current GTP-c load balancing when a GW node has a partial failure or is undergoing maintenance?
question_69511.ground_truth: DNS weights associated with the node can become stale or provide wrong information about the node's capacity. This can result in uneven distribution of SGW or PGW load and network overload issues.

question_69512.question: What information can the Ambient IoT devices store and monitor for laundry purposes?
question_69512.ground_truth: The Ambient IoT devices can store clothing information such as color, fabric, materials, shape, and temperature. They can also monitor parameter values such as temperature and humidity, which can be used to detect sweat stains.

question_69514.question: What is part of the information presented to the user to enable service selection in the user service discovery process?
question_69514.ground_truth: A list of available MBMS user services or user service bundles, along with information on the user services.

question_69516.question: What protocol does the IMS use to provide support for Multimedia Priority Service?
question_69516.ground_truth: IP multimedia session/call control protocol based on Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) and Session Description Protocol (SDP)

question_69517.question: How long should the MS wait before initiating an emergency call in the limited service state?

question_69519.question: What is the criteria for the 3rd order intermodulation component to overlap with DLCC2?
question_69519.ground_truth: The criteria for the 3rd order intermodulation component to overlap with DLCC2 is F BW - F DUP - (a+b) - b < c+d < F BW - F DUP + b.

question_69520.question: What is recommended for the UE when receiving PUSCH transmission in sTTI (sPUSCH) with a subframe granularity?
question_69520.ground_truth: It is recommended not to superimpose PUSCH and short TTI sPUSCH on the same REs, and to support PHICH-less asynchronous UL HARQ for sPUSCH.

question_69521.question: What should the TRAU do for the AoTDM-AoIP mixed case when the call is locally switched?
question_69521.ground_truth: The TRAU should send some "silence codeword" on the A interface to allow the supervision of the circuits for the leg using AoTDM, and if G.711 codec is used over AoIP, the TRAU should send some "silence codeword" on the A interface, else the BSS should send e.g. some SID frames on the AoIP-Interface to allow the supervision of the IP-links.

question_69522.question: What must the MCData client do upon receiving an initial SIP INVITE request?
question_69522.ground_truth: The MCData client follows the procedures for termination of multimedia sessions in the IM CN subsystem as specified in 3GPP TS 24.229 with the clarifications provided in TS 24.282, clause 10.2.5.2.4.

question_69523.question: What is the current issue with PDB in different deployments?
question_69523.ground_truth: The current issue with PDB in different deployments is that it does not consider the variety in delay between RAN nodes and PSA UPFs.

question_69527.question: What is the role of the 3GPP AAA Proxy in the LBO scenario for initial attach with PMIPv6 on S2b?
question_69527.ground_truth: In the LBO scenario, the 3GPP AAA Proxy acts as an intermediary and forwards messages from the 3GPP AAA Server in the HPLMN to the PDN GW in the VPLMN, and vice versa. This allows for message exchanges between the PDN GW in the VPLMN and the hPCRF in the HPLMN, which are forwarded by the vPCRF in the VPLMN.

question_69530.question: What initial access signals and channels are introduced to support larger PRACH transmission power under PSD limitation and/or to meet OCB requirement in NR-related Release 16 Features?
question_69530.ground_truth: For PRACH, longer PRACH sequences of length 1151 and 517 are introduced, applicable to 15kHz SCS and 30kHz SCS, respectively. Legacy length 839 PRACH sequence is not supported in a cell with shared spectrum channel access.

question_69531.question: What is the function of the MBMS-URL Handler as defined in the present document?
question_69531.ground_truth: The MBMS-URL Handler is a logical function that translates the MBMS-URL to a sequence of MBMS-API calls in order to provide resources delivered by MBMS User Services to a general application.

question_69533.question: What is the observation for the Urban 4GHz TDD scenario in terms of the worst channel for MIL and coverage bottleneck?
question_69533.ground_truth: The worst channel for MIL in the Urban 4GHz TDD scenario is PUSCH for eMBB with frame structure DDDSU, which can be the coverage bottleneck for the given scenario. The channels that need to be enhanced to achieve the target MPL calculated from 400m ISD are PUSCH for eMBB with frame structures DDDSU and DDDSUDDSUU.

question_69534.question: What action must an emergency attached MS take after completing the Attach procedure?
question_69534.ground_truth: The emergency attached MS must initiate the PDP Context Request procedure directly after the Attach procedure is completed.

question_69536.question: What should the UAE-S include in the HTTP 200 (OK) response when the UAS UE registration is successful?
question_69536.ground_truth: The UAE-S should include a result element set to "success" in the registration-info element of the UAE-info root element.

question_69537.question: What must the MSGin5G Server do if a message is too large to be sent?
question_69537.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server segments the message into a set of segmented MSGin5G messages such that each segmented MSGin5G message can fit within the maximum allowed MSGin5G message segmentation size.

question_69539.question: What message is required to be created when modifying PC5 QoS parameters for existing PC5 QoS flow(s) in a 5G ProSe direct link?
question_69539.ground_truth: A PROSE DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION REQUEST message is required to be created.

question_69540.question: What is the function of the SCEF in the reliable delivery of Non-IP data between UE and SCEF using the Control Plane CIoT EPS Optimization?
question_69540.ground_truth: The SCEF applies rate control and indicates to the MME the status of the DL data delivery, which may be forwarded to the AS.

question_69541.question: What is the effect of lawful interception on the target's communication?
question_69541.ground_truth: Lawful interception shall not alter the operation of a target's services or provide any indication to any party involved in the communication.

question_69542.question: What action does the MS perform when it switches on and performs GPRS ATTACH on Cell A?
question_69542.ground_truth: The MS performs an initial Cell Update by sending an LLC frame when it performs a GPRS ATTACH on Cell A.

question_69543.question: What is the role of the SMF during PDU session establishment and modification regarding QoS for devices behind the 5G-RG?
question_69543.ground_truth: The SMF may signal Non-3GPP QoS Assistance Information (N3QAI) for each QoS flow to the 5G-RG, which the 5G-RG can use to reserve resources in the non-3GPP network behind the 5G-RG for consumer real time applications.

question_69544.question: What action should the MCData client perform upon receiving a display indication or processing of the payload by the target application?
question_69544.ground_truth: The MCData client should store "READ" as the disposition type, store the current UTC time as the stored SDS notification time, generate an SDS OFF-NETWORK NOTIFICATION message, send the message to the stored sender MCData user ID, initialize the counter CFS2 (SDS notification retransmission) with the value set to 1, and start timer TFS2 (SDS notification retransmission).

question_69546.question: What is the message definition for the SIP MESSAGE request to send an emergency notification in 3GPP TS 24.229?
question_69546.ground_truth: The message definition for the SIP MESSAGE request to send an emergency notification in 3GPP TS 24.229 is specified in clause 18.1.2, which includes the Request-URI, MIME body, and the P-Asserted-Identity header field.

question_69547.question: Which entity interacts with CHF for charging in Solution #8.2 for converged charging for NSSAA?
question_69547.ground_truth: AAA-P interacts with CHF during NSSAA procedure for a given UE and S-NSSAI for CHF to produce appropriate CDR for charging for "requesting (re-)authentication/authorization" between the owner of the NSSAAF and the owner of the AAA-S.

question_69548.question: What is the result of the startStreamingService() method being received with a parameter serviceID?
question_69548.ground_truth: The MBMS client uses the Manifest file to offer a valid media presentation to the Media client, stores the URL of the Manifest file, and sends a serviceStarted() notification.

question_69549.question: What additional information can the SGSN provide in signalling messages sent to the GGSN/P-GW to disable the charging functions in the SGSN in TS 23.203?
question_69549.ground_truth: The SGSN can include extra information in the signalling messages sent to the GGSN, such as IMEISV, RAT type, S-CDR CAMEL information, CGI/SAI, and user CSG information, depending on the situation.

question_69550.question: What should the UE do with the radio link failure information after 48 hours?
question_69550.ground_truth: The UE should discard the radio link failure information after 48 hours.

question_69552.question: What does the OCS do after receiving the Debit Units Request for a refund?
question_69552.ground_truth: The OCS performs the Debit Units Request operation for refund and returns the Debit Units Response to the ProSe Function.

question_69553.question: What is the measurement that, when not supported for the target band and the serving cell's band, results in transmission restrictions on the union of restricted serving cell symbols in simultaneousRxTxInterBandCA?

question_69555.question: What protocols are used for routing user data and control signalling in the backbone network?

question_69557.question: When can the HA remove any associated IPv4 binding cache entry while processing a periodic Binding Update?
question_69557.ground_truth: If the Binding Update does not include the IPv4 home address option, the HA shall remove any associated IPv4 binding cache entry.

question_69559.question: What is the relation between the SLSS transmission initiation delay and the SLSS period in the initiation/cease of SLSS?
question_69559.ground_truth: The initiation/cease delay of SLSS transmissions can be expressed as: Tevaluate,SLSS + SLSS period, where Tevaluate,SLSS is the evaluation time for initiate/cease of SLSS and SLSS period is set as 40ms in this test.

question_69560.question: What is the role of Rg reference point in the GUP system?
question_69560.ground_truth: The Rg reference point in the GUP system allows applications to create, read, modify, and delete any user profile data using the harmonized access interface.

question_69561.question: What is the expectation of the initiating MCPTT user during a broadcast group call?
question_69561.ground_truth: The initiating MCPTT user expects no response from the other MCPTT users during a broadcast group call.

question_69562.question: What information does the NG-RAN node use when setting up the UE-associated logical NG-connection towards the 5GC for access control of subsequent mobility?
question_69562.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node uses the list of CAGs allowed for the UE and, whether the UE is allowed to access non-CAG cells to set up the UE-associated logical NG-connection.

question_69564.question: What information element is used to indicate the PLMN Identity?

question_69568.question: What is the name of the threat that involves storing passwords in an insecure way?

question_69570.question: What is the guard band for the Tx UE to protect the MSS frequency range 1518-1559MHz?
question_69570.ground_truth: The guard band for the Tx UE to protect the MSS frequency range 1518-1559MHz is 1 MHz separation frequency between IMT/LTE and MSS.

question_69571.question: What should the MCPTT client do upon receiving a SIP re-INVITE request for an existing private call with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body and an <emergency-ind> element set to "true"?
question_69571.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should display to the MCPTT user an indication that this is a SIP re-INVITE request to upgrade this call to an MCPTT emergency private call, display the MCPTT ID of the originator of the MCPTT emergency private call, display an indication of the MCPTT emergency alert and associated information if the <alert-ind> element is set to "true", and set the MCPTT emergency private priority state to "MEPP 2: in-progress" for this private call.

question_69572.question: What is the final state of the MS for execution counter M = 2?
question_69572.ground_truth: The active state (U10) of a call on cell A.

question_69574.question: What should the MS do if the network commands it to reallocate the RR connection, and the establishment of the main DCCH fails?
question_69574.ground_truth: The MS should release all the allocated packet resources, revert to the old channel, trigger the establishment of the main DCCH, and send a DTM ASSIGNMENT FAILURE message on the main DCCH with cause value "lower layer failure".

question_69575.question: What is one of the objectives for the system procedures for location service in different slice types?
question_69575.ground_truth: One of the objectives for the system procedures for location service in different slice types is to avoid overhead for repetitive non-successful privacy verification when the UE user has temporarily disallowed location exposure.

question_69576.question: In what scenario will the Requested-UTRAN-GERAN-Authentication-Info AVP be required to be present?
question_69576.ground_truth: When the requestingNodeType parameter within SendAuthenticationInfoArg takes the value of "sgsn" or "mme-sgsn".

question_69578.question: What value should the MCVideo client set the Expires header field to, if the targeted MCVideo user is no longer interested in any MCVideo group at the targeted MCVideo client?
question_69578.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should set the Expires header field to zero.

question_69579.question: What is a SAPI and how is it used in the AN/CN connection?
question_69579.ground_truth: A SAPI is used as a connection identifier allocated unambiguously to each connection during its lifetime. In the infrastructure side, it is used to identify the connection and in the exchanges at the AS boundary.

question_69584.question: What is the maximum limit for the phase error in GMSK modulation in normal BTSs?
question_69584.ground_truth: The maximum limit for the phase error in GMSK modulation in normal BTSs is 5 degrees rms and 20 degrees peak.

question_69585.question: What is the preferential protocol approach for integrating TSN into a 5G system from a RAN perspective?

question_69586.question: What must be supported by a target eNB and the target MME for PDN connections with UP integrity protection set to Required to be transferred from 5GS to EPS?
question_69586.ground_truth: The target eNB and the target MME must indicate support of User Plane Integrity Protection with EPS.

question_69587.question: What action must the UE take if the IM CN Subsystem Signalling Flag is not received upon successful signalling PDP context establishment?
question_69587.ground_truth: The UE shall consider the PDP context as a general-purpose PDP context if the flag is not received.

question_69588.question: What should the input signal to the BSSTE be compared with, in order to meet conformance requirements?
question_69588.ground_truth: The input signal before channel encoding in the BSSTE should be compared with the signal obtained from the BSS receiver after channel decoding.

question_69589.question: What is the mode of operation used when Public Safety ProSe enabled UEs are not in proximity of a group owner or network coverage?
question_69589.ground_truth: The ad-hoc mode architecture is used in such cases.

question_69592.question: Which category of Trustworthy Machine Learning focuses on correcting and eliminating bias in machine learning models?

question_69593.question: What is the main focus of the 6.1.2.2.2 conformance requirements?
question_69593.ground_truth: The 6.1.2.2.2 conformance requirements focus on the Mobile Station (MS) invoking a MO-LR by sending a REGISTER message to the network containing a LCS-MOLR invoke component, receiving a FACILITY message from the network containing a LCS-MOLR return result component, and terminating the dialogue by sending a RELEASE COMPLETE message after the last location request operation.

question_69594.question: What are two means by which GNSS system providers can protect against jamming attacks?
question_69594.ground_truth: GNSS system providers can protect against jamming attacks by using stronger signals broadcast on more frequencies and using more constellations simultaneously.

question_69595.question: What is the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group that the provided document is a part of?

question_69596.question: What is the effect of the clear method on the TLV list of an EditHandler and the current TLV selected?
question_69596.ground_truth: The clear method clears the TLV list of an EditHandler and resets the current TLV selected.

question_69597.question: What is the purpose of the AI index field in the availability combination of soft symbols or soft RB sets in an RB set group in a slot?
question_69597.ground_truth: The AI index field includes the maximum of the values provided by the corresponding availabilityCombinationId, with a minimum of 1 bit and a maximum equal to the ceiling of the log base 2 of the maximum AI index plus 1.

question_69598.question: What is the method of test for section 26.2.1.3.2?
question_69598.ground_truth: The method of test for section 26.2.1.3.2 involves sending a PAGING REQUEST message to the MS and storing the "Random Reference" contained in the CHANNEL REQUEST message sent by the MS. This is performed K times, and it is verified that the MS produces different values r(k).

question_69600.question: What are the four categories of attributes used to describe Bearer Services in the 3GPP's documentation?
question_69600.ground_truth: The four categories of attributes used to describe Bearer Services in the 3GPP's documentation are Information transfer attributes, Access attributes, Interworking attributes, and General attributes.

question_69601.question: What HTTP status code is returned by the NEF when successfully creating a new "Individual Slice Parameters Provisioning" resource?
question_69601.ground_truth: The NEF responds with an HTTP "200 OK" status code when successfully creating a new "Individual Slice Parameters Provisioning" resource.

question_69602.question: What is the probability of false detection of the ACK defined as in 8.3.12.2?
question_69602.ground_truth: The probability of false detection of the ACK is defined as a conditional probability of erroneous detection of the ACK when input is only noise.

question_69603.question: What is the format of the DedicatedSIBRequest message for requesting the required posSIB(s)?
question_69603.ground_truth: The UE should include requestedPosSIB-List in the onDemandSIB-RequestList to indicate the requested posSIB(s) if the procedure is triggered to request the required posSIB(s).

question_69604.question: What should the mobile station do when it receives a PACKET UPLINK ASSIGNMENT message while the Uplink TBF is extended?
question_69604.ground_truth: The mobile station should switch to the new assigned channels and continue sending PACKET DUMMY CONTROL BLOCKs in the uplink.

question_69605.question: What condition must be met before the SS changes the SNR value to T1 in the test procedure?
question_69605.ground_truth: The test equipment must have received the initial preamble transmission from the UE.

question_69606.question: What is an association class in UML?
question_69606.ground_truth: An association class is an association that also has class properties and is used when an "InformationObjectClass" needs to maintain associations to several other instances of "InformationObjectClass" and there are relationships between the members of the associations within the scope of the "containing" "InformationObjectClass".

question_69608.question: What message does the Serving GANC send the MS after receiving the handover command from the target GERAN?
question_69608.ground_truth: The Serving GANC transmits the GA-RRC HANDOVER COMMAND to the MS including the details sent by the GERAN on the target resource allocation.

question_69609.question: What is required to achieve end-to-end QoS for a session between AIPNs, including cases involving more than one network administration and different QoS ensuring methods?
question_69609.ground_truth: AIPNs should be able to guarantee end-to-end QoS for a user-to-user or multicast (e.g. user-to-multicast) session between AIPNs, including cases involving more than one network administration in the provision of the end-to-end service, and support different QoS ensuring methods within the same AIPN and between different AIPNs. It is also required to support interworking between different QoS ensuring methods in the end-to-end path.

question_69610.question: What should a UE do upon sending a DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT message and receiving a list of forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming"?
question_69610.ground_truth: The UE should store the TAI(s) belonging to the serving PLMN or equivalent PLMN(s) and ignore the TAI(s) which do not belong to the serving PLMN or equivalent PLMN included in the IE, if not already stored, into the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming".

question_69611.question: What is the purpose of the USAT Interpreter System as defined in TS 31.111?
question_69611.ground_truth: The USAT Interpreter System allows Application Systems to use an USAT Interpreter for services requiring the usage of USAT specific functionality.

question_69612.question: What information does the MS need to initiate the registration procedure towards a Serving GANC?
question_69612.ground_truth: The MS needs the GANC-SEGW address, a GANC address, and a GANC TCP port number to initiate the registration procedure towards a Serving GANC.

question_69613.question: What are the three components of the Transport Format for E-DCH?
question_69613.ground_truth: The Transport Format for E-DCH consists of three parts: the dynamic part, the semi-static part, and the static part.

question_69615.question: What is identified as the worst channel in terms of MIL for the Rural 700MHz FDD NLOS O2I scenario?

question_69616.question: What is the Psharing factor used to determine the P value for an RLM-RS resource measured in the set?
question_69616.ground_truth: The Psharing factor used to determine the P value for an RLM-RS resource measured in the set is 3.

question_69618.question: What is the procedure for the UE in determining the presence of access networks in the access network discovery procedure?
question_69618.ground_truth: The UE may use the information provided by the ANDSF, such as a query from the ANDSF, or apply the techniques specific to the non-3GPP access technologies to discover available non-3GPP access networks. The UE may also signal to the ANDSF to obtain information on operator preferred access networks. The discovery of the ANDSF by the UE, the connection to the ANDSF by the UE, and the signaling between the UE and the ANDSF are given in clause~6.8.

question_69620.question: What is one method for a UE to make a request for a file from a repair server using the File Repair without FDT approach?
question_69620.ground_truth: A UE can make the request for the file from symbol-based repair servers and conventional HTTP servers by determining the MD5 of the latest version of the file of interest, and the list of files in a session that do not have a file schedule.

question_69622.question: What should the P-CSCF do if it receives a 1xx or 2xx response to the initial request and the response is originated from a UE which the P-CSCF considers as privileged sender?
question_69622.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should remove any P-Preferred-Identity header field, if present, and skip the steps that follow.

question_69624.question: What is the scope of the synchronization used in the uplink direction for signals received from terminals inside one cell?
question_69624.ground_truth: Timing advance is used in the uplink direction for signals received from terminals inside one cell, allowing for TDMA/FDMA component for resource division.

question_69625.question: What is the parameter that should be the largest among all the measured cells in inter-frequency RSTD?
question_69625.ground_truth: The parameter that should be the largest among all the measured cells in inter-frequency RSTD is T.

question_69627.question: In what cases are NAS messages processed by the receiving EMM entity in the UE or forwarded to the ESM entity without network establishing a secure exchange of NAS messages for the NAS signalling connection?
question_69627.ground_truth: NAS messages including IDENTITY REQUEST, AUTHENTICATION REQUEST, AUTHENTICATION REJECT, ATTACH REJECT, DETACH ACCEPT, TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT, and SERVICE REJECT are processed by the receiving EMM entity in the UE without network establishing a secure exchange of NAS messages for the NAS signalling connection in certain situations.

question_69629.question: Which parameter of the Protocol Negotiation Result event indicates the possible failure cause in case of negotiation failure?

question_69630.question: In case of 512-sample TCX, how many packets will have a "hole" where the overflowing bits will be written, after overflow has happened?
question_69630.ground_truth: In case of 512-sample TCX, only one packet will have this "hole" where the overflowing bits will be written.

question_69631.question: What is the role of the IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS) in the AOC service?
question_69631.ground_truth: The IMS is used to specify the stage 3 description of the AOC service in the TISPAN NGN Release 2 network.

question_69632.question: What is one function of the LMF in the Ranging/SL positioning service?
question_69632.ground_truth: The LMF requests and controls the UE to perform Ranging/SL positioning measurement, receives the Ranging/SL positioning measurement from the UE and makes calculation, and returns the Ranging/SL positioning result to the AMF.

question_69634.question: What is the outcome if terminating traffic for a registered user cannot be processed correctly until a new initial registration takes place?
question_69634.ground_truth: This could result in an abnormal situation where the user is not identified as registered and the request is sent to the HSS as an error.

question_69635.question: What is the role of the user equipment (UE) in the UTRAN UE Positioning function?
question_69635.ground_truth: The user equipment (UE) in the UTRAN UE Positioning function provides the mechanisms to support the calculation of the geographical position of a UE, which can be used for various purposes such as supporting Radio Resource Management functions and location-based services.

question_69638.question: What is the effect of a successful verification of integrity in the MS during a UMTS authentication challenge?
question_69638.ground_truth: If the integrity is successfully verified in the MS during a UMTS authentication challenge, then the MS checks if the replayed MS network capability and replayed MS Radio Access Capability in the AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING REQUEST message has not been altered compared to the latest MS network capability and the latest MS Radio Access Capability that the MS sent to the network. If the replayed MS network capability and replayed MS Radio Access Capability in the AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING REQUEST message are not the same as the latest MS network capability and the MS Radio Access Capability that the MS sent to the network, then the MS ignores the authentication and ciphering procedure.

question_69639.question: What are the main four candidates being studied for PRS Tx diversity schemes in section 6.2?
question_69639.ground_truth: The main four candidates being studied for PRS Tx diversity schemes in section 6.2 are Antenna switching, Transmit diversity 1, Transmit diversity 2, and Random antenna switching.

question_69640.question: What happens to the MP-DCCP connection associated with a QoS flow, after a QoS flow is deleted and this QoS flow was used to transfer MP-DCCP-LL traffic?
question_69640.ground_truth: The MP-DCCP connection associated with this QoS flow is released

question_69641.question: What action is taken when the UDR detects loss or corruption of partial temporary data?
question_69641.ground_truth: The UDR notifies the corresponding NFs with DNN/S-NSSAI as identification of the impacted temporary data via NRF, allowing NFs to take actions to restore these parts of data as needed.

question_69642.question: What is the format of the TP-User-Data field when TP-UDHI is set to 1?
question_69642.ground_truth: When TP-UDHI is set to 1, the TP-User-Data field contains a header in the following order: Information-Element-Identifier, Length of Information-Element, and Information-Element Data.

question_69644.question: What should be the minimum conformance requirement for the single-tone and multi-tone transmission minimum output power for the channel bandwidth for category NB1 and NB2?
question_69644.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement for the single-tone and multi-tone transmission minimum output power for the channel bandwidth for category NB1 and NB2 is -40 dBm for 3.75kHz and 15kHz sub-carrier spacing.

question_69645.question: What is the role of the gNB-DU ID in the 3GPP 5G system?
question_69645.ground_truth: The gNB-DU ID is used to uniquely identify the gNB-DU within a gNB-CU in the 3GPP 5G system.

question_69646.question: How many signaling interactions are needed in the optimized service flow of the pressure powered switch use case?
question_69646.ground_truth: Through optimized protocols, only a minimal number of signaling interactions is needed for the switch to complete the procedure and transmit its identity.

question_69647.question: What is the purpose of sending a Handover Notify message in inter-H(e)NB mobility?
question_69647.ground_truth: The purpose of sending a Handover Notify message in inter-H(e)NB mobility is to continue handover procedures as per TS23.401 or TS23.060.

question_69649.question: What type of RF requirement enhancement is covered by CR-200666?
question_69649.ground_truth: CR-200666 covers NR RF requirement enhancements for frequency range 2 (FR2) in RAN#86.

question_69650.question: What command is used in the scenario to display a text string on the ME?
question_69650.ground_truth: The GET INKEY command is used in the scenario to display a text string on the ME.

question_69651.question: How many panels per CPE are being considered for the bi-directional operation for two panels in the CPE?
question_69651.ground_truth: For the bi-directional operation for two panels in the CPE, two panels per CPE for both transmit and receive are being considered, with each panel pointing in opposite directions.

question_69655.question: What should the UE do if it supports S1 mode?
question_69655.ground_truth: The UE must set the S1 mode bit to "S1 mode supported" in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message, include the S1 UE network capability IE in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message, and set the HO attach bit if it supports transferring a PDU session from N1 mode to S1 mode.

question_69656.question: What is the purpose of the sum subcounter in the UE Context Release Request measurement?
question_69656.ground_truth: The sum subcounter is provided when only a subset of per cause measurements is supported in the UE Context Release Request measurement.

question_69657.question: What is the role of the UIM (Umbrella Information Model) in the 3GPP Technical Specification document?
question_69657.ground_truth: The UIM provides the set of classes that strengthen consistency of representation in the fixed and mobile environments for management of a Federated Network Information Model (FNIM) solution. However, it cannot be used directly for implementation.

question_69658.question: What action should the UE take upon receiving a NOTIFY request for reg event?
question_69658.ground_truth: The UE should respond with a valid 200 OK response when it receives a NOTIFY request for reg event.

question_69659.question: What is the role of the SKM-C in the SEAL key provisioning procedure?
question_69659.ground_truth: The SKM-C is a SEAL KM client located in a VAL server that may send a SEAL Key Provision request to the SKM-S to provision key information applicable to a particular VAL service, VAL client, VAL device, or VAL user.

question_69660.question: What is the aim of the Furnish Charging Information IF?
question_69660.ground_truth: The Furnish Charging Information IF is used to request the gsmSSF to include call related information in the CAMEL specific logical call record, which is moved to the corresponding CDR once the logical call record is completed.

question_69661.question: How can the MME or ePDG discover PGW-C/SMFs available within a PGW-C/SMF Set in a deployment using a PGW Set FQDN?
question_69661.ground_truth: The MME or ePDG can discover the PGW-C/SMFs available within a PGW-C/SMF Set by initiating an S-NAPTR procedure with the Application-Unique String set to the PGW Set FQDN, and with the "Service Parameters" set to "x-3gpp-pgw:x-s5-gtp" or "x-3gpp-pgw:x-s8-gtp" (for an MME) or to "x-3gpp-pgw:x-s2b-gtp" (for an ePDG).

question_69662.question: What is the difference between unconditional and conditional DIP values in the context of the interference characterization?
question_69662.ground_truth: Unconditional DIP values are DIP ratio statistics presented without any conditions, while conditional DIP values are median DIP values presented for different values of geometry.

question_69663.question: What is the purpose of using FEC offsets 5 and 7 in the EVS channel aware mode?
question_69663.ground_truth: The purpose of using FEC offsets 5 and 7 in the EVS channel aware mode is to maximize the availability of partial copies in the event of larger error bursts that are common with network conditions resulting in higher JICO.

question_69664.question: What function provides the procedures for IMS emergency session anchoring and PS to CS access transfer?

question_69665.question: What is the impact of unidirectional beam arrangement for UL Doppler shift?
question_69665.ground_truth: The unidirectional beam arrangement results in a virtually constant UL Doppler shift towards which the UE tunes its downlink carrier frequency and internal reference frequency. This in turn helps to improve PRACH detection performance, PUCCH decoding performance, and PUSCH demodulation performance.

question_69666.question: What is the maximum number of frame each paging sub-channel occupies in multi-frequency cells?
question_69666.ground_truth: The paging sub-channel occupies a maximum of 2 frame in multi-frequency cells.

question_69667.question: What is the required bandwidth allocation for RTCP specified in a two-party session where both participants are active?
question_69667.ground_truth: The RR bandwidth modifier in the b=RR: line will typically get the value of zero in such sessions.

question_69668.question: What is the procedure for constructing the NAI if the UE is roaming and the "prefer 3GPP RPLMN" indication is set?
question_69668.ground_truth: If the UE is roaming and the "prefer 3GPP RPLMN" indication is set, then the UE shall construct a decorated NAI that includes the realm of the RPLMN when selecting a WLAN that directly interworks with the RPLMN, or construct a decorated NAI that includes the realm of a service provider and the realm of the RPLMN when the selected WLAN directly interworks with a service provider in EVSP. If not, the UE shall construct the NAI as specified in the first case.

question_69669.question: What happens during the MBSR mobility when the MBSR changes the donor gNB-CU?
question_69669.ground_truth: The MBSR keeps announcing the same TAC, which prevents UEs from performing mobility registrations. The new donor gNB-CU forwards the MBSR context to the AMFs in case of full migration and may remove the TAC if no other MBSRs context using the same TAC exist.

question_69671.question: What is the name of the exception that indicates a service error in the PlayVoiceXmlMessage operation?

question_69673.question: What is the role of the 3rd party provider in this use case?
question_69673.ground_truth: The 3rd party provider offers services to participants of an e-game event and negotiates with Network A to manage resources and access to their services during the event at the specified location.

question_69675.question: What should the UE do if it has received all segments of a warning message and complete geographical area coordinates from SIB8?
question_69675.ground_truth: The UE should forward the received warning message, messageIdentifier, serialNumber, dataCodingScheme, and geographical area coordinates (if any) to upper layers and continue reception of SIB8.

question_69678.question: What is the advantage of using UE information for H(e)NB location verification?
question_69678.ground_truth: Using UE information allows for H(e)NB location verification even if the H(e)NB moves to an unregistered address, and requires an attacker to compromise both the IP address and false macro-cell information to commit fraud.

question_69679.question: What action does the MME/SGSN take after sending the non-IP data to the UE using data transfer via the MME procedure?
question_69679.ground_truth: The MME/SGSN sends a NIDD Submit Response (cause) message towards the SCEF acknowledging the NIDD Submit Request from SCEF.

question_69682.question: What three entities are responsible for bitrate control allocation within the 5GS?
question_69682.ground_truth: The three entities responsible for bitrate control allocation within the 5GS are the Slice PCF, SMF, and UPF.

question_69685.question: Which bit depth is used for internal bit-depth for all sequences in H.265/HEVC anchors?
question_69685.ground_truth: The internal bit-depth used for all sequences in H.265/HEVC anchors is 10.

question_69686.question: What should a UE do if it prefers to use the PC5 communication path for the ProSe service and the Uu path is currently being used?
question_69686.ground_truth: The UE should switch to the PC5 communication path for the ProSe service.

question_69687.question: What needs to be supported by the PC5 of the Layer-3 UE-to-UE relay in order to accommodate off-network direct communications?
question_69687.ground_truth: PC5 of the Layer-3 UE-to-UE relay should support relay discovery, one-to-one communication (including PC5-level mutual authentication between the Remote UE and the Relay UE, as well as IP address assignment), and IP router functionality for off-network direct communications.

question_69688.question: What is the role of the TURN server in the OAuth Implicit Grant based TURN Authentication in WebRTC?
question_69688.ground_truth: The TURN server is the resource server that receives the access token from the TURN client in the OAuth Implicit Grant based TURN Authentication in WebRTC.

question_69689.question: What is the requirement for determining authorization for cancelling an MCPTT emergency group or private call?
question_69689.ground_truth: The IWF may authorize the MCPTT emergency group call cancellation request if it has received a SIP request for an MCPTT group call with the <emergency-ind> element of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body set to a value of "false".

question_69693.question: What action does the MS take upon the second expiry of timer T308 while in the U19 state?
question_69693.ground_truth: The MS enters the U0 "Null" state, releases the MM-connection and returns to the idle mode with relevant CC entities.

question_69694.question: What information is included in the ProSe Direct Communication Transmission and Reception Data Containers in 5G ProSe?
question_69694.ground_truth: The components of the Direct Communication Transmission and Reception Data Containers are defined in TS 32.245 and include various fields such as "ProSe Communication ID", "ProSe Communication Flags", "ProSe Communication Size", "ProSe Communication Data", etc.

question_69695.question: What is the format of the address field for control channels and what does the address field extension bit (EA) indicate?
question_69695.ground_truth: The address field consists of the address field extension bit EA, the command/response bit C/R, the SAPI, and the Link Protocol Discriminator LPD. The EA indicates if the address field is extended to span more than one octet.

question_69696.question: In the context of 5G, what are the benefits of implementing a uniform way to provide UEs with security instructions?
question_69696.ground_truth: Benefits of implementing a uniform way to provide UEs with security instructions in 5G include providing a consistent and organized method for providing security instructions, enabling the inclusion of dedicated security functionality in the MT part of the user device, and allowing extensibility for future security features in user devices.

question_69697.question: What is the difference between the D-interface and the A-interface in this specification?
question_69697.ground_truth: The D-interface is a physical interface, while the A-interface is a physical interface as well, but the B-interface is an internal interface defined for modelling purposes and is not normative in this specification.

question_69700.question: What is required for a H(e)NB to indicate its validity to the H(e)MS in the device validation method?
question_69700.ground_truth: The device shall implicitly indicate its validity to the H(e)MS in the device validation method by successful execution of device authentication, which requires the device integrity check to be successful and the CA issuing the H(e)NB device certificate to be trusted by the manufacturer.

question_69702.question: When should the UE ignore the Reflective QoS Indication if it is received during IKEv2 signalling for IPsec tunnel establishment with ePDG or DSMIPv6 over a Fixed Broadband Access network?
question_69702.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the Reflective QoS Indication if it is received during IKEv2 signalling for IPsec tunnel establishment with ePDG or DSMIPv6 over a Fixed Broadband Access network when the UE is attaching to the Fixed Broadband Access network.

question_69704.question: What documentation is needed for providing an exposed MnS discovery service?
question_69704.ground_truth: A study is needed to determine if the exposed MnS discovery service should be provided by an MnS discovery service producer, a dedicated exposed MnS discovery service producer, or a trusted discovery system.

question_69705.question: What information does the ProSe server provide in the ProSe communication request message to the serving MME for initiating ProSe communication?
question_69705.ground_truth: The ProSe server provides UE discovery profiles of UE-A and UE-B, including UE discovery range class, discovery codes for user-A and user-B, monitoring and/or announcing role in discovery for UE-A and UE-B.

question_69706.question: In what situation should the Node B initiate the Information Reporting procedure for the GANSS Time Model IE when the Information Type Item IE is set to "GANSS Information"?
question_69706.ground_truth: When any change has occurred in the t_ot or WN_t parameter of the GANSS Time Model IE.

question_69707.question: What are the considerations for inter-system mobility in terms of V2X applications?
question_69707.ground_truth: Inter-system mobility needs to consider separate handling of V2X applications and other applications, as the use of NR is expected to surpass the performance of E-UTRA and some advanced V2X applications are supported only by NR.

question_69708.question: What is the main objective of TC14 power allocation?
question_69708.ground_truth: The main objective of TC14 power allocation is to set the power of each carrier to the same power so that the sum of the carrier powers equals the rated total output power as declared by the manufacturer.

question_69709.question: What is the role of the "UE Context Release" message in this process?
question_69709.ground_truth: Upon reception of the UE Context Release message, the source SN releases radio and C-plane related resources associated to the UE context. Any ongoing data forwarding may continue.

question_69710.question: What procedure does the LMF perform after receiving the event report message from the UE?
question_69710.ground_truth: The LMF may obtain location measurements or a location estimate for the UE by performing a UE positioning procedure or use the location measurements and/or location estimate(s) obtained at step 24 and/or step 26 to determine the UE location.

question_69711.question: What are the conditions for the solution to provide redundant data transmission between UPF and UE?
question_69711.ground_truth: The solution requires that the reliabilities of NFs are high enough to fulfill the reliability requirement of URLLC services, the UE is under overlapping coverage of the two RAN nodes, and a redundant transmission is activated for a QoS Flow based on local policies and network conditions.

question_69713.question: In what frequency range do the intra-frequency SS-SINR accuracy requirements in FR1 apply?
question_69713.ground_truth: The intra-frequency SS-SINR accuracy requirements in FR1 apply to a cell on the same frequency as that of the serving cell in FR1.

question_69715.question: What should the UE do if the 380 (Alternative Service) response contains a Contact header field with a service URN top-level service type of "sos"?
question_69715.ground_truth: The UE should initiate an emergency call and set the Request-URI of the initial request for a dialog or the standalone transaction to the URN in the Contact header field.

question_69716.question: How does the OMR procedure handle the case when media resources are required for session establishment?
question_69716.ground_truth: The OMR procedures include a "second SDP offer/answer" transaction that is initiated by any of the involved IMS-ALGs during session establishment towards the initial SDP answerer upon reception of the initial SDP answer and MR resources are required.

question_69718.question: How does the AMF agent handle N2 signaling when a UE moves from one TA to another?
question_69718.ground_truth: The AMF agent replaces the Proxy RAN node ID with the RAN node ID and forwards the response message to the NG RAN node. If a UE moves from one TA to another, the AMF agent sends an acknowledgment message and handles the corresponding NG-AP messages accordingly.

question_69720.question: What is the starting point of the interruption window for SCell activation in NR standalone mode or EN-DC mode?
question_69720.ground_truth: The starting point of the interruption window for SCell activation in NR standalone mode or EN-DC mode is the slot (n + THARQ + 3 ms), where n is the slot where the SCell activation command is received.

question_69721.question: What is the expected MEASUREMENT INFORMATION content in the test procedure?
question_69721.ground_truth: The MEASUREMENT INFORMATION content is the same as in 60.1.

question_69722.question: In case the lower layers indicate that the RRC connection has been suspended and the de-registration type is "switch off", what should the UE do if it is authorized to access CAG cells only?
question_69722.ground_truth: The UE may perform a local de-registration either immediately or after an implementation-dependent time.

question_69723.question: What is the first step in the scenario where there is an API invocation request at the NEF for ECUR mode?
question_69723.ground_truth: The NEF receives an API invocation Request from an AF.

question_69726.question: In what state would a transmission participant enter if the established MCVideo call is a chat group call and the SIP INVITE request is not an implicit Transmission request?
question_69726.ground_truth: The transmission participant would enter the 'U: has no permission to transmit' state.

question_69727.question: What is the format of the Visited Country FQDN for SNPN N3IWF supporting Onboarding?
question_69727.ground_truth: The Visited Country FQDN for SNPN N3IWF supporting Onboarding is constructed as "onboarding.n3iwf.snpn-5gc.mcc<MCC>.visited-country.pub.3gppnetwork.org", where <MCC> is the Mobile Country Code of the visited country.

question_69729.question: What should be done to ensure proper measurement of BER for a multi-band capable Base Station?
question_69729.ground_truth: Steps 5) to 7) of the test procedure should be followed.

question_69730.question: What is the main advantage of solution #3.1 for the roaming context in the 3GPP charging system?
question_69730.ground_truth: The main advantage of solution #3.1 is that it allows requests with new mandatory AVPs to pass through intermediate Diameter Proxy Agents, even those not supporting the AVPs.

question_69731.question: How does the ASM server initiate a pull service experience request from the ASM client?
question_69731.ground_truth: The ASM server sends a pull service experience request to the ASM client, specifying the identity of the VAL server for which the report is required and including the VAL service ID and VAL server identity in the request.

question_69734.question: In TC21b, what should be done if the rated total output power and total number of supported carriers are not simultaneously supported in Multi-RAT operations?
question_69734.ground_truth: Two instances of TC21b should be generated using different values for rated total output power and the total number of supported carriers.

question_69735.question: What is the purpose of the Maximum Group Data Rate per 5G VN group in the context of group related data rate policy control?
question_69735.ground_truth: The Maximum Group Data Rate per 5G VN group is used to control and manage the group data rate for 5G VN groups, either provisioned by the AF, the operator, or both.

question_69738.question: What is the implication of the "BARRING OF ROAMING OUTSIDE THE HOME PLMN" enumeration value in the tBarringOfRoaming simple type?
question_69738.ground_truth: Roaming outside the home PLMN is barred.

question_69739.question: What factors does the measurement reporting delay exclude in its calculation?
question_69739.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay excludes a delay uncertainty resulted when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH, and any delay caused by no UL resources for UE to send the measurement report.

question_69740.question: How does the network transmit new timing advance values to the mobile station?
question_69740.ground_truth: The network sends new timing advance values via a downlink signalling message, called TA-message, on PTCCH/D. The network can also send timing advance information in Packet Timing Advance/Power Control and Packet Uplink Ack/Nack messages on PACCH.

question_69741.question: What happens to the received data when the MAC entity successfully decodes it in a new transmission?
question_69741.ground_truth: If the MAC entity successfully decodes the received data in a new transmission, it delivers the decoded MAC PDU to upper layers.

question_69742.question: What is the procedure for the Edge Application Server to request UE Identifier API from the Edge Enabler Server?
question_69742.ground_truth: The Edge Application Server requests UE Identifier API from the Edge Enabler Server with the User information (such as ACR, Edge Application Server user ID, or IP address of the Application Client) and the Identifier of Edge Application Server. The Edge Enabler Server then responds with the determined UE based on the received user information.

question_69743.question: What should the UE do in case of abnormal cases, other than those specified in other clauses?
question_69743.ground_truth: The UE should proceed by ignoring the CS SERVICE NOTIFICATION message or the Paging with CN domain indicator set to "CS", entering the state MM IDLE, and incrementing the tracking area updating attempt counter. If this counter is less than 5, the UE should start timer T3411 and enter state EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE-MM. If the counter is equal to 5, the UE should perform specific actions based on its operation mode.

question_69744.question: What is the procedure for mobile originating circuit switched calls in the initial conditions of call set-up?
question_69744.ground_truth: The procedure for mobile originating circuit switched calls shall be performed under Ideal radio conditions as defined in clause 5 with initial conditions that the UE shall be operated under normal test conditions and the Test-USIM shall be inserted in the UE.
