question_69745.question: What is the channel identifier used in the test procedure?
question_69745.ground_truth: The channel identifier used in the test procedure is 1.

question_69746.question: What is required for the gsmSCF to establish communication with the network when originating a new call?
question_69746.ground_truth: The gsmSCF establishes communication with the network using CAP signalling and sends an Initiate Call Attempt information flow which contains the address of the called party, then instructs the gsmSSF to continue with the call processing.

question_69747.question: What action should the NRM Server take if the VAL Server is not authorized to initiate a request?
question_69747.ground_truth: The NRM Server should verify whether the VAL server is authorized to initiate such a request and respond accordingly.

question_69748.question: What is the function of the S-E-DPDCH in UL MIMO?
question_69748.ground_truth: The S-E-DPDCH channels in UL MIMO are responsible for transmitting the channel bits on the secondary spatial stream.

question_69751.question: What message does the HSS send to the SCEF to acknowledge acceptance of the Monitoring Request?
question_69751.ground_truth: The HSS sends a "Monitoring Response" message to the SCEF to acknowledge acceptance of the Monitoring Request.

question_69752.question: What is the procedure for wideband adaptive noise filling at 24.4/32kbps in 6.2.3.2.1.3.1?
question_69752.ground_truth: Wideband adaptive noise filling at 24.4 and 32 kbps proceeds by calculating the total available bits and the bits variance for the sub-bands in non-transient frames, and reconstructing the un-decoded coefficients of the sub-band based on the average energy of the sub-band.

question_69753.question: What are the three protocol suites that the standard allows operators to choose from for transporting SCCP messages in the Radio Network Layer?
question_69753.ground_truth: The three protocol suites are ATM Option 1, ATM Option 2, and IP Transport Option. ATM Option 1 uses SCCP with ATM Adaptation Layer (AAL) or MTP3 with SAAL-NNI, ATM Option 2 uses M3UA or SCTP with IP and M3UA, while IP Transport Option uses SCCP, M3UA and SCTP with IP and Multi-homing.

question_69758.question: What is the recommended throttling method for DASH traffic?
question_69758.ground_truth: It is recommended that the throttling bitrate is signaled to the DASH client in order to make use of the information in the rate adaptation.

question_69759.question: What should the UE do if it receives an SOR-CMCI with no rules over N1 NAS signalling and it has an SOR-CMCI stored in the non-volatile memory of the ME?
question_69759.ground_truth: The UE will use the SOR-CMCI stored in the non-volatile memory of the ME.

question_69760.question: What is the state of the MME when the MME has no EMM context or the EMM context is marked as detached?
question_69760.ground_truth: In the state EMM-DEREGISTERED, the MME has no EMM context or the EMM Context is marked as detached.

question_69761.question: What is the impact of the harmonized solution in section 5.1.5.4.2?
question_69761.ground_truth: The harmonized solution is made up of 4 solutions with 3 fundamental functions: FA selection, Call Setup, and Floor control.

question_69762.question: What functions do Call and Session Control provide within ework's Network functions?
question_69762.ground_truth: Call and Session Control functions allow applications to control and monitor calls, packet switched sessions, and IM Sessions. They provide QoS information and monitoring, call handling, user interaction, and event monitoring.

question_69764.question: What action should the MBMS interface take when it receives RTP media packets or floor control messages over the MBMS subchannel?
question_69764.ground_truth: If there is an association between the TMGI, the MBMS subchannel for audio and for floor control with an ongoing conversation in a group session, the MBMS interface shall forward the received floor control messages to the floor participant in the conversation and forward the received RTP packets to the media mixer if the SSRC value is different from the one used by the MCPTT client. If there is no association, the MBMS interface shall ignore the floor control message or RTP media packet.

question_69765.question: What is the role of the Application Server in the ISC interface of the IP Multimedia Subsystem?
question_69765.ground_truth: The Application Server can use the ISC interface to control an IP Multimedia session via a transit function, with transactions initiated as a result of the transit proxying a SIP request to the Application Server.

question_69767.question: What is the purpose of the Syndicated Feed Reception (SFR) specification within 3GPP environments?
question_69767.ground_truth: The SFR specification aims to define the optimized reception for any existing syndicated feeds using 3GPP specific bearers while reusing OMA DCD procedures and metadata for client-server transactions.

question_69768.question: What should the MCData client include in the Payload IE when sending binary data in an DATA PAYLOAD message for SDS?
question_69768.ground_truth: The MCData client should set the Payload content type as "BINARY" when including binary data in the Payload IE of an DATA PAYLOAD message for SDS.

question_69769.question: What is the "NPI" parameter in the "Address" section used for?
question_69769.ground_truth: The "NPI" (Numbering Plan Indicator) parameter is used to specify the numbering plan in use, in this case the ISDN / telephone numbering plan.

question_69770.question: What modulation scheme is used for PDCCH and PBCH?
question_69770.ground_truth: QPSK modulation is used for PDCCH and PBCH.

question_69772.question: What is the procedure for activating SCell2 during the test?
question_69772.ground_truth: The SS sends the activation MAC-CE in subframe (m+10) after activating SCell1 and receiving an ACK.

question_69774.question: What is the maximum time allowed for the overall delays measured in this test case?
question_69774.ground_truth: The overall delays measured in this test case should be less than 802 ms.

question_69778.question: What should the transferor UE do when it receives a NOTIFY request that indicates that the transferee and the transfer target have successfully setup a communication?
question_69778.ground_truth: The transferor UE may terminate the original communication with the transferee UE, by sending a BYE request on the original dialog.

question_69779.question: What procedure does the MCVideo server follow to check if a user is affiliated with an MCVideo group at an MCVideo client?
question_69779.ground_truth: The MCVideo server checks if a user is affiliated with an MCVideo group at an MCVideo client by following the procedures specified in clause~6.3.6, such as finding the applicable MCVideo group information entry and the applicable MCVideo user information entry.

question_69780.question: What is the arithmetic mean obtained in the "Average Number of simultaneous E-RABs" measurement?
question_69780.ground_truth: The arithmetic mean is obtained by sampling at a pre-defined interval, the number of simultaneous E-RABs and then taking the arithmetic mean.

question_69782.question: In what state is the MCPTT client when it is waiting for a response to a Floor request message?

question_69783.question: What is the purpose of Solution #33 in the context of 5G ProSe-enabled UEs?
question_69783.ground_truth: The purpose of Solution #33 is to provide a mechanism for 5G ProSe-enabled UEs to communicate with each other over a direct PC5 link, with the assistance of a UE-to-UE relay in case the direct communication range is exceeded due to UE mobility.

question_69784.question: What type of burst is used for the CTSAGCH and CTSPCH in their respective formats?
question_69784.ground_truth: Normal Bursts (NB) are used for the CTSAGCH and CTSPCH.

question_69785.question: What should the NCR-MT do when measuring CSI-RS for BFD and SSB in the same OFDM symbol in FR1?
question_69785.ground_truth: If the NCR-MT does not support simultaneousRxDataSSB-DiffNumerology, it has to measure one of the two measurements, and longer measurement period for CSI-RS based BFD measurement is expected.

question_69786.question: In what order should the non-CA bands be included in UECapabilityInformation message, considering all non-CA bands are supported by the UE?
question_69786.ground_truth: The non-CA bands should be included in UECapabilityInformation message in the order of decreasing priority, based on whether the UE supports more MIMO layers with TM9 and TM10 than implied by the UE category, whether the UE supports TM10 with one or more CSI processes, or whether the UE supports 1024QAM in DL.

question_69787.question: In the context of this 3GPP technical report, what does MPR stand for?

question_69788.question: What is the maximum number of interruptions allowed during SCell activation for a known SCell with a measurement cycle greater than 160ms in intra-band CA?
question_69788.ground_truth: When the SCell being activated is known and the SCell measurement cycle is greater than 160ms, up to 1+L2,1 interruptions are allowed during SCell activation in intra-band CA.

question_69789.question: What happens when the SGSN receives a reset indication from the VLR in the 3GPP system?
question_69789.ground_truth: When the SGSN receives a reset indication from the VLR, it sets the VLR-Reliable variable to false. It then immediately performs the location update for non-GPRS services procedure for MSs still attached to non-GPRS services or performs a network initiated detach with detach type "IMSI detach" after completion of the periodic routing area update procedure.

question_69790.question: What performance-enhancing feature is aimed at enabling higher data rates in GERAN with minimal impacts to infrastructure?
question_69790.ground_truth: Multi-carrier is a performance-enhancing feature that transmits data to a single user on multiple carriers, increasing peak and average user throughput proportionally to the number of carriers.

question_69793.question: What is the percentage increase in capacity performance for FR1, Dense Urban, DL, with 100MHz bandwidth for VR/AR single-stream traffic model, 45Mbps, 10ms PDB, 60 FPS, with SU-MIMO and 64TxRU, when the offset across UEs is changed from zero to equal?
question_69793.ground_truth: There is a 35.56% increase in capacity performance.

question_69794.question: What is the purpose of the ProSe Layer in the UE communication?
question_69794.ground_truth: The ProSe Layer provides the means for the applications to exchange user data, such as messages, talk bursts, video streams, etc.

question_69795.question: In which states of the mobility management sublayer can a MM connection for an emergency call be established?
question_69795.ground_truth: A MM connection for an emergency call can be established in all states of the mobility management sublayer which allow MM connection establishment for a normal originating call.

question_69798.question: What is the purpose of the N4 Association Release Procedure in 4G Core Network?
question_69798.ground_truth: The N4 Association Release Procedure is used to terminate the N4 association between the SMF and the UPF due to operational, administrative, or management (OAM) reasons.

question_69801.question: In what situation does the algorithm select one frequency from the "sl-SyncFreqList" as the synchronization carrier frequency?
question_69801.ground_truth: When the concerned frequency(ies) are included in "sl-SyncFreqList" as defined in the first and second scenarios.

question_69803.question: What will be the effect if the call crosses network boundaries?
question_69803.ground_truth: The voice path between the shown IMS Core and the remote end will have substantial influence, but this question is not discussed in the present document.

question_69804.question: What is the purpose of the "system scenarios" in the context of the UTRA (Universal Terrestrial Radio Access) standards development?
question_69804.ground_truth: The "system scenarios" are used to decide the physical layer parameters of UTRA operation, particularly the radio transmission and reception. They are used to consider all relevant aspects of operation and identify the most critical cases, which will then help determine the final parameters that meet both service and implementation requirements.

question_69805.question: What does a UE do if a bandwidth part indicator field in a DCI format indicates an active UL BWP different from the current one for UL transmissions?
question_69805.ground_truth: The UE sets the active UL BWP to the indicated one by the bandwidth part indicator, and if the size of the information fields in the DCI format is different between the current and indicated UL BWPs, the UE adjusts the number of bits used for the interpretation of the information fields accordingly.

question_69806.question: What must the Target NG-RAN do when it accepts a QoS Flow based on an Alternative QoS Profile during a handover?
question_69806.ground_truth: After accepting a QoS Flow based on an Alternative QoS Profile during a handover, the Target NG-RAN shall treat it the same way as if it had sent a notification that the GFBR can no longer be guaranteed with a reference to that Alternative QoS Profile to the SMF.

question_69809.question: In which state of the association does the SGSN process the BSSAP+-PAGING-REQUEST message before sending the message on the Gb/Iu-PS interface in the location update for non-GPRS services procedure?
question_69809.ground_truth: The SGSN processes the BSSAP+-PAGING-REQUEST message before sending the message on the Gb/Iu-PS interface in the location update for non-GPRS services procedure in any state of the association except for Gs-NULL.

question_69813.question: What actions should the floor participant take upon the expiry of timer T203 (End of RTP media)?
question_69813.ground_truth: The floor participant should request the MCPTT client to stop rendering received RTP media packets, send the Floor Request message to other floor participants, stop timer T204 (Floor Queue Position request), if it is running, initialize the counter C201 (Floor request) with a value of 1, start timer T201 (Floor Request), clear the stored SSRC of the current floor arbitrator, and enter the 'O: pending request' state.

question_69818.question: What is used to indicate network slice in the SRH during packet forwarding in the 5G System Architecture?
question_69818.ground_truth: A simple transport slice example is used as an example to explain the packet flow in the 5G System Architecture. The SRH contains the set of SIDs mapping to the provisioned Network Instance in the FAR based on local information during packet forwarding. The last SID identifies the N4 session at the next UPF, representing the network slice.

question_69821.question: What is the expected action from involved nodes when overload information is received?
question_69821.ground_truth: Please refer to clause 8.2.4, indicating that a detailed description of the expected actions is specified in a separate clause.

question_69822.question: What is the role of the RedCap UE in the Random Access procedure?
question_69822.ground_truth: The RedCap UE can be identified by the network during the Random Access procedure via MSG3/MSGA from a RedCap-specific LCID(s) and optionally via MSG1/MSGA (PRACH occasion or PRACH preamble).

question_69823.question: What is the measurement provided by SM.CreationDefaultBearerS5S8Succ in the context of 3GPP Evolved Packet System (EPS)?
question_69823.ground_truth: The number of successful default bearer creation in the EPS.

question_69824.question: What is the maximum latency allowed for downloading the "Remote control part" in the split control mode for robotics?
question_69824.ground_truth: The maximum latency for downloading the "Remote control part" in the split control mode for robotics is 12ms.

question_69825.question: What is the impact of requiring UE to blindly detect all interference parameters compared to network assistance/coordination?
question_69825.ground_truth: Requiring UE to blindly detect all interference parameters may increase receiver complexity compared to some network assistance/coordination.

question_69826.question: What is the role of CN in handling Warning Area List in Solution #9?
question_69826.ground_truth: No change on Warning Area List is expected in Solution #9 to support the Public Warning System, and it is managed by IAB-donor gNB.

question_69827.question: How can a specific mode of DANE be queried?
question_69827.ground_truth: A specific mode of DANE can be queried by using the specific DANE FQDN, which identifies that mode of DANE.

question_69828.question: What is the process of obtaining an OAuth 2.0 token from the NRF?
question_69828.ground_truth: The NF requests an OAuth 2.0 token from the NRF, and the NRF authenticates the NF requesting the token using X.509 certificates and a corresponding private key.

question_69829.question: What are the functions supported by the Xn-C interface of the Xn interface?
question_69829.ground_truth: The Xn-C interface supports the following functions: Xn interface management and error handling, UE connected mode mobility management, UE context retrieval, dual connectivity, interference coordination, and self-optimization.

question_69831.question: What is the maximum allowed handover delay value for this test case?
question_69831.ground_truth: The maximum allowed handover delay value is 280 ms.

question_69832.question: What must the AMF include in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message if the UE did not include the requested NSSAI and none of the S-NSSAIs in the requested NSSAI are allowed?
question_69832.ground_truth: The AMF must include the allowed NSSAI containing no S-NSSAIs and the rejected NSSAI containing the requested NSSAI in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

question_69834.question: What is the significance of the conformance requirements in the 3GPP TS 36.579 series of technical specifications?
question_69834.ground_truth: The conformance requirements determine the scope of each test case in the 3GPP TS 36.579 series of technical specifications, and are explicitly copied from relevant core specifications to ensure accurate testing. Any differences in conformance requirements in different releases of the core specifications are specified separately to ensure compatibility and correctness.

question_69835.question: What 5GC control functions are impacted in solution #37?
question_69835.ground_truth: SMF, NEF, PCF, UDR, and UDM are impacted in solution #37.

question_69836.question: What are the ATSSS rules provided to the UE for 5G connectivity?
question_69836.ground_truth: The ATSSS rules are provided from the PGW-C+SMF to the UE via SM NAS signalling over 5GC. These rules govern the distribution of uplink traffic across non-3GPP access in EPC and 3GPP access in 5GC.

question_69837.question: What is the role of the PCF during MBS session deletion with PCC?
question_69837.ground_truth: The PCF is responsible for releasing the SM Policy Association for the MBS session. It first sends a deletion request to the MB-SMF and then de-registers at the BSF that it handles the MBS session.

question_69838.question: How is the ePDG informed about the APN associated with the UE's PDN Connection?
question_69838.ground_truth: The 3GPP AAA Server informs the HSS of the PDN GW identity and APN associated with the UE's PDN Connection, and this information is then registered in the HSS.

question_69839.question: What is the purpose of the PI bitmap in the PCH data frames?
question_69839.ground_truth: The PI bitmap in the PCH data frames contains indication values for all higher layer PI values possible. Each bit in the bitmap indicates if the paging indicator associated with that particular PI shall be set to 0 or 1.

question_69840.question: What is the purpose of intent fulfillment in Intent-driven MnS?
question_69840.ground_truth: The goal of intent fulfillment is to bring the network or service's state to satisfy the new or updated intent. This may involve deploying new intents or ensuring the assurance requirements for a network or service are met.

question_69841.question: What is the significance of the ProSe Code in the 5G ProSe restricted discovery?
question_69841.ground_truth: The ProSe Code is significant because it is used to establish security during one-to-one communication establishment between the Announcing UE and the Monitoring UE.

question_69842.question: What is the role of the Discoverer UE in steps 5-10 of the discovery process?
question_69842.ground_truth: The Discoverer UE is responsible for sending a Discovery Request message with the RPAUID to the ProSe Function in its HPLMN, receiving an authorization response from the ProSe Application Server, and sending a Discovery Request message to the ProSe Function in the HPLMN of the Discoveree UE if the request is authorized.

question_69843.question: In the "3GPP2-1X-FHRPD" access type, what is the maximum length of the "ci-3gpp2" parameter when the Carrier-ID is included?
question_69843.ground_truth: The "ci-3gpp2" parameter is 40 hexadecimal characters when the Carrier-ID is included.

question_69844.question: What action must the UE take when it receives an initial INVITE request that does not include an SDP offer?
question_69844.ground_truth: The UE can accept the request and include an SDP offer in the first reliable response. The SDP offer will reflect the called user's terminal capabilities and user preferences for the session.

question_69846.question: What is the purpose of the User ID field in the context of MCPTT communication?
question_69846.ground_truth: The User ID field contains the MCPTT ID of an MCPTT user and is used to identify the MCPTT user in MCPTT communication.

question_69847.question: What should a UE do upon receiving a network-initiated de-registration with no 5GMM cause and "re-registration not required" for 3GPP access?
question_69847.ground_truth: The UE deletes the rejected NSSAI, performs a local release of PDU sessions and enters the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED for 3GPP access.

question_69848.question: When should the ePDG send a GTPv2 Trace Session Activation message?
question_69848.ground_truth: If GTPv2 is used on S2b and the ePDG receives a Trace-Info AVP including Trace-Data in the authorization response.

question_69849.question: What is the condition to check for a successful test in the event-triggered reporting with Event 1A and Event 1F?
question_69849.ground_truth: For a successful test, the measurement reporting delay should be within the required limit for Event 1A and Event 1F.

question_69851.question: How many Iu interfaces can each RNC have towards the PS-domain and CS-domain from a separated core network architecture?
question_69851.ground_truth: Each RNC shall not have more than one Iu interface (Iu-PS) towards the PS-domain and may also have further Iu interfaces (Iu-CS) towards other CN nodes within the CS domain but not more than one Iu interface (Iu-CS) towards its default CN node.

question_69852.question: What method is called to indicate that the network has detected overload?

question_69853.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 4.7.1.2.1.2?
question_69853.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the inter-frequency SS-RSRP absolute measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for all bands.

question_69854.question: What is the main requirement of the R11 MTC Trigger Security Optional Solution?
question_69854.ground_truth: The main requirement of the R11 MTC Trigger Security Optional Solution is that the HPLMN implements Home Network Routing, which forces the delivery of the SMS to an SMS Router in the HPLMN rather than to the serving MSC/VLR, SGSN or MME of the destination UE.

question_69855.question: What information is contained in the access network discovery and selection information provided by the ANDSF?
question_69855.ground_truth: The access network discovery and selection information provided by the ANDSF contains information to assist the UE with selecting the access network, control and assist the UE with performing the inter-system change, control and assist a UE with selecting the access network to be used for routing different IP flows over different access networks, identify IP flows applicable for non-seamless WLAN offload, and control and assist a UE with selecting a prioritised APN which is associated with an existing PDN connection for routing different IP flows.

question_69856.question: Where can one find the specifications for the DRM Service and System Aspects?
question_69856.ground_truth: The specifications for the DRM Service and System Aspects can be found in OMA-RD-DRM.

question_69857.question: What should the IWF performing the controlling role do if it receives a SIP INVITE request for an MCPTT group call and a risk of congestion exists?
question_69857.ground_truth: The IWF performing the controlling role can reject the SIP INVITE request with a SIP 500 (Server Internal Error) response and include a Retry-After header field to the response.

question_69859.question: What is the total RTP payload size of each packet in the AMR12.2 speech frames with 100% redundancy and a maximum offset of 4 frames?

question_69861.question: What should the SMF do if it receives a PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message after sending a PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message with the PTI set to "No procedure transaction identity assigned" and the PDU session ID is the same?
question_69861.ground_truth: The SMF shall consider the PDU session as released if it receives a PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message after sending a PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message with the PTI set to "No procedure transaction identity assigned" and the PDU session ID is the same.

question_69862.question: What capability does Service Accessibility support that is pertinent to Priority Service?

question_69863.question: What are the two categories of haptic services based on the entity that initiates the delivery of haptic information?

question_69865.question: What information is used to enable slice-aware admission and congestion control during mobility in 5G?
question_69865.ground_truth: S-NSSAI is introduced as part of the PDU session information that is transferred during mobility signalling to enable slice-aware admission and congestion control.

question_69867.question: What is the role of the Operator Platform (OP) as defined by GSMA OPG in 3GPP TS?
question_69867.ground_truth: The Operator Platform (OP) as defined by GSMA OPG in 3GPP TS guides the industry to define a common solution for exposing network capabilities and edge compute resources to enterprise customers and developers allowing monetization of those capabilities.

question_69868.question: Where is the user plane for EPC based packet domain services defined?
question_69868.ground_truth: The user plane for EPC based packet domain services is defined in 3GPP TS 23.401, 3GPP TS 23.402, and 3GPP TS 23.060.

question_69869.question: What should the SMF do if there are no PDU sessions to transmit the multicast MBS session data in the UPF and multicast transport is used over N19mb?
question_69869.ground_truth: The SMF should leave the multicast distribution tree of MB-UPF.

question_69870.question: What is the effect of the timing advance command or timing adjustment indication on the UL transmission timing of secondary cells when they do not belong to the same TAG as the primary cell or PSCell?
question_69870.ground_truth: Upon reception of a timing advance command or timing adjustment indication for a TAG not containing the primary cell or PSCell, the UE adjusts uplink transmission timing for PUSCH/SRS of all the secondary cells in the TAG based on the received timing advance command or timing adjustment indication. If the frame structure types of the serving cells in the TAG are different, the UE assumes NTA offset = 624 for all the secondary cells in the TAG. The UL transmission timing for PUSCH/SRS is the same for all the secondary cells in the TAG.

question_69871.question: What should be the priority index of a PUSCH transmission with semi-persistent CSI report?
question_69871.ground_truth: A UE determines a priority index from a priority indicator field, if provided, in the DCI format that activates the semi-persistent CSI report.

question_69872.question: What service is RAS in the 606-614 MHz band in China and 608 - 614 MHz band in India, and what is its purpose?
question_69872.ground_truth: RAS stands for Radio Astronomy Service, which is a receive-only service that uses highly sensitive receivers to examine and study radio waves of cosmic origin.

question_69873.question: When Treselection has a non-zero value, how long should a UE wait before reselecting a UTRA FDD cell that has been satisfied with the reselection criteria?
question_69873.ground_truth: The UE shall wait for Treselection time, and if the cell remains satisfied with the reselection criteria within this duration, then the UE shall reselect that cell.

question_69875.question: How much ACLR tightening is required for ISD=0.75 km for PC Set 4A and 4B?
question_69875.ground_truth: For ISD=0.75 km, it requires around 1dB of ACLR tightening for Set 4A and around 2 dB of ACLR tightening for Set 4B.

question_69876.question: What should the PCRF do if there is traffic mapping information not matching any service data flow filter known to it, and the UE is allowed to request for enhanced QoS for traffic not belonging to operator-controlled services?
question_69876.ground_truth: The PCRF should authorize this traffic mapping information by adding the respective service data flow filter to a new or existing PCC.

question_69880.question: In the context of the document, what is the definition of the term "Throughput"?
question_69880.ground_truth: Throughput is a parameter describing service speed, it is the number of data bits successfully transferred in one direction between specified reference points per unit time.

question_69882.question: What should the PSS adapter do upon receipt of a RTSP TEARDOWN message in PSS streaming session teardown?
question_69882.ground_truth: The PSS adapter sends a SIP BYE message to the SCF and closes the RTSP session to the PSS Server after receiving the SIP BYE message from the UE.

question_69884.question: What is the content of the DSM message that needs to be partially ciphered due to the implementation of the rekeying procedure?
question_69884.ground_truth: The new L2 IDs and the new Kd session ID that are added to the DSM Command message.

question_69885.question: What is the effect of the Upper Layer Abort on the CM-sublayer in the network and the SMC entity in the mobile station?
question_69885.ground_truth: In both cases, an MM-connection release request, without indication of release cause, is passed to the MM-sublayer, and the SMC entity enters the Idle state. In the network, the CM-sublayer may form and send the CP-ERROR message to release the connection.

question_69887.question: What should the UE do if the reportType is set to eventTriggered and if the entry condition for this event is fulfilled for one or more applicable cells for all measurements in 8.1.3.1.5.2?
question_69887.ground_truth: The UE should include a measurement reporting entry within the VarMeasReportList for this measId, set the numberOfReportsSent to 0, include the concerned cell(s) in the cellsTriggeredList, and initiate the measurement reporting procedure.

question_69888.question: Which existing TS 3GPP standards in earlier releases address some concepts for IoT devices, while not specifically addressing extremely small and lightweight Ambient IoT devices?
question_69888.ground_truth: TS 22.011, TS 22.278, TS 22.368, and TS 22.261 introduce access control for MTC with features like network selection and device triggering. However, they do not specifically address the challenges of extremely small and lightweight Ambient IoT devices.

question_69890.question: What is the distance between the AAS BS and the CLTA in the test procedure?
question_69890.ground_truth: The distance between the AAS BS and the CLTA in the test procedure is 0.1 meters.

question_69892.question: What is the meaning of bit 0 in the bit mask specified for the ULR-Flags AVP in the S6a/S6d interface protocol?
question_69892.ground_truth: Bit 0 in the ULR-Flags AVP indicates the 2G-Only bit. If set to 1, the flag indicates that the mobile station is operating in 2G mode only. If set to 0, the flag indicates that the mobile station is capable of operating in other than 2G mode.

question_69893.question: When will the synchronization of supplementary services settings fail?
question_69893.ground_truth: The synchronization will fail when a user inserts a SIP URI as a diverted-to-party address in the IMS domain, which has no Tel URI associated with it, as there will be no valid setting for the CS domain for this particular parameter.

question_69895.question: What is the objective of Step 5 in the coexistence analysis methodology?
question_69895.ground_truth: The objective of Step 5 in the coexistence analysis methodology is to identify the necessity of introducing new NB-IoT RF requirements to ensure proper coexistence with CDMA systems.

question_69896.question: What is the change in the lower tolerance limit for the maximum output power requirement when it is relaxed?
question_69896.ground_truth: The lower tolerance limit is reduced by 1.5 dB when the maximum output power requirement is relaxed.

question_69898.question: What action shall a UE not take if it cannot demodulate the BSIC of a GSM BCCH carrier?
question_69898.ground_truth: It shall not consider the GSM BCCH carrier in cell reselection.

question_69902.question: What is the purpose of setting the imminent peril indicator in step 2 when upgrading to an imminent peril group SDS communication?
question_69902.ground_truth: The imminent peril indicator is set to correspond to an imminent peril priority for bearer adjustments.

question_69903.question: What is a motivation and driver for the development of an AIPN?
question_69903.ground_truth: A motivation and driver for the development of an AIPN is that the technical and commercial evolution of the mobile communications industry points towards an AIPN, which provides the ability to offer enhanced and flexible mobile services, quickly and cost-effectively.

question_69905.question: What is the purpose of the "related-icid" header field parameter in the 200 (OK) response?
question_69905.ground_truth: The "related-icid" header field parameter in the 200 (OK) response contains the "icid-value" header fields parameter used in the original call and can be used for charging correlation of generated CDR records in the visited network A (i.e. "visited-a").

question_69906.question: What is the intended use of the network deployment described in Scenario One - S6a/S6d Pre Rel8 Gr interworking scenario with one IWF?
question_69906.ground_truth: The intended use of the network deployment described in Scenario One is to allow users of a Pre Rel8 UMTS/GPRS network to access a visited EPS with only E-UTRAN. The Pre Rel8 HLR will be upgraded to support Rel-8 EPS security and Pre Rel8 Gr will be upgraded to support transfer of Rel-8 security parameters.

question_69911.question: What is the format of the "PDU-Session-Resource-To-Setup-List" in the "NG-RAN-BearerContextSetupRequest"?
question_69911.ground_truth: The "PDU-Session-Resource-To-Setup-List" in the "NG-RAN-BearerContextSetupRequest" is a sequence of "SEQUENCE OF PDU-SESSION-RESOURCE-SETUP-ITEM". Each "PDU-SESSION-RESOURCE-SETUP-ITEM" contains an "E1AP-IE-ID" and "criticality", "TYPE", and "PRESENCE INDICATION" of "PDU-SESSION-RESOURCE-PERMISSIONS-SETUP-ITEM".

question_69913.question: What is a potential motivation for an attacker to use mode of operation a) without the involvement of the target operator?
question_69913.ground_truth: The attacker may want to eavesdrop on unencrypted radio traffic between the victim's UE and the false base station.

question_69914.question: What does the SymbolMod function do with the given input arguments?
question_69914.ground_truth: The SymbolMod function generates a modulated output sequence (mPulse) based on the modulator struct (ms) and a symbol index (symbol).

question_69915.question: What is the responsibility of the 5GMS Media Session Handler in 5G system?
question_69915.ground_truth: The 5GMS Media Session Handler in 5G system is responsible for Consumption Reporting, Metrics Reporting, and Dynamic Policies.

question_69917.question: What should the NAF do if the received message has an invalid Bootstrapping Transaction Identifier (B-TID)?
question_69917.ground_truth: In this case, the NAF should request the UE to bootstrap again.

question_69918.question: What should the S-CSCF do with the "term-ioi" header field parameter received in the P-Charging-Vector header field?
question_69918.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should store the value of the received "term-ioi" header field parameter if present, include a type 1 or type 3 "term-ioi" header field parameter in the forwarded response, and remove all received "orig-ioi", "term-ioi" and "transit-ioi" header field parameters from the forwarded response.

question_69919.question: What is the role of the AKRS in the established key use procedure?
question_69919.ground_truth: In the established key use procedure, the AKRS retrieves the appropriate key from storage and calculates the AKMA Key, which is then used for the AKMA service.

question_69920.question: What is the test description for section 6.5A.3.1.4 and 6.5A.3.1.5 of the document?
question_69920.ground_truth: The test description is the same as in clause 6.5A.3.1.1.4 for each of the sections mentioned.

question_69921.question: What measurement provides the number of attempted outgoing handovers when DRX is used?

question_69922.question: What message does the Serving GW send to the MME after step A.1 to proceed with the deactivation of bearers?

question_69923.question: What is the purpose of the Sx management procedures?
question_69923.ground_truth: The Sx management procedures are used by the CP function to manage the UP function independent of any Sx session, allowing tasks such as provisioning, modifying, or terminating PFD sets belonging to an Application ID.

question_69925.question: What is the role of the Overload-Sequence-Number in GTP-C overload control?
question_69925.ground_truth: The Overload-Sequence-Number is a mandatory parameter that aids in sequencing the overload information and differentiating two Overload Control Information IEs generated at two different instants by the same GTP-C entity for the same overload scope.

question_69926.question: What is the current limitation of IMS network regarding Group Communication in terms of end-to-end setup time?
question_69926.ground_truth: The current limitation of IMS network regarding Group Communication is that the end-to-end setup time is more than 300ms, while the requirement for critical group communication like MCPTT is for it to be less than or equal to 300ms.

question_69927.question: How does the UE determine the set of physical resource blocks to be used for PUSCH transmission with type 1 hopping?
question_69927.ground_truth: The set of physical resource blocks to be used for PUSCH transmission with type 1 hopping is contiguously allocated resource blocks from the lowest index PRB index obtained from the uplink scheduling grant.

question_69929.question: What is the role of the discovery procedure in Solution #3?
question_69929.ground_truth: The discovery procedure is used by the 5G ProSe Source UE to find the UE-to-UE relay and determine if network-based Relay service authentication and authorization is supported.

question_69930.question: What measure does the UE take in the described IMS solution with dedicated RLOS-APN to minimize the risk of IP address spoofing?
question_69930.ground_truth: In the described IMS solution with dedicated RLOS-APN, the UE verifies that the IP address is within the range of IP addresses reserved for RLOS and that the PDN connection has been established for the RLOS APN to minimize the risk of IP address spoofing.

question_69932.question: What action should the UE take upon receiving an EAP-failure message?
question_69932.ground_truth: The UE should delete any partial native 5G NAS security context and the new K~AUSF and K~SEAF, if any.

question_69933.question: What is the difference between alternative 1 and alternative 2 for Channel Access Control list Provision Procedure in the 5G registration procedure?
question_69933.ground_truth: In alternative 1, the Channel Access Control list is sent to UDM, while in alternative 2, it is sent to PCF.

question_69934.question: What should the 5G DDNMF do if the ProSe application ID is country-specific and known, but the PLMN ID indicated in the ProSe application ID is not the same as that of the 5G DDNMF?
question_69934.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF should check with the UDM whether the UE is authorized for open 5G ProSe direct discovery monitoring, obtain the corresponding discovery filter, associate the discovery filter with the new discovery entry in the UE context, and start timer T5065 assigned for each discovery filter.

question_69935.question: In what order will the WLAN UE search for a WSID to connect to if none of the listed data files are available in the USIM and the ME supports at least one of the optional lists in the ME memory?
question_69935.ground_truth: The WLAN UE will search for a WSID in the following order: WSIDs supporting 3GPP-WLAN interworking in implementation-specific order, then each WSID in the "User Controlled WLAN Specific Identifier list" data file in the ME, and finally each WSID in the "Operator Controlled WLAN Specific Identifier list" data file in the ME.

question_69936.question: What is the data type for the "ProfileName" element in the XML schema?

question_69937.question: Does 3GPP need to standardize EGMF, and if so, what detailed information should be provided?
question_69937.ground_truth: Yes, 3GPP should standardize EGMF, including details on EGMF internals. 3GPP should also decide whether the EGMF is positioned on the Network Management Layer (NML), the Service Management Layer (SML), or the BSS layer.

question_69938.question: What is the method used for quantizing the bass post-filter gain in speech coding?
question_69938.ground_truth: At 16.4 and 24.4 kbps, the bass post-filter gain is quantized on 2 bits by first reconstructing the signal as defined in subclause 6.1.3. The bass post-filter is then applied and the enhancement signal is computed. The residual signal is low pass filtered in time domain by a convolution with the impulse response. The optimal gain adjustment is computed and quantized on 2 bits. The quantization is adjusted in case the delta SNR provided by the estimated gain is detected as positive.

question_69939.question: What is the definition of TAE in the context of 3GPP TS 37.105?
question_69939.ground_truth: TAE stands for Time Alignment Error, which is the timing difference between the transmission of multiple antennas or carriers in a base station.

question_69941.question: What must an MS (Mobile Station) in eCall only mode do if it cannot select any PLMN (Public Land Mobile Network) to register to?
question_69941.ground_truth: The MS will indicate "no service" to the user, wait until a new PLMN is available and allowable, and then repeat the procedure.

question_69942.question: What is the recommendation for controlling whether untrusted or lower trusted VNFs are allowed to run on the same host as VNFs in a higher trust domain?
question_69942.ground_truth: It should be possible to control this, potentially requiring solutions both inside and outside 3GPP.

question_69943.question: When should the "Required" header field be used in RTSP requests?
question_69943.ground_truth: The "Required" header field is used to ensure that a certain feature is supported by the PSS server, causing the request to fail with a 551 reply code and "Option not supported" as the reason if the feature is not supported.

question_69945.question: What should a remote UE do every discovery period for selecting or reselecting a ProSe relay UE?
question_69945.ground_truth: A remote UE should search for candidate relay UEs for selection and/or reselection every discovery period.

question_69946.question: What is the role of the 64-ary orthogonal modulation used in mapping information bits onto the E-RUCCH?
question_69946.ground_truth: The 64-ary orthogonal modulation is used to modulate the data onto the E-RUCCH, which allows for more efficient use of the radio frequency spectrum and higher data rates.

question_69947.question: What is the purpose of the Mp1 reference point in ETSI ISG MEC?
question_69947.ground_truth: The Mp1 reference point in ETSI ISG MEC is used to provide service registration, service discovery, and communication support for MEC services between the MEC platform and MEC applications.

question_69952.question: What is the purpose of the hybrid AAS BS requirements in the document?
question_69952.ground_truth: The hybrid AAS BS requirements are specified for E-UTRA AAS Base Station (BS), the FDD mode of UTRA AAS Base Station (BS), the 1,28 Mcps TDD mode of UTRA AAS Base Station (BS) in single RAT and any MSR AAS Base Station (BS) implementation of these RATs including NR operation.

question_69953.question: Which message is sent by the GANC to the Core Network to indicate that the mobile station has responded with a GAN-RR PAGING RESPONSE?

question_69955.question: What is the requirement for the overall delays measured in the E-UTRAN TDD - UTRAN TDD event triggered reporting test?
question_69955.ground_truth: The overall delays measured should be less than a total of 6402 ms in this test case (which gives a total of 6400 ms for measurement reporting delay plus 2 ms for TTI insertion uncertainty).

question_69956.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group GSM/EDGE Radio Access Network (GERAN) in relation to Machine-Type Communications (MTC)?
question_69956.ground_truth: The purpose of the GERAN in relation to MTC is to study improvements for Machine-type Communications in GERAN, which includes enhancements for smart metering, efficient use of RAN resources, overload and congestion control on the radio, A and Gb interface, and identifiers used for MTC devices in the radio access network.

question_69957.question: What is the function of the "SupportedPLMNs-List" in the "GNB-CU-UP-E1SetupRequest" message?
question_69957.ground_truth: The "SupportedPLMNs-List" in the "GNB-CU-UP-E1SetupRequest" message is used to indicate the supported PLMNs (Public Land Mobile Networks) for the UE.

question_69958.question: What is the procedure for an AF to retrieve the PCF address for Rx session establishment through a BSF (redirect)?
question_69958.ground_truth: The AF contacts the BSF (redirect) on Rx session establishment to retrieve the PCF address, but the BSF does not maintain Diameter sessions and the Diameter Base redirect procedures are applicable.

question_69960.question: What should the MCPTT client do with the SIP INFO request where the Request-URI contains an MCPTT session ID identifying an ongoing group session?
question_69960.ground_truth: The MCPTT client shall follow the actions specified in subclause~6.2.8.1.13 upon receiving a SIP INFO request where the Request-URI contains an MCPTT session ID identifying an ongoing group session.

question_69961.question: What is the purpose of studying transport security for the MSGin5G interfaces in the 3GPP document?
question_69961.ground_truth: The purpose of studying transport security for the MSGin5G interfaces in the 3GPP document is to ensure confidentiality, integrity, and replay protection for the new interfaces introduced in the MSGin5G service.

question_69962.question: What does the SMF include in the PCC rules when it sends a notification to the NEF in case of 4A?
question_69962.ground_truth: The SMF includes the Notification URI pointing to the NEF and the Notification Correlation ID assigned by the NEF in the PCC rules.

question_69963.question: What is the role of "Edge Enabler Server" in the Edge Computing architecture?
question_69963.ground_truth: The Edge Enabler Server provides services for the Edge Application Servers and Edge Enabler Clients in the Edge Hosting Environment.

question_69964.question: What is the purpose of repetition coding in the field coding of ACK/NACK for HS-SICH type 2?
question_69964.ground_truth: The purpose of repetition coding in the field coding of ACK/NACK for HS-SICH type 2 is to increase the reliability of the ACK/NACK information by repeating the coded bits 36 times for each stream.

question_69965.question: What action should the NRM server take if it is unable to modify the targeted "Individual MBS Resource" resource?
question_69965.ground_truth: The NRM server should take proper error handling actions, as specified in clause~7.4.1.5, and respond to the VAL server with an appropriate error status code.

question_69966.question: What should the NG-RAN node do if the Partially Allowed NSSAI IE is contained in the UE INFORMATION TRANSFER message and the total number of S-NSSAIs included in the Allowed NSSAI and Partially Allowed NSSAI exceeds eight?
question_69966.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node should consider the procedure as failed.

question_69967.question: What is the purpose of the "Schedule Messages" in SMSCB DRX?
question_69967.ground_truth: The Schedule Messages provide information about the CB messages that will be sent immediately afterwards, allowing the MS to restrict reception to those messages the customer is interested in receiving.

question_69968.question: When should the HA create a child security association to protect the traffic send via the DSMIPv6 tunnel?
question_69968.ground_truth: The HA may optionally trigger the creation of a child security association to protect the traffic send via the DSMIPv6 tunnel after establishing the IPsec security association with the UE.

question_69969.question: What is the state of the MS, upon receiving a PROGRESS message indicating availability of in-band information, when in the mobile originated circuit switched basic service?

question_69970.question: What should a UE in CS/PS mode 2 of operation or a UE operating in CS/PS mode 1 of operation with "IMS voice available" do when the CS domain is not available?
question_69970.ground_truth: They may provide a notification to the user or the upper layers that the CS domain is not available.

question_69971.question: What is the impact of session-unrelated procedures in IMS Network Element?
question_69971.ground_truth: Session-unrelated procedures in IMS Network Element requires a Credit-Control session for service units, separate from the SIP session, which is controlled by the IMS-GWF/AS and S-CSCF.

question_69972.question: What is the minimum number of UTRA carriers that a UE indicating support for increased UE carrier monitoring UTRA must be capable of monitoring?
question_69972.ground_truth: Depending on UE capability, a minimum of 6 FDD UTRA carriers and 7 TDD UTRA carriers.

question_69974.question: What parameter is used in the adaptive lag window to control the strength of the window?
question_69974.ground_truth: The pitch gain is used in the adaptive lag window to control the strength of the window. A larger pitch gain corresponds to a stronger (heavy smoothing with larger) window, while a smaller pitch gain corresponds to a weaker window (light smoothing with smaller).

question_69977.question: What are the benefits of calculating the final MOS value in the QoE server rather than in the client?
question_69977.ground_truth: Calculating the final MOS value in the QoE server allows for the use of advanced network optimization, flexible MOS windowing, and avoids issues when the MOS model calculation needs to be updated. It also ensures standardized interpretation of DASH QoE metrics and enables evaluation of network delivery performance based on the result A/V MOS for streaming content with different encoding schemes and network bandwidth.

question_69978.question: What are the frequency ranges for measuring the received power in steps a) and b) of the BSS test in 8-3?
question_69978.ground_truth: The frequency range for measuring the received power in step a) of the BSS test in 8-3 is 30 MHz to 12,75 GHz, excluding the BTS relevant transmitter band. The frequency range for measuring the received power in step b) of the BSS test in 8-3 is the same as step a) but including the BTS relevant transmitter band.

question_69979.question: What is the purpose of UPF collecting and reporting real-time jitter to SMF?
question_69979.ground_truth: The data is used to update the local jitter average and sent to the RAN if the difference between the estimated local jitter average and the last local jitter range provided to the RAN is greater than a given threshold.

question_69980.question: What is the responsibility of the PDG in the tunnel establishment process?
question_69980.ground_truth: The PDG provides the WLAN UE with an IPv6 Prefix belonging to the Intranet/ISP addressing space, which is used for packet forwarding within the packet domain and for packet forwarding on the Intranet/ISP. The PDG may also request user authentication from a server belonging to the Intranet/ISP.

question_69981.question: What is the difference between the gross bit rate and average bit rate of encoded bit stream in the VSELP coding?
question_69981.ground_truth: The gross bit rate of encoded bit stream in the VSELP coding is 228 bits, leading to a gross bit rate of 11,4 kbit/s, whereas the average bit rate for the encoded bit stream is 5,6 kbit/s.

question_69982.question: What is the role of the token in the decryption stage of the receiving UE-x?
question_69982.ground_truth: The token is used to verify the token in the decryption stage of the receiving UE-x. If the verification is successful, UE-x decrypts the broadcast message using the SLPBK.

question_69983.question: What does the 9.2.1FD.3 test aim to verify for a UE with HS-DSCH category 31?
question_69983.ground_truth: The 9.2.1FD.3 test verifies the ability of the receiver to receive a predefined test signal, representing a multi-path fading channel with information bit throughput R not falling below a specified value. The test stresses the multicode reception and channel decoding with incremental redundancy.

question_69988.question: Which solution proposes to enhance SEAL to support device monitoring for FFAPP?

question_69989.question: What information is used to identify the bearer in PDG for charging?
question_69989.ground_truth: A unique identifier generated by the PDG (PDG Charging Id) is used to determine the bearer in PDG for charging.

question_69990.question: What is the data type of the "allow-functional-alias-binding-with-group" element in the 3GPP specification?
question_69990.ground_truth: The "allow-functional-alias-binding-with-group" element is a Boolean data type in the 3GPP specification.

question_69991.question: What is the role of the WUDB database in the architecture described?
question_69991.ground_truth: The WUDB database stores the relationship between an individual IMPU and the S-CSCF serving that IMPU.

question_69992.question: What is the minimum required throughput for a given SNR in NPUSCH format 1 performance requirement?
question_69992.ground_truth: The required throughput is expressed as a fraction of maximum throughput for the FRCs listed in Annex A.

question_69995.question: What signalling is used in the SRVCC Preparation procedure?
question_69995.ground_truth: The SRVCC Preparation procedure uses connection oriented signalling.

question_69996.question: What is one of the design principles for the new RAT's Multimedia Broadcast/Multicast Service?
question_69996.ground_truth: The new RAT should support static and dynamic resource allocation between Multicast/Broadcast and unicast.

question_69999.question: What is the unique identifier of the MBMS service used by the UE to select the target application?
question_69999.ground_truth: The serviceId element in the download header fragment

question_70001.question: What is the HTTP status code that the MnS producer sends to the MnS consumer in case of success when acknowledging multiple alarms?
question_70001.ground_truth: The MnS producer sends a HTTP status code of "200 OK" to the MnS consumer in case of success when acknowledging multiple alarms.

question_70002.question: What is the purpose of the Activate TV Service Resources Procedure?
question_70002.ground_truth: The Activate TV Service Resources Procedure is used by the Content Provider AS to cause allocation of resources for an MBMS bearer in case of broadcast only, or for the BM-SC to initiate allocation for broadcast+unicast service.

question_70004.question: What are the conditions for a UE to consider a cell as known?
question_70004.ground_truth: A UE considers a cell as known if it has sent a valid L3-RSRP measurement report with SSB index for the target cell during the last 5 seconds, and certain conditions related to the detectability of the SSB and PDSCH are met during MIB and SIB1 decoding.

question_70007.question: What is the maximum test time for MS in the DCS1800 and PCS1900 frequency ranges for the reference sensitivity test?
question_70007.ground_truth: The maximum test time for MS in the DCS1800 and PCS1900 frequency ranges for the reference sensitivity test is 17 minutes.

question_70008.question: How are the MDCT coefficients divided for the computation of the frequency sharpness in this process?
question_70008.ground_truth: The 288 MDCT coefficients in the 6400-13600 Hz frequency range are split into nine sharpness bands, with 32 coefficients per band.

question_70009.question: What are the expected eV2X scenarios supported by the 3GPP system?
question_70009.ground_truth: The 3GPP system is expected to support various enhanced V2X scenarios, such as Vehicles Platooning, Advanced Driving, Extended Sensors, and Remote Driving.

question_70010.question: What is the purpose of the document "3rd Generation Partnership Project; Technical Specification Group Radio Access Networks; NR intra band Carrier Aggregation (CA) Rel-16 for xCC Down Link (DL) / yCC Up Link (UL) including contiguous and non-contiguous spectrum (x >= y)"?
question_70010.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to gather the relevant background information and studies in order to address NR Intra-band Carrier Aggregation requirements for specific band combinations under the Rel-16 time frame.

question_70011.question: How does the UE handle the timers T3584 and T3585 when the 5GSM congestion re-attempt indicator IE with the ABO bit set to "The back-off timer is applied in all PLMNs or all equivalent SNPNs" is included in the 5GSM message with the 5GSM cause value #69 or #67?
question_70011.ground_truth: The UE applies the timers T3584 and T3585 for all the PLMNs or all the equivalent SNPNs when the 5GSM congestion re-attempt indicator IE with the ABO bit set to "The back-off timer is applied in all PLMNs or all equivalent SNPNs" is included in the 5GSM message with the 5GSM cause value #67 or #69. Otherwise, the UE applies the timers T3584 and T3585 for the registered PLMN or the registered SNPN.

question_70012.question: What is the role of the hysteresis parameter (Hys) in the A5-1 and A5-2 inequalities?
question_70012.ground_truth: The hysteresis parameter (Hys) is used to determine the cell triggering conditions for A5-1 and A5-2 by comparing the measurement results (Mp, Mn) with the hysteresis parameter and threshold parameters (Thresh1, Thresh2).

question_70013.question: What does the SIP cause code "0" indicate in a successful session termination?
question_70013.ground_truth: The cause "Normal end of session" indicates that an ongoing SIP session has been normally released either by the user or by the network.

question_70014.question: What is the function of the "Last RFCI Indicator" field in the error handling procedure?
question_70014.ground_truth: The "Last RFCI Indicator" field is used to indicate which is the last RFCI in the current INITIALISATION control frame, allowing for the detection of a spare extension field.

question_70015.question: What should the UE do when it receives a NSSAI DELETE REQUEST message with Delete NSSAI type equal to 10, access type equal to 01 and octets 3, 4, and 5 not set to "00000000"?
question_70015.ground_truth: The UE should delete allowed NSSAI associated with non-3GPP access for the PLMN indicated by octets 3, 4, and 5 stored at the UE if any.

question_70017.question: What should the floor control interface do upon receiving a Floor Request message from the associated floor participant?
question_70017.ground_truth: The floor control interface shall forward the Floor Request message to the floor control server arbitration logic in the MCPTT server and instruct the media distributor to act accordingly.

question_70018.question: What should the UE do if it receives a Network Slice-Specific Authentication Command message while in the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED state?
question_70018.ground_truth: If the UE receives a Network Slice-Specific Authentication Command message while in the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED state, it should ignore the message and proceed with the de-registration procedure.

question_70019.question: What message does the new 3G-SGSN send to the old 2G-SGSN to get the MM and PDP contexts for the MS?

question_70020.question: What should the UE do before changing the synchronization reference from GNSS to another source?
question_70020.ground_truth: The UE should evaluate the GNSS synchronization source reliability for at least 20 seconds before changing the synchronization reference from GNSS to another synchronization reference source.

question_70022.question: What action does the Serving GW take when it receives a DL packet for a non-accepted bearer?
question_70022.ground_truth: The Serving GW drops the DL packet and does not send a Downlink Data Notification to the MME.

question_70023.question: What is the effect of timer F firing while the session is in the "progressing" or "alerting" state?
question_70023.ground_truth: Session establishment has failed and the SCC AS or UE clears the session.

question_70026.question: What should the P-CSCF do if IMSI is derived from the public user identity conveyed in To header and it is different from the IMSI received from PCRF?
question_70026.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall reject the REGISTER request by returning a 403 (Forbidden) response and shall not perform the rest of the steps.

question_70028.question: What is the role of the LSA1 interface in the interaction between the LC and the NM?
question_70028.ground_truth: The LSA1 interface acts on the LSA Spectrum Resource level, allowing the LC and NM to exchange information about the availability and use of shared spectrum resources.

question_70029.question: How does the SCEF determine the broadcast area if no location information is provided in the Update Session procedure?
question_70029.ground_truth: The SCEF uses either a list of MBMS Service Area Identities, or a list of cell IDs, or both as the MBMS broadcast area in such cases.

question_70030.question: What response is sent by UE-2 to acknowledge the SIP re-INVITE request in step ~9?

question_70031.question: What action does the MS take after accepting a call and sending the CONNECT message?
question_70031.ground_truth: After acceptance of the call, the MS sends a CONNECT message, followed by sending the HANDOVER COMMAND if it receives one allocating a TCH in another band.

question_70035.question: What is the significance of Step 5 in the 5GMSu uplink streaming process?
question_70035.ground_truth: Step 5 connects the 5GMSu Client with the 5GMSu AF for the uplink streaming session. It involves the 5GMSu Client requesting Service Access Information if not provided earlier.

question_70036.question: What should the "a=imageseq" attribute convey in an MTSI client that supports still images?
question_70036.ground_truth: The "a=imageseq" attribute in an MTSI client that supports still images conveys the number of images in the corresponding image collection or image sequence in the SDP media description. It applies to the payload type number of the corresponding video media session, and should be included in the SDP answer if received in the SDP offer.

question_70037.question: What is the difference between S5-AV1-01 and S5-AV1-02 in terms of frame encoding?
question_70037.ground_truth: S5-AV1-01 encodes frames with no fixed random access, while S5-AV1-02 encodes frames with fixed random access every second.

question_70038.question: What is the type of the "PrivateCallKMSURI" element in the PrivateCallKMSURIEntryType complex type?

question_70039.question: What is the F1 interface is defined as in the context of 3GPP TS 38.47x?
question_70039.ground_truth: The F1 interface is defined as the interface between a gNB-CU and a gNB-DU of a gNB within an NG-RAN, or between a gNB-CU and a gNB-DU of an en-gNB within an E-UTRAN.

question_70040.question: What is the definition of "transient phenomena" as per IEC 60050-161?
question_70040.ground_truth: Transient phenomena pertains to or designates a phenomenon or a quantity that varies between two consecutive steady states during a time interval short compared with the time-scale of interest.

question_70041.question: What should the MS do upon receiving an IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message in the E-GSM band?
question_70041.ground_truth: The MS should initiate a local end release of link layer connections, disconnect the physical channels, command the switching to the assigned channels, and initiate the establishment of lower layer connections, including activating the channels, connecting them, and establishing main signaling links.

question_70042.question: What is the role of the RADIUS Disconnect-Request in the DN-AAA initiated QoS flow termination procedure?
question_70042.ground_truth: The RADIUS Disconnect-Request is used by the DN-AAA server to release the corresponding resources and terminate the QoS flow with the SMF.

question_70043.question: What is the issue being studied in Key Issue 2, as per the document?
question_70043.ground_truth: The issue is providing priority to emergency services especially in case of congestion, allowing fulfilment of requirements expressed in 3GPP specifications about preferential treatment of emergency services in case of Diameter or GTP-c congestion, with no changes foreseen to GTP-c / Diameter protocols.

question_70044.question: Which sources achieved sub-meter level horizontal positioning accuracy in the InF-SH scenario (Scenario 1) without synchronization and gNB/UE TX/RX timing errors?
question_70044.ground_truth: The horizontal positioning accuracy of sub-meter level @ 90% was achieved by Rel.16 solutions from 13 sources in FR1 and 9 sources in FR2 for the InF-SH scenario.

question_70045.question: What is the transport protocol used by the IMS-ALG when forwarding the reserved AGW connection point in step 6?

question_70046.question: What is the scaling factor for NR PRS-based measurement in the positioning frequency layer i when the UE is not requested to measure a PRS resource with multiple Rx TEGs?

question_70047.question: How does the SL Positioning Client UE transmit the service request when it is not in proximity of UE1/UE2?
question_70047.ground_truth: The SL Positioning Client UE transmits the service request over the 5GS network to UE1/UE2, which assumes that both the SL Positioning Client UE and UE1/UE2 are in 5G coverage.

question_70048.question: How does the number of models required for Approach 2 differ between fixed and dynamic active TRPs?
question_70048.ground_truth: In Approach 2, if the set of active TRPs is fixed, then one model is sufficient to cover the entire evaluation area. However, if the set of active TRPs can change dynamically, then one model is developed to handle various patterns of active TRPs.

question_70049.question: What is the purpose of the relay service code parameter in UE-to-network relay discovery?
question_70049.ground_truth: The relay service code parameter identifies the connectivity service to be announced by the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE.

question_70050.question: What is the difference between radio communications equipment and radio equipment?
question_70050.ground_truth: Radio communications equipment includes one or more transmitters and/or receivers and/or parts thereof, while radio equipment consists of a radio digital unit and a radio unit.

question_70051.question: What is the purpose of combining soft clipping with hard clipping in reducing computational complexity?
question_70051.ground_truth: The purpose is to enhance clipping efficiency while maintaining performance, with the soft clipping targeting only the highest signal peaks and the hard clipping applied on the remaining peaks.

question_70052.question: What are the operation aspects considered for NR V2X sidelink operation in this NR V2X Work Item?
question_70052.ground_truth: The operation aspects considered are: (1) operation bands used for evaluation, (2) gNB deployment (with and without network control), and (3) concurrent operation.

question_70053.question: What action should an AS take if it receives a request or response from a served user containing a Resource-Share field with the value "no-media-sharing"?
question_70053.ground_truth: The AS should no longer apply resource sharing with sessions involving the UE sending the request or response.

question_70054.question: What must the UCMF do if the received HTTP DELETE request can't be successfully fulfilled?
question_70054.ground_truth: The UCMF shall send an HTTP error response if the received HTTP DELETE request can't be successfully fulfilled due to an internal error or the error in the HTTP DELETE request.

question_70055.question: What action should the IWF perform upon receiving a SIP re-INVITE request with an imminent peril indication and the in-progress emergency state of the group already set to "true"?
question_70055.ground_truth: The IWF should generate a SIP MESSAGE request notification of the MCPTT user's imminent peril indication and send it to the other affiliated members of the group.

question_70056.question: What entity initiates QoS Monitoring when it receives the QoS Monitoring policy of the QoS Flow?

question_70057.question: Which abbreviations are commonly used in the performance measurements of UTRAN?
question_70057.ground_truth: Multiple abbreviations are used, such as AOA, ASN.1, BER, BLER, CN, CS, DT, etc. Each of these abbreviations refers to specific parameters or components within UTRAN measurement, allowing for precise communication when discussing the various performance measurement components.

question_70058.question: What is the role of the network in RLC unacknowledged mode uplink?
question_70058.ground_truth: In RLC unacknowledged mode uplink, the network is responsible for sending acknowledgements when needed.

question_70059.question: What does the phrase "shall indicate" imply in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
question_70059.ground_truth: The phrase "shall indicate" in 3GPP technical specifications implies a mandatory requirement to do something.

question_70061.question: What should the MS do if it has a FQDN of the Provisioning SEGW and receives the Discovery Request message within the TU3901 timer?
question_70061.ground_truth: The MS should perform a public DNS query to retrieve the IP-address of the Provisioning SEGW and establish the secure connection towards the Provisioning SEGW.

question_70062.question: What is the purpose of the P-CSCF restoration procedure in 5G access?
question_70062.ground_truth: The P-CSCF restoration procedure in 5G access is used to restore the P-CSCF when it fails, and to ensure proper delivery of SIP messages.

question_70063.question: Based on the discussed document, what capabilities is the VAE server expected to provide?
question_70063.ground_truth: The VAE server is expected to provide V2X application layer support functions to V2X applications, such as network resource management, QoS adaptation, monitoring, and other related capabilities.

question_70064.question: What is the purpose of the E1 Application Protocol (E1AP), as specified in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project Technical Specification?
question_70064.ground_truth: The E1AP supports the functions of the E1 interface by signalling procedures, which provides means for interconnecting various components within an NG-RAN, E-UTRAN, or ng-eNB within an NG-RAN or E-UTRAN.

question_70065.question: What is the role of the CS Proxy in the network when determining which VCC Application is supporting the UE?
question_70065.ground_truth: The CS Proxy uses the IMSI to do a lookup in the HSS to determine which VCC Application is supporting the UE.

question_70066.question: What is the percentage increase in mean capacity performance when bandwidth is increased from 100MHz to 400MHz for FR2, Dense Urban, DL, AR/VR (45 Mbps, 10ms PDB, 60FPS), DDDUU TDD format based on Source 16?
question_70066.ground_truth: The mean capacity performance is increased by about 560%.

question_70067.question: What is the definition of closed loop power control in the Uplink?
question_70067.ground_truth: Closed loop power control in the Uplink is the ability of the UE transmitter to adjust its output power in accordance with one or more TPC commands received in the downlink.

question_70068.question: Which scenarios are considered in the WLAN/3GPP radio interworking study?
question_70068.ground_truth: The study assumes no distinction between indoor and outdoor scenarios, does not rely on standardized interfaces between 3GPP and WLAN RAN nodes, and does not consider residential WLAN AP deployment. The scenarios focus on WLAN nodes deployed and controlled by operators and their partners, the conditions for traffic steering, and the use cases for different UE and access conditions.

question_70069.question: What does the term "absolute position" refer to in the context of the document?
question_70069.ground_truth: Absolute position is an estimate of the UE (User Equipment) position in 2D/3D geographic coordinates (e.g., latitude, longitude, elevation) within a coordinate system.

question_70070.question: What includes information about an Edge Application Server (EAS) used to describe services and service characteristics offered?

question_70072.question: What is the purpose of Performance Management in the context of 3G systems?
question_70072.ground_truth: The purpose of Performance Management in the context of 3G systems is to collect performance related data, which can be used to locate potential problems in the network.

question_70073.question: What is the main purpose of the 3GPP system in the high accuracy ePositioning service?
question_70073.ground_truth: The main purpose of the 3GPP system in the high accuracy ePositioning service is to determine the position of fast-moving cars and robots in a short time to avoid collisions with their surroundings. The required accuracy for the car's position must be 1 meter, and for the robot 10 cm, the two-way delay for positioning is 10-15 ms.

question_70074.question: What are two primary factors MUROS techniques should consider carefully in order to increase capacity?
question_70074.ground_truth: MUROS techniques should consider the balance between low frequency reuse and high time slot reuse, as well as properly handle potential increases in co-channel and adjacent channel interference, which can lead to a decrease in C/I and frequency reuse.

question_70075.question: What is the role of the Uplink State Flag (USF) in GPRS?
question_70075.ground_truth: The USF is used in the uplink direction to allow multiplexing of radio blocks from a number of MSs on a PDCH. The USF values are used to reserve the uplink for different MSs in dynamic and extended dynamic medium access modes.

question_70077.question: What is the role of the AHR in the location registration step?
question_70077.ground_truth: In the location registration step (Step 1), the AHR determines the location of the H(e)NB based on the identifier obtained from the CLF, and registers the location of this H(e)NB. After Step 1, AHR can store the access line location identifier as an attribute of H(e)NB profile, treating it as a criterion to judge the location with.

question_70079.question: What is the recommended minimum requirement for modulation accuracy to ensure sufficient receiver performance and limit extra noise power in a WCDMA uplink?
question_70079.ground_truth: A value of 17.5% is recommended for the minimum requirement for WCDMA uplink modulation accuracy.

question_70080.question: What should the receiving side of an AM RLC entity do when it receives an AMD PDU where the SN (sequence number) is not within the receiving window or has been received before?
question_70080.ground_truth: The receiving side of an AM RLC entity should discard the received AMD PDU if the SN falls outside of the receiving window or if the byte segment numbers of the RLC SDU with SN = x have been received before.

question_70081.question: In which element within the "EmergencyCall" can the "User Info ID" of the recipient MCPTT user for an MCPTT emergency private call be specified?
question_70081.ground_truth: The "ProSeUserID-entry" element of the "MCPTTPrivateRecipient" of the "EmergencyCall" element is where the "User Info ID" of the recipient MCPTT user for an MCPTT emergency private call can be specified.

question_70082.question: What should the tBSS do if the oBSS Node ID in the GCR is the same as its own BSS Node ID in 4.3.3.3?
question_70082.ground_truth: The tBSS should perform call leg correlation.

question_70083.question: What is one of the advantages of using multiple links to PLMN(s) and NPN(s) for uplink video stream transmission?
question_70083.ground_truth: It increases video quality and time duration during which the uplink video stream could be transmitted with required QoS in case of mobile cameras.

question_70087.question: What is the message that the UE sends to the MME to activate 3GPP PS Data Off?
question_70087.ground_truth: The UE sends a USSD message containing a well-known *# sequence that activates 3GPP PS Data Off.

question_70088.question: What is the information content in the FACILITY message sent in the FACILITY message sent in clause 1.1?
question_70088.ground_truth: The FACILITY message sent in clause 1.1 includes the Facility information element with an invoke of the Notification operation indicating that the call is waiting.

question_70089.question: What is the meaning of a full ECD (FECD) in the context of Phy-to-Phy H.248 Context types?
question_70089.ground_truth: A FECD is a full-way ECD that represents two complementary HECDs, one for each direction in a Phy-to-Phy H.248 Context type.

question_70090.question: What is the difference between options 1 and 2 in UE-bearer-to-BH-RLC-Channel mapping in the IAB-node?
