question_70422.ground_truth: The MAC entity should indicate the activation of the PSI-based SDU discard for the DRB to upper-layers.

question_70424.question: What is the content type of the HTTP bodies specified in the present specification?
question_70424.ground_truth: JSON (application/json) shall be used as the content type of the HTTP bodies specified in the present specification.

question_70426.question: What type of record is used to report non-communication related target actions (events) in ProSe UE-to-NW Relay?
question_70426.ground_truth: The REPORT record is used to report non-communication related target actions (events) in ProSe UE-to-NW Relay.

question_70427.question: Which UL/DL resource assignment method for NR cells can cause interferers between networks on adjacent channels?
question_70427.ground_truth: Semi-static and/or dynamic DL/UL resource assignment

question_70428.question: What are the pre-conditions for sending a message from a MSGin5G UE to a Legacy 3GPP UE?
question_70428.ground_truth: The pre-conditions are that the MSGin5G Client in MSGin5G UE has registered with the MSGin5G Server and the Message Gateway has registered with the MSGin5G Server on behalf of the Legacy 3GPP UE, and the Legacy 3GPP Message Gateway is aware of the UE Service ID of the Legacy 3GPP UE.

question_70430.question: What shall the MCVideo client include in the SIP re-INVITE request when cancelling an in-progress emergency condition on an MCVideo group?
question_70430.ground_truth: The MCVideo client shall include a SIP re-INVITE request with an SDP offer if the request is sent within an on-demand session, a Resource-Priority header field, and comply with the procedures in subclause 6.2.8.1.2. It shall also include specific MIME bodies and header fields based on the details of the emergency condition being cancelled.

question_70431.question: What protocol is used for mutual authentication between the UE and the BSF in 3GPP AKA infrastructure?
question_70431.ground_truth: The HTTP Digest AKA protocol, which is specified in RFC 3310, is used for mutual authentication between the UE and the BSF in 3GPP AKA infrastructure.

question_70432.question: What is the role of the "end marker" packets in the E-UTRAN initiated E-RAB modification procedure?
question_70432.ground_truth: The "end marker" packets are sent by the Serving GW to assist the reordering function in the Master eNodeB and/or Secondary RAN nodes when bearers are switched.

question_70433.question: What is the maximum luminance width and height that a decoded texture signal of a Bitstream conforming to the 3GPP VR Flexible H.265/HEVC Operation point should not exceed?
question_70433.ground_truth: The decoded texture signal shall not exceed the luminance width of 8192 pixels, and shall not exceed the luminance height of 8192 pixels.

question_70434.question: What does the "PHR Measurement" determine the range of PHR value for?
question_70434.ground_truth: The "PHR Measurement" determines the range of PHR value from -32 to +38 dB.

question_70436.question: Which complexType has a sequence that includes "hAccuracy", "vAccuracy", and "responseTime" elements?

question_70437.question: In what mode does the TWAN report its support of the new WLCP PDN connection modification procedure to the P-GW at the establishment of the IMS PDN connection?
question_70437.ground_truth: It is reported with an additional indicator.

question_70438.question: What action should an MS take if the timer T3396 is requested by the HLR for an MS that has PDP contexts for emergency services?
question_70438.ground_truth: The SGSN should send a DEACTIVATE PDP CONTEXT REQUEST message to the MS for all the PDP contexts that are not PDP contexts for emergency services.

question_70439.question: What is the role of the DUSK in the protected message processing in the receiving UE?
question_70439.ground_truth: The DUSK in the protected message processing in the receiving UE can be used to protect exactly one ProSe Code that the receiver matches, or to provide message-specific confidentiality without the need for the receiving UE to check the MIC.

question_70442.question: How is the notification of the selected second P-CSCF for restoration sent to the UE in IMS network?
question_70442.ground_truth: The notification of the selected second P-CSCF for restoration can be sent to the UE through a 401 challenge message, with the 200 OK message, or with a NOTIFY message after the registration procedure succeeds.

question_70443.question: When is the Measured Results IE included in the E-CID MEASUREMENT INITIATION RESPONSE message?
question_70443.ground_truth: The Measured Results IE is included in the E-CID MEASUREMENT INITIATION RESPONSE message when measurement results other than the "Cell-ID" have been requested.

question_70444.question: What are the recommended key performance indicators (KPIs) and quality of experience (QoE) metrics for augmented reality (AR) media?
question_70444.ground_truth: The report recommends defining relevant KPIs and QoE metrics for AR media, but it does not provide specifics.

question_70445.question: What is an approach to avoid clipping media using SDES before the SDP answer arrives?
question_70445.ground_truth: An approach is to allow the usage of unencrypted early media and apply protection only to media after the SDP answer. Alternatively, a solution can be described outside SDES for receiving RTP media before SRTP is negotiated with the answerer, after which SRTP is preferred over RTP.

question_70446.question: What does the NAS (Non-Access Stratum) described in the document form?
question_70446.ground_truth: The NAS is the highest stratum of the control plane between UE and MME at the radio interface (reference point "LTE-Uu").

question_70447.question: What does the document define the term "Integration Reference Point (IRP)" to mean?
question_70447.ground_truth: IRP is defined in the document as an abstract entity which may be accessed through an open interface between two or more systems, and represents a Network Resource (NR) for the purpose of management.

question_70450.question: What is the purpose of the Information Exchange service in PCAP?
question_70450.ground_truth: The Information Exchange service enables the RNC to obtain GPS or GANSS related data from an SAS.

question_70451.question: What triggers the procedure for monitoring the COUNT values associated to each radio bearer?
question_70451.ground_truth: The procedure is triggered whenever any of these COUNT values reaches a critical checking value.

question_70452.question: Which parameter represents the BitRate type in the F1AP protocol?

question_70454.question: What is the purpose of the In-Reply-To header in a SIP MESSAGE request containing a submit report?
question_70454.ground_truth: The SM-over-IP sender uses the In-Reply-To header to indicate whether the request corresponds to a short message submitted by the SM-over-IP sender or not.

question_70456.question: In the context of SEAL services, what does a "group" refer to?
question_70456.ground_truth: A group, in the context of SEAL services, refers to a SEAL group, which consists of a SEAL group management server (SGM-S) that manages group documents, and SEAL group management clients (SGM-C) that interact with the SGM-S to manage group documents.

question_70458.question: When is a new RLC entity initialized for a TBF in the new cell during a PS handover?
question_70458.ground_truth: A new RLC entity is initialized to support that TBF when the timing advance with the new cell calculated by the mobile station is out of range and the new cell does not accept out of range timing advance, or when RLC reset is indicated for a TBF allocated in the new cell corresponding to a PFC receiving a PS handover.

question_70460.question: What information must be reported to the NAS if the high-quality criterion is not met?
question_70460.ground_truth: Along with the PLMN identities, the NAS must be reported the corresponding RSRP values and any associated CAG-ID if the high-quality criterion is not met.

question_70461.question: What are the four UE capabilities introduced in Rel.16 related to low PAPR DMRS?

question_70462.question: What is a NEST in the context of network slicing?
question_70462.ground_truth: A NEST (Network Slice Example Setup) is a GST (Generic Slice Template) filled with values, used to specify the requirements of a network slice.

question_70463.question: What is the mean and 5% DL Average-UPT gain for operator 2 when using SBFD Alt 2 and large packet size at low load level?
question_70463.ground_truth: The mean and 5% DL Average-UPT gain for operator 2 when using SBFD Alt 2 and large packet size at low load level are 1.15% and 0.43%, respectively.

question_70464.question: What is the pre-condition for initiating an MCPTT imminent peril group call?
question_70464.ground_truth: The initiating MCPTT client should have been provisioned with an MCPTT group that has been designated in the provisioning to be used for imminent peril communications.

question_70465.question: What is required to be included in the Requested Data Value IE if the GANSS Generic Assistance Data IE is included and contains any GANSS-specific assistance data?
question_70465.ground_truth: At least one of the GANSS Reference Time, GANSS Ionospheric Model, GANSS Reference Location, GANSS Additional Ionospheric Model, or GANSS Earth Orientation Parameters IEs must be present.

question_70466.question: What is the purpose of the NG-RAN's admission control in the context of setting up a QoS Flow?
question_70466.ground_truth: The NG-RAN performs admission control to determine if it can support the required QoS, specifically the guaranteed bitrate (GBR), and establishes the QoS Flow if it can.

question_70467.question: What is the maximum aggregate adjustment rate for the initial transmit timing accuracy in Test 1?
question_70467.ground_truth: The maximum aggregate adjustment rate for the initial transmit timing accuracy in Test 1 is Tq per 200 ms.

question_70468.question: What is the format of Unsuccessful Outcome in E1AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?
question_70468.ground_truth: Unsuccessful Outcome in E1AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE is a SEQUENCE of three elements: procedureCode, criticality, and value.

question_70469.question: What information must the PCRF provide to the AF upon indication of change of IP-CAN type?
question_70469.ground_truth: The PCRF shall provide to the AF the information about the IP-CAN type the user is currently using and upon indication of change of IP-CAN type, notify the AF on changes of the type of IP-CAN.

question_70470.question: What should the Event header field be set to in the SIP NOTIFY request for the non-controlling MCVideo function?
question_70470.ground_truth: The Event header field should be set to "conference" in the SIP NOTIFY request for the non-controlling MCVideo function.

question_70471.question: What procedure is initiated in the MS when it receives a paging request from the RAN?

question_70473.question: What does the Rijndael kernel function refer to in the 3GPP authentication and key generation functions?
question_70473.ground_truth: The Rijndael kernel function is a cryptographic kernel function used as a building block in the 3GPP authentication and key generation functions.

question_70474.question: What should the UE do upon start of T310 timer?
question_70474.ground_truth: Upon start of T310 timer, the UE should monitor the link for recovery using the evaluation period and Layer 1 indication interval corresponding to the non-DRX mode until the expiry or stop of T310 timer.

question_70475.question: What information does the UE check in the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message to identify the PDN connectivity procedure?

question_70477.question: When do you consider the Random Access procedure for an SCell unsuccessfully completed?
question_70477.ground_truth: The Random Access procedure for an SCell is considered unsuccessfully completed when the preamble transmission counter exceeds the preambleTransMax + 1 and the preamble was transmitted on an SCell.

question_70478.question: What are some traditional TV distribution formats considered in the analysis for defining TV profiles by 3GPP?
question_70478.ground_truth: The analysis was conducted based on information collected from organizations such as the Advanced Television Systems Committee (ATSC), the DASH Industry Forum (DASH-IF), the Digital Entertainment Content Ecosystem (DECE) and the Digital Video Broadcasting (DVB) Project.

question_70479.question: What is the impact of an adjacent GSM deployment on EC-GSM outage in percentage points?
question_70479.ground_truth: The impact of GSM onto EC-GSM ranges between 0.1 and 0.9 percentage points in outage.

question_70480.question: What is the validity timer indicating for how long the ProSe Restricted Code is valid in step~3?
question_70480.ground_truth: The validity timer shall indicate for how long this ProSe Restricted Code is going to be valid.

question_70483.question: What entity is responsible for deciding if QoS parameters fulfill the QoS requirements in the deterministic communication solution?

question_70486.question: What are the two interworking alternatives specified for IP-ATM interworking?
question_70486.ground_truth: The two alternatives are ATM/IP Dual Stack implemented in the IP UTRAN node, and an Interworking Function (IWF) which can be internal or external to the UTRAN/CN node.

question_70488.question: What should the UE do in 8.2.3.13.1.3.2 when it has the necessary timing information already?
question_70488.ground_truth: In 8.2.3.13.1.3.2, the UE may omit reading the MIB (Master Information Block) if it already has the required timing information or if the timing information is not needed for random access.

question_70490.question: What is the USAT execution environment's capability to make automatic calls?
question_70490.ground_truth: The USAT execution environment is allowed to make automatic calls but only with user confirmation.

question_70491.question: What is the purpose of the time window in the potential QoS change notification?
question_70491.ground_truth: The time window indicates the time period to which the information in the potential QoS change notification applies. It is needed for the specific applications the V2X Application Server serves. If not provided, a default value set by the operator is used.

question_70492.question: When should the S-CCF perform the initial registration procedures with IMS-AKA authentication described in subclause 5.4.1.2.1?
question_70492.ground_truth: The S-CCF shall perform the initial registration procedures with IMS-AKA authentication described in subclause 5.4.1.2.1 if the REGISTER request contains an Authorization header field with the "integrity-protected" parameter set to "yes".

question_70493.question: What happens to the MS's registration context when the GANC sends the GA-RC DEREGISTER message to the MS?
question_70493.ground_truth: The GANC removes the MS context in the GANC when it sends the GA-RC DEREGISTER message to the MS.

question_70494.question: Who does this test apply to?
question_70494.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of E-UTRAN TDD UE release 13 and forward that support uplink carrier aggregation and multiple timing advances.

question_70497.question: What is the purpose of the USIM Application Toolkit in the context of 3GPP network operation phase?
question_70497.ground_truth: The USIM Application Toolkit provides a set of commands and procedures for use during 3GPP network operation phase, in addition to those defined in TS~31.101, for ME that supports the specific mechanism(s) required by the application for USIM Application Toolkit.

question_70498.question: What is the function of the RS used for beam management?
question_70498.ground_truth: Based on the RS transmitted by TRP, UE reports information associated with N selected Tx beams.

question_70499.question: What is the message sent by the MS to initiate the re-establishment of RABs?
question_70499.ground_truth: The MS initiates the re-establishment of RABs by using the Service Request (Service Type = Data) message.

question_70501.question: Which parameter identifies the alphabet/coding and the language applied to a CBS Message?

question_70502.question: What should the IRI-POI in the MME set the payload format to when generating xIRI for SMS over NAS records in EPS?
question_70502.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the MME should set the payload format to EpsHI2Operations.EpsIRIContent (value 14) when generating xIRI for SMS over NAS records in EPS.

question_70503.question: What should the SMF do when the QoS notification control is not enabled and the other access does not accept the QoS profile for a GBR QoS flow?
question_70503.ground_truth: The SMF should release the resources for the GBR QoS flow and report to the PCF about the removal of the PCC rule.

question_70504.question: What is the main security concern for chat services in SIP traffic?
question_70504.ground_truth: The main security concern for chat services in SIP traffic is to protect the communication between the user and the chat server, as chat messages usually end up in the chat server where they are handled in plaintext.

question_70506.question: What is the VAE server providing to the V2X application specific server in Solution #20 after storing the file uploaded by the user at V2X UE?
question_70506.ground_truth: The VAE server provides the file to the V2X application specific server after storing the file uploaded by the user at V2X UE.

question_70508.question: What are the two types of Resource Units (RUs) defined for uplink data multiplexing?

question_70509.question: What is the primary difference between the measurement methodologies for OTA co-location spurious emissions and OTA transmitter intermodulation measurements in General Chamber under normal test conditions (FR1)?
question_70509.ground_truth: The primary difference is that for OTA co-location spurious emissions measurements, the interferer is injected into the antenna from a co-located base station, while for OTA transmitter intermodulation measurements, the interferer is injected into the CLTA from a signal generator.

question_70512.question: What is the frequency range for the uplink channel size in Band 17 when operating with Band 4 downlink in a carrier aggregation scenario?
question_70512.ground_truth: The uplink channel size in Band 17 should be 1/3 of the Band 4 downlink size, regardless of the Band 4 downlink size being 5 MHz or 10 MHz.

question_70513.question: What is the purpose of the "Control plane only indication" information element in the session management procedure?
question_70513.ground_truth: The Control plane only indication information element is used to indicate that a PDN connection is only for control plane CIoT EPS optimization, such as when the PDN connection is with an SCEF.

question_70514.question: What is the role of an Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the 3GPP system?
question_70514.ground_truth: The Integration Reference Point (IRP) is a reference point between an IRPAgent and one or several IRPManagers for network management purposes in the 3GPP system. It specifies the semantics and behaviour of information object class attributes and relations visible across the reference point in a protocol and technology-neutral way, without defining their syntax and encoding.

question_70515.question: What is the impact on the UE when PLMN A can accept Disaster Inbound Roamers from PLMN D?
question_70515.ground_truth: The UE is impacted with the determination that PLMN A can accept Disaster Inbound Roamers from PLMN D and can select PLMN A for registration using legacy principles as long as PLMN D is not in the UE's forbidden PLMNs list.

question_70516.question: What message does the initiating UE generate when starting the 5G ProSe AA message reliable transport procedure?
question_70516.ground_truth: The initiating UE generates a PROSE AA MESSAGE TRANSPORT REQUEST message when starting the 5G ProSe AA message reliable transport procedure.

question_70517.question: What are the allowed frequency bands for operation in the GSM 450 band?
question_70517.ground_truth: The allowed frequency bands for operation in the GSM 450 band are 450.4 - 457.6 MHz for mobile transmit, base receive and 460.4 - 467.6 MHz for base transmit, mobile receive.

question_70518.question: What should the UE do in registration with AMF reallocation via direct NAS reroute before initiating a NAS registration over a second NAS connection to an AMF of the same network?
question_70518.ground_truth: The UE should not initiate a NAS registration over a second NAS connection to an AMF of the same network before primary authentication on the first NAS connection is complete.

question_70519.question: What information does the SGSN send to the VLR when initiating a location update procedure towards the new MSC/VLR?
question_70519.ground_truth: The SGSN sends a Location Update Request (new LAI, IMSI, SGSN Number, Location Update Type) message to the VLR.

question_70520.question: Who are the actors involved in establishing a voice communication with a PSAP to report an emergency situation?
question_70520.ground_truth: Bob is the emergency caller and Carol is the PSAP call taker receiving the emergency communication.

question_70521.question: What should a UE do before requesting RLOS attach?
question_70521.ground_truth: The UE should check whether the PLMN is advertising its support of RLOS before requesting RLOS attach.

question_70522.question: When is an inter-RAT measurement considered as measurement without gap?
question_70522.ground_truth: An inter-RAT measurement is considered as measurement without gap if the UE indicates 'nogap-noncsg' via NeedForGapNCSG-InfoEUTRA for the inter-RAT measurement.

question_70523.question: What is the potential security threat if the interfaces between the 5G system and 3GPP services and application functions lack confidentiality, integrity, and replay protection between authenticated endpoints?
question_70523.ground_truth: An attacker can eavesdrop, alter data unnoticed, and replay packets, making the system vulnerable to unauthorized access and data manipulation.

question_70524.question: What should the target UE provide after receiving a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message in the 5G ProSe direct link?
question_70524.ground_truth: The target UE should provide the PC5 link identifier self-assigned for this 5G ProSe direct link, PQFI(s) and its corresponding PC5 QoS parameters, an indication of activation of the PC5 unicast user plane security protection, and an indication of emergency services if applicable.

question_70525.question: What is the HTTP custom header used for setting and carrying the message priority information between the client and the server in 3GPP networks?
question_70525.ground_truth: The HTTP custom header used is "3gpp-Sbi-Message-Priority".

question_70529.question: What information is included in the GTP-U header extension for conveying PDU Set-related information in the downlink direction?
question_70529.ground_truth: PDU Set ID, indication of last packet of the PDU set, XR stream identifier, XR Multi-modal Data identifier, PDU Handling Type, PDU Set sequence number, and PDU sequence number.

question_70531.question: What information does the PCF need to provide when initiating sponsored data connectivity per PCC rule?
question_70531.ground_truth: The PCF needs information about the sponsor, the application service provider, and optionally the threshold values from the AF in order to provision sponsored data connectivity per PCC rule using the PCC rule provisioning procedure as defined in clause~4.2.6.2.1. The PCF also needs to include the "sponsorId" attribute and "appSvcProvId" attribute within the ChargingData data type which the PCC rule refers to.

question_70532.question: What should the MS not monitor during the Fixed Uplink Allocation for uplink allocation?
question_70532.ground_truth: The MS should not monitor the USF on the DL PDCH for uplink allocation.

question_70536.question: What is the basic limit requirement for single-band connectors operating in non-contiguous spectrum?
question_70536.ground_truth: A combined basic limit shall be applied for single-band connectors operating in non-contiguous spectrum, which is the cumulative sum of the basic limit specified for the adjacent sub-blocks on each side of the gap between passbands. The basic limit for each sub-block is specified in clauses 6.5.3.2.1 to 6.5.3.2.4 of the present clause.

question_70537.question: What messages are used for 5GC Location Services in MT-LR and MO-LR Services?
question_70537.ground_truth: The MT-LR and MO-LR Services messages (TS 23.273) are used for 5GC Location Services, and can be transported in the same RRC container message as LPP messages.

question_70538.question: What is the recommended action for the S-CSCF if it receives an integrity-protected REGISTER message from the UE?
question_70538.ground_truth: The S-CSCF may decide not to authenticate the user by means of the AKA protocol.

question_70539.question: What are the two types of reporting identified for conveying additional information in a network?

question_70540.question: Which identity is used to distinguish the Web service provider and serves for the proxy to find the AVs?

question_70541.question: What is the requirement for the UE to measure CSI-RS for RLM without measurement gaps for FR2?
question_70541.ground_truth: The UE is required to be capable of measuring CSI-RS for RLM without measurement gaps for FR2.

question_70542.question: What is the role of the "SS-Status" in the NotifySS-Arg sequence?
question_70542.ground_truth: The "SS-Status" in the NotifySS-Arg sequence indicates the status of the supplementary service.

question_70543.question: What should the MAC entity do after determining the UL grant for the MSGA payload and the associated HARQ information if the Random Access Preamble was selected among the contention-based Random Access Preamble(s)?
question_70543.ground_truth: The MAC entity should deliver the UL grant and the associated HARQ information to the HARQ entity, and perform the MSGA transmission procedure.

question_70547.question: What is the role of an AS in the context of 3GPP PS Data Off exempt services?
question_70547.ground_truth: An AS is responsible for enforcing the 3GPP PS data off status. If the 3GPP PS data off status is active and the service is not a 3GPP PS Data Off exempt service, the AS prevents downlink IP packets of the service from reaching the UE over EPS IP-CAN, GPRS IP-CAN and 5GS IP-CAN.

question_70548.question: What is the purpose of the NS virtual link in the composite NS?
question_70548.ground_truth: The NS virtual link in the composite NS connects the UPF VNF to the EC VNF.

question_70549.question: What is the primary advantage of "Solution B: New Band Number" over introducing a new band for a regional sub-band?
question_70549.ground_truth: Solution B does not require new band combinations, and it uses existing UE capability signalling and barring, without requiring new network signalling. Additionally, it does not need any NS values for barring UEs, and it effectively communicates UE support for a specific frequency range.

question_70550.question: What is the behavior of the MS when its list of blacklisted numbers is full?
question_70550.ground_truth: When the blacklist is full, the MT shall prohibit further automatic call attempts to any one number until the blacklist is manually cleared at the MT in respect of one or more B numbers.

question_70553.question: What should be set in the "sl-RLC-ModeIndication" field to include the RLC mode(s) and optionally QoS profile(s) of the sidelink QoS flow(s) of the associated RLC mode(s) in NR sidelink communication transmission?
question_70553.ground_truth: The "sl-RLC-ModeIndication" field should be set to include the RLC mode(s) and optionally QoS profile(s) of the sidelink QoS flow(s) of the associated RLC mode(s) in NR sidelink communication transmission.

question_70556.question: What should the UE include in the IE "GANSS Additional Assistance Data Request" when some GANSS assistance data was missing and the IE "Additional Assistance Data Request" is set to TRUE?
question_70556.ground_truth: The UE should include the IE "GANSS Additional Assistance Data Request" in the MEASUREMENT REPORT when some GANSS assistance data was missing and the IE "Additional Assistance Data Request" is set to TRUE.

question_70559.question: What are the UTRAN parameters for the system simulator for the 1.3 test sequence, as defined in the 3GPP TS 31.111 clause 7.5.12?
question_70559.ground_truth: Mobile Country Code (MCC) = 001; Mobile Network Code (MNC) = 01; Location Area Code (LAC) = 0001

question_70560.question: When should the separate requirements for micro-BTS be applied?
question_70560.ground_truth: The separate requirements for micro-BTS should be applied only when a micro-BTS is directly being tested. If there is no separate requirement for a micro-BTS, the requirements for the BTS apply to a micro-BTS.

question_70562.question: What is the requirement for L1-SINR measurement with CSI-RS as CMR and CSI-IM as IMR?
question_70562.ground_truth: The requirement should apply only if the number of CSI-RS resources in the resource set for CMR and the number of CSI-IM resources in the resource set for IMR are the same.

question_70564.question: What is the interface between the transceiver unit array (TRXUA) and the radio distribution network (RDN) in a hybrid AAS BS called?
question_70564.ground_truth: The interface between the TRXUA and the RDN in a hybrid AAS BS is called the transceiver array boundary (TAB).

question_70565.question: Which network function is responsible for triggering network slice quota event notification when the threshold is reached or the periodic timer expires?
question_70565.ground_truth: The NSQ-NF is responsible for triggering network slice quota event notification when the threshold is reached or the periodic timer expires.

question_70566.question: Over which frequency band is the interfering signal offset defined for the co-location minimum requirements in BS type 1-C and BS type 1-H?
question_70566.ground_truth: The interfering signal offset is defined relative to the Base Station RF Bandwidth edges or Radio Bandwidth edges in BS type 1-C and BS type 1-H for the co-location minimum requirements.

question_70568.question: What should the MME do upon receipt of the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message in state BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE PENDING?
question_70568.ground_truth: The MME stops the timer T3485, enters the state BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE, and aborts the dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure. The MME also requests the lower layer to release the radio resources that were established during the dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure.

question_70569.question: What does the 5GS session management (5GSM) protocol provide in the 5G system?
question_70569.ground_truth: The 5GS session management (5GSM) protocol provides procedures for the handling of 5GS PDU sessions and control of user-plane resources together with the bearer control provided by the access stratum.

question_70570.question: What is the role of the BM-SC in controlling the content broadcasted in different areas for location-dependent MBMS user services?
question_70570.ground_truth: The BM-SC controls the content broadcasted in different areas by establishing a separate MBMS bearer service for each content data flow. The BM-SC allocates the Flow Identifier during the MBMS Session Start procedure and initiates a separate session for each content data flow. A UE is unaware of the Flow Identifier and the existence of multiple sessions for the same MBMS user service.

question_70572.question: What is an ad hoc group emergency alert in the context of MC systems?
question_70572.ground_truth: An ad hoc group emergency alert in the context of MC systems is an emergency alert that involves MC service users from multiple interconnected MC systems, where an MC service user initiates the alert and specifies the criteria for determining the participants list.

question_70573.question: What functional entities are used at the service layer to realize roaming for NGCN users in NGN?
question_70573.ground_truth: The main functional entities from the IMS service layer that are used to realize roaming for NGCN users in NGN include the P-CSCF and IBCF.

question_70574.question: What is the effect of the timer-regrouping procedure on MCPTT group sessions?
question_70574.ground_truth: When a MCPTT group is regrouped, the floor control messages in the media plane include a grouped regrouped indication, and the warning text "148 MCPTT group is regrouped" is included in a Warning header field.

question_70575.question: What does the variable Hys represent in event A3H1?
question_70575.ground_truth: The variable Hys represents the hysteresis parameter for event A3H1. It is expressed in the same unit as the variable Ms, which is meters.

question_70576.question: What action should the UE take when the 200 (OK) response for the security association protected REGISTER request is received in GPRS-IMS-Bundled authentication?
question_70576.ground_truth: The UE shall change the temporary set of security associations to a newly established set of security associations, and use the newly established set of security associations for further messages sent towards the P-CSCF if it is the only set of security associations available.

question_70577.question: What occurs if the access attempt is considered barred and rand is higher than the value indicated by uac-BarringFactor?
question_70577.ground_truth: In this case, the UE considers the access attempt as barred.

question_70581.question: What is the meaning of "shall" in the context of 3GPP technical documents?
question_70581.ground_truth: In 3GPP technical documents, "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

question_70582.question: When would the IRI-POI in the SMF generate an xIRI containing an SMFMAPDUSessionModification record?
question_70582.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the SMF shall generate an xIRI containing an SMFMAPDUSessionModification record when an MA PDU session has been modified for the target UE, including UE initiated or network initiated MA PDU session modification, and handover or MA PDU session establishment over a second access type, among other events.

question_70583.question: What should the terminating MCData client do when it receives an MSRP SEND message via an MBMS bearer associated to the group?
question_70583.ground_truth: The terminating MCData client should decapsulate and, if necessary, decrypt and validate the payload, accept the payload as correctly destined for the terminating MCData client, and process the payload as a received MSRP SEND message during the established MSRP session.

question_70590.question: What is the structure of the OSA API specification and what is its relationship to other 3GPP Technical Specifications?
question_70590.ground_truth: The OSA API specification is structured in multiple parts, including an overview, common data definitions, framework, call control, user interaction, mobility, terminal capabilities, data session control, messaging, connectivity manager, account management, and charging. Each part covers a specific aspect of the OSA API specification and is related to other 3GPP Technical Specifications that define the network protocols and procedures.

question_70591.question: What is the role of the application level signalling bearer (e.g. TMGI 9) in the improved solution described?
question_70591.ground_truth: The application level signalling bearer (e.g. TMGI 9) is used for all control messages needed for the media MBMS bearers (TMGI 1 and TMGI 2). It allows the MC service clients to receive floor control messages for all calls going on in the areas of both TMGI 1 and TMGI 2.

question_70592.question: What is the average horizontal field of view for human vision?
question_70592.ground_truth: The average horizontal field of view for human vision is around 200-220 degrees.

question_70594.question: What is the key issue that needs to be studied regarding conveying current overload situations at a NF service producer to a NF service consumer?
question_70594.ground_truth: The key issue includes studying solutions for conveying the overload situation, information to be included in the conveyed overload information, frequency of inclusion, and where to include the conveyed overload information.

question_70596.question: What type of radio transmission is used for RLP frames in A/Gb mode?
question_70596.ground_truth: In A/Gb mode, RLP frames are sent with strict alignment to radio transmission. Whenever a frame is to be sent, the RLP entity is required to provide the necessary protocol information to be contained in it.

question_70597.question: What should the SS do if the UE has re-selected Cell 2 within T1?
question_70597.ground_truth: If the UE has re-selected Cell 2 within T1, the SS should continue with step 7.

question_70598.question: What is the first action taken in the SRVCC handover from GERAN without DTM support to HSPA?
question_70598.ground_truth: The UE reports that a UTRAN has now good quality by sending a Measurement Report to the BSS.

question_70599.question: Why does a network operator need knowledge about a user's UEs and his identities?
question_70599.ground_truth: A network operator needs knowledge about a user's UEs and his identities in the CS, PS, and IMS domains to provide combined services spanning these domains.

question_70601.question: What action should the 3GPP AAA server take when it receives a Push-Profile-Request command with a result code indicating failure?
question_70601.ground_truth: The 3GPP AAA server should send a Push-Profile-Answer command with a corresponding failure result code indicating the reason for the failure.

question_70602.question: What happens when the floor control server receives a Floor Request message with a priority level that is higher than the current speaker in a temporary group session?
question_70602.ground_truth: The floor control server will pre-empt the current speaker based on the negotiated maximum priority level and the priority level included in the Floor Request message.

question_70603.question: What is the expected operation for lawful interception in 5.2?
question_70603.ground_truth: The expected operation for lawful interception in 5.2 is the administration of intercepts by the CSP, the activation and deactivation of interception, and the security of interception processes. These functions shall only be accessible by authorized personnel and no indication shall be given to any party to the communication that the intercept function has been activated.

question_70605.question: In what scenario should the Associated-Registered-Identities AVP be added to the answer message in the HSS?
question_70605.ground_truth: The Associated-Registered-Identities AVP should be added to the answer message in the HSS when there are multiple Private User Identities being registered with the Public Identity and the IMS Restoration Procedures are supported in the HSS.

question_70606.question: What is the function of the Remote User Agent (RUA) within the ICCF?
question_70606.ground_truth: The RUA performs SIP User Agent functions on behalf of the ICS UE for IMS voice sessions established using CS voice bearers.

question_70607.question: What can the MRFC request the MRFP to send to parties connected in a call/session?
question_70607.ground_truth: The MRFC can request the MRFP to send tones or announcements, with specific identifiers and durations.

question_70608.question: Which RF architecture did RAN4 consider in Rel-14 for LTE-based V2X service, and what was their approach to adding new licensed bands for V2X operation?
question_70608.ground_truth: RAN4 considered an example RF architecture for LTE-based V2X service in Rel-14 using a phased approach for adding new licensed bands for V2X operation. The first phase involved adding new licensed bands without harmonics/IMD problems into Band 47, which included Band 3/7/8/39/41. The second phase would cover solving harmonics/IMD problems of multi-carrier V2X band combinations.

question_70609.question: How can a UE transfer training data to an Over-The-Top server for UE-side model training?
question_70609.ground_truth: A UE can collect training data and transfer it to an Over-The-Top (OTT) server by directly transferring it to the OTT server, or transfer it to the Core Network which then transfers it to the OTT server.

question_70610.question: What actions does the non ICS UE take to trigger the service control signalling path transfer when it detects a loss of Gm reference point?
question_70610.ground_truth: The non ICS UE sends the service control signalling path transfer notification to the SCC AS over I1, requesting a switch to I1 for Service Control Signalling Path.

question_70611.question: What is the purpose of including a Resource-Priority header field in an MCVideo imminent peril group call?
question_70611.ground_truth: The Resource-Priority header field provides imminent peril level priority and starts the infrastructure priority adjustment process sooner.

question_70613.question: What is the purpose of the Additional update result information element?
question_70613.ground_truth: The Additional update result information element provides additional information about the result of a combined attach procedure or a combined tracking area updating procedure.

question_70615.question: In the context of establishing a transport bearer for E-DCH MAC-d flows, what should be included in the Binding ID IE and Transport Layer Address IE for a set of coordinated DCHs when the Transport Bearer Not Requested Indicator IE is not included in FDD?
question_70615.ground_truth: The Binding ID IE and Transport Layer Address IE should be included for only one of the DCHs in a set of coordinated DCHs when the Transport Bearer Not Requested Indicator IE is not included in FDD.

question_70616.question: What message is sent when measurements are reported for an intra-frequency measurement with a TDD mode at 1.28 Mcps?
question_70616.ground_truth: The MEASUREMENT REPORT message is sent when measurements are reported for an intra-frequency measurement with a TDD mode at 1.28 Mcps.

question_70617.question: What are the main scenarios for CHF-to-CHF communication in the message flows?
question_70617.ground_truth: The main scenarios for CHF-to-CHF communication in the message flows are Session Based Charging (SBC), Immediate Event Charging (IEC), and Post Event Charging (PEC).

question_70618.question: What is the disadvantage of option 2.2 in terms of technical realization?
question_70618.ground_truth: Option 2.2 requires substantial work for the technical realization, possibly too much for the actual benefit it brings.

question_70619.question: What is the role of the DF2 in the context of 12.2.3 events?
question_70619.ground_truth: The DF2 is an entity that receives elements from various events in the 12.2.3 section, for example, attach, detach, bearer activation, bearer deactivation, etc., but only if it is available.

question_70621.question: What is the maximum allowed measurement reporting delay for Event A1 and Event A6 in the discussed tests?
question_70621.ground_truth: The maximum allowed measurement reporting delay for Event A1 and Event A6 is 6400 ms.

question_70622.question: What should the MCVideo server do when sending integrity protected content?
question_70622.ground_truth: The MCVideo server should use the appropriate keying information specified in clause~6.6.3.2 and perform the procedures in clause~6.6.3.3.3 to integrity protect XML MIME bodies.

question_70624.question: What should the NEF do if an AF service identifier is provided and it needs to interact with the NSACF(s)?
question_70624.ground_truth: The NEF shall translate the AF service identifier into the corresponding S-NSSAI before sending the request(s) to the NSACF(s).

question_70626.question: What is the purpose of IPSEC in securing point to point communications links?
question_70626.ground_truth: IPSEC is a cost-effective and efficient method for securing point to point communications links.

question_70627.question: What is MME's role in load handling and re-balancing?
question_70627.ground_truth: MME contains mechanisms for avoiding and handling overload situations. It can use NAS signalling to reject NAS requests from UEs and may restrict the load that its eNodeBs are generating on it by invoking the S1 interface overload procedure, adjusting the proportion of eNodeBs that receive S1 interface OVERLOAD START message, and deciding the content of the message accordingly.

question_70628.question: What protocols can the OSA Call Control SCF be mapped to in the CS domain?
question_70628.ground_truth: The OSA Call Control SCF can be mapped to CAP and MAP protocols in the CS domain.

question_70629.question: What is the purpose of the test in section 9.1.41.1, related to FD-FDD Intra Frequency Absolute RSRP Accuracy for UE category 0?
question_70629.ground_truth: The test in section 9.1.41.1 aims to verify that the FDD intra-frequency absolute RSRP measurement accuracy is within the specified limit for all bands, for UE category 0.

question_70631.question: What is the main difference between Sol#16 and Sol#30 in terms of Assistant UE discovery and selection?
question_70631.ground_truth: The main difference is that in Sol#16, the Assistant UE is selected during the discovery procedure by UE1. In Sol#30, the Assistant UE is discovered and selected by UE1 and UE2 by any solutions for KI#3, and are only involved in measuring but not in result collection or calculation.

question_70634.question: What is one benefit of segmenting and distributing the content in the network for the IMS CoD service?
question_70634.ground_truth: Segmenting and distributing the content in the network helps reduce the time-to-market of CoD since the segments of video content are smaller and can be downloaded to the cache servers more quickly.

question_70636.question: What should the AMF include in the SERVICE ACCEPT message if it needs to indicate which PDU sessions are active in the AMF?
question_70636.ground_truth: The AMF should include a PDU session status IE in the SERVICE ACCEPT message to indicate which PDU sessions are active in the AMF.

question_70637.question: What should the MS do when it receives a Register Reject message with a Reject Cause of "Location not allowed", as specified in the sub-clause 6.2.3.3?
question_70637.ground_truth: The MS should release the TCP connection established to the GANC, if still established, release the secure connection towards the SEGW associated with the GANC, store the AP-ID in the AP Black List and not initiate a new Register Request from this AP until the AP-ID is removed from the AP Black List.

question_70638.question: What should a mobile station transmit with priority during packet transfer mode?
question_70638.ground_truth: In packet transfer mode, a mobile station shall transmit RLC/MAC control blocks, except Packet Uplink Dummy Control Blocks, with priority over RLC data blocks and RLC/MAC control blocks containing Packet Uplink Dummy Control Blocks.

question_70642.question: What protocol is used by the UE and P-CSCF to provide the User Agent role in SIP?
question_70642.ground_truth: The User Equipment (UE) and the P-CSCF provide the User Agent (UA) role in SIP.

question_70648.question: What action does the MS GA-SM take when it receives De-activate PDP Context Response from the serving GA-SM?
question_70648.ground_truth: The MS GA-SM releases all the resources related to that PDP context and sends SMREG-PDP-DEACTIVATE-CNF via the unchanged SMREG-SAP interface.

question_70649.question: What is the main function of the Element Manager (EM) in the 3GPP 3rd Generation Partnership Project?
question_70649.ground_truth: The main function of the Element Manager (EM) within the 3GPP 3rd Generation Partnership Project is to provide a package of end-user functions for management of a set of closely related types of Network Elements (NEs).

question_70650.question: What happens to the CC links when a conference is released in a multi-party call?
question_70650.ground_truth: If the conference is released and the initial state (1 held, 1 active call) is re-established, the required CC links are still available.

question_70651.question: What is the role of the fading function in the testing procedure for the reference sensitivity?
question_70651.ground_truth: The fading function is used to set the propagation conditions for the testing of the MS. It is set to TUhigh, HThigh, RAhigh, and STATIC in different testing scenarios to evaluate the performance of the MS under different conditions.

question_70652.question: What parameters do the MME and the UE use to map from R99 to EPS QoS parameters?
question_70652.ground_truth: The MME and the UE use the mapping defined in 3GPP TS 23.401, annex E to map from R99 to EPS QoS parameters.

question_70653.question: What is the method used in Sol#28 to send the ECS address to the UE via DL NAS message?
question_70653.ground_truth: The V-SMF or H-SMF sends the ECS address in ePCO to UE via DL NAS message.

question_70655.question: What triggers the H.245 negotiation between UE-A and UE-B for this scenario?
question_70655.ground_truth: The H.245 negotiation between UE-A and UE-B is triggered after MSC-B sends ACM with in-band information indicator at Step 15 and 16.

question_70656.question: What message does the source MN send to the target eNB for SN terminated bearers using RLC AM in step 5a?

question_70659.question: What is the main function of interface Ts between the Tracker AS and the CSS?
question_70659.ground_truth: The Tracker AS collects a set of information from the CSS through interface Ts, such as the index of contents/content segments cached in that CSS.

question_70660.question: What delay does TIDCCH measurement reporting exclude?
question_70660.ground_truth: TIDCCH measurement reporting excludes any delay caused by no UL resources for the user equipment (UE) to send the measurement report.

question_70661.question: What message does the MS send to indicate acceptance of a mobile terminated call?
question_70661.ground_truth: The MS indicates acceptance of a MT call by sending CONNECT.

question_70663.question: What is the purpose of the "time remaining until the next paging group occurrence" parameter and when is it used?
question_70663.ground_truth: The "time remaining until the next paging group occurrence" parameter determines the occurrence of ongoing paging group occurrences for a given MS, and is used by the SGSN to reattempt paging if the initial paging message was not sent on the radio interface, and to adjust the paging timing for all MSs that are subject to extended Idle mode DRX.

question_70664.question: What is the objective of monitoring call information in ework?
question_70664.ground_truth: Monitoring call information allows an application to request call-related data such as call duration, end time, and call events, which can then be used for various purposes like call event monitoring and reporting.

question_70665.question: What is the role of SEAL Network Slice Capability Enablement Client (SNSCE-C) and SEAL Network Slice Capability Enablement Server (SNSCE-S) in the context of the present document?
question_70665.ground_truth: The SNSCE-C and SNSCE-S are functional entities that enable the network slice capability enablement service in a trusted network. The SNSCE-S acts as an Application Function (AF) and influences the UE's URSP rules for the application traffic by providing guidance on the route selection descriptors S-NSSAI and DNN.

question_70667.question: What is the impact of 3rd order IMD generated by dual uplink of Band 3 + Band n1 on the own Rx of band n78?
question_70667.ground_truth: The impact of 3rd order IMD generated by dual uplink of Band 3 + Band n1 on the own Rx of band n78 is that it may fall into the own Rx of band n78.

question_70668.question: What is the requirement for the 5G system to be used as a supplement or backup to the GNSS receiver based (or wired) clock synchronization systems in a Smart Grid?
question_70668.ground_truth: The 5G system should be able to improve the accuracy and availability of the clock synchronization across the Smart Grid when used as a supplement or backup.

question_70671.question: What message does the AF send to the NEF when it needs to retrieve Network Status Information (NSI) for a specific geographic area?
question_70671.ground_truth: The AF sends a Network Status Request (Geographical area, AF Identifier, Duration, Threshold) message to the NEF.

question_70673.question: What is the percentage increase in mean capacity performance when bandwidth is increased from 100MHz to 400MHz for FR2, Dense Urban, DL, AR/VR (30 Mbps, 10ms PDB, 60FPS), DDDSU TDD format based on Source 16?
question_70673.ground_truth: The mean capacity performance is increased by about 300%.

question_70674.question: What action is expected when the destroy() method is called in any state of the Media Player?
question_70674.ground_truth: All information related to the media and the network is cleared and the Media Player is left in the IDLE state.

question_70675.question: Under what circumstances would the MAC entity identify the logical channel for BRID or DAA for NR sidelink communication?
question_70675.ground_truth: When QoS information associated to BRID or DAA, i.e. PQI(s), is available from upper layers.

question_70676.question: What is the format of the Home Network Realm/Domain in the EPC?
question_70676.ground_truth: The Home Network Realm/Domain in the EPC is in the form of an Internet domain name, consisting of one or more labels, each with the alphabetic characters (A-Z and a-z), digits (0-9) and the hyphen (-) and beginning and ending with either an alphabetic character or a digit. The Home Network Realm/Domain shall be in the form of "epc.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.3gppnetwork.org".

question_70677.question: What must the UE include in the "+sip.instance" header field parameter when it only supports 3GPP and 3GPP2 radio access networks?

question_70678.question: What must the NEF ensure when it receives an AF request from the AF via the NEF, targeting an individual UE address?
question_70678.ground_truth: The NEF must ensure the necessary authorization control and map the information provided by the AF into information needed by the 5GC.

question_70679.question: What is a network feature described by the P-Asserted-Identity mechanism in the context of SIP?
question_70679.ground_truth: The P-Asserted-Identity mechanism in SIP allows a network of trusted SIP servers to assert the identity of authenticated users.

question_70680.question: What is the concept of Decoupled eMBMS content, service, and transport use case?
question_70680.ground_truth: In this use case, the content provider partners with a MNO to distribute a subset of its video/TV services offered by the content provider, by accessing only the MBMS transport provided by the MNO. The content provider is able to insert metadata and content into the MNO's eMBMS distribution network directly.

question_70681.question: How does the network handle the delivery of the calling line identity in the CLIP Supplementary Service?
question_70681.ground_truth: The network shall deliver the calling line identity to the called party at call set-up time, regardless of the terminal capability to handle the information.

question_70682.question: What is the maximum number of GPS satellite almanacs that can be included in a GANSS Measured Results List?

question_70683.question: When is the 4th field (OPERATOR-SPECIFIC) present in a 3GPP Release?
question_70683.ground_truth: The 4th field (OPERATOR-SPECIFIC) is present after the OpenAPI freeze of a 3GPP Release, based on operator policy and compliance with the rules in the Semantic Versioning Specification.

question_70684.question: What is a requirement for the MCVideo service when operating off-network to determine which Participants are allowed to transmit at a point in time?
question_70684.ground_truth: The MCVideo service when operating off-network shall determine at a point in time which off-network Participant(s) are allowed to transmit to other off-network Participants.

question_70685.question: What must the SM-PCF (i.e. secondary) and H-PCF (primary) interact for in the case of a roaming UE's request to a serving PLMN on a PDU session establishment or release of S-NSSAI?
question_70685.ground_truth: The interaction between SM-PCF (i.e. secondary) and the H-PCF (primary) is for control and enforcement of the Roaming UEs' requests, e.g. via N24.

question_70686.question: What is the purpose of the Prototype Pitch Period (PPP) encoding in speech coding?
question_70686.ground_truth: PPP is a technique that exploits the fact that pitch-cycle waveforms in a voiced segment do not change quickly in a frame. It allows for encoding of speech by transmitting a representative prototype pitch period in the voiced segment. At the decoder, the non-transmitted pitch-cycle waveforms can be derived by means of interpolation. This method is used to achieve very low bit-rate coding while maintaining high-quality reconstructed voiced speech.

question_70687.question: What action does the partner MCData server take after checking which MCData users are authorized to receive a file in the partner MCData system?
question_70687.ground_truth: The partner MCData server sends the MCData FD request to the MCData users determined with the file URL being provided in MCData FD request prepended with the server URI of the partner MCData content server, such that the URL identifies a file location in the partner MCData content server.

question_70689.question: What is the significance of the 5G system for line current differential protection in power distribution?
question_70689.ground_truth: The 5G system can provide low-latency and high-bandwidth communication between protection relays, which is essential for time synchronization and fast protection of power lines.

question_70690.question: What is the goal of Candidate IP-PFS Solution 4c in traffic identification?
question_70690.ground_truth: The goal of Candidate IP-PFS Solution 4c is to map both downlink and uplink traffic for a particular application flow within a PDU Session to a specific QoS Flow and handle them separately by the 5G System.

question_70692.question: What are the two key approaches defined in Rel-17 for frequency offset compensation in HST-SFN scenario?
question_70692.ground_truth: UE-based (scheme A) and TRP-based (scheme B) compensation schemes are the two key approaches defined in Rel-17 for frequency offset compensation in HST-SFN scenario.

question_70693.question: What impacts are there on UE and E-UTRAN for implementing the solution of extending paging DRX based on UE low power preference indication?
question_70693.ground_truth: The impacts on UE include an extension to the RRC connection release to include extended paging DRX, while the impacts on E-UTRAN include support for the extension of S1-AP Context release messages for extended paging DRX and low power indication and the need for eNB to support longer DRX cycle beyond 2.56 seconds.

question_70695.question: What actions does the UE take if it cannot derive the required parameters for registration from the ISIM?
question_70695.ground_truth: The UE cannot proceed with the request and will not be able to register to the IM CN subsystem.

question_70696.question: What is the difference in MCS usage between retransmissions with the RESEGMENT bit set to '0' and '1' in uplink TBFs?
question_70696.ground_truth: With the RESEGMENT bit set to '0', the mobile station must use an MCS within the same family as the initial transmission without splitting the payload. With the RESEGMENT bit set to '1', the mobile station may use an MCS within the same family as the initial transmission and split the payload.

question_70697.question: What should the UE do if it receives a REGISTRATION REJECT message with T3346 value IE and the timer is not zero or deactivated?
question_70697.ground_truth: The UE shall abort the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update, reset the registration attempt counter, set the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED, and start timer T3346 with the value provided in the T3346 value IE.

question_70698.question: In which nodes or functionality could the "Low-Priority-Access" be introduced?
question_70698.ground_truth: The "Low-Priority-Access" could be introduced in E-UTRAN, UTRAN, and GERAN, overloading mechanisms of the RAN, EMM, GMM and MM signaling, SGSN and MME, GGSN, S-GW, P-GW, among others.

question_70699.question: In what scenario would the field "affectedCarrierFreqRangeCombList" be included in the message?
question_70699.ground_truth: When the UE is experiencing IDC problems that it cannot solve by itself, and the center frequency of the affected frequency range is within the candidate frequency range included in candidateServingFreqRangeListNR.

question_70700.question: What may occur if the ON-OFF transition at the MS is set wrongly?
question_70700.ground_truth: Loss of data and potentially release of the connection may occur.

question_70706.question: How much time is allowed for interruption when intra-frequency make-before-break handover is commanded?
question_70706.ground_truth: The interruption time shall be less than 5 ms.

question_70707.question: What is a requirement for E-UTRA security?
question_70707.ground_truth: A requirement for E-UTRA security is that the UE shall have a UICC inserted and an activated USIM application.

question_70709.question: What is the name of the channel used for the modulation of the carrier signal?

question_70712.question: What is the maximum attenuation used in the base station antenna radiation pattern in 3-sector cell sites?
question_70712.ground_truth: The maximum attenuation used in the base station antenna radiation pattern is 20dB.

question_70716.question: What is the purpose of exposing network information to the AF for QoS monitoring?
question_70716.ground_truth: Exposing network information to the AF enables real-time media codec/traffic adaptation to the network conditions. This information includes congestion level, round-trip time, data rate, and the QoS Network Class (QNC) for a specific QoS flow.

question_70717.question: During N2 and Xn handover, what should be done with the DRB and/or SRB connections between the UE and the SN?
question_70717.ground_truth: The DRB and/or SRB connections between the UE and the SN should be released.

question_70720.question: What is the definition of Cellular IoT (CIoT) as per the document?
question_70720.ground_truth: The definition of Cellular IoT (CIoT) as per the document is Internet of Things using 3GPP technology.

question_70722.question: What is the input for the "Presence-In-AOI-Report" event for triggering a notification for any UE?
question_70722.ground_truth: The input for the "Presence-In-AOI-Report" event for triggering a notification for any UE includes only the Area of Interest (AOI) identifier.

question_70723.question: What should the UE do if it does not have a valid 5G NAS security context and needs to send the REGISTRATION REQUEST message?
question_70723.ground_truth: The UE should send the REGISTRATION REQUEST message without including the NAS message container IE and set the Payload container type IE to "UE policy container", including the entire REGISTRATION REQUEST message in the NAS message container IE that is sent as part of the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message.

question_70724.question: What is the defined Pfa value in 8.8.1.1 and 8.8.2A.1 for the RACH preamble detection?
question_70724.ground_truth: The Pfa value is defined as a conditional probability of erroneous detection of the preamble when input is only noise (+interference), and it should be 10-3 or less.

question_70725.question: What should the AMF do if the Notification URI is provided and it determines that the paging or NAS Notification has failed?
question_70725.ground_truth: The AMF should notify the NF which invoked the service operation with the specified cause.

question_70726.question: Which INTEGER value in the GPS-UTC-Model range (0..7) represents 24 bit a1 in GPS UTC Model?

question_70729.question: What is the purpose of Slice based VPLMN Selection Policy (SVSP) in 5G network?
question_70729.ground_truth: The purpose of SVSP is to control the UE behavior in cases where a slice the UE wants to use is supported in the VPLMN but temporally rejected by the network due to reasons such as NSAC failure, congestion control, or not allowed in the current registration area.

question_70730.question: What triggers the removal of old EAS information in the UE when the network sets up a new local PSA due to UE mobility in IPv6 multi-homing with a BP?
question_70730.ground_truth: The UE gets a new IPv6 prefix (and routing rules) and removal of old prefix, which triggers the UE to remove the old EAS information bound to the old prefix.

question_70733.question: What is the HTTP status code that indicates a successfully received and processed inter-PLMN application service continuity request?
question_70733.ground_truth: The NSCE Server shall respond with an HTTP "204 No Content" status code.

question_70736.question: What happens to the discardTimer associated with a PDCP SDU when it is received from upper layers?
question_70736.ground_truth: The discardTimer associated with the PDCP SDU is started when it is received from upper layers.

question_70738.question: What current list of objects of PDU Session User Plane Protocol are supported as parts of the Argument of SRv6 user plane?
question_70738.ground_truth: The current list of objects of PDU Session User Plane Protocol that are supported as parts of the Argument of SRv6 user plane include all objects defined in TS~38.415~, except PPI.

question_70739.question: What should an MCVideo client do upon receiving a SIP 4xx, 5xx, or 6xx response to the SIP MESSAGE request?
question_70739.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should set the MCVideo emergency alert state to "MVEA 1: no-alert" and leave the MCVideo emergency state as is, assuming the MCVideo user can clear it manually if needed.

question_70740.question: What encoding style does the SOAP solution set use in the WSDL file?
question_70740.ground_truth: The SOAP solution set uses "literal" encoding style in the WSDL file.

question_70741.question: Which document specifies application specific tests for applications residing on an UICC?
question_70741.ground_truth: TS~31.121 specifies application specific tests for applications residing on an UICC.

question_70742.question: What happens if the bearer of interest has insufficient bandwidth for the desired bearer(s)?
question_70742.ground_truth: If the bearer of interest has insufficient bandwidth, the polling MC service server may resort to unicast, or may allocate another bearer for the congested area. If a duplicate bearer is allocated for the same area, it should not be shared with other servers and probably should be torn down as soon as the congestion on the original bearer clears up.

question_70743.question: What are the two classes of LCS Applications and how are they identified?
question_70743.ground_truth: The two classes of LCS Applications are Internal applications and External applications. Internal applications are identified by LCS client internal ID and External applications are identified by LCS client external ID.

question_70745.question: What does the UTRAN key hierarchy introduced in this text solve in terms of security threats?
question_70745.ground_truth: The UTRAN key hierarchy solves the security threats brought by present deployments of UTRAN with RNC functionality moved to HSPA NodeBs by providing a pair of legacy keys by the source SGSN+, which will be sent to the target SGSN during SGSN relocation. This prevents the attacker from having access to the keys used by the target normal UMTS network.

question_70746.question: What is the definition of "spectrum re-allocation" provided in the document?
question_70746.ground_truth: Spectrum re-allocation is the assignment of spectrum from one RAT to another, in a reversible manner, for a period of time (temporal) or in an area (spatial).

question_70748.question: What is the main difference between steps 5a and 5b in the session termination process initiated by the AF in the VPLMN?
question_70748.ground_truth: In step 5a, the H-PCRF sends Diameter STA, session termination answer, to the V-PCRF without including access network information. In contrast, in step 5b, the H-PCRF sends Diameter STA, session termination answer, to the V-PCRF with access network information obtained in step 7.

question_70750.question: Which device identity is used in the TERMINAL RESPONSE message with 3G Session Reset procedure?
question_70750.ground_truth: The source device is ME and the destination device is UICC in the TERMINAL RESPONSE message with 3G Session Reset procedure.

question_70751.question: What information does the S-CSCF use to identify the user during the registration process for an already registered public user identity linked to the same private user identity?
question_70751.ground_truth: The S-CSCF uses the public user identity as received in the To header field of the REGISTER request and the private user identity as received in the Authorization header field of the REGISTER request to identify the user.

question_70752.question: Which 3GPP specification provides the stage 2 details of the AKMA TLS protocol profiles for 5G?

question_70753.question: What is the procedure for accessing EPC when the IMSI is available and authenticated in a cdma2000 HRPD access network?
question_70753.ground_truth: The UE and network shall use the root NAI for EPC access authentication when the UE obtains emergency services via a cdma2000 HRPD access network connected to an EPC in the UE's HPLMN.

question_70756.question: What happens when a GTP-C entity operates over its signalling capacity?
question_70756.ground_truth: When a GTP-C entity operates over its signalling capacity, it results in diminished performance, including impacts to handling of incoming and outgoing traffic.

question_70757.question: Which attribute of the 'Customer' entity in the SID defines the degree of importance relative to other customers?
question_70757.ground_truth: 'customerRank' is the attribute of the 'Customer' entity in the SID that defines the degree of importance relative to other customers.

question_70758.question: What action should the network take if it detects semantic errors in TFT operations during a PDP context activation?
question_70758.ground_truth: The network should reject the activation request with cause "semantic error in the TFT operation".

question_70759.question: How does a UE select a consumption report server to send a consumption report?
question_70759.ground_truth: A UE randomly selects one of the serviceURI elements currently present under consumptionReporting, with uniform distribution as the destination of the consumption report message, if more than one serviceURI elements are present under consumptionReporting.

question_70760.question: In which clause is the method of test for RE Power control dynamic range defined?
question_70760.ground_truth: No specific test or test requirements are defined for RE Power control dynamic range. The Error Vector Magnitude test provides sufficient test coverage for this requirement, which can be found in clause 6.5.4.

question_70761.question: What are the main service flows for implementing the Ambient IoT service in the automated supply chain distribution use case?
question_70761.ground_truth: 1) Generating unique IDs for Ambient IoT devices, 2) Attaching Ambient IoT devices onto products, 3) Inventorying and reporting the information of Ambient IoT devices, 4) Harvesting power from the environment, 5) Obtaining the information of the Ambient IoT devices, 6) Packaging the products, 7) Performing positioning services for monitoring the loading process, 8) Periodically performing inventory and location reporting of Ambient IoT devices in transit, 9) Identifying the location during transportation, 10) Locating the products based on the report from the 5G network.

question_70762.question: What should be done in the first slot after the end of the corresponding PSFCH transmission carrying the SL HARQ feedback or its resources in case of UL/SL prioritization failure or SL LBT failure?
question_70762.ground_truth: Start the sl-drx-HARQ-RTT-Timer for the corresponding Sidelink process in the first slot after the end of the corresponding PSFCH transmission or resources.

question_70763.question: What should the SLM server do upon receiving a CoAP PUT request where the CoAP URI identifies a registration update?
question_70763.ground_truth: The SLM server should determine the identity of the sender of the CoAP PUT request and may authorize the location-capability, which includes the identities of the available location access type and positioning methods of the VAL UE.

question_70765.question: What is the difference between an aggregation packet and a fragmentation unit in the context of RTP packets and NAL units?
question_70765.ground_truth: An aggregation packet is when one RTP packet can carry multiple NAL units, while a fragmentation unit is when multiple RTP packets are used to carry one NAL unit.

question_70766.question: What is the first requirement for the MsgA preamble in Test 1?
question_70766.ground_truth: The MsgA shall be one of the Random Access Preambles associated with SSB index 0.

question_70767.question: What information must be provided to the CSE when a change of position event occurs?
question_70767.ground_truth: The VPLMN must provide the CSE with information about the event met, type of monitoring, event specific data (which includes location information), and charge result if charging supervision is provided.

question_70768.question: What action should the BTS take if it is not possible to stop a specified measurement?
question_70768.ground_truth: The BTS should send a NACK message instead of an ACK message to indicate that it is not possible to stop the measurement.

question_70769.question: What is the 5% UL Average-UPT gain for operator 2 when using SBFD Alt 2 and large packet size at high load level?
question_70769.ground_truth: The 5% UL Average-UPT gain for operator 2 when using SBFD Alt 2 and large packet size at high load level is 0%.

question_70770.question: What is the length of the MBMS Subchannel field, excluding padding, in an MBMS subchannel control message?
question_70770.ground_truth: The MBMS Subchannel field length is the total length in octets of the Appl. m-line Number, reserved, IP Version, spare, Media Port Number, and IP address items.

question_70771.question: What is the potential risk of hypervisor and VM breakouts in a fully virtualized network with a common hypervisor and resources?
question_70771.ground_truth: A hypervisor breakout could have a devastating impact on network security, while a VM breakout could compromise all other VMs within a host or a limited set of hosts.

question_70772.question: What is the difference between the Route and Record-Route header fields in the INVITE request?
question_70772.ground_truth: The Route header field in the INVITE request identifies the next IBCF or I-CSCF node in the signaling path while the Record-Route header field contains the entries included in the received INVITE request plus an entry of the incoming IBCF-hA2.

question_70773.question: In the context of the Mobile profile, what media types are required to be supported in profile 10?
question_70773.ground_truth: The media types required to be supported in profile 10 are Still Image, Bitmap Graphics, Speech, Audio, Video, 3GP file format, and SVG fonts.

question_70774.question: What is the feature introduced in Rel-15 to reduce UE power consumption in idle mode through the use of wake-up signals (WUS)?

question_70775.question: In what state does the MCVideo client start timer T206 when receiving encoded media from the user or if encoded media is already buffered?
question_70775.ground_truth: The MCVideo client starts timer T206 when receiving encoded media from the user or if encoded media is already buffered in the state 'O: transmission arbitration'.

question_70776.question: What information in the network function can be accessed by the NWDAF?
question_70776.ground_truth: The NWDAF can access available information in the network function related to network slices, types of services, and the load level of the network slice instance.

question_70778.question: How is the downlink signal level of the broadcast carriers of the serving cell and neighbor cells estimated in EC-GSM for extended coverage?
question_70778.ground_truth: The downlink signal level of the broadcast carriers of the serving cell and neighbor cells in EC-GSM for extended coverage can be estimated by detecting and measuring the signal level of FCCH bursts, measuring the signal level of EC-SCH after coherently combining all repeated bursts, and measuring the signal level of EC-AGCH/EC-PCH blocks. Combinations of these methods can be used to improve accuracy.

question_70782.question: What is the purpose of 19.5.9 in the context of 3GPP TS 24.229?
question_70782.ground_truth: The purpose of 19.5.9 is to verify that the UE handles the IMS emergency registration and related signaling independently from any other ongoing IMS registration.

question_70783.question: What is the training data input format used in the precoding matrix for the evaluation of Type 3 UE first separate training with dataset sharing manner for CSI compression?
question_70783.ground_truth: The training data samples are not quantized, i.e., Float32 is used/represented.

question_70784.question: What should be the position of an ancillary RF amplifier when performing tests on a BS?
question_70784.ground_truth: Sufficient tests should be repeated with the ancillary amplifier fitted and, if it is optional, without the ancillary RF amplifier to verify that the BS meets the requirements of the present document in both cases.

question_70786.question: How often does the UE need to verify the BSIC of the GSM BCCH carrier in inter-RAT cell reselection?
question_70786.ground_truth: The UE should verify the BSIC of the GSM BCCH carrier at least every 30 seconds in inter-RAT cell reselection.

question_70790.question: What is the time period referred to as the Provisioning Session in the 5G Mobile Media Service (5GMS) system?
question_70790.ground_truth: The Provisioning Session is the time period during which the 5GMSu Client is permitted to upload stream media content.

question_70791.question: What is the purpose of the programmatic library in the MBMS Control Application Programming Interface (API)?
