question_71141.ground_truth: The IMS-ALG is required to strip the SDP "a=3ge2ae:requested" attribute and the SDP fingerprint attribute from the UDPTL based media of the received SDP offer if the P-CSCF and served UE indicated support for end-to-access-edge media security for UDPTL using DTLS and certificate fingerprints during registration.

question_71143.question: What information is collected and recorded for 5GS CIoT access and usage in Use Case #7 and #10?
question_71143.ground_truth: In Use Case #7 and #10, the network operator collects and records the 5GS CIoT access information (e.g., NB-IoT RAT type) and usage information (in a PDU session) in terms of NB-IoT technologies.

question_71144.question: What should a UE do if it receives a DETACH REQUEST message with GMM cause "PLMN not allowed to operate at the present UE location" in a non-satellite E-UTRA cell?
question_71144.ground_truth: The UE should set the EPS update status to EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED and delete any GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list and eKSI, in addition to resetting the registration attempt counter and starting a corresponding timer instance.

question_71145.question: What is the main purpose of the analysis of 8.2.2.2, 8.2.2.3, and 8.2.2.4 in DASH-based signalling?
question_71145.ground_truth: The purpose is to identify gaps in the signaling methods of DASH-based signalling.

question_71147.question: What message does the UE send to the SRNC to confirm the Active Set Update?
question_71147.ground_truth: The UE sends the RRC message Active Set Update Complete to the SRNC to confirm the Active Set Update.

question_71150.question: What action does the A-SMF take when the AMF notifies it of a UE location change within the same region as the A-SMF?
question_71150.ground_truth: The A-SMF updates the original UL-CL/BP UPF via the local SMF to establish a tunnel between the new I-UPF and the original UL-CL/BP UPF.

question_71151.question: What service state is the UE in when there is no connection established between the UE and the RAN?
question_71151.ground_truth: In the UE, this state corresponds to power off or possibly a "no SIM" condition. In the CN, the NULL state corresponds to CS-DETACHED and PS-DETACHED.

question_71155.question: What is the procedure to be followed if the P-CSCF does not receive any response to an initial request for a dialog or standalone transaction sent to an E-CSCF or S-CSCF?
question_71155.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall include a URI, associated with a different E-CSCF, in the topmost Route header field of the initial request for a dialog or standalone transaction and forward the request, if the P-CSCF does not receive any response to an initial request for a dialog or standalone transaction or an unknown method sent to an E-CSCF or S-CSCF (including its retransmissions);

question_71156.question: What three cases are used for determining the time period uncertainty in SCell activation?
question_71156.ground_truth: Known case, first valid L3-RSRP reporting when UE reports valid L3-RSRP, and first valid L1-RSRP reporting when UE does not report L3-RSRP results.

question_71157.question: What is the role of the ISIM-ME Interface testing in terms of assessing the conformance of terminals with features for the ISIM application?
question_71157.ground_truth: The ISIM-ME Interface testing is used to extract conformance requirements for terminals with features for the ISIM application and to identify any gaps in test coverage.

question_71161.question: What are the conditions for the UE Policy Container with indicating the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Information Provisioning request during registration procedure?
question_71161.ground_truth: The UE includes the UE Policy Container with indicating the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Information Provisioning request during registration procedure if it supports 5G ProSe capability as a Remote UE/UE-to-UE Relay and does not have valid 5G ProSe Remote UE/UE-to-UE Relay information.

question_71162.question: What is the significance of the three digits in the version number (x.y.z) of the Technical Specification?
question_71162.ground_truth: The first digit indicates the stage of approval of the document by the TSG. The second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, such as technical enhancements, corrections, and updates. The third digit is incremented when only editorial changes have been made to the document.

question_71163.question: What parameter might not be needed if all User Equipments (UEs) support dual mode receivers?
question_71163.ground_truth: The cdma2000 1X Pilot PN sequence offset index increment parameter might not be needed if all UEs support dual mode receivers.

question_71164.question: What are the two interfaces provided by the OSA API Mapping?
question_71164.ground_truth: The two interfaces provided by the OSA API Mapping are Data Session Control Interface Class methods and CAMEL Application Part operations and Mobile Application Part operations.

question_71165.question: What are the challenges in testing BS demodulation requirements in the 7-24 GHz range?
question_71165.ground_truth: The challenges in testing BS demodulation requirements in the 7-24 GHz range are OTA testing of more than 2RX demodulation requirements may not be feasible and a link budget assessment is needed in applicable test chambers to ensure OTA testability feasibility at sufficiently high SINR at the BS receiver. BS demodulation requirements that are not OTA tested may still be specified as conducted only.

question_71166.question: What is the expected eCall adoption timeline for new vehicles in the European Union?
question_71166.ground_truth: It is envisioned that eCall will be offered on all new vehicles in the EU by 2010.

question_71167.question: What is the purpose of the in-sync test in 7.3.2.1?
question_71167.ground_truth: The purpose of the in-sync test in 7.3.2.1 is to verify that the UE properly detects the in-sync for the purpose of monitoring downlink radio link quality of the serving cell.

question_71168.question: What is the objective of the MSGin5G message segment recovery procedure?
question_71168.ground_truth: The objective of the MSGin5G message segment recovery procedure is to recover missing segments and to reassemble all the segmented messages into a single MSGin5G message, to ensure that the complete message is delivered correctly.

question_71170.question: What is the node named "V2XServiceIDtoV2XNRFrequencyMappingRule" used for in the V2XoverNRPC5 node?
question_71170.ground_truth: It contains the mapping rules between the V2X service identifier and V2X NR frequency for V2X communication over the NR-PC5.

question_71171.question: What information does the MAC entity indicate to upper layers when it receives a GNSS Measurement Command MAC CE with a Type field indicating network-triggered GNSS measurement?
question_71171.ground_truth: The MAC entity indicates a request to perform GNSS measurement to upper layers.

question_71172.question: What should the UE do when it receives an EAP-request/AKA'-challenge message?
question_71172.ground_truth: The UE should proceed with an EAP-request/AKA'-challenge message only if a USIM is present. During a successful EAP based primary authentication and key agreement procedure, the CK and IK are computed by the USIM. CK and IK are then used by the ME as key material to generate an EMSK or MSK.

question_71173.question: How does the UE determine access to the cell as barred or not when eab-Param is included in eab-Common?
question_71173.ground_truth: The UE considers access to the cell as barred if the UE belongs to the category of UEs as indicated in the eab-Category and the corresponding bit in the eab-BarringBitmap is set to one. Otherwise, the UE considers access to the cell as not barred due to EAB.

question_71174.question: What action will the MME take upon receipt of a CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message with Control plane service type indicating "mobile originating request" if the MME needs to perform an EPS bearer context status synchronization for an EPS bearer context not associated with Control plane only indication?
question_71174.ground_truth: The MME will send a SERVICE ACCEPT message upon receipt of a CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message with Control plane service type indicating "mobile originating request" if the MME needs to perform an EPS bearer context status synchronization for an EPS bearer context not associated with Control plane only indication, and there is no downlink user data pending to be delivered via the user plane, and the UE did not set the "active" flag in the Control plane service type IE to 1.

question_71175.question: What is the difference between intra-frequency and inter-frequency DAPS handover in NR FR1?
question_71175.ground_truth: Intra-frequency DAPS handover is when the center frequency and subcarrier spacing of the SSBs of the source and target cells are the same, while inter-frequency handover is when they are different.

question_71177.question: What is the system's capability with regards to negotiating the user's desired language(s) and modalities, per media stream and/or session, in the context of a user equipment (UE)?
question_71177.ground_truth: The system should be able to negotiate the user's desired language(s) and modalities, per media stream and/or session, in order of preference.

question_71178.question: What should the UDM include in the SOR-CMCI if the UE is registered in the HPLMN?
question_71178.ground_truth: If the UE is registered in the HPLMN, the UDM should include the SOR-CMCI, the "Store SOR-CMCI in ME" indicator, and the HPLMN indication that no change of the "Operator Controlled PLMN Selector with Access Technology" list stored in the UE is needed.

question_71180.question: What entity is responsible for setting the PC5 QoS parameters and Range for each Group Identifier when the application layer passes eV2X messages to the V2X layer for transmission?

question_71181.question: How does solution #3 handle MO SMS for AMF re-allocation in terms of NAS signalling?
question_71181.ground_truth: Solution #3 proposes using NAS security to re-use a new one-time encryption key for encryption of MO SMS included in initial NAS signalling messages in MO SMS.

question_71183.question: What is the default data rate for both layer 1 options on the Iuant interface in UTRA, E-UTRA, and NR?
question_71183.ground_truth: The default data rate for both layer 1 options is 9.6 kbps.

question_71185.question: What is the role of the "3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP)" in the production of the present document?
question_71185.ground_truth: The 3GPP is the organization that produced the present document.

question_71188.question: What is the length and type of the generic message container IE and the Replayed NAS message container IE?
question_71188.ground_truth: The generic message container IE is a type 6 information element with a length that depends on the size of the encapsulated message, and the Replayed NAS message container IE is also a type 6 information element with a length that depends on the size of the replayed NAS message.

question_71189.question: What are the LI functions present in the SGW-C/PGW-C and SGW-U/PGW-U in CUPS EPS architecture?
question_71189.ground_truth: In CUPS EPS architecture, the SGW-C/PGW-C contain the IRI-POI, IRI-TF, and CC-TF, while the SGW-U/PGW-U contain the CC-POI and IRI-POI.

question_71191.question: What should the MCVideo server consider as the served MCVideo user information entry?
question_71191.ground_truth: The MCVideo server should consider an MCVideo user information entry that is in the list of MCVideo user information entries, and the MCVideo ID of the MCVideo user information entry is equal to the served MCVideo ID.

question_71192.question: What is used by NG-RAN for resource management of UE's PC5 transmission for 5G ProSe services in network scheduled mode?

question_71193.question: What is the post-condition for an MPS for MMTEL video or video conference call/session?
question_71193.ground_truth: Upon end of the MPS for MMTEL video or video conference call/session, the UE returns to normal conditions, i.e., use of normal MMTEL video service.

question_71194.question: What is the power level of the interferer specified in relation to the OTA REFSENS power level for both FR1 and FR2?
question_71194.ground_truth: The specification for the interferer power level is 33dB higher than the OTA REFSENS power level for both FR1 and FR2.

question_71195.question: What is the purpose of the Media Flow Control field?
question_71195.ground_truth: The Media Flow Control field is used to indicate to the floor control server whether the user wants to control the reception of unicast media.

question_71196.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network document?
question_71196.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to provide a descriptive recommendation for cell planning in mobile networks.

question_71197.question: In case of non-synchronized cells, what restriction is placed on the mobile station regarding sending RLC/MAC blocks while the PHYSICAL INFORMATION message has not been received?
question_71197.ground_truth: The mobile station shall not send any RLC/MAC block other than those containing the HANDOVER ACCESS message while the PHYSICAL INFORMATION message has not been received by this mobile station.

question_71198.question: What is the maximum interruption time (Tinterrupt) when the target cell is unknown for intra-frequency conditional handover?
question_71198.ground_truth: The maximum interruption time (Tinterrupt) for intra-frequency conditional handover when the target cell is unknown is Tinterrupt = Tsearch + TIU + 20 ms.

question_71199.question: What is the general concept described in section 6.3 of the document which aims to solve key issue #1?
question_71199.ground_truth: The general concept described in section 6.3 of the document aims to use the IMS AS to determine if routing of media traffic via a localized UPF is necessary, then indicating this to the P-CSCF, so that the P-CSCF can use the "AF influence of traffic routing" feature of the 5GC to direct the traffic for a specific media flow to the local UPF.

question_71200.question: What should the HLR do if it receives an unsupported IE from the gsmSCF or the IP-SM-GW?
question_71200.ground_truth: The HLR shall return an error if it does not functionally support an IE which it receives.

question_71201.question: What should the network do if two or more old packet filters among all TFTs associated with the PDN connection have identical packet filter precedence values?
question_71201.ground_truth: If two or more old packet filters among all TFTs associated with the PDN connection have identical packet filter precedence values and do not belong to the default EPS bearer context, the network shall further process the new request and, if it was processed successfully, shall delete the old packet filters which have identical filter precedence values. If one or more old packet filters belong to the default EPS bearer context, the network shall release the relevant PDN connection and, if it is the last remaining PDN connection, the network shall detach the UE using detach type "re-attach required". Otherwise, the network shall reject the allocation request with ESM cause #45 "syntactical errors in packet filter(s)".

question_71202.question: When can a UE use different ProSe Restricted Codes to announce without having to contact the ProSe Function again?
question_71202.ground_truth: If the ProSe Restricted Code Suffix pool contains multiple suffixes, the UE may use different suffixes to form different ProSe Restricted Codes to announce, as long as the ProSe Restricted Code Prefix is valid.

question_71204.question: What is the difference in 5GMM cause values used in SNPN and PLMN?
question_71204.ground_truth: 5GMM cause values #74 "Temporarily not authorized for this SNPN" and #75 "Permanently not authorized for this SNPN" can be used in SNPN but cannot be used in PLMN, while 5GMM cause values #11 "PLMN not allowed", #31 "Redirection to EPC required", #73 "Serving network not authorized", and #76 "Not authorized for this CAG or authorized for CAG cells only" can be used in PLMN but not in SNPN.

question_71205.question: In what scenario should the UE set the "ME support of SOR-SNPN-SI" indicator to "supported"?
question_71205.ground_truth: The UE may set the "ME support of SOR-SNPN-SI" indicator to "supported" if it supports access to an SNPN (Single Network Packet) using credentials from a credentials holder and the UE is in a PLMN (Public Land Mobile Network).

question_71206.question: What is the function of a Multi-Access PDU Session in the context of 5G connectivity?
question_71206.ground_truth: A Multi-Access PDU Session allows for a PDU Session to be extended with user-plane resources via an associated PDN Connection on non-3GPP access in EPC, enabling simultaneous association with user-plane resources on non-3GPP access network connected to EPC and 3GPP access connected to 5GC.

question_71207.question: What is the maximum number of QMC-related ESNPNS?

question_71208.question: What replaces the Charging Key to correlate charging information in the second scenario when both sponsored and non-sponsored IP flows use the same Charging Key?
question_71208.ground_truth: Sponsor Identity and Application Service Provider Identity

question_71209.question: When is the main EAS sent DNAIs and service area in the ACR selection notification?
question_71209.ground_truth: In an EAS bundle, when an executed ACR scenario is selected by the EEC or EES, the main EAS will receive DNAIs and service area in the ACR selection notification.

question_71211.question: What is the effect of an SS-Status parameter in the CFNRy registration result?
question_71211.ground_truth: The SS-Status parameter in the CFNRy registration result is used to provide backwards compatibility with phase~1 and can be ignored by the MS. The network sets it to reflect the state of the service.

question_71212.question: How do MTSI sender and MTSI receiver signal available or requested additional delay budget information (DBI)?
question_71212.ground_truth: They use RTCP feedback messages identified by PT (payload type) = RTPFB (205) and FMT (feedback message type) with value '10'.

question_71213.question: What is the recommended implementation of IP version for IUR data transport in TSG RAN UTRAN Iur Interface Data Transport and Transport Signalling (Release 17)?
question_71213.ground_truth: IP dual stack support is recommended for the potential transition period from IPv4 to IPv6 in the transport network.

question_71214.question: What is a potential solution for securing the A1 interface when the SCEF is controlled by a business partner, such as another 3GPP operator?
question_71214.ground_truth: The interface should be protected using NDS/IP (TS 33.210) and Functional entity Security GW to authenticate and authorize the individual instance of SCEF and secure the interface between the 3GPP Network Entity and the SCEF.

question_71215.question: What should be included in the supportedBandCombinationList if srs-SwitchingTimeRequest is received and SRS carrier switching is supported?
question_71215.ground_truth: srs-SwitchingTimesListNR and srs-SwitchingAffectedBandsListNR for each band combination

question_71216.question: How many polynomials are used to encode the 23 bits block in sub-clause 5.3a.6.4?

question_71217.question: What is the public user identity for an NGCN site in NGN arrangements?
question_71217.ground_truth: The public user identity, also known as the NGCN site identifier, is a valid corporate network user identifier that has to be owned and managed by the enterprise.

question_71219.question: As a service consumer, what should I do if I determine that the received HTTP POST message needs to be redirected in the ACR Management Events service?
question_71219.ground_truth: I may respond with an HTTP "307 Temporary Redirect" status code or an HTTP "308 Permanent Redirect" status code, including an HTTP "Location" header containing an alternative URI representing the end point of an alternative service consumer where the notification should be redirected.

question_71220.question: What action does the MS take if it requests additional assistance data and the entire requested assistance data is not available in the SS?
question_71220.ground_truth: If the MS requests additional assistance data and the entire requested assistance data is not available in the SS, then the SS repeats the RRLP Measure Position Request message without assistance data, and the MS performs positioning measurements and responds with an RR APPLICATION INFORMATION message containing an RRLP Measure Position Response.

question_71222.question: What action must the MRFC take upon receipt of an SDP offer with Predefined ROI mode?
question_71222.ground_truth: The MRFC must determine based on local policy and ROI negotiation results on other call legs whether to accept the Predefined ROI offer and include the accepted set of predefined ROIs in the SDP answer.

question_71223.question: What is the difference between transparent and non-transparent copying of RANAP/S1AP parameters across GTPv2 interfaces?
question_71223.ground_truth: Transparent copying involves copying the respective information into one or more octets of the GTPv2 IE, while non-transparent copying involves decoding the ASN.1/PER parameter and encoding the value(s) into the GTPv2 IE.

question_71224.question: What is the time alignment timer common included in SIB1?
question_71224.ground_truth: The time alignment timer common included in SIB1 is a timer that is applied in the UE to control the time alignment of the uplink transmission. It is specified in TS 38.304, clause 5.2.2.2.2.

question_71225.question: What is an Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the context of 3GPP?
question_71225.ground_truth: An Integration Reference Point (IRP) is a functional capability realized over the Itf-N interface, which is built up by a number of IRPs and a related Name Convention. An IRP usually consists of an IRPManager and an IRPAgent, and there are typically three types of transactions between them: operation invocation, notification, and file transfer.

question_71226.question: What does the ENUMERATED keyword correspond to in the definition of SONInformation?
question_71226.ground_truth: It is a type of choice in programming that allows a variable to have a constrained set of two values, the first one being the main value and the second one being a customized extension value.

question_71228.question: What is the difference between network initiated and mobile initiated location services operations?
question_71228.ground_truth: Network initiated location services operations are requested by the network and sent to the mobile station, while mobile initiated location services operations are requested by the mobile station and sent to the network.

question_71231.question: What is the role of the BSF in GBA Push?
question_71231.ground_truth: The BSF, in GBA Push, is the network entity that receives the GBA-Push-Info intended for the UE from the NAF over the Zpn reference point and forwards it over Upa. Additionally, the BSF generates GPI and finds the private identity corresponding to a public identity.

question_71233.question: What is the function of the G-RAN Transparent Container in the context of 5G system?
question_71233.ground_truth: The G-RAN Transparent Container is used to infer that direct data forwarding can be performed in a node-internal way when the target gNB receives a specific message.

question_71235.question: What function is to enable the transfer of NAS information between UE and CN?
question_71235.ground_truth: The transport of NAS information between UE and CN.

question_71236.question: When is the uplink DPCCH not transmitted in the described procedure?
question_71236.ground_truth: The uplink DPCCH is not transmitted when all of the specified conditions are met for that uplink frequency, which include there being no HARQ-ACK transmission on HS-DPCCH, no CQI transmission on HS-DPCCH, no E-DCH transmission during the UL DPCCH slot, and others.

question_71237.question: What message is sent by the network to the UE to request activation of a default EPS bearer context?
question_71237.ground_truth: ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST

question_71238.question: What is the condition that the SS checks in order to confirm the correct functioning of the MS in this test?
question_71238.ground_truth: The SS checks that the CC entity has entered the state U0 with all the relevant transaction identifiers.

question_71239.question: What is the impact on existing security architecture if home network credentials are used to access a hosting network as per clause 6.10.2.1?
question_71239.ground_truth: There is not any system impact on existing security architecture if home network credentials are used to access a hosting network as per clause 6.10.2.1.

question_71241.question: What was the secondary objective of the verification laboratory in checking the source code of the AMR-WB+ decoder?
question_71241.ground_truth: The secondary objective was to ensure that the source code can easily be ported on a DSP target by mapping basic operators or combination of basic operators onto the native intrinsic functions from the target platform.

question_71242.question: What are some examples of possible PTP interactive teleservices offered by a GPRS network administration?
question_71242.ground_truth: Examples include retrieval services (e.g., accessing information from databases), messaging services (e.g., user-to-user communication with store-and-forward mailbox functions), conversational services (e.g., real-time end-to-end information transfer like the Internet's Telnet application), and tele-action services (e.g., low data-volume transactions such as credit card validations).

question_71243.question: What must the S-CSCF do when determining the duration of the registration based on the received REGISTER request?
question_71243.ground_truth: The S-CSCF shall determine the duration of the registration by checking the value of the registration expiration interval value in the received REGISTER request and based on local policy.

question_71246.question: What feature is not assumed to be supported by the solution for business trunking in the context of Allocation of a STN-SR or retrieval of UE SRVCC capabilities from the HSS?
question_71246.ground_truth: The solution does not assume that Allocation of a STN-SR or retrieval of UE SRVCC capabilities from the HSS is supported for business trunking in WebRTC clients.

question_71247.question: When using Option A for IRI events, what should the IRI-POI in the SMF+PGW-C generate xIRI for upon detecting?
question_71247.ground_truth: PDN connection establishment, PDN connection modification, PDN connection release, start of interception with an established PDN connection, unsuccessful procedure.

question_71248.question: When does the UE send routing rules in UE-initiated NBIFOM when both 3GPP and TWAN access are used in MCM?
question_71248.ground_truth: The UE sends routing rules via the 3GPP access when both 3GPP and TWAN access are used in UE-initiated NBIFOM in SCM.

question_71250.question: What is the blocking performance applied to, as per the definition in 6.5B.1?
question_71250.ground_truth: The blocking performance is a measure of the receiver's ability to receive a wanted signal at its assigned channel frequency in the presence of an unwanted interferer on frequencies other than those of the spurious response or the adjacent channels, without this unwanted input signal causing a degradation of the performance of the receiver beyond a specified limit.

question_71251.question: What does the offset parameter do when querying a collection of resource results?
question_71251.ground_truth: The offset parameter controls the starting point within the collection of resource results.

question_71254.question: What is the message unit parameter used for in the context of layer-to-layer communication?
question_71254.ground_truth: The message unit parameter contains additional layer-to-layer information concerning actions and results associated with requests in the context of layer-to-layer communication.

question_71256.question: What is the requirement for the number of preamble ramping cycles in the test?
question_71256.ground_truth: The requirement is for the UE to transmit 2 preamble cycles, consisting of 12 preambles in each preamble cycle.

question_71257.question: What state is the MultiParty Call in when no Call Leg objects are associated with it?
question_71257.ground_truth: The MultiParty Call is in the IDLE state when no Call Leg objects are associated with it.

question_71259.question: How can operators create or modify services?
question_71259.ground_truth: Operators can utilize toolkits standardized by 3GPP or external solutions to create or modify services. Examples include CAMEL or LCS for creating applications like pre-paid services.

question_71260.question: Which performance measurement is used for the time it takes to transfer a first/initial packet in a data burst from one point to another, in the 3GPP technical specification?

question_71261.question: What is the purpose of the 29.2.6.2 test for Asynchronous Transparent Bearer Capabilities?
question_71261.ground_truth: The purpose of the 29.2.6.2 test for Asynchronous Transparent Bearer Capabilities is to verify the ability of the MS to transfer a Break Signal to the R-interface and vice versa.

question_71262.question: What services can be performed by an intermediate SS7-carrier when using a hub-and-spoke architecture for SS7SEGs?
question_71262.ground_truth: An intermediate SS7-carrier can perform tasks such as TCAP user payload modification, protocol interworking, message screening (e.g. SPAM control), advanced reporting, and other security-related functions when using a hub-and-spoke architecture for SS7SEGs.

question_71263.question: What is the initial value of the PTK ID stored in non-volatile memory of the ME?
question_71263.ground_truth: The initial value of the PTK ID stored in non-volatile memory of the ME is one.

question_71265.question: What new procedure is introduced in 6.2.4.3 of the solution for the RAN to retrieve UE Radio Capability?
question_71265.ground_truth: The new procedure introduced in 6.2.4.3 of the solution is for the RAN to retrieve UE Radio Capability over the radio interface and notify the AMF using the N2 UE Capability Info Indication message.

question_71268.question: What action should the MSGin5G Client on the Constrained UE take when it receives a CoAP POST request for de-registration that is allowed to be delayed for bulk de-registration?
question_71268.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Client on the Constrained UE shall set the "T" field in the CoAP header to 0, include the MSGin5G Server address in the Option header, set the "Content-Format" element to "50", and include specific information elements as specified in the "De-registration initiated by Constrained UE" section.

question_71271.question: In what scenario should the Node B assign the RL Set ID IE included in the RADIO LINK ADDITION RESPONSE message a value that uniquely identifies the RL Set within the Node B Communication Context?
question_71271.ground_truth: For each RL not having a common generation of the TPC commands in the DL with another RL, the Node B shall assign the RL Set ID IE included in the RADIO LINK ADDITION RESPONSE message a value that uniquely identifies the RL Set within the Node B Communication Context.

question_71273.question: When supporting QoS differentiation in the PLMN with network-initiated QoS, what are the two things that an SLA governs between the PLMN and the SNPN?
question_71273.ground_truth: 1) Mapping between the DSCP markings for the IPsec child SAs on NWu and the corresponding QoS, which is the QoS requirement of the SNPN and is expected to be provided by the PLMN, and 2) N3IWF IP address(es) in the SNPN.

question_71276.question: What information element is used by the VLR to request open identification of an MS in the MAP_PROVIDE_IMSI request?
question_71276.ground_truth: Identity type is set to IMSI.

question_71277.question: What is required for MExE classmark 2 devices in terms of application installation?
question_71277.ground_truth: MExE classmark 2 devices shall support the Implementation-Title, Main-Icon, and Main-Class and Class-Path JAR file manifest entries for application installation.

question_71279.question: What is the maximum redundancy level that can be used when transmitting AMR or AMR-WB encoded speech media?
question_71279.ground_truth: The maximum redundancy level that can be used when transmitting AMR or AMR-WB encoded speech media is 300 %.

question_71280.question: What is the function of the UTC-based counter LSB parameter in the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message?
question_71280.ground_truth: The UTC-based counter LSB parameter is set to the 4 least significant bits of the UTC-based counter.

question_71284.question: What is the role of SL session-less operation in the described solution?
question_71284.ground_truth: SL session-less operation allows each participating UE to broadcast the information, while SL session-based operation allows each participating UE to send the information within the established SLPP session. The choice between the two depends on the desired communication method.

question_71285.question: What is the outcome if the PLMN has made contact with the CSE in request mode and the unsuccessful call establishment event occurs?
question_71285.ground_truth: When the PLMN has made contact with the CSE in request mode, the CSE can instruct the PLMN to perform charging activities and activate subsequent control service events for the call by specifying the service events to be detected and reported. The PLMN can then notify the CSE and continue call processing, or suspend call processing, notify the CSE, and await further instructions. In both cases, the PLMN should provide information regarding the event met, type of monitoring, and cause of unsuccessful call establishment.

question_71287.question: What is the purpose of sending a PDU Session Establishment Request over a second access with the same PDU Session ID that was provided over the first access, and setting the Request Type as "MA PDU Request" in the UL NAS Transport message?
question_71287.ground_truth: The purpose of this action is to allow for a Multi-access PDU Session, which enables the correlation of measurement packets with the corresponding access type for accurate measurement results.

question_71288.question: When the current serving cell is not a GERAN cell, what is set to value 99 in the 8.69 parameter?

question_71289.question: What are the two basic building blocks used to describe the layer 3 procedures in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_71289.ground_truth: The two basic building blocks used to describe the layer 3 procedures are elementary procedures and structured procedures.

question_71290.question: What should the MS do if the commanded mode is MCS-5-7, but there is only one RLC block that can be transmitted in that MCS?
question_71290.ground_truth: The MS shall send that block in MCS-5 for case a) or MCS-6 for case b).

question_71291.question: What is the expected sequence of commands and responses when the link is dropped?
question_71291.ground_truth: The expected sequence includes the "GET STATUS" command resulting in "Link dropped" and corresponding codes for each channel.

question_71292.question: What information is excluded from the message that the vPCRF sends to the hPCRF during the S9 session establishment procedure?
question_71292.ground_truth: The outer IP header information of the tunnelled traffic is excluded from the message that the vPCRF sends to the hPCRF during the S9 session establishment procedure.

question_71293.question: What is the role of BBF in managing the user plane for the PDU Session between 5G-RG and FAGF?
question_71293.ground_truth: BBF is responsible for determining the means for managing the user plane for the PDU Session between 5G-RG and FAGF.

question_71294.question: When does a network function check for the interpretation of a UE Radio Capability ID?
question_71294.ground_truth: A network function checks for the interpretation of a UE Radio Capability ID when it needs to provide UE Radio Capability ID mapping, or when no mapping is available between a UE Radio Capability ID and the corresponding UE Radio Capability information in a network function or node.

question_71295.question: What command does the PCRF send to the TSSF to update the traffic steering control information for an IP-CAN session?
question_71295.ground_truth: The PCRF provisions the new, updated or requests to remove ADC rules for the corresponding IP-CAN session by sending a Diameter TSR command to the TSSF, including the Request-Type AVP set to the value "1".

question_71296.question: What kind of information does the generic name of a primitive represent in the context of layer-to-layer communication?
question_71296.ground_truth: The generic name of a primitive represents the activity that the identified layer should perform in the context of layer-to-layer communication.

question_71297.question: What is the requirement for the out-of-band emissions in FR2 for a repeater type 2-O operating in the NR operating bands?
question_71297.ground_truth: The out-of-band emissions in FR2 are limited by OTA operating band unwanted emission limits for a repeater type 2-O operating in the NR operating bands.

question_71298.question: What is the purpose of the InitialUE-Identity field in the RRCSetupRequest?
question_71298.ground_truth: The InitialUE-Identity field in the RRCSetupRequest is used to identify a UE at the start of an RRC connection setup.

question_71299.question: Which trade-off values for TX and RX relaxation were obtained using the shared-pain principle for cross-band requirements between Band 7 and Band 22?
question_71299.ground_truth: TX and RX relaxation are in the range of 0.5-0.6 dB for both Band 7 and Band 22.

question_71300.question: What is the role of the Network Manager (NM) in the 3GPP TS 32.432 standard?
question_71300.ground_truth: The Network Manager (NM) is responsible for the management of a network, mainly supported by the EM(s), but it may also involve direct access to the Network Elements. The NM communicates with the network through open and well-standardized interfaces, supporting management of multi-vendor and multi-technology Network Elements.

question_71302.question: How many non-consecutive DTX subframes are allowed during SCell deactivation in the inter-band TDD case?
question_71302.ground_truth: The SS allows up to 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes during SCell deactivation in the inter-band TDD case.

question_71304.question: What is the effect of activating the Communication Hold (HOLD) service in a communication?
question_71304.ground_truth: Activating the HOLD service will not result in the CCNL communication being established if the originating party is busy or CCNL busy, and the terminating party is available.

question_71305.question: What is the impact of the CV value on the uplink TBF in the context of 3GPP TS 44.060?
question_71305.ground_truth: The CV (channel coding value) affects the channel coding scheme used in the uplink direction for the mobile station.

question_71307.question: What should the UE do with the timer T3396 if it is running and a PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message was received for a non-emergency PDU session?
question_71307.ground_truth: The UE should not stop the timer T3396 associated with no DNN if it is running.

question_71308.question: What is the typical mean data rate of instant messaging applications?
question_71308.ground_truth: The typical mean data rate of instant messaging applications most commonly lies within a range of 30 - 100 Bytes/s (for aggregated uplink plus downlink).

question_71311.question: What is the role of the TR editor in the 3GPP technical document?
question_71311.ground_truth: The TR editor is responsible for introducing all approved TPs in the current TR.

question_71312.question: What is the role of the 'Certificate Management Network Entity' (CMNE) solution introduced to consider the NF lifecycle in the certificate lifecycle management for SBA?
question_71312.ground_truth: The CMNE is responsible for synchronizing certificate related events and NF related events in SBA by communicating with CA/RA, NRF and Virtualization Orchestration platforms.

question_71314.question: What type of information does the "id-list-notification" element contain?
question_71314.ground_truth: The "id-list-notification" element contains information about a list of IDs.

question_71317.question: What information does each bit in the perCC field of the enhanced type 3 HARQ-ACK codebook convey?
question_71317.ground_truth: Each bit in the perCC field corresponds to a serving cell, indicating whether the HARQ-ACK information of that corresponding serving cell is included or not in the Type 3 HARQ-ACK codebook.

question_71318.question: What should the initiating UE do when it is acting as a 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay UE and the NAS level mobility management congestion control is activated?
question_71318.ground_truth: The initiating UE shall send a PROSE DIRECT LINK RELEASE REQUEST message containing PC5 signalling protocol cause value #13 "congestion situation" and may provide a back-off timer value to the target UE. The initiating UE shall not accept any 5G ProSe direct link establishment request for 5G ProSe UE-to-network relaying if the back-off timer NAS level mobility management congestion control is running.

question_71319.question: Which ITU-T Recommendation provides a set of techniques for network administrators to manage network performance and differentiate between different users?
question_71319.ground_truth: QoS metrics may include network layer measurements such as packet loss, delay or jitter, which are provided in QoS metrics and techniques for network administrators in ITU-T Recommendations.

question_71320.question: What is a digital representation as defined in the present document?
question_71320.ground_truth: A digital representation is the mobile metaverse media associated with the presentation of a particular virtual or physical object, giving an example of an avatar.

question_71322.question: What does Nupf interface support in the 5G System?
question_71322.ground_truth: The Nupf interface supports direct interaction between UPF and NFs for QoS monitoring information exposure, analytics data exposure, and TSC management information exposure.

question_71323.question: Under what conditions should the IWF include the warning text "149 SIP INFO request pending" in a Warning header field in the SIP 200 (OK) response?
question_71323.ground_truth: The IWF should include this warning text in the SIP 200 (OK) response if the received SIP re-INVITE request contains an unauthorized request for an MCPTT emergency alert cancellation and a value of "true" for the alert-ind element.

question_71324.question: What is required for most federated learning solutions?
question_71324.ground_truth: Model sharing between NWDAF instances is a prerequisite for federated learning operation

question_71325.question: What modifications are required in Step 11 and Step 12 for the restricted discovery model A in the DUIHC solution?
question_71325.ground_truth: In Step 11, the broadcasted MIC should be computed using links in the DUIHC, and in Step 12, the source authenticity of the received message should be verified using the received anchor of the DUIHC.

question_71326.question: Under what conditions will the AMF indicate the NID of the serving SNPN in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message?
question_71326.ground_truth: The AMF will indicate the NID of the serving SNPN in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message if the ESI bit of the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message is set to "equivalent SNPNs supported", and the serving SNPN changes.

question_71327.question: What is the energy consumed per minute in the Ready State for CC1 devices, running the non-DRX timer with a duration of 20 seconds, looking for two DRX opportunities, and spending the rest of the time in deep sleep?
question_71327.ground_truth: The energy consumed per minute is calculated by multiplying the operating currents and times in the stated conditions: IRX*VRX*5 + IPLL*VPLL*5 + IDS*VDS*20 + ESync = Joules.

question_71328.question: What entity is responsible for handling a group of PCC rules and generating QoS characteristics values for a group of flows in a multi-modal service?

question_71329.question: What information should the new PGW-C/SMF include in the Sender F-TEID for Control Plane IE when sending signalling towards the ePDG?
question_71329.ground_truth: The new PGW-C/SMF should include the new S2b PGW IP address and the Sender F-TEID for Control Plane containing a new S2b PGW F-TEID for control plane in the Create/Update/Delete Bearer Request message towards the ePDG.

question_71331.question: What is the primary function of the DRA when it is overloaded and running in redirect agent mode?
question_71331.ground_truth: The redirect agent, when overloaded, never appears in the path of messages between the PCRF and its clients, but has similar impacts on clients of the PCRF as the PA2 mode, mainly affecting session establishment and termination requests that modify the binding.

question_71332.question: What is the range of values for TSSB for BFD Link Quality measurement?
question_71332.ground_truth: TSSB for BFD Link Quality measurement can have different ranges of values depending on the conditions, such as whether the BFD-RS resource is overlapped with measurement gaps, partially or fully overlapped with SMTC period, or not overlapped with measurement gaps, among other conditions.

question_71333.question: What should the mobile equipment (ME) do if it identifies an emergency number dialed by the end user as a valid emergency number?
question_71333.ground_truth: The ME should initiate emergency call establishment if it occurs under one or more of the specified conditions, and normal call establishment otherwise.

question_71334.question: What is the parameter measured in the test and what is its unit of measurement?
question_71334.ground_truth: The parameter measured in the test is the cell global identifier of cell 2 and its unit of measurement is not specified.

question_71335.question: What is the purpose of the Virtual Noise Generator (VNG) in the SS and controlled by TTCN?
question_71335.ground_truth: The VNG in the SS is used to provide noise interference at a well-defined level for one or several NR cells.

question_71336.question: What is the role of the polyphase index in the LTP filtering process?
question_71336.ground_truth: The polyphase index of the filter is determined by the fractional pitch lag. It is used in the polyphase FIR filter to predict the signal in the LTP filtered signal computation.

question_71337.question: When calculating a position after performing measurements, what action should the UE take if it supports UE GPS timing of cell frames measurement or if the "GPS timing of Cell wanted" is set to FALSE?
question_71337.ground_truth: The UE should include the IE "GPS TOW msec" in the MEASUREMENT REPORT.

question_71338.question: What is one advantage of the central scheduler in the combined cell deployment?
question_71338.ground_truth: The central scheduler can track the user equipment (UE) between multiple nodes, which allows for fast decision-making on TTI level and avoids loading of RNC.

question_71339.question: What are the responsibilities of the SMF regarding the dedicated (re)location information of a set of UEs?
question_71339.ground_truth: The SMF manages the PDU Session considering the received dedicated (re)location information, which includes routing decisions for traffic of PDU Session and DNS handling rule decision.

question_71340.question: In which mode of USSD message routing is it recommended to use visited-routed mode to remove reliance on the home network?
question_71340.ground_truth: It is recommended to use visited-routed mode to remove reliance on the home network when establishing a logical control channel over the CS domain using USSD.

question_71341.question: What is the purpose of P(Em) in 9.4.4B.2?
question_71341.ground_truth: The purpose of P(Em) in 9.4.4B.2 is a probability of an event, which represents the probability of detecting the HS-SCCH signaling for a single transport block case with certain HS-SCCH-1 Ecr/Ior values of HS-SCCH type 3 coding, assuming STTD and DPCH is disabled on HS-SCCH and DPCH.

question_71342.question: In which bands of 1, 5, 6, 18, 19, 20, 26, 28, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 39, 42, 43, and 44 will the 3rd order intermodulation products from Bands 1, 2, 5, 6, 12, 13, 14, 22, 23, 25, 27, 28, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 39, 42, 43, and 44 not fall into their base station (BS) receive?
question_71342.ground_truth: The 3rd order intermodulation products will not fall into the BS receive for bands 1, 5, 6, 18, 19, 20, 26, 28, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 39, 42, 43, and 44 when considering the impact of maximum bandwidth and removing the bands that are not intended for use in the same geographical area as Band 28 and Band 42.

question_71344.question: What is the purpose of the EmergencyCallData.eCall.MSD Info-Package in an eCall over IMS?
question_71344.ground_truth: The EmergencyCallData.eCall.MSD Info-Package is used in an eCall over IMS to provide the minimum set of emergency related data from the UE to the PSAP. It also allows the PSAP to request an updated MSD and receive an acknowledgement for an MSD received in an INVITE request.

question_71345.question: What is the effect of executing the "+CGDATA" command?
question_71345.ground_truth: When the "+CGDATA" command is executed, the MT performs any necessary actions to establish communication between the TE (terminal equipment) and the network using one or more Packet Domain PDP types.

question_71346.question: What is the activation time for the signalled Timing Advance value in the 3GPP TS 36.211 standard?
question_71346.ground_truth: The signalled Timing Advance value is applied to the transmission timing at the designated activation time, which is 6 sub-frames after the reception of the timing advance command.

question_71349.question: Which network resource allocation does the PMU application use to ensure physical isolation demand, and what can it share with the electricity information collection application?
question_71349.ground_truth: The PMU application uses a dedicated core network element and dedicated radio resource for its link to ensure physical isolation. It can share the network resource with the electricity information collection application for logical isolation.

question_71350.question: What message does the UE optionally send in response to a EMSDP Session Start Confirmation?
question_71350.ground_truth: The UE optionally sends an EMSDP Session Start Confirmation message, if requested.

question_71352.question: In equation (1100), what does the noise filling factor represent?
question_71352.ground_truth: The noise filling factor is a value that determines the amount of noise to be added to the decoded coefficients in the noise filling process. It is calculated based on the smoothed noise gain and the inverse of the square root of the sub-band energy.

question_71353.question: What service uses Channel 37 for operation and is widely deployed in the US?

question_71357.question: What is the purpose of the TFO Information field in TRAU frames and when should it be used?
question_71357.ground_truth: The TFO Information field is used to indicate support for Tandem Free Operation (TFO) in TRAU frames. It should be used when TFO is supported and enabled, and the corresponding codes should be ignored if TFO is not supported or disabled.

question_71360.question: What is the purpose of the Edge Enabler Server in de-registering an Edge Application Server?
question_71360.ground_truth: The Edge Enabler Server de-registers an Edge Application Server for load balancing purposes.

question_71362.question: What is the main goal of the OSA standardized APIs?
question_71362.ground_truth: The main goal of the OSA standardized APIs is to provide a secure, extensible, and scalable interface for network functionality access, allowing for the inclusion of new functionality with a minimum impact on applications.

question_71364.question: What is the purpose of the IMEISV information element in the 3GPP NAS protocol?
question_71364.ground_truth: The IMEISV information element is used to request the UE to send its IMEISV with the corresponding SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message.

question_71365.question: Which data type is used for the "MaximumSpeed" in the "SpeedType" complex type?

question_71370.question: What information does the ProSe Key Management Function include in the Key Response message if the UE supports the required algorithm?
question_71370.ground_truth: If the UE supports the required algorithm, the Key Response message includes the Group Member Identity and the EPS encryption algorithm identifier that the UE should use when sending or receiving protected data for this group.

question_71373.question: What is the solution for providing redundant user plane paths based on dual connectivity in the 5G network?
question_71373.ground_truth: The solution allows a terminal device to establish two redundant PDU Sessions over the 5G network with independent user plane paths maintained whenever possible. The user plane redundancy is achieved by setting up one PDU session as MN terminated MCG bearer and the other as SN terminated SCG bearer, with possible restrictions on bearer type changes.

question_71374.question: What are the two types of bursts that can be sent by an EC-GSM device to access the system?
question_71374.ground_truth: The two types of bursts are Access Burst (AB) and Normal Burst (NB).

question_71375.question: What is the CAT-M1 UE action, when all received Random Access Responses contain Random Access Preamble identifiers that do not match the transmitted Random Access Preamble?
question_71375.ground_truth: Upon expiration of the back off time, the Cat-M1 UE shall re-select a preamble and transmit with the calculated PRACH transmission power if all received Random Access Responses contain identifiers that do not match the transmitted Random Access Preamble.

question_71376.question: What should the UE do upon expiry of timer T3540 in cases a and b?
question_71376.ground_truth: Upon expiry of T3540 in cases a and b, the UE shall locally release the established NAS signalling connection.

question_71377.question: What is the significance of the PRACH occasion for a PRACH transmission triggered by a PDCCH order?
question_71377.ground_truth: The PRACH occasion for a PRACH transmission triggered by a PDCCH order indicates the PRACH transmission's time and frequency resources, which the UE uses to transmit the PRACH preamble and access the network.

question_71378.question: What is the use of the muted stored events mechanism (NWDAF) in controlling the frequency of data collection from Event Producer NFs?
question_71378.ground_truth: The muted stored events mechanism in NWDAF is used to avoid constant notifications and retrieve the mute stored events when it requires.

question_71380.question: What is the function of the QoS Flow ID (QFI) in the 5G System?
question_71380.ground_truth: The QFI is used to identify a QoS flow in the 5G System and all user plane traffic with the same QFI within a PDU Session receives the same traffic forwarding treatment.

question_71381.question: What is the procedure for Distributed anchor and multiple sessions (SSC mode 3) where the 5GC triggers move of PSA due to UE mobility?
question_71381.ground_truth: The UE has ongoing application traffic, 5GC triggers move of PSA, UE sets up a new PDU session and gets a DNS server address from 5GC, UE issues a discovery of a new AS, and once new AS address is received, the UE can start using the new AS based on UE's application implementation.

question_71382.question: What is the responsibility of the requestAccess() method for distribution technology authentication?
question_71382.ground_truth: The requestAccess() method is used by a client to request the type of access they require from the IpAuthentication or IpAPILevelAuthentication interface.

question_71383.question: What is the purpose of the "UE Reachability" monitoring event in high latency communication?
question_71383.ground_truth: The "UE Reachability" monitoring event is used to send event notifications to application servers when a UE becomes reachable, indicating that the UE is available for data transfer.

question_71384.question: What is the MPR for UEs without indicating IE dualPA-Architecture supported in intra-band non-contiguous CA power class 2 when B is in the range of 5.04 to 10.08?

question_71385.question: What is the difference between Unattended and Early Attended Call Transfer?
question_71385.ground_truth: In Unattended Call Transfer, an ongoing call is transferred to a 3rd party without checking the status, while in Early Attended Call Transfer, the transferring party waits to hear the ring tone before transferring the call.

question_71388.question: What is the impact of a successfully detected PRACH but unsuccessfully decoded PUSCH in the MSGB?
question_71388.ground_truth: If the PRACH is detected but the decoding of PUSCH fails, network will include a fallback indication in MSGB and the subsequent UE procedure will be similar to that for a UE monitoring msg2 in the 4 step RACH.

question_71389.question: What should the DCCF do if the "notifFlag" attribute is set to "RETRIEVAL"?
question_71389.ground_truth: The DCCF shall send the stored events to the NF service consumer and mute the event notification again.

question_71390.question: What action does the BSF take when it receives a deregistration request from a PCF for an MBS session that it is no longer handling?
question_71390.ground_truth: The BSF sends an HTTP "204 No Content" response to the PCF and removes the corresponding stored PCF for an MBS session binding information.

question_71391.question: What is the requirement for a target MS when a RR message starts a new RR management procedure during an ongoing positioning procedure or transfer of RRLP positioning assistance data?
question_71391.ground_truth: The target MS shall terminate any positioning procedure or the transfer of RRLP positioning assistance data without sending any response.

question_71392.question: What is used to determine the accuracy of sub-band channel CQI reporting under frequency-selective fading conditions?
question_71392.ground_truth: The accuracy is determined by a double-sided percentile of the reported differential CQI offset level 0 per sub-band and the relative increase of the throughput obtained when transmitting the corresponding reported sub-band CQI on a randomly selected sub-band among the best CQI sub-bands compared to the throughput when transmitting a fixed transport format based on the wideband CQI median on a randomly selected sub-band among all the sub-bands.

question_71393.question: What should be done if no positive or negative acquisition indicator corresponding to the selected signature is detected in the downlink access slot corresponding to the selected uplink access slot, and the Preamble Retransmission Counter is greater than 0?
question_71393.ground_truth: The Preamble Retransmission Counter should be decreased by one, and if it is still greater than 0, the procedure should be repeated from step 5. Otherwise, L1 status ("No ack on AICH") should be passed to the higher layers (MAC) and the physical random access procedure should be exited.

question_71395.question: In the context of network slicing, what is the role of the Network Slice Type (NEST)?
question_71395.ground_truth: The NEST is a GSMA Generic Network Slice Template filled with values, describing a type of network slice and embodying some attributes of ServiceProfile.

question_71397.question: What is the purpose of the "Handover Command" in the eSRVCC process?
question_71397.ground_truth: The Handover Command triggers the UE to change to the prepared Target RAN channel. The time it takes for the UE to change channels is implementation dependent.

question_71398.question: What is the expected final state of the MS after deactivation of the GA-PSR TC?
question_71398.ground_truth: The expected final state of the MS after deactivation of the GA-PSR TC is for the MS to be in GA-PSR-STANDBY state and in service of the GAN cell.

question_71399.question: What happens in the post-condition of the Cell Re-home scenario?
question_71399.ground_truth: The operator's intent that the selected Cell is re-homed to the destination RAN Node is fulfilled by the MnS Producer.

question_71400.question: What are the two cases for HTTP proxy usage between the KMC and KMS?
question_71400.ground_truth: The two cases are: (1) the key management client establishes a connection to the MCPTT KMS via the HTTP Proxy, with the KMS connection to the HTTP Proxy also being secured, and (2) the key management client establishes a direct HTTPS connection to the MCPTT KMS.

question_71401.question: What are the two types of UE policies that the PCF provides to the AMF via the N15 reference point?
question_71401.ground_truth: UE Access Network discovery and selection policies and UE Route Selection Policies (URSP).

question_71402.question: In what time period is the SS required to transmit NCD-SSB on Cell 2 in step 6 of the test procedure described in clause 16.6.1.1.4.2?
question_71402.ground_truth: The SS is required to transmit NCD-SSB on Cell 2 when T1 expires and T2 starts.

question_71403.question: What is the role of the E-RABs-Admitted-ToBeReleased-SgNBModReqdList field in the SgNBModificationRequired message?
question_71403.ground_truth: The E-RABs-Admitted-ToBeReleased-SgNBModReqdList field in the SgNBModificationRequired message is used to indicate the list of E-RABs that are admitted to be released when an SgNB modification is required.

question_71406.question: What is the gain of the AI/ML based solution compared to the benchmark in terms of SGCS from the observation window length perspective?
question_71406.ground_truth: The gain is slightly increased with the increase of the length for the observation window.

question_71408.question: What BMI threshold is considered for Jack to undergo a kidney transplant operation, given his medical history?
question_71408.ground_truth: Jack's BMI should be below 40 kg/m2 to qualify for a kidney transplant operation.

question_71409.question: What is the instruction for the C-APDU in the PROACTIVE COMMAND PERFORM CARD APDU 1.1.1?

question_71410.question: What is the role of the service provider and user contractual agreement in this solution for enabling the service?
question_71410.ground_truth: The service provider and user need to agree to enable the service, which implies that the service provider provides the UE with default UE credentials.

question_71411.question: What should the MS transmit after receiving the first RNR frame from the SS?
question_71411.ground_truth: The MS should stop sending I+S frames and start sending supervisory frames within T2.

question_71412.question: What should the Node B do if the Serving Cell Change CFN IE is included in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message?
question_71412.ground_truth: The Node B should activate the resources that are allocated for the new additional serving E-DCH Radio Link at the next coming CFN with a value equal to the value requested by the RNC.

question_71414.question: When should the SMF bind PCC rules with service data flow(s) supporting ECN marking for L4S within the "l4sInd" attribute to a new QoS flow?
question_71414.ground_truth: When the SMF provisions a PCC rule with the indication of service data flow(s) supporting ECN marking for L4S within the "l4sInd" attribute, it should bind the PCC rule to a new QoS flow and not bind any other PCC rules to this QoS flow.

question_71415.question: What is the purpose of PDU Session secondary A&A for a Remote UE via Relay UE?
question_71415.ground_truth: The purpose of PDU Session secondary A&A for a Remote UE via Relay UE is to provide a secondary authentication and authorization for a Remote UE over a PDU Session using a network-controlled authorization procedure. This helps to ensure that the Remote UE is compliant with the necessary prerequisites for accessing the PDU Session.

question_71416.question: What type of platform is HAPS in the document's abbreviations list?

question_71417.question: Who are the known consumers of the Ndccf DataManagement service defined in Section 4.2.1.2?
question_71417.ground_truth: The known consumers of the Ndccf DataManagement service are: Policy Control Function (PCF), Network Slice Selection Function (NSSF), Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF), Session Management Function (SMF), Network Exposure Function (NEF), Application Function (AF), Location Management Function (LMF), Network Data Analytics Function (NWDAF), Analytics Data Repository Function (ADRF), and Data Collection Coordination Function (DCCF).

question_71418.question: What are the additional back-off requirements for the PC2 2Tx MPR measurements?
question_71418.ground_truth: The additional back-off required was 1dB for outer allocations and 1dB for inner allocations compared to the corresponding 1Tx PC2 MPR.

question_71419.question: What is the purpose of the bulk transfer of multimedia from ground to train in the FRMCS system?
question_71419.ground_truth: The bulk transfer of multimedia from ground to train in the FRMCS system is to minimize the excessive consumption of network capacity between train and ground by transferring multimedia databases during stops at stations, stops, and depots with minimum one gigabit transfer speed.

question_71420.question: What command is sent by the USIM simulator to the ME in expected sequence 1.1?
question_71420.ground_truth: PROACTIVE COMMAND: GET STATUS 1.1.1 is sent by the USIM simulator to the ME in expected sequence 1.1.

question_71422.question: What are the source and destination devices for the initial PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP CALL command?
question_71422.ground_truth: The source device for the initial PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP CALL command is the UICC, while the destination device is the Network.

question_71423.question: What is the minimum percentage of successful tests required for a test to pass in E-UTRAN FDD - GSM handover: unknown target cell test, with a confidence level of 95%?

question_71426.question: What type of interface does a 3G ME of R99 or Rel-4 provide for supporting a 2G SIM in addition to the 3G UICC interface?
question_71426.ground_truth: A 3G ME of R99 or Rel-4 provides a 2G SIM interface for supporting a 2G SIM in addition to the 3G UICC interface.

question_71429.question: What information elements does the PIN discovery request from the PINE to the PEMC/PIN server include?
question_71429.ground_truth: The PIN discovery request from the PINE to the PEMC/PIN server includes the UE identifier, PIN client ID, UE location, Security credentials, and the service that PINE wants to consume. Additionally, the PIN discovery request can also have filter information such as the interesting area or type of PIN.

question_71430.question: What are the benefits of using a common datamodel and the Common Profile Storage Framework (CPSF) in IdM?
question_71430.ground_truth: The benefits include reducing admin costs, improving accuracy and security of the data store, allowing new applications to leverage the existing infrastructure and improve end-user experience with quick access to applications, modification of attributes or preferences at one location, and customized application experience. Additionally, it improves application security and allows for easy observation and proof of some principles of fair information practices.

question_71431.question: What information about the S5/S8 interface of the SMF+PGW-C is included in the MME EPS Bearer context for each EPS PDN connection?
question_71431.ground_truth: The IP address and FQDN for the S5/S8 interface of the SMF+PGW-C are included in the MME EPS Bearer context for each EPS PDN connection.

question_71434.question: What is the requirement for using the Supported-Features AVP on the S9 reference point in terms of diameter session?
question_71434.ground_truth: Any further command messages shall always be compliant with the list of supported features indicated in the Supported-Features AVPs during session establishment. Features that are not advertised as supported shall not be used to construct command messages for that Diameter session.

question_71435.question: What is the maximum RRC procedure delay in this test case?

question_71438.question: What are the primary characteristics of Home NBs and Home eNBs that require specific management services?
question_71438.ground_truth: The primary characteristics that require specific management services include the large quantity of Home NBs and Home eNBs, the presence of multiple vendors, the fact that Home NBs and Home eNBs are consumer products often located in private residences which may not be easily accessible for maintenance.

question_71441.question: What is the role of a PUA (Presence User Agent) in the 3GPP IP Multimedia (IM) Core Network (CN) subsystem?
question_71441.ground_truth: A PUA is an entity that provides presence information to a PS (Presence Server).

question_71442.question: What must the customer provide as input when requesting a customized network slice instance from the operator?
question_71442.ground_truth: The customer must provide a set of service requirements, such as the business scenario, isolation, throughput, latency, coverage, etc.

question_71443.question: What is the function of the Timing Advance (TA) and common TA parameters in the NTN cell?
question_71443.ground_truth: The Timing Advance (TA) and common TA parameters in the NTN cell are used to achieve uplink synchronization. A UE must acquire its GNSS position, satellite ephemeris, and common TA before connecting to an NTN cell.

question_71444.question: What does the measurement 4.34.1.1.2 signify in the context of HSUPA?
question_71444.ground_truth: The measurement 4.34.1.1.2 provides the number of successful Mac-d setups for HSUPA, which suggests the successful establishment of E-DCH connections for uplink packet data transmission.

question_71445.question: What is the first action of the AS when applying the early session model in the CAT service?
question_71445.ground_truth: Upon receiving the first SIP 18x response containing an early-session SDP offer with a "g.3gpp.cat" value, the AS will decide which CAT service should have priority based on the operator policy and the calling party's preferences.

question_71446.question: What is the purpose of the UE SS-RSRPB per receiver branch reporting?
question_71446.ground_truth: The UE SS-RSRPB per receiver branch reporting is used to command the UE to report SS-RSRP per UE receiver branch. The report from the UE is a vector of values, where the number of the reported values equals the number of receiver branches on the UE.

question_71447.question: What is the role of SMF in the PDU session establishment procedure for the case with single UE and single UPF?
question_71447.ground_truth: The SMF initiates an N4 Session Establishment procedure with the selected UPF (with replicator functionality) and allocates CN Tunnel ID(s) in this procedure.

question_71448.question: What is the throughput for 90% of the exception reports on the uplink when using the enhanced procedure for AB based access attempt and a Doppler spread of 25 Hz?

question_71450.question: What is the purpose of the AnticipatedRequests message in the Proxy Caching workflow?
question_71450.ground_truth: This message allows a 3GP-DASH client to announce to a DANE its interest in a specific set of segments, signaling the set of segments in representations that the DASH client is likely to select and request soon.

question_71451.question: What is the role of the N32-c interface in the context of the N32 interfaces?
question_71451.ground_truth: The N32-c interface provides initial handshake and negotiates parameters for the actual N32 message forwarding.

question_71452.question: Which element in the XML schema has a complex type with a "sequence" that contains an "xswm:SwVersionToBeInstalledConditional" element type?
question_71452.ground_truth: The "NotifySwMProfileCreation" element in the XML schema has a complex type with a "sequence" that contains an "xswm:SwVersionToBeInstalledConditional" element type.

question_71455.question: What are the requirements for RX only multi-band TAB connector(s) in terms of spurious emissions?
question_71455.ground_truth: The RX spurious emissions requirements for RX only multi-band TAB connector(s) are subject to exclusion zones in each supported operating band.

question_71458.question: What information does the EAS Deployment information provided by AF include to differentiate the EAS deployment information of different PLMNs?
question_71458.ground_truth: The EAS Deployment information provided by AF includes the EAS provider's ID (i.e. PLMN ID) to differentiate the EAS deployment information of different PLMNs.

question_71459.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 04.08 subclause 5.2.1.1, what is the first message sent by the MS on the assigned dedicated channel after the system simulator (SS) assigns the channel for an emergency call?
question_71459.ground_truth: The first message is a CM SERVICE REQUEST message with the correct CKSN and TMSI, with CM Service Type "emergency call establishment".

question_71460.question: What is the adjacent channel leakage power ratio (ACLRadj-x) for NB-CIoT, where x is defined as floor(carrier spacing/channel bandwidth) + 1?
question_71460.ground_truth: ACLRadj-x represents the x-th adjacent channel leakage power ratio which is defined over the 5 kHz uplink channels used in NB-CIoT, where x = floor(carrier spacing/channel bandwidth) + 1.

question_71461.question: What is the accuracy requirement of NR RSSI measurements on a serving carrier frequency with CCA?
question_71461.ground_truth: The accuracy requirements of NR RSSI measurements on a serving carrier frequency with CCA are the same as the intra-frequency RSSI absolute accuracy requirements in TS 38.133 subclause 10.1.34.1.

question_71462.question: What action does the NG-RAN take after it receives the N1 SM container (PDU Session Modification Command (MBS Session ID, UE removed from MBS session with appropriate cause)) from the AMF?
question_71462.ground_truth: The NG-RAN transports the N1 SM container to the UE to inform it that it has been removed from the MBS session, and if there are no joined UEs in the MBS session, the NG-RAN releases the radio resources and initiates the DL tunnel release towards MB-UPF via AMF and MB-SMF (for unicast transport of N3mb). For multicast transportation of N3mb, the NG-RAN performs IGMP/MLD Leave for the MBS session. The NG-RAN then sends N2 Response to the AMF and removes the MBS Session Context from the NG-RAN.

question_71463.question: What is the maximum output Power for PC 3 in the FDD power class with an omnidirectional antenna?
question_71463.ground_truth: The maximum output Power for PC 3 in the FDD power class with an omnidirectional antenna is 23dBm (0.20W).

question_71465.question: What is the role of the AMF in reporting satellite backhaul to SMF during PDU session establishment and satellite backhaul category changes?
question_71465.ground_truth: The AMF reports the satellite backhaul to SMF during PDU session establishment and when the satellite backhaul category changes (e.g. at handover). The satellite backhaul category includes the type of satellite used in the backhaul, such as GEO, MEO, LEO or others, and can be determined based on Global RAN Node IDs associated with satellite backhaul.

question_71466.question: In A/Gb mode, what does the network include in the AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING REQUEST message if only a change of the integrity or ciphering algorithm is requested in the authentication and ciphering procedure?
question_71466.ground_truth: The network shall include the new GPRS GSM integrity algorithm or the new setting of the ciphering mode and the new GPRS GSM ciphering algorithm to be taken into use in the AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING REQUEST message.

question_71467.question: What is the purpose of the temporary group-broadcast group call procedure?
question_71467.ground_truth: The purpose of the temporary group-broadcast group call procedure is to establish a temporary group call between multiple groups from primary and partner MCPTT systems. This procedure is used when the authorized MCPTT user/dispatcher wants to initiate a group call with multiple groups from primary and partner MCPTT systems.

question_71468.question: What is the role of the "business trunking application" in the NGN?
question_71468.ground_truth: The business trunking application in the NGN is an application that provides transit capabilities between NGCNs, as well as break-in capabilities from NGN to NGCN and break-out capabilities from NGCN to NGN. It can also provide additional services beyond basic break-in, break-out, and transit capabilities to the NGCN.

question_71469.question: What action should the NRM server take if the discovery result is successful upon checking the connectivity between the DS-TT ports and related available QoS characteristics?
question_71469.ground_truth: The NRM server should return an HTTP GET response message to the VAL server with an HTTP "200 OK" status code with the TscStreamAvailability data structure as the response body, including the stream specification matching the received query parameters and the corresponding list of traffic specifications.

question_71471.question: What should the HSS be able to do in deployments satisfying all SA1 requirements related to the PS Data Off feature?
question_71471.ground_truth: The HSS should be able to detect if the VPLMN supports the PS Data Off feature, handle the list of Exempted APNs and associated Packet Filtering Information, and send it to the MME/SGSN.

question_71472.question: What information is included in the MapGroupToMBSsession message and over which reference point is it sent?
question_71472.ground_truth: The MapGroupToMBSsession message includes association information between the group call and MBS session, such as the MCVideo group ID and media stream identifier of the established MBS session. This message is sent over the MCVideo-9 reference point.

question_71473.question: What happens when the DN-AAA initiated re-authentication and re-authorization procedures are not applicable for PAP/CHAP?
