question_73796.ground_truth: The Barred Dialling Number service is enabled in the USIM Simulator for the tests.

question_73797.question: Which IE indicates whether the Node B is allowed to use 64 QAM modulation for HS-DSCH transmission or not?

question_73798.question: How can the SMF consider the non-3GPP delay budget when signalling the dynamic CN PDB to NG-RAN?
question_73798.ground_truth: The SMF may apply the non-3GPP delay budget when signalling the dynamic CN PDB to NG-RAN based on the (DNN, S-NSSAI) combination of the PDU Session.

question_73799.question: What is the effect of communication services of lower priority running in parallel on high priority communication services, especially their end-to-end latency and availability?
question_73799.ground_truth: High priority communication services, especially their end-to-end latency and availability, shall not be affected by communication services of lower priority running in parallel.

question_73800.question: What should the AMF do upon receiving a SECURITY MODE REJECT message from the UE?
question_73800.ground_truth: The AMF should stop timer Tyx and abort the ongoing procedure that triggered the initiation of the NAS security mode control procedure. The AMF should also apply the 5GS security context in use before the initiation of the security mode control procedure to protect the SECURITY MODE REJECT message and any subsequent messages.

question_73801.question: What are the two main types of mobility restrictions in the solution for 5WWC use cases?
question_73801.ground_truth: The two main types of mobility restrictions in the solution for 5WWC use cases are Service Area Restrictions and Forbidden Area.

question_73802.question: What is the SW processing time needed by UE, including RF warm up period (Tprocessing), when the source NR PSCell and target NR PSCell are in the different FR?

question_73803.question: What is the format of the "DCH-InformationResponseList-RL-ReconfReady" protocol IEs?
question_73803.ground_truth: It is a protocol IE single container that contains an "ID" and a "DCH-InformationResponse" with CRITICALITY ignore and mandatory presence.

question_73805.question: What is the role of SMF in the traffic duplication procedure?
question_73805.ground_truth: SMF determines whether to use MA-PDU session and SMF determines ATSSS rules for the UE and N4 rules for UPF in the traffic duplication procedure.

question_73807.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the handover delay in E-UTRAN FDD-FDD intra frequency handover case?
question_73807.ground_truth: The handover delay shall be less than maximum RRC procedure delay + Tinterrupt in RRC_CONNECTED state.

question_73809.question: What should the UE include in the SDP answer for CRS service if the telephone-event media subtype is used?
question_73809.ground_truth: The UE should indicate support of the SIP INFO mechanism for DTMF transport by including a Recv-Info header field with a "infoDtmf" value.

question_73810.question: In the case of a Floor Taken message with a Track Info field, what action should be taken regarding the Floor Taken message and the Track Info field?
question_73810.ground_truth: The Floor Taken message should be sent to the identified floor participant interface and the Track Info field should be removed, with the exception of when the Track Info field contains more than one <Participant Reference> value.

question_73813.question: What is the role of the MBMS session start procedure in the 3GPP network?
question_73813.ground_truth: The MBMS session start procedure is used by the BM-SC to trigger the bearer resource establishment and announce the arrival of data for a MBMS bearer service to every MBMS GW that will deliver the MBMS bearer service.

question_73814.question: Which compression methods are used in the IPDC RAN-level compression algorithm?
question_73814.ground_truth: The IPDC RAN-level compression algorithm uses pattern-matching (LZ77 algorithm) and entropy coding (Huffman) to compress data.

question_73815.question: How many HS-SCCH orders can be simultaneously received by the UE across the serving and all the activated secondary serving HS-DSCH cells?
question_73815.ground_truth: The maximum number of HS-SCCH orders simultaneously received by the UE across the serving and all the activated secondary serving HS-DSCH cells is 2.

question_73817.question: What is the meaning of the term "Information Object Class" (IOC) in the context of the present document?
question_73817.ground_truth: An IOC represents the management aspect of a network resource and describes the information that can be passed or used in management interfaces. It is a technology agnostic software object and has attributes that represent the various properties of the class of objects.

question_73818.question: What should a WIC do when it receives a response indicating that a UE non-detected emergency call has happened and was not supported by the network?
question_73818.ground_truth: The WIC should indicate to the user that an attempt for an UE non-detected emergency call has happened and was not supported by the network, and should not retry the emergency call via W2 interface.

question_73819.question: What input data source is relied upon by OAM reporting in relative proximity analytics?
question_73819.ground_truth: OAM reporting relies on Mediated Access Point (MAP) Data Collection Function (DCAF) which uses Radio Resource Control (RRC) and reports User Equipment (UE) measurements up to every 16 ms. This information is used to derive relative proximity and time to collision (TTC) information.

question_73820.question: What is the purpose of using the Line Id as ULI in N2 messages?
question_73820.ground_truth: The Line Id as ULI is used to identify the UE location and is provided in N2 messages to the AMF.

question_73821.question: What message is sent from the SS to the UE to trigger the transmission of a MEASUREMENT REPORT?
question_73821.ground_truth: A MEASUREMENT CONTROL message is sent from the SS to the UE to trigger the transmission of a MEASUREMENT REPORT.

question_73822.question: What should a 3GPP UE comply with as a minimum to support IPv6?
question_73822.ground_truth: A 3GPP UE should comply with the Basic IP group of specifications as defined in RFC 3316 as a minimum to support IPv6.

question_73823.question: What are the two steps in Option 2c for disambiguation at RNC?
question_73823.ground_truth: Step 1: Construction of the HNB database in the macro cell RNC during Femto to Macro mobility. Step 2: Best match activity (disambiguation) executed by the RNC during Macro to Femto mobility (hand-in).

question_73825.question: What should PDN-GWs not do if Create Session Request includes the emergency APN or RLOS APN?
question_73825.ground_truth: PDN-GWs should not perform any checks of Maximum APN Restriction.

question_73826.question: Which technical specification is required for the ME to support the DISPLAY TEXT command with Chinese characters?
question_73826.ground_truth: The ME shall support the UCS2 alphabet for the coding of the Chinese characters, as defined in the ISO/IEC 10646 technical specification.

question_73827.question: What action should the MCVideo client take upon receiving a SIP 4xx response, a SIP 5xx response, or a SIP 6xx response to the SIP INVITE request?
question_73827.ground_truth: The MCVideo client shall perform the actions specified in clause 6.2.8.1.5.

question_73828.question: What is the algorithm used to calculate the response for the authentication challenge in the Authorization header?
question_73828.ground_truth: The algorithm used to calculate the response for the authentication challenge in the Authorization header is AKAv1-MD5.

question_73829.question: What action might the AMF-UE take when it receives a Handover Required message?
question_73829.ground_truth: The AMF-UE may determine to select a new AMF-UE for the specific UE and invoke Create UE Context Request with UE Context (Link ID) and "move together" towards the new AMF-UE.

question_73830.question: What is the requirement for an evaluator to demonstrate competency in conducting an evaluation for conformance to 3GPP SCAS requirements?
question_73830.ground_truth: An evaluator can demonstrate their competency in conducting an evaluation for conformance to 3GPP SCAS requirements through an "audit and accreditation" by the SECAM Accreditation Body.

question_73832.question: What is the role of the IM CN subsystem in the PSS download service?
question_73832.ground_truth: The IM CN subsystem forwards the SIP INVITE message to the SCF, forwards the SIP 200 OK from the SCF to the UE, and handles the SIP dialog.

question_73833.question: What is the requirement for the L3 filter in the test case?
question_73833.ground_truth: When L3 filtering is used, an additional delay can be expected.

question_73836.question: What is the predefined size limit in H-PCF and V-PCF related to in terms of message size?
question_73836.ground_truth: The predefined size limit in H-PCF and V-PCF is related to the maximum size limit allowed in NG-RAN (PDCP layer) for NAS messages from AMF to UE.

question_73837.question: What are the requirements for a UE when measuring the CSI-RS for L1-RSRP measurement on one CC and it is in the same OFDM symbol as another CSI-RS for RLM, BFD, CBD, or L1-RSRP measurement on the same CC or different CCs in the same band?
question_73837.ground_truth: The UE is required to measure one of but not both CSI-RS for L1-RSRP measurement and the other CSI-RS, under certain conditions. Otherwise, the UE can measure the CSI-RS for L1-RSRP measurement without any restriction.

question_73839.question: In the SGSN pool scenario, how should the IP Source address be determined for an Identification Response, Context Response, or Suspend Acknowledge message?
question_73839.ground_truth: In the SGSN pool scenario, if the Identification Request, Context Request, or Suspend Notification messages have been forwarded by another SGSN in the pool, the IP Source address for the Identification Response, Context Response, or Suspend Acknowledge messages should be locally allocated by the sending GTP entity. The IP Destination Address for these messages shall be determined based on the value of the "Address for Control Plane" information element received in the corresponding Identification Request or Suspend Notification message, or the value of the "S3/S16/S10 Address and TEID for Control Plane" information element received in the corresponding Context Request message.

question_73840.question: What should the UE do if it receives an AUTHENTICATION REJECT message over non-3GPP access?
question_73840.ground_truth: The UE should set the update status for non-3GPP access to "5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED", delete certain stored information for non-3GPP access, and set the counter for "USIM considered invalid for 5GS services over non-3GPP access" to the UE implementation-specific maximum value.

question_73841.question: What is the function of the Resource allocation type field in the DCI format?
question_73841.ground_truth: The Resource allocation type field is a 1-bit field in the DCI format, which indicates the type of resource allocation used for scheduling the PUSCH.

question_73843.question: What is the definition of gNB as given in TS 38.300?
question_73843.ground_truth: gNB is defined as a next generation NodeB, which is a next generation node B of the radio access network.

question_73844.question: How does IETF RFC 6681 define the use of repair packets in an RTP-based delivery for which source packets are unmodified?
question_73844.ground_truth: IETF RFC 6681 defines that only the repair packets add the headers in an RTP-based delivery for which source packets are unmodified. At least one repair packet needs to be received to obtain the source block number a source packet belongs to and the source block length of this source block.

question_73845.question: What should the MCPTT Service do for interworking with GSM-R for MCPTT Group Call and Advanced Speech Call Items?
question_73845.ground_truth: The MCPTT Service shall enable interworking between MCPTT Group Call and Advanced Speech Call Items used in GSM-R, minimizing the impact on GSM-R.

question_73846.question: What is the purpose of the heartbeat supervision in the described interfaces?
question_73846.ground_truth: The heartbeat supervision is used to check if a service or framework is operational and responsive.

question_73847.question: What system does the eMBMS system use to deliver DTT services as MBMS User Services?
question_73847.ground_truth: The method of DTT service delivery over eMBMS in this case is referred to as "MBMS Service Type 2: Full MBMS service mode".

question_73848.question: When does the MBMS client invoke the "fdServiceListUpdate()" notification?
question_73848.ground_truth: The MBMS client invokes the "fdServiceListUpdate()" notification when there has been a change to the parameters reported to the application in response to a "getFdServices()" API.

question_73851.question: What is the frequency resolution resulting from the 640-point DCT?
question_73851.ground_truth: The frequency resolution resulting from the 640-point DCT is 10 Hz.

question_73852.question: Which two extension strings are supported in DIMS for the switch element?

question_73854.question: What action does the SGSN take in architecture variants using Gn/Gp based interaction with GGSN when a PDP context using streaming or conversational traffic class is released and the maximum bit rate is downgraded to 0~kbit/s?
question_73854.ground_truth: The SGSN sends an Update PDP Context Request (TEID, QoS Negotiated) message to the GGSN to set the maximum bit rate to 0~kbit/s. The value of 0 kbit/s for the maximum bit rate for both uplink and downlink indicates to the SGSN that a RAB shall not be re-established for this PDP Context in subsequent Service Request Procedure.

question_73857.question: What is the format of the parameter "heightUnits" in the structure "RelativeGeodeticLocation"?
question_73857.ground_truth: The format of the parameter "heightUnits" in the structure "RelativeGeodeticLocation" is an enumerated type with possible values of "mm", "cm", "m", "km", and "meter" (case insensitive).

question_73859.question: What is the term for the interference caused by unpaired spectrum DL signals from an aggressor cell interfering with the UL signals of a victim cell in the same unpaired spectrum bandwidth?

question_73860.question: What is one of the requirements for reducing operational expenditures (OPEX) and the time required to restore the network?
question_73860.ground_truth: The requirement is to minimize the need for manual intervention by triggering procedures with network signalling events and minimizing O&M steps.

question_73861.question: What are the components of the Global identification of the CN node?
question_73861.ground_truth: The Global identification of the CN node consists of the CN-Id together with the PLMN identifier.

question_73862.question: What information is conveyed in the BCD Display information element?
question_73862.ground_truth: The BCD Display information element conveys a BCD coded telephone number.

question_73863.question: What is the Mobile Country Code (MCC) and Mobile Network Code (MNC) for the network in the provided data connection status change event?

question_73865.question: What is the file format for the speech files used by the encoder and decoder programs?
question_73865.ground_truth: Speech files used by the encoder and decoder consist of 16-bit words where each word contains a 14-bit, left-aligned speech sample. The byte order depends on the host architecture. The encoder and decoder process complete frames of 320 samples.

question_73866.question: What is the proposal for the signalling procedure of interworking group creation between MCPTT and LMR system?
question_73866.ground_truth: The proposal is for a new procedure to support user regroup for interworking, which reuses the existing group creation procedure defined in 3GPP TS 23.379. The user regroup is between MCPTT and LMR systems, and the IWF will perform the authorization check with the LMR system to determine whether the LMR group can be regrouped.

question_73867.question: Under what circumstances does the "authorization before allowing access to resources" solution allow access to resources related to a UE?
question_73867.ground_truth: The API Exposing Function checks and verifies the resource owner authorization information before allowing access to the related resources. The token verification is expected to happen before granting access to the API invoker.

question_73868.question: What action does the test system take after the UE sends a CQI report with non-zero CQI index for PSCell during T4?
question_73868.ground_truth: The test system sends a RRC message to the UE to release PSCell (Cell 2) on radio channel 2.

question_73870.question: What is one of the main focus areas for the harmonics and IMD interference generated in UL and unsynchronized Band 33, 38, 39, or 41?
question_73870.ground_truth: The recommended action is to ensure that the harmonics and IMD interference generated within the Bands 1 and unsynchronized Band 33, unsynchronized Band 38, unsynchronized Band 39, or unsynchronized Band 41 receiver should be well below the receiver noise floor to eliminate the possibility of receiver desensitization. For this reason, Bands 7 and 40 BS transmitters should not share the same antenna with Band 1 and unsynchronized Band 33, unsynchronized Band 38, unsynchronized Band 39, or unsynchronized Band 41 receivers, unless the antenna path meets very stringent 3rd order PIM specifications.

question_73871.question: What is the role of the UE in determining traffic steering to the specific access network?
question_73871.ground_truth: The UE takes available parameters, such as ANDSF policies, RAN/WLAN parameters, and user preferences, into account and determines the traffic steering to the selected access network for specific flows.

question_73874.question: What value must the Leap Indicator (LI) field in the Leap Indicator field not use for the MBMS UE to successfully perform time synchronization?

question_73875.question: What should the UE do when transmitting RRCEarlyDataRequest message?
question_73875.ground_truth: The UE shall set the contents of RRCEarlyDataRequest message based on the information received from upper layers and submit the RRCEarlyDataRequest message to the lower layers for transmission.

question_73877.question: What is one additional remark for the personal download content service using PBS?
question_73877.ground_truth: One additional remark for the personal download content service using PBS is that it allows for a good business opportunity for MBNOs, PBCPs, and PBSPs.

question_73878.question: What is the action taken by the UE when it fails to decode the BSIC of a GSM cell after two successive attempts during BSIC re-confirmation?
question_73878.ground_truth: If the UE fails to decode the BSIC after two successive attempts during BSIC re-confirmation, it shall abort the re-confirmation attempts for that GSM cell and treat it as a new GSM cell with an unidentified BSIC, moving it to the initial BSIC identification procedure.

question_73879.question: In the context of 3GPP Technical Specifications, what does "might" indicate?
question_73879.ground_truth: "Might" indicates a likelihood that something will happen as a result of action taken by some agency outside the scope of the document.

question_73880.question: What channels are used to broadcast packet data specific system information?

question_73881.question: In what scenario should the UE include the Requested MBS container IE in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message?
question_73881.ground_truth: The UE should include the Requested MBS container IE in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message if it wants to establish a new PDU session, perform handover of an existing PDU session from non-3GPP access to 3GPP access, transfer an existing PDN connection in the EPS to the 5GS, transfer an existing PDN connection in untrusted non-3GPP access connected to the EPC to the 5GS, or establish user plane resources over 3GPP access of an MA PDU session established over non-3GPP access only and it also intends to join one or more multicast MBS sessions that is associated to the PDU session.

question_73882.question: What is the main advantage of B2DA over homogeneous EDA allocation schemes in terms of sharing the uplink?
question_73882.ground_truth: B2DA can provide superior sharing of the uplink compared to homogeneous EDA allocation schemes, as it allocates uplink slots more efficiently.

question_73883.question: What is the purpose of the SIP 199 (Early Dialog Terminated) response code and under what circumstances is it sent by the AS-hA1 to the UE-A?
question_73883.ground_truth: The SIP 199 (Early Dialog Terminated) response code is sent by the AS-hA1 to the UE-A to terminate the early dialog between the two. It is used when the originating UE-A has indicated support for this response code and that there is no change of SDP.

question_73884.question: What should the UE do if the AMF includes rejected NSSAI in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message with the rejection cause "S-NSSAI temporarily not available in the current PLMN"?
question_73884.ground_truth: The UE shall add the rejected S-NSSAI(s) in the temporarily rejected NSSAI for the current PLMN and consider this S-NSSAI is temporarily not available in the current PLMN.

question_73885.question: What is the procedure followed for Content Delivery Termination when the IMS P2P CDS UE terminates the existing P2P session?
question_73885.ground_truth: The IMS P2P CDS UE first releases all the current P2P media connections and then notifies the Tracker AS to remove itself from all related Peer lists in Content Delivery Termination Procedure.

question_73886.question: What security features are included in the security requirements for the EDGE interfaces?
question_73886.ground_truth: Confidentiality, integrity, and replay protection are included in the security requirements for the EDGE interfaces.

question_73887.question: What should the MeNB assume if it does not receive the Secondary MeNB UL GTP Tunnel Endpoint at PDCP IE to the en-gNB in the SGNB MODIFICATION CONFIRM message, although the Secondary SgNB DL GTP Tunnel Endpoint at SCG IE was provided to the MeNB in the SGNB MODIFICATION REQUIRED message?
question_73887.ground_truth: The MeNB should assume the setup of the secondary X2-U bearer as being failed if it does not receive the Secondary MeNB UL GTP Tunnel Endpoint at PDCP IE to the en-gNB in the SGNB MODIFICATION CONFIRM message, although the Secondary SgNB DL GTP Tunnel Endpoint at SCG IE was provided to the MeNB in the SGNB MODIFICATION REQUIRED message.

question_73888.question: What is the unit of data collection for UE transactions dispersion and what is provided by the AMF?
question_73888.ground_truth: The unit of data collection for UE transactions dispersion is per UE and per transaction. The AMF provides the entry and exit time of a UE to a location for data analytics.

question_73889.question: When is a UE blocked from sending another ESM request for the same procedure for the same PLMN and APN combination?
question_73889.ground_truth: When the network includes a back-off timer value in an EPS session management reject message for the same procedure for the same PLMN and APN combination for the specified duration.

question_73890.question: What action does the AMF take if the UE is reachable but in a Non-Allowed Area, unless the request from the SMF is for regulatory prioritized service?
question_73890.ground_truth: The AMF rejects the request from the SMF and notifies the SMF that the UE is reachable only for regulatory prioritized service.

question_73892.question: What function provides the number of EES registration requests received by the ECS?
question_73892.ground_truth: 5.14.1.1 provides the number of EES registration requests received by the ECS.

question_73893.question: How does the ePDG set the DSCP value for downlink packets in Non-3GPP access?
question_73893.ground_truth: The ePDG sets the DSCP value for downlink packets by deriving it from the QCI, and optionally the ARP, of the S2b bearer via which the downlink packet was received.

question_73894.question: What is the difference between the first and second digits in the version number of 3GPP technical documents?
question_73894.ground_truth: The first digit represents the stage of development, with 0 indicating a draft, 1 indicating a TSG approved document under change control, and greater than 1 indicating a TSG approved document not under change control. The second digit is incremented for all changes of substance.

question_73895.question: What is the role of the Transport Layer Address in the 3GPP 5G specifications and what are the supported IP versions?
question_73895.ground_truth: The Transport Layer Address is a bit string of 32 bits in case of IPv4, 128 bits in case of IPv6, or 160 bits if both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses are signalled. The 3GPP 5G specifications support IPv6 and/or IPv4 for the NG interface.

question_73896.question: What is the frequency range of the high band target signal in the spectral flip and down mix module when the low band ACELP core codes up to a maximum bandwidth of 8 kHz?
question_73896.ground_truth: The high band target signal contains input signal components in the 8 -- 16 kHz band.

question_73898.question: What is the minimum latency required for the live video image to be transferred on additional monitors in the context of image guided surgery?
question_73898.ground_truth: The minimum latency required is compatible with collaborative activity on surgery, where the surgeon is operating based on the second monitor and the assistant is controlling the endoscope based on the primary monitor.

question_73899.question: What element must be included in the "restricted-match" when it contains transactions sent from the UE to the ProSe Function to report a matching of the restricted direct discovery model A or model B?
question_73899.ground_truth: A "RPAUID" element must be included in the "restricted-match" element.

question_73900.question: What should the MCData client include in the SIP 200 (OK) response if the Mandatory indication IE of the FD SIGNALLING PAYLOAD is set to "MANDATORY"?
question_73900.ground_truth: The MCData client should include the option tag "timer" in a Require header field, start the SIP session timer, include the g.3gpp.mcdata.fd media feature tag in the Contact header field, and include the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag containing the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcdata.fd" in the Contact header field of the SIP 200 (OK) response.

question_73901.question: In the context of temporary identities, what are the restrictions on the values that can be used to code the temporary identity username?
question_73901.ground_truth: The temporary identity username shall not be a null string and shall not be coded with the reserved hexadecimal value FF.

question_73902.question: How should the file name be constructed for a measurement result file that contains results for multiple NEs, multiple granularity periods, and is the third file for this domain/granularity period combination?
question_73902.ground_truth: The file name for a measurement result file that contains results for multiple NEs, multiple granularity periods, and is the third file for this domain/granularity period combination, should be constructed in the format "D<Startdate>.<Starttime>-<Enddate>.<Endtime>_<DomainId>_-_3".

question_73903.question: What is the impact of the cancellation of an ad hoc emergency alert?
question_73903.ground_truth: The MC service server sends an ad hoc group emergency alert cancel notification to the MC service server in the partner MC system, and the ad hoc group associated with the emergency alert will be updated accordingly.

question_73906.question: What does the Relay UE need to support related to authorization in Solution #30?
question_73906.ground_truth: The Relay UE needs to support procedures for authorization in Solution #30.

question_73909.question: What action should an SGM-C take upon receiving a CoAP 2.02 (Deleted) response when sending a CoAP DELETE request to the SGM-S?
question_73909.ground_truth: The SGM-C should notify the VAL user about successful group deregistration.

question_73911.question: What is the time dilated solution applied for in Carrier Aggregation scenarios?
question_73911.ground_truth: The time dilated solution is applied for improving the latency and throughput performance in Carrier Aggregation scenarios.

question_73913.question: What is used for file-based and DASH-based delivery in 3GPP VR services?
question_73913.ground_truth: The content may be made available using file-based delivery or DASH-based delivery, potentially with 3GPP services such as DASH in PSS or DASH-over-MBMS.

question_73914.question: What is the key difference between the uplink of a carrier being supplemented and the supplementary uplink in terms of UE scheduling?
question_73914.ground_truth: In the uplink of a carrier being supplemented, the UE may be scheduled to transmit on either the primary uplink or the uplink of the carrier being supplemented, whereas on the supplementary uplink, the UE may only transmit when specifically scheduled by the gNB.

question_73915.question: What is the purpose of service management functionality in the 3GPP management system for customer service requests?
question_73915.ground_truth: The operator uses the service management functionality in the 3GPP management system for providing types of services to the customers with their own end user/device population and for supporting service provision automation.

question_73916.question: What is the delay between RRC message processing and first SSB transmission for QCL-TypeD, denoted as Tfirst-SSB?
question_73916.ground_truth: Tfirst-SSB is the time to first SSB transmission after L1-RSRP measurement when TCI state switching involves QCL-TypeD, and it is the time to first SSB transmission after RRC processing time at the UE for other QCL types.

question_73917.question: In step 14, what is the action taken by the SS after the RRC connection release, if any of the specified conditions in steps 6, 8, 9 are not met?
question_73917.ground_truth: The SS transmits a RRCConnectionRelease message to release the RRC connection, which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources.

question_73918.question: What does the shared risk principle refer to in the context of test tolerances?
question_73918.ground_truth: The shared risk principle is a method of comparison, where measurement results are compared against test limits which are the original limits plus the test tolerances.

question_73919.question: What is the procedure for a chat group call setup in the MCPTT system?
question_73919.ground_truth: The procedure involves sending a group join request with the MCPTT group ID of the desired group, verifying authorization, forwards the group join request to the partner MCPTT server, generating an implicit affiliation if necessary, verifying authorization, replying with a group join response, storing the affiliation status of the user, forwarding the group join response to the MCPTT client, and using floor control during the call.

question_73922.question: What is the maximum number of LADNs that can be included in the LADN information IE, and what is the minimum and maximum length of this information element?
question_73922.ground_truth: The LADN information IE can contain a maximum of 8 different LADNs, each including a DNN and a tracking area identity lists. The minimum length of this information element is 13 octets, and the maximum length is 15602 octets.

question_73925.question: How is the UE transmit intermodulation requirement defined in proposal 1?
question_73925.ground_truth: The UE transmit intermodulation attenuation is defined as a ratio of the sum of the filtered mean powers centred on the assigned channel frequencies and the filtered mean power centred on a frequency of intermodulation product of the sub block being tested.

question_73927.question: What is the purpose of using access tokens in MCPTT user authorization?
question_73927.ground_truth: The access tokens obtained during user authentication are used to gain MCPTT services for the user, as defined in clause 5.6.

question_73928.question: What is the mandatory requirement for Instance IDs if the UE supports GRUU or multiple registrations?
question_73928.ground_truth: If the UE supports GRUU or multiple registrations, then it shall have an Instance ID in conformance with the mandatory requirements for Instance IDs specified in RFC 5627 and RFC 5626.

question_73929.question: What enhancements are required for PC5 as part of the Rel-13 work item eProSe-Ext?
question_73929.ground_truth: The enhancements required for PC5 as part of the Rel-13 work item eProSe-Ext include relay discovery and one-to-one communication, including PC5-level mutual authentication between the Remote UE and the Relay UE, as well as IP address assignment.

question_73930.question: What is the procedure for measuring the transmitter output power in 13.3.4.2.2?
question_73930.ground_truth: The procedure involves taking received transmitter output power measurements at maximum power for ARFCN in the Low, Mid, and High range with the MS rotated by n*45~degrees for all values of n in the range 0 to 7. The measurements are then scaled to actual transmitter output powers for all measured power control levels and ARFCN.

question_73933.question: What kind of service continuity requirement does the 5G system need to meet when changing the IP address and IP anchoring point for some or all connections associated with a UE?
question_73933.ground_truth: The 5G system should minimize the impact to the user experience, specifically by minimizing interruption time when changing the IP address and IP anchoring point.

question_73934.question: What is the procedure when the GPI corresponds to an incomplete NAF SA?
question_73934.ground_truth: The Ks indicated by GPI is activated, and the processing continues from step 7 as described.

question_73935.question: What are the four use case groups identified by SA1 for advanced V2X services?
question_73935.ground_truth: The four use case groups for advanced V2X services are Vehicles Platooning, Extended Sensors, Advanced Driving, and Remote Driving.

question_73936.question: What happens when the CSE has concluded performing charging activities in the successful short message delivery procedure?
question_73936.ground_truth: Once the CSE has concluded performing charging activities, it shall issue the instruction to continue the processing.

question_73937.question: What is the effect of an IPv6 Home Network Prefix release in the LMA Initiated PDN Connection Deletion Procedure?
question_73937.ground_truth: When the UE's PDN connection is deactivated, the LMA returns the IPv6 Home Network Prefix assigned to the UE's PDN connection to the pool of free IPv6 Home Network Prefixes.

question_73938.question: Which information element in HandoverCancel message is mandatory and indicates the cause of handover cancellation?

question_73939.question: Which subclause of 3GPP TS 04.08 and 3GPP TS 24.008 specifies the requirements for the mobile station to leave the eCALL INACTIVE state?

question_73940.question: What are the supported audio and video codecs for 3G-324M terminals?
question_73940.ground_truth: 3G-324M terminals offering audio communication shall support the AMR audio codec and H.263 for video communication. Support for MPEG-4 simple profile, H.261 and G.723.1 is optional.

question_73943.question: What is the role of an Anchor SMF (A-SMF) as defined in the Definitions section?
question_73943.ground_truth: The A-SMF is the SMF serving the PDU Session when a single SMF is used as defined for non-roaming and LBO scenarios in Rel-15. A PDU Session always involves an A-SMF, and an A-SMF is never changed for a PDU Session.

question_73944.question: What should the AMF do when a CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message has a Payload container type IE set to "CIoT user data container"?
question_73944.ground_truth: The AMF shall look up a PDU session routing context for the UE and the PDU session ID, and forward the content of the Payload container IE to the SMF associated with the UE. If the corresponding PDU session is a PDU session for LADN, the AMF determines the UE presence in LADN service area (see subclause 6.2.6) and forwards the UE presence in LADN service area towards the SMF.

question_73947.question: What must the MCPTT user on MCPTT client 1 do in order to initiate an MCPTT emergency private call?
question_73947.ground_truth: The MCPTT user on MCPTT client 1 must initiate an MCPTT emergency private call and set the MCPTT emergency state. The MCPTT emergency state is retained until explicitly cancelled.

question_73948.question: Which bits in the Time and Timezone parameter indicate the most significant and least significant month digits?
question_73948.ground_truth: The most significant month digit occupies bits 0-3 of the third octet, and the least significant month digit occupies bits 4-7 of the third octet.

question_73949.question: What is the name of the procedure defined in clause~4.13, which defines the additional procedures or additions to existing procedures to support specific services such as SMS over NAS in clause~4.13.2.1?
question_73949.ground_truth: The procedure is referred to as Application Triggering.

question_73951.question: What message is sent by the UE upon MM connection establishment for a basic call?

question_73952.question: What is the name of the document that provides requirements for TSN in 5G Systems, TSN-AF integration, and AF support for non-TSN services?

question_73954.question: What should the MS do when a DETACH REQUEST message is received by the MS while waiting for an ATTACH ACCEPT message or ATTACH REJECT message, as per 44.2.1.2.9.1?
question_73954.ground_truth: When the Detach type is 're-attach not required', the MS shall terminate the combined GPRS attach procedure and continue with the combined GPRS detach procedure. When the Detach type is 're-attach required', the MS shall ignore the combined GPRS detach procedure and continue with the combined GPRS attach.

question_73955.question: What information can the SMF provide to the UE in the N1 SM container if per QoS-flow Non-3GPP QoS Assistance Information is required based on the S-NSSAI and DNN for PIN?
question_73955.ground_truth: The SMF can provide per QoS-flow Non-3GPP QoS Assistance Information to the UE in the N1 SM container, if required based on the S-NSSAI and DNN for PIN.

question_73956.question: Which 3GPP channel model is a geometry-based stochastic channel model that reproduces the stochastic properties of MIMO channels over time, frequency, and space?

question_73957.question: What are the four solutions for out-of-order PUSCH scheduling when the UE always processes the second scheduled PUSCH?
question_73957.ground_truth: The four solutions are: (1) the UE processes the second scheduled PUSCH and may or may not drop the processing of the first scheduled PUSCH, (2) both PUSCHs can be processed as a UE capability with no condition, (3) both PUSCHs can be processed under some conditions, and (4) the UE drops the first scheduled PUSCH.

question_73959.question: How is a secured connection established between MSGin5G Server 1 and MSGin5G Server 2 in different PLMNs?
question_73959.ground_truth: MSGin5G Server 1 and MSGin5G Server 2 have established a secured connection, although the procedure for securing the connection is not specified in the document.

question_73960.question: What is the effect of applying different CPC settings on the interference level caused by DPCCH bursts?
question_73960.ground_truth: Different CPC settings result in different interference levels created by the DPCCH bursts. For instance, 100 users activated on a secondary carrier amount to an average of just 1.25 continuous DPCCH for one evaluated setting.

question_73961.question: What is a major requirement for mobile network operators (MNOs) or industry verticals regarding network slice communication?
question_73961.ground_truth: Providing secure inter- and intra- network slice communication and secure internet access are major requirements for mobile network operators (MNOs) or industry verticals regarding network slice communication.

question_73962.question: What is the worst case Doppler shift for LEO in S band and Ka band for NTN systems?
question_73962.ground_truth: The worst case Doppler shift for LEO in S band (2 GHz) is up to +/- 48 kHz in downlink for the whole satellite coverage and for LEO in Ka band (20 GHz) is up to +/- 480 kHz in downlink for the whole satellite coverage.

question_73963.question: What is the 5% DL Average-UPT gain for semi-static SBFD at low load level with SBFD Alt 4 and large packet size?
question_73963.ground_truth: The 5% DL Average-UPT gain for semi-static SBFD at low load level with SBFD Alt 4 and large packet size is 0%.

question_73965.question: What is the test procedure for the test case 26.7.4.5.4.6 ?
question_73965.ground_truth: The test procedure for the test case 26.7.4.5.4.6 is to verify that the MS only selects the highest priority network available from those of the same country as the serving PLMN when registered on a VPLMN of a country different to it's HPLMN and does not take into account PLMNs, including the HPLMN, which are included in the Equivalent PLMN list.

question_73966.question: In which of the following situations should the PDCP entity use the reordering function when receiving a PDCP PDU from lower layers, for SLRBs mapped on RLC UM?
question_73966.ground_truth: When the PDCP entity receives a PDCP SN which is not "0".

question_73967.question: What action should the IWF take when it receives a SIP 302 (Moved Temporarily) response to the SIP INVITE request?
question_73967.ground_truth: The IWF shall generate a SIP INVITE request and send it to the new location specified in the SIP 302 response.

question_73969.question: How does the ePWS proposal aim to improve warning notifications for UEs with no user interface?
question_73969.ground_truth: The ePWS proposal specifies that a Warning Notification shall be capable of supporting the inclusion of information that enables UEs with no user interface to identify a warning message. It depends on UE implementation when such a UE receives a Warning Notification.

question_73970.question: What is the role of the EAP-Initiate/Re-auth and EAP-Finish/Re-auth messages in the EAP re-authentication procedure for inter-TNGF mobility?
question_73970.ground_truth: The EAP-Initiate/Re-auth message is used to initiate the EAP re-authentication procedure, while the EAP-Finish/Re-auth message is used to complete it. These messages are verified using the re-authentication integrity keys to ensure secure communication.

question_73974.question: What is the function of Detection Points (DPs) in CAMEL as defined in subclause 6.2.1?
question_73974.ground_truth: DPs are points in association where GPRS events may be made visible to the gsmSCF. They are used to detect GPRS events, such as the start or end of a GPRS session or PDP context, and to allow the gsmSCF to influence subsequent handling of the GPRS session or PDP context.

question_73975.question: What is the purpose of the test in step a) of the procedure?
question_73975.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in step a) of the procedure is to verify that the MS accurately indicates every block transmitted by the SS with incorrect BCS as not acknowledged in the Packet Downlink Ack/Nack message.

question_73976.question: What kind of information is not useful for download delivery services that transport DASH segments?
question_73976.ground_truth: File schedule information, which includes a file URI and a list of broadcast delivery start and end times, is not useful for download delivery services that transport DASH segments.

question_73977.question: What does the convergence of user data imply in the 3GPP system?
question_73977.ground_truth: The convergence of user data implies the support of user data provisioning, which includes user data manipulation like creation, deletion, reading, modification and other operations.

question_73979.question: What are the two main purposes of location information in emergency services?
question_73979.ground_truth: The initial purpose of the location information is to enable the IMS network to determine which PSAP serves the area where the UE is currently located, so that the IMS network can route the emergency session to the correct PSAP. The second purpose is for the PSAP to get more accurate or updated location information for the terminal during or after the emergency session where required by local regulation.

question_73980.question: What is one benefit of using the device trigger delivery service in MTC?
question_73980.ground_truth: One benefit of using the device trigger delivery service in MTC is that it allows for many different sets of trigger delivery services to be utilized across MNOs without impacting the MTC server on the device trigger request submission functionality.

question_73981.question: When does the UE initiate the establishment of the PDU Session for the LADN?
question_73981.ground_truth: The UE initiates the PDU Session for the LADN when it detects that it moves into the LADN Service Area.

question_73983.question: What is the relevance of XML complex type and XML element type, as defined in the document?
question_73983.ground_truth: XML complex type and XML element type are used in XML schemas to define structure and content constraints for XML documents, and can be used together by a single XML document.

question_73984.question: What information is included in the information that may be transferred from the UE to Network in the UE-assisted mode of Barometric Pressure positioning method?
question_73984.ground_truth: In UE-assisted mode, the UE reports the Barometric Pressure measurements together with associated quality estimates. These measurements enable the Network to calculate the vertical location of the UE, possibly using other measurements and data.

question_73985.question: What is the data type of <OSid> in 7.39 Application Start and Stop indication for applications other than MMTEL and SMSoverIP +CACDC?
question_73985.ground_truth: The data type of <OSid> is an operating system identifier.

question_73987.question: In the context of 3GPP TS 24.341, what is used to encode the short message in the body of the SIP MESSAGE request?
question_73987.ground_truth: The content transfer encoding of type "binary" is used for the encoding of the SM in the body of the SIP MESSAGE request.

question_73988.question: Which protocol does the 4.40 IRATHO related measurements belong to?
question_73988.ground_truth: The 4.40 IRATHO related measurements belong to the inter-RAT handover procedures.

question_73989.question: How does the BSS-2 handle UL user plane data during a handover when the UE-1 is still being served by the BSS-1?
question_73989.ground_truth: The BSS-2 bi-casts the UL user plane data to both MGW2 and the local path, and the MGW-2 transmits the data to the MGW-1, which then sends it to the target RNC.

question_73991.question: What action is taken for each QoS flow that needs to be released in 5.8.2.3.1?
question_73991.ground_truth: Each QoS flow requested to release increments the relevant subcounter per 5QI and the relevant subcounter per S-NSSAI by 1 respectively.

question_73992.question: What controls the maximum data rate of a GBR QoS Flow?
question_73992.ground_truth: Authorized MBR value of the associated PCC rule

question_73993.question: What is the purpose of the Supplementary Service invocation notification (SS-CSI) data?
question_73993.ground_truth: The SS-CSI data is used to notify the gsmSCF about Supplementary Service invocation and consists of a notification criterion and gsmSCF address.

question_73994.question: What information does the "5G ProSe Authorized" IE provide regarding a UE's authorization status for using 5G ProSe services?
question_73994.ground_truth: The "5G ProSe Authorized" IE indicates whether the UE is authorized to use 5G ProSe services.

question_73995.question: What is the initial condition required for executing the CLOSE CHANNEL command?
question_73995.ground_truth: The initial condition required for executing the CLOSE CHANNEL command is that the ME is connected to the USIM Simulator and the USS, and the elementary files are coded as Toolkit default. Prior to this test, the ME should have been powered on and performed the PROFILE DOWNLOAD procedure.

question_73996.question: What is the maximum duration of the test for GSM850, GSM900, DCS1800, and PCS1900 in minutes?
question_73996.ground_truth: The maximum duration of the test is 19 minutes for all four frequency ranges.

question_73997.question: How does the ProSe UE-to-Network Relay relay the traffic in the uplink direction for a UE that connects to the relay and the network?
question_73997.ground_truth: The UE sends the packet to UE-R using a ProSe bearer, then UE-R forwards the uplink packet via a PDN connection towards the PGW. The UE-R selects the uplink EPS bearers based on the uplink TFTs received from the PGW.

question_73998.question: What parameters are used to provide 5G VN group-MBR information from AF to NEF or UDM?
question_73998.ground_truth: 5G VN group-MBR is provided to NEF as a parameter of 5G VN group data information and to UDM in the same way.

question_73999.question: What should the MS do after receiving a DTM ASSIGNMENT COMMAND message from the SS in the context of intracell change of channel for reallocation of resources while in DTM?
question_73999.ground_truth: The MS initiates a local end release of link layer connections, disconnects the physical channels, commands the switching to the assigned channel, and initiates the establishment of lower layer connection including the activation of the channel and the establishment of the main signalling link.

question_74001.question: What parameter is sent by the AF to the NEF and UDM for 5G VN group information through Nnef_ParameterProvision_Create and Nudm_ParameterProvision_Create?
question_74001.ground_truth: 5G VN group information (GPSI, DNN, S-NSSAI and 5G VN group service area)

question_74004.question: What should the S-CSCF do upon receiving SM9, which includes the cause of authentication failure, if the IMPU is currently Not registered?
question_74004.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should clear the S-CSCF name in the HSS by sending a Cx-Put to the HSS in CM3, and not update the registration flag.

question_74005.question: What conditions must be satisfied for the MDCT coefficients to be predicted using the MDCT core in the case of high bit rate core?
question_74005.ground_truth: In the case of high bit rate core, the MDCT coefficients of the upper band are predicted using the 20 decoded highest frequency coefficients for transient mode and using the 2 decoded highest frequency envelopes for non-transient mode. The normalized coefficients are predicted by random noise or by weighting the random noise and the decoded low frequency coefficients.

question_74007.question: What is the definition of the directional response for scene-based audio?
question_74007.ground_truth: The directional response for scene-based audio is the transfer function between a device under test and a loudspeaker located at an equal distance and a set of predefined directions.

question_74008.question: Which PR explicitly mentions the 5G System's ability to support the combination of 3GPP positioning technologies with non-3GPP positioning technologies for better performance?
question_74008.ground_truth: PR-006 explicitly mentions the 5G System's ability to support the combination of 3GPP positioning technologies with non-3GPP positioning technologies for better performance.

question_74009.question: What is the purpose of the secondary authentication for PDU session authorization?
question_74009.ground_truth: The secondary authentication is used for PDU session authorization to access an EHE in the VPLMN. It is reused for both LBO and HR PDU session scenarios.

question_74010.question: How is an XML element defined and represented in the AAM IRP XML file format definition?
question_74010.ground_truth: An XML element is a constituent of an XML document; it has a type, is identified by a name, has a set of XML attribute specifications (if any), and may contain other XML elements or be composed of tags.

question_74011.question: What is the purpose of HSCSD in GERAN Iu mode as per the document?
question_74011.ground_truth: HSCSD in GERAN Iu mode provides the ability to use one bearer to provide all necessary data rates. The multislot mechanism is not necessary in this mode, but certain information must be provided by the mobile station during the service negotiation for inter-system handover to GERAN.

question_74012.question: Which network elements use the TMSI mechanism and which use EAP mechanisms in the SAE network?
question_74012.ground_truth: The TMSI mechanism is used by the serving network element while EAP mechanisms are used by the home network element.

question_74013.question: What is the purpose of emulating typical radio conditions in test channels?
question_74013.ground_truth: The purpose of emulating typical radio conditions in test channels is to permit emulation of typical radio conditions in terms of delays and losses.

question_74015.question: What should the User Equipment (UE) do if it receives a 401 (Unauthorized) response to its REGISTER request?
question_74015.ground_truth: The UE should extract the RAND and AUTN parameters, check the validity of the authentication challenge, and calculate the RES parameter to derive the CK and IK keys for setting up a temporary set of security associations for the registration.

question_74017.question: What is the interface used by the gsmSCF to request information from the HLR in the CAMEL architecture?

question_74018.question: What is the impact of using EAP-AKA in terms of the number of core network messages for authentication?
question_74018.ground_truth: EAP-AKA is likely to require more messages across LTE for authentication compared to UMTS AKA NAS due to the need for security-related procedures.

question_74020.question: What is the meaning of the term "E-UTRA" in the test description 6.2.2.2.3?
question_74020.ground_truth: E-UTRA stands for Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access, which is the radio interface for the Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access Network, commonly known as 4G LTE.

question_74023.question: Which test applicability applies to the general spurious emissions test for the E-UTRA component supporting inter-band EN-DC including FR2 with 5 NR UL CCs?
question_74023.ground_truth: The same minimum conformance requirements as in clause 6.5.3.3 for the NR carrier are applied to the E-UTRA component supporting inter-band EN-DC including FR2 with 5 NR UL CCs. No exception requirements are applicable to NR or E-UTRA. The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.101-3 clause 6.4B.3.4.

question_74024.question: What is the action taken when the data link layer entity receives a supervisory frame with the P/F bit set to "0" while in an own receiver busy condition?
question_74024.ground_truth: The received supervisory frames with the P/F bit set to "0" shall be processed, and an RNR response frame with the F bit set to "1" shall be transmitted.

question_74025.question: What are the two cases when a controller UE loses collaborative session control?
question_74025.ground_truth: The two cases are when a successive controller UE is selected or criteria on how to select the successive Controller UE is provided.

question_74027.question: What is the OTA RX spurious emissions requirement for BS type 1-O operating in TDD?
question_74027.ground_truth: The OTA RX spurious emissions requirement for BS type 1-O operating in TDD applies during the transmitter OFF period only.

question_74028.question: What are the procedures for providing 3G-H.324/M calls over 3,1kHz audio in the 3GPP TS 27 series?
question_74028.ground_truth: In case of 3G-H.324/M calls over 3.1kHz audio, the IWF shall provide the V.34 modem modulation and the V.8 procedure with the indication of H.324 support in the call function category of the V.8 handshaking. The performance of V.8bis by the modem function is FFS.

question_74029.question: What does the PDN GW do after receiving the Create Session Request message from the Serving GW in step 9?
question_74029.ground_truth: After receiving the Create Session Request message from the Serving GW in step 9, the PDN GW may execute a PCEF-Initiated IP CAN Session Modification Procedure with the PCRF.

question_74030.question: How is the 5GS Tracking Area Identity (TAI) FQDN constructed?
question_74030.ground_truth: The 5GS TAI FQDN is constructed using the TAC, MCC, and MNC. It identifies a specific tracking area within the 5GS network and is used for mobility management.

question_74032.question: What should a UE do to handle forking in SIP messages as required by RFC 3261?
question_74032.ground_truth: A UE can accept or reject any of the forked responses, for example, if the UE is capable of supporting a limited number of simultaneous transactions or early dialogs.

question_74034.question: What is the difference between the simple streaming service and the enhanced streaming service in the 3GPP PSS?
question_74034.ground_truth: The simple streaming service in the 3GPP PSS is defined in Release 4 and includes a basic set of streaming features. The enhanced streaming service in the 3GPP PSS is introduced in Release 5 and may include more advanced service features, such as capability exchange, in a fully backwards compatible manner.

question_74036.question: What is provided by the CSP in case of cell database information reporting?
question_74036.ground_truth: The CSP may provide CSI, which includes cell site information and cell radio-related information, asynchronously in a stand-alone CSR (Cell Site Report) IRI message or in the IRI message itself, when a cell identity is provided in an IRI message for the target's location.

question_74037.question: What is the allowed time span for potential interruptions on PCell during DL BWP switching on SCell1 and SCell2?
question_74037.ground_truth: Potential interruptions of PCell due to DL BWP switching on SCell1 and SCell2 are carried out within the correct time span, and are within the correct length, by monitoring ACK/NACKs sent in PCell for PCell.

question_74038.question: What should the ME do if it receives a SEND SS command with an alpha identifier that is not a null data object?
question_74038.ground_truth: The ME should use the alpha identifier to inform the user, and not give any other information about the SS request.

question_74040.question: What is the role of the BM-SC (Broadcast-Multicast - Service Centre) in the context of DASH over MBMS?
question_74040.ground_truth: The BM-SC is responsible for the FLUTE-based download delivery of DASH content in the DASH over MBMS architecture.

question_74041.question: What is the significance of 5G Media Streaming Architecture in downlink and uplink media streaming?
question_74041.ground_truth: 5G Media Streaming Architecture is used for both unicast downlink and unicast uplink media streaming. It specifies the format and protocol for media streaming services between the UE and the Media Application Server.

question_74042.question: What does the CDIV service allow the diverting user to do?
question_74042.ground_truth: The CDIV service allows the diverting user to divert communications addressed to them to another destination.

question_74044.question: What is the difference in DL Average-UPT between the case with no DL power adjustment and the case with DL power adjustment (3 dB power back off) in FR1 2-layer Scenario B based on Source 1?
question_74044.ground_truth: With a large packet size, the DL power adjustment results in a higher or similar mean and 5% DL Average-UPT for all load levels compared to the case with no DL power adjustment.

question_74045.question: What is the result of the general result field for the POWER ON CARD command in the initial conditions?

question_74046.question: What must the UICC respond with to indicate successful processing of a TERMINAL RESPONSE for a proactive command in 6.8.8?
question_74046.ground_truth: The UICC must respond with '90 00', '6F XX', '62 XX' or '63 XX' to indicate successful processing.

question_74047.question: What should the UE (MCPTT Client) do upon receiving a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message with the Confirm mode indication present, while being in an off-network environment and user acknowledgement is not required?
question_74047.ground_truth: The UE (MCPTT Client) should enter the "S3: part of ongoing call" state and send a GROUP CALL ACCEPT message.

question_74050.question: What is the trigger for increasing the number of successful tests in the test procedure?
question_74050.ground_truth: If the SS detects uplink power in NR carrier for CSI transmission, does not detect PUCCH with LRR before time point B, and detects PUCCH with LRR and BFR MAC CE before time point F, the number of successful tests is increased by one.

question_74052.question: What additional information does the source eNB include in the HANDOVER REQUEST, if it proposes to do forwarding of downlink data for each E-RAB?
question_74052.ground_truth: For each E-RAB, the source eNB includes the DL Forwarding IE within the E-RABs To be Setup Item IE of the HANDOVER REQUEST message, and the DL GTP Tunnel Endpoint IE within the E-RABs Admitted Item IE of the HANDOVER REQUEST ACKNOWLEDGE message.

question_74053.question: When does the implicit downlink TBF release timer on the network side expire?
question_74053.ground_truth: The implicit downlink TBF release timer on the network side expires when the network transmits a new DL data radio block or the mobile station receives a new data radio block during the delayed DL TBF release mode.

question_74055.question: In the RNC centric mode, what action should the SAS take when a UE positioning attempt fails due to inaccurate or insufficient position measurements and related data?
question_74055.ground_truth: The SAS may return a PCAP Position Calculation Response message over the Iupc interface containing a less accurate position estimate. If a less accurate estimate is not available or will not meet the accuracy requirement, the SAS may instead return a PCAP Position Calculation Failure message containing no position estimate and indicating the cause of failure.

question_74056.question: What are the main differences between Scenario E and the Initial Attach IMS-based scenario?
question_74056.ground_truth: In Scenario E, the APN is different from the IMS well-known APN and the Default EPS Bearer QoS may have a QCI value different from 5. Additionally, dedicated bearers may be established.

question_74059.question: What should the network do if the SETUP message contains no bearer capability IE?
question_74059.ground_truth: The network should perform compatibility checking of the CALL CONFIRMED message in the same way as the compatibility checking of the SETUP message in the mobile originating call case.

question_74061.question: What is the purpose of the "tdialog" option tag in a SIP INVITE request?
question_74061.ground_truth: The "tdialog" option tag in a SIP INVITE request indicates that the support for Target-Dialog header field is required.

question_74062.question: What is the penalty in dB that can be expected when using Dual Strip TRX (DSR) compared to a single TRX solution?
question_74062.ground_truth: A loss of at least 2 dB.

question_74063.question: What types of frame transfer are supported by the LAPDm protocol?
question_74063.ground_truth: The LAPDm protocol supports unacknowledged information transfer and multiple frame acknowledged information transfer.

question_74064.question: What is the requirement for the battery life of the PWS-UE regarding PWS?
question_74064.ground_truth: The battery life of the PWS-UE shall not be significantly reduced by PWS.

question_74065.question: What should the SMF do when the UE becomes reachable after performing extended buffering for a PDU session?
question_74065.ground_truth: The SMF should send the buffered data to the UPF and establish the User Plane(s) for the PDU Sessions, or deliver the buffered data to the UE as per the 4.24.2 procedure of Control Plane CIoT 5GS Optimisation.

question_74069.question: In what sub-state of the GMM-REGISTERED state are the lower layers prevented from sending user data or signalling information?
question_74069.ground_truth: In the GMM-REGISTERED.SUSPENDED sub-state, the lower layers are prevented from sending user data or signalling information.

question_74070.question: What is a tariff period in the context of MBMS?
question_74070.ground_truth: A tariff period is a part of one (calendar) day during which a particular tariff is applied, defined by the time at which the period begins (the switch-over time) and the tariff to be applied after switch-over.

question_74071.question: What is the meaning of "shall" in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_74071.ground_truth: In the 3GPP technical specification, "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

question_74073.question: What happens to the decoder state and data if the IGF all-Zero flag is set to 1 in the noiseless decoding of the IGF scale factor vector?
question_74073.ground_truth: In this case, the decoder state is reset and no further data is read from the bit stream, because the decoded scale factors are all set to zero.

question_74075.question: In step 11a, what condition must be met for the SS to count a success for the event "Deactivation"?
question_74075.ground_truth: The last CSI report for SCell1 must be received by the SS earlier than or equal to subframe (n+8), and DTX must not be observed by the SS anywhere outside the specified subframes during T3.

question_74076.question: What is the purpose of Maximum Number of Reports and Maximum Duration of Reporting parameters?
question_74076.ground_truth: Maximum Number of Reports and Maximum Duration of Reporting limit the duration for which events are reported, either to a certain number of reports or a specific time period.

question_74077.question: What file formats do the encoder and decoder programs use and how do the speech files read by the encoder and written by the decoder differ from each other?
question_74077.ground_truth: The speech files read by the encoder and written by the decoder consist of 16-bit words where each word contains a 14-bit, left aligned speech sample. The byte order depends on the host architecture. However, the encoder will only process n frames if the length of the input file is n*320 + k words, while the files produced by the decoder will always have a length of n*320 words.

question_74078.question: When is the version number incremented in the 3GPP documentation system?
question_74078.ground_truth: The second digit is incremented for all changes of substance, and the third digit is incremented when only editorial changes have been made.

question_74079.question: What should be studied for FR1 and FR2 scenarios and services in the NR coverage enhancements study item?
question_74079.ground_truth: The target scenarios and services for FR1 include urban (outdoor gNB serving indoor UEs) scenario, rural scenario (including extreme long distance rural scenario), TDD and FDD. For FR2, the targets are indoor scenario (indoor gNB serving indoor UEs), urban/suburban scenario (including outdoor gNB serving outdoor UEs and outdoor gNB serving indoor UEs), and eMBB service as first priority and VoIP as second priority. LPWA services and scenarios are not included.

question_74081.question: What are the two primary methods for the NRM server to obtain location information of a VAL UE during inter-system switching in the described scenarios?
question_74081.ground_truth: The two primary methods for the NRM server to obtain location information of a VAL UE are through a location management client triggered by RAT change, and through notifications provided from the network to the NRM server related to 5GS supporting EPS interworking.

question_74082.question: What is the condition for using a Test System with a measurement uncertainty greater than that specified in clause 4.1.2?
question_74082.ground_truth: If the Test System for a test is known to have a measurement uncertainty greater than that specified in clause 4.1.2, it is still permitted to use this apparatus, provided that an adjustment is made to tighten the test requirement, making the test harder to pass.

question_74085.question: In the 5G NSWO use case, what is the format of the NAI for an anonymous SUCI?
question_74085.ground_truth: The NAI format for an anonymous SUCI is either: type1.rid678.schid0.useridanonymous@5gc-nswo.nid<NID>.mnc015.mcc234.3gppnetwork.org or type1.rid678.schid0.userid@5gc-nswo.nid<NID>.mnc015.mcc234.3gppnetwork.org

question_74087.question: What is the role of the MME in delivering SMS over NAS without impacting MSC's?
question_74087.ground_truth: The MME needs to be able to accept or reject the SMS registration at EPS attach time, and indicate whether it supports as an alternative SMSoSGs. Additionally, an interface needs to be defined between the MME and the SMS-GMSC/SMS-IWMC for SMS delivery. The MME also needs to indicate to the network that the UE supports Native SMS Capability on E-UTRAN and that it intends to register for that in both EPS Attach and TAU procedures, as a combined registration is needed to achieve SMS delivery over E-UTRAN.

question_74088.question: What is the role of the non-3GPP delay in the communication between PIN and PEGC via 5GC?
question_74088.ground_truth: The non-3GPP delay is the delay between the PEGC and the PINE, and 5GC may need to compensate for this delay in 5GS.

question_74089.question: What is a precondition for MCPTT UE registration?
question_74089.ground_truth: A precondition for MCPTT UE registration is that the UE is authorized for MCPTT service.

question_74090.question: In the context of EC-GSM, what happens when the synchronization to the serving cell is successful but the access attempt to the network fails for a given coverage class?
question_74090.ground_truth: If the synchronization to the serving cell is successful but the access attempt to the network fails for a given coverage class, the coverage class may be increased by 1 until a successful access attempt is experienced or neighbor cell measurements can be triggered, potentially resulting in cell reselection.

question_74091.question: What is the purpose of a Registration Request with an emergency registration type in the 5G system?
question_74091.ground_truth: It is used to request an emergency registration for packet switched traffic in the 5G system.

question_74092.question: What is the result of the CALL CONTROL BY SIM command in the 4.3 case?
question_74092.ground_truth: The CALL CONTROL BY SIM command in the 4.3 case results in "Allowed with modifications".

question_74093.question: What is the purpose of the MCPTT server in step 4 of the private call procedure?
question_74093.ground_truth: The MCPTT server confirms that both MCPTT users are authorized for the private call, verifies the functional alias if present, checks the commencement mode setting of the called MCPTT client, and checks whether the MCPTT user at MCPTT client 1 is authorized to initiate the call in manual commencement mode.

question_74094.question: What is the method used to measure the Block Error Rate (BLER) of HS-PDSCH received from the UE at the SS in the testing described in 6.5FA.4.2 or 6.5G.4.2?
question_74094.ground_truth: The BLER is measured by counting the number of NACK, ACK and statDTX on the UL HS-DPCCH and dividing the sum of NACK and statDTX by the sum of NACK, statDTX and ACK.

question_74095.question: In what way is the "phone-context" tel URI parameter constructed when the IP-CAN is EPS?
question_74095.ground_truth: The "phone-context" tel URI parameter is constructed from the MCC, the MNC and the home network domain name by concatenating the MCC, MNC, and the string "eps" as domain labels before the home network domain name.

question_74096.question: What information should be included in the "o=" field of the session-level section in the SDP body for a private call?
question_74096.ground_truth: The "o=" field should include the username portion set to a dash.

question_74097.question: What must the NG-RAN broadcast during a Disaster Condition to notify UEs of accessibility for Disaster Roaming service?
question_74097.ground_truth: The NG-RAN broadcasts an indication of accessibility for Disaster Roaming service and a list of one or more PLMN(s) with Disaster Condition for which Disaster Roaming service is offered by the available PLMN.

question_74100.question: In which scenarios is the high-loss model applicable?
question_74100.ground_truth: The high-loss model is applicable to UMa and UMi-Street Canyon scenarios.

question_74101.question: Which features share the same RF implementation for the same band combination?
question_74101.ground_truth: UL NR CA, UL NR DC, EN-DC, and NE-DC features share the same RF implementation for the same band combination.

question_74103.question: What is the function of the local NEF in the described solution?
question_74103.ground_truth: The local NEF acts as both a NEF (sending information to an APP) and an invoker of MnS services provided by a MnS (SA~WG5 defined) entity to receive OAM output information from NG RAN.

question_74104.question: In what message should the UE include the NBIFOM routing rules parameter when requesting bearer resource modification or allocation procedure?
question_74104.ground_truth: The UE should include the NBIFOM container IE with the NBIFOM routing rules parameter in either the BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message or the BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message.

question_74105.question: What is the definition of transmitter OFF power for UTRA and E-UTRA in the context of testing the transmitter OFF power of a base station?
question_74105.ground_truth: Transmitter OFF power for UTRA and E-UTRA is defined as the mean power measured over 70 microseconds filtered with a square filter of bandwidth equal to the Base Station RF Bandwidth of the BS, centered on the central frequency of the Base Station RF Bandwidth during the transmitter OFF period.

question_74107.question: What is the purpose of the Announce Request procedure in the ProSe Function?
question_74107.ground_truth: The Announce Request procedure is used by the UE to indicate whether it desires Restricted Discovery with application-controlled extension and by the ProSe Function to determine if the requested Restricted ProSe App User ID should be used in Restricted Discovery with application-controlled extension.

question_74108.question: Which SMF action takes place considering AF request(s) to establish QoS policies for individual PDU Sessions?
question_74108.ground_truth: The PCF determines QoS policies considering AF request(s) for the individual PDU Sessions of the talker and the listeners.

question_74110.question: When must the UE discard the random access report information in the VarRA-Report?
question_74110.ground_truth: The UE may discard the random access report information, i.e. release the UE variable VarRA-Report, 48 hours after the last successful random access procedure or the failed or successfully completed on-demand system information acquisition procedure related information is added to the VarRA-Report.

question_74111.question: What is the aim of Key Issue #4, which is focused on the support of PC5 QoS framework enhancement for eV2X?
question_74111.ground_truth: The aim of Key Issue #4 is to investigate the enhancement of the PC5 QoS framework to allow the application function (AF) to influence QoS for eV2X applications.

question_74112.question: What is the difference between gNB-CU, gNB-DU, gNB, and en-gNB as defined in TS 38.401, TS 38.300, TS 37.340?
question_74112.ground_truth: gNB-CU is a gNB central unit, gNB-DU is a gNB distributed unit, gNB is a Next-Generation NodeB, and en-gNB is an evolved-gNB.

question_74113.question: What protocol does the AUSF send to the PAF in the SBI message?

question_74114.question: What is the role of the Data Session Manager?
question_74114.ground_truth: The Data Session Manager is responsible for management functions related to data session, and allows the application programmer to enable or disable data session-related event notifications.

question_74115.question: What is the method used in the API for a service to specify the reference address of the callback interface that it uses to invoke methods on the application?

question_74116.question: What error is used when the gsmSCF, gsmSSF, gsmSRF, smsSSF or gprsSSF is not able to execute a specific task and recovery is expected within the current call instance?

question_74117.question: What should the SCC AS do upon receiving a SIP UPDATE request from the controller UE in Alternative 1?
question_74117.ground_truth: The SCC AS should authorize the request for the session setup in the controllee UE, and send a SIP INVITE request including the SDP information as specified.

question_74118.question: In the 3GPP RRM tests, what is the method for combining test system uncertainties and how do they combine uncertainties?
question_74118.ground_truth: The method for combining test system uncertainties is based on the root-sum-squares method, which is used to maintain the same tolerance interval for the combined uncertainty as is already specified for the contributing test system uncertainties. The uncertainties are assumed to be uncorrelated, and are added result root-sum-square unless otherwise stated. The combination of uncertainties is performed using dB values for simplicity.

question_74120.question: Which complexType has the attribute "namespace" set to "##other" and the processContents attribute set to "lax"?

question_74121.question: What does the "(n-1) out of n" approach mean in the context of performance measurements?
question_74121.ground_truth: The "(n-1) out of n" approach allows a vendor to choose any (n-1) out of the n defined counters for implementation, while the missing nth value can be calculated in post-processing. This approach is used to avoid redundancy in measurements.

question_74122.question: What is the effect when the ProSe Function assigns a new ProSe Response Code and ProSe Query Code with a new validity timer T4011?
question_74122.ground_truth: It implies that the ProSe Function shall allocate Discovery Query Filter(s) based on the allocated ProSe Query Code and starts timer T4012, which is longer than timer T4011.

question_74123.question: What is the format of the Management Object Identifier for the Allowed CSG List MO?
