question_74447.question: What information must be included in the GANSS Positioning IE if the GANSS Generic Assistance Data IE is to be contained in the Requested Data Value IE?
question_74447.ground_truth: The GANSS Generic Assistance Data IE included in the Requested Data Value IE must contain at least one of the following: GANSS Real Time Integrity, GANSS Data Bit Assistance, DGANSS Corrections, GANSS Almanac and Satellite Health, GANSS Reference Measurement Information, GANSS UTC Model, GANSS Time Model, GANSS Navigation Model, GANSS Additional Time Models, GANSS Additional Navigation Models, GANSS Additional UTC Models, GANSS Auxiliary Information, DBDS Corrections, or BDS Ionospheric Grid Model.

question_74448.question: How many exceptions to the transmitter power control range are allowed for each direction in inner loop power control?
question_74448.ground_truth: Up to 2 exceptions to the transmitter power control range are allowed for each direction in inner loop power control.

question_74449.question: What is the applied approach for inter-band EN-DC including FR2 for UL MIMO in clause 7.3B.2.4D?
question_74449.ground_truth: An LTE anchor agnostic approach is applied and only NR carriers need to be tested.

question_74450.question: What is the time 'T' set to in the sequence of intra-NR inter-cell handover?
question_74450.ground_truth: Time 'T' is set to 300 ms in advance of the handover in the sequence of intra-NR inter-cell handover.

question_74451.question: In Solution #31, what happens when the target UE is out of coverage?
question_74451.ground_truth: In Solution #31, when the target UE is out of coverage, the GMLC determines to use Network assisted sidelink positioning to locate the target UE and selects a Located UE based on the target area. The LMF then triggers the LCS procedure of the Located UE to get the location of the Target UE.

question_74455.question: What is the minimum and maximum length of the list of user info ID information element?
question_74455.ground_truth: The list of user info ID information element has a minimum length of 4 octets and a maximum length of 257 octets.

question_74457.question: What should the MS do when a downlink SACCH block is correctly decoded and the next uplink SACCH block is not a repetition?
question_74457.ground_truth: The MS should set the SACCH Repetition Request in the next uplink SACCH block to "Repeated SACCH not required".

question_74459.question: What are the QoS parameters that the PCF derives in the process of 5G QoS Identifier (5QI), Authorized Allocation and Retention Priority (ARP) and Authorized Maximum/Guaranteed Data Rate DL parameters derivation?
question_74459.ground_truth: The PCF derives the Authorized QoS parameters from the MBS service information, including the Authorized 5QI, ARP, Authorized Maximum/Guaranteed Data Rate DL parameters, Priority Level (PL), Averaging Window (AW) and Maximum Data Burst Volume (MDBV).

question_74460.question: In the solution, what is the time granularity of the UTC-based counter associated with a discovery slot?
question_74460.ground_truth: The UTC-based counter associated with a discovery slot is set to a value of UTC time in granularity of seconds, which means it increments by one every second.

question_74461.question: What action does the MSC-A server take in step 3 of the Retrieval procedure?
question_74461.ground_truth: The MSC-A server requests the MGW-A to stop an announcement towards the held party.

question_74462.question: What happens when UEs in CM-IDLE state using an NTN RAN with discontinuous coverage in the same geographical area recover to be in coverage due to the expiration of the Periodic Registration Update timer?
question_74462.ground_truth: Signalling overload will occur as UEs may simultaneously initiate the Periodic Registration Update procedure and service Request procedure, leading to the arrival of multiple 5G NAS procedures at 5G CN.

question_74465.question: What action does the SGSN take when it receives an indication of UE reachability and has a MM context for that UE?
question_74465.ground_truth: If the SGSN contains an MM context of the UE, it stores URRP-SGSN to indicate the need to report to the HSS information regarding changes in UE reachability and sends a UE-Activity-Notification (IMSI, UE-Reachable) message to the HSS when the UE is next detected to be reachable.

question_74466.question: What is the main difference between hybrid services and regular services in 5GMS content delivery?
question_74466.ground_truth: Hybrid services allow for a basic service to be available on both unicast and eMBMS, with potential additional user experiences on unicast, while regular services are only available on one delivery network.

question_74469.question: What approach does Solution #12 propose to reduce service interruption during handover of user equipment (UE) in AMF-MBSR?
question_74469.ground_truth: Solution #12 proposes a full migration approach with a 2-step handover procedure, where the first step is MBSR handover without F1 anchor change, and the second step is UE handover trigger.

question_74471.question: What is the requirement for the MS when receiving a HANDOVER TO UTRAN COMMAND message from GSM and the handover fails because of a protocol error?
question_74471.ground_truth: The MS shall return an RR STATUS message on DCCH of the old channel in the GSM cell with RR cause #96 "Invalid mandatory information".

question_74472.question: In clause 7.6.1.5, what is the meaning of HTTP error handling being "supported" as specified in clause 6.7?
question_74472.ground_truth: This means that the API will follow the HTTP error handling rules as defined in clause 6.7, such as returning appropriate HTTP status codes for different types of errors.

question_74474.question: What is the purpose of using DNN/S-NSSAI as a new granularity in the solution described?
question_74474.ground_truth: The purpose is to identify the parts of UDR's temporary data which subjects to loss/corruption without impacts to other parts, and to provide different level of backup reliability for user data under different DNN/S-NSSAI.

question_74475.question: Under what circumstances would the UE send a PMFP PLR count request message over the QoS flow of the non-default QoS rule?
question_74475.ground_truth: The UE sends a PMFP PLR count request message over a QoS flow of the non-default QoS rule if it intends to measure the PLR of the SDF (Selected Data Flow) over a non-default QoS rule. Otherwise, it sends the message over the QoS flow of the default QoS rule.

question_74477.question: What is the purpose of the "a=mbms-mode:" attribute in SDP session descriptions?
question_74477.ground_truth: The "a=mbms-mode:" attribute in SDP session descriptions is used to declare the MBMS bearer mode in the session. It is required when the session carries packets for more than one object.

question_74478.question: For which mobile communication system is specified the error performance limits at RX interference level for the TI5 multipath propagation condition?
question_74478.ground_truth: Pico-BTS and Local Area multicarrier BTS with multicarrier receiver

question_74479.question: What action does the UE take upon receiving N311 consecutive "in-sync" indications for the PCell from lower layers while T315 is running?
question_74479.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T315.

question_74480.question: What should the PCF include within the TrafficControlData data instance if the PDU session should be correlated via a common DNAI?
question_74480.ground_truth: The PCF should include within the TrafficControlData data instance the "traffCorreInd" attribute set to true.

question_74481.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement specified in clause 11.6.2.4.3 for NR SA FR1 inter-frequency SS-RSRQ measurement accuracy on a carrier frequency with CCA?
question_74481.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clauses 11.6.2.0.3 and 11.6.2.0.4 for absolute and relative accuracy under CCA, respectively.

question_74482.question: What action should the ePDG take upon receiving an uplink IP packet via an ePDG's ESP SPI bound to an S2b bearer of the PDN connection?
question_74482.ground_truth: The ePDG shall forward an uplink IP packet received via an ePDG's ESP SPI bound to an S2b bearer of the PDN connection using the S2b bearer.

question_74483.question: What is the minimum separation distance required for rural, urban, and indoor scenarios for inter-operator guard band (uncoordinated deployment)?
question_74483.ground_truth: The minimum separation distance required for rural, urban, and indoor scenarios for inter-operator guard band (uncoordinated deployment) is 30 m, 15 m, and 3 m, respectively.

question_74484.question: What is the measurement that provides the mean number of simultaneous HSUPA users in a serving E-DCH cell?

question_74485.question: What does 6.1.10.2 test for as per its test purpose subclause?
question_74485.ground_truth: The test verifies that the TRPaverage and TRPmin of the UE is not below specified values as per 6.1.10.2 subclause.

question_74486.question: What is the function of temporary group formation in MCPTT services?
question_74486.ground_truth: Temporary group formation is used to create a temporary group involving multiple MCPTT systems, such as in the case of a dispatcher/authorized user/UE requesting group regroup operation to the group management server.

question_74488.question: Under what conditions can the MC service server or location management client request the status of stored location information reports from the location management client1?
question_74488.ground_truth: The MC service server or location management client can request the status of stored location information reports from the location management client1, as long as the location management client1 has returned to report location information and has stored location information reports, there is a communication link between the location management client and location management server, and the location management server checks the authorization of this request.

question_74490.question: What is the potential impact of CSIPTO on IMS in the transitional period?
question_74490.ground_truth: Maintaining two IMS sessions for the same connection simultaneously towards the same endpoints during the transitional period when the two PDN connections co-exist creates complexity. In addition, CSIPTO requirements have not been developed for use in conjunction with IMS.

question_74492.question: How does a UE handle measuring CSG cells in a specific frequency or RAT?
question_74492.ground_truth: The UE may avoid measurements of any CSG cells that are known by the UE not to be CSG member cells on the carrier frequency dedicated to CSG deployment, unless the UE is in CSG member cell and needs to optimize measurements for handover or other features.

question_74494.question: What is the test purpose of this test procedure?
question_74494.ground_truth: The test purpose of this test procedure is to test the correct operation of the interrogation procedure, and correct display of the response from the SS in the case of an error response and an invoke problem.

question_74495.question: Which entity performs the IUT add media request to setup a new media flow towards the Controller UE-1?
question_74495.ground_truth: The Controller UE-1 performs the IUT add media request to setup a new media flow towards the Controller UE-1.

question_74498.question: What happens to the counters when both EPS and 5GS are subject to unified quota management and a PDN connection is established in the EPS or handed over to EPS?
question_74498.ground_truth: The counter is incremented when the PDN connection is established or handed over to EPS.

question_74499.question: What is the significance of the SS waiting until the MS indicates that the 12.65 kbit/s is the recommended downlink codec mode?
question_74499.ground_truth: This waiting period ensures that the SS operates in the same codec mode as the MS, and if the MS never reaches that point, the test is considered failed.

question_74501.question: What are the required parameters in a connectionRequest RUA-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?
question_74501.ground_truth: The required parameters in a connectionRequest RUA-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE are initiating message, procedure code, and criticality.

question_74502.question: How is the receiver handling duplicated PDUs in the RSM mechanism?
question_74502.ground_truth: The receiver retains the PDU that arrives at the destination first and discards the one arriving later.

question_74503.question: What is the function of I-SMF in terms of local traffic steering when it is inserted into a PDU Session?
question_74503.ground_truth: The I-SMF is responsible for the insertion, modification and removal of UPF(s) to ensure local traffic steering. It determines which DNAI(s) are to be selected, selects UPFs acting as UL CL/BP and/or PDU Session Anchor based on the DNAI(s) of interest for this PDU Session.

question_74504.question: What information is included in the notification of QoS sustainability analytics?
question_74504.ground_truth: The notification of QoS sustainability analytics includes Analytics ID = "QoS Sustainability", target of analytics reporting (any UE), analytics filter information (5QI and additional QoS parameters or QoS characteristics attributes), location information, S-NSSAI (optional), analytics target period, reporting threshold(s), notification correlation id, and notification target address.

question_74505.question: What modifications do the session setup, modification, and release procedures incur in this solution?
question_74505.ground_truth: The procedures are not modified, except for the handling of incoming sessions by an I-CSCF in a mobile terminating call.

question_74507.question: What is the purpose of the MMBP metadata parameters in this specification?
question_74507.ground_truth: The MMBP metadata parameters provide information about the MMBP, such as the media type, size, accessibility, and processing requirements. They help the client decide which MMBP to playback and how to process it.

question_74508.question: What is the meaning of "handover interface" in the context of this specification?
question_74508.ground_truth: A handover interface is the physical and logical interface across which the interception measures are requested from network operator / access provider / service provider, and the results of interception are delivered from a network operator / access provider / service provider to a law enforcement monitoring facility.

question_74509.question: What is added to the measurement cause 'No Reply' when the RADIO LINK SETUP FAILURE corresponds to RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST with the ``HS-DSCH Information'' and ``Additional HS Cell Information RL Setup'' IE not received by the controlling RNC?
question_74509.ground_truth: Each failed attempt to set up a Dual-Cell HSDPA radio link is added to the measurement cause 'No Reply'.

question_74510.question: What are the bandwidths used for ACLR/UTRA measurements?
question_74510.ground_truth: The bandwidths used are 5 MHz and 1.6 MHz.

question_74511.question: What is the NAS COUNT behavior when NIA0 is used for integrity protection in 5G NAS messages?
question_74511.ground_truth: When NIA0 is used for integrity protection in 5G NAS messages, if the NAS COUNT values wrap around, the NAS connection shall be kept even if a new KAMF has not been established before the NAS COUNT wrap around.

question_74512.question: What is the defined measurement reporting delay excluding for event triggered measurement reporting, assuming no delay from other RRC signaling on the DCCH and excluding a delay uncertainty from inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH?
question_74512.ground_truth: The defined measurement reporting delay for event triggered measurement reporting, assuming no delay from other RRC signaling on the DCCH and excluding a delay uncertainty from inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH, is the time between an event that will trigger a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface.

question_74513.question: What must the controlling MCPTT function do if release of the MCPTT session is required for each participant in the MCPTT session?
question_74513.ground_truth: The controlling MCPTT function must perform the procedures as specified in subclause 6.3.3.1.5 if release of the MCPTT session is required for each participant in the MCPTT session.

question_74515.question: In which scenario will the "plmnId" attribute and "dnn" and "snssai" attributes be provided in the NsmfEventExposureNotification data structure?
question_74515.ground_truth: If the "HR-SBO" feature is supported and the SMF determines that the UE has moved to a serving PLMN in which local traffic offload is allowed.

question_74516.question: Which specific key issue does Solution #11 address?
question_74516.ground_truth: Solution #11 addresses Key Issue #4: Avoidance of conflict between UE IP address/prefix allocated by SMF(s).

question_74518.question: What should the UE do if it receives a 486, 600, or 603 response to the INVITE request in the initial eCall attempt?
question_74518.ground_truth: The UE should consider the initial MSD transmission as successful and perform domain selection to re-attempt the eCall.

question_74519.question: What is the issue described in clause 5.4.2 within the context of CCA?
question_74519.ground_truth: The issue described in clause 5.4.2 is that, even if there is a minimum level of trust, the CCA validity time cannot avoid the threat of an SCP sending a service request and receiving a valid service response on behalf of an NF Service Consumer, without the explicit authorization of the Consumer.

question_74522.question: What information is required from the consumer and data sources for solution #x?
question_74522.ground_truth: The consumer is required to send per slice measurements and analytics, application session performance analytics, and historical data on slice information. Data Source #1 provides PM data for a given NSI, Data Source #2 provides slice load analytics for NSI/S-NSSAI and service experience for NSI/S-NSSAI, and Data Source #3 provides application QoS measurements for an application session connected to the requested slice. The output is a statistics or prediction for the VAL application QoS for one or more requested S-NSSAIs/NSIs.

question_74523.question: What should the MS do after successfully establishing a TCP connection to the GANC?
question_74523.ground_truth: The MS includes the Register Reject Cause IE, Redirection Counter IE, and Default GANC IE in the GA-RC DISCOVERY REQUEST message, and sends it to the Provisioning GANC on the established TCP connection.

question_74524.question: What is the impact on existing nodes for the Trigger Recall/Replace function?
question_74524.ground_truth: Tsp and T4 need to be enhanced to support new messages and/or new IEs for the Trigger Recall/Replace function. SMS-SC and MTC-IWF also need to support the Trigger Recall/Replace function.

question_74525.question: What shall the UE do if 5GMM cause #75 is received via 3GPP access from a cell belonging to an SNPN?
question_74525.ground_truth: The UE shall set the 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, store the 5GS update status accordingly, and reset the registration attempt counter. The UE shall also delete any 5G-GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list ngKSI, and the list of equivalent SNPNs (if available) and set the 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED and store it accordingly.

question_74527.question: What should the MCPTT client do when it receives a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message with the Call type IE set to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL" and the stored call type being different from "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL"?
question_74527.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should set the stored last call type change time, stored last user to change call type, stored current call type, stored current ProSe per-packet priority, start timer TFG13, and enter the "T1: in-progress emergency group call" state.

question_74530.question: How many points are agreed upon as a framework for developing OTA test to prove equivalence?
question_74530.ground_truth: Eleven points have been agreed upon as a framework for developing OTA test to prove equivalence.

question_74532.question: What does the abbreviation "ACLR" stand for in the context of 3GPP specifications?
question_74532.ground_truth: Adjacent Channel Leakage power Ratio, the power ratio of the assigned and adjacent channels.

question_74533.question: What are the two scenarios for serving a UE when it is connected to 5GC?
question_74533.ground_truth: A UE can be served by E-UTRA or NR through the Uu interface.

question_74535.question: What is the transmitter power of the UE turned off within after expiry of which timer?
question_74535.ground_truth: The transmitter power of the UE is turned off within 40 ms after expiry of T310 timer.

question_74537.question: What is the operation that involves performing the DSMIPv6 Home Link Detection Function and setting up a security association if there is no security existing association between the UE and HA during the attach to additional access network procedure?
question_74537.ground_truth: The Home Link Detection and setting up a security association are distinct operations. The Home Link Detection Function is used to determine if the new link will be a home link or a foreign link. If the link is home, a security association will be set up through the home link. If the link is foreign, the UE shall send the Binding Update message through the added link and register the binding for the home link by including a BID mobility option in the Binding Update message.

question_74539.question: What is the duration of time period T1 in the test?
question_74539.ground_truth: The duration of time period T1 in the test is not specified and is decided by the test implementation.

question_74543.question: What does the 4.7 section of the document describe?
question_74543.ground_truth: This section contains the detailed description of the information flows used by CAMEL for IP Multimedia Subsystems call control.

question_74544.question: What are the capabilities that the NWDAF containing MTLF can register in its NF Profile registered in the NRF?
question_74544.ground_truth: The NWDAF containing MTLF can register "FL capability" that indicates support for "FLaggregation" and/or "FL participant" for the corresponding Analytics ID.

question_74546.question: What is the role of the metrics reporting server in a SAND-enabled PSS architecture?
question_74546.ground_truth: The metrics reporting server is responsible for receiving and processing QoE metrics in a SAND-enabled PSS architecture, providing a means for measuring the quality of the streaming service.

question_74547.question: What should the UE do, if the AUTN parameter received in the AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message is found to be invalid by the UE?
question_74547.ground_truth: If the AUTN parameter received in the AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message is found to be invalid by the UE, the UE should return an AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message to the network, with the 5GMM cause #20 "MAC failure" and then follow the procedure described in subclause~5.4.1.3.7, item c.

question_74548.question: What is the purpose of storing LCS permanent data in the VLR/SGSN and MME?
question_74548.ground_truth: Storing LCS permanent data in the VLR/SGSN and MME allows for fast and efficient processing of LCS requests during location updates and attach procedures.

question_74549.question: What is the allowed time period for the UE to transmit preamble on a beam during the test in DRX mode?
question_74549.ground_truth: The UE is allowed to transmit preamble on a beam associated with the candidate beam set q1 no later than D1 = 1930 ms after the start of T5, during the test in DRX mode.

question_74550.question: Which test applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 16 and forward?
question_74550.ground_truth: The test that applies to all types of E-UTRA UE release 16 and forward is 6.2E.2.2.1.2.

question_74551.question: What should the MS do when the service request for mobile originated services is rejected due to general NAS level mobility management congestion control?
question_74551.ground_truth: The network sets the GMM cause value to #22 "congestion" and assigns a back-off timer T3346. The MS resets the service request attempt counter, stops timer T3317 and takes different actions based on the received reject cause value.

question_74553.question: What type of distortion occurs when the corners of an image stretch outward due to the refraction of light crossing the lens?
question_74553.ground_truth: Pincushion distortion is the type of distortion that occurs when the corners of an image stretch outward due to the refraction of light crossing the lens.

question_74554.question: What is the GM-C reference point in the SEAL based application architecture for enabling PINAPP?
question_74554.ground_truth: The GM-C reference point is the interface between the PIN client and the SEAL group management client within the UE. This reference point allows the PIN client to communicate with the SEAL group management client to achieve PIN management.

question_74557.question: What is one of the key variables that needs to be considered in order to guarantee high availability of remote access to DA assets in a fault scenario?
question_74557.ground_truth: Power autonomy of cellular nodes is a key variable that needs to be accounted for in order to ensure high availability of remote access to DA assets during a power outage.

question_74560.question: What protection mechanism is used for HTTP traffic between the UE and the HTTP proxy and between the UE and the IdMS in the described network architecture?
question_74560.ground_truth: All HTTP traffic between the UE and the HTTP proxy and between the UE and the IdMS is protected using HTTPS.

question_74564.question: What signaling method is used to indicate E-DCH related information to a UE in MU-MIMO mode?
question_74564.ground_truth: The NodeB scheduler uses E-AGCH type 2 to signal the E-DCH related information to UE in MU-MIMO mode.

question_74565.question: What is the meaning of "shall" in the Technical Specification?
question_74565.ground_truth: "Shall" in the Technical Specification indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

question_74566.question: What is the role of NM, EM, and DM/EM in the management of virtualized network functions that are part of the NR?
question_74566.ground_truth: NM is responsible for requesting EM (Element Manager) to establish the relation between virtualized and non-virtualized parts of the network, and between the CN NF and gNB. DM/EM (Data/Element Manager) reports the performance measurements of dedicated hardware resource utilization to NM for the deployment of the non-virtualized part of gNB.

question_74567.question: What is the process to update the PSK (Pre-shared Key) in Solution 7?
question_74567.ground_truth: The key generation center generates the updated PSK, which is then transferred to the OTA server and finally to the RN (Radio Node) and UICC (User Identity Card). This update is performed at the application layer and can be executed within the 3GPP scope.

question_74569.question: When will the S-CSCF perform the initial registration procedures with SIP digest as a security mechanism?
question_74569.ground_truth: The S-CSCF will do this if the HSS responds with an authentication scheme of SIP digest.

question_74570.question: In which nodes of the 3GPP network is the group handling introduced to cumulate the reports in Alternative B of reporting of monitoring events?
question_74570.ground_truth: In Alternative B, the group handling is introduced in MME/SGSN/Serving GW/PDN GW/PCRF/HSS nodes to cumulate the per UE monitoring reports into one group monitoring report.

question_74572.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Report on Evolved Universal Terrestrial Radio Access (LTE Advanced) Inter-band Carrier Aggregation (CA) Rel-14 for 2 Down Link (DL) / 1 Up Link (UL)?
question_74572.ground_truth: The purpose of the report is to gather the relevant background information and studies in order to address 2DL/1UL Inter-band Carrier Aggregation requirements for the Rel-14 band combinations.

question_74573.question: What is the focus of Fixed Mobile Convergence (5.6) in TR23.863?
question_74573.ground_truth: The focus of Fixed Mobile Convergence is to leverage the 5G network characteristics to enable combined use of fixed broadband (e.g. FTTx/xDSL) and Next Generation Radio access network.

question_74574.question: What is the purpose of the UE EIRP measurement in step 5 of 6.2D.3.4.2?
question_74574.ground_truth: The purpose of the UE EIRP measurement is to ensure that the measured value meets the requirements described in clause 6.2D.3.5.

question_74575.question: In case inter-frequency handover occurs during the RSTD measurements, what is the requirement for the UE to meet the RSTD measurement accuracy and PRS bandwidth?
question_74575.ground_truth: The UE shall meet the RSTD measurement accuracy for a PRS bandwidth which is not larger than the minimum channel bandwidth of all the PCells during the RSTD measurement period.

question_74577.question: What is a logical connection between a SEPP in one PLMN and a SEPP in another PLMN for exchange of protected HTTP messages called in 3GPP TS 33.501?

question_74578.question: What is the AMBR or TMBR provided by the AMF and SMF to the AN depending on the Access type?
question_74578.ground_truth: The AMF and SMF provide an AMBR or a TMBR to the AN depending on the Access type. For wireline access, Session-TMBR and UE-TMBR are used. For wireless access, Session-AMBR and UE-AMBR are used.

question_74579.question: What is the role of the IBCF-hA1 in step 9-10 in the SIP flow?
question_74579.ground_truth: The IBCF-hA1 in step 9-10 is responsible for sending the SIP INVITE request via Ibcf-hA1.home-A.net and the VoIP IC network to the Ibcf-vA1.visited-A.net of the VPLMN. It also updates the SDP when loopback applies to avoid looped media routing.

question_74581.question: What is the expected sequence for the UE to send BYE requests to terminate the initial calls?
question_74581.ground_truth: UE sends two BYE requests to terminate the two initial calls it put on hold, and SS responds to the BYE requests with a valid 200 OK response each.

question_74584.question: What action does the PDN GW take if the Handover Indicator in the Proxy Binding Update indicates initial attach or that the handover state is unknown?
question_74584.ground_truth: The PDN GW defers linking with the Gx session until step 7 and verifies that the IP-CAN type reported over Gxa and Gx are the same.

question_74586.question: Which protocol is used by the routing functions of layer 3 for passing messages with task 2 in non-3GPP access?
question_74586.ground_truth: The protocol discriminator (PD) or PDU session identity is used by the routing functions of layer 3 for passing messages with task 2 in non-3GPP access.

question_74587.question: What is the difference between I1-ps and I1-cs in the signalling paths of IMS?
question_74587.ground_truth: I1-ps is used for session control signalling before handover to target access while I1-cs is used for session control signalling after handover to target access.

question_74588.question: What is the significance of the RAB establishment for PS domain with and without queuing, and how do they relate to the UMTS network?
question_74588.ground_truth: The RAB establishment for PS domain with and without queuing is used to determine the number of successfully established RABs and RAB establishment failures in the UMTS network for the PS domain. It can be used to support the coverage ratio (CR) calculation for EE coverage area determination.

question_74589.question: What is the maximum number of cyclic shifts for comb-8 in Rel-17?
question_74589.ground_truth: The maximum number of cyclic shifts for comb-8 is 6.

question_74591.question: What is the Network Resource Model (NRM) in the context of 5G networks?
question_74591.ground_truth: The Network Resource Model (NRM) is a model that specifies the information and solution sets for the management and orchestration of 5G networks, including NR, NG-RAN, 5GC, and network slices.

question_74592.question: What should the UE set in the MeasurementReport message for each measId that concerns NR and has reportSFTD-Meas set to true in TS 38.331, clause 5.5.5.3?
question_74592.ground_truth: The UE should set sfn-OffsetResult and frameBoundaryOffsetResult to the measurement results provided by lower layers, and set the rsrp-Result to the RSRP of the NR PSCell if the reportRSRP is set to true.

question_74594.question: What are the possible initiators for the ADAE server to pull the service experience information from the ADAE client?
question_74594.ground_truth: The ADAE server can initiate the pull upon receiving a service experience from an ADAE client, upon receiving a VAL server performance analytics request from an application service provider or any other event that requires the ADAE server to determine the service experience data.

question_74595.question: What action does the HSS take if it receives Monitoring Request for a group of UEs?
question_74595.ground_truth: The HSS stores the monitoring parameters for every group member UE and sends a Monitoring Request to the MME/SGSN for each individual UE in the group.

question_74597.question: What should the MCVideo service support regarding procedures and related information flows?
question_74597.ground_truth: The MCVideo service should support procedures and related information flows as specified in subclause~10.1, 10.8, and 10.13 of 3GPP~TS~23.280.

question_74598.question: What is the NG-RAN/Satellite NG-RAN Primary Timing Advance value equal to if the ME has never been in NG-RAN or Satellite NG-RAN RRC connected mode on the current cell?
question_74598.ground_truth: The NG-RAN/Satellite NG-RAN Primary Timing Advance value is equal to 'FF FF FF'.

question_74600.question: What constraint does the "ServiceProvider" leave apply on the value of EquivalentVisitedSPs in "ANDSF/VisitedNetworkPreference/EquivalentVisitedSPs/<X>"?
question_74600.ground_truth: The "ServiceProvider" leave in "ANDSF/VisitedNetworkPreference/EquivalentVisitedSPs/<X>" identifies the realm of a service provider that is equivalent to the V-PLMN over WLAN.

question_74601.question: How does the MBSF (MBS Functionality) determine the URL for the MCData server to push the file in push ingest mode?
question_74601.ground_truth: The MBSF provides the URL to the MCData server to push the file into the MBS session. The MCData server is always the functional entity ingesting the file content into the MBSTF via the Nmb8 interface.

question_74602.question: What is the purpose of the hybrid combiner in option A for the dual carrier RF architecture?
question_74602.ground_truth: The purpose of the hybrid combiner in option A is to combine the signals from the two carriers into a single antenna. The insertion loss of this combiner is about 3 dB to 3.5 dB.

question_74603.question: What is the name of the approach where each node only performs overload control for its next-hop peer node?

question_74605.question: What is the relationship between the insertion loss of the high TX rejection RX filters and the typical GSM receiver filters?
question_74605.ground_truth: The insertion loss of the high TX rejection RX filters is slightly higher than that of the typical GSM receiver filters

question_74607.question: What should the MCPTT client or server do for each MIME body when including multiple MIME bodies in a SIP message?
question_74607.ground_truth: The MCPTT client or server should insert the boundary delimiter, shall insert the Content-Type header field with the MIME type of the MIME body, and shall insert the content of the MIME body for each MIME body.

question_74608.question: What is the status code response when the UDR creates the data using PUT method?
question_74608.ground_truth: On success, the UDR responds with "201 Created" with the content containing the representation of the created data, and the "Location" header contains the URI of the created data.

question_74610.question: What is an IMRN and what is its role in the emergency call handling?
question_74610.ground_truth: An IMRN is an IP Multimedia Routeing Number that is assigned to a call for routing within the IM CN. It is minimally used to route the call to the E-SCC AS, but may also enable call routing to the IM CN for anchoring.

question_74611.question: How can the controller UE request another UE to become the controller UE of the collaborative session?
question_74611.ground_truth: The controller UE can include the identity of the intended new controller UE in a SIP REFER request sent to the SCC AS, or in a SIP INFO request or SIP PUBLISH method, or by embedding the XML body in the Refer-To URI, or by including a new header field "IUT-Controller-Assignment" in the SIP REFER request.

question_74613.question: What security aspect is addressed by Key Issue #5 in the 3GPP system for UE-to-UE relay scenarios?
question_74613.ground_truth: Key Issue #5 addresses protecting the security (integrity and confidentiality) of information transmitted between source and target UEs over the UE-to-UE relay.

question_74614.question: What should be the Selected SSC mode IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message if the SSC mode IE is not included in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message and the PDU session is non-emergency and of "Ethernet" or "Unstructured" PDU session type?
question_74614.ground_truth: The Selected SSC mode IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message should be set to "SSC mode 1" or "SSC mode 2".

question_74615.question: What is the format of the Management Object Identifier for the 3GPP System to Wireless Local Area Network interworking MO?
question_74615.ground_truth: The Management Object Identifier for the 3GPP System to Wireless Local Area Network interworking MO is: urn:oma:mo:ext-3gpp-IWLAN:1.0.

question_74616.question: What compression schemes were considered for the eCall verification system?
question_74616.ground_truth: Two compression schemes were considered for the eCall verification system: Simple G.711 A-law companding and G.729 encoding.

question_74617.question: What should the PDCP entity do when indicating PDCP data volume for BSR triggering and Buffer Size calculation, if PDCP duplication is activated for the RB and the associated RLC entity is not the primary RLC entity or primary path?
question_74617.ground_truth: The PDCP entity should indicate the PDCP data volume excluding the PDCP Control PDU to the MAC entity associated with the RLC entity other than the primary RLC entity or primary path.

question_74618.question: What are the definition of X1 and X2 in Test 1 and Test 2 respectively in measurement reporting delay from the beginning of time period T2?
question_74618.ground_truth: X1 in Test 1 is 10080 for UE supporting power class 1, or 6240 for UE supporting other power class and X2 in Test 2 is 107520 for UE supporting power class 1, or 66560 for UE supporting other power class.

question_74619.question: What is the role of the DN-AAA server in the process of Secondary Re-authentication for a PDU Session?
question_74619.ground_truth: The DN-AAA server can trigger the Secondary Re-authentication procedure for a PDU Session and, if successful, provide the DN authorized Session AMBR and/or DN Authorization Profile Index to the SMF.

question_74620.question: When can the UE return the position and optional velocity estimate to the SRNC after performing measurements for a UE-based method?
question_74620.ground_truth: The UE returns the position and optional velocity estimate to the SRNC after calculating the estimate, which includes the position, optional velocity estimate, estimated accuracy of the results, and time of the estimate.

question_74621.question: What must the UE do if the SUCI is included in the 5GS mobile identity IE and the timer T3519 is not running?
question_74621.ground_truth: The UE must start timer T3519 and store the value of the SUCI sent in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message. The UE must include the stored SUCI in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message while timer T3519 is running.

question_74622.question: What is the policy that helps a UE manage releasing an inactive PDU Session or deregistering from an unused S-NSSAI?

question_74623.question: What is the procedure for updating the Credentials Holder's controlled prioritized lists of preferred SNPNs and GINs in the context of Steering of Roaming?
question_74623.ground_truth: The Credentials Holder can update the prioritized lists of preferred SNPNs and GINs using the Steering of Roaming (SoR) procedure as defined in Annex C of TS~23.122.

question_74624.question: What is the priority order for the analysis and specification of operation types in the V2X work item for RAN4?
question_74624.ground_truth: The priority order is first for single carrier operation and second for multiple component carrier (MCC) operation.

question_74625.question: What should be done if the target cell is unknown?
question_74625.ground_truth: A longer interruption can be expected if the target cell is unknown.

question_74628.question: In the password registration procedure, what is the second step if the password check procedure has returned an indication of successful password check?
question_74628.ground_truth: The second step in the password registration procedure, after a successful password check, is that the network sends an invoke component of the operation "get password" with "new password?" as the value of the mandatory GuidanceInfo information element. This is embedded in a FACILITY message, prompting the MS to return the required new password.

question_74629.question: What is the initial state of the 'basic floor control operations towards the floor participant' state machine?
question_74629.ground_truth: The 'basic floor control operations towards the floor participant' state machine is initially in the 'Start-stop' state.

question_74630.question: How is the media plane established during the chat group call using the chat model?
question_74630.ground_truth: The MCPTT server establishes the media plane for the call if not already established, and the associated floor participants use the floor control procedure to initiate the call.

question_74632.question: What is the definition of "Conditional Handover" in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_74632.ground_truth: A handover which is executed by the UE.

question_74633.question: When must the mobile station send a PACKET CELL CHANGE FAILURE message on PACCH when the mobile station is in packet transfer mode or MAC-Shared state?
question_74633.ground_truth: When the network controlled cell reselection procedure fails due to access being denied in the new cell (IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT REJECT, PACKET ASSIGNMENT REJECT, or RRC CONNECTION REJECT message).

question_74634.question: In the context of the 5G ProSe direct link modification procedure for negotiated 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-UE relay reselection, what message is created by the initiating UE if it acts as a 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE?
question_74634.ground_truth: A PROSE DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION REQUEST message is created by the initiating UE for every IP address/prefix of the target 5G ProSe layer-3 end UEs received on the associated PROSE DIRECT LINK MODIFICATION REQUEST message from the source 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE.

question_74635.question: How many tests are usually performed with the maximum Base Station RF Bandwidth located at the bottom, middle and top of the supported frequency range in the operating band?
question_74635.ground_truth: Many tests in this TS are performed with 3 tests: BRFBW (bottom), MRFBW (middle) and TRFBW (top) in the supported frequency range in the operating band.

question_74636.question: How many external identifiers can be associated with the same Internal Identifier?
question_74636.ground_truth: One or more external identifiers can be associated with the same Internal Identifier.

question_74638.question: What exception is thrown if the 'incr' array is null in the increase method?
question_74638.ground_truth: If the 'incr' array is null, an instance of NullPointerException is thrown.

question_74639.question: Which delivery methods are mentioned for the first User Service?
question_74639.ground_truth: The first User Service is delivered over both the MBMS bearer and the unicast bearer.

question_74640.question: What event triggers the generation of the "File transfer xIRI" by the IRI-POI in the File Transfer Localisation Function?
question_74640.ground_truth: When the IRI-POI in the File Transfer Localisation Function detects that it has received a file destined for the target UE from the HTTP Content Server, or when it has retrieved a file from the HTTP Content Server for the target non-local ID.

question_74642.question: What action does the BSS-1 take when it cannot receive DL data at the same time as it receives local data during a handover?
question_74642.ground_truth: The BSS-1 sends any DL data it receives directly to the served UE to minimize the break in user plane data.

question_74643.question: What method does the framework use to request the application to provide load statistics records for the application?

question_74645.question: What is the Correlation Number used for in EPS bearer/tunnel?
question_74645.ground_truth: The Correlation Number is used to correlate call content with intercept-related information, to correlate different intercept-related records within one bearer/tunnel, and to correlate lawful assessment reports with the intercept records of the triggering events.

question_74646.question: What is the NAS Message Redirection procedure, and when is it triggered?
question_74646.ground_truth: The NAS Message Redirection procedure is a process that allows eNodeB to load balance between MMEs within the same DCN when a UE is in ECM-IDLE state. It is triggered at the next intra-MME Tracking Area Update Request.

question_74647.question: In the GUB Group Id IE, what does it correspond to?
question_74647.ground_truth: The GU Group Id IE corresponds to a globally unique group id corresponding to a pool area.

question_74652.question: What happens if MC service client 1 is not authorized to cancel the ad-hoc group emergency alert?
question_74652.ground_truth: If MC service client 1 is not authorized to cancel the ad-hoc group emergency alert, then the MC service server and MC service client 1 shall not proceed with the rest of the steps to cancel the alert.

question_74655.question: Which CAP-datatypes are used in CAP for Rel-6 for ApplyChargingGPRSArg to define the charging characteristics of a GPRS session?
question_74655.ground_truth: The CAP-datatypes used in CAP for Rel-6 for ApplyChargingGPRSArg to define the charging characteristics of a GPRS session are ChargingCharacteristics.

question_74656.question: When can the UE initiate the PDP context activation procedure in the context of adding GERAN or UTRAN access to an existing NBIFOM PDN connection?
question_74656.ground_truth: The UE can initiate the PDP context activation procedure only if the NBIFOM applies to a PDN connection and if the UE is operating in A/Gb mode or Iu mode (but cannot trigger an inter-system change to execute the procedure).

question_74657.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for a UE capable of beam correspondence without the need for UL beam sweeping in the 5G NR system?
question_74657.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement is defined in clause 5.5.9.0.1 of the 3GPP TS 38.133.

question_74658.question: What is the impact of using a single affiliation by the participating system during group affiliation in an MCPTT system?
question_74658.ground_truth: Using a single affiliation by the participating system when any group members have affiliated within that system enables interworking with LMR systems that do not support sending individual group members' affiliations through the IWF. However, the behavior of the MCPTT server may need to be changed to convey calling and talking party identities corresponding to the actual LMR users, if required.

question_74659.question: What should the UE do if one or more Access Identities are indicated and for at least one of these Access Identities the corresponding bit in the uac-BarringForAccessIdentity is set to zero?
question_74659.ground_truth: Consider the access attempt as allowed.

question_74661.question: What is the purpose of the HS-DPCCH in a network with SHO?
question_74661.ground_truth: The HS-DPCCH carries UL control information related to DL transmissions, such as HARQ ACK and PCI/CQI. Poor reception quality of the HS-DPCCH in the serving cell can cause degraded HSDPA cell and end-user throughput.

question_74662.question: What is the impact of DRX cycle and the number of beams per RRH on the time-of-stay in a cell in bi-directional Scenario-B without DPS?
question_74662.ground_truth: Time-of-stay in bi-directional Scenario-B without DPS is significantly affected by DRX cycle and the number of beams per RRH. Generally, time-of-stay times in bi-directional scenario are about half of the times or lower in comparison to uni-directional scenario.

question_74663.question: What is required between steps 10 and 12 in Phase II for IPsec solutions to protect the S1/X2 reference points?
question_74663.ground_truth: IKEv2 must be run to establish SAs and start protecting the IP traffic over Un.

question_74664.question: What can a SIP entity that receives a P-Charging-Vector header field do with the information received?
question_74664.ground_truth: A SIP entity that receives a P-Charging-Vector header field may take appropriate fields from the received header field and encode them in the equivalent field within the Relayed-Charge header field, along with a value in the relay-source to indicate the relaying SIP entity.

question_74666.question: What is the conformance requirement referred to in TS 38.508-1, 9.1.9.7.2?
question_74666.ground_truth: The conformance requirements covered in the current TC are specified in TS 24.501, clauses 4.16, 5.4.4.1, 5.4.4.2, 5.4.4.3, 5.5.1.2.4. Unless otherwise stated, these are Rel-16 requirements.

question_74667.question: How does the MIKEY-IBAKE protocol framework support mutual authentication of entities involved in the key exchange?
question_74667.ground_truth: The MIKEY-IBAKE protocol framework inherently supports mutual authentication of entities involved in the key exchange, fulfilling requirement 7 specified in 5.4.

question_74668.question: What is the purpose of the NRI attribute in a TLLI?
question_74668.ground_truth: The NRI attribute is used to route uplink LLC frames to the correct SGSN, even if the NRI of the TLLI points to a different SGSN.

question_74669.question: What should the mobile station do during a location update if an emergency number is stored in the SIM?
question_74669.ground_truth: The mobile station shall send a CHANNEL REQUEST message with an establishment cause of "emergency call".

question_74671.question: What is the purpose of investigating possible enhancements of the 5G QoS framework for improved RAN QoS monitoring and control?
question_74671.ground_truth: The purpose is to support improved QoS monitoring and control in the 5G QoS framework, particularly in relation to the radio access network (RAN). This has a dependency on the RAN and requires coordination with RAN working groups.

question_74674.question: What is the purpose of adjusting the priority of the underlying bearers for all participants in the MCPTT group?
question_74674.ground_truth: The priority adjustment is made to ensure that all successive calls during the group's in-progress emergency state receive the adjusted bearer priority.

question_74676.question: At what point does the SS wait until the MS indicates that the 12.2 kbit/s is the recommended downlink codec mode in step 3b?
question_74676.ground_truth: The SS waits until the MS indicates that the 12.2 kbit/s is the recommended downlink codec mode after sending a Channel Mode Modify procedure in step 3b.

question_74677.question: What are the two possible network modes the UE can end up in after the leaving procedure?
question_74677.ground_truth: After the leaving procedure, the UE/USIM may end up in either CM-IDLE mode or RRC Inactive mode.

question_74679.question: How does the 3GPP Technical Specification Group define normative and informative elements in the present document?
question_74679.ground_truth: Normative elements are indicated by "shall" and "shall not", while informative elements are indicated by "may", "need not", "can", "cannot", "is", "is not", "shall", "shall not", "will", "will not", "might", and "might not".

question_74680.question: What is the purpose of the Supported-Features AVP in the Diameter protocol on the Sy interface?
question_74680.ground_truth: The Supported-Features AVP is used during session establishment to inform the destination host about the required and optional features that the origin host supports.

question_74681.question: What is the purpose of the "Distribution Release Response" message in the 5G network?
question_74681.ground_truth: The "Distribution Release Response" message is used to confirm the successful release of the distribution session in the 5G network.

question_74682.question: What is the Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) for the DANE in the out-of-band scenario?
question_74682.ground_truth: The FQDN for the DANE is "dane.mnc<MNC>.mcc<MCC>.pub.3gppnetwork.org".

question_74683.question: How is self-interference modelled for coverage evaluation in option 2?
question_74683.ground_truth: Self-interference in option 2 is modelled as additive white Gaussian noise with a fixed INR of -6 dB for a 1 dB desense target.

question_74684.question: What is the accuracy of current positioning mechanisms, OTDOA and E-CID based on UE Rx-Tx time difference measurement, defined for?
question_74684.ground_truth: The accuracy of current positioning mechanisms and in particular OTDOA and E-CID based on UE Rx-Tx time difference measurement is only defined for limited scenarios, such as limited channel bandwidth for the cells to be measured and tests defined assuming single Tx antenna. Practical networks may have Tx diversity on antenna port which is used for RSTD measurements, and it is desirable to study the possibility of enhanced accuracy for other practical deployment scenarios.

question_74685.question: What is the purpose of the downlink assignment in the MAC entity in 5G?
question_74685.ground_truth: The downlink assignment in the MAC entity in 5G is a scheduling control signal that informs the UE of the resources allocated to it and the redundancy version for the dedicated broadcast HARQ process.

question_74687.question: What is the role of the RRC protocol in the control of radio resources?
question_74687.ground_truth: The RRC protocol controls and signals the allocation of radio resources to the UE and allows MAC to arbitrate between users and Radio Bearers within the radio resource allocation.

question_74691.question: What are some of the high-level requirements for the NRM defined in 3GPP TS 28.621 to support?
question_74691.ground_truth: The NRM defined in 3GPP TS 28.621 shall support management of UMTS-GSM Inter-system handover, telecommunication network management purposes including management of converged networks, and networks that include virtualized network functions.

question_74692.question: What information is included in the MS Radio Access Capability information element in ATTACH REQUEST message?
question_74692.ground_truth: The MS Radio Access Capability information element in ATTACH REQUEST message provides information concerning radio aspects of the mobile station including radio part of the network and radio frequency requirements.

question_74693.question: What subframe should the SS receive the first CSI report for inter-band CA UE in step 6b?
question_74693.ground_truth: Subframe (m+6) or (m+9) if the subframe (m+8) was subject to interruption

question_74695.question: What information does UE-1 include in the Solicitation message?
question_74695.ground_truth: UE-1 includes the following parameters in the Solicitation message: Type, Discovery Type, Discoverer Info, ProSe UE ID, and a list of "Remote User Info" corresponding to the remote user(s) of interest.

question_74696.question: What is the role of the UDR in the 5GC network?
question_74696.ground_truth: The UDR (Unified Data Repository) stores, updates, and removes corresponding information related to the network access and mobility of User Equipments (UEs) in the 5GC network.

question_74697.question: What type of data is Validity Area and Time of the Day in system mobility policy, and where is it conditionally stored?
question_74697.ground_truth: Validity Area and Time of the Day in system mobility policy is a set of information that indicates where and when the policy can be applied by the UE. It is conditionally stored in the Access Network Discovery and Selection Function (ANDSF).

question_74699.question: What is the new requirement PR.5.27-002 for supporting the use case?
question_74699.ground_truth: The 5G network shall support Ambient IoT device triggering to get one or more Ambient IoT devices to perform specific actions including initiating communication with the network.

question_74700.question: What are the three codec types that speech quality and delay should be measured for in Scenario 1 and 2?
question_74700.ground_truth: AMR-WB, AMR, and EVS SWB at various bit rates.

question_74701.question: What are the radio parameters of the 5G ProSe direct communication applicable per geographical area in the context of 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay?
question_74701.ground_truth: The radio parameters include information such as channel number, channel bandwidth, uplink and downlink transmission power, etc. This information is used to determine the radio characteristics of the direct communication for a given geographical area.

question_74702.question: Who is the patron saint of music and poetry?

question_74703.question: What protocol does the N3IWF use to encapsulate the DL PDU in a GRE packet for sending over NWu?
question_74703.ground_truth: The N3IWF uses GRE encapsulation to send the DL PDU over NWu.

question_74704.question: What is the action taken by the SS if the handover to Cell 2 fails?
question_74704.ground_truth: If the handover to Cell 2 fails, the SS will switch off and on the UE to attempt the handover again.

question_74705.question: What is the requirement for the measurement reporting delay in Test 1 and Test 2 of 5.6.2.3.5-1?
question_74705.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay should be less than 6720 ms for UE supporting power class 1 and 4160 ms for UE supporting other power class in Test 1 and Test 2.

question_74707.question: How should the SNRM-S respond to an HTTP POST request from a SNRM-C if the identity of the sender of the received HTTP POST request is not authorized to request mbms resource?
question_74707.ground_truth: The SNRM-S shall respond with a HTTP 403 (Forbidden) response to the HTTP POST request and shall skip rest of the steps.

question_74708.question: What are the physical channels and signals used by NR V2X sidelink?
question_74708.ground_truth: The NR V2X sidelink uses the following physical channels and signals: Physical sidelink broadcast channel (PSBCH), Physical sidelink control channel (PSCCH), Physical sidelink shared channel (PSSCH), Physical sidelink feedback channel (PSFCH), Sidelink primary and secondary synchronization signals (S-PSS and S-SSS), Phase-tracking reference signal (PT-RS), and Channel state information reference signal (CSI-RS).

question_74709.question: In what situation can the MS send an ASSIGNMENT COMPLETE message with cause 'normal event' after receiving an ASSIGNMENT COMMAND message using half rate speech version 6?
question_74709.ground_truth: After the MS has started a normal channel assignment procedure, initiated a local end release of link layer connections, disconnected the physical channels, commanded the switching to the assigned channels, and established lower layer connections.

question_74710.question: What are some conditions that determine the delivery mechanism for a MM?
question_74710.ground_truth: The roaming status of the recipient, the identity of the MM originator, the time of day, and the upper limit to the MM size.

question_74711.question: What is the effect of Control Plane data back-off timer on exception reporting and response to paging?
question_74711.ground_truth: The UE may send an initial NAS Message for exception reporting even if Control Plane data back-off timer is running, and may respond to paging with an initial NAS Message without uplink data even if the Control Plane data back-off timer is running.

question_74712.question: What should be appended as a new entry in the VarRA-Report upon successfully completing a random-access procedure?
question_74712.ground_truth: The plmn-IdentityList, cellId, spCellId, raPurpose, and ra-InformationCommon should be appended as a new entry in the VarRA-Report.

question_74715.question: What is the importance of REFSENS requirements?
question_74715.ground_truth: REFSENS requirements ensure the proper functioning and performance of the system, by specifying sensitivity thresholds for various CA combinations.

question_74716.question: What does the acronym RSVP stand for in networking?

question_74718.question: How does the Policy Control Function (PCF) access the Session Management Event Exposure Service at SMF?
question_74718.ground_truth: The PCF accesses the Session Management Event Exposure Service at the SMF via the N7 Reference point.

question_74719.question: What is the role of the CTS-FP in the intracell handover procedure?
question_74719.ground_truth: The CTS-FP initiates the intracell handover procedure by sending a CTS INTRACELL HANDOVER COMMAND message to the CTS-MS on the main signalling link, commands the switching to the assigned channel, and initiates the establishment of lower layer connections.

question_74720.question: What is the purpose of EVENT accounting data in offline charging?
question_74720.ground_truth: EVENT accounting data is used for simple registration, interrogation, successful service events, and unsuccessful session establishment attempts, which are not related to actual sessions.

question_74721.question: What are the disadvantages of sending the EVS-CMR on demand?
question_74721.ground_truth: The disadvantages of sending the EVS-CMR on demand are that lost frames mean a lost CMR, and it is often not trivial to detect such a case. This option has already been discussed in length for the AMR Rate Control.

question_74725.question: What message is sent by an EC capable mobile station attempting system access using the EC-RACH?
question_74725.ground_truth: The message sent by an EC capable mobile station attempting system access using the EC-RACH is the EC PACKET~UPLINK~ASSIGNMENT or EC PACKET UPLINK ACK/NACK message.

question_74726.question: For which scenarios is the MCPTT service applicable?
question_74726.ground_truth: The MCPTT service can be used for public safety applications and for general commercial applications (e.g., utility companies and railways).

question_74728.question: What does the FastFirstHigherPriorityPLMNSearch leaf indicate in terms of network search behavior?
question_74728.ground_truth: The FastFirstHigherPriorityPLMNSearch leaf indicates whether the user equipment (UE) performs the first search for a higher priority PLMN (Public Land Mobile Network) after at least 2 minutes and at most T minutes upon entering a VPLMN (Visited PLMN).

question_74733.question: Which interfaces need to be updated to carry bearer RAT type information per bearer basis?
question_74733.ground_truth: The S1-AP interface, and GTP messages such as Create Session Request message, Bearer Resource Command message, Modify Bearer Request message, Modify Access Bearers Request message, Context Request message, and Change Notification Request message.

question_74735.question: What SIP header fields are intended for end-to-end operation in IMS networks?
question_74735.ground_truth: P-Asserted-Identity header fields are intended for end-to-end operation in IMS networks.

question_74737.question: What is the test purpose for SCell activation and deactivation delay in 5.5.3.1.1?
question_74737.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify that the SCell activation and deactivation times are within the requirements when the SCell in FR2 intra-band is known by the UE at the time of activation.

question_74741.question: What is the proposal in 6.3.2 aiming to optimize?
question_74741.ground_truth: The proposal in 6.3.2 aims to optimize the gap pattern used for inter-frequency measurements by reducing the serving cell interruption to 1 subframe around the actual measurement time.

question_74742.question: What is the document specifying for User Equipment (UE) in UMTS system, the UE functions required for conformance testing purposes?
question_74742.ground_truth: The present document, Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network; Terminal logical test interface; Special conformance testing functions (Release 17) by the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP), specifies such functions.

question_74743.question: How does the AMF determine the new S-NSSAI to use?
question_74743.ground_truth: The AMF determines the new S-NSSAI to use by using NSSF, PCF, or OAM.

question_74746.question: What should the MRFC do if it receives an SDP offer with the SDP "a=bw-info" attribute?
question_74746.ground_truth: If the MRFC receives an SDP offer containing the SDP "a=bw-info" attribute(s), the MRFC shall select the payload types, construct appropriate SDP "a=bw-info" attribute(s) and include the "Additional Bandwidth Properties" information element in the remote descriptor when requesting the MRFP to reserve resources.

question_74747.question: What is the role of the TERMINAL RESPONSE command in the PROACTIVE COMMAND: SEND USSD process?
question_74747.ground_truth: The TERMINAL RESPONSE command is sent from the network to the ME (Mobile Equipment) to indicate the result of the SEND USSD process.

question_74748.question: What is the unit used for the KPI of Data Volume per Energy Consumption (DV/EC) in the considered network elements?
question_74748.ground_truth: The unit used for the KPI of Data Volume per Energy Consumption (DV/EC) in the considered network elements is bit/J.

question_74750.question: Why are co-existence emissions requirements not specified for FR2 systems in release 15 of the TS 38.104?
question_74750.ground_truth: Co-existence emissions requirements are not specified for FR2 systems in release 15 of the TS 38.104 because the low number of FR2 bands makes co-existence unlikely, and the high path loss and beam forming nature of FR2 systems make interference between BS more unlikely.

question_74751.question: What information does T-CU-CP include in the F1-AP CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message to T-DU in step 6?
question_74751.ground_truth: T-CU-CP includes UE context information and CU-UP-UL-TEID for data radio bearers in the F1-AP CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message to T-DU in step 6.

question_74752.question: What is the pre-test condition for the number of cells in the Intra-NR measurements testing?
question_74752.ground_truth: The pre-test condition states that there are three cells in the Intra-NR measurements testing, where NR Cell 1 is the PCell, NR Cell 3 is the SCell, and NR Cell 12 is the intra-frequency neighbor cell of NR Cell 3.

question_74753.question: What is the reported range of RSRQ and its resolution?
question_74753.ground_truth: The reporting range of RSRQ is from -34 dB to 2.5 dB with 0.5 dB resolution.

question_74754.question: What component establishes the user plane tunnel in the network between the SGSN and the S-GW when there is 3G access via the S4 interface?

question_74755.question: What is the purpose of the Release SM Context service operation?
question_74755.ground_truth: The Release SM Context service operation is used to release the SM Context of a given PDU session in the SMF, V-SMF, or I-SMF during various network procedures such as registration, handover, or PDU session release.

question_74756.question: What message is sent by the ProSe Function in the HPLMN after receiving a Discovery Request in open discovery, if the ProSe Function of the local PLMN does not return any mask?
question_74756.ground_truth: The ProSe Function in the HPLMN notifies the UE that the Discovery Request has been rejected.

question_74757.question: How does a UE determine whether a single * in a Supplementary Service procedure is an activation or registration?
question_74757.ground_truth: A UE determines whether a single * in a Supplementary Service procedure is an activation or registration based on the context, such as whether it contains a forwarded-to number or not.

question_74758.question: What open issue does Solution #31 complement in terms of ACR and a centralized repository deployed in an ECSP provider?
question_74758.ground_truth: Solution #31 complements solution #27 and solution #30 when there is a centralized repository deployed in an ECSP provider.

question_74759.question: What is the role of the BVCI (BSSGP Virtual Connection Identifier) information element in the described network?
question_74759.ground_truth: The BVCI identifies a BVC in the network.

question_74760.question: How shorter TTI length and L1 overhead affect the performance gain in the context of UL latency reduction solutions?
question_74760.ground_truth: Shorter TTI and more L1 overhead lead to smaller performance gain in the context of UL latency reduction solutions.

question_74761.question: What information is specified in the parameter "time" for the method "startConnection()"?
question_74761.ground_truth: The parameter "time" for the method "startConnection()" specifies the granted time in milliseconds for the connection.

question_74762.question: What information is required for the LMF to determine the location of the MBSR's TRP?
question_74762.ground_truth: The LMF requires the updated location information of the TRP(s) associated with MBSRs. The LMF initiates the TRP Information Exchange procedure and requests the updated location information of the TRP(s) associated with MBSRs from the donor-CU through the gNB(s) associated with the Cell ID(s).

question_74763.question: What are the purposes of CAG IDs in 5G NR networks?
question_74763.ground_truth: CAG IDs in 5G NR networks indicate whether a cell is a CAG or PNI-NPN cell, allow cells with cellReservedForOtherUse=true to be considered as candidate cells for reselection, support CAG functionality with CU-DU split and CP-UP split, indicate NPN IDs in SIB1, and allow indication of TAC, RANAC, cell Identity per SNPN or per PNI-NPN in SIB1.

question_74765.question: What entity receives the request to create a PIN from the AMF?

question_74766.question: What happens if both ends perform a handover during a simultaneous Inter-BSS handover and break LCLS?
question_74766.ground_truth: Both handovers will leave LCLS not possible and resources are released from the serving BSS.

question_74768.question: What should the network do if it receives a LOCATION UPDATING REQUEST message with a protocol error?
question_74768.ground_truth: The network should, if possible, return a LOCATION UPDATING REJECT message with one of the specified Reject causes and then start the channel release procedure.

question_74769.question: In what scenarios cannot the RTP-based CMR be used?
question_74769.ground_truth: The RTP-based CMR cannot be used when it is disabled or for uni-directional media such as sendonly or recvonly.

question_74771.question: What is the purpose of the classmark updating procedure?
question_74771.ground_truth: The purpose of the classmark updating procedure is to inform the receiving entity about classmark information received from the MS.

question_74772.question: What is the difference between the "suppress OA" and "suppress preferential CUG" for the <CUG_info> parameter in the 7.34 Enhanced closed user group?
question_74772.ground_truth: "suppress OA" suppresses the outgoing access, while "suppress preferential CUG" suppresses the preferential closed user group.

question_74773.question: What is the purpose of PIN service continuity in a PIN?
question_74773.ground_truth: PIN service continuity in a PIN ensures that a PIN application on a user equipment (UE) can continue to receive services from an application server after it moves out of reach of a PIN element, such as PEGC or another PINE, due to mobility.

question_74774.question: What is the effect of turning off cDRX on downlink in terms of available delay budget for uplink retransmissions?
question_74774.ground_truth: Turning off cDRX on downlink can provide up to 40ms of additional delay budget for uplink and result in improved end-to-end performance in terms of PLR, delay reduction, and POLQA scores.

question_74775.question: What is the name of the cruise ship that Truman is embarking on for his voyage?

question_74777.question: Which reference point is used for unicast media exchange between the media distribution function of the MCPTT server and the media mixer of the MCPTT client in 5G System?
question_74777.ground_truth: The MCPTT-7 reference point is used for unicast media exchange between the media distribution function and the media mixer, and uses the N6 reference point in 5G System.

question_74778.question: What action does the SMF take upon receipt of a PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message and a PDU session ID?
question_74778.ground_truth: The SMF creates a PDU SESSION AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message and starts timer T3590.

question_74779.question: In which scenario should the SNRM-C send an MBMS listening status report with information related to TMGI 1 and TMGI 2 towards the SNRM-S?
question_74779.ground_truth: If the SNRM-C receives TMGI 1 and TMGI 2.

question_74780.question: What are the reference sensitivity requirements for RedCap UE in clause 7.3I.2 when supporting IE supportOfERedCap-r18 and eRedCapNotReducedBB-BW-r18?
question_74780.ground_truth: The REFSENS requirements for RedCap UE in clause 7.3I.2 apply.

question_74781.question: What command may be used to accept a network request for a PDP context activation?
question_74781.ground_truth: The V.250 'A' (Answer) command may be used to accept a network request for a PDP context activation announced by the unsolicited result code RING.

question_74784.question: What is the purpose of the NEF Anchored Group NIDD procedure via NEF anchored unicast MT data?
question_74784.ground_truth: The purpose of the NEF Anchored Group NIDD procedure via NEF anchored unicast MT data is to send a Group NIDD addressed to an External Group Identifier. The NEF uses the NEF anchored Mobile Terminated Data Transport procedure that is specified in steps 2-16 in clause 4.25.5 to send the MT NIDD to each UE in the group.

question_74785.question: What is the issue with establishing a NAS and AS security context for UEs connecting to the PARLOS portal?
question_74785.ground_truth: When a UE requests a PARLOS connection to a PLMN, and the UE is in unauthenticated or limited service state, the serving PLMN may not be able to obtain credentials for the UE from the HSS. This makes it impossible to establish a regular NAS and AS context, which are necessary for securing the NAS and AS communication.

question_74787.question: What information is held by the GCR for static broadcast call attributes?
question_74787.ground_truth: The GCR stores a list of static Broadcast Call Attributes for a given group call reference, which includes a list of cells, a list of group call relay MSCs or redundancy pools, information on the cipher algorithm and group key, information on the allowed codecs, a list of dispatcher identities, and eMLPP priority level.

question_74788.question: What is the impact of Solution #13 on UDR internal logic?
question_74788.ground_truth: For ensuring that AuthEvent containing newer result is allowed to be stored, the UDR internal logic is impacted.

question_74791.question: What is the target address for sending the monitoring event report in option A?
question_74791.ground_truth: The target address for sending the monitoring event report in option A is determined based on the target address for the event report using either 2.1 or 2.2.

question_74792.question: When should the UE include the target user info in the 5G ProSe direct link establishment procedure?
question_74792.ground_truth: When the target UE's application layer ID is received from upper layers or known based on the unicast layer-2 ID of the target UE, or if the user info ID of the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE is obtained during the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay discovery procedure.

question_74793.question: What is the procedure if a UE-originating request from an unregistered user does not match the highest priority initial filter criteria?
question_74793.ground_truth: The S-CSCF checks for matching of the following filter criteria priorities until one applies and, if no more (or none) of the initial filter criteria apply, forwards the request downstream based on the route decision.

question_74794.question: What information is included in the request when the target NF is UDM or AUSF?
question_74794.ground_truth: If the target NF is UDM or AUSF, the request may include the UE's Routing Indicator, Home Network Public Key identifier, UE's HNI: PLMN ID, PLMN ID + NID, Home Network Identifier in the form of a realm, and optionally the credentials owned by CH with AAA Server or in the case of SNPN Onboarding using a DCS with AAA Server.

question_74795.question: What is the purpose of allocating resources based on QoS and priority level in the FRMCS system?
question_74795.ground_truth: The aim is to ensure the required level of communication quality for the various kinds of railway applications.

question_74796.question: Which element contains the range information over which the UAV application message is to be sent?
question_74796.ground_truth: The "application-defined-proximity-range-info" element contains the range information over which the UAV application message is to be sent.

question_74797.question: Which entity determines whether a UE is within the 5G VN group service area before PDU session establishment?
question_74797.ground_truth: The SMF determines whether a UE is within the 5G VN group service area before PDU session establishment.

question_74800.question: What type of services support real-time exchange of 3D video information over mobile networks?
question_74800.ground_truth: 3D conversational services and multiple-party 3D video conference are the services that support real-time exchange of 3D video information over mobile networks.
