question_75164.ground_truth: If timer TU5002 expires in the MS, the MS will release the associated transport channel(s) if the MS needs to deactivate one or more transport channels for a specific domain.

question_75165.question: What is the objective of allowing 2 RX exception for vehicle mounted UEs in NR bands where 4 Rx is mandated?
question_75165.ground_truth: The objectives of allowing 2 RX exception for vehicle mounted UEs are to investigate the impact of 2Rx vehicle mounted UE on coverage and throughput and propose possible ways to avoid or minimize such impact. It also includes studying the methods to distinguish vehicular UE from handheld UE, defining vehicle mounted UEs, and verifying conformance and GCF certification.

question_75166.question: What does the "Scheduled IP Throughput in DL" measure in 4G E-UTRAN?
question_75166.ground_truth: The "Scheduled IP Throughput in DL" measures the volume of a data burst during IP throughput measurement in downlink, excluding the data transmitted in the TTI when the buffer is emptied. It is maintained separately for each QCI and measures the IP throughput between the eNodeB (or RN) and UEs.

question_75167.question: What method is used to inform the application that all requested call leg information has been sent and that the call leg object is destroyed?
question_75167.ground_truth: The callLegEnded() method is used for this purpose.

question_75168.question: What is the foreseen final state of the MS for an outgoing call when the MS has answered the call while having a held MultiParty call in 31.4.3.2 test procedure?
question_75168.ground_truth: Call A-B, state U10, auxiliary state "Call in MPTY, call held". Call A-C, state U10, auxiliary state "Call in MPTY, call held". Call A-D State U10.

question_75169.question: What is the requirement for the OTA interfering signal RMS field-strength at the base station RIB per polarization, as defined in MSR operation?
question_75169.ground_truth: The OTA interfering signal RMS field-strength shall be set to 0.36 V/m at the base station RIB per polarization.

question_75170.question: What is the role of the Service Enabler Architecture Layer for Verticals (SEAL) in the 3GPP system?
question_75170.ground_truth: The Service Enabler Architecture Layer for Verticals (SEAL) is a framework in the 3GPP system that specifies the capabilities and services to efficiently support storage and delivery for the application content/data for vertical applications.

question_75173.question: When should the UE start a back-off timer for the bearer resource allocation procedure with the value provided by the network or deactivate the respective back-off timer if the network includes the Re-attempt indicator IE indicating that re-attempt in an equivalent PLMN is not allowed for each combination of a PLMN from the equivalent PLMN list and the APN?
question_75173.ground_truth: The UE should start a back-off timer for the bearer resource allocation procedure with the value provided by the network or deactivate the respective back-off timer if the network includes the Re-attempt indicator IE indicating that re-attempt in an equivalent PLMN is not allowed for each combination of a PLMN from the equivalent PLMN list and the APN.

question_75174.question: How many frequencies can be included in the GSM Neighbour Cell list as per the conformance requirement?
question_75174.ground_truth: The GSM Neighbour Cell list may contain up to 96 GSM Neighbour Cells.

question_75175.question: What is the term for the unique ID assigned by the manager interface for each operation?
question_75175.ground_truth: The term for the unique ID assigned by the manager interface for each operation is assignment ID.

question_75179.question: What system can the Edge Enabler Server interact with to retrieve the location of the user equipment (UE) in the 3GPP network?
question_75179.ground_truth: The Edge Enabler Server can interact with 3GPP systems such as 5GS, EPS, through APIs exposed by SCEF/NEF, LCS, or NWDAF as specified in 3GPP TS 23.502.

question_75180.question: What is the role of ACM entities in processing incoming ACM commands, as specified in section 10.17.3?
question_75180.ground_truth: ACM entities process incoming ACM commands via manual or automatic methods, as defined in 3GPP TS 33.180.

question_75182.question: What is the HTTP status code that SMSF returns if MT SMS delivery fails due to SMSF internal errors?
question_75182.ground_truth: The HTTP status code that SMSF returns if MT SMS delivery fails due to SMSF internal errors is "500 Internal Server Error".

question_75183.question: What is the role of the MCPTT server of the primary MCPTT system in the broadcast temporary group call?
question_75183.ground_truth: The MCPTT server of the primary MCPTT system obtains the temporary group information, initiates directly a call request to the accessible group members, and provides a group call response message to the MCPTT client of the affiliated MCPTT user upon receiving responses to the call requests.

question_75184.question: What was the goal of the listening experiment in 5.2.3?
question_75184.ground_truth: The goal of the listening experiment in 5.2.3 was to detect the impact of a given set of HRTFs and an HpTF on the perceived externalization, coloration, and localization of discrete sound sources.

question_75186.question: What is the "Service Identifier" parameter used for in Solution #1e for correlating 5GS charging related messages with edge application?
question_75186.ground_truth: The "Service Identifier" parameter is used in Solution #1e for correlating 5GS charging related messages with edge application to identify the instance of the edge application and not only the identity of the service (e.g., edge computing service). This solution requires that the "Service Identifier" parameter is able to identify the instance of the edge application.

question_75187.question: What observation is specified for the repeated tests for the UE to send an Event A3 triggered measurement report in section 16.6.2.1.5?
question_75187.ground_truth: The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests should be at least 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_75190.question: What is the Cellular Text Telephone Modem (CTM) and what type of technology is it?
question_75190.ground_truth: The Cellular Text Telephone Modem (CTM) is a technology that is used for reliable transmission of text telephone text via the speech channel of cellular or PSTN networks. It is a general technology, independent of text telephone types.

question_75191.question: What standard HTTP headers are used in the HTTP bodies specified in this specification, as per clause 6.4.2.2.1?
question_75191.ground_truth: Clause 5.2.2 of 3GPP TS 29.500 specifies the usage of HTTP standard headers, which are applicable to the HTTP bodies specified in this specification, as per clause 6.4.2.2.1.

question_75193.question: What should a mobile station do if the BC-IE received from the network contains the parameters 'fixed network user rate', 'other modem type', and 'user initiated modification' in the circuit switched set-up?
question_75193.ground_truth: The MS has two options: a) discard these parameters in the call confirmed message, or b) include the possibly modified values for the 'fixed network user rate' and 'other modem type' in the BC-IE of the call confirmed message, and include additional parameters for non-transparent services.

question_75196.question: When is an EEC Context created during a successful EEC registration at the receiver EES?
question_75196.ground_truth: The receiver EES creates an EEC Context after a successful registration, with the EEC ID and UE ID set based on the registration request parameters.

question_75197.question: What are the conditions for the determination of the serving cell for counting PDCCH candidates and a corresponding number of non-overlapping CCEs if a UE monitors PDCCH candidates on a scheduling cell for scheduling on serving cells from a set of serving cells?
question_75197.ground_truth: The determination of the serving cell for counting PDCCH candidates and a corresponding number of non-overlapping CCEs is dependent on the inclusion of the scheduling cell in the set of serving cells and the provision of search space sets for PDCCH candidates on the serving cell and scheduling cell.

question_75199.question: What information does the Downlink Channel Quality Report Command MAC Control Element contain, and what is its size?
question_75199.ground_truth: The Downlink Channel Quality Report Command MAC Control Element has a fixed size of zero bits and does not contain any information. It is used to activate the Downlink Channel Quality Report MAC control element.

question_75201.question: What is the name of the message that shall be sent on the S5/S8 interface by the PGW to the SGW when a Downlink Data Notification Acknowledge message is received with the Context not found cause value?

question_75202.question: Which information is encapsulated in the an-APDU MAP parameter of the Prepare-Handover MAP request?
question_75202.ground_truth: The RELOCATION REQUEST message and, if tracing activity has been invoked, the trace related messages are encapsulated in the an-APDU MAP parameter of the Prepare-Handover MAP request.

question_75203.question: What action does the UE take when it detects that the ngKSI received in the authentication request message is already in use?
question_75203.ground_truth: The UE rejects the core network and returns an authentication failure message with a 5GMM cause value indicating the reason for the failure (in this case, 5GMM cause #71 "ngKSI already in use").

question_75204.question: What is the required number of successful tests in 8.2.3.1.4.2 for the test to pass?
question_75204.ground_truth: The required number of successful tests is equal to 90% of the total number of tests, with a confidence level of 95%.

question_75205.question: What is the purpose of the Broadcast Channel (BCH) in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_75205.ground_truth: The Broadcast Channel (BCH) is a downlink transport channel used to broadcast system- and cell-specific information to all UEs within a cell.

question_75206.question: What message is used to perform handover from GERAN A/Gb mode/GAN mode to UTRAN and is sent within the PS Handover Command message for PS handover from GERAN A/Gb mode or within the GA-PSR Handover Command message for PS handover from GAN mode?
question_75206.ground_truth: The Handover to UTRAN Command message

question_75208.question: What should the MS do after receiving a command from the System Simulator within T200?
question_75208.ground_truth: The MS should respond to the command within T200.

question_75209.question: What happens after the MS receives the PS Handover Command message?
question_75209.ground_truth: The MS associates its RAB IDs to the respective PFIs based on the NSAPI, suspends uplink transmission of user plane data, and accesses the cell using access bursts.

question_75210.question: In section 6.7.2.4.2 of the document, what is the recommended resolution bandwidth (RBW) filter setting for measuring the spectrum of a transmitted signal?
question_75210.ground_truth: The recommended resolution bandwidth (RBW) filter setting for measuring the spectrum of a transmitted signal is 30 kHz or less.

question_75211.question: In what state is the UE when it has requested release of the EMM context by starting the detach procedure and is waiting for a response from the MME?

question_75213.question: What information does the L1 header of SACCH from UE to network carry?
question_75213.ground_truth: The L1 header of SACCH from UE to network carries information of timing advance and UE uplink transmission power level.

question_75214.question: What message format does an SNRM-C include in the HTTP POST request when initiating network assisted QoS management for UE communications?
question_75214.ground_truth: The SNRM-C includes an application/vnd.3gpp.seal-network-QoS-management-info+xml MIME body with the <network-QoS-management-info> root element in the HTTP POST request message.

question_75215.question: How many CLUE data channels can be established per SCTP association in telepresence support?
question_75215.ground_truth: Only one CLUE data channel can be established per SCTP association in telepresence support.

question_75216.question: What action should a PCRF take when it receives a non-initial message for which no Diameter session exists?
question_75216.ground_truth: It should discard the message and return a Diameter error indication to the originating PCRF client.

question_75218.question: What should the PCF invoke if it includes more than one transfer policy?
question_75218.ground_truth: The PCF should wait for the transfer policy selected by the NF service consumer.

question_75219.question: What should the AMF and UE do to recover from a failure to align the NAS security contexts due to a state mis-match between AMF and UE?
question_75219.ground_truth: The AMF can align the security contexts in use on the 3GPP and non-3GPP access using the NAS SMC procedure during a subsequent registration procedure. This can either be initiated by the UE or sent in response to a Service Reject if the UE sends a Service Request.

question_75220.question: In the scenario where the session starts in 3GPP access, what is required for the PDN GW to consider the bearers of the PDN connection being handed over as resumed and perform the handover?
question_75220.ground_truth: The PDN GW considers the bearers of the PDN connection being handed over as resumed and performs the handover when it receives the Proxy Binding Update and the corresponding PS bearers are suspended.

question_75221.question: What are the main objectives of the centralized HNB power control approach?
question_75221.ground_truth: The main objectives are to optimize system performance, communicate with HNBs at a slower or faster time-scale, and not rely on all HNBs being able to "hear" the network for the network command.

question_75222.question: What is the relationship between the correlations of DS and AS, SF and AS, and SF and DS, in the intra-site correlation matrix?
question_75222.ground_truth: The correlation between DS & AS is +0.5, between SF & AS is -0.6, and between SF & DS is -0.6.

question_75225.question: How are the UEM values for LA MSR BS class determined in the UTRA and E-UTRA bandwidths greater than or equal to 5MHz?
question_75225.ground_truth: The UEM values of LA E-UTRA bandwidth greater than or equal to 5MHz are stricter than the LA UTRA UEM values, so they are suggested to be adopted for LA MSR BC1 UEM values.

question_75226.question: What should the MS do upon receiving a GA-RRC PAGING REQUEST message in GA-RRC-CONNECTED state for the indicated domain?
question_75226.ground_truth: The MS should ignore the GA-RRC PAGING REQUEST message and continue with any ongoing procedure as if it was not received.

question_75227.question: What type of payload can be transported using the NAS transport procedures between the UE and the AMF?
question_75227.ground_truth: The NAS transport procedures can transport payloads such as a single 5GSM message, SMS, or an LPP message, and optional associated payload routing information.

question_75230.question: What should the floor control server interface do when it receives a Floor Granted message from the controlling MCPTT function?
question_75230.ground_truth: It should send the Floor Granted message to the identified floor participant interface, update the floor queue, and potentially send a Floor Taken or Floor Idle message based on the received Floor Granted message.

question_75234.question: What action should the P-CSCF take when receiving a 1xx or 2xx response to a request, if a security association exists and a session needs to be released?
question_75234.ground_truth: The P-CSCF replaces the Contact header field value with a new one, such that it can release the session if needed, only if a 1xx or 2xx response will be received for the request.

question_75235.question: What is used to negotiate the details of supported media streams and the maximum capability of each of those streams for CLUE?
question_75235.ground_truth: SDP is used for this negotiation.

question_75236.question: What is the purpose of the P-Access-Network-Info header field in the INVITE request due to STN-SR?
question_75236.ground_truth: The P-Access-Network-Info header field identifies the location of the UE in the 3G access network, the time-zone and daylight saving on that location.

question_75237.question: Which 3GPP signal level is considered for revealing higher layer UE bugs affecting throughput in non-fading single-path conditions?

question_75238.question: What will the UE do if it would simultaneously transmit on the UL and receive on the SL in two respective carriers and the UE is not capable of simultaneous transmission on the UL and reception on the SL in the two respective carriers?
question_75238.ground_truth: The UE transmits on UL or receives on SL, with the higher priority.

question_75239.question: What is an exception requirement for both NR and E-UTRA for the minimum conformance requirements for intra-band contiguous EN-DC within FR1 with 3 DL CCs?
question_75239.ground_truth: An exception requirement for both NR and E-UTRA is that the LTE anchor agnostic approach is not applied. E-UTRA test point analysis is included, and E-UTRA measurements are performed.

question_75240.question: What was the smallest percentage increase in beam prediction accuracy for a 960ms prediction time, as reported by the evaluation results from 1 source?
question_75240.ground_truth: There was a 10.6% prediction accuracy increase for a 960ms prediction time.

question_75242.question: What should the NF Service Consumer do when the default EPS bearer ID is the same as an existing SM context for the POST request?
question_75242.ground_truth: The NF Service Consumer shall store the association of the PDU Session ID and the SMF ID, and store the allocated EBI(s) associated to the PDU Session ID.

question_75243.question: How many times does the MS resend the PDP CONTEXT ACTIVATION REQUEST when the network does not reply to the request, as specified in 45.2.4.1.1?
question_75243.ground_truth: The MS resends the PDP CONTEXT ACTIVATION REQUEST five times on the expiry of the timer T3380.

question_75246.question: What should the UE do if the back-off timer value received along with the S-NSSAI in the rejected NSSAI for the maximum number of UEs reached is not zero?
question_75246.ground_truth: The UE should stop the timer T3526 associated with the S-NSSAI, start the timer T3526 with the received back-off timer value, and remove the S-NSSAI from the rejected NSSAI for the maximum number of UEs reached when the timer T3526 associated with the S-NSSAI expires.

question_75247.question: How does a UE determine an index of a PSFCH resource for a PSFCH transmission with HARQ-ACK information in response to a PSSCH reception?
question_75247.ground_truth: The UE determines the index as (PID+MID) mod RPRB,CSPEFCH where PID is the physical layer source ID provided by SCI format 2 scheduling the PSSCH reception, and MID is the identity of the UE receiving the PSSCH as indicated by higher layers if the UE detects a SCI format 2 with Cast type indicator field value of "01"; otherwise, MID is zero.

question_75249.question: What is the purpose of the INVITE message that the RUA of the ICCF sends to the S-CSCF in step 9?
question_75249.ground_truth: The INVITE message is used to initiate a session towards party B, and it contains the 200 OK from step 8.

question_75250.question: What is the test purpose of the intermodulation characteristics in the 7,68 Mcps TDD option?
question_75250.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify the ability of the BS receiver to inhibit the generation of intermodulation products in its non-linear elements caused by the presence of two high-level interfering signals at frequencies with a specific relationship to the frequency of the wanted signal.

question_75252.question: What is the 256-bit key used for when wrapping key material in the procedure for key provisioning between the MCPTT KMS and the key management client?
question_75252.ground_truth: The 256-bit key used for wrapping key material in the procedure for key provisioning between the MCPTT KMS and the key management client is called the Transport Key (TrK).

question_75253.question: What is the purpose of the "DN priorities for appDomains" information and how is it used in the 5G core network?
question_75253.ground_truth: The "DN priorities for appDomains" information is used to provide the 5GC with information about the relative precedence of data to use to reach different domains based on the UE location and DNN/S-NSSAI negotiated with the operator. This information is used to control the DNS resolver used by the UE, enforce URSP rules based on the relative precedence of DNN/S-NSSAI, and set preferences for internet applications reachable via both a specific DNN and S-NSSAI.

question_75254.question: How are the terms "shall" and "shall not" used in the present document?
question_75254.ground_truth: In the present document, "shall" indicates a mandatory requirement to do something, while "shall not" indicates a prohibition to do something.

question_75255.question: How does the NAS SMC procedure behave when UE is in idle state and MTC-IWF sends IWF SMC?
question_75255.ground_truth: If UE is in idle state, MME can run an empty NAS SMC only for carrying the IWF SMC procedure if it receives the IWF SMC from MTC-IWF before the timer in MME expires.

question_75256.question: What is the main difference between the extension described in clause 6.1 and the one in 6.2.2 for IMS emergency calls?
question_75256.ground_truth: In 6.1, the call is redirected back to the UE, while in 6.2.2, the initial serving IMS Core forwards the call to an alternative IMS Core.

question_75257.question: What is the function of mapping between DDI (Data Description Indicator) fields and MAC-d flows in MAC-es entity?
question_75257.ground_truth: The mapping between the DDI (Data Description Indicator) fields and the MAC-d flows and MAC-d PDU size is provided to the Node B by the SRNC. This mapping allows MAC-e PDU demultiplexing to form MAC-es PDUs aimed for one or more MAC-d flows.

question_75258.question: What is the purpose of the Vs reference point?
question_75258.ground_truth: The Vs reference point supports the interactions related to V2X application layer support functions between the VAE server and the V2X application specific server.

question_75259.question: What is the group notification mechanism used for when there is no data to be sent for a multicast session in RRC IDLE/INACTIVE state?
question_75259.ground_truth: The group notification mechanism is used to notify the UEs in RRC IDLE/INACTIVE state when a multicast session has been activated by the CN or the gNB has multicast session data to deliver. Upon reception of the group notification, the UEs reconnect to the network.

question_75260.question: What is the gain in using post-decoding NAIC in a low load scenario?
question_75260.ground_truth: There are no significant benefits in using post-decoding NAIC in low load scenarios.

question_75263.question: If the outgoing Request-URI is a SIP URI with the user part starting with a plus sign and the user SIP URI parameter equals "phone", what should the S-CSCF do if local policy indicates that the procedure should be performed?
question_75263.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should translate the international public telecommunications number contained in the user part of the SIP URI to a globally routeable SIP URI using either an ENUM/DNS translation mechanism or any other available database. If the translation succeeds, the S-CSCF should update the Request-URI with the globally routeable SIP URI. If the translation fails, the S-CSCF should forward the request to a BGCF or any other appropriate entity in the originator's home network or send an appropriate SIP response to the originator.

question_75268.question: What is the main focus of Approach 1 in the "Number of CWs per TP" category?
question_75268.ground_truth: Approach 1 in the "Number of CWs per TP" category aims to save signaling overhead by restricting each TP to transmit only one CW.

question_75270.question: What is the purpose of ADC Rule authorization in the context of TDF session?
question_75270.ground_truth: It determines which predefined and/or dynamic ADC rules to activate for a TDF session and involves the selection of parameters for dynamic ADC rules.

question_75271.question: What is the effect of the PDN GW initiated resource releasing procedure on the connections and PDN address when it is performed due to a handover?
question_75271.ground_truth: When the PDN GW initiated resource releasing procedure is performed due to a handover, the connections associated with the PDN address are released, but the PDN address is kept in the PDN GW.

question_75272.question: How is an application notified of available Service Capability Features in the OSA environment?
question_75272.ground_truth: The Framework informs the Applications about available Service Capability Features upon request. This is done through registering Service Capability Features offered by a Service Capability Server at the Framework.

question_75273.question: Which two IDs are mandatory in the PositioningMeasurementResponseIEs F1AP-Protocol-IES?
question_75273.ground_truth: id-TransactionID and id-LMF-MeasurementID are the two IDs that are mandatory in the PositioningMeasurementResponseIEs F1AP-Protocol-IES.

question_75274.question: Which information element specifies the addressed application within the target BSS node?
question_75274.ground_truth: The RIM Application Identity information element

question_75276.question: Under which conditions can the UE initiate Session Management procedures for a specific S-NSSAI while the back-off timer is not associated to any S-NSSAI?
question_75276.ground_truth: The UE may initiate Session Management procedures for a specific S-NSSAI while the back-off timer is not associated to any S-NSSAI.

question_75277.question: What stores the UE Radio Access Capability Information received from the eNodeB without any truncation and has a maximum S1-AP SCTP packet size of 65535 bytes?

question_75278.question: What does the resourceOperationalState field represent in the HS-DSCH-Resources-Information-AuditRsp field?
question_75278.ground_truth: The resourceOperationalState field indicates whether a resource is currently in use or available for allocation.

question_75282.question: What is the name of the transmission point that transmits PDCCH, synchronization signals, PBCH, and PDSCH in the scenario with non-coherent joint transmission from two transmission points?

question_75283.question: What is the objective of the Thresholds node inside the ThresholdConditions node?
question_75283.ground_truth: The Thresholds node acts as a placeholder for all 3GPP and WLAN access thresholds to be considered while evaluating the RANValidityCondition node.

question_75285.question: What is the data destination address used for in the UICC/ME interface?
question_75285.ground_truth: The data destination address is used as the end point destination address for sent data when a UICC/ME interface transport is present.

question_75287.question: What condition must be fulfilled for a Floor request granted message to be sent back to the transmitting users?
question_75287.ground_truth: The MCPTT Group Call commencement conditions must be fulfilled.

question_75288.question: What should the UE include in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message during inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode?
question_75288.ground_truth: The UE shall include the eKSI indicating the 5G NAS security context value in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

question_75289.question: What was agreed for Sub-Topic 3-3 during the GTW session on the 5th of November?
question_75289.ground_truth: The agreed condition for Sub-Topic 3-3 during the GTW session on the 5th of November is that PC1.5 should be allowed extra 3dB only because of power class declaration.

question_75290.question: What should the floor participant do when receiving a Floor Granted message or a floor granted indication in an SIP 200 (OK) response in the application and signalling layer?
question_75290.ground_truth: The floor participant should provide floor granted notification to the user, if not already done, and enter the 'U: has permission' state.

question_75291.question: What is the CSE initiated call release procedure in CAMEL?
question_75291.ground_truth: The CSE initiated call release procedure in CAMEL enables the CSE to initiate a call release at any moment of the call. It can be used if the originating VPLMN has reported an initial service event to the CSE and is waiting for instructions, or if the CSE is waiting for the report of a subsequent service event.

question_75292.question: What is the MIME type of the alternative content in the third example User Service Description?
question_75292.ground_truth: The MIME type of the alternative content in the third example User Service Description is "application/dash+xml;profiles=urn:3GPP:PSS:profile:DASH10".

question_75293.question: What is the base interface that all application, framework, and service interfaces inherit from in this API?

question_75294.question: What is the name of the redundancy mode for IAB-nodes operating in SA-mode?

question_75296.question: What is the maximum RF bandwidth supported by a Base Station within an operating band, as defined in the document?
question_75296.ground_truth: The maximum Base Station RF bandwidth is the maximum RF bandwidth supported by a BS within an operating band.

question_75297.question: What is the effect of the "setCallback" method in the subconference interface?
question_75297.ground_truth: The "setCallback" method in the subconference interface changes the callback interface reference.

question_75298.question: In which mode does a UE operate if CRS is transmitted over a 6-PRB bandwidth within the cell bandwidth in a subframe comprised in any non-zero length T1?
question_75298.ground_truth: The UE operates in HD-FDD mode if CRS is transmitted over a 6-PRB bandwidth within the cell bandwidth in a subframe comprised in any non-zero length T1.

question_75300.question: What is the meaning of "shall" in the context of stage 2 and stage 3 of generic management services for mobile network in the present document?
question_75300.ground_truth: In the present document, "shall" in the context of stage 2 and stage 3 of generic management services for mobile network may indicate a mandatory requirement to do something, but only in the context of normative provisions. It is used to define CRUD operations for managing managed objects and notifications to report changes related to managed objects and their attributes.

question_75303.question: Under what conditions is an MCVideo emergency alert cancellation request considered to be an authorized request?
question_75303.ground_truth: An MCVideo emergency alert cancellation request is considered to be an authorized request if the "<allow-cancel-emergency-alert>" element of the "actions" element of a "rule" element of the MCVideo user profile document identified by the MCVideo ID of the calling MCVideo user is set to a value of "true". In all other cases, it is considered to be an unauthorized request.

question_75305.question: What is one of the functions specific to the New RAN for supporting network slicing?

question_75306.question: Which technical specifications in 3GPP cover the user identity-related aspects of this use case?
question_75306.ground_truth: TS 22.173, TS 22.101, and TS 22.261 are the technical specifications in 3GPP that cover the user identity-related aspects of this use case.

question_75307.question: What is the requirement for the event triggered measurement reporting delay in this test?
question_75307.ground_truth: The event triggered measurement reporting delay, measured without L3 filtering, should be less than Tidentify_intra_FS3_DRX, with an additional delay possible if L3 filtering is used or if other conditions are met.

question_75308.question: What changes are required in the 3GPP system nodes when the new steering mode with duplication criteria is applied?
question_75308.ground_truth: SMF, PCF, UPF, UE, and NEF need to be updated to support the new steering mode and its optional traffic duplication criteria. The SMF creates ATSSS and N4 rules with the new steering mode data and updates the nodes for downlink and uplink traffic. The AF can request start and stop of traffic duplication and provide traffic duplication parameter if necessary.

question_75309.question: What is the purpose of the sticker-form factor Ambient IoT device attached to the RTIs in the described supply chain use case?
question_75309.ground_truth: The purpose of the Ambient IoT device is to monitor and ensure the product expected longevity of the food products in the RTIs, and provide real-time demand-based routing of Fresh products, as well as alerting the relevant parties if temperature is compromised or if product mix-up occurs. The device also helps in reducing food waste and improving food safety.

question_75310.question: What is a purpose of point set registration in augmented reality?
question_75310.ground_truth: The purpose is to find a spatial transformation that aligns two point sets and merge multiple data sets into a globally consistent model, or map a new measurement to a known data set to identify features or to estimate its pose.

question_75312.question: What is the definition of measurement reporting delay in the context of E-UTRAN FDD-event triggered reporting?
question_75312.ground_truth: Measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between an event that triggers a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface.

question_75313.question: What does GMSK stand for in the document?
question_75313.ground_truth: GMSK stands for Gaussian Minimum Shift Keying, a type of modulation method used in the GSM standards.

question_75314.question: What is the spurious response defined for NR V2X as per existing specification?
question_75314.ground_truth: Spurious response is defined as the receiver's ability to receive a wanted signal on its assigned channel frequency without exceeding a given degradation due to the presence of an unwanted CW interfering signal at any other frequency at which a response is obtained.

question_75317.question: What are the main requirements for the system to provide ICS in different domains?
question_75317.ground_truth: The main requirements are that the system shall be capable to provide ICS to the UE when it uses CS domain for both media transport and session signalling, and the system shall be capable to provide ICS to the UE when it uses PS domain for session signalling and CS domain for media transport and session signalling.

question_75318.question: What abnormal case is the trigger for the UE to inform the upper layers of the failure of the procedure or attempt initial registration for emergency services?
question_75318.ground_truth: The first expiry of timer T3580 when the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message was sent with request type set to "initial emergency request" or "existing emergency PDU session".

question_75319.question: How can HNB OAM system send neighbor cell information to the RNC for target cell disambiguation?
question_75319.ground_truth: The HNB OAM system can send this information to the RNC OAM system, which can then pass it to the RNC to either speed up creation of a neighbor cell database or maintain such a database.

question_75320.question: Which SSC mode has specific IP continuity support when using IPv4, IPv6, or IPv4v6 type PDU Sessions?
question_75320.ground_truth: SSC mode 1 has specific IP continuity support when using IPv4, IPv6, or IPv4v6 type PDU Sessions.

question_75322.question: What SL PRS measurements are being introduced for sidelink positioning?
question_75322.ground_truth: The SL PRS measurements being introduced for sidelink positioning are SL Rx-Tx time difference measurement, SL RSTD measurement, SL RSRP measurement, SL RSRPP measurement, SL RTOA measurement, and SL Azimuth and Zenith angle of Arrival measurements.

question_75323.question: What is the length of a soccer field in yards?

question_75324.question: What is the purpose of using a separate MBMS bearer for control messages?
question_75324.ground_truth: Using a separate MBMS bearer for control messages, such as call and floor control messages, allows efficient delivery of MC application level control signaling without the need for immediate MC service UE location reports when moving between MBMS SAIs. This improves the management MC service servers for making proper decisions regarding communication traffic distribution among the utilized MBMS bearers.

question_75325.question: What happens if the detach procedure is aborted due to lower layer failure or release of the NAS signalling connection before reception of DETACH ACCEPT message?
question_75325.ground_truth: The UE proceeds to the EMM-NULL state, EMM-DEREGISTERED state, EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE state, or EMM-DEREGISTERED state and MM-NULL state, based on the reason for the detach request.

question_75327.question: Under what conditions does the 3GPP network system send a monitoring response to the VAE server?
question_75327.ground_truth: The 3GPP network system sends a monitoring response to the VAE server indicating the success or failure for initiating monitoring of network situation and QoS for the requested information.

question_75328.question: What message should the MME send during inter-MME mobility to transfer the PGW Change Info to the target MME?
question_75328.ground_truth: The MME should include the PGW Change Info in the MME/SGSN/AMF UE EPS PDN Connections IE from the source AMF to the target MME, if available.

question_75329.question: What is the impact of RF switching time on the minimum number of unmuted repetitions of a PRS resource instance for RSTD, RSTD based on aggregated PRS resources from multiple PFLs, PRS-RSRP, UE Rx-Tx time difference, and PRS-RSRPP, DL RSCPD reported with RSTD, DL RSCP reported with UE Rx-Tx time difference measurements?
question_75329.ground_truth: The minimum number of unmuted repetitions of a PRS resource instance for RSTD, RSTD based on aggregated PRS resources from multiple PFLs, PRS-RSRP, UE Rx-Tx time difference, and PRS-RSRPP, DL RSCPD reported with RSTD, DL RSCP reported with UE Rx-Tx time difference measurements is taken into account while considering the RF switching time, RF switching time is excluded while considering MGL for deciding the overlapping of PRS resource instances with measurement gaps.

question_75330.question: What is the recommended 'maxptime' value in TS 24.229 for defining the 'maxprate' parameter as an optional SDP parameter?
question_75330.ground_truth: The recommended 'maxptime' value in TS 24.229 is 240 ms.

question_75332.question: What is the function of the EPS bearer ID in a Diameter ASR message?
question_75332.ground_truth: The EPS bearer ID in a Diameter ASR message identifies the particular bearer to be terminated. The absence of the EPS bearer ID in the message indicates that all bearers/resources for this particular user and sharing the same user session shall be deleted.

question_75333.question: What is the procedure for sending a discovery message using Model B in ProSe discovery?
question_75333.ground_truth: When using Model B, the UE or application announces a discovery message indicating "Model B (request)" in the Discovery model field, and carrying the ProSe UE Identity and/or ProSe Application Identity of the discoveree UE or Group in the Content field. If the Type field is set to 3, the request contains the ProSe Application Identity in addition to either the ProSe UE Identity or ProSe Group Identity.

question_75334.question: What needs to be met to support the redundant transmission in home routed roaming scenario?
question_75334.ground_truth: To support the redundant transmission in home routed roaming scenario, the V-SMF selects two intermediate UPFs and sets up the redundant transmission tunnels on N3 and N9. This request requires two disjointed transport paths to exist between I-UPF and PSA UPF.

question_75336.question: When can the UE reselect to its HPLMN upon moving towards a shared RAN where at least one participating operator is the UE's Home operator?
question_75336.ground_truth: Upon the operator's policy, the UE shall be able to reselect to its HPLMN when moving towards a shared RAN, even if the old registered PLMN is still available, but only if the UE is in automatic network selection mode.

question_75338.question: Which type name indicates the AMF capabilities?

question_75339.question: What should the UE do when it receives N310 consecutive "out-of-sync" indications for the SpCell from lower layers due to radio link failure?
question_75339.ground_truth: The UE should start timer T310 for the corresponding SpCell, and upon timer expiry, initiate the NR SCG failure information procedure to report SCGFailureInformationNR with failure type set to 't310-Expiry'.

question_75340.question: What is the mechanism used in in-game communications to provide each player with a 3D audio scene that matches their 3D visual scene?
question_75340.ground_truth: Each player obtains the audio signals of its nearest players and a local audio rendering client renders those signals at the relative positions provided by the game engine.

question_75341.question: What is the difference between a single network operator environment and a multi-operator environment in terms of SIP Transfer of Charging Information?
question_75341.ground_truth: In a single network operator environment, both the CDP and CGP are located in the same network, while in a multi-operator environment, they are located in different networks.

question_75342.question: What type of modulation is used in EGPRS2-B, as defined in 3GPP TS 45.004 clause 5?

question_75343.question: What message does the IWF2 receive from the HSS in the first step of the "Purge" procedure in a one IWF scenario?
question_75343.ground_truth: The IWF receives a PUR message from the MME, SGSN, or combined MME/SGSN in the first step of the "Purge" procedure in a one IWF scenario.

question_75345.question: What are the minimum conformance requirements for the TDD-TDD inter-frequency test in CRS based discovery signal?
question_75345.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements for the TDD-TDD inter-frequency test in CRS based discovery signal are the same as the minimum conformance requirements for TDD UE release 12 and forward, and support for FGI bit 16 and 25.

question_75347.question: What is the performance requirement for preamble detection in PRACH in 8.4.1.1?
question_75347.ground_truth: The performance requirement for PRACH for preamble detection is determined by the two parameters: total probability of false detection of the preamble (Pfa) and the probability of detection of preamble (Pd). The performance is measured by the required SNR at probability of detection, Pd of 99%. Pfa shall be 0.1% or less.

question_75349.question: What is the data type of the "anyExt" element in the complex types defined in the provided XML schema?
question_75349.ground_truth: The "anyExt" element in the complex types defined in the provided XML schema is of the data type "anyExtType", which is defined elsewhere in the schema.

question_75350.question: What is the purpose of testing the MS with varying signal strength values?
question_75350.ground_truth: The purpose of testing the MS with varying signal strength values is to verify that the MS meets conformance requirements 1.1 (measurement accuracy), 1.2 (minimum number of measurements), and 1.3 (uniformity of measurement samples).

question_75352.question: Which standards and guidelines should be followed while defining Web Service messages and interfaces in Parlay X Web Services?
question_75352.ground_truth: Parlay X Web Services should follow Web Services standards, including SOAP, XML, and HTTP as per the WS-I Basic Profile. Web Service interfaces are to be defined using WSDL 1.1, adhering to the WS-I Basic Profile. Security requirements can be met through Virtual Private Networks or Transport Level Security using HTTP over TLS.

question_75353.question: What is the function of the Discovery Query Filter in Model B restricted discovery?
question_75353.ground_truth: The Discovery Query Filter is used to monitor a query in Model B restricted discovery.

question_75355.question: What is the principle applies for PDU Session transfer from 5GC to EPC for UE operating in dual-registration mode?
question_75355.ground_truth: UE operating in Dual Registration mode may register in EPC ahead of any PDU Session transfer using the Attach procedure indicating that the UE is moving from 5GC without establishing a PDN Connection in EPC if the EPC supports EPS Attach without PDN Connectivity.

question_75356.question: What is SCEF-Reference-ID used for in Architecture Enhancements for Service Exposure (AESE)?
question_75356.ground_truth: SCEF-Reference-ID is used to uniquely identify an event created by an SCEF in AESE.

question_75357.question: What is a Managed Object (MO) in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_75357.ground_truth: A Managed Object (MO) is an abstract entity that represents a Network Resource (NR) in a 3GPP core network for the purpose of management. It is an instance of a Managed Object Class (MOC) as defined in a Management Information Model (MIM). The MIM describes the interface to the MO, including its attributes, operations, notifications, and behavior.

question_75358.question: What is one of the benefits of using both broader and narrower bandwidth pulse shaping for different VAMOS users as per the suggested adaptation scheme?
question_75358.ground_truth: The benefit of using both broader and narrower bandwidth pulse shaping for different VAMOS users is that each user can improve their performance based on their specific RF power and C/I needs.

question_75359.question: What resource does the UDM return if the "plmn-id" is not included in the request?
question_75359.ground_truth: The UDM returns the trace data for the SUPI associated with the HPLMN.

question_75360.question: What state does the MME enter after sending the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message?

question_75361.question: What are the benefits of the new QoS limitations solution?
question_75361.ground_truth: The benefits include enabling high-latency satellite backhaul connections to be used in combination with the standardized 5GS UPF selection mechanism, providing a mixture of UPFs with varying QoS limitations, and supporting various deployment scenarios involving terrestrial or satellite backhauls.

question_75362.question: What is the purpose of the 5GS synchronization for time synchronization?
question_75362.ground_truth: The 5GS synchronization provides the 5G internal system clock to the DS-TT (data-stream user) for time synchronization. The UE forwards the 5G internal system clock to the DS-TT for this purpose.

question_75363.question: What is the purpose of the "Allowed NSSAI" IE?
question_75363.ground_truth: The "Allowed NSSAI" IE contains the allowed NSSAI.

question_75364.question: What is the role of the MME in the EPS?
question_75364.ground_truth: The MME is the control plane entity within EPS that supports various functions such as mobility management, NAS signalling and security, inter-CN node signalling, tracking area list management, PDN GW and Serving GW selection, roaming, authentication, bearer management functions, and lawful interception of signalling traffic.

question_75365.question: What is used for addressing at the LLC layer?

question_75366.question: What is the point at which the TRXUA connects with the RDN in a BS type 1-H radio architecture called?
question_75366.ground_truth: The point where a TXU or RXU connects with the RDN is called "Transceiver Array Boundary connector" (TAB connector).

question_75367.question: What is the role of the NR-NS-PmaxList field in the NR-MultiBandInfo component in the MultiFrequencyBandListNR-SIB?
question_75367.ground_truth: The NR-NS-PmaxList field in the NR-MultiBandInfo component in the MultiFrequencyBandListNR-SIB indicates the list of NR-NS-Pmax values, which are common for all NR frequency bands in the MultiFrequencyBandListNR-SIB. The NR-NS-PmaxList field is OPTIONAL.

question_75368.question: What should a UE do when the network cannot accept an attach request with attach type not set to "EPS emergency attach" and including a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message with request type set to "emergency" and receives the AUTHENTICATION REJECT message?
question_75368.ground_truth: The UE should inform the upper layers of the failure of the procedure, and then attempt EPS attach for emergency bearer services including the PDN CONNECTIVITY if the UE is in the same selected PLMN where the last attach request was attempted.

question_75374.question: When is the MCVideo server required to send an MCVideo ringing to MCVideo client 1?
question_75374.ground_truth: The MCVideo server sends an MCVideo ringing to MCVideo client 1 when MCVideo client 2 is alerted and has accepted the incoming call, indicating that MCVideo client 2 is being notified.

question_75375.question: What layer does the Nq-AP protocol use for encoding messages in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_75375.ground_truth: The Nq-AP protocol uses a Type, Length and Value (TLV) encoding of messages over an SCTP transport.

question_75376.question: What should the SME (Short Message Entity) do if it does not receive a response or an RP-ERROR with an appropriate cause value after an SMS-SUBMIT?
question_75376.ground_truth: The SME should automatically repeat the SMS-SUBMIT using the same TP-MR value and set the TP-RD bit to 1. The number of automatic attempts is in the range of 1 to 3.

question_75377.question: What does the "Bandwidth" leaf node represent in the end-to-end SDP negotiation process?
question_75377.ground_truth: The "Bandwidth" leaf node represents the bit rate in bits/sec for either the speech or video part used in the end-to-end SDP negotiation process.

question_75378.question: What is the indication added to the RSD when Location Criteria is included and becomes invalid in the current PDU Session?
question_75378.ground_truth: A "Revaluation Suggested" indication is added to the RSD when Location Criteria is included and becomes invalid in the current PDU Session, indicating to the UE that it should re-evaluate URSP rules.

question_75379.question: What should the UE do when it receives a DEREGISTRATION ACCEPT message and has stopped timer Txa after the de-registration procedure is completed for 5GS services over 3GPP access?
question_75379.ground_truth: If the UE supports N1 mode only and the de-registration procedure was performed due to disabling of 5GS services, the UE shall enter the 5GMM-NULL state for 3GPP access. Otherwise, the UE shall enter the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state for 3GPP access.

question_75380.question: What is the function of the IOPS packet distribution function in the IOPS-based IP connectivity communication?
question_75380.ground_truth: The IOPS packet distribution function receives IP packets for relaying, decapsulates them to get the IP packet containing the inner IP header, resolves the IP address destination, and transmits/relays the IP packets to the targeted MC UE(s) via the local EPS.

question_75381.question: When should a BL/CE UE drop the SRS transmission that falls into the reserved symbol of a BL/CE UL subframe?
question_75381.ground_truth: For a BL/CE UE, the SRS transmission that falls into the reserved symbol of a BL/CE UL subframe is dropped.

question_75382.question: Where can PSS and MBMS user profile and UE capabilities information be stored?
question_75382.ground_truth: The information can be stored in Application Server functions, a stand-alone server associated with one or more Application Server functions, or in the HSS as transparent data associated to these Application Server functions.

question_75383.question: What kind of network is required for the professional video production use case?
question_75383.ground_truth: The use case requires a 5G network with special focus on high data rate, low latency, and ultra-precise time synchronization throughout the whole operation time.

question_75385.question: What is the BCCH ARFCN value for cell B in the initial conditions for 450/1800 MS?

question_75386.question: What does the term "Logical Model" mean in the context of 3GPP network?
question_75386.ground_truth: It is an abstract view of a network or network element by means of information objects representing network element, aggregations of network elements, the topological relationship between the elements, endpoints of connections (termination points), and transport entities (such as connections) that transport information between two or more termination points.

question_75387.question: What message is sent by the MS to indicate the completion of the GERAN to EGAN handover procedure?

question_75388.question: In what way does an MC user get notified when a relevant MC user becomes disconnected from the IOPS MC system?
question_75388.ground_truth: The IOPS MC system sends a NOTIFY message to the MC user informing that the registration status of the MC user has changed to disconnected. The MCPTT client then notifies the MC user about the registration status change of the MC user.

question_75389.question: What simulator is used to simulate a location and provide a timing reference for off-network testing?
question_75389.ground_truth: A GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System) simulator is used to simulate a location and provide a timing reference for off-network testing.

question_75391.question: What is the maximum value of Altitude in the AltitudeAndDirection element?
question_75391.ground_truth: The maximum value of Altitude in the AltitudeAndDirection element is 32767.

question_75392.question: What does the first digit in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Specification document represent?
question_75392.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Specification document represents the stage of development of the document. A value of 1 indicates that the document is presented to the TSG for information, 2 indicates that the document is presented to the TSG for approval, and 3 or greater indicates that the document is a TSG approved document under change control.

question_75395.question: What should be the value of octet b when coding the BSS Container IE in the Bearer Context IE in Forward Relocation Request and Context Response messages and one of the flags PFI, RP, SAPI and PHX is set to 1 in octet 6?
question_75395.ground_truth: The value of octet b should be the corresponding type of parameter (Packet FlowID, Radio Priority, SAPI and PS handover XID parameters) when coding the BSS Container IE in the Bearer Context IE in Forward Relocation Request and Context Response messages and one of the flags PFI, RP, SAPI and PHX is set to 1 in octet 6.

question_75396.question: In the 3GPP TS 25.214 v7.1.0 specification, what are P-CCPCH 1 and P-CCPCH 2 mapped onto?
question_75396.ground_truth: P-CCPCH 1 and P-CCPCH 2 are mapped onto timeslot#0 using the channelisation codes with a spreading factor of 16.

question_75397.question: What is the UE behavior, if no Random Access Response is received within the RA Response window?
question_75397.ground_truth: The Cat-M1 UE shall re-select a preamble and transmit with the calculated PRACH transmission power when the back off time expires, if no Random Access Response is received within the RA Response window.

question_75398.question: What attribute in the "pPolicyCtrlReqTriggers" specifies the DN-AAA authorization profile index if the "DN-Authorization" feature is supported?

question_75400.question: What triggers the start of the "drx-onDurationTimerPTM" during broadcast DRX in 5G NR?
question_75400.ground_truth: The "drx-onDurationTimerPTM" starts after "drx-SlotOffsetPTM" from the beginning of the subframe, when the modulo operation of SFN times 10 plus subframe number equals the "drx-StartOffset-PTM".

question_75401.question: What is the countermeasure for packet modification attacks between UE and SAE gateway?
question_75401.ground_truth: The countermeasure is to use user plane integrity protection between UE and SAE gateway.

question_75402.question: What should the manufacturer declare for a BS supporting multi-band operation, in addition to the support for the "and" operation?
question_75402.ground_truth: The manufacturer should declare supported operating band combinations, supported operating band(s) of each antenna connector, support of multi-band transmitter and/or multi-band receiver, total number of supported carriers for the declared band combinations of the BS, maximum number of supported carriers per band in multi-band operation, total RF bandwidth BWtot for the declared band combinations of the BS, maximum Base Station RF bandwidth of each supported operating band in multi-band operation, maximum Radio Bandwidth BWmax in transmit and receive direction for the declared band combinations of the BS, any other limitations under simultaneous operation in the declared band combinations of the BS, total output power as a sum over all supported operating bands in the declared band combinations of the BS, maximum supported power difference between any two carriers in any two different supported operating bands, the rated output power per carrier in multi-band operation, and the rated total output power Prated,t of each supported operating band in multi-band operation.

question_75403.question: What is the value of the constant ABS(a)?

question_75404.question: What is the method of test in 70.11.8.4 to verify the MS's first position estimate meets the Conformance requirement under GPS satellite signal conditions that represent simple multi-path conditions?
question_75404.ground_truth: The method of test in 70.11.8.4 to verify the MS's first position estimate meets the Conformance requirement under GPS satellite signal conditions that represent simple multi-path conditions is to use normal test environment and start GPS scenario #1 or #2 with specific initial conditions.

question_75406.question: What does the backoff in sections 8.2.1 and 8.3.1 refer to in terms of EGPRS2-A and EGPRS2-B performance evaluation?
question_75406.ground_truth: The backoff indicates a shift of Es/N0 values, which are the ratio of energy per symbol to noise spectral density, during the evaluation of the techniques.

question_75408.question: How is the registration procedure initiated by an Inbound Disaster Roamer performed?
question_75408.ground_truth: The registration procedure is typically initiated by the Inbound Disaster Roamer sending a registration request to the Disaster Roaming PLMN, which then authenticates the UE and registers it for service.

question_75409.question: In the context of 3GPP network products and threat model, what does the term "SCAS" refer to?
question_75409.ground_truth: SCAS stands for "3GPP Security Assurance Specification".

question_75412.question: Which HSS related event is generated when the HSS detects that the target has roamed?
question_75412.ground_truth: The Serving Evolved Packet System for IoT UE event is generated when the HSS detects that the target has roamed.

question_75413.question: What actions does the H-PCRF take when storing selected PCC Rules and binding IP-CAN bearers?
question_75413.ground_truth: The H-PCRF stores the selected PCC Rules, selects the bearer control mode, and stores information about the IP-CAN bearer to which PCC Rules have been assigned if the H-PCRF controls the binding of IP-CAN bearers. If the binding of IP-CAN bearers is controlled by the BBERF/PCEF, the H-PCRF derives QoS information per QCI.

question_75415.question: What should the UE (MCVideo Client) do upon receiving a Media Reception End Request message from the SS (MCVideo Server) during an ongoing Imminent Peril Chat Group Call?
question_75415.ground_truth: The UE (MCVideo Client) should notify the MCVideo User, and upon receipt of user acceptance, send a Media Reception End Response message to the SS (MCVideo Server).

question_75416.question: What is the conformance requirement for the ME when sending a response in accordance with 27.11.1.5.2?
question_75416.ground_truth: The ME shall send an error signal in accordance with ISO/IEC~7816-3, subclause 6.3.3, and expect a repetition of the character. The ME shall correctly evaluate the character when repeated by the SIM simulator.

question_75417.question: What operation is included in a FACILITY message when the Explicit Call Transfer supplementary service is signaled towards the network?
question_75417.ground_truth: The ExplicitCT operation is included in a FACILITY message when the Explicit Call Transfer supplementary service is signaled towards the network.

question_75418.question: What is the recommended UDP blast duration to prevent physical layer DTX based on the UE Category for embedded testing?
question_75418.ground_truth: The UDP blast duration should be selected based on the minimum test times and a sufficient rate to prevent physical layer DTX.

question_75419.question: What should the MS do if the command has not been acknowledged after sending it?
question_75419.ground_truth: The MS shall repeat the command after the time-out of T200.

question_75421.question: Which protocol extension specified in the InitialUE-MessageExtensions is mandatory?
question_75421.ground_truth: There is no mandatory protocol extension in the InitialUE-MessageExtensions.

question_75424.question: How is the information about the new RAN node transmitted when the UE moves to a new eNB/RNC during connectionless mode and the connectionless activity timer is running?
question_75424.ground_truth: The information about the new RAN node is transmitted using the information sent in the uplink packets, which includes the RAN Node IP address and the DL TEID to be used.

question_75425.question: What are the three levels of group handling described in the solution for mitigating signalling cost in a 3GPP network?
question_75425.ground_truth: The three levels of group handling described are between SCS/AS and SCEF, between SCS/AS and HSS/PCRF via SCEF, and between SCS/AS and MME/SGSN via SCEF and HSS/PCRF.

question_75426.question: What should the UE include in the measResultServingCell when setting the contents of the MCGFailureInformation message?
question_75426.ground_truth: The UE should include the available quantities of the concerned cell, set in accordance with the performance requirements in TS 36.133.

question_75429.question: What are the types of information that can be contained in the E-RABs-Confirmed-ToBeReleased-ModReqdList and E-RABs-Confirmed-ToBeModified-ModReqdList sequences, which contain information about E-RABs that are to be released or modified?
question_75429.ground_truth: Both E-RABs-Confirmed-ToBeReleased-ModReqdList and E-RABs-Confirmed-ToBeModified-ModReqdList are sequences of size (1..maxnoofBearers) containing a ProtocolIE-SingleContainer with an E-RABs-Confirmed-ToBeReleased-ModReqdItem or E-RABs-Confirmed-ToBeModified-ModReqdItem as the ProtocolIE-SingleContainer type.

question_75430.question: What is the result of the PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP EVENT LIST 1.1.1?
question_75430.ground_truth: The result of the PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP EVENT LIST 1.1.1 is Command performed successfully.

question_75431.question: What are the benefits of Option 2-1 in splitting NR functions between central and distributed units?
question_75431.ground_truth: Option 2-1 allows traffic aggregation from NR and E-UTRA transmission points to be centralized, facilitating the management of traffic load between NR and E-UTRA transmission points. The fundamental principles for achieving a PDCP-RLC split have already been standardized for LTE Dual Connectivity, alternative 3C.

question_75433.question: What information does the "Average codec bitrate" metric represent for non-speech media?
question_75433.ground_truth: The "Average codec bitrate" metric for non-speech media is the total number of RTP payload bits received divided by the length of the measurement resolution period.

question_75434.question: What should the P-CSCF do when it receives an initial request for a dialog or standalone transaction or an unknown method, and the request is sent using Ethernet as an IP-CAN?
question_75434.ground_truth: The P-CSCF may insert a P-Access-Network-Info header into the request by setting the access-type field to one of the Ethernet options, adding the "network-provided" parameter, and the "eth-location" access-info parameter with the value obtained from the CLF.

question_75435.question: What is the purpose of the test in 27.12.1a.3?
question_75435.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that the authentication procedure is done with a frequency of at least 13/4 MHz if the bit b2 of the file characteristics (byte 1 of the directory characteristics) is set to 1.

question_75436.question: What data type is used as a token to match load statistics requests with their results?

question_75438.question: What is the purpose of the "cellReservedForOperatorUse" field in SIB1?
question_75438.ground_truth: The "cellReservedForOperatorUse" field in SIB1 is used to indicate if a cell is reserved for operator use in the SIB1 message.

question_75439.question: Which IP network protocol stack is used in EPS?
question_75439.ground_truth: EPS (Evolved Packet System) uses Evolved Packet Core (EPC) and Long Term Evolution (LTE) network protocol stacks.

question_75441.question: What is the system capacity measured in reports per 200 kHz per hour?

question_75442.question: What are the three categories of interfaces related to application integration?
question_75442.ground_truth: The three categories of interfaces related to application integration are high-level generic interfaces, high-level (technology-independent) interfaces, and detailed (product-specific) interfaces.

question_75444.question: What is the main function of the Fax Adaptation functions in the described Teleservice?
question_75444.ground_truth: The main function of the Fax Adaptation functions is to contain all the protocol modules specific for this Teleservice.

question_75446.question: What is required when a location report is sent in an SLM client HTTP procedure?
question_75446.ground_truth: To send the location report, the SLM-C can use an appropriate HTTP or CoAP request message containing the identity of the sender and trigger criteria.

question_75447.question: What action does the H-PCF take if the UE information is not available in step 2 and is available in the UDR, with reliable information?
question_75447.ground_truth: The H-PCF uses UE information retrieved from the UDR in the determination of whether and which ANDSP and/or URSP has to be provisioned if the UE information is not available in step 2 and is available in the UDR with reliable information in step 7.

question_75448.question: What is the 3GPP split architecture for NG-RAN characterized by?
question_75448.ground_truth: The 3GPP split architecture for NG-RAN is characterized by the presence of a single gNB-CU-CP, which is in control of one or more gNB-DU(s) and one or more gNB-CU-UP(s).

question_75449.question: What is the difference between the various types of V2X services defined in the 3GPP specifications?
question_75449.ground_truth: The four types of V2X services (V2V, V2I, V2N, and V2P) differ in terms of the parties involved in the communication and the specific V2X applications they use.

question_75450.question: What is the scheme that should be used when the authority contains an FQDN and not a literal IP address in a Service Capability Profile (SCP)?

question_75451.question: What is the definition of End-to-End Latency as per the document?
question_75451.ground_truth: End-to-End Latency is the time that takes to transfer a given piece of information from a source to a destination, measured at the communication interface, from the moment it is transmitted by the source to the moment it is successfully received at the destination.

question_75452.question: What are the three points that define the reference plane for DUT positioning in Speech Mode with beside the Head Phantom?
question_75452.ground_truth: The three points are the center of the right ear piece (RE), the center of the left ear piece (LE), and the center of mouth (M).

question_75453.question: What is the conformance requirement for the received signal quality assessment in 21.3.1.2?
question_75453.ground_truth: The received signal quality shall be measured by the MS in a manner that can be related to an equivalent average BER before channel decoding, assessed over the reporting period of one SACCH multiframe.

question_75454.question: What is the role of the Radio Block Centre (RBC) in FRMCS?
question_75454.ground_truth: The RBC in FRMCS uses the received position and speed information from a train to decide its Movement Authority.

question_75455.question: What is the requirement for the RF input/output ports of a hybrid AAS BS in terms of termination for EMC testing?
question_75455.ground_truth: The RF input/output ports of a hybrid AAS BS shall be correctly terminated for EMC testing.

question_75456.question: What is the maximum allowed difference between the RSRP measured from one cell and the RSRP measured from another cell on a different frequency for the TDD inter-frequency relative accuracy of RSRP test?
question_75456.ground_truth: The maximum allowed difference is 27 dB.

question_75458.question: What is one method for invoking an MPS for DTS as specified in the 3GPP system?
question_75458.ground_truth: A method for MPS for DTS invocation may include using a web browser to enter a predetermined address (e.g., URL) or using a specialized MPS application on the UE.

question_75459.question: What is one of the methods to distribute objects such as music and effects, and different languages in a cost and spectrum-efficient manner?
question_75459.ground_truth: Objects can be distributed separately and combined at the receiver.

question_75460.question: What is one of the high-level requirements for preventing unsolicited communication in IMS?
question_75460.ground_truth: IMS should provide means for a user to inform the network of an unsolicited communication.

question_75462.question: What receiver RF requirements are defined in LTE Rel-8 for measuring the receiver ability to receive a wanted signal at its assigned channel frequency in the presence of an adjacent channel signal with a specified center frequency offset?
question_75462.ground_truth: Adjacent channel selectivity (ACS) is defined in LTE Rel-8, which is a measure of the receiver ability to receive a wanted signal at its assigned channel frequency in the presence of an adjacent channel signal with a specified center frequency offset.

question_75463.question: What information does the MC service server send to MC service clients after updating the MBS session?
question_75463.ground_truth: The MC service server sends the MapGroupToSessionStream information to MC service clients 2 to n, providing the required stream information to receive the media related to the group communication within the MBS session.

question_75465.question: What is the function of the PCRF (Policy and Charging Rules Function) in 3GPP systems?
question_75465.ground_truth: The PCRF acts as a policy decision point for policy and charging control of service data flows/applications and IP bearer resources. It selects and provides the applicable policy and charging control decision to the PCEF and, if applicable, application detection and control decision to the TDF or PCEF with application detection and control feature.

question_75466.question: What is the possible method for IMS registration via CS access using ISC in IMS?
question_75466.ground_truth: The UE sends the content of SIP Register encoded in ICCP, in a USSD message to the ICCF using IMSI as the identity. Alternatively CAMEL mobility triggers may be used to inform the ICCF about the CS attach of the ICS user.

question_75467.question: What should the MeNB do if it receives a SGNB MODIFICATION REQUEST message containing the MeNB to SgNB Container IE that does not include required information as specified in TS 38.331?
question_75467.ground_truth: The MeNB should send the SGNB MODIFICATION REQUEST REJECT message to the en-gNB.

question_75468.question: What should the UE do if the network indicates "SMS only" in the Additional update result IE?
question_75468.ground_truth: A UE operating in CS/PS mode 1 with "IMS voice not available" shall attempt to select GERAN or UTRAN radio access technology and disable the E-UTRA capability.

question_75470.question: What actions does the V2X application layer at the V2X UE take when network metrics and V2X UE context information indicate a need for resource modification for the Level of Automation (LoA)?
question_75470.ground_truth: The V2X application layer at the V2X UE triggers a resource modification for the LoA based on the network metrics and V2X UE context information.

question_75471.question: What is indicated by the value of the 'Identifier for DCI formats' bit field when it is set to 1?
question_75471.ground_truth: It indicates a DL DCI format.

question_75472.question: What fading profiles are being considered for 5G NR in the associated performance test procedures in TS 38.521-4?

question_75474.question: What is the maximum number of VLAN tags allowed by the SMF for a PDU Session?
question_75474.ground_truth: The SMF may receive a list of allowed VLAN tags from DN-AAA for a maximum of 16 VLAN tags for a PDU Session.

question_75476.question: What is the purpose of the test in 9.3.7C of the document?
question_75476.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in 9.3.7C is to verify that when using the TF (Transport Format) based on the Median CQI (Channel Quality Indicator), the BLER (Block Error Rate) for blocks associated with CQI reports of Median CQI is less than or equal to 60%, and the BLER for blocks associated with CQI reports of Median CQI+2 is less than or equal to 15%.

question_75477.question: What is the purpose of testing the maximum input level for intra-band contiguous EN-DC (2 CCs)?
question_75477.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to measure the UE's ability to receive data with a given average throughput for a specified reference measurement channel, under conditions of high signal level, ideal propagation, and no added noise. A UE unable to meet the throughput requirement under these conditions will decrease the coverage area near to an e-NodeB or a gNB.

question_75479.question: What type of signalling transport service does PCAP require for connectionless data transfer?
question_75479.ground_truth: PCAP requires a connectionless data transfer service that notifies PCAP in case a message does not reach the intended peer PCAP entity.

question_75481.question: What is the difference between the Direct Far Field (DFF) and Indirect Far Field (IFF) methodologies in positioned probes for two-simultaneous AoA testing?
question_75481.ground_truth: In the DFF methodology, the millimeter-wave measurement probes are placed in the far-field away from the Device Under Test (DUT) and can be positioned arbitrarily while the DUT is fixed. In contrast, the IFF methodology uses a measurement probe and reflector instead of the probes, allowing for full degrees of freedom for each AoA.

question_75484.question: What is the purpose of the KASUMI algorithm in the 3GPP security architecture?
question_75484.ground_truth: The KASUMI algorithm is the building block for the confidentiality and integrity algorithms (f8 and f9) in the 3GPP security architecture.

question_75485.question: What does the variable Ofn represent in event A3H1?
question_75485.ground_truth: The variable Ofn is the measurement object specific offset of the reference signal of the neighboring cell. It is expressed in the same unit as the Mn, Mp, Ofp, and Ocp, which is dB.

question_75487.question: What should a UE do if it fails to acquire the required number of samples per GSM carrier during one measurement period?
question_75487.ground_truth: In such a case, the UE should measure as many GSM carriers as possible during that measurement period using at least 3 samples per GSM carrier. The remaining GSM carriers can be measured in the following measurement periods.

question_75490.question: What should the MS prepare when sending a GA-CSR CLASSMARK CHANGE message and a GA-CSR UTRAN CLASSMARK CHANGE message?
question_75490.ground_truth: The GA-CSR CLASSMARK CHANGE message should be sent first, followed by the GA-CSR UTRAN CLASSMARK CHANGE message, if applicable, and sent only if the MS is in GA-CSR-DEDICATED state.

question_75491.question: What action does the DCCF take if it accepts the muting instructions from the "dataSub" attribute in the request and the EnhDataMgmt feature is supported?
question_75491.ground_truth: The DCCF indicates the applied muting notification settings in the response, e.g. within the "mutingSetting" attribute.

question_75492.question: In what order of priority have the scenarios for CSI feedback enhancements been studied?
question_75492.ground_truth: The scenarios have been studied in the following order of priority: Priority 1: Scenarios A and C, and Priority 2: Scenario B.

question_75493.question: What is the protocol used in the user plane for PDP Type PPP in the MS and above GTP in the GGSN?

question_75494.question: What is the purpose of the MDA assisted fault management in MDA capabilities?
question_75494.ground_truth: The MDA assisted fault management provides analytics outputs for failure prediction analysis. It helps identify potential issues and prevent failures, assisting in maintaining an efficient and reliable network.

question_75495.question: What are the two different duplex spacings being considered in the AWS-3 band plan to address the different licensees for the AWS-3 spectrum and protection of Federal satellite receiver sites?
question_75495.ground_truth: The two duplex spacings are 300 MHz in Scenario 1 and 295 MHz in Scenario 2B.

question_75496.question: What is the purpose of "simultaneous connection establishment attempts" in TCP connection synchronized by both peers?
question_75496.ground_truth: This method, also defined in IETF RFC 793, allows both peers to initiate the connection at the same time, which can be useful for NAT traversal and may provide higher service reliability and performance.

question_75497.question: What is the ACLR requirement for a BS operating in non-contiguous spectrum and multiple bands?
