question_75497.ground_truth: The ACLR requirement applies for the first and second adjacent channel inside any sub-block gap or Inter RF Bandwidth gap with a gap size greater than or equal to 15 MHz and 20 MHz, respectively.

question_75500.question: What shall the SS transmit in step 4 of the procedure, as indicated in 8.3.2.1.4.2(a)?
question_75500.ground_truth: A MEASUREMENT CONTROL message on cell 1.

question_75501.question: What is the minimum percentage rate of correct events observed with a confidence level of 95% in the test requirement for the UE behavior?
question_75501.ground_truth: The minimum percentage rate of correct events observed with a confidence level of 95% in the test requirement for the UE behavior is 90%.

question_75502.question: What attribute defines the interval between two successive reports for periodical reporting of measurement M1 in LTE or NR?

question_75503.question: Which numbering plan is represented by the Numbering Plan field in the GT, and what does the value 0001 indicate?
question_75503.ground_truth: The Numbering Plan field in the GT represents E.163/4, and the value 0001 specifically refers to the Integrated Services Digital Network (ISDN) user part address.

question_75506.question: What does the Iupc interface connect in the context of the UMTS system's Universal Terrestrial Radio Access Network (UTRAN)?
question_75506.ground_truth: Stand-Alone SMLC (SAS) and Radio Network Controller (RNC) components.

question_75508.question: What should the PGW-C do when it receives a GTP error indication from a SGW-U for a bearer other than the default bearer?
question_75508.ground_truth: The PGW-C shall delete its Bearer context with a delete bearer message to SGW-C and may notify the Operation and Maintenance network element.

question_75509.question: What is the advantage of using 8PSK instead of 16APK in Transmission 2 with link adaptation?
question_75509.ground_truth: The advantage of using 8PSK instead of 16APK in Transmission 2 with link adaptation is that it provides an advantage over EGPRS when switching modulations, and it allows for the possibility of the receiver decoding the source data after only one transmission over 8PSK, improving the throughput.

question_75511.question: What conditions shall be met to increase the number of failed tests?
question_75511.ground_truth: The UE does not meet the CQI reporting requirements or the SS does not detect uplink power higher than -48.5 dBm during the periods specified.

question_75512.question: How is the Content of Communication delivered to the LEMF (Lawful Interception Management Function)?
question_75512.ground_truth: The Content of Communication is delivered to the LEMF via the HI3 interface, which transports the encrypted and deciphered copy of the information flow during an established, frequently bi-directional, communication of the target. The network does not record or store the Content of Communication.

question_75513.question: What is the benefit of considering the dependency among PDU sets during transmission?
question_75513.ground_truth: Considering the dependency among PDU sets during transmission can prevent waste of RAN resources and N3 resources, and result in more efficient data transmission.

question_75514.question: What is the role of the UE-to-UE relay in the link management of extended PC5 links between source UE and target UE(s)?
question_75514.ground_truth: The UE-to-UE Relay maintains a management connection between the Relay UE and each Source/Target UE, and also maintains one or more extended end-to-end PC5 unicast links between a Source UE and Target UE(s). Link management, including keepalive, link modification, link identifier update, and link release, is supported over direct unicast links and needs to be supported over extended PC5 links as well.

question_75515.question: What are some of the traditional distribution formats considered in the 3GPP Technical Report for TV services?
question_75515.ground_truth: The traditional distribution formats include those defined by DVB, ATSC, SCTE or other broadcast organizations, such as SD, HD, full HD, and UHD content.

question_75516.question: When would the V2X layer trigger Uu RRC signaling towards the NG-RAN?
question_75516.ground_truth: The V2X layer may trigger Uu RRC signaling towards the NG-RAN when there is a new V2X Application initiated, or when the Pedestrian UE has an active Uu connection in RRC_CONNECTED state.

question_75518.question: What is the scope of the document "3GPP TS 29.198-4: Multimedia Call Control Service Capability Feature (SCF)"?
question_75518.ground_truth: The document specifies the Multimedia Call Control Service Capability Feature (SCF) aspects of the 3GPP OSA (Open Service Access) API.

question_75519.question: What should be the criteria for a UE to perform cell reselection to an inter-frequency cell on an equal absolute priority layer to the camped frequency?
question_75519.ground_truth: Criterion 2 should be fulfilled, which is a set of conditions related to the signal strength and quality of neighboring cells.

question_75520.question: What is the significance of the first number in the second set of parameters for the Interactive or background / UL in 6.10.3.4.1.35?
question_75520.ground_truth: The first number represents the maximum achievable uplink bit rate for the interactive or background service in kbps.

question_75523.question: What should the MME do after it receives the Initial Context Response message and Attach Complete message from the new UE?
question_75523.ground_truth: The MME sends a Modify Bearer Request message to the Serving GW, which includes the EPS Bearer Identity, eNodeB address, eNodeB TEID, Handover Indication, Presence Reporting Area Information, RAT type, LTE-M RAT type reporting to PGW, and other relevant information.

question_75524.question: How many bits are used for the modulation and coding scheme and redundancy version in the DCI format 0?
question_75524.ground_truth: 5 bits are used for the modulation and coding scheme and redundancy version in the DCI format 0.

question_75525.question: What is the method used by V-SMF to differentiate charging information in solution #2.14?
question_75525.ground_truth: V-SMF distinguishes the charging information for H-CHF and V-CHF in the solution #2.14 using an indication.

question_75526.question: What steps should the network follow if it fails to authenticate the UE and the 5G-GUTI was used in the initial NAS message?
question_75526.ground_truth: The network should transport the EAP-failure message in the AUTHENTICATION RESULT message, initiate an identification procedure to retrieve SUCI from the UE, and restart the EAP based primary authentication and key agreement procedure with the received SUCI.

question_75527.question: What does the Core-Network-Restrictions AVP contain in the 3GPP network?
question_75527.ground_truth: The Core-Network-Restrictions AVP contains a bitmask indicating the types of Core Network that are disallowed for a given user in the 3GPP network.

question_75528.question: What message does the source CU-CP (S-CU-CP) send to the source CU-UP (S-CU-UP) in the resource release phase to release the data radio bearers and release the corresponding resources?

question_75529.question: In the subframe where a first PMI is reported for transmission modes 9, what type of report does a UE report as per Mode 1-1 description?
question_75529.ground_truth: A UE shall report a type 2a report consisting of a first PMI corresponding to a set of precoding matrices selected from the codebook subset assuming transmission on all narrowband(s) in the CSI reference resource.

question_75531.question: What limit is met at an offset between 12.5 kHz and 37.5 kHz from the channel edge for all PRB allocations studied for the 1.4 and 5 MHz bandwidths?
question_75531.ground_truth: The limit -20 dBm/0.3 kHz is met at an offset between 12.5 kHz and 37.5 kHz from the channel edge for all PRB allocations studied for the 1.4 and 5 MHz bandwidths.

question_75532.question: What was the result of the REFRESH 2.2.1 response in the REFRESH 2.2.1 terminal response?
question_75532.ground_truth: The result code is 0000, indicating that the command was performed successfully.

question_75533.question: What is the result if the T(RI) instance expires in the originating BSS?
question_75533.ground_truth: As an implementation option, the originating BSS can either inform the application that the procedure has failed or restart the RAN Information Send procedure a finite number of times.

question_75534.question: Which UE power classes and frequency ranges does the 7.6.3.4 test case apply to?
question_75534.ground_truth: The 7.6.3.4 test case applies to all types of NR UE Release 15 and forward supporting 5GS NR SA FR2 and long DRX cycle, with test frequency less than or equal to 40.8 GHz and UE PC3.

question_75536.question: What is the purpose of the connectionless activity timer in the UE, eNB/RNC, and SGW/SGSN in the context of connectionless mode?
question_75536.ground_truth: The connectionless activity timer is used to determine whether the UE is considered active or idle for connectionless purposes. If it is active, the DL packets are sent to the RAN node serving the UE. If it is idle, the SGW may either invoke the network triggered Service Request procedure or mark the DL forwarding information as "tentative".

question_75537.question: What is the API for starting a group call session in the MBMS network?

question_75538.question: What is the purpose of sharing the NG-RAN node to a PLMN with a disaster condition?
question_75538.ground_truth: The purpose of sharing the NG-RAN node to a PLMN with a disaster condition is to handle the disaster condition, but there is a restriction on the number of networks that can share the NG-RAN node.

question_75539.question: What is the definition of "PDU session" as used in the present document?
question_75539.ground_truth: A PDU session is a virtual logical channel between the user equipment and the 5G core network, it is used to carry data for different services, including data communication, voice, and multimedia.

question_75540.question: How does the RNC respond when it is able to process the information contained in the INFORMATION TRANSFER INDICATION message?
question_75540.ground_truth: When the RNC is able to process the information contained in the INFORMATION TRANSFER INDICATION message, it shall respond with the INFORMATION TRANSFER CONFIRMATION message provided with the same Information Transfer ID IE as the one received in the INFORMATION TRANSFER INDICATION message.

question_75543.question: What is the purpose of the N2 procedures via Untrusted non-3GPP Access?
question_75543.ground_truth: The N2 procedures via Untrusted non-3GPP Access are used to release N2 signalling resources and to establish or re-establish user plane connections between the UE and the 5GC.

question_75545.question: What is the purpose of the +CLAC command?
question_75545.ground_truth: The +CLAC command lists all available AT commands.

question_75547.question: What should the UE do if the serving cell meets certain criteria and it needs to perform intra-frequency measurements?
question_75547.ground_truth: The UE may choose not to perform intra-frequency measurements if the serving cell fulfils Srxlev > SIntraSearchP and Squal > SIntraSearchQ.

question_75548.question: What is one approach to mitigate receiver non-linearity behaviors in wireless communications?
question_75548.ground_truth: One approach is to use components with increased linearity, such as LNAs, which can reduce non-linearity at the cost of increased energy consumption and potentially size.

question_75549.question: In which scenarios can CBRA and CFRA be supported on the PCell and PSCell respectively in MR-DC?
question_75549.ground_truth: CBRA can be supported on the PCell, if the MN is a gNB and on the PSCell, if the SN is a gNB while CFRA is only supported on the PCell, if the MN is a gNB in MR-DC.

question_75553.question: What is the state of the CC entities relating to the seven mobile terminating transaction identifiers when returning to idle mode?
question_75553.ground_truth: They should be in state U0, "Null".

question_75555.question: What is responsible for generating the PCK and the PCK-ID in a standalone one-to-one SDS using media plane or one-to-one SDS session or one-to-one FD using media plane?
question_75555.ground_truth: The MCData client initiating the standalone one-to-one SDS.

question_75556.question: How can the application instance lifecycle management interface be used for EAS lifecycle management?
question_75556.ground_truth: The application lifecycle management interface produced by MEO/MEAO contains various operations such as create, terminate, and query application instance information. These operations can be used to achieve the EAS lifecycle management requirements.

question_75557.question: Which protocol is used for signalling of media plane in an MCPTT group call, if it's not SIP?
question_75557.ground_truth: The protocol used for signalling of media plane is non-SIP, it can be protocol like RTCP.

question_75558.question: What are the two modes of operation supported by LAPDm and in which situations are they applicable?
question_75558.ground_truth: LAPDm supports unacknowledged operation using UI frames and acknowledged operation using the multiple frame procedure. The unacknowledged mode of operation is used for applications on control channels, while the acknowledged mode is used for other types of channels.

question_75559.question: What is the role of the SMF in the QoS Flow setup process?
question_75559.ground_truth: The SMF receives the indication from the NG-RAN regarding the success of the QoS Flow setup and whether the GFBR can be guaranteed. The SMF then follows the current notification control mechanism if the GFBR cannot be guaranteed.

question_75560.question: What security measures does GIBA not allow for SIP requests?
question_75560.ground_truth: GIBA does not allow SIP requests to be protected using an IPsec security association because it does not perform a key agreement procedure.

question_75561.question: When are DL and UL transmissions not scheduled in parallel for NB-IoT in FDD mode or TDD mode with a single HARQ process?
question_75561.ground_truth: If a DL transmission has been scheduled, an UL transmission will not be scheduled until the HARQ RTT Timer of the DL HARQ process has expired (and vice versa).

question_75562.question: What is the significance of the frequency range 43.5 GHz < f <= 60~GHz in the context of TRP measurement for OTA TX spurious emissions?
question_75562.ground_truth: This frequency range is considered for the MU values for the whole spurious emissions range for FR2, while the other frequency ranges are common with existing FR1 and FR2 in-band TRP emissions measurements.

question_75563.question: What are some of the responsibilities of the UE, MME, and RAN in network authorized connection establishment procedures?
question_75563.ground_truth: UE is responsible for supporting discovery procedures, network authorized connection establishment procedures, and authorization and provisioning from ProSe Function. MME is responsible for authorization for direct connection setup, mapping of direct connection bearer to EPS bearer, determination that two UEs are served by the same MME based on the discovery information, security procedures, and providing security keys to the UEs for the direct connection. The RAN is responsible for supporting network authorized connection establishment procedures and authorization and control of the radio resources used for direct connection.

question_75564.question: What is the potential impact of unclear personal data collection policies?
question_75564.ground_truth: An unclear policy on personal data collection may bring the risk of user's information disclosure and potential unlawful usage of personal information.

question_75566.question: What is the status of the first two calls in the scenario "CALL A-B ACTIVE/CALL C-B WAITING"?
question_75566.ground_truth: The first call (A-B) is active, and the second call (C-B) is waiting.

question_75569.question: What should the gsmSRF do when prompt and collect user information procedure is canceled by the gsmSCF as per clause 14.1.2.4?
question_75569.ground_truth: When prompt and collect user information procedure is canceled by the gsmSCF, the gsmSRF should order the MGW to stop playing the announcement or sending tone, if they are still in progress, and also stop detecting DTMF tones using the Stop DTMF Detection procedure as per clause 14.4.2.

question_75570.question: What HTTP method is used to request the update of an Individual Data Storage resource?
question_75570.ground_truth: The HTTP PUT method is used to update an Individual Data Storage resource.

question_75571.question: What action does the AUSF take when a fresh KAUSF is generated for the UE?
question_75571.ground_truth: The AUSF resets the CounterUPU to 0x00 0x01 when a fresh KAUSF is generated for the UE.

question_75572.question: What is the difference between active and passive antenna measurement procedures?
question_75572.ground_truth: Active antenna measurements use a transceiver to establish a wireless link against a BS simulator, measuring the power received by antennas of the test setup, while passive antenna measurements feed power to the antenna by measurement cables. Active measurements are typically used for HH equipment, while passive measurements are used for vehicles.

question_75574.question: What information should be included by the SGSN in the BSSAP+-GPRS-DETACH-INDICATION message and BSSAP+-IMSI-DETACH-INDICATION message, in Iu mode?
question_75574.ground_truth: The service area identification where the mobile was in the last radio contact.

question_75575.question: What are the conditions for the TDD - TDD inter frequency absolute RSRQ accuracy test?
question_75575.ground_truth: The TDD - TDD inter frequency absolute RSRQ accuracy test includes a specific test environment, frequencies to be tested, channel bandwidth to be tested, and the connection of the SS and AWGN noise sources to the UE antenna connectors.

question_75577.question: What should the Node B do when it receives a DSCH DATA FRAME with a TFI value corresponding to there being no data to transmit, such a DSCH DATA FRAME will have no transport blocks?
question_75577.ground_truth: On receiving such a zero payload DSCH DATA FRAME, the Node B shall apply the specified PDSCH Set as described above starting in the PDSCH Uu frame associated to the specified CFN. This feature enables multiple DSCH's with different TTI to be supported.

question_75578.question: What is one example of a performance metric for an AI/ML model in the context of NW-side monitoring?
question_75578.ground_truth: The calculation of a performance metric at NW.

question_75580.question: What message transfer method is initiated by the SMS Service Centre when triggering a device via the SMS SC?
question_75580.ground_truth: A MT SMS message transfer that eventually results in a PDP connection being established

question_75583.question: What functions are provided by the MC gateway UE for MC gateway clients?
question_75583.ground_truth: The MC gateway UE provides functions such as association with an MC gateway UE, MC service selection, and MC service continuation.

question_75584.question: What is the name of the 3GPP SMIL language profile that is based on SMIL Basic and SMIL Scalability Framework?

question_75587.question: What action should the floor control interface take if another MCPTT client has permission and the priority level is not pre-emptive when receiving a floor request?
question_75587.ground_truth: The floor control interface shall send a Floor Deny message to the associated floor participant and include the Reject Cause field with the value cause #1 (Another MCPTT client has permission).

question_75588.question: How does the BER performance vary with the position of TSC in the new slot without channel tracking?
question_75588.ground_truth: The BER performance is more sensitive to the position of TSC in the new slot without channel tracking.

question_75589.question: What is the PLMN selection criteria used when UE is in Automatic network selection mode and RPLMN, HPLMN, and VPLMN cells are available?
question_75589.ground_truth: UE selects a cell of the RPLMN or HPLMN when UE is in Automatic network selection mode and RPLMN, HPLMN, and VPLMN cells are available.

question_75590.question: What level of digital signal is represented by 40 dBSPL in a 1 kHz pure sine tone calibration file with a 16bit signed integer at 48 kHz sampling frequency?
question_75590.ground_truth: The 1 kHz pure sine tone in the calibration file represents 40 dBSPL or -66.5 dBov.

question_75591.question: What is the conducted requirement for the RF LO distribution in the AAS BS for beam forming?
question_75591.ground_truth: The conducted requirement for the RF LO distribution in the AAS BS for beam forming is to have a known phase relationship between each other, which can be achieved through a common source or individual PLLs locked to a common reference frequency.

question_75592.question: What happens when the S-CSCF receives new routing information during a terminating call in the SIP network?
question_75592.ground_truth: When the S-CSCF receives new routing information during a terminating call, it interprets the route or terminating access and alerts the terminating party.

question_75593.question: What actions does the SMF take when releasing resources for a PDU Session in 3GPP access, as part of handing over the PDU Session to untrusted non-3GPP access?
question_75593.ground_truth: The SMF releases resources in 3GPP access by performing steps 3b, 4 to 7a/7b as specified in clause~4.3.4.2, while not releasing the PDU Session and maintaining the SM context between the AMF and the SMF.

question_75595.question: What action must the UE take when it receives a 403 (Forbidden) response while performing SIP digest with TLS?
question_75595.ground_truth: The UE must consider the registration to have failed.

question_75597.question: In ONAP, what is the DCAE collection framework aimed at collecting and what delivery method does the VES-HV (High-Volume) Collector support?
question_75597.ground_truth: The DCAE collection framework in ONAP is aimed at collecting all sorts of events from VNFs, and the VES-HV (High-Volume) Collector supports Real-Time Performance Measurement (RTPM) using Google Protocol Buffer (GPB) over TLS/TCP.

question_75599.question: What is the test procedure for verifying conformance requirements 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, and 1.4 for GMSK modulation under propagation condition TUhigh at 200 kHz above and below the wanted signal frequency?
question_75599.ground_truth: For GMSK Modulation, the SS sets up a downlink DLMC TBF using MCS-1 coding, establishes an uplink TBF, sets the USF to allocate the uplink to the MS, and initiates transmission of unwanted signals at specified frequencies and adjacent interference ratios to calculate the block error ratio. This procedure is repeated for each coding scheme MCS-1 to MCS-4.

question_75600.question: What is the purpose of the SEAL Data Delivery (SEALDD) Server?
question_75600.ground_truth: The SEALDD Server is part of the SEAL Enabler Layer and ensures the efficient use and deployment of storage and delivery capabilities for the application content/data of vertical applications.

question_75602.question: What is the main purpose of the same origin policy in web browsers?
question_75602.ground_truth: The same origin policy in web browsers restricts JavaScript's access to NAF specific authentication tokens, allowing it to only access tokens related to the same web page origin.

question_75603.question: What is the time duration for T5 in the test described in 6.5.5.3.4.2 and 6.5.5.4.4.2?
question_75603.ground_truth: The time duration for T5 in the test described in 6.5.5.3.4.2 is 160 ms and in 6.5.5.4.4.2 is 20 ms.

question_75604.question: When may the UE avoid performing a P-CSCF discovery in a new IP-CAN?
question_75604.ground_truth: The UE may avoid P-CSCF discovery in the new IP-CAN if its IP address used to access IMS does not change and the operator does not require a separate pool of P-CSCFs for particular access networks.

question_75606.question: What should the mobile station do during the contention resolution on DBPSCHs when it receives a non-distribution RLC/MAC control message addressing the mobile station by G-RNTI, RB Id (PACCH), or RRB Id (SDCCH or FACCH) value associated with one its uplink TBFs?
question_75606.ground_truth: The mobile station should act on that message using the procedure defined for the message, as outlined in sub-clause 9. If it acts on the message and receives a valid RRBP field, it should transmit a PACKET CONTROL ACKNOWLEDGEMENT message in the next possible uplink occurrence on the same logical channel.

question_75608.question: Which header field is used to carry information relating to the possibility to use priority sharing?
question_75608.ground_truth: The Priority-Share header field is used to carry information relating to the possibility to use priority sharing.

question_75610.question: What should the UE follow when interruptions to the PCell and SCells are not allowed during the PRS positioning occasion?
question_75610.ground_truth: The UE shall follow the interruption requirements specified in Section 7.10. No interruption to the PCell shall be allowed during the PRS positioning occasion on the PCell, and no interruption to the SCells shall be allowed during the PRS positioning occasion on the SCells.

question_75612.question: What is the difference between Media Flow-A and Media Flow-B in the Collaborative Session procedure?
question_75612.ground_truth: Media Flow-A and Media Flow-B represent different media types, which are established for UEs in the Collaborative Session. Media Flow-A is established for UE-1 while Media Flow-B is established for UE-2, with possible variations depending on the specific scenario.

question_75614.question: What is the purpose of including pointers to the two FARs in the MAR?
question_75614.ground_truth: The purpose of including pointers to the two FARs (Primary Discontinuous Reception Rule and Forwarding Action Rule) in the MAR is to enable separate usage reporting with separate URR IDs per access.

question_75615.question: In what situation would the AMF trigger the network-initiated deregistration procedure?
question_75615.ground_truth: The AMF can initiate the network-initiated deregistration procedure in various situations, such as when it cannot provide an allowed NSSAI to the UE, when the UE's registered PLMN is not allowed to operate in its current location, when the UE's accessibility has expired, or if the network detects a disaster condition.

question_75616.question: What messages are removed from the handover procedures when a device remains in the serving area?
question_75616.ground_truth: The modify bearer request and response messages over S11/S4 are removed during handover procedures when a device remains in the serving area.

question_75617.question: How many bits are used to indicate the redundancy version in DCI format 1A when the new data indicator is not present?

question_75618.question: What is the function of the Ack/Nack handling in the described test setup?
question_75618.ground_truth: The Ack/Nack handling is set up to transmit new data each time regardless of the UE's response, as there are no HARQ re-transmissions in the test setup.

question_75619.question: What must the MCVideo server determine when receiving a SIP REGISTER request containing an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with an <mcvideo-access-token>, <mcvideo-request-uri>, and <selected-user-profile-index> elements?
question_75619.ground_truth: If confidentiality protection has been applied, the MCVideo server must determine if it has succeeded, and if so, identify the MCVideo ID of the user in the partner MCVideo system, the MCVideo ID of the user in the primary MCVideo system, and the selected user profile index.

question_75620.question: What should a UE consider in order to determine if a frequency is part of the MBMS frequencies of interest?
question_75620.ground_truth: A UE should consider a frequency to be part of the MBMS frequencies of interest if at least one MBMS session the UE is receiving or interested to receive via an MRB or SC-MRB is ongoing or about to start, and for at least one of these MBMS sessions either SystemInformationBlockType15 acquired from the PCell includes for the concerned frequency one or more MBMS SAIs as indicated in the USD for this session or this session is in receive only mode.

question_75622.question: What is the purpose of the "iE-Extensions" field in the "Cell-InformationItem-AuditRsp" sequence?
question_75622.ground_truth: The "iE-Extensions" field in the "Cell-InformationItem-AuditRsp" sequence is used to specify additional information about the cell, and it is of type "ProtocolExtensionContainer".

question_75623.question: What is the purpose of the 5GMM capability information element?
question_75623.ground_truth: The 5GMM capability information element provides the network with information concerning aspects of the UE related to the 5GCN or interworking with the EPS.

question_75624.question: What is the purpose of the LSF weighting function in the quantization process?
question_75624.ground_truth: The LSF weighting function is derived from the first-stage approximation and applied to the residual LSF vector to ensure that the quantization of the LPC filter is as close as possible to a minimization of the spectral distortion.

question_75625.question: What procedure is used to provision broadcast protection keys to the Target/Reference UEs when they need SL Positioning data in a coverage scenario within Solution 22?
question_75625.ground_truth: The procedure involves the LMF invoking the Nlmf_Broadcast_CipheringKeyData Notify service operation towards the AMF carrying SL Positioning broadcast Encryption Key (SPEK) and Integrity Key (SPIK) and the Target/Reference UE obtaining the broadcast protection keys from its HPLMN's AMF and LMF. The procedure is protected by the NAS security.

question_75626.question: What is the definition of the off power observation period?
question_75626.ground_truth: The off power observation period is defined as the RRC filtered mean power in a duration of at least one timeslot excluding any transient periods.

question_75628.question: How can a UE indicate SMS-only service to the network during the EPS/IMSI Attach Request procedure?
question_75628.ground_truth: A UE indicates SMS-only service to the network during the EPS/IMSI Attach Request procedure by using the "SMS-only" indication.

question_75630.question: In the mobile network, what is the purpose of the IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT procedure for (MT) in the PAGING RESPONSE phase?
question_75630.ground_truth: To allocate a dedicated traffic channel for the mobile station in the RR connection establishment phase.

question_75631.question: What should the MS do if it receives a GA-RRC PAGING REQUEST with not matching identity while in GA-RRC-IDLE state for PS domain in service of GAN cell?
question_75631.ground_truth: The MS should ignore the GA-RRC PAGING REQUEST and continue with any ongoing procedures as if the GA-RRC PAGING REQUEST was not received.

question_75632.question: What is the difference between the defined values of the 10.1.81 Access domain selection preference for MO SMS command?
question_75632.ground_truth: The defined values of the 10.1.81 Access domain selection preference for MO SMS command indicate the preferred access domain for MO SMS over NAS messages. A value of 0 indicates that a 3GPP access is preferred, while a value of 1 indicates that a non-3GPP access is preferred.

question_75633.question: What information is included in the CUG information for an MO, MF, or TO call, and where is it sent?
question_75633.ground_truth: The CUG information for an MO, MF, or TO call is sent to the gsmSCF in the Initial DP information flow.

question_75634.question: What should a UE do when it receives a certain type of registration reject message over 3GPP access without integrity protection?
question_75634.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3510 or T3517 (if running), start timer T3247 with a random value uniformly drawn from the range between 30 minutes and 60 minutes (if the timer is not running), increment the counter for "SIM/USIM considered invalid for GPRS services" events, and take other specified actions.

question_75635.question: When should a network include the TLLI in a PACKET UPLINK ASSIGNMENT message after the first correctly received RLC data block carrying the TLLI?
question_75635.ground_truth: The network should include the TLLI in the PACKET UPLINK ASSIGNMENT message after the first correctly received RLC data block carrying the TLLI, when the resources for the TBF need to be reallocated.

question_75637.question: Which are the initial services identified in the Technical Report for XR Traffic analysis?
question_75637.ground_truth: Viewport independent 6DoF Streaming, Viewport dependent 6DoF Streaming, Simple Single Buffer split rendering for online cloud gaming, Cloud gaming, and MTSI-based XR conversational services.

question_75638.question: What is the requirement for IRPAgent in the context of NFV?
question_75638.ground_truth: The IRPAgent shall support the capability allowing IRPManager to manage the mobile networks that include virtualized network functions. It shall also support the capability to differentiate the virtualized and non-virtualized network functions, and the capability to create, delete, update, and manage MOIs corresponding to a VNF instance.

question_75639.question: What is the use of the Notify SM Context Status service operation in providing SMF derived CN assisted RAN parameters tuning?
question_75639.ground_truth: The Notify SM Context Status service operation can be used by the SMF to provide the SMF derived CN assisted RAN parameters tuning to the NF Service Consumer (e.g. AMF), if the NF Service Consumer has indicated support of the CARPT (CN Assisted RAN Parameters Tuning) feature.

question_75641.question: How does the priority level granted to the MC service server 1 get mapped to an applicable SIP priority header or a reservation priority AVP?
question_75641.ground_truth: The priority level granted to the MC service server 1 can be mapped to an applicable SIP priority header or a reservation priority AVP when the MC service server uses the Rx reference point directly.

question_75644.question: What operation is invoked for charging events that are requested by the gsmSCF?
question_75644.ground_truth: The same operation as the CallGap procedure.

question_75645.question: What is the maximum processing time for the assistance data and location information request (T) in the PRS resources?

question_75646.question: What does the 9.2.2.131 IE define in the context of GANSS?
question_75646.ground_truth: This IE defines a specific signal within a particular GANSS.

question_75648.question: What is the role of the PCRF in the solution described in clause 7.2.1.2?
question_75648.ground_truth: The PCRF is responsible for ensuring that the relevant QoS rules are installed in the correct BBERFs.

question_75649.question: Which devices are specified for the SET UP CALL proactive command from the UICC to the network?
question_75649.ground_truth: The source device is UICC and the destination device is Network.

question_75651.question: What can be reused for all tickets that an IMS UE receives during the lifetime of its current security association with the KMS?
question_75651.ground_truth: The Mod B parameters used in the modification can be reused for all tickets that the IMS UE receives during the lifetime of its current security association with the KMS.

question_75652.question: What should the call control entity of the network do when, in any state except the "null" state and the "release request" state, receives a RELEASE message containing a Facility IE including an Invoke=CCBSRequest?
question_75652.ground_truth: The call control entity of the network in any state except the "null" state and the "release request" state, should upon receipt of a RELEASE message with a Facility IE including an Invoke=CCBSRequest, stop all running call control timers, send a RELEASE COMPLETE message indicating the success or failure of the recall activation attempt, release the MM connection, and return to the "null" state.

question_75653.question: What is the role of the "tGeographicalAreaChange" complex type as defined in the XML schema?
question_75653.ground_truth: The "tGeographicalAreaChange" complex type defines the structure for representing changes in geographical areas. It contains elements for specifying the type of area change and the corresponding geographical area definition.

question_75655.question: What should the User Equipment (UE) do in response to an authentication failure when it has a PDN connection for RLOS established or is establishing a PDN connection for RLOS?
question_75655.ground_truth: The UE should start any retransmission timers, consider itself attached for access to RLOS, and continue using the current security context, if any.

question_75657.question: What is the difference between the test method described in clause 7.10.3 and 7.10.3b for UE delay?
question_75657.ground_truth: The test method is the same in both clauses, except that for 7.10.3b the source levels are different. For analogue connections, the source level is -60 dBV at electrical reference interface output, and for digital connection, it is -16 dBm0 at electrical reference interface output.

question_75658.question: What should a mobile station do if a PACKET DOWNLINK ASSIGNMENT fails during uplink transfer?
question_75658.ground_truth: The mobile station should abort the procedure and continue the normal operation of the uplink TBF.

question_75663.question: What is the difference between 22.228 and IMS Multimedia Telephony services in terms of the systems used for making or receiving a voice (or video) service?
question_75663.ground_truth: In 22.228, a single system is used for making or receiving a voice (or video) service, whereas in IMS Multimedia Telephony, the same user may make or receive a voice service via two different systems (CS and PS/IMS).

question_75664.question: Which protocol is used as the user data bearer over the Iu towards the PS domain?
question_75664.ground_truth: GTP-U is used as the user data bearer over the Iu towards the PS domain.

question_75665.question: How are UE's radio resources chosen for 5G ProSe services?
question_75665.ground_truth: When serving a cell, UEs are required to use radio resources indicated by the cell. If not provided, the UE can use "operator-managed" resources or those provisioned in the ME or UICC.

question_75666.question: What protocols are used for IP Multicast access in the Packet Domain?
question_75666.ground_truth: The PDG shall support IGMP (IPv4) and/or MLD (IPv6) and one or more Inter-Router Multicast protocols, such as DVMRP, MOSPF, or PIM-SM.

question_75667.question: When does the UE stay in the current serving cell and applies the normal cell reselection process?
question_75667.ground_truth: The UE stays in the current serving cell and applies the normal cell reselection process if none of the conditions for starting the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update are met, or if the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update was not initiated due to network congestion, or if the lower layers indicate that the access attempt is barred.

question_75669.question: What action should the PDN GW take when it receives a Session Termination Request message and there is an ongoing session, but the Session-Id does not correspond with the active session for the user?
question_75669.ground_truth: The PDN GW shall send a Session Termination Answer message to the PDN GW or 3GPP AAA Proxy, indicating DIAMETER_UNKNOWN_SESSION_ID.

question_75670.question: What message is sent by the network to the MS containing a LCS-MOLR invoke component, indicating the start of a location procedure?
question_75670.ground_truth: A REGISTER message with an MO-LR request of type "locationEstimate" is sent by the MS to the network to initiate the location procedure.

question_75671.question: What is the name of the measurement that provides the number of all successful routing information interrogation responses sent by the SLF via all diameter interfaces?

question_75672.question: What action does the PCRF take when it sends an ASR (abort session request) command to the AF upon IP-CAN session termination?
question_75672.ground_truth: The PCRF sends an ASR command to the AF on each active Rx Diameter session when an IP-CAN session is terminated.

question_75674.question: How is the target PUSCH-less carrier of E-UTRA SCells for SRS carrier based switching specified in the case of aperiodic SRS transmission?
question_75674.ground_truth: The target PUSCH-less carrier of E-UTRA SCells for SRS carrier based switching is specified using the DCI SRS request field in the case of aperiodic SRS transmission.

question_75676.question: What is the role of UPF/NW-TT in 5G timings?
question_75676.ground_truth: UPF/NW-TT reports 5G GM or PTP GM time sync status (e.g. clock class and UTC traceability) to TSCTSF via PMIC/UMIC.

question_75677.question: In which message can the network provide the UE with one or more QoS rules or QoS flow descriptions when activating a default or dedicated EPS bearer context?
question_75677.ground_truth: ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST or ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message

question_75679.question: What does the provider do when it receives a request to deallocate a slice profile in an NSSI and an existing NSSI can be reused?
question_75679.ground_truth: The provider may modify the requested NSSI without termination to satisfy the request.

question_75682.question: What is the difference between mandatory, conditional, and optional parameters in the context of IRI records?
question_75682.ground_truth: Mandatory parameters are required for the record, conditional parameters are required in certain situations, and optional parameters are provided at the implementation's discretion.

question_75684.question: What are the main components of a non-add hoc add-on conference call in 3GPP networks?
question_75684.ground_truth: In a non-add hoc add-on conference call, a conference is initiated with a web interface, and a subconference is created for grouping parties. The application can then add parties to the subconference, and split or release subconferences as necessary.

question_75685.question: How often should the UE evaluate the inter-frequency cell re-selection criteria?
question_75685.ground_truth: The UE should evaluate the inter-frequency cell re-selection criteria at least every DRX cycle, which has a length of 1.28 seconds.

question_75686.question: What is the field that the H(e)NB shall verify to check the revocation status of the H(e)MS certificate when the H(e)MS is accessible on the public Internet?
question_75686.ground_truth: The H(e)NB shall verify the subjectAltName field of the H(e)MS certificate against the name of the H(e)MS.

question_75688.question: What should a UE do when it is provided with searchSpaceGroupIdList-r17 and searchSpaceSwitchTimer-r17 for PDCCH monitoring on an active DL BWP of a serving cell?
question_75688.ground_truth: If a UE is provided group indexes for a Type3-PDCCH CSS set or a USS set by searchSpaceGroupIdList-r17 and a timer value by searchSpaceSwitchTimer-r17 for PDCCH monitoring an active DL BWP of on a serving cell and the timer is running, the UE resets the timer after a slot of the active DL BWP of the serving cell if the UE detects a DCI format in a PDCCH reception in the slot with CRC scrambled by C-RNTI/CS-RNTI/MCS-C-RNTI/G-RNTI for multicast/G-CS-RNTI, otherwise, the UE decrements the timer value by one after a slot of the active DL BWP of the serving cell.

question_75689.question: What services does signalling transport provide for RANAP?
question_75689.ground_truth: Signalling transport provides two main services for RANAP: a connection oriented data transfer service, supported by a signalling connection between RNC and CN domain, and a connectionless data transfer service.

question_75690.question: What is the scaling factor "r" for positioning frequency layer i, and what values can it have?
question_75690.ground_truth: The scaling factor "r" for positioning frequency layer i is a duration of DL PRS symbols in ms corresponding to "ppw-durationOfPRS-ProcessingSymbolsN" if positioning frequency layer i is in Case 1, and to "ppw-durationOfPRS-ProcessingSymbolsN2" if positioning frequency layer i is in Case 2. It can have different values corresponding to different cases for positioning frequency layer i.

question_75691.question: Which filter language is used in the SOAP solution set for the Trace Management IRP?
question_75691.ground_truth: The filter language used in the SOAP solution set for the Trace Management IRP is the XPath Language.

question_75692.question: What are the scenarios supported in Solution 3?
question_75692.ground_truth: Solution 3 supports LIPA, SIPTO from the HNB Subsystem, and SIPTO from the macro network, and is applicable for breakout in the residential/enterprise IP network and breakout at or above RAN.

question_75693.question: What action does the mobile station take if it receives a CM SERVICE PROMPT message while in the WAIT FOR OUTGOING MM CONNECTION or WAIT FOR ADDITIONAL OUTGOING MM CONNECTION state?
question_75693.ground_truth: The mobile station sends an MM STATUS message with cause "Message not compatible with protocol state".

question_75694.question: What action does the PCRF take once it has determined the policy decision, considering MPS EPS Priority and IMS Signalling Priority for the user?
question_75694.ground_truth: The PCRF makes the authorization and policy decision. If MPS EPS Priority, MPS Priority Level, and IMS Signalling Priority are present for the user, the PCRF takes the information into account.

question_75695.question: What is the function of Alternative 1 in ensuring OMR?
question_75695.ground_truth: Alternative 1 ensures OMR by identifying a media path for a session that can bypass any network that does not provide media functions, as long as both the UE and the next interconnected network are reachable using public IP addresses.

question_75696.question: What state is set after the earliest media time is set and the play() command is issued when seek() method is called?
question_75696.ground_truth: The state is set to PAUSED.

question_75697.question: What is the purpose of the Assistance Data Transfer procedure in SLPP?
question_75697.ground_truth: The Assistance Data Transfer procedure in SLPP enables Endpoint A to request assistance data from Endpoint B to assist in positioning, and to enable Endpoint B to transfer assistance data in the absence of a request.

question_75699.question: What behavior is considered as incorrect paging in the context of CCCH in a GSM network?
question_75699.ground_truth: Incorrect paging is when a MS in idle mode responds to paging not meant for it, causing unnecessary accesses on CCCH. This could potentially block the use of CCCH and degrade GSM EGPRS and circuit-switched services for other users.

question_75700.question: What does the SMF do after receiving a notification from the UPF regarding a UE MAC address change?
question_75700.ground_truth: The SMF uses the established accounting session, if applicable, to inform the DN-AAA server by sending Diameter Accounting-Request Interim-Update with the latest UE MAC addresses in use.

question_75701.question: What potential vulnerability is introduced in 5GS due to the support of NoN-IP unicast/multicast/broadcast communication between two UEs and for communication via UE-to-UE and UE-to-Network relays?
question_75701.ground_truth: This support can open vulnerability in 5GS and allow various privacy attacks including tracing and tracking of entities and identities.

question_75702.question: What is the purpose of the Edge Enabler Server validating the registration request and verifying the security credentials when receiving a request from the Edge Enabler Client?
question_75702.ground_truth: The Edge Enabler Server validates the registration request and verifies the security credentials to ensure that the request is coming from a trusted source and that the necessary requirements can be fulfilled.

question_75703.question: What action does the SMSF take when deregistering a UE's SMSF registration for 3GPP access?
question_75703.ground_truth: The SMSF sends a DELETE request to the resource representing the UE's SMSF registration for 3GPP access.

question_75704.question: What should be the general test parameter settings in step 4.5.6.1.2.4.1-3?
question_75704.ground_truth: The general test parameter settings in step 4.5.6.1.2.4.1-3 include the parameters for the PCell, PSCell, and SCell, such as frequency, bandwidth, etc.

question_75705.question: What are the three key families identified for the massive Internet of Things application scenarios?
question_75705.ground_truth: The three key families identified are operational aspects, connectivity aspects, and resource efficiency aspects.

question_75706.question: What action should the MS (mobile station) take when the PDP context is deactivated and one or more MBMS contexts are linked to it?
question_75706.ground_truth: The MS should deactivate all linked MBMS contexts locally without peer-to-peer signaling between the MS and the network.

question_75708.question: What is the requirement for the 3GPP system to support a device accessing the network indirectly via a relay UE?

question_75709.question: What unit is the channel bandwidth (BWChannel) expressed in?

question_75711.question: Which organization is responsible for approving the related CRs (CRs stands for Change Requests) in the 3GPP system for UAS support?
question_75711.ground_truth: 3GPP (3rd Generation Partnership Project) is the organization responsible for approving these CRs.

question_75712.question: What is the impact of Charging in the operational aspects of the network?
question_75712.ground_truth: There is no impact of Charging in the operational aspects of the network.

question_75716.question: What components contribute to the age of content in the context of gaming?
question_75716.ground_truth: The age of content in gaming consists of the time taken to create one or more video buffers, encode them into a video stream frame, deliver the video frame to the game client, decode the video frame by the game client, and present the video frame to the user.

question_75717.question: In the context of step 11b, how many non-consecutive DTX subframes are allowed during the SCell1 deactivation for inter-band PCC(FDD) and SCells?
question_75717.ground_truth: Up to 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes are allowed during the SCell1 deactivation for inter-band PCC(FDD) and SCells.

question_75719.question: What is Unstructured Supplementary Service Data (USSD) and what is its role in mobile networks?
question_75719.ground_truth: Unstructured Supplementary Service Data (USSD) is a communications protocol used in mobile networks to provide out-of-band signaling and additional messages to the user. It is used for mobile initiated MMI mode over IP Multimedia Core Network Subsystem (IMS) and for network initiated MMI mode over IP Multimedia Core Network Subsystem (IMS) for the transparent transport of MMI strings entered by the user to the Application Servers (AS) and for the transparent transport of text strings back to the User Equipment (UE) to be displayed for user information.

question_75721.question: What is required for a UE to connect to a WLAN access network using 5GS credentials without a 5GS registration?
question_75721.ground_truth: The UE has to use a NAI format for 5G NSWO that has a realm different than the realm used for Trusted non-3GPP access to the 5GC.

question_75722.question: What are the two basic mechanisms by which downlink sub-band transmissions can impact the performance in the uplink sub-bands?
question_75722.ground_truth: The two basic mechanisms are unwanted emissions from the downlink sub-bands that occur at frequencies corresponding to the uplink sub-band and cause interference, and a high downlink power from the downlink sub-bands passing through the uplink receiver that can induce interference in the uplink sub-band due to non-linearities in the RF.

question_75723.question: What information is conveyed in the Modem Status Command and Response?
question_75723.ground_truth: The Modem Status Command conveys virtual V.24 control signals to a data stream, indicating the status of each signal. In a Response, a copy of the V.24 signals that are received from the Command frame is returned.

question_75726.question: What is the total number of prototype glottal impulse shapes in the codebook?
question_75726.ground_truth: The total number of prototype glottal impulse shapes in the codebook is 8.

question_75727.question: What is the significance of the availability time offset in the SAND message set for DASH-based streaming?
question_75727.ground_truth: The AvailabilityTimeOffset SAND message allows a DASH client to have advance knowledge of the availability time offset from the DANE to the DASH client, which can be useful for signaling availability time offset dependent on the network delivering it.

question_75729.question: What information does the SMF use to select a PCF instance when making a delegated discovery and selection in SCP?
question_75729.ground_truth: The SMF includes information such as the SUPI range, results of a discovery procedure with NRF, UE's SUPI, MA PDU session capability of the PCF, PCF Group ID, PCF Set ID, Same PCF Selection Indication, and URSP delivery in EPS capability of the PCF.

question_75730.question: What function can the AF (Application Function) provide in terms of sponsored data connectivity?
question_75730.ground_truth: The AF may provide the PCF with sponsored data connectivity information, including optionally a usage threshold, and may request the PCF to report events related to sponsored data connectivity.

question_75731.question: What are the two potential modes of communication between Intent-driven MnS consumer and producer?
question_75731.ground_truth: The two potential modes of communication are synchronous mode and asynchronous mode.

question_75732.question: What is the difference between a Gateway Control session that serves a single IP-CAN session and one that serves all the IP-CAN sessions from the same Care-of address of the UE?
question_75732.ground_truth: A Gateway Control session that serves a single IP-CAN session is used for S-GW/BBERF connecting to PDN-GW using S5/S8 PMIP, while a session that serves all the IP-CAN sessions from the same Care-of address of the UE is used for a UE connecting to PDN-GW using S2c.

question_75733.question: What does the ID id-ServingCellMO-encoded-in-CGC-List represent?
question_75733.ground_truth: The ServingCellMO-encoded-in-CGC-List represents a list of serving cell information that is encoded in the CGC.

question_75734.question: What should the UE do if it detects a cell on a NR carrier whose physical identity is not allowed for that carrier in the measurement control system information of the serving cell?
question_75734.ground_truth: The UE is not required to perform measurements on that cell.

question_75741.question: What is the expected final state of the MS when the SS sends a DISCONNECT message containing an optional information element not coded as "comprehension required" in the PICS statements section?
question_75741.ground_truth: The MS has a call control entity in CC state U19.

question_75742.question: What is the policy for providing the local emergency call numbers over 3GPP access and TWAN/ePDG to the UE?
question_75742.ground_truth: Procedures already exist for providing local emergency call numbers over 3GPP access. However, new procedures would need to be defined to provide the local emergency call numbers over TWAN/ePDG because those procedures are not yet in place.

question_75743.question: When does the EES send an ACR selection notification to the selected EAS?
question_75743.ground_truth: The EES sends an ACR selection notification to the selected EAS providing the selected ACR scenario list after the EEC selects the ACR scenario(s) that should be used for the given AC and selected EAS.

question_75744.question: What should the MS do if an unknown Access Technology Type is received?
question_75744.ground_truth: The MS should ignore all the corresponding fields if the received Access Technology Type is unknown.

question_75745.question: In the scenario where the UE (MCVideo Client) has upgraded an On-demand Pre-arranged Group Call with Automatic Commencement Mode to an Emergency Group Call and the MCVideo User is authorized for cancelling an MCVideo Emergency state (MCVideo in-progress emergency cancel), what should the UE (MCVideo Client) do when the MCVideo User requests to cancel the ongoing MCVideo Emergency state?
question_75745.ground_truth: The UE (MCVideo Client) should send a SIP re-INVITE request and upon receipt of a SIP 2xx response, consider the emergency condition cancelled and notify the user.

question_75747.question: What is the procedure for determining the physical cell identity of Cell 2 in the next iteration of the test procedure loop?
question_75747.ground_truth: The SS shall set Cell 2 physical cell identity to ((current cell 2 physical cell identity + 1) mod 14+2) for the next iteration of the test procedure loop.

question_75748.question: What is Receiver Antenna Gain (dBi) and how is it specified?
question_75748.ground_truth: Receiver Antenna Gain (dBi) is the maximum gain of the receiver antenna in the horizontal plane, specified in decibels (dB) relative to an isotropic radiator.

question_75749.question: What is the maximum number of random access attempts a device can perform in the EC-GSM system?
question_75749.ground_truth: Each device can perform up to a maximum of 6 random access attempts in the EC-GSM system.

question_75750.question: What should the UE do if it receives the Always-on PDU session indication IE with the value set to "Always-on PDU session required" for a PDU session and the network does not send the Always-on PDU session indication IE in a subsequent PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message?
question_75750.ground_truth: The UE shall consider the PDU session as an always-on PDU session.

question_75752.question: When should the UE set the onDemandSISuccess to true?
question_75752.ground_truth: The UE should set the onDemandSISuccess to true if the on-demand system information acquisition was successful and the UE received the requested system information.

question_75753.question: How many steps does the registration procedure have when slice authentication is performed?
question_75753.ground_truth: The registration procedure has 12 steps when slice authentication is performed.

question_75754.question: Which message in Cx Interface is impacted by the Early IMS Security mechanism, and what is required in those messages when Early IMS Security is employed?
question_75754.ground_truth: The User-Authorisation-Request/Answer (Cx-UAR/UAA), Multimedia-Auth-Request/Answer (Cx-MAR/MAA) and Server-Assignment-Request/Answer (Cx-SAR/SAA) messages are impacted by the Early IMS Security mechanism. When employed, a Private User Identity must be derived from the Temporary Public User Identity and used in the User-Name AVP of certain Cx messages, such as UAR and MAR. Additionally, the SIP-Auth-Data-Item grouped AVP must contain the user IP address in MAA commands, and the SIP-Auth-Data-Item AVP is replaced by a new structure.

question_75755.question: What are the two types of TCP establishment procedures supported for Rel-12?
question_75755.ground_truth: The two types of TCP establishment procedures supported for Rel-12 are immediate TCP connection establishment (mandatory) and delayed TCP connection establishment (optional).

question_75756.question: What command types are sent to the network in expected sequence 1.1 and 1.2?
question_75756.ground_truth: The command types sent to the network in expected sequence 1.1 and 1.2 are both "SEND DTMF".

question_75757.question: What should the P-CSCF do with a 401 (Unauthorized) response received from the S-CSCF when the REGISTER request was challenged?
question_75757.ground_truth: The P-CSCF should delete any temporary set of security associations established towards the UE, remove the "ck" and "ik" WWW-Authenticate header field parameters from the 401 (Unauthorized) response, and bind the values to the proper private user identity and to the temporary set of security associations which will be setup as a result of this challenge. The P-CSCF shall forward the 401 (Unauthorized) response to the UE if and only if the "ck" and "ik" header field parameters have been removed. Additionally, it should insert a Security-Server header field in the response, containing the P-CSCF static signalling plane security list and the parameters needed for this security association setup.

question_75758.question: What is the minimum communication range between vessels in 3GPP maritime communication?
question_75758.ground_truth: The minimum communication range between vessels shall be equal to the maximum line-of-sight range between antennas mounted on two vessels at sea or on inland waterways.

question_75759.question: What happens when a FRMCS User relocates from the FRMCS System to the GSM-R system?
question_75759.ground_truth: The applicable functional identity or identities associated with FRMCS user require(s) a conversion to the functional address format applicable within the GSM-R system.

question_75760.question: What is the format of N6RP in the "IP.N6OutLinkUsage.N6RP" measurement of the N6 interface?
question_75760.ground_truth: The format of N6RP is vendor specific

question_75761.question: How is the RAN-visible QoE information reported and who handles it?
question_75761.ground_truth: The RAN-visible QoE information is reported as a separate IE visible to the RAN. It can be assembled and sent by an NG-RAN node to a UE, which then includes the RAN-visible report in the MeasReportAppLayer IE, and sends it to the RAN. The NG-RAN node then reads the RAN-visible QoE information and forwards it to the QoE server accordingly.

question_75763.question: In single RAT UTRA operation, what shall the emissions inside any sub-block gap not exceed?
question_75763.ground_truth: The emissions inside any sub-block gap shall not exceed the cumulative sum of the minimum requirements specified for the adjacent sub blocks on each side of the sub-block gap.

question_75764.question: Which cell is the inter-RAT neighbor cell of NR Cell 1 in this pre-test condition?
question_75764.ground_truth: UTRA Cell 5 is the inter-RAT neighbor cell of NR Cell 1 in this pre-test condition.

question_75766.question: Which frequency division duplex mode supports both full duplex and half duplex operation in the LTE system?

question_75768.question: What is a possibility to overcome one of the main disadvantages of a distributed approach for UC identification and scoring?
question_75768.ground_truth: A possibility to overcome one of the main disadvantages of a distributed approach is to centralize the scoring part, with a single scoring instance operated by a neutral organization and UC sensor functionality distributed across different networks.

question_75769.question: What information does the USS send to the UE during the UUAA procedure?
question_75769.ground_truth: The USS sends an Authentication Response message, including the GPSI, the UUAA result, the authorized CAA-level UAV ID, and a UUAA Authorization Payload to the UE.

question_75770.question: What should the floor participant do upon receiving RTP media packets during the 'U: pending Request' state?
question_75770.ground_truth: The floor participant should request the MCPTT client to start rendering the received RTP media packets, start the optional timer T103 (End of RTP media) for the floor participant form which RTP packets were received, and remain in the 'U: pending Request' state.

question_75771.question: How do the MME and HSS maintain sessions when using the Diameter protocol?
question_75771.ground_truth: Between the MME and the HSS and between the SGSN and the HSS, Diameter sessions are implicitly terminated, meaning the server does not maintain state information about the session and the client does not send re-authorization or session termination requests.

question_75772.question: What frequencies will two-tone 3rd order IMD fall into when using Band 8 and 11 in LTE Advanced Carrier Aggregation?
question_75772.ground_truth: Two-tone 3rd order IMD will fall into BS receive frequencies of Band 8, 21 when using Band 8 and 11 in LTE Advanced Carrier Aggregation.

question_75773.question: What is the purpose of the MIC field in the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message?
question_75773.ground_truth: The MIC field is used to verify the integrity protection of the PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message.

question_75774.question: How does the MME/SGSN identify if the MM context of the UE exists and if the UE has an IMS PDN connection context?
question_75774.ground_truth: The MME/SGSN shall check the UE state to identify if the MM context of the UE exists and if the UE has an IMS PDN connection context.

question_75778.question: What should the system simulator do to perform dynamic ARFCN mapping tests?
question_75778.ground_truth: The system simulator should follow the requirements and rules in 3GPP TS 45.005 and 3GPP TS 44.018 for dynamic ARFCN mapping, including changing ARFCN values to physical frequencies.

question_75779.question: What is used to signal the use of JSON format for the content type in the HTTP bodies specified in the specification?
question_75779.ground_truth: The content type "application/json" is used to signal the use of JSON format for the content type in the HTTP bodies specified in the specification.

question_75780.question: How long should a UE consider stored system information to be valid, unless specified otherwise?
question_75780.ground_truth: 3 hours or 24 hours from the moment it was confirmed to be valid.

question_75782.question: What is the solution for addressing security issues in NB-IoT positioning?
question_75782.ground_truth: The solution is to indicate to an E-SMLC whether AS security is currently being used for a UE in an LCS-AP Location Request. The E-SMLC would then take this into account when instigating different uplink positioning procedures.

question_75783.question: What is the purpose of the VCC Domain Transfer Number (VDN) in the context of voice call continuity?
question_75783.ground_truth: The VCC Domain Transfer Number (VDN) is a public telecommunication number used by the UE to request Domain Transfer to the CS domain from the Domain Transfer Function within VCC.

question_75784.question: What are the mandatory regulatory requirements for the technical conditions of 900 MHz UMTS operation in Japan for UTRA?
question_75784.ground_truth: The mandatory regulatory requirements for the technical conditions of 900 MHz UMTS operation in Japan for UTRA include frequency error, spurious emissions, adjacent channel leakage power ratio (ACLR), spectrum emission mask, occupied bandwidth, maximum output power and transmit OFF power.

question_75785.question: What is the role of the RAB sub-flow combination (RFC) in the Iu UP protocol?
question_75785.ground_truth: The RAB sub-flow combination (RFC) is an authorized combination of the variable attributes of currently valid RAB sub-flows that can be submitted simultaneously to the Iu UP for transmission over the Iu interface.

question_75786.question: What should a UE do if it is in the process of establishing a non-emergency PDN connection without an APN provided by the UE and it has already sent a BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message without an APN?
question_75786.ground_truth: The UE should not send another BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message without an APN and with request type different from "emergency" or "handover of emergency bearer services", or another PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST or BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST message for a non-emergency PDN connection established without an APN provided by the UE, until the UE is switched off or the USIM is removed, or it receives an ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST or DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message for a non-emergency PDN connection established without an APN provided by the UE. The UE may send another BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST message in the PLMN for the same APN if the Back-off timer value IE is not included in the network's response.

question_75787.question: What is the challenge in using the existing public numbering resources for MTC services?
question_75787.ground_truth: The challenge is that there are unprecedented demands for E.164 MSISDNs resources for MTC services and these demands are expected to accelerate, leading to a significant risk of some national numbering/dialling plans running out of numbers. This would impact not only MTC services but also GSM/UMTS service providers in general.

question_75788.question: What is specified in sub clause 4.4.3 of the document?
question_75788.ground_truth: Sub clause 4.4.3 specifies the common parameters for the simulated NR cells in standalone NR and non-standalone network scenarios.

question_75790.question: What should the IBCF do if the SDP answer contains none of the codecs from the original SDP offer?
question_75790.ground_truth: The IBCF shall select one of the returned codecs and invoke the transcoding function.

question_75794.question: What should the SS do after time duration T1 if the UE has not re-selected Cell 1 and T1 has expired?
question_75794.ground_truth: The SS should switch off and on the UE and continue with step 11.

question_75796.question: What is the purpose of the MSGin5G Server in determining if a client is allowed to send a message to the Application Server?
question_75796.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server determines if the MSGin5G Client or Non-3GPP UE is authorized to send a message to the Application Server based on the information received in the MSGin5G message request.

question_75797.question: What function does the GSMF perform in the 5G VN group management?
question_75797.ground_truth: The GSMF handles a new NF type, registers to NRF, retrieves peer SMFs, manages N19 tunnels and manages UE IP/MAC addresses for VN group communications.

question_75798.question: In case of Emergency Attach, what information is used as the UE Identity to the PCRF when the IMSI is marked as unauthenticated?
question_75798.ground_truth: The IMEI (International Mobile Equipment Identity) is used as the UE Identity in the message to the PCRF.

question_75799.question: In the context of an ADRF, what does the "storeHandl" attribute indicate?
question_75799.ground_truth: The "storeHandl" attribute indicates the storage approach to be followed for the data or analytics, such as the lifetime of the data or analytics and the deletion notification URI.

question_75800.question: In the test described in 3GPP TS 04.60 subclause 7.1.2.3, what does the mobile station do when it receives a PACKET UPLINK ACK/NACK with incorrect TLLI?
question_75800.ground_truth: The mobile station is required to 'immediately' stop transmitting and retry the packet access procedure.

question_75801.question: What is the purpose of the Furnish Charging Information SMS Information Flow?
question_75801.ground_truth: The Furnish Charging Information SMS Information Flow is used to request the gsmSSF or gprsSSF to include information in the CAMEL specific logical MO SMS or MT SMS record.

question_75802.question: In the SP/AP SRS TCI State Indication MAC CE, what field indicates whether to activate or deactivate indicated SP SRS resource set?

question_75803.question: What are the attributes of the InferenceFeedback IOC?
question_75803.ground_truth: The attributes of the InferenceFeedback IOC are: inference report ID, indication of whether there are actions to be taken due to the inference report, and feedback for the inference report in the form of lack of confidence or accuracy for a specific output information element.

question_75806.question: What are some of the gaps observed in TS 26.114 for MTSI when introducing NR as a new access technology?
question_75806.ground_truth: Some of the gaps observed in TS 26.114 for MTSI include the need to define speech frame encapsulation parameters for the SDP offer-answer messages, the need for access network bitrate recommendation (ANBR) message mapping for NR access, the need for ECN-triggered media rate adaptation for speech and video, the need for RAN delay budget reporting mechanisms for NR access, and the need for media handling enhancements for enabling codec-aware optimizations of single radio voice call continuity (SRVCC) handover thresholds in Voice over LTE (VoLTE).

question_75807.question: What are two situations where users may experience problems receiving MBMS services?
question_75807.ground_truth: a) When an operator provides a service on one access only and a UE is camping on the other; b) When an operator provides a service with different QoS levels on two access types and a UE changes access type during an ongoing MBMS session.

question_75808.question: With which PLMN identity should the MS initialize the Routing Area Identification in a shared network for GERAN using the A/Gb mode in 3GPP TS 24.008?
question_75808.ground_truth: The chosen PLMN identity should be indicated to the GERAN in the first RLC data block of an upper layer PDU when a foreign TLLI is used by the network sharing supporting MS for transmission.

question_75811.question: What is a necessary condition for a UE to be selected for MDT data collection in the gNB-CU-UP?
question_75811.ground_truth: A necessary condition for a UE to be selected for MDT data collection in the gNB-CU-UP is that the serving PLMN is within the Management Based MDT PLMN List.

question_75812.question: Which condition is required for the maximum input level for Intra-band non-contiguous CA in 7.4A.0.2?
question_75812.ground_truth: The condition for maximum input level for Intra-band non-contiguous CA in 7.4A.0.2 requires the same conditions as in 7.4A.0.1.

question_75813.question: Who is responsible for entering the LIID for each target identity?
question_75813.ground_truth: The authorized operator (NO/AN/SP) is responsible for entering the LIID for each target identity.

question_75814.question: For a UE to access a CSG cell, how is the HNB required to secure communication?
question_75814.ground_truth: The HNB is required to secure the communication to/from the SeGW, which is a mandatory logical function implemented either as a separate physical entity or integrated into the HNB GW.

question_75815.question: When should the HSS immediately push the complete user profile to the S-CSCF during a request to update the user profile?
question_75815.ground_truth: If the Public Identity is registered or unregistered and there are changes in the user profile, the HSS should immediately push the complete user profile to the S-CSCF.

question_75816.question: What kind of mechanisms are used for differentiation of BSSAP and BSSOMAP in the SCCP?
question_75816.ground_truth: Differentiation between BSSAP and BSSOMAP is by addressing mechanisms within the SCCP, using the subsystem number, as specified in 3GPP~TS~48.002.

question_75817.question: What is the purpose of the SID parameters in FD-CNG?
question_75817.ground_truth: The SID parameters in FD-CNG describe the energy of the background noise in the spectral partitions. The first parameters capture the spectral energy of the noise in FFT bins covering the core bandwidth, and the remaining parameters capture the spectral energy of the noise in CLDFB bands above the core bandwidth. These parameters are then interpolated using linear interpolation in the log domain and then used to estimate a set of LPC coefficients and used to update excitation and LPC related memories.

question_75818.question: What is the function of the AAA-P in the network?
question_75818.ground_truth: The AAA-P in the network acts as a proxy for the NSS-AAA when it belongs to a third party, or when the operator deploys it towards third parties. It is used by the NSSAAF to send the access-request message for authentication/authorization information.

question_75819.question: What action is taken by the eNB if the packet limit for the current fast path session is exceeded?
question_75819.ground_truth: The eNB releases the S1-U connection and removes the Small Data Fast Path information if the packet limit for the current fast path session is exceeded.

question_75820.question: When is UC identification necessary to be evaluated real-time and when is it possible to be non-real-time for an IMR-based PUCI AS?
question_75820.ground_truth: UC identification must be evaluated real-time for an IMR-based PUCI AS as the result of UC identification (a UC marking/score) has to be delivered with the signaling of the call, but for Supplementary Services UC identification can be non-real-time, such as putting a UC source on a blacklist via a web interface of the operator.

question_75821.question: Which RFC specifies the DHCPv6 message format to support the DHCPv6 server and relay function?

question_75824.question: What is the maximum length of the Session-Id field in the AA-Request (AAA) command in 3GPP AAA protocol?
question_75824.ground_truth: There is no maximum length of the Session-Id field in the AA-Request (AAA) command.

question_75825.question: What are the expected user experienced data rates for the 3GPP system as per PR.5.1.3.1-001?
question_75825.ground_truth: The 3GPP system shall support user experienced data rates of up to 1 Gbps DL (downlink) and 500 Mbps UL (uplink) while the user is moving slowly up to 10 km/h.

question_75826.question: What does the "Number of scheduled TB for SC-MTCH" field in the corresponding DCI determine in NPRACH transmission?
question_75826.ground_truth: The "Number of scheduled TB for SC-MTCH" field in the corresponding DCI determines the number of UL subframes in which the UE transmits the physical random access response message for the NPRACH transmission.

question_75827.question: What message does the MS send and what state does it enter if it supports immediate connect for the selected basic service?
question_75827.ground_truth: The MS sends a CONNECT message and enters the state U8, connect request.

question_75829.question: What should the MCPTT client do when it receives a SIP INVITE request for the private call with an SDP offer not including a media-level section for a media-floor control entity?
