question_75829.ground_truth: The MCPTT client shall consider it as the request for private call without floor control and shall follow the procedures as specified in subclause~11.1.1.2.1.2 for on-demand session and subclause~11.1.1.2.2.2 for pre-established session.

question_75831.question: What is an AMF within the context of 3GPP 23.501 and 29.510?
question_75831.ground_truth: An AMF (Access and Mobility Management Function) in 3GPP 23.501 and 29.510 is responsible for the network access, mobility management, and session management of UEs.

question_75832.question: What should the MS do if it is incapable of accepting the new QoS Negotiated by the network?
question_75832.ground_truth: The MS should initiate application level signalling to lower the QoS requirements for the concerned application(s). If this is not possible, the MS should de-activate the PDP context with the PDP Context Deactivation Initiated by the MS procedure.

question_75833.question: What is the name of the data structure used to store and exchange XR Spatial Description information?

question_75836.question: What does the slice profile consist of in the context of network slicing management?
question_75836.ground_truth: The slice profile consists of an associated set of requirements (e.g. those derived from service level requirements) that are applicable to the network slice subnet constituents, such as TN requirements (e.g. set of QoS attributes for the links interconnecting network slice subnet constituent network functions). The slice profile may be common or specific (applicable to only AN network function or only to CN network function network slice subnet constituents).

question_75837.question: What should the UE do after sending the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMPLETE for the ongoing PDU session modification procedure in case 6 if the QoS rule is not the default QoS rule?
question_75837.ground_truth: The UE shall send a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message with 5GSM cause #83 "semantic error in the QoS operation" to delete the QoS rule.

question_75839.question: What is the purpose of the Return Preferred information in the Context Response?
question_75839.ground_truth: The Return Preferred information in the Context Response is an indication by the MME of a preferred return of the UE to the last used EPS PLMN at a later access change to an EPS shared network. Based on this indication, the AMF may store the last used EPS PLMN ID in UE Context.

question_75840.question: What is the effect of the PreferredRoamingPartnerList node in the selection criteria?
question_75840.ground_truth: If a WLAN access network satisfies rules associated with the PreferredRoamingPartnerList node, the WLAN access network matches this node.

question_75841.question: What protocol stack is used for the control plane of the SCCH for the PC5 interface in NR sidelink communication?
question_75841.ground_truth: The AS protocol stack for the control plane for SCCH for RRC in the PC5 interface consists of RRC, PDCP, RLC and MAC sublayers, and the physical layer.

question_75842.question: Which bands, besides Band 1, 2, 5, 20, 22, 26, 27, 28, 33, 38 and 42, may have interference issues when using Bands 7, 27, and 28 in a geographical area?
question_75842.ground_truth: The third-order IMD products of Bands 7, 27, and 28 may only fall into the BS receive band of Bands 5, 20, 26, 27, 28, and 38, but bands 6, 13, 14, 18, 19, 41 and 44 are not intended for use in the same geographical area as bands 7 and 28.

question_75845.question: Which command is used to attempt to perform a PS attach if it is not already attached?
question_75845.ground_truth: When the 'S0=n' (n>0) command is received, the MT shall attempt to perform a PS attach if it is not already attached.

question_75848.question: Which algorithm does an operator use to derive the "TOPc" variable from TOP and K in the Tuak algorithm set?
question_75848.ground_truth: The TOPc variable is derived from TOP and K in the Tuak algorithm set using the functions f1, f1*, f2, f3, f4, f5 and f5* in the 3GPP system.

question_75850.question: What action should the UE take if it receives the 5GMM cause value #12 (Tracking area not allowed) in a REGISTRATION REJECT message?
question_75850.ground_truth: The UE should set the 5GS update status to 5U3 (Roaming Not Allowed), delete certain information, reset the registration attempt counter, store the current TAI in the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service", and enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.

question_75851.question: What happens during an Emergency Attach when the MME receives an unsuccessful Update Location Response from HSS?
question_75851.ground_truth: The MME shall ignore it and continue with the Attach procedure.

question_75853.question: What requirements should the E-UTRAN intra-frequency measurements under time domain measurement resource restriction meet in section 8.1.2.8?
question_75853.ground_truth: The requirements in sections 8.1.2.8.1 and 8.1.2.8.2 should be met, except for the measurement reporting requirements. The measurement reporting requirements for E-CID RSRP and RSRQ are defined in section 8.1.2.8.3.

question_75854.question: What are the two ways in which the first PDSCH can be dropped for processing?
question_75854.ground_truth: The first PDSCH can be dropped for processing in one of the two ways: (1) by dropping the processing of the first PDSCH on the same serving cell, or (2) by dropping the processing of a PDSCH(s) on the same cell or a different serving cell.

question_75855.question: What are the three reference UE antenna patterns adopted for fast fading?
question_75855.ground_truth: The three reference UE antenna patterns adopted for fast fading are Quasi Isotropic with linear polarization, Co-phased array with dual linear polarization, and VSAT type with circular polarization.

question_75856.question: What message does the ePDG send to the PGW during an IPSec tunnel update initiated by the UE?
question_75856.ground_truth: The ePDG sends a Modify bearer request message with the new UE local IP address to the PGW.

question_75859.question: Which organization standardized the A interface User Plane over IP (AoIP) in the 48-series?

question_75860.question: What value should the network set for back-off timer T3346 in the event of general NAS level mobility management congestion control?
question_75860.ground_truth: The network should assign a value for back-off timer T3346 when the service request for mobile originated services is rejected due to general NAS level mobility management congestion control.

question_75862.question: In what situation will the MS deactivate all MBMS contexts locally that are not in SM state PDP-INACTIVE?
question_75862.ground_truth: When the MBMS context status information element is not included in the ROUTING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message.

question_75863.question: What does the SCC AS do upon sending the I1 Success message to the UE?
question_75863.ground_truth: Upon sending the I1 Success message to the UE, the SCC AS considers the service control signalling as being transferred from the Gm interface to the I1 interface and the associated CS media as being transferred to the I1 session (i.e. the I1 protocol is now controlling the transferred CS media).

question_75865.question: What should be done to ensure minimal effects on the measurement results in an antenna measurement system?
question_75865.ground_truth: All coaxial cables should be dressed to minimize the effects.

question_75867.question: What is the role of an ML entity loading MnS producer in deploying an ML entity?
question_75867.ground_truth: An ML entity loading MnS producer is responsible for loading the ML entity to the target inference function(s) after the ML entity is trained and tested. This may be done based on a request from the MnS consumer or initiated based on a consumer predefined loading policy.

question_75869.question: What is the purpose of the noise fill step in 6.8.1.4.2.3.2?
question_75869.ground_truth: The noise fill step adds noise over all the frequency bins at a constant level, making the transition between non-modified and modified excitation smoother.

question_75870.question: What is the name of the first time period in the test procedure, with duration of T1?

question_75873.question: What are the main issues to consider when interactions between services occur in the context of network services?
question_75873.ground_truth: The main issues to consider are the different phases of a call, a service spanning on more than one network, and service interactions that may occur between services offered to a single user, as well as between services offered to different interacting users.

question_75874.question: What should the UDM do if the HPLMN UDM received and verified the UE acknowledgement in step 5?
question_75874.ground_truth: The UDM informs the SOR-AF about successful delivery of the SOR-CMCI to the UE, and includes the "ME support of SOR-CMCI" indicator and the "ME support of SOR-SNPN-SI" indicator, if any.

question_75876.question: In the process of upgrading the MCPTT group session to an MCPTT emergency call, what should the MCPTT client include as per step (b)?
question_75876.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should include a Resource-Priority header field and comply with the procedures in subclause~6.2.8.1.2.

question_75877.question: What information is required for a UE to assist GPS initialisation in the ASN.1 definition?
question_75877.ground_truth: The ASN.1 definition for GPS-related information includes the timeInfoUTC-r11 field, which provides the number of seconds since January 1, 1900, at midnight 00:00:00 UTC. The UE may use this information to assist GPS initialisation.

question_75878.question: In case the UE's are not authorized to use ProSe, what can they do to continue communicating?
question_75878.ground_truth: If the UE's are not authorized to use ProSe, they can continue to communicate via the infrastructure as they are already in RRC connected state.

question_75879.question: What is the network slice usage control information provisioning behavior in roaming scenarios?
question_75879.ground_truth: Network slice usage control information provisioning/update/removal by the PCF is not supported in roaming scenarios.

question_75880.question: What data is classified as sensitive application data in the context of MCData plane?
question_75880.ground_truth: The sensitive application data in the context of MCData plane includes MCData ID, MCData group ID, alert indicator, access token, and MCData client ID.

question_75881.question: What is the maximum queuing delay for over 99% of calls at full CPU load without TA?

question_75882.question: What is required to enable application specific information exchanges between the client and the server in the UE and network?
question_75882.ground_truth: The network and UE shall be able to enable application specific information exchanges (e.g. client events, display information, etc.) with conversational QoS.

question_75883.question: What happens in the VLR if the HLR receives a request that should be barred due to Operator Determined Barring, and the VLR does not support this feature?
question_75883.ground_truth: The VLR will reject the request with an appropriate phase 1 error, such as illegal SS operation or system failure.

question_75884.question: What is the MBMS HC Indicator field used for in the MBMS IP Multicast Distribution in 3GPP TS 25.413?
question_75884.ground_truth: The MBMS HC Indicator field in the MBMS IP Multicast Distribution is used to indicate if header compression should be used for MBMS user plane data in 3GPP TS 25.413. It is encoded as a one octet long enumeration, with two enumeration values: 0 (indicates "uncompressed-header") and 1 (indicates "compressed-header").

question_75885.question: What are the general requirements for the key establishment procedure between a UICC and a terminal?
question_75885.ground_truth: The general requirements for the key establishment procedure between a UICC and a terminal include the ability of the terminal and the UICC to establish a shared key, trustworthiness of the terminal, encryption of the shared key during transmission, authentication of the terminal and the network, a trusted server handling authentication parameters and the shared key, and authorization control by the home network.

question_75887.question: What is the purpose of increasing the transmission power of cell 5 at the beginning of T2?
question_75887.ground_truth: The purpose of increasing the transmission power of cell 5 at the beginning of T2 is to trigger Event A6.

question_75888.question: What message is sent by the gNB-CU to the AMF to indicate the successful preparation of resources for the outgoing handover from 5GS to EPS for EPS fallback?

question_75889.question: What is a Managed Object (MO) in the context of a Management Information Model (MIM)?
question_75889.ground_truth: A Managed Object (MO) is an abstract entity that represents a Network Resource (NR) for the purpose of management in a Management Information Model (MIM). It is an instance of a Managed Object Class (MOC) constituting a clearly defined sub-network, and the MIM describes its attributes and operations.

question_75890.question: What is the function of the Refer request in the media retrieval process?
question_75890.ground_truth: The Refer request is used by a UE to initiate the media retrieval process and identify the source and details of the media component(s) to be retrieved.

question_75891.question: How are keys (CSK or MuSiKs) within key download messages distributed in the MCX system?
question_75891.ground_truth: Keys within key download messages are distributed encrypted specifically to a MCX user and signed using an identity representing the MCX Server.

question_75893.question: When is the LMF required to perform additional support in the privacy verification process?
question_75893.ground_truth: The LMF may require additional support in the privacy verification process when some of the UEs have different HPLMN, are not in network coverage, or have different serving AMF.

question_75894.question: What should the SGSN do after sending the BSSAP+-GPRS-DETACH-INDICATION message to the VLR in the explicit GPRS detach procedure?
question_75894.ground_truth: After sending the BSSAP+-GPRS-DETACH-INDICATION message, the SGSN shall start timer T8 and move the state of the association to Gs-NULL.

question_75895.question: When is secure exchange of NAS messages established during inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode in EMM-CONNECTED mode?
question_75895.ground_truth: Secure exchange of NAS messages is established using NAS security related parameters encapsulated in the AS signalling from the AMF to the UE triggering the inter-system handover, and using the mapped EPS security context in the NAS messages exchanged between the UE and the MME.

question_75897.question: What is the interference signal used in the additional BC3 blocking minimum requirement for BS operating in the same geographical area as UTRA TDD?
question_75897.ground_truth: The interference signal is a 1,28 Mcps UTRA TDD signal as specified in 3GPP TS 37.104 Annex A.

question_75898.question: What is the parameter range for the access category number of operator-specific access categories in the 3GPP system?
question_75898.ground_truth: The access category number for operator-specific access categories in the 3GPP system is in the range 32-63.

question_75899.question: What should the UE do if it is allowed to reduce maximum transmit power for certain TFCs and E-TFCs?
question_75899.ground_truth: The UE should use the reduced maximum transmit power in the evaluation of TFC and E-TFC selection criteria for those TFCs.

question_75900.question: What is the purpose of the group call response message from the MCPTT server of the primary MCPTT system to the affiliated MCPTT user upon receiving responses to call requests?
question_75900.ground_truth: The group call response message will consist of the success or failure result and/or detailed reason information if there is a failure to establish the group call involving users from both the primary and partner MCPTT systems.

question_75901.question: What should the MME assume about the UE's supported security algorithms if it doesn't have access to the UE's EPS security capabilities?
question_75901.ground_truth: If the MME does not have access to the UE's EPS security capabilities, it shall assume that the default set of EPS security algorithms defined in clause 9.2.2.1 of the present document is supported by the UE.

question_75902.question: What should the MCData clients receive in step 9 of the MCData group standalone FD procedure if the file is not successfully received over MBMS due to poor reception quality?
question_75902.ground_truth: The media storage client of the MCData client(s) can download the file using the procedure defined in subclause 7.5.2.3 if the file is not successfully received over MBMS due to poor reception quality.

question_75903.question: What is the test requirement specified for out-of-band blocking for intra-band non-contiguous EN-DC (2 CCs) in clause 7.6B.3.2?
question_75903.ground_truth: The test requirement is the same as that for NR carrier in clause 7.6.3.5 of TS 38.521-1.

question_75904.question: What is the maximum average MSD transmission time allowed for the specified full campaign in AMR-FR codec modes plus GSM-FR for the full test campaign in the FoM metric?
question_75904.ground_truth: The maximum average MSD transmission time allowed for the specified full campaign in AMR-FR codec modes plus GSM-FR for the full test campaign in the FoM metric is 2.90 seconds.

question_75905.question: What are the methods of mutual authentication supported by the terminal?
question_75905.ground_truth: The terminal should support certificate-based mutual authentication or shared key-based mutual authentication using PSK TLS with a pre-shared key.

question_75906.question: What does the Certificate Update Orchestrator (CUO) do in the context of bulk certificate updates?
question_75906.ground_truth: The CUO is a network management functionality that monitors various factors such as certificate expiry, revocations, and incoming triggers, and schedules certificate updates in a staggered and prioritized manner to avoid service disruptions during bulk certificate updates.

question_75907.question: When is the SCell activation delay equal to TFirstATRS + Tgap + TATRS + 5ms in the FR1 band?
question_75907.ground_truth: The SCell activation delay is equal to TFirstATRS + Tgap + TATRS + 5ms when the SCell is an FR1 cell, contiguous to an active serving cell in the same band, and fulfills the specified conditions.

question_75908.question: What should a receiving node do when it receives a message with one or more IEs/IE groups marked as "Ignore IE" that it does not comprehend?
question_75908.ground_truth: The receiving node should ignore the content of the not comprehended IEs/IE groups and continue with the procedure as if the not comprehended IEs/IE groups were not received using the understood IEs/IE groups.

question_75909.question: What is the required response time for a MS to transmit using the new TA value after receiving it in response to a handover access burst, as per 3GPP TS 05.10 subclause 6.9?

question_75912.question: In which situations should the UE include an EPS bearer context status IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message?
question_75912.ground_truth: The UE may include an EPS bearer context status IE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message if it has at least one dedicated EPS bearer context active in the UE, if it has established PDN connection(s) of "non IP" or Ethernet PDN type, or if it has locally deactivated at least one dedicated or default EPS bearer context upon an inter-system mobility or inter-system change.

question_75916.question: What does the username part of the NAI represent in the context of 5GCN registration via a trusted non-3GPP access?
question_75916.ground_truth: The username part of the NAI is not used to identify the UE, it is rather used by the trusted non-3GPP access for TNGF selection.

question_75917.question: Which command code is used for the STR (Session-Termination-Request) Command for STa?

question_75919.question: What is the value of the "associatedProcedureDescriptionURI" in the provided Service Announcement procedure and what is its purpose?
question_75919.ground_truth: The value of the "associatedProcedureDescriptionURI" is "<serviceURI/>" which is an empty tag. It is used in the associatedProcedureDescription fragment to specify the procedure used in the service.

question_75920.question: What is the difference in DL bandwidth between Alternative 1 and Alternative 2 for the AWS-Extension band?
question_75920.ground_truth: Alternative 2 adds 20MHz of DL compared to Alternative 1.

question_75921.question: What is the maximum power intermodulation products can have without violating the 10 dB SNR requirement in the desired signal band?
question_75921.ground_truth: The maximum power intermodulation products can have without violating the 10 dB SNR requirement in the desired signal band is -116.8 dBm.

question_75922.question: What does the document define in the context of USIM Application Toolkit?
question_75922.ground_truth: The document defines the interface between the UICC and the ME, the commands, the application protocol, and the mandatory requirements on the UICC and ME for each procedure in the context of USIM Application Toolkit.

question_75924.question: What does the TS 32.571 standard define in the context of 3GPP Technical Specification Group Services and System Aspects, Telecommunication management?
question_75924.ground_truth: The TS 32.571 standard defines Telecommunication management, Home Node B (HNB) and Home eNode B (HeNB) management, and Type 2 interface concepts and requirements.

question_75925.question: Does the card reader support ID-1 size cards?
question_75925.ground_truth: In the first scenario, the card reader does not support ID-1 size cards. However, in the second and third scenarios, the card reader does support ID-1 size cards.

question_75926.question: What will happen if the two provided passwords are identical and the network confirms the registration of the new password?
question_75926.ground_truth: The network sends the return result component of the "register password" operation to the MS with the new password as a mandatory information element.

question_75927.question: What is the color of the foreground and background of the first three PROACTIVE COMMAND: OPEN CHANNEL commands?
question_75927.ground_truth: The color of the foreground is dark green and the color of the background is bright yellow in the first three PROACTIVE COMMAND: OPEN CHANNEL commands.

question_75928.question: When is the drx-RetransmissionTimerUL stopped for the corresponding HARQ process?
question_75928.ground_truth: The drx-RetransmissionTimerUL is stopped in the same symbol as the start of the drx-HARQ-RTT-TimerUL for the corresponding HARQ process.

question_75930.question: What information is included in the GPS Reference Time assistance data element?
question_75930.ground_truth: The GPS Reference Time assistance data element includes the GPS Reference Time fields that occur once per message in the assistance data, as defined in subclause 6.1.3.2.1.

question_75932.question: What should a mobile station do if it receives an uplink assignment with a starting time and a downlink TBF is in progress but no uplink TBF is in progress?
question_75932.ground_truth: The mobile station shall wait until the starting time before beginning to monitor the USFs. While waiting for the starting time, the mobile station shall monitor the assigned PDCHs.

question_75933.question: How should messages related to MPS, MCX, and Emergency calls be ranked when it is known by the application sending the message?
question_75933.ground_truth: They should be ranked based on their priority, such as ARP priority level, 5QI priority level, MPS Priority, etc., with MPS and MCX having higher priorities than Emergency calls, and Emergency call related messages having higher priority than the rest of the messages.

question_75934.question: What is the action taken when the SGSN receives a GPRS-CSI analyzed event during the Idle state?
question_75934.ground_truth: The SGSN moves to the PDP Context Setup state.

question_75935.question: What is the minimum number of slots the downlink DPCH/Io power ratio should be below the specified value for 90% of the time?
question_75935.ground_truth: The downlink DPCH/Io power ratio should be below the specified value for 90% of the time.

question_75936.question: What are the post-conditions for the DTS service in the 3GPP system?
question_75936.ground_truth: Upon end of the DTS session, the UE returns to normal conditions (i.e., use of normal data service).

question_75937.question: Which bands' 2nd order harmonics may fall into the BS receive band of Band 39 when the Band 39 BS is transmitting?
question_75937.ground_truth: The 2nd order harmonics of the Band 39 BS transmitting may fall into the BS receive band of Bands 43.

question_75938.question: What is the delay requirement when the UE receives a RRC message implying E-UTRAN/UTRAN TDD handover?
question_75938.ground_truth: When the UE receives a RRC message implying E-UTRAN/UTRAN TDD handover, the UE shall be ready to start the transmission of the SYNC-UL within Dhandover seconds from the end of the last TTI containing the RRC MOBILITY FROM E-UTRA command, where Dhandover equals the RRC procedure delay plus the interruption time stated in clause~5.3.2.2.2.

question_75939.question: What is the name of the measurement that provides the number of successful S-CSCF registration/deregistration notification procedures?

question_75940.question: What is the sensitivity level set for the MS receive level for EC-BCCH reference performance?
question_75940.ground_truth: The sensitivity level set for the MS receive level for EC-BCCH reference performance is -123,5 dBm.

question_75941.question: Based on Solution #12, what is an objective of the 5G system for interactive media services?
question_75941.ground_truth: Based on Solution #12, an objective of the 5G system for interactive media services is to be aware of the PDU set and handle packets of one PDU Set in an integrated manner, with the option to drop the entire PDU Set when one or some PDUs fail to be transmitted.

question_75943.question: What should the E-UTRAN broadcast in a cell for a PLMN to ensure that each Tracking Area (TA) is Earth-stationary in case of moving cells for Cellular IoT over satellite access?
question_75943.ground_truth: The E-UTRAN should change the TA values that are broadcast in a cell's system information as the cell moves to ensure that each TA is Earth-stationary.

question_75944.question: What is the noted difference between multiple carriers and carrier aggregation in terms of resource allocation?
question_75944.ground_truth: Multiple carriers and carrier aggregation may have differences in resource allocation. The final decision for normative work in this area requires consensus at RAN.

question_75945.question: What do values 0 to 127 of the SST field represent?
question_75945.ground_truth: Values 0 to 127 of the SST field belong to the standardized SST range, as defined in 3GPP TS 23.501.

question_75946.question: What is the Occurrence specified for the RANValidityCondition node?
question_75946.ground_truth: The Occurrence of the RANValidityCondition node is ZeroOrOne, which means it can appear once or not at all.

question_75947.question: Upon receiving a Disconnect message in the 'U: Pre-established session in use' state, what actions shall the MCPTT client take?
question_75947.ground_truth: The MCPTT client shall send an Acknowledge message if acknowledgment is required, enter the 'U: Pre-established session not in use' state, and act as specified in clause 6.2.4.

question_75948.question: What should the floor control server do upon receiving a unicast media stop request?
question_75948.ground_truth: The floor control server should notify the media distributor to stop sending media to the MCPTT client and may deallocate associated bearer resources.

question_75949.question: What is the role of the predefined dictionary provided to the UE in the context of UL data compression?
question_75949.ground_truth: The predefined dictionary provided to the UE is used by its compression function to compress data sent in the uplink direction.

question_75950.question: What is the measurement reporting delay defined in Clause 2.2.2.1.3, excluding certain delays?
question_75950.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay is defined as the time between an event that will trigger a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface, excluding a delay uncertainty resulted when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH and a delay which caused by no UL resources for UE to send the measurement report.

question_75951.question: How does the TP-User-Data-Length field change for compressed data?
question_75951.ground_truth: The TP-User-Data-Length field is the first octet of the TP-User-Data content of the Short Message and its definition remains unchanged for both compressed and uncompressed data.

question_75952.question: What should be done if an event occurs that results in the termination of a PDP Context, and the gprsSSF has marked it as "Waiting-for-AC"?
question_75952.ground_truth: The gprsSSF should remove the "Waiting-for-AC" markings for that PDP Context and check if the TC guard timer should be stopped.

question_75953.question: What is the role of the CAPIF core function in the functional entities description (6.3), and what does it consist of?
question_75953.ground_truth: The CAPIF core function consists of various capabilities like authenticating API invokers, controlling service API access based on PLMN operator policies, publishing and discovering service APIs information, storing service API invocation logs, charging based on logs, monitoring invocations, onboarding API invokers, and more.

question_75954.question: What happens if the requested traffic class is not available when mapping RANAP and BSSMAP assignment messages?
question_75954.ground_truth: No radio resource will be available, and it will be mapped to the BSSMAP Assignment Failure message.

question_75955.question: What is the performance gain achieved by using HOMTC including 32QAM and a 5 timeslot allocation as compared to EGPRS in terms of spectral efficiency?
question_75955.ground_truth: The performance gain is an improvement of 50% in spectral efficiency.

question_75957.question: What is the synchronization requirement for MBMS user services?
question_75957.ground_truth: When necessary, within a single MBMS user service, it shall be possible to synchronize the media sessions. This is important to ensure a smooth and cohesive user experience for multimedia content.

question_75958.question: How does the UE handle failures occurring consecutively in different cells for NR?
question_75958.ground_truth: The UE stores multiple CEF report entries in the CEF report list for failures occurring consecutively in different cells for NR.

question_75959.question: How should an AIPN guarantee QoS for a multicast session, while ensuring that the QoS of other terminals is not affected when one of the terminals moves to an access system that does not support the required QoS?
question_75959.ground_truth: An AIPN should be able to guarantee QoS of a multicast session without modification to QoS of other terminals, even when one of the terminals moves to an access system that does not support the required QoS. QoS modification can be applied to the terminal moving from one access system to another, but the QoS of other terminals of the multicast session should remain unaffected by the modification of QoS.

question_75963.question: What is the maximum number of USIMs that can be supported by a commercially deployed UE?
question_75963.ground_truth: Typically, commercially deployed UEs support up to two USIMs, but the 3GPP system is required to support ME with multiple USIMs (on the same UICC or on different UICCs) that are registered at the same time.

question_75964.question: What should the controllee UE include in the SIP REFER request when replicating a media component from a collaborative session?
question_75964.ground_truth: The controllee UE should include a Request-URI field containing the contact of the controller UE, the SIP URI of the controllee UE in the Refer-To header field, an Accept-Contact header field containing the g.3gpp.iut-xyz media feature tag, and an Accept header field containing "application/sdp" and "message/sipfrag".

question_75965.question: What should the MCVideo client include in the NOTIFY VIDEO PUSH message if the result is set as FAILURE?
question_75965.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should set the Reason IE with the stored failure reason if the result is set as FAILURE in the NOTIFY VIDEO PUSH message.

question_75966.question: What are some new scalability features supported by SHVC that are not supported by SVC?
question_75966.ground_truth: SHVC supports hybrid codec scalability, bit depth scalability, and color gamut scalability, which are not supported by SVC. These features allow for more flexibility in video coding and can be used to fully enable the migration from HDTV to UHDTV.

question_75967.question: What is the first digit in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Specification signifying?
question_75967.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number of a 3GPP Technical Specification signifies the stage of development of the document. A value of 1 indicates that the document has been presented to the TSG for information, a value of 2 means that the document has been presented to the TSG for approval, and a value of 3 or greater indicates that the document is a TSG approved document under change control.

question_75968.question: When does the H-PCRF initiate the PCRF initiated Gateway Control Session Termination procedure or the Gateway Control and QoS Rules Provision procedure and proxy the information over S9 to the BBERF through the V-PCRF when case 2a applies for Local Breakout?
question_75968.ground_truth: When the home routed access is used or case 2a applies for Local Breakout

question_75969.question: Which IEs are to be included in the MaxMIMO-LayerPreferenceFR2-2 IE if the UE has a preference for the number of downlink and uplink MIMO layers for each BWP of each FR2-2 serving cell in the cell group, and the UE prefers to reduce the number of maximum MIMO layers of each serving cell operating on FR2 2?

question_75970.question: What occurs when there is an ongoing disconnection and the HSS is informed about the WLAN user?
question_75970.ground_truth: The HSS de-registers the WLAN user, and the requester 3GPP AAA Server assumes that the user already has a 3GPP AAA Server assigned.

question_75971.question: What is the purpose of the "modal verbs" used in the document?
question_75971.ground_truth: The "modal verbs" used in the document indicate a mandatory requirement, prohibition, recommendation, permission, possibility, or certainty to do something.

question_75973.question: What is the range of possible mini-slot lengths in OFDM symbols?
question_75973.ground_truth: The lengths of mini-slots range from 2 to slot length - 1 OFDM symbols, with a minimum length of 2 being supported for URLLC use cases, at least above 6 GHz.

question_75974.question: What action does the AMF take in step 3 based on its support for non-3GPP path switching and the UE's indication in step 1?
question_75974.ground_truth: The AMF indicates whether the UE supports non-3GPP path switching to the V-SMF.

question_75975.question: What is the term for the sum of the energy consumption of all nodes in a simulated or measured area under a specific load level?

question_75976.question: What must be agreed upon to evaluate the impact of a Band 5 HPUE on the public safety downlink in 851-861 MHz and uplink in 806-816 MHz, as well as to determine the target OOBE from a Band 5 HPUE to the public safety downlink and uplink frequency ranges?
question_75976.ground_truth: The target OOBE from a Band 5 HPUE to the public safety downlink and uplink frequency ranges, as well as the achievable attenuation on the Band 5 HPUE carrier power at the public safety downlink and uplink receiver filters, must be agreed upon to evaluate the impact from a Band 5 HPUE on the public safety downlink and uplink operations.

question_75977.question: Which document defines the stage 2 level requirements and signaling flows for the NEF Northbound interface?
question_75977.ground_truth: 3GPP TS 23.502, 3GPP TS 23.247, and 3GPP TS 26.531 define the stage 2 level requirements and signaling flows for the NEF Northbound interface.

question_75978.question: What is the purpose of the Multi-Device (MuD) service in the 3GPP IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS)?
question_75978.ground_truth: The Multi-Device (MuD) service in the 3GPP IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS) is an operator specific service that enables a user to use different UEs (User Equipments) that are registered under the same public user identity, providing a synchronization of communication logs between the federated UEs which support communication log.

question_75980.question: What is the initial condition for testing the behavior of the MS if the network rejects the location updating with the cause "Roaming not allowed in this area"?
question_75980.ground_truth: The initial conditions involve two cells belonging to different location areas of the same PLMN with LAI a and b, IMSI attach/detach allowed in every cell, and the MS having a valid TMSI, CKSN, and Kc and being "idle updated" on cell B.

question_75981.question: What is the difference between a UE-PDG tunnel being the same or changing, in the context of a non-3GPP IP access network?
question_75981.ground_truth: If the PDG remains the same, existing IPsec tunnel can be maintained, while if the PDG changes, a new IPsec tunnel needs to be established.

question_75982.question: What should the UE do if it is triggered by the upper layers to stop responding to solicitation on proximity of a connectivity service via a 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay UE?
question_75982.ground_truth: The UE should instruct the lower layers to stop monitoring and trigger the corresponding procedure in lower layers as specified in 3GPP TS 38.331 if it is in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode.

question_75984.question: What should the SGW-C do when it receives a Sx message Sx Session Set Deletion Request from the SGW-U?
question_75984.ground_truth: The SGW-C shall retrieve all the Sx sessions corresponding to the received FQ-CSID(s) and mark them to be restored.

question_75985.question: What is the action the network must take when an old TMSI cannot be prevented from being allocated again after an IMSI record is deleted in the VLR by O&M action?
question_75985.ground_truth: If the MS whose IMSI record was deleted attempts to access the network using the TMSI after it has been allocated to a different IMSI, authentication or ciphering will almost certainly fail, causing the TMSI to be deleted from the MS.

question_75986.question: When is an immediate location change report not required from a VAL UE located in TMGI 2, if it's interested in a VAL service group transmission (e.g. V2X) only going on in TMGI 1?
question_75986.ground_truth: If the VAL UE receives information from TMGI 9, it can initiate a unicast bearer to request to receive that specific VAL service communication over a unicast without the need for an immediate location change report.

question_75987.question: What is the difference between the local NRF deployment model and the NF Service Consumer directly accessing the NRF where the NF Service Producer is registered model?
question_75987.ground_truth: In the local NRF deployment model, NFc goes first to its local NRF, which authenticates NFc and then forwards or redirects the request to the target NRF holding the policy for NFp services. In the NF Service Consumer directly accessing the NRF where the NF Service Producer is registered model, the NF (e.g., AMF) can register and/or be known as OAuth 2.0 client to a PLMN-wide NRF, but can also address a specific NRF directly.

question_75989.question: Which message type is sent from the CTS-MS to the CTS-FP after initiating deciphering on the CTS-FP?

question_75990.question: In Coverage Evaluation Method 1, what is the mean DL coverage that Source 15 observed in FR1, InH, DL, VR/AR30, #UE/cell =1?
question_75990.ground_truth: In Coverage Evaluation Method 1, Source 15 observed a mean DL coverage of -72dB in FR1, InH, DL, VR/AR30, #UE/cell =1.

question_75991.question: What high-level requirements does the Global Text Telephony feature need to meet?
question_75991.ground_truth: The Global Text Telephony feature needs to meet several high-level requirements, including providing a real-time conversational text feature, having standardized methods for Global Text Telephony in mobile networks, supporting current and evolving text telephony and text conversation features, providing a consistent way of handling conversations, enabling consistent access to the feature, supporting interoperability with existing and emerging text telephone systems, enabling emergency calls, and meeting network operators' differing requirements.

question_75992.question: Who is able to terminate the Driver to Controller voice communication?
question_75992.ground_truth: The Driver can terminate the voice communication with Controllers, while any Controller can put on hold, leave or terminate the Driver to Controller communication.

question_75994.question: What two scenarios does the LSA Controller (LC) Integration Reference Point (IRP) support?
question_75994.ground_truth: The LSA Controller (LC) Integration Reference Point (IRP) supports two scenarios: one scenario where the LC communicates LSA spectrum resource availability information to the NM, and another scenario where the LC determines and communicates constraints on parameters of cells liable to use LSA spectrum resources to the NM.

question_75995.question: What is the maximum duration of the test scenario?
question_75995.ground_truth: The maximum duration of the test scenario is 45 seconds.

question_75997.question: What should the UE do when the back-off timer is not deactivated and is switched to another network (PLMN or SNPN)?
question_75997.ground_truth: The UE should not stop timer T3585 upon a PLMN change, SNPN change, or inter-system change.

question_75998.question: What does the EF (Elementary File) in the 3GPP technical specification contain?
question_75998.ground_truth: The EF is a part of a file which represents a complete logical entity, and each EF has specific attributes e.g. file size, record length, etc. that determine how data is accessed in the file.

question_75999.question: What layer of the OSI model does the physical layer support all functions required for the transmission of bit streams on the physical medium?
question_75999.ground_truth: The physical layer supports all functions required for the transmission of bit streams on the physical medium in the OSI Reference Model.

question_76000.question: What is the requirement for the getValueByte method's conformance in terms of its definition in the API?
question_76000.ground_truth: The method shall be compliant to its definition in the API.

question_76001.question: What message type is used in the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE relay update request?
question_76001.ground_truth: PROSE UE TO UE RELAY UPDATE REQUEST

question_76004.question: What information is provided by the 3GPP AAA server to the ePDG at the SWm Authentication and Authorization procedure or upon request of the ePDG, in the case of untrusted WLAN access?
question_76004.ground_truth: WLAN Access Network location information, which it considers as network provided location, is provided by the 3GPP AAA server to the ePDG at the SWm Authentication and Authorization procedure or upon request of the ePDG, in the case of untrusted WLAN access.

question_76005.question: What is the conformance requirement for the Mobile Station when it receives an UMTS challenge request during the routing area updating procedure with ciphering indicator information element set to 'ciphering mode off'?
question_76005.ground_truth: The Mobile Station shall respond with an AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING RESPONSE message and shall stop ciphering.

question_76006.question: When does the UE signal its UE Specific DRX Parameters to the Core Network during Attach and Tracking/Routing Area Update procedures?
question_76006.ground_truth: The UE signals UE Specific DRX Parameters during Attach and Tracking/Routing Area Update procedures in E-UTRAN and UTRAN. The UE can propose a DRX cycle length separately for WB-EUTRA and NB-IoT. In NB-IoT, the UE can request UE specific DRX for NB-IoT during Attach and Tracking Area Update procedures if the cell supports it. The eNodeB sends the UE Specific DRX Parameters for the UE's current RAT to the MME in S1 interface Page Request messages, together with information derived from the IMSI, to help determine the DRX cycle length. The UE Specific DRX Parameters are sent from the old CN node to the new CN node as part of the MM context information during mobility.

question_76007.question: What is a potential security requirement for the remote provisioning process between the UE and the PS?
question_76007.ground_truth: The UE and the PS should be authorized for remote provisioning.

question_76008.question: What should the MS include in a Service Request message for Iu mode if it has MBMS contexts with an SM state different from PDP-INACTIVE?
question_76008.ground_truth: The MS should include the MBMS context status IE in the Service Request message for Iu mode if it has MBMS contexts with an SM state different from PDP-INACTIVE.

question_76009.question: What should the old V-SMF or I-SMF do during an inter-PLMN procedure with an I-SMF or V-SMF change when returning the attributes of the SM context?
question_76009.ground_truth: The old V-SMF or I-SMF should return the attributes as they were received from the anchor SMF.

question_76011.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement defined in clause 6.3A.4.4.0 for aggregated power tolerance for CA?
question_76011.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement defined in clause 6.3A.4.4.0 for aggregated power tolerance for CA is the ability of the UE transmitter to maintain its power during non-contiguous transmissions within 21ms in response to 0 dB TPC commands with respect to the first UE transmission and all other power control parameters as specified in TS 38.213 kept constant.

question_76012.question: What is the first step in the procedure for transferring an NR RRC message from the SN to the UE without using SRB3?
question_76012.ground_truth: The SN initiates the procedure by sending the SgNB Modification Required to the MN.

question_76015.question: What message is sent by the gNB-DU to confirm the setup of a multicast context?

question_76016.question: What measures should be taken to provide connectivity service to UAV UEs differently from other non-UAV UEs?
question_76016.ground_truth: Adjustment of radio coverage is necessary, and in some cases, additional equipment can be installed to provide coverage at the height where a UAV operates.

question_76017.question: What is the basic requirement for a successful test result?
question_76017.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the total number of successful tests shall be more than 90% of the cases with a confidence level of 95%.

question_76018.question: What must the MSC/VLR in the VPLMN do when the UE is roaming to a non-enhanced network?
question_76018.ground_truth: The MSC/VLR in the VPLMN will make the CS registration to the HLR.

question_76022.question: In what ways can inventory data be assigned to the related equipment/units?
question_76022.ground_truth: Inventory data can either be integrated in the related equipment/units or be assigned to the related equipment/units during the installation or during operation.

question_76023.question: What functions does an MCX UE-to-Network Relay support in relation to MCX Service coverage extension?
question_76023.ground_truth: An MCX UE-to-Network Relay supports the bi-directional relay of signalling (control plane) and data (user plane) between an MCX UE and the on-network MCX Service, and provides a mechanism for an off-network MCX UE to affiliate to one or more MCX Service Groups using the on-network MCX Service.

question_76025.question: When the SMF gets the information about real-time measurements of QoS monitoring parameters for SDFs from the UPF, what should the SMF do when it gets information about uplink packet delay(s)?
question_76025.ground_truth: The SMF shall inform the PCF about the uplink packet delay(s) for the impacted PCC rules.

question_76026.question: Which protocolIEs are mandatory in the MBMSRegistrationFailure message?
question_76026.ground_truth: The only mandatory protocolIE in the MBMSRegistrationFailure message is "id-Cause".

question_76027.question: What is the required horizontal accuracy for asset location, route guidance, and navigation in 3GPP TS 22.261?
question_76027.ground_truth: The LCS service shall provide techniques that allow operators to deploy networks that can provide at least the level of accuracy required by the regional regulatory bodies, which is 10m-50m for asset location, route guidance, and navigation.

question_76028.question: What is the significance of the two-way delay budget (TWDB) in the context of data transmission?
question_76028.ground_truth: With the TWDB, as long as the PDUs for UL and DL are delivered within the TWDB, the corresponding PDUs are not counted as lost and thus not included in the PER.

question_76030.question: When would the IRI-POI in the SMF generate an xIRI containing an SMFUnsuccessfulProcedure record?
question_76030.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the SMF generates an xIRI containing an SMFUnsuccessfulProcedure record when the IRI-POI present in the SMF detects an unsuccessful procedure or error condition for a UE matching one of the target identifiers provided via LI_X1.

question_76031.question: What is the objective of this test procedure with an MS supporting TCH/F and speech version 3, version 2, and version 1?
question_76031.ground_truth: The objective is to test the MS's ability to perform a handover from a full-rate traffic channel (TCH/F) on cell A to a full-rate or half-rate traffic channel on cell B, while supporting speech version 3, 2, or 1.

question_76032.question: In what situation would a UE retransmit the DISCOVERY_REQUEST message?
question_76032.ground_truth: When there is no response from the 5G DDNMF after the DISCOVERY_REQUEST message has been successfully delivered.

question_76033.question: In the use case of data communication for security between two approaching trains, what is the role of User B (sensor) in the service flows?
question_76033.ground_truth: User B initiates a data communication to report what it has detected if some threshold is reached.

question_76034.question: What is the benefit of using the same identities for LTE accesses in SAE as in GSM and UMTS networks for addressing, mobility, connectivity, confidentiality, and other reasons?
question_76034.ground_truth: The benefit of using the same identities for LTE accesses in SAE as in GSM and UMTS networks for addressing, mobility, connectivity, confidentiality, and other reasons is that it is beneficial from a UE mobility and identification point of view. In addition, new identities are needed for new network entities.

question_76035.question: What is the purpose of Packet Data Protocol context activation in a GPRS network?
question_76035.ground_truth: The activation of Packet Data Protocol context makes the MS known in the corresponding P-GW/GGSN, and interworking with data networks can commence, thus enabling the user to transfer data transparently between the MS and the packet data networks with a method known as encapsulation and tunnelling.

question_76036.question: What is the role of the CN domain MDA MnS producer in the 3GPP cross domain MDA MnS producer's interactions?
question_76036.ground_truth: The CN domain MDA MnS producer may consume analytics results produced by NWDAF, MnS provided by CN domain management, other MDA MnS producers, management data derived by subnetwork management function(s), and management data derived by element management function(s).

question_76037.question: What should the PCF set when revoking MPS for DTS, in terms of the ARP and 5QI for the default QoS flow and the PCC rules bound to it?
question_76037.ground_truth: The PCF sets the ARP and the 5QI (along with any associated QoS characteristics) as appropriate for its decision, for the default QoOS flow and the PCC rules bound to it that had the same ARP and 5QI as the default QoS flow or had the "defQosFlowIndication" attribute set to true.

question_76038.question: What does the "UnidirectionalQoSSpecification" data type describe?
question_76038.ground_truth: It describes a network Quality of Service specification for media streaming in one direction.

question_76039.question: What information does the PDN GW include in the Modify Bearer Response message if there has been a RAT change towards E-UTRAN and location information change reporting is required and supported in the target MME?
question_76039.ground_truth: The PDN GW includes MS Info Change Reporting Action in the Modify Bearer Response message if there has been a RAT change towards E-UTRAN and location information change reporting is required and supported in the target MME.

question_76040.question: What is the meaning of "inter-band carrier aggregation" as defined in the document?
question_76040.ground_truth: Inter-band carrier aggregation is the carrier aggregation of component carriers in different operating bands.

question_76044.question: How does the cell search performance of CZ-UMTS compare to that of filtered UMTS without zero chip, and UMTS searcher?
question_76044.ground_truth: CZ-UMTS has around 1dB better performance than the filtered UMTS without zero chip, but has about 3dB performance loss compared to the UMTS searcher. This loss is mostly due to the reduction in processing gain.

question_76046.question: What needs to be done to add a new SIP header field for encoding the II-NNI traversal scenario type?
question_76046.ground_truth: A new IETF RFC is required to add a new SIP header field for encoding the II-NNI traversal scenario type.

question_76048.question: What is the absolute time reference chosen for calculating the Initial Energy (IE)?
question_76048.ground_truth: The absolute time reference chosen is the 1980-01-06 T00:00:19 International Atomic Time (TAI).

question_76050.question: How does the UE determine the entering condition for event A1 in 5.5.4.2?
question_76050.ground_truth: The UE considers the entering condition for event A1 to be satisfied when the inequality A1-1, Ms - Hys > Thresh, is fulfilled.

question_76052.question: What is the role of an "attacker model for EVA" in the evaluation process?
question_76052.ground_truth: The attacker model for EVA is used to define the scale of attacker type and levels for exploiting vulnerabilities during the evaluation process.

question_76053.question: Which type of fading is used for calculating antenna gain in RAN1 SLS if small scale fading is not modeled?
question_76053.ground_truth: If small scale fading is not modeled, antenna gain is calculated based on the line of sight (LOS) direction instead of the multipath directions.

question_76054.question: What should a CC entity of a MS in CC-state U8, "Connect Request", do when allocated a traffic channel by the network performing the assignment procedure as per Conformance requirement 26.8.1.3.5.8.2?
question_76054.ground_truth: A CC entity of a MS in CC-state U8, "Connect Request", shall perform a layer 2 establishment on the FACCH without changing the state of the call in progress.

question_76056.question: What is the size limitation of NAS messages for UMTS system when sent via Gb interface and when sent in CS domain via radio interface?
question_76056.ground_truth: The size limitation of NAS messages for UMTS system when sent via Gb interface is not specified, while when sent in CS domain via radio interface, the size of NAS messages should not exceed 251 octets.

question_76060.question: What entity is responsible for storing, updating, and distributing up-to-date positioning assistance data within the 5GS LCS system in the described solution?

question_76061.question: What should a network do when it receives a 5GSM message with "missing mandatory IE" error?
question_76061.ground_truth: The network should return a status message (5GSM STATUS) with cause #96 "invalid mandatory information".

question_76063.question: What message does the SS send to the UE in the 3GPP TS 25.331 mobile-terminated location request procedure to initiate the network-assisted UE-assisted GPS positioning measurement?
question_76063.ground_truth: The SS sends a MEASUREMENT CONTROL message to the UE to initiate the network-assisted UE-assisted GPS positioning measurement.

question_76065.question: What happens if the MS does not send data in the uplink direction for a Full Rate data call?
question_76065.ground_truth: If the MS does not send data in the uplink direction for a Full Rate data call, the CCU sends idle data frames instead of data frames.

question_76067.question: What is the MCPTT Server in the context of IMS architecture?
question_76067.ground_truth: The MCPTT Server is a superset of the MCPTT AS and the MRF. It is equivalent to the PoC Server in the OMA PCPS Architecture and provides centralized group call handling, which includes Media distribution, Floor Control, policy enforcement for users participating in the MCPTT Group call, and sharing of Talker identification information to the MCPTT Group call participants.

question_76068.question: What channels are used for signalling in EGPRS when using blind physical layer transmissions?
question_76068.ground_truth: When using blind physical layer transmissions in EGPRS, multiple burst time intervals (BTTI) blocks are mapped onto the physical channel, resulting in an effective TTI that is a multiple of the basic TTI.

question_76069.question: What is the exception for message contents in 6.6.19.3.5?
question_76069.ground_truth: The exception for message contents in 6.6.19.3.5 is defined in 6.6.19.3.4 regarding SA and FR1 measurement test procedures.

question_76070.question: What happens during a successful handover, as indicated in the diagram with a "COMPLETE" notation?
question_76070.ground_truth: After all procedures are completed successfully, the handover process ends, and normal communication is re-established between the two systems.

question_76071.question: Which sub-element within the <adaptation> element contains the identity of the VAL UE or VAL group of UEs for whom the network resource adaptation occurs?
question_76071.ground_truth: The sub-element can be either <VAL-ue-id-list> or <VAL-group-id>, both of which contain the identity of the corresponding VAL UE or VAL group of UEs.

question_76072.question: What is the maximum supported size of a PDCP SDU for the NB-IoT?
question_76072.ground_truth: The maximum supported size of a PDCP SDU for the NB-IoT is 160 octets.

question_76073.question: What are the potential requirements for the CTF in the 5G architecture regarding charging functionalities?
question_76073.ground_truth: The potential requirements for the CTF in the 5G architecture regarding charging functionalities are: 1) Combined online and offline charging, 2) Offline charging only.

question_76075.question: What is the purpose of using NSI ID and NRF in the network selection procedure?
question_76075.ground_truth: The Network Slice Selection Function (NSSF) is used to select the Network Slice instance (NSI) and determine the appropriate NRF (Network Function Repository) to select NFs (Network Functions) or services within the selected NSI. The NSI ID is an optional parameter that may be returned by the NSSF.

question_76076.question: What is the purpose of the MCPTT-9 reference point between the floor control server and the floor participant in the context of MCPTT?
question_76076.ground_truth: The MCPTT-9 reference point provides floor control signalling between the floor control server and the floor participant over a multicast bearer.

question_76077.question: What information does the ProSe server use to determine if UE-A and UE-B are in proximity?
question_76077.ground_truth: The ProSe server determines if UE-A and UE-B are in proximity based on their serving cells, eNB, MME, and other proximity criteria.

question_76079.question: What is the purpose of the RANAP User Adaption (RUA) in the 3GPP 3rd Generation Partnership Project?
question_76079.ground_truth: The RANAP User Adaption (RUA) in the 3GPP 3rd Generation Partnership Project provides the signalling service between the Home Node B (HNB) and the Home Node B Gateway (HNB-GW) to fulfill the RUA functions. It ensures reliable and in-sequence delivery of signalling data using Stream Control Transmission Protocol (SCTP).

question_76080.question: What is the difference between Enhanced performance requirements types 1, 2, 3, and 3i?
question_76080.ground_truth: Types 1, 2, 3, and 3i are optional performance requirements for the UE, based on different receiver structures: Type 1 uses receiver diversity, Type 2 uses a chip equaliser receiver structure, Type 3 uses a chip equaliser receiver structure with receiver diversity, and Type 3i uses an interference-aware chip equaliser receiver structure with receiver diversity.

question_76082.question: What is the conformance requirement for co-channel rejection at a co-channel interference ratio (C/Ic) of 27 dB?
question_76082.ground_truth: The block error rate (BLER) performance shall not exceed 1% at a co-channel interference ratio (C/Ic) of 27 dB.

question_76084.question: What should the UE (MCPTT Client) do when the MCPTT User engages in communication with the invited MCPTT User(s) in step (2) under 5.6.1?
question_76084.ground_truth: In step (2) under 5.6.1, the UE (MCPTT Client) should respect the floor control imposed by the MCPTT Server and use the updated CSK to protect the sent floor control messages when the MCPTT User engages in communication with the invited MCPTT User(s).

question_76085.question: What are the conditions for automatically obtaining local emergency numbers when the UE is connected to a PLMN through untrusted non-3GPP access?
question_76085.ground_truth: Local emergency numbers can be provided through DNS query or IKEv2. The UE shall store the local emergency numbers if the UE is connected to a PLMN through non-3GPP access and registered to the same or different PLMN through 3GPP access in the same country. The UE shall not use the received local emergency numbers if it is connected to a PLMN through non-3GPP access and registered to different PLMN through 3GPP access that is not in the same country.

question_76087.question: What is the name of the complex type with the "PLMN-list-type" name that includes an unbounded sequence of PLMN elements with the type "PLMN-info"?
question_76087.ground_truth: The name of the complex type is "PLMN-list-type".

question_76088.question: What is the use of a GPSI in the Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization procedure?
question_76088.ground_truth: A GPSI is used to create an association with the EAP Identity in the EAP ID response message, so the AAA-S can later use it to revoke authorization or to trigger reauthentication.

question_76089.question: What is the significance of the number of active wireless microphones at a live event?
question_76089.ground_truth: The number of active wireless microphones at a live event can range between 5 and 300, and each one produces an audio stream that needs to be processed, resulting in a significant amount of data being transmitted.

question_76090.question: What is the purpose of using a Relay UE in the described network?
question_76090.ground_truth: A Relay UE provides indirect connectivity between remote UEs and the 5G Core Network through the 5G satellite access, allowing for connectivity in areas with no connectivity to 5G services through any 5G terrestrial access networks.

question_76091.question: What protocol is used to encapsulate Non-IP data for tunneling between the GGSN/P-GW and the AS in the Gi/SGi based Non-IP data delivery?

question_76092.question: In scenario 1 step 5-11, what message is sent from the SMF+PGW-C to the DN-AAA to forward the UE authentication/authorization information?
question_76092.ground_truth: The SMF sends a Diameter DER message to the DN-AAA to forward the UE authentication/authorization information.

question_76093.question: What are some of the reference points used in the Evolved Packet System (EPS)?
question_76093.ground_truth: The reference points used in the Evolved Packet System (EPS) include M1 between MBMS GW and E-UTRAN/UTRAN for MBMS data delivery, M3 between MME and E-UTRAN for the control plane, Sm between MME and MBMS GW for the control plane, Sn between MBMS GW and SGSN (S4 based) for the control plane and MBMS data delivery, SGi-mb between BM-SC and MBMS GW function for MBMS data delivery, and SGmb for the control plane between BM-SC and MBMS GW.

question_76094.question: What is the significance of the packetServiceListUpdate() notification in clause 6.4.3.6?
question_76094.ground_truth: The packetServiceListUpdate() notification is used by the MBMS client to inform the MAA about a successful API call setPacketServiceClassFilter() or other updates in Packet service list. It indicates that the updates to the service class list are active.

question_76095.question: What type of traffic is the IMS measurement valid for?

question_76096.question: Where are the security features of the Gb architecture implemented in the C-UNB solution between the legacy core network and the C-UNB server?
question_76096.ground_truth: The security features of the Gb architecture are implemented in the C-UNB solution between the legacy core network and the C-UNB server, using soft SIM cards stored in the C-UNB server.

question_76099.question: What is the role of the WIC in the OAuth Implicit Grant based TURN Authentication in WebRTC?
question_76099.ground_truth: The WIC is the OAuth client of implicit type in the OAuth Implicit Grant based TURN Authentication in WebRTC.

question_76100.question: What is the Cell Identification Discriminator value that indicates no additional information is required?
question_76100.ground_truth: The Cell Identification Discriminator value "0110" indicates no additional information is required.

question_76101.question: What should the UE do when it receives a serving PLMN rate control IE in the ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message?
question_76101.ground_truth: The UE stores the serving PLMN rate control IE value as the maximum allowed limit of uplink User data container IE in ESM DATA TRANSPORT messages for the corresponding PDN connection.

question_76102.question: What is the role of the QoE metrics in option b) within option 2?
question_76102.ground_truth: The QoE metrics in option b) within option 2 are used for evaluating user experience in streaming services, optimizing network performance, and providing control over when, where, and how often to collect metrics.

question_76103.question: What component is reported to be the limiting factor in achieving the required IIP2 in a direct down conversion receiver?

question_76104.question: What is the role of the Information Service (IS) in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_76104.ground_truth: The Information Service (IS) is a part of the Evolved Packet Core (EPC) Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP) in the 3GPP, which defines the protocol neutral Information Service.

question_76105.question: What action does the SCF take if the c-line(s) in the SDP offer do not correspond to a multicast session?
question_76105.ground_truth: If the c-line(s) in the SDP offer do not correspond to a multicast session, the SCF shall answer with a 403 error code.

question_76106.question: What is the role of the EAP framework in the secondary authentication procedure for the remote UE in the 5G Prose UE-to-Network Relay scenario?
question_76106.ground_truth: The EAP framework is reused in the secondary authentication procedure for the remote UE, with a modification on the triggering condition as the Relay UE's SMF triggers the Remote UE's secondary authentication when it receives Remote UE report from the Relay UE.

question_76107.question: What happens to the audio of an MPS MMTEL video call if both the audio and video cannot be supported but the audio can be supported?
question_76107.ground_truth: The 3GPP system retains the audio of an MPS MMTEL video call when both the audio and video cannot be supported but the audio can be supported.

question_76108.question: In what scenario might the GMLC request the updated location information of the WLAN UE from the GMLC?
question_76108.ground_truth: The GMLC might request the updated location information in step 4 of the procedure for obtaining initial or updated location information from the GMLC.

question_76110.question: How can network slicing help in handling the new market segments and verticals?
question_76110.ground_truth: Network slicing enables the robust handling of new segments and verticals by isolating different segments from each other and providing independent management, orchestration, analytics, and service exposure tailored to each vertical's need. This ensures that a scenario where a huge number of electricity meters are misbehaving in the network does not negatively impact other users or mission-critical services.

question_76111.question: What is the goal of the "ism" mechanism in the context of TWAG and IMS nodes?
question_76111.ground_truth: The goal of the "ism" mechanism is to provide location information from TWAG to IMS nodes upon bearer creation, deletion, or modification.

question_76112.question: What is the difference between SA-based and NSA-based IAB integration?
question_76112.ground_truth: SA-based IAB integration involves the IAB-node MT part connecting the network as a normal UE, while NSA-based IAB-node integration involves the IAB-node MT part performing connection setup procedure and authentication via LTE RRC signaling to the LTE network.

question_76114.question: What are the two modes for UL scheduling in NB-IoT for the UE in RRC connected mode?
question_76114.ground_truth: The two modes are RACH procedure mode and polling mode.

question_76115.question: What are the main functionalities of the software management work item in SA5?
question_76115.ground_truth: The software management work item in SA5 includes functionalities such as downloading software, installation of software, activation of software, backup and restore of software, fallback of software, validation and terminate validation operations on software.

question_76117.question: What should the core network node to which the mobile station was redirected do with the first message received after the redirection in the MM+CC+SS (via CS domain) message flow if accessed by a release 98 or earlier mobile station, if the send sequence number of the first message received after the redirection and the value of N(SD) received during the redirection procedure are identical?
question_76117.ground_truth: The core network node to which the mobile station was redirected should discard the received message from the mobile station, if the send sequence number of the first message received after the redirection and the value of N(SD) received during the redirection procedure are identical for a release 98 or earlier mobile station.

question_76118.question: What information is included in the locationInfo field of the handover failure report, if detailed location information is available?
question_76118.ground_truth: The locationInfo field includes the locationCoordinates and, if available, horizontalVelocity.

question_76119.question: When does the new AMF perform feature renegotiation in AMF relocation scenarios?
question_76119.ground_truth: The new AMF may perform feature renegotiation in AMF relocation scenarios if the feature "FeatureRenegotiation" is supported and any of the relevant parameters about the UE context need to be updated.

question_76121.question: What does the ATSC 3.0 LLS comprise and what does it provide?
question_76121.ground_truth: The ATSC 3.0 LLS comprises two main functional components: Low Level Signaling (LLS) and Service Layer Signaling (SLS). The LLS provides bootstrap information for fast channel acquisition, and SLS provides detailed service discovery and acquisition information for the ATSC 3.0 receiver device.

question_76122.question: How many sources observed a performance gain between 0.1% and 0.2% for Max rank 1 and CSI feedback overhead C in RU less than or equal to 39%?
question_76122.ground_truth: 5 sources observed a performance gain between 0.1% and 0.2%.

question_76123.question: What information does the "CurrentUpgrade" data type provide?
question_76123.ground_truth: The "CurrentUpgrade" data type specifies whether it is optimal to upgrade the gNB at present.

question_76125.question: When must the MCPTT client include an Accept-Contact header field with the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag in the SIP MESSAGE request when sending an MCPTT emergency alert?
question_76125.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should always include an Accept-Contact header field with the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag in the SIP MESSAGE request when sending an MCPTT emergency alert.

question_76126.question: What should the UE do when there is no PDCCH addressing the C-RNTI in msg3 transmission?
question_76126.ground_truth: The UE should perform the Random Access Resource selection procedure and transmit with the calculated PRACH transmission power when the Contention Resolution Timer expires and then after the backoff timer expires.

question_76128.question: What is theimum amount of aggregate maximum bits for a RAB in subclause 6.1.3.5 of 9.3.25 of TS23.041?

question_76129.question: What is the feature introduced in the new 5G design for Connected mode mobility and Idle/Inactive mode mobility?
question_76129.ground_truth: For Connected mode mobility, the new feature is the support of RSSI and Channel Occupancy (CO) measurements. For Idle/Inactive mode mobility, the main feature is that the rules for checking other cells for reselection have been relaxed, and a white-list of neighbor cells is broadcasted to handle the cases when the best cell on a frequency belongs to a different PLMN.

question_76130.question: What does the "AS" leaf node in the "Bandwidth" interior node provide for the video part?
question_76130.ground_truth: The "AS" leaf node in the "Bandwidth" interior node gives the preferred video codec bandwidth by the network for the bearer set-up, including RTP/UDP/IP headers, in kbits/sec.

question_76132.question: What is a potential requirement for the deployment of 5G technology in vertical domains, in order to ensure availability and reliability?
question_76132.ground_truth: A potential requirement is restricting access to resources to only those entities belonging to the enterprise or a subset of them.

question_76133.question: In what scenario would the MME include the Secondary RAT usage data in the message?
question_76133.ground_truth: The MME includes the Secondary RAT usage data in the message if the Serving GW has been relocated and PGW Secondary RAT reporting is active or if the MME received Secondary RAT usage data in step~9a and the Serving GW has not been relocated.

question_76134.question: What are the roles that the User Equipment (UE) should implement in the IM CN subsystem?
question_76134.ground_truth: The UE should implement the User Agent (UA) role, access technology specific procedures, and may include one or several interconnected SIP elements when performing the functions of an external attached network.

question_76135.question: What should the SS do to ensure that each codec in the ACS has been implemented correctly?
question_76135.ground_truth: The SS should set the CMC to each of the applicable modes and ensure that the UL frames with each CMI are received without parity error.

question_76138.question: What is the role of AF (Application Function) in Key Issue 6 solutions?
question_76138.ground_truth: The AF plays an important role in the Key Issue 6 solutions by providing the BAT window, consisting of earliest and latest arrival time of traffic, which is used by the NG-RAN to provide a BAT offset for UL and DL directions.

question_76139.question: What is the purpose of the "<currentLocation>" field in the MooD header for HTTP-based unicast content access?
question_76139.ground_truth: The "<currentLocation>" field in the MooD header for HTTP-based unicast content access represents the serving cell-ID(s) or a list of MBMS SAI of the UE.

question_76140.question: When can the UE send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for the same S-NSSAI and the same DNN in the current SNPN, after receiving the PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message with the 5GSM cause #29 "user authentication or authorization failed" and the Back-off timer value IE?
question_76140.ground_truth: The UE can send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for the same S-NSSAI and the same DNN in the current SNPN, if the timer value in the Back-off timer value IE indicates neither zero nor deactivated, and it is not running and is not deactivated for the S-NSSAI and the DNN in the current SNPN.

question_76141.question: What are class definitions in the IRP IS specification?
question_76141.ground_truth: Class definitions in the IRP IS specification define information object classes using the provided structure, with attributes, attribute constraints, and notifications, or a reference to the common notifications if applicable.

question_76142.question: What is the initial requirement for the channel bandwidth in the test described in 6.1.1.4.2?
question_76142.ground_truth: The initial channel bandwidth used is 10 MHz.

question_76143.question: What is the intended use of the information in the scope sections (W1 and W2) of IRP IS specifications?
question_76143.ground_truth: The information in the scope sections (W1 and W2) of IRP IS specifications should be copied as the first two paragraphs of the NRM or Interface IRP IS specification, and provides the necessary information about what the IS specification document contains.

question_76144.question: What is one of the components of the MPQUIC steering functionality used for data transmission in the uplink direction?
question_76144.ground_truth: QoS flow selection & Steering mode selection
