question_77160.ground_truth: Solution #1 for Service Authorization to NG-RAN addresses two major aspects: supporting authorization and policy/parameter provisioning to UE, and identifying necessary information for Ranging/SL Positioning service authorization and provisioning.

question_77163.question: What is the conceptual goal of adding a 3-axis positioner to the measurement system?
question_77163.ground_truth: The goal is to accomplish robustness to UE orientation by sampling outcomes in spatially uniform directions, which reduces bias. This requires adding test AoAs in more directions rather than just along meridians, necessitating a 3-axis positioner instead of the legacy 2-axis positioner.

question_77164.question: In the HS-DSCH-Update-Response, what does HS-DSCH-FDD-Secondary-Serving-Information-To-Modify refer to?
question_77164.ground_truth: It refers to the information used to modify the secondary UE's HS-DSCH resources.

question_77166.question: What is the purpose of the MC server initiated group de-affiliation procedure?
question_77166.ground_truth: The MC server initiated group de-affiliation procedure is triggered by the MC service server when a relevant trigger condition occurs, such as the user moving outside the permitted geographical operational area of the MC service group, or the permitted geographical operational area is modified.

question_77167.question: What is the User Status (US) interface class used for in the OSA API Mapping?
question_77167.ground_truth: The User Status (US) interface class allows applications to obtain the status of mobile telephony users in the OSA API Mapping.

question_77169.question: What should a MS do when a GPRS attach procedure is rejected by the network with the cause 'GPRS services not allowed in this PLMN'?
question_77169.ground_truth: The MS should delete any RAI, P-TMSI, P-TMSI signature, and GPRS ciphering key sequence number stored, set the GPRS update status to GU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, store the PLMN identity in the "forbidden PLMNs for GPRS service" list, and change to the state GMM-DEREGISTERED.

question_77170.question: Which method releases an individual SM context resource in SMF or V-SMF for HR roaming scenario?
question_77170.ground_truth: The "release" custom operation is used to release an individual SM context resource in SMF or V-SMF for HR roaming scenarios.

question_77171.question: What is sent in the get MCPTT user profile response message in 10.1.4.1a.3?
question_77171.ground_truth: The get MCPTT user profile response message includes the all MCPTT user profiles that are associated with the MCPTT ID when a download is necessary.

question_77172.question: What is the maximum measurement period for SL-RSSI requirements for congestion control measurement?
question_77172.ground_truth: The maximum measurement period for SL-RSSI requirements for congestion control measurement is 1 slot.

question_77174.question: Which interface is used by the AoC Function to receive RTTI from Auxiliary AoC Function (AACF) and provide AoC Information to the UE?

question_77175.question: What should the UE do if it receives a PC3a or PC8 message indicating a ProSe discovery mechanism that the UE is not authorized to use?
question_77175.ground_truth: The UE should discard the message.

question_77176.question: When using ideal, dynamic on/off based on packet arrival/completion schemes with 0 MBSFN per radio frame and no cell ID planning, what gain can be expected for low/medium traffic loads?

question_77178.question: How are the monitoring event reports delivered in the Monitoring via Tracing-like mechanisms?
question_77178.ground_truth: A Monitor Collection Entity (similar to the Trace Collection Entity defined in TS 32.422) is used to collect the notifications events reported by the PLMN entities. Monitoring events can be detected by different nodes depending on event type, and Monitoring event reports are generated and sent out to the Monitor Collection Entity.

question_77181.question: What is the MBMS-API and MBMS-URL defined for in the present document?
question_77181.ground_truth: The MBMS-API is an Application Programming Interface between the MBMS Client and the MBMS-Aware application for a specific Application User Service. The MBMS-URL is a Universal Resource Locator that enables a general application to access resources delivered through an MBMS User Service using the MBMS URL handler.

question_77183.question: What is the role of the SMF in handling IGMP/MLD and corresponding traffic replication towards the UE in the 5G registration procedure?
question_77183.ground_truth: The SMF acts as a DHCP proxy and adds Option 82 including Line ID to the DHCP Discover and Request messages for IGMP/MLD handling.

question_77185.question: What action does the GGSN take if it receives an UpdatePDPContextRequest from the SGSN that indicates a direct tunnel establishment or teardown?
question_77185.ground_truth: The GGSN does not send the Accounting Request (Interim) message to the Diameter server and may delete the PDP context if the Accounting Answer is not received from the Diameter server.

question_77186.question: What are the average Tx Ec/No for the dual TB interleaved transmission scheme (Option III) and single TB transmission scheme (Option I) in the context of MIMO?
question_77186.ground_truth: The average Tx Ec/No for the dual TB interleaved transmission scheme (Option III) and single TB transmission scheme (Option I) in the context of MIMO are presented in subclause 8.2 and 8.3 of the reference R1-112632.

question_77187.question: What is the band-limited white noise source adjusted for in step 1 of 8.3.3.4.2.2 and 8.3A.4.2.2.2?
question_77187.ground_truth: The band-limited white noise source is adjusted so that its power spectral density measured at the BS antenna connector takes on the value Ioc.

question_77188.question: What is the purpose of the Information-Element-Data field in a concatenated short message?
question_77188.ground_truth: The Information-Element-Data field in a concatenated short message contains information set by the application in the SMS-SUBMIT that allows the receiving entity to reassemble the short messages in the correct order.

question_77189.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the number of successful handovers during repeated tests?
question_77189.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement for the number of successful handovers during repeated tests is 90%.

question_77190.question: What is the difference between VCC capable UEs and unauthorized UEs in terms of IMRN assignment?
question_77190.ground_truth: For VCC capable UEs, the IMRN can be static, while for unauthorized UEs, a unique IMRN is allocated since there is no MSISDN for these UEs.

question_77193.question: What are the network elements involved in generating PS domain CDRs for offline charging in the 3GPP PS domain?
question_77193.ground_truth: The network elements involved in generating PS domain CDRs for offline charging in the 3GPP PS domain are SGSN, S-GW, ePDG, TWAG, P-GW, GGSN, MME, and TDF.

question_77194.question: What information needs to be transferred to the PGW for proper charging data collection and policy control over a TWAN?
question_77194.ground_truth: The network identity, location of the AP, and optionally geo-location information needs to be transferred to the PGW.

question_77195.question: What should the mobile station do when the network requests a change of RLC mode during an uplink packet transfer?
question_77195.ground_truth: The mobile station should send a PACKET RESOURCE REQUEST message on PACCH indicating the new RLC mode and start timer T3168.

question_77196.question: How does a dispatcher communicate with a group controller via E-UTRAN/EPC?
question_77196.ground_truth: A dispatcher obtains the group owner's IP address and authorization information from the ProSe Application server, then uses application layer signalling to communicate over the SGi, with 3GPP tunnelling used for delivery.

question_77200.question: How does SMF determine information about the user plane network topology in the 5G Core network?
question_77200.ground_truth: The SMF uses no additional parameters for UPF selection for a PDU Session serving TSC or Deterministic Networking. The SMF determines information about the user plane network topology from information such as identifiers and IP addresses of N3 terminations provided by a W-AGF or a TNGF or a TWIF, information on user plane interfaces of UPFs, and information on N3 User Plane terminations of the AN serving the UE.

question_77201.question: What is the role of the "CORBA Solution Set" in the context of the passge?
question_77201.ground_truth: The "CORBA Solution Set" is a technical specification that outlines the capabilities of the Generic Integration Reference Point (IRP) management and its relation to the 3GPP TS 32.312 V9.0.X.

question_77202.question: What is the result of the TERMINAL RESPONSE command in the SEND SS 2.1.1AB sequence?
question_77202.ground_truth: The result of the TERMINAL RESPONSE command in the SEND SS 2.1.1AB sequence is "Command performed successfully, but requested icon could not be displayed".

question_77204.question: What should the UE do if it is establishing or resuming an RRC connection and has initiated transmitting CP data using PUR or early data transmission?
question_77204.ground_truth: The UE should initiate transmission of the RRCEarlyDataRequest message in accordance with 5.3.3.3b.

question_77205.question: What is the purpose of the RESource INDication message in the context of channel interference measurement?
question_77205.ground_truth: The RESource INDication message reports the interference level for each of the channels that have been idle for the whole measurement period.

question_77207.question: What is the significance of the "P-CSCF" in the context of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group's study on improved end-to-end Quality of Service (QoS) handling for Multimedia Telephony Service for IMS (MTSI)?
question_77207.ground_truth: The P-CSCF, acting as a Proxy Call Server Control Function (AF), is responsible for analyzing the SDP offer and answer, and determines the session information and media information that will be allocated. It then instructs the Policy Charging and Rules Function (PCRF) to allocate resources for the Service Data Flow.

question_77208.question: What is the main advantage of using PUCCH offsets for enabling orthogonal PUCCH assignments between HeNB and macro-eNB users?
question_77208.ground_truth: It helps maintain uplink control signaling reliability for both HeNBs and macro-eNBs.

question_77209.question: What action will the network take if the tracking area update request is rejected due to operator determined barring in NB-S1 mode?
question_77209.ground_truth: The network will set the EMM cause value to #22 "congestion" and assign a value for back-off timer T3346 in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message.

question_77211.question: What occurs when both the UL transport block has been completely transmitted and DL has been successfully decoded early during a TTI?
question_77211.ground_truth: The UE discontinues the transmission of UL DPCCH for the remaining duration of the TTI.

question_77212.question: What is the RRC re-establishment delay requirement for HD-FDD Intra-frequency RRC Re-establishment test case?
question_77212.ground_truth: The RRC re-establishment delay requirement is defined as the time from the start of time period T3, to the moment when the UE starts to send NPRACH preambles to Ncell 2 for sending the RRCConnectionReestablishmentRequest-NB message to Ncell 2. The RRC re-establishment delay to an unknown NB-IoT FDD intra frequency cell shall be less than 58 seconds.

question_77213.question: What information should the UE set in the VarRLF-Report, if the failure is detected due to radio link failure?
question_77213.ground_truth: The UE should set the connectionFailureType to rlf, the rlf-Cause to the trigger for detecting radio link failure and the nrFailedPCellId in failedPCellId to the global cell identity and the tracking area code of the PCell where radio link failure is detected.

question_77215.question: What is the effect of the RulePriority node in ISRP rules?
question_77215.ground_truth: The RulePriority node enables the UE to determine which flow distribution rule, out of potentially several flow distribution rules, contained in every supported flow distribution container of the 'active' ISRP rule, it should apply to an IP flow matching the data traffic description of the multiple flow distribution rules.

question_77216.question: How does the range of phase noise output of multiple LOs vary from a single LO to small sub-arrays driving their own LO?
question_77216.ground_truth: The actual LO-architecture of an antenna array can vary from a single LO driving the whole antenna array up to small sub-arrays each having their own LO. When multiple LOs are considered, the phase noise output of those can have a varying degree of correlation. The LO-structure is an implementation-specific aspect and does not need to be considered in the standard.

question_77217.question: What is the restriction on PUCCH/PUSCH/SRS transmission at SSB symbols for UE performing intra-frequency measurements in a TDD band?
question_77217.ground_truth: UE is not expected to transmit PUCCH/PUSCH/SRS on SSB symbols to be measured, and on 1 data symbol before each consecutive SSB symbols to be measured and 1 data symbol after each consecutive SSB symbols to be measured within SMTC window duration.

question_77219.question: What is the duration of T2, where no PDSCH traffic is scheduled for the UE and the UE is expected to transmit SidelinkUEInformation indicating discRxInterest?
question_77219.ground_truth: T2 lasts for an unspecified duration, but if the UE does not transmit SidelinkUEInformation for up to 2 seconds, the test system shall transition to T3.

question_77220.question: What is the key issue addressed by Solution #24 in the document?
question_77220.ground_truth: Differentiated QoS handling for different PDU Sets.

question_77221.question: What is the role of BSS (BSS of Company-NB) in the interaction between Company-NA and Company-NB?
question_77221.ground_truth: BSS of Company-NB can use 3GPP management APIs towards its own management system as part of handling requests from Company-NA.

question_77222.question: What must the IUT (MCPTT Server) do when the SS-UE1 (MCPTT client) ends the pre-arranged group call during an MCPTT On-demand Pre-arranged Group Call with Automatic Commencement Mode?
question_77222.ground_truth: The IUT (MCPTT Server) must respond by sending a SIP 200 (OK) message to the client ending the call and send a SIP BYE message to the other participants.

question_77223.question: What is the function of a TP UE in an audio-only telepresence IM session?
question_77223.ground_truth: In an audio-only telepresence IM session, a TP UE can represent audio sources and corresponding attributes by establishing a CLUE channel. This enables users to enjoy the multimedia experience by sending and receiving specific audio streams in a mono or stereo format.

question_77225.question: What action should the USSI AS take upon receiving a request with a specific MIME body?
question_77225.ground_truth: If the USSI AS accepts the MIME body, it shall send a 200 (OK) response with a Recv-Info header field, an Accept header field, and an SDP answer.

question_77226.question: What is the consequence of the absence of the "AddressType" leaf in an IP flow description?
question_77226.ground_truth: The absence of the "AddressType" leaf indicates that the IP flow described by the rule can have both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.

question_77227.question: In which cases are the output of the bit stream writer for each sub-frame for a TCX10 frame written to a temporary buffer, instead of being fed directly to the bit stream?
question_77227.ground_truth: The output of the bit stream writer for each sub-frame for a TCX10 frame is written to a temporary buffer in case of a TCX10 frame, where two sub-frames are coded dependently within one 20ms frame.

question_77233.question: What shall an MTSI client in terminal do if TMMBR and TMMBN are not allowed to be used in the session and it receives an indication of a reduction in downlink bandwidth allocation?
question_77233.ground_truth: The MTSI client in terminal shall send a SIP UPDATE to the other party to establish the new rate as specified in clause~6.2.7.

question_77234.question: What is the role of the TR editor in the 3GPP Technical Report maintenance process?
question_77234.ground_truth: A single company is responsible for introducing all approved TPs in the current TR, i.e. TR editor. However, it is the responsibility of the contact person of each band/band combination to ensure that the TPs related to the band/band combination have been implemented.

question_77236.question: What is the bit demand calculation based on in the AAC encoder?
question_77236.ground_truth: The bit demand of the current frame in the AAC encoder depends on the current fullness of the bit reservoir and the relative difficulty of the frame, which is measured by the perceptual entropy based on the unmodified psychoacoustic thresholds.

question_77237.question: In the E-UTRAN initiated E-RAB modification procedure, what information does the Serving GW return to the MME in response to a Modify Bearer Request message?
question_77237.ground_truth: The Serving GW returns a Modify Bearer Response message to the MME, providing the Serving GW address and TEID for uplink traffic.

question_77239.question: What message is sent by the network to the MS to initiate the P-TMSI reallocation procedure?

question_77240.question: What should the UE do if it does not have geographical location information when sending an INVITE request for an emergency call?
question_77240.ground_truth: The UE should not include any geographical location information in the INVITE request if it has no geographical location information available.

question_77242.question: What is the mean power saving gain provided by the enhanced CDRX scheme in FR1, UL only evaluation, DU, AR UL 1 & 2 streams?
question_77242.ground_truth: The mean power saving gain provided by the enhanced CDRX scheme in FR1, UL only evaluation, DU, AR UL 1 & 2 streams is 25.56%.

question_77243.question: What is the role of the OAM in assisting an SMF's addition or removal from an SMF set?
question_77243.ground_truth: The OAM plays a crucial role in reporting available UE IP addresses/prefixes, assigning appropriate UE IP addresses/prefixes, and updating IP address pools in both the SMF and the SMF set. The OAM helps avoid disrupting existing IP address pool planning and ensures the continuity of UE IP address/prefix allocation policy.

question_77244.question: What happens during an orderly release of an IAB-node in a network?
question_77244.ground_truth: During an orderly release of an IAB-node, the network and the IAB-node are aware in advance. The IAB-donor-CU removes the F1 interface connection to the IAB-DU without releasing the IAB-MT. If both the F1 interface and IAB-MT need to be released, the IAB-donor-CU removes the F1 interface to the IAB-DU before releasing the collocated IAB-MT.

question_77245.question: What value should be used for a structured attribute if its property is set to True and it has both True and False values in its (descendant) attribute fields?
question_77245.ground_truth: The True value should be used for the attribute and all its (descendant) attribute fields.

question_77246.question: What procedure is followed when the network initiates group call abortion or termination?
question_77246.ground_truth: The MS reacts as specified in subclause 6.4 when the network initiates group call abortion or termination.

question_77247.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the RRC connection re-establishment delay in E-UTRAN FDD Intra-frequency RRC Re-establishment for 5MHz Bandwidth?
question_77247.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement for the RRC connection re-establishment delay in E-UTRAN FDD Intra-frequency RRC Re-establishment for 5MHz Bandwidth is the same as in clause 6.1.1.3.

question_77248.question: What are the RF requirement enhancements introduced in the scope of the NR RRM Enhancement work item?
question_77248.ground_truth: The RF requirement enhancements introduced in the scope of the NR RRM Enhancement work item include SRS carrier switching, Multiple Scell activation/deactivation, CGI reading with autonomous gap for NR capable UE, BWP switching on multiple CCs, Inter-band CA requirement for FR2, Inter-frequency measurement without MG, Mandatory measurement gap patterns, Spatial relation switch for uplink, and UE specific channel BW change.

question_77250.question: What is the goal of the work item related to User Data Convergence (UDC) in TR 22.985 and TS 22.101?
question_77250.ground_truth: The goal of the work item is to develop a framework for overall management of the UDC, including a framework for model handling and management, and the logical centralization of user data.

question_77253.question: Which role is provided by the P-CSCF, with exceptions and additional capabilities to SIP, SDP, and SigComp described in subclause 5.2, 6.2, and 8.2, and with access technology specific procedures?
question_77253.ground_truth: The P-CSCF provides the proxy role with the exceptions and additional capabilities described in subclause 5.2, 6.2, and 8.2, and with access technology specific procedures.

question_77254.question: What is the format of the information displayed when the CAG is selected using the set command with <mode> as 1?
question_77254.ground_truth: In alphanumeric format, the information displayed includes the HRNN, CAG ID, Associated PLMN MCC MNC, and an indication of whether the MT is only allowed to access the Associated PLMN in 5GS via CAG cells. In numeric format, only the CAG ID, Associated PLMN MCC MNC, and an indication of whether the MT is only allowed to access the Associated PLMN in 5GS via CAG cells are displayed.

question_77255.question: What is the definition of a successful cross-check for anchor reconstruction verification?
question_77255.ground_truth: A successful cross-check for anchor reconstruction verification is achieved when the same md5 for the anchor sequence is obtained by using a verified anchor bitstream in two different implementations of a reference decoder.

question_77256.question: What addressing information must be replaced when transporting payload messages between networks in the user plane?
question_77256.ground_truth: At the receipt of a payload message, the TrGW shall replace the received destination IP address(es) and port number(s) in the payload message with the corresponding IP address(es) and port number(s) signalled by the IBCF, and replace the received source IP address(es) and port number(s) in the payload message with the corresponding IP address(es) and port number(s) allocated by the TrGW at its own terminations.

question_77257.question: What actions does the AS take when it receives an Identification response INFO request with the originating identity?
question_77257.ground_truth: When the AS receives an Identification response INFO request with the originating identity, it stops the timer T<sub>O-ID</sub>, stores the MCID information, and sends a 180 (Ringing) response towards the originating user.

question_77258.question: What information should be included in the intent report for an MnS consumer to validate whether the intent is really fulfilled?
question_77258.ground_truth: The intent report should include the intent fulfilment information, achieved values for targets, intent conflict information, and intent fulfilment feasibility check information.

question_77259.question: What kind of failure is given less importance in the context of the provided technical report?
question_77259.ground_truth: IMS-UE service interruption, because there are already procedures for handling unreachable terminals and re-registration timers in place.

question_77260.question: What is the expected pattern for UE to receive the PDSCH for RMSI scheduling multiplexing patterns 2 in the Type0-PDCCH CSS set and SSB symbols to be measured for L1-RSRP measurement?
question_77260.ground_truth: UE is expected to receive PDSCH that corresponds to the PDCCH that UE monitors in the Type0-PDCCH CSS set, on SSB symbols to be measured for L1-RSRP measurement for RMSI scheduling multiplexing patterns 2 in the Type0-PDCCH CSS set and SSB symbols to be measured for L1-RSRP measurement.

question_77262.question: In Solution #6, what is the role of SMSF in the key generation and authentication process for the authentication between legacy UE and the MSGin5G server?
question_77262.ground_truth: SMSF acts as the key management function in the key generation and authentication process for the authentication between legacy UE and the MSGin5G server.

question_77263.question: What is the difference between structured data and unstructured data in the context of 5G System architecture?
question_77263.ground_truth: In the context of 5G System architecture, structured data refers to data for which the structure is defined in 3GPP specifications, while unstructured data refers to data for which the structure is not defined in 3GPP specifications.

question_77264.question: What are the functions of the PDN GW?
question_77264.ground_truth: The PDN GW provides PDN connectivity to both GERAN/UTRAN and E-UTRAN capable UEs. Its functions include per-user based packet filtering, lawful interception, UE IP address allocation, transport level packet marking, uplink and downlink service level charging, DL rate enforcement based on the accumulated MBRs of the aggregate of SDFs with the same GBR QCI, DHCPv4 and DHCPv6 functions, and user plane anchor for mobility between 3GPP and non-3GPP access.

question_77265.question: What is the purpose of the stream identifier (SI) information element in the 3GPP system?
question_77265.ground_truth: The purpose of the stream identifier (SI) information element is to associate a particular call with a Radio Access Bearer (RAB), and to identify whether a new traffic channel is requested for the call.

question_77266.question: What is the recommended protection requirement in dB for an interferer in the adjacent channel spectrum for a 1 dB desense?

question_77268.question: What is the expected delay for livery using unicast bearers?
question_77268.ground_truth: The expected delay for livery using unicast bearers is in the order of 40ms.

question_77269.question: What shall the IWF assign when a Diameter message reaches it to set up a new Diameter session?
question_77269.ground_truth: The IWF shall assign an SS7 number for the Diameter node MME/SGSN and shall assign a Diameter identity for the SS7 node HSS.

question_77270.question: How are cells mapped to a MBSFN Area Id in the MBMS system?
question_77270.ground_truth: The GCS AS is responsible for mapping cells reported by the UEs to a MBSFN Area Id.

question_77271.question: What changes are envisaged for the AN/CN connection point?
question_77271.ground_truth: Two changes are envisaged: introducing a new SAP type and creating a mapping example between the two communication segments.

question_77272.question: What is the role of the PMIP-based S5/S8 in the case of trusted non-3GPP accesses?
question_77272.ground_truth: The PMIP-based S5/S8 is used for trusted non-3GPP accesses, where the non-3GPP network supports prefix advertisement for IPv6 prefix received from the P-GW in PMIPv6 Proxy Binding Acknowledgement.

question_77273.question: What is not permitted in scheduling new transmissions in MAC-hs?
question_77273.ground_truth: Scheduling new transmissions, including retransmissions originating in the RLC layer, within the same TTI, along with retransmissions originating from the HARQ layer.

question_77275.question: How can the V2X authorization update procedure be initiated?
question_77275.ground_truth: The V2X authorization update procedure can be initiated by the V2X control function sending a notification requesting the UE to initiate server-initiated provisioning of the management object specified in 3GPP TS 24.385 to the UE.

question_77276.question: What are the two energy saving states identified in the document for cells and network elements?
question_77276.ground_truth: The two energy saving states are notEnergySaving state and energySaving state.

question_77277.question: What message is sent to the MS when the default call handling is release, due to the default Call Handling parameter being release in the relevant CSI?
question_77277.ground_truth: A BYE indication is sent to the MS in this case.

question_77278.question: What is the role of the SS in the intermodulation rejection test?
question_77278.ground_truth: The SS in the intermodulation rejection test calculates the block error ratio (BLER) performance for PDTCH/DAS5 to 12 and USF/DAS-5 to 12.

question_77279.question: In the context of analytics, what does the NWDAF provide to a NF or AF?
question_77279.ground_truth: The NWDAF provides analytics information (statistics or predictions) to a NF or AF regarding e.g. the number, direction and velocity of UEs during an analytics target period in a target area. The analytics can be used by consumers to further derive the congestion situation in the target area.

question_77281.question: What message is sent by RNS-A to 3G-MSC-A to initiate the handover procedure?

question_77282.question: What is the maximum ACK missed detection probability requirement for PUCCH format 0 with 1 UCI bit?
question_77282.ground_truth: The ACK missed detection probability shall not exceed 1%.

question_77283.question: What is the size of the input blocks of speech samples in the AMR-WB speech codec?
question_77283.ground_truth: The input blocks of speech samples are of size 320 samples.

question_77284.question: What procedure does the MN use when it decides to setup two tunnels in PDU session resource modify?
question_77284.ground_truth: The MN uses the SN Addition or the MN-initiated SN Modification procedure up to step 6 or step 8 if data forwarding applies.

question_77285.question: What action does the NG-RAN node take when it receives a MULTICAST SESSION UPDATE REQUEST message with the MBS QoS Flows To Be Setup or Modify List IE included?
question_77285.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node sets up or modifies the MBS QoS profile accordingly.

question_77286.question: What is the difference between "shall" and "must" in the present document?
question_77286.ground_truth: "Shall" is used in place of "must" in the present document, except in direct citations from external documents or to maintain continuity of style when extending or modifying the provisions of such referenced documents.

question_77287.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for this test case as defined in 7.5.9.2.1.3?
question_77287.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements for this test case are defined in clause 7.5.9.0.1, and the normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 clause A.7.5.9.2.

question_77288.question: In the scenario where the number of padding bits is smaller than the size of the Extended Long Truncated BSR with zero Buffer Size field plus its subheader, what must happen for the MAC entity to report the Extended Short Truncated BSR of the LCG with the highest priority logical channel with data available for transmission?
question_77288.ground_truth: More than one LCG must have data available for transmission when the BSR is to be built.

question_77289.question: What is the responsibility of the 5GMS AF in initiating the QoS Flow establishment?
question_77289.ground_truth: The 5GMS AF provisions the information for a Dynamic PCC rule with the PCF.

question_77291.question: What information does the HSS provide to the IMS-AS in the SRVCC procedure?
question_77291.ground_truth: The HSS provides a single C-MSISDN, a single STN-SR, and UE SRVCC Capability data to the IMS-AS in the SRVCC procedure.

question_77292.question: What is required when using the Multimedia Conference function to record the messaging media stream?
question_77292.ground_truth: The MRFC may request the MRFP to filter the message of the recipient, and the MRFP shall utilize the Message Session Relay Protocol (MSRP) to transport messages carrying different media. The media types shall be MIME encoded.

question_77293.question: What action does the gNB-DU take if the gNB-CU-CP requests the establishment of F1-U resources for ptp retransmission?
question_77293.ground_truth: The gNB-DU requests the establishment of F1-U resources for ptp retransmission by triggering the F1AP Multicast Distribution Setup procedure.

question_77294.question: What is the role of the P-CSCF in supporting IP-PBX in static mode of operation?
question_77294.ground_truth: The P-CSCF in static mode of operation for IP-PBX supports all normal functions of a P-CSCF and registers on behalf of the IP-PBX with an IMS public identity when the connection with the IP-PBX is set.

question_77295.question: How can a dedicated RG be defined for application-based charging based on operator agreements?
question_77295.ground_truth: A specific RG value can be defined for application-based charging based on operator agreements. To make application-based charging interoperability easier, the GSMA standardized RG value for the default bearer can be used.

question_77297.question: What is the frequency range over which the measurements are made for GSM 400 and DCS 1800 at 200 kHz intervals?
question_77297.ground_truth: The measurements are made over the band 450 MHz to 496 MHz for GSM 400 and over the band 925 MHz to 960 MHz for DCS 1800 at 200 kHz intervals.

question_77299.question: What is the method used to transmit data in the MBMS Streaming Delivery Method?
question_77299.ground_truth: Data is transmitted continuously and immediately played out via the display and/or loudspeaker in the MBMS Streaming Delivery Method.

question_77300.question: What should the network do if two or more packet filters in all TFTs associated with the same PDP address and APN have identical packet filter precedence values?
question_77300.ground_truth: The network should not reject the new request, but further process it. If the new request is processed successfully, the old packet filters which have identical filter precedence values will be deleted, and the PDP contexts for which it has deleted the packet filters will be deactivated.

question_77301.question: What should be done when the candidate number of MCPTT group IDs is bigger than the N2 value of the served MCPTT ID?
question_77301.ground_truth: The IWF should reduce the candidate MCPTT group IDs to that equal to N2 based on service provider policy.

question_77302.question: What is the margin added to the signaled value of absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation for 1 Rx RedCap UE?
question_77302.ground_truth: The 1 Rx RedCap UE adds 1 dB to the signaled value of absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation.

question_77304.question: What information does the AccessStratumRelease ENUMERATED indicate?
question_77304.ground_truth: The AccessStratumRelease ENUMERATED indicates the release supported by the UE.

question_77306.question: What does the MME do if there is no bearer context at all after receiving the TAU Request?
question_77306.ground_truth: If there is no bearer context at all, the MME rejects the TAU Request.

question_77312.question: What should the Mobile Station (MS) send if it chooses to send a SREJ frame in case a?
question_77312.ground_truth: The MS should send an I+S SREJ frame containing N(R)=NSS+1.

question_77314.question: What is the impact of the CUG service on the MiD service?
question_77314.ground_truth: The CUG service imposes restrictions on both incoming and outgoing calls. The MiD shall not use any identity C or identity D that are restricted by the CUG service.

question_77316.question: What is the requirement for resuming a suspended RRC connection triggered by upper layers?
question_77316.ground_truth: The UE shall perform the unified access control procedure, and if the access attempt is barred, the procedure ends. If the resumption occurs after release with redirect with mpsPriorityIndication, the resumeCause is set to mps-PriorityAccess.

question_77317.question: What is the format of the Protocol identifier and Protocol version number in the first octet of the I1 message common part?
question_77317.ground_truth: The Protocol identifier is "0001" and the Protocol version number is "0001", indicating that the message is an I1 protocol message and this is the first version of the specification.

question_77318.question: What is required to ensure the MTC triggers are protected in the event of network internal nodes or signalling links being compromised in solution 3C?
question_77318.ground_truth: Some form of cryptographic protection of MTC triggers is needed between the MTC server and the UE.

question_77319.question: What will the UE do if the PDN connection is released when one or more old packet filters belong to the default bearer context, as specified in clause 7.2.4.1?
question_77319.ground_truth: The UE will release the PDN connection as specified in clause 7.2.4.1.

question_77320.question: What should the SMF do when timer T3592 expires in the network-requested PDU session release procedure?
question_77320.ground_truth: The SMF shall retransmit the PDU SESSION RELEASE COMMAND message and shall reset and start timer T3592. This retransmission is repeated four times, i.e. on the fifth expiry of timer T3592, the SMF shall abort the procedure.

question_77322.question: What factors can cause the activation of the USAT Interpreter from its idle state?
question_77322.ground_truth: The USAT Interpreter can be activated from its idle state by local selection from the UE using menu, locally from the UE as the result of an event, by an incoming page initiated by an external system entity (push mode), or optionally by an internal application using a proprietary interface.

question_77323.question: What causes the release of an ad-hoc group call?
question_77323.ground_truth: The ad-hoc group call can be released due to hang time expiry, the last participant leaving, the second last participant leaving, the initiator leaving, or if the minimum number of affiliated MCVideo group members are not present.

question_77324.question: What are the limitations of the xFR-C BS type compared to beam forming architectures in the 7-24 GHz frequency range?
question_77324.ground_truth: The xFR-C BS type has lower antenna gain and larger path loss in the 7-24 GHz frequency range, resulting in smaller cell sizes compared to beam forming architectures.

question_77325.question: What action does the MCVideo client take upon receiving a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message in the "S7: Waiting for call announcement after call release" state?
question_77325.ground_truth: Upon receiving a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message in the "S7: Waiting for call announcement after call release" state, the MCVideo client stores various pieces of information from the message, stops timer TFG1, starts timer TFG5, and enters the "S6: ignoring incoming call announcements" state.

question_77328.question: What happens to the keys CK and IK if the AKA authentication is run over a non-3GPP SAE access network?
question_77328.ground_truth: CK and IK are not transferred from the HSS and remain in the HSS when the AKA authentication is run over a non-3GPP SAE access network, such as LTE or a non-3GPP SAE access network.

question_77329.question: In which LTE mode, the data to be transported are represented in terms of sets of resource units?
question_77329.ground_truth: In LTE TDD mode, the data to be transported are represented in terms of sets of resource units.

question_77331.question: What action does the AMF take if it receives a Supported NSSAI from the NG-RAN containing incompatible S-NSSAIs with respect to the UE capabilities?
question_77331.ground_truth: The AMF modifies the Allowed NSSAI as needed, and indicates to the SMF(s) which PDU Session ID(s) corresponding to the incompatible S-NSSAIs should be released.

question_77335.question: In the context of FDD, what values should the Node B use for non cell specific Radio Link related parameters and non cell specific E-DPCH, UL DPCH, E-DCH, and F-DPCH parameters on the secondary uplink frequency?
question_77335.ground_truth: The Node B should use the same values as for the corresponding cell of the Primary uplink frequency.

question_77337.question: Which KI (Key Issue) proposes the use of a new NF/interface/functionality (e.g., GSMF) as a common anchor for SMFs serving different service areas in a 5G VN group?

question_77338.question: What should the MAC entity do if the Random Access Preamble was selected among the contention-based preambles?
question_77338.ground_truth: The MAC entity should select a PUSCH occasion corresponding to the selected preamble and PRACH occasion, determine the UL grant for the MSGA payload and associated HARQ information, and if the selected preamble and PRACH occasion is mapped to a valid PUSCH occasion, deliver the UL grant and associated HARQ information to the HARQ entity.

question_77339.question: What information is sent by the MGW when the "CTM report" procedure is initiated?
question_77339.ground_truth: The MGW sends a NOT.req command with the necessary information.

question_77340.question: What is the Occurrence value for the node named "GeographicalArea"?
question_77340.ground_truth: The Occurrence is One, meaning this node is required to exist exactly once.

question_77341.question: What should the UE do when the timer T3526 associated with a specific rejected S-NSSAI due to maximum number of UEs reached expires?
question_77341.ground_truth: The UE shall remove the S-NSSAI from the rejected NSSAI for the maximum number of UEs reached.

question_77343.question: What is the challenge in some countries regarding UE meeting regulations while roaming?
question_77343.ground_truth: In some countries, the UE vendor is responsible for ensuring the UE meets regulations, but the operator or base station is not. This can lead to ambiguity when UEs roam in countries where they are not certified.

question_77344.question: What are some of the key features of the 5G system for serving a wide diversity of verticals and services?
question_77344.ground_truth: Adaptability and flexibility are some of the key features of the 5G system for serving a wide diversity of verticals and services.

question_77345.question: What is the significance of the propagation properties in the cross band carrier aggregation for the present document?
question_77345.ground_truth: The propagation properties are significant because they allow for a path loss model, which shows a 7.2 dB difference between low frequency (900MHz) and high frequency (2000MHz) bands. This impacts the design of the carrier aggregation scenario, particularly with a high frequency secondary carrier.

question_77346.question: What is a mechanism of resource reservation where the IP-CAN on behalf of the network initiates the resources to the UE?

question_77348.question: What information does the UE include in the MO-LR Invoke message when requesting periodic transfer of location to a third party LCS client?
question_77348.ground_truth: The UE includes the periodic location related parameters (reporting interval and total number of reports), the identity of the LCS client, the address of the GMLC if available, and a request for use of MO-LR Short Circuit if the UE supports UE based positioning.

question_77349.question: What is the issue that overlays cause to viewport-dependent streaming?
question_77349.ground_truth: The issue is that when an overlay with different content is sticked on top of (part of) the viewport, the content behind the overlay does not need to be sent at higher quality. This allows saving bandwidth or increasing the quality in the viewport for the non-overlaid parts.

question_77350.question: What does the 3GPP Technical Specification Group produce in the area of mobile telecommunications?
question_77350.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group produces technical specifications and reports for the 3rd Generation Partnership Project in the area of mobile telecommunications.

question_77351.question: What is the definition of aggregate power control tolerance for inter-band carrier aggregation, in terms of maintaining the power in non-contiguous transmission within 21 ms in response to 0 dB TPC commands?
question_77351.ground_truth: The UE must meet the requirements for inter-band carrier aggregation with uplink assigned to two E-UTRA bands, where the aggregate power tolerance is specified on each component carrier and exceeds the minimum output power as defined in subclause 6.3.2A. The total power is limited by maximum output power as defined in subclause 6.2.2A. The requirements can be tested by time aligning any transmission gaps on both the component carriers.

question_77352.question: What is the potential impact of a PWS Security circumvention attack?
question_77352.ground_truth: A PWS Security circumvention attack can be used by an attacker to create panic or significant damage by sending false warning messages via a false BS to a sufficiently large number of users.

question_77353.question: What should the UE include in the REMOTE UE REPORT message if any encrypted IMSI remote UE identity is included in the message?
question_77353.ground_truth: The UE should include the corresponding ProSe Key Management Function address in the REMOTE UE REPORT message if any encrypted IMSI remote UE identity is included in the message.

question_77354.question: What should the initiating UE do if timer T5089 expires before the 5G ProSe direct link security mode control procedure is completed?
question_77354.ground_truth: Retransmit the PROSE DIRECT LINK COMMAND message and restart timer T5089. After reaching the maximum number of allowed retransmissions, abort the 5G ProSe direct link security mode control procedure and delete security context for the 5G ProSe direct link.

question_77355.question: What is the role of the P-CSCF in routing IMS traffic via a localized UPF?
question_77355.ground_truth: The P-CSCF selects an IMS-AGW or an IMS-AGW list based on the UE's location and requested services and sends AAR with policies to influence the SMF to select a UPF which is closer to the IMS-AGW and the UE.

question_77356.question: What is the effect of the MNRG flag on the SGSN?
question_77356.ground_truth: The MNRG flag on the SGSN remains set independently of whether the MSC/VLR was successful in delivering the SM or not. In certain cases, this can cause a small amount of duplicate signalling between the SGSN and the HLR/HSS.

question_77358.question: In the F1AP UE messages, what does the PC5RLCChannelSetupList contain?
question_77358.ground_truth: The information of the PC5 RLC Channel Setup procedure in the F1AP UE messages.

question_77360.question: What target identities does the LIPF provision to the IRI-POI present in the NEF for NIDD using NEF?
question_77360.ground_truth: The LIPF provisions the intercept information associated with the SUPI and GPSI target identities to the IRI-POI present in the NEF for NIDD using NEF.

question_77362.question: What is used to forward media plane control messages to group members who do not or cannot receive the MBMS subchannels?

question_77364.question: What does the term "DCSF" stand for in relation to the IMS DC architecture?
question_77364.ground_truth: DCSF stands for Data Channel Service Function, which is an application function that may be required to be applied on the media in the IMS DC.

question_77365.question: What is the requirement for the presence of the GUTI IE in an Identification Request message?
question_77365.ground_truth: The GUTI IE shall not coexist with any of the RAI IE, P-TMSI IE, and P-TMSI Signature IE in an Identification Request message.

question_77366.question: What is one potential impact on 5G roaming due to the motion of the Relay UE between countries?
question_77366.ground_truth: Roaming functions can be impacted since UE's can be roaming during the motion of the Relay UE from one country to another, while the UE is attached to the Relay UE.

question_77367.question: What is the purpose of the Open Platform in relation to 3GPP TS 33.234?
question_77367.ground_truth: The Open Platform is a trusted platform that must have secure authentication and authorization mechanisms to protect against eavesdropping, malicious modification of sensitive data, and operator applications residing on the Open Platform.

question_77368.question: What is the system that becomes overloaded when there is a huge surge in mobility management signalling in a network?

question_77369.question: What is the role of the Media Application Provider in 5G Media Streaming?
question_77369.ground_truth: The Media Application Provider in 5G Media Streaming provides a 5GMS Application-private API for information exchange between the Media Application and the Media-aware Application.

question_77370.question: Which information element is mandatory in the "AMFCPRelocationIndicationIEs" sequence?
question_77370.ground_truth: The "ID id-AMF-UE-NGAP-ID", "ID id-RAN-UE-NGAP-ID", and "ID id-S-NSSAI" information elements are mandatory in the "AMFCPRelocationIndicationIEs" sequence.

question_77371.question: Which IETF RFC is related to the PDUs used in A.2.1.3, and what is its name?
question_77371.ground_truth: The name of the IETF RFC relating to the PDUs used in A.2.1.3 is not explicitly mentioned, but it is a part of the IETF RFCs related to IMS usage.

question_77372.question: What should a UE do when it receives a message with semantically incorrect contents, if no reactions are specified in clauses 4, 5, or 6 of the procedural part of the present document?
question_77372.ground_truth: The UE should ignore the message, except that it shall return a status message with cause #95 "semantically incorrect message".

question_77373.question: What is the procedure for a Multi-USIM UE to modify the paging occasions to avoid paging collisions?
question_77373.ground_truth: The Multi-USIM UE sends a Requested IMSI Offset to the MME to signal an alternative IMSI and avoid paging collisions.

question_77375.question: What should the UE do when the neighbor NR cell becomes offset better than the serving?
question_77375.ground_truth: Upon this condition, the UE sends the MeasurementReport for event A3.

question_77376.question: What should the UE do if all segments of a warning message have not been assembled within a period of 3 hours?
question_77376.ground_truth: The UE should discard any stored warningMessageSegment and the current value of messageIdentifier and serialNumber for SystemInformationBlockType11 or SystemInformationBlockType12 if the complete warning message has not been assembled within a period of 3 hours.

question_77377.question: What is the name of the time duration defined in clause 8.6.3 for a simultaneous RRC based BWP switch on multiple CCs?
question_77377.ground_truth: The name of the time duration defined in clause 8.6.3 for a simultaneous RRC based BWP switch on multiple CCs is D.

question_77378.question: When is the MCS indicator bit of the 5GS network feature support IE used to determine if access identity 2 is valid?
question_77378.ground_truth: When the UE is not in the country of its HPLMN prior to receiving the MCS indicator bit of the 5GS network feature support IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message being set to "Access identity 2 valid in RPLMN or equivalent PLMN".

question_77379.question: How are physical layer measurements for uplink channels defined in N-GSM?
question_77379.ground_truth: Physical layer measurements for uplink channels are "to be defined" (FFS) in N-GSM.

question_77380.question: What is the purpose of modifying the U-RNTI in Solution 1d?
question_77380.ground_truth: The purpose of modifying the U-RNTI every time the UE leaves the coverage area of an HNB and attaches to another HNB connected to the same HNB-GW is to ensure that the same U-RNTI is not used in different HNBs.

question_77381.question: What are the target identities that the LI functions in the SGW/PGW support for provisioning in a non-roaming case for E-UTRAN?

question_77384.question: What function is used to determine the ZOAs in the LOS case?
question_77384.ground_truth: In the LOS case, the ZOAs are determined by applying the inverse Laplacian function (7.5-14) with input parameters Pn and RMS angle spread ZSA.

question_77385.question: What is the main focus of the solution in addressing Key Issue 1?
question_77385.ground_truth: The main focus of the solution in addressing Key Issue 1 is to realize the reliability of user plane between UPF and UE.

question_77386.question: What is the impact of reducing the number of coverage classes on the random access delay in the network?
question_77386.ground_truth: Reducing the number of coverage classes negatively impacts the random access delay in the network, but the overall delay is still small.

question_77388.question: When should all requirements for power class 2 be applied for inter-band EN-DC within TDD in FR1?
question_77388.ground_truth: All requirements for power class 2 should be applied for inter-band EN-DC within TDD in FR1 when the UE supports a different power class than the default UE power class for an E-UTRA TDD and NR TDD Inter-band EN-DC band combination, the supported power class enables higher maximum output power, and the percentage of NR uplink symbols transmitted in a certain evaluation period meets certain conditions.

question_77389.question: What feature does the 5G system need to provide in order to enable roaming between 5G satellite and terrestrial access networks?
question_77389.ground_truth: The 5G system needs to support network reselection based on home operator policy, even when a UE is still in coverage of its current network.

question_77390.question: What message is sent to the MS (Measure Position Request) for in the test?
question_77390.ground_truth: MEASURE POSITION REQUEST (3GPP TS 44.031 sub clause A.2)

question_77391.question: What is the purpose of the LTE Advanced Intra-band Non-contiguous Carrier Aggregation in Band 4 work item?
question_77391.ground_truth: The purpose of this work item is to specify the band-specific RF requirements for Band 4 intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation and to add the performance requirements and conformance testing for this band combination in the relevant specifications.

question_77392.question: Which parameter is used to indicate the aggregate requested bit rate in kbit/s for the EPS bearer context or the 5G QoS flow in the +CGBRRREQ command?
question_77392.ground_truth: The <reqBitrate> parameter is used to indicate the aggregate requested bit rate in kbit/s for the EPS bearer context or the 5G QoS flow in the +CGBRRREQ command.

question_77393.question: What is the role of the ProSe UE-Network Relay in eMBMS relay support?
question_77393.ground_truth: The ProSe UE-Network Relay function includes support for the relay of eMBMS to Remote UEs served by the UE-to-Network Relay. It relays eMBMS traffic related to specific TMGIs as requested by served Remote UEs and transparently transfers the traffic over the PC5 one-to-many link.

question_77394.question: What happens to a mobile station in MAC-Dedicated state after releasing all DBPSCHs?
question_77394.ground_truth: The mobile station enters the MAC-Idle state

question_77395.question: What details would the IWF include in the SIP re-INVITE request if an emergency alert needs to be cancelled by a user other than its originator?
question_77395.ground_truth: If an MCPTT emergency alert is cancelled by a user other than its originator, the IWF would include an "<originated-by>" element set to the MCPTT ID of the MCPTT user who originated the MCPTT emergency alert. This is to identify which MCPTT emergency alert is being cancelled, as multiple MCPTT users could have originated emergency alerts to the same group.

question_77396.question: What must the MCPTT client include in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body when setting the MCPTT emergency state to "true"?
question_77396.ground_truth: The MCPTT client must include an <emergency-ind> element set to "true" in the SIP INVITE request or SIP REFER request.

question_77398.question: In Cellular IoT, what step must be taken if the receiving part has no valid security context and the check of the MAC fails?
question_77398.ground_truth: The processing of the received GMM message should follow exactly the conditions specified for LTE in TS 24.301.

question_77400.question: How is the TRP calculated in the test?
question_77400.ground_truth: The TRP is calculated by integrating the power transmitted in different directions over the entire radiation sphere. It can also be calculated by sampling the statistically distributed radiated power of the LEE in a Rayleigh fading environment and using the average value of these samples, which is proportional to the TRP.

question_77402.question: What is the intended usage of the MIME type that is used for sending additional digits of the callee's number in SIP INFO messages?
question_77402.ground_truth: The intended usage of this MIME type is limited.

question_77403.question: What are the open architectural issues for both UMTS and EPS in Solution 1?
question_77403.ground_truth: The open architectural issues for both UMTS and EPS in Solution 1 are whether mobility is supported/required for LIPA and SIPTO traffic, and whether the standalone L-GW architecture is supported for LIPA and SIPTO.

question_77404.question: What is the format of the URL used in the "3GPP-Asset-Information" attribute?
question_77404.ground_truth: The URL used in the "3GPP-Asset-Information" attribute is as defined in RFC 4566.

question_77405.question: What is the role of the 5GMSd AS in the establishment of a 5GMSd session?
question_77405.ground_truth: The 5GMSd AS hosts an MPD or 3GP/MP4 file and responds to the HTTP GET message from the Media Player with the requested MPD resource or 3GP/MP4 resource when successful. The 5GMSd AS also provides Service Access Information for the establishment of a 5GMSd session.

question_77406.question: What should the UE do if it receives an AUTHENTICATION REJECT message without integrity protection and the counter for the entry for the current SNPN considered invalid for 3GPP access events is not at its maximum value?
question_77406.ground_truth: The UE should proceed as specified in subclause 5.3.20.3 for the case that the 5GMM cause value received is #3.

question_77408.question: What entity identifies SDES keys when Session Description Protocol (SDP) Security Descriptions for Media Streams is used in ICE?
question_77408.ground_truth: The DF2 shall identify the SDES keys from the SDP offer and SDP answer messages and provide the DF3 with the necessary SDES related parameters.

question_77410.question: What is the principle behind the test tolerance (TT) being equal to the measurement uncertainty (MU) in the context of test requirements?
question_77410.ground_truth: This principle is referred to as the "Never fail a good DUT" principle, where the probability of a borderline bad UE being judged as PASS is greater than the probability of a borderline good UE being judged as FAIL.

question_77411.question: What should MSC-A do if MSC-B indicates that either the assignment or Handover Number allocation cannot be completed in the MAP-PREPARE-HANDOVER response?
question_77411.ground_truth: MSC-A shall terminate the circuit establishment attempt and maintain the existing connection to the UE/MS, if possible.

question_77413.question: What services does the NWDAF contain when providing the NWDAF-assisted service type detection solution?
question_77413.ground_truth: The NWDAF contains AnLF and MTLF that provide specific services related to the NWDAF-assisted service type detection solution.

question_77414.question: What should the 5G system support for UEs that have the ability to obtain service from more than one VPLMN simultaneously?
question_77414.ground_truth: The 5G system should support a mechanism to enable a UE to be registered to more than one VPLMN simultaneously and use network slices from more than one VPLMN simultaneously.

question_77415.question: What is the Top-5 beam pair prediction accuracy based on two sources?
question_77415.ground_truth: The Top-5 beam pair prediction accuracy can be 91% and 94% based on two different sources.

question_77416.question: What action should the RNC take when all RABs included in the RABs Setup List IE in the ENHANCED RELOCATION COMPLETE REQUEST message are successfully established in the target RNC?
question_77416.ground_truth: The RNC includes the Transport Layer Address IE and the Iu Transport Association IE in the RABs Setup List IE in the ENHANCED RELOCATION COMPLETE REQUEST message.

question_77418.question: What is the minimum number of reference points recommended for ensuring accuracy of TRP?
question_77418.ground_truth: It is recommended to have at least 4 reference points to ensure accuracy of TRP.

question_77419.question: What is the procedure for terminating a multimedia IMS session to a CSI UE?
question_77419.ground_truth: UE 2 initiates the multimedia session for voice and MSRP by sending an INVITE message towards UE 1, which triggers the S-CSCF2 of the originating network to send the INVITE message for the voice and MSRP to the S-CSCF1 of the terminating network. The S-CSCF1 of the terminating network then sends the INVITE message for the voice and MSRP to the CSI AS, which ultimately sends the message to UE 1. This procedure follows the normal IMS procedure for IMS/CS interworking, but has been simplified for clarity by omitting some entities.

question_77420.question: How does the Entry Point concept help in network management?
question_77420.ground_truth: The Entry Point concept allows the NM to discover the outline information of IRPs, including the DN of IRPs, the supported IRPVersions, and their scope of management in the managed systems. It also allows the NM to obtain the References of the IRPs of a specific IRPVersion by inputting the DN of the IRP which supports the IRPVersion number it needs.

question_77421.question: What is the complexity of SGW implementation when behaving uniformly towards both failed and non-failed nodes?
question_77421.ground_truth: The implementation complexity of SGW is reduced when it behaves uniformly towards both failed and non-failed nodes.

question_77422.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 9.2.1IB and 9.2.1IC?
question_77422.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the ability of the receiver to receive a predefined test signal, representing a multi-path fading channel with information bit throughput R not falling below a specified value. The test stresses the multicode reception and channel decoding with incremental redundancy.

question_77423.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for 5.7.5.2 in the NR UE supporting EN-DC from Release 16 onwards?
question_77423.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 5.7.5.0.1 of the document.

question_77424.question: What is not required for no checking in the NO MORE field in the STATUS PDU?
question_77424.ground_truth: The NO MORE field in the STATUS PDU does not require any checking.

question_77425.question: What is the effect on Alice's data rate after moving to cell Y in Use Case 2?
question_77425.ground_truth: After Alice moves to cell Y, which is not user plane congested, the network detects this and deactivates her data rate limitation, causing her data rate to increase to, for example, 5 Mbps.

question_77426.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for the NR SA FR2 event-triggered reporting tests on inter-frequency measurement with NCSG for FR2 when DRX is not used?
question_77426.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 7.16.1.0.

question_77427.question: What is the impact of applying the Operator centric method for CS Handover without DTM support and SRVCC to GERAN without DTM support?
question_77427.ground_truth: The risk of changing operator can be avoided by applying the Operator centric method for these cases, which involves coordination of the CS-NRI allocated to the UE in the source network with CS-NRIs used by the MSCs of the selected target operator.

question_77429.question: What is the consequence when the MCData client sends a non-200 MSRP response to an MSRP SEND request?
question_77429.ground_truth: The MCData client shall handle the error as specified in IETF~RFC~4975 and abort transmission of further MSRP chunks. It shall also indicate to the MCData user that the SDS message or the SDS disposition notification could not be sent.

question_77431.question: What is the mechanism specified in the 3GPP TS 32.33x-series for managing Notification Logs in telecommunications management?
question_77431.ground_truth: The 3GPP TS 32.33x-series specifies a standard general-purpose mechanism for the management of Notification Logs containing selected or all notifications from the network for historical analysis on faults and conditions in the network.

question_77432.question: What is the role of the FF Application Server (AS) in the FF application layer functional model?
question_77432.ground_truth: The FF Application Server (AS) consists of the FAE server and the FF application specific server(s), providing the FF application layer support functions to the FF application specific server(s) via FAE-S reference point.

question_77433.question: What are the steps to perform the test procedure specified in 6.2D.3.4.2?
question_77433.ground_truth: The test procedure consists of setting the UE in the Tx beam peak direction, continuously sending uplink power control commands, activating and deactivating UE Beamlock Function (UBF), and measuring UE EIRP in the Tx beam peak direction.

question_77437.question: What action does the gNB-CU-CP take if the gNB-CU-UE cannot accept the setup?
question_77437.ground_truth: If the gNB-CU-UE cannot accept the setup, the gNB-CU-CP shall respond with a GNB-CU-CP E1 SETUP FAILURE message with an appropriate cause value.

question_77439.question: What are the exceptions allowed for the micro and pico-BTS in the combined range 600 kHz to 6 MHz above and below the carrier frequency?
question_77439.ground_truth: In the combined range 600 kHz to 6 MHz above and below the carrier frequency, in up to three bands of 200 kHz width centered on a frequency which is an integer multiple of 200 kHz, exceptions at up to -36 dBm are allowed for the micro and pico-BTS.

question_77441.question: What is the effect of a successful bootstrapping procedure between the UE and the BSF?
question_77441.ground_truth: After a successful bootstrapping procedure between the UE and the BSF, both parties contain the key material (Ks) and the B-TID, and the BSF also contains security specific attributes related to the UE.

question_77442.question: What is the frequency range for the new 5G band defined in 3GPP Release 17?
question_77442.ground_truth: The frequency range for the new 5G band defined in 3GPP Release 17 is 47.2 - 48.2 GHz.

question_77443.question: How does either station initiate a wake-up from the reduced power state?
question_77443.ground_truth: Either station may initiate a wake-up from the reduced power state by the transmission of the wake-up signal which consists of continuous flag characters.

question_77444.question: What is the focus of Part 8 of the 3GPP TS 23.198 for OSA?
question_77444.ground_truth: Part 8 of the 3GPP TS 23.198 for OSA, also known as "Terminal Status," specifies the aspects of the interface that provide access to the status of a terminal.

question_77445.question: What action should the mobile station take if it receives an RLC/MAC control message on a logical channel where this RLC/MAC control message is not allowed?
question_77445.ground_truth: The mobile station should ignore the message.

question_77447.question: What SDP attribute is used to signal the 3GPP MTSI client's support for this RTCP feedback message?
question_77447.ground_truth: The a=rtcp-fb attribute in conjunction with the 3gpp-delay-budget parameter is used to signal the 3GPP MTSI client's support for this RTCP feedback message.

question_77449.question: What message does the serving gNB send to the LMF upon successfully activating the UL-SRS?
question_77449.ground_truth: The serving gNB sends the NRPPa Positioning Activation Response message to the LMF upon successfully activating the UL-SRS.

question_77451.question: What should the SGSN do upon receipt of a HLR reset indication from the HLR?
question_77451.ground_truth: The SGSN shall set the NGAF for all registered MSs in the SGSN for which a valid MSC/VLR-association exists and report to the VLR if there is any activity from the MS.

question_77453.question: How many measurements must the UE use for filtering SS-RSRP or SS-RSRQ of each measured higher, lower, and equal priority inter-frequency cell?
question_77453.ground_truth: The UE shall filter SS-RSRP or SS-RSRQ measurements of each measured higher, lower and equal priority inter-frequency cell using at least 2 measurements.

question_77454.question: What is the minimum downlink rate on DPCH for the combination described in 7.4.5a?

question_77455.question: What is the maximum number of event triggered periodic measurement reports that the UE should be capable of sending, as specified in Section 8.11.3.1.1.2.1.3?
question_77455.ground_truth: The UE should be capable of sending at most one event triggered periodic measurement report per event-triggered reporting event.

question_77456.question: What should be done if Msg3 is being retransmitted?
question_77456.ground_truth: The same group of Random Access Preambles as was used for the preamble transmission attempt corresponding to the first transmission of Msg3 should be selected.

question_77460.question: Which part of the SA2 TR 23.887 V0.6.0 solution is vulnerable to flooding and security attacks in the 3GPP network for small data transmission?
question_77460.ground_truth: The network topology and sensitive network information, such as SGW S1-U F-TEID, can be vulnerable to flooding and security attacks if not handled appropriately, leading to the risk of exposing the number of S-GWs and S-GW IP addresses to the user.

question_77461.question: What is an XML attribute specification, and what does it consist of?
question_77461.ground_truth: An XML attribute specification consists of a name and a value. It is used to provide additional information about an XML element, such as describing its properties or providing metadata. XML attribute specifications can be found within the start-tag or empty-element tag of an XML element.

question_77463.question: What does the abbreviation "CA" stand for in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?

question_77464.question: In the absence of an "Absolute Grant" and the last SG update being due to a Primary Absolute Grant, what shall the UE calculate its new SG by applying?
question_77464.ground_truth: A Delta compared with its last used power ratio.

question_77465.question: What is the role of a Network Element Manager (EM) and a Network Manager (NM) in the 3GPP series?
question_77465.ground_truth: A Network Element Manager (EM) provides a set of end-user functions for the management of a set of closely related types of Network Elements (NEs), while a Network Manager (NM) provides a package of end-user functions with the responsibility for managing a network, mainly through EM(s) but also through direct access to NEs. The communication between the network and the NM is based on open and well-standardized interfaces, supporting the management of multi-vendor and multi-technology NEs.

question_77466.question: What is the purpose of the "Security Compliance Testing (SCT)" in Methodology 2?
question_77466.ground_truth: The purpose of Security Compliance Testing (SCT) in Methodology 2 is to check the compliance of a network product with applicable Security Assurance Specifications (SCAS).

question_77467.question: When must the UE include a Privacy header with the "id" type when using the TIR service in temporary mode?
question_77467.ground_truth: The UE must include a Privacy header with privacy type of "id" in any non-100 responses it sends upon receipt of a SIP request when using the TIR service in temporary mode and the terminating user wishes to override the default setting currently set to "not restricted."

question_77468.question: What could be done for a less strict synchronization requirement in 5G NR for both intra and inter-band non-contiguous CA?
question_77468.ground_truth: Marginally increasing the LTE MRTD error at the UE or allocating slightly reduced max propagation difference for the UE would allow for a less strict synchronization requirement.

question_77469.question: What is the procedure where a mobile station uses to derive the timing advance value for uplink transmission?
question_77469.ground_truth: The mobile station uses the continuous timing advance update procedure to derive the timing advance value for uplink transmission. This procedure is carried out on the PTCCH assigned to the mobile station.

question_77471.question: What should be included in the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body in the <mcptt-request-uri> element when initiating an MCPTT prearranged group call using a pre-established session?
question_77471.ground_truth: The group identity should be set in the <mcptt-request-uri> element when initiating an MCPTT prearranged group call using a pre-established session.

question_77473.question: What is mandatory for signalling, bearer, and management plane traffic over the interface between H(e)NB and SeGW?
question_77473.ground_truth: All signalling, bearer, and management plane traffic over the interface between H(e)NB and SeGW should be sent through an IPsec ESP tunnel that is established as a result of the authentication procedure.

question_77474.question: What action does the UE take when it stops being authorized to perform the UE-to-network relay discovery procedure?
question_77474.ground_truth: The UE instructs the lower layers to stop the discoverer operation and if the UE is in EMM-CONNECTED mode, the UE triggers the corresponding procedure in lower layers as specified in 3GPP TS 36.331.

question_77475.question: What action does the new SGSN take when it triggers the release of resources in the target cell during a PS handover?
question_77475.ground_truth: The new SGSN sends an Iu Release Command message to the target RNC, which then releases all resources allocated for the handover.

question_77477.question: What is the unit used for measuring the data volume in the uplink provided by the "UL Cell PDCP SDU Data Volume on Xn Interface" measurement?
question_77477.ground_truth: The unit used for measuring the data volume in the uplink provided by the "UL Cell PDCP SDU Data Volume on Xn Interface" measurement is Mbit.

question_77478.question: In a communication system, what is the starting time of the sTTI for the first subframe?
question_77478.ground_truth: The starting time of the sTTI for the first subframe is given by sTTIStartTimeUl.

question_77479.question: What are the functionalities of MCVideo emergency group calls supported by the procedures in this specification?
question_77479.ground_truth: The functionalities of MCVideo emergency group calls supported by the procedures in this specification are MCVideo emergency group call origination, upgrade of an MCVideo group call to an MCVideo emergency group call, and in-progress group emergency cancel.

question_77481.question: What is the sequence of timeslots on a DBPSCH or SBPSCH used to convey one radio block called?

question_77482.question: What is the purpose of the CDIV services?
question_77482.ground_truth: The CDIV services allow for the redirection of incoming communications to another user based on different conditions, such as unconditional forwarding, forwarding on a busy line, or forwarding if there is no reply.

question_77483.question: What is the maximum number of CBR levels for dedicated SRS-SL-NR resource pool is FFS?
question_77483.ground_truth: The value is defined by 3GPP and is not specified in this text.

question_77484.question: What message does the MME send to the UE when connectivity with the requested PDN cannot be accepted by the network?
question_77484.ground_truth: The MME sends a PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message to the UE when connectivity with the requested PDN cannot be accepted by the network.

question_77488.question: What should the UE do during SCell activation, in terms of sending CSI reports for SCell and monitoring CSI reports for SCell from the SS?
question_77488.ground_truth: During SCell activation, the UE should start sending CSI reports for SCell and the SS should monitor CSI reports for SCell sent from the UE. The SS should also monitor ACK/NACK sent in PCell during this time.

question_77489.question: What should the SS do when it receives a Registration Request message from a MS with a stored FQDN for a serving GANC associated with the AP-ID?
question_77489.ground_truth: The SS should answer the Registration Request message with Registration Rejected before timer TU3904 expires and initiate the Discovery Procedure towards the Provisioning GANC.

question_77490.question: What is the format of the application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body in a SIP MESSAGE request for notifying an MCVideo client about entering or exiting from an emergency alert area?
question_77490.ground_truth: The MIME body includes an <emergency-alert-area-ind> element that is set to "true" if the client has entered the emergency alert area, or "false" if the client has exited the emergency alert area.

question_77491.question: What happens on the CTS-FP side when the main signalling link is disconnected in the channel release procedure?
question_77491.ground_truth: When the main signalling link is disconnected on the CTS-FP side, timer TC3107 is started. When it times out, the CTS-FP deactivates the channels. If timer TC3106 times out, the CTS-FP also deactivates the channels.

question_77493.question: Which requirement will the UE check when the 5GSM cause #84 "syntactical error in the QoS operation" is present and after the completion of the PDU session modification procedure in case 6?
question_77493.ground_truth: The UE will check for the presence of at least one other valid QoS rule in the Authorized QoS rules IE; if not found, the UE will release the PDU SESSION by sending a PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message with 5GSM cause #84 "syntactical error in the QoS operation".

question_77494.question: What should the SNRM-S do if the media bearer modification is not required and the HTTP POST request message contains a modification of unicast resources?
question_77494.ground_truth: The SNRM-S should generate an HTTP 200 (OK) response message indicating failure of the resource modification request operation.
