question_77495.question: What should the initiating UE do after creating a 5G ProSe direct link context for each of the 5G ProSe direct link(s)?
question_77495.ground_truth: The initiating UE should store the source layer-2 ID and the destination layer-2 ID used in the transport of this message provided by the lower layers in the 5G ProSe direct link context(s) to complete the establishment of the 5G ProSe direct link with the target UE(s).

question_77496.question: What is the test purpose for testing that the MS reacts correctly when receiving a HANDOVER TO UTRAN COMMAND and the handover fails because of frequency not implemented?
question_77496.ground_truth: The test purpose is to ensure that the MS reactivates the old channel and transmits a HANDOVER FAILURE message to the network on the old channel in the GSM cell when the handover to UTRAN fails because of frequency not implemented.

question_77498.question: How is the total number of REs for PUSCH determined in the scenario when the UE is scheduled to transmit a transport block on PUSCH by a DCI and transform precoding is disabled?
question_77498.ground_truth: By multiplying the number of REs within the slot by the number of RBs assigned to the UE for the PUSCH transmission.

question_77500.question: What is the drawback of using a wideband transmitter with a limited carrier separation in terms of frequency planning?
question_77500.ground_truth: The drawback is that it can have a negative impact on the frequency diversity in the case of inter-carrier interleaving, due to the reduced carrier separation.

question_77501.question: What is the difference between granularity period and reporting period in the context of performance measurements?
question_77501.ground_truth: Granularity period refers to the sampling rate of performance measurements, determined by the producing application, while reporting period is the rate of collecting performance measurements, determined by the consuming application. The collection resolution is an integral multiple of the corresponding granularity.

question_77502.question: What should the 5G system be able to support for open standard based broadcast workflows?
question_77502.ground_truth: PR 5.6.6-010, PR 5.7.6-003, PR 5.7.6-005 (combined requirement from multiple use cases)

question_77503.question: What is the purpose of the GW Control and QoS Provision Procedure in the procedure for dedicated bearer activation with PMIP-based S5 or S8?
question_77503.ground_truth: The GW Control and QoS Provision Procedure is used to determine whether the BPCF will allocate resources for a new SDF/s.

question_77505.question: What is the Triple DES Encryption Plug-In used for?
question_77505.ground_truth: The Triple DES (Data Encryption Standard) Encryption Plug-In is used to encrypt arbitrary application-level data. It is typically called from a page to encrypt data before it is transmitted to a network application. This plug-in uses the Triple DES encryption algorithm to encrypt the data.

question_77506.question: What should the UE do if higher priority inter-RAT layers are found and the SServingCell of the E-UTRA serving cell is less than or equal to Snonintrasearch?
question_77506.ground_truth: The UE shall search for and measure inter-RAT layers of higher, equal or lower priority in preparation for possible reselection if the SServingCell of the E-UTRA serving cell is less than or equal to Snonintrasearch.

question_77507.question: What standard does CORBA follow for its data types and operations?
question_77507.ground_truth: CORBA follows the OMG Notification Service for its data types and operations. Specifically, the delta synchronization IS defines semantics of parameters carried in operations and notifications, and their mapping to OMG Notification Service-defined equivalents.

question_77508.question: What is described in requirement R-7.12.2-002 regarding an on-going MCX Service communication?
question_77508.ground_truth: Requirement R-7.12.2-002 states that the MCX Service should minimize the interruption to an on-going MCX Service communication when an MCX UE transitions its connection for that communication from on-network operation to off-network operation via a ProSe UE-to-UE relay.

question_77509.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 9.2.1JC.3 and 9.2.1JD.3?
question_77509.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify the ability of the receiver to receive a predefined test signal, representing a multi-path fading channel with information bit throughput not falling below a specified value. The test specifically stresses the multicode reception and channel decoding with incremental redundancy.

question_77511.question: What is the format of the UE-Measurement-Forwarding-ExtIEs NBAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION structure?
question_77511.ground_truth: The UE-Measurement-Forwarding-ExtIEs NBAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION structure is a sequence of at least one item, where each item is a set of extensions to the UE-Measurement-Forwarding-ExtIEs NBAP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION structure.

question_77513.question: What does the Location Exclude List indicator information element indicate?
question_77513.ground_truth: The Location Exclude List indicator information element is used to indicate which part of the Location Area Identification is to be added in the Location Exclude List.

question_77514.question: What is the purpose of SEALDD server and SEALDD client in the E2E redundant transmission path establishment with dual UE - dual UP architecture?
question_77514.ground_truth: SEALDD server and SEALDD client are responsible for dual-UP uplink and downlink traffic on SEALDD-UUs in the E2E redundant transmission path establishment with dual UE - dual UP architecture.

question_77515.question: What is the content of data for sPDSCH in the N-TM?
question_77515.ground_truth: The content of data for sPDSCH in the N-TM is 'all 0' data.

question_77516.question: What is the purpose of the DRA (redirect) in establishing Diameter sessions in non-roaming cases?
question_77516.ground_truth: The DRA (redirect) establishes Diameter sessions with the target PCRF node when the DRA client sends an external trigger requiring session establishment. The DRA (redirect) stores user information, creates a dynamic DRA binding, and sends a Diameter Answer with the target PCRF identity to the client. The client then resends the Diameter Establishment Request to the target PCRF node.

question_77517.question: In which message is the PDU Session Modification Command sent transparently through NG-RAN without the N2 SM information to inform the UE about changes in the QoS parameters that the NG-RAN is currently fulfilling?
question_77517.ground_truth: The N1 SM container is sent transparently through NG-RAN without the N2 SM information in the PDU Session Modification Command to inform the UE about changes in the QoS parameters that the NG-RAN is currently fulfilling.

question_77519.question: What is the downside of maintaining resources in the SGW after the MME restart detection?
question_77519.ground_truth: Maintaining resources in the SGW after the MME restart detection can lead to extra signalling over the S11 interface and may cause a new reattachment of the UE to the network.

question_77522.question: What should be used on RACH for handling the packet channel requests received than can be served?
question_77522.ground_truth: Packet Queuing Notification shall be transmitted to the sender of the Packet Channel Request

question_77523.question: When the SS (MCPTT Server) initiates an On-demand Pre-arranged Group Call with Manual Commencement Mode, what should the MCPTT client do if the user is authorized to restrict the reason for failure?
question_77523.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should respond with a SIP 480 (Temporarily unavailable) message, not including warning texts, if the user is authorized to restrict the reason for failure.

question_77526.question: In what scenarios is network slice usage control information provisioning/update/removal by the PCF not supported?
question_77526.ground_truth: This is not supported in roaming scenarios.

question_77529.question: What should the PDN GW do if it initiates the PDN GW Initiated Resource Allocation Deactivation procedure and supports the P-CSCF restoration procedure over WLAN access?
question_77529.ground_truth: The PGW should include the 3GPP Specific PMIPv6 error code IE and set it to the cause "Reactivation requested" in the LMA Initiated PDN Connection Deletion procedure.

question_77530.question: What action should the MS take when it receives a message that is too short to contain a complete message header and all mandatory information elements?
question_77530.ground_truth: The MS should ignore the message.

question_77532.question: What HTTP based solution set is included in the new Streaming data reporting MnS for streaming connection establishment and connection/stream meta-data exchange?
question_77532.ground_truth: The HTTP based solution set for streaming connection establishment and connection/stream meta-data exchange in the new Streaming data reporting MnS is RESTful HTTP.

question_77533.question: Which pre-condition is required for the transfer of incoming or ongoing voice communications: FRMCS User should be registered to a single or multiple FRMCS Equipment?

question_77534.question: What is the requirement for SSB for CBD measurement in the same OFDM symbol as CSI-RS for BFD on FR1?
question_77534.ground_truth: If SSB and CSI-RS have the same SCS, the UE should be able to measure the SSB for CBD measurement without any restrictions. If SSB and CSI-RS have different SCS-es, different requirements apply based on the UE capabilities.

question_77535.question: How many bits is the Data Volume (DV) field in the Data Volume and Power Headroom Report (DPR) MAC control element?
question_77535.ground_truth: The Data Volume (DV) field in the Data Volume and Power Headroom Report (DPR) MAC control element is 4 bits.

question_77536.question: What action does the UE take when it receives a PLMN not allowed message and supports A/Gb mode or Iu mode?
question_77536.ground_truth: The UE handles the GMM parameters as specified in 3GPP TS 24.008 for the case when a DETACH REQUEST is received with the GMM cause with the same value and with detach type set to "re-attach not required".

question_77537.question: What is the condition for P to be equal to 1, when CSI-RS is partially overlapped with measurement gap and SMTC occasion is partially overlapped with measurement gap?
question_77537.ground_truth: The condition for P to be equal to 1 is when CSI-RS is partially overlapped with measurement gap, CSI-RS is fully overlapped with SMTC occasion and SMTC occasion is partially overlapped with measurement gap.

question_77538.question: What should the UE include in the Request-URI of the INVITE request after a successful initial emergency registration?
question_77538.ground_truth: The UE should include a service URN in the Request-URI of the INVITE request in accordance with subclause~5.1.6.8.1 after a successful initial emergency registration.

question_77540.question: Which reference point enables transport of service data flow based offline charging information?
question_77540.ground_truth: The Gz reference point allows transport of service data flow based offline charging information from the PCEF to the OFCS.

question_77541.question: What is the objective of enhancing Radio Access Network (RAN) slicing for NR in the 3rd Generation Partnership Project Technical Specification Group RAN study?
question_77541.ground_truth: The objective is to enable fast access to the cell supporting the intended slice and to support service continuity.

question_77542.question: Which Solution Set definitions are defined in the specification?
question_77542.ground_truth: The 3GPP Generic IRP management CORBA SS and 3GPP Generic IRP management SOAP Solution Set.

question_77543.question: What is the benefit of using Incremental Redundancy in EGPRS and Turbo coded logical channels?
question_77543.ground_truth: It provides more accurate throughput simulation for EGPRS and Turbo coded logical channels.

question_77544.question: What should a UE not expect to have in the same slot for each cell when performing DAPS operation in the same frequency band?
question_77544.ground_truth: A UE should not expect to have USS sets on both the target MCG and the source MCG that result in the number of monitored PDCCH candidates and the total number of non-overlapped CCEs in both cells that each exceed the corresponding maximum numbers per slot.

question_77545.question: What should the SS check, after sending a PROGRESS message containing indication of in-band information availability to the MS, when the TCH is in speech mode?
question_77545.ground_truth: The SS checks that the TCH is through connected

question_77550.question: What is the role of the PIN server in handling the service switch in Solution #8?
question_77550.ground_truth: The PIN server in Solution #8 selects the PIN Applications in PINE and instructs the PIN Management Client to execute the service switch procedure. It sends information about the Application Session ID, Destination PINE, and end-point information to the PEMC Client.

question_77551.question: What is the minimum requirement for Pico BTS in terms of maximum power measured at step b)?
question_77551.ground_truth: The minimum requirement for Pico BTS in terms of maximum power measured at step b) is -62 dBm.

question_77552.question: What is the impact of deployment scenarios on the TAE at the UE?
question_77552.ground_truth: The TAE at the UE depends on the differences in signal arrival time at the UE due to differences in distance between the transmission points and the UE, which in turn depends on the deployment scenario. Different deployment scenarios, such as intra base station or separated transmission points, can have different effects on the TAE at the UE.

question_77553.question: What should the ME do if the UICC responds with '62 XX' or '63 XX' when sending a USSD message?
question_77553.ground_truth: The ME should acknowledge the receipt of the USSD message to the network using a FACILITY message, including the status word and response data from the UICC in the USSD String of the return result component.

question_77554.question: What actions does the BCC entity in the MS take when it receives a TERMINATION REJECT message and is in the U5 state?
question_77554.ground_truth: When the BCC entity in the MS receives a TERMINATION REJECT message and is in the U5 state, it informs higher layers and stops Tterm.

question_77555.question: What is the purpose of the PC5 link establishment procedure with L3 UE-to-Network relay in this solution?
question_77555.ground_truth: The PC5 link establishment procedure with L3 UE-to-Network relay is used to establish a secure link between a Remote UE and a network for the purpose of performing a PDU Session with secondary A&A using an existing PDU session that requires secondary authentication.

question_77556.question: What should an SMF do when it receives an HTTP PUT request with an expiry time equal to or less than the expiry time received in the request?
question_77556.ground_truth: The SMF shall select an expiry time that is equal to or less than the expiry time received in the request.

question_77557.question: What is the structure of the PDUSessionResourceFailedToSetupListPSReq data type, which is a sequence of PDUSessionResourceFailedToSetupItemPSReq?
question_77557.ground_truth: Each instance of PDUSessionResourceFailedToSetupItemPSReq contains a PDUSessionID, a PathSwitchRequestSetupFailedTransfer, and an optional ProtocolExtensionContainer.

question_77558.question: If a UE indicates a capability to transmit a PUCCH with HARQ-ACK information using repetitions, how does the UE determine the number of slots for repetitions of a PUCCH transmission with HARQ-ACK information?
question_77558.ground_truth: The UE determines the number of slots for repetitions based on an indication by numberOfPUCCHforMsg4HARQACK-RepetitionsList.

question_77561.question: What is the role of the discover MBS session request in this process?
question_77561.ground_truth: The discover MBS session request is sent by the MC service server 1 to several other MC service servers to determine if there is an MBS session available in a specific MBS service area with the requested bandwidth.

question_77562.question: What must the business trunking application do when it receives a terminating request for an NGCN?
question_77562.ground_truth: The business trunking application shall identify the particular NGCN the enterprise user belongs to, and also the P-CSCF(s) or IBCF(s), respectively serving the NGCN, and shall forward the request towards the NGCN. Therefore, the business trunking application shall create a route to the NGCN by adding a SIP URI of the P-CSCF or IBCF, respectively serving the NGCN and the NGCN in a Route header field as bottommost entries.

question_77564.question: What protocol is used for securing communication between the user equipment (UE) and the intranet when data is transmitted over an insecure network, such as the Internet?
question_77564.ground_truth: The Intranet Protocol is used to ensure security between the UE and the intranet when data is transmitted over an insecure network. This protocol is responsible for user authentication and encryption of user data.

question_77565.question: What should the CRNC do if the Reset Indicator IE is set to "Node B" in the RESET REQUEST message from the Node B?
question_77565.ground_truth: The CRNC shall remove the information related to this Node B and all the radio resources allocated in the CRNC. The CRNC shall also initiate release of the user plane transport bearers towards the Node B involved in the CRNC Communication Contexts related to this Node B. After clearing all related resources, the CRNC shall return the RESET RESPONSE message to the Node B.

question_77566.question: After how many attempts will the initiating UE abort the 5G ProSe direct link establishment procedure if it does not receive a PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT message?
question_77566.ground_truth: The maximum number of allowed retransmissions is UE implementation specific.

question_77567.question: In the context of phonebook options, what is the difference between a Global Phone Book and a Local Phone Book?
question_77567.ground_truth: A Global Phone Book is accessible to all UICC applications while a Local Phone Book is only accessible to the USIM application.

question_77568.question: What happens during the user/UE accessing services provided by PIN devices?
question_77568.ground_truth: Based on the location of the UE, the communication method connecting the UE and PIN Element vary. When the user is out of home, the 5G network connects the UE and the PIN Element behind the PIN Element with gateway Capability. When the user is at home, the PIN Element with gateway Capability discovers and connects the UE via PIN direct connection or direct device connection.

question_77571.question: What is the UE requirement for intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation with one uplink carrier and two or more downlink sub-blocks, as specified in subclause 7.8.1F?
question_77571.ground_truth: The UE shall meet the requirements for each sub-block as specified in subclauses 7.8.1.1 and in this subclause for one component carrier and two or more component carriers per sub-block, respectively, with requirements applying for out-of-gap interferers while all downlink carriers are active.

question_77572.question: What is the applicability of the frequency error test in step 5.3C and 5.3D?
question_77572.ground_truth: The frequency error requirements and tests in step 5.3C and 5.3D apply for Release 11 and later releases to all types of UTRA for the FDD UE that support UL CLTD.

question_77573.question: What is the purpose of the "a=rtcp-fb" line with a "pause" CCM parameter in the SDP offer/answer?
question_77573.ground_truth: The "a=rtcp-fb" line with a "pause" CCM parameter in the SDP offer/answer is used to indicate to the MRFP which RTCP feedback "CCM PAUSE-RESUME" messages it may send to the conference participant and to indicate the full "RTP-level pause and resume" functionality that will be offered.

question_77574.question: In the process of encoding 5 pulses in a section, how are the 3 pulses in that section encoded?
question_77574.ground_truth: The 3 pulses in that section are encoded using 3(M-1)+1 bits in each section.

question_77575.question: What are the conditions that must be met for the inter-frequency relative CSI-RSRP measurement accuracy requirements to be valid?
question_77575.ground_truth: The conditions include the transmission of CSI reference signals in discovery signal occasions on one antenna port only from each TP, the fulfillment of conditions defined in 36.101 Clause 7.3 for reference sensitivity, the measurement of CSI-RSRP as specified in Annex B.3.24.3 for a corresponding Band, and the absence of MBSFN subframes in the discovery signal occasion. Additionally, the measured channels or TPs must include at least one operating under frame structure 3, and the difference in CSI-RSRP must be 20 dB.

question_77577.question: What is the implication of using the first option for UL DPCCH slot format optimization, removing TFCI fields?
question_77577.ground_truth: TFCI need not be carried on the UL DPCCH anymore, preserving the ability to achieve 1 slot delay for the inner-loop power control in downlink.

question_77578.question: What XML schema should be used for defining user data in the Confirmation of Manual Service Operation (CONF) service in 3GPP TS 24.605?
question_77578.ground_truth: No user data is defined for 3GPP TS 24.605 subclause 4.16.1. The operator part of the CONF service does not contain any user-defined data.

question_77580.question: What action does the MS take upon receiving the DTM ASSIGNMENT COMMAND message?
question_77580.ground_truth: Upon receiving the DTM ASSIGNMENT COMMAND message, the MS moves to the new allocation, reconnects the CS resources, passes the ASSIGNMENT COMPLETE message to the SS on the main DCCH and starts to send RLC DATA BLOCKS to the SS on the assigned TBF.

question_77581.question: What are the initial conditions for performing the procedure described in section 7.2.3.3.1.8?
question_77581.ground_truth: The UE is operated under normal test conditions, and the Test-USIM is inserted in the UE.

question_77582.question: What features should the E-UTRAN support for the V2N MNO if requested?
question_77582.ground_truth: The E-UTRAN should support anonymity, privacy, and integrity protection of communication for V2N applications if requested by the V2N MNO.

question_77584.question: What is the procedure for protecting IPX provider modified attributes?
question_77584.ground_truth: The IPX providers use JSON Web Signature (JWS) with asymmetric methods and private/public key pairs to integrity protect the modifiedDataToIntegrityProtect object.

question_77587.question: What is the purpose of the UTRAN Cell Identifier List and UTRAN Received Signal Level List information elements?
question_77587.ground_truth: The UTRAN Cell Identifier List and UTRAN Received Signal Level List information elements are used to rank UTRAN cells in descending order of received signal level when requesting handover to a UTRAN cell.

question_77588.question: What does the UDM do when it receives a Send Routing Info for SM request from SMS-SC or SMS GMSC?
question_77588.ground_truth: The UDM retrieves the SMSF address from 5GS UDR and forwards the MAP Send Routing Info for SM request to HSS FE to query more routing addresses for MT SMS.

question_77590.question: In the context of FDD, what should the Node B do if the Serving Cell Change CFN IE is not included in the RADIO LINK ADDITION REQUEST message?
question_77590.ground_truth: The Node B shall activate immediately the resources that are allocated for the new serving E-DCH Radio Link.

question_77591.question: How many spare bit locations does the E-HICH contain?
question_77591.ground_truth: The E-HICH contains 8 spare bit locations.

question_77592.question: What security mechanism header field parameter is used to distinguish media plane security mechanisms?

question_77593.question: What is the impact of the PLMN environment on the T.30 protocol procedure?
question_77593.ground_truth: In the PLMN environment, some additional protection is necessary in the T.30 protocol procedure to ensure a correct change-over from one modem type to another, especially during two consecutive segments that require different transmission speeds without any interposed acknowledgement.

question_77594.question: What should the UE do with the precondition mechanism after receiving a response with an SDP body that includes the "precondition" option-tag in the Require header field?
question_77594.ground_truth: The UE should include the "precondition" option-tag in the Require header field in subsequent requests that include an SDP body in the same dialog and in responses with an SDP body to subsequent requests that include an SDP body with "precondition" option-tag in the Supported header field or Require header field received in-dialog.

question_77595.question: What is the function of the up-sampling module in the SHVC two-layer spatial scalability encoder architecture?
question_77595.ground_truth: The up-sampling module maps reconstructed sample values from the base layer to the higher-resolution sampling grid of the enhancement layer, allowing the use of the reconstructed base layer sample values for enhancement layer prediction.

question_77596.question: What is the purpose of the "Last Visited PSCell Information" IE in the context of 3GPP radio access networks?
question_77596.ground_truth: The "Last Visited PSCell Information" IE contains cell-specific information related to CN paging subgrouping for a specific UE in 3GPP radio access networks.

question_77597.question: What is the formula used to calculate nrs-Power in the determination of the downlink path loss estimate in dB for serving cell?
question_77597.ground_truth: nrs-Power is provided by higher layers and Clause 16.2.2 for serving cell.

question_77598.question: What indicator is used in the Proxy Binding Acknowledgement when deferred IPv4 address allocation is allowed and a new IPv4 address is not assigned during initial attach procedure?
question_77598.ground_truth: The DHCPv4 Address Allocation Procedure Indication is returned in the Proxy Binding Acknowledgement.

question_77599.question: When is the CA duplication deactivated for a DRB in a MAC entity?
question_77599.ground_truth: When none or only one of RLC entities of the DRB in the MAC entity remains activated.

question_77601.question: What is the time duration between the initial transmission of one transport block (TB) and the corresponding ACK/NACK complete decoding, referred to as d?
question_77601.ground_truth: d is the time duration between the initial transmission of one transport block (TB) and the corresponding ACK/NACK complete decoding.

question_77602.question: What are the conditions for being able to apply the pattern multiplication method for TRP estimation?
question_77602.ground_truth: The conditions for being able to apply the pattern multiplication method for TRP estimation include the vertical cut (and the main beam) being in the xz-plane, the frequency of the emission being within the downlink operating band, the bandwidth of the emission being the same as the bandwidth of the in-band modulated signal, the emission appearing/disappearing when the TX power is turned on/off, and the antenna arrays of the BS having rectangular grids of antenna element positions, symmetry planes that are vertical and horizontal, and parallel antenna planes.

question_77604.question: How are subband CQI values encoded when reported for each codeword?
question_77604.ground_truth: Subband CQI values are encoded differentially with respect to their respective wideband CQI values using 2-bits as defined by Subband differential CQI offset level = subband CQI index - wideband CQI index.

question_77606.question: What information is assigned to each of the SR5 service elements to support operation over different PC5 RATs?
question_77606.ground_truth: Each of the SR5 service elements is assigned a V2X Service Type (e.g. PSID, ITS-AID, or AID) and a ProSe Identifier (e.g. Application ID) to support the operation over different PC5 RATs.

question_77607.question: What are some existing features that partly or fully cover the use case functionality of using satellite connectivity to aid in terrestrial network planning?
question_77607.ground_truth: Some existing features include Relay UE/relay node that supports terrestrial connectivity to UEs and connects to non-terrestrial access networks, and the ability to trigger a subset of MDT procedures for collecting UE-specific measurements.

question_77608.question: What is required for an FRMCS User to initiate a video conference?
question_77608.ground_truth: An FRMCS User can initiate a video conference if they are an authorized user, and there is a bearer service established by the FRMCS System for the video conference.

question_77609.question: What is one solution for achieving synchronization between neighboring base stations?
question_77609.ground_truth: One solution is to detect reference signals transmitted over the air and calculate propagation delays from synchronization source to synchronization target. This is done by messages requesting and responding to synchronization procedures between the neighboring base stations.

question_77610.question: What are the post-conditions of a successful video conference?
question_77610.ground_truth: The post-conditions of a successful video conference are that real-time video (synchronized video and audio information) can be transmitted and received among authorized FRMCS Users involved in the ongoing video conference.

question_77611.question: What happens when the CBCF receives a RESTART-INDICATION-NG-RAN message shortly after a preceding one with the same Restarted Cell List NG-RAN included in both messages?
question_77611.ground_truth: The CBCF considers the RESTART-INDICATION-NG-RAN as a duplicate message and ignores it.

question_77613.question: How is a global ML model generated in Federated Learning among multiple NWDAFs containing MTLF?
question_77613.ground_truth: In Federated Learning among multiple NWDAFs containing MTLF, the FL server NWDAF generates global ML model by aggregating local model information from FL client NWDAFs. It sends the global ML model back to FL client NWDAFs and repeats training iteration if needed.

question_77615.question: What is the role of the HSS/AuC in the synchronization failure mechanism described in subsection 6.3.5?
question_77615.ground_truth: The HSS/AuC acts as a mediator in the synchronization failure mechanism described in subsection 6.3.5 by retrieving the SQNMS from the USIM, verifying AUTS, resetting the SQNHE to SQNMS, and sending a new batch of authentication vectors to the VLR/SGSN.

question_77619.question: What is the role of RTP / RTCP in a TP UE in relation to CLUE?
question_77619.ground_truth: No media handling requirements and recommendations have been specified in TS 24.103 for a TP UE regarding the usage of RTP / RTCP in relation to negotiation and establishment of the CLUE data channel.

question_77620.question: In the procedure for actions upon reception of SIB2, when should the UE apply the p-Max?
question_77620.ground_truth: In the procedure for actions upon reception of SIB2, the UE should apply the p-Max in step 2, if the UE does not support at least one additionalSpectrumEmission within the frequencyBandList; in step 3, if the UE does not select a frequency band for the supplementary uplink; and in step 4, if the UE does not support at least one additionalSpectrumEmission within the frequencyBandListSUL. Additionally, the UE should apply the p-Max for SUL in step 6, if the additionalPmax is not present in the same entry of the selected additionalSpectrumEmission within nr-NS-PmaxList for the supplementary uplink.

question_77622.question: Which procedure is applied for redundant I-UPF or redundant N3/N9 tunnels for URLLC in Service Request procedures from 3GPP access?
question_77622.ground_truth: The procedure in clause~4.2.3.2 is applied for this scenario.

question_77625.question: How does the UDM/SIDF handle the concealed CAG ID in the 5G system?
question_77625.ground_truth: The UDM/SIDF is responsible for de-concealing the CAG ID from the integrated SUCI if the UE generated the SUCI with adding CAG ID to the scheme-input. Or the UDM/SIDF is responsible for de-concealing the CAG ID from the concealed SUCI using the same mechanism of decealing SUPI from SUCI.

question_77626.question: What happens to the MA PDU Session when UE moves from 5GS to EPS in idle mode or connected mobility and the PDN connection is moved to EPS as well?
question_77626.ground_truth: The SMF triggers PDU Session Release procedure to release the MA PDU Session over Non-3GPP access.

question_77627.question: What is one of the functions provided by the Visited Policy Control Function (V-PCF) to the visited network as NF service producer?
question_77627.ground_truth: The Visited Policy Control Function (V-PCF) provides functions such as receiving policy control request triggers and/or UE policy (e.g. ANDSP, URSP, V2XP, A2XP, ProSeP, RSLPP) from the H-PCF, and reporting the UE state and UE policy enforcement result to the H-PCF.

question_77628.question: When is the UE not required to conduct reception/transmission from/to the corresponding serving cells during the gap occasion for a per-UE Pre-MG pattern as per the network-controlled or autonomous activation/deactivation mechanism?
question_77628.ground_truth: If the per-UE Pre-MG pattern is activated then the UE is not required to conduct reception/transmission from/to the corresponding serving cells during the gap occasion, otherwise, the UE can be scheduled for reception/transmission of signals in all the serving cells during the gap occasion.

question_77629.question: What is required for storing EAP-AKA credentials in the H(e)NB's Trusted Environment (TrE)?
question_77629.ground_truth: The EAP-AKA credentials for device authentication must be stored in an irremovable Trusted Environment of the H(e)NB, whereas for the hosting party authentication, the credentials are stored on a Host Party Module (HPM).

question_77630.question: What action does the MCVideo server take after replacing the list of MCVideo group information entries in the served MCVideo client information entry with the candidate list?
question_77630.ground_truth: The MCVideo server performs the procedures specified in clause 8.2.2.2.6 for the served MCVideo ID and each MCVideo group ID that has an MCVideo group information entry in the candidate list with an affiliation status of "affiliating."

question_77631.question: What action does the TRAU take when it receives the first uplink frame for a FR or EFR speech or data call?
question_77631.ground_truth: The TRAU sets the mode of operation accordingly and sends downlink frames with the set "Frame Type" and intermediate rate adaption bit rate as an acknowledgement indication.

question_77632.question: Which HTTP method is supported by the All service API invocation logs resource, as per 8.8.2.2.3.1?
question_77632.ground_truth: The GET method is supported by the All service API invocation logs resource, as per 8.8.2.2.3.1.

question_77633.question: How can the Edge Application Server request specific QoS from the 3GPP network?
question_77633.ground_truth: The Edge Application Server can request specific QoS from the 3GPP network by using the Nnef_AFsessionWithQoS_Create service operation and Nnef_AFsessionWithQoS_Notify service operation in TS23.502.

question_77634.question: What is the number of redundancy versions in ARQ_MAX?

question_77637.question: What is the function of an application server in the context of 6.2.2?
question_77637.ground_truth: An application server may be included for a CSI call, but it is not assigned any specific CSI role.

question_77638.question: What is the role of the MC service server of the primary MC system in the affiliation procedure?
question_77638.ground_truth: The MC service server of the primary MC system checks the MC service client's authorization to affiliate to the requested MC service group and the maximum number of MC service groups the client can be affiliated to. It also sends group affiliation requests to the corresponding MC service server of the partner MC system if necessary.

question_77641.question: What is the dominant factor for NB-IoT operation when considering SINR degradation in the co-existence study?
question_77641.ground_truth: The UE ACLR is the dominant factor for NB-IoT operation when considering SINR degradation in the co-existence study.

question_77642.question: When does the 3GP-DASH client initiate a Network Assistance session with the DANE?
question_77642.ground_truth: The 3GP-DASH client initiates a Network Assistance session with the Network Assistance DANE at a convenient stage in the process of preparing to receive the content, and it ends when the playback of that content item stops.

question_77643.question: In what scenarios is the AN-GW-Address AVP included in the CCA command sent by the H-PCRF to the V-PCRF?
question_77643.ground_truth: The AN-GW-Address AVP is included in the CCA command sent by the H-PCRF to the V-PCRF if the PCC rules are applicable only for a single BBERF in the CCA command.

question_77644.question: What is the delay element in step 9 of the RACH procedure in the interruption time?
question_77644.ground_truth: The delay element in step 9 of the RACH procedure in the interruption time is 1 subframe required for PRACH preamble transmission.

question_77645.question: What is the purpose of the S-CSCF adding an "fe-addr" element of the "fe-identifier" header field parameter to the P-Charging-Vector header field?
question_77645.ground_truth: The purpose is to add its own address or identifier if not already available to support charging purposes.

question_77646.question: What is the maximum number of active transmitter units that can be considered when calculating the emissions limit for an AAS BS in single RAT UTRA operation and UTRA only MSR AAS BS?
question_77646.ground_truth: The maximum number of active transmitter units that can be considered is four times the number of cells.

question_77647.question: What is the method to perform the HARQ bit collection in the case of HS-DSCH?
question_77647.ground_truth: The HARQ bit collection is done using a rectangular interleaver, which is determined based on the number of rows and columns, which varies depending on the modulation mode used. Sequential Write operation is used to read values column by column, and transmitted systematic bits are written row by row. The remaining space is filled with parity bits written column-wise and in alternating order.

question_77648.question: What is the purpose of the test described in 9.1.61.2?
question_77648.ground_truth: The purpose of the test is to verify that CSI-RSRP measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for SCells operating under frame structure 3.

question_77649.question: What should the UE do during T3 if it doesn't send at least one CSI report for PSCell with a non-zero CQI index?
question_77649.ground_truth: The UE should increase the number of failed iterations by one, switch off the UE and continue to step 11.

question_77650.question: What are the parameters used in E-DCH Scheduling Information in the standard?
question_77650.ground_truth: The E-DCH Scheduling Information parameters include: Logical channels for which Scheduling Information is expected to be reported by the UE, Logical channel identity of logical channels mapped to E-DCH, Period for sending Scheduling Information (applicable when UE is not allowed to transmit scheduled data), Period for sending Scheduling Information (applicable when UE is allowed to transmit scheduled data), and for FDD, power offset to use when sending Scheduling Information alone.

question_77651.question: What is the purpose of the User Data Convergence (UDC) in the 3GPP system?
question_77651.ground_truth: The User Data Convergence (UDC) in the 3GPP system supports a layered architecture, separating the data from the application logic, and stores user data in a logically unique repository allowing access from core and service layer entities, named application front-ends.

question_77652.question: What is the name of the complex type defined in the schema that allows any XML attribute to be used in the future?

question_77653.question: What is the motivation for considering the option to support 2 CC DL CA with either 1 CC or 2 CC UL at the UE?
question_77653.ground_truth: The motivation is to potentially give some flexibility to UE vendors regarding the trade-off between cost and performance, depending on the type of UE and the applications or usage scenarios it may be targeted at supporting.

question_77654.question: What is the primary goal of the flow control procedure?
question_77654.ground_truth: The flow control procedure is used to regulate traffic flow for TRX processor overload, downlink CCCH overload, and ACCH overload.

question_77657.question: What is the role of SMF in providing QoS rule(s) for a Multi-Access PDU Session?
question_77657.ground_truth: The SMF provides QoS rule(s) to the UE when a Multi-Access PDU Session is established. These rules are used for the classification and marking of UL User plane traffic, based on QoS flows, which are access agnostic.

question_77659.question: What should be passed to higher layers (MAC) as L1 status if a positive acquisition indicator on AICH is detected in the downlink access slot corresponding to the selected uplink access slot?
question_77659.ground_truth: Pass L1 status (''Ack on AICH received'') with the default E-DCH resource index corresponding to the selected signature.

question_77660.question: What action does the gsmSSF take if it encounters a TDP and call gapping hasn't been initiated for the same gsmSCF or for any call gapping without a provided gsmSCFAddress?
question_77660.ground_truth: The gsmSSF may send an "InitialDP" operation.

question_77661.question: Which ID has a criticality value of "reject" and a presence indicator of "mandatory" in the MBMSSessionStartRequest-IEs?
question_77661.ground_truth: id-MME-MBMS-M3AP-ID, id-TMGI, id-MBMS-E-RAB-QoS-Parameters, id-MBMS-Session-Duration, id-MBMS-Service-Area, id-MinimumTimeToMBMSDataTransfer, and id-MBMS-Cell-List have a criticality value of "reject" and a presence indicator of "mandatory" in the MBMSSessionStartRequest-IEs.

question_77662.question: In what scenario can a UE trigger a Mobility Registration Update to switch traffic from an old non-3GPP access to a new non-3GPP access?
question_77662.ground_truth: When the UE supports non-3GPP access path switching, the AMF has indicated support for it, and the PLMN of the selected new non-3GPP access is the same as the old one.

question_77663.question: What must the NF Service Producer support in the inter-PLMN scenario for Key Issue #7 solution?
question_77663.ground_truth: The NF Service Producer must support whichever authorization mechanism is determined by the hNRF.

question_77664.question: What message does the SGSN send to the MS to confirm the re-allocation of the new P-TMSI?
question_77664.ground_truth: Routing Area Update Accept (P-TMSI, TMSI, P-TMSI signature, Receive N-PDU number) message

question_77665.question: When does the S-GW include the current values for HeNB local IP address and UDP port number in a Modify Bearer Request over S5/S8?
question_77665.ground_truth: The S-GW includes the current values for HeNB local IP address and UDP port if the UE is accessing the network from a HeNB for any other reason not listed in the procedure.

question_77666.question: When is the Match Report procedure skipped in step 5?
question_77666.ground_truth: The Match Report procedure is skipped in step 5 when the Target RPAUID, corresponding to the ProSe Restricted Code in the Discovery Filter, is included in the Discovery Response message.

question_77667.question: Which protocol element is optional in "DSCH-InformationResponseList-RL-AdditionRspTDD-RL-AdditionRspTDD" sequence?

question_77668.question: What should the UE do if it does not receive the extended idle mode DRX parameters information element in the relevant accept message from the MME?
question_77668.ground_truth: The UE shall apply its regular discontinuous reception as defined in clause~5.13.

question_77669.question: What is the minimum number of inter-frequency cells that a UE shall be capable of performing RSRP and RSRQ measurements for in the E-UTRAN TDD-TDD inter frequency measurements test?
question_77669.ground_truth: The UE shall be capable of performing RSRP and RSRQ measurements of at least 4 inter-frequency cells per TDD inter-frequency.

question_77670.question: What is the definition of "Transmission delay" as outlined in the document?
question_77670.ground_truth: Transmission delay is the time it takes to transfer a given piece of data between two nodes, measured from the moment it is transmitted to the moment it is received, without assuming correct reception. This concept does not include processing time.

question_77674.question: What is the value of in-channel sub-band selectivity agreed upon for modeling the inter-sub-band selectivity?

question_77676.question: In the context of FDD, what should the Node B do if the DL Reference Power IE, the E-AGCH Power Offset IE, the E-RGCH PowerOffset IE, and/or the E-HICH Power Offset IE are present in the Multicell E-DCH RL Specific Information IE in the Additional E-DCH RL Specific Information To Add IE, or if the DL Reference Power IE, the Primary CPICH Usage For Channel Estimation IE, the Secondary CPICH Information Change IE, the E-AGCH Power Offset IE, the E-RGCH Power Offset IE, the E-HICH Power Offset IE and/or the E-DCH DL Control Channel Grant IE are present in the Multicell E-DCH RL Specific Information IE in the Additional E-DCH RL Specific Information To Modify IE?
question_77676.ground_truth: The Node B should use the information the same way as in the information is used on the Primary uplink frequency.

question_77678.question: What triggers the ePDG to initiate the release of resources on the WLAN in the network-initiated removal of WLAN access from the PDN connection?
question_77678.ground_truth: The trigger can be operator intervention or other factors such as Dead Peer Detection.

question_77679.question: What is the condition for a successful test case in the test procedure?
question_77679.ground_truth: A successful test case is when the overall delays measured (time from the beginning of time period T2 to the moment the UE sends an Event A3 triggered measurement report) is less than 1002 ms.

question_77680.question: What should be added to the MCData client ID list in the served MCData user information entry?
question_77680.ground_truth: The MCData client ID derived from the received SIP request, if it is not already present.

question_77681.question: What input is important for activating a radio network?
question_77681.ground_truth: The important input for activating a radio network includes SAI, TMGI, GBR, and the time when it shall be active.

question_77684.question: What should the SCC AS take into account when determining the g.3gpp.accesstype media feature tag values to use in the SIP INVITE request?
question_77684.ground_truth: The SCC AS should take into account the access-type, access-class of the P-Access-Network-Info header field and the value of the g.3gpp.accesstype media feature tag to determine the IP-CAN to use.

question_77685.question: What action should the UE take when it receives a NOTIFY indicating that the transferee and the transfer Target have successfully setup a communication?
question_77685.ground_truth: The UE may terminate the original communication with the transferee UE by sending a BYE message on the original dialog.

question_77686.question: When should a MS return a status message with cause #97 "message type non-existent or not implemented" when receiving a message in acknowledged mode?
question_77686.ground_truth: When the message is not defined for the PD or not implemented by the receiver.

question_77687.question: What is the purpose of the measurement "Number of PDU Sessions successfully setup"?
question_77687.ground_truth: This measurement provides the number of PDU Sessions successfully setup by the N3IWF for the PDU SESSION RESOURCE SETUP REQUESTs received from AMF, and it is split into subcounters per S-NSSAI.

question_77688.question: What is the purpose of NR Enhanced Cell ID (NR E-CID) positioning methods?
question_77688.ground_truth: NR E-CID positioning refers to techniques which use UE and/or NR radio resource related measurements to improve the UE location estimate.

question_77689.question: What is the meaning of "5G-GUTI" in 3GPP TS 23.003?
question_77689.ground_truth: 5G-GUTI is an abbreviation for 5G Globally Unique Temporary Identifier, defined in 3GPP TS 23.003.

question_77690.question: What are the conformance requirements specified for this test case?
question_77690.ground_truth: The conformance requirements for this test case are specified in TS 38.214 clauses 6.1.2.1 and 6.1.4, and TS 38.321 clauses 5.4.1, 5.4.2.1 and 5.4.2.2, and are applicable as Rel-17 requirements.

question_77692.question: What is the maximum number of TimeSlots that can be specified in the TimeslotInfo-CellSyncInitiationRqstTDD field?
question_77692.ground_truth: The maximum number of TimeSlots that can be specified in the TimeslotInfo-CellSyncInitiationRqstTDD field is 15.

question_77693.question: What should the UE do if the Contention Resolution Timer expires when performing a random access procedure?
question_77693.ground_truth: The UE needs to re-select a preamble and transmit with the calculated PRACH transmission power when the backoff time expires if the Contention Resolution Timer expires.

question_77694.question: What is the second step in switching from a controlling MCPTT function mode to a non-controlling MCPTT function mode?
question_77694.ground_truth: The second step is for the controlling MCPTT function to start acting as a non-controlling MCPTT function. The floor control server sends a Floor Request message for each queued floor request, stores the active floor request queue in a passive floor request queue, and performs specified actions.

question_77695.question: What is the definition of "eNB" in the context of E-UTRA Layer 2 measurements?
question_77695.ground_truth: In the E-UTRA Layer 2 measurements document, eNB stands for "Evolved NodeB" and is used to refer to the radio access point in the E-UTRA network, specifically the base station that communicates with UEs.

question_77696.question: What are the scenarios for LTE V2X sidelink communication and NR sidelink communication?
question_77696.ground_truth: The scenarios can be categorized into standalone and MR-DC scenarios, with the standalone scenarios supporting LTE V2X sidelink communication and NR sidelink communication through gNB, ng-eNB, and eNB. The MR-DC scenarios support LTE V2X sidelink communication and NR sidelink communication through Uu, NGEN-DC, and EN-DC.

question_77697.question: What is a reasonable target for vertical accuracy in the 5G System's positioning service?
question_77697.ground_truth: A vertical accuracy in the range 2.5m seems a reasonable target.

question_77698.question: What is the expected behavior of a RedCap UE when identifying CGI of an NR cell with autonomous gaps in section 16.6.5.0.1 of the document?
question_77698.ground_truth: When a RedCap UE is identifying CGI of an NR cell with autonomous gaps, the UE is not expected to transmit PUCCH/PUSCH/SRS or receive PDCCH/PDSCH/TRS/CSI-RS for CQI on PCell for the following slots specified in section 16.6.5.0.1 of the document.

question_77703.question: What is the significance of the version numbering system used in the 3GPP technical specifications?
question_77703.ground_truth: The version numbering system indicates the level of approval and changes made to the document. A version number with a first digit of "3" or greater indicates a TSG approved document under change control.

question_77705.question: What is the role of the AS in providing the OCB service?
question_77705.ground_truth: The AS provides the OCB service by operating as a SIP proxy, a 3rd party call controller, or a terminating UA, depending on the scenario, to manage outgoing communications based on the user's defined barring program.

question_77706.question: What is the frequency limit for the second harmonics of Band 39, Band 39 and Band 41 in LTE Advanced 3 Band Carrier Aggregation (3DL/1UL)?
question_77706.ground_truth: The second harmonics of Band 39, Band 39 and Band 41 in LTE Advanced 3 Band Carrier Aggregation (3DL/1UL) may fall to UL frequencies of Band 43.

question_77707.question: What should the eNB do if the X2 Removal Threshold IE is included in the EN-DC X2 REMOVAL REQUEST message?
question_77707.ground_truth: If supported, the candidate eNB should accept to remove the interface instance with the en-gNB if the X2 Benefit Value of the interface instance determined at the candidate eNB is lower than the value of the X2 Removal Threshold IE.

question_77708.question: What is the function of the "precondition" mechanism in the scenario described?
question_77708.ground_truth: The "precondition" mechanism is a negotiation mechanism that allows the user agent to negotiate the media parameters for a session before the session is established. It allows the user agent to specify the codecs that it supports and the parameters that it needs for the session. The user agent can use the "precondition" mechanism to request that the other party supports specific codecs or parameters before the session is established.

question_77709.question: How are congestion related packet drops handled for services using a Non-GBR QCI?
question_77709.ground_truth: Services using a Non-GBR QCI should be prepared to experience congestion related packet drops, except for QCI 80. For services using QCI 80, more than 2 percent of packets might exceed the PDB of QCI 80 due to its low latency objective.

question_77710.question: What is one of the benefits of in-network caching and storage in PP networks?
question_77710.ground_truth: One benefit of in-network caching and storage in PP networks is that it allows operators to dimension their network and backhaul more efficiently.

question_77711.question: What is the purpose of using the Session ID in the file download delivery process?
question_77711.ground_truth: The MBMS Identity field can be used by the BM-SC and terminal to establish an n-to-m mapping between the files of a file download sessions and their corresponding MBMS bearer sessions over which the files are transported.

question_77712.question: What is the procedure for swapping from one part test to another part test?
question_77712.ground_truth: To swap from one part test to another part test, terminate the call and repeat the test, starting from initial conditions step 1 with the other part test connection in A.43.

question_77713.question: What is the purpose of the Drift RNTI (D-RNTI) in the GERAN/UTRAN?
question_77713.ground_truth: The D-RNTI is allocated by the TBSS and is used to identify the MS/UE during a handover via the Iur-g interface.

question_77714.question: What information can the NG-RAN node take into account when deciding whether to accept the setup of a QoS flow or not during the PDU SESSION RESOURCE SETUP REQUEST message handling?
question_77714.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node may accept the setup of the QoS flow when notification control has been enabled if the requested QoS parameters or at least one of the alternative QoS parameters sets can be fulfilled at the time of setup.

question_77716.question: What is the maximum length of the Mobile Identity information element?
question_77716.ground_truth: The maximal length of the Mobile Identity information element is 11 octets.

question_77719.question: What is the purpose of the source eNB including AS algorithms used in the source cell in the source to target transparent container that is sent to the target eNB for S1-handover?
question_77719.ground_truth: The purpose of including AS algorithms used in the source cell in the source to target transparent container that is sent to the target eNB for S1-handover is so that the target eNB can decipher and integrity verify the RRCReestablishmentComplete message on SRB1 in the potential RRCConnectionRe-establishment procedure.

question_77722.question: What is the indication for a barred cell in the MIB message for NTN?
question_77722.ground_truth: cellBarred with a value of "barred" in the MIB message

question_77723.question: What condition must be met for the IRI-POI in the PTC server to generate an xIRI containing a PTCSessionStart record?
question_77723.ground_truth: The IRI-POI in the PTC server generates the xIRI containing a PTCSessionStart record when the IRI-POI present in the PTC server detects that the PTC Session is initiated and communication begins for both an on-demand and pre-established PTC session.

question_77725.question: What does the NOP build using performance measurements and PEE parameters?
question_77725.ground_truth: The NOP builds EE KPIs using performance measurements and PEE parameters for its own purpose, i.e. the EE KPIs are not communicated to any other roles.

question_77730.question: What is the requirement for the MCPTT client when generating a SIP MESSAGE request?
question_77730.ground_truth: The MCPTT client shall include the ICSI value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt" in a P-Preferred-Service header field and the g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag with the value of "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt" in the Accept-Contact header field.

question_77731.question: What are the four test points for MCData Conformance testing?
question_77731.ground_truth: The four test points for MCData Conformance testing are on-network functional model (1), off-network functional model (2), LTE Legacy requirements between UE and EPS (1), and LTE Legacy requirements between UEs (2).

question_77732.question: When can the AMF-UE send a Page Relay towards the AMF-MBSR when the UE moves with the MBSR?
question_77732.ground_truth: When the AMF-UE knows the serving RAN node for the MBSR and the UE context includes a Link ID.

question_77733.question: What is the purpose of the ATSSS rule in Example 2?
question_77733.ground_truth: The ATSSS rule in Example 2 is used to provide high reliability when the UE communicates with an application server over TCP/port 1234, by steering TCP traffic to port 1234 using redundant steering.

question_77734.question: What does AAS BS refer to in the document?
question_77734.ground_truth: AAS BS stands for Active Antenna System Base Station.

question_77735.question: What actions should the UE take if timer T3346 is running and it receives a REGISTRATION REJECT message from the network?
question_77735.ground_truth: The UE shall abort the registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update, set the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED and change to state 5GMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION-UPDATE.

question_77737.question: What is the role of a multimedia telephony participant in an IMS multimedia telephony communication service?
question_77737.ground_truth: A UE shall implement the role of a multimedia telephony participant, which is responsible for participating in IMS multimedia telephony communication service sessions.

question_77738.question: What is the difference in CP length between NSR and HSR when the DFT size is decreased from 142 to 140?
question_77738.ground_truth: The CP length of both NSR and HSR increases from 6 symbols to 8 symbols.

question_77739.question: When SMF provides charging information related to 5GS CIoT during PDU session establishment, what are the three types of information it provides?
question_77739.ground_truth: The indication of Control Plane 5GS CIoT optimization, small data rate control indication, and the RAT types (NB-IoT or LTE-M).

question_77741.question: What is the main goal of using ECN bits for L4S as per Solution #41?
question_77741.ground_truth: The main goal of using ECN bits for L4S as per Solution #41 is to enable codec/rate adaptation to meet requirements for services in 5G System.

question_77743.question: In which scenario is the end-to-end (e2e) encryption for the data channel used in application data channel?
question_77743.ground_truth: The end-to-end (e2e) encryption for the data channel is used in application data channel when the external Data Server supports both HTTP and IETF RFC 8831 WebRTC data channel protocols for the P2A/A2P Application data channel use cases or P2P cases when the DCMF is not used to anchor the Application data channel.

question_77746.question: What is the function of the Broadcast Control Channel (BCCH) in LTE?
question_77746.ground_truth: The Broadcast Control Channel (BCCH) is a downlink channel used in LTE for broadcasting system control information.

question_77747.question: What network behavior does the UE indicate during the registration procedure to prefer control plane CIoT 5GS optimization or user plane CIoT 5GS optimization?
question_77747.ground_truth: The UE may indicate preference for control plane CIoT 5GS optimization or user plane CIoT 5GS optimization, which is considered as the request to use the corresponding behavior.

question_77748.question: What is the purpose of using the Special Information Tone defined by ITU-T for LCLS management tones?
question_77748.ground_truth: To ensure the tones are unique for LCLS only

question_77751.question: What is the purpose of specifying the interface for USIM Application Toolkit?
question_77751.ground_truth: The purpose of specifying the interface is to ensure interoperability between a UICC and an ME independently of the respective manufacturers and operators for USIM Application Toolkit.

question_77752.question: How does the EES handle graceful shutdown for maintenance or other reasons?
question_77752.ground_truth: The EES pushes all related context to a selected alternate EES instance and notifies all its consumers, who then re-connect to another EES instance within the same EES set for subsequent communication.

question_77755.question: What should be done during the registration and activation of a UE in the PN?
question_77755.ground_truth: The registration and activation procedures should include a validation and update of identities and capabilities associated with the UE. For this to happen, the UE should either send a registration/activation request to the network or the network should "invite" the UE based on a request received from another UE belonging to the PN. Additionally, registration and activation should only be done for UEs that are currently attached/registered to the network.

question_77756.question: What is the pre-condition for video streaming to be played fluently in the network?
question_77756.ground_truth: Enough bandwidth can be assigned to the user, which is the case in 3G, LTE, or when the network is in a normal load status.

question_77758.question: What is one of the responsibilities of the MTC-IWF regarding device triggering functionality, in addition to receiving a device trigger request from an SCS and reporting to the SCS the acceptance or non-acceptance of the device trigger request?
question_77758.ground_truth: The MTC-IWF may apply MTC-IWF and/or SGSN/MME induced congestion/load control as part of the response to trigger requests.

question_77759.question: What is the default mode of sending user plane data in the 3GPP network?
question_77759.ground_truth: The default mode of sending user plane data in the 3GPP network is IP unicast encapsulation of IP multicast datagrams.

question_77760.question: What are the scene description restrictions for SVG-based Timed Graphics in 3GPP?
question_77760.ground_truth: The scene description restrictions for SVG-based Timed Graphics in 3GPP include the use of SVG Tiny 1.2 for the description of the scene, the absence of continuous media such as audio or video in the scene, and limitations on interactivity and scene commands.

question_77761.question: How does the SMF provide the access network charging identifier information within the "accNetChId" attribute of the SmPolicyContextData data structure?
question_77761.ground_truth: The SMF provides the access network charging identifier information within the "accNetChId" attribute of the SmPolicyContextData data structure by including the "accNetChaIdValue" attribute containing the Access Network Charging Identifier for the PDU session (i.e., for the default QoS flow) and the "sessionChScope" attribute set to true. The SMF may also provide the address of the network entity performing the charging functionality within the "chargEntityAddr" attribute.

question_77762.question: What is the purpose of the private message mechanism in M3AP?
question_77762.ground_truth: The private message mechanism in M3AP is used for special operator or vendor-specific features and research purposes, but not for basic functionality.

question_77763.question: What is a hybrid MBMS service which contains a real-time audio/video stream associated with one or more auxiliary file delivery components?
question_77763.ground_truth: The hybrid MBMS services include live car race with synchronized race statistics and targeted advertisements, or live music concert with information on the performers and upcoming tour calendar and related information.

question_77765.question: What should the UE do with the list of service route values received in the Service-Route header field?
question_77765.ground_truth: The UE should store the list of service route values and bind it either to the contact address or to the registration flow and the associated contact address.

question_77768.question: What method does Solution 5, Alternative 5a, Option 1 use to achieve UE-SCEF reliability?
question_77768.ground_truth: Solution 5, Alternative 5a, Option 1 achieves UE-SCEF reliability by defining a protocol between the UE and SCEF for exchanging non-IP packets.

question_77769.question: What is the role of the QoS Profile in the BSSGP?
question_77769.ground_truth: The QoS Profile in BSSGP defines the (peak) bit rate, the type of BSSGP's SDU (signalling or data), the type of LLC frame (ACK, SACK, or not), the precedence class, and the transmission mode used when transmitting the LLC-PDU across the radio interface.

question_77770.question: In the event of multiple service types being applicable for a target identifier in 5GC, what is the approach for provisioning the LI function?
question_77770.ground_truth: The LIPF may provision the LI function in a NF only once for all applicable service types, or may determine the services that need to be intercepted at the LI function present in a NF and then provision that LI function for all services together.

question_77771.question: What is the use of ProSe Group Member Discovery parameters in the context of direct discovery over PC5 interface?
question_77771.ground_truth: ProSe Group Member Discovery parameters, such as Application Layer Group ID, Layer-2 Group ID, User Info ID (Announcer Info, Discoverer/Discoveree Info), are used for direct discovery over PC5 interface to identify an application layer group that the UE belongs to, a layer-2 ID for Discovery Group ID, and information about the announcing user or the discoverer/discoveree UE.

question_77774.question: What is a requirement for the network providing the Service Capability Feature (SCF) when it is accessed from a different network?
question_77774.ground_truth: The network providing the SCF shall be able to control the visibility and usage of the SCF by another network.

question_77776.question: What is the average horizontal positioning accuracy at CDF=90% when the number of active TRPs is reduced from 18 to 3, for TRP reduction in AI/ML assisted positioning?
question_77776.ground_truth: The average horizontal positioning accuracy is E = (2.01~42.76) x E18TRP (meters)

question_77777.question: What is the purpose of the QoS verification capability described in the solution?
question_77777.ground_truth: The purpose of the QoS verification capability is to enable the VAL server to verify QoS data of a network and check whether the existing QoS data is able to satisfy the VAL client's requirement.

question_77778.question: What is the method used by the SMF to send the P-CSCF address(es) to the UE for a PDU Session establishment procedure relating to IMS?
question_77778.ground_truth: The SMF sends the P-CSCF address(es) to the UE transparently through the AMF, and in case of Home Routed, also through the SMF in the VPLMN.

question_77779.question: What is the purpose of the challenge mechanism in the group-based ProSe communication?
question_77779.ground_truth: The challenge mechanism is used to determine if the respondents are belonging to the group and are trustworthy members of these groups in group-based ProSe communication. The response to the challenge is a function of the UE ProSe ID of the respondent and the challenge itself.

question_77782.question: What should the MTSI client use as the maximum data rate if the ECN-triggered adaptation indicates AMR5.9 and the PLR-triggered adaptation indicates AMR4.75?
question_77782.ground_truth: The MTSI client should use a maximum data rate of AMR4.75.

question_77783.question: What are the functional impacts on the 5G CN when considering a satellite access with moving coverage areas and on-board gNBs?
question_77783.ground_truth: This is a point expected to be studied within Key Issue 3.

question_77784.question: What is the parameter that enables and disables reporting of primary notification events when received from the network?

question_77785.question: Which HTTP method is used to create an individual MBS distribution session resource in the MBSTF?
question_77785.ground_truth: The POST method is used to create an individual MBS distribution session resource in the MBSTF.

question_77788.question: How is the ETWS Secondary Notification distributed in E-UTRAN?
question_77788.ground_truth: In E-UTRAN, the ETWS Secondary Notification is distributed using SIB 11, while the other warning systems use SIB 12.

question_77789.question: Which steps should be taken when setting the affiliation status of the MCData group information entry added to the candidate list by the procedures of clause 8.3.2.12?
question_77789.ground_truth: The affiliation status of the MCData group information entry added to the candidate list of the MCData group information entries should be set to "affiliated" if the IWF has received a SIP 2xx response from the controlling MCData function to a SIP request that had triggered performing the procedures of clause 8.3.2.12.

question_77791.question: What information does the Packet Flow Identifier (PFI) provide in the context of an LLC PDU?
question_77791.ground_truth: The PFI identifies the packet flow context associated with the LLC PDU. It is included by the SGSN if the packet flow context feature is negotiated, and the mobile station supports it. If the mobile station does not support the PFC feature or if the PFI is not known, the SGSN uses the pre-defined PFI to indicate best-effort QoS.

question_77793.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project Technical Specification Group's work on Signal Precoding Enhancements for EGPRS2 DL?
question_77793.ground_truth: The purpose is to provide significant performance gains for EGPRS2, improving data throughput while maintaining spectral properties and minimizing impacts on existing services, base stations, and mobile stations.

question_77794.question: If the UE is not registered to the access other than the access the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message is received and the 5GS registration result value in the 5GS registration result IE value in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message is set to "3GPP access and non-3GPP access", what should the UE consider itself as being registered to?
question_77794.ground_truth: Only the access where the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message is received

question_77795.question: What is the name of the media-level SDP attribute specified in clause 6.2.9 to indicate ANBR support?
question_77795.ground_truth: The name of the media-level SDP attribute specified in clause 6.2.9 to indicate ANBR support is "anbr".

question_77796.question: What interaction takes place between the CP and UP function during the IP-CAN session establishment procedure where TDF-C selects a new TDF-U and creates Sx session?
question_77796.ground_truth: The new TDF-C selects a new TDF-U and creates Sx session with TDF-U during the IP-CAN session establishment procedure.

question_77797.question: What is mandatory in the 5G system to provide secure communication between entities?
question_77797.ground_truth: All network functions support mutually authenticated TLS and HTTPS.

question_77801.question: What type of CDRs is used for collecting charging information related to the transmission of Short Messages through the SGSN and MME in MO or MT direction?
question_77801.ground_truth: S-SMO-CDR for MO direction transfer and S-SMT-CDR for MT direction transfer are used to collect charging information related to the transmission of Short Messages.

question_77803.question: What should the UE do when it receives a RRCSetup message in response to an RRCConnectionReestablishment message?
question_77803.ground_truth: The UE should start T311 timer and initiate the RRC connection re-establishment procedure, and if the re-establishment is successful, the UE should resume the RRC connection without explicit signaling.

question_77804.question: What is the impact on the UE's Link ID when a new AMF-UE is allocated during UE mobility with the MBSR?
question_77804.ground_truth: When a new AMF-UE is allocated, the NG-RAN responds to the new AMF-UE with a new Link ID, associates the new Link ID with the UEs, and replaces the old Link ID in the context of the MBSR and the context of UEs with the new Link ID.

question_77805.question: What should be met for the UE physical layer to be capable of performing CSI-RSRP measurements of identified inter-frequency TPs with an explicit inter-frequency TP list, as specified in 8.11.3.2?
question_77805.ground_truth: The UE physical layer should be capable of performing CSI-RSRP measurements of at least 3 identified inter-frequency TPs per FS3 inter-frequency, for up to 3 FS3 inter-frequencies, with the specified measurement period.

question_77810.question: Where in the SIP (Session Initiation Protocol) Header Fields registry is the Handover-Info header field defined?
question_77810.ground_truth: The Handover-Info header field is defined in the IANA registry: Header Fields registry for the Session Initiation Protocol (SIP)

question_77813.question: What data object contains the SIP or TEL URI of the Calling Party in the ENVELOPE (EVENT DOWNLOAD - MT call) message?

question_77814.question: In what condition does the UE select the time and frequency resource for SL-PRS retransmissions if the selected resource pool is a SL-PRS dedicated resource pool?
question_77814.ground_truth: The time and frequency resource for SL-PRS retransmissions is selected randomly from the resources indicated by the physical layer, taking into account the selected number of SL-PRS retransmissions and the remaining SL-PRS delay budget.

question_77815.question: Which message is sent by the source eNB to the target eNB to initiate the Handover Preparation procedure?

question_77816.question: Which UE releases and duplex modes are applicable for the 8.16.100 test?
question_77816.ground_truth: Applicability for the 8.16.100 test requires support for FGI bit 111 for all types of E-UTRA FDD and TDD UE, from release 14 and forward, supporting 7DL CA.

question_77817.question: When must a UE trigger the UE-to-network relay selection procedure?
question_77817.ground_truth: The UE shall trigger the UE-to-network relay selection procedure if it is authorized to act as a 5G ProSe remote UE towards a 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE, and has obtained a list of 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE candidates fulfilling ProSe layer criteria and lower layers criteria.

question_77818.question: What is the role of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in relation to the present document?
question_77818.ground_truth: The 3GPP is the organization that has produced the present document, and continues to work on it with the goal of approving it under change control.

question_77820.question: What authorization information does the eP-CSCF obtain upon validating the access token from the Authorization header field?
question_77820.ground_truth: The eP-CSCF obtains the associated authorization information, including the private user identity and public user identity of the associated user, the WAF and WWSF identities, and the authorization information scope.

question_77821.question: What is the outcome if the IP-CAN bearer modification is not upgrading the QoS and not providing traffic mapping information?
question_77821.ground_truth: The IP-CAN bearer modification is always acknowledged by the GW (PCEF).

question_77822.question: What is the purpose of the CC-PAG in the LI system?
question_77822.ground_truth: The CC-PAG performs the function of aggregating the xCC (cross-correlation cases) from different CC-POIs towards the MDF3. It is an optional LI function that may be deployed in networks that need aggregation of xCC from potentially large number of different CC-POIs towards the MDF3.

question_77823.question: What must the UE include in the To header field if it supports RFC 6140 and performs the functions of an external attached network?
question_77823.ground_truth: The main URI of the UE.

question_77824.question: What is the role of the Mediation and Delivery Function (MDF) in a 3GPP Communication Service Provider (CSP) network?
question_77824.ground_truth: The Mediation and Delivery Function (MDF) performs any necessary mediation of the Interception Product before delivering it to the Law Enforcement Monitoring Facility (LEMF) in a 3GPP Communication Service Provider (CSP) network.

question_77825.question: In which substate does the UE search for PLMNs or SNPNs?

question_77828.question: What bit in the L2 frame identifies the command and what is its value for short L2 header type 1?
question_77828.ground_truth: The C/R bit identifies a frame as either a command or a response. In short L2 header type 1, it takes a value of 0.

question_77830.question: What message does the UE send to the serving AMF upon successfully verifying and updating the UE Parameters Update Data?
question_77830.ground_truth: The UE sends the UL NAS Transport message to the serving AMF, including the generated UPU-MAC-IUE in a transparent container.
