question_77835.question: What message does the MeNB consider to concern CPAC if supported, when receiving an ED message from the MeNB?

question_77836.question: When will the UE set to NACK value in the HARQ-ACK codebook any HARQ-ACK information corresponding to PDSCH reception or SPS PDSCH release or TCI state update that the UE detects in a PDCCH monitoring occasion that starts after a PDCCH monitoring occasion where the UE detects a DCI format scheduling the PUSCH transmission?
question_77836.ground_truth: When a UE multiplexes HARQ-ACK information in a PUSCH transmission that is scheduled by a DCI format that includes a DAI field, but is not provided with fdmed-ReceptionMulticast and pdsch-HARQ-ACK-Codebook = 'semi-static' for both unicast and multicast HARQ-ACK information.

question_77837.question: What parameter of the gsmSCF indicates which timer shall be reset in the ResetTimer procedure?

question_77838.question: What happens after the OCS responds with a Debit Units Response message to the SMS-SC in the IEC operation model for Device Triggering?
question_77838.ground_truth: The SMS-SC returns "Device Trigger Answer" with appropriate result associated to the reception of the trigger request, indicating if it was successfully received or failed due to an error at the SMS-SC.

question_77840.question: What action should the UE take if a packet filter consists of conflicting packet filter components which would render the packet filter ineffective?
question_77840.ground_truth: The UE shall initiate a PDU session modification procedure by sending a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message to delete the mapped EPS bearer context with 5GSM cause #44 "semantic errors in packet filter(s)".

question_77842.question: What is the role of the UAS NF in Solution #5?
question_77842.ground_truth: The UAS NF may play a role similar to the ProSe AF on behalf of the USS to ensure secure discovery between UAV and UAV-C.

question_77843.question: What is the ACLR requirement for the interfering signal in step 7.5.4.2.3, and what is its purpose?
question_77843.ground_truth: The ACLR requirement for the interfering signal in step 7.5.4.2.3 is at least 63~dB, and its purpose is to eliminate the impact of interfering signal adjacent channel leakage power on the ACS measurement.

question_77844.question: What is the function of the UAV identifier (UAV ID) as defined in the present document?
question_77844.ground_truth: The UAV identifier (UAV ID) is an unique identifier of a UAV. It can be in the form of a 3GPP UE ID (e.g. GPSI, External Identifier) or CAA level UAV ID as assigned by civil aviation authorities (e.g. FAA) via USS/UTM.

question_77846.question: What is the maximum Doppler frequency offset for the PDSCH requirement in the uni-directional deployment scenario?
question_77846.ground_truth: The maximum Doppler frequency offset for the PDSCH requirement in the uni-directional deployment scenario is 9722 Hz targeting 350km/h at 30 GHz.

question_77847.question: What is the tolerance value for the OTA ACS, general blocking, and narrowband blocking test?
question_77847.ground_truth: The tolerance value for OTA ACS, general blocking, and narrowband blocking test is derived based on clause 10.5.4 and is applicable for all test methods addressing OTA ACS, general blocking, and narrowband blocking test requirements.

question_77850.question: What does the 0 value of the <hidden> parameter indicate in the context of phonebook entry?
question_77850.ground_truth: The phonebook entry is not hidden

question_77851.question: What is required when the UE sends a REGISTER request and does not support GRUU but supports multiple registrations?
question_77851.ground_truth: The UE must include a "reg-id" header field parameter and all supported ICSI values in a g.3gpp.icsi-ref media feature tag, and IARI values in a g.3gpp.iari-ref media feature tag.

question_77852.question: When may the SMF send a PDU Session Modification Command to indicate that the PDU Session is no longer edge-anchored?
question_77852.ground_truth: The SMF sends a PDU Session Modification Command to indicate that the PDU Session is no longer edge-anchored when there is no longer a local PSA UPF for the PDU Session and the SMF reselects a PSA UPF for the PDU Session.

question_77854.question: What should the SNRM-S include in the HTTP POST request to the VAL server when sending a user-plane delivery mode?
question_77854.ground_truth: The SNRM-S shall include a delivery-mode element indicating whether to deliver the user data to the UE(s) via unicast mode or multicast mode, an MBMS-media-stream-id element indicating the MBMS media stream to be used to deliver the media currently over unicast or the MBMS media stream currently being used, and one or more unicast-media-stream-id element(s) indicating the unicast media stream to be used to deliver the media currently over multicast or the unicast to be stopped and switched to multicast.

question_77855.question: What is the default message for the 200 OK response in the SIP MESSAGE request (Step 4)?
question_77855.ground_truth: The default message for the 200 OK response in the SIP MESSAGE request (Step 4) is defined in Annex A.3.1.

question_77856.question: What is the overall delays measured when DRX cycle length is 1280 ms test requirement is expressed as?
question_77856.ground_truth: Overall delay measured = measurement reporting delay + TTI insertion uncertainty + DRX cycle length

question_77858.question: What is the purpose of the MCPTT release request message being routed through the SIP core in the unicast call release procedure (terminating)?
question_77858.ground_truth: The MCPTT release request message is routed through the SIP core to the corresponding MCPTT client and AEP hides the identities before routing the messages.

question_77859.question: When considering the maximum bandwidth, which frequency bands do the 3rd order IMD products fall into the BS receive of which frequency bands?
question_77859.ground_truth: The 3rd order IMD products only fall into the BS receive of Bands 1, 2, 22, 25, 33, 35, 36, 37, 39, 42, 43, 48 and 65.

question_77860.question: How does the UPF handle forwarding of unicast Ethernet traffic in 5G?
question_77860.ground_truth: The UPF forwards DL unicast traffic (with a known destination address) on a PDU Session determined based on the source MAC address(es) used by the UE for the UL traffic. It forwards UL unicast traffic (with a known destination address) on a port (PDU Session or N6 interface) determined based on the source MAC address(es) learned beforehand.

question_77861.question: What is the purpose of the "supplementary service" in the context of bearer operations?
question_77861.ground_truth: Supplementary services are additional services offered by the network to the user, such as call forwarding, call waiting, etc.

question_77862.question: In the context of E-UTRA FDD Repeater, what is the difference between "Output power, Pout" and "Maximum output power, Pmax"?
question_77862.ground_truth: "Output power, Pout" is the mean power of one carrier at maximum repeater gain delivered to a load with resistance equal to the nominal load impedance of the transmitter. "Maximum output power, Pmax" is the mean power level per carrier measured at the antenna connector of the Repeater in specified reference conditions.

question_77863.question: What should be the state of the gprsSSF FSM if there are no more armed EDPs or pending reports after sending an ApplyChargingReportGPRS operation due to a timer or counter expiry?
question_77863.ground_truth: The gprsSSF FSM shall transit to the state "Idle".

question_77864.question: What is the purpose of sending a group join request in the chat group (restricted) call model?
question_77864.ground_truth: The purpose of sending a group join request is to indicate to the MCVideo server that the user associated with the given MCVideo client wishes to participate in the group communication for the group, and to negotiate media parameters for the group call.

question_77865.question: What happens when a UE moves to a new PEGC within the same PIN network?
question_77865.ground_truth: The new PEGC will allocate a new PINE identifier for the UE to access 5GC via this PEGC, and notify the PEMC to update the PIN profile in UDM with the new PINE information.

question_77866.question: What is the purpose of the "correlator" parameter in the "NotifySmsReception" operation?
question_77866.ground_truth: The "correlator" parameter in the "NotifySmsReception" operation identifies the provisioning step, containing the criteria that the SMS must fulfill for the notification to occur.

question_77867.question: What should the "setup" attribute be set to in the SDP answer for the UE to initiate an outgoing TCP connection?
question_77867.ground_truth: The "setup" attribute should be set to 'active'.

question_77868.question: What is the type of the "transportLayerAddress" attribute defined in the "ul-common-E-DCH-MACflow-Specific-InfoResponseList-Item" structure?
question_77868.ground_truth: The type of "transportLayerAddress" attribute is TransportLayerAddress and it is optional.

question_77870.question: What is the "separation bit" in the AMF field of AUTN and what is its significance in EPS AKA?
question_77870.ground_truth: The "separation bit" in the AMF field of AUTN is bit 0 of the AMF field of AUTN. It is used to indicate the usability of the authentication vector for AKA in an EPS context or a non-EPS context (e.g. GSM, UMTS). In an EPS context, the secret keys CK and IK generated during AKA shall never leave the HSS.

question_77872.question: What should the UE do if the complete SIB28 has not been assembled within a period of 3 hours?
question_77872.ground_truth: The UE should discard any stored segments for SIB28.

question_77873.question: What information does an IRI-POI/CC-TF examine when an IMS session is terminated at an IMS UE to verify for a target match when the target identity is IMPU?
question_77873.ground_truth: The Request URI and To header present in the SIP INVITE.

question_77874.question: What is the MME-centric approach for changing the user plane session identity in solution 2?
question_77874.ground_truth: In solution 2, the SGW-C triggers the MME-centric approach by initiating the MME to perform a Modify Bearer Request procedure for UP session identity change. This approach is chosen to minimize the impact on existing functional entities and consider race conditions.

question_77875.question: What should be the measurement reporting delay for a MEASUREMENT REPORT message for Cell 2 triggered by event 1A during time period T2?
question_77875.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay for a MEASUREMENT REPORT message for Cell 2 triggered by event 1A during time period T2 should be less than 880 ms.

question_77876.question: What is the process of UE-to-Network Relay discovery and selection, and how can it be applied for Layer-2 UE-to-Network Relay?
question_77876.ground_truth: The process of UE-to-Network Relay discovery and selection can be applied for Layer-2 UE-to-Network Relay by using Model A or Model B. Solutions for the detailed UE-to-Network Relay discovery and selection can reuse Solution #19, with the difference that slicing and DNN information do not need to be considered. The UE-to-Network Relay discovery and selection for Layer-2 UE-to-Network Relay can be found in clause~6.7.2.9 and Solution #19, Solution #41.

question_77878.question: Which message is sent to the MS to test the spare bits?
question_77878.ground_truth: The IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT REJECT message is sent to the MS to test the spare bits.

question_77881.question: What is the maximum allowable time alignment error (TAE) between any two transmissions on different transmit antenna connectors in the UL MIMO scheme?
question_77881.ground_truth: The time alignment error (TAE) shall not exceed 130 ns for UE(s) with multiple transmit antenna connectors.

question_77882.question: What is the maximum number of SS/PBCH block indexes included in resultRS-IndexList as part of the UE's procedure for beam measurements based on SS/PBCH block?

question_77883.question: What will the EES include in the UE location notification sent to the EAS?
question_77883.ground_truth: The EES includes the location of the UE(s), which consists of UE ID, location type, and may include location accuracy and the timestamp of the location.

question_77884.question: What should the controller UE include in the SIP REFER request after sending the SIP 200 (OK) response?
question_77884.ground_truth: The controller UE should include the Request-URI set to the URI of the SCC AS, the Refer-To header field with the SIP URI of the controllee UE, the body parameter containing SDP media lines, the Accept header field with the MIME type "message/sipfrag", the Target-Dialog header field with the dialog parameters of the session, the Contact header field with the g.3gpp.iut-controller media feature-tag, and the Referred-By header field with a registered public user identity of the controller UE.

question_77885.question: What range of SE gains can 16/64 NUCs provide over 16/64 QAM for a specific SNR gain?
question_77885.ground_truth: 16/64 NUCs can provide additional SNR gains over 16/64 QAM, which can extend the coverage by 0.1-0.5dB. As the order of constellation increases, the gain is larger.

question_77886.question: What is the role of the session identifier in GBA authentication?
question_77886.ground_truth: The session identifier is used to make the link between the BA session and the AA session. In Scenario 2, the user may visually check that the 2 identifiers displayed match. In Scenario 3, the session identifier provided by the OP/NAF to the BA is presented by the AA to the BA, and the link between the two sessions can be made at the NAF/OP level without the user being involved in the matching operation.

question_77887.question: What is the role of the PDC Report Type IEs in the PDC Measurement Initiation Request-IEs?
question_77887.ground_truth: The PDC Report Type IEs in PDC Measurement Initiation Request-IEs indicate the type of report that should be generated based on the measurement. The report type can either be periodic or event-triggered.

question_77889.question: What is the role of the NM in step 4.2.3.3.1 in scaling a specific VNF instance as part of NS scaling?
question_77889.ground_truth: The NM sends a ScaleNsRequest with parameters to the NFVO to initiate the scaling of the VNF instance.

question_77890.question: What are the possible indication types that a U2N Relay UE can set when initiating the NotificationMessageSidelink message transmission?
question_77890.ground_truth: The possible indication types include relayUE-Uu-RLF, relayUE-HO, relayUE-CellReselection, and relayUE-Uu-RRC-Failure.

question_77891.question: What is the recommended scenario for the UE to provide a URI as a value for the Geolocation header field in the INVITE request?
question_77891.ground_truth: It is recommended that UE's only use the option of providing a URI when the domain part belongs to the current P-CSCF or S-CSCF provider.

question_77892.question: When is an xIRI containing a FiveGMSAFNetworkAssistance record generated by the IRI-POI in the 5GMS AF?
question_77892.ground_truth: When the IRI-POI in the 5GMS AF detects that the 5GMS AF has received a network assistance from the target UE.

question_77894.question: How does the UE return the WLAN measurements to the SRNC in the WLAN positioning procedure?
question_77894.ground_truth: The UE returns the WLAN measurements, along with a time stamp, to the SRNC in the RRC signalling message.

question_77895.question: What is the purpose of the sum subcounter in some measurements?
question_77895.ground_truth: The sum subcounter is provided when only a subset of per network or per IMS network domain measurements is supported, to give a total of that subset.

question_77896.question: What is the procedure for sending a MO-SMS from UE-A to IP-SM-GW-A when the recipient UE is not reachable in the IMS network and does not have an MSISDN?
question_77896.ground_truth: The TP-DA field is filled with a dummy value and B's SIP URI is indicated in the SIP MESSAGE. The P-CSCF fills the p-asserted-identity before sending the MESSAGE to S-CSCF and IP-SM-GW-A for further processing.

question_77898.question: What is the KPI for peak data rate of a single UE for a short period of time in range of 50 m, in case of imminent collision, as specified in PR.5.6-007?

question_77899.question: What system initiates a railway emergency call that gets routed to the FRMCS system in the scenario described?
question_77899.ground_truth: The GSM-R system initiates a railway emergency call that gets routed to the FRMCS system in the scenario described.

question_77900.question: What should the mobile station do when it returns to packet idle mode and receives a downlink RLC data block?
question_77900.ground_truth: The mobile station ignores this block, because it has returned to packet idle mode.

question_77901.question: When is the "UE positioning GPS assistance data" and "UE positioning GANSS assistance data" information elements set in MEASUREMENT CONTROL messages for UE-assisted test cases?
question_77901.ground_truth: These information elements are set in MEASUREMENT CONTROL messages for UE-assisted test cases when adequate assistance data is required.

question_77902.question: What should the eNB do if there is no valid key for the UE in the eNB?
question_77902.ground_truth: The eNB requests the MME for the key K_CLT, including the eKSI and the UE ID along with the request.

question_77903.question: What is the role of the NWDAF in acquiring Slice load level analytics for charging?
question_77903.ground_truth: The NWDAF provides services specified in TS 23.288 that can be used to acquire Slice load level analytics, which can be utilized for charging based on load level of a Network Slice.

question_77904.question: What is the purpose of the TLS server certificate in the 5G authentication process?
question_77904.ground_truth: The TLS server certificate is validated by the UE to ensure the authenticity of the AUSF during EAP-TTLS phase 1.

question_77905.question: What is the requirement for the network when providing a per-UE measurement gap pattern for concurrent monitoring of all frequency layers?
question_77905.ground_truth: During the per-UE measurement gaps, an ATG UE is not required to conduct reception/transmission from/to the corresponding NR serving cells, except for the reception of signals used for RRM measurement(s).

question_77906.question: What is the ACLR LEO class limit for the conducted transmitter requirements of SAN?
question_77906.ground_truth: The ACLR LEO class limit for the conducted transmitter requirements of SAN is 14 dB.

question_77907.question: In the process of handling services data, if the ServiceData XML element is present with or without content, what is defined in clauses 6.1 to 6.4?
question_77907.ground_truth: The Service Data element is present, and clauses 6.1 to 6.4 provide details about its handling.

question_77908.question: What action should an SGM-S take if the sender of a received COAP DELETE request is not authorized to delete the requested group member resource?
question_77908.ground_truth: The SGM-S should respond with a CoAP 4.03 (Forbidden) response to the CoAP DELETE request and skip the rest of the steps.

question_77910.question: Which category of session management procedures belongs to the next lower level of priority and should be throttled during network congestion?
question_77910.ground_truth: Release Access Bearer Request, Modify Bearer Request, Change Notification, Suspend Notification, and Resume Notification.

question_77911.question: What is the purpose of the validity period in a device trigger request?
question_77911.ground_truth: The validity period in a device trigger request specifies the length of time for which the request is valid.

question_77912.question: What should the UE do upon expiry of T310 timer in the no DRX mode?
question_77912.ground_truth: The UE should turn off the transmitter power in the monitored cell within 40ms after expiry of T310 timer in the no DRX mode.

question_77913.question: What is the maximum number of interrupted slots on a serving cell in NR standalone operation when MGL = 3 ms and MG timing advance = 0ms?
question_77913.ground_truth: The maximum number of interrupted slots on a serving cell in NR standalone operation when MGL = 3 ms and MG timing advance = 0ms is 3.

question_77915.question: What is the access technology for the PLMN not allowed rejection cause code?

question_77916.question: When does the "CSI request" bit field in a DCI format trigger an aperiodic CSI report and the UE is expected to receive a value of N > 1 as determined by the procedure in Clause 8.0?
question_77916.ground_truth: If DCI format 4B is used and for both TBs, or if DCI format 0B is used and UE is not expected to receive the value of N > 1 as determined by the procedure in Clause 8.0.

question_77917.question: What is the conformance requirement for inter-system handover to UTRAN from GSM SDCDH/CC Establishment?
question_77917.ground_truth: The MS shall be able to receive a INTER SYSTEM TO UTRAN HANDOVER COMMAND message from GSM and perform an inter-system handover, and if it succeeds in establishing the connection to UTRAN, it shall transmit a HANDOVER TO UTRAN COMPLETE message on the uplink DCCH.

question_77918.question: Which message does the MME send to initiate the bearer context deactivation procedure when the UE requests PDN disconnection to a PDN?
question_77918.ground_truth: Upon receiving the PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST message from the UE, the MME initiates the bearer context deactivation procedure by sending the DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message, including the linked EPS bearer identity and setting the ESM cause to #36 "regular deactivation".

question_77919.question: What is the purpose of the 5G SRVCC indication in the 3GPP 5G system?
question_77919.ground_truth: The 5G SRVCC indication is used in the 3GPS 5G system to indicate that the PDU session for IMS is released due to PS to CS handover for 5G SRVCC.

question_77920.question: What are the two options for membership verification during SHO from macro to hybrid?
question_77920.ground_truth: Option 1 involves the macro RNC remaining as SRNC and taking additional resources from the hybrid HNB, while Option 2 involves the CN providing membership verification for the target HNB during SHO operations.

question_77922.question: What is the purpose of the TDD Absolute RSRP Accuracy test for E-UTRA Carrier Aggregation for 20MHz + 10MHz?
question_77922.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify the accuracy of the RSRP measurement for E-UTRA TDD UE in carrier aggregation scenarios with 20MHz + 10MHz.

question_77923.question: When is the UE required to meet the requirements for a given frequency layer while performing intra-frequency measurements of GSO cells in UE category M1 with CE mode A?
question_77923.ground_truth: The UE is required to meet the requirements for a given frequency layer only if it is measuring cells associated with a satellite that is not subject to t-serviceStartNeigh for cells in that satellite.

question_77924.question: What is the purpose of the discoveree UE procedure for UE-to-network relay discovery?
question_77924.ground_truth: The discoveree UE procedure for UE-to-network relay discovery enables a ProSe-enabled UE with a UE-to-network Relay to respond to solicitation from other ProSe-enabled UEs on proximity of a connectivity service provided by the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE, upon a request from upper layers.

question_77925.question: What action will the PGW-C take when it receives a Modify bearer request from a restarted SGW-C after an SGW-C failure?
question_77925.ground_truth: The PGW-C will initiate a Sx Session Modification Procedure to modify the FAR when it receives the Modify bearer request from the restarted SGW-C.

question_77927.question: What is the purpose of the G-RNTI management in the GERAN?
question_77927.ground_truth: The G-RNTI is used to identify a mobile station during contention resolution in the GERAN. If a mobile station does not possess a GERAN allocated G-RNTI, it shall use a Random G-RNTI.

question_77930.question: What conditions should be met to consider the entering condition 1 (B2-1) for an event to be satisfied?
question_77930.ground_truth: The entering condition 1 (B2-1) for an event is satisfied when Mp + Hys < Thresh1, where Mp is the measurement result of the PCell not taking into account any offsets, Hys is the hysteresis parameter for this event, and Thresh1 is the threshold parameter for this event.

question_77931.question: What is the bandwidth that should be used to measure intermodulation components for multicarrier BTS in the relevant transmit band 6 MHz or less away from the wanted signal carrier frequency?

question_77932.question: What is the maximum allowed BLER performance for USF/MSC-1 to 9, under extreme conditions, as specified in 3GPP TS 05.05 subclause 6.2?
question_77932.ground_truth: The BLER performance for USF/MSC-1 to 9 shall not exceed 1%.

question_77933.question: How can IMS request traffic to route using (or prevent routing using) a local UPF in the 5GC?
question_77933.ground_truth: The IMS network can influence or control how the 5GC selects the UP path by interacting with the 5GC through an appropriate IMS node (such as the IMS AS, CSCF, or other IMS node) and specifying the desired routing behavior. An application server can request traffic to route using a local UPF by communicating with the IMS network and indicating the desired routing behavior.

question_77934.question: What must the MgNB do when the received UP security policy is "Required" or "Preferred" and there are two redundant transmissions?
question_77934.ground_truth: The MgNB must reject the establishment of UP resources for the PDU Session and indicate the decision to the SgNB to ensure the same UP encryption protection and integrity protection for both transmissions.

question_77935.question: What must the NG-RAN node do upon reception of the PDU SESSION RESOURCE NOTIFY message?
question_77935.ground_truth: The NG-RAN node shall, upon reception of the PDU SESSION RESOURCE NOTIFY message, transfer the PDU Session Resource Notify Transfer IE or PDU Session Resource Notify Released Transfer IE to the SMF associated with the concerned PDU session.

question_77940.question: What is the overall synchronization accuracy error between a clock source and UE clock if there is a 100 ns time error between TSN GM clock and gNB, and the SCS is 15 kHz?
question_77940.ground_truth: 665 ns (i.e. 540ns (air interface accuracy) + 100ns (network interface accuracy) + 25 ns (granularity/2))

question_77941.question: What should the UE do when it receives a 401 (Unauthorized) response to a REGISTER request?
question_77941.ground_truth: The UE should extract the RAND and AUTN parameters and check the validity of the received authentication challenge.

question_77942.question: When should the first CSI report for SCell be sent during T2, in the absence of interruption?
question_77942.ground_truth: In the absence of interruption, the first CSI report for SCell should be sent in subframe (m+8) during T2.

question_77943.question: How does service signaling indicate the transport mode of interactivity application content files in the case of broadcast delivery?
question_77943.ground_truth: By indicating the delivery schedule of interactivity application content files.

question_77944.question: How does the WebRTC IMS Client obtain the access token for the IMS registration?
question_77944.ground_truth: The WebRTC IMS Client obtains the access token from the WAF (a third party authorization server) via an authentication protocol like OAuth 2.0. The WWSF (WebRTC Web Signaling Function) acts as the client in the OAuth 2.0 protocol, and the IMS network (eP-CSCF) acts as the resource server.

question_77946.question: What should the floor participant do when a Floor Deny message is received with a matching User ID and current floor arbitrator SSRC?
question_77946.ground_truth: The floor participant should stop timer T204 (Floor Queue Position request), stop the T233 (Pending user action) timer if running, notify the user about the denied floor, and enter the "O: has no permission" state.

question_77947.question: When does the SS deactivate SCell1 by sending the deactivation MAC-CE?
question_77947.ground_truth: The SS deactivates SCell1 by sending the deactivation MAC-CE in a subframe n, where n is an even number for FDD PCell and 4 or 9 for TDD PCell.

question_77948.question: What is the role of the SS (Node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources in the test setup?
question_77948.ground_truth: The SS (Node B emulator) and AWGN noise sources are connected to the UE (User Equipment) antenna for the test.

question_77949.question: What is assigned to the logical entities for I-CSCFs used in registration?
question_77949.ground_truth: SIP URIs are assigned to the logical entities for I-CSCFs used in registration.

question_77950.question: What are some options for directing cell broadcast messages to MTC devices?
question_77950.ground_truth: Options for directing cell broadcast messages to MTC devices include assigning PLMN specific CBS message identifiers and broadcasting in a specific geographic area, or using a message structure that includes the type of identifier and the identifier itself in the broadcast.

question_77951.question: What should be the value of bits 5 to 8 of octet 6 for Global CN-Id if an Administration decides to include only two digits in the MNC?
question_77951.ground_truth: Bits 5 to 8 of octet 6 should be coded as "1111" if an Administration decides to include only two digits in the MNC.

question_77952.question: What is the condition under which the UE, in 5GMM-IDLE mode over 3GPP access, shall request the lower layer to establish an RRC connection?
question_77952.ground_truth: The UE, in 5GMM-IDLE mode over 3GPP access, shall request the lower layer to establish an RRC connection when it needs to transmit an initial NAS message.

question_77954.question: What is the purpose of Mobility Robustness Optimization (MRO) in SON?
question_77954.ground_truth: The MRO is to automatically detect and solve problems related to the intra-5G and inter-RAT mobility, which include too early or too late handovers, handover to wrong cells, unnecessary handovers, and ping-pang handovers.

question_77955.question: What is the procedure for the UE to instruct the lower layers to start monitoring for PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message?
question_77955.ground_truth: The UE instructs the lower layers to start monitoring for PROSE PC5 DISCOVERY message by using the group identifier as the input to the SHA-256 hashing algorithm and using the 24 least significant bits of the 256 bits of the output as the destination layer-2 ID. The SHA-256 hashing algorithm is implemented in the ME.

question_77956.question: What is the condition in the pseudocode for the UE to expect to receive more than one PDSCH in a same DL slot associated with a coresetPoolIndex value if the UE is not provided with multiPDSCH-perSlotType1-CB?
question_77956.ground_truth: The condition is if the UE is not provided with multiPDSCH-perSlotType1-CB and the UE does not indicate a capability to receive more than one unicast PDSCH or multicast PDSCH per slot and MA,c is not an empty set.

question_77958.question: Where does the E2M Key Server (EMKS) reside in the PLMN security solution?
question_77958.ground_truth: The EMKS always resides in an operator's home network.

question_77959.question: What action does the DN-AAA server take if the PDU Session Establishment is authorized?
question_77959.ground_truth: When DN-AAA server authorizes the PDU Session Establishment, it may send DN Authorization Data for the established PDU Session to the SMF. The DN authorization data for the established PDU Session may include one or more of the following: A DN Authorization Profile Index, a list of allowed MAC addresses for the PDU Session, a list of allowed VLAN tags for the PDU Session, DN authorized Session AMBR for the PDU Session, Framed Route information for the PDU Session, and L2TP information.

question_77960.question: What is the format of FQDNs in Multi-Vendor eNodeB Plug-and-Play?
question_77960.ground_truth: The format of FQDNs in Multi-Vendor eNodeB Plug-and-Play is "<vendor ID>.<system>.<OAM realm>".

question_77961.question: What is the role of the MSC-A Server in the described scenario?
question_77961.ground_truth: The MSC-A Server receives the answer message and starts the charging for the call.

question_77962.question: In what scenarios can the UE and AMF not suspend the transmission of 5GSM messages during 5GMM procedures?
question_77962.ground_truth: The UE and AMF will not suspend the transmission of 5GSM messages related to other PDU session(s) during a service request procedure for re-establishing user-plane resources of PDU session(s), as long as the UE is in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode and the procedure does not include PDU session status IE or Allowed PDU session status IE. Additionally, the UE and AMF do not suspend the transmission of 5GSM messages if the 5GMM procedure is piggybacking 5GSM messages.

question_77963.question: What is the format used for storing the short term filter parameters in the GSM enhanced full rate codec?

question_77964.question: In what mode is the MS required to select a CAG cell with a CAG-ID present in the "Allowed CAG list"?
question_77964.ground_truth: The MS is required to select the CAG cell if the UE is in Automatic network selection mode and the CAG cell with a CAG-ID present in the "Allowed CAG list" becomes available.

question_77965.question: In what order should the MME candidates be tried for selection?
question_77965.ground_truth: The MME candidates should be tried in the order they are given, as topological closeness is not a factor in MME selection.

question_77967.question: What is the difference between a shared and non-shared NSSI?
question_77967.ground_truth: A non-shared NSSI is dedicated to one NSI and not shared as a constituent by two or more NSSIs, while a shared NSSI can be shared by two or more NSSIs.

question_77968.question: What type of observables are provided by RTK Observations in the assistance data?
question_77968.ground_truth: RTK Observations provides the GNSS receiver with all primary observables, including pseudo-range, phase-range, phase-range rate, and carrier-to-noise ratio.

question_77969.question: What is the condition that the EN-DC UE must meet when transmitting an event triggered measurement report as specified in clause 4.6.2.1.5-1 of the test requirement?
question_77969.ground_truth: The EN-DC UE must transmit an event triggered measurement report with a measurement reporting delay less than 920 ms from the beginning of time period T2, and the rate of correct events observed during repeated tests must be at least 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_77970.question: What is the requirement for the H(e)NB to authenticate the SeGW?
question_77970.ground_truth: The H(e)NB shall authenticate the SeGW based on the SeGW's certificate.

question_77972.question: What should the MCData client do upon receiving a non-200 MSRP response to the MSRP SEND request?
question_77972.ground_truth: The MCData client should handle the error as specified in IETF RFC 4975 and indicate to the MCData user that the SDS message or the SDS disposition notification could not be sent.

question_77974.question: What is the purpose of the test procedure in 4.5A.2B.2.2?
question_77974.ground_truth: The purpose of the test procedure in 4.5A.2B.2.2 is to establish multiple PDN connections in S1 mode after the first PDN connection is established during the ATTACH to EPS procedure.

question_77975.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a 200 (OK) response for a security association protected REGISTER request registering a public user identity with the associated contact address?
question_77975.ground_truth: The UE should establish a new set of security associations and use them for further messages sent towards the P-CSCF. If there are additional sets of security associations available, the UE can either use them or use the newly established set of security associations.

question_77976.question: What should be resolved in the core network to properly implement in-bound connected mode handover from a non-CSG cell to a CSG cell and vice versa?
question_77976.ground_truth: The core network should resolve connected mode access control, access control for different access modes, and routing of S1AP message to the target HeNB GW/HeNB for in-bound handover to a CSG cell.

question_77977.question: In which options described in this solution can the same K~PC5-COM~ key be reused if the Remote UE re-connects to the same Relay UE?
question_77977.ground_truth: The same K~PC5-COM~ key can be reused in Option 2 if the Remote UE re-connects to the same Relay UE without having the Relay UE connect to the PKMF to get a new K~PC5-COM~ key. However, in Solution #21, no message authentication code is included in the Direct Communication Request.

question_77978.question: What is evaluated during the vendor accreditation process for network product development and network product life cycle management?
question_77978.ground_truth: The security relevant part of the vendor network product development and network product life cycle management processes is evaluated during the vendor accreditation process by the SECAM Accreditation Body. The vendor will define their own processes and describe them in written format. During an audit, the processes will be evaluated and their application on development activities in practice will be verified.

question_77979.question: Which REST design principle states that the server is stateless and does not store client context?
question_77979.ground_truth: Stateless servers is a REST design principle that states that the server is stateless and does not store client context.

question_77980.question: In what scenario are interactivity event notifications particularly useful?
question_77980.ground_truth: Interactivity event notifications provide dynamic indications of the occurrence of interactivity events, and related timing information. They are particularly useful in real-time events, such as a time-out called during a live football game.

question_77981.question: In the scenario where the mobile station supports event-based FANR, what triggers the mobile station to initiate the FANR procedure?
question_77981.ground_truth: In the scenario where the mobile station supports event-based FANR, the mobile station initiates the FANR procedure whenever an out-of-sequence condition is detected or the RLC/MAC header of a radio block for data transfer is correctly received but the RLC data part is corrupted.

question_77983.question: What actions trigger an update of the CS Registration status in the HSS?
question_77983.ground_truth: The CS Registration status is updated when there is a change in a user's CS location data, such as when a user roams into a VLR area that s/he is not allowed to have access, or when the user manually cancels the CS registration.

question_77984.question: What should the NAS do if the event which triggered the access attempt was a request to re-establish the user-plane resources for an existing PDU session, and the NAS did not initiate the service request procedure?
question_77984.ground_truth: Upon receiving an indication from the lower layers that the barring is alleviated for the access category, the NAS may initiate the service request procedure as specified in subclause~5.6.1, if still needed.

question_77986.question: How are analytics exchanged between PLMNs in 5G roaming architecture?
question_77986.ground_truth: The NF consumer in the HPLMN can retrieve analytics from the VPLMN via the H-RE-NWDAF and V-RE-NWDAF in both HPLMN and VPLMN. Similarly, the NF consumer in the VPLMN can retrieve analytics from the HPLMN via the V-RE-NWDAF in VPLMN and H-RE-NWDAF in HPLMN.

question_77987.question: What is the requirement for the S5 interface to fulfill in terms of accessing multiple PDNs?
question_77987.ground_truth: The S5 interface shall allow access to multiple PDNs, and it shall be possible to allow a UE to connect to different packet data networks.

question_77988.question: How are the measured BRIR positions passed to the mpegh3daLocalSetupInformation() in MPEG-H 3DA?
question_77988.ground_truth: The measured BRIR positions are passed to the mpegh3daLocalSetupInformation() as specified in ISO/IEC 23008-3, clause 4.8.2.2 in MPEG-H 3DA.

question_77989.question: What is the role of Intermodulation (IM) products in terms of the impact of the wideband transmitter on legacy frequency planning?
question_77989.ground_truth: Intermodulation (IM) products are the reason for the maximum carrier separation in a wideband transmitter, measuring 1 MHz, which impacts the legacy frequency planning. Due to this limitation, a system point-of-view requires a minimum carrier separation to ensure a certain quality level in a cell.

question_77990.question: What are some types of network-assisted GNSS methods?
question_77990.ground_truth: Some types of network-assisted GNSS methods include UE-Assisted, where the UE performs GNSS measurements and sends these measurements to the LMF for position calculation, and UE-Based, where the UE performs GNSS measurements and calculates its own location using additional measurements from non-GNSS sources and assistance data from the LMF.

question_77991.question: What is the name of the message that is used for unsolicited capability transfer in SLPP procedures?

question_77993.question: Where can an AS be hosted in a PIN network?
question_77993.ground_truth: An AS can be hosted on a locally connected hardware hosting platform, embedded in a PIN Element with Gateway Capability, or as an on-site extension of an in-network service hosted on a hosting environment like an edge computing platform.

question_77994.question: What procedures should the UE perform when upper layers request a PDCP entity re-establishment?
question_77994.ground_truth: The UE should follow the procedures in TS 38.323, clauses 5.1.2, 5.2.2.1, 5.3, 5.4.1, 5.4.2, and 7.1.

question_77995.question: What key issue does Solution 2 address for the outbound roaming user?
question_77995.ground_truth: Solution 2 addresses the key issue where the HPLMN fully supports IMS and SeDoC, but the VPLMN of the outbound roaming user does not support IMS or ICS. The enhancement is to provide HLR services towards the VLR in the VPLMN using an interworking function.

question_77997.question: What are the emergency session handling functions that an AS should provide if it is the first point that identifies an IMS emergency session?
question_77997.ground_truth: If the AS is the first point that identifies an IMS emergency session, it should detect the emergency session establishment request, verify that the UE is not roaming, optionally obtain the location, prioritize the emergency session, provide the TEL URI associated with the public user identity in the session establishment request if known and not already present, check the validity of the caller TEL URI if provided by the UE, and mark the request as an emergency session request.

question_77998.question: What reference point is used between H(e)NB and DF2 for LI events and event information in UMTS HNBs?
question_77998.ground_truth: The X2 reference point is used between H(e)NB and DF2 for LI events and event information in UMTS HNBs.

question_77999.question: In which cases does UE ignore PDCCH skipping?
question_77999.ground_truth: UE ignores PDCCH skipping when on all serving cells of the corresponding Cell Group when SR is sent and is pending, during contention resolution timer running on SpCell, and during monitoring of the RAR/MsgB window on SpCell.

question_78001.question: What are the requirements for packet duplication and elimination for UPF in 5G systems?
question_78001.ground_truth: The UPF supports packet duplication in downlink direction and elimination in uplink direction by the UP protocol. Specifically, for QoS Flows of a PDU session, the PSA UPF duplicates the downlink packet of the Qos Flow and assigns the same GTP-U sequence number to them. These duplicated packets are transmitted to I-UPF1 and I-UPF2 via N9 Tunnel 1 and N9 Tunnel 2 separately. Each I-UPF forwards the packet with the same GTP-U sequence number as received from the UPF to NG-RAN via N3 Tunnel 1 and N3 Tunnel 2 respectively. The NG-RAN eliminates the duplicated packet based on the GTP-U sequence number. For uplink traffic, the NG-RAN duplicates the packet of the QoS Flow for the UE and the UPF eliminates the duplicated packet based on the GTP-U sequence number.

question_78002.question: What is a mandatory authentication method for Trusted WLAN access in 3GPP-based access authentication?
question_78002.ground_truth: 3GPP-based access authentication as defined in TS 33.402 is mandatory for Trusted WLAN access.

question_78003.question: What is the reporting range of RSRQ defined in 3GPP TS 36.133?
question_78003.ground_truth: The reporting range of RSRQ is defined from -19.5 dB to -3 with 0.5 dB resolution.

question_78004.question: Which function is used to protect transmitted data against non-authorized third-party alteration?

question_78005.question: Which non-3GPP service is not utilized in Region 2 and thus not taken into account in study of US 600 MHz band?

question_78010.question: What does the term "Bit-rate change" refer to in the context of the present document?
question_78010.ground_truth: Bit-rate change refers to the change of the codec mode bit-rates for a given (HR/FR) channel mode.

question_78011.question: What is the purpose of the MC service server sending an MC service emergency alert cancel request towards the MC service clients of the affiliated group members?
question_78011.ground_truth: This is to notify the relevant MC service clients of the cancellation of an emergency alert request.

question_78012.question: What is the maximum number of certificates that the SeGW can send in a certificate path?
question_78012.ground_truth: The SeGW shall not send certificate paths containing more than four certificates.

question_78014.question: How does the EEC use the "General context holding time" to make an ACR request?
question_78014.ground_truth: The EEC can use the "General context holding time" to make a timely ACR request by performing an ACR launching procedure when it predicts to move to the service area of the discovered EAS within the time indicated in the IE.

question_78015.question: What conditions are required for the UE to be in State 3A-RF-DC2 in this test?
question_78015.ground_truth: The UE is required to support DC Split DRB bearer and to be in State 3A-RF-DC2.

question_78016.question: What is the preferred method for transferring RCI information to an AF (Application Function) located outside the operator network?
question_78016.ground_truth: In case of RCI transfer to the TDF/AF without PCRF involvement, tunneling is preferred. This ensures that DSCP markings used in the operator's transport networks are not affected, and the AF located outside the operator's network can interpret the received congestion notification.

question_78017.question: What is the role of the SMF in sending local DN notification information to the UE during the local PSA insertion/relocation/delete procedure?
question_78017.ground_truth: The SMF supports to send the local DN notification information to the UE using PDU Session Modification during the local PSA insertion/relocation/delete procedure.

question_78018.question: What is the role of the MB-SMF in supporting secure MBS traffic delivery between the UE and the NG-RAN?
question_78018.ground_truth: The MB-SMF is responsible for deriving the MBS session key and providing it to the UE and the NG-RAN. It also selects the security algorithms for protecting the MBS data traffic over the air.

question_78021.question: What is the purpose of the Neighbour Removal Function in the ANR?
question_78021.ground_truth: The Neighbour Removal Function in the ANR is responsible for removing outdated NCRs (Neighbour Cell Relations) from the NCRT.

question_78022.question: When does the MAC entity consider the Random Access procedure successfully completed?
question_78022.ground_truth: When the MAC entity receives the Random Access Response and the following description of events occur.

question_78023.question: What is the purpose of entering the UE into loopback test mode in the presence of HSDPA?
question_78023.ground_truth: The purpose of entering the UE into loopback test mode in the presence of HSDPA is to start the loopback test and verify the performance of the UE in the HSDPA mode.

question_78024.question: What action does the Proxy-Gn take after receiving the Update PDP Context Request from the GGSN during the handover from GERAN/UTRAN to EGAN?
question_78024.ground_truth: The Proxy-Gn stores relevant parameters, informs the GGSN to switch the user plane to the EGANC, and sends Create PDP Context Response to the serving EGANC GA-SM.

question_78026.question: What information does the MaxNumberofUEs data type represent in network slicing?
question_78026.ground_truth: The MaxNumberofUEs data type represents the maximum number of concurrent UEs supported by the network slice. This data type can be used in the FeasibilityCheckAndReservationJob IOC and in other network slicing operations to ensure that the network slice can support the required number of UEs.

question_78028.question: What is the definition of a "Geographical Identifier" in the context of this study?
question_78028.ground_truth: A Geographical Identifier (GI) is an identifier of a geographical area defined within a country or territory, described in a geospatial or civic location manner, or in an operator-specific format. It is generated by the access network or an IMS node and is used to identify the geographical location of a cell.

question_78030.question: What is the role of network capability exposure (flexibility enabler 3) in 5G?
question_78030.ground_truth: Network capability exposure provides access to the network capabilities needed by 3rd party ISPs/ICPs. It allows 3rd parties to dynamically customize a dedicated network slice for diverse use cases and access various network capabilities, making it an essential enabler for 5G.

question_78032.question: What does the number "x.y.z" in the Technical Specification represent?
question_78032.ground_truth: The number "x.y.z" in the Technical Specification represents the version of the document, with "x" indicating the level of approval, "y" representing changes of substance, and "z" denoting editorial changes.

question_78033.question: Who can stop the periodic reporting by the FRMCS System in the Request for identities in a certain area use case?
question_78033.ground_truth: Only the FRMCS User, the application or the External System initially requesting periodic reporting can stop the periodic reporting by the FRMCS System.

question_78034.question: What is the reference sensitivity level defined in 7.2.1 for the BS?
question_78034.ground_truth: The reference sensitivity level is the minimum mean power received at the antenna connector at which the BER shall not exceed the specific value indicated by the BS BS.

question_78035.question: What is the message sent by the SS in response to a DHCP Solicit message when the UE requested for IP address only?
question_78035.ground_truth: The SS responds by Advertise message including IP address(es) of P-CSCF servers when the UE requested for IP address only in the DHCP Solicit message.

question_78036.question: Based on Solution 9, what is the role of the ICS-IWF in supporting Single Service Profile in IMS when there is outbound roaming into a legacy network without any IMS/ICS/SeDoc support?
question_78036.ground_truth: In this case, the ICS-IWF converts the IMS service settings into a CS service profile, which is further provided to the local MSC-Server. The MSC-Server in the VPLMN will then execute the services in CS based on this profile.

question_78038.question: What is the role of the V-NEF in HR-SBO PDU sessions as per clause 6.7?
question_78038.ground_truth: The AF may send an AF request to the V-NEF to influence traffic routing and support Edge Relocation. The steps involving PCF are skipped in this case.

question_78039.question: What is the role of the consumer in the MDA process?
question_78039.ground_truth: The consumer provides training data for the ML model used in the MDA process and may also provide validation data to further train the ML model.

question_78041.question: What should be done with the UUAA context if the NF service consumer removes the successful UUAA result during the UUAA Revocation procedure?
question_78041.ground_truth: The NEF (UAS-NF) shall remove the UUAA context in this case.

question_78042.question: What is the property of a transaction that ensures the data within the database is consistent at the begin and commit or after roll back?

question_78044.question: What value shall the "ref" attribute contain in the "ack" element in the "application/EmergencyCallData.Control+xml" MIME body part if the UE receives a 486, 600, or 603 response to the INVITE request in the procedures specified in subclause 5.1.6.8?
question_78044.ground_truth: The "ref" attribute in the "ack" element shall contain the Content-ID of the MIME body part containing the MSD sent by the UE.

question_78045.question: What entity is responsible for authorizing a MBSR node to operate as a mobile IAB node?
question_78045.ground_truth: The OAM system of the serving PLMN

question_78046.question: What is the requirement when the SIM simulator sends error code 9804 as a reaction to an instruction from the ME?
question_78046.ground_truth: The ME shall give an appropriate MMI indication, such as a notification to the user.

question_78047.question: What information does the UE include in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message to indicate the current 5G NAS security context value?
question_78047.ground_truth: The UE includes the eKSI indicating the 5G NAS security context value in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.

question_78048.question: What is the role of the HPLMN supported mechanism list in the authentication process between the EEC and EES?
question_78048.ground_truth: The HPLMN supported mechanism list is a priority-ordered list of authentication mechanisms that the EEC obtains during registration with the HPLMN. This list is used by the EEC to choose an authentication mechanism to send to the ECS.

question_78050.question: What is the potential requirement for the 3GPP management system related to tracking activities of an internal or external user of the system?

question_78052.question: What should the old BSS follow in determining whether to include the "Target cell radio information" field element in the HANDOVER REQUIRED message?
question_78052.ground_truth: The old BSS should only send the "Target cell radio information" field element when it sends a single cell in the "Cell Identifier List (preferred)" in the HANDOVER REQUIRED message.

question_78053.question: What does the Di field in the PSI-Based SDU Discard Activation/Deactivation MAC CE indicate?
question_78053.ground_truth: The Di field in the PSI-Based SDU Discard Activation/Deactivation MAC CE indicates the activation/deactivation status of the PSI-based SDU discard of DRB i.

question_78054.question: What is one characteristic of the Websocket protocol?
question_78054.ground_truth: The Websocket protocol relies on the client to open the Websocket, and provides bidirectional communications over a TCP connection without having to open multiple HTTP connections.

question_78055.question: What is the requirement for each measured E-UTRA and NB-IoT carrier for the throughput to be?
question_78055.ground_truth: The throughput for each measured E-UTRA and NB-IoT carrier should be greater than or equal to 95% of the maximum throughput of the reference measurement channel.

question_78059.question: What is the Certificate Signing Request defined as in the 3GPP-m1 API?
question_78059.ground_truth: The Certificate Signing Request is defined as a Base64-encoded DER certificate request or certificate, including leading and trailing encapsulation boundary lines in the Privacy-Enhanced Mail (PEM) textual format.

question_78060.question: What are the post-conditions for V2X Road Safety service usage in the described scenario?
question_78060.ground_truth: The post-conditions for V2X Road Safety service usage are that Jeremy (the driver) changes the route to the destination and saves time to travel, while Vehicle D drives cautiously and reduces the potential risk of pedestrian fatality.

question_78061.question: What is the role of the centralized Edge Enabler Server in relation to edge application service APIs publish and discovery?
question_78061.ground_truth: The centralized Edge Enabler Server provides functions for edge application servers to onboard, publish, discover, and charge for their service APIs. It supports the onboarding of edge application servers, publishing of their service APIs, discovery of available service APIs, and charging for service API invocations. The Edge Enabler Server acts as a core function for CAPIF, allowing different edge application servers within and across the Edge Data Network to access each other's service APIs.

question_78062.question: What is the general solution for signaling support of multiple bands in the context of extended bands and legacy bands?
question_78062.ground_truth: The general solution for signaling support of multiple bands in the context of extended bands and legacy bands is to append extension fields to the SIB1 message and the SIB2 information element in RRC signaling, which carries the information about the harmonized band, such as Band 26, while the existing field carries information about the legacy band, such as Band 5.

question_78064.question: What type of E-UTRA FD-FDD CE UE does this test apply to?
question_78064.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA FD-FDD CE UE, including both BL/CE and non-BL/CE UE.

question_78065.question: What are the new requirements needed to support the use case of haptic feedback for a personal exclusion zone in dangerous remote environments?
question_78065.ground_truth: The new requirements needed to support the use case of haptic feedback for a personal exclusion zone in dangerous remote environments include the 5G system shall be able to support real-time multi-modal communication for interactive haptic control and feedback with KPIs.

question_78066.question: What is the overall BD-rate decrease of SHVC compared to simulcast for 1.5x spatial scalability with deltaQP being 2, specifically for the IRAP non-aligned test case?
question_78066.ground_truth: The overall BD-rate decrease of SHVC compared to simulcast for 1.5x spatial scalability with deltaQP being 2 in the IRAP non-aligned test case is 27.9%.

question_78067.question: What should the mobile station do upon receiving an IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message containing a TBF starting time which has already expired?
question_78067.ground_truth: The mobile station shall ignore the indicated TBF starting time, immediately start timer T3190, and switch to the assigned PDCH.

question_78068.question: What action does the SMF take when it receives the notification response from the AF, indicating that buffering of uplink traffic to the target DNAI is no more needed as traffic to the target DNAI /EAS is now authorized by the AF?
question_78068.ground_truth: The SMF updates the PSA2 by indicating the PSA2 to send the buffered uplink packets and to stop buffering, then releases PSA1.

question_78071.question: What is the role of the Policy Control Function (PCF) in 5G architecture?
question_78071.ground_truth: The Policy Control Function (PCF) is responsible for policy control decisions and flow based charging control functionalities in 5G architecture. It provides policies to the SMF, such as policies for application and service data flow detection, gating, QoS, flow based charging, traffic steering control, and usage monitoring control.

question_78072.question: What is the role of the MAC entity in this process?
question_78072.ground_truth: The MAC entity determines the timing and duration of the SL-SCH and SL-PRS transmission based on the sidelink grant received for the PDCCH (Physical Downlink Control Channel) occasion.

question_78073.question: What should be the expected final state of the MS in the test procedure of the eMLPP registration?
question_78073.ground_truth: The expected final state of the MS in the test procedure of the eMLPP registration is "Idle, updated".

question_78076.question: What is the maximum number of diversions permitted for each communication that a service provider should define?

question_78077.question: What is the purpose of the document in describing the CAPIF related information elements for service API invocation requests and responses?
question_78077.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to provide a high-level overview of the procedure for service API access control, while leaving the details of the service API invocation request and response to be defined in other documents.

question_78079.question: Which operating band is subject to specific regulations in order to protect GPS, as established in FCC Order DA 20-48?
question_78079.ground_truth: Operation in Band n24 requires additional FCC regulations for protection of GPS.

question_78080.question: What does the first digit in the version number of a 3GPP technical specification or report indicate?
question_78080.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number of a 3GPP technical specification or report indicates the stage of development or approval of the document within the TSG.

question_78081.question: What is the responsibility of the IP Edge/PCEF in PCEF based charging in clause 5.13.3.1?
question_78081.ground_truth: The IP Edge/PCEF initiates a charging session upon IP-CAN session initiation if online charging is applicable for the IP-CAN session and at least one PCC rule is activated. The IP Edge/PCEF may also request credit from the OCS for each charging key of the activated PCC rules.

question_78082.question: What message does the HPLMN ProSe Function send to the ProSe Application Server when the UE indicated it desired application-controlled extension in step~2.a?
question_78082.ground_truth: The Auth Request (ProSe Application ID, Request Type, Application Level Container, Allowed number of suffixes) message.

question_78083.question: How is the n:th PRACH message part scrambling code defined when using long scrambling codes?
question_78083.ground_truth: The n:th PRACH message part scrambling code, denoted Sr-msg,n, where n = 0, 1, ..., 8191, is based on the long scrambling sequence and is defined as Sr-msg,n(i) = Clong,n(i + 4096), i = 0, 1, ..., 38399.

question_78085.question: When will a mobile station send a CP-ERROR message with cause #81 "Invalid Transaction Identifier"?
question_78085.ground_truth: When the mobile station receives a CP-ACK message specifying a Transaction Identifier which is not associated with an active SM transfer.

question_78086.question: What identifier is used by the UTRAN paging coordination function to check if a signaling connection towards the other CN domain already exists for a UE?
question_78086.ground_truth: The Permanent NAS UE Identity IE (i.e. IMSI)

question_78087.question: What is the state established between a user and a serving network domain after the execution of 3G AKA, with ciphering and integrity protection keys CK and IK available at either side, and that can still be given if these keys are converted into Kc to work with a 2G BSS?

question_78089.question: What is the function of the Transport Format Combination Indicator (TFCI) field in FLO?
question_78089.ground_truth: The Transport Format Combination Indicator (TFCI) field in FLO is a layer 1 header that indicates the active TFC (Transport Format Combination) for a radio packet. When a radio packet is received, this is the first to be decoded by the receiver, which can then determine the transport formats for the different transport channels and start the actual decoding.

question_78090.question: What are the responsibilities of an MCData server in the participating role in MCData service?
question_78090.ground_truth: The MCData server performing the participating role is responsible for handling transmission control towards MCData users of the one-to-one and group data communication, interfacing with the group management server for group policy and affiliation status information, relaying the MCData communication messages, and handling reception control to its MCData users of the one-to-one and group data communication.

question_78092.question: What are the initial TWAN specific L2 procedures and who are responsible for performing them?
question_78092.ground_truth: The initial TWAN specific L2 procedures are performed by the TWAN, and these procedures are outside the scope of 3GPP. These procedures may include authentication, authorization and accounting (AAA) related functions, and access point discovery and selection for the UE.

question_78093.question: What is the role of the GTP-U protocol in data transport over the Xn interface?
question_78093.ground_truth: The GTP-U (GPRS Tunneling Protocol User Plane) is a protocol used to transport data over the Xn interface between two NG-RAN nodes. It is responsible for encapsulating IP packets and adding a GTP header for identification and error checking.

question_78094.question: What is the role of the "Ionospheric Model" in the MS-assisted measurement reports conversion process in A-GPS?
question_78094.ground_truth: The "Ionospheric Model" contains the ionospheric parameters which allow the single frequency user to utilize the ionospheric model for computation of the ionospheric delay in the MS-assisted measurement reports conversion process in A-GPS.

question_78095.question: What is one of the quality features contributing to the QoE in a spatial audio reproduction system?
question_78095.ground_truth: Localization accuracy (azimuth, elevation, distance) is one of the quality features contributing to the QoE in a spatial audio reproduction system.

question_78096.question: What conditions should be met for the intra frequency measurement report trigger by event 1A?
question_78096.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay should be within the required limit of 1040 ms. This delay is the sum of 956.2 ms and 80 ms delay uncertainty.

question_78097.question: What is the purpose of the Delta Synchronization IRP interface?
question_78097.ground_truth: The Delta Synchronization IRP interface allows an IRPManager to request only the data that has changed since a specific point in time, reducing the amount of data that needs to be transferred to re-establish synchronization.

question_78098.question: What is the maximum search time assumed when the target cell is not known at the time of handover?
question_78098.ground_truth: The maximum search time is 80 ms when the target cell is not known at the time of handover.

question_78099.question: What list does the UE store the PLMN identity in when it receives a PLMN not allowed message?
question_78099.ground_truth: The UE stores the PLMN identity in the "forbidden PLMN list" when it receives a PLMN not allowed message.

question_78100.question: What is the general quality requirement for Application A in terms of speech coding?
question_78100.ground_truth: The general quality requirement for Application A is to be better than ITU-T Recommendation G.722 wideband codec at 48 kbit/s.

question_78101.question: Which ID is mandatory and present in the HandoverRequestAcknowledge message?
question_78101.ground_truth: 'ID id-AMF-UE-NGAP-ID', 'ID id-RAN-UE-NGAP-ID', and 'ID id-PDUSessionResourceAdmittedList' are mandatory and present in the HandoverRequestAcknowledge message.

question_78102.question: What should be set as the value of mcgRecoveryFailureCause if the fast MCG recovery procedure fails due to expiry of timer T316?

question_78103.question: What should the MCData client do upon receiving a display indication before timer TDU1 expires?
question_78103.ground_truth: The MCData client should stop timer TDU1 and send a delivered and read notification.

question_78104.question: Which frequency range requires both conducted and OTA requirements in the NR BS specification?
question_78104.ground_truth: FR1 requires both conducted and OTA requirements in the NR BS specification.

question_78105.question: What is the length of the OCTET STRING SuccessfulHandoverReport-Container in the SONInformation-ExtIEs NGAP-PROTOCOL-IES context?
question_78105.ground_truth: It is a maximum of 16 bytes in length.

question_78106.question: What does the S-EAS do in Phase IV (Post-ACR Clean up) of an ACR initiated by the S-EAS?
question_78106.ground_truth: The S-EAS transfers the application context to the CAS, determined in step 3, and sends the ACR information notification (ACR complete) message to the EEC to confirm that the ACR has completed.

question_78108.question: What should be the value of the <min-length-alias> element within the <common> element?
question_78108.ground_truth: The value of the <min-length-alias> element should be between 0 and 255.

question_78110.question: What is the purpose of the message type "request SECONDARY PDP context ACTIVATION reject"?
question_78110.ground_truth: This message is sent by the MS to the network to reject the request of a secondary PDP context activation initiated by the network.

question_78111.question: In the 3GPP standard, what does RP-GW stand for?

question_78112.question: Which interfaces are replaced with their starred counterparts in the LMF based solution for roaming and non-roaming UEs?
question_78112.ground_truth: In the LMF based solution for roaming and non-roaming UEs, the NLs interface between the AMF and LMF is replaced by an NLs* interface, and the NLg interface between an AMF and GMLC is replaced by an NLg* interface between an LMF and GMLC.

question_78113.question: What are the two USSD-based alternatives for call origination using the I1 reference point?
question_78113.ground_truth: The two USSD-based alternatives for call origination using the I1 reference point are the two-step procedure for setting up of Session Control Signalling Path and the Bearer Control Signalling session, and the combined one-step procedure.

question_78114.question: What type of identifier is used as the temporary identifier for the UE that is common to both 3GPP and non-3GPP access in 5G System?

question_78116.question: When must the GGSN send a Diameter Accounting-Request INTERIM-UPDATE message for deferred IPv4 address allocation?
question_78116.ground_truth: The GGSN must send a Diameter Accounting-Request INTERIM-UPDATE message to inform the accounting server about the allocated IPv4 address when the IPv4 address is allocated or re-allocated.

question_78117.question: What action should be taken if a BSSAP+-MOBILE-STATUS message is received with an unknown or unforeseen message type?
question_78117.ground_truth: The message should be ignored and a BSSAP+-MOBILE-STATUS message with the Gs Cause Value set to "message unknown" and the Erroneous message IE containing the received message should be returned.

question_78118.question: In Solution 19, what does the Application Function do for an ad-hoc group?
question_78118.ground_truth: The Application Function creates an ad-hoc group of a collection of UEs, based on common use cases or applications. It assigns an (external) Group ID to the collection of UEs and provisions this group information to 5GC either directly or via NEF.

question_78120.question: What is the type of data in the "En-gNB-EUTRA-NRCellResourceCoordinationReqIEs" sequence that is defined as mandatory and has a presence of mandatory?

question_78121.question: What action does the SMF take if it receives the clock drifting from the UPF and the received Time Domain matches the Time Domain information within the "tscaiTimeDom" attribute included in the PCC rule?
question_78121.ground_truth: The SMF may determine the time offset and cumulative rate ratio (when available) based on received Time Domain information and adjust the TSCAI information as described above.

question_78124.question: What is the definition of Pmax,c,AC?
question_78124.ground_truth: Maximum carrier output power measured per antenna connector

question_78125.question: What is the effect of non-zero in equation (190) on the amplitude?
question_78125.ground_truth: If is non-zero, the amplitude is adjusted, and a small random component is added to the phase.

question_78126.question: Which types of E-UTRA HD-FDD UE does the test applicability in section 8.1.39.2 apply to?
question_78126.ground_truth: The test applies to all types of E-UTRA HD-FDD UE release 13 and forward with supports CEModeB, DRX and intra-frequency SI acquisition for HO.

question_78127.question: What is one requirement for the communication path between UE1 and UE2 when performing Ranging/Sidelink positioning?
question_78127.ground_truth: The communication path between UE1 and UE2 must be established before Ranging/Sidelink positioning can take place. This can be done through existing technologies, such as direct PC5 communication or communication via UE-to-UE relay.

question_78128.question: How many non-consecutive DTX subframes are allowed in each specified time period for the event "Deactivation" to be successful in the inter-band PCC(FDD) and SCells scenario?
question_78128.ground_truth: Up to 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes are allowed in each specified time period for the event "Deactivation" to be successful in the inter-band PCC(FDD) and SCells scenario.

question_78132.question: What are the four purposes of camping on a cell in RRC_IDLE and RRC_INACTIVE states?
question_78132.ground_truth: Camping on a cell in RRC_IDLE and RRC_INACTIVE states enables the UE to receive system information, access the network for establishing or resuming RRC connections, receive paging messages, and deliver data from the network, and receive ETWS and CMAS notifications.

question_78133.question: What action should the receiving PDCP entity take if the integrity verification fails when performing deciphering and integrity verification of the PDCP Data PDU?
question_78133.ground_truth: The receiving PDCP entity should indicate the integrity verification failure to the upper layer and discard the PDCP Data PDU, considering it as not received.

question_78134.question: What information must the RNC include in the RABs Release Item IE in the IU RELEASE COMPLETE message when the release was initiated by the UTRAN?
question_78134.ground_truth: The RNC must include the available DL/UL GTP-PDU Sequence Number(s) to be reported for each RAB in the RAB Release Item IE in the IU RELEASE COMPLETE message.

question_78135.question: What is the difference between EARFCN and NR-ARFCN?
question_78135.ground_truth: EARFCN (E-UTRAN Frequency NR) is a variable that represents the frequency resource allocation in the E-UTRA/E-UTRAN network, while NR-ARFCN (New Radio Absolute Radio Frequency NR) is a variable that represents the frequency resource allocation in the NR network. The EARFCN is defined as a variable that ranges from 0 to 430 by default, while the NR-ARFCN is defined as a variable that ranges from 0 to 1599.

question_78136.question: What are the parameters used to interpret variations in energy efficiency KPI values in 5G networks?
question_78136.ground_truth: The parameters can be classified into demography, topography, and climate classes, which describe the network characteristics with regard to population density, geographical conditions, and climate zones. These parameters can be further classified into subclasses, such as dense urban, urban, sub-urban, rural, or unpopulated scenarios in the demography class.

question_78137.question: How are the pulse-position index and the pulse-number index determined in the pulse indexing method?
question_78137.ground_truth: The pulse-position index is determined based on the pulse distribution of pulse positions on the track, and the pulse-number index is determined based on the quantity of pulses in each pulse position.

question_78138.question: What are the pre-conditions that should be met for VAL service group communications associated with a certain VAL service group to use a pre-created MBS session?
question_78138.ground_truth: The pre-conditions include the NRM server deciding to use an MBS session for VAL service group communications based on transport only mode, performing MB-SMF discovery and selection, having registered NRM clients that belong to the same VAL service group, and the NRM server being aware whether to request the creation of the MBS service server with or without dynamic PCC rule.

question_78141.question: What is the role of the interleaver for HS-SICH type 2?
question_78141.ground_truth: The interleaver for HS-SICH type 2 is used to scramble the bits of the HS-SICH information field in order to increase the robustness against errors in the radio channel.

question_78143.question: What modifications will the MCPTT client make to the stored current call type upon an MCPTT emergency group call?
question_78143.ground_truth: The MCPTT client will set the stored current call type to "EMERGENCY GROUP CALL" when an MCPTT emergency group call is initiated.

question_78144.question: What should an MS do if it is in A/Gb mode and receives a page in a different network type?
question_78144.ground_truth: The MS shall perform a normal or combined routing area updating procedure depending on the network operation mode in the current RA.

question_78145.question: What is the goal of NG-RAN positioning operations?
question_78145.ground_truth: The goal of NG-RAN positioning operations is to support positioning of a target UE by obtaining location related measurements for the UE and computing a location estimate and possibly additional information like velocity.

question_78146.question: What is the action taken by the FAGF when the AMF sends an N2 PDU Session Request (N2 SM information received from SMF, NAS message) message to the FAGF in non-roaming or LBO scenarios?
question_78146.ground_truth: The FAGF may trigger an access-specific resource modification towards the 5G-RG.

question_78147.question: What is the definition of "Feeder link" as used in the document?
question_78147.ground_truth: A Feeder link is the wireless link between the NTN-Gateway and the satellite.

question_78148.question: What action should the Node B take if the Information Type Item IE is set to "GANSS Information" and any change has occurred in the specified GANSS Information item?
question_78148.ground_truth: The Node B should initiate the Information Reporting procedure for that specific GANSS Information item.
