question_78150.question: What should be the value of the "state" attribute within each <contact> element after the S-CSCF processes the registration request?
question_78150.ground_truth: The value should be set to "active".

question_78151.question: What is the recommended size of the referenced alternative ring tone in order not to delay communication establishment?
question_78151.ground_truth: It is recommended that the size of the referenced alternative ring tone is small.

question_78152.question: What is the purpose of the Channel Mode Modify procedure in step 1a of the test?
question_78152.ground_truth: The Channel Mode Modify procedure is used to change the active codec set to a specific set of codecs and decision thresholds and hysteresis values as specified in the test. This is done to ensure that the correct coding is used in different scenarios.

question_78153.question: What should the UE do if cell selection or reselection occurs while T309 or T302 is running and if the UE is connected to 5GC?
question_78153.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T309 for all access categories if it is running, perform the actions upon leaving RRC_INACTIVE if it is in RRC_INACTIVE and T302 is running, or stop timer T302 if it is running and perform the actions as specified in 5.3.16.4.

question_78154.question: What is the purpose of PUCCH resource indicator field in DCI formats for determining a PUCCH resource for HARQ-ACK transmission?
question_78154.ground_truth: The PUCCH resource indicator field in DCI formats is used to determine the PUCCH resource for HARQ-ACK transmission, indicating a same slot for the PUCCH transmission. It is used in conjunction with a PUCCH resource set provided to the UE for HARQ-ACK transmission.

question_78155.question: What is the issue described in use case 1 and 2 in terms of connected mode?
question_78155.ground_truth: The issue described in use case 1 and 2 for connected mode is similar to the one in idle mode, where the network may want to restrict the UE's access to the PS domain while allowing access to the CS domain during network congestion.

question_78156.question: What indication may the MME include in the Bearer Modify Request message to the eNodeB regarding traffic offload to WLAN?
question_78156.ground_truth: The MME may include an indication whether the traffic of this PDN Connection is allowed to be offloaded to WLAN in the Bearer Modify Request message to the eNodeB.

question_78157.question: What is a capability of a 5G system with satellite access?
question_78157.ground_truth: A 5G system with satellite access can support mechanisms to authorize a UE to use the S&F satellite operation.

question_78159.question: In the Pool Centric scenario, what is the risk for incorrect CS/PS coordination?
question_78159.ground_truth: The risk for incorrect CS/PS coordination is that the operator selection is made independently in the PS domain by source RAN and in the CS domain by target BSS.

question_78160.question: What are the essential parameters in the "QoS Sustainability" Analytics ID request?
question_78160.ground_truth: The essential parameters in the "QoS Sustainability" Analytics ID request are Analytics ID, Target of Analytics Reporting, Analytics Filter Information, Location information, Optional maximum number of objects, Analytics target period, and Reporting Threshold(s).

question_78161.question: What is the role of the location management server in the MBMS system?
question_78161.ground_truth: The location management server is responsible for providing the latest location information of the MC service user to the MBMS management server.

question_78162.question: What is one of the post-conditions upon end of the DTS session?
question_78162.ground_truth: The UE returns to normal conditions (i.e., use of normal data service).

question_78164.question: What is the role of FQ-CSID in partial failure handling?
question_78164.ground_truth: FQ-CSID is an opaque parameter used to identify the failed unit during partial failure handling. It is exchanged between peer nodes during PDN Connection establishment and relocation.

question_78165.question: What is the requirement for the measurement report delay when L3 filtering is used?
question_78165.ground_truth: When L3 filtering is used, an additional delay can be expected in the event triggered measurement reporting delay.

question_78166.question: In what situation can the mobile station delay the location updating procedure in the new location area?
question_78166.ground_truth: The mobile station may delay the location updating procedure in the new location area if it is initiating an emergency call but moves to a different location area due to cell re-selection or redirection by the network.

question_78167.question: What is the purpose of RIM Information Transfer between two RAN nodes via 5GC?
question_78167.ground_truth: The purpose of RIM Information Transfer between two RAN nodes via 5GC is to enable the transfer of RIM information. The AMF does not interpret the transferred RIM information.

question_78168.question: What is the overall delays measured test requirement for the initial cell identification time (Tidentify,E-UTRAN FDD) in this procedure?
question_78168.ground_truth: The overall delays measured shall be less than a total of 3840 ms in this test case.

question_78169.question: What signalling information is exchanged using the M1 reference point?
question_78169.ground_truth: The M1 reference point is used for MBMS data delivery between MBMS-GW and E-UTRAN/UTRAN using IP Multicast.

question_78170.question: What message does the MS send to the CN to release the call when call clearing is initiated by the MS?
question_78170.ground_truth: The MS sends the Disconnect message to the CN to release the call.

question_78172.question: What message type is used for the RP-DATA message sent from the network to the mobile station?
question_78172.ground_truth: The message type for the RP-DATA message sent from the network to the mobile station is 010.

question_78173.question: In what ways can the network architecture be enhanced to facilitate FDD-TDD joint operation?
question_78173.ground_truth: Network architecture enhancements to facilitate FDD-TDD joint operation can include, but are not limited to, accommodations for non-ideal backhaul in joint operation scenarios. However, keeping the minimum network architecture change is still of interest from operators' perspective.

question_78174.question: Which group provides a quasi-deterministic channel model that addresses various challenges such as shadowing, spatial consistency, environment dynamics, spherical wave modelling, dual mobility Doppler model, and polarization?

question_78176.question: What are the two mechanisms for QoS and policy differentiation in the case of one PDU Session serving multiple PINEs?
question_78176.ground_truth: The two mechanisms for QoS and policy differentiation in the case of one PDU Session serving multiple PINEs are during UE-initiated PDU Session Modification procedure with PINE information and during network-initiated PDU Session Modification procedure for a PEGC.

question_78178.question: What is the purpose of the MME in the LIPA architecture?
question_78178.ground_truth: The MME is responsible for sending LHN parameters (e.g. L-GW address) via the S-GW to the L-GW during the handover process.

question_78179.question: Which two parties can initiate the termination of an Automatic Train Protection data communication?
question_78179.ground_truth: The FRMCS User (on-board of the train or in the control center at the track side) can initiate the termination of an Automatic Train Protection data communication.

question_78180.question: What is the purpose of the ID field in BlockResourceRequest-IEs?
question_78180.ground_truth: The ID field in BlockResourceRequest-IEs is used to specify the type of information element (IE) that is contained in the ProtocolIE-Container.

question_78181.question: What should the AMF store upon successful PDU Session Establishment?
question_78181.ground_truth: The AMF stores the access type associated with the PDU Session and the identification of the serving SMF of the UE.

question_78182.question: What is the purpose of the fine gain adjustment in 6.2.3.2.1.2.2?
question_78182.ground_truth: The fine gain adjustment is obtained to compensate for the gain prediction error in the decoded spectral coefficients.

question_78184.question: What is the purpose of the "InitialDP" operation in gsmSSF?
question_78184.ground_truth: The "InitialDP" operation in gsmSSF is used after detection of a TDP-R in the BCSM, to request the gsmSCF for instructions to complete the call.

question_78185.question: What is the purpose of the Announcement service in the technical specification?
question_78185.ground_truth: The Announcement service provides announcement capabilities for use in a Diameter based online or converged charging session. It allows the CCS/OCS to specify that a given announcement be played to a call party in order to deliver charging/billing related notifications.

question_78186.question: What should the SS do after 5 preamble transmission attempts have been received in Test 1?
question_78186.ground_truth: The SS should transmit a random access response containing a random access preamble identifier corresponding to the transmitted random access after 5 preamble transmission attempts have been received by the SS.

question_78187.question: What process is started immediately during activation for intra-cell channel change?
question_78187.ground_truth: Transmission and reception on the main channel in the indicated mode, ciphering if so indicated, and reception and transmission on SACCH.

question_78188.question: What is required for a PCC rule to identify service data flows to be measured, as per TS 23.203?
question_78188.ground_truth: PCC rules are used to identify service data flows to be measured including certain characteristics related to that service data flow. One PCC rule identifies a service data flow to be measured and can also include specific characteristics related to that service data flow.

question_78189.question: How can the MME initiate paging of the UE in the cells of all tracking areas contained in the TAI list?
question_78189.ground_truth: The MME can send the paging request message only to those HeNBs which have the TAI in the UE's registered TAI list and the CSG ID in the UE's CSG white list, or provide both the TAI and the UE's CSG white list to those HeNBs which have the TAI in the UE's registered TAI list, and let each of the HeNBs decide whether its cell belongs to the CSG area and send the paging via the radio interface. If the HeNB GW is adopted as an entity of CSG architecture, other approaches of paging optimization may be possible.

question_78190.question: What are the three different formats for producing audio for VR?
question_78190.ground_truth: The three different formats for producing audio for VR are channels-based, objects-based, and scene-based audio formats.

question_78191.question: What is a "target service or equipment" in the context of targeted communication interception?
question_78191.ground_truth: A "target service or equipment" refers to the communication service or device associated with the target of the interception. This could include items such as an IMSIs, MSISDNs, NAI, Tel URI, SIP URI, IMEI, or MAC.

question_78192.question: What is the protocol compatibility of the MO for BCP of MMTEL communication service?
question_78192.ground_truth: The MO for BCP of MMTEL communication service is compatible with OMA Device Management (DM) 1.2.

question_78195.question: What are two examples of immersive media that are not specifically volumetric media formats?
question_78195.ground_truth: 2D video and Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) such as NeRFs, Signed Distance Functions (SDFs), and Occupancy Networks (ONet) are two examples of immersive media that are not specifically volumetric media formats.

question_78196.question: What is the impact of poor parameters settings in the first deployment stage of E-UTRAN on the network coverage?
question_78196.ground_truth: Poor parameters settings in the first deployment stage of E-UTRAN can lead to un-continuous coverage and drop calls due to bad coverage.

question_78199.question: What is a key feature of NR PC5 ProSe communication that needs to be supported for public safety and interactive services?
question_78199.ground_truth: NR PC5 ProSe communication including unicast and groupcast needs to be supported.

question_78202.question: What action does the PCF take when the NF service consumer is not able to handle the notification during the request for termination of the policy association?
question_78202.ground_truth: The PCF resends the failed request for termination of the policy association to the new AMF's URI, or to its alternate or backup IPv4, IPv6 Address(es) or FQDN(s) if it is aware of them.

question_78204.question: In what situations may MCVideo client B decide to send a Private communication failed response to MCVideo client A?
question_78204.ground_truth: If MCVideo client B fails to establish communication with MCVideo client C

question_78205.question: How are the first stage and second stage excitation gains quantized, at 32 kbps or lower bit-rates, when using the TC mode in the described codec?
question_78205.ground_truth: The first stage excitation gain (pitch gain) and the second stage excitation gain (algebraic gain) are quantized using the memory-less vector gain quantization at 32 kbps or lower bit-rates when using the TC mode in the described codec.

question_78207.question: What is the pre-condition for the signalling flow for adding, updating, or removing reporting restrictions for a given UE and APN?
question_78207.ground_truth: The RCAF has already performed RUCI reporting for the given UE and APN.

question_78208.question: What is the driving force behind the need for a Common Profile Storage Framework of User Data for network services and management?
question_78208.ground_truth: The increasing number of physically disjoint but logically correlated user data stored in several databases within and outside 3GPP requires consolidation and coordination to prevent redundancy, contradiction, and enable operators to administer and provision complex and combined services.

question_78209.question: What is the expected final state of the mobile station after the test?
question_78209.ground_truth: The mobile station is expected to be in MM-state "idle, updated" after the test.

question_78210.question: What is included in the Uu QoS flow descriptions in ProSe path switching request?
question_78210.ground_truth: The Uu QoS flow descriptions are included if the initiating UE derives the requested QoS flow description based on the PC5 QoS parameters of the PC5 QoS flow(s) between the initiating UE and the target UE.

question_78211.question: Which clause in TS 24.581 specifies the transmission control entities and the procedures for starting and stopping the transmission?
question_78211.ground_truth: Clause 7.2.3.7.3 in TS 24.581 specifies the transmission control entities and the procedures for starting and stopping the transmission.

question_78212.question: What is the difference between Delta Synchronization and logging?
question_78212.ground_truth: Delta Synchronization tries to compress the information to only one set of delta synchronization data per changed instance and not to report undone changes, while logging contains a history of the changes since the synchronization point. Delta Synchronization is not necessarily based on a log and can be used even if the changes are not recorded in a log.

question_78214.question: What is the role of the M-DDNMF in the 5G ProSe restricted discovery?
question_78214.ground_truth: The M-DDNMF is responsible for communicating with the A-DDNMF and checking the MIC, ProSe security policies, and authorizing the discovery request.

question_78215.question: In which domain are emergency calls provided for roaming architecture with home-routed traffic?
question_78215.ground_truth: The UE would use IMS emergency services provided in the VPLMN in the CS domain for emergency calls, instead of the HPLMN, in the roaming architecture with home-routed traffic.

question_78217.question: What is the purpose of using SGi PtP tunnelling based on UDP/IP bearer in this solution?
question_78217.ground_truth: The purpose is to reduce the transmitted data size and save a significant number of transmitted bytes by creating IP/UDP headers in the PGW and not by the UE.

question_78219.question: What is the PLMN NMS notification's impact on existing nodes and functionality?
question_78219.ground_truth: PLMN NMS notifies the Disaster Roaming PLMN AMF and the affected UE to ensure smooth transition when the Disaster Condition is no longer applicable.

question_78220.question: What is used to secure the user plane traffic in Solution 9's IPsec based flavor?
question_78220.ground_truth: AS confidentiality protection is used to secure user plane traffic in Solution 9's IPsec based flavor.

question_78221.question: What should MTSI clients support to negotiate RTP profiles for all media types in the 3GPP TS 26.114 specification?
question_78221.ground_truth: MTSI clients should support SDPCapNeg to negotiate RTP profiles for all media types where AVPF is supported. They shall support the complete SDPCapNeg framework.

question_78222.question: What is the purpose of 3GPP's Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network UTRAN Iu interface layer 1 (Release 17)?
question_78222.ground_truth: The purpose of this specification is to define the standards for implementing Layer 1 on the Iu interface, which includes functions such as interface to physical medium, ATM-Cell delineation, line clock extraction capability, layer 1 alarms extraction and generation, in-sequence delivery, and transmission quality control.

question_78223.question: What should the UE do when it receives an initial request for a dialog or a standalone transaction that contains a service URN with a top-level service type of "sos" and the request is not in response to a 380 (Alternative Service) response to an initial request for a dialog, or a standalone transaction, or an unknown method?
question_78223.ground_truth: The UE shall set the Request-URI of the initial request for a dialog or the standalone transaction to the service URN.

question_78224.question: What is the difference between Single base RTK service and MAC Network RTK service?
question_78224.ground_truth: Single base RTK service uses a reference station with known position to improve positioning accuracy, while MAC network RTK service uses a group of reference stations and one of them is chosen as the Master station, and the others are Auxiliary stations. The Master station provides full raw observations and coordinate information, while the Auxiliary stations provide reduced ambiguity-levelled observations and coordinate differences.

question_78225.question: What should the MCVideo client do upon receiving a SIP NOTIFY request containing an application/pidf+xml MIME body indicating per-user functional alias information?
question_78225.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should determine the status of the MCVideo user for each functional alias in the MIME body. If the p-id-fa element value of the application/pidf+xml MIME body of the SIP NOTIFY request is included, the p-id-fa element value indicates the SIP PUBLISH request which triggered sending of the SIP NOTIFY request. If the MCVideo client detected a functional alias activation or deactivation, it should perform the procedure specified in clause~8.2.1.7.

question_78226.question: What is the current adoption rate of HTTP/2 and HTTP/3?
question_78226.ground_truth: HTTP/2 is used by about 45% of websites, while HTTP/3 is only used by about 5% of websites.

question_78228.question: When the MCPTT client receives a Floor Taken message, what state will it enter?
question_78228.ground_truth: It will enter the 'U: not permitted and Floor Taken' state.

question_78229.question: What was the pre-condition for the extended sensor use cases in terms of communication service?
question_78229.ground_truth: The V2X service provider may appoint key sensor data suppliers (Vehicles and RSUs) to construct collective situational awareness and the key sensors need more reliable and specific communication supporting. The communication service should support different data rate, different reliability, different information deliver frequency etc.

question_78231.question: What message is used to assign uplink resources to a device in response to an access request on the EC-RACH on TS1 using Normal Burst (NB)?
question_78231.ground_truth: The EC-AGCH Fixed Uplink Allocation 2 message

question_78232.question: Which functional entity performs the signalling user agent function in SIP transactions?
question_78232.ground_truth: The signalling user agent functional entity acts as the SIP user agent (both client and server) for all SIP transactions.

question_78233.question: When should the S-CSCF retain the access-network-charging-info parameter in the P-Charging-Vector header when forwarding a UE-originated reINVITE request to an AS within its trust domain?
question_78233.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should retain the access-network-charging-info parameter in the P-Charging-Vector header when forwarding the request to an AS within its trust domain.

question_78234.question: Which network node includes the received NBIFOM container IE in the MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REJECT message or the ACTIVATE SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT REJECT message to the UE in the context of UE-initiated IP flow mobility over GERAN or UTRAN?
question_78234.ground_truth: The SGSN includes the received NBIFOM container IE in the MODIFY PDP CONTEXT REJECT message or the ACTIVATE SECONDARY PDP CONTEXT REJECT message to the UE in the context of UE-initiated IP flow mobility over GERAN or UTRAN.

question_78235.question: What is the purpose of activating USIM-RN in the RN attach procedure in Solution 11?
question_78235.ground_truth: The purpose of activating USIM-RN in the RN attach procedure in Solution 11 is to ensure that the USIM-RN is used in the RN attach procedure and to invalidate any EPS security context on the USIM-RN. This helps in distinguishing a USIM-RN from a USIM-INI in the RN attach procedure.

question_78237.question: What is the purpose of multicast and broadcast techniques in the 3GPP system?
question_78237.ground_truth: The purpose of multicast and broadcast techniques in the 3GPP system is to decrease the amount of data within the network and use resources more efficiently, especially with a large number of users receiving the same high data rate services.

question_78238.question: In a situation where only 25% of the terminals are operating SATD, what is the impact on the net system capacity gain with non-ideal algorithms?
question_78238.ground_truth: There is no net system capacity gain from UL SATD with non-ideal algorithms.

question_78239.question: What is the name of the cotrol channel in 5G NR that is used to schedule DL transmissions on PDSCH and UL transmissions on PUSCH?

question_78240.question: What is the dominant factor in determining the delay represented in the contention-based access (method i) RRC signalling assessment?
question_78240.ground_truth: The dominant factor in determining the delay represented in the contention-based access (method i) RRC signalling assessment is the time taken to transmit the message over the radio interface.

question_78241.question: What is the method used for obtaining the "Packet Loss Rate" in the uplink provided by the "UL PDCP SDU Loss Rate" measurement?
question_78241.ground_truth: The "UL PDCP SDU Loss Rate" measurement is obtained by counting the number of missing UL PDCP sequence numbers, representing packets that are not delivered to higher layers, of a data radio bearer, divided by Total number of UL PDCP sequence numbers (also including missing sequence numbers) of a bearer, starting from the sequence number of the first packet delivered by UE PDCP to gNB-CU-UP until the sequence number of the last packet.

question_78242.question: Which two devices are involved in the exchange of information in response to the "PROVIDE LOCAL INFORMATION" command?
question_78242.ground_truth: The two devices involved in the exchange of information in response to the "PROVIDE LOCAL INFORMATION" command are the UICC and the ME.

question_78243.question: What is the mechanism used to handle the discrepancy between the clock speed of the PLMN and the local modem clock speed?
question_78243.ground_truth: A FIFO buffering technique is used in the FAs on both PLMN sides to compensate against mismatching between the PLMN clock speed and the local modem clock speed.

question_78244.question: What is the role of the S-EAS in the EELManagedACR service request?
question_78244.ground_truth: The S-EAS sends an EELManagedACR service request to request the S-EES to handle all the service operations of the ACR.

question_78247.question: What is the purpose of the SYNC-DL sequences used in the downlink pilot channel (DwPCH)?
question_78247.ground_truth: The SYNC-DL sequences used in the downlink pilot channel (DwPCH) indicate the presence of the P-CCPCH in the multi-frame of the resource units of code and in time slot #0.

question_78248.question: What is the expected sequence of events for PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP EVENT LIST 1.1.2?
question_78248.ground_truth: The expected sequence of events for PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP EVENT LIST 1.1.2 is as follows: PROACTIVE COMMAND: SET UP EVENT LIST 1.1.2, TERMINAL RESPONSE: SET UP EVENT LIST 1.1.2, and EVENT DOWNLOAD - LOCATION STATUS 1.1.2A or EVENT DOWNLOAD - LOCATION STATUS 1.1.2B.

question_78249.question: What are the two main types of charging data messages in the context of offline charging?
question_78249.ground_truth: The two main types of charging data messages in the context of offline charging are Charging Data Request and Charging Data Response.

question_78250.question: What is the degradation in PCDE value for the Repeater scenario compared to the Node B in the document?

question_78251.question: What is the role of the Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF) in the Network Slice-Specific Authentication and Authorization (NSSAA) in 5G System?
question_78251.ground_truth: The AMF acts as the EAP Authenticator in the NSSAA procedure, communicating with the AAA Server via the AUSF and interworking with the AAA protocol supported by the AAA-S.

question_78252.question: What action should the network take if it receives a transaction identifier value that is non-existent or not implemented?
question_78252.ground_truth: The network should abort any ongoing SM procedure related to the received transaction identifier value and stop any related timer.

question_78254.question: Which RF and BB bandwidths are used in UE peak rate reduction options PR1 and PR2?
question_78254.ground_truth: The resource allocation spans a bandwidth of maximum 20 MHz (maximum UE channel bandwidth) for PR1 and PR2, allowing for good performance while minimizing RF complexity.

question_78257.question: What should be included in the Refer-To header field of the SIP REFER request to leave an MCPTT session?
question_78257.ground_truth: The Refer-To header field of the SIP REFER request should be set to the MCPTT session identity to leave, including the "method" SIP URI parameter with the value "BYE".

question_78259.question: What is the purpose of the FEC-OTI-Scheme-Specific-Info FDT Instance data element in FLUTE?
question_78259.ground_truth: The FEC-OTI-Scheme-Specific-Info FDT Instance data element contains information specific to the FEC scheme indicated by the FEC Encoding ID, encoded using base64.

question_78260.question: What additional information does the MCPTT UE transmit to all users, including those operating off the network?
question_78260.ground_truth: The MCPTT UE can transmit the talker's Location information, User ID, aliases, off-network MCPTT Group ID, group alias, and, if available, Mission Critical Organization name to all users in a call, including those operating off the network and late entering the call in progress, allowing them to maintain situational awareness.

question_78261.question: What should the S-CSCF do with the access-network-charging-info parameter when forwarding a UE-originated reINVITE request to an AS outside its home network?
question_78261.ground_truth: The S-CSCF should not include the access-network-charging-info parameter in the P-Charging-Vector header when forwarding the request outside its home network.

question_78262.question: Which command is used to read the 5GS ATSSS rules of the QoS flow of the default QoS rule associated with a specific context identifier <cid>?
question_78262.ground_truth: The 10.1.70 +C5GATSSSRRDP command is used to read the 5GS ATSSS rules of the QoS flow of the default QoS rule associated with a specific context identifier <cid>.

question_78265.question: What is the recommended content delivery model for XR split rendering?
question_78265.ground_truth: The recommended content delivery model for XR split rendering includes sending eye buffers at the same time, slice to IP mapping with fragmentation, RTP-based time codes and packet numbering, RTP/RTCP-based feedback ACK/NACK, and RTP/RTCP-based feedback on bitrate.

question_78267.question: How shall the UICC store the Ks, which is the concatenation of CK and IK, on the UICC?
question_78267.ground_truth: The UICC stores Ks, which is the concatenation of CK and IK, on the UICC.

question_78269.question: What is the method that should be used to fill the EnvelopeHandler TLV list?
question_78269.ground_truth: The EnvelopeHandler TLV list is filled with the Comprehension TLV data objects of the ENVELOPE APDU command, provided in the order given in the ENVELOPE command data.

question_78271.question: Which two peer entities are described in the Group Call Control protocol in the present document?
question_78271.ground_truth: One GCC entity in the MS, the other one in the network.

question_78272.question: What is the purpose of invoking MPS for all participants on an MMTEL video conference call?
question_78272.ground_truth: The purpose is to provide priority service for the host and all participants, assuming that others will experience similar service degradations, rather than waiting until problems with the MMTEL conference call are observed.

question_78273.question: What feature of the 5GMS system enables the use of edge computing capabilities for media streaming?

question_78274.question: Which mode of the RoHC algorithm is used when the compressor has just been created or has been reset?

question_78275.question: What is the type of the Transfer-Information AVP for IMS service continuity?
question_78275.ground_truth: The Transfer-Information AVP for IMS service continuity is of type Grouped.

question_78276.question: What measurement procedure should be used to determine the effective radiated power of an emission in an anechoic shielded chamber?
question_78276.ground_truth: Pre-calibration can be used instead of a substitution measurement in an anechoic shielded chamber.

question_78279.question: What are the conditions to determine if the current frame is not a transition frame?
question_78279.ground_truth: The current frame is not a transition frame if neither of the following two conditions are met: 1) changing from a fricative frame to a non-fricative frame, and 2) changing from a non-fricative frame to a fricative frame.

question_78281.question: What is the rSRVCC capability indication to the network transmitted by the UE in the GERAN/UTRAN attach procedure?
question_78281.ground_truth: The rSRVCC capability indication is transmitted by the UE in the Attach Request message sent to the SGSN at combined GPRS/IMSI Attach and in the Routing Area Update Request message at combined RA/LA Update.

question_78282.question: What is the test purpose in subclause 6.6.2.2.3?
question_78282.ground_truth: The test purpose in subclause 6.6.2.2.3 is to verify the ability of the BS to limit the interference produced by the transmitted signal to other UTRA receivers operating at the first or second adjacent RF channel.

question_78284.question: How many inter-frequency cells per TDD inter-frequency should the UE be capable of performing RSRP and RSRQ measurements for?
question_78284.ground_truth: The UE should be capable of performing RSRP and RSRQ measurements of at least 4 inter-frequency cells per TDD inter-frequency.

question_78285.question: What resonator type is required in BS RF TX filtering with 93 dB of rejection and separate transmit and receive antenna ports?
question_78285.ground_truth: Metal resonators are required in BS RF TX filtering with 93 dB of rejection and separate transmit and receive antenna ports.

question_78286.question: What is the maximum power that shall be used for transmitting the FPACH in a cell, and what is the reference point for it?
question_78286.ground_truth: Max FPACH Power is the maximum power that shall be used for transmitting the FPACH in a cell, with the reference point being the antenna connector.

question_78287.question: When does the UE defer access barring checks until it has obtained SIB1?
question_78287.ground_truth: After a PCell change in RRC_CONNECTED, the UE shall defer access barring checks until it has obtained SIB1 from the target cell.

question_78288.question: What is the difference between a local MBS service and a location dependent MBS service in terms of the MBS service area?
question_78288.ground_truth: A local MBS service is provided in one MBS service area, while a location dependent MBS service is provided in several MBS service areas.

question_78289.question: How many cells are used in this test with each carrier having one cell?
question_78289.ground_truth: There are two cells per carrier in this test; one cell for the primary cell (Cell 1) and one cell for the secondary cell (Cell 2).

question_78290.question: How many RLP frames are contained in one A-TRAU' frame?
question_78290.ground_truth: One A-TRAU' frame contains two consecutive A-TRAU frames.

question_78291.question: What is the impact of not receiving the Negotiated PEIPS assistance information IE during the last registration procedure in 5GMM?
question_78291.ground_truth: If the UE did not receive the Negotiated PEIPS assistance information IE during the last registration procedure, the UE shall delete any existing PEIPS assistance information received from the network and shall not use PEIPS assistance information.

question_78294.question: What is the maximum size of the Option Field of the IP header or TCP header for transporting NIP response?
question_78294.ground_truth: The Option Field of the IP header or TCP header can provide 40 bytes for transporting NIP response.

question_78295.question: What is the problem with using an RF hopping channel that includes ARFCN=0 in the hopping sequence?
question_78295.ground_truth: Some Phase 2 and Phase 2+ MSs may not be able to access the assigned channel correctly if the network assigns an RF hopping channel that includes ARFCN=0 in the hopping sequence.

question_78296.question: What type of traffic is the DL PRB usage measurement valid for?
question_78296.ground_truth: The DL PRB usage measurement is valid for packet switched traffic.

question_78297.question: What does the abbreviation "3GPP" in the document stand for?
question_78297.ground_truth: 3GPP stands for the 3rd Generation Partnership Project, which is an organization that develops technical specifications for mobile communication systems.

question_78298.question: What is the requirement for the RSRQ measurement accuracy for all measured cells as specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.18.3?
question_78298.ground_truth: The RSRQ measurement accuracy for all measured cells shall be as specified in 3GPP TS 36.133 clause 9.1.18.3.

question_78299.question: What does the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) technical specification group focus on in the "Study on charging aspects for enhanced support of non-public networks" document?
question_78299.ground_truth: The 3GPP technical specification group focuses on studying charging scenarios and potential charging requirements for Non-Public Networks (i.e. Stand-alone Non-Public Network (SNPN) or Public Network Integrated NPN (PNI-NPN)), possible charging solutions for Non-Public Networks with potential impact on charging architecture, charging functions and charging procedures, as well as end user charging and Inter-Provider charging in the document.

question_78300.question: What is the definition of the Eb/N0 used in the measurement performance requirements?
question_78300.ground_truth: Eb/N0 is the ratio of the received total energy of the desired signal to the total noise power spectral density, defined as Ec/N0 multiplied by the ratio of the number of chips per frame (Lchip) to the number of information bits per frame (Linf).

question_78302.question: When should UEs initiate the procedure to resume a suspended RRC connection?
question_78302.ground_truth: UEs should initiate the procedure to resume a suspended RRC connection when upper layers or the Access Stratum requests it, while ensuring valid and up-to-date essential system information.

question_78303.question: What should the UE (MCPTT Client) do when it receives an initial SIP INVITE request with an application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-info+xml MIME body for an MCPTT On-demand Chat Group Emergency Group Call?
question_78303.ground_truth: The UE (MCPTT Client) should display to the MCPTT user an indication of this being an MCPTT emergency group call, display the MCPTT ID of the originator, display the MCPTT group identity, and set the MCPTT emergency group state to "MEG 2: in-progress".

question_78304.question: What is one of the challenges that might arise when different applications need semantically identical data in different forms of representation?
question_78304.ground_truth: A numerical value might be represented as a number (Roman or Arabic) or as a string (e.g. "fifteen") in different languages (English or French).

question_78305.question: What is a management control loop between the CSP and the NSP for communication service assurance?
question_78305.ground_truth: A management control loop between the CSP and the NSP for communication service assurance is an interaction in which the CSP provides feedback to the CSC and adjusts the resources used by a communication service or the CSC adjusts the SLS continuously to achieve the assured requirements.

question_78306.question: What is the purpose of connecting to a Premises Radio Access Station (PRAS) in a Customer Premises Network (CPN)?
question_78306.ground_truth: The purpose is to provide cellular access to User Equipment (UE) and enable priority access for certain UEs within the limits set by the operator policy.

question_78307.question: What is the purpose of the Assistance Data Transfer Procedure in DL-AoD positioning?
question_78307.ground_truth: The Assistance Data Transfer Procedure in DL-AoD positioning is used to enable the LMF to provide assistance data to the UE, and for the UE to request assistance data from the LMF as part of a positioning procedure.

question_78308.question: What is the size limitation of NAS messages for GSM/GPRS system when sent in CS domain via radio interface and when sent in PS domain via radio interface?
question_78308.ground_truth: When NAS messages are sent in CS domain via radio interface in GSM/GPRS network, the size of such NAS messages should not exceed 251 octets. While for NAS messages sent in PS domain via radio interface, the size should not exceed 1560 octets.

question_78311.question: What is the definition of Transmit OFF power in the context of UTRA FDD UE?
question_78311.ground_truth: Transmit OFF power is the RRC filtered mean power when the transmitter is off, measured during periods when the UE is not transmitting or when the UE is not transmitting DPCCH due to discontinuous uplink DPCCH transmission.

question_78312.question: What should be avoided in order to prevent desensitization of the receive band for Band 5 or 26 in a BS with a Band (2+2+5) BS transmitter?
question_78312.ground_truth: The Band (2+2+5) BS transmitter should not share the same antenna with Band 5 or 26 BS receiver.

question_78314.question: What happens to the CSG Id of a UE when the permissions for the UE to access a HeNB are removed?
question_78314.ground_truth: The CSG Id is deleted from the Allowed CSG List contained in the UE to prevent the UE from accessing the CSG cell.

question_78315.question: What is the objective of Solution 1.2 in implementing PDU session charging for SSC Mode 1?
question_78315.ground_truth: The objective is to achieve charging information collection for PDU session continuity in SSC Mode 1 by interfacing the SMF in the 5G architecture.

question_78317.question: Which 5G system architecture specification is linked to the SA2 WI on Architectural enhancements for 5G multicast-broadcast services?

question_78318.question: What should the UE do if no random access response is received within the RA Response window of 48 sub-frames in Test 2?
question_78318.ground_truth: The UE should consider the random access response reception not successful and re-select a preamble, transmitting with the calculated NPRACH transmission power when the backoff time expires if no random access response is received within the RA Response window of 48 sub-frames.

question_78319.question: What should the ME do when at least one of the stated conditions is met, in reference to storing (TMPI, IMPI)-pairs in non-volatile memory?
question_78319.ground_truth: The ME shall delete all stored (TMPI, IMPI)-pairs when any of the following conditions are met: (1) the UICC is removed from the ME while the ME is in power on state, (2) another UICC has been inserted to the ME upon power up, (3) no UICC has been inserted to the ME upon power up.

question_78320.question: Under what conditions must the MCVideo client report that it is not listening to the MBMS subchannels?
question_78320.ground_truth: The MCVideo client must report that it is not listening to the MBMS subchannels if it receives an MBMS bearer announcement, suffers from bad MBMS bearer radio condition, and/or the MBMS bearer is cancelled.

question_78322.question: What is the role of the IWF in the PPP protocol in terms of control character transparency?
question_78322.ground_truth: The IWF identifies whether the higher layer protocol is PPP and detects and interprets the ACCM negotiation result. If PPP is used, the conversion function in the IWF applies a default ACCM until another is negotiated.

question_78323.question: What is the PDN address of the default EPS bearer context set to, when the PDU session type is "IPv4", "IPv6" or "IPv4v6"?
question_78323.ground_truth: The PDN address of the default EPS bearer context is set to the PDU address of the PDU session.

question_78324.question: What information is included in the EVENT DOWNLOAD - CALL CONNECTED command in the Call Connected Event test?
question_78324.ground_truth: The EVENT DOWNLOAD - CALL CONNECTED command includes information such as the event list, source device, destination device, and transaction identifier.

question_78325.question: How does the flexibility of QoS handling differ between the EPS and 5GS models?
question_78325.ground_truth: The main distinguishing feature is that the flexible use of the priority, latency and reliability parameters in 5GS are not tied to a bearer, unlike in the EPS model.

question_78327.question: What happened to the dual Bearer Services in PLMN from Release 17 onwards?
question_78327.ground_truth: From Release 17 onwards, the dual Bearer Services "alternate speech/data" (BS 61) and "speech followed by data" (BS 81) are no longer required by a PLMN.

question_78329.question: What is the LTE key hierarchy optimization for the transfer of small data in the user plane?
question_78329.ground_truth: LTE key hierarchy can be optimized for small data transmission by aligning with SA2's solution for the transfer of small data. This optimization reduces the computing and storage resources for UE, eNB, and MME when the AS security contexts are not used.

question_78331.question: What is the requirement for the rate of correct handovers observed during repeated tests?
question_78331.ground_truth: The rate of correct handovers observed during repeated tests should be at least 90%.

question_78333.question: What is the role of a sync device in the 5G system as per TS 22.104?
question_78333.ground_truth: A sync device is responsible for processing and transmitting IEEE 1588v2 / Precision Time Protocol messages, synchronizing the user-specific time clock of UEs with a working clock, providing a media dependent interface for one or multiple IEEE 802.1AS sync domains, and interfacing with the 5G sync domain which can be used by applications to derive their working clock domain or global time domain.

question_78336.question: What is the maximum timing error that can be tolerated for Redcap UEs in commercial scenarios?
question_78336.ground_truth: The maximum timing error that can be tolerated for Redcap UEs in commercial scenarios is 2ns.

question_78337.question: What should the CDF do if it does not receive an acknowledgement or a successful response from CGF1 due to any reason?
question_78337.ground_truth: In this case, the unacknowledged CDR packets are redirected to CGF2.

question_78338.question: What are the generic considerations for scene-based audio capture systems, and what is the impact of latency on the overall audio capture system?
question_78338.ground_truth: Generic considerations for scene-based audio capture systems include Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR), Acoustic Overload Point (AOP), Microphone frequency response, Wind Noise Protection, and Microphone element spacing, crosstalk, gain- and directivity matching. When it comes to two-way communication on the audio capture system, the mouth to ear latency should be low enough to allow a natural conversational experience.

question_78340.question: What is the purpose of the "mode" and "restriction" elements in the operator-originating-identity-presentation-restriction in the 3GPP network?
question_78340.ground_truth: The "mode" element specifies the identity presentation mode, while the "restriction" element specifies the identity presentation restriction in the operator-originating-identity-presentation-restriction.

question_78341.question: How are the E-UCCH and TPC transmitted in E-PUCH timeslots?
question_78341.ground_truth: When E-PUCH does contain E-UCCH, TPC is also transmitted. When E-PUCH does not contain E-UCCH, TPC is not transmitted.

question_78344.question: How many simulation cases are there in System simulation evaluations of Scenario 4?
question_78344.ground_truth: There are three simulation cases in System simulation evaluations of Scenario 4.

question_78345.question: What header field parameter must the UE include in the Via header field when sending a request using UDP?
question_78345.ground_truth: The UE must include a "rport" header field parameter with no value in the Via header field.

question_78347.question: What is the target user plane latency for URLLC in the uplink (UL) and downlink (DL) directions?
question_78347.ground_truth: The target user plane latency for URLLC in the UL and DL directions is 0.5ms.

question_78348.question: What is the objective of the LTE Advanced intra-band non-contiguous Carrier Aggregation work item in Band 41 for 4 downlinks?
question_78348.ground_truth: The objective of this work item is to provide specification support for intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation in LTE TDD Band 41 for 4 downlinks.

question_78350.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP VR Headend in the end-to-end architecture for the distribution of VR content?
question_78350.ground_truth: The 3GPP VR Headend is responsible for generating content that can be consumed by receivers conforming to the present document, typically this includes 3D audio and spherical video signals that are properly encoded.

question_78351.question: What is the purpose of the Service Description in this specification?
question_78351.ground_truth: The Service Description indicates 5G ProSe service domain information.

question_78352.question: What are the bandwidths of low frequency bands and high frequency bands in WB for different bit rates?
question_78352.ground_truth: The bandwidths of low frequency bands and high frequency bands are 4, 5, 7, and 8 for 7.2kbps, 8kbps, 9.6kbps, and 13.2kbps respectively, while the bandwidths of high frequency bands are 19, 17, 15, and 13 for the same bit rates.

question_78354.question: What is the value of M for aperiodic CSI-RS resources as CMR in FR2?
question_78354.ground_truth: For aperiodic CSI-RS resources as CMR in FR2, M = 1.

question_78355.question: What is required for a 5GC capable UE behind a FN-RG that impacts 3GPP reference points?
question_78355.ground_truth: The 5GC capable UE behind a FN-RG, which is not 5GC capable, shall use 3GPP procedures and the impact on 3GPP reference points shall be minimized. The FN-RG is responsible for transparently enabling direct N1 signaling and user plane transport between the 3GPP UE and the AMF/SMF and UPF in the 5GC. The 5GC shall be able to support the functionality for user-plane treatment in the UPF and W-5GAN may be enabled to support QoS treatment for the 3GPP UE using FN-RG access.

question_78356.question: What is the role of PKMF/PCF in authorizing the SL Positioning Client UE?
question_78356.ground_truth: PKMF/PCF is a network function that supports the authorization of the SL Positioning Client UE. It provides information of Ranging/SL positioning exposure to the UE during Service Authorization and Information Provisioning procedure. It authorizes the Client UE based on its local information and sends the authorization result to UE1.

question_78357.question: What attribute in the "pPolicyCtrlReqTriggers" specifies the type of access?

question_78358.question: What should an MCVideo client do when a timer expires in a state with no specified handling?
question_78358.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should ignore the expiration of the timer.

question_78359.question: What is the expected range of the PDCP sequence number?
question_78359.ground_truth: The PDCP sequence number ranges from 0 to 65535.

question_78361.question: What is the purpose of Solution #40 in EAS instantiation status provision provided by ECS?
question_78361.ground_truth: Solution #40 enables the EES to ensure the proper number of EAS instances are instantiated in the EDN, indicates what information may be utilized by an EES to decide to trigger dynamic EAS instantiation, and updates the EES profile provided to the ECS in the EES registration request and provided to the EEC in the service provisioning response with EASID(s) available at the EES and EAS instantiation status for each EASID.

question_78363.question: What happens after the new SGSN receives the first correct RLC/MAC block from the MS?
question_78363.ground_truth: The target BSS sends a PS Handover Complete message to the new SGSN, indicating that the MS has arrived at the target cell. The new SGSN then sends a Forward Relocation Complete message to the old SGSN, which then starts the packet forwarding timer and stops forwarding data after the timer expires.

question_78366.question: What are the valid values for carrierType-r14 in the ASN.1 definition?
question_78366.ground_truth: The valid values for carrierType-r14 in the ASN.1 definition are mbms, fembmsMixed, and fembmsDedicated.

question_78368.question: What is a Presentity in the context of a Presence Service?
question_78368.ground_truth: A Presentity is a presence entity that provides Presence Information to a Presence Service.

question_78369.question: What is the out of band emission limit specified in section 6.5.2.1.1 in terms of?
question_78369.ground_truth: The out of band emission limit is specified in terms of a spectrum emission mask and adjacent channel leakage power ratio for the transmitter.

question_78370.question: What is the format of the "Facility" information element in the "Facility" message as defined in TS 24.010 in the context of 3GPP technical specifications?
question_78370.ground_truth: The format of the "Facility" information element in the "Facility" message as defined in TS 24.010 is TLV.

question_78376.question: Which type of BS has transmitter spurious emission limits as specified in clause 6.6.5, for all BS with common RX and TX antenna port?
question_78376.ground_truth: For all BS type 1-C with common RX and TX antenna port, this applies.

question_78377.question: What is the downlink power step size limit when determining the EIS (Effective Isotropic Sensitivity) in the context of the TRS testing?
question_78377.ground_truth: The downlink power step size shall be no more than 0.5 dB when the RF power level is near the NR sensitivity level.

question_78378.question: How many resource blocks can be reserved for random access preamble transmissions in a subframe?
question_78378.ground_truth: A random access channel occupies 6 resource blocks in a subframe or set of consecutive subframes.

question_78379.question: What entity generates and provides PCC rules with the Policy Control Request Trigger in response to a backhaul delay control request from the AMF?

question_78380.question: What are the three categories of applications in the FRMCS system?
question_78380.ground_truth: The three categories of applications in the FRMCS system are Critical data, Non-Critical data, and Messaging.

question_78381.question: What is the effect of the "merge" operation in 3GPP JSON Patch?
question_78381.ground_truth: The "merge" operation merges the JSON object contained in the "value" property into the target resource referenced by "path" using the rules of JSON Merge Patch.

question_78382.question: Which two policies are used for the "UpdatePolicy" leaf to determine whether or not to request an update of its VisitedNetworkPreference when the rule is no longer considered to be valid by the UE?
question_78382.ground_truth: The two policies for the "UpdatePolicy" leaf are "Indicates that the UE is not required to request an update of the rules" and "Indicates that the UE is required to request an update of the rules."

question_78383.question: What should the source E-UTRAN/UTRAN do after it decides to terminate the handover procedure before its completion?
question_78383.ground_truth: The source E-UTRAN/UTRAN shall attempt to trigger handover cancellation procedures and send a session reestablishment trigger notification to the UE to start the recovery procedure if the session transfer procedure is in progress.

question_78385.question: What is the primary performance objective for VAMOS enhancements?
question_78385.ground_truth: The primary performance objective for VAMOS enhancements is to improve the call quality of both paired and non-paired mobiles in a VAMOS network.

question_78386.question: What is the size of the LAA contention window used in the Category 4 LBT scheme?
question_78386.ground_truth: The size of the LAA contention window used in the Category 4 LBT scheme is variable, with a candidate for variation being exponential backoff between X and Y ECCA slots.

question_78387.question: What is the procedure for the release of the service control signalling session when using I1, if the ICS UE initiates the release?
question_78387.ground_truth: The ICS UE sends a release over I1, the SCC AS sends a SIP BYE to the I/S-CSCF serving the ICS UE, the S-CSCF forwards the SIP BYE to UE A, UE A sends a SIP OK to the SCC AS via the S-CSCF of the UE B, and the SCC AS completes the session release procedure by sending a release-ack over I1.

question_78388.question: What XML schema should be implemented when compliant with the USSD related information in 3GPP TS 24.390?
question_78388.ground_truth: The XML schema defined in 3GPP TS 24.390 for unstructured supplementary services data should be implemented.

question_78390.question: What is the focus of the 3GPP technical report "Study on management and orchestration of network slicing for next generation network (Release 15)"?
question_78390.ground_truth: The report investigates and makes recommendations on management and orchestration for network slicing on the Network Slice Instance Layer and for non-virtualised NE's also the Resource layer.

question_78393.question: What reference point supports group management interactions between group management clients located in different VAL UEs?
question_78393.ground_truth: The GM-PC5 reference point supports group management interactions between group management clients located in different VAL UEs.

question_78394.question: What does the CTC Activation List information element describe?
question_78394.ground_truth: The CTC Activation List information element is used by the GANC to describe the circuit transport channel(s) that shall be activated between the GANC and MS.

question_78395.question: What should the MS consider all other values of the Traffic handling priority, octet 11, as?
question_78395.ground_truth: The MS should consider all other values as reserved.

question_78397.question: What should the UE do during step 4.5.6.1.2.4.6?
question_78397.ground_truth: During step 4.5.6.1.2.4.6, the UE should switch its bandwidth part from BWP-1 to BWP-2 on SCell.

question_78398.question: What is the role of a DSO's RADIUS server in the example, in relation to the MNO's RADIUS (as a proxy)?
question_78398.ground_truth: The DSO's RADIUS server is responsible for end-to-end authentication of the meters or Smart Grid terminal devices, and communicates with the MNO's RADIUS via a dedicated VPN connection.

question_78402.question: What is the overall delay measured when DRX cycle length is 1280 ms?
question_78402.ground_truth: The overall delay measured when DRX cycle length is 1280 ms is expressed as: Overall delay measured = measurement reporting delay + TTI insertion uncertainty + DRX cycle length and measurement reporting delay = Tidentify_inter = 25600 ms.

question_78404.question: What is the main advantage of Solution 18 for positioning?
question_78404.ground_truth: The main advantage of Solution 18 is that it addresses Sub-Issue #5.8 by improving the timeliness of delivering location reports and efficiently using UE transmission power.

question_78405.question: What information does the "V2X-service-ids-list" element contain?
question_78405.ground_truth: The "V2X-service-ids-list" element is a mandatory element that contains a list of V2X service IDs that the V2X UE is no longer interested in receiving, along with their corresponding layer 2 IDs.

question_78406.question: How did the study evaluate the performance of a suboptimal SATD algorithm?
question_78406.ground_truth: The performance of a suboptimal SATD algorithm was evaluated by modelling a UE's random decision-making for a certain part of the radio frames.

question_78407.question: What is the definition of "Application Server Incoming Leg Control Model (AS-ILCM)" given in the document?
question_78407.ground_truth: Application Server Incoming Leg Control Model (AS-ILCM) is a term used in the document to describe a model that represents the behavior of an application server (AS) when handling SIP information for an incoming leg.

question_78408.question: What information does the network check when authorizing the SL Positioning Client UE to discover a UE?
question_78408.ground_truth: The network checks if the SL Positioning Client UE is authorized to use Ranging/SL Positioning service and if it is authorized to request the Ranging result of the specific UEs.

question_78409.question: What is the purpose of the "ResponseCode" element in the "ResponseType" complex type?
question_78409.ground_truth: The "ResponseCode" element is used to indicate the status of the response.

question_78412.question: How are new AVPs introduced in the Diameter application for convey load/overload information?
question_78412.ground_truth: Any new AVP introduced in the existing 3GPP defined Diameter application to convey load/overload information will have to be optional AVPs with the M-bit cleared.

question_78414.question: What is the procedure for the BM-SC to detect an MB2-C path failure in deployments without a Diameter Agent between the BM-SC and the GCS AS?
question_78414.ground_truth: The BM-SC can detect an MB2-C path failure in deployments without a Diameter Agent between the BM-SC and the GCS AS by using mechanisms as specified in the Diameter Base Protocol, such as transport connection failure, GCS AS peer not responding, Diameter Device-Watchdog-Request and Device-Watchdog-Answer messages during periods when there is no need for other MB2 signalling, or by using the MBMS Heartbeat procedure.

question_78415.question: What is the message request when forwarding a MAP PROCESS-SIGNALLING message in the case of a reversion to old channels of the MS?
question_78415.ground_truth: The message request when forwarding a MAP PROCESS-SIGNALLING message in the case of a reversion to old channels of the MS is -an-APDU( MAP U -ABORT HANDOVER FAILURE).

question_78416.question: What should the HPLMN ProSe Function include in the Match Request when making use of the Prose Match Report Procedure to retrieve ProSe Application IDs from the ProSe Function in the local PLMN?
question_78416.ground_truth: The HPLMN ProSe Function includes the Discovery Type, discovered ProSe Application Code(s), MIC, UTC-based counter, UE identity, metadata requested (if any), and PC5 radio technology in the Match Request.

question_78417.question: What should a UE operating in CS/PS mode 1 of operation with "IMS voice not available" and with a persistent EPS bearer context do when the radio bearer associated with the persistent EPS bearer context has been released and the UE is registered for EPS services only, operating in CS/PS mode 1 of operation with "IMS voice not available"?
question_78417.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T3402, if already running, attempt to select GERAN or UTRAN radio access technology and proceed with appropriate MM or GMM specific procedures and disable the E-UTRA capability.

question_78418.question: What is the impact of different UL power control parameters on the mean and 5% UL Average-UPT in the case of higher and lower UE Tx power for all load levels?
question_78418.ground_truth: In the case of higher UE Tx power, different UL power control parameters have a higher and similar mean and 5% DL Average-UPT for all load levels. In the case of lower UE Tx power, different UL power control parameters have a similar mean and 5% DL Average-UPT for all load levels. Additionally, they have a lower and similar mean and 5% UL Average-UPT for all load levels in the case of lower UE Tx power.

question_78419.question: What matrix is used to normalize the minimum phase inverse filters in the headphone compensation filter generation process?
question_78419.ground_truth: The compensation filters were normalized to have a maximum absolute sample value of 1.

question_78420.question: What is used as a reference to a specific QoS forwarding behavior for a 5G QoS Flow?

question_78421.question: How are service data flows detected in trusted scenarios where the UE connects to the EPC using S2c with no user plane confidentiality protection?
question_78421.ground_truth: The BBF access detects service data flows inspecting the inner packets encapsulated in the DSMIPv6 tunnel using the information on the mobility protocol tunneling header and SDF filters provided by the PCRF via the S9a reference point.

question_78422.question: Which type of PDU is received by an SGSN from a BSS in 5.3.12 informing if the queued LLC-PDU(s) for an MS were deleted or transferred from the old to the new cell within the routing area?

question_78424.question: What is the difference between "UE-based A-GNSS" and "UE-assisted A-GNSS" as defined in the document?
question_78424.ground_truth: UE-based A-GNSS refers to the measurement parameters reported by the user equipment (UE) itself, while UE-assisted A-GNSS refers to the measurements performed with assistance from the UE, with the resulting UE GNSS code phase measurements converted into a horizontal position estimate.

question_78425.question: What should be applied if a CSoPS capable UE cannot initiate an IMS voice session?
question_78425.ground_truth: CSoPS should be applied for voice calls in cases when the IMS registered (for non-voice IMS services) and CSoPS capable UE cannot initiate an IMS voice session.

question_78426.question: What action should the UE take if it deems that the network has failed the authentication check during a 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure?
question_78426.ground_truth: The UE should request RRC to locally release the RRC connection and treat the active cell as barred.

question_78428.question: What happens if the S-CSCF receives a REGISTER request with the value "*" in the Contact header field and the value zero in the Expires header field?
question_78428.ground_truth: Remove all contact addresses that were bound to the public user identity found in the To header field and have been registered by this UE identified with its private user identity.

question_78429.question: What is the responsibility of the MSGin5G Server after receiving a UE Reachability monitoring notification?
question_78429.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server responds with an acknowledgement of the notification via SCEF/NEF and updates its information on the UE's availability.

question_78430.question: What should the UE do when it receives an RRCRelease message indicating redirection to E-UTRA?
question_78430.ground_truth: The UE should indicate the available CN Type(s) and the received cnType to upper layers after cell selection, and handle the case if the E-UTRA cell selected after the redirection does not support the core network type specified by the cnType.

question_78431.question: What are the two sets of identifiers contained in the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery message?
question_78431.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay Discovery message contains a Direct Discovery set, which is part of the contents of the 5G ProSe Direct Discovery message, and a UE-to-UE Relay Discovery set, which contains information to support the discovery of the 5G ProSe UE-to-UE Relay and extensions of the Direct Discovery.

question_78433.question: What should a UE do if it prefers to use the Uu communication path for the ProSe service and the PC5 path is currently being used?
question_78433.ground_truth: The UE should switch to the Uu communication path for the ProSe service.

question_78434.question: What are the architectural features specified in the SOAP solution set?
question_78434.ground_truth: The SOAP solution set specifies the use of SOAP 1.1, SOAP 1.2, WSDL 1.1 and XPath Language. It also imports definitions from the PM IRP XML definitions and uses a number of namespace prefixes.

question_78435.question: What is the maximum distance (X) between UEs that can be used for relative positioning to achieve a distance accuracy of 0.5m @ 90% (Set B) in 3 sources?

question_78436.question: What should the UE do upon receiving a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message with an invalid PDU session identity?
question_78436.ground_truth: The UE should send a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND REJECT message with a 5GSM cause set to #43: invalid PDU session identity, if the UE receives a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message with a PDU session ID which does not belong to any PDU session in PDU SESSION ACTIVE state.

question_78437.question: What is the meaning of the MCVideo session identity in the context of MCVideo?
question_78437.ground_truth: The MCVideo session identity is a SIP URI assigned by the MCVideo server that identifies an MCVideo session between an MCVideo client and a participating MCVideo function or between a participating MCVideo function and a controlling MCVideo function.

question_78438.question: How does the 3GPP network support authorisation of UEs for V2N Service?
question_78438.ground_truth: The 3GPP network provides means to support the entity to authorise the UEs supporting V2N Services.

question_78439.question: What information is included in the CDRs for differentiated charging if the message delivery fails?
question_78439.ground_truth: The SCS Identifier, SMS Application port ID, and Trigger Indication are included in the CDRs for differentiated charging if the message delivery fails.

question_78440.question: What information is included in the logged measurement report for WLAN and Bluetooth measurement logging in 3GPP TS 38.331?
question_78440.ground_truth: The logged measurement report for WLAN measurement logging consists of WLAN measurement results, and for Bluetooth measurement logging, the logged measurement report consists of Bluetooth measurement results, respectively.

question_78442.question: What is the purpose of the "talker channel parameter" feature in the context of time-critical data transfer?
question_78442.ground_truth: The "talker channel parameter" ensures that the voice group call channel uplink is available for the uplink access and the transmission of time-critical application-specific data.

question_78443.question: What security procedure option may be used for emergency calls when authentication is impossible because the USIM is absent?
question_78443.ground_truth: As a serving network option, emergency calls may be established without the network having to apply the security mode procedure as defined in TS 24.008.

question_78444.question: What is the function of NG-RAN as specified in TS 38.300?
question_78444.ground_truth: NG-RAN supports radio access network sharing and remote interference management as specified in TS 38.300.

question_78445.question: What is the parameter used to determine the receiver characteristics of the PHICH?
question_78445.ground_truth: The receiver characteristics of the PHICH are determined by the probability of miss-detecting an ACK for a NACK (Pm-an).

question_78446.question: What is the difference between intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation and intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation?
question_78446.ground_truth: Intra-band contiguous carrier aggregation is when contiguous carriers are aggregated in the same operating band, while intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation is when non-contiguous carriers are aggregated in the same operating band.

question_78447.question: What should the MCPTT Service do to support interworking with TETRA systems that are compliant with the ETSI TETRA standards?
question_78447.ground_truth: The MCPTT Service shall enable interworking with non-3GPP PTT Systems that are compliant with the ETSI TETRA standards.

question_78448.question: What design ideas are used in the Notification IRP?
question_78448.ground_truth: The design ideas used in the Notification IRP include the separation of notification Consumers (IRPManagers) from Producers (IRPAgents), and notifications being sent to IRPManagers without the need for them to periodically check for new notifications.

question_78450.question: What should a network do after a 5G-SRVCC handover with an emergency PDU session, where the "null integrity protection algorithm" 5G-IA0 was used in N1 mode?
question_78450.ground_truth: The network does not need to apply security procedures for this connection.

question_78452.question: What does the SMF do when there are multiple access type conditioned session rules with authorized Session-AMBR and the UE's current access type and RAT type matches with the conditions of more than one policy?
question_78452.ground_truth: The SMF applies the Session-AMBR with the policy that has the most strict matching condition, e.g., Policy2 that specifies access type and RAT type when the UE's current access type and RAT type matches both conditions.

question_78453.question: What bit depth precision should a Bitstream conforming to the H.265/HEVC UHD Operation Point use?
question_78453.ground_truth: A Bitstream conforming to the H.265/HEVC UHD Operation Point shall be encoded with 10 bits precision.

question_78454.question: Which release supports E-DCH and HS-PDSCH simultaneously in the uplink and downlink directions?

question_78455.question: How does the legacy UE determine the target cell when detecting a target cell?
question_78455.ground_truth: The legacy UE detects a target cell by means of detecting its PSC and reports to the SRNC a number of other PSCs, together with their pilot signal strength, belonging to either monitored cells or detected cells. The UE may also report timing difference information between source and target.

question_78456.question: What are the main differences between the two procedures for Enhanced Serving RNS Relocation using S4?
question_78456.ground_truth: The two procedures for Enhanced Serving RNS Relocation using S4 differ based on whether the Serving GW is changed or not. In the procedure without Serving GW relocation, the SGSN updates EPS Bearer contexts, while in the procedure with Serving GW relocation, the SGSN selects a new Serving GW and sends Create Session Request messages to establish a new user-plane path for the EPS Bearer contexts.

question_78460.question: What is one regulatory requirement for some frequency bands for the detection of interference from radar systems and to avoid co-channel operation with these systems?

question_78461.question: What is the role of the NSCE server in the slice requirements alignment procedure?
question_78461.ground_truth: The NSCE server checks if the VAL server is authorized to trigger the service, retrieves network slice related performance data, compares the requirements with network slice performance statistics, and generates the optimal slice requirements for the required service of the vertical.

question_78462.question: How does the 3GPP system handle uplink and downlink non-IP traffic in this solution?
question_78462.ground_truth: For uplink, the UE sends the data to C-SGN (or P-GW if the UE is roaming) over the non-IP PDN connection, which forwards the data to the application server or N-gateway. For downlink, the application server or N-gateway forwards the data to the P-GW or C-SGN for the UE to receive over the bearer.

question_78466.question: What is the role of the FP in the channel mode modify procedure?
question_78466.ground_truth: The FP initiates the procedure by sending a CTS CHANNEL MODE MODIFY message to the CTS-MS to request the mobile station to set the channel mode for one channel or one channel set.

question_78467.question: What is the role of the ePDG in handling IPSec tunneling for non-3GPP accesses?
question_78467.ground_truth: The ePDG handles tunnel authentication and authorization, and decapsulation/encapsulation of packets for IPSec tunneling for non-3GPP accesses. It also includes functionality for transportation of a remote IP address for S2b and allocation of downlink GRE key for each PDN connection within the ePDG for PMIPv6-based S2b interface.

question_78468.question: What entities comprise the trusted N3GPP access network from the 5GC-capable UE and 5GC perspective when IEEE 802.1x with 3GPP credentials are used with a 5G-RG?
question_78468.ground_truth: The combination of 5G-RG, W-5GAN, UPF and IWF will act as a trusted N3GPP access network from the 5GC-capable UE and 5GC perspective.

question_78472.question: In the context of 9.2.3, what is the difference between formulas (9.2) and (9.1) in the document?
question_78472.ground_truth: Formula (9.2) is covering formula (9.1) in the sense that in the case described in section 9.2.2, OFFk and Tmk are both equal to zero and (9.1) is a special case of (9.2) with OFFk and Tmk equal to zero.

question_78473.question: What action should the NG-RAN take upon receipt of a PWS Restart Indication message?
question_78473.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a PWS Restart Indication message, the NG-RAN should consider the warning message service as restarted and re-send the warning message data to the NG-RAN.

question_78474.question: What can the MRFC request the MRFP to do when executing the Play Multimedia procedure?
question_78474.ground_truth: The MRFC can request the MRFP to detect DTMF digit while executing ASR, and may request the MRFP to stop ASR when a DTMF digit is detected, among other things.

question_78475.question: What is the minimum expiration time of the idle mode generic timer in idle mode operations?
question_78475.ground_truth: The minimum expiration time of the idle mode generic timer is at least 6 minutes.

question_78476.question: Who are the intended recipients of the ML models provided by the MTLF?
question_78476.ground_truth: The ML models are shared with the same vendor's AnLF, but not with other vendor's AnLF.

question_78477.question: What is the capacity performance for FR2, Indoor Hotspot DL, with 100MHz bandwidth for VR/AR single-stream traffic model, SU-MIMO, 10ms PDB, 60 FPS, 45Mbps, DDDUU, Option 1 UE Antenna parameters (M, N, P) = (1, 4, 2), 3 panels (left, right, top)?
question_78477.ground_truth: The capacity performance is 2.5 UEs per cell.

question_78478.question: What must the UE include in the UECapabilityEnquirySidelink message when it is requested to provide supported bands and band combinations?
question_78478.ground_truth: The UE must set frequencyBandListFilterSidelink to include the supported bands and band combinations in the UECapabilityEnquirySidelink message.

question_78479.question: What are the pre-conditions for the establishment of the relation between the CN NF and the gNB?
question_78479.ground_truth: The pre-conditions for the establishment of the relation between the CN NF and the gNB are the instantiation of the VNF that is part of the CN NF and the gNB, and the non-establishment of the relation between the CN NF and the gNB.

question_78480.question: What is the input signal level formula for the adjacent channel requirements of speech and control channels in VAMOS mode for uplink?
question_78480.ground_truth: The input signal level of the GMSK modulated VAMOS subchannel 2 signal shall be: -75 dBm + Iar + Corr, where Iar is the adjacent channel (200 kHz) interference ratio and Corr is the correction factor for reference performance.

question_78481.question: How can the P-CSCF determine whether the UE is roaming?
question_78481.ground_truth: The P-CSCF can determine whether the UE is roaming by analyzing the home network domain name of the user received in the Request-URI in the REGISTER request.

question_78482.question: What should the MRFP do when the "Autonomous request" information element is included in the SDP offer?
question_78482.ground_truth: The MRFP is allowed to autonomously send RTCP feedback CCM PAUSE and RESUME messages.

question_78483.question: What should the ME do with the Vpp when it is deactivating the SIM/ME interface while powered down from 5V mode?
question_78483.ground_truth: The ME should deactivate Vpp together with Vcc when it is deactivating the SIM/ME interface while powered down from 5V mode.
