question_79177.ground_truth: DIMS data-stream can be managed either in a single transport or two separate transports based on whether the DIMS units are used only in redundant processing or in normal processing.

question_79178.question: What is the structure of a SuccessfulOutcome sequence, which is used to indicate the successful completion of a procedure in the NGAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURES?
question_79178.ground_truth: The SuccessfulOutcome sequence is a structure that consists of three fields: procedureCode, criticality, and value. The procedureCode field indicates the procedure that was successfully completed, the criticality field indicates the level of importance of the procedure, and the value field contains information about the outcome of the procedure.

question_79179.question: What is the action taken by the participating MCPTT function when a call over a pre-established session is released?
question_79179.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function informs the MCPTT client of the release of the call using a Disconnect message over the MCPTT-4 reference point, while reserving the pre-established session for future use.

question_79180.question: What is the purpose of the "UE test mode procedures" in the 5GS protocol stack?
question_79180.ground_truth: The UE test mode procedures are intended for setting the UE into a test mode where the SS can set up test bearers terminated at a particular point in the 5GS protocol stack, as specified in the functional block diagram of each UE test loop mode of operation.

question_79181.question: What request does the SCC AS send to UE-3 to indicate the progress of the REFER request processing?
question_79181.ground_truth: The SCC AS sends a NOTIFY request to UE-3 to indicate the progress of the REFER request processing.

question_79182.question: What procedure is used if the SMLC desires to avoid lower layer segmentation and transfer the LCS assistance data more reliably?
question_79182.ground_truth: The SMLC may precede the RRLP MEASURE POSITION REQUEST with an "Assistance Data Delivery" procedure.

question_79183.question: What are the pros and cons of the three solutions provided for ensuring the optimized user plane path during MM procedures?
question_79183.ground_truth: Solution 1 has no impact on existing entities like MME and PGW, but solutions 2 and 3 have MME and PGW standards impact and require new procedures or changes to existing 3GPP procedures. Solution 2 has a sub-optimal user plane path until the "subsequent" procedure takes place, while solution 3 ensures the optimized user plane path during the UE mobility procedure.

question_79187.question: What are the four main phases of the S-EAS decided ACR scenario?
question_79187.ground_truth: The four main phases of the S-EAS decided ACR scenario are: Phase I: ACR Detection, Phase II: ACR Decision, Phase III: ACR Execution, and Phase IV: Post-ACR Clean up.

question_79188.question: What is the mechanism used to decide the modulation and coding scheme for traffic channels in CIoT devices?
question_79188.ground_truth: The network decides the modulation and coding scheme to be used for traffic channels based on the reported quality and signal strength from the device.

question_79189.question: What is the high-level description of the solution for Key Issue #2 regarding the maximum number of PDU sessions per slice based on the quota?
question_79189.ground_truth: The solution involves sharing a single network slice among multiple service types, supporting priority among services, and allowing specific services different treatment. The network should be able to differentiate how and when to enforce the slice quota based on operator policy and service agreement.

question_79190.question: What should the MME do if it determines that interworking with 5GS is changed to Supported and it has selected a standalone PGW?
question_79190.ground_truth: The MME may initiate PDN disconnection with reactivation required at the end of the tracking area update procedure. This allows the MME to select a SMF+PGW-C for session continuity when the UE moves to 5GS.

question_79194.question: What is the purpose of the Reset Resource procedure?
question_79194.ground_truth: The Reset Resource procedure is used to initialize part of the UTRAN in the event of an abnormal failure in the CN or vice versa.

question_79195.question: What should the Request-URI of the INVITE request include in case of an emergency call?
question_79195.ground_truth: The UE shall include a service URN in the Request-URI of the INVITE request in accordance with subclause~5.1.6.8.1.

question_79196.question: Who can utilize the gain of the frequency hopping feature?
question_79196.ground_truth: The frequency hopping feature can be utilized by legacy mobiles, provided that they can be supported by the MUROS concept and are allocated to sub-channel one.

question_79197.question: When should the UE store the received SOR-CMCI in the non-volatile memory of the ME?
question_79197.ground_truth: The UE should store the received SOR-CMCI in the non-volatile memory of the ME when it receives a USAT REFRESH with command qualifier of type "Steering of Roaming" or when it receives the steering of roaming information containing the SOR-CMCI over N1 NAS signalling and the "Store SOR-CMCI in ME" indicator is set to "Store SOR-CMCI in ME".

question_79198.question: What is the role of the MCPTT client in response to the periodic group call announcement?
question_79198.ground_truth: The MCPTT client does not need to respond to the periodic group call announcement, as it is only used to provide additional values per parameter for better user experience.

question_79199.question: What information is included in the Location Report returned by the RAN to the SGSN when the requested location estimate has been obtained?
question_79199.ground_truth: The Location Report includes an indication of whether the obtained location estimate satisfies the requested accuracy or not, the location estimate if obtained, and a failure cause if the location estimate could not be obtained or if the requested location assistance data could not be transferred successfully to the UE.

question_79201.question: What does it indicate when the Reject cause value is set to '6' in the floor control server's response?
question_79201.ground_truth: The floor control server cannot grant the floor request due to congestion.

question_79202.question: Which intermodulation product falls into the 3rd own Rx frequency of Band 42 in section 6.43.1.2?
question_79202.ground_truth: The 3rd and 4th IMDs fall into the 3rd own Rx frequency of Band 42 in section 6.43.1.2.

question_79203.question: Under what conditions can the participating MCVideo function choose to accept an unauthorized prearranged MCVideo group call request with an emergency or imminent peril indication set to "true"?
question_79203.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function can choose to accept the request if the SIP INVITE request contains an emergency indication or an imminent peril indication set to "true" and this is an authorized request for originating a priority call as determined by local policy in clause 6.3.2.1.6.1.

question_79205.question: When is the measurement reporting procedure initiated if the reportType is set to rxTxPeriodical and a (first) measurement result is available?
question_79205.ground_truth: If the reportType is set to rxTxPeriodical and a (first) measurement result is available, a measurement reporting entry for the measId is included within the VarMeasReportList for that measId, the numberOfReportsSent is set to 0, and the measurement reporting procedure is initiated as specified in section 5.5.5.

question_79206.question: Who must never issue an AV with the Separation bit set to 1 to a non-SAE network entity?
question_79206.ground_truth: The HSS must never issue an AV with the Separation bit set to 1 to a non-SAE network entity.

question_79207.question: What are the functions of the NF Service producer in the secured AI/ML model transfer and retrieval mechanism?
question_79207.ground_truth: The NF Service producer is responsible for training the model, storing the encrypted ML model in the ADRF, registering the model specific information, and sending the URI to access the model upon successful model storage.

question_79208.question: What is the maximum number of outstanding SMS-DELIVER requests that the SC can have for a specific MS at a given time?
question_79208.ground_truth: Only one outstanding SMS-DELIVER request is allowed for a specific MS at any given time.

question_79209.question: What is the purpose of the intent driven approach for RAN energy saving discussed in Issue 4.1?
question_79209.ground_truth: The intent driven approach for RAN energy saving enables the 3GPP management system to analyze and select the optimal balance between energy saving and service experience by using intelligence mechanisms.

question_79210.question: How many slots are included in a radio frame?
question_79210.ground_truth: A radio frame consists of 15 slots. The length of a slot corresponds to 2560 chips.

question_79212.question: Which element contains the <remote-UE> and/or <UNR> elements?
question_79212.ground_truth: The <requested-for> element contains the <remote-UE> and/or <UNR> elements.

question_79213.question: How often should the UE measure the signal level of GSM BCCH carriers if they are indicated in the measurement control system information of the serving cell?
question_79213.ground_truth: The UE should measure the signal level of GSM BCCH carriers at least every Tmeasure,GSM if they are indicated in the measurement control system information of the serving cell.

question_79214.question: What is the purpose of the EEC sharing UE mobility requirement in 7.51.2.1?
question_79214.ground_truth: The solution proposes the EEC to share the indication for mobility support requirement in EEC registration request message in order to enhance EEC registration procedure specified in clause~8.4.2.2.2 and EEC registration update procedure as specified in clause~8.4.2.2.3. The EEC registration request or update request from the EEC may include indication for mobility support requirement to the EES.

question_79217.question: What is the condition for the SSB transmission for the PDCCH monitoring occasion for paging, as defined in 8.1.8.2.2.3?
question_79217.ground_truth: The PDCCH monitoring occasion for paging which do not overlap with UL symbols are sequentially numbered from zero starting from the first PDCCH monitoring occasion for paging in the PF.

question_79218.question: What is the purpose of a PGW-CDR in IP-CAN session charging?
question_79218.ground_truth: A PGW-CDR is used to collect charging information related to the IP-CAN bearer data information for a UE/MS in the P-GW.

question_79220.question: What does the EU status EU2: NOT UPDATED imply?
question_79220.ground_truth: The last attach, service request or tracking area updating attempt failed procedurally, e.g. no response or reject message was received from the MME.

question_79221.question: What is the role of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in relation to the Future Railway Mobile Communication System (FRMCS)?
question_79221.ground_truth: The 3GPP is responsible for producing technical specifications and reports for FRMCS, as well as other mobile communication systems. The present document is a technical report produced by the 3GPP, providing analysis and potential requirements for FRMCS.

question_79222.question: What are the four possible elements that can be contained within the <prose-pc3ch-message> element?
question_79222.ground_truth: The four possible elements are: <USAGE_INFORMATION_REPORT_LIST>, <USAGE_INFORMATION_REPORT_LIST_RESPONSE>, <anyExt>, and elements from other namespaces defined in future releases.

question_79223.question: What action does the System Simulator take after receiving measurements concerning cell B?
question_79223.ground_truth: The SS sends a HANDOVER COMMAND message allocating a channel (TCH/F, TCH/H or SDCCH), with a starting time and channel descriptions for both before and after the starting time, based on the measurements received.

question_79224.question: What happens at the receiver side when the DC subcarrier is not present in the transmitted signal?
question_79224.ground_truth: All subcarriers within the receiver bandwidth are transmitted.

question_79226.question: How many HARQ processes can one HARQ entity support for HS-DSCH operation in one TTI?
question_79226.ground_truth: One HARQ entity is capable of supporting multiple instances (HARQ process) of stop and wait HARQ protocols.

question_79227.question: Which HTTP method is used by the "C2 Operation Mode Management Completion Notification" to notify the C2 operation mode management completion status for a UAS?
question_79227.ground_truth: The "C2 Operation Mode Management Completion Notification" uses the HTTP POST method to notify the C2 operation mode management completion status for a UAS.

question_79228.question: What network deployment scenarios does the solution support?
question_79228.ground_truth: The solution supports regional Edge Data Network deployment and partial Edge Data Network deployment.

question_79229.question: What is the order of priority for the mobile station to select the mobile identity type in the paging response message for enhanced DTM CS establishment?
question_79229.ground_truth: The mobile identity type is selected in the following order of priority: TMSI (if available), and IMSI (if no TMSI is available).

question_79230.question: What is the function of the MC Security Gateway (SeGy) in the 3GPP technical specification?
question_79230.ground_truth: The MC Security Gateway (SeGy) is a function which terminates MC security to allow for interworking with external systems that do not support mission critical security mechanisms.

question_79232.question: What represents the properties of a network slice in a 5G network?
question_79232.ground_truth: The NetworkSlice IOC represents the properties of a network slice in a 5G network.

question_79233.question: What is the role of the NEF (Network Exposure Function) in the interaction between the AF and the 5GC?
question_79233.ground_truth: If the operator does not allow an AF to access the network directly, the AF shall use the NEF to interact with the 5GC.

question_79234.question: What is the procedure for the ME to avoid a synchronization failure when in A/Gb mode?
question_79234.ground_truth: To avoid a synchronization failure when the ME receives an AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING REQUEST message, the ME stores the received RAND value together with the RES value from the USIM in the volatile memory and associates it with the PS domain. When the ME receives a subsequent AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING REQUEST message in the same PS domain, the ME checks if the stored RAND value is equal to the new received value in the AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING REQUEST message. If they are the same, the ME immediately sends the AUTHENTICATION AND CIPHERING RESPONSE message with the stored RES value for the PS domain. If there is no valid stored RAND or the stored RAND is different from the new received value, the ME proceeds with the standard authentication process.

question_79235.question: How does the new bandwidth information get provided to the IMS-AGW, TrGW and MRFP via the Iq interface, Ix interface and Mp interfaces, respectively?
question_79235.ground_truth: The new bandwidth information is provided to the IMS-AGW, TrGW and MRFP via the Iq interface, Ix interface and Mp interfaces, respectively.

question_79236.question: Which methods can the UE use to detect movement?
question_79236.ground_truth: The UE can detect movement based on the ICMP Lifetime field of the router advertisements, if the lifetime of an agent advertisement has expired and the UE has not received another Agent Advertisement message from the same FA, it will need to register with a new FA. Another method is based on the advertised prefix, a change in the advertised prefix may lead the UE to think that it has moved and to register with the newly advertised prefix. The UE can also detect movement based on layer 1 and layer 2 indications.

question_79239.question: What is the time period during which the BS transmitter is not transmitting data or reference symbols?

question_79240.question: Which two network performance parameters are included in the scope of network performance management in 3GPP?
question_79240.ground_truth: Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and performance measurements are included in the scope of network performance management in 3GPP.

question_79241.question: If the reportType is set to eventTriggered, when is the leaving condition for event B2 considered to be fulfilled?
question_79241.ground_truth: The leaving condition for event B2 is considered to be fulfilled for one or more of the cells included in the cellsTriggeredList, for all measurements after layer 3 filtering taken during timeToTrigger defined for this event, if the b2-Threshold2 is met and the cellsTriggeredList is not empty.

question_79244.question: What are the two main options available for content down-sampling and up-sampling in the content re-targeting operation?
question_79244.ground_truth: The two main options are: (1) performing down-sampling (up-sampling) operation on both stereo views first and then performing depth adjustment, or (2) first extracting the depth map and performing down-sampling (up-sampling) operation on one view and the depth map.

question_79246.question: What action should the VLR take if it receives a BSSAP+-LOCATION-UPDATE-REQUEST message while T6-2 is running?
question_79246.ground_truth: The VLR should stop T6-2, abort the TMSI reallocation procedure, and proceed with the new location update for non-GPRS services procedure.

question_79248.question: What is the role of the field flag in HS-SCCH type 8?
question_79248.ground_truth: The field flag is used to distinguish the mapping of special information in HS-SCCH type 8.

question_79249.question: What is required for the MS to consider another subchannel as the new worst subchannel in the 26.13.1.1.3.1 conformance requirements?
question_79249.ground_truth: For the MS to consider another subchannel as the new worst subchannel, the RX quality of the other subchannel must be worse than the currently reported worst subchannel.

question_79251.question: What is the format of the MCData Group Identity value in an MBMS subchannel control message?
question_79251.ground_truth: The MCData Group Identity value is a binary value that contains the MCData group identity as defined in 3GPP TS 24.282 and is in URI format (ASCII string).

question_79253.question: What is the definition of "initial location" in the context of an originating emergency call?
question_79253.ground_truth: In the context of an originating emergency call, the location estimate and the associated time stamp at the commencement of the call set-up is referred to as "initial location".

question_79254.question: What does the 5G system provide to enable the Localized Mobile Metaverse Services use case functionality?
question_79254.ground_truth: The 5G system provides location-based services, means to expose the UE's location to a 3rd party service provider, and location services supported through a CAPIF API between NEF and the AF.

question_79255.question: What occurs when the LL-RELEASE-IND service primitive is received?
question_79255.ground_truth: When the LL-RELEASE-IND service primitive is received, the LLC link has been disconnected and LLC is in ADM mode.

question_79256.question: What is the effect of the successful operation of the assignment procedure?
question_79256.ground_truth: Based on the analysis of the ASSIGNMENT REQUEST, the BSS chooses the appropriate radio resource(s) and allocates the appropriate resources for transcoding, rate adaptation etc. The BSS sends the appropriate radio assignment messages and starts timer T10. The ASSIGNMENT REQUEST message includes sufficient information to allow the BSS to construct the necessary layer 3 radio messages.

question_79257.question: What should the ME not do with the new KAUSF when handling an EAP response message and certain conditions are met?
question_79257.ground_truth: The ME should not use the new KAUSF in the verification of SOR transparent container and UE parameters update transparent container, if any are received, until receipt of an EAP-success message.

question_79258.question: When can the gsmSCF send the Continue IF?
question_79258.ground_truth: The gsmSCF can send the Continue IF when there is a CSA with a single call segment, which includes only leg~1, or only leg~2, or both leg~1 and leg~2, but no other legs.

question_79259.question: What action does the MS take when it receives a RRLP MEASURE POSITION REQUEST with the same REFERENCE NUMBER as the current one?
question_79259.ground_truth: The MS ignores the second RRLP MEASURE POSITION REQUEST.

question_79260.question: What is the maximum RF bandwidth of each supported operating band that should not be exceeded when combining two or more bands in a multi-band operation?
question_79260.ground_truth: The sum of the maximum RF bandwidth of each supported operating band should not exceed the declared total RF bandwidth of transmitter and receiver for the declared band combinations of the BS.

question_79261.question: How does the UE initiate the provisioning of HomeNetworkPreference information?
question_79261.ground_truth: The UE sends a client-initiated session containing a generic alert with the "Type" element set to "urn:oma:at:ext-3gpp-andsf:1.0:provision-homenetworkpreference-info" and the "LocURI" element set to the address of the ANDSF Management Object.

question_79263.question: What is the role of the inter-satellite link in this communication system?
question_79263.ground_truth: The inter-satellite link is used to forward the stored packets from one satellite to another while preserving the integrity, confidentiality, and security of the data.

question_79264.question: What are the impacts on the BSS and Core Network for the fast Ack/Nack reporting mechanism?
question_79264.ground_truth: There are no impacts to the Core Network, but the BSS needs to be updated to handle the new ACK/NACK scheme. This may involve reusing existing signalling messages, except for the "Fast Ack/Nack reporting" mechanism, and updating BTS algorithms to exploit Incremental Redundancy.

question_79266.question: What is the request type for a SIP MESSAGE request that is sent to the controlling MCVideo function, contains a Content-Type header set to "application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml" and includes an XML body containing an <mcvideoinfo> root element with an <mcvideo-Params> element and an <emergency-ind> or <alert-ind> element?
question_79266.ground_truth: A SIP MESSAGE request for emergency notification for controlling MCVideo function

question_79267.question: What should the DPCCH quality be monitored for on the UEs receiver antenna connectors?
question_79267.ground_truth: The DPCCH quality should be monitored in the UE and compared to the thresholds Qout and Qin for the purpose of monitoring synchronization.

question_79269.question: What is the role of the SPK-ID in the MCData function?
question_79269.ground_truth: The SPK-ID is used in the participating and controlling MCData functions for the creation and verification of the authentication signature in the MCData function.

question_79270.question: How do online charging and offline charging relate to AoC services?
question_79270.ground_truth: From the end-user perspective, online charging, offline charging, and AoC services are mutually independent. However, AoC Information can be based on tariff information from an online charging system or real-time tariff information from an external network or service provider.

question_79272.question: How many bits does the retransmission sequence number (RSN) have in E-UCCH part 2?
question_79272.ground_truth: The RSN in E-UCCH part 2 consists of two bits.

question_79273.question: What is the internal state managed by the MCVideo client, in conjunction with the MCVideo imminent peril group state, to aid in managing the use of the Resource-Priority header field and related actions?

question_79275.question: What message is sent by the UE to the SCF in order to de-register from one or more MBMS User Services?

question_79277.question: In what mode should the M-HC continue compressing uplink data if it is already operating in R mode and a context relocation of RFC3095 header compression protocol is to be applied?
question_79277.ground_truth: The M-HC can continue compressing uplink data and transmitting it normally.

question_79279.question: What should the H-PCF check when processing policy decisions in the "UE Policy Association Modification" procedure?
question_79279.ground_truth: The H-PCF must check if the UE policy size exceeds a predefined limit before sending the response to the AMF in step 2.

question_79283.question: What data type is used for providing information of an untrusted AF Instance?

question_79284.question: What is the difference between the channel part and the noise-and-interference part of explicit feedback in support of DL CoMP in LTE-Advanced?
question_79284.ground_truth: The channel part includes channel properties, such as the channel matrix or transmit channel covariance, while the noise-and-interference part includes interference measurements and the total receive power or covariance matrix.

question_79286.question: What is the effect of using SF64 code shared by 3 users in comparison to using SF128 for one user?
question_79286.ground_truth: By sharing one SF64 code among 3 users, the number of effective users becomes 192 without loss of OVSF code orthogonality, while the code rate loss is roughly 1.76dB, which can be compensated by removing the dedicated pilot fields.

question_79288.question: What is the frequency separation between Band 1 downlink and B7 uplink?
question_79288.ground_truth: The frequency separation of Band 1 downlink and B7 uplink is 330 MHz.

question_79289.question: What conditions must be met before a mobile station can make a mobile-originated access attempt for the CS domain or PS domain after receiving an implicit reject?
question_79289.ground_truth: The mobile station is not allowed to make a mobile-originated access attempt for the CS domain or PS domain in the same cell until T3234 or T3236 expires or is stopped.

question_79290.question: What is the meaning of the term "OAM" in the NWDAF context?
question_79290.ground_truth: OAM stands for Operations, Administration, and Maintenance, referring to the network management tasks undertaken in the 5GC network.

question_79293.question: What is the measurement period for inter frequency CPICH measurements, if the UE does not require measurement occasions and idle intervals to perform inter-frequency FDD measurements?

question_79294.question: How many output streams does the tail biting convolutional coding encoder have?
question_79294.ground_truth: The tail biting convolutional coding encoder has three output streams, labeled and .

question_79296.question: Which type of compression maintains the maximum amount of information while reducing the stream size to fit a given bandwidth?

question_79297.question: What is one of the implementation criteria that can be used to define whether a connection is optimal or suboptimal in a 3GPP system?
question_79297.ground_truth: Geography, topology, and load balancing are some of the implementation criteria that can be used to define whether a connection is optimal or suboptimal in a 3GPP system.

question_79299.question: What is the function of the old EAS in the process of EAS relocation?
question_79299.ground_truth: The old EAS may send the new EAS IP address to the UE via an application mechanism, such as HTTP redirection, or it may receive the last packet notification from the UE and then start to use the new EAS IP address as the target IP address for uplink data.

question_79301.question: What is one of the threats faced by the infrequent small data feature?
question_79301.ground_truth: An attacker sniffing the traffic on the air interface has more time in between transmissions to mount a key recovery attack.

question_79302.question: What is the function of the "ProfileLevel" interior node for the H.265 video codec?
question_79302.ground_truth: The "ProfileLevel" interior node for the H.265 video codec is used to refer to a list of parameters related to the profile and level of the video codec. It specifies the maximum computational complexity supported by the offerer in performing decoding for the given profile.

question_79303.question: In what state should the floor participant interface be when it receives a Floor Request message from the floor participant while in the 'P: has no permission' state?
question_79303.ground_truth: The floor participant interface should send the Floor Request message to the floor control server interface and remain in the 'P: has no permission' state.

question_79304.question: How is the PDN differentiated in the case of multiple PDNs broadcasting or multicasting datagrams sent by the UE in IPv4?
question_79304.ground_truth: In IPv4, it cannot be distinguished by evaluating the IP address. The network side needs to know which interface (i.e. network) the broadcast comes from, in this case, it is associated with the default bearer of the particular PDN.

question_79307.question: What is the role of the VAE server in the message delivery procedure to target geographical locations?
question_79307.ground_truth: The VAE server determines the client identification for the intended clients in the target geographic locations using the mapping, and then transmits the message to each VAE client using the client identification.

question_79308.question: What is the effect of Terminating Identification Restriction (TIR) on the conference notification service for a conference focus?
question_79308.ground_truth: If TIR is active for the terminating party of a session, then the identity information of that participant shall not be included in conference notifications to other participants.

question_79309.question: What is the maximum allowed offset for frequency modulation in the described measurement when a generic expression is applied?
question_79309.ground_truth: The maximum allowed offset for frequency modulation is 1.8 MHz.

question_79310.question: What is the function of the Serving GW when the non-3GPP IP accesses are connected to the VPLMN in a roaming scenario?
question_79310.ground_truth: The Serving GW acts as a local non-3GPP anchor for the non-3GPP IP accesses when they are connected to the VPLMN in a roaming scenario.

question_79312.question: What is the role of the UTM in associating the UAV and the UAV controller as a UAS in the initial authorization process?
question_79312.ground_truth: The UTM needs to be able to associate the UAV and the UAV controller as a UAS during the initial authorization procedures. If the UTM rejects the request, the MNO rejects the attach request of the UAV and/or UAV controller of the UAS.

question_79313.question: What physical-layer information is required for short-term timescale coordination between NR SL and LTE SL when SL transmissions from both RATs overlap or one RAT's transmission overlaps with the other RAT's reception?
question_79313.ground_truth: For short-term timescale coordination, coexistence is feasible between NR SL and LTE SL with SPS scheduling when SL transmissions from both RATs overlap or transmission from one overlaps with reception for the other, by prioritizing one of the RATs on each occurrence. This requires information exchange within the UE between the SLs.

question_79315.question: What is the default authentication method for EEC, ECS, and EES?
question_79315.ground_truth: The default authentication method for EEC, ECS, and EES is TLS with certificates.

question_79316.question: What are the procedures for handling P-CSCF service interruption scenarios between the IP-CAN, IM CN subsystem, HSS, and UE?
question_79316.ground_truth: HSS based P-CSCF restoration procedures involve the IP-CAN, IM CN subsystem, HSS, and UE.

question_79317.question: What is the definition of "test orchestration" in the 3GPP technical documents?
question_79317.ground_truth: Test orchestration refers to determining the execution order of test cases in a test task, while allocating and deallocating resources to support testing.

question_79319.question: What should a UE do if the resumption of the RRC connection is triggered by a multicast reception request as specified in clause 5.3.13.1d?
question_79319.ground_truth: The UE should select '0' as the Access Category, perform the unified access control procedure as specified in 5.3.14 using the selected Access Category and one or more Access Identities provided by upper layers, and if the access attempt is barred, the procedure ends.

question_79321.question: What should a PFCP entity do after it has restarted and cleared all remote restart counters across PFCP based interfaces?
question_79321.ground_truth: It shall immediate update all local Recovery Time Stamps and shall clear all remote Recovery Time Stamps, and when peer PFCP entities information is available, it shall send its updated Recovery Time Stamps in a Heartbeat Request message to the peer PFCP entities before initiating any PFCP session signalling.

question_79323.question: What is the role of the 3GPP Technical Specification Group (TSG) in the production of 3GPP technical specifications?
question_79323.ground_truth: The 3GPP Technical Specification Group (TSG) is responsible for the production of 3GPP technical specifications. The contents of a technical specification may change following formal TSG approval.

question_79325.question: What is the function of 'IvsProcess' in the C-code?
question_79325.ground_truth: The function 'IvsProcess' is an IVS modem function that processes the PCM data in the C-code.

question_79326.question: What should the UE do when the CSI-IM for L1-SINR measurement and the CSI-RS are not Quasi-Collocation-ed with respect to QCL-TypeD or the QCL information is not known to the UE in FR2 for one CC in the same band?
question_79326.ground_truth: The UE is required to measure one of but not both CSI-IM for L1-SINR measurement and CSI-RS.

question_79327.question: What is the measure used to define the modulation accuracy in 10.1?
question_79327.ground_truth: The modulation accuracy is defined by the Error Vector Magnitude (EVM), which is a measure of the difference between the theoretical waveform and a modified version of the measured waveform.

question_79328.question: What is the role of synchronization primitives in the LTE downlink?
question_79328.ground_truth: In LTE, synchronization primitives are used to indicate the synchronization status of radio links, both in uplink and downlink. They play a critical role in maintaining the synchronization of dedicated channels and detecting any potential out-of-sync issues.

question_79329.question: When does the UE make the non-current full native 5G NAS security context as the current native 5G NAS security context, during an inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode in 5GMM-IDLE mode?
question_79329.ground_truth: The UE makes the non-current full native 5G NAS security context as the current native 5G NAS security context, when the UE has a non-current full native 5G NAS security context, and performs an inter-system change from S1 mode to N1 mode in 5GMM-IDLE mode.

question_79332.question: What bit is used for conveying channel control information in the parallel data substreams in multislot data AIURs?
question_79332.ground_truth: The S6, S8, S9, and the other X-bit are used for conveying channel control information in the parallel data substreams in multislot data AIURs.

question_79333.question: What is the role of the SCC AS after it receives an OK message from the Conference AS?
question_79333.ground_truth: After the SCC AS receives an OK message from the Conference AS, it sends an OK message to the ICS UE A via the I1 interface to continue session establishment.

question_79334.question: What is the role of Solution #45 in enabling support for QoS for L3 relaying?
question_79334.ground_truth: Solution #45 enables support for QoS that is appropriate for the services offered to Remote UE even if it is accessing over 5G Prose Relay UE served by a PLMN that is different from the PLMN serving the Remote UE.

question_79336.question: What is the expected sequence for the test described in section 43.1.2.2?
question_79336.ground_truth: The expected sequence for the test described in section 43.1.2.2 is for the MS to ignore negative acknowledgements for data blocks outside the transmit window.

question_79337.question: What are the two functionalities of the Group Session Management Function (GSMF) for the management and control of maximum bit rate for a 5G VN group?
question_79337.ground_truth: The two functionalities of the GSMF are storing the status of the activated 5G VN group members and their maximum bit rate and introducing the Group-MBR as a new input parameter for the 5G VN group data in UDM and NEF parameter provisioning services for 5G VN group data provisioning. The Group-MBR limits the total bit rate that can be expected to be provided across all sessions of a 5G VN group.

question_79338.question: What is the XML element used to determine the group identity related to an SDS or FD message request?

question_79339.question: What is the procedure in UMTS for transmission by the RNC of a RANAP RAB RELEASE REQUEST message for PS domain?
question_79339.ground_truth: On transmission by the RNC of a RANAP RAB RELEASE REQUEST message for PS domain, each RAB requested to be released is added to the relevant per cause measurement.

question_79340.question: What is the definition of Total Radiated Sensitivity (TRS) using the Anechoic Chamber method?
question_79340.ground_truth: TRS is defined as the inverted integral of the effective isotropic sensitivity (EIS) over a sphere, where EIS is the minimum power level at which the throughput exceeds or equals 95% of the maximum throughput of the specified reference measurement channel.

question_79341.question: In the inter-band TDD case, how many non-consecutive DTX subframes are allowed by the SS during the subframes (m+20) to (m+29) and (m+33) for SCell1?
question_79341.ground_truth: The SS should allow for at most 2 non-consecutive DTX subframes during the subframes (m+20) to (m+29) and (m+33) for SCell1.

question_79342.question: What is the limitation of using HSS for supporting change location triggers and associated logic in 3GPP system?
question_79342.ground_truth: The limitation of using HSS for supporting change location triggers and associated logic in 3GPP system is that it requires enhancements to HSS, MME/SGSN, and increases signalling to/from nodes (MME/SGSN and SCEF) and HSS, which is not recommended.

question_79344.question: What is the expected sequence defined in clause 27.22.4.13.2.5 when the SIM simulator sends a SET UP CALL command?
question_79344.ground_truth: The expected sequence defined in clause 27.22.4.13.2.5 when the SIM simulator sends a SET UP CALL command is the same as the sequence in clause 27.22.4.13.2.1.

question_79345.question: In which situations do the Intra-MeNB handover involving SCG change and Inter-MeNB handover without SeNB change procedures apply?
question_79345.ground_truth: These procedures apply in the case of intra-MeNB or inter-MeNB handover, where the NR part may or may not change.

question_79346.question: In which scenario should the SNRM-S send an MBMS bearer announcement message with information related to TMGI 2 towards the SNRM-C?
question_79346.ground_truth: If the SNRM-S receives an HTTP POST request message containing a Content-Type header field set to "application/vnd.3gpp.seal-location-info+xml" and an application/vnd.3gpp.seal-location-info+xml MIME body with a <report> element in the <location-info> root element and the identity of the sender of the received HTTP POST request is authorized to report location information.

question_79348.question: What should the SS look out for in subframes (m+5) to (m+9) and (m+13) up to the end of T2 for intra-band CA UE in step 6a?

question_79350.question: Which records are used to report handover related events between the MME and RAN nodes for a target UE?

question_79352.question: What is the role of the 3GPP Generic User Profile (GUP) within the 3GPP mobile system?
question_79352.ground_truth: The 3GPP Generic User Profile (GUP) provides a conceptual description to enable harmonized usage of the user-related information located in different entities within the 3GPP mobile system, which includes multiple domains and access technologies.

question_79353.question: What is the Overall delays measured test requirement for this test case?
question_79353.ground_truth: The Overall delays measured shall be less than a total of 1002 ms in this test case.

question_79356.question: What is the purpose of defining new bandwidth modifiers in TS 26.114 clause 6.2?
question_79356.ground_truth: The purpose is to align the b=AS bandwidth with the downlink Maximum Bit Rate (MBR) and clarify the conditions when an MTSI client should perform a session re-negotiation.

question_79357.question: What is the location information structure?
question_79357.ground_truth: Location information structure contains horizontalUncertainty, horizontalConfidence, verticalUncertainty, and verticalConfidence integers (0-255 and 0-100, respectively) to describe the location and height uncertainty of the measured location. The iE-Extensions can be used to add additional information to the structure.

question_79358.question: What is the maximum number of physical channels for a timeslot in uplink for 7.68Mcps TDD?
question_79358.ground_truth: The maximum number of physical channels for a timeslot in uplink for 7.68Mcps TDD is 32.

question_79359.question: What action does the CC-entity of the MS in state U11 take when the RELEASE message is received?
question_79359.ground_truth: The CC-entity returns RELEASE COMPLETE and enters the CC-state U0, "Null".

question_79360.question: What are the UPF event exposure events used for data collection?
question_79360.ground_truth: The UPF event exposure events used for data collection include QoS Monitoring, UserDataUsageMeasures, and UserDataUsageTrends.

question_79362.question: Where should the IMS Server MSISDN be included when sending a SIP MESSAGE with SMS-DELIVER?
question_79362.ground_truth: It should be included in the RP-OA and TP-OA of RP-DATA (SMS-DELIVER).

question_79363.question: What are the two 5G QoS characteristics that are signaled together if they are not standardized?
question_79363.ground_truth: A 5QI value from the non-standardized value range and the 5G QoS characteristics are signaled together over N7 if they are not standardized.

question_79365.question: What are the devices involved in the channel establishment in the PROACTIVE COMMAND: OPEN CHANNEL 6.2.1?
question_79365.ground_truth: The source device is UICC, and the destination device is ME.

question_79366.question: What is the role of the HSS in the SAE/LTE Access System?
question_79366.ground_truth: The HSS stores the UE context, including the permanent user identity and other information like security and IP connectivity parameters. It also registers the MME/UPE serving the user at the HSS and confirms the registration of the new MME/UPE.

question_79367.question: What should be the response of the USS (UICC Sub-System) when the URL requested in the proactive command execution is not the Default URL or the URL provided in the proactive command?
question_79367.ground_truth: The USS should respond with an HTTP status error code (4xx "Client Error" or 5xx "Server Error") to URL requests which do not match the Default URL or the URL provided in the proactive command.

question_79369.question: What is the difference between an emergency group communication and a regular group communication in MCVideo?
question_79369.ground_truth: During an emergency group communication, every communication initiated by the MCVideo client will be an emergency communication, and the group remains in the in-progress emergency state until the emergency group communication ends or the in-progress emergency state is cancelled.

question_79371.question: What is power dynamics in the context of time-dilated UMTS?
question_79371.ground_truth: Power dynamics refers to the way in which the transmission power of a time-dilated UMTS signal is controlled and managed. It can include inner loop power control, handling of output power when out of synchronization, and the adjustment of transmit ON/OFF time mask.

question_79372.question: In which field of the RTP header extension can an MTSI sender signal the requested delay budget for the sent RTP stream?
question_79372.ground_truth: The MTSI sender can signal the requested delay budget in the RTP header extension by including the request as a new RTP header extension with the ID set to delay and len=7.

question_79376.question: What is the role of the AMF in the MBS session activation procedure?
question_79376.ground_truth: The AMF determines the CM state of the UEs involved in the multicast MBS session, indicates UEs to the SMF when they are in the CM-CONNECTED state, and notifies the related SMF of UEs that are reachable after the AMF receives a request for the SMF to indicate UEs for the MT-Group.

question_79377.question: What HTTP status code should be returned, if the HSS sends a request to the UDM to update thePEI attribute in the 3GPP Access Registration context and the user does not exist?

question_79378.question: What is the difference between cell update and routing area update?
question_79378.ground_truth: A cell update is performed when the MS enters a new cell inside the current RA and the MS is in READY state, while a routing area update is performed when the MS enters a new cell that is part of a different routing area.

question_79380.question: What must the ME do if the UICC responds with '93 00' when attempting to establish an EPS PDN connection?
question_79380.ground_truth: The ME shall not activate the EPS PDN Connection and may retry the command.

question_79381.question: What is the procedure for UE if the AMF has indicated support for emergency services using fallback via the Registration Accept message for the current RAT?
question_79381.ground_truth: The UE sends a Service Request message indicating that it requires emergency services fallback if it has a pending IMS emergency session request. The UE is not required to include PDU Sessions that are not relevant for the emergency service in the List Of PDU Sessions to be Activated in the Service Request for the emergency service.

question_79382.question: What is the maximum time duration from the start of T5 for the UE to transmit PUCCH with LRR, followed by BFR MAC CE containing a beam associated with the candidate beam set q1,0 for the specific test scenario?
question_79382.ground_truth: No later than time point F occurring no later than D1 = 1920+10 ms after the start of T5.

question_79383.question: What is the network provider responsible for in service-based sharing scenarios?
question_79383.ground_truth: The network provider is responsible for maintaining QoS guarantees for each service or customer over the resource facing aspects of a single NSI and determining the policies and rules about how the network resources are utilized.

question_79384.question: What should the Parlay-X Gateway do if the network capability does not support aliases or group addresses and the Identity Management Framework is not available?
question_79384.ground_truth: The Parlay-X Gateway should reject the aliases and group addresses in this situation.

question_79385.question: What is the Initial Codec Mode set to in step 1b) of the procedure?
question_79385.ground_truth: The Initial Codec Mode is set to the 12.2 kbit/s mode in 1b).

question_79389.question: What message does SGSN send to MME to initiate the forward relocation procedure for a voice media handover in LTE?
question_79389.ground_truth: SGSN sends the Forward Relocation Request message to the MME with the CS indication to initiate the forward relocation procedure for a voice media handover in LTE.

question_79390.question: What should the UE do if it has reached the maximum number of rejected S-NSSAIs and wishes to obtain services in the current serving cell without performing a PLMN selection or SNPN selection?
question_79390.ground_truth: The UE may stay in the current serving cell and attempt to use the rejected S-NSSAI(s) for the maximum number of UEs reached in the current serving cell after the rejected S-NSSAI(s) are removed.

question_79392.question: What two aspects of the 5G network's energy efficiency can be addressed by the work item related to 5G Energy Efficiency (EE)?
question_79392.ground_truth: The two aspects of the 5G network's energy efficiency that can be addressed by the work item are the definition of EE Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and the specification of solutions to optimize EE via Energy Saving (ES) techniques.

question_79393.question: What is the result of the terminal response when attempting to deactivate timer with the identifier 3, and which device receives the response?
question_79393.ground_truth: Action in contradiction with the current timer state. The response is received by the ME device.

question_79394.question: What is the expected outcome of the "Normal execution" criteria CRRN1 in the CatReadBinary API?
question_79394.ground_truth: If data can be accessed at the specified offset in the currently selected transparent file, an attempt is made to read the number of bytes in Bytes, the bytes read are returned in Buffer and the actual number of bytes read returned in Bytes.

question_79395.question: What is the condition for a failure in the event "Cell 2 A2"?
question_79395.ground_truth: If the UE sends event-triggered measurement reports before the beginning of time period T3 or fails to report the event within the overall delays measured requirement, then the number of failures for the event "Cell 2 A2" is increased by one.

question_79397.question: How does the FRMCS system handle an ongoing railway emergency alert in terms of ongoing interactions and other types of communication on the FRMCS equipment?
question_79397.ground_truth: While an alert is active, the FRMCS User is still able to establish and/or receive other types of communication. However, if an emergency voice communication is established by the FRMCS User during this time, any other ongoing voice communications will be terminated.

question_79398.question: What is the length of the timeslot shifting sequence for a given set of parameters in the context of 3GPP TS 23.003?
question_79398.ground_truth: The length of the timeslot shifting sequence for a given set of parameters is 8 x 51 52-multiframes.

question_79399.question: What is the maximum allowed delay uncertainty for measurement reporting on the DCCH?
question_79399.ground_truth: The maximum allowed delay uncertainty for measurement reporting on the DCCH is 2 times the TTIDCCH.

question_79402.question: What action does the IMS-ALG take if the P-CSCF indicates that it should ignore incoming TCP connection establishment requests?
question_79402.ground_truth: If the P-CSCF indicates that it should ignore incoming TCP connection establishment requests, the IMS-AGW will drop any incoming TCP SYN received from the remote peer.

question_79403.question: What step is taken after the RN and DeNB have established a KO-bound AS security context to avoid having to re-run the activation procedure after a CONNECTED-IDLE-CONNECTED cycle?
question_79403.ground_truth: The RN and the DeNB keep using a KO-bound AS security context even if the RN goes via RRC_IDLE state and comes back to RRC_CONNECTED.

question_79404.question: What are the conditions for a VAL user to participate in a new group created by an authorized VAL user/UE?
question_79404.ground_truth: If an authorized VAL user/UE wants to participate in a new group created by the authorized VAL user/UE, then the authorized VAL user/UE needs to have been included in the new group as a member.

question_79405.question: What message does the UE use to initiate a PRU association procedure?
question_79405.ground_truth: The UE invokes a PRU association procedure by sending a REGISTER message containing a PRU-association invoke component as defined in 3GPP~TS~24.080.

question_79407.question: What is one solution for achieving UE topological location awareness in 5G that involves the 5GC(SMF) providing a DNS that is closest to the PSA?
question_79407.ground_truth: Providing a DNS for the PDU Session that is near the PSA, the DNS request can be solved to an Application server which is closest to that PSA. Solution alternatives include the 5GC(SMF) providing a DNS that is closest to the PSA.

question_79408.question: What information is indicated in the "X-3gpp-FEC-Interleaving" attribute in interleaving signaling of MBMS service?
question_79408.ground_truth: The "X-3gpp-FEC-Interleaving" attribute indicates to receivers the order of transmission of the media units of a source block and whether intra-stream interleaving has been performed or not for each of the flows in the FEC source block.

question_79409.question: What should a UE include in the NBIFOM status parameter when responding with a PDN MODIFICATION REJECT message due to a rejected routing rules indication?
question_79409.ground_truth: When responding with a PDN MODIFICATION REJECT message due to a rejected routing rules indication, the UE should include the NBIFOM status parameter with an appropriate error value in the NBIFOM container IE.

question_79410.question: What is the technique used in character grouping to increase compression performance of the Huffman coder?
question_79410.ground_truth: The technique involves grouping characters that may be expected to occur together within the input stream, signaling transitions between the groups rather than each individual character.

question_79411.question: What happens when a dual-radio UE loses coverage of a PLMN NG-RAN?
question_79411.ground_truth: When PLMN NG-RAN coverage is lost, the UE can initiate PDU session mobility for PLMN PDU session(s) from NG-RAN to N3IWF access. The process includes losing access, registering to PLMN 5GC via N3IWF access (if not already done), and performing UE-initiated PDU session mobility for PLMN PDU session(s) to N3IWF access in PLMN 5GC.

question_79412.question: In what circumstances will the UE consider the access attempt as barred during the initiation of the procedure?
question_79412.ground_truth: If timer T390 is running for the Access Category or if timer T302 is running and the Access Category is neither '2' nor '0', the UE will consider the access attempt as barred.

question_79414.question: What happens when a new TCP connection is opened, and the old one is closed, in terms of the Flow Description used for application/flow identification?
question_79414.ground_truth: When a new TCP connection is opened, and the old one is closed, the 5GMSd AF needs to invoke the NEF/PCF-related APIs with new flow description to update the PDRs in the UPF to follow the changed transport layer 5-tuples for application/flow identification.

question_79415.question: What is the maximum Bit Error Rate (BER) allowable for any UTRA FDD or TDD carrier for the reference measurement channel as defined in 3GPP TS 25.104 and 3GPP TS 25.105 respectively?
question_79415.ground_truth: The BER shall not exceed 0.001 for the reference measurement channel defined in 3GPP TS 25.104 and 3GPP TS 25.105 for UTRA FDD and TDD carriers, respectively.

question_79417.question: Which charging information is sent in Step 3ch-b during PDU session establishment in a Home-routed roaming scenario?
question_79417.ground_truth: RAT Type, Small Data Rate Control Status, and Control Plane CIoT 5GS Optimisation are sent in Step 3ch-b during PDU session establishment in a Home-routed roaming scenario.

question_79419.question: Which training sequence is selected if the serving cell supports four or less coverage classes and both CC2 and CC3 are not present?
question_79419.ground_truth: If the serving cell supports four or less coverage classes and both CC2 and CC3 are not present, TS~6 is selected as the training sequence.

question_79420.question: What is the recommended way to signal segment unavailability between the client and server in DASH?
question_79420.ground_truth: Regular 404s and the Date-Header specifying the time of the server are recommended to indicate segment unavailability in DASH.

question_79421.question: What are the two operation modes for V2X communication defined in the document?
question_79421.ground_truth: The two operation modes for V2X communication defined in the document are over the PC5 and over LTE-Uu.

question_79422.question: In which situations must the IMS nodes require the network to provide the NPLI of the UE?
question_79422.ground_truth: The IMS nodes may require the network to provide the NPLI of the UE upon session establishment, session release, session modification, and SIP MESSAGE for SMS.

question_79423.question: What are the abbreviations used in the document related to the GSM Cordless Telephony System?
question_79423.ground_truth: AFA, CTS, CTSAGCH, CTSARCH, CTSBCH, CTS-FP, CTS-MS, CTSMSI, CTSPCH, DPLMN, FPBI, GFL, RX, TFH, and TX are the abbreviations used in the document related to the GSM Cordless Telephony System.

question_79425.question: What is the value of Tsearch in the calculation of Tinterrupt if the target cell is known?
question_79425.ground_truth: If the target cell is known, Tsearch = 0 ms.

question_79426.question: What are the conformance requirements for UE when responding to a 423 (Interval Too Brief) response?
question_79426.ground_truth: The UE is required to send another REGISTER request with an expiration timer of at least the value received in the Min-Expires header of the 423 (Interval Too Brief) response.

question_79427.question: What should a GTP entity do if it detects an information element with invalid length in a Request message?
question_79427.ground_truth: If the invalid length IE is not the last one in the message, the receiving GTP entity may not be able to detect which IEs have invalid length. An error response should be sent with Cause IE value set to "Invalid length" if the invalid IE is the last one in the message or the Length value is greater than the overall length of the message.

question_79428.question: What should a DASH client do if it observes issues, such as 404 responses, when requesting segments in a live stream?
question_79428.ground_truth: The DASH client should back up slightly in its requests to avoid being too aggressive and risking further 404 responses.

question_79430.question: Which long-term solution is recommended for addressing the risk of numbering and dialling plans running out of numbers due to MTC service deployment?
question_79430.ground_truth: The recommended long-term solution is IPv6 addressing with corresponding identifiers, such as SIP-addresses, URIs/URLs, in combination with MTC solutions in core and radio networks.

question_79431.question: What is the purpose of a break-in service for a specific NGCN site in business trunking applications?
question_79431.ground_truth: A break-in service converts incoming public network traffic to private network traffic if the conditions agreed between the enterprise and the NGN operator indicate this.

question_79432.question: What is the handover function used by the MGW before and after relocation on UMTS to UMTS?
question_79432.ground_truth: The interworking function used by the MGW before relocation will also be used after relocation in UMTS to UMTS handover.

question_79434.question: What is the default criticality level of the IDs in the XWAP-PROTOCOL-IES group?
question_79434.ground_truth: The default criticality level of the IDs in the XWAP-PROTOCOL-IES group is ignore.

question_79437.question: What is one of the main advantages of using eMBB and URLLC for prehospital care in an ambulance?
question_79437.ground_truth: It enables effective tele-guidance of an ambulance nurse by a remote expert, improving diagnosis, treatment, and compliance in a medical emergency, and allows for accurate ultrasound examination by ambulance nurses similar to that of physicians.

question_79438.question: What should the SMF do if it receives an "exemptionInd attribute indicating 'message was exempted from the S-NSSAI and DNN based congestion activated in the AMF'" but the UE-requested PDU session modification procedure is not exempt from S-NSSAI only based congestion control?
question_79438.ground_truth: The SMF shall set the 5GSM cause #67 "insufficient resources for specific slice and DNN" in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message.

question_79439.question: What is a potential simplification for reducing the number of simultaneous discrete interferers in SAIC terminal assessment?
question_79439.ground_truth: One potential simplification is reducing the required number of simultaneous discrete interferers by restricting performance assessment to be on the basis of co-channel or adjacent channel performance. Alternatively, a single co- or adjacent channel interferer could be combined with residual interferers to model more complex scenarios.

question_79441.question: What are the main factors influencing the design aspects that impact the in-channel selectivity?
question_79441.ground_truth: Design aspects that impact the in-channel selectivity include linearity, ADC range, phase noise, frequency error, power level, and signal processing inside the receiver.

question_79443.question: What action should the controlling MCVideo function take if it receives a SIP re-INVITE request containing an unauthorized request for an MCVideo emergency call as determined by subclause~6.3.3.1.13.2?
question_79443.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should reject the SIP re-INVITE request with a SIP 403 (Forbidden) response as specified in subclause~6.3.3.1.14.

question_79444.question: What is the data type of the "tadata" element?
question_79444.ground_truth: The data type of the "tadata" element is xs:boolean.

question_79445.question: What information about cells and eNBs does the X2-Proxy manage in the X2 setup response message?
question_79445.ground_truth: The X2-Proxy includes the HeNBs (cells) that have an X2 interface with the X2-Proxy as served cells the X2 Setup Response message.

question_79446.question: Which nodes are impacted by the new changes in the EPS?
question_79446.ground_truth: eNB, MME, SGW, and PGW are impacted by the new changes in the EPS. For instance, eNB includes a bearer RAT type information being used per S1-U bearer basis while sending the E-RAB Modification Indication message to the MME. The MME extracts the bearer RAT type information per bearer and put them into the modify bearer request message, and so on.

question_79447.question: What message should the UE include in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message to request an always-on PDU session when switching from S1 mode to N1 mode?
question_79447.ground_truth: The Always-on PDU session requested IE with the value of "Always-on PDU session requested" should be included in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message.

question_79449.question: What is the periodicity of SS block transmission that a UE may assume by default for initial cell selection?
question_79449.ground_truth: The UE may assume a default SS burst set periodicity which is frequency band-dependent for initial cell selection.

question_79450.question: What should the IBCF do to the codecs added to the original SDP offer before forwarding the SDP answer to the offerer?
question_79450.ground_truth: The IBCF shall remove them from the SDP.

question_79452.question: What update is needed for the MBMS bearer announcement procedure to accommodate a user roaming in a visited PLMN?
question_79452.ground_truth: The MBMS bearer announcement procedure should be updated to consider the inclusion of an alternative TMGI list in the service announcement procedure. This is specifically needed when the user roams in a visited PLMN and receives media from MBMS bearers. Additionally, the MC service server needs to utilize the PLMN ID to uniquely identify the correct MBMS SAI when considering location reporting for MBMS roaming scenarios.

question_79453.question: What are the priority simulation scenarios for high priority co-existence scenarios?
question_79453.ground_truth: The priority simulation scenarios for high priority co-existence scenarios are: 5MHz E-UTRA-UTRA (victim), downlink; 10MHz E-UTRA-10MHz E-UTRA (victim), downlink; 10MHz E-UTRA-10MHz E-UTRA (victim), uplink; 5MHz E-UTRA-UTRA (victim), uplink; 1.6MHz E-UTRA-UTRA 1.6MHz (victim), downlink; 1.6MHz E-UTRA-UTRA 1.6MHz (victim), uplink.

question_79454.question: What are the guidelines for formatting OpenAPI specification files?
question_79454.ground_truth: The guidelines include using two white spaces for indentation, adding comments using the standard YAML syntax, and avoiding the use of tabs, "unbreakable" spaces, and trailing spaces.

question_79456.question: What is the purpose of quota management in converged charging?
question_79456.ground_truth: Quota management is a feature of converged charging used to manage and report on the amount of data consumed by a user.

question_79457.question: What is the test applicability for the E-UTRAN FDD UE ProSe Direct Discovery Transmission Timing Accuracy Test?
question_79457.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE FFS.

question_79458.question: What is the role of private slice in this 3GPP system scenario?
question_79458.ground_truth: Private slice is a network slice deployment dedicated for the sole use by a specific third-party, operated in a combined manner with the PLMN. The 5G network provides APIs for the third-party to get the network status information of a private slice.

question_79460.question: What action should the UE take if it receives a request from the upper layers to perform emergency services fallback or establish an emergency PDU session, and there are no user-plane resources established for PDU sessions?
question_79460.ground_truth: The UE should locally release the N1 NAS signalling connection and initiate the registration procedure as specified in subclause 5.5.1.3 or 5.6.1.5.

question_79461.question: What should MSC-A do if the UE fails the CSG membership check and the target cell is a CSG cell?
question_79461.ground_truth: MSC-A shall send an A-HANDOVER-REQUIRED-REJECT to BSS-A.

question_79463.question: What is the primary feature of the indirect far field (IFF) method 1 for UE RF characteristics?
question_79463.ground_truth: The primary feature of the indirect far field (IFF) method 1 is that it creates a far field environment using a transformation with a parabolic reflector.

question_79464.question: What is the main issue addressed in Solution #11?
question_79464.ground_truth: Solution #11 addresses Key Issue #4 (PDU Set integrated packet handling) and Key Issue #5 (Differentiated PDU Set Handling) in providing a solution to handle data dependency and importance in XRM service packet transmission.

question_79465.question: Which bands, other than Bands 5 and 30, can be affected by the 2nd and 3rd harmonics and IMD products caused by the BS transmitting in Bands 5 and 30?

question_79468.question: What is the next action to be performed when memory reserved for logged measurement information becomes full?
question_79468.ground_truth: Stop timer T330 and perform the same actions as performed upon expiry of T330.

question_79470.question: What is the name of the complexType "PolygonAreaType" that contains a sequence of elements, including "Corner", "anyExt", and an "any" element with processContents set to "lax"?
question_79470.ground_truth: The name of the complexType is "PolygonAreaType".

question_79471.question: What is the maximum duration of the test for verifying the MS's capability to correctly decode a two-message assignment and switch to the assigned PDCH?

question_79472.question: What is the role of the N14 interface in AMF re-allocation and AMF-to-AMF information transfer?
question_79472.ground_truth: The N14 interface is used for AMF re-allocation and AMF-to-AMF information transfer, and it can be either intra-PLMN or inter-PLMN.

question_79474.question: Which two solutions for Key Issue 4 (Solution 17) are most beneficial depending on the scenario for reusing multicast/broadcast architecture?
question_79474.ground_truth: Solution 17 - Option 1 and Solution 17 - Option 3 are the most beneficial solutions for Key Issue 4.

question_79475.question: What is one of the traffic duplication criteria that can be applied to the traffic on the primary access for GBR networks in the 3GPP system?
question_79475.ground_truth: Link quality, which can be based onPacket Loss Rate (PLR) or Round Trip Time (RTT) thresholds.

question_79476.question: What is the policy based on which the UDM may trigger a primary authentication when supporting Home triggered authentication in 6.15.2.2?
question_79476.ground_truth: The UDM may trigger a primary authentication based on its local policy to refresh the UPU counter based on the value of counter received in step 3.

question_79477.question: What should the UE do if it detects consistent LBT failures up to T310 expiry in PCell, random access problem indication from SCG MAC, or indication from SCG RLC that the maximum number of retransmissions has been reached?
question_79477.ground_truth: The UE should initiate the SCG failure information procedure as specified in 5.7.3 to report SCG radio link failure.

question_79480.question: What is the term used to describe the interfaces in the GNP model that are not defined by 3GPP?
question_79480.ground_truth: Service interfaces that are not defined by 3GPP

question_79481.question: What is the maximum measurement period for intra frequency Timeslot ISCP measurements on arbitrary DL timeslots?
question_79481.ground_truth: The maximum measurement period for intra frequency Timeslot ISCP measurements on arbitrary DL timeslots is 400 ms.

question_79482.question: What happens if the ECS-ER is not available and EES information is not available corresponding to the Application Group ID?
question_79482.ground_truth: The ECS identifies EES(s) based on the information contained in the request.

question_79483.question: What should a UE do if it fails to perform a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message with request type set to "handover" due to abnormal case a) in clause~5.5.1.2.6 and if the UE intends to transfer an emergency PDU session?
question_79483.ground_truth: The UE should attempt EPS attach for emergency bearer services including a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message with request type set to "handover of emergency bearer services" for the emergency PDU session.

question_79484.question: What is the subject of the 3GPP Technical Specification TS 32.401?
question_79484.ground_truth: The concept and requirements of Performance Management (PM) in telecommunications.

question_79485.question: What parameters are used in the entering and leaving conditions for event A5?
question_79485.ground_truth: The entering condition for event A5 is satisfied when both condition A5-1 and condition A5-2 are fulfilled, and the leaving condition for event A5 is satisfied when condition A5-3 or condition A5-4 is met. The parameters used in these conditions include the measurement result of the NR SpCell (Mp), the measurement result of the neighboring cell/SCell (Mn), the measurement object specific offset of the neighbor/SCell cell (Ofn), the cell specific offset of the neighbor cell/SCell (Ocn), the hysteresis parameter for this event (Hys), and the threshold parameters for this event (Thresh1 and Thresh2).

question_79486.question: What is the purpose of mapping a slice coverage area to a geographical coverage area?
question_79486.ground_truth: The purpose is to map the desired geographical coverage area with the available radio coverage, which depends on the base station planning and deployment.

question_79487.question: What was the largest degradation in UPT (User Packet Transfer) shown in one source when implementing a category 2 LBT scheme in an unspecified system?
question_79487.ground_truth: The largest degradation in UPT was less than 7%.

question_79489.question: What is the purpose of the 3GPP PS Data Off feature in the context of updating PDP context?
question_79489.ground_truth: The 3GPP PS Data Off feature allows the GGSN to indicate its support for the 3GPP PS Data Off UE Status in the Update PDP Context Response PCO.

question_79490.question: What network aspects of IMS-based telepresence were addressed by the CT groups (CT1, CT3, CT4) in 3GPP services?
question_79490.ground_truth: The CT groups addressed the core network aspects of IMS-based telepresence, including the incorporation of new tools for controlling and negotiating multiple spatially related media streams in an IMS conference supporting telepresence.

question_79491.question: What does the "Mute for notification" parameter control in a PCC rule?
question_79491.ground_truth: The "Mute for notification" parameter defines whether the SMF (Session Management Function) sends start/stop notifications to the PCF (Policy Control Function) for an application. If absent, notifications are sent.

question_79492.question: What is the purpose of the ForServiceBased node in the ISRP data distribution rules?
question_79492.ground_truth: The ForServiceBased node in the ISRP data distribution rules is a flow distribution container that indicates data distribution among accesses based on APN.

question_79494.question: What is the initial value of the RRC SN and the RLC SN during radio connection establishment?
question_79494.ground_truth: The RRC SN and the RLC SN are both initialized to 0 during radio connection establishment.

question_79495.question: What is the service concept of Personal Broadcast Service (PBS)?
question_79495.ground_truth: PBS is a content distribution service using 3GPP accesses that allows any internet user, private company, or mobile user to generate content and broadcast/multicast it to mobile users using a versatile packet data network.

question_79496.question: What does the XR Runtime provide to support the application in rendering different views in the tethered display AR Glasses context?
question_79496.ground_truth: The XR Runtime provides access to the viewer pose and projection parameters that are needed to render the different views, for a particular display time within a specified XR space.

question_79498.question: When is ISR deactivated for a CSoPS enabled UE?
question_79498.ground_truth: ISR is deactivated for a CSoPS enabled UE when it performs a combined RAU/LAU, such as when its periodic RAU timer expires, or it moves to an unregistered RA or system operating in NMO II or III.

question_79499.question: What functions does the DetNet AF support in relation to DetNet network?
question_79499.ground_truth: The DetNet AF supports mapping DetNet flow related parameters to 5GS QoS requirements and TSC requirements, sending the parameters to TSCTSF, and responding to the DetNet controller.

question_79500.question: What kind of requirement does the term "shall" indicate in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_79500.ground_truth: The term "shall" in the 3GPP Technical Specification indicates a mandatory requirement to do something.

question_79502.question: Under what circumstances is the PTC List Management Events Report Record triggered while changing contact lists, PTC Group lists, or when notified of changes to PTC-specific documents stored in the network?
question_79502.ground_truth: The PTC List Management Events Report Record is triggered when attempting changes to contact lists or PTC Group lists, when the network notifies the PTC Target's PTC Client of changes made to contact lists or PTC Group lists, or when the PTC Target is a member of a PTC Group, and the network notifies of changes made to that PTC Group list. The report is triggered for both successful and unsuccessful events.

question_79504.question: What information is included in the Charging Data Request message from the SCEF as used for Exposure Function API offline charging?
question_79504.ground_truth: The Charging Data Request from the SCEF for offline charging includes all charging information related to the API invoke request.

question_79505.question: What is the difference between Group regrouping and User regrouping in an MCX Service?
question_79505.ground_truth: Group regrouping in an MCX Service is the dynamic combining of a multiplicity of groups into a new, temporary group, controlled by a dispatcher or any authorized user. User regrouping, on the other hand, is the mechanism for combining MCX Users into a new MCX Service Group under the control of a dispatcher or authorized user to support ad-hoc communication needs. User regrouping is useful in situations where there is an urgent need for a dedicated set of individual MCX Users to communicate in an MCX Service Group.

question_79506.question: What determines the test tolerance for the test requirements in 5.4.2C?
question_79506.ground_truth: The test tolerance for the test requirements in 5.4.2C is non-zero if the test requirement differs from the Minimum Requirement and is defined in clause~F.2.

question_79507.question: What is the natural way of conveying information related to session and/or media bandwidths between clients and network nodes?
question_79507.ground_truth: SDP (Session Description Protocol) is the natural way of conveying information related to session and/or media bandwidths between clients and network nodes.

question_79508.question: What action does the UE take when the REGISTRATION REJECT message is not integrity protected and the UE is not operating in SNPN access operation mode, and the Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming" IE is not included in the REGISTRATION REJECT message?
question_79508.ground_truth: The UE shall store the current TAI in the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming" and enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE.

question_79509.question: Which network technologies does the MCData system provide interworking support for, regarding LMR systems?
question_79509.ground_truth: The MCData system provides interworking support with LMR systems defined in 3GPP TS 23.283, which can include both 4G and 5GS networks.

question_79510.question: What triggers the switch to the default BWP when the activity timer expires in 5G NR?
question_79510.ground_truth: The switch to the default BWP takes place when the activity timer expires, which is restarted upon successful PDCCH decoding.

question_79512.question: What was the total number of listening tests performed in the selection phase?
question_79512.ground_truth: A total of 48 listening tests were performed in the selection phase.
