question_79849.question: What is the difference between the solution of compressing just the outer headers, excluding GTP and the solution of stripping the outer headers, excluding GTP?
question_79849.ground_truth: The solution of compressing just the outer headers, excluding GTP, uses the existing ROHC IP/UDP profile to compress the outer two headers, and the inner headers will stay as they are without compression. The solution of stripping the outer headers, excluding GTP, transmits essential information in the headers out of band and strips the headers at the sender and recreates them at the receiver. This results in a 13-byte header in the latter solution.

question_79850.question: What is the role of a Policy MnS producer in the service-based architecture of 5G networks?
question_79850.ground_truth: A Policy MnS producer is responsible for storing defined network policies, detecting policy conflicts, making policy execution decisions, and evaluating the effectiveness of network policy execution.

question_79852.question: What are the two procedures outlined in clause 6.23.2 of the 5G LAN group communication proposal?
question_79852.ground_truth: The two procedures outlined in clause 6.23.2 are the Registration Procedure and the PDU Session Establishment Procedure.

question_79853.question: What is the purpose of the test described in section 16.1.1.6.4?
question_79853.ground_truth: The purpose of the test described in section 16.1.1.6.4 is to verify the requirement for stationary idle mode relaxed measurement criteria for NR RedCap UE with 2Rx, supporting Rel.17, in a situation where there are two cells with different tracking areas, and the UE has not registered with the network for the tracking area containing one of the cells.

question_79855.question: What mechanisms are supported for RA-SDT (RAchiev-SDT) and when is it supported without UE context relocation?
question_79855.ground_truth: RA-SDT is supported with and without UE context relocation. It is supported without context relocation when the UE accesses the same gNB it last connected to, otherwise, it is supported with context relocation.

question_79856.question: How does solution #57 propose to control the granularity of location information in federated learning?
question_79856.ground_truth: Solution #57 proposes to control the granularity through preferred location granularity and preferred LCS QoS analytics in the request.

question_79857.question: What can message prioritization be based on when performing message throttling?
question_79857.ground_truth: Message prioritization can be based on the nature of the overload condition and application-dependent message priority.

question_79859.question: What are the measurements related to the BGCF procedures for forwarding sessions?
question_79859.ground_truth: The measurements include Attempted sessions at BGCF, Attempted sessions forwarded to MGCF, Attempted sessions forwarded to IBCF, and Successful sessions forwarded to MGCF.

question_79860.question: What is the objective of the service flow in the use case of inbound logistics for manufacturing?
question_79860.ground_truth: The objective is for the pallet to connect to the local type-b network to track its arrival and integrate with the stock control systems of the factory.

question_79862.question: What is the purpose of CN Tunnel Info and how is it allocated and released in the UPF?
question_79862.ground_truth: CN Tunnel Info comprises the TEID and the IP address which is used by the UPF on the N3/N9 tunnel for the PDU Session. The UPF manages the CN Tunnel Info space. When a new CN Tunnel Info is needed, the SMF shall request the UPF to allocate CN Tunnel Info for the applicable N3/N9 reference point. In response, the UPF provides CN Tunnel Info to the SMF. In the case of PDU Session Release or a UPF is removed from the user plane path of an existing PDU Session, the SMF shall request UPF to release CN Tunnel Info for the PDU Session.

question_79864.question: What is the effect of sending a PACKET MEASUREMENT ORDER in the MS measurement reporting process?
question_79864.ground_truth: When the network sends a PACKET MEASUREMENT ORDER to a particular MS, it overrides the broadcast parameters on PBCCH, and the individual parameters sent are valid until the RESET command is sent to the MS, there is a downlink signalling failure, or the MS goes to the Standby state.

question_79866.question: What is the function of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in the field of mobile telecommunications?
question_79866.ground_truth: The 3GPP is a collaboration between groups of telecommunications associations which aims to define globally applicable technical specifications for mobile networks through a series of releases.

question_79869.question: Which direction do messages flow in the context of gNB-CU and gNB-DU, if the gNB-CU sends a message to the gNB-DU?
question_79869.ground_truth: The direction would be gNB-CU -> gNB-DU.

question_79870.question: What is the requirement for a UE to consider a GSM cell as "verified" in terms of decoding the SCH and identifying the BSIC?
question_79870.ground_truth: A UE considers a GSM cell as "verified" if it has decoded the SCH of the BCCH carrier and identified the BSIC at least once, and continues to re-confirm the BSIC at least once every 30 seconds.

question_79872.question: What error handling mechanism is supported for the MBSGroupMsgDelivery API?
question_79872.ground_truth: HTTP error responses, protocol errors, and application errors specified in clause 5.2.6 of 3GPP TS 29.122 are supported for the MBSGroupMsgDelivery API.

question_79873.question: What should the mobile station do if access is denied in the new cell during a cell reselection procedure?
question_79873.ground_truth: If access is denied in the new cell, the mobile station determines that the network controlled cell reselection procedure has failed and sends a PACKET CELL CHANGE FAILURE message with the appropriate cause value to the network in the old cell.

question_79875.question: What attribute does the network set in the schemaVersion element?
question_79875.ground_truth: The schema version attribute is set to 2 by the network in the schemaVersion element.

question_79876.question: What systems require policy and charging control consideration when non-3GPP inter-access system mobility is considered?
question_79876.ground_truth: The home operator and the controlled service, which may cross operator and access system boundaries, require policy and charging control consideration.

question_79877.question: What is the minimum cell re-selection delay required for the UE in this test scenario?
question_79877.ground_truth: The minimum cell re-selection delay required for the UE is less than 8 seconds with a DRX cycle length of 1.28 seconds.

question_79878.question: Which reference point is used for transferring (QoS) policy information between PCRF and Serving Gateway?
question_79878.ground_truth: The Gxc-interface is used for transferring (QoS) policy information from PCRF to the Serving Gateway, Gxc is used only in the case of PMIP-based S5/S8.

question_79879.question: In what scenarios can multiple Binding Indications be included in a single service request?
question_79879.ground_truth: Multiple Binding Indications can be included in a single service request to provide bindings for different event notifications, or to provide bindings for notification or callback as well as for other services that the NF service consumer can provide later as a NF Service Producer.

question_79881.question: What scheduling restrictions apply to an user equipment (UE) performing SS-RSRP measurements on an FR2 inter-frequency cell?
question_79881.ground_truth: The UE is not expected to transmit or receive any data signals, such as PUCCH/PUSCH/SRS/PDCCH/PDSCH/TRS/CSI-RS for CQI, during SSB symbols and their surrounding data symbols to be measured within a specified measurement window duration.

question_79882.question: What is the purpose of overload information in GTP-c nodes?
question_79882.ground_truth: Overload information is used to reduce/throttle the amount of GTP-c signalling traffic between nodes and provide guidance to the receiving node to decide appropriate mitigation measures when a node is operating over its nominal capacity.

question_79883.question: What is the purpose of the OMC ID in the warning message delivery procedure?
question_79883.ground_truth: The OMC ID is used to indicate the Operational Maintenance Center to which the trace record generated in step 8 is destined. It allows the O&M system to deliver the records to the desired destination.

question_79884.question: What is the impact on compressed mode patterns with the introduction of time-dilated UMTS?
question_79884.ground_truth: With time-dilated UMTS, there is no need for compressed mode patterns with more than one transmission gap per radio frame.

question_79885.question: What are the types of Radio Network Temporary Identities (RNTIs) in 3GPP specifications, and what are their uses?
question_79885.ground_truth: The four types of RNTIs in 3GPP specifications are Serving BSS/RNC RNTI (S-RNTI), Drift BSS/RNC RNTI (D-RNTI), Cell RNTI (C-RNTI), and UTRAN RNTI (U-RNTI) or GERAN RNTI (G-RNTI). The S-RNTI is used to identify a mobile to the serving BSS/RNC, the D-RNTI is used to identify a mobile to the drift BSS/RNC, the C-RNTI is used to identify a mobile in UTRAN when using the Iur-g interface between UTRAN and GERAN, and the G-RNTI/U-RNTI is allocated to a mobile having an RRC connection to identify it within GERAN/UTRAN.

question_79888.question: When should the UE set the MH6-PDU bit to "Multi-homed IPv6 PDU session supported" in the 5GSM capability IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message?
question_79888.ground_truth: The UE shall set the MH6-PDU bit to "Multi-homed IPv6 PDU session supported" in the 5GSM capability IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message if it supports multi-homed IPv6 PDU session and requests to establish a new PDU session of "IPv6" or "IPv4v6" PDU session type or it requests to transfer an existing PDN connection of "IPv6" or "IPv4v6" PDN type in the EPS or in an untrusted non-3GPP access connected to the EPC to the 5GS.

question_79890.question: What is the purpose of the "requestIdentifier" field in the response message of the "sendSms" operation?
question_79890.ground_truth: The "requestIdentifier" field in the response message of the "sendSms" operation is used by the application to invoke the "getSmsDeliveryStatus" operation to poll for the delivery status.

question_79891.question: What is the result of UE-1 turning off cDRX in terms of end-to-end delay and jitter?
question_79891.ground_truth: Turning off cDRX at UE-1 helps to reduce end-to-end delay and jitter.

question_79892.question: What is the purpose of the test for the successful case of dedicated assignment with starting time in the 3GPP protocol?
question_79892.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that the MS, after receiving an ASSIGNMENT COMMAND message with a starting time and channel descriptions for both before and after the starting time, performs the assignment correctly using the description for before the time, and eventually starts using the frequency parameters for after the time at the time indicated in the message.

question_79893.question: What logical states are applicable for the CCBS service in the originating network?
question_79893.ground_truth: (Not Provisioned, Not Applicable, Not Active, Not Induced) and (Provisioned, Not Applicable, Active and Operative, Not Induced)

question_79894.question: What is the impact of receiving a LOAD INDICATION message without the "Resource situation information element"?
question_79894.ground_truth: If the BSS receives a LOAD INDICATION message without the "Resource situation information element", it means that the indicated cell is not able to perform incoming handover requests and the receiving BSS may stop the whole handover traffic to this cell.

question_79895.question: What is the RLM/BFD requirement for DRX < 80ms for FR2 HST scenarios being studied by RAN4?
question_79895.ground_truth: RAN4 is studying the RLM/BFD requirements for DRX < 80ms for FR2 HST scenarios using two options: following RX beam factor for set-1 and set-2 or using the existing RLM/BFD requirements for DRX < 80ms.

question_79896.question: What is a potential threat related to the use of multiple security domains for media security?
question_79896.ground_truth: An external security domain may pretend to have a user on the domain that does not use the domain, allowing for impersonation and man-in-the-middle (MitM) attacks.

question_79897.question: How is MC service supported over 5G ProSe?
question_79897.ground_truth: The solution proposes to reuse the application layer procedures over 5G ProSe with proper changes to support MC service over 5G ProSe. The application layer identities, procedures, and information flows used in TS 23.280, TS 23.379, TS 23.281, and TS 23.282 are reused with differences in use of identifiers and procedures.

question_79899.question: What is the recommended procedure to ensure secure communications between two users, A and B, in different KMS domains?
question_79899.ground_truth: User A requests a ticket for user B from its home KMS, then sends the ticket to user B, who presents the ticket to his home KMS, the KMS B, which sends the keys and information to KMS A in a protected way, and finally KMS B sends the keys and information to user B in a protected way.

question_79901.question: Which Bands are the focus for the impact of harmonics and IMD on the BS receive band for Bands 7 and 26?
question_79901.ground_truth: Bands 5, 8, and 28 are the focus for the impact of harmonics and IMD on the BS receive band for Bands 7 and 26.

question_79902.question: When an LTM cell switch procedure is triggered, what should the UE follow for timers T310, T311 and constants N310, N311?
question_79902.ground_truth: The UE should use the default values specified in 9.2.3 for timers T310, T311 and constants N310, N311 associated with the cell group for which the LTM cell switch procedure is triggered.

question_79904.question: What is the maximum duration of test and maximum time for operator actions for the emergency call establishment test?
question_79904.ground_truth: The maximum duration of test is 3 minutes and the maximum time for operator actions is 30 seconds.

question_79906.question: How does the AMF determine the proper SMF for handling a PDU session with multiple sub-groups?
question_79906.ground_truth: The AMF selects the SMF per DNN/S-NSSAI. If multiple SMFs are needed, it sends the PDU session request to the SMF with the highest priority (predefined by operator, AF, or UE). The SMF then selects the other SMFs for each sub-group. SMF1 and SMF2 communicate with each other to establish the PDU session, exchanging necessary control information for forwarding rules.

question_79907.question: What is the key used to generate PEK and PIK in the 3GPP Sidelink Positioning system?

question_79908.question: What is the minimum downlink bit rate on DPCH in release 6?

question_79909.question: What is the issue when sending application server doesn't use Tsp interface or other SMS interface?
question_79909.ground_truth: The issue is that, if the sending application server doesn't use Tsp interface or other SMS interface, device triggers cannot be sent and network initiated communication with devices may not be possible, especially if the active time is short and the power saving intervals are long.

question_79910.question: In downlink resource allocation of type 1, when is the resource indication value (RIV) equal to 0?
question_79910.ground_truth: The RIV is equal to 0 when the starting virtual resource block is 0 and the length in terms of contiguously allocated resource blocks is 0.

question_79911.question: What is the aim of the Richardson maturity model for REST APIs?
question_79911.ground_truth: The aim of the Richardson maturity model for REST APIs is to define the compliance levels for HTTP-based REST APIs, with the goal of achieving Level 3 which allows for the use of hypermedia.

question_79912.question: What information must the PDN GW include in the Delete Bearer Request message if the Delete Bearer Request message is caused by a handover from 3GPP to non-3GPP?
question_79912.ground_truth: The PDN GW includes 'Cause' IE in the Delete Bearer Request message and sets the IE to 'RAT changed from 3GPP to Non-3GPP'.

question_79914.question: What is one of the functions provided by the MRFP in relation to media processing?
question_79914.ground_truth: Media stream processing, such as audio transcoding and media analysis.

question_79915.question: What action should the MCVideo client take if an initial SIP INVITE request contains an application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body with the <mcvideoinfo> element containing the <mcvideo-Params> element with the <emergency-ind> element set to a value of "true"?
question_79915.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should display to the user an indication that this is a SIP INVITE request for an MCVideo emergency group call, and set the MCVideo emergency group state to "MVEG 2: in-progress".

question_79916.question: What should the UE do when it receives a paging message with access type set to non-3GPP access while in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode over non-3GPP access?
question_79916.ground_truth: The UE shall not respond to the paging message.

question_79917.question: What does the ID field represent in the BFD-RS set of the Serving Cell?
question_79917.ground_truth: The ID field in the BFD-RS set of the Serving Cell indicates the identity of the BFD-RS set. It is set to 0 for BFD-RS set one and set to 1 for BFD-RS set two.

question_79918.question: What action will the network take if inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode is initiated by the UE and the MME does not support N26 interface?
question_79918.ground_truth: The MME will send a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message with EMM cause value #9 to the UE.

question_79920.question: What must the mobile station do when it receives a PACKET POLLING REQUEST message?
question_79920.ground_truth: The mobile station must respond to the network with the PACKET CONTROL ACKNOWLEDGEMENT message in the block period specified by the RRBP field.

question_79921.question: What is the purpose of the Advice Of Charge (AOC) service provided in the communication?
question_79921.ground_truth: The AOC service provides charging information for both the original and the resulting CCNL communication.

question_79922.question: What is the requirement for the correct events observed during repeated tests, as defined in clause 5.6.4.2.5 and clause 5.6.4.1.5?
question_79922.ground_truth: The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

question_79923.question: What is the difference between sliceAllowedCellListNR and sliceExcludedCellListNR?
question_79923.ground_truth: sliceAllowedCellListNR contains the list of cells that are allowed for the slices, while sliceExcludedCellListNR contains the list of cells that are excluded for the slices.

question_79924.question: What message is used by the UE to initiate a Mobile Originated Location Request in 3GPP TS 24.080 clause 5.2.2.1?
question_79924.ground_truth: The UE invokes a MO-LR by sending a REGISTER message to the network containing a LCS-MOLR invoke component in order to initiate a Mobile Originated Location Request in 3GPP TS 24.080 clause 5.2.2.1.

question_79925.question: What is the process for determining the initial DL power for each timeslot within a DSCH type CCTrCH in a 1.28 Mcps TDD system?
question_79925.ground_truth: If both the CCTrCH Initial DL Transmission Power IE and the DL Time Slot ISCP Info LCR IE are included in the RL Information IE, then the Node B shall use that power for the PDSCH. Otherwise, the initial DL Power is the Initial DL Transmission Power IE included in the RL Information IE and it shall reduce the DL TX power in those downlink timeslots of the radio link where the interference is low, and increase the DL TX power in those timeslots where the interference is high, while keeping the total downlink power in the radio link unchanged.

question_79926.question: What is the generalized performance of the AI/ML based CSI prediction for generalization Case 2 over various UE speeds?
question_79926.ground_truth: Certain combinations of UE speed may result in a generalized performance, while others may lead to performance degradations.

question_79927.question: What does the 'UDHI' bit in a Short Message Service Point to Point (SMS-PP) indicate?
question_79927.ground_truth: The 'UDHI' bit in an SMS-PP indicates that the data is binary (8-bit data) and invokes the User Data Header (UDH) functionality.

question_79928.question: What happens if multiple call gapping procedures are active with the same gap criteria?
question_79928.ground_truth: "Manually initiated" call gapping prevails over automatically initiated service request gapping.

question_79929.question: What is the maximum number of RLC data blocks that can be transmitted from the SS to the MS in the procedure for the downlink EGPRS TBF in Incremental Redundancy RLC mode?

question_79930.question: What does RH1's proxy do if it receives a request to set up a roaming relation with pSEPP and the cSEPP is not allowed to do so?
question_79930.ground_truth: RH1's proxy shall return an error message.

question_79932.question: What should the UE do when timer T319 expires and there is connection establishment failure information available?
question_79932.ground_truth: The UE appends the connection establishment failure information as a new entry in the VarConnEstFailReportList.

question_79933.question: In which step of the negotiation procedure for TLS 1.3 would the UE/EEC send A-KID or B-TID depending on the HPLMN support?
question_79933.ground_truth: In step 1 of the negotiation procedure for TLS 1.3, the UE/EEC sends A-KID or B-TID depending on the HPLMN support.

question_79934.question: What is the situation when the path loss criterion (C1) for the current serving cell falls below zero for a period of 5 seconds?
question_79934.ground_truth: This indicates that the path loss to the cell has become too high.

question_79935.question: What is the non-roaming architecture for 5G Core Network for Wireline 5G Access network referred to as in clause 4.1.7?

question_79937.question: What are the requirements regarding the access network type for SDES?
question_79937.ground_truth: SDES is access network independent and leverages the IMS security architecture. It works independently of any different authentication methods defined for IMS.

question_79939.question: How many stop and wait ARQ processes can the HS-HARQ mechanism utilize to transfer several data blocks across the air interface at a time?
question_79939.ground_truth: The HS-HARQ mechanism can utilize multiple stop and wait ARQ processes, with each process performing a simple stop and wait ARQ protocol to transfer several data blocks across the air interface at a time.

question_79940.question: What does the C field in the Dual Connectivity PHR MAC Control Element indicate?
question_79940.ground_truth: The C field in the Dual Connectivity PHR MAC Control Element indicates the presence of a PH field for the serving cell of any MAC entity, except the PCell.

question_79942.question: When does the time for detecting and measuring at least n cells (TMIB) start?
question_79942.ground_truth: TMIB is the time required for acquiring the MIB information of the target cell. TMIB = 0 if the SFN of at least one cell in OTDOA assistance data is known to the UE.

question_79944.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) Technical Specification Group's study on enhancements to Web Real Time Communication (WebRTC) access to IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS) - Stage 2 (Release 13)?
question_79944.ground_truth: The purpose is to support the requirements defined by SA1 as part of eWebRTCi (Enhancements to WEBRTC interoperability) without requiring changes to existing WebRTC enabled web browsers.

question_79945.question: What is the purpose of using combined procedures in the MM between PS and CS domain?
question_79945.ground_truth: The purpose of using combined procedures in the MM between PS and CS domain is to offer flexibility in the provision of MM and to avoid non-optimal usage of the radio resource.

question_79947.question: What is one pre-condition required for the Message Gateway to send a Non-MSGin5G UE registration request to the MSGin5G Server?
question_79947.ground_truth: A pre-condition required for the Message Gateway to send a Non-MSGin5G UE registration request to the MSGin5G Server is that a secured connection has been established between the Message Gateway and the MSGin5G Server.

question_79948.question: What is the additional requirement on the PCEF, as specified in the solution addressing requirement 3 for CT3?
question_79948.ground_truth: The PCEF must be able to separate charging records generated for CAT media and normal media based on the rating group (RG) or service ID (SID).

question_79949.question: What action does the ACF take when it detects a tariff change in Step 1 of the AoC-S delivery?
question_79949.ground_truth: The ACF queries the OCS for Tariff Information.

question_79952.question: Which protocol element is optional to be included in the "MeasurementRequest-IEs" sequence?
question_79952.ground_truth: The "ID id-SFNInitialisationTime" element is optional in the "MeasurementRequest-IEs" sequence.

question_79953.question: What is the purpose of the Generic Call Control Service Capability Feature (SCF) in the OSA specifications?
question_79953.ground_truth: The Generic Call Control SCF is part of the OSA specifications that define an architecture for application developers to make use of network functionality through an open standardized interface. The Generic Call Control SCF specifies the aspects of the interface related to call control.

question_79954.question: How many bits are used to represent the adaptive and fixed codebook gains in the AMR-WB codec?
question_79954.ground_truth: The adaptive and fixed codebook gains are vector quantified with 6 or 7 bits.

question_79956.question: What should the MBSF do when an NF service consumer requests the deletion of an existing MBS User Service?
question_79956.ground_truth: The MBSF should delete the targeted "Individual MBS User Service" resource and respond to the NF service consumer with an HTTP "204 No Content" status code. On failure, the MBSF should take proper error handling actions, as specified in clause~6.1.7, and respond to the NF service consumer with an appropriate error status code.

question_79959.question: What is required for a UE to fulfill the not-at-cell edge criterion?
question_79959.ground_truth: A UE fulfills the not-at-cell edge criterion if Srxlev > SnonIntraSearchP and Squal > SnonIntraSearchQ.

question_79962.question: During registration, what procedure does the PCF provide to instruct the AMF to interact with PCF when a network slice requires slice re-mapping?
question_79962.ground_truth: The PCF provides a PCR trigger of slice re-mapping required to instruct the AMF during registration (6.2.3.2).

question_79963.question: What is the role of the Application Function (AF) in the process of EAS relocation?
question_79963.ground_truth: The AF is responsible for providing the selected target DNAI, new EAS IP address to the SMF in the case of early notification. It also indicates the support of seamless edge application relocation and the need to buffer the uplink data in the local PSA.

question_79964.question: What is the maximum allowed EVM for the downlink of a Repeater?
question_79964.ground_truth: The Error Vector Magnitude for the downlink of a Repeater shall not exceed 9.25%.

question_79965.question: What should be the content of bits 5 to 8 of the last octet, if the calling party BCD number contains an odd number of digits?
question_79965.ground_truth: Bits 5 to 8 of the last octet should be filled with "1111" as the end mark.

question_79967.question: What does a receiving entity do with information elements with unsupported or reserved values in the Information-Element-Data?
question_79967.ground_truth: A receiving entity shall ignore any information element where the value of the Information-Element-Data is Reserved or not supported.

question_79968.question: What is the role of the MCPTT server in dynamic MBMS bearer establishment?
question_79968.ground_truth: The MCPTT server derives a new bearer specific MSCCK from the PFK and establishes the MBMS bearer(s) for the group communication session.

question_79969.question: What is the expected sequence for the SEND USSD test with center alignment?
question_79969.ground_truth: The expected sequence for the SEND USSD test with center alignment is Expected Sequence 4.2.

question_79970.question: What is the impact of ICI (inter-carrier interference) compensation with multi-tap filtering when compared to CPE-only compensation in a CP-OFDM communication system for MCS 22 evaluation of the same SCS, based on the existing Rel-15 NR PTRS structure?
question_79970.ground_truth: Performance gain of ICI compensation with additional complexity of multi-tap filtering compared to CPE-only compensation is observed for 120, 240 and 480 kHz SCS when there is sufficient number of PTRS in the frequency domain.

question_79972.question: What is the process for handling a NW-initiated IP flow mobility request that conflicts with the ISRP for IFOM rules?
question_79972.ground_truth: If the UE receives a NW-initiated IP flow mobility request that is in conflict with the ISRP for IFOM rules, it rejects the request and provides a cause indicating the policy conflict to the network. This ensures that the UE can enforce the active ISRP for IFOM rules as required.

question_79974.question: What is an example of a PCC rule for ATSSS control?
question_79974.ground_truth: An example of a PCC rule for ATSSS control is "SDF template: UDP, DestAddr 1.2.3.4", "Steering Mode: Active/Standby, Active=3GPP, Standby=non-3GPP". This rule means to steer UDP traffic with the destination IP address 1.2.3.4 to the active access (3GPP), if available. If the active access is not available, use the standby access (non-3GPP).

question_79975.question: What is the purpose of dynamic capacity negotiation between the Hosting RAN Operator and a Participating Operator?
question_79975.ground_truth: Dynamic capacity negotiation allows a Participating Operator to request on-demand spare capacity of the Shared GERAN or UTRAN based on policies and without human intervention, and for the Hosting RAN Operator to allocate and cancel such capacity as needed.

question_79976.question: What is the purpose of the requirements template in 3GPP Telecommunication management?
question_79976.ground_truth: The requirements template in 3GPP Telecommunication management contains the template to be used for the production of all IRP based requirements TSs. It is mainly based on the requirements template (Annex A) in the ITU-T M.3020 recommendation.

question_79977.question: When should the user equipment (UE) release the RLC entity for SRB0 in case the SI request is based on the RRCSystemInfoRequest message?
question_79977.ground_truth: The RLC entity for SRB0 should be released immediately after the reset MAC in case the SI request is based on the RRCSystemInfoRequest message.

question_79978.question: What is the purpose of checking MEASUREMENT REPORT messages until statistical significance is achieved?
question_79978.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure that the results of the measurements are reliable and accurate.

question_79979.question: What is the role of the Call Session Control Function (CSCF) in the IMS?
question_79979.ground_truth: The CSCF can act as Proxy CSCF (P-CSCF), Serving CSCF (S-CSCF), Emergency CSCF (E-CSCF), or Interrogating CSCF (I-CSCF), and handles various aspects of IMS connections such as session state management and emergency session handling.

question_79980.question: What functions may be used for high latency communication in mobile terminated (MT) communication?
question_79980.ground_truth: Functions for high latency communication may be used to handle MT communication with UEs being unreachable while using power saving functions or satellite access with discontinuous coverage. This feature includes invoking extended buffering of MT data at the Serving GW when the UE is in a power saving state and not reachable. Buffered data is delivered to the UE using NAS PDUs when the UE contacts the MME. Event notifications are sent to application servers that have requested UE Reachability or Availability after DDN failure monitoring events when a UE becomes reachable.

question_79981.question: What should the network and UE support for an emergency call to seamlessly transition from a 3GPP network to the WLAN network?
question_79981.ground_truth: The network and UE should support a means for emergency calls to change radio access type, and as seamlessly as possible move the calls from 3GPP network to the WLAN network.

question_79984.question: What is the impact of NBIFOM implementation on the 3GPP RAN?
question_79984.ground_truth: There is no impact to 3GPP RAN from the implementation of NBIFOM.

question_79985.question: What is the difference between "OTA requirements" and "conducted requirements" in the context of 3GPP Technical Specifications?
question_79985.ground_truth: "OTA requirements" refer to radiated requirements, while "conducted requirements" refer to conducted (i.e. wired) requirements.

question_79986.question: When should the SMF include one or more DNS server IPv4 address(es), one or more DNS server IPv6 address(es) or both in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message?
question_79986.ground_truth: The SMF should include one or more DNS server IPv4 address(es), one or more DNS server IPv6 address(es) or both in the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION COMMAND message if the SMF needs to provide DNS server address(es) to the UE and the UE has provided the DNS server IPv4 address request, the DNS server IPv6 address request or both in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message or a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message.

question_79988.question: What is the procedure for CAPIF interconnection supported by this subclause?
question_79988.ground_truth: The procedures in this subclause correspond to the architectural requirements on CAPIF interconnection by ensuring communication between CAPIF core functions.

question_79989.question: What is the SNR Difference true before and after a switch?
question_79989.ground_truth: The Rx Ec/No increases after a switch for the most part, due to the improvement in the channel.

question_79991.question: What message is used to communicate a BSS-internal Codec change to the rest of the network?

question_79994.question: What are the steps involved when a user homed in the IWF retrieves active functional alias(es) for a certain MC service user?
question_79994.ground_truth: The user homed in the IWF can request a list of active functional aliases for a certain MC service ID from the MC service server, which then checks if the querying user is authorized to perform the query. If authorized, the MC service server retrieves the requested functional alias information and sends an IWF functional alias information query response including the active functional alias or MC service ID information to the user homed in the IWF.

question_79995.question: What is the relationship between the port number for the PDU Session and the DS-TT port MAC address or IP address of the UE?
question_79995.ground_truth: The port number for the PDU Session is assigned by the UPF during PDU session establishment and reported to the SMF from the UPF. The SMF provides the port number to the TSN AF or TSCTSF, which maintains an association between the port number for the PDU Session and the DS-TT port MAC address or IP address of the UE.

question_79997.question: Which type of data does "INTEGER (1.. 4800)" represent in the "ulRtoa" within "UL-RTOAMeasurement" definition?
question_79997.ground_truth: It represents an integer value within the range of 1 to 4800.

question_79998.question: What is the prediction accuracy achieved by AI/ML for 63.2% prediction accuracy with 32 Tx beam and 8 Rx beam in Set A, and Set B is the same in each time instance for prediction time 80ms, using measurements from 4 time instances with a measurement periodicity of 80ms?

question_79999.question: What is the definition of "V2X service" in the present document?
question_79999.ground_truth: In the present document, "V2X service" is defined as a service or application that enables communication between vehicles and other entities, such as vehicles, pedestrians, infrastructure, and the network.

question_80002.question: What is the impact of different QoS requirements or S-NSSAIs received from participating 5GCs on resource establishment in RAN sharing?
question_80002.ground_truth: The gNB resolves different QoS requirements or S-NSSAIs received from the participating 5GCs in an implementation-specific way, which may affect the establishment of NG-U resources towards all or some of the involved 5GCs.

question_80003.question: In what scenarios can Per APN SIPTO@LN (Selected IP Traffic Offload in the local network) be used, and what does it imply for existing active PDN connections?
question_80003.ground_truth: Per APN SIPTO@LN can be used in various scenarios, including UE camping in idle mode or connected mode with active PDN connections. It can be applied when a UE requests a new PDN connection, makes a Service Request, or during handovers between H(e)NB cells and PDN connections. After handover, SIPTO@LN may be carried out to existing active PDN connections the UE has.

question_80004.question: What is the requirement for test 33.8.5?
question_80004.ground_truth: The requirement for test 33.8.5 is that the MS shall establish an emergency call.

question_80005.question: Which SIP method is used to indicate that a request has been received, understood, and being processed by a server (e.g., a user being added to a group call) but further actions are needed before the request can be fulfilled?

question_80006.question: When generating an I1 Invite message, what should the ICS UE do regarding the transport layer protocol selection?
question_80006.ground_truth: The ICS UE needs to select the transport layer protocol depending on the access network type and forward the I1 Invite message toward the SCC AS after generating the message.

question_80007.question: Which band does the "Minimum output power for UL MIMO" test case not have a minimum output power requirement for?
question_80007.ground_truth: Band n259 is the band for which the minimum output power requirement is not provided for UL MIMO.

question_80008.question: What message is sent by the RNC to the CN upon failure to process a request in the MBMS SESSION UPDATE procedure?

question_80009.question: What should the UE do if it supports A/Gb mode or Iu mode and has a valid GUTI?
question_80009.ground_truth: The UE should map the P-TMSI and RAI into the Old GUTI IE, include Old GUTI type IE with GUTI type set to "Mapped GUTI", and indicate the GUTI in the Additional GUTI IE if it has a valid GUTI.

question_80010.question: What is the relationship between the PC5 DRX and the PDB in the context of QoS flows?
question_80010.ground_truth: The PC5 DRX relates to the PDB and service pattern, and the PC5 DRX negotiation should be triggered by the QoS Flow establishment.

question_80011.question: What entity triggers the procedure for creating, updating, deleting, or getting the time synchronization context between 5G access stratum and the higher stratum in the TSCTSF?
question_80011.ground_truth: The procedure can be triggered by an AF request to influence the 5G access stratum time distribution or by PTP instance activation, modification, or deactivation in the TSCTSF.

question_80012.question: Where does the information about the mapping of the EC-RACH on physical channels come from?
question_80012.ground_truth: The physical channels on which the EC-RACH is mapped are derived by the MS from the EC SI broadcasted on the EC-BCCH.

question_80013.question: What is the purpose of the ng-eNB-DU ID in the 3GPP 5G system?
question_80013.ground_truth: The ng-eNB-DU ID is used to uniquely identify the ng-eNB-DU at least within an ng-eNB-CU in the 3GPP 5G system.

question_80015.question: Which HTTP methods are followed in the F-C API for the FLUS interface specification?
question_80015.ground_truth: The F-C API follows the RESTful design principles, and all operations are performed using HTTP 1.1 over TLS.

question_80017.question: What is the action performed when using the PATCH request method in the provided example?
question_80017.ground_truth: Modification of the list of members of a 5G VN group

question_80018.question: Regarding the Tactile Internet, what are the potential service requirements for maximum distance between endpoints?
question_80018.ground_truth: The potential service requirement is to have 1ms one-way delay between mobile devices and devices in the nearby internet.

question_80019.question: What is the carrier-to-interference ratio definition used in the plots FER versus C1/I1?
question_80019.ground_truth: The plots FER versus C1/I1 disregard the internal interference power by the second sub channel C2.

question_80020.question: In which section of TS 38.214 is the mapping type of PDSCH determined?
question_80020.ground_truth: In Section 5.1.2.2.1 of TS 38.214, the mapping type of PDSCH is determined.

question_80021.question: What network entity is responsible for collecting charging information for the radio interface usage in IP-CAN bearers?
question_80021.ground_truth: The PCNs (Charging Networks) are responsible for collecting charging information for the radio interface usage in IP-CAN bearers.

question_80022.question: In the E-SMLC Initiated Assistance Data Delivery followed by Location Information Transfer: UE-Based procedure, what should the UE send in response to a location request when it has received assistance data and is asked to provide a location estimate?
question_80022.ground_truth: The UE should send a PROVIDE LOCATION INFORMATION message containing a location estimate.

question_80024.question: How much MSD is needed in the n3 FDD band if both Duplexer isolation characteristic (2dB relaxation) and increased noise level (1.5dB) in Rx band by RFIC/PA operation for PC2 FDD UE are considered?
question_80024.ground_truth: A 1.7 dB MSD is needed in the n3 FDD band if both Duplexer isolation characteristic (2dB relaxation) and increased noise level (1.5dB) in Rx band by RFIC/PA operation for PC2 FDD UE are considered.

question_80026.question: What is the significance of the DNN in the N9HR LI architecture?
question_80026.ground_truth: The DNN is significant in N9HR LI as it identifies a data network name being used for N9HR, enabling the lawful interception of voice services for inbound roaming targets with N9HR.

question_80027.question: What was the mean power saving gain with a marginal loss in DL UE satisfied rate observed in FR1, DL evaluation, DU, VR30 for the eCDRX for jitter handling scheme?
question_80027.ground_truth: The mean power saving gain was 31.00%.

question_80029.question: How does the AMF determine the LADN service area information for a given DNN?
question_80029.ground_truth: The AMF determines the LADN service area information for a given DNN by taking the intersection of the LADN service area and the assigned Registration Area for the UE. The AMF does not create a Registration Area based on the availability of LADNs.

question_80030.question: What happens when a network slice instance for an existing PDU session needs to be changed?
question_80030.ground_truth: The AMF deletes the old NSI ID corresponding to the congested or unavailable network slice and informs the SMF to release the PDU session. Then, the SMF triggers the impacted UE to establish new PDU sessions associated with the same S-NSSAI using specific procedures.

question_80032.question: In what scenarios does the UE determine an access category and one or more access identities for each access attempt in order to derive an RRC establishment cause in 5GMM-IDLE mode or 5GMM-IDLE mode with suspend indication over 3GPP access?
question_80032.ground_truth: The UE determines an access category and one or more access identities for each access attempt in order to derive an RRC establishment cause when the UE is in 5GMM-IDLE mode or 5GMM-IDLE mode with suspend indication over 3GPP access and an event that requires a transition to 5GMM-CONNECTED mode occurs.

question_80033.question: What is the minimum rate of correct events required during repeated tests for E-UTRAn TDD Intra-frequency identification of a new CGI of E-UTRA cell using autonomous gaps for CE UE in CEModeB?
question_80033.ground_truth: The minimum rate of correct events required during repeated tests for this test is 90%.

question_80034.question: What timer does the SS start after sending an RRC message implying SI reading to the UE?
question_80034.ground_truth: The SS starts the T3 timer after sending the last TTI containing the RRC message implying SI reading to the UE.

question_80035.question: What is the effect of the number of legacy slots in the new slot aggregation on the performance gain?
question_80035.ground_truth: The more legacy slots in the aggregation, the more gain will be obtained.

question_80036.question: What is the percentage of all the possible measured distance and/or direction that can be expected to include the true distance and/or direction considering the ranging accuracy in ranging based services?

question_80037.question: What is the feature that allows for background data transfer policies to be requested and negotiated in the specified solution?
question_80037.ground_truth: The Background Data Transfer (BDT) feature is used to request and negotiate policies for data transfer in the specified solution.

question_80038.question: When should the mobile station stop timer T3210 after sending a PACKET CELL CHANGE NOTIFICATION message in response to a PACKET CELL CHANGE NOTIFICATION message?
question_80038.ground_truth: When the mobile station receives the first PACKET NEIGBOUR CELL DATA message, PACKET CELL CHANGE CONTINUE message, or PACKET CELL CHANGE ORDER message after sending the PACKET CELL CHANGE NOTIFICATION message.

question_80039.question: What happens when a registration timeout occurs in ICS UEs after attaching to the CS access?
question_80039.ground_truth: If a registration timeout occurs while the user is engaged in a call, the ICCF re-registers the ICS user in IMS. If the user is not engaged in a call, the ICCF performs a Sh or MAP ATI poll to HSS to check the CS status of an ICS user.

question_80040.question: What should the MBMS GW do when it receives an MBMS Session Start Request with the same TMGI and MBMS Flow Identifier but from a different BM-SC that already controls the MBMS session?
question_80040.ground_truth: The MBMS GW should pass on the "MBMS session re-establishment indication" flag in the MBMS Session Start Request it sends to MME/SGSNs if received from the BM-SC. The MBMS GW should replace the SGmb related resources for this MBMS service by those received in the MBMS Session Start Request (if different).

question_80041.question: Which two input parameters are used to generate the message authentication codes in 3G UMTS network?
question_80041.ground_truth: The two input parameters used to generate the message authentication codes in 3G UMTS network are the network-side nonce FRESH and the signalling message itself.

question_80042.question: What is the main concern regarding the current "device to enterprise" security solutions in the MTC user plane protection study?
question_80042.ground_truth: The main concern is that these security mechanisms incur a significant data overhead and could impact the useful battery life of MTC devices negatively.

question_80047.question: What is the maximum duration of the test procedure for the expected sequence of an MS that does not support PDP Context Activation requested by the network?
question_80047.ground_truth: The maximum duration of the test is 5 minutes.

question_80048.question: What does LTE-V stand for in the document?
question_80048.ground_truth: LTE-V stands for LTE V2X, which refers to Long Term Evolution Vehicle-to-Everything.

question_80050.question: In Scenario-B, how many beams are considered for the RRH antenna and the UE antenna for the uni-directional deployment, based on the document's analysis of the number of beams for coverage in Scenario B?
question_80050.ground_truth: Up to 3 beams are considered for the RRH antenna and up to 2 beams are considered for the UE antenna for the uni-directional deployment in Scenario B.

question_80051.question: What is the purpose of the Performance Measurement Function (PMF) protocol in the context of access network performance measurements in the ATSSS work?
question_80051.ground_truth: The Performance Measurement Function (PMF) protocol is used for access network performance measurements in the ATSSS work to estimate the Round-Trip Time (RTT) and Packet Loss Rate (PLR) over a certain QoS flow.

question_80052.question: What should the USIM do if the verification of the AUTN fails in 5G AKA?
question_80052.ground_truth: The USIM shall indicate to the ME the reason for failure and pass the AUTS parameter to the ME. The ME shall respond with an NAS message Authentication Failure with a CAUSE value indicating the reason for failure, and include the AUTS provided by the USIM if the synchronization failure is due to the AUTN.

question_80053.question: What are the requirements for performing RSS-based RSRP measurements for detected intra-frequency cells on serving and neighbor cells for UE category M1 with CE mode B?
question_80053.ground_truth: For performing RSS-based RSRP measurements on detected intra-frequency cells, the UE assumes that the RSS transmission of each neighbor cell starts in the radio frame that is closest in time, i.e. within a window of +/- 5ms, around the corresponding radio frame offset calculated from RRC signalling in the serving cell. The requirements for RSS-based RSRP measurements for a neighbor cell apply provided that the RSS transmission of each neighbor cell starts in the radio frame within a window of +/- 5ms around the calculated radio frame offset of the serving cell.

question_80054.question: What is the condition for a UE with low mobility to fulfill the relaxed measurement criterion in 5.2.4.9.1?
question_80054.ground_truth: The condition is (SrxlevRef - Srxlev) < SSearchDeltaP, where SrxlevRef is the reference Srxlev value of the serving cell, Srxlev is the current Srxlev value of the serving cell, and SSearchDeltaP is a threshold value.

question_80055.question: What is the purpose of the short window time duration when searching for a match?
question_80055.ground_truth: The purpose of the short window time duration is to identify the correct association match when there are multiple associations in the cache and to prevent missing of otherwise matching associations due to discrepancies between their stored association/disassociation time and the observed time provided by LEA.

question_80056.question: What does the 5GMM cause #79 indicate about a UE's ability to request UAS services?
question_80056.ground_truth: The 5GMM cause #79 indicates that the UE is marked in the UE's 5GMM context that it is not allowed to request UAS services. This causes the UE to pass to the 5GSM sublayer an indication that the 5GSM message was not forwarded because the UE is not allowed to request UAS services along with the 5GSM message from the Payload container IE of the DL NAS TRANSPORT message.

question_80057.question: What is the procedure if the AMF receives a Control Plane Service Request with uplink data, and the AMF has a Control Plane data back-off timer running for the UE?
question_80057.ground_truth: The AMF may decide to process the Control Plane Service Request with uplink data, i.e. decrypt and forward the data payload, or not based on certain conditions.

question_80058.question: What is the recommended architectural principle for Scenario 1 and Scenario 4 for non-5G Capable devices connecting to a 5G-RG?
question_80058.ground_truth: The recommended architectural principle is for a non-5G capable device to use the 3GPP reference points N2 and N3 for a W-5GAN interface to the 5GC, and for the 5G-RG to support the N1 signaling between the non-5G capable device and the 5GC. For user plane support, the 5GC shall be able to support the functionality for user-plane treatment in the UPF, and the W-5GAN shall be enabled to support QoS treatment of QoS flows.

question_80061.question: What is the purpose of the "Target 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE MAC address" IE in 5G ProSe direct link establishment?
question_80061.ground_truth: The "Target 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE MAC address" IE is used to indicate the MAC address of the target 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE when the 5G ProSe direct link establishment procedure is between the source and target 5G ProSe layer-3 end UEs and the MAC address of the target 5G ProSe layer-3 end UE is available in the 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-UE relay UE.

question_80062.question: What network information does the MGCF use to generate the Request-URI and To header field when sending an initial INVITE request towards the SIP-I based circuit switched core network?
question_80062.ground_truth: The MGCF creates an internal ISUP called party number from the received Request URI and generates the new Request-URI and To header field from the internal ISUP called party number.

question_80064.question: When EAS discovery filters are not provided, how does the EES identify the EAS(s)?
question_80064.ground_truth: The EES identifies the EAS(s) based on the UE-specific service information at the EES and the UE location, or by applying the ECSP policy.

question_80065.question: What is used by the UE and UPF to derive an estimation of the average RTT over an access type and QoS Flow?
question_80065.ground_truth: The UE and UPF derive an estimation of the average RTT over an access type and QoS Flow by averaging the RTT measurements obtained over this access type and QoS Flow.

question_80067.question: What is the format of an instance-id when an IMEI is available?
question_80067.ground_truth: When an IMEI is available, the instance-id shall take the form of a IMEI URN, where the imeival shall contain the IMEI encoded as defined in RFC 7254. An example of such an instance-id is: "urn:gsma:imei:90420156-025763-0".

question_80069.question: When would the MME trigger a Network Triggered Service Request from step~3?
question_80069.ground_truth: The MME triggers a Network Triggered Service Request from step~3 when the UE is in ECM-IDLE state and the QoS parameter ARP is modified, or when extended idle mode DRX is enabled for the UE.

question_80072.question: What does the IWU do during the signalling interworking of a call from an external SIP-I network towards the SIP-I based circuit-switched core network?
question_80072.ground_truth: The IWU decapsulates the ISUP message from the received SIP message, encapsulates the resulting ISUP message into the SIP message, and sends it to the succeeding 3GPP node. If the SIP BYE request does not contain an encapsulated REL message, the IWU constructs an ISUP REL message and sends it in a SIP message to the succeeding 3GPP node.

question_80073.question: What happens if the LMR system manages the group affiliations internally without involving the MCPTT system for group affiliation?
question_80073.ground_truth: In this case, the LMR system manages the affiliations from other LMR group members internally without involving the MCPTT system.

question_80074.question: Which element can appear multiple times in the "prose-direct-discovery-response" complexType?
question_80074.ground_truth: The element "response-announce", "response-monitor", "restricted-announce-response", "restricted-monitor-response", "restricted-discoveree-response", "restricted-discoverer-response", "response-reject", and "discovery-update-request" can appear multiple times in the "prose-direct-discovery-response" complexType.

question_80075.question: What should the MAC entity do if the Random Access Preamble is not selected in the contention-based Random Access procedure?
question_80075.ground_truth: The MAC entity should consider the Random Access procedure successfully completed and process the received UL grant value.

question_80077.question: What is the difference between NUD and NDUB?
question_80077.ground_truth: NUD stands for User Determined User Busy, while NDUB stands for Network Determined User Busy.

question_80079.question: What must the MCData server do if it wants to deliver a file to a group and uses the xMB interface with the pull ingest mode defined?
question_80079.ground_truth: The MCData server must update the MBMS session to provide the file list, including the file URL to be used by the BM-SC to fetch the file and the earliest fetch time.

question_80080.question: What is a format for transporting timed text, such as subtitles, in 3GPP files?

question_80082.question: What is the delay uncertainty in acquiring the first available PRACH occasion in the target NR cell in NR RRC re-establishment?

question_80083.question: What is the definition of a "Page" in the context of the USAT Interpreter?
question_80083.ground_truth: A "Page" in the context of the USAT Interpreter is the context of a USAT Interpreter rendering, the scope of USAT Interpreter variables, and the unit of transmission between the Gateway and a USIM containing the USAT Interpreter.

question_80084.question: How is the issue of Tracking Area Codes (TAC) fluctuations in moving cells addressed in 5GS?
question_80084.ground_truth: To avoid TAC fluctuations, the Radio Access Network broadcasts in the cell the list of Tracking Area Codes, corresponding to tracking areas that have been defined on the earth surface through network planning, for the zone currently enlighten by the radio cell.

question_80085.question: What is the command type in the SEND DATA command with the send immediately qualifier?

question_80086.question: What is the role of the Policy Control Function (PCF) in the 5G system?
question_80086.ground_truth: The Policy Control Function (PCF) in the 5G system is responsible for policy and charging control (PCC) and is a key component of the policy framework functionality, working in conjunction with other functions such as SMF, UPF, AMF, NEF, NWDAF, and AF.

question_80087.question: What is the purpose of providing a list of relevant operations in the description part of the charging information structure?
question_80087.ground_truth: The purpose of providing a list of relevant operations in the description part of the charging information structure is to provide evidences for the consumption of a service, and to ensure the validity of charging when necessary.

question_80089.question: What is the primary information flow for an MCData user joining a group conversation that is in progress?
question_80089.ground_truth: The media plane is established for the group conversation, and stored messages are delivered to the MCData user once affiliated with the MCData group.

question_80090.question: What is the role of ITU-T P.NATSproject in 3GPP technical report on streaming?
question_80090.ground_truth: ITU-T P.NATSproject develops an objective assessment model for progressive download and adaptive type media streaming, which supports both OTT and operator-managed video services. ITU-T P.NATSproject supports various protocols, including HTTP/TCP/IP, RTMP/TCP/IP, HLS/HTTP/TCP/IP, and DASH/HTTP/TCP/IP.

question_80091.question: When does the SCEF send the NIDD Submit Response message to the MME/SGSN in the roaming case?
question_80091.ground_truth: The SCEF sends the NIDD Submit Response message to the IWK-SCEF over T7 and the IWK-SCEF forwards the message to the MME/SGSN over T6a/T6b, if it can deliver the data.

question_80092.question: What is the notification URI variable for specifying the callback URI for EAS Deployment notification events?
question_80092.ground_truth: The notification URI variable for specifying the callback URI for EAS Deployment notification events is "<notifUri>".

question_80093.question: What is the standard deviation of the bulk log normal shadowing that applies to all sub-paths in the microcell NLOS case?
question_80093.ground_truth: The standard deviation of the bulk log normal shadowing that applies to all sub-paths in the microcell NLOS case is 10 dB.

question_80094.question: What are some of the mobility cases being studied in relation to supporting location continuity in 5GS?
question_80094.ground_truth: Some of the mobility cases being studied include mobility within 5GC (e.g. for change of serving AMF), mobility between EPS and 5GC when UE uses 3GPP access and/or non-3GPP access, and mobility between 3GPP access and non-3GPP access, both access connected to 5GC.

question_80095.question: Which type of data is sent in the cAPSpecificBoundSet in CAP?
question_80095.ground_truth: PARAMETERS-BOUND, represents the data type definitions for the bound values for each operation package.

question_80097.question: What should the floor control interface do upon receiving a Floor Request message without a Floor Indicator field and the D-bit and E-bit of the Floor Indicator are set to '0'?
question_80097.ground_truth: The floor control interface shall send a Floor Deny message to the associated floor participant, specifying the reject cause as 'Another MCPTT client has permission'.

question_80098.question: What conditions must be met for the UE to request the parameters for restricted Prose direct discovery model A announcing?
question_80098.ground_truth: The UE requests the parameters for restricted Prose direct discovery model A announcing if the transaction ID, the Announcing Type is set to "on demand", and the on demand announcing enabled indicator is not set to 1 in the UE's context for this discovery entry.

question_80099.question: How is Priority Service requested during call origination?
question_80099.ground_truth: Priority Service is manually requested during call origination by adding the Priority Service service code (SC) to the origination request.

question_80100.question: What is one of the responsibilities of the IMS Core in establishing a pre-established PoC session?
question_80100.ground_truth: The IMS Core (A) identifies that the service indication matches ISC filtering information and routes the INVITE request to the PoC AS (A) when establishing a pre-established PoC session.

question_80101.question: What is the term for the third order intermodulation product that falls to UL frequencies?
question_80101.ground_truth: The term for the third order intermodulation product that falls to UL frequencies is IMD products.

question_80102.question: What is the requirement for the early IMS security solution with regards to the 3GPP PS domain?
question_80102.ground_truth: The requirement is to support secure access over the 3GPP PS domain (including GSM/GPRS and UMTS access).

question_80103.question: What measures are required to ensure secure storage and execution environment for multiple MCIMs in M2ME?
question_80103.ground_truth: A TRE should be a secure storage for MCIMs and assuring the security aspects of the provisioning process, and of the subsequent storage and usage of MCIMs in M2ME. It should not be possible for sensitive data to leak from the provisioning channel to an insecure or unauthorized function within the M2ME.

question_80104.question: What is the protocol used in the session description in the SIP message?

question_80106.question: In what mode can the UE proceed with specific procedures if the event is an MO-MMTEL-voice-call-started indication, MO-MMTEL-video-call-started indication, or MO-SMSoIP-attempt-started indication, and the UE is operating in dual-registration mode?
question_80106.ground_truth: The UE can proceed in S1 mode with the appropriate EMM and ESM procedures to make a PDN connection providing access to IMS available.

question_80108.question: What are the conditions for the "UE with PEIPS assistance information provided in 5GMM-CONNECTED" test case in the 9.1.14.1.3 test procedure?
question_80108.ground_truth: The conditions for the "UE with PEIPS assistance information provided in 5GMM-CONNECTED" test case in the 9.1.14.1.3 test procedure are that the UE receives a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message without Negotiated PEIPS assistance information IE and the UE monitors one paging occasion per DRX cycle.

question_80110.question: What is the scope of the NFs that provide the LI functions within the CSP network?
question_80110.ground_truth: The scope of the NFs that provide the LI functions within the CSP network is determined based on various factors such as LI service type, CSP deployment choice, and the scope of LI as authorized in the warrant.

question_80113.question: What is the scope of the LTE Advanced Intra-band Non-contiguous Carrier Aggregation in Band 7 work item?
question_80113.ground_truth: The objective of this work item is to provide specification support for intra-band non-contiguous carrier aggregation in LTE FDD Band 7.

question_80114.question: In which message protocol and procedures are the NAS aspect explained?
question_80114.ground_truth: In the message protocol and procedures described in 3GPP TS 24.501.

question_80115.question: How does the BSF determine the network slice selection for a UE?
question_80115.ground_truth: The BSF selects the network slice for a UE based on the user identity, DNN, S-NSSAI, and, if available, the UE IP or MAC address, and the level of binding. The BSF may register, update, and remove the stored information about the selected PCF using the Nbsf management service operations.

question_80116.question: What approach is considered to resolve the backward-compatibility issue with Rel-14 LTE PC5 V2X for broadcast?
question_80116.ground_truth: A "Tx Profiles" based approach is considered, which involves using "Tx Profiles" to solve Key Issue #2 on 3GPP PC5 RAT selection for a V2X application by extending "Tx Profiles" to cover NR PC5 transmission mechanisms.

question_80117.question: What is the format of the HTTP POST request for setting up an AF session with required QoS for a target UE identified by its UE address in 5GS?
question_80117.ground_truth: In the HTTP POST request, the AF may include a "dnn" attribute and/or a "snssai" attribute, and in the HTTP PUT request, the AF shall keep the same value(s) of the "dnn" attribute and/or the "snssai" attribute as set in the HTTP POST request if provided.

question_80118.question: What is the condition for a UE to be considered successful in the test in Section 8.4.2.2?
question_80118.ground_truth: The UE must report an event correctly and within the required time limit as specified in the normative reference.

question_80119.question: What type of measurement is provided by the "This measurement provides the number of failed radio link setups on Iur for each cell" statement?
question_80119.ground_truth: The measurement provides a count of failed radio link setups on Iur for each cell.

question_80120.question: What is the definition of MCBD for FR1 and FR2 in the context of the measurement restrictions described?
question_80120.ground_truth: MCBD is the measurement quantity in use for evaluating the spatial network interface (CSI) in 5G NR communications. For FR1, when the CSI-RS is transmitted over a bandwidth greater than or equal to 24 PRBs, MCBD = 3. For FR2, MCBD is calculated based on the number of CSI-RS resources and the number of bands on which UE is performing beam failure detection for SCell.

question_80121.question: Which solution provides policy control information for Remote UE to select a L3 route?
question_80121.ground_truth: Sol#26 provides URSP rules changes to provide policy control information to assist the Remote UE select a L3 route with or without N3IWF or L2 route among the different communications paths for an application/service.

question_80122.question: What does the Sequence Numbers of Released Packets IE contain?
question_80122.ground_truth: The Sequence Numbers of Released Packets IE contains the sequence numbers of Data Record Transfer Requests that have been released.

question_80123.question: What is the purpose of the "nonce" header field parameter in the Authorization header field when sending a REGISTER request?
question_80123.ground_truth: The "nonce" header field parameter in the Authorization header field is set to the last received nonce value when sending a REGISTER request.

question_80128.question: What subtitle decoding capability should a 5GMSd Client support if it has the Television (TV) profile?
question_80128.ground_truth: If a 5GMSd Client supports the Television (TV) profile, it should support IMSC-1.1-TEXT-DEC decoding capabilities.

question_80129.question: What message does the H-NWDAF send to the V-NWDAF if the user consent parameters, operator policy, and/or regulatory policy indicate that the analytics information is allowed to be exposed to the VPLMN?
question_80129.ground_truth: The H-NWDAF sends analytics response to V-NWDAF, which contains analytics information.

question_80130.question: What should the BSS do if it has already obtained information about a PFC from the SGSN and receives the BSS context at the "new" BVCI with the same PFC information?
question_80130.ground_truth: The BSS should disregard the information corresponding to this PFC within the BSS context transferred from the "old" BVCI.

question_80131.question: What is the format of a security requirement description in SECAM?
question_80131.ground_truth: A security requirement description includes a unique requirement name, a unique requirement reference, a detailed description for the security requirement, a list of security objective references achieved through fulfilling this requirement, and a test case that defines how the requirement is tested.

question_80132.question: What must be tracked in the S-CSCF CDR in addition to Application Servers Information for sufficient CDR correlation in the Billing Domain?

question_80133.question: What information is used to derive the intermediate key NH in the E-UTRAN key hierarchy?
question_80133.ground_truth: The key set identifier eKSI, the initial KeNB from the current NAS security context, and a counter counting how many NH-derivations have already been performed are used to derive the intermediate key NH.

question_80134.question: What is the function of the MTC Server checking at the AAA Server the relationship between the IP address and the MTC Device provided ID?
question_80134.ground_truth: The MTC Server checks at the AAA Server the relationship between the IP address and the MTC Device provided ID to check the validity of the MTC Device provided id.

question_80135.question: What is the interruption time for TDD-TDD cell re-selection?
question_80135.ground_truth: The interruption time for TDD-TDD cell re-selection shall be less than Tinterrupt, TDD = TIU + 20 + TSI + TRA + TCSI ms.

question_80139.question: What regulations apply to the existing rules for 1670-1675 MHz?
question_80139.ground_truth: The existing rules for 1670-1675 MHz allow 2000 Watts peak EIRP from base stations, and 4 Watts peak EIRP from mobile terminals (47 CFR 27.50(f)). The FCC has not mandated the radio propagation direction and accepts both FDD and TDD technologies in this band. The LTE deployment in this band will adhere to all 3GPP terrestrial out-of-band requirements for spurious emissions.

question_80140.question: What is the purpose of the AS registration update request?
question_80140.ground_truth: The AS sends an AS registration update request to the PEMC or PIN Server where it registered to update the registration information associated with the AS registration identifier.

question_80141.question: What is the data volume reporting function used for in UTRAN?
question_80141.ground_truth: Reporting the volume of unacknowledged data to the CN for accounting purpose.

question_80142.question: What information does the +CUSATE command provide in the context of USAT?
question_80142.ground_truth: The +CUSATE command allows the TE to send a USAT envelope command to the MT and receive a response with information about the status and busy state of the UICC. The command can also be used to send the UICC the status words provided by the MT in response to a USAT envelope command that it has executed.

question_80143.question: What is the core requirement for the E-UTRA DL RS power in OTA AAS BS?
question_80143.ground_truth: The core requirement for the E-UTRA DL RS power is that the control signal power is within the required accuracy compared to the power level which is intended. The power level for the conformance test is declared.

question_80144.question: What is the reference point MCData-IPcon-3 used for in the MCData application signalling for establishing a session?
question_80144.ground_truth: The reference point MCData-IPcon-3 is used for carrying downlink unidirectional IP Data over the media plane between the IPcon distribution function of the MCData server and the IPcon function of the MCData client(s) for point-to-point MCData IP connectivity.

question_80147.question: In what frequency range does the regional requirement for protection of GPS apply?
question_80147.ground_truth: The regional requirement for protection of GPS applies in the frequency range 1559-1610 MHz.

question_80148.question: What message does the mobile station send before the SS sends a HANDOVER COMMAND message, ordering it to switch to cell B?
question_80148.ground_truth: The mobile station sends an IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT message before the SS sends a HANDOVER COMMAND message, ordering it to switch to cell B.

question_80149.question: What is the purpose of defining trust domains in a 3GPP network?
question_80149.ground_truth: The purpose of defining trust domains in a 3GPP network is to provide separation between workloads, allowing resources to be used in the most efficient and secure manner. This ensures that critical and sensitive workloads do not run on the same host pool as vulnerable functions.

question_80150.question: Which requirement supports efficient service parameter provisioning and high-density connections of devices?
question_80150.ground_truth: PR.5.3.3.1-001 and PR.5.3.3.1-002 aim to support efficient service parameter provisioning and high-density connections of devices.

question_80151.question: What is the transmission time for N-AGCH in GPRS+10 dB and GPRS+20 dB scenarios, respectively?
question_80151.ground_truth: Transmission Time (N-AGCH) for GPRS+10 dB is 470.8 ms, and for GPRS+20 dB is 1176.9 ms.

question_80152.question: In which two cases is the PDN-GW the only possible ICE in the 3GPP network, when accessing the network through a trusted Non-3GPP access (S2a)?
question_80152.ground_truth: In the case of non-roaming (PDN-GW in the HPLMN) and in the case of roaming with local breakout (PDN-GW located in the VPLMN).

question_80155.question: What is the definition of co-channel rejection in the context of packet channels?
question_80155.ground_truth: Co-channel rejection is a measure of the capability of the receiver to receive a wanted modulated signal without exceeding a given degradation due to the presence of an unwanted modulated signal, both signals being at the nominal frequency of the receiver.

question_80158.question: What action should a floor participant take upon receiving a Floor Granted message in the 'O: pending request' state, when the User ID field does not match its own MCPTT ID and the SSRC of the floor participant sending the message matches the stored SSRC of the current arbitrator?
question_80158.ground_truth: The floor participant should request the MCPTT client to stop rendering received RTP media packets, set the stored SSRC of the candidate arbitrator to the SSRC of the user to whom the floor was granted, reset the counter C201 associated with timer T201, restart timer T203 and T201, and remain in 'O: pending request' state.

question_80159.question: What action does the SMF take if it detects that the UE is outside the MBS service area?
question_80159.ground_truth: If the SMF detects that the UE is outside the MBS service area, it rejects the multicast session join and sends a Join Reject to the UE, indicating that the MBS join is rejected due to the UE being outside of the local service area.

question_80160.question: When the UE requests Ranging/SL Positioning policy/parameters, what parameters are provided by the PCF depending on the type of Policy Provisioning Request indicated?
question_80160.ground_truth: There are three scenarios depending on the type of Policy Provisioning Request indicated: (1) PCF provides Ranging/SL Positioning policy/parameters in the V2XP if V2X Policy Provisioning Request is indicated together with Ranging/SL Positioning Policy Provisioning Request, (2) PCF provides Ranging/SL Positioning policy/parameters in the ProSeP if 5G ProSe Policy Provisioning Request is indicated together with Ranging/SL Positioning Policy Provisioning Request, and (3) PCF provides Ranging/SL Positioning policy/parameters in both the V2XP and the ProSeP if both V2X Policy Provisioning Request and 5G ProSe Policy Provisioning Request are indicated together with Ranging/SL Positioning Policy Provisioning Request.

question_80162.question: What are some applications of the Reed Solomon code?
question_80162.ground_truth: The Reed Solomon code is used in storage systems, communications, and digital television. Examples of these applications include hard disk drives, optical storage, and satellite communications.

question_80164.question: What action is taken by the HSS when it responds with a 3xx status code?
question_80164.ground_truth: The HSS includes a Location header with an URI pointing to the endpoint of another HSS (service) instance.

question_80165.question: What is the role of the AUSF in the SoR/UPU Counter Wrap Around Use Case?
question_80165.ground_truth: If the SoR/UPU Counter is about to wrap around, the AUSF notifies the UDM about the wrap around condition, along with the SUPI. The UDM then needs to initiate primary (re-)authentication for a UE by sending a request to the serving AMF.

question_80166.question: What is the difference between the first and second HARQ-ACK reporting modes?
question_80166.ground_truth: The first HARQ-ACK reporting mode requires the UE to transmit a PUCCH for HARQ-ACK information with either ACK or NACK value, whereas the second HARQ-ACK reporting mode has the UE only transmit a PUCCH for HARQ-ACK information with NACK value. The second mode also has different PUCCH resource selection rules.

question_80167.question: What is the purpose of the handle provided to UE-1 and UE-2, and when is it updated?
