question_80167.ground_truth: The handle is provided to UE-1 and UE-2 when they register with a specific PLMN. It uniquely identifies the UE-PLMN pair. The UE-1 and UE-2, along with their associated PLMNs, can refresh and update this handle value during registration procedures. The handles and their corresponding security keys are stored in the AMF UE context.

question_80168.question: What is the frequency to be used for the RRC re-establishment delay test in clause 6.1.10.4?
question_80168.ground_truth: The frequency to be used for the RRC re-establishment delay test in clause 6.1.10.4 is 10 MHz.

question_80170.question: What is the minimum conformance requirement for RRC based uplink spatial relation switch delay as specified in clause 7.5.9.0.2?
question_80170.ground_truth: The minimum conformance requirement for RRC based uplink spatial relation switch delay is defined in clause 7.5.9.0.2.

question_80172.question: What message type must be included in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message by the UE to request SMS over NAS support?

question_80174.question: What is the method used by MPEG G-PCC for encoding volumetric media?
question_80174.ground_truth: MPEG G-PCC divides volumetric media into multiple sub-blocks. It then recursively subdivides a volumetric media until no more sub-blocks are left. Tools including arithmetic encoding are used to encode all the tree information into the bitstream.

question_80176.question: When should the mobile station store the received GPRS mobile allocation in direct encoding 1 or 2 for possible later reference in an assignment message using the indirect encoding?
question_80176.ground_truth: The mobile station should store the received GPRS mobile allocation in direct encoding 1 or 2 in the frequency parameters information element for possible later reference in an assignment message using the indirect encoding when it will be used for decoding frequency information in a subsequent assignment message.

question_80178.question: Which section of TR 23.887 describes the solution for Extended DRX in idle mode?
question_80178.ground_truth: Section 7.1.3.1 of TR 23.887 describes the solution for Extended DRX in idle mode.

question_80179.question: What operation is used to request deleting a policy domain?
question_80179.ground_truth: The "deleteDomain" operation is used to request deleting a policy domain.

question_80180.question: Which functional entity of IAB is responsible for providing NR Uu access to UEs and child IAB-nodes?
question_80180.ground_truth: The gNB-DU in the IAB-node is responsible for providing NR Uu access to UEs and child IAB-nodes.

question_80182.question: What does the "FEC-Redundancy-Level" attribute in the FLUTE FDT indicate?
question_80182.ground_truth: The "FEC-Redundancy-Level" attribute in the FLUTE FDT indicates the FEC redundancy level for the file, which is the extra redundancy added for the file during MBMS delivery.

question_80184.question: What is the RF requirements reusability for UMTS900 and UMTS850 in the 3GPP UMTS system?
question_80184.ground_truth: The RF requirements for UMTS900 and UMTS850 are similar, and the simulation results for UMTS850 can be reused for UMTS900 in most cases.

question_80187.question: What should the UE do if it does not have the required activated TCI-states information in the new BWP to receive PDCCH and PDSCH?
question_80187.ground_truth: The UE should continue to use old TCI-states before the BWP switch until a new MAC CE updating the required activated TCI-states information is received after the BWP switch.

question_80188.question: What should the UE do if it receives an SOR transparent container during a registration procedure and decides to release the N1 NAS signalling connection?
question_80188.ground_truth: The UE shall suspend the transmission of 5GSM messages after sending the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message and until the N1 NAS signalling connection is released, with the exception of an emergency PDU session.

question_80189.question: What happens when the NF service consumer sends an HTTP GET request to fetch analytics from the DCCF?
question_80189.ground_truth: The DCCF responds with HTTP "204 No Content" status code

question_80191.question: What is the minimum attenuation requirement for the TX filter to protect a Band 5 BS receiver in a co-existence scenario?
question_80191.ground_truth: The attenuation requirement of the TX filter to protect Band 5 BS receiver in co-existence scenario is 36 dB.

question_80192.question: What are the drawbacks of the small data solution?
question_80192.ground_truth: The small data solution has several drawbacks, including the need for modifications to existing interfaces and nodes, the requirement for MME to queue DL data together with paging when UE is idle, and the need for separate API calls if the application has to select the data path.

question_80193.question: What is one use case where a server/agent may request more load reduction from certain client nodes than from others?
question_80193.ground_truth: One use case is when some client nodes are generating significantly more requests than others, leading to overload. In this case, the server/agent can request more load reduction from the "flooding" clients and less or no reduction from other clients.

question_80194.question: Which organization approves the revisions of the 3GPP technical report?
question_80194.ground_truth: The Technical Specification Group Radio Access Network (TSG RAN) of the 3GPP.

question_80195.question: What is the recommended scope of a radio capability filter in RACS supporting PLMN, if filtering of radio capabilities applies in RRC?
question_80195.ground_truth: The recommended scope of a radio capability filter in RACS supporting PLMN is as much as possible of wider scope, preferably PLMN-wide, and not only specific to a RAN node or region.

question_80196.question: When must the UE stop timer T3396 upon receiving a MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message, except for emergency PDN connections?
question_80196.ground_truth: The UE must stop timer T3396 upon receiving a MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message when a UE provided an APN for the establishment of the PDN connection, or when no APN was provided, and the request type was not "emergency" nor "handover of emergency bearer services".

question_80197.question: In which clause is the measurement reporting delay defined as the time between an event that triggers a measurement report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface?

question_80198.question: What is key issue #2c and possible solutions?
question_80198.ground_truth: Key issue #2c is finding the correct CHF for solutions #2.1 and #2.3 where V-CHF communicates with H-CHF. Possible solutions for this issue are using NRF (Solution #2.8) or SUPI (Solution #2.9) to find the H-CHF.

question_80199.question: What is a disadvantage of using Solution 1, where the MME FQ-CSID is kept in the PGW when the UE is ISR activated?
question_80199.ground_truth: One disadvantage is that the SGW and PGW cannot change the FQ-CSID assigned before ISR activation, since the MME may not be able to update those changes.

question_80200.question: What is the main focus of the LMF-based solution in addressing key issues in 5G LCS architecture?
question_80200.ground_truth: The LMF-based solution in the 5G LCS architecture focuses on enhancing the LCS architecture, supporting low latency LCS, slicing-dependent location services, scalability, IoT UE support, and LCS support for Non-3GPP access.

question_80201.question: What is the use of the optional fields in an email <-> SMS gateway?
question_80201.ground_truth: The optional fields in an email <-> SMS gateway are used for presenting the message to the user and may include fields like subject, real name, and optional control flag.

question_80202.question: What is the procedure for creating the application/vnd.3gpp.mcptt-signed+xml MIME body?
question_80202.ground_truth: The procedure is defined in Annex~F.6.2 and the semantic described in Annex~F.6.3 of the document, which involves performing reference generation and signature generation on the MIME bodies included in the SIP request or SIP response.

question_80203.question: What is the purpose of the verification of the energies of the last sub-blocks preceding the onset?
question_80203.ground_truth: The verification is done to avoid false pre-echo detection. If the energies of the last sub-blocks preceding the onset do not satisfy certain conditions, the pre-echo attenuation is inhibited.

question_80204.question: Which fading profile is used for measuring high SNR cases for maximum data rate testing or high order modulation testing?
question_80204.ground_truth: VA3 for HSPA and EVA200 for LTE

question_80205.question: What is one of the measurements required for FR1 channel model validation in OTA testing?

question_80208.question: What is the purpose of the test for E-UTRAN TDD UE transmit timing accuracy for CE UE in CEModeA?
question_80208.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that the CE UE have the capability to follow the frame timing change of the connected System Simulator by measuring the reception of the SRS and verifying the requirements.

question_80209.question: What type of traffic is the UE Context Release Request measurement valid for?
question_80209.ground_truth: The UE Context Release Request measurement is valid for packet switched traffic.

question_80210.question: What is the procedure for verifying the TLS certificate between intra-domain TLS entities?
question_80210.ground_truth: The NF TLS client checks the sender's certificate to ensure it is not expired, uses the intermediate CA's public key to verify the signature, verifies the intermediate CA's certificate, and then verifies that the intermediate CA's certificate is trusted using the provisioned self-signed root certificate. A successful transaction results in a self-signed root certificate that the receiver implicitly trusts.

question_80213.question: What should the MCVideo client do when it receives a SIP INFO request where the Request-URI contains an MCVideo session ID identifying an ongoing group session?
question_80213.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should follow the actions specified in subclause 6.2.8.1.13.

question_80214.question: What is the event described in section 5.8.10.4.3, where the serving becomes worse than a threshold, called in the NR sidelink measurement system?

question_80215.question: What is the modulation scheme used by the SS to transmit packets on PDTCH when using DAS-7 coding for a 16-QAM Modulation?

question_80216.question: What is the purpose of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project's Technical Specification Group's document "Test plan for speech quality and delay through a headset electrical interface (Release 17) Foreword"?
question_80216.ground_truth: The purpose of the document is to provide a standardized test methodology for measuring speech transmission quality and delay through a UE (User Equipment) headset electrical interface, which will help to interpret results consistently and make accurate conclusions about network and UE performance.

question_80217.question: What information is used for the initial signalling of PC5 unicast link establishment if a prior unicast link to the same Application Layer ID doesn't exist?
question_80217.ground_truth: The initial signalling for the establishment of the PC5 unicast link may use the known Layer-2 ID of the communication peer, or a default destination Layer-2 ID associated with the V2X service type.

question_80218.question: What is the minimum number of bytes that a "Granted Party's Identity" value should be if the MCPTT standard requires the "Granted Party's Identity" value to be padded?
question_80218.ground_truth: The minimum number of bytes that a "Granted Party's Identity" value should be if the MCPTT standard requires the "Granted Party's Identity" value to be padded is (2 + multiple of 4) bytes.

question_80220.question: What are the RF channels used in this test?
question_80220.ground_truth: The primary cell (Cell 1) is on RF channel 1 (PCC) and the secondary cell (Cell 2) is on RF channel 2 (SCC).

question_80222.question: Which solution is widely adopted in the industry for RESTful API design?

question_80224.question: What information is provisioned for 5G ProSe Direct Discovery?
question_80224.ground_truth: The information provisioned includes authorization policies and parameters such as the mapping of ProSe services to Destination Layer-2 IDs for sending/receiving discovery messages.

question_80226.question: What is the purpose of the Arbitration use case in the FRMCS System?
question_80226.ground_truth: The FRMCS System performs arbitration based on the context of the communication to determine the behavior of the end user device in case of multiple competing communications, and the System may ask the FRMCS User to select the communication to accept.

question_80234.question: What must the UE check before initiating the discoveree request procedure for Model B in a new PLMN?
question_80234.ground_truth: The UE must be authorized for restricted ProSe direct discovery model B discoveree operation in the new PLMN.

question_80235.question: What is the purpose of the notification procedure in 5GS?
question_80235.ground_truth: The notification procedure is used by the network to request the UE to re-activate the PDU sessions associated with a particular access type.

question_80237.question: What changes needs to be made to the Contact header in the REGISTER request if the REGISTER request contained a Required or Supported header containing the value "gruu"?
question_80237.ground_truth: The Contact header should include pub-gruu and temp-gruu header parameters for each contact address in the contact header that has a +sip.instance header parameter, with the values containing the public GRUU and the most recently assigned temporary GRUU representing the association between the public user identity and the instance ID.

question_80238.question: What is the OUTCOME for the mBMSUELinking RANAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?

question_80239.question: What action does the AMF take if the UE supports multiple records of NAS security context storage for multiple registration and has two records stored, and is attempting registration to the PLMN associated with the second record of that access?
question_80239.ground_truth: The UE uses the second NAS security context of that access to protect the initial NAS message, and the AMF re-establishes the secure exchange of NAS messages.

question_80240.question: What are the FCC requirements for the band 2000-2020 MHz frequency range in the United States?
question_80240.ground_truth: The FCC rules for the band 2000-2020 MHz require a maximum emissions limit of -50 dBm/MHz for the frequency range 1930-1990 MHz, -40 dBm/MHz for the frequency range 1990-1999 MHz, and -40 dBm/(1 % Channel Bandwidth) for the frequency range 1999-2000 MHz. The EIRP in the frequency range 2000-2005 MHz is limited to 7 dBm.

question_80242.question: Under what circumstances will the UE consider cells as candidates for cell reselection?
question_80242.ground_truth: The UE shall not consider any exclude-listed cells as candidates for cell reselection.

question_80244.question: What is the maximum time allowed for the initial BSIC identification of a single GSM cell?
question_80244.ground_truth: Tidentify abort = 5000 ms, indicating the time necessary to identify one new GSM cell.

question_80245.question: What are the two main criteria for selecting the Target RAN Codec in eSRVCC procedures?
question_80245.ground_truth: The two main criteria for selecting the Target RAN Codec in eSRVCC procedures are to optimize the Target RAN Codec to fit the IMS Selected Codec, and if that is impossible or not optimal, then to renegotiate the IMS Selected Codec with the remote end to fit any selected Target RAN Codec at call transfer.

question_80246.question: What is the purpose of the MIMO Capability IE in the information element for local cells that are MIMO capable when operating at 1.28Mcps TDD?
question_80246.ground_truth: The purpose of the MIMO Capability IE is to indicate that the local cell is MIMO capable. This information element is included in the local cell information for every MIMO capable local cell.

question_80247.question: What is the purpose of the test procedure described in clause 16.1.1.8.4.2?
question_80247.ground_truth: The purpose of the test procedure is not clear from the given text, as it only refers to clause 16.1.1.7.4.2.

question_80249.question: Which method can create, retrieve, update, or delete repository data for a given service indication?
question_80249.ground_truth: The PUT, GET, and DELETE methods can be used to create, retrieve, update, or delete repository data for a given service indication.

question_80250.question: Which LPN channel has a significant power requirement after E-DCH decoupling, especially for larger CIO values?
question_80250.ground_truth: The E-AGCH channel has a significant power requirement after E-DCH decoupling, especially for larger CIO values.

question_80253.question: In what scenario should the AMF set the Payload container type IE to "UE policy container" when forwarding a UE policy container to the UE?
question_80253.ground_truth: The AMF should set the Payload container type IE to "UE policy container" when it receives a UE policy container from the PCF and forwards it to the UE.

question_80254.question: What is the maximum number of transmissions that can be performed for a MAC PDU currently in the buffer, for synchronous HARQ?

question_80256.question: What is the definition of transmission intermodulation as specified in EN 302 574-1?
question_80256.ground_truth: Transmission intermodulation is a measure of the capability of the transmitter to inhibit the generation of signals in its non-linear elements caused by the presence of the wanted signal and an interfering signal reaching the transmitter via the antenna. The interference signal is at specific frequency offsets from the subject signal carrier frequency, but excluding interference frequencies that are outside of the allocated frequency band.

question_80257.question: How is the actual value for thresholds calculated in the "RSRP-RangeNR-r15" field of the RSRP-RangeNR information element?
question_80257.ground_truth: The actual value for thresholds is (field value - 156) dBm, except for field value 127, in which case the actual value is infinity.

question_80258.question: When can the MME provide the Full UE Radio Capability information to E-UTRAN when the UE performs Service Request or TA U with active flag, causing establishment of DRBs, from an NB-IoT cell?
question_80258.ground_truth: The MME can provide the Full UE Radio Capability information to E-UTRAN when it has valid Full UE Radio Capability information stored.

question_80261.question: How many RLC blocks are present in MCS-10 and MCS-11, and what families do they belong to?
question_80261.ground_truth: Both MCS-10 and MCS-11 consist of 3 RLC blocks. MCS-10 falls into families B, and MCS-11 falls into family A.

question_80262.question: What is the role of the PFDF in handling PFDs?
question_80262.ground_truth: The PFDF is responsible for validating, distributing, and provisions/updates/removes PFDs to the PCEF/TDF.

question_80264.question: What is the role of the BSSLAP APDU in the Connection Oriented Information Transfer procedure?
question_80264.ground_truth: The BSSLAP APDU contains the information that needs to be transferred concerning a particular target MS. In this procedure, it is included in the BSSMAP-LE Connection Oriented Information message and transferred between the SMLC and the BSS serving the target MS.

question_80265.question: What does the solution aim to minimize the impact on?
question_80265.ground_truth: The solution aims to minimize the impact on other NFs when the UE moves to a region that has UPFs that are not connected to or managed by the A-SMF.

question_80266.question: What is the scope of the present document as defined in 3GPP TS 32.365 V9.0.0?
question_80266.ground_truth: The present document specifies the XML Definitions for the Entry Point IRP (EPIRP) as it applies to Itf-N, in accordance with EP IRP IS definitions and Notification Log IRP XML Definitions. This specification is related to 3GPP TS 32.362 V9.0.X.

question_80267.question: What are the two new attributes introduced in the ML Assessment Request IOC and ML Assessment Response IOC to allow the MnS consumer to request the assessment of ML entity fulfilment of trustworthiness requirements and report the achieved assessment trustworthiness score?
question_80267.ground_truth: The two new attributes are ML Assessment Request IOC and ML Assessment Response IOC.

question_80268.question: What is the role of the PFDs in the management of packet flow descriptions in clause 6.1.20?
question_80268.ground_truth: The PFDs are used in the application detection and enforcement actions in the PCEF and TDF. They are provided by the ASP and become part of the application detection filters in the PCEF/TDF.

question_80269.question: What are the three types of PDN connectivity that can be registered during the initial registration?
question_80269.ground_truth: The three types of PDN connectivity that can be registered during the initial registration are 'ims', 'internet', and 'mcx'.

question_80270.question: What is the primary responsibility of the rapporteur of each work item (WI) in TR maintenance?
question_80270.ground_truth: It is the responsibility of the rapporteur of each WI to ensure that the TPs related to the WI have been implemented in the present document.

question_80271.question: What command type is used when the ME needs to send data to the UICC?

question_80272.question: What is the accuracy level required for use cases operating in environments with mild signal obstruction?
question_80272.ground_truth: The required accuracy level for use cases operating in environments with mild signal obstruction is better than 1 m/s.

question_80274.question: What should the old BSS do in case of an unsuccessful DTM Handover to UTRAN when using the existing handover procedure inside the CN?
question_80274.ground_truth: The old BSS should not initiate a cell load based handover procedure if it has knowledge of the load in the target cell and, after a successful completion of the handover procedure, this load would be higher than in the old cell.

question_80275.question: What should the SS check regarding the UE's authentication scheme in step 1 of the test procedure?
question_80275.ground_truth: The SS should check that the UE can authenticate itself correctly with the authentication scheme that the UE supports, which includes HTTP Digest authentication or GAA based authentication.

question_80276.question: What is the number of search space sets that a UE expects to monitor for detecting up to 3 sizes of DCI formats with CRC scrambled by C-RNTI per serving cell?
question_80276.ground_truth: A UE expects to monitor PDCCH candidates for up to 4 sizes of DCI formats that include up to 3 sizes of DCI formats with CRC scrambled by C-RNTI per serving cell.

question_80277.question: What are the three CSI feedback overhead ranges defined for evaluating CSI feedback reduction?
question_80277.ground_truth: CSI feedback overhead A, CSI feedback overhead B, and CSI feedback overhead C

question_80278.question: How many possible scenarios are there for a particular MS/UE in the GERAN/UTRAN part of the PLMN?
question_80278.ground_truth: There are three possible scenarios for a particular MS/UE.

question_80279.question: What is the role of the notification management server functional entity in the notification management functional model?
question_80279.ground_truth: The notification management server functional entity handles the notification management aspects by interacting with the notification management client and the VAL servers, receiving notification messages from the vertical application layer and delivering it to the notification management client.

question_80280.question: What message does the MS send to initiate a MOLR procedure as call independent supplementary services?
question_80280.ground_truth: The MS initiates the MOLR procedure by sending a REGISTER message with Facility IE containing a component set to a DTAP LCS-MOLR Invoke.

question_80282.question: What is a requirement for the MC service client 1 to send an MC service group affiliation change request?
question_80282.ground_truth: The MC service client 1 requires the target MC service user(s) ID, MC service group(s) ID, and the requested affiliation status to send an MC service group affiliation change request.

question_80283.question: What is the maximum number of APNs for which the PGW is allowed to advertise the Load Control Information?
question_80283.ground_truth: The maximum number of APNs for which the PGW is allowed to advertise the Load Control Information is 10.

question_80284.question: What does the Number of Active UEs IE indicate in the 3GPP 5G standard?
question_80284.ground_truth: The Number of Active UEs IE indicates the mean number of active UEs as defined in TS 38.314.

question_80285.question: What is the purpose of the 6.3.1.1 operation setPartialSuspensionOfItfN?
question_80285.ground_truth: Allows an IRPManager to suspend the forwarding via Itf-N of notifications generated by scoped managed object instances and all other notifications not related to managed NRM IOC instances.

question_80286.question: How are the LPC coefficients transformed into the ISP domain, and then back to the LP filter coefficients?
question_80286.ground_truth: The LPC coefficients are transformed into the ISP domain for quantization and interpolation purposes. The interpolated and quantized filters are then converted back to the LP filter coefficients to construct the synthesis and weighting filters at each subframe.

question_80288.question: With FR1, Urban Macro, DL, with 100MHz bandwidth for CG traffic model, 15ms PDB, 60 FPS, and SU-MIMO, what is the capacity performance range and mean capacity performance with a PDB increase from 10ms to 15ms and 30Mbps data rate?
question_80288.ground_truth: The range of capacity performance is 4.05~10.6 UEs per cell, and the mean capacity performance is 7.72 UEs per cell with 30Mbps and 15ms PDB.

question_80289.question: What is the role of the "Reserve IMS resources" procedure in the described multimedia conference establishment procedure?
question_80289.ground_truth: The "Reserve IMS resources" procedure is used by the MRFC to request resources from the MRFP before creating an ad-hoc conference.

question_80290.question: What action does the UP Function take when the last L2TP session in a L2TP tunnel is terminated?
question_80290.ground_truth: The UP Function may terminate the L2TP tunnel as well, but it is also possible to retain the L2TP tunnel even if all L2TP sessions are terminated.

question_80291.question: What is the maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell?
question_80291.ground_truth: The maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell is 1280 ms.

question_80293.question: What should be done for a multi-band capable BS with a separate antenna connector when testing a single band?
question_80293.ground_truth: The antenna connector not being under test should be terminated.

question_80294.question: What are the channels used to send resource assignment to an MS prior to packet transfer?

question_80300.question: What is the PROCEDURE CODE for the positionCalculation PCAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE?
question_80300.ground_truth: The PROCEDURE CODE for the positionCalculation PCAP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE is id-PositionCalculation.

question_80302.question: When shall the octets for Old EPS Security Context be present in a S10 Forward Relocation Request message?
question_80302.ground_truth: The octets for Old EPS Security Context shall be present if the OSCI (Old Security Context Indicator), bit 1 of octet 6) is set to "1"; otherwise they shall not be present.

question_80304.question: What is the purpose of load balancing/shifting in cellular networks?
question_80304.ground_truth: The purpose of load balancing/shifting is to improve the overall system performance by changing the traffic load distribution over cells/layers. This can be achieved by obtaining a more evenly distributed traffic load across the cells/layers or by concentrating the traffic into fewer cells to mitigate inter-cell interference in dense small cell deployments.

question_80306.question: What system is responsible for performing real-time credit-control in a packet-switched domain?

question_80307.question: What is the length of the speech frame for all 3GPP Codec Types when using compressed speech on the A-Interface?

question_80311.question: What is the test procedure for test 1 in the UE behavior of the random access procedure?
question_80311.ground_truth: The UE shall send the signalled preamble and wait for a random access response. If the received responses are not successful, the UE shall re-transmit the preamble with the calculated PRACH transmission power.

question_80314.question: How is the depth range of a stereoscopic 3D video provided in a DASH service?
question_80314.ground_truth: The maximum and minimum disparity, screen width (or diagonal) or range of screen widths (or range of diagonals) could be signalled as part of MPD describing DASH service. This information would allow DASH client to choose version of stereoscopic 3D video which would ensure the highest quality of the 3D experience on a given hardware.

question_80315.question: What cause value does the SGW return if no response is received from the PGW or MME/S4-SGSN?
question_80315.ground_truth: The SGW returns the cause value "remote peer not responding" if no response is received from the PGW or MME/S4-SGSN.

question_80316.question: What are the main functions of the PCRF in the EPC network?
question_80316.ground_truth: The PCRF is responsible for policy and charging control in the EPC network. It terminates the Rx interface and the Gx interface, associates the sessions established over the multiple reference points for the same UE's IP-CAN session, and implements PCC session binding.

question_80318.question: What does the NAS do if the access attempt is barred and the UE is operating in the single-registration mode and the MO-SMSoIP-attempt-started indication or the MO-IMS-registration-related-signalling-started indication triggered the access attempt?
question_80318.ground_truth: The NAS should notify the upper layers that the access attempt is barred, and upon receiving an indication from the lower layers that the barring is alleviated for the access category with which the access attempt was associated, the NAS shall notify the upper layers that the barring is alleviated for the access category and may initiate the procedure to send the initial NAS message, if still needed.

question_80320.question: What is the purpose of padding in a MAC PDU?
question_80320.ground_truth: Padding is placed at the end of the MAC PDU if present, and its presence and length are implicitly based on the TB size and size of MAC subPDUs.

question_80324.question: How does a L2 U2N Relay UE send paging to a L2 U2N Remote UE via PC5?
question_80324.ground_truth: A L2 U2N Relay UE uses unicast signalling to send paging to a L2 U2N Remote UE via PC5.

question_80325.question: What is the length of the field F1 in the Spatial Relation for Resource IDi?
question_80325.ground_truth: The length of the field F1 is 1 bit.

question_80327.question: What is the main focus of Key Issue #2 in the Technical Report?
question_80327.ground_truth: Key Issue #2 aims to study how a roaming UE can obtain prioritization information of the VPLMNs with which the UE may register for the network slice.

question_80329.question: What actions should the PCF take if it receives service information with an MPS session indication and an active IMS Signalling Priority for the PDU session?
question_80329.ground_truth: The PCF sets the ARP of the default QoS flow and PCC rules for IMS Multimedia priority services, and derives the PCC rules corresponding to the IMS Multimedia Priority Service.

question_80330.question: When the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message is received in order to take a 5G NAS security context into use created after a successful execution of the 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure, what should the UE do to the uplink NAS COUNT counter in the new 5G NAS security context after taking it into use?
question_80330.ground_truth: The UE shall reset the uplink NAS COUNT counter.

question_80332.question: What is the IPv6/UDP/RTP overhead when sending 8 non-redundant frames (80 ms) in the packets in the A->B direction in Use case B?

question_80334.question: What happens when the UE sends an LCS Periodic Location Cancellation request to the MME?
question_80334.ground_truth: The UE stops the periodic and triggered event reporting and returns an LCS Periodic Location cancellation ack. to the MME, even when the UE has no knowledge of the location procedure being cancelled.

question_80335.question: What does the ADRF respond with if none of the requested ML model(s) exist in the ADRF ML Model Store?
question_80335.ground_truth: The ADRF responds with "204 No Content".

question_80336.question: What is the maximum allowed time for the UE to identify a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell, provided that it has already been identified?
question_80336.ground_truth: The maximum allowed time is 5120 ms.

question_80337.question: What is the difference between disabling HARQ feedback and enabling it for downlink HARQ processes in the network?
question_80337.ground_truth: Disabling HARQ feedback allows scheduling a HARQ process before one HARQ RTT has elapsed since last scheduled, while enabling HARQ feedback requires waiting for the HARQ RTT before scheduling the next HARQ process.

question_80339.question: What is the composition of the MCPTT application service?
question_80339.ground_truth: The MCPTT application service is composed of an MCPTT server, a floor control server, a media resource function controller, and a media resource function gateway.

question_80341.question: What is required for the PS-PS in conjunction with PS-CS Access Transfer: PS to CS?
question_80341.ground_truth: The flow requires that the user is in an active or inactive IMS originating or terminating session, and the Gm reference point of ICS is used for control of IMS sessions that use CS media.

question_80342.question: What are the preconditions and postconditions for the gsmSSF in the case of cancel(allRequests)?
question_80342.ground_truth: The gsmSSF FSM should be in the "Waiting_for_Instructions" or "Monitoring" state for the preconditions, whereas the postconditions include disarmed EDP and cancelled reports, with the gsmSSF FSM transiting to the "Idle" or remaining in the "Waiting_for_Instructions" state.

question_80343.question: What should the UE do when the RS in spatialRelationInfoPos being accurately measured after suspending the transmission of the SRS for positioning resource?
question_80343.ground_truth: The UE should resume the SRS transmission.

question_80344.question: What is the UE location calculation method for TTFF test cases in general?
question_80344.ground_truth: For every test instance in each TTFF test case, the UE location is randomly selected to be within 3 km of the reference location using a uniform random distribution. The altitude of the UE is randomly selected between 0 m to 500 m above WGS84 reference ellipsoid. The UE locations are calculated as an offset from the reference location.

question_80345.question: What must the S-CSCF verify when it receives a UE-originating request from an unregistered user?
question_80345.ground_truth: The S-CSCF must verify if the public user identity of the served user is barred. If so, it shall respond with a 4xx error code and stop further processing of the request.

question_80346.question: What is the purpose of the AOC-E service procedure in IMS?
question_80346.ground_truth: The AOC-E service procedure in IMS provides a single integer value for the number of recorded AOC information used in the communication.

question_80347.question: What shall the SS do when the MS attempts to perform an IMSI attach onto carrier 1 in step 20.15.4.2?
question_80347.ground_truth: The SS shall reject the IMSI attach request with cause "LA not allowed".

question_80348.question: What is the evaluation precedence index parameter defined for in the mentioned passage?
question_80348.ground_truth: The <evaluation precedence index< parameter is an integer type that defines a relative priority among packet filters when there is more than one packet filter for a specific context in the mentioned passage.

question_80349.question: What is the term used to describe qualities such as low latency, high availability and reliability, large number of users and devices handling, strong security and priority handling in the context of 3GPP?

question_80350.question: What are some key issues to consider in the scenario described, particularly if the backhaul is wired?
question_80350.ground_truth: The key issues include reliability, backhaul capacity, and scalability.

question_80352.question: What are the different ways to associate an NW-TT with a network instance in a 5G System?
question_80352.ground_truth: An NW-TT can be associated with a network instance or with network instance together with DNN/S-NSSAI in the UPF, and the same NW-TT is used for all PDU Sessions in the UPF for the given DNN/S-NSSAI.

question_80353.question: What are the UTRAN Identifiers defined in the UTRAN architecture?
question_80353.ground_truth: UTRAN Identifiers include PLMN Identity, CN Domain Identifier, RNC Identifier, Service Area Identifier, Cell Identifier, Local Cell Identifier, and UE Identifiers (RNTI). Each of these identifiers has a unique role in identifying resources, cells, and user equipment in the UTRAN architecture.

question_80354.question: What are the possible ways a UE can announce itself to other UEs in proximity using ProSe Discovery procedure?
question_80354.ground_truth: A UE can announce itself by groupcasting or broadcasting a Beacon message, including the ProSe Application ID, the Application Layer User ID or ProSe UE ID of the announcing UE, and optional additional parameters.

question_80355.question: What is the KPI for data throughput in the V2X application for coordinated driving manoeuvre at intersections?
question_80355.ground_truth: The KPI for data throughput in the V2X application for coordinated driving manoeuvre at intersections is 10 Mbps.

question_80356.question: What is the role of the MCData server when upgrading an MCData group communication to in-progress emergency state?
question_80356.ground_truth: The MCData server sets the emergency state of the MCData group and adjusts the priority of the underlying bearer for all or selected participants in the MCData group SDS communication that receive the communication over unicast.

question_80358.question: What are the two fundamental energy saving states for a network element?
question_80358.ground_truth: The two fundamental energy saving states for a network element are notEnergySaving state and energySaving state.

question_80359.question: What is the role of the N3IWF, W-AGF or TNGF in the CM-CONNECTED state of the UE?
question_80359.ground_truth: The N3IWF, W-AGF or TNGF provides connectivity for the UE in the CM-CONNECTED state, and if the new AMF and the old AMF are in the same PLMN, the new AMF creates an NGAP UE association towards the N3IWF/TNGF/W-AGF to which the UE is connected, which releases the existing NGAP UE association between the old AMF and the N3IWF/TNGF/W-AGF.

question_80360.question: What are the four phases of the lifecycle of a communication service instance (CSI)?
question_80360.ground_truth: The four phases of a CSI lifecycle are the Preparation phase, the CSI commissioning phase, the CSI operation phase, and the CSI decommissioning phase.

question_80362.question: What should the SCC AS do after receiving a SIP 2xx response for the SIP re-INVITE request sent to the remote UE?
question_80362.ground_truth: The SCC AS sends a SIP ACK request on the remote leg and sends a SIP re-INVITE request to the local UE to remove the media for the transferred media component.

question_80365.question: What are the main challenges associated with the low-latency audio streaming for local conference systems use case?
question_80365.ground_truth: The main challenges associated with the low-latency audio streaming for local conference systems use case include stringent requirements on end-to-end latency, packet error ratio, and communication service availability, as well as clock synchronization between different nodes at the application level.

question_80366.question: What is the main focus of Group 3 solutions in enabling paging reception for multi-USIM devices?
question_80366.ground_truth: Group 3 solutions, such as #7, #8, #12, #24, #26, #27, and #12, aim to deliver MT service notifications in the current system. These solutions may introduce additional NFs in the Core Network and impact system performance regarding cost, complexity, delay, and paging resource wastage.

question_80367.question: What is the role of ALLOCATIONOrRetentionPriority in network management?
question_80367.ground_truth: ALLOCATIONOrRetentionPriority is a SEQUENCE containing various priority level and pre-emption related information, used to control the allocation or retention of resources in a network.

question_80368.question: What should the VAE server do if the authorization is successful when receiving a POST request from the service consumer to create an Individual Application Requirement?
question_80368.ground_truth: The VAE server should create a new resource representing the Individual Application Requirement, interact with the SEAL NRM server for the V2X application requirement, and respond to the service consumer with a 201 Created message, including the URI for the created resource.

question_80369.question: What is the transmission scenario in section 8.3.1.3.1 of the document?
question_80369.ground_truth: The transmission scenario in section 8.3.1.3.1 of the document is a scenario where two transmission points share the same Cell ID and the UE receives DCI format 2D.

question_80370.question: What does the UDM use to map the SUCI to the SUPI and select an authentication method?
question_80370.ground_truth: The UDM uses the "username" part of the SUPI, the "realm" part of the SUPI, the AUN3 device indicator, a combination of the "realm" part and the AUN3 device indicator, or the UDM local policy to map the SUCI to the SUPI and select an authentication method.

question_80371.question: Which AVP indicates the time for the radio resources setup in the E-UTRAN access type?
question_80371.ground_truth: The MBMS-Data-Transfer-Start AVP (AVP code 929) indicates the time for the radio resources setup in the E-UTRAN access type.

question_80372.question: What is the mean UL Average-UPT gain for semi-static SBFD at low load level with a large packet size and 30dBm BS transmission power?

question_80373.question: What is the maximum allowed interruption on a PCell when switching carriers for SRS transmission or non-contention based PRACH?
question_80373.ground_truth: The maximum allowed interruption on a PCell when switching carriers for SRS transmission or non-contention based PRACH is 1 subframe.

question_80376.question: What should the floor control interface do upon receiving a Queued Floor Requests message, including a Queued Floor Requests Purpose field with the Queued Floor Requests Purpose value set to '0' (Cancel Request), from the associated floor participant?
question_80376.ground_truth: If the MCPTT ID of the associated floor participant is an authorized user, the floor control interface shall forward the Queued Floor Requests message to the floor control server arbitration logic, otherwise it shall send a Queued Floor Requests message to the associated floor participant with the Queued Floor Requests Purpose value set to '1' (Cancel Result)

question_80377.question: What is the formula for calculating the value of timer T390 when the access attempt is considered as barred?
question_80377.ground_truth: The formula for calculating the value of timer T390 when the access attempt is considered as barred is T390 = (0.7+ 0.6 * rand) * uac-BarringTime.

question_80379.question: What is the length of the Queued Floor Requests Purpose field, as indicated by the Queued Floor Requests Purpose Length value?
question_80379.ground_truth: The Queued Floor Requests Purpose Length value has a length of 2 octets and indicates the total length of the Queued Floor Requests Purpose value item.

question_80380.question: What should the UE do when the DPCCH quality is estimated to be worse than a threshold Qout in clause 5.4.4B.2?
question_80380.ground_truth: When the UE estimates the DPCCH quality to be worse than a threshold Qout, the UE shall shut its transmitter off within 40 ms.

question_80382.question: What is the difference between Richardson Maturity Model Level 1 and 2 in terms of HTTP verbs used?
question_80382.ground_truth: In Level 1, all operations are conducted through HTTP POST while in Level 2, HTTP GET, PATCH and PUT are used for specific operations.

question_80384.question: What is the effect of setting octet 12 and octet 13 to "11111110" in the Guaranteed bit rate for uplink and downlink?
question_80384.ground_truth: If the sending entity wants to indicate a Guaranteed bit rate for uplink or downlink higher than 8640 kbps, it shall set octet 12 or octet 13 to "11111110", i.e. 8640 kbps, and shall encode the value for the Guaranteed bit rate in octet 18 or octet 16.

question_80385.question: What should the EEC utilize when performing EAS discovery if the AC does not include any optional IEs in the EAS discovery request, and AC registration was performed?
question_80385.ground_truth: The EEC may utilize the AC profile provided by the AC during AC registration when performing EAS discovery if the AC does not include any optional IEs in the EAS discovery request.

question_80386.question: What is the typical CMR value for the downlink direction in the TRAU?
question_80386.ground_truth: The typical CMR value for the downlink direction in the TRAU is "1.1.1".

question_80387.question: How many separate URR IDs does the MAR contain per FAR?
question_80387.ground_truth: The MAR contains pointers to QER per FAR, which allows for separate usage reporting per access.

question_80388.question: What is the impact of high EVM in the Rx filter on the system?
question_80388.ground_truth: High EVM in the Rx filter results in increased Inter Symbol Interference and decreased receiver sensitivity performance for those 5 MHz channels at the band edges.

question_80389.question: What is the purpose of the MGW-id provided to the succeeding node in the IAM in CFNRy call forwarding?
question_80389.ground_truth: The MGW-id is provided to the succeeding node in the IAM, to indicate the Media Gateway (MGW) that will be used for the waiting call in CFNRy call forwarding.

question_80391.question: What level of frequency isolation is feasible for a base station by the Nokia example?
question_80391.ground_truth: The feasible level of frequency isolation for a base station is 45 dB, which is in line with the 45 dB ACLR requirement.

question_80395.question: What is the focus of 3GPP's Fault Management standardization objectives?
question_80395.ground_truth: The focus of 3GPP's Fault Management standardization objectives is to detect failures as soon as they occur and to limit their effects on the network Quality of Service (QoS) as far as possible.

question_80396.question: What should the UE do upon receiving an ATTACH REJECT message with EMM cause #25 or #78 that was received without integrity protection?
question_80396.ground_truth: The UE should discard the message.

question_80397.question: What is the difference between an SM-MO and an SM-MT short message?
question_80397.ground_truth: An SM-MO short message is sent from a mobile station to a service center, while an SM-MT short message is sent from a service center to a mobile station.

question_80398.question: What is the mode of operation of the network when the MS is powered on?
question_80398.ground_truth: Network Mode of Operation is set to NMO II.

question_80400.question: How is a UPF selected for a particular PDU Session in the 5G Core network?
question_80400.ground_truth: After the SMF Provisioning of available UPFs, the SMF selects an UPF for a particular PDU Session. The SMF then initiates N4 session management procedures for the selected UPF, as defined in clause 4.4.1 of TS 23.502.

question_80401.question: What is the frequency offset and amplitude of the unwanted signal when interfering with the wanted signal in 16-QAM modulation?
question_80401.ground_truth: The unwanted signal is transmitted at a nominal frequency 200 kHz above or below the nominal frequency of the wanted signal with an amplitude set to achieve an adjacent interference ratio 1dB above that specified in the conformance requirements.

question_80404.question: What should the ME do with the GPRS UMTS ciphering key and GPRS UMTS integrity key when switching from S1 mode to Iu mode or A/Gb mode?
question_80404.ground_truth: The ME should handle the GPRS UMTS ciphering key, the GPRS UMTS integrity key, the GPRS GSM ciphering key, and a potential GPRS GSM Kc128 depending on the current EPS security context or the UMTS security context for the PS domain stored in the MS and the network.

question_80405.question: What is the expected sequence when the mobile station receives an unknown message in the state U1?
question_80405.ground_truth: The expected sequence when the mobile station receives an unknown message in the state U1 is for the mobile station to return a STATUS message and remain in the U1 state.

question_80406.question: What is the role of the Mns Producer in the solution 6.3.3 volume control by CCS based on performance collection?
question_80406.ground_truth: The Mns Producer is responsible for collecting volume from UPFs, aggregating per S-NSsAI, and notifying on volume thresholds triggers supplied by CCS during the mechanism.

question_80407.question: What message is sent by the source UE in the Layer-2 based UE-to-UE Relay re-selection procedure to request the re-selection of the new UE-to-UE Relay?
question_80407.ground_truth: A Link Modification Request message is sent by the source UE in the Layer-2 based UE-to-UE Relay re-selection procedure to request the re-selection of the new UE-to-UE Relay.

question_80408.question: What is the issue when the path taken by the signal does not match the expected path?

question_80409.question: What is the main procedure followed in 6.4.3.1 for user plane relocation during the service request procedure?
question_80409.ground_truth: The procedure involves the SGW CP function determining a better SGW UP function for the UE, allocating user plane session resources in the new SGW UP function, sending new SGW UP F-TEIDs to the MME, and providing new F-TEIDs of the SGW to the eNB using existing S1AP message E-RAB Modify Request.

question_80411.question: How many alternatives are considered for the evaluations of the cubic metric, and what is the implication of each alternative?
question_80411.ground_truth: Two alternatives are considered for the evaluations of the cubic metric. Alternative 1 assumes each stream is transmitted from an individual physical antenna, while alternative 2 assumes each stream is pre-coded with a vector such that each stream is transmitted from both physical antennas.

question_80412.question: What information is the CSeq header of a BYE request set to if no CSeq value was stored for that session?
question_80412.ground_truth: The CSeq header of a BYE request is set to a random number within the valid range for CSeqs if no CSeq value was stored for that session.

question_80413.question: What is the maximum number of warning messages that a UE can re-assemble simultaneously, as per the given text?
question_80413.ground_truth: The maximum number of warning messages that a UE can re-assemble simultaneously is a function of UE implementation.

question_80414.question: What are the benefits of using a UE Capability ID and a delta set in the network-controlled capabilities sending and UE Capability ID allocation solution?
question_80414.ground_truth: Using a UE Capability ID and a delta set in this solution allows for more efficient signalling of UE Radio Capabilities, as the full set of UE Radio Capabilities does not need to be sent every time. It also allows for the coexistence of different UE Radio Capabilities within the same UE.

question_80416.question: What is the main cause of clipping in digital networks?
question_80416.ground_truth: The main cause of clipping is voice switching controlled by voice activity detection.

question_80417.question: What is a hybrid ESM solution and how does it differ from centralized and distributed solutions?
question_80417.ground_truth: A hybrid ESM solution combines both centralized and distributed solutions by having decision-making for energy saving actions done by both OAM system and NE. The OAM system and NE execute energy saving related measurements separately, and the decision to trigger energy saving actions is made at OAM system or NE level, with the trigger condition being combined information from both parties. The final executor of energy saving actions is still the NE.

question_80420.question: What is the function of the MBMS RAB Release procedure?
question_80420.ground_truth: The MBMS RAB Release procedure is used to enable the UTRAN to request the release of an MBMS RAB. The MBMS RAB is defined for the PS domain only.

question_80421.question: What is the power level measured at for the modulation sidebands of the carrier frequency in step f)?
question_80421.ground_truth: The power level is measured at FT + 200 kHz * N and FT - 200 kHz * N, where N = 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, and 8 in step f).

question_80423.question: What action must the SMF take when receiving the rejection of the QoS flow creation or modification from the network?
question_80423.ground_truth: The SMF must report the enforcement error of the PCC rule to the PCF if the time zone was requested by the PCF and the SMF received the rejection of the QoS flow creation or modification.

question_80424.question: What further enables the ProSe Function to verify the authorization of the announcing UE to announce the ProSe App Code at that time instance, in addition to protecting the messages in open discovery?
question_80424.ground_truth: Integrity protection via Message Integrity Check (MIC) that uses UTC-based counter associated with the discovery slot further enables the ProSe Function to verify the authorization of the announcing UE.

question_80425.question: What is the basic concept of the FEC system used in commercial XR split rendering and cloud gaming services?
question_80425.ground_truth: The basic concept is to add Application Data Units (ADUs) to a source block that then generates packets of basically equal size to distribute the content. Each ADU is assigned a size F and additional properties, and forms a source block with K encoding symbols. The source block is then divided into K source packets and N-K repair packets, which are sent as part of the same ADU.

question_80427.question: What is the use of the Random Number, Signed Response, and Ciphering Key triplet vector?
question_80427.ground_truth: The Random Number, Signed Response, and Ciphering Key triplet vector is used for authentication and encryption in I-WLAN. It is calculated in the 2G AuC for SIM-based users and derived from quintuplet vectors in the 3G HLR/HSS for USIM-based users.

question_80428.question: What is the purpose of the UTRA carriers adjusting their transmission power to the UE's PMAX level?
question_80428.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure that the UE's transmission power reaches the PMAX level within at least 200 ms of the first TPC command in this step.

question_80429.question: Which ID has a criticality value of "ignore" and a presence indicator of "optional" in the MBMSSessionStartResponse-IEs?
question_80429.ground_truth: id-CriticalityDiagnostics has a criticality value of "ignore" and a presence indicator of "optional" in the MBMSSessionStartResponse-IEs.

question_80430.question: What regulatory mechanism is used to ensure the forwards and backwards compatibility of the protocol in SLmAP?
question_80430.ground_truth: The mechanism used is the inclusion of ID and criticality fields in messages and information elements (IEs) that are coded in a standard format that will not be changed in the future.

question_80431.question: What is the modulated interferer bandwidth for FR2 in the general receiver intermodulation requirements?
question_80431.ground_truth: The modulated interferer bandwidth for FR2 in the general receiver intermodulation requirements is 50 MHz.

question_80433.question: What should the AMF do if the UE has triggered the registration procedure for mobility registration update for non-3GPP access path switching from the old non-3GPP access to the new non-3GPP access and the UE receives the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message over the new non-3GPP access?
question_80433.ground_truth: The UE should consider itself as de-registered for 5GS services over the old non-3GPP access.

question_80435.question: What happens to active PDP contexts when the attachment state changes to detached?
question_80435.ground_truth: Any active PDP contexts will be automatically deactivated when the attachment state changes to detached.

question_80437.question: What provides the number of successful data record creations at the UDR?
question_80437.ground_truth: 5.13.1.2.2 provides the number of successful data record creations at the UDR.

question_80438.question: What is the purpose of the File Repair Procedure in MBMS?
question_80438.ground_truth: The File Repair Procedure in MBMS is designed to repair lost or corrupted file fragments from the MBMS download data transmission.

question_80439.question: What should be the delay requirement for Event A3 triggered measurement report in the test described in section 16.6.2.10.4?
question_80439.ground_truth: The UE (User Equipment) shall send one Event A3 triggered measurement report, with a measurement reporting delay less than 1280 ms from the beginning of time period T2, in the test described in section 16.6.2.10.4.

question_80440.question: What is the purpose of the Monitoring UE in the 5G ProSe restricted discovery?
question_80440.ground_truth: The Monitoring UE sends a Discovery Request message containing the ProSe Application ID to the DDNMF in its HPLMN to get the parameters for monitoring. Based on the Discovery Filter, it listens for a discovery message that satisfies its filter.

question_80441.question: When is the TCP management function used in the UTRAN-CN interface?
question_80441.ground_truth: The TCP management function is used to establish and release TCP connections between the CN and UTRAN over Iu-BC.

question_80443.question: What is the purpose of verifying that the preferred sub-bands can be used for frequency-selective scheduling under frequency-selective fading conditions?
question_80443.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure that the reported sub-band channel CQI (Channel Quality Indicator) can accurately represent the channel conditions, which can help improve the efficiency of frequency-selective scheduling.

question_80444.question: What nodes are impacted by Solution 2.5 for Key Issue 2 - making the UE aware of 3GPP PS Data exempt services?
question_80444.ground_truth: The UE, MME, S-GW, P-GW, P-CSCF and HSS are impacted by Solution 2.5 for Key Issue 2 - making the UE aware of 3GPP PS Data exempt services.

question_80445.question: What message is sent by the MN to initiate the Secondary Node Release procedure in case of MN initiated SN Release?

question_80446.question: What keys are used to protect media and floor control messages in an on-network private call in MCPTT sessions?
question_80446.ground_truth: The PCK and the PCK-ID protect media and floor control messages sent between the MCPTT client and the participating MCPTT function serving the MCPTT client in an on-network private call in MCPTT sessions.

question_80447.question: What is one possible mechanism to resolve the problem of TAS not being able to distinguish the real release cause from the response SIP message?
question_80447.ground_truth: ICCF checks the call session's state and then converts SIP 480 to the correct SIP response.

question_80448.question: What is a "Cache-Control" header in HTTP responses, and what should be its value?
question_80448.ground_truth: The "Cache-Control" header in HTTP responses indicates the amount of time in seconds after which the received response is considered stale. Its value should be a "max-age" value.

question_80449.question: What is the method for determining user location information at the SCC AS?
question_80449.ground_truth: The method for determining user location information at the SCC AS is implementation dependent.

question_80450.question: What are the different scenarios of devices in the Internet-of-Things?
question_80450.ground_truth: Some devices are always connected and are not very mobile, reachable and have permanent IP addresses. Some devices are always connected but mobile, reachable, but have dynamic IP addresses. Some devices are connected via a gateway, reachable, but addressed via their gateway. Some devices are not always connected, reachable via a virtual representation in the network (e.g. an API on a network server through which the latest measurements from the sensor are available). Sometimes a device may reach another device via direct radio communication or ad-hoc networking.

question_80452.question: What should the terminating UE do during session initiation if local resource reservation is required and the precondition mechanism is enabled?
question_80452.ground_truth: The terminating UE should use the precondition mechanism and include a Require header field with the "precondition" option-tag in relevant responses and requests.

question_80454.question: What is the role of the M2 interface in E-UTRAN?
question_80454.ground_truth: The M2 interface is a logical interface between the eNB and the MCE in E-UTRAN, used for transporting M2-AP signalling messages.

question_80456.question: What happens if the ProtocolType leaf is not supported by the UE in a flow distribution rule?
question_80456.ground_truth: The UE ignores the IPFlow instance if the ProtocolType leaf is not supported by the UE.

question_80457.question: What is the maximum number of service instances that can exist per client application?
question_80457.ground_truth: There must be only one service instance per client application. Therefore, in case the client attempts to select a service for which it has already signed a service agreement and this service agreement has not been terminated, a reference to the already existing service manager will be returned.

question_80458.question: What is the definition of an "Active Antenna System (AAS) Base Station (BS)" as provided in the document?
question_80458.ground_truth: An "Active Antenna System (AAS) Base Station (BS)" is defined as a base station system that combines an Antenna Array with an Active transceiver unit array and a Radio Distribution Network.

question_80460.question: What are the supported states for a Network Slice Instance?
question_80460.ground_truth: A Network Slice Instance supports Inactive (identifier exists and ready to be activated) and Active (identifier exists and associated NSSIs are active) states.

question_80462.question: What functionality is used in Rel-15 for determining an appropriate set of S-NSSAI for the Allowed NSSAI in order to support MEANS?
question_80462.ground_truth: The NSSF/AMF functionality in Rel-15 is used for determining an appropriate set of S-NSSAI for the Allowed NSSAI in order to support MEANS.

question_80463.question: What is the requirement for the BS when transmitting 3 DL CA of Band (1 + 18 + 28) to prevent receiver desensitization for Band 43?
question_80463.ground_truth: The BS transmitter should not share the same antenna with Band 43 BS receiver unless the antenna path meets very stringent 3rd order PIM specification to prevent receiver desensitization.

question_80465.question: What is the function of TpFwID in the OSA Service Capability Feature?
question_80465.ground_truth: TpFwID is used to identify the Framework in the OSA Service Capability Feature.

question_80466.question: How is the LOS channel coefficient determined in the LOS case?
question_80466.ground_truth: The LOS channel coefficient is determined by equation (7.5-29), which includes the field patterns of receive and transmit antenna elements, the Dirac's delta function, and the 3D distance between the transmitter and receiver.

question_80469.question: What is the impact of introducing semi-persistent scheduling in downlink?
question_80469.ground_truth: By introducing semi-persistent scheduling in downlink, it can reduce the control channel overhead and increase the VoIP capacity, as the HS-SCCH is no longer required for HS-DSCH transmissions after the first transmission. The Node B can assign and re-assign the UE's semi-persistent resource for downlink transmission.

question_80470.question: What is the role of the NWDAF containing AnLF during the discovery of NWDAF containing MTLF as FL client?
question_80470.ground_truth: During the discovery of NWDAF containing MTLF as FL client, a consumer (e.g. an FL server) includes in the request FL capability type as FL client, Time Period of Interest, a list of NF type(s). The NRF returns one or more candidate instances of NWDAF containing MTLF as FL client to the consumer. The NWDAF containing AnLF can act as an FL server for the ML model training.

question_80472.question: How is the updated policy exposed to the 3rd party?
question_80472.ground_truth: The updated policy could be exposed to the 3rd party through a notification system or appropriate interface between the network and the 3rd party.

question_80474.question: What is the term used in the present document to describe the version number string of the IRP document?

question_80477.question: What happens in step 13 of the Edge Enabler Client triggered application context relocation solution?
question_80477.ground_truth: Upon receiving the Context relocation response, the Edge Enabler Client reroutes the UE application data traffic.

question_80478.question: What action should an SGSN take if it receives a combined routing area update request from an MS and detects that the VLR serving the MS is no longer in service?
question_80478.ground_truth: The SGSN may select an alternative VLR that is in service for the MS and immediately perform the location update for non-GPRS services procedure towards the selected VLR.

question_80479.question: What action should the MS take if it receives a GA-PSR TC activation message from the GANC while the GA-PSR TC is active?
question_80479.ground_truth: The MS should send the GA-PSR-ACTIVATE-UTC-ACK message to the GANC including the MS UDP port allocated to the existing GA-PSR TC. In parallel, if the GANC provided new IP Address and UDP port number, the MS should update the GA-PSR TC attributes accordingly.

question_80481.question: What type of information is specified in the "tLocalServiceType" element?
question_80481.ground_truth: The "tLocalServiceType" element specifies information about local services.

question_80483.question: What type of IP address is allocated to the UE during the mobile originating packet switched sessions procedure if it supports IPv4/IPv6 or IPv6?
question_80483.ground_truth: A full IPv6 address is allocated to the UE via NAS signalling in the PDP CONTEXT ACCEPT message.

question_80485.question: What action will the V-PCRF take when it is handling the AF signalling session locally with the V-AF and is notified of the loss or release of resources associated with the PCC Rules corresponding to V-AF Signalling IP Flows?
question_80485.ground_truth: The V-PCRF will inform the V-AF about the Loss of the Signalling Transmission Path by sending a Re-Authorization Request (RAR) command to the V-AF.

question_80486.question: What should the Node B do if the UE Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate IE is included in the RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST message?
question_80486.ground_truth: The Node B should store the UE Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate parameters if supported, to control the aggregate data rate of non-GBR traffic for this UE.

question_80487.question: What is the namespace and MIME type signalling for Rel-9 Adaptive HTTP Streaming in the MPD?
question_80487.ground_truth: The namespace is "urn:3GPP:ns:PSS:AdaptiveHTTPStreamingMPD:2009" and the MIME type signalling is "application/3gpp-ahs+xml".

question_80489.question: What is an example of a broadcast signalling event that can cause overload in the 5GC service based interfaces?
question_80489.ground_truth: Large number of UEs generating application layer broadcasts which results in signalling flood towards each member of that application layer broadcast domain.

question_80491.question: What is the function of EES (OP-A) in the edge node sharing scenario?
question_80491.ground_truth: EES (OP-A) registers EAS on its EES, and also registers itself on ECS (OP-A) via EDGE-6 reference point.

question_80492.question: What information does the Service-Route header in SIP point to in the home network?
question_80492.ground_truth: The Service-Route header in SIP points to the S-CSCF (Serving Call Session Control Function) which is always located in the home network.

question_80494.question: How does the performance change when multiple Tx beams are used and the Rx beam is parallel to the track?
question_80494.ground_truth: Adding more Tx beams when only one Rx beam parallel to the track is used does not provide significant gain. However, if the Rx beam is oriented more towards the RRH, the received signal power can be significantly increased in the areas next to the RRH.

question_80498.question: What is the action that the SS shall take after receiving a MeasurementReport message in step 6?)
question_80498.ground_truth: The SS shall transmit an RRCRelease message to release the RRC connection which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources.

question_80499.question: What is the potential impact of CUPS on the E-UTRAN?
question_80499.ground_truth: The potential impact of CUPS on the E-UTRAN includes affect on performance measurements of the EPC network and may cause changes in the EPC NRM IRP.

question_80500.question: What is the DLMC Bandwidth for the GSM 700 and GSM 850 networks?
question_80500.ground_truth: The DLMC Bandwidth for the GSM 700 is 5MHz and for the GSM 850 is 5MHz low band.

question_80502.question: What should the UE do when it receives a CANCEL request for a forked MT voice call and has received INVITE for voice call and has proceeded the call initiation until before accepting the voice call?
question_80502.ground_truth: The UE should send 200 OK for CANCEL and 487 Request Terminated for INVITE.

question_80503.question: What procedure for additional authentication and authorization with an external AAA Server is not expected during the IKE tunnel establishment procedure?
question_80503.ground_truth: The procedure for additional authentication and authorization with an external AAA Server as specified in RFC 4739 and TS 33.402 is not expected during the IKE tunnel establishment procedure.

question_80504.question: When does a Multi-Access PDU Session use user-plane resources of an associated PDN Connection in EPC?
question_80504.ground_truth: A Multi-Access PDU Session may use user-plane resources of an associated PDN Connection in EPC when the UE has not indicated support for Ethernet PDN connection type or if the network does not support Ethernet PDN connection type.

question_80505.question: What parameter in BSSMAP-LE CONNECTION ORIENTED INFORMATION message identifies the specific Multilateration positioning method that has been triggered by the SMLC?
question_80505.ground_truth: The Multilateration Positioning Method parameter in the BSSMAP-LE CONNECTION ORIENTED INFORMATION message identifies the specific Multilateration positioning method that has been triggered by the SMLC.

question_80506.question: What is the role of the HLR in USSD operations?
question_80506.ground_truth: The HLR, in USSD operations, examines the alphabet and contents of the message, and takes appropriate actions based on the format of the message. If it does not support the alphabet indicated, it informs the UE.

question_80508.question: What should the MCData client include in the Supported header field of the SIP REFER request?
question_80508.ground_truth: The MCData client should include the option tag "norefersub" in the Supported header field of the SIP REFER request.

question_80509.question: What should be done when the candidate expiration interval is zero and the current time is outside the expiration time of the MCPTT group information entry?
question_80509.ground_truth: The MCPTT group information entry should be copied into a new MCPTT group information entry of the candidate list of the MCPTT group information entries, with the affiliation status set to "de-affiliating" and the expiration time to some time in the future.

question_80511.question: What is the purpose of the Auth-Session-State AVP between the 3GPP AAA server and the HSS in 3GPP WLAN Wx reference point?
question_80511.ground_truth: The Auth-Session-State AVP is used between the 3GPP AAA server and the HSS to indicate implicitly terminated sessions, where the client does not need to send re-authorization or session termination requests to the server.

question_80512.question: In the scenario where the mobile station supports Reduced Latency, what is the purpose of the third step in the test procedure for each test case?
question_80512.ground_truth: The third step in the test procedure for each test case is where the SS verifies that the mobile station inserts a PAN field in the subsequently received uplink data block that indicates non-receipt of the downlink data blocks implied by the out of sequence BSNs.

question_80515.question: What is the purpose of the PLMN List-2 and PLMN List-3 in the context of accessing a PLMN over trusted non-3GPP access?
question_80515.ground_truth: The PLMN List-2 and PLMN List-3 are used to determine if a WLAN has "trusted connectivity" to a given PLMN. If the PLMN is not included in either of these lists, then the WLAN can only support connectivity to an ePDG or N3IWF in the PLMN (i.e. "untrusted connectivity").

question_80517.question: What is the key point to be considered by the overload mechanism regarding charging sessions?
question_80517.ground_truth: The key point is that a server for charging applications may have multiple clients in parallel (several Rf instances from CDF and several Ro instances from OCS), and an overload may be caused by a subset of active charging sessions. The overload mechanism should allow targeting the appropriate charging session(s) so the accurate behavior can take place on the client side.

question_80518.question: What message does the target Serving GW send to the target MME after allocating its local resources?

question_80519.question: When is the de-registration procedure with appropriate de-registration type invoked by the network?
question_80519.ground_truth: The de-registration procedure with appropriate de-registration type is invoked by the network if the network informs the UE to re-register to the network.

question_80521.question: What information does the H(e)NB return when the IP address is requested?
question_80521.ground_truth: The H(e)NB returns the IP address reported to H(e)MS and/or HNB-GW for location verification. If no such IP address is available, the H(e)NB returns a "ME currently not able to process command - no service" message.

question_80522.question: What is the purpose of periodic drive tests in a network?
question_80522.ground_truth: The purpose of periodic drive tests is to update the operator's understanding of the coverage levels provided in their networks, detect changes due to new constructions, and identify areas for improvement.

question_80523.question: What message does the UE send back to the ProSe Function after removing the Discovery Filter from the ProSe Discovery services operation?
question_80523.ground_truth: The UE sends back a Discovery Update Ack (Result, Discovery Entry ID) message to confirm the revocation operation.

question_80524.question: What is sent by MCPTT server 1 to MCPTT client 1 in step 10 if automatic commencement mode is not used?

question_80526.question: What is the purpose of using security procedures for Restricted 5G ProSe Direct Discovery in Solution #5?
question_80526.ground_truth: The purpose is to provide confidentiality protection of the discovery messages to ensure the privacy of the UAV/UAV-C when dynamic discovery is used between UAV and UAV-C equipped with a UE.

question_80529.question: What is the maximum RF BW without IM3 in the own receive band for higher order PIM products (5th, 7th, and 9th order)?
question_80529.ground_truth: The maximum RF BW without IM3 in the own receive band is equal to the UL-DL separation divided by 3, 4, and 5 for 5th, 7th, and 9th order PIM products, respectively.

question_80530.question: What field is present in an AMD PDU header only when the Data field consists of an RLC SDU segment which is not the first segment?

question_80531.question: What is the main challenge when using the 3GPP system to access pre-encoded videos from Internet services?
question_80531.ground_truth: The main challenge is that the 3GPP system needs to take care of the appropriate delivery quality and the delivered bit rate since external networks do not consider the special needs of the 3GPP system.

question_80532.question: What mechanism is used for authentication and key agreement between MME and UE in SA3?
question_80532.ground_truth: The UMTS AKA mechanism is used for authentication and key agreement between MME and UE in SA3.

question_80533.question: How should user service announcements over point-to-point push bearers be transmitted to the MBMS terminal?
question_80533.ground_truth: User service announcements over point-to-point push bearers can either be transmitted by embedding the metadata fragment within the metadata envelope or by referencing the metadata fragment in a multipart MIME container. The metadata envelope and fragments are transported together and in-band of the same transport session.

question_80534.question: In the Operator Centric scenario, when will there be CS/PS uncoordinated users?
