question_80534.ground_truth: There will be CS/PS uncoordinated users when there are uncoordinated NRIs in the CS and PS domains, and these users will stay uncoordinated until the next pool change.

question_80536.question: When is the primary authentication considered successful and the new KAUSF stored as the latest KAUSF in 5G?
question_80536.ground_truth: The primary authentication is considered successful and the new KAUSF stored as the latest KAUSF in 5G when the UE receives a valid NAS Security Mode Command message from the AMF during the authenticated procedure.

question_80538.question: What is the recommended port number to use for sending and receiving RTP packets for a given RTP based media stream?
question_80538.ground_truth: For a given RTP based media stream, the recommended port number to use for sending and receiving RTP packets is the same port number.

question_80540.question: What is the impact of starting a separate TCP connection establishment on the user plane connection when e2e security is applied at the corresponding call leg?
question_80540.ground_truth: It may speed up the establishment of the user plane connection.

question_80541.question: What should the SMF do if it receives a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message with request type set to "existing PDU session" or "existing emergency PDU session", and it does not have any information about that PDU session?
question_80541.ground_truth: The SMF should reject the PDU session establishment procedure with the 5GSM cause set to #54 "PDU session does not exist" in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message.

question_80542.question: What is the requirement for inter frequency CPICH measurements when the UE does not require measurement occasions and idle intervals to perform inter-frequency FDD measurements?
question_80542.ground_truth: If the UE does not require measurement occasions and idle intervals to perform inter-frequency FDD measurements, the measurement period for inter frequency CPICH measurements shall be 480 ms.

question_80543.question: In LTE-A, what needs to be considered for transmit intermodulation performance?
question_80543.ground_truth: Intermodulation performance can be challenging and may need to be defined in terms per RB allocation, per CC carrier, or all CC.

question_80544.question: What is the difference between the first and second digits in the version number of the document?
question_80544.ground_truth: The first digit represents the level of approval of the document by the TSG, and the second digit indicates technical enhancements, corrections, updates, etc.

question_80546.question: What is the difference between a 5G System and a 5G Virtual Network (5G VN)?
question_80546.ground_truth: A 5G System refers to the overall architecture and components of the 5G network, while a 5G Virtual Network (5G VN) is a set of network resources and services that are isolated from the rest of the network, allowing for customized services and control.

question_80548.question: What are the three parts of the Iu UP PDU Type 14 format for procedure sending?
question_80548.ground_truth: The Iu UP PDU Type 14 is made up of the Iu UP Frame Control part (fixed size), the Iu UP Frame Check Sum part (fixed size), and the Iu UP Frame Payload part (variable length, rounded up to octet).

question_80549.question: Which HTTP method is specified for the "Data Management and/or Status Information Notification" in SEALDD?
question_80549.ground_truth: The HTTP method specified for the "Data Management and/or Status Information Notification" in SEALDD is POST.

question_80551.question: Under what conditions can the transmitter unit(s) associated with the RIB under test be turned off for the out-of-band blocker tests?
question_80551.ground_truth: The transmitter unit(s) associated with the RIB under test can be turned off for the out-of-band blocker tests when the frequency of the blocker is such that no IM2 or IM3 products fall inside the bandwidth of the wanted signal.

question_80552.question: In Solution 4.4, what is the method for sending the 3GPP PS Data Off status from the MME to the HSS?
question_80552.ground_truth: The MME sends the 3GPP PS Data Off status to the HSS using the Location Update or Notify procedure.

question_80554.question: In which field is id-MIMO-N-M-Ratio used?
question_80554.ground_truth: Used in the HSSDCH Physical Layer

question_80555.question: What is the name of the procedure that stops an announcement and may also be stopped by releasing the IMS termination?

question_80557.question: What must the MCPTT server check when receiving a de-affiliation request from an MCPTT user?
question_80557.ground_truth: The MCPTT server must check if the user is authorized to de-affiliate to the requested MCPTT group(s) and if the user has affiliated to the requested MCPTT group(s).

question_80558.question: What is the function of the MCData group standalone FD request in the MCData group?
question_80558.ground_truth: The MCData group standalone FD request contains the conversation identifier for message thread indication, and may include additional implementation-specific information and a mandatory download indication.

question_80559.question: What must the MCVideo client include in the SIP INVITE request's application/vnd.3gpp.mcvideo-info+xml MIME body's <mcvideo-Params> element in a prearranged session-type for the MCVideo on-demand call?
question_80559.ground_truth: The <session-type> must be set to "prearranged", the <mcvideo-request-uri> must be set to the group identity, and the <mcvideo-client-id> must be set to the MCVideo client ID of the originating MCVideo client.

question_80560.question: What is the difference between online and offline charging in 3GPP TSs?
question_80560.ground_truth: Online charging is a charging mechanism where charging information can affect, in real-time, the service rendered and requires a direct interaction of the charging mechanism with bearer/session/service control. Offline charging, on the other hand, collects information related to a chargeable event and stores it as a Charging Data Record (CDR) for later processing.

question_80561.question: When a downlink control block encoded using MCS-0 occurs in the first two TDMA frames of a given basic radio block period, in what radio block period should the mobile station transmit uplink data blocks if it receives the assigned USF in the second reduced radio block period of a given basic radio block period?
question_80561.ground_truth: The mobile station should transmit uplink data blocks in the first reduced radio block period starting in the next basic radio block period and continuing with the first reduced radio block period in the following basic radio block periods.

question_80562.question: What should the MAC entity do if the MSGA transmission is for the CCCH logical channel and it's the first MSGA transmission within this Random Access procedure?
question_80562.ground_truth: The MAC entity should indicate to the Multiplexing and assembly entity to include a C-RNTI MAC CE in the subsequent uplink transmission.

question_80563.question: Which section of TS 24.379 specifies the requirements for a UE (MCPTT Client) to store specific information upon receiving a GROUP CALL ANNOUNCEMENT message for an ongoing call in another state machine?

question_80564.question: What is the maximum time allowed for the mobile station to receive a CC-ESTABLISHMENT message before initiating clearing procedures towards the network?
question_80564.ground_truth: If no CC-ESTABLISHMENT message is received by the call control entity of the mobile station before the expiry of timer T332, then the mobile station shall initiate clearing procedures towards the network using a RELEASE COMPLETE message.

question_80566.question: What happens if the request processing failed when sending an AS registration response?
question_80566.ground_truth: If the request processing failed, the PEMC or PIN Server indicates failure and may provide a failure reason.

question_80567.question: What message is sent by the NEF to the AF upon successful creation of a new "Individual application AM Context" resource?
question_80567.ground_truth: The NEF sends an HTTP "201 Created" response with the AppAmContextExpRespData data structure and a Location header field containing the URI of the created resource to the AF.

question_80568.question: What must the UE do when it loses the IP address of the N5CW device when accessing 5GC via the TWIF?
question_80568.ground_truth: The UE shall initiate the UE-requested PDU session release procedure.

question_80569.question: How many test frequencies can a band have for NR sidelink operations with up to three test frequencies?
question_80569.ground_truth: A band can have up to three test frequencies for NR sidelink operations with up to three test frequencies.

question_80571.question: What is the action that the Serving GW takes to assist the reordering function in the target eNodeB when the Serving GW is relocated and the PDN GW switches the path?
question_80571.ground_truth: The Serving GW sends one or more "end marker" packets on the old path immediately after switching the path to assist the reordering function in the target eNodeB. The source Serving GW forwards the "end marker" packets to the source eNodeB.

question_80575.question: What is the relative limit for the maximum Mean Power of a MR MSR BS's transmitted signal?
question_80575.ground_truth: The relative limit for the maximum Mean Power of a MR MSR BS's transmitted signal is a general value, and the specific absolute limit depends on the BS class.

question_80576.question: What should the UE do if it exceeds certain measurement thresholds (Mm,max, Md,max, or Me,max) while monitoring a cell?
question_80576.ground_truth: The UE should restart measurements if it exceeds Mm,max, Md,max, or Me,max while monitoring a cell.

question_80577.question: What is the role of the CHF in the solution?
question_80577.ground_truth: The I-SMF reports usage to the A-SMF through the Nchf interface, and there is no change to this interface.

question_80578.question: What is the input S to the KDF in the derivation of P-TID process?
question_80578.ground_truth: The input S to the KDF in the derivation of P-TID includes FC, P0, L0, P1, and L1, where FC, P0, L0, and L1 are predefined values, and P1 is the relay service code.

question_80579.question: What note is associated with Step 5 in the Inter-SGSN Routing Area Update process?
question_80579.ground_truth: The optional Steps 5 and 6 apply if the NAS container IE includes a "Reset without old XID parameters."

question_80580.question: When are the route selection descriptors of the URSP rule evaluated in the UE's connection to non-3GPP access?
question_80580.ground_truth: The route selection descriptors of the URSP rule are evaluated in the UE's connection to non-3GPP access after the URSP rules, except the default URSP rule, have been evaluated with a traffic descriptor that matches the application information or the PIN information in increasing order of their precedence values.

question_80581.question: What is the difference between the two options the mobile station has to signal an uplink request in the voice group call with A-interface link sharing?
question_80581.ground_truth: If the priority uplink access parameter indicates "RACH access", then the mobile station sends an uplink access message on the RACH. If the priority uplink access parameter indicates "group call channel uplink access", then the mobile station always sends an uplink access message on the group call channel uplink.

question_80582.question: What are the three transport modes that can be used for transmitting a UDP flow between UE and UPF in the MPQUIC steering functionality?
question_80582.ground_truth: The three transport modes are Datagram mode 2, Datagram mode 1, and Stream mode.

question_80584.question: What is the expected sequence of messages for the outgoing call test in 26.8.1.2.1.1.1?
question_80584.ground_truth: The expected sequence of messages for the outgoing call test in 26.8.1.2.1.1.1 is as follows: CM SERVICE REQUEST message with a CM service type of "Mobile originating call establishment or packet mode connection establishment" sent by the MS and CM SERVICE ACCEPT message sent by the serving SS as a response.

question_80585.question: What is the purpose of generating a SIP 200 (OK) response when the MCData client receives a "SIP MESSAGE request for standalone SDS for terminating MCData client"?
question_80585.ground_truth: The purpose of generating a SIP 200 (OK) response is to indicate a successful reception of SIP MESSAGE request.

question_80586.question: What is the definition of initial registration in the context of this procedure?
question_80586.ground_truth: The UE sending an unprotected REGISTER request and, if challenged, sending the integrity-protected REGISTER request or other appropriate response to the challenge, to register to IMS services.

question_80588.question: What is the role of the Xib reference point in the S8HR LI solution?
question_80588.ground_truth: The Xib reference point is used to exchange control plane information between the LMISF and the S-GW/BBIFF. It is used for the LMISF to provide S8HR APN information, instruct the S-GW/BBIFF to notify of bearer creation, modification, or deletion, and receive target identity information from the ADMF.

question_80589.question: In which subframes should a UE not receive NPDSCH assigned by NPDCCH with DCI CRC scrambled by G-RNTI?
question_80589.ground_truth: A UE is not required to receive NPDSCH assigned by NPDCCH with DCI CRC scrambled by G-RNTI in subframes in which the UE monitors a Type1A-NPDCCH common search space or in subframes in which the UE receives NPDSCH assigned by NPDCCH with DCI CRC scrambled by SC-RNTI.

question_80590.question: How does the UE-to-network relay generate KD?
question_80590.ground_truth: The UE-to-network relay generates KD by using the PKMF-retrieved PRUK, a KD Freshness Parameter (a locally generated random number), a nonce sent by the Remote UE, and the Relay Service Code the Remote UE wishes to access.

question_80591.question: What should be the level of the wanted signal at the base station antenna connector as specified in clause 7.6.5?
question_80591.ground_truth: The level of the wanted signal measured at the BS antenna connector shall be set to the level specified in subclause 7.6.5.

question_80592.question: What shall the MCPTT client do upon receiving a PRIVATE CALL REJECT message when in the "Q2: in-progress emergency private call" state?
question_80592.ground_truth: The MCPTT client shall stop timer TFP1, set the ProSe per-packet priority, set the stored current call type to "PRIVATE CALL", and enter the "Q1: in-progress private call" state.

question_80595.question: What should be the data type of the request body if the cardinality is "M..N" for data type "array(<type>)"?
question_80595.ground_truth: The data type of the request body should be an array containing elements of the specified data type "<type>", with the number of elements within the array being between M and N (inclusive).

question_80596.question: What information should the VAE-S include in the <dynamic-group-id> element of the HTTP PUT request message, when assigning a ProSe Layer-2 Group ID to a dynamic group?
question_80596.ground_truth: The identity of the dynamic group

question_80597.question: Which UE categories are applicable for the FDD-FDD intra frequency handover test case in 5.1.13.2?
question_80597.ground_truth: This test applies to all types of E-UTRA FD-FDD UE release 13 and forward of UE category M1 and higher, including non-BL/CE UE.

question_80598.question: What should the UE do if the field useFullResumeID is signalled in SIB1?
question_80598.ground_truth: The UE should select RRCResumeRequest1 as the message to use and set the resumeIdentity to the stored fullI-RNTI value.

question_80599.question: How are carriers placed in the ANTCR8 receiver tests?
question_80599.ground_truth: In the ANTCR8 receiver tests, a NR carrier is placed adjacent to the upper Base Station RF Bandwidth edge, and another NR carrier is placed adjacent to the lower Base Station RF Bandwidth edge. The sub-block edges adjacent to the sub-block gap are determined using the specified Foffset,RAT for the carrier adjacent to the sub-block gap.

question_80600.question: What is the purpose of using RTP payload type 97 in the SDP answer?
question_80600.ground_truth: The purpose of using RTP payload type 97 in the SDP answer is to indicate the use of AMR, max 123.2 kbps and bandwidth-efficient payload format.

question_80601.question: What is the purpose of the "Termination of an Automatic Train Protection data communication" use case?
question_80601.ground_truth: The "Termination of an Automatic Train Protection data communication" use case allows the FRMCS User to release an ongoing Automatic Train Protection related data communication.

question_80602.question: What is the role of the AMF in the SSAA procedure described in Solution #4?
question_80602.ground_truth: The Advanced Mobile Function (AMF) is responsible for performing the Slice Specific Authentication and Authorization (SSAA) procedure between the UE and the AAA Server (AAA-S) based on the EAP framework. It acts as the EAP authenticator and updates the Allowed NSSAI to include the authenticated S-NSSAI in the UE and the AMF after the successful completion of the SSAA procedure.

question_80603.question: In which scenarios is the SMF able to support the charging of redundant transmission for high reliability communication?
question_80603.ground_truth: The SMF is able to support the charging of redundant transmission for high reliability communication in any scenario where high reliability communication is required.

question_80604.question: What is the format of the Per-Link Aggregate Maximum Bit Rate value for V2X unicast mode communication over the NR-PC5?

question_80605.question: Which of the following is a type of IMS messaging service that expects immediate message delivery in real-time fashion?

question_80606.question: How does the UE confirm the successful resource reservation during session establishment procedure?
question_80606.ground_truth: Upon successful reservation of local resources, the UE shall confirm the successful reservation within the next SIP request, usually in a PRACK/UPDATE request, or in a reINVITE request if the precondition mechanism is not supported.

question_80607.question: What information should not be included in the information transfer capability field if it indicates "speech" in the backup bearer capability IE?
question_80607.ground_truth: Octets 4, 5, 5a, 5b, 6, 6a, 6b, 6c, 6d, 6e, 6f, 6g and 7 should not be included if the information transfer capability field indicates "speech" in the backup bearer capability IE.

question_80608.question: Who can activate the Earthquake and Tsunami Warning System (ETWS)?
question_80608.ground_truth: A Warning Notification Provider, such as a government agency, is able to activate ETWS to deliver Warning Notifications to users in a specified Notification Area.

question_80609.question: In scenario a) eNodeB failure without recovery or HeNodeB switched down, what information related to broadcast performance cannot be calculated by the CBC due to the eNodeB failure?
question_80609.ground_truth: The CBC cannot calculate the correct number of broadcasts performed as it is not aware of the eNodeB failure and cannot determine the time when the eNodeB stopped broadcasting.

question_80610.question: What is the user information rate, which must be transmitted over the air interface in DC-HSDPA?
question_80610.ground_truth: The total received power spectral density, including signal and interference, as measured at the UE antenna connector.

question_80611.question: What are the types of network-controlled repeaters and downlink classes?
question_80611.ground_truth: There are three types of network-controlled repeaters and downlink classes: Wide Area NCR, Medium Range NCR, and Local Area NCR.

question_80612.question: What are the challenges to the 5G system in the remote support use case for augmented-reality devices in plant maintenance?
question_80612.ground_truth: The challenges are "simultaneous" uplink/downlink of high-bit-rate data streams and assisting in achieving low end-to-end latencies over large geographic distances.

question_80613.question: What message does UE1 broadcast when it wants to initiate the Ranging/SL Positioning measurement with UE2 via an Assistance UE?
question_80613.ground_truth: UE1 broadcasts Direct Communication Request containing UE1 ID and UE2 ID, Ranging Service Code, long term credential ID, nonce 1 and its security capabilities.

question_80615.question: What is the role of the SAE MME in the 3GPP access system?
question_80615.ground_truth: The SAE MME is responsible for creating a UE context and establishing bearer resources for the UE in the target Evolved RAN.

question_80616.question: How does the MTC-IWF communicate load control rules to the MTC server?
question_80616.ground_truth: The MTC-IWF communicates load control rules to the MTC server by sending an appropriate message over the MTCsp interface, indicating suppression factor, suppression delay, or suppression subcategories, such as an application identifier or a specific TCP/UDP port, to suppress triggers sending from one or more MTC servers.

question_80618.question: What is the purpose of the "A-ADRF" and "A-DCCF" in the 3GPP system?
question_80618.ground_truth: The "A-ADRF" is an "Analytical Data Repository Function" and the "A-DCCF" is a "Data Collection and Coordination Function" that operate at the application layer of the 3GPP system.

question_80619.question: What is the maximum number of broadcast GINs in r17?

question_80620.question: In the alternative approach for relay setup, how does the device requesting relay select the best candidate?
question_80620.ground_truth: After receiving the relay responses from candidate UE devices, the device requesting relay compares the three parameters of each candidate and selects the best one.

question_80622.question: What does the Serving GW do after receiving the Create Session Response from the target MME?
question_80622.ground_truth: The Serving GW starts a timer, assigns addresses and TEIDs for downlink traffic from the PDN GW, sends a Modify Bearer Request message per PDN connection to the PDN GW(s), updates its context field, and returns a Modify Bearer Response message to the Serving GW.

question_80623.question: What is the purpose of the Reused Extended Object facility?
question_80623.ground_truth: The Reused Extended Object facility is used to reuse an Extended Object in a message that has already been defined in the same message.

question_80625.question: What is the maximum number of layers that a UE which supports Increased UE carrier monitoring E-UTRA is required to monitor?
question_80625.ground_truth: A UE which supports Increased UE carrier monitoring E-UTRA is required to monitor a maximum of 4 x Nfreq, E-UTRA + 4 x Nfreq, UTRA + 3 x MGSM + 4 x Nfreq, cdma2000 + 4 x Nfreq, HRPD + 4 x Nfreq, NR inter-RAT carriers.

question_80626.question: What is the effect of sending a +CMUX command while in any multiplexer mode?
question_80626.ground_truth: If a +CMUX command is issued whilst in any multiplexer mode, it shall be ignored, and the MT/TA shall return a +CME ERROR: <err> response.

question_80628.question: What should the MCData client do when receiving a SIP 200 (OK) message with the a=setup attribute set to "passive" from the SS (MCDATA server) after requesting the establishment of a MSRP connection?
question_80628.ground_truth: The MCData client should send a blank MSRP SEND message to bind the MSRP connection and then send the one-to-one standalone SDS message via a MSRP SEND message with a disposition of "DELIVERY".

question_80629.question: What is the significance of Step 5 in the solution evaluation?
question_80629.ground_truth: In Step 5, the solution is granted access to the server NWDAF if it is authorized based on the permitted-server-NWDAF list. This confirms the implementation of the authorization mechanism for the selection of participant NWDAF instances in the Federated Learning group.

question_80630.question: When a 5G-RG is connected via both NG-RAN and W-5GAN, how many N1 instances will exist for the 5G-RG?
question_80630.ground_truth: There will be one N1 instance over NG-RAN and one N1 instance over W-5GAN.

question_80631.question: How are the network functions in the 5G System architecture represented and interacted with?
question_80631.ground_truth: Network functions in the 5G System architecture are represented in a service-based manner, where network functions (e.g., AMF) within the Control Plane enable other authorized network functions to access their services. The interaction between network functions is also represented by point-to-point reference points, such as N11 between AMF and SMF. In the non-roaming case, service-based interfaces are used within the Control Plane, and the 5G System architecture is depicted using the reference point representation to show how various network functions interact.

question_80634.question: What must be ensured for time duration T4 and T5 in the described procedure?
question_80634.ground_truth: During time duration T4 and T5, the UE shall detect beam failure and initiate link recovery. Also, it measures and evaluates beam candidates from beam candidate set q1 during these time periods.

question_80636.question: What is the national flower of Portugal?

question_80637.question: What is the difference between DCH and E-DCH in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_80637.ground_truth: DCH (Dedicated Channel) is used for carrying user or control information between the UTRAN and a UE, while E-DCH (Enhanced Dedicated Channel) is used specifically for up-link data transmission in the 1.28Mcps TDD option.

question_80638.question: Which Key Issue investigates how to support network slice access based converged charging service on the simultaneous/max. number of UEs for specific charging requirements?

question_80639.question: What is the significance of the NF service discovery procedure in the same PLMN?
question_80639.ground_truth: The NF service discovery procedure is crucial in determining whether to provide the NF producer to the NF consumer based on the certificate status of the NF producer. This ensures that only NF producers with valid certificates are provided during the service discovery.

question_80640.question: Which UEs is this test case 8.16.94 applicable to?
question_80640.ground_truth: This test case applies to all types of E-UTRA FDD UE release 11 and forward that support 5DL CA, all types of E-UTRA TDD UE release 11 and forward that support 5DL CA, and all types of E-UTRA FDD and TDD Release 12 and forward UE that support E-UTRA FDD, E-UTRA TDD and 5DL CA.

question_80641.question: What should the source MME do when providing the transparent handover container to the target AMF during handover from EPS to 5GS?
question_80641.ground_truth: The source MME should ensure that the selected AMF is capable of performing AMF selection and should consider the S-NSSAIs associated to PDN connections in the transparent handover container.

question_80642.question: What is the format of the PositioningMeasurementFailureIndication message?
question_80642.ground_truth: The PositioningMeasurementFailureIndication message is a SEQUENCE that contains a ProtocolIE-Container, which includes a set of ProtocolIE-SingleContainer elements, each with a specific ID, Criticality, Type, Presence, and optional Additional Information.

question_80643.question: What is the test procedure for 42.3.1.1.8 in the context of GPRS MS testing?
question_80643.ground_truth: The test procedure for 42.3.1.1.8 involves triggering the MS to initiate packet uplink transfer in RLC acknowledged mode, the SS ordering the MS to use two-phase access procedure, and assigning two timeslots to the MS for uplink data transfer.

question_80645.question: What action should the HSS take if it receives a message from a service-related entity requesting EPS User State and/or EPS Location Information without the Serving Node Indication IE?
question_80645.ground_truth: The HSS shall set the "EPS User State Request" bit and/or "EPS Location Information Request" bit respectively in the IDR-Flags and may also set the "Current Location Request" bit, unless it knows that the registered MME and/or SGSN do not support state/location information retrieval.

question_80646.question: Who is responsible for segmenting messages in the Application-to-Point communication model?
question_80646.ground_truth: The MSGin5G Server is responsible for segmenting messages in the Application-to-Point communication model.

question_80647.question: What are the necessary procedures defined for the NF Producer?
question_80647.ground_truth: The necessary procedures defined for the NF Producer include the application of procedures and node functionality enhancements for SBI-based MT SMS, the registration of new services in NRF, and the querying of NRF to invoke the services for SM MT.

question_80648.question: What is GERAN Feature Package 2?
question_80648.ground_truth: GERAN Feature Package 2 includes Enhanced Power Control (EPC) for uplink and downlink power control.

question_80650.question: What are the aspects of redundant network deployment managed by the operator and not subject to 3GPP standardization?
question_80650.ground_truth: The aspects include the support for dual connectivity in RAN and sufficient RAN coverage for dual connectivity in the target area, UE support for dual connectivity, alignment of UPF deployment with RAN deployment and support for redundant user plane paths, alignment of the underlying transport topology with RAN and UPF deployment and support for redundant user plane paths, a topology and geographical distribution of functions that support the redundant user plane paths, and independent operation of the redundant user plane paths, such as independent power supplies.

question_80652.question: What should be the state of the cg-SDT-TimeAlignmentTimer before initiating the CG-SDT procedure?
question_80652.ground_truth: The cg-SDT-TimeAlignmentTimer should be running before initiating the CG-SDT procedure.

question_80653.question: What is the principle behind the noise contrast effect in the GSM system?
question_80653.ground_truth: The noise contrast effect is the perceived annoyance caused by the sudden drop in background noise when the transmission is off during DTX operation. In the GSM system, this is reduced by inserting artificial comfort noise at the receiving end when speech is absent.

question_80654.question: What format is used for the "addr" property in the MSGin5G JSON schema?
question_80654.ground_truth: The "addr" property in the MSGin5G JSON schema uses the "uri" format.

question_80657.question: What is the purpose of testing the behavior of the MS if the network rejects the GPRS attach procedure with the cause 'GPRS services not allowed'?
question_80657.ground_truth: The purpose is to ensure that the MS does not perform GPRS attach and either perform an MM IMSI attach or do a Location Update with the update type set to IMSI attach if the conditions in 3GPP TS 04.08 and 3GPP TS 24.008 are met.

question_80662.question: What is the role of the USS in the 5G System?
question_80662.ground_truth: The USS provides UAS-specific AF services to NF service consumers, such as NEF, and functions as a part of the AF.

question_80664.question: What is the purpose of the Hosting E-UTRAN/NG-RAN Operator collecting start and end service events in the Shared E-UTRAN/NG-RAN for the UEs of the Participating Operator?
question_80664.ground_truth: The purpose is to facilitate interoperator accounting between the Hosting E-UTRAN/NG-RAN Operator and the Participating Operator.

question_80665.question: When should a UE treat a cell as if the cell status is "barred" when the cellBarredNES is absent?
question_80665.ground_truth: When cellBarredNES is absent and cellBarred is set to "barred", a UE capable of NES cell DTX/DRX shall treat this cell as if cell status is "barred".

question_80666.question: For the HPLMNwAcT EF, how many MCC, MNC, and LAC bytes are used for a single HPLMN entry?
question_80666.ground_truth: 3 Bytes (MCC), 2 Bytes (MNC), and 2 Bytes (LAC) are used for a single HPLMN entry in the HPLMNwAcT EF.

question_80668.question: What is the purpose of the authorization model in GUP?
question_80668.ground_truth: The authorization model in GUP supports the issuance of assertions which convey information regarding the resource to be accessed, the entity attempting to access the resource, the mechanism by which the accessing entity must use to demonstrate its identity to the recipient, and the ability for the accessing entity to access the resource on behalf of another system entity. Therefore, the authorization model supports a constrained proxy mechanism, allowing a proxy to access the resource on behalf of the intended sender.

question_80670.question: What happens when the EAP-SIM or EAP-AKA authentication procedure fails, and the current GANC-SEGW is the SEGW associated to the Default GANC or a Serving GANC?
question_80670.ground_truth: The MS shall act as if it had received GA-RC REGISTER REJECT with the Reject Cause value 'IMSI not allowed' as defined in sub-clause 6.2.3.3.

question_80671.question: Which measurements are used to calculate the final Network Slice EE KPI based on summing up the number of active UEs in the DL per cell and the number of active UEs in the UL per cell for MIoT type of slice?
question_80671.ground_truth: DRB.MeanActiveUeDl.SNSSAI and DRB.MeanActiveUeUl.SNSSAI are used to calculate the final Network Slice EE KPI based on summing up the number of active UEs in the DL per cell and the number of active UEs in the UL per cell for MIoT type of slice.

question_80672.question: What should the IWF do upon receiving a SIP 4xx, 5xx or 6xx response to the SIP INVITE request in the participating procedure?
question_80672.ground_truth: The IWF should perform the procedures for SIP 4xx, 5xx or 6xx responses as specified in clause~10.1.2.1 if the implicit affiliation procedures were invoked, and shall perform the steps for the received SIP 4xx, 5xx or 6xx as specified in clause~10.1.2.1.

question_80674.question: What must the Permitted MCPTT client include in the Message Sequence Number field when sending a Floor Revoke message?
question_80674.ground_truth: The Permitted MCPTT client must include a Message Sequence Number field with a value increased with 1 when sending a Floor Revoke message.

question_80676.question: What is the format of the QoEInformationTransfer in the F1AP-PROTOCOL-CONTAINER?
question_80676.ground_truth: QoEInformationTransfer in the F1AP-PROTOCOL-CONTAINER is a SEQUENCE that consists of a protocolIEs field, which is a ProtocolIE-Container containing QoEInformationTransfer-IEs.

question_80677.question: What are the MRFC and MRFP responsible for in the described multimedia conference establishment procedure?
question_80677.ground_truth: The MRFC is responsible for requesting resources from the MRFP, sending an SIP INVITE request with the SDP offer, receiving the 200 (OK) final response with the SDP answer, and providing additional bandwidth properties information to the MRFP. The MRFP is responsible for providing resources to the MRFC, receiving the SIP INVITE request with the SDP offer, sending the 200 (OK) final response with the SDP answer, and using the media bandwidth range for rate adaptation.

question_80678.question: What attribute is used to define the start time for initiation procedure randomization in the `initiationRandomization` element?
question_80678.ground_truth: The `initiationStartTime` attribute is used to define the start time for initiation procedure randomization in the `initiationRandomization` element.

question_80680.question: When is the Broadcast Scheduled Area List IE or Broadcast Scheduled Area List NG-RAN IE included in the WRITE-REPLACE WARNING INDICATION?
question_80680.ground_truth: The Broadcast Scheduled Area List IE or Broadcast Scheduled Area List NG-RAN IE is included in the WRITE-REPLACE WARNING INDICATION when stopping the broadcast was successful in at least one of the cells within the eNodeBs or NG-RAN nodes.

question_80681.question: What does the AMF perform if it doesn't have mobility information for the UE?
question_80681.ground_truth: The AMF performs service discovery to determine the required information.

question_80683.question: What is the purpose of the "Text Attribute" section in the "OPEN CHANNEL" command?
question_80683.ground_truth: The "Text Attribute" section in the "OPEN CHANNEL" command specifies the formatting of the alpha identifier, such as formatting position, formatting length, formatting mode, and color.

question_80684.question: What should the SS do if the parameter 3300 or 3301 is reported from the UE via txDirectCurrentLocation IE in 6.4.2.2.4.2?
question_80684.ground_truth: In case the parameter 3300 or 3301 is reported from the UE via txDirectCurrentLocation IE, the SS should not proceed to test procedure and mark the test not applicable with reasoning in the test report.

question_80687.question: What is the function of the "fe" namespace in the source-urn parameter of the Response-Source header field?
question_80687.ground_truth: The "fe" namespace in the source-urn parameter of the Response-Source header field is used to indicate an IMS functional-entity.

question_80688.question: What is the role of the "ProvideLocation" service operation in the 5GC-MT-LR Procedure for the commercial location service?
question_80688.ground_truth: The "ProvideLocation" service operation is used in the 5GC-MT-LR Procedure for the commercial location service to provide the location information for a target UE. The service operation is invoked by a NF Service Consumer, such as a NEF, towards the GMLC.

question_80689.question: What should a UE do when an inter-RAT E-UTRA cell meets the reselection criteria, but the Treselection timer has a non-zero value?
question_80689.ground_truth: The UE should evaluate this E-UTRA cell for the Treselection time. If this cell remains satisfied with the reselection criteria within this duration, then the UE shall reselect this cell.

question_80690.question: What is one of the recommended requirements for Datacasting services?
question_80690.ground_truth: One of the recommended requirements is that the network can inform UEs of different recommended durations of monitoring periods.

question_80691.question: What is the purpose of Tally in a camera setup?
question_80691.ground_truth: Tally is used to indicate which camera is currently "on-air" or being used for filming.

question_80692.question: Who is responsible for specifying the security functions f1, f1*, f2, f3, f4, f5, and f5* within the 3GPP system?
question_80692.ground_truth: The security functions f1, f1*, f2, f3, f4, f5, and f5* within the 3GPP system are to be specified by each operator rather than being fully standardized.

question_80693.question: What is the source device and destination device for the 3.1.1 proactive SIM command?
question_80693.ground_truth: Source device is SIM and destination device is ME (ME means Mobile Equipment)

question_80694.question: When should the multi-rate or rate-adaptive capabilities of the codec be used with redundancy?
question_80694.ground_truth: It should be used with redundancy for variable-rate codecs to avoid increasing the load in the network, and only for fixed-rate codecs when permitted by the allocated bandwidth.

question_80695.question: What message includes the Resume Id, Authentication Token, Bearer Ind, and Establishment Cause in the RRC Connection Resume procedure?
question_80695.ground_truth: In msg3, designated here as RRC Connection Resume Request, the UE includes its Resume Id, Authentication Token, Bearer Ind, and Establishment Cause in the RRC Connection Resume procedure.

question_80696.question: What is the name of the 3GPP file format defined in TS 26.244 that provides a common multimedia file format for 3GPP multimedia services?

question_80698.question: What is the purpose of the "dependentRequired" property in the MSGin5G Registration Response schema?
question_80698.ground_truth: The "dependentRequired" property in the MSGin5G Registration Response schema specifies that the "regExpTime" property is required when the "result" property is true, and the "Cause" property is required when the "result" property is false.

question_80700.question: How can the "telephone-event" media subtype be signaled for DTMF transport between the UE and the AS?
question_80700.ground_truth: The AS should include the "telephone-event" in the SDP for CAT media, sent to the UE.

question_80701.question: What is the requirement for group regroup between different MCPTT systems?
question_80701.ground_truth: The groups belonging to different MCPTT systems can be dynamically regrouped only if there exists a service provider agreement between them and the security aspects of sharing the user information shall be governed as per the service provider agreement between the Primary MCPTT system and the Partner MCPTT system.

question_80702.question: Why is the temporary identity mechanism used in UMTS similar to the TMSI mechanism?
question_80702.ground_truth: The temporary identity is used to identify the user in UMTS, while the TMSI is often used in UMTS instead of the user permanent identity. This mechanism provides improved security over UTRAN as the user's temporary identity can be allocated by the network and protected confidentially.

question_80704.question: What should a mobile station do if it receives a new indicated reporting period or change packet mode while timer T3158 is active and the new indicated reporting period is less than the time to expiry of timer T3158?
question_80704.ground_truth: If a mobile station receives a new indicated reporting period or change packet mode while timer T3158 is active and the new indicated reporting period is less than the time to expiry of timer T3158, the mobile station shall immediately restart timer T3158 with the new indicated reporting period.

question_80705.question: What is Solution #41's proposal for sending an indication from 5GS to avoid switching away to non-seamless WIFI access?
question_80705.ground_truth: Solution #41 suggests applying existing URSP rules to control non-seamless WIFI offload based on the RSD defined in clause 6.1.2.2.1 of TS~23.503.

question_80706.question: What should the floor participant do when it receives a Floor Granted message, the <User ID> value in the User ID field matches its own MCPTT ID, and the SSRC of the floor participant sending the Floor Granted message matches the stored SSRC of the current floor arbitrator?
question_80706.ground_truth: The floor participant shall request the MCPTT client to stop rendering received RTP media packets, set the stored SSRC of the current floor arbitrator to its own SSRC, stop timer T203 (End of RTP media), provide a floor granted notification to the MCPTT user, and enter the 'O: has permission' state.

question_80707.question: What is the total time required for a UE to detect and measure at least 16 cells, including the reference cell, in E-UTRAN FDD intra-frequency RSTD measurements?
question_80707.ground_truth: TMIB ms, where TMIB is the time required for acquiring the MIB information of the target cell.

question_80708.question: What is the difference between M2 and M2* interfaces?
question_80708.ground_truth: M2 is defined as a reference point between the SEN MCE and shared eNB, while M2* is a reference point between the SEN MCE and participating PLMNs eNBs, considered as an inter-PLMN interface.

question_80709.question: What should the UE consider as rejected if it receives a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message with the Requested MBS container IE included and the MBS operation set to "Join MBS session"?
question_80709.ground_truth: The UE shall consider the requested MBS join as rejected.

question_80710.question: What is the "allowed-range-class" defined in subclause 11.2.4.9(a)?
question_80710.ground_truth: The "allowed-range-class" is defined in subclause 11.2.4.9(a) as an element used in the response-register message to specify the allowed range class.

question_80711.question: What is the meaning of the "PRESENCE" field in the "protocolIE" sequence of the mentioned messages?
question_80711.ground_truth: The "PRESENCE" field in the "protocolIE" sequence indicates whether the information is mandatory, optional, or conditional in the message. The "mandatory" value indicates that the information must be present in the message. The "optional" value indicates that the information may be present in the message or not, and the "PRESENCE" value "absent" indicates that the information must not be present in the message.

question_80712.question: When does the 3G/2G SGSN send the Forward SRNS Context message?
question_80712.ground_truth: The 3G/2G SGSN sends the Forward SRNS Context message to the target RNC/BSS if there is at least one PDP context that requires "delivery order" to be preserved.

question_80713.question: What is the 5G system requirement related to providing means to predict and expose network condition changes?
question_80713.ground_truth: The 5G system shall be able to provide the means to predict and expose network condition changes, such as bitrate, latency, and reliability, to an authorized 3rd party.

question_80714.question: What method in OSA API Mapping is used for sending information to the user?
question_80714.ground_truth: sendInfoReq is the method in OSA API Mapping used for sending information to the user.

question_80715.question: What information does the AF send to the NEF or PCF to create a new non-GBR QoS Flow?
question_80715.ground_truth: The AF sends the XRM stream information and request QoS and additional Requested Alternative QoS Parameter Set(s) to the NEF or PCF to create a new non-GBR QoS Flow.

question_80717.question: What are some of the charging models supported by PCC charging?
question_80717.ground_truth: PCC charging supports volume based charging, time based charging, volume and time based charging, event based charging, and no charging.

question_80718.question: What type of analytics subsets can be provided to any consumer, such as PCF, AF, or NEF, by the NWDAF?
question_80718.ground_truth: The NWDAF can provide analytics subset "List of top applications in UL (0..NU)" and "List of top applications in DL (0..ND)" to any consumer.

question_80719.question: What are reference spaces in OpenXR and how are they used?
question_80719.ground_truth: Reference spaces in OpenXR are well-defined frames of reference that applications use to bootstrap their spatial reasoning. Examples include VIEW, LOCAL, and STAGE spaces, each with a specific origin and orientation.

question_80720.question: What networks and access technologies does the IM CN subsystem support for IP multimedia applications?
question_80720.ground_truth: The IM CN subsystem supports various IP Connectivity Access Networks, including E-UTRAN, UTRAN, GERAN, fixed line, I-WLAN, DOCSIS, WiMAX, cdma2000, and DVB-RCS2 access.

question_80722.question: What is the impact of the S-IWF acting as an S3 relay function in interworking with non VCC capable IMS network or UE?
question_80722.ground_truth: If the S-IWF acts as an S3 relay function, it forwards the IMS signalling data between the IMS network and the UE without performing any VCC procedure. This leads to no impact on the existing GERAN and UTRAN nodes, or the IMS network.

question_80724.question: What should the IBCF do when an 18x provisional response with the P-Early-Media header field is received from the functional entity other than the functional entity within the trust domain?
question_80724.ground_truth: The IBCF shall set the Through-Connection information element to "inactive" or set the value of the Through-Connection information element based on the value of the direction attribute in the last received SDP answer.

question_80725.question: What is the primary difference between Solution 2 and Solution 3a?
question_80725.ground_truth: In Solution 2, RGs are defined independently by each HPLMN and maintained by the V-PCRF, while in Solution 3a, S9 is used to dynamically allocate RGs based on service and QoS criteria, allowing accurate use of inter-PLMN Gy.

question_80726.question: What is the test purpose when testing the behavior of the MS when it receives a GA-RC DEREGISTER message with a Reject Cause Information Element of 'Network Congestion'?
question_80726.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify that the MS changes state to GA-RC DEREGISTERED and starts to try to register again after receiving GA-RC DEREGISTER with cause 'Network Congestion'.

question_80727.question: What is the initial approach suggested for the global roll-out of PWS Security?
question_80727.ground_truth: The initial approach suggested is a bottom-up approach, where a single country or a group of countries with a common regulation can go ahead with the implementation without being dependent on the rest of the world.

question_80728.question: What is the purpose of the HNS Network Resources IRP: CORBA Solution Set in the 3GPP telecommunication network?
question_80728.ground_truth: The HNS Network Resources IRP: CORBA Solution Set specifies the mapping of the IRP information model to the protocol specific details necessary for implementation in a CORBA/IDL environment.

question_80729.question: What event triggers the transmission of the NBAP message RADIO LINK SETUP REQUEST with the "E-DCH FDD Information" IE?
question_80729.ground_truth: The RNC transmits this message to set up a new E-DCH connection for packet switched traffic in FDD mode using the Node B Application Part (NBAP).

question_80730.question: What is the functionality of the S301 reference point in the optimized handovers between mobile WiMAX and 3GPP accesses?
question_80730.ground_truth: The S301 reference point has the same functionality as the S1-MME and terminates to the MME inside the 3GPP Access. It is used to maintain the same functionality as the S1-MME when performing handovers between mobile WiMAX and 3GPP accesses.

question_80731.question: What is the communication service availability requirement for the 5G system to support "Remote control part" downloading in the split control mode for robotics?
question_80731.ground_truth: The 5G system shall support "Remote control part" downloading in the split control mode for robotics with communication service availability not lower than 99.999%.

question_80733.question: What must a user service announcement be associated with in order to be described by a Service Announcement User Service in non-ROM services?
question_80733.ground_truth: A user service announcement in non-ROM services must be associated with an operator-specific MCC+MNC value or correspond to one of the reserved values as defined in TS 24.116.

question_80734.question: What is the main goal of NB M2M solution in terms of system complexity?
question_80734.ground_truth: NB M2M solution adopts PHY and MAC layer design techniques that are intended to be compatible with ultra-low complexity MS implementations.

question_80735.question: What is the purpose of the 'release()' method?
question_80735.ground_truth: The 'release()' method releases the session, preventing any further operations from being performed on it. It also frees unused parts of a reservation.

question_80739.question: In the context of X2AP-PROTOCOL-EXTENSION, what data type is defined by ServedCell-Information?
question_80739.ground_truth: ServedCell-Information is a data type that contains information about a served cell in the context of X2AP (5G X2 interface signalling).

question_80740.question: What information does the CHF use to determine the non-blocking mode change?
question_80740.ground_truth: The CHF determines to change the non-blocking mode based on user information (e.g. Account Balance and account status) in the charging system.

question_80741.question: What 3M TS standardizes the procedures for refreshing radio interface ciphering keys?
question_80741.ground_truth: TS 23.401, clause 5.3.10.4.1, in conjunction with TS 33.401, clause 7.2.9, standardizes the procedures for refreshing radio interface ciphering keys when using the UE Context Modification procedure over a longer time period.

question_80742.question: What is the blocking requirement for UMTS interferers when the body loss is increased to 12 dB (6 dB per UE)?
question_80742.ground_truth: The blocking requirement for UMTS interferers when the body loss is increased to 12 dB (6 dB per UE) is -26 dBm.

question_80743.question: What is the role of CAPIF in the xMB work item for Northbound APIs in 3GPP Release 16?
question_80743.ground_truth: CAPIF is aligned to the xMB reference point in the CAPIF4xMB work item for Northbound APIs in 3GPP Release 16, which exists between Content Providers (as API invokers) and the BM-SC. CAPIF offers a simple interface for controlling the MBMS delivery procedure and ingesting data for delivery via MBMS.

question_80744.question: What should the SMF do if it receives a POST request with the upCnxState IE set to ACTIVATING in a UE Triggered Service Request with I-SMF Insertion?
question_80744.ground_truth: The SMF shall behave as specified in clause 4.23.4.3 (step 8a) of 3GPP TS 23.502, indicating that User Plane resource for the PDU Session is going to be established by the I-SMF.

question_80745.question: What is the purpose of the Kd session ID in Solution #3?
question_80745.ground_truth: The Kd session ID in Solution #3 plays a crucial role in ensuring a secure unicast link between peer UEs. Both the initiating and peer UEs use the Kd session ID to store and retrieve security contexts. By generating unique Kd session IDs, Solution #3 prevents man-in-the-middle attacks and enables successful PDCP layer security operations.

question_80746.question: In the context of the 5G network, what does BFD stand for?

question_80747.question: Can the PCF update the mute indication of a provisioned PCC rule during the PDU session lifetime?
question_80747.ground_truth: No, the PCF is not allowed to update the mute indication of a provisioned PCC rule during the PDU session lifetime.

question_80749.question: What is the recommended minimum test time for LTE in static testing?
question_80749.ground_truth: The recommended minimum test time for LTE in static testing is 60 seconds.

question_80753.question: What is the purpose of the PUD session in PIN communication via 5GS?
question_80753.ground_truth: The PDU session is established to securely transfer data between the PINE and the PEMC. This session is managed by the 5GS and is necessary to ensure the quality of service and security of the data transmitted over the network.

question_80754.question: What is the main reason for the additional performance degradation of Low complexity SBPCE2?
question_80754.ground_truth: The additional degradation is mainly due to the need for higher order modulation symbols to compensate for the smaller FFT size used compared to SBPCE2B.

question_80755.question: What action does the AMF take if the UE provides authentication/authorization information corresponding to a DN-specific identity during PDU Session Establishment and SMF determines that Secondary authentication/authorization of the PDU Session Establishment is required based on the SMF policy associated with the DN?
question_80755.ground_truth: The AMF passes the authentication/authorization information of the UE to the DN-AAA server via the UPF if the DN-AAA server is located in the DN. If the Secondary authentication/authorization of the PDU Session Establishment fails, the SMF rejects the PDU Session Establishment.

question_80756.question: What is the Allocation-and-Retention-Priority AVP used for in the 3GPP access types E-UTRAN, UTRAN, and GERAN?
question_80756.ground_truth: It is used to indicate a priority for deciding whether a bearer establishment or modification request can be accepted or needs to be rejected in case of resource limitations, or which bearer(s) to drop during exceptional resource limitations.

question_80757.question: What is the purpose of GPRS Timer 2, GPRS Timer 3 and CSGinfo parameters in the displayed network state scenarios?
question_80757.ground_truth: GPRS Timers 2 and 3 are related to active time and periodic tracking area update. CSGinfo includes CSGtype, HNB Name, CSGID, and CSG Associated PLMN MCC MNC information for the user equipment, and their encoding depends on the +CSSGS command.

question_80759.question: What is the requirement for the BS in non-contiguous spectrum?
question_80759.ground_truth: The requirements apply both at the Base Station RF Bandwidth edges and inside the sub-block gaps for BS operation in non-contiguous spectrum.

question_80760.question: What is the maximum level of the output RF spectrum due to 16-QAM modulation for an EGPRS MS in the band of 600 kHz to 1800 kHz offset from the carrier under extreme conditions as defined in 3GPP TS 45.005, subclause 4.2.1 and 3GPP TS 45.005, annex D subclauses D.2.1 and D.2.2?
question_80760.ground_truth: The maximum level of the output RF spectrum due to 16-QAM modulation for an EGPRS MS in the band of 600 kHz to 1800 kHz offset from the carrier under extreme conditions is -46 dBm.

question_80761.question: How does a UE derive the home network domain name when deriving the Provisioning GANC identifier if the (U)SIM is not provisioned with the FQDN or IP address of the Provisioning GANC-SEGW?
question_80761.ground_truth: A UE derives the home network domain name by creating a domain name as specified in 17.3.1 and adding the label "psegw." to the beginning of the domain name.

question_80763.question: What are the two parts of an Access Point Name (APN)?
question_80763.ground_truth: The two parts of an APN are the APN Operator Identifier and a reference to the GGSN or P-GW to be used, which may optionally identify the packet data network and a specific service to be offered.

question_80764.question: What is required for the PCEF to return accumulated usage data volume to the PCRF after a restart?
question_80764.ground_truth: The PCEF needs to have the capability to store and retrieve the accumulated usage data volume reported to the PCRF before the PCRF restart.

question_80765.question: What is the duration of the test for verifying the correct release of a full-rate TCH after receiving a CHANNEL RELEASE message in the 3GPP protocol?
question_80765.ground_truth: The maximum duration of this test is 20 seconds.

question_80768.question: What component is responsible for ingesting media content from the 5GMSd AS in the eMBMS provisioning mode?

question_80770.question: What is the role of the 5GMS AS in the DS domain?
question_80770.ground_truth: The 5GMS AS is deployed in the trusted DN as a part of the DS domain to provide Quality of Service Support like a DSCP-enabled link.

question_80771.question: What does the "A/D" field in the Enhanced SP/AP SRS Spatial Relation Indication MAC CE indicate?
question_80771.ground_truth: The "A/D" field indicates whether to activate or deactivate the indicated SRS resource set. The field is set to 1 to indicate activation, and 0 to indicate deactivation.

question_80772.question: What does the CatStatus function return?
question_80772.ground_truth: The CatStatus function returns the file status of the currently selected file.

question_80773.question: What happens when a UE with basic network connectivity attempts to establish an MMTEL video conference call and fails?
question_80773.ground_truth: The UE can invoke MPS for the MMTEL video conference call or to upgrade an already established MMTEL video conference call if it is unable to establish a successful call due to congestion or unavailability of resources.

question_80774.question: What should the UE do if it detects an alteration in the Replayed UE security capabilities IE received from the AMF during the security mode control procedure in 5G NAS?
question_80774.ground_truth: The UE should set the cause value to #23 "UE security capabilities mismatch" if it detects an alteration in the Replayed UE security capabilities IE received from the AMF.

question_80775.question: What is the process when the PEMC creates a direct connection with the PINE?
question_80775.ground_truth: The PEMC may set up a direct connection with the PINE by sending an Association Create Request without block indication and including the MAC address of the PINE to indicate the PEMC only accepts direct connection with the corresponding PINE.

question_80776.question: What is a UE Capability ID used for in the context of UE Radio Capabilities?
question_80776.ground_truth: A UE Capability ID is used to represent a subset of UE Radio Capabilities, and can be used to signal this subset more efficiently than signalling the full set of UE Radio Capabilities.

question_80780.question: What is the maximum number of node level LCI IE instances that can be signaled by a GTP-C entity in a single message?
question_80780.ground_truth: There can be at most one instance of node level LCI IE per node (i.e. per SGW or PGW) in a single message.

question_80781.question: What standard defines the Bluetooth scenario data for the test cases in Subclause 10.1 of TS 37.571-2?
question_80781.ground_truth: Subclause 10.1 of TS 37.571-2 defines the Bluetooth scenario data for signalling test cases.

question_80782.question: What should the controller UE do when it receives an error response for the SIP REFER request or the subsequent SIP NOTIFY requests?
question_80782.ground_truth: The controller UE shall consider the transfer operation failed and continue the existing session.

question_80783.question: When does the 5G DDNMF send a POST request to the matchInfoCallbackRef URI to notify the NF service consumer about match information?
question_80783.ground_truth: The 5G DDNMF sends a POST request to the matchInfoCallbackRef URI to notify the NF service consumer about match information when there is a matching result, and the information can be used for charging purpose.

question_80784.question: What is the role of TSCTSF in the network timing synchronization status monitoring in 5GS?
question_80784.ground_truth: TSCTSF supports network timing synchronization status monitoring in 5GS by receiving node-level information about timing synchronization status from gNBs and UPF/NW-TTs, notifying service updates, and modifying time synchronization service based on the current synchronization status.

question_80785.question: What should the PCF include within each PccRule data structure when generating PCC rules with traffic routing information?
question_80785.ground_truth: The PCF should include necessary information to identify the concerned traffic within either the "flowInfos" attribute or the "appId" attribute, and inject the Traffic Control Data decision with the list of locations that the traffic shall be routed to in the "routeToLocs" attribute.

question_80786.question: What is the role of the Video Aware Controller (VAC) in the described network resource management system?
question_80786.ground_truth: The Video Aware Controller (VAC) is the central intelligence for video-aware resource management in the network. It communicates Maximum Bit Rate (MBR) values to DASH clients, which influences their video rate adaptation behavior, effectively managing network resources at various parts of the network.

question_80788.question: What is the requirement for the test to pass in 4.7.1.2.1.5?
question_80788.ground_truth: For the test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values in each test shall be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

question_80789.question: What is the name of the scheme used for downlink transmission in 5G NR?
question_80789.ground_truth: Demodulation Reference Signal (DMRS) based spatial multiplexing is used for Physical Downlink Shared Channel (PDSCH) in 5G NR.

question_80791.question: What is the minimum test time due to multipath conditions discussed in the Limit checking section?
question_80791.ground_truth: The minimum test time due to multipath conditions is 990 wavelengths crossed with the speed given in the fading profile.

question_80793.question: When can a UE request the establishment of a PDU session for a Conditional S-NSSAI?
question_80793.ground_truth: The UE can request the establishment of a PDU session for a Conditional S-NSSAI when it is in a TA where the S-NSSAI is available, the validity time associated with the S-NSSAI applies, or in the Serving Area where the S-NSSAI is available.

question_80795.question: What are the supported sampling frequencies for the background noise level estimation in the TCX time domain concealment?
question_80795.ground_truth: The background noise level estimation is supported for the sampling frequencies 9.6, 16.4, 24.4, 48, and 128 kbps.

question_80796.question: What is the format of the response message containing the requested location estimate?
question_80796.ground_truth: The network returns an LCS result to the MS carrying the requested location estimate in a FACILITY message.

question_80798.question: What is the name of the method used to get the Delay descriptor lists for the QoS Information?
question_80798.ground_truth: The Delay descriptor is a part of getProvisionedQoSInfo() return parameter TpProvisionedQoSInfo.

question_80799.question: What triggers the initiation of an S9 session termination by the V-PCRF?
question_80799.ground_truth: The V-PCRF initiates a termination of the S9 session when it receives a trigger that removes the last existing S9 subsession associated with the referred S9 session.

question_80802.question: In which entity of the network is the MBMS Session Stop procedure propagated for E-UTRAN and UTRAN for EPS?
question_80802.ground_truth: To all MBMS GWs, MMEs, and SGSNs that are registered for the corresponding MBMS bearer service and to E-UTRAN/UTRAN that have accepted to receive IP multicast distribution for E-UTRAN and UTRAN for EPS

question_80803.question: What is the maximum allowable interruption rate for the PCell during SCell activation and deactivation?
question_80803.ground_truth: The interruption of PCell should not be more than the values specified for intra-band CA and inter-band CA in clause~7.8.2.

question_80805.question: What are the available enablers for providing multiple language support in a 3GPP environment?
question_80805.ground_truth: 3GP-DASH supports late binding, so language can be distributed independently of the video. Additionally, 3GP-DASH supports signalling multiple languages by using the @lang attribute with Adaptation Sets. The mixing of the music and effects and the language track is done at the sender.

question_80806.question: What information is required for an intra-SGSN routing area update procedure?
question_80806.ground_truth: The MS sends a Routing Area Update Request (P-TMSI, old RAI, old P-TMSI Signature, Update Type, MS Radio Access Capability, DRX parameters, extended idle mode DRX parameters, MS Network Capability, Support for restriction of use of Enhanced Coverage, additional P-TMSI/RAI, Voice domain preference and UE's usage setting) to the SGSN.

question_80807.question: In TDD with different UL-DL patterns, which TDD UL-DL pattern is used for the PUCCH with DM-RS bundling performance tests if the BS supports multiple TDD UL-DL patterns with more than one consecutive UL slots?
question_80807.ground_truth: Only one of the supported TDD UL-DL patterns with more than one consecutive UL slots is used for the PUCCH with DM-RS bundling performance tests.

question_80808.question: What is the difference between a Management Information Base (MIB) and a Management Information Model (MIM) in the context of 3GPP Telecommunication Management?
question_80808.ground_truth: A Management Information Base (MIB) is the set of existing managed objects in a management domain, while a Management Information Model (MIM) is a model that represents the actual managed telecommunications Network Resources (NRs) that a System is providing through the subject IRP. The MIM describes Managed Object Classes (MOC), their associations, attributes and operations.

question_80810.question: Which 3GPP messaging service is designed to allow users to send and receive messages with various media types, including text, images, audio, and video?
question_80810.ground_truth: Multimedia Messaging Service (MMS) is a 3GPP messaging service designed to allow users to send and receive messages with various media types, including text, images, audio, and video.

question_80811.question: What is the purpose of step 9.3.3.4.2.3 in the procedure?
question_80811.ground_truth: The purpose of step 9.3.3.4.2.3 in the procedure is to determine if the UE correctly reports a limited range of CQI (Channel Quality Indicator) values under predefined channel conditions.

question_80813.question: What are the two modes of operation defined for CS data services in UMTS?
question_80813.ground_truth: The two modes of operation defined for CS data services in UMTS are Iu mode and A/Gb mode, indicating a system or sub-system that operates accordingly to the use of an Iu-CS or Iu-PS interface and A or Gb interface, respectively.

question_80814.question: What must the MS send if it does not support the requested positioning method?
question_80814.ground_truth: RRLP Measure Position Response message with a Location Error component indicating that the requested method is not supported.

question_80815.question: What is the parameter bound for the gprsConnectPackage operation package?
question_80815.ground_truth: The parameter bound for the gprsConnectPackage operation package is "bound".

question_80816.question: What is the class that defines the constants for the ToolkitException class?
question_80816.ground_truth: The ToolkitException class itself defines the constants for the ToolkitException class, as there is no separate class for these constants.

question_80817.question: What information does the S-CSCF store in the local data upon the receipt of a REGISTER request without an Authorization header field for an already registered public user identity linked to the same private user identity?
question_80817.ground_truth: The S-CSCF stores the list of public user identities, including the associated set of implicitly registered public user identities and wildcarded public user identities due to the received REGISTER request. The service profile(s) corresponding to the public user identities being registered are also stored. If S-CSCF restoration procedures are supported, the restoration information, as well as the user profile(s) corresponding to the public user identities being registered, are also stored.

question_80818.question: When does the MME indicate whether the traffic of a PDN Connection is allowed to be offloaded to WLAN?
question_80818.ground_truth: The MME may include an indication whether the traffic of this PDN Connection is allowed to be offloaded to WLAN as part of the Session Management Request when signaling the Bearer Setup Request (EPS Bearer Identity, EPS Bearer QoS, Maximum Packet Loss Rate, Session Management Request, S1-TEID) message to the eNodeB.

question_80819.question: What happens in the MME upon receipt of a HSS reset?
question_80819.ground_truth: The MME marks each relevant MM contexts as invalid, sets the Non-EPS Alert Flag (NEAF) if an MME - MSC/VLR association exists, and performs an update location to the HSS if there is any activity from a marked UE in ECM-CONNECTED state.

question_80822.question: What is the role of the DRA in handling multiple and separately addressable PCRFs in a Diameter realm?
question_80822.ground_truth: The DRA, when deployed, is responsible for selecting the PCRF at IP-CAN session establishment by the PDN GW and being involved in unsolicited service reporting over Sd. It also selects the PCRF at initial attach (IP-CAN session or Gateway Control session establishment) and ensures that all Diameter sessions reach the same PCRF for a given IP-CAN session in a Diameter realm.

question_80823.question: What is the format of the "dsl-bearer-info" value in the "xdsl-charging-info" parameter?
question_80823.ground_truth: The "dsl-bearer-info" value includes the "dsl-bearer-item", "dsl-bearer-sig", "dslcid", and "flow-id" parameters for each DSL bearer.

question_80824.question: What should be the course of action if the MCVideo client fails to establish communication?
question_80824.ground_truth: The MCVideo client should send a Private communication failed response indicating the failure reason to the appropriate MCVideo client

question_80827.question: Under what condition is a UE allowed to request 5GS services when camped on a cell of a TA that is in the list of "5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service"?
question_80827.ground_truth: When the UE needs to request emergency services.

question_80828.question: Which entities are impacted by provisioning DetNet traffic to 5GS parameters?
question_80828.ground_truth: The DetNet AF, TSCTSF, and optionally the NEF are impacted by provisioning DetNet traffic to 5GS parameters.

question_80831.question: What should the UE do with the concerned cells included in the cellsTriggeredList during event B1 measurement?
question_80831.ground_truth: The UE should include the concerned cells in the cellsTriggeredList defined within the VarMeasReportList for the measId.

question_80832.question: How many bits are used for quantization in the AMR-WB-interoperable mode?

question_80833.question: What message is sent by the network at any time during EMM context is established to send certain information to the UE?

question_80837.question: What are the implications of applying the Service Gap timer in the AMF for handling connection requests?
question_80837.ground_truth: The AMF may enforce the Service Gap timer by rejecting connection requests for MO user plane data, MO control plane data, or MO SMS when a Service Gap timer is running. The AMF may also enforce the Service Gap timer by not allowing MO signalling after Initial Registration requests when a Service Gap timer is running, except for Mobility Registration procedure, Periodic Registration procedure, or access to the network for regulatory prioritized services like Emergency services, which are allowed. When connection requests and SM signalling are rejected while the Service Gap timer is running, the AMF may include a Mobility Management back-off timer corresponding to the time left of the current Service Gap timer.

question_80838.question: What are the possible sequence of steps for a common SLPP session procedure?
question_80838.ground_truth: The possible sequence of steps for a common SLPP session procedure includes sending an SLPP message containing an assigned session identifier for an initial SLPP transaction, exchanging further messages to continue the transaction, instigating further transactions by sending additional SLPP messages, and terminating the session with a final transaction.

question_80839.question: What are the two types of Diameter-based implementation for AUSF in the 5G system?
question_80839.ground_truth: The two types of Diameter-based implementation for AUSF in the 5G system are Diameter server and Diameter proxy agent.

question_80840.question: What happens to the receiver's decode attempts when a frame has successfully decoded?
question_80840.ground_truth: The receiver does not attempt any further decode attempts once the frame has successfully decoded.

question_80841.question: What is the value of CAMEL Capability Handling for GPRS-CSI in SGSN?
question_80841.ground_truth: The CAMEL Capability Handling for GPRS-CSI in SGSN shall have the value CAMEL phase 3.

question_80842.question: What triggers the SM Policy Association Modification procedure in the VPLMN, when the UE is using LBO roaming?
question_80842.ground_truth: The SM Policy Association Modification procedure in the VPLMN can be initiated either by the SMF or the PCF. It is triggered when the PCF decides to modify policy decisions for a PDU session, due to factors like a change in the UDR policy data or application data, CHF spending limit report, or when group data rate policy control applies for a 5G VN Group.

question_80843.question: What needs to be in place to ensure secure identity mapping in the GBA framework?
question_80843.ground_truth: Proper security measures need to be in place to verify that a person is authorized to request mapping, and to ensure that the USS is stored securely to prevent unauthorized access.

question_80844.question: What is the role of the NEF in the position service exposure?
question_80844.ground_truth: The NEF is responsible for receiving location service requests from applications and sending corresponding requests to the GMLC or LCS client. It performs privacy checks based on the privacy profile and performs an MT-LR procedure if the requested location service is allowed.

question_80845.question: What is the test purpose for NR SA FR1 inter-frequency SS-RSRQ measurement accuracy on a carrier frequency with CCA?
question_80845.ground_truth: The test purpose is to verify that the SS-RSRQ measurement accuracy on the carrier frequency with CCA is within the specified limits.

question_80847.question: What information is contained in the parameters of the PHY-Data-IND primitive?
question_80847.ground_truth: The parameters of the PHY-Data-IND primitive include TFI, E-TFI (E-DCH only), Transport Block Set, CRC check result, TD (RX Timing Deviation measurement) (optional, TDD only), Process Id (HS-DSCH and E-DCH only), and Retransmission number (E-DCH only).

question_80848.question: When does a MS change its uplink power level upon receiving an EPC Uplink Power Control Command?
question_80848.ground_truth: A MS changes its uplink power level to the new power level on the corresponding uplink channel at the first TDMA frame belonging to the next EPC reporting period.

question_80849.question: In what situations is the UE allowed to initiate the Mobility Management procedures without low access priority while the Mobility Management back-off timer is running?
question_80849.ground_truth: The UE can initiate the Mobility Management procedures without low access priority while the Mobility Management back-off timer is running in the following situations: (1) if the UE has a permission to override low access priority, and (2) if the back-off timer was started due to a reject message for a request with low access priority and the upper layers in the UE request to establish a PDN connection without low access priority or the UE has an established PDN connection that is without low access priority.

question_80850.question: What is one of the potential new requirements for the 5G system to support the given use case?
question_80850.ground_truth: The 5G system should support the encoding of sensor data capturing a person's facial expression, movement, and gestures as part of the avatar encoding.
