The MCPTT server then adjusts the priority of the underlying bearer, handles the MCPTT in-progress emergency group state cancel request towards the affiliated MCPTT clients, and sends an IWF in-progress emergency group state cancel response to the IWF to confirm the IWF in-progress emergency group state cancel request.

question_81181.question: What is the goal of the SECAM evaluation for 3GPP virtualized network products?
question_81181.ground_truth: The SECAM evaluation for 3GPP virtualized network products aims to demonstrate the compliance of the network product with the 3GPP security assurance specifications, provide evidence of compliance with the vendor's product and development lifecycle processes, and show that the actors performing the evaluation tasks are accredited by the SECAM Accreditation Body.

question_81183.question: What measurement is obtained by accumulating the number of octets of MBMS data on MAC-m layer in MBMS related measurements?
question_81183.ground_truth: Number of octets of MBMS data on MAC layer

question_81184.question: What HTTP error response will the BSF send if the "Individual PCF for a PDU Session Binding" resource does not exist?
question_81184.ground_truth: The BSF will respond with "404 Not Found" error code.

question_81185.question: When can the 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE instruct the lower layers to stop announcing UE procedure for relay discovery additional information?
question_81185.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay UE may instruct the lower layers to stop announcing, if one of the conditions for announcing UE procedure for relay discovery additional information is no longer met.

question_81186.question: What should the MRFP do if it does not perform video transcoding but receives an RTP header extension for Arbitrary ROI?
question_81186.ground_truth: If the MRFP does not apply video transcoding and receives an RTP header extension for Arbitrary ROI, it shall pass the RTP header extension to succeeding RTP streams.

question_81187.question: If the AMF receives a paging restrictions information in the Control Plane Service Request, what will the AMF do?
question_81187.ground_truth: The AMF will update the UE context with the received Paging Restrictions information.

question_81188.question: What 5GMM cause value should the network set if the initial registration request is rejected due to general NAS level mobility management congestion control?
question_81188.ground_truth: The network shall set the 5GMM cause value to #22 "congestion" if the initial registration request is rejected due to general NAS level mobility management congestion control.

question_81189.question: What is the requirement for handling multiple affiliate requests from a UE to a Common MCX Service Group?
question_81189.ground_truth: The MCX Service may respond by permitting access to the group for some but not all MCX Services if appropriate.

question_81190.question: What is the action taken by the RAN node after receiving the network positioning message from the UE?
question_81190.ground_truth: The RAN node obtains uplink location measurements of UE signalling, sends a network positioning message included in an N2 Transport message to an AMF, and includes any uplink location measurements obtained by the RAN node and the positioning protocol message, the UE ID, the authentication code and the priority indication received at step 29.

question_81192.question: What are the registration requirements for an NGCN site in NGN arrangements?
question_81192.ground_truth: The NGCN site is required to register in the IMS based on standard registration procedures for the IM CN subsystem using the pair of private user identity and public user identity representing the NGCN site as a whole.

question_81193.question: What are the initial conditions for the RSRQ FDD - FDD inter frequency relative accuracy test?
question_81193.ground_truth: The initial conditions for the RSRQ FDD - FDD inter frequency relative accuracy test include the test environment, frequencies to be tested, channel bandwidth to be tested, and the connection of the SS and AWGN noise sources to the UE antenna connectors.

question_81194.question: What should the MCData client do upon expiry of timer TFS1 (SDS retransmission)?
question_81194.ground_truth: The MCData client should generate a SDS OFF-NETWORK MESSAGE message and send it, increment the CFS1 (SDS retransmission) counter, and start timer TFS1 (SDS retransmission) again if the associated counter CFS1 (SDS retransmission) has not reached its upper limit.

question_81196.question: What should the UE do when it receives a NOTIFY request with certain attributes?
question_81196.ground_truth: Upon receipt of a NOTIFY request, the UE removes all registration details relating to the respective public user identity if the state attribute is set to "terminated".

question_81197.question: What existing features of the 5G system partly or fully cover the use case functionality of the emergency stop service?
question_81197.ground_truth: The 5G system has to support safety-relevant real-time traffic with fixed transfer intervals of less than or equal to 10 ms, fixed short packet sizes, sporadic TCP traffic with reasonable latency, and high performance enhancements for time-sensitive networking for the emergency stop use case.

question_81198.question: What should the SMF do when a session rule was successfully installed, but can no longer be enforced by the SMF and the "ImmediateTermination" feature is supported?
question_81198.ground_truth: If the SMF determines to terminate the PDU session immediately, the SMF shall trigger the deletion of the SM Policy Association, otherwise the SMF shall set the "ruleStatus" attribute to INACTIVE.

question_81199.question: What is the expected result when the CLOSE CHANNEL command is performed successfully?
question_81199.ground_truth: When the CLOSE CHANNEL command is performed successfully, the UICC will send a TERMINAL RESPONSE (Command Performed Successfully) to the ME.

question_81202.question: What is the role of the "Migrated MC system" in the context of the 3GPP technical specification for mission critical services?
question_81202.ground_truth: The Migrated MC system is the partner MC system to which an MC service user has migrated, and in which that migrated MC service user is receiving MC service.

question_81204.question: What is the role of the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay in the NAS message communication with the Remote UE?
question_81204.ground_truth: The 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay releases the PC5 link with the Remote UE after including Remote User ID in the NAS message to indicate the Remote UE.

question_81206.question: What does the HS-DSCH TDD Information IE provide when added to a Node B Communication Context?
question_81206.ground_truth: The HS-DSCH TDD Information IE is used for initial addition of HS-DSCH information to a Node B Communication Context.

question_81207.question: What action must the network take if the DRX parameter is included in the DRX Parameter IE in the ATTACH REQUEST message?
question_81207.ground_truth: The network must replace any stored DRX parameter with the received parameter and use it for the downlink transfer of signalling and user data.

question_81208.question: What is the role of the UE, ePDG, and P-GW in the call flow for P-CSCF restoration?
question_81208.ground_truth: The UE answers to the ePDG, which then answers to the P-GW. The UE selects one available P-CSCF from the received list and proceeds with an IMS registration.

question_81209.question: What is the purpose of ML entity capability discovery and mapping?
question_81209.ground_truth: The purpose is to identify the specific capabilities of ML entities and map them to the tasks that the network or management function aims to accomplish using AI/ML.

question_81211.question: What is the function of the RIM procedures in the cellular network?
question_81211.ground_truth: The RIM procedures allow RAN node applications to be transparent for the MME and SGSN, facilitating operations such as Network Assisted Cell Change and the exchange of SON related information.

question_81212.question: What is the recommended way to adapt to higher bit rates at the beginning of a session to ensure that the transmission path can support them?
question_81212.ground_truth: It is recommended that when adapting to a higher rate the sender increases the rate only to the next higher rate in the list of codec modes allowed in the session, because it is unknown in the beginning of the RTP stream whether the transmission path can support higher rates.

question_81213.question: What should the network do in case 2 if the TFT operation is "Replace packet filters in existing TFT" or "Add packet filters to existing TFT"?
question_81213.ground_truth: The network should process the new request as a request with TFT operation = "Create a new TFT" in this case.

question_81215.question: What is the model used to calculate the macrocell pathloss in the suburban and urban macrocell environments?
question_81215.ground_truth: The macrocell pathloss is based on the modified COST231 Hata urban propagation model.

question_81216.question: When are non-supported IEs rejected or ignored in the 3GPP charging system?
question_81216.ground_truth: IEs can be rejected by the receiver if they are unexpected and determine the conditions for rejection (e.g., due to specific Node and message context). If not specified in the middle Tier TS, the IE is ignored if not supported. IEs are mandatory to be supported by the receiver when received in the context of a specific middle Tier TS. When unexpected in a specific middle Tier TS, Node, and message, the receiver may reject or ignore the non-supported IEs.

question_81218.question: What is one potential new requirement needed to support Ambient IoT devices in the 5G system?
question_81218.ground_truth: One potential new requirement needed to support Ambient IoT devices is the support of energy efficient communication mechanisms to minimize device communication power consumption.

question_81219.question: What entities are impacted by the introduction of the CAG-based UE access control via MBSR?
question_81219.ground_truth: AMF, GMLC, MBSR, and UEs are impacted by the introduction of the CAG-based UE access control via MBSR.

question_81220.question: In the context of MC Bearer Context Setup procedure, what must the gNB-CU-UP check if MRB resources are requested to be setup by the gNB-CU-CP and the MBS Session Associated Information Non-Support-to-Support IE is contained in the MC BEARER CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST message?
question_81220.ground_truth: The gNB-CU-UP must perform duplication elimination between the packets delivered through the individual NG-U tunnel and the shared NG-U tunnel if it supports this procedure.

question_81221.question: When should a Mobile Station use a request from the CM layer for a service other than an emergency call as a trigger for a normal location updating procedure?
question_81221.ground_truth: When the Mobile Station's attempt counter reaches the value of 4, it should use a request for a CM connection other than emergency call as a trigger for a location updating procedure.

question_81223.question: What should be the level of the interfering signal when applied on the other port mapped to the same receiver as the wanted signal for a single-band or multi-band test?
question_81223.ground_truth: The level of the interfering signal should be set to the same level as the wanted signal when applied on the other port mapped to the same receiver as the wanted signal for a single-band or multi-band test.

question_81224.question: Which role is responsible for storing the current count of UEs and PDU Sessions in the AMF Set in the solution #9?
question_81224.ground_truth: The AMF is responsible for storing the current count of UEs and PDU Sessions in the AMF Set in the solution #9.

question_81227.question: What is the maximum size of an SDS message for an MCData client to send a group SDS message if the value of the "mcdata-on-network-max-data-size-for-SDS" is 1200 and the value of the "mcdata-max-data-in-single-request" is 800?
question_81227.ground_truth: The maximum size of an SDS message for an MCData client to send a group SDS message is 800 bytes.

question_81228.question: What type of spatial audio is well suited for creating hyper-realistic mixes required by professional live VR applications, where audio elements can be positioned in 'world-space' and transformed by a presentation manager to match multiple viewpoints?

question_81230.question: What is the purpose of the "name" parameter in the discoverService() method?
question_81230.ground_truth: The "name" parameter in the discoverService() method conveys the required service type and is key to the central purpose of "service trading".

question_81231.question: What are the recommendations for spurious emissions in frequency ranges 7-13 GHz and 13-24 GHz, respectively?
question_81231.ground_truth: The recommended upper limit for measurements in the 7-13 GHz range is 26 GHz, and for 13-24 GHz, the upper limit is the 2nd harmonic.

question_81234.question: Which type of addresses are allocated to all IM CN subsystem entities?
question_81234.ground_truth: All IM CN subsystem entities are allocated IP addresses.

question_81235.question: What happens to the UE when the corresponding bit for the subgroup the UE belongs to is not indicated as 1 by the PEI corresponding to its PO?
question_81235.ground_truth: The UE will not monitor the associated PO with subgrouping if the corresponding bit is not indicated as 1.

question_81236.question: What is a network-initiated deregistration event at the S-CSCF that can be received from the HSS or can be an internal event in the S-CSCF?
question_81236.ground_truth: A network-initiated deregistration event that occurs at the S-CSCF can be received from the HSS or can be an internal event in the S-CSCF.

question_81237.question: What is the purpose of the SIP signalling protection in relation to the MIME body?
question_81237.ground_truth: The protection of the SIP signalling will also protect the present MIME body.

question_81238.question: What action does the UE take when it decides to deregister for ProSe?
question_81238.ground_truth: The UE acknowledges the deregistration request by sending a UE Deregistration Response message and removes the stored ProSe context for the UE.

question_81240.question: What should the UE do during the period from time point A to time point F (1120 ms after the start of time duration T5) in this test?
question_81240.ground_truth: During that period, the UE shall transmit uplink signal at least once every DRX cycle, in the On-duration part of the cycle in the subframe on PCell and PSCell.

question_81241.question: What does the term "network deployment" refer to in the context of content delivery modelling?
question_81241.ground_truth: In the context of content delivery modelling, a network deployment refers to the network infrastructure that supports the transport of packets, including the maximum transfer unit (MTU) size and typical link MTU size, which affects IP packet fragmentation.

question_81243.question: What is the gain provided by the semi-static SBFD in the uplink (UL) when using SBFD Alt 4 and a large packet size at a medium load level?
question_81243.ground_truth: The semi-static SBFD provides a mean and 5% UL Average-UPT gain of 1.08%.

question_81244.question: What is the function of the LTE eNB in the inter-RAT energy saving scenario?
question_81244.ground_truth: The LTE eNB is responsible for activating the dormant capacity booster NR cell and making energy saving decisions in the inter-RAT energy saving scenario.

question_81245.question: What are the 2nd priority channels which do not meet the absolute MPL target with an ISD of 200m for the Suburban 28GHz TDD NLOS O2O scenario?
question_81245.ground_truth: None of the 2nd priority channels meet the absolute MPL target with an ISD of 200m for the Suburban 28GHz TDD NLOS O2O scenario.

question_81247.question: When would the procedure be triggered due to successful completion of Mobility from NR to E-UTRA?
question_81247.ground_truth: The procedure would be triggered due to successful completion of Mobility from NR to E-UTRA when the UE transitions from the NR network to the E-UTRA network.

question_81248.question: What happens after the MCPTT User Services Client sends an HTTP POST message to the form provided in step (5c)?
question_81248.ground_truth: After receiving the HTTP POST message from the MCPTT User Services Client, USC Identity Management (Domain 1) sends an HTTP 302 FOUND containing a SAML response redirecting the User Services Client to USC Identity Management (Domain 2).

question_81250.question: What is the role of the Smart Secure Platform (SSP) in the context of the 5G system?
question_81250.ground_truth: The Smart Secure Platform (SSP) is a flexible solution for credential storage and processing in the 5G system, in addition to the existing UICC platform. The possibility of including the SSP in the 5G system depends on the progress of the ETSI SCP on the topic.

question_81251.question: Which type of orbit is considered a Low Earth Orbit?
question_81251.ground_truth: An orbit around the Earth with an altitude between 300 km and 1500 km is considered a Low Earth Orbit.

question_81252.question: What is the variable that represents the periodicity of the PRS-RSRP measurement in positioning frequency layer i, in the equation for the scaling factor for a positioning frequency layer within the associated measurement gap pattern?
question_81252.ground_truth: is the periodicity of the PRS-RSRP measurement in positioning frequency layer i.

question_81253.question: What aspects are not considered in this 5GS ATSSS study?
question_81253.ground_truth: This study does not include changes to the charging framework, ATSSS procedures applied in NG-RAN, 5GS enhancements to support trusted non-3GPP access networks, and 5GS enhancements to support wireline access networks.

question_81255.question: What is the purpose of the non-numerical K1 feature in the new 5G design?
question_81255.ground_truth: The non-numerical K1 feature is introduced to allow the gNB not to provide a time to report ACK/NACK when scheduling the PDSCH. The UE will hold on to the ACK/NACK corresponds to the PDSCH and report ACK/NACK when a later PDSCH is scheduled with another DL grant with proper K1 timing indicated.

question_81256.question: What information is exchanged in the load reporting function for inter-system load balancing between NG-RAN and E-UTRAN?
question_81256.ground_truth: Cell Capacity Class value, Capacity value, RRC connections, number of active UEs, and Radio Resource Status are exchanged.

question_81257.question: What procedure is followed in this solution for relocating the application context for a UE?
question_81257.ground_truth: The source Edge Application Server determines the need for application context relocation, sends the relocation request to the source EES, which then determines the target Edge Application Server and its associated EES, and sends the application context relocation request to the target EES for UE application context transfer. The target Edge Application Server responds with an application context relocation response, and the source EES returns the response to the source Edge Application Server. The UE application context is then transferred from the source Edge Application Server to the target Edge Application Server.

question_81259.question: What should the floor participant do after sending a Floor Ack message in response to a Floor Idle message?
question_81259.ground_truth: The floor participant may provide a floor idle notification to the MCPTT user and shall stop timer T100 (Floor Release).

question_81260.question: What should the initiating UE do if retransmission timer T5087 expires and the PC5 signalling protocol cause included in the PC5 signalling protocol cause IE is not #4 "direct connection is not available anymore" or not #5 "lack of resources for 5G ProSe direct link"?
question_81260.ground_truth: If the retransmission timer T5087 expires and the PC5 signalling protocol cause is not #4 "direct connection is not available anymore" or not #5 "lack of resources for 5G ProSe direct link", the initiating UE should initiate the transmission of the PROSE DIRECT LINK RELEASE REQUEST message again and restart timer T5087.

question_81261.question: Which two elements are specified in the 3GPP TS 24.379 for MCPTT call control and TS 24.380 for MCPTT media plane control?
question_81261.ground_truth: TS 24.379 specifies the protocol aspects of the MCPTT service for call control and TS 24.380 specifies the protocol aspects of the MCPTT service for media plane.

question_81262.question: What should the P-CSCF do if it detects a PCRF failure?
question_81262.ground_truth: It should initiate the appropriate teardown action as specified in the corresponding specification.

question_81263.question: What is the role of the HSS in the WLAN UE location retrieval process?
question_81263.ground_truth: The HSS returns the address of AAA server of the target WLAN UE and the capability of the WLAN UE to the GMLC.

question_81264.question: What is the duration of T1 and T2 in the test procedure described in 5.2.9.4.2?
question_81264.ground_truth: The duration of T1 and T2 in the test procedure described in 5.2.9.4.2 are time durations of T1, T2 respectively.

question_81265.question: What is the task of the SS in step 3 of 10.4.1.4.2?
question_81265.ground_truth: The SS analyzes the E-TFCI transmitted on the E-DPCCH for each E-DCH TTI to determine if a missed detection event has occurred.

question_81266.question: What is the effect of the introduction of IAB node on the NR design from the IAB-DU perspective?
question_81266.ground_truth: The introduction of the IAB node should be transparent to the UE from the IAB-DU perspective.

question_81269.question: In subclause 10.5.2, which TPI bit(s) will the UE ignore during downlink compressed mode?
question_81269.ground_truth: The UE will ignore the other TPI bit if one of the two slots carrying the TPI bits overlaps a downlink transmission gap.

question_81271.question: What is the role of the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) in the development of the present document?
question_81271.ground_truth: The 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) is the organization that produced the present document.

question_81273.question: What should a GSM switching entity do if it receives a CUG Interlock code in a call establishment message but does not support the CUG service?
question_81273.ground_truth: The GSM switching entity should abort the call, with a reason for rejection being "Incompatible Destination".

question_81274.question: What type of tunnel information is included in the L2TP Tunnel Information for setting up a L2TP tunnel and L2TP session information to setup a L2TP session?
question_81274.ground_truth: L2TP Tunnel Information includes LNS IPv4 address or IPv6 address of LNS, Tunnel Password. L2TP Session Information includes specific information related to the PDU Session, e.g. a Calling Number which may be set to UE's GPSI, an indication to instruct that the UPF or UPF+PGW-U shall request the LNS to allocate an IP address for the PDU Session, indications to instruct that the UPF or UPF+PGW-U shall request the LNS to provide DNS server addresses or NBNS server addresses etc. as specified in 3GPP TS 29.244.

question_81278.question: Under what circumstances would a UE initiate the RRC connection resume procedure in 5.3.13.2 with resumeCause set to mt-Access?
question_81278.ground_truth: When upper layers or the AS request the resume of a suspended RRC connection or the initiation of SDT as specified in clause 5.3.13.1b, and the UE has valid and up-to-date essential system information as specified in clause 5.2.2.2.

question_81279.question: What information does the PA.PolicyAMAssoReq.SNSSAI subcounter provide?
question_81279.ground_truth: The number of AM policy association requests received by the visiting PCF (V-PCF) per S-NSSAI.

question_81280.question: What is the potential limitation of solution 7 for key issue #3 as a fallback use case?
question_81280.ground_truth: The potential limitation of solution 7 for key issue #3 as a fallback use case is that there may be scenarios where there are no other visible WLAN APs or where the serving network does not have location information for other visible WLAN APs.

question_81281.question: What is the MMBox-Storage-Requested AVP (AVP code 1248) indicating with the value of "1"?
question_81281.ground_truth: An MMBox storage has been requested by the originator MMS User Agent.

question_81283.question: What is the first step when a UE realizes it is losing connection to the network?
question_81283.ground_truth: The first step is for UE-1 (Remote UE) to perform ProSe UE-Network Relay discovery over PC5 and establish a secure point-to-point link with the Relay (UE-R) over PC5.

question_81284.question: What must a UE validate a Semi-Persistent Scheduling assignment PDCCH for, if the UE is to validate a Semi-Persistent Scheduling assignment in accordance with the new data indicator field and the scrambling of the Semi-Persistent Scheduling C-RNTI or UL-SPS-V-RNTI?
question_81284.ground_truth: A UE must validate that the CRC parity bits obtained for the PDCCH payload are scrambled with the Semi-Persistent Scheduling C-RNTI or UL-SPS-V-RNTI and the new data indicator field is set to '0' for the enabled transport block, in order to validate a Semi-Persistent Scheduling assignment with the aforementioned conditions.

question_81286.question: What is the significance of the "PS to CS SRVCC handover, general non-specific failure" value in the "<srvcch>" parameter?
question_81286.ground_truth: The "PS to CS SRVCC handover, general non-specific failure" value in the "<srvcch>" parameter indicates that there has been a general non-specific failure in the PS to CS SRVCC handover process.

question_81287.question: What is the difference between KPI 1 and KPI 2 in terms of communication?
question_81287.ground_truth: KPI 1 does not include MCPTT call establishment, while KPI 2 does include MCPTT call establishment.

question_81288.question: When should a UE send a reception report if the samplePercentage is less than 100?
question_81288.ground_truth: The UE generates a random number which is uniformly distributed in the range of 0 to 100, and sends the reception report when the generated random number is of a lower value than the samplePercentage value.

question_81289.question: What must the SGM-C include in an HTTP PUT request when updating group membership in a group document?
question_81289.ground_truth: The SGM-C must include an Authorization header field with the "Bearer" authentication scheme set to an access token of the "bearer" token type.

question_81290.question: Which node reports the serving NW changes towards PCRF when this monitoring event is requested?
question_81290.ground_truth: The PCEF reports the serving NW that currently services the UE when the "serving NW changes/Roaming changes" monitoring event is requested.

question_81291.question: What is the formula used in USQ module to determine the best quantized values?
question_81291.ground_truth: The Euclidean distance is used in the USQ module to determine the best quantized values.

question_81293.question: What is the purpose of Macro power reduction as an LPN range expansion technique in an interference limited system?
question_81293.ground_truth: The purpose of Macro power reduction as an LPN range expansion technique in an interference limited system is to reduce geometry degradation for UEs in a Macro only system by allowing UEs to select an LPN as the serving sector if it has the best Ec/Io.

question_81296.question: What is necessary for the partner identity management service to grant authorization to a visiting user?
question_81296.ground_truth: The partner identity management service must authenticate and verify the user before granting authorization to a visiting user.

question_81297.question: What are the advantages of SDES in terms of scalability, cost, and performance?
question_81297.ground_truth: SDES is a simple and straightforward approach that does not require additional network elements, expensive computations, or multiple roundtrips, as long as the IMS infrastructure provides the security for the SIP signalling and the SIP proxies.

question_81301.question: How does power control affect the average throughput and relative gains in HSDPA+R99 scenario?
question_81301.ground_truth: Power control has relatively little effect on the average throughput and relative gains in HSDPA+R99 scenario.

question_81302.question: What is the purpose of NR SA FR1 Event-triggered reporting tests without gap under non-DRX for NR satellite access?
question_81302.ground_truth: The purpose of this test is to verify that the UE makes correct reporting of an event, and partly verify the intra-frequency cell search requirements in clauses~14.5.1.0.1.1 and 14.5.1.0.1.2.

question_81303.question: What is the minimum requirement for NCR-MT to evaluate whether the downlink radio link quality becomes worse in CSI-RS based beam failure detection?
question_81303.ground_truth: NCR-MT should evaluate whether the downlink radio link quality on the CSI-RS resource becomes worse than Qout_LR_CSI-RS within TEvaluate_BFD_CSI-RS ms period.

question_81304.question: What do UEs in a RM-DEREGISTERED state with no conditions resulting in limited service state do to access 5GC Emergency Services?
question_81304.ground_truth: They initiate the Initial Registration procedure for normal service instead of Emergency Registration to receive Emergency Services.

question_81305.question: What process may be triggered by the MeNB initiated SgNB Modification procedure during the intra-CU topology adaptation procedure in NSA using MCG SRB?
question_81305.ground_truth: The MeNB initiated SgNB Modification procedure may be triggered by the SgNB initiated SgNB Modification procedure during the intra-CU topology adaptation procedure in NSA using MCG SRB, which provides information such as data forwarding addresses, new SN security key, measurement gap, etc.

question_81306.question: What is the reason for the increase in header overheads with the reduction of TTI duration?
question_81306.ground_truth: The shorter TTI duration leads to smaller TBS, which in turn results in more segments in the RLC layer. This brings more header bits in RLC and MAC, increasing the overall header overheads.

question_81308.question: What action does the network take upon receipt of an ATTACH REQUEST message sent with a randomly selected random TLLI?
question_81308.ground_truth: The network assigns a P-TMSI to the MS and derives a local TLLI from the assigned P-TMSI, which it then transmits to the MS.

question_81311.question: What two additional documents are included in the STa reference point for Trusted non-3GPP IP Access over the STa reference point?

question_81312.question: What is the difference in behavior between the three different settings of the "Gm origination with CS media" policy in ICS UE?
question_81312.ground_truth: When set to "Gm disabled", the ICS UE will not use the procedure specified in clause~7.3.2.2.4. When set to "Gm enabled but not preferred", the ICS UE will not use the procedure if the destination is a telephone number with no additional SIP parameters required, but will use it in other cases. When set to "Gm enabled", the ICS UE will always use the procedure specified in clause~7.3.2.2.4.

question_81314.question: What should the MCPTT client do after sending a GROUP CALL PROBE message in the "S1: start-stop" state?
question_81314.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should start the TFG3 and TFG1 timers, enter the "S2: waiting for call announcement" state, and create a call type control state machine.

question_81315.question: Which two solutions, out of solutions #5.1, #5.2, and #5.8, solve key issues #5a, #5b, and #5c related to the charging mechanism for 5G data connectivity usage when roaming?
question_81315.ground_truth: Solutions #5.1 and #5.8 both solve key issues #5a, #5b, and #5c related to the charging mechanism for 5G data connectivity usage when roaming.

question_81316.question: What are the three main functional blocks of the AAS BS radio architecture?
question_81316.ground_truth: The three main functional blocks of the AAS BS radio architecture are the transceiver unit array (TRXUA), the radio distribution network (RDN), and the antenna array (AA).

question_81317.question: What does it mean for a UE to be indicated for the second HARQ-ACK reporting mode?
question_81317.ground_truth: When a UE is indicated for the second HARQ-ACK reporting mode, it changes the HARQ-ACK reporting mode and the PUCCH resource selection rules. The UE also does not expect to be provided pdsch-HARQ-ACK-Codebook = semi-static for multicast HARQ-ACK information.

question_81318.question: In which situations are packet only MSs required to assume GSM COMPACT as the lowest priority radio access technology?
question_81318.ground_truth: A packet only MS, which supports GSM COMPACT but has no access technology information storage in the SIM, shall assume GSM COMPACT as the lowest priority radio access technology when selecting a PLMN.

question_81319.question: What is the state of the UE before the test procedure in 9.1.5.17.3.1(1) begins?
question_81319.ground_truth: The UE is in state 5GMM-REGISTERED and 5GMM-IDLE mode over 3GPP access.

question_81321.question: What is the format of the "TYPE 1" IOI (Initial-OI) if the IOI is Type 1 in the P-Charging-Vector header field?
question_81321.ground_truth: The "TYPE 1" IOI (Initial-OI) in the P-Charging-Vector header field is represented as a quoted string starting with the "Type 1" string prefix followed by the IOI value.

question_81323.question: What is the purpose of the resetTimerGPRS operation in the eZone?
question_81323.ground_truth: The resetTimerGPRS operation is used to request the gprsSSF to refresh an application timer in the gprsSSF.

question_81324.question: What information does the SMF2 send to the SMF1 via the GSMF after it receives a N19 tunnel establishment request from the SMF1?
question_81324.ground_truth: The SMF2 sends respond to the SMF1 including (list of) UPF tunnel information and corresponding UE IP address(es) served by the UPF(s) for the 5G VN group.

question_81325.question: What shall the MS do following the successful location request on the VPLMN of the home country and after the first search the mobile has failed to find its HPLMN?
question_81325.ground_truth: The MS shall perform a location update request on the HPLMN after time T, which is the HPLMN Search Period stored in the SIM.

question_81326.question: In which step is the UE instructed to retune to the target radio?
question_81326.ground_truth: The UE is instructed to retune to the target radio in step 7a and step 11.

question_81327.question: What is the size of the Random Access Preamble Identifier field in bits?
question_81327.ground_truth: The size of the Random Access Preamble Identifier field is 6 bits.

question_81328.question: What do the 3GPP specifications control in terms of intermodulation products in a BS?
question_81328.ground_truth: Intermodulation products generated in the antenna system are not controlled by 3GPP specifications. Therefore, to ensure continued satisfactory operation of a BS, an operator will normally select NR-ARFCNs to minimize intermodulation products falling on receive channels. For testing of complete conformance, an operator may specify the NR-ARFCNs to be used.

question_81329.question: What is the requirement for providing privacy protection of the UEs involved in the unicast session?
question_81329.ground_truth: In order to get privacy protection from the other participant in the unicast session, it is necessary to drop the unicast connection and re-initialise it with a different long term credential, which prevents the need to coordinate the change of higher layer credentials with PC5 layer credentials in order to preserve the privacy requested by the application.

question_81330.question: What is the procedure for a MCVideo client to retrieve MCVideo capabilities information from the MCVideo server?
question_81330.ground_truth: The MCVideo client requests the MCVideo capabilities information by specifying some criteria, the MCVideo server checks if the user of the MCVideo client is authorized to retrieve the information, and if authorized, the MCVideo server provides the requested MCVideo capabilities information to the MCVideo client.

question_81332.question: Which technical specification describes the charging aspects for 5G ProSe charging in the TS 32.277?

question_81333.question: What information should be included in the cgi-Info-5GC for each cell, if the purpose is set to reportCGI and the corresponding measObject is associated with NR RAT?
question_81333.ground_truth: For each cell, plmn-IdentityInfoList including plmn-IdentityList, trackingAreaCode (if available), ran-AreaCode (if available) and cellIdentity for each entry of the plmn-IdentityInfoList, frequencyBandList (if broadcasted), gNB-ID-Length (if broadcasted), should be included. If the MIB associated with the concerned measObject indicates that SIB1 is not broadcast, the noSIB1 field should be included.

question_81334.question: What does CC represent in the context of these measurements?
question_81334.ground_truth: It refers to the type of traffic, which is packet switched in this case.

question_81335.question: What RLC-SAP is used in the MBSInterestIndication message to transmit from UE to Network?

question_81336.question: What is the average L1-RSRP difference of the Top-1 predicted beam pair based on five sources?
question_81336.ground_truth: The average L1-RSRP difference of the Top-1 predicted beam pair can be below or about 1dB, and 1dB~2dB based on five different sources.

question_81337.question: What factors determine the number of outlying subcarriers in the LTE-MTC carrier?
question_81337.ground_truth: The choice of NR subcarrier index within a RB for placing the LTE-MTC carrier determines the number of outlying subcarriers in the LTE-MTC carrier.

question_81338.question: What action does the network take when the UE selects an inappropriate N3IWF for the requested slices that the UE is allowed to access?
question_81338.ground_truth: The AMF sends a UE Registration Reject message to the UE, indicating that the selected N3IWF was not appropriate for the requested slices. The AMF may also provide target N3IWF information to the UE in the Registration Reject message.

question_81339.question: What must the HSS do if there is no stored STN-SR in the HSS for the specified Service-Indication and IMS Public User Identity or Public Service Identity?
question_81339.ground_truth: The HSS must check whether the Sequence Number in the Sh-Update Req is 0.

question_81341.question: Under which conditions can an ICS User use a non-ICS UE for IMS multimedia telephony communication service settings data management?
question_81341.ground_truth: When the ICS User uses a non-ICS UE not supporting multimedia telephony and a downloadable application can be used to manage the communication service settings data.

question_81343.question: What are the issues that could arise when relying solely on 5G security mechanisms, without realizing security on top, in automation applications?
question_81343.ground_truth: Relying on 5G security alone may shorten the lifespan of battery-powered IoT devices and deteriorate dependability parameters for automation applications. Automation applications need to verify that required 5G security mechanisms are actually active to ensure security and dependability.

question_81346.question: What is the CCA value for a UE supporting FR2-2 power class 1 to measure intra-frequency without gaps?

question_81347.question: Which document defines a solution for dealing with multiple audio streams during a call in MCPTT?
question_81347.ground_truth: 3GPP TS~23.379 subclause 10.9.1.3.2.2 defines a solution for dealing with multiple audio streams during a call in MCPTT.

question_81348.question: In test case 26.8.1.4.5.8, what action should the CC entity of the MS take if an unknown message is received in state U26, mobile originating modify?
question_81348.ground_truth: The CC entity of the MS should return a STATUS message.

question_81350.question: What is the effect of time-dilated UMTS on the Reference Sensitivity level (REFSENS)?
question_81350.ground_truth: The REFSENS values will need to be re-evaluated for time-dilated UMTS, taking into account the new chip rate and potential changes to the physical layer and filter design.

question_81351.question: What action should the MCPTT client take upon receiving a SIP 2xx response to the SIP re-INVITE request when sending a SIP re-INVITE request to cancel the imminent peril group state of the group?
question_81351.ground_truth: After receiving a SIP 2xx response to the SIP re-INVITE request, the MCPTT client should interact with the user plane as specified in 3GPP TS 24.380, set the MCPTT imminent peril group state of the group to "MIG 1: no-imminent-peril", and set the MCPTT imminent peril group call state of the group to "MIGC 1: imminent-peril-gc-capable".

question_81352.question: What is the general ON/OFF time mask rule for intra-band contiguous multi-carrier operation?
question_81352.ground_truth: For intra-band contiguous multi-carrier operation, the general ON/OFF time mask is applicable for each component carrier during the ON power period and the transient periods, while the OFF period is only applicable for each component carrier when all the component carriers are OFF.

question_81353.question: What is the minimum number of SSBs that a UE needs to be capable of performing SS-RSRP, SS-RSRQ, and SS-SINR measurements for within a layer 1 measurement period for FR1 in a single intra-frequency layer?
question_81353.ground_truth: At least 24 SSBs with different SSB index and/or PCI

question_81354.question: What are the drawbacks of the small data solution in LTE?
question_81354.ground_truth: The small data solution requires an increase in MME capacity for this traffic, MME required to queue DL data together with the paging when UE is idle which could be lengthy, separate API calls to be used if the application has to select the data path and typically TCP transport scenario requires multiple round trips.

question_81356.question: How can a "trigger-id" attribute be used in the "cell-change" criteria?
question_81356.ground_truth: The "trigger-id" attribute can be used in the "cell-change" criteria to specify a unique string that identifies what cell changes trigger the request for a location report.

question_81358.question: What action does the MAC entity take when the maximum uplink transmission timing difference between TAGs of the MAC entity or between TAGs of any MAC entity of the UE is exceeded for an SCell?
question_81358.ground_truth: The MAC entity considers the timeAlignmentTimer associated with the SCell as expired and stops uplink transmissions for the SCell.

question_81359.question: What factors does the PCRF take into account when determining transfer policies for background data transfer?
question_81359.ground_truth: The PCRF determines transfer policies based on the information provided by the AF, network policy, congestion level, load status estimation for the required time window and network area, and existing transfer policies.

question_81361.question: What are the responsibilities of the rSRVCC UE during the handover procedure?
question_81361.ground_truth: The rSRVCC UE indicates its rSRVCC capability to the access network and IMS, pre-allocates ports for voice after the handover, informs the network about supported Codecs, and re-establishes the session control of the media after handover to the target access.

question_81362.question: In a URSP rule, what does a PDU Session Pair ID indicate?
question_81362.ground_truth: An PDU Session Pair ID is an indication shared by redundant PDU Sessions. For backward compatibility, PCF may provide a RSD with PDU Session Pair ID and RSN and a RSD without PDU Session Pair ID in the URSP rule. In this case, the RSD with PDU Session Pair ID and RSN has a lower precedence value (i.e. higher prioritised) than the one without PDU Session Pair ID. If a non-supporting UE receives the RSD containing PDU Session Pair ID, it ignores this RSD.

question_81363.question: What is the purpose of the "Control Plane Only" indicator in the EPS CIoT Optimization?
question_81363.ground_truth: The Control Plane Only indicator is used to prevent situations where a Reliable Data Service instance needs to interface to both the user and control plane.

question_81366.question: What should the UE do if, upon an inter-system change from N1 mode to NB-S1 mode in EMM-IDLE mode, the number of active default EPS bearer contexts in the UE is larger than the UE's implementation-specific maximum number of active user plane radio bearers and the UE is using user plane CIoT EPS optimization?
question_81366.ground_truth: The UE shall locally deactivate at least one default EPS bearer context such that the total number of active default EPS bearer contexts that remained does not exceed the UE's implementation-specific maximum number of active user plane radio bearers.

question_81368.question: What is the PC5 parameters provisioning over V1 issue about?
question_81368.ground_truth: The PC5 parameters provisioning over V1 issue is about the current lack of provisioning PC5 based discovery and communication parameters over V1 reference point, which is needed to support the business model that the V2X application server is dominated by 3rd party, and how to provision PC5 based discovery and communication parameters over V1 reference point.

question_81370.question: What is the length of the LCG ID field in the Short BSR format and the Short Truncated BSR format?
question_81370.ground_truth: The length of the LCG ID field in the Short BSR format and the Short Truncated BSR format is 3 bits.

question_81371.question: What is the purpose of the second stage decoding in the process?
question_81371.ground_truth: The second stage decoding is performed if certain conditions are met after the first stage decoding, and it involves decoding the second stage global gain and updating it, as well as reconstructing the spectrum of the upper band using the contribution of the second stage decoding.

question_81372.question: What information does the PCF return for the S-NSSAI of the serving network?
question_81372.ground_truth: The PCF returns the authorized UE-Slice-MBR for the S-NSSAI of the serving network.

question_81375.question: When do IARP rules for APN apply and when do they not apply?
question_81375.ground_truth: IARP rules for APN apply when they steer IP traffic to an existing PDN connection, and they do not apply when no APN in the IARP for APN rule is associated with an existing PDN connection.

question_81376.question: What is used to transfer location information from the UTRAN to the CN for an active UE?
question_81376.ground_truth: The Location Information Update function is used to transfer location information from the UTRAN to the CN for an active UE. The UTRAN sends this information initially at the signalling connection establishment for a UE and at any change of the UE location as long as the signalling connection exists.

question_81377.question: In the context of a radio link addition response for FDD and TDD, what should the Node B include in the RADIO LINK ADDITION RESPONSE message for the transport bearer to be established for each DSCH and USCH in TDD?
question_81377.ground_truth: In the context of a radio link addition response for FDD and TDD, the Node B should include both the Transport Layer Address IE and the Binding ID IE for the transport bearer to be established for each DSCH and USCH in TDD.

question_81378.question: What is one requirement for a UE to be able to recover a file from a repair server?
question_81378.ground_truth: A UE that is unable to receive a file and its FDT during the scheduled broadcast window should be able to fully recover the file from the repair server.

question_81379.question: What is the condition for the MAC entity to stop an ongoing Random Access procedure due to a pending SR for BFR of an SCell without valid PUCCH resources?
question_81379.ground_truth: The MAC entity may stop the ongoing Random Access procedure due to a pending SR for BFR of an SCell without valid PUCCH resources if a MAC PDU is transmitted using a UL grant other than a UL grant provided by Random Access Response or a UL grant determined as specified in clause 5.1.2a for the transmission of the MSGA payload, and this PDU contains a MAC CE for BFR which includes beam failure recovery information of that SCell.

question_81380.question: What is the impact of handover on the control procedure and operation of the service?
question_81380.ground_truth: Handover has no impact on the control procedure and operation of the service.

question_81381.question: What is required for the key derivation for protected payloads?
question_81381.ground_truth: For key derivation, the MC client(s) or MC server(s) need to have a shared DPPK, which is then hashed through a KDF to produce a DPCK. The DPPK will also have a shared key identifier, the DPPK-ID, which is used as input to the KDF.

question_81382.question: What is the purpose of the Zh' reference point in the bootstrapping approach?
question_81382.ground_truth: The Zh' reference point is optional for the BSF to support for bootstrapping an HLR or HSS without Zh reference point support.

question_81383.question: What is the responsibility of the LMF after receiving the network positioning message from the AMF?
question_81383.ground_truth: The LMF identifies the UE using the UE ID in the network positioning message, authenticates the UE ID using the authentication code in the network positioning message, and determines or verifies a location estimate for the UE using the location measurements or location estimate included in the network positioning messages.

question_81384.question: What is the role of the reset parameter in the getMessageListReq() method?
question_81384.ground_truth: The reset parameter in the getMessageListReq() method indicates whether the application intends to obtain the list of messages starting from the beginning (TRUE) or requests the next part of the list that has not (yet) been obtained since the last call to this method with this parameter set to TRUE (FALSE).

question_81385.question: What does the MCPTT server do after receiving an imminent peril group call request towards its affiliated MCPTT group members?
question_81385.ground_truth: The MCPTT server sends the imminent peril group call request towards the MCPTT clients of each of those affiliated MCPTT group members. It includes an indication of the in-progress imminent peril in the request and checks the privacy policy of the MCPTT user to decide if the location information of MCPTT client 1 can be provided to other users on the call.

question_81386.question: What methods can be used to initially access a service based on this specification?
question_81386.ground_truth: Service access for services based on this specification can be achieved using a Media Presentation Description or a URL to the media file. The service access URL can be made available through HTTP or embedded within HTML pages.

question_81387.question: In the context of case n), what must the AMF do for each payload container entry of the Payload container IE?
question_81387.ground_truth: The AMF must set the payload container type field of the payload container entry to a payload container type value set in the Payload container type IE, set the payload container entry contents field of the payload container entry to the payload container contents set in the Payload container IE and set the optional IE fields, if any, to the optional associated information as specified for cases a) to m3).

question_81389.question: What is the pass criteria for the Compound RTCP Packet Format Test?
question_81389.ground_truth: The pass criteria for this test are that all RTCP packets sent from the SUT fulfil the following: 1) A Sender Report or Receiver Report is included as the first part of the compound RTCP packet, 2) An SDES packet with a CNAME SDES item is included in the compound RTCP packet, 3) Each RTCP packet in the compound RTCP packet starts on a 32-bit boundary, 4) Each RTCP packet in the compound RTCP packet has a length field with a value that is the number of 32-bit words minus one occupied by that RTCP packet, including the RTCP packet header and any padding, and 5) The UDP packet that contains the compound RTCP packet in criteria 4 as payload has a Length field with a value that is 4 times the sum of the length fields in all the RTCP packets in the compound RTCP packet (the total RTCP size in bytes) plus 8 (the UDP header size in bytes).

question_81390.question: What abbreviations are used in the present document for telecommunication management terms?
question_81390.ground_truth: CORBA (Common Object Request Broker Architecture), DN (Distinguished Name), IS (Information Service), IDL (Interface Definition Language), IOC (Information Object Class), IRP (Integration Reference Point), MO (Managed Object), MOC (Managed Object Class), NRM (Network Resource Model), OMG (Object Management Group), and SS (Solution Set).

question_81392.question: How can the MS update information in the GANC regarding changes to the overlapping GERAN cell or changes to the generic IP access network point of attachment?
question_81392.ground_truth: The MS sends a GA-RC REGISTER UPDATE UPLINK message to the GANC carrying the updated information.

question_81393.question: What is the maximum number of 3GPP-UE-MAC-Address sub-attributes that may be sent in one RADIUS CoA or Access-Accept message?
question_81393.ground_truth: The maximum number of 3GPP-UE-MAC-Address sub-attributes that may be sent in one RADIUS CoA or Access-Accept message is 16.

question_81396.question: What is the significance of maximizing commonality of the various protocols that flow on the Iu interface from a UTRAN perspective?
question_81396.ground_truth: Maximizing commonality of the various protocols that flow on the Iu interface from a UTRAN perspective is desirable as it offers a common set of radio access bearer services to Core Network nodes, maintains a common functional split between UTRAN and Core Network nodes, and ensures that signalling in the radio network control plane is not dependent on the specific choice of transport layers.

question_81397.question: What is the maximum throughput for an FRC in E-UTRA?
question_81397.ground_truth: The maximum throughput for an FRC in E-UTRA is equal to the payload size * the number of uplink subframes per second.

question_81398.question: What does the term "Media Service Enablers" refer to in the context of the 3GPP?
question_81398.ground_truth: Media Service Enablers refer to a set of functions that support third-party applications in making use of advanced functionalities provided by the 5G System. This includes well-defined client and network functionalities for a media service.

question_81399.question: Under what conditions must a UE not initiate the detach signalling procedure?
question_81399.ground_truth: The UE shall not initiate the detach signalling procedure unless the current TAI is part of the TAI list.

question_81400.question: What should the UE do if timer T3585 is running or deactivated for an S-NSSAI and old PLMN or SNPN, but not running and not deactivated for the S-NSSAI and new PLMN or SNPN upon SNPN change?
question_81400.ground_truth: The UE is allowed to send a PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for the same S-NSSAI in the new PLMN or SNPN if timer T3585 is running or deactivated for an S-NSSAI and old PLMN or SNPN, but not running and not deactivated for the S-NSSAI and new PLMN or SNPN upon SNPN change.

question_81401.question: What is the data type of the "user-max-simultaneous-authorizations" element and what does it indicate?
question_81401.ground_truth: The data type of the "user-max-simultaneous-authorizations" element is "positiveInteger", and it indicates the maximum allowed number of simultaneous service authorizations for the MCData user.

question_81402.question: How does the MCPTT Key Management Server (KMS) manage the security domain?
question_81402.ground_truth: The MCPTT Key Management Server (KMS) manages the security domain by provisioning key material associated to specific MCPTT identities. For any endpoint to use or access end-to-end secure communications, it shall be provisioned with key material associated with its identity. Through the use of the KMS, MCPTT administrators can manage access to communications within the MCPTT network.

question_81403.question: What is the abbreviation for "Circuit-Switched" in the 3GPP system context?

question_81404.question: What is the agreed performance metric for evaluation of co-existence performance for V2V in TR 36.885 Section 9.1.1?
question_81404.ground_truth: The agreed performance metric for evaluation of co-existence performance for V2V is the Packet Reception Ratio (PRR) as defined in TR 36.885 Section 9.1.1.

question_81406.question: What should the MCPTT client do when it receives a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP BYE request?
question_81406.ground_truth: When the MCPTT client receives a SIP 200 (OK) response to the SIP BYE request, it should interact with the media plane and terminate the call.

question_81408.question: In the context of TS 24.379, what should the MCPTT server do upon receiving a SIP PUBLISH request, as specified in clause 7.3.4, if service authorization was successful and a Resource-Share header with the value "supported" was included in the third-party REGISTER request?
question_81408.ground_truth: Upon receiving a SIP PUBLISH request with a specific condition, the MCPTT server should bind the MCPTT ID to the identity of the MCPTT UE if the Resource-Share header with the value "supported" was included in the third-party REGISTER request that contained the IMS public user identity.

question_81410.question: What is the role of the RAN-INFORMATION-ACK PDU in this process?
question_81410.ground_truth: The RAN-INFORMATION-ACK PDU is used to acknowledge the receipt of the RAN-INFORMATION PDU.

question_81411.question: What should the UE do if it is not able to report the requested measurement results in the mobile-terminated location request procedure using network-assisted UE-assisted GPS?
question_81411.ground_truth: The UE should include the IE "UE positioning error" in the MEASUREMENT REPORT and set the contents of this IE as specified in subclause 8.6.7.19.5.

question_81414.question: At medium load level, what is the 5% UL Average-UPT loss with SBFD Alt 2 and large packet size?
question_81414.ground_truth: The 5% UL Average-UPT loss with SBFD Alt 2 and large packet size at medium load level is -27.16%.

question_81415.question: What is the service provided to Disaster Inbound Roamers only within the specific region where Disaster Condition applies?
question_81415.ground_truth: Provision of service to Disaster Inbound Roamers only within the specific region where Disaster Condition applies.

question_81416.question: What is the abbreviation for "User Equipment" in the context of 3GPP specifications?

question_81417.question: How does the NWDAF collect input data for relative proximity analytics?
question_81417.ground_truth: The NWDAF collects input data for relative proximity analytics from various sources, including UE sensor information via trace job or MDT data collection mechanism, individual UE proximity information via DCAF (Direct Communication Application Function), OAM (Operation, Administration and Maintenance) services, AF (Application Function) services, USM (User Service Management) services, GMLC (Gateway Mobile Location Center), and AMF (Access and Mobility Management Function) services.

question_81418.question: What is the procedure for network-initiated IP-CAN session modification?
question_81418.ground_truth: It involves the H-PCRF receiving a trigger to re-evaluate PCC Rules and policy decision for an IP-CAN session, selecting PCC Rules to be installed, modified or removed, storing the updated PCC Rules, and sending a Diameter RAR to request that the PCEF installs, modifies or removes PCC Rules and updates the policy decision.

question_81419.question: What should the MBMS client do if the application supports handling of partial files, and the file was not recovered by any recovery procedure?
question_81419.ground_truth: The MBMS client should provide the partial file to the application including the position of all received bytes.

question_81420.question: How can the geographic information for cell broadcasting be provided by the MTC server to the MTC-IWF?
question_81420.ground_truth: The geographic information for cell broadcasting can be provided by the MTC server to the MTC-IWF through an interface, such as MTCsp, or directly to the CBC.

question_81421.question: With which SS fading function should the SS repeat steps b) to t) for MS indicating VAMOS III support?
question_81421.ground_truth: The SS should repeat steps b) to t) for MS indicating VAMOS III support with the SS fading function set in turn to TU high/(Corr.=0,7, AGI=-6 dB as per 3GPP TS 45.005 Annex Q.7).

question_81423.question: What is the role of the GMLC in Solution 6 in terms of privacy verification?
question_81423.ground_truth: The GMLC is responsible for privacy verification based on information from the PPR in Solution 6.

question_81425.question: What does the 9.2.2.130 IE define in the context of GANSS?
question_81425.ground_truth: This IE defines a particular GANSS.

question_81427.question: What is the role of the AMF in Solution #5.1 upon completion of registration procedure?
question_81427.ground_truth: Upon completion of the registration procedure, the AMF sends a NAS Security Mode Command to the UE to activate NAS security and sends an NGAP Initial Context Setup Request that includes the N3IWF key. The AMF then initiates a deregistration timer for the user plane of the MA PDU session.

question_81428.question: If the unwanted signal is 0.35 dB higher than the wanted signal in the test system, what will be the equivalent percentage uncertainty?
question_81428.ground_truth: The equivalent percentage uncertainty to a 0.35 dB difference between the unwanted and wanted signals is 2.08%.

question_81429.question: During an E-RUCCH transmission triggered by Scheduling Information reporting, what should a UE do if it receives a synchronization establishment command?
question_81429.ground_truth: If a UE receives a synchronization establishment command during an E-RUCCH transmission triggered by Scheduling Information reporting, the UE should not initiate a new E-RUCCH transmission as a response to that command and should ignore the corresponding event.

question_81431.question: Which steering mode is supported by the ATSSS-LL functionality?
question_81431.ground_truth: The ATSSS-LL functionality supports any steering mode that can be used with ATSSS-LL, as specified in clause~5.32.8.

question_81435.question: What is the main advantage of the new solution for MC service UE migration?
question_81435.ground_truth: The main advantage of the new solution is its ability to reuse existing MC service SIP security parameters, eliminating the need for additional SIP security mechanism data or a new SIP security mechanism for migration. Additionally, this solution requires connectivity between the partner MC system and primary MC system, and no new nodes are required.

question_81436.question: What happens if the floor control server of the partner MCPTT system receives multiple floor requests at the same time or during an interval?
question_81436.ground_truth: The floor control server of the partner MCPTT system forwards the floor requests to the floor control server of the primary MCPTT system (the floor arbitrator for the MCPTT group call) and includes priority-related information or group information in the forwarded request.

question_81437.question: What is the default maximum number of codewords for the transmit and receive direction for the Multi-Packet Method in V.44 Method of operation?
question_81437.ground_truth: The default maximum number of codewords for the transmit direction is 2048 and for the receive direction is also 2048.

question_81438.question: In Model A of direct discovery for Proximity-based Services (ProSe), what information does the announcing UE broadcast in the discovery messages?
question_81438.ground_truth: In Model A of direct discovery for Proximity-based Services (ProSe), the announcing UE broadcasts information about itself, such as its ProSe Application Identities or ProSe UE Identities in the discovery message.

question_81439.question: Which security requirements does Solution #3.6 address?

question_81440.question: What procedures are followed for power saving based on updating parameters before releasing the signalling connection?
question_81440.ground_truth: The AMF/MME determines the power saving parameters based on coverage information and provides the parameters to the UE before releasing the signalling connection. The UE then uses these parameters for making sure that it does not attempt to access the network when there is no coverage and that it's aware of the coverage returning and attempts to access the network as needed.

question_81441.question: What is the maximum block error ratio allowed for PDTCH/DAS5 to 12 under different propagation conditions?
question_81441.ground_truth: The block error ratio for PDTCH/DAS5 to 12 under different propagation conditions should not exceed 10% or 30%, depending on Modulation and Coding Schemes.

question_81442.question: What should a Mobile Station (MS) do if it receives a CM SERVICE REJECT or ABORT message with MM cause value #6 before the network has activated the integrity protection for the CS domain?
question_81442.ground_truth: The MS should start timer T3247 with a random value uniformly drawn from the range between 30 minutes and 60 minutes, if the timer is not running. Then, if the MS maintains a counter for "SIM/USIM considered invalid for non-GPRS services" events and the counter has a value less than an MS implementation-specific maximum value, the MS should proceed as specified in subclauses 4.5.1.1 or 4.3.5.2 respectively, but should not consider the SIM/USIM as invalid for non-GPRS services.

question_81443.question: What is the purpose of releasing the RRC connection?
question_81443.ground_truth: The purpose of releasing the RRC connection is to release the established radio bearers and all radio resources.

question_81444.question: What communication protocol is used for session management and media negotiation in MCPTT?
question_81444.ground_truth: The SIP-3 reference point, which uses the SIP core, is used for session management and media negotiation in MCPTT.

question_81445.question: What network modes of operation are supported by MCVideo group and private streaming?
question_81445.ground_truth: MCVideo group streaming and MCVideo private streaming operate in on-network and off-network modes.

question_81446.question: What is the pattern used for the sequence diagram in the case where an application is interested in determining the status of a terminal device and receives a notification?
question_81446.ground_truth: The pattern used for the sequence diagram in this case is the Application Correlated Multiple Notification.

question_81447.question: What is the difference between offline and online charging?
question_81447.ground_truth: Offline charging is a charging mechanism where charging information does not affect, in real-time, the service rendered, while online charging is a charging mechanism where charging information can affect, in real-time, the service rendered and therefore requires a direct interaction of the charging mechanism with bearer/session/service control.

question_81448.question: What is the purpose of using PINs or solving audio riddles in public telephone networks to enhance protection against UC?
question_81448.ground_truth: The purpose is to add an extra layer of security to prevent uninvited calls. However, their suitability for widespread use has to be carefully examined due to their impact on usability.

question_81449.question: What are the possible categories of a UE for E-DPDCH in the "Physical Layer category" section for the E-DCH with 16QAM?
question_81449.ground_truth: The possible categories of a UE for E-DPDCH in the "Physical Layer category" section for the E-DCH with 16QAM are categories 5, 6, 7, 8, and 9.

question_81450.question: What services are provided by the ProSe entity?
question_81450.ground_truth: The ProSe entity provides services such as registration for ProSe services, enabling/disabling of discoverability, discovery of ProSe Service Users in proximity, and enabling/disabling of direct communications.

question_81451.question: What is the role of the Session and Service Continuity (SSC) mode when a network slice becomes unavailable for an ongoing 5G Media Streaming session in the 5G system?
question_81451.ground_truth: Depending on the SSC mode, the SMF may update the network slices in the UE/RAN/UPF via the PDU Session Modification procedure, or trigger the modification/release of the PDU Session and re-establish it in the Alternative S-NSSAI.

question_81452.question: What should the USIM be considered invalid for, if the authentication procedure is not accepted by the network for non-EPS services?
question_81452.ground_truth: The USIM should be considered invalid for non-EPS services, until switching off or the UICC containing the USIM is removed.

question_81454.question: What is one of the initial conditions specified in 8.16.88.4.1 for the test environment?
question_81454.ground_truth: One of the initial conditions specified in 8.16.88.4.1 for the test environment is the normal Test Environment as defined in 3GPP TS 36.508, clause 4.1.

question_81455.question: What message does the target BSS send to the 3G/2G SGSN upon receiving the first correct RLC/MAC block from the MS in the target cell?
question_81455.ground_truth: The target BSS sends a PS Handover Complete (Local TLLI, IMSI, Request for Inter RAT Handover Info) message to the 3G/2G SGSN upon receiving the first correct RLC/MAC block from the MS in the target cell.

question_81457.question: What does the ProSe Function do when it receives a valid Target PDUID - Target RPAUID pair with a valid PC5 radio technology match from the HPLMN ProSe Function?
question_81457.ground_truth: The ProSe Function retrieves the ProSe Restricted Code corresponding to that Target PDUID, Application ID and Target RPAUID and stores the PDUID of the monitoring UE in the context of the announcing UE.

question_81458.question: What is the purpose of using the Supported Features mechanism in Rel-16 for load control?
question_81458.ground_truth: The purpose of using the Supported Features mechanism in Rel-16 for load control is to discover the support of Rel-16 load control mechanism between NF service producer and NF service consumer. This allows a NF service producer to convey the load information to a NF service consumer using a Rel-16 mechanism only if the NF service consumer has included in the Supported Features that it supports Rel-16 load conveyance / control mechanism.

question_81459.question: Where can the NCR-MT channel bandwidth for NCR-MT carrier be placed?
question_81459.ground_truth: The placement of the NCR-MT channel bandwidth, for NCR-MT carrier, is flexible but can only be completely within the NCR-Fwd passband.

question_81463.question: What is the maximum allowed time for consecutive missing ACK/NACK for SCell (Cell 3) before it is considered a fail for the event "Timer based BWP switch"?

question_81466.question: What is the purpose of the ASFunction IOC in the IMS Network Resource Model (NRM) Integration Reference Point (IRP)?
question_81466.ground_truth: The ASFunction IOC represents AS functionality and can be instantiated when a specific Application Server (AS) type is not already represented by an IOC subclassed from this IOC. If the AS type is already represented by an IOC in this specification, then it should be used, and the ASFunction relationships will be carried forward to the sub-classed IOC.

question_81467.question: In the 6.5.3.2 signalling control plane description, what is the function of the local inbound/outbound proxy functional entity?
question_81467.ground_truth: The local inbound/outbound proxy functional entity acts as both an inbound proxy and an outbound proxy for all SIP transactions.

question_81468.question: What is the minimum radio frequency performance standard established by the document for UTRA FDD repeaters?
question_81468.ground_truth: The present document establishes the minimum radio frequency performance for UTRA FDD repeaters.

question_81469.question: What should the SMF set the 5GSM cause IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message to if the connectivity with the requested DN is rejected by the network?
question_81469.ground_truth: The SMF shall set the 5GSM cause IE of the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message to indicate the reason for rejecting the PDU session establishment.

question_81470.question: What does the term "Joint Detection" (JD) represent in the 3GPP TS?
question_81470.ground_truth: Joint Detection (JD) is a method used in 3GPP TS that improves the performance of a receiver by jointly detecting the signals transmitted by multiple users, rather than detecting each signal separately.

question_81471.question: What should the UE do when the size of a list is extended and it receives an extension field with additional entries?
question_81471.ground_truth: The UE should create a combined list by concatenating the additional entries to the original field while maintaining the order among both the original and the additional entries, and then apply the same behavior as defined for the original field for the combined list.

question_81472.question: Which bands should be considered for co-location questions to avoid mutual interference of BS transmitters and receivers?
question_81472.ground_truth: Bands 1, 21, 28, 31, and 44 or Bands 1, 25, and 36 or 37.

question_81474.question: When an MCPTT user wants to cancel an in-progress emergency condition on an MCPTT emergency private call, what should the MCPTT client generate?
question_81474.ground_truth: The MCPTT client should generate a SIP re-INVITE request that follows the UE session procedures specified in 3GPP TS 24.229 and subclause 6.2.8.3.1.2.

question_81477.question: What is provided to the user to increase their visibility of the security features in certain events?
question_81477.ground_truth: Indication of access network encryption and indication of the level of security are provided to the user to increase their visibility of the security features.

question_81478.question: In the calculation of Teff, what are the conditions for a UE to include all PRS resources to be measured in the same PPW occasion during Tavailable?
question_81478.ground_truth: A UE will include all PRS resources to be measured in the same PPW occasion during Tavailable if positioning frequency layer i is in Case 1 and all PRS resources to be measured are available in the same PPW occasion during Tavailable. If positioning frequency layer i is in Case 2 and all PRS resources to be measured are available in the same PPW occasion during Tavailable, the formula is Teff = PPWL.

question_81479.question: What is the formula for calculating the Block Error Rate (BLER) performance based on the number of re-transmitted downlink RLC data blocks?
question_81479.ground_truth: BLER = (Number of re-transmitted downlink RLC data blocks / Total number of downlink RLC data blocks transmitted) * 100%

question_81480.question: When the UE is equipped with a UICC, what should the UE attempt first when selecting an ePDG if the Non-3GPP Access Node Selection Information is not available?
question_81480.ground_truth: If the UE is equipped with a UICC and the Non-3GPP Access Node Selection Information is not available, the UE should first attempt to select an N3IWF following the procedure defined in clause~6.3.6.2 before attempting to select an ePDG.

question_81481.question: What parameters are transmitted within the FEC Scheme-Specific Information?
question_81481.ground_truth: Encoding symbol size (T) and m parameter (m)

question_81483.question: What was the preferred type of building block determined by SAGE for the Tuak design?
question_81483.ground_truth: A hash function was determined to be the best type of building block for the Tuak design.

question_81484.question: How can the UE/UPF identify the start of a PDU Set over RTP/SRTP?
question_81484.ground_truth: The UE/UPF can identify the start of a PDU Set over RTP/SRTP by using the IP packet filter in the PDR (for UPF) or the NAS QoS rules to match the XRM service stream. The RTP payload type can also be used to identify the media type.

question_81486.question: Which of the following security protocols is used for end-to-end media security between the UE and external attached network: SDES, KMS, SRTP, DTLS-SRTP, TLS and pre-shared key ciphersuites?
question_81486.ground_truth: SDES, SRTP, DTLS-SRTP, TLS and pre-shared key ciphersuites

question_81488.question: What special hardware is required to perform radio jamming attacks?
question_81488.ground_truth: Radio jamming attacks can be made with special hardware.

question_81489.question: What are the key features of a delivery manifest?
question_81489.ground_truth: Adaptation to device capability or network bandwidth is the key feature of a delivery manifest. It contains a group of multiple different encodings of the same media component with the description of the encoding variations, enabling adaptive switching of a group of different encodings.

question_81492.question: When is a PDU assembled with a BSR considered to accommodate all pending data available for transmission?
question_81492.ground_truth: When the UL grant(s) can accommodate all pending data available for transmission.

question_81493.question: What frequency range does the T-GSM 380 band operate on for mobile transmit and base receive?

question_81494.question: What should the Node B do when the choice of Continue, Setup or Change is "Setup" in the Multi-Carrier E-DCH Information Reconf IE?
question_81494.ground_truth: The Node B should setup the requested E-DCH resource on the uplink frequencies indicated by the UARFCN IE in the Multi-Carrier E-DCH Information LCR IE.

question_81495.question: What is the minimum downlink total power dynamic range for UTRA FDD in this section?
question_81495.ground_truth: The minimum downlink total power dynamic range for UTRA FDD is 17.7 dB.
