question_82193.question: When should the network include the T3302 value IE in a routing area update reject message, and what effect does this have on the T3302 timer?
question_82193.ground_truth: The network may include the T3302 value IE in a routing area update reject message to indicate a value for the T3302 timer. If the MS is attached for emergency bearer services and this message is not integrity protected, the MS shall use the received contents of this IE. If this IE is not included or if the message is received without integrity protection, the MS shall use the default value.

question_82196.question: How many inter-frequency cells per TDD inter-frequency must the UE be capable of performing RSRP and RSRQ measurements for?
question_82196.ground_truth: The UE must be capable of performing RSRP and RSRQ measurements for at least 3 identified inter-frequency cells per TDD inter-frequency for up to 3 TDD inter-frequencies.

question_82197.question: What is used by the PCEF in the first scenario to collect separate charging information for offline charging for sponsored flows?

question_82198.question: What is the expected result after the ME has performed the second command received from the UICC?

question_82199.question: What is the fundamental goal when measuring L1 throughput during receiver and performance tests in 5G NR?
question_82199.ground_truth: To compare the measured throughput around the expected throughput for a specific reference measurement channel.

question_82200.question: What does the StartSourcePortNumber leaf represent in a flow distribution rule?
question_82200.ground_truth: The StartSourcePortNumber leaf indicates the first source port number of the source port numbers range in a flow description.

question_82202.question: What type of elements can be contained in the "restricted-announce-response" element, apart from the predefined elements?
question_82202.ground_truth: Zero, one or more elements from other namespaces defined in future releases, and zero, one or more attributes defined in future releases can be contained in the "restricted-announce-response" element.

question_82203.question: What components does Oil&Gas equip their infrastructure with in a large scale industrial setting?
question_82203.ground_truth: Oil&Gas equips their infrastructure with sensors and actuators which are connected via a mobile network.

question_82204.question: What determines whether TDF session charging, ABC, or both are active for a single CDR that handles both TDF session and ABC information in clause 5.2.1.9?

question_82205.question: Under what condition may the UE choose not to perform intra-frequency measurements?
question_82205.ground_truth: The UE may choose not to perform intra-frequency measurements if the serving cell meets the Srxlev > SIntraSearchP and Squal > SIntraSearchQ conditions.

question_82207.question: What is the command for activating or hibernating SCell?
question_82207.ground_truth: The activation/hibernation command for SCell is sent in the form of a MAC-CE (Medium Access Control-Control Element) by the SS (Serving System).

question_82209.question: How many times should the preamble be re-transmitted if the random access response does not correspond to the transmitted random access preamble?
question_82209.ground_truth: The preamble should be re-transmitted 5 times after which a random access response containing a random access preamble identifier corresponding to the transmitted random access should be sent by the SS.

question_82210.question: What action does the NSACF take when the NSAC for number of UEs with at least one PDU session or one PDN connection is used, and the UE is registered to different PLMNs over 3GPP access and non-3GPP access?
question_82210.ground_truth: The AMF in one access cannot enforce a common NSSRG over both accesses.

question_82211.question: What is the maximum number of errors allowed in the UTRAN and LTE streaming test cases for the target Mean Time Between Failure (MTBF)?

question_82213.question: What is the action taken by the MRFP when the value of the "Mix audio" is indicated?
question_82213.ground_truth: The MRFP mixes all the received audio streams from all other conference participants and sends the resulting audio stream(s) to each conference participant.

question_82215.question: How can out-of-coverage UEs belonging to the same group as an in-coverage UE receive the provisioning message?
question_82215.ground_truth: The out-of-coverage UEs could receive the provisioning message through an in-coverage UE (i.e., remote UE to NW relay).

question_82216.question: What is the maximum measurement reporting delay for event 3A from the beginning of time period T2 in the test for verifying the correct reporting of an event when doing inter frequency and E-UTRAN FDD measurements?
question_82216.ground_truth: The maximum measurement reporting delay for event 3A from the beginning of time period T2 in the test for verifying the correct reporting of an event when doing inter frequency and E-UTRAN FDD measurements is 8.23 seconds.

question_82217.question: How can an NF (Network Function) notify the NWDAF (Network Data Analytics Function) about requested CDIs?
question_82217.ground_truth: An NF can notify the NWDAF of requested CDIs by sending unique or periodic notifications, either containing a single timestamped set of CDI instances or information about a file containing several instances.

question_82219.question: What does Ioc' represent in the context of DC-HSDPA?
question_82219.ground_truth: Ioc' is the received power spectral density (integrated in a noise bandwidth equal to the chip rate and normalized to the chip rate) of the summation of the received power spectral densities of the two strongest interfering cells plus Ioc as measured at the UE antenna connector.

question_82220.question: What is the meaning of an Implementation Conformance Statement (ICS) as defined in ISO/IEC 9646-1?
question_82220.ground_truth: An Implementation Conformance Statement (ICS) is a statement made by the supplier of an implementation or system claimed to conform to a given specification. It states which capabilities have been implemented, and can take several forms, including protocol ICS, profile ICS, profile specific ICS, and information object ICS.

question_82221.question: What type of elementary stream is encapsulated in ISO BMFF and transported by ROUTE or MMTP over UDP/IP in ATSC 3.0 broadcast delivery networks?
question_82221.ground_truth: Encoded samples of video and/or audio elementary stream are encapsulated in ISO BMFF and transported by ROUTE or MMTP over UDP/IP in ATSC 3.0 broadcast delivery networks.

question_82223.question: What must be implemented by a Framework as a minimum requirement for distribution technology authentication mechanism?
question_82223.ground_truth: At least one of IpAuthentication or IpAPILevelAuthentication interfaces.

question_82224.question: What parameter is used in the callOverloadEncountered() method to specify the assignmentID corresponding to the associated setCallLoadControl?

question_82226.question: When can a CS-Connected UE receive CBS warning messages?
question_82226.ground_truth: It is not possible for a CS-Connected UE to receive CBS warning messages.

question_82228.question: Which operation is not available for Ash UL DPCCH2 in FDD?
question_82228.ground_truth: Ash UL DPCCH2 operation is not available in FDD.

question_82232.question: What is the purpose of the network slice adaptation for VAL application in 4.10 of the NSCE server?
question_82232.ground_truth: This functionality enables the VAL to adapt the network slice for a VAL application by updating URSP rules at the 5GS, triggered by either the VAL server or VAL UE to enhance user experience.

question_82233.question: What information should the UE include in the MEASUREMENT REPORT, if the IE "GPS timing of Cell wanted" is set to TRUE and the UE supports the capability to provide the GPS timing of the cell frames measurement?
question_82233.ground_truth: The UE should include the IE "UE positioning GPS measured results" in the measurement report, with the following information: the IE "Primary CPICH Info" for FDD, the IE "cell parameters id" for TDD, the IE "Reference SFN", and the UE GPS timing of cell frames.

question_82236.question: What are the two types of dispositions required for an MSR (Multi-Schema Registration) request?
question_82236.ground_truth: The two types of dispositions are DeliveredDisposition and ReadDisposition.

question_82237.question: What is the negotiation status for SPLIT PG CYCLE between the MS and the network?
question_82237.ground_truth: The SPLIT PG CYCLE has been negotiated between the MS and the network.

question_82238.question: What interfaces are affected by the basic mechanism for the HSS based solution?
question_82238.ground_truth: The basic mechanism for the HSS based solution affects the interfaces between the UE, P-GW, and 3GPP AAA Server over SWx, S2a, and S2b.

question_82239.question: What is the procedure described in Solution #4 for a UE attached for RLOS to obtain emergency services?
question_82239.ground_truth: Solution #4 describes the use of a dedicated RLOS-APN for a UE attached for RLOS to obtain emergency services. During the attach procedure, the UE indicates in the Attach Request that the attachment is for RLOS. If the UE is authenticated, the MME uses the existing credentials. If the UE is not authenticated, the MME establishes a default PDN connection to a specific RLOS APN as part of the Attach procedure.

question_82240.question: What action does the MS take if it receives a "CP-DATA" with an invalid short message transfer reference value?
question_82240.ground_truth: The MS sends a "CP-ERROR" with cause # 81, "Invalid short message transfer reference value".

question_82242.question: What are the possible causes of unsuccessful call establishment in the VPLMN/IPLMN network?
question_82242.ground_truth: The possible causes of unsuccessful call establishment in the VPLMN/IPLMN network are: not reachable, busy, no answer, or route select failure.

question_82243.question: Which transport protocol is used for MBMS streaming delivery, as defined in TS 26.346?
question_82243.ground_truth: RTP is used for MBMS streaming delivery, providing real-time or streaming data transfer over UDP.

question_82244.question: What entity is responsible for reordering data units in the MAC-is sublayer?
question_82244.ground_truth: The Reordering entity in the MAC-is sublayer is responsible for reordering data units based on the received TSN and other factors.

question_82245.question: What is the term "Carrier aggregation" defined as in the document?
question_82245.ground_truth: Carrier aggregation is the aggregation of two or more component carriers in order to support wider transmission bandwidths.

question_82246.question: Which attribute is referenced in the XML schema to specify the index type for the elements defined in this specification?
question_82246.ground_truth: IndexType is referenced in the "xs:attributeGroup" element.

question_82247.question: Which SIP method is used to delete a resource (e.g., a user) from a server?

question_82251.question: What is the granularity of the Time of Arrival (TOA) value range in the user plane synchronization?
question_82251.ground_truth: The granularity of the Time of Arrival (TOA) value range in the user plane synchronization is 125 microseconds.

question_82252.question: What is the difference between the 'Req' and 'Res' or 'Err' suffix in method names?
question_82252.ground_truth: The 'Req' suffix signifies an asynchronous method request, while the 'Res' and 'Err' suffixes serve asynchronous methods for method results and errors, respectively.

question_82253.question: What should a participating MCVideo function do upon receiving a SIP MESSAGE requests for emergency notification for terminating MCVideo client and it contains an emergency indication set to a value of "true" or an alert indication set to a value of "true"?
question_82253.ground_truth: The participating MCVideo function can choose to accept the request, even if it's unable to process it, due to a lack of resources or a risk of congestion.

question_82254.question: Who are the network operators that have deployed 5G networks and agreed to share radio access network in a planned geographic area via indirect connection between their shared radio access network and the core network of one of the operators?

question_82255.question: What is the scope of the present document in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_82255.ground_truth: The present document is an Integration Reference Point (IRP) named "Core Network (CN) and non-3GPP access interworking system Network Resource Model IRP" in the 3GPP Technical Specification on Telecommunication management.

question_82256.question: What is the definition of blocking in the context of receiver performance?
question_82256.ground_truth: The blocking characteristics is a measure of the receiver ability to receive a wanted signal at its assigned channel in the presence of an unwanted interferer, which are either a 1.4MHz, 3MHz, or 5MHz E-UTRA signal or a CW signal for out-of-band blocking.

question_82258.question: What function requests the (U)SIM to send the IMEI to the SIM using the PROVIDE LOCAL INFORMATION proactive command?

question_82260.question: What should the mobile station include in the PACKET PSI STATUS (respectively PACKET SI STATUS) message?
question_82260.ground_truth: The mobile station should include as many PSI (respectively SI) message types that fit into the Received PSI Message List (respectively Received SI Message List) construction in the PACKET PSI STATUS (respectively PACKET SI STATUS) message and that meet the specified criteria.

question_82261.question: What is the role of the "message authentication code (MAC)" in the authentication process?
question_82261.ground_truth: The message authentication code (MAC) is used to verify the freshness of the authentication vector and the integrity of the signaling messages.

question_82262.question: What is the conformance requirement for the block error ratio calculated by the SS under any combination of normal and extreme test voltages and ambient temperatures?
question_82262.ground_truth: The block error ratio shall not exceed the conformance requirement.

question_82263.question: What is the maximum number of audio frames recommended to be included in one MUX-PDU in the 3GPP TS 26.114 document?
question_82263.ground_truth: No more than 1-3 audio frames should be included in one MUX-PDU to avoid excessive delay, as per the 3GPP TS 26.114 document.

question_82264.question: What is the source device and destination device in the "LAUNCH BROWSER" command?
question_82264.ground_truth: In the "LAUNCH BROWSER" command, the source device is UICC (Universal Integrated Circuit Card) and the destination device is ME (Mobile Equipment).

question_82265.question: What should the network do if the UE has a PDN connection for emergency bearer services established or is establishing a PDN connection for emergency bearer services?
question_82265.ground_truth: The network may respond to the AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message by initiating the security mode control procedure with null integrity protection or by aborting the authentication procedure and continuing to use the current security context. The network should deactivate all non-emergency EPS bearer contexts for the UE.

question_82266.question: What action should a station take if it receives I frames with an incorrect sequence number?
question_82266.ground_truth: The station should ignore the sequence number field in those frames and discard the information field until the expected I frame is received correctly. However, the station should use the P/F indications in the discarded I frames.

question_82267.question: In the GERAN GWCN, non-DTM, no combined update procedures scenario, what is the risk for incorrect CS/PS coordination?
question_82267.ground_truth: The risk for incorrect CS/PS coordination is that the operator selection is made independently in the PS domain by source RAN and in the CS domain by target MSC.

question_82268.question: What message does the HNB-GW send to the Source HNB to relocate the UE to the Target HNB?
question_82268.ground_truth: The HNBAP UE Signalling Transfer message containing a Cell Update message, Context ID as the Routing Information, target RNC-Id and target Cell-Identity information.

question_82270.question: What are the potential restrictions for the maximum number of monitored Physical Downlink Control Channel (PDCCH) candidates per slot for Rel-16 NR URLLC?
question_82270.ground_truth: Further enhancements for PDCCH monitoring capability, including potential restrictions, can be considered during the work item phase.

question_82271.question: What security requirement can the UE choose not to accept?
question_82271.ground_truth: The UE can choose not to accept data that does not meet the defined security requirements.

question_82272.question: Which message contents shall be used for the cell re-selection delay test for UTRA FDD UE that support E-UTRA FDD?
question_82272.ground_truth: The messages specified in the test case, which includes messages such as SystemInformationBlockType19 and PRACH-ConfCommonDEFAULT for inter-RAT cell re-selection, should be used.

question_82274.question: What is the document part 5 of in the 3GPP TS covering the Technical Specification Group Core Network; Open Service Access (OSA); Application Programming Interface (API)?

question_82275.question: What are the targeted performance requirements of MMSE-IRC receiver for PUSCH under synchronous network operations?
question_82275.ground_truth: The first priority for phase I work is SIMO PUSCH to SIMO PUSCH collision under synchronous network. The BS MMSE-IRC demodulation requirements for both synchronous and asynchronous network operations are specified in phase II work of the present document.

question_82278.question: How does the TSG RAN specify Rx core requirements for dual-band 4C-HSDPA in case of dual uplinks?
question_82278.ground_truth: In case of dual uplinks, the Rx core requirements for dual-band 4C-HSDPA are specified with the farthest and closest dual UL carrier frequencies for each DL band, considering a maximum difference of 1 dB. The UE transmit power is adjusted (reduced) to meet the requirements with the farthest dual UL carrier frequencies. For single band operation, the requirements can be increased by the same amount as the assumed insertion loss increase used to derive the dual-band requirements.

question_82279.question: What happens when the ProSe Function serving user A decides that it is more convenient to allocate a new ProSe Restricted Code to user A and provide new corresponding Discovery Filters rather than revoking the Discovery Filters from the monitoring UEs?
question_82279.ground_truth: The ProSe Function stores the new ProSe Restricted Code and validity timer in the user context, and sends a Discovery Update Request (UE Identity, Discovery Entry ID, Update Info) message to the UE of user A. The UE then replaces the old ProSe Restricted Code and sends a Discovery Update Ack (Result, Discovery Entry ID) message back to the ProSe Function. If necessary, the UE sends Monitor Update messages to the monitoring UEs, which then replace the old Discovery Filters with the new ones. The ProSe Application Server is updated with the results of the overall procedure.

question_82280.question: What are the two mechanisms for handling Non-IP (NIDD) data delivery to the AF?
question_82280.ground_truth: The two mechanisms are delivery using the NIDD API and delivery using UPF via a Point-to-Point (PtP) N6 tunnel.

question_82281.question: What functional entities are added or enhanced to provide the MBMS Bearer Service?
question_82281.ground_truth: The existing PS Domain functional entities (GGSN, SGSN, MME, E-UTRAN, UTRAN, GERAN, and UE) are enhanced to provide the MBMS Bearer Service. A new functional entity, MBMS GW, exists at the edge between the CN and the BM-SC for the bearer plane in EPS. Additionally, new functional entities such as BM-SC, MCE, and eNB may be required for operation in MBMS.

question_82282.question: What is the role of the SMF in providing PSA-RAN PDB to the NG-RAN node during PDU session establishment or modification procedures?
question_82282.ground_truth: The SMF provides PSA-RAN PDB for a QoS Flow to the NG-RAN node during PDU session establishment/modification or service request procedures.

question_82283.question: How are DNAI or geographical zone identifier in the spatial Validity conditions mapped in the URSP rule?
question_82283.ground_truth: DNAI or geographical zone identifier in the spatial Validity conditions, if any, are mapped to the list of Cell IDs, RAN node IDs, or TAI list in the Location Criteria in the Route Selection Descriptor of the URSP rule.

question_82284.question: What is Sol#6's solution for UE-to-Network Relay support?
question_82284.ground_truth: Sol#6 proposes the L3 solution for the support of UE-to-Network Relay, where the L3 Relay UE relays any IP, Ethernet, or unstructured unicast traffic between the Remote UE and the network.

question_82285.question: In what scenarios should the initiating UE, acting as the 5G ProSe end UE, include the User security key ID IE set to UP-PRUK ID or CP-PRUK ID in the PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message?
question_82285.ground_truth: The initiating UE, acting as the 5G ProSe end UE, should include the User security key ID IE set to UP-PRUK ID or CP-PRUK ID in the PROSE DIRECT LINK ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message if it has received the PC5 signalling protocol cause value #15 "security procedure failure of 5G ProSe UE-to-network relay" due to a UE-to-network relay reselection procedure.

question_82287.question: What should the P-CSCF do if no security association exists between it and the UE, and the UE is performing the functions of an external attached network operating in static mode?
question_82287.ground_truth: The P-CSCF shall initiate a TLS session towards the UE before sending the initial request in accordance with 3GPP TS 33.310.

question_82288.question: What should the Node B do when the DCHs To Modify IE includes the Unidirectional DCH indicator IE set to "Uplink DCH only"?
question_82288.ground_truth: The Node B should ignore the Transport Format Set IE for the downlink for this DCH. As a consequence, this DCH is not included as a part of the downlink CCTrCH.

question_82292.question: What message is sent from a CN node to an RNC to indicate that all references have been cleared, after the UTRAN has sent a RESET message?

question_82294.question: What is one requirement for the protocol selection in a virtualized environment?
question_82294.ground_truth: In a virtualized environment, any protocol used should be capable to support a large number of endpoints as there could be a large number of NF instances.

question_82295.question: What is the bitrate range for Full HD resolutions in streaming of video?
question_82295.ground_truth: Bitrates up to 12 Mbps are not uncommon for Full HD resolutions in streaming of video.

question_82296.question: What is the purpose of the test in 70.9.4.5?
question_82296.ground_truth: The purpose of the test in 70.9.4.5 is to verify that a MS sends a correct positioning capability via control classmark sending and terminates the current location measurement if the second RRLP MEASURE POSITION REQUEST is received with a different REFERENCE NUMBER.

question_82297.question: What is the starting state of the 'general floor control operation' state machine before any floor control input is applied or when a call is released?

question_82298.question: What mechanism for device triggering should provide a method for ensuring authenticity?
question_82298.ground_truth: All device triggering mechanisms should provide a mechanism for ensuring authenticity.

question_82299.question: What does USS stand for in the context of 3GPP UAS support?
question_82299.ground_truth: USS stands for Uncrewed Aerial System (UAS) application support aspects.

question_82300.question: How can a UE that is not in Receive Only Mode acquire the service announcement of a regular MBMS User Service?
question_82300.ground_truth: A UE that is not in Receive Only Mode can acquire the service announcement of a regular MBMS User Service by pre-storing the related session parameters, pre-storing the session parameters in the MBMS application, acquiring via delivery over OMA PUSH, or downloading the session parameters from an HTTP server resolved from the Service Announcement FQDN.

question_82302.question: What does Alternate 1 of the operational testing feature entail?
question_82302.ground_truth: Alternate 1 of the operational testing feature is designed to test upgraded software utilizing slicing. This testing involves creating a test entity exclusively for testing, instantiating a network slice, and selecting appropriate UEs and deployment locations for the test.

question_82303.question: What should the MCData client do when sending a SIP BYE request to release a MCData communication?
question_82303.ground_truth: The MCData client should generate a SIP BYE request with the Request-URI set to the MCData session identity to be released, and send the request towards the MCData server.

question_82308.question: What is the driving force behind the need for provision of restricted local operator services?
question_82308.ground_truth: The need for provision of restricted local operator services is based on FCC regulations in the U.S. related to manual roaming and Resale and Roaming.

question_82309.question: What is the format of the DeliveryBoostRequest message and where is it used?
question_82309.ground_truth: The DeliveryBoostRequest message is a SAND PED message extension class that is used in the Network Assistance request within the compound NetworkAssistanceRequest SAND transaction. It is used to request a delivery boost for the upcoming media segment to ensure seamless and high-quality playback. The DeliveryBoostRequest message is defined in the schema whose @schemeIdUri is "urn:3gpp:dash: schema:sandmessageextension:2017".

question_82310.question: By how much was the capacity performance increased when using the delay-aware scheduler compared to the PF scheduler for FR2, Dense Urban, DL, with VR/AR, 30Mbps, 10ms PDB, with SU-MIMO?
question_82310.ground_truth: The capacity performance was increased by 5.4%.

question_82312.question: What is the MIME type used to identify documents that follow the associated delivery procedure description schema?

question_82313.question: How is the TDMA frame number of the last burst containing the message conveyed in the CTS L1 information?
question_82313.ground_truth: The TDMA frame number of the last burst containing the message is conveyed in the T1, T2, and T3 fields in the CTS L1 information.

question_82316.question: What message is sent by the UE after receiving a REGISTER message with the LCS-LocationNotification Invoke component set to NotifyLocationAllowed?
question_82316.ground_truth: The UE notifies the user of the location procedure and terminates the dialogue by sending a RELEASE COMPLETE message.

question_82318.question: What issue can arise when paging messages for the same downlink PDU are received by a mobile station in multiple cells?
question_82318.ground_truth: A mobile station may trigger a RACH procedure and send a paging response multiple times, even though the downlink message has already been delivered, causing unnecessary signaling in the network.

question_82319.question: What is the functional description of the solution for ProSe Priority and QoS?
question_82319.ground_truth: The solution for ProSe Priority and QoS involves setting a ProSe Per-Packet Priority by the application layer based on criteria, with the UE upper layers providing the lower layers with the priority selected in order to prioritize intra-UE and inter-UE transmissions in a strict priority order. The solution is neutral to the way the UE is accessing the medium and supports 8 levels for the ProSe Per-Packet Priority to support a wide range of applications.

question_82321.question: What is the role of the elemental procedures in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_82321.ground_truth: Elementary procedures are basic building blocks provided by the protocol control entities of the three sublayers: radio resource management, mobility management, and connection management sublayer. Complete layer 3 transactions consist of specific sequences of these elementary procedures.

question_82322.question: What should the controlling MCVideo function do when the in-progress emergency state of the group is set to "true" and a member of the group indicates a new imminent peril indication?
question_82322.ground_truth: The controlling MCVideo function should generate a SIP MESSAGE request notification with the imminentperil-ind element set to "true" and send it to each of the other affiliated members of the group. The function should also cache the information that this MCVideo user has initiated an MCVideo imminent peril call.

question_82325.question: When does the PCEF activate a predefined PCC rule if there are no UE provided traffic mapping information related to the IP-CAN bearer?
question_82325.ground_truth: The PCEF may activate a predefined PCC rule if it is not known in the PCRF and there are no UE provided traffic mapping information related to the IP-CAN bearer.

question_82326.question: In the document, what does the acronym MC-HSDPA stand for?
question_82326.ground_truth: Multi-carrier High Speed Downlink Packet Access

question_82327.question: What are the three possible scenarios when the surround sound is to be played back over loudspeakers?
question_82327.ground_truth: The three possible scenarios are: decoding and rendering on a UE, decoding and rendering on a non-3GPP device connected to a UE, and decoding on a UE and rendering on a non-3GPP device connected to a UE.

question_82328.question: What security mechanism can be used to protect the NAS layer in option A?
question_82328.ground_truth: Current LTE security mechanisms can be used to provide the security for the NAS layer.

question_82329.question: What is the minimum number of (error) events required for an early pass decision in testing the adjacent channel interference performance?
question_82329.ground_truth: For an early pass decision, the number of (error) events must be greater than or equal to 1, including artificial errors.

question_82330.question: What is the name of the message that the network sends to CN/AS to start the execution of UTRAN to GSM/BSS inter-RAT handover procedure?

question_82331.question: What happens to 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay when it receives a Mobility Management back-off timer from the AMF?
question_82331.ground_truth: When the 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay receives a Mobility Management back-off timer from the AMF, it enters CM_IDLE state and releases the PC5 connections with its 5G ProSe Remote UEs, indicating it is temporarily not available. It does not perform UE-to-Network Relay Discovery or accept any PC5 connections for relaying until the back-off timer expires.

question_82332.question: In which cases can the Update SM Context service operation be used during the handover of a PDU session between 3GPP and untrusted non-3GPP access?
question_82332.ground_truth: The Update SM Context service operation can be used in the cases where the same AMF or a target AMF in the same PLMN is involved during the handover of a PDU session between 3GPP and untrusted non-3GPP access.

question_82333.question: What should the Receiving Entity do if it cannot authenticate the Sending Entity when receiving a secured Command Packet requesting a Proof of Receipt?
question_82333.ground_truth: The Receiving Entity should discard the Command Packet with no further action being taken.

question_82334.question: What capability does the 5G system have in determining the location of an ambient IoT device?
question_82334.ground_truth: The 5G system is able to determine the location of an ambient IoT device when it becomes active, as triggered by the 5G network.

question_82336.question: How is the measurement name organized in the template?
question_82336.ground_truth: The measurement names are dotted sequences of items organized from the general to the particular. The first item identifies the measurement family, and the second item identifies the name of the measurement. Depending on the measurement type, additional items may be present to specify subcounters.

question_82337.question: What are the maximum input level requirements for inter-band concurrent NR V2X operation in licensed band and Band n47, as specified in section 7.4E of the document?
question_82337.ground_truth: For the inter-band concurrent NR V2X operation, the requirements specified in subclause 7.4E of TS 38.101-1 and the requirements specified in subclause 7.4.1 of TS 36.101 apply for the NR sidelink reception in Band n47 and the E-UTRA downlink reception in licensed band, respectively while all downlink carriers are active.

question_82339.question: What should the UE do when it receives a downlink assignment with MAC PDU scheduled for its G-RNTI and decodes it unsuccessfully in the NR cell?
question_82339.ground_truth: The UE sends NACK for the corresponding HARQ process.

question_82340.question: What is the maximum allowed number of spurious response frequencies in the out-of-band frequency region for all BTS and MXM?
question_82340.ground_truth: The maximum allowed number of spurious response frequencies in the out-of-band frequency region for all BTS and MXM is 24, with a maximum of three contiguous occurrences per group in case the spurious response frequencies are below f0.

question_82341.question: What is the purpose of the AR-6.3-3 requirement in the NSCE architecture?
question_82341.ground_truth: The purpose of the AR-6.3-3 requirement in the NSCE architecture is to support interactions with the 3GPP network management system to consume network slice lifecycle management service provided by the Mobile Network Operator (MNO).

question_82342.question: What kind of attack can an adversary capable of breaking into signaling exchange during link establishment perform?
question_82342.ground_truth: The adversary can eavesdrop on signaling or subsequent data traffic, attack the integrity of signaling, or usurp the identity of one or more of the participants.

question_82343.question: What is the maximum overall delays measured allowed for other power classes in Test 1 and Test 2?
question_82343.ground_truth: The maximum overall delays measured allowed for other power classes in Test 1 and Test 2 is 4162 ms in Test 1 and 2082 ms in Test 2.

question_82344.question: What shall the System Software (SS) do when T1 expires in the test described in 6.5.1.2.4.2?
question_82344.ground_truth: The SS shall change the SNR value to T2 and start the time duration T2.

question_82345.question: What is the maximum rate of ACK/NACK feedback loss allowed for interruptions due to CQI measurements on dormant SCell(s) during SCell dormancy?
question_82345.ground_truth: The rate of ACK/NACK feedback loss on any non-dormant serving cell resulting from CQI measurements on dormant SCells shall not exceed 0.5%.

question_82346.question: What is the purpose of generating the integrity key Kmac in the enhanced integrity protection mechanism for GSM/GPRS?
question_82346.ground_truth: The purpose of generating Kmac is to protect the PWS public key and ensure that UE will get a genuine public key to verify the signature.

question_82347.question: What is one aspect to consider for sub-PRB interlacing with 60 kHz SCS?
question_82347.ground_truth: Power boosting potential depending on resource allocation size.

question_82348.question: What is the purpose of the Target field in a Media Transfer Request?
question_82348.ground_truth: The Target field in a Media Transfer Request identifies the user equipment (UE) that serves as the target of media transfer.

question_82349.question: Which RLC-SAP is used for the DLInformationTransfer message?

question_82350.question: What is the purpose of the RRCConnectionRelease message in the test procedure?
question_82350.ground_truth: The RRCConnectionRelease message is used to release the RRC connection which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources. It is also used to switch off the UE or to ensure the UE is in State 3A or 3A-RF after the test procedure.

question_82351.question: What are the scheduling restrictions on FR2 serving cells when inter-band carrier aggregation is performed in FR2?
question_82351.ground_truth: There are no scheduling restrictions on FR2 serving cells in different bands when inter-band carrier aggregation is performed in FR2, provided that the UE is capable of independent beam management on this FR2 band pair.

question_82352.question: What is the role of the convolutional code in the encoding unit of the EC-GSM-IoT MCS-1/M?
question_82352.ground_truth: The convolutional code is a part of the encoding unit of the EC-GSM-IoT, used to generate the coded bits from the input data bits d(k) of the EC-GSM-IoT MCS-1/M.

question_82353.question: What is the required SNR for the target pathloss reference signal and the associated SSB in 8.14C.2?
question_82353.ground_truth: The SNR for both the target pathloss reference signal and the associated SSB should be greater than or equal to -3dB in 8.14C.2.

question_82354.question: How does the SGSN/MME determine whether to deliver the device trigger request to the UE over T5a/T5b?
question_82354.ground_truth: The SGSN/MME decides whether to deliver the request to the device over T5a/T5b based on whether an APN is provided and known, and whether a bearer exists for that APN.

question_82356.question: What message is sent to the MS in the source cell during the execution phase of a PS handover from UTRAN/GERAN Iu mode to GAN mode?
question_82356.ground_truth: The GA-PSR ACTIVATE UTC REQ message is sent from the target GANC to the MS during the execution phase of a PS handover from UTRAN/GERAN Iu mode to GAN mode to activate the transport channel to be used in the GAN cell.

question_82358.question: What action does the 5GC take during PDU session resource modify to allow the MN to split the PDU session?
question_82358.ground_truth: The 5GC provides an additional UL TEID address that can be used as the additional NG-U tunnel for the MN to split the PDU session.

question_82359.question: What are the three scenarios considered in the document for ICS support across different types of access networks?
question_82359.ground_truth: The three scenarios considered are: Scenario A - the network is an IP CAN capable of transporting bi-directional speech media, Scenario B - the UE is served through the CS domain, and Scenario C - both CS domain and a non bi-directional speech media capable IP CAN are available in the network.

question_82360.question: What value should the IWF include in the ICSI value of the P-Asserted-Service header field in a SIP INVITE request sent towards the controlling MCPTT function?
question_82360.ground_truth: The IWF should include the ICSI value "urn:urn-7:3gpp-service.ims.icsi.mcptt" in the P-Asserted-Service header field of the outgoing SIP INVITE request.

question_82363.question: What happens when the UE selects an E-UTRA cell that is "reserved for operator use" and another E-UTRA cell that is not, both cells belonging to the UE's HPLMN, after receiving a RRCRelease message with redirectedCarrierInfo indicating redirection to eutra?
question_82363.ground_truth: The UE selects the E-UTRA cell with the lowest access class, performs an ATTACH or a TAU procedure, and successfully completes the MO MMTEL call in EPS.

question_82365.question: What is the purpose of the SECAM Accreditation Body in the context of 3GPP virtualized network products?
question_82365.ground_truth: The SECAM Accreditation Body is responsible for managing and writing accreditation and monitoring rules, handling the dispute resolution process, and deciding who takes on the role of SECAM Accreditation Body for 3GPP virtualized network products.

question_82366.question: What is the meaning of the first digit of the version number in the 3GPP technical report?
question_82366.ground_truth: The first digit in the version number represents the status of the report in the TSG. 1 indicates that the report is presented to the TSG for information, 2 indicates that the report is presented to the TSG for approval, and higher numbers indicate that the report is a TSG approved document under change control.

question_82367.question: What does the GGSN need to do if it receives a RADIUS Disconnect Request message and it has deleted the corresponding PDP context?
question_82367.ground_truth: The GGSN need not wait for the DeletePDPContextResponse from the SGSN to send the RADIUS DisconnectResponse to the AAA server if it has deleted the corresponding PDP context.

question_82368.question: How many successes for the event "Deactivation" are tracked in the intra-band and inter-band scenario?
question_82368.ground_truth: The number of successes for the event "Deactivation" is increased by one for each successful "Deactivation" event in the intra-band and inter-band scenario.

question_82369.question: How can the MCPTT server communicate with the IWF when an interworking group is homed in the LMR system?
question_82369.ground_truth: The MCPTT server can forward the floor request to the IWF for final floor control determination when the interworking group is homed in the LMR system.

question_82372.question: What is the difference between 3GPP and 3GPP2?
question_82372.ground_truth: 3GPP and 3GPP2 are both organizations that develop and maintain the 3G UMTS standards. 3GPP covers GSM, WCDMA, and LTE, while 3GPP2 covers CDMA2000 standards.

question_82374.question: What are the benefits of the first solution described?
question_82374.ground_truth: The first solution provides confidentiality and integrity protection for the NAS and AS signalling against passive attacks, and can protect against passive attacks even if the attacker does not get initial messages. This solution limits the time an attacker needs to act as a false base station, and uses public key cryptography to minimize the impact of the UE and MME.

question_82375.question: What is the subject of the 3GPP technical report "Derivation of test tolerances and measurement uncertainty for User Equipment (UE) conformance test cases (Release 18)"?
question_82375.ground_truth: The report specifies a general method used to derive Measurement Uncertainties and Test Tolerances for UE conformance tests, and establishes a system for relating the Test Tolerances to the measurement uncertainties of the Test System.

question_82376.question: In 6.3.8.1.2, what is the category of errors that CatPlayTone test needs to verify?

question_82379.question: What is the length of interruption in each interruption occasion?
question_82379.ground_truth: The interruption length is defined in clause 8.2.2.2.2.

question_82383.question: What should the UE do if it detects that the requested NR cell is not transmitting SIB1?
question_82383.ground_truth: The UE should stop timer T321, include a measurement reporting entry for this measId in the VarMeasReportList, set the numberOfReportsSent to 0, and initiate the measurement reporting procedure as specified in clause 5.5.5 of TS 38.331.

question_82384.question: What are the recommended extensions for the content preparation procedures in TS 26.501 Release~16?
question_82384.ground_truth: The recommended extensions are the inclusion of content preparation deployment scenarios and associated call flows in Stage 2 and extending the Content Preparation Templates Provisioning API to make the use of the Content Preparation Template interoperable in the 5GMS architecture.

question_82385.question: What should the network do when it receives a CFU registration request which contains a ForwardedToSubaddress, and any network element involved is of protocol version 1?
question_82385.ground_truth: The network should reject the CFU registration request.

question_82386.question: What is used for the Dual-Stack Mobile IPv6 (DSMIPv6) Home Agent discovery?
question_82386.ground_truth: The procedures used for the DSMIPv6 Home Agent discovery are compliant to IETF RFCs, as specified in the present document.

question_82387.question: What is the maximum duration of the test in minutes for GSM850, GSM900, DCS1800, and PCS1900?
question_82387.ground_truth: The maximum duration of the test is 54 minutes.

question_82388.question: What should the mobile station do if the PS handover to A/Gb mode fails for the reason of T3218 expiry?
question_82388.ground_truth: The mobile station should return to the cell on which the PS HANDOVER COMMAND message was received, send a PACKET CELL CHANGE FAILURE message with cause "No response on target cell" and resume the TBFs that were ongoing in the old cell.

question_82390.question: In what transport layer security protocol is the AKMA TLS protocol profiles based on?

question_82391.question: How are the minimum requirements and test procedures for Base station output power related to Carrier aggregation (CA) defined in TS36.104 and MSR TS37.104?
question_82391.ground_truth: The definitions of "Base station output power" in TS36.104 and MSR TS37.104 are aligned as much as possible, with some differences regarding the "declared power." However, it should be clarified that the "rated output power per carrier" depends on the transmission mode set.

question_82392.question: When can the HNB initiate the HNB de-registration procedure?
question_82392.ground_truth: The HNB can initiate the HNB de-registration procedure whenever it needs to terminate operations.

question_82394.question: What feature does QUIC aim to provide?
question_82394.ground_truth: QUIC aims to provide a flexible set of features that allow it to be a general-purpose transport for multiple applications.

question_82395.question: What is the main difference between Model A and Model B for 5G ProSe UE-to-Network Relay discovery?
question_82395.ground_truth: Model A uses a single discovery protocol message (Announcement), while Model B uses two discovery protocol messages (Solicitation and Response) for UE-to-Network Relay discovery.

question_82396.question: Which type of cell group in MR-DC is associated with the Master Node and consists of the SpCell (PCell) and optionally one or more SCells?

question_82397.question: What is the recommended DTMF transport mechanism when both "telephone-event" media subtype and SIP INFO mechanism are supported by the UE?
question_82397.ground_truth: The AS should choose which DTMF transport mechanism to use based on operator policy.

question_82399.question: What is the purpose of the "Broadcast Scheduled Area List NG-RAN" parameter in the Warning Message Content NG-RAN?
question_82399.ground_truth: The Broadcast Scheduled Area List NG-RAN parameter in the Warning Message Content NG-RAN indicates the areas where initiation of a broadcast was performed successfully.

question_82400.question: What is the default value for the acknowledgement timer (T1) in the absence of an explicit DLC priority assignment message?
question_82400.ground_truth: The default value for T1 is 100 ms.

question_82402.question: How is the output power and rated output power defined in the context of E-UTRA?
question_82402.ground_truth: Output power is the mean power of one carrier of the base station, delivered to a load with resistance equal to the nominal load impedance of the transmitter, while rated output power is the mean power level per carrier that the manufacturer has declared to be available at the antenna connector.

question_82404.question: What action is taken by the UE regarding the usage information report in 5G ProSe Direct Discovery over PC5 reference point?
question_82404.ground_truth: The UE creates and sends the usage information report to the CTF located in ProSe NF when reporting criteria are met.

question_82407.question: When must the PS Furnish Charging Information be sent in the Debit / Reserve Units Response message as per clause 5.3.2.3?
question_82407.ground_truth: When the OCS sends session specific charging information, it must send the PS Furnish Charging Information at command level in the Debit / Reserve Units Response. When the OCS sends service specific charging information, it must send the PS Furnish Charging Information at MSCC level in the Debit / Reserve Units Response.

question_82408.question: What is the purpose of the test case given in 13.1.1.2?
question_82408.ground_truth: The purpose of the test case is to verify that when the current and target cell operate on the same carrier frequency, the Cat-NB1 UE can search and measure cells to meet the intra-frequency cell re-selection requirements with serving cell RRM measurement relaxation.

question_82409.question: What is the scenario tested in the closed-loop single layer TM4 performance verification with CRS interference mitigation?
question_82409.ground_truth: The scenario tested is with 4 CRS antenna ports in the serving and aggressor cells.

question_82410.question: What is a Presence Tuple in the context of a Presence Service?
question_82410.ground_truth: A Presence Tuple consists of a Status, an optional Communication Address, and optional Other Presence Markup.

question_82411.question: What must the UE do if HTTP digest authentication support is specified and HTTPS is used?
question_82411.ground_truth: The UE must support the TLS profile specified in 3GPP TS 33.310 Annex E in all procedures where TLS support is specified.

question_82412.question: What procedure is the PDU Session Establishment Procedure via Wireline Access Network based on?
question_82412.ground_truth: The 5G-RG Requested PDU Session Establishment procedure in solution 3 clause~6.3.3.

question_82413.question: What is the role of the Incoming Media Gateway Control Function (IMGCF) in the technical specification?
question_82413.ground_truth: The Incoming Media Gateway Control Function (IMGCF) is a Media Gateway Control Function (MGCF) that terminates incoming calls from IMS and originates calls using BICC/ISUP protocols.

question_82414.question: What is the minimum reporting delay in the 2.9.5-1 test?
question_82414.ground_truth: The minimum reporting delay in the 2.9.5-1 test is less than 4.8s from the beginning of time period T2.

question_82416.question: Which two nodes are impacted in handling UE's IMS emergency registration in solution #5?
question_82416.ground_truth: The two main impacted nodes in handling UE's IMS emergency registration in solution #5 are the PCRF and P-CSCF.

question_82417.question: What is the role of the selectAuthenticationMechanism() method in API level Authentication?
question_82417.ground_truth: The selectAuthenticationMechanism() method is used by the client to inform the Framework of the different authentication mechanisms it supports. The Framework will select one of the suggested authentication mechanisms and that mechanism shall be used for authentication by both Framework and Client.

question_82419.question: What are the pre-requisites for the orchestration tasks provided by the NSCOF function in solution #12?
question_82419.ground_truth: The pre-requisites for the NSCOF solution are a secure mutual TLS connection between the 3rd party certificate administrator and NSCOF function, a pre-established trust relationship between the NSCOF and Operator's RA/CA, and a pre-established trust relationship between the Operator's RA/CA and 3rd Party CA.

question_82420.question: In which test case scenarios does Combination NR-2 apply?
question_82420.ground_truth: Combination NR-2 applies to NR FDD intra-frequency multi cell scenario, NR TDD intra-frequency multi cell scenario, NR FDD and NR TDD dual mode multi cell roaming scenario, NR FDD single cell RRM test case scenario, and NR TDD single cell RRM test case scenario.

question_82421.question: What should the MAC entity do if the Random Access Response is successfully received and includes a MAC subPDU with RAPID only?
question_82421.ground_truth: The MAC entity should consider the Random Access procedure successfully completed and indicate the reception of an acknowledgement for SI request to upper layers.

question_82424.question: What is an AMD PDU in the context of 38.322 clause 5.2.3.2.2?
question_82424.ground_truth: An AMD PDU (Medium Access Control PDU) is a protocol data unit that contains a Data field and an AMD PDU header in the context of 38.322 clause 5.2.3.2.2.

question_82426.question: What is the goal of the possible solution for paging optimization?
question_82426.ground_truth: The goal is to ensure efficient network resource usage by optimizing the current paging procedures in 5G networks, by predicting the time window at which the user is out-of-coverage.

question_82428.question: In the context of GPRS as IP-CAN, what does the "ggsn" parameter represent?
question_82428.ground_truth: The "ggsn" parameter represents the GPRS Support Node's address in the GPRS as IP-CAN.

question_82431.question: When is interception set to occur at the anchor UPF by default?
question_82431.ground_truth: Interception occurs at the anchor UPF by default when a warrant that includes the service scoping of CC is activated for a target UE with an established PDU session and when the IRI-POI present in the SMF generates the xIRI containing an SMFStartOfInterceptionWithEstablishedPDUSession record.

question_82432.question: What happens when the Serving GW receives a Modify Bearer Request message and ISR is active?
question_82432.ground_truth: The Serving GW re-sends the Downlink Data Notification message only to the new MME or SGSN from which it received the Modify Bearer Request message.

question_82433.question: What should be specified in the present document regarding enhanced RF requirements for FR2 multi-Rx chain DL reception?
question_82433.ground_truth: The present document should specify RF requirements, mainly spherical coverage requirements, for devices with simultaneous reception from different directions with different QCL TypeD RSs.

question_82434.question: What is the function of the I-SMF in the 5G LAN-type service when a UE is connected with the PSA via an I-UPF?
question_82434.ground_truth: The SMF controls the traffic switching without any specific knowledge or involvement of the I-SMF to support the 5G LAN-type service.

question_82435.question: How are APN-related policy information taken into service or out of service?
question_82435.ground_truth: APN-related policy information can be taken into service when the validity conditions specified as part of the policy information are fulfilled, and it can be taken out of service when those conditions are no longer fulfilled. This can be done without requiring any PCC interaction.

question_82436.question: What is the maximum measurement reporting delay in inter-frequency OTDOA measurements?
question_82436.ground_truth: The maximum measurement reporting delay in inter-frequency OTDOA measurements is less than the measurement period as defined in Clause 8.16.2.4.3.

question_82438.question: What is the duration of the test?
question_82438.ground_truth: The duration of the test is one time period with durations of T1, with all cells having constant signal levels throughout the test.

question_82439.question: What is the requirement for the interruption on the PCell and/or on the activated SCell during SCell activation?
question_82439.ground_truth: The interruption on the PCell and/or on the activated SCell due to the SCell activation should not occur before subframe n+5 and not occur after subframe n+9 if the PCell and/or the activated SCell being interrupted and the SCell being activated belong to E-UTRA TDD or if the activated SCell being interrupted and the SCell being activated belong to E-UTRA FDD and the PCell belongs to E-UTRA TDD. Otherwise, the interruption should not occur before subframe n+5 and not occur after subframe n+11.

question_82441.question: What is the name of the set of protocols and procedures needed to protect TCAP user messages in the 3GPP Technical Specification?
question_82441.ground_truth: TCAPsec is the name of the set of protocols and procedures needed to protect TCAP user messages in the 3GPP Technical Specification.

question_82442.question: Which protocol was first used by 3GPP for management of telecommunication networks?
question_82442.ground_truth: CMIP was the first protocol used by 3GPP for management of telecommunication networks.

question_82443.question: What is the purpose of the autonomous gaps in the downlink reception and uplink transmission of a UE?
question_82443.ground_truth: The purpose of autonomous gaps is to receive MIB and SIB1 messages during cell identification.

question_82445.question: What is the maximum bit depth and chroma sampling supported by the Main profile of AV1?
question_82445.ground_truth: The Main profile of AV1 supports a maximum bit depth of 8 or 10 bits per sample and 4:0:0 (greyscale) and 4:2:0 (quarter) chroma sampling.

question_82447.question: What are some key issues that the low latency audio streaming use case for wireless audio production aims to address?
question_82447.ground_truth: The low latency audio streaming use case for wireless audio production addresses key issues of wireless audio production, focusing on low-latency and high-reliability aspects.

question_82448.question: Which video codec standard is used in Multiview Video Coding (MVC) for compressing stereoscopic video in a backwards compatible manner?

question_82449.question: What should the MAC entity do when it receives a Timing Advance Command value of FFF?
question_82449.ground_truth: The MAC entity should process the received Timing Advance Command, consider the RACH-less LTM cell switch to be ongoing, and indicate to upper layers to skip the Random Access procedure for this LTM cell switch if it is associated with SCG.

question_82450.question: What is the initial state of the UE and System Simulator before the test procedure?
question_82450.ground_truth: The UE is in state 3N-A and Test Mode Activated, while the System Simulator is set up with an NR cell and system information combination NR-1.

question_82453.question: What action does the MS take if it receives a point-to-point short message while on a voice group call channel and not the endpoint of the layer 2 link for acknowledged message transfer?
question_82453.ground_truth: The MS shall ignore the point-to-point short message received on the SACCH of the voice group call channel.

question_82454.question: What is the LTE Advanced Carrier Aggregation: Band 1 and Band 3 and Band 5 and Band 7 with 2 ULs?
question_82454.ground_truth: The LTE Advanced Carrier Aggregation: Band 1 and Band 3 and Band 5 and Band 7 with 2 ULs is a certain LTE Advanced Carrier Aggregation band combination, and there was no interference to the own 3rd and 4th Rx frequency range for this band combination.

question_82456.question: What should the UE do when it receives a 180 (Ringing) response for an early dialogue during a MO call?
question_82456.ground_truth: The UE should send a PRACK request as a reliable provisional response to the 180 (Ringing) message.

question_82457.question: What is the role of the Sidelink HARQ Entity in the SL-DCH transmission process?
question_82457.ground_truth: The Sidelink HARQ Entity is responsible for maintaining one Sidelink process for each MAC PDU in the SL-DCH transmission process and delivering MAC PDUs and grants to the corresponding Sidelink process.

question_82461.question: What are the two conditions that the IWF performing the controlling role needs to check to ensure that an MCPTT emergency alert request is authorized?
question_82461.ground_truth: 1) if the user is authorized to initiate an emergency alert, and 2) if the IWF allows emergency alerts on the group. If both conditions are met, then the MCPTT emergency alert request shall be considered an authorized request for an MCPTT emergency alert targeted to an MCPTT group. Otherwise, it shall be considered to be an unauthorized request for an MCPTT emergency alert targeted to an MCPTT group.

question_82464.question: What is the responsibility of the GGSN/P-GW regarding P-CSCF server address(es) in a Create PDP Context Response/Create Session Response?
question_82464.ground_truth: The GGSN/P-GW shall provide only those P-CSCF address(es) that are available in a Create PDP Context Response/Create Session Response.

question_82465.question: What does the reset E1AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE do?
question_82465.ground_truth: The resetE1AP-ELEMENTARY-PROCEDURE resets the connection between two E1AP peers, releasing all resources.

question_82466.question: What is the main goal of the multi-domain, multi-layer, and multi-technology management service coordination automation use case?
question_82466.ground_truth: The main goal of this use case is to enable automation of end-to-end joint coordination of management services across multiple domains, multi-layers, and multi-technologies.

question_82470.question: What is the significance of the version number format in 3GPP Technical Specification documents?
question_82470.ground_truth: The version number format in 3GPP Technical Specification documents consists of three digits. The first digit indicates the stage of approval, the second digit denotes changes of substance, and the third digit represents editorial changes.

question_82471.question: What is the distribution of raw SINR values taken from CQI measurements in the uni-directional tunnel scenario with DPS?
question_82471.ground_truth: The SINR level is high and sufficient to support high mobility performance for cases where the train travels in the same direction as RRH beams are pointing to, but not in the opposite direction. When DPS is used, the probability of low SINR samples is lower compared to the non-DPS case.

question_82472.question: What mechanism is used by the RLAN device in Europe to ensure mitigation of aggregate power from a large number of devices?
question_82472.ground_truth: The Transmit Power Control (TPC) mechanism is used by the RLAN device in Europe to ensure mitigation of aggregate power from a large number of devices.

question_82473.question: What type of AVP is the Next-Tariff AVP, and what information does it hold?
question_82473.ground_truth: The Next-Tariff AVP is of type Grouped and holds tariff information, including the formula for cost calculation, the scale factor, and the calculated cost in the Currency-Code AVP.

question_82474.question: What should the mobile station do when it is in CCN mode and receives a PACKET NEIGHBOR CELL DATA message or a PACKET CELL CHANGE CONTINUE message without any neighbor cell system information?
question_82474.ground_truth: The mobile station should stop timer T3208 and T3210 if they are still running, leave CCN mode, and continue cell reselection in NC0/NC1 mode.

question_82476.question: What is the purpose of the audioTrackFormat element in Recommendation ITU-R BS.2076-0?
question_82476.ground_truth: The audioTrackFormat element in Recommendation ITU-R BS.2076-0 describes what format the audio data is in.

question_82477.question: What are the two time synchronization methods in a 5G system where the time source is provided by the UPF/NW-TT via gPTP or PTP?

question_82480.question: Who are the intended audience and stakeholders for this 3GPP Technical Report on Diameter-based protocols usage and recommendations in 3GPP (Release 17)?
question_82480.ground_truth: The intended audience for this 3GPP Technical Report includes all 3GPP working groups involved in the development of Diameter based interfaces, operators of 3GPP networks, and vendors of 3GPP equipment. The report is also relevant to the broader IETF community as a case study of the usage of Diameter in a specific SDO context.

question_82481.question: What is the requirement for the 3GPP management system to enable an authorized data consumer to discover stored management data?

question_82482.question: What happens in step 7, if the PDU session supports EPS interworking?
question_82482.ground_truth: If the PDU session supports EPS interworking, the N2 SM information contains the Mapping between EBI(s) and QFI(s).

question_82483.question: What is the test purpose for the test case 26.7.4.5.4.5?
question_82483.ground_truth: The test purpose for the test case 26.7.4.5.4.5 is to verify that the MS remains on the highest priority network when the HPLMN/higher priority PLMN Search is performed, if the MS is receiving a foreign country's VPLMN and is in automatic mode.

question_82485.question: What are some of the functions of the X2 interface?
question_82485.ground_truth: Some of the functions of the X2 interface include intra-LTE-Access-system mobility support for ECM-CONNECTED UEs, load management, inter-cell interference coordination, general X2 management and error handling functions, application level data exchange between eNBs, trace functions, data exchange for self-optimization, and support for EN-DC.

question_82486.question: What are the sequence of events for 3D-video streaming in XR graphics?
question_82486.ground_truth: The sequence of events includes the user turning on the device and starting to play the game, establishing a hand-shake between the game app and the server, sending sensor data to the cloud render server via 5GS for rendering and producing multimedia or pre-rendered graphics data, and sending the data back to the use device for multimedia decoding and display.

question_82487.question: What security methods does Diameter use for communication between two diameter peers?
question_82487.ground_truth: Diameter security is provided by IPsec or TLS/DTLS.

question_82488.question: Which specification defines a JavaScript API for performing basic cryptographic operations in web applications?

question_82490.question: What is IP address preservation in the context of handover to non-3GPP accesses?
question_82490.ground_truth: IP address preservation in handover to non-3GPP accesses is provided with S2a or S2b procedures when NBM is used for providing connectivity and the network supports NBM between the two access technologies involved in the handover.

question_82491.question: What would be the resulting die area if an on-chip power amplifier (PA) was added?
question_82491.ground_truth: If an on-chip power amplifier (PA) was added, the resulting die area would be approximately 5.4 mm2.

question_82493.question: In which procedure does the location management server request location information from the location management client?

question_82494.question: What features does the MPQUIC functionality support for transmitting a UDP flow?
question_82494.ground_truth: The MPQUIC functionality supports various transport modes for transmitting a UDP flow, such as Datagram mode 1, Datagram mode 2, and Stream mode. The PCF selects the specific transport mode to be used for a UDP flow and provides it in the ATSSS rules and N4/MAR rules.

question_82495.question: Which components are responsible for encoding and decoding of error protection coding in the specified scenario?
question_82495.ground_truth: BTS/TRX (Base station subsystem transceiver subsystem) is responsible for encoding and decoding of error protection coding in the specified scenario.

question_82497.question: What new elements are introduced in the FDT to enable the operator to collect File Repair Statistics from a standard HTTP server without using UE Reception Reports?
question_82497.ground_truth: The new server URI elements in the File element of the FDT and a BaseURI element into the FDT enable the operator to collect File Repair Statistics from a standard HTTP server without using UE Reception Reports. The operator can use these new elements to provide session-specific URIs which the UE uses to make file repair requests.

question_82498.question: What is the role of the migration management server in the MC system?
question_82498.ground_truth: The migration management server is used in migration from the SIP core of the primary MC system to the SIP core of the partner MC system.

question_82499.question: What action is taken by the UE upon the expiration of the content switching timer?
question_82499.ground_truth: After timer expiration, the UE should send a SIP INFO message with the Content Reporting Info Package to the SCF.

question_82500.question: What is the base method used for the final decision in ECR if the VAD flag is set and mode is classified as uncertain mode?
question_82500.ground_truth: The base method for decision in ECR is based on open-loop lag values, LTP gain values, and normalized correlation values of the current frame.

question_82501.question: What information is provided by the Max-Requested-Bandwidth-UL AVP?
question_82501.ground_truth: The Max-Requested-Bandwidth-UL AVP indicates the maximum requested bandwidth in bits per second for an uplink IP flow.

question_82502.question: What should the MME do during an overload situation to prioritize certain types of traffic?
question_82502.ground_truth: During an overload situation, the MME should attempt to maintain support for emergency bearer services and MPS while restricting the load for UEs that access the network with low access priority.

question_82504.question: In clause 4.2.7.1, which security functional requirement is associated with VNFM's authorization to access VNF's API?
question_82504.ground_truth: The fourth requirement is "VNF shall check whether VNFM has been authorized when VNFM accesses VNF's API".

question_82505.question: What is the purpose of the adaptive post-processing procedure known as anti-sparseness processing?
question_82505.ground_truth: The purpose of anti-sparseness processing is to reduce perceptual artifacts from a sparse fixed codebook vector in the audio codec processing function.

question_82507.question: In which network scenarios is the S9 reference point used?
question_82507.ground_truth: The S9 reference point is used for case 1, which is a network without a gateway control session, and for cases 2a and 2b in both HR and VA scenarios, where a gateway control session is needed.

question_82508.question: What information can be obtained from the P-Access-Network-Info header field in a REGISTER request to the AS?
question_82508.ground_truth: The AS can obtain information about the served user core network in REGISTER requests from S-CSCF, which can be obtained either from the P-Access-Network-Info header field and P-Visited-Network-ID header field in the REGISTER request or can be obtained from those header fields in the body of the REGISTER request.

question_82509.question: What format constraints should be followed for Representations conforming to the H.265/HEVC Full HD HDR Operation Point?
question_82509.ground_truth: The requirements as defined in clause 5.4.3 and 5.7.3 should be followed. The video track should be encoded using the requirements and recommendations for H.265/HEVC Full HD HDR Operation Point as defined in clause 4.5.5.

question_82510.question: What must the AMF do when it receives an elapsed time from RAN indicating UE unreachable and the UE's CM state is in CM-IDLE?
question_82510.ground_truth: The AMF should deduce a Mobile Reachable timer value based on the elapsed time received from RAN and the normal Mobile Reachable timer value. If the Mobile Reachable timer expires, the AMF determines that the UE is not reachable.

question_82515.question: What is the expected average RSSI (at the antenna connection of the MS) for the neighbor cell during the test procedure in 70.6.3.5?
question_82515.ground_truth: The expected average RSSI (at the antenna connection of the MS) for the neighbor cell during the test procedure in 70.6.3.5 is -110 dBm.

question_82516.question: What should the mobile station do when the counter N3104 reaches its maximum value in the contention resolution procedure, as specified in subclause 7.1.3.3?
question_82516.ground_truth: The mobile station should remain in packet idle mode, notify higher layer (TBF establishment failure), abort transactions in progress and continue with cell reselection.

question_82517.question: What should be the measurement reporting delay for the Event W3 triggered measurement report?
question_82517.ground_truth: The measurement reporting delay for the Event W3 triggered measurement report should be less than 500 ms from the beginning of time period T3.

question_82518.question: What do the first digit values in the document version signify?
question_82518.ground_truth: The first digit indicates the document's stage of approval within the TSG.

question_82519.question: What is the procedure when the MC service server switches from 5G to LTE bearers or sessions?
question_82519.ground_truth: When the MC service server performs path switch between 5G and LTE bearers or sessions, there will be a service interrupt, and the functional entity residing in 5GS may be NEF, MBSF, MB-SMF or PCF or PCC related interaction for session creation and related interaction.

question_82521.question: What should the PCF do if the preliminary service information is insufficient to construct appropriate PCC rules?
question_82521.ground_truth: The PCF should provide preliminary PCC rules to authorize the UE requested QoS and packet filters and may apply a dedicated charging key value to indicate to the charging subsystem.

question_82524.question: What system initiates a group call request message with the MCPTT group ID in the setup procedure for an MCPTT group?
question_82524.ground_truth: The affiliated MCPTT user via MCPTT client

question_82525.question: What is the purpose of the test defined in clause 8.2.13.3?
question_82525.ground_truth: The purpose of the test defined in clause 8.2.13.3 is to verify the receiver's ability to achieve throughput under multipath fading propagation conditions for a given SNR, specifically for PUSCH with DMRS bundling.

question_82527.question: What standard IP-based protocols are used in the GAN architecture without modifications?
question_82527.ground_truth: The GAN can be designed to use standard IP-based protocols such as IP over standard lower layers, TCP for GSM/GPRS signalling and SMS, IPsec ESP for a secure tunnel for GERAN user and control plane traffic, IKEv2 and EAP-SIM for authentication, UDP for IPsec NAT traversal and GPRS data transfer, and RTP/UDP for transfer of circuit switched speech and user data over IP transport.

question_82528.question: In what order does the SMF select the CHF when establishing a PDU session, and what are the conditions for using the NRF based discovery and offline only service instances?
question_82528.ground_truth: The SMF selects the CHF in the following order: 1. CHF address(es) with associated CHF instance ID(s) and/or CHF set ID(s) provided by the PCF for the PDU session. 2. UDM provided charging characteristics. 3. NRF based discovery. 4. SMF locally provisioned charging characteristics. For NRF based discovery: CHF instance(s) supporting CHF "offline only" service instances may be selected when the PDU session charging method indicates "offline only" for the PDU session.

question_82529.question: What is the minimum number of transceiver units (TRXUs) required for an Over-the-Air (OTA) AAS BS for UTRA and E-UTRA?
question_82529.ground_truth: For UTRA, the minimum number of TRXUs required for an OTA AAS BS is 4, and for E-UTRA, it is 8.

question_82531.question: What action does the IBCF take upon receipt of the first SDP answer when setting up a terminating session using different IP versions?
question_82531.ground_truth: The IBCF requests the RACS to bind corresponding IP addresses and port numbers from its pool and sends a new SDP answer to the other network.

question_82533.question: What is the duration for measuring Pm-dsg in section 13.6.2.5.4.2?
question_82533.ground_truth: The duration for measuring Pm-dsg in section 13.6.2.5.4.2 is 4500 NPDCCH.

question_82534.question: What is the main objective of Key Issue 10: NWDAF service support to select NF instances?
question_82534.ground_truth: The main objective is to leverage the NWDAF to perform data analytics for assistance in selection of an optimal NF instance where multiple instances of that NF exist within a slice or shared across multiple slices. Consumers of this analytic information can be an SMF used for UPF steering/selection or an NRF.

question_82535.question: What should the UE include in the verification payload's MAC field when calculating the MAC?
question_82535.ground_truth: The UE should include both the initiator's and the responder's identities, the timestamp, and the response message as defined in RFC 3830.

question_82537.question: What should the participating MCPTT function do when a Floor Idle message is received, in the 'M: A conversation is active' state?
question_82537.ground_truth: The participating MCPTT function should check if there is a stored message-sequence-number value associated with the conversation, replace the stored message-sequence-number value with the received message-sequence-number field if the received message-sequence-number value is higher than the stored value, store the received message-sequence-number value and associate it with the conversation if it is the first floor control message received in the conversation, send the received Floor Idle message over the MBMS subchannel, send a Floor Ack message towards the controlling MCPTT function if the received Floor Idle message indicates that a Floor Ack message is expected, restart timer T15 (Conversation), and remain in the 'M: A conversation is active' state.

question_82540.question: What happens when the MCPTT client is in the "P1: ignoring same call id" state and timer TFP7 expires?
question_82540.ground_truth: When the MCPTT client is in the "P1: ignoring same call id" state and timer TFP7 expires, the MCPTT client should clear the stored call identifier and enter the "P0: start-stop" state.

question_82541.question: What does the term "S-NAPTR-based" mean?
question_82541.ground_truth: S-NAPTR-based refers to a technique used in 3GPP networks for performing service selection based on the NAPTR records. It involves the use of the S-NAPTR procedure, which logically outputs a list of host names for a given application-unique string.

question_82543.question: What information does the RAN (Radio Access Network) use to perform per-PDU Set based QoS handling?
question_82543.ground_truth: The PDU Set in GTP-U header and per-PDU set information contained in the QoS Profile received from the SMF

question_82545.question: What happens to all the instances of policy decisions that are not referred to by any PCC rule when the PCF receives a report?
question_82545.ground_truth: They are removed from the SMF.

question_82548.question: What action does the MS take when it receives a REGISTER message containing a LCS Location Notification Invoke component with notificationType set to notifyAndVerify-LocationAllowedIfNoResponse?
